Lin Zitian noticed his admiring gaze and sighed, feeling proud.
[This time, I made the right call. Sigh, it’s not easy sticking close to the ruling class...]
In the arena, Xiao Ya smiled at the ten grandmasters in their respective spots and started the finals, “In this Pill King round, everyone has free reign on what they make. Instead of speed, it will be the highest grade that will crown you Pill King in this Hundred Pill Meeting!”
In an instant, some were worried while others were happy!
Huangpu Qingyun’s side laughed. It went as Lin Zitian said, with the final round based on an alchemist’s true ability.
Tao Danniang frowned. Zhuo Fan was in the Bone Tempering Stage and could only make a 5th-grade pill after giving his all. How was he going to defeat the 7th-grade alchemist Vicious Pill King now?
Yet, by his appearances, Zhuo Fan seemed unconcerned. When Vicious Pill King looked at him, his eyes were filled with fighting spirit.
After losing three rounds in a row, he figured out that the kid couldn’t always rely on schemes. The refining of a 7th-grade pill at the Bone Tempering Stage may be pure fantasy, but...
[Humph, this kid might actually pull it off!]
Zhuo Fan felt the old man’s eyes and waved. He didn’t think the one to believe him the most ended up being his greatest opponent.
“Then, for the purpose of fairness, Drifting Flowers Edifice will provide high-grade ingredients for grandmasters who are missing ingredients.”
Xiao Ya clapped and a lovely group of hundreds of disciples pushed cabinets in the arena.
The cabinets contained ingredients from the lowest grade to the 7th, and even a few 8th-grade ingredients could be noticed.
Swallowing dryly, everyone, especially the alchemists, were now greedily looking over the items.
Like a pack of starved wolves meeting a fresh lamb. Like a pack of perverts meeting a naked and gorgeous lady!
[Damn, Drifting Flowers Edifice is filthy rich.] The sheer amount of ingredients here was not something a third and second rate clans could hope to obtain. Not even a first rate clan could get them easily.
“I invite the grandmasters to choose the ingredients you are lacking for your refining. A word of caution, however, do not get greedy. You need to refine with all the chosen ingredients, otherwise...” Xiaoya’s smile penetrated their deepest thoughts.
Coughing lightly, the people chuckled in embarrassment then began choosing.
In no time at all, they all finished, having returned to their spots. However, Xiao Ya looked around and found one spot empty still.
Looking at the cabinets, Zhuo Fan was there choosing, uh, looting his booty.
He didn’t take his time going from one ingredient to another but stuffed a whole cabinet in his ring and moved to the next. From the 1st grade to the 8th, he didn’t miss one. The crowd was in total shock!
[Dude, can you not so openly rob the Drifting Flowers Edifice?]
Silavin: My god. The comedy! My stomach! Hahaha!

chapters.title: Chapter 146, Shameless Looting
chapters.content:
Chapter 146, Shameless Looting
“Grandmaster Song, y-you...
Xiao Ya pursed her red lips and despite knowing what he was doing, she couldn’t outright say it. Before the three rounds, Zhuo Fan was nothing more than a nameless silk pants, now turned number one famous alchemist. Some token of respect had to be present when addressing him.
[Even as the first in the empire, you still need to be ethical. You should not openly break the rules of Hundred Pill Meeting.]
Xiao Ya was watching him awkwardly. She could neither stand still nor let him do what he wanted. This was a pickle.
Zhuo Fan’s hands paused and raised an eyebrow, “Didn’t you say these are for us? So which is it?”
“Grandmaster Song, I think you misunderstood me.” She explained, “These are only used as complementary ingredients to the ones you have...”
“Yeah, but I am lacking everything!”
Zhuo Fan resumed looting the cabinets.
The crowd was speechless, [You can do that?] The alchemists from before were also shocked silly, thinking they should’ve taken some more when they had the chance.
“Uh, judge! If Grandmaster Song can do it, then there’s no problem if I do it too...” Liu Yizhen licked his lips, looking at Zhuo Fan and Xiao Ya anxiously.
[If I don’t hurry up, the kid will pick them all clean.]
He was a top alchemist, but he sorely lacked ingredients.
Xiao Ya glared, “Grandmaster Liu, don’t make trouble. You’re saying you can use them all in this round?”
Liu Yizhen let an awkward smile, then shook his head on his way to his spot.
With how many ingredients there were, who could refine them all? He couldn’t mess with Drifting Flowers Edifice.
Then again, [Getting a couple can’t hurt, right?]
Liu Yizhen looked again at Zhuo Fan with admiration. He was plundering the cabinets like he was moving house. [Just which clan or sect does he hail? There’s no way a third rate clan kid would dare perform highway robbery right under Drifting Flowers Edifice’s nose.]
“Grandmaster Song, you need to make sure you use all ingredients you are taking. Or there will be serious consequences!” Xiao Ya had gotten angry and changed her tone.
Zhuo Fan’s hand slowed, then smiled inside.
[With how many there are here, how could they be refined in one go? This amount is enough for tens of thousands of pills. Then again, so what?]
Once he got crowned as the Pill King, he’d take the Bodhi Root and haul ass out! The Drifting Flowers Edifice could then do nothing but eat his dust.
So, he might as well get as many treasures as he could. They’d be breaking all ties at the end and it would be such a waste to leave these beauties lying here!
Slowly turning his head, Zhuo Fan grinned, “How do you know I won’t be using them all? I’ll do it in a jiffy, don’t you worry your pretty little head about it.”
He then resumed his shameless picking.
Xiao Ya was close to crying. She never saw a more vile grandmaster in her life.
Refining tens of thousands of pills on the spot? As if! This was daylight robbery!
The crowd watched the darkest horse in this arena, who had displayed alchemy skills more outstanding than even Vicious Pill King, now robbing the cabinets of ingredients.
[To think this grandmaster has balls to rob Drifting Flowers Edifice...]
Yet, Drifting Flowers Edifice did not even try removing him from the premises. After all, who told them to give the alchemists free reign? And what if someone insisted he could refine thousands upon thousands of pills?
[Although far fetched, that’s beside the point. You can only settle this after the competition.]
Xiao Ya waited bitterly for Zhuo Fan to load up his ring.
When he stopped, Xiao Ya was overjoyed, and smiled, “Grandmaster Song, are you ready? Then please return to your spot and begin refining. Everyone is waiting for you.”
Frowning, Zhuo Fan turned to Xiao Ya and his ring flashed, “My storage ring is packed, can you bring me another?”
Staggering, Xiao Ya was about to collapse. The audience’s faces froze.
[Grandmaster Song, you’re too shameless!]
“No, Drifting Flowers Edifice does not provide storage rings.” Xiao Ya roared.
Glancing at her, Zhuo Fan snorted helplessly, “What Seven Noble Houses? So stingy!”
Xiao Ya was close to spurting blood. Thank god she choked on words and the blood stayed inside. She glared at Zhuo Fan with such hatred that she wished she could tear him limb from limb.
[You took advantage of us and still dares to call us stingy? Is there anyone in the world more shameless than you?]
Looking at the cabinets, most of them were empty, leaving only the 1st and 2nd-grade ingredients behind. Xiao Ya was this close to bursting into tears.
These ingredients took Drifting Flowers Edifice a whole year to gather! Some of them were close to a hundred years old before being harvested. Yet, all of them were swept clean by a damn punk.
Drifting Flowers Edifice aimed to show off their power by letting the participants choose their ingredients. But then, this fool came around and nabbed them all.
[Just you wait, brat. If you don’t bake ten thousand pills I will tear you a new one!]
Xiao Ya glared with all her power at Zhuo Fan to comfort her bleeding heart. Her slight, almost ephemeral respect she had for him before now burned in the flames of rage and hatred.
[This punk is a rogue.]
Zhuo Fan had better things to do than care about her opinion. He scratched his nose and went to his spot. [What is fame when tangible stuff is more valuable, he-he-he...]
On the terrace, Xie Tianyang was piqued by his actions, then asked, “Elder Jiu, I heard you and the brat came to become allies. All his ingredients must be coming from Veiled Dragon Pavilion. Why is it that he looks so miserably poor? He was even moved by those 1st-grade ingredients!”
“Humph, when talking about greedy people, even a needle on the ground can move them.” Long Kui berated.
Xie Tianyang raised an eyebrow in thought. [Well, that’s quite true. With this brat’s character, everywhere he goes, not even grass is left.]
Long Jiu muttered under his breath but actually agreed with Long Kui’s assessment, “What little Kui said isn’t without wisdom. This brat sure is greedy. Veiled Dragon Pavilion may be his ally, but we can’t just give him our best ingredients. We can only provide 4th grade at most. But for some reason, the attendant in charge of giving him ingredients suddenly gave 5th-grade ingredients too, and lots of them.
“We later questioned the old and loyal attendant but he would rather take the blame for sneaking the ingredients out than to say anything. Ha-ha-ha, that brat sure has a way with people!” Long Jiu chuckled. His eyes however were especially dignified.
Xie Tianyang muttered, “Damn, I know this brat is vicious to everyone, enemy and friend alike. But he can even dig out Veiled Dragon Pavilion cornerstones?”
“That’s not quite right. The attendant is still fine, working for our house as we speak. Even he doesn’t know what got into him at that time to help that brat out!”
Shuddering, Xie Tianyang and Jian Suifeng looked at each other as they sank in deep thought.
They, who had a certain understanding of Zhuo Fan, now revised their opinion of him. [We must not, by any means, act too friendly with him when we interact.]
[Or he’ll dig out everything from our house.]
The overseers were too focused on what happened in the arena to pay attention to their discussion. With every empty cabinet, their hearts bled harder.
[As the son in law to Drifting Flowers Edifices, he shows not the least restraint when taking our things. But he even goes as far as not leaving anything!]
Chu Qingcheng’s angelic eyes now had a rare hint of killing intent.
[Rotten brat, isn’t what’s yours mine? What are you taking everything for? You’ll soon be returning them anyway...]
Xiao Ya took a few deep breaths to push her anger down.
Boring her eyes into Zhuo Fan, she shouted at the ten participants, “With everyone ready, the Pill King round shall begin.”
Yuan Qi flames were ignited one after the other.
Zhuo Fan was unmoving, however. Xiao Ya gnashed her teeth and spat, “Grandmaster Song, don’t forget, you have to refine all the ingredients!”
Snorting, Zhuo Fan had a smile of disdain.
[You daft? I ain’t that stupid! Wait for me to be crowned Pill King, take my prize, then skip town. What will you do then?]
Boom!
Like a roar of a huge beast, the sound from a blood-colored flame shook everything as it reached the heavens.
The instant it appeared, the alchemists close to it had their flames shriveled up.
Squinting, Zhuo Fan laughed coldly inside.
[Humph, that old coot finally plans to show his true skill...]

chapters.title: Chapter 147, Amazing Display
chapters.content:
Chapter 147, Amazing Display
“T-this...”
Xiao Ya jumped in fright from the sudden strange flame and turned in its direction.
Liu Yizhen smoothened his beard as he gave a chuckling apology to his fellow alchemists behind him, “Ha-ha-ha, terribly sorry, it is the finals and I must give it my all. Do forgive me if I offend anyone.”
No matter how polite he made it sound, his eyes couldn’t hide the pride he felt.
The alchemists swallowed dryly and eyed the towering flame and then, to their own lifeless Yuan Qi kindle, feeling more and more despondent.
How were they supposed to compete when another just snuffed out their efforts?
They watched him with hatred in their hearts but also envy. Just where did this old guy get that flame from anyways?
With that flame, his refining might reach the 6th grade!
Xiao Ya’s eyes lit up and cried, “Grandmaster Liu’s flame must be from a 4th level spiritual beast, the Sky Blazing Python’s heart fire. I heard the Sky Blazing Python spends its time moving underground and its core is influenced by the earth’s fire. It is so hot it can melt anything. No ingredient on this land cannot be refined with it. Grandmaster Liu must’ve been holding onto it for the final round.”
“Ha-ha-ha, you sure are knowledgeable, girl. No wonder you’re the judge. But besides a flame, one must also make use of an intricate refining skill. I have taken out this flame to increase my rank. However, I dare not aim for the crown.”
Liu Yizhen shook his hand with modesty, but his pride was no different from one who thought of himself as the next Pill King.
[Hypocrite!]
Cursed the crowd, in particular, the alchemists who only had Yuan Qi flames and were influenced by the mighty blaze.
He had a reason to be smug of course, with how strong his 4th level spiritual beast flame was.
It not only increased his refining but also slowed down the others’ – killing two birds with one stone. With such a flame, if two people were of equal levels, one would have his refining boosted by two grades.
His confidence was well placed.
[Even you, Vicious Pill King! My flame will lower you from 7th grade to 6th.]
Everyone could make this educated guess just from looking at the faltering flames around him.
Just when the crowd was focused on the battle between Vicious Pill King and Zhuo Fan, it had now gotten even more confusing to whom the crown would place their bets on.
Xiao Ya sighed and watched Liu Yizhen in admiration. He was the true black horse of the Hundred Pill Meeting.
[He hid it well.]
She couldn’t help asking this though, “Grandmaster Liu, I heard that Sky Blazing Python is very rare and strong as a Profound Heaven expert. May I ask how you obtained its core’s flame?”
“Ha-ha-ha, that time was truly dangerous. About a year ago...”
“Humph, you’re so cocky with just a stinking snake flame?”
Just as Liu Yizhen was about to retell his grand and historical venture, of the endless trials of hardship he had to go through, a snort stopped him short.
Then marked by a humming, a small bluish flame flickered into existence.
Its appearance cut the size of all Yuan Qi flames in half. What was even more astounding was the fact that even Liu Yizhen’s beast core flame shuddered as it turned lifeless.
Crying out in shock, Liu Yizhen turned to find Yan Fu holding a raging dark blue fire and sporting a condescending smile.
“T-this...”
Xiao Ya cried, “Is this a 5th level spiritual beast flame, from the Fire Swallow?”
“Indeed!”
Yan Fu laughed coldly and mocked Liu Yizhen, “I have bested you in the imperial capital, Old Liu, and I will do it again today. Don’t get carried away in thinking the Pill King title is yours! Ha-ha-ha, how laughable. You think you’re the only one in this world with a special flame?”
Beet red, Liu Yizhen felt his anger boil but had no leeway to complain.
He had to admit that a top alchemist was more than capable of getting himself a 4th level spiritual beast flame. The least of all Yan Fu, who was Pill King Hall’s core disciple!
[Sigh, I was too naive.] In the end, who could compare with the Seven Noble Houses?
Liu Yizhen gave a wistful sigh. Before he could rise completely, another one came to knock him down to his place. Now recalling the smug look from before, it only worked to color his face red.
“Uh, young master Yan, Fire Swallow is a 5th level spiritual beast that even Radiant Stage experts have trouble defeating! How did you get its flame?” Xiao Ya’s eyes were riveted on the flame.
Grinning, Yan Fu swept his eyes over Tao Danniang and the rest of Drifting Flowers Edifice’s female disciples and laughed, “This flame was bestowed by Pill King Hall to me, the greatest of its disciples. As for how, humph, Pill King Hall needs only to want something and it will soon have it.”
His words didn’t reach the average disciple because of the competition’s noise, but Chu Qingcheng and her overseers heard it clearly, and glared at him.
Even Tao Danniang’s green face turned gloomy and terrifying.
But he couldn’t care less as he began introducing it in his arrogance, “Alchemy is the balance of yin and yang. Old Liu’s flame may perhaps be from a 4th level spiritual beast, but the earth fire is too violent, unfit for refining pills. My flame, on the contrary, is fire yet it holds some water, it is also water yet it contains fire. Thus fire and water combine and yin and yang intertwine. It is the most fitting flame for alchemy. And only Pill King Hall’s men know how to find such a flame, and so, the only ones who can be Pill King is...”
Suddenly, a green flame appeared before him.
The common Yuan Qi flames shrunk again, and Liu Yizhen with Yan Fu’s spiritual beast flames were also cut down to size.
Emerging like a beast king from deep in the mountains, the other flames prostrated before it.
Yan Fu squinted and looked at Tao Danniang’s green flame in shock, “Y-you... that...”
“Humph, your Fire Swallow flame is best suited for alchemy? You will first have to ask this 6th level spiritual beast flame of mine, the Moon Fire Falcon’s flame.”
[What, a 6th level spiritual beast?]
This caused widespread shock.
Not even a Radiant Stage expert would dare mess with such a being. Just how did Tao Danniang get hold of this marvel?
Xiao Ya grew happy inside. Tao Danniang was from Drifting Flowers Edifice, after all, and praised, “Aunt Tao, how did you obtain the flame of a 6th level spiritual beast?”
“Humph, girl, why ask when you already know. You think my old body has the skill to go pull the life fire from the belly of a 6th level spiritual beast?”
Tao Danniang cursed as she eyed Yan Fu, then the further away Vicious Pill King. [Trying to shake Drifting Flowers Edifice’s prestige?] Then she shouted, “This is a fire is passed down in the Drifting Flowers Edifice to its best alchemist.”
“Girl, remember, this is not a flame that can be sought. The Moon Fire Falcon flies thirty kilometers above and comes out at night to absorb the moon’s yin while eating the spiritual herbs in the mountains. This makes its flame have the essence of the moon. It can increase the grade of a pill in refining. How can a mere Fire Swallow’s flame compare to it?”
Under the guise of teaching Xiao Ya, Tao Danniang was in fact speaking loudly to jab at Yan Fu.
Yan Fu gnashed his teeth but kept silent. A 5th level beast flame was a cut short compared to a 6th level beast flame. Not to mention, the Moon Fire Falcon ate many spiritual herbs in its life, making it far stronger than Fire Swallow.
This ultimately made it unfit for comparison.
Tao Danniang stuck her chin out in pride and mocked, “Pill King title is only fit for Pill King Hall, is it? Humph, punk, be careful of making too big a boost and unable to back it up!”
Shuddering, Yan Fu glared at her as he barked, “Old hag, don’t get too happy. I am just a junior, not your match in alchemy. But don’t forget, I’m not the best alchemist in Pill King Hall. My master, Vicious Pill King is.”
Yan Fu turned to Vicious Pill King and shouted, “Master, open the eyes of these ignorant fools and let them see your true strength.”
The people turned their attention to Vicious Pill King, waiting for the best alchemist in the empire to let out his best skill.
Only the few grandmaster alchemists who used Yuan Qi flames felt like crying looking at the puny flames in their hands.
[Grandmasters, you’re all so rich you all have beast flames. But we are dirt poor, using the weakest flame made of Yuan Qi.]
[Have some mercy and don’t take out an even more amazing flame or our Yuan Qi flames won’t take it. We won’t even be able to cook rice, let alone pills...]

chapters.title: Chapter 148, Heaven and Earth Spirit Flame
chapters.content:
Chapter 148, Heaven and Earth Spirit Flame
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Silavin
“Master...”
Yan Fu’s call echoed in everyone’s ears, but Vicious Pill King seemed oblivious. His eyes fixed on one place only.
It happened even at Yan Fu’s second call.
Following his sight, what lay at the end was the first spot where Zhuo Fan stood with his arms crossed and eyes closed.
In Vicious Pill King’s eyes, this opponent was the only one who could light his competitive spirit.
Taking a deep breath, Vicious Pill King shouted, “Kid, don’t you have any other special skills in store for this final round?”
Flashing his eyes open, Zhuo Fan shot him a look and snorted, “If yours truly has or not, what’s it to you?”
“Quite a lot actually. I want to have a showdown with you, a fair competition. If you’re still hiding your skills, then I shall be using the flame that had been with me for years to win. But if this is all you had to offer, I won’t take advantage of your plight. Even keeping my flame hidden, I can still beat you just with a plain Yuan Qi flame.”
[Such bold words!]
The people’s hearts shivered, their faces gloomy.
If Vicious Pill King said this before, none would have anything to comment. Just who could beat the best alchemist in the empire?
But now, after losing to Zhuo Fan three times, his words were akin to an empty boast.
[Oh please, don’t you recall how Grandmaster Song, pissed, sneezed and farted you out of the second spot? If not for wasting half of your shriveled life, you’d never even be in this round!]
[It happened just a few minutes ago. Did you go senile, you old coot?]
Not only Chu Qingcheng looked derisory at him, but the rest of the audience as well.
But Vicious Pill King only had eyes for Zhuo Fan. Anything else, even the despising glances directed to him, were of no consequence.
Zhuo Fan squinted and snorted, “Humph, then let yours truly enlighten you. I indeed have hidden one skill. Don’t you worry your old little head about it and go all out. The title of Pill King will be mine regardless.”
“Ha-ha-ha, alright. Then I shall rest easy. You are the first opponent in decades that can make me exert all my ability in alchemy. Please, after you.”
Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan asked, “Why do you want me to go first? Shouldn’t we both do it at the same time?”
With an ambiguous smile, Vicious Pill King showed a proud expression, “Youngster, I’m not bragging when I say that even with your great refining skill, you won’t finish that pill once I let out this old flame of mine. In hope that you can exert your best, I will start after you finish. It wouldn’t matter if I finish a bit later. This round is based on the grade after all.”
Zhuo Fan’s mouth perked at one corner and almost laughed.
[The old coot has total confidence in his flame.] But so did he in regards to his azure flame, his secret weapon. Just that it got him wondering which was stronger, his azure flame or the old coot’s?
[There is no doubt. Mine is better.] It was one of those treasures that the Demonic Emperor would covet.
Smiling, he said, “Since Elder Yan is so sure, by all means, take out your flame and let us all widen our horizons. While also letting me know if I should just give up right now.”
“Yeah, master, just let them see your might!” Yan Fu cheered.
Laughing, Vicious Pill King never felt more excited as of this moment, “If you want to see it so much, then here it is.”
With a cackling laughter, a white fire burned in Vicious Pill King’s thin hand. Then, a wicked face appeared within the flame.
That cackling laughter actually came from it.
Its appearance snuffed out all the Yuan Qi flames around. Liu Yizhen, Yan Fu and Tao Danniang’s beast flames acted as if something dreadful appeared and shrank to half their size, as if prostrating before their king.
Shock was an understatement, as even Zhuo Fan’s eyelids trembled.
[Who knew this old guy was actually hiding something so valuable?]
“T-this...” Tao Danniang was scared out of her mind. Yan Fu raised his head in pride and laughed, “Do you see that? This is the flame master chanced upon a decade ago, the heaven and earth spirit flame, Bone Soul Truefire!”
[A heaven and earth spirit flame?]
Sss~
Those words evoked gasps of sheer amazement from all around. The people watched the evil face in Vicious Pill King’s hand and their hearts sighed.
Even the alchemical disinclined knew that the heaven and earth spirit flame was made from gathered spiritual energy of heaven and earth that over millions of years and had gained spirituality. The flame was actually alive, a veritable king among flames.
The 5th and 6th level beast flames were nothing compared to it.
The flame was the body while the wicked face was the spirit of the Bone Soul Truefire. It not only could refine any kind of ingredient but also amplify their effects and raise the grade of the pill. It was every alchemist’s dream to have one.
Vicious Pill King was the best alchemist in Tianyu for a reason after all. Now, no matter what secret refining skill Zhuo Fan used it, would be of no importance.
Did you not see how the Yuan Qi flames got snuffed, they couldn’t stand its power. Even those beast flames were shirking away.
Three things were of most importance to an alchemist, cultivation, refining skills, and flame. When the flame was wilted from the pressure of another, winning was impossible!
Sighing, the people turned to Zhuo Fan, shaking their heads in pity.
[How sad, an extraordinary alchemist was so close to beating the best alchemist in Tianyu but under the flame’s suppression, failure is imminent. If he fails here, we will lose another genius. The Heavens must be truly jealous of geniuses.]
The thought didn’t even cross their mind if Zhuo Fan, with how young he was, and his background, had a flame that could counter Vicious Pill King’s heaven and earth spirit flame.
Since not even the seven houses could pass along such flames. This old guy’s luck had to be off the charts to stumble upon the Bone Soul Truefire.
Sensing everyone’s fear and awe of it, the white flame’s face cackled madly in excitement. The laughter was jarring to the ear and filled with boundless despise. Just like a ruler who won andlorded over his enemies.
He-he-he...
Tao Danniang sighed and closed her eyes. If she knew the old man to have such a spirit item, she wouldn’t have wasted her energy and just gave up.
Then again, now that she recalled, the one who won three times against Vicious Pill King was none other than him.
Tao Danniang turned to Zhuo Fan and shook her head.
[Not even the brat can get out of this one...]
Chu Qingcheng frowned in worry. She was looking at Zhuo in hope he had a way to turn it all around. But Zhuo Fan’s face never wavered. He was always calm, as if he was in deep thought.
The overseers were beside themselves in worry. Only Long Jiu’s group was unphased. According to Zhuo Fan’s plan, winning wasn’t a must. At worst he’d just bolt.
On the eastern stand, Huangpu Qingyun’s group had long since started laughing.
“The old man actually had such a treasure hidden. Losing now is impossible, ha-ha-ha...” Huangpu Qingyun laughed, “Vicious Pill King is definitely worthy of his title!”
The others nodded, with the happiest being Lin Zitian.
At some point, he tied his fate with Vicious Pill King over a reason not he was sure of. But now that Vicious Pill King was at an advantage, the second young master was excited and he was basking in the glory nearby.
“Elder Lin!” Huangpu Qingyun smiled.
Lin Zitian rushed next to him, “Yes!”
“The moment the kid loses, rush over, and take his head. Understandd?”
Startled, Lin Zitian said, “Why me? Isn’t Elder Yan supposed to do this?”
Squinting, Huangpu Qingyun snorted, “If he were to move, Qingcheng would be sure to block him. I do not wish to further alienate her from me. Your Merry Woods is focusing on speed, so taking the kid’s head in an instant is easy. Qingcheng would be enraged but would not dare to make everything worse over a dead man.”
Realizing what he meant, Lin Zitian gave a thumbs up, “Nice, second young master is truly wise!”
The other men felt their stomachs churning as they secretly cursed him for being shameless.
Huangpu Qingyun’s smile seemed to say everything was dancing in his palm.
But just then, the crowd froze in shock seeing Vicious Pill King’s flame swayed around Zhuo as he laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, brat, now you know why I told you to go first? Even if you have a beast flame, it won’t do you any good with my Bone Soul Truefire out.”
“Didn’t you want to get your hands on the Bodhi Root?” Zhuo Fan was still calm.
Taking a deep breath, Vicious Pill King seemed to recall something and laughed, “Yes, I indeed want it. But what I want more is to win against you fair and square. To see who among us shall be the best alchemist in Tianyu. Defeating you because of the flame’s power is not something I will ever accept.”
Zhuo Fan looked long at him.
[He may be shameless and despicable, cunning and vicious, but when all is said and done he is a tough grandmaster alchemist. It’s kind of a pity for him to be in the Pill King Hall.]

chapters.title: Chapter 149, The Monarchic Azure Flame
chapters.content:
Chapter 149, The Monarchic Azure Flame
A wicked grin plastered on his face, Zhuo Fan seemed to have something special in store.
Yan Fu’s heart seized. He understood his master’s intention and wanted to advise against it, but Vicious Pill King shook his hand.
“Did the old fart turn senile?” Huangpu Qingyun sensed the situation spiraling into an undesirable direction and clenched his fists.
Lin Zitian wiped the cold sweat from his brows, his mind was on edge.
[Old coot! You’re vile and wicked, so why the hell are you doing the exact opposite at a crucial time like this? Cut the righteous act, both our lives are at stake here!]
Catching the eastern stand’s people’s reaction with a side glance, Zhuo Fan swiveled his eyes on Vicious Pill King, “Old man, I appreciate the thought, but there really is no need for that. It’s best you go ahead and refine.”
Vicious Pill King stared at Zhuo Fan in astonishment.
Zhuo Fan’s words were backed by unfaltering confidence. He did not propose to do it together and see who was stronger but directly urged Yan Song to go fist.
[Does he have an even stronger flame than Bone Soul Truefire?]
[He fears that his flame will affect my own.]
Vicious Pill King’s heart trembled, but he couldn’t find it in himself to believe that the world could house a stronger flame than the heaven and earth spirit flame.
“Ha-ha-ha! Youngster, don’t brag. Taking your age and background into account, the most you can afford is a 4th level beast flame. You think it’s enough to stand toe to toe with mine?”
Vicious Pill King was probing Zhuo Fan, who only smiled.
Such action only made Zhuo Fan look more mysterious that even the rest were at a loss for words. [You’re telling us that Grandmaster Song has a mystical flame that can stand against your Bone Soul Truefire?]
[This would make the final round more exciting.]
[Two grandmasters, two heaven and earth spirit flames, fighting toe to toe for the crown.]
In a blink, the crowd’s nervous eyes landed on Zhuo Fan, eagerly awaiting his answer. Chu Qingcheng and the overseers were especially nervous.
In terms of refining skills, Zhuo Fan was a cut above Yan Song. Coupled with a possible heaven and earth spirit flame, this could all work to compensate for his weak cultivation.
Only Xie Tianyang felt disdained as he laughed, “Don’t go and believe his hosh-posh people. That brat is up to his neck in faking again. He is in a battle of minds with the old man. I’ve seen this trick too many times to count.”
Long Jiu and the rest nodded.
With how deep and twisted the kid’s plans went, it was very much plausible to be a tactic of his to unnerve Yan Song.
Today’s events proved it. Yan Song himself suffered at Zhuo Fan’s schemes again and again, making him grow cautious.
After some careful thought, he laughed, “Kid, I am frank with you but yet you still use such petty tricks to mess with my head. The same tactic won’t work on me again.”
“What makes you think I am?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow.
“Humph, by no means do you have a heaven and earth spirit flame, perhaps not even a beast flame. You are only pretending so as to disturb my mind. You used these cheap tricks in the previous two rounds already, and you want to do it again?”
Shaking his head, Zhuo Fan sighed, “Vicious Pill King, you have such a low opinion of me. You take yours truly as nothing but a vicious and petty schemer whose plans only amount to lying about having a heaven and earth spirit flame to mess with your head? Is that what you think my plans amount to? I’m hurt!”
Pausing, Vicious Pill King realized it was indeed so.
Zhuo Fan may have sneezed and farted, nothing but petty tricks, but it hit right when it hurt him the most. Each and every time, his focus crumbled at the most crucial moment. If his mind was not as strong, he would’ve long devolved into chaos, unable to continue refining.
Compared to the last two times, Zhuo Fan’s words now were a bit disbelieving, but not enough to affect his mind.
This only threw Vicious Pill King into even deeper confusion.
In his eyes, Zhuo Fan had become an enigma, whose every gesture and random act were filled with intricate mysteries. Never had he encountered such a baffling opponent in his life.
[Damn it, who’d have thought picking a fight with this punk would end up becoming a torment.]
Vicious Pill King couldn’t come to a conclusion even after some long and hard thinking. He just gnashed his teeth in the end and howled, “Brat, no matter what flame you have, take it out. I want to have a fair match with you so stop jumping at every shadow!”
“It is because I have the same wish that I do not want to reveal it. I still insist on letting you go first.” Zhuo Fan sneered, “If I do take it out, you might lose your desire to even compete. Starting together would end in your loss, no doubt about it.”
His words sounded even more cocksure than Vicious Pill King’s from before. They were so outrageous that none of the people there believed him.
[A flame that can cow the best alchemist in the empire to surrender just at the sight of it, does it even exist?]
Not even Vicious Pill King was that outrageous before pulling out his white flame.
[Dude, take a closer look. He holds the lord of the flames, a heaven and earth spirit flame. Even if you have the same kind of fire, it will only result in a tie.]
[Even if by some off chance it is stronger, how much could it actually be compared to Yan Song’s?]
[You’re saying your flame is so freakish that it can suppress a heaven and earth spirit flame just as the latter suppresses beast flames?]
[Did the world even have such a thing?]
“Humph, he’s clearly faking and bragging yet none of his words sound believable.” Xie Tianyang mocked.
Vicious Pill King laughed, “Kid, you take me for a three-year-old? The world does not have such a savage flame. If you can take it out, then I will directly kowtow three...”
Suddenly, his voice was choked with the appearance of an azure flame above two of Zhuo Fan’s fingers. It was as calm as candlelight, unimpressive in the slightest.
But this plain azure flame descended on the world like a monarch. Its invisible pressure befell like a mountain.
The cackling Bone Soul Truefire now seemed to have found its nemesis and scurried back into Vicious Pill King’s body, never to come out again.
Not even at Vicious Pill King’s incessant urgings.
If a heaven and earth spirit flame was so decisive, then Liu Yizhen’s, Yan Fu’s and Tao Danniang’s beast flames were even worse.
They had no spirituality but they nonetheless trembled under the azure fire’s pressure and died out.
When the monarch of flames descended, no common flame dared to burn!
All the fires died out in a blink, even the other alchemists’.
Only Zhuo Fan’s frail azure flame let out a soft glow.
The shock was incomprehensible. Even Vicious Pill King stared slackjawed.
“W-what is this? The heaven and earth spirit flame ran?” Vicious Pill King’s body was swaying. He was the owner of Bone Soul Truefire and could feel it shivering in fear, “What flame is that?”
Zhuo Fan looked at his azure flame with a smile, “Who knows? It’s been given to me anyway.”
His cheeks twitching, Vicious Pill King trembled.
[Why is it that I wasn’t lucky enough to have someone give me such a strong flame?]
When he chanced upon the Bone Soul Truefire, he’d been so thrilled he couldn’t sleep a wink for how much fortune smiled upon him. He could’ve died happy!
But here, now, in Zhuo Fan’s presence, his bit of luck was lackluster, to say the least.
“Now, do you still want to refine?” Zhuo Fan snickered, letting the azure flame sway in front of him.
Vicious Pill King’s eyes reddened from envy. How the hell could he still refine? His entire mind was set on that frail flame.
He was almost consumed by the desire to just seize it.
Zhuo Fan laughed, knowing perfectly well what Yan Song was thinking, “Now do you believe me? Well then, Vicious Pill King, let me ask you. Who’s the petty one?”
Vicious Pill King felt like crying.
[Goddamn it! This punk is unfathomable! Three rounds ago he spoke not a grain of truth and now he said the most unbelievable things yet it turns out to be the whole and unfurnished truth!]
[Curses! His plots are too sinister for me to unravel!]
Despite being filled with regret, Vicious Pill King still reddened as he admitted, “Pardon me, Grandmaster Song. I have wrongly mistaken a gentleman for being petty.”
“Ha-ha-ha, lighten up. It’s enough to know that I’m a perfect gentleman.”
Zhuo Fan laughed and not only made the old man redden harder from shame but even flaunted, “Then, wanna go ahead and refine? Or maybe, together?”
[You joking? Refine with you? How, when any and all flames were snuffed because of yours?]
[I get why this punk said there was no competition if both refined together!]
Vicious Pill King sighed and admitted it despite the humiliation it brought, “Pardons, Grandmaster Song. I was overconfident. I shall go ahead and refine first.”
“Alright. With my generous nature, I shall let you begin.”
Zhuo Fan smiled and took back his azure flame while crossing his arms. Even so, he couldn’t help himself from muttering, “Stingy, how unreasonable!”
His voice may have been soft, but all heard him.
Vicious Pill King staggered. He was truly pissed but felt more aggrieved than anything else.
[I rarely want a fair fight and what do I get? Humiliation. Being good is not all that cracked up to be.]
He was oblivious though that as he was feeling sorry for himself. Zhuo Fan nodded in his mind and his mouth widened into a broad and satisfied smile...

chapters.title: Chapter 150, Authority
chapters.content:
Chapter 150, Authority
>
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Silavin
“Holy cow, he wasn’t faking! The brat did have a card up his sleeve!”
On the terrace, Xie Tianyang stumbled. Then it hit him, “Right, he used the same azure flame against You Guiqi too. I took it as some martial art at the time but now I see that it’s actually a heaven and earth treasure...”
It all made sense now, how he faced Hell Valley’s profound ranked martial art and easily overcame it.
The azure flame could easily handle a heaven and earth spirit flame so it was only natural to be able to deal with You Guiqi’s wicked skill...
Xie Tianyang found himself looking at Long Jiu, “This brat has so much stuff on him that makes him a walking treasury. Are you sure he’s only a third rate clan kid?”
“Why are you looking at me for? I’m as clueless as you are!” Long Jiu snorted then kept watching Zhuo Fan.
Veiled Dragon Pavilion had looked again and again into Zhuo Fan’s history but they always came with the same answer. A servant that never left the Luo clan.
Yet the night of the Luo clan’s demise marked his complete change.
A mere servant took the four-membered Luo clan and pulled it through the crisis. Along the path of remarkable wisdom and deep schemes, he changed the fate of the Luo clan; turning it into a future opponent for the Seven Noble Houses.
Veiled Dragon Pavilion weren’t fools, of course, especially Long Jiu. Their new hatred for Hell Valley was all because Zhuo Fan instigated it.
Yet, even so, they were willing to take this burden for him.
First, just as Zhuo Fan predicted, Veiled Dragon Pavilion was not about to show weakness before their archenemy, Hell Valley. With how deep their hatred was, adding one more debt was of little concern.
Not to mention, in the great battle of Windgaze City, making them carry the killing of those two elders was in fact a favor. Even when he was summoned by the Emperor, the Pavilion Lord was grinning from ear to ear.
It had been years since Pavilion Lord was this excited.
And secondly, Zhuo Fan’s power shocked every one of them to the marrow. Even Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s highly ranked men started discussing with Zhuo Fan when he was but a Qi Condensation cultivator.
None of them could’ve come with a more perfect plan than his.
Sowing dissension, escaping, bidding his time to land the final blow—it all may have seemed simple tactics but their execution would’ve been far from his.
This was something easily understood by reading the two houses’ millennia-long feud.
Moreover, Zhuo Fan was very skilled. Not only he could set up a 5th-grade array, but he also had many long lost ancient arrays.
After so many miracles, Pavilion Lord’s quick decision to cooperate with Zhuo Fan was met with no objection. And that was only because this kid’s actions left everyone unable to unravel his true purpose!
From the looks of it, Zhuo Fan’s change seemed to have started from that fateful night.
Before it, he was just an honest-to-god and shy servant. After it, he changed into the sinister and cunning steward that none in the seven houses could compare with.
That night was the crux. But what did happen that night?
Taking a deep breath, Long Jiu was filled with confusion trying to pick some hints by looking at the smug figure, only to sigh in the end.
[He may very well be the only one who knows the answer to this riddle...]
Totally oblivious of Long Jiu group’s comments, the overseers had long been skipping in joy at seeing Vicious Pill King taken down a peg, again.
Just like some 16-year-old girls, blushing to the ears.
This was the finals after all. Pushing the old man back would help in increasing his chance of winning it.
Xiao Dandan had never seen her senior aunt and master so happy in her life. She knew they were happy and so was she, raising her pretty face in pride.
As if to tell the world, [Here comes my man!]
As Chu Qingcheng saw that figure growing in authority, her heart grew with love, though still reserved enough not to be so frank about it as Xiao Dandan. But her eyes couldn’t hide the warmth and feelings she had for him.
On the eastern stand, Huangpu Qingyun’s elegant visage was now twisted in rage.
Even the most oblivious of his men could see he was best left alone, if they valued their life.
But did that mean he wouldn’t come to you by himself?
“Elder Lin!” Huangpu Qingyun squinted and snapped.
Lin Zitian shivered and stood at attention, though his heart was on the verge of crying, “Second young master, orders?”
“Didn’t you promise me that the old fool will win? Well, where is his win? He quoted fairness and offered to let the punk refine first, only to be shamed further. What fairness? He wouldn’t have brought more shame on himself if someone else did that to him...”
“Second young master, Elder Yan isn’t the only one at fault.” Lin Zitian spoke over Huangpu Qingyun to curb his anger, or he would’ve been sent into the fray sooner than needed. At that time, that bastard Vicious Pill King would’ve been long gone and he unable to deal with the kid alone. To safeguard his life, he had to speak up.
He continued anxiously, “Second young master, you saw it too. It’s not Elder Yan who is powerless but that punk is just too... too freakish!”
Lin Zitian stammered for a long time before coming with an apt description, “The heaven and earth spirit flame is the lord of the flames. But who saw it coming that the brat would pull an even more freakish flame rendering the lord of the flames inferior. None of us did!”
Huangpu Qingyun rose his hand at first but soon put it down. He had calmed down somewhat after those words, though his calmness was one that inspired fear. He looked at Zhuo Fan, “Indeed, this is not on Elder Yan, but all because that brat is... too strong!”
This was the first time Huangpu Qingyun admitted Zhuo Fan’s strength.
His men trembled. Their second young master was a man of immense pride who never acknowledged anyone.
Yet here he was praising someone for their strength and was also quite sincere at it.
Perhaps, Huangpu Qingyun’s anger wasn’t because of Yan Song’s setback, but his unwillingness to admit someone could have the same authority as him.
This was something a proud and domineering man like himself would never allow to happen.
Therefore, they all looked at Zhuo Fan as if he was already dead.
And sure enough, Huangpu Qingyun followed with, “Elder Lin, there’s no need to act anymore. I will kill that brat myself.”
“Uh, then what of Edifice Lord Chu...”
Huangpu Qingyun’s eyes flashed with naked killing intent, “I want to avoid fighting with Qingcheng, but I can never find peace until I kill the kid myself!”
His men’s hearts shivered as they nodded.
Whoosh~
Vicious Pill King let out his white flame again and Xiao Ya rushed to stop him, “Forgive me, Elder Yan, but because of your flame and the beast flames, the other alchemists can’t refine. So, to give a fair judgment I can only ask all of you to refine one at a time, from weak to strong.”
“Humph, you want me to give way to them?”
Vicious Pill King snored, “Why should I? It won’t matter even if my flame doesn’t affect them! They don’t rise to even one hair of mine! Giving way to them means wasting my time.”
Tao Danniang grew angry and glared at him. Yan Fu snickered at the side, finding it only natural.
His master was the best in the empire, except the unknown kid that sprung up from who knew where. Who else could match his master?
The alchemists, Liu Yizhen included, were livid, but facts were facts. They had no ways to refute Vicious Pill King and could only sigh.
Xiao Ya found herself in a tight spot.
What was planned to be the finals between ten people, now became a clash of two. Were the other eight alchemists mere decorations to make them look good? What was the point of getting this far then?
Too bad Vicious Pill King was the best alchemist in the empire and was dead set on his decision. The judge could do nothing.
In Xiao Ya’s moment of anxiety and stomping, a lazy voice echoed.
“Old man, since it’s a competition, give them a chance. Why do you have to be so hard?”
This startled everyone and turned to see Zhuo Fan still with his arms crossed and eyes closed, but smiling nonetheless.
Frowning, Vicious Pill King muttered then withdrew his flame.
Those alchemists who had it rough with just their Yuan Qi flames were overjoyed. While the others looked at Vicious Pill King dumbfounded.
Even Yan Fu looked at Vicious Pill King as if he wasn’t his master.
Since when did his prideful master secede just like that because someone said so? [This is mortifying!]
But the fact was, one word from Zhuo Fan was enough to make the grand and arrogant Vicious Pill King renounce his pride.
“What’s going on? Did the old man get a personality change?” Up in the eastern stand, Hell Valley’s fifth elder was filled with puzzlement like everyone else.
What they didn’t notice, however, was Huangpu Qingyun’s even thicker killing intent!
Perhaps he was the sole person here who understood authority.
It was what made others submit completely!
He wielded the same authority, an obvious fact from the people around him that listened to his orders without question. But this authority was bestowed by Regent Estate. As these men submitted to Regent Estate’s power, he could only thus order them.
More clearly stated, they spoke yes while their hearts were against it.
Only Huangpu Qingyun understood that Zhuo Fan had become the man with the most authority here. And his authority was based on the true submission of everyone present. Vicious Pill King was the perfect example, seceding with just some words.
It was all because from the very beginning he grasped everyone’s hearts, letting them take one step at a time in growing their faith in him.
This was the true way of the ruling class in seizing authority.
At first Huangpu Qingyun’s killing intent at Zhuo Fan was rather hazy. He guessed it was because of a conflict of interest. But now he clearly wanted Zhuo Fan dead. After Lin Zitian spoke and Zhuo Fan showed a monarchic flame, he understood perfectly why Zhuo Fan had to die.
He wasn’t as narrow-minded as others thought him to be, that he couldn’t stand someone more powerful them him. His decision to kill Zhuo Fan was because of the feeling he got from the latter. Every time Zhuo Fan did something, it was like an open challenge to his authority.
How could a regent’s authority be so easily challenged?
A mountain wasn’t big enough for two tigers. With two people knowing the way to grasp the hearts of the people, they would fight over authority and only one would come out victorious.
Zhuo Fan had long noticed the killing intent coming from the eastern stand, but he was unfazed as ever, even sporting a scornful grin...

chapters.title: Chapter 151, Clinging
chapters.content:
Chapter 151, Clinging
Going with Xiao Ya’s proposal, the first to start were the five grandmasters who used Yuan Qi flames. They hastily took out their flames and gave a sign of gratitude at the other grandmasters.
Although they were ranked among the best alchemists in Tianyu Empire, Zhuo Fan showed up with his heaven-defying refining skill that made them look as common as muck.
This was clearly showed through the yawns of the crowd.
Their refining resulted in three high and two mid 5th grade pills. Not one could go higher than 5th grade.
The third round had such a grade as the target. Showing it now, in the finals, robbed them of any chance at getting the first place.
They knew of their limits but chose to do it anyway so they could catch the eyes of some powerful clans.
Grinning, Yan Fu patronized, “Master was right after all. Letting those idiots go first was a total waste of time.”
He threw Liu Yizhen a side glance and sneered, “Lu old man, weren’t you bragging about using your 4th level beast flame to freakin press us all down into making a 5th-grade pill?”
“He-he-he, I have no intention to be Pill King. Just getting ahead of a twerp like you and washing away the disgrace is enough.” Liu Yizhen said as he caressed his beard.
Yan Fu seemed to have heard the biggest joke ever, “Ha-ha-ha, old man, losing is losing. What are you doing tacking that cocky tone? Not to mention, my beast flame is stronger than yours. And you still think of besting me?”
“Humph, alchemy isn’t based on flame alone. Last time I lost in terms of speed, but when it comes to refining abilities, I am above you, twerp.”
Liu Yizhen’s hand burned with his beast flame as he threw in all kinds of ingredients. Yan Fu had a constant sneer on his face.
As seconds trickled by, the scarlet flame blazed constantly, illuminating Liu Yizhen’s hard red face. Suddenly, Liu Yizhen spat a blood arrow into the flame.
The fire exploded and a scarlet pill twirled in the air before he caught it.
Liu Yizhen ignored the blood on his mouth as he gasped. He glowered at Yan Fu and revealed a crazy smile as he showed the pill.
“Brat! Tell me, what grade is this?”
Yan Fu stared at the old man and gnashed his teeth in reply. But Xiao Ya yelped, “Grandmaster Liu refined a high 6th-grade pill!”
[Say what?]
The audience was in an uproar. Grandmaster Liu was a 5th-grade alchemist, but he actually managed to refine a 6th-grade pill. This was something not even a fresh 6th-grade alchemist could pull off.
Was it really all because of the 4th level beast flame? Could it be...
Whoosh~
Yan Fu cut their second-guessing short by letting his blue flame out. The raging tongue of flame shined in his pair of eyes as if they themselves contained a deep fire within.
Whoosh~
Ingredients flew into it one after another, refining and mixing. He did it with such practiced ease that it looked no different than eating, earning no few praises.
Zhuo Fan was too awesome earlier, so Liu Yizhen and Yan Fu’s limelight got smothered. People now bore witness to a youth, who, while not as freakish as Zhuo Fan, was by all intents and purposes a genius of alchemy.
He was indeed an expert alchemist hailing from Pill King Hall!
Suddenly, Yan Fu also bit his tongue and spat blood essence. It fused with the blue flame in a blink.
Liu Yizhen’s pupils contracted as his weak body trembled. His lips parted but no words could come out from the sheer shock that grasped his mind.
Whoosh!
The fire vanished and a bluish pill shined. He grabbed it and showed it to Liu Yizhen. Yan Fu was pale and blood dripped from his mouth, painting a gruesome image when coupled with his smile, “Old man, tell me, what grade is this?”
Looking closely, Liu Yizhen shook his head sullenly. He was now too dejected to even reply.
Yan Fu let out an unrestrained laughter.
Xiao Ya flicked closer and looked in shock, “Young master Yan Fu refined a low 7th-grade pill!”
[What?!]
The audience exploded. [There was now another 7th-grade alchemist in the Pill King Hall besides Vicious Pill King? And one so young at that?]
At the side, Tao Danniang couldn’t help sucking her teeth.
[They’re both insane. They have no shot at becoming the Pill King with Vicious Pill King around so why still refine with blood essence? Is their grudge so deep to warrant such illogical action?]
Losing a drop of blood essence meant an injured vitality that could persist through years. If one was careless in their recovery, it could lead to permanent damage, worse would be stunted cultivation.
An alchemist would never use such a method unless the situation was dire.
[Vicious Pill King did it to barely qualify. You two, however, the hell you just up and harmed yourself for some simple refining?]
Tao Danniang cursed them inside but was in fact hesitating.
She was a 6th-grade alchemist who should’ve had no problem with these two. But god knew what got into them, using their blood essence to refine. Yan Fu even managed to land a 7th-grade pill.
If she too didn’t bleed, Yan Fu would win. [What goddamned face will I have left then?]
Gnashing her teeth and stomping, Tao Danniang’s eyes flashed with resolve and the green flame appeared in her hand.
[I’ve been at this even before you were born. You think I have lost my touch?]
Ingredients spiraled inside the flame. When it was almost done, she also bit her tongue and spat a blood arrow.
When the flame died out, Tao Danniang’s weak body reached for the pill with a gleeful smile.
“Heavens! It’s a mid 7th-grade pill!”
Xiao Ya’s outcry agitated the crowd. Only Yan Fu and Liu Yizhen looked at her puzzled.
“Old hag, we decided on settling our accounts from the imperial capital alchemy competition. So what are you trying to pull?”
Ugh!
Tao Danniang almost spat blood in anger. But seeing the two of them confused, her face went red and tried to cover it with a snort, “I’ll have you know that there is a mountain beyond a mountain as there’s someone above another. You too have a long way to go. Don’t let yourself caught up in thinking only you two exist in this contest. You need to set your eyes further into the distance. There are many adversaries ahead.”
Tao Danniang sighed and through this lesson, she recovered her bearing.
But the two weren’t grateful in the least.
“Old hag, we focused on each other because we wish to settle a score. How does this have anything to do with you?”
Yan Fu raised an eyebrow and spoke vaguely, “You think we don’t know of mountains beyond mountains and someone above another? Aren’t they clearly master and that brat? What’s the point of even saying it?”
Liu Yizhen nodded in full accord. [These two are prime examples. What are you trying to teach us?]
Tao Danniang sank into silence, lost for words.
Seeing the two of them sporting wise gazes, she was itching to kick them. [You think I’d waste blood essence to uphold my reputation if it weren’t for you two morons doing it first in your dumb fight?]
[I wanted out of this awkward situation with my name intact, but you bastards aren’t even giving me that.]
[Speaking of which, I can expect it from this prick, Yan Fu, since he’s from Pill King Hall. But what of you, Liu Yizhen? So old and you don’t know how to show some respect?]
Tao Danniang gnashed her teeth in rage.
But no one cared about her.
At this moment, all eyes were on Vicious Pill King. Despite this round being a showdown between ten contestants, it was in fact between only two.
Squinting, Vicious Pill King stared hard at Zhuo Fan.
Whoosh~
With an evil laughter, the Bone Soul Truefire reemerged. He was in no hurry to throw ingredients in, choosing to spit blood essence again.
“Master, no!” Yan Fu cried.
Vicious Pill King already did this in the third round, harming himself. If he did it again then he would be left with scarring injury, or worse, die from severe trauma.
But Vicious Pill King no longer cared.
How often did he meet a real opponent? To defeat Zhuo Fan, his greatest adversary, he was willing to do everything he could, even pay with his life.
Vicious Pill King then threw ingredients in the flame, getting it refined in an instant in the Bone Soul Truefire, mixing along with his blood essence.
Suddenly, Vicious Pill King spat blood essence again.
This shocked even Tao Danniang. [Has the old man lost it? It may increase the pill’s grade greatly but it will also threaten his life.]
Vicious Pill King hardly cared. His eyes filled with endless madness...
Yan Fu fell to his knees, with tears streaming down his cheeks, “Master, what happened to you...”
Whoosh~
Only now did the ever relaxed Zhuo Fan open his eyes, watching Vicious Pill King with an even gaze.
But noticing Zhuo Fan watching him, it got Vicious Pill King even more excited...

chapters.title: Chapter 152, Cradle Returning Dragons
chapters.content:
Chapter 152, Cradle Returning Dragons
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Silavin
Whoosh~
The raging flame made a clear contrast with Vicious Pill King’s wane face. The once imposing and tough old man now appeared frail and with one foot in the grave. His body swayed in the breeze, a moment away from collapsing.
But he clenched his teeth and persevered. He grinned at Zhuo Fan, who was looking back at him, with excitement.
As if to challenge Zhuo Fan, Vicious Pill King’s gestures changed and the flame soared.
Losing blood essence three times in a day along with supplying so much Yuan Qi had taken its toll on his aged body. Sweat began to fall from not just his face as his hands grew paler and seemed to age with the naked eye.
But his eyes danced in joy as he saw the pill slowly form within the flame.
His behavior even stirred the sympathy of those who hated him to the core, including Chu Qingcheng and the overseers.
“Vicious Pill King is vile and twisted, but one had to admit his alchemy skill is worthy of admiration. He lives up to his name as the first alchemist in the empire.” Long Jiu sighed in praise.
The others nodded, watching Vicious Pill King with the same feelings.
Despite being on opposite sides, a hero was worthy of respect.
Bone Soul Truefire was indeed a heaven and earth spirit flame. And in the expert hands of Vicious Pill King, the pill was completed in no time at all.
The pill was ready to be taken out of the inferno.
But right at this moment, Vicious Pill King spat more blood essence!
Everyone was nervous when it entered the fire. A humming spread and the Bone Soul Truefire burned hotter.
At the same time, a pill shined brightly and flew out of the fire with a cackle. The sound of the laughter was in fact the same as Bone Soul Truefire’s.
“Vicious Pill King bestowed the pill with spirituality!” Long Jiu sighed in amazement. The others looked on in shock at the incredible dancing pill.
It was a known fact that a heaven and earth spirit flame could instill spirituality into a pill, but doing it was a whole another matter.
In Tianyu Empire’s thousand-year-old history, there had been accounts of alchemists possessing a heaven and earth spirit flame, but none of them were able to refine a living pill.
This rumor came from outside the borders. But for such an alchemist to appear even after such a long time, it was still rarer than rare. The entire continent might not have had such a genius appearing over the last half millennia.
But Vicious Pill King had done it!
Zhuo Fan with his dazzling performance had made the people neglect this number one alchemist in the empire. But now he used his power to prove he was still the best.
With a gesture, the pill entered his hand and Vicious Pill King’s hair started swirling in the air. He slowly raised the pill in Zhuo Fan’s direction, his eyes recovering their pride and arrogance.
He was weakened but let the people see this old man teetering towards collapse like a lofty giant.
“T-this...”
Xiao Ya opened and closed her mouth speechless. In the end, she finally managed to express her doubt, “Odd, the pill looks to be above the 7th grade but not quite in the 8th. What does it mean?”
Squinting, Vicious Pill King didn’t respond. Only stared rivetingly at Zhuo Fan.
It was an open provocation.
Chuckling, Zhuo Fan said, “It is without a doubt a 7th-grade pill, albeit a perfect one. If you insist on defining it, you can call it a grade skipping pill. But it is in fact this kind of pill the hardest to refine in one’s alchemical journey. It may be a 7th-grade pill, but it’s worth supersedes a common 8th-grade pill.”
The crowd was in complete shock!
This was their first time hearing of a 7th grade pill that exceeded an 8th grade pill. Even some low-grade alchemists were dumbstruck.
Though the 5th-grade alchemists and above were fully aware of the reason.
There were, in fact, some alchemists who had a hundred percent chance of refining 5th-grade pills that could touch upon how to reach the perfect quality. But never, even after they entered the 6th grade, had they achieved it.
Thus 6th grade pills were easy to refine, while perfect 5th-grade pills were nigh impossible.
To them, refining a grade surpassing pill was a talent among talents.
Talent was already needed to become a high-grade alchemist, but for refining a perfect pill one had to be a genius.
It was clear Vicious Pill King was such a man.
In an instant, the people’s image of Vicious Pill King grew exponentially.
Vicious Pill King, however, didn’t care about such things. His eyes were on one man only. That man was the sole person qualified to make him stake his life in this competition.
Following his eyes, the crowd’s sight landed on Zhuo Fan. They now knew why Vicious Pill King went all out in this refining, even risking his life to make a perfect pill. It was all to beat the strongest opponent he ever had.
They were all watching Zhuo Fan eager to see his reaction.
A clash between heavyweights, a match among peak grandmaster alchemists was a rare occurrence. After today, none may get the chance to see another again. This only worked to raise their spirits higher.
Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan began pondering.
None disturbed him either in the deafening silence that ensued. Yet the people’s eyes were fixed on Zhuo Fan, not leaving him for even a blink.
With gloom ever-present on his face, Huangpu Qingyun’s killing intent only grew. The more Zhuo Fan could grasp the hearts of the people, the more threatened he felt of his authority.
He was certain of one thing, Zhuo Fan had to be dealt with.
Long Jiu’s group frowned, waiting for Zhuo Fan’s next move. Chu Qingcheng and the overseers watched on edge.
The strangest thing that happened was Chu Qingcheng no longer cared about the prevalent grudge between Pill King Hall and Drifting Flowers Edifice. Her mind was solely preoccupied with Zhuo Fan, of how he would respond to Vicious Pill King.
In this tense atmosphere, even the crowd forgot this was an alchemy contest, only caring about the match between two peak grandmaster alchemists.
It mattered not who won, because they were waiting for the two of them to give them the shock of their lives.
After a moment of deep thought, Zhuo Fan let out a long breath and his face revealed a mysterious grin, “So that’s how it is. Let’s give it a try.”
Chuckling, he turned to Vicious Pill King, “Any man who spat blood essence five times is bound to die. Old man, you did it four times today, which was quite impressive. If I don’t get it together and show something special, I would only be insulting you.”
“You are correct!” Vicious Pill King grinned fearlessly and as excited as before.
There was nothing more thrilling than seeing one’s greatest opponent answering his challenge by going all out.
Zhuo Fan noticed his excitement and chuckled as he walked next to his cauldron.
With him moving, so did the countless pairs of eyes. Zhuo Fan was now the center of attention, the life of the party. His every gesture stirring the hearts of many.
Rustle~
He leisurely lit up the fire and snapped his finger. Tens of spirit stones revolved around the cauldron before falling into an intricate and bizarre shape.
The people looked at each other dumbly.
[What is Grandmaster Song doing? Setting an array? What did that have to do with alchemy?]
Even Vicious Pill King as well as the rest of the alchemists were clueless of his intention. Since time immemorial, alchemy and arrays never intersected. What was his purpose?
Ignoring the baffled audience, Zhuo Fan’s hand made a sign and chanted, “Heaven’s gate, earth’s locks, open for me! Let thy spiritual energy flood this array! Assist my heavenly fire in opening its eyes! Let spirits and dragons enter this pill!”
The world quaked and with it, the Drifting Flowers Arena started to rumble.
Everyone was rattled, not knowing what was happening.
Right then, creepy laughter echoed as dark shadows from all directions flew towards Zhuo Fan and revolved above his head.
Then they slammed into the core of the array.
At the same time, Dragon roars echoed and dragon images flew from the core of the array, under the gobsmacked faces of everyone.
When the world stopped shaking, the shadows were gone and the sky was crowded by nine dragon images.
Zhuo Fan snapped his finger and threw an azure flame into the cauldron.
The dragons seemed elated as they flew around agog before slamming inside the cauldron.
In a blink, a deeper dragon roar was heard and an azure fire dragon burst out of the cauldron.
It was then followed by the other 8. The azure fire inside the cauldron was now gone, absorbed by the dragons.
With his eyes flashing, Zhuo Fan grinned as his hands danced.
Hundreds of ingredients took to the sky at that moment.
“Secret pill array, Cradle Returning Dragons!”
Zhuo Fan shouted and the nine fire dragons responded with a roar before flying into the ingredients floating about...

chapters.title: Chapter 153, Dragon Transformation Array
chapters.content:
Chapter 153, Dragon Transformation Array
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Silavin
Boom!
The thunderous roars rang in people’s eardrums. It then followed with a resplendent light, so glaring that they couldn’t open their eyes.
Once the light died out and the nine dragons’ roars passed, all the ingredients were gone from the sky.
But under closer attention, one could see that the nine fire dragons had changed. Within their body made of azure flames, a line coursed through them like a blood vessel.
But instead of blood, it was flowing with the ingredients extracts.
Instant refining!
The people watched Zhuo Fan incredulously.
They recalled Zhuo Fan’s Ninth Heaven Roaring Dragon Claw with which he instantly refined 3rd-grade pill ingredients. But he had now achieved the same result with hundreds of 7th-grade pill ingredients.
Such speed raised his refining skill to another level of comprehension.
Even Vicious Pill King had to admit, he could not accomplish such a feat. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have taken this Bone Tempering brat as his strongest adversary.
This was just the start of everyone’s shock. The greatest awe was how the nine dragons had different colored mixtures flowing through them.
Zhuo Fan just up and separated the ingredients in the instant they were refined.
Speed refining seemed simple, but it touched upon one’s control over the ingredients and his flame. A stronger flame would ruin the ingredient while a weak one wouldn’t refine them.
Regarding the difficulty of control, each successive ingredient grade would be like vaulting heaven. This was the wall that had so many alchemists standing before it, unable to advance.
Zhuo Fan’s instant refining needed absolute control, which was even harder. Not even Vicious Pill King could do it.
Zhuo Fan not only did it but went a level further in his control, separating the hundreds of ingredients into nine types.
This was something Vicious Pill King didn’t think was possible.
Some pills, especially poisons, needed the extracts divided, followed by careful mixing. The Pill King Hall’s poisoned palm was no exception.
It turned refining into a very precise task, with every ingredient refined independently. One blunder would add impurities and ruin the batch.
Yet, Zhuo Fan refined nine types of ingredients in a flash. Such accuracy was something the audience could not even begin to fathom, and this was what got Vicious Pill King so overwhelmed.
How did the world give birth to such a mystical refining skill and such an outstanding genius alchemist?
Hu~
As Vicious Pill King had known, this step was the hardest when making pills. Even Zhuo Fan couldn’t help but let out a breath when this step was completed.
The perceptive Xiao Ya knew Zhuo Fan was at a crucial step and didn’t disturb him. Now that he relaxed, she couldn’t reign in her curiosity any longer, “Grandmaster Song, what was that secret skill, it is no lie to say that it shook the world?”
“Ha-ha-ha, a mere pill array, a simple little array to help in refining.”
Zhuo Fan chuckled and turned to Vicious Pill King. His provocation, however, was loud enough for everyone to hear him, “For a high-grade pill to become a grade surpassing pill, it has to have spirituality. Using blood essence to make the heaven and earth spirit flame’s spirituality instill a spirit into the pill is one way. But that’s too dangerous. If all alchemists did it, nine out of ten would die. Truly idiotic!”
Vicious Pill King’s eyelid twitched, feeling the naked irony within. This brat was teaching him a lesson. Like a senior teaching his juniors. This stung him hard.
But Zhuo Fan’s words were correct. Vicious Pill King would’ve never braved such danger if he was but a greenhorn alchemist.
“Then, did you also instill spirituality into the pill, Grandmaster Song?” Xiao Ya asked in awe while looking at the nine majestic dragons.
Nodding, Zhuo Fan had a cocksure grin, “Spirituality is instilled only by pouring heaven and earth spirituality into the pill. A heaven and earth spirit flame has such a property, albeit incomplete. The soul of a heaven and earth spirit flame is merely formed over millions of years within the earth by accumulating the spirits of the earth. Just take out the spirits and you can instill spirituality.”
“Does that mean those gray shadows were the spirits of the earth?”
“Correct. Spirits are all around us, just that they do not persist for long, nor do they have awareness. The locations of the seven houses were chosen with dense spiritual energy in mind. A place like that gives birth to many spirits, but not just anyone can find them.”
Chuckling, Zhuo Fan pointed at the array, “In the long-forgotten past, alchemy and array were one specialty. But as there were many different sects, alchemy and arrays diverged, to the point many ancient arrays are lost. The array that I set up today is the ancient Dragon Transformation Array. It draws the spirits around and transforms them into dragon spirits. Not a true dragon, mind you, but one containing just a hint of a true dragon spirit’s might. A striking difference from a heaven and earth spirit flame’s spirituality formed over millions of years.”
Despite the shock they were in, Zhuo Fan’s words brought them further amazement. They had endless admiration for him.
This pill array was in no ancient book, moreover, no one had heard of it either. But Grandmaster Song not only had vast and widespread knowledge about all aspects but even grasped the intricacies of a pill refining array.
Considering all the secret refining skills he displayed today, there might not be a second one like him in the entire continent, least of all this empire.
An Exalted of alchemy!
Vicious Pill King couldn’t be clearer on this. However, he still clung onto a thread of hope. He may have lost in terms of refining skills, but he won over Zhuo Fan in terms of cultivation. The possibility of victory was still there.
Zhuo Fan chuckled, as if in response to Vicious Pill King’s thoughts. Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed and his hand signs changed.
The nine fire dragons roared and whipped their tails in the center of the array.
Boom!
With an earth-shattering noise, the nine tails collided. They broke off from the dragons and crumbled down into flames that ultimately mixed together.
With another roar, the flame burst into nine dragonlings. These dragonlings’ blood vessels were of the same color, flowing azure.
The erudite found it incredulous how Zhuo Fan refined the nine concoctions into a single mix in an instant.
Instant refining again!
A moment of extreme importance, one that required perfect control, was done in a blink. This got even those grandmaster alchemists peeved.
[Grandmaster Song, your refining skill is great and all, but can you please tone it down?]
[Are you doing all the hard steps so casually just so you can rub our faces in it? Would it hurt to take at least a second while doing it?]
They were all in envy and depression over the might of such an exotic refining skill.
Roar!
The nine tailless fire dragons roared and charged to the center of the array. This time, head first.
Boom!
As before, the nine tailless dragons blended into a sea of fire. The next moment, another nine dragonlings emerged from the blaze.
And just as the first nine dragonlings, these had the same azure bloodstream.
Eighteen roaring dragonlings were truly an impressive spectacle.
“Ha-ha-ha, time to wrap it up!”
Squinting, Zhuo Fan’s hand flashed and a small bottle appeared. He opened it, releasing a soothing smell filled with vitality.
Bodhi Jade Sap!
With trembling eyes, the grandmaster alchemists watched Zhuo Fan in shock and puzzlement.
They all knew Bodhi Jade Sap was Drifting Flowers Edifice’s treasure. So how did it end up in Grandmaster Song’s deft hands? Was he Drifting Flowers Edifice’s...
It all started to make sense! But even so, the shock was immense. [Where did Drifting Flowers Edifice find this Exalted Grandmaster Song?]
In today’s alchemy competition, he smacked the face of Pill King Hall for no less than a hundred times.
The structure of Tianyu’s alchemy system was going to change. Pill King Hall was no longer at the top. Such a change had countless implications.
It was a known fact that Pill King Hall was the imperial family’s pill supplier. If they weren’t the best in Tianyu, why would the imperial family buy from them?
People started to draw conclusions.
Drifting Flowers Edifice’s Hundred Pill Meeting was a platform for Pill King Hall, to show off their own skills.
But how could the ordinary masses have known? Behind the scenes, Vicious Pill King alone had almost driven the entire Drifting Flowers Edifice to collapse. Meanwhile, Zhuo Fan was not even specifically invited by the Drifting Flowers Edifice to deal with Pill King Hall’s Vicious Pill King.
If the masses had known, they would most likely have the same expression as those from Drifting Flowers Edifice?
The two overseers were smiling. Zhuo Fan might not have been invited by them, but he was, nonetheless, Drifting Flowers Edifice’s son in law.
With Zhuo Fan at the helm, Pill King Hall would be held in check!
Chu Qingcheng was thinking the same thing. She was rejoicing that her rash action proved to be a choice with incredible implications towards better!
Only Zhuo Fan begged to differ. He was only doing what he had to...

chapters.title: Chapter 154, Transcending Pill King
chapters.content:
Chapter 154, Transcending Pill King
“Ashes to ashes, dust to dust. Let the dragon’s feast perfect the pill!”
Zhuo Fan’s shout was followed by a vigorous shake of the hand, sending 18 drops of Bodhi Jade Sap into the air. The 18 dragonlings acted like cats catching the smell of fish, nabbing a drop each.
Roar!
As the dragonlings roared, their body dissolved into azure flames followed by their heads and leaving a ball of azure fire.
Then the fire scattered to reveal upon the world a shining azure pill. It released a soothing smell, gripping the hearts of everyone there.
“W-what grade is it to have such an astonishing effect?” The people stared unblinking at the 18 dancing pills.
These pills had yet to renounce their dragonic nature, roaring as they traveled the sky.
All 18 of them were clearly alive. What got people so distraught was that while Vicious Pill King nearly gave his life to make just one, Zhuo Fan flipped his hand and there went eighteen of them dancing across the sky.
This feeling was something words weren’t enough to describe. Just how many times did one need to surpass Vicious Pill King’s skill to breach this gap?
There was no need for judging at this point. Everyone was dead set that Zhuo Fan was the winner. And this time, his victory was perfect, incontestable, thoroughly crushing the opposition.
Taking a small bottle, Zhuo Fan waved for the 18 pills. He put them inside without even letting Xiao Ya take a single peek.
Xiao Ya was alarmed, “Grandmaster Song, the pills you refined...”
“No need to see them.” Zhuo Fan cut her off with a shake of his head. He turned to the dumbstruck and collapsed Vicious Pill King and muttered, “I won!”
Pure confidence.
The whole crowd watched the calm and proud Zhuo Fan with a sense of awe. They looked at him as if he was their sole king.
His cocky and obnoxious attitude came back in full force as well, making them all bend their knees.
[In alchemy, I am the first. Who dares claim my throne?]
Zhuo Fan stood there, quietly, giving the grandmaster alchemists a whole new meaning to how small they felt.
He was a true Pill King. A Pill King with unquestionable authority!
Xiao Ya was the closest to Zhuo Fan. She bore the brunt of his aura, but was fast to recover also, “Grandmaster Song, I’m convinced you have gone beyond mere winning. But please, explain to us, what grade are they?”
“18 pills, all of perfect 8th-grade quality!” Zhuo Fan deadpanned.
The crowd erupted in surprise. The grandmaster alchemists knew he exceeded their imagination, but never knew the full extent of it. How sheerly unbelievable it all was.
Vicious Pill King could refine a perfect 7th-grade pill and he was already at the peak of his skill.
When people saw the 18 pills, despite the shock, they only went as far as thinking Zhuo Fan refined them as perfect 7th-grade pills. It was more than enough to surpass Vicious by many times.
