But this little prick went even further beyond anyone’s guess. He not only surpassed him but went a full grade above.
Perfect 8th-grade pill. That was something not even a 10th-grade alchemist could accomplish consistently, least of all 18 of them in one breath.
Such heaven-defying skill was only mentioned in legends, hearsay. How could it ever be a reality, here and now?
This cheeky little prick was that much of a monster?
They shouted at him in their hearts, but they could not hide the sheer admiration and respect they held for his incredible refining ability.
Vicious Pill King himself was floored. His green hair became white under the naked eye. He aged dozens of years in just one breath.
It was an astonishing defeat. Vicious Pill King never had suffered such a thorough and complete loss. It left him with no chance of a comeback.
This Pill King had discovered today that his refining ability was nothing when faced with a true expert. The despair, the grief, was harder to bear than even death.
Yan Fu watched his master’s loss with a pained heart. He flicked a glare at Zhuo Fan, but all he could do was gnash his teeth.
[This brat is too damn strong. Master was never his match. And I will never get the chance to catch up to him either!]
As there was a man beyond the next, so was a sky beyond another. It was such an apt description that no one could refute it.
He took master as his role model. Acting as brash as him, thinking his master was the best alchemist in the world. But then came the day his master was defeated, hopeless of even taking revenge.
Such a gap was no different from a chasm...
Tao Danniang ought to be going wild with joy seeing Yan Song’s crushed spirit. But it never came. Every new wave drove higher than its predecessor, who died on the sandy beach.
Didn’t Yan Song’s defeat mark the end of their generation of grandmaster alchemists?
The world was going to be tumultuous. A warrior of the new generation was already standing on their corpses, breaking the grounds of a new age.
Turning to Zhuo Fan next to her, Tao Danniang was grateful.
Fortune helped them to have him as Drifting Flowers Edifice’s...
Long Jiu and the rest watched it all with a sigh.
“Goddamn it, this prick sure knows how to act. He said it wasn’t clear that he could lose against Vicious Pill King. And the end result? Not only did he win, but got a freaking perfect win! And not just a perfect win, but crushed him thoroughly!”
Xie Tianyang couldn’t help cursing to high heavens despite the shock, “For god’s sake, just look at Vicious Pill King. He got his life scared out of him by that brat... even I feel sorry for him!”
Long Jiu nodded gravely, “The brat is beyond ruthless. He won’t let the other have anything left. A single perfect 8th-grade pill was more than enough to win it by a landslide, but he went as far as to make 17 more, striking a fatal blow to Vicious Pill King. I fear he might never recover from this trauma for as long as he lived.”
“You’re speaking of... a heart demon?” Xie Tianyang raised an eyebrow.
Nodding, Long Jiu’s eyes flashed, “Even without it, he may never get to refine a high-grade pill in his life. That brat’s vicious retribution leaves everyone in dread!”
They all had to nod at that.
“Then the Pill King of this Hundred Pill Meeting is... “
As the crowd raved, Xiao Ya pointed at Zhuo Fan while shouting. Before she could finish, however, quick steps were heard approaching.
Zhuo Fan was slowly and calmly walking towards the center stage. Xiao Ya was startled, “Grandmaster Song, what...”
“Only I have the right to declare myself as Pill King!”
Throwing that casual sentence, Zhuo Fan didn’t even look at her and walked past her.
The crowd was in awe again, [He has the aura of a king! He is without a doubt this generation’s Pill King!]
Xiao Ya suddenly forgot she was the judge here and blushed a bit. She was so lost in Zhuo Fan’s flair that she forgot to do her job.
Xie Tianyang sighed enviously, “He is an expert at putting on airs. When will I get the chance to do the same I wonder? Just one time is all I ask.”
Under the chaotic shouts from all around him, Zhuo Fan arrived before the stage. He swallowed when he saw the wooden box and a weight fell off his heart.
[Chu Qingtian, wearing your cloak up to this point, I can rest at ease to say that I have returned your sister’s debt.]
Zhuo Fan let his cloak fall and walked on stage.
The people were struck into silence. They saw the cloak spread on the steps of the stage and the words on it and were moved.
“Heaven-toppling... Pill!”
It all started with a murmur, but it soon grew into an ear-splitting roar. They all started to pump their fist and join, “Heaven-toppling Pill, Heaven-toppling Pill, Heaven-toppling Pill...”
Indeed, Pill King was far beneath a man of Zhuo Fan’s caliber. In their hearts, only this title, Heaven-toppling Pill, was fit to Grandmaster Song’s genius.
Chu Qingcheng covered her mouth, her eyes flowing with tears.
The people acclaimed Zhuo Fan as Heaven-toppling Pill, but it was in fact Chu Qingtian’s wish. Zhuo Fan had taken her little brother’s place and fulfilled his cherished wish.
Her eyes on him now contained an even deeper love.
Vicious Pill King was in a daze as he heard the roars and looked at the four words on the stage’s steps. He seemed to be both crying and laughing, “Heaven-toppling Pill. I never thought there was a man in this world who’d use these words. Qingtian, I have lost today at his hands, and yours...”
Vicious Pill King seemed to have lost it. But his eyes seemed to have realized something as they got clearer...
Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan was cool, despite the turmoil banging his ears. He did not look at the cloak again, as it had no more sway on him.
He did what he had to. He paid the favor he owed. And now followed with his true objective.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes turned colder and reached for the wooden box on the pedestal.
But with a sudden sound, a golden fist caught him off guard, “Punk, you are far from worthy of taking the Bodhi Root!”
“Watch out!”Chu Qingcheng paled at the danger he was facing, but her warning came too late.
The iron fist struck Zhuo Fan square in the chest.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes suddenly turned vicious! His act as Song Yu was done. Now, it was time for the Demonic Emperor, Zhuo Fan, to reenter the scene...

chapters.title: Chapter 155, True Demon Revealed
chapters.content:
Chapter 155, True Demon Revealed
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Silavin
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan vanished the next moment. Huangpu Qingyun’s heart was in distress. How could a Bone Tempering kid escape his sneak attack?
Thunder rolled and Huangpu Qingyun’s heart froze, feeling danger creeping up on him.
His only reaction was a slight tilt of his head.
Whoosh!
A flash of lightning streaked past his face, drawing blood. Huangpu Qingyun’s forehead was soaked with sweat.
He had a keen danger sense, otherwise his head would have rolled off his shoulders.
Bam!
He may have avoided the killing blow, but a hammer blow shot into his belly. He felt pain down to his marrow as if a cannon shot at him.
With a rumble, he flew back and created a three meter wide hole in the Drifting Flowers Arena wall.
It all happened in a blink. It was unclear how he was even attacked, only to ultimately end up through the wall.
The snicker on those on the eastern stand froze. [What was going on? How did Huangpu Qingyun lose when he was the one with greater power, when he was the one at the advantage?]
His opponent was but a Bone Tempering kid!
Aghast, the people looked towards the center stage only to feel their faces twitching.
Zhuo Fan was standing there in all his glory, with the Lightning Wings flickering behind him. His leg was still high up, the clear reason behind Huangpu Qingyun’s setback.
Those wings, could they be...
“Zhuo Fan!” Hell Valley’s 5th elder gnashed his teeth in malice. His eyes filled with killing intent.
This was unbelievable to the crowd. They once heard of this demon Zhuo Fan and the sensations he stirred. Of his lightning wings and his ruthless savagery.
Who could’ve seen it coming? The one to defeat Vicious Pill King four times, the one to transcend the title of Pill King, Heaven-toppling Pill, the same Grandmaster Song, was in fact the one and only Zhuo Fan.
Even Chu Qingcheng and Drifting Flowers Edifice’s people were in a state of shock. That vile and deceitful demon of a man was in fact the pigheaded, blunt, and oafish Song Yu?
[They had absolutely nothing in common!]
Or more aptly put, Zhuo Fan’s performance was so convincing, he got everyone dancing his tune!
“Did you know he was Zhuo Fan all along?” Peony Overseer asked Long Jiu’s group.
Nodding, Long Jiu stroked his beard with a chuckle, “Indeed. And our friendship with the kid isn’t shallow either!”
“What will you do now? Are you going to join him in fighting Hell Valley and Regent Estate?” Iris Overseer frowned in worry.
They all saw Huangpu Qingyun’s power. Now that he had three other houses helping him, they were out of their depths. But that wasn’t the worst part. This was a turning point. Once they joined this fight, the damage was done, and the seven house war would erupt.
With how precarious Drifting Flowers Edifice’s state was, their end was guaranteed!
They did not want to see it come to pass. However, Hell Valley’s number one offender, Zhuo Fan, came out of the closet. Now the seven houses were split in sticking for Zhuo Fan or wishing to kill him.
Drifting Flowers Edifice held a grudge against the party who wished to kill Zhuo Fan. Therefore, they could not join them. On the other hand, Zhuo Fan’s side was the weakest, doomed to fail.
Iris Overseer and Peony Overseer were in anguish, on the verge of tears.
[You got smacked again and again so many times before, but why do you appear now, in front of so many people? Wose, in front of your enemies! Why are you making it so hard on us? Drifting Flowers Edifice never offended you, so why are you looking to harm us?]
Xie Tianyang could guess what they were thinking and gestures dismissively, “Don’t you worry now. There’s no need to join this miserable battle. We plan on sitting back as well.”
“You won’t help him?” Peony Overseer was puzzled and glad. Puzzled since he always said he and Zhuo Fan went through thick and thin together, but not willing to help him now when it matters. Glad, since they could play innocent. Since no one was going to help him, then Drifting Flowers Edifice needn’t bother themselves with other people’s problems.
However, seeing them so callous, Xiao Dandan was fuming mad, “Humph, and you call yourselves brothers while afraid to lend a hand when it matters. If you won’t help him, I will.”
Xiao Dandan just started running when Peony Overseer dragged her back.
“Don’t go cause trouble, missy. That Zhuo Fan has a vile reputation. Who knows what he was planning while hiding in Drifting Flowers City? Why are you still treating him like your husband? And how come you’re more infatuated then before?” Drifting Flowers City cussed.
Xiao Dandan felt chagrined, “Master, I finally found a good man and I just can’t sit by and watch him die.”
“Miss Dandan is so virtuous, worthy of me calling you sister in law.”
Xie Tianyang giggled, “Don’t you worry your pretty little head. This is all part of that brat’s master plan. He even warned us not to get involved and to believe in him to see this through to the end.”
“What? Is this true? Or are you just saying this to shift the blame and pull the wool over my eyes? ” Xiao Dandan suspected him.
The others laughed with a shake of their heads and even Peony Overseer felt bitter.
[Foolish girl, who do you think they are? If people of the seven houses say they won’t go save him, then that’s what they’ll do. Why would they go and lie to a lass?]
Seeing her suspicion not in the least dispelled, Long Kui let out a disarming giggle, “Lady Dandan, that brat didn’t want us to interfere, afraid that Regent Estate would target us and affect the rise of his clan. Which reminds me. This is all part of a selfish aim of his. Why would a ruthless and devious savage such as him show kindness otherwise? Why would he burden himself with the lives of others otherwise? This brings me back to the chaos that happened in Windgaze City between us and Hell Valley. He took advantage of the turmoil and killed two of their elders, while making us take the fall...”
“You are not allowed to speak ill of my husband! Can’t you see it’s all because of his intelligence?” Xiao Dandan cut her off with an irritated tone.
Shaking her head, Long Kui remained silent. [What’s so good about him anyway? What got this grown-up lady so delusional over him?]
Ignoring her martial niece, Iris Overseer looked at Zhuo Fan then at Long Jiu, “Uncle Jiu, you say that he wants to carry this by himself. But how is a Bone Tempering cultivator able to deal with four houses ganging up on him and flee with his life? Will you intervene if his death is certain?”
Long Jiu paused for a long time, then nodded with unyielding conviction, “Yes, he is the brother I believe in without question.”
“I as well. I owe him a debt.” Xie Tianyang grinned, then chuckled at the tall figure in the arena, “However, we are probably overthinking things. He got this in the bag.”
“What!? He can actually escape under the eyes of four experts?” Peony Overseer jolted, “That would make him just as the rumors spoke of, a freak. These four are renowned figures of the Profound Heaven Stage.”
“Ha-ha-ha, he is without a doubt, a freak!” Xie Tianyang laughed, “I also do not know if he can escape, but I know from his fight with You Guiqi. He is no oaf. As long as he set his mind on something, he will see it through to the end.”
They all had to nod at this and returned to watch the events unfold.
Crash!
With a burst, Huangpu Qingyun flew out of the rubble. There was dust all over him, but otherwise, not a scratch on him.
He however knew full well how his belly hurt.
Feeling his belly carefully, Huangpu Qingyun watched the winged Zhuo Fan solemnly.
He underestimated him for having a Bone Tempering cultivation, but in fact, Zhuo Fan’s speed wasn’t the only one transcending stages, his body’s power too.
As a fellow body cultivator, Huangpu Qingyun knew how difficult Zhuo Fan could be. What surpassed this, however, was the shock of finding someone with a more savage body cultivation method than Regent Estate’s Imperial Tyrant Body Art.
Easing his leg down, Zhuo Fan’s face was ever the same, calm and unfeeling. He opened the wooden box in his hands and breathed in deeply. The root was finally his.
Grinning from ear to ear, Zhuo Fan put the box away and ignored the flabbergast looks of everyone as he turned his attention to Hundred Pill Meeting, “Second young master, didn’t you say something about being unworthy of Bodhi Root? Ha-ha-ha, as you well know, as the Pill King of this Hundred Pill Meeting, I am rightfully entitled to it.”
“You little shit, you won’t live enough to enjoy it!” Huangpu Qingyun’s eyes exploded with killing intent.
Shrugging, Zhuo Fan chuckled a retort, “If yours truly took it, I am least afraid of someone taking it from me!”
Whoosh!
With a sudden sound, Hell Valley’s 5th elder flashed not ten meters from him. He glared, “Punk, you’re that Zhuo Fan who killed 7th elder! Don’t even think of denying it. Many from Hell Valley saw those same lightning wings when you committed the crime!”
“When did I ever say the contrary? He-he-he, then again, who else out there is brazen enough to openly steal what one of the seven houses covet?”
Zhuo Fan’s face slowly changed to his original appearance.
Despite knowing it was coming, the crowd was still filled with panic. Zhuo Fan’s face was the same one on Hell Valley’s kill order.
The crowd devolved into chaos as each ran which way.
The fight between the killer of Hell Valley’s mastermind – You Guiqi – Zhuo Fan and their 5th elder was not something these first, second and third rate clans would dare involve themselves in.
If by some disaster, they would get killed from a stray attack, they wouldn’t even have time to lament.
Despite such fears, they couldn’t help feeling sorry for the magnificent Heaven-toppling Pill, Grandmaster Song, ending up to be the demon Zhuo Fan.
Under the seven houses’ encirclement, the only ending was with one’s head on a pike.
Regardless if he was the demon Zhuo Fan, or the freak Zhuo Fan, how could either of them escape from the seven houses’ entrapment?

chapters.title: Chapter 156, Savage Like a Tiger
chapters.content:
Chapter 156, Savage Like a Tiger
Chu Qingcheng’s thoughts aligned with the rest.
She gazed upon the changing yet unmistakably proud face with incertitude.
Zhuo Fan had lied to her from the start, yet he did not once do something to disappoint her. It turned out that with his intervention, all the crises were laid before her, unraveled, waiting for her to solve them with ease.
She came to believe that she and Drifting Flowers Edifice owed him. Now there was no reason for her to hold back from helping him avoid the danger he was in.
However, that only applied if he was anyone but Zhuo Fan. After all, he killed Hell Valley’s 7th elder.
If she chose to stand up for him, Hell Valley would soon be knocking with a war on her door. Regent Estate and Pill King Hall would never miss the golden opportunity either. Thus marking the end of Drifting Flowers Edifice.
She was deep in thought for a while before coming to a decision. Chu Qingcheng gnashed her teeth and her eyes shined with conviction as she took a simple step.
[Death is nothing, since today is Drifting Flowers Edifice’s judgment day. Without this man’s help, Vicious Pill King would’ve gripped the whole of Drifting Flowers Edifice in a mere two days.]
Rather than struggle on death’s door, ending alongside the man she admired with a bang didn’t seem like a bad way to go.
Chu Qingcheng’s gait became firm and nodded at Tao Danniang, “Aunt Tao!”
Clear on her intention, Tao Danniang sighed as she grew resolute as well.
But right then, one red and one blue silk ribbon held them tight before lifting them on the terrace.
“I knew you two were foolish, but thankfully I managed to stop you.”
Peony Overseer and Iris Overseer released the ribbons and sighed. Xie Tianyang then rushed to explain Zhuo Fan’s intentions.
The two were alarmed, unable to comprehend how a Bone Tempering cultivator could face four Profound Heaven experts. It was impossible even to a freak like him.
Shrugging, Xie Tianyang sighed, “I’ve fulfilled my end and told you of his wishes. If you still wish to be reckless, all you’ll be doing is ruining his plan. His anger will be on you!”
“Let’s see him dare get angry at me!” Chu Qingcheng shouted. But soon, she realized this was not the time for casual bickering.
With a rotten smile, Xie Tianyang spoke in circles, “Edifice Lord Chu, you have no idea of the extent of that brat’s retribution. By the time you find out, you’ll be left in tears. He-he-he...”
Chu Qingcheng watched the arena mystified.
At the same time, Huangpu Qingyun and Zhuo Fan turned towards the terrace as if in sync.
Huangpu Qingyun was worried Chu Qingcheng would stick out for Zhuo Fan. He didn’t want to fight her and now he could finally put this worry to rest. Meanwhile, Zhuo Fan was even more concerned. If Chu Qingcheng stood up, his plan would go up in smokes.
Two rivals were actually willing to pause over a woman.
“Brat, it’s time you pay for my 7th brother’s misery with your life!”
Suddenly, Hell Valley’s 5th elder charged Zhuo Fan. His body exploded with power and ignited into a scarlet flame as he swung at Zhuo Fan.
The fist was filled with rage and thrown in haste, but it kicked up a storm. Zhuo Fan couldn’t even breathe from its power, as if a mountain was crushing him.
[5th layer of Profound Heaven Stage, and a body cultivator too!]
His pupils contracting, he although had an inkling of the man’s power, it exceeded his expectations.
Despite being a Profound Heaven expert as well, he was in a different league from You Guiqi. Zhuo Fan weighed it thoroughly and came to the conclusion he was far from this man’s match in body power.
[But everyone has a shortcoming. Your flesh might be steel, but I have two blades behind me!]
With savagery in his eyes, Zhuo Fan stood his ground. The Lightning Wings warped into sickles and attacked 5th elder.
One hacked the flaming fist, the other his face.
Zhuo Fan was willing to accept this heavy wound if it meant the death of his opponent.
Seeing the incoming sickle, 5th elder stomped. With an explosion, he stopped in his tracks and flew backward.
The wings missed and with a boom, a 5 meter hole was left behind three meters from 5th elder.
Wisps of black smoke drifted above the hole.
Feeling the icy sweat trickling down his head, 5th elder expression turned grave. He no longer charged recklessly.
He now knew how You Guiqi met his end.
[This brat is too vicious. Not only to his enemies, but even to himself.] It may look advantageous exchanging a wound for a kill, but he would open himself to others, a pig ready to be slaughtered.
To make such a savage decision in a split second showed how cunning and ruthless he was!
The 5th elder was beginning to worry about the upcoming battle. What if the brat up and chose to take them both down?
Such an ending would be meaningless.
The worried people on the terrace watched in shock. [Is this the rumored demon Zhuo Fan? He is indeed a monstrosity.]
Yet, the women from Drifting Flowers Edifice came to find he was sporting one hell of a domineering air.
In this state, where Zhuo Fan was the weakest in terms of cultivation and number, he exuded the aura of the strongest, one who looked down on others with pride.
While Huangpu Qingyun’s team, the one with higher cultivation and number, was bleak and distressed. Their stance looked to be the weakest of the two sides!
The previous exchange between 5th elder and Zhuo Fan was the perfect example. Zhuo Fan was willing to bet his life while 5th elder wasn’t quite up to terms with staking his life on one strike. It ended as it played, with 5th elder terrified and Zhuo Fan winning.
[I was the one to attack first but ended up scared by his sickles. How mortifying!]
“This is how a man should be, brave. I finally found a real man. How great that he is also my husband...” Xiao Dandan was love-struck, with only him in her ever infatuated eyes.
Chu Qingcheng shook her head but was feeling her fair share of growing feelings as well. [Yes, this is how my husband should be, an undefeated hero!]
In the arena, 5th elder was aware of the humiliation. He was pissed, but he stayed put. Zhuo Fan grinned and placed the Bodhi Root in his Thunder Ring, “Yours truly shall no longer entertain you, buh-bye!”
Zhuo Fan punctuated with a stomp and took flight. His wings shot him high in the sky.
“Where do you think you’re going?”
Snorting, 5th elder stomped as well, chasing after him. In mere seconds, he overtook Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan however, expected this and the Lightning Wings shifted into whips as they lashed at him, “Get lost!”
“Humph, you little prick, you think you’re the only one with demonic treasures?”
th elder had come prepared. His hand suddenly held an enormous scarlet hammer. He used both his hands to swing it at Zhuo Fan, “If you’ve got the guts, let’s see you bet your life again!”
“A 5th-grade demonic treasure!”
Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth and shifted his wings into shields.
With the enemy having a 5th-grade demonic treasure, exchanging a wound for a life was impossible now. His life might be the one to perish first.
Bam!
Zhuo Fan smashed into the ground like a meteor, picking up a cloud of dust. When it cleared, it revealed the crumbled stage.
Chu Qingcheng and the others were alarmed. Xiao Dandan even jumped to search for his body, but Peony Overseer caught her before she could do it.
Long Jiu’s group was looking grave.
Hell Valley’s 5th elder was a body cultivator. If this hammer strike hadn’t outright killed Zhuo Fan, it would definitely leave a mark. If the situation worsened, they would have no choice but offend Regent Estate and join the fight.
th elder floated down and smashed the ground with his hammer, making the earth quake three times.
Huangpu Qingyun eyed the ruins, then the proud 5th elder and cackled, “Ha-ha-ha, 5th elder is indeed Hell Valley’s expert body cultivator. Your art is as strong as Regent Estate’s Imperial Tyrant Body Art.”
“You’re too kind, second young master, ha-ha-ha...” 5th elder faked modesty. He had always been confident of his body cultivation method. Huangpu Qingyun’s words of praises made his heart pump with pride.
Huangpu Qingyun turned to the ruins again with a chuckle, “With 5th elder’s strength, that brat must be close to dying if not dead already. Could I ask a favor from 5th elder? If he’s still alive, allow me to exact revenge for your valley’s 7th elder.”
Huangpu Qingyun’s eyes flashed with naked killing intent.
th elder knew he was after this all along and didn’t hurt earning his favor over such a small matter. He laughed, “Others are unworthy, but if it’s the second young master’s request, please do not hesitate to do it. But I would like to return to Hell Valley with his head.”
“I will never forget 5th elder’s dutiful act!”
Huangpu Qingyun then walked towards the ruins with killing intent.
Since ancient times, one mountain wasn’t big enough for two tigers. [This is your fate, that I will wring the life out of you to ease my heart.]
Chu Qingcheng’s group stared in anxiety and worry that he would kill Zhuo Fan.
“Uncle Jiu, do we attack?” Chu Qingcheng asked impatiently.
But Long Jiu’s lone eye stared at the ruins, still ruminating. This only worked to add more pressure on Chu Qingcheng...

chapters.title: Chapter 157, Cunning Like a Fox
chapters.content:
Chapter 157, Cunning Like a Fox
“Humph, if you won’t go, I will!”
Chu Qingcheng had reached her limit again, flicking her sleeve as she rushed to save him. Long Jiu and his group helplessly followed after her.
But an explosion stopped them before they could intervene.
Huangpu Qingyun was right at the edge of the crumbled stage when it shot into the air. A black figure flashed and a foot slammed Huangpu Qingyun’s cheek.
Huangpu Qingyun flew for dozens of meters and was now seeing stars. The black figure was far from finished, flickering behind Huangpu Qingyun and hacked with two thunderous axes for his head.
Huangpu Qingyun was too caught up to even know what was happening before finding himself face to face with death.
“Watch out, second young master!”
Hell Valley’s 5th elder swung his two fists to help him, but the figure already retreated.
When the black figure stopped, it was unmistakably Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan had blood flowing from his mouth and sporting an infuriated expression, only surpassed by the killing intent in his eyes.
“Dammit, so close and I would’ve had that punk’s life!” Zhuo Fan spat blood and barked at Huangpu Qingyun.
Huangpu Qingyun was overwhelmed and his body broke out in cold sweat.
[This goddamn prick is too deceitful. He faked death among the ruble so that I would get close enough to kill me.]
[If not for 5th timely rescue, I would’ve been a goner.]
Huangpu Qingyun grew more roiled, but feeling more appalled than ever. Chu Qingcheng’s side was wild with joy. Zhuo Fan looked as fine as ever, with hardly enough to be called wounded.
“Well damn. I always took the rumor of him being a freak as nothing more than a jest. But two years after we last saw each other, this brat’s hardheadedness reached a whole new level. With how strong Hell Valley’s 5th elder’s body was, even Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s 3rd elder would want to avoid fighting him. They have come to blows many times over the years but always ended in a tie. How is it that this brat is pitch-perfect after getting a smack from his hammer? He is an abomination.”
Long Jiu said suddenly to Xie Tianyang, “Kid, didn’t you see him last time? Just when did he get that freakish?”
Shrugging, Xie Tianyang felt downcast, “Who knew it would all happen overnight? From the 6th layer of Qi Condensation, where he could beat even Bone Tempering experts, he suddenly changed to the Bone Tempering freak who killed You Guiqi!”
[Overnight?!]
They all smacked their lips. What baffling skill did the brat use to become so dreadful?
But then they recalled how he changed overnight when the Luo clan was in crisis at that time as well. And now he did it again, this time gaining an unbreakable body.
“Brother, just how much are you hiding for your dear older brother?” Long Jiu sighed as the rest watched Zhuo Fan in amazement.
This kid was a true monster. Not only his alchemy ability was top-notch, but he was well versed in other aspects as well!
Unaware of his dear older brother, Long Jiu, labeling him a monster, Zhuo Fan spat another mouthful of blood as he watched the appalled Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder.
“Goddamned old fart! Your hammer almost snapped my rib. But you at least managed to shake my organs a bit and give me a slight wound. Hell Valley, eh? Fine then, Hell Valley’s old 5th, I’ll remember this debt.”
With a twitching face, Zhuo Fan spat the words with great rancor. Yet, why did it sound more like a mockery than anything else?
A grand 5th layer Profound Heaven bone cultivator’s hammer blow couldn’t kill a Bone Tempering cultivator, when it would turn any normal Profound Heaven expert to mush. Not even Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s 3rd elder dared to take on his hammer.
The least was a serious wound and worst, death.
But this punk didn’t even get a rib cracked, nor sported the slightest wound.
[Just who the hell is this brat?]
th elder had regarded Zhuo Fan highly from the start. At least at You Guiqi’s level since he managed to kill him.
But he now realized how sorely mistaken he was.
[This punk is a monster through and through. His body is nigh unbreakable!]
[Thank the fates he’s not in the Profound Heaven Stage and can’t use his body to its full advantage...]
Spatting, 5th elder turned grave!
Zhuo Fan secretly laughed having figured out what was on his mind. This was the best time to flee. And he did just that, without any useless words, just fled.
The grave 5th elder jolted and cursed inside as he rushed to block him.
[Think I’m a fool to let you walk away after you cursed me? You won’t get the chance! You won’t live to make my life miserable.]
He was indeed a Profound Heaven expert, catching up in an instant and swinging his hammer on Zhuo Fan again.
But Zhuo Fan was prepared this time. Grinning, his Lightning Wings deflected the hammer and rushed towards the 5th elder.
th elder was in glee.
Zhuo Fan may have dodged the blow, but coming closer, couldn’t be better.
th elder let go of the hammer and smashed his fist towards Zhuo’s face.
The blow packed enough power to at least break a few bones this time.
But Zhuo Fan kept his cool, even snickering. He lightly stepped, “Mystifying Phantom Step!”
Zhuo Fan vanished into thin air and popped behind 5th elder.
th elder had no idea what occurred while Zhuo Fan used this chance to flee.
“Kid, you won’t get away that easy!”
Suddenly, Huangpu Qingyun appeared and blocked his escape.
Zhuo Fan frowned and felt vexation get to him, [I so want to take him down a peg but this is not the time.] They were both body cultivators but with one stage gap. Brawling would be detrimental to Zhuo Fan.
Moreover, it would also slow down his speed if he were to use the Lightning Wings to fend off his opponent. Afterwards, the 5th elder would rush over during the gap and make matters worse.
With no alternative, Zhuo Fan used Mystifying Phantom Step again to escape Huangpu Qingyun.
Huangpu Qingyun stood dumbly in mid-air. [What’s with this strange art?] He never saw anything remotely resembling it.
However, to the dismay of the ones on the terrace, a blue figure flashed over, curbing Zhuo Fan’s escape.
With a boom, he was kicked back before he could figure out how it happened.
He hit the ground so hard, a wave of dust formed.
The messy Zhuo Fan clawed back to his feet. He felt his sore face as he looked coldly.
th elder and Huangpu Qingyun took one side around him as did the blue figure. Zhuo Fan snickering at him, “The kick was fast, but hardly powerful. It turns out to be an elder from Merry Woods. “
The one to get a leg up on Zhuo Fan was none other than Lin Zitian.
Taking a quick look at Vicious Pill King, he found him too drained to join in the fight. Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder were tough but had no way to counter Zhuo Fan’s eerie movements.
Thus making Merry Woods’ speed the only way to bring the brat down a peg.
Lin Zitian thought, [Fortune favors the bold.] He made sure to kick back this monstrosity to win the greatest credit.
Unbeknownst to him, that kick shot him straight through the gates of hell.
“Elder Lin, well done! I will remember this later!” Huangpu Qingyun was vexed by Zhuo Fan’s erratic movements but now only Lin Zitian could keep him here so Huangpu Qingyun flattered him.
Picking up on the second young master’s plan, 5th elder followed suit, “This little prick is such a headache, having a strange movement art on top of his strong body. If not for Elder Lin, he would’ve escaped.”
Lin Zitian was proud of his glorious achievement, but shook his head trying to act modestly.
Peony Overseer was itching to go there and kick his butt.
[You damn old fart. It’s fine if you don’t want to help Drifting Flowers Edifice, but you went as far as helping that bastard from Regent Estate against Drifting Flowers Edifice’s son in law? I was a fool to waste my feelings on you.]
Zhuo Fan had a contemptuous grin and secretly cursed him for being a moron. Ye, even in this situation, he didn’t put him in his eyes.
He already saw through Merry Woods’ cultivation method, a useless trick, fancy but pointless! If his disciple ruined himself with it, what was to say of his master?
How was he a worthy enemy if he was the weakest, albeit fastest?
Zhuo Fan sneered. He only took into consideration Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder, while throwing Elder Lin in the back of his mind.
Such clearcut disregard irked Elder Lin, stinging his prideful heart.
“Second young master, 5th elder, allow me to handle this arrogant punk!”
Lin Zitian didn’t find anything amiss and shouted. Zhuo Fan looked at him queerly. [This opportunist sure is ballsy.]
[You know I killed You Guiqi, who was as weak as you, yet you dare challenge me?]
Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder looked at him the same way.
[Is this old man alright? Even I have to watch my every move when facing this demon and here you are asking to do it alone?]
[Just who was the truly arrogant one here? One or two praises already got to your head?]

chapters.title: Chapter 158, Unstoppable Speed
chapters.content:
Chapter 158, Unstoppable Speed
Sticking out his chest, Lin Zitian felt so full of himself being the center of attention.
What he didn’t see was the suspicion in their eyes.
“5th elder, if Elder Lin wishes to fight him, let us owe him this favor and we’ll repay it back in the future.” Squinting, Huangpu Qingyun no longer second-guessed it and agreed with Lin Zitian.
Lin Zitian cupped his hands to Huangpu Qingyun in joy, “I wouldn’t dare. This is something I should be doing anyway. For the second young master to grant me this honor is enough.”
Huangpu Qingyun’s words revealed how much importance he gave himself. Lin Zitian was overjoyed Merry Woods now had a powerful backer.
“But second young master...” 5th elder spoke with revulsion. Though his face had an understanding smile when turned to Huangpu Qingyun.
As if the second young master cared about this pawn called Lin Zitian! He was only used as bait to see what other tricks Zhuo Fan had up his sleeves.
At the least, they’d make some early plans on how to deal with them.
Snickering inside, 5th elder cupped his hands at Lin Zitian, “Elder Lin, thank you for your trouble.”
“You’re too kind, 5th elder.”
Lin Zitian’s face had a glittering smile plastered on it. Like the bottom of the barrel got hailed as the number one genius. While Zhuo Fan could barely contain his mockery.
[There’s no worse fool out there than a clueless lab rat!]
[Fighting such a moron is a total waste of time.]
Zhuo Fan didn’t waste words and capitalized on their inattention by jumping backward. His Lightning Wings were primed into sharpened daggers to break out of this encirclement.
This time he wasn’t aiming for the air, but the wall behind him.
As the wall was the closest to him, his action would leave the other unable to react. This would ultimately allow him to escape Drifting Flowers Arena and take to the skies.
He would be soon as free as a bird, in his own element. While also offsetting the three’s Profound Heaven speed from catching up.
Huangpu Qingyun shouted in alarm, “Damn it! He wants to run!”
He cursed Zhuo Fan inside for his cunning nature. One careless moment and he would slip away!
By the time he and 5th elder got to the hole in the wall, Zhou Fan had the advantage of the open sky outside.
“Ha-ha-ha, Huangpu Qingyun, old 5th, we will meet again if fate allows it.” Zhuo Fan sped up and left his laughter behind.
Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder gnashed their teeth but didn’t pursue.
They knew it was too late already.
But Zhuo Fan once again omitted Lin Zitian’s name.
It was clear disregard!
Lin Zitian’s grew irate, [This prick thinks of escaping with me from Merry Woods here? Absurd!]
Whoosh!
Lin Zitian’s figure vanished. Not even Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder who were the closest, noticed his movements.
The next thing everyone knew, he was behind Zhuo Fan and cutting off the latter’s retreat.
So fast!
Zhuo Fan was startled somewhat. Lin Zitian was in the Profound Heaven Stage but his speed was far above it.
[He isn’t an elder of Merry Woods for nothing. Although...]
[Since when is speed everything? You’re nothing more than a paper tiger to me.]
Grinning, Zhuo Fan didn’t slow down at all, going straight for Elder Lin.
This had the elder fuming with rage.
“You little shit, you will pay for your insolence!” Like an enraged lion, Lin Zitian roared and charged as well.
But Zhuo Fan wasn’t one to mind, mocking him in fact as his Lightning Wings were sharpened for impact, “Your funeral!”
The clash already had a conclusion in everyone’s minds.
Zhuo Fan was a monster yet only a Bone Tempering cultivator. He could face off against the impressive 5th layer of Profound Heaven body cultivator, Hell Valley’s 5th elder by himself. Not to mention he killed You Guiqi in one hit.
[You, Lin Zitian, are no body cultivator, even weaker than You Guiqi. Yet, you dare face such a freak? Truly a moron.]
“Let’s go together, 5th elder!” Huangpu Qingyun spoke.
Startled, 5th elder didn’t understand, “Second young master, we won’t be able to save him even if we do join.”
“Fool, what saving? He might not last a hit, but as a Profound Heaven expert he can delay that brat long enough for us to catch up!”
Huangpu Qingyun already bolted with the 5th elder laughing right behind him.
Zhuo Fan had long guessed their plan and his mouth perked into a peculiar smile.
Whoosh~
Just when they were about to clash, Zhuo Fan used Mystifying Phantom Step again, only to appear behind Lin Zitian.
“What?!”
Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder stopped in shock. Zhuo Fan’s cackle came from behind Lin Zitian, “Ha-ha-ha, your plan was for me to waste time on this idiot, right? You counted your chickens too soon!”
“Damn it, he figured it out!” Huangpu Qingyun scowled.
Long Jiu’s group now realized as well. Lin Zitian wasn’t there to attack Zhuo Fan, but to stall him enough for the other two to catch up.
It was clearly out of Lin Zitian’s intentions, ending up used by Huangpu Qingyun.
Regent Estate was indeed an expert in manipulation. But Zhuo Fan saw through it with a glance, hailing his skills a cut higher.
In this three against one battle, they did not fight with only their fists but with their minds. If one side lost either aspect, defeat was imminent.
Long Jiu admired Zhuo Fan even greater now. If it were him in Zhuo Fan’s shoes, he would’ve attacked Lin Zitian and fell in Huangpu Qingyun’s trap.
But now the situation resolved and Zhuo Fan was free to leave.
However, before anyone could breathe a sigh of relief, Lin Zitian punched Zhuo Fan as he roared, “Punk, you dare look down on me?”
“Humph, you seriously don’t know when to quit. Since you want death, I shall oblige!”
Finding Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder stock still from the corner of his eye, Zhuo Fan grinned. Killing intent flared in his eyes and thrust at Lin Zitian.
Huangpu Qingyun was filled with regret.
Who knew Lin Zitian was so thickheaded, still in pursuit? If they knew, they wouldn’t have stopped. Now, however, it was too late to go after him again. All they could do was watch Lin Zitian throw away his life for nothing.
Lin Zitian didn’t seem afraid of the 6th-grade demonic treasure coming for his life. He even had time to mock, “Brat, don’t you know power is useless when you can’t even land a hit?”
Zhuo Fan didn’t seem to catch his drift. But then Lin Zitian vanished half a meter away from him and the Lightning Wings hit naught but air.
“How?!”
Zhuo Fan was in shock. It was impossible to move so fast without build-up. Only his Mystifying Phantom Step could do it, allowing him to blink short distances.
What he failed to detect, however, was the ripple in space. This was a burst over short distances.
But this burst was so fast that not even a Profound Heaven expert’s speed was its match.
In his shock, Lin Zitian appeared again with a mocking smile as he punched Zhuo Fan’s chest. With Lightning Wings in mid-attack, Zhuo Fan could only use his arm to block.
“Humph, regardless of how fast Merry Woods is, your power is nothing. With such childish punches, not even a hundred will help. Can one man’s punch make any difference?”
“He-he-he, ever heard of constant efforts always prevail?”
Snorting, Lin Zitian mocked Zhuo Fan but his heart was furious as he added more power into his punch. But Zhuo Fan didn’t care, as Lin Zitian was indeed punching like a child. The most he could do was add his Yuan Qi on his punch to rattle Zhuo Fan’s organs.
Zhuo Fan was flabbergasted to discover this paper tiger sent him flying. He planted into a rock and ended up buried under the rubble.
This astonished everyone around, making them reassess Elder Lin. To send the freakish Zhuo Fan flying earned him the title of peak expert in the Profound Heaven Stage.
Some couldn’t even believe the opportunist Lin Zitian had such power in him.
Even Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder were rooted in shock.
Rumble!
Zhuo Fan jumped out of the rubble, unharmed, but his arm looked inflamed.
Raising his eyes on Lin Zitian, Zhuo Fan was now serious, “It seems I’ve underestimated you, Elder Lin!”
“Humph, you better believe it! We, the Merry Woods, have become one of the seven houses thanks to our strength!” Lin Zitian put away his fist as his eyes flashed with pride.
All around looked at Lin Zitian with newfound respect. His figure never looked so imposing.
Despite all that, Lin Zitian sneakily put his hand behind him and rubbed the pain away as he sucked a cold breath.
His hand was purple...

chapters.title: Chapter 159, Sinister Like a Snake
chapters.content:
Chapter 159, Sinister Like a Snake
[Blast it! Why is his body so damn hard? How is he even human? One punch almost destroyed my hand!]
Lin Zitian stood with hands behind his back, his head at a 45 degree up angle, like a veritable expert.
He was looked down on most of the time and now, he finally had the chance to show off. But what people were unaware of was that his eyes were swimming in tears. Without keeping appearances, he’d be losing all decorum.
He could barely hold it in!
His hand was screaming in pain...
“Ha-ha-ha, Elder Lin’s power opened my eyes! I am in awe!” Huangpu Qingyun laughed.
The battle started with them having the advantage. Then Zhuo Fan had to take out some weird movement that made their advantage moot. Lin Zitian had the speed to counter it, but unfortunately, he was a paper tiger.
In spite of appearances, this Elder Lin showed he had what it took to fight Zhuo Fan. With the three of them working in tandem, Zhuo Fan was dead meat.
Huangpu Qingyun proposed, “Elder Lin, you have just shown your strength, but it’s best we deal with this little prick as soon as possible! “
“Yeah, Elder Lin. It will take you too long to bring him down so I and second young master will help you!”
Getting Huangpu Qingyun’s meaning, 5th elder urged as well in a sincere tone. He wasn’t faking it this time.
Before, Lin Zitian was but a mere cannon fodder. But now, he was an asset worth considering when taking down Zhuo Fan. Not only in terms of speed, but even with his power, he managed to earn the two’s approval.
His heart moved to tears, Lin Zitian who never received such courtesy cupped his hands, “Don’t worry, second young master, 5th elder. I will not let him escape as long as I’m around!”
“I have full trust in you!”
Huangpu Qingyun then turned to Zhuo Fan with killing intent.
Zhuo Fan sank into a deep and heavy mood.
He could deal with them two, but adding a Lin Zitian who could strike him into the mix and it would make living a lot harder.
He already had a plan set just for this occasion. Or he wouldn’t have been so brazen to show himself. But that plan was a final resort. It was dangerous so he wanted to avoid it at all costs.
The only path left for him was driving a wedge in their teamwork. As for where to start, did one even need to ask?
Snickering, Zhuo Fan eyed Lin Zitian with an evil glint, “Elder Lin, I was truly wrong about you. I never took you for an expert, when you are in fact no less than Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder.”
“Ha-ha-ha, you’re late in realizing the obvious!”
Lin Zitian laughed the resentment away, now filled with nothing but content. Zhuo Fan was a junior, true, but he was infamous in the Tianyu Empire. He had proven himself a man of great power and ambition when he killed You Guiqi.
Zhuo Fan’s approval made him feel like he was bursting with prestige.
Zhuo Fan eyes his vanity and upped the ante, “But you can’t blame me for that, Elder Lin. Merry Woods isn’t exactly as impressive as the other houses. Nor its reputation for that matter...”
“Rubbish! Merry Woods’ name has always been glorious!” Zhuo Fan’s words began to take effect, having Lin Zitian cut him off incensed.
It only made Zhuo Fan’s devious smile wider, “From now on Merry Woods will be known throughout the empire. But did you perhaps not hear of those lines?”
“What lines?”
“Merry Woods, the opportunist. At a gust, it shifts between two. Today they bow before a red dress, tomorrow, they kneel before a tree. But on which day the wind is stronger, that no one would want the lame leg anymore?”
Of course, these lines were a proud work of Zhuo Fan. However, they comprised everything he witnessed in his stay at Drifting Flowers Edifice, emphasizing Lin Zitian’s magnificent love life.
Even Zhuo Fan grew narcissistic when he heard himself. [Such literary talent would make me a best seller!]
But to Lin Zitian’s ears, it was jarring. His face flushed and turned to see Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder dry coughing.
But anyone could see they were laughing inside.
With rasp breath, Lin Zitian cursed, “Bullshit! Who dared started this vilification? I will break the one who started this rumor!”
“Rumor? Elder Lin is so forgetful, avoiding responsibilities. Now that you have a staunch supporter backing you, did you forget the fragrant and soft legs of yesterday?” Zhuo Fan coincidently looked at the terrace in that exact moment.
Noticing his eyes, Peony Overseer was ashamed, boring her resentment into him.
Chu Qingcheng frowned, “Senior sister, is this...”
“Edifice Lord Chu, don’t listen to his hosh-posh. I was about to do it, for Drifting Flowers Edifice... but he didn’t agree and we were through. What stuff about responsibility when he didn’t do anything?” Peony Overseer rushed to explain, but it only made it worse. Everyone was looking at her oddly.
At the same time, Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder were filled with mirth when seeing Lin Zitian.
Though more aptly, mirth filled with mockery and contempt.
Playing with women was nothing to a man, but that didn’t go the same with ‘leaning left then right’. Regent Estate prized loyalty above all else.
Lin Zitian’s face alternated between white and blue. His mouth parted but he had no riposte.
Even the weakened Vicious Pill King had to sneer at such sensational news. Lin Zitian looked as if he choked on a fly. He couldn’t spit or swallow, stuck in the worst moment of his life.
Looking back at himself, he regretted it in his heart for talking with this bastard.
“You little shit, I will tear you into a thousand pieces!”
Lin Zitian flew into a rage, ignoring his teammates as he charged at Zhuo Fan. The latter was startled and moved the Lightning Wings to attack Lin Zitian.
Whoosh!
Lin Zitian vanished again, only to appear before Zhuo Fan. Without a choice, Zhuo Fan had to block with his hand again.
The same scene replayed, with Zhuo Fan smashing into a rock, then covered in rubble.
Coming out of there, he saw Lin Zitian already on him, not leaving him room to even breathe. Zhuo Fan’s arm was inflamed but he pressed on with his wings.
It was useless. Lightning Wings were fast but not a match for Lin Zitian’s speed.
This resulted in him being ragdolled from one rock to another by Lin Zitian’s kicks. Lin Zitian was no body cultivator, so such attacks meant little harm to Zhuo Fan, but such damages accumulate.
Around the 7th or 8th round, Zhuo Fan was bruised all over. Not life-threatening but it worked to cut at his body’s strength, now huffing for breath.
Taking seven-eight hits of this left him wounded deeply. Even his Diamond Body would start to decline under a Profound Heaven expert’s onslaught.
Persistent effort!
Anything hammered long enough, no matter how tough, would soon break at some point.
The same was happening to Zhuo Fan. Despite the battering he suffered, the staunch resolve never left his eyes.
Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder laughed out loud. Zhuo Fan was done for. Without them needing to even lift a finger.
They never thought of Lin Zitian as someone that strong. He was flinging the demon Zhuo Fan around like nothing when they were having such a hard time with him just a few moments before.
[Ha-ha-ha, everyone has a weakness!]
Huangpu Qingyun laughed inside and shouted, “Elder Lin, leave him half alive. Let me have a go.”
Chu Qingcheng was filled with worry, as was Xiao Dandan. Seeing Zhuo Fan suffering, she was on the verge of crying. Long Jiu tightened his fists, ready to jump in at a moment’s notice.
But Vicious Pill King watched Zhuo Fan with doubt, “Something is off here, but what?”
“Master, did you say something?” Yan Fu came next to him. Following his gaze, he suddenly laughed, “Oh, you mean that brat. He-he-he, he will soon die at Elder Lin’s hands and clear your resentment. He was so haughty and insufferable just a while back and now he is getting his just deserts, ha-ha-ha...”
“Yes, that’s it!”
Vicious Pill King muttered, “I see it now. What it felt off. His haughty and obnoxious nature is gone.”
Yan Fu was startled, “Master, what is so bad about that? Why would he still act cocky if he is beaten senseless?”
“You know nothing!”
Cursing, Vicious Pill King turned grave, “Even in death, a lion’s a lion. If a king takes off his gown, he is still a king. That gaze that said everything is beneath him will never disappear.”
“But it is gone now... no, not gone, hidden. Like a viper poised to make use of that once chance that will take the enemy’s life!”
Vicious Pill King watched Zhuo Fan being kicked around and cried in fright, “Elder Lin, watch out! He is planning on taking your disciple hostage!”

chapters.title: Chapter 160, The Plot to End Lin Zitian
chapters.content:
Chapter 160, The Plot to End Lin Zitian
Precisely!
Everyone had eyes only for Zhuo Fan and were unable to see the bigger picture. That whenever Lin Zitian sent Zhuo Fan flying, it brought him one strike closer to the eastern stand.
With all the experts down in the arena, it left poor Lin Tianyu, disciple of Lin Zitian, alone.
Lin Tianyu was watching how his master taught that man who brutalized and humiliated him in front of so many people a hard lesson. Yet, Vicious Pill King’s yell got him staring blankly.
[W-why me again?]
Lin Zitian also stopped from shock.
But Zhuo Fan snickered and his eyes flashed with killing intent, “Humph, too late!”
He stomped and shot like a cannonball for Lin Tianyu. He no longer hid his intense killing intent and released it out onto the world.
Zhuo Fan was still just a hundred meters away from Lin Tianyu. It took a mere blink to one with comparable speed to those Profound Heaven experts to close this distance, leaving Lin Zitian unable to do a thing.
“Lin Zitian, you seemed to have had a blast kicking me around. Now, I will kill your prized disciple. Let’s see how you like them apples!”
Frightened, Lin Zitian knew he’d been led by the nose. But how, when he was a highly intelligent man, yet never saw any signs pointing to this?
However, this was no time to think, his disciple was in Zhuo Fan’s evil clutches. Lin Zitian flashed behind Zhuo Fan and punched as he roared, “Zhuo Fan, fight me if you have the guts! Leave my disciple out of it!”
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan vanished from his sight. Then a groan escaped his lips and his body trembled. Lin Zitian’s rage-filled eyes went stiff.
Looking down, he saw a hand sticking out of his chest whilst holding a slowly beating heart.
“Wish granted, ha-ha-ha...”
A sinister laughter reached Lin Zitian but all he could feel was his body growing colder. His life ebbing away.
But his eyes were ever clouded in doubt. He struggled to look back at the demonic youth, “Y-you, how did you match my speed...”
“Didn’t your disciple tell you? I already told him. It doesn’t matter how fast you are when I know who your target is!”
Zhuo Fan clenched his hand and the beating heart splashed blood everywhere. Lin Zitian’s ice-cold corpse slumped on the eastern stand. His eyes wide as saucers, dying with regret.
Lin Tianyu wailed in fear and curled up in a corner, not even daring to look Zhuo Fan in the eye.
“Trash! You don’t even dare look at your master’s killer? Disappointing!” Zhuo Fan left with a snicker.
What met him were the frightened eyes of everyone else.
Merry Woods’s elder Lin Zitian was killed in one blow. But the worst was Zhuo Fan’s casual expression when doing it. It looked like he was squashing a bug and not a Profound Heaven expert.
And his calculative eyes looked on as if everything fell in his predetermined plan. It was as though he was able to easily pluck the lives of his enemy at the drop of a hat.
[Demon!]
This was the sole impression he conveyed.
“Edifice Lord Chu, I told you. You know nothing of this brat. Did you see it just now? He is a Demon King, in the flesh!” Xie Tianyang’s expression was grave. Although this made it the second time he saw Zhuo Fan kill a Profound Heaven expert, the shock was in no way lessened.
Zhuo Fan’s slaughter was incomparable to any other’s. It was as natural as a king disposing of his slave.
Such a cold and unfeeling manner made him shiver whenever he saw Zhuo Fan strike. The same went for everyone there as well.
“This brat is worse than Vicious Pill King!” Peony Overseer’s lip trembled, “I-I can see now why the Hell Kill Order was issued. But I feel that the Hell Kill Order is not enough to make him feel an ounce of fear!”
“Qingcheng, you need to think this over carefully, whether he is the man you want to return to!” Iris Overseer sucked a deep breath and spoke her concerns.
Chu Qingcheng muttered to herself for a while. her eyes were filled with uncertainty, but soon hardened, “Indeed. What you all say has its merits. But! Isn’t this the very same Demon King who saved our Drifting Flowers Edifice?”
“Yeah, sister Qingcheng. Husband may be vile, but only to our enemies. He never harmed us. Don’t ever think otherwise.” Xiao Dandan blurted.
Her devotion to Zhuo Fan was unflinching. Afterall, she desired to be with him for as long as they lived. However, Zhuo Fan once said he didn’t accept Chu Qingcheng’s dowry. So, how could she accept her then, when she was nothing but an extra?
So Xiao Dandan had to keep Zhuo Fan in Chu Qingcheng’s heart. Otherwise, he would not only refuse Chu Qingcheng, but the free gift as well.
The heart could only bear so much for love!
The two overseers also sighed seeing Chu Qingcheng making up her mind. They all knew, however, there would not be one day of peace around someone like Zhuo Fan.
Vicious Pill King watched the cold and sinister Zhuo Fan up in the stand and sighed, “I was wrong. You didn’t aim for Lin Tianyu, but was after Lin Zitian from the start.”
“Correct. I wanted that old coot’s life from the very beginning. Why would I go after his trash of a disciple for?” Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Also, I may be holding Lin Tianyu hostage, striking fear in Lin Zitian, but would Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder care about his life? Am I someone who doesn’t know a person’s value?”
“Ha-ha-ha, right. When a viper bares its fangs, it will strike its mark. I was wrong in thinking Lin Tianyu was important!” Vicious Pill King lamented and shook his head, “However, your fight leading to Lin Tianyu was all according to your plan.”
“You’re catching on!”
Zhuo Fan raised his head and grinned, “Lin Zitian was a fool, thinking he was in control. When in fact, every strike was predetermined. When all paths are sealed, his only choice was the only one he saw. It was the path I let him see. This was the conclusion I came to while I was kicked around.”
“What a sinister brat!”
Huangpu Qingyun gnashed his teeth, “If only I noticed earlier. I and 5th elder would’ve stepped in and save Elder Lin’s life.”
“Ha-ha-ha, don’t kid yourself Huangpu Qingyun. You’re overconfident if you think a daft brat like you can see through my schemes. Do you think a few books on ruling are enough to grasp the people’s hearts? Humph, you’re far beneath me.”
Zhuo Fan laughed with scorn, “It would’ve been quite the high stakes mind game if You Guiqi was here, but you guys, just don’t cut it!”
Clenching his fists, Huangpu Qingyun was infuriated. The great Regent Estate’s second young master had never been patronized in his life by his peers, to the extent of being mocked as a daft brat.
This was no different from a beggar cursing at an emperor in the middle of the street. The emperor was no emperor if he would take it lying down.
Or he wasn’t Regent Estate’s second young master if he let it slide.
Zhuo Fan’s mockery only grew worse when he noticed his fury, “Huangpu Qingyun, you can’t take it? Then let me reiterate. You know nothing of the ways of ruling, so don’t go smear mud on the true way of grasping the people’s hearts.”
“If the three of you had gone together against me, I wouldn’t have stood a chance. So I had to relieve you of one man, the oh so intelligent and ambitious Elder Lin.”
Everyone was fixated on Zhuo Fan, who was telling how he led them by the nose, and managed to kill Lin Zitian. Huangpu Qingyun’s heart was bleeding from hatred, yet his ears were attentive to catch the details.
“First things first, a ruler needs to see talent, to be tolerant! With how vain Lin Zitian was, all I had to do was to fling some dirt at him and he lost control. And you, instead of appeasing him, you mocked him from the side, making him fly off the handle. In his anger-addled mind, he left you behind fighting me all by himself!”
The witnesses turned to see how Huangpu Qingyun would react. One thing was clear though, he wasn’t tolerant in the least, not at all how a ruler should behave.
To be blunt, he was not leader material.
Huangpu Qingyun sensed the change in everyone and his hatred for Zhuo Fan grew.
Yet, Zhuo Fan just kept going, “Moving on, a ruler has control over the situation, placing worth on the greater picture. Of all people here, only Lin Zitian could counter my speed. But you let this valuable asset go further and further away from you in his battle with me, out of your range. You only had to stay close to him and he would still be alive. This is another fault of yours.”
“Enough! It is you who killed Lin Zitian, and now you’re trying to pin it on me? Humph, everyone knows how deceitful you are!” Huangpu Qingyun could no longer sit still while listening to his mockery.
Smiling, Zhuo Fan scorned him, “A regent is a regent because he is leading the people. Those that shirk responsibilities are not fit to be regents, and are not worthy to follow!”
The people’s hearts shivered. They watched Zhuo Fan, amazed at how much sense he made. It also worked to dampen their respect for Huangpu Qingyun by a great deal.
They respected Regent Estate’s second young master at first, for his strict handling of affairs, for being a ruling talent.
But Zhuo Fan opened their eyes to the truth. He was no leading material and following him would lead them to a dead end. Even 5th elder’s eyes changed, now sporting a different opinion.
Sowing discord!
But this sowing was hidden very deep, since he was driving a wedge between their trust and not just based on emotions. Huangpu Qingyun’s retinue was formed of blind followers, thinking there was nothing he couldn’t do. If it worked, it couldn’t be better.
But Zhuo Fan’s killing of Lin Zitian fell mostly on his shoulders. Saying he was unfit to lead at this point, whether the people believe or not, it cut down a great deal of his prestige.
He would become someone no one wanted to follow and, most importantly, the cooperation between Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder would falter, making them weaker.
Zhuo Fan smiled his evil grin, as if all were dancing in the palm of his hand...

chapters.title: Chapter 161, Rumbling Blood Bat
chapters.content:
Chapter 161, Rumbling Blood Bat
With eyebrows locked in a scowl, Huangpu Qingyun could feel the eyes on him taking a different nuance, making his heart burn with newfound rage.
[Damn it, this punk is good in psychological warfare as well. He got these geezers buckling with a few words. This can’t go on. He must die, beyond any shadow of a doubt. I have to shut him up now. Will I have any respect left, any credibility, if this keeps up?]
With his mind set, Huangpu Qingyun restrained his aura, ready to make an overt attack at any opportune moment. [Since I can’t counter that odd movement, I’ll just finish him off with one clean and hidden strike!’
Before his chance came, however, Zhuo Fan flitted to the closest arena wall, aiming for a quick escape.
“Curses, again with the running!”
Huangpu Qingyun cussed, feeling his plan ruined before he could even enact it.
He wanted to sneak attack Zhuo Fan so he dropped his aura to confuse enemies. But Zhuo Fan took the initiative to move first before he could.
He was exasperated, [The little shit is a parasite. How is it that whenever I’m planning something, he reacts as if knowing what it is?]
There wasn’t anyone around to tell him that this old and veteran demon, Zhuo Fan, could tell if he had to take a dump before even he did.
And now that 5th elder’s trust in Huangpu Qingyun plummeted, his reaction was somewhat slower than before.
This short delay allowed Zhuo Fan to arrive before the wall.
The two hurried to catch him while Zhuo Fan was having a blast, “Ha-ha-ha, too slow. You’re far from enough to stop yours truly.”
Zhuo Fan lashed his Lightning Wings at the walls.
The wall sported a brand new five-meter tall hole, allowing sunshine to spill inside. Fresh air rushed to him, lifting his spirits.
Zhuo Fan then stepped into the clouds. He was like a caged bird finally seeing the wide-open skies for the first time.
th elder gnashed his teeth. Only now did his senses come back, figuring out that Zhuo Fan’s speech was meant to drive a wedge and affect their state of mind.
How else could he escape from under the tight guard of two Profound Heaven experts in an enclosed space like Drifting Flowers Arena?
[This kid is more cunning than 7th Elder!]
He may be sighing inside, but his eyes were filled with killing intent. The more outstanding Zhuo Fan revealed to be, the more he had to put the kid down.
[He’s already a freak in Bone Tempering Stage. What will happen when he enters the Profound Heaven Stage then? Who in Tianyu will be able to stop him?]
Huangpu Qingyun was of a like mind.
He had to be killed!
They looked at each other, finding determination in each of their eyes. They rushed through the hole and engaged in the chase. Vicious Pill King muttered to himself as he took Yan Fu through the hole as well.
The only ones left inside were Long Jiu’s gang.
Secretly sighing, Iris Overseer looked on in fright, “Demon Zhuo Fan is beyond cunning. He played the astute Huangpu Qingyun like a fiddle. Now I can see how he killed the Insidious Demon, You Guiqi.”
“He-he, but of course!”
Snickering, Xie Tianyang shook his head dejected, “That brat is just too sly. Those with brains but not brawn will undoubtedly lose. Those with brawn but no brains will never get the upper hand on him. He is the single most dreadful thing in this world.”
“My husband is brave and wise beyond his age!” Xiao Dandan’s pride in Zhuo Fan jumped a few notches.
Chu Qingcheng smiled without meaning to. Even her eyes glinted with pride.
The others had to nod at her words. Zhuo Fan was a rarity on this continent. Where could one find such a youth excelling in mettle and mind!
Long Jiu proposed, “Let’s go as well. He is now in an open space with a high chance of escaping, but it’s best we are nearby if things go south.”
They all nodded and flew outside.
But a panicked cry came at this moment, “Dandan, Dandan, save me!”
His master’s corpse turned Lin Tianyu’s legs to mush, unable to even move from fear. Watching Chu Qingcheng’s group leaving as well, he supposed they were aiming for Zhuo Fan and got excited.
Lin Tianyu started crying as if he hadn’t seen his relatives in years.
This man truly took after his master. He was still clueless which side was pro Zhuo Fan, and which was anti Zhuo Fan. He went and assumed Zhuo Fan made a scapegoat out of Drifting Flowers Edifice.
So, he hurried to Xiao Dandan, gave a few bows to the seniors and wept, “Dandan, that demon killed my master. For the feelings we had, for Drifting Flowers Edifice and Merry Woods’ intermarriages all these years, I plead seniors to give master justice and kill that demon. Please avenge master!”
Long Jiu’s group was startled, then looked at him funny.
The apple truly didn’t fall far from the tree. [He’s as dumb as his master. Did you not see us standing at the side doing nothing, with no intention of stepping in?]
[You are one clueless kid to come ask us for help!]
Lin Tianyu was off-put when they were silent and second-guessed. They had to be in fear of Zhuo Fan, unwilling to join thinking their houses’ well-being was on the line.
Since appealing to their morality went bust, he’d appeal to reason.
He turned grave on the spot as he spoke with zeal, “Demon Zhuo Fan flaunts his ruthless and barbaric power. Today he killed my master, tomorrow he will kill you. Even with second young master and 5th elder joining hands, they may not hold him here. If he runs, it will spell the end of the seven houses. For our brothers and sisters, I plead you to think of your own house, of your bleak future, and join together with second young master in removing this vile spawn from the face of the world!”
Lin Tianyu spoke with righteousness, with valor, but the ones he was talking to were having a ball in their minds.
[Is this kid still playing the gentleman with no crowd around to see him?]
[Better yet, since when did the seven houses become brothers and sisters? Are you blind to not see Vicious Pill King almost annihilating Drifting Flowers Edifice?]
[You need to get your facts straight. Just how has this disciple been raised to believe this nonsense? When the time comes, he is the type that won’t even know how he died.]
They only shook their heads and ignored him as they went on their merry way.
[He is a prime example of what a fool is!]
“Uh, miss Dandan, I find this kid upstanding, so why not take him? Later... you’ll need to handle him well!” Xie Tianyang cracked jokes.
Lin Tianyu had no clue what this Sword Marquise Abode’s young master was going with this.
But his words brought Xiao Dandan one thought only. [Isn’t that telling me to whip him?] And her cheeks flushed.
Lin Tianyu saw them treating him like thin air and he downheartedly implored Xiao Dandan, “Dandan, Merry Woods is too far and I won’t make it in time to report. Please, you have to convince your seniors to avenge master!”
“Do it yourself! What man are you, letting others do your job for you?” Xiao Dandan snapped a glare at him then kicked him before storming back to the group.
She was so perplexed. How could they both be men, with one a hero and the other an annoying coward? He even had the nerve to ask others for revenge when he didn’t even look the killer in the eye!
The more she compared the two, the more her love grew.
On the other hand, Lin Tianyu fell to the ground and wailed dejectedly, “What’s wrong with asking others for revenge? How am I supposed to fight that freak who killed master? This is not how a man...”
Outside the Drifting Flowers Arena was packed with clansmen and alchemists, who were in the area, afraid of getting in the crossfire between Huangpu Qingyun and Zhuo Fan.
Although they did leave the building, they were too curious to vacate the premises.
They wanted to see for themselves the ending. How the demon Zhuo Fan, grandmaster of alchemy, was as scary as the rumors painted him out to be. Meanwhile, they were also afraid that they might get caught in the crossfire and end up injured.
This was a Profound Heaven experts fight to the death, was it not? Sticking too close would send one to an early grave.
[Sigh, everything’s so twisted.]
The Drifting Flowers Edifice’s disciples were tasked with upholding order. Xiao Ya was among them too, lamenting. [Why is this time’s Hundred Pill Meeting filled with fighting?]
She was thinking the Drifting Flowers Arena might even blow up from their Profound Heaven Stage powers.
Boom!
As she was mulling, a loud explosion rang her ears.
The crowd saw a new opening in the arena wall and a winged figure taking to the skies.
Zhuo Fan!
Startled, they began to admire how amazing he was to escape from Hell Valley and Regent Estate.
But then, two more figures came out, Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder. They only took a blink to bar Zhuo Fan’s way.
A sledgehammer and a golden fist flew and backing Zhuo Fan into a corner.
But with the wide open space around him, Zhuo Fan bizarre art was even weirder, flitting back and forth like a specter.
Not even Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder’s tight blockade could hold Zhuo Fan.
In the sky, three figures dashed around, but they always flashed past each other, not once connecting.
The crowd had long stood slackjawed. None could reach their speeds but they could guess how astonishing it was.
Seeing Zhuo Fan flitting around so relaxed was enough proof.
[No wonder he’s dubbed demon when he can throw off Profound Heaven experts with his weird movements. Only a demon could move as creepy as that.]
Whoosh!
With a sudden kick, Zhuo Fan escaped the two’s encirclement. Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder were now panting in pursuit but couldn’t catch up.
They were body cultivators but had no movement art. Matching their speed to Zhuo Fan taxed their bodies.
“Ha-ha-ha, Huangpu Qingyun, time to count your blessings!” Laughed Zhuo Fan.
Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder were far from willing to give up.
Suddenly, an aged voice came, “Youngster, have you forgotten about me?”
Unable to react, Zhuo Fan was stuck. It was as though he was hit with an artillery shell. Slamming him onto the ground, creating a ten-meter crater in the ground.
And in his previous spot was a meter large blood-colored bat with small eyes and sharp glints.
The crowd cried out, “3rd level spiritual beast, “Rumbling Blood Bat!”

chapters.title: Chapter 162, Dire Straights
chapters.content:
Chapter 162, Dire Straights
Rumbling Blood Bat, a seldom-seen peculiar spiritual beast.
In the world of spiritual beasts, the strong preyed on the weak. The higher the level, the stronger they were. Yet, this creature was an exception. It was no stronger than a 1st level spiritual beast and had neither claws nor fangs.
It had a shocking trait though. the Rumbling Bat Wave. It was a sound attack that struck the soul. It would leave one in a coma or, worse, annihilate one’s soul.
After using it, it would then go and bore its fangs into the victim, sucking blood away. It may be a mere 3rd level spiritual beast, but few were capable of surviving its sound attack.
Not even a 4th level spiritual beast could stand up to a flock of ten Rumbling Blood Bats.
Who cared how tough you were? Who cared how skilled you were? You’d still die from this creature’s sound attack if your soul lacked heart.
This creature that bared Zhuo Fan’s escape was one that could strike fear even in 4th level spiritual beasts.
Jumping out of the hole, Zhuo Fan looked up at the ten bats. He was finally sporting a serious expression. Then looking at the speaker and saw Vicious Pill King.
He was holding a gourd, smiling at Zhuo Fan.
“Now I see. This must be your final move!” Zhuo Fan squinted.
He’d seen the old man carry the gourd for a while now. But only discovered it was a beast holding item.
When cornered by Iris Overseer, Chu Qingcheng, and Long Jiu not too long ago, he was still putting a tough front because of the Rumbling Blood Bats in his gourd.
It was smart of them to back off and not to attack then, or they would’ve been doomed.
This old man wasn’t to be pushed around. Even after using blood essence four times, he still couldn’t be underestimated no matter how weak he appeared.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed in admiration.
Long Jiu’s group just came out through the hole and saw him standing amidst ruins. They turned to the sky and paled, “Rumbling Blood Bat! And ten of them?!”
They all turned grave.
Just when they thought Zhuo Fan had free reign of the skies outside the arena, he was met with ten Rumbling Blood Bats. Zhuo Fan was now cornered by two Profound Heaven experts and a 4th level spiritual beast equivalent flock of bats.
Not even a Profound Heaven expert could pull an escape out of this, least of all, a winged Bone Tempering expert.
Their hearts were now stretched taught.
“Ha-ha-ha, Elder Yan. In the end, you are the most reliable to block this brat!”
Laughing freely, Huangpu Qingyun floated next to the old man. Then, he stuck up his chin at Zhuo Fan, “Kid, let’s see you run now!”
Hell Valley’s 5th elder landed beside them, eyes flashing with cruelty.
Sighing, Vicious Pill King looked on with regret, “Song, uh, Grandmaster Zhuo, I am in awe of sir’s wondrous refining skill. I am pained to have you as my enemy. But I am bereft of any choice!”
His words stirred the sympathy of many clan delegates, as well as the alchemists participating today.
The demon Zhuo Fan, who offended Hell Valley, was Grandmaster Song. Such sorrow!
A cruel death awaited all who dared oppose the Seven Noble Houses. But an exalted alchemist to find his end in such a wretched way, was lamentable.
The least the crowd could do was show deep respect while sending off this great man on his final journey...
But Zhuo Fan only snickered, “He-he-he, Elder Yan, you think too highly of your batsies. They can scare a 4th level spiritual beasts, but in the end, they’re a flock!”
Zhuo Fan vanished as he took flight.
The bats flapped their wings and opened their snouts. The air rippled and a visible wave traveled at Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan sidestepped. The wave hit the ground but nothing happened. Yet, the stones around turned to dust.
The people began to fear the Rumbling Blood Bat even more. A normal Bone Tempering expert struck by this wave would’ve died in anguish.
But Zhuo Fan relied on his uncanny speed to dance among the attacks. He was almost out of their encirclement.
“Damn, Zhuo Fan is too sly. He noticed that the ten bats are unable to coordinate and slipped through the gaps in their attacks. Let’s block him together, 5th elder!”
Huangpu Qingyun cried in panic, to which, Vicious Pill King dismissed his words, “Second young master, don’t worry. You’ll only make it worse if you charge along with the blood bats. I will make sure he won’t have anywhere else to run.”
Vicious Pill King opened his gourd and made a hand sign.
A screech came from within it, followed by another flock of bats flying to the gap Zhuo Fan was aiming for, shutting it tight.
Hum~
A dozens of times stronger ripple sent Zhuo Fan barreling into the ground, leaving another huge hole.
When he crawled out, he sucked a cold breath at the sight.
The sky was filled with Rumbling Blood Bats. A rough estimate would give around a hundred.
If 10 were enough for a 4th level spiritual beast, then a hundred would even kill a 5th level spiritual beast.
A bolt of fear went through the crowd, including Huangpu Qingyun. They were so frightened they couldn’t speak.
Not even a Radiant Stage expert could come out of this one, least of all this Zhuo Fan freak.
“Holy! Just where did the old coot find so many Rumbling Blood Bats? They don’t grow on trees!” Long Jiu’s mind was in a haze, “Not even the brat could get out of this one.”
“What?” Xiao Dandan jerked, “You’re saying husband has no chance?”
Nodding gravely, Long Jiu sighed and pointed.
When Zhuo Fan was falling, Vicious Pill King made other signs and had Zhuo Fan surrounded by the hundred bats.
If he dared fly, the bats would blow him back down.
This barricaded area seemed to belong to a different world, covered by a hundred rare Rumbling Blood Bats. They tightened the space so much that it became smaller than Drifting Flowers Arena.
“Damn it!” Zhuo Fan frowned as he jumped in the sky again.
Hum~
Like a pillar coming from the heavens above, Zhuo Fan was sent into the ground without delay. His knees were touching dirt, blood seeped from his mouth, and all the rocks around him were blown away as nothing but dust.
“Ha-ha-ha, a hundred blood bats is so strong that even the kid’s unyielding body is wounded. His death is in sight.” Huangpu Qingyun laughed, watching Vicious Pill King with newfound respect, “Elder Yan, you’ve surprised me. I never knew you hid such wonderful things.”
“Second young master, you jest. These bats were gathered over the past thousand years by the Pill King Hall. I was only allowed to use them because of my modest contributions to Pill King Hall.”
Vicious Pill King then turned a sad look to Zhuo Fan, “Second young master, Zhuo Fan is, after all, a grandmaster alchemist. He may deserve death, but leave his corpse intact.”
“Humph, I really wanted to tear him apart, but since it’s Elder Yan’s request, I will let it go.” Huangpu Qingyun waved, pleased inside.
Nodding, Vicious Pill King made the hundred Rumbling Blood Bats open their snouts again.
All of them struck with sound attacks at the same time.
“Ah!”
With a wail, Zhuo Fan felt his head about to explode and his mind fading. His soul was damaged.
If not for the refining he had been through, he would’ve long had his soul scattered.
“Blast it! I still had a way out but now it’s useless. I should’ve used it when I had the chance! These bastards better hope I won’t get out of here or I will slaughter them all.”
His head hurting like hell, Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth and held on to his dear life. His bloodshot eyes and veiny forehead let the crowd in on the suffering he was enduring.
“Humph, he is a freak alright. Anyone would’ve hit the dirt by now, but he’s still holding strong.” 5th elder exclaimed.
