Huangpu Qingyun laughed, his eyes sharp, “So what if he’s a freak? He’s just slightly tougher than the average man. He’ll soon drop dead anyway. This is for the best. Killing him here will show the world what end awaits any who stands against Regent Estate.”
“Ah!”
Zhuo Fan’s wail never ceased, akin to a flogged wild beast. The rocks he had been clutching had long been crushed to powder.
Vicious Pill King didn’t indulge in taking revenge, only feeling endless regret. His greatest and most respected opponent would find himself dead in such a wretched way.
The alchemists around also sighed. But there was no one there willing to stand up to the seven houses.
Xiao Dandan’s face was covered in tears, pleading Chu Qingcheng with her eyes. She bit her lip, about to intervene, but Long Jiu pulled her back.
“Not even we can save him from the hundred Rumbling Blood Bats’ onslaught. We will only throw our lives away. Let it go, there is no point...” Long Jiu sighed at Zhuo Fan’s sorry state. Already thinking about how to abandon the Luo clan.
His alliance was with Zhuo Fan. Without him, the Veiled Dragon Pavilion had no reason to help the Luo clan. With Zhuo Fan dying, the alliance agreement would fall through.
[Sigh, brother, don’t blame me. I will look after your clan, but cannot uphold the alliance any longer. It just isn’t in the house’s benefit!]
Long Jiu sighed, while the rest lowered their heads in resignation.
Zhuo Fan was in dire straits, with no one appearing to aid him...

chapters.title: Chapter 163, I Want to Kill
chapters.content:
Chapter 163, I Want to Kill
Suddenly, Zhuo Fan’s wailing was cut short. Everyone’s heart seized with a shiver. Qingcheng even began shedding tears thinking Zhuo Fan was gone.
But what was so astonishing was that Zhuo Fan’s energy signature was still there, with an azure flame in the center of his forehead.
Under its cover, Zhuo Fan started breathing eased up. The sound waves didn’t stop, but they weren’t as aggravating as before.
“That’s...” Xie Tianyang cried, “I remember now! In his battle with You Guiqi, this azure flame appeared as well, shielding his soul.”
Indeed, Zhuo Fan was muddled from the pain to his soul and forgot about the azure flame protecting his soul.
Now that his soul was at its limit, the azure flame came out by itself.
With it, Zhuo Fan relaxed. Under the gentle and warm glow of the flame, his soul began to recover.
Zhuo Fan felt how it grew and was on the verge to break through into the Radiant Stage.
Slowly closing his eyes, Zhuo Fan remained kneeling and ignored everything around him as he let the warmth bathe him. This was a rare chance for his soul to advance and he wasn’t about to miss it.
The proud Huangpu Qingyun now cried in panic at Vicious Pill King, “Elder Yan, what’s happening? He still seems to be alive!”
“Uh, he’s not dead yet!” Vicious Pill King was also confused.
“Then what is this? Why isn’t he wailing and seems to be enjoying it instead?” Huangpu Qingyun was baffled.
Vicious Pill King rolled his eyes and shook his head, [How should I know?]
“Elder Yan.” Huangpu Qingyun squinted, “You can’t be thinking of going easy on him because he’s an incredible alchemist, are you?”
Incensed, Vicious Pill King snapped his glare on him, “Second young master, please watch your tone! Haven’t Pill King Hall always assisted Regent Estate? When have we ever shown the opposite? Aren’t we getting the Bodhi Root for you as well?”
“Ha-ha-ha, that remains to be seen. Everyone knows Pill King Hall yearns for this incredible treasure. Who knows, maybe you’ll just take it and run at first chance!” Huangpu Qingyun snorted.
Vicious Pill King was so furious he couldn’t say a word and his heart sank.
Zhuo Fan’s words may have been to break their teamwork, but they were undoubtedly true. This Huangpu Qingyun was no leader material, he was too narrow-minded.
th elder walked to Huangpu Qingyun, watching Zhuo Fan assaulted by the Rumbling Blood Bats and said, “Second young master, I think he had come up with a way to block the blood bats. If this continues, the situation will only worsen.”
“What do you think we should do?” Huangpu Qingyun was growing worried as well.
th elder revealed a wicked grin, “I suggest we attack him together. The blood bats sealed that uncanny movement skill and we can kill him at close range. Also, second young master, didn’t you speak of killing him yourself to ease your hatred? He-he-he...”
“Yes, we’ll do as you say.” Huangpu Qingyun nodded, and said to Vicious Pill King in request, when in fact it sounded more like a demand, “I’ll be troubling Elder Yan to stop the blood bat’s attack and let us go fight him ourselves. But remember, don’t let that kid escape again.”
Snorting inside, despite his anger, Vicious Pill King complied. Who told the Regent Estate and Pill King Hall to sign an alliance agreement? For lack of a better alternative, he had to obey.
With a hand sign, the hundred Rumbling Blood Bats stopped but Zhuo Fan’s eyes were still very much closed as he kneeled on the ground. He looked just like a man on his last leg, with his reserves spent, he was unable to even stand up. With one exception, the azure flame still flickered on his forehead.
“What’s wrong with him?” Chu Qingcheng asked, anxious.
With the sound attacks gone, he should’ve jumped to his feet. But he was sitting there like a statue instead. He may be either comatose or too weak to even move.
Both of which were the worst possibilities in such a dangerous situation.
Chu Qingcheng pleaded Long Jiu with her eyes, “Uncle Jiu...”
His lone eye shook as he said gravely, “Wait a bit longer!”
“If he still has a scheme in play, we will not only fail to save him by going in now, but even ruin his plan.” Xie Tianyang blurted.
The rest nodded.
They were all clear from Zhuo Fan’s handling of Huangpu Qingyun so far. He always aimed for when his opponent was unguarded. He was unfathomable to always seem to manage to have Huangpu Qingyun trapped again and again without even realizing it.
Huangpu Qingyun was thinking the same thing.
Zhuo Fan looked calm, unmoving, but who knew if he was faking it instead? They wanted to avoid his sudden assault, which could send another one of them to an early grave.
Huangpu Qingyun recalled just how dangerous it was so far and he was soaked in a cold sweat. His steps were even more careful as they neared Zhuo Fan.
The alchemists and the clans’ delegates bolted before they could witness the intricate battle of before.
To their eyes, two Profound Heaven experts, from the seven houses, were shaking in their boots in the face of a defenseless Bone Tempering cultivator.
They were dumbstruck!
[Dude, what’s up with that? You are the ones after his life, you are the strongest one here, yet you won’t dare get close to an unconscious man? You’re disgracing the seven houses, you know?]
Huangpu Qingyun’s response, if he could hear them, would be, [I know! Damn it!]
Taking a deep breath, Huangpu Qingyun closed in on Zhuo Fan ever so slowly, yet the sweat on his brow grew denser as well. He wasn’t afraid of fighting Zhuo Fan.
It was Zhuo Fan’s tricky nature that left him harried.
At the end of it all, he was just scared of falling for Zhuo Fan’s trick again!
When they finally got to Zhuo Fan, Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder tested with a punch.
Bam!
The golden fist smacked into Zhuo Fan’s face and sent him flying. Then a boom resounded as he was buried in rubble.
Huangpu Qingyun was stumped, [Wasn’t that too easy?] Zhuo Fan didn’t even react and he was now overjoyed. [He must be still out of it from the bats’ sound attacks.]
“5th elder, we were right. His brain is the only thing that kept him alive so far.” Huangpu Qingyun laughed.
th elder nodded and grinned as he invited, “If you would, second young master!”
The two puffed out their chest and strutted to the rubble.
The people were speechless. They were shaking in their boots before, but now they knew he was out like an extinguished candle, a lamb to the slaughter, they got their haughty attitudes back.
[W-what kind of people are these?]
The crowd looked at them with derision. They’d be raining mockeries if not for them being from the seven houses.
The two were too self-absorbed in their joy to notice, and were now going to pluck the fruit of victory.
Chu Qingcheng was panicking. Even if she acted now, it was far too late.
Long Jiu looked up at the circling bats, then around, and said through clenched teeth, “Jian Suifeng, Iris Overseer, Peony Overseer, come with me to deal with the bats. Kill as many as you can. Qingcheng, you go save the kid. I hope Huangpu Qingyun will go easy seeing a familiar face!”
Chu Qingcheng nodded with conviction.
But before they could start, another boom followed. Zhuo Fan jumped out of the rubble and the azure flame was also gone, but his eyes flashed with a bluish glow, as if flames still throbbed within.
“Who the hell hit me? Step up and I promise not to beat you to death!” He twisted his neck around to the two of them with an evil grin.
Startled, Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder were incredulous, “You’re fine even after being hit by a hundred bats’ attacks?”
“Ha-ha-ha, the hundred bats’ cawing were nothing but annoying.” Zhuo Fan showed a cryptic smile.
The people were dumbstruck. A hundred Rumbling Blood Bats were enough to kill a 5th level spiritual beast but he was safe and sound?
[Zhuo Fan is a freak through and through.]
Vicious Pill King was also dazed from shock. Long Jiu’s group finally relaxed.
“He is always giving us scares and worries. He has a talent to keep turning a crisis into a blessing in disguise!” Long Jiu sighed, but Chu Qingcheng frowned at the bats in the sky, “The danger has yet to pass.”
“No, it’s all fine now.”
Xie Tianyang smiled, “Look how his eyes changed. I only saw that look once, when he killed You Guiqi. I will never forget that unnerving confidence.”
They all looked and realized Xie Tianyang was right. Zhuo Fan’s entire demeanor changed. He was like a honed sword, waiting to leave its sheath and upturn the world.
And deep in the dark abyss that were his eyes, frigid killing intent roiled.
Even Long Jiu, a Profound Heaven expert, shivered. Xie Tianyang laughed and stretched, “He is itching to slaughter someone!”
Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder nearby the rubble were tense. But the hundred bats overhead worked to assure their safety, “Ha-ha-ha, Zhuo Fan, there’s nowhere for you to run. So stand still and await your death.”
“Run?”
Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan flicked his eyes at the beasts above and smiled, “Yeah, there’s nowhere to run now. And since none of you want to see me running, I will do just what you want and stay put.”
“Stay... and kill!” Zhuo Fan spat through gnashed teeth, riveting his boundless killing intent on the two of them.
The two shivered and their hearts were struck by an odd sense of fear.
The two found it hard to accept it, [How can this be...]

chapters.title: Chapter 164, Discerning Field
chapters.content:
Chapter 164, Discerning Field
Soul suppression!
It was an ability anyone with a powerful soul could use to put pressure on those weaker than him, until they could not even stand. Zhuo Fan didn’t reach that far but was enough to instill fear in his enemies.
This in turn caused them to feel shocked.
Although both were body cultivators, they were nonetheless still focused on training their souls in preparation to enter the Radiant Stage. The best example was Huangpu Qingyun, who trained in Imperial Tyrant Body Art, refining his body with dragon power but also able to use dragon soul to refine his own soul.
Their souls were strong, even for Profound Heaven experts like them.
However, reality showed Zhuo Fan’s soul exceeded theirs by so much, that they felt fear. The only explanation was that this kid had the soul of a Radiant Stage expert.
This thought crippled their hearts in fear. They stared dumbstruck at Zhuo Fan to such a degree that not even they could think it possible.
His cultivation was merely in the Bone Tempering Stage yet could go toe to toe with a Profound Heaven expert and even have his soul in the Radiant Stage. Was such an outlandish coincidence even possible?
Zhuo Fan picked up on their thinking and smirked, “I believe thanks are in order. Without the Rumbling Bat Wave’s torment, I would’ve never have gotten such a timely chance at breaking through!”
The azure fire in his eyes died out and Huangpu Qingyun’s heart seized with it. He felt a deep fear from the core of his being.
[That has to be it!]
The two were now certain Zhuo Fan just entered the Radiant Stage with his soul. His soul was indeed strong but not quite there yet to kill with intent alone.
The reason for his still position before, was because he was in the middle of advancing.
[This freak cannot be allowed to live!]
Yelling inside, Huangpu Qingyun signaled 5th elder with his eyes. 5th elder picked up on his decision and got ready.
They had to end him now while they still had the chance. Or when he grasped how to kill with intent, it’d be too late!
Bam!
With no preamble, Huangpu Qingyun shot towards Zhuo Fan. His body lit up in a golden glow and was preparing a punch.
th elder also took out his hammer, aiming at Zhuo Fan’s head.
Zhuo Fan was suddenly overshadowed as if a mountain was about to fall on him. Suddenly, in front of him was Huangpu Qingyun with his majestic fist, holding enough power to break mountains and cleave seas.
In face of such devastating assault, Zhuo Fan was unphased. Two azure glows flickered in his eyes and all he did was slant his head, and the might fist hit nothing but air.
The golden light traced passed his ear, blowing up a whole street of houses, yet powerless enough to not touch a single hair on Zhuo Fan’s head.
Regarding the incoming hammer, Zhuo Fan simply jumped and was out of its range.
The hammer boomed into the ground, caving the earth for 20 meters around, yet only enough to reach Zhuo Fan’s toes. He was barely standing at the edge, at peace, as if all was natural in the world.
Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder were nervous, going at him again, with a flurry of fists and a rain of hammer blows. There were so many blows. Each was so fast that it should have sealed any means of escape.
However, Zhuo Fan lightly sidestepped around the attacks without even the use of Mystifying Phantom Step. Simple footwork was enough to get him out of any and all danger.
Throughout these hundred blows, Zhuo Fan had danced in but a 2 meter circle, while Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder were powerless to even ruffle his clothes.
This spectacle was unheard of, much less seen, eliciting cries from the crowd.
Two Profound Heaven experts were rendered moot in the face of a Bone Tempering Stage cultivator. They attacked a hundred times but not once succeeded. Even if this was staged, it was not possible to have such uncanny accuracy.
While it was impossible to make sense of it all, it was all so clear to Long Jiu and the rest. But they were all so shocked, so astonished, that they only stared bugged eyed for a long time.
They were clear of this being a Radiant Stage cultivator’s ability, the Discerning Field!
Within its range, the user could detect the most minute change. It was also easy enough to detect an attack’s course.
This was the reason behind all his perfect evasions. While he was under a barrage of blows, his heart was as still as water.
“This brat had reached a whole new level of freak. That’s a Radiant Stage’s ability, yet used by a Bone Tempering cultivator...” Long Jiu was astonished, yet his heart was pained.
How many elders of Veiled Dragon Pavilion worked their whole lives to reach the Radiant Stage, to feel its power for themselves, yet were unable to? Long Jiu was no exception.
However, this up and coming Zhuo Fan, still wet behind his ears, beat them to it. It was a sense of defeat mixed with admiration that made it so hard to swallow.
He saw Zhuo as his brother, but he could not cast out all the envy he had. Why were they so different? Why couldn’t he do it as well?
Xie Tianyang sighed as well, “By the looks of it, our little freak came out of his shell and became a full-fledged abomination. I wonder if he even has a limit. Will I ever be able to reach him?
“Ha-ha, it doesn’t look like it...” Xie Tianyang shook his head in frustration.
The others sighed and nodded.
Back to the battle, Zhuo Fan skipped around calmly, escaping the enemies’ range. The only thing off about him was the azure glint ever-present in his eyes.
Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder were already panting. They could guess as to the reason as well, but knowing didn’t enable them to solve it.
Zhuo Fan, a Bone Tempering cultivator, was armed with the Radiant Stage’s Discerning Field, leaving them powerless to even land a glancing blow.
“You little prick, fight me if you dare! Come on, be a man for a change!”
Perhaps his mind was taxed, or his patience long overdrawn, that 5th elder started cursing Zhuo Fan. He was now regretting doing it.
[Since two great Profound Heaven experts can’t finish a mere Bone Tempering cultivator, you’re asking him to stand still? If this isn’t ridiculous then what is?]
[You might as well ask him to tie himself up for you while he’s at it.]
His words were met with profound disdain from the crowd. The seven houses picking on others was a common occurrence, but never had they sunk so low.
[Humph, now I know why Grandmaster Zhuo killed You Guiqi. That old coot was so insufferable that he couldn’t take it anymore. Hell Valley must be the most shameless of all seven houses!]
Many whispers traveled, and none were good, holding some hint of scorn, whether open or otherwise.
Huangpu Qingyun glared at the senile fool, [If you want to disgrace yourself, fine. But don’t go around dragging me into your mess. Just what is Hell Valley’s requirement for elders these days? Shamelessness?]
Zhuo Fan only quirked an eyebrow and smiled a nod, “I guess that’s fine. Since I don’t plan on going anywhere either, I suppose I might as well give you a sound defeat. You see this spot, I won’t move from it!”
Zhuo Fan then planted his feet a tad deeper into the ground, his face filled with zest, “Just like in refining earlier. If my feet leave this spot, my head will be yours!”
Sss~
The crowd gasped in fright.
[The heroism of Grandmaster Zhuo is so unmatched it got to his head! There was nothing to fear while refining since you had that amazing ancient secret refining art. It is all because of that, that you managed to keep your head!]
[But this is another matter entirely. You, sir, a Bone Tempering cultivator, although stronger than average but is still a Bone Tempering cultivator nonetheless. For the love of god. You are facing two shameless and despicable Profound Heaven experts head-on. They won’t go easy on you just ’cause you’re weaker.]
[If you’re still doing with all this into account, then, it’s your funeral!]
Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder jerked but turned bewildered.
“You little prick, what are you playing at?” Huangpu Qingyun eyed him cautiously.
And the crowd rolled their big white eyes, with some close to spurting blood.
[Grandmaster Zhuo is rooted to the spot and all that’s left is to tie him up. Yet, you fools are overthinking it saying it’s some sort of scheme of his?]
[Humph, guess there’s no frickin’ relation between a man’s nerve and his cultivation.]
[A Bone Tempering cultivator has more guts to face two Profound Heaven experts, while you two are more scared than a mouse. You don’t get to see this every day!]
The people could no longer stand for how despicable they acted and scorned them despite being from the seven houses.
Huangpu Qingyun’s face was aflame, finding his own words somewhat faint-hearted. But it was best to be safe rather than sorry in that punk’s trap.
Laughing, Zhuo Fan didn’t even try hiding it, “Of course I have one. But nothing overt, just something necessary.”
Zhuo Fan took out a bottle and snickered, “Don’t forget, I’m an alchemist.”
He popped the cork and a blue gleaming pill landed in his hand with a shake.
“5th grade pill, Bursting Pill!”
Vicious Pill King’s cried. And Huangpu Qingyun was also panicking as he flitted back tens of meters, “He’s gonna blow!”
The scene was thrown into chaos as people scampered all over the place for cover. They feared a Bone Tempering cultivator’s detonation would reach them.
Long Jiu’s group was startled and perplexed. The situation wasn’t that dire to warrant such an extreme decision as blowing himself up.
To be truthful, the Bursting Pill was in fact only useful when one did detonate himself!
The people looked at Zhuo Fan’s calm face, still sporting that cryptic smile of his...

chapters.title: Chapter 165, Dominatin
chapters.content:
Chapter 165, Dominatin
One, two, three... The pills fell in Zhuo Fan’s hand with a light tap of the bottle. And with every fall of the azure gleaming pill, hearts were strung tighter than a fiddle.
When five gathered in his palm, Zhuo Fan placed the bottle away, “Five pills ought to be the limit.”
“Five?!” Vicious Pill King’s eyelid twitched.
A single Bursting Pill could increase one’s Yuan Qi by ten times. If the body couldn’t take it, it would blow up from the strain. That explosion was also ten times stronger than a simple self-detonation.
Taking these pills would turn Zhuo Fan into a ticking time bomb. It increased his power fifty times, but the explosion would be no less than a Profound Heaven expert’s.
The damage wouldn’t be limited to this small area either, but the entire Drifting Flowers City. It would be swept by the shockwave, razed to the ground.
Vicious Pill King’s heart shuddered as he shouted in fear, “Stop him, or he’ll drag us all down with him!”
Too little, too late. Zhuo Fan swallowed the pills without hesitation.
In a blink, the wind picked up, and a rumbling echoed.
Under the frightened eyes of his audience, the space around Zhuo Fan warped. Something seemed to seep out of his body as well, looking akin to raw and physical Yuan Qi.
His Lightning Wings had grown twice their size.
Under constant changes, Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth as sweat trickled down his brow. His fist clenched, his face, grim from the unspeakable pain.
But he held on to his voice, not letting even a grunt escape.
Bam!
His body shivered and his two arms exploded in size. His forehead sported the azure flame again, but this time bigger than before.
The azure flame now burned hotter, his wings flickered with thunder, and his cold eyes were bloodshot. His twisted face as well looked ready to unleash a gruesome power.
The people watched the advent of their death from afar, incredulous of how much power he had gotten.
He rose steadily from the 2nd layer of Bone Tempering Stage under the watchful eyes of Vicious Pill King and the rest, with constant anguish.
The stronger he got, the more bang for his buck. If his control slipped while he powered up, the explosion would be less, but only by a fraction.
But Zhuo Fan stubbornly hung on and his power soared.
Huangpu Qingyun was appalled, but he was crying inside. [What in god’s name is this brat made of? How is he still holding it together?]
With a relieving sigh, just like a tornado, Zhuo Fan’s power up reached the end. Yet, outside of everyone’s expectation, there was no explosion.
All they saw was a calm Zhuo Fan breathing in and out.
“That’s...” Vicious Pill King’s voice trembled, “I-it’s the Profound Heaven Stage!”
The others could see the fierce aura around him and gasped. In just a few breaths, Zhuo Fan climbed from the 2nd layer of Bone Tempering Stage all the way to the Profound Heaven Stage.
[T-this is too astonishing!] Huangpu Qingyun and the 5th elder’s faces were grave.
They knew now the pills weren’t to off himself, but to increase his power.
But how could a man accomplish such a feat?
To the average man, a ten times Yuan Qi increase would burst him like a balloon. But this brat withstood five times of that.
[Just how tough is he?]
“Monster!”
Huangpu Qingyun couldn’t help but voice it. The others also watched with shock and awe of Zhuo Fan’s staunch body.
Making a come hither gesture at Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder, Zhuo Fan mocked them with a smile, “Didn’t you want to fight? Well, come and get me!”
The audacity and scorn made Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder burst with anger. This was the first time they were ever mocked this much.
They shot at Zhuo Fan without words and Huangpu Qingyun launched a golden fist right at his face.
“You little shit, if you have the nerve to taunt then don’t dodge and take it like a man!” Huangpu Qingyun was goading him.
Smirking, Zhuo Fan lifted his hand, “There’s no longer a need to dodge...”
Bam!
Fists met, tearing up the air with a sharp explosion and making ears sting from it. The two’s Yuan Qi collided and spread like a tidal wave all around.
The pebbles and rocks around were pulverized under such raw unbridled power.
The people were frantic in getting their Yuan Qi up to shield themselves, but some weak Bone Tempering cultivators were flung twenty meters away and spat blood.
The shock from a simple clash dominated their hearts. The fight was going to be intense.
But then, their eyes widened.
They watched in shock as Huangpu Qingyun’s all-out attack was simply blocked by Zhuo Fan. The latter didn’t even look to be trying.
Suddenly, 5th elder entered the scene from behind, swinging that hammer right at his head.
Dong!
Screeching of metal on metal resounded and another shockwave sped away. The audience worked to withstand it but dozens were flung into the air.
Yet, when they looked up now, their eyes were twitching.
Zhuo Fan’s face was as calm as ever, to the point of ignoring the 5th elder completely and letting a wing lightly block the hammer.
Zhuo Fan didn’t even shudder from the blow.
Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder cried frantically, “Impossible!”
“Nothing’s impossible, especially when it comes to yours truly!” Zhuo Fan gripped Huangpu Qingyun’s fist and threw him.
Huangpu Qingyun slammed into the ground, sinking inch by inch.
Not forgetting about the 5th elder either, his Lightning Wings slightly shook and the old man flew for a hundred meters before hitting the ground. But even so, he had to take six more steps back to stabilize.
Looking at Zhuo Fan now, the 5th elder was frightened. But his heart couldn’t accept it and charged again. Zhuo Fan brushed his attempt off, only staring down at Huangpu Qingyun with sarcasm, “Second young master, remember when you talked to me about men and women? Then allow me to inform you that this time, only those standing... are real men.”
It was naked humiliation!
Huangpu Qingyun roared and swung at Zhuo Fan. He was Regent Estate’s second young master, how dared someone insult him?
th elder arrived as well, smashing with his hammer.
But Zhuo Fan only laughed at their futile attempts.
His body was refined with Diamond Sand into a 5th-grade demonic treasure. He couldn’t take these two on earlier because his Yuan Qi was lacking in bringing about the body’s true potential.
Taking five Bursting Pill compensated for this, allowing him to use his demonic treasure body to its full capabilities. Adding to his Radiant Stage soul, how could these two even land a hit?
Grinning, Zhuo Fan placed a hand behind him and only used his left to block everything and anything Huangpu Qingyun threw at him. At the same time, he used his wings to dance to 5th elder’s hammering tune.
Clangs and dings were heard constantly, as the power behind each swing was enough to pulverize anything around them
The sting from the explosions hurt the people’s ears but they were too dumbstruck to mind.
Seeing how easily Zhuo Fan handled two Profound Heaven experts while standing still was hard to believe, even when seeing it themselves.
[What is wrong with this world? Since when did there exist a Bone Tempering cultivator who is such a monster, capable of making Profound Heaven experts become his stepping stone? This is two on one, and they can’t even gain the upper hand! Worst, their opponent is taking it in stride.]
Despite their curses, they knew the truth. The Profound Heaven experts that laid in front of their eyes were in no way weak, but this Bone Tempering youth was simply too much of a monster!
Long Jiu’s group was stupefied.
A blink was all it took for Zhuo Fan’s power to surpass everyone’s imagination. Their minds couldn’t cope with the impossible scene unfolding right before their eyes.
The world flipped, the power scheme upturned, and a Bone Tempering cultivator was playing with two Profound Heaven experts!
Chu Qingcheng and her overseers were bug-eyed. It was Iris Overseer who first recovered somewhat to gasp, “Demon Zhuo Fan lives up to his infamy. The monster of all freaks.”
Xie Tianyang felt like crying, “8th elder, I should go find elder brother to train with my sword. I want to revive Sword Marquise Abode. There’s no point in going after that brat. That dream... is just wishful thinking!”
Jian Suifeng sighed as well.
Ever since they saw Zhuo, not only the juniors, but even the elders were suffering a serious blow to their self-esteem...

chapters.title: Chapter 166, Dauntless
chapters.content:
Chapter 166, Dauntless
Boom~
Not for a second did the explosion stopped.
Huangpu Qingyun had now clashed two hundred times with Zhuo Fan. Adding 5th elder’s hammer blows, it made for a total of four hundred yet Zhuo Fan had not once lost his cool.
No matter how the two attacked, they could not even scratch him.
With cold laughter, Zhuo Fan was now looking at them as if they were a bunch of noisy children, hardly of any threat.
Hu~
Suddenly, the azure flame flickered above Zhuo Fan slowly dissipated. Zhuo Fan’s brow was locked, finally sporting a serious face.
[Almost there!]
“Humph, have you swung enough? My turn then.”
Snorting, the ever passive Zhuo Fan just stretched his hand and gripped Huangpu Qingyun’s wrist in a vise.
Bam!
A simple ordinary fist hit the man squarely in the belly and gave Huangpu Qingyun the feeling as if a mountain bore through. He then whistled through the air like a ragdoll.
Only to pass through dozens of buildings on his way and ending under a pile of rubble.
With one down, Zhuo Fan looked askance at the ever swinging 5th elder. One wing shifted and flowed along the hammer like a viper and latched onto his shoulder.
The other whipped him on the chest.
Bam!
With a thunderous sound that could only be made by a crumbling mountain, 5th elder flew into the air before smacking into the ground, leaving behind a deep hole.
When he staggered out of it, he slipped and fell down, spewing blood.
“Five... ribs broken!” 5th elder tried to bear through the pain as his brow was marred with cold sweat.
He had never suffered this much in his entire life as a body cultivator. Worse, just one thrash was all it took to break his five ribs.
Huangpu Qingyun faired no better. He got out of the rubble only to hit the dirt, and spat OUT blood five times; with pieces of flesh in the puddle.
Clutching his stomach, he was aware of the heavy wounds his organs suffered. But his shock of Zhuo Fan’s power trumped it.
He cultivated the Imperial Tyrant Body Art yet, couldn’t take even a punch?
The azure flame died from his forehead and Zhuo Fan eyed the two coldly. He lightly stepped out of the footprints he made and patronized, “I gave you not one, but two chances. It’s you who are too weak to make use of them. You ought to be convinced of your defeat by now. So it is only proper for me to take your lives.”
The crowd was in complete shock!
With the two of them being second young master of Regent Estate and 5th elder of Hell Valley, they may be beaten at every turn, but only they had the privilege of killing others whenever and however they wanted. It was not supposed to be not the other way around. It was as if their killer couldn’t give a rat’s ass about the seven houses’ retaliation.
But the crowd doubled back and wondered again, [Who is this man?]
Demon Zhuo Fan, killer of the insidious You Guiqi. So, why would he care if he messed with Hell Valley, again?
When one of the Seven Noble Houses was offended, what difference would it make if he added another?
This realization got the audience’s expectation to rise!
The Seven Noble Houses had no one to answer to for a thousand years, until now. This was perhaps a once in a lifetime chance to see the Seven Noble Houses finally being on the receiving end. It was high time they got what they deserved in full.
They masked the joy they felt, silently cheering.
[Grandmaster Zhuo, you’re our man! Kill them, kill them all...]
Besides, it had nothing to do with them anyway. It wasn’t like enjoying the show was a capital crime!
Zhuo Fan seemed to have heard their hearts and stepped towards Huangpu Qingyun with killing intent in his eyes.
Huangpu Qingyun was downright panicking, finally getting acquainted with the taste of fear for the very first time. He never saw someone as powerful as Zhuo Fan, nor one to have such a matching imposing flair.
Deep down, he began to feel like a meager ant waiting to be squished.
Sweating like a pig, Huangpu Qingyun fell backward with a mask of fear and not even trying to put on a token of resistance.
Hell Valley’s 5th elder felt just as helpless.
This freak Zhuo Fan surpassed their expectations. He wanted to go and help but he needed power, which he didn’t possess. Also, what was he doing going around helping Regent Estate’s second young master when his situation was no better?
However, a seven-colored mist flew at the squinting Zhuo Fan, “Rainbow Cloud Palm, Yan Song!”
“Of course it is me!”
Vicious Pill King propped his frail body as he used the signature profound ranked martial art of Pill King Hall. His mouth curved into a grin, “Grandmaster Zhuo, I admit your refining skill is thousands of times better than mine, but your escape is nigh impossible from the poison of my Rainbow Cloud Palm.”
“Yan Song, putting up this front will only speed your death. Why must you throw your life away?” Zhuo Fan frowned as he shouted at Vicious Pill King.
Grinning, Vicious Pill King raised his head and sighed, “Repaying favor with favor!”
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow and secretly nodded.
Boom!
The seven-colored poisoned mist swallowed Zhuo Fan whole.
Huangpu Qingyun was grasping straws at this point, happy to find hope in this frail rescuer, “Thank you Elder Yan, but this brat is a freak of nature. Can your Rainbow Cloud Palm handle him?”
“Cough, cough... no, it can only buy time!”
Using a profound ranked martial art with an already weary and damaged body only aggravated his precarious state resulting in a vicious coughing fit, followed by spitting blood. Yan Fu could no longer stand still and watch him suffer, but Vicious Pill King gestured to him to stand down.
“Second young master, the Bursting Pill has increased his power to Profound Heaven Stage for a short while, but it comes with side effects. As this power isn’t his to begin with, once the time is up... cough~”
“You’re saying he’ll go back to normal?” Huangpu Qingyun’s eyes shined, his face ecstatic. He could see the dawn of victory on the horizon.
Vicious Pill King smiled, “It won’t stop there. He forced himself to increase his power and it will undoubtedly harm his body, no matter how tough he is. Once his boost is sapped, his body will be torn from the inside, his power is waning. He will be nothing more than a lamb to the slaughter!”
“We just need to hang on for a bit and victory will be ours!” Huangpu Qingyun found hope rekindled. 5th elder was thrilled as well.
“But how long can he last?” 5th elder asked nervously, and Huangpu Qingyun looked at Yan Song eagerly.
Snickering, Vicious Pill King’s eyes glinted at the rainbow mist, “Not long. You may not have noticed but the azure flame wisped away from his forehead. His time is running short.”
Huangpu Qingyun reddened with shame. The two were scared shitless and that made them lose all reason.
Vicious Pill King shook his head, fully grasping the seriousness of the situation, “Second young master, you can’t blame yourselves. This brat is too cunning, seeing through you and having you buy into his fake bravado. He is now under my Rainbow Cloud Palm and is suffering from its poison. He will soon be too weak to put up any resistance.”
Huangpu Qingyun was immensely grateful. He could finally see the light. Chu Qingcheng however, was frowning in worry.
Then a sudden laughter came from within the mist.
“Ha-ha-ha, you’re indeed praise worthy, Vicious Pill King. I can’t hide the Bursting Pill’s side effect from you! Although, you are wrong about one thing. The time I have to kill the likes of you is aplenty!”
“Humph, Grandmaster Zhuo, you can’t fool me! You had your chance before, but now, under my Rainbow Cloud Palm’s poison, your Yuan Qi will be sapped even faster!”
“Oh, you mean these seven poisons?”
More laughter spread from the mist, “Elder Yan, you may not recall our discussion but, to whom this world belonged to again?”
“My answer is to men and smart people, naturally!” Vicious Pill King didn’t know where Zhuo Fan was going with this.
With another laughter, Zhuo Fan continued, “Mine is different. The world belongs only to the strong!”
Suddenly, black billowing energy spewed from within the seven-colored mist and swallowed the poison mist whole. And from amidst the black energy, Zhuo Fan strutted out like a king, unharmed and untouched.
“Impossible! Pill King Hall’s thousand-year-long research in the seven poisons...” Bug-eyed, Vicious Pill King staggered two steps back.
All the shocks he experienced today paled to this.
Grinning, Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed, “Old man, do you get my meaning? I am not saying you should lump me together with those useless broads. What I’m saying is not to take me for a weakling, the same as them. Your poison only works on the weak, with not one damn effect on the strong like me.”
Vicious Pill King gasped heavier and heavier. Unknown if from shock or anger.
But Iris Overseer was so pissed her eyes spat fire, “Who is this brat calling weak?”
“Easy now, easy, it’s all just an act.” Xie Tianyang placated her, and smiled, “Moreover, his words clarified that you and he have nothing going on. This is for your own good. At least Regent Estate won’t come finding faults with you.”
“Yeah, darling’s words are savage but he’s always looking out for us. Not to mention, we are indeed weaker than darling!” Xiao Dandan looked at him like a love-struck puppy. Infatuated the more she gazed upon him, and grew in boldness as well.
Peony Overseer pinched her, “Damn girl, you’re starting to get on my nerves...”

chapters.title: Chapter 167, Invincible
chapters.content:
Chapter 167, Invincible
Zhuo Fan dominated the battlefield. He was a living paragon, taking dauntless steps towards the three. The murderous glint in his eyes was razor-sharp and got them shaking from the very core.
Zhuo Fan was now the picture of indomitability, willing to slay everything that dared bar his path, including gods. Huangpu Qingyun had lost all will to even resist, standing there like a terrified chicken.
The three never dreamed they’d see the day when they would run into such a dreadful foe.
For three great experts, joint together too, sinking so low was an irony in and of itself.
Sweating bullets, Vicious Pill King watched Zhuo Fan with nothing but fear. He very much knew of his foe’s weakness, needing but little time to turn all of this around, yet, he couldn’t stop the sense of powerlessness boring deep in his heart.
This was power. He knew how to counter, but lacked the means to do so. The power gap was a bottomless pit.
Vicious Pill King wrecked his mind about and suddenly his eyes flashed with resolve. He took out a bottle toward the other two, “Second young master, both of you take a pill.”
He proceeded to give each of them one.
Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder stared at it in shock. Zhuo Fan’s brow also shook. He was more than familiar with it. In fact, it was the same pill he used, Bursting Pill.
Eyes shuddering, Huangpu Qingyun’s heavy gaze landed on Vicious Pill King, “Elder Yan, this is indeed the only way. Even if we need someone to self-destruct to kill him.”
Huangpu Qingyun squinted at 5th elder, “5th elder, I entrust this task to you. Have no worry, I will pay your valley a personal visit and present my utmost gratitude to Valley Lord, in honor of your selfless sacrifice. Regent Estate and Hell Valley will forevermore be allies!”
[When the time to blow is at hand, why the hell aren’t you doing it?]
th elder was about to rain curses, but Huangpu Qingyun’s dead set eyes cut him deep.
[Regent Estate is a double-crossing two-timing pack of pricks. I can bet my life on it that Huangpu Qingyun won’t ever take Hell Valley as his ally. Even if he does, what freaking good will that honor do me?]
th elder wouldn’t stick his head out even for Hell Valley.
Huangpu Qingyun saw 5th elder still wavering and stared him down while belittling him, “This brat is Hell Valley’s problem to begin with. It’s your duty to finish him!”
th elder’s face sank, itching to tear Huangpu Qingyun a new one.
[Hell Valley has a score to settle with this demon, but aren’t you also aiming to kill him? And now that you find yourself lacking, you wish to throw me to the wolves?]
Zhuo Fan shook his head and snickered.
When life and death hung in the balance, almost everyone would cling to their only vain chance at life. Why would he sacrifice himself for the sake of others? Everyone looked on with respect and deference towards Regent Estate but none would ever wash their necks and spill blood for them.
Who was that big of a fool anyway?
“He-he-he, no need to shift the blame, you’ll both be dropping dead soon enough.” Grinning, Zhuo Fan’s fist ebbed with black energy.
Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elders shuddered and stepped back in horror.
Vicious Pill King shook his head and shouted, “Second young master, 5th elder, this pill isn’t meant to kill you. It is to boost your power like it did to the brat.”
“What did you say?” The two shouted in unison, watching him flabbergast.
Sighing inside, Vicious Pill King showed a trace of disappointment. These two were great in the seven houses, but they couldn’t hold a candle to a kid’s valor.
His face hard, he spoke, “You are body cultivators, while he is a freak of nature, you are titans. If he could take five, how could you not even handle one? And since death is certain, why not go for broke? Isn’t it better to die on your terms then end up lambs to the slaughter like my weak self?”
The two trembled and gathered up their courage as they looked at the pill in their hands. Then they swallowed it.
Instantly, a gale blew and their Yuan Qi spiked. Overpowering Yuan Qi coursed through their veins, eating at their flesh. The pain was excruciating and elicited a roar from them both.
The Yuan Qi imbued roar scattered even the Rumbling Blood Bats. While the people around covered their ears in hope of dampening the splitting headache.
But this power couldn’t be denied, tearing at their ears and making them all bleed.
Zhuo Fan had to take a few steps back from the raw display of power. Vicious Pill King was pushed back more than ten feet as well, but his breath was as uneven as before.
With how Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder were Profound Heaven experts to begin with, a ten times increase in power far outstripped the norm.
The increase finally stopped and the two felt the surging Yuan Qi within their bodies. The power was intoxicating, evident from their excited faces.
They could never believe this was their power.
Now looking at Zhuo Fan, they shed all fears and bore down on him with killing intent.
“Ha-ha-ha, this outcome is only logical. Taking a Bursting Pill is nothing when you’re a Profound Heaven Stage cultivator.” Vicious Pill King laughed in glee. This was his desperate attempt at turning things around, yet never once did he believe it would work.
Long Jiu’s group felt the two’s raw power, far exceeding Zhuo Fan’s and were filled with concern. Zhuo Fan’s advantage was stripped and, even worse, his time was running out.
As time passed, the two may not be able to defeat him, but his Yuan Qi would run dry and all that awaited him was death.
Zhuo Fan couldn’t be more clearer on this. In fact, this was his main worry.
Tightening his fists, with a burst of power, Zhuo Fan’s wings flickered and stared down the three of them, “We all know I don’t have time to waste. So I’ll just snatch victory with one blow.”
“Humph, couldn’t agree more. I will take your head myself.”
With great power came a great boost in ego to Huangpu Qingyun, releasing all that he was worth. Following dragons roars, six golden dragons swirled around him, the same as when he first attacked Zhuo Fan.
But soon, a seventh dragon was added.
“Imperial Tyrant Body Art, 7th stage!” Not only Vicious Pill King but even Long Jiu’s group gasped.
The Imperial Tyrant Body Art was a marvel among body cultivation methods. Each stage would transform the user body, toughening and strengthening it in all aspects. With him advancing in such a dire moment, Huangpu Qingyun’s power must’ve grown by no less than ten times.
In a blink, the people turned to Zhuo Fan with worry.
Huangpu Qingyun had now become the same level of freak as Zhuo Fan.
“He-he-he, you little shit, feast your eyes on Regent Estate’s Imperial Tyrant Body Art’s true power.”
Huangpu Qingyun roared and charged. The seven golden dragons swirled around and made all defense moot.
Zhuo Fan’s squinted fearlessly. He charged as well, although his display was much weaker.
At the moment of impact, Zhuo Fan revealed his trademark smirk, “Kid, when it comes to martial arts, your wretched Regent Estate has nothing on me!”
Zhuo Fan roared, “Wraith Style’s first move, Soaring Demonic Dragon!”
Roar!
With a sky shaking roar, Zhuo Fan was enveloped in the image of a black dragon as he clashed with Huangpu Qingyun.
The seven golden dragons and the black dragon collided, unleashing a shockwave of epic proportion. The witnesses had to cough blood while the weaker ones were knocked out cold.
Even Vicious Pill King was hurled three hundred meters into the air.
He never would’ve guessed Zhuo Fan was hiding so many outstanding abilities. It was no less than Regent Estate’s Imperial Tyrant Body Art, if not stronger.
When things finally settled, people relaxed. They turned to see smoke billowing and watched dumbstruck.
Zhuo Fan and Huangpu Qingyun changed positions, but Zhuo Fan was as mighty as ever, with no decrease in his aura, just like a god of war. His eyes flashed with boundless valor.
As for Huangpu Qingyun, he was pale and blood pooled at his feet. Looking down he saw half of his body in pieces. His innards had long turned to dust.
“H-how can it be... so strong...”
Huangpu Qingyun’s eyes bulged out of his sockets as he peered into the hole in his body. Then, his eyes went dead, and collapsed in his own blood. His death was the same as any of Zhuo Fan’s victims, filled with endless remorse.
Sss~
Gasping, the people stared at Zhuo Fan with dread. Huangpu Qingyun, under the Bursting Pill, at the peak of his power, was killed in one blow.
Vicious Pill King as well as Long Jiu watched, astonished at Zhuo Fan’s new degree of power, making them reassess this youth’s level.
They thought that in Huangpu Qingyun’s newfound power against Zhuo Fan, a tie was already an extravagant wish. But it went way beyond that, getting killed with only a single blow.
Xie Tianyang gasped and lamented, “Now I really need to go practice my sword with big brother...”
For this week, we will be posting 5 chapters a week cause we reached the goal. Well, if next week is below the goal, we will revert back to 4.

chapters.title: Chapter 168, Leaving By Suicide
chapters.content:
Chapter 168, Leaving By Suicide
It was just too hard a truth to swallow.
Hell Valley’s 5th elder still sported a confident smile in his power, just as Huangpu Qingyun before him. But witnessing the latter’s miserable ending cut all his bravado short as he reeled back again and again.
[No, that is no human. Not even a Bursting Pill is enough to defeat him. I need to escape, now!]
“Second young master!”
Suddenly, four cries echoed and four figures were next to Huangpu Qingyun and lamenting his fate. Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow at the four. They were Huangpu Qingyun’s porters, in the 1st layer of the Profound Heaven Stage.
However, Zhuo Fan’s soul was now in the Radiant Stage and this time, looked at the four with a frown and suspicious eyes.
These guys were indeed of Profound Heaven cultivation but were weak as hell, even when compared with peak Bone Tempering experts. [No wonder Huangpu Qingyun told them to stand aside. But why are they here anyway?]
At one point in his thinking, Zhuo Fan’s vision swirled and his body was on the verge of collapse.
[Damnation, I’m running out of time.]
Gnashing his teeth, Zhuo Fan braced himself to keep up appearances and then flee from this place. Staying here longer than necessary would only make it worse for him, as he wouldn’t be able to hold on for long and fall unconscious. At that point, his head was up for grabs.
But he didn’t get the chance as the four porters roared and jumped him, “You savage mongrel! You dare kill Regent Estate’s second young master, we will kill you!”
“Just the four of you? Please!”
Zhuo Fan snorted, but as the four approached, his mind whirled and his power plummeted. Bursting Pill’s effect was declining faster and faster.
Bitting his tongue to clear his head, Zhuo Fan’s wing lashed out and the three porters were cut in two while the latter was wailing on the ground having his arm chopped off.
Ignoring the ‘lucky’ fellow, Zhuo Fan flew away as fast as he could.
Vicious Pill King paused for a moment before yelling, “5th elder, stop him now! His fight with second young master used up his Yuan Qi and can’t hold on for long. We have to keep him here at all costs.”
When 5th elder was ready to slink into obscurity, he whipped his head around and saw the three dead and one rolling on the ground. His eyes lit up then laughed out loud.
Demon Zhuo Fan’s attacks were ruthless and precise. [How could he just harm and not kill? His body can’t take it and didn’t have the time to finish the last one.]
th elder then shot straight for Zhuo Fan and swung his mighty hammer.
With his vision fading away, Zhuo Fan swayed in his flight. He watched the incoming hammer dazed.
Chu Qingcheng was beside herself with worry, but there was not enough time to help.
th elder cackled, his eyes lit up with savagery, “Ha-ha-ha, demon Zhuo Fan, time to pay for what you did to 7th elder and second young master with your life.”
“You’re not nearly worthy enough to take my life!”
His body’s power was sapped, but his eyes never lost their ruthlessness. Bitting his tongue again to sober somewhat, Zhuo Fan roared and lashed with his wings like a pair of lightning whips.
Bam!
th elder’s hands went numb from pain, with the half a ton hammer slipping from his grip, flung away by Zhuo Fan.
Yet, 5th elder couldn’t be happier, “Ha-ha-ha, wise ass. It is you who fell for it this time. You can’t possibly fend me off when you have no wings to protect you and your body is too weak to resist!”
th elder’s hand was wrought in a fierce flame and clawed at Zhuo Fan’s chest, “High spirit ranked martial art, Back Piercing Fire Claw!”
With the Lightning Wings used to fend off the hammer, they were too far off to recall them in time. Zhuo Fan’s chest was wide open.
With 5th elder being a body cultivator in the 5th layer of Profound Heaven Stage and using a high spirit ranked martial art, the strike would go straight through him.
Not even Zhuo Fan could keep his life then.
th elder smirked while Chu Qingcheng was watching below wracked with anxiety and powerless to help.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed coldly and said, “I already told you. You’re not worthy enough to take my life!”
Zhuo Fan roared, “Wraith Style’s second move, Ghostly Dragon Claw!”
With another heaven shaking dragonic roar, the two claws clashed.
Something incredible happened. In that instant, Zhuo Fan ripped 5th elder’s entire arm clean off.
Blood spurted but 5th elder took a long time for the feeling to sink in. He turned to his arm and then fell from the sky wailing.
Only Zhuo Fan, the invincible, stood in the sky like a king. The burning arm he was clutching, was now soaked in blood.
“Humph, no one is worthy of taking yours truly’s life!”
Snorting, Zhuo Fan once again displayed his power for all to see. He clenched his hand and 5th elder’s hand was ripped to pieces.
[He’s just too strong!]
They couldn’t be further from the truth. Zhuo Fan’s power kept dropping but even so, he ripped the arm off 5th elder despite the latter having been at his peak of power, and having taken the Bursting Pill.
Such power struck the core of everyone.
Vicious Pill King had long been reduced to standing there dumbly. Zhuo Fan’s early power was based on the five Bursting Pills.
But now that the pills’ effect was waning, how was he still invincible?
Even Long Jiu’s eye bulged out.
Who was Hell Valley’s 5th elder? An expert that clashed with Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s 3rd elder thousands of times to a draw. The shock was palpable, seeing his hand ripped off like it was a child’s play.
“Just how am I going to explain this to third brother? This little freak has far surpassed him. How shocked will he be when he finds out?”
Long Jiu shook his head, turning to Long Kui and Long Jie, “Maybe, you’ll be the one to break the news to him.”
The two had long stopped listening. They never had truly witnessed Zhuo Fan fight for real, and were now watching dumbstruck at what their peer was capable of.
Panting, Zhuo Fan had used too much of his energy. He snapped a cold glare at the dazed Vicious Pill King and flew off.
Biting his lip, Vicious Pill King’s eyes roamed everywhere and after some hesitation, he roared, “Zhuo Fan, don’t forget! I’m still around!”
The hundred Rumbling Blood Bats flew at Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan’s flight faltered and glared back, “Old fool, don’t be obstinate. I let you go in respect from one grandmaster alchemist to another. Don’t you come and throw your life away!”
“Humph, as I was entrusted, I shall reply with the same devotion! Second young master is dead and only your head will keep me alive! Bluntly speaking, either you die, or I die!”
Vicious Pill King roared as his hand made signs. The hundred Rumbling opened their snouts and unleashed Rumbling Bat Waves on Zhuo Fan.
A huge ripple struck Zhuo Fan just like a tidal wave.
Chu Qingcheng was overwhelmed with alarm. This was a soul attack. Zhuo Fan’s tough body was useless against it and could only resist with the azure flame.
And when that happened, he’d be too exhausted to leave.
But Zhuo Fan wasn’t fretting.
He flicked his eyes to Vicious Pill King and made a hand sign, “Since that is your wish, I shall oblige. Wraith Style’s third move, Necro Dragon’s Screech!”
Zhuo Fan snapped his jaws open and roared!
This dragon roar was unlike the Rumbling Blood Bat’s wave, it came out of Zhuo Fan’s mouth and appeared as a dragon. It flew in the air and shook the whole world.
“T-that’s a sound martial art, and a goddamned Profound Rank at that!” Xie Tianyang had never been so overwhelmed with shock in his entire life. He said to Long Jiu, “Didn’t he say he comes from a third rate clan? Just where the hell did he really come from when such an art doesn’t even exist in the entire Tianyu Empire, or the seven houses?”
Long Jiu shook his head bitterly, “How am I supposed to know? That is one secret only the brat knows. But there’s one absolute truth, he did not come from that third rate clan.”
Xie Tianyang nodded slowly.
Then, the two sound waves collided.
The tidal wave and the dragon fought each other and the aftermath spread well into the crowd below.
The previous shockwaves were from Yuan Qi, so the people could resist it. But this time, it was a soul attack.They would hit the ground, dead if their souls lacked in the least.
Chu Qingcheng used her soul to resist and Peony Overseer covered Xiao Dandan behind her. But even they, Profound Heaven experts were forced to spew blood.
With pain came shock, unable to believe that a sound martial art was unblockable. They weren’t even the real targets of the attack and were already suffering. It was unimaginable how astonishing its power was on the real target.
The people began looking at Zhuo Fan with dread. Vicious Pill King was relying on the hundred Rumbling Blood Bats while Zhuo Fan could do it himself.
His hand made another sign as Vicious Pill King did his best to withstand the shockwave, with dark blood leaking from his mouth. Never had he dreamt it possible for Zhuo Fan to use a sound martial art. He was an abomination!
He was able to hold Zhuo Fan back before, but now...
Squinting, Zhuo Fan saw through the old coot’s inability and roared again.
The huge dragon above whipped its tail and the tidal sound wave was dissolved. It then flew through the hundred Rumbling Blood Bats, who’s eyes went blank as they fell on the ground like hail.
Such was irony, cruel and merciless. The powerful blood bats, prideful in their sound waves were shot dead by Zhuo Fan’s own sound attack.
But the huge dragon didn’t stop there, passing through Vicious Pill King as well. His mind went blank, with not even a simple thought coming to him.
Then, his body plopped two the ground, stiffly. Yan Fu wailed, “Master!”
Zhuo Fan grinned and flew away. When his figure was gone, a mad laughter resounded, “The great seven houses beneath the imperial family are not able to kill one man even with seven against one. Their name is undeserved, bringing shame to the entire world, ha-ha-ha...”

chapters.title: Chapter 169, Calamitous Casualties
chapters.content:
Chapter 169, Calamitous Casualties
Zhuo Fan was long gone yet the people still stared dumbly in his direction.
And when they managed to gather their wits, all they heard were mournful cries all around. The ground was littered with corpses and thousands of wounded, the aftermath of Zhuo Fan and Huangpu Qingyun’s fierce clash.
The last sound wave, in particular, must’ve caused over a thousand to fall!
Hell Valley’s 5th elder weakly got to his feet, watching dazed, his missing arm bellowed to the sky, “Zhuo Fan!”
These two simple words were mixed with hatred and rage that any other survivor had after this bitter battle.
Yep, after this ’bout’ Zhuo Fan’s name would be heard clearer and further than ever, but never in a good light. He was one of the very few notorious figures known in Tianyu since its foundation.
Demons paled to what he had become now.
Towards the bodies strung about, to the endless suffering ramming their ears, people had only horror in their core. But at the same time, two words were deeply etched in their minds.
[Demon Archon!]
Chu Qingcheng’s group finally came to as well, only to look on with pity at the miserable state surrounding them and sent people to count in the dead. Xiao Ya was soon back with a tally, and a visage painted in sorrow.
“Edifice Lord, in the aftermath of the battle, 4862 are dead and 36019 people are wounded. This count is mainly the heavily wounded, while the light wounded are too many to count.”
“So many!”
Iris Overseer cried and said inside, [Is Zhuo Fan the harbinger of death? He killed so many in just one strike!]
Long Jiu’s group was startled as well.
They were aware of how insanely powerful the brat was, but not once they thought him capable of this. It was no different than the aftermath of a skirmish.
“And...” Xiao Ya faltered, but still said it, “Because of Hundred Pill Meeting, many delegates of important clans have come. The number of casualties is disastrous, with more than two thousand clans having lost their people, and ten thousand more in critical condition.”
Chu Qingcheng’s heart tightened and was agitated, “Xiao Ya, try to calm them down. Tell them Drifting Flowers Edifice will give them an answer for this disaster. That we will also offer some compensation for their losses!”
“Yes!” Xiao Ya left with a nod.
Xie Tianyang took a deep breath, “Damn, killing more than four thousand at once. This brat is racking up enemies to an all-time high.”
“Humph, how is it darling’s fault? With how many died in the aftermath, they should be taking up with Regent Estate for the damages!” Not once did Xiao Dandan see Zhuo in a bad light and wasn’t one to tolerate anyone who spoke ill of him as well.
Xie Tianyang had to admit Xiao Dandan’s words with a nod, but then he jeered, “Oh, miss Dandan speaks true. Although... Who has the nerve to complain to the Seven Noble Houses? Not to mention, Regent Estate is also a victim, with four dead and a cripple.”
“Humph, since they don’t dare to take it up with Regent Estate, they think darling is one to be pushed around?” Xiao Dandan stuck out her chin in pride.
“Yeah, with that freak’s power, even a Profound Heaven expert would give him a wide berth. However...” Raising an eyebrow, Xie Tianyang chuckled, “Didn’t you listen to Vicious Pill King? The kid’s time is almost up, and he’ll be unable to move then. Even a three-year-old could do him in.”
That startled them.
If not for his reminder, they’d have forgotten Zhuo Fan might be lying somewhere, weak and alone.
“Everyone, scour the place for demon Zhuo Fan. I want him alive! He will have Regent Estate to answer to!” Chu Qingcheng ordered. The only way to pull the wool over the other’s eyes was to treat him like an enemy.
Xiao Dandan bore her stare into Xie Tianyang with hatred, “Why didn’t you say so earlier?”
“Would it have mattered? Those with half a brain are already searching for him!” Xie Tianyang pointed around them with a smile, “Tell me, who is missing here?”
Long Jiu’s group was puzzled. Only Xiao Dandan clapped, “It’s the Dong siblings.”
Then, she took off in Zhuo Fan’s direction.
“Silly girl, why so anxious?” Peony Overseer shouted.
“How can I not be? That Dong lass has a thing for darling. I can’t let her get ahead of me!”
The other had to laugh at that. Xiao Dandan was one innocent and chipper young lady!
Peony Overseer’s face flushed. [You nitwit disciple, you’re enough of a disappointment as it is. I get that you’re all googly-eyed over him but can you at least not make a fool out of me too?]
On another note, Zhuo Fan was rushing to fly away while also keeping an eye out for a nice corner of the world to hide and lick his wounds. All while his sight was growing ever hazy.
Suddenly, his vision went dark and passed out. His body then crash-landed into a small valley.
With a bang, he touched the ground and got buried in a pile of rocks.
Moon took the sun’s place in the sky, then soon, the sun rose back to its rightful place...
For three days, Zhuo Fan laid there among the rocks, defenseless. This was a blessing in disguise, as the wild animals would’ve dispensed with his body by now if he was out in the open.
Rustle~
On the dawn of the fourth day, morning dew trickled from the rocks and on Zhuo Fan’s face, rousing him from slumber.
Zhuo Fan opened his eyes and felt his whole body aching so much he couldn’t even budge.
His original plan was to take the root and flee. He’d then divide and conquer his pursuers, Huangpu Qingyun’s group of four, as they got further apart from each other going after him.
Bursting Pill was saved as his last resort.
He had been trying to get away many times, but was foiled at every turn and even got surrounded. With no choice in the matter, he ended fighting the four of them together instead of making a break for it.
But the toll for this was hardly worth it. Sensing his body, he was sure he was stuck here, disabled, for a month before he could even lift a finger.
During this period, he’d be as helpless as a lamb, at the mercy of any strong guy that chanced upon him.
Putting his life in fate’s hands wasn’t the Demonic Emperor’s style. But no amount of lamenting would get him out of it. He was a piece of meat ready to have its life pounded out of him!
Suddenly, slow steps were heard coming and Zhuo Fan tensed. But he was too hurt to even sweep the area with his soul to check. He was in the dark about the person’s cultivation and panic was slowly setting in.
Suppose it was the enemy’s Profound Heaven expert. That would curb his short life even shorter.
Crack~
Sounds of stones clashing resounded and Zhuo Fan knew the newcomer was digging through the pile.
Boom!
Then, the final layer was removed and a piercing sun ray graced his face and making him unable to see his ‘rescuer’.
Then he heard a familiar voice, “Brother, I found him!”
“Dong Xiaowan?” Frowning, Zhuo Fan sighed. [If it’s the Dong guys, I’m saved, he-he.]
“Step aside Xiaowan, I’ll get him out!”
Rocks crumbled to pieces as a powerful hand reached into the pile and pulled the buried Zhuo Fan out into the light of day.
With a boom, his dirty body was wrested out of the darkness by Dong Tianba and smacked the ground hard. Zhuo Fan felt something was oddly off here.
Before Zhuo Fan even saw their faces, what greeted him was the cold glinting steel of a 3rd-grade spiritual sword resting on his neck.
Zhuo Fan’s heart was floored, [What did I ever do to you?]
Dong Xiaowan cried, “Brother, what are you doing?”
“Stay out of this!”
Dong Tianba stared Zhuo Fan down, the sword shaking in his hand, “Demon Zhuo Fan, I’ve been waiting to meet you for a long long time. You’re just as they say, so cunning you made complete fools out of us!”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Here I am, demon Zhuo Fan! I never planned to fool you, but you never left me alone!”
“You dare talk back?” Dong Tianba’s anger spiked, “I’m asking you, where’s my dear brother Song Yu? Why did you take his face in coming to Drifting Flowers City?”
Zhuo Fan finally got to know what this was all about and grinned wickedly, “I’m sure you realized the truth by now.”
“You killed him?” Dong Tianba’s hand trembled and his eyes reddened.
“Of course!”
“Why?”
Grinning, Zhuo Fan’s eyes were cold, and his tone flat, “I am a demon. Since when did I need a reason to kill someone?”
Zhuo Fan’s remorseless eyes in killing Song Yu got Dong Tianba trembling from anger. Roaring, his sword advanced.
“No, brother!” Dong Xiaowan threw herself before Zhuo Fan and said nervously, “Brother, he helped us. We would’ve died if it weren’t for him, and so would our clan. You’re not only picking on the weak, but you’re also biting the hands that feeds you!”
Dong Tianba’s sword stopped. His hands trembled, a reflection of his chaotic heart.
“Who dares harm my darling?” A sudden shout echoed.
A flash of red pushed Dong Xiaowan back and stood before Zhuo Fan – Xiao Dandan of course.
“Dong Tianba, you got some nerve. You dare mess with my man?”

chapters.title: Chapter 170, A Three Layers Jump
chapters.content:
Chapter 170, A Three Layers Jump
Xiao Dandan scared Dong Tianba, jumping two steps back, causing his sword to tremble like a leaf. He wasn’t afraid of her, but the Drifting Flowers Edifice behind her.
“Move!” Zhuo Fan’s cold tone came.
Xiao Dandan jerked and turned her head in doubt, only to meet a pair of frosty eyes, “Darling, this ungrateful punk wants to hurt you.”
“Are you deaf?” Zhuo Fan’s roar got Xiao Dandan shaking in her boots and demurely moved aside.
Zhuo Fan was immobile but that didn’t curb his dominating attitude in the least.
He spoke to Dong Tianba calmly, “I won’t lie to you. I not only killed your good little brother, Song Yu, but his sister as well. If you plan on taking revenge, no one’s stopping you!”
Dong Tianba was hesitating and flitted a glance at Xiao Dandan. She had her glaring eyes riveted to him, as if to say, [Just try it!]
Zhuo Fan understood his reluctance, “This is between us, men. Women have no place here. Listen here Xiao Dandan, if you mess with the Dong clan because of this, then don’t ever call me darling again.”
Xiao Dandan flared, “Then you’ll accept me?”
Zhuo Fan just stared at Dong Tianba with unnerving calm.
The sword lifted at times and fell in others. Dong Tianba saw Zhuo Fan’s eyes shift from hatred to gratitude. Recalling the time when they were drinking like best buds, Dong Tianba threw the sword a way away with a sigh.
“Forget it. I’ll just take it as brother’s Song Yu’s luck was the worst to meet a Demon Archon like you.”
“Why aren’t you attacking? Is it because of Xiao Dandan? Kill her then kill me. You two need to just keep a tight lid on this and no even Drifting Flowers Edifice will find out about this. If you’re still worried, I can teach you how to make a scapegoat out of another clan. One hundred percent success guaranteed.” Zhuo Fan smiled wickedly.
His words got all three of them jumping.
Did the world have someone so kind to teach his killer not to get found out? Xiao Dandan was morose and muttered, “Darling, I’m trying to help you. So why do you want me killed as well?”
Turning a blind eye to this love-struck puppy, Zhuo Fan stared at Dong Tianba with a vague smile.
Dong Tianba was vexed, “Wan’er is right. You saved us before and killing you will bite the hands that feed us. It’s best if today ends with both our debts being settled.”
“You’re saying... you’re letting me go for saving you?” Zhuo Fan smiled.
Nodding, Dong Tianba sighed, “What a pity, I just can’t take revenge for my dear brother Song Yu...”
Whoosh!
Dong Tianba was cut short by a golden streak passing his ear. With a boom, a fifty-meter tall rock was pulverized.
The golden light returned to Zhuo Fan and grinned wickedly.
The three found it to be a golden infant. It was indeed Zhuo Fan’s Bone Tempering Stage Blood Infant!
With a sneer, Zhuo Fan’s tone was cold, “Dong Tianba, you are far from worthy to decide my fate. My life is my own no matter the circumstances. Suppose your sword got a bit too close, well, you wouldn’t be standing right now.”
Breaking out in a cold sweat, Dong Tianba looked at the grinning Blood Infant, then at the sinister smile on Zhuo Fan. The two caused his heart to beat a mile a minute.
Demon Zhuo Fan was the one who killed You Guiqi, not someone a nobody like him could handle.
Zhuo Fan needed but a blow and this second rate young master would be naught but dust. It made a mockery of his earlier display of settling their score even.
[I never had the right to choose the fate of someone who challenged the Seven Noble Houses!]
Xiao Dandan’s eyes were more intoxicated than ever.
Her darling was so hurt he couldn’t move but the flair around him, the boldness, made him a man among men, the best of the best, were still there!
Dong Xiaowan wasn’t that far gone as Xiao Dandan, but among the fear and trepidation her eyes conveyed, they nonetheless held a constant ripple and firm gaze on him.
Not bored enough to mind the eyes of his fans, Zhuo Fan closed his eyes, “Take me somewhere safe. I need a fortnight at the least to recover.”
“Ok, darling, I’ll carry you.” Xiao Dandan jumped at the chance, holding no reservations.
Zhuo Fan’s silence was all the approval she needed.
Suddenly, Zhuo Fan’s ears peeled and he opened his eyes, “Wait. Someone’s coming.”
The others looked around for any signs while Zhuo Fan got Blood Infant back in his body.
Blood Infant was good with scaring Bone Tempering cultivators, but he might not succeed in a sneak attack against a Profound Heaven expert. Least of all going from the front.
Only when he paired up with Blood Infant in battles, was he invincible.
But now, he was a dead weight and Blood Infant’s success rate fell sharply. He hid Blood Infant in his body, waiting for the right moment to strike a killing blow.
The bushes ruffled under the anxious gaze of everyone. Then, an old man came out.
Zhuo Fan knew who it was, Liu Yizhen.
Liu Yizhen couldn’t be happier he found Zhuo Fan, “Song, uh, Grandmaster Zhuo, I finally found you. I’m so glad you’re alright.”
Zhuo Fan looked at the others clueless.
[Was I ever so close with this oldie? What got you so concerned about my health?]
Zhuo Fan was baffled, seeing Liu Yizhen jumping to examine Zhuo Fan’s state. Zhuo Fan and the rest found no ill will hidden among his actions and let him through.
Liu Yizhen was frowning a moment later, gushing with worry, “Grandmaster Zhuo’s meridians are damaged. You’ll need three to five months to recover. Luckily I have the 6th-grade pill, Yang Recovery Pill. It may not be enough to bring about a total recovery but enough to allow Grandmaster Zhuo to at least move.”
“Yang Recovery Pill?”
Zhuo Fan was overjoyed. He knew of this pill since he was an alchemist. With it and the Bodhi Jade Sap, he’d be up and about in no time flat.
Before the Hundred Pill Meeting, he had no 6th-grade ingredients and couldn’t refine a Yang Recovery Pill, or he’d have done it ages ago. Liu Yizhen’s arrival was such timely help.
Liu Yizhen saw him in glee and was even overjoyed. His hand flashed with a bottle and presented a scarlet pill.
Xiao Dandan hovered it near Zhuo Fan for a close inspection then let him have it when it was deemed safe.
In an instant, Zhuo Fan began glowing a blinding light from his main acupoints as the warmth traveled through his meridians. It was so strong that even the others around him could feel it.
It started with a twitch of his finger as Zhuo Fan slowly got the feeling in his arm, testing its range of movements.
Liu Yizhen shouted in glee, “In less than an hour, Grandmaster Zhuo will be able to walk.”
Zhuo Fan wasn’t one to wait as he used his only able arm to swallow a drop of Bodhi Jade Sap.
Liu Yizhen slapped his head, “How could I forget? Grandmaster Zhuo still has that divine treasure. You won’t even need an hour now and you’ll make a full recovery.”
This shocked the rest.
Zhuo Fan sat cross-legged and focused on recovery.
The medicine flowed throughout his body and Zhuo Fan could feel how his meridians recover. It went so well that they not only recovered, but became stronger.
Bang!
With a sudden popping sound, Zhuo Fan’s ears twitched as a newfound power roamed unhinged through him.
Dong Tianba cried, “He broke through!”
His words were followed by another pop and Zhuo Fan’s power doubled as he even started to glow in waves. It was as if Diamond Sand was roaming through his body.
“H-he broke through again!”
Liu Yizhen blinked his aged eyes and yelped, “This is incredible! Breaking through twice in one breath! How many in this world would ever have such luck?”
Then it happened again right in the middle of his speech!
“What?!”
Liu Yizhen’s voice trembled, “Doing it three times in a row is unheard of! Grandmaster Zhuo’s title of ‘freak’ is justly deserved. Even I had to cultivate day after day, year after year, to advance, but never once have I done it so fast.”
Everyone around him, who heard his speech, rolled their eyes.
[How can you even compare yourself? He is a freak, a genius among geniuses. How can an old coot, who’s not even a genius to begin with, even dream of climbing to his level?]
Liu Yizhen realized his blunder and straightened his beard awkwardly.
An hour later, Zhuo Fan’s power withdrew within him and opened his eyes with a flash of azure.
Every minute movement within a kilometer around him in the valley appeared in his mind, down to the last cricket.
This was Radiant Stage’s Discerning Field!
When Zhuo Fan just entered the Radiant Stage with his soul, he exhausted his Yuan Qi from using that dangerous pill, thus preventing him from carefully sensing the changes the new stage brought. Now, he broke three layers and entered the 5th layer of the Bone Tempering Stage in one smooth motion.
His growth wasn’t limited to that of the body, but of the soul as well, while also stabilizing it.
Just like Fang Qiubai, who had eyes everywhere within a kilometer of him, Zhuo Fan could as well. All that was left was to practice killing with his mere intent.
That was a Radiant Stage expert’s most dreadful ability...

chapters.title: Chapter 171, Antidote
chapters.content:
Chapter 171, Antidote
“Congratulations, Grandmaster Zhuo, for your recovery and improvement!” Liu Yizhen gave a gesture of respect along with a smile.
Zhuo Fan shot him a glance, “Skip the small-talk and say what you want.”
Liu Yizhen’s face froze for a second, then bloomed into a broad smile, “Grandmaster Zhuo is a man of true talent. I will no longer hide it from you.”
“Humph, that’s all thanks to knowing there is no one in this world helping a stranger without getting something in return! There’s no free lunch in this world. You must be after something big to give away a 6th-grade pill.”
Zhuo Fan’s piercing gaze saw right through him. Liu Yizhen muttered something under his breath then threw himself at Zhuo Fan’s feet, kowtowing three times, “Disciple Liu Yizhen admires Grandmaster Zhuo’s endless talent. I beseech Grandmaster to accept me!”
Dumbstruck, not even in Zhuo Fan’s wildest dreams did he consider the old guy’s request being this. Scowling for a second, he said, “Give me an empty jade slip!”
Liu Yizhen’s eyes sparkled and handed it over with glee, “Yes, master!”
Not even he expected his request to go through so smoothly.
However, Zhuo Fan closed his eyes for a brief moment then gave the jade slip back, “Grandmaster Liu, this jade slip contains three alchemy secret skills, my debt to you. We are now even. Don’t mention apprenticeship again. I do not take disciples!”
[Why the hell would I take another when the first and last one almost got me killed? Humph, teaching a disciple starves the master. This saying couldn’t be more right. I will abide by it all my life!]
Zhuo Fan sighed, recalling that traitorous disciple of his.
Liu Yizhen wanted to plead his case, but Zhuo Fan cut him off with a wave.
Zhuo Fan then turned to Xiao Dandan, throwing her a pitch-black ring. Xiao Dandan was startled. Wasn’t it the same storage ring Chu Qingcheng gave her?
“Take this back to Edifice Lord Chu. Tell her that I have paid the favor for the medicine. She and I are now even!”
“W-what about me?” Xiao Dandan was panicking, her heart in turmoil.
Zhuo Fan perked an eyebrow and watched her funny, “It has nothing to do with me. Do whatever.”
He took a single step and shot high into the sky, disappearing in a flash. Liu Yizhen watched the jade slip downcast then sighed as he put it in his ring.
Xiao Dandan looked at the sky and cried, “Waaah, darling doesn’t want me~!”
Dong Xiaowan saw the heartbroken Xiao Dandan and lowered her head in desolation. At least Zhuo Fan explained himself to Xiao Dandan, while not sparing her so much as a glance.
[Am I of no value in his heart?]
Dong Tianba saw through his sister’s distress and patted her shoulder, “Wan’er, that guy is bound to cause great chaos. There’s nothing in common between him and us.”
Dong Xiaowan nodded, her heart clear. How could a girl from a second rate clan deserve a hero who fought back the seven houses?
But that didn’t mean she could accept it. She looked up at the wailing Xiao Dandan and felt envious.
He did spare this lady a glance at the least...
...
In the hazy night, among the broken-down houses of the slum, Chu Qingcheng’s lovely figure struck a touching image standing there in the moonlight.
She had behind her Iris Overseer and Long Jiu’s group while Drifting Flowers Edifice’s disciples scoured the place for any sign of Zhuo Fan.
“Edifice Lord Chu, it’s been four days already. Are you sure he’d return here?” Xie Tianyang shook off a yawn.
Chu Qingcheng was still as she watched Zhuo Fan’s fleeing direction, but her eyes flickered with resolve, “This is where we lived together. I know he will come here once he is safe.”
“Sigh, that only means you don’t know him. That brat is a ruthless and stone-cold killer. When he was docile to you in that idyllic period, it was just him playing his role as Song Yu. That wasn’t the real him!” Xie Tianyang sighed.
Chu Qingcheng smiled, but her mind was set, “I believe in the feelings from that time. He will not abandon me!”
[We can only hope.]
