Xie Tianyang sighed, not believing in the slightest...
Tap, tap!
Suddenly, a horse’s trotting was heard and everyone looked to see a worn-out carriage drawing near. Chu Qingcheng’s eyes shined, her heart in bliss.
She recognized this carriage, it was Song-, uh, Zhuo Fan’s.
“He’s back!” Chu Qingcheng cried, rushing over with the others in tow.
But the people to come out were just Dong Tianba, Dong Xiaowan, and the crying Xiao Dandan.
Chu Qingcheng realized they were the only one insie and asked, “You came back without finding him?”
Dong Xiaowan and Xiao Dandan were downhearted and in no mood to speak. Dong Tianba bowed, “Edifice Lord Chu, we did find him, but... he left once he recovered. We didn’t follow...”
“What, he left?” Chu Qingcheng exclaimed in shock before he could finish. This man left without so much as giving her an explanation? Why?
“Waaah, sister Qingcheng, darling doesn’t want us!
Xiao Dandan could no longer hold in the pain and let it out in the form of rivers of tears. Chu Qingcheng was stunned as Peony Overseer drew her dear disciple into a hug, “Dandan, tell me, did he do anything to you?”
Sniffing twice, Xiao Dandan gave the black ring to Chu Qingcheng and said between tears, “Sister Qingcheng, he said he repaid the favor for the medicine. From now on there is no relation between us.”
“What, does he have no conscience? Is he that heartless?” Peony Overseer went into a rage, “I told you, men aren’t good for anything.”
Chu Qingcheng was lost as she took the items from the ring.
It was the spirit tablet Chu Qingcheng gave to Zhuo Fan before going to her death. Now, Zhuo Fan returned it.
As if he didn’t recognize her as his wife.
There was also a box and Chu Qingcheng looked within with a dead gaze.
Aunt Tao snatched it and sighed, “At least he has the conscience to leave this behind.”
Bu Chu Qingcheng couldn’t make herself care about anything, not even the return of the Bodhi Root. All she ever felt was loss.
Except for returning the bottle of Bodhi Jade Sap, everything else was back.
His meaning loud and clear. From now on they were strangers!
“You mean... he was using me the whole time?” Chu Qingcheng swayed as she whispered. Yet the look on her face spoke volumes of her denial.
[I finally found a man that I love, only to be deceived in the end?]
Xie Tianyang had long seen it coming and coughed, “Edifice Lord Chu, let me just say something, but don’t get angry. The brat told us he came to Drifting Flowers City for the Bodhi Jade Sap. But because of the sudden involvement of the Regent Estate, he helped you in passing. And that only after judging that the benefits outweighed the risks. His actions aren’t driven by kindness or compassion, so please don’t feel sad!”
Shivering, Chu Qingcheng frowned, still no willing to believe what’s in front of her.
Iris Overseer couldn’t take it anymore and patted Chu Qingcheng’s shoulder. She knew Chu Qingcheng was kind on the outside, but quite proud inside. No man ever managed to get her attention.
But this time, she finally found a man after her own heart, only to be cast away without a shred of remorse. The bitter pain was a far deeper wound than that of flesh.
Peony Overseer had to say something as well, “How dare this punk break our Edifice Lord’s heart? The next time I see him, I will peel his skin!”
“Can you?” Snorting, Xie Tianyang mocked from the side.
Startled, Peony Overseer wet her dry lips as she recalled Zhuo Fan’s freaky power and a cold shiver crawled down her spine, “I take it back. I’ll just curse him in my head.”
The others didn’t know how to react.
“Eh, what’s this?” Tao Danniang took out a vial from the ring, “Qingcheng, did you give him this as well?”
Shaking her head, Chu Qingcheng’s eyes were hazy, “I didn’t give him these pills.”
Squinting, Tao Danniang’s eyes shined, “It must be his gift!”
She opened it and a thick medicinal aroma wafted about, along with the faint roars of dragons.
“A-aren’t these the perfect 8th-grade pills refined in the Pill King finals? Why did he give them up?” Tao Danniang started counting, “One, two... sixteen, seventeen!”
Weren’t they eighteen?
Tao Danniang’s eyes wandered in thought when suddenly threw a pill to Iris Overseer as she yelled, “Eat it!’
Caught off guard, Qin Caiqing was puzzled but did what she said.
Suddenly, an azure glow came from within her. Qin Caiqing then sat to absorb the pill with eyes closed. Fifteen minutes later, a muffled boom was heard and Qin Caiqing’s power shot up.
Under the shock of everyone there, Iris Overseer broke through.
Only after a full thirty minutes did Qin Caiqing opened her clear eyes in joy, “Aunt Tao, not only I advanced but the Rainbow Cloud Palm left behind by Vicious Pill King is gone!”
What?!
They all turned with hope at the vial.
The poison of Pill King Hall was infamous throughout the land, yet this group here seemed to hold the only cure. What was even more astonishing was that they as many as 17 antidotes to the Rainbow Cloud Palm’s poison.
Such news would unleash a bitter fight over them among clans, with even Pill King Hall participating.
The difference was, while the clans would come to get them, the Pill King Hall would do its all to destroy them...

chapters.title: Chapter 172, Forceful Invitation
chapters.content:
Chapter 172, Forceful Invitation
“He is indeed an unheard of genius. I toiled for years over the pill recipe, but this kid up and understood it. I am completely in awe...”
Tao Danniang laughed, sighed, then sank into depression. Zhuo Fan’s godly alchemy skill left her feeling inferior in her meager achievements.
It was a far greater blow than Vicious Pill King could ever give her.
After all, Vicious Pill King was the best in Tianyu and yet, she could still follow his tracks. While Zhuo Fan, he had risen to unseen heights; to the point she couldn’t even catch a shadow.
Chu Qingcheng and the rest were over the moon, “Is that true?”
“Of course. With the 17 pills the kid gave us, it is enough to get Drifting Flowers Edifice out of this crisis!” Tao Danniang laughed.
Chu Qingcheng blinked, still finding it hard to believe this was real, “Aunt Tao, you mean to say he unraveled the mystery of that antidote? That pill recipe is real?”
“Yes, it is undoubtedly real. Vicious Pill King may have denied it, but to make the antidote to Rainbow Cloud Palm, one had to at least have a recipe. Or you wouldn’t know where to even begin.”
Tao Danniang sighed again, “But that kid is amazing, not only understanding the pill recipe but also following it in refining. The pill recipe was just a 7th grade, yet he made perfect 8th-grade pills. With this, even Grandmother’s recovery is assured.”
“What, Grandmother?” Long Jiu’s group cried, “She’s still alive?”
With a vague smile, Tao Danniang shook her head, “Just a breath away from death. But she will soon be back!”
Everyone felt uplifted by the news.
Zhuo Fan’s act was of huge consequence. Drifting Flowers Edifice’s Grandmother was the Lady of Steel. Furthermore, he not only wrested Drifting Flowers Edifice out of Pill King Hall’s control, he even saved Grandmother.
From now on, Drifting Flowers Edifice’s only way was up. Regent Estate would not find it so easy to handle this house as before!
“He is the savior of Drifting Flowers Edifice!” Long Jiu sighed, his admiration for Zhuo Fan going up a notch. [To think this was his plan all along.]
How else could Drifting Flowers Edifice resist their wretched ally, Regent Estate? Drifting Flowers Edifice will soon return to being a national power.
If Long Jiu understood this, then so did Chu Qingcheng and the others.
Sharing a look, Chu Qingcheng and the others had a newfound respect for Zhuo Fan. Even Peony Overseer, who endlessly cursed at Zhuo Fan, felt a little ashamed.
Regardless of what was said, regardless of how focused Zhuo Fan was on his own directive, one thing was certain. He was the herald of Drifting Flowers Edifice’s new dawn.
This alone made him Drifting Flowers Edifice’s greatest contributor!
“It’s no longer him owing me, but me being indebted to him. Our bond still remains!” Chu Qingcheng smiled with a crafty look.
They were eager to get back to Drifting Flowers Edifice, remove the poison from their sisters, and boost the morale of their troops.
Out of everyone’s notice, when the moon fell from its peak, a winged figure watched them from a treetop. He sighed and vanished into the night...
In another place, on the wide street, Yan Fu was shedding bitter tears going westward on a carriage. He was returning to Pill King Hall with the body of his master, Vicious Pill King.
No one would have ever believed this trip to Drifting Flowers City would rob the grand Vicious Pill King of his life.
Wiping his nose, Yan Fu recalled his master’s smile, his care for his disciple, and his grief only grew. His cloudy eyes once again began shedding tears of sorrow.
“No, I cannot cry. I will have vindication!” Wiping his tears, Yan Fu’s eyes steeled, “Zhuo Fan, one day I will kill you and lay master’s soul to rest!”
Hu~
A sudden gale blew, followed by thunder. Yan Fu’s heart seized and turned to look back. He saw a man with wings of lightning charging for him.
“Z-Z-Zhuo Fan!”
In a blink, Yan Fu’s towering thirst for revenge was wiped clean. The panic was so palpable from his face that he was on the verge of tears.
[Dude, I was saying one day! Not now! Why are you here? I’m not ready! Could you at least give me at least seven or eight decades?]
But why would ever Zhuo Fan care? He always followed through with what he put his mind to.
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan’s arrival was swift like lightning.
With lack of a better choice, Yan Fu jumped off the carriage. He then hopped on his feet with a serious face.
[Since I can’t avoid him, come! I am not afraid of you, even if I die!]
But Zhuo Fan couldn’t care less of him.
Boom!
With a crack of thunder, Zhuo Fan went through the carriage, which blew into smoldering ash. As Zhuo Fan’s figure was made clear from the wreckage, he was holding someone.
Yan Fu cursed in panic, “Zhuo Fan, you bastard! What do you think you’re doing to my master?”
“Came to whip a corpse, ha-ha-ha...”
The air echoed with Zhuo Fan’s mockery. Yan Fu shook but all he could do was cry, “Master, forgive me. Disciple is useless. I can’t even defend your body. I am unfilial. I cannot stop that demon from humiliating you...”
Zhuo Fan looked back at him with a smile. Although the kid was a cunning twerp, not great in the least, he was loyal though.
After flying for half an hour, Zhuo Fan landed in a groove and threw Vicious Pill King’s corpse on the ground.
Watching the aged and peaceful man, Zhuo Fan put a pill in Vicious Pill King’s mouth then brought out his gourd. Opening it, a blood-red cute worm wiggled from within.
“He-he-he, finally going to put you to good use!”
Zhuo Fan snickered and placed the Bloodworm in Vicious Pill King’s mouth. He put away the gourd and started going through gestures as he shouted, “Ha!”
In a blink, a visible ripple came from Vicious Pill King.
Shuddering, Vicious Pill King started moving and got up. His mind in a panic, his hazy eyes looked around, “Where... am I?”
“Ha-ha-ha, Elder Yan, we can finally have a nice and quiet chat.” Zhuo Fan made a point to give the kindest and most heartwarming smile he could.
But all he managed to do was send Yan Song into a shivering fit. He staggered backward, to get some to a safe distance from him.
Such a reaction was as instinctive as when a bunny met face to face with a tiger.
If only the others were here to see this, they’d be slackjawed. The grand and magnificent Vicious Pill King, the best alchemist in the empire, who treaded the continent with such haughtiness, was actually a scaredy-cat!
But any who had dealings with Zhuo Fan would find this totally understandable. The fear that was Demon Archon, Zhuo Fan, was not something mortals could fathom.
“D-din’t you just killed me? How on...” Staring long at Zhuo Fan, Vicious Pill King recalled what happened four days ago. But to him, it was as if it was just a moment ago.
Chuckling, Zhuo Fan said, “My actions are always ethical. Those that I want to kill, they stay dead. As for the others, they won’t die if I’m around. I made sure the sound attack was weakened before it hit you, dislodging your soul from your body for a while. It’s akin to feigning death. A mere Soul Restoring Pill would wake you up easily.”
Roaming his eyes in thought, Vicious Pill King found it to be true, but still asked with no little suspicion, “Why did you let me live instead of killing me?”
“Ha-ha-ha, didn’t I tell you? I respect you as being the first Grandmaster of your generation. It’d be such a pity to kill you and I find that using you is a much better alternative!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shined and his grin widened.
Scared out of his wits, Vicious Pill King now knew Zhuo Fan’s intention and mocked him, “Ha-ha-ha, you think you can recruit me just ’cause you want to? I am the best alchemist in Pill King Hall, so why would I fall from grace and become your errand boy?”
“Nice, prideful. I just love your attitude. At least this way, you’ll get to make plenty of pills!” Zhuo Fan condescended, adding a thumbs up for good measure, “Sigh, guess I can’t force you!”
Startled, Vicious Pill King was puzzled. [I refused yet he’s not one bit angry? He gave up too easily! This is not how the usual demon acts.]
“Zhuo Fan, you won’t try to persuade me?”
“What would be the point? I said all I had to say already. It’s fine as long as you understand!” Zhuo Fan smiled like a good chap.
But then his hand made a sign.
In a blink, a bloody mark appeared on Vicious Pill King’s forehead, causing his blood to boil. He felt his head exploding, that it was slowly cracking itself open.
Vicious Pill King held his head and rolled on the ground from the torture. Blood seeped from his mouth, ears, nose, and eyes.
“Zhuo Fan, what the hell did you do to me?” Vicious Pill King’s eyes bulged out, ready to explode.
In all his years, he had never endured such excruciating pain. Even the poisons he made paled in comparison to the torture this suffering brought about.
He just couldn’t figure out what Zhuo Fan had done to him.
Giggling, Zhuo Fan showed him a red worm, “Elder Yan, to be completely honest, I was afraid you might not be so inclined to go along with my request. So, I gave you this little pet while you were unconscious. It can make your blood to surge and expand, ending up with a bloody bang. “
Horrified, Vicious Pill King didn’t think Zhuo Fan was capable of having such vile acts. He knew he had no escape and clung to his only hope as he yelled, “Zhuo Fan, you’re going back on your own words. Didn’t you say you won’t force me?”
“Yeah, I won’t ever force you. It is wholly up to your own free will if you want to come with. But if you refuse, that takes us back to when we were enemies. It is only right that I rid the world of my enemies, no?” Zhuo Fan’s cold face stared him down.
Vicious Pill King’s mouth fell and felt like crying.
It was clear like ink on paper. Zhuo Fan wanted to force him into submission, but the prick had the gall to preach him of free will, even if it made perfect sense.
“Then end me, spare me of this suffering!”
“Tch, tch, tch, I can’t help you there. It’s my decision on how I destroy my enemies. In your long-lived life, sir, how many enemies have you seen teaching their killer how to kill them?” Zhuo Fan blinked with a wide and naive smile.
Though it only helped to horrify Vicious Pill King further.
[Demon Zhuo Fan earned his name. He is entirely insidious and cruel...]

chapters.title: Chapter 173, Pill House Elder
chapters.content:
Chapter 173, Pill House Elder
“Ah!”
Vicious Pill King’s screams reached the clouds, evoking the same torment a soul would feel when being fed upon by the horde of wraiths in the Underworld. The good news was this was in the wild, so no human would be scared to death by hearing his cries at night.
Zhuo Fan sat leisurely on a big rock, staring at him pitilessly.
Suddenly, Vicious Pill King had had enough. He gnashed his teeth and gathered his Yuan Qi to blow himself up.
Of course, such an obvious move didn’t escape Zhuo Fan’s sharp eyes. He made a gesture and all his work came undone as the energy seeped into nothing.
“Ha-ha-ha, I almost forgot to tell you. Once the Bloodworm enters you, you are under my complete control. Think of suicide? You need to have my permission first!” Zhuo Fan mocked.
Vicious Pill King’s heart was filled with shock.
[Where did this Demon Archon Zhuo Fan come from? Why was he so evil? If I had this thing, I would not need to waste time with Rainbow Cloud Palm. Instead, I could have outright controlled Drifting Flowers Edifice.]
The irony here was that instead of him getting to use it, Zhuo Fan used it on him, the glorious Vicious Pill King.
“Ah!”
All Vicious Pill King could do was make his torment known through endless shrieks and wails. His eyes bulged and blood crammed into his skull, on the verge of popping. And that was exactly what was hoping to happen.
Being at the edge of exploding, he couldn’t even move as the torture only grew and grew.
He just couldn’t believe such hell existed. And Zhuo Fan’s gaze made his fear all the more. [The malice this kid shows had never been seen in this world, and probably won’t appear either long after he is gone.]
“K-kill me!” Vicious Pill King was as stubborn as ever, although his eyes did contain a hint of pleading.
Zhuo Fan passed him a glance and placed an hourglass on the ground.
“Elder Yan, I don’t have time to waste on you. If you want to die, all you have to do is wait for the hourglass to end. It’s not much, just around 24 hours.”
[What?!]
Vicious Pill King was on the verge of tears. Wasn’t the same as saying to let him be driven mad by pain for a whole day? He didn’t want to wait even a minute.
[Please kill me! I beg you, sir!]
Vicious Pill King wailed inside, but not minding his plight, Zhuo Fan ruffled the dust off himself and left.
“W-wait, where are you going?” Vicious Pill King cried.
The chance to make Zhuo Fan deliver him into the sweet embrace of death would be higher if he was watching. But if Zhuo Fan left, he’d be all alone in his suffering for a full day!
Imagining that horror got him shivering.
Never had he imagined this day would come, to hope for death, to be so miserable.
He was now longing for it, growing ever impatient to get it!
Snorting, Zhuo Fan disdained, “My time is too precious to waste it on you to kick the bucket. But I respect you too much, as the best alchemist of your generation, to walk this path all by your lonesome self. So, I’ll just fetch your prized pupil to show you the way to the Underworld. He will make good company. I believe he will jump in joy since such a filial disciple can be together with his cherished master, ha-ha-ha...”
“What?!”
Panicking, Vicious Pill King’s eyes took an ominous glint, “Zhuo Fan, if you touch one hair on his head, I vow to haunt you in the afterlife!”
Cocking an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan turned to look at him with a beaming smile, “Oh dear, threatening me, are we? Well, go ahead then.”
Zhuo Fan flew away.
“Wait, wait!!”
Vicious Pill King’s anxious cries were met with silence. Then, his face sank as he said, “Grandmaster Zhuo, young master Zhuo, I concede. I am not your match. I will do anything you want, just let my disciple go!”
Zhuo Fan’s laughter echoed into the sky. He smirked triumphantly without turning around, he casually responded. “When I stole your body, I had the impression that we might become allies. So, I didn’t harm your disciple, for your sake. But now, since we’re enemies, it’s best to snuff any danger out...”
Vicious Pill King had gone silent.
Zhuo Fan’s meaning was crystal clear. Either he surrendered and both disciple and master would be his buddies, ensuring their safety. Or stay enemies and be rooted out!
He didn’t want his sole disciple to be harmed, but Pill King Hall was his house. How could he betray it?
Vicious Pill King was plagued with indecision.
Picking up on his conundrum, Zhuo Fan grinned, “Elder Yan, do you have any friends, lovers, or any cherished people in the Pill King Hall?”
“Why do you want to know that?” Vicious Pill King frowned.
Shrugging, Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Not much. Since we’ll be palls, it’s best to know who they are so I’ll go easy on them if I ever meet them.”
Zhuo Fan spoke in such a heartfelt and touching tone that had Vicious Pill King nod.
“Sigh, no need for such compassion. Our great house doesn’t only fight with outsiders but also among ourselves. Especially when I became the first alchemist and earned my title, the fighting only intensified. I’ve given all my life to my house. I am not close to even the elders, only to my disciple. I hope Grandmaster Zhuo will spare him!”
Vicious Pill King’s tone was mournful, yet sincere. Zhuo Fan nodded, “Does that mean Elder Yan concedes?”
“I cannot, Pill King Hall is my home...”
“What home? A place filled with coldness, a place undeserving of you is worthy of being called home?”
Zhuo Fan cut him off before he could finish, “The way I see it, Pill King Hall is nothing more than a bank, loaning and collecting money. It should be proud of itself to raise a great alchemist such as yourself. But, think about it. All those years you wasted on it, is time you will never get back. You stand on the edge of a knife. Dwell on this reluctance of yours to leave it. Is Pill King Hall truly worthy to be called your home?”
Vicious Pill King was shocked to the core. Zhuo Fan also calmed down the Bloodworm and let him think it through.
Zhuo Fan wanted Vicious Pill King to surrender wholly, not be forced into submission. He would be better off without him otherwise. Who knew when he’d be sold out one day because of him?
“Besides, didn’t you betray Pill King Hall?” Zhuo Fan prodded Vicious Pill King, seeing him hesitating, “What happened with Chu Qingtian and the pill recipe? And don’t you dare tell me he was a spy, who would believe a normal disciple could steal the pill recipe? Isn’t it more along the lines that you gave it to him?”
Startled, Vicious Pill King watched Zhuo Fan shocked, “H-how did you know...”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Because you’re too similar to the Chu Qingtian. You are both fond of alchemy. Which alchemy master wouldn’t like a disciple who loves alchemy as well as he does? Although you mocked Chu Qingtian whenever he is mentioned, you have not once denounced his talent. In fact, you even find him pitiful!”
Vicious Pill King sat dazed on the ground, powerless to move, as he droned, “As soon as the child arrived at the door, I knew of his origin. At the beginning, I have to admit, I held no good intentions towards him. Furthermore, I am usually haughty and shameless. Doing whatever I liked. But, his talent had me surprised and I could no longer bear to hold such intentions towards him anymore.”
“So, I let him steal the pill recipe. Allowed him the opportunity to learn it on his own. If he could understand it, then, he would’ve surpassed me. Such a pity...” Vicious Pill King sighed with sorrow, “That was the only time I failed Pill King Hall!”
[Humph, only by making you admit your betrayal, will you embrace it!]
[Besides, any ‘loyalist’ that had betrayed once, will definitely do it again!]
Zhuo Fan shed some light, “Elder Yan loves his disciples, and no harm was done even if the pill recipe was leaked, since no one could unravel it. Furthermore, you’re dead and no one will look into this betrayal of yours.”
“What, dead?”
“Correct. Everyone saw how I killed you. I killed you then and saved you now, without the eyes of the public. In other words, your life is mine, it no longer has anything to do with Pill King Hall!”
The words struck close to home. Vicious Pill King still held onto Pill King Hall not because he cared for it, but being the place where he grew up.
But Zhuo Fan said he died once, breaking all ties with Pill King Hall. Now it was time to think about the future and leave the past behind.
And sure enough, Vicious Pill King’s eyes changed, hesitation growing stronger in him.
Zhuo Fan thought it was about time to drive the last nail, “You now have a choice. To return to being Pill King Hall’s Vicious Pill King, and enemies to me along with your disciple so that I may kill you again. Or accept my proposal, and become Windgaze City’s Luo clan’s Pill House’s Elder, be reborn and shake the world!”
Vicious Pill King’s eyes flashed and laughed, “Grandmaster Zhuo’s words are sweet. So, I’ve already died once. In that case, I am willing to follow the great Grandmaster Zhuo into shaking Tianyu.”
Vicious Pill King looked more majestic than ever as he cupped his hands.
“Excellent!”
Nodding, Zhuo Fan flicked an azure pill to him. Vicious Pill King cried in shock, “Isn’t this one of the perfect 8th-grade pills Grandmaster Zhuo refined? Why are you...”
“To remove your poison!”
Zhuo Fan spoke in a heavy tone, “I already saw through that pill recipe and improved upon it. This perfect 8th-grade pill is made based on its instructions. It stated that to make the antidote, I first must make the poison. I used the seven poisonous ingredients and then, seven more detoxifying ingredients to create this. Following that pill recipe, it was impossible to refine a true antidote. Also, the initial part of mixing those seven poisonous ingredients was what ended up poisoning Tao Danniang and the others.”
Vicious Pill King felt even more admiration, “Grandmaster Zhuo is without a doubt the best alchemist. You even understood the thousand-year-old pill recipe of Pill King Hall with one look?”
“Ha-ha-ha, you don’t need to exaggerate. It took me five days.”
Zhuo Fan waved his praise in modesty. But Vicious Pill King’s cheeks twitched. [That’s still fast. If the Hall Leader knew, he might end up crying...]

chapters.title: Chapter 174, Luo Clan’s Calamity
chapters.content:
Chapter 174, Luo Clan’s Calamity
Vicious Pill King no longer hesitated and swallowed the pill in one gulp.
He realized on the spot that Zhuo Fan saw through the flaw of the pill recipe since he could make the antidote.
The Rainbow Cloud Palm was made of seven incredible poisons that only Pill King Hall could remove. But even that wasn’t a real antidote, just diminishing the poison within the body so that it would no longer be deadly. Yet as time passed, that little bit of poison would constantly harm the body.
Anyone who used this palm was never long for this world. But to make their house look mighty, they chose to use it anyway. This skill was a double-edged sword.
To the point that his hair turned green as well as his eyes.
For this reason, they had planned to get their hands on the Bodhi Jade Sap for centuries. Not for evil intentions, or swallowing Drifting Flowers Edifice, but to use Bodhi Jade Sap and dispel the poison.
As to Regent Estate entering the fray, that happened later!
And Zhuo Fan, the Eminent Alchemist of his generation, not only understood the pill recipe, but even refined the antidote to its perfect form, 8th grade.
Since Vicious Pill King, a Grandmaster of his generation, knew how great this pill was, he took it without a shred of doubt.
The pill roared in his belly like a dragon, turning into an azure dragon power that scoured every corner of his being.
As if alive, it rooted out every scrap of poison, yet was mild on his meridians while also increasing his Yuan Qi.
He was moved and immensely intrigued by this perfect 8th-grade pill.
Standing at the side, Zhuo Fan saw him shining in an azure glow and the green from his originally black hair was retreating.
The wrinkles smoothed over as well, giving him a fresh and youthful air. Vicious Pill King flashed his black eyes open, free of any trace of poison.
Laughing, Vicious Pill King stood up. His manner grew more dignified as his power advanced a layer. He went from the 5th to the 6th layer of Profound Heaven Stage.
By the looks of him now, he ought to be in his forties and not the aged geezer from before.
Sizing him up, Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Elder Yan, you truly have been reborn. Even your acquaintances may not recognize you.”
“It is all thanks to Grandmaster Zhou’s pill. I was filled with poison after practicing that art for far too long. Grandmaster Zhou is truly the best in the empire!” Vicious Pill King cupped his hands in admiration.
Returning his gesture, Zhuo Fan smiled, “We are all on the same side now. So, there is no need to call me Grandmaster. You are an elder of the Luo clan while I am but a mere steward. From now on, you can call me Steward Zhuo.”
“Eh, Luo clan?” Vicious Pill King’s tone was odd, “I heard that you came from a third rate clan, but no one said anything about a Luo clan. Then again, thinking of Steward Zhuo’s incredible talent, the Luo clan must be a hidden dragon, ready to rear its head and tower over all. It may not be as renowned as the seven houses, but its might is that of a crownless king!”
“Uh, maybe later!” Zhuo Fan chuckled awkwardly.
The Luo clan had only one Profound Heaven expert who only broke through two damn years ago. At best, it’d be considered a second rate clan. But with this old guy joining the fold, they’d make a good first rate clan.
But Zhuo Fan’s appetite was far from being quenched. He wanted to raise the Luo clan above the other seven houses in ten years, to be the best clan in Tianyu.
However, it was not a ripe time. They were far too weak. [So what? Can’t we steal what we miss? Didn’t I do the same with this Profound Heaven elder here?]
[Humph, if there’s a first, there’s bound to be a second.]
All in all, there was no one who could stop the Demonic Emperor from fulfilling his cunning plans!
With a flash of insidiousness hidden in his eyes, Zhuo Fan spoke heavily, “Elder Yan, I promise you that the Luo clan is the best in Tianyu, second to none!”
Gasping Vicious Pill King was shocked. Not even Regent Estate had the gall to proclaim that. But the air about Zhuo Fan made him realize this was not a joke.
It made a believer out of him as well. With a genius like Zhuo Fan around, any clan could become the best. He was so moved thinking that joining such a powerful clan would raise him to even greater heights.
But how could he had known Zhuo Fan’s words only applied to the future. Even so, he was simply thrilled.
“Gran-, no, Steward Zhuo, when will we be returning to the clan?” Vicious Pill King was quite eager.
He was dying to see this hidden and powerful clan.
Although seeing it might be a tad bit of a letdown.
Zhuo Fan tch-ed inside, but didn’t let it show and waved him off, “What’s the rush? We’ll get there eventually. I still have a task to fulfill so you’ll be coming with me.”
Slightly let down, Vicious Pill King nodded nonetheless.
For such a freak, a hidden gem, a first-class troublemaker, one who slapped the seven houses like they were children, him staying in the Luo clan will forever be the clan’s greatest fortune.
[Such confidence he has. That means the Luo clan must be a behemoth to stand above the seven houses. Just how many ages have they laid in waiting, beyond the prying eyes of the seven houses and the imperial family? They must be strong for Steward Zhuo to be with them.]
[As a new elder, I have to apply myself and not drag it behind.]
Vicious Pill King was having wonderful flights of fancy regarding this behemoth. What escaped his notion, however, was that the great Luo clan wasn’t hidden to conceal its strength, but so downright weak no one paid it any attention.
Zhuo Fan knew what he was thinking yet did nothing to bring his feet back to earth. He cared too much for the old man’s heart.
People always aimed higher and higher. The old guy may be listening to him since a little worm worked its magic, but Zhuo Fan still needed him to still be in an illusion. After all, Zhuo Fan needed to keep his motivation high.
“By the way, Steward Zhuo, aren’t you afraid some ill might befall the clan after the ruckus you made in the Drifting Flowers City?” It was just a sudden thought and soon he was shaking his head in self-mockery.
[How can such a clan be afraid of anything?]
Zhuo Fan didn’t much care either, “Afraid of what? The seven houses are banned from Windgaze City. And the other clans are trifles!”
“Oh, I see. The Emperor issued the order just to protect our Luo clan.” Vicious Pill King exclaimed, looking ever eager to see it.
[For even the Emperor to watch over it, this clan must be a paradise. It must be at least as strong as the seven houses since the Emperor ordered for the seven houses to stay clear of this city.]
The more he thought, the more excited he was. This turncoat business might’ve been the best thing that ever happened to him. He cracked up, “Ha-ha-ha, then I can rest easy. Even if Regent Estate comes knocking, they’ll only suffer. I would really like to see their looks now.”
Staggering, Zhuo Fan woodenly turned his head with a frown, “You’re saying Regent Estate can still go in? It dares violate the Emperor’s edict?”
“Uh, Steward Zhuo, it seems our Luo clan had been hiding for too long and doesn’t know everything.”
Vicious Pill King chuckled, “Over the past millennium, the imperial family had given many orders to the seven houses, but do you know why it never had a conflict with them despite them never obeying?”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes roamed in thinking then suddenly focused, “They were probing the imperial family’s tolerance?”
Vicious Pill King laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, Steward Zhuo is indeed wise beyond his age. Indeed, the seven houses were testing the imperial family. And these acts only increased over the last century.”
“What was the imperial family’s reaction then?” Zhuo Fan was anxious.
“Weak, always the first to back down!” Vicious Pill King squinted, “The current Emperor has to be the worst this empire has ever seen. The houses may respect him, but none fear him.”
“And you even killed Regent Estate’s second young master at Drifting Flowers Edifice. The Regent Estate will surely use this excuse to step out of line and see the impact it has on the imperial family...”
“Let’s go!”
Zhuo Fan was troubled and cut Vicious Pill King off as he flew straight for Windgaze City.
Vicious Pill King was startled, “Steward Zhuo, where are we going?”
“Home, this spells trouble!”
“What trouble? With the power invested in the Luo clan, not even the imperial family dares enter its domain, least of all an outsider. The Regent Estate is bound to suffer a great deal of pain...”
“What damn power? If I’m not there, there won’t even be corpses left!” Shouting, Zhuo Fan sped away.
Now, he regretted blowing the situation out of proportions back in the city. He didn’t know the delicate relation between the imperial family and the seven houses, that they’d enter a cold war. They may be cordial in the open, but conflicts still arose among them.
If this kept up, Windgaze City might be the fuse that would blow this charade sky high.
If the Regent Estate wasn’t going to attack the Luo clan directly, but the imperial family. His clan would end up sacrificed by the imperial family to de-escalate the conflict.
The more he thought, the faster he flew. Zhuo Fan thought the imperial family’s power was unquestionable, but it actually declined to such a degree.
Vicious Pill King might be clueless but still dragged behind Zhuo Fan as they sped toward the Luo clan...

chapters.title: Chapter 175, Shaking the Nation
chapters.content:
Chapter 175, Shaking the Nation
A month later, in the Imperial Capital.
In a garden of mesmerizing beauty and singing birds, the emperor sat across from a wizen old man under a pavilion. At a closer look, it was easy to recognize him as being Mr. Sima.
A stone table laid between them, with a chessboard filled with black and white pieces. Mr. Sima was playing the black pieces.
The emperor held a white piece, still unclear as to the best place to put it. When he finally placed it, he chuckled sadly, “Mr. Sima’s skill is exquisite. I fall sorely short. But could you at least give me some leeway as an Emperor? You won ten matches already.”
“Ha-ha-ha, Your Majesty is too modest!”
Mr. Sima chuckled, “I am only able to grasp this square foot area, while Your Majesty plays with the whole nation in mind. How could my meager skill ever compare? Your Majesty may have lost ten chess matches but has resolved the land’s issues. It is I who has fallen dreadfully short!”
“Ha-ha-ha, Mr. Sima mustn’t joke. In this land, it is unknown who shall be the true winner!”
“But Your Majesty has everything set in place and is only waiting for the final piece, correct?” Mr. Sima let a meaningful chuckle as he placed a black piece on the board.
The emperor’s face twitched a second as they exchanged glances. Then they burst out laughing.
“Im-Imperial father...”
A thundering cry came from behind, shaking with it the ground in its wake. The emperor waved the maids to clean the board, “Damn, that brat is back again.”
“Ha-ha-ha, Your Majesty need not fret. I have come prepared!”
Mr. Sima waved for the maids to leave, as he smiled at the board, “I brought a black iron board this time so the third prince won’t get to disturb the match!”
The emperor smiled, “Mr. Sima is thoughtful.”
A familiar figure rolled into their sights. The fatty was jumping over and quaking the ground with every step.
The emperor turned to the heavy weighting Yuwen Cong and lamented. [What did this kid eat to grow even fatter in these three months?]
Bang~
Yuwen Cong ran for all he was worth at the emperor – soaked in sweat, and filled with panic. Watching the ball growing ever bigger, the two servant girls were feeling fear, fear for their lives that the fatty would slip and barrel straight for them.
“Cong’er, slow down!” The emperor pointed at him impatiently.
But the warning fell onto Yuwen Cong’s deaf ears as he strained to understand, “What did you say, imperial father?”
His eyes finally catching onto who the emperor’s guest was, had robbed him of the attention of what was in front. A mischievous rock found itself in his path, and the fatty was now falling to the ground like a ton of bricks.
He found it odd as the ground only grew nearer, inertia working against him and turning him into a veritable living ball of flesh rolling on its merry way straight for the emperor.
The emperor stood in shock and stepped back. Mr. Sima was too out of it, “The third prince is a man of extraordinary talent. Who else can have such a precise shape?”
Bam!
In his sighing, Yuwen Cong found himself shooting right before him, taking out the stone table by happenstance as well.
The black iron chessboard was also thrown to the ground and the game scattered everywhere.
His face twitching, Mr. Sima stood agape at the ball of flesh, itching to curse him. The ball was aiming for the match all along, but who’d have thought to lift the chess in that dire moment?
And he even promised the chess match would be untouched. It was not only touched, but the board was entirely thrown off.
“Mr. Sima, are you alright?” Yuwen Cong rubbed his poor spine as he crawled on his stubby legs.
Mr. Sima’s eyes twitched and took a deep breath, “Third prince, few and far in between had managed to shame me. You should be proud to be one of them!”
[Eh?]
Yuwen Cong was at a loss, blinking his bean-sized puppy eyes cluelessly. Suddenly, a bellow came from behind him, “Cong’er, how many times have I told you that a prince must remain calm and upright. What got you so frantic that you had to lose all decorum?”
With uncanny agility, Yuwen Cong kneeled and cried, “Imperial father, this time it’s huge, titanic!”
“Humph, what titanic? Are you going to say the sky is falling?”
With an angry snort, the emperor flicked his sleeve at the servants to rearrange the table and bring tea. He took back his seat and shouted coldly at Yuwen Cong, “Over the past century, the Tianyu Empire had been in harmony, filled with peace and prosperity. The biggest event was only fifty years ago, when Quanrong had crossed the borders. The second is the death of You Guiqi two months ago. What could be more grave than these two?”
Yuwen Cong peaked at the emperor as he mumbled, “Imperial father, this matter is indeed grave. At least far more than the situation two months ago!”
The emperor was about to pour tea when his face turned grave, “Who was it this time?”
“Merry Woods’s sixth elder, Lin Zitian!” Yuwen Cong was kneeling as he reported.
Face twitching, the emperor took a deep breath and took his teacup, “Lin Zitian, he can be said to be someone of importance, but not up to the likes of You Guiqi. Well, he’s dead now. Oh, and who killed him?”
“Luo clan’s steward, Zhuo Fan!”
“What? Him again?” The Emperor perked an eyebrow, “This kid only knows how to stir trouble! First was Hell Valley and now Merry Woods. Humph, he just doesn’t know his limits and probably will be ending up dead in a ditch somewhere. Who knows by what lucky turn of events that he managed to kill You Guiqi, and now he thinks he’s a bigshot around here!”
“But Your Majesty, he is the pillar of the Luo clan. Anything he does will come back to bite the Luo clan. While your Secret Pearl Order...”
“I know, I know!” The emperor waved him off with a smile. He turned to see Mr. Sima’s eyes flickering, as if already knowing what he was planning, “I assume Mr. Sima is fond of talent and would like to outstretch a helping hand, perhaps?”
“Ha-ha-ha, helping him means helping the Luo clan, which in turn, helps Your Majesty...”
“Fine, if Mr. Sima wants to help him, then go ahead. I believe the Merry Woods would consider Mr. Sima’s presence and will know restraint.” The emperor smiled.
Yuwen Cong looked up at the two then blurted, “Uh, Mr. Sima I will have to trouble you to go to Hell Valley.”
“Eh, why would I?” Mr. Sima asked.
Just killing You Guiqi got the Hell Valley to bear a deep seeded hatred for Zhuo Fan. Going was pointless.
With a sneaky smile, Yuwen Cong replied, “Because the kid also robbed Hell Valley’s fifth elder of his arm. The Hell Valley is a powder keg ready to explode. Perhaps your face is great enough to fizzle it out...”
“What?!”
The emperor and Mr. Sima replied at the same time. While Mr. Sima went slackjawed.
“You’re saying the kid took Hell Valley’s 5th elder’s hand? How is that possible?”
Mr. Sima blinked the shock away, “That fifth elder is a powerful body cultivator, just as Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s third elder. He is known as the Diamondback Ape, for crushing a whole mountain. And you mean to tell me this renowned expert got his arm ruined by an unknown kid?”
“Who is unknown? At this point, the entire Tianyu heard of this Demon Archon, Zhuo Fan. He caused a sensation at the Hundred Pill Meeting, fighting one against seven, yet standing invincible! While the Seven Noble Houses turned into a laughing stock, with three dead and one crippled!” Yuwen Cong mocked.
This came as an even greater shock to the emperor and Mr. Sima.
“Three died and one crippled... Lin Zitian died and 5th elder was crippled. Then who are the other two?” The emperor was getting nervous, “Who?”
“Uh, Vicious Pill King, Yan Song!” Yuwen Cong spoke with caution.
Sss~
The two gasped in shock.
A dead Lin Zitian was no biggie, but Vicious Pill King was more well known even compared to You Guiqi, and was stronger far stronger. With Vicious Pill King dead as well, the Pill King Hall wouldn’t rest until either they or Zhuo Fan laid dead.
“Damn this brat! Is he looking to stir up heaven itself? He thinks that since the Luo clan is under our protection, he can just go wherever and kill whoever?” The emperor was imperially pissed.
Mr. Sima straightened his beard and sighed, “Guess kicking up a storm is also a talent, of sorts. Who knew the insignificant Luo clan could bring up such a savage? Ha-ha-ha, quite amusing!”
“Mr. Sima, don’t just go being fond of that kind of talent in front of me. This kid went past poking a hornet nest and is now stabbing at heaven. Messing with three houses in one swing sure is amazing. He’d very soon find himself dead, that’s how amazing he is!” The emperor panted with rage, “I hoped he’d be the one to revive Luo clan, but now, I just pray he won’t end up inviting calamity and ruining the Luo clan altogether, and my Secret Pearl Order...”
Mr. Sima chuckled and tried to mollify him, “Your Majesty, at worst, I’ll just have to intervene and tie him down so he won’t pull any more stunts. In the end, the three houses don’t dare to openly defy the imperial might, going after the Luo clan.”
“Maybe not them, but one house does!” Yuwen Cong whispered with a grin.
Now the two recalled there was one more dead unaccounted for, “Who is he?”
“Uh, imperial father, it’s best if you sit!” Yuwen Cong emphasized every word, “Regent Estate’s second young master, Huangpu Qingyun!”
Sss~
Mr. Sima was struck dumb. The emperor was having a panic attack, breathing in and out to finally recover his voice, “My heart... dammit! This brat went and poked the heavens...”

chapters.title: Chapter 176, Regent Estate’s Invitation
chapters.content:
Chapter 176, Regent Estate’s Invitation
A silence had swallowed the imperial gardens, one it had never seen since its making. Even the birds felt the situation was dire, not making a peep.
Yuwen Cong looked cautiously at the serious emperor sunk in deep thought.
Mr. Sima frowned, “Your Majesty, with how thoroughly blown out of proportion this matter is, I leave the decision to you. Perhaps giving up on Luo clan is...”
The emperor started pacing, his brows locked tight.
After ages, he stopped. His eyes were incredibly calm, while also hiding a deep hint of freezing killing intent.
“No, I must protect the Luo clan and the boy!”
Waving, the emperor shouted, “I have always exercised tolerance in my ruling. But this has gone far enough. They will push me down a cliff if I let this happen.”
“Here’s my decree. Inform Marshal Dugu to move swiftly! There’s not a moment to lose!”
[What, the second of the Four Pillars, War God Dugu Zhantian is coming back?]
Yuwen Cong hesitated to speak, but Mr. Sima showed his unrest, “Your Majesty, you can’t! Marshal Dugu defends the borders. The Quanrong wouldn’t dare to step a foot beyond the Thunder Pond with him there. The border will descend into chaos if he leaves!”
“You’re exaggerating. For thirty years, the border had been peaceful.” The emperor cut Mr. Sima’s advice short. His eyes flashed coldly, “I will show my cousin, who this land belongs to. He has crossed my final line!”
Shuddering inside, Mr. Sima knew the emperor had made up his mind and sighed. Yuwen Cong bowed and then withdrew with the edict.
The emperor looked up, his eyes flashing as he laughed coldly...
...
Prime-minister’s residence in the Imperial Capital.
Prime-minister Zhuge Changfeng was swinging in his rocking chair with his eyes closed in rest. Suddenly, a black figure came and whispered before vanishing again.
Opening his eyes, Zhuge Changfeng revealed a calculative look as a smile grew on his face, “The monkey had stirred enough ruckus in the Heavenly Temple and made him nervous. To even have that old man return. Ha-ha-ha, the time for the war between the seven houses and him is soon upon us. Since this is the case, let me spice things up.”
(StarReader: Journey to the West reference. Monkey King always caused havoc in every task Jade Emperor gave him.)
Zhuge Changfeng looked in his yard, “Elders Yin and Yang!”
“Prime Minister Zhuge, what is it that you ask of us?” One black and one white figure flashed before him.
Zhuge Changfeng smiled, “Do you know where Thunder Swarm Mountain is?”
“It is a place for one of the empire’s tree guardian sects, the Demon Scheming Sect. There is a large barrier there. It detains the four greatest criminals, now suffering the strikes of ten thousand lightning bolts every day for the past 60 years!” The black-haired elder spoke.
Nodding, Zhuge Changfeng smiled, “Very good, can you go there and get them out?”
“What?!” The two exchanged a glance, thinking they had heard him wrong.
“Prime-minister Zhuge, why would you want to? This is the matter of Demon Scheming Sect that we shouldn’t meddle in. Not only were the four savage disciples on the path of demonic cultivation, but held key positions within the sect. They can’t be used.” The white-haired elder cupped his hands.
Shaking his head, Zhuge Changfeng said, “Those four old fellows have been stuck there for sixty years. Demon Scheming Sect couldn’t care less anymore. As long as we keep our mouths shut about this, no one will know. Also, I never planned on recruiting the four. Now, can you two do it or not?”
“Of course!” The two elders nodded.
They may have not come from a great sect, but their skills have very much sharpened over the centuries. A mere barrier couldn’t stop them.
Nodding, Zhuge Changfeng laughed, “Good, now go. The already restless Tianyu will soon reach a boiling point, ha-ha-ha...”
Meanwhile, Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s Pavilion Lord, Long Yifey, was listening along with the elders to Long Jiu’s report – the shock palpable.
Once Long Jiu finished, all were bug-eyed.
“You mean to say that Hell Valley’s 5th elder lost an arm?” Third elder cried out.
Understanding his feelings, Long Jiu smiled wryly as he advised, “Third brother should relax. The kid had taken the Bursting Pill first. If you had taken it...”
“But you also said that the fifth elder ate it too...” Third elder’s face sank in disappointment.
Long Jiu rushed to say, “Yeah, you’re right, but that kid ate five. If you took five...”
“I’d be a goner!”
Third elder cut him off with a sigh. He shook his mind clear, and continued, “Moreover, he is only in the Bone Tempering Stage. Sigh, the young always surpasses the old. I must be getting too much in years...”
Long Jiu watched him sink into depression but didn’t know what to say to make him feel better. [If you know what’s best for you, don’t go comparing yourself with that little monster.]
An elder with white hair shouted, “Third elder, why are you still hanging on to some meager honor? Did you not hear what it’s at stake here? Regent Estate’s Huangpu Qingyun was killed!”
“True, Regent Estate’s Imperial Tyrant Body Art is mystical body art. Yet, that kid blew away Huangpu Qingyun’s lower body to smithereens. Just how strong of a body must he have to pull it off? I know that even I fall short!” Third elder looked even more downcast.
The elders who spoke held his forehead, [Brother is hopeless.] He then turned to Long Yifey, “Pavilion Lord, this matter concerns Regent Estate and it’s best we do not get ourselves involved. If Regent Estate drags us into this because of the kid...”
“But did you not hear Long Jiu? Regent Estate is targeting every other house. Even if the matter with Zhuo Fan never happened, sooner or later they would come knocking on our door. If we cut ties with Zhuo Fan, we’ll only be avoiding the truth. We may soon find ourselves following in Drifting Flowers Edifice’s footsteps.” Another elder interrupted.
“From what you say, you want us to work together with Zhuo Fan to fend off Regent Estate? This is giving them an excuse to wipe us off the earth.”
“That will happen even without an excuse. Can we not see how much ambition the Regent Estate has? This will end us grounded down the same way it happened to Drifting Flowers Edifice. I’d rather fight now than see that happen!”
“Enough!”
Long Yifey shouted over the clamor, breaking the argument, “It is I who agreed to become allies with Zhuo Fan, and this shall not change even now. The kid’s display had opened my eyes, realizing he will be a great help to us. I will say this again, as long as Zhuo Fan lives, our alliance with the Luo clan is still in effect.”
“But Pavilion Lord, Regent Estate...”
“Enough, This is my decision!” Long Yifey’s eyes flashed, “Our alliance with Zhuo Fan has always been followed through in the dark. The Regent Estate has no clue this is happening. They have nothing to use against us!”
[So that’s why!]
The other elders exclaimed, “Pavilion Lord is brilliant!”
“Humph, what brilliant? It’s called tactics!” Long Yifey let out a bitter laughter. He may hate this kind of person the most, but for the sake of his house, this was the best choice.
“Pavilion Lord, Regent Estate sent a letter!”
A disciple shouted from beyond the doors.
Long Yifey looked at the elders then let the man in.
[Regent Estate came swiftly!]
The disciple bowed before Long Yifey and presented the letter with the Regent Estate words written in gold on it.
Long Yifey was startled the moment he opened it. Third elder snatched the letter and his eyes widened, “Regent Estate will hold an assembly half a month from now. The seven houses are to convene and plan to remove the demon scourge!”
“You mean...”
Long Yifey nodded, “Regent Estate is playing a ferocious move this time. The last time they did this was just three hundred years ago!”
“Yeah, but that little monster three hundred years ago had the seven houses going crazy. While this time, Regent Estate is playing this move just for its own benefit without even asking the opinion of the six houses. It is basically acting as though it is the head of the seven houses!”
Third elder spat, “The Veiled Dragon Pavilion cannot lose again in the next Esoteric Debate!”
The others all nodded!
The other five houses received the Regent Estate’s invitation at the same time. Suddenly, the six houses were now en route to convene with the Regent Estate on the plan to rid the world of Demon Archon Zhuo Fan!
Achoo~
Zhuo Fan was speeding towards the Luo clan when he suddenly felt a chill and shuddered. He rubbed his nose, “Blast it, who’s cursing me this time? Why is it that I feel a chill on my back?”
“Ha-ha-ha, Steward Zhuo kicked a storm in Drifting Flowers City, with casualties in the thousands. Their grief must be focused on you.” Vicious Pill King was laughing at his side, having a blast.
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow and mocked, “Elder Yan, Drifting Flowers Edifice’s grief is far stronger on you. Don’t you feel the chill from the tens of thousand female disciples putting all their sorrow and pain on you?”
Vicious Pill King chuckled sheepishly, “I’m used to it!”
Zhuo Fan grinned. None of them were good people so this teasing had no effect on either of them.
“Wait!”
Zhuo Fan suddenly halted and Vicious Pill King asked, “What’s wrong?”
Snickering, Zhuo Fan said, “They move fast. An ambush is laid for us not half a mile from here...”

chapters.title: Chapter 177, Sneak Attack
chapters.content:
Chapter 177, Sneak Attack
“What?” Vicious Pill King watched Zhuo Fan baffled. Then, he recalled how in Drifting Flowers City Zhuo Fan’s soul reached the Radiant Stage and knew Discerning Field.
And after so much time had passed, it would’ve been odd if he couldn’t get more used to it and detect movements in half a mile.
Closing his eyes, Zhuo Fan said, “In a forest half a mile out, two people are hiding to the West. From their energy, they must be from Hell Valley. To the East, there are also two quick on their feet, probably Merry Woods. And finally the two in the North with heavy air about them. Cultivators of Imperial Tyrant Body Art are experts from Regent Estate. And all six of them are in the 5th layer of Profound Heaven Stage.”
“Steward Zhuo is amazing to use Radiant Stage’s ability!” Vicious Pill King praised, “Now we can just avoid them and let them wait forever, ha-ha-ha...”
Quirking an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan snickered, “And why should we? Since they are here, we might as well duke it out!”
“Steward Zhuo, you can’t!”
Vicious Pill King was flustered as he tried to explain, “They are clearly prepared this time. In the Drifting Flowers City, you fought the four of us, and, as much as it pains to admit, we underestimated you. Not to mention, we were all from different houses, with gaps in our cooperation. Now that the houses sent pairs, even if you take that pill again, it will only make them drag it out then end you at your weakest.”
Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan eyed him deeply. [I didn’t think the old man would be so caring so quickly.] He said, “I was alone then, but don’t I have you now?”
“Me?”
Vicious Pill King shook his head, “The common folk fears me for my Rainbow Cloud Palm. But with how many there are here, only one has to bear the brunt of my poison and I will be a goner. Later, he just has to go get the antidote from Pill King Hall. I’m sure you are clear on this from the moment you fought my disciple. “
Indeed, he was posing as Song Yu at the time but being relentless was the bane of Pill King Hall’s poison. At worst, it was one life at the price of another.
Moreover, the enemy was now working together. Even if they did get poisoned, Pill King Hall would offer the antidote and Vicious Pill King’s threat would plummet.
“What if you can poison them all? Won’t their power drop?” Eyes flashing, a grin was plastered on Zhuo Fan.
Vicious Pill King didn’t seem to get it, “How can I? They’re not stupid to sit still and take on my palm. And they’re all Profound Heaven experts. They may not be able to use Radiant Stage’s abilities, but they can at least discern any movements in a thousand-meter radius. The moment we approach, they’ll spot us and we’ll have no chance of retaliation.”
(StarReader: author mistake perhaps? First half a mile now a kilometer?)
(Silavin: Might not be. He got used to it but, he is still new. It might be that the ability is stronger.)
“And if they can’t spot us?”
Zhuo Fan watched Vicious Pill King with a playful smile. Vicious Pill King was baffled, then saw a red pill thrown his way.
Vicious Pill King watched it even more perplexed.
Zhuo Fan said, “This is an Energy Concealing Pill, a 1st-grade pill. For a full day, your energy won’t be released. Unless someone sees you, or a Radiant Stage expert actively searches for you, no one will notice.”
Zhuo Fan took one.
In a blink, his aura vanished. Vicious Pill King watched dumbstruck.
“Since when did such a marvelous pill exist in this world? How come I never heard of it? And a 1st grade as well?” Vicious Pill King’s shock and disbelief were understandable.
Zhuo Fan mocked, “It is an ancient pill recipe. How could you know of it? But that’s not important, I will tell you about it later since I recruited you to help me to make pills. The Energy Concealing Pill will be of great importance later. For now, stick close. We will talk again after we deal with these pesky flies!”
Zhuo Fan resumed flight.
Vicious Pill King swallowed it after a moment of shock then followed him excitedly.
Putting aside how amazing the Luo clan was, just getting to study these ancient pills from Zhuo Fan was a reward in and of itself.
[Following this kid was the best choice I ever made!]
Vicious Pill King’s heart was dancing in joy, the same as when he made his first living pill...
In a hidden part of the forest, two elders in white sat on two rocks with their eyes closed. Even so, they were always on guard, listening to every rustle, every gust of wind.
Only when they were certain the gust wasn’t made by some expert, did they relax.
“Third brother, will that kid really pass through here? We’ve been at this for days and there’s still no sign of him. Did he pass us already or took another route?” One elder muttered.
The other elder still held his eyes closed and his position on the rock, “Mr. Leng is famed for his insight. He doesn’t make mistakes. He said that we will meet the killer of sixth brother here, today. It will soon be over, just be patient!”
“But all this waiting is so boring...” The other elder sighed.
Then, a black shadow moved closer, unperceived by the pair. When it got behind them, with a thunderous roar, two wings ran the two through.
Zhuo Fan then came out of the shadow.
Spatting blood, the two elders opened their eyes and strained their heads behind them, just to see Zhuo Fan looking down on them.
“I was afraid you two would spot me so I used Elusive Shadow Art, but you guys always had your eyes closed. You can’t be serious even when laying an ambush! Sigh, Merry Woods is doomed to perish!”
Under the shock of the two, Zhuo Fan twisted their necks. Then, black energy swallowed the bodies, leaving not but ash in its wake.
The two were so dumbstruck before, still disbelieving to be caught off guard so thoroughly.
Clapping, Zhuo Fan shrugged.
He learned from his encounter with Lin Zitian that Merry Woods’s cultivation method boasted great speed. So he figured he’d rather deal with these two first and remove the trouble later.
What he didn’t expect was for this pair to wait in ambush with eyes closed. [They were clearly begging for it!]
[You mean to say killing four elders of the seven houses doesn’t warrant any contingencies?]
[Well, they make it easier for me to do what I want, at least!]
After devouring the two experts, he could feel the Yuan Qi inside him surging. Zhuo Fan turned to the West, at where Hell Valley’s elders lay in wait.
[Humph, old enemies do meet often it seems!]
Zhuo Fan snickered, turned into a shadow, and began haunting his way forward.
The elders in the West weren’t like Merry Woods, waiting idly. Their aura was somber and watching over any sign of movement around them.
They knew Zhuo Fan for who he was and never dropped their guard for a second.
“Third elder, the kid is late and it’s making me nervous!” An elder watched around, ready to pounce. His hawk eyes scrutinized every inch.
The other elder was just as vigilant, but through some strange coincidence, he always kept a hundred meters from his partner, “Fourth elder, the kid not only killed seventh elder but even crippled 5th elder. He is vicious to the core and hard to handle. We must not underestimate him for being in the Bone Tempering Stage. He will be here soon and we must work together and avoid ending like seventh elder and fifth elder!”
“Relax, I consider this kid a veteran Profound Heaven expert!” The fourth elder nodded with a grave expression.
A shadow was creeping in on him, listening to his words. Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow and mocked them in his mind.
[You don’t say. Your welcoming of your enemy is truly worthy of this Demonic Emperor. Although, how am I to ambush you when you’re so on edge?]
Zhuo Fan started recalling the two wastes from Merry Woods. Those guys saved him a lot of trouble, but what about this pair?
He would be hard-pressed to get rid of these two quickly, not to mention, they were higher than fifth elder in rank.
Sighing, Zhuo Fan began to hesitate.
Then, he heard a boom and a rainbow mist rose in the North. Everything this mist touched, be it plants, animals, and even rocks, decayed.
The two elders looked in shock, “Rainbow Cloud Palm?”
“Why is Pill King Hall here? I thought they weren’t included in this plan?” Third elder asked.
Fourth elder paused then waved indifferently, “He-he-he, didn’t the kid kill their best alchemist? I heard that he stole his corpse later on. This is one shame they can’t take lying down. I suspect they came here willingly. Anyway, the more we are, the better the odds. “
“But why are they using Rainbow Cloud Palm...” Third elder paused then came to a shocking conclusion.
The other elder’s eyes shined and shouted, “They found the kid. We better hurry and help!”
But before they could even take to the skies, they saw two people rushing towards them. The elders panicked, “Aren’t they Regent Estate’s elders? Why are they poisoned? Was it an accident?”
In their moment of doubt, a shadow flitted behind them...

chapters.title: Chapter 178, Nefarious
chapters.content:
Chapter 178, Nefarious
Whoosh!
As third elder and fourth elder were still trying to make sense of the Regent Estate’s elders’ poisoning, Zhuo Fan stabbed his wings towards fourth elder’s chest.
He was run through in a blink.
He began to feel a sting in his chest, then how his body grew ever weaker as the life ebbed out of him.
He then slumped on the ground.
“Fourth elder!”
Third elder roared but Zhuo Fan’s second wing was already coming at him.
However, these two elders matched well with each other even in their daily lives, more so in battle. They attacked and retreated in such a way that they always maintained a fixed distance.
This was happening now as well, making Zhuo Fan’s attack only take down fourth elder while third elder was just too far away for him to reach in time.
Third elder jumped backward and dodged the Lightning Wing.
He saw fourth elder’s corpse then turned his bloodshot eyes to Zhuo Fan, thirsting for revenge.
Zhuo Fan glanced at the corpse below him then at the Profound Heaven expert opposite of him and grinned.
“Are you that Demon Archon Zhuo Fan?” Third elder clenched his fists, his aura exploding with immense power. He was in the 8th layer of Profound Heaven Stage.
Not even a pill could guarantee Zhuo Fan a win in this fight.
But Zhuo Fan kept his cool at all times, nodding slightly then looking at the dead fourth elder, “Is he your brother? You fit quite well together.”
“What’s it to you? You killed seventh elder, fourth elder, and crippled fifth elder. I will make sure you never leave this place alive.” Third elder spat through clenched teeth, yet his ever raging eyes couldn’t help but pause over his brother’s body.
Taking it all in, Zhuo Fan snickered. He then had the corpse suspended with his Lightning Wings.
“What are you doing?” Third elder roared.
“To my enemy I will not only kill him but ruin his corpse as well, making him die in regret!” Zhuo Fan snorted.
Third elder was about to charge, but Zhuo Fan suddenly sighed, “However...”
Third elder stared wide-eyed.
“Seeing you brothers so close, I will let him go. After all, I also have a brother earned from life and death struggles, only to die at the hands of You Guiqi. If not for this, I wouldn’t have had any quarrel with Hell Valley.”
Zhuo Fan sighed and shook his head.
Third elder was stunned, relating to this third rate clan kid and why he became Hell Valley’s enemy. Thinking of his earlier action, he also would’ve charged and exact revenge for his brother regardless of peril.
“Even so, you think I’ll let you go?” Third elder snorted, angry still.
Zhuo Fan snickered and raised his head to show his blazing eyes, “For my brother’s revenge I have incurred upon me today’s disaster, but I do not regret it. How could I ask my enemy for forgiveness? But seeing you meet the same fate as I did, I won’t ruin his body and return it to you.”
Zhuo Fan flicked Lightning Wings and threw the corpse to third elder.
Third elder moved with haste, now looking at Zhuo Fan with a faint trace of respect as he bellowed, “Good, we will have a man to man fight and see who’s the real, ugh...”
Third elder stopped for some reason, feeling a chill in his heart. Looking down, he saw a fist-sized hole in his chest that wasn’t there before.
Blood flowed in rivers from it.
Third elder looked at Zhuo Fan in complete and utter perplexity.
[What’s going on? We didn’t even start fighting and I’m already dying?]
With a snicker, Zhuo Fan waved.
A golden light came from third elder’s back flying over next to Zhuo Fan.
Third elder watched the golden infant closer.
“This is my demonic creature. I hid it in the body and threw it over all so I could catch you off guard. That is why I also cooked up that little story about my dead brother. I only killed You Guiqi for being an eyesore.”
Waving at third elder, Zhuo Fan sent him off with his most demonic smile he could muster, “Fare thee well, loyal and cherishing Hell Valley’s third elder. I hope you won’t be so gullible to a stranger’s words in your next life. Especially your enemies’, ha-ha-ha...”
Falling backward, third elder felt himself going colder, his eyes still reflecting Zhuo Fan’s last smile.
[Demon Archon Zhuo Fan’s nefarious ploys are foolproof. No wonder even seventh elder fell victim...]
Bam!
Third elder fell next to his brother, yet, as his mind stopped working, those eyes were forever opened and evoked unspeakable regret!
They were sent here to end Zhuo Fan, only to fumble about and die so miserably...
“I took too long here. Better go and help Elder Yan!”
Sighing, Zhuo Fan took back Blood Infant and flew up high. In four breaths, he arrived above the Northern part of the forest.
The Regent Estate’s elders were now green with poison. Despite being in the 9th stage of Profound Heaven Stage, the poison was nonetheless effective in dropping them all the way to the 4th layer.
Yet, even in such a case, a body cultivator was still as strong as a normal 6th layer Profound Heaven expert. Recalling Huangpu Qingyun’s might in his 2nd layer, he realized Regent Estate’s body cultivators were not pushovers.
“It was an accident. I made a mistake. I thought Demon Zhuo Fan was hiding here!”
“Bullshit! Who in this world doesn’t know we are from Regent Estate, especially with these clothes? Don’t try to play the fool. You did this on purpose! Stay right there! We’ll break your bones and we will go together to your Pill King Hall to settle this!”
Up in the sky, Vicious Pill King fled like a frightened mouse, with the two Regent Estate’s elders on his tail.
With how Vicious Pill King was proclaimed dead and rejuvenated a couple decades after removing the poison, these two elders had no clue as to who he really was.
But he wasn’t about to shout it out either. Would a traitor like him have any resting moment from Pill King Hall and the entire empire’s pursuit?
He may be Vicious Pill King, but he was not as skilled as Zhuo Fan, and clearly not as bold to be hunted down by everyone.
Zhuo Fan sighed.
Where had the great and might Vicious Pill King from Drifting Flowers Edifice gone to? Why was he such a scaredy-cat before two of Regent Estate’s elders?
[Is it Regent Estate too strong, or Vicious Pill King just too damn weak?]
Zhuo Fan already knew the answer, but didn’t want to accept it. Because his troubles would grow exponentially if it was so.
“Regent Estate, I will surpass you in ten years!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed.
Spotting Zhuo Fan, Vicious Pill King laughed as if he found his savior, “Steward Zhuo, you finally came! Save me!”
Vicious Pill King dashed behind Zhuo Fan without an ounce of propriety.
At this point, the two elders also caught up. Seeing Zhuo Fan’s Lightning Wings, they shouted, “Bone Tempering Stage cultivation, Lightning Wings... You’re that Demon Archon Zhuo Fan who made a mess of Drifting Flowers City!”
“The one and only. And you two must be from Regent Estate. I take it.” Zhuo Fan said with a chill in his voice.
They nodded, then eying Vicious Pill King behind him with curiosity, “Now I see. Pill King Hall had turned to rely on Demon Archon Zhuo Fan. No wonder he attacked us on the sly. You still dare say it was an accident?”
Vicious Pill King snickered.
The two elders snorted, “Why do you think Regent Estate’s Imperial Tyrant Body Art makes us the best among the seven houses? It’s that not even your Rainbow Cloud Palm can kill us. We will crush you both and fulfill our mission!”
“Humph, you’re a broken record, you know that? You’re clearly weaker now and still prance around saying you can take us on?” Zhuo Fan snorted in disdain.
The two elders cracked up, “Even weakened, we are more than enough to wring the life out of you!”
“I don’t believe you. Why not try killing him first?” Zhuo Fan chuckled and threw Vicious Pill King forward.
Vicious Pill King cried in panic, [Did Zhuo Fan just sell me out?]
The two were puzzled, but still grabbed tight to Vicious Pill King. Feeling him trembling in their grasp, they were stumped.
Grinning evilly, Zhuo Fan said, “You shouldn’t take him for the coward he is. He has real skill, you know?”
To prove his point, a golden glow came out of Vicious Pill King and entered one of the elders.
The elder froze in place and one could even see how he started drying up like a raisin. His life was swiftly leaving him.
Shell-shocked, the other elder darted a hundred meters back. Even Vicious Pill King was just as horrified.
He never saw Zhuo Fan make use of Blood Infant, nor kill with Demon Transformation Art. Now he was watching this all play out in utter fear, [How can such an abominable and cruel method exist?]
Floating before Vicious Pill King, Zhuo Fan recalled Blood Infant sneakily and laughed at the frightened remaining Regent Estate elder, “Did you see that? Now, can you still boast about taking us on?”
The elder had his voice shocked out of him and watched Vicious Pill King in horror.
[Forget it. That old guy is inconsequential. What matters is I get Zhuo Fan’s head and complete my mission. I don’t need to worry myself with that old man’s eerie skill!]
The elder took a deep breath and laughed, “Kid, you’re good to have found such a patron. Then, I will spare your life today, but... what is that?”
Suddenly, the elder pointed behind the two with panic.
Zhuo Fan and Vicious Pill King turned to look. In that blink, the elder snickered and appeared before Zhuo Fan in a single step, aiming for Zhuo Fan’s head.
Bam!
The elder didn’t get to touch one hair on his head, however, as a golden light flew from Zhuo Fan and blew a hole in the elder’s chest.
Zhuo Fan turned back to see the shocked elder, “That’s the oldest trick in the book. Don’t you know anything else? Now, I finally know what that old saying means, all brawn and no brain!”
Chuckling, Zhuo Fan lightly pushed and the man fell like trash in the abyss!
Vicious Pill King had long been stupefied by how easily Zhuo Fan dealt with two experts from Regent Estate. He now understood what it meant to kill people as easy as chatting...

chapters.title: Chapter 179, Unwonted Contriver
chapters.content:
Chapter 179, Unwonted Contriver
Whoosh!
The golden light moved about then returned to Zhuo Fan’s side. Vicious Pill King watched the golden infant with shock, “What just happened?”
“Simple really, since you fled around like a mouse, they held you in contempt. So I put my demonic creature in you before throwing you over to deal with one of them.”
Grinning, Zhuo Fan added, “When a powerful Profound Heaven expert died without rime or reason, it got his partner scared out of his mind. I used this chance to recall the demonic creature. This time, he held you in too high regard, thinking you hid yourself to pull a fast one on them. And by comparison, he thought I was the easy target this time and charged for me. And to make matter run smoothly, he had his attention split between me and you, leaving room for my demonic creature to catch him off guard!”
Vicious Pill King blinked, still out of sorts.
Zhuo Fan laughed, “In the end, they all died. First was arrogance, second overconfident, third conceitedness...”
“Uh, Steward Zhuo, aren’t they all the same?” Vicious Pill King muttered.
Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan laughed harder, “Indeed, this is the disease that plagues every expert. Facing them head first will make me lose without a doubt. Too bad, they were too full of themselves. To others, this will hardly matter, but when it comes to me, a fraction of a second of carelessness is enough for me to give them a death full of regrets!”
A bolt of fear went through his core as Vicious Pill King watched Zhuo with even more admiration.
Now that he thought about it, everything panned out just as Zhuo Fan explained. It was all done with the sole purpose of baiting the Regent Estate elders, and it worked like a charm.
Without even realizing it, the two bit the dust in but a blink.
Rather than say this was a well-thought-out and ingenious trap preset by Zhuo Fan, it was in fact more along the lines of him reading them like a book and pushing the right buttons to make them fall into a trap themselves.
[Such cunningness is unheard of. No wonder even You Guiqi fell!]
Vicious Pill King held a deep respect for Zhuo Fan now, “Steward Zhuo is of endless wisdom and courage, with foolproof plans. But being just a steward is a waste for you!”
“Humph, you don’t need to go ass-kissing. I am clear where my talent lies. Nothing is beneath me, be it a higher rank or the entire world! Only...”
Zhuo Fan sighed as he looked in Windgaze City’s direction.
This wasn’t the time for such thoughts, but to settle the safety of Luo clan and avoid any trouble they might suffer. This wasn’t just forced on him by his heart demon, but a wish that slowly crept into his mind without his notice.
Since Vicious Pill King didn’t know the whole story, he thought it was for a much higher purpose. His eyes roamed in thought then snapped into focus when he reached a shocking conclusion.
A youth of remarkable talent like Zhuo Fan was willing to be a steward.
And what was a steward? The Clan Head’s right-hand man! Able to do everything and loyal to a fault. What monster was this Clan Head to be able to raise such a young and outstanding Zhuo Fan yet as cunning and vile like a Demon Archon?
Seeing Zhuo Fan’s look, that staunch resolve to do everything in his power for the Luo clan, his admiration only grew for this Clan Head!
This was his first time hearing Tianyu had such a titanic clan, such a person of overbearing might. Vicious Pill King was eager to meet this person and was jumping in joy inside.
Vicious Pill King was having a flight of fancy of epic proportions, hailing the Luo clan into the ranks of seven houses while holding the Clan Head in even more admiration and regard than the emperor himself.
How could he ever have known the Luo clan was not even a first rate clan? That the Clan Head was long rotting in the dirt and leaving a pair of wretched brother and sister behind?
They should be thankful Zhuo Fan was there to keep their sorry lives!
Delusions were bliss while reality, a dump.
But that was something dear Vicious Pill King would have to experience for himself when he gazed upon the glorious Luo clan...
“Let’s go!” Zhuo Fan was ready to resume their journey when Vicious Pill King laughed, “Steward Zhuo, are those other two places handled?”
Zhuo Fan knew what he was hinting at and rolled his eyes, “Cut the crap. Think I had time to waste saving your sorry ass if I hadn’t finished those other four blokes?”
“Ha-ha-ha, Steward Zhuo is of genuine talent! Four Profound Heaven experts from Merry Woods and Hell Valley dealt with in a blink. All while I couldn’t even handle two Regent Estate elders. I am ashamed!” Vicious Pill King’s admiration only grew.
And the more he admired Zhuo Fan, the more he believed in Luo clan’s power! And, of course, sinking deeper into his delusion...
Suddenly, Zhuo Fan stopped and Vicious Pill King looked over.
Zhuo Fan squinted, “Elder Yan, I overheard Merry Woods’s elders mentioning that Mr. Leng planned this ambush. Do you know him?”
“Leng Wuchang!”
Zhuo Fan’s words stirred Vicious Pill King, “No wonder. I thought with so many roads leading to Windgaze City, how is it they managed to pick the exact same one we were taking? So it was all Leng Wuchang’s doing.”
“You know him?”
Nodding, Vicious Pill King sighed, “To be frank, Steward Zhuo and Leng Wuchang are much alike!”
[I know nothing about him, just how are we so damn alike?]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed.
Knowing Zhuo Fan didn’t understand, Vicious Pill King elaborated, “Ha-ha-ha, what I mean to say is that he is a steward like you, but that of the Regent Estate!”
What?!
Zhuo Fan was shocked for a second, then he started making guesses. With how Regent Estate was the strongest of the seven houses, the steward, the aid of the Clan Head, had to be a man of renown.
“There are three people widely known for their wisdom in Tianyu Empire. Prime-minister Zhuge, one which you already know. Regardless of what decisions he makes, they are all so irrefutably correct that no one could find any fault in them. In recent centuries, the empire had been in turmoil because of invaders beyond the borders, that was until he took office. As the head of the Four Pillars, the emperor hates him to the bone, but he can’t do without him either. The seven houses as well, fear him.”
