Vicious Pill King flicked his sleeve and continued, “The second sage is Regent Estate’s steward, Unwonted Contriver Leng Wuchang. As a distant relative of the imperial family, the Regent Estate is taught in the same way an emperor is. Their steward was also appointed by the Prime-minister. Leng Wuchang may be a steward in name, but his position carries a whole lot more weight. He is equivalent to Zhuge Changfeng’s position in the empire. Regarding talent, rumor has it he is not one bit inferior to Zhuge Changfeng either, although no one had seen them wage a battle of the minds. Leng Wuchang is admired by all for his foolproof plans and insight.”
“And the third?” Zhuo Fan was impatient seeing Vicious Pill King stop just now.
Laughing, Vicious Pill King’s eyes shined oddly, “Steward Zhuo, isn’t it obvious? It is you who killed the third.”
“Insidious Demon, You Guiqi?” Zhuo Fan caught his meaning.
Vicious Pill King nodded, “Ha-ha-ha, yes, him. The third sage was Insidious Demon, famed for his dastardly and cunning ploys. But ever since he stumbled upon Steward Zhuo, a man of wildly greater intellect, his head fell like a rock. From that point on, Steward Zhuo became the third sage of Tianyu.”
“Hey, easy on the bootlicking. I killed him using power alone. I didn’t waste my brain power on him. That would’ve been tiresome!” Zhuo Fan mocked as he brushed off his flattery.
Vicious Pill King stroked his beard and nodded, “I guessed as much. You Guiqi may not be up to the level of the other two, but it is nonetheless hard to catch him off guard. So, he must’ve died from the power gap!”
“Does that mean Leng Wuchang is more cunning than You Guiqi?” Zhuo Fan tightened his brows as the topic was brought out.
Nodding, Vicious Pill King laughed in dismay, “Ha-ha-ha, more than that. Zhuge Changfeng is a marvelous strategist. Leng Wuchang’s every scheme plays as it should. You Guiqi’s devious traps are unsolvable. Compared to the first two, You Guiqi was passable in schemes, but fell dreadfully short in power.
“The first two had intricate plans put in place. Hard to defend from the dark yet openly for everyone to see. You could see through You Guiqi’s elaborate tricks, but when it comes to Zhuge Changfeng and Leng Wuchang, you’ll have no choice but to jump even if they tell you a trap is before you. Who is better, who is inferior, who is stronger, who is weaker? Steward Zhuo, now do you know the difference between them?”
Vicious Pill King sighed, his tone ever solemn, “Since Leng Wuchang is involved, we must tread carefully and lightly!”
Zhuo Fan nodded.
Since he was far more shrewd than You Guiqi, then he would not contest him in cunning, but in strength. No matter how ingenious and convoluted plans he threw at Zhuo Fan, power reigned supreme.
This was the true plot, in which power was the true way.
This brought him back to finding experts to back the Luo clan.
Hu~
A sudden breeze blew and Zhuo Fan squinted. He grew anxious as he pulled Vicious Pill King’s hand to fly faster.
“Let’s go!”
“What’s wrong, Steward Zhuo?” Having never seen him so alarmed, Vicious Pill King was startled.
Eyes twitching, Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth, “Curses, they sent a Radiant Stage expert as well!”
“What!?” This time Vicious Pill King was panicking.
[How can this be...]

chapters.title: Chapter 180, Paying Respects to a Radiant Stage
chapters.content:
Chapter 180, Paying Respects to a Radiant Stage
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Silavin
Eh?
Half a mile out, a tall and buffed elderly with silver hair was flying idly behind them. Then, his brows furrowed and a hint of shock swept his face.
“Was I discovered?”
The elderly’s eyes flash in suspicion, then shook his head, “Not possible. They are only a Bone Tempering Stage and a Profound Heaven Stage. Only the likes of Radiant Stage experts can discover me. They picked up the pace since they were hurrying. Yes, that has to be it. “
Laughing dryly, the elderly had no clue how close to home his random guess brought him.
If these two with their low cultivation could spot a Radiant Stage, then the latter would find themselves obsolete.
The old man used his soul to scour the place of battle and shouted, “Damn brat, they’re so weak yet, they killed six Profound Heaven experts of three houses, and perfectly too. He-he-he, his reputation precedes him. The kid must have an even more valuable body cultivation method than Imperial Tyrant Body Art.”
He licked his lips and excitement danced in his eyes as he increased his speed.
But his act was easily picked up by Zhuo Fan as he pulled Vicious Pill King even faster.
There was no denying it this time, the old man was spotted. Why else would Zhuo Fan react so quickly?
Then he recalled his earlier thought about being obsolete.
His face went red in a flash and felt like slapping himself for those needless remarks. But the way he looked at Zhuo Fan was with even more zeal.
“He-he-he, this kid is a freak through and through. How amusing!”
The old man ramped up his speed ten times and in mere breaths, he already caught the two in his sights, only a thousand meters out.
Startled, Zhuo Fan found his pursuer close behind and shouted, “Shit, the old guy is almost on top of us!”
“What, that fast?”
Vicious Pill King peeked behind and paled in fright, “Why did it have to be this freak? My poor life is over!”
“You know him?” Zhuo Fan asked.
Vicious Pill King nodded on the verge of tears, “Who doesn’t? Everyone of my generation knows and fears this freak.”
“Who is he?”
“The Mad Dipper, Li Jingtian!” Vicious Pill King swallowed dryly as he broke out in cold sweat.
Zhuo Fan was also becoming anxious, having never seen Vicious Pill King so scared before. With how arrogant he usually was, he would stand up even to a Radiant Stage if the chance arose.
Just then, a booming laughter entered their ears, “Ha-ha-ha, don’t run, I recognize you. Aren’t you that Yan Song kid? And is that little imp next to you is Zhuo Fan? You better halt, there’s something I want to discuss with you!”
Vicious Pill King’s face sank.
[Why is it that my face changed so much that those two Regent Estate elders couldn’t tell who I am even when they held me, yet, you saw through me from a mile away?]
Then, he realized. The old freak just scanned with his soul and instantly knew the truth.
Zhuo Fan could feel the shivering Vicious Pill King and was panicking as well.
This guy was no pushover. Their fate would be grim once the old guy gets his paws on them. Only a moron would stop now.
His Lightning Wings flapped and doubled his speed.
“Humph, learn when to quit!”
Squinting, Li Jingtian released a ripple that shot straight for the two with deadly precision.
[Killing with intent?]
Zhuo Fan looked back flustered as the azure flame flashed in his eyes.
Hum~
Another visible ripple was shot. Incomparable with the first, but enough to pull up a defense against the first one.
Bam!
The two intents clashed, vibrating the space itself. A bolt of pain shocked Zhuo Fan’s head and the azure flame appeared on his forehead.
Next, Zhuo Fan pulled Vicious Pill King speeding up as he tried to ease the shock he felt.
His soul may have entered the Radiant Stage, but he was a long way from being Li Jingtian’s level. When their intents collided, it forced his azure flame out.
He was clear the azure flame safeguarded his soul. Its appearance proved what a serious threat the old man’s intent had to his soul, despite not meaning to kill him outright.
Even so, his soul wasn’t free from injury.
If that intent had hit, he’d be out cold and waiting for the old guy to pick him up.
While he was shocked, a thousand meters behind him, Li Jingtian was downright struck dumb. He really didn’t see it coming. Only a Radiant Stage could grasp this ability yet, he just witnessed a Bone Tempering cultivator using it.
He looked as if he saw a tiger sprout wings and take off. Not only was it impossible, but seeing it become reality, he realized what a true freak that kid was.
A tiger was the king of beasts. If it took flight, then who could stand up to him?
He felt a real threat coming off from Zhuo Fan. He could use Radiant Stage’s abilities in the Bone Tempering Stage. Then, when he reached the Radiant Stage, he’d be unstoppable.
At that point, even fellow Radiant Stage cultivators would fall beneath the kid’s intent.
This last thought sent a shiver down Li Jingtian’s spine. No wonder the seven houses gathered to end this brat once and for all.
The best freak out there was a dead one. Leave him alone and he might grow even beyond the demon three centuries ago.
Bloodthirst seeped into Li Jingtian’s eyes. If he found Zhuo Fan amusing at first, now he wanted nothing more than to squeeze the last drop of life out of him and rid the world of a future menace.
But that didn’t say anything about not wringing out the things he wanted first.
Li Jingtian went faster, shooting for the two like a meteor. Zhuo Fan could barely react as their necks were grabbed in steel like vises.
“Ha-ha-ha, let’s see you run now?”
So fast!
Zhuo Fan scowled. Wondering if he should use this chance to let Blood Infant on him. But he cast that thought aside as soon as it came.
This man was in the Radiant Stage, and had Discerning Field around him. Blood Infant would be discovered the instant it left his body. Unless Blood Infant entered the Profound Heaven Stage and reached a speed that surpassed a Radiant Stage’s soul detection.
A pity, he was only in the 5th layer of Bone Tempering Stage. Since he shared his life with Blood Infant, the two had the same cultivation!
[Goddammit! Why did I bump into a Radiant Stage!?] Zhuo Fan cursed inside his bad luck as cold sweat ran down his back.
He was utterly powerless in the face of a Radiant Stage expert. This feeling of having his life in the hands of someone else was the worse he’d ever felt, not to mention, dangerous.
“Ha-ha-ha, you little prick, I don’t know how you become so young and handsome, but no matter how fast you run, you can never escape me!”
Ignoring Zhuo Fan, Li Jingtian turned to the shivering Vicious Pill King.
Vicious Pill King looked as if he just lost his mum, “Senior Li, how can I compare to you? When you became widely known throughout Tianyu, I was but a lowly 2nd-grade alchemist. Don’t you care how people will see you if you kill me?”
“Oh, I always heard how haughty Vicious Pill King, but you looked more like a mouse to me. Where’s your zeal, your backbone?”
“Elder Li, don’t joke. I would never dare act pompous before you.” Vicious Pill King said downcast, “Senior Li, in the end, you are Regent Estate’s guest Venerable. This is obviously a misunderstanding between the houses. Why not...”
“Houses?”
Raising an eyebrow, Li Jingtian cracked up, “You mean Regent Estate and Pill King Hall or Regent Estate and Zhuo Fan’s clan?”
Vicious Pill King’s mind shivered at this. He was planning on keeping his dumb act, to get out of this alive. But it didn’t look like this was going to happen anytime sooner.
Li Jingtian’s smile was frosty, “Don’t think I don’t know. I saw your fight earlier. You turned your back on Pill King Hall and threw your lot with Zhuo Fan!”
“Uh...” Vicious Pill King was stumped, turning to Zhuo Fan for a way out.
Since going back to Pill King Hall was out, betraying Zhuo Fan was impossible. That would make him immoral. He was Vicious Pill King, not an opportunist like Lin Zitian who swung both ways. He still cared about his face, albeit younger.
Sighing, Vicious Pill King admitted, “Yes, I left Pill King Hall. I will follow Steward Zhuo to the Luo clan. Now if you want to kill me, go ahead.”
Zhuo Fan nodded inside.
He saw Vicious Pill King as a devout alchemist foremost and a loyalist second, a man you could count on.
Li Jingtian didn’t expect such a blunt reply and laughed, “Good! Yan Song. You live up to your rumors. I will let you go, but this kid...”
“You want to kill me?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, staring at Li Jingtian, “Sure. I mean, you are Regent Estate’s Venerable and I killed your second young master and you want vindication. But I couldn’t help but hear that you are their guest Venerable and have no relation with Regent Estate.”
“Where are you going with this?” Li Jingtian’s eyes flashed.
Grinning, Zhuo Fan spoke boldly, “Then let’s discuss terms for you to join me. What Regent Estate offers you, I, Zhuo Fan, can not only meet their offer, but double it!”

chapters.title: Chapter 181, A Martial Fanatic With Honors
chapters.content:
Chapter 181, A Martial Fanatic With Honors
[[What?!]]
Li Jingtian and Vicious Pill King were shocked silly.
Regent Estate was the head of the seven houses and fulfilled Li Jingtian’s however pricey terms. But was there anyone else in the whole empire who could simply double it?
Even the imperial family would find it hard to meet twice what Regent Estate offered.
But thinking over Zhuo Fan’s skill and the titanic and secret clan behind him, Vicious Pill King started grinning.
Since Zhuo Fan boasted the Luo clan as the best in Tianyu, then it had to be above the seven houses, even equal to the imperial family.
Vicious Pill King stuck out his head and laughed, “Elder Li, our Steward Zhuo’s words are gold.”
Li Jingtian’s eyes flashed.
Thinking how deceitful Zhuo Fan was, of course he didn’t believe a word. But the moment Yan Song laid eyes on him, he bolted like a mouse, yet, was now puffing up his chest.
This led him to believe Zhuo Fan had stronger and very much real backing for him to speak such words.
How was he supposed to know Yan Song’s courage was born out of delusions? A more apt description would be Zhuo Fan painted him a pretty picture, and Yan Song’s mind embellished.
Since the strong Vicious Pill King believed it, it conveyed enough confidence for Li Jingtian to maybe trust it as well.
Muttering something, Li Jingtian snorted, “Humph, you little pup, you think too highly of yourself. If you think you can buy me over, you have another thing coming. Do you have any idea how I met Regent Estate, how I became their Venerable, and what they gave me?”
Vicious Pill King’s heart was wound tight. [Is Mad Dipper unbuyable?]
Zhuo Fan grinned, hiding the sneer in his heart.
[Oh, you big shmuck. I didn’t know who you were before but now I’m perfectly clear. You wouldn’t be flouncing around if you were such a Regent Estate die-hard. You’d be ending us with impunity and taking our corpses back.]
[Ain’t it obvious you’re bitching to ask for a bigger pay? I’ve played this game myself a million times!]
Squinting, Zhuo Fan smiled, “My knowledge is shallow. Having not heard of Elder Li’s glorious pursuits, I ask that you enlighten me.”
“Ha-ha-ha, I knew you were wet behind your ears. That’s why you spouted those egotistical words about buying me. Although I can’t blame you, since I haven’t gone out much for you to hear of me.”
Nodding with pride, thinking things were going his way, Li Jingtian turned to Vicious Pill King, “However, if I were to retell old stories of myself, all you’d be hearing is bragging. Yan Song, you tell him.”
Shivering, Vicious Pill King bobbed his head, “Right away!”
Despite the apprehension he felt, Vicious Pill King glanced at Li Jingtian then spoke with the utmost gravity, “Steward Zhuo, Elder Li is a man that shook the empire. You’d be hard pressed to find another grand figure such as him in the whole of Tianyu Empire.
“Elder Li started as a rogue cultivator, no match to any of the seven houses’ experts. However, his mind was staunch, his heart set on giving his all in training his arts. Since he had no cultivation method, he stole it from other clans. He began with a mortal ranked cultivation method, slowly working his way to a spirit ranked cultivation method, then a profound ranked cultivation method. The exploits of Elder Li are found in every history book...”
“Oh, so, Elder Yan means Elder Li is a thief?” Zhuo Fan interrupted as he scratched his nose.
Panicked, Vicious Pill King gesticulated wildly in his stammering, “I-I never said such a thing...”
“Mind your words!” Li Jingtian bellowed and slapped him. Looking somewhat awkwardly at Zhuo Fan.
He was hoping Vicious Pill King would make a proper account of his heroic deeds, racking up his value. But this old coot went and spilled the whole beans about his inglorious past.
All robbing would do was drop his price instead.
Li Jingtian glared at Yan Song then coughed, “Ha-ha-ha, that is an old story, a part unworthy of attention.”
“How can it be? Without a cultivation method, your only choice was to steal if you didn’t want to stay weak all your life. I truly admire your courage!” Zhuo Fan smiled.
Li Jingtian’s eyes shined and his heart jumped in joy since Zhuo Fan didn’t despise him. He laughed even harder, “Your reputation doesn’t do you justice, Demon Archon, Zhuo Fan. You aren’t like those so-called experts, but a man of true talent.
“Correct. In my younger days, I had to go steal renown skills and cultivation methods from clans to become what I am now. And the more I stole, the more enemies I gained. But I showed no fear. After cultivating, I became stronger than any of them and killed any who chased me down. I always fought them with the same skills I stole, promising to hand my head over if I ever lost!”
Zhuo Fan looked at him deeply. [Isn’t that the same as what I’ve been through in the Hundred Pill Meeting?] Zhuo Fan’s opinion of him grew somewhat.
He was a renowned man to steal other’s belongings and achieve greatness, just like Zhuo Fan. None of them were saints, just looking at things from a different angle!
“Then, people started calling Elder Li as the ‘Mad Dipper’. It means to say how arrogant I am yet so powerful none of them could do anything to me!” Vicious Pill King put his two cents in.
Li Jingtian nodded, “So I robbed and cultivated my way to the Profound Heaven Stage, unmatched by all. But at that point, I have reached a chokepoint.”
“Yeah. Spirit ranked cultivation methods are too slow in the Profound Heaven Stage and had to be exchanged. And the only ones with such cultivation methods are the imperial family and seven houses, or the Four Pillars. Is this how you leaned on Regent Estate?” Zhuo Fan said.
Li Jingtian shook his head, holding his head up high.
Vicious Pill King butted in, “Steward Zhuo, you may not know, but Elder Li didn’t lean on Regent Estate, but fought his way in. Elder Li heard of Regent Estate’s Imperial Tyrant Body Art being the best of all the houses and wanted to take it. Five elders had to work together but even they, with their Imperial Tyrant Body Art, couldn’t defeat Elder Li spirit ranked body cultivation method. Even Regent Estate’s Grand Elder Huangpu Fenglei had to intervene. Thus, he invited him into his house as a guest elder, now Venerable. This was one of the rare events in the history of Regent Estate.”
Vicious Pill King turned his admiration-filled eyes to Li Jingtian. Li Jingtian’s head rose even higher, as if that was possible, as he stroked his ego in just the right spots.
As if to say. [Look, I didn’t go there begging, it was Regent Estate who invited me.]
But Zhuo Fan saw through everything and snorted inside.
This so-called invitation was after he became a sensation.
[Regent Estate is fraught with danger. No matter how tough you are, a Profound Heaven expert would soon be lying dead somewhere before he could make any kind of scene. It’s obvious he used his own strength to recommend how fitting he was for Regent Estate.]
[If I went in, my conceived version of Imperial Tyrant Body Art would’ve grown far stronger than theirs, thus boosting the power of Regent Estate.]
[Nonetheless, a body cultivator who has always been engrossed in his training yet, still had the time to develop such cunningness is a rarity. It had to be all that chasing’s fault]
Li Jingtian looked more pleasing in Zhuo Fan’s eyes.
[This Radiant Stage guy has brawn and brain. He is a good specimen!]
Scratching his nose, Zhuo Fan smiled, “In other words, Elder Li is a martial fanatic. Doing anything and everything in your pursuit of power.”
“You only have one life. If you don’t fight your way to rise above the masses, it’s not worth living for!” Li Jingtian looked at the skies and sighed.
Zhuo Fan spoke, “Now, I know what Elder Li wants...”
“Hold on, I don’t want you to see me as...”
“I have my own cultivation method!”
Zhuo Fan cut him off, “What I am unclear, however, is why Elder Li, a Regent Estate’s guest Venerable, and knowing the Imperial Tyrant Body Art, would come after my cultivation method?”
“Uh, kid, I am not actually...”
“Do be frank with me!”
Shooting him a glance, Zhuo Fan was completely defiant, “If Elder Li isn’t honest, you will never get what you want from me. Since I don’t know what you really want.”
Stammering, Li Jingtian looked squarely at Zhuo Fan with admiration. [He is no common kid. Few are those who can meet the gaze of a Radiant Stage expert.]
[No wonder Leng wanted me to personally deal with him.]
Li Jingtian sighed and nodded, “Indeed. I came today for a cultivation method. Humph, I am Regent Estate’s guest Venerable, yet, they only imparted the Imperial Tyrant Body Art up to the seventh stage, omitting the last two. Yet, those weaker than me get to practice it without worry.
“Ridiculous! If I had trained to the ninth stage, I’d be invincible. Not even the imperial family’s Divine Dragons can compare. Just why have they not given me the last stages?”
Li Jingtian let go of all his rancor, to which, the two looked at each other and shook their heads in mockery.
This guy really was a martial fanatic, godlike even. Could Regent Estate rein him in if he became invincible? Humph, he had always been an outsider.
[I wouldn’t impart it either if I couldn’t control you!]
Zhuo Fan said so yet, the outline of a plan was forming in his mind.
This man could be taken into the fold. Though, he needed to fine-tune his rash behavior and get him to fall in line...

chapters.title: Chapter 182, Duping a Radiant Stage Expert
chapters.content:
Chapter 182, Duping a Radiant Stage Expert
“Kid, I have been completely open with you. Now, it’s your turn to tell me that body cultivation method of yours!”
He wanted to still pose as a senior, but Zhuo Fan’s bluntness was hard to cope with. He thus reverted to his Mad Dipper, robber self.
Scratching his nose, Zhuo Fan was just as calm as he smiled, “Elder Li, how do you know my cultivation method is better than Imperial Tyrant Body Art?”
“Humph, anyone can tell after the stunt you pulled in Drifting Flowers City!”
Li Jingtian huffed, “Huangpu Qingyun just entered the seventh stage of Imperial Tyrant Body Art yet, could only take one Bursting Pill. And then there’s you, taking five of them and killing him outright. Even a blind could see whose is better!”
Zhuo Fan and Vicious Pill King shared a look and nodded. Not everyone was stupid, able to tell which was which.
Yet, Zhuo Fan still chose to shake his head, “Elder Li, you are a renowned senior, most clear on the power the Imperial Tyrant Body Art holds. Think it through, just how many cultivation methods are there that can surpass it? “
Li Jingtian was at a loss.
“Ha-ha-ha, Elder Li, as you know the full recount of what happened in Drifting Flowers Edifice, then you must also know what my other title is!”
“Eminent Alchemist Zhuo Fan?” Li Jingtian was stunned, “You mean...”
Zhuo Fan nodded with a crafty smile, “I managed to display such power with my body because of my cultivation method, yes, but also thanks to the pills personally refined. Just one was enough to boost my power five times!”
“What, is that possible?”
Body cultivators were stronger than average because of their tough bodies. And the only way to obtain it was through arduous training, no exceptions.
But if there was a pill that could do the same thing, where’d the body cultivators’ advantage go?
[Does the world have such a miraculous pill?]
Li Jingtian was skeptical, but Zhuo Fan’s logic held some truth. How else could Zhuo Fan with his Bone Tempering Stage cultivation stand up to Huangpu Qingyun?
Li Jingtian was clearly hesitating, but then he said coldly, “Kid, give me the pills or I’ll waste you.”
“Can’t, I ate them all. How else could I have finished off Huangpu Qingyun?”
“Then you better make some. Aren’t you an alchemist?”
“Out of ingredients!”
“Then, I will stay with you until you get them!” Li Jingtian was shouting now.
Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan caught Vicious Pill King showing off a peculiar smile. One that Li Jingtian clearly spotted.
“In that case, I need the blood of a red tail ice fox, a third level beast. Let’s go to Allbeast Mountain Range.” Zhuo Fan proposed.
Li Jingtian waved him off with a smile, “Hold on. Why should we go that far? There’s plenty of third level spiritual beasts in a nearby forest. They aren’t as many in Allbeast Mountain Range, but should be enough for refining.”
Frowning, Zhuo Fan had no choice but to sigh and nod, “Very well. Let’s go.”
Turning around, he gave Vicious Pill King a look. Vicious Pill King didn’t seem to have caught it but Li Jingtian was on guard to pick up this particular strange behavior.
He pulled Zhuo around by the shoulder and squinted, “Kid, a third level spiritual beast doesn’t need all three of us. Let Yan Song get it while we wait.”
“Ha-ha-ha, I am an alchemist and pay close attention to the details when picking any ingredient. How could I let Elder Yan go?” Zhuo Fan wiped his brow of sweat.
Li Jingtian snorted inside. He didn’t know what Zhuo Fan’s game was, but rumors about his cunning and treachery floated everywhere. It’s best to be on the safe side. How many’s blood ended up in this kid’s hands just because they looked down on him?
Li Jingtian was a veteran and saw through everything. He laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, kid, cut the act. I said he will go alone and that’s final. He is also an alchemist and knows what spiritual beast to pick.”
Gnashing his teeth, Zhuo Fan furrowed his brows, but sighed in the end and took out a gourd from his ring, “Elder Yan, here are the favorite worms of the red tail ice fox. Bait it with this and catch it quickly.”
Yan Song’s eyes lit up, catching his meaning, and nodded.
“Wait!”
Li Jingtian felt something was off, “What is this? Let me see!”
Yan Song hesitated but Zhuo Fan nodded.
Li Jingtian took the ice-cold gourd and opened it. A blood-colored worm wiggled its way out.
Li Jingtian looked at it with a critical eye but found nothing unusual. He gave it back to Vicious Pill King, “This fox eats worms?”
“Ha-ha-ha, who else but us alchemists know the habits of every spiritual beast?” Zhuo Fan laughed.
When Li Jingtian found Vicious Pill King had gone ten meters away, he shouted, “Yan Song, you have one day to bring a third level spiritual beast. Be late and we won’t wait for you.”
Yan Song staggered in his flight looking back at Zhuo Fan and nodded.
Zhuo Fan sneered inside. Li Jingtian was quite cautious, leaving no stone unturned. Even though he let Yan Song go, he gave him a deadline.
Now, it wouldn’t matter even if he got help, since these two would be long gone.
[Humph, getting hounded in his younger days worked wonders for his prudence it seems. But despite all this caution, it only sends him deeper into my trap.]
Zhuo Fan grinned.
Around twelve hours later, Vicious Pill King carried a snow-white fox’s body. Its tail was a vibrant red.
Vicious Pill King placed the body down and returned the gourd to Zhuo Fan with a slight nod.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Now, we can refine.”
“Wait!”
Li Jingtian again butted in, his eyes flashing eerily. A flick of his finger cut the fox in two.
Li Jingtian stooped and squeezed the parts until a red worm came out.
“Now you can begin!” Li Jingtian squashed the worm to a paste.
Vicious Pill King was startled yet found Zhuo Fan calm as a well.
“So now I will refine a body pill for Elder Yan to prove my words!” Zhuo Fan took a deep breath and used his Yuan Qi flame.
But Li Jingtian barked, “Wait. I want ten. The more you have, the better.”
“But you can only take it once in your life! Taking any more would be useless!” Zhuo Fan furrowed his brows.
Laughing, Li Jingtian’s eyes were sharp, “If I say you make ten, then that’s what you’ll do. Unless you two don’t want your heads on your shoulders!”
For lack of a better option, Zhuo Fan started refining. When the pills were just about done, he added the ice fox’s blood.
With a hum, ten pills radiating cool air and colored red flew into Zhuo Fan’s palm.
Li Jingtian cried in shock, “Why are they so cold yet came out of a Yuan Qi fire?”
“Elder Li may not know that this 3rd-grade pill, Freezing Body Pill, is a clan secret. Refined with a yin yang flame, it is hot inside and cold on the surface. Once ingested, hot and cold will travel through the body hundreds of times, tempering it.” Zhuo Fan explained.
Li Jingtian reached over, “Give me one!”
Zhuo Fan nodded, acquiescing his demand.
“Wait!”
Li Jingtian had a sly smile, “Give me the other nine!”
Zhuo Fan frowned but complied. Li Jingtian then pointed at the one Zhuo Fan was holding and said with a cold smile, “Kid, eat it.”
“I told you, this pill only works once!” Zhuo Fan frowned,
Laughing, Li Jingtian’s eyes bore into him, “I know of course. But it won’t matter if you take one more. If you don’t eat it, that this pill must have a defect and I will kill you.”
Zhuo Fan ate it in the end.
Seeing him fine, Li Jingtian’s eyes roamed around in thought, “Kid, pick one from these nine.”
Zhuo Fan sighed and took one.
“Give it to me!” Li Jingtian said.
Zhuo Fan complied, yet Li Jingtian shouted again, just before he ate it, “Hold on. You eat it, Yan Song.”
“Me?” Yan Song stammered but was forced to eat it either way.
In this way, Li Jingtian made Zhuo Fan pick again and again, until only three were left. He picked one himself then checked the two’s faces before eating it.
Li Jingtian felt a chill seep into him, then a warmth. It was so gentle and cozy.
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow then snickered.
[This guy is paranoid, but he took the bait anyway, he-he-he...]

chapters.title: Chapter 183, Another One Comes Aboard
chapters.content:
Chapter 183, Another One Comes Aboard
Li Jingtian entered meditation and focused on refining the pill. Zhuo Fan and Vicious Pill King were actually just standing there looking at him.
Six hours later, Li Jingtian stood up. Zhuo Fan smiled, “How is it, Elder Li? Happy?”
“Yes, my body feels so free!”
Li Jingtian let a carefree laugh, but then was cut short as he frowned, “However, why is it that my body hasn’t grown in power?”
Grinning, Zhuo Fan said, “That’s normal since it was not a body pill by any means. It’d be odd if you did get stronger!”
“What? You lied?” Li Jingtian’s rage exploded.
Vicious Pill King hunkered for cover behind Zhuo, but the latter was still carefree, “Oh my, Elder Li, you are a veteran and a man with widened horizons. How come you bought into this fairy tale about body pills? Don’t you know cultivators walk in defiance to Heavens? The greater the price the bigger the reward. Relying on pills will only ruin you in the long run!”
“You played me for a fool?!” Li Jingtian’s eyes were red now.
Vicious Pill King shivered as he shook Zhuo Fan’s arm. He tried to make him stop aggravating this old monster.
Zhuo Fan, however, flicked his hand free and laughed, “And, what are you gonna do about it? You think I’m as dumb as those morons you robbed, thinking you can just take my cultivation method? Fat chance!”
“Why you little...”
Li Jingtian was panting in rage, pointing at Zhuo Fan all the while.
The great Mad Dipper Li Jingtian was somebody, even in his early days, that the seven houses would show some respect. But then, he met this young pup who started cursing him.
The shame was unbearable.
No matter if he got the cultivation method or not, Zhuo Fan had to die.
Li Jingtian bellowed and slapped the two. The wave of power coming from him almost blew the two away.
“Kid, your life ends here!”
Vicious Pill King shivered behind Zhuo Fan in fear.
[Steward Zhuo, you tricked him but your Bloodworms plan fell through, so why are you making it worse?]
[You looked so wise with your poise and calmness, but how come why are you hotheaded today?]
Vicious Pill King cried as he wailed inside. Who could have seen this coming? He just got a new lease on life only to die again a month later.
[Is this the end of my poor life?]
In the middle of his lamentation and prayers, Zhuo Fan snorted and made a sign.
“Ah...”
A shriek of pain shuddered the heavens itself. A bloody mark appeared on Li Jingtian’s forehead that forced his palm to a stop but a hair’s breadth away from Zhuo Fan
He then proceeded to hold his head as he collapsed in agony.
Blood flowed from his eyes, ears, nose, and mouth, dyeing the ground red. His eyes bulged out and were ready to pop.
The wail had Vicious Pill King looking stumped. Looking back at Zhuo Fan, he noticed the trademark wicked grin on his face.
“Uh, Steward Zhuo, did it work?” Vicious Pill King blinked.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “But of course. This coot is under my complete control. Elder Yan, you did well today. I will remember this!”
“Great, ha-ha-ha...”
Vicious Pill King’s spirits were uplifted. He looked to Li Jingtian with a proud gaze. [He-he-he, you finally got yours. Who told you to play around?]
[Don’t you know any ploy before Zhuo Fan is paid back many folds?]
Vicious Pill King felt it on his own skin. But seeing the Mad Dipper of Tianyu’s act crushed and shamed, made him chipper.
His admiration for Zhuo Fan grew as well of course
[He even managed to bring a Radiant Stage cultivator to his knees! This boy is too much!]
“W-what’s happening to me?” Li Jingtian held his head as he rolled on the ground, “What the hell did you do to me?
Zhuo Fan and Vicious Pill King snickered in sync.
Taking the remaining two pills, Zhuo Fan said, “Elder Li, I’m sure you know by now. I mean, didn’t a veteran cultivator like you ever heard the saying, don’t take candy from a stranger?”
“The pill?” Li Jingtian’s eyes widened, “Impossible. Even if a 3rd-grade pill had poison, my Yuan Qi is more than enough to remove it. And didn’t you take it too?”
Zhuo Fan snickered, “We did indeed. Terribly sorry, however, this pill is completely safe. It has no poison, though it does refresh one’s body. What is wreaking havoc in your body is this little buddy.”
Zhuo Fan presented the gourd and a Bloodworm came out.
Li Jingtian had known something was off about it, but never thought it could be so deadly and make him stand on the edge of a precipice.
“This is my demonic creature, Bloodworm. It takes control of your blood. I am linked with it and a thought from me is enough to plunge you into a world of pain! It works just the same even on a Radiant Stage expert like you and there’s nothing you can do about it.”
Li Jingtian was shocked and roamed his eyes around, all while he expressed his doubt, “That can’t be! I scanned every ingredient you used, even the dead fox and there was nothing wrong with any of them. The Bloodworm was killed by me at the start. You’re saying the worm didn’t die when being refined?”
Vicious Pill King was also curious about this. This was the reason for his disappointment earlier. He just didn’t know how Zhuo Fan pulled off getting this old guy to swallow a Bloodworm.
“Ha-ha-ha, I know this as well. Why else would I propose the red-tailed ice fox?”
Chuckling, Zhuo Fan’s eyes shined with wisdom, “My Bloodworm lives in frigid pools, and the ice fox’s main property is its icy blood. So, I had Elder Yan feed it a Bloodworm, but not to include it in the pill later. It was all so it would lay its eggs. You might have killed the Bloodworm, but the icy blood was filled with eggs.”
“Now I get it! Under a Radiant Stage expert’s scrutiny, they’ll notice any hint of life in seconds. But an egg isn’t alive until it hatches. This made Li Jingtian’s search useless.”
Vicious Pill King exclaimed while also giving Zhuo Fan a good round of ass-kissing, “Steward Zhuo is a sage to cover all aspects. Not even the veteran Li Jingtian could match your perfect schemes. I am in awe!”
“That’s not right. How did you make the Bloodworm grow so fast from a mere egg?” Li Jingtian was still in denial.
With a light smile, Zhuo Fan supplied the explanation on a casual note, “You have the potency of the pill to thank for that. As I’ve said, I used both yin and yang fires in the refining. If I did not do so, the yang fire would have ruined the egg in the blood. The rest is as you already understand. Or more aptly put, felt on your own skin. The pill freely switches from yin to yang. Sometimes the warmth of spring, and sometimes the chill of a winter blizzard. It imitates the four seasons. Though it may have been six hours, but to the Bloodworm, it was equivalent to decades.
“Not to mention, this pill speeds up your pulse, all to help the little Bloodworm grow. The pill was no body pill, but one that facilitates the flow of blood, the Spring Pill!”
The explanation floored Li Jingtian completely.
Never had he thought this day would come. He moved unchecked across the empire only to fall in the hands of a twerp. He could only laugh at himself for being greedy. It was this that brought him to his knees.
But Zhuo Fan saw through him once again, “Ha-ha-ha, you must be thinking greed got you into this mess, no? Wrong. Humans are inherently greedy. Take away your desire, and would you still be human? Desire is fine, but you must never ever try to take any shortcuts. There’s no such thing as a miracle pill to make you strong. And even if there is, the price you’d have to pay for it would be so much greater.”
Zhuo Fan then placed a jade slip at his feet, stopping the Bloodworm’s torment as he continued preaching, “Like I said. I have my own cultivation method. It is called Wraith Art, a mid profound ranked demonic method of astonishing power. Train it to completion and it won’t lack one bit to a top one. It is without a doubt stronger than even the Imperial Tyrant Body Art. At the same time, I will also give you three matching profound ranked martial arts.”
“If you are willing to bend a knee and join me and the Luo clan, pick it up and become its elder. Or, you can just leave, return to Regent Estate as a guest Venerable. I won’t stop you!”
Looking Zhuo Fan straight in the eye, Li Jingtian could pick up on his sincerity.
He slowly reached for the jade slip as he muttered, “I first want to see if it is real and not and if it is incomplete like what Regent Estate had passed to me.”
Zhuo Fan smiled and nodded.
When Li Jingtian caught a glimpse of it, his eyes widened, “Bloody hell! There’s a sound profound ranked martial art in here! This doesn’t exist anywhere in the empire. What kind of a behemoth is this Luo clan to have such a treasure? “
“Your decision?” Zhuo Fan smiled.
“I’m in. Who the hell wouldn’t at this point?” Li Jingtian put the jade slip in his ring and laughed, “Kid, I’d come over to your side much earlier if you had just shown me this cultivation method. What need was there for all that cloak and dagger spiel? He-he-he...”
“You don’t say.” Knowing what he was thinking once again, Zhuo Fan smiled coldly, “Wouldn’t you have killed me instead, to silence me, and take my head for a reward?”
Li Jingtian scratched his head awkwardly from having his heart laid bare.
[Zhuo Fan is just as the rumors say. Nothing escapes him. No wonder he can act so calmly after killing six experts.]
[With such a talent, the clan must be of even more epic proportions. I didn’t lose out following him.]
Li Jingtian laughed inside. He may have been forced to switch camps but you could say he traded up!
As such, another poor and disillusioned expert climbed aboard.
Zhuo Fan didn’t mind at all. [Isn’t it a good thing if they trust the Luo clan? Although they may perhaps experience a somewhat mild let down when they see it.]
Zhuo Fan felt somewhat bashful at that last thought...

chapters.title: Chapter 184, Seven Houses Gathering
chapters.content:
Chapter 184, Seven Houses Gathering
The Caged Dragon City leaned onto the endless miles long Bulwark Range. Four towering peaks, jutting cliff edges, and cloud wreathed hunks of rocks had the city surrounded. Seen from above, the four looked like spikes nailing down a proud dragon, dooming it for all eternity.
And this city here was where the head of the seven houses, the Regent Estate, laid its roots.
An old man in his fifty, with sunken cheeks and pale as paper, was now standing before the looming city gate. His hair was in a bun, just like a scholar’s, evoking a refined and courteous air. But the bloodthirst in his eyes ruined this image.
Two Profound Heaven experts flanked him, yet, their attitude was quite deferred toward the old man, with a hint of fear mixed within.
Whoosh!
Suddenly, three lights flashed before them. They were none other than Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s Pavilion Lord, Long Yifey, 3rd elder and Long Jiu.
“You honor me, Pavilion Lord Long, with your arrival. Do forgive me for coming so late to welcome you!” The scholar half bowed to Long Yifey, yet, there was no trace of courteousness on his face.
Long Yifey returned the greeting with haste and respect, “It is of no importance. How could I possibly demand Sir Leng come in person? You have given me a world of respect just by waiting for me.”
“Ha-ha-ha, Pavilion Lord Long is courteous. It is only proper I do so, as the steward of Regent Estate!” Sir Leng cupped his hands and his lips curled into a wide smile.
Long Yifey nodded but felt his heart in a vice.
Around a man they called Unwonted Contriver Leng Wuchang, one had to be mindful of his every little gesture at all times, lest they reveal something they wouldn’t want to about themselves. Lest they would unwittingly allow him to pry into Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s secrets.
Even the other six house lords treated meeting Sir Leng with more gravity than seeing the emperor.
Whoosh!
Three more figures arrived just then. Looking over, they were Hell Valley’s Valley Lord, You Wanshan, along with his Grand Elder and one-armed 5th elder. Perhaps the rage and humiliation still held him in their grip for his features were tightened and morose.
After exchanging greetings with Leng Wuchang, and some short pleasantries, Leng Wuchang flicked his cold eyes on Long Yifey, “Humph, Pavilion Lord Long, enemies always seem to bump into each other. This is the second time we meet since our audience with the emperor.”
“Ha-ha-ha, quite so. Life is fickle like that. It seems, however, after we parted from the imperial capital, Veiled Dragon Pavilion stayed the same, yet, I find it that not to be the case for Hell Valley.” Long Yifey chuckled, the sarcasm clear in his eyes as well.
This open jab at Hell Valley was an obvious mockery to them losing two great generals. First the demise of You Guiqi, and second, the crippling of 5th elder, Diamondback Ape.
Hell Valley’s losses were tremendous, falling dreadfully short in power compared to Veiled Dragon Pavilion.
You Wanshan’s face contorted in rage and stomped forward, his power threatening to break out as he spat, “Long Yifey, come and see for yourself if Hell Valley is still the same or not.”
“Humph, you think the likes of you scare me?”
Snorting, Long Yifey’s eyes were sharp, letting his power ooze out. The two peak Profound Heaven experts’ auras clashed, putting pressure on the two Profound Heaven experts belonging to Regent Estate into retreating.
Even though Regent Estate was crowned as the strongest house, Long Yifey and You Wanshan were not to be taken lightly either.
Few present could push back these two elders, even in the Regent Estate.
The two sides bared their fangs, needing one last push to blow everything up in smoke. Leng Wuchang coughed, “Gentlemen, please, this is Regent Estate!”
Those simple words were as if spoken by a god as it shook the hearts of the two and their aura vanishing.
They proceeded to instantly bow in apology, “Please show leniency, Sir Leng.”
“It’s fine. Just remember that we are in Regent Estate and you are our guests. You will make it difficult for me if you start fighting here. Please take it elsewhere if you want to sort your differences. That’s all I’m asking.”
Leng Wuchang’s face was as blank as ever, but the words were chilling to the bone. His eyes even contained a hint of reprimand when looking at them. Despite the anger welling in the two, they could only let it simmer.
He had the monster that was Regent Estate behind him, someone none of the six houses wanted to make an enemy of.
“Ha-ha-ha, this place sure is lively. Valley Lord You, Pavilion Lord Long, it’s been ages!”
A laughter broke out, followed by three towering figures in green. Their leader was a wizen old man with silver-haired while the other two were his elders. One was red-haired and the other violet, yet, each one of them had an eerie hint of green in their eyes.
“Hall Lord Yan Bogong?” Squinting, You Wanshan mocked them, “You seem to be quite springy, for someone who had his best alchemist slaughtered in cold blood.”
“Ha-ha-ha, Valley Lord You, there’s no need to provoke me!”
Yan Bogong smiled, “Pill King Hall is different from you. You always go on a murder spree every day, with every one of your elders a mighty general – my condolences for the loss by the way. While we at the Pill King Hall pursue alchemy above all else. Only the best alchemist is worthy of the Vicious Pill King title. Even if we were robbed of our precious alchemist, we still have many more that can fit the role as well. Just as we have many 7th grade alchemists like Yan Song. Since they have always been in his shadow for so long, they must be letting it all out in laughter now.”
“In short, we do not lack alchemists. Our next Vicious Pill King will achieve just as his predecessor had, taking the title of the best alchemist in Tianyu.”
Yan Bogong stood proud before the two, while You Wanshan cursed silently, “A cold and cruel hell is a more fitting place for you!”
Long Yifey snorted, “Hall Lord Yan seems to be quite confident. I heard that in the Hundred Pill Meeting held by Drifting Flowers Edifice, before Vicious Pill King’s untimely demise, he fell utterly short to the more skilled Zhuo Fan. Do tell, how is the best alchemist in Tianyu one of yours now, hmm? I certainly don’t see it.”
For the first time since he came, Yan Bogong’s face took a darker tone, his eyes flashing with bloodthirst, “Humph, and if Zhuo Fan dies? The dead can’t compete with Pill King Hall in taking the best alchemist title.”
“What? Zhuo Fan? Where is that devil?”
A sudden bark rang everyone’s ears. It followed with the arrival of three figures in blue. A middle-aged man with delicate features walked to Leng Wuchang, “Sir Leng, hasn’t Zhuo Fan been dealt with yet?”
Leng Wuchang frowned.
Merry Woods was the dumbest ally no one would ever want. [Could you speak any louder? I don’t think everyone heard you clearly.]
Too little too late. Long Yifey could already guess as his eyes glanced at the two.
Leng Wuchang coughed, “House Lord Lin, please mind yourself. We are all here to strategize on how to rid the world of that devil.”
“Oh, Lin Rufeng, why do I get the feeling you already began to act?” Lin Rufeng’s eyes searched for a clue, a tick, anything.
Lin Rufeng nodded without a care, “Damn right. That punk killed our 6th elder. How can we not retaliate? This time, we sent two Profound Heaven experts...”
“House Lord Lin, Zhuo Fan is most cunning. It is not appropriate for Merry Woods to act alone. Let us all work together on this after the Seven Houses Gathering.” Leng Wuchang intervened before Lin Rufeng’s loose tongue could do even more damage.
Lin Rufeng was startled, [What do you mean alone? Weren’t you in it as well?]
But Leng Wuchang’s deadly glare shut him up before he could open his beak.
However, Long Yifey could already guess what happened. [Regent Estate has been on the move even before the Seven Houses Gathering. And they excluded Veiled Dragon Pavilion it seems.]
It was a clear indication that Regent Estate crossed Veiled Dragon Pavilion from their ally list.
[This spells trouble. If the Regent Estate goal is to rule all seven houses, they are sure to make an example out of Veiled Dragon Pavilion by eliminating us.]
Long Yifey secretly sighed. [I can only pray for Zhuo Fan’s safety, that he will assist us once he rises to power. You must stay alive at all costs!]
“Ha-ha-ha, it’s been a long time since it’s been so bustling here. It must’ve been what, a century since our last gathering?”
A sudden chuckle followed a scholarly middle-aged man with a long beard joining them with two elders behind. And one of them was Sword Marquise Abode’s 8th elder, Jian Suifeng.
Jian Suifeng and Long Jiu’s eyes met and they nodded at each other.
In Drifting Flowers City, Zhuo Fan pulled the strings in getting Sword Marquise Abode and Veiled Dragon Pavilion secretly more acquainted. Long Yifey’s eyes shined at the newcomer, finally meeting an ally, and laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, Abode Lord Sky Breaking Xie Xiaofeng, we meet at last!”
“Pavilion Lord Soaring Dragon Long Yifey, I’ve been looking forward to seeing you as well.” Xie Xiaofeng cupped his hands, laughing together for a reason only they knew.
These two were house lords yet, they have never once met before but since they were allies now, they saw each other in a better light.
Leng Wuchang’s brows trembled.
“The seven houses are almost all here. But in light of Drifting Flowers Edifice’s unfortunate disaster that demon caused, I believe they have their hands tied and can’t join us. Let us...”
“Who said Drifting Flowers Edifice’s hands are tied?”
A clear and powerful voice cut Leng Wuchang’s speech short. Then a bang echoed as a golden staff with a dragon head smashed the ground.
The sight of her caused the others to widen their eyes, even Leng Wuchang.
[The old hag still lives...]

chapters.title: Chapter 185, Demon Purging Decree
chapters.content:
Chapter 185, Demon Purging Decree
A curvaceous woman in her forties, free from the scars of time, walked with dignity and lofty air.
At every step, the dragon head golden staff smashed the pavement. Oddly enough, it was at that instant the other people’s hearts jumped as well.
She was the legend that had kept Drifting Flowers Edifice afloat a century ago with her own two hands, the one they called Grandmother, Chu Bijun!
Long Yifey and Xie Xiaofeng had heard of her recovery from Long Jiu and Jian Suifeng, but seeing her in person was a whole other matter entirely.
Each of them watched dumbstruck as if they saw a ghost. One could hardly blame them.
Behind Grandmother were Iris Overseer and Peony Overseer. They stood proud and head held high, finally able to blow off their long pented steam.
“I-impossible! You should be dead!” Hall Lord Yan stammered.
Snorting, Chu Bijun flicked him a look and spat, “Yan Bogong, you’d wish it so. But to your disappointment, I am still alive and well. I may soon even enter the Radiant Stage. Humph, your deep consideration for Drifting Flowers Edifice over the years have been noted. I will make sure to repay each and every transgression!”
Shivering inside, Yan Bogong sank into a depression.
Chu Bijun’s title of Lady of Steel was for her staunch determination in following through on her promise. The future of Pill King Hall looked quite bleak.
“Congratulations on your recovery, Edifice Lord Chu, and resuming your lead!”
Leng Wuchang gradually cooled and cupped his hands to Chu Bijun. She returned the gestures with a light bow, “Please, Sir Leng, you’re too kind. The Edifice Lord has always been Qingcheng. But she had to enter seclusion while this gathering is taking place. So I took it upon myself to assist her by coming here in her stead.”
“Edifice Lord Chu is modest. Everyone knows you are the First Overseer. However, you are no different than an Edifice Lord, thus your title. With you leading, Drifting Flowers Edifice will bound to rise.” Smiling, Leng Wuchang continued, “You have my utmost admiration for advising three generations of Edifice Lords and for your open-minded nature.”
Chu Bijun nodded in her show of respect.
Leng Wuchang smiled, “Would it be too much to ask that in this Seven Houses Gathering, Edifice Lord Chu put aside our differences?”
“Ha-ha-ha, of course, Sir Leng. Only, I’m not so sure everyone else would be as quick to agree as me.” Chu Bijun sneaked a glance at Yan Bogong.
Yan Bogong gnashed his teeth, “Since Sir Leng asked, I shall accommodate your request while in Regent Estate.”
“Ha-ha-ha, wonderful!”
Laughing, Leng Wuchang’s eyes roamed over the crowd and gestured with a flourish, “Guests, please follow me. Estate Lord is waiting.”
He took the lead.
The rest followed after him, while Yan Bogong snorted at Chu Bijun. Chu Bijun only smiled coldly, leaving with her overseers.
When passing by Veiled Dragon Pavilion and Sword Marquise Abode, they exchanged glances and the three broke out in smiles.
This was done in such a casual manner that no one noticed. These three houses were in fact allies.
The six houses’ delegates entered in a lofty and grand hall. The arrangements were full of taste and refinement, yet there were only seven seats.
It was obviously reserved for the house lords, while their detail made to stand. This earned no little dissent among the elder. They were revered in their own houses and even their house lord showed them proper respect.
While here, they seemed to be treated like air.
Turning a blind eye, Leng Wuchang gestured, “Please take your seats while I ask Estate Lord to join you. “
And he left.
Yan Bogong, You Wanshan and Lin Rufeng looked at each other before taking their seats. Chu Bijun squinted and took a seat as well.
The elders were however, made to stand at their side.
Long Yifey and Xie Xiaofeng exchanged a glance then looked at their elders, undecided to the best course of action. A house leader should fight for the respect of his elders.
The best way was to ask Regent Estate for more seats. The elders were the pillars of the house, not mere servants to watch their house lord eat while standing aside.
But the seating was so strange that left the two at a loss.
While they were debating inside, a stout man in golden ceremonial robes dazzled in with Leng Wuchang behind him.
He was the Estate Lord, Huangpu Tianyuan!
The people stood and offered their respects.
Huangpu Tianyuan returned their gesture and sat in the seat of honor. Only then did the other sit as well. Leng Wuchang chose to stand behind Huangpu Tianyuan, without a hint of complaint.
Huangpu Tianyuan took everyone’s presence into account and, even though Leng Wuchang warned him, he was shocked to see Chu Bijun here just the same, “Edifice Lord Chu, I am relieved to see you in good health.”
Chu Bijun nodded, “I am most grateful for Estate Lord’s kind thoughts!”
“Drifting Flowers Edifice and Regent Estate have always been close. Chu Bijun recovery is a happy event for us, Regent Estate.” Huangpu Tianyuan smiled and patted her snow-white hand.
Chu Bijun withdrew in flustered and with reddened cheeks.
[Goddamn hypocrite!]
Iris Overseer and Peony Overseer cursed him secretly. If not for Grandmother’s early warning, they’d be blowing a gasket right about now.
Huangpu Tianyuan turned to Long Yifey and Xie Xiaofeng, asking in faux interest, “Pavilion Lord Long, Abode Lord Xie, why are you standing? Do you find your seats lacking? I will change them for you.”
“Uh, no no no!”
Long Yifey denied, his eyes darting around while replying oddly, “Sir Leng is one of the three sages in Tianyu. How could I let him stand? I freely offer my own seat to him.”
Xie Xiaofeng understood his hidden meaning.
At an important and rare occasion as the Seven Houses Gathering, how could Regent Estate make such a casual blunder to forget some seats? It was obviously done on purpose.
Mentioning it would instantly trigger the trap. As for what that was, no one knew.
Yet, Leng Wuchang took a roundabout approach, hanging the issue over Leng Wuchang’s head. Although unable to talk back for Regent Estate’s accommodations, the least he could do was counter it ingeniously.
[He-he-he, Pavilion Lord Long still knows how to use the old noodle!]
Xie Xiaofeng joined in as well, “Ai, how could I let Pavilion Lord Long give his seat? It’s best I give my own.”
“Oh, no no no, take mine!”
“Please, I insist!”
The two kept going back and forth hoping to make a mountain out of a molehill. Yet Huangpu Tianyuan was sitting there without the slightest disturbance.
Leng Wuchang snorted secretly. He cupped his hands at the two, “Thank you house lords for your generous offers, but we have rules here. I cannot agree. These seven seats are for house lords only. A subject like me is unworthy of seating next to lords.”
[So that’s why!]
[Is this regent’s skill in dividing his subjects from the lords?]
The two saw the same guess in each other’s eye.
Leng Wuchang was quite vague, but it hinted at Regent Estate’s ambition. He tossed out the ‘subjects and lord’ excuse to test who was worthy of making ties with Huangpu Tianyuan and who was not.
As for who was the lord and the subjects among the seven houses, it was painfully clear.
For the sake of dealing with Zhuo Fan, they convened the Seven Houses Gathering, but it was in fact a cover to threaten the six houses into submission!
There was no way Regent Estate would breach this subject out of their own initiative. So how could they deal with this?
Long Yifey and Xie Xiaofeng gnashed their teeth, taking seats with anxious hearts. The elders stood behind them with heavy expressions.
Regent Estate was planning on using Zhuo Fan as a scapegoat to unite the houses!
Huangpu Tianyuan smiled once everyone was seated, “The reason why I’ve asked you all here today is abundantly clear.
“As of late, devil Zhuo Fan had repeatedly breached the Seven Noble Houses’ honor. Beginning with Hell Valley’s 7th elder, it slowly snowballed into the chaos that engulfed Drifting Flowers Edifice and robbing us of four elders with his devious ploys. The whole of Tianyu sees us as nothing but buffoons. If we let him continue on this path, the day may very well come when he will purge one house from its roots.”
“He-he-he, wasn’t Drifting Flowers City the root of Drifting Flowers Edifice? He-he-he...” Hall Lord couldn’t help but point out his mockery.
Chu Bijun smiled coldly, “Indeed, Drifting Flowers City has been reduced to shambles. However, that was at the price of taking out the best alchemist in Tianyu. Shouldn this old bones destroy a few more?”
“Chu Bijun, mind your goddamn tone!” Yan Bogong slapped the table.
Chu Bijun was quite calm as she stood, “Humph, anyone here is more than clear who should mind his?”
“Enough!”
Huangpu Tianyuan shouted, “Fighting among us before our enemy is vanquished will only benefit him.”
Huangpu Tianyuan ended their quarrel and resumed, “For that purpose, I propose, in the name of the seven houses, the Demon Purging Decree and put an end to his vile tendencies!”
[What?!]
The others gasped, even Chu Bijun and Yan Bogong.
They all had their guesses, but hearing it was still a shock!
The last time the Demon Purging Decree was issued was three centuries ago...

chapters.title: Chapter 186, Grandmother’s Tactic
chapters.content:
Chapter 186, Grandmother’s Tactic
Demon Purging Decree was the seven houses’ act, which held as much power as the emperor’s edicts. Yet, it was far more cruel.
Even if the emperor was subjected to some offense, his edict would involve the seven houses, at the most, in dealing with the offender. But the Demon Purging Decree rendered a constant kill order on the target, in which, the seven houses would deploy all their assets, including their Venerables, in hunting him down.
The target would be exterminated with extreme prejudice. It wasn’t limited to the target either, as it included the place he visited, be it a village or a city. They were all burned to the ground.
Driven by fear, everyone else would start hounding the target as well, until he had nowhere to hide in the whole of Tianyu Empire.
In this manner, the target would slowly grow weary, unable to cope, and ultimately perish.
As this was a drastic measure, the Demon Purging Decree was issued only if voted unanimously by the seven house lords. If one house fail to participate, it would be tantamount to betraying the imperial family and being labeled as traitors.
Yet, Zhuo Fan only killed people from four houses, becoming bitter enemies with them. Even if he had all seven of them breathing down his neck, it would still not warrant such a cruel and vicious act as the Demon Purging Decree.
Since this act implied the slaughter of innocents in cold blood.
Three centuries ago, the seven houses would have refrained from using it as well, but that little monster was too hard to deal with. While this time, it was used on a mere Bone Tempering cultivator!
Everyone was frowning, sinking into their thoughts.
“What does everyone think?” Huangpu Tianyuan smiled.
Yan Bogong, You Wanshan, and one other nodded, “We agree to Estate Lord’s decision. The brat has to be put down at once!”
Long Yifey muttered, “However, using Demon Purging Decree at this time is overkill. This implies an empire-wide call to arms and an explanation has to be given to the imperial family. Furthermore, Zhuo Fan is hardly at the level of that little monster three centuries ago. It doesn’t make sense to use the Demon Purging Decree for just this.”
Xie Xiaofeng nodded.
“Humph, of course you’d say that, Pavilion Lord Long. At that time, Veiled Dragon Pavilion was willing to take the blame for the kid. You must be practically joined at the hip with that devil by now.” You Wanshan snorted.
Long Yifey roared, “You Wanshan, cease your baseless accusations! When your two elders died in Windgaze City, we were in the dark too. Would you have believed us if we just told you it wasn’t us? We might as well settle this now so that rumours won’t spread saying that Qianlong Pavilion is afraid of you. How is it that now, your story has changed into us taking the fall for Zhuo Fan?”
“He-he-he, you know full well who’s taking the blame. Are you to tell me you are that oblivious to what happens in your own backyard? Windgaze City is your domain!”
“Ha-ha-ha, you knew full well that was our domain yet you sent elders in. They were seeking death!”
“Say that again!” You Wanshan slapped the table and jumped to his feet. Long Yifey did the same in answer to his challenge.
Huangpu Tianyuan snorted in anger.
One that shook the entire place. You Wanshan and Long Yifey felt their ears ringing and a heavy force pushing down on them.
Shock set in as well. Huangpu Tianyuan’s power was incredible. Despite all being peak Profound Heaven Stage experts here, they were a cut below him.
The two were reduced to only glaring at each other as they took their seats.
Eyeing them coldly, Huangpu Tianyuan said, “Remember, this is the Regent Estate!”
The two apologized but were wary nonetheless.
“Edifice Lord Chu, what is your decision?” Huangpu Tianyuan smiled.
After a brief reflection, Chu Bijun responded with a smile, “I wholly approve of Estate Lord’s decision. This devil ruined Drifting Flowers Edifice and has to be put down.”
Long Yifey and Xie Xiaofeng watched each other baffled.
[Hey Grandma, we are allies here. Don’t go kicking us to the curb!]
Huangpu Tianyuan was shocked at her casual response.
But then Chu Bijun showed an expression plagued by worry, “Estate Lord, we may issue the Demon Purging Decree, but you have to move like lightning and destroy him. You must know that he has the Bodhi Root in his possession, Drifting Flowers Edifice’s greatest treasure. If he is pushed into a corner and eats it, it will boost his power and will ruin us.”
Chu Bijun’s words struck a chord. Huangpu Tianyuan sighed, “On second thought, it is best we don’t unleash such a calamity as the Demon Purging Decree on the people. “
[En... wait, what?]
You Wanshan’s side nodded out of instinct but soon came to and was flabbergast. He thought to himself.
[I say, Estate Lord, didn’t you tell us to follow your lead? We even agreed to enact the Demon Purging Decree. Why are you then so whimsical? Are you going back on your words to trick us too?]
Huangpu Tianyuan treated their looks of doubt as air, sighing once again in abject sorrow, “I only proposed the Demon Purging Decree to see if there’s any compassion left in your hearts. Us seven are the peak of Tianyu’s power, we have to lead by example, to stand united in upholding peace in Tianyu. If we adhere to the Demon Purging Decree and bring disaster to our people over one kid, for our selfishness no less, wouldn’t that be too despicable of us?”
Long Yifey and Xie Xiaofeng bobbed their heads. They were clueless as to why Huangpu Tianyuan shifted gear like a teenager, but they agreed in a heartbeat.
You Wanshan’s side had their faces twitching. And Huangpu Tianyuan’s amiable smile almost had them spurt blood.
[Curses! Are you playing with us?]
[Did you just use us knowing our motives earlier to paint us the villains while making you the benevolent hero?]
[This damn Regent Estate is a den of bastards.]
You Wanshan’s side glanced at each other, looking as if they swallowed a fly.
They all then started to discuss how to deal with Zhuo Fan, but came up empty. Huangpu Tianyuan then adjourned the meeting, for the house lords to get some rest.
When Chu Bijun left, Huangpu Tianyuan never let her out of his sight.
“This damn hag is back to her old tricks!” When all left, Huangpu Tianyuan spoke faintly.
Nodding, Leng Wuchang smiled, “Yes, hitting us right where it hurts. The hag saw your motive with a glance and threw a wrench in your Demon Purging Decree. From what I’ve seen, the Drifting Flowers Edifice may be the weakest house, but Chu Bijun isn’t easy to deal with. At least, far more troublesome than Long Yifey and Xie Xiaofeng working together.”
“Indeed. With this hag back, the Drifting Flowers Edifice is going to be a hard pill to swallow!” Huangpu Tianyuan sighed.
You Wanshan’s group suddenly appeared in the hall.
Already knowing they’d come, Leng Wuchang waved them off with a smile, “I know what’s on your minds, but please relax. We have no ill will towards any of you. Estate Lord only changed his decision on the spur of the moment.”
Startled, You Wanshan’s group held Leng Wuchang in even greater admiration.
“Sir is an outstanding strategist. It is indeed why we came here yet you could tell with a single look!”
“Please, you’re too kind. I only have people’s best intentions in mind.” Leng Wuchang smiled.
“But Sir Leng, Estate Lord, how are we to get rid of Zhuo Fan?” You Wanshan frowned.
Hell Valley and Zhuo Fan’s grudges were bone-deep. They only cared about seeing Zhuo Fan dead.
Huangpu Tianyuan and Leng Wuchang laughed.
“Valley Lord You, a pup has you running scared? Look at you shaking in worry over there,you are bringing disgrace to the seven houses.” Huangpu Tianyuan mocked him.
Leng Wuchang’s eyes flashed, “Valley Lord You, haven’t we already sent a team to intercept him?”
“And if it fails? Isn’t this the reason for the Demon Purging Decree?” This was You Wanshan and the others’ biggest worry.
Huangpu Tianyuan rejected, “You think a mere Bone Tempering kid is worthy of the Demon Purging Decree? The decree is only a means to an end, a convenient excuse.”
You Wanshan blinked baffled.
Leng Wuchang looked unperturbed, “I may not know much about him, but three houses send two Profound Heaven experts after him. The chance of success is over 90%. But just now, it became 100%!”
“Oh, what makes you so sure of success, Sir Leng?” Huangpu Tianyuan raised an eyebrow. Even he was curious.
Leng Wuchang grinned, “Because our guest Venerable, Leng Wuchang, volunteered as well.”
“He’s going too, whatever for?” Huangpu Tianyuan was startled.
“Why else? He must have heard of the kid’s exploits in Drifting Flowers City and plans on taking Zhuo Fan’s cultivation method for himself. That martial fanatic knows when to be serious only when these things are involved.”
“Humph, what a fool. He is Regent Estate’s guest Venerable, with Imperial Tyrant Body Art at his disposal, and yet here he is coveting an outsider’s cultivation method.” Huangpu Tianyuan snorted.
Leng Wuchang shook his hand indifferently, “It doesn’t matter. With Elder Li’s character, he’ll definitely kill the kid afterward. The brat’s fate is sealed.”
You Wanshan’s group was overjoyed at the news.
Now that a Radiant Stage expert set his eyes on Zhuo Fan, he would die for sure no matter how skilled he was.
Yet to their complete lack of knowledge of the situation, that giddy Radiant Stage expert who went to rob and kill, got turned instead.
Even Leng Wuchang would be so shocked his eyes would pop out of their sockets...

chapters.title: Chapter 187, Return to Windgaze City
chapters.content:
Chapter 187, Return to Windgaze City
“Also...”
You Wanshan’s group was slowly getting into a mood of celebrating Zhuo Fan’s death. Meanwhile, the one-armed 5th elder was shedding tears of vindication. However, this stopped when Leng Wuchang shot them a look, “You all need to proceed to Windgaze City!”
The smile froze on the four and You Wanshan turned his head mechanically, with a bright smile to offer the two, “Estate Lord, Sir Leng, haven’t we been keeping watch of Windgaze City just so we could get rid of Zhuo Fan? Why do we need to attack that place now that Zhuo Fan is out of the picture?”
“Fool!”
Huangpu Tianyuan barked, his eyes cold, “That’s the place that gave birth to Zhuo Fan and there’s a good chance for a second, a third, maybe even a tenth Zhuo Fan to rise! Rather than deal with that mess, we need to level that clan. Furthermore...”
Huangpu Tianyuan’s tone shifted to a darker one, “Have I ever gone back on my words?”
[You did exactly that just now!]
Shivering, You Wanshan’s group complained in their minds, but they were on their best behavior on the outside. Bowing to Huangpu Tianyuan again, they then left.
“Send them a message. It’s time for them to begin!”
“En!”
Huangpu Tianyuan, nodded, pleased. Once the four were out of sight of the hall, You Wanshan stomped in rage, “Who does Regent Estate think they are to use us as messengers?”
“Yeah, the Emperor banned us from Windgaze City two years ago. Regent Estate wants to test the imperial family’s limits and doesn’t dare go himself. So, he is making us face the danger. What an abominable man!” Yan Bogong gnashed his teeth.
Lin Rufeng furrowed his brow in worry, “But, we will be offending Regent Estate if we don’t go. And if we do, we will incur the imperial family’s wrath. What is the better choice?”
They stared at each other for a long time but came out empty as they sighed.
The imperial family may be a frail tiger now, but that didn’t mean one should start groping its tail. If by some chance they touched a sore spot, the weak tiger would snap back at them. The three houses would feel the fangs and claws of the imperial family and would have no place to hide in the empire.
[Go to hell, Regent Estate!] Each of them was thinking along the same lines, but none dared to turn Huangpu Tianyuan down.
th elder continued, “Valley Lord, we should choose the lesser of two evils! We don’t know if the imperial family will act if we move in on Windgaze City. But going against Regent Estate will have Huangpu Tianyuan on our backs. And you know his short temper.”
The three house lords shuddered and sighed.
“In this situation, our only option is to go on a limb!”
You Wanshan spat, “That the imperial family is useless and won’t act against us!”
You Wanshan picked a green jade slip and made a gesture. The jade slip turned into a light and shot in Windgaze City’s direction.
The other two house lords followed his gestures.
Leng Wuchang was outside the hall, smiling at the three lights tracing the sky above Caged Dragon City.
“The three realized my plan but they chose to follow it anyway!” Huangpu Tianyuan chuckled as he walked next to Leng Wuchang.
Leng Wuchang nodded with a smile of his own, “The three are house lords, after all, not mere idiots. How could they not see through Estate Lord’s intentions? But even so, after balancing the gains and losses, they ultimately sided with Estate Lord. The seven houses seem to take the imperial family as just an empty shell!”
“Indeed. Over the last thousand years, the seven houses thrived while the imperial clan declined. It reached a point where the current Emperor is the weakest this empire has ever seen. A great opportunity presents itself to us!”
Huangpu Tianyuan grinned and showed his ambition, “If the imperial family remains passive even after the battle of Windgaze City, then I can enact the Demon Purging Decree and purge all outsiders while unifying the seven houses. I will ultimately control the whole land!”
“Ha-ha-ha, with the seven houses under you, not even the Four Pillars can stand in your way! I would like to be the first to congratulate the Estate Lord for taking the throne!” Leng Wuchang gave a deep bow.
Huangpu Tianyuan laughed having his ego stroked, then helped Leng Wuchang up, “Leng Wuchang, you are the genius of this generation yet, chose to become my steward, helping Regent Estate’s rise to glory. I hereby vow that once I ascend the throne, I will make you the head of the Four Pillars!”
“I am most grateful for Estate Lord’s kindness!”
Leng Wuchang bowed again as hope flickered in his gaze, “Once Elder Li kills Zhuo Fan and brings back the Bodhi Root. I will assist Estate Lord in obtaining the Nine Dragons Diamond Body. Not even the imperial family’s five Divine Dragons will be able to harm you then. You will truly wield ultimate power and rule above everyone!”
“But won’t that martial fanatic catch an interest into that worldly treasure? Or would he just throw it away?”
“Ha-ha-ha, you must be jesting, Estate Lord. Elder Li is only a martial fanatic and not a complete idiot. How could he throw away such a treasure? Of course he’ll return it to us. And with Elder Li’s ability, Zhuo Fan will have no opportunity in damaging the treasure at all. Rest assured, Estate Lord.”
Leng Wuchang and Huangpu Tianyuan started laughing together. As if the world was their oyster.
In a different part of the city, Long Yifey, Xie Xiaofeng, and Chu Bijun convened in a secluded place once they left the hall.
Long Yifey showed Chu Bijun proper respect, “Grandmother, what has gotten into Regent Estate? Could you please enlighten me?”
This also concerned Xie Xiaofeng deeply. They knew Regent Estate was up to something, and it was not good by the looks of it, but he couldn’t make heads or tails of it.
Grandmother sighed and shook her head, “Pavilion Lord Long, Abode Lord Xie, the three of us are in an alliance so I’ll be frank. You two are at the very top of Huangpu Tianyuan’s blacklist.”
[What?!]
Startled, the two had guessed as much, but there was another thing to hear it from Grandmother, a renowned figure among even the seven houses.
Chu Bijun took a deep breath and resumed, “I have dealt with the houses for all my life and can attest that I know every house’s style like the back of my hand. Let’s turn back to when we just entered the hall. You believed since Leng Wuchang spoke of the ‘lords and subject’ that he was looking for you to follow Regent Estate blindly, right?”
“Isn’t that the case?” The two asked together.
Shaking her head, Chu Bijun sighed, her eyes focused, “That was a test of obedience!”
“Obedience?”
“Precisely. The so-called ‘lord and subject’ setup was in fact, a way to lord over the masses. To sum it up, to judge obedience! The instant we entered the hall, it was made abundantly clear.”
Chu Bijun squinted, her tone cold, “Huangpu Tianyuan is too proud and he only wants those who obey around him. So when you saw the seats he had laid out for you, he expected you to take them without making a peep. Pavilion Lord Long may have been clever, but to him, it was all the same as not obeying him and putting you first on the blacklist.”
Long Yifey never would’ve thought Regent Estate was so overbearing to impose his will even on the seven houses.
Xie Xiaofeng frowned as he nodded in agreement, “I can see now why Grandmother has been going along with his intentions. It was all to make Drifting Flowers Edifice among the last to get rid of.”
“That should be the case!”
Chu Bijun nodded, “Now that he believes the Bodhi Root is with Zhuo Fan, and that I obey him throughout this whole farce. In his eyes, Drifting Flowers Edifice should be behind your houses on the blacklist.”
“Brother Xie, we must stay vigilant.” Long Yifey laughed dryly.
Xie Xiaofeng nodded.
What they thought would be a hidden alliance with Drifting Flowers Edifice to make a joint covert attack, now became a full-blown and open assault.
Suddenly, becoming the vanguard had placed a heavy weight on their shoulders. As if the vicious eyes of Regent Estate were fixed on them both.
But they had to admire the Lady of Steel.
Drifting Flowers Edifice had now revived to the one of old along with Lady of Steel’s recovery. For her to shift Regent Estate’s main priority from them was a difficult feat to pull.
Putting these two in the first line of fire...
Chu Bijun knew what they were thinking and tapped with her dragon head staff, “House lords, do not think for a second you are shouldering Drifting Flowers Edifice’ disaster alone. With you in front, Drifting Flowers Edifice is indeed safe, for now. But we are all in the same boat. If one house falls, the ruin of the other two will only be a matter of time.”
The two bowed in profound respect, “Grandmother has always had the greater picture in mind. We are ashamed!”
“Now that we are allies in the truest sense of the word, we must devise a plan to stop Regent Estate’s campaign!”
Chu Bijun spoke in an imposing tone, “His plan to use the Demon Purging Decree was not to deal with demon Zhuo Fan, but take advantage of the chaos and swallow the six houses. But I knew his keen interest in Bodhi Root and mentioned it, all so he would give up on that notion. It won’t last, however. Once he kills Zhuo Fan and obtains the Bodhi Root, the Demon Purging Decree will be issued all the same.”
“But wouldn’t the death of Zhuo Fan take away the sole reason behind the Demon Purging Decree?”
“Fool!”
Grandmother tapped with her staff, her tone dropping lower, “Demon Purging Decree never had anything to do with Zhuo Fan from the start. He is an excuse. And this excuse remains valid even if he kills Zhuo Fan while the facts are hidden! I am convinced that Regent Estate had long since sent a team to deal with the kid. And since Unwonted Contriver Leng Wuchang is also lending a hand, I can only assume the worst.”
Long Yifey and Xie Xiaofeng nodded, hearts overwhelmed with shame.
This was the Lady of Steel, a woman worthy of her title! In times of great peril, she was not a bit inferior to a man. Before this senior, the two house lords were naught but mere children that listened to her orders.
“All that Regent Estate is missing is to determine the limit of the imperial family. Only then, will they unleash the Demon Purging Decree without scruples. And this limit is none other than Windgaze City!” Chu Bijun’s eyes focused and shouted, “We do not know the imperial family’s stance on Windgaze City, so we have to help them. We cannot let Luo clan fall!”
“Qing’er, Peony, go and inform Huangpu Tianyuan that I, Pavilion Lord Long, and Abode Lord Xie have urgent matters to attend in our houses and have to leave.”
“At once!” The two overseers bowed.
Chu Bijun turned to the house lords, “We must make haste and aid Windgaze City. The enemy must have forces in place already. I can only hope we make it in time.”
“Uh, Grandmother, won’t the three houses be moving together?”
