“We can’t afford any delays!” Chu Bijun cut through their hesitation on the spot, “Leng Wuchang is a shrewd man and we won’t be able to hide our cooperation from him for long. It’s best we make it public and face them head-on. This will also work to show that we are one and not to be pushed around.”
Saying her piece, Chu Bijun flew away.
Long Yifey and Xie Xiaofeng looked at each other and laughed dryly. [Lady of Steel is fierce indeed.] The two house lords couldn’t gain any word in at all. All they could do was follow her lead!
[She’s a bit too fierce...]
And at this moment, three figures landed on a mountain outside Windgaze City.
“Guess who’s back!”

chapters.title: Chapter 188, Fink
chapters.content:
Chapter 188, Fink
With a deep breath, Zhuo Fan overlooked Windgaze City, especially Blackwind Mountain, with a sigh.
For Luo clan’s safety, its steward left on a two-year journey. [I wonder how they are doing? Old Pang’s Wraith Art was a success or death?]
Zhuo Fan’s mind was filled with thoughts the nearer he got. He didn’t realize when the Luo clan got to be so important to him.
“Elder Li, you’re not pulling my leg, are you? Regent Estate truly canceled the Demon Purging Decree?” Vicious Pill King was on pins and needles all the way to Windgaze City.
Li Jingtian forced a smile. This guy had asked him a hundred times already but no matter how he explained it, he’d come back to ask, again and again, getting on his nerves.
His eyes snapped on Vicious Pill King and roared, “Kid, you’re so old yet nagging me like a midwife. This will be the last time I’ll tell you, I came voluntarily after you, not because Regent Estate issued the Demon Purging Decree. At least, not before I left. If you ask me one more time, geezer, I’ll tear your mouth off!”
Vicious Pill King jerked from fear. He remained quiet but worry still plagued him.
Zhuo Fan had also got to know what the Demon Purging Decree entailed this past two weeks and could feel Vicious Pill King’s distress.
Radiant Stage experts were the ultimate power of any house, and the only way to use them was through a Demon Purging Decree.
Zhuo Fan was certain Li Jingtian didn’t come because of it, and lying to him was impossible. This martial fanatic really came just to steal cultivation methods.
Or the moment the old man saw them, Zhuo Fan’d fight instead of letting himself be captured.
“Elder Yan, relax. Even if the Demon Purging Decree is released, it won’t be anytime soon. We will still have time to prepare!” Zhuo Fan smiled.
Hum~
A sudden ripple spread from Windgaze City. Vicious Pill King was still out of it, but the other two felt it, “Radiant Stage?”
Their faces took a darker tone.
Especially Zhuo Fan, [Is Demon Purging Decree really in effect?] It was all too sudden. He and the elders had ways to safeguard themselves, but the Luo clan was powerless.
Zhuo Fan nodded at Li Jingtian, who searched with his soul. Under the cover of Li Jingtian’s soul sense, Zhuo Fan released his own.
This would make the other side only notice Long’s Discerning Field while Zhuo Fan’s was still hidden.
This would give him a good opportunity to lay some traps if the other was an enemy. At any given time and place, Zhuo Fan hid his cards to make a deadly strike on any who came after him.
Li Jingtian had to admire Zhuo Fan for his behavior.
It was the first time he saw the kid this vigilant. While Li Jingtian was a martial fanatic, Zhuo Fan would be a high-functioning sociopath, with killing always on his mind.
But that stemmed from Zhuo Fan always meeting difficult opponents. At the end of it all, Zhuo Fan was still standing while all the others around him laid dead.
And since the first thing that came to Zhuo Fan’s mind was killing, those people had to exhibit just a brief lack in judgment and their lives were forfeited.
Li Jingtian secretly signed, holding Zhuo Fan in even higher regard.
“Three Radiant Stage experts!” Li Jingtian frowned.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Two in the 3rd layer and one in the 4th. Not to mention, there are many Profound Heaven experts around as well! Wait, there’s also those two...”
Zhuo Fan snickered all of a sudden, “I knew they were garbage, but had no good excuse so far. But this time, humph...”
Zhuo Fan observed Blackwind Mountain in the distance. A glance was enough to reveal that the arrays he set up were activated, easing his worries.
[Blackwind Mountain still holds!]
“Well I’ll be, Luo clan is no pushover. Just from not being able to see through the arrays, I can tell it’s no less than at a Regent Estate’s level. Even a Radiant Stage will have his work cut out for him.”
Li Jingtian scanned the Blackwind Mountain as well.
The minute Vicious Pill King heard something about Radiant Stage experts being involved, he jumped the gun, “Three Radiant Stage experts in one go. This must be the Demon Purging Decree...”
“Elder Yan, stop whining. Demon Purging Decree has nothing to do with this!”
Zhuo Fan saw Vicious Pill King hysterical and shook his head, “They would’ve attacked before the arrays were activated if the Demon Purging Decree was declared. But look at them, they’re still waiting for orders!”
“But why else are Radiant Stage experts included if not because of Demon Purging Decree?”
“Because of me!”
Zhuo Fan shot him a look, “To make sure I stay dead, they laid a trap. Everything is taken into account, including the intervention of Veiled Dragon Pavilion. I can say for sure that once I set foot in Windgaze City, those three Radiant Stage experts will take my life! However...”
A creepy grin found itself on his lips as Zhuo Fan turned to Li Jingtian, “They’ll never guess I still have a Radiant Stage expert on my side, and a 6th layer body cultivator to boot!”
“Ha-ha-ha, with me here, these pups won’t take one hair from you!” Li Jingtian laughed and jutted his chin.
With a raised eyebrow, Zhuo Fan said evilly, “Why stop there? Elder Li, that would be a walk in the park for you.”
“Uh...”
Li Jingtian pondered carefully, and his eyes took a savage tone, “Then I’ll just kill my way in and put them in their place!”
“No!” Zhuo Fan smiled.
Li Jingtian was confused, “Steward Zhuo doesn’t trust my strength? Humph, forget about these weak bastards, when not even a Radiant Stage expert at my layer can take three hits from me!”
Li Jingtian’s tone was mighty enough, but unclear if from confidence or overconfidence.
Zhuo Fan however still had the same smile, “And what if I want Elder Li to kill them as well?”
“That...” Li Jingtian frowned as he smoothed his beard in predicament.
Killing those weaker than him was easy, but doing the same for those in the same stage was a whole nother matter. Taking Windgaze City’s battle as an example, Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s 3rd and 5th elders were far stronger than Hell Valley’s elders.
But unable to kill him no matter how they tried.
It was all thanks to Zhuo Fan’s schemes, taking advantage of the enemy’s carelessness, that he killed two elders. This was also why Veiled Dragon Pavilion was in so much uproar then.
When someone stronger couldn’t kill them, Zhuo Fan up and pulled off such an impossible feat while two stages below. Not once, but twice.
And now, Li Jingtian was finding it hard to answer Zhuo Fan’s request.
Grinning diabolically, Zhuo Fan’s eyes were on him, “Elder Li, I seem to recall you are still Regent Estate’s guest Venerable!”
“Uh, Steward Zhuo, my intentions are real...”
Li Jingtian was just about to explain his loyalty when he caught onto Zhuo Fan’s sneaky meaning.
“Precisely. No one yet knows of you standing with the Luo clan, so...”
Zhuo Fan got closer to Li Jingtian’s ear, who nodded now and then.
Once done explaining, Zhuo Fan stressed, “Remember, don’t go rambling about once inside. Slap them a couple of times and tell them to lay siege on the mountain!”
“Got it. It’s been so long since I played this role! Ha-ha-ha...”
Li Jingtian flew straight for Windgaze City. Zhuo Fan grinned, disregarding Vicious Pill King’s facial expression, “He-he-he, when one looks for a fink, quality is always preferred. And the ones you have found are some I can’t wait to get rid of.”
Vicious Pill King had no clue what he was raving about as Zhuo Fan pulled him towards Blackwind Mountain.
“Elder Yan, I’ll take you to see the clan!”
Vicious Pill King’s eyes sparkled and nodded. [It is finally time to see the legendary clan...]
Meanwhile, in Windgaze City’s Sun clan’s manor.
Those poor quality finks Zhuo Fan mentioned, Cai Rong and Cai Xiaoting, were sitting in a small room with evil looks.
“Humph, to hell with the Sun clan, and to hell with Hell Valley! We’ve been running around Blackwind Mountain for so long and even drew them a map. It’s not our fault they couldn’t see the guarding arrays, yet now, they give us the silent treatment!” Cai Xiaoting nagged.
Cai Rong sighed, “Zhuo Fan is incredible to set guarding arrays before leaving! But that damn Luo Yunchang is too paranoid, not having extended contact with outsiders. We had to turn traitors if we wanted to attack it! Ha-ha, our map is useless now that the guarding arrays are up. No wonder everyone gives us the cold shoulder!”
“Humph, Zhuo Fan must’ve taught her before leaving! That bitch gobbles up everything Zhuo Fan says. She is so loyal that she almost pushed the Luo clan head position on him!” Cai Xiaoting raged, his eyes clouded in jealousy.
“Tell me father, am I not, Cai Xiaoting, the grand young master of Cai Manor, better than that nobody? Why is it that Luo Yunchang never looked at me ever since Zhuo Fan showed up? He’s been gone for two years now, yet, she pins for him every day by looking in the direction he left. There was not even a word of mention to me regarding the guarding arrays... “
Cai Rong regretted the more he saw his son complaining.
Zhuo Fan was a true genius, admired even by the seven houses. He would’ve long given his daughter to Zhuo Fan if he had one instead!
[My son is in the 9th layer of Qi Condensation yet, has not a bit of wisdom on him...]
Cai Rong shook his head when Sun Yufei burst in, “The elders want to see you. Come with me.”
Startled, the Cai father and son turned happy thinking they would meet Hell Valley’s higher ups. Their rise was just around the corner...

chapters.title: Chapter 189, One Stronger than the Last
chapters.content:
Chapter 189, One Stronger than the Last
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Silavin
Cai clan’s father and son followed Sun Yufei into the Sun manor’s parlor.
Sun Yufei motioned for them to stop as she made a respectful bow, “Elder, the Cai clan father and son are here!”
“Let them in!”
The cold voice sent shivers down the father and son’s spines, shuffling behind Sun Yufei with the courage of a mouse.
They were about to meet a man of great power in the seven houses, a grand Profound Heaven expert. One word from him would send their heads tumbling.
They only just stepped through the door and their knees hit the floor, soon followed by their heads, “Salutations, elder. I am Cai Rong, head of the Cai clan and he is my son!”
Sun Yufei couldn’t help but frown.
She used to think Cai Xiaoting was a distinguished man of valor and pride. Only to find he had not one single bone in his back.
She was the one leading them, yet, instead of letting her make her own gesture of respect first, they cut in front of her! Then again, hardly anyone in Tianyu didn’t go on his knees when meeting an elder from the seven houses.
But this cowardice brought them to a whole new level of shameless she never saw before, earning her contempt, [I must’ve been blind to have fancied you!]
The feelings were mutual for the middle-aged men sitting in the chairs across, holding them in even worse regard.
“Ha-ha-ha, this pair knows how to choose sides!”
The voice on their left made the Cai clan father and son look. [It isn’t just one Hell Valley elder that came this time?]
What they saw was an old man with blue hair nodding at them. He was mocking, being satisfied, and flashing in his eyes gave the father-son duo a weird feeling.
“Yan Zhenglan, if you find them so capable, why not take them under Pill King Hall’s wing?” The man in the center teased.
Yan Zhenglan shook his hand and laughed, “You Laoliu, isn’t it a bit rude to push these men who came to Hell Valley? Even to an inferior clan such as theirs, credit must be given where it’s due and take them in your care. When a dog wags its tail, a master ought to throw it a pound of flesh, no?”
“What are you guys doing wasting time on these fools? Ask what we came here for and let’s get on with it! House lords’ messages could arrive any day now!”
The rude voice came from the two’s right this time. They turned cautiously and saw a stout man with a beard in a blue robe and of imposing presence.
Another Profound Heaven expert.
“Ha-ha-ha, what crawled up your ass and died?” You Laoliu dismissed him with a smile, “Lin Yuelun, among us three houses, Merry Woods’ grudge with Zhuo Fan is the smallest. So just sit tight! Maybe Zhuo Fan has already been dealt with and we won’t be doing any attacking. We’re not allowed to be here anyway!”
The other two caught his meaning and shivered a nod.
The two from the Cai clan had long been sweating buckets.
[What the hell is wrong with this world? Why are three of the Seven Noble Houses here? I only recall swearing fealty to Hell Valley, not to three of them!]
[Are we such a hot commodity that they’re fighting over us? Ha-ha-ha, as if! Zhuo Fan! They must’ve come here for revenge!]
Cai Rong gnashed his teeth, the hatred for Zhuo Fan burning even hotter!
In this backwater place, Lei Yuting handled the intelligence of the Luo clan, while the father and son remained in the dark regarding Zhuo Fan’s exploits in the outside world.
He was smart enough to guess Zhuo Fan poked his nose where he shouldn’t to end up with two more houses on his tail.
Wasn’t that clear enough he wanted to make it hard for these two?
[Couldn’t you have offended anyone else instead of the seven houses?]
The original plan was to work from the darkness with the Sun clan for the Hell Valley and wipe out the Luo clan, presenting Windgaze City as a welcome gift. But the plan went up in smoke as Hell Valley suffered a crushing defeat instead.
[The imperial family’s Secret Pearl Order can go to hell for all I care. The eighth house is going to be the Luo clan, not my Cai clan. Why the hell should I give my life for them?]
But the arrival of Pill King Hall and Merry Woods told him their hatred for the Luo clan was no less than Hell Valley’s.
Why else would two great houses travel thousands of miles to Windgaze City, even when the imperial family had put a ban on this area?
In short, one house’s ire became three houses’ wrath.
Selling the Luo clan out might have been able to appease one house’s anger, but when there were three, even if the Luo clan was burned to the ground the remaining rage of the other two houses would be shifted onto the father and son!
After all, they were once part of the Luo clan, no?
Cai Rong was on the verge of crying! [Zhuo Fan is a genius to stir three hornet nests! What the hell did you do to offend three houses in just two years?]
The three elders didn’t know the anguish and sorrow plaguing the poor father and son, not that they cared. Yan Laoliu sipped his tea and shouted, “Cai Rong, begin by telling me of the experts hiding in the Luo clan.”
“Uh...”
Cai Rong was out of it for a second then bobbed his head, on the verge of hugging their legs and begging for mercy. As for getting rewarded for his merit, that was long forgotten.
“Elders, the Luo clan is a second rate clan at best. Only Grand Elder Lei Yuntian is a Profound Heaven expert, one that advanced two years ago. As for his goddaughter, Lei Yuting, and Captain Pang, they are all in the Bone Tempering Stage! While the Luo clan orphans, Luo Yunhai and Luo Yunchang are even weaker. The rest are inconsequential, beneath elders’ attention... “
Cai Rong blurted out as fast as he could, sometimes pausing, letting Cai Xiaoting join the explanation.
They spilled the beans on anything and everything that happened in the Luo clan over the past two years.
The three elders looked at the two somewhat awkwardly.
They all have seen their fair share of snitches but never ever someone as useless as these two. [How did they even keep their vassal clan status?]
“That’s all. We have no need to know what flowers you planted on the mountain!” Scratching his nose, You Laoliu said, “What of the four arrays? Do you know how to shut them down, or how to avoid them?”
“Zhuo Fan has set them up before his departure. We know nothing about them. Only after betraying the Luo clan, did we find out of the arrays’ existence. You have to believe me, elders...”
“Fine fine, we believe you!”
To Cai Rong’s panic, You Laoliu gestured for him to stop. How could the three elders not believe such dedicated traitors?
The elders nodded.
They had a rudimentary knowledge of the Luo clan so there was no point in asking further. Knowing how the two planted flowers behind the mountain or staking out the latrines for days on end would probably, most definitely, not reveal some groundbreaking secret. They thought.
Just as they were about to ask the two to leave, three men suddenly broke in and the elders got shocked and rushed to bow, “Greetings to the three Venerables!”
[What?! Venerables? Isn’t that a Radiant Stage expert?]
Gasping, Cai Rong brought his head even lower. He was so shocked he almost had a heart attack. Never had he entertained the notion there would be one here, much less see one in person.
The only one they ever saw was the Jade Flute Divine Sword, Fang Qiubai. That man was following the third prince, and it was clear that he had no ill intentions towards them.
While these three Venerables wouldn’t be as tolerant, killing them at a whim if they wanted to. The two didn’t shiver in fear before the elders, but were now rooted on the spot.
The Venerables couldn’t care less about ants, fixing their eyes on the elders.
“We detected three men outside Windgaze City. A Bone Tempering Stage, a Profound Heaven Stage and a 6th layer of Radiant Stage experts!” One Venerable spoke.
The elders were shocked.
[Why would such an expert come here for? Was he a friend or foe?]
“Damn! the Radiant Stage expert is heading for us!” A Venerable shouted.
Everyone was on edge right now, as even the elders broke out in sweat. A Profound Heaven expert was no different than an ant before a 6th layer Radiant Stage.
The three Venerables fixed their gazes outside this courtyard.
The atmosphere was so heavy, no breath was heard and the air grew thick. Cai Rong and his son were crawling on the ground shaking like a leaf.
If all the experts here fought with the newcomer, they would have no chance of survival!
Boom!
Shockingly, Mad Dipper, Li Jingtian slammed into the Sun clan’s yard, kicking up dust. Once it settled, his raging face was terrifying.
“A-aren’t you...”
A Venerable recognized him and pointed a trembling finger.
He didn’t get the chance to continue as Li Jingtian slapped him silly.
The Venerable was bent over as Li Jingtian shouted, “Fools, why haven’t you attacked yet?”
The others were dumbstruck.
Not caused by Li Jingtian’s booming voice, but the suddenness of his slap.
Who was this man to slap a high and mighty Radiant Stage expert, a Venerable?
Cai Rong and his son were paralyzed. Today had been an eventful day for them, to say the least.
In the span of only fifteen minutes, one stronger than the next kept popping up! It all culminated with the arrival of a Radiant Stage expert slapping a seven houses’ Venerable silly...

chapters.title: Chapter 190, I Told You to Attack that Mountain!
chapters.content:
Chapter 190, I Told You to Attack that Mountain!
All stood still as statues, not breathing, and mouth agape.
The slapped Venerable wobbled then held his swelling face. Despite the rage coursing in his veins, he chose only to give a hateful stare.
“Y-you’re that guest Venerable from Regent Estate, Mad Dipper Li Jingtian! Why are you here? Didn’t Regent Estate choose to stay out of this? More importantly, what’s the meaning of this?”
The others gasped, with Cai Rong and his son appalled.
[No wonder he dared throw his weight around, he’s from Regent Estate, the head of the seven houses. But why would the Regent Estate take an interest in this backwater city?]
[Don’t tell me. That blasted Zhuo Fan went and stepped on Regent Estate’s toes?]
Cai Rong felt woozy. [That filthy mongrel is nothing but trouble! This goes beyond only me dying, my entire clan will be uprooted!]
It suddenly hit him that even if he hadn’t sold out the Luo clan, Zhuo Fan would sooner or later have them disposed of. Two years of hard work and schemes had just gone down the drain.
Of course, Li Jingtian snapped back in a higher tone, “You have the gall to question me? If you weren’t standing around with your hands down your pants Zhuo Fan wouldn’t have sneaked through that array that even my soul sense can’t penetrate!”
“What, Zhuo Fan escaped from six Profound Heaven experts and yourself? You’re saying he’s back? Why haven’t we noticed then?” Another Venerable cried out.
Li Jingtian stared him down, before giving him a resounding slap as well, “Be quiet, or people might think you’re an idiot!”
They were all too shocked to even speak.
Elder Li was just as the rumor painted him to be, a Mad Dipper and had an even worse temper. Especially now that a Bone Tempering cultivator like Zhuo Fan actually slipped through his fingers. Opening one’s mouth now would only make one a target.
[And you went ahead and pointed out his failure. No wonder you got slapped!]
What they didn’t stop to think about, however, was that all of this was part of Zhuo Fan’s cunning plan.
Looking at it from a different angle, Li Jingtian’s sudden arrival in Windgaze City was full of warning signs. Putting aside the fact that Zhuo Fan slipped past a 6th layer Radiant Stage expert like Li Jingtian and returned to Blackwind Mountain, and not even the three Radiant Stage experts felt him. There was clearly something off about this.
In spite of all the glaring faults, Li Jingtian’s venting scared all these suspicions away from their minds. It devolved into taking Li Jingtian’s words as solid gold.
This way, Zhuo Fan had them all follow Li Jingtian into his trap.
“Every abled body is to follow my lead and attack that mountain!” Li Jingtian barked as his cold eyes swept them.
The three Venerables hesitated with a frown, “Elder Li, we have yet to get word from the house lords. We can’t...”
“Cut the crap! Why have the three of them sent you here if not to get that damn Luo clan?”
And Li Jingtian emphasized with another resounding slap, “I am here, so why are you still frickin’ hesitating? I told you to attack that mountain! Do it, and you’ll gain merit for it. Don’t...”
Li Jingtian snorted twice for good measure and flew at Blackwind Mountain.
The three slapped Venerables looked at each other in consternation. They finally gnashed their teeth and followed.
Their reticence was about Regent Estate using the three houses to test the imperial family’s limit. So, the Regent Estate had sent two of their elders to kill Zhuo Fan and not a single one of their men to Windgaze City. It was the same as saying, they had no hand in this if it went belly up.
So, the three Venerables were awaiting their house lords’ orders.
But now, Li Jingtian came, who represented Regent Estate. Since he dared to attack, they had to follow. At worst, the Regent Estate would be leading the charge. This sounded like a solid plan to the three.
As they only had their house’s benefits in mind, they chose to put all the discrepancies aside.
For example, they clearly sensed two more people with Li Jingtian before. They had questions like: ‘Who were they? And if he chased Zhuo Fan all the way here, why was one of them in the Bone Tempering stage?’
However, they chose to ignore all these important and obvious issues. Or more aptly put, they’d never speak up even if they did come to mind. Afterall, were Li Jingtian’s slaps so refreshing that they wanted more?
This way, the three cowardly Venerable came aboard Li Jingtian’s rocky ship.
On the three elders’ side, they could only laugh bitterly and follow as well. Now that their Venerables joined the front, they had no excuse not to!
The only ones left were three people, Cai clan’s father and son, as well as Sun Yufei.
Cai Rong sighed as he followed the experts fly away, “Today opened my eyes. I’ve never seen so many Radiant Stage experts in one place before, and even a Venerable from the great Regent Estate is here. One stronger than the last. Even those three Profound Heaven elders were naught but ants before the four experts.”
“Humph, look who’s talking! Who was it that was shaking in fear earlier?” Sun Yufei made her contempt known.
Cai Xiaoting was annoyed, “Sister Yufei, Cai clan has always been on friendly terms with the Sun clan. Why are you suddenly so antagonistic towards my father?”
“Humph, you’re no different either. A deadbeat!”
“You...” Cai Xiaoting’s face was aflame from rage, his knuckles white. It was obvious he couldn’t put a lid on his anger and wanted to take this former goddess of his down a peg.
But a sudden sound made Sun Clan Head’s arrival known. He turned his attention from the big hole made from Li Jingtian’s landing to the empty yard, “What happened? Where are the elders?”
Sun Yufei chose to ignore Cai Xiaoting and explained to Sun Clan Head what happened.
Sun Clan Head grabbed Sun Yufei and livened his step, “Yufei, we’re going to Blackwind Mountain!”
“Whatever for?” Sun Yufei was stunned.
“Foolish girl, it’s to cheer on the elders and Venerables, of course!” Sun Clan Head laughed, “Remember, if you want any of them to notice you, you have to put on a decent show!”
Cai Rong raised an eyebrow and dragged his son along as well.
“Dad, are we...”
“As if! The Sun clan lorded over us all because they had a relative in Hell Valley. With three elders and four houses Venerables here fighting, it is our best chance at making ties with one of them. the Sun clan had Hell Valley’s backing and, who knows, we might get Regent Estate as a sponsor! We’ll see then how tough they’ll act around us!”
Cai Xiaoting nodded fiercely, “Dad, you’re right. Will that Sun bitch dare look down on me then?”
Cai Xiaoting felt himself filled with the desire to fight, putting more power in his legs and going faster than even his dad.
Cai Rong relaxed seeing him, [My child is all grown up!]
This way, the two clans outdid themselves in kissing the asses of the four houses. They were afraid these backers of theirs might get snatched by someone else...
Inside Blackwind Mountain’s hall, a pale Luo Yunchang sat cross-legged. She had worked hard in her cultivation these last two years but she was still only a peak Qi Condensation cultivator.
For one person to sustain four large arrays day in day out was a heavy burden!
Next to her was Lei Yuntian, as well as Captain Pang and some others. Seeing their usually healthy and energetic young miss now looking haggard, pain laced their hearts.
“Young miss, please take a rest. They arrived in Windgaze City for a month now and still have not attacked. There shouldn’t be a problem if you take a breather.” Captain Pang’s face was filled with black energy as his aura leaked without realizing it. Yet, even so, tears welled in his fierce eyes.
Smiling slightly, Luo Yunchang’s lips seemed pale, yet her smile ever bright, “Sister Lei is still hard at work with scouting right? The enemy has at least three Profound Heaven experts, along with even stronger people among them. All our attempts to find out more about their side have proved fruitless. I’m afraid if they chose to attack, we might not even have the time to activate the array.”
“Girl, you can’t keep this up for much longer!” Lei Yuntian sighed, “It’s all my fault for being powerless and letting you suffer like this. For a girl to shoulder the defense of a clan when disaster strikes, makes me realize how useless this Grand Elder is!”
“Uncle Lei, don’t beat yourself up. You and Captain Pang, along with sister Lei, have worked tirelessly for the Luo clan to thrive. I couldn’t do anything to help you up till now. So allow me to at least do this for our clan. Luo clan is my home, and you are part of it. I saw it laid to ruin once, and I’m not going to stand by and see it happen again... “
Luo Yunchang’s sad tone had them all sighing.
Luo Yunhai looked at his sister, “If only bro Zhuo was here, it would’ve all been fine. He always had a way out of any crisis!”
The eyes of the others trembled and softened.
Lei Yuting bit her lip in, “This damn brat, kicked up a storm for us and still hasn’t come back. He must be living it up out there!”
“Sister Lei, don’t say that. Zhuo Fan must be rushing over as we speak!” Luo Yunchang frowned slightly, “We must defend our clan and await his return!”
“Yunchang, he is actually...”
Captain Pang’s scowl and the shaking of the head had Lei Yuting swallow her words. She had been in charge of intelligence for the Luo clan and knew fully well of Zhuo Fan’s love life, but refrained from sharing it with Luo Yunchang.
Luo Yunchang looked puzzled.
“Ah!” she cried out.
“What’s wrong?” The others were frantic.
Luo Yunchang’s brows quivered as her eyes revealed shock, “I lost control over the Poison Dragon Array in the East...”
[[What?!]]
Everyone’s hearts were in their throats...

chapters.title: Chapter 191, Stand as One
chapters.content:
Chapter 191, Stand as One
Whoosh~
Four figures flashed before Blackwind Mountain, Li Jingtian and the three Venerables.
They watched four pillars of different light shoot into the sky. The four mists wrapped the mountain so closely the four could only sigh when their attempt at scanning it was futile.
“I am amazed to see such intricate arrays in such a place. It may very well be better than the guarding arrays of our houses. It’s hard to imagine how a third rate clan would know such skill!” One Venerable sighed.
The others did the same, including Li Jingtian, but he did it out of excitement.
Why wouldn’t he, when this was his new patron?
With another sound, Yan Laoliu, Yan Zhenglan, and Lin Rufeng arrived as well.
Seeing as all joined the war effort, Li Jingtian pointed at the Poison Dragon Array, “You three elders, go deal with that array. The Venerables are with me!”
Li Jingtian flew into the Blackflame Array in the South. The Venerables only shrugged before going after him.
As for the elders, they had even less right to complain, especially when the Venerables complied. And since he was a Regent Estate’s Venerable, the aftermath would fall on him anyway.
They entered the array but had complete disregard for safety.
“Humph, a 5th-grade array can’t stop a Profound Heaven expert, least of all four Venerables!” You Laoliu mocked as they entered the Poison Dragon Array.
“Damn!”
On Blackwind Mountain’s hall, Luo Yunchang jumped to her feet and made the others grow nervous, “What happened?”
Luo Yunchang took a deep breath to calm down, “Four experts entered the Blackflame Array in the South! They only just entered it and the array is on the verge of collapse!”
What?!
The others gnashed their teeth with sinking hearts.
And before Luo Yunchang even realized, the Poison Dragon Array got out of her control as well. It was most likely broken through. And now that there were four even stronger enemies going into Blackflame Array, Blackwind Mountain would soon be flattened.
“Let me go meet them!”
Lei Yuntian couldn’t just sit around doing nothing and rushed outside. Luo Yunchang cried behind him, “Uncle Lei, I can’t see how strong the four are even as they are in the array. They may be beyond the Profound Heaven Stage. You are not their match!”
Lei Yuntian faltered for a second, then he stepped firmly. He vanished soon after, but not before saying, “Luo clan almost perished because of me. Now it is time I pay that debt with my life. Run, I will hold them off!”
The others looked down, their hearts forlorn. They knew of the guilt plaguing Lei Yuntian. He gave his all these past two years and was now going to his doom, just so he could protect the Luo siblings.
“Ha-ha-ha, Elder Lei, since when can one man hold back so many? Allow me to join you.” Captain Pang laughed, following after him.
“Captain Pang...” Tears welled in Luo Yunchang’s eyes.
Grinning, Captain Pang laughed emboldened, “Elder Lei can sacrifice himself for the Luo clan after being here for only two years. But I, who had been living in the Luo clan’s grace for my entire life, can’t? If only I could see my brother one last time...”
Lei Yuting patted Luo Yunchang’s shoulder. The latter looked at her with a grim look and a bad feeling, “Sister Lei, you don’t mean...”
Nodding, Lei Yuting smiled faintly, “I am immensely grateful for godfather’s kindness. I can’t let him die alone! Just... ha-ha-ha, Yunchang, do me a favor and give that brat two slaps for me. That’s what he deserves for not returning to send me off to my death!”
And, Lei Yuting left for Blackflame Array. Despite how desolate she looked and unreconciled, perhaps not seeing that man one last time weighed heavier than she realized...
Seeing everyone vanish into the mist, Luo Yunchang’s eyes grew hazy from tears. Her brother spoke, “Sister, are they giving their lives for us?”
Nodding, two trails of tears slowly formed down her cheeks.
Luo Yunchang hugged Luo Yunhai as she whispered, “Yunhai, we may not have a dad, but we still have a home. They are our family. Look for brother Zhuo when you’re out. He will definitely protect you!”
“Sister, what about you?” Luo Yunhai blinked puzzled.
With a poignant smile, Luo Yunchang added, “Yunhai, do you remember the teachings of our ancestors?”
“Of course, steadfast and righteous!”
“We cannot let their sacrifice be in vain! But I will have to stay and control the arrays to help them!” With unyielding resolve, Luo Yunchang pushed Luo Yunhai away as she rushed to her duty.
“Sister!” Luo Yunhai wailed.
Luo Yunchang didn’t look back, only spoke, “Go find Zhuo Fan...”
Inside the Blackflame Array, Li Jingtian’s group saw the infernal black flames capable of gnawing bones sped towards them.
Since they were Radiant Stage experts, a flick of the wrist repelled such a meager attack.
Flooded by endless flames, they could only sigh.
“Such a rare 5th-grade array, with incredible power as well. A pity the user’s control is weak, unable to bring out even 1% of its potential. Or even the four might’ve had a hard time getting through!”
A Venerable sighed a node. He was glad the enemy lacked a true expert! If these four 5th-grade arrays each had a Radiant Stage expert controlling them, Blackwind Mountain would’ve been a steel fortress.
Not even Regent Estate’s experts could push through that.
Hum~
A sudden ripple passed and they looked at the source to see Lei Yuntian coming closer.
“Who’s there?” A Venerable shouted.
Snorting, Lei Yuntian barked, “Luo clan’s Grand Elder, Lei Yuntian!”
“Eh, he’s a Grand Elder?”
Raising an eyebrow, they looked at each other and burst out laughing. A Grand Elder was usually the clan’s strongest elder. But it was obvious from a mile away that Lei Yuntian just entered Profound Heaven stage.
[What Grand Elder? Humph, Luo clan is nothing but a third rate clan, or a second rate at best. There’s no one strong in it at all!]
It was so weak that it wasn’t worthy of the four Venerables’ intervention. They were only sent here because of the four arrays.
Li Jingtian blinked. To him, the Luo clan ought to be an obscure clan that was stronger than even the seven houses.
[Why does the clan have a freak like Zhuo Fan, but its elder is so...]
Then it hit him and secretly laughed. A 5th layer of Bone Tempering cultivator like Zhuo Fan managed to kill six Profound Heaven experts and escape unscathed.
[This elder is only in the 1st layer of Profound Heaven Stage, but he can kill a Radiant Stage expert, no?]
[With the steward a monster, the elder has to be at least a freak.]
Snickering, he patted a Venerable’s shoulder and pointed at Lei Yuntian, “Go and shut this geezer’s trap.”
“He-he-he, Elder Li, it will be my pleasure!” Bowed and swung a fist straight for Lei Yuntian.
Li Jingtian snorted, [You moron, don’t let Luo clan’s cultivation fool you or you won’t even know what killed you.]
Since Zhuo Fan was a freak, then the entire Luo clan had to be a den of freaks.
And yet, reality was such a letdown!
Boom!
Lei Yuntian raised his hand in defense but the light blow had him sprawled on the ground and coughing blood.
Wide-eyed, Li Jingtian’s smile froze on his face. [What kind of Grand Elder are you if you’re not a freak level, at the minimum?]
Zhuo Fan had stressed time and time again to look after the Luo clan’s members. But this martial fanatic heard this old guy was a Grand Elder and it got to his head, thinking the old guy’s power was through the roof.
When in fact, the old man was just as his cultivation stated, a common Profound Heaven expert, unlike the excessive Zhuo Fan.
Li Jingtian’s face darkened.
How was he going to explain this to Zhuo Fan? Was his promise worth nothing?
“He-he-he, I didn’t even warm up yet and you’re already dying? So weak! If not for this array limiting my senses, I wouldn’t have wasted time with you and dirty my hand!” The Venerable wiped his hand.
He had the power to kill Lei Yuntian in one hit, but it was obvious he liked to play with his prey. Such humiliation had Lei Yuntian spit more blood.
Whoosh!
A sudden black figure flashed before Lei Yuntian. Lei Yuntian cried, “Captain Pang!”
Grinning, Captain Pang shouted, “When enemies storm the gates, when home is in peril, it is the captain of the guards’ duty to defend it. How can I let Elder Lei do it alone?”
“Me as well!” Lei Yuting flitted next to him.
Lei Yuntian was moved, while the Venerable snickered, “Humph, you’re not even in the Profound Heaven Stage. You just came here to die!”
“Humph, we’ll make sure you taste hell before we do!”
The sudden shout had the blackfire form eight dragons and charge at the Venerable.
He had no time to react as he was engulfed in flames.
It was also then that Luo Yunchang appeared...

chapters.title: Chapter 192, Snare
chapters.content:
Chapter 192, Snare
“Young miss, what are you doing here?”
They looked shocked as she appeared and started going through gestures.
Luo Yunchang smiled, “We are a family. We live together, we die together!”
They all trembled and felt immense gratitude. It was worth dying for a clan that valued them so.
“But what of Yunhai?” Lei Yuntian staggered to his feet with a pale face.
Bitterness flooded Luo Yunchang’s face, but soon replaced it with a smile, “It’s fine. He’s grown up now, almost entering the Qi Condensation Stage. I had him go look for Zhuo Fan. He will be safe with him.”
Luo Yunchang may have said so, but anyone could see it worried her still.
Sighing, the others began worrying as well. Luo Yunhai was but a child. Searching the empire for Zhuo Fan was fine as long as he did find him. But in this world, danger lurked at every turn.
“Ha-ha-ha, are you guys talking about that brat?”
A cackling came from the blackfire pyre. With a boom, the flames were repelled and the Venerable walked forward.
“Humph, your steward dared to kill 7th elder and has been sentenced to death. No matter where he runs, we’ll be close behind him! As for you, Luo clan, you have committed a heinous crime for bringing such evil into this world. Not one shall be spared. I will find even that kid of yours and grind his bones to dust!”
“You won’t even spare a child?” Luo Yunchang gnashed her teeth.
The Venerable snickered, “Not even if he is a baby. I will kill him where he stands, without the slightest hesitation!”
Luo Yunchang was enraged as she clenched her hands.
Then, a sudden childish voice came, “You don’t need to look. I’m right here!”
The others looked in shock at the speaker, “Yunhai, what are you doing here?”
Beaming a wide smile, Luo Yunhai spoke with unbending courage, “Sister, our Luo clan’s ancestors taught us to be steadfast and righteous. I cannot let you throw your lives away just so that I alone may live!”
Hearts stirring, his clansmen looked at Luo Yunhai with an indescribable look. Even Li Jingtian had to sigh in the end.
Luo clan was admirable, maybe not the strongest by far, but they had loyalty first and foremost!
[I was wrong. Was this what Steward Zhuo meant when he said this clan was the best in the world?]
Li Jingtian sighed. But even now, he misunderstood what Zhuo Fan meant. There was no way a Demonic Emperor like Zhuo Fan would value affection.
The meaning of his words were: [Wherever I am, that place is the strongest!]
But that was all unimportant. Here and now, Li Jingtian didn’t join Zhuo Fan’s gang because he was forced, but from seeing the Luo clan’s spirit. He felt that the Luo clan of now, was far better than the seven houses...
“Ha-ha-ha, since all of Luo clan is here, then allow me to send you off, permanently.” With a mad cackle, the Venerable’s eyes flashed with bloodthirst, while the other two behind snickered.
Luo Yunchang’s heart was ready for battle, “If you want my brother, you’ll have to go through me!”
Luo Yunchang’s hands moved.
The blackfire started swirling like a tornado, with that Venerable at its center. She clearly wanted to swallow him in a sea of flames.
“Blackfire Storm!”
And yet, the Venerable was standing there with an unphased look as he waited for the blackfire to storm him from all directions.
Then, a soul ripple echoed out, extinguishing the blackfire into nothing.
Luo Yunchang was forced to spit blood, under the anxiousness of her clansmen.
Snorting, the Venerable mocked, “This 5th-grade array of yours is pretty good. Too bad, your cultivation is too low. You’re not even a Bone Tempering cultivator and your control is sorely lacking. But now, you no longer have time for regrets, for I am here to send you on your last journey!”
The Venerable stretched his hand, making Captain Pang and the rest tense to take the brunt of the attack. He knew very well how fruitless it all was, yet, he still wanted to uphold his duty until the very last moment.
Suddenly, there were two groans and the Venerable’s movement slacked. He turned his head in inconceivable shock. Luo Yunchang was also wide-eyed.
Their eyes reflected two blood-red fists coming out of two people’s chests.
The two Venerables in the back were still laid back in enjoying the drama. They were just about to witness the end of the Luo clan when they suddenly felt their life ebbing from their chests.
Jerkingly turning their heads back, their eyes reflected the cold and unfeeling face of Li Jingtian.
“E-Elder Li, wh....”
“The dead don’t need to know!” Snorting, Li Jingtian flicked his hands and the two Venerable fell in pieces. The blackfire soon engulfed them and ground them to ashes.
Gasping from shock, the last Venerable was filled with suspicion. [Why is this Regent Estate’s Venerable killing us?]
[I don’t remember any of our houses having offended Regent Estate!]
But the truth was laid out right in front of him. Not only did Li Jingtian murder them, he had planned to do so for the very beginning. After all, no matter how strong he was, it was impossible for him to kill two masters of that cultivation level in an instant. Such a task can only be accomplished by a sneak attack!
“E-Elder Li, what is the meaning of this?” The last Venerable ignored the Luo clan and cautiously sizing up Li Jingtian. The cold and meticulousness of his sudden strike had him filled with dread. It came without warning.
Snapping his eyes on the Venerable, Li Jingtian snorted, “Fool, are you that thick in the head? You’ve been had, duped, strung along. Need I say more?”
“What?!”
The Venerable was overwhelmed but had no time to make sense of anything. Li Jingtian was out to get him and if he didn’t run now, his end was certain.
He, a 3rd layer of Radiant Stage cultivator, could flaunt his strength before the Luo clan, but that fell through the instant he faced Li Jingtian, a 6th layer of Radiant Stage body cultivator.
It wouldn’t take even five exchanges before he’d splatter the ground with his blood.
Thankfully, their cultivations weren’t that far apart and Li Jingtian could do nothing to stop him from running.
No sooner thought than done, he bolted to escape the array while Li Jingtian was calmly making hand signs.
Suddenly, Luo Yunchang cried as she felt her control over the Blackflame Array wrested from her grip.
The Blackflame Array roared to life like an erupting volcano, forming firewalls to box everyone in. The Venerable didn’t fly far as the firewalls forced him to retreat.
When he looked intently, he was scared out of his mind!
The Blackflame Array was suddenly used to its full power. If before there were only some tongues of blackfire around, now, there was a sea of lava in every direction.
Not even a Radiant Stage expert had hope of getting out now. If just a spark touched him, he’d be soon nothing more than a charred corpse.
Shivering from fear, he turned his head to see Li Jingtian making signs. The Venerable stammered, “E-Elder Li, why do you know how to use the array?”
The same question was on Luo Yunchang’s mind as well.
Snickering, Li Jingtian’s eyes flashed with bloodthirst, “Moron, I told you already! You’ve been had! I thought of drawing you into the array then trap you here. He-he-he, didn’t you find it odd how the array was so weak? But with me in control, don’t you find it strong? He-he-he, let me clue you in. I’m with the Luo clan. Steward Zhuo Fan himself invited me into the Luo clan as its elder!”
[What?!]
This was shocking news to any who heard it, but the Venerable went pale from fright.
Luo Yunchang’s group was floored, finding it impossible to believe such a miracle had graced them.
Zhuo Fan went to recruit experts. He said so just before leaving two years ago. But who’d ever expect it would be one of such caliber?
Heavens, this Radiant Stage expert shot the Luo clan from a mere clan, all the way into the rank of a house. Their shock was completely and utterly understandable...
...
In another location, the three elders entered the Poison Dragon Array and already felt the miasma growing thick. Yan Zhenglan pulled out some pills, “This is a Poison Repelling Pill for each of you!”
They all took one and kept an ever-watchful eye on the surroundings.
Then, two figures entered their sights. One was around forty, with black hair and a black beard. None of the three recognized him. Only Yan Zhenglan had a nagging feeling of deja vu.
The other person was but a Bone Tempering Stage youth.
They were startled instantly as they took out the Hell Kill Order. [It’s him, Demon Archon Zhuo Fan!]
Zhuo Fan seemed as if only now discovered the trio and clapped in laughter, “Ha-ha-ha, everyone’s finally here. I’ve been waiting!”
Faces dark, the elders felt bitter.
They knew of the havoc he stirred in Drifting Flowers City, killing three experts and ruining another’s hand. They had no hope of winning, not to mention, they were in his array.
[Blast it! The Venerables should be meeting this punk, not us! Why did it have to be us? I knew I should’ve picked another array!]
They felt close to tears as they pinned their final hopes on having the four Radiant Stage experts hurrying with breaking through the array and coming over to help.
Like that’ll ever happen! Out of their knowledge, the four had long fallen in Zhuo Fan’s trap, with two already dead and the last one making one last ditch effort before succumbing as well.
They were having a hard time saving themselves, yet, they were putting their meager hope on someone in an even worse state than them...

chapters.title: Chapter 193, Vicious Pill King’s Reemergence
chapters.content:
Chapter 193, Vicious Pill King’s Reemergence
Zhuo Fan easily picked on the three’s thoughts and jeered, “You should all lighten up and be thankful that all of you are unworthy of me ending you personally. Not with your meager strength. The one all of you shall have the honor of facing is our Pill House Elder!”
Zhuo Fan patted the elder’s shoulder, “Elder Yan, they’re all yours!”
“Ha-ha-ha, don’t worry Steward Zhuo, these old goats are nobodies. I’m more than enough for them!” Yan Song laughed, bringing out the old Vicious Pill King’s haughty demeanor back out.
Zhuo Fan nodded and chuckled before leaving.
The three elders’ faces were pitch black. As the saying went, ‘death before dishonor’.
Even though they were all far beneath Zhuo Fan’s match, his utter disregard of them had their minds filled with nothing but rage.
By the way, who was this cocky uncle Zhuo Fan left them with? [We don’t know what hole you crawl out of, nor do we care, but who do you think you are to talk to us like that? Zhuo Fan?]
The three stared daggers at Yan Song. The latter was quite relaxed and confident.
“Old coot, state your name. I do not kill without knowing my opponent’s name!” You Laoliu coldly stated. The other two watched Yan Song with the same desire, to rip him apart.
Grinning, Yan Song’s eyes glinted evilly, “Humph, I’m afraid of making you wet your pants if I do!”
“Oh? Do enlighten us please as to what other circus clown the third rate Luo clan has besides your freak, Zhuo Fan. Ha-ha-ha... “
The three’s laughter dripped sarcasm.
Squinting, Yan Song’s mouth curled in pride, “Then unclog your ears and prepare to be amazed. I am Yan Song!”
[What?!]
The three were dumbstruck, with bulging eyes and everything. Especially Pill King Hall’s Yan Zhenglan. His eyes were as big as saucers.
They all knew Yan Song fell at the hands of Zhuo Fan in the chaos of Drifting Flowers City. How the hell did he end up here, and as Luo clan’s Pill House Elder no less?
When Yan Zhenglan and Lin Rufeng came from their stupor, they looked at Yan Zhenglan. He was the only one here who was most familiar with Yan Song, being from the same house and all.
He should spot immediately if that man was the real Vicious Pill King.
After a long and hard scrutiny, Yan Zhenglan gasped, “Vicious Pill King, Elder Yan Song! It’s really you!”
You Laoliu’s heart trembled and his face grew solemn.
[No wonder this geezer mocked us.] While he was known as the Vicious Pill King, they were truly and utterly titleless.
“Why, Yan Song? Why did you betray Pill King Hall!?” Yan Zhenglan shouted.
Yan Song had only mockery for him, “Vicious Pill King had followed the natural course and died in Drifting Flowers City from Zhuo Fan. And from his death, Yan Song was reborn. Tell me, where’s the betrayal? Besides, with me out of the picture, isn’t the Vicious Pill King title up for grabs? Humph, I’m not naive. Don’t tell me the Pill King Hall didn’t break out in celebration once they heard of my death.”
Yan Zhenglan stammered in silence.
From his reaction, the others knew Yan Song told the truth. No wonder he betrayed Pill King Hall, he had nothing holding him there, no relation to speak of.
Scratching their nose, the elders’ eyes exposed a fierce light.
With everything clear, any argument from them would do nothing in bringing Yan Song back. In that case, they had to go through Yan Song if they wanted to clear the array.
But Yan Song’s old title still gripped their hearts in fear.
“Old Yan is an expert in poisons. It is my domain as well. I will hold him, while you two flank him from the sides. We have to end this swiftly. It will be hard to get to him once he hides behind his Rainbow Cloud Palm!”
Yan Zhenglan signaled the two as he whispered. The two nodded.
Yan Zhenglan then shot like an arrow for Yan Song with an outstretched palm.
A python made of purple miasma came out and threatened to bite Yan Song.
“High spirit ranked martial art, Shifting Cloud Palm!”
His mouth tracing a cold smile, Yan Zhenglan mocked, “Humph, Yan Zhenglan, an inept like you who can’t use the Rainbow Cloud Palm dares to play with poison around me?”
Seven colored veils of mist flew from Yan Song’s palms like dragons, forming a rainbow storm crushing the purple python and rushing for Yan Zhenglan.
“Humph, now, this is Pill King Hall’s real skill, profound ranked martial art, Rainbow Cloud Palm!”
Yan Zhenglan focus sharpened and forehead started to ooze cold sweat. However, he was in no rush because he knew that he was going to be sacrificing himself.
Suddenly, You Laoliu and Lin Rufeng appeared left and right of Yan Song. Yan Zhenglan laughed, “Yan Song, you’re done for! You’re exposed before you hide in the Rainbow Cloud Palm’s poisonous mist. I may not train in your martial art, but I know it like the back of my hand. And you will suffer dearly for it!”
You Laoliu and Lin Rufeng had vicious grins, thinking this win was in the bag.
When the grand Vicious Pill King fall under their attacks, who would anyone dare call them without a title in the future?
Although, Yan Song’s face didn’t seem particularly worried. As the two’s palms inched closer, he made a hand sign and two dragon roars echoed out!
Suddenly, two groans came as two dragon tails jumped from the earth and sent the two men barreling. You Laoliu and Lin Rufeng were still trying to make sense of everything. They were just inches from striking down Yan Song when out of the blue, their bodies were flung about like garbage.
Just as they smacked the ground two hundred meters out, the rainbow storm engulfed Yan Zhenglan.
Boom!
Yan Zhenglan flew a full hundred meters as he spat black blood. His body was now filled with the deadly poisons of the Rainbow Cloud Palm.
You Laoliu and Lin Rufeng crawled back to their feet. They felt weary for some odd reason and looked down in shock. The green vestige on their body was evidence of poisoning.
“How?” The three roared at the same time.
Yan Song snickered with an evil glint in his eye, “Yan Zhenglan, you aren’t useful even as bait! You take me for a sitting duck if I’m not hiding in the Rainbow Cloud Palm mist? He-he-he, did you forget where we are? This here is a 5th-grade array, the Poison Dragon Array that I am able to control! Here, I can create all the poison mist I want. Your plan failed the moment you thought it out!”
Yan Song made another sign.
Roar!
Seven dragon roars were heard as seven hundred-meter-long dragons of different colors came from beneath his feet. Their maws were open and the poisonous stench was easily felt coming from their fangs.
If not crushed to death in their grip first, the poison would rip them apart from the inside out!
The three cried in alarm.
Yan Song alone was bad enough with his nefarious poison, but now, with this 5th-grade array, he was invincible.
Not even a Radiant Stage expert could escape him, least of all them!
The three’s hearts sank as despair set in.
Yan Song cackled like mad, just as he did back in the Drifting Flowers City. That rampant Vicious Pill King was back.
Yan Song’s ego even grew, if that was possible. Because he had the 5th-grade array, he was god. [Not even a Radiant Stage expert can take me on! Ha-ha-ha...]
...
In another place, Sun clan’s father and daughter along with Cai clan’s father and son finally came to Blackwind Mountain. Since flying was not an option, they had to rely on their tiny legs to run themselves into exhaustion.
But as they gazed upon the four light pillars, hope glimmered in their eyes.
“Cough, cough, congratulations 6th elder for your complete success!” Sun Clan Head panted then cupped his hands and bent his wais ninety degrees down angle.
Sun Yufei felt awkward, “Father, there’s no one here. What are you doing?”
“Ha-ha-ha, foolish girl, the elders are cleaning up the Luo clan and would surely gain many contributions for this. As those experts move fast, I fear that my nerves may get to me when the time comes to congratulate them and my manners would slip. It’s best I practice my performance for when it counts!”
Sun Clan Head smiled, “Yufei, let’s do it together for a brighter future!”
Sun Yufei’s mouth twisted in revulsion.
“Congratulations, Elder Li, in returning victorious!”
Suddenly, Cai Rong bowed as well as he mocked Sun Clan Head, “If you want a sponsor, you have to think big. Elder Li is a Regent Estate Venerable. Everything will be ours once we earn his favor!”
“He-he-he, Xiaoting, practice along!” Cai Rong patted Cai Xiaoting’s shoulder. A chip of the ol’ block, Cai Xiaoting’s gesture was spot on like his father’s. Sun Yufei felt more disgusted than ever.
Sun Clan Head sneered, “Cai Clan Head, you sure are ignorant! But what can you expect when you haven’t been in touch with the seven houses and know nothing about them. A Venerable may be strong, but they ignore house affairs. Only elders hold the true power in a house.
“Your ass-kissing has more worth directed at an elder. They are the ones who can make you a vassal clan!” Sun Clan Head spoke with immense pride.
Cai Rong scowled and smoothened his beard as he sank in his thoughts.
Then, a lazy voice reached them, “Ass-kissing must be done in style. One wrong kiss and you’ll get the gallows! I mean, won’t you offend the Venerables if you only do it to elders? And if you flatter the Venerables, won’t the elders feel irritated? What a dilemma. Why not both? You may get nothing, but at least you’ll keep your heads!”
“Good point!”
Clan Head and Sun Clan Head looked at each other then bobbed their heads. Only then they reacted, [Who said that?] And turned to look.
It was better not knowing. They cried out with such fear, one may think they saw a ghost, “Z-Z-Zhuo Fan, why are you here...”

chapters.title: Chapter 194, Total Victory
chapters.content:
Chapter 194, Total Victory
Who knew when Zhuo Fan got there? Surely not them. But his seamless interjection in their discussion unnerved them all.
“Ha-ha-ha, lighten up. I’m the same as you, I came here to welcome guests!” Zhuo Fan waved the awkwardness away with a smile.
Though his smile looked dreadfully cold to the rest.
It was practically common knowledge four houses, Regent Estate included, came here explicitly for Zhuo Fan’s head. Yet, the four Venerables and the three elders were inside trying to break the arrays. All while he was standing just outside for the heck of it.
The Sun and Cai people looked at him, feeling his toying with the seven houses was worthy of applause.
Swallowing dryly, Cai Rong ventured a nervous reply, “Z-Zhuo Fan, I have always had the Luo clan’s benefit in mind in all my actions. Hear me out please, and leave quickly. If the Venerables come out, you won’t stand a chance!”
“Oh, I never knew Elder Cai would, after betraying the Luo clan, care so much for me. Ha-ha-ha, I’m touched!” Zhuo Fan raised a mocking eyebrow.
Cai Rong reddened, feeling the condescending tone, but he didn’t snap back. His reply was one of genuine concern, “Zhuo Fan, Luo clan’s misfortune has come because of you. Why did you come back? I am concerned for your wellbeing. Don’t let your talent go to waste. Quickly escape!”
Cai Rong was very concerned but still urged Zhuo Fan to leave.
Even when facing the Demon Archon, who was such a thorn in the seven houses’ side, this third rate clan’s head was filled with uncertainty. Or he’d long since captured Zhuo Fan and handed him over.
The Sun Clan Head was thinking along the same lines.
But since youths were rash as usual, their kids couldn’t see this logic. Cai Xiaoting stood with his chest out as he shouted, “Dad, he’s only a 5th layer of Bone Tempering cultivator. Why waste time and just go deal with him alongside Uncle Sun? Get his head and the seven houses will hail us as heroes, ha-ha-ha...”
“Quiet, fool! You know nothing!” Cai Rong glared at his son.
Sun Clan Head sneered as well. He didn’t know what Zhuo Fan did to get on the seven houses’ bad side but the old fox in him knew something was up.
It was best to stand down until all was made clear, lest he wanted an untimely death.
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, “Oh? Taking my head you say. That’s a good plan!”
“No no no, that was never our intention!”
Gesticulating like mad, Cai Rong was on pins and needles, “Xiaoting is a foolish child. I promise you, we aren’t your enemies. Please leave quickly. Leave before the Venerables are back!”
“Ha-ha-ha, them coming back?”
Zhuo Fan’s tone was unbridled, “I set those arrays and know them like the back of my hand. If even one man escapes, my head...”
Bam!
With a loud noise, a figure flew from Poison Dragon Array, so poisoned that his body had seven colors on him. His mouth was tight yet black blood kept flowing from his lips, ears, and nose.
It was hard to figure out who he was, but Cai Rong knew as he cried, “Pill King Hall’s Elder Yan!”
Zhuo Fan’s cheek twitched. He just got into his role of showing off and then, this guy had to come out just to spite him.
Fuming mad, he stepped right before Yan Zhenglan.
The fearful Elder Yan was only thinking of escaping when he found someone just ahead. But then dread set in when he saw his face, “Z-Z-Zhuo Fan?”
“How did you get here?” Zhuo Fan’s mouth trembled, but anyone could feel the coldness in his voice, the rage boiling deep within.
Yan Zhenglan shivered, “I-I took advantage of Yan Song not paying attention...”
“It would’ve been so much better if you died inside. Now, your corpse’s going to be in pieces!”
Sighing, Zhuo Fan’s Lightning Wings crackled and shifted into sickles.
Yan Zhenglan’s shock was still prevalent on his face as he fell in six pieces, soaking the ground in blood.
Sss~
Gasping, the others were shocked out of their minds.
Now, they knew why the seven houses wanted to end Zhuo Fan so desperately. A Profound Heaven expert fell apart instantly thanks to Zhuo Fan’s skill.
Even wounded, how could a Bone Tempering cultivator kill a Profound Heaven expert?
Cai Xiaoting felt weak in the knees, tumbling down. He hated himself for those brash words he spoke just now. Telling his dad to deal with this freak was the same as sending him to an early grave!
Cai Rong and Sun Clan Head were soaked in sweat.
At least, these old foxes had their wits about them from the start and weren’t rash. If they had been anything else, their meat pile would soon be joining the elder’s on the ground.
Whoosh!
Flashing before them, Zhuo Fan looked quite awkward, “Uh, just forget the last part. Alright?”
“Yep, you bet. Don’t know what you’re talking about Steward Zhuo. Ha-ha-ha...”
“Yeah, my ears must be playing tricks on me!”
The four of them shook their heads till they were dizzy. Zhuo Fan smiled.
With a second sound, another figure popped out of Poison Dragon Array, but this time, it was Vicious Pill King. He took in the pieces of Yan Zhenglan, and the cold faced Zhuo Fan, catching the gist of it all.
Scratching his head, Yan Song giggled, “Thanks, Steward Zhuo for helping me get rid of that one. It would’ve been much harder for me alone!”
“Elder Yan, you let one escape with your skill?” Zhuo Fan smiled coldly.
Yan Song’s scalp felt numb, “Steward Zhuo, I was careless. He was also an alchemist, so...”
“Elder Yan, do you have any idea what I was just about to promise these guys? A head... ha-ha-ha. So tell me, whose head is it going to be?” Ignoring his words, Zhuo Fan’s cold glare stared him down.
Shivering, Yan Song knew this time, it was serious.
Steward Zhuo was flaunting before these guys but then, his show deflated like a balloon, and so did his prestige. Of course he’d be pissed.
Swallowing dryly, Yan Song had a cruel smile for them, “Steward Zhuo, that’s easy! Isn’t it just some heads? Aren’t there four heads lining up for the taking?”
“Good point. With them dead, no one will know about your blunder!”
“Yep, yep...” Yan Song smiled and nodded.
Cai Rong’s group was scared out of their wits. They kneeled and begged forgiveness. While also cursing them inside, [What kind of damn unreasonable freaks are these people?]
What they didn’t know was this vicious demon wouldn’t have made a name for himself if he was reasonable.
Shaking his head, Zhuo Fan waved, “Forget it. Don’t scare these shrimps. Elder Yan, what of the other two?”
“Dead!” Yan Song was solemn.
Nodding, Zhuo Fan turned to the four, “Alright, take these four in. I want to leave them for that snot-nosed brat to handle. And teach him how to be a Clan Head!”
“Understood!”
Vicious Pill King pointed in finger at them and the four were chained, soon flying behind him as he entered Poison Dragon Array.
Hum~
A ripple spread and the Blackflame Array in the South opened to reveal Luo Yunchang and the rest. Li Jingtian was leisurely walking behind them.
Zhuo Fan eased a breath seeing everyone safe. The battle was now over.
“Big bro Zhuo!”
Luo Yunhai cried and skipped over for a fierce hug. His tears soaking Zhuo Fan’s clothes.
Zhuo Fan noded with a smile, feeling warm and fuzzy inside.
Looking up, he found Lei Yuntian and Captain Pang looking at him with fervent gazes. The two nodded, and Zhuo Fan laughed, “Old Pang, I’m relieved to see you still kicking!”
Captain Pang knew what he meant and laughed as well, “Steward Zhuo, if I am to die, I will do it fighting for the Luo clan. Never will I waste away in training!”
Then Zhuo Fan turned to Lei Yuting with a smile, “Miss Lei, how are the people I asked you to train?”
Lei Yuting huffed and gave him a sound slap in return.
Zhuo Fan was stunned. [What did I say?]
But then he saw her teary eyes.
“Damn you, bastard! You finally came back and instead of asking if I was fine you went straight to business?” Lei Yuting wailed.
Zhuo Fan blinked, [That does make a lot of sense.] So he smiled, “Ha-ha-ha, Miss Lei, how have you been?”
Bam!
Then another slap graced his face. Zhuo Fan was now floored. [What the hell? I asked how you are so what’s the problem? You want me to pay respects to your whole family?]
Lei Yuting glared instead, “Too little, too late!”
Reeling from the blow, Zhuo Fan was almost coughing blood at this point. [This girl’s too fickle I can’t make sense of her heart!]
The others smiled at his misfortune. Li Jingtian joined them, never having seen the cunning Steward Zhuo so soft hearted.
Shaking his head with a sigh, Zhuo Fan really couldn’t get her. [It’s best I don’t talk at all.]
When they separated, Zhuo Fan looked to see Luo Yunchang fumbling towards him with a pale face.
Zhuo Fan frowned, “Young miss, are you hurt?”
Luo Yunchang only locked eyes with him, as if to see straight through his heart. Ice cold hands touched his face, as her eyes stared at him with emotion, “Zhuo Fan, welcome home!”
Luo Yunchang’s eyes closed and collapsed in his arms.
“Young miss!” The others were worried.
Zhuo Fan stood there in a daze.
The Luo clan was considered his clan since rebirth. But he never once saw it as his home. When Luo Yunchang said those words, they struck a chord in his thawing heart...

chapters.title: Chapter 195, Mean Steward
chapters.content:
Chapter 195, Mean Steward
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Silavin
The warm glow of the morning sun spilled through the window and into the pink room. Luo Yunchang’s eyes trembled open but the glaring sun’s rays made her squint.
“Young miss Luo, are you awake?”
Luo Yunchang turned to see Lei Yuting’s servant, Xiao Cui. She was happily bringing in piping hot stew.
Luo Yunchang weakly got up, as Xiao Cui placed the bowl on a nearby table.
Luo Yunchang nodded gratefully for her help, “Xiao Cui, where’s sister Lei?”
“Miss and Steward Zhuo are in a meeting! She told me to watch over you. She also had me make this stew for you...”
“Zhuo Fan...”
She didn’t seem to have heard her as Luo Yunchang shivered having recalled something. She then broke out in a wide smile, “Yeah, he’s back. I’m going to see him!”
“Slow down, young miss Luo. You’re still very much weakened. Please have this stew first. Steward Zhuo isn’t running anywhere.”
“I don’t care. I want to see him!”
Luo Yunchang was so excited all the fatigue left her as she jumped out of bed. Xiao Cui sighed, left with following after her out of worry.
The two soon arrived before Blackwind Mountain’s hall, hearing Zhuo Fan’s familiar voice from within.
“Elder Lei, how is your cultivation?” Zhuo Fan asked as he browsed the books.
Lei Yuntian replied in disappointment, “I am muddled, and have not advanced one layer in two years. But I feel I will break through soon...”
“Muddled indeed!”
Zhuo Fan’s cold tone cut his frail tone short. But his eyes were still checking the reports, “Thought it’s not your fault. It is hard for someone as old as you to advance.”
Lei Yuntian forced an embarrassed smile. [Steward Zhuo is so blunt, not sparing any feelings.]
Lei Yuting saw her godfather put on the spot and slapped the table in anger, “Zhuo Fan, where are you going with this? While you were gone for the last two years, we had to look after the Luo clan. And now that you’re back, the first thing you do is point fingers.”
“And you!”
Zhuo Fan threw a book before her as he spoke coldly, “When I came back yesterday you said I cut straight to business instead of greeting you. That I was cold! So I spent all day catching up with what you have been doing over the years. But today, I need to resume my role as the steward!”
Snapping his eyes on her, Zhuo Fan pointed at the book, “I told you to form a shadow corp before leaving to become our hidden ace as well as our eyes and ears in Tianyu. Why is it that all you managed to contact are some small towns and some villages? You didn’t place anyone in the capital, not to mention the seven houses’ cities!”
“Humph, you think it’s that easy?” Huffed Lei Yuting, “Ten times I’ve sent people into Hell Valley’s city, but they were seized every time. Thankfully, they were loyal to us and died rather than say anything. Or Hell Valley would’ve been upon us a year ago!”
“Oh, did you not see how it’s done when I got into Drifting Flowers City?” Zhuo Fan raised a taunting eyebrow.
Lei Yuting spat through gnashed teeth, “Don’t you even start. Just when I was close to forgetting. Steward Zhuo had gone out for the glory of the clan, but never forgot to spare certain someone his feelings, quite carefree I might add! If my men had even half your skills, they would have infiltrated the whole empire by now, even the palace.”
“Uh, whatever you may think, I did it all for the clan!” Zhuo Fan scratched his nose.
Captain Pang grinned, adding his two cents to smooth things over, “Ha-ha-ha, young miss Lei misunderstands. Brother Zhuo’s thinking is unfathomable. I’m sure Brother Zhuo had a good reason for letting those rumors appear. Look, didn’t he bring back two experts like he promised?”
“And you, Old Pang!”
Zhuo Fan butted in before Lei Yuting could nag some more.
Captain Pang was startled, and swallowed drily, feeling cold sweat down his spine. Now it was his turn it seemed. None of them knew the refined Zhuo Fan, who planned to put the Luo clan back on its feet, would be so mean.
Because Captain Pang cultivated the Wraith Art, the vibe coming from him was that of a fiend. But before Zhuo Fan, he was nothing more than a mouse in front of a cat.
Although the two were like brothers, Captain Pang still shivered whenever he saw Zhuo Fan acting high and mighty. [Who knows what fault this kid will find now?]
“Uh, brother, I...”
“Done awesome!” Out of all expectations, Zhuo Fan beamed. He was happy as well, while the rest, sullen. [What did Captain Pang do that is so awesome?]
[Our efforts aren’t lower than his!]
Zhuo Fan elaborated with a grin, “When I gave you the Wraith Art I didn’t even think you’d survive. You not only survived but even exceeded my expectations.”
[Then why the hell did you give it to me then?]
Captain Pang’s face twitched, not knowing if he should be glad or enraged. [You gave it to me thinking I’d die?]
Knowing what he was thinking, Zhuo Fan patted his shoulder, “Ha-ha-ha, don’t you worry now. You are reborn as one of Luo clan’s pillars!”
Captain Pang nodded solemnly. Defending the Luo clan had been his aim all along...
Having talked with his men, Zhuo Fan looked at the small figure at the side.
The bored Luo Yunhai noticed his eyes and shivered. He felt danger in his gaze, as if a viper was out to get him.
“He-he-he, big bro Zhuo, I’m still a child. Cut me some slack!” Luo Yunhai opened his big naive eyes like an oversized kitten.
Too bad this trick didn’t fly with a Demon like Zhuo Fan.
Grinning, Zhuo Fan looked like a ghost from the Underworld, “You rotten brat, how’s your cultivation?”
[Why ask when you already know?]
Luo Yunhai felt a shiver down his spine, “Uh, big bro Zhuo, I’m in the 9th layer of Foundation Establishment. On the verge of breaking through!”
He also gave Captain Pang a sign, who added, “Steward Zhuo, young master Yunhai has only been cultivating for two years. To reach such a level is a feat worthy of a genius!”
“Oh, not bad indeed. How many hours a day did you cultivate?” Zhuo Fan nodded with a smile everpresent.
Luo Yunhai’s eyes darted around then raised six fingers, “Six hours!”
Captain Pang was startled, then nodded, “That’s right, young master Yunhai cultivated in earnest!”
“Good, then from now on you’ll do it for 20 hours a day.” Zhuo Fan’s smile was wide as ever, causing the others to gasp.
Wouldn’t the poor kid die of exhaustion training for so long?
Luo Yunhai was dumbstruck. He immediately shouted his complaints, “Big bro Zhuo, I’ll die!”
“Hardly. By feeding you pills each day, death will long be forgotten! Plus, as the days pass you’ll get used to it!” Zhuo Fan laughed.
He recalled how his master did the same for him.
His lower lip trembling, Luo Yunhai was on the verge of tears, “But that would leave me with only four hours to rest. What about playing?”
“Who told you you have four hours to rest?”
Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan added, “Two hours is enough, while the rest is for reading books! How are you going to be a Clan Head if you’re stacked in all the right places except in the head?”
Luo Yunhai’s eyes rolled into his skull and slumped in his chair.
The others sighed secretly. Zhuo Fan wasn’t mean to just them but even to children. No wonder he was called Demon Archon in the outside world.
Vicious Pill King and Li Jingtian were staying quiet, but hearing Zhuo Fan’s verdict, even they shivered.
Then they looked at Luo Yunhai with all their sympathy. [Is it a blessing, or a disaster? No one can tell.]
The cruel steward set his eyes on the poor child. He was dead set on making him the Luo clan’s next in line. Yet, his future wasn’t as glorious as any true future clan head, but one of a miserable childhood.
But with Zhuo Fan’s wicked planning and the kid’s talent, his future was bound to be limitless.
This could be counted as his only blessing.
After a few more words, Zhuo Fan told them to withdraw, leaving only Vicious Pill King and Li Jingtian behind. As for Luo Yunhai, he walked out like a zombie, feeling like the whole world abandoned him.
Such a young child was showing such despair.
Zhuo Fan ignored him as he poured himself some tea, “Young miss, since you’re already here, you might as well come in ...”

chapters.title: Chapter 196, The Four Tigers of Tianyu
chapters.content:
Chapter 196, The Four Tigers of Tianyu
With graceful steps, Luo Yunchang gestured Xiao Cui to stay as she entered alone. Her softened gaze had been on Zhuo Fan all this time.
Zhuo Fan smiled as he rose, “Young miss, are you better?”
Luo Yunchang didn’t speak, only nodded slightly.
Zhuo Fan took a deep breath out of awkwardness. He gestured to the other two and smiled, “Ha-ha-ha, let me introduce you Elder Yan Song. He will be Luo clan’s Pill House Elder. The other is Elder Li Jingtian, the elder in charge of the arrays. As long as he operates the 5th-grade arrays, no one can break through them!”
Blinking, Luo Yunchang now realized there were two more people there and rushed to greet them.
The elders returned her greeting as well.
And yet, Li Jingtian still had pride in his eyes, while Vicious Pill King was downcast.
Zhuo Fan’s face turned solemn, “Are you perhaps not satisfied?”
Vicious Pill King was the one who replied, “Steward Zhuo, the Luo clan you describe is not at all as we’ve seen! We just found out that the Luo clan has no elders and that is only around a second rate clan...” Vicious Pill King sighed.
What he thought to be a titan in hiding, stronger than the seven houses was more along the lines of a damn frickin’ third rate clan!
Li Jingtian sighed as well. He could feel the loyalty of this clan, but the reality failed to rise to his expectation, by a huge margin.
Zhuo Fan glared at them, “I never said anything about the Luo clan’s extent when I invited you in. You accepted my invitation of your own free will...”
“But Steward Zhuo, you said the Luo clan is the strongest clan in Tianyu...”
“Are you saying it’s my fault?” Zhuo Fan cut Vicious Pill King off and scared him with his sudden reply.
Luo Yunchang bowed again, “Elder Yan, Elder Li, first of all, I would like to express my deepest gratitude for joining the Luo clan. I know we are a small clan, unfit of your greatness, but please believe me, With Steward Zhuo, and you, the Luo clan will become better and stronger. We, the Luo clan will not disappoint you. If you still want to leave, I will not stop you...”
Luo Yunchang’s heartfelt words touched the two.
“You two old coots better goddamn suck it up!”
Then came Zhuo Fan’s cold tone. While Luo Yunchang’s words were that of a fairy, Zhuo Fan’s were that of a demon wanting to feast on their flesh.
“You may dislike how weak the Luo clan is, but I promise you, in five years, I will make the Luo clan rise to the level of the seven houses. And in ten years, It will exceed them! If you want to leave, hump. Getting into the Luo clan is easy, but getting out will be done through the mud, cold and very much dead!”
Shuddering, the elders could feel Zhuo Fan’s bloodthirst. Just looking at him, they knew he wasn’t kidding.
If they tested Demon Archon’s anger, today may very well be their funeral.
Sweating, Li Jingtian and Vicious Pill King dropped to one knee, “Young miss, Steward Zhuo, we were only joking. Don’t take it to heart.”
Luo Yunchang was shocked. She may be the young miss but how could she receive such gestures from the elders? Not to mention, one was in the Profound Heaven Stage and the other in the Radiant Stage.
She rushed to get them up, “Please rise elders, this isn’t proper!”
But Luo Yunchang could do nothing if they refused.
Sneaking a glance at Zhuo Fan, they noticed his ever stone-cold face and lowered their heads. He may be quite courteous to them usually, but when it came to such principles, he was dead serious.
If they couldn’t appease Zhuo Fan’s anger, their lives were forfeited today.
Luo Yunchang turned to Zhuo Fan and said, “Zhuo Fan, you...”
Squinting, Zhuo Fan spoke, “I will let this matter rest here on account of young miss. But I better not hear of this again. Now, leave!”
“Thank you, Steward Zhuo. Thank you, young miss!”
Sighing, the two bowed again and ran outside. It seemed they had to get much closer with this young miss of theirs.
She may be frail, but she could keep that steward in check. [Our very lives depend on it!]
Luo Yunchang was left stunned at how quickly the two bolted. She had no idea Zhuo Fan could control a Profound Heaven expert and a Radiant Stage expert.
The two experts were like shy kids before Zhuo Fan.
What she didn’t know was that if she could control the Bloodworm as well as he does, she’d receive the same treatment. Forget about whining, they wouldn’t even make a peep!
Turning to Zhuo Fan, Luo Yunchang revealed a broad smile, “Zhuo Fan, why do I feel you’re more amazing than two years ago? I almost can’t recognize you. But weren’t you a bit harsh on them? Sister Lei and the others worked hard all this time...”
“I know, and I am very pleased with their progress. They gave their all and exceeded my expectations!” Zhuo Fan’s smile was no longer cruel.
Luo Yunchang was even more puzzled now, “Then why did you...”
