“Ha-ha-ha, as leaders, one must mind both gratitude and show of power! I know how grateful you must have been for their hard work, so when I came back I showed them power! How else would they know who is the leader of the Luo clan?” Zhuo Fan’s eyes were deep.
Luo Yunchang hesitated, “But they are family, going through thick and thin alongside us. Must we be so hard on them?”
“People change with time. If your power does not change, then you must be wary of everyone around you! Today, they may be your most loyal men, and tomorrow, your worst enemies. Just like how the seven houses were subjects to the empire at its founding, now they are a danger to it!”
Zhuo Fan grinned with cruelty. Luo Yunchang watched him long and stammered, “Zhuo Fan, you’re truly frightening. Will there also be a day when you’ll become our enemy?”
“Perhaps!” Zhuo Fan chuckled.
“I would rather die at your hand than see you as one!” Luo Yunchang’s eyes flickered.
Zhuo Fan trembled and sighed, “Who can tell what the future holds?”
Silence swept the hall, bringing a morbid atmosphere with it.
It was now that Luo Yunhai rushed in tears to Luo Yunchang, “Sister, that’s not important right now. Big bro Zhuo wants to kill me! Resting for only two hours is impossible...”
Startled, Luo Yunchang recalled how her brother was the most hardworking of them all, “Steward Zhuo, don’t you think twenty hours a day is a bit...”
“You don’t have to say it, young miss, I am doing it for his own good. A bit of sweat now will save a lot of bloodshed later! Or you can just stop him from following the wishes of your father...”
“Yunhai, stop complaining and follow Steward Zhuo’s schedule!” Luo Yunchang snapped at the child.
Luo Yunhai’s eyes rolled into his skull and passed out.
Before Zhuo Fan came, his life was still bearable. Now that he was here, he entered hell.
Zhuo Fan shook his head...
Meanwhile, at the foot of Blackwind Mountain, four tall and stout figures stood.
One was in a blue robe and cowl, with a twin mustache, and holding a light sword.
Another wore a scholar crest and waved a golden fan. His eyes were so calm as if even the world burning wouldn’t affect his tranquility.
The third man was brash and big, with fiery hair and eyes holding sparks within. One look was enough to tell anyone he was a powder keg primed to blow.
As for the last, he was unlike the first three. He was twice as broad as a normal man. From his bulging muscles, one would instantly consider him a body cultivator. Yet his narrow eyes were quite delicate. Standing there, he looked no different than a firm mountain.
The four watched the four guarding arrays and their eyes shined in shock.
“No wonder godfather sent us thousands of miles here to their rescue! This place already houses an amazing figure!” The man in blue turned to his side to ask, “What do you think of these arrays?”
With a snap, the second man opened his fan and spoke calmly, “The intricacies of these arrays are hard to grasp. But as long as a Profound Heaven expert or higher is in control of them, not even the four of us can escape!”
“Blast it! Then we’ve traveled all this way for nothing? They clearly have their defenses up!” The red-haired man shouted.
The man in blue berated, “Third brother, orders are orders. And they were given by the Marshal himself. Whether this place is a volcano, or an impenetrable fortress, we still have to go in. Have you forgotten the taste of the Marshal’s cane when you entered a drunken rave last time?”
The red-haired man stammered but remained silent.
The man in blue nodded, then cupped his hands towards Blackwind Mountain as he shouted, “The four generals under Marshal Dugu extend their respects to Luo Clan Head!”
His lofty voice traveled for miles, straight into Zhuo Fan’s ear.
His ears piqued, Zhuo Fan’s eyebrow rose, “Why has War God Dugu, second of the Four Pillars, sent his men all the way over here? Could it be...”

chapters.title: Chapter 197, War God’s Advent
chapters.content:
Chapter 197, War God’s Advent
“Young miss, take the kid to his training. I’ll go take a look!” Zhuo Fan looked to Luo Yunchang.
She gave a nod then dragged Luo Yunhai out by the ear. The Marshall of Tianyu may have come, and despite the ever-present shock, Zhuo Fan was here to assuage all her worries.
Regardless of the magnitude of the coming storm, nothing could last long in the face of Zhuo Fan’s meticulous planning. This belief had evolved into blind faith in the man, a faith deep-rooted in the hearts of all Luo clansmen.
Dragged away and through glistening eyes, Luo Yunhai’s last cry at Zhuo Fan was, “Big bro Zhuo, you single-handedly ruined my life!”
“You twerp who hasn’t ever grown hair down there, what ruin?” Zhuo Fan teased. He turned to look down Blackwind Mountain and took slow steps downhill.
Hum~
With a ripple, the Poison Dragon Array’s miasma parted. Zhuo Fan walked before the four as he sized each one of them, “I am Luo clan’s steward, Zhuo Fan. And sirs...”
“Oh, we are the four generals under Marshal Dugu. Hearing of the Luo clan’s peril, he ordered us to rescue you. Greetings, I am Dugu Feng!” The man in blue cupped his hands.
The man with the fan did as well, “I am Dugu Lin!”
“Dugu Huo!” The redhead stout fellow rumbled a reply.
As for the last and the biggest man, “Dugu Shan!”
“Wind, forest, fire, mountain? The Four Tigers of Tianyu?” Zhuo Fan cried as he started making calculations in his mind.
(Starreader: reference to four phrases from Sun Tzu’s The Art of War: “as swift as the wind, as gentle as a forest, as fierce as fire, as unshakable as a mountain.”)
He had heard his fair share of stories regarding the renowned Four Pillars. Second of the Four Pillars, Dugu Zhantian, was married to his military career. He had no children, but four godsons of great bravery and power. Given their talent, they weren’t the least bit lacking to the geniuses raised inside the seven houses. Perhaps even surpassing them.
The four had repeatedly rendered great military services that earned the people’s gratitude in the form of the Four Tigers of Tianyu title.
Dugu Feng, the eldest, was swift as the wind and excelled in surprise attacks – nicknamed Storm Tiger. Dugu Lin, the second, was as gentle as a forest, knowing the art of war by heart. For his calmness of mind, he was known as Crouching Forest Tiger. Dugu Huo, the third, burned like fire, and was just as blazing in temper as well. For his boldness, he was known as Raging Tiger. Dugu Shan, the fourth, was as steadfast as a mountain, hard as stone. Proficient in defense, he was known as Mountain Tiger!
No endeavor the four had worked on ever failed. They were almost matching the God of War in their renown.
Many times, the emperor expressed his desire to lift them to the ranks of commanders, and joined Dugu Zhantian in becoming Tianyu’s Five Marshals, only to refuse each time. They would rather stay as Marshal Dugu’s tigers, rather than be alone as Tianyu Empire’s four lion kings!
They were always inseparable from Dugu Zhantian. If the four of them arrived, then Dugu Zhantian...
Checking his surroundings, Zhuo Fan’s obvious thoughts were easily noticed by Dugu Lin who tapped the fan in his palm, “Steward Zhuo, there’s no need for you to look. We are the only ones here. Our orders carried us thousands of miles to rescue you all. Marshal Dugu and his forces are running a little late, I’m afraid.”
“Oh, so Marshal Dugu is gracing us with his presence!” Zhuo Fan nodded and laughed, “I understand. Then I shall inform the young miss and young master post haste. You may return!”
Zhuo Fan waved as he left. The four were startled, even shocked.
The four of them were hailed as the Four Tigers of Tianyu everywhere in the empire, with even the seven houses bound to showing them some respect. But here, in this backwater Luo clan, not only were they not allowed entry, the door was slammed into their face. To top it all off, he even said he’d inform someone.
Wasn’t this a little bit too absurd?
Rage had stirred in the hearts of the four. Dugu Huo, who had a notoriously fiery temper, cursed on the spot, “What kind of steward are you to act so unreasonably? We came all this way to help you yet not only you did not show any appreciation, you even slam the door behind you. That is no way to treat a guest!”
“Guest, you say?”
Zhuo Fan quirked an eyebrow, turning his head to give them a closer eye, “You’re telling me you came to save us and I’m supposed to believe that? We just had a hard battle on our hands not a couple a days ago, with blood and bodies everywhere. Letting you in might drown the Luo clan in flames!”
The four gasped. So the steward wasn’t slighting them, but was overly cautious. That reason was enough to dampen their rage.
Dugu Feng cupped his hands again, “We are Marshal Dugu’s four generals. He has always been a frank and open person and we are under strict orders. We are not the enemy here. Are you perhaps doubting Marshal Dugu’s integrity?”
“Marshal Dugu is a pillar of our empire, in charge of defense, which my clan admires him greatly. Our young miss and young master burn incense and pray every day for Marshal’s health, to keep our nation safe!”
Zhuo Fan cupped his hands at the heavens, shouting with zeal, just like a true Dugu Zhantian fanboy. His action earned the nods of the four, even approval points.
[It’s good that the Luo clan holds our godfather in such high regards. It makes our trip worthwhile.]
Then, Zhuo Fan flipped his tune out of the blue. His face was cold, his eyes accusingly, “And how am I to know you are the real Four Tigers of Tianyu? Have you seen how many copycats have cropped up nowadays?”
“Please look over Marshal Dugu’s token!” Dugu Feng quickly offered a copper badge. But Zhuo Fan didn’t even glance at it, only curled his mouth, “Like I said, there are many copycats around these days. If you yourself can’t prove who you are, what good would a token do?”
“Hey, stop messing around, punk. Us Four Tigers of Tianyu have roamed the empire for so many years, but not once has there been a case of someone copying us. You only have your ignorance to blame for not knowing who we are. You won’t let us in, is that it? Wanna see how I make my way through, breaking those arrays of yours?”
Dugu Huo barked, having reached his already short limit of his slight patience. Zhuo Fan staggered back, putting on a perfect fearful face, “See, see?! You now show your true colors and still dare pretend? Marshal Dugu’s army runs under strict orders, bearing the love of the people. How can there be such brash people wanting to barge into someone’s home in his army? You’re no different from bandits!”
“You...” Dugu Huo gnashed his teeth.
Dugu Feng frowned and shouted, “Third brother, stop nagging. Are you going to stain Marshal Dugu’s name by charging into one’s home?”
Dugu Huo glared at Zhuo Fan with burning hatred, but his feet remained in place.
Dugu Feng bowed, “I apologize for my third brother’s lack of courtesy. Please do not take it to mind, Steward Zhuo. Can you trust us now?”
“Trust? Humph, you almost had me there, but fortunately, I caught on to your game. Is that how Marshal Dugu’s generals behave, playing the good guy bad guy routine?”
Flushing red, the four were left speechless. Even Dugu Huo found it so embarrassing that he forgot to complain.
Zhuo Fan snorted, “Didn’t you say Marshal Dugu is on his way. We’ll just have to wait for him to prove your identities.”
With that said, Zhuo Fan vanished into the Poison Dragon Array, and the miasma blocked the four’s sight.
They wanted to shout at him but he was already gone.
The four were left downcast behind.
Who’d ever seen it coming? They, who were revered even in the seven houses, were now forced to stand on the doorsteps of some backwater Luo clan.
And they couldn’t complain either. The clan just went through a hellish battle and their nerves were taught. And best of all, the Luo clan was a die-hard fan of the Marshal. How could the four burst in and ruin their godfather’s image?
Sighing, Dugu Huo turned to Dugu Feng, “Big brother, what do we do now?”
“What else? Stay in a Windgaze City’s tavern.”
“But how are we going to give a full report to Marshal when we can’t even get in to assess the situation?”
“We’ll report facts!” Dugu Lin shot Dugu Huo a glare, “Luo clan is more than it seems. It’s best we wait for Marshal’s personal intervention!”
The other’s hearts chilled recalling the four 5th-grade arrays and nodded.
Putting aside this place having such astonishing arrays, the fact the order was sent for the four tigers to come here was proof enough of the real threat that the Luo clan was under.
Yet, even after going through such a gory battle, it was clear from their steward’s appearance that the clan wasn’t suffering so much. This pointed out that the Luo clan was more than met the eye.
Being generals themselves, the four could tell of this mysterious clan’s power.
In another part, Zhuo Fan returned to the hall and convened with the rest. Great changes happened throughout the clan as entire rooms were thrown into chaos.
He made the four tigers back off just so he could make preparations. Since the Four Pillars were here, there was no way they were gonna miss this chance of leaning on a great mountain.
Yep, it was all about clinging to power. Although, different tactics were needed depending on the target. Zhuo Fan’s methods weren’t as crude and tasteless as those narrow-minded Cai and Sun clans.
He wanted Dugu Zhantian to be eternally tied to the Luo clan.
Luo Yunchang watched the people rush about as they were close to tearing down the whole of Blackwind Mountain. She turned to Zhuo Fan in puzzlement, “What... this...”
Zhuo Fan said before she could continue, “Young miss, you’re just in time. Tell that kid to switch from cultivation and hit the books for the next few days!”
“Read, what?” Luo Yunchang was dazed.
Zhuo Fan grinned, “Just some matters of circumstances, like war books...”
Achoo~
Not a hundred mile out of Windgaze City, a wizen man rode his large horse when a sudden sneeze caught him off guard and a shiver ran through him, “Guard, how long until we reach Windgaze City?”
Everywhere around him was crawling with thousands upon thousands of soldiers. A general close by reported, “Marshal, we will arrive in three days!”
The old man nodded, but the frown never left him, “I have come out of countless battlefields with honors, so why is it that this small Windgaze City is putting me on edge...”

chapters.title: Chapter 198, Welcoming
chapters.content:
Chapter 198, Welcoming
Three days later Zhuo Fan was in a small room, checking Luo Yunhai’s progress in reading.
Suddenly, the earth began to rumble like a huge earthquake. Zhuo Fan raised a brow, focusing his attention outside, only to be shocked at what he saw.
[What an aura. He is indeed the God of War!]
Zhuo Fan rose to his feet and shouted, “Everyone to your stations! The Luo clan’s safety for the next few years at stake here!”
“Understood!”
The men outside the room replied, having already gotten ready as they scrambled. Zhuo Fan turned to Luo Yunhai with his devious grin, “Kid, you’re up now. You better had learned your part!”
Luo Yunhai’s face sank, “Big bro Zhuo, do I have to?”
“What do you think?”
The room was soon engulfed in Zhuo Fan’s evil cackling...
Outside Windgaze City, the Four Tigers of Tianyu were already waiting for the orderly and impeccable military procession marching towards them. It was like a dark cloud without an end.
The shaking of the mountains was due to the huge army. On the battlefield, any man, even a Profound Heaven expert would shudder in face of such might.
Leading the army was a huge man on a horse, his beard swirling in the wind. Despite reigning in his power, his mighty air and unbending nature were hard to conceal.
He was the second of Tianyu’s Four Pillars, Marshal of Tianyu’s armies, God of War Dugu Zhantian!
He was in the 6th layer of the Radiant Stage, yet the whole of Tianyu considered him the strongest. His four godsons were also peak Profound Heaven experts.
Just based on the loyalty of his million men, not even the Regent Estate would dare slight such a man! Despite Regent Estate having experts with higher cultivation than him.
Once Dugu Zhantian sent an order, his million soldiers were like an unstoppable flood of steel. Even Regent Estate’s Venerables would have a hard time dealing with such a barrage.
To unite all these weak soldiers, to make them act as one, that was what it mean to be a true God of War!
For this reason, the seven houses were afraid of the Marshal, the head of the Four Pillars, Zhuge Changfeng!
Who told them to allow him to amass such power? In this case, drowning one with numbers couldn’t be a more apt description!
“Generals welcome Marshal!” The four gave a deep bow.
Dugu Zhantian nodded, “What’s the situation? Is the Luo clan safe?”
“The Luo clan is at peace!” Dugu Feng spoke heavily.
Dugu Zhantian nodded a sigh, “It’s good we arrived in time. We did not fail His Majesty. Was there anyone making it hard on them?”
“Uh, before we arrived, it would seem that the Luo clan had suffered a sneak attack!” Dugu Feng mumbled.
Dugu Zhantian raised an eyebrow, his eyes staring back at him, “What? Then how are they? What are their losses? What about the attackers? Any prisoners? What of Luo Clan Head...”
Dugu Zhantian shot questions nonstop at the bitter looking four.
How could they know when the Luo clan had slammed the door in their faces? Dugu Feng braced for reprisal as he reported, “Marshal, we are in the dark...”
“What?!”
Dugu Zhantian blew his top, “Then what have you been doing over the past few days, idling? Feng’er, that’s unlike you at all!”
They’ve been stationed at the borders for decades to prevent the Quanrong armies from invading. Yet, the emperor decreed him to go to Windgaze City’s rescue. He knew this matter was of utmost importance.
So, on his march here, he sent his four most trusted generals ahead to provide timely assistance. Only to find them idling about these past three days, and knowing absolutely nothing!
And these were Dugu Zhantian’s Four Tigers no less!
“Humph, you must have let the wine get to your heads and caused a scene. I’ll settle your punishment later!” Dugu Zhantian flared, almost wanting to do it now if not for delaying his rescue operation.
Dugu Lin bowed flustered, “Marshal, please hear us out!”
Having been told the ins and outs of the matter, Dugu Zhantian was staring dumbstruck.
“There are four 5th-grade arrays in this backwater area?” Dugu Zhantian blinked and started scouting ahead with his soul sense. And sure enough, he found four arrays surrounding Blackwind Mountain blocking his search.
Dugu Zhantian was shocked, “No wonder the emperor told me to come in person. There must be a mighty figure among them.”
Sighing, Dugu Zhantian turned to the four, “Now that you couldn’t enter, I no longer blame you!”
“Marshal, who said we can’t? If not for big brother stopping me, I would’ve torn down those damn arrays long ago!” Dugu Huo roared.
Dugu Zhantian berated, “You’re a disgrace! How dare you charge into people’s homes without an explicit order? If you had dared charged inside, I would’ve had your damn head for defying orders!”
“Uh, Marshal, I was only venting. Don’t take it seriously...” Dugu Huo ducked his head in shame.
The other three secretly snickered.
Dugu Zhantian cut in, “Marshal, the Luo clan’s steward said he will let us in after you arrived. He must mean for you to personally go inside!”
“Eh?”
Dugu Zhantian burst out laughing, “I have come at the order of the emperor to take a look at this Luo clan as well. But since there’s a mighty figure inside, I would also like to meet him!”
He dismounted and strode towards Blackwind Mountain, “Pass my order. The army is not to disturb the people and are to set camp ten miles Southeast of here!”
“Understood!”
The entire army roared, while the four rushed to follow him.
Dugu Zhantian went next to Dugu Zhantian, “Marshal, that steward is extremely cautious. He will ask a ton of questions and will not hold a polite tone. Please do not get angry when you deal with him.”
“Humph, you think my temper is short like you rascals?” Dugu Zhantian laughed and Dugu Huo grumbled inside, [Your rage is more explosive than mine!]
Dugu Lin slapped his fan, “Third brother, that steward didn’t do it out of caution. He wants to see the Marshal in person. As to why, we shall soon find out soon.”
“Ha-ha-ha, Lin’er is the most cool-headed among you, and can see things differently. He is right, the Luo clan must’ve wanted to see me. Then, I will just have to see for myself what’s so great about this clan, ha-ha-ha...”
Dugu Zhantian walked with his domineering air, soon arriving at Blackwind Mountain.
“Tianyu’s Marshal, Dugu Zhantian greets Luo Clan Head!” Dugu Zhantian bellowed.
Hum~
The Poison Dragon Array’s miasma dissipated and Zhuo Fan came out. But this time he had a look of complete respect.
He bowed, “I am Luo clan’s steward, Zhuo Fan. Welcome, Marshal Dugu, and the four generals!”
“Oh, so you’re that steward? I heard you’re quite cautious, not trusting even my token in the hands of my generals. Why then do you believe who I am at the mere sight of me?” Dugu Zhantian grinned, clearly mocking Zhuo Fan’s earlier attitude.
But Zhuo Fan acted the fool, “Marshal Dugu is the God of War. Who’d dare impersonate you? Even if someone did, none could copy your aura honed after numerous victories, nor the thick killing intent on you for slaughtering countless men.
“Is there any other true man, a man old but holding strong still, in Tianyu? I could feel and hear from afar the might you possess. Only Marshal Dugu is capable of making my energy surge in my veins. My respect to you is like a flood, an unstoppable river, like a never ending sea, a mighty... “
“Fine, fine, I get it!” Dugu Zhantian cut his rambling short.
He wanted to test the kid and see his true intentions, but then, he saw him engage in this foolery, going as far as worshiping the ground he stepped on. It was so enrapturing, that even he felt a chill and had to stop it.
If this went on for any longer, he’d be hurling for days and nights.
The four were dumbstruck. None saw it coming. Zhuo Fan this time was a thorough ass kisser, blowing their wish of questioning out of their minds.
Dugu Zhantian had seen his fair share of fawners like Zhuo Fan, but never wasted time with any. Whenever they spoke, it was always followed by a long endless string of adulation.
Dugu Zhantian took a long look at him, “This backwater town has many experts it seems, even this young steward. I am in awe. Then, little brother, is it possible to see Luo Clan Head?”
“He’s eagerly awaiting!”
Grinning, Zhuo Fan bowed and Dugu Zhantian strode forward.
The Marshal could see this was all arranged by that mighty figure. He could feel getting closer and closer to him. What he didn’t know was that mighty figure was that young steward.
The four generals followed closely, with Dugu Huo jutting his chin and muttering next to Zhuo Fan, “Humph, now do you believe us?”
“Of course, I was too blind to see your greatness. I beg your pardon!” Zhuo Fan smiled.
Dugu Lin looked at him deeply but shook his head in the end.
He was Dugu Army’s strategist and knew something was off about Zhuo Fan. But he just couldn’t dare believe all of this was orchestrated by such a young pup.
Or he would be the second coming of Zhuge Changfeng...

chapters.title: Chapter 199, My Godfather, My Rock
chapters.content:
Chapter 199, My Godfather, My Rock
“Please, after you, Marshal!”
With Zhuo Fan as guide, they passed through the Poison Dragon Array, reaching the peak of Blackwind Mountain. Instead of a lavish clan dwelling, they were greeted by simple gates of a barracks.
They could even hear faint cries of kill from beyond.
Frowning, the five were quite puzzled. [What is the Luo clan up to now?]
With a smile, Zhuo Fan gestured, “Ha-ha-ha, please don’t take offense, Marshal. We have just recently gone through a bloody attack and are still tense. Our guards especially, training day and night. Will God of War be willing to say a few words to our young blood? The whole clan would be most grateful.” Zhuo Fan bowed again.
Dugu Zhantian nodded slowly. He first wanted to know what the Luo clan was cooking up, and second, to know how deep they hid their assets.
For the emperor to view them so highly and pull him from the borders in rescuing a nameless clan, he had to see for himself what they really were.
Following Zhuo Fan through the gates, the five arrived before Luo clan’s manor. What had them all in shock was that there were no buildings around, only tents. They looked akin to an army ready for war.
That was Zhuo Fan’s ingenious plan was all about. He tore down all buildings for tents to stir Marshal Dugu’s sympathy and make him feel at home.
With how Dugu Zhantian spent years on end on the battlefields, he’d be more at home in a tent than between four walls.
This was also a form of flattery, to conform to one’s tastes, covert as it was.
Sure enough, Dugu Zhantian trembled as he nodded. Zhuo Fan no longer spoke, having a sly grin on his face instead.
They soon arrived at Luo clan’s training area, where Captain Pang was in the middle of practice with his guards. Most of them were still children, but their every strike was filled with zeal and their eyes burning with power. They look strikingly similar to veterans after decades of war.
Not even Dugu Zhantian could remain unfeeling seeing such a scene. Just what could those ten-year-olds have possibly seen to harden their gaze?
As an experienced commander, with decades of war behind him, he knew how to turn a batch of fresh recruits into dauntless warriors.
But never in his wildest dream did he expect to see this in a backwater clan. The world was filled with marvels!
He was now burning to know who was this great figure behind the Luo clan.
Unbeknownst to him, this burning zeal in the eyes of the youths was thanks to the Wraith Art they trained in.
As for those kids whose spirits were crushed, they lay dead, with bones crushed and bodies mauled. What he was seeing were those that came back from the brink of death, standing at the peak. How could they not be dauntless!
“Marshal, our third rate clan just went through a disaster and only the surviving few are training now. You must be thinking it’s a sorry sight.” Zhuo Fan sighed in feint modesty.
Dugu Zhantian shook his hand, “No no, hardly. The kids may not have cultivated, but their eyes are those of elites. If these are just your survivors, then your main guard unit that fell must’ve been a monster. How could such a mighty guard ever need rescuing?”
Zhuo Fan blinked and smiled.
[This Marshal is pragmatic. I see now why he is acclaimed as a God of War. He is an upright and just man.]
Zhuo Fan nodded secretly, having understood more about the Marshal’s nature.
“Then Marshal, please feel free to point out some tips.”
“No need! I would not dare show my meager skill before you!” Dugu Zhantian laughed, “Steward Zhuo, I only wish to meet with your Clan Head. Such a man has set four 5th-grade arrays, and still trained such young warriors. I’m truly eager to see him!”
The four behind him were shocked.
Marshal was the God of War, with countless figures wanting to meet him. But now, it was the other way around. It was he who wanted to see someone else.
Just who was guiding the Luo clan? How could the mere training of some guards move the grand Tianyu’s God of War?
The four sighed as they turned to look at the guards again. These small few children were indeed far stronger than their own elites, it’s no wonder...
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed and grinned, “Since Marshal is so eager, please come with me. Our Clan Head is also waiting.”
Zhuo Fan entered the biggest tent as the others rushed to catch up to him. How could they have known all of this was Zhuo Fan leading them by the nose...
“The art of war is of vital importance to the State. It is a matter of life and death, a road either to safety or to ruin. Hence it is a subject of inquiry which can on no account be neglected. The art of war, then, is governed by five constant factors, to be taken into account in one’s deliberations, when seeking to determine the conditions obtaining in the field. These are: The Moral Law, Heaven, Earth...”
(Starreader: excerpt from Sun Tzu’s Art of War.)
A bright voice read.
Dugu Zhantian’s faltered his steps, “That’s the Art of War. Who is reading?”
“Oh, I almost forgot. Young master had been training for twenty hours. He needs some rest!” Zhuo Fan slapped his forehead and rushed in another direction. He was unconcerned about the others following him, though.
Dugu Zhantian’s group followed either way.
They arrived at a small yard where a youth held a bowl on his head and in horse stance. His knees and hands also held a bowl, but the surface of the water was unperturbed.
What laid under his butt was a shining dagger. If his legs slacked for even a second, he’d tear himself a new one. Despite the danger, he was still reciting the Art of War.
Dugu Zhantian was puzzled, “Steward Zhuo, he...”
“Ha-ha-ha, Luo clan’s young master, Luo Yunhai!”
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “From young to old, all of Luo clan admires Marshal Dugu. All of us adhere to military doctrine. Especially the young master, who is training while studying, hoping to one day to serve under the Marshal!”
Dugu Zhantian blinked, [Why is the Clan Head of this Luo clan with his impressive soldiers wish to be under me? Everything about this clan is mysterious. Just what are they after?]
Zhuo Fan probed with a smile, “Marshal, will you accept our young master?”
“Uh, of course. If the youth wishes to serve his nation, to enter the battlefield...”
“Perfect!”
Zhuo Fan’s yell cut him off. He then pulled Luo Yunhai up, “Yunhai, don’t just stand there, Marshal Dugu wants to take you in. Go and pour him tea!”
“Right away!”
Luo Yunhai ran like the wind, like a bird out of its cage. [Finally out of that damn position. I almost couldn’t take it!]
Dugu Zhantian felt dizzy, [Wait, you’re going to make me accept him here?]
“Uh, Steward Zhuo, that was...”
“Marshal Dugu needn’t say anything. My Clan Head would be immensely pleased to know you showed such care for young master. He will be grateful for all his life. You may not know it, but this was our Clan Head’s cherished dream...”
Zhuo Fan held Dugu Zhantian’s large hand, with tears in his eyes. Dugu Zhantian wanted to refuse, but now he didn’t have the heart to go through with it.
[Isn’t it just a soldier? He isn’t half bad either. Perhaps he’ll earn some merits in the future. It’s just taking one extra recruit anyway.] Sighing, he nodded in the end.
Then a screech came, “Marshal Dugu, it’s actually you?”
Luo Yunchang appeared who knew when and was shaking from excitement.
Zhuo Fan’s face was twitching. [Tone it down on the boasting!]
“Steward Zhuo, she...”
“Uh, let me introduce you. She is our young miss, Luo Yunchang!” Zhuo Fan brought her before Dugu Zhantian and explained what happened.
Luo Yunchang’s eyes lit up, jumping in joy, completely out of her modest and virtuous character.
Zhuo Fan’s mouth twitched as he whispered, “Alright now, don’t push it!”
Luo Yunchang reigned in her excitement then apologized to Dugu Zhantian, who didn’t seem to mind.
But the four generals looked particularly close at Luo Yunchang. Especially the third brother, whose eyes were practically burning.
Zhuo Fan laughed inside.
[Yep, she is no less than Diaochan. And Luo Yunchang is also a rare beauty.]
(Starreader: Fictional character in Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Diaochan is one of the four beauties of ancient China. She is a maid of Dong Zhuo who charmed Lu Bu into assassinating him in 192. )
Zhuo Fan turned to Dugu Zhantian, “Marshal Dugu, taking young master in is the greatest joy that ever graced the Luo clan. Why not make it even better by becoming kin?”
Kin?!
Stunned by those words, the four generals looked at Luo Yunchang with blushes. Dugu Zhantian rubbed his beard and looked expectantly at her, “I don’t know if Clan Head will agree...”
“No worries, dad would definitely agree. It is his cherished wish!” Luo Yunchang rushed a reply.
Dugu Zhantian saw his godsons bashful but hardly refusing. Dugu Huo had it worse, like a volcano ready to blow.
Dugu Zhantian recalled how his godsons had fought by his side for decades and thought it was time for them to start a family. So he nodded, “Since Clan Head agrees, then I’m more than happy to do it!”
The four generals clenched their fists, so excited they were trembling. But who was the one to marry this young miss?
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed and showed a sly smile.
Luo Yunhai now came with the tea and saw Zhuo Fan nodding. He kneeled as he offered the teacup to Dugu Zhantian.
Dugu Zhantian’s mind was filled with the joy of a wedding, taking the cup in passing.
But at that moment, Luo Yunhai’s voice slammed into their ears, “Luo Yunhai greets godfather!”
Pff!
Dugu Zhantian staggered, as he spat out the tea he just drank...

chapters.title: Chapter 200, I Want a Sister In Law, Not a Brother!
chapters.content:
Chapter 200, I Want a Sister In Law, Not a Brother!
“W-w-what did you just call me?” Dugu Zhantian’s old eyes bulged and pointed a trembling finger at Luo Yunhai with a shocked face. The four generals were dumbstruck as well.
Marshal only agreed to take him as a soldier. How did it jump from that to being a godson?
Luo Yunhai had a genial face as he cupped his hands in respect, “Is it wrong of me to call you godfather?”
“Yeah, ol’ Marshal, didn’t you say it yourself that you wanted to be kin? The grand Marshal Dugu is going back on his word over such a trivial matter?” Zhuo Fan secretly snickered.
Dugu Zhantian was bug-eyed. It took a while to get over his shock and turned from Luo Yunchang to Luo Yunhai.
[True, Steward Zhuo only spoke of being kin, not carrying to elaborate on its type.] For Luo Yunhai to call him godfather, was also a type of kin.
But since only Luo Yunchang was there at the time, they believed it could only be through marriage.
And the next thing they noticed was that Luo Yunhai was kneeling there, and offering the teacup. Wasn’t his actions clearly done for a godfather ceremony? [Sigh, how could I be so careless?]
Dugu Zhantian rested his forehead, and said to Zhuo Fan bitterly, “Steward Zhuo, then what you meant by kin, was in fact...”
“Yes. Did Marshal perhaps think otherwise?”
“I thought...” Looking at Luo Yunchang, then at his four godsons, Dugu Zhantian sighed in resignation, “The same.”
The four generals’ faces crumbled with his last words. Zhuo Fan clapped with joy, “Ha-ha-ha, outstanding. Then young master, hurry and kowtow three times to your godfather.”
“Yes!” Luo Yunhai shouted, more than eager in his obeisance.
Dugu Zhantian sighed bitterly with a shake of his head. He wanted to give his godsons a sister in law, only to end up giving them a younger brother instead.
He was left with no alternative, since he already accepted. If he were to switch facts now and say he wanted the girl instead, wouldn’t it be the same as robbing the common people’s women?
He was Dugu Zhantian, who had an illustruous military reputation, a man pursuing honesty and bravery as well as maintaining a strict order in his ranks. Was he just going to throw it all away just like that?
[Let it be. With his talent and Luo clan’s elite army, in two years of training under me, he ought to turn up as another tiger, no?]
Dugu Zhantian looked on the bright side. His face then turned serious as he looked at Luo Yunhai, “Yunhai, today, you take me as your godfather, so you must follow the rules of the Dugu house. I am a man that separates private and public matters. Now that you are in the Dugu Army and if I am still in armor, you must address me as Marshal. Disobey any military rule and I will punish you according to the martial law, no exceptions. Your four brothers can attest to that.”
“Yes, godfather. Uh, Marshal!” Luo Yunhai cupped his hands in glee.
Dugu Zhantian nodded pleased, [Clever boy.], “Furthermore, as you are now my godson you are not to shame my name. Or your head shall fall!”
“Yes, Marshal!” Luo Yunhai grinned and shouted.
Zhuo Fan smiled and cupped his hands, “Congratulations, Marshal, for getting another bright godson. I am most certain our young master will not let you down.”
He then turned to the four generals, his smile ever present, “Congratulations, generals, you have now an outstanding brother. Young master shall be indebted to you looking after him, ha-ha-ha...”
Turning from the beaming Luo Yunchang, a fairy upon this mortal world, to the grinning Zhuo Fan, the four looked bitter and depressed.
[Enough blabber! We have enough brothers as it is, millions in fact! We don’t need more, all we wanted was a sister in law!]
Dugu Huo had it worse, feeling such disappointment that his eyes glistened with tears.
[Goddamn wretched Luo clan! You ignited our desires without us knowing and you give us a little brother instead?]
[I feel like crying! I’ve been in the field of battle for decades and now I don’t wanna go back...]
Knowing exactly what they were grumbling about in their minds, Zhuo Fan gave Luo Yunchang a thumbs up as he laughed inside. [Who knew the young miss knew how to work her charms? She got the four of ’em hooked without so much as an eye batting.]
Luo Yunchang stuck out her head in womanly pride and returned Zhuo Fan an enchanting smile.
This only worked to fuel the lamentation in the four men’s hearts.
“Steward Zhuo, now that I have Yunhai as godson, don’t you think it’s time I see your Clan Head?” Dugu Zhantian asked.
Shuddering, Zhuo Fan sighed a nod, “Indeed, I do believe Clan Head wished he could meet Marshal for a long time.”
Luo Yunhai and Luo Yunchang showed sullen faces.
Dugu Zhantian’s group was startled, following them in silence.
Not fifteen minutes later, they reached a large tent. Zhuo Fan allowed them to enter first. What they saw left them speechless.
On the table in the middle of the large tent stood a lonely spirit tablet. It was actually inscribed with Luo Clan Head’s name.
“Clan Head, your most esteemed and revered Marshal Dugu has come to see you. You must be so happy.” Zhuo Fan’s knees hit the ground, wailing to high heavens.
Luo Yunhai and Luo Yunchang had tears streaming down their cheeks.
Unlike Zhuo Fan, theirs was no act, but genuine pain. The loss of their father happened two years ago and this spirit tabled was very much real.
How could they not feel sorrow when gazing upon the spirit tablet?
Dugu Zhantian’s group was stunned. They never would’ve thought the battle of Windgaze City just now was so disastrous it robbed them of their Clan Head.
They had come too late.
Shaking his head, Dugu Zhantian and the generals felt their pain, paying their respects as well by burning incense. Their hearts were bleak thinking the Clan Head died not a few days ago.
“Steward Zhuo, if you don’t mind me asking, are the four 5th-grade arrays outside due to Clan Head?” Dugu Zhantian asked after showing his respect.
Zhuo Fan jumped to his feet and held his head high, “It is indeed so. Clan Head was but a Bone Tempering cultivator, but that didn’t stop him from reading the starry sky and the land’s layout, grasping arrays and alchemy alike. Those arrays were personally placed by the Clan Head.”
“Clan Head was a truly extraordinary man. I see why His Majesty sent me to your rescue!” Dugu Zhantian sighed.
Regarding the intricacies of a 5th-grade array, not even a Radiant Stage expert could claim to understand them fully. But as a mere Bone Tempering cultivator, the Luo Clan Head could set four 5th grade arrays. He had to be the genius of the millennium.
[A pity that he was only in the Bone Tempering Stage and was too weak to control the arrays fully and repel the stronger invaders.] Dugu Zhantian could even imagine Clan Head’s last moments. He sighed, “A true pity. If only he was still alive, I would’ve asked him to join my army as general. He would’ve been a great help to my army in fighting back the Quanrong.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyebrow flickered and clicked his tongue inwardly. [Thank god I wasn’t stupid enough to say I set them up, or they’d be hauling me to the borders. That would be dreadfully scary!]
“And who was the filth that dared attack the Luo clan, making you suffer so much, and even kill Clan Head?” Dugu Zhantian’s killing intent spiked.
He was only sent here by the emperor to protect the Luo clan. As for the enemy, he had no idea who it was.
Zhuo Fan snickered inwardly, [Perfect.] and sobbed, “Marshal does not know how cruel and terrifying they were. We had a hundred thousand people on Blackwind Mountain, now reduced to less than ten thousand.”
The sorrowful siblings jumped in fright, looking at Zhuo Fan with horror.
Nothing seemed beneath this guy, no act to foul, no ditch too filthy. The siblings thought to themselves. [When were there ever a hundred thousand men on this mountain? Better yet, we couldn’t feed them even if there were!]
Dugu Zhantian was boiling mad, “Such bastards slaughtering common folk live in my country? Now that I’ve returned to court, I will make sure to uproot this evil from our nation and bring it to peace!”
“Please godfa-, Marshal, bring justice to the Luo clan!” Luo Yunhai bowed.
Luo Yunchang rushed to do the same, “Please Marshal, bring us justice!”
“Be at ease, I do not tolerate such meaningless slaughter. I will have them taste the fist of justice for you.” Dugu Zhantian flicked his sleeve and roared.
Dugu Feng grabbed Luo Yunhai and Luo Yunchang’s arms and helped them to their feet. But his eyes never left Luo Yunchang, “Ha-ha-ha, even if Yunhai wasn’t my brother, The Four Tigers will never let such criminals live.”
The other three were gnashing their teeth in frustration.
[That’s eldest brother for you. Swift to act. How come we didn’t think of it? But there’s plenty of chance to pursue her, now that Luo Yunhai is our little brother.]
They then started crowding around her and extended their clutches, justifying it with sympathy. While their eyes glared at Dugu Feng as if to say, ‘Let the girl go! It’s my turn!’
But then Zhuo Fan passed through and took Dugu Feng’s wretched hand as well as the three clutches with ardent passion, “We couldn’t thank the four generals enough.”
“Ha-ha-ha, it’s only proper...”
Taking their hands back in annoyance, the four still had a smile, but their hearts were vexed. [We want to cope a feel of that young miss you got over there, so why the hell a rotten steward butts into our business?]
[Humph, such a killjoy!]
Watching them with a cold eye, Dugu Zhantian was pondering. [As their godfather, I have the final say in not only the peace on Tianyu, but to what lady fits them as well.]
“Steward Zhuo, who are they, where do they come from? I will immediately send my troops to flatten them all!” Dugu Zhantian bellowed with majestic power.
Zhuo Fan cupped his hands, “Marshal Dugu is a true God of War, in power and manners. I will be straight with you. One of those fiends was Hell Valley. I am certain that Marshal’s army can uproot every single one of them, raze their nest to the ground, restore peace...”
“Wait wait wait, come again?” Dugu Zhantian stammered, his scalp numb as cold sweat trickled down.
Zhuo Fan held his head high and spoke clearly, “It was Hell Valley! Why, is it perhaps difficult, Marshal?”
Dugu Zhantian’s face twitched
[Difficult, he says. That couldn’t even begin to describe it! Since when was it so easy to act against the seven houses?] He was from the Four Pillars, but he couldn’t just up and march on the seven houses! That’d start a civil war!
Dugu Zhantian held his forehead and sighed.
[I got too carried away with boasting!] Who’d have thought the reason why the emperor would send him over was to repel the seven houses? It was only natural, since only the Four Pillars could reign in the seven houses of Tianyu.
[Why didn’t you say anything, Your Majesty? Now I can’t go back on my word after boasting about it!]
Finding the hopeful gazes of Zhuo Fan, Luo Yunhai, and Luo Yunchang, for the first time ever, Dugu Zhantian flushed in embarrassment, trying to look elsewhere...

chapters.title: Chapter 201, Foolproof
chapters.content:
Chapter 201, Foolproof
“Old Marshal, would it be possible for us to go with your army when you set out? To cheer you on!?” Zhuo Fan looked as guileless as a newborn blinking those big eyes of his.
Dugu Zhantian’s face froze, slapping himself with his calloused hand, and stammering to find the right answer. He just had to go and brag about getting justice for Luo clan. Now, he got his just desert. Just what excuse was good enough to get out of this one?
Dugu Lin felt his godfather predicament and said with a roll of his eyes, “Steward Zhuo, are you sure it’s Hell Valley? Do you have any proof? This is a very serious matter. Attacking the seven houses without a reasonable charge, the whole empire will rise up against us!”
“Right, that’s my concern as well!”
Dugu Zhantian recovered quickly and stared on the steward and the siblings as he asked tense, “Do you have any proof?”
Looking at each other, Zhuo Fan and the siblings frowned. The three houses’ elders and Venerables were wiped out. How would they get evidence now?
After muttering for a while, Zhuo Fan spoke, “They fled too fast and left nothing behind.”
Dugu Zhantian sighed in relief, then gestured at Dugu Lin in appreciation for lifting that rock off his heart, “Since there’s no proof, I...”
“Although...”
Zhuo Fan’s interjection got Dugu Zhantian on the edge, “However fast they ran, their spies, the Sun clan and Cai Rong, our former elder, with his son, were left behind and are in our custody. That should be enough proof.”
“Uh...” Dugu Zhantian hinted at Dugu Lin for help. Dugu Lin was the wisest and most level-headed among the Four Tigers. It now fell onto him to uphold the reputation of the Dugu Army, to let this matter die.
Dugu Lin shook his head, “A spy of no importance, that has absolutely no relation with anyone from Hell Valley, can hardly be considered proof.”
“Exactly!”
Dugu Zhantian shook his head in dismay, “I’m not trying to avoid this, but my hands are tied without hard evidence. Or I would’ve set out with my army at once, trampling Hell Valley into the ground.”
Roaring with such zeal, Dugu Zhantian sighed at the end, while giving Dugu Lin a thumbs up on the sly.
Dugu Lin gave a covert nod as well.
Their ol’ Marshal was a military man, hating evil to the core, but not a hot headed one. He couldn’t just attack the important seven houses on a whim.
Or it would ruin Tianyu!
While Zhuo Fan couldn’t care less. The world could burn for all he cared, as long as his enemies perished in the fire. Seeing Dugu Zhantian not easily pushed to make an enemy out of Hell Valley, pointing out one lame excuse after another, Zhuo Fan frowned.
[What to do? How can I make Dugu Zhantian and those bastards get in a conflict? Even a minor skirmish is better than nothing.]
Zhuo Fan’s plan was similar to what he did during the battle in Windgaze City. This time though, the grudge between the Luo clan and the seven houses would shift into the grudge between Four Pillars’ Dugu Zhantian and the seven houses.
[That’ll keep Luo clan safe and sound for a few years at least.]
Zhuo Fan saw it was far fetched to get rid of Hell Valley any time soon and didn’t make all these preparations for that. He wanted Dugu Zhantian to be the face of Luo clan and let everyone know they’d have to go through Marshal before getting to them.
[But this old goat keeps skirting around instead...]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes darted around in deep thought.
“Steward Zhuo, our scouts report three floating lights above Windgaze City. What are they?” Captain Pang burst into the tent.
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow and everyone went outside.
Up above, three light indeed spiraled in the sky. They had erratic movements, as if flies with no way home.
“That’s a messaging jade slip!” Dugu Zhantian was shocked, “Feng’er, grab them and see who sent them.”
“Understood!” Dugu Feng cupped his hands.
But before he acted, a figure flashed in the sky with a rumble. It caught the jade slips and was back in a flash.
Dugu Zhantian and the four generals were dumbstruck. Zhuo Fan was just a 5th layer of Bone Tempering cultivator yet, could fly as fast as a Profound Heaven expert.
And his Lightning Wings could turn in mid air, as if alive. It was shocking enough for Clan Head to set up the 5th grade arrays and no one was expecting such a skill from the young steward.
One had to wonder what faces they’d make when they realized his speed wasn’t limited to match the Profound Heaven Stage, and that he had killed many renowned Profound Heaven experts in Tianyu.
But since they only now returned from the battlefield, they were still out of the loop as to how dreadful this devoted and fervent servant of the Luo clan was.
Chuckling at their reactions, Zhuo Fan took the lead to look into the three jade slips then he snickered.
“Marshal Dugu, weren’t you looking for proof? Here it is, he-he-he...”
Dugu Zhantian took the three jade slips skeptical. But when he read them, his face darkened and cursed inwardly.
[Are these three houses packed with idiots? Couldn’t they have taken these jade slip with them before leaving?]
These were Hell Valley, Pill King Hall, and Merry Woods’ three house leaders sending their orders to their elders and Venerables.
When a messaging jade slip arrived, only their respective house elder could retrieve it through a specific gesture. In the case when no one was there to take them, the jade slip would float around for two hours before finally returning to the sender.
It was a pity that these important elders and Venerables in Windgaze City had long since kicked the bucket. The jade slips floated about idly and Zhuo Fan took them as the much needed irrefutable proof to set Dugu Zhantian into motion.
“Marshal Dugu, is this enough?” Zhuo Fan’s smiled inside, but his face calm as ever.
Dugu Zhantian spoke with hatred, “Enough!”
“Is this proof, foolproof?”
“It is!”
“So when can we expect you to charge on Hell Valley?”
“Uh...” Dugu Zhantian’s face was solemn, “I will need His Majesty’s approval to move the army. Don’t worry, I will take the proof to court and definitely bring justice to the Luo clan.”
Zhuo Fan beamed, [As long as you do it.], “Marshal, won’t it be convenient to deal with Pill King Hall and Merry Woods as well since you’re at it? Look, the foolproof also involves them as well...”
Dugu Zhantian felt a headache coming, [Hell Valley is bad enough, now you want those two dealt with as well? Why not repeat history and jump straight to a full blown war with the seven houses like the one a thousand years ago?]
Dugu Zhantian smiled dejectedly, “I will report to His Majesty and abide by his ruling!”
“Oh, that’s also fine!” Zhuo Fan nodded. Then he recalled something, “But Marshal, since you’re returning to the court, mind including one little thing in your report?”
“What, there’s more?” Dugu Zhantian was speechless. [Just how many houses did you step on anyway?]
Zhuo Fan scratched his nose, “This might be a bit tricky though. We knew they were working behind the scenes, but there’s no solid proof about them. It’s up to Marshal if you wish to mention them.”
“The one behind three houses? Who?” Dugu Zhantian’s voice trembled.
Zhuo Fan smiled and spoke vaguely, “Ha-ha-ha, to Marshal it is no one important. But to us, a small clan, it is a colossus. Only under Marshal’s wing can we survive.”
“Who exactly are they?” Dugu Zhantian was growing anxious.
“Regent Estate!”
Sss~
Gasping, not just Dugu Zhantian, but even the generals were in complete shock. [Did the Luo clan poke the heavens or something? Not only offending the three houses, but even Regent Estate!]
Dugu Zhantian may not fear Regent Estate, but his losses would be disastrous.
His Dugu Army was the defense of the nation, how could it be worn down in civil war?
“What’s wrong, Marshal Dugu?” Zhuo Fan blinked his large eyes.
Dugu Zhantian hurriedly walked away with his four godsons for fear Zhuo Fan could read his mood, “You guys sure are awesome, but I can’t make a rash decision in this. I will return to camp and think it through. Oh, why do I suddenly feel so dizzy.”
“Marshal Dugu, if you disregard us, what about the promise you made in front of Clan Head’s spirit tablet to bring us justice?” Zhuo Fan shouted as he showed them out.
Luo Yunhai cried, “Godfa-, Marshal, you promised me...”
“Fine fine, I am a man of my word. However, let me wrap my head around it first. My camp is only ten miles from here. With me here, no one will bother you. Let’s leave it at that, goodbye.”
Dugu Zhantian cupped his hand in a rush, then ran away. The Four Tigers of Tianyu gave Luo Yunchang one last look then followed suit.
They vanished the next second.
Zhuo Fan grinned seeing them gone in a blink, “This Marshal Dugu may not want to contest with the seven houses, but he did promise us safety at least!”
“Big bro Zhuo,” Luo Yunhai said, “Do I really have to join Marshal’s army?”
“Of course. It is your fortune to be trained by Dugu Zhantian, the man who held the frontiers for decades, with Four Tigers under him.”
“Why don’t you do it then? Wasn’t he fascinated by your arrays?”
Zhuo Fan snorted, “As the saying goes, a good man doesn’t enlist. Why the hell would I go for?”
(StarReader: points at him being an honest to God, faithful and righteous man who does no evil. Or he’s one hell of a smart guy to avoid enlisting.)
“Then what about me?”
Shooting him a look, Zhuo Fan spoke coldly, “You either go with Dugu Zhantian, or cultivate twenty hours a day.”
“Army, here I come!” Luo Yunhai ran out in fear.
Luo Yunchang smiled, then muttered, “Zhuo Fan, what if... making him a godson fails? Would you have married me off to make a tie with Four Pillars?”
“Perhaps.” Zhuo Fan spoke as if it was obvious, “In regards to political marriage, using you to get the Four Pillars on our side is as good a move as any. In fact, we’d be the ones truly winning here. We can even go a step further and get the best out of it by having you marry Dugu Huo. He is so impulsive and easy to use...”
“Go to hell!” Luo Yunchang glared at him and kicked him off the mountain before leaving in a huff.
Zhuo Fan ate dirt before he got to crawl to his feet and shouted behind her, “What the hell? Isn’t it all for Luo clan? Besides, what difference does it make who you aren’t even marrying... “
This only worked to fuel Luo Yunchang’s rage as she stomped faster...
In another place, Dugu Zhantian’s group descended the mountain post haste, in fear Zhuo Fan would go after them with more excessive demands.
Suddenly, Dugu Lin stopped with a frown, “Marshal, why do I have the odd feeling we’ve been played?”
The others stopped as well, now noticing something was very off about all this. In their trip to Blackwind Mountain, they didn’t get anything cleared up, yet ended up with a godson and a heavy responsibility. At the end of the day, they were now tied with Luo clan.
To the point they’d be fighting four houses together!
[What’s going on here?]
Dugu Zhantian and the tigers scratched their heads in complete loss...

chapters.title: Chapter 202, Taunt
chapters.content:
Chapter 202, Taunt
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Silavin
A fortnight later, Zhuo Fan was patiently cultivating, taking advantage of the short idle time he rarely could afford.
He had to handle every little matter in the Luo clan these few days. It was his duty as a steward to make sure everything ran smoothly. Adding to that, he had to look after the guards and shadow corp’s cultivation. Thus, his own training suffered.
Since Luo Yunhai was now Dugu Zhantian’s godson, he also had to constantly ferry this young master to Dugu Zhantian’s camp and strengthen their relationship.
Their interactions were rocky at first, with Dugu Zhantian in a bad mood, but the kid was sharp and slowly started to grow on the old guy. Soon, Marshall began treating him like his favorite. Even though he was aware of Luo clan’s intent, he nonetheless agreed to it in a moment of carelessness.
And they got so close that Luo Yunhai was staying at the Dugu Army camp ten miles out for two or three days sometimes. It was such a relief to Zhuo Fan to hear this.
[This pair of godson and godfather finally shows results...]
Suddenly, Zhuo Fan opened his eyes and grinned wickedly, “He-he-he, I was beginning to worry I’d have no excuse to get that old man to march on you. But who’d have thought you’d come instead. It doesn’t get any better than this!”
“Old Pang!”
Zhuo Fan got out and shouted. Captain Pang rushed to him and cupped his hands, “Steward Zhuo, what do you need of me?”
“Go to Dugu Army camp and tell the old man, trouble has come to Luo clan!”
“What, enemy attack? Where? Can I go see?” Captain Pang was growing anxious in his rush outside.
Zhuo Fan flicked his forehead with a smile, “Stop using that excuse. Don’t worry about that and just go ask for help!”
Captain Pang scratched his head, puzzled. But since Zhuo Fan said it, he’d have to follow his order. After all, Zhuo Fan’s every move was meticulously made and surely had a good reason for this. As long as they followed his instructions everything would be all right.
Zhuo Fan smiled as Captain Pang ran like the wind. Then he also flew towards Windgaze City’s gate.
At the same time, people started appearing nearby the entrance of Windgaze City, people from Veiled Dragon Pavilion, Drifting Flowers Edifice, and Sword Marquise Abode.
Chu Bijun looked beyond the gates with worry, “I wonder if the attack already started. I hope we’re not too late.”
“If there ever had been an attack, it had to have happened already with how quiet the city is. However...” Long Yifey muttered, “Windgaze City is forbidden to us from the seven houses. Shouldn’t we scout it first?”
Everyone turned quiet.
They didn’t know how Hell Valley and the rest infiltrated the city, but one thing was certain, they didn’t just waltz in. If they go in and get discovered, adding to that the possibility of Luo clan being laid in ruins, they would be the ones to ultimately take the fall.
With the weakened imperial family, they wouldn’t suffer much, but the Regent Estate wasn’t that benevolent. They’d accuse them of rebelling with this excuse. They’d fall right in their trap.
But they wouldn’t know the situation without going in first, and they also couldn’t just stay here fiddling their thumbs either. It was hard no matter what choice was made!
Sighing, Chu Bijun tapped her golden dragon head cane, “One must do what he has to do! Let’s go!”
She then led Iris and Peony Overseers to the gates. Long Yifey and Xie Xiaofeng nodded, not far behind either.
Grandmother may be known as the Lady of Steel, but these two men were just as bold as her.
They all disregarded the ban and any traps that may be about, going straight through the front gate into Windgaze City.
“Chu Bijun, stop!” A shout came from above and figures block their path. On a closer look, they were clearly people from Hell Valley, Pill King Hall, and Merry Woods.
Chu Bijun squinted, “Valley Lord You, what’s the meaning of this?”
“He-he-he, we all know why we’re here. Too bad, you’re too late!” You Wanshan and Yan Bogong’s group started laughing.
Chu Bijun frowned, “You mean you already...”
“Correct, we knew you’d come to help Luo clan. But no matter how fast you rushed here, could it be faster than the message jade slips? Humph, I will let you in on a little secret. If my calculations are correct, our forces hidden in the Windgaze City had long received our orders and assaulted the Luo clan two weeks ago. By now, the Luo clan should be nothing but a pile of corpses, ha-ha-ha...”
Yan Bogong laughed , soon joined by the rest. Chu Bijun and Long Yifey were unsettled.
It all bore down to imperial family’s response. If they were any more passive, the Regent Estate’s campaign would go unchecked, with these three houses as their very first targets.
In a blink, Drifting Flowers Edifice, Sword Marquise Abode, and Veiled Dragon Pavilion found themselves in an imminent danger.
But then, a carefree laughter echoed, “I do hope you can find it in your hearts to forgive me. It seems we have sorely disappointed you. The Luo clan hasn’t seen blood for over a month, not even a chicken’s.”
They turned in shock to see a youth with an evil grin plastered on his face, leaning on the city gates.
“Z-Zhuo Fan?”
They all cried in unison. Long Jiu’s group was ecstatic. Since this kid was here, Luo clan’s safety was a done deal. And by contrast, You Wanshan’s group was filled with dread.
Except for Hell Valley’s 5th elder, none of them saw Zhuo Fan before. But having seen the Hell Kill Order, they knew his appearance.
“W-weren’t you supposed to be killed on your way back? How...” You Wanshan was overwhelmed.
Zhuo Fan snickered evilly, “Oh, you mean those dead bags of bones? He-he-he, they all died by my hands, no exceptions.”
“That’s impossible!” You Wanshan’s group screamed, not daring to even believe such grievous news.
Hell Valley and Merry Woods each sent two elders in the 5th layer of Profound Heaven Stage, the cornerstones of their houses, even Regent Estate supplied with two peak Profound Heaven experts.
Not even a 9th layer of Profound Heaven cultivator could kill them all off, so how could it be possible for a 5th layer of Bone Tempering Zhuo Fan?
Zhuo Fan easily saw through them and smiled, “You call a 5th layer Profound Heaven expert and above strong? Ha-ha-ha, they didn’t look like it. From the mental point of you that is!”
Zhuo Fan pointed at his noggin, with disdain, “Let’s take it from the top. Merry Woods’ elders were retards, no question about it. I mean, who the hell closes his eyes when laying an ambush? I had an easy time getting behind them and making sure their eyes forever remained closed. He-he-he, guess that’s where Merry Woods excels at. All the merrying got to their heads till they went crazy! “
Pff!
Iris Overseer and Peony Overseer stifled their laughter, while Lin Rufeng was red as a crab.
Yan Bogong and You Wanshan threw him a condemning look, [Is that the kind of fools you should be sending?]
“As for Regent Estate, humph, they’re too complacent, always looking down on me. You tell me, am I someone to be underestimated? As for the end of all arrogant elders, I’m sure you gentlemen can easily figure it out.” Zhuo Fan flicked his nose.
They all approved in their hearts. If Regent Estate had a fault, that would be conceit. Although when taking their power into consideration, that wasn’t much of a weakness really.
But before a freak like Zhuo Fan, they’d be no different than lambs to the slaughter.
“What of my 3rd and 4th elders?” You Wanshan barked.
Zhuo Fan snickered and dissed him, “Valley Lord You, chill, of course they died too. But you can’t blame me for that. Who told them to be ponces? All I could do was fulfill their cherished wish and send them on their merry way together, to never part even in afterlife, he-he-he... “
“What?!”
You Wanshan trembled. He already knew this would be the case, but it was hard to accept this fact until Zhuo Fan had to spell it out for him.
Hell Valley’s 5th elder, was boiling mad. Zhuo Fan already robbed his arm, and now two of his brothers. He was outraged, “Zhuo Fan, it’s either you or me!”
“Tch, that’s my line!” Zhuo Fan quipped in mockery.
Chu Bijun’s group was filled with shock. This was their general reaction ever since they heard two elders from Merry Woods got killed.
After all, Zhuo Fan killed four and crippled one back in Drifting Flowers City, having long shocked the world.
But then, they heard how Hell Valley and Regent Estate’s elders suffered the same fate, despite Regent Estate’s elders being far stronger than Diamondback Ape.
This clearly pointed out the other two houses’ elders were by no means weak.
And even with all that, he killed all six of them perfectly, coming out of it without so much as a scratch. This was the real reason for their shock.
Especially to Chu Bijun, who just woke up, finding it hard to cope to a world that changed so greatly so quickly. The revered seven houses were not only taunted but ridiculed to such a degree!
A storm was brewing one that would shuffle the ranks of the seven houses.
Chu Bijun’s eyes trembled. Her gaze was fixed on Zhuo Fan, however, as they glinted...

chapters.title: Chapter 203, Borrowing Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 203, Borrowing Power
“Zhuo Fan, you rotten punk, today I will bury you!”
Wailing like a banshee, You Wanshan glared at Zhuo Fan with bloodshot eyes. Yan Bogong and Lin Rufeng were also releasing their bloodthirst.
Long Yifey and Xie Xiaofeng held their guard up. Since Zhuo Fan was safe, of course they’d to jump to his rescue. The same thought ran through Chu Bijun’s mind as well. For Drifting Flowers Edifice’s benefit, Zhuo Fan had to come out unharmed.
It all became a stand off in an instant, as six house lords surrounded Zhuo Fan as they were on guard regarding each other’s reaction; each out of their own selfish desire. Meanwhile, Zhuo Fan was peachy, taking but a light jump backward and through the city gates. He then pointed at You Wanshan in taunt, “You old farts, come and get me if you have the guts! You won’t get to touch a single hair of mine regardless of where we’d been. That goes especially here, in my domain. Well, any takers?”
“Zhuo Fan!”
You Wanshan had long lost his patience with Zhuo Fan’s taunts, roaring as he charged after him with the others.
With so many Profound Heaven experts burning to eat his heart out, even Zhuo Fan felt somewhat overwhelmed.
Chu Bijun’s group rushed to block them, but You Wanshan’s team were long since prepared.
“Rainbow Cloud Palm!”
Yan Bogong was the furthest behind, turning around and spreading his arms. The seven colored mists flew at Chu Bijun and others, making the stop and withdraw in panic.
“Split up!”
“Ha-ha-ha, quite clever!” Yan Bogong laughed with pride. But seeing the rest of You Wanshan’s group going after Zhuo Fan, the anxiety ramped up in Chu Bijun.
Regardless how outstanding Zhuo Fan was, or how many Profound Heaven experts he got under his belt, none of them believed it to be from a head on fight, but earned through cunning and subterfuge. This time, You Wanshan’s team was all going after him.
In this desperate situation, even with Zhuo Fan’s godly skills, his chance at life would be slim at best.
Yet, for some odd reason, Zhuo Fan’s was as relaxed as ever, even having time to throw them his trademark evil grin.
This sounded off an alarm in the enraged mind of You Wanshan. As to why, he couldn’t quite put his finger on it.
Whoosh!
Suddenly, with a booming sound, a bluish light landed smack in the center of Windgaze City’s gates. You Wanshan’s team was in mid flight when a wave of bluish power erupted from the light and sending them barreling.
When they recovered, they looked upon a ten foot long bluish crescent blade, having seven foot long hilt engraved with a blue dragon and a three foot long blade shooting blinding red rays. It spoke of its thirst of tasting the blood of everyone it touched.
And on the blade was a shimmering silver dragon image.
You Wanshan’s team cried in fear, “6th-grade spiritual weapon, Dragonslaying Crescent Blade!”
“Ha-ha-ha, You Wanshan, I didn’t think you’d recognize my trusted battle companion!” An aged voice boomed, followed by Dugu Zhantian floating next to the crescent blade.
Picking it up as if it was nothing, the blade started ringing out dragonic roars.
The Four Tigers of Tianyu brought Luo Yunhai to Zhuo Fan. They were glaring at You Wanshan’s team, releasing their imposing auras all the while.
Scalp numb, You Wanshan never considered this scenario. For Tianyu’s great Marshal, God of War Dugu Zhantian, to descend upon Windgaze City, a backwater town.
Chu Bijun’s group were slackjawed from the sudden turn of events.
“Marshal, this is between us and the punk. I hope you won’t meddle!” You Wanshan’s brow trembled, his mood sinking dangerously low.
Making a half swing with the blade, Dugu Zhantian roared, “Ha-ha-ha, that’s rich! The Emperor ordered me to defend Windgaze City, and you’re implying your casual words carry more weight than His Majesty’s? Humph, You Wanshan, the seven houses’ prestige must have gotten to your head and forgot your place!”
“What, the Emperor’s edict?”
You Wanshan shuddered, his face white as paper. The hearts of the other house leaders hit rock bottom.
The whole purpose of Windgaze City operation was to test the imperial family’s bottom line. If the Luo clan fell to ruins and the imperial family gave a cold shoulder, then they’d ramp up their already obnoxious arrogance to swallow whole every other houses while completely disregarding the imperial family.
But now they met face to face with God of War Dugu Zhantian of the frontier. This was Emperor’s warning to the seven houses, to stay in line.
This time, they really went and groped a tiger’s butt!
You Wanshan sighed, filled with grievances. He didn’t want to grope anything, but the Regent Estate made him.
Now that the tiger left the mountain, Regent Estate would shirk off the blame, falling in the background, while letting them take the fall. The emperor would then make a harsh example of these three houses.
The three house leaders looked at each other’s eyes, ready to explode in tears.
Chu Bijun’s group was elated at their misery. For the first time in a century, the imperial family stood their ground. This should curb Regent Estate’s arrogance in the future.
At the very least, it would greatly delay their plan to swallow the seven houses.
Grumbling, You Wanshan cupped his hands, “Marshal, knowing that you stand guard at Windgaze City, I shall not cross into it. However, Zhuo Fan killed many of our elders and even crippled my 5th elder’s arm. I ask that you hand him over for us to handle. This great favor will one day be repaid by our three houses.”
Since goin in Windgaze City was out, ripping Zhuo Fan apart wasn’t that bad of a trade off.
Frowning, Dugu Zhantian turned his incredulous eyes to Zhuo Fan, as if seeing him for the first time, “Is what he said, true?”
The Four Tigers of Tianyu, were also looking at him in amazement.
At first they were impressed such a youth could hold the position of steward in a clan. It was a rare occurrence indeed.
But who’d ever stop to think that this kid was so incredible, so outrageous, that he would kill so many of seven houses’ elders.
Perhaps telling them now that Zhuo Fan didn’t just stop at killing elders and went a step further in slaughtering Regent Estate’s second young master, might perhaps cause their brains to stop working.
“Well...”
Zhuo Fan was caught in the middle. So he chose another path, that of pulling Luo Yunhai forward and cursing at You Wanshan, “What are you droning on about? Do you know how close we are with Marshal Dugu, uh? How dare you have such gall as to ask Marshal Dugu to hand me over? That is outrageous!”
All were too dumbstruck to even reply.
[Dugu Zhantian had lived his life by the blade, fighting day in day out on the border. You have no relation to him, zero! So how damn close could you possibly be?!]
Then came Zhuo Fan’s laughter in response to their thought. He patted Luo Yunhai’s shoulder, “Humph, bunch of ignorant fools is what you are! Our young master is Luo Yunhai, Marshal Dugu’s fifth godson!”
Say what?!
The dull and shocked stares creaked towards Dugu Zhantian. The grand and mighty God of War, second of Four Pillars, Dugu Zhantian, just up and took a third rate clan’s young master? Could this relation get any more inappropriate than this?
Despite being done in a not so honorable way and barely a half a month old, Dugu Zhantian was forced to nod.
What a shocker!
For Luo clan to hug such a big tree was like a pheasant turning into a phoenix. Regarding fame, Luo Yunhai would be no less than at the level of the seven houses’ geniuses!
“Kid, don’t push it!” Knowing where Zhuo Fan was going, Dugu Zhantian gave the brat a warning.
Zhuo Fan chuckled in response, borrowing the man’s power to lay it down even thicker, “You Wanshan, you got any idea who I am? I’m the great Luo clan’s steward, the trusted aid of young miss and young master. Asking for Marshal to hand me over is the same as asking for my young master, the same to having Marshal hand over one of his four generals. Now you tell me, will Marshal ever agree to that? Will young master? Will our million strong Dugu Army?”
That had the expected effect of driving fear into their very bones.
[Just how did a simple matter got a million warriors in the mix? How? This guy would stoop to anything!]
“Furthermore, you even dare ask Marshal to hand me over? Humph, how then are your houses going to answer for the slaughtering you did in the Luo clan not a few days ago?” Zhuo Fan held his chest with pain in his voice, he cried, and he sniffed, “Oh, my poor hundred thousand unfortunate souls of my clan, how could you maniacs have robbed them from us...”
Pff!
You Wanshan was holding back the blood threatening to come out. The Sun and Cai clans acted as his eyes and ears in Windgaze City, so he at least knew the basic facts about Luo clan.
[What hundred thousand men?! Your third rate clan never had them! Stop talking rubbish! Not even the Seven Noble Houses has that many people!]
The cheeks of every one there started twitching and dark clouds loomed over their faces. Even Long Yifey, who was the most friendly with Zhuo Fan, scratched his head dazed.
[I get you’re framing them, but can’t you be a bit more realistic?]
Oh, but Zhuo Fan was just getting started, raining charges on the poor blokes, “Outside of the vile and inhuman slaughter you’ve lowered yourselves to, your greatest crime is disobeying Tianyu’s most brilliant, wises, amazing, and sacred holy Emperor. Our holy Emperor had explicitly stated this area banned for the seven houses, but you dare come throwing it in chaos. This is no longer disobedience, but plain insurrection!”
“Marshal Dugu, as the nation most esteemed patriot, how could you ever allow such conduct to take place before your very eyes? You must strike at once, take their heads and make them pay their crimes! The emperor would certainly not punish you for ridding the empire of this foul beasts!”
“Yeah, godfather, I shall go bring the soldiers here to crush Hell Valley and protect the sanctity of our holy Emperor, your patriotic heart, the people’s hope.” Striking while the iron was hot, Luo Yunhai cupped his hands and asked Dugu Zhantian for permission to go fetch the million head Dugu Army.
Dugu Zhantian felt like cursing right now, [How did these two brats’ topic ended with sicking the army on Hell Valley? This isn’t a joke, but the start of civil war!]
You Wanshan’s team was dumbfounded. Their demand was perfectly reasonable, to settle their grudge with Zhuo Fan. How did it degenerate to making Dugu Zhantian going after them and even sending the million strong army for their heads?
You Wanshan looked at the rest and saw that everyone was sweating buckets.
If these kids spurred Dugu Zhantian long enough, those brats would really get to make him send the army to uproot the millennia long foundation of Hell Valley...
Silavin: Damn. I had a good laugh.
Though, it made me wonder, why on NovelUpdate, this novel is rated so low? Like 3.7? Are we even reading the same novel?
Well, maybe they were reading the MTL version shared online, which means, they don’t even understand the humour.
Though, what do you guys think?

chapters.title: Chapter 204, The Dispossessed
chapters.content:
Chapter 204, The Dispossessed
“Marshal Dugu, you mustn’t go believing these brats’ nonsense and look at things from another perspective. Civil war, people dying left and right. I’m sure you want to avoid that from happening.”
You Wanshan rushed to cup his hands to Dugu Zhantian and spoke anxiously. The others from his team watched tense for any change in Marshal’s expression.
If Dugu Zhantian was going to storm Hell Valley, then the next to follow would be their houses.
The atmosphere suddenly took a heavy tone, making it hard to even breathe.
Dugu Zhantian stroked his beard, and when Zhuo Fan saw him move his arm dismissively, he jumped in action, “Humph, Valley Lord You, the nerve on you, to dare command Marshal who to attack and who to hand over! You must already be taking those million soldiers as yours!”
You Wanshan sent all his hatred in his glare at Zhuo Fan. He would’ve long since jumped Zhuo Fan and kill this thorn in his side by now if Dugu Zhantian wasn’t there to help it.
Funny enough, Dugu Zhantian’s mind worked the same. He was clenching his fists wishing he could beat some sense into this egotistical parvenu for using his army. Only emperor’s edict to protect Luo clan stopped him from chocking the life of this damn punk.
[My army is not Hell Valley’s, and it’s most certainly not yours. You damn steward, who do you think you are to represent my army when trying to show off? You even go as far as threaten the grand Seven Noble Houses! Are you dying to start a civil war?]
Thank god for Zhuo Fan, You Wanshan and Dugu Zhantian had no clue of the other’s thoughts or they’d be shaking on it while putting an end to the kid’s play.
You Wanshan took deep breaths to push down the anger and bring out the calm. He chose to relinquish his house lord’s demeanor, and cupped his hands, speaking in a difficult tone, “Marshal Dugu, let us all just take a step back. Since you defend Windgaze City, we won’t dare to intrude. As for Zhuo Fan, we don’t want him. I am willing to do this for you and forget about today. What do you say?”
“Valley Lord, that punk killed...” 5th elder shouted, but You Wanshan snapped, “Quiet, can’t you see Marshal Dugu is in charge here?”
th elder turned from Dugu Zhantian to the mocking Zhuo Fan and stormed away outraged.
Understanding where Hell Valley was going and not wanting to see this spiral further out of control, Dugu Zhantian sighed with a nod.
While all people there wanted love and peace, there was one who burned to see the two sides like oil and water.
So he butted in just as Dugu Zhantian was about to conclude this affair with a laugh, “Valley Lord You, you must be dreaming if you think you’re getting away that easy! Have you forgotten the hundred thousand men you killed in my clan, those pitiful lost souls unable to find peace...”
“Shut up!
But Dugu Zhantian and You Wanshan snapped at him in unison. Reeling, Zhuo Fan knew when to quit, so he quietly stood there, not making even a peep, like an angel.
His action made other feel mortified.
[This kid will stoop to any low, uncaring of appearances, a true parvenu. His talent is a damn waste as a steward.]
Dugu Zhantian stammered. He saw Zhuo turned from a biting dog into an adorable kitty, as if all that brash talk was not said, and was lost for words. In the end he cupped his hands, “You Wanshan, then we shall let this matter rest here. However, I do feel the need of reminding you, Valley Lord You, this empire is under Yuwen ruling, not your backyard!”
“I shall keep in mind Marshal’s counsel. Farewell!” You Wanshan gave one last salute and left with the others. Yet just a few steps after, his eerie tone came, “Marshal, on your way to Windgaze City, have you perhaps met some of my men?”
“Uh...” Dugu Zhantian was about to shake his head.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes sparkles like stars and grabbed hold of this golden ticket with a snicker and stepped up, “Valley Lord You, Marshal’s four generals are of immense valor, how could they waste time on nobodies? Ha-ha-ha, I urge you to got back and look after their families, and put a stop to your men’s reckless behavior. Windgaze City isn’t a place where you can come and go as you please.”
