[Women doll up for their men, and this is the men’s attitude? Humph, why would any woman do it if not to attract men? Especially towards the one they love, the woman will want to look at their prettiest.]
Even if the man spoke of loving her wholly. She never wanted to let him see her ugly side.
Zhuo Fan saw through it so he raised their love higher. Then made her return to her old and ugly appearance. He wasn’t aiming at the old guy from the start, but the old hag instead.
First came the bashing of the old hag’s mental walls, and later came the defeat of the old guy.
Zhuo Fan snickered, hopped on Xue Qingjian and mocked, “He-he-he, sister, you don’t much look like a sister now, do you? More like a granny if you ask me...”
“Don’t say it, please...” Xue Qingjian cried as she covered her face.
Qiu Yanhai cursed, “Beast, stop this instant or you’ll be sorry!”
“Sorry? Ha-ha-ha... your lives are in my hands yet you dare take that tone with me?” Zhuo Fan snickered as his hand grabbed Xue Qingjian’s sash, “You old pair of farts, do you believe me when I say that I can make this old hag look even more unsightly? Though I have no interest in seeing and let your old goat eyes feast on her alone. But I can’t help but wonder, just how interested are you, old man, in this sister’s fine body?”
Zhuo Fan punctuated by a light pulling.
“No!” Xue Qingjian cried, her eyes already rolling in her skull. Qiu Yanhai was tearing up, sobbing a plea, “S-Steward Zhuo, we submit. Please, just let her go. Don’t shame us any more, I beg you...”
Qiu Yanhai, a mighty expert, was crying like a child, earning sympathy from any who would see him. Zhuo Fan turned to Xue Qingjian, to see the old hag nodding through her tears as well.
Zhuo Fan switched to a cheerful smile on the spot, “Was that so hard? You could’ve done this from the start and spare yourself the suffering. Please rise, elders. Oh~, how can anyone be so cruel to you, elders? I have with me some healing pills. Kindly take them, elders!”
Zhuo Fan suddenly turned bipolar, as if his previous demonic him was a different personality. He helped the two up with the proper respect and gave them a vial.
The old couple was scared witless. Seeing the vial they suddenly broke out in shivers. They recoiled and shook their heads vehemently. They dreaded any more of Zhuo Fan’s pills.
But Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow and snapped, “You dare refuse my pills?”
Shuddering again, the couple creaked over, and took the pills under Zhuo Fan’s watchful eye.
Zhuo Fan beamed again. In this way, the Luo clan just got itself another pair of obedient elders.
Witnessing everything, Li Jingtian’s heart shook to the core. [Steward Zhuo is an abomination to make these powerful experts crumble from his cruel ways in a matter of minutes. He is as demonic as it gets.]
He was grateful to high heaven for changing sides as fast as he did. Or with Steward Zhuo’s cruel methods, who knew what boundless humiliation he would be showered with.
At that point he’d have no reputation to speak of, ran thoroughly through the mud...

chapters.title: Chapter 213, Deterrence
chapters.content:
Chapter 213, Deterrence
After six hours, Qiu Yanhai and Xue Qingjian opened their eyes, having mostly healed their injuries. Xue Qingjian returned to her youth, to the beaming Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian at the side.
Now that the couple got up, Zhuo Fan came to them with a friendly laughter, “I guess congratulations are in order, for your recovery. Now let us all return to the clan.”
Shivering inside, the two staggered backward in fear.
“Uh, don’t look at me like I’m the enemy here. We’re all on the same side now, no?” Zhuo Fan shrugged and smiled at Xue Qingjian, “Sister, did you already forget how close we ‘siblings’ are?”
Swallowing dryly, Xue Qingjian scampered behind Qiu Yanhai, like a mouse afraid of the cat. But the eyes held an unmistakable hatred overshadowed by immense fear.
Glaring at him, Xue Qingjian spat, “Who’s your sister? I must’ve been blind to not see you’ve got the demon in you!”
True enough, since she took Zhuo Fan as a naive child who barely opened his eyes to the world. Who’d have thought this pup was in control of the famous Mad Dipper.
He had no scruples and such vile schemes that had even this famed pair of monsters shiver in fear! How the hell was that a little brother? A demon from hell was more like it.
Xue Qingjian was regretting having been swept by Zhuo Fan’s sweet smile and sophistry. She was itching to gouge his eyes out and squash them!
Zhuo Fan was becoming irritated. Qiu Yanhai saw his mood sink and urged, “Steward Zhuo, please calm yourself. My old hag is raving. Don’t mind her!”
“Nevermind then, your lives are in my hands anyway. It’s your choice if you want to get along with me. Now that you’re Luo clan’s elders, it’s time we move!”
Zhuo Fan ignored them and unfolded his Lightning Wings as he took to the skies.
Seeing the demon take flight, the pair breathed easier, yet looked close to breaking down in tears.
They who lived free in a mountain, they, who fended off even Regent Estate’s threats, how was it they had fallen so low, in the hands of a twerp?
They couldn’t make one sense of it all...
Li Jingtian walked to them and mocked, “Didn’t you laugh at me saying I have no guts, old man? Well, where’s yours?”
Smiling dejectedly, Qiu Yanhai shook his head and sighed, “I was at fault before. I didn’t expect you to be so powerful!”
“Ha-ha-ha, as long as you know!” Li Jingtian said, “But I am a man of immense willpower, and not under complete control of the Bloodworm. And the ones I ever followed never were ordinary! Try to look beyond Steward Zhuo’s young looks. He does everything with calm and precision. Fierce tactics are a powerful man’s tools. You won’t lose out by following him!”
The two nodded after a long time.
“And since we’ll be working together in the future, I’ll let you in on the basics to survive in the Luo clan!” Making sure Zhuo Fan was far enough, Li Jingtian whispered.
The couple had their ears peeled, “Please tell us, brother Li! “
“Except for Steward Zhuo, anyone in the Luo clan are good people to get close to, especially our young miss. She is a must to win over. Steward Zhuo may be all about power play, looking down on all, but he is always devoted to the Luo clan. He will more often than not listen to young miss. So, if you ever get on his bad side, rush to the young miss and have her plead your case. That gets you off the punishment almost completely!” Li Jingtian patted Qiu Yanhai’s shoulder, while giving the two a serious look.
The two were immensely grateful as they cupped their hands, “Thank you, brother Li!”
“It’s nothing. We are all in the same boat, you can dispense the courtesy. Ha-ha-ha...” Li Jingtian waved.
Was he actually that caring? Of course not. The two were ignorant of the Luo clan’s matters, but would figure it out easily in the first three days anyway.
He reminded them earlier since this favor came cheap and saw no reason not to have them owe him one.
[Just when did I begin turning into such a vicious man?]
He sighed and suddenly scratched his head, [Guess environment changes the man...]
At the gates of the imperial capital, Marshal Dugu was sitting astride his large horse and entering the city with his five godsons. The million strong army was stationed ten miles out.
The news of Dugu Zhantian’s return, the second of the Four Pillars to the court, was soon on the lips of every citizen!
“Your Majesty, Marshal Dugu is seeking an audience!”
“Enter!”
In the golden palace of the imperial capital, the emperor was sitting on a lavish throne. Next to him was the man he often played chess with, Mr. Sima.
Dugu Zhantian entered with large steps and bowed, “Dugu Zhantian greets Your Majesty. May you have a long and prosperous life!”
“Ha-ha-ha, Marshal Dugu has come from far away. You must be weary, please sit!” With a chuckle, the emperor walked to Dugu Zhantian and helped him to a chair.
Any man would feel immensely grateful and honored. But Dugu Zhantian found it a matter of fact. He was after all a pillar of the empire. Wouldn’t a man like him receive at least this much from the emperor?
“Marshal Dugu, how is the situation in Windgaze City?” Dugu Zhantian just took a seat and the emperor already started inquiring.
Dugu Zhantian sighed, “The circumstances are poor I’m afraid. I have rushed to the rescue per the imperial edict but I was late. Windgaze City had been under a terrible battle, in which the Luo clan lost a hundred thousand men...”
Pff!
Watching Dugu Zhantian speak in such a grave tone, the emperor’s heart sank. Then he heard him mention Luo clan’s ‘losses’ and spurted blood.
“Marshal Dugu, how can a third rate clan like the Luo clan have a hundred thousand men?” The emperor exclaimed, then cursed inside, [Even me, who has rarely been outside the palace knows it. How come you have no common sense!], “Marshal, did you see it yourself?”
“Uh, no, actually. But when Luo clan’s steward reported it, I also found it odd..”
“That steward is Zhuo Fan!” The emperor’s face twitched. [Of course it’s him again. That brat is nothing but trouble. Speaking of so many casualties as if it’s the order of the day.]
Dugu Zhantian nodded, “Your Majesty is wise. It is indeed Steward Zhuo who told me of Luo clan’s casualties. I was also skeptical in trusting this man’s careless talk. How can a small clan have so many people? Not even the seven houses have so many. But Luo clan’s losses were indeed great in that battle, with even their Clan Head falling victim!”
The emperor held his head and sighed, “Marshal, Luo Clan Head is dead for almost three years now...”
“What?!” Dugu Zhantian was shocked, then he went beet red. [Damn those wretched brats, they played me! But that’s not the issue here. The problem is they made a fool of me in front of the emperor.]
[Zhuo Fan, Yunhai, I will get you for this!] Dugu Zhantian gnashed his teeth.
The emperor shook his head, knowing he’d been had, “Never mind then. Please tell me what you can about the Luo clan, Marshal.”
Dugu Zhantian was startled, then lowered his head in shame.
From the moment he entered the Luo clan, all he’d heard about it was from Zhuo Fan’s mouth, not getting the time to do his own investigation. And when it came to reporting, Zhuo Fan’s words didn’t look as truthful now. He realized he knew next to nothing about the Luo clan!
Noticing his plight, the emperor didn’t know whether to laugh or cry, [Why did you even go to Windgaze City for? Are you just as sloppy with your enemy’s intelligence as well?]
“Nevermind then!” The emperor sighed, “Are the Luo clan’s Luo Yunhai and Luo Yunchang alright?”
“Uh, they’re completely fine!” Dugu Zhantian spoke.
“Then what of Captain Pang Yi, their elder Lei Yuntian and his goddaughter Lei Yuting...”
Dugu Zhantian started answering all the questions the emperor had regarding the Luo clan’s higher ups. In the end the emperor nodded, “Since they are fine, the Luo clan suffered no losses! But this clan sure is capable, to still be standing despite the ever watchful eyes of Regent Estate and Hell Valley!”
“Uh, Your Majesty, outside Blackwind Mountain, where Luo clan is located, there are four 5th-grade arrays placed by the Clan Head. A normal expert would find it hard to infiltrate!” Dugu Zhantian added.
The emperor raised an eyebrow, then sent a shocking glance to Mr. Sima, “This Zhuo Fan kid is more and more impressive. I heard he could set arrays, but never imagined he could set four 5th-grade ones!”
“What, they were done by Zhuo Fan?” Dugu Zhantian cried out.
Sighing, the emperor only glanced at the old man, [Just what have you been up to in Windgaze City? I asked you here to give me a report, but why is it me explaining things to you instead?]
The emperor continued, “The Luo clan lost everything, even their Clan Head three years ago, leaving only the siblings, steward, and Captain Pang Yi behind. The current Luo clan has been brought about by Zhuo Fan. And it’s this kid...”
The emperor began recounting Zhuo Fan’s acts of troublemaking through the empire. Once he finished with the mess he left in Drifting Flowers Edifice, he added, “This kid is a rare talent, but a pity he’s too volatile. He makes me like him and hate him all at the same time. Luo clan’s problems are due to him. But it is also he who made the Luo clan stand tall. I just can’t tell if this bizarre steward is a blessing or calamity for the Luo clan!”
Blinking, Dugu Zhantian was speechless. He never took Zhuo Fan as an array master! As for all the stunts he pulled, Dugu Zhantian couldn’t care less.
[Hell, what soldier doesn’t pull stunts? Skill is all that matters! I must have him in my camp.]
Dugu Zhantian’s mind was set!
“By the way, Marshal, is there anything else you’d like to report?” The emperor had no expectation at this point, but still asked.
Dugu Zhantian rushed to say, “Yes, it involves the Hell Valley and two other houses’ evidence of attacking the Luo clan. Please make a decision, Your Majesty. These three houses had tried going into Windgaze City while I was there!”
Dugu Zhantian took the three jade slips out. The emperor’s eyes lit up and laughed, “With this evidence I’ll finally take them down a notch! Did you see Regent Estate there as well?”
Dugu Zhantian shook his head, “Among the seven houses’ house lords’ group I saw in Windgaze City, none were from Regent Estate!”
“I see. That cousin of mine sure likes to hide all traces. He’s sure to plan something insidious!” Throwing away the three jade slips, the emperor barked, “Humph, I will use these three houses as a testament to my power. Let all see who is the true ruler of these lands...”

chapters.title: Chapter 214, The Dreaded Divine Dragons
chapters.content:
Chapter 214, The Dreaded Divine Dragons
Hell Valley was a place ever shrouded in thick and eerie mist. Today, however, was an exceptionally sunny day and cleared the view somewhat.
Despite the warm glow of the sun promised joy, the Hell Valley’s denizens’ hearts were in a haze!
In the meeting hall, You Wanshan sat in his chair with elders on either side. The empty seats among the rows of elders were a dead giveaway to their sombre mood.
They were grimly reminded of their losses!
It had been two years since their wisest elder, You Guiqi, was killed. In this time, the valley sent their best in getting revenge for such a heavy blow.
The irony was, instead of the corpse of their most hated enemy, Zhuo Fan, being brought, even more losses were added to the pile!
Putting aside their very first elder losses in Windgaze City, because of Zhuo Fan as well, after You Guiqi fell, the headcount slowly included 3rd elder, 4th elder, 6th elder. Even 5th elder didn’t escape unscathed, having his arm ripped out.
Hell Valley was in a precarious situation, with half of their 12 elders gone and one crippled. All while Zhuo Fan was live and kicking. This was something hard to accept.
It was utter humiliation!
None foresaw they would take a blow as they did three centuries ago. Their thousand year old legacy, their seven houses dignity was poked and taunted at every turn.
Bam!
You Wanshan slammed the table, and all could hear his grinding teeth. Everyone was filled with the same hatred, especially 5th elder. He touched his wounded shoulder as fire threatens to escape his eyes every time he cursed one name over and over in his mind.
Zhuo Fan!
But they were now stuck. They pushed the imperial family too far and the latter summoned Marshal Dugu to drive fear into them. If they made one wrong move, they’d soon be seeing Dugu Zhantian’s million army at their doorstep. And none could bear the brunt of such an aftermath.
Here they were, all wishing to charge into Windgaze City, to wring Luo clan and Zhuo Fan of their blood, but none had the nerve to do it.
Their very survival hanged in the balance!
This was their conundrum.
The Grand Elder looked around him and sighed. The atmosphere was stifling...
“I can’t take it anymore. I have to put that bastard down for good!”
th elder was the one to break first. Eyes turned to him, but none replied, even though they all felt the same way. Anyone there knew the consequences of such an action.
Hum~
A sudden ripple brought with it the faint sound of a flute!
“Goddammit! Who dares be cheerful at such a wretched time? I’ll rip him apart!” 5th elder was at a boil, and the music only helped to spur his anger further.
But before he could go on the hunt, Grand Elder lifted his hand, fear shaking his very core, “Wait, t-this is Divine Dragon Fang Qiubai’s flute...”
“Jade Flute Divine Sword?!”
They were all started, with hearts in their throat. Even the enraged 5th elder slowly calmed down, his mouth hanging open from shock.
“Damn it all! What is that Jade Flute Divine Sword doing here?” 5th elder turned to the rest.
You Wanshan sighed, filled with bitterness.
[Humph, why frickin’ else? Isn’t it the emperor who stuck him onto us? Just why has the decades wretched imperial family up and grown a backbone all of a sudden?]
You Wanshan felt like crying, but he braced for the meeting as he signaled for the elders to follow him outside Hell Valley.
At the entrance, the figure of the imposing and mighty Divine Dragons Fang Qiubai was playing a melodious tune on his flute!
When the sound stopped out of the blue, Fang Qiubai fiddled with the flute in his hand as he spoke coldly, “By order of the emperor, Valley Lord You is to immediately attend court!”
You Wanshan was furious.
The seven houses and imperial family were at an impasse, with both sides handling Tianyu’s affairs. Even when an edict came before to Hell Valley, it had always been presented with respect and courtesy.
It was clear that this time, the emperor sent the Divine Dragon with his edict. He even played the flute outside their valley to draw them out. It was a show of strength.
If they showed any fear, wouldn’t the emperor take an even harder stand when he saw him? No matter how sound his reason was, he still had to go. He wanted to have a long talk with the emperor. Shielding Zhuo Fan had many implications. Was the emperor setting himself the seven houses with this?
You Wanshan was filled with sudden boldness, “Mr. Fang has toiled coming here with the edict. Unfortunately, I have caught a cold and can only attend the court in a few months. Please show compassion!”
[A damn cold? This load of bull can’t get any more obvious than this!]
[Can a peak Profound Heaven expert even catch a cold? You’re clearly putting the emperor on the spot!]
The elders gave You Wanshan a nod. [That’s our Valley Lord! He’d use this excuse to tell that old goat we are Hell Valley of the seven houses! We’re not his dogs to order around...]
Boom!
An explosion jarred the ears of everyone, even as they were in awe of their Valley Lord. It was then followed by a fierce wind that picked up the dust.
Once the dust settled, everyone gasped.
The mountain range on Hell Valley’s side had vanished into thin air. In mid air, Fang Qiubai put away the jade flute, “You are to set out at once, Valley Lord You!”
The next second, he vanished, leaving the Hell Valley’s elders and You Wanshan pale from fright. The disappearing mountains struck a chord in everyone!
[Is this Divine Dragon Fang Qiubai’s power? It’s too damn insane! He has the power to obliterate Hell Valley all by himself!]
Whoosh!
Suddenly, an aged man in gray robe appeared. You Wanshan lit up at his coming, “Venerable, you arrived. Do you...”
“Of course I know. I only dared come after he left!” The Venerable sighed, “Valley Lord, we really did it this time. The emperor may be a paper tiger, but his five Divine Dragons are savage beasts by themselves! I’m saying that you... just go to court and apologize. The Emperor can no longer be offended!”
You Wanshan nodded, feeling forlorn and on the verge of tears.
[What’s wrong with us, Hell Valley? Someone barged in and yet we have to apologize...]
A week later, You Wanshan was punctual in his arrival to the imperial capital. A palace maid took him to a waiting room to await the emperor’s summon. This never ever happened before. How was it that it suddenly turned to them waiting on the emperor now?
He was helpless. Just who died and put the emperor in charge? He could only sigh, following after the maid.
And to add insult to injury, You Wanshan found two old friends in there already, Yan Bogong and Lin Rufeng.
The two smiled wryly at You Wanshan’s appearance.
The three were like children in detention, sitting there outside the director’s office, waiting for the emperor’s call!
“House Lord Lin, who came to Merry Woods?” With nothing better to do, You Wanshan started chatting.
Lin Rufeng shook his head and sighed, “Monochrome Chess Sage, Sima Hui!”
“Oh, the old guy plays chess all the time and cultivates his mind. His temper is the mildest among the five Divine Dragons. Jade Flute Divine Sword Fang Qiubai up and flattened the mountains on one of Hell Valley’s sides!”
“Mild my ass!”
Lin Rufeng started ranting with a mournful look, “That old geezer didn’t say a word as he entered Merry Woods and hurled chess pieces. Do you have any idea what that’s like? Every single strike was like a meteor impact. Doing it a few times had leveled half of Merry Woods! Now we only have half a millenia legacy! Then he pulled out the imperial decree, stating his hand slipped just then. So don’t go telling me he’s mild!”
Lin Rufeng felt sour and tearful. You Wanshan never thought there was anyone having it worse than Hell Valley!
“Ai, you two lucked out compared to Pill King Hall!”
Yan Bogong sighed, as if all his energy left him, “The ones you saw can still be called humans. While my envoy was downright savage. The entire Pill King Hall lays in ruins, with all our pills and ingredients picked clean...”
“What, eating all ingredients...”
The two cried out in shock, fear shining in their glassy eyes, “Hall Lord Yan, you truly had it worse than any of us. For the emperor to really let out that reckless little freak out means he had reached the limit of his rage...”
Yan Bogong nodded, “So painfully true!”
The three looked at each other and the room was filled with laments, puzzling the hell out of the guards outside.
Weren’t all seven house’s lords filled with brashness and contempt each time they came to the imperial capital? Why was it that this time they were like lambs going to the gallows? All they heard from the tree were wails and sighs...

chapters.title: Chapter 215, The Tiger Leaves the Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 215, The Tiger Leaves the Mountain
“House lords, His Majesty is summoning you!” After a six hour long wait, a guard finally came to this remote room.
The three sighed as if going to their funeral and followed the guard without any dissent.
Soon they came upon the palace’s gates. The guard bowed and gestured for them to enter. With a deep breath, the three slipped into the hall.
They saw the emperor dignified on his throne, with Sima Hui next to him. At the end of the stairs, in front of the throne, stood the tall and mighty Marshal Dugu.
The three swallowed dryly, feeling as if their hearts were in a vise when these men’s gazes landed on them.
“Valley Lord You, Hall Lord Yan, House Lord Lin, greets Your Majesty!” They showed utmost respect to the emperor.
The emperor nodded with a winning smile, “House lords, can you guess why I have summoned thee?”
“Uh...” They all shook their heads, “Your Majesty, we do not.”
Bam!
With a clang, three jade slips landed in front of them. The emperor tone dropped lower, “Humph, so you don’t know? Then do you at least know these jade slips?”
The three started sweating like pigs as they shivered a nod.
“In that case, do tell me why are you explicitly defying my edict, going into the area I deemed forbidden? Not even you, the seven houses, founding fathers of the empire have such rights!”
The emperor slapped the armrest of his throne, making the three slump into pleading on the ground in their knees, “Spare us, Your Majesty!”
This was unprecedented. The seven houses, house lords were, for the first time, on their knees before the emperor. The emperor raised an eyebrow, feeling freer than ever. As if returning to the time of his ascension to the throne, when all officials showed him utmost respect.
As a matter of fact, he was far more moved than before.
When has there ever been a case in the long history of Tianyu Empire of an emperor getting the seven house lords kneeling before them? It may very be the very first time since this nation came together.
Such honor lifted him above all other emperors before him.
However, he couldn’t let it show, or these three blokes would milk him for it!
So the emperor kept a hardened and cold face, though his tone sounded softer, “Thou are all ministers loyal to our nation. You are unlikely to resort to such disgraceful behavior without rime or reason. Please share with me your motives so I can judge if your actions were indeed unintentional mistakes!”
The three’s eyes lit up. [Is the emperor giving us a way out? All that we’ve been doing is because of that Zhuo Fan! As long as that fool dies, Luo clan and Windgaze City are of no importance.]
But before they could explain, Dugu Zhantian barked, “Speak, who’s behind you all?”
Shivering, the three choked on their words. They peeked at the emperor, only to see him sporting the same cold and calm face.
That was tantamount to saying Dugu Zhantian was voicing the emperor’s intentions. Since he couldn’t outright say it, he had Dugu Zhantian play his proxy.
The meaning was crystal clear. The emperor didn’t care why they went to Windgaze City, only wanting to know by whose orders they marched.
The emperor was aiming for Regent Estate and they were the means to an end, mere pawns.
They instantly broke out in cold sweat.
The emperor, a tiger cooped up in the palace all his life, was ready to go out and maul someone. But the problem was, Regent Estate wasn’t an easy target either, a fierce tiger on its own!
The three houses were now smack in the middle of the Regent Estate and the imperial family’s power struggle. Their only fate, sacrifices!
[Curse it to high heavens! How did we end up in this mess? If only we hadn’t listened to Regent Estate and attack Windgaze City. The imperial family would have no excuse to look for us.]
They now faced the heavy burden of choosing to let the emperor maul them or be used to maul the Regent Estate. But would the Regent Estate ever let them go afterward?
[Any choice promises death!]
The three were overwhelmed with regrets. They bit their lips, unsure what to say.
“Speak, who is behind you?” Dugu Zhantian barked and pressured them with his powerful soul.
If it were any other occasion, the three peak Profound Heaven experts could’ve stood firm, since they were on the verge of advancing to the Radiant Stage. But now, however, they were frightened, their spirit shaken. And this show of force broke through their mental walls, making their clenched jaws relax.
But then, a loud shout echoed.
“Regent Estate Lord, Huangpu Tianyuan and Prime Minister Zhuge Changfeng are requesting audience!”
Eyes widening, the emperor and the other two men were shocked.
For the Estate Lord to burst in at such a crucial time, his intention had to be premeditated. More importantly, why was he coming along with Zhuge Changfeng?
This spelled trouble.
The three house lords heard Huangpu Tianyuan was coming and re-tightened their jaws.
[Thank god Regent Estate was scared of getting involved in this so they came to the rescue. We’d been done for otherwise!]
You Wanshan breathed in and calmed his heart.
The emperor narrowed his eyes, “Let them in!”
“This damn tiger can no longer sit on his mountain!” Sima Hui muttered. The emperor nodded with a grave expression.
“Estate Lord Huangpu Tianyuan, Prime Minister Zhuge Changfeng, Regent Estate’s Steward Leng, and Regent Estate’s High Venerable Huangpu Fenglei greets Your Majesty!”
Four people entered the hall. Walking behind Huangpu Tianyuan and Zhuge Changfeng, were two more. One of them was an old yet stout man that made even Divine Dragon Sima Hui’s eyes tremble.
[What is Regent Estate’s number one expert, High Venerable Huangpu Fenglei doing here?]
Sima Hui gasped, feeling the peak Radiant Stage power the old man was releasing. His cultivation was not one bit less than the five Divine Dragons’.
Huangpu Fenglei noticed Sima Hui as well, giving a smile in return, one with mockery and taunt!
“Oh my, house lords, the seven houses have always been on the same footing as the imperial family. I know you all respect Your Majesty so, but there’s no need for you to kneel! Others might grossly misunderstand and think His Majesty intends to suppress the seven houses, going against ancestor’s rule and bringing him shame. Up up up, come now, you can’t have His Majesty suffer such injustice!”
After bowing to the emperor, Zhuge Changfeng went to help the three house lords with a smile. The emperor clenched his fists and gnashed his teeth.
The emperor didn’t allow them to rise, but Zhuge Changfeng dared help them out of his own initiative. His intentions couldn’t be clearer. But since Zhuge Changfeng’s reason was very sound, the emperor could do nothing to vent his anger.
This was how Zhuge Changfeng usurped the emperor’s prestige, while raising the three house lords’ by getting them to their feet. That was because they had the Regent Estate backing them, helping ease their fears.
At that moment, the emperor group’s pressure exerted on the house lords went up in smoke. Using the same excuse again would no longer work.
[You’re good, Zhuge Changfeng, I’ll give you that!]
The emperor cursed inside but didn’t let it show. He turned to Huangpu Tianyuan laughing, “Cousin, you’ve been away from the imperial capital for decades. What could have brought you here today?”
“Your Majesty, I have come to confess!” Huangpu Tianyuan bowed.
The emperor’s brow shook. Despite not understanding, he added, “Cousin, I do not understand! Regent Estate is kin to the imperial family and always proper, defending the Caged Dragon City in the imperial family’s stead. What possible reason is there for you to confess? What crime?”
“Your Majesty, your patronizing tone terrifies me so! “
Huangpu Tianyuan clenched his fists and said humbly, “The seven houses have assisted the imperial family for a thousand years and bring peace to Tianyu. But the three houses dared defy your decree, entering the area Your Majesty deigned forbidden and causing the people to lament. I, Regent Estate, the head of the seven houses, have failed in my duties and deserve to be punished!”
Crack!
The emperor’s fingers let out a sudden sound, as his face only sank lower.
Since the founding of the empire, the seven houses and the imperial family had been at peace, but the duty of reining in the seven houses fell to the imperial family. But for Huangpu Tianyuan to dare utter such responsibility, he did no damn crime. He was overreaching in his power play to gain more status.
But over the millennium, the Regent Estate had been the head of the seven houses, a truth the emperor could not refute. His only choice was to stew in anger!
“Cousin this is too much of a burden for you. How can I let you take the three houses’ crime onto yourself?” The emperor stated.
“Yeah, Estate Lord Huangpu. Regent Estate may stand at the top of the seven houses and should indeed take responsibility for them. But since lord wishes to take their crimes onto yourself, you’d be placing yourself in peril. Furthermore, the three houses’ crime may not be as heavy for you to take it upon yourself!” Zhuge Changfeng revealed a wicked grin as he eyed the emperor.
Widening his eyes, the emperor smiled coldly, “Is the Prime Minister implying that I am wrong?”
“I wouldn’t dream of it. Your Majesty is not wrong in the least. Just that this matter is so minor...”
Zhuge Changfeng’s contempt was clear to all. The emperor was enraged, on the verge of blowing a fuse...

chapters.title: Chapter 216, Exploit
chapters.content:
Chapter 216, Exploit
“So according to you, Zhuge Changfeng, openly defying an imperial edict is a trifle?” Dugu Zhantian spoke coldly with a booming voice, “If everyone does it, what would become of the imperial family’s dignity?”
Brushing away his outburst with a smile and a wave, Zhuge Changfeng shook his head, “Marshal, ease your anger. That is not what I meant at all. Defying the imperial edict has and always will be a serious crime. But in the case where the ruler is rash and tyrannical...”
“Say that again!?” Dugu Zhantian barked.
Zhuge Changfeng waved his hand with a dismissing smile, “Ha-ha-ha, Marshal need not be angry. I wasn’t speaking of His Majesty. His Majesty is an upstanding ruler. Even more than that, right?”
The emperor’s heart shivered, he and Sima Hui both snorting inside.
The three were putting the squeeze on the three house lords just to avoid this particular mess. Only so they could hold one over the Regent Estate. But now, Zhuge Changfeng had breached this topic and the emperor couldn’t stay silent.
The emperor gave a curt nod for them to elaborate on the reason behind this mess.
The three house lords straightened their backs and cupped their hands, “Your Majesty, all that transpired is due to one man, Windgaze City’s Luo clan’s steward, Zhuo Fan.”
You Wanshan then followed with painting Zhuo Fan in a gruesome way and with flourishing detail.
The emperor simply sat there in his throne. He long knew of Zhuo Fan’s ‘adventures’ so why tell him again? Yet despite knowing, the emperor let Zhuo Fan cause all the trouble he wanted.
But now, all he wished was to avoid and bury this topic for good.
Once You Wanshan finished, Huangpu Tianyuan continued, “Your Majesty, this vile spawn defies the seven houses’ dignity. I beseech Your Majesty to lift the ban on Windgaze City and allow us to exact capital punishment on this wretched beast, to show the nation how upright Your Majesty is! “
This time the emperor was in a real bind. Instead of having the three houses turn on Regent Estate, the latter got to strike against the Luo clan and ruin his plans!
Tap, tap!
The emperor rapped his fingers on the armrest in deep thought, “Due to the havoc the Hell Valley and Veiled Dragon Pavilion had inflicted on the people three years ago in Windgaze City, I have elected to turn it into a forbidden ground. But I see that overlooking one man has caused endless suffering once again. My heart is in pain.”
They all knew where he was going with this, sporting large winning grins.
And sure enough, the emperor continued with, “I shall not look into your first offense, but you are not to step into Windgaze City again. If you want to catch that beast, you will have to wait for him to come out!”
“Your Majesty’s heart is with the people. The empire rejoices in having you!” Huangpu Tianyuan’s group cupped their hands in heartfelt admiration, but the sneer on their faces was plain to see.
This hidden battle between emperor and Regent Estate ended with the former’s complete defeat.
Not only did he not seize Regent Estate’s weakness, with the three houses getting away scot-free, what was worse, he was unable to defend his chess piece, Windgaze City, almost throwing it to the wolves.
The emperor’s might faded, earning the ridicule of all!
“Thank you, Your Majesty!” You Wanshan bowed like the rest and then showed the same respect to Huangpu Tianyuan, “Thank you, Estate Lord Huangpu!”
The emperor felt he was choking on something where neither choice of swallowing or spitting out was any good. He resolved to just stare at them with all the anger his eyes could muster.
Huangpu Tianyuan simply ignored it and half bowed, “Your Majesty, we are most grateful for your mercy. We shall take our leave.”
He didn’t care if the emperor had other intentions, he simply turned around and left. It was a clear disregard of the emperor’s position. And yet the emperor could only glare with hatred.
“Hold on!”
The people turned to see Monochrome Chess Sage stomping over, with fire in his eyes, at High Venerable Huangpu Fenglei, “It’s been so long, Sir Huangpu. Would you care for a game of chess?”
Not letting the other respond, Sima Hui directly launched a chess piece at Huangpu Fenglei.
A great power suddenly pressed on everyone’s shoulders.
The house lords were all peak Profound Heaven experts but just this meager chess piece had them all feel as if a mountain was bearing down on them. They couldn’t even step back, blood draining from their faces.
Divine Dragon Sima Hui’s attack was terrifying!
Yet Huangpu Fenglei simply stepped before them without fear. He extended two fingers and caught the piece as if it was nothing, dispelling the pressure with his gesture.
Squinting, Sima Hui didn’t expect for Huangpu Fenglei to be so strong as to take his attack so easily!
With a grin, Huangpu Fenglei spoke, “Mr. Sima’s chess skill is exquisite. How could a martial artist such as I compare with a chess sage such as you? I would only disgrace you by playing!”
Huangpu Fenglei then flicked the chess piece back.
A pressure far greater than before came down on Sima Hui and the emperor.
Sima Hui took a rushed step forward to protect the emperor and was going to use two fingers as well. But the power was too great and forced him to take a step back.
Looking aghast at Huangpu Fenglei, Sima Hui said, “After not seeing each other for so many decades, Mr. Huangpu’s power has greatly increased! I’m afraid I may no longer be your match!”
“You’re too kind. Mr. Sima is far more talented than I. Only, Mr. Sima indulges in chess while I merely work hard in my training!”
With a mocking laughter, Huangpu Fenglei gave Huangpu Qingyun’s group a look. They all joined his laughter as they left this great symbol of imperial power that was the palace!
Sima Hui’s brow had faint sweat watching them go. He looked down to see how deep an imprint his foot left when he withdrew.
Huangpu Fenglei’s power was dreadful to force a Divine Dragon to leave such a mark on the floor!
Bam!
The emperor shot to his feet and knocked over a candle stand as he cursed, “These traitorous mongrels have gone too far! They come to my palace, asking for my obedience?”
“Calm down, Your Majesty!”
Sima Hui advised, “With Zhuge Changfeng here, our reasons are moot in front of a man with his oratory skills. That is why I tried going after Huangpu Fenglei to make them cower. But who’d have thought Huangpu Fenglei’s power trumps mine, further diminishing your prestige. It was my miscalculation. Please forgive me, Your Majesty!”
The emperor didn’t speak, his eyes shining with a dark look.
Dugu Zhantian smoothened his beard and sighed, “This plan was to use the three houses and strike a blow at Regent Estate’s arrogance. Or at least drive a wedge between them. But now, Regent Estate came to their rescue, further making them stand with the Regent Estate. All our hard work was exploited by Regent Estate! Now that the Regent Estate is together with three houses, they will be even harder to deal with...”
Sima Hui nodded, while the emperor was pacing in deep thought.
Then the emperor’s eyes shined, “Mr. Sima, isn’t the Esoteric Debate around the corner?”
“Indeed Your Majesty. It shall take place in five years!” Sima Hui nodded, then started, “Your Majesty, you don’t mean...”
Smiling, the emperor nodded, “Hasn’t the Regent Estate flaunted being the head of the seven houses since he always took first place in the Esoteric Debate? If he comes short in any way this time, their dignity would take a heavy blow. And the seed of doubt would be planted in the other houses, that its power had declined!”
“But Regent Estate’s every generation has been filled with geniuses. Especially this one, with even some freaks mixed among them! The other houses have their own fair share of talents, but none can compare. There’s even rumors that one among them can break the shackles of Radiant Stage, becoming the peak of power in Tianyu. Just what junior could have such potential...”
Sima Hui’s brow was locked, to which the emperor snorted, “Speaking of freaks, is there any little freak more rampant than that guy?”
“Your Majesty, you mean... Zhuo Fan?” Sima Hui and Dugu Zhantian spoke in unison.
The emperor nodded with a sneaky smile, “It’s time for that brat and the Luo clan to pay back for sheltering them. They need to just cut the Regent Estate down a peg at the Esoteric Debate and I will declare the Luo clan as the eighth noble house to keep Regent Estate in line!”
Sima Hui and Dugu Zhantian were speechless.
Zhuo Fan had shocked them again and again, but the Luo clan’s foundation was thin. This eighth house would find it hard to stay afloat when it was even weaker than Drifting Flowers Edifice, threatened to be swallowed by the other house. Yet the emperor was hoping to use it to counter Regent Estate.
None of them knew that Zhuo Fan had already made preparation to strengthen the foundation of this flimsy clan...
In another place, Zhuge Changfeng’s group left the palace with scorn on their faces. Especially the three house lords, who were pushed into a corner by the emperor, were now wild with joy.
And just like the emperor, they were in complete awe of the Regent Estate and Huangpu Fenglei.
[Holy molly, how many are there that can push back a Divine Dragon?]
“Zhuge Changfeng, thank you for making all of this happen!” Huangpu Tianyuan cupped his hands.
Zhuge Changfeng smiled and spoke in the same cold tone, “Ha-ha-ha, there’s no need to thank me. Wasn’t it all planned by your steward, Leng Wuchang?”
Zhuge Changfeng then left with a smile. The Yin and Yang elders caught up to him, having kept their distance so far.
You Wanshan didn’t quite understand, but Leng Wuchang’s face changed, turning to Huangpu Tianyuan.
Correct, all was planned by Leng Wuchang, including the three house lords’ detainment by the emperor. It was all done so he could save the three houses at the best moment, and become more reliant on the Regent Estate.
What was once a scheme privy to only he and Huangpu Tianyuan, it was seen through by Zhuge Changfeng in an instant.
Watching Zhuge Changfeng’s shrinking figure, Leng Wuchang and Huangpu Tianyuan felt an odd chill. No wonder Zhuge Changfeng was the head of the Four Pillars, he was frightening...
Zhuge Changfeng himself was sporting a mystifying smile.
“Prime Minister must be glad!” The white-haired elder smiled.
Zhuge Changfeng nodded, “I just saw a bunch of fools getting happy having scored an empty victory! But, ha-ha-ha....”
The elders were puzzled.
Zhuge Changfeng was quite vague, “But, Yuwen has ruled these lands for a thousand years for a reason! To not even see through a chess player’s unfathomable skill, he still dares to play with cloak and dagger? So this is the extent of Unwonted Contriver, ha-ha-ha... “

chapters.title: Chapter 217, The Suicidal Life and Death Art
chapters.content:
Chapter 217, The Suicidal Life and Death Art
Four figures fell on Blackwind Mountain, Zhuo Fan and his three elders.
Qiu Yanhai and Xue Qingjian watched in awe the impressive sight formed by the mighty four 5th-grade arrays.
[Luo clan is outstanding to this extent that it’s no wonder its steward is so cunning and able. But how come we never heard of it?]
The two looked at each other puzzled.
Zhuo Fan knew all too well what dwelled on their mind, but didn’t dispel their doubts, only made a path through the arrays with a sign. He took the lead and the others rushed to follow.
Once back in the clan, Zhuo Fan called for a general meeting to introduce their newest elders.
The two elders were presented with the sight of people no stronger than ants. Knowing they could kill these people with their thumb, it instilled a deep sense of disappointment in the old couple.
Though after having received Zhuo Fan’s cruelty, it curbed their characters so as to not let it show.
Only when Zhuo Fan introduced Luo Yunchang did their eyes shine. Recalling Li Jingtian’s words, they showed utmost respect for Luo Yunchang. Xue Qingjian even held her shoulder, “Young miss you are the picture of beauty, like an angel from above. I can’t help but rue the day a rotten punk would have you for himself, oho-ho-ho...”
Luo Yunchang blushed and shook her head, but her heart was grateful as she sneaked a peek at Zhuo Fan. She also found the two elders quite likable.
They were Radiant Stage experts yet so calm and mild, unlike the arrogant stereotype everyone knew.
Though clueless this was all brought about by Zhuo Fan’s thorough and unyielding discipline.
The man in question was right now frowning. [Why are these two who always snapped back with how great they are in Tianyu suddenly fawning? And why at Luo Yunchang?]
Turning to Li Jingtian, he caught the latter looking elsewhere entirely. [This has nothing to do with me....]
“Now that introductions are out of the way, the others may return to their tasks.” Zhuo Fan’s clap left only Luo Yunchang and the four elders behind.
He turned to the couple, “You two will be watching over the Blackflame Array in the South and the Ice Shadows Array in the North. I will later tell you how to wield them! Working alongside Elder Yan and Elder Li’s arrays, the Luo clan will never know defeat!”
“Understood!” Qiu Yanhai and Xue Qingjian cupped their hands.
Luo Yunchang was overjoyed knowing the four experts would turn the mountain into an impenetrable fortress. Not even a seven houses siege could make her worry now.
“Also...”
Zhuo Fan’s hand flashed and offered a jade slip, “As you are now Luo clan’s elders, I shall treat you as one of us. Here is the secret Life and Death Art. I find it quite suitable to you two!”
Qiu Yanhai took the jade slip, amazed by what it contained.
Knowing what they were gonna say, Zhuo Fan smiled, “This is no cultivation method or martial art, but a way to combine your strengths. A limitless improving method!”
“What?!”
Brushing off their shock, Zhuo Fan continued, “This Life and Death Art means treading the fine line between life and death on the edge of a knife. At the collision between two opposing forces, world destroying power lies! But once control over it slips, death becomes you. This leads to this art going by a more common name, the Suicidal Secret Art!”
“What are you doing giving it to them for? That’s too dangerous!” Luo Yunchang spoke in their defense.
The couple was almost moved to tears.
[Li Jingtian didn’t lie. Getting close to the young miss is a must if we want to live!]
But Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Young miss needn’t fret. If others trained in this art, they’d have a fate worse than death. But I saw how the two elders’ fire and water arts combine, how seamless they work together. They are able to conform to the other on the fly, understanding each other’s hearts. In fact, they may understand the other even better than they do themselves. The two’s attributes may be in conflict, but they are nevertheless able to control the clashing force between fire and water. There’s a 50% chance they’ll succeed!”
“Fifty?!”
The couple was nervous, and Luo Yunchang jumped in fright, “That’s too little!”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Nothing ventured, nothing gained. The greater the danger the bigger the return. I’m sure you two know this fully well. After all, you fought Tianyu’s experts off decades ago. I can also guarantee, this method has infinite growth. The greater your control, the more powerful you become. You can one day reach the point when you can face all five Divine Dragons together!”
Widened eyes and gasps of shock were heard all around!
Imperial family’s Divine Dragons were the strongest in Tianyu. Not even if their cultivation matched could they defeat one, least of all five.
These were not false promises, as Zhuo Fan never was one for empty talk.
Li Jingtian snapped his excited eyes on the jade slip, his martial fanatic side rearing its head, “Uh, what if, suppose, I train it?”
“Elder Li, this was given to us by Steward Zhuo. So don’t go against his decision!” Qiu Yanhai guarded the jade slip, watching Li Jingtian as if he was an archenemy to the couple.
The two loved each other, but having been in the martial world for so long, the promise of power could hardly be denied. Hearing the return of the Life and Death Art being so gargantuan, they’d take it even if it was just a third chance of success.
How could they have ever reached the 5th layer of Radiant Stage if they didn’t have this bit of boldness?
Though Li Jingtian’s eyes never faltered from the jade slip.
Zhuo Fan dismissed his fervent greed, “Elder Li, it’s not for you. I’ll be blunt. Train it, and die!”
“What nonsense is that? With my talent, my aptitude, my power, I am better than them in everything!” Li Jingtian rebuked.
Zhuo Fan shrugged and turned to the two.
The couple was now eagerly combing through the information in the jade slip. Fifteen minutes later, they looked dumbfounded, sporting an extra red face.
Li Jingtian was startled and impatient, “Well, spit it out, is the art so intricate not even you two can unravel? Give it here, let this old man have a look!”
“Beat it! It won’t do you any good even if you do look!” Xue Qingjian glared at him. Qiu Yanhai lowered his head in embarrassment, “He-he-he, Steward Zhuo, just where did you pick a dual cultivation art? You’re putting us on the spot!”
Dual cultivation art?
Li Jingtian’s eyes bugged out as he stammered.
Zhuo Fan cracked up, “Ha-ha-ha, Life and Death Art needs two people that are closer to each other than their relatives yet of opposite cultivation methods. Only this can bring out its power. If your feelings are true, they will be conveyed and fruit will blossom. If all you have is lust, death follows! Elder Li, you and me are lone wolves, it doesn’t suit us!”
Li Jingtian only smirked. The couple felt quite shy at this point, then blushed harder as they looked at each other.
“Steward Zhuo, we also... can’t cultivate it!” Qiu Yanhai twiddled his thumbs, “Uhm, me and Qingjian never actually done... that.”
Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan asked, “You’ve never done it for decades yet are so in tune with each other? Then what are you waiting for?”
Luo Yunchang clapped, “It’s been ages since we had a wedding in the Luo clan. Please let me arrange it all for the elders on a most auspicious day!”
The couple’s faces went redder, acting like shy teenagers.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes widened and shouted, “What auspicious, what arrangement? That’s so quaint and cliche! Just get it on already and train that art! Blast it, for decades you’ve been around a belle, yet never tapped that fine booty. Shame on you! She even dolled up for decades for you in vain. So get your ass in gear already!”
Bam!
Zhuo Fan kicked Qiu Yanhai’s ass, but the old geezer wasn’t the least bit angry. He took Xue Qingjian’s hand and left giggling, “Qingjian, it’s Steward Zhuo’s order. I don’t have a choice. For the sake of the clan, we must bear through this hardship, ha-ha-ha...”
“Pervert!” Xue Qingjian rolled her eyes, yet left with her blushing head lowered.
Luo Yunchang watched the loving couple in envy. She turned to Zhuo Fan with a pout, “You say that, but you are no different!”
Zhuo Fan looked at her, oblivious.
Li Jingtian laughed, “Steward Zhuo, you shouldn’t waste...”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes snapped to him before he finished, scaring him from continuing.
[So you do understand. Young miss, I did my best to help you up to here.] Li Jingtian started looking elsewhere.
All of a sudden, Yan Song started flattering Zhuo Fan, “”Steward Zhuo, please give me an art too. I...
“Didn’t I give you refining skills?” Zhuo Fan asked.
Yan Song scratched his head, “Ha-ha-ha, now that you mention it. But I’m a cultivator first, before an alchemist, one with dreams of greatness...”
“Fine fine, I understand perfectly!” Zhuo Fan offered a jade slip, “I am not too fond of poisons, but since you’re with me, I will be sure to give you what you deserve. This here is a high profound ranked martial art, Nine Nines Fantasy Palm. It also contains the formula for making the world’s 81 strangest poisons.
“Beside the myriad of palm attacks, it also wields 81 poisons, each with 81 variations. Each change conforms to any man, to any environment, ever evolving. In short, the poison’s only cure is if you remove it yourself. It is thus named, Lord Over Life and Death. Take it and go!”
Yan Song took the jade slip with trembling hands and fervent gaze, “This is leagues above the Rainbow Cloud Palm. It’s incomparable. He-he-he, Steward Zhuo, you are so amazing and grand. I knew I made the right choice following you!”
“Cut the flattery, just make sure to give your all in your tasks!” Zhuo Fan waved him off.
Li Jingtian stroked his chin. [What is up with today? Steward Zhuo is handing treasures left and right! Forget the odd couple, he’s even given Yan Song something after just one word of pleading.]
[Should I also get my game on and act as cute as possible to squeeze Steward Zhuo of some goodies?]
But he shook his head in the end. He knew very well when to stop. It was better to do it after he trained Wraith Art to peak first.
But then, a sudden shout came from outside Blackwind Mountain, “Brother, I came to visit!”
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow and shook his head after knowing who it was...

chapters.title: Chapter 218, Acting Bestowed Elder
chapters.content:
Chapter 218, Acting Bestowed Elder
Zhuo Fan ended the meeting with a shake of his hand, sending the elders into obscurity. He had no intention of showing the world Luo clan’s experts.
He turned to Luo Yunchang with a smile, “Young miss, I would like you to kindly welcome our honored guest.”
Luo Yunchang had no idea who dropped by, but since Zhuo Fan wished her to go, she would gladly do it. And of course, since she was a young miss, she had a role to play.
Her dainty hand raised, Luo Yunchang softly spoke, “Steward Zhuo, please help me to our guest!”
He rolled his eyes, [She’s no disabled seventy year old hag, what help?]
Nevertheless, towards this silly request, Zhuo Fan didn’t flare out, as to not receive this pampered miss’ tongue lashing. So he took her outstretched arm.
It would never ever cross the past Zhuo Fan’s mind to do such a thing. But now, Zhuo Fan found the rough edges of his character had smoothed over, somewhat. Particularly in the case of young miss, where he caved quite easily!
[Goddammit! How can I still be a Demonic Emperor?] Zhuo Fan cursed but wasn’t that angry, quite happy in fact. As if enjoying the moment.
Luo Yunchang stole a glance at the forced Zhuo Fan and giggled a sweet laughter.
The two thus descended, passed the arrays and off the mountain. What greeted them was another mountain, uh, more aptly put, a mountain of a man!
Luo Yunchang and Zhuo Fan’s eyes widened.
Not from being impressed by the newcomer’s imposing manner, but from recognition. In fact, he was Zhuo Fan’s brother who he liked a lot!
They were speechless because, [How can any human get so fat?]
Yes siree, the ‘man’ before them was the third prince of the empire, his sworn brother, Yuwen Cong. The man looked like a veritable wall blocking the view of the two, hoisted on two thick and trembling legs.
Today was sunny and warm, but Yuwen Cong’s head was soaked in sweat, and kept on sweating buckets.
“Brother, you finally came! I almost... couldn’t take it...” Yuwen Cong gasped, wiping his head again and again with a handkerchief, only to be dripping wet the next second. The servant rushed to replace it.
On his right was another familiar face to Zhuo Fan, Jade Flute Divine Sword, Fang Qiubai. Having long given up on this bloke of a disciple, Fang Qiubai was watching the four 5th-grade arrays in shock and awe.
The two were leading twenty yellow dressed elders. Their chests stuck out, their manners filled with power. They looked like no servants of the third prince, more like guards.
Zhuo Fan found his face twitching seeing the sweat soaked Yuwen Cong and sighed, “Oh please. It’s your fault for running all the way here, fatty! “
“Can you blame me? I wouldn’t have gone all out if it weren’t for imperial father’s edict!” The fatty sighed and started fanning himself with his hand, “Hurry and take me up the mountain. It’s too hot here!”
Right then, around ten people came around him to lift him up after a strenuous effort, taking one toiling step after another.
And each step left behind a deep mark.
These servants weren’t experts, just in the Qi Condensation Stage. But seeing how even they were having the worst time of their lives carrying the fatty, Zhuo Fan muttered, “Fatty, you’re goddamn fatter!”
“Don’t say it! Imperial father is in a bad mood. Every time that happens, he takes it out on me and leaves me suffering. I was too stressed to even eat or drink yet the next thing I know I’m up to 400 kg in weight. Oh, the horror!”
He sighed each time he slapped his belly. This act of his made the men below him stagger. Their bent backs were creaking.
Luo Yunchang couldn’t bear to look a second more. Zhuo Fan was speechless.
[You don’t eat from stress yet still gained so much weight? How damn fat will you be then if you’re in a perky mood? How much will you eat?]
“You’re a true marvel!” Zhuo Fan shook his head and sighed.
The fatty snickered, “Thank you, but you’re just the same. We brothers are the marvels of the world! “
Zhuo Fan’s mood sank, [Are you showing off or making yourself look goddamn better than me?]
So Zhuo Fan switched targets to Fang Qiubai, “Mr. Fang, it’s been a long time. Do you perhaps not care what becomes of this fatty?”
“Not in the least!”
With a lazy wave, Fang Qiubai smiled, “A noble man has noble qualities!”
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes, [I was wondering what made this fatty so feisty without caring about consequences. It’s all because his master encourages it.]
[Truly, if the base is crooked, the top is out of whack!]
“By the way, Zhuo Fan, you’ve been stirring quite the storm lately, throwing the whole Tianyu in chaos!” Fang Qiubai eyed him, “But that’s understandable. You can’t survive without going out of line. There may have not been a Luo clan today if it weren’t for you monkeying around!”
Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan took a long look at him, feeling his words held another meaning.
But instead of continuing, he laughed, “Let’s talk it out inside!”
Then he started flying up Blackwind Mountain. Finding the fatty way too slow, Fang Qiubai lifted him along with a wave.
The servants found themselves lighter and fell on the ground in bliss. They cursed, [carrying that damn tub of lard will get us killed!]
As for the elders in yellow, they followed as well.
Zhuo Fan and Luo Yunchang took the weary servants too. The servants finally had the leisure to not mind the weight.
At the peak of Blackwind Mountain, the fatty was working his damndest in wiping the sweat off himself under a pavilion. Fang Qiubai was at the side, with poise and grace.
Seeing Zhuo Fan coming up with the servants, the fatty beckoned, “Hurry up and fan me!”
The servants shook their heads and started working hard at the fatty’s side.
Now the fatty was finally feeling like himself, letting the occasional cry of appreciation.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, [This fatty wasn’t like this three years ago. Why is he so sleazy all of a sudden?]
What had him truly baffled however, [Why aren’t the old guys joining in with the servants?]
Zhuo Fan pointed, “Fatty, aren’t they yours as well? Why are they standing around idle?”
“How could they be? Do you know what their cultivation is?” The fatty eyes widened.
Zhuo Fan blinked, “Profound Heaven!”
“Yes, Profound Heaven experts. How could I have them do such a thing? It will be too humiliating for them.” The fatty spoke upright.
Zhuo Fan thought so as well. He recalls how he would often insult the Radiant Stage experts when he beckons them but never asked them to pour tea for him. It was simply overkill. He found no point in respecting anyone whose talents were of no use.
[Am I not one to respect talents and make use of their abilities fully?]
[Ha-ha-ha, probably not.] Since he always saw others with a cynical eye and never showed any respect. Anyways, who in the mortal domain was worthy of the Demonic Emperor’s respect?
Zhuo Fan shook his head, [With different statuses there are different attitudes!]
Just then, fatty struggled to walk to him and smiled, “Brother, to be honest, these Profound Heaven experts aren’t mine, but yours!”
“Mine?”
“Uh, no no no, that’s not right either. You’re just Luo clan’s steward. How can they be yours? I mean to say that they are elders who my imperial father offered to the Luo clan. Your clan just got a gift falling into your lap and it’s rise is just around the corner. Well, are you happy? He-he-he...” The fatty laughed at Zhuo Fan’s dumbstruck face.
Luo Yunchang’s eyes shined in glee, “They will all be Luo clan’s...”
Before she could properly enjoy this gift of twenty Profound Heaven elders, Zhuo Fan spoke dully, “Fatty, even if the Emperor bestows us these Profound Heaven elders, we will first have to see if they are fit for the Luo clan!”
The fatty was totally clueless what he was getting at.
Luo clan, a third rate clan, had a sudden windfall of twenty Profound Heaven experts and they should be wild with joy! Even a first rate clan would be dancing around and thank the emperor by now.
So why was this Zhuo Fan so cold, even trying to reject them?
If he only knew Zhuo Fan had three Radiant Stage experts in the bag, he’d probably take the twenty elders back that instant.
[Damn, how mortifying! We have Radiant Stage experts, so of course we’d outright refuse some Profound Heaven experts. Not to mention they are...]
Fang Qiubai eyed Zhuo Fan with a deep gaze.
Zhuo Fan walked before the elders and sized them up. He found they were quite strong, but nothing outstanding, while also detecting a great deal of pride.
The kind that hinted at, ‘If I am second, no one dares say they’re first!’
Zhuo Fan frowned, [What’s there to be cocky about when you’re not even in the Radiant Stage?]
Pacing around, he spoke, “As of now, you are Luo clan’s elders. I am the steward, Zhuo Fan. You are to listen to every one of my instructions, besides young miss...”
“Humph, a puny steward minds me? Luo clan sure is an oddity!” One of them complained before Zhuo Fan finished.
Zhuo Fan’s face went cold in a flash.
Luo Yunchang shrugged and turned her head, not in the least interested in their fates.
There was no cocky elder in the Luo clan, not one! That was because this place housed an even more outrageously conceited steward. You could offend anyone in the Luo clan, but may god help you if you stepped on the steward’s toes. Humph, your funeral!
[You’re on your own now. Zhuo Fan’s power goes unchallenged here!]
They were oblivious to this iron rule, but they’d do it anyway even if they knew, since they came by the grand order of the emperor. Though, they were most certainly gambling with their lives at this point...

chapters.title: Chapter 219, How Is That a Rule?
chapters.content:
Chapter 219, How Is That a Rule?
“Who said that? Step forward!” Zhuo Fan roamed the group with a critical eye.
A thin elder moved, sneering at Zhuo Fan, “Humph, you snot nosed brat...”
Pa!
Zhuo Fan instantly cuffed the man, making him stumble, “That’s Steward Zhuo for you!”
“Y-you...” The elder was dumbstruck, too angry to even speak clearly. Forget about him being a Profound Heaven expert, just based on his age alone, receiving a slap from a brat was a downright disgrace!
The blood rushed to his head and charged Zhuo Fan, “You damn punk, you think you’re great? I will teach you a lesson for daring to raise your hand against an imperial guard!”
But then he groaned and went bug-eyed. His breathing grew fainter and his head forever lowered.
His chest was now sporting an extra fist hole through his chest. Zhuo Fan glanced at his dripping bloody hand, painting a marvelous work of art!
Sss~
Gasping, the other elders watched Zhuo Fan in shock. How was this 5th layer of Bone Tempering kid able to kill one of them so easily??
Luo Yunchang yelped and covered her eyes. The fatty’s face twitched and said, “Brother, I knew you were awesome, but these were bestowed to you. You can’t just kill them!”
Fang Qiubai’s eyes trembled, watching Zhuo Fan with an even more curious gaze.
This Divine Dragon had heard rumors aplenty regarding Zhuo Fan, but seeing was believing.
With Zhuo Fan’s mere cultivation, the feats he pulled against others higher than him left people shocked.
Zhuo Fan frowned and ignored the other’s unusual gazes as suspicion grew in his mind. [This geezer is clearly in the Profound Heaven Stage yet his speed and power are lackluster.]
He was planning on making an example out of this one for the rest of them, by leaving him a heavy wound. But it ended with him getting killed instead.
[It’s as if he’s...]
Squinting, Zhuo Fan’s eyes shined faintly azure, releasing a short range soul scan to scour these acting elders while hiding from Jade Flute Divine Sword’s notice.
Sure enough, these guys were all posing as Profound Heaven experts, while their power was far below the threshold. Just like Huangpu Qingyun’s four porters in Drifting Flowers City.
If you’d must define these guy’s power, that’d make them fake Profound Heaven experts.
But this fake stage was only privy to a Radiant Stage expert, while all others couldn’t tell the difference. [In a nutshell, they’re goddamn props!]
Sighing, Zhuo Fan barked, “Fatty, you tricked me! These are no Profound Heaven experts! You brought me fakes! Just take them away already!”
Fatty cried, “You know?”
“Cut the act. I am not blind enough to not see a real Profound Heaven expert from a fake.” Zhuo Fan glared, “Are you looking to see me loose out when I’ll be facing other houses with these fake Profound Heaven experts that are no more than some Bone Tempering pups?”
The fatty scratched his nose in embarrassment, “Uh, it’s just so you can look the part. When others see these twenty men, they will be intimidated... “
“Spare me the nonsense, and give it to me straight. Where did you get these weirdos?”
The fatty scratched his face in silence.
Fang Qiubai chuckled, “Let me explain it. Their talents were meager, imperial guards with slim chances to even enter the Profound Heaven Stage. They couldn’t even take two hits from a real Profound Heaven expert even if they did enter it. So the imperial family had a project to raise many of such people into Profound Heaven experts through pills. But it failed. They have the air of a Profound Heaven expert but not the power to back it up.
“But as Cong’er said, even these props have use. Two decades ago, Quanrong was about to invade Tianyu. His Majesty was scared of war, losing his subjects and wealth and pushed tens of thousands of fake Profound Heaven experts to the frontlines, scaring away the Quanrong. Ha-ha-ha, you have to admire His Majesty’s wisdom!”
Face twitching, Zhuo Fan watched speechless. [No wonder he’s the weakest in the empire’s thousand long history. He doesn’t do anything, he just poses.]
Though he had to admit, mixing lies with truth was an ingenious tactic. [But it has no damn use in a war between houses...]
Zhuo Fan threw the fake experts a look, then sighed, “Fatty, when you give something, make sure it has some use, alright? Even ten real Profound Heaven experts would do!”
“What, ten? We got none!”
Crying out, the fatty persuaded like a cheapskate, “Bro, real Profound Heaven experts are the creme de la creme in any clan. How can they be raised so easily? Veiled Dragon Pavilion has nine, and of Hell Valley’s 12, you killed six. Our imperial family is also short on them. Imperial father can’t dispense any!”
Zhuo Fan shrugged, “Then if he wants to bestow something, let him give something real. These fakers are not only cocky, they even start posing in my face. Take them back!”
“Uh, that’s unlikely. How can we go against an imperial edict? If you really do this, I cannot bear the responsibility. Imperial father won’t budge either. Also...”
Fatty turned to those fake elders and shouted, “Also, you! If you go back, your heads will fall!”
They instantly fell to their knees, pleading.
But Zhuo Fan shook his head still, finding it hard to accept, “They have no skills. With you here, of course they’ll beg, but once you leave, they will return to their haughty attitude...”
“I see, brother. Don’t worry, leave it to me!”
The fatty cursed at them, “You bunch of good for nothing bastards, you have been bestowed to the Luo clan as elders and must follow its rules to a fault, especially steward’s orders. Also who are you to say no? You’re just a bunch of fakers! Let me tell you, this brother of mine, steward Zhuo Fan, has fought Hell Valley, kicked around Drifting Flowers Edifice, punching and smashing any and all from the seven houses. The number of Profound Heaven elders from the seven houses under his belt exceeds ten!
“You must be wondering, how is he still alive? Power! If you had his power, of course you’d defy him. If you don’t, then you better goddamn listen or just drop dead!”
The fatty’s ‘pep’ talk did the trick and the fakes watched Zhuo Fan in shock.
Not once did they think this brat was such a monster, to openly defy the seven houses.
No wonder he acted so high and mighty with them, even daring to kill one bestowed by the emperor. The Luo clan’s steward being powerful seemed valid.
They’d always lived in the palace and knew nothing of Zhuo Fan’s exploits. So they instantly prostrated half into fatty’s howling speech.
Of course they were nothing compared with such a man of power. What right they had to still act tough? Luo Yunchang was overwhelmed with emotion, but mostly watched Zhuo Fan in joy.
“What do you think, brother? They’ll listen now!”
“Cough, Cough...” Ignoring the smiling fatty, Zhuo Fan faked a cough and stuck out his chest as he spoke to the fakes, “As you’ve been bestowed by His Majesty, and seeing how important it is to third prince, I will accept, albeit reluctantly, such fake Profound Heaven experts.”
The fatty was over the moon, as were the rest. Their mission was now complete, and were exempt from the emperor’s punishment.
“However...”
Zhuo Fan’s tone turned heavy, “You are to abide by Luo clan’s rules if you are to stay! First, the most important of all, only me, steward Zhuo Fan, is allowed to show off! Whoever dares to show off before me will find their life cut short!”
They all turned dumbfounded, [How is that a rule?]
The fatty’s face darkened and twitched, “Young miss Luo, does the Luo clan really have such a shameless rule?”
Luo Yunchang bobbed her head and held her mouth, yet her stomach hurt from how hard it was to stop from laughing.
The fatty was speechless.
“Second, when you are outside the clan, I am the first and foremost who show off, and when it’s your turn to do it, it must by all means be a cut below mine! Failure to comply means death!”
They all held their foreheads. [So this is the Luo clan? Is this how its steward acts? It’s just so hard to fathom! Are these what you call rules?]
Luo Yunchang was laughing so hard she laid on the table. The fatty patted his fat cheeks helpless and Fang Qiubai watched it all engrossed.
“Third,” Zhuo Fan continued, “You are to obey my every order without question. When I say you kill, you comply. Otherwise, death!”
They shivered when he reached this point and nodded.
They may have submitted, but Zhuo Fan could see the doubt in their eyes.
To someone like Zhuo Fan, it was this doubt that spoke of the problems ahead.
Zhuo Fan cracked jokes with his first two rules just to ease them into a false security. While the third rule was to test them.
And just as he saw, the third rule was accepted with some hesitation.
If they were indeed bestowed by the emperor, the latter would’ve ordered them to obey the Luo clan to the letter. So the third rule ought to have been received instantly.
But they hesitated. This proved they had a different aim being here, and this sudden rule caught them off guard.
Zhuo Fan showed a crafty smile, “This makes you Luo clan’s elders. Grand Elder will take you now!”
“Elder Lei!”
Lei Yuntian flashed before Zhuo Fan and cupped his hands, “Steward Zhuo, orders?”
“These are elders bestowed by His Majesty. They will be under your care. You have to take good care of them!” Zhuo Fan grinned evilly.
Lei Yuntian was happy so many experts joined. But Zhuo Fan’s ‘good care’ painted a very clear image as to Zhuo Fan’s intention regarding these fakes. To not let them wander off and to keep his eyes on them.
Nodding, Lei Yuntian took the elders with a solemn look.
The elders were sadly mistaken that they were now in the clear, having entered the Luo clan, when in fact they would be under tight surveillance. What was more, neither the fatty nor anyone else there knew this would happen. The fatty then saw Zhuo Fan return to being seated at the pavilion along with him and the rest.
“Brother, besides the third rule, the first two will have me killed!” Fatty patted Zhuo Fan’s shoulder laughingly.
Zhuo Fan spoke solemnly, “Without these two, how can there be a third rule, ha-ha-ha...”
Fatty joined in, thinking the first two rules were to establish Zhuo Fan’s prestige for the third one. But then he looked at Zhuo Fan seriously, “Then let us get to the matter at hand. Luo clan’s steward, Zhuo Fan, receive this edict...”

chapters.title: Chapter 220, Esoteric Debate
chapters.content:
Chapter 220, Esoteric Debate
“Long live the Emperor!” Luo Yunchang bowed, while Zhuo Fan remained still, “Speak!”
Fatty’s fat face twitched helpless, “Brother, this is the imperial edict. Looking on with such contempt would have you labeled a traitor and your head chopped!”
“Whatever, only we are here anyway. With Mr Fang not looking to be a man indulging in gossip, if you won’t tell it, no one will. Moreover, it won’t matter even if you did. For the Emperor to issue me an imperial edict, that only means he needs me. How could he kill me over such trifles?” Zhuo Fan shrugged.
The fatty was lost for words, [Zhuo Fan is indeed a man who can see through anyone.] The emperor wouldn’t do anything even if this guy lay in bed when receiving the edict.
But where would the imperial family’s dignity be then?
The fatty looked bitterly at Fang Qiubai, “Master, how is this guy any good?”
“Ha-ha-ha, extraordinary people need to be handled extraordinarily. So you don’t need to mind this empty courtesy!” Fang Qiubai caressed his beard.
Sighing, the fatty could only nod.
Luo Yunchang rushed to her feet and pouted at Zhuo Fan’s side. He noticed with amusement this new side of the always serious young miss, “Young miss, with your temper, you can’t be so frivolous around such an important event as receiving the imperial edict.”
“Humph, what frivolous? What would be the point in kneeling if you don’t? And you’ll be dealing with anything that arises anyway!” Luo Yunchang snorted and stuck out her chin.
Zhuo Fan laughed and praised, “That’s our young miss alright!”
This was the Luo clan Zhuo Fan wanted, the best clan in the world. They had to aim for the heavens themselves as well. How could that come to fruition if they’d buckle just from some yellow paper from some emperor?
The fatty was almost crying, [Zhuo Fan is ruining the Luo clan!]
When he came here three years ago, the Luo clan was filled with respect and saw the imperial family with reverence. But now, they were tough and stubborn, with even the ever cautious young miss acting like this. They didn’t yet make the part to face the seven houses but they already started to show the same defect as them.
[Just how the Clan Head was, so too did the clan act. And just how their steward behaves now, that’s what the clans will turn into.]
The fatty shook his head, dispensing with the courtesy as well, “Nevermind then, it’s a verbal order anyway. I’ll be straight with you. The Emperor intends to have you participate in the Esoteric Debate and take the Regent Estate down a peg!”
“The Esoteric Debate?”
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow. He looked at Luo Yunchang, finding her just as clueless as he was!
The fatty raised his bloated head and showed a cocky grin.
[He-he-he, you were so cocky before, so feisty, when you are in fact nothing but boors! It’s now my turn to show off!] The fatty laughed and preened, “Esoteric Debate is held once a century, a gathering of the most elite clans. With the Luo clan not being even a third rate clan, a mere cannon fodder for all these years, it is perfectly normal for you to be ignorant!”
“Is that so? Then why is the Emperor inviting our small clan? Please report to His Majesty, third prince, that after hearing your words, Zhuo Fan feels sorely lacking and ashamed to participate in this grand summit. Tell him to find someone more worthy of his attention.” Zhuo Fan flicked the nonexistent dust of his clothes.
The fatty caught Zhuo Fan’s arm in panic, “Don’t, brother! Imperial father will kill me if I go back like this! It is my fault for trying to show off. Right, I will definitely frame Luo clan’s first rule on my wall to remind myself every day you will be the only one to show off. Please find it in your heart to forgive this foolish brother of yours... “
The fatty was begging Zhuo Fan in tears, his swag gone like the wind. Luo Yunchang giggled and Fang Qiubai shook his head.
“Fine, do continue!” Zhuo Fan was only playing around with the third prince. He knew when to quit.
The fatty sighed and no longer dared messed around, “Brother, to tell the truth, the Esoteric Debate is really not some place where elite clans gathered, but where houses bet on their honor to avail themselves. It is a slaughterhouse. A clan can rise to the top in one step, or fall to their ruins in another. Many first rate clans would find themselves worse than even third rate clans! Brother, you must be vigilant if you still want to go!”
“Oh, why do you say that?” Zhuo Fan frowned in doubt.
With a sigh, the fatty’s green and beady eyes shined with a deep gaze, “This goes back to the founding of the empire, of the time when the seven houses were in constant conflict with each other. There was no open war between the seven houses, but none was willing to back down to anyone. To settle the disputes among them, Tianyu’s founding emperor signed an agreement with them. Anyone below thirty years of age was going to compete in order to settle whose house would become the head of the seven houses. These youths would also one day represent their houses in the future. Their power predicted their houses’ power under their rule!
“The seven houses thus no longer took arms and their ranks divided. This was the inception of the Esoteric Debate. Gradually, more and more outstanding clans who wished for greatness joined. They were chosen by the seven houses and imperial family to participate. This is how the current Esoteric Debate came to be.
“Yet, no matter how many clans joined, it was still the seven houses that came on top. The others would simply be fighting for the chance to be their vassals. It slowly turned into a bizarre situation. For the sake of their reputation, the seven houses weren’t into this debate to the death, while the vassal clans fought to the bitter end for their masters. The survivors would thus be looked kindly upon by the houses, and also receive their support. While the rest would become mountain of bones for the other to rise on!”
The fatty’s tone contained mockery, pity, but most of all anger.
The seven houses’ existence robbed the rest of the clans their chance at greatness, reducing them to mere expendable pawns. The Esoteric Debate held each century left Tianyu stagnant, its power never reaching new heights.
While the seven houses’ power kept on growing.
To him, the seven houses were Tianyu’s cancer!
Zhuo Fan sensed his hatred and nodded, “Then what does the Emperor expect of me? Defeat Regent Estate?”
