“Uh, that’s hardly feasible for a fresh clan like yours. You’re just too weak!” The fatty smiled wryly and dismissed his words, “Regent Estate dares call itself the head of the seven houses and harbors the ambition to swallow the other houses because it never once lost in the Esoteric Debates. Imperial father wishes for you to harass Regent Estate and throw them off their game. Regardless of which other house takes the head title, it would give Regent Estate a severe blow to their prestige!”
Zhuo Fan’s brow trembled and shot the fatty a look, “Harass? You want me to lower myself in doing such a trifling matter?”
“Ha-ha-ha, brother, I know you’re great. But you do not understand them. Even interfering would be a tough problem for many other people.”
Chuckling, fatty gave him a yellow ribbon of silk, “This was the roster for the last Esoteric Debate. See for yourself.”
Zhuo Fan looked at the names of the seven houses’ disciples in shock. Especially since there were so many familiar names.
The fatty pointed out each one, “The seventh name, from Drifting Flowers Edifice, must be quite familiar to you. Grandmother Chu Bijun is renowned among the seven houses. But despite her bravery, she was too weak. Drifting Flowers Edifice was dead last among the houses in the last Esoteric Debate. As if to point out it would in fact become the weakest in this last century among the houses.”
Zhuo Fan nodded. Watching the names, many issues started making sense. It showed the precise power of every house lord, extrapolated into the probable power each clan had in the near future.
“The 6th name, Merry Woods!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes skipped it the moment he saw it!
[Humph, nothing notable about a claptrap spouting opportunist pre-copernican obscurantist with no backbone to speak of!]
“Fifth name, Sword Marquise Abode, led by Jian Suifeng...”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes twitched and frowned. Since Sword Marquise Abode came in fifth, then its power was also in fifth among the houses.
The next name had him widen his eyes, “Fourth, Veiled Dragon Pavilion with Long Jiu and the other elders. Third, Hell Valley, with You Guiqi participating as well. Second, Pill King Hall’s group led by Vicious Pill King. And first, of course, was Regent Estate..”
Zhuo Fan’s heart sank.
All his allies were dead last while the top ranks were held by Regent Estate’s loyal dogs. They were not only weaker than the head, but weaker than everyone else.
Picking up on his thoughts, the fatty laughed and patted his shoulder, “Ha-ha-ha, there’s no need to fret, brother. Thanks to your evil ways, these houses’ power is no longer what it used to!”
“What do you mean?” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shined. He knew he wrecked Hell Valley, but what of Pill King Hall?
Fatty chuckled, “The ranking of the last Esoteric Debate is like this because of some amazing figures that appeared at the time. Hell Valley’s third spot was all thanks to 5th elder. Diamondback Ape’s power pushed back Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s third elder in accordance with You Guiqi’s master plan. Without these two, Hell Valley would be far weaker than Veiled Dragon Pavilion!
“Then there’s Pill King Hall in second place. They had Vicious Pill King to thank for that. His poison was so deadly no one dared approach him. Without him, they wouldn’t have gotten ahead of even Merry Woods...”
The fatty trailed off, but Zhuo Fan got the picture. Hell Valley and Pill King Hall’s powers were mostly sapped, since their pillars were cruelly and mercilessly killed, or ruined, by Zhuo Fan himself.
So of course the two no longer were what they used to.
Fatty grinned, “There were many illustrious names in the last Esoteric Debate. You Guiqi, this mastermind, was publicly acclaimed as the first genius among the twenty Profound Heaven experts of the seven houses joining the debate. Then there was Vicious Pill King, the alchemist of the millennium. Uncle Jiu also showed great prowess as well, known for his Purple Lightning Gold Eye...”
Zhuo Fan nodded, secretly rejoicing.
It was great that his first Profound Heaven expert kill was You Guiqi, avoiding many future headaches.
With You Guiqi alive, plotting from the shadows, his head would’ve hurt like hell by now. But wasting You Guiqi was the same as cutting Hell Valley’s power in half.
Thinking clearly now, his trip to Blue Expanse City was downright ingenious. [As for Vicious Pill King, he-he, I sure scored big...]

chapters.title: Chapter 221, The Six Dragons and Phoenix
chapters.content:
Chapter 221, The Six Dragons and Phoenix
“Now that you have seen where the seven houses stand, you need to pay a closer look to your strongest opponents in the next Esoteric Debate!”
The fatty handed another yellow silk ribbon on a heavy tone, “These are the widely acclaimed geniuses of today from the seven houses. The Six dragons and One Phoenix!”
“Six Dragons and Phoenix?” Zhuo Fan perked an eyebrow. That thin silk caught his interest. He recalled having heard of this title in the Drifting Flowers Edifice, when he shelved that info for later. Only to now realize these were the candidates for top power holders in their houses for the next century!
Fatty continued, “The Six Dragons and One Phoenix goes back a thousand years. Along the course of history, these seven had always been the strongest talents at each debate. No matter how great the disciples of other sects and clans were, they still couldn’t compare. In fact, they fell dreadfully short. In other words, the future of the seven houses is in their hands, their power reaching higher than their predecessor, and slipping ever so slightly out of the imperial family’s control with every generation. This is why the Regent Estate is in a haste to unify the seven houses now. Any more delays would make this ambition too costly to achieve, if not impossible!”
Zhuo Fan nodded.
The seven houses’ growth wasn’t just a plague on the imperial family, but on Regent Estate as well. If this went on, Tianyu would find itself one day split in seven, with the imperial family still there only to keep up appearances. But among the houses, the statuses would change, one no longer being the head of the seven houses. With the empire divided, unification would hardly be achievable again.
Zhuo Fan watched the silk ribbon in earnest.
“The phoenix here is represented by Drifting Flowers Edifice’s Edifice Lord, Ascending Ice Phoenix, Chu Qingcheng!”The fatty’s finger rested on Drifting Flowers Edifice, “Some say Chu Qingcheng has the beauty to destroy nations and incredible talent as well. She was entrusted with the power of Edifice Lord since young. With her strong character, her aloof disposition gives the impression the men would only dirty her! Nevertheless, her power is very much real, surpassing many of the seven houses’ elders... “
“You saw her?” Zhuo Fan interrupted him with a smile.
The fatty sighed, “You can say that I have and haven’t. When she was 16, I once went to Drifting Flowers Edifice. That fine figure, the grace, the pose, are all otherworldly. Many years have passed since, but I still recall that view as if from a dream. Ah, such a pity her face was always covered. Despite staying for one short month, she only shot me a glance. She is truly deserving of being called an icy beauty!”
“Is that so? But I’ve seen her!” Zhuo Fan nodded.
Fatty nodded out of reflex, then froze and cried, “What, you did? You saw her, even... her face?”
“What else would I be seeing?” Zhuo Fan grinned.
The fatty threw him a look of envy as he rushed to ask, “How does she look? Do the rumors do her justice?”
“Ha-ha-ha, as if. Regardless if she’s a fairy, an immortal, or even goddess, no amount of words are enough to encompass her visage. Your imaginations could never fathom the extent of her beauty!” Zhuo Fan was once again putting on airs as if it was his second nature.
The fatty swallowed dryly and glared at Zhuo Fan. [Why is it that this punk always gets the good stuff? How many men ever saw Chu Qingcheng’s face? I didn’ get the chance to see it, yet this darn kid could?]
Luo Yunchang was sulking with puffed out cheeks, “Zhuo Fan, is she that pretty?”
“Absolutely. I have the three days spent with her as testament of how accurate my description is!” Zhuo Fan nodded.
But it only helped fuel Luo Yunchang’s anger while the fatty shouted out of envy, “What, you lived with her for three days? Doesn’t she loathes men?”
“Uh, that... depends on the man. I mean, everyone is different. You can’t go saying because she was cold to you when you met that she’s an icy beauty. Brother, this may possibly be a little harsh, but take it from me. If I were a woman, even I wouldn’t want to be seen with you!” Patting the fatty’s shoulder, Zhuo Fan sighed.
The fatty was sullen, his mouth twitching, [Goddammit, can you not cut me so deep then make a joke out of it...]
“Although,” Zhuo Fan’s eyes sharpened, “Chu Qingcheng’s talent truly is amazing, but it may not be as monstrous as you’d think. She couldn’t even beat Huangpu Qingyun. If these Six Dragons One Phoenix are the same, I can handle them easily.”
Zhuo Fan was pretty darn egotistical, yet the fatty didn’t jump to criticize him. Since Zhuo Fan kicked a storm in Drifting Flowers Edifice and escaped unharmed still, he was entitled to some bragging rights!
It was now that the ever silent Fang Qiubai coughed, “Kid, if you really think so, you’d have the shock of your life five years later in the Esoteric Debate!”
“Oh, what makes you say that?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, his eyes snapped on the Divine Dragon.
Fang Qiubai squinted, “Having been to Drifting Flowers Edifice in person, you must know by now their situation. I’ve met that girl as well. Her talent is outstanding, but the chaos around her had stalled her cultivation, making her fall behind other houses’ disciples. You said that she couldn’t match Huangpu Qingyun, but let me tell you this. When Chu Qingcheng was twenty and fought Huangpu Qingyun, I happened to be the judge. How do you think it ended?”
Zhuo Fan frowned.
“Ha-ha-ha, Huangpu Qingyun suffered a total defeat in one move!” Fang Qiubai laughed, “I could see then that this girl’s talent surpassed a Divine Dragon’s. And the other houses’ disciples are no different.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, not daring to slight them again.
“Furthermore, with Drifting Flowers Edifice having regained Chu Bijun’s support, that girl can now focus on cultivating. I am eager to see how far she can reach in five years time. But the other houses’ disciples will most likely go even higher. I look forward to see this time’s Esoteric Debate, ha-ha-ha...” Fang Qiubai laughed at the sky.
Zhuo Fan gasped, his gaze unprecedentedly hard.
[If there’s any truth in Fang Qiubai’s words, then these Six Dragons and One Phoenix will probably exceed my clan’s elders by then.] He was going to face the same level of freak as him.
Fatty nodded seeing Zhuo Fan’s dead serious face, “Among the six dragons, Merry Woods has the Forest Fleeting Dragon, Lin Xuanfeng. Merry Woods has the most uncanny speed among the houses. And Lin Rufeng’s is even more so. He fleets about the trees like the wind, gone before you even know it...”
“From Sword Marquise Abode hiels Golden Armored Sword Dragon, Xie Tianshang. Sword Marquise Abode is an item refining house, also specialized in sword arts. Xie Tianshang is many times stronger than his younger brother, Xie Tianyang – a true sword genius. Sword Marquise Abode’s sole profound ranked martial art, Flowing Space’s Nine Forms is so intricate that many elders can’t even grasp it fully their entire lives. Then they say that this kid had done it at nine, unconceivable...”
Zhuo Fan listened engrossed as the fatty got him acquainted with every dragon. When fatty reached Regent Estate, his hands trembled, his gaze hard.
“Brother, none of them can ever amount to the one I’m about to tell you next. Regent Estate’s eldest young master, Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord, Huangpu Qingtian!”
Taking a deep breath to compose himself, fatty resumed, “His younger brother, Huangpu Qingyun, you’ve met. But if you compare the two, the younger brother looks totally average and the same goes for the five dragons. This is the true genius among geniuses, a freak among freaks.”
“And it is this man we know the least about. But one thing is certain, the five dragons and one phoenix are not his match!”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes widened, his heart jumped!
[Just now you said the five dragons and one phoenix are incredible, making me cautious, but then you go and tell me none of them can hold a candle to the sixth dragon. Just what kind of horror is that guy?]
The fatty patted Zhuo Fan’s shoulder and sighed, “Now do you get it? Brother, it’s not that easy to interfere with Regent Estate as you may think. Next to these freaks, the so-called demon Zhuo Fan everyone talks about falls short...”
Squinting, Zhuo Fan took a deep breath, “No worries. At the next Esoteric Debate five years later, you will see a brand new Zhuo Fan and Luo clan. But first, there are some things that require my immediate attention. I hope the imperial family can keep the Luo clan safe in the meantime!”
Eyes shining, fatty and Fang Qiubai shared a look and smiled a nod.
“Rest assured, brother. Train in peace and prepare for the Esoteric Debate. Leave the Luo clan’s safety to us. Also, if you stand out enough in the Esoteric Debate, imperial father will use this chance to hail you to the rank of Noble House. Then, Regent Estate will find it much harder to touch you when it has to go through the imperial family first!” The fatty just promised any other clan’s most cherished dream, but also entrusting him with a near suicidal mission no clan would ever want.
Zhuo Fan nodded and sighed.
[Fortune has always favored the bold. In the thick of danger, opportunity avails itself. And this Esoteric Debate is Luo clan’s best chance to shoot straight for the moon...]

chapters.title: Chapter 222, Thunder Swarm Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 222, Thunder Swarm Mountain
The two had explained everything thoroughly to Zhuo Fan before leaving.
Seeing them go, Zhuo Fan’s eyes shined, “Young miss, gather everyone. It is time we go to Windgaze City!”
Luo Yunchang looked at him deeply before nodding.
Not much later, they all gathered, except the Grand Elder, who was watching over the newcomers.
Luo Yunchang and Zhuo Fan took the main seats, overlooking them as they explained what fatty said.
Even though shocked, everyone was sporting a serious face. The imperial family’s task was of monumental proportions. It wanted this fresh clan, not even a decade old, to fight against the seven houses with a thousand year old legacy, each.
This was a fool’s errand!
Even Li Jingtian was frowning.
“Elder Li, you’ve been living in Regent Estate until now. What are, in your opinion, my chances with Huangpu Qingtian?” Zhuo Fan asked.
The others settled down, awaiting his answer.
Li Jingtian shook his head, “None whatsoever!”
The eyes of others widened, their hearts jumped, and Zhuo Fan frowned. Li Jingtian’s assessment was undoubtedly reliable, giving Zhuo Fan further shock.
“Old Li, Steward Zhuo isn’t your run of the mill. Wherever in Tianyu have you seen any other Bone Tempering cultivator kill a dozen Profound Heaven experts in Tianyu? You’re saying that twerp Huangpu Qingtian still holds a candle to our great Steward Zhuo?” Xue Qingjian giggled a flattery.
However, Zhuo Fan shot her a glare, “Sister, sucking up has no place here. Please take this matter seriously, or I’ll take what you said as wishing for my demise!”
Xue Qingjian zipped her mouth on the spot. She could feel the coldness in Zhuo Fan’s tone.
This also made the others tremble. The usual rampant and obnoxious Zhuo Fan actually knew to be cautious at crucial times.
His act earned their admiration. He wasn’t one influenced by some cheap words of flattery, keeping his cool when it was needed the most.
Li Jingtian secretly approved, “Steward Zhuo, to be blunt, third prince and Fang Qiubai didn’t see the real him, only speaking based on mere hearsay. But even if they had seen him, they’d have the same impression. Poise of a king and a talent of a freak!”
Zhuo Fan squinted, “Go on!”
“As Elder Xue mentioned, Steward Zhuo’s Bone Tempering cultivation is enough to kill Profound Heaven experts. But I feel the need to enlighten everyone here that Steward Zhuo isn’t the first to have done this. Ten years ago, Huangpu Qingtian, in his 2nd layer of Bone Tempering Stage, easily defeated Regent Estate’s Profound Heaven elders. As you all know, their elders are unlike You Guiqi and the others. Every one of them trained in Imperial Tyrant Body Art!”
“How is that possible?!”
Even Zhuo Fan couldn’t help but cry out. His victories over Profound Heaven experts were thanks to his Lightning Wings and Diamond Sand body. He never thought it possible for a second method to exist into making another reach such power.
Li Jingtian read this from his reaction and smiled dejectedly, “They are the freaks roaming this world. It’s as if they were born to trample everyone else under their feet. Before I left, he had always been under the High Venerable’s tutelage and I am unsure of his progress. But no question about it, he is in the Profound Heaven Stage just as Huangpu Qingyun. At least in the 5th layer! His real power is hard to fathom... “
Up to this point, Zhuo Fan had been in a constant frown. He never once saw it possible for one man’s exceptional talent to reach such an incredible level. Thus, he refused to believe one man’s talent could be so monstrous!
“Taking into account Old Li’s opinion, does this mean Steward Zhuo has not even a glimmer of hope in beating him?” Qiu Yanhai turned to Zhuo Fan in worry.
He was no longer hating Zhuo Fan for forcing them to join, on the contrary, he was completely grateful. Without Zhuo Fan, he and Xue Qingjian wouldn’t have grown so powerful so quickly.
Zhuo Fan was their matchmaker and was worried for his safety.
Chuckling, Li Jingtian said, “That may hardly be the case. What I spoke of was in terms of strength. It just means Steward Zhuo is unable to face him head on. Others are clueless to Steward Zhuo’s tricks, but which elder among us isn’t clear on how he operates? Remember how every one of us joined the Luo clan!”
They all looked at each other and burst out laughing.
Indeed, the dread of Zhuo Fan wasn’t based on power, but a shrewdness similar to You Guiqi’s. It involved schemes hardly anyone could pierce!
Taking that into account as well, then Zhuo Fan’s chances were through the roof...
Yan Song praised, “This Esoteric Debate may very well be the strongest since its inception. Thank my lucky stars I joined the one last century, or I may as well turn into cannon fodder in this one!”
The others cracked up again, to which Zhuo Fan just smiled. But one name carved itself in his heart, Huangpu Qingtian!
“Elders, do any of you know of a place with thick thunderclouds in Tianyu?”
One voice spoke, “Why does Steward Zhuo ask?”
With a flash, Zhuo Fan held a flickering egg. He smiled, “This is why!”
“6th level spiritual beast, Thunder Skylark’s egg!” They all cried in shock.
Li Jingtian watched Zhuo Fan in envy, “He-he-he, Steward Zhuo has many hidden treasures, even a 6th level spiritual beast’s egg. If it hatches, we will have a beast that will even give a Radiant Stage a run for his money!”
“Yeah, we toiled long and hard, yet only managed to get 5th level spirit animals. Who knew Steward Zhuo would hold a 6th level spiritual beast? This is a rare treasure even for a Radiant Stage. Steward Zhuo’s methods are flawless!” Xue Qingjian and Qiu Yanhai admired him.
With a dismissive wave, Zhuo Fan smiled, “Please, enough with the buttering. I only obtained this egg through chance. And because it was damaged, I had to go to Drifting Flowers Edifice and use Bodhi Jade Sap to restore it. Then various things cropped up and had no time to mind it. Only recently I managed to restore it. But to make it hatch, I must find a place with thick lightning bolts!”
“Easy, just set up a thunder gathering array!” Xue Qingjian shrugged.
Zhuo Fan shot her alternative option on the spot, “The lightning will be too feeble and also costly! I want to incubate it in a natural thundercloud. This is all so its power will reach its peak!”
Li Jingtian and the rest nodded.
Incubating it with poor lightning bolts would only waste this grand 6th level spiritual beast’s potential.
They knew what was on Zhuo Fan’s mind. This was another ace up his sleeve in dealing with Huangpu Qingtian. The hatching of this spirit animal was of great import.
“If we’re speaking of a natural place engulfed in thunderstorm all year round in Tianyu, only one place comes to mind...” Li Jingtian caressed his beard.
Xue Qingjian was frantic, “No way! That’s a forbidden area! We already have our hands full with the seven houses. Isn’t that enough trouble as it is?”
“What place are you talking about?” Zhuo Fan was quite piqued.
The elders exchanged a glance and said together, “Thunder Swarm Mountain!”
“Thunder Swarm Mountain? What’s wrong with it?”
“As Steward Zhuo can imagine, it is a place where lightning strikes everyday, all day. It’s skies blanketed with thick thunderclouds. This place had been like this ever since the founding of the empire!” Li Jingtian spoke.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shined, “Perfect. I’ll have my egg hatch there!”
“You can’t!”
Xue Qingjian cried in panic, “Since sixty years ago, one of the empire’s three guardian sects, Demon Scheming Sect exiled four criminals there to receive thousands of thunder strikes a day. If we go there and release the four by mistake, we’ll be offending the Demon Scheming Sect and suffer their wrath.”
Zhuo Fan squinted, “Are you saying the four criminals are being guarded by the Demon Scheming Sect?”
“Uh, not at all! Demon Scheming Sect just left them there and ignored them ever since. They thought none would dare risk offending them and let the four out.”
“What bloody reason is there to fear then? Even if we do let them out by mistake, we just have to haul ass out of there with none the wiser!” Zhuo Fan snickered.
Xue Qingjian was startled, [That’s true. But won’t that be too vile? If Demon Scheming Sect ever finds out, we’re done for.]
But how could the bold Zhuo Fan be so cowardly? If he’d be panicking over every trifle, how could he have ever risen to be a Demonic Emperor?
Zhuo Fan slapped his thigh, settling on taking Li Jingtian to Thunder Swarm Mountain.
This used to be in preparation for Lightning Canyon, but now became a means to deal with Huangpu Qingtian as well.
But before he set out, he entrusted an unbelievable task to Yan Song and Lei Yuting. This task would decisively affect Luo clan’s place in Tianyu...

chapters.title: Chapter 223, The Abominable Four Scheming Demons
chapters.content:
Chapter 223, The Abominable Four Scheming Demons
Whoosh!
Two figures flashed among the clouds. They were Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian on their way to Thunder Swarm Mountain.
“Elder Li, how much longer?” Zhuo Fan rubbed his Thunder Ring.
Li Jingtian calculated, “By my estimates, we should arrive in three days!”
“Good!” Zhuo Fan flapped his wings and tripled his speed, “The faster we get there, the better!”
Hu~
Then, a sudden attack came at them in the form of a shadow. Zhuo Fan had no time to stop, about to smash into it.
Li Jingtian intervened, however, and grabbed Zhuo Fan’s neck. He then placed Zhuo Fan behind him, but the shadow sped straight for them.
“Ghostly Dragon Claw!” Li Jingtian shouted.
Bam!
With a devastating sound, the shadow was sent flying while Li Jingtian stood unphased, tall and proud. Yet he couldn’t stop his red hand from shaking.
“Elder Li, are you alright?”
Zhuo Fan looked on carefully, while Li Jingtian was frowning, “Don’t worry. That item is a spiritual weapon, most likely a 5th-grade one. If not for being a body cultivator, I might’ve ended up dead.”
Sighing, Zhuo Fan nodded, then breathed easier.
“Hi-hi-hi, you must be someone to have blocked my 5th-grade spiritual weapon, the bone staff with your bare hand. It looks like I caught myself a big fish!”
A creepy snicker accompanied the appearance of a man not hundred meters from the pair, holding a black item in his hands.
Under a closer look, Zhuo Fan could see that the black item was a two meter long black staff with a human skull at the ends. The wielder however was a hideous pygmy. The evil air wafting from him made one’s nerves tighten!
“3rd layer of Radiant Stage!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes widened as he and Li Jingtian cried at the same time.
The pygmy was excited all of a sudden and gesticulated in joy, “Hi-hi-hi, now you know how great I am so be good and surrender and I may be kind enough to spare your miserable lives!”
“Humph, a mere 3rd layer of Radiant Stage expert dares show off before me?” Li Jingtian stomped forward and released his mighty power.
The pygmy was cowered back again and again by the display and gasped, “What, you’re in the 6th layer?”
“Ha-ha-ha, how the hell did you live so long to reach the 3rd layer of Radiant Stage when you attack without even scouting your opponent first?” Zhuo Fan mocked, “It’s my turn to ask the questions. Who are you and why did you attack us?”
The pygmy cackled after sparing Zhuo Fan a second glance, “Ha-ha-ha, a puny 5th layer of Bone Tempering cultivator thinks himself worthy of hearing your grandpa’s name?”
“You little shit that is neither human nor monster, dares to call yourself my grandpa?” Zhuo Fan’s face was vicious as he glared, “Elder Li, no more questions. Deal with this midget and let’s be on our way!”
“With pleasure!”
Li Jingtian had long found this pygmy’s attitude annoying. [Zhuo Fan shows off because he is the steward of a clan, and he has both ambition and power within himself. While you, a filthy little shite, too ugly to even look at, and weaker than me to boot, dare do the same?]
[You have another thing coming!]
So Li Jingtian eagerly went on the offensive the instant Zhuo Fan gave the order. The pygmy wasn’t scared by Li Jingtian’s charge, however, and started twirling his bone staff.
Bang~
Metallic clashes rang all around. Li Jingtian didn’t use a weapon, but as a body cultivator, he honed his body into a weapon in and of itself.
Every one of his strikes was no lesser than one coming from the bone staff.
And since the two of them were of different cultivation layers, the pygmy was on the retreat with every blow from Li Jingtian, despite holding the advantage with a spiritual weapon.
He wielded the black staff with uncanny movements, avoiding all attacks, but when his energy reserves were up, only death would welcome him.
“Blast it, I really hit a snag this time!” The pygmy started cursing from exhaustion. Then, clenching his teeth, he suddenly jumped to gain some distance.
But Li Jingtian realized his attempt at running aways so he shouted and struck the black staff fiercely with his hands. This time, however, as the the black staff danced, the pygmy was shrouded in black energy, while the bone staff started letting out eerie screeches.
The next second, the vile energy took the shape of a skeleton as it cackled at the two.
“This demonic cultivation method is beyond vile!” Zhuo Fan frowned. He never thought this weird pygmy would be a sinister demonic cultivator.
But he wasn’t worried. When it came to sinister demonic methods, the Wraith Style used by Li Jingtian was by far one of the most wicked out there.
“Hi-hi-hi, you didn’t expect this, did you? I am a dreadful demonic cultivator! With this low profound ranked martial art of mine, Demon Shadow Bone Staff, I will swallow your body and soul. Scared now? Ha-ha-ha...” The pygmy crackled from within the shadowy skeleton. Li Jingtian only grinned, “Moron!”
“What, you still dare take me on? Then die!”
The pygmy sure had a screw loose, though he had quite the sharp pair of ears on him. The mockery in Li Jingtian’s words earned his rage, charging at him with the image of the skeleton.
But Li Jingtian only smirked without an ounce of fear, just as a black dragon image engulfed him.
“You blind little shit, let me show you true demonic martial arts. Wraith Style’s first move, Soaring Demonic Dragon!”
Roar!
With a reverberating roar, Li Jingtian’s power surged and charged at the skeleton image. In a totally anticlimactic way, the skeleton image up and vanished without even a sound.
Pff!
The pygmy spurted blood and was sent flying just as his staff snapped in two.
A 5th-grade spiritual weapon was broken by using brute force alone. The Mad Dipper combined with Wraith Art was a force to be reckoned with.
Looking at his broken black staff, the pygmy realized the error of his ways. He really kicked a wall this time. His eyes began to show fear.
“Wait, hold on, I give. Please let me go!” The pygmy started wailing and begging for his life.
Li Jingtian turned to Zhuo Fan for opinions, only to see him looking elsewhere and letting him handle it. So Li Jingtian looked at the pygmy with a cruel grin, “It’s far too late now, you little shit!”
Li Jingtian laughed and slapped his chest. The pygmy wailed, “Brothers, your big brother is about to die. Come save me!”
“Who dares kill my brother....”
An ear-piercing cry resounded and startled Li Jingtian into seeing three shadows flying at him. They were on him in a flash.
The three launched attacks at the same time, forcing him to jump next to Zhuo Fan.
But the sight of them had Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian slackjawed. Before there was one and now there were four pygmies. Though there were differences here and there despite how ugly they all were.
One was sharp, one was wretched, and the last was shy. Now that the three helped the first pygmy up, he regained his brash tone and started cackling, “Ha-ha-ha, so now you’re scared since my brothers are here? Give yourself up and I may be inclined to spare your wretched lives!”
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched and darkened.
[He definitely has more than one screw loose. He just had a harsh lesson beaten into him a moment ago but now he’s back to showing off. Guess you can’t teach an old dog new tricks.] It was fine if his backers were stronger, but Zhuo Fan could easily see they were of the same cultivation. Elder Li had no problem with one, so where did this tyke get all that courage from?
“Elder Li, for the sake of humanity, get rid of these little shits. I can’t bear to watch!” Zhuo Fan sighed.
Li Jingtian however recalled something and turned grave, “Steward Zhuo, we may have hit a snag this time.”
Startled, Zhuo Fan saw Li Jingtian cup his hands, “Are you perhaps the legendary Four Scheming Demons the Demon Scheming Sect placed in Thunder Swarm Mountain?”
Widening his eyes, Zhuo Fan turned to the four.
[Didn’t the Demon Scheming Sect lock them up? What are they doing up and about?]
At his mention, the four assumed weird poses and shouted to the world, “Indeed. We are the demonic cultivator hero quartet, known to all as the Abominable Four Scheming Demons!”
The creepy display the four put on and their pygmy appearances was jarring to one’s eyes. Zhuo Fan was even cringing.
[These four are grade A weirdos, one dumber than the next. I just can’t figure out why in the world Demon Scheming Sect would take them in.]
“Elder Li, I still believe it’s in humanity’s best interest you deal with them, forthwith. Now I know why the Demon Scheming Sect threw them in the Thunder Swarm Mountain and forgot about them! Humph, not even I would want to spare one moment longer seeing these weirdos!”
But not only Li Jingtian was unmoving, his face only grew heavier, “Steward Zhuo, they are more than their ‘exotic’ appearance led you to believe. These four threw Tianyu in chaos when they joined hands back in the day!”
Zhuo Fan squinted and looked at them again. Since it was so, he was very much eager to see how...

chapters.title: Chapter 224, Dreadful Unity Tactic
chapters.content:
Chapter 224, Dreadful Unity Tactic
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Silavin
“Big brother, they look impressive. It’s best we make a run for it!” One pygmy hunkered behind the other three and peeked his head out at Zhuo Fan in fear.
Zhuo Fan was stumped. [The hell, you balked after some hot air?] This never happened before, not once. [What are you doing posing around as our enemy then? Why not just scram in the first place?]
Another pygmy noticed this contradiction and cuffed the shy one over the head, “Coward, you’re always cramping our style! We won’t take you with us ever again. And our eldest bro was hurt by them. How can we let this slide?”
Zhuo Fan nodded, [That’s more like it.] He was sensible to even neglect that part about their style. [This guy’s reaction is more like it, that’s a proper human response.]
But that thought didn’t finish forming as the pygmy added another slap, “And even if we don’t get revenge for old bro, how are we going to get compensation for getting his bone staff ruined? They have to pony up!”
The pygmy was then holding the halves of the black staff close to his heart, on the verge of crying.
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched and darkened.
His previous thought was wiped clean off his mind. [I stand corrected, they’re inhuman. You don’t care about your elder bro’s wound and yet you cry over some junk?]
[Even if it is a 5th grade spiritual weapon, how can Radiant Stage experts bawl over something like this?]
In the end, the eldest pygmy ignored his moronic brothers’ senseless talk and shouted as he hit their heads, “Goddamn it! I didn’t call you over to squabble, but to fight! I’ll lead and you follow!”
He then charged at Zhuo Fan and Elder Li. But on his second step, his wounds flared and he spat blood. Even so, his eyes were fixed on Zhuo Fan.
“Attack, attack~” The last pygmy thought of making an even bigger scene and was now hopping and skipping from the side, egging them on. Though he showed not an ounce of intent to join the bustle.
Their eyes squinting, the other three turned to this pygmy and started raining kicks and punches on this cheerleader.
“Blast it all to hell! Every single time you stand aside and cheer but are the last one to help!”
“Yeah, third bro. If you don’t charge first this time, we won’t charge at all...”
“Uh, let’s all calm down a bit. Old bro is wounded. It might be best if we make a tactical retreat..”
The cowering pygmy in the back earned a glare from the rest. Then the three started taking it out on him.
“Fourth bro, you butt in every single time and ruin our morale and make us lose!”
“Yeah, we wouldn’t have lost the last time if you’d have charged with us! How else could the Sect Leader manage to banish us in that wretched place to suffer so many lightning attacks otherwise?”
The three were quite springy in giving the fourth a run for his money. Then the fourth thought of something and barked, “What of second bro? If not for him being so damn petty, going after the spiritual weapon the enemy dropped, we wouldn’t have lost!”
In a blink, the three stopped and turned to the pygmy that wanted compensation. Now the fourth joined the squabble and the three ganged on the second bro...
Zhuo Fan’s face was having a field day from all that twitching, [What the hell’s wrong with these weirdos? What have they come here for, beat each other up?]
Their enemy was right across yet they were having the time of their lives smacking themselves instead. Zhuo Fan couldn’t make out if they were mocking the two or plain dumb as a rock!
“Elder Li, are these guys even strong?” Zhuo Fan sneered.
Li Jingtian sweated, “Should be. I only heard rumors about them and never met them myself. They say these four are quadruplets and fit together like a glove. This is why the Demon Scheming Sect recruited them and taught them a unity tactic! They usually win by numbers, despite being weaker.”
“That doesn’t look united to me! How do they even fight if all they do is beat each other?” Zhuo Fan scratched his nose.
Li Jingtian laughed wryly, despite the four’s fight getting more traction, and explained, “Steward Zhuo, just as you heard, this must’ve led to their banishment. They may be able to work together flawlessly in battle, but their characters are totally different and hard to reach a consensus!”
“Speaking of the first pygmy, he is the eldest among the Four Scheming Demons. Violent Demon! He is brash, rude, and very much brainless. No matter how strong the opponent he faces, he is the first to charge head first. If his brothers follow or not is another matter entirely. This is also why we didn’t sense any soul ripple to scout our level and instead skipped to throwing the black staff at us!”
“Oh, I am well aware of his stupidity!” Zhuo Fan nodded.
Li Jingtian pointed at the pygmy getting a beating, “The one asking for compensation is the second brother, Scrooge Demon! He is the cheapskate of the four, narrow minded, and always forgoes long term profit in favor of short term pocket change. He is a typical case of strain at gnats and swallow camels!”
“That guy deserves to be beaten. He ignores his elder bro and laments the loss of a spiritual weapon. One look at him and it makes me want to smack him too.” Zhuo Fan watched him get clobbered without remorse.
Li Jingtian chuckled, pointing at the cheering, yet the least one to do anything, like a mascot, “That is the third brother, Sly Demon. He is sharp and expert in sneak attacks. Rumor has it that each time the four fight, he always stands at the sideline doing nothing. But every time heads come rolling on the enemy’s sides, it’s all thanks to him. He’s your typical opportunist!”
“This guy has at least a redeeming quality, hoodwinking his enemies. And yet he uses his smarts to steal the credit from right under his brothers’ noses! At least he’s much better than the first two!” Zhuo Fan nodded.
Li Jingtian pointed to the cowardly pygmy, “He is the fourth brother, Wimp Demon! In every fight, he stands behind his first bro. But some say, he is the strongest among the four. Many experts despise his nature and slight him, only to fall at his hands in the end.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Elder Li, why don’t you go and mess with them a bit. Force them to show their skills!”
Li Jingtian shook his head vehemently, “Steward Zhuo, don’t joke about this. They may not look like much, but they’re dreadful together. I heard that a century ago, they were only in the 9th layer of Profound Heaven Stage but killed a 2nd layer of Radiant Stage expert.”
“Just think. Any Radiant Stage expert is hard enough to fight, but these four killed one when they were in the Profound Heaven Stage. Now that they’re in the 3rd layer of Radiant Stage, I’m not confident I can come out alive!”
“What’s that got to do with anything? Their eldest bro is wounded and their unity tactic’s effect will fall sharply.” With a snicker, Zhuo Fan got Li Jingtian to see things from a different angle.
Suddenly, Zhuo Fan pointed at Li Jingtian and yelled at the pygmies, “Hey, this old dude said your dad mated with a swine and ended up having you four weirdos!”
The four stopped fighting and turned their vicious eyes on Li Jingtian. Zhuo Fan chuckled and jumped back half a mile, leaving Li Jingtian their sole lone target.
Li Jingtian paled from fright and wiped the sweat of his brow.
[Steward Zhuo, you screwed me over!]
The four got to their feet and walked to Li Jingtian side by side. Their faces lost their dumb looks and eyed him with savagery.
Wimp Demon was no longer cowardly, Sly Demon no longer dodgy, and Scrooge Demon’s eyes lost their greed. In that instant, the four became just like Violent Demon, releasing their vile power.
Zhuo Fan’s brow shuddered and his eyes shined. All while Li Jingtian’s mood sank and his eyes glittered with tears as he cursed Zhuo Fan in his heart to the ends of the earth.
[I may be the Luo clan’s elder, but that doesn’t mean you get to screw me over!]
But the deal was already done, and Li Jingtian had no choice but to face the music, “That’s right. You’re all eyesores, so come on!”
“Ha!”
The four howled and, with bloodshot eyes, jumped at him. The four figures merged in midair and caused this Mad Dipper to gasp as he took three steps back.
Overwhelmed with shock, Li Jingtian knew this was their unity tactic, but feeling it on his own skin was far more dreadful than hearing about it. The four’s powers combined, but not merely additively, but multiplied.
Li Jingtian had no time to be careless, releasing his all in his next punch, colliding with their attack.
Boom!
With a loud noise, Li Jingtian was thrown a hundred meters into the air, feeling the blood in his heart boiling. Yet the four savage figures didn’t stop for a second.
“Curses! You want to go head to head? Fine then, bring it!”
Li Jingtian held the four demons in fear, but once the fight started, his martial fanatic self reared its head. He was no longer afraid, but laughing, “Wraith Style’s first move, Soaring Demonic Dragon!”
Roar!
A draconic roar echoed and Li Jingtian was enveloped by a black dragon’s image. In his unparalleled state, he charged at the Four Scheming Demons.
This time, Li Jingtian, with the help of his profound ranked martial art, had gained enough power to overwhelm the four’s combined vile energy.
The four’s eyes widened, not expecting Li Jingtian to be so amazing, “Ah, we’re finished...
Despite saying so, when they were about to collide with Li Jingtian, they snickered, “Hi-hi-hi, that’s enough playing...”
In that instant, the strange united attack up and vanished before Li Jingtian, making his attack hit naught but air.
At the same time, figures appeared around him that escaped the detection of his Discerning Field. Only a creepy snicker reached his ears, as if to prove he was surrounded.
“This...”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes widened from the side and trembled, “Something is definitely off about them....”

chapters.title: Chapter 225, Necro Dragon’s Screech Shakes the Four Demons
chapters.content:
Chapter 225, Necro Dragon’s Screech Shakes the Four Demons
Editor: Silavin
Hi-hi-hi...
Among the cawing like laughter, Li Jingtian’s eyes darted to the afterimages popping around him with all the seriousness he could muster.
Hu~
Then, a sudden wind spelled the arrival of Sly Demon giving him a resounding slap from the front before vanishing into thin air.
Li Jingtian couldn’t quite make out what just happened, but the reddening cheek bore testament.
“So fast!” Zhuo Fan cried out.
But it was far from over. It was now Violent Demon’s turn. He gave Li Jingtian a slap from the front again before completing his attack with the same vanishing act. What was even more astonishing was that he hit the same spot.
It followed with Scrooge Demon and Wimp Demon, slapping him in the same place.
Li Jingtian’s anger got the better of him as he roared, “You damn little shits, what you think you’re doing hitting the same cheek? Come on, here’s the other!”
“Hi-hi-hi, what’s our entertainment got to do with you?” A cackle came from all around in waves.
While Zhuo Fan squinted with a thoughtful gaze, “Curious, Violent Demon was never that fast. How is it that his speed increased even when he is still injured? Yet, his attack got weaker. I wonder...”
“Elder Li, let them hit you!” Zhuo Fan shouted.
Li Jingtian was stumped, [Haven’t I been hit enough already as it is?] But thinking about it again, he soon realized Zhuo’s aim and grinned.
[You little shits, I will pay those slaps back a hundred fold!]
Taking a deep breath, Li Jingtian roared, “You bunch of mongrels, let’s see if you have the guts to hit my other cheek!”
“Hi-hi-hi, no we won’t. We’ll only hit just that one!”
The four’s creepy laughter echoed again, followed by another slap on Li Jingtian’s cheek.
Pff!
But before the hand could even tickle Li Jingtian’s face, a large hand clutched it. Li Jingtian snickered at Sly Demon, his eyes sparkling, “Damn bastard, didn’t I tell you to hit me on the other cheek? Now, you’re mine!”
“Curses, we’ve been had!”
Gasping, Sly Demon found that Li Jingtian’s words were all to goad him into slapping again. Now that Li Jingtian knew Sly Demon’s target, regardless of the speed employed, it was easy to catch him when Li Jingtian’s guard was up.
This was also Zhuo Fan’s plan when he spoke out before.
Li Jingtian’s grip tightened. There was no way Sly Demon could get out of Li Jingtian’s grip, not when he was three layers weaker. The other demons shifted around at high speed as they panicked, “Damn, we’ve been had...”
“He-he-he, time to meet your maker! Your unity tactic is done for!” Snickering, Li Jingtian slapped Sly Demon’s head.
With such power behind it, especially when it came from the 6th layer of Radiant Stage Li Jingtian, it was really a one way ticket to the afterlife!
Any one of the demons was clear on that.
The Sly Demon started struggling and crying out, “I’m dead, so dead! For real this time...”
“Oh god, oh gods, I’m gonna die...” But the oddest thing happened. In this critical moment the other three demons didn’t rush to save him, but were crying out in fear.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed, his mind making the right adjustments to his train of thoughts.
Hu~
Yet, this mighty palm hit nothing but air in the end. Li Jingtian was shocked, watching Sly Demon’s head sinking into his shoulders to dodge the bullet.
When the demon’s head popped back out, he sighed relieved.
“God darn it! You’re in my hand already, so why won’t you just die!”
Li Jingtian was consumed by rage as he launched a flurry of punches. But with incredible shock, Sly Demon, despite having his arm in a vise, twisted around in this limited space he was in, dodging every one of those deadly attacks.
Li Jingtian was slackjawed. [What the hell is this? What kind of movement is that?]
But what truly took the cake was the three demons around still crying around in fear, but were not lending Sly Demon any helping hand. Were they abandoning him or confident in their brother’s power?
In a blink, Li Jingtian was at a complete loss. These Four Scheming Demons were freaks in the truest sense of the word.
“Elder Li, watch out?” Zhuo Fan warned and Li Jingtian saw the other three demons flying at him.
But their speed was far from fast as before, giving Li Jingtian time to react. As his hand still held onto Sly Demon, his leg swept.
But what happened next was downright bizarre.
The three demons actually closed their eyes in fear, then leaned back to dastardly avoid the kick while still going straight for Li Jingtian.
[What. The. Hell? What just happened? Not only can I not make sense of anything they’re doing, I can’t even anticipate their moves.] One minute they were charging in with all bravado, the next they were flitting all over the place in fear.
But one thing was certain, they were on the advantage.
“Ah!”
With a cry, Violent Demon grabbed Li Jingtian’s hand that held Sly Demon and chomped.
Li Jingtian let go from the pain and Sly Demon rejoiced in his newfound freedom.
The four demons then returned into circling Li Jingtian at high speeds and letting out eerie laughter.
He may be a martial fanatic, and fearless in face of adversity, but fighting these four demons had him at his wits’ end. He couldn’t make heads or tails when they were weak or strong. It was like hitting frickin’ cotton.
The four noticed his predicament and laughed as they charged, “Brothers, let’s fleece this guy and shame him thoroughly!”
Oh!
The other cheered and Li Jingtian turned serious, eyeing the afterimages around him. But then, they up and vanished, appearing instead as hazy images, as if ghosts from the Underworld.
Li Jingtian punched.
He hit nothing, of course, while the ghosts wrapped around his body. In a blink, his jacket and storage ring left him soundlessly. As if swallowed by those gray ghosts.
When the ghosts drew away, they once again let out creepy laughter. Li Jingtian was left in flimsy undergarments, watching his surroundings in shock.
“I see. So this is their Unity Tactic. As expected from a demonic skill, striking at the heart of things!” Zhuo Fan took a deep breath and shouted, “Elder Li, we are not their match. Retreat at once!”
Zhuo Fan was the first to fly away. Li Jingtian gnashed his teeth and snorted in anger before following suit.
The four figures reappeared as they watched the pair leave with smiles.
“Humph, that old geezer thinks he can get away after humiliating us? Hi-hi-hi, brothers, charge!”
Oh!
Under Violent Demon’s order, they all cried in unison and gave chase. They were not in the least bit slower than Li Jingtian, perhaps even faster.
Li Jingtian threw a look back and paled as he arrived next to Zhuo Fan, “They are clearly in the 3rd layer of Radiant Stage so how are they surpassing my speed? They’ll soon be upon us!”
“No worries, that’s only the third brother’s cultivation method, which focused on speed alone. Even if he does catch up to us, he can’t do jack squat!” Snickering Zhuo put on an ambiguous smile.
Li Jingtian was startled, but clueless nonetheless.
“Elder Li, once they get close, we’ll finish them off in a blink!”
“What?” Li Jingtian cried, “How?”
He had tangled with the four at full power to no avail. He couldn’t find any real way of dealing with these weird quadruplets.
Zhuo Fan said, “They use a unity tactic, so getting rid of one is of course impossible. You need to defeat all four of them at the same time. Going after just one is pointless!”
“Then how...” Li Jingtian muttered.
Smiling, Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, “Elder Li, do you recall Wraith Style’s third move?”
Li Jingtian’s eyes lit up and nodded, as both of them broke out in laughter.
“Then... shall we do this together?” Li Jingtian asked.
“Of course. Rather be safe than sorry!”
Zhuo Fan smiled and his hand made a sign, with Li Jingtian copying him.
The four demons were right behind the two when Violent Demon screamed, “You two better give up and I may be inclined to spare your miserable lives!”
“And, and, pay us for the broken bone staff...” Scrooge Demon added.
With a snicker, Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian shared a look and nodded. They grounded to a halt and shot straight for the oblivious four, shouting in unison, “Wraith Style’s third move, Necro Dragon’s Screech!”
Roar!
With two draconic roars, two soul ripples shot straight for Four Scheming Demons.
They cried in shock, having not expected them to know a sound martial art, the bane of their unity tactic.
A pity realizing wasn’t the same as escaping it.
In a blink, the mighty sound waves crashed into the four. They couldn’t even wail their pain as they spat blood and toppled over like logs.
Even the forest beneath them was affected, turning into a place of death as animal corpses littered the earth. After all, this was the combined attack of two souls! How could the average man handle it?
These four 3rd layer Radiant Stage experts were no different!
Peace soon instilled once again, though carrying with it an eerie tune. Zhuo Fan and Elder Li watched the dead eyed four demons on the ground and gave a smug smile.
Li Jingtian in particular. He snatched back his jacket and storage ring from Scrooge Demon and cursed, “Goddamn it, what are you doing still holding them when you’re out like a light? No wonder he’s Scrooge Demon. Well let me return the favor and make you demons in the truest sense by sending you all to hell!”
“Elder Li, wait!”
Zhuo Fan rushed to stop him, “I still have use for the four. Seal their cultivation for now!”
Li Jingtian nodded after a pause, catching Zhuo Fan’s drift.
[He-he-he, the four’s hell has only just begun...]

chapters.title: Chapter 226, Even Sages Are Idiots, Sometimes
chapters.content:
Chapter 226, Even Sages Are Idiots, Sometimes
“Uh... what just... why do I feel so woozy...”
Violent Demon opened his heavy eyelids but his vision was still foggy. He reached to scratch his head but oddly enough, he couldn’t. Looking down, [Dammit! I’m hogtied.]
Turning to his sides, his bros were in the same boat, all strapped around a three meter thick tree. He wailed, “Oy, wake up you fools, we’re strapped here!”
The three were roused and slowly getting their wits about them, what little they ever had. When they saw they were in a very tight pinch, and their cultivation sealed, they started wailing, “Oh bloody hell, who’s the bastard that dares tie us four demons, your grandpas? Release us right now, or I’ll give you a fate worse than death...”
“Ha-ha-ha, these little shits sure are bonkers. Look at them, like lambs to the slaughter yet still so feisty!”
A chuckle announced Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian’s casual entrance in their field of view, one filled with derision. In response, the four rained curses.
Li Jingtian’s face was dark and was ready to hit them, “You damn mongrels, one more peep out of you and I’ll have your heads!”
The barking halted on the spot, but their beady eyes still glared at the duo.
Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian only laughed.
These four were blokes, but at least knew to read the mood. They balked under the tiniest threat, making it much easier for what Zhuo Fan had in mind next.
“Cough~, I will now ask you some questions. Be honest, or I’ll make sure you are 6 feet under!” Zhuo Fan coughed dryly.
The four just shook their heads and puffed out their chests, quite brave, or maybe moronic? [Ask away, but I won’t answer one!]
Zhuo Fan brushed past their rash reaction and asked, “I heard you were sealed in Thunder Swarm Mountain. How come you’re out? Who released you?”
“Don’t know!” Violent Demon shouted.
Zhuo Fan snorted, “Nerves of steel I see! Elder Li, waste him!”
“Wait, I really don’t know!” Violent Demon’s courage was deflated on the spot as he pleaded, “I beg you, let us go. We’ve only been out for a few months and hardly played enough. We don’t want to die!”
“Screw you, if you cherish your life so much, what are you doing posing as heroes?” Zhuo Fan glared. [These little shits are only good at putting up an act.] But they didn’t know when to stop and almost fooled even him in thinking they were tough as nails.
Violent Demon heard Zhuo Fan’s demand and nodded, all while his brothers were snickering. But a glare from the eldest brother had them fall in line.
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes, [I’ve never seen such top notch weirdos in either of my lives.]
But the doubts he had were far from cleared, “You’re saying someone let you out and yet you don’t know? You expect me to buy such an obvious lie?”
“Our lives are in your hands. We’d never dare do anything of the sort. We really don’t know!” Violent Demon was bitter as he tried to painstakingly remember, “Eight months ago, we were still trapped in the Thunder Swarm Mountain, struck by thousands of lightning daily. Then, a sudden crack opened in the barrier. But when we got out, there was no one there. So we went about doing the usual, killing, burning, pillaging, ruining some cities and clans, you know, the works... “
“Hold up, why on earth did you start doing that anyway?” Zhuo Fan blinked.
The four looked at each other and sneered, with Violent Demon growing cocky in his creepy laughter, “I can tell with one look you’re a bookworm and narrow minded. We are demonic heroes. What demonic cultivator out there doesn’t pillage? The more we kill, the evilier we are, the further we walk on the demonic path. And our demonic heroes’ life will thus find its glorious meaning!”
“Four lunatics is more like it!” Li Jingtian mocked.
Zhuo Fan scratched his nose, getting pissed as well.
[You’re the narrow minded ones! I have studied the demonic path my entire life, even becoming the Demonic Emperor. And then here you are telling me I’m the shallow one when it comes to it?]
[At the end of it all, the so-called demonic path comes down to one word only, selfishness! Any and all demonic cultivators are cool headed, working only to further their benefits by any means necessary. In fact, pillaging is against our path. For us, this is only a means to an end, not our purpose.]
But these four blokes turned the method into a purpose. They couldn’t be more wrong. If the demon path goal was this, then the entire world would’ve long turned on them and wiped them out.
[Just why the hell did the Demon Scheming Sect even take them in?]
Zhuo Fan held his head, not bothered to waste anymore time with these blokes. But his heart was in doubt, [Just who released them? And why?]
He thought for a while but found no answer. Zhuo Fan continued, “Why did you attack us then? Who told you to?”
“Uh, dumb luck!” Violent Demon mumbled.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Elder Li, waste him!”
“Ah, wait, wait, I’m being honest here!”
Violent Demon looked at Zhuo Fan on the verge of crying, [Why is this lil’ bro so bent on wasting people?] He was even more violent than even himself, “That’s the truth of it. Since our escape from Thunder Swarm Mountain, we laid four cities to ruin and killed around half a million people. We soon found ourselves bored and were about to choose our fifth city to waste when we met an imp at some point and made a bet with him. Who knew we’d lose and had to promise to look for ingredients in his stead. And where were we supposed to find it? Robbing people of course. Especially those in the Profound Heaven Stage or above. Their rings must be loaded with ingredients...”
“So, you saw us flying there and just up and threw your black staff at us?” Zhuo Fan stared Violent Demon down, looking for lies and forcing him to squeeze a nod, “We thought we’d find plenty of good stuff and complete the bet, but who knew we’d fail right at the start! Such a dumb luck, waah~...”
Violent Demon started bawling like a kid which threw the other three into doing the same.
Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian were stumped.
[These little twerps are weirdos, no kidding.] One minute they were savage, the next they played the victim, like wronged children.
“Fine fine, don’t cry. Whoever cries, I’ll waste him!” Zhuo Fan shouted and the tears grounded to a halt. Zhuo Fan shook his head inwardly, [I just can’t tell when they’re being real or just faking it.] But he still had some doubts that needed clarified, “You guys know when to concede having lost a bet?”
“Of course. We are demonic heroes, when have we ever been anything but trustworthy?” Violent Demon puffed up his chest and spoke self-righteously, the other brothers followed suit.
Looking him in the eye, Zhuo Fan walked to him and squinted. The four looked back cautiously, their hearts in their throat.
Li Jingtian came before Zhuo Fan and said, “Steward Zhuo, can we trust anything that came out of their mouths?”
Zhuo Fan nodded and said, “Their heads may be screwed on wrong and speaking in tongues, but they are more or less telling the truth. The one who released them wished to incite chaos in Tianyu. They’re not here for us!”
“Then, we can rest easy and continue onward to Thunder Swarm Mountain. I was afraid our tracks were followed and someone laid a trap for us.” Li Jingtian sighed.
Zhuo Fan nodded, but his face was dead serious.
Like this, the two stood there in silence for a while. Zhuo Fan was mulling over something and Li Jingtian stayed nearby so he wouldn’t disturb.
As for the four demons, they were watching the duo nervously, worried for their poor lives.
Finally, Li Jingtian couldn’t help but voice his confusion, “Steward Zhuo, are you thinking about our trip to Thunder Swarm Mountain or how to deal with these guys?”
“Ha-ha-ha, since these little guys’ interference wasn’t on purpose, then Thunder Swarm Mountain will be safe. As for these weirdos, I’m of a mind to recruit them. It just so happens that I have a unity tactic on me that suits them like a glove!” Zhuo Fan smiled.
Li Jingtian nodded, “I knew Steward Zhuo is lenient and found them appealing. But, Steward Zhuo, don’t you need to think it further? You may offend the Demon Scheming Sect if you take them.”
“Hardly. Since Demon Scheming Sect threw them away and ignored them for sixty years, it won’t matter. Moreover, true great men don’t mind trifles and are unafraid of some petty danger. So stop thinking as if this is a matter of epic importance!” Zhuo Fan shook his head.
“Then Steward Zhuo wants to...”
Sighing, Zhuo Fan took out the Bloodworm gourd and frowned, “I no longer have on me cold spiritual beast blood, so how can I place an active Bloodworm egg in the pills and hoodwink the four morons into taking them? Their brains may be slow, but they are Radiant Stage experts still...”
Li Jingtian watched him oddly and blinked in awkwardness, “Uh, Steward Zhuo, they are under our complete control. I assume there’s no need to go as far as hoodwinking them into eating the pill as well..”
Shuddering, Zhuo Fan went beet red and face slapped himself.
[What a fool I am! I deceived Li Jingtian into taking the Bloodworm because he was just too amazing. But against these four little twerps under my control I don’t need to waste so much time. I’ll just give it to them!]
[Sigh, here I am saying others have screwed up heads, while mine is on the fritz as well.]
Zhuo Fan blushed hotter, even avoiding Li Jingtian’s gaze, “Elder Li, please forget that just now!”
“Aye!”
Li Jingtian stifled a laughter, watching this treacherous Steward Zhuo, [Who knew he’d be so oblivious today?]
“Uh, Steward Zhuo, could you give me two of those worms? I want to try stuffing it into others’ mouths as well!” Li Jingtian snickered, as he saw Zhuo Fan closing in on the four.
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow and smiled, “Sure!”
Thus the two, with two worms each, snickered at the four demons. The four were now shaking in fear and wailing, “What are you planning? Haven’t we been honest here? Why are you still...”
Bloodworms entered each of their mouths, forever branding them with the Luo clan’s seal...

chapters.title: Chapter 227, Godly Tactic
chapters.content:
Chapter 227, Godly Tactic
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Silavin
With that settled, Zhuo Fan had Li Jingtian release the four and restore their cultivation.
The first thing the four did with their newfound freedom was to band together and assume that dumb pose again, “Humph, you got some nerve tying us up and feeding us worms. This shame has to be paid back! Even if you surrender, we will not spare your miserable lives!”
“Yeah, we won’t spare your miserable lives, for sure!” The other three demons mimicked Violent Demon. Yet Li Jingtian and Zhuo Fan shared a look and sneered.
The four demons were puzzled.
[What’s going on? Why aren’t they cowering?]
Before they could make sense of anything, a blood mark appeared on their heads and threatened to burst their skulls like a balloon.
The four forwent their haughty attitude in favor of rolling on the ground and holding their heads, all while their eyes threatened to explode from how bloodshot they were.
Zhuo Fan sauntered over and sneered. Then, explained the deal with the Bloodworms. This seemed to get through to them, that they were at the mercy of a kid.
“If you want to live, listen closely...”
“Of course we will, so stop it already! My head’s about to pop!”
“Yeah, you’re our boss now. Screw that rotten old Violent Demon!”
“You bastard, no sense of loyalty! Haven’t we got the same mother? Daddy, please get rid of these treacherous bastards. I’m more than enough to look after you. They are not worth shit...”
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched and Li Jingtian’s mood sank.
[These little shits have no shame at all!] They were the most immoral Radiant Stage expert the two ever saw! Zhuo Fan was still having second thoughts if taking this immoral four under him would only come back to haunt him.
[Even calling me a damn daddy!? Sigh, god I hope this won’t come back to bite me!]
Zhuo Fan lamented inside and his hand sign changed, relieving the four of their pain. The four demons went on their knees on the spot and hugged Zhuo Fan’s legs, “Daddy, I’m yours forever and always. Oh please don’t let that bug give your child a tummy ache!”
Zhuo Fan’s brows were shuddering and kicked the fool, “Not one damn bone in your back!”
“What? Daddy wants to see us show off our backbone?”
With a shine in their eyes, the four joined together in their retarded pose and shouted, “We are the demonic heroes, the Abominable Four! Our daddy is... uh, daddy, what was your name again?”
Zhuo Fan felt like spitting blood. Li Jingtian was laughing his heart out.
Who’d ever believe these four weirdos, the Four Scheming Demons, who had him on the ropes before now had no morals whatsoever!
Zhuo Fan glared at the four, “You are forbidden from calling me that, or I’ll have the worms wreck your body so bad you’d be begging for the sweet release of death!”
“Yes, mommy!” The four imps puffed their chests, totally guessing Zhuo Fan’s meaning.
Zhuo Fan reeled, almost collapsing. He glared at them, [That’s goddamn worse! You’re even changing my gender!]
“Call me Steward Zhuo!” Zhuo Fan emphasized each word as he spat through gnashed teeth.
The four stood at attention and shouted, “Yes, Steward Zhuo!”
Zhuo Fan finally breathed easier. [No wonder they’re called the Abominable Four Scheming Demons. It’s like fighting with the demons of the Underworld!]
He finally figured out why Demon Scheming Sect ignored these dunces for sixty years. Spending but a moment around these fools would cut one’s life short from anger.
Though they had one redeeming quality, they were strong.
With the Luo clan on the rise, it needed strong experts. Once the clan’s situation stabilized, [The first ones I’ll put down for good will be these four weirdos!]
Zhuo Fan said, “You are now one of us now, so explain to me this unity tactic.”
“Uh...” Violent Demon looked at his brothers and spoke with difficulty, “It is a secret art of Demon Scheming Sect. We can’t reveal it.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, [That’s how a human should act. At least they aren’t complete wastes, knowing when to be loyal.] Even if the Demon Scheming Sect threw them away for sixty years, they were still protecting their secrets.
But what he heard next filled Zhuo Fan with a sudden and most compelling urge to choke the life out of them.
“Uh, the thing is, only we four can train it. It’s our secret. If we let it slip, we’ll easily be defeated in the future. That’s too dangerous! How about we tell you of Demon Scheming Sect’s guarding array instead, or where they keep their scriptures, or where Sect Leader’s room is perhaps...”
Zhuo Fan waved him off, clenching his fists hard. One could even hear the grinding of teeth.
“You sure like spilling the beans on everything about the Demon Scheming Sect...” Zhuo Fan laughed from anger, already regretting his decision, “The day might come where you’d even sell me out!”
The four looked at each other but remained silent. Then they each looked elsewhere and started whistling.
This only worked to fuel Zhuo Fan’s rage as he barked, “Hurry up and fork out that unity tactic or I’ll end you right here, right now!”
The four nodded in panic.
That was fine, since their lives were in Zhuo Fan’s hands. Not even the unity tactic could save them from this. So they started to string up all the details pertaining to the secret art.
Li Jingtian listened from the side, now understanding what made the four’s attacks so strange and hard to counter.
The unity tactic only worked when four people were intrinsically connected on the biological and spiritual level.
This unity tactic was called Four Hearts Formation, pointing at the four human emotions, happiness, anger, sorrow, and joy.
Violent Demon trained anger to the point of being berserk. Once he struck, nothing could stand up to him. Scrooge Demon trained sorrow to the point of a grudge. He shifted from real to illusory, throwing the enemy off guard. He was swift like a ghost and impossible to throw off, giving his opponent a very hard time. Sly Demon trained happiness to the point of ecstasy. Swift like the wind, leaving behind only afterimages. Wimp Demon trained joy to the point of being whimsical. And since he was also cowardly by nature, he reached the peak of defensive arts.
In short, the eldest brother was in charge of power, third bro in charge of speed, second bro and fourth bro in charge of movement arts. But even they were different, with second bro in charge of attacking movements while fourth bro with defensive ones.
If any four people trained like this, they’d end up as waste.
With only the eldest bro having enough power to do some damage, the other three couldn’t do anything to their enemy. Yet, in this lay the crux of the Four Hearts Formation. It allowed the four to combine their advantages and become one, effectively multiplying their power.
This was why the four charged all together at Li Jingtian and gave him a hard time. The four of them turned into the eldest brother, Violent Demon!
Then the four surrounded Li Jingtian but turned into third brother, Sly Demon!
And why Li Jingtian could never harm Sly Demon once despite having him in his grip was all thanks to Wimp Demon’s ability. Li Jingtian then ended up half naked because Scrooge Demon bestowed his ability on his brothers.
This way, one man’s ability was transferred to the four. And since they were of four, their power would multiply. The enemy would be left flabbergast, unable to cope with the situation before meeting his ultimate demise.
But if this secret was leaked, there was no more reason to fear them. As long as they stopped the four’s change into Violent Demon, they’d be finished.
Because the other three’s power came nowhere near the first!
“So this strange formation had me on the ropes!” Li Jingtian caressed his bead, “But it does have a weakness. The four of you can’t use all of your abilities at the same time. Otherwise, it would truly be insane!”
“Really? Then I’ll help them reach that point!”
With a sly grin, Zhuo Fan showed a jade slip, “Abominable Four Scheming Demons, since you are now with me, I will make it worth your while. This is also a unity tactic, Four Division Formation. The users would move to the four cardinal points, with the five elements endearing one another, making each one of you use all the other’s abilities. Furthermore, it will also work to boost your personal ability by three layers!”
“What?!” The four demons cried out and Li Jingtian smacked his lips, “It’s insane enough they can use all the others’ abilities but it can even increase their power by three layers? Ain’t that the same as facing the Four Scheming Demons at the 6th layer of Radiant Stage?”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Correct. With the four divisions amplifying each other, everyone can use anyone’s ability. They will have speed, power, movements, defense, thus becoming true monsters. Not to mention, it complements the Four Hearts Formation. As for raising them three layers, ha-ha-ha, that’s only in the beginning stage of the Four Division Formation. Once they reached the mid stage, the amplification would raise their power by six layers.
“And if trained to peak, by a whole stage! In other words, the four of them will become as strong as a peak Radiant Stage expert!”
Li Jingtian was slackjawed, watching Zhuo Fan incredulous, “Steward Zhuo, are you perhaps someone who fled a super sect or something? The Four Division Formation is insanely more outrageous than the Four Hearts Formation. Where the hell did you come up with this treasure?”
“Secret!” Zhuo Fan smiled mysteriously...

chapters.title: Chapter 228, Mystery Kid
chapters.content:
Chapter 228, Mystery Kid
Editor: Silavin
The Four Scheming Demons were now thrilled, holding a much stronger unity tactic than the one they used before. But then Scrooge Demon suddenly said, “Uh, Steward Zhuo, if it’s of no trouble, could you perhaps, maybe pay us back for the bone staff?”
“Ha-ha-ha, no worries!”
Zhuo Fan nodded, [Scrooge Demon is a miser after all. He just got a better unity tactic for free yet still wants compensation for the 5th-grade spiritual weapon.]
But since they were his men now, Zhuo Fan would naturally listen to their requests.
Zhuo Fan sent Li Jingtian after the pieces of the black staff. He then added some Diamond Sand and in the azure flame, the staff was instantly restored, even improved upon.
The Four Scheming Demons were jumping in joy for having their spiritual weapon back.
Perhaps the excitement got to his head or he was just plain petty, but Scrooge Demon pointed at Li Jingtian without an ounce of shame, “Steward Zhuo, could you also give me that old guy’s ring and clothes?”
“What for?” Zhuo Fan asked.
Chuckling, Scrooge Demon spoke as a matter of factly, “We just lost them because we went unconscious. How else could that old guy take them from me?”
“Blast it, they were mine to begin with, you hear?” Li Jingtian flew into a rage, “You little shit, what kind of logic is that? They are yours once they exchange hands?”
Zhuo Fan’s face sank, “Your twisted characters won’t change, but you are never to use them on my men. Or else...”
“I know, Steward Zhuo, I will think better of him from now on!” Noticing Zhuo Fan’s displeasure, and in fear of having the bug in his stomach go topsy-turvy, Violent Demon shouted in plea for mercy, “He-he-he, please excuse him. If he doesn’t get to steal what he fancies, he’ll sulk for a few days!”
Zhuo Fan’s cheek twitched, [That just means he’s really stingy!]
“From now on do not touch what isn’t yours!”
Violent Demon saw Scrooge Demon’s eyes still fixed on Li Jingtian, shouting and turning his head forcefully. But that stubborn face had the duo not know how to respond to it.
[Among these four weirdos, Scrooge Demon is the worst. I’ll have to enforce extra security to stop this damn kleptomaniac...]
Clap~
Zhuo Fan got their attention, but Scrooge Demon was still very depressed. Zhuo Fan ignored him, “Listen well. We are now going to Thunder Swarm Mountain so you will be leading us since you know the way!”
“Uh, but...” The four shook their heads hesitantly, “We can’t!”
Zhuo Fan frowned, “Why?”
“Steward Zhuo, did you forget? We promised a child to get him an ingredient. The Four Scheming Demons are demonic heroes of indomitable spirit, how can we disappoint him?”
Zhuo Fan eyes them deeply and nodded.
If it were others, he’d be forcing them along. But these four weirdos were hardly honorable. If he left the four the impression he was about to force them out of their promise, without setting a precedent wouldn’t teaching them later be impossible?
Pausing, Zhuo Fan said, “Fine, we will first find the kid, give him the ingredient then go to Thunder Swarm Mountain!”
“Steward Zhuo, you really have it?” The four eyes’ shined.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Of course!”
The four started whispering among each other and let out a strange laughter. Violent Demon even raised his head smug, “You see? I told you flying people had the ingredient on them and I was right in attacking them!”
“Eldest bro is brilliant! Hi-hi-hi...” The other three gave thumbs up.
Zhuo Fan felt unwell for some reason. Their behavior raised many flags. But then again, this was their usual manner so he let it slide.
And so, Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian followed the four demons westward, reaching a tall mountain half a day later.
In the sunset’s glow, an eight-year-old kid sat on a meter tall rock. He put something in his mouth from time to time and chewed.
As if noticing the newcomers, the kid’s ears moved, and turned his head, revealing his sparkling eyes.
But Zhuo Fan’s heart shuddered at the sight. As if a savage beast had set its gaze on him. His feeling that something was off only grew stronger.
[What’s going on here? Why is a child not even a decade old making me feel such danger?]
Li Jingtian’s eyes widened and said, “Steward Zhuo, the child is in the 2nd layer of Radiant Stage!”
“What?!” Crying out, Zhuo Fan was incredulous.
How was a kid such an expert? [Another pygmy?] But taking a closer look, he had quite the delicate features. If an old freak would’ve used his cultivation to keep his youth, it was still impossible to take the same appearance as this child!
That left him with only one possibility, the child reached the Radiant Stage from a young age!
Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian exchanged a glance of shock. Then also turned a vigilant eye to the four demons. [These little shits only said they lost a bet with a kid, but not once mentioned he was a Radiant Stage expert!]
[Was it on purpose? Why?]
Zhuo Fan squinted and his fists tightened...
The kid didn’t get up, still sitting on the rock as he spoke, “You four are finally back. If you’d have been any later, I’d assume you ran away and make me go after you!”
The four shook like a leaf, quite afraid of him. Not only Wimp Demon, but even Sly Demon and Scrooge Demon. They all ducked behind Violent Demon who’s legs were quivering, “We would never do that. We ran twice already and don’t dare do it again!”
Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian were in shock. How were the great four demons holding a kid in such fear? Was this 2nd layer of Radiant Stage expert stronger than them who were a layer higher and using unity tactic?
“The three days are almost up. Did you bring the ingredient?” The kid turned a blind eye to Zhuo Fan and Elder Li and spoke coldly to the demons, like the judge about to hand over his sentence.
The four shivered a nod and pointed at Zhuo Fan, “They have it. Just search them...”
Zhuo Fan’s face sank. He knew he just got sold out and was now looking into the kid’s cold eyes.
“Take it out!” The youth extended his hand.
Zhuo Fan sensed no ill will from him and approached him. He noticed that the kid was holding a 4th grade ingredient, Purple Root!
The kid bit out of the Purple Root from time to time as he approached, chewing it like a snack.
Zhuo Fan’s heart was in shock.
[He’s eating an alchemy ingredient before it’s even refined!] Even a Radiant Stage expert would have his meridians explode doing such a ridiculous thing. Yet the kid was just peachy, as if he could refine the ingredient naturally.
[Monster!]
It was Zhuo Fan’s first time using this word on others, having gotten used to others usually using it on him.
The kid then spoke before Zhuo Fan even took out the ingredient, “Do you have any 5th-grade or higher ingredients? The taste of these 4th-grade ones is so flat. I’m tired of having this thing.”
Zhuo Fan’s mouth twitched, [Picky brat!]
His hand flashed and revealed a snow white mountain ginseng, “This is a 5th-grade ingredient, a ten thousand years old Snow Ginseng. It should fit your tastes!”
The kid’s eyes lit up and snatched it pleased, “It’s been so long since I’ve tasted such a good ingredient. Curse those damn bastards in yellow. They only feed me slops. I almost died of hunger!”
“Yellow?” Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan sank in thought, [Who is he talking about? The only one’s among the seven houses are Regent Estate who wear yellow.]
But his thought didn’t get far as the kid took a bite of the ginseng then showed an exasperatingly pleased expression, “You four earned three more days of living. Go and search again. If you can’t find anything, your heads will fall!”
The four demons were ecstatic and prostrated!
“Hold on!”
Zhuo Fan waved them off, “Why do I feel you enslaved them? Wasn’t it a bet and losing it made them search for an ingredient?”
Frowning, the kid was growing angry, “Bet? I loathe gambling! The one time I ever betted, I lost. It forced me to eat wretched ingredients every day. From then on I vowed never to bet again! “
“Then...” Zhuo Fan wondered, [Why were the four demons helping him with ingredients?]
The kid spoke matter of factly, “I caught these four pillaging their fourth city and was about to get rid of them. But they were willing to go around searching for ingredients in my stead, so I let them go for now! Besides, I am missing a few hands and can understand the saying ‘many hands make light work’.
“I’d feel ashamed taking their lives after eating their ingredients. But since their crimes are too serious, they are to give me an ingredient every three days. They will keep doing this for as long as my trip outside lasts. This is also a means for them to atone!”
Zhuo Fan was startled, [Why does it feel this kid is no less the weirdo the other four are?]
