[What does giving you ingredients have to do with their pillaging crimes?]
When he heard the kid spoke of stopping the four demons’ pillaging he thought he was a typical righteous cultivator, helping the poor and all that. When in fact, the kid was the same as these four from the start, enslaving others to do his bidding. Just that he used it under the guise of punishing evil.
[Shit, four vile people and a hypocrite. None of them are any good!]
[Then again, it doesn’t seem I’m made of better cloth either!]
Zhuo Fan scratched his nose, “He-he-he, how about we make a deal? The four are now under me, so I will give you ten 5th-grade ingredients to let them leave with me. What do you say?”
“Ten?” The kid’s eyes lit up and drooled. But then he paused, revealing a sly grin, “Since you have so many ingredients, you’re not going anywhere. You’ll stay right here and search for ingredients just as well!”
Eyes twitching, Zhuo Fan’s face sank, [Why you greedy little piece of...]

chapters.title: Chapter 229, Tianyu’s Strongest, Invincible Scamp
chapters.content:
Chapter 229, Tianyu’s Strongest, Invincible Scamp
Taking slow steps back, Zhuo Fan’s cold eyes stared at the kid, “Little brother, I won’t take you for an ignorant child since you’re a Radiant Stage expert. Are you going to force me into servitude?”
“He-he-he, pillagers belong in prison, so it’s only fitting they do some community service for a bit.”
“But that was done by those four. What’s it got to do with me?”
“Birds of a feather flock together! Since you’re on the same side as them, then you’re no better. A little punishment is only natural!”
Squinting, Zhuo Fan eyed that naive smile on the child, and grew angry, “You can’t go back once you started things. I do not like hitting children but if...”
“Eh, want to hit me? Ha-ha-ha, good. But let me warn you. I have no wish to kill you so I will give you all ten chances to challenge me! If you can win just once, I’ll let you all go!” The kid hooked his finger and beamed.
Zhuo Fan walked back to Li Jingtian but his eyes were more and more serious as he watched the kid.
He may be in the 2nd layer of Radiant Stage, but the kid was as calm as ever even in the face of four people one layer stronger and another, four layer stronger. He was confident in his victory.
And how the Four Scheming Demons were so scared of him, his power couldn’t be judged based on his low cultivation.
Zhuo Fan whispered to the four demons, “How is his power? Is he strong, weak?”
The four demons looked at each other and Violent Demon said cautiously, “He is very strong, but still not able to beat me. The fact is, this kid is very sharp, picking the weakness of our Four Hearts Formation with one look. How else could he defeat us?”
Zhuo Fan nodded, [I see. How else could the four enter servitude if not having their unity tactic crushed?]
But to be sure, Zhuo Fan gave Li Jingtian a signal, “Elder Li, you have to go all out on the kid. Hold nothing back. You have to kill him, and with how odd this kid is, the four demons’ words can’t be trusted either. We can’t afford to lose because of them!”
Li Jingtian nodded, bloodthirst setting into his gaze.
He suddenly roared and released billowing black energy. His immense power made the sky and earth tremble alike.
The Four Scheming Demons were able to confuse Li Jingtian thanks to their Four Hearts Formation, stopping him from releasing his full might. They now realized how terrifying Li Jingtian was.
If Li Jingtian had gone all out from the start, Violent Demon would’ve been long dead, in one move even. This would ultimately prevent the four brothers from using Four Hearts Formation.
The four united could break steel, while scattered were like grass!
But the kid was still sitting on that rock with arms crossed and unafraid. Not one change in his expression was seen. This made Zhuo Fan frown, [Is he faking it or truly belittling Li Jingtian?]
If it were the latter, the kid’s power had to be huge.
“Wraith Style, 1st move, Soaring Demonic Dragon!”
Roar!
With a dragon roar, Li Jingtian shot at the kid, surrounded by a black dragon image baring its fangs and claws, ready to rip him to pieces.
Explosions were heard with every step he took, even from the air. It seemed as if the space couldn’t hold his power. The rocks around him were pulverized as well!
“So strong!”
Even Zhuo Fan admired Li Jingtian. This martial fanatic was a true fit for Wraith Art. Its power was displayed fully in the hands of this man, showing shocking phenomenons.
But the bad feeling never left Zhuo Fan. The kid was just too calm, not putting Li Jingtian in his eyes.
[What’s going on? Even a peak Radiant Stage would show some reaction. But the kid...]
Yawning just as Li Jingtian got to him, the kid’s reaction to this expert’s incredible display of power was to extend a hand.
Pff!
A groan had everyone watch slackjawed. Li Jingtian’s mighty power was stopped as simple as that, by a boy’s hand.
The black dragon image threw a fit behind Li Jingtian, wanting to break out of its shackles, but the kid had the dragon powerless under his thin arm.
Even the world started taking different hues.
On one side, Li Jingtian’s power was still going strong, causing a veritable storm to blow over, while on the other, there was only peace and serenity behind the boy. Even sunshine warmed the gentle nature. The black dragon’s onslaught held no sway here.
“How is this... possible?” Zhuo Fan watched agape. This may very well be the very first time someone thoroughly shocked him.
Li Jingtian was sweating buckets, doing his damndest in getting out of this child’s hold.
It was the same as a crazed bull meeting a hundred meter tall cliff. Regardless of the raw power it had, it couldn’t budge the cliff one inch.
The kid grinned, “First attempt!”
The kid grabbed Li Jingtian’s arm and just threw him.
Boom!
A huge rock was blown to rubble. Zhuo Fan and the four demons were shocked and jumped in the air.
Once the dust settled, the view made them gasp.
The huge rock was flattened in an instant, and Li Jingtian struggled to crawl from beneath the rubble. He spat blood and fear crept into his gaze.
Only he who met the kid head on knew the dread he instilled.
In front of the weird kid’s eyes, he looked like a baby, easy to kill as if lifting a finger. This was his first time ever Mad Dipper experienced such powerlessness.
Zhuo Fan and the others were watching bug-eyed in fear and shock. None saw it coming, that a pup had such insane amount of power. Not even in the Sacred Domain Zhuo Fan saw such freaks.
Li Jingtian was in the 6th layer of Radiant Stage and a body cultivator genius while using a profound ranked martial art. He had enough power to face a peak Radiant Stage expert. But today, before a mere boy in the 2nd layer of Radiant Stage, he was powerless.
The kid didn’t use any kind of martial art, only the power of his hand to topple and throw Li Jingtian.
[What kind of freaky power is this?]
Zhuo Fan paled, watching the air with a blank mind. There, the kid happily sat in mid-air, “With the mountain ruined, I’ll be waiting for you on that peak. Don’t forget, three days. Oh, and your ten ingredients?”
Zhuo Fan wiped his brow, shivering as he took the ingredients for the boy. The kid was delighted as he took them, “You’re not bad, kiddio. The more ingredients you find, the Invincible Scamp, Gu Santong, will reward you heavily!”
Then he vanished into thin air.
Zhuo Fan bobbed his head on and on, and only after hitting his chest did the shivering stopped. He sighed, “God, that monster is insanely powerful!”
“S-Steward Zhuo, who did he say he was?” The wounded Li Jingtian swayed in his flight to Zhuo Fan. His eyes were incredulous.
Zhuo Fan frowned, “He seemed to have called himself, Invincible Scamp, Gu Santong! What, you know him Elder Li?”
“Holy mother of god! No wonder I lost so miserably! Of all the rotten luck, why did I have to meet that devil? How could I be so blind!” Li Jingtian slapped his head, regretting so much he was close to tears.
Zhuo Fan asked hurriedly, “Just who is this Gu Santong?”
“Hi-hi-hi, for Steward Zhuo to not know even the likes of Invincible Scamp Gu Santong, you must be dumber than a rock!” A creepy snicker came from behind Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan’s temple popped a vein, his mouth twitched and glared at the four demons, “You knew who he was and what he was capable of, didn’t you?”
“Damn right we knew. We are demonic heroes, knowing all the experts in Tianyu! With how renown this devil is, how couldn’t we recognize him? You think everyone’s a bonehead like you?” Violent Demon snickered and laughed at the two’s misfortune.
Zhuo Fan tightened his fists and cooled his anger, “Then, did you make us come here on purpose, and face that devil? Moreover, that bet was fake, right?”
“Hi-hi-hi, of course! We are demonic heroes, never done a good thing in our lives. We were so angry when that devil suppressed us and had no way to vent. But got you to join in too, and seeing you suffer brings a tear of joy in my eyes! And have you ever seen a demonic cultivator holding one’s end of a bet? You got served, ha-ha-ha...”
The Four Scheming Demons danced in joy and made a mockery out of Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan popped another vein, red from anger. Never thought the clever him, the cunning him, would be had by a bunch of schmucks. [God damn it!]
Ka!
Zhuo Fan’s finger moved and made a sign. The four were now sporting bloody marks on their forehead, wailing on the ground from pain and begging for mercy.
But Zhuo Fan held no pity for them. [If I don’t put these little shits in their place, they’ll be the death of me!]
Li Jingtian watched the four’s pain in silence.
They were total retards. They knew their lives were in the hands of another yet still dared to fool him. They only had themselves to blame for this. Now that they were also caught in the middle with Invincible Scamp Gu Santong, he knew they were in deep trouble now!
Li Jingtian frowned and sighed...

chapters.title: Chapter 230, The Legend of a Monster
chapters.content:
Chapter 230, The Legend of a Monster
“Steward Zhuo, we know our wrongs. Spare us!” Sly Demon rolled on the ground begging.
“What Steward Zhuo, it should be Daddy Zhuo. Let us go, we won’t do it again!” Scrooge Demon was wailing in pain.
“What Daddy Zhuo, it should be Grandaddy Zhuo. Please...” Violent Demon was even crying, but he didn’t get to finish as he glared at Scrooge Demon. Then he punched his face, “Damn it, you dare take advantage of me?”
Scrooge Demon held his purple eye, having no clue what happened. But Wimp Demon couldn’t take the pain and said, “Elder bro, it was the second bro calling him daddy. Then you started calling him granddaddy. Don’t blame him!”
Widening his eyes, Violent Demon cuffed Wimp Demon, “Bastard, silence is frickin’ golden!”
“Why do you hit me when it was all your fault?” Scrooge Demon instantly understood having heard Wimp Demon. He charged with a rage filled fist.
Wimp Demon was glum, and even though he didn’t join the hustle and bustle, he circled behind eldest brother and whacked him with a fist whenever he had the chance.
Third bro, Sly Demon, who wished for nothing more than to see the chaos blow out of proportions, held his head from the pain while cheering from the side.
The four thus entered their routine squabble, making it all so lively.
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched from all the ruckus, popping a third vein. He never met such hard to deal with weirdos. They even had time to quarrel while being tortured by the Bloodworm!
“It seems a bit of pain is not up to your standards. Then how about we kick things up a notch!” Zhuo Fan made another sign.
Pff!
The four demons spurted blood and turned blood red all over as they scrambled from the pain. It was so excruciating they hadn’t had the mind to quarrel anymore.
Zhuo Fan panted, almost blowing his top at the four. When he calmed down, he said, “Elder Li, who is that Gu Santong? Why is he so dreadful?”
Shaking his head, Li Jingtian sighed, “I am not clear either, but legends say Gu Santong is called Invincible Scamp. Undefeated throughout his life. Three centuries ago, he caused a storm through Tianyu, throwing the empire on the brink of collapse . He later vanished into thin air, never hearing from him since. I never thought we’d meet him here!”
“What, three hundred years ago? How is he looking so young if he’s so old?” Zhuo Fan was shocked.
Li Jingtian was also puzzled, “I am not sure either. I only heard rumors about him. If he truly is the Invincible Scamp, then he is indeed three centuries old! Or perhaps, he is Invincible Scamp’s descendant, carrying his name...”
“Hi-hi-hi, Invincible Scamp Gu Santong has caused immense waves with his indomitable power at the time, how can someone else have his title? Moreover, you’ve seen his method, if he is not the real Invincible Scamp, how could you have ended up in such a sorry state?”
Violent Demon shouted his mockery, while the other demons’ wailing at the side turned into a creepy combination with snickering in the mix.
Li Jingtian caressed his beard and nodded. The four little shits’ words were mostly senseless blabber, dumb as wood, but they spoke reason, sometimes. He didn’t believe there was anyone outside this legendary Invincible Scamp that could bring him to such a sorry state.
Zhuo Fan snapped a glance at the four, “Elder Li doesn’t know about Gu Santong, but you do?”
“Damn right. This geezer may be old, but he knows shit having been born way before the war three hundred years ago!” Violent Demon mocked.
Zhuo Fan scowled, “You’re not much older than Elder Li so how do you know then?”
“He-he-he, Steward Zhuo, there’s something you’re missing. When Gu Santong was causing havoc in the empire, he not only shamed the seven houses, but the entire Tianyu Empire. This made his name taboo to the whole empire. Among the seven houses, only house lords know of his endeavors and that only passed through speech from the previous house lords. The elders hardly know a thing about him. And that is because of the shame he represented, hi-hi-hi...”
Violent Demon’s creepy laughter seemed to mock the seven houses, “Demon Scheming Sect is different. Even before Tianyu was in uproar, our elders warned us to not get entangled with this monster. I can only blame our rotten luck to have stumbled on him just as we got out of that wretched place. Ah, woe is me...”
Having recalled the bitter experience, Violent Demon started crying along with his three demons, who were also wailing on top of things.
Zhuo Fan had it, “Stop crying and tell the truth for once!”
“Alright!” The four demons’ rivers of tears dried up on the spot, “We ask that Steward Zhuo spares us. Let us clear our thoughts...”
Zhuo Fan squinted and sighed but still made a sign to stop their torture. They then resumed their creepy laughter and jumped in joy.
Zhuo Fan saw they hadn’t learned their lesson even a fraction and he was fuming mad, “Explain it to me clearly and I’ll forgo your previous transgression. Or else...”
His fingers moved, threatening them with more torture and they panicked, “Steward Zhuo, don’t worry, we know when to be serious. We won’t ever dare fool you again!
Zhuo Fan nodded satisfied.
The four looked at each other and Violent Demon was the first to start, “As far as we know, Invincible Scamp Gu Santong’s life is an odd one. Simply unheard of!”
“What do you mean?” Zhuo Fan frowned.
Violent Demon shook his head and said, “It’s so damn baffling that even we don’t know the full extent of this oddity!”
Zhuo Fan almost fell and his eyes started spewing flames of rage as he cursed, “Cut the crap! Carry on to egg me, and I’ll give you a world of pain!”
Zhuo Fan was about to do just that when Sly Demon jumped in, “Wait, Steward Zhuo, eldest bro is serious. Gu Santong is truly baffling that even we know little of him. He just sprung up out of nowhere. With the imperial family, the empire’s three guardian sects, and the seven houses’ power, not even an ant could’ve caused such havoc, least of all a man. But isn’t it bizarre how Gu Santong just popped up from thin air?”
Zhuo Fan’s hand stopped in mid sign.
The four demons had some screws loose, most of the time, but Sly Demon was speaking some reason. It was baffling how an unknown powerful devil just showed up like that.
[From the Sacred Domain perhaps?]
Zhuo Fan spoke, “Go on!”
Violent Demon continued, “The kid always had this appearance, that of an eight year old boy. But he was only in the 5th layer of Profound Heaven Stage at the time. But after three hundred years, he is still as young, yet his cultivation increased to the 2nd layer of Radiant Stage, quite slow I might add. What never changed all this time is him holding the title of Tianyu’s strongest. Before, he was the strongest beneath the Radiant Stage and now he is the strongest in the Radiant Stage!”
“Oh, that baffling?” Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan ‘s heart was filled with suspicions.
If this kid was an old monster, did he perhaps use cultivation to keep such appearances? That may also explain why his cultivation went so slow.
But who was dumb enough to keep himself as young as a child? They’d usually stop around 16. This way they could partake in some of the more pleasant aspects of life, he-he-he...
This seemed to have made Zhuo Fan recall a veil-covered face and the demure figure. But Zhuo Fan shook his head at that thought.
He was aiming to become an overlord on the demonic path, how could he ever let himself get bogged down by kinship?
[Perhaps the kid’s thinking the same thing.]
So far, Zhuo Fan could understand him, “Continue!”
“He is really queer. He doesn’t like anything, except eating ingredients. If it was anyone else, he’d be already blown to bits by the potent ingredients. But he is unscathed! Steward Zhuo, I’m sure you can imagine by now, which houses’ ingredients are the most appealing when this freak ever ran out of them!”
“Imperial family and the seven houses?” Zhuo Fan’s eyes widened and suddenly showed a sly grin, “Could it be..”
“Hi-hi-hi, Steward Zhuo sure is evil, thinking about plunging the world into chaos. Though it is the truth nonetheless. The kid went to Pill King Hall’s fields and picked them clean of any and all herbs raging from 2nd to 7th grade. He even gobbled those 8th grade ones that took a thousand years to grow! How could Pill King Hall sit still after that? So their elders chased after him. The kid didn’t use any martial art, but his fists are insanely powerful. In just a single move, the elders were wiped out completely! I am sure this old geezer here knows the taste of that fist the best, he-he-he...”
Violent Demon mocked Li Jingtian.
Li Jingtian nodded, breaking out in sweat just thinking about it.
In their clash, Gu Santong didn’t even punch, only threw him like nothing and already gave him a deep wound. If it were a punch instead, his life would’ve been forfeited.
[Such outstanding power!]
Taking a deep breath, Li Jingtian shuddered from the memory and fear crawled into his heart.
This never happened in all his long years as Mad Dipper!
Zhuo Fan understood his state of mind and paled as well. He patted Elder Li’s shoulder in comfort, and spoke with seriousness, “And then?”
“Hi-hi-hi, then Pill King Hall requested assistance from Regent Estate and they sent their elders on the kid’s trail, only to suffer the same fate. All the while Gu Santong was rampant in robbing ingredients everywhere he went, even attacking the warehouses of the seven houses and leaving them with nothing. Without a choice, the always squabbling seven houses put aside their differences and worked together for the first time. They issued the worst and most cruel order since the empire’s existence, the Demon Purging Decree...”
[Say what?!]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes widened in shock. He recalled how everyone spoke of this Demon Purging Decree as the most gruesome thing in existence. And the first use was on Gu Santong. But how was that kid still alive now?
[Just what kind of power does he have? How could he fight against an entire nation and only as a damn Profound Heaven expert...]

chapters.title: Chapter 231, The Third Divine Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 231, The Third Divine Dragon
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Silavin
“Once the Demon Purging Decree was issued, every place Gu Santong had been was burned to the ground! It reached a point where every man, woman, and child shouted at him to die out of fear. He was treated like a public enemy. It didn’t matter where he went, because the entire empire was against him. Isolated and despised, this mere child began to feel glum. Rumor has it that when the seven houses’ Venerables chased, the kid had no heart to fight and fled. The Demon Purging Decree showed results in the end, at least it cut the little monster’s fighting spirit.”
Zhuo Fan nodded.
He was clear on that feeling, as demonic cultivators had often stumbled upon such a situation. Because they killed some righteous people for some reason, the others disregarded the truth and demanded their deaths. All because they were labeled demonic.
In such a helpless and isolated state, anyone would feel miserable. For this exact reason, his firm belief was that a demonic cultivator had to stand on his own, to cultivate a certain state of mind.
Even if alone, one needed to have the courage to face the whole world.
As such, he, the Demonic Emperor, didn’t establish a sect or a cult after his rise, becoming the loneliest of the eight emperors. This was also the nature of demonic cultivators, though when problems arose there would have been no one to rely on.
Gu Santong may be invincible, but he was still very much like a child. The isolation and hatred had an even greater effect, leaving him with a trauma.
[Sigh, the Demon Purging Decree is psychological warfare!]
Zhuo Fan sighed and said to Violent Demon, “Then how did he remove his heart demon to become the current Invincible Scamp?”
“Hi-hi-hi, Steward Zhuo sure is smart. You caught on right away he didn’t have that title before!” Violent Demon laughed.
Zhuo Fan grinned, “Becoming isolated bores heavy on one’s mind. In this state, even if powerful, it was still far from becoming invincible!”
“Ha-ha-ha, precisely. When the seven houses’ Venerables went after the kid, he was slowly reaching the end of his rope, on the brink of annihilation. But something happened then, and the kid changed completely. After only three months, when people thought he was on his deathbed and were searching for his corpse, he emerged. But if before he still had an innocent and childish manner, this time, he was devil incarnate. His actions struck fear in not only the seven houses, but the imperial family as well. His style was very much like ours from the demonic path, Hi-hi-hi...”
“Oh, what did he do?” Zhuo Fan grew excited and Li Jingtian eager.
Breaking out in laughter again, the light in Violent Demon’s eyes danced, “Do unto others as others have done unto you! Once he appeared again, he threatened to destroy the entire empire. ‘Didn’t you declare Demon Purging Decree on me, burning any place I have been to to isolate me? Fine then, I won’t wait for you to destroy the cities I’m just going to do it myself and save you the trouble. Every place I visit will be wiped out. When I leave this Tianyu, the empire will be an empty one!’”
“Hi-hi-hi, Steward Zhuo, Old Li, could you even fathom the kid’s baffling power? Every single punch and kick of his razed cities to the ground. This not only had the seven houses scared, but the entire Tianyu was shaking in their boots. They had to be crying inside at the time, thinking ‘what did it have to do with them’. ‘We’re innocent!’ Ha-ha-ha, a bunch of morons if you ask me, the lot of them! “
The other three demons were also excited, wishing they had been there to stir trouble. Sly Demon even spoke over Violent Demon.
Violent Demon glared then kicked him, “Damn you, Sly Demon, this is the best part. I’m telling the story!”
Sly Demon smirked and snorted inside but made no comment.
Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian were speechless. Li Jingtian asked, “I once heard of the kid’s notoriety, but never knew he was so vicious. He wanted to destroy an empire, by himself?”
But Zhuo Fan shook his head, clapping in admiration, “His guts are commendable. I would’ve done the same thing in his stead.”
“Humph, as for those who called themselves innocent, at the moment of the Demon Purging Decree, there was no one who stood up to the seven houses’ slaughter. In fact, they even pitched in. They were anything but innocent. And since they became enemies, mercy and regrets have no place here!”
Zhuo Fan snickered and nodded, “The little imp is starting to grow on me.”
Li Jingtian looked long at Zhuo Fan and found his impression was not unlike his own.
In this cruel world, it was kill or be killed. Even innocent killings were the order of the day. And in the case of enemies, there was even less remorse.
[Steward Zhuo is truly a man who will make countless sacrifices.] Li Jingtian sighed inside.
“And then?” Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian asked in unison.
Glaring at his three bros to curb their interruption, Violent Demon continued, “He-he-he, what followed next was a prime example of how a true demonic cultivator should act. In but half a year, the kid fulfilled his promise, wiping out every place he went to until his onslaught had covered half the empire. Any and all who heard his coming, sent the people fleeing for their lives. The seven houses’ Venerable joined hands to surround him, to no avail. The kid still went on killing regardless of opposition. He then started to be referred as the All-ravaging Child! To show that everywhere he went, he left ravaged lands behind him!
“The imperial family could no longer take it, seeing the seven houses in disarray. If it didn’t intervene now, the empire would be done for. So it sent its 50 Divine Dragons...”
Violent Demon started sputtering as he spoke from the excitement. As if he was the one laying Tianyu to ruin instead. Zhuo Fan waved him off, “Hold on, How many Divine Dragons was that again?”
Violent Demon raised five fingers, “Fifty, why?”
Sss~
Gasping, Zhuo Fan was shocked, “There were fifty Divine Dragons then? You mean to say fifty Jade Flute Divine Sword Fang Qiubai at peak Radiant Stage?”
“He-he-he, Steward Zhuo, you’ve got it all wrong. The aptitudes of Divine Dragons at the time weren’t as high as the current ones. How could there be fifty Jade Flute Divine Sword?”
Zhuo Fan nodded and sighed. Fifty Jade Flute Divine Sword was a dreaded sight. More to the point, it would be even more damn frightening if the kid escaped from them as well.
Before he even had the chance to calm his thoughts, Violent Demon continued, “The imperial family was still going strong at the time, having around twenty experts like Jade Flute Divine Sword. And the other thirty were at least in the 5th layer of Radiant Stage. Three among them were even called Immemorial Sages by the world, stronger than even Jade Flute Divine Sword. Even Invincible Scamp had a hard time dealing with them!”
“What?” Zhuo Fan cried and looked at Li Jingtian. They two were incredulous the imperial family ever held so much power.
Easily guessing their thoughts, the Four Scheming Demons started their creepy jeer, “Hi-hi-hi, how ignorant you are. You think Tianyu’s imperial family and the seven houses of now only have this little power after a thousand years? Just three centuries ago, the imperial family had fifty Divine Dragons, the Regent Estate a hundred Radiant Stage experts and the other houses in the tens. This is what kept the houses in a delicate balance.
“But in the war with Gu Santong, the seven houses’ united force of hundreds of Radiant Stage experts were almost wiped out. Even the imperial family’s fifty Divine Dragons were destroyed, leaving but only the three Immemorial Sages alive. This battle waged for a whole year in a devastating fashion. Two of the sages ultimately succumbed from in this war of attrition, leaving behind the strongest Immemorial Sage to contend with the little monster. But at this time, both of them were nearing their limits, with the end looking to be drawn in mutual destruction...”
Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian were wide eyed.
[Thank god Invincible Scamp wrecked Tianyu three hundred years ago or the Luo clan would’ve never got to rise above the seven houses not even in a hundred years, not to mention ten!]
Zhuo Fan wiped his brow, cheering inside!
“By the way, how did their fight end? With the kid still alive, did the last sage die? If that is so, why then the kid hid himself for the past centuries?”
Nodding, Violent Demon smiled, “Precisely. The last sage was very smart. He knew if both died, the imperial family would be left stranded, and the seven houses ultimately dividing Tianyu! So at the very end, he read the kid’s nature and resorted to shamelessly dupe him into a thousand year agreement. He stated that if he stood his ground after receiving the kid’s ten punches, the kid would replace him in becoming the imperial family’s Divine Dragon and safeguarding the imperial family for a thousand years!
“If he died, then Gu Santong could do with Tianyu as he pleased, with no one stopping him! Hi-hi-hi, Steward Zhuo, don’t you think this is the most ridiculous joke you’ve ever heard? If the sage died, with all other Divine Dragons laying dead as well, who on earth remained to stop the little monster? This was the most obvious trap if I ever saw one, but the kid was duped just as easily, or perhaps overconfident in his strength. Once the ten punches were struck, the sage was peach perfect and Invincible Scamp had the rotten luck of being in the imperial family’s indentured servant ever since. Hi-hi-hi, what a moron! If it were me, I’d disregard the bet even after the punches, ha-ha-ha...
“I am tens of times wiser than that brat, a genius I tell ya!”
The other demons egged him on with thumbs up, and Violent Demon’s laughter only grew more rampant.
But Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian were shocked speechless. Never in their wildest dreams had they conceived that Gu Santong was the imperial family’s third Divine Dragon...

chapters.title: Chapter 232, A Stubborn Heart
chapters.content:
Chapter 232, A Stubborn Heart
The five Divine Dragons of the imperial family, the strongest in Tianyu.
And yet, the highly placed members of the seven houses had limited knowledge about them, limited to Jade Flute Divine Sword Fang Qiubai and Monochrome Chess Sage Sima Hui. The house lords were the only ones entitled to the matters pertaining three centuries ago, that the Invincible Scamp Gu, the devil who pushed Tianyu on the brink of collapse, was now a Divine Dragon.
But this resolution only brought more problems than solved.
Zhuo Fan squinted at the four demons, “Since the imperial family is rearing this behemoth, what is it doing getting scared of the seven houses?”
“He-he-he, Steward Zhuo, you clearly know nothing. That last Immemorial Sage was the strongest in Tianyu, on the brink of breaking out of the Radiant Stage’s shackles and reaching the Void Consciousness and becoming undying! A pity he met Gu Santong, that little monster. Regardless of how strong he was, he couldn’t stand the kid’s ten punches. But even so, thanks to his consciousness on the brink of becoming void, he endured the kid’s onslaught for a full hour before having his soul scattered.
“Gu Santong admired his dedication, who was willing to stake his soul in winning the bet. This was how the man protected Tianyu’s imperial family and forced the kid to stick to his promise. But Gu Santong was no fool either. He resigned to only protecting the imperial family and nothing more. Thus, he was the imperial family’s strongest shield, but not their spear, ignoring any orders. Even so, the imperial family still won. Would anyone dare disobey them, when they had him on their side?
“Of course, his existence was never accepted by the seven houses. If he went berserk again, what would become of the seven houses? So, they went to the emperor again and again for a resolution or they would be leaving the empire! For lack of a better choice, the imperial family could only ask for the kid to make a vow as a Divine Dragon to not attack the seven houses unless provoked. Also, the imperial family will have him under strict supervision. He is not to step one foot outside the Imperial Capital without the Emperor’s explicit approval.
“With how Tianyu lost its backbone in that war, if the seven houses withdrew, the empire was open to foreign invasions. And the kid had no choice but to agree to this and protect the imperial family through the oath! The seven houses begrudgingly compromised as well, and the imperial family changed his title into Invincible Scamp. As if to mean all that happened was just a kid throwing a tantrum. But now, the Invincible Scamp who’s been locked away for three centuries by the imperial family was set free by the Emperor!”
Violent Demon and the three demons wore their brows in a frown.
Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian nodded and sighed. Gu Santong was indeed savage, but also honorable, far more than these little shits.
Zhuo Fan squinted at the four, and snickered, “Is that all?”
“Uh, pretty much. Now then, Steward Zhuo, you have the boundless honor of listening to the legends of the much greater, much more heroic four demons than even the likes of Invincible Scamp Gu Santong! Correct, those four are without a doubt yours truly, the demonic heroes, Four Scheming...”
“Not interested!”
With a sneer and a sign, the four demons started wailing in torment as they tousled the ground.
Among the screams of pain they voiced their doubts, “Steward Zhuo, what did we do this time? Is this how you repay us?”
“Nothing bad, in fact you did exemplary work. I’m only dishing out premeditated punishment...” Zhuo Fan snickered and cackled.
The four’s hearts were in grief as they shouted, “Steward Zhuo, you’re breaking your promise. You said you’ll forget about everything if we told you about Gu Santong!”
“Tch tch tch...” Zhuo Fan mocked, “We’re all demon cultivators here, right? Since when can you believe anything we say? You’re morons to have trusted me in the first place!”
Pff!
Li Jingtian almost burst out laughing.
It was the four little shits who duped Zhuo Fan in the first place, and now he was paying them back in spades. [Steward Zhuo isn’t one to take a loss, regardless how small.] The Four Scheming Demons were on the verge of tears.
Zhuo Fan returned their mocking words right back at them, leaving them speechless.
Being tricked made them feel anger, sorrow, pain, the works. [My head hurts, my face hurts, my whole body hurts!]
They could only resort to begging now. But Zhuo Fan turned a deaf ear to their pleading, speaking to Li Jingtian with a smile, “Elder Li, do you know what I’m thinking?”
“He-he-he, Steward Zhuo wants Gu Santong?” Li Jingtian’s eyes lit up.
Nodding, Zhuo Fan’s eyes shined with exceptional greed, “I’ve never wanted a subordinate as much as I want him!”
“But if the imperial family finds out you’ve stolen their cornerstone from under their feet...” Li Jingtian was worried.
Grinning, Zhuo Fan mocked, “With Gu Santong in the bag, what good will it do to them if they know? They couldn’t handle his power three centuries ago, but can they now?”
Li Jingtian laughed!
Zhuo Fan launched into the air, flying for Gu Santong’s mountain, “Elder Li, look after them. I’m going to probe the devil. I am going to confirm some suspicions of mine.”
“Steward Zhuo, don’t worry. Leave this to me, ha-ha-ha...” Cupping his hands, Li Jingtian turned to four, their wailing music to his ears...
Whoosh!
Zhuo Fan landed on the peak. He saw Gu Santong sitting on the edge of a cliff with his dainty feet dangling and enjoying the sunset.
Seeing him approach, the kid’s eyes lit up, “Oh, you’re back so fast. Did you already get an ingredient?”
“Ha-ha-ha, yep!” Zhuo Fan nodded.
Gu Santong was caught by surprise and cheered as he jumped to Zhuo Fan, “How are you so fast? Take it out and let me see.”
Zhuo Fan’s hand shined and revealed a purple leaf.
“Another 5th-grade ingredient!” Gu Santong was overjoyed, eager to dig in since the smell was intoxicating.
Without preamble, he bit into it as he praised Zhuo Fan, “You’re not bad at all. Far better than the others. Those four couldn’t get one in three days, but you found one in an instant! Ha-ha-ha, you did well. I won’t forget it!”
“Oh, and how will you repay me?” Zhuo Fan smiled.
Gu Santong hesitated, his eyes darting all over before holding out two fingers in all seriousness, “I’ll give you two more attempts. You just have to defeat me once and I’ll let you all go. With the old guy using one, you are left with eleven!”
“Ha-ha-ha, so this is your reward!”
Zhuo Fan chuckled and shook his head as he cursed the brat in his head.
[This punk was corrupted by the strongest Immemorial Sage alright, giving fake rewards. Blast it, if I could beat you, what need do I have of you to let me go? We’d be leaving anyway!]
[But since we can’t, more attempts only means getting beaten by you even more. Are you taking us for fools?]
[You’ll get yours, oh don’t you worry. In a jiffy, I will put your cheeky ass in place. I’ll show you how it’s really done!]
Zhuo Fan snickered, “Then I’ll be going to get more and more attempts!”
“Go, go! Work hard now!” Gu Santong waved him off, as if Zhuo Fan was nothing to him but a precious ingredient dispenser.
Zhuo Fan left with a smile and returned fifteen minutes later to Li Jingtian. The Four Scheming Demons rushed to beg for mercy, but Zhuo Fan didn’t even spare them a glance, “Elder Li, the kid’s only redeeming feature is his brawn. Easy to handle!”
“Eh, what do you mean?” Li Jingtian’s asked eager.
Zhuo Fan showed two items. One was the Bloodworm gourd, the other, a glowing ingredient more precious than a mere 5th grade.
Zhuo Fan took a Bloodworm from the gourd and placed it on the ingredient. The worm then disappeared deep inside it.
Li Jingtian still didn’t understand, but Zhuo Fan explained, “In your fight with the kid, I noticed how he never used Discerning Field despite being in the Radiant Stage. So I tested him again with a 5th grade ingredient. Seeing him gobble it up like candy, we’ll give him this Bloodworm spiked ingredient and then...”
The two shared a look and sank into a choreographed evil snicker.
In the middle of the four’s cries Wimp Demon was about to say something but Violent Demon’s glare cut him short.
The other two demons along with Violent Demon snickered. But their mockery of the pair didn’t sound much different from their wails making it fall under Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian’s radar...
Whoosh!
Zhuo Fan went to Gu Santong again.
Gu Santong was suspicious now, “How are you so fast? Did you get another one?”
“Yep!” Zhuo Fan nodded.
Gu Santong was overjoyed, “You’re the very definition of an expert, not like those four snails. Give it here and I’ll give you... ten attempts!”
“Ha-ha-ha, much obliged!”
Smirking, Zhuo Fan presented the ingredient and Gu Santong cried in joy, “It’s a 6th-grade ingredient. You’re incredible!”
Zhuo Fan only smiled, but he mocked him inside.
[To make you take the bait and drop your guard, I’m even giving you a 6th-grade ingredient! Curses, I didn’t even get that many off of Drifting Flowers Edifice!]
[But it’s fine. Using it in exchange for such a powerful expert is bloody worth it!]
His eyes shining, Zhuo Fan licked his lips, staring closely at Gu Santong. As long as the brat ate it, then he would have the strongest in Tianyu at his fingertips.
Even Zhuo Fan couldn’t control his excitement as his heart hammered in his chest.
But Gu Santong didn’t eat it and frowned, “Eh, there’s something off about this ingredient!”
Bam!
Zhuo Fan’s heart hit rock bottom, watching on nervously. [Did the brat find out...]

chapters.title: Chapter 233, Complete Loss
chapters.content:
Chapter 233, Complete Loss
“How can a genuine 6th-grade ingredient have problems?” Zhuo Fan scratched his nose as worry crept in his heart.
Scrunching his nose, Gu Santong frowned and split the ingredient in two with his fingers. A red worm was seen wiggling further into the ingredient, but Gu Santong picked it up.
“What is this?” Gu Santong’s set his eyes on Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan was shocked inside, but didn’t show it. If the kid found out, he’d be pulverized with a flick alone!
Zhuo Fan knew he couldn’t admit it even in death. He had to play innocent, “Strange, how did a worm get inside an ingredient?”
“Yeah, ingredients are worldly treasure so how could this grand 6th-grade ingredient caught a worm?” Gu Santong stared Zhuo Fan down. But could only shake his head in the end having not detected any abnormalities. He killed the bug and ate the ingredient, “Whatever, anything is possible in this world! But be more careful next time you go pick ingredients.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, and hightail it out of there with a soaked back.
How did this kid, without a Discerning Field, find out about the Bloodworm?
Luckily the kid didn’t doubt him or he’d be a goner!
Recalling Li Jingtian’s heavy wounds after a mere throw, Zhuo Fan swallowed dryly as he flew away.
Yet Gu Santong still sat there on the cliff, chewing ingredients with a frown. [How is it that an ingredient caught a worm?]
Whoosh!
Zhuo Fan returned like lighting to Li Jingtian. The latter was eager to know the result, “Steward Zhuo, how was it?”
“Can’t you tell from my face?” Zhuo Fan spoke glumly.
Li Jingtian knew Zhuo Fan was depressed, “You mean the kid used the Discerning Field for the first time?”
“As if!”
Zhuo Fan shook his head and sighed, his brow in a constant frown, “And this is what worries me. Without using his soul to investigate, how the hell did he find the hidden worm? If I can’t understand this, any future attempts will be pointless!”
Li Jingtian sank in thought as well. The four demons suddenly stopped yelling as they tried muffling their laughter. But the pain got too much and soon resumed their tenor symphony.
Zhuo Fan couldn’t care less, however.
“Steward Zhuo, should we try with eggs?” Li Jingtian proposed, “We may not know what trick he used, but not even Discerning Field can find the eggs. I refused to believe he is any different!”
Zhuo Fan slapped his thigh, “We’ll do it like you said Elder Li! But this time it will cost me heavily!”
Gnashing his teeth, Zhuo Fan’s hand revealed a three-foot-long red and white root.
Li Jingtian shouted in shock, “7th-grade ingredient, Yin Yang Moon Fire Root!”
“Correct. This ingredient is hot on the outside but cold inside. This is one of the few ingredients with yin and yang in harmony. Because of it’s rarity, it is even valued higher than an 8th-grade ingredient.”
Stammering, Zhuo Fan caressed the red hot root yet ice cold whiskers with a bleeding heart, “I got it when I was in Drifting Flowers Edifice and couldn’t bear the thought of using it in the competition. Yet, I am now using it to house some worm eggs. When the kid takes it, it’s the same as eating a Spring Pill, quickening the growth of the worm!”
Seeing him so reluctant, Li Jingtian patted his shoulder, “Steward Zhuo, you know what they say, nothing ventured, nothing gained. Think about it, a 7th-grade ingredient in exchange for the Invincible Scamp, no matter how you see it, it’s totally worth it. I’m sure you can see it with your cunning mind!”
Zhuo Fan’s gaze hardened and nodded, “Yes, this is not just a mere exchange but a great deal!”
Zhuo Fan let a Bloodworm into the ingredient, then soon after put it back in the gourd.
Now the ingredient was filled with Bloodworm eggs.
Taking a deep breath, he looked at the ingredient with hope and smiled, “Everything rests on you now!”
“Good luck, Steward Zhuo!” Li Jingtian cupped his hands.
Zhuo Fan nodded and flew to Gu Santong.
He was there in a flash.
Startled, Gu Santong turned to Zhuo Fan, “You’re damn quick, you know that? Those four fools have nothing on you! What did you find this time? Take it out...”
But he couldn’t finish as the sight of the ingredient in Zhuo Fan’s hands had him wide eyed, “7th-grade ingredient! You actually found a 7th grade ingredient?”
“Just lucky, I guess!” Zhuo Fan nodded.
Gu Santong took it and drooled. He was moved to tears, “A 7th-grade ingredient, oh I haven’t had one in three centuries. Those bastards in yellow only know how to starve me with wretched 1st and 2nd grade ingredients. It took me three hundred years to reach the 2nd layer of Radiant Stage...”
Gu Santong lamented his grief, while Zhuo Fan nodded inwardly.
Now he knew who he was talking about. They were the Imperial Capital’s guards. He found another big secret as well. His cultivation didn’t rely on training, or maybe training did very little. Only eating ingredients increased his strength.
[Curses, if I take him in, I’ll go broke before I get to raise him!]
On second thought, [I might not need to feed him anyway since he is already invincible. Yeah, no problem.]
Then, it suddenly occurred to him.
[The Imperial family definitely has high grade ingredients. Yet, over the last centuries they’ve only been feeding him 1st and 2nd grade.]
[Was it done on purpose to hold this monster’s growth in check?]
[So the more power he has the harder it is for the imperial family to control him!]
Squinting, Zhuo Fan realized Gu Santong was unlike the rumors painted him as the strongest in the empire. At least the imperial family seemed to have a way to keep him in check.
Otherwise there was no reason to stunt his cultivation for so many years.
Zhuo Fan took a deep breath. As of yet, he was unsure if this conjecture was real or not, but he couldn’t ignore it either or he’d be suffering at the hands of the imperial family sometime in the future.
The imperial family still had uses for them and they were relying on the imperial family, but who was to say when all of this could just go belly up?
[In short, there are no everlasting friends. Anyone can become an enemy!]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed coldly!
Eh?
Gu Santong suddenly frowned and cried out. He looked at the ingredient and shook his head, “This one is also fishy. Why are all the ingredients you find so queer?”
His heart drumming in his chest, Zhuo Fan swallowed dryly, “Ha-ha-ha, what could possibly be wrong?”
Gu Santong snapped the ingredient in two and pointed, “See that?”
Zhuo Fan saw the core of the ingredient in shock.
Gu Santong broke it right where the Bloodworm laid its eggs. The middle of this 7th grade ingredient was white as the moon and released a deep chill. But in this whiteness, there were some greyish dots, Bloodworm’s eggs.
The average man would definitely miss them even with scrutiny. Not even a Radiant Stage expert searching it with his soul could find them – Li Jingtian bore testament to that.
Yet this little monster actually did it! Not only found them, but even accurately struck their exact spot. Even Zhuo Fan had to admire his prowess!
[This ain’t the time to gawk!]
Wiping his brow, Zhuo Fan squinted and faked, “Uh, what are you saying? I can’t see anything!”
Gu Santong pointed his childlike finger, “See these dots, they don’t match the ingredient. They are in fact closely resembling the worm in the last ingredient. They must be its eggs.”
Zhuo Fan’s heart sank and his legs almost gave.
[He looks like a clueless brat, but his eyesight is spot on. He can even see similarities between the eggs and the Bloodworm!]
Zhuo Fan was gripped with fear. [If the kid blames me for the worm and the eggs, a single hit from him will reduce me to pulp!]
But that didn’t happen as Gu Santong waved the eggs off the ingredient and started chewing it.
He chewed as he smiled, “I can’t blame you for this, just like the ingredient with the worm in it. How can I throw away a 7th grade ingredient? I don’t mind taking it, ha-ha-ha...”
Gu Santong laughed brightly, and Zhuo Fan felt his heart bleed.
[Ahhhhh! Not only I lost a fortune but I couldn’t get the kid either. I lost everything!]
But as he was mourning the loss, Gu Santong’s words drifted over, “Hey, you’re really good at finding ingredients. So why don’t I shorten the time? One ingredient every two hours, a 7th-grade one!”
Stumbling, Zhuo Fan was close to spurting blood. He had no one to blame but himself!
Giving the kid so many ingredients ended up with him admitting defeat. And instead of getting him wrapped around Zhou Fan’s fingers, the kid asked a 7th grade ingredient per two hours! [He’s killing me!]
Not even he had so many on hand...

chapters.title: Chapter 234, Godlike Nose
chapters.content:
Chapter 234, Godlike Nose
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Silavin
In a place filled with rubble, Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian sat glumly on a big stone. Four were howling in the background, completing the picture with the odd twist and turn as pain stabbed through them!
Zhuo Fan sighed at the sky and stood, “I need to go give the imp another ingredient! If this keeps up, I’ll lose everything...”
“Steward Zhuo, can’t we just flee? Why must we suffer at his hands?” Li Jingtian frowned.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Flee? I am not giving up. I already lost six 7th-grade ingredients, but still can’t find that brat’s weakness. If I leave now, all of that will go to waste. Humph, I’ve never once suffered so much in a deal!”
Li Jingtian understood him. Now was time to go all out against this Invincible Scamp Gu Santong. Zhuo Fan refused to believe he couldn’t subdue him, not after wasting so many ingredients on the prick.
So Li Jingtian only shook his head, unable to figure out what Gu Santong’s trick is to leave even the cunning Zhuo Fan out of options!
But just then, creepy laughter resounded.
Zhuo Fan looked back in reflex to see the four demons wrecked with pain yet slipping a sneer among the tortured faces.
It was an odd sound for sure, the combination of groans and jeers coming out of those twisted faces didn’t seem natural. You couldn’t tell if it was crying or laughing.
But their eyes spoke enough for Zhuo Fan to pick on their naked mockery!
“What are you laughing at?” Zhuo Fan snapped, “You know, don’t you?”
The creepy laughter grounded to a halt, and the four turned around and wailed in pain once again. Zhuo Fan tightened his fists.
This was silent protest. Zhuo Fan could bet his ingredients that the four knew something!
“Speak, and your mistakes shall be crossed out. Or I can promise you will go through such pain you can’t even begin to imagine!” Zhuo Fan squinted and spoke with bloodthirst.
Wimp Demon shuddered, but Violent Demon’s glare stopped him from saying anything, “Damn fourth bro, did you forget how he played us? If you say one word, I will... ah!”
Violent Demon couldn’t finish as Zhuo Fan’s hand sign ramped up the pain. He could only flop around from agony.
The other demons were startled and Wimp Demon was downright shaking, “Steward Zhuo, Gu Santong’s nose is very sharp. It doesn’t matter what you do to the ingredient, he’ll always find out!”
“Nose?”
His eyes widening, Zhuo Fan turned to Li Jingtian. Then his sign changed and Wimp Demon’s pain up and vanished.
Wimp Demon moved around in joy.
Zhuo Fan spoke, “Wimp Demon, tell me all you know!”
Wimp Demon held Zhuo Fan in fear and nodded, “Gu Santong isn’t only outrageously powerful, his nose is more so, godlike even. The last time we gave him an ingredient, we laced it with poison, but he sniffed it out instantly and beat us to a pulp. Then we thought of fleeing, but he could easily sniff us out in a thousand miles, giving us another beating. Then... there is no then. We searched seriously knowing we can’t escape his evil clutches and looked for ingredients for him...”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes twitched, but he believed him!
He was amazing enough to sniff out the poison out of an ingredient. But to track them down in a thousand mile radius, that was godlike.
Even Radiant Stage’s Discerning Field paled in comparison!
Now the pair knew why Gu Santong let them go about searching for ingredients without minding them. No matter where they went, he’d find them!
“He can smell the Bloodworm and its eggs? Is that it?” Zhuo Fan was incredulous, “Such an insanely sharp nose. Is he perhaps looking down on Discerning Field?”
Li Jingtian’s face was grave as well, “Steward Zhuo, does that mean escaping is impossible?”
“Uh, I urge you not to flee, or you’ll only suffer instead!” Wimp Demon warned.
Zhuo Fan took a deep breath and nodded. Gu Santong was even more amazing then he thought. Now not only striking back at him was impossible, even fleeing was out.
Zhuo Fan was glum.
But he showed a smile to Wimp Demon, patting him, “Wimp Demon, you’re a nice guy. Far better than those idiots. You’ve been tousled by the Bloodworm enough, go take a rest.”
“What?!”
Wimp Demon whooped in joy while the other three demons cried in dissent, “No way! Didn’t you say demonic cultivators don’t stick to their word?”
Grinning, Zhuo Fan mocked, “It’s no promise, but a reward!”
Then he ignored the three. The only thing on their mind was regret, [How could I be so stupid to miss this chance?]
Wimp Demon puffed his chest, strutting among the three demons crying out in agony. The three demons glared at him with envy and hatred!
Li Jingtian was speechless, and held Zhuo Fan’s methods in even more admiration.
These four little shits were immune to soft and hard methods, even their thinking was screwed up. The only way to get them in line was with the carrot and the stick!
Li Jingtian sighed, “Steward Zhuo, these four little shits had dragged us into a swamp that’s hard to get out of!”
“But I don’t think it’s such a miserable encounter. At least we now know Gu Santong’s ace!” Zhuo Fan grinned, his eyes flashing as he watched the peak Gu Santong stayed on, “In this world, what we fear the most is the unknown. Now that we know what his trick is, we just gotta think hard of how to counter it. No one is invincible, even monsters! “
Li Jingtian’s heart shuddered and looked at Zhuo Fan with hope.
[That’s how a true man of ambition is. He can remain calm even in the face of Tianyu’s strongest! A pity such a talent is not a Clan Head...]
Rumble!
With a sudden loud noise, the sky dimmed.
Zhuo Fan sighed, “It’s about to rain. I’ll hand the ingredient over to the kid then think of a way to deal with his skill. I must have him under me!”
“If Steward Zhuo said it, then it’s as good as done!” Li Jingtian caressed his beard. He now had blind faith in Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan shook his head and set off. From the peak came Gu Santong’s angry voice, “Damn heaven, what lightning? Tone down the noise!”
Zhuo Fan was startled, then frowned in thought.
He heard a howl as a visible sound wave came from the peak and shot at the sky. In a blink, the thunderclouds scattered and the sky brightened.
There was no cloud seen for thousands of miles!
Li Jingtian was shocked, “Gu Santong is amazing! With a mere shout, he unleashed an even stronger ripple than I do with Necro Dragon’s Screech!”
Zhuo Fan scowled, his eyes spacing out in thought, “The kid had always been calm around us, not showing even a bit of anger...”
“He-he-he, guess we weren’t worthy to make him angry!” Li Jingtian grinned.
“But, why was he raging at the thunderclouds?”
Li Jingtian shook his head, “Maybe he hates lightning?”
“Or is it fear?” Zhuo Fan squinted.
Li Jingtian shuddered, “Steward Zhuo, you mean...”
“Perhaps his weakness is lightning!”
Zhuo Fan made a hand sign and the demons’ torture stopped, letting them catch their breath.
Zhuo Fan said, “Get ready, we’re going to Thunder Swarm Mountain?”
“But we’re still in the kid’s palm. Whatever for are we going to that damnable place?”Violent Demon shouted.
Zhuo Fan glared and his finger moved, “My word is law, so cut the crap. Or else...”
“Fine fine, we’ll listen to Steward Zhuo. We won’t complain again!” Violent Demon lifted his hands in defeat.
Zhuo Fan nodded. He flew to Gu Santong and was soon back again, “Let’s go!”
“Uh, what if Gu Santong comes after us?” Violent Demon hesitated.
“I told the kid we’ll be going a bit further for his ingredients and that there’s an 8th-grade ingredient there but we’ll be needing three days. He instantly agreed! By the time he figures out he’d been had, our trap will be ready!” Zhuo Fan snickered evilly.
Four Scheming Demons asked in unison, “Trap?”
“We will lure Tianyu’s strongest, Invincible Scamp Gu Santong into a trap!” Zhuo Fan grinned, his eyes burning with resolve...

chapters.title: Chapter 235, The Thunder Array Trap
chapters.content:
Chapter 235, The Thunder Array Trap
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Silavin
Rumble~
On top of a tall mountain, from South to North, from West to East, four cliffs stood! These cliffs were eternally shrouded by dark clouds with rumbling thunders striking them at any given moment.
But the way these bucket-sized lightning bolts slammed into the four cliffs was akin to lightning dragons. They struck them and then returned back to the clouds to begin the cycle anew!
From afar, it looked like a nest of lightning dragons roaming around the cliffs!
“Is this Thunder Swarm Mountain?” Zhuo Fan asked as he watched the spectacle.
The Four Scheming Demons nodded with a pained face having vividly recalled the torment they had to endure inside. Violent Demon found it difficult to even speak, “We’ve been stuck in there for sixty-odd years, having lightning pass through us every second of every day! If it weren’t for that dumbass leaving a hole behind, we might still be in there. Those were the worst years ever, waaah…”
Violent Demon cried as he pointed at the cliffs. The other demons were also tearing up.
Li Jingtian’s face twitched. He used to feel sad and bitter as well, but when the four described it, he felt disgusted instead.
[Didn’t someone just save you? Why aren’t you seeing him in a good light? Do such people even exist, that would even call their rescuer a dumbass?]
Zhuo Fan stood unflinching in the face of those crocodile tears. His eyes ever shined as he gazed at the cliffs, “He isn’t a dumbass at all. In fact, he didn’t poke a hole in the barrier out of carelessness!”
“Eh? He let them go on purpose?” Li Jingtian cried.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “This barrier may be fitting this place, raised on top of this natural array, but it is very intricately and painstakingly placed to leave almost no loopholes. That cliff, for example, is one such hole. Only an erudite could see it! “
“What, on purpose? Then how come we didn’t see anyone when we got out?” The four stopped crying on the spot and looked at each other baffled.
They looked inwardly for an answer, but there didn’t seem to be anyone on friendly terms with them besides those in the sect. Who could be so kind as to let them out?
Scratching his nose, Zhuo Fan smiled, “He must’ve done it for his own reasons. But he never would’ve imagined he helped me instead! Ha-ha-ha… Don’t dwell on it. What’s crucial is that we set up an array and bait Gu Santong inside!”
“This 6th-grade array is slightly damaged. Once I fix it, its power will double!” Zhuo Fan pointed at the cliff.
Li Jingtian nodded and frowned, “Steward Zhuo, are you sure the kid will enter? What if he sees the array and waits for us outside instead? We won’t be able to hold on then!”
“No worries. Others will hesitate while he will jump straight in. Because he is the Invincible Scamp, undefeated throughout his life. He never suffered defeat which makes him cocky. And cockiness leads to neglect! I believe there’s not a best Radiant Stage sucker out there as this Gu Santong!” Zhuo Fan cackled with confidence.
Li Jingtian gave a thumbs up, “Steward Zhuo sees through everyone. My admiration for you knows no bounds!”
“Enough sucking up to me! I am certain he’ll go in, but I can’t gauge his power, making success uncertain. But with this natural 6th-grade array and with us controlling it, success will be ours. Otherwise…” Zhuo Fan frowned and sighed.
Four Scheming Demons jumped over and shouted, “What do you need us to do?”
“Your job is to go in the array and distract Gu Santong!”
“No way! We have had enough of this array. Even in the Demon Scheming Sect, everyone was against us controlling arrays! That’s blatant discrimination!” The four demons demanded fairness.
Zhuo Fan’s face darkened.
[You damn idiots! Of course no one will let you. They were afraid you’d go messing it all up and you’ll go farther than mere discrimination against them.] His face was solemn, “I’m also discriminating against you. But don’t you dare friggin’ meddle with the array as I work on it. And you’d better listen to every one of my orders when Gu Santong gets inside and give your all while doing it. Or else…”
Zhuo Fan’s finger moved, sending the four demons shivering into bobbing their heads.
Then, they instantly switched to an aggrieved expression and kicked the stones at their feet in dissent. [Why is everyone hell bent against us? We are four demonic heroes, what’s not to like?]
Li Jingtian laughed wryly at the four’s lonely figures. Zhuo Fan didn’t know if he should laugh or cry at these buffoon’s antics!
…
Three days came and went, soon revealing Gu Santong landing at the foot of Thunder Swarm Mountain. But the mountain was different than before, its black clouds gone.
It was a particularly sunny afternoon, with birds singing on this barren Thunder Swarm Mountain. Only the occasional flickers on the rocks bore testament this place was once flooded with lightning.
But Gu Santong saw none of that. He only sniffed and shouted, “You bastards have taken advantage of my trust and good nature. Get the hell out right now! I don’t have much time to waste here. If you don’t go out to get me ingredients I’ll be bitter all my life. Who knows when I will get to eat so many good ingredients?
“Listen up. I know you’re on that mountain. Get out right now! I am pressed for time so I will forgo your transgression! Don’t make me come after you, or you’ll be sorry…” Gu Santong’s childish voice reverberated for miles.
But no reply came from the mountain.
Gu Santong was pissed, “Fine, have it your way. It’s on you! See how I’ll put you in your place once I get my hands on you!”
With a loud sound, Gu Santong charged straight into Thunder Swarm Mountain’s center. But just as he arrived in between the four cliffs and wiggled his nose in search of their location, a fierce gale blew!
Black clouds started rolling in swiftly, submerging the cliffs in darkness. Then, peals of lightning flashed within the dark clouds, surrounding Gu Santong in the middle.
Gu Santong’s eyes widened and cried, “An Array?”
Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian hid in the tallest and shortest cliffs’ caves, controlling the array. They snorted at Gu Santong’s shock again and again.
[He-he-he, Invincible Scamp, your day has come!]
Rumble!
A thunderous sound came from above and a lightning dragon spiraled around the four cliffs, setting up the barrier to seal in even a Radiant Stage expert.
Gu Santong shuddered and frowned. He covered his ears and cursed, “You bastards, is it not enough you set up an array, but did it have to be a thunder one?”
Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian cracked up.
[Ha-ha-ha, only thunder can keep you little freak in check, who is scared of it!]
“Elder Li, this is just the start. But be careful, the lightning may have a heavy impact on him but I don’t want to kill him. I want him alive!” Zhuo Fan transmitted words to Li Jingtian.
Li Jingtian nodded and laughed, “I got it, Steward Zhuo. We can’t have those ingredients go to waste. I know what to do!”
The two changed hand signs as they laughed.
Rumble!
With another loud sound, hundreds of lightning fell from the sky straight for Gu Santong.
Boom~
With a cacophony of explosions, Gu Santong’s frail figure slammed into the ground, kicking up dust.
Zhuo Fan stopped, worried for his safety as he shouted, “Wait, why isn’t he resisting? You’re telling me lightning is fatal for him? That’s bad. I don’t want him dead!”
“Steward Zhuo, should I go take a look?” Li Jingtian suggested.
Zhuo Fan hesitated. When the dust cleared, the two saw something incredulous. A huge hole in which Gu Santong was slammed.
But the child in question was unscathed, covering his ears and raining curses. His face was filled with loathing but otherwise, not a scratch on him.
“No way! Lightning should be his weakness!” Zhuo Fan was incredulous and shouted, “Abominable Four Scheming Demons, keep him busy and show me how he handles the lightning. Elder Li, raise the power!”
“Understood!”
The four shouted and the demons gave a creepy snicker as they shot for Gu Santong in a series of afterimages. Li Jingtian and Zhuo Fan were shifting through the hand signs.
Hi-hi-hi…
Hearing their jeer, Gu Santong sniffed and looked at the afterimages with loathing, “I knew you were messing around here. I could smell you a mile away! Shut down the array! I hate lightning the most!”
“He-he-he, lightning is the little monster’s bane. We won’t stop it so what are you gonna do about it?” Violent Demon laughed, his afterimage shifting to Gu Santong to land a punch.
But Gu Santong still held his ears and stood unmoving, despite his mouth spitting out endless curses.
Then Violent Demon’s face sank as he held his hand and cussed, “Goddammit! The kid’s hard as a rock. My hand almost got ruined!”
Rumble!
Just then, thousands of lightning struck Gu Santong…

chapters.title: Chapter 236, Invincible Fist
chapters.content:
Chapter 236, Invincible Fist
Boom~
Lightning struck Gu Santong constantly, smashing him into another hole. Even a peak Radiant Stage expert would have a hard time facing such a hit!
Yet, Zhuo Fan was still unclear if all of this was enough for the likes of Gu Santong. He was Invincible Scamp, the strongest in Tianyu!
His eyes fixed on the settling dust, Zhuo Fan’s heartbeat quickened. When the dust cleared, his eyes widened and gasped.
Gu Santong was still covering his ears and standing there, unharmed. But his face took a darker shade, out of anger.
“Four Scheming Demons, how did he take on the lightning? You should’ve seen it clearly from your angle!” Zhuo Fan roared through the transmission.
Four Scheming Demons turned into gray afterimages around Gu Santong as they reported in fear, “S-Steward Zhuo, this kid didn’t stop one lightning. Each bolt was a direct hit but he is still standing there like nothing happened...”
“What?!”
Four Scheming Demons’ report froze Zhuo Fan, “You mean to tell me lightning doesn’t do a damn thing to this kid? Was my assumption wrong?”
“Steward Zhuo, what now? He is just standing here in the array but we can’t do anything to him. Something bad is bound to happen if this goes on. And once he gets out, he’ll want to settle the score! We’ll be finished!”
Squinting, Zhuo Fan said, “Elder Li, the lightning isn’t his weakness, but he always shouts profanities at it. I was wrong, he just hates lightning. But this 6th-grade array is built on a natural formation.Let’s use all we have on him. No matter how ridiculously powerful he is, it’ll be worth it if we can wear him out even a little!
“Alright!” Li Jingtian agreed.
Zhuo Fan sighed.
Despite saying that, he had a feeling they’d fail from the moment he set up the array. As this was all based on the premise his guess was right, that Gu Santong was weak to lightning. He was now holding the fates of everyone in his hands. He knew there was only a fifty percent chance of success!
But he wanted to get Gu Santong so badly that he was willing to gamble on that measly fifty percent, using even the lives of others. But even in this case he had a failsafe.
Just escaping was also fifty-fifty!
If Gu Santong bore through it as well, they were dead! This was indeed a very risky move from his part, totally opposite for his usual style!
“Steward Zhuo, I’m ready. How are you?” Li Jingtian sent over.
Zhuo Fan sighed, and his hands moved, “I as well. Begin!”
The two’s signs synced!
Thunder rolled and lightning flickered. From the deep and rumbling dark clouds, tens of thousands of lightning bolts barreled down. That immense power caused even Thunder Swarm Mountain to shake. It meant that even the 6th-grade array was having a hard time withstanding such might.
The Four Scheming Demons were slackjawed, crying out in fear as they retreated!
They no longer dared staying close to Gu Santong. The lightning this time may very well smash them to bits!
Gu Santong, with his ears covered, looked at the thunder with pure loathing and anger!
“Gu Santong, if you still stand after this, then you must be my karma coming back to bite me!” Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth and his hand sign changed.
Boom!
Hundreds of thousands of lightning bolts rained down. They twisted around each other and formed a lightning dragon that coiled around each cliff as it roared.
Such destructive power seemed to wish for the annihilation of the whole world. Zhuo Fan was certain that the lightning dragon would turn this Thunder Swarm Mountain and everything in a hundred miles barren. Only the array controllers would survive.
He never hoped it would come to this!
But he was the Demonic Emperor, rising on top of a mountain of bones! If he wanted Invincible Scamp’s power, mercy for some miscellaneous creatures had no place here!
Roar!
The entire sky was roaring as it came crashing down!
Gu Santong felt the sheer brutality aiming at him, forced to squint at the eye-piercing light. His ears rang from the sudden explosions and only now, finally, his hands released them, forming a small fist.
Then...
A punch soared straight for the lightning dragon’s head, releasing an odd ripple.
Gu Santong didn’t even put the lightning dragon in his eyes. His face was calm, yet the ripple he released flew like a meteor, pushing back at the lightning dragon.
Every place the ripple touched, lightning crumbled!
People would be shocked to see how it began with the lightning dragon’s head, turning it into specks of light. The ripple then shot past the lightning dragon and exploded way up high!
The rumbling and black thunderclouds were sporting a mile wide hole in their center, allowing for the sun’s warm glow to pass through!
Pff!
Groaning, Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian spat blood, thoroughly stupefied.
Gu Santong struck the picture of a god of war, in the middle of the sun shining down on him from the wide hole in the sky. The two of them were lost for words.
“Invincible Scamp is crazy strong! No wonder he could face the entire empire and still win!” Zhuo Fan sighed, “It’s my loss this time! Elder Li, patch up the thunderclouds, it’s time to bolt! Invincible Scamp is out of my league! Or maybe, we’ll just get him on a better occasion!”
This was the first time Li Jingtian saw Zhuo give up. But the image of Gu Santong easily withstanding a 6th-grade array left him shuddering.
[Only an extraordinary man could control such a freak! Zhuo Fan and Huangpu Qingtian are also freaks but they have a long way to go to be monsters!]
Li Jingtian smiled dejectedly and copied Zhuo Fan’s sign in patching the hole in the sky. They then sent the order for retreat to the four demons.
They no longer used the array to seize Invincible Scamp, but to buy time. They would never get out of this alive otherwise!
This may very well be the first time he and Zhuo Fan felt so utterly powerless.
Especially Zhuo Fan, with his cunning mind and foolproof plans. They all were rendered powerless in the face of that kid!
Absolute power indeed trumped over any ploy!
But seeing the looming black clouds gathering, Gu Santong roared, “You six bastards, I told you already that I hate lightning. Yet, you dare continue?”
With a snort, Gu Santong stomped!
With two steps, Thunder Swarm Mountain’s four cliffs shook ceaselessly. Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian wobbled, shaken to their core.
But the next thing had them swept by panic.
Gu Santong tightened his fists at the side, as if focusing his power. Then he struck!
Hum~
Another ripple spread everywhere, making everything it touched quake. With Gu Santong at the center, all around him crumbled to dust.
The ripple looked slow when in fact had incredible speed, leaving nothing but dust in its wake!
Zhuo Fan cried out, “The kid’s power is insane. He can shake space itself with a punch alone! Run, the 6th-grade array can’t do anything to him. We can’t deal with him! Go underground, there’s no escaping it!”
Li Jingtian paled from shock.
He knew Gu Santong was godlike, but now it was no longer an exaggerating description. The kid shook off the 6th-grade array as if it was a breeze, an array that held Radiant Stage experts for tens of years prisoners.
[How is he even human?]
They didn’t get to make two steps as the ripple passed by them and into the horizon!
Boom!
Anything in a hundred miles was pulverized. Once the dust settled, the sight was overwhelming and impossible to fathom.
As far as the eye could see, in any given direction, down to the last blade of grass, all was just gone! Gu Santong leveled a hundred mile wide circle in a blink.
As to Thunder Swarm Mountain and the black clouds, it looked as if they never even existed in the first place.
Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian crawled from underground, shivering at this sight. The four demons came out as well and stood agape, scared to the core.
Wimp Demon was holding his head as it shook like a leaf. He wanted to bury his head, anything, so long as it rid that little monster’s image out of his head.
Gu Santong was an abomination! If not for Steward Zhuo’s timely advice, they’d be nothing but dust by now!
Violent Demon lamented inside.
[Invincible Scamp is a real freak. We can’t mess with him ever again no matter how Steward Zhuo tortures us. We must never agree to such a reckless plan ever again!]
The four vowed to themselves. Though clueless they all were to the fact Gu Santong was standing right behind them with a cold face. Bloodthirst flashed in his eyes as he looked at their dusty backs...

chapters.title: Chapter 237, Sophistry
chapters.content:
Chapter 237, Sophistry
“I got you now, you bastards!”
A chilling voice crept from behind the four. Their body froze and looked back in reflex to see Gu Santong’s furious gaze.
Scared out of their wits, the four shivered as they lowered their heads, not daring to look him in the eye.
Gu Santong scratched his nose, sweeping the four with a cold eye and snorting, “Who was it that threw the punch on me? Step forward!”
“He did it!”
The four didn’t even lift their heads as three demons pointed straight at Violent Demon.
Violent Demon felt like kicking these bunch of ignoble bastards’ arse, but he was weak as a kitten before Gu Santong’s stern gaze. He then showed a miserable and crying smile, “It’s not my fault, I never would’ve done it if I wasn’t compelled!”
“Oh, who forced you then?” Furrowing his brow, Gu Santong fists tightened.
Swallowing dryly, Violent Demon squeaked, “It’s...”
Creak!
Violent Demon shuddered in that instant and his jaw froze open, but could not utter a sound. As if something was shoved down his throat.
Then, a cheerful cry entered their ears, “Gu Santong, you’re finally here. Thank the heavens, I thought we’d never see you again!”
Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian staggered their wretched bodies over. While Li Jingtian’s face was tense from anxiety, by contrast, Zhuo Fan’s was that of joy, as if guileless. He even went as far as give Gu Santong an old fashioned cozy hug.
The four demons now knew why Violent Demon was choking on his own voice. Zhuo Fan’s Bloodworm was doing its thing!
These two had the life of the four demons in their hands. And offending any side now was certain death no matter how they sliced it. So the three demons buried their heads in the dirt to avoid looking at anyone.
Violent Demon’s face twitched and shivered. He was fearing for his life. Thinking Zhuo Fan would take his life to protect his own.
Getting out of Zhuo Fan’s hug, Gu Santong stared at him with resentment. Zhuo Fan was startled and faked innocence, “What’s wrong?”
“Why did you run? Why did you set up a lightning array here?” Gu Santong snapped at him. Li Jingtian swallowed dryly, his whole body frozen, while the four demons shivered.
Only Zhuo had a downright shocked expression, “What are you talking about? Who set an array?”
“You didn’t set the lightning array?”
“As if! You think we’d still be trapped with you if we could?” Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes.
Gu Santong was speechless, the four demons startled, all while confusion predominated to all present.
“You’re saying you’ve been trapped in there as well?” Gu Santong spoke, his tone still carried anger, albeit subdued.
Sighing, Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Of course, or we’d have long returned with the ingredient!”
“What, you’ve been trapped here just to get an ingredient?” Gu Santong cried, now his anger deflated.
Zhuo Fan nodded, running his mouth, “Gu Santong, do you know why there’s a 6th-grade lightning array here?”
Gu Santong shook his head, a telltale sign he bought into Zhuo Fan’s lie completely.
“Because there’s a precious 8th-grade ingredient here. Someone used the array to protect it!” Zhuo Fan spoke, “To help you get that ingredient, we had to go into the lion’s den, and barely got out alive. But thankfully you got here just in time! But why do you say we ran away? Didn’t I tell you we’ll be going on an ingredient hunt?”
“Uh, that’s...” Gu Santong blushed, fiddling with his hands, like a child caught with his hand in the cookie jar. Somewhat aggrieved and somewhat guilty.
They were braving danger for his sake, yet he was here casting blame on them – for shame!
Zhuo Fan sighed, giving Li Jingtian a look, and the two showed a carefree smile. Gu Santong sure was an abomination, but pure as a child, and more importantly, easy to fool.
The Four Scheming Demons were struck dumb.
They had feared the kid for his power. But even after three centuries, he was still but a child, easy to dupe. Why didn’t they think of that?
But Gu Santong’s shyness only lasted a second as he pointed at Violent Demon with a frown, “Why then were they moving around the array so freely, even giving me a punch? You were clearly against me!”
Shuddering, they all felt shock and fear, with the four demons lowering their heads.
Li Jingtian’s brow was soaked, his lips dry, and looked anxiously at Zhuo Fan for help. [He may be a child at heart and mind, but everyone knows the chaos he caused Tianyu three hundred years ago!]
[It’s not that easy to dupe him after all!]
This was Zhuo Fan’s plan all along. If they couldn’t hold him with the array, then they’ll throw in a play. They’d fake being victims as well, braving the danger of death for the kid’s sake.
This worked to explain why they were in the array, and also scored sympathy points with the kid. Without any real evidence, even if the kid was dubious, he couldn’t just trash them when they were giving their all in finding him ingredients!
So, Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian never once showed themselves as the array worked, just so they could enact this play, and give themselves a way out.
Who’d have thought however, that the Four Scheming Demons Zhuo Fan asked to keep the kid busy went as far as punching him!
Now this was throwing a wrench in his act...
[Steward Zhuo, how about we throw these little shits to the wolves?]
Li Jingtian spoke with his eyes.
Zhuo Fan squinted, as the four demons looked nervously at him. They could feel it in their bones how his next words had the power to save them and condemn them.
If Zhuo Fan made them scapegoats, they’d have no chance at all, except at a swift death.
At this very moment, no one moved.
Gu Santong stared at Zhuo, waiting for his answer. Li Jingtian was also looking at him, waiting for his decision. Four Scheming Demons were begging him with their faces, their miserable and pitiful faces.
Eveyone’s lives rested on him!
“Uh...”
Zhuo Fan finally opened his mouth, and instead of answering, he gave Gu Santong a question, “Do you know arrays?”
“Nope!” Gu Santong was blunt
