“I guessed as much! That’s great!”
“Eh?” Gu Santong glared at him and Zhuo Fan rushed to say, “Ha-ha-ha, don’t misunderstand. I only want to explain to you clearly so as to not weigh your conscience with innocent killings!”
Zhuo Fan rubbed his chin as he began, “Arrays are graded from one to twelve according to their power. As for their type, they are trapping, killing, and bewildering arrays. That thunder array was of the killing type. But it also had a trapping array hidden. Did you notice?”
Gu Santong nodded. He knew the second he got in the array he’d have to smash his way through if he wanted out.
“But did you notice the bewildering array as well?” Zhuo Fan gave a vague smile.
Gu Santong shook his head, “You’re saying a bewildering caught me?”
But then he snorted, “No way. I didn’t feel any illusions around me. What I see may be fake, but my nose has never let me down. That guy hit me and I caught him red handed...”
Being pointed at, Violent Demon shivered in fear. In that moment, he was more of a wimp than Wimp Demon.
Everyone looked at him with derision, [This is the first goddamn time I’m hiding behind forth bro!]
But in the face of all this, Zhuo Fan waved it off, “I didn’t say you were caught in an illusion, but he was. Let me ask you this. Did you four really attack Gu Santong?”
Shuddering, the four reacted to Steward Zhuo’s meaning. He was giving them a way out!
So they shook their heads and bowed, “We thought you were someone else! Please forgive us!”
“Is that so? Then who was that little monster you kept raving on about?” Gu Santong stared them down.
The four pointed at Zhuo Fan on the spot, “Him!”
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched and his anger boiled. Wasn’t that saying they wanted to kill him? But this was not the time to bicker with these four morons!
Gu Santong looked dubious at him, “You’re also a monster?”
“Uh, before meeting you, they indeed called me that!” With an awkward chuckle, Zhuo Fan’s fists crunched and Lightning Wings unfolded behind him, “Can anyone do this?”
Gu Santong’s eyes twitched, “I see. I always thought you used a flying demonic treasure when in fact it is tied to your body. You’re indeed monstrous enough!”
That ended that.
Gu Santong was still dubious, but could find no plausible excuse to beat the crap out of them.
Everyone else gave Zhuo Fan a big round of thumbs up, in admiration for his sophistry, and putting an end to this deadly situation.
Zhuo Fan sighed and rejoiced inside. [Thank god we met Gu Santong. If it was anyone else, this blatant lie wouldn’t fly and would’ve got us all killed instead. All because they harbored doubts.]
Anyone would rather kill a thousand innocents than miss the culprit!
This was where Gu Santong was different. Zhuo Fan knew he guarded the imperial family for three hundred years all for the sake of a promise. But only after being his prisoner did he fully understand that to this kid, words were gold, and he needed a good reason when handling anyone.
When he slaughtered half the empire’s cities, that was because others pushed him. He didn’t start it!
So Zhuo Fan made a heroic, reckless and gutsy gamble. But even this had only a fifty-fifty chance. If Gu Santong was still stubborn they could only resign to their fate and the kid’s temper.
Thankfully, the kid was quite moral, not swinging around his weight without proper reason!
Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan smiled. But then Gu Santong suddenly said, “Hold on, since you all did this for an ingredient, where is it?”
They all froze up again.
An 8th-grade ingredient was a heavenly treasure. How were they supposed to just find it?
Gu Santong’s glare once again descended...

chapters.title: Chapter 238, Lightning Canyon Appears
chapters.content:
Chapter 238, Lightning Canyon Appears
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Silavin
“If there’s no 8th-grade ingredient, then all of this is a lie cooked up by all of you!” Gu Santong eyed each one with suspicion.
Violent Demon was frantic, “You fist leveled everything in a hundred miles! That ingredient is dust by now...”
“Bullshit!”
Gu Santong cursed, “An 8th-grade ingredient is a worldly treasure, possessing spirituality. If you could think of burrowing underground at a crucial moment, then so could it!”
“T-then it must’ve fled!” Wimp Demon whimpered.
Gu Santong snorted, “More bullshit! My nose can pick up its scent even a thousand meters below. How the hell can it escape my notice?”
“T-t-then...” It was Sly Demon’s turn to take the stands and patch the growing hole in the lie. But he stuttered so greatly, none of his words made sense, despite how much his eyes showed he wanted to.
Gu Santong snorted, eyeing them with thick bloodthirst, “Humph, without the 8th-grade ingredient all you’ve said so far was a big fat lie. You are the ones who set up the lightning array!”
They were all nervous now and chilled to the bone.
“Hold on!”
Zhuo Fan shouted with a pained face, “The 8th-grade ingredient is indeed real. It truly wanted to flee but I managed to grab it just as the lightning array crumbled. You didn’t pick up its scent because I placed it in my ring!”
Zhuo Fan’s hand revealed a glowing ingredient. The sweet smell it released worked to sooth everyone’s weary minds!
Gu Santong was dumbstruck. The 8th-grade ingredient was real.
Even if he didn’t believe Zhuo Fan, he now had no choice but to. The proof was incontestable!
The six’s reason for rushing into the array held strong. What they did in the array, only they knew, and no matter how they explained it, Gu Santong would never find the truth.
But now, he no longer cared.
With an 8th-grade ingredient in hand, what’s the big problem being trapped in an array by them? This compensation was enough if he even had to go through a second array.
Licking his dry lips, Gu Santong scratched his head in embarrassment, “Ops, I’ve been wrong about you, guys. You really gave it all for my sake. Then, is this 8th-grade ingredient mine?”
Zhuo Fan was silent, having to go through great difficulty to squeeze a nod.
Gu Santong then took it and threw the ingredient into his mouth and started chomping, “In fact, even if you did set the array up, it’s all water under the bridge. If every array has an 8th-grade ingredient, I’d jump in head first, ha-ha-ha...”
“Rest easy, our efforts weren’t for nothing!” Zhuo Fan smiled, but was crying inside. His heart bled with every chomp!
He got that 8th-grade ingredient from Drifting Flowers Edifice’s Hundred Pill Meeting, and only the one. He was keeping it for a special occasion, alright? Who’d have thought it’d be wasted on Gu Santong to calm his anger? But it was either that or his life!
This was Zhuo Fan’s first time losing out to such an extent.
While Gu Santong was gorging himself with the ingredient, Li Jingtian slipped next to him and patted him, “It’s only a worldly possession, Steward Zhuo! Only by being alive will you get to have more of them!”
“Yeah, I never knew Steward Zhuo had an 8th-grade ingredient. What’s more, Steward Zhuo loves us so much, he gave it up. We are touched!” The Four Scheming Demons sniffed.
Zhuo Fan glared instead, “Shut it, I’ve made an investment in you and I expect you to pay me back ten fold at the least! We’ll first placate the devil then we’ll think of something later!”
“Yes!” They all nodded obediently. Especially the four demons, who looked at him with just a hint of respect. Unlike before when there was only fear...
Rumble!
A sudden thunderous noise traveled for thousands of miles.
Zhuo Fan frowned and looked around, “Isn’t Thunder Swarm Mountain flattened? Where is that noise coming from?”
“Maybe it’s a real thunderstorm!” Li Jingtian scratched his beard.
But Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Unlikely. The kid’s two fists silenced everything in a hundred miles, even removing clouds. So where’s this lightning coming from without any clouds around?”
Li Jingtian found Zhuo Fan’s explanation to be reasonable.
“Steward Zhuo, look, something’s off with the kid. Did you poison the 8th-grade ingredient?” Sly Demon shouted and pointed at Gu Santong.
Zhuo Fan saw Gu Santong covering his ears and crouching his shivering body. Even his most delicious treat, the 8th-grade ingredient, laid half-eaten on the ground.
Violent Demon cried in joy, “Steward Zhuo, you’re amazing, of ultimate cunningness to have dealt with the kid. Tell us, how did you poison him? Our plans have always been foiled by that godlike nose...”
“Knock it off, I didn’t do anything!”
Zhuo Fan glared at them then turned to Gu Santong, “It doesn’t look like somethings wrong with the kid. So it must be his mental state!”
“Eh?”
Li Jingtian raised an eyebrow, but after a bit of mulling he cried, “It’s fear. How come the great Gu Santong actually knows fear?”
“What?” Zhuo Fan was startled and Li Jingtian explained, “When I was teaching brats in Regent Estate, I was very strict. So much so, some weak minded ones caved in just at my voice alone, taking the same posture as he is now. I’d usually go on and kick out anyone I’ve seen behaving like this. Without guts, I was not going to waste time on them!”
“You’re saying... he’s scared? But what could drive such fear into this little monster?” Zhuo Fan’s heart was perturbed as well.
Rumble!
The thunder only grew in intensity and Zhuo Fan looked startled at the sky.
Then a bolt flashed out of the blue and the sky darkened as black as night, as if a huge hand swept over the area. Next, purple lightning began to fall nonstop.
Each place they hit was turned to dust, wafting everywhere.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes widened, and cried, “Lightning Canyon!”
Correct, this was one of the continent’s three danger zones, Lightning Canyon! It was the place Zhuo Fan had been aiming for all this time, the Heavenly Emperor’s remnant!
Long Jiu once told him about it and has been preparing himself since. But having met with one strange and unavoidable event after another, he had to put them on hold.
And now...
With a flash, the Thunder Skylark’s egg appeared in his hand. His eyes looked at this flickering egg with a bitter face.
He felt regret, [Why haven’t I hatched this egg the moment I got here? Now that Thunder Swarm Mountain is gone, how do I do it?]
But even if he had, the chick wouldn’t be of any use in the Lightning Canyon!
[If only I hatched it sooner. It would’ve matured after a few years.] It was as if fate dictated it was not his time to enter Lightning Canyon!
Watching the purple lightning falling from the clouds, Zhuo Fan sighed and flew away from them, “Let’s go!”
The other five were quick to follow!
They all heard of the notorious Lightning Canyon’s danger. Going in was suicide! The best way is to get out of here following Zhuo Fan!
Luckily, Lightning Canyon just showed up and their speed was more than enough to get them in the clear.
But they flew for a bit and Zhuo Fan looked back all of a sudden, “Where’s the brat, Gu Santong?”
He found that the bold and powerful Invincible Scamp was reacting like any child would in this situation. He was shivering and closing his ears, losing all reason out of fear.
“Ha-ha-ha, the kid is afraid of lightning! Where’d all that fierce attitude go?” Violent Demon mocked.
The other demons joined him, but Zhuo Fan was pausing in thought. Then, he exclaimed, “I get it. He isn’t afraid of lightning, but afraid of purple lightning. We were wrong from the start! “
“Hi-hi-hi, Steward Zhuo, you’re kidding. Who on earth isn’t afraid of purple lightning? Even those Sect Leaders of ours would bolt at the sight of it!” Violent Demon laughed.
Shaking his head, Zhuo Fan’s eyes were fixed on Gu Santong, “This kid is different. The others had the bravery to run, but the kid is lacking even that. Just what is his connection with Lightning Canyon?”
Zhuo Fan suddenly said, “Elder Li, you and the demons leave. I’m getting him out!”
“No, Steward Zhuo!” Li Jingtian was anxious, “Lightning Canyon is about to descend and you’ll be soon crushed to death. You can’t risk it!”
“Yeah, Steward Zhuo, let that punk die for all we care! Wasn’t he almighty? Let’s see him handle purple lighting for a change!” Violent Demon spat and the demons nodded.
The four demons had been nothing but trouble so far, but ever since Zhuo Fan saved their lives by paying an 8th-grade ingredient, their view changed. They held Zhuo Fan with favor, albeit slightly.
Zhuo Fan was gratified but his mind was made, “Elder Li, if anything happens to me, take care of these four. Don’t let them turn the clan upside down!”
Zhuo Fan shot for Gu Santong.
“Steward Zhuo!”
Li Jingtian shouted, but all he could see was his vanishing figure among the purple lightning.
Gnashing his teeth, he eyed the demons and flew away, “Let’s go!”
“What about Steward Zhuo?”
“He’ll be back!” Li Jingtian’s eyes were firm...

chapters.title: Chapter 239, Azure Flame Guard
chapters.content:
Chapter 239, Azure Flame Guard
Whoosh!
The purple lightning bolts spun a spider’s web as they hammered the skies, it was as if the heavens were becoming fragmented. Then, a lightning bolt fell before Gu Santong.
Zhuo Fan saw the shivering child among the lightning and cried, “Gu Santong, stop daydreaming and run! Don’t you want to live?”
“S-save...” Gu Santong shook his head and stuttered.
“What?” Zhuo Fan shouted.
“Save... me!” Gu Santong showed his pitiful face, his eyes filled with tears.
Zhuo Fan was shocked. Never would’ve thought it possible that the great Gu Santong’s nightmare was purple lightning. He truly became a child gripped by fear.
Frowning, Zhuo Fan showed a particular grin. Then he grabbed the kid and flew away!
Wasn’t it obvious he should fulfill his request?
Zhuo Fan had been going all this time about having the kid under him, but since the kid was a tough nut to crack, how could he succeed?
Only now. at the kid’s weakest, the best chance presented itself. This was the sole reason why Zhuo Fan braved the danger of rescuing him.
Otherwise, with his rotten character, he wouldn’t be caught dead saving anyone!
This was the opportunity of a lifetime, to have the strongest in Tianyu at his behest.
When the stakes were high, so was the return. And only through this grave risk might he be able to gain an invincible subordinate!
Zhuo Fan laughed coldly inside, [Gu Santong has been keeping a promise for three hundred years after losing one lousy bet. Now that I save him, won’t he give his all in repaying me?]
[He-he-he, with Gu Santong behind me, let’s see how those Regent Estate bastards dare lift even a finger against me!]
Zhuo Fan could already see the future, one in which the seven houses were at his feet!
Too bad though, what man proposes god disposes. This time, his risk may very well be fatal!
With a shocking boom, the fragmented sky was now thoroughly wrecked, revealing a huge black hole in the sky.
Purple lightning fell by the thousand, pulverizing anything it touched. And the storm kicked up by the lightning sent everything in that black abyss.
Zhuo Fan was flying with all his power when a sudden power gripped him, slowly sucking him into the black hole. Like an invisible hand, it wanted to throw him into that endless abyss.
Heart in a vise, Zhuo Fan picked up more speed with his wings.
But he didn’t gain one bit of ground, falling ever deeper among the purple lightning storm.
Zhuo Fan’s anxiety grew and grew and his brow was soaked. The situation took a dire turn for the worst. Thus he turned to the scared Gu Santong, “Gu Santong, we are about to be sucked in. Is there anything you can do?”
Gu Santong had been shivering all this time, with fear robbing him even of his voice.
But even if this was his normal state, his first reaction was to roll his eyes. [Oh please, you’re the one doing the rescuing, remember? Now you’re asking me for help? You’d think I’d be shivering here doing nothing if I had a way out?]
Sighing, Zhuo Fan knew the kid was out for the count, scared witless by the purple lightning. He only had himself to rely on.
But everywhere he looked was purple lightning. Besides lightning, there was only more lightning. And all while the sucking abyss was doing its best to devour them among the tight curtain of lighting. The lightest touch would stop their hearts.
[Is this how I’ll lose the gamble and my life? In the Lightning Canyon?]
Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth, unwilling to give up for a second. He was still working his damndest in getting out of there.
Boom!
Suddenly, a purple bolt smashed into his back, forcing him to spit blood. Losing his balance, he drifted deeper into the bottomless pit.
Wiping his blood, Zhuo Fan rejoiced, “Thankfully, it’s only a 3rd Heaven purple lightning, just like brother Jiu’s, or I’d be a goner!”
But he didn’t finish his words as a second lightning fell. This time his whole body shivered. His Diamond Sand and unbreakable body was sporting cracks, and blood spilled from the force of the lightning!
“What? A 4th Heaven purple lightning?”
Gasping, Zhuo Fan looked up to see the big hole was getting increasingly closer. And the closer it got, the stronger the lightning.
If a 6th Heaven lightning struck him, he would be pulverized in body and soul!
Zhuo Fan was out of his depth this time. He was about to die a second time at a moment’s notice if he didn’t come up with something, and fast.
It was time to exert the power he gathered all these years!
But the crucial thing was, Nine Serenities Secret Records’ secret technique could not be used so frequently. Each subsequent use would break the tie between the soul and his consciousness. After all, he was making use of another’s soul.
There may very well not be a next rebirth. Afterall the type of grievance he needed may have vanished from the world.
Zhuo Fan was reborn this time, but regarded his life with utmost seriousness. It may very well be his last!
Taking a deep breath to cool down. Zhuo Fan started thinking about a plan of action. He gnashed his teeth and settled on taking out the Thunder Skylark’s egg.
His original plan was to use the newborn Thunder Skylark to control the lightning’s power, and let it absorb it. Even if it could only absorb the 6th Heaven it would buy him enough time to get inside this place.
But now, he only had an egg, that may very well be unable to take a single lightning before crack open like a melon.
But desperate times called for desperate measures!
Zhuo Fan held the egg in one hand and Gu Santong in the other, flung straight for the Lightning Canyon’s black hole. He was carefully controlling his flight as he looked for the right approach.
Boom!
With a thunderclap, a purple lightning shot straight for Zhuo Fan. His eyes squinted and shouted, “4th Heaven purple lighting!”
He lifted the egg to let it take the brunt.
Perhaps it was their connection, or it was just plain first in its path, but the purple lightning struck the Thunder Skylark’s egg. It was as if it acted as a beacon.
But the enormous power having slammed into the egg made it shudder, on the verge of breaking. Zhuo Fan used Demon Transformation Art post haste, taking the rest of the lightning power into him and refined it!
Perhaps the egg still had some magic left in it as by some miracle, it cushioned the lightning’s power. Zhuo Fan shuddered but he was otherwise unaffected.
This worked to lift his mood, [This could work!] But what worried him most was the power of the purple lightning. Even with the Demon Transformation Art, he couldn’t refine all of it. Some of its power wasn’t much of a threat to him, but if he let that power roam around his body, it would only get worse!
[I have to find the right path inside. If lightning doesn’t strike me down first, I’ll die from overexposure!]
Zhuo Fan felt numb. He sensed the places where the purple lightning traveled inside him and his face grew grave.
Boom~
The closer he got to the black hole, the purple lightning struck with greater intensity and frequency. Zhuo Fan pushed through the pain and lasted so far, but more and more unrefined lightning power gathered inside him, wreaking havoc. As the damage on his organs intensified, blood started leaking from his mouth!
Boom!
Another purple flash signaled a fast approaching lightning, “5th Heaven purple lightning!”
This was one power that could crush even a Radiant Stage expert!
Zhuo Fan operated the Demon Transformation Art to the max. Black energy covered the egg, waiting for the moment the lightning struck it to refine it.
But, the lightning scattered the black energy in an instant. Its power flew unencumbered through the egg and into his body.
Pff!
Blood and gore spewed out of his mouth, Zhuo Fan having suffered a heavy blow. He was incapable of refining such powerful lightning in time and was taking its toll on him.
He was now on the brink of collapse. So weak he couldn’t handle another.
But when it rained, it poured.
As if that strike was the curtain’s call, another lightning slammed down. Zhuo Fan was now pale, looking at the incoming attack bitterly. His eyes having lost its last thread of hope, “Blast it, another 5th Heaven purple lightning! I’m finished!”
He looked at the shivering Gu Santong, and patted his head, “Who’d ever knew this would happen, that I would ultimately die saving a kid? I mean, I wouldn’t be suffering so much if I haven’t saved you. Is this my fate, all because of greed?”
Zhuo Fan shook his head and sighed, “But I do not regret it. Few are the chances a man gets at life! I have failed this time, but even if it will be the next time, I’d still choose this path. I only hope... there will be a next time!”
Clenching his eyes shut, Zhuo Fan held Gu Santong close, yet he looked quite at peace.
He was a man of ambition, but even in the face of death, he would welcome it with open arms!
Pff!
Suddenly, an azure flame flitted from his forehead, covering the two of them in its glow. It was then when the purple lightning struck.
The oddest thing happened. When the lightning touched the flame, it was melted down in a flash. One could see with the naked eye how the purple lightning was rendered useless..

chapters.title: Chapter 240, Will to Live
chapters.content:
Chapter 240, Will to Live
Slowly opening his eyes, Zhuo Fan found he was still in one piece. But the shock of his life was the azure fire surrounding him. Never had he thought his azure flame outstripped even the might of the terrifying purple lightning!
That mystery expert in the Allbeast Mountain Range once again popped in his mind.
He never did figure out why was that person entrusting him with the azure flame. But now, he guessed it was to help him get into the Lightning Canyon!
But for which reason? Was there something in the Lightning Canyon he wanted but couldn’t get it himself?
Zhuo Fan was filled with doubts but he shook them away.
This was not the time for flights of fancy. That was for later, including whatever scheme that man may have in play. After all, his life was on the line right now.
Zhuo Fan swiftly got his bearings, looking for a way out of this thunder shower. But what he saw gave him goosebumps. The purple lightning was endless, and since he didn’t know how long the azure flame lasted, he had to hurry!
Boom~
Lightning fell like rain on the azure flame. From the 5th Heaven all the way to the 8th, the flame was unaffected. Only it’s intensity seemed to have dropped a little.
Zhuo Fan held Gu Santong and flew deeper into the black abyss. But as far as the eye could see there was only purple lightning and nothing else.
Zhuo Fan was growing restless from the severe problem he was in!
Boom!
Suddenly, another lightning smashed into them. Zhuo Fan couldn’t keep his body straight and felt numb. The azure flame as well was greatly diminished.
“9th Heaven purple lightning!”
Zhuo Fan gasped. This was the one that worried him the most, the 9th Heaven purple lightning. Even the mysterious azure flame couldn’t hold for long under such onslaught.
If the azure flame guard fell through, they were finished!
Knowing the greatest threat was here, he scoured the place for a way out. Roaming his eyes everywhere for even the slightest loophole in the curtain of lightning.
But even he, a Demonic Emperor expert in arrays, couldn’t find one thread of hope. It was clear at a glance that a great expert set this up, to prevent any other intruders.
This was the Heavenly Emperor’s remnant after all, one of the three strongest emperors in antiquity. How could this puny Demonic Emperor hold a candle to him?
Slapping his head to get rid of such thoughts, Zhuo Fan was pushed to the edge, his nerves wound tight as he looked for an exit, to no avail. Facing the endless array the Heavenly Emperor placed personally, he felt utterly powerless.
Boom!
Another 9th Heaven purple lightning struck, marking the drop in the azure flame’s intensity. He even started feeling the purple lightning’s power on his skin. His azure guard wouldn’t last long like this.
Zhuo Fan sighed.
His early thinking was too naive. It was a pipe dream using Thunder Skylark to resist 6th Heaven purple lightning to explore the Heavenly Emperor’s remnant. Even with the azure guard protecting him from the 9th Heaven purple lightning, he was deep within the abyss but could not find its entrance.
The great Heavenly Emperor’s array was not something the Demonic Emperor could just break out of!
Even the most outstanding Nine Serenities Emperor would need days to figure it out. But he didn’t have days, not even hours!
There was no way a measly Bone Tempering cultivator ever could pull it off!
Zhuo Fan slapped his head. His previous act of defying Gu Santong was an act of bravery. But now, it slowly started to resemble suicide.
Because he was now entering Lightning Canyon in advance, instead of later. If he couldn’t break out of it this time, then he could never do it anytime.
By coming here now he only hastened his death!
[Ah, azure flame, you came at such a perfect timing all to say ‘I told you so’, didn’t you? If it weren’t today with Gu Santong, but later alone, it wouldn’t make a difference still, right?]
Zhuo Fan lamented, “In the end, I was too conceited. Thinking with the Demon Emperor’s legacy I could rule the world and even looked down on the Heavenly Emperor’s array. I am such a lame joke! At least no one knows me for the Demon Emperor that I was, or I’d be the world’s biggest laughingstock...”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, downcast, his eyes losing their light, uncaring of the relentless hammering the purple lightning did.
Suddenly, a flash of red came from deep within the black abyss.
Zhuo Fan turned his head to see it and found it very small but it had no purple lightning around it!
His eyes lit up and Zhuo Fan shouted, “Right, brother Jiu said that he was suddenly swept by this purple thunderstorm and entered by chance. That means Heavenly Emperor’s array isn’t perfect. And this loophole wasn’t left intentionally by the creator but by someone who actually broke a hole into it!”
Zhuo Fan looked at the red glow with more attention, filling him with joy.
Correct, that red light was a loophole and following it would take them in. But if they followed it in, they’d enter the remnant!
[He-he-he, am I supposed to just flee now that I reached thus far? Of course I’ll go in and make a thorough investigation inside! Who knows when such a god sent chance will be presented to me ? Whether or not I’ll find the loophole again in this huge array is the real question!]
Zhuo Fan lost his dispirited gaze and turned ecstatic, “What’s so great about Heavenly Emperor? Wasn’t it already broken into by someone? Ha-ha-ha... “
If only Heavenly Emperor could hear him now, he’d be going blue from anger and spitting back in reply.
[You damn rotten shameless punk! Why are you getting so smug? You didn’t make the hole, did you?]
Speaking of the hole’s size, it was far too small to enter.
Worse yet, the hole even had purple lightning all around it that he didn’t dare touch!
To enter, he had to enlarge it from afar, and then go in through the red light. This way, the purple lightning would stop bothering him.
The crux of it all was, how can he proceed? He didn’t think punching and kicking would just up and open a Heavenly Emperor’s array. That’d be ridiculous!
[Then again...], Zhuo Fan’s eyes landed on the curled up Gu Santong.
[Kid, time to pay up!]
Laughing inside, Zhuo Fan started rattling the kid, “Gu Santong, we are in grave danger, with only one chance at survival. See that red light? That is the exit. Punch it, make it big enough for us to go through!”
“No no no, I’m scared of that lightning!” Gu Santong held his ears and jerked his head.
Zhuo Fan barked, “I’m scared too, but are you more scared of them or death? And even if we are to die, let’s all go out with a bang and no regrets!”
Gu Santong was startled but still shivered.
Zhuo Fan smiled and tousled his hair, his tone softer, “It’s fine. I’ll hold you close. Even if we die, I’ll go first! I won’t ever let go of you, so you don’t either. When life hangs in the balance we must hold nothing back!”
[Particularly about letting me go, alright? If not for your sake, punch for me. Please?]
Zhuo Fan didn’t voice his thought, but he made a great impression on Gu Santong!
Gu Santong regarded him deeply, his heart warm and fuzzy. His frightened body no longer trembled and looked at the red light and nodded.
Then, with a shout, he lifted his childish fist and punched!
Hum~
A strange ripple came from Gu Santong’s fist, as if a large dragon shot forth. It was so excessive that even the purple lightning was warped in its wake as it shook the very fabric of space.
Boom!
The red light grew and turned into a man-sized hole, sending out a red pillar of light this time.
Where it shined, no purple lightning dared go near it!
Zhuo Fan was ecstatic and rubbed the kid’s head, “You were brilliant, kid!”
Gu Santong grinned like an innocent child!
But then, a purple lightning slammed into Zhuo Fan. The azure flame shuddered and up and vanished.
The remaining lightning power snaked its way into Zhuo Fan and forced him to spat flickering blood. His face paled.
“Are you alright?” Gu Santong cried.
Suddenly hugging the kid, Zhuo Fan showed a weak smile, “It’s fine. I told you, I’ll be holding on to you as long as I have a breath in my body. There’s nothing scary about this purple lightning!”
Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth and flew towards the red light. But when he entered the cover of the light, he blacked out. All while his arms still held Gu Santong close.
The two floated like that among the red light, with only Gu Santong aware, moved seeing Zhuo Fan’s pale face...
Outside of the purple storm, not long after Lightning Canyon came, it vanished again.
It left behind absolutely nothing. Gu Santong’s two fists at least left dust, but the Lightning Canyon annihilated everything.
It reshaped the land in its wake, leaving behind a place where not even dust remained. And where the purple lightning struck the earth, it left boiling lava!
Li Jingtian and the four demons sent a soul ripple to search the area but found no trace of Zhuo Fan and Gu Santong!
“Steward Zhuo and that devil had to be destroyed body and soul!” Sly Demon sighed.
“Waaah, Steward Zhuo is so pitiful! Why did he have to die with that devil?” Wimp Demon sniffed, “Steward Zhuo was so good to us, not abandoning when it mattered most!”
“Yeah, unlike our Sect Leader, who would use us as pastries in a heartbeat!” Violent Demon sighed in sorrow as well. But soon he grinned and laughed, “Well, look on the bright side. Aren’t we free again? Ha-ha-ha... “
The three demons froze then jumped in joy, “Yeah, yeah...”
Li Jingtian’s face was glum, his brow twitching as he barked, “Who told you that lie? Now that you’re in the employment of the Luo clan, you won’t get out so easily!”
“Humph, think you can scare us? Who do you think you are, Steward Zhuo?” Violent Demon mocked.
Snorting, Li Jingtian’s fingers moved, “You think only Steward Zhuo can control the Bloodworms? Think about it, why would Steward Zhuo leave you in my care if not for teaching me how to control you?”
Shuddering, the demons watched him vigilant.
“Humph, you don’t believe me? Want a taste to refresh your memories?”
“Uh, no no no, we believe you!” Just as Li Jingtian was about to do it, the demons begged. Then they bowed with lamenting faces, “Elder Li, we will listen to you!”
Nodding smugly, Li Jingtian glared ,”That’s better. Now let’s get back to Windgaze City and guard the Luo clan. I still have to ask Young Miss to confer you the rank of elders. Or if you stay in my care I’ll put you on latrine duty!”
“Uh, we will be elders!” The four shouted in panic as they flew to Windgaze City.
Seeing them go, Li Jingtian sighed at the empty space behind, “Steward Zhuo, staying with you for so long, I’ve picked up a few tricks. Don’t worry, no matter where you are, I believe you’re still alive. I’ll look after these clowns and await your return! “
Li Jingtian then followed after the demons, leaving behind the desolate place...

chapters.title: Chapter 241, I’ll Be Your Father!
chapters.content:
Chapter 241, I’ll Be Your Father!
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Silavin
Boom~
The crackling of lightning never stopped jarring his ears, rousing the weakened and pale Zhuo Fan.
Above, all he saw was a dome of blackness, with only a hazy red light shining down on the earth around him.
Earlier, they jumped inside that hole in the sky after following the curtain of red light, the same one that kept changing positions! Looking further, one could see above the red curtain, the purple lightning raining havoc like dragons all around and towards it.
But once the lightning touched the red light, it bounced back.
The red light was a haven, freeing this patch of earth from the lightning’s deadly assault!
“Is this... Heavenly Emperor’s remnant?” With a faint smile, Zhuo Fan was heavily wounded but that didn’t stop the joy he felt. He was finally here.
Looking around, all he saw was yellow rocky outcrops everywhere.
It didn’t look like much, but he wasn’t disappointed in the least. It was the person that made a mountain known, not the hunk of rock itself! Even if the Heavenly Emperor’s remnant was a wasteland, it still hid treasures!
Zhuo Fan crawled to his feet, eager to begin searching. He tried getting up but then found something heavy on him.
Gu Santong was holding on for his dear life, his small face in tranquil sleep.
Gu Santong was stirred awake and wiped the drool for his face. He opened his hazy eyes and gave an innocent smile, “Ha-ha-ha, you’re awake!”
Zhuo Fan smiled a nod.
But then, another lightning roared nearby and Gu Santong was frightened into burying his head in Zhuo Fan’s chest, his hands holding onto Zhuo Fan for his dear life!
Zhuo Fan shook his head, never imagining Invincible Scamp would be such a shy kid.[It is understandable if we were outside, but why are you acting all scared here when you know the lightning can’t touch you?]
“Uh, Gu Santong, we’re safe here. You should let go and let me look around!”
“Don’t wanna!” Gu Santong shook his head, holding him tighter, “I’m scared of purple lightning. Holding you feels safe!”
Zhuo Fan smiled dejectedly and shook his head, “Oh please, you’re much stronger than me, so how can you feel safe next to me? It’d make more sense if I was the one holding onto you!”
Gu Santong grumbled and lifted his head, “You kinda remind me of dad, and felt safe holding on to you...”
“Dad?” Zhuo Fan started, “You have a dad?”
Gu Santong rolled his eyes and Zhuo Fan’s face twitched, [What the hell am I saying? Who doesn’t? It’s not like this kid came out of a rock or something, right?]
He hurriedly brushed it off with a chuckle, “Uh, that’s not it. I was just surprised. With how strong you are, your dad must be amazing!”
“I don’t know. I’ve never seen my father for as long as I can remember!” Gu Santong said downcast.
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow in thought.
Knowing what he was thinking, Gu Santong added, “The dad I’m talking about is godfather. He is surnamed Gu and had two sons. When I was chased around because of the Demon Purging Decree, it was he who saved and nursed me!”
“Did he give you your name?” Zhuo Fan asked.
Gu Santong nodded and showed a bittersweet smile, “The Gu clan was a clan of scholars, with every generation working as officials. They weren’t very high ranked, neither held important positions, but they had a happy life. After he saved me, he took me as his third son and taught me to read and write. He wished for me to be a sensible man, so he named me Santong.”
(StarReader: san=three tong=communication)
“Uh, I see. He picked up a precious treasure! With you watching over them, their success was guaranteed. They must’ve been instantly promoted and their clan became a first rate one, right?” Zhuo Fan chuckled.
But Gu Santong sighed in sadness, “No, I harmed them instead. If it weren’t for me, their whole clan wouldn’t have died!”
Zhuo Fan was startled and soon could guess what happened.
This child was hunted down with the Demon Purging Decree, and even a mere greeting would earn that person death. Reading all those books must’ve gotten to that clan’s head to have welcomed their calamity into their house.
“Uh, don’t feel bad. That is also fate!” Zhuo Fan patted his head, “Is this why you turned into the empire’s enemy?”
Gu Santong nodded, his eyes taking a hint of savagery from the bitterness in his heart, but then sighed at the end, “In the end I was too careless, agreeing to that old fart’s promise. Now I am powerless to fight the seven houses.”
“You could’ve just broke your promise. A child’s words do not hold weight. No one would blame you!” Zhuo Fan ruffled his hair, like a devil on his shoulder, pushing him towards malice and destruction.
But Gu Santong shook his head vehemently, “Dad taught me the value of reading, taught me honor. I won’t disgrace his teaching just because he died!”
“Good child!”
Zhuo Fan nodded, but inwardly sighed, [Such an ambitious sapling got ruined in an instant. Ah, but all bookworms are suckers...]
[But, that’s fine as well. How else could I’ve had such leeway if this kid was immoral?]
Zhuo Fan felt like extending that Gu scholar a gesture of gratitude. [Thanks for having misled this mighty kid onto the path of a bookworm and off my kill list!]
Zhuo Fan rejoiced and showed a sneaky grin, “You must always listen to your godfather. He was right!”
Gu Santong nodded, falling for Zhuo Fan’s ploy like a baby.
“By the way, what did you mean when you said I reminded you of your dad?” Zhuo Fan’s eyes beamed.
Gu Santong blushed, turning meek as he mumbled, “When you held me as we charged in here and protected me from lightning, remind me of the time when dad protected me and told me to escape...”
“Oh, I see!”
Zhuo Fan exclaimed, [The kid took my act as fatherly love.] The difference here though was while that Gu guy loved kids, Zhuo Fan loved himself.
His ‘selfless’ act in protecting Gu Santong was all so he could have him under him, that his death would be such a pity. If the scenario was instead a one guaranteed survivor, Zhuo Fan wouldn’t hesitate to throw the kid to the wolves.
Who knew this act would lead to a huge misunderstanding instead?
So Zhuo Fan showed a queer smile, “Uh, Santong, how about I’ll be your dad?”
This rotten and shameless punk even had the balls to call the kid by his name to get closer.
Gu Santong seemed opposed to the idea, feeling quite awkward as well, “Why would I do that? I’m three hundred years old. And how old are you? That’s too queer...”
“What’s so queer about it? You may have three centuries over me, but you’re a child at heart and need looking after!” Zhuo Fan shouted his righteousness, his tone growing soft, “And we are also here by fate. I was fond of you the moment I saw you!”
“Really?” Gu Santong was expectant.
Zhuo Fan nodded. [Damn right I am. Particularly of your insane power. I like that the best! So hurry up and work under me like a good little soldier!]
Gu Santong rubbed his chin and lifted his head, “What’s in it for me?”
[Why you little prick!]
Zhuo Fan cursed inside, but he soon accepted the fact, since all kids were pricks, “I can protect you!”
“Do I even need your protection?”
“What was that just now then if not protection?” Zhuo Fan said, “Also, you may be unreasonably strong, but far too gullible and easy to dupe. Just think, if you hadn’t readily believed that guy’s lie ending up protecting the imperial family for a millenia, wouldn’t you be exacting revenge on the seven houses by now?”
“Accept me as your godfather and I will safeguard you, as well as show the world who they really are! Bloody bastards, dare to cheat my son? You must be tired of living!”
Zhuo Fan sputtered, talking big words that made Gu Santong laugh, but still couldn’t stop from making the kid feel warm inside, “We, father and son, are the strongest and smartest combination! Did you see that old guy and the four little shits listening to every word I say? They are all stronger than me but aren’t they still hanging on my every word? That is wisdom. The wise controls and so do the powerful...”
Gu Santong bobbed his head.
Zhuo Fan finished off with his biggest sales pitch, “Join me and with my power, no one will pick on you. Above all, you will never have to eat that garbage ingredients again. If I can find an 8th grade, I won’t ever give you a 7th grade!”
Zhuo Fan then showed him 20 7th grade ingredients, “As a token of my sincerity, these are all the 7th grade ingredients from my ring. I also admit all those other ingredients I’ve given you were already in my storage ring. Only the 8th grade ingredient had to be found. I truly had to enter the lightning array and suffer untold hardships for it!”
Zhuo Fan’s speech was impeccable, mixing truth and lies flawlessly and hiding his greatest offense in order to gain trust. He knew Gu Santong cared most about other’s intent to hurt him. It was a shadow left in his heart a long time ago. Zhuo Fan must never ever admit to having set the lightning array himself, ever.
“I know!”
Gu Santong took the ingredient, [He’s hooked!] as he drooled, “I still had my doubts about you trying to harm me, but now I trust you. Since you are forthcoming with the ingredients from your ring, I’m sure there is nothing else hidden.”
Zhuo Fan nodded and sighed inside. [How can I feel at ease leaving this gullible child all alone in the world? Most of all, letting others use him would be poor judgment from my part. That’ll cause me endless trouble! He’s far more fitting in the care of my adequate and fatherly hands, he-he-he.... ]
“As for you hiding ingredients, I knew it already!”
“You did?” Zhuo Fan was shocked. If the kid did know and with his temper, he’d have stolen them by now from Zhuo Fan. But why didn’t he?
Gu Santong smiled, “To be honest, eating ingredients isn’t important. It’s the wait for them that I find most appealing. Godfather usually went out for weeks even a month sometimes to find me ingredients to eat. He always returned with 1st or 2nd grade ones but the image of him appearing filled with hope at sunset gave me peace...”
“Oh, I see. Then give them back and I will return one every one or two weeks!” Zhuo Fan licked his lips, still hoping to not waste them like this.
But Gu Santong held them close, and turned around, “How can you ask back something you’ve already given? What kinda dad are you?”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shined and laughed, “Does that mean you will take me as a godfather?”
Gu Santong meekly nodded.
Zhuo Fan burst out laughing at the heavens!
[Ha-ha-ha, with this monstrous son, what seven houses, what Regent Estate would ever dare mess with me...]

chapters.title: Chapter 242, Ancient Sacred Beast, Soaring Qilin
chapters.content:
Chapter 242, Ancient Sacred Beast, Soaring Qilin
Pff!
In the middle of laughing, Zhuo Fan’s eyes bulged, he shivered and, under a purple lightning’s effect,spat blood.
When the blood hit the ground, it exploded and left a black mark.
Gu Santong cried, “Godfather, are you alright?”
“I’m fine. This purple lightning is just too powerful!” Zhuo Fan wiped the blood, and panted with a grave look in his eyes.
The purple lightning exceeded his calculations. The part that he failed to refine with Demon Transformation Art roamed around his body just now and caused disaster in its wake.
But he had no way to stop it either. This was akin to slow acting poison. He knew it ravaged his body, and would one day rob his life, but couldn’t do anything about it!
Looking further, at the rocks and yellow sand, Zhuo Fan took a deep breath and stood up, his face hard, “Santong, help me search for anything suspicious!”
He knew the purple lightning was one of Heavenly Emperor’s abilities and the emperor must have had to have a way to dispel it. He had no choice but to scour Heavenly Emperor’s remnant and find that cure.
Gu Santong nodded genially and helped Zhuo Fan up, “Uh, godfather, you can just call me young Sanzi. That’s how my old dad used to call me. Anyone who was friendly with me called me that!”
Zhuo Fan nodded, smiling weakly, “Alright, young Sanzi. Go scout ahead!”
“Understood!”
Gu Santong cupped his hands, and skipped away. Having recognized Zhuo Fan as godfather, and finding someone close to him, did wonders for his ego, even ignoring the ceaseless rumbling above.
Since Zhuo Fan was right behind him, he had nothing to fear!
The duo had been wandering this endless stretch of yellow sand for over six hours but still couldn’t reach the end. Zhuo Fan ceased his walk and frowned.
Gu Santong stopped as well and looked back, “What is it, godfather?”
“Young Sanzi, don’t you feel we’ve been going in circles?” Zhuo Fan looked around and his doubts grew, “Damn, it’s a bewildering array!”
Gu Santong’s eyes widened and rushed to him. “What, a bewildering array?”
“How could I’ve been fooled by it...” Gu Santong pouted. Basing his confidence on his previous shallow experience, he had nothing to fear and smiled, “No worry, godfather. See how I punch through it!”
Gu Santong lifted his small fist and struck!
Hum~
But the usual sight of seeing a ripple level a hundred miles of land didn’t appear. The ground just shook a bit then quietened.
Gu Santong was dispirited, “This can’t be!”
This never happened before, not once.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, having already guessed it.
This was not your average array, but one set up by Heavenly Emperor, one of the three strongest emperors of ancient times. If a little monster could simply force his way through, then the Heavenly Emperor would’ve been an empty title.
[If he could break this array so easily, what would then be the point of finding some Heavenly Emperor’s remnant when I could straight up take this little monster as master instead!?]
“Young Sanzi, save your energy. Come here!” Zhuo Fan shook his head seeing him punch everywhere, “Young Sanzi, I want you to be honest with me. You’ve never been here before?”
Gu Santong shook his head puzzled.
Zhuo Fan frowned, “Then why are you afraid of purple lightning? Did you see it before?”
“I haven’t!” Gu Santong paused then shook his head in the end, “How strange, this is the first time I’m seeing it yet I felt instinctual fear towards it. At it’s thunderclaps, I can’t help but shiver. It’s not like the common lightning, which I hate but am not scared!”
This was odd. According to Zhuo Fan, the kid had to have a connection with Lightning Canyon, but now...
Scratching his nose, Zhuo Fan mulled it over, “Can’t be. No one has instinctual fear against anyone, not to such extent at least. Was it perhaps... ancestral memories?”
Zhuo Fan asked, “Young Sanzi, who is your master to have trained you so powerful?”
“I don’t have a master!”
“Then how did you reach the Profound Heaven Stage three centuries ago?”
“Uh...” Now that he stopped to think about it, Gu Santong said puzzled, “I don’t know. For as long as I can remember, I’ve been in the Profound Heaven Stage. I had no one to call a friend, looking for ingredients alone!”
Zhuo Fan was shocked as a radical conclusion crawled into his mind.
[What if... this kid isn’t human?]
Zhuo Fan licked his dry lips, he himself was scared by that thought.
The average human became stronger through diligent cultivation and understanding of the Heavenly Dao. But there were some creatures that were naturally strong, like the spiritual beasts. And those that assumed human form, were a cut above mere spiritual beasts...
Zhuo Fan didn’t dare to finish that thought. If it was true, then wasn’t the Mortal Domain, the place unanimously despised by all experts from the Sacred Domain, a place to be reckoned with?
Recalling the mysterious expert in the Allbeast Mountain Range only worked to strengthen his hypothesis!
“Godfather,” Gu Santong turned his bright eyes to him, “I’ll use my nose. In the illusory array before, I could see through anything fake with my nose. Nothing can lie my sense of smell. I’ll find us a way out in no time!”
Zhuo Fan shook his head in dismay.
[It worked outside because there were all kinds of scents coming from outside of the array! But here, beyond all this sand, there’s only more sand.]
[If this array had such a weakness, Heavenly Emperor would’ve been taken for a fool, locked up and had his cell key thrown away!]
Before he could say anything, Gu Santong wiggled his nose and said, “I found something, godfather! I smell something familiar!”
What?!
Zhuo Fan was bug eyed, letting himself be pulled by the child.
After just a few steps, they stopped. He scrunched his nose again and pointed, “There’s our exit!”
Zhuo Fan found a three inch jutting rock. A kick could send it flying easy. [Is this the core of the illusory array?]
Before he could make sense of it all, Gu Santong jumped over and picked it up. Then collapsed on the side!
Whoosh~
The surroundings suddenly changed. They were walking downward when the change in scenery came and it was hard to react quickly!
This place was but half a mile wide, with a black still sky, but the soil was no longer sand. Instead it was red earth.
Zhuo Fan could easily take in the scent of blood. Looking back, he realized they’d been walking in circles not a hundred meters from the edge.
Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan rejoiced, [Thank god I have Gu Santong with me, or I’d be caught dead wandering the illusory array alone!]
Then, some sobbing entered his ears.
Zhuo Fan looked to Gu Santong leaning on a red pillar and shedding tears. He struck an incredibly sorry figure, with his tear-streaked face.
“Uh, young Sanzi, what’s wrong?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow.
Shaking his head, Gu Santong was trying to hold in his crying, “I don’t know either. I only picked up its scent and all of a sudden, my heart couldn’t bear the sorrow!”
Startled, Zhuo Fan eyed the red pillar closely.
That look alone made him jump in fright.
It was hundreds of meters tall, jutting out of the ground like a mountain. It even passed the black sky! The purple lightning not once stopped striking it, making out a scorched sound yet couldn’t make a single dent on it.
Zhuo Fan clicked his tongue. [What is this thing? How can it withstand so many purple lightning strikes without so much as a scratch?] The shocker was the stage of the lightning, 12th Heaven!
The fact this pillar was standing strong even in the face of this, it was bound to be special.
Zhuo Fan inwardly smiled, [So the Heavenly Emperor is a fool in the end! Letting such a huge pillar with such an obvious scent, of course someone will find it... Wait!]
Zhuo Fan caught onto something and sized the pillar in greater detail all while his breathing grew ragged.
[This scent, the spiritual energy is mixed with something wild. It must be from a spiritual beast, no, a sacred beast!]
Zhuo Fan gasped as a chill crawled up his spine.
[You’re telling me this pillar isn’t made of metal but from a sacred beast!]
Zhuo Fan started combing through the Nine Serenities Secret Records in his mind.
“During the ancient times, five sacred beasts ruled the skies, undefeated. Not even peak Emperor Stage experts could fight them. Their only match were the three strongest emperors. The beasts were...”
“And one of the five ancient sacred beasts is the Soaring Qilin!” Zhuo Fan cried out in shock.
None of the ten famous emperors of antiquity ever expected Soaring Qilin would end up here. And by the looks of it, it was clearly dead, with only the Soaring Qilin’s leg still firmly planted in this place!
Its killer was no secret either, the owner of the 12th Heaven Purple Lightning Gold Eye, Heavenly Emperor!
[Could this perhaps not be the Heavenly Emperor’s remnant, but his slaughterhouse instead...]

chapters.title: Chapter 243, Heavenly Emperor’s Ultimate Art, Divine Void Eye
chapters.content:
Chapter 243, Heavenly Emperor’s Ultimate Art, Divine Void Eye
Bang~
The shaking earth pulled Zhuo out of his train of thoughts. He turned to see Gu Santong crying hot tears as he gave his all in shaking the pillar.
With the shaking of the pillar, so too did the whole space. The bolts of purple lightning hammered the red curtain, wishing to punch through and turn all of this place into smoldering ashes.
Zhuo Fan cried out, “Young Sanzi, what are you doing? The red curtain of light that keeps us alive comes from this Soaring Qilin leg. If it falls, we’ll die with it!”
“But... I can’t stand it seeing it struck by the purple lightning. I just can’t take the sorrow...” Gu Santong sniffed.
Startled, Zhuo Fan turned to the Qilin’s leg in thought.
[They say blood is thicker than water.] And Gu Santong’s every action proved to him that the kid wasn’t ordinary. At this point in time, the kid was resonating with the Soaring Qilin leg and started crying.
[Is he perhaps related to one of the five ancient sacred beasts, the Soaring Qilin?]
Zhuo Fan sighed and ruffled the kid’s hair, “If you do not wish for it to cry from Heaven, stop.”
Gu Santong didn’t understand.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “It is nothing if I die, but if you die, the pillar would also feel sad. No one wants to see his descendants die in vain!”
“You mean... he is my kin?” Gu Santong widened his teary eyes in shock.
Nodding, Zhuo Fan continued, “You feel unbearable sadness the moment you saw the Qilin leg being struck down by lightning. Don’t you think the owner of this leg would feel even sadder it’s leg couldn’t protect you from the purple lightning? “
Gu Santong looked at him deeply and no longer attacked the pillar.
Pff!
Suddenly, Zhuo Fan spat blood that scorched the ground again. Gu Santong cried in panic.
Zhuo Fan waved his hand bitterly, “The purple lightning keeps ruining my body. I hoped to find the art to dispel it in Heavenly Emperor’s remnant, but... “
Sighing, Zhuo Fan said, “It looks like I survived the entrance only to die inside!”
“Godfather, you’ll be fine, We just became kin!” Gu Santong was anxious.
He finally found someone who cared for him, only to see him die. Gu Santong was so heartbroken, tears began to fall again.
Zhuo Fan shook his head in dismay. He was an evil man who rarely did anything good, yet even so, someone was crying on his deathbed. He felt gratified.
The irony here couldn’t be more obvious. This godson of his who was crying was gained through tricks and ill intentions.
Squinting, Zhuo Fan sighed and put his storage ring on Gu Santong’s finger, just like a legacy, “This ring has many ingredients. Take it! I hope you will grow up fast. With the natural power in your blood, you will one day get out of here!”
“Godfather...” Gu Santong’s tears glimmered, touched to the core.
Zhuo Fan wiped his tears away and took out the Thunder Skylark’s egg, “After my death, you will be lonely. Take this bird to help you brave the times... “
He didn’t finish as chirping was heard.
Zhuo Fan was startled, “Are you kiddin’ me? It’s hatching now? How...”
Shriek~
With a loud crack the egg burst and revealed the head of a small chick, with lightning streaking it.
It looked different from any common Thunder Skylark, it was purple. And the shocking thing was that the flickering lightning was purple as well!
Gu Santong cowered to the side at its sight, while Zhuo Fan stood agape, “Un-frreaking-believable! It can use the 1st Heaven purple lightning at birth! This Thunder Skylark is a variant... “
Eek~
The chick blinked its beady eyes at Zhuo Fan, taking him for its mother. It cried out in joy and flapped its wings as it leaped at him.
It couldn’t fly yet, having just been born, staggering its frail body over and rubbing its head on him.
Zhuo Fan was out of it looking at the blinking chick. Then he cursed, “You little poultry, you got the most out of this trip to Lightning Canyon! A normal Thunder Skylark can only reach the 6th level with common lightning. But you little cheeky thing got born with purple lightning. I am looking forward to seeing how high you can reach!”
“Godfather, grab it! Don’t let it come near me!” Gu Santong was hiding behind the Qilin leg and shouting in fear.
Zhuo Fan laughed, “Young Sanzi, what are you afraid of? Its purple lightning is only in the 1st Heaven. It can’t hurt even me, let alone you! Once I’m gone, you will only have each other to pass the long lonely days here! Don’t be afraid, alright?
“Come here. Since I’ve cared for this cheeky thing so much, it can be called my son as well. As the big brother, you should come and greet your little brother!”
Zhuo Fan was being childish. He knew Gu Santong was scared of purple lightning, yet he was now teasing him by making this chick his kin.
Gu Santong shook while trembling.
Zhuo Fan laughed, [Ah, I’m not long for this world anyway. Teasing Tianyu’s strongest, the Invincible Scamp, is such a joy.]
So he put the chick down and pointed it to Gu Santong.
The chick, gladly accepted his mother’s instruction and wobbled with a chirp to Gu Santong. Like a little bro wanting to play with his big bro. But the crackling purple lightning all over its body drove fear straight into Gu Santong.
“Beat it, shoo, don’t come any closer!”
Gu Santong threw rocks around the pillar at it. But the chick’s gait was as wobbly as it was springy, dodging as it approached.
In fact, it thought big bro was playing with it and was skipping over in excitement.
Gu Santong’s pitiful face was on the verge of tears. It kept throwing rocks at it but always missed. Zhuo Fan laughed from the sidelines. Like a grandpa amused by his grandson’s antics!
Perhaps from being pushed into a corner seeing the rocks were of no help, Gu Santong looked around and noticed something white sticking out.
Gu Santong went for it but was shocked to find he couldn’t lift it.
This was stranger than fiction. With his power, he couldn’t lift a small rock? So he stabbed his hand into the dirt and strained into pulling this odd rock.
But what came out of the ground was a rock the size of a man, looking funny in the hand of a child like Gu Santong. What’s more, the kid found it heavy even for his strength.
Zhuo Fan cried out in shock but Gu Santong was in the throes of fear as the chick got ever closer. So he threw it.
The chick cried out and flapped its wings. Fear was a powerful motivator and actually made it learn how to fly on the spot!
The large rock shook the earth and left a meter wide hole around it. The chick landed in fright on it, and this time looked at Gu Santong with palpitation.
[Big bro wasn’t playing around with me, he truly hates me!]
Zhuo Fan shook his head at Gu Santong’s fuming appearance. He was about to scold him when his eyes snapped to the large rock.
He inspected it in detail.
The large rock looked like a huge egg, smooth and shiny enough to see one’s reflection. But on a closer look one could see light spilling from within, and could even make out the shape of a human.
“Imparting Stone!”
Zhuo Fan cried out in excitement, “This is an amazing treasure!”
The Imparting Stone was exceedingly rare in the Sacred Domain. It is used by Masters to pass down secret arts to their disciples or family members.
Usually, the Imparting Stone would be passed down from the previous clan leader to the next one. The new leader would smash the stone and thus gain the inheritance.
The inheriting process also destroys the Imparting Stone. When the leader reaches the end of his life, he would leave all his knowledge into another Imparting Stone for the next leader.
This way, the legacy of a clan would live on!
But never did he think this isolated world would house such a treasure.
[Who’s memories did this Imparting Stone contain?] Was it the Qilin’s or Heavenly Emperor’s? If they were Heavenly Emperor’s, he’d struck gold. It may even contain the way of removing the purple lightning from his body!
Zhuo Fan was eager to try it, “Young Sanzi, break that rock!”
Gu Santong thought Zhuo Fan was scolding in a roundabout way, “If you’re going to scold me, do it to my face! I know I shouldn’t use such a large rock on a chick. Since you took it as your son, he is my little brother, so I wouldn’t cross the line. But don’t use the rock as an excuse!”
Zhuo Fan laughed, “I am content knowing you own up to your mistakes, but I’m not scolding you here. I only want you to help me break that rock so that I may live!”
Gu Santong’s eyes shined and was in glee knowing he could save Zhuo Fan!
So with a boom, the Imparting Stone was blown to pieces by Gu Santong’s mighty fist. A multicolored mist drifted out of it!
Within it, a human shape appeared, around 20 years old but with a dignified expression. Purple flickered on his left eye while his right eye was as deep as the abyss.
Looking any longer, one would feel sucked in.
“The leader of the ten ancient emperors, the Heavenly Emperor!” Zhuo Fan gasped.
The person was tranquil, his gaze looked ahead but it gave the impression it overlooked all of creation, “Junior, as you were fortunate enough to open my Imparting Stone, you must be kin. I shall impart to you my ultimate magical art, Divine Eye of the Void. Pay close attention...”
“What, the Divine Eye of the Void? I struck the motherlode, ha-ha-ha...” Zhuo Fan shuddered from joy and couldn’t hold back the laughter...

chapters.title: Chapter 244, First Stage of Divine Eye of the Void
chapters.content:
Chapter 244, First Stage of Divine Eye of the Void
When people spoke of Heavenly Emperor, one of the three strongest ancient emperors, they always mentioned his greatest abilities, the Purple Lightning Gold Eye on his left, and the Divine Eye of the Void on his right! The Divine Eye of the Void was also the first magical ability he comprehended when he entered the Emperor Stage. It held such unbelievable power that not even Purple Lightning Gold Eye could come close.
Zhuo Fan was stoked. For fear his two brats would interfere, he even gave them a sign to keep quiet, yet his eyes and ears never missed anything the image revealed.
This was a once in a lifetime chance. Missing a single word would leave him with endless regrets!
“The Divine Eye of the Void is a supreme ocular magical art. Place your attention on the word void. It is another word for emptiness. Only in emptiness can one have space. And to be one with the emptiness is a virtue. Afterall, all space is emptiness and not emptiness at the same time.”
Heavenly Emperor’s image stood tall as he imparted the art. Zhuo Fan didn’t even blink, afraid of losing even a minute gesture.
Gu Santong and the chick could feel how important this was to Zhuo Fan and stood quietly at the side.
For three days and three nights, Zhuo Fan hadn’t moved, hadn’t spoken, hadn’t even blinked for how engrossed he was.
The Heavenly Emperor ended with, “I have imparted you with the 12 stages of Divine Eye of the Void! You now hold inside you the power to make our clan supreme, all you need to do is will it. Regarding my second magical art, Purple Lightning Gold Eye, it was born out of this Divine Eye of the Void. If your talent is not lacking, it will come to you with time without having the need to train it. If you lack in any way, seek out the other Imparting Stone of mine to help you train it. But if you wish to follow in my footsteps and reach my power, stop here! Take what I’ve given you and use your own abilities to attain comprehension of it...”
The mist dissipated and the Heavenly Emperor’s figure faded away, leaving behind the pieces of the Imparting Stone. These pieces had now turned to useless hunks of rocks!
Zhuo Fan frowned.
Gu Santong asked, “What’s wrong, godfather?”
“Nothing, just that the last phrase was odd. As if he didn’t want his descendant to train in the Purple Lightning Gold Eye!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes squinted.
Gu Santong laughed at the sky and mocked, “What does it matter what he wanted? It all comes down to your decision to train or not.”
“Of course I want to. That’s one of his masterpieces!” Zhuo Fan widened his eyes.
“Then what are we waiting for? I’ll help you search for it!” Gu Santong jumped right into scrounge through the rocks on the ground, looking for another Imparting Stone.
Zhuo Fan shook his head in the end.
The Heavenly Emperor didn’t want for his descendant to train the Purple Lightning Gold Eye, but deduce it by himself instead of blindingly following the teachings of others. And yet, he was still afraid his descendant was unable to achieve it so he left the training method for the Purple Lightning Gold Eye behind.
Zhuo Fan, however, was not Heavenly Emperor’s descendant, so there was no point in abiding by Heavenly Emperor’s teachings!
[Who cares? Waste not want not. It’s here anyway so I might as well use it.] But what struck him as odd, was that the image clearly intended to leave it all for his descendant. So how on earth did it end up being taken advantage of by this down on his luck, rebirthed Demonic Emperor who stumbled his way inside?
Looking at the jutting Qilin leg, Zhuo Fan was in deep thought.
[He-he-he, who the hell cares? Since it fell in my lap, if I don’t take it, who will?]
Zhuo Fan grinned, and scoured the place with Gu Santong. The chick was skipping around at the side, chirping oddly.
[What is daddy and bro doing? Looking for worms to eat?]
The chick hopped into the fun!
An hour later, most of the place was turned upside down but no sign of anything that remotely resembled another Imparting Stone. Zhuo Fan was curious, [Does this place have only the Divine Eye of the Void Imparting Stone?]
Then he facepalmed and cursed, [I’m such a fool!]
How could he forget about Long Jiu?
Long Jiu said he’d been sucked into the purple lightning storm, and punched everywhere. In sheer coincidence he entered through the gap in the array and smashed the Purple Lightning Gold Eye’s Imparting Stone by chance.
So when he was listening to that strange voice he’d been training Purple Lightning Gold Eye without even realizing. But in his frantic state, he forgot the training method to the art, thus making the art lost.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, [I can’t decide if it was bad luck or dumb luck!]
His dumb luck was because of the ridiculously low chance of any of those events ever happening to him. Furthermore, in a row too. And bad luck since he was clearly being taught an ultimate skill, yet, he was too much of a chicken to keep it together to remember it!
Zhuo Fan sighed, then recalled Heavenly Emperor’s words. [It may perhaps be a blessing in disguise.]
“Young Sanzi, we can stop now. The Purple Lightning Gold Eye isn’t fated for me. Let it go!” Zhuo Fan sighed and chuckled.
Gu Santong said, concerned, “But can you alleviate your wounds with only that Divine Eye of the Void? As the saying goes, whoever started something must also have a way of ending it. The purple lightning is harming you so the Purple Lightning Gold Eye must cure you as well!”
Zhuo Fan shuddered, felt warm and fuzzy inside.
He only wanted the Purple Lightning Gold Eye to boost his power. But Gu Santong’s main priority was to cure him.
[I may have cheated him into the fold, but he’s starting to really grow on me.]
“It’s of no importance. The Divine Eye of the Void is enough to cure me!” Zhuo Fan smiled and beckoned his two sons over.
Gu Santong still felt somewhat repelled by the purple lightning chick, but he was doing his best to accept this little bro of his.
Zhuo Fan patted their heads and spoke solemnly, “Young Sanzi, and you too little bird, uh I’ll just call you Qiao’er. Your dad is going to set up an array and enter seclusion to heal and train. I do not know when I’ll come out. You will be staying here but don’t wander off outside of the light’s curtain!”
“Worry not, godfather, I won’t!” Gu Santong waved, his face showing fear as he looked at the purple lightning outside.
But Qiao’er, cocked its head, oblivious. Zhuo Fan had no time to explain, handing it over in Gu Santong’s care as he immediately set up an array. He sat cross legged in its center and closed his eyes.
Months flashed by!
The next thing he knew when he opened his eyes was that still purple lightning streaked sky. The change he felt inside was the only testament time even passed. With an incredible release of power, his right eye sported a golden ring flashing on and off, with streaks of purple flickering now and then.
He removed the array with a sweep of the hand and Zhuo Fan stood up.
“Eh, you’re out?” A childish voice came from behind, “Godfather, are you cured now?”
“Of course!” Zhuo Fan smiled, and turned to Gu Santong, “Not only cured, but new and improved. Now we can leave this place. I will show both of you my power as we fly out of here!”
Face twitching, Gu Santong sighed, “Godfather, when you boast, at least make it reasonable! You took five years to get to the 9th layer of Bone Tempering Stage. How can you fly us out when you’re not even in the Profound Heaven Stage? I actually have more hope on Qiao’er!”
Gu Santong pointed at the sky and shouted, “Qiao’er, dad is out!”
Shriek~
With a sharp cry, a three meter long purple bird was soaring above the red curtain. The endless booms of purple lightning struck its body but could do nothing to it.
Zhuo Fan went slackjawed, “I-is that Qiao’er? He’s already a 4th level spiritual beast and can produce 4th Heaven purple lightning! But how is it that the 12th Heaven purple lightning outside has no effect on him?”
“I was also worried at first, but he must be of the same nature as the purple lightning.” Gu Santong shrugged, “Those purple lightning never once harmed him. He absorbs them by instinct and then releases it without any consequences!”
Zhuo Fan was blinking in shock.
[My godson is a monster, and my spiritual beast is also a goddamn freak of nature. Not even a 12th Heaven purple lightning fazes him!]
[But that’s only obvious. I reckon I have also stepped into the ranks of monsters. I may have been called a ‘monster’ by others, but now, I’m sure I can even surprise young Sanzi, ha-ha-ha...]
Zhuo Fan turned his smiling face to Gu Santong, “Young Sanzi, did you eat all the ingredients I gave you?”
“Ages ago, and Qiao’er ate half! I haven’t had an ingredient to eat for three years now and couldn’t get out as well. I’m starving here...” Gu Santong rubbed his stomach dejected.
Zhuo Fan patted his shoulder, “No worries, dad will take you out now!”
“Yeah, right! A 9th layer Bone Tempering cultivator? Even if you did have to heal first, you’re too slow in advancing.” Gu Santong teased, then sighed, “My hopes are all on Qiao’er. He isn’t afraid of purple lightning and once he finds the right way out of here, he’ll bring me plenty of ingredients, he-he-he...”
Zhuo Fan’s face sank, [How can I let a son look down on his father?]
So he coughed to get Gu Santong’s attention, “Young Sanzi, how can you be so cruel to your old man? You’re making me look bad! Come, throw me a punch. I will show you what I can do. Cultivation isn’t everything!”
Gu Santong looked at him oddly, “Dad, be serious. Not even a Radiant Stage expert can take my punch!”
“Cut the chatter and bring it on! I said that I’ll show you my power and that’s what I’ll do!” Zhuo Fan shouted.
Gu Santong sighed and extended a finger, [Dad is so stubborn that I have no choice but play with him. Sigh, I just hope I don’t overdo it!]
Gu Santong simply flicked.
A ripple shot like an arrow straight for Zhuo Fan.
Gu Santong had controlled his power to the bare minimum, but Zhuo Fan couldn’t even take this lightly. Yet he was standing there unfazed for the attack to approach swiftly.
“Watch out, godfather!” Gu Santong cried in panic, [Why didn’t I hold back more? Even if dad is a body cultivator, his level is just too low and this will leave him a pulp!]
His shock didn’t end there as Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed golden and vanished into thin air.
When he appeared, he was behind Gu Santong!
“Divine Eye of the Void’s 1st stage!” Zhuo Fan snickered. Gu Santong was shocked!
Because the moment Zhuo Fan was gone, he lost all traces of him. Not just sight, but smell and hearing as well, all senses failed to detect him as if he was no longer in this world!
[This can’t be...]

chapters.title: Chapter 245, Getting Out
chapters.content:
Chapter 245, Getting Out
“Young Sanzi, here comes my punch!”
Before Gu Santong could get his wits about him, Zhuo Fan shouted. Gu Santong mocked in the end, “Dad, dodging is easy, but punching...”
Starting with a flicker, a purple lightning shot for him.
Gu Santong’s eyes widened and instinct screamed at him to dodge behind the pillar with a jump. The lightning crossed space in a flash, striking the pillar with a boom!
Gu Santong peeked out and saw Zhuo’s fist wrapped in purple lightning, “G-godfather, how can you use purple lightning?”
“Ha-ha-ha, that’s thanks to Divine Eye of the Void!” Zhuo Fan flicked his hand, being smug after seeing young Sanzi’s reaction. He finally got to show off in front of his godlike adopted son of his, “The Divine Eye of the Void pays emphasis on the void part. It’s main use is control over space. The first stage allows me to switch places anywhere in my soul search’s range. And...”
Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed golden and Gu Santong’s ring appeared on his finger, “Allows me complete control over inanimate items, changing their location. Ha-ha-ha, young Sanzi, since you ate all ingredients from it you won’t be needing my storage ring anymore!”
Even Gu Santong couldn’t help but gawk at the explanation and display of such an outstanding art. This was the first time in the life of Invincible Scamp to show such a shocked face.
“Won’t that make you invincible, since no one can hit you?” Gu Santong blinked.
Scratching his chin, Zhuo Fan nodded, “You can say that, but not quite either. If the first stage of Divine Eye of the Void is so invincible what would be the point of the remaining 11 stages? In truth, this is only control over space. If space is sealed, or I’m inside another space, I’m finished!”
“T-then what’s with the purple lightning? How...” Gu Santong stammered.
Zhuo Fan grinned and his right eye flashes purple, “After training Divine Eye of the Void to the 1st stage, my right eye can open up a pocket dimension. Those purple lightning remnants that wrecked my body and couldn’t be removed are now stored in that pocket dimension. To use them at my discretion!”
“That is why I said cultivation isn’t everything! I may have used most of my time on healing and comprehending the 1st stage of Divine Eye of the Void, but true power is a whole other matter!”
Zhuo Fan grinned, leaving Gu Santong dumbfounded!
Despite Zhuo Fan not having gone through immense changes in the past five years, training in a remarkable art turned him into a freak nonetheless. If Gu Santong hadn’t seen it with his own eyes, he wouldn’t have believed it!
Going out like this, he’d be like a wolf hiding among sheep, ready to strike at any so called expert out there. Who’d ever suspect a 9th layer of Bone Tempering cultivator to have such an insane trump card!
“T-then what of the 2nd stage, godfather? Let me see it!” Gu Santong was eager to witness even more of Divine Eye of the Void’s power.
Blushing, Zhuo Fan coughed drilly, “Uh, Divine Eye of the Void is very hard to understand. Even I only learned the first stage after so long...”
Gu Santong’s face sank in disappointment before he even finished.
Zhuo Fan scratched his head, helpless, [The kid’s face changes tune faster than the weather!] But then he said something that brightened Gu Santong’s day, “But since this space has the same origin as my Divine Eye of the Void, we can now leave this place. Young Sanzi, you’ll get to eat more ingredients!”
“Awesome!”
Gu Santong jumped ten feet in joy, already back to his cheerful self. He heard Zhuo Fan say that before but didn’t believe him one bit.
Now, after Zhuo Fan’s demonstration, he was very much a believer.
Qiao’er also flew before Zhuo Fan and circled Zhuo Fan in jubilation.
Zhuo Fan laughed and repeated his explanation before showing his Thunder Ring, “Don’t resist as I place you in my ring. We will then shortly leave this place and get you out!”
Qiao’er flapped its wings in joy. It felt very close to the Thunder Ring since it was refined from its mother and entered it without complaint.
Gu Santong was hesitating, “Godfather, wait a moment!”
Gu Santong turned to the pillar, fell to his knees and knocked his head on the ground three times, tears streaming down his face, “I do not know who you are, but I know you’re my kin. I don’t know how you died, but I feel heartbroken over your death. I am leaving now, leaving you alone. Take care of yourself!”
Gu Santong wiped his face and went to Zhuo Fan. He didn’t look back, in fear he might not want to ever leave.
Putting Gu Santong in the ring, Zhuo Fan looked at the pillar and sighed, “Soaring Qilin, I am not a good man, and I do not wish to go between you and the Heavenly Emperor. As a Soaring Qilin, you’re a heaven sent ingredient for me. How could I not want you? But, as this child’s godfather, I still hope I can ease his pain...”
Sighing, Zhuo Fan’s eye flashed with light and struck the pillar!
With a bang, the pillar swayed and fell.
With its collapse, the red curtain vanished as well. The purple lightning above the black sky rushed to Zhuo Fan like jackals, wishing to tear him limb from limb.
But Zhuo Fan was calm as ever. He placed the Qilin leg in his ring then his golden eye flashed, right as the purple lightning was about to hit him, vanishing from this world.
The next thing he knew, he was outside the hole he used to enter into this space. But the lightning didn’t hit him as he vanished again.
Thus, in the sea of purple lightning, a flash of golden could be seen on and off growing further and further away. And the purple lightning could do nothing to stop it.
When they reached the edge of the Lightning Canyon, Zhuo Fan’s golden eye flashed one more time.
Whoosh~
His last stop was in a thick forest. Looking up, the bright moon hung in the sky bathing this corner of the world in its moonlight.
“Finally out, but where am I?”
Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan tasted freedom again. With Lightning Canyon wandering the continent he was hard pressed to pinpoint his exact location.
[Who cares anyway? It’s fine as long as I’m out.]
He took Gu Santong and Qiao’er out of his ring and the kid was ecstatic to finally be out again.
This was Qiao’er’s first time seeing the real world, and cried in joy. It flew everywhere, curious to explore it!
“Young Sanzi, I have a gift for you!”
Zhuo Fan showed the kid a tender smile. Gu Santong asked ecstatic, “What, did you have more hidden ingredients in your ring?”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “You little twerp, you picked my ring clean of them. Where could I find any? I think you will find this far more attractive!”
Zhuo Fan then showed the Qilin leg that was still flickering with lightning!
Gu Santong had tears in his eyes as he expressed his gratitude, “You got it out...”
“Of course. I know how much you care for it and don’t want it to be hacked by purple lightning. Since I have the power, of course I’ll help you!”
“Thank you!”
Gu Santong wiped his tears and bowed deeply. Zhuo Fan was truly the spitting image of his former godfather, bearing the same amount of care for him as well.
