He valued Zhuo Fan far more greatly now, more than even his real parents.
This perhaps was one of Zhuo Fan’s very rare acts of kindness. He always looked at Gu Santong and thought how to use him. But the kid’s pure heart touched him, making fatherly love blossom in his cruel and dead heart!
Gu Santong went to the Qilin leg, felt its rough surface and even hugged it, feeling the warmth.
He then came to Zhuo Fan with a request, “Godfather, will you look after it for a while?”
“Why won’t you...” Zhuo Fan asked, but saw Gu Santong’s sad face and could easily guess.
Gu Santong was forced into a promise to defend the Imperial Capital and wasn’t even allowed to eat the ingredients he liked so much. How could he be allowed a storage ring then? It would soon be discovered and confiscated if he took it with him.
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Alright, but you best take care and not be so hard on yourself. If you ever find yourself in mortal danger, forget about that promise. Your life is more important!”
“Yes!” Gu Santong smiled brightly.
Zhuo Fan returned his smile and stashed the Qilin leg away.
“By the way, godfather. It’s been five years since I was allowed to leave the Imperial Capital. I need to report back, but where will you go?” At the moment of their separation, Gu Santong still felt reluctant to leave.
Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan put on a diabolical grin, “Since it’s been five years, it’s the right time for the Esoteric Debate to start. I’m going there to liven the mood! Let’s see if those legendary Regent Estate freaks can live up to the expectation, ha-ha-ha...”

chapters.title: Chapter 246, Emergence of Dragons
chapters.content:
Chapter 246, Emergence of Dragons
Drifting Flowers City, at the entrance to the stone room behind Drifting Flowers Edifice. Grandmother, with Iris and Peony Overseer, were waiting. Under the warm sunlight, among the refreshing chirping, they were the only ones whose faces showed no change, their eyes fixed on the stone door.
Rumble!
With a heavy sound, the heavy stone door opened and four figures emerged. The first wore a silk cover, but her delicate figure and her graceful poise couldn’t be hidden. Her eyes were enough to make anyone in the world flustered and intoxicated by her beauty.
And behind her were three old women. They looked calm, but clearly excited.
Chu Bijun’s brow jumped and she sent three silver needles at the woman. But the woman only lifted her delicate hand casually.
A sudden chill came then and a wall of cold mist formed. The three needles rapidly lost speed and ended up falling on the ground into frozen pieces!
Grandmother sighed in praise, “Qingcheng, you’ve greatly improved, as if reborn. If not for neglecting cultivation for the past decade, you’d be no weaker than the other houses’ chosen in the Esoteric Debate!”
Indeed, this person who came out after a long five years of seclusion was Chu Qingcheng. She was no longer as weak as she was five years ago. She was like a towering glacier, worthy of the title Ascending Ice Phoenix!
“You’re too kind, Grandmother! It is all thanks to our three Venerables helping day and night with my training. I am grateful, Venerables!”
Chu Qingcheng slightly bowed at the three old women behind her, and so did Grandmother and the overseers. The Venerables spoke, “It is the least we could do as Drifting Flowers Edifice’s Venerables. Qingcheng’s talent is remarkable, only needing to stimulate her potential. She did the rest!”
The four once again bowed, and the Venerables closed the stone door with a wave. Chu Bijun walked to Chu Qingcheng and looked her up and down.
“8th layer of Profound Heaven Stage, good good! We will show the world the power of Drifting Flowers Edifice in this Esoteric Debate!” Chu Bijun’s eyes shined.
Iris Overseer smiled, “With Qingcheng, we will show them who Drifting Flowers Edifice is. Let’s see them try to take women lightly again!”
“Ha-ha-ha, true, but...” Chu Bijun frowned, “We must also make our standing clear! We must strike at Regent Estate’s arrogance in this Esoteric Debate! Or they will strike back at us many times harder!”
“Yes, that is why, Qingcheng, you must work together with Veiled Dragon Pavilion and Sword Marquise Abode, our two allies. I have talked with them and have reached an agreement!” Iris Overseer said, “As four of your opponents, Pill King Hall, Hell Valley, and Merry Woods, they have all sided with Regent Estate. The Seven Noble Houses are now split in two factions! This is why the Esoteric Debate this time will be so much crueler, so much more savage!”
Chu Qingcheng frowned in worry, “Regent Estate’s monster, Huangpu Qingtian, is hard to deal with already. And now that we are three against four...”
“Ha-ha-ha, don’t worry. It will definitely be four against four. I heard that the Luo clan will be joining in as well. They were but a third rate clan before and must be planning on standing abreast to us by passing the first two rounds of elimination. I wonder though, who’ll they be sending...” Grandmother considered.
Chu Qingcheng’s eyes lit up, “Luo clan will come?”
Already clear on who Chu Qingcheng had her mind on, Grandmother shook her head, “It’s unclear if he will be there as well. He’s been missing for five years already. It is a bad omen. Not even his clansmen know about his whereabouts. So the support we can expect from the Luo clan is minimal!”
“What, he’s gone? How? Why?” Chu Qingcheng didn’t care if the Luo clan helped them, and was only worried about Zhuo Fan. Grandmother shook her head.
[Such deep love is like a poison, making one forget even oneself!]
Iris Overseer sighed, “I heard he was last sighted where Lightning Canyon appeared five years ago. Then, he vanished. We can only assume...”
Chu Qingcheng trembled and shot down that idea, “Impossible, he will be fine!”
Peony Overseer cursed instead, “That foul and ungrateful prick, how does his fate have anything to do with us? He didn’t value your feelings, not one bit!”
Chu Qingcheng’s eyes grew hazy, her heart in a mess. Grandmother spoke gravely, “Qingcheng, whether he comes or not, I hope you will keep your distance from him. I met him once. His ambition is unhealthy, much greater than we can imagine. Such a man is very attractive, but also one who can easily harm women. In his heart, women are burdens. Beings he finds no value in. For your own sake, don’t get too close!”
Chu Qingcheng was silent, alone with the bitterness in her heart.
[But I can no longer go back...]
In another part, deep in Sword Marquise Abode, there lay a stone gate on the verge of opening. Two youths came from within, Xie Tianyang and a youth with white temples. His eyes were cold like a blade.
There was also the on and off flicker in his eyes, but if one looked, he’d feel two sharp swords stabbing him. The pain would be too much to keep one’s eyes focused on him.
He was none other than Sword Marquise Abode’s leading talent, Xie Tianyang’s elder brother, one of the six dragons, Golden Armored Sword Dragon Xie Tianshang!
“Tianshang, Tianyang, you’re out!” Xie Xiaofeng laughed and patted their shoulders.
Xie Tianyang snickered, “Dad, I’ve mastered our house’s entire martial art, Flowing Space’s Nine Forms. I can now marry Ning’er!”
Xie Tianshang gave a curt nod, walking past Xie Xiaofeng and to the training area, “I’m off to practice. Later!”
Xie Xiaofeng felt helpless watching his sons.
The eldest was a martial fanatic, always thinking about training, never getting close with anyone. While the second was a love-struck fool, the only thing on his mind was marriage. If he hadn’t been smart and tricked him into lifting the sword for her, he probably never would’ve had.
Xie Xiaofeng sighed, [It’d be great if they were combined into one!]
Jian Suifeng came from behind, “Abode Lord, don’t worry, Tianyang’s temper will smooth over time. As for Tianshang, he only has one person in mind. He won’t stop until he defeats that person!”
“You mean the Regent Estate’s monster?” Xie Xiaofeng sighed, “Forget it, I don’t want my son to tangle with that monster. It will only bring us shame!”
Jian Suifeng nodded and sighed...
In another part, in the rear gardens of Veiled Dragon Pavilion...
A youth in fine green clothes was taking a walk and showed an infatuated look, “Ah, the air is so much better outside. Bliss!”
“Eldest young master!” Long Jiu rushed over anxious, “When did you get out? Why wasn’t I informed of this?”
“He-he-he, if you had you’d be throwing some congratulatory feast to ruin my mood! It was better to come here and get some peace!” The youth’s smile turned odd, “By the way, Uncle Jiu, what of little Kui and little Jie? How come I don’t see them?”
“Ha-ha-ha, they’re hard at training!”
“Ai, when will they come out?” The youth asked.
With a vague chuckle, Long Jiu said, “Eldest young master, you’ve been in seclusion for a decade. There are many things you have missed! If you’d have witnessed the battle of Drifting Flowers Edifice, you’d have been as stimulated as them!”
“What do you mean?” The youth rose an eyebrow.
But Long Jiu only smiled in response, [Kids these days won’t work hard without a well placed stimulus...]
Similar occurrences happened in the other houses as the Six Dragons and One Phoenix came out of seclusion to join the Esoteric Debate. Especially...
In Caged Dragon City, people gathered outside a secret room on the mountain behind Regent Estate. As the stone gate moved, two people were made known to all. One was a calm youth, his every step at ease and firm. His incredible air made even the Profound Heaven elders step back in shock.
Behind him was High Venerable Huangpu Fenglei with pride in his eyes.
“High Venerable, any progress?” Huangpu Tianyuan asked.
Huangpu Fenglei caressed his beard with a smile, “I oversaw his training personally. He is the pinnacle in the world, second to none!”
“High Venerable, that is hardly the case!”
The youth’s cold tone came in rebuke, “My current self isn’t taught on, only my nature. And father, your words are pointless!”
Shuddering, everyone watched Huangpu Tianyuan speak with such crass and lack of manners. Yet all nodded, [This is the air of a lord!]
Taking a deep breath, Huangpu Tianyuan chuckled, “Seeing you so confident, I won’t ask any further. I believe that in the Esoteric Debate you will bring shock on everyone’s faces. Let them see that Regent Estate’s power shrouds the seven houses!”
“Father, you’re wrong again. I am not confident, just my nature! I do not need to amaze them for Regent Estate to shroud the houses. My very arrival turns it into reality! The unification of the seven houses, that impossible matter, will be completed with my ascension!”
Huangpu Qingtian was calm and someone rushed to put a golden cape over his shoulder. His natural grace and demeanor looked down on every single being.
Even Huangpu Tianyuan felt anger inside. The youth was clearly unfilial.
But this was Regent Estate, and they trained themselves to have lordly flairs. It didn’t matter if the father and son fought over the Estate Lord position, what mattered was the ability to have it! One’s leadership applied to the entire house, even to the Estate Lord.
Leng Wuchang came to Huangpu Tianyuan and bowed, “Eldest young master, it is good to be confident, but one must also be wary in every taken action, lest you’d meet with utter failure!”
“Oh, and where are you going with this?” Huangpu Tianyuan glanced by.
Smiling Leng Wuchang said, “A fiend had recently appeared in Tianyu, by the name of Zhuo Fan. It pushed back the seven houses and killed dozens of our elders. Even the second young master fell victim. I heard he will be joining in the Esoteric Debate. Please remain cautious, eldest young master!”
“Humph, second brother was worthless. He got what he deserved, killed by a nobody. As for those elders, they are even bigger fools! But for that kid to kill so many and still live, that makes you the biggest fools of all! Are you telling me he’s as invincible as that Gu Santong from three hundred years ago?” Huangpu Qingtian snapped coldly.
Leng Wuchang shook his head, “Gu Santong is a monster seen perhaps once a millennia. But he is not like Gu Santong. Gu Santong may be unbridled, but gullible. While that kid’s treachery runs deep, expert at gathering people to stand by his side. The reason why we’ve failed to get his head is because three houses have formed an alliance with him. He is also relying on one of the Four Pillars, War God Dugu Zhantian and even the imperial family is protecting him. Our hands were tied...”
“Oh, a schemer you say?” Shaking his head, Huangpu Qingtian said, “Fine then, since you’re all so worthless, I will personally end that man in the Esoteric Debate!”
“Eldest young master, please exercise extreme caution. Every single one that has underestimated the kid has died in agony!”
Leng Wuchang bowed, but his words earned a snort from Huangpu Qingtian, “Sir Leng, I admire your talent greatly, but please, do not lump me together with you fools! By the way, once I have that kid’s head, the title of Estate Lord... Oh, father, isn’t it about time for you to step down?”
Trembling, Huangpu Tianyuan’s face was a mask of darkness and rage!
This was his ‘good’ son, the strongest talent in the seven houses, the head of the six dragons, one that at this crucial time, was only thinking of how to snatch his father’s position, the Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord Huangpu Qingtian...

chapters.title: Chapter 247, The Biggest Underdog
chapters.content:
Chapter 247, The Biggest Underdog
June 22, 2021
<<Previous ChapterIndexNext Chapter>>
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Silavin
Five months later, at the Imperial Capital, the Emperor was reviewing reports in the study.
Suddenly, a black figure knelt at his side. Hands cupped in respect, black figure spoke “Your Majesty, Dragon Cloud City’s report on the Luo clan has come!”
“Deliver!”
The Emperor spoke, but didn’t spare the man a glance. The man offered the report with both hands.
The Emperor took one glance at it and threw it back into the man’s face, “Every damn report over the past five years has been either all quiet or all normal! The Luo clan is set to make waves in the Esoteric Debate, but where is that Bone Tempering Stage kid? How the hell are you even getting your intelligence?”
“Please sooth your anger, Your Majesty! I’ve been at fault!” The man was on the ground in a blink, shaking like a leaf.
The Emperor caressed his beard, but the fire in his eyes was like a smoldering volcano. Oddly enough, he soon restored his calm.
Yet this only worked to instill greater fear in the man’s bones!
“Is there anything on that Zhuo Fan?” The emperor’s tone was cold.
The man shook his head, “Nothing, Your Majesty!”
“And what of Divine Dragon Gu Santong?” The emperor followed.
The man was on the verge of tears, “Unknown, Your Majesty!”
“You’ve been searching for five years but can’t find anything about Zhuo Fan. That rampant guy Gu Santong must still be stirring trouble somewhere and yet you can’t even find a trace of him! Humph, why am I even raising you worthless mongrels? You can’t do anything!” The Emperor’s eyes flashed with bloodthirst.
The man kowtowed three times, pleading, “Your Majesty, please quell your anger. I am incompetent! Please spare me!”
“Out!” The Emperor flicked his sleeve.
The man kowtowed three more times and bolted, “Thank you, Your Majesty, thank you...”
The Emperor took a deep breath and lifted his head, “Gu Santong and Zhuo Fan are missing. Can this piece of information even be trusted? Did they perish in the Lightning Canyon?
“It’s fine if Gu Santong is gone from this world. It might actually be a blessing! But Zhuo Fan? He is yet to fulfill his task. His death would be such a waste! But this boy brings too many surprises. He lifted up a wretched third rate clan to one that is brimming with power! A miracle really! But I just can’t tell if the Luo clan can still complete the task without Zhuo Fan, ha-ha-ha...”
The Emperor chuckled quite cheerfully, like a sly rogue.
Just then, a guard fell to his knees before the emperor, “Your Majesty, Divine Dragon Gu Santong has returned!”
Ugh!
The laughter came to a grunting stop, and the emperor sighed, “Understood!” But his good mood was gone.
[Ah, the worst trouble is yet to come...]
Meanwhile, before the great gates of a city, a familiar figure appeared. He looked up and read the imposing words on the wall, Dragon Cloud City.
Rumor had it that the imperial family, Yuwen clan’s efforts to raise an army to found the empire in historic times all began from this place. As such, every single Esoteric Debate was held here.
“I got held up for too long in the Lightning Canyon. I hope I made it in time. Hope those guys didn’t get themselves wiped out again!” Zhuo Fan sighed under his black cloak as he entered the city.
There were soldiers all around the city, but that did not stop anyone from milling about.
This city afterall was a gathering place of the empire’s most distinguished houses and clans. Everyone was free to come and go or even join the Esoteric Debate if they wished.
But the army was tasked with breaking any conflicts among these clans, most of all among the seven houses. Once a fight broke out, it was easy to plunge the entire empire into unrest.
This made the soldiers stationed here ready to act at a moment’s notice.
The only one in the whole empire able to shake the seven houses was none other than the second of the Four Pillars and Tianyu’s Marshal, God of War, Dugu Zhantian!
Though meeting this big man was the last thing on Zhuo Fan’s mind.
Inside the city, Zhuo Fan was shocked. The place was packed, like a sea of people. It was more packed than Drifting Flowers City at the time of the Hundred Pill Meeting!
Then again, how many clans did the Hundred Pill Meeting attract? The Esoteric Debate, however, drew in all the clans that hoped for a swift rise to fame and power. The difference was obvious.
He didn’t have the time to let the sights distract him. His top priority was to get back to the Luo clan and ascertain the situation.
But only after a few steps, a ruckus entered his ears. “Windgaze City’s Luo clan has landed their 27th win, advancing into the second rate clans’ finals and becoming this Esoteric Debate’s biggest underdog! “
Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan looked towards the speaker but only found a small tavern. So he stepped in to learn more.
The thick smell of wine and clamor struck his face the moment he stepped in. Some guys with bare arms were shouting and waving their fists around, god only knew why.
There was a betting table in the tavern and a score table on the far wall had the name of every clan on it. People at the table were constantly placing bets.
Of course, not everyone was betting.
Zhuo Fan saw that the board had the seven houses’ names on it as well as their representative genius.
“Ascending Ice Phoenix – Drifting Flowers Edifice, Forest Fleeting Dragon – Merry Woods, Golden Armored Sword Dragon – Sword Marquise Abode...” Zhuo Fan muttered every word, but then he screamed, “Soaring Demonic Dragon – Blackwind Mountain? Who the hell came up with this?”
The dealer from the table saw Zhuo Fan amazed and smirked, “Hey dummy, what hole did you crawl out of? Haven’t you ever heard of Windgaze City’s Luo clan on Blackwind Mountain? Of their Soaring Demonic Dragon Zhuo Fan?”
Zhuo Fan’s mouth was agape. He scratched his head, [When did this Soaring Black Dragon stuff get started?]
Seeing his puzzlement, the dealer sighed, “You’re really ignorant! When Demon Archon Zhuo Fan wrecked Drifting Flowers City, everyone and their uncles learnt about him! Now that we know he represents the Luo clan in the Esoteric Debate, of course he stands on par with the Six Dragons and One Phoenix. This is why people call him Soaring Demonic Dragon. Apparently, it is the name of the martial art he used!”
“Bullshit!”
A buffed guy started arguing, “Complete and utter bullshit! The Demon Archon Zhuo Fan did use the Soaring Demonic Dragon in Drifting Flowers City to kill Regent Estate’s second young master, but his nickname has a totally different meaning! His Soaring Demonic Dragon title implies that he wants to break through to Heaven, and challenge the seven houses’ thousand year long authority! You know nothing! So don’t go about talking rubbish!”
Zhuo Fan nodded, finding this second explanation far more plausible.
[God damn it! Who the hell dares to say that Heaven stands above me? I’ll rip them to pieces! This is more my style. Ha-ha-ha, yours truly likes Soaring Demonic Dragon!]
But his joy ended as soon as the dealer barked back, “Cut the crap! Demon Archon Zhuo Fan may be great, but do you think he has it in him to contest the seven houses? The seven houses’ status in Tianyu has been unshaken for a thousand years. Haven’t you heard? Luo clan has the Sword Marquise Abode, Veiled Dragon Pavilion and Drifting Flowers Edifice backing them! I reckon that even if the Luo clan climbs high enough to enter the fight between the seven houses, it will only fight as a vassal clan of the three houses!”
Bam!
Zhuo Fan slapped the table, his face twisted in grimace, “Who the hell told you that Luo clan is their vassal? Get your head straight, Luo clan will become an independent clan, competing on the same level as the seven houses. It will not cower behind some other house for safety! Just wait and watch!”
The two looked at Zhuo Fan puzzled. [What’s his connection with the Luo clan? Why is he so fired up in protecting this underdog?]
But they didn’t have the time to talk back and curse Zhuo Fan for being a mental case as an aged voice laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, indeed. Luo clan should aim for the best clan and challenge the unwritten rule that has held on for millennia. If not, like every single time, the Esoteric Debate would end with only the seven houses competing. Wouldn’t that be too boring? “
Shuddering, Zhuo Fan looked back to see three elders. Every one of them was wearing a cloak to hide their features.
The elder in the middle revealed his piercing eyes and grinned, “Steward Zhuo, I’ve long wished to meet you my soul brother! I am Prime Minister Zhuge Changfeng. Care to join me for a chat?”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes widened and he looked at him deeply.
He never thought that the head of the Four Pillars, Zhuge Changfeng would personally grace him with his presence! Glancing at the two elders on his sides, from their mighty aura, he could tell they were rare experts.
With a deep breath, Zhuo Fan nodded. Zhuge Changfeng grinned and made a flourish. The two then walked side by side to a table.
The two elders stood behind Zhuge Changfeng and their eyes flashed, sending an energy to envelop the table. The noise around them slowly ceased and their words were never heard by the people outside.
Yet to the untrained eye, the four looked like they were having a casual chat. The dealer and the big man looked baffled for a minute and then ignored them.
Zhuo Fan was shocked and became wary of the two elders. No average Radiant Stage expert could just set up a barrier so casually. Not even a peak one!
The two must’ve trained in some special cultivation method. They weren’t to be taken lightly.
Thinking about Zhuge Changfeng, he may only be in the 2nd layer of the Profound Heaven Stage, but he was surrounded by many powerful people. He was a man no one from the seven houses dared underestimate.
His name as the head of the Four Pillars was well deserved...

chapters.title: Chapter 248, Wise Men’s Talk
chapters.content:
Chapter 248, Wise Men’s Talk
“Steward Zhuo, you must be wondering why I was looking for you.” Zhuge Changfeng’s beard trembled.
Zhuo Fan nodded, but his only reply was a fixed stare.
Zhuge Changfeng held him in greater admiration.
In fact, just by answering, Zhuo Fan would’ve fallen in his trap. Regardless of the content, Zhuo Fan’s reply would’ve given him the rights to lead the conversation and, ultimately, Zhuo Fan by the nose.
But Zhuo Fan kept silent, thus keeping his right to speak.
It may be some minor detail, but to a leader of Zhuge Changfeng’s stature, it was very important. Right of speech translated into power. If one’s right to speak was taken away, then that person was at a disadvantage.
On this aspect, Zhuge Changfeng was an expert, and he admired Zhuo Fan’s response greatly, “Steward Zhuo, your rumors do not do you justice. I am in awe after meeting you!”
“Prime-minister Zhuge is exaggerating. Your illustrious name has given me far more shock!” Zhuo Fan laughed.
Zhuge Changfeng sighed, “Wise men speak plainly. Let us dispense with the tricks. Or we’ll be at it for three days and still not finish.”
“Ha-ha-ha, Prime-minister Zhuge is quite open so I shall do the same!” Zhuo Fan nodded cheerfully.
Zhuge Changfeng went straight to the point, “Steward Zhuo, I fear that someone may have instigated the Luo clan’s participation in the Esoteric Debate.”
“Oh, what makes you say that?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow.
Zhuge Changfeng replied, “We are both men who look at things from all perspectives. I am certain that with you as its steward, Luo clan’s rise beyond the seven houses would only be a matter of time. But your coming out in the open has been far too soon. With Steward Zhuo’s cunning, I believe you are not a man looking for short term gain. I surmise that you’ve been forced, or perhaps, lured into a choice that you could not refuse!”
Zhuo Fan was impressed.
[Zhuge Changfeng is amazing, able to understand everything.] Indeed, Luo clan jumping into the Esoteric Debate and starting a fight with the seven houses was far too soon.
Earlier he was quite pleased with Luo clan’s power, but even he couldn’t be as bold as to declare that this fight was a sure win!
He chose this situation so he wouldn’t lose the imperial family’s support, or worse, offend them instead.
Saying that he was lured was accurate. Forced? Also correct. These assumptions were both correct. Above all, Luo clan’s power coming out in the open at this moment allowed Zhuge Changfeng, possibly the only person in the empire, to surmise that Luo clan would one day surpass the seven houses.
This guess couldn’t be called brazen, but calamitous!
And Zhuo Fan was hoping to see the day when Luo clan would reach such a level. But now, no one out there would ever believe it, except Zhuge Changfeng.
Even Zhuo Fan had to admire his foresight. If it were anywhere else, even he wouldn’t make such an absurd guess!
“Head of the Four Pillars, Prime-minister Zhuge is truly wise. I admire you!” Zhuo Fan’s flattery was sincere.
Zhuge Changfeng chuckled, “Steward Zhuo is too kind. This old bag of bones has been soaked in this world for far too many years, thus gaining some thoughts about its revolutions. I fall utterly short to young Steward Zhuo wisdom. Carrying on your shoulders, the honor of the entire clan, you’ve earned my respect, ha-ha-ha...”
“Then Prime Minister Zhuge is saying...”
“To watch your back!” Zhuge Changfeng’s eyes shined, his voice solemn.
Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan looked a little lost.
Clearly knowing his heart, Zhuge Changfeng chuckled, “I can tell what Steward Zhuo is thinking. Yes, my words are full of suspicion. Who on earth would be so selfless, so caring for their fellow neighbor? And yes, I have a reason. But rest assured, Steward Zhuo, you are not my enemy. In fact, he may very well be yours too!”
“Oh, care to elaborate?” Zhuo Fan started.
Zhuge Changfeng twirled his white mustache, his eyes shining, “I am sure Steward Zhuo is more than familiar with the saying, when two fight the third wins. So will you be among the first two, or the third?”
Zhuge Changfeng shook his head, “I’m sure the wise Steward Zhuo has caught on my meaning by now!”
Scratching his nose, Zhuo Fan looked him in the eye and showed a broad smile.
Zhuge Changfeng read his intent, and only smiled in reply.
The two shared a smile full of countless implications, and nodded.
“Ha-ha-ha, talking with smart guys is so refreshing and easy! Steward Zhuo, I have said my piece and I’ll be leaving. But before I do, please be kind enough to fulfil this selfish request of mine and explain something to me.” Zhuge Changfeng rose to his feet and cupped his hands.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “I don’t see why not.”
“I am the Empire’s Prime Minister, Leng Wuchang is the Regent Estate’s steward, and you sir are Luo clan’s steward. This makes the three of us cut from the same cloth, with each of us scheming and lording over people. Myself and Leng Wuchang are both selfish, and luckily our interests are shared for now, and not set on a colliding path. But considering your talent, why would you pick the Luo clan? I can tell that sir is not doing this out of sympathy, or any kind of feelings. It... escapes my capacity to understand!”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes trembled and he took a deep breath, before showing a crafty smile and emphasizing every word, “Because my ambition is far greater than yours!”
The head of the Four Pillars, for the first time, trembled and his fists clenched.
The Yin Yang elders saw this and for the first time looked at Zhuo Fan with shock and ill intent. The thick bloodthirst they oozed couldn’t be concealed.
But Zhuo Fan was still composed, only his right eye flashing golden.
“Wait!”
On the brink of war, Zhuge Changfeng put a stop to the hostilities. The elders calmed down and Zhuo Fan relaxed.
But Zhuge Changfeng was perplexed and said to Zhuo Fan, “I may not know the extent of sir’s ambition, but I nevertheless look forward to that day, and hope that it won’t all come crashing down instead.”
Zhuge Changfeng signaled the two elders and left.
A good distance from the tavern, one elder snorted, “Prime Minister, why did you stop us? His words were far too rude!”
“No, I don’t think that was mere boasting!” Zhuge Changfeng furrowed his brow, “However, what is his aim? With his ability, it’s only a matter of time before he becomes an overlord. But instead he chooses to be bogged down by that burden, Luo clan. To what end? Sigh, this kid is the first one I cannot see through!”
The Yin Yang elders shared a glance but didn’t say anything, in fear of disturbing him. But for some reason, Zhuge Changfeng was frowning constantly, leaving the elders at a loss.
[When were the rash words of some pup ever of any value?]
In another part of Dragon Cloud City, at the largest fighting stage, thunderous applause resounded!
On the stage, Luo Yunchang’s tall figure breathed heavily. Her lithe and demure figure, wrapped tightly in clothes, painted a fine picture. Every man there was drooling at her curves!
Even more so when those beads of sweat worked to emphasize her enticing body lines!
But her 5th layer of Bone Tempering cultivation cut short any errant and lustful desire. Just now, the young lady had dispatched four 4th layer Bone Tempering experts, while she herself remained unharmed.
Next to her stood a cold youth of about sixteen and in the 3rd layer of Bone Tempering Stage. Despite his young age, he was famed throughout the empire.
Marshal Dugu’s fifth godson, Tianyu’s Five Tiger’s youngest, Swooping Dragonic Tiger, Luo Yunhai. Everyone and their uncles had heard of him. Being at Dugu Zhantian’s side and fighting next to his four brothers for more than two years, he had proven himself in battles becoming a real man of valor.
Circling them were ten people around Luo Yunhai’s age, but their eyes held a far more staunch look. They released constant dark energy and their iron forged bodies glowed.
They were of similar cultivation, but in a true life or death fight, they could render peak Bone Tempering experts heavily wounded, if not outright dead.
They were the Luo clan’s guards that Zhuo Fan entrusted Captain Pang with training.
This was only the tip of the iceberg and even the guards were enough to strike fear in many.
The thought of seeing these monsters fully grown sent chills down the crowd’s spine. And to avoid people acting in fear and envy, the Luo clan chose to only bring these ten youths.
If others had known that Luo clan would raise so many freaks and still hide their cards, they’d have long snuffed it in the cradle.
Regardless of the what ifs, Luo clan had nevertheless caused widespread shock to all who bore witness to this obscure clan.
Just now, these Luo clan’s 12 fought with a renowned second rate clan’s hundred. Yet none of them was injured heavily even when the opposition had peak Bone Tempering experts among them.
This forced people to see Luo clan in a different and frightening light.
Not to mention Luo clan’s strongest had yet to take the stage. That rumored Soaring Demonic Dragon, how outrageous was he?

chapters.title: Chapter 249, In Sights
chapters.content:
Chapter 249, In Sights
“The Victory of this second rate clan battle goes to the Luo clan!”
A Profound Heaven stage expert in a robe flew on stage and gestured at Luo clan’s 12.
The crowd broke out in a thunderous applause.
“This is Luo clan’s 28th win. I cannot believe they are a third rate clan!”
“Yeah, and their best man is yet to appear as well. People say their steward, Zhuo Fan, is on the same level as the Six Dragons and One Phoenix. He is hailed as Tianyu’s seventh dragon, Soaring Demonic Dragon!”
“What? If Luo clan is so strong, why haven’t I heard of it? Why is it stuck being a third rate clan?”
“......”
People displayed immense shock in the stands, while many were whispering about the mysterious power behind such a strong underdog.
Meanwhile, a few familiar faces stood at the highest point in the stands. The veterans of the martial world would instantly recognize these shocking figures.
Weren’t they the seven houses’ representatives, Six Dragons and One Phoenix?
“Ha-ha-ha, what third rate clan? That brat duped us! Even facing a top second rate clan they won cleanly. If this was a third rate clan, who would be a second rate one? Right, Ning’er?”
The woman was none other than Xue Ningxiang, from the newest Sword Marquise Abode’s vassal clan, the Xue clan.
She wasn’t paying attention to Xie Tianyang however, having eyes fixed on the stage, “Why isn’t big brother Zhuo here? Isn’t he joining?”
“Ning’er, why do you always have to mention him? It hurts!” Xie Tianyang’s mood went sour.
Xie Tianshang sitting next to them, sheathed his cold blade in the scabbard and said, “It seems the rumor is true. The Soaring Demonic Dragon is no longer a part of this world!”
“What rumor?” Xue Ningxiang was anxious.
Xie Tianshang spoke coldly, “Five years ago, they say Zhuo Fan chanced upon Lightning Canyon and is buried there. What a pity, I really hoped to meet such a highly praised man. Now I can no longer see his strength for myself...”
“Brother!” Xie Tianyang cut him off but it was far too late. The damage was done.
Xue Ningxiang’s tears threatened to burst as she shook her head, “Nonsense, big brother Zhuo can’t be dead...”
“Uh, Ning’er, calm down. He’s only missing. No one has found his body yet...”
Xie Tianyang was trying to patch things up but Ning’er glared, “Brother Tianyang, why didn’t you tell me?”
Xie Tianyang sighed, “I didn’t want to see you so sad...”
“Ha-ha-ha, just for that? You should’ve told her sooner rather than prolong the agony! Don’t you know that prolonged longing will only make a woman’s pain deeper?”
The three looked back to see Long Jie and Long Kui along with an exuberant youth walking up to them.
Squinting, Xie Tianshang’s scabbard crackled in his hand, “Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s Abyss Dragon, Long Xingyun! We finally meet.”
“Please don’t. We’re all allies here. Don’t pull your sword at our first meeting!” Long Xingyun noticed Xie Tianshang’s thirst for battle and waved frantically.
Xie Tianshang snorted and tightened his grip on the hilt of his sword, suppressing his battle lust, “Humph, sorry. I can’t help but want to pit myself against an expert when I meet them. Please disregard my rudeness!”
Long Xingyun was sweating. He had heard of this martial fanatic, but he didn’t think his illness was so serious. [You aren’t going to go after me after chopping the enemy, are you?]
Sighing, Long Xingyun turned to the Luo clan on stage, “I’ve heard of the Soaring Demonic Dragon Zhuo Fan’s resounding name and hoped to see him. A shame I will never have the chance!”
“Why do you say that? You also believe big brother Zhuo is dead? His body hasn’t been found!” Ning’er shouted.
Shaking his head, Long Xingyun turned solemn, “The lives that Lightning Canyon robs are left without a corpse. If his fortune was the same as Uncle Jiu, surviving that disaster, he would most likely appear here. But after 28 fights, he is still missing. The first 27 fights were nothing, but the last one was only won by using all they had, even if they were unharmed. If he didn’t appear even now when it matters the most, I fear he’s gone from this world!”
Shuddering, Xue Ningxiang was far from just believing this, but her heart knew the truth. With everyone around telling her so, she couldn’t help but think the same as well.
And this only worked to make the pain worse.
Xie Tianyang clenched his fists and bit his lip, hating himself for being powerless.
“By the way, do you guys think that the Luo clan without Zhuo Fan is worth being our ally?” Long Xingyun suddenly spoke.
Xie Tianshang shuddered and spoke, “In my eyes, ally or whatever doesn’t matter. Whether they are worthy of a challenge or not matters!”
“Ha-ha-ha, that’s a martial fanatic for you!” Long Xingyun laughed and admired him.
Xie Tianyang was glum, “I don’t care what you think. Me and Zhuo Fan are brothers and even if he isn’t here, I hope to see Luo clan leave this place safely!”
“Uh, second young master sure is milder among the two!” Long Xingyun smiled, “But Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s ally is Zhuo Fan. Without him around, the agreement is void. Whether the Luo clan can hold on to the agreement, it will rest solely on their performance. I fear, however, that they will never achieve it.”
Long Xingyun gestured to the front, “Look, without the care of that demonic dragon, most of the savage dragons have them in their sights. Second young master, are you capable of stealing the dinner from the claws of those savage dragons?”
Xie Tianyang’s group turned to look in shock.
Four figures suddenly showed up across from them!
“Hell Valley’s Specter Dragon, You Yushan!” Xie Tianshang’s eyes trembled at the sight of a man in grey.
“Merry Woods’s Forest Fleeting Dragon, Lin Xuanfeng!” Xie Tianyang looked at another gravely.
“And also Pill King Hall’s Plague Dragon, Yan Bangui!” Long Xingyun pointed at a youth with half a face purple, “They say he went insane cultivating his poison and this is the result. And with his poisonous constitution, even without Yan Song or Yan Fu’s achievements in alchemy, his mastery of poisons far exceeds Vicious Pill King’s. He is a fearful man!
“But, far from the strongest!”
Long Xingyun’s face turned grave and even a hint of fear was present as he gestured at the last man, “The real monster, Regent Estate’s Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord, Huangpu Qingtian, is present as well!”
Ka!
A sharp sound came from Xie Tianshang’s scabbard, his eyes glinting.
Long Xingyun smiled dejectedly, [This martial fanatic, does he not know what dreadful existence that man is? How is he so eager to challenge him at first glance?]
[I just can’t tell if these blockhead allies of mine are a blessing or a calamity!]
Meanwhile, Huangpu Qingtian’s four also glanced their way but were calm as water. Even Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes only spared them a cursory glance.
“That Zhuo Fan still hasn’t shown himself!” Huangpu Qingtian stared at the Luo clan.
Lin Xuanfeng giggled, “Eldest young master, are you that eager to smash someone?”
“No, I’m only curious why Sir Leng holds him in such high regard!” Huangpu Qingtian crossed his arms, “This world is yet to see a man worthy of my attention. I hope that kid would make an exception!”
“He-he-he, Eldest young master is truly a hero among heroes. You must really want to fight that kid!”
Lin Xuanfeng jumped right in with his ass kissing, only to get a sharp look from Huangpu Qingtian in return, “Lin Xuanfeng, watch your tongue. This world doesn’t have anyone worthy fighting with either. Only some temporary targets need destroying! I only want to see if that man is worthy of killing him myself. If he can’t even amount to that, he will be left to you guys to handle!”
Lin Xuanfeng shivered and nodded.
The other two sneered, [This brat is usually crafty, but this time’s ass kissing only reached the feet! He-he-he...]
Picking up on the two’s mockery, Lin Xuanfeng’s felt rage inside. Then his eyes lit up and proposed, “Eldest young master, why don’t I test the Luo clan. Zhuo Fan is bound to show up then. And if he doesn’t, we’ll simply end them.”
“Do it!”
Huangpu Qingtian’s curt nod cut him off. Then the other laughed as he vanished.
Xie Tianshang’s group watching from afar was also gone. Huangpu Qingtian paused, “You two go as well. Perhaps the six dragons’ fight will happen earlier!”
“Understood!”
The two glanced at each other and were gone, leaving only Huangpu Qingtian standing alone with a sharp gaze.
This was all in response to Leng Wuchang’s judgment of this time’s Esoteric Debate. It may just be a guess, but was enough to make this man take it seriously.
Because Leng Wuchang had never said something like this to him ever before.
That implication of not wanting to see Zhuo Fan was a lie! As a man of great power himself, even if conceited, he had to make things clear. Only by snuffing out the cradle would allow ultimate peace to descend...

chapters.title: Chapter 250, Picking a Fight
chapters.content:
Chapter 250, Picking a Fight
“Young miss, young master, good work!”
The people began commending the shocking power of the Luo clan’s 12 with a round of applause as they left the stage. Captain Pang rushed over and expressed his thanks as well for the two’s work, watching them with great regret.
If only he was younger, he would be joining and fighting alongside them as well.
Luo Yunchang nodded, not able to speak from how weary she was.
Captain Pang didn’t dally any more and led them to a bench to rest. He then turned to the ten guards with praise, “You’ve done well today. I will surely remember it!”
The ten youths nodded, but their faces showed not a twitch, as if they were frozen in time.
Luo Yunhai panted and sighed as well, “Captain Pang, just how did you train them? These young guards are even more dauntless than most people I’ve seen in the army.”
“He-he-he, young master, there are some things you don’t know. These guys are trained by me according to Steward Zhuo’s training regimen. He said that great soldiers are good when fighting back, but these fellows are men willing to lay down their lives for the Luo clan when it matters the most.”
Captain Pang sputtered with great pride the feats of these kids. But then he froze and looked at the silent Luo Yunchang in distress.
Luo Yunchang’s hand tightened and her eyes glistened in tears.
Luo Yunhai glared at Captain Pang, “We asked about their training, so why are you talking about sacrifice...”
Captain Pang slapped himself till he was red, then cursed, “It’s my rotten mouth to blame for making young miss feel such sorrow again.”
“Captain Pang, I don’t blame you.”
Luo Yunchang stopped him from blaming himself, “Five years without so much as a word. Elder Li did say that he is definitely alive, but from the look on his face, not even he believed those words. If he were still alive, there was bound to be some news at this point, not total silence.”
Tears started trailing down her cheeks.
Luo Yunhai felt her pain as Captain Pang sighed, not knowing how to reply. The Luo clan didn’t want to accept Zhuo Fan’s death, but they had no choice in the matter.
At that time, the entire clan was in mourning.
How did that saying go? Misery loves company. Their so called allies had changed their stance, and their support was waning.
They were abandoned when the clan needed the most help.
Many times Luo Yunchang wished to show the world their Radiant Stage experts. Zhuo Fan was gone, but the clan still held strong.
Luo clan had the power to face the seven houses!
But Luo Yunchang was reminded every single time of Zhuo Fan’s decisive stance, of keeping their cards hidden even from one’s allies. This made her snuff out that reckless thought.
She thus burned with even more desire, to prove to them who Luo clan was, in the Esoteric Debate. Especially to their allies, that they are worthy of their constant support.
No matter what, she had to lead the Luo clan into the final battle.
Taking a deep breath, Luo Yunchang wiped her tears and steeled her will. She stood up, “Come, Grand Elder is waiting for us!”
Luo Yunhai and Captain Pang looked startled at the leaving delicate figure.
With Zhuo Fan gone the past half a decade, and Luo Yunhai in the army, all the weight of the clan rested on the young miss’ shoulders. And the talks with their allies were the most taxing.
She didn’t have Zhuo Fan’s cunning, nor his brashness. But on this path, her weak and fearful self slowly rose to the challenge, meeting the houses head on. Within the fake civility, with all that back and forth, she grew to be an imposing figure.
But only she knew the taunts, mocking, and misery she had to endure.
Sighing, Captain Pang and Luo Yunhai followed after her. The three soon arrived with the ten guards at the exit of the fighting stage.
Lei Yuntian was there waiting for them, along with the Profound Heaven fakes.
“Yunhai, Yunchang, congratulations! You won 28 times in a row!” Lei Yuntian cupped his hands.
Luo Yunchang raised an eyebrow, “Uncle Lei, you knew we’d won even when you were outside?”
“Of course. With such a resounding applause, how could I not know? I’ve heard it so many times these days that my ears have swollen. Ha-ha-ha...” Lei Yuntian was cheerful.
Luo Yunchang chuckled as well as they walked with him to their accommodations.
“Uncle Lei, how about we make a different sound tomorrow, since your ears are swollen?”
“No need. I like this one very much, ha-ha-ha...”
They talked with the setting sun behind them, cheerful about tomorrow’s victory. Among the ten young guards behind them there were also the Profound Heaven fakers.
Their power wasn’t much to talk about. Even one of the young guards could finish them off. But that swag and pose had their intended purpose, to shock and awe the bystanders.
[Holy hell, the Luo clan is truly an underdog. They raised 20 Profound Heaven experts! They are as strong as the seven houses.]
Though none realized, looks could be deceiving. These elders were paper tigers, mere toys to scare children. But just as Fang Qiubai said before, showing them off was their strongest suit...
Whoosh~
Suddenly, a breeze passed by Luo Yunchang’s charming figure. She felt her ear and her face changed!
“What’s wrong, Yunchang?’ Lei Yuntian asked.
Luo Yunchang was confused, “M-my earring’s gone!”
“Sister, did you lose it?” Luo Yunhai looked around and shouted, “Everyone, my sister lost her earring. Please help us find it!”
They all started looking around for the young miss’ earring.
Just then, a funny laughter reached them, “Ha-ha-ha, idiots, here it is!”
Ding~
A sharp ringing sound was heard and they all looked in the direction of a creepy man in robes holding an earring.
Luo Yunchang cried, “T-that’s mine!”
“Merry Woods’s Forest Fleeting Dragon, Lin Xuanfeng!” Luo Yunchang was quite shocked.
All eyes were now on that man. Was this one of the strongest disciples in Tianyu, one of Six Dragons and One Phoenix, Forest Fleeting Dragon?
The cheerful mood had long been replaced with heavy silence. Even those twenty Profound Heaven fakes felt their scalps go numb. These guys were no match for the Six Dragons and One Phoenix. Even if they weren’t fakes.
Even among Profound Heaven experts, the Six Dragons and One Phoenix were the best.
Why was this Lin Xuanfeng suddenly approaching them? Was he picking a fight? [What are you doing picking a fight with us? Aren’t you from the seven houses, aren’t you afraid of shaming yourself?]
This was on everyone’s mind.
Lin Xuanfeng looked at Luo Yunhai in provocation, “Such a remarkable godson that old guy Dugu Zhantian has gained. You recognized me with just one look?”
“Of course. We may be soldiers, but the godfather has told us about the renowned figures in Tianyu.” Luo Yunhai straightened his back and shouted, “And you? What do you think you’re doing? This is Dragon Cloud City and it is time for the Esoteric Debate. The houses and clans are forbidden from making a ruckus. Are you challenging Marshal Dugu’s order and is that why you’re blocking our way?”
“He-he-he, stop scaring people with that old guy’s name. I’m not everyone!” Lin Xuanfeng mocked, “Kid, do you know why the old man told you about Tianyu’s strongest? It was to warn you that even he can’t offend some people. It was something for you to watch out for. That order is for the average clans only, not for us, the seven houses.”
Luo Yunhai seethed from anger, “You dare to openly go against his order? See when I report to Marshal and he puts you in your place!”
“Ha-ha-ha, you gullible pup. I just told you, that old man won’t interfere!”
Laughing, Lin Xuanfeng flashed right in front of Luo Yunchang in the next blink. He took in her perfume, shook her other earring, and snickered, “Gorgeous, mind spending the night with me?”
Blushing, Luo Yunchang’s face was a mask of anger as she sent a slap, “Pervert!”
Whoosh~
Lin Xuanfeng was back to his original place before the slap made contact, “Ha-ha-ha, this is all Luo clan amounts to? You could not even find someone good enough to touch my clothes, but you dare showing off in Dragon Cloud City?”
“Men, together!” Lei Yuntian snapped.
His cultivation was now in the 5th layer of the Profound Heaven Stage, reaching Lin Xuanfeng in a blink and striking with his finger.
As for those Profound Heaven fakes, they had no choice but to join as well.
In the face of the incoming finger, Lin Xuanfeng only grinned. Then the oddest thing happened.
He vanished into thin air and the 20 Profound Heaven fakes behind Lei Yuntian were knocked out one at a time.
Lin Xuanfeng then returned to his spot, but Lin Xuanfeng’s finger still hadn’t arrived. He let out a bored yawn and with a light grip, snuffed out the lightning on the finger, “Too slow, I’ve already finished fighting!”
Lin Xuanfeng’s kick sent Lei Yuntian flying.
Spurting blood, Lei Yuntian fell before the siblings. Only now did the 20 Profound Heaven fakes collapsed, actually lasting a second more than Lei Yuntian.
They had long been knocked out!
Such speed!
Gasping, Luo Yunhai’s face turned solemn. He knew Lin Xuanfeng was fast, but even he didn’t think it’d be to this extent. It was as if he defied the laws of time and space.
He didn’t catch any of Lin Xuanfeng’s movements, and it looked as if he had always been standing there. But he knew that Lin Xuanfeng had put everyone out of commission in a flash.
Without a second thought, Luo Yunhai jumped in front of his sister. Luo Yunchang was solemn as well, glancing at Captain Pang and getting ready to face their great enemy.
The power of the six dragons wasn’t something they could contend with. They were all wishing from the bottom of their hearts that that person would come. Ironically, this was where the both side’s thoughts aligned, with Lin Xuanfeng hoping for the same thing.

chapters.title: Chapter 251, Dragon and Phoenix Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 251, Dragon and Phoenix Battle
“Is the Soaring Demonic Dragon truly dead? I mean, this would never have happened if he wasn’t. Unless of course he is the biggest coward out there!” Giving others a mocking glance, he punctuated with a sneer.
Luo Yunchang’s heart trembled. [He’s after Zhuo Fan!] The guy assumed Zhuo Fan was watching from the shadows around here somewhere and decided to stage this play to draw him out.
When in fact the reality was much much crueler. Zhuo Fan wasn’t even here to begin with.
The Luo clan wallowed in mourning and Luo Yunchang snapped back in indignation, “Since when did an outsider get the rights to butt into the affairs of our steward?”
“Ha, looks like you hold Zhuo Fan in quite a high regard! Although, would it even make that much of a difference if he were here? A nobody who some no-name clans call Soaring Demonic Dragon, one who can barely stand up to our level, the level of the Six Dragons and One Phoenix, doesn’t deserve my attention!”
With a spark of cruelty in his eyes, Lin Xuanfeng flashed right in front of Luo Yunchang’s face.
The group jerked back in fright. [He’s so fast! Too fast!] They didn’t even sense him move.
Especially Lei Yuntian, who sucked in a cold breath. Both were of an equal stage in strength, that of the Profound Heaven. And common knowledge told him a difference in speed could exist but not to the extent of a gulf. Yet Lin Xuanfeng’s brazen display proved that the six dragons were in a league of their own, even if they were only Profound Heaven experts.
Snickering, Lin Xuanfeng touched the smooth and delicate chin of the frightened Luo Yunchang, “Young miss Luo, if we were to take this somewhere private, wouldn’t that Steward Zhuo end up working under me in the end? Are you willing to come along?”
“Don’t touch my sister!”
Luo Yunhai snapped, sending a flying kick at him. Lei Yuntian and Captain Pang joined him by punching.
Lei Yuntian flickered like lightning while the dark energy around Captain Pang turned him into an unstoppable raging machine.
“Get your filthy hands off young miss!”
Lin Xuanfeng couldn’t care less about their bravado, to the point he even disregarded them completely. With Lei Yuntian leading the charge, Lin Xuanfeng simply swished his wrist and Captain Pang tumbled forward.
Captain Pang rammed into Lei Yuntian and the two coughed blood in their flight.
To the mere 3rd layer of Bone Tempering Luo Yunhai, this was even more disdainful. A simple rise of his leg followed by a casual step ended the kid’s attack.
Ah!
Luo Yunhai’s wailed out of pain from having his leg bone bend under the guy’s foot. Luo Yunchang rushed over, “Yunhai!”
She didn’t make it however, as Lin Xuanfeng was quick in seizing her wrist and grinning like a demon, “Young miss Luo, will you cooperate now?”
Luo Yunchang bit her lip, her eyes teary as she clenched her fists in hatred.
Seeing her so stubborn, Lin Xuanfeng snickered as he put more weight on his foot.
Ah!
Luo Yunhai made his pain known again. But he cut off his screams abruptly despite the agony. He chose to hold it in, although it was clear from his purple face that it took all he had not to keep screaming.
He couldn’t scream, or his sister would have no choice but to agree and the Luo clan’s name would go up in flames. His training in the Dugu Army taught him how to shed away the weak young master persona and become a true man of principle.
“Oh, quite the tough one I see.”
Raising an eyebrow, Lin Xuanfeng eyed him viciously, and put more power in his stomp.
The sound of crushed bone jarred everyone’s ears, but Luo Yunhai only gnashed his teeth as sweat soaked him. No matter how much it hurt, how pale he got, he didn’t make a sound.
Lei Yuntian and Captain Pang were enraged at this, yet couldn’t even twitch as their bodies were seriously hurt as well. As for those Profound Heaven fakes, they were rooted in place and shivering from pain. They had no intention of showing off anymore. After biting the dust once, they simply closed their eyes shut.
Even as imperial guards they had never offended the seven houses, least of all now.
Although the young guards had guts, even they’d think twice after being knocked out cold from just one slap.
Luo Yunchang felt her brother’s pain, so much so her teeth were threatening to break under the strain of her clenched jaw. She was caught in the middle, whether to choose her clan’s honor or save her younger brother from the torment.
Lin Xuanfeng roared as he yanked her wrist, “Talk! Are you going to give in and make me Zhuo Fan’s master or not?”
“Humph, are you worthy?” Luo Yunchang scoffed back, “Compared to him, you’re nothing but discarded dung, unfit to even carry his shoes!”
Lin Xuanfeng’s eyes twitched and he backhanded her, “Have it your way then, skank!”
Luo Yunchang showed no fear at the incoming blow. The others wanted to help but were unable to even move.
All they could do was watch him humiliate their young miss.
Whoosh!
And right then, a white ribbon shot at Lin Xuanfeng. He was forced to give up on his attack and flickered away. The ribbon passed through the air and went back.
The source was tens of meters away from the Luo clan’s siblings.
Lin Xuanfeng spat back as he watched the white ribbon fly away, “Ascending Ice Phoenix Chu Qingcheng, this is none of your damn business. Beat it!”
“Humph, Drifting Flowers City will never allow anyone to harass women!”
A white figure along with Iris and Peony Overseers walked over. Her elegance and her demeanor, both pictured her as a celestial. Not even her veil could mask the outstanding beauty she possessed, to the extent that it left even Luo Yunchang speechless.
[Is this Chu Qingcheng? She is just like a goddess!]
Then she noticed the two overseers and her whole face lit up, “Sister Iris, Sister Peony!”
When Zhuo Fan was reported missing, perhaps because they were all women, while meeting with her allies, Luo Yunchang and the two hit it off. The two liked Luo Yunchang as well, treating her like an angel.
Unlike that devious and devilish Zhuo Fan.
It was only natural that the three were practically sisters now.
The overseers rushed to her in worry, “Yunchang, are you alright?”
Luo Yunchang nodded her head with a smile and went to help her brother and Captain Pang. The overseers supplied them with pills to offer relief.
Chu Qingcheng only stared daggers at Lin Xuanfeng.
Lin Xuanfeng scratched his nose as he said in good nature, “Chu Qingcheng, this is no Drifting Flowers City, so try to keep your nose out of another’s business.”
“Habit!” Chu Qingcheng scoffed and chuckled in mockery.
Lin Xuanfeng laughed back coldly, “Then you’ll have to forgive me for what I’m about to do.”
Lin Xuanfeng flickered, putting Luo Yunchang and her group on edge.
Iris and Peony Overseers held her hand to ease her worries.
Only this time, Chu Qingcheng intervened. A white mist rose between her hands, swiftly spreading around. Wherever the mist passed, a layer of ice formed.
Lin Xuanfeng slowly became suspicious as the mist coiled around his figure. His speed was clearly affected as everyone had no trouble seeing him anymore.
Shocked, Lin Xuanfeng got some distance between them. He trembled a bit and the ice sheet on him crumbled off, but the fear in his eyes was more than apparent.
“Frost Domain! Did your soul reach the Radiant Stage?” Lin Xuanfeng cried incredulously.
He felt how Chu Qingcheng’s frost spread along her Discerning Field and acted as a barrier. Any that stepped foot in it, would find it impossible to escape her notice, regardless of speed.
It was a sign of imminent breakthrough into the Radiant Stage.
Once her Frost Domain became an invisible divine sense, that would be when she’d attain the true form of Discerning Field. And, just like Zhuo Fan, she had the prospect of entering the Radiant Stage.
As for killing with intent, it wasn’t that far away either.
His face growing colder, Lin Xuanfeng said, “I heard you wasted ten years of your cultivation. Who knew you’d recover so fast. Chu Qingcheng, you are worthy of being among the Six Dragons and One Phoenix, albeit barely. I extend my admiration!”
“Then get lost if you know what’s good for you! I am in no mood of stirring something up before the true battle between the seven houses!” Chu Qingcheng glanced over.
Lin Xuanfeng was pissed and his face was a mask of hatred. Then he broke out into a grin, accompanied by him snickering, “Chu Qingcheng, you’re a bit full of yourself. Not even you are enough to deal with me!”
Whoosh!
With a boom, Chu Qingcheng felt a wind on her back and felt a slap coming her way.
The two palms met and Chu Qingcheng put all her power in it to repel the attacker. When she noticed her palm, it was covered in green.
It was lucky that she had formed a layer of ice beforehand. The ice made from Yuan Qi fell on the ground, sizzling like acid and releasing a foul stench.
Chu Qingcheng held her nose and jumped back startled, “What dreadful poison!”
Looking up, she noticed the attacker was a man with half his face purple, and said, “Plague Dragon, Yan Bangui!”

chapters.title: Chapter 252, The Dread of Huangpu Tianyuan
chapters.content:
Chapter 252, The Dread of Huangpu Tianyuan
“Ha-ha-ha, you old poisoner! About time you showed up. Any later and I’d have had to go all out!” Lin Xuanfeng roared in laughter walking next to Yan Bangui while raising a taunting look at Chu Qingcheng.
Yan Bangui was simply silent. The only sign he had that seemed to acknowledge the man was the bloodthirsty cold stare.
Heart jumping, Chu Qingcheng grew serious. Six Dragons and One Phoenix’s power was the strongest in the Profound Heaven Stage. Besides Huangpu Qingtian, there wasn’t much of a difference in the other six’s power.
She could deal with Forest Fleeting Dragon, Lin Xuanfeng, but her hands were tied with Yan Bangui in the mix. The others picked up on this and grew nervous.
Lin Xuanfeng puffed up his chest and laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, Ascending Ice Phoenix, now that we are two against one, I reckon what your chances will be?”
Chu Qingcheng tightened her fists in response.
“Ha-ha-ha, you’re among the Six Dragons and One Phoenix, yet you have no shame going two against one? What will you say to three against two then?”
The others jerked and saw Long Xingyun and Xie Tianshang’s groups arriving.
Xue Ningxiang looked at Luo Yunchang. She gathered her courage and showed a bashful smile, “Young miss Luo, are you alright?”
Luo Yunchang chuckled a nod, but was quite perplexed. [Who is this girl? I don’t even know her so why does she care so much about me?]
But when she noticed the Thunder Ring, she realized that Zhuo Fan wore the same one, “T-that ring...”
“This is our engagement ring!” Xie Tianyang butted in, showing his own without an ounce of shame.
It was precisely for this occasion that he had Zhuo Fan make one for him as well.
Glaring at him, Xue Ningxiang stammered an explanation, “Young miss Luo, don’t misunderstand. This is nothing between us. Brother Zhuo simply gave a token to each of us!”
“Oh, I see!” Luo Yunchang nodded in disappointment and vexation. [That guy never gave me anything...]
Chu Qingcheng’s ears perked up and she whipped her head back, feeling quite down herself.
[Grandmother said he is heartless, yet he suddenly grew a conscience? Humph, damn philanderer...]
Long Xingyun got next to Chu Qingcheng and stared at their opponents, “I wonder, who among you will spar with me?”
“Humph, stand back and leave them all to me!”
Xie Tianshang stepped in front, his sword sheath moved and his piercing gaze landed on his enemies. Like sharp blades, the two had a very real cold and sharp feeling on their necks!
Long Xingyun almost facepalmed, [This guy’s martial fanatic obsession is out again. Though this is a very good opportunity to see how reliable he really is!]
While their side got bolstered, the enemy’s side was tense.
Now that the tables had turned, they were the ones at a disadvantage.
“Ha-ha-ha, it’s three on three in fact!”
A laughter followed when a gray figure popped out before Lin Xuanfeng. Their tension eased.
Chu Qingcheng frowned and spat, “Specter Dragon, You Yushan!”
“It is I!” You Yushan nodded and turned to his own allies, “Eldest young master was right, Six Dragons and One Phoenix were bound to fight earlier.”
“Ha-ha-ha, in this case, we are even. What’s there to fear?” Lin Xuanfeng cackled, having recovered his cockiness.
Chu Qingcheng’s side waited solemnly.
With a metallic sound, Xie Tianshang’s sword left its sheath, “You two, pick someone else. These three are mine!”
“Young master Xie, can you take them on all by yourself?” Chu Qingcheng frowned in worry.
Hardening his gaze, Xie Tianshang made up his mind, “How else can I challenge Huangpu Qingtian?”
“Brother Xie, I don’t care about the other two, but leave You Yushan to me!” Long Xingyun stepped up with a hard face, “Veiled Dragon Pavilion and Hell Valley’s grudges can only be settled amongst ourselves!”
“Ha-ha-ha, perfect. I was thinking the same thing. Let’s see what Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s Abyss Dragon is made of! I’ll make sure whether Hell Valley has overestimated you or not!”
You Yushan laughed, with sparks flying as their gazes met.
The scene was close to a breaking point. It was missing but a spark to devolve in an all out war.
But then a shout came, “Stop!”
Whoosh!
Four men appeared between the two sides, eliciting murmurs from the others, “Four Tigers of Tianyu!”
“Seniors, Marshal Dugu forbids any grudge fights in Dragon Cloud City. The seven houses are no exception. Please comply!” Dugu Feng cupped his hands at the six, his tone very cold.
And yet another shout came, “Brother Yunhai...”
Dugu Huo noticed Luo Yunhai on the ground and knew at a glance that his leg was broken. His short temper was already burning as he raved, “Who did this?”
“Third brother, it was Lin Xuanfeng!” Luo Yunchang spoke in a pleading voice, “Please, elder brother, help us!”
Dugu Huo’s face heated up as he roared like a beast, “Anyone who harms our family is dead! Eldest brother...”
“Quiet!”
Dugu Feng cut him off with a glare, then continued, “I hope that we can all let this matter rest! If Marshal were to step in himself, it won’t simply end with words!”
The rest stared at him fixedly, then nodded slowly.
Dugu Zhantian was the second of the Four Pillars. They had to show him some respect after all.
“Fine. It’s such a pity though, that I didn’t get to show them my prowess. We’ll just have to wait for the decisive battle of the houses then!” Lin Xuanfeng shrugged and mocked. They hadn’t lost in this exchange anyway.
The rest looked at each other and nodded as well.
Dugu Feng eased his breath and walked to Luo Yunhai, “Yunhai, please forgive me.”
“No, I understand that the eldest brother had to dissolve the situation!” Luo Yunhai’s eyes were firm.
Past five years in the Dugu Army had him grown accustomed to the meaning of military. In order to reach an objective, sometimes personal honor had to be sacrificed.
Taking a deep breath, Dugu Feng patted his shoulder, feeling his pain as well.
His little brother was pushed around and what did the eldest brother do? Nothing! All because of his orders. He was a soldier first and foremost, a Dugu Army’s general!
The other tigers sighed as well, filled with just as much rage as him.
“Oh, isn’t the situation over yet?” A sudden voice came, lofty as an emperor’s. Carrying might with every word.
They all turned to see the most dreadful among the six dragons.
Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord, Huangpu Qingtian!
“Eldest young master, this is what happened...” Lin Xuanfeng looked like a dog as he explained in brief.
Huangpu Qingtian nodded, yet his face was always calm. He stepped forward and said, “Since Zhuo Fan is a no-show, hurry up and kill the Luo clan! If such a crucial event doesn’t warrant his coming, he must be dead for sure!”
The others jerked in fright. Huangpu Qingtian was going to go against Dugu Zhantian’s orders and kill the Luo clan.
“Young master Huangpu, Marshal is against any grudge fights. Are you... “
Dugu Feng blocked his path and shouted, but Huangpu Qingtian only had disdain for his attempt, “Grudge fight, war, they all describe armed conflicts between two equally strong sides! But none of you are even worthy of a grudge fight. So erasing someone weak doesn’t violate any order.”
[Such crass!]
The people were shocked once again by this man’s egotistical behavior.
Whoosh!
Suddenly, a sword light came down from above, straight for Huangpu Qingtian. Xie Tianshang was filled with fighting spirit as he shouted, “Huangpu Qingtian, I’ve waited ten years for this! Flowing Space’s Nine Forms – Splitting Heaven!”
“Ten years? Then you waited for nothing!”
He walked just like before, and yet in the face of the upcoming sword attack, he only replied with a casual palm attack.
Boom!
The sword wave splintered and an almighty power slammed into Xie Tianshang’s chest and sent him flying while coughing blood.
The way Huangpu Qingtian put away his hand was as if he flicked away a pest, a mosquito – so casual, so dismissive. Not even his gait changed!
Sss~
All watched in stunned silence how he dominated Xie Tianshang. Not even Xie Tianyang conceived it possible for his invincible brother to be so easily dealt with by Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord.
Everyone said Huangpu Qingtian was a monster, but how could there be such discrepancy from the rest of the Six Dragons and One Phoenix? The others couldn’t even put up any resistance.
The hearts of everyone sank in despair! Huangpu Qingtian was an untameable mountain as he stepped towards them.
Although slow, his step carried such power that it was as if he was stepping on everyone’s hearts, crushing their spirit and will...

chapters.title: Chapter 253, Demonic Dragon’s Appearance
chapters.content:
Chapter 253, Demonic Dragon’s Appearance
The heavy pressure pressed down on all and they flinched back again and again. Yet Huangpu Qingtian was still strolling forward, like a king on a mission!
The air was excruciatingly thick, hard to even breathe. The dread on everyone’s face only increased with every sound of Huangpu Qingtian’s steps.
Monster!
It was on everyone’s mind, yet none dared say it.
Lin Xuanfeng, Yan Bangui, and You Yushan observed coldly. The stronger Huangpu Qingtian was, the more at ease they were, and respectful!
“Huangpu Qingtian, think this through, or you will suffer the consequences!” Dugu Feng wiped his brow.
Among his peers in Tianyu, Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord was the first to scare this leader of tigers.
Nodding, Huangpu Qingtian never missed a beat, “Relax, I’m not after you, the five tigers’ lives. I still have to show consideration for Marshal Dugu! As long as you come out unharmed, he will not charge into Regent Estate! So taking Luo clan’s young miss’ head with me won’t make that old geezer snap.”
The four tigers felt eerily afraid and worried.
Huangpu Qingtian was not only high on his horse, but quite astute as well, a schemer and plotter.
He grasped Dugu Zhantian’s bottom line, and knew when to stop just shy from it, even if he was about to cause a massacre.
Correct, Dugu Zhantian cared most about his five godsons. He was tough on them, true, but he cherished them dearly as well.
If anything were to happen to them, the old guy would flip and march his army regardless of consequences. Everyone had a bottom line, and the second of Four Pillars, Marshal of 3rd Army was no exception.
Even though Luo Yunchang was the dear sister of his fifth godson, not even for her would he go into action. She had nothing to do with him.
Knowing this, Huangpu Qingtian acted unrestrained and unfeeling to others.
“Young miss Luo, run! Go find the Marshal. You’ll be safe there. Go while we hold him off!” Dugu Lin whispered.
Luo Yunchang was worried for Luo Yunhai.
Dugu Lin said, “Don’t worry, Yunhai is our brother and godfather’s godson. Huangpu Qingtian won’t ever touch him. Go, we won’t be able to hold him for long!”
Luo Yunchang took one last look at her brother and nodded. She was relieved but still hesitant.
Just then, a soft hand grabbed her into a run. Looking back, it was actually Xue Ningxiang.
“Sister Luo, brother Zhuo always called me a burden! Let’s see him say that again after I save his clan’s young miss!” Xue Ningxiang stuck out her charming and cute nose as she smiled.
Seeing this cutie, Luo Yunchang’s worries drifted out of her.
She didn’t know how Zhuo Fan got to meet this girl, but the girl was like an angel, easing her worries...
Lin Xuanfeng snickered from afar, “Running, is it? Did you ask me first?”
“Wait, don’t sour the eldest young master’s mood!” You Yushan blocked him with a sneer.
He now realized that without Huangpu Qingtian’s explicit approval, none could do anything. When the man was on the prowl, only horror would’ve awaited him for meddling with his hunt. Lin Xuanfeng wiped his brow and nodded.
You Yushan beamed in reply.
[Thanks, dude. If not for you, I would’ve been a goner!]
[No thanks necessary. I’m not doing it for you either. With Huangpu Qingtian’s temper, I fear you’ll take me down with you.]
You Yushan snickered.
Back to Huangpu Qingtian, he didn’t much care if the two girls broke into a run and shook his head, “A hare always thinks it can outrun its hunter, only to find its efforts go in vain.”
Huangpu Qingtian punctuated with chasing after the two.
The four tigers rushed to intercept with four palms, “Wind, forest, fire, mountain – Imperial Army!”(StarReader: 风林火山，千军万马 is original. If you have a better suggestion, I’m all ears.)
Boom!
As if a dam broke, the power swept everything like a literal army.
Although it was only four palms, it was as if tens of men joined hands! Not even Huangpu Qingtian could ignore it, feeling the sudden and forceful might boring down on him.
Huangpu Tianyuan’s grinned, “A formation! A pity, it’s too low grade.”
And he punched.
Without any preamble, just this plain punch contained almost godly power. The boom sent the four tigers flying as they bled from their mouths!
Now they felt on their own skin why Xie Tianshang was so badly wounded after just one attack. Because Huangpu Qingtian was no human. [How can our peer, in both age and cultivation, have such power?]
But the crux of it all was, their so called stalling was pointless. Huangpu Qingtian simply barreled through them unimpeded in his chase after Luo Yunchang. It was as if stepping on ants in passing!
Whoosh!
Suddenly, a whistle announced the incoming claw attack, below Huangpu Qingtian’s belt. It was so devious, so sneaky, it caused everyone to gasp!
“Veiled Dragon Claw!”(StarReader: 潜龙勿用. I have no clue if it’s a declaration of an attack or huangpu saying it’s useless.)
Long Xingyun’s eyes glinted as he arrived in the man’s path. Huangpu Qingtian laughed coldly, “Veiled Dragon Pavilion gets worse by the day. You only got so far through underhanded and crafty methods!”
“He-he-he, and? This is what I know best!” Long Xingyun snickered, not minding it in the least.
Huangpu Qingtian disregarded him and was planning on kicking him away.
It was then he found it odd that his leg didn’t move. A shining ice sheet crept up his legs and rooted him in place.
He then saw a dainty palm, filled with mist shooting from above. Chu Qingcheng!
Unable to move, Long Xingyun clawed him from below, and Chu Qingcheng attacked from above. It was the perfect combo to subdue an enemy’s movements while also unleashing a pincer attack!
Squinting, Huangpu Qingtian snorted fearlessly, “I see. You laid a trap for me with Frost Domain while the four tigers blocked my path! Not bad at all, I will give you that much. But...”
Pa, pa!
Two loud noises echoed as Chu Qingcheng’s palm slammed into his head and Long Xingyun’s claw hit from below. Although despicable, it was a strong attack nonetheless!
And yet, no one expected what happened next.
Two peak Profound Heaven experts could do nothing against one with equal cultivation!
Chu Qingcheng and Long Xingyun stared in shock and sucked a cold breath! [Just how strong is this monster?]
Huangpu Qingtian curled his lips, “A pity, you are too weak and overestimate your strength!”
Despite his words, his eyes flashed.
Then, with a boom, his body exploded in a golden light and roared like a dragon. A golden dragon rose from him, sending the pair flying and coughing blood.
It then circled back into his body.
“W-what is that thing?” Long Xingyun watched Huangpu Qingtian perturbed, as did the rest.
It was as if his body held a guardian.
Grinning, Huangpu Qingtian mocked, “It is the heritage of an emperor. You are not worthy to know!”
Huangpu Qingtian then chose to ignore him, leaving him sitting on the ground in shock and bleeding at the mouth.
Whoosh~
With no one left to block him, Huangpu Qingtian went after the girls. They looked back in shock, to find Chu Qingcheng, Xie Tianshang, and Luo Yunchang, as well as the Four Tigers of Tianyu wounded on the ground and unable to even get up on their feet!
Despite the intense fight, it only took a second. The gap was so insanely wide that all that effort didn’t stall Huangpu Qingtian for even a fraction of a second!
[How is there such discrepancy between him and the other Five Dragons and One Phoenix?]
The two were now panicking from fright! Huangpu Qingtian was like a relentless monster. No one seemed to be able to escape his clutches!
“Ning’er, watch out!”
Xie Tianyang roared, as he and Long Jie with Long Kui jumped in front. But what could they do when Five Dragons and One Phoenix could do nothing?
The answer? Nothing.
With a mere flick, Huangpu Qingtian sent them flying, landing heavily on the ground.
Snickering, Huangpu Qingtian extended his hand, “Young miss Luo, this palm of mine will splatter the both of you! If Zhuo Fan doesn’t show even now, he is definitely dead, or maybe just a lily-livered good for nothing coward!”
“Rubbish! You’re the real coward! Brother Zhuo is a hero!” Ning’er cursed.
Luo Yunchang was giving her all to run, but still nodded at Ning’er’s words.
Grinning, Huangpu Qingtian mocked, “I hope so too, but at this point he seems likelier dead than alive.”
Huangpu Qingtian struck with his palm. It looked casual, but the might behind it was that of a mountain.
The girls were scared to even run, watching the incoming palm with fear.
Everyone wanted to help them, somehow save them, but no one had the strength.
“Sister!” Luo Yunhai cried and crawled.
“Ning’er!” Xie Tianyang was doing the same with clenched teeth.
Huangpu Qingtian looked on coldly as his attack approached the girls, “Ha-ha-ha, Zhuo Fan is really dead after all. A shame you all had to die for nothing. As he defied Regent Estate, I had no choice but to waste my time with this puny Luo clan. You only have Zhuo Fan to blame for your fates. It was he who cut your young lives short!”
Luo Yunchang and Ning’er remained silent.
Xie Tianyang punched the ground, reminded of how powerless he was back in Blue Expanse City and cursed, “That bastard Zhuo Fan! Why does he always wash his hands off every offense he ever does. Now Ning’er is giving her life away for nothing! Bastard, come out if you have any shred of conscience!”
Lin Xuanfeng’s group found his cursing entertaining, “So Zhuo Fan really is dead. Or this would never have happened!”
“No, Zhuo Fan is not dead!” Luo Yunchang shouted back.
Huangpu Qingtian’s attack was about to hit the girls, “Then call him out! Show me that he’s alive! But it’s too late now. No one can save you from my attack!”
Tears streamed Luo Yunchang’s face, “Zhuo Fan, if you can hear me, please come! At least let me see you one last time!”
She was on the brink of death yet no response came. Lin Xuanfeng’s group laughed harder at her futile attempt and treated her like a fool.
Ning’er held her close instead, even if her heart had the same feeling.
“Useless! Die in peace!”
Whoosh~
Huangpu Qingtian’s palm attack sped up and the girls felt their breaths caught in their throat, picturing the gory mess they would soon become. Luo Yunchang closed her teary eyes, in pain and sorrow.
[Why couldn’t I see Zhuo Fan one last time?]
Ning’er was praying for a miracle, the same miracle that saved her in Blue Expanse City!
[Will anyone save us?]
Crack~
Suddenly, Xie Tianyang and Ning’er’s Thunder Ring flickered and the two cried.
“Zhuo Fan!”
“Big brother Zhuo!”
Boom!
Too little, too late. Huangpu Qingtian’s palm struck down, destroying even the ground below them!
