Xie Tianyang watched the aftermath in a daze, slumping powerless as tears flowed from his eyes.
It was now that a carefree voice entered their ears, “Were you looking for me?”

chapters.title: Chapter 254, Another Monster
chapters.content:
Chapter 254, Another Monster
A shiver ran through Huangpu Qingtian and his knuckles turned white. He turned, like the rest, to where the voice came from.
To see a figure in a billowing black cloak, wielding a sword of unmatched edge, yet sheathed for now. But that could not hide the dread and power it instilled in the hearts of all present!
Especially when he held two girls in his arms, the same ones Huangpu Qingtian was about to kill.
[How?]
The mangled bodies and the torn limbs were nowhere to be seen. How were they still in one piece? [Did this man just do the impossible? Did he save them without even Huangpu Qingtian noticing?]
[That’s absurd!] Who could ever pull such a feat such as saving someone from right under Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord’s nose, and at the last second too!
Not even the feeting feet Lin Xuanfeng could pull it off.
[Who the hell is this guy?]
Eyes filled with shock and intrigue graced the black figure. Not even Huangpu Qingtian could stop his eye from twitching. It was a rare sight to see him lose his voice.
Because it had never happened to him, ever...
Once the haze passed, Luo Yunchang was still trying to make sense of everything. One second she was staring death in the face, and the next she was in the arms of a robed man.
Xue Ningxiang didn’t fare any better, but the familiar flickering forced her eyes on the man’s hand, on the sparkling Thunder Ring, “Big brother Zhuo, you’re alright!”
Her words earned the gasp of the crowd.
Easing them down, Zhuo Fan smiled and pulled back his cowl to reveal the same familiar face that some cherished, some hated, and some reviled.
Yes sir, he was the one and only Soaring Demonic Dragon. Who made sure to leave chaos in his wake wherever he went, Zhuo Fan!
Smiling to Xue Ningxiang, Zhuo Fan showed a rare calmness, “Ning’er, it’s been a while!”
Xue Ningxiang nodded a smile, lowering her bashful face. Xie Tianyang was still crawling and couldn’t for the life of him decide which was better, life or death. He was thrilled that Xue Ningxiang was safe and sound. But the deep gaze Xue Ningxiang gave Zhuo Fan made him feel his life was over!
[Ning’er, why have you never looked at me like that?]
Bam!
Zhuo Fan stumbled forward and held his butt. He snapped back irate, “Young miss, what’s wrong? We haven’t seen...”
His words soon stopped though. Because Luo Yunchang was looking at him with teary eyes and a reproachful glare.
“You are asking me? What about you? Where the hell did you run off to for the past five years? I was worried sick!”
Luo Yunchang raved, but she couldn’t mask the joy bursting from her chest as she forgot where she was and jumped into his arms, her tears falling nonstop.
She wanted to hold him close to her heart and never let him go.
Zhuo Fan was caught unprepared, not knowing how to even respond, but ultimately deciding to hug her back.
Xue Ningxiang felt a stab of pain from deep within her heart. She should be happy to see Zhuo Fan again, so why the pain? But the sight of this young miss holding Zhuo Fan so close seemed to make her heart frantic!
Chu Qingcheng was no different.
Zhuo Fan was the husband she recognized back in Drifting Flowers City, and here he was, spreading his love! However reasonable and perfectly natural her brain told her this reunion was, her heart was another matter entirely. The pain was far greater than any wound she had ever received!
Two women’s love aside, the Four Tigers of Tianyu felt their hearts literally crack!
[Young miss Luo pined for someone else. That makes the five years we carried a torch for her go down the drain. We even fought among each other over her! This blasted and rotten Steward Zhuo is a clan thief in the truest sense! He even stole young miss’ heart!]
And yet, worries soon gave way to joy.
Watching such a touchy reunion, Xie Tianyang’s mouth split into a wide grin! [As long as Zhuo Fan has a woman, Ning’er will be devastated. The perfect time to make my move.]
[Whether it is Chu Qingcheng or Luo Yunchang, who cares? Ha-ha-ha...]
Xie Tianyang was laughing his heart out, on the inside, totally forgetting the precarious and quite deadly situation they were in seconds ago.
“For even a 5th layer of Bone Tempering woman to kick your ass, Soaring Demonic Dragon’s reputation is undeserving!” A brash and cocky voice burst Luo Yunchang’s bubble of happiness.
She came crashing down to reality, reminded of the danger they were in. She jumped away from Zhuo Fan, wiped her tears and, like the perfect image of a little girl, dodged behind him, “Steward Zhuo, keep me safe!”
Her coy voice was enough to melt the four tigers’ ice cold hearts, which were now bursting out of their chest in rage and rancor directed at the newly arrived man, Zhuo Fan. [What does young miss Luo sees in that Steward Zhuo? Isn’t he beneath her?]
Glancing back, Zhuo Fan was puzzled, [Since when did this lass learn to throw a hissy fit? It’s not a bad idea, though.]
“Ha-ha-ha, eldest young master, this guy doesn’t look like much. He’s only in the 9th layer of Bone Tempering Stage. He couldn’t even break through to the Profound Heaven Stage! Fighting him will only harm your image so allow me to do the honors!” Lin Xuanfeng laughed.
Huangpu Qingtian nodded.
[The brat is right. If this is all Zhuo Fan amounts to, there’s no need for my intervention.] But in case Zhuo Fan was pulling his punches, it might not be so bad to let this dumbass test the waters.
Huangpu Qingtian smiled, “Suit yourself. I’ll allow it!”
“Thank you, eldest young master!” Lin Xuanfeng snickered at Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow and turned to Luo Yunchang, “Who’re these guys?”
Luo Yunchang gave a rushed explanation. Getting the memo on who was who here, Zhuo Fan realized how powerful Huangpu Qingtian was. He alone dealt with Zhuo Fan’s three allies and the Four Tigers of Tianyu, yet was still so composed.
[Actually, he’s dreadfully powerful and Zhuo Fan would never have fought him in the past. As for now, he-he...]
Zhuo Fan grinned deviously, his brain already cooking the beginnings of a plan. Luo Yunchang brightened. Being so long in Zhuo Fan’s presence, she knew his tells, and the confidence he showed now was more than a little reassuring.
So without further ado, she singled Lin Xuanfeng out, “Steward Zhuo, ignore the others and teach this prick a lesson he never forgets!”
Zhuo Fan asked puzzled, “What’s so special about him?”
“H-he had errant intentions about me!” Luo Yunchang was wishy-washy, holding his sleeve and acting like a big child. It unleashed a cuteness overload attack on everyone’s heart.
Zhuo Fan blinked, giving her another look. [Young miss has changed. She finally started to work out her naivety.]
And since the young miss had spoken, it was a steward’s duty to comply. Whether it request was real or not was besides the point.
Zhuo Fan switched his tone in the blink of an eye and stared down Lin Xuanfeng, “Forest Fleeting Dragon Lin Xuanfeng, you must be tired of living! You had the nerve to go after my young miss!”
“He-he-he, and? It’s not my fault that Luo clan has no men...”
Pa!
He didn’t get to finish his sentence as something knocked him flying! He went through four houses before getting buried under the rubble.
Zhuo Fan was a whole hundred meters away, his eyes aflame as he lowered his hand, “Bastard, you dare say that with me here? Go to hell!”
The silence was deafening.
They stared slack jawed at him. Even Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord was stunned!
[What just happened? They were a hundred meters apart. How did Zhuo Fan slap him away?]
The one under the rubble was from the Six Dragons and One Phoenix, Lin Xuanfeng! The fastest man in the Profound Heaven Stage! Be it an attack or a hidden weapon, anything thrown at the guy was easily dodged.
That was all thanks to his speed! As for melee attacks, you couldn’t even touch the man.
Yet here was Zhuo Fan, flicking his hand and sending this speedster flying. If that wasn’t shocking, what else was?
But what was really on everyone’s mind was [How did he do it?]
No one noticed anything. He moved so fast, it went beyond their perception, including Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord’s!
If a monster like him couldn’t catch what happened, didn’t that make Zhuo Fan a monster himself?
Their eyes watching Zhuo Fan turned from shock to fearful.
Xie Tianshang muttered to himself before sighing, “Soaring Demonic Dragon’s reputation precedes him, what an oddity!”
Long Xingyun was dazed, “I now know why father allied with the Luo clan. Why Little Kui and Little Jie were so driven to cultivate! This monster gives too great of a shock. But will only cultivation be enough to catch up to these two monsters?”
Long Xingyun shook his head. Chu Qingcheng watched the imposing figure with a deep gaze. But then recalling his ties with the other girls ruined her mood...

chapters.title: Chapter 255, Almighty Ability
chapters.content:
Chapter 255, Almighty Ability
Rumble!
Lin Xuanfeng rose from under the ruins with a bloody mouth and spat what seemed to be blood along with a tooth mixed in it. He looked towards Zhuo Fan, but this time he wasn’t as carefree as before.
[Soaring Demonic Dragon is a mystery in and of himself.] He didn’t even get a chance to react and was sent flying.
What’s more, Zhuo Fan did it offhandedly. If he hadn’t pulled his punches, would he even be alive right now? More importantly, the opponent’s speed was creepier than his. The speed he prided himself with turned out to have no use whatsoever!
Lin Xuanfeng’s fear of Zhuo Fan only grew stronger.
You Yushan and Yan Bangui rushed over, while looking at Zhuo Fan distraught. They had heard the rumors about the infamous Zhuo Fan, but seeing was believing, of how demonically dreadful he was.
[No wonder this guy caused chaos among the seven houses, yet was living nice and happy. His power is even weirder...]
With a dismissive wave, Zhuo Fan acted as if all was natural, and turned to Luo Yunchang, “Young miss, will you be content with such a punishment? Should I give him a kick as well?”
Lin Xuanfeng’s heart jumped and he shivered a step back. Having gone through that light slap, the Forest Fleeting Dragon of the Six Dragons and One Phoenix was shaking in his boots.
No one would ever believe it was possible, but the truth was undeniable!
Huangpu Qingtian scared him into submission with diplomacy and might. Zhuo Fan, on the other hand, did it through brutality! They were at such a level, not even the Six Dragons and One Phoenix could mess with any of them.
Luo Yunchang now picked up on Zhuo Fan’s words. His display was so frightening that even she was dazed, “Uh, no need. He only lacked manners when speaking with me. A slap is enough!”
Lin Xuanfeng eased a breath, grateful even. [Young miss Luo, you’re the best!]
But Luo Yunchang’s next words had him on the verge of wetting himself from fear.
“As for the matter regarding Yunhai...” Luo Yunchang pointed at her brother on the ground and then pleaded Zhuo Fan with big eyes, “Steward Zhuo, they harassed your young master. You can’t let this matter stand!”
Zhuo Fan’s face hardened, noticing the half grownup Luo Yunhai had his leg broken and his bloodthirst spiked, “Who did this, young master?”
Luo Yunhai shook his head helplessly.
With Zhuo Fan missing god knows where, his sister had to take over clan matters.
Her gentle and kind sister had gone through so many negotiations with her allies that it had changed her initially weak standpoint to the unbendable one of today.
Having negotiated so much, patting down, faking and being stubborn came easy! [She has turned as tough and as unreasonable as brother Zhuo!]
Especially sharp in using her female attributes to look weak and have others do the work for her, or drive a wedge. [Now that big bro Zhuo’s back, she feels left out, yet still couldn’t hide all the charm she gained from those years of handling the clan’s negotiations.]
And Zhuo Fan? Everyone here knew Zhuo Fan never took things lying down. He was even more cunning and insidious than Luo Yunchang! Looking at it in a different way, Luo Yunchang’s style was all thanks to Zhuo Fan’s influence!
Luo Yunhai, having lived in Dugu Army, knew how to gauge a situation and when to stop. He waved, “It’s nothing, brother Zhuo. I’m happy to know you’re alright and that you came back!”
“What nothing? Yunhai, has the army messed with your head? Forget about enduring it like we did before. Brother Zhuo’s back and we’re not about to take this anymore. Right...” Luo Yunchang turned to see a shocked Zhuo Fan looking back, as if he didn’t recognize her. She blushed and went back to being a meek and cute kid, “Isn’t that right?”
[Young miss, have you lost it?]
Blinking, Zhuo Fan broke out in sweat. When did the young miss become so shrewd? But that didn’t mean he didn’t like the change.
In a world where strong prey on the weak, compassion would only get one killed. Regardless of the fact whether it was a good reason to fight back or not, he still had to do it to some extent. That was Zhuo Fan’s creed and style.
The world wasn’t ruled by reason, but by might!
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed, “Listen to your sister. When I was gone, I couldn’t help even if I wanted to! But since I’m back, there will be no compromises, or I’d be a steward for nothing!”
They all could sense the thick bloodthirst in his voice. Luo Yunhai was silent.
All men shuddered inside, admiring Zhuo Fan’s flair. While the girls swooned. Even the always ticked off Peony Overseer had to admit he struck a reliable figure with unmatched charm!
“Never mind. Yunhai must be troubled as well!”
Luo Yunchang sighed and once again changed her style as she clung to Zhuo Fan’s arm and grumbled, “He did it. He broke Yunhai’s leg!”
“Him again?” Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan swiveled to Lin Xuanfeng, “It seems a slap was too light for you!”
Swallowing dryly, Lin Xuanfeng reeled two steps back, soaked to the bone in sweat. Yan Bangui and You Yushan were vigilant on either side of him.
Of this generation, besides Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord, only Zhuo Fan could instill such fear in them!
Pa!
Huangpu Qingtian’s light step put him right in front of Zhuo Fan, “Had enough?”
“Oh, you want to stop me?” Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan showed his trademark evil grin.
Huangpu Qingtian was as calm as ever, not minding Zhuo Fan’s tone the least, “You’re overthinking things. No one has managed to surpass me, and you’re no different!”
The crowd watched all tensed up. [Huangpu Qingtian is on the move!]
And this was the first time that he acted out of his own initiative to block someone. He didn’t say it, but his stance was clear. He acknowledged Zhuo Fan’s strength!
Only when facing a true opponent would he stand in front of them!
His earlier attacks were casual because none of them were worthy of his attention. Zhuo Fan was the exception!
This only worked to put pressure on the crowd, eagerly watching the two monsters’ first contact.
Xie Tianshang was bitter and lonesome. All the martial fanatic in him ever wanted was to have a face to face match with Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord.
A pity he was sorely lacking in power!
Lin Xuanfeng’s group breathed easy. [With the boss taking a stand, this kid will no longer threaten us!]
And yet...
Scratching his head, Zhuo Fan grinned at the casual Huangpu Qingtian, “You think so?”
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan vanished!
Huangpu Qingtian didn’t have time to even appreciate the novelty of the situation as Zhuo Fan’s chuckle came from a hundred meters away. He was right before Lin Xuanfeng!
“Ha-ha-ha, kid, you hurt my young master. Pay up!”
Lin Xuanfeng was scared witless. When did he get past Huangpu Qingtian and come here?
He couldn’t even get one step away as Zhuo Fan’s purple lightning enveloped leg hit him squarely in the gut. He flew for tens of meters.
The purple lightning was torturing his body until he spat blood. His organs were in a seriously damaged state!
Sss~
An all around gasp was heard. His allies, Yan Bangui and You Yushan stood rooted in fear at Zhuo’s display.
But after Lin Xuanfeng was kicked off, they struck back with a palm.
Zhuo Fan vanished again, appearing next to the twirling Lin Xuanfeng in the sky and clutched his leg with a demonic smirk, “Kid, you broke my young master’s leg. I think taking away yours sounds pretty fair!”
Lin Xuanfeng was panicking inside. He didn’t even get to beg as Zhuo Fan followed through with his threat.
“Ghostly Dragon Claw!”
Rip!
Blood spurted like a fountain, followed closely by Lin Xuanfeng’s wail of agony. Zhuo Fan threw away the leg he just tore off.
Huangpu Qingtian was shocked. This is the first time his face changed and he wanted to help. But then a voice came from behind him, “Young master Huangpu, weren’t you going to stop me? What are you doing showing me your back then?”
Shuddering, Huangpu Qingtian felt a trickle of sweat on his scalp. He turned stiffly to find Zhuo Fan still there, calm and snickering.
While on the other end, Yan Bangui and You Yushan found that the target of their attack had been switched to each other. They were sent flying and blood spilled from their lips.
However, that wasn’t as important as the looks Zhuo Fan was getting.
Zhuo Fan did all that in a breath. It wasn’t a stretch to call it an instant. He came and went three times in that short timespan.
He kicked Lin Xuanfeng, then ripped his leg off, and finally came back to his original spot. He did all that to those three men! Because it all happened too fast, Huangpu Qingtian had no way of even intercepting.
It was the same as Zhuo Fan proclaiming [Nothing is out of my reach!]
The looks of shock were as if they saw an abomination. Even Huangpu Qingtian was doing it. For the first time ever, this man felt powerless...

chapters.title: Chapter 256, Hindrance
chapters.content:
Chapter 256, Hindrance
Wiping his brow by instinct, Huangpu Qingtian seemed calm, but turning to Zhuo Fan, he had lost his casual stance and became grave.
Although he was a very conceited person, it didn’t stop him from admitting that today he had met his match.
“It seems I can’t let my guard down around you!” Huangpu Qingtian’s tone dropped and he stared at Zhuo Fan like a hunter.
Grinning, Zhuo Fan said, “Oh, so that’s what you’ve been missing so far? Are your ready now?”
With another creepy grin, Zhuo Fan was gone.
He popped before Yan Bangui and slapped him while cackling, “Then I’ll go after your sidekick’s head this time!”
Yan Bangui panicked. He never thought Zhuo Fan would pick on him. He got flustered while defending and released his poison!
Since when could a hastily made plan repel Zhuo Fan’s long ready palm strike? Moreover, his poison hardly worked on the likes of Zhuo Fan who could just use Demon Transformation Art to dispel it!
But before his attack could land, Zhuo Fan squinted and was gone.
Boom!
Huangpu Qingtian was looking at rubble. It was where Zhuo Fan and the two girls had stood but was now littered with dust. Zhuo Fan reappeared a hundred meters away holding the girls while giving Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord the evil eye.
Huangpu Qingtian snickered back, “Like I said, you can’t get past me!”
Zhuo Fan clenched his jaw and his fists. Huangpu Qingtian was no muscle-brain and quite cunning as well!
Zhuo Fan wanted to relieve Yan Bangui of his cumbersome head as an affront to this man. But this guy knew he couldn’t give chase and settled for targeting Luo Yunchang and Xue Ningxiang.
Forced to save them, regardless of how fast one was, he had to abandon his tricks!
Yan Bangui was scared out of his mind as he watched them. He didn’t want his fate to have such an untimely ending.
The fright was so intense, he felt he had lost a decade of his lifespan!
You Yushan was affected as well, seeing the two dragons on the brink of a war and bolted. Only the crippled Lin Xuanfeng was left behind wailing on the ground!
Not that anyone had a mind to pay him any attention when they were focused on the two monsters. They all wanted to know who was going to be the champion in the Esoteric Debate!
Anticlimactic as it were, finding the result so early...
Holding a girl in each arm, Zhuo Fan’s eyes glared with anger at Huangpu Qingtian. If earlier he was just messing around, he was now focused.
The girls caught onto the situation and ran far away to not disturb their battle.
Huangpu Qingtian grinned in excitement, sensing the change in Zhuo Fan. Facing an opponent like Zhuo Fan couldn’t be more thrilling. Wrapped in a golden light, his power surged and he was putting pressure even on Chu Qingcheng’s group despite how far they were.
Huangpu Qingtian’s power dominated the scene, just like how a king showed his presence!
Zhuo Fan’s stance paled somewhat, but the faint black energy rolling about, the flickers of purple in his eyes, spoke of a deep power laying hidden, waiting for the emperor to come close so he could wring his neck!
It gave everyone a feeling of danger never sensed before.
The onlookers felt their heart in their throats, yet they couldn’t budge an inch.
“Imperial Tyrant Body Art!”
Huangpu Qingtian shouted and nine golden dragons twisted around him before shooting for Zhuo Fan.
Seen from afar, it was as if the sky was coming down to pulverize the earth. Such mighty power could be felt even by the audience!
[Is this how much of a freak he has become? Is this the level of Huangpu Qingtian’s profound ranked martial art?]
All swallowed dryly in shock, waiting nervously for Zhuo Fan’s reaction!
Laughing, Zhuo Fan’s eyes had a golden ring with purple lightning streaking in them, and charged as well!
Roar!
A draconic roar followed the image of a black dragon growing around Zhuo Fan. But the streaks of purple lightning around it caused the earth to rumble incessantly. It was as if the end of days was coming!
While others cried in shock, Huangpu Qingtian’s eye trembled. Because of the power Zhuo Fan displayed.
This martial art was no weaker than his 9th stage of Imperial Tyrant Body Art!
As far as the eyes could see the two mighty powers created a stark and conflicting contrast.
Huangpu Qingtian was bathed in golden glow, like an emperor gracing the world with his presence. Zhuo Fan, however, was in the form of a black dragon wrapped in purple lightning, threatening to tear the world asunder!
If Huangpu Qingtian was a natural born emperor, Zhuo Fan was his antithesis, a necrotic dragon ready to defy any ruling that was imposed on him!
“These two are fated enemies!” Xie Tianshang sighed.
The others nodded.
They were unclear, however, who was it that would come out on top. Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord or Soaring Demonic Dragon?
They all looked perturbed at this scene. Perhaps the Esoteric Debate would be cut short here and now. Perhaps Regent Estate’s millennium long reign would come to an end!
The six houses were witnessing history in the making!
“Soaring Demonic Dragon!”
“Imperial Tyrant Body Art!”
Roar! Roar!
With two mighty roars, Zhuo Fan and Huangpu Qingtian’s dragons were on a collision course. But, a third roar resonated from between them, followed by a blue glow.
The two were forced to slow down their attacks!
Because the blue glow came from none other than the second of Four Pillars, Marshal Dugu Zhantian’s 6th grade spiritual weapon, Dragonslaying Crescent Blade!
A mighty figure drifted from the sky and landed between the two. He caught the two’s wrists and flung them into the air.
Bam~
Zhuo Fan and Huangpu Qingtian’s outrageously powerful martial arts hit nothing and instead each of them were buried in rubble!
When they crawled out and got their wits about them, the aged and mighty Dugu Zhantian stood in all his majestic form before them!
“I will have no grudge fights in my Dragon Cloud City! You two bastards take me for air?”
Dugu Zhantian’s eyes snapped on Huangpu Qingtian, causing his breath to catch in his throat.
He was prideful, but no fool! He was overbearing among peers, and even if he skipped stages, he’d only fight the average Radiant Stage expert.
In the face of Dugu Zhantian, the general who reeked of blood and battle, he was subdued!
“I won’t ever violate Marshal Dugu’s orders again!” Huangpu Qingtian admitted his wrongs. His face was calm however, like a king’s!
Dugu Zhantian’s anger had nowhere to vent since he didn’t want to tangle with Regent Estate. So he turned to Zhuo Fan and barked, “Zhuo Fan, where do you think you’re going?”
The man in question was skulking away, like a thief in the night. He sighed at having been caught, but putting on a bright smile the next instant, he said, “Ha-ha-ha, Marshal Dugu, how’s it going? Please show consideration for my young master. He’s right over there!”
“Cut the crap! I knew you were still alive and have been waiting for this!” Dugu Zhantian mocked him the instant he spouted hypocrisies, “But where did you run off to this time, what trouble have you stirred up? When did you arrive? And how is it that you’re already giving me trouble?”
“Uh, today, actually.”
Zhuo Fan scratched his head shyly. But then he squinted and pointed at Luo Yunhai, “Ol’ Marshal, this is totally not my fault! Look at my young master, your godson! Someone broke his leg. I was only doing my duty as the Luo clan’s steward.”
[Say what?!]
Dugu Zhantian took in the sorry state this place was and found his five godsons on the ground, with Luo Yunhai feeble from the blood loss due to a broken leg.
Dugu Zhantian’s eyes went bloodshot as he roared, “Who did this? I’ll never let you go!”
“They did it, Marshal Dugu! Please give our young master justice!” Zhuo Fan pointed fingers instantly, at Huangpu Qingtian, of course. Zhuo Fan was the picture of a good servant having the backing of his faithful master.
Luo Yunchang added her two cents in the form of a grieving sister, “Please godfather, please give my brother justice!”
Taking a deep breath, Dugu Zhantian’s eyes spat fire as he glared at Huangpu Qingtian...

chapters.title: Chapter 257, Killing With Intent
chapters.content:
Chapter 257, Killing With Intent
“Huangpu Qingtian, why have you harmed my godsons?” Dugu Zhantian barely contained the beast raging inside.
Huangpu Qingtian was calm, “Because they were in my way!”
“And why were they in your way?”
“They carried out Marshal’s orders to prevent me from having a grudge fight.”
Tightening his fists, Dugu Zhantian’s eyes spat fire, “In other words, they aren’t at fault here!”
“No, they aren’t.” Dugu Zhantian was about to blow a gasket. Huangpu Qingtian said coldly, “I also said that they are not fit to enter a grudge fight with me, not when they’re so weak. Therefore it does not fall into defying Marshal’s order! As for my fight with Steward Zhuo, that was indeed a grudge fight. But your five sons were already downed by that point. So it can be said that they weren’t hurt from doing their duty.”
Huangpu Qingtian knew Marshal Dugu was a man of integrity so he used sophistry! Saying that the five tigers had voluntarily, and of their own volition, stepped in his way and he thus inadvertently harmed them while running through them!
Although pedantic, Dugu Zhantian was no moron to not notice the way he shifted blame. His eyes only grew colder as his knuckles popped, “What you’re saying is that my godsons were wounded without your intention?”
“Precisely so. They ran into me and wounded themselves!” Huangpu Qingtian jutted his chin and spoke righteously.
“And what of my fifth godson? What happened to his leg? And don’t go saying he broke his leg running into you!” Dugu Zhantian’s eyes were bloodshot, his voice rumbling and thick with bloodthirst.
Shaking his head, Huangpu Qingtian said, “That wasn’t me, it was Lin Xuanfeng. Out of respect for you, Marshal, I was extremely lenient on your godsons!”
“Where’s that Lin Xuanfeng then? I have a score to settle with him!” Dugu Zhantian’s eyes darted around.
With a slow stretch of the hand, a finger pointed out the gasping Lin Xuanfeng. Huangpu Qingtian said, “Marshal, there’s no need for that now! Steward Zhuo had, in front of everyone, taken matter into his own hands on behalf of his master. Is Marshal still going to continue?”
Ugh!
Dugu Zhantian spotted the pool of blood in which the pale face of the crippled Lin Xuanfeng lay.
His anger washed away in an instant!
The guy was on his last leg, quite literally, given the circumstances. And even if saved, he’d be left a waste. His fate was far worse than his godson’s!
He suddenly felt awkward, even in the wrong. As if he was the accuser in this case, especially when they were worse off than his side by a dozen times!
Zhuo Fan, of course, didn’t think so. Availing of Dugu Zhantian’s presence, he was giving his very best in blowing this sky high, “Ol’ Marshal, don’t listen to his lies. You have no idea of the cruelty and harassment he put us through! When I arrived, the four had ganged up on my young master, humiliating and trampling him!
“My loyalty to my master is unquestionable, coming to his rescue at once. But I was also a victim of their assault. It was impossible for me to fight the four alone, leaving me riddled with wounds. Out of carelessness and sheer coincidence, they made a mistake and lost a leg. But we are the victims here, we were the ones abused! Please give us justice, Marshal!” Zhuo Fan’s voice took a mournful and stuttering tone, filled with pain and agony, “They saw our clan small and weak and decided to harass us. They are low and despicable people!”
Pff!
Everyone there spurted blood. Even Huangpu Qingtian’s face twitched. Even he, with his upbringing, was finding it hard not to flip out.
[What’s with this guy? He twists everything!]
Although cunning, his speech was based on sophistry. Yet never had he seen someone of Zhuo Fan’s ilk, running his mouth and spouting such outrageous lies!
[You rotten bastard! Look around you! Look at the witnesses! How can you be so despicable?]
Despite his perfectly reasonable thinking, Luo Yunchang also picked this time to add oil to the fire, “Steward Zhuo downplayed it slightly, out of worry for the Luo clan, but this is indeed the situation. Please help us, Godfather!”
Pff!
With another round of blood from the crowd, all eyes were on Luo Yunchang, [The hell? What is young miss Luo doing copying Steward Zhuo?]
[Sigh, another one falls under Zhuo Fan’s bad influence!]
It was followed by a round of sighs and head shaking, [Oh, you poor poor thing. Coming from an upright clan yet unable to escape this man’s devious corruption!] Luo Yunchang and Zhuo Fan shared a sly grin!
Face twitching, Dugu Zhantian already had a taste of Zhuo Fan’s grandstanding and wasn’t buying it this time. [Then again, this is the perfect chance to get back at Regent Estate.]
So, Dugu Zhantian nodded, “I see, Huangpu Qingtian. I have banned grudge fights and yet you all started harassing the weak with numbers. A much viler act than a mere grudge fight. Is this what you thought of my orders? I will take this matter to each of your houses and get a thorough explanation from them!”
“Marshal, you only heard his side...” Huangpu Qingtian was flustered for the first time.
Raising an eyebrow, Dugu Zhantian’s eyes gleamed, “Oh, one-sided? Ha-ha-ha, alright then, let’s see what the witnesses say!”
Dugu Zhantian turned to the ones on the ground and asked, “What Zhuo Fan said, is it true?”
They looked at each other, clearly getting his drift. Since Dugu Zhantian was siding with Zhuo Fan, of course they nodded.
Especially the Five Tigers of Tianyu. These guys were quite frank and upright but not dumb. Of course they’d help their kin!
Face twitching, Huangpu Qingtian was swept by anger. [They’re clearly aiming for us!]
“Marshal, I thought you were a righteous man, but now I see...” Huangpu Qingtian clenched his fists and jaw.
With a bright smile, Dugu Zhantian mocked, “See what? You heard them. Is there anything you would like to add?”
“Humph, they are clearly siding with Zhuo Fan while on our side Lin Xuanfeng had his leg ripped out!” Huangpu Qingtian was finding it hard to restrain his towering anger, evident from his loud voice.
Dugu Zhantian roared back, “You have one victim while they are all down! So who’s side is the real victim here? Who was it that harassed others with their power? Are you so damn blind?”
Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes twitched. He had never been so furious in his life.
Most of all, never ever had he been taken advantage of!
Yet here, against Zhuo Fan, he could do nothing as the man had spun a trap around him. Even Dugu Zhantian was against him!
He, who had always seen himself as a king, an emperor, was now reaching the limits of his patience!
“Soaring Demonic Dragon, your title sure is apt in going after me, Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord. Humph, we’ll just have to see how you will end!” Huangpu Qingtian squinted then up and left.
He knew arguing any longer would be a waste of time.
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow and pointed at him, “Marshal Dugu, you’re just gonna let him go? He just threatened me! My poor little life is on the line here...”
Hum~
A sudden ripple spread and Dugu Zhantian jumped in front of Zhuo Fan, releasing a ripple of his own.
A boom reverberated as the space warped visibly.
Huangpu Qingtian snorted at Zhuo Fan in anger, “Soaring Demonic Dragon, you’re lucky this time. But when the Esoteric Debate starts, when the seven houses battle, hope you’ll have the same amount of luck then!”
And he took his two allies while dragging Lin Xuanfeng with them.
Dugu Zhantian looked at him in shock, “This kid, he is a peak Profound Heaven expert yet can use killing with intent that only a Radiant Stage expert can use. He truly is the number one talent in Tianyu. His future is limitless!”
The others jerked in fright. Huangpu Qingtian had long surpassed them. He was on a whole different level!
The next time they meet, they might not even come out alive. Against killing with intent, no amount of speed would help.
Zhuo Fan only chuckled, “A mere bluff!”
Dugu Zhantian towered behind him and cuffed him, “What damn bluff? That’s power! Do you have any idea how dangerous that was? I know you’re a body cultivator and perhaps can win in a brawl against him, but that was a soul attack, killing with intent! You’d never even realize when your life was taken from you!
“I see no way for you to win against that monster!” Dugu Zhantian eyed them and sighed.
The others frowned and sighed as well. Zhuo Fan had given a thread of hope to all, but now it was all crushed to dust.
No one beneath a Radiant Stage could survive an intent attack.
Zhuo Fan had his freaky ability but not even that would save him.
Yet the man in question hardly cared, he had stopped caring for as long as five years ago...

chapters.title: Chapter 258, Conscription
chapters.content:
Chapter 258, Conscription
Dugu Zhantian had some soldiers take the wounded to the marshal’s residence for immediate treatment. Yet none of them noticed a spindly figure further away, watching them.
Upon closer look, one would identify him as Unwonted Contriver Leng Wuchang, Regent Estate’s steward!
Leng Wuchang twirled his mustache as he kept watching, Zhuo Fan in particular, “This kid is not as heartless as I thought...”
It had been six hours since they arrived at the marshal’s temporary residence in Dragon Cloud City. Time in which the wounded were placed in a side wing and administered pills.
Luo Yunchang and Ning’er, the only ones who came out unharmed from this ordeal were the caretakers. As for Zhuo Fan, he was there as well, expressing his heartfelt thanks to his three paralyzed allies.
“Thank you all for such hard work. If it weren’t for your help, our clan’s line would’ve been severed!” Zhuo Fan held each of their hands.
Long Jie and Long Kui felt odd seeing the kind and gentle smile on his face.
They had been arduous in cultivating these past five years, just so they could bridge the gap between them and this monster. And yet he just showed up and instead of getting closer, they had only fallen farther behind.
Even though this guy was still a shameless Bone Tempering cultivator, how could his power be classified as one?
As this was Long Xingyun’s first time seeing this freak in the flesh and in action, he was quite moved, “Brother Zhuo, now I see what my father was thinking. Only after seeing you have I realized how much time I’ve been wasting.”
“Sigh, youth is wasted on the young. But even so, you should live your life to the fullest and take some time off to enjoy it. Ha-ha-ha, don’t take it to heart!” Zhuo Fan patted his shoulder.
But the more he paid attention the more Long Xingyun felt it was fake. [Is this your way of consoling me?]
Xie Tianshang’s eyes were filled with fighting spirit, wishing nothing more than to jump on his legs and have a go with the man, “Zhuo Fan, once I’m healed, how about we have a match?”
Zhuo Fan blinked, completely not getting what he was going for, “We just met and never have I gotten on your bad side, so why do you want to fight me?”
“Ignore him. My elder brother is a martial fanatic. He wants to fight any expert that catches his eye!” Xie Tianyang jabbed. Having known Zhuo Fan for so long, he had no qualms whatsoever.
Zhuo Fan nodded, [Ah, another one. I see, I see. Just like Elder Li. It’s best that I keep my distance.] He wasn’t so idle as to waste time sparring with a martial fanatic every day.
So Zhuo Fan gave him a wide berth, going over Xie Tianyang.
“Hey, wait, you didn’t answer me...”
Xie Tianshang watched Zhuo Fan with a fervent gaze. He was sorely wishing right now that he could just jump and exchange hundreds of moves with Zhuo Fan. But would Zhuo Fan listen? He treated martial fanatics as basket cases.
Tangling with him would only net Zhuo Fan a huge waste of time.
And so, Xie Tianshang’s grumblings were firmly and undoubtedly ignored. Zhuo Fan walked next to his little brother instead, and knocked his head a few times, “Brother Xie, you did a good job today. I must say, you sure gave your all for Ning’er.”
“Zip it. My life belongs to Ning’er!” Rolling his eyes, Xie Tianyang was quite frank, making the nearby Xue Ningxiang blush and glare back. She was clearly signaling not to spout such things around Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan laughed carefree.
Xie Tianyang’s eyes turned serious, his voice tinted with worry, “Zhuo Fan, do you always stand out wherever you go? You’ve got my Ning’er to swoon over you every time she sees you. Can’t you tone it down a little so I can have a shot?”
Shuddering, Zhuo Fan remained silent.
Xie Tianyang seemed to be joking, but how could Zhuo Fan not sense the worry within. If this went on, the three’s relationship would become more complicated or, worse, break apart!
Zhuo Fan sighed after a moment, “Sorry, that’s how heavens made me. If I don’t show off, who else will? Just focus on getting better!”
Patting his shoulder, Zhuo Fan left with a stiff smile.
Xie Tianyang laughed dejectedly. He knew Zhuo Fan had yet to make a decision on this and was making a tactical retreat. Or was it an attack? Although he made himself seem ruthless, who could guard against feelings creeping up on oneself?
He went around spreading thanks to all the clan’s helpers, including but not limited to the four tigers. But the tigers saw him as an enemy, something he couldn’t wrap his head around as to why.
[I stole no wife of yours, so what the hell is with the glares?]
But when he reached the final patient, he spun on his leg and walked away.
“Stop!”
The charming voice came from Chu Qingcheng, who was watching him in reproach, “Y-you aren’t going to even talk to me?”
Iris and Peony Overseers were staring daggers. As if accusing him of abandoning his wife!
“Uh, thank you Drifting Flowers Edifices, for helping our clan in our desperate hour...”
“That’s not it and you know it!” Chu Qingcheng cut him off, “I just want to know why. Why didn’t you see me one last time before leaving Drifting Flowers City?”
Steeling himself, Zhuo Fan said, “I killed and took what I needed. I fulfilled my goal and had no reason to stay.”
“No reason at all?” Chu Qingcheng blinked. Her pretty eyes demanded an answer.
Zhuo Fan didn’t know how to respond. Then a sudden giggle came, “Steward Zhuo, Marshal is calling you. Leave things here to me!”
Luo Yunchang came over with a smile, faking obliviousness. Saved by the bell, Zhuo Fan grabbed the excuse like his lifeline and bobbed his head, “Then I’ll go right now. Young miss, take good care of them!”
And he was gone, despite the doe eyes Chu Qingcheng was giving him.
Luo Yunchang turned a hard stare at Chu Qingcheng, “Edifice Lord Chu, Steward Zhuo is a boor. If he has hurt you with his words or actions, please forgive him. I’ll be taking care of you in his place!”
Luo Yunchang’s words were full of propriety and good nature, but the true meaning was, [He’s mine!]
Chu Qingcheng had taken care of Drifting Flowers Edifices for so many years since an even younger age than Luo Yunchang. How could she not hear the veiled threat? She laughed coldly, “You’re far too kind. Zhuo Fan’s transgressions are too grave to measure. How could I possibly ask Clan Head to take the blame? I will have Zhuo Fan supply me with the appropriate resolution. But thank you for your offer, young miss.”
I.e. [This is between me and Zhuo Fan. You’ve got no business here, so scram!]
Sparks were flying off between them soon after.
The others looked away from the cat fight and lamented.
[Sigh, this is a woman’s war. It’s best we don’t get caught in between.] But Xue Ningxiang looked on in distress, feeling somewhat excluded...
Going back to the culprit behind all this, Zhuo Fan was speeding towards Marshal’s house across from the wounded ward in jubilation. [Perfect timing!] He was truly caught in the trap back there.
Who would have thought facing Chu Qingcheng was more exhausting than fighting Huangpu Qingtian! He’d rather go against a hundred Huangpu Qingtians than see Chu Qingcheng again.
But when he entered Marshal’s home, the old guy laughed heartily, putting him on high alert.
“Ha-ha-ha, you came, kid. Sit, I have something to tell you!” Dugu Zhantian laughed and gestured at the chair nearby.
Zhuo Fan was on guard as he eased into the chair. Dugu Zhantian’s critical eye from his seat of honor had Zhuo Fan’s hair stand on end.
“Uh, Ol’ Marshal, you wanted to see me?” Zhuo Fan broke the silence.
Dugu Zhantian grinned, “It’s nothing much, just your conscription!”
“Conscription?” Zhuo Fan shook his head vehemently, “No no no. I am not army material. Find someone else!”
Glaring, Dugu Zhantian’s beard trembled as he cursed, “Cut the crap! Who on earth is born a soldier? Even that brat Yunhai got trained into shape by me! With your talents, a year tops, and you’ll be taking my job!”
“If you’re so confident, go find someone else. Why do you want me?” Zhuo Fan shook his head.
Dugu Zhantian sighed and his eyes were glazed with worry, “It’s easy to train an army, but it’s so hard to find a good array master! In the field of war, there are many array masters using their skills in the form of formations. We are sorely lacking in array masters and that has made our recent losses disastrous!”
“Don’t look at me. I’m a meathead. I don’t know anything when it comes to arrays or formations!” Zhuo Fan made up a lie.
But Dugu Zhantian wouldn’t have it. He had looked into the kid before calling him. Such a flimsy lie wouldn’t fly with him, “He-he-he, oh please. I already know everything. Your old Clan Head has long been dead and you are the one running the show. Including the four 5th grade arrays!”
Dugu Zhantian’s eyes shined when he reached this point. He was sorely lacking an outstanding array master and wanted to have Zhuo Fan without fail. The latter felt trapped in the old guy’s gaze and didn’t know how to get away.
He felt like crying.
This was exactly why he wanted to slink through Dragon Cloud City and never cross paths with the Marshal. He already saw this coming and wanted to avoid it for as long as possible...

chapters.title: Chapter 259, The God of War’s Fright
chapters.content:
Chapter 259, The God of War’s Fright
“Ol’ Marshal, I truly cannot do this. Please find someone else!” Zhuo Fan shook his head and rose to leave.
Whoosh~
In a flash of blue, the Dragonslaying Crescent Blade was nailed in front of him, followed by, “Why?”
Zhuo Fan was in despair, [Isn’t it obvious? I don’t want to!] Since he was asked for a reason, Zhuo Fan had to oblige. So he stuck out his neck and refused, “They say that a good man doesn’t enlist...”
“Bullshit!”
In reply to his most eloquent words, Dugu Zhantian spat in his face, “Those are the words of friggin’ morons. Zhuo Fan, you are a wise man, so how can you lower yourself to a commoner’s thinking? Also, did you not take the helm of the Luo clan after the Clan Head’s death, looking after the siblings? Why then?
“I only see loyalty. Kid, your actions speak for yourself, of your loyalty and devotion! So what’s the problem with being loyal to one’s nation. Isn’t that the same? It should be the same thing to you! Why do you insist on avoiding enlisting?”
The walls were quite thin here and the wounded next door heard Dugu Zhantian’s raving loud and clear. [Dugu Zhantian wants Zhuo Fan in the army!]
[But can he rein in this Soaring Demonic Dragon?]
Luo Yunchang and Chu Qingcheng thought this as well. Even though their glaring never faltered, their ears were idle to pick up on the Marshal’s shouts!
Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan gritted his teeth. [This old guy just won’t quit.] And sighed, “Marshal Dugu, we are neither friends nor enemies. Please refrain from dragging me into this hell!”
“How is the army and fighting for your nation, hell?” Dugu Zhantian was stunned.
Zhuo Fan squinted and roared, “As they say, after three years in the army, even an ugly broad would look like a courtesan! This will deal a devastating blow to my standards and ruin my prospects to raise a family!”
Pff!
The girls in the wounded ward stifled their giggles. While Luo Yunchang and Chu Qingcheng sure had an active imagination, evident by their red cheeks.
Then their eyes met and jealousy reared its ugly head. [Which one of us is that punk going to take to raise a family?]
The Four Tigers of Tianyu and Luo Yunhai were awkward, to say the least. They’ve been in the army for five years. Did that mean their standards were out of whack?
But Dugu Zhantian’s shout came soon after to save their image, “More crap! Where the hell did you hear that nonsense? How could three years lead to such a drastic change?”
The five in the ward nodded. [Well said, Marshal!]
Dugu Zhantian then followed with, “That only happens after five years! My four godsons need six years, by the looks of them, to see any girl a babe. As for Yunhai, it’s too soon to tell!”
The five wanted to crawl into a corner and die. The feel of the others’ eyes on them only made it worse!
[Godfather, enlist him if you want to, but why in god’s name are you dragging us into this?]
[It was fine and all if these old army stories helped but all you are doing is making yourself look bad! Us as well!]
[What a rotten godfather!]
The five sighed and buried their heads in the pillows...
Dugu Zhantian was being serious now, “None of that matters. Didn’t I tell you? You’ll be a soldier for one year then be my staff officer. Those things don’t apply to you!”
“Why not make me one from the start?” Zhuo Fan scratched his head.
Dugu Zhantian squinted and snapped, “Impossible! In my army one needs to do military service. One can only be promoted based on merits. How can I just make you one from the start? Everyone will object. But don’t worry, once in the corps, I’ll give you plenty of chances to show your ability and you’ll be promoted in no time!”
Zhuo Fan sighed. Seeing Dugu Zhantian so stubborn, like a hustler, he left Zhuo Fan without a way to deal with him.
“Fine, fine, but on one condition!” Zhuo Fan nodded in the end.
Dugu Zhantian’s eyes sparkled, “Name it! I’ll do my best to accommodate you! “
“Uh, Ol’ Marshal, would you be so kind as to lend me your status for a short month? I could get used to being a Marshal myself!”
“You think the army is a game?” Dugu Zhantian shook his head, but then he eyed Zhuo Fan skeptically, “What for?”
“What else? To sweep the land and pacify the empire!” Zhuo Fan roared his loyalty.
Dugu Zhantian said in a rush, “Stop messing around. This army can’t move as you wish!”
“He-he-he, it’s fine. Won’t I have the appropriate rank a year later? At that time, I can just kill and smash whoever and whenever.” Zhuo Fan giggled.
Panicking inside, Dugu Zhantian now realized he had only paid attention to Zhuo Fan’s talent and not his many remarkable ‘feats’.
[I can’t take the same approach I took with Luo Yunhai when teaching him. Or when he gets the army at his beck and call, he’d leave the nation wide open for attack!] His eyes were swiveling, unclear what choice was best here.
[No, I can’t have him fly through the ranks. I’ll have to stamp out his rebellious nature in the army!]
Zhuo Fan had a knowing grin, “He-he-he, I know what you’re planning. But no matter, I’m the best there is when it comes to roping someone to my side! It won’t take me even a year to turn the three million Dugu Army into the Zhuo Army. At that point, being a General or not would hardly make a difference!”
“You don’t say. I am giving my all here, but who knows when we will have to face Regent Estate on the field of battle. But if you think you can wrest control of one of the Four Pillars, the empire’s army, then be my guest.”
Zhuo Fan laughed, “I have never thought about it like that. But now, Marshal, you have to enlist me! Even if you have your whole army infected with gayness rather than some twisted broads, I’d still go for it!”
“No!”
It seems someone had a change of heart. Dugu Zhantian was frantically shaking his hands and sweating buckets!
[That was close! I almost welcomed the devil with open hands!] Granted he was talented, but if there was one thing he truly excelled at, it was blowing things out of proportion! [In the off chance I can’t tame him, the Dugu Army will be under his thumb and will corrupt the empire’s greatest weapon!]
[I better reconsider whether to let this guy in!]
Dugu Zhantian said bashfully, “Uh, Zhuo Fan, since you find enlisting to be such a pain. I won’t force you...”
“No, I think it’ll be a blast, Ol’ Marshal...”
“No no no, I’ve never forced anyone to do anything in my life. It’s best you stay and look after the Luo clan. Oh right, the three house lords are here as well. I better go see them!”
“What about my enlistment...”
Zhuo Fan shouted after the scampering Dugu Zhantian.
Zhuo Fan watched the mighty and awe-inspiring Dugu turn into a scaredy cat with a snicker.
[Tch, I get far more out of developing the Luo clan than stealing your three million army!]
[Then again, having Dugu Army by my side is not bad either!] Zhuo Fan mused, his eyes flashing.
Dugu Zhantian just left the room and turned to the wounded ward.
It seemed that Sword Marquise Abode, Veiled Dragon Pavilion, and Drifting Flowers Edifices’ leaders were also present. They all saluted Dugu Zhantian, “Thank you Marshal for coming to their rescue!”
“No thanks needed. This is my responsibility. Although someone else saved them in the end, while I was only a mediator!” Dugu Zhantian waved.
The leaders chuckled.
Grandmother then frowned, “Marshal, I was meaning to ask. Are you intent on conscripting Zhuo Fan? Could I ask you to postpone it until after the Esoteric Debate?”
“Of course. As for conscripting, I still need to consider it. there’s no need to fret!” Dugu Zhantian stated.
Zhuo Fan’s vision of the army had scared the crap out of him!
[The kid seems capable of anything! He may very well have a way of turning the Dugu Army into his personal army!]
And he wasn’t about to give his army away just for one array master! Dugu Zhantian was thankful he came back to his senses and avoided a disaster!
Zhuo Fan took this moment to enter and greet the house lords.
The three nodded in reply. They could finally breathe easier seeing him safe and sound.
To be blunt, there would be no Luo clan without Zhuo Fan, the truest underdog. Luo clan wouldn’t stand a chance in the Esoteric Debate, whether as an ally or enemy.
But with Zhuo Fan back in town, the clan was in full force.
“Steward Zhuo, the entire Luo clan is injured. We can’t make it to tomorrow’s fight! Will you, as their steward step forth?” Grandmother smiled widely, hoping to see the miracle that was Zhuo Fan in action after a five year break.
Shrugging, Zhuo Fan said, “Of course, it is my duty to represent the Luo clan! It is time for the Luo clan to stand abreast with all of you!”
“That will depend on Steward Zhuo’s first battle!” Long Yifey raised an eyebrow.
They all looked at each other and burst out laughing, all eager to see Zhuo Fan put on a good show tomorrow...

chapters.title: Chapter 260, We Will Kill Zhuo Fan
chapters.content:
Chapter 260, We Will Kill Zhuo Fan
The next day, Dragon Cloud City’s fighting stage was enveloped by a roaring crowd shouting their cheers.
On the stage, two youths stood thrilled and panting, surrounded by either dead or wounded people.
“The winner of today’s battle hails from Crescent Sword City, the Xue clan! They are advancing to the final battle!” A Profound Heaven expert stepped on stage and gestured at the youths.
The crowd exploded with applause, raising the excitement of the two. They left the stage and walked to their cheering clan.
“Big brother, second brother, congratulations!”
Xue Ningxiang gave them a hug and a sweet smile.
The two were Xue Gang and Xue Lin. After the horrors of Blue Expanse City, Xie Tianyang saved them and their clan became Sword Marquise Abode’s vassal.
It was the only way they could have joined the Esoteric Debate.
“Gang’er, Lin’er, you’ve done well. You are now ready to join the final battle and help Sword Marquise Abode’s young masters in their fight!” Xue Wanlong laughed with pride, “Remember, never let down our clan and protect the two young masters!”
Patriarch Xue Dingtian nodded at the side.
Thanks to Xie Tianyang, their clan was under Sword Marquise Abode’s wing, cared for and well supplied. But this left them uneasy, and they were going to use this chance to repay their help! This was the reason for joining the Esoteric Debate.
Xue Gang and Xue Lin nodded, filled with battle spirit.
Xie Tianyang stood next to Xue Ningxiang, sighing, “Uncle, why did you let the brothers join such a cruel battle? This time’s battle will be far more deadly and vicious than any of the past ones. I fear...”
“Second young master, I have made my decision. We cannot go on receiving Sword Marquise Abode’s grace without giving anything back. Please give us this chance to show our gratitude!” Xue Wanlong cupped his hands.
Xie Tianyang sighed.
The Profound Heaven expert on the stage suddenly said, “The next fight will be between Drifting Flowers City’s Dong clan and Flood City’s Yu clan!”
Two familiar figures walked on stage. Xie Tianyang’s eyes brightened, “Who knew we’d see them here?”
“Aren’t they brother Dong and sister Wan’er? You know them as well?” Xue Ningxiang was startled.
Xie Tianyang looked at her instead, “Ning’er, how do you know them?”
“Drifting Flowers Edifices and Sword Marquise Abode are allies. We met when the two houses gathered for negotiation. Brother Dong is somewhat frivolous, but Wan’er is very nice!” Ning’er smiled, “How do you know them? Disciples of the seven houses hardly ever meet with people from second rate clans.”
“Uh, we met in Drifting Flowers City. I hear that Dong Xiaowan and the kid have something going on between them.” Xie Tianyang grinned, thinking of having a little payback.
Xue Ningxiang looked closer at Dong Xiaowan and muttered, “No wonder she never said anything when the topic about who she likes came up...”
Correct, the two Dong siblings were those Dongs.
Because of their ties with Zhuo Fan back in Drifting Flowers City and having gotten familiar with Drifting Flowers Edifices’ leaders, the Dong clan had been on a swift rise. They had long outstripped the title of vassal clan and moved to Drifting Flowers City to become their trusted aide.
The old master of the Dong clan couldn’t be happier and stated that they had to go and see their most treasured benefactor in the flesh.
Of course, such a thing wasn’t so easy to achieve, not with how busy Zhuo Fan was. If he wasn’t blowing something up, he was beating the life out of someone. The likes of him could hardly squeeze a meeting between his murderous rampage and endless mayhem.
Thanks to Drifting Flowers Edifices’ help, Dong Tianba had entered the Profound Heaven Stage, displaying his majestic air on today’s stage. In but half an hour, he and his sister won over their opponents and arrived next to their clansmen and friends.
“Young master Xie, uncle xie, sir Xie, brothers Xie, how do you do?”
Dong Tianba cupped his hands in pride. Dong Xiaowan bowed as well with a smile. The others nodded, while Xue Gang had eyes only for Dong Xiaowan and her charming smile.
Everyone could tell what he was thinking.
“Brother Xue, how have you been? I never thought our clans would enter the final battle. We will be fighting alongside it seems, ha-ha-ha...” A portly man came over.
Dong Tianba and Dong Xiaowan cupped their hands, “Dad!”
Xue clan greeted in kind, but only when he saw Xie Tianyang did the old man greet back.
He was the Dong Clan Head.
Dong Clan Head pointed at Xue Gang, “Young master is of great talent. Could I be so bold as to ask if you’re married?”
“Uh, no.” Xue Dingtian smiled, his meaning clear.
Dong Clan Head nodded and smiled at his daughter, “What a fine coincidence, neither is my daughter. I find our clans so friendly that I was wondering...”
“Dad!” Dong Xiaowan gave him the stink-eye and was sullen.
Xue Ningxiang could see herself in her and shook her head. The two already had someone and were not going to just change their minds at the drop of the hat.
Meanwhile, the Profound Heaven expert on the stage said, “The next fight is between Sun Spire City’s Hong clan and Blue Expanse City’s Sun clan!”
Shuddering, the Xue clan turned to the stage. Blue Expanse City used to be their turf while being Hell Valley’s vassal. Since betraying their patron, Blue Expanse City fell under another clan’s jurisdiction.
Bluntly put, the Sun clan was their replacement, Hell Valley’s brand new lap dog.
The Sun clan only sent a man and a woman to fight against fifty Bone Tempering experts led by two Profound Heaven cultivators.
Such power among second rate clans made it a seeded clan, closely approaching the qualifications to be a first rate clan.
Against such strength, the Sun clan sent merely two, a really odd pair. Their eyes released a bloody glow, and closely resembled monsters rather than humans. Not even their appearances could be distinguished.
The sight of them standing there sent shivers among many. As if they were demons who sprang out of hell. But upon closer look, they were only peak Bone Tempering cultivators.
“He-he-he, two peak Bone Tempering cultivators want to mess with fifty experts?” The leading youth snickered, “From your demonic look, living must’ve been hard and you’ve come for the sweet release of death, right? Ha-ha-ha...”
The others laughed as well.
That demonic man however was wrapped in black energy as it suddenly jumped from him with a roar.
A veritable fountain of blood bloomed, while the Hong clan youth fell with a perplexed look.
He was still wondering how a peak Bone Tempering cultivator killed him.
Sss~
The others gasped. Hong clan’s laughter died and watched the pair of enemies in shock.
How could a fresh Profound Heaven expert die in one blow?
[A sneak attack for sure!]
With a shout, the fifty men from Hong clan stormed the pair. The two only had a creepy grin as they turned into black mist and roamed among them.
The slaughter began. Not of the pair, but of those fifty experts as the two crazed monsters were unleashed upon them.
Wails, sobbing, and horror grated on the audience’s ears. In just fifteen minutes, they were the only ones standing, while the corpses around them had their throats ripped out.
Blood soaked into the arena and the dead stare of the bodies gave a glimpse into the cruelty they had just suffered.
Xue Ningxiang had long since covered her eyes. Xie Tianyang’s brow was furrowed, [What made these guys act with such brutality?]
The girl on stage suddenly snapped her head back and pointed at the Xue clan with a nasty grin, “Traitor of Hell Valley, you will die in the final battle, by our hands. None of you will live. We will cleanse the Hell Valley of its traitors! Your time will soon come, hi-hi-hi...”
The Xue clan felt a shiver run down their very core.
This pair was way too abnormal. Not just the sons, but even the father and patriarch felt their hair stand on end.
Xie Tianyang stepped up and shielded Xue Ningxiang as he roared, “Stop barking! I would like to see you try and touch the Xue clan!”
“Second young master Xie, our house lord’s son will deal with you and we will deal with the traitorous Xue clan!” Snickering, the girl threw her head back.
The creepy way she talked and her posture only worked to deepen one’s fear.
The man next to her said, “Don’t forget our main objective, the Luo clan. Xue clan is just a side dish!”
“You’re after the Luo clan?” Xue Ningxiang was worried.
On the other hand, Xie Tianyang felt relief. A few days back he would’ve been worried as well, but not now.
Because the Luo clan had recovered their pillar, the Demon Archon Zhuo Fan.
With him around, these weirdos looked like imps in comparison. Going after the Luo clan was a death sentence.
But the man saw Xue Ningxiang’s distress and reveled in it, “Yes, we will find the Luo clan and slaughter them all! Especially that Zhuo Fan. We will tear him limb from limb!”
Xue Ningxiang’s pure heart was stuck in her throat, vexed over Zhuo Fan’s safety.
[Brother Zhuo, two bad men are after you!]
While Xie Tianyang almost burst out laughing, [Dude, have you even seen Zhuo Fan? Have you seen his power? What is your boasting based on, hot air? Not even a moron will believe such a lame joke!]
But then he saw Xue Ningxiang sick with worry and amended his thoughts with a twitch of his cheek, [Ning’er excluded.]
She was no moron, just naive...

chapters.title: Chapter 261, Limelight
chapters.content:
Chapter 261, Limelight
“Look, Hell Valley’s men are here!”
Someone from the crowd shouted and everyone turned their heads to see You Wanshan and his elder detail. He stood on the highest point with a sombre look, flanked by You Ming and the rest of their other disciples participating in the final battle.
As this place was the fighting grounds for third and second rate clans, with how not even first rate clans would come here to watch, least of all the seven houses, there were no honorary seats for them.
What stirred the biggest shock was the sudden appearance of Hell Valley, taking seat at the highest position. They could see the whole stage from there, but it was also a strategic position to emphasize the usual disdain the seven houses had for these puny clans.
But what was up with this sudden arrival? Who had caught their eye?
Were they going to enjoy the show alongside them, or was there a new star on the rise no one knew about? If it was the latter, who was this person and what was he capable of to garner such ostentatious audience?
The crowd grew restless with their speculations.
Sun clan’s creepy guy noticed You Wanshan’s imposing figure and showed a morbid smile, “See? Valley Lord You came to personally watch us crush your clans. This is how much Hell Valley values us!”
“Yeah, we’re not like those Xue traitors. Valley Lord finds us indispensable!” Sun clan’s creepy girl showed a morbid smile herself.
Xue clan only gave the duo a cursory glance, while being concerned about Hell Valley’s real intentions. Hell Valley came to cheer for the Sun clan? How is that even possible, when they have never shown such care for any vassal before?
Xie Tianyang mocked, “Cocky brats, You Wanshan isn’t so bored as to watch a couple of aberrations.”
“Say that again! What else would Valley Lord You be here for? There’s only us around who is Hell Valley’s vassal!” The girl roared.
Xie Tianyang shrugged.
The seven houses only ever cared about each other and never about some squirming ants trying to get some praise. [You’re disillusioned if you think he came here to cheer for you!]
And then another sudden cry of shock came, followed by another unexpected arrival.
And while Hell Valley’s men were emitting deadly auras, the newcomers were graceful women with thin veils.
Drifting Flowers Edifices!
Grandmother was in the lead as Chu Qingcheng was still nursing her wound. Behind her were her entire overseer contingent and the Drifting Flowers Edifices’ disciples participating in the final battle.
Even Xiao Dandan was among them, darting her eyes around and looking for her special someone.
[He-he-he, here comes another lovesick lass. That punk will be so annoyed], Xie Tianyang snickered. Dong Clan Head puffed up his chest and took on a prideful air, “Ha-ha-ha, I didn’t expect Drifting Flowers Edifices’ overseers to come support us. Our Dong clan is so cherished. We may be Drifting Flowers Edifices’ trusted aide, but to receive such care, ha-ha-ha...”
The guy was grinning from ear to ear and making the Xue clan envious.
His position seemed to be so high that even the Edifice Lord came in person.
Only Xie Tianyang sighed.
[It seems narcissism is an inherent trait of these vassals, not just aberrations are susceptible to it but even normal people. What in the hell gave you the idea that the seven houses came to see you specifically?]
Then came the third cry of the day. Xue clansmen watched overwhelmed with joy.
Why? Because Sword Marquise Abode’s Xie Xiaofeng was leading Xie Tianshang and his elders over.
Patriarch Xue Dingtian was touched to the core as he showed off to the Dong Clan Head, “Ha-ha-ha, Clan Head, Sword Marquise Abode values us quite a lot as well...”
“Wait!”
He didn’t get to finish his haughty words, as Xie Tianyang interrupted him, “Everyone, I know fully well my words may sound crass, but could you cool off for a second and stop with the self-important attitude? Those house lords haven’t even looked at you once, so how can you say they’ve come for you?”
The sudden wake up call made them realize the wisdom in his words.
[If not for us, then who?] This was a fighting stage for the seven houses’ vassals!
Xie Tianyang shook his head.
If there was anything the seven houses paid attention to, besides each other of course, was strength. [Who else but that punk could stir up so many of them to come here?]
While they were vexed by this conundrum, Pill King Hall appeared with a fourth cry. Yan Bogong led Yan Bangui and Yan Fu with his elders over. They were soon followed by Merry Woods’s House Lord Lin coming with his elders and a bouncing Lin Xuanfeng.
After a night of healing, Lin Xuanfeng’s wound was closed. Even though he hopped about with a pale face. The audience was amazed, [Is this Forest Fleeting Dragon, one of the Six Dragons and One Phoenix? Why does he have only one leg? How would he fleet through the forest now?]
Few were aware of the circumstances regarding Forest Fleeting Dragon’s misery. How the vile Soaring Demonic Dragon ripped his leg clean off!
But the biggest shock of all was what came next.
The head of the seven houses, Regent Estate!
Huangpu Tianyuan was leading the group, with Regent Estate’s steward, Leng Wuchang on his left, and his eldest, the head of Six Dragons and One Phoenix, Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord Huangpu Qingtian on his right. Behind them was a team of Profound Heaven elders, thirty in number!
The frightening display made everyone’s hair stand on end. The other six houses also paused at their entrance.
Regent Estate’s power was unquestionably the highest among the houses!
It had the ambition to swallow the others for good reason. It would’ve been a waste of their might if they didn’t aim for at least this much.
Under the riveting gazes of the crowd, Huangpu Tianyuan made his way forward with a regal air and boundless power that stopped anyone from breathing within three hundred meters.
Only when Regent Estate took the foremost position did the man slowly withdraw his power, but the damage, or deterrence, was done. In his wake, the people were left shivering and gasping.
That was enough to rouse up even the narcissistic trio of clans from their arrogance. The presence of all the seven houses had nothing to do with them at all.
Thinking about what loudmouths they were seconds ago, they started blushing like crazy.
The Dong, Xue, and even the Sun clan’s aberrations were stiff and awkward.
This only helped to fuel their curiosity. Why were they all here? For whom?
Xie Tianyang knew it all along of course.
The Profound Heaven expert on the stage stood on pins and needles under the stare of all those mighty figures. He shakily took out the roster.
He was the king of this stage, but not anymore. ‘Cause now he was a bottom feeder among all these big shots!
He swallowed down while shaking and shouted, “The next fight will be between Zephyr City’s Wan clan and Windgaze City’s Luo clan!”
Every head turned to the dark entrance of the stage to see the greatest underdog in this Esoteric Debate, Luo clan!
Even though the Luo clan’s 28 strong men were quite something, the more they advanced the harder it became. Case in point, they left the last battle while supporting each other.
Their opponent, the Wan clan, was a renowned second rate clan. It even had three Profound Heaven youths.
The crowd was eagerly awaiting for the Luo clan, but their prospects at winning were slim at best.
Tap, tap, tap...
A light noise was heard as Luo Yunhai was coming out on crutches, leaning on his sister towards the stage.
The crowd’s shock passed and was replaced by sighs.
They all saw Luo Yunhai’s valor and might, fearless as a tiger. And this tiger was an indispensable force in the Luo clan’s team.
Yet now he had an unexplained wound, which only crippled their chance of victory even more.
Wan clan’s twenty strong men were already on the stage and were now snickering. [Victory’s ours!]
But then a plain figure slowly made itself noticed by walking behind the siblings. He caught the attention of all the houses.
Regent Estate, Hell Valley, and their other two allies bore a deep hatred for Zhuo Fan. They suddenly released a deadly aura that made the audience shiver.
[It all makes sense now. The seven houses came for him!]
Playing with his flickering Thunder Ring, Zhuo Fan walked without a care in the world. His deep gaze, his far off look seemed to find everyone beneath him.
This was how Zhuo Fan followed after Luo Yunchang, with a charming and faint smile.
The biggest shock was received by those who didn’t know Zhuo Fan.
[Who is he? Why are the seven houses here for him?]
Dong Tianba and Dong Xiaowan went slack jawed. They never ever thought they’d meet him here.
Dong Xiaowan in particular, her gaze was filled with complicated emotions. Joy, sadness, and a hint of relief...
Xue Wanlong and Xue Dingtian were shocked as well. They never thought that the young brat they met in Allbeast Mountain Range would appear here.
“S-Soaring Demonic Dragon!”
The shout had caused another round of shock among the crowd as their eyes never strayed from Zhuo Fan!
[He is the Luo clan’s strongest? The same Soaring Demonic Dragon on par with Six Dragons and One Phoenix?]
The Luo clan’s main force has come out in the open!
The crowd watched eagerly, thrilled to witness a good show...

chapters.title: Chapter 262, Cheerleaders/Groupies
chapters.content:
Chapter 262, Cheerleaders/Groupies
“Old Pang, stay here and look after them.” Zhuo Fan spoke behind him to Captain Pang and the young guards before walking on stage alone.
The crowd wondered, [Alone against Wan clan’s 20 strongest?] But then recalled that he had a title akin to the Six Dragons and One Phoenix and got excited at the prospect.
This was what everyone wanted to see. The extent of power one man possessed to make the seven houses pay so much attention to.
“Brother Zhuo, fingers crossed!” Xue Ningxiang cheered with an adorable face.
Staggering for a second there, Zhuo Fan waved back slightly with a smile.
Dong Xiaowan waved as well, but found him not even noticing her and was peeved, “Ning’er, are you and brother Zhuo close?”
“He saved my clan’s lives!” Xue Ningxiang nodded, but then found Dong Xiaowan gloomy and mumbled, “Uh, sister Wan’er, sorry…”
“It’s fine. He never even looked at me anyway.” Dong Xiaowan shook her head sullen.
Dong Clan Head gleaned something out of all of this and asked Dong Tianba, “Is that youth who I think it is?”
Dong Tianba nodded and sighed.
His sister had been lovestruck since back in Drifting Flowers City. Her crush never spared her a glance, while she pined for him every moment.
[I can’t tell if she is foolish or silly.]
“Darling, good luck! Crush them all!” A cute voice came from Drifting Flowers Edifices’ side and slammed into the ears of the audience. Xiao Dandan was practically jumping in her seat, gesticulating wildly to make sure he saw her.
Zhuo Fan held his head, [What’s this idiot doing here? Is Drifting Flowers Edifices so understaffed? How is she fit to join the seven houses’ final battle with her cultivation? Cannon fodder is more like it!]
Pulling Xiao Dandan back down, Peony Overseer cursed, “Why can’t you act proper instead of some lovesick maiden?”
“Humph, me and darling have already tied the knot. He’ll come around!” Xiao Dandan pouted, still clinging to her hope.
Sighing, Peony Overseer said. “This girl has lost it.”
On the other hand, Xie Tianyang was laughing his head off, using this chance to gossip with Xue Ningxiang, “Ning’er, see that? This punk is a womanizer. He got another one just like that! And I can attest to having seen them kissing in public myself… “
Xie Tianyang laughed inside, [Time to cash in on the scheme I cooked back in Drifting Flowers Edifices.]
Xue Ningxiang’s eyes were fixed on Zhuo Fan, having a sinking and uncomfortable feeling in her heart.
The looks Zhuo Fan got from the audience were odd, to say the least.
[This kid’s the bomb. He goes around the seven houses, spreading chaos and destruction, while not forgetting to sow the seeds of love!]
[Lady Killer Demonic Dragon is far more appropriate!]
“Steward Zhuo, you are a true man of mercy, to show such restraint in your travels!” Luo Yunchang towered behind Zhuo Fan with a sweet smile. And yet the killing intent in her eyes made her close to a demon.
Zhuo Fan shrugged it off, “I only did what I had to. The rest was a force of circumstance, out of my control.”
“Force of circumstance you say?” Luo Yunchang teased and held his face.
Zhuo Fan was caught off guard, “What are you doing?”
“Force of circumstance.” Grinning, Luo Yunchang looked at him longingly and smooched him.
Zhuo Fan felt her soft lips but didn’t get to relish in the sensation as Luo Yunchang swished her head away blushing. But the look in her eyes, was that of a blissful maiden.
“Steward Zhuo, good luck!” Luo Yunchang batted her eyes at him then shot a glance towards Drifting Flowers Edifices.
Chu Qingcheng’s eyes were spitting fire right about now. Her teeth crunching so hard even Grandmother could hear.
Xiao Dandan was having a hard time swallowing down her anger. She was ready to jump at that hussy’s throat. Fortunately, Peony Overseer was there to rein her in.
“Who is she? How dare she force herself on darling?”
“That’s their clan’s matter. It has nothing to do with you.” Peony Overseer sighed.
Xiao Dandan whined, “That’s my darling! Of course it has…”
Xie Tianyang found the ever sweet and cheerful Xue Ningxiang wearing a mask of anger and sorrow.
[This is a cat fight only a man can stir. But why do I get the feeling even my cute and lovely Ning’er wants to join the battlefield as well?]
The audience was even more shocked, [That’s no Demonic Dragon, that’s a Love Doctor I tell you!] While actually, they felt jealousy and anger, [Being a skirt-chaser is a skill as well.]
Huangpu Tianyuan twiddled his mustache with a cold eye, “Sir Leng, who among these girls is his Achilles heel?”
“They all have a crush on him, but he ignores them completely. It’s too soon to tell if any of them can be called his weakness. This needs further observation.” Leng Wuchang’s eyes flashed.
Huangpu Tianyuan nodded.
Zhuo Fan was out of it for a second there, then saw Luo Yunchang’s rosy cheeks and rubbed her head, “Young miss Luo, you’re not getting weird on me, are you?”
“You’re the weird one. Now get on stage!” With a glare, Luo Yunchang pushed him forward.
With that charming and touching look, she made quite a number of hearts skip a beat in the crowd.
Zhuo Fan shook his head and went on.
Just then, two figures wrapped in black energy popped up in front of him. The Blue Expanse City’s Sun clan duo!
Looking at the two creepy aberrations, Zhuo Fan was stunned, “You need something?”
“Hi-hi-hi, Zhuo Fan, you can’t tell who we are?” The man let out an eerie laughter, followed by the girl.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Sorry, I’ve sinned so much I don’t keep track of how many I’ve wronged. If you’re here for revenge, kindly wait your turn. I’ll be with you in a second to send you to the afterlife!”
“Hi-hi-hi, Zhuo Fan you’re as arrogant as ever. But we aren’t the same as before. This time it’s you who dies!” The man’s eyes flashed bloody red.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “I get it now. I’ve never seen such ugly freaks in my life. Going through such a nasty makeover, of course I couldn’t recognize the current you!”
The crowd erupted in laughter.
Even the girls who were glaring at each other giggled, breaking off their cat fight. Only the duo on stage was pissed.
“Zhuo Fan, that’s enough!”
Another shout came and two more figures wrapped in black smoke appeared as they landed in front of Zhuo Fan. They were old men in the 5th layer of Profound Heaven Stage.
But their faces were as creepy and disturbing as the duo’s.
“Zhuo Fan, you’ve mocked and derided us ever since we met. It’s because of you we look like this. Today, we will take your head as revenge!” One of the old men said savagely.
Luo Yunchang frowned, “You came for revenge but we do not even know how we’ve offended you.”
“Humph, Yunchang, have you forgotten? Destruction of our clan, being cast out, are these not reasons enough?” The old man spat.
Luo Yunchang was still puzzled, but Zhuo Fan caught onto something and mocked, “Oh, so it’s you. Who knew you ended up so pathetic and turned into freaks. Now that you’ve lost all reason to live, you’ve come to me for reincarnation?”
“We came to kill you, or die together!” the old man’s mind was set.
Snickering, Zhuo Fan said, “Even if you came to kill me, you ought to get in line. After I deal with the ones on stage, I don’t mind finishing off the lot of you as well.”
The four nodded.
As the saying went, know thyself and your enemy and you’d be ever-victorious. It payed to know what the other party was capable of.
So the four cleared a path for Zhuo Fan to go on stage.
By now, the 20 strong fighters on stage were grave. They had lost the mockery and disdain they had for the Bone Tempering Zhuo Fan.
They just found out that he can stand tall like Six Dragons and One Phoenix and changed their thinking.
How were they going to beat such a monster? Heck, not even a first rate clan could do him in!
But since they were on stage already, the fight was unavoidable.
They came to Esoteric Debate in hopes of coming under the wing of the seven houses after all.
