This made every fight a chance to show their spirit and worth. A chance they would never miss.
“Soaring Demonic Dragon, come!” Wan clan’s leader cupped his hands, ready for battle. He was sweating buckets, but that didn’t stop him from braving through the fear.
“Wait!”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “My Luo clan will definitely enter the final battle and this is too much of a hassle. So in order to move things along, let all clans, from third to first rate step in. If I lose, we walk. If I win, we’ll go straight to the final battle, fighting with the seven houses!”
Sss~
A round of gasps echoed. He wants to fight every clan, alone? That was just too outrageously cocky!
His words only sparked anger in every clan present. While only the seven houses looked on calmly.
They were the only ones who knew all too well of Zhuo Fan’s cunningness and deceit…

chapters.title: Chapter 263, A Shocking and Devastating Strike
chapters.content:
Chapter 263, A Shocking and Devastating Strike
The clans were outraged at Zhuo Fan’s haughty declaration while also terrified of the one they called Soaring Demonic Dragon.
The Profound Heaven expert directing the fights said to Zhuo Fan, “This isn’t in the rules!”
“What matters is strength, that’s how one earns their right to participate in the final battle!” Grinning, Zhuo Fan stuck out his chin as he turned to the seven houses, “And it’s a perfect time to show them who they’re up against!”
Such ego to consider himself the seven houses’ equal!
He instantly earned the disdain of the crowd. While those that knew of his exploits with the seven houses thought, [The kid sure is qualified.]
Huangpu Qingtian stepped forward and watched the stage coldly.
The appearance of Regent Estate’s eldest young master shocked them all.
They soon heard a clear and mighty voice ringing in their ears. The words had such impact they almost had a heart attack.
“Do as per his wishes. But...” Huangpu Qingtian drew his arm over the crowd, “I declare that anyone who brings me Zhuo Fan’s head, their clan will become Regent Estate’s vassal!”
Sss~
After a round of gasps, a deathly silence ensued. The clans were so overwhelmed they couldn’t dare believe their ears!
[This is godsent!]
One little head was enough to skip the cruel and deadly Esoteric Debate’s last battle and just come under Regent Estate’s wing.
What they didn’t know however was that this dream was closer to a nightmare than reality.
But the promise of greatness robbed their minds of what was to come. Their eyes were fixed on Zhuo Fan, wishing they were already holding his head!
All they were waiting for now was that Profound Heaven expert’s signal and they’d be onto him like wolves.
No one even stopped to think that this free meal could be too hard to even chew. Was Zhuo Fan’s title of Soaring Demonic Dragon, on par with Six Dragons and One Phoenix, for naught?
“Young master Huangpu, you’re sending them to their deaths!”
Zhuo Fan was carefree as he showed an evil grin to Huangpu Qingtian.
Huangpu Qingtian responded with the same smile, “Isn’t this what you wanted?”
Then they laughed.
Zhuo Fan wanted to cause a sensation alright, to establish Luo clan’s position in the upcoming final battle. So the more people that jumped on his sword the better. While Huangpu Qingtian never once believed these second and third rate clans had any good seeds among them to even harm Zhuo Fan.
He was using them to see Zhuo Fan’s limit and develop contingencies.
Each side understood the other’s intent flawlessly, all while using each other.
It was a win-win scenario. The only losses here would be just your run-of-the-mill rock for brains suicidal morons.
The seven houses noticed this as well and they were stunned looking at the laughing duo.
[These two are devious and cruel men of ambition. They gaze far into the horizon!]
In this Esoteric Debate, the winner would come from one of them.
But as the world wasn’t big enough for the two of them, they had to settle their score here and now. Or the world would be plunged into chaos at their hands, ripped apart and burned to cinders.
The house lords watched them with glinting eyes.
The Esoteric Debate was going to revolve around these two monsters, Huangpu Qingtian and Zhuo Fan. Each leading his own faction of houses, something unheard of in the past Esoteric Debates.
The battle for unification was underway and nothing or anyone could stop it. All that was left was to see who had the last laugh!
This was something privy to the seven houses only. Those crickets downstairs only knew how to fight among each other for scraps...
The presiding Profound Heaven expert got his nod of approval and flew up high, soon followed by his clear words.
“Luo clan’s qualifying fight for the final battle begins!”
Roar!
The clans flung themselves like mindless beasts at Zhuo Fan. They were all spectators turned opportunists. What used to be innocent bystanders, were now fired up by the smell of blood and glory.
They were all just one gory head away from becoming the foundation of their clan’s endless fame. Who could fight the temptation? Perhaps they were lucky enough and would even get it.
And the number who thought so was by no means small.
As such, the referee’s words were marked by a veritable flood of people storming the stage. It was close to ten thousand people, with plenty of Bone Tempering and Profound Heaven experts joining as well!
The Wan clan already on stage was overwhelmed.
Zhuo Fan was their opponent but, as things stood, did they even have a snowball’s chance in hell to rob the guy’s head from the masses?
Luck was with them in that regard, being so close and all. Yet when they looked deep into Zhuo Fan’s bottomless gaze, the 20 strong men found themselves frozen.
The incoming tide behind them was oblivious, rushing onwards like clueless children swept by the promise of reward as they launched attacks on Zhuo Fan.
The thousands of people swallowed Zhuo Fan until he was no longer visible.
Xue Ningxiang was worried, “Will brother Zhuo be fine?”
“Totally. With that punk’s luck, not even the seven houses can do anything to him, let alone these pests!” Xie Tianyang comforted Ning’er but he was nonetheless frowning, “But isn’t thousands of people at once perhaps an overkill? The punk is amazing, sure, but there is also the danger of dying from exhaustion. Why is he waiting them out? Why isn’t he thinning the crowd?”
“Hi-hi-hi, no matter how strong, he is all alone against the tide! He is finished!” A creepy laughter jarred his ear.
The audience, or what was left of it, turned to the creepy man to hear him say, “A shame we are already under Hell Valley and cannot throw our lot with Regent Estate. We would’ve been in there cashing our luck otherwise.”
“En, true!” Dong Clan Head nodded.
Wan’er glared at him.
Dong Clan Head shook his head as he looked at the sea of people on the stage, “These are cruel words, but that is reality. Regent Estate’s bait is too enticing for anyone to resist. Not even the kid would’ve thought his egotistical words would stir such a reaction.”
“Even if he dies, he only has himself to blame.” Dong Clan Head sighed, as did Xue Wanlong and Xue Dingtian.
Xue Ningxiang and Dong Xiaowan watched on, plagued with worry. Dong Tianba and the Xue clan’s youths were frowning. But only Xie Tianyang had a mocking smile.
[Egotistical? Of course he is!]
[But have you ever seen how cautious he is? How could a brash and obnoxious kid ever manage to toy with You Guiqi?]
Xie Tianyang was not one bit worried for Zhuo Fan’s fate.
He knew Zhuo Fan showed cockiness on the outside but never actually did something unless he had a plan set in motion.
Hu~
An invisible ripple spawned in the center of the stage, swallowing it whole.
The force of it had Huangpu Tianyuan squinting. He watched as the tide of people on the stage had blank stares before collapsing.
All the contestants dropped on the ground one at a time, with the crazed and thirsty greed frozen on their faces.
Those outside the stage stopped in their charge, watching the stage tensely.
Zhuo Fan touched the buffed guy in front with his finger and let him collapse.
The ground around him was littered with bodies, not that he cared, stepping over them in his conquering march.
Like a king, he was stepping on the bodies of his enemies as he took his throne.
Xue Ningxiang and Dong Xiaowan were overjoyed while Dong Clan Head, Xue Clan Head were shellshocked.
“What just happened? What’s wrong with them?” The shock on everyone’s faces was palpable.
Zhuo Fan was uncaring, looking over the leftovers, still standing and cocking his finger with a nasty grin, “There’s still a thousand left. Come and take my head if you want it.”
Swallowing dryly, they were now faltering. Their previous high had passed, as did their courage. The sight of an evil and grinning Zhuo Fan in the middle of thousands of bodies tended to do that to a feeble mind.
“Killing with intent!” Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes trembled.
His quiet voice spread everywhere among the deathly silence.
In an instant, everyone looked at Zhuo Fan in shock.
[Isn’t that a Radiant Stage expert’s ability? Why is a Bone Tempering cultivator wielding it?]
The fear in their eyes couldn’t be more pronounced.
This was why so many people dropped lifeless without even a chance to fight back. The one that killed them was on par with a Radiant Stage expert...

chapters.title: Chapter 264, Tyrant
chapters.content:
Chapter 264, Tyrant
All the big shots from the seven houses were overwhelmed at Zhuo Fan’s power having exceeded their expectations by a long shot.
What was considered a freak body cultivator, harder than diamonds, had in a single step crossed over the Profound Heaven Stage and went straight to using Radiant Stage’s abilities, leaving these old fogies eating dust.
Bluntly put, these seven houses’ big shots were so daft that not even one had touched upon the Radiant Stage.
And that shame came crashing down, evident by their flushed faces.
[What is wrong with this generation? One freakier than the last.] If these bags of bones were of Zhuo Fan’s age, they’d be dancing in joy if they had the hope of even entering the Profound Heaven Stage.
[But now, it only brings us tears!]
[Out with the old and in with the new, they always say. But the new has kicked us to the curb with this display! Sigh...]
As the old bones watched the imposing and daunting Zhuo Fan on stage, their eyes glistened with tears, feeling as if they had aged a few centuries on the spot.
Huangpu Qingtian was having a hard time containing himself, evident by the gnashing teeth and clenched fists.
He showed off killing with intent last night, to flounce his almightiness and scare the living daylights out of Zhuo Fan. But come tomorrow, Zhuo Fan replied with the same coin, making his act anything but of a circus clown.
Such a display of power would leave anyone wallowing in their refuse from fright. As to what Zhuo Fan did after this display, not only bitchslapped him but threw him from the highest peak into the deepest abyss.
The more he thought about it, the more he realized that his act yesterday was of foolishness.
Zhuo Fan picked on his shame and did what he liked doing best, egging Huangpu Qingtian on with an exaggerated middle finger and a quirk of his eyebrows. Words were hardly necessarily at this stage in getting his point across.
[Dumbass!]
Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes were spitting flames at this point, having long crossed the limits of his tolerance.
But Leng Wuchang held his shoulder, stopping him from acting out.
By getting rid of these third and second rate clans, Zhuo Fan spoke aplenty. By “killing with intent” taken as his weapon of choice, he spat on Huangpu Qingtian’s bravado while also slapping him around for good measure. Could any living being take it?
And yet he did. He knew this was neither time nor place for such an altercation.
“Ol’ poisoner, have you ever seen the eldest young master lose his cool?” You Yushan walked over to Yan Bangui.
Shaking his head, Yan Bangui’s face was grave, “Not even once.”
“Same. But the punk sure knows how to push the eldest young master’s buttons.” He chuckled for a second before sighing, “By the looks of it, the final battle revolving around Six Dragons and One Phoenix for so many centuries has now turned into Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord versus Soaring Demonic Dragon. All we can do is stay back and cheer, like mere squires. We were so useless yesterday as well...”
Yan Bangui recalled how Zhuo Fan had popped up in his face and shuddered from how powerless he felt. He didn’t want to admit it, not with how he scrunched his teeth.
Since when their prestige as Six Dragons and One Phoenix was seen with mockery?
Yan Bogong, leader of Pill King Hall, glanced at the two with calm, “Don’t sell yourself short. You are very much needed in the plan to get ourselves rid of that little monster.”
Shuddering, the two recovered their fighting spirit.
“Yeah, we just need a good plan and together we will waste him for good!” Yan Fu grinned with hatred.
While the two were quite, You Yushan mocked him, “We? Ha-ha-ha, what can you possibly do? Since when are you on the same level as us?”
Yan Bangui couldn’t help but smile and Yan Bogong chuckled.
Yan Fu was furious, but there was nothing he could do.
Ever since his master, Yan Song, suffered an untimely demise, he lost all support in Pill King Hall. His alchemy was very much well regarded still, but his poison arts paled to the likes of Yan Bangui so he was kicked to the curb.
It only worked to fuel his hatred for Zhuo Fan to new heights. He lost everything because of him!
Back on the stage, all those greedy and power hungry clans finally woke up from the allure of fame. They started drawing back, further and further away.
The referee landed on the corpse filled stage and sighed at Zhuo Fan’s insane power.
In the millennium that passed, and in all the Esoteric Debates that were held, never had the preliminaries to the final battle yielded so many casualties.
Although sad, he had no sympathy whatsoever.
Their greed got them their deaths. They bet their lives for power and fame, but lost in the end.
They got their just desserts!
“In this qualification round for the final battle, Luo clan is victorious!” The old guy shouted.
They all heard it but they didn’t applaud. Those that laid at Zhuo Fan’s feet were their brothers, part of the same clans.
Why would anyone congratulate their enemy for killing their men? Did that even make sense?
The only thing they felt when looking at the slaughter was pain. Zhuo Fan had stepped on their kin to enter the final battle. Why the hell would they applaud? Their hearts were only capable of unbridled hatred now.
Not that Zhuo Fan cared. Every general climbed to his rank by stepping over a mountain of corpses. He had no need for eulogies and acclamations, only to be feared and obeyed!
“Old Pang, make a list with all the dead people’s clans. I will pay a visit to each and every one of them.” Zhuo Fan pointed at the corpse filled stage.
Old Pang got to work immediately.
The relatives watched disgruntled, and some even had the courage to voice their indignation, “Zhuo Fan, we don’t need your hypocrisy. Don’t think that some poor apology will be enough to atone for this slaughter!”
This earned the nods of the crowd.
“Apology, atone?”
Quirking an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan felt he had heard the biggest joke ever, “Ha-ha-ha, are you stupid or what? Since when did I start having regrets from killing? And you even went as far as thinking I’d apologize for squashing mere ants?
“Humph, let me be perfectly clear. When you went after me just now, wishing to get my head, I made sure to burn each one of you in my mind! I only want the list so I can pay a social visit and send you off with the rest of your clan and avoid any meddlesome folks in the future. Apologize? Atone? Unlike all those stories where the guy gets the girl, I will be sure to take her from right under your noses, morons!”
Sss~
Gasps of fear resounded everywhere.
[Is this guy human? He slaughtered so many and yet he won’t rest until he has committed genocide?]
Gone was vengeance from everyone’s minds and instead they shivered in fear worrying if they’d even have a future. [Maybe moving into mountains and avoiding this Demon Archon is for the best.]
They all paled and forgot everything about revenge.
Leng Wuchang snickered a praise, “This brat sure is crafty. People seek revenge out of survival. But when that is at risk, all the hatred evaporates. They will most likely run home and cover all of this up, while leaving him a free path to the final battle!”
“But this punk is a tyrant. He does not care for the people!” Huangpu Tianyuan said.
Leng Wuchang shook his head, “A tyrant is called that only in the moment of his fall. That is when others gather their nerves to call him that. If he keeps on winning, he will always be a righteous lord. His actions will have no impact whatsoever as well. As you can see from his choice today, he instilled a powerful image on all present here that getting on Luo clan’s bad sides or on the seven houses’ bad side made no difference. They’ll end up dead either way. So who then will go against the Luo clan besides us?”
Gasping, Huangpu Tianyuan nodded, “He is both ambitious and a ruler material. We need to nip him in the bud!”
Huangpu Tianyuan stood up and left.
Seeing Regent Estate following their Estate Lord, the other six houses glanced one more time at Zhuo Fan before leaving as well. Staying any longer wouldn’t net them any new information anyway.
They had been introduced already to Zhuo Fan’s other grand ability.
Zhuo Fan sighed watching them go and went to Xue Ningxiang and Xie Tianyang, “What a coincidence. You are also joining the Esoteric Debate?”
He failed to notice, however, Leng Wuchang pausing and looking back at him with a wide grin.
“Estate Lord, I may have found this brat’s weakness.” Leng Wuchang beamed at Huangpu Tianyuan.
Huangpu Tianyuan raised an eyebrow, “Sir Leng found out the cause behind his vanishing acts?”
“No, but it is akin to a spacial array. We can only use another array to seal this ability!” Leng Wuchang shook his head.
If only Zhuo Fan was here to hear this, he’d have the shock of his life, and praise Leng Wuchang’s cunning eyes. The Divine Eye of the Void’s 1st stage’s weakness was indeed a sealed space.
“But how do we trap him in an array? He is just too insidious to fall for it!” Huangpu Tianyuan frowned.
Leng Wuchang showed a vague smile, “He is trickier than a fox, proving to be a hard opponent even for me. But even smart people act like an average person sometimes!”
“Hoh, Sir Leng must have a plan ready then.” Huangpu Tianyuan’s eyes flashed.
Leng Wuchang nodded and smiled...

chapters.title: Chapter 265, A Clan Dog’s Burial
chapters.content:
Chapter 265, A Clan Dog’s Burial
“Big brother Zhuo, congratulations on getting into the final battle!” Xue Ningxiang couldn’t stop the sweet smile from gracing her face.
Xue Dingtian and Dong Clan Head’s hearts jumped from fear, despite knowing fully well that Zhuo Fan had always been on their side.
It was all because his power was the biggest threat.
The sight of Zhuo Fan slaughtering thousands of people with intent alone gave them the feeling of ants looking at a giant. He could kill them on a whim if he found them displeasing in any way. Who wouldn’t shake in their boots?
They had a stiff smile on their faces, but their backs were soaked.
They were like deer in the headlights. The tiger had them in his sights, and even if his appetite was abated, their fear was very much real.
Zhuo Fan was oblivious to the fear he evoked, he who had become a dreaded existence just minutes ago, was now smiling and nodding.
The others nodded stiffly with an awkward smile.
He puffed up his chest as he looked at Xue Ningxiang, “That was going to happen in due time anyways. It will hardly make a difference when garbage throws itself at me, even if they are in the tens of thousands!”
They all laughed dryly, but sweat poured out harder.
His tone was haughty, but then the people thought about it from a different angle. Weren’t Dong clan and Xue clan average clans as well, garbage even? What would be their future?
Wasn’t he clearly mocking them in a convoluted way?
It wasn’t like the two could complain. Who told him to get strong enough to end their lives with a squeeze?
[Just smile and nod.]
Zhuo Fan was minding his own business, and with how often he was around big shots, he had no idea what waves his words were stirring in these two clan head’s minds.
Xue Ningxiang chuckled innocently. But then she frowned, “Uh, big brother Zhuo, will you really end their clans? They just lost their relatives. On the stage, death is unavoidable, but going so far as to kill their whole clan afterwards is cruel. My clan was also on the verge of being wiped out and I can relate. Please, c-could you just let them go?”
“Well...”
Zhuo Fan frowned. Xue Dingtian noticed the predicament and chastised, “Ning’er, Steward Zhuo had his reason for doing it. You can’t go and ruin his plans with your playfulness! Moreover, a true man never goes back on his word, even more so for Steward Zhuo, who is a hero, a great...”
“Fine, no problem!”
Xue Dingtian didn’t even get to teach his dear granddaughter about manners before Zhuo Fan just shrugged it off, “I only meant to scare them anyway, to dispel any thoughts of going against me. Since I got what I wanted, there’s no need to exterminate them. What do you take me for, a pitiless Demon Archon?”
[Damn right!]
They all shook their heads but nodded in their minds.
[If you’re no Demon Archon, what are the thousands of corpses doing on stage?]
Xue Ningxiang was ecstatic. She felt for those pitiful clans deeply, [Big brother Zhuo doesn’t need to go through a pointless slaughter.]
Zhuo Fan smiled and ruffled her hair. His savage face showed a rare hint of being content.
Xue Dingtian was dumbstruck. He was looking to justify Zhuo Fan’s cruel way all this time and even reproached his granddaughter.
And yet Zhuo Fan actually agreed with his granddaughter’s pleading instead of giving credence to his reasoning. Where would his face go when speaking to his juniors now?
But seeing that Zhuo Fan had eyes for Ning’er alone, the old man sighed, [My face is useless here. Better leave them alone, lest I become a third wheel.]
“Hey, hands off! Don’t you know mere acquaintances should never touch?”
Xie Tianyang burst into their corner of the world and flung Zhuo Fan’s hand off Ning’er’s head. His jealousy was already burning strong and seeing Zhuo Fan patting her was the last straw.
Zhuo Fan saw right through him and sighed.
Luo Yunchang took this moment to barge in as well, “Yeah, how could any respectable woman be touched so casually?”
Then she said in apology, “Ning’er, please don’t mind it. Steward Zhuo is a boor. I’ll teach him some manners when we get back.”
“Uh, it’s alright. Young miss Luo, don’t blame big brother Zhuo.” Xue Ningxiang panicked. The gullible girl thought the young miss had the power to knock some sense into Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan frowned, feeling ticked off for some odd reason.
“Steward Zhuo, here’s the list!” Captain Pang came with a paper.
Zhuo Fan scrunched it up and threw it, “Never mind.”
Captain Pang was stumped, [What’s with Steward Zhuo? Why is he so angry?]
Zhuo Fan had no clue why, but felt something amiss when Xie Tianyang flung his hand off the girl’s head. It only got worse when Luo Yunchang showed up and her words stung him.
He was now sulking and had no one to vent on.
Suddenly, Zhuo Fan shouted, “Wait!”
They all looked around to see where Zhuo Fan was looking. The Sun clan’s four were tip-toeing away.
They were depressed. They worked so hard on their cultivation the last five years too. They thought with their strength, it was enough to at least take Zhuo Fan to his grave together if not alone.
But then they saw that monstrous Zhuo Fan turn into an abomination, killing with intent.
The four of them had no chance whatsoever now. They would be finished in a blink!
Oh, they still wanted revenge of course, but that didn’t mean becoming cannon fodder was in their plan. Only an idiot would jump right in when there was no chance of victory.
So they chose to high tail out of there!
Once Zhuo Fan figured out who they were, he no longer cared about them. But now he needed a good punching bag to blow off some steam and they became the perfect targets.
Zhuo Fan hardly ever got angry, especially the kind of dubious and inexplicable type of anger he was feeling right now.
But now that he ran into these guys, he felt like the luckiest man alive.
Staggering, the old man in front stiffly looked back as he used the same hoarse voice, “You need something?”
Are you serious?
[You’re asking me? After you had the gall to shout that you’ll kill me?]
Zhuo Fan smiled in anger, walking towards them while spouting, “Cai Rong, Cai Xiaoting, and the Sun clan’s father and daughter, drop the dumb act!”
The four shuddered as they turned, yet they were too scared to even look him in the eye.
Luo Yunchang’s group jerked. They threw the four out of their clan but who knew they’d end up looking like freaks of nature?
Zhuo Fan cared not about their flimsy explanations and appeared right in front of the four as he taunted, “Come then. Weren’t you gonna take revenge? I’ll take you all on and even give you two free moves!”
Their faces sank, no longer arrogant as before, but down in the dumps.
[What good will two moves do when you can kill us with intent alone?]
“Don’t feel like it?”
That only got Zhuo Fan’s rage to tower higher and roared, “Since you have no guts, kneel. See how I put you in your place!”
Regardless of how unwilling they were, their knees buckled.
To kneel or not to kneel? That was the question.
Kneeling was shameful, but most likely a better outcome than ending up a smear on the ground at this savage’s hands.
[Life is ever precious. Face matters not, especially with our creepy looks.]
One after the other, they bent their knees and fell on Zhuo Fan’s feet.
Luo Yunchang cried, “H-how did you all end up like this?”
“How else? The Hell Valley gave them some double-edged demonic method.” A Demonic Emperor like Zhuo Fan saw through them in a flash as he cursed, “Just look at yourselves! You’re neither human nor monster and yet you still want to live? Is this the awe inspiring power you all sought? Especially you, instead of staying as an elder in the Luo clan you went ahead and threw your whole lot with the Sun clan! What a fool.”
Zhuo Fan sputtered into Cai Rong’s flushed face.
Zhuo Fan had hardly had enough and kept on flinging curses, “Do you know why you look like this? It’s what you deserve for being so adamant in becoming someone’s lap dogs. Even as an elder of the Luo clan, you wanted to climb aboard Hell Valley. Now that you did, you’re worth less than even a dog! Idiot, nitwit, dumbass, nimrod... “
Zhuo Fan was on a roll. He was thorough in cursing out every bit of respect the four ever had.
They couldn’t even muster a retort.
Luo Yunchang glanced at Zhuo Fan with complicated thoughts.
“Zhuo Fan, kill us or torture us. But stop with the insults!” Cai Rong had had enough it seemed.
Zhuo Fan squinted, “Kill you? Why would I ever do that?”
The four were startled and echoed, “You won’t kill us?”
“Of course not. I only care about two kinds of people. Friends, to hang out with, and enemies, to kill!” Grinning, Zhuo Fan added, “What do you suppose you are?”
“Enemy?” Cai Rong tested.
Shaking his head, Zhuo Fan snickered.
“Friends... perhaps?” Cai Rong’s heart thumped with hope. Was Zhuo Fan absolving them, was he going to help them?
Zhuo Fan was cracking up, and mocked them even harder, “Wrong, you are nothing to me! Just a bunch of clowns unworthy to kill and even less to call friends!
“Beat it! Live on like the dogs you are and have a taste of worldly pain as you reflect on your mistakes. I expect a good show on your part!”
With a grin, Zhuo Fan finally felt at peace, having cursed them and humiliated them so thoroughly...

chapters.title: Chapter 266, Rage
chapters.content:
Chapter 266, Rage
Shameless humiliation!
The faces of the four were aflame, wishing they could go out fighting, and yet they kneeled there without a peep.
Why were they here anyway? Did they come here only to get humiliated?
Luo Yunchang sighed and glanced at Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan looked crazed in his enjoyment, shouting, “Why are you still here? Get lost already!”
Cai Rong’s group shook their heads and left, but not before they heard Zhuo Fan sinking one last insult, “Do it like dogs! What are you standing around for when you’re not even humans?”
Shuddering, the four bit their lips fiercely. Zhuo Fan was towering over them with his mighty air and arrogance yet all they could do was suffer.
He was just that strong!
Cai Rong wept as he crawled away with the other three. Their image in the evening sun struck the picture of degradation, of stray dogs begging for mercy.
Zhuo Fan barked on and on, trying to dispel that queer rage completely.
People watched Zhuo Fan being thorough in humiliating these four, leaving them without a shred of dignity. The more they saw, the greater their fear of Zhuo Fan became.
They said a warrior could be killed but not shamed. And yet when these Clan Heads watched such naked display of abuse and mockery, they felt it was even worse than having their entire clan wiped out.
Because visiting the Underworld may be cruel and sad, but all clansmen would meet again in the afterlife. While the shamed would have to live on with this disgrace, in this nightmare built by harsh and cruel words, a fate worse than death.
While Zhuo Fan was raining curses, his every word stung Xue and Dong clan like daggers.
[Are we dogs or warriors?]
[The Luo clan had Zhuo Fan as their pillar that even the seven houses regarded with importance and thus they could maintain their integrity.] While to the average clan in this word, not being dogs would end up becoming their destruction. How could one have integrity when his entire existence was threatened?
Oftentimes they never wished to rise above their station, simply to survive. That was why they had integrity on the surface, while acting like dogs through their actions.
Just that these two clans were lucky enough to get a good master, Drifting Flowers Edifices and Sword Marquise Abode. Unlike how the cruel Hell Valley treated their vassals.
So they may be dogs, but could venture in calling themselves dogs with pedigree.
Taking deep breaths, Xue Clan Head and Dong Clan Head glanced at each other then shook their heads. Zhuo Fan and Luo clan were worlds apart from them...
“Steward Zhuo, calm down. Why are you so angry? It’s not worth stressing yourself over this.” Captain Pang came to Zhuo Fan with a smile.
Zhuo Fan shrugged, his face calm, “I’m fine. I am not one to get angry over the likes of them. They are not worth it. I only abused them since it worked to show off my pretentious style.”
Captain Pang reeled and laughed dryly. [What a reason to curse someone. How freakish!]
Only Luo Yunchang bit her lip watching Zhuo Fan.
“Oh, sorry everyone, there are matters that I need to deal with. I shall take my leave.” Zhuo Fan cupped his hands and left with Luo Yunchang and company.
The others replied in kind.
Only Dong Xiaowan watched him grumbling, “He never even looked at me...”
Dong Clan Head patted her shoulder and shook his head, “Wan’er, you and him are of different worlds. It’s impossible.”
Dong Xiaowan closed her teary eyes...
In Luo clan’s residence, the ever quiet Luo Yunchang spoke up, “Zhuo Fan, miss Ning’er and you...”
“What’s wrong?” Zhuo Fan asked puzzled.
Luo Yunchang looked at him long, then shook her head, “Nothing.”
Zhuo Fan blinked obliviously.
Luo clan stayed in a small courtyard in Dragon Cloud City. After coming here, Zhuo Fan called for Lei Yuntian and the twenty Profound Heaven fakes.
“With Steward Zhuo as our bulwark, we will always achieve absolute victory!” Lei Yuntian cupped his hands and laughed.
Zhuo Fan merely barked at the fakers, “Elder Lei, cane these things a hundred times each, personally!”
Lei Yuntian was startled. [Why is Steward Zhuo angry? Did he lose?]
[No way!] Whenever Zhuo Fan entered the fray, he only came out winning, not to mention this was an easy matter. The twenty fakers were stumped as well, [What did we do?]
They’ve been well behaved as of late. [We never showed off either.]
Zhuo Fan snorted, “You think I forgot about you since I didn’t pay you any attention last couple of days? Luo clan was attacked yesterday and even our allies and outsiders came out with heavy wounds trying to protect our masters. While you just picked a corner to let this play out. You think you’ll get out of this so easily?”
“B-but they were Six Dragons and One Phoenix! We have no hope of defeating them, would’ve only died for nothing!” One of the twenty said with fear.
Squinting, Zhuo Fan’s flick sent him flying as he roared, “You call that a reason? When you were imperial guards, did you run away as well? You are now the Luo clan’s guards and the least you could do is be our shields. We are never to die before all of you. Didn’t Elder Lei and Captain Pang act just the same? You don’t have the Luo clan’s wellbeing as your priority and must be punished.”
Lei Yuntian nodded after a pause. He was right and these guys had to be put in their place.
“Elder Lei, what are you standing around for? Do it!” Zhuo Fan barked.
The twenty fakers jolted in fear.
Lei Yuntian was about to execute the order when he froze.
[Wait, a hundred canes per faker? Won’t my old body give out after two thousand hits? Steward Zhuo, are you punishing them or taking it out on me?]
But then again, only he was the best person suited for the job since if anyone else did it, it wouldn’t count as punishment.
[But two thousand canes...]
Lei Yuntian looked at Luo Yunchang bitter, “Yunchang, what happened today? Why is Steward Zhuo so irritated?”
Luo Yunchang shook her head, “Never mind, Uncle Lei. Just give them twenty canes each, but a bit harder.”
They all eased a breath in relief.
The fakers rejoiced, as did Lei Yuntian. They were blessed to have this young miss above Demon Archon Zhuo. Two thousand canes turning into four hundred was far more manageable...
Back in his room, Zhuo Fan sat down, and emptied the teacup at the side in one gulp and sighed. He was finally calm.
Luo Yunchang and Captain Pang entered to which Zhuo Fan said, “How is Elder Li and the others? They should be close.”
For Dragon Cloud City to keep the peace, no house was allowed to bring in Radiant Stage experts. So Zhuo Fan guessed Li Jingtian’s group had to be waiting on the outskirts of town.
Captain Pang shook his head, “Young miss Lei and Elder Yan hadn’t come since you had plans for them.”
“Correct. I indeed told them to move around this time. And the others?” Zhuo Fan nodded.
Captain Pang muttered, “Uh, the others didn’t as well.”
“Why?” Zhuo Fan finally had the time to mind Luo clan’s situation and was stunned by what he heard.
“It was my idea.” Luo Yunchang said, “Dragon Cloud City doesn’t allow Radiant Stage experts in and you said not to expose our cards too soon. So I...”
“Fool!” Zhuo Fan snapped, enraged again, “The seven houses didn’t bring Radiant Stage experts because of their power, while you have none. If you and Yunhai die here, the Luo clan is finished. What would be the point of all my plans and my efforts to help the clan? To throw it all away in the end?”
Luo Yunchang bit her lip and tears threatened to fall down her cheeks. But instead of succumbing to them she snapped back, “Yes! I am not so astute and failed to see the big picture! And you? After being gone for five years, you instantly scream at anyone you find an eyesore. It’d have been better if you hadn’t bothered coming!”
Luo Yunchang slammed the door as she left.
Captain Pang was awkward, “Uh, Steward Zhuo, please don’t take it to heart. She didn’t mean it. She missed you day and night...”
“Fine fine, I know. This isn’t the first time she has acted like this anyway.” Zhuo Fan sighed and squinted, “Old Pang, send a messaging jade slip for Elder Li to provide us support. I have a feeling we will have a falling out with Regent Estate.”
Captain Pang nodded.
Zhuo Fan was soon left alone with his thoughts.
He closed his eyes as he considered.
He knew something was off about him today. Irritated by everything and lashing out at anyone. He was this close to trading blows too. This couldn’t go on.
If anger got the best of him, he would force his way forward which was not a good thing. He had to control himself at all costs. Or there was a high chance he would do something he would regret.
But why was he so ticked off all of a sudden?
Taking a deep breath and closing his eyes, he calmed down and started cultivating.
Suddenly, a shout echoed and Zhuo Fan clutched his right eye as he fell to the ground soaked. The golden ring in his eye flashed on and off as a faint second golden ring appeared.
[Am I about to achieve Divine Eye of the Void’s 2nd stage?]
Zhuo Fan was excited...

chapters.title: Chapter 267, Cold-blooded
chapters.content:
Chapter 267, Cold-blooded
Rustle~
With a few flicks of his arms, Zhuo Fan set up a defensive array and sat cross-legged, calmed his mind and readied himself to advance. He felt his right eye burning red hot as the golden ring flashed. Zhuo Fan took a deep breath and focused his entire soul power on his right eye.
The Divine Eye of the Void had an intrinsic connection with one’s soul. Each advancement would tax one’s soul greatly.
Three days passed within a blink in this manner, with Zhuo Fan focused on his task and no one disturbing him either. However, the morning of the fourth day Zhuo Fan opened his eyes with a sigh.
“It still failed. Is it because my soul is weak or because of my restless state of mind?” Squinting, Zhuo Fan began regretting. It was such a rare chance to get stronger and he had thoroughly wasted it.
Recalling his impatience four days ago, Zhuo Fan shook his head. [Why couldn’t I be calm? I need to temper my heart and remove all distractions.]
Zhuo Fan took a deep breath and closed his eyes. The next time he opened them, they were crystal clear with no ripples across them.
Zhuo Fan stood up, undid the array and walked out.
He was met with Luo Yunchang and company. One look was enough to tell him something was up.
“What’s wrong?” Zhuo Fan eyed them.
Luo Yunchang muttered, “Pavilion Lord Long has sent word that they want to discuss the final battle among the seven houses with you. But you were cultivating these past days and...”
“Alright, I got it.”
Zhuo Fan interrupted her and walked away without even looking at them. Like a lone wolf.
Luo Yunchang looked at his back for a long while and then said, “Captain Pang, did you also notice that he has changed?”
Captain Pang swallowed, “Steward Zhuo didn’t change, he has only returned to how he was eight years ago. He looks the same as back then in Misty Forest.”
Luo Yunchang watched the prideful figure with an aching heart.
[Is he... leaving again?]
A demonic cultivator only ever cared about themselves.
With Zhuo Fan having met so many people over the years, each encounter had a faint influence, each tainting his heart and ultimately rattling his usually peaceful state of mind.
He was of the belief that this was the sole reason for his failure to advance Divine Eye of the Void to the 2nd stage. After careful consideration, he had cast out every influence, along with the ever growing emotions.
The strong had no need for dead weights.
Surveying the white clouds floating about the blue sky, Zhuo Fan’s eyes were crystal clear. So much so that they looked dead.
[So much better.]
Sighing, Zhuo Fan walked with purpose to a courtyard ten times larger than the Luo clan’s.
This place had high ranking people watching the gate.
“Brother, the killing with intent you used has opened my eyes!” Long Jiu laughed.
Zhuo Fan nodded unaffected, “Long time no see, brother Jiu!”
Long Jiu paused for a second. [Why is brother so cold today?]
“Darling, you were so cool!” Xiao Dandan skipped over at some point with a rosy face. Peony Overseer held her face and sighed.
Zhuo Fan glanced at her and said, “Lass, do that again and I’ll make sure it will be your last!”
Reeling, Xiao Dandan watched him like he was some stranger. She had gotten used to Zhuo Fan talking like that, but this time she could see the bloodthirst glinting in his eyes.
She was certain that if she opened her mouth at this instant, Zhuo Fan would rip it off!
Peony Overseer saw her disciple being picked on and glared. But before she could spring in defense, Zhuo Fan’s cold, emotionless eyes snapped at her, “And you, deal with your disciple before she meets with misfortune. When that time comes, you’ll only have yourself to blame for not educating her properly!”
Zhuo Fan then walked inside without sparing the women a look.
Zhuo Fan had long lost his joking mood and was ready to follow up on his threats.
[What’s wrong with this kid? He’s like another person.]
While those familiar with Zhuo Fan were stifled, the rest were even more afraid of earning his ire.
Zhuo Fan was surrounded by a constant air of savagery as if he was standing above all. No one dared to stand closer than three meter around this mighty lord.
His far away look and his power let them know that the best he ever felt was when he was alone.
This Zhuo Fan left them all cold and shaken inside.
Rumble!
Zhuo Fan walked in through the heavy door, where the three clans sat around a round table. They all smiled at his coming, Chu Qingcheng especially.
He nodded and smiled in reply, but ignored Chu Qingcheng as he took a chair.
“Steward Zhuo, the qualification round has concluded. Because of your involvement, a large number of clans were eliminated. This makes the final battle planned a month later be moved two days from now.” Long Yifey explained.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “So the reason you wanted to see me is...”
“Seeing how the Luo clan has never participated in the final battle of the seven houses before, there are some things you have yet to learn.” Long Yifey smiled, “Actually, the final battle is held in a different area each time and rules change accordingly. What remains the same is how cruel and brutal it is.”
“So it isn’t held in Dragon Cloud City? Hasn’t it been a tradition for Esoteric Debate to be held here for the past thousand years?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow.
Long Yifey shook his head, “This is the imperial family’s scheme. Only by constantly changing the environment could they see the true power of the seven houses. And with how powerful the disciples from the seven houses are, so too will the terrain become of a much greater difficulty. This time it is expected to be the worst so far!”
Zhuo Fan squinted, still out of the loop.
Grandmother giggled, “Steward Zhuo needn’t be baffled. The Dragon Cloud City has a large 8th grade Teleportation Array to send us anywhere within the Tianyu Empire. And that is where the final battle will be held. This is also to prevent anyone from setting an ambush.”
Zhuo Fan nodded. [Imperial family thought of everything. But using such a large Teleportation Array only for Esoteric Debate is such a waste.]
Zhuo Fan shook his head in the end.
If the imperial family wanted to waste their coffers, how was that his problem? He was better off focusing on the final battle.
That was the whole reason why they were gathered here.
Xie Xiaofeng smiled, “Steward Zhuo, your skills have opened our eyes. But we still wish to ask, how confident are you in facing Huangpu Qingtian?”
Squinting, Zhuo Fan snickered, “None whatsoever. But you can rest easy knowing that I can hold him down. With how one of the other three is a cripple, can you handle the remaining two?”
“With Steward Zhuo holding off that monster, the other two and a half men will be easily taken care of. The seven houses’ ranking will be in upheaval!” Xie Xiaofeng anticipated with joy.
The others laughed with him.
They discussed further details then adjourned. Zhuo Fan walked to the door when a graceful figure blocked his view.
Zhuo Fan eyed Chu Qingcheng.
“You need something?” Zhuo Fan said flatly.
Chu Qingcheng watched the impassive Zhuo Fan in anger, “Zhuo Fan, I want an answer. Did you have no reason to stay in Drifting Flowers City longer?”
“None!” Zhuo Fan was resolute, “I told you, I only did it out of self interest. Since I had achieved my goal and got what I came for, I had no reason to stay.”
Chu Qingcheng gnashed her teeth and clenched her fists, “What about the days spent in that shack...”
“You call playing house being real?” Mocking, Zhuo Fan sneered, “Without sacrificing a few days of my youth, you would’ve never given up Bodhi Jade Sap so willingly...”
Pa!
Chu Qingcheng slapped him before he could finish.
Grinning, Zhuo Fan giggled despite her raging eyes, “Silly girl, you’re so easily duped that I worry how Drifting Flowers Edifices will survive after Grandmother’s gone. Why not give it to me?”
“Bastard, you are dead inside!” Chu Qingcheng glared, her fingers dug into her palm drawing blood, trailing her flawless skin.
Smirking, Zhuo Fan no longer looked at her as he left, but his mockery stung nonetheless, “Ha-ha-ha, I am and always will be a demonic cultivator. Even if that time made me feel anything, so what? You think you can hook me in?”
Pff!
With heart wrenching pain, Chu Qingcheng watched him leave with a face filled with tears. Zhuo Fan paused but never turned around. His face forever cold as he walked away alone.
Peony Overseer and the rest rushed over, seeing Chu Qingcheng’s state and starting cursing Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan hardly cared about the pesky cawing, leaving with a cold smile on his face.
He had just left the courtyard and soon noticed some blood seeping from his mouth.
He wiped it off unfeeling and mechanically.
To become a Demonic Emperor he had to be cold-blooded and to never allow a trace of emotion to get a hold of him ever again...

chapters.title: Chapter 268, Prologue of the Final Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 268, Prologue of the Final Battle
Dragon Cloud City’s westernmost side had a towering mountain going by the name of Transfer Peak.
Right on top of this huge hunk of rock laid a grand 8th grade Teleportation Array. Some said that even before Tianyu Empire came to be, the Yuwen imperial family used this precise array to send its troops to every corner of the empire.
But as the chaos made way to peace, it didn’t see much use, serving now just as a means to blow off the seven houses’ ever accumulating rancor through the Esoteric Debate.
At this particular moment, hundreds of clans were gathering on it en masse. They all looked at the array with nervousness, excitement and awe.
Anyone would be excited when it came to joining the final battle, knowing their rise was just around the corner, as was their destruction. And they were nervous as well at having qualified for this final battle. Besides the first rate clans still holding their ranks, the third and second rate clans went through a shuffling. Few were those that rose to become first rate, with new and incredible power.
The final battle, however, wasn’t as cushy as the qualification round. Not that the entry fights were ever easy to begin with, but when taking the final battle into account, its cruelty was way worse than the qualification battles. Thus, it was easy to imagine how nervous these clans were feeling.
That went farther for a particular underdog, the Luo clan of Windgaze City. With Soaring Demonic Dragon Zhuo Fan on par with Six Dragons and One Phoenix as vanguard, was there anyone capable of pushing them back? What was on the clans’ minds however was whose vassal were they, for whose sake were they fighting for?
The worry hit many hard.
“Look, the Luo clan!” A shout snapped hundreds of heads in Luo Yunchang’s direction as she led the Luo clan alongside Zhuo Fan.
Finally healed, Luo Yunhai could now show his heroic aura, and thirst for battle. A youth still, yet the Fifth Tiger of Tianyu would never just be another face in the crowd.
Their proceedings instilled a certain heavy air around the onlookers.
The Luo clan was a veritable wolf strutting through a sheep herd. It was so bad that the people made a ten meter wide space for them. Everyone feared getting close to this savage beast.
And yet, there were always exceptions...
“Big brother Zhuo, you’re all here!”
Xue Ningxiang skipped over hyped and waving. The Xue and Dong clans behind her earned not few raised eyebrows.
What was their connection for these two clans to get so close with this wolf?
But the appearance of Sword Marquise Abode’s second young master, Xie Tianyang, making his way there as well, cleared all doubts. [So they’re allies!]
There was no shortage of rumors flying about the Luo clan, especially about its supporters. It so happened that Sword Marquise Abode was among these rumors, and today only validated it.
This only worked to make the people even more envious of this upstart clan. [So this is why the Luo clan jumped from third to first rate and had a free path to the final battle. They have a house behind them!]
[What kind of sheer dumb and rotten luck had they stumbled upon to have a house treat them so?]
Thinking of how mountains of wealth were literally flung at this third rate clan to reach such a position, [If it were us in their stead, we’d have reached the moon by now, tch....]
People always looked at the surface of things, unaware that the Luo clan of today wasn’t because of the support of some houses. And it was what they were today that had caught the seven houses’ attention.
It was painfully obvious to see who here was a dog or a man...
Xue Ningxiang gasped as she reached them with a sweet and innocent smile. Zhuo Fan’s mouth quirked and he ruffled her hair, “What are you doing here? Haven’t you always hated watching people die?”
Luo Yunchang retorted as she watched him longingly. It was her first time in days that she caught Zhuo Fan show a carefree smile. But why wasn’t it directed at her?
Luo Yunchang sighed feeling the ache deep within.
“It’s fine, big brother Zhuo. Xue clan is joining as well and I’ll be going too!” Xue Ningxiang giggled, brandishing her cute little fists to show her battle spirit.
Zhuo Fan shouted anxiously, “You can’t, Ning’er! This is a vicious battle, not a game. A girl like you has no place on the battlefield!”
“I don’t care, because I know big brother Zhuo will be there to save me whenever I’m in danger!” Xue Ningxiang blinked her bright eyes, watching Zhuo Fan eagerly. She then looked at the Thunder Ring, “Whenever I’m in peril, the Thunder Ring will flicker and you’ll appear. Isn’t that right?”
Zhuo Fan squinted, then nodded in defeat, “Fine, I’ll look after you.”
“You don’t have to worry about that. You have Huangpu Qingtian to deal with. Ning’er will be in my care!” Xie Tianyang stormed next to Xue Ningxiang and held her shoulder, making a claim on her.
Xue Dingtian only now arrived and smiled awkwardly, “I can’t stop her. This girl is too stubborn. But don’t worry, she will be in her brothers and young master Xie’s care so she won’t be in any trouble.”
On cue, Xue Lin and Xue Gang cupped their hands.
Startled, Zhuo Fan gave them a once over and nodded, despite the sense of loss taking hold on his heart. He felt that he and Ning’er were only growing apart. With mountains rising between them, they could never return to the blissful times they shared in Allbeast Mountain Range.
[This is for the best.] He wanted to numb his heart, and severing those memories of their past encounters was for the best.
With a deep breath, Zhuo Fan regained inner peace, like a stone-cold killer. He said to Xie Tianyang, “Take good care of her and make sure nothing happens!”
“It goes without saying.” Xie Tianyang nodded.
“Zhuo Fan, I’m coming as well!” Luo Yunchang spoke up.
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, “Why, didn’t I say I and Yunhai and ten guards are enough? Why do you want to come all of a sudden? How...”
“No reason, you’ll protect me so it’ll be fine!” Luo Yunchang batted her eyes.
Shaking his head, Zhuo Fan said, “No, too dangerous!”
“Are you worried about me?”
“That’s not it!” Zhuo Fan scratched his nose, “I’ll be in danger if I have to constantly look after you!”
The others chuckled.
Luo Yunchang glared as she kicked his shin. [You make me a dead weight while you said you’d protect Ning’er? What am I then?]
Zhuo Fan let her vent on his leg, stiffened for a second as his face went cold. Luo Yunchang kicked him once but the second kick didn’t come, for her heart grew forlorn the more she looked at Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan had closed off his heart under lock and key. He was like a prideful hero, wishing to bear everything alone...
“The seven houses are here!” The shout got everyone’s attention. With Regent Estate in the lead, the seven houses strutted forth.
Chu Qingcheng was there as well. She glanced at Zhuo Fan only to see his face ever cold and impassive which made her clench her fists.
[Grandmother was right. He is dead inside, not worth any woman’s attention.]
Scoffing, she ignored him and walked behind Grandmother with a frosty gaze.
“Marshal Dugu has arrived!”
Dugu Zhantian brought ten thousand soldiers to surround this area. He did it as a safety measure to instill order.
But the thick scent of blood and steel shuddered the nerves of every disciple here, they who had only known life in the clan.
Laughing, Dugu Zhantian stopped before Zhuo Fan and patted his shoulder, “Ha-ha-ha, kid, I was ready to come out and save you that day, but you have Radiant Stage abilities already. You hid them so well that you even had me worried!”
“Marshal was there as well?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow.
Dugu Zhantian nodded with a smile, “How could I not? Just the day before Huangpu Qingtian showed off his intent. I had to watch over you. Who knew, who friggin’ knew, you are both made of the same cloth, monsters the lot of you! I was worried for nothing, ha-ha-ha...”
Laughing on, Dugu Zhantian turned to Luo Yunhai and gave him some warnings before leaving. The Four Tigers of Tianyu offered their encouragement as they left as well.
Reaching the forefront, Dugu Zhantian surveyed the crowd of clans, “Please step before the array. The Esoteric Debate’s final battle will begin shortly!”
Starting with Regent Estate, the seven houses took the first line in order of the previous Esoteric Debate’s ranking.
Next were the clans, never even entertaining the thought of cutting ahead. The clans either stood behind their master or the house they wished to become a vassal of.
Obviously, Regent Estate had the numerical advantage.
But typical of Regent Estate, that didn’t mean these clans were going to be accepted. While other clans with modicum of strength settled for standing behind other houses they wished to follow.
Dong clan went behind Drifting Flowers Edifices, and Xue clan behind Sword Marquise Abode.
Zhuo Fan glanced at Luo Yunhai and nodded.
Luo Yunhai strutted under the shocked gaze of the people right abreast the seven houses, next to Drifting Flowers Edifices!
The rest of the clan’s members puffed up their chests right behind him.
The shock was understandable. The crowd now realized that the Luo clan was no one’s dog but stood on their own!
But this was a direct challenge to the seven houses’ authority. Would they be able to handle it?

chapters.title: Chapter 269, The Most Enticing Reward
chapters.content:
Chapter 269, The Most Enticing Reward
The seven houses turned their heads but the calm look on their faces said it all. They were expecting this. That only fueled the crowd’s uproar. [The seven houses are accepting the Luo clan’s rise?]
But how could they allow anyone to stand at their level? The Luo clan did have Soaring Demonic Dragon Zhuo Fan, that insane monster, but the rest of the clan was a whole another matter entirely.
Huangpu Tianyuan snickered at the narrow minded clans around him. Were they so blind to see it coming ever since Zhuo Fan started having a field day with the seven houses’ elders?
So even though Luo clan was overstepping its bounds, per usual, none of the houses found it worthy of a reaction.
“Oh, your ambition for power and status sure is commendable. Ha-ha-ha, in the end you still abided by his wishes and showed up.” An aged voice echoed.
The crowd turned around in shock.
They found three old men coming over. The leader being the head of Four Pillars, Prime Minister Zhuge Changfeng flanked by his Yin Yang elders. Even from afar, the people could sense the hidden and thick power they exuded, enough to crush this entire area.
[Why is this geezer here?]
Dugu Zhantian held his beard with a stern face. Huangpu Tianyuan’s side was put off by the presence of Tianyu’s number one mind.
This old bean had extended You Wanshan and company a hand in wrestling out of the emperor’s grip one time, but it was a known fact that no one could truly unravel the real reason behind his ‘kindness’.
His mind was unreadable! Yesterday’s friend could very well turn into today’s enemy. But the worse was the constant anxiety one was in not knowing when that would happen.
Leng Wuchang eyed the hunched figure then shook his head and sighed. Not even he could read the old man.
Hailed as Unwonted Contriver, with everyone an open book before his scrutiny, he had no confidence when it came to reading Zhuge Changfeng!
Zhuge Changfeng sported a vague smile as he walked next to Zhuo Fan, “Have you thought it through? Or are you going to be swept away by the storm?”
Gasps of shock resounded everywhere, [What is the Luo clan and Zhuge Changfeng’s connection?]
They now understood why Luo clan had risen to challenge the seven houses.
[Blast it! With two pillars behind you, the young master under a Marshal and the Prime Minister cheering you on, not even the seven houses would dare slight such a clan!]
[So this... is Luo clan’s true backing!]
People’s faces twitched and their hearts sank. [Why does this never happen to me? Just what tricks did this Luo clan pull to grab hold of two pillars?]
Huangpu Tianyuan’s side was also stunned. They never saw it coming. Zhuge Changfeng came for Zhuo Fan! With even Zhuge Changfeng helping them, they had no chance to finish off the Luo clan. Ever!
Huangpu Tianyuan’s face sank as his knuckles went white.
Leng Wuchang dismissed his worries, “Estate Lord, Zhuge Changfeng is different from Dugu Zhantian, a pragmatic. Even if he intended to get close to Luo clan, it will only be because of Zhuo Fan’s skills. Once Zhuo Fan is out of the picture, they will fall like a ton of bricks!”
“It only makes this time’s Esoteric Debate of paramount importance, to stomp that punk dead!” Huangpu Tianyuan’s eyes flashed with bloodthirst.
Leng Wuchang nodded, turning to the only one who could achieve this feat, Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord Huangpu Qingtian.
Yet the man in question was oblivious to their conversation. His eyes showed he was raring to go turn the entire battlefield upside down.
[Perfect.]
Leng Wuchang chuckled, finding everyone dancing his tune.
Going back to Zhuo Fan, the man smiled, “Prime Minister, how do you know if the Luo clan isn’t in the eye of the storm already?”
Zhuge Changfeng raised an eyebrow, “I trust your judgment. It’s fine as long as you aren’t forced into it. I am eager to see the day Steward Zhuo achieves his ambitions.”
Zhuo Fan nodded and Zhuge Changfeng laughed. He took his Yin Yang elders to Dugu Zhantian, “Old Marshal, please don’t take it hard on me for dropping unannounced.”
“I would never. You are the honorable Prime Minister of our empire. It is only natural to come see the grand Esoteric Debate,” Dugu Zhantian’s beard trembled, his tone cold.
Zhuge Changfeng laughed, “Old Marshal, don’t be so stiff. I’m here by myself out of boredom. Don’t think too much of it.”
[Humph, as if.]
The crowd cursed inside as well. Since when was Zhuge Changfeng that bored to come here without rime or reason. The game was most definitely afoot.
The old fox’s schemes aside, Dugu Zhantian had no time to mind him. His orders were to make sure Esoteric Debate ran smoothly.
Recalling the emperor’s explicit and repeated warnings, a caution the emperor never showed before, led this old general to believe the Esoteric Debate of today had national ramifications.
Dugu Zhantian barked, “By His Majesty’s grace, the Esoteric Debate will allow clansmen below the age of thirty to participate. No one older is allowed entry or I will personally cut them down! The rules will be explained to you shortly by one of Divine Dragons, Jade Flute Divine Sword Fang Qiubai!”
Whoosh!
A whistle of white clothes signified the entrance of an old man holding a jade flute and exuding a dominating air, Fang Qiubai.
Rustle~
A flick of his hand sent five jades taller than two people around the Teleportation Array. Looking at it, the people saw the stone form five huge gates.
“8th grade Army Transfer, National Elemental Stones!”
Looking at the red, yellow, green, blue, and brown stones, Zhuge Changfeng and the seven houses took a step back in shock.
Fang Qiubai nodded, “Correct, this is indeed the array passed down by imperial ancestors!”
Fang Qiubai then made a sign and the stones shone, each reflecting a beautiful scenery, of beasts and birds.
A 3rd level spiritual beast soon passed by and watched the crowd curiously. Then came a 4th level spiritual beast and howled, but was left to claw away at an invisible barrier, unable to reach them.
Fang Qiubai’s voice roused them from the shock, “I will now present you all with the rules for this Esoteric Debate. As you have seen for yourselves, the center and the stone arrays are both unidirectional. You will shortly stand in the center array and I will then send you to the location of the final battle. But to return, the only way is through the National Elemental Stones!”
The crowd looked puzzled.
Fang Qiubai continued, “The five National Elemental Stones are a one way door, but from the final battle location to here! To activate it you will need to find not only these stones but also their key! However, each array has a yin and yang key that must be joined to return. And the order of your arrival will mark your ranking.”
“Simple enough.” Huangpu Qingtian smiled. The others nodded, finding it pretty straightforward. It all came down to finding some keys and the way back.
The greatest danger was merely deadly battles between clans, nothing of importance.
Fang Qiubai raised an eyebrow, and snickered, “Simple is it? You won’t be saying that after you find out the location.”
The clans stared at him distraught.
“Beast King Mountain!” Fang Qiubai mocked.
Sss~
Gasps echoed around and some even felt their knees shaking.
Beast King Mountain wasn’t as deadly as Allbeast Mountain Range, but high level spiritual beasts were nevertheless present. There were many 5th and 6th level spiritual beast kings roaming, hence the name Beast King Mountain.
Even Profound Heaven and Radiant Stage experts would have a hard time scouring that place for anything, not to mention the plenty of Bone Tempering cultivators among the clans.
There was no need to even fight when the spiritual beasts would kill them off before they could even meet.
The hearts of everyone sank in despair. Why was this time’s battle so cruel and deadly?
Only Six Dragons, One Phoenix and Zhuo Fan were the picture of calmness.
Glancing at these monsters left them stomping in indignation. Was this place chosen with these freaks in mind? [If you take away the eight monsters, you’d only have average people! This is ridiculous!]
Fang Qiubai grinned at their silent protest, “But of course, no danger comes unwarranted. It is slightly dangerous this time around, but the reward is up to the risk. These are five 8th grade pills, Brimming Sacred Pill. It will be up to each one of you to earn it!”
[Say what?!]
Zhuo Fan and Huangpu Qingtian were both affected.
The Brimming Sacred Pill was of most value to a Radiant Stage expert or those on the brink. Across the whole of Tianyu, this pill was the rarest of all. Not even the seven houses had one.
Huangpu Qingtian, Huangpu Tianyuan and other peak Profound Heaven experts needed just one little pill and they would jump right into being a Radiant Stage expert with no strings attached.
While to a Radiant Stage expert, it would boost their soul many times over.
“Worth it!”
Huangpu Tianyuan was moved as he looked at his son. He had been stuck at peak Profound Heaven Stage for decades. This chance was godsent.
And yet, Huangpu Qingtian’s face left him cold.
[God damn it! If this brat gets it, he’ll eat it on the spot!]
Zhuge Changfeng frowned as he twirled his mustache, “The old man has come out swinging. He is eager to begin his plan!”
While the second and third rate clans looked on in forlorn depression.
[This is clearly meant for those monsters! Where among us do you see a Radiant Stage or peak Profound Heaven expert? Taking it will only make us pop like fireworks!]
It came with great fear and trepidation as to how cruel this event would be for them.
This stage was practically designed to be the death of them. They were nothing more than cannon fodder! But to climb aboard a house, a timely help would get the attention they desperately yearned. Even if they were cannon fodder, they’d still risk it...

chapters.title: Chapter 270, Beast King Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 270, Beast King Mountain
“Alright, youngsters. Time to go!”
Fang Qiubai made a hand sign and pointed at the dark mass in the center of the array.
In a dazzling fashion, a pillar of light sprung up straight to the sky and forced people to squint.
Every clan’s younger generation rubbed their eyes and their mouths twitched. But no matter how unwilling, they all walked on.
[Go! Go! Just go and die!]
They all cursed. No matter how they thought about it, Fang Qiubai’s ‘cheering’ felt more like a blatant wish for an untimely death!
Not like they had a choice in the matter. So on they went, for their clan’s honor, and for their future!
Whoosh~
People sank into the pillar of light one after another, gone for good.
Zhuo Fan glanced at the array and said to Luo Yunhai’s group, “The Teleportation Array is random and will split us up. No matter what happens, you are to search for each other first and foremost!”
“Yes, Steward Zhuo!” The ten young guards nodded and Luo Yunhai spoke gravely, “Don’t worry, brother Zhuo, my godfather put me through some scouting lessons and I’ll quickly find you.”
Grinning, Zhuo Fan said, “It was a good thing after all, leaving you in Marshal’s care all those years. I can rest easy now.”
Luo Yunhai’s eyes shined with resolve.
“Let’s go!” Zhuo Fan took his group through the light pillar. Luo Yunchang’s side looked from afar and prayed for their safety.
“Zhuo Fan, I will make you pay for killing my master!” A sudden roar caught Zhuo Fan’s attention. Yan Fu watched him filled with revenge and hatred, more obvious now that the white light separated them.
Zhuo Fan was stunned, [Damn, forgot about that twerp.]
[This guy is a coward anyway. He only waited for me to get in the array before barking!]
[Ah, what a chicken.]
Zhuo Fan shook his head and sighed. He was gone.
Yan Fu however was over the moon. He actually managed to provoke the monster. Yan Bangui walked over and mocked, “Spineless brat, try to refrain from being so despicable next time.”
The other houses also snickered.
[Waiting for your enemy to be unable to do anything to you, if that isn’t cowardice, what is? You’ve gone long on the path of a gutless rat!]
As they looked at him in ridicule, the rest of the seven houses entered the pillar of light as well. Yan Fu gnashed his teeth, his face flushed as he followed them.
The bustling place from moments ago soon turned quiet.
Fang Qiubai found all participants gone and closed the array with another hand sign. Yet beyond his perception, two shadowy figures slipped past just as he finished...
Whoosh!
The towering light pillar died and Zhuo Fan found himself in the heart of a forest. He didn’t even get to make sense of his surroundings as a roar grated his ears.
With a rancid smell and whistling wind signaling its arrival, a dozens of meter tall bear rose behind him. With his rock splitting paw, it smashed right for him.
Even a 9th layer of Bone Tempering cultivator would be hard pressed to face such power.
Snapping his head back, Zhuo Fan frowned, “4th level spiritual beast, Mountain Crushing Bear?”
The giant paw was right in his face, yet all Zhuo Fan did was have his eye flash azure.
The fierce bear paw came to a grinding halt and the giant bear was scared out of his mind as he ran with all his power.
Zhuo Fan watched the disappearing humongous bear with a snicker.
[The azure flame’s use isn’t limited to Allbeast Mountain Range. All spiritual beasts are under its influence.]
This would make the trip to Beast King Mountain a breeze. While others had to painstakingly pay attention to any high level spiritual beasts on the prowl, he was out on an evening stroll.
The Beast King Mountain was his home turf.
On the other hand, it was a nightmare for the rest of those poor suckers. Particularly those that had yet to enter the Profound Heaven Stage.
Since he was welcomed by a 4th level spiritual beast, the others ought to be receiving more or less the same honor, no?
“I have to find Yunhai fast!” Frowning, Zhuo Fan’s wings unfolded and he took to the skies.
Some flying spiritual beasts shot straight for him, but a flash of azure flame from Zhuo Fan’s eyes cut their intent clean off.
Whoosh~
Flashes of white dazzled the sky for the better part of the next hour yet Zhuo Fan never met another person. He sighed at how ridiculously vast the Beast King Mountain was.
If he didn’t find the others fast, who knew what might happen?
“Save me!”
A charming voice entered his ears.
Zhuo Fan paused. [With how vicious the Beast King Mountain is, no normal person would be stupid enough to come here. This person has to be a contender!]
Among the many clans that joined, Drifting Flowers Edifices had the most girls!
[Should I or should I not?]
Zhuo Fan mulled it over for a second before flying down.
[I guess it won’t be nice to watch your own ally bite the dust without helping. Since I won’t find Yunhai anytime soon, I better lend a helping hand.]
Zhuo Fan sent out a soul ripple and locked onto the source of the sound in an instant.
He saw a huge lake in the distance, wide enough that it was impossible to see the other shore. The place was verdant and lush, framed perfectly by the sun’s rays. But the water of the lake started to roil and billow as huge waves rose all over the place.
A charming girl slammed into the water in great distress. Across from her was a quarter mile long scarlet venomous serpent. It’s eerie pair of sharp eyes looked at the panicking girl with hunger.
“6th level spiritual beast, Overpowering Flood Dragon?” Zhuo Fan squinted in shock.
That was no ordinary snake, but a water serpent descended from the mighty Flood Dragon. Such a spiritual beast was a natural king. It was a peak existence even among 6th level spiritual beasts!
Not even a common 7th level spiritual beast could contend with it.
Zhuo Fan gasped in awe at the Beast King Mountain hiding such a monster. Even more so to the bad luck this missy had, in landing not just in its turf, but its home waters. In fact, she popped right in its goddamned open maw! It couldn’t get any worse than that...
Sss~
Flicking its red tongue, the serpent opened its maw ready to swallow the girl whole.
The girl shuddered and curled up, giving up on herself.
Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed with a golden ring and he appeared next to her. With another flash, they were gone.
The savage serpent bit down but got nothing but fresh water. It looked around agape, [Where’d she go?]
The more it looked around, the more shocked it became.
Not for a second did the serpent believe that she was fast enough to escape its range. The only plausible answer was, [An illusion?]
It lifted its huge tail, creating a fifty meter wide splash.
It rubbed its head with the tip in bewilderment.
[How come? Am I growing senile and have started seeing things?]
In another area, the girl closed her eyes and shivered in Zhuo Fan’s embrace, waiting for the jaws of death to rob her life. She waited yet nothing came, not even pain.
She only felt a bit chilly as the breeze traced her curves.
The girl cracked her eyes open to see a broad chest and the blue sky.
Zhuo Fan was paying attention to where he flew with a cold stare. But when he felt her squirming, he said, “You’re alright, ah...”
Zhuo Fan’s voice was stuck in his throat and his scalp went numb watching the nubile figure. [The girl’s naked!]
The girl looked at him and then at her silky smooth and uncovered skin before blushing and wailing, “Ah~, you rogue! Don’t look! Close your eyes!”
“You’re the damn rogue! What are you doing coming here without clothes? Since when is Drifting Flowers Edifices so deviant?”
“What Drifting Flowers Edifices? I know no Drifting Flowers Edifices. I thought I told you to shut your eyes! Don’t you dare look!”
“Zip it. It’s perfectly normal for a man to look, especially now. Go and wear something if you don’t like it!”
“You...”
She glared at him and huffed. Her eyes sparkled, on the verge of tears and her face was growing flushed by the second...

chapters.title: Chapter 271, Beast Mistress
chapters.content:
Chapter 271, Beast Mistress
Ding~
In the thick forest, Zhuo Fan was facing away from the bush behind him in silence and focus. He could even hear some clear ringing coming from that bush.
Zhuo Fan sighed.
[No good deed goes unpunished.] He went and saved the damsel, only to find her naked. So they made a pit stop at a bush to dress up. But this chick was taking her sweet time doing it. [Can’t you just put on a coat or a robe and be done with it? Look at me!]
Rustle~
The grass crunched behind him and Zhuo Fan turned. He was in for the shock of his life.
He hadn’t gotten a good look at this damsel, with the rescuing and all, but now that he had, she was quite the looker. She had a cute button nose, more than generous curves, and big eyes to reflect complex emotions.
Considering her clothes, it was a striking difference from the refined and graceful silken robes. They were made with ease of movements in mind. The constant ringing finally drew his attention to her bracelet having a bell attached, completing her wild look.
[She’s a foreigner!]
Zhuo Fan watched on speechless. Never had it crossed his mind that in a place filled with his clans’ disciples, he would find a girl not native of Tianyu!
Noticing the obvious look she was getting, the girl blushed. She was squirming with shyness, but still had the guts to give him a sharp glare, “What are you looking at? See how I’ll poke your eyes out!”
“Tch, not that there’s anything to see. Why are you so feisty?” Zhuo Fan jabbed.
The girl blushed harder and felt disgruntled. She was a pure and single girl and then she stumbled upon this stranger who had got more than an eyeful. How could she face the world now?
She was mortified, wishing to bury her head in her chest.
[Go die!]
All this while Zhuo Fan was walking away cursing, “God friggin’ damn it! I saved the wrong damsel and wasted all this time too...”
Glaring, the girl spat, “What’s the meaning of this? You regret saving me?”
She skipped in front of him and fixed her piercing eyes on him.
Zhuo Fan’s words struck a nerve and she got over her shyness in a jiffy.
[I’m an exotic beauty, a man’s dream! It was your greatest fortune getting to save me and even getting an eyeful.]
[What’s with that tone, as if you were the one found naked? I am the one hurting here. You ruined me!]
[Humph, greedy pig!]
The girl’s eyes were staring a hole into Zhuo Fan, wishing to tear him a new one.
And Zhuo Fan’s response? Pushing her aside in mid stride, “Move, I’ve wasted enough pointless time on you as it is.”
The girl eyed the proud Zhuo Fan walking away and blinked.
[And you call yourself a man?]
This was a first. All the men she had met so far were quite taken with her, not cold as ice like this one. Then she recalled the desire in his eyes when he got an eyeful in the sky and it was clear that this guy was a man from head to toe. [So why?]
Then it hit her. What was she doing looking hopeful instead of getting her due for staining a girl’s reputation? [Ah, how mortifying...]
She cupped her blushing cheeks, her mind drawing all kinds of untoward conclusions.
Not that Zhuo Fan had a mind to care. He ignored this ‘fated’ encounter and was this close to forgetting her as well. What was the point in remembering every bystander?
Roar!
A sudden gust signaled the appearance of a golden panther as it jumped down from a tree up above.
It stared savagely at Zhuo Fan, bearing its reeking fangs as well.
“4th level spiritual beast, Mountain Crossing Golden Panther!” The girl cried in fear.
Zhuo Fan only frowned with slight worry.
With 4th level spiritual beasts being the order of the day on Beast King Mountain, he was plagued by what might happen to Yunhai.
The girl figured Zhuo Fan was rooted to his spot from sheer terror and rushed to his rescue.
The spiritual beast started laughing at Zhuo Fan’s outlandish reaction.
[He-he-he, I scared the kid witless with my entrance. Purrrfect, it has been days since my last feast!]
Roar!
The kitty pounced, its maw ready to swallow Zhuo Fan whole.
Zhuo Fan smiled as his eyes were about to flash the danger away, just as a graceful figure jumped in front and blocked the savage beast.
Ding~
The girl’s bracelet rang melodiously as she faced that savage pair of eyes with her charm. The girl then started moving her waist to the ringing, just like a dance.
All the beast could do was gawk in a trance at the dancing girl.
Zhuo Fan was stunned. He never knew you could deal with spiritual beasts in such an outlandish way.
Through dancing and soul power, one charmed their opponent. Humans were hardly affected, but spiritual beasts with their tiny minds gobbled it up on the spot.
As the girl went along her dancing routine, the spiritual beast’s head was lolling about and its eyes glazed.
Then the girl clapped.
The savage beast’s head cocked and slumped. The fear and dizziness in its eyes made a stark contrast with the contentment on its face.
Left gasping, the girl wiped her brow.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Ha-ha-ha, you’re really something. This world sure is wide and there are many approaches to the same problem.”
“Hey, don’t just stand there and comment on my skill from your high horse!” Snapping her glare on him, the girl said after a pause, “Looking at you, you’re just a 9th layer Bone Tempering cultivator. No wonder this 4th level spiritual beast scared you silly.”
“Right back at you. Who was it I wonder, that had her bare ass saved from that lake?” Zhuo Fan snickered. The girl now had his full attention.
Blushing, the girl stuck out her head, “How is that the same? That thing in the water was a 6th level spiritual beast... Wait! How are you able to fly as a Bone Tempering cultivator? How did you save me? I am in the 2nd layer of the Profound Heaven Stage myself, but not even I could escape that monster!”
Finally getting her wits about her, she realized the sheer ridiculousness of it all. How was she spared from ending up a 6th level spiritual beast’s lunch?
Zhuo Fan wasn’t about to blurt all his secrets to a total stranger and only showed off his Lightning Wings with a smile, “These things are quite fast, enough to outrun a water serpent.”
The girl blinked for a second and nodded, “I see, a 6th grade flying spiritual weapon.”
