The sight of those lightning-streaked wings had the girl musing. Then she said in all seriousness, “Oi, kid, since you saved me and I saved you, we’re even!”
Zhuo Fan nodded. Though technically, he could’ve easily dealt with the kitty.
“But...” The girl flushed again for some odd reason and was plagued by indecision. Her voice grew fainter to such a degree, even Zhuo Fan would’ve had a hard time hearing if not for his cultivation.
“You still owe me for seeing me naked...”
“Oh, that makes sense.”
Zhuo Fan nodded and chuckled, “I totally understand you. Don’t worry, I am not one to leave a debt unsettled. One moment.”
Zhuo Fan then removed his sash.
The girl became bug eyed and turned away in embarrassment, “What are you doing, rogue?”
“You said I took advantage of your plight, so I’m only returning the favor. This should make us even. He-he-he, rest easy m’lady, I will definitely won’t ask anything in return, including integrity.” Zhuo Fan snickered, sizing the shivering lady with a curious eye.
The girl was fuming now, “Damn pervert! That’s not what I meant!”
“What else is there? You mean you want more?” Zhuo Fan grinned, “Fine, my magnanimous self will never be so petty as a certain girl. Go ahead, feel me up as much as you want. Ha-ha-ha, do as you wish with me, I won’t complain. Really, not one peep.”
“Ahh~, rotten pervert! I’ve had it with you!” The girl was stomping and pouting, “I-I only want you to help me get some Shaping Spring. I don’t need to see your... your...”
“Shaping Spring?”
Zhuo Fan’s playful mood was gone, replaced by dead seriousness.
[This matter... is starting to become interesting...]

chapters.title: Chapter 272, Shaping Spring
chapters.content:
Chapter 272, Shaping Spring
Shaping Spring was an underground river flowing for millions of years. Subjected to constant heat from the core, it was formed of earth’s essence and it was priceless.
While Ice Heart Moon Soul of Xue Qingjian was a peak water treasure of yin, the Shaping Spring was a yang water essence.
Just like Diamond Sand, the Shaping Spring was among the best ingredients, if not the best itself. They said Diamond Sand was the blood of the earth, while Shaping Spring was earth’s blood’s blood. Diamond Sand was a hard ingredient and Shaping Spring a soft one. Diamond Sand made strong spiritual weapons, while Shaping Spring allowed a spiritual weapon to go through endless changes.
Water had no form, shape or size, and with just a drop of Shaping Spring placed in a spiritual weapon, it would turn into a sacred item, free to change its size at will.
Big and unstoppable as a hammer of a thousand pounds, or small and sublime like an invisible needle.
There was one more incredible property the Shaping Spring had the others didn’t know about. It matched with a body refining array. Zhuo Fan grinned as his mind drifted to the tall pillar in his Thunder Ring.
It not once crossed his mind to take this direction, since he never could. But now he had a chance at getting the Shaping Spring and with it, he could complete that art written in the Nine Serenities Secret Records. He may very well gain the same freakish power Gu Santong exhibited!
Zhuo Fan was very excited to try.
If he could get his hands on the same power that made Gu Santong invincible in Tianyu, then the father and son pair... but not even his imagination could fully grasp the extent of such power.
The danger of achieving such a godly refinement was thousands of times greater than when he refined his body with Diamond Sand.
Hesitation had him for a second, but he shook his head clear. [There’s no time to delay. That thought comes after I can get it.]
Then his trademark evil smile graced his face once again, “Miss, what would you have me do?”
The girl eyed him skeptically. [Why is this punk so warm all of a sudden? Odd...]
But taking a look at Zhuo Fan’s cultivation in the Bone Tempering Stage, her worries were put to rest.
What could a 9th layer of Bone Tempering Stage possibly do when he only had a 6th grade spiritual weapon built for speed?
The girl smiled in kind, “Come with me. Help me get the Shaping Spring, and what you did to me... uh, it’ll make us square.”
The girl blushed.
Zhuo Fan nodded with the same hypocritical smile as always.
He felt like sighing. [Oh, so many people judge me by my cultivation, only to be swallowed whole by me.]
[This girlie is no different.]
He followed close behind her with a cold smile.
For some very odd reason, she shivered from a creepy feeling striking her very core. Yet her response was to cock her head in bewilderment...
Ah, another lady got duped...
The duo soon arrived at the edge of a lake. Zhuo Fan’s eyes trembled, [Isn’t this the same lake I saved her from?]
The girl smiled, “Hey, do you know why I was in danger last time?”
“Do you even need to ask? Bathing in some else’s home is the same as taking a leak in it. If I was that water serpent, I’d swallow you in one gulp too.” Zhuo Fan said sagely.
Blushing, she seethed, “W-what bathing? Who would do that in such a dangerous place? Where do you come up with all these dumb conclusions?”
“What else is there? Weren’t you going all natural when I got you out?” Zhuo Fan scratched his nose.
Yet for some reason, despite his unfazed face, his body was quite honest. Two trails of blood flowed down his nose.
Zhuo Fan was stunned, “Eh, why am I bleeding?”
The girl was flushed and smacked his head in resentfulness, “Stop having errant thoughts or I... I...”
“I what? Make me bathe naked for you to look?” Zhuo Fan snorted.
The girl was stomping in anger, red as a tomato. Why was she so unlucky to meet this creep?
Then again, only by working together with this creep could she get the Shaping Spring and she sighed. She reigned in her indignation and turned grave, “Do you see that cave across the lake?”
Zhuo Fan followed her fingers to see endless fog surrounding a mountain. There was also a faint image of a man sized cave entrance at its foot, half of it submerged in water. Zhuo Fan nodded, “What of it?”
“That is the serpent’s cave.” The girl said.
Zhuo Fan asked, “How, that thing was five hundred meters long. The cave is too small for...”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes jumped. The girl giggled and made good use of this rare chance to mock him, “He-he-he, you’re not as dumb as you look. Yes, that serpent is definitely eating the Shaping Spring. It allows it to change its size and enter that cave.”
“What makes you so sure Shaping Spring is in there? Perhaps the venomous serpent ate it somewhere else, or maybe it’s in the middle of eating...” Zhuo Fan frowned.
Whoosh~
With a flash of light, a golden-tailed carp jumped in front of him, splashing his face with icy cold water.
Pff!
The girl giggled, reveling in his misery, content she finally managed to get some retribution. Zhuo Fan wiped his face, uncaring that she did it on purpose, “I see. You have a 1st level water type pet you used to scout the poisonous serpent’s cave while it was away.”
“Clever boy.”
The girl winked and smiled, “I’ve been staking out the strange 6th level spiritual beast since I found it a month ago. Until three days ago, it only kept to the cave. So I used my 1st level spiritual beast, Golden-fin Fish, to find that it really contained Shaping Spring. But that poisonous serpent was truly vicious, coming back just an hour later. So I waited the past three days for it to come out. But since it didn’t, I had no choice but to go in and confront it.”
Seeing the girl’s charming smile, like she had hit the jackpot, Zhuo Fan jabbed, “So you got naked and tried working your wiles on it? Wait, that ain’t right, you’re different species. Even if you forced yourself on that ‘hunk’, it would only see you as lunch.”
“W-what nonsense are you babbling? Who would ever seduce that beast?”
Blushing, the girl gnashed her teeth in anger, “I-I only intended to use my beast controlling art to tame it. There is nothing obscene about it!”
“Beast taming? What does that have to do with you running around in all your glory?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow.
The girl’s glare sharpened a notch, “Oy, could you stop with the vulgarities? My clan’s beast controlling art pays special attention to being one with nature. The more in tune one is, the stronger the art. Since I can only tame a 4th level spiritual beast at most, I had to give my body and soul in joining with nature this time around. But I failed anyway because its soul is stronger than average and almost lost my life at its jaws of death.”
Zhuo Fan nodded. The venomous serpent was related to the Flood Dragon. Dragon blood flowed through its veins. How could it be just a mere 6th level spiritual beast? The girl was in over her head trying to charm the beastie with her skill.
“Oi, brat, weren’t you quick at flying? Draw the venomous serpent out and let me fetch the Shaping Spring! Do that and I will cross out the crass attitude and disrespect you showed me.”
The girl showed a bewitching smile and batted her big puppy eyes.
That might have worked on your average hormone riddled male to fire him up in braving any dangers. But Zhuo Fan, however, was a stone cold killer.
“My thoughts exactly.” Zhuo Fan showed his trademark evil smirk.
The girl’s eyes shined with glee, but Zhuo Fan could easily see a spark of contempt hidden there. One that said, [All men are the same.]
[Humph, ignorant bint, now that I know where Shaping Spring is, you’ve outlived your usefulness.]
Snickering to himself, Zhuo Fan flew to the cave. The girl stared at him all the way with an increasingly wider smile.
She could practically hold the Shaping Spring in her arms.
Yet something nagged her in the corner of her mind. [Isn’t this perhaps a little too easy? Is this man that much of a fool, so easily taken in by some eye batting and exploited to his literal death?]

chapters.title: Chapter 273, Great Haul
chapters.content:
Chapter 273, Great Haul
Bang~
Zhuo Fan pummeled the entrance wall. The gonging sound was eerily similar to someone knocking on a metal door.
The girl looked on dazed, from a very safe distance. [This punk has nerves of steel, I’ll give him that. Or is he plain indifferent to the 6th level spiritual beast just waiting for him inside.]
[Speaking of his insensitivity, was he that easily taken in by my charm?]
The girl looked at him closer, [Something isn’t right here.]
Splash~
Then, the sound of water was heard and a meter long water serpent swam out of the cave. It shook as its body expanded.
It was back to its five hundred meters long size in a blink, which created a huge splash as he hissed at the two humans.
Hiss!
The stench licked his cheek and Zhuo Fan clutched his nose as he sized the snake.
[This guy ate Shaping Spring alright.]
The girl was waving her hand down yonder in panic. Not out of worry for Zhuo Fan, of course, but his death would mean her venture would abruptly end with a big fat zero haul.
[Why is this brat just standing there? Is he scared shitless? God damn it, why did I fail when I’m so close?]
The girl gnashed her teeth in annoyance.
The venomous serpent thought the same, laughing out loud and looking with contempt.
[This brat must be so naive to knock at my home. Now that he has basked in my royal glory, he’s scared witless. Ha-ha-ha, it’s only natural. Even I am in awe of my glorious self most of the time, ha-ha-ha...]
Glancing at the delusional snake, and its wagging tail, Zhuo Fan could read him like a book. He grinned as he simply flew inside the cave.
“Guard this place and don’t come in without my say.” Zhuo Fan belittled this useless thing and just waltzed in.
The venomous serpent was out of it from shock. [What did he just say? To watch the door?]
The serpent was enraged. No one ever ignored it, least of all claim its cave like he owned the place!
[Oy, punk, do you have any idea whose home this is? Do you have a death wish?]
Hiss!
The venomous serpent got closer to Zhuo Fan and hissed in his face. Covering him in drool, it hoped to knock some sense into him with its almighty majesty.
The girl was soaked from fear. [Run you fool!]
Yet Zhuo Fan only had disdain in his eyes. He wiped the drool from his face, and glared, “Behave.”
Pff!
The venomous serpent almost spat blood. It had never met someone so full of themselves to ignore it and even belittle it. It was royally pissed.
The girl was scared witless.
[You behave, brat! You’re pissing it off by telling it to watch the door. I get you want to die but could you at least do it down yonder? Some of us still need to get in, you know?]
[The guy’s brains are on the fritz!]
She sighed. She could practically see the kid torn into pieces by the angry venomous serpent.
And that was what the serpent was about to do.
[Holy friggin’ balls! I’ve seen many dauntless, but none so boneheaded to not even care for their lives. They look for death or, better yet, they deserve death with such an idiotic stance.]
[You’re dead meat, so cut the act. Humph, as you wish, this king will send you off.]
Licking its sharp fangs, the venomous serpent hissed and went on to swallow him whole. With how the red mouth was covered in poison, Zhuo Fan would find himself melting the instant he touched it.
The girl closed her eyes and looked away. She couldn’t bear the horror that followed.
Yet Zhuo Fan was cool as a cucumber as the azure flame flashed in his eyes.
Hum~
A ripple wracked the venomous serpent.
Scared, the huge serpent froze in its place.
He was soaked in sweat, even as his maw was right on top of Zhuo Fan, with fangs bared and all. And yet he just didn’t chomp.
The look in Zhuo Fan’s eye got him so terrified, it started shivering.
“You’re so feisty to not listen when you’re ordered.” Zhuo Fan shook his head as he went in like he owned the place.
Leaving the venomous serpent behind like a statue, scared and dumbfounded.
[W-what power was that?]
The serpent’s heart was frantic.
Spiritual beasts cared a lot about levels, more than the strength even. A 6th level spiritual beast’s pup was no stronger than a 3rd level spiritual beast but no 4th level spiritual beast would dare attack it.
It was their inborn majestic aura doing its thing. No low level spiritual beast messed with a higher one, ever. It was etched in their bones, blood, and the like.
As a 6th level spiritual beast, it was invincible here. A king lording over the masses. It had the right to pick on others, not the other way around!
But it finally got his due in the form of Zhuo Fan. The guy flexed his power for a blink and scared the living daylights out of the snake.
It had no clue what level of spiritual beast that power was equivalent to, but its blood told him to surrender and lay down all hostilities against Zhuo Fan.
[Damn it all to hell! What was that?] He held such power that it made even a 6th level spiritual beast shake in its own skin.
[What savage beast could have such power? And why is it with a human? Is he perhaps a dreadful beast’s young?]
The venomous serpent was sweating buckets. It was just like a beggar meeting an emperor, with only obedience in his heart.
If it was told to guard the door, that was what it’d do. What was so bad about it anyway?
It went to such an extent that the snake swam out of the cave and didn’t even have the gall to look behind him.
While the girl who had struck Zhuo Fan off as a dead man, sneaked a peak all this time and was now dumbstruck.
[What the hell? Since when were vicious venomous serpents so meek? It’s not only not entering the cave, but was even posing as a damn watchdog!]
[How in bloody hell did a Bone Tempering cultivator do this? Does he also have a secret beast taming art?]
The girl cocked her head, glancing at Zhuo Fan going further in with amazement and more than a little curiosity.
[This brat isn’t as dumb as he looks. He may very well not have needed my help with the 4th level spiritual beast as well. Wait, if he’s so strong and all, why is he hiding it? Is he planning to take it all for himself?]
The girl panicked and stomped in anger. Her wish to go in there herself was curbed by the venomous serpent guard at the door.
This time she was close to blowing a gasket. She had wasted a month staking out this place, only to let another person reap the reward.
[I was hustled!]
She then pouted and slumped on the ground, sulking...
Back to Zhuo Fan, the man in question soon arrived at the end of the cave. The view here shocked him senseless.
The cave was your average hole in the mountain, opening into a room a thousand square meters in size, but the dazzling scene was breathtaking.
He came here for Shaping Spring and actually found so many high grade herbs. There were a hundred 8th grade and at least a thousand 7th grade herbs!
Such haul could contest with the seven houses’ stores.
If not even imperial family’s!
[Holy mother of god! True wealth truly comes from nature.] He assumed these were all gathered by the snakey, but why didn’t he eat them? [To last him through the winter?]
[More for me, I guess! He-he-he...]
Without further ado, and not caring for the beast outside, he pocketed all herbs with a wave. He even went to every corner and made sure he didn’t miss anything.
Zhuo Fan cackled like mad for such a great haul.
It echoed along the cave walls and traveled outside.
Venomous serpent’s heart sank and tears fell from his eyes.
The girl heard the cackle as well and almost sank into depression. [Those were supposed to be mine!]
Having already scouted the cave with her pet fish, she knew what a jackpot that cave held. She didn’t tell Zhuo Fan about it in fear he’d want a bite as well.
And now? He didn’t just take a bite but swallowed it whole.
The girl was wallowing in misery, tears threatening to burst out of her clear eyes...

chapters.title: Chapter 274, Divine Eye of the Void’s 2nd Stage
chapters.content:
Chapter 274, Divine Eye of the Void’s 2nd Stage
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan drifted around in the cave, waving his ring in every direction. He could feel joy bubbling out of him with every precious ingredient being tucked away in the safe confines of his ring.
He just came to Beast King Mountain and had already made a killing. [This is the best goddamn omen of all!]
Zhuo Fan cackled, his sound chilling the snake and human outside to the bone.
After he had made sure nothing was left unappropriated, Zhuo Fan began his search for Shaping Spring in earnest. His soul sense spread to every corner.
Then Zhuo Fan rushed deeper. Standing next to a hot spring, he watched the bottom of the spring in shock.
An all natural hot spring! It was ten meter wide and had hot water coming out from the wall in front. But what was truly amazing was the thick white layer at the bottom of it.
Zhuo Fan knew right away that this was Shaping Spring.
[Isn’t it a bit too much?]
Not even he had hoped to find so much of the underground miraculous treasure. Just a vial of the stuff could buy you a town!
He’d be happy with just a bowl. But he didn’t just get a bowl, he instead got a whole tub!
He could literally bathe in it.
Zhuo Fan shuddered from excitement. Thinking back on this mountain, he realized that only after billions of years of accumulation could have gathered so much of Shaping Spring.
There would’ve been even more of it if not for a certain snake sampling it.
[This is enough as it is. Anyways, one shouldn’t be too greedy. It’s bad for health.]
Zhuo Fan chuckled at his egotistical thinking. Any who heard him would’ve spat blood. [If you’re not greedy then the people in this world are all altruists.]
[Humph, greedy pig!]
Plop!
With a laugh, Zhuo Fan jumped right in. He sank until the Shaping Spring reached his waist.
Zhuo Fan quirked his eyebrows in glee.
[So deep!]
There was even more of the Shaping Spring than he thought was possible.
Zhuo Fan went right down to business. Taking out bottles and filling them with the stuff before throwing them into his ring.
Zhuo Fan’s face always sported that dumb grin throughout this ‘ordeal’, smiling from ear to ear.
[I hit pay dirt coming to this Beast King Mountain. It’s totally worth it even if I don’t get that Brimming Sacred Pill. Ha-ha-ha...]
Zhuo Fan’s laughter echoed throughout the cave.
Bam!
While he was hauling his booty, he touched upon something. It didn’t sound like a rock, but something hollow.
He groped around blindly before taking out a blue vial. Zhuo Fan looked at it curiously.
[Why is there a vial here? Is collecting baubles another one of the serpent’s hobbies?]
But the writing on it left him stupefied, “My luck can’t be that good, right? Did I actually stumble upon a Brimming Sacred Pill?”
Yes sir, the vial had those exact words on it. The cap even had a seal on it to not leak its fragrance and attract spiritual beasts.
Zhuo Fan started flipping it.
Fang Qiubai threw five such pills into Beast King Mountain at the start. This one must’ve flown through an underground river and chanced upon this place, with the snake totally oblivious of it.
Zhuo Fan sighed, [I’m so lucky even I’m scared.]
The odds of finding a Brimming Sacred Pill among Shaping Spring was a true close to zero chance.
But was he one to waste such an opportunity? Hell no! He threw it in his ring and resumed hauling his loot. It took him half a day of ‘grueling’ work to capture it all, down to the last drop.
The venomous serpent outside was swimming around, peeved. [Just what are you doing in my home? Couldn’t you at least leave some for me? Waaah~]
Uncaring and unfeeling for the heartbroken snake outside, Zhuo Fan had no idea about the meaning of restraint. He took one last look at the spotless walls, and nodded in satisfaction that he didn’t miss anything.
Woe was the poor snake. It was now a millionaire turned pauper, wrung dry by Zhuo Fan.
If it’d only seen this spotless place, it’d be crying his lungs out.
Not that the greedy Zhuo Fan ever cared, mind you.
Zhuo Fan now took his time to inspect the Brimming Sacred Pill. He uncapped it and swallowed it.
With enemies coming out at every turn in the Esoteric Debate, he was hard pressed to find such leisure again, giving him enough time to refine the pill. It’d be best to stay in here, under the snake’s watch and grow stronger.
Boom!
An explosion of soul power happened the instant he swallowed it. As if a sea was unleashed in his head, his mind threatened to burst.
Zhuo Fan never thought the pill would be so outrageously strong. Finding it painful even for him to absorb such a vast amount.
Nevertheless, he was happy as he channeled it into his right eye. With his soul at the Radiant Stage, increasing it a few more times would hardly help him in this battle.
His focus was on reaching the Divine Eye of the Void’s 2nd stage with the help of the Brimming Sacred Pill!
The 1st stage had incredible power and made him practically invincible, but the 2nd stage was even more so, as it covered his deadly weakness.
His victory in this final battle solely rested on it!
Zhuo Fan’s right eye burned hot as the golden ring in it flickered. Slowly, a second golden halo came into existence beyond the first.
Even if blood spilled from his eye, even if the pain was excruciating, he braced for it and remained staunch!
If he hadn’t missed his chance in Dragon Cloud City, it wouldn’t have been such an ordeal. But now, forced by circumstances, he chose to power his way through, multiplying his agony instead.
He couldn’t even spare the attention to care though. Even as he bled from his eye, even as he was soaked in sweat, he still remained firmly seated on the ground.
Over the next couple of days, Zhuo Fan was in constant frown and veins bulged on his forehead. He was still suffering through the pain and felt the breaking point drawing ever nearer.
He reached his limit on the afternoon of the third day. He was teetering on the edge, just as the second halo formed in his right eye.
An invisible wave shot to the skies the next moment. A simple glare actually made a small hole straight through the whole five hundred meter tall mountain above him like it was nothing!
The bright sky, the warm sunlight, passed through it and shined upon the gleeful Zhuo Fan. He was spent and weary, but thrilled.
Divine Eye of the Void’s 2nd stage, Void Annihilation!
The power to break through any space!
Even trapped in an array or space, he’d now have no problem blowing his way out all thanks to a little help from something called Divine Eye of the Void’s 2nd stage.
“Ha-ha-ha, awesome! I am truly invincible now!” Zhuo Fan cackled, but fell the instant he tried getting up.
He guessed that he would have to wait as tending to his soul came first. A great deal of his soul power was used on breaking through and it was now time to use the rest to cultivate.
So he sat cross legged again.
The next day, his soul spread around and found everything to be far clearer. He realized the range had increased to two miles and flew out of the cave.
He had struck the motherlode coming to Beast King Mountain!
Whoosh!
Shooting out of the cave with a thunderclap, he ignored the snake and took to the skies.
With his nemesis finally out, the venomous serpent shrank his size and entered the cave.
The empty and spotless place left him wailing in rage.
The hoard he grew throughout his life was gone, just like that. Even Shaping Spring was picked clean. He licked the hot spring and found not a drop remaining.
The snake wailed, [He is worse than a bandit!]
But then he noticed the bright sky above and almost fainted from anger.
[Blast it all to hell! Have you no restrain?]
[You already cleaned me out and now you go as far as punching holes in my home? What did I ever do to you ? Waaah~]

chapters.title: Chapter 275, Ruler of the World
chapters.content:
Chapter 275, Ruler of the World
Whoosh!
Thunder cracked across the bright sky, announcing Zhuo Fan’s lightning-fast flight, his face pleased as punch.
What was that saying? One good deed deserves another. [Yeah, that’s the one. I saved that annoying lass and nature replied in kind from her bountiful bosom. I’ll have to rethink my approach and spread kindness from now on, ha-ha-ha...]
Zhuo Fan cackled.
Then he spotted the same girl not far ahead. She figured he was going to take off and waited for him outside.
“Oh, miss, do you need something?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow.
Fuming mad, she said, “Hand it over!”
“Hand what over?” Zhuo Fan played dumb.
The girl barked, “Shaping Spring and those herbs! Think I am so stupid not to realize what you’ve been doing in there? But I am a woman of morals so I won’t bicker. According to the laws of the cultivation world, half belongs to me by right!”
“Bint, no can do.” Zhuo Fan shook his head, “You said giving you half is fair, but why would I ever do that?”
The lady played the kicked puppy card, “B-but I found it!”
“First come first serve!”
“If it weren’t for me, you’d never get them! So give me my fair share!” The girl panicked.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Did you forget I saved you? To repay me you showed me the treasury. Now we’re even, buh-bye.”
Zhuo Fan left laughing, but the lady blocked him again with a snarl, “You damn bastard! Out of respect for saving me, I wasn’t going to argue with you and split the haul evenly. But you just don’t know when to quit!”
Her 2nd layer of Profound Heaven cultivation exploded, glaring at Zhuo Fan with the clear intent to fight him over it.
Zhuo Fan yawned, “Missy, power isn’t always limited by cultivation stages. Once we fight, your hopes are dashed.”
“Humph, damn egomaniac, enough bluffing! You may have subdued the 6th level spiritual beast but I’m no spiritual beast. I also know taming arts and they only work on spiritual beasts. Stop trying to scare me, it ain’t going to work.”
She then punched straight for Zhuo Fan’s face. The fierce power of the fist came barreling down towards him, backed by her 2nd layer of Profound Heaven cultivation.
It had no effect on Zhuo Fan, however, still calm and uncaring as he vanished. The girl was left speechless.
The next second she found her wrist yanked behind her back.
“Ah!”
She then started crying from pain, “Y-you’re breaking my arm. Let go...”
Zhuo Fan shook his head and let go.
She jumped ten meters away and looked at him perplexed.
[How did he do that?] He was clearly in the 9th layer of Bone Tempering Stage yet overpowered a 2nd layer of Profound Heaven cultivator in both power and speed. She felt like a mouse in the claws of a hawk. [This doesn’t make sense!]
[It’s too damn freaky!]
Only now did she recall Zhuo Fan’s words.
[This guy is a bloody monster!]
The girl gnashed her teeth and a flick of the hand revealed three roaring 4th level spiritual beasts ready to pounce at Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow curiously, “You’re not half bad, I’ll give you that. You don’t see that everyday, a lady having three 4th level spirit animals.”
“He-he-he, scared?”
She stuck her chin out in her boasting, “Let me tell you, I have a dozen spirit animals, but these three are my most cherished ones and they even know how to fly. I would have drowned you in my spirit animals if we were on the ground instead!”
Zhuo Fan looked at her oddly.
Most people in Tianyu focused on personal power, with hardly any interest in rearing beasts. That made spirit animals a rarity. You were hard pressed to find even high stage experts having one.
But this girl here was quite average in cultivation yet had over ten spirit animals. It was Zhuo Fan’s first time meeting someone who specialized in rearing beasts.
His odd looks however were taken as fear by the lass, who cackled, “It’s too late to be scared now. But if your apology is heartfelt enough and you give me those items, I may be inclined to spare your miserable life. I will even forgive your earlier transgression!”
“Whatever gave you the idea that I’m scared? Did you forget how that 6th level spiritual beast acted in front of me? Just like a kitty. And you think some 4th level spiritual beasts will do? Ha-ha-ha...” Zhuo Fan sneered.
The girl snapped, “C-cut your boasting! Who knows what you really did to that serpent? But it can only be something similar to my own taming art, a soul attack. But these three pets of mine are linked with my soul. Their master’s orders are paramount. It will be impossible for you to tame them!”
“Oh, shall I give it a shot?” Zhuo Fan snickered.
The naked contempt he showed only earned her ire, “Attack! Show him your power!”
Roar!
The three beasts were extremely loyal, jumping on Zhuo Fan the moment they were given the go signal. Yet nothing could unnerve Zhuo Fan.
The three were right on top of him, ready to tear him to pieces when his eyes flashed azure.
And, just like the 6th level spiritual beast before, the three pets froze and starting sweating like pigs.
[Mommy! Who the hell is this big shot? Why is he so scary?]
Without further ado, the scared witless beasts bolted with tail between their legs, swift as the wind.
It took a long time for the truth to worm itself into the girl’s mind, sheer absurdity of it all. She then shouted for her pets to come back.
But would they listen?
What master’s orders were paramount? Life was infinitely more precious!
[Blast it, is the master’s brain on the fritz? Why would we ever face such horror? To die?]
The girl shouted herself hoarse, but her pets were long gone, infuriating her.
Then she sobered up and shuddered from fear.
Zhuo Fan drifted towards her with his mocking smile, “It seems being linked with your pets ain’t all sunshine and rainbows. With the three of them horrified, their master is ought to feel some of that fear herself.”
“W-who the hell are you?” The girl froze, watching him in horror.
Now she knew why the 6th level spiritual beast held this man in such fear, and her pets were no different.
Because this man didn’t use something as trifling as his soul to subdue them, but instilled a sense of utter dread in their very being, that even robbed them of the thought of fighting back.
[But how?]
Why would vicious beasts show such fear towards one simple man? Such a ludicrous story was never heard anywhere in the world.
But this guy did it with ease! [Just who is he?]
Zhuo Fan smiled and answered her doubts, “I will one day rule this world!”
With a laugh and flap of his wings, he was gone. He left the girl shivering and staring dumbly in shock.
This mystery man had tangled with her so many times and left her with a bone deep impression. Those final words were etched in her mind.
She would scoff if it was anyone else saying them, but for some reason, hearing them from Zhuo Fan made her believe he could do it.
[How could Tianyu have such a dreadful man?]
The girl was filled with trepidation.
Whoosh!
Two black-robed men flashed in front of her.
“Lian’er, is something wrong?” One asked, while the other followed with, “Young miss, are you alright?”
She only looked at them with fear in her eyes, “Brother, Tianyu isn’t something we can just attack. It’s best that we fall back...”
Then her vision blurred and she fell unconscious. The two held her in worry, calling out to her.
[What did she mean?]

chapters.title: Chapter 276, Plight
chapters.content:
Chapter 276, Plight
“Young chief, young miss is only shaken up. You don’t need to worry.”
The night sky was brightened by the moon’s glow and dazzling stars. In a dusky cave crackled a bonfire, shining its light onto the hundred black-robed figures, all with heads down and in solemn silence.
A white mustached old man glanced at the girl resting near the fire with a youth at her side.
The youth asked, “She is in extreme shock, but why? I’ve known my sister for all my life. She grew among spiritual beasts and is very brash. Just what could have scared her so much?”
“Well...” The old man frowned, then sighed, “It is different for everyone. I am sorry this old man can’t be of any help.”
The youth sighed and waved the old man away.
It was now that the resting girl’s eyes fluttered and she said weakly, “B-brother...”
“Lian’er, you’re awake!” The youth grabbed her wrist in happiness. The other black-robed men rejoiced but did not disturb them.
“Lian’er, what happened to you? You are strong enough to wander the Beast King Mountain for months. So why did you suddenly black out? That was dangerous!” The youth looked at her in concern.
Lian’er nodded, her eyes glistening as she said anxiously, “Brother, don’t attack Tianyu. It holds our natural enemy and if we attack rashly we will suffer greatly. Our clan will be ruined!”
The youth looked at her puzzled. So she propped her weak body up and began retelling her encounter with Zhuo Fan from start to finish.
The youth was shocked, “What, Tianyu has such a mystical power to cower spiritual beasts?”
The faces of everyone around them fell.
This news was a nightmare!
“Tianyu is a true dragon among men. We can’t underestimate it!”
Taking a deep breath, the youth stood and paced around with a frown, “We, the Quanrong, are experts in rearing beasts, able to sweep the lands with our beast army. Not even that God of War, Dugu Zhantian, dares face us. Only with the help of his arrays and formations can he stand on equal ground to us. But if Tianyu has someone capable of instilling fear into beasts, to the point they’d go against their master’s orders, our beast army will collapse in a heartbeat.”
The others nodded, having reached the same dreadful conclusion. This news broke Quanrong’s strongest advantage, robbing them of any means to attack.
“Young chief, allow this general to purge this danger from the world!” A strapping middle-aged man cupped his hands.
From the powerful waves he released, this man was clearly a Radiant Stage expert!
Mulling it over, the youth shook his head in the end, “No. Tianyu is in the middle of its Esoteric Debate. We need to use this chance and inspect the Teleportation Array from the shadows. The slightest mistake on our part will endanger our entire operation.”
“Brother, you still want to do it? But that guy...” Lian’er spoke in worry.
The youth came to a decision, “All the more reason. If we can’t conquer Tianyu, we will never get the chance again and will lose every future war!”
They all nodded solemnly.
Lian’er sighed, “But brother, is that man truly trustworthy? Can we really take Tianyu in one move?”
“Ha-ha-ha, Lian’er and everyone needs to relax. There is no better spy in Tianyu than that man.” The youth cackled. As if the world was his oyster...
Back to Zhuo Fan, he was still flying among the clouds in search of Luo Yunhai and the rest.
Suddenly, his nose twitched and he changed directions.
Blood!
Whoosh!
Zhuo Fan landed near a river soaked in blood and bodies coming from upstream.
The wounds on the bodies clearly showed they were man made. A great battle must be underway upstream and he rushed to investigate.
His Discerning Field was strong enough to scout two miles ahead in great detail. He could even see what was behind those two mountains in front.
Zhuo Fan bypassed them with his senses and saw a great deal of men gathered at the mouth of a valley. From their signatures, he easily identified them as Luo Yunhai, Xue Ningxiang, and other second and third rate clans.
Outside the valley entrance were the vassals of the Regent Estate’s faction, forcing Yunhai’s group into the valley. He had no clue who they were but their leader couldn’t be more familiar. Zhuo Fan snickered, “Oh my, now a cripple goes out hunting? You must have a death wish.”
Quite right. The man leading the attack on Luo Yunhai was Forest Fleeting Dragon, Lin Xuanfeng. Albeit a one-legged dragon, but he still had the power to shock everyone.
His dragon title was shaky now, but to the average Profound Heaven expert, he was undefeated.
Lin Xuanfeng looked coldly at his enemies and shouted, “Listen up! I only care about the Luo clan to settle a grudge. I don’t have time to waste on extras so get lost. Or you could just follow Luo clan to their grave!”
The men were tense and glanced at Luo Yunhai.
It was obvious Lin Xuanfeng was taking it out on the Luo clan for having Zhuo Fan rip his leg clean off. Their grudges had nothing to do with these second rate clans.
Although vassals of Drifting Flowers Edifices, Sword Marquise Abode, and Veiled Dragon Pavilion were allies of Luo clan, they were nonetheless far from willing to pay the ultimate sacrifice in defending them.
Luo Yunhai knew this as well as he said solemnly, “Our meeting was pure chance, friends. There’s no need to implicate youself as well. If you wish...”
“Useless cripple, our fate lies with the Luo clan. You don’t scare us! Why don’t you pick on big brother Zhuo if you have the guts!”
The charming voice cut Luo Yunhai off, with a brash and arrogant tone. Her allies were scared witless.
[Young miss!]
[If you want to defend Luo clan and die, go right ahead, we won’t stop you. But could you please not drag us into this as well? And why are you even mentioning that guy’s name, are you trying to piss off Lin Xuanfeng some more?]
[How are we supposed to face that whirlwind, Lin Xuanfeng?]
They all felt like crying, having their lifeline cut off without remorse.
Xue Gang and Xue Lin looked at Xue Ningxiang with a shake of their heads. They knew she liked Zhuo Fan, but going as far as ticking off Lin Xuanfeng was the worst case scenario.
Luo Yunhai looked at Xue Ningxiang, moved, “Sister Ning’er, thank you...”
“What thanks? Without big brother Zhuo around, it falls to me to keep you safe!” Xue Ningxiang patted her chest with a prideful face. She was happy as long as she could do anything for Zhuo Fan.
And yet her brothers were crying inside.
[Damn brat! How can you look after someone when you’re constantly being looked after? Moreover, Luo Yunhai and his ten guards are stronger than any of us. How can we even protect them?]
Luo Yunhai scratched his nose, “Uh, I am grateful for sister Ning’er’s good intentions. But it’s best if I take big brother Zhuo’s place and look after you.”
Ning’er patted Luo Yunhai’s head and smiled, “Never mind protecting me, since big brother Zhuo is surely just around a corner, ready to jump in and save me.”
Luo Yunhai was puzzled.
Ning’er showed her Thunder Ring with a smile, “Each time I’m in danger, the Thunder Ring flashes and that means big brother Zhuo is here!”
Luo Yunhai sighed at how innocent and naive she was, even delusional some might say.
[It would be best if big brother Zhuo comes in the nick of time. But if you think he’s going to show up each time you’re in danger, won’t you treat your life as a joke?]
Her brothers knew this as well and tried reasoning with her, but Xue Ningxiang turned a deaf ear.
A girl’s fairy tail was impossible to dispel!
Xue Ningxiang’s choice of words sure got the obvious reaction out of Lin Xuanfeng. He was pissed and filled with bloodthirst.
“Young master Lin, we...” His men glanced at him.
Lin Xuanfeng’s eyes were bloodshot as he barked, “Ignorant brat! Just kill them all and be done with them!”
His roar resounded in Luo Yunhai’s group’s ears, scaring them. Only Xue Ningxiang was closely watching Thunder Ring for any signs, waiting for that spark of hope...

chapters.title: Chapter 277, Breakout
chapters.content:
Chapter 277, Breakout
“Kill!”
The war cry signaled the enemy’s charge into the valley entrance. The thick bloodthirst in the air was that from a stampede of enraged bulls. The pressure was too great even for a Profound Heaven expert to hold on, making it harder to breathe.
They all turned pale as paper. Not only was the enemy outnumbering them many times over, but they even had the strength advantage. How were they going to come out of this one?
Even Luo Yunhai, who alongside the four tigers saw charging armies on an almost daily basis, was affected. Their side was at a gross disadvantage.
Be it in terrain or numbers, none of it worked in their favor. In war tactics, this situation could only be overcome by forcing one’s way through if one wanted to get out alive.
His jaw set, Luo Yunhai turned to his side teetering on the verge of collapse and shouted, “Everyone, don’t all of you have someone here you wish to protect?”
That caught their attention. Luo Yunhai’s eyes flashed, “They may outnumber us but they are rabble! I can help you get your loved ones out safely. They will be in the center while we form a circle around them as we break out of the enemy attack. We will likely lose our lives but our loved ones will have the highest chance at survival!”
The dead eyes of his group finally sparked with a glimmer of hope.
“Brother, go in the middle, I’ll protect you!”
“Foolish child, I’m the big brother, how can I let you give your life for me? It is my duty to keep you alive!”
“Brother...” The younger brother’s eyes glistened...
“Sister, stay close to the center and don’t fall behind!” Another brother patted his younger sister’s shoulder.
“Brother in law, go in the middle. I’ll get you out for sure!”
“Silly boy, how can I live if you died? How will I face your sister?” The man said to his wife’s younger brother.
...
They soon shed the fear instilled by the enemy’s war cry and their hearts held a deep feeling of warmth, spurring on their will to fight to the death.
Luo Yunhai nodded, grateful that his plan worked. Next up was the fight!
Looking back at the savage enemy marching over, Luo Yunhai took a deep breath and like a true Marshal, he took in the entire battlefield to make use of.
Zhuo Fan would be so proud if he could see this boy having grown up.
Because Luo Yunhai’s words were the right tactic for a Marshal to use in this critical situation.
He had to kindle the will to fight in his men.
If he said something along the lines of ‘fight alongside me to survive’, the effect would hardly be noticeable.
Everyone considered their lives as the number one priority and they made sure to treasure it. But how could they overcome their fears in the face of that relentless tide marching towards them?
Even if he could make them fight for their own sake, it was a flimsy reason bound to crumble at first contact. Death would follow all the same at this point.
But Luo Yunhai was sharp in figuring out these people had loved ones mixed in this group. He appealed to their humanity, their conscience, their responsibility, and drove them to war.
Although this meant cutting their effective fighting force in half, the ones doing the protecting would give their absolute best, and more, to make sure their loved ones lived to see tomorrow.
To instantly turn these random groups of people into a cohesive unit bent on fighting to the death was the sign of a great general Luo Yunhai had the hopes of becoming.
“Yunhai, stay behind me. Sister will protect you!” Xue Ningxiang’s beaming face graced his eyes. She even flexed to back up her claim.
Luo Yunhai let out an awkward chuckle, “Ha-ha-ha, I am grateful for your kindness, but I am the one commanding this charge. It’s more important that I stay in front as well!”
Xue Gang and Xue Lin hoisted the overconfident, and delusional, Xue Ningxiang behind, “Ning’er, don’t be willful. He’s stronger than you. Listen to your brother and stay in the middle. Let your brothers get you to safety!”
Xue Ningxiang pouted, then her eyes sparked, “Then I’ll stay behind Yunhai. That way I can protect him when he needs help!”
Helpless, they had no choice but to agree. Behind Luo Yunhai could also be said to belong to the center of the group, somewhat.
But Xue Gang and Xue Lin were not leaving her sides. Anything could happen in the spur of the moment, especially on the battlefield. They had to protect her.
Similar scenes happened all around them as the people were determined to get their loved ones out alive. Luo Yunhai formed them into ranks, and as he stood in front of them, an old man stepped forward.
“Young master Luo, I’ll be at your side to protect you. If I am to fall, please send my words to Grandmaster Zhuo. My greatest regret is that I wasn’t good enough to have him as my master...” The old man shook his head.
Zhuo Fan would have a nice dumbstruck face if he was here. Wasn’t this old guy the same Liu Yizhen, who competed alongside Yan Song in the Hundred Pill Meeting?
He wanted to be Zhuo Fan’s disciple, but Zhuo Fan wouldn’t hear it.
But how did he end up here then?
Luo Yunhai sighed, “Grandmaster Liu is so determined. If not for sir’s guards, we’d have long been mere corpses on the ground. As long as we get out alive, I will think of a way to make big brother Zhuo receive you.”
“Thank you, young master Luo!” Grandmaster Liu nodded sadly, “Let’s talk about this after we survive. Either way, being able to show my respect to Grandmaster Zhuo by helping him is gratification enough.”
Luo Yunhai nodded, [Grandmaster Liu is so honest and righteous!]
Kill~!
The howls of war drew nearer. Luo Yunhai faced the enemy as the leader of his men, waiting. When the enemy was at the hundred meter mark, he led his own charge, “For our loved ones, charge!”
Roar!
Thunderous shouts echoed his own battle spirit and they rushed on like a tide. The enemy was baffled at the sudden development, even as the sides clashed.
Boom!
Their morale sank to half in a blink. As if a spear pierced the great skies and left a massive hole, so did the force go through them like butter.
The enemy looked dumbstruck, even the enraged Lin Xuanfeng. He was watching speechless as the wedge formation went through his group.
[They’re a hundred against my thousand. How can we not even block their charge?]
The wails and miserable cries rang in his ears. He looked in time to see his men flailing their bleeding arms and leg stumps in agony. The enemy was reaping through his men like a dragon. His men couldn’t put up even a token of resistance and it only drove him madder.
“For goddamn sake! What use do I have for any of you if you can’t even do this much? A bunch of damn wastes is what you all are!”
The man next to him stammered, “Young master Lin, t-this isn’t our fault! They suddenly used military formations. They are only a hundred but we can’t even get close to them! Each time we approach it’s like we’re facing four or five of them! It’s baffling!”
“Humph! Whats baffling? It’s just some army tactic!” Lin Xuanfeng’s eyes flashed eerily, “Now that I think about it, that Luo clan’s brat followed Dugu Zhantian for five years. It’d be odd if he didn’t know at least this much. Blast it all to hell! We can’t let Luo clan get any stronger!”
Spatting, Lin Xuanfeng hopped and was gone. Then he flashed in front of the wedge formation.
“Lin Xuanfeng!” Luo Yunhai shouted.
Snickering, Lin Xuanfeng mocked, “Brat, you think you’re so great now that you’ve been by Dugu Zhantian’s side for a couple of years? You take me for a weakling? Think you can get away alive with just this?
“He-he-he, first I’ll break your army, then I’ll break your skull!” Lin Xuanfeng snickered and was gone again.
Before anyone could react, he flashed in the middle of their formation and a blue tornado sprung up. It grew until it swallowed them all, careening them into the air and breaking the formation.
Luo Yunhai looked up from the ground in shock.
Even after Zhuo Fan ripped his leg off, Lin Xuanfeng had the power to face so many people. He really was one of the Six Dragons and One Phoenix, Forest Fleeting Dragon!
He broke their formation and flung them scattered among the enemy. They were doomed!
Luo Yunhai’s heart sank, his final hope leaving him. What was left was to wait and have their lives reaped...

chapters.title: Chapter 278, Void Annihilation’s Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 278, Void Annihilation’s Power
Ah!
The cries of agony pierced the skies as the enemy began its slaughter. With their formation broken and outnumbered ten to one, their hopes of surviving were dashed. Just like a mouse squeezed around by a mighty dragon.
Their will to fight had collapsed, replaced by utter despair.
Luo Yunhai gnashed his teeth and got onto his feet. He wanted to reorganize his ranks. He wasn’t about to give up as long as there was an inkling of hope.
But as soon as he got to his feet, he was kicked flying, with blood flowing from his lips.
Coughing blood, Luo Yunhai glared at the cocky and snickering Lin Xuanfeng, “He-he-he, brat, you’re finished! So behave and wait there for me to take your head and present it to Zhuo Fan. I wonder what face he’ll make, ha-ha-ha... “
“Humph, let’s see you try! You think the next time he’ll stop at one leg?” Luo Yunhai retorted in mockery.
Lin Xuanfeng’s mood sank dangerously low.
His life was smooth sailing, the pride of Merry Woods. No one ever showed any disrespect to someone of his talent. Then he met Zhuo Fan, and everything spiraled out of control, him becoming a laughing stock.
His leg was ripped off and hence he suffered endless ridicule that had affected his state of mind to such a degree that it had cast a shadow over him. Not even he wanted to admit such a disgrace happened to him.
And yet Luo Yunhai went on poking his sore spot, earning his wrath, “Damn punk! You think we can’t deal with that Zhuo Fan? Humph, let me tell you, we’ve long been ready to end him. He’s living on borrowed time. You’re the first to go and the bastard will soon follow you to your grave!”
Lin Xuanfeng lifted his Yuan Qi soaked palm, winding up for the finale.
Luo Yunhai was worried, his fists clenched, but not over his safety. It was for Zhuo Fan’s.
He sensed from Lin Xuanfeng’s tone that those words weren’t empty threats. They may very well have grasped Zhuo Fan’s weakness. He had to warn Zhuo Fan before it was too late.
How was he going to do that though, when he was too powerless to even protect himself?
Luo Yunhai’s inner conflict left him in a mess.
Lin Xuanfeng took it as fear, “Ha-ha-ha, here I thought you’d be a man of courage having followed Dugu Zhantian for years, but deep down, you’re just a spineless coward. Don’t worry, I’ll leave your corpse intact, out of respect for Dugu Zhantian.”
Lin Xuanfeng launched his palm attack like a fierce storm.
“Stop! No one can harm the Luo clan’s young master!” An aged voice shouted, just as a red hot flame shot for Lin Xuanfeng.
Lin Xuanfeng only snickered.
Liu Yizhen came to the rescue, with his 4th level spiritual beast flame.
But his flame looked nothing more than a candle to Lin Xuanfeng, “You senile old fool dare mess in my affairs? Get lost!”
Thump!
A flick of the hand had a blue wind scatter the flimsy flame to nothing. Liu Yizhen spat blood and collapsed, pale.
Grinning, Lin Xuanfeng turned to Luo Yunhai, “No one’s gonna save you now!”
“Stop!”
It was a delicate voice this time. Xue Ningxiang popped out of nowhere and stood between them, “You’ll have to go through me first!”
“You again!”
Squinting, he clearly recalled Xue Ningxiang shouting cripple left and right, “Humph, don’t you worry. Once I’m through with him, you’re next!”
“Ning’er!”
Xue Gang and Xue Lin rushed over but Lin Xuanfeng’s flick of the hand left them sprawling and heavily wounded.
With a twisted smile, a promise of cruelty that was to come, Lin Xuanfeng’s Yuan Qi exploded, “And stay down!”
“Humph, we won’t die. Big brother Zhuo will save us!” Xue Ningxiang faced him without an ounce of fear.
Lin Xuanfeng jerked, looking around frantic, “Zhuo Fan, where? Is he close?”
Xue Ningxiang laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, how the mighty have fallen. I knew you’re scared of big brother Zhuo!”
Luo Yunhai shook his head.
Apparently, Zhuo Fan did more than simply pull a leg. He had also scarred the guy mentally!
“You damn brat dare to lie to me! Zhuo Fan would never stand still in this situation if he was here!” Lin Xuanfeng’s anger flared. Two brats got the best of the grand and mighty Forest Fleeting Dragon. They had scared him just by mentioning Zhuo Fan. He would never hear the end of it if word got out.
Lin Xuanfeng’s eyes looked at Xue Ningxiang with bloodthirst, wishing nothing more than to wring her pretty neck, “Blasted bint! You two’ve been a pain in my rear from the moment we met!”
Lin Xuanfeng’s hand was wrapped in a blue wind and slapped at Xue Ningxiang’s chest.
Luo Yunhai was too hurt to try and stop him. He could only watch the sinister palm inching towards Xue Ningxiang’s chest.
“Big brother Zhuo!”
Xue Ningxiang cried, her eyes focussed on the dead Thunder Ring. Then she closed her eyes and prayed for a miracle.
Luo Yunhai could only sigh. Zhuo Fan was no god. It was impossible for him to watch over her around the clock like a guardian angel.
Xue Gang and Xue Lin crawled on while bleeding in a desperate attempt to reach her. Why was their foolish sister so zealous in her faith? The last two times were sheer coincidences.
[Zhuo Fan won’t always watch over you when you need him the most. So why are you so stubborn?]
Lin Xuanfeng laughed, “Zhuo Fan won’t come brat! Die, ha-ha-ha... “
Though clueless, their entire drama was laid before Zhuo Fan’s eyes two miles out thanks to his soul sense.
He saw how Xue Ningxiang and Luo Yunhai were together and he also saw Lin Xuanfeng’s strike closing in on them.
Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed with two golden halos and an invisible beam shot out, passing through any and all obstacles, straight for its target.
Divine Eye of the Void’s 2nd stage, Void Annihilation.
Whoosh!
It shot fast as light, passing through everything like they were nothing.
In the middle of the slaughter, a hum became apparent as a sudden hole appeared on the men in its path without any warning.
Blood flowed even as the men were oblivious to their doom. It was just too fast, too sudden.
Lin Xuanfeng’s hand was inches from Xue Ningxiang when the hum passed, robbing him of his hand. It left behind a bleeding stump.
Lin Xuanfeng was too dumbstruck to even react.
[W-what was that? Why is my hand gone?] He didn’t even feel a thing. One moment it was there, and poof, gone the next. It was faster than getting it chopped off.
Xue Ningxiang and Luo Yunhai were equally baffled.
Lin Xuanfeng stiffly looked around to see a line of men with oddly missing parts of their bodies, bleeding out.
Looking further, he saw a hole in the valley’s side, black as night. Zhuo Fan used Void Annihilation from two miles away to rob his hand and anything in its path.
It was an all powerful ability able to target anyone regardless of distance!
Zhuo Fan’s enemies would never know rest if they knew he possessed such divine might. Or the moment they drop their guard, their chest would sport a sudden extra large hole!
Not that Lin Xuanfeng knew that. He only looked at the black hole in dread. [This is too freaky! What the hell was that? Who could possibly kill so many men in a blink?]
It even exceeded Forest Fleeting Dragon’s reaction and robbed him off his hand! What kind of godly skill was that?
In the middle of their shock and despair, Zhuo Fan used his Yuan Qi to shout, “God damn it, Lin Xuanfeng! You dare touch my people, you bastard? Don’t move a muscle, I’ll be right there to rip your head off myself!”
His yell passed through the black hole and into the valley, so loud it even quaked mountains.
It was as if the two mountains spoke. Such awe-inspiring power scared everyone present into freezing and paling.
[Are the mountains threatening us?]
[Balls! Did our battle wake up a local god?]
Only Lin Xuanfeng recognized the voice. He shook like a leaf. He would never forget the owner of that voice in his life, the same Soaring Demonic Dragon who ripped off his leg...

chapters.title: Chapter 279, God’s Position
chapters.content:
Chapter 279, God’s Position
Quiet, deadly quiet!
Everyone was horrified by this inexplicable situation, and they all stopped fighting, whether it was Lin Xuanfeng or Luo Family.
Everyone looked at the constantly vibrating mountain, shocked to speak.
Only Luo Yunhai and Xue Ningxiang were happy, their eyes flashing with excitement. From the moment that angry roar began, they had already understood that their guardian god, Zhuo Fan was here!
“Uh, Lord Lin, this”
On the side of Lin Xuanfeng, someone wanted to ask him what to do next, but he turned around and saw him immediately. I couldn’t find the trace, I couldn’t find it when I searched for it, I didn’t feel a curse in my heart!
Your grandma’s Lin Xuanfeng, shouted louder than anyone when she rushed, and called them rubbish. But when he escaped, he escaped faster than anyone else, and ran away without a sound.
Such a ruthless, unscrupulous, courageous rat generation, can actually be included in the six dragons and one phoenix, I am!
His heart was burning with anger. The man glanced around at everyone present, and saw that everyone had no morale to fight, and it seemed that there was going to be something extraordinary from the Luo family, even Lin Xuanfeng was scared away.
Then what are they doing here, waiting to die?
So the man waved his hand and shouted to everyone: “Withdraw!”
At this time, people looked back and noticed that Cyclone Lin had already run out of sight. So without saying anything, he immediately retreated.
They were originally the dominant party, but when they ran, they were extremely embarrassed. They couldn’t even take care of the wounded, so they escaped as if they were the defeated party.
Seeing this scene, Luo Yunhai shook his head and sighed: “Brother Zhuo is Brother Zhuo, and he screams everywhere. A roar scared more than a thousand people away! It was more tapered than we just had. Breaking through, it’s much stronger!”
Xue Ningxiang nodded proudly when she heard it, and a small star flashed in her eyes! I haven’t seen Zhuo Fan’s figure yet, but he is already overwhelmed by his mighty power. It’s obviously his fan!
Xue Gang and Xue Lin both shook their heads and smiled bitterly. Zhuo Fan appeared in time and saved them, of course it is a good thing! But their girl, under Zhuo Fan’s charm, seemed to sink deeper, but this was a bit dangerous!
At this moment, Zhuo Fan is like a god in Xue Ningxiang’s heart. It seems that every time she encounters danger, he can appear in time!
This is by no means a good sign!
The two of Xue Gang and Xue Lin looked at each other. They understood, but they both shook their heads helplessly.
In the past, Ning”er could not listen to their persuasion, but now it has been repeatedly verified by the fact that Zhuo Fan appeared in time, even less able to listen to them.
Oh!
The two shook their heads for a while and sighed.
Then, in the joy of rebirth after the disaster, everyone began to look after the wounded and clean up the battlefield. After about a quarter of an hour, but hearing a thunder and exploding, a dark shadow suddenly fell.
Everyone turned their heads to look, but it was the soaring dragon that made the enemy frightened, no doubt outstanding!
Looking around, glanced at everyone, Zhuo Fan cursed, “Let Lin Xuanfeng run away again! When I run into him next time, I must remove his other leg. Let him crawl around in front of Lao Tzu in the future!”
Everyone was sweating profusely and looked at Zhuo Fan in awe!
I am afraid that in this universe, among the younger generation, there is only this soaring dragon Zhuo Fan who dares to provoke the six dragons and the phoenix so arrogantly. If you put it on them, and let them have a hundred courage, you wouldn’t dare to speak such arrogant words!
For a time, people looked at Zhuo Fan with more envy and admiration.
This is a man who is not afraid of the sky and is not afraid of the sky!
I didn’t care about the admiration of others, Zhuo Fan turned to Luo Yunhai and Xue Ningxiang, and cared: “Yunhai, Ning”er, are you all right!”
Xue Ningxiang could not help but shake Shaking her head, there was a bright smile on her face: “Don’t worry, Brother Zhuo, I’ll be fine! I know that you will be next to Ning”er in times of crisis!”
said, and raised his hands. Thunder Ring.
Zhuo Fan also smiled, also waved his hand, the Thunder Spirit Ring on his finger flashed with a strange light.
“Brother Zhuo, I have taken Master Liu’s healing pill. It is already much better, and I will probably be fine soon!” At this time, Luo Yunhai also paled in his cheeks and smiled towards Zhuo Fan.
Unconsciously raised his brows, Zhuo Fan turned his head and looked at the old figure standing beside him, muttering: “Master Liu?”
“Ha ha ha Zhuo Master, it’s been a long time since I saw you, don’t come here unharmed!” Liu Yizhen looked at Zhuo Fan and bowed respectfully.
Zhuo Fan couldn’t help but a look of doubt flashed in his eyes: “Why are you here? Isn’t this time a hundred schools of thought contend for a family disciple under the age of 30 to participate? Master Liu, are you old?”
“Uh, Master Zhuo, don’t get me wrong. The old man is not a disciple of the Hundred Schools of Thought, and I don’t know that this Beast King Mountain will be chosen as the place for the decisive battle of the Hundred Schools of Thought. The old man is just going to the mountain to gather medicine and just meet That’s it!” Liu Yizhen said bye again, explaining.
Taking a deep look at him, Zhuo Fan was still suspicious: “Really such a coincidence?”
“It’s such a coincidence. Maybe this is my fate with Master Zhuo!” Liu Yizhen nodded calmly and answered.
Zhuo Fan curled his mouth in disdain, waved his hand and said: “Go go, don’t get close, what fate do I have with you?”
Liu Yizhen felt stagnant and a little depressed. The ground lowered his head.
Seeing this, Luo Yunhai rushed to help out: “Brother Zhuo, in fact, we were able to survive this time. A large part of the reason is that Master Liu assisted. He is really our Luo The great benefactor of the family! I heard that he admires you very much and has the willingness to apprentice. It’s better to”
“Liu Yizhen, after so many years, your intention of worshiping me as a teacher has not given up?” But not yet When Luo Yunhai finished speaking, Zhuo Fan was already staring at Liu Yizhen and questioned.
Unconsciously, Liu Yi really nodded his head anxiously: “Of course, the master Zhuo is the master of alchemy among the people seen by the old man. It is true that the old man can worship Master Zhuo. What I want in my life!”
“Such words”
His eyes narrowed involuntarily, Zhuo Fan stared at his eyes closely, and faintly said: “Also, we are missing Manpower, just your old man has caught up! If you can protect the Luo family in this controversy of a hundred schools of thought, contribute to the family and apprentice, I can think about it!”
“Oh, I will do my best As far as you can, you can live up to the great expectations of Master Zhuo!” Liu Yizhen hurriedly paid his respects.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed, and he nodded slightly.
Luo Yunhai was also overjoyed when he saw this, he gave Liu Yizhen a fist, and congratulated him for finally touching Zhuo Fan’s heart.
Liu Yizhen also bowed respectfully to Luo Yunhai, thanking him for his support and reputation, otherwise Zhuo Fan would definitely be the same as six or seven years ago, he would never be a bird!
In this way, Liu Yizhen completely became a temporary Luo family, looking after everyone’s injuries, and Zhuo Fan didn’t have the time to heal other people, just sitting in Taniguchi and guarding them.
However, because he is sitting there, people can heal their wounds at ease and are not afraid of enemy harassment.
Oh, the soaring devil dragon, even if the six dragons and one phoenix dare not easily provoke the existence, there is really no more trustworthy guardian in the world!
So, for ten consecutive days, Zhuo Fan meditated in Taniguchi, while the rest of the people healed and recuperated in the valley.
However, their battle here has just subsided, another place. The war will begin again!
In a lush mountain forest, a piece of emerald jade stone as high as two persons stands right next to a tall giant tree in the sky. Look closely, it is very similar to the Five Elements Town State Stone, but it is exactly the wooden gate of the Five Elements Town State Stone in the Beast King Mountain!
On both sides of it, there are two groups of people and horses.
On one side are Chu Qingcheng of Huayulou, Xie Tianshang of Jianhou Mansion and Long Xingyun of Qianlong Pavilion, and the other side are Huangpu Sky-upholding of Emperor’s Gate, Youyu Mountain of Nether Valley and Yan Bangui and others in the Palace of Medicine King!
The two sides are at war, staring at each other.
Behind the wooden gate, the major families in Yunlong City also passed through this gate to watch the confrontation between the two sides.
Huang Pu Tianyuan curled his lips in disdain, glanced at everyone present, seeming to talk to himself, but he seemed to announce to everyone: “There is no suspense, it seems that the God of Escape Pill belongs to us. Hahaha!”
You Wanshan in Netherworld Valley and Uncle Yan from the Medicine King Hall nodded together, their faces showing pride.
Following the emperor’s gate, it’s so confident, so arrogant and cool!
The grandmother Chu Bijun of Huayulou, the pavilion master Long Yifei of Qianlong Pavilion, and the three of Jianhou Mansion Xie Xiaofeng, their faces were gloomy and extremely ugly! Although they didn’t want to admit it, they knew in their hearts that this battle was a one-sided loss. Just Huangpu Sky-upholding alone, they already have no chance of winning!
Originally, Chu Qingcheng first discovered that Yi Shen Dan fell in front of the wooden formation gate. But I didn’t expect Huangpu Sky-upholding and the others to follow.
In this way, the battle surrounding this Yi Shen Dan will begin! However, they had no chance of winning in the face of the Zhentian Emperor Long!
“This monster!”
Grandma gritted her teeth bitterly and cursed secretly. Huang Pu Tianyuan laughed unconsciously, and even more glamorous!
When Zhuge Changfeng saw this, he also shook his beard and nodded slightly: “Yes, there is a strong abnormal monster on one side, but the monster on the other side has not arrived yet. This situation is indeed true. The biggest disadvantage is to surrender obediently!”
As soon as this statement came out, everyone responded!
Yes, they have Huangpu Sky-upholding over there, but we also have Zhuo Fan here! I heard that the two played against each other for the first time, and Zhuo Fan was able to restrain the emperor dragon!
But, at such a critical moment, where did that kid go?
For a while, everyone hated it in their hearts, saying that the alliance is good, and the chain will be dropped at a critical moment.
Ahee!
Facing the rising sun, Zhuo Fan sneezed loudly for no reason, and felt a cool breeze blowing behind his back!
“Grandma, a bear, who is talking bad about me behind your back?” Zhuo Fan touched his nose, his face full of suffocation.

chapters.title: Chapter 280, The Power of One
chapters.content:
Chapter 280, The Power of One
Tap~
Huangpu Qingtian’s every step instilled dignity and nobility, neither forced nor rushed. Chu Qingcheng’s group was unnerved, taking steps back in contrast.
The pressure was so big, each of his step made them back away faster.
Drifting Flowers Edifices, Veiled Dragon Pavilion, and Sword Marquise Abode had thousands of people behind them, yet faced with but a single man, they all shirked further back. A truly laughable and ridiculous scene.
Yet to the parties involved, humor was the last thing on their minds. When faced with the head of Six Dragons and One Phoenix, Huangpu Qingtian, all they could feel was fear and dread.
You Yushan and Yan Bangui had thousands behind them as well that just stood there, watching the other faction with contempt.
In the face of Huangpu Qingtian, anyone would end up a sorry sight.
If they switched places, You Yushan’s group had no doubt in their mind they would end up the same way.
As to why the situation devolved in such a way, it all came down to Chu Qingcheng’s group’s rotten luck. Or maybe having known so little about Regent Estate, yet insisting on making an enemy out of them...
“How long are you going to shirk back?” Huangpu Qingtian stopped at some point, with a beaming and noble smile, “Hand over the Brimming Sacred Pill and I’ll let you go.”
Frowning, Chu Qingcheng gnashed her teeth in silence. Her allies clenched her fists at the naked scorn.
Handing over what the three houses found was total humiliation.
Long Xingyun muled, [It’s best we’re flexible.] And smiled, “Young master Huangpu, is this how Regent Estate’s eldest young master carries himself? You’re no different from a shameless bandit at this point. There are four Brimming Sacred Pill out there so why are you after ours in particular?”
“Ha-ha-ha, Long Xingyun, I knew you’re a smooth talker, preaching sophistry. True, Regent Estate isn’t too keen on robbing you, but did you forget? This here is the Esoteric Debate, where might makes right. Everything belongs to the strongest!”
With a snicker, Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes flashed with greed and snatched at the air, “That is why all of them will be mine. You better hand it over now, or...”
“Or what, fight?”
Xie Tianshang snapped as he shot in the air, drawing his sword and releasing such shocking energy it reached the skies. The sword energy shuddered all who looked at it, feeling as if ten thousands swords were about to pierce them.
Even Yan Bangui and You Yushan turned serious, eying him with a sigh.
[Xie Tianshang is a true sword talent.] It was their first time seeing sword energy reaching such a level.
Thinking about it, they were no match for him in a straight out fight.
Long Xingyun looked at the hovering figure stunned. [It had been what, a few days? How did he get so strong?]
And yet...
Huangpu Qingtian’s calm demeanor left Long Xingyun sighing.
[Compared to this monster, Xie Tianshang had a long way to go.]
But even so, they had to fight regardless.
Long Xingyun shot his hands forward. Energy hummed off his hands and released a powerful attack.
There was a dragon roar echo and when the energy was upon Huangpu Qingtian, it shot for the ground.
The earth beneath Huangpu Qingtian exploded as a dragon opened its maw to swallow him.
“Profound ranked martial art, Sea Upturning Dragon Palm!” Long Xingyun roared.
He didn’t finish as a loud boom splintered the huge dragon into nothingness. Huangpu Qingtian shined golden as he walked out of the attack, looking down on all creation.
Pff!
Long Xingyun coughed blood, having just been injured internally.
Xie Tianshang clutched his sword and shot for Huangpu Qingtian. The piercing light of his sword tip was as dazzling as the night’s stars.
It pulverized anything it touched and left only this outstanding light.
This was Sword Marquise Abode’s profound ranked martial art Flowing Space’s Nine Forms’ strongest attack, Extinction.
When this sword flew, everything was erased!
Abode Lord Xie Xiaofeng watched in awe and pride, his house’s strongest move being unleashed just beyond the wood National Elemental Stone.
The son had surpassed the father.
With how much stronger the move was than his own, he was certain his son would become an even more remarkable Abode Lord than himself.
Huangpu Tianyuan mocked, “Abode Lord Xie, to be so prideful of your son’s meager achievements, aren’t you perhaps thinking so little of him?”
Xie Xiaofeng snorted, “I know of Regent Estate’s eldest young master’s godlike talent, but I’ll have to say that not even he can take this attack without consequence.”
“Oh? We shall see.” Grinned Huangpu Tianyuan, and his elders joined him in mocking the man.
Xie Xiaofeng’s heart seized in fright, turning to see the shocking scene beyond the wood stone.
As the glaring sword attack came closer, Huangpu Qingtian merely pointed at the dazzling dot of light.
Boom!
The space cracked and seemed to have been torn open. A bright golden light met with the sword attack, swallowing it whole.
The almighty sword attack, crumbled under the finger’s power and forced Xie Tianshang into a bout of spitting blood. He was on his knees, even if having received but a light wound.
“H-how?” Xie Xiaofeng cried.
Huangpu Tianyuan laughed, “Abode Lord Xie, I told you, my son’s talent is in a league of its own. Speaking of power, he has surpassed his father since five years ago!”
[Say what?!]
They were still trying to process this development yet now they found Huangpu Qingtian had long since surpassed the current Estate Lord?
It was a known fact that Regent Estate had the best talents in Tianyu, capable of holding their own if it ever came to face the other six houses. Huangpu Tianyuan was of an even greater talent and a peak Profound Heaven cultivator as well. That made him the strongest Profound Heaven cultivator in Tianyu.
Yet here he was stating Huangpu Qingtian surpassed him since five years ago. Even more so when that Huangpu Qingtian wasn’t even at peak Profound Heaven Stage.
Now that he was at peak Profound Heaven Stage and mastered killing with intent, did that mean he could face a Radiant Stage expert?
[H-how on earth can one beat that?]
The faces of others sank as they cursed this rotten monster.
Huangpu Tianyuan looked awfully proud standing there, but his heart was bleeding, cursing his monster of a son as well. It was this monstrous talent that threatened his Estate Lord position.
It may very well come to be that once the Esoteric Debate was over, his son would be entitled in his demand for him to hand over his throne. That was one outcome he never hoped to see.
It went so far that he even hoped his son would die at Zhuo Fan’s hands.
Of course, there was no way he’d be so open as to share his thoughts. Huangpu Qingtian was the hope of all Venerables, if not the entire Regent Estate.
Any that dared to even show a hint of dissatisfaction with him would be culled on the spot, Estate Lord included. The Venerables would make sure of that.
Huangpu Qingtian was the apple of Regent Estate, their hope for the future. And they weren’t about to let it be snuffed out!
Huangpu Tianyuan looked on at the prideful and imperial figure beyond the wood National Elemental Stone with killing intent.
...
Huangpu Qingtian put his finger away and laughed at the kneeling Xie Tianshang, “Ha-ha-ha, how amusing. Who knew you could grow so strong in such a short time? You’re way stronger than those two behind me. Pledge yourself to me and you won’t regret it!”
They all looked shocked. This was daylight talent ‘robbery’!
“He-he-he, I am from Sword Marquise Abode. It is not my choice who our allies are!” Xie Tianshang laughed, happy Huangpu Qingtian was finally giving him some time of day.
Huangpu Qingtian shook his head, “Stubborn fool! Whether the seven houses or the whole world, it will be ours! Those old geezers will soon find themselves between four walls and six feet under. Why would you care about their decisions? Just agree and the entire Sword Marquise Abode will agree as well. “
Huangpu Qingtian turned to Chu Qingcheng and Long Xingyun, “You two as well. Swear yourself to me and the Esoteric Debate will end here and now. The seven houses will be eternally one!”
Not just Chu Qingcheng’s group was shocked, but even Dragon Cloud City’s side’s clan elders watched Huangpu Qingtian incredulous.
It was the leader of a clan that made decisions, not their top disciple.
Yet this Huangpu Qingtian not only circumvented his Estate Lord, but even spat in the face of the rest of those geezers. This was a gross lack of respect, a power play and disregard for the others above his station.
This was something no one, not even young masters of other houses, would dare to utter.
Yet Huangpu Qingtian did this out in the open. He didn’t even care that he was stealing his father’s position.
They all turned to see Huangpu Tianyuan’s face ashen from anger. While the elders couldn’t care less. They even nodded!
At that point, people realized that this was perhaps the true power of a monarch...

chapters.title: Chapter 281, Blizzard Dragon Slash
chapters.content:
Chapter 281, Blizzard Dragon Slash
In front of the National Elemental Stone, the people stared shockingly at Huangpu Qingtian, especially Luo Yunchang. She was sweating and plagued with worry.
If the three houses’ disciples fell to Huangpu Qingtian’s wild and overreaching ambition, it would be tantamount to throwing Zhuo Fan to the wolves. No matter how strong Zhuo Fan was, he couldn’t face all seven houses’ experts by himself!
It didn’t take long for Chu Qingcheng, Xie Tianshang and Long Xingyun to reach a conclusion. They unanimously shook their heads, their minds made.
Raising an eyebrow, Huangpu Qingtian had seen it coming, but was still somewhat in disbelief, “Why make such an unwise and detrimental decision?”
“Humph, if you can scare me with some pretty words, I will never be able to hold my head up high. I will be blaming myself more than anyone else would. That is one future I don’t want to see!” Long Xingyun snickered, speaking from the bottom of his heart.
Huangpu Qingtian shook his head in contempt, “What value could dignity and self-respect have in the face of true power? This is your only chance. Take it, or become my enemies!”
The three saw the determination in each other’s eyes and were resolved to fight alongside each other.
Huangpu Qingtian snorted, “You asked for it. Don’t come crying later when you’re starting to regret!”
Huangpu Qingtian disappeared with a light step. The next thing they knew was his sudden appearance before the trio.
So fast!
The three jerked. They knew Huangpu Qingtian was the strongest, but had heard nothing of his speed, which was obviously even higher than Lin Xuanfeng.
They couldn’t even react as they were already on the ground.
[How did his cultivation reach such perfection, having both unbridled power and unmatched speed?]
[Damn monster!]
The three gnashed their teeth in shock. But they were still Six Dragons and One Phoenix and recovered their calm quickly.
Chu Qingcheng grabbed her allies and covered them in a cold barrier. The two then attacked.
Xie Tianshang’s sword flashed and Long Xingyun’s palm held a dragon image. Perhaps Chu Qingcheng’s cold had an influence, as the sword wave and the dragon image fused with the coldness while passing through the barrier. They transformed into a huge attack that slammed towards Huangpu Qingtian.
