Xie Tianshang was the first to complain and looked at him with thirst for battle, “Why?”
Rolling his eyes, Xie Tianyang provided the explanation, “Big brother, that’s him talking nonsense. With him being the strongest, if he wanted to be a spy, he’d have done it from the start. Why waste time with this convoluted ploy?”
“Uh, then...” Xie Tianshang didn’t get it.
Luo Yunhai chuckled, “Big brother Zhuo is trying to say that doubting each other will be buying into the enemy’s trap and make us weaker. We will talk later about the spy matter. Now it’s time for all of us to unite and fight!”
They all nodded and attached greater importance to Luo clan.
The sinister and deceitful Zhuo Fan wasn’t the only one with a full grasp of the situation. Luo clan’s future Clan Head was also wise. He lived up to his name as the fifth godson of Dugu Zhantian.
Taking this into account, Luo clan’s rise was imminent!
The three houses’ top disciples nodded in praise as well. Although the Luo clan had ridiculous growth over the years, so much so they felt scared, they were nonetheless eager to see what would become of this fledgling clan.
In the eyes of the crowd, the clan head and servant glowed with unprecedented brightness...
“Big brother Zhuo, something’s off here!” Luo Yunhai glanced at his surroundings as he whispered to Zhuo Fan, “This place is prone to ambushes. We need to be extra cautious.”
Nodding, Zhuo Fan gave the area a once over, “In your eyes, how do you think they’ll do it?”
“A frontal assault with a pincer move, followed by an ambush from behind.” Luo Yunhai’s eyes were firm, convinced of seeing through the other’s scheme.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “You’ve learned well from that old geezer. You haven’t let me down. You and your team deal with the back ambush while I will handle the front. “
Zhuo Fan then shot forth with a calm look.
Luo Yunhai was startled then nodded.
He knew the frontal assault was the enemy’s main force. What Zhuo Fan chose was the hardest and most dangerous mission.
Then again, recalling Zhuo Fan’s dreaded power and mystical abilities, Luo Yunhai set his mind at ease.
“Where is Zhuo Fan going?”
Xie Tianshang was left clueless, as were many others. He was about to chase when Luo Yunhai stopped him, “I ask of you all to listen to my orders, lest we be routed!”
After the shock subsided, they looked at him in derision.
They all admired Luo Yunhai, but not to the point they’d be in awe of this young man who lacked the almighty power Zhuo Fan had.
Which among these future house lords would ever let a runt tell them what to do?
If there was anyone from Luo clan who they’d ever accept, it would be Zhuo Fan! But letting a tyke boss them around?
Humph!
All he got was snorts.
Luo Yunhai’s face grew grave, knowing there was nothing else he could do. Every aspect of him, be it experience or power, lacked in making these houses’ geniuses trust him, let alone listening to him.
But it was at this crucial moment a cold, yet charming, voice echoed, “Is it Zhuo Fan’s decision?”
Luo Yunhai looked up startled, to see Chu Qingcheng’s cold and critical eye. He nodded.
She looked back at the man’s imposing figure walking in front of them and sighed, “Then what is your plan?”
That got a reaction out of the crowd. [The grand Edifice Lord Chu is actually listening to a damn kid?]
[You may fancy Zhuo Fan and want his favor, but don’t go throwing away Drifting Flowers Edifices’ reputation!]
Surely they all hung on Zhuo Fan’s every word. The mighty Soaring Demonic Dragon could fight toe to toe with Huangpu Qingtian, no? So what reason did they have to treat a brat the same way?
The other two houses refrained from commenting.
To Xue Ningxiang, the world’s number one innocent, more like delusional, missus, the intricacies this decision held to the other houses went right over her head as she shouted, “Yunhai, I’ll listen to you! You got us out of that impasse last time. You may not be on big brother Zhuo’s level, but you’re still stronger than these guys, who only know how to lose!”
Restraint was not in Xue Ningxiang’s vocabulary, making Long Xingyun and Xie Tianshang’s faces aflame. Ever since they came to Beast King Mountain they hadn’t won once. Nor lost with dignity.
And that was the truth of it. All they ever achieved since coming here was a big fat nada.
They felt ashamed even more now, with Xue Ningxiang there to poke their wounds. It also had something to do with Xie Tianyang being her shadow, safeguarding her every step of the way. If it was any other vassal clan, even with Sword Marquise Abode’s amiable stance, they’d still get a trashing.
Would any lord allow their vassal to act like so?
“Ning’er, don’t say that. Leave them with some dignity!”
They were all on the same side after all, practically brothers. Xie Tianyang had to curb Xue Ningxiang’s willfulness. He then turned to Xie Tianshang, “Big brother, all of us house disciples are usually focused on cultivating. Fighting alone is out of the question, but when it comes to joining a team, it’s best we leave it to Yunhai. If I know that punk Zhuo Fan well, he never did things he wasn’t sure of. So let’s go along with his decision.”
Luo Yunhai nodded in gratitude at Chu Qingcheng, Xue Ningxiang and Xie Tianyang. Then turned nervously to Xie Tianshang.
Xie Tianshang squinted but gave his consent, “What would you have us do?”
Luo Yunhai was overjoyed. He finally had Sword Marquise Abode’s support.
Long Xingyun saw how two of his allies caved and shrugged, in lack of a better option, “Since Drifting Flowers Edifices and Sword Marquise Abode approve, I will also listen to you.”
Luo Yunhai was excited.
He had now become the tri-house alliance’s acting commander. He had the power to move thousands of people, that of the thee houses and their vassals.
As long as Huangpu Qingtian didn’t butt in, he was certain nothing could stand in the way of him and his army.
Luo Yunhai put on a serious face and spoke, “From my discussion with big brother Zhuo we’ve concluded that we are surrounded. We will have to break through the encirclement. Listen up, everyone, the vassals are to split in three groups, those belonging to each houses.
“The Drifting Flowers Edifices division will form a column, awaiting my order to attack our behind. The other two will form our flanks as we move in tandem. Keep cool and don’t break formation as you fight. Be mindful of your position in the formation to not let it crumble.” Luo Yunhai shouted with confidence.
He knew full well that Zhuo Fan was the sole reason they listened. But come the aftermath of the battle, he was certain their views will change.
[My five years in the army weren’t a waste.]
Luo Yunhai vowed...

chapters.title: Chapter 291, Charge
chapters.content:
Chapter 291, Charge
Zhuo Fan went over to Huangpu Qingtian, his gait casual, his tone calm, just like seeing an old pal, “Young master Huangpu, since this is the second round, you should’ve told me. Where’s the pill then?”
“Ha-ha-ha, please. It’d be the same as dangling the Brimming Sacred Pill in your face. Now that I’ve seen what Steward Zhuo can do, let’s see you try getting it now!” Huangpu Qingtian raised a taunting eyebrow.
Zhuo Fan shook his head. There was no point in doing anything, not when he had no clue of the item’s location.
“Young master Huangpu, since you won’t tell me, take it as my loss this time. Let’s meet again in round three!” Zhuo Fan waved and was about to retreat, as if scared.
Huangpu Qingtian snickered, “Steward Zhuo, I admit that I have no way of stopping you from leaving. Nor do you have a way of stopping me. But I can’t say the same for them.”
Hinting at Luo Yunhai’s army, Huangpu Qingtian snickered with a light clap.
Furious roars filled the marsh, storming for the group of allies from both sides. Just as Luo Yunhai predicted.
The attack was formed of two armies led by Yan Bangui and You Yushan, respectively. There was no sign of Lin Xuanfeng.
The guy was double the cripple, true, but a Profound Heaven expert regardless. He wasn’t about to miss out on springing an ambush.
With such an obvious answer, Luo Yunhai easily predicted the guy was waiting for them to retreat in his direction.
“Nice, you live up to the name of Tianyu’s Fifth Tiger!” Xie Tianshang showed his admiration. His opinion of Luo Yunhai grew a notch.
The same went for the others.
If not for Luo Yunhai’s tactic, the sudden charge of so many enemies would’ve crushed them where they stood. Some would chose to flee and run into Lin Xuanfeng’s team, sealing any means of escape.
Luo Yunhai may be weak, but his art of war was leagues above anyone from Six Dragons and One Phoenix!
Luo Yunhai just shook his hand. The praise didn’t get to his head as he kept his cool in dealing with the sudden dual charge, “Listen up. Only act when I give the signal!”
They all nodded, fully trusting Luo Yunhai.
Huangpu Qingtian watched it all with a smile, “Steward Zhuo, your allies look positively rooted in fear. They huddle together like lambs, about to break, flooded by my men.”
“Isn’t it what you wanted anyway?” Zhuo Fan smiled back, completely confident of Luo Yunhai’s abilities.
Squinting, Huangpu Qingtian felt something amiss.
His side had ten thousand men doing the charge and even laid down an ambush. While the tri-house alliance numbered three thousand at best, outnumbered five to one!
With them holding the field and numerical advantage, anyone would think this battle was in the bag. So what did Zhuo Fan based his confidence on?
Huangpu Qingtian would find out soon enough.
“Kill!”
With an earth shaking roar, Luo Yunhai pointed behind him and his army followed.
Yan Bangui and You Yushan’s armies were stunned in bafflement.
[We haven’t even made contact, so why are they charging behind? The ambush hadn’t sprung yet either!]
The two were oblivious to its meaning and took it as a good thing. Regardless of what trick they pulled, it would only work to show a hole in their formation. [This will make things easier, killing them down to the last man!]
The two only grew excited in their charge.
How could they have known their crass assumption couldn’t be farther from the truth?
Luo Yunhai’s army did charge, but its flanks did their job in keeping the center shielded. Despite the flanks clashing with the enemy, they showed no weakness in their defense as they also didn’t engage in a heated fight, moving with the center’s charge as well.
Yan Bangui and Yan Bangui’s armies found themselves in the worst situation. They felt as if each man was facing five people. Just as they attacked the front, a sudden retaliation came from the back.
The tri-house alliance moved like the sea, crushing the enemy armies in waves. Amidst the turbulent waters, Yan Bangui and You Yushan found their numbers culled.
As for the lucky survivors, they landed far behind the battle, looking on at the endless strings of corpses left by the alliance’s charge.
They had the numbers, they had the flanking, but now they had the biggest losses. While Yan Bangui and You Yushan looked positively glum, Huangpu Qingtian gnashed his teeth.
[You’ve got your ass handed to you even when five to one?! Just what do I keep you idiots for anyway?]
You Yushan’s back tingled from Huangpu Qingtian’s seething bloodthirst and he gave the signal to Lin Xuanfeng.
A three-pronged attack ought to save them from a gruesome and cruel death, no?
But as Lin Xuanfeng eagerly led his five thousand men to beat someone when they were down…
He heard a loud boom and his army was blown away. Luo Yunhai’s vanguard, Drifting Flowers Edifices, was mowing his men like grass.
His only reaction… slackjawed.
[What. The. Hell?]
[Weren’t we supposed to catch a fish in a barrel at this point? Why the hell do I still see them holding strong?]
[How the hell does a huge fish like this just slip right past you?]
[Yan Bangui and You Yushan, are you more useless than manure? What are you doing letting a pristine army charge here? How am I supposed to stop them?]
While he was here cursing his allies, the duo cursed right back.
[You damn cripple! Is this how you lead an army? Are your men meant as cannon fodder? I don’t expect you to stop them, but you could at least curb their charge somewhat!]
[You’re 100% garbage is what you are! You got what was coming to you when Soaring Demonic Dragon took an arm and a leg!]
As the trio cursed each other like no tomorrow, Luo Yunhai had no problem punching his way through the encirclement.
Zhuo Fan laughed from pride.
When it came to armies, ambushes were the norm. This couldn’t have been a better test for the fledgling Marshal. The way Luo Yunhai set his army was the typical echelon formation, excelling in counter attacking the pincer attack and allowing high mobility.
This formation puts a price on speed above all else. Once it was formed and picked enough speed, nothing could stand in its way.
Zhuo Fan flicked a grin to Huangpu Qingtian, “Young master Huangpu, my guess is that it wouldn’t be so hard for them to get away.”
Face twitching, Huangpu Qingtian looked ahead with a scorching gaze. He wished nothing more than to kill those three wretched allies of his.
The reason for one’s defeat wasn’t an unbeatable enemy, but wretched allies.
[Those morons have higher numbers yet were still smacked around. All they managed to do is drag my reputation through the mud. They’re nothing but utter imbeciles!]
Taking a deep breath to quell the surging anger, Huangpu Qingtian laughed coldly, “Ha-ha-ha, Steward Zhuo is erudite in pen and sword. You’ve had this planned all along…”
“No, no, no, there was no planning. They did it all by themselves. One must give credit where it’s due, and not take it for oneself.” Zhuo Fan cut him off with his snide remark.
Which only got Huangpu Qingtian even more worked up.
Zhuo Fan’s deceitful character was common knowledge, so losing to him was hardly shameful. But those three sods of his lost to the likes of some broads from Drifting Flowers Edifices. To make matters worse, it was the tyke from Luo clan leading them.
With his allies having lost any semblance of dignity, it was quite sensible for their leader to blow a gasket.
Grating his teeth and fuming mad, Huangpu Qingtian’s face took on a vile tone, “Steward Zhuo, I never wished to drag them into this. You leave me no choice but to…”
“What, go and snap their necks yourself? Ha-ha-ha, you’ll have to go through me first.” With his trademark evil grin, Zhuo Fan’s urge for battle flared.
Huangpu Qingtian nodded, “Our fight is foreordained. But first, let’s see if you can save them!”
Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes flashed with cruelty and roared at the sky.
“Ooh~!”
Shockingly enough, Huangpu Qingtian’s mere shout sounded closer to a dragon than a human.
Zhuo Fan squinted, but his reply was a calm gathering of eerie power in his eyes.
That dragon roar was a special martial art, just like his Wraith Style. They both originated from dragons!
But no man could ever release a dragon’s roar, short of being a dragon himself.
Zhuo Fan shook that thought away, finding it utterly ridiculous. A true dragon had the power of at least Gu Santong.
Despite being called a monster, his might had yet to shed the realm of mortals. [So why then…]
Zhuo Fan’s train of thought was cut off when the earth rumbled with a dreadful sound…

chapters.title: Chapter 292, Blood Croc Army
chapters.content:
Chapter 292, Blood Croc Army
Boom~
As the rumbling continued, the sound only grew louder. Not even the chaos of battle could drown it.
Luo clan and Drifting Flowers Edifices stopped their charge. So too did Yan Bangui and You Yushan cease attacking their flanks.
Ally and enemy alike watched dumbstruck at the source of the noise. What dreaded creature could make such a ‘riveting’ entrance?
Roar!
They got their answer in the form of an endless stampede of blood-red creatures crawling towards them from behind Huangpu Qingtian. Regardless of where one looked, all they saw was a crawling red mass.
Now that they got a closer look, the creature was a fanged blood crocodile of five meters in length. They were pack animals crawling on the ground, yet that didn’t stop them from having incredible speed and tough bodies like peak Bone Tempering experts.
“3rd level spiritual beast, Blood Croc!”
Everyone cried out in alarm. Who wouldn’t, when watching ten thousand Blood Crocs marching towards them with relentless force.
A lucky few Profound Heaven experts would just fly out, while the rest were doomed to be ripped limb from limb in the jaws of a croc.
Luo Yunhai turned grave, “Godfather told me the Quanrong are expert beast masters, sweeping the battlefield with their beast army. This army can use formations and could hold its own at a numerical disadvantage, but I never imagined Huangpu Qingtian would resort to the likes of this. This is bad!”
“What, Huangpu Qingtian called them?” Long Xingyun snapped his head at the smirking figure, just as the Blood Crocs simply bypassed him. Now a believer, his face sank, “This monster is already strong enough, but now he can call upon a beast army as well? We can’t fight them. Our only choice is to run or get trampled!”
The others took one last fearful look at Huangpu Qingtian and nodded. Huangpu Qingtian’s talent had reached a godlike level!
But was running that easy? Sure, the few flying ones could take some passengers, but what about the other couple thousand?
They were fated to end up as broken corpses under the Blood Crocs’ stampede.
Chu Qingcheng frowned and sighed.
Yan Bangui, You Yushan and Lin Xuanfeng snickered as they flew away with their Profound Heaven experts, uncaring to the fate of the rest.
Xie Tianyang looked at Zhuo Fan’s broad and straight back, “Our fate now rests solely in his hands.”
Everyone looked at Zhuo Fan in frustration and helplessness.
Zhuo Fan’s abilities were eerie, to say the least, of great power, but could one man stop the flood?
They held no hope in Zhuo Fan.
Even Luo Yunhai, always confident of Zhuo Fan’s invincibility, faltered, “I and big brother Zhuo had anticipated the enemy launching a frontal assault. It was our ignorance that led us to assume they’d be men and not thousands of Blood Crocs! Humans are susceptible to fear. A bit of trick here and there from big brother Zhuo would be enough to buy us plenty of time. But when facing a horde of savage spiritual beasts, they won’t falter for anything…”
“Damn it! Is there no other way?” Xie Tianshang cut him off in anger. His eyes were burning from rage, “Huangpu Qingtian is inhuman!”
The others got what he was saying.
Yes, he was inhuman. No man was able to subdue a Blood Croc horde and use it for himself. No one would be so cruel to his fellow men, to even throw away his own men’s lives to be ground beneath the marching horde of his beasts.
Then it dawned on them, [Eh? Isn’t that strikingly similar to Zhuo Fan?]
They turned to him now. The man was taking a deep breath and looked on heavily. Like a cold-blooded monster, he also possessed power no man could.
But how much could this monster slow the horde down? [We don’t ask for much, just enough to let us get out alive.]
They held little hope for Zhuo Fan pulling through for them, but they still did hope!
His talent was unseen in this world as well, but he was a human like the rest. How could he possibly slow the beast flood down?
Well, one delusional girl thought this was right up his alley. Xue Ningxiang clenched her fists and said, “No worries. Big brother Zhuo can do it…”
She had now crossed the point of no return, becoming an eternal Zhuo Fan’s, uh, fan. She didn’t care about hows or whys, just as long as Zhuo Fan did something, everything would be alright.
Funnily enough, she was right!
Luo Yunhai begged to differ however. Zhuo Fan had no problem dealing with a bunch of men charging over, but as for spiritual beasts…
In the face of the ravenous flood, Zhuo Fan looked like a dinghy floating about, ready to tip at any jolt.
However, this dinghy was quite calm, and smiling, “Young master Huangpu, who knew you can tame beasts.”
“Ha-ha-ha, you’re too kind. It is but a mere parlor trick.” Huangpu Qingtian acted casual but couldn’t hide the conceit in his eyes from Zhuo Fan.
As Zhuo Fan took pride in his blinking art, Huangpu Qingtian was confident of his beast taming skill.
It was akin to providence. As if Heaven went out of its way to lay everything at this king’s feet so that no man, or beast, could defy his righteous conquest.
Zhuo Fan could tell what he was thinking and grinned, “Young master Huangpu, you sure are confident in your ability.”
“Not confidence, but a given!” Huangpu Qingtian smiled with his head held high. The Emperor declared, “In this world, be it armies, the ground beneath their feet, the officials, and even these savage beasts, all are fated to bow before their true king!”
[Show off!]
Zhuo Fan’s inner outcry summed it up nicely. While his reply was a snort and shake of the head, “What do you say to a wager then?”
“On what?” That got Huangpu Qingtian’s attention. [The kid has time to bet when his life is at stake? What’s he up to?]
Bang! Zhuo Fan drew a heavy line with his foot, sneering at Huangpu Qingtian, “I wager your beast army won’t cross it. Even if just one of them does, I lose.”
“Pretentious!” Huangpu Qingtian only had anger for his haughty boast.
He knew what Zhuo Fan was capable of, but never once believed the punk had the power to quell the beast tide of tens of thousands! Huangpu Qingtian only managed to do it with that little secret deep within him. As for power alone? Impossible.
Zhuo Fan’s crass words undermined his authority. Was the ability of a regent that easily dispelled?
Zhuo Fan only mocked him, “Well then, oh young master Huangpu, do you accept? The stakes are the Brimming Sacred Pills we each hold. The winner gets the other’s pill!”
Huangpu Qingtian mulled over the trickery Zhuo Fan planned to include in this wager, but still held supreme confidence that nothing the punk did could change anything. As such, for honor and hubris, he nodded, “Show me then your futile attempts to stop tens of thousands of spiritual beasts!”
“My pleasure!” With a crafty grin, Zhuo Fan turned to the charging Blood Croc tide.
Filled with barbaric and unrelenting savagery, these Blood Crocs had only one answer to this suicidal kid, gaping maws filled with teeth and sharp claws.
Chu Qingcheng, Xue Ningxiang and the rest watched on unnerved. Huangpu Qingtian had a cold smile, calm and uncaring to the lonely man facing a flood.
Hum~
Zhuo Fan’s eyes then flashed in a strange light.
The Blood Crocs were about to tear into him, with one of them even having his head in its maw. It only needed to chomp and that would be the end of Zhuo Fan.
But the Blood Crocs’ eyes shrank in fear. Under the astonished looks of the bystanders, the beast army began to shiver.
Roar!
A mewling cry from somewhere among them signaled the rest of the Blood Crocs to turn tail and scamper from whence they came.
The wild eyes and stumbling gait only hinted at the horrors these beasts had seen. They were even faster in retreat!
This spectacle left everyone slackjawed. Chu Qingcheng was dumbstruck, Xie Tianyang was shell shocked, You Yushan was speechless, Lin Xuanfeng jumped out of his skin and, naturally, Huangpu Qingtian was floored.
He still had a clear picture in mind, of Zhuo Fan being torn apart, only to be replaced with an image of a cowering beast army.
What made it worse was the unknown element of how he’d done it.
Huangpu Qingtian stood there like a statue, his eyes lost, mindless of even the fleeing spiritual beasts zipping by…

chapters.title: Chapter 293, First Contact
chapters.content:
Chapter 293, First Contact
“What… just happened?”
You Yushan was floating about in the air, looking dazed at the scampering blood tide. When he finally managed to return to his senses, he said to his two allies, “Wasn’t that eldest young master’s trump card?”
The two were still out of it by the looks of it.
Huangpu Qingtian had laid it on pretty thick with his boasting. That once Blood Crocs came into play, the tri-house alliance would be left in mangled pieces. They were so excited to see Zhuo Fan finally falling short in something, getting with the program of suffering like everyone else.
The boasting got them hyped as well, eager to see Zhuo Fan in tears.
That wasn’t meant to be however, not when the sure kill method was running away at top speed.
The three sank into depression, followed closely by the sharp decline in Huangpu Qingtian’s grandeur.
Even Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord got the same treatment as them. He boasted and flounced, sure, but do that in front of Soaring Demonic Dragon and you’d get bitch slapped.
[He had met his bane!]
Luo Yunhai’s side was on the verge of breaking down at the sight of the savage beast tide. They felt the end coming, their future robbed.
But looking at it now, they knew the earlier panic was quite pointless. There was no need to fear, as long as Zhuo Fan was here!
The acting commander of the tri-house alliance shook his head at the casual Zhuo Fan, “Sigh, it seems even I don’t know big brother Zhuo well. He shrugged the beast army of tens of thousand like it was nothing.”
“Forgive me, friends. I have made the grievous mistake of doubting big brother Zhuo’s abilities. With how Huangpu Qingtian can do it, it’s quite obvious big brother Zhuo can do it too. It’s a fallacy to think otherwise!”
Luo Yunhai gave a solemn bow to the vexed crowd.
It made sense though. Having gone through so many events with Zhuo Fan, there was one undeniable truth all of them should’ve figured out by now. Nothing was impossible for him.
If even he met with an impossible conundrum, then all hope was lost.
Huangpu Qingtian could control spiritual beasts? Humph, then so could Zhuo Fan. The basis? He was Zhuo Fan, of course.
In the blink of an eye, Zhuo Fan’s fan club found its ranks greatly bolstered.
One had to admit that even a fan was right, sometimes. Just look at Xue Ningxiang, bouncing around with unbridled joy, “See that? What did I tell you?”
Chu Qingcheng shook her head. Although her love rival, she still found her innocence pleasing to the eye.
Xiao Dandan’s eyes had hearts in them, watching Zhuo Fan with an intoxicated leer.
Zhuo Fan’s cold tone gave her quite the scare back then, but with him striking the alpha male pose, she threw that fear out the window. Dying by his hand would be a dream come true at this point.
[I’d rather be a ghost by a hero’s side than the wife of a lousy bum!]
The lust was strong with this one. Xiao Dandan simply wanted to gobble Zhuo Fan up. Dong Xiaowan saw the other’s galls in envy.
They all fought over Zhuo Fan’s attention, but not her. She was of low status and being unable to follow her heart left her in misery…
“These monsters are capable of anything!” Xie Tianyang glanced at Xue Ningxiang’s red face with jealousy.
The others paused for a second then nodded unanimously.
One man controlled a beast tide while the other shooed it away with a wink. Could a human being ever do that?
The two became a beacon of shock and awe to every onlooker.
Zhuo Fan reigned totally supreme. He did have the upper hand and all…
Rumble~
Amidst the ever shaking earth from the fleeing Blood Crocs passing him by, Huangpu Qingtian’s face twitched. His fists scrunched up and he spat through gnashed teeth, “Stop! I command you all to stop!”
Not one Blood Croc minded his rave. They had bigger things to worry about.
[You moron of elephantine proportions. You’re merely a king on earth and can command some of us, but that man is an emperor over everyone. You don’t compare!]
[Go home, wash up, and sleep tight!]
No Blood Croc who passed him showed any intent of ever stopping, even if he roared himself hoarse.
Roar!
Huangpu Qingtian was pissed. He released a dragon roar deep enough to resound even through the deaf Blood Crocs.
Zhuo Fan looked on with a quizzical look.
Only now did the Blood Crocs stop and look at him.
Huangpu Qingtian smiled in joy, having regained some semblance of his regality. But then the Blood Crocs lowered their heads again and scampered off like naughty children.
The man’s eyes were bloodshot and his anger exploded.
He was a king and no one defied him. Especially not some mongrels!
Thump!
An iron fist lashed out and blood blossomed. The punch blew up the head of a Blood Croc.
“Stop or die!” Huangpu Qingtian wailed with his hand dripping blood.
Not that it had any effect. The Blood Crocs didn’t give a rat’s ass about his commands.
In a fit of anger, he blew up five more Blood Crocs but the beasts took it in a stride, running as fast as their legs could carry them.
As anger gave way to despondency, this king found himself dethroned, standing there in absent shock as the Blood Crocs streamed by…
“Why won’t they listen? I am their king!” Huangpu Qingtian muttered under his breath in bewilderment.
All this while the Blood Crocs ignored him. He didn’t strike a kingly figure anymore, but that of a beggar now that he had lost his throne. He was a nobody!
The rest of the Six Dragons and One Phoenix, foe and ally alike were watching it all in stunned shock. The day had finally come for the mighty Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord, Huangpu Qingtian, to be lost and despondent.
The defiance of his orders thwarted by Zhuo Fan’s ability had a far greater impact on this proud and majestic king. It was too much for even him to bear!
The watchful shadow from the sides sighed, “These two are natural enemies. Yet each is a genius seen once every ten thousand years. The death of even one of them would be such a tragedy. Should I… take them both?”
He threw away that thought with a shake of his head and snickered, “He-he-he, nah. The world isn’t big enough for both of them. Their fight is preordained. It’s only a matter of time. The most sensible choice is to let them go at it and pick the winner, hi-hi-hi…”
No one knew such a creepy and uncertain element had snuck its way into the Esoteric Debate.
Zhuo Fan scratched his nose, feeling quite disappointed in himself, “Uh, Young master Huangpu, don’t be so down. There’s no shortage of people who had and will lose to me. By the looks of it, I seem to be the winner in this little wager of ours. Will you honor our deal?”
With all the Blood Crocs gone, Huangpu Qingtian raised his head to reveal a crazed pair of eyes as he snapped, “Humph, my word is gold. What do you take me for, a welsher?”
Huangpu Qingtian took out a vial from his chest. Zhuo Fan knew it to have the Brimming Sacred Pill.
Huangpu Qingtian was afraid Zhuo Fan would snatch his ring again so he hid it in his clothes.
Any cultivator out there had the means to store their things, be it rings or bags. It was arguably the safest place to keep, unlike on your own body.
But Huangpu Qingtian’s thinking went the other way around. He chose the most important item to hide on himself. The most dangerous place was also the safest. It even caught Zhuo Fan off guard.
Zhuo Fan would never have found it even if he snatched all the storage rings.
Zhuo Fan laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, Young master Huangpu is so crafty. I never saw it coming. I was still of a mind you gave it to that cripple for safekeeping! “
“Humph, you take me for a fool to leave it on him after the first pill?” Huangpu Qingtian flicked and the vial flew at Zhuo Fan, “Humph, take it!”
Whoosh!
The vial shot through the air, leaving eerie sounds as it passed. Even space shimmered.
Zhuo Fan felt a sudden immense pressure slam into his shoulders just as it neared. It even made the likes of him stagger.
Startled, Zhuo Fan threw his hand forward to block it.
Thump!
The impact had him slide five meters and even found his arm that caught the vial numb.
He was shocked to find what a mere flick could do. No wonder Chu Qingcheng and the other two lost against Huangpu Qingtian even though they joined hands.
[This guy is a monster, a monster body cultivator!]
Besides Gu Santong, he would definitely be the most outstanding talent of the younger generation.
Zhuo Fan knew that even his Diamond Body was a far cry from Huangpu Qingtian’s physique!
[Elder Li was right, this guy is a true monster, stronger than me.]
After this first true contact with Huangpu Qingtian, Zhuo Fan now realized the full extent of the power the head of Six Dragons and One Phoenix wielded…

chapters.title: Chapter 294, Release the Beasts
chapters.content:
Chapter 294, Release the Beasts
Whoosh!
A black figure blocked Zhuo Fan.
He was still staggered from the previous blow when another strike came out of the blue.
Squinting, Zhuo Fan blocked the strike with his hand.
Boom!
The immense power of the strike cracked earth under him, caving it for a hundred meters around. But it hardly mattered compared to the pain coming from his arm. It was on the verge of being broken!
Astonished, Zhuo Fan found himself face to face with a sinister looking Huangpu Qingtian, his eyes beaming with murderous intent.
“Zhuo Fan, I can’t let you live!” Cackling, Huangpu Qingtian spun a kick into Zhuo Fan’s waist, aiming to split him in two, “You’re the first to ever rile my desire to kill!”
His brow shuddering, Zhuo Fan faced the sky splitting leg. Since he couldn’t block, he had his right eye flash golden.
Instant movement!
Whoosh!
Huangpu Qingtian had cut Zhuo Fan in half, only to find it was his afterimage. While the man himself got some much needed distance between them, gasping for breath.
He didn’t anticipate Huangpu Qingtian would ever resort to sucker punching him. What he did just now must’ve really pushed the guy’s buttons and had now driven him mad with the sole purpose of slaughtering him.
The onlookers from farther away were astonished.
This was the third time Zhuo Fan and Huangpu Qingtian were at each other’s throats. First in Dragon Cloud City, cut short by Dugu Zhantian’s meddling. Second was pill stealing, though no one was there to witness exactly how it went down. And as the saying went, third time’s the charm. They truly let loose in this round, no holds barred.
The result? Zhuo Fan’s prospects at winning just hit rock bottom. He was on a total defensive. And if not for that mystical ability of his, he’d be a goner.
Huangpu Qingtian’s overwhelming dominance crushed Zhuo Fan!
Not even Zhuo Fan could face this monster.
Gnashing his teeth, Xie Tianshang was tense. You Yushan, however, was cackling mad. Both side’s leaders had monstrous talent, but when it came to measuring fists, Huangpu Qingtian won by a landslide. Zhuo Fan had no way to fight back!
The uninvited guest in the shadows nodded, “Huangpu Qingtian has the advantage in body, but Zhuo Fan is far more flexible and crafty. He is better by far. And this is when he isn’t even in the Profound Heaven Stage. If the two were of equal cultivation, this fight would’ve ended a long time ago. “
Huangpu Qingtian drew the same conclusion, which only fueled his desire to kill to new heights.
Zhuo Fan presented himself as a real and tangible threat to him. He never got the same feeling from the other Six Dragons and One Phoenix, and only looked at them with disdain even when forced to deal with their cooperation.
On the other hand, Zhuo Fan was a great threat to him. Even more so now that he saw Zhuo Fan cower the Blood Croc horde and trampled all over his royal face.
It was a wake up call. That Zhuo Fan was the same as him, qualified to be king.
With a cold glint in his eye, Huangpu Qingtian barked, “Zhuo Fan, is your art only good at running away?”
“Yep!” Zhuo Fan was blunt as a birch stump, not forgetting his evil grin as he counted on his fingers, “Running, assassination, scouting, spying, and let’s not forget my favorite, ring stealing. It has quite wonderful applications, don’t you think?”
That only pissed Huangpu Qingtian off. He was looking to mock the man into attacking.
But Zhuo Fan was way too calm, ignoring the cheap taunt and making a kingly comeback. His desire to murder Zhuo Fan on the spot spiked again.
The shadow nodded. He knew how to appreciate talents.
Detached from everything and looking at things with cool and critical eyes were the makings of a great arriviste. At the same time, Huangpu Qingtian’s image fell a notch in his eyes.
The shadow slowly began to be partial towards Zhuo Fan, finding him to be the better seed…
Taking a deep breath, Huangpu Qingtian found himself in distress. Zhuo Fan was unlike Chu Qingcheng and the like. He could come and go as he pleased, with no one to stop him. He was the biggest headache there ever was when made an enemy.
That magical art gave him an insurmountable advantage.
So Huangpu Qingtian pointed at his allies and barked, “What are you gawking at? Kill them already!”
The trio woke up with a start. Why had they stopped? [We gotta box them in.] Thus they gave the signal.
Luo Yunhai’s echelon formation was still shaken from the Blood Croc horde and their momentum slacked. They were losing.
With the enemy surrounding them, the couple thousand army had sunk into despair against the ten thousand enemies. Few were of Chu Qingcheng’s level to escape, while the rest would find their lives driven into the mud.
Panicking, Luo Yunhai commanded, “Three round formation!”
In an instant the three divisions became rotating barrels, blocking the enemy’s onslaught. You Yushan wasn’t worried though. This formation was a defensive one. They would just have to whittle them down with numbers.
Grinning, the three looked on coldly.
Zhuo Fan frowned a bit. As long as his friends were stuck here, he was going nowhere and would sooner or later end up just as dead.
You Yushan leading the ten thousand army not only entrapped Chu Qingcheng’s group but also bogged down Zhuo Fan - two birds with one stone.
“Ha-ha-ha, Zhuo Fan, see how I trample them!” Huangpu Qingtian snickered.
He was forcing Zhuo Fan to face him.
Squinting, Zhuo Fan sported a cold smile, “You’d lower yourself to such an extent? Moreover, you’d have done it already if you wanted to.”
“Ha-ha-ha, indeed. I despise them, but now that you’re here, things have changed. I’ll take great delight in tearing them apart before your very eyes.”
Zhuo Fan tensed and secretly sighed. Just like he thought. Huangpu Qingtian left them alive, just so he could restrain him.
But the cold smile never changed, “Young master Huangpu, do you really think I’d let them drag me down?”
“Oh? But isn’t your young master with them as well?” Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes glinted, having seen through him. He charged for the armies.
It was also then when a wind whistled straight for him.
This was what he was waiting for. He blocked the kick with his hand, releasing a metallic sound.
Looking closer, he found Zhuo Fan eying him coldly.
“He-he-he, finally decided to attack.” Huangpu Qingtian gave a crafty smile from having found Zhuo Fan’s achilles’ heel. He threw a devastating punch.
The blow had the power of a mountain behind it.
Zhuo Fan vanished, letting the punch pass him.
The earth caved in tens of meters over a kilometer as a result of the massive impact.
It kicked up a cloud of dust and shocked even the clashing armies from the immense power display.
What power could do this?
Zhuo Fan was sweating now. Blocking that would’ve earned him a quick trip down under.
He looked at his friends helplessly, forced to clash this monster head on.
Huangpu Qingtian cackled at the floating Zhuo Fan, filled with scorn, “I wonder for how long can you stop my advance!”
Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth and charged.
The effect each time was minimal, barely stalling Huangpu Qingtian’s progress. His teleports saved him from the worst, but there was no way to escape unscathed.
Huangpu Qingtian was inevitable. He royally took one step at a time towards his target as he unleashed his power.
The sight of Zhuo Fan being played around like a mouse left the others in despair. Not even their last hope could stop the mighty Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord.
But only Chu Qingcheng saw through it and said nervously, “It’s for us. Huangpu Qingtian is forcing Zhuo Fan’s hand. We have to get out of here!”
It dawned on them what a disgrace they were. They became Zhuo Fan’s shackles.
“But how are we supposed to break out when we’re outnumbered? What do we do?” Luo Yunhai sighed.
For even Luo Yunhai to come out empty, it showed how truly desperate a situation they were all in.
Chu Qingcheng turned to her two allies, “Have you brought your spiritual beasts?”
Their eyes lit up, reminded how their houses provided them with some high level spiritual beasts. They were pressed at every turn all this time that they’d completely forgotten.
The two nodded.
Chu Qingcheng smiled and spoke heavily, “Use our trump cards. Release the beasts and clear a path!”

chapters.title: Chapter 295, Qiao’er’s Appearance
chapters.content:
Chapter 295, Qiao’er’s Appearance
Shriek~
A bird cry pierced the sky, heralding the appearance of a snow white beast and plunging the area into a freezer.
To the shock of everyone, they found a five meter large white eagle looming overhead. It kicked up a snowstorm with each flap of its wings. Biting cold winds pierced the enemies in their charge, slowing them and freezing the hapless.
“5th level spiritual beast, Nether Wind Falcon!” Chu Qingcheng shouted.
Xie Tianshang and Long Xingyun weren’t slow either.
Roar!
The reverberating roar drew one’s attention to a ten meter golden leopard. Its piercing eyes unnerved the staunchest of hearts, ready to pounce on them and maul their flesh.
“5th level spiritual beast, Golden Cloud Leopard!” Xie Tianshang shouted.
“And mine, 5th level spiritual beast, Heaven-seething Lava Serpent!” Long Xingyun pointed at a fifty meter long python covered in rocks. Its eyes shooting flames.
The descent of three 5th level mighty beasts struck fear in the hearts of the enemy. Each one was equal to a Radiant Stage expert. With three of them unleashed, the tri-house alliance’s power was greatly boosted.
Roar! Shriek! Sss!
The only sensible reaction in the face of such a display was to shirk back. The three spiritual beasts started raining havoc within the enemy lines, darting to and fro unhinged. Not even Profound Heaven experts faced them.
As the cries of agony reached the sky, Chu Qingcheng’s team made a breach, even if that gap was now littered with corpses.
“Yunhai, use the path to get us out!” Chu Qingcheng pointed at the clearing.
Luo Yunhai was about to do just that but three cold laughs revealed You Yushan and his two allies looking down on them still.
You Yushan only mocked them, “Chu Qingcheng, aren’t we all from the seven houses? You think you’re the only ones with pets? Don’t take us lightly. Our reserves aren’t the least bit weaker than yours!”
You Yushan snapped his fingers and revealed a blazing falcon thirty meters long, “5th level spiritual beast, Scorching Eagle!”
“Mine as well, 5th level spiritual beast, Hundred Eyes Pestilence Spider!”
Yan Bangui revealed a fifty meter long, black as night tarantula.
It spewed a thick miasma that cut off the path ahead.
Chu Qingcheng’s group found themselves back at a standstill.
Lin Xuanfeng snickered at their grave faces, “It’s time for you to feast your eyes on my 5th level spiritual beast, Nine-clawed Wind Stoat!”
A sharp wind brushed by and revealed a short one meter long skunk bearing its claws at them.
The six spiritual beasts started fighting, with no clear winner in sight. The shockwaves blew away any poor soul too slow to react.
These were the ripples from six Radiant Stage experts’ attacks. Even a Profound Heaven expert would be sent to his death.
The morale began to sink as fear set in. But the most feared were still the seven houses.
Only the likes of them could dish out 5th level spiritual beasts that could fight a Radiant Stage expert to a standstill!
The reveal of the six spiritual beasts only furthered the tug of war. You Yushan’s side stayed back in fear of not being dragged into their battle, but Chu Qingcheng’s group now had no way of breaking out either.
It now became clear that they were doomed to wait for Huangpu Qingtian to come reap their lives.
Chu Qingcheng turned to the others, “This stalemate is the worst outcome for us. Does anyone have a 5th level spiritual beast that can help?”
All she got was eye rolls.
[What do you take us for? You think we’re that well off to raise a 5th level spiritual beast?]
Chu Qingcheng sighed in sorrow while You Yushan’s side was having a field day at their expense.
The longer this dragged on the greater the danger.
Huangpu Qingtian glanced over satisfied, before turning to Zhuo Fan, “I didn’t think they would use their trump cards so soon. A shame it changed nothing.”
Zhuo Fan frowned and his hand trembled.
“Ha-ha-ha, worried? Then I will help you feel at ease by not making you waste time on a bunch of soon to be corpses!” Grinning, Huangpu Qingtian shouted, “Flaming Lion King, end them!”
Roar!
The imposing power pierced the hearts of everyone as a flaming winged lion pounced on Chu Qingcheng’s army.
“6th level spiritual beast, Flaming Lion King!”
They all gasped in fear. None saw it coming, that Huangpu Qingtian’s spirit animal would be a 6th level spiritual beast.
It was going to throw the stalemate in the enemy’s favor!
The tri-house alliance’s spiritual beasts shuddered from the lion’s roar. Their power cut down, they were pushed back by the other three spiritual beasts.
“We’re finished!”
Chu Qingcheng’s army was filled with despair and frustration as the savage lion unleashed waves of flame in its path.
Even though they’d die either way. Up till now they at least had the chance to take as many as they could down with them. With even some Profound Heaven experts cherishing the faint hope of survival. But now that the lion king was here, all hope was lost.
Their lives were now waiting for the flames of war to burn them to cinders.
You Yushan’s side laughed. Zhuo Fan kept on shuddering. He didn’t get to act as a twisted and maniacally voice grated his ears.
“If you leave, who’s to hold me back?
Huangpu Qingtian cackled. He was having a blast seeing Zhuo Fan so conflicted. After suffering at his hand for so many times, he finally had vindication. It felt good.
Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan found himself in a bind.
With two threats on a collision course with Chu Qingcheng’s group, he could only pick one. It was such a nerve wrecking decision that he felt lost regardless of what he picked.
But then, his Thunder Ring flickered. Zhuo Fan felt the impatience and hatred within.
Qiao’er?
He was startled and perplexed at its impatience. But he soon knew why.
Flaming Lion King was the same beast who had killed his mother. Although a different one, the thirst for revenge remained. Its hatred ran bone deep for what it had done to its mother.
But how was the young Qiao’er going to fight against the Flaming Lion King? It was only a 4th level spiritual beast.
The answer was picked for him as Qiao’er had reached its limit and the Thunder Ring flickered stronger.
[Sigh, it’s not like it will change anything.]
Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth, having made a decision, “Young master Huangpu, I may not be able to split myself, but what you have, well so do I!”
With a snicker, Zhuo Fan flourished, “Come, Qiao’er!”
In a flash of purple, a purple lightning shot for Flaming Lion King. Qiao’er only had one thing on its mind, revenge.
“What is that?” You Yushan peered at the lightening glow.
Yan Bangui said, “It appears to be a Thunder Skylark, a 6th level spiritual beast. But why is it purple?”
“What, 6th level spiritual beast? He has one too?” Lin Xuanfeng panicked, “Won’t this end up in a standstill again?”
Yan Bangui took a closer look, before giving a deprecating shake of his head, “Relax, that won’t happen. This Thunder Skylark is only a chick, at the 4th level. It’s no match for an adult Flaming Lion King! Besides, an adult Thunder Skylark would fare no better.”
Lin Xuanfeng laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, what’s up with Zhuo Fan then? Is he so fed up with his useless spiritual beast that he wants to give it to the lion king as a snack?”
That set the other two laughing.
While on Chu Qingcheng’s side, they were hopeful a treacherous man like Zhuo Fan had to have an amazing spirit animal.
Only to feel their hopes crumble at the sight of a young Thunder Skylark, a mere 4th level spiritual beast, and they resumed despairing.
Even Zhuo Fan felt how hopeless it was to even let such a meager support out.
Ha~
With great hope came an equally great disappointment as they all sighed, resigned to their fates…
Huangpu Qingtian wasn’t about to let this golden chance go and mocked the chick as well, “Zhuo Fan, are you that desperate to even send your useless spiritual beast to its death?”
“What can I say? If it wants to die, I can’t stop it!”
Shrugging, Zhuo Fan didn’t seem to care, but the worry in his eyes was unmistakable. Even he didn’t know of Qiao’er’s power. Common sense dictated that a 4th level spiritual beast wouldn’t be considered even a side dish to a 6th level spiritual beast.
Qiao’er’s chances were between nil and infinitesimal.
Catching on to Zhuo Fan’s worry, Huangpu Qingtian capitalized on it to put his own worries to rest. [The punk has no overt scheme in play at all. He is on the ropes.] That last one made his day and he smiled from ear to ear.
In the meantime, Qiao’er was already behind the Flaming Lion King.
It had everyone’s full attention. Even their breath was caught in their throat at the imminent clash…

chapters.title: Chapter 296, Purple Lightning’s Superiority
chapters.content:
Chapter 296, Purple Lightning’s Superiority
Roar!
Flaming Lion King’s roar grated ears as it showed its dominance. The six 5th level spiritual beasts had long stopped to watch.
You Yushan’s group’s spiritual beasts bent a knee and bowed their heads before the mighty lion king. While on Chu Qingcheng’s side, their spiritual beasts knew when they were overpowered and shuddered as they inched backward again and again.
It only worked to further let arrogance get to Flaming Lion King’s head, showing a scornful smile. It escaped his notice or, better yet, it brushed off Qiao’er’s existence entirely.
And it went the same for the other six spiritual beasts.
What could a 4th level spiritual beast possibly do in this hopeless situation?
Chu Qingcheng’s side’s spiritual beasts were vexed. [It makes no difference even if you come, fowl. You’re dead anyway.] While the enemy’s beasts looked on with mockery.
Chu Qingcheng’s faction was plunged deeper in despair. If the purple Thunder Skylark instilled a trickle of hope earlier, it was now thoroughly squashed.
A spiritual beast’s senses were accurate. If they looked down on the chick, then it was clearly worthless…
Shriek~
Not that Qiao’er cared what any of them thought of it. It only had eyes for Flaming Lion King. It cried from behind to call out the lion king with a gaze burning with hatred and thirst for battle.
Flaming Lion King swished his head back, glaring at Qiao’er, itching to eat it and quench its anger.
[You dare challenge me?]
Qiao’er’s plumes flickered and purple sparks traveled all over it. If that wasn’t clear enough, then the thick bloodthirst made it abundantly obvious it wanted the lion king’s head on a platter.
The lion king was royally pissed when Qiao’er didn’t stop its cries.
[You wretched and filthy whelp, no Thunder Skylark can match me, but you, a chick, thinks it can? For you to challenge my authority, the punishment is death.]
Roar!
With another angry roar, Flaming Lion King started showing its violent side. The frightened six spiritual beasts were already meek, not even squawking. Qiao’er was the only exception, its eyes were fixed on the bronze lion and its screeches never stopped taunting it.
The fully incensed Flaming Lion King opened its maw and spewed a three meter big fireball.
Not even a Profound Heaven expert could block such a blow. He’d be turned to ashes.
Everyone watched on edge, worried for the Thunder Skylark’s fate. Xue Ningxiang was panicking, turning to Xie Tianyang, “Brother Tianyang, big brother Zhuo’s bird looks so pitiful. Please save it!”
Ugh!
Cold sweat filled the silent Xie Tianyang. He turned to the unbearably naive Xue Ningxiang with an aggrieved look, “Ning’er, if the bird is pitiful, I am even more so! Have you forgotten our time in Allbeast Mountain Range, of the fight between Flaming Lion King and Thunder Skylark? Now you are asking me to save a 4th level spiritual beast when I am nowhere near as strong as a 6th level spiritual beast?”
“But… it’s just so pitiful!” Xue Ningxiang was saddened.
Xie Tianyang shook his head, “Blame Zhuo Fan. He knows it too yet insists on sending it to its death.”
His words got nods from all around him, puzzled as to why Zhuo Fan took this reckless course of action.
Zhuo Fan himself tightened his fists from worry. [Qiao’er, you are the embodiment of lightning and faster than Flaming Lion King. You must dodge!]
Huangpu Qingtian snickered, “You must be thinking Flaming Lion King can’t catch up to Thunder Skylark’s speed, right? Ha-ha-ha, have you forgotten whose spirit animal the lion king is?”
Huangpu Qingtian gave Flaming Lion King a look.
Flaming Lion King nodded and flapped its wings.
A blazing tornado engulfed tiny Qiao’er, sealing all means of escape. Just as the fireball approached.
With its biggest advantage sealed, its fate was without a doubt certain death.
Zhuo Fan panicked inside, [How is the brash and overbearing Flaming Lion King capable of such refined skill?]
“Ha-ha-ha, you have a spirit animal and you don’t know? Unlike spiritual beasts, a master can teach and train its pet martial arts according to their attributes. As I and Flaming Lion King are weak in speed, I devised this move to deal with quick enemies.” Huangpu Qingtian snickered.
Zhuo Fan’s anger swelled.
He had always been a lone wolf. And since he never raised spirit animals before, he was oblivious to its implications. Now he didn’t even have the time to regret.
This was Qiao’er’s decision and all he could do was support it. All consequences were for it to bear.
This was the demonic path he treaded!
He hatched Qiao’er from a mere egg and was practically kin. Of course it would walk the same path as him…
Boom!
The fireball exploded on Qiao’er. It combined with the fire tornado in a tremendous bang, releasing a torrent of flames.
Xue Ningxiang clutched her ears, ducking behind Xie Tianyang in fear as she observed the flaming explosion in dismay. The others sighed.
[Here lie the bones of an overconfident creature.]
Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth, refraining from looking and clenched his fists further.
Huangpu Qingtian beamed. He wasn’t in the habit of letting an opponent’s weakness pass by, making sure to drive home as much hurt as he could muster through his condescending, “Zhuo Fan, you truly are empty inside. To even send that young spirit animal to its death…”
Boom!
A thunder cut his mockery short. It came from within the fiery blaze. Purple lightning streaked the skies and pulverized the flames into nothing. Qiao’er was revealed at the center of the purple lightning, its eyes were raging as before, bent on killing the lion king where it stood.
[How in god’s name is that possible?]
Shock and awe was prevalent down below. The worst off were the six 5th level spiritual beasts. Not in a million years had they considered it possible for a 4th level spiritual beast to survive the lion king’s head on assault.
“W-what skill is that?” Huangpu Qingtian was no different, “Since when did Thunder Skylark have such a skill?”
Zhuo Fan looked at the sky in frown. Only to see Qiao’er wrapped in a purple cocoon of lightning. The errant purple lightning hammered the flames and evaporated at mere touch.
Zhuo Fan was speechless. He found the purple shield familiar and realized where it came from. It was the same as Lightning Canyon’s protective barrier. [Is it…]
He didn’t complete his thought as Qiao’er was on the move again.
Shriek~
Qiao’er called out Flaming Lion King once again. But it wasn’t all talk now, releasing its all in the upcoming clash.
Purple lightning snaked from its body, twisting space itself. The pressure grew from such a mighty display, to the point it felt as if the end of days was upon them.
The 5th level spiritual beasts weren’t the only ones terrified of the imminent danger, even humans found Qiao’er dreadful.
[Why is a 4th level spiritual beast far more dangerous than a 6th level one?]
Even Flaming Lion King squinted, moving backward with a grave face.
Who’d have thought the same Thunder Skylark he slighted would unleash such power?
Long Xingyun’s side was dumbfounded. They were more than a little familiar with Qiao’er’s power.
“Little Kui, Little Jie, don’t you find that lightning…” Long Xingyun stared wide-eyed.
Long Kui nodded, “Yes, it’s Uncle Jiu’s purple lightning. But… far stronger!”
Long Xingyun gasped, shocked to the extreme.
He had never dreamed he’d ever see the might of Godeye Long Jiu, the power he was famed for, Purple Lightning God Eye, being displayed here, and on a far greater scale and power. On a spiritual beast no less.
Huangpu Qingtian was completely floored, “Z-Zhuo Fan, t-that’s a Thunder Skylark?”
“In the flesh. The one I reared myself!” Zhuo Fan grinned, sponging off another’s achievements without even a twitch. He pointed at the lion and barked, “Qiao’er, put an end to that eyesore!”
Ding!
Its pair of eyes shone with bloodthirst as Qiao’er’s sharp claws glinted. With a flap of its lightning wings, it zoomed for Flaming Lion King like a thunder god.
All eyes were on Qiao’er.
The next moment, the entire sky flashed purple and people’s heart’s seized…

chapters.title: Chapter 297, Turning the Tide
chapters.content:
Chapter 297, Turning the Tide
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
Roar!
This time people found the shout a bit off. One could feel the haughtiness subside and even detect a hint of fear.
Flaming Lion King’s shaking body kept moving backwards as it stared at incoming purple lightning. Franticness touched its eyes and it started spitting fireballs and flapped its wings to keep the dreaded purple lightning at bay.
Fireballs dozens of meters big flew out accompanied by blazing tornadoes – anything to stop Qiao’er.
This power was enough to sunder earth and burn the sky. The six 5th level spiritual beasts had long since cowered away in fear.
The power of a 6th level spiritual beast!
However, Qiao’er was relentless. Lightning streaked its body as it slipped through the cracks in the flames, arriving five meters from the Flaming Lion King and coming face to face with a firestorm. Its eyes squinted and whirled. It charged through, with the purple lightning wrapped around it acting as a drill, piercing the flames and rendering them void.
Boom~
The struck fireballs exploded in a spectacular fashion. Flaming Lion King was beside itself in fear and the next thing it knew was its reflection in Qiao’er’s cold eyes!
Pff!
Qiao’er ran through Flaming Lion King’s chest before he could even think about dodging. Scarlet blood gushed from the hole like a flood. Flaming Lion King was watching its wound paralyzed.
It, a great 6th level spiritual beast, had actually found its end at the claws of a young Thunder Skylark, a 4th level spiritual beast, in one move!
Its eyes grew heavy, its body colder, evident from the flickering flames over its body. Flaming Lion King felt itself slipping into the dark abyss. Yet it still wanted to go on.
However, the hole in his chest was too great and he soon found his sight go black before collapsing…
Sss~
Gasping, the crowd never saw it coming. A 4th level spiritual beast killing a 6th level spiritual beast? Ridiculous!
Zhuo Fan was just as shocked.
Qiao’er had exceeded his expectations. Especially that killing blow. The average Thunder Skylark didn’t have such skills.
Thunder Skylark was a mild 6th level spiritual beast. It only knew to use its lightning to cover its body in defense, but never to focus it into an attacking skill.
This was where Qiao’er differed from the norm. It used the 4th Heaven purple lightning and even comprehended two skills, one for defense and another for attack. It was uncontested proof of its sentience.
Other spirit animals, like Flaming Lion King, were trained in skills by humans, while Qiao’er picked them up by itself. The difference was obvious, like comparing heaven and earth.
And what did it mean if a spiritual beast gained sentience?
The chance to evolve into a sacred beast!
This had never happened among spiritual beasts, nor the appearance of someone like Qiao’er either. A never before seen spiritual beast born from purple lightning!
Zhuo Fan did not yet know where the purple lightning came from. He was still debating if the Heavenly Emperor created it or obtained it somehow.
But one thing he did know was, purple lightning wasn’t just sparkles to instill such fear into even the likes of sacred beasts. Qiao’er had bathed in this almighty power and had a high chance of evolving.
The last thought really got his blood flowing. [Am I going to have a sacred beast spirit animal?!]
While he was in his own little world, the others were dazed – the six 5th level spiritual beasts included. They all looked wide eyed at the purple figure.
Who knew a 4th level spiritual beast ever had it in him to kill a 6th level spiritual beast? Surely not them. Not to mention it was overkill how it happened.
[T-this is insane! Illogical, absurd!] It went beyond human and beast comprehension alike, neither side was capable of staring truth in the face.
Huangpu Qingtian was the prime example. Seeing his strongest spirit animal killed like nothing, it had messed up the mind of this poor king. [What the hell is that thing?]
Everyone was so out of it and looking at the slight figure in the air until…
Shriek~
Qiao’er flapped its wings celebrating its conquest. The cry pierced through the people’s haze but the fear still lingered.
[The little guy is Zhuo Fan’s equivalent in the spiritual beast world. A monster!]
[Sigh, like master like pet.]
The people lamented, watching the purple figure in envy.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shined, “Qiao’er, clear a path for them to break free!”
The crowd was in complete shock.
While only You Yushan’s side was panicking. [That thing is stronger than a 6th level spiritual beast.] Clearing a path meant going through them.
Chu Qingcheng’s side was jubilant and Zhuo Fan’s image grew in their hearts.
[That’s our Zhuo Fan. He always pulls through for us!]
Shriek~
Qiao’er complied with his order and dived. He began by peppering the three 5th level spiritual beasts with purple lightning.
Boom~
The lightning smashed down like hail, forcing the spiritual beasts to scatter to and fro in fear.
[Where did this freak come from? And why is this abnormality set on us?]
You Yushan’s side was nervous. It wouldn’t be long before their beasts would be bombarded to pieces. All the crying in the world wouldn’t bring them back then!
Robbed of any choice, in fear and anxiety, You Yushan’s side recalled their spiritual beasts. As long as Qiao’er was looming overhead, no one dared take their spirit animal out ever again.
Having lost its targets, Qiao’er flew around unhinged, releasing purple lighting like a veritable thunderstorm and killing all in its path.
Cries of horror pierced the sky and the ears of You Yushan and his two allies as they scattered for cover and their lives. Who the hell had the time to keep Chu Qingcheng in a deadlock?
Luo Yunhai soon found their path cleared and just strutted out like the enemy wasn’t even there.
Quite understandable when the same enemy was now screaming and running for their lives.
The eyes on Qiao’er were that of awe, shock and fear. Looking at it dominating the battlefield with its power and valor left them sighing.
[If Zhuo Fan’s spirit animal could turn the tides so easily, why didn’t he take it out from the start?]
How were they supposed to know Zhuo Fan had no clue of Qiao’er’s true might. You’d think he’d keep it stashed away instead of showing off otherwise?
Xie Tianyang looked lost, his face stiff, “Ning’er, do you still find the bird pitiful?”
With a veritable symphony of screams and wails gracing her ears, Xue Ningxiang went beet red as she said, “Uh, no, but the men facing it sure are.”
“Everything that Zhuo Fan throws out is insane. Not even his pet is normal!” Xie Tianyang sighed.
Just how did he do it? How the hell did he raise such a monstrous spiritual beast?
“Enough chatter! We need to get out of here first!” Chu Qingcheng snapped, then gave a nod to Luo Yunhai who signaled, “Charge!”
With Qiao’er providing cover fire, they breezed through the enemy lines. No one wanted to stop them either, not unless they wanted to be left smoking and sizzling after a bath of purple lightning.
Huangpu Qingtian stared wide-eyed at the escaping prey and raved, “A bunch of useless mongrels dare foil my plans? You have another thing coming!”
“Ha-ha-ha, what if you include me?”
Whoosh!
Zhuo Fan popped up before him and kicked his face. Huangpu Qingtian mocked, “Humph, you think you can stop me? The only reason you’ve lived so far is because I was toying with you! You truly believe me to be this weak?”
Huangpu Qingtian’s punch this time left the impression of a rock fifty meters tall crashing down on Zhou Fan.
Bam!
Yet when the two attacks clashed, Zhuo Fan’s leg flickered purple. A boom resounded as Huangpu Qingtian felt an incredible force stagger him.
Followed closely by Zhuo Fan’s evil grin, “Ha-ha-ha, who wasn’t?”
Boom!
Huangpu Qingtian was forced back five steps. Zhuo Fan didn’t let him recover and punched this time, his hand wrapped in purple lightning.
“Young master Huangpu, we’re the same, you and I. None of us will use our aces until the last moment.”
Squinting, Zhuo Fan’s smirk widened and he hammered Huangpu Qingtian’s chest.
Huangpu Qingtian rushed his hand to defend.
Boom!
Another powerful blast revealed purple lightning streaking across the ground, now disintegrated in a thousand meters range. His punch was not one bit less than Huangpu Qingtian’s earlier strike…

chapters.title: Chapter 298, All’s Within My Grasp
chapters.content:
Chapter 298, All’s Within My Grasp
As dust billowed, the boom traveled a thousand miles.
You Yushan’s side couldn’t pierce the veil of dust and were beside themselves with shock. Who knew Zhuo Fan was capable of such power? So much so that it almost overwhelmed Huangpu Qingtian!
The worry was prevalent in all, but none ventured forth to clarify it. They were too afraid to interfere between Soaring Demonic Dragon and Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord’s deathmatch.
When the dust settled all they saw was a mess. When they double checked the two were nowhere in sight, they scrunched up the little courage they had and investigated the disaster.
But the sudden explosion scared them back. Looking at the source, they found Huangpu Qingtian shooting from the ground, wretched and dirty.
He may look unseemingly, but there was no apparent wound on him.
The shock was palpable at Huangpu Qingtian’s state. Taking into account the force behind that fist yet him coming out unharmed in the least, surged them with joy and admiration.
“Eldest young master, you’re ok!” You Yushan’s gang dashed over.
Taking a deep breath, Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes glinted coldly, but he wasn’t looking at them, “Where’s Zhuo Fan?”
“Uh…”
The three were confused, until You Yushan came forth with a bow, “Eldest young master, Zhuo Fan’s punch unleashed a cloud of smoke. Once the dust finally settled we only saw the eldest young master appear. We saw no trace of him. I suspect he has already fled.”
Brow shuddering, Huangpu Qingtian spread his Discerning Field for a more precise investigation. Certain that Zhuo Fan was gone, he said, “And Chu Qingcheng’s group?”
Blushing, the three hanged their heads, “Forgive us, eldest young master! W-we let them escape!”
Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes flashed icily.
Reeling, the three broke out in sweat.
They wished for Huangpu Qingtian’s cursing so badly right now. At least it would vent some of his anger. Anything was better than this eerie silence. The fear of not knowing his thinking was only mounting.
One day Huangpu Qingtian may very well be so angry as to strike them down!
The three shuddered in horror, trying to scour for a gesture, anything that betrayed his state of mind.
Huangpu Qingtian kept silent for a long time before finally smiling, “Let them run. It won’t change anything.”
The three were stunned, having never seen Huangpu Qingtian like this and didn’t know how to react.
[Wait, is this the same cold-blooded eldest young master? Not only did his scheme come apart at the seams, but he also lost a Brimming Sacred Pill and a 6th level spirit animal. No to mention he invested so much effort in this plan too, but even after gaining nothing from it, he isn’t flying into a rage?]
[Am I dreaming?]
[Did he flip?]
Baffled by the sudden turn of events, they looked on at him in bewilderment. Like he was a different man.
Easily picking up on their thoughts, Huangpu Qingtian showed a vague smile, “Don’t forget our mission in this battle!”
“How can we? It’s the position as head of the seven houses!” Lin Xuanfeng let it slip.
Having nothing but scorn for the man, Huangpu Qingtian shook his head, “Regent Estate has been the head for a thousand years and not because of this child’s play, but by raw power! We don’t need this insipid game to prove anything. Not now, not ever!”
Huangpu Qingtian instilled fear in each one of them with his declaration.
[That’s the Regent Estate we know, unchanged for a thousand years.]
“Is it for… Brimming Sacred Pills then?” You Yushan ventured.
Grinning, Huangpu Qingtian shook his head again, “Brimming Sacred Pill is a rare 8th grade pill that even the Regent Estate covets. However, that is hardly our goal!”
“Then please enlighten us, eldest young master!” Yan Bangui bowed.
Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes burst with coldness as he clenched his crackling fist, “Zhuo Fan!”
[What?!]
The crowd was in complete shock.
Sure, Zhuo Fan was like a disease, but the Esoteric Debate was held once a century to settle the power struggle between the clans. Yet he was saying that Regent Estate only joined because of one man?
[Aren’t you overthinking things?]
His cold eyes swept the crowd, lingering longer on his three allies, then Huangpu Qingtian clarified their doubts, “Do you believe Zhuo Fan and Esoteric Debate to be two separate matters?”
Despite everyone avoiding his powerful and steady gaze, there were nods.
“Humph, ignorants!”
Huangpu Qingtian mocked, “Fools! You have that wretched mentality that says he is only a talented cultivator, that you will sooner or later put him down with the power of your houses. What if I tell you that as long as he’s around, Luo clan will stand abreast the seven houses in ten years, surpass us in twenty, and in thirty, it will be the strongest clan in Tianyu that not even all seven houses together can oppose! Will you still think this Esoteric Debate to be nothing but a boring game?”
[This can’t be…]
This was too much to bear. You Yushan was even denying it as he second-guessed Huangpu Qingtian’s words, “Eldest young master, aren’t you exaggerating? The legacy of the seven houses is a thousand years old. He won’t reach our level in a century, not to mention decades!”
“Humph, exaggerate? Ha-ha-ha, if it was me saying that, your reaction would be inexcusable, albeit understandable. However… ”
The crowd was hanging on every one of his words.
Huangpu Qingtian snickered, “What if it came from Sir Leng? Would you doubt the words of a cunning man with ineffable plans like the Unwonted Contriver?”
“What? Leng Wuchang said that?”
They just got the shock of their lives. For even Leng Wuchang to say that, it meant the prediction had to be true!
They just couldn’t wrap their head around how Zhuo Fan being a monster gifted with such godlike skills.
Huangpu Qingtian smiled at their skepticism, “Sir Leng said he is of incredible talent, equal to Zhuge Changfeng. He only needs to grasp power and he will soar beyond anyone’s reach. That is why we need to clip his wings before he can fully spread them. Or the seven houses will soon be no more. Shame Drifting Flowers Edifices, Veiled Dragon Pavilion and Sword Marquise Abode are too blind to see it. They are playing with fire standing behind him and will find one day robbed of everything!
“But the Luo clan is under the imperial family’s protection, and they have Dugu Zhantian for support. We are without means to strike him down in any other circumstances. The only way to eradicate him is to do it within the bounds of the Esoteric Debate!”
Huangpu Qingtian turned his bloodthirsty eyes to them, “That is why our main mission in the Esoteric Debate is to get Zhuo Fan’s head. Everything else is secondary!”
The others turned grave, realizing Huangpu Qingtian had finally revealed Regent Estate’s real objective for the Esoteric Debate.
But this was nigh impossible to achieve. Harder than gathering the Brimming Sacred Pills and facing spiritual beasts.
After witnessing Zhuo Fan’s mystical abilities, they came to realize that he was unrivaled beneath the Radiant Stage.
Even the Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord, the strongest of Six Dragons and One Phoenix, had allegedly barely overpowered him. But when they thought about ignoring him, that was an absolute no.
[Or Huangpu Qingtian would’ve turned him into a bloody damn smear by now! Why waste so much time explaining it to us?]
“Uh, eldest young master, how are we to go about purging Zhuo Fan? Our best chance was when we had everyone cornered and Zhuo Fan was forced to stay. But now they will be on guard and make it even harder!” You Yushan sighed.
Grinning, Huangpu Qingtian said, “That was our best chance? Ha-ha-ha, merely bait. The punk has bit on it and all that is left is to wait for the poison to take its effect.”
Everyone was clueless.
Ignoring them, Huangpu Qingtian turned towards where Chu Qingcheng’s group was last seen, “Ha-ha-ha, they thought they’d escaped when in fact they fell right for it! Not even the cunning Zhuo Fan has hope of breaking out of Sir Leng’s personally designed master plan. Relax, all’s within my grasp… “
The others shuddered, clueless as to what got into him.
And since Sir Leng intervened himself, then this should be a done deal. Sir Leng was hailed as the number one schemer, with a zero fail rate.
The shadow tailing them was startled, [I’ve heard of Tianyu’s Unwonted Contriver, but never imagined he will lower himself to deal with a junior. Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord is talented and powerful, but now he even has Leng Wuchang behind him. Zhuo Fan, you are up against peak experts in both brawn and brains.]
“If you fail, it’s only fair I discard you. But if you win… you just became a hot commodity, he-he-he…”

chapters.title: Chapter 299, Array Map
chapters.content:
Chapter 299, Array Map
Rustle~
A shadow streaked the sky, flashing in and out of view every mile.
When he finally stopped, he had crossed tens of miles, listening to the ruckus a few miles out. He just gave a nod, more to himself, and was gone again.
The final appearance was in the middle of the group.
“Who?” Xie Tianshang shouted, sword at the ready. He saw everyone look on with joy, “Oh, you’re finally back.”
“Yeah, so what are you standing with your weapon drawn for? Put it away, will you.” Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes.
Xie Tianshang shook his head as he did just that, “Brother Zhuo is right. I wish to learn a lot from you in a spar, but it doesn’t seem appropriate to do it in the middle of a crisis.”
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched.
[That’s a martial fanatic for you. His mind is ever skewed in thinking fighting came first. At least he isn’t a lost cause and a complete battle maniac, yet.]
Zhuo Fan’s return was met with jubilation all around. As if he had become the true winner of that little skirmish back there. Even the vassals forgot about their true masters and they looked up at him in reverence.
It was only a matter of time. With the three houses now willing to follow Zhuo Fan’s every word, it was obvious who the little clans would choose.
Zhuo Fan’s earlier turning point was the crux. If not for his timely help in clearing a path, they would’ve been mowed down.
They had witnessed it themselves. It was no wonder he was hailed as a savior. Zhuo Fan’s image soared in their minds…
“Zhuo Fan, are you hurt?” Chu Qingcheng came over. She saw the light scratches and spoke softly. Her face was calm, but the eyes spoke volumes of the deep care and worry she had for him.
Zhuo Fan brushed it off and switched topics, “It’s fine. But Huangpu Qingtian isn’t a pushover… Oh, what of Ning’er and my spirit animal?”
Chu Qingcheng dimmed, knowing he didn’t want to talk about it. She was so aggrieved for not being able to make sense of his thinking.
Dong Tianba graced her with a thorough analysis of Zhuo Fan’s heart’s ranking, but it was just that, guesswork. In the end, only Zhuo Fan knew what he was thinking.
And this got Chu Qingcheng vexed the most. Any woman wished to know if the one they love thought about her the most. Then there’s Zhuo Fan, who was always so vague and dodgy that no one could get a single clue what went on in that big brain of his…
“Brother Zhuo, your spirit animal is so fierce none of us dare even approach. What is even stranger, it seems to have taken a particular liking to young miss Xue and second young master Xie. Look for yourself!” Long Xingyun smiled and pointed above.
Zhuo Fan was dumbstruck.
He saw a purple lightning drifting through the clouds. And on Qiao’er’s back was a man and woman having a blast. Who else but Xue Ningxiang and Xie Tianyang?
Zhuo Fan felt depressed at their entertainment. [A Thunder Skylark is a high level spiritual beast, so what is it doing getting so attached to strangers?]
But then it dawned on him.
Xue Ningxiang and Xie Tianyang wore Thunder Rings he refined from Qiao’er’s mother. They held its mother’s scent.
Such an outcome was obvious.
Shaking his head, Zhuo Fan sighed, “Fate, I guess.”
That threw the others off. Qiao’er noticed Zhuo Fan and chirped cheerfully. Seeing where they were flying, Xue Ningxiang waved, “Big brother Zhuo, welcome back!”
Only Xie Tianyang’s mood sank. [Here comes the third wheel…]
Smiling, Zhuo Fan gestured for Qiao’er to come next to him. Xue Ningxiang jumped off the bird and skipped over with rosy cheeks and a sweet smile, “Big brother Zhuo, i-is it the same Thunder Skylark young we found in Allbeast Mountain Range?”
“Yeah. I got it to hatch.” Zhuo Fan ruffled her hair.
Xue Ningxiang bobbed her head and treated Qiao’er as seeing an old friend, “How adorable, just like its mother!”
Her words set the crowd off in a round of twitching. Zhuo Fan wasn’t exempt.
If there was anyone among them who’d call Qiao’er adorable, then that would be the ever naive Xue Ningxiang. They recalled with dread how Qiao’er flew in a circle once and blasted experts to smithereens. [How in hell is that adorable?]
They all went silent, having no clue how to break it.
Shriek~
Qiao’er’s sharp cry and piercing eyes raised everyone from their stupor to demand, [You dare say I’m not? Go on, make my day…]
Shivering, they all bobbed their heads, completing the image with a bright smile and a soaked back. Having got its wish, Qiao’er chirped and gave Xue Ningxiang a smile.
Zhuo Fan shook his head at how fast the beast and girl had hit it off. [Is Qiao’er taking Ning’er as its mother?]
Zhuo Fan’s cheeks went ablaze as his mind spun. He was Qiao’er’s dad and Ning’er its mom. Then he and Ning’er…
“Oi, Zhuo Fan, how the hell have you been raising it? It’s no less monster than you are. Mind… giving it to me?” Xie Tianyang showed his greedy side.
That caught Xie Tianshang’s attention, looking at Zhuo Fan expectantly.
