Even before it landed, the ground caved a hundred meters. Zhuo Fan merely stood there, taking the pressure like it was nothing.
You Yushan’s group had been worried for Huangpu Qingtian, but they now cheered.
“It’s the earth ranked martial art, Nine Dragons Diamond Body! Ha-ha-ha, the punk is dead for sure!” You Yushan laughed.
Yan Bangui’s face split into a grin, “If not for that fancy art he used before, the punk would’ve been dead for ages. Now he is trapped in an array and won’t escape no matter what trick he pulls!”
The rest of the survivors nodded thrilled. They could practically see Zhuo Fan’s head rolling. The dragons’ clash was about to reach its end and everyone was excited to see it happen.
Chu Qingcheng was more worried than ever. Huangpu Qingtian’s earth ranked martial art wasn’t something one could just take head on. Zhuo Fan had bolstered his power, but in his wounded state, she feared he wouldn’t be able to take it.
Everyone watched nerve-wrecked for Zhuo Fan’s fate to end.
“Ha-ha-ha, die you prat!” Huangpu Qingtian cackled, his claw landing on Zhuo Fan’s head.
The hearts of everyone stopped for a second.
Only Zhuo Fan stood calm, unaffected by the pressure. But when the claw was on top of him, his fist tightened, purple lightning gathered and struck.
Bam!
The fist and claw met, releasing a terrible sound, but just as they touched, Huangpu Qingtian’s claw was flung away.
Zhuo Fan’s purple lightning powered fist astonishingly smashed the man’s face.
Pff!
Huangpu Qingtian was flung into the sky, blood trailing behind him from his nose. Zhuo Fan was still calmly standing in the same spot, his fist held high.
The yapping around instantly grew to a halt and the people looked at the imposing figure in fear.
[Dude, that’s an earth ranked martial art, you know? Personally delivered by Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord. Aren’t you perhaps just a little bit condescending flicking it away with a meager fist?]
Everyone gulped, unnerved. They wrote Zhuo Fan off at first, thinking the earth ranked martial art had rooted him in place. But now they knew he was looking down on it.
[Too strong!]
Xie Tianyang’s blood was boiling with excitement, [Seeing the two dragons fight, my life was worth it...]
Tuning out the senseless chatter, Zhuo Fan looked at the man he had sent flying hovering in the air. His eyes glinted and he jumped.
In but an instant, he was upon Huangpu Qingtian.
Huangpu Qingtian was startled. He didn’t get to feel the extent of his wounds as Zhuo Fan came with a kick in the gut.
The blow was so fierce and brutal that even if he wasn’t heavily injured before, he was now puking his guts and blood from the pain.
Whoosh!
A flash of light smashed towards You Yushan and the other two.
The trio was taken in by Zhuo Fan’s ridiculous power display, but seeing Huangpu Qingtian come crashing down, they panicked, “Take cover!”
Every man for himself. Nobody wanted to get anywhere near this battle.
Not that they had the time.
Boom!
Huangpu Qingtian slammed into the ground, picking up dust and releasing a devastating shockwave. It blew apart four hundred hapless people too slow to get away. The ground was now littered with pieces of them.
You Yushan’s trio watched from the air and gulped in fear. Why did they get the feeling that this plan to do Zhuo Fan in was in fact digging their own graves?
[Forget about that fiend, look at us! Our side is about to collapse.] Even their strongest, Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord, was getting his ass handed to him.
Looking into the distance, Zhuo Fan’s cold and aloof image was that of a thunder god. You Yushan’s trio’s courage faltered, [Damn it all to hell! How do you beat that...]

chapters.title: Chapter 318, Dragon Vein Soul
chapters.content:
Chapter 318, Dragon Vein Soul
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
Hu~
The fierce wind picked up the dust and blocked everyone’s sight.
When it settled, they witnessed a bloodbath, dismembered bodies and mangled limbs. The four houses’ vassals participating in this ambush numbered ten thousand, yet now less than a tenth remained.
Even then, the lucky survivors were traumatized, running all over the place in fear, trying anything as long as it got them away from this hell. A shame there was no way out, not unless the 365 Profound Heaven experts opened the Microcosmic Orbit Array.
With a bang, Huangpu Qingtian jumped out of the rubble, face bloody and enraged. Zhuo Fan was so heavy handed that he had caved in the man’s nose.
People all around sighed.
They had never seen the grand Regent Estate’s eldest young master beaten to such an extent, to the point he couldn’t muster an ounce of strength to fight back. It was unprecedented.
Everyone turned to Zhuo Fan in fear.
Perhaps only Soaring Demonic Dragon was capable of doing so much damage. Their dread only rose.
Those geniuses from the seven houses had it worse. Ever since Zhuo Fan showed up, all he ever did was bash these arrogant young masters and misses.
They accepted Huangpu Qingtian being the strongest, since he was from Regent Estate and all, the head of the houses. He was a monster through and through.
While Zhuo Fan, well, the guy came from a third rate clan! Yet he was the one who trampled all standards and obstacles with his power. It was the greatest form of ridicule.
Long Jie and Long Kui were the most bitter.
The first time they met him, they recognized Zhuo Fan’s talent but looked down on his status. Regardless of how godsent one’s talent was, without a house behind him, he would never surpass them.
Yet now, Zhuo Fan created miracles wherever he went. His current project involved brutalizing the strongest genius of the seven houses, Huangpu Qingtian. His display gave each of them a resounding slap to the face informing them who was the real hero here!
Huff~
Panting, Zhuo Fan’s eyes steeled. He looked invincible in the eyes of others, but he knew himself best. Releasing all that purple lightning ate away at his body and he was now seriously hurt. It was highly likely that he was going to collapse before he finished Huangpu Qingtian off.
“Eldest young master!”
You Yushan’s trio went to their master and helped him up. Seeing his disfigured face, they cried, “Eldest young master, the punk’s power is out of this world. We have to fall back. He will kill us all at this rate!”
“Bullshit!”
Flinging his arm to make his way through the trio, Huangpu Qingtian’s rage grew stronger, “As long as I’m here, failure is impossible! I’ve never known defeat in my entire life!”
The three felt conflicted and their faces fell. All they could do was shake their heads at the pigheaded Huangpu Qingtian.
[Dude, take a good look at yourself and don’t force the issue. So what if you always won? You are losing now, when it mattered. What else can you do when even the earth ranked martial art has failed?]
[That punk is a monster among freakin’ monsters! How is he so powerful?]
Of course, they knew to keep their thoughts to themselves, lest they poke Huangpu Qingtian’s ego and end up a smear on the ground along with the countless others. One thing was certain though, the man’s imposing air was gone.
Zhuo Fan was too strong for them to cope with...
Taking a deep breath to calm down somewhat, Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes pondered. Then he came to a decision as he muttered, “No choice but to use that.”
“You still have a way, eldest young master?” The trio asked in unison.
Huangpu Qingtian hesitated for a second, but the sight of the proud maniac who had reduced him to such a low state steeled his decision as he spoke defiantly, “I am invincible, no one can beat me. And you are no different!”
Huangpu Qingtian released a sound that shook the world. A golden dragon image flew out of his body and circled above him.
You Yushan’s trio cried out, “W-what is that thing?”
Long Xingyun cried out, “T-this thing again? What is Huangpu Qingtian growing within himself?”
He recalled perfectly how twice they had trapped Huangpu Qingtian, but this damn golden dragon ruined all their attempts.
They took it for a martial art, but after careful inspection they found it to be something else.
Fang Qiubai felt it was oddly familiar.
He saw Huangpu Qingtian use it earlier when dealing with Chu Qingcheng’s trio, but that was in defense and it had only appeared for a brief second. Even he took it for a martial art.
But seeing it circling above, like a real dragon, he began to pick up on the clues.
“Damn that bastard! Is he out of his mind bringing it out for everyone to see?” Huangpu Tianyuan clenched his fists and raved.
Regent Estate’s elders were wiping their brows, looking around in fear of being overheard.
Sighing, Leng Wuchang shook his head, “He won’t be able to kill that freak otherwise. I only hope it’s appearance after a thousand years won’t have anyone here capable of recognizing it.”
The other Regent Estate clansmen nodded and rejoiced inside.
Not for long though, as Zhuo Fan’s cold voice echoed in everyone’s ears.
“Dragon Vein Soul?” Frowning, Zhuo Fan turned grave.
Huangpu Qingtian’s face twitched and he cursed inside. [Damn rotten punk, you actually recognize this thousand year old relic?]
Regent Estate’s elders almost spat blood. They wished nothing more than to get in there and kill him on the spot.
[Blast it! How did a twerp like you find out about it? This is ridiculous!]
That was all Fang Qiubai needed as he slapped his head. He and Dugu Zhantian shared a shocked look and barked, “Huangpu Tianyuan, your insolence knows no bounds. The imperial family ordered you to protect Caged Dragon City yet you secretly took out the Dragon Vein Soul from the imperial family’s Dragon Vein. Are you planning on revolting?”
The people panicked. They had never seen Jade Flute Divine Sword so outraged.
The words Dragon Vein Soul had landed on deaf ears for many small clans, even a few first rate ones.
As for the leaders of the six houses, they paled and turned to Regent Estate in mute shock.
Others next to them had no clue how dreadful the Dragon Vein Soul was, but being from the elite houses, they understood its importance. And that was what gave them the biggest shock.
Regent Estate had the nerve to move a Dragon Vein Soul!
Sweating buckets, Huangpu Tianyuan’s heart was in his throat.
Dragon Vein Soul was the imperial family’s lifeline. It nurtured and brought prosperity to the Tianyu Empire, it was of national importance. Moving the Dragon Vein would bring about a huge change in the world. Even the third pillar, Parish’s high priests, said those wielding the Dragon Vein held the fate of the land in their hands. This was why the Regent Estate was tasked with defending it.
First because the Regent Estate and Tianyu’s imperial family were related, worthy of trust. Secondly, only the seven houses had the power to defend it and prevent any riots appearing from vying over it.
But Huangpu Qingtian took it out before the whole crowd. That was the same as declaring the Regent Estate planned on using it for themselves replacing the imperial family!
This was a clear act of treason and Divine Dragon Fang Qiubai had the right to destroy them where they stood.
Regent Estate had yet to unite the seven houses and their power wasn’t yet up to the challenge of facing the imperial family. If a war broke out, the Regent Estate was done for.
Huangpu Tianyuan gnashed his teeth. [Damn bastard! You’re so blind to see the real picture and yet you want to steal my position? How can you condemn the entire house over your disgrace?]
[Even if you lost against that freak, that still doesn’t give you the right to release the Dragon Vein Soul!]
Regent Estate’s elders were on pins and needles. Huangpu Tianyuan took a deep breath and was about to bullshit his way out of this but didn’t get the chance.
Leng Wuchang spoke calmly, “Sir Fang, you are wrong. The Dragon Vein Soul is the foundation of our nation, but this does not, by any means, prove we wish to rebel. We are only following our duties based on His Majesty’s decree.”
“Did His Majesty tell you to take out the dragon soul for your own selfish use?” Fang Qiubai spat, “Humph, Sir Leng, I know your mind is sharp and cunning, but you better give me a damn good reason why I shouldn’t decorate Dragon Cloud City with your heads!”
There was widespread shock, with those in the dark of the importance of Dragon Vein Soul even more so.
The mighty Divine Dragon was going to slaughter the Regent Estate? Was the emperor going to fight the seven houses and plunge the nation into turmoil?
Regent Estate’s elders felt weak in their knees. Only Leng Wuchang was the picture of calmness...

chapters.title: Chapter 319, Demagogue
chapters.content:
Chapter 319, Demagogue
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
Leng Wuchang twirled his beard as his eyes swept the crowd, ultimately stopping at Fang Qiubai, “Sir Fang, do you know what Regent Estate’s duty is at Caged Dragon City?”
“To protect the Dragon Vein!” Fang Qiubai gave a flat reply.
Smiling, Leng Wuchang sneered, “Do you know why we guard it then? Out of fear of being stolen perhaps?”
Fang Qiubai stared back at him in silence.
Zhuge Changfeng smiled, “Tianyu’s nine dragons Dragon Vein was sealed in Caged Dragon City by the first High Priest himself, for the future of the empire and posterity. But the dragons within the Dragon Vein are a relentless force and once they break the seal they would unleash endless death and destruction. The people would suffer and chaos would thrive. That is why Regent Estate was tasked with defending it. Rather than say it was to guard against greedy people, it was more in line to stop the Dragon Vein’s collapse and ensuing devastation.”
“The Prime Minister is precisely right.”
Leng Wuchang gave Zhuge Changfeng a half bow then turned to Fang Qiubai, “The dragon vein is tyrannical. Only Tianyu’s Great Ancestor could make one of the dragon souls accept him. After the Great Ancestor’s death, none could make them submit, ultimately getting sealed in Caged Dragon City. Over the course of the millennium, there were many lusting for its power, but were devoured instead. Sir Fang stated that we have taken it out for our private use, which is absolutely ludicrous. If we were to give it to Sir Fang, would you accept it? In your capacity as a Divine Dragon, the peak of Tianyu’s power, how confident are you of success? If not even sir dares, how could we?”
Anger rose within Fang Qiubai, but he remained silent.
The Dragon Vein Soul was a heaven and earth spiritual being that chose its master. Anyone that tried to claim it instead, would find a swift and cruel ending, devoured whole.
In other words, the Regent Estate had no reason to take it out. And yet...
Glancing at the dragon soul next to Huangpu Qingtian, Fang Qiubai’s eyes glinted, “Then, Sir Leng, explain to me why your dear eldest young master is currently in possession of it.”
Squinting, Leng Wuchang peaked at the National Elemental Stone then smiled, “What’s to explain? The dragon soul has chosen its master. Isn’t it obvious?”
“You...” Fang Qiubai clenched his fists, boring holes into Leng Wuchang with his glare.
Leng Wuchang’s smile never faltered, “Regent Estate has always had peaceful and righteous people, facing any difficulties by ourselves, not willing to let the world see our suffering. But since Sir Fang insists on knowing, I will oblige you with explanation as to dispel any further misunderstandings.”
Leng Wuchang let out a pained sigh, “It all began two dozen years ago with Nine Dragon’s insurrection. Our Venerables were unable to stop them, suffering heavy casualties. But we were blessed with an eldest young master that had outstanding talent. The dragon soul chose him as its master, sparing the world of its ire. Later we realized that it was impossible to seal it back again, and since it was calmly staying within the eldest young master, we simply let it be. If we forced it back into the seal, we feared the other eight dragon souls would use this chance to escape as well and that would spell doom for Tianyu.”
Leng Wuchang’s speech was heartrending, subtly shifting the blame on the dragon soul’s escape. He even embellished with the Regent Estate suffering heavy casualties in an attempt to stop it. Thus, in a wonderful and convoluted way, he turned their treason into martyrdom.
They had ‘sacrificed’ so much to keep the Dragon Vein sealed, it would do them heavy injustice if the emperor would strike them in response.
Fang Qiubai gnashed his teeth, [What Dragon Vein insurrection? Am I to take your word for it? Who else but you know what the hell truly happened back then? You can say whatever you like at this point.]
It was because of this that the Regent Estate stuck to their statement ‘it’s all the dragon soul’s fault’. That they always only had the empire’s safety at heart, but ended up unable to seal it back. Fang Qiubai couldn’t do shit to them now.
If the Regent Estate was wiped out regardless, they would incur the wrath of the common people. And no one ever wanted to take responsibility for a possible civil war, now did they?
Fang Qiubai took a deep breath, “Why weren’t we informed?”
“Informed?” Leng Wuchang sneered and sighed, “Sir Fang, as a court official couldn’t you tell? It would invite suspicion and who knew how twisted the truth would become? The circumstances today had forced me to reveal it to Sir Fang. We hoped to have endured this disaster in silence, and only mourn our heavy losses in our hearts. We’d rather brave through the pain and torment than receive suspicion and undue disrespect for what was only expected of us.”
Pff!
Zhuge Changfeng slipped a giggle and shook his head.
Leng Wuchang was a true wordsmith. He showed they were ever devoted, bearing through any pain, while also cursing the emperor on the sly for casting suspicion on its loyal subjects.
Harming them now would make the imperial family the bad guy here and criticized for harming their patriots. It would ultimately end with the imperial family losing the people’s favor.
And that wasn’t even half of it. Leng Wuchang twisted it all up by saying that the dragon soul broke the seal and accepted Huangpu Qingtian as its master.
That was the same as saying he truly was godsent as the world’s rightful king.
With the only man in Tianyu’s history capable of having a dragon soul being none other than Tianyu’s first emperor, that lifted Huangpu Qingtian to the same status. What further proof was needed?
It also worked to plant the seed in the hearts of the people that the Huangpu clan of Regent Estate would replace Tianyu’s Yuwen clan in ruling the empire.
But with Leng Wuchang not stating it, Fang Qiubai couldn’t exactly point it out either. His only choice was to seethe in silence.
Regent Estate elders’ worry was now replaced with full blown conceit, arrogance, being stuck up... the usual.
“Sir Leng is a true demagogue.” Fang Qiubai snorted.
Leng Wuchang raised his head and waved, “You give me too much credit. I am only stating the facts, ha-ha-ha...”
Fang Qiubai faltered and turned to look at the arrogant figure within the National Elemental Stone with killing intent.
Leng Wuchang may have preached all he wanted, but Huangpu Qingtian’s death was guaranteed in his eyes!
The third pillar’s prophecy had never been wrong. The one to have the Dao Dragon would have the world. [Since the brat has a dragon soul then he might obtain the whole Dragon Vein. That will spell the end of Tianyu’s imperial family.]
He noticed how the eyes of the rest changed when they looked at Huangpu Qingtian. They may even be hailing him as their rightful king, a bad sign indeed.
Only Luo Yunchang and the rest stared at the National Elemental Stone with worry.
Huangpu Qingtian had the dragon soul’s help, providence as he said, by his side. Zhuo Fan may be stronger, but how was he going to defeat the king handpicked by fate? Huangpu Qingtian was under the dragon soul’s protection.
Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan stared at his opponent, knowing this as well. Just that he didn’t place two cents on some flimsy reason as providence or what not. Moreover, his Blood Infant wasn’t the least bit inferior to the Dragon Vein Soul.
Much better in fact. As Blood Infant had a far sharper mind. It was the symbol of a true king.
[With it roaming around Huangpu Qingtian and defending him, it’s going to make things hard.]
Pff!
Spitting blood, Zhuo Fan frowned as his heart sank. He had released too much purple lightning and his body couldn’t take it anymore. It was now or never.
Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth and charged, [All or nothing!]
“Oh? You dare come at me knowing full well what Dragon Vein Soul can do? Die then!”
Huangpu Qingtian saw Zhuo Fan ready for battle and shouted, “Not even father could subdue the dragon soul while I did it in my childhood! Do you know what that means? I am God’s gift to the world! You are not fighting me but fate, heaven itself! The only outcome you’ll have from it is death!”
Huangpu Qingtian spoke with such complete confidence, self-conceit and presence as if he was an emperor rebuking a peasant.
You Yushan’s trio by his side basked in the leftover pride, making full use of their connection. They were destined to be officials!
Those watching the National Elemental Stone sighed. With the dragon soul taken out, they had written Zhuo Fan off. Who could fight against heaven?
Zhuo Fan gave a snort instead, “No wonder those Blood Crocs listened to you. So that’s your spiel. Dragon Vein Soul is the lord over the earth that no one dares disobey. A king’s right indeed, providence even. Your point being?”
Purple lightning flickered all over Zhuo Fan as he gathered all his power and shouted, “I am Soaring Demonic Dragon. I will ascend the nine heavens if I have to. Don’t ever think your puny earth dragon king, a crownless dragon, can stand in my way!”
This painted shock on everyone’s faces. Providence declared through its agent, the Dragon Vein Soul, who was king. But Zhuo Fan wasn’t buying it. He would’ve disgraced his Soaring Demonic Dragon title if he did. He feared nothing, not even heaven!
Huangpu Qingtian shuddered, his eyes bloodshot.
He could accept the earlier defiance, but now he had displayed the Dragon Vein Soul’s approval and yet this ant still dared to look down on him? Huangpu Qingtian had long passed the limits of his patience.
From an early age he knew that he was the one destined to have the Dragon Vein, the royal throne offered to him on a silver platter. Every man, including his father, had to bow before him.
Zhuo Fan knew this and showed not an ounce of respect, enraging him further.
The one thing his entire pride relied on was looked down at with such scorn that it was a heavy blow to his self esteem. As if to say he was king above all, but always beneath Zhuo Fan!
His fist tightened and he roared, “Then I shall take heaven’s stead in eradicating the world of an ant daring to defy a king’s authority!”
Huangpu Qingtian clawed, “Nine Dragons Diamond Body, Earth Dragon Empowered Claw! “
As the dragon soul took flight the earth quaked and a surge of incredible might rose up from underground...

chapters.title: Chapter 320, Heaven-devouring Thunder Phoenix
chapters.content:
Chapter 320, Heaven-devouring Thunder Phoenix
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
Roar!
The dragon roar’s might buckled the world itself, followed shortly by the dragon soul ascending to the ninth heaven, then plunging back into the earth below.
The ground quaked and beast roars resounded. The terrible power came from the souls and worked its way up into the body of everyone, scaring them in body and mind.
Then a beast’s head came out of the ground and swallowed them whole.
Zhuo Fan frowned.
The Nine Dragons Diamond Body was an earth ranked martial art at its base and the Dragon Vein Soul was a lord of the land as well. With them combined, the martial art had its power doubled, truly capable of ripping the world asunder.
Zhuo Fan took a deep breath and the roaming purple lightning around him focused, ready for the final strike.
Rumble!
The earth literally exploded as the golden dragon three hundred meters long shot from underground, aiming for Zhuo Fan. Its fangs and claws bared, setting itself up to tear into heavens themselves if it had to.
Roar!
With another dragon roar, the dragon’s might descended. Reaching Zhuo Fan a thousand meters away. The man was shocked.
He had a guess it would be strong, but not this much. The dragon held enough power to write off any Radiant Stage expert on the spot.
Gu Santong and Divine Dragons not included.
The onlookers gasped, their very core shaking in fear. [How can a pre-Radiant Stage expert hold enough power to destroy everything?]
You Yushan’s trio were doing a victory dance as they laughed, “Such power! I knew the eldest young master was heaven’s greatest gift on earth! He is invincible beneath heaven! That punk can be all heaven-defying he wants but not even he can match up to the eldest young master!”
“Hear, hear, the punk is done for, ha-ha-ha...”
The trio were having the time of their lives with their early celebration. They had invested so much blood and sweat into this, lost so many men and now, it had finally paid off.
Only Chu Qingcheng and company were shaking at the mighty display. Worry gnawed at their conscience as tears fell down unabated.
Fang Qiubai’s eyes shrank and he sighed, “The Dragon Vein Soul is a true match for an earth ranked martial art. Such power makes the outcome obvious. Huangpu Qingtian truly is the first in his generation...”
The rest nodded as well. They turned in the direction the golden dragon was charging to see a man wrapped in purple lightning standing there with his back straight, his gaze hard. He was dauntless in the face of danger, earning no few sighs.
Zhuo Fan would’ve beaten Huangpu Qingtian if they were going by talent alone. But the sudden reveal of Dragon Vein Soul, of providence’s machinations, left all taking his demise with pity.
No mortal could defy heaven’s will...
The people were already lamenting, writing Zhuo Fan off as he was receiving the capital punishment for his transgression. Yet Zhuo Fan’s eyes never lost their light, his fighting spirit burned hot against adversity.
To him, the Dragon Vein Soul was a mere spirit born of this world, albeit a pretty strong one. Yet it had no damn relation with providence and the likes.
Even if true providence descended, [As long as I am the stronger one, let heaven make you a god in this world but it still won’t save you from me.]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes steeled and his hands made a sign.
“Ha-ha-ha, Zhuo Fan, heaven made me king, the new world order! You dare go against me and you shall die for defying heaven. You shall die just because I wish it. It is the will of heaven, your fate!” Huangpu Qingtian cackled, drunk on power and megalomania.
This nemesis that had defied him for so long would finally meet his end. Who wouldn’t be happy?
Zhuo Fan’s face was cold, his eyes flashing purple, his hands making the signs as he shouted, “Screw you! I alone decide my fate. The one to die is you!”
Zhuo Fan then roared.
“Wraith Style, 3rd move, Necro Dragon’s Screech!”
Roar!
An earth shaking dragon roar pierced the clouds and a pulse spread from Zhuo Fan’s mouth.
Huangpu Qingtian mocked, “A trifling profound ranked sound martial art? How can it stand up to my dragon soul and earth ranked martial art? Humph, I get it, you are on your last leg, the desperate attempt of a hopeless fool!”
“Humph, to deal with the Dragon Vein Soul, a soul based martial art is all I need. Not to mention, this isn’t your average sound martial art. You think you’re the only one who can boost a martial art?” Zhuo Fan’s grin turned sinister.
Huangpu Qingtian doubled back and before he could react, the damage was done.
Zhuo Fan’s roar moved slowly towards the golden dragon, only to explode a hundred meters from it.
When the sound dissipated, purple lighting surged in its wake, spreading like wildfire and taking the form of a hundred meter long purple lightning bird.
The purple lightning crackled in every direction, its power bearing down on the incoming golden dragon.
Huangpu Qingtian cried, “What is that?”
“Your doom!”
Zhuo Fan’s face split into a grin as he was reeling, about to collapse. This last move had him spent, but it still couldn’t wipe the savage smirk from his lips, “While you used your Dragon Soul to add to your martial art’s power, what stops me from infusing my entire purple lightning into the sound wave?”
Huangpu Qingtian’s face twitched, “How can purple lightning ever match my dragon soul? Dragon Vein Soul is a king’s symbol that no being in this world dares defy. Your purple lightning is nothing. It isn’t even conscious. Dragon Vein Soul, shred him!”
Roar!
Huangpu Qingtian’s words set the golden dragon into a frenzy, charging for Zhuo Fan. Its vicious face set to tear all who opposed it.
The earth ranked martial art topped with Dragon Vein Soul actually had a mind of its own, following Huangpu Qingtian’s order.
Zhuo Fan watched it all with a sneer.
[Purple lightning is beneath the dragon soul? Humph, ignorant fool!]
Zhuo Fan didn’t know where the purple lightning came from, but it had the potential to kill a sacred beast.
Not to mention, Zhuo Fan had added a little something to it, a trace of azure flame.
It wasn’t as overbearing as the purple lightning, but it had a spark of intelligence. Each time Zhuo Fan was in dire straits, the azure flame would come out and shield him from harm.
Zhuo Fan had done this so that the thunderbird would gain the azure flame’s awareness.
Zhuo Fan pointed, his bloodthirst exploding in his roar, “Kill him earth ranked martial art. Heaven-devouring Thunder Phoenix!”
Correct, an earth ranked martial art. With the purple lightning and a bit of azure flame, the profound ranked martial art was forcefully upgraded to a new rank.
The thunderbird cried out at his order, shooting forth.
Golden light erupted as the dragon roared and purple lightning scalded the heavens in an unbridled display of raw power.
The people below saw a dragon and a thunderbird clash in an apocalyptic explosion, ringing their ears.
And then it happened.
Under the thunderbird’s purple lightning explosion, the dragon began to crumble inch by inch as it dissolved into golden specks. With a cry of pain, the golden dragon soul left the huge dragon and fled for Huangpu Qingtian.
The purple thunder bird had scared the Dragon Vein Soul off!
[How is this possible?]
Huangpu Qingtian’s jaw hit the floor, his eyes bulged out. Others didn’t fare any better.
[Holy hell! Dragon Vein Soul, you’re supposed to be a lord of the land, its king. What are you doing getting scared of a silly flickering bird? Where has your rampant attitude gone? Your master had even bragged about you being his royal symbol!]
The scared Dragon Vein Soul’s reply to their thoughts would be a round of abuse.
[You know shit! I am the king of the land, but that thing is the king of the skies! What else am I to do but run?]
[Ignorant whelps! Stop spewing crap when you know nothing of the world’s inner workings. I am born of the earth, but that thing is born of the world! We are light years apart.]
Not that any side knew any of this of course. It was just that their minds were blown away seeing the Dragon Vein Soul running away with its tail between its legs. Their brains went out of commission.
[Dragon Vein Soul ain’t so tough after all.]
Fang Qiubai watched it all bleary-eyed. Then he frowned, then he shook his head, and lastly looked at Zhuo Fan astounded.
Dragon Vein Soul wasn’t weak, not by a long shot, it was the kid using a far deadlier attack.
Even Fang Qiubai started praising. [Just what are you, kid...]
With the Dragon Vein Soul abandoning ship, the three hundred meter long golden dragon turned into an earth dragon. And an average earth ranked martial art was no match for the purple thunderbird, collapsing in seconds.
What followed next was obvious. The thunder bird flew at Huangpu Qingtian. Its eyes filled with killing intent just like Zhuo Fan’s.
How could this be?
Gnashing his teeth, Huangpu Qingtian was still in denial. The Dragon Vein Soul, the cornerstone of his pride and joy, of his very existence, was scared off by some purple lightning.
[What is that lightning that is able to scare the king of the land?]
He didn’t have the time to ponder such philosophical questions though. The thunderbird was coming in for the kill...

chapters.title: Chapter 321, At Death’s Door
chapters.content:
Chapter 321, At Death’s Door
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes showed fear for the first time. The dreadful aura of the thunderbird posed a definite and tangible threat to his life.
This hadn’t been brought about before, not even when Zhuo Fan was bashing him around. Because he had a fallback, the Dragon Vein Soul.
He was destined to rule, heaven’s gift on earth, with no man capable of defeating him. And yet...
“Run!”
You Yushan’s trio knew the tables had turned. The thunderbird was a very real danger to anything in existence. The Six Dragons and One Phoenix were no exception, ending up as nothing more than bone meal. That prediction had them running frantically for their lives.
Funnily enough, their grand boss was doing the same thing for the first time ever.
Not that it would do much good at this late an hour. They barely added a hundred meters between them when the thunderbird flapped its crackling wings and was upon Huangpu Qingtian.
Huangpu Qingtian was traumatized. Facing this world destroyer and its all powerful aura, all he could do was shout, “Transformation, Earth Dragon Claw!”
A flash of golden light shone and his entire right arm was enveloped in light among the dragon roars. It was at this instant that the thunderbird ran into him.
The berserk purple lightning pulverized anything it touched.
Boom!
The sky itself turned purple from the sheer magnitude of the blast. Purple lightning spread like wildfire catching the three slowpokes and sending them sprawling, heavily wounded.
The array holding Zhuo Fan prisoner began to shake for the first time. The 365 Profound Heaven experts spat blood at the same time, weakened.
Everyone was shocked at how the Six Dragons and One Phoenix, the peak of power in the Profound Heaven Stage, couldn’t even take on the after blast of the thunder bird. The Microcosmic Orbit Array, said to contain even a Radiant Stage expert, suffered under the tyrannical purple lightning. Every one of the 365 Profound Heaven experts controlling it were left with heavy wounds.
The power of the thunderbird was obvious.
They all watched the thick dust, eyes widened. Not even Regent Estate could contain the shock they felt.
Who could conceive it possible for Zhuo Fan to employ such power to annihilate everyone? What then of Huangpu Qingtian, who took the full blast?
Everyone watched the screen with bated breath.
Pff!
Zhuo Fan spurted blood and the lightning faded from his body. Focusing all the purple lightning into one blow and forcing a profound ranked martial art to go a rank higher had left him teetering on the edge of collapse.
His body was far too weak to handle an earth ranked martial art, or he’d have already trained in one. But to defeat Huangpu Qingtian, he threw caution to the wind and used every ounce of his strength. This left him on the brink of destruction.
Zhuo Fan was now weaker than your average Bone Tempering expert. Even after killing Huangpu Qingtian, he would still be in danger on Beast King Mountain.
Though he wasn’t of a mind to care. As long as Huangpu Qingtian was dead and done, nothing else mattered...
Narrowing his eyes, Zhuo Fan took a deep breath and moved, slowly, towards the cloud of dust. All that purple lightning did a number on his body, with no less than 20 wounds on his body deep enough to show the bone. His staggering walk was that of a demon from hell.
You Yushan’s trio were shaken to their core. They tried to get away, but any movement only aggravated their injuries. They were going nowhere fast.
They could only stare at the demon trudging towards them.
“Damn it! The three hundred people outside, release the damn array and come save us!” You Yushan shouted.
Yan Bangui and Lin Xuanfeng did the same, “Release the array already...”
The hellish image had them traumatized and horrified to the point of peeing themselves.
The viewers watched it all in heavy silence. At the end of it all, the Six Dragons and One Phoenix were mere men, fearing death and clinging to life. All that mettle they had was now gone.
All of Tianyu held the seven houses in reverence, practically worshiped them. But if there was one thing the Esoteric Debate showed, what Zhuo Fan’s fight showed, was that the grand disciples of these houses were nothing but disgraces.
The effect was immediate. The surviving clans had their opinion of the seven houses sharply diminished. While towards the Luo clan, they held no little amount of respect.
In this great battle, the Luo clan rose above the masses through their acts. Their steward even more so, fighting adversity without a hint of fear, his tall and imposing figure facing heaven itself. It got everyone’s blood pumping.
Everyone dreamt to be a hero at some point. Everyone yearned to fight back the authority breathing down on them. But none had the nerve to do it. Yet Zhuo Fan, a mere third rate clan steward, did it for them, fulfilling their wish, and brutalizing the seven houses’ experts.
It had gone beyond mere fighting oppression as he went against providence itself, against the heaven made king, Huangpu Qingtian and his kingly symbol, Dragon Vein Soul.
Not even a destined king was infallible, dead just the same before the third rate clan’s Zhuo Fan.
Everyone turned to the weakened Zhuo Fan with eyes filled with respect. Even the vassals of other houses had their views changed.
Leng Wuchang noticed and clenched his beard, even pulled a hair. But he was too engrossed in his scowl to notice.
Fang Qiubai sported a big smile.
[By defeating Huangpu Qingtian, Zhuo Fan had cut the seven houses’ prestige in one fell swoop. His Majesty would be ecstatic at the news.]
The emperor had planned for Zhuo Fan to cut down the Regent Estate’s momentum. But the man had gone leagues beyond his duty. Zhuo Fan had passed his mission with flying colors. Regent Estate’s very reputation was severely affected. It was a great help for when they had to quell the seven houses.
Fang Qiubai smiled and nodded.
[Having the Dragon Vein Soul doesn’t mean a thing. Huangpu Qingtian was still dragged through the mud before everyone. He won’t have the gall to be cocky now...]
“I forbid it!”
Fang Qiubai’s bright smile faded. While Leng Wuchang and the rest of the Regent Estate watched their vassals tense up, as a cold voice came from within the dust cloud.
Rumble!
Zhuo Fan couldn’t fight the shudder. His face darkened as he looked ahead in stunned silence.
You Yushan’s trio looked as well, with tears of joy welling in their eyes.
[Eldest young master... lives!]
[This can’t be!]
Fang Qiubai was aghast. [He suffered the brunt of all that raw power no Radiant Stage expert could take. How the hell...]
The dust scattered and revealed a bloody and panting Huangpu Qingtian with his entire right arm turned into a dragon claw, like a true monster.
It was this claw that ruined Zhuo Fan’s mighty blow.
“Transformation!”
Fang Qiubai and Zhuo Fan cried at the same time and color drained from their faces.
The act implied changing one’s soul and body. Special cultivation methods could turn one into a merciless beast when trained to perfection. And Huangpu Qingtian who had the Dragon Vein Soul would ultimately turn into a dragon.
Huangpu Qingtian only had a claw, but it was a true dragon claw, an earth dragon’s claw. Tough beyond imagination, leaps above even a 6th grade spiritual weapon.
“How? To reach transformation he had to have trained Nine Dragons Diamond Body to perfection, but he’s still in the first level. How did he do it?” Fang Qiubai was incredulous, “Not even Tianyu’s founding emperor could do it!”
Leng Wuchang sighed, seeing Huangpu Qingtian safe and smiled at Fang Qiubai, “Ha-ha-ha, it’s a simple matter of talent.”
Fang Qiubai was overwhelmed.
[Has Huangpu Qingtian’s talent reached such a monstrous level that he could transform before training Nine Dragons Diamond Body to completion?]
That made him the most dangerous being in existence. When he finished Nine Dragons Diamond Body, not even Gu Santong could face him.
[It will mark the day when the Regent Estate will become the ruling family...]
Leng Wuchang easily gleaned into his thought process, looking at the National Elemental Stone with a smile, “The true winner has finally been decided...”
Whoosh!
Huangpu Qingtian sprung at Zhuo Fan, clawing at him.
Zhuo Fan panicked. Try as he might, he was too weak to even dodge.
But he was still defiant, gnashing his teeth and gathering the last vestige of power, “Wraith Style’s second move, Ghostly Dragon Claw!”
Roar!
A dragon roar began but was cut off. Huangpu Qingtian’s own claw had a firm grip on the enemy’s claw.
“Not a chance!”
Zhuo Fan’s last act scared him. Huangpu Qingtian no longer looked at Zhuo Fan with the usual haughty attitude, instead he looked at him with fear.
Zhuo Fan was the first to ever shake him so much. So for the first time, he went all out. He felt Zhuo Fan was at his weakest moment, on his deathbed.
But against Zhuo Fan he would never feel safe until the very last breath left his body.
Ah!
Huangpu Qingtian wailed and ripped Zhuo Fan’s right arm clean off. Blood spurted like a fountain and Luo Yunchang cried in fear.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes bulged out and his features twisted. But he pushed through the pain and pierced at Huangpu Qingtian with his wings, despite how hopeless it was...

chapters.title: Chapter 322, Fleeing
chapters.content:
Chapter 322, Fleeing
Editor: Elitecoder
Clang!
A metallic screech was heard as the Lightning Wings struck the claw Huangpu Qingtian easily used to defend.
Panting, Huangpu Qingtian tightened his claw, staring Zhuo Fan in the eye. Zhuo Fan met his gaze, bewildered. [Why couldn’t the Lightning Wings pierce it?]
“I told you. You have no chance!”
Huangpu Qingtian’s face twisted with savagery and tore off one of Zhuo Fan’s wings.
Blood spurted from his back and Zhuo Fan broke out in sweat, falling down. The pain in his back blinded him for a moment, but he gnashed his teeth through the pain.
Ah!
Luo Yunchang cried out, tears falling like a river. The other women turned their heads away. They couldn’t bear to watch.
Yet their eyelids never stopped trembling...
Zhuo Fan shook from the pain. He made a fist wanting to get up with his only arm but Huangpu Qingtian stomped on his other wing. Looking down on him, the savage dragon claw slowly lifted him up.
“Game over. The punk is done for!”
Leng Wuchang sighed, despite the stunned face he pulled, “That was too close. I didn’t foresee the punk having so much of that strange purple lightning. If not for the eldest young master having that last move, I fear everything would have been in vain. Regent Estate’s glory would’ve hit rock bottom and the vassals would no longer worship us.”
He saw that the others now looked at the crippled Zhuo Fan with worry and lamentation.
As if to say, fighting Regent Estate was fighting heaven. The only outcome was death.
Leng Wuchang was pleased. This was exactly what he wanted.
Zhuge Changfeng looked on with regret, “A pity. With the kid’s power, if he just wasn’t so hot blooded and lost his mind, he would have had an even chance at victory.”
“Ha-ha-ha, Prime Minister, is this how you work? There are no ifs in this world. Failure means annihilation!” Leng Wuchang smiled at him.
Zhuge Changfeng’s eyes glinted, “I only mourn the loss of a talent. A pity for him to go down this way. Naturally, he only has himself to blame for this outcome.”
“The Prime Minister is most right. We, the schemers, fear becoming berserk ourselves and digging our own graves.”
Leng Wuchang and Zhuge Changfeng shared a look, then laughed...
On the battlefield, a shadow watched it all from a corner, finding himself at an impasse.
Out of Zhuo Fan and Huangpu Qingtian, he only wanted the strongest. And although they were equally powerful, Zhuo Fan had the greater potential.
But now Zhuo Fan had lost and was about to die. Should he go save him?
[Sigh, everything’s so twisted.]
A headhunter feared not searching the world for thousands of miles yet to come out empty, but being forced to choose one of two prized horses.
[It’s too vexing!]
But soon, the shadow came to a decision.
He wanted the strongest, that hadn’t changed. Zhuo Fan had the greatest potential but defeat spoke by itself. He didn’t pity him regardless of how great the kid was...
Huff~
Zhuo Fan and Huangpu Qingtian were panting, staring at each other in hatred. They both were spent of Yuan Qi, body riddled with wounds, but it was obvious that Zhuo Fan was far worse for wear.
“Zhuo Fan, your very existence is a threat to me. You must die!” Huangpu Qingtian moved a trembling dragon claw and aimed for Zhuo Fan’s chest.
Squinting, Zhuo Fan’s blood bubbled from his right arm and his back, His face ashen, but the fire in his eyes burnt strong, “Huangpu Qingtian, you will die for touching Ning’er!”
“Oh really? And how are you going to do that from under my heel?” Huangpu Qingtian mocked.
Huangpu Qingtian’s heart seized the next second. He could see Zhuo Fan had no intention of dying, but he looked back like a wild animal ready to tear into him.
[There’s still some fight left in him!]
Huangpu Qingtian’s unease only grew. Even if he dismembered Zhuo Fan, as long as the man’s eyes burned, the threat still existed.
With a roar, Huangpu Qingtian stabbed his claw at Zhuo Fan’s heart.
Ah!
With a cry, Luo Yunchang could no longer bear to watch. Fang Qiubai squinted, overwhelmed by anxiety.
[Zhuo Fan’s death proclaims the Regent Estate as the winner. It will only make them stronger.]
[Kid, you must live at all costs!]
Fang Qiubai shouted inside.
Divine Eye of the Void’s 2nd stage, Void Annihilation!
As Huangpu Qingtian’s claw inched forward, Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed with two golden halos and space warped.
Huangpu Qingtian’s claw would take Zhuo Fan’s heart at this rate, but so too would Void Annihilation punch a hole through the enemy’s chest.
It truly was a life for a life.
But Zhuo Fan still had Blood Infant. As long as Blood Infant was in his blood, even without a heart, he wouldn’t die. For him, it was more of a heavy wound in exchange for a life.
Even though Huangpu Qingtian was oblivious to these subtleties, he still didn’t find it worth it to go down like this.
Startled by the warped space, Huangpu Qingtian dodged and his claw stabbed the ground next to Zhuo Fan. They both get to live a while longer.
Yet Void Annihilation brushed past Huangpu Qingtian’s left arm and peeled his flesh. Blood oozed out like water.
Huangpu Qingtian had no time to react as Void Annihilation continued on its path and smashed into the array.
Boom!
Like a hole punched through the sky, the 6th grade array, Microcosmic Orbit Array, shattered. The 365 Profound Heaven experts acting as the core of the array, died on the spot.
They spurted up blood, their eyes rolled into their heads and they breathed their last.
[What... just happened?]
Huangpu Qingtian looked at the wound on his arm, then at the crumbling array, but was left dumbfounded.
He had no idea what had occurred. All that he knew was that Zhuo Fan landed a sneak attack on him.
But how could a mere sneak attack be so powerful?
Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth in hatred. [He’s still alive!]
Since he had failed, Zhuo Fan knew Huangpu Qingtian had to be on guard and a second chance wouldn’t come. With his last attempt failing, he was all out of means to catch Huangpu Qingtian unaware.
[I have no choice but to use my last plan. Humph, Leng Wuchang, I didn’t think it was you in the end who managed to outplay me. You may be the Unwonted Contriver, but not even you could foresee my last resort.]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed and he ignored the pain as he moved, ripping his last wing that Huangpu Qingtian had pinned down.
Huangpu Qingtian cried inside.
[He wants to run!]
And he pierced the dragon claw at Zhuo Fan’s throat, just as Zhuo Fan vanished through the use of Shift.
With the array gone, Zhuo Fan had regained his freedom and no one could stop him now.
Void Annihilation overcame the flaw of Divine Eye of the Void’s 1st stage by breaking any restrictions. Zhuo Fan didn’t use it all this time because he had no intention of escaping, hellbent on finishing off Huangpu Qingtian.
The array had him trapped, but so too was Huangpu Qingtian. He could have run away anytime anyway.
Something that Huangpu Qingtian wasn’t privy to and not even Leng Wuchang predicted this. It was unclear at this point who played who.
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan flashed a thousand meters away and took out Qiao’er from the ring. He had it carry him as it flew away.
Not a moment too soon as Zhuo Fan blacked out.
Huangpu Qingtian took a few steps after him and spat blood. He glanced at the flesh gouged from his left arm seeping blood, then at the hellscape around him, littered with broken corpses.
They had ten thousand men, paid such a heavy price and still couldn’t finish the job. The frustration fueled his raging howl.
Fang Qiubai eased his breath. Noone expected the kid to break the array. He had them scared.
Leng Wuchang was stunned and sighed, “The kid is far more treacherous than I gave him credit for.”
“Sir Leng, it seems to me the kid has escaped with his life and your meticulous planning failed. Ha-ha-ha...” Zhuge Changfeng laughed.
Leng Wuchang shook his head. He didn’t look too pleased yet his voice was calm, “Prime Minister, I thank you for your concern. The kid had exceeded my calculations, but I have taken this outcome into account. With him on his deathbed, he is like a fish in a barrel, waiting to be squashed!”
“Don’t get so confident, Sir Leng. The kid is a true miracle worker, ha-ha-ha...” Zhuge Changfeng mocked. Leng Wuchang fell silent. But his eyes were completely focused on the National Elemental Stone, waiting for the next plan to come into play...

chapters.title: Chapter 323, The Future Is Ours
chapters.content:
Chapter 323, The Future Is Ours
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
Caw~
In the glow of the twilight sun, cawing entered the ears of the people there, as a murder of crows circled the bloodbath.
Huangpu Qingtian stared in Zhuo Fan’s last direction, panting and frustrated.
He had prepared the ambush, put so much effort into it, only to be routed and failing to take Zhuo Fan’s life. Such disgrace lowered his royal prestige in the public’s eye.
What right did he have now to go vie for his father’s position after such a gruesome slaughter?
Ah!
Huangpu Qingtian vented his frustration by wailing. The regret and anger only festered in his core. The crows landing nearby flew away startled.
You Yushan’s trio was grounded and unable to move. Watching Huangpu Qingtian’s irritation, they knew when to keep to themselves, afraid they’d direct his anger on themselves.
“Eldest young master?”
A weak voice ventured. Looking over they saw Yan Fu bringing a dozen survivors of vassal clans, fear clearly painted on his face.
Snapping his eyes on him, Huangpu Qingtian spat, “Humph, such fortune upon you. So many have died, along with hundreds of Profound Heaven experts, but you, Bone Tempering fools and Yan Fu, the ants, still breathe.”
Yan Fu and the others shuddered but he was the first to fall to his knees followed by the rest. Their heads lowered, silent as the grave.
“Eldest young master, forgive us. That m-monster put fear into us and we escaped before the array was activated. S-so...”
“So you lived?” Huangpu Qingtian sneered.
Yan Fu trembled, nodding stiffly.
Huangpu Qingtian only had contempt for them, but Yan Bangui’s round of abuse cut him off before he could continue, “Yan Fu, you are the stain of Pill King Hall. That monster killed your master and when you had the chance to ambush him what did you do? You chose the path of a sniveling coward!”
“Eldest young master, I failed to teach my junior brother proper manners. If you want to punish him, you may go ahead and even kill this disgrace to avoid shaming us further.” Yan Bangui barked.
Yan Fu gulped, shivering from fear yet hatred growing inside him.
It wasn’t as much chastising but more for the sake of the audience of Hall Lord Yan Bogong.
With everyone running away in fear just now, if Huangpu Qingtian were to think of killing them, who was there to stop him? Even if they were killed out in the open, would Pill King Hall seek Regent Estate for justice?
Absolutely not. That in turn would make the world look down on Pill King Hall.
And this was where Yan Bangui’s words came into play. By mocking Yan Fu, he saved the face of Pill King Hall, letting Huangpu Qingtian vent while also giving Regent Estate a resounding round of ass kissing, showing his endless devotion towards Regent Estate.
In the case Huangpu Qingtian killed Yan Fu then and there, he’d be safe, since Pill King Hall now authorized Huangpu Qingtian to deal with the main offender.
Regardless of the outcome, Pill King Hall’s honor was safeguarded and the two houses would never be closer.
All at the low price of throwing Yan Fu to the wolf.
And that wasn’t even the best part. Yan Bogong would definitely reward him for having saved Pill King Hall’s honor.
Yan Fu’s rage only grew inside him, but he still laid there waiting.
Huangpu Qingtian glanced at Yan Bangui, aware of his ploy, then smiled, “It’s fine. We have lost too many in this battle and we need all the help we can get. We can’t just have Yan Fu, a rare alchemist, killed. It will be of great help to us now that he’s alive.”
“Eldest young master’s mercy knows no bounds. Let me express a thousand thanks in my junior brother’s stead.” Yan Bangui put on the good guy act then berated, “Yan Fu, what are you gawking at? Thank the eldest young master for his mercy. It is all thanks to the eldest young master’s infinite generosity that I don’t have you punished as well!”
Yan Fu groaned, wishing nothing more than to give the man a few slaps.
[You threw me away, my own clansman, not even pleading for me and now you’re acting the savior? Even going as far as asking me for thanks?]
[As if Huangpu Qingtian respects you so much that he spared my life.]
[Humph, just you wait. I’ll be sure to return the favor, don’t you worry.]
And yet Yan Fu’s face was filled with respect and gratitude, “Thank you eldest young master for your mercy. Thank you senior brother for your care!”
Nodding, the two accepted in glee, putting on the face of chastising naughty children.
“What are the rest of you standing around for? Look after their injuries!” Huangpu Qingtian pointed at You Yushan’s trio.
Yan Fu nodded, taking first a pill for Huangpu Qingtian, then he and the rest went to nurse the other three.
Huangpu Qingtian nodded at Yan Fu’s meek figure.
[The kid has good eyes to know who gets the first pill.]
But then Huangpu Qingtian sighed over the biggest worry, letting Zhuo Fan escape. It would be hard looking for him in the wide expanse of Beast King Mountain.
Huangpu Qingtian scowled and took out a jade slip.
It was the last jade slip Leng Wuchang gave him, warning him repeatedly to never open it unless he ran out of options.
The state he was in wasn’t just out of options, even with a thousand ways he still wouldn’t have anything remotely good he could use. With Zhuo Fan’s cunning, the same trick wouldn’t work twice.
Not to mention he had no clue where to even begin the search.
Sighing, Huangpu Qingtian paused in hesitation then ultimately read the jade slip.
[Just what could Sir Leng have prepared in this late hour. What ingenious trick could we use?]
Finished reading the jade slip, his eyes shined and he laughed, “I see it now. Sir Leng is a true mastermind to take even that into account. Ha-ha-ha, Zhuo Fan, no matter how sly you are you shall never escape my grasp!”
“Eh? A Brimming Sacred Pill?”
The faint sound behind him caught his undivided attention.
Huangpu Qingtian whipped his head to see Yan Fu trembling and facing away from everyone. The excitement got to him as he shouted, “Yan Fu, what are you doing?”
“Uh, n-nothing.” Yan Fu stiffly turned around to show a painful smile while hiding his hand behind him.
Squinting, Huangpu Qingtian said coldly, “What are you holding? Show it to me!”
Sweating buckets, Yan Fu hesitated for a long time before putting on a smile and presenting a storage ring with both hands, “Congratulations, eldest young master. I found the Brimming Sacred Pills, all four of them!”
“Where?” Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes shined as he snatched the rings. Emptying them, he was looking at four vials in his palm, the Brimming Sacred Pills.
Yan Fu pointed at an arm soaked in blood, “I took it from that arm. I thought...”
“Isn’t that Zhuo Fan’s arm?” Huangpu Qingtian stared Yan Fu down, “You found it quite fast and even knew it was his. Were you perhaps watching our fight, waiting for the right moment to steal our things?”
“Eldest young master, I would never even dream of it!” Yan Fu fell to his knees in fear.
“Wouldn’t dream of it?” Huangpu Qingtian had a sinister smile as he eyed the four vials, “Then how do you explain the missing seals from all four of the vials? Did you plan on switching the pills, is that it?”
Huangpu Qingtian used Discerning Field on the spot, only relaxing when he found the genuine goods in the vials.
Yan Fu was scared to death and pleaded, “Eldest young master, please, I only wanted to confirm they were real. As an alchemist I just couldn’t help but want to see an 8th grade pill.”
The hard stare was making him sweat buckets. Huangpu Qingtian spoke, “Listen here, leave the other’s possessions alone for now. The only items you are ever allowed to use are those I give you. You aren’t even allowed to look, understand?”
“Y-yes, I shall take it to heart, eldest young master!” Yan Fu bobbed his head.
Grinning, Huangpu Qingtian gave a pleased nod. Then he turned to the somewhat recovered trio and showed them the pills, “See that? I told you. All the pills I lost will one day return to me!”
“Brimming Sacred Pill!”
The three perked up.
Huangpu Tianyuan was moved. He was worried that the rotten bastard would only go after one, but instead he had obtained all four. With such a fortune, he, the Estate Lord, would surely get one as well.
The smile had yet to reach his eyes as he watched Huangpu Qingtian share the three pills with his allies.
The three looked at him puzzled.
Huangpu Qingtian snickered, “Take it and let’s go hunt down Zhuo Fan together!”
[What?!]
The three were stunned.
The Brimming Sacred Pill was as rare as it got. Yet Huangpu Qingtian was just going to hand it over? Huangpu Tianyuan went slack jawed.
[Since when is that brat so generous? You should keep them to yourself when it counts the most. If you ever feel like being generous, do that in your own house, not with some brats!]
Snorting, Huangpu Qingtian could tell what they were thinking and said, “Remember this well. The future of the world is ultimately ours!”

chapters.title: Chapter 324, Every Trick in the Book
chapters.content:
Chapter 324, Every Trick in the Book
[The future is ours!]
Those simple words had their ambition grow unchecked.
You Yushan’s trio looked at Huangpu Qingtian’s smile and felt the Brimming Sacred Pill in their hand heavy as Mt. Tai.
The pill and those words were the perfect sales pitch.
He said the same thing to all Six Dragons and One Phoenix before the wood exit, that they held the future in their grasp. They would soon surpass their own house lords and their glory.
And now that they took his offered pill, they agreed to be wholly on Huangpu Qingtian’s side. They would follow him blindly from now on, and the houses’ structure and interests would change as a result.
This implied that when they became house lords, they would still align with Huangpu Qingtian and listen to his orders.
This single Brimming Sacred Pill represented not just their allegiance but their houses’ as well, and everything that came along with it; their forces, their wealth, their souls.
Huangpu Qingtian’s plan of roping in the three future house lords was far more ingenious than how Huangpu Tianyuan earned the current house lords’ favor.
As long as the three held him in the highest regard, so too would the future three houses. Whether or not the three current house lords would object by writing them off as inheritors, Huangpu Qingtian wasn’t the least bit worried.
Once these three became his men, they would have Regent Estate behind them. And Regent Estate would do all in its power to get them the house lord position. If those geezer were tired of living, they were most welcome to refuse.
You Yushan’s trio looked at each other in sorrow, feeling the weight of the pill growing by the second.
They were over the moon having gotten the Brimming Sacred Pill, albeit at the price of betraying their own house. But if they refused, how would Huangpu Qingtian react?
The three were pulled from two directions but soon came to a decision and bowed, “We thank the eldest young master for his generosity!”
Today’s decision had sealed the fate and future of their houses in one direction, as vassals. But refusing it would most likely end with them buried on this mountain.
Tallying up both choices’ ups and downs, the three favored satisfying their own interests.
So what if they defected their clans in front of everyone? As long as the Regent Estate had their backs, their own house lords and elders wouldn’t even touch them. Not to mention their house lord position was guaranteed.
It was just about being Huangpu Qingtian’s loyal dog. How bad could it be? Then again, they’d be below one man, but lords over the masses. At that time, a mere hint of accusing them for this decision would earn the offender a quick trip six feet under...
That worked to calm their worries and they showed pure respect. Huangpu Qingtian nodded and laughed...
“Ha-ha-ha...”
Twitching, Huangpu Tianyuan watched the wise and powerful son of his, while cackling with a mask of rage.
Looking at the three house lords, he saw the glum hanging heavy on their faces.
Huangpu Qingtian not only carried out the Regent Estate’s plan to unify the houses, but spurred the juniors to fight for their elders’ power.
Even a blind man could see Huangpu Qingtian was strengthening his position for when the time came to take his father’s place.
Be that as it may, Regent Estate’s plan to unite the houses without conflict was of far greater benefit. Regent Estate’s elders were totally for it, evident by their prideful looks.
Regent Estate’s house lord status was reserved for the most capable. The father and son could fight all they wanted, as long as the future lord worked for the better of Regent Estate.
And watching Huangpu Qingtian employ hidden schemes and tricks along with the power invested in him, just like a true emperor, the elders loved him even more. Who would blame him now for calling them geezers?
[As long as you can make the Regent Estate thrive for thousands of years, you can even call us a bag of bones!]
Huangpu Tianyuan eyed the prideful elders behind him and sighed dejected.
[If this keeps up, the brat will soon come back with Zhuo Fan’s head and earn great merit. Higher than anyone.]
[And what will become of me then?]
Squinting, Huangpu Tianyuan could no longer bear the stress and frustration and said, “Sir Leng, how sure are you of your plan to finish Zhuo Fan off?”
“If it were anyone else, I’d guarantee it right away. But with how crafty he is, I can only go as far as ninety percent.” Leng Wuchang spoke lightly.
Huangpu Tianyuan’s heart froze.
[Such assurance is insane...]
The man was now worried for Zhuo Fan’s fate and for the first time, resenting Leng Wuchang’s sharp mind.
[Just what plan do you have to be so certain? Is there anyone out there able to survive you, an ant perhaps?]
Sighing, Huangpu Tianyuan’s mood sank into the pits of despair.
Leng Wuchang smiled inside. He knew fully well the thoughts this house lord had, but didn’t mind them in the least.
His genius mind was a rarity in this world. No matter what house lord took office in Regent Estate, it wouldn’t change a thing. He would still be their right-hand man or left-hand man, all because of his strength.
This was why he did not care what Huangpu Tianyuan thought. Zhuo Fan was the only one on his mind right now. Zhuo Fan was the first ever to have escaped his foolproof plans.
He found it impossible to gauge Zhuo Fan’s actions and this Unwonted Contriver felt the same threat he felt from Zhuge Changfeng.
In this, Huangpu Qingtian and his interests were aligned, to end Zhuo Fan.
...
“Alright, now that you’ve made your decision, hurry and take it. After you enter the Radiant Stage, we will go hunt that pest down!” Huangpu Qingtian smiled at the trio.
They were all puzzled and You Yushan was the first to inquire, “Eldest young master, we do not know where to start. Do you perhaps know his location? But even so, why don’t we go after him this instant instead of waiting to break through?”
“Ha-ha-ha, Zhuo Fan is bedridden and he’ll make sure to hide where no one can find him. Not even me. But Sir Leng knows he will sooner or later appear at one place and that is where we’ll wait for him. With him licking his wounds, we won’t be disturbed for a while. It is our best chance to bolster our power. When everything is set and we ambush him, he will have no room to escape!” Huangpu Qingtian laughed.
The three nodded amazedly, “If Sir Leng said it, it must be so!”
The three placed a simple defensive array around them and ate the Brimming Sacred Pill.
Huangpu Qingtian smiled, placing Yan Fu and the others as guards. He placed his own defenses around and ate his own pill.
The four of them were peak Profound Heaven experts, soon to be Radiant Stage experts, courtesy of Brimming Sacred Pill.
Huangpu Qingtian’s soul’s strength would be multiplied tens of times and not even Zhuo Fan with his Shift would be able to escape his grasp.
Zhuo Fan’s end was nigh...
In another place, a purple lightning bird stood before a dark cave. The crackling lightning was enough deterrence for any approaching spiritual beast.
A man covered in blood laid in the cave, unmoving.
With his wings and arm ripped away, it was the first time Zhuo Fan had been in such a dangerous state.
Qiao’er sometimes looked back in worry. It wanted to get Zhuo Fan some food and water but was worried it would come back to find a spiritual beast gorging on his body.
So he stood watch.
Ten days came and went as man and beast monopolized the cave in complete silence. Only on the 15th day, a groan came from Zhuo Fan as he opened his eyes. The blinding sunlight coming from outside made him squint.
Shriek~
Qiao’er flapped its wings and cheered.
With a smile, Zhuo Fan forced himself up and said, “Don’t worry. As long as Blood Infant is safe, I won’t die.
“How long was I out, Qiao’er?” He asked.
Shriek~
Qiao’er flapped its wings and cried out. Zhuo Fan frowned and smiled, “Half a month? Just in time. Come, it’s time for us to settle a debt!”
Shriek~
Qiao’er barred his way, anxiously flapping its wings. [You’ll die if you go now!]
Smiling, Zhuo Fan patted its head, “Don’t write off your old man just yet. I’ve got more than just a strong arm. A sharp head on my shoulders! Qiao’er, by my reckoning I won’t even have to lift a finger to kill them all, he-he-he... “
Qiao’er cocked its head, unable to read between the lines. But seeing the crafty smirk, it dawned on the bird.
“I didn’t lose my right arm for nothing.” Touching the stump, Zhuo Fan’s eyes glinted...

chapters.title: Chapter 325, No, You Lost
chapters.content:
Chapter 325, No, You Lost
A lonely and lazy figure was approaching the water exit in Beast King Mountain. From the empty right sleeve it was clear he only had one arm.
“Zhuo Fan!”
The people beyond the National Elemental Stone had been waiting for him to show up for twenty days. After the fight back at the earth exit, Zhuo Fan had vanished, only appearing before another exit now.
Zhuo Fan’s coming had them gasping. [He’s still alive!]
But the pale face and the wobbling gait let them know he was far from healed.
Being in such a damaged state, it would’ve been common sense to look for a quiet corner somewhere to lay low and lick his wounds. Yet here he was, walking around. It made no sense.
Luo Yunchang’s eyes moistened, “Why... must you...”
Uncaring of the audience commenting on his appearance, Zhuo Fan walked forth. When he was a hundred meters off of the water exit, he stopped. He looked down at the empty ground and sighed.
Everyone was startled, [What’s he doing?]
Only Chu Qingcheng and Luo Yunchang knew. Zhuo Fan paid homage to Xue Ningxiang. This was where she died twenty days ago.
Taking a deep and long breath, Zhuo Fan forced back his sadness and grief, “Ning’er, don’t worry. Big brother Zhuo will soon make everyone follow you for what they did to you. May it bring you peace.”
“Ha-ha-ha, bold words! How are you going to get revenge with that weak and crippled body? Are you a comedian now?” A whistle reached his ears.
Four people now stood before Zhuo Fan, Huangpu Qingtian and his allies. Then a dozen people walked out of the woods to surround him, Yan Fu and the surviving vassals.
What was truly shocking was Huangpu Qingtian’s group had entered the Radiant Stage in preparation to deal with Zhuo Fan.
Everyone knew they got the Brimming Sacred Pill and that they had a good chance of advancing, but seeing it was another matter entirely.
Seeing the four practically reborn, bolstered in power and speed, the people feared for the worse.
In the long history of Tianyu, there had never been anyone entering the Radiant Stage before the age of thirty. But now there were four of them, shocking the masses.
Huangpu Tianyuan was the one suffering the most. If his son had brought just one Brimming Sacred Pill home, the house lord would have achieved his lifelong dream of entering the Radiant Stage as well.
[But this wretched son of mine would rather leave his old man to die. Damn you!]
It was because of this he knew that when the four would return, their Radiant Stage cultivation would be a threat to every house lord, ultimately to be replaced.
The four house lords looked at each other crestfallen.
Chu Qingcheng was worried sick, choked with emotion. How was Zhuo Fan going to survive being wounded like that and up against four Radiant Stage experts?
Fang Qiubai and Dugu Zhantian shook their heads, “Fate has caught up to the kid. He has nowhere else to go.”
Leng Wuchang was the only one with a smile on his face, like everything went according to plan...
Zhuo Fan looked at the four, yet people found it odd how laid back he was about this whole trap thing. All he did was mutter, “Ning’er, do you see? Everyone who hurt you is here. Big brother Zhuo will avenge you!”
You Yushan looked puzzled.
“Zhuo Fan, have you lost it? There are four Radiant Stage experts here while you aren’t even healed. There is a huge gulf between us and yet you dare spout things like revenge? Humph, you have lost in all aspects!” Lin Xuanfeng shouted.
Frowning, Zhuo Fan glanced at him then showed a vague smile, “Ha-ha-ha, no, it’s you who has lost everything.”
“Cut the crap you lunatic! Even the blind can see we four are invincible. Wake up and smell the roses!” Lin Xuanfeng’s eyes narrowed as he cursed, but Zhuo Fan’s odd mirthless smile unnerved him.
Huangpu Qingtian felt the same.
[With how sly he is, what did he plan to remain so calm in front of us?]
Huangpu Qingtian looked around for clues. But nothing was picked up when he released his soul and his worry only grew.
[Is he bluffing?]
Leng Wuchang was also frowning. Zhuo Fan was becoming more and more of an enigma.
With a mocking smile on his lips, Zhuo Fan sighed, “Leng Wuchang sure is something, able to guess I’ll stop by to pay my respects to Ning’er before leaving Beast King Mountain. He even had you set up an ambush. Truly a feat only Unwonted Contriver can pull.”
“What, how can you know everything?” Huangpu Qingtian cried.
Leng Wuchang’s eyes tightened and his aged hand clutched his beard.
Shaking his head, Zhuo Fan said, “I know nothing really. But one thing I do know, every move we make is part of Leng Wuchang’s grand design in some way or another. He’d been watching me for too long and I must say, he knows me better than I do myself. Since nothing I do will escape his plans, why not let nature run its course.”
Huangpu Qingtian looked hard at him then sighed as he probed, “Are you giving up?”
“No, didn’t I tell you already? I came for all your lives.” Zhuo Fan’s lips broke out into his trademark evil grin.
Seizing up, the four were totally oblivious to Zhuo Fan’s meaning.
[He knows he can’t escape Leng Wuchang’s predictions so why is he playing the winner? Does he have a way to turn it all around?]
It was easy for Zhuo Fan to guess what was on their minds, “Ha-ha-ha, I have indeed fallen for Leng Wuchang’s ploys, but to be fair, Huangpu Qingtian, haven’t you fallen for mine as well? With Leng Wuchang in the background, when it comes to you and me, I come out on top.”
Huangpu Qingtian shuddered, not knowing whether to believe him or not.
[Is this mere grandstanding, a bluff?]
Leng Wuchang shot to his feet, his face changing color in seconds. His eyes swirled around, his mind fast at work.
Then he looked up and cried, “Did the punk know he can’t escape my plans so he went on the offensive to lay a trap for eldest young master? But when did he...”
Leng Wuchang’s mind had guessed it, just that he didn’t know the specifics and his face paled.
Zhuge Changfeng eyed this Unwonted Contriver and grinned, “Avoid a ready enemy and only fight when he is weary. The kid sure is sharp. He knows he can’t beat you in this mind game so he chose to accept everything you did to him and fight your eldest young master. Sir Leng, you are not there by your lord. His scheming mind pales in comparison. Zhuo Fan’s eyes sure are vicious, ha-ha-ha...”
Words failed Leng Wuchang. All he could do was stew in his anger. [What did this punk do to Huangpu Qingtian to act so confident before four Radiant Stage experts?]
Not even Zhuge Changfeng could figure it out, least of all him. [Is this young pup able to turn the tables?]
He didn’t believe it, he didn’t want to believe it.
Zhuge Changfeng was looking at the National Elemental Stone in anticipation. This Prime Minister wanted to see what godly scheme could he pull off to turn all of it around...
Huangpu Qingtian stared hatefully at him, “Zhuo Fan, stop lying. I don’t believe you. With your weak body, what can your meager attempts possibly do against four Radiant Stage experts to reverse this situation?”
“Ha-ha-ha, you’re wrong. To be honest, it’s not me who will do it, you will. You will give me victory. In fact, I won the instant you guys entered the Radiant Stage!” Zhuo Fan snickered,
Huangpu Qingtian roared, “Cut the bull! You’re clearly faking it. I will personally turn you to ash and see you mock me then!”
Huangpu Qingtian pounced, aiming for Zhuo Fan’s head.
With how weak Zhuo Fan was, his head would crack like an overripe tomato.
Luo Yunchang cried out and turned away. Chu Qingcheng was deeply troubled by what was coming, while only Zhuo Fan’s smile never faltered. Like the incoming fist wasn’t even there.
When the fist was about to touch him, he made a sign.
Rumble!
For no apparent reason, Huangpu Qingtian found his body stopping dead in its tracks. He couldn’t control his body.
Looking up at Zhuo Fan, he found the man’s grin spitting on his face...

chapters.title: Chapter 326, Zhuo Fan’s Deceit
chapters.content:
Chapter 326, Zhuo Fan’s Deceit
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
“Eldest young master!”
You Yushan and the other two cried out seeing Huangpu Qingtian frozen in place.
Huangpu Qingtian was sweating buckets, “I-I can’t move. What are you standing around for? Do something!”
He knew Zhuo Fan must’ve done something, though he didn’t know exactly what.
Never for the life of him did he think it possible for Zhuo Fan, on his deathbed, to be hiding such an eerie trick. The fear of not knowing how he did it only amplified the dread.
He was now stuck in place, waiting for the axe to fall even as his heart was beating out of his chest.
His three allies knew time was of the essence and sprung on Zhuo Fan as well.
The three mighty Radiant Stage powers slammed into Zhuo Fan. He was forced two steps back, but he was not in the least bit panic, going by the wide grin.
“Stop!”
Making the same sign, Zhuo Fan mocked, “I told you, you already lost.”
Rumble!
Just like Huangpu Qingtian, the three stopped as well. Bug-eyed, they looked at the grinning Zhuo Fan in fear.
They couldn’t move as well....
The viewers cried out in shock and doubt. Zhuge Changfeng and Leng Wuchang were also astounded.
[What did the punk do to gain control of them?]
They knew Zhuo Fan had the four in the bag. As for when the bag opened and the four were shoved in, no one knew, not even the two greatest minds of Tianyu.
The most aware of it all were the victims. Huangpu Qingtian watched Zhuo Fan in shock, “W-what did you do to me?”
Zhuo Fan only giggled and looked around. Once he had the four riled up, and the dozen vassals scared out of their minds, he spoke, “Eldest young master, you are fated to rule, providence made you king. Can it be that your elders never told you when you were a child not to take candy from a stranger?”
“What? W-what did we take?”
Huangpu Qingtian was stunned for a second and then it all came crashing down, “The pills...”
Nodding, Zhuo Fan showed the same smile, “We have a winner. The very same 8th grade pill, Brimming Sacred Pill. I left a little something inside it, you see. So when you entered the Radiant Stage, you had already lost.”
[This can’t be!]
Huangpu Qingtian and the other three felt a chill crawling up their spines. The pills they got that boosted their power were spiked.
That meant they were now affected by its poison.
[But Huangpu Qingtian got them by coincidence when he ripped out Zhuo Fan’s right arm. How could Zhuo Fan give it to us on purpose? Don’t tell me...]
Eyes wide as saucers, they looked upon Zhuo Fan in horror.
[It was his plan all along? To even rip his own arm...]
Zhuo Fan knew fully well what went on in those little heads of theirs, “Looks like you figured it out. I let Huangpu Qingtian take my right arm on purpose.”
The crowd was in complete shock.
Leng Wuchang’s eyes shuddered. Zhuo Fan’s scheme ran so deep, so ruthless, that it made even Unwonted Contriver shiver.
Who’d ever see it coming? He gave up an arm to have Huangpu Qingtian at his mercy.
The people looking at the one-armed and frail Zhuo Fan had long lost their sympathy. Even his pale face was warped into that of a demon in the minds of his enemies.
This clueless herd of sheep actually dared to surround the wolf!
“Ha-ha-ha, shocking, ain’t it? I knew that I wouldn’t be a match for you so I cooked up a little something and had you all invited for dinner. Victory got to your head and pride lowered your guard. You thought I was breathing my last, that all danger had lifted. Then you took those tampered pills in your greatest moment of weakness!”
Zhuo Fan ginned maliciously.
Back then, he knew Chu Qingcheng and the others were trapped as he rushed to the water exit. On his way he noticed a cold pond, reminding him of his old plan since god knew when to use Bloodworms on his enemies.
So he took advantage of the time Huangpu Qingtian believed his mind was in chaos after falling for their ploy and prepared his own scheme.
