Seeing Ning’er dead truly made him go berserk, going after Huangpu Qingtian for revenge. Killing him himself would have been better, but if he did lose, he had this trick in mind ready to turn it all around, just in case.
Like he said, he accepted all of Leng Wuchang’s machinations, but not without leaving Huangpu Qingtian with a gift of his own.
Something Leng Wuchang would never consider.
Seeing how everyone was up to their neck deep in his ploy and couldn’t make sense of anything, Leng Wuchang always assumed they couldn’t spare anything in plotting back. But Zhuo Fan knew he couldn’t avoid it so he accepted it all with open arms, leaving him with the opening needed to plan his own trickery.
The one to take the win!
Huangpu Qingtian stared at this demon incarnate horrified. Leng Wuchang was also trembling.
He’d been a schemer and a plotter all his life, always achieving his projections. But Zhuo Fan managed to twist it around at the final moment. Then again, when taking into account Zhuo Fan’s weird methods, hardly anyone could make feasible projections.
But nevertheless, a loss was a loss. Leng Wuchang had to man up and admit he failed at the most crucial moment.
All victories leading up to here were for nothing when he botched the final and most crucial battle.
Zhuge Changfeng taunted, “Sir Leng, it seems to me that you messed with not just any monkey, but Great Sage the Equal of Heaven, ha-ha-ha...”
Leng Wuchang’s face twitched as he stewed in his own anger...
Huangpu Qingtian was floored, “Impossible! If we had never found those pills, your plan would’ve gone up in smoke and you’d lose your hand for nothing. Those pills clearly had Fang Qiubai’s... seal...”
Huangpu Qingtian’s stiff face turned to Yan Fu.
Grinning, Zhuo Fan said, “What about the seal? Ha-ha-ha, true, you wouldn’t have trusted the vials if you found them without the seals. But what if those seals were somehow removed in front of you, or given the impression that they were?”
“Yan Fu...” Huangpu Qingtian glared in hatred.
Under the bewildered gazes of everyone, Yan Fu stepped behind Zhuo Fan.
They just had the shock of their lives. Yan Fu was one of Zhuo Fan’s!
Luo Yunchang was stunned. Since when did the Luo clan get to him? Hall Lord Yan Bogong’s eyes were ready to pop from their sockets. [He’s on Zhuo Fan’s side? Since when?]
It was common knowledge that Zhuo Fan killed his master. There was no one out there who hated Zhuo Fan’s guts more than him. So how...
Ignoring the dumbstruck faces, Zhuo Fan mocked, “You guessed it, he’s with me. I made sure to give him a sending jade way earlier too. If you hadn’t found the pills on your own, he was there to make sure you’d correct that little mishap. And to make sure to remove any traces of my meddling of course.
“For you guys, someone insignificant like him would fall under your radar. But he ultimately sided with me and got you to fall for it, thus turning all this around. He takes all the credit for your defeat!”
Zhuo Fan praised Yan Fu, “You were marvelous. I won’t soon forget it.”
“Thank you, Steward Zhuo!” Yan Fu bowed.
Yan Bogong’s frail heart cracked. How was it that the pride of Pill King Hall, their genius alchemists hailed within their house, all ended up at Zhuo Fan’s hands?
And that was right under their nose too. He did it so openly, before every clan and house in Tianyu, that he literally bitch slapped Pill King Hall into the ground!
Long Jiu and Jian Suifeng sighed in admiration.
They discussed it back in Drifting Flowers City that Zhuo Fan was unequaled when it came to digging up a party’s cornerstones. But seeing it first hand, they had to take their hat off to him. And he did that with his most hateful enemy.
Not even Unwonted Contriver saw that coming. The spy Zhuo Fan planted, or converted, was none other than the one who hated him the most, Yan Fu.
Yan Bangui saw red before his eyes, “Yan Fu! You damn treacherous knave, you actually stooped so low to side with the man who killed your master? You are unworthy to be a Pill King Hall disciple, even less so to walk the earth!”
“Humph, ever since my master left, it only got worse for me living in Pill King Hall. I have nothing to return to. Who cares about being some Pill King Hall disciple? Also...”
Squinting, Yan Fu’s hate filled eyes showed a hint of warmth, unaware he clutched at his chest. There laid hidden a green jade slip...

chapters.title: Chapter 327, Revenge Game
chapters.content:
Chapter 327, Revenge Game
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
It was the same jade Zhuo Fan gave him when the man answered Huangpu Qingtian’s challenge. It had a simple sentence, one that touched his heart.
It was something his master had Zhuo Fan give to him, “If you find your life in Pill King Hall difficult, come with Steward Zhuo to find me!”
He was certain from the soul trace on the jade slip that it was without a doubt his master’s. The familiar feeling was so strong, he barely held back his tears.
His master lived in the Luo clan. And by the sound of it, quite well.
He recalled what Zhuo Fan told him at the time, that he’d take him to see his master in hell. It was a clear proof of acceptance.
From that instant, this youth who hated Zhuo Fan’s guts switched sides at the drop of the hat. He became Zhuo Fan’s spy, feeding him information in secret.
Yan Fu’s eyes snapped to his clansman and he shouted, “Yan Bangui, listen up. From this very moment, I and Pill King Hall are through. I belong to the Luo clan. A failure like you has no right to judge me.”
Yan Bangui was a keg set to blow, evident from his red face. His chest heaved yet he couldn’t find a word of reply.
[This son of a bitch finds himself some backing and thinks he can defy me? No matter how big a nerve he had earlier, he still wouldn’t curse back.] But now...
Zhuo Fan was laughing it up at their expense. He praised Yan Fu, “Well said. This is the kind of mettle all youths of the Luo clan should have. These four may be in Six Dragons and One Phoenix, but to me, they aren’t worth a goddamned thing!”
Zhuo Fan’s words were lofty and powerful, looking down on all creation.
Yan Fu was excited. Chest forward, head bobbing, the pride on his face unmistakable. He took on the same attitude he had when traveling with Vicious Pill King.
Inside he sighed. [Following Zhuo Fan is truly out of this world, freedom and bliss.] All the hatred and bitterness festering in his heart during these years magically went away. [No wonder my master got up and dumped Pill King Hall.]
His attitude sent a shiver down their spine.
Scour the world and one would find the Luo clan’s Zhuo Fan the only one to ever look at the seven houses with such loathing. [By the looks of it, this clan was growing in power, its future only bright.]
People began seeing the Luo clan in a different light.
But the Luo clan’s people had no time to mind other’s opinion of them, looking at the National Elemental Stone in worry.
Zhuo Fan was dominating the show, but seeing how wounded he was...
Luo Yunchang couldn’t fight back the pain in her heart seeing the bloody one-armed Zhuo Fan.
Outsiders got the wrong idea seeing the Luo clan so worried. They thought worry came from Zhuo Fan possibly letting emotions override his judgment and that he might do something he would regret.
In every Esoteric Debate that had been held in the past thousand years, many people died while the seven houses held each other in professional courtesy, thus coming out unharmed each time.
This time was no exception. They were split into factions, with heavy casualties on both sides, yet even in the most disastrous Esoteric Debate in history all those that died were vassals.
None from the seven houses fell, not one from Six Dragons and One Phoenix. This seemed to be the houses’ bottom line.
However, if Zhuo Fan were to get impulsive and kill these four, it would mark the start of the house war. This will make the Luo clan fodder in this war. And nobody from the Luo clan wanted to see that happen.
But they were clearly overthinking things.
They were blissfully unaware that the Luo clan was loyal to Zhuo Fan to a fault, even if fewer in numbers. They would accept any decision Zhuo Fan made, even bringing doom to the Luo clan.
Of course, with Zhuo Fan’s cunning mind there was no way he’d let that happen. So Luo clan’s people held unshakable trust in Zhuo Fan’s every action.
Zhuo Fan’s decision was Luo clan’s decision...
“What are you gawking at? He’s on his deathbed. Attack together and he will die!” Huangpu Qingtian shouted at the rest. The four of them took the Brimming Sacred Pill and couldn’t control themselves, but their vassals hadn’t and could still pose a threat to Zhuo Fan.
It was the perfect moment to strike, at his most vulnerable. Once he got better, all would be done for.
You Yushan noticed this as well and shouted along with his allies.
They didn’t get to move as the dozen Bone Tempering cultivators’ eyes went blank and they collapsed.
Zhuo Fan snickered, “I may be wounded, but did you forget? My soul is in the Radiant Stage.”
The four gasped.
They should’ve known that a sleeping tiger was still a tiger. Since when could ants take the Soaring Demonic Dragon’s life?
The four were wrecked with despair.
Huangpu Qingtian threatened, “Zhuo Fan, think this through. Killing us will start a war with our houses and the vassal clans. Are you willing to take that chance? Not even the emperor can save you then!”
“War?”
Yan Fu knew the Luo clan was under the imperial family and Dugu Zhantian’s protection, and since he had yet to be filled in to the Luo clan’s true power, he began to worry.
[Did I enter the Luo clan only to die?]
Zhuo Fan grinned, “Quite true. Killing you will start a war. How scary! But I am never one to write off a revenge. What to do, what to do? “
Zhuo Fan put on a hypocritical thinking posture. Huangpu Qingtian’s group was even more unnerved by his attitude. They hoped the punk would look at the big picture and get scared of what he saw, sparing them in the meantime.
It went double for Huangpu Qingtian. Providence had him king and all that. His life was invaluable. How could he just die?
“I have it!”
Zhuo Fan snapped his fingers, earning a jerk from his victims, “Since I have to get revenge but you are nonetheless valuable and oughtn’t be killed, I can only let heaven decide your fate.”
The four were shocked. But Zhuo Fan’s hand made a sign and the four could move. Though none of them could use their Yuan Qi.
Their cultivation was sealed.
Pff!
Huangpu Qingtian groaned as a thumb-sized hole appeared on his chest. The pain almost made him black out as he looked down.
He was unbeatable all his life, never even suffering a heavy wound. But this sudden hole exploding from within was heartrending.
Bam~
Three more groans and his allies shared his pain.
“Zhuo Fan, w-what are you going to do?” Huangpu Qingtian gnashed his teeth, “If you plan on killing us, stop playing and release us from this torment!”
“Release you? Ha-ha-ha, did you release Ning’er?”
Zhuo Fan’s smile was that of anger, “Relax, I said that your fate is in heaven’s hand and will give you guys a chance. I am a man of my word.
“The holes in your chest represent your number.” He gestured at the four.
The four found Huangpu Qingtian having one hole so he ought to be one. You Yushan had two, Yan Bangui had three and Lin Xuanfeng had four.
They looked at each other bewildered.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “We will play a game, the great escape! I will give you guys three days to find the keys and leave this place. Getting back to Dragon Cloud City, your lives will be spared. But if I find you before you leave, he-he-he, terribly sorry but that’s providence. Now you can’t blame me for being shortsighted and not giving you a way out.”
Zhuo Fan’s hand flashed and the keys to three exits appeared. He tossed them into the sky and they were soon spread all over Beast King Mountain.
“Yan Fu, make a sealed box for me holding four lots. Three days later I will be drawing one, my target. As for the rest of you lucky fellows, you’d be spared, for a while. Since I am a bastion of fairness, I will release a signal before my hunt. Your lives are now in heaven’s hands.”
With a wicked grin, Zhuo Fan waved them off, “Come on, off you go. But remember, you better hope I don’t find you~.”
The four exchanged a glance and bolted in four directions.
They knew Zhuo Fan was playing with them but they had no choice in the matter. All they could do was fight...
Yan Fu gasped and turned to Zhuo Fan, “Uh, Steward Zhuo, are you killing them or letting them go? Why go through all this trouble just to kill them? And if you wanted to let them go...”
“Humph, how could I ever let them off.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes glinted and his mood became deadly, “Yan Fu, do you fear death?”
“Uh, yes!” Yan Fu nodded after a pause.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “No, you do not fear death, but dying. Ning’er was a pure hearted girl. Although she had a smile upon her face at death, I know it was for our sakes. She knew she was going to die and must’ve felt a terrible dread. This fear tortured her for three days!”
Zhuo Fan clenched his fists, his eyes bloodshot as he spat, “So I will make those sons of bitches know the true meaning of fear every waking moment until they’d wish for death.”
Yan Fu shuddered and nodded.
Zhuo Fan never cared about some big picture, nor intended to let them off. He wanted them to suffer more than Xue Ningxiang did.
Yan Fu now understood why he did it and went into the forest to carve a box out of a tree. Zhuo Fan stayed behind, closed his eyes and resumed healing.
Time passed on and the third day was soon up. At the dawn of the fourth, Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed open, out for blood.
By his side, Yan Fu presented the box obscuring its content. This was the item that would decide the four’s fate.
The hunt was on...

chapters.title: Chapter 328, Go on Run, One-legged Dragon!
chapters.content:
Chapter 328, Go on Run, One-legged Dragon!
Editor: Elitecoder
“Which one, which one~? I wonder who’s the lucky bastard that gets to go first. The suspense is killing me.”
Sneering, Zhuo Fan snapped his fingers and a wood piece floated out of the box.
A tiny character was etched on it.
Four!
“Oh, it’s four.” Zhuo Fan’s face split into a wide and very malicious grin. Then he asked, “Remind me again, who was number four?”
Yan Fu spoke with reverence, “Steward Zhuo, number four is Forest Fleeting Dragon, Lin Xuanfeng.”
“Oh, it’s that gimp dragon. What rotten luck! Among Six Dragons and One Phoenix, I seem to recall having already taken my ire on him twice so far. Now providence has spoken and has placed him first in my path. Ha-ha-ha, I can’t help but wonder, has his crimes earned him such ill-fate or is he just so down on his luck, so cursed, to suffer hell first?”
Laughing, Zhuo Fan said, “Whatever, in his case, he truly must be ill-fated, ha-ha-ha...”
Zhuo Fan pointed at the sky.
A flare shot up and exploded into four fireworks bathing the Beast King Mountain in red.
The frantic Huangpu Qingtian, scurrying in the forest, looked up at the sound, “Four fireworks means number four. Lin Xuanfeng is such an unlucky dog.”
Huangpu Qingtian shook his head, rejoicing inside.
Zhuo Fan was really playing by the rules and wasn’t targeting him specifically. Or more likely than not, he’d be after him the first chance he got.
With Lin Xuanfeng playing the first victim, it bought him precious time to find the keys.
Tightening the red crystal in his hand, Huangpu Qingtian took a deep breath and sped up in the search for its pair.
He needed yin and yang keys to be home free.
He had to work even faster now. Who knew how fast Lin Xuanfeng would fall and who’d be the next poor schmuck to follow?
On the off chance it was him, that would mean death!
Although he breathed easier for a moment, the anxiety only mounted...
Yan Bangui and You Yushan noticed the flare with their nerves stretched taut. This meant Zhuo Fan’s death game had started.
But they relaxed soon after, seeing Zhuo Fan going after Lin Xuanfeng. Their safety was assured, for now.
Though they also knew that once Lin Xuanfeng fell, Zhuo Fan would go after them. And with their cultivation sealed up, Zhuo Fan would pick them like ants.
And so, their speed mounted, as did their will to live...
The pressure had grown on the three who lucked out but the last one was showing quite a different reaction.
“Hell yeah! I got the wood exit keys. My luck is off the hook!”
In a particularly glum and dark corner of the forest, Lin Xuanfeng clenched the two green crystals and danced in joy.
Even with a number of close to thirty thousand people wandering Beast King Mountain’s forest for a month now, the wood exit keys were never found. And here he was catching a lucky break.
[This luck is godlike!]
All he had to do was get to the wood exit and he’d be back in the safety of Dragon Cloud City.
This would make his survival, by Zhuo Fan’s game rules, providence. Zhuo Fan couldn’t touch him.
Zhuo Fan may be a very sore loser, but every elder in Dragon Cloud City, along with Dugu Zhantian and Fang Qiubai keeping the peace, would make sure to prevent any foul play.
He would be safe!
Filling his lungs with air, Lin Xuanfeng felt the urge to bow before the mighty power of heaven, to offer his gratitude for actually caring, for once, about his fate. All previous resentments were wiped clean as his luck had finally turned.
He was looking at the dawning sky with a smile on his face when a sudden flare exploded into four fireworks. The crimson sky reflected perfectly on his equally red face.
“The heavens are giving me their blessing, ha-ha-ha...”
Lin Xuanfeng was still trapped in his fantasy, giggling away. But then his smile froze.
[How can old heaven get up and burst for no rhyme or reason? That’s man-made.] With the four having their cultivation sealed, it only left Zhuo Fan.
[Is that the signal starting his death game?]
[The sky had four fireworks. Doesn’t that paint a target on #4...]
Lin Xuanfeng’s face twitched, looking rigidly at his chest and the holes in it. There they were, in all their bloody glory, four holes bored into him precisely three days ago.
[F*ck, I’m that #4!]
The corners of Lin Xuanfeng’s mouth sank and tears threatened to burst out of his eyes.
He had a good thing going here, this close to renewing his lease on life. But providence had a different plan in mind, sending Zhuo Fan on a man hunt for the first target, him.
He plunged from the glorious halls of paradise, into the infernal abyss.
[My luck has turned, worse than ever!]
[Old heaven, could you please not tease me?]
Lin Xuanfeng’s heart shuddered, his eyes hot from tears, feeling victimized. Not forgetting the fact that he wasn’t even included in the plan to kill the lass. That was all Yan Bangui and You Yushan’s doing, prodded by Huangpu Qingtian from behind.
[He should be going after those three for revenge!]
[Why! Why is it that the first one that monster is hunting is me? It’s so unfair!]
Lin Xuanfeng wailed, asking the heavens with his pitiful eyes, [What do I do now?] At this very moment, he felt like the most miserable and wretched man in this whole wide world.
Nevermind the leg Zhuo Fan snapped off of him, or the hand Zhuo Fan disintegrated. Zhuo Fan was now hot on his heels for revenge. Yet he, the only one innocent in this whole matter, was the first target.
Just what magnitude of bad luck was this?
Lin Xuanfeng’s eyes opened the floodgates.
However, he didn’t have time to wallow in self-pity. With two keys in hand, all he had to do was get to the wood exit and he’d be the winner.
Lin Xuanfeng broke into a mad dash, short of one leg, granted, but not slower than in his prime.
His title, Forest Fleeting Dragon, was granted for his amazing speed after all.
But with a flash of golden light, there came Zhuo Fan popping not a hundred yards from the man, “Lin Xuanfeng, you saw the flare I assume. Indeed, you’re my first victim. Be good and stand still, would you.”
[Isn’t it too soon? How did he find me so fast?]
Lin Xuanfeng whipped his head back and sure enough, Zhuo Fan had a positively killing smile, “Bro, can’t you cut me some slack? Huangpu Qingtian planned on killing the girl. And the other two executed it. I was in the dark when it happened. If you want revenge, go take it out on them. I’m innocent here!”
Lin Xuanfeng hopped away in panic, a sniveling mess, as he begged. But the dread only grew and the despair deepened.
Smiling, Zhuo Fan looked down on the man but never got closer. He always stayed within a hundred meters, “You’re right. Among the four, you can be called innocent. But how is it my fault your number came up? I made this game and will respect its rules. You only have old heaven to blame for your hapless fate, ha-ha-ha...”
Face sinking deeper in sorrow, Lin Xuanfeng gave his all in hopping forward, but could never shake Zhuo Fan off.
[Since it’s fate, I can only resign to it. Why must I suffer so?] The hunter could collect on his life any time he wanted, but wasn’t doing it for his own amusement.
Since death was certain, a quick one was preferred.
Lin Xuanfeng sighed and slowed down.
Zhuo Fan knew what he was thinking from a hundred meters away, “But you are also right in being innocent. Here’s a thought. I see you have the wood exit keys so I will make an exception. If you can reach the wood exit and Dragon Cloud City within a day, you win and I will consider the matter settled.”
“Truly?”
The resigned Lin Xuanfeng found a glimmer of hope and his speed shot up again. Zhuo Fan’s cold tone came from a hundred meters away again, “I’ll be right here, behind you. If your time is up and you’re still here, I’ll make my move.”
Lin Xuanfeng bobbed his head, “You said it, so you better not go back on your word!”
“Ha-ha-ha, I am playing the game by the books and with no regrets.” Zhuo Fan’s eyes glinted.
Lin Xuanfeng’s heart burst with joy and he put more power in his leg. At some point, sweat poured down him like rain and his leg seared with pain.
After hopping for half a day, he found that he still had a lot of ground left to cover. He ignored the pain and pushed through at full speed.
Zhuo Fan was always behind him, coldly staring and sharpening his bloodthirst.
[Humph, Forest Fleeting Dragon, did you really think I’ll let you live? I only chose the best way to kill you. Not a single person related to Ning’er’s death will be spared!]
Zhuo Fan scoffed internally...

chapters.title: Chapter 329, The Best Way to Die
chapters.content:
Chapter 329, The Best Way to Die
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
“Lin Xuanfeng, half a day has passed!” The owner of the cold eyes stalking the beaten up prey spoke.
Panting, Lin Xuanfeng was soaked but wasn’t slowing down even for a second. He only took deep breaths and gained more speed, not stopping for his life.
“In ten hours I’m making a move.”
Lin Xuanfeng, with his sealed cultivation, had been at it for 14 hours. His speed had been at its peak all this time and his leg shuddered with every hop. The run had been so intense, the sole of his shoe had worn off.
He’d been hopping about barefoot through thorns and bushes and was now leaving a blood trail.
He wished nothing more than to take a breather after such a long and intense fleeing.
But Zhuo Fan’s constant cold reminder from behind came as a rude awakening. Stopping meant dying, his corpse forever pushing up daisies in the middle of the forest.
Lin Xuanfeng’s sole option was to bear through the pain and run.
“Eight hours left!”
The countdown on his life aroused Lin Xuanfeng from his rambling run and swaying vision, “That’s too soon!”
A glance at the sky would give light into this matter.
Unless of course a certain face was blocking it, scaring the living daylight out of him.
“You still have time to stargaze? The clock is ticking. Better hurry up or your head will fall!” Zhuo Fan grinned.
Lin Xuanfeng gasped and forgot about the sky as he sprung forth like mad.
Zhuo Fan snickered and resumed following from behind. Like a reaper, his voice descended upon the wretched.
“Six hours left!”
Lin Xuanfeng’s eyes were bloodshot in his mad sprint.
“Four hours left!”
Lin Xuanfeng ran with his life on the line. Faster than even before he got his cultivation sealed!
“Only... two hours...” Zhuo Fan’s face twisted in a grim smile.
Lin Xuanfeng’s face fell. He was soaked in sweat, his face red as blood, but his heart was wrecked from this torment. He closed his eyes and ran head first...
Passing one more bush just like the thousands before it, Lin Xuanfeng saw a green crystal, four meters tall. The wood exit.
The audience knew Zhuo Fan and the four were playing a deadly game of chase. It looked like he was torturing them. Many believed he pulled a game on them as an excuse to come out of this pickle with his face unmarred.
Zhuo Fan was the top dog for thousands of miles around and yet still refrained from setting himself against four houses by looking for a reason to let the four go.
But when Lin Xuanfeng came out from the forest, they were shocked.
Lin Xuanfeng looked nothing like the proud Forest Fleeting Dragon of before. Passing through pointy vegetation barefoot had made pinpoint incisions each time and now his sole of the foot was stripped of flesh.
As he crossed the last bush, everyone heard a resounding crack. His knee snapped from the sheer speed, in an open fracture.
Anyone moving at such blazing speed would know what that meant. But Zhuo Fan’s constant reminder had him scared to death. His mind had been reduced to thinking only about survival and he was unaware what running for his life at such insane speed would do.
Not even when his last leg broke and his bloody face crunched into the ground did Lin Xuanfeng care. His eyes showed only madness. Watching the wood exit ahead, he cackled. “Ha-ha-ha, I’ve finally arrived. I can survive!”
With red eyes and without legs, Lin Xuanfeng crawled his way forward as his lips cracked into a smile. Euphoria descended upon his mind.
He was going to live!
This was the chance Zhuo Fan gave him, the chance to survive. Of the four he was the only one innocent, so Zhuo Fan gave him a way out, as long as he could grasp it.
Lin Xuanfeng elbowed his way faster towards his hope.
The audience was speechless. Why was he looking so wretched and yet found the time to smile?
He looked mangled, battered and wretched. Yet had such a crazed look of happiness. [What is going on?]
Nobody would know that Zhuo Fan had turned Lin Xuanfeng like this, that he had etched a demon in his heart...
“I won! I’m going to live!”
Lin Xuanfeng panted as he crawled before the wood exit. With shaking hands, he placed the keys from his ring into the groves with exultation.
The audience nodded. The guy looked to be coming out of a torture chamber but he was going home now.
As the last key approached the slot, a lazy leg stepped on his hand and he dropped the crystal.
Lin Xuanfeng looked in shock to see Zhuo Fan’s manic grin.
The audience watched the two with hearts in their throat. Was Zhuo Fan such a demon to kill him right at the very end?
Lin Xuanfeng’s face didn’t seem to say so. He wasn’t shocked, having known this was coming every two hours.
“W-why?” Blinking his bleary eyes, Lin Xuanfeng’s hoarse voice came out oozing his desperation, “I’m here, I won...”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, peering down on him, “Unfortunately, time is up. If only you were a fraction faster you’d have made it. A shame...”
Sss~
Lin Xuanfeng gasped and his face shuddered, changing from fear to sorrow, to denial, and despair. His eyes shrank and his head slumped. The agony in those eyes was so vivid, anyone could see how hopeless, how... dead they were.
The people were appalled.
A person suddenly appeared, Yan Fu.
Yan Fu asked Zhuo Fan, unclear what happened, “Steward Zhuo...”
Zhuo Fan merely gestured at the bloody man. Yan Fu kneeled and felt his neck, “Steward Zhuo, he’s dead!”
The people were frightened. Why would a perfectly fine man get up and die? Did they miss Zhuo Fan doing something?
Yan Fu asked, “He has no mortal wound. Steward Zhuo, how did you do it?”
“Through fear, exhaustion and despair.” Zhuo Fan smiled coldly.
Yan Fu was even more puzzled.
[Is this a joke? Since when can a Radiant Stage expert die from fear, exhaustion and anguish?]
Zhuo Fan said, “I sealed his cultivation so he could only draw speed from his body. When I came upon him, we were a ways away from here. Running all the way here would take three days at the minimum. But I told him he had one day to escape or I’ll kill him. He gave his all and more in running here with me behind him reminding of the time.
“Fear had gnawed at his body, making waste more stamina without even realizing it. When he finally did arrive, hope blossomed. After three long days of fear, he saw a ray of hope. His state of mind was already shaken when I came and told him the time was up. Then all that hope turned into anguish. Joy into grief, shock into fear. It all happened so fast that these emotions attacked his mind and took his life.
“That is why I said he was scared to death, but also exhausted to death. Even more so, died from anguish.” Zhuo Fan smiled.
Yan Fu’s heart thumped.
He knew Zhuo Fan was vicious, but not that monstrous. He toyed with a man’s dignity until the man fell to his death.
Gulping, Yan Fu probed, “Steward Zhuo, did he reach here in one day?”
Zhuo Fan snickered, “The kid had quite the potential. He lived up to his title and was quite fast in getting here with two hours to spare too. But as I was always behind like a reaper, I scared him and stopped him from checking the time until he even forgot about the real time. So when I said he lost, he lost it. Then despair and fear claimed him, ha-ha-ha...
“The grand Forest Fleeting Dragon truly was the fastest. So fast that he ended up breaking his only leg and died from exhaustion. Wasn’t it the best way to die? Ha-ha-ha...”
Zhuo Fan cackled.
Yan Fu and the audience were sweating bullets and a shiver went down their spines.
[Demon...]

chapters.title: Chapter 330, Next Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 330, Next Up
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
“Bring out the box. Let’s see who’s the next lucky bastard.”
Zhuo Fan’s condescending smile turned manic, “The suspense is killing me. I have to get back in the game, hi-hi-hi...”
Zhuo Fan’s demonic side was there for all to see, sending shivers and horrors to the fainthearted.
People thought Zhuo Fan was using an excuse to let them go, for the bigger picture and what not. But they all knew they had grossly overestimated him. Zhuo Fan wanted nothing more than to play a savage game and toy them to death in the process.
The hatred boiling in Zhuo Fan had driven him mad for a long time now. His ‘unorthodox’ method at exacting revenge had few appalled, and the rest horrified.
Only those three knew of Lin Xuanfeng’s true anguish and pain. The rest would be fortunate to seek out suicide than wait for Zhuo Fan to find them.
Shaking their heads, people sighed. Messing with the seven houses? Fine. Stomping on Regent Estate’s toes? Not bad either. But may god have mercy on any who was ignorant enough to incite the wrath of Demon Archon Zhuo Fan. The end wouldn’t be pretty, that was for sure...
Yan Fu presented the object of interest and Zhuo Fan smiled. He plunged his hand inside and soon came out with the lucky runner up.
Zhuo Fan looked at the number and smirked, “Humph, enemies meet on a narrow road. So I’ll be hunting down this lackey next.”
Zhuo Fan flipped the wooden piece over toward the wood exit for all to see.
Two.
None other than Xue Ningxiang’s killer, You Yushan!
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed and he pointed above.
Whoosh!
A flare rose above the clouds, exploding in a brilliant double firework.
Huangpu Qingtian and Yan Bangui checked nervously, then looked at the holes on their chest, and finally relaxed.
[Thank god it’s not me!]
Though they knew this safety was ephemeral.
With how soon Zhuo Fan let out the second flare, it went without saying that Lin Xuanfeng had bit the dust. With You Yushan as the second victim, who was to know how long he’d last before death would loom over them?
With nerves stretched tighter than a violin, the wait was mounting the ever present fear. They could literally feel Zhuo Fan’s demon claw squeezing down on their throat.
Like Zhuo Fan said, death wasn’t terrifying. But dying... was agony.
Palpable fear was their longtime companion now, Huangpu Qingtian in particular. The guy had been invincible one too many times in his life and had never experienced this side of a battle, almost having a nervous breakdown.
He had reached such a state that any loud noise was treated as Zhuo Fan sending a signal, doing nothing but pushing him further into the depths of despair.
Right now, he was angry. Providence had made him king, so how could he be such a coward? He had completely ignored the precarious and erratic state his mind was currently in.
Zhuo Fan’s death game had him running scared, crushing any royal demeanor he ever had...
In another corner of the forest, You Yushan finally had the keys to the metal exit. His cheering was quite premature and disconcerting, at least when the flare exploded in the sky and fear replaced any trace of joy.
Looking down at his own chest, two holes were there for all to see. Demon Zhuo Fan was on the hunt for him.
You Yushan’s face fell, his fate suddenly turning on him. It was so appalling that his mind exploded in quite the colorful curses.
[That damn rotten Lin Xuanfeng! Wasn’t he praised for speed? Why did he let himself get caught so fast? Did he give up? Couldn’t you hang on for at least a few days longer and let your brothers reach safety?]
[Humph, a gimp is a gimp, alive or dead. Not a single damn use!]
You Yushan cursed at the dead, but the top priority was still getting out of here and out of Zhuo Fan’s range.
As luck would have it, he was a short way off the metal exit. He only had to reach it and he’d wallow in safety.
You Yushan set into a sprint, thinking he still had some time before Zhuo Fan got to him.
You Yushan dashed like a maniac and the fact that Zhuo Fan hadn’t shown himself yet, eased some of his tense muscles.
His guess had been spot on. Zhuo Fan would need time to get to him.
But as we all know, appearances can be deceiving. The golden exit shined its glow before him, like the goddess of victory opening her arms to welcome him. But then his eyes shrank and his body froze in place.
What awaited him were two very familiar figures.
Yan Fu, the snitch, and Zhuo Fan, the demon.
The viewers sighed. [Oh, you poor poor schmuck, these two have been waiting for you for ages and you just had to walk right into their trap.]
Zhuo Fan looked at the sky and then at the dumbstruck You Yushan, “You came. I’ve been waiting here for an hour now!”
[What are you doing here? How did you know I was coming here? And more importantly, did you come here to stop me?]
You Yushan’s mind was going a mile a minute, not knowing what to do.
He just couldn’t tell if Zhuo Fan was now a master diviner or not. How did he get here so fast moments after dealing with Lin Xuanfeng?
As if a mind reader, Zhuo Fan’s cold smile came in response to his thoughts, “You Yushan, you are Ning’er’s executioner. Now then, what’s the best way to go about killing you?”
Gulping, You Yushan watched Zhuo Fan inch closer towards him. His legs were shaking like noodles and he soon collapsed in fear. He started bawling on his knees for mercy, “Brother, let me go! I am a mere underling. Leng Wuchang is the one who planned to kill her. Huangpu Qingtian was the director and I was merely following orders. Take your revenge on them, I was just a lackey, mere nobody. Please let me go!”
“Tch, what Six Dragons and One Phoenix? Aren’t they all sniveling cowards when death looms?” Yan Fu was milking his dread for all he was worth.
Zhuo Fan’s follower felt no little satisfaction seeing the grand Six Dragons and One Phoenix treated with such derision.
On the viewers’ side, everyone sported disgust at You Yushan’s character.
Valley Lord You Wanshan’s face was dark and broody. You Yushan was a dragon, which in turn represented the image of Hell Valley.
Even with his cultivation sealed, meeting Zhuo Fan would merely end up in death. But instead he opted for the coward’s way out, bawling on his knees for his miserable life, while also shaming Hell Valley completely.
The seven houses of Tianyu were seen as lofty existences, revered and feared. But now, that respect is long gone.
Even the great disciples of their houses were merely men in the end. [They fear the strong and death just like the next bloke. Even our clans have a few intrepid characters among us.]
[In this aspect at least, we are stronger than the houses...]
The seven houses were seen as gods in the Tianyu Empire. But taking them down from their cozy throne would make all the reverence vanish.
Fang Qiubai and Dugu Zhantian nodded with a smile.
The way they saw it, Zhuo Fan was practically issuing a death sentence to the houses. At the very least, the vassals the seven houses enjoyed seeing fighting over their attention, would thin out.
It was just another blow at their name, what the emperor only dreamt of achieving. Who’d have thought it would come to fruition at the hands of Zhuo Fan? The seven houses’ image was almost ruined.
[The emperor would laugh for days if he knew.]
Long Xingyun and Xie Tianshang sighed at their fortune.
The fortune of sticking with Zhuo Fan. Otherwise, they would’ve been standing in You Yushan’s place by now. Losing their life was nothing compared to losing their house’s image.
Zhuo Fan was a Demon Archon, an incontestable existence. It was far better to join him than suffer his wrath.
Long Xingyun looked at Long Yifey in respect.
[The old man knows his stuff to see the diamond in the rough. His mind is even sharper to stay close as well.]
Long Yifey noticed his son’s eyes and held his head high. [Xingyun, see that? That’s how a house lord should be, to have an eye for talent...]
Zhuo Fan smirked at the hapless and disgusting thing, “Did they also tell you to rob Ning’er’s essence?”
“Uhm...” You Yushan was sweating bullets, not missing a beat in his begging and bowing, “They wanted to see her suffer and all I could do was follow orders. You... uh, here, take the girl’s essence. Please have it and let me go.”
You Yushan took a censer from his ring and presented it.
Zhuo Fan received it and looked at the pure essence within. Feeling the familiar aura, Zhuo Fan’s hands shook, his heart was in pain and his eyes looked ready to burst, but he pushed the sadness back.
Even with the essence in his hand, his towering rage blew like a volcano, “You Yushan, since you took it, then you must know how long the body can last before it must be returned!”
“Uh... twenty four hours...” You Yushan trembled, his voice faltering under Zhuo Fan’s rage.
Squinting, Zhuo Fan barked, “You know it’s useless now, yet you still dare to give it to me? I should smash you to death with it...”
Zhuo Fan was about to do just that. You Yushan held his head in fear. But as it was Ning’er’s memento, he couldn’t bear to stain her pure essence with this filth.
Zhuo Fan put the censer away and smiled, “Do you believe taking one’s essence to be the most excruciating pain? Ha-ha-ha, that’s because you haven’t seen me do it...”

chapters.title: Chapter 331, Devoured
chapters.content:
Chapter 331, Devoured
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
“When you... do it...” You Yushan shuddered in fear.
Zhuo Fan sported his trademark twisted smile of cruelty. Those words had You Yushan scared to death.
Rumble!
You Yushan found himself paralyzed and slumped.
Zhuo Fan walked up to him and showed an icy gourd, “You Yushan, don’t you find it odd how I’m in control of all your actions? How do I know your precise location? “
Blinking, You Yushan was filled with doubt but couldn’t even speak. All he could do was watch Zhuo Fan with a chaotic mind.
“Ha-ha-ha, I don’t mind telling you my little secret. To be quite honest, none of you are poisoned, but have my demonic creature in you as a parasite. These demonic creatures are linked with me. No matter where you go or you wish to go, I’ll know it all.”
Zhuo Fan opened the gourd and a worm wiggled out.
You Yushan’s heart seized in shock.
A demonic cultivator had demonic creatures of course, but even he didn’t know of such a devastating demonic creature that could control a Radiant Stage expert.
At this moment, he realized that they had Zhuo Fan’s parasites within them and even if they did run, they wouldn’t leave Zhuo Fan’s control.
All of this death game nonsense had been rigged from the start. Zhuo Fan loomed over them like a god and they were his puppets.
You Yushan groaned in despair.
Funny how they were filled with hope in finding the keys to get out alive, when everything was set from the beginning. Their fate was sealed.
Zhuo Fan snickered, “There’s no point in crying over it. You guys still have hope. I won’t be out there looking for my next victim as long as the current one entertains me enough. Make it worth my while, let me forget about everything and the others would have enough time to escape.”
“W-what do you mean by that?” You Yushan had a very bad feeling about this.
Zhuo Fan laughed and said, “Simple really. I’m ready to have some fun with you.”
Zhuo Fan flipped the gourd and Bloodworms spilled out on You Yushan. He was deathly pale but couldn’t move, only panicked, “Zhuo Fan, what are you doing?”
“Ha-ha-ha, what indeed. Can’t you tell? I’m letting you have a taste of a pain worse than ‘death by essence extraction’.” Zhuo Fan’s eyes showed his savagery.
Ah!
A wail of agony broke the stillness of the forest. Those thousand squirming Bloodworms burrowed into You Yushan’s skin.
They began feasting on his flesh and blood started pouring from his body.
His face twisted in pain, veins popping, mouth trembling from wanting to bite his tongue but he was robbed of even that freedom.
Zhuo Fan watched the convulsing body with eerie calmness, “I’ve fed these thousand Bloodworms my blood essence, but how could my meager blood be enough to quench their hunger? Fighting over a single drop of blood has turned them vicious. But thanks to you showing up, they can finally have their fill, ha-ha-ha...
“And that’s not even half of it. They have tiny jaws but are quite pointy, with a passion for a man’s mind. Over the next few days, you ought to feel it, the pain. It’s likely a hundred times worse than having your essence drawn! The good news is, they are quite the slow eaters and like to keep the taste fresh, you see. So as they work their way deeper, they make sure to keep you from bleeding out. You won’t die anytime soon, let me tell you, just enough for you to enjoy the sweet and blissful pain, ha-ha-ha...”
“Ah~, just kill me!” You Yushan gnashed his teeth, roaring like a beast.
Zhuo Fan only mocked him, “That’s not very nice. All the pain you’re feeling will help buy your eldest young master time. Isn’t he your master? Weren’t you obeying his orders? What can a meager sacrifice compare to that?”
“F*ck him and kill me already! Then go and kill him too. Why should I suffer for him?” You Yushan’s eyes were popping out of his skull.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes glinted coldly, “Since you don’t consider him your master, why did you listen to his order and let Ning’er suffer? Humph, wake up and smell the roses. A man should own up to his mistakes and bear through the consequences.”
Zhuo Fan smiled and sat down to the side to heal. The wails of agony music to his ears.
Yan Fu shuddered, his back cold as ice. Glancing at the howling figure, then at the calm Zhuo Fan, his awe only grew.
[Steward Zhuo’s revenge isn’t to be taken lightly. Not even the insufferable brats from the seven houses have such capacity for cruelty.]
This was a good opportunity to see the vicious side of Soaring Demonic Dragon.
The viewers listened to the screams with fear in their hearts. Xue clan’s three generations knew Zhuo Fan was doing it for Ning’er, but even they found the cruelty a touch inhumane.
They found the murderer of their dear Ning’er a sorry sight, having offended Zhuo Fan. They actually felt pity for him.
If the victims themselves would think so of their tormentor, it went without saying about the rest.
In the minds of everyone out there, a single thought ruled, [Never ever mess with this Demon Archon!]
Even as time trickled by, You Yushan’s ravings never stopped.
A day later, You Yushan’s skin was gnawed away by the Bloodworms, his face unrecognizable. He looked like a dried corpse, red all over yet without a drop of blood on him.
The Bloodworms made sure not to spill their drink, while You Yushan’s screams were relentless.
On the second day, all of You Yushan’s tendons were devoured. All that was left was a pile of flesh, having nothing to hold him together.
But You Yushan’s cries kept on coming.
On the third day, You Yushan’s flesh was next. Even if he wanted to wail now, he couldn’t. Wailing for two days straight had turned him mute.
Then came the fourth day and the Bloodworms went to work on his bones.
...
Finally, on the 9th day, You Yushan was picked almost completely clean. Whether intentional or not, the Bloodworms left behind his vital organs intact. As if to let him see with his own eyes the gory sight that he was, without flesh and bones.
At this vile and gruesome sight, Yan Fu’s stomach flipped and emptied.
The viewers were horrified by the torture, turning away to keep their own sanity.
You Yushan’s eyes glistened, begging Zhuo Fan for death, the only thing he could do. His throat, neck and tongue had long been devoured.
All that was left of him were a few arteries and organs barely keeping him from flat-lining. Yet it was a pain worse than death.
Zhuo Fan glanced at the sufferer, looked at his pleading face, and said, “Want to die?”
You Yushan rolled his eyes frantically. With the eyelids gone as well, he was hardly equipped to convey his meaning.
Zhuo Fan understood him clearly either way.
Zhuo Fan said, “Let this be a lesson. You can mess with the king of hell, but never with this steward.”
You Yushan’s eyes moved faster, to convey that he understood. The viewers watched in shock.
Zhuo Fan was speaking more to them than to the dying You Yushan. His meaning was crystal clear.
[See that? Be nice and don’t side with that rotten Regent Estate against me. So what if you’re from the seven houses? Your death will be as brutal as I feel like it.]
Everyone came to the same sensible decision then and there, to be cautious. While for Regent Estate’s vassals, their minds began working as well, although from a different angle.
To never involve themselves with the Luo clan, even in death.
[Their steward is a god damned inquisitor!]
Fang Qiubai rejoiced inside. [The brat is awesome. He made one guy take the fall and scared the rest from ever getting anywhere near Regent Estate.]
Huangpu Tianyuan’s face sank. He felt it loud and clear, how Zhuo Fan had trampled on the Regent Estate’s thousand year long prestige.
How could they proclaim themselves rulers over Tianyu if everyone gave them a wide berth?
Everyone from the Regent Estate looked at Zhuo Fan with hatred, and helplessness...
Zhuo Fan signaled the Bloodworms to devour the organs. They moved quickly and You Yushan was gone in moments.
It was obvious that Zhuo Fan was lying out of his ass when he said that Bloodworms were slow eaters. it was only a means to torture You Yushan more.
But watching himself being eaten quickly, spared of any further torment, You Yushan’s final gaze was that of relief.
Yan Fu gasped and rushed with the box over, “Steward Zhuo, please.”
“No need.”
Zhuo Fan waved, his eyes savage, “We’ve wasted too much time here and the criminals are about to escape.”
Zhuo Fan released another flare.
One firework, Huangpu Qingtian’s number was up. [Just you wait. You are the one who will never ever leave this place alive...]

chapters.title: Chapter 332, Dragon Eater
chapters.content:
Chapter 332, Dragon Eater
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
Bang!
A blazing light shined above Beast King Mountain just as Huangpu Qingtian got out from a bush. He saw a single firework and panicked.
[The demon has finally set his sights on me. However...]
With a sly grin, Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes glinted and his hand flickered with two red crystals.
[He-he-he, too little too late!]
Huangpu Qingtian took a deep breath and rushed forward filled with excitement.
He had the fire keys and even the fire exit was just around the corner, needing merely two hours to reach it.
From the distance of the flare, he noticed that Zhuo Fan was far away and would need a long time to catch up with how damaged he was.
[Even in this great escape, the true winner shall be me, the rightful king!]
“Ha-ha-ha, You Yushan, well done in keeping the demon occupied for so long. I really have to thank you for helping me live!”
Huangpu Qingtian’s tone turned colder, “Although, that’s providence. Sacrificing yourself for me is the highest form of death! I am a true king for old heaven to pave my way, ha-ha-ha...”
Cackling, Huangpu Qingtian sped up as the arrogance returned to his face.
To him, everything and anything that happened was providence.
Zhuo Fan could’ve easily broken his neck and be done with, but who knew what came over him to turn it all into a death game. Zhuo Fan had already killed two of them, leaving the first and third free to roam the forest for quite a long time.
This was clearly heaven bestowing its blessings and allowing the rightful king to make a comeback, to rule the world.
Huangpu Qingtian’s narcissistic tendencies knew no bounds, “Zhuo Fan, I’ll let you have this one. But I am the true king. One day you will die by my hand, humph...”
Bloodthirst entered his eyes as he ran faster.
...
Whoosh~
An hour later, Huangpu Qingtian flashed out of the high grass and appeared before the crimson crystal exit, with no one else around.
Huangpu Qingtian’s face lit up.
[I knew the punk wouldn’t make it. It’s my win.]
The viewers saw him appear as well and were getting nervous.
Was Zhuo Fan running late, leaving this guy to win?
Everyone thought of it as a darn shame. Not just Drifting Flowers Edifice and allies, but Regent Estate’s many vassals hung their heads in defeat.
It had started with Zhuo Fan having the four of their lives at his fingertips. He had insisted on torturing them one at a time only to finally let the main culprit off the hook.
It wasn’t out of hate for Huangpu Qingtian, but people felt sorry for Zhuo Fan. If the prey slipped away from one’s fingers, it was the worst feeling anyone could have.
People started to send their hearts to Zhuo Fan. [This must be the magnetism of the strong...]
Leng Wuchang frowned at everyone’s reaction. As things stood, it was only a matter of time before Zhuo Fan would tarnish Regent Estate’s entire reputation.
The elders from Regent Estate had no clue about this, only rejoicing at seeing their eldest young master almost out of the woods.
Huangpu Qingtian was after all a renowned genius that not even the Regent Estate could afford to lose.
“I just need to put the crystals in and I’m done.”
Panting, Huangpu Qingtian reached the exit and stabbed the crystals in the grooves.
Hum~
A red pillar shot for the skies in a dazzling light show.
Huangpu Qingtian stared at the light with a smile, “Ha-ha-ha, Zhuo Fan, I won! I’m still alive.”
Regent Estate’s elders were excited as well, watching the National Elemental Stone with red eyes. If only the array wasn’t a one way transfer, they’d be in there dragging him here.
[Eldest young master, don’t show off and hurry already!]
But a king wasn’t a king without a bit of swag and hot air. Since he got out of hell, he had to first regain his rightful appearance worthy of his position, being unnecessarily pompous.
Unhurried in the least, especially when one step got him home, Huangpu Qingtian’s cocky look made the Regent Estate elders gnash their teeth.
Huangpu Qingtian first began with cleaning up his act and straightening his messy hair. He didn’t forget to recover his usual haughty look after the exhaustion he had suffered all these days running, to regain his poised nobility and to return home triumphant.
Regent Estate elders’ faces twitched. They wished nothing more than to give him a beating.
[Eldest young master, prancing aside, you’re still in grave danger. Your life is about to run out yet you actually have the time to stroke your ego?]
[Humph, you’ll only have yourself to blame if you die now.]
The Regent Estate’s elders sighed, not realizing their complaints turned out to be curses.
Huangpu Qingtian, having finally recovered a modicum of royal cockyness, strutted towards the fire exit like the true winner of the Esoteric Debate.
Then, a thunderous boom came with the fall of lightning.
“Stop!”
Huangpu Qingtian’s lifted leg twisted and exploded in a mist of blood. His body had yet to pass the veil and a heart rending pain stabbed his chest as he collapsed.
Huangpu Qingtian didn’t need to turn around to know who was behind him.
Startled, Huangpu Qingtian never would’ve guessed Zhuo Fan would reach him so fast when he was already so hurt. Does this mean he was going to die?
What about that prancing just now? All that showing off and priming himself made him look like a clown.
Huangpu Qingtian gnashed his teeth and kicked with his remaining leg before he hit the ground, aiming for the exit.
His life aside, he had to survive and maintain his regal prestige. He could not allow his royal self to be reduced to a laughing stock. He had to become the final winner, the only champion and receive the people’s worship.
But a flash of thunder and a black figure slamming into his spine, destroyed any hope of reaching the full height of his glory. Instead, he was now a meter into the ground and spitting blood.
What made it worse was his finger being a millimeter from victory. So close yet so far.
“Eldest young master!”
The Regent Estate elders cried. Struggling so hard to make one last push yet failing, filled Huangpu Qingtian with desperation.
Stepping on Huangpu Qingtian, Zhuo Fan grinned and panted, “Huangpu Qingtian, I finally caught up. You almost had me worried there, that I would lose my chance, he-he-he...”
“Zhuo Fan, how did you get here so fast...” Huangpu Qingtian turned a hateful glare at the man on his spine. But didn’t finish as it all made sense.
Behind Zhuo Fan was Yan Fu jumping off of a purple bird and rushing to Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan snickered, “Do you get it now? I lost my wings, but I still have a Thunder Skylark. With speed as its focus, it was of great help catching up in time.”
Huangpu Qingtian lamented.
[How could I forget that punk still had a spiritual beast?] It had gotten to his head that with the punk’s meager speed, he had enough time to prance a bit and tend to his regal good looks.
He would’ve skipped all that waste of time if he knew and avoided this mess by jumping right in.
But no, he just had to show off his flashy side and die, becoming the butt of Tianyu’s joke!
Huangpu Qingtian wailed some more, “Zhuo Fan, kill me then! But I am king decreed by heaven and I ask that you let me go with dignity.”
Squinting, Zhuo Fan snorted, “Humph, dignity is it? Sure. I’ll make sure to pick the most dignified death I can think of.”
Zhuo Fan leaned and bit his ear off.
Ah!
Huangpu Qingtian raved in pain, “Z-Zhuo Fan, what are you doing?”
“Me? Humph, didn’t you want the most dignified death? Wish granted. I’ll bury you all in my belly, far more respectful than having dirt peppered all over you in a hole somewhere.” Zhuo Fan grinned with bloodthirsty eyes.
That came as a shock to all who heard him.
Soaring Demonic Dragon was planning on eating Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord alive?
Followed by shivers of fear.
[That is the cruelest death yet...]

chapters.title: Chapter 333, Royal Transfer
chapters.content:
Chapter 333, Royal Transfer
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
Huangpu Qingtian was startled at his words and saw Zhuo Fan spit his ear horrified.
How come he didn’t see Zhuo Fan coming up with such a gruesome death penalty for him?
[What dignified? I will even lose my rights as a human being!] What made it worse was being stripped of his kingly aura.
Far more gruesome than Lin Xuanfeng and You Yushan’s deaths, that was for sure...
“Zhuo Fan, y-you’re a demon. You dare eat me?” Huangpu Qingtian squinted, appalled.
Grinning, with Huangpu Qingtian’s blood marring his lips, Zhuo Fan’s eyes had a manic glint, “Yes, that’s exactly right. I was thinking about the best way to torture you, for you to feel the most pain. I’ve decided this is the perfect end for you.
“It won’t be the most painful – You Yushan had it a hundred times worse- nor the most humiliating – Lin Xuanfeng has you beat at that – but for the one sentencing Ning’er to death, I chose this for you. And do you know why? Ha-ha-ha, it’s the one that brings me the most joy. Devouring you is the only way to ease this raging maelstrom of hatred inside of me.”
Zhuo Fan bit down again, took off a large chunk from Huangpu Qingtian’s scruff, making his victim howl to the sky and tears flow down his cheeks.
Yan Fu shuddered and took two discreet steps back. The viewers couldn’t look anymore, feeling bile coming into their throats. Their hearts hammered in their chest, threatening to jump out any second.
Zhuo Fan was right. Eating him alive wasn’t the most painful, nor the most shameful, but it was the most horrible.
Everyone had fear in their eyes.
Zhuo Fan’s earlier punishments made him look like a demon, but now he was a demon archon.
Only Chu Qingcheng was without worry, fear or anxiety, just sadness.
For Zhuo Fan to have such hatred towards Huangpu Qingtian, it showed the pain he was enduring. A pain so great that only through this savage act could he somewhat appease it...
Ah!
Zhuo Fan grinned. Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes bulged, his veins popped, his regal face twisted horribly.
“Zhuo Fan, I am the rightful king appointed by providence itself. You will receive heavenly punishment for eating me!” Huangpu Qingtian roared.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “He-he-he, heavenly punishment? I’ve been going against heaven all this time so what’s there to fear going a bit further? Your so-called providence is a grand delusion you found yourself in. Even if you had heaven’s protection, it wouldn’t change a thing. I’d still come after you even if I had to pierce the nine heavens!”
Zhuo Fan bit down again, his teeth bloody.
Roar!
Incited by Huangpu Qingtian’s words, a dragon roar sounded and his bloody body let out a golden light.
Zhuo Fan was startled. He had the Bloodworm seal Huangpu Qingtian’s cultivation. [So why is he releasing such a strong power?]
The answer came soon.
The golden dragon soul shot from Huangpu Qingtian into the sky before coming back down towards Zhuo Fan.
Dragon soul’s protection!
Zhuo Fan frowned and sighed. He had totally forgotten about Huangpu Qingtian’s Dragon Vein Soul coming to save him in dire moments.
Leng Wuchang and Huangpu Tianyuan snickered at this point. Zhuo Fan was so weak that the Dragon Vein Soul would attack his soul and end him.
Hu~
A dragon image flashed by and the dragon soul passed through Zhuo Fan. A searing pain struck his head and he spat blood from how damaged his soul was.
“Ha-ha-ha, Zhuo Fan, you got what was coming for you! If you’d just killed me, none of this would’ve happened. But you, a lesser man, had to dare eat this king. Now you will die being devoured by the dragon soul!”
Huangpu Qingtian cackled. Despite being riddled with bite wounds, he still had the time to laugh, “I am the true rightful king of heaven. I am untouchable, ha-ha-ha...”
Fang Qiubai was startled.
In the most intense moment, the Dragon Vein Soul actually came out to defend him. [Is Huangpu Qingtian truly a son of heaven for the dragon soul to protect him so much?]
Zhuo Fan only grinned. He saw the dragon soul coming for another pass and said, “Humph, a mere earth spirit dares defy this emperor? Die!”
Then an azure flame flickered from his forehead.
The azure flame expanded into a firebird. It took to the skies and shot for the petrified dragon soul.
The dragon soul downright panicked, shuddered, then hightailed it.
A bit too late for that, unfortunately. The azure bird flashed before it and clawed at its body. It held the dragon like a meager worm as it doubled back.
The dragon soul only whimpered as the bird flew back to Zhuo Fan.
Now that got a reaction out of the crowd, or more precisely a lack of reaction. People stared at Zhuo Fan blankly. Huangpu Qingtian’s mind blew away as he couldn’t quite find any words to speak.
[What the hell? That’s a Dragon Vein Soul! How does a blue bird get to dangle it back just like that?]
“The kid has his own spirit, far stronger than even Huangpu Qingtian’s Dragon Vein Soul!” Fang Qiubai shouted.
The Dragon Vein Soul was a rarity in the world, the symbol of kings. Who thought it possible then that Zhuo Fan would have something far more deadly?
[Just who is he? He is from a third rate clan so why is he covered with treasures?]
Zhuge Changfeng stroked his beard, watching Zhuo Fan with blazing eyes.
Only Regent Estate’s side was in pain. The stronger Zhuo Fan was, the bigger the threat. And now that the king’s symbol was crushed so easily, this feeling only grew stronger.
This signified he was the rightful king upon this world, heaven approved.
Regent Estate’s resentment billowed and their hatred grew. Zhuo Fan, the little demon, no longer just had the potential to be a threat, but a veritable one at their own survival. A monster that defied the heavens.
“We need to make time and seek the High Priest for answers. Where did he come from? How did he make the Dragon Vein Soul surrender?” Huangpu Tianyuan sighed.
Leng Wuchang nodded as well, his face deep in ponder.
Man proposed and heaven disposed. Leng Wuchang had flawless plans, but that only accounted for men. Anything he tried with those decreed by heaven would be rendered null. They would be under providence’s care and would come back from death’s door stronger than ever.
He never wanted to mess with these freaks for the same reason.
Huangpu Qingtian qualified as one when he got the dragon soul’s approval. All of the Regent Estate, including him, called Huangpu Qingtian as heaven’s chosen. That his arrogance was god given and justified.
That belief only grew stronger as the third of the Four Pillars, Tianyu’s High Priest gave his vague acknowledgment.
But at this very moment, this heaven’s chosen was being eaten alive by Zhuo Fan. Even his guardian, dragon soul, could do nothing to stop it.
[Is this also by providence that the punk has a kingly disposition? Or is it perhaps coming from somewhere beyond heaven?]
Leng Wuchang saw Zhuo Fan as a fearful enigma.
Huangpu Qingtian saw his dragon soul coming back in the bird’s claws and cried, “Zhuo Fan, who the hell are you? You just called yourself emperor, then...”
“None of your business!”
Zhuo Fan mocked, “All you need to know is this. Messing with me is the worst mistake of your miserable life!”
Zhuo Fan took a bite out of his throat this time, tearing it off.
Blood poured and Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes dulled, feeling his life drained from him. With that, the golden energy left his body and entered Zhuo Fan.
The azure bird brought the dragon soul back. Just in time to see the golden energy moving into Zhuo Fan, it released its claws in shock.
The dragon soul roared in its newfound freedom.
But it didn’t attack Zhuo Fan this time, and instead circled him twice. It watched the golden energy move then entered Zhuo Fan’s body itself.
Roar!
As another dragon roar came, Zhuo Fan didn’t seem to feel any change but then he exploded with light.
The azure bird nodded and returned into Zhuo Fan as well.
Huangpu Tianyuan, having witnessed this event, cried, “Royal transfer! The world is about to change!”

chapters.title: Chapter 334, World Changes
chapters.content:
Chapter 334, World Changes
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
Roar!
With one more dragon roar, Zhuo Fan glowed golden as he himself let out a roar of his own.
Huangpu Qingtian soaked in his own blood, weak and fading. Watching the blinding golden light, he shouted his frustration and agony in his mind.
[T-that is my right! Zhuo Fan, give it back, give it... back...]
Zhuo Fan had bit his throat clean off and he had no way to speak. He could only express the regret and resentment on his face as he watched his greatest enemy steal his own dragon soul, take his dragon power and for providence to make him king instead.
[How is this possible? How can providence change? I am Tianyu’s rightful ruler. Return my dragon soul! It’s not you, not you...]
Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes dimmed and he finally slumped his head, losing the last trace of life.
Only his resentful eyes still spoke of his wretched death...
The viewers couldn’t care less about Huangpu Qingtian’s grievances. They had more important things to mind right now, like watching Zhuo Fan.
[Dragon Vein’s dragon soul can be transferred? Does that mean Zhuo Fan is the new king decreed by heaven?]
Rumble!
With a thunder clap, the sky darkened and lightning brewed. The earth shook so hard no one could stand up straight.
On Beast King Mountain, all spiritual beasts curled up in the safety of their den. Even the dreaded 6th level spiritual beasts tucked away their heads in fear.
Only Zhuo Fan roared at the sky, while the golden light grew in intensity.
“Prime Minister, what’s happening?” His two elders asked.
Zhuge Changfeng saw them baffled and sighed with a grave face as he said, “The High Priest told me once that when the world shakes, heavy changes are upon us. Tianyu is about to change!”
The people turned back to the roaring Zhuo Fan with a pensive expression.
[Is this change related to that man?]
In Regent Estate’s home city, Caged Dragon City, the earth shuddered, and the entire city wobbled. High Venerable Huangpu Fenglei woke up from his meditation in shock.
He came out of his room and shouted, “Guard, what is going on?”
“High Venerable, the Dragon Vein is rebelling!” A Profound Heaven expert kneeled.
Huangpu Fenglei shouted, “Impossible. Regent Estate has defended the Dragon Vein for a thousand years and it has never rebelled once. One of the nine dragon souls even came out from the seal so how can it still rebel?”
“I don’t know, but the other eight are hammering the seal. The shock waves have killed many Bone Tempering experts. We can’t hold much longer, High Venerable. What do we do?”
Huangpu Fenglei frowned and shouted, “Call all Regent Estate’s Venerables at the seal and suppress the dragon souls. Get the ones in seclusion as well. If they are released, we’ll be the first to suffer their wrath!”
“Understood!” The man rushed to obey.
Huangpu Fenglei shot for the seal the next second. He just couldn’t make sense of why the Dragon Vein Souls would suddenly rebel.
In a dark alley of Caged Dragon City, shadows shifted.
“Elder Yan, how do we get in with Regent Estate on high alert?” A charming voice said. She was Lei Yuting, Luo clan’s shadow corps’ captain.
The one across from her was Vicious Pill King, in his forties.
Looking at the strict guard at the gate, just like in the imperial capital, Yan Song sighed, “Even with the Energy Concealing Pill to evade the guards, we’ll be sitting ducks once we set foot inside with the dozens of Venerables and their Discerning Fields. Slipping in now is impossible!”
“We still have to do it. Zhuo Fan said we will one day go to war with the seven houses and an intelligence network is paramount. With the Regent Estate having Leng Wuchang, it is imperative that we get any information as early as possible.” Lei Yuting was firm in her decision.
Yan Song sighed. He caressed his beard, thinking of a way to achieve it.
A sudden boom shook the ground and the sky and a billowing black cloud launched lightning everywhere in Caged Dragon City.
Yan Song’s team had no idea what happened. All they saw were men rushing towards a golden light.
They were a mix of Radiant Stage experts and Profound Heaven experts!
Vicious Pill King was speechless then burst out, “Ha-ha-ha, it’s providence! Something big must be happening to Regent Estate right now to get all Venerables and their Profound Heaven experts to leave this place. It doesn’t get more deserted than this. Lass, follow me!”
“Great!” Lei Yuting perked up and signaled for the other men to follow as they slipped within Regent Estate. Each one of them was carrying a meter large bag with something squirming inside...
In the imperial capital, the emperor was perusing a report, checking the empire’s situation, when the rumbling started. A black cloud thick as night loomed overhead, flickering with lightning.
The earth was shaking so badly that the ink spilled on the neat parchment.
“What’s going on? Tianyu has been enjoying prosperity for a thousand years. How can it suddenly shake so much?”
The emperor swayed as the reports were rolling on the floor, “This isn’t a good sign, something bad is happening. Guard, send for the High Priest!”
“Report!”
What came was a guard bowing and presenting a paper, “Your Majesty, the Parish had sent someone over and asked me to present this paper to Your Majesty. They added that all that concerns Your Majesty is in here. If there are still doubts, they cannot help as heaven does not reveal its secrets.”
Eyes twitching, the emperor said, “Give it here. That old geezer must be a god to pry into heaven’s will and foresee this event.”
“Yes!”
The guard presented the paper. The emperor took it and frowned as he read. A short poem was written, but he couldn’t make sense of it.
“The world shook at the shake of the earth dragon’s tail, then came the celestial dragon to quell the chaos. As both the celestial and earth dragons exist, the land and rivers shall each call their king!”
“What is this supposed to mean? Does the old foggie only know to talk in riddles? Can’t he say anything clearly?” The emperor shook his head as he pondered, “The land and rivers shall each call their king... Does it mean Tianyu will split and the empire will be in chaos?”
The emperor’s eyes flashed, “NO, I can’t let that happen. My Yuwen clan won’t be divided. Humph, what land, rivers and kings? Tianyu will forever remain whole, under the Yuwen clan!”
The emperor stared at the billowing thunder cloud with intense killing intent.
[Not even heaven can stop me...]
On Beast King Mountain, Zhuo Fan howled for nine days and nine nights. The shaking soon spread to all of the Tianyu Empire, persisting just as long. It only stopped when Zhuo Fan did.
The audience watched in shock, knowing full well that the world had changed and that Zhuo Fan was in the center of it all. Was this the world’s way of bestowing royal power?
Everyone started seeing Zhuo Fan in a different light.
Fang Qiubai especially. He used to care about Zhuo Fan’s fate, and now could feel Zhuo Fan, with the dragon soul and providence by his side, was the greatest threat to Tianyu’s imperial family.
It left him pulled in two directions. Should he snuff him in the cradle or report to His Majesty?
Dugu Zhantian was in the same situation.
He and the Luo clan were practically family. Luo Yunhai was even his fifth godson. He could never raise his hand against the Luo clan’s steward.
But Zhuo Fan was now a threat to the imperial family. A loyal marshal like him couldn’t overlook this.
The two looked at each other and sighed.
Leng Wuchang saw their dilemma and whispered to Huangpu Tianyuan, “Estate Lord, the kid will arrive any second now. You and the other three house lords are to kill him swiftly and prevent a calamity.”
“How can that be? Fang Qiubai and Dugu Zhantian are Radiant Stage experts. That’s asking for death, attacking right in front of them.” Huangpu Tianyuan gasped.
Leng Wuchang shook his head, “Estate Lord, relax. They would’ve done anything to protect Zhuo Fan earlier, but now things have changed. We aren’t the only ones who want to see the kid dead. Because of grief, you couldn’t hold your hand and killed the kid. Won’t you garner everyone’s sympathy?”
Huangpu Tianyuan’s eyes lit up and he saw reason. He nodded, with a sinister smile...

chapters.title: Chapter 335, Fanatic Protects
chapters.content:
Chapter 335, Fanatic Protects
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan looked at the faint golden glow around himself and smiled sensing the golden dragon resting in his Dantian.
He had used Diamond Sand to temper himself and now he had Dragon Vein’s dragon power and a king’s dragon soul. Three great treasures for body cultivation combined in one vessel.
He simply needed to refine the dragon power and unite with the dragon soul and his body would soar above even Huangpu Qingtian’s.
Speaking of which, he threw a condescending smile at those resentful eyes, “Weren’t you calling yourself a rightful king, decreed by providence? Humph, I stole everything you had, including your destiny...”
Suddenly, Zhuo Fan fell silent and his heart felt uneasy.
[Is the dragon soul’s shift heaven sent or a disaster?]
He felt something in the air had changed. As the dragon soul now resided within his body, he sensed the other factions’ attitude shift. Especially the imperial family’s.
Then again, which emperor out there would allow the one calling himself rightful king take his throne?
Huangpu Qingtian was so egotistical to spout it left and right because the Regent Estate had his back. For Zhuo Fan to keep his life...
[The time has come for the Luo clan to show its power!]
Squinting, Zhuo Fan sighed.
Then, a yellow pillar of light shot into the sky a thousand miles from him. Yan Fu paled, “Yan Bangui got away!”
Zhuo Fan glanced and merely shook his head, “An ant, nothing more.”
Yan Fu stammered, but kept his trap shut despite the resentment.
“What, you have a bone to pick with him?” Zhuo Fan saw right through him.
Yan Fu only sighed.
Zhuo Fan patted his shoulder, his eyes glinting mysteriously, “Relax, you are with me now. I will definitely help you deal with it.”
Yan Fu saw Zhuo Fan’s cryptic smile...
Yan Bangui passed through the earth National Elemental Stone flustered, gasping and rejoicing for having escaped that living nightmare.
Yan Bogong almost broke down crying from joy.
[My family! I’m finally back. It wasn’t easy escaping that monster.]
Yan Bogong saw Pill King Hall’s most prized pupil return in tears. Of the six dragons, Zhuo Fan had reaped three, making the last survivor to be treated like a treasure.
The Pill King Hall rushed to console him and congratulate the safe return of their Plague Dragon.
After a short moment of joy, Hall Lord Yan Bogong turned to Zhuo Fan being reflected on the fire National Elemental Stone. His face grew dark and he said, “Bangui, we and Estate Lord Huangpu struck a secret deal. When the punk comes back we’ll attack him together. Stay behind me and try to land the killing blow to wash the shame of betrayal. Let the world know of Pill King Hall’s power.”
Yan Bangui jerked, but when he saw Zhuo Fan all he had was deep rooted fear.
[Spare me, Hall Lord! I escaped that monster by the skin of my teeth and now you want me to die again?]
Yan Bogong knew what he was thinking and got angry, “Useless prick, are you that horrified after the punk gave you a little fright? Humph, relax. It will be us old fellows going first. You only have to go and collect his head and restore our image. This is an easy merit. What, you don’t even know how to pick up a head?”
Yan Bangui was quite hesitant but nodded at the end.
Yan Bogong broke out into a smile, “That’s our Pill King Hall’s disciple, ha-ha-ha...”
Viewers turned their attention to the fire National Elemental Stone, waiting for Zhuo Fan and Yan Fu’s return.
“It’s time.”
Zhuo Fan stood before the fire exit, viewers clueless of his meaning as was Yan Fu. But then, he looked at the sky and raised his palm as he muttered.
Yan Fu asked, “Steward Zhuo, what...”
“Yan Fu, weren’t you vexed at letting Yan Bangui off? Ha-ha-ha, as a reward for your great service, and your welcome gift in the Luo clan, I, its steward, shall fulfill your cherished wish.”
Zhuo Fan started to bend one finger at a time as he said, “Five, four...”
Everyone was puzzled just like Yan Fu.
Three, two...
“What is the punk playing at?” Yan Bogong looked at his allies.
Only Leng Wuchang was in constant pondering, then shouted at Yan Bogong, “Hall Lord Yan, get away from the kid!”
“What?” Yan Bogong was still out of it.
Just then, everyone heard, “One.”
With the final word, Zhuo Fan made a fist.
Bang!
A ringing explosion came out of nowhere as Yan Bangui didn’t even realize as he went boom.
The devastating power crippled the elders from Pill King Hall. Yan Bangui had just entered the Radiant Stage and his explosion took many elders down with him.
Even their vassals came out bloodied. Their casualties were in the hundreds.
While the lucky ones who survived didn’t get to enjoy their fortune as Yan Bangui’s blood landed on them, eating their flesh and bone alike.
Everything around Pill King Hall was thrown into chaos, with corpses littering the ground. Pill King Hall instantly lost eight elders, a crippling blow.
Yan Bogong crawled from beneath a pile of corpses and shook at the carnage laid before him. [What happened? Why are Pill King Hall’s experts almost all dead?]
Looking at the corpse pinning him down, Yan Bogong panicked as he pushed it away, seeing it was eaten by Yan Bangui’s blood, a trait of the poison body. If not for the guy taking the fall for him, he’d be dead right now.
The other houses saw the horror and fled from Pill King Hall.
No one could understand why the peach-perfect Yan Bangui just popped.
But a malicious cackle grated their ears.
Hi-hi-hi!
Zhuo Fan held his forehead as he laughed. Noone got the joke and neither did Yan Fu, “Uh... Steward Zhuo, what’s wrong?”
“Oh, nothing, only laughing at a bunch of morons. Did they actually think I’d let him live?”
Yan Fu blinked, to which Zhuo Fan explained, “From the start, I made sure to come prepared. The Bloodworms are connected to me so I made sure to arm them. As long as any of those dumbasses left Beast King Mountain, they were to self-destruct in ten minutes. What a stroke of luck, they always believed they had a way out and they gave their all in reaching the exit. All of it was just a grand act, a joke of epic proportions, ha-ha-ha...”
“This entire game was never meant to have a winner!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes glinted.
Yan Fu’s heart froze. Going by his words, Yan Bangui became a ticking time bomb the moment he stepped in Dragon Cloud City. He must be in pieces by now!
Zhuo Fan grinned, knowing what was going in that head of his, “You guessed it, the brat is toast, cooked. A Radiant Stage expert’s self-destruct ought to have taken many lives with him as well. As for how many, he-he-he, care to guess?”
Was there even a point? Almost none from Pill King Hall could escape. Yan Bangui was put in the center moments after returning.
Finding out that the rotten senior brother of his who always mocked him was toyed to death by the demon himself, Yan Fu should be happy. But no joy reached his heart.
For some odd reason, he felt safe around Zhuo Fan, true, but the fear was up to par by comparison. It was unnerving. Even when his most hated enemy suffered at the hands of the demon, what he felt instead was a bit of sympathy.
[True to his words. ‘You can mess with the king of hell, but never with this steward!’]
Offending the king of hell, at the worst you’d just die. Offend Steward Zhuo, and you’d find that even death would be a luxury.
In Dragon Cloud City, everyone looked at Zhuo Fan in dread.
