Yan Bangui ran with such zeal thinking he’d escape, but Zhuo Fan cooked a little something for Pill King Hall and sent him off with a package. This creepy method and insidious plot left the survivors shuddering.
Even Leng Wuchang, a renowned mind in the empire, looked at the snickering figure in fear. Zhuo Fan had long surpassed Zhuge Changfeng and became his biggest enemy.
“Well, time to head back.”
Zhuo Fan returned to his cool demeanor, but his eyes hid a deep and heavy sorrow as he walked towards the red glow. Yan Fu nodded.
Whoosh!
The two stepped through and were back.
The people treated him like a demon, shaking in fear. Only the girls were happy seeing him alive and went to welcome him.
Then it happened.
Explosions sounded as four men attacked the pair. A great pressure fell on the people, making them fall back in panic.
The four were none other than Huangpu Tianyuan and his allies, all peak Profound Heaven house lords.
Fang Qiubai was about to block them but stayed his hand. After careful consideration, he picked neutrality.
Dugu Zhantian watched it all with a cold eye and a lament.
[Perhaps... it’s for the best.]
Only Luo Yunchang and Chu Qingcheng were devastated. They wanted to give a helping hand.
“Zhuo Fan, you’ll pay for what you did to my son!” Huangpu Tianyuan roared his righteous excuse, punching straight for Zhuo Fan.
Yan Fu, behind Zhuo Fan, could barely breathe from the power display. The other three house lords unleashed their own might as well.
Zhuo Fan, heavily wounded, was besieged by four experts on all sides. Escape was not an option.
Not that he was worried.
With a twisted grin, he said, “Sorry, but you’re a little late in getting revenge for Huangpu Qingtian.”
An explosion followed as a black figure slammed the four into the air.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes glinted and he smiled, “As I live and breathe, Elder Li...”

chapters.title: Chapter 336, Fanatic Fights Sword God
chapters.content:
Chapter 336, Fanatic Fights Sword God
Editor: Elitecoder
Boom!
The ringing from the boom had yet to stop, forcing the people to cover their ears. The thick dust had Zhuo Fan and Yan Fu obscured within it.
Huangpu Tianyuan’s team of four finally landed while coughing blood. The respective house elders surrounded their house lords and checked their wounds.
But Huangpu Tianyuan flicked his sleeve, shooing the elder before him aside. His eyes peered into the dust and he spat, “Who the hell dares to interfere in the Regent Estate’s affairs?”
Fang Qiubai and Dugu Zhantian looked towards the commotion with a frown.
They knew who it was, but they were baffled why that man was on Zhuo Fan’s side.
The rest of the houses watched intently. They were all dying to know at this point. Who had the nerve to save Zhuo Fan from the clutches of Regent Estate?
Once the dust settled, somewhat, it revealed an imposing physique. An outstandish old man, poised and his back straight, stood in front of Zhuo Fan. His tyrannical aura bent on crushing everyone in his path hung heavy over everyone’s hearts.
He was none other than one of the rare top Radiant Stage experts in Tianyu.
“Mad Dipper, Li Jingtian!”
A Regent Estate elder shouted, “Elder Li, you are a guest Venerable of ours. Where have you been over the past few years? Why are you suddenly siding with that punk? He is the Regent Estate’s greatest enemy!”
Those words set the crowd reeling.
The mystery expert was Regent Estate’s Venerable, the living legend, Mad Dipper Li Jingtian?
He truly lived up to his name, respected and feared both.
Fang Qiubai and Dugu Zhantian were startled as well. Nobody knew of Li Jingtian’s strength before, but the vibes he was sending deterred even the mighty Divine Dragon!
“Elder Li!”
A cry sounded, making the eyes of everyone land on Luo Yunchang. To everyone’s shock, she ran to Li Jingtian’s side and patted his chest, “Thanks to your timely arrival, Zhuo Fan is safe!”
Twitching, everyone looked puzzled, the seven house lords included.
[What’s that Lu miss doing being so friendly with that savage fiend?]
Li Jingtian’s reaction however got a priceless expression out of them all.
“Ha-ha-ha, young miss, relax. Nothing will happen to Steward Zhuo, not when he has such a cunning nature.” Li Jingtian laughed.
The people went slack jawed.
[Say... what? Young miss... Steward Zhuo...]
[Tell me it isn’t true! How, why, when? The Luo clan is just a third rate upstart clan. How in the hell did they manage to entice that old freak Mad Dipper to become their Venerable instead?]
[That makes the Luo clan practically on par with the seven houses!]
[Ha-ha-ha, we must be tripping. That Mad Dipper must’ve been conned into helping them just like Zhuo Fan did with Dugu Zhantian. There’s absolutely no way, not in a million years for him to be on their side.]
[Then again, seeing how the punk’s methods were quite all encompassing, the kid could practically turn everyone into his backers.]
Sighing, the crowd’s opinion of Zhuo Fan jumped again and again.
And that went for everyone there, from no name clans, to the seven house lords. Since having a backer and joining them were totally different things.
A backer was good as a makeshift safeguard, but by joining the clan wholly, the man could both defend and attack in need, turning the clan into a force to be reckoned with.
Zhuo Fan was great, no doubt, but not even he could pull a peak Radiant Stage expert to his side, to join a third rate clan no less. That was simply ludicrous!
Long Yifey and the rest shook their heads. [We must be overthinking things.] If Li Jingtian was their Venerable, then the Luo clan was a match for the seven houses...
A truly cruel and delicious irony how everyone was denying the truth staring them dead in their faces. Depending on the viewpoint, of course.
“Elder Li, what’s the meaning of this? You may be friends with the punk, but clan matters come first. You need to address this with utmost severity. Why are you stopping me from taking revenge for my son?” Huangpu Tianyuan raved.
Squinting, Li Jingtian laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, Estate Lord Huangpu, that’s exactly right. I of course take the clan’s interests into heavy consideration. That is why, as Luo clan’s elder, I cannot allow you to touch one hair of our steward.”
Dong!
A bomb went off in all of their heads. They felt their minds swoon after being smacked with a copper bell right in the noggin. Reeling from shock, they looked at Li Jingtian gobsmacked.
[The Mad Dipper actually joined the Luo clan! And... and he’s just a friggin’ elder!]
[As if!]
[Are you high? Did you just get up and quit the prestigious position of a guest Venerable over at Regent Estate to become a mere elder for a third rate clan?]
Huangpu Tianyuan stammered all this time. Leng Wuchang twirled his beard and asked, “Elder Li, why?”
“Humph, isn’t it obvious? There was nothing holding me back, no incentive at all. I dumped Regent Estate for the Luo clan because they can give me something you can’t!” Li Jingtian smiled with pride.
Now that definitely got a shocking reaction.
The grandiose head of houses was dumped over a tiny clan? That had got to be the joke of the century!
Hearing it from anyone else, it would earn a couple of laughs. But it came directly from the source, Mad Dipper himself.
A peak Radiant Stage expert abandoned all those benefits and downshifted to become some elder? Why the hell would he do that if there was nothing in it for him?
It begged the question though, what could the Luo clan hold to make Mad Dipper wipe his hands off of the Regent Estate?
All eyes were on Zhuo Fan. Everyone knew that only one man was capable of making the old demon switch camps. He definitely had a hand in this.
[But even then, getting him to change sides was a godlike move! How did he do it?]
Long Jiu sighed, [I knew the kid is an expert at stealing other’s foundations. Fortunately, we are a tight knit house or even our experts would’ve fallen for his bewitching promises.]
Unaware as he was that Zhuo Fan wouldn’t take them even if they were given for free.
Moving past the standard reaction of shock everyone showed today, Li Jingtian turned to the one-armed Zhuo Fan with a heart broken expression. Taking him into a bear hug, the man spoke solemnly, “Steward Zhuo, what are your orders?”
Zhuo Fan glanced over to the Regent Estate and said, “No one from the Regent Estate leaves this place alive.”
The cold and insipid tone rang into people’s ears.
[The demon is that cruel to go ahead and wipe out all Regent Estate’s elders?]
Mad Dipper was no fool. Doing so was declaring war with the head of the houses. This was not a game.
Zhuo Fan was consumed by his hatred and desire for revenge. With Li Jingtian being Regent Estate’s Venerable once, he should still have some lingering feelings left over for his ex employer. Now that he was a mere elder, he should think about the clan’s needs and not follow the demon steward’s ramblings.
Li Jingtian simply patted his shoulder and turned to Regent Estate’s men with a look that promised death and agony. He was hellbent on murdering anyone to fulfill Zhuo Fan’s design.
[He’s nuts! The entire Luo clan is going along with Zhuo Fan’s madness!]
After a quick sigh of lamentation, everyone scampered off. Noone wanted to be here and suffer a quick death when a Radiant Stage expert went on a murdering spree.
Long Yifey thought about advising against it. But Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian’s determined gazes made him falter. All he could do was follow his clansmen in getting away from here.
It was then that Li Jingtian kicked it off with a bang. The power and the pressure were that of a mountain coming down on you. Huangpu Tianyuan and his thirty-ish elder’s group gasped, but found even breathing hard. They couldn’t even fight back.
This was the power of a peak Radiant Stage expert. These guys were nothing but ants to Li Jingtian.
But then, a boom announced the approach of a man in white, facing off Li Jingtian with a palm attack.
Boom!
The world felt like it was falling apart as the two palms collided. All anyone could do was duck their heads and cover their ears.
Long Yifey and the rest of the Profound Heaven experts were feeling horrible just the same. They covered their ears and stood up a bit, but if the flowing sweat was any indication, they had to be feeling just as powerless as their neighbors if they were to face these palms instead.
Tap~
The two withdrew five steps. Looking up, the one facing Li Jingtian was none other than Jade Flute Divine Sword, Fang Qiubai.
Cupping his hands, Fang Qiubai spoke, “Mad Dipper Li Jingtian, your name precedes you.”
“One of the imperial family’s five Divine Dragons, Jade Flute Divine Sword Fang Qiubai. I’ve long since waited for this. One glance is enough to tell me of your uncommon character. But are you certain you want to go head to head with me?”
Li Jingtian smiled, his eyes exploding with bloodthirst. The martial fanatic in him reared its head, fueling his desire to fight....

chapters.title: Chapter 337, Stalemate
chapters.content:
Chapter 337, Stalemate
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
Fang Qiubai waved him off, “Brother Li, I would never treat you as an enemy. It is the Emperor’s decree you see, to defend Dragon Cloud City’s public order. I was forced to intervene the moment you attacked Regent Estate. I ask that you be sensible and let this matter rest. It would be for the best of both the Regent Estate and Luo clan, wouldn’t you say?”
Li Jingtian’s eye twitched, realizing this opponent of his knew his way with words. If the Luo clan and Regent Estate fought it out now, both sides would end up with a disaster. He was at an impasse, however...
A glance at Zhuo Fan’s cold face and the seething bloodthirst in his eyes made that choice for him.
Li Jingtian gnashed his teeth and smirked, “Mr Fang, it’s been ages since I met an opponent like yourself. How about we spar a little?”
Fang Qiubai frowned at Li Jingtian’s smile. [I forgot, Mad Dipper is a martial fanatic but he is not an idiot either. So why would he insist on being so reckless?]
[Killing even a single elder of Regent Estate today will set off Regent Estate on the warpath against the Luo clan...]
The answer was made clear soon enough. Li Jingtian looked back and Zhuo Fan said something to him.
It was unimaginable to see the great Mad Dipper actually abiding by a pup’s every word. Talking to Li Jingtian now wouldn’t change a damn thing, so he had to switch gears and talk it out with Zhuo Fan.
Fang Qiubai said, “Steward Zhuo, I understand your anger, but this is not the place to settle your grudges. I ask that you do not forsake your clan over a single loss.”
That had the crowd thrown in a loop. [If he wants to persuade someone, he should do that with Li Jingtian. Who is to stop him if he decides otherwise?]
Then it dawned on them like the sun’s morning glow.
[Oh, Li Jingtian is doing it at Zhuo Fan’s orders. Does that mean a word out of him can make Li Jingtian stop? A peak Radiant Stage expert, Mad Dipper in particular, is actually housebroken?]
The vassals and the seven house lords turned to Zhuo Fan to gawk in shock.
[That’s a Radiant Stage expert we’re talking about! These guys are Venerables in the seven houses. One would have to beg for any kind of help. Even the house lords need to watch their words around them. And all they could do is make requests, not order them around.]
[Or the Venerable will simply scoff at anybody pleading to them!]
But here is one peak Radiant Stage expert who is listening to a kid. [Did Li Jingtian mellow out, or are Zhuo Fan’s methods far more sinister?]
Then again, Mad Dipper was called as such for a very good reason. That made the first reason moot and the second one highly plausible. Zhuo Fan was versed with so much knowledge that he could even get Mad Dipper to fall in line.
[So why is he then just an elder and not a Venerable?]
Venerables, who are on the same status as a patriarch, were above a house lord who could only order elders around. [Zhuo Fan, oh Zhuo Fan, you are just a steward, so how can you tell an elder what to do?]
Long Yifey and the rest sighed watching him. [This kid might very well be the greatest steward to have ever walked the earth!]
[It’s hard to tell if I should be happy or sad if I had such a capable steward in my clan...]
...
Zhuo Fan ignored the chatter and stared back at Fang Qiubai, then turned his head away. [Don’t care.]
Fang Qiubai faltered. [This punk doesn’t know when to quit.] Li Jingtian laughed it off, filled with thirst for battle, “Mr Fang, it’s hard for me to find such a good opponent like you. I won’t be holding back. Please return in kind. I won’t be blamed for any unforeseen demise on your part.”
“Brother Li, I feel the need to stress this. Per Emperor’s orders, I cannot allow you to rain havoc in Dragon Cloud City!” Fang Qiubai saw talking was off the table and the jade flute began to let out sounds.
Li Jingtian saw Fang Qiubai getting serious and was overjoyed. He gave a belly laugh, then charged with a dragon roar.
“Wraith Style’s 2nd move, Ghostly Dragon Claw!”
Roar!
Li Jingtian was covered from head to toe in black energy and a claw sprung out. The power it released was intent on tearing a hole in space itself.
Fang Qiubai gasped. He let the shock subside and turned serious as well. With the flute in hand, he stabbed at the incoming attack.
“Profound Heaven Sword Star!”
Hum~
The jade flute was wrapped in a blue wind and turned into a sword, it’s tip shooting into the sky.
The black and blue auras collided, shuddering the hearts of onlookers. Then came the shock wave, turning to dust anything in its path.
Fortunately, the people were wise enough to stay clear from the start, lest they’d be pulverized as well by now.
Once all settled down, they watched on slack jawed.
Li Jingtian and Fang Qiubai were staring at each other with grave faces mere five meters away from each other.
Jade Flute Divine Sword’s hand holding the flute trembled. While Li Jingtian’s brows shook, far more astounded.
His hand was dripping blood on the ground.
[Elder Li... lost?]
Luo Yunchang was filled with worry. Zhuo Fan only shook his head, “It’s no loss, but a stalemate. Neither could overpower the other!”
The next second, a sharp crack announced the crumbling flute falling to the ground from Fang Qiubai’s hand.
Fang Qiubai sighed at his loss, “Brother Li, this flute has followed me for fifty years. I never thought I’d see it crumble here. Take it as me having lost by a fraction.”
Li Jingtian smiled, lifting his bloody palm and speaking cheerfully, “This iron hand of mine has been with me for 158 years. But today it has come to harm. I have lost in this exchange.”
The two stared for a second before laughing it up, while respecting each other for the hero the other was in their hearts.
“Mr Fang, should we go at it again and settle this stalemate?” Li Jingtian spoke while waving his bloody hand.
Fang Qiubai looked at the broken flute and nodded, “Since brother Li is so courteous, I shall oblige.”
“Marvelous!”
Li Jingtian laughed and attacked.
But then Zhuo Fan said, “Elder Li, we’ll leave it here today, out of respect for Mr Fang. We’ll just have to settle our grudges with Regent Estate some other time.”
The people’s faces twitched.
[That’s a nice way of putting it. What respect for Mr Fang? You should have done that from the start if you had any respect for the man!]
[Saying it now when you know fighting won’t get you anywhere makes you look like a hypocrite!]
At least he was far better then those stupid heads knowing only to push ahead regardless. [The kid sure is smart, to know when to retreat.]
Fang Qiubai smiled, “Then, brother Li, we will spar again another day. Or your steward might get angry!”
Li Jingtian sighed with a nod, “Fine, since Steward Zhuo said so, I don’t have a choice but to fight another day.”
Li Jingtian cupped his hands and walked back to Zhuo Fan.
While Fang Qiubai stood there with a heavy frown.
He had just taunted Li Jingtian, to see if he was so resolute in following the little demon’s words.
Not expecting at all that Li Jingtian hadn’t even entertained the notion of defying Zhuo Fan’s orders, his reply being very calm. As if the grand Mad Dipper listening to a brat was the norm, not to mention he was devoted to a fault.
Zhuo Fan’s qualifications as king had now evolved. It wasn’t as simple as drawing his peers over to his side, but included the power to rally astonishing people like Li Jingtian under his banner.
It only proved the fact that Zhuo Fan was far more worthy to be king than Huangpu Qingtian. Getting Dragon Vein Soul was a mere coincidence. He had the power to become an emperor already, but now it was also decreed by heaven itself.
At that moment, Zhuo Fan became the number one threat for the imperial family in Fang Qiubai’s mind...
“Mr Fang!”
Zhuo Fan called with a cryptic smile, “You were very quick in stopping Elder Li. You are a true Divine Dragon. His Majesty made the right choice in sending you to preside over Dragon Cloud City’s order.”
Fang Qiubai’s face flushed a bit.
No one but him could sense the dripping sarcasm.
[He’s mocking me for not intervening when Huangpu Tianyuan’s team attacked him before, but stepping in when Li Jingtian attacked.] It was a clear sign that Fang Qiubai wanted Zhuo Fan dead.
Keeping Dragon Cloud City’s order was merely the best excuse at the moment.
[He has now taken me into account as a potential enemy. When he had Li Jingtian attack Huangpu Tianyuan, it was all to see my stance.]
[The little demon is too outstanding!]
Staring at Zhuo’s creepy smile, Fang Qiubai sighed...

chapters.title: Chapter 338, Declaration of War
chapters.content:
Chapter 338, Declaration of War
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
On the Luo clan’s way back, Zhuo Fan was the picture of calmness. Li Jingtian stuck to him like glue, creating a stifling atmosphere that no one around dared to break and approach.
Everyone watched them go in shock, even the house lords.
No one had seen it coming. A mere third rate clan had risen to the ranks of a house the instant Li Jingtian showed up next to them.
Nobody present knew a house, except Regent Estate of course, that had someone at the height of power as Li Jingtian had reached, a peak Radiant Stage expert.
Not to mention the said expert could fight Divine Dragon Fang Qiubai to a draw. This fact only gave the Luo Clan even greater importance.
From now on, Luo clan wasn’t merely at the level of a house, but was right below Regent Estate. Any offense would be met with impunity from Li Jingtian, annihilating their entire clan.
Such a thing had never been never achieved in the past because of the delicate balance of power. This also did not push the other clans into a corner.
But now, You Wanshan and the other houses who held a grudge with Zhuo Fan had to reconsider their approach to revenge as the Luo clan had now become the second house under Regent Estate.
Luo clan was strong, but only because of Li Jingtian alone.
Yet that man was strong enough to shock everyone.
Luo clan slowly made their way to their accommodations in Dragon Cloud City. Zhuo Fan had a deathly look on his face that no one disturbed. And in this manner, they walked further and further away...
Suddenly, Zhuo Fan stopped and looked at Leng Wuchang with a sinister smile as he shouted, “Sir Leng, I admit my loss this time. But the games have just begun. Let us have a blast next time, ha-ha-ha...”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes exploded with hatred and coupled with his creepy tone, everyone’s hair stood on end.
Leng Wuchang’s face grew graver than ever. But it only matched Zhuo Fan’s bloodthirsty stare.
It was Zhuge Changfeng who then said, “Sir Leng, you really kicked the hornet’s nest this time, ha-ha-ha...”
Zhuge Changfeng then left with his two elders.
Leng Wuchang’s beard shuddered in rage.
The others around him were too scared to make a peep. It was a tangle between big shots, not something they should butt in.
Messing with the Regent Estate would get one killed, erasing the body and clan. While pissing off Zhuo Fan, who had tormented half of the six dragons, none of the vassals and small clans dared to imagine.
Not to mention they had a peak Radiant Stage expert as cover, bringing them on the same level as the seven houses.
Under the watchful eyes of the crowd, the two houses had sparks flying when their gazes met.
“Ahe-he-hem!”
“Uh, people, in all the Esoteric Debates held over the millennium, the grudges aren’t brought back from the competition. If the two houses wish to resolve their hatred, please wait for the next Esoteric Debate.” Dugu Zhantian took on an imposing stance and said so.
Zhuo Fan only smiled. Leng Wuchang’s killing intent never faltered.
It was clear as day that no one was buying it.
There were no grudges in the past Esoteric Debates because the seven houses kept appearances. While this time, Regent Estate killed the one Zhuo Fan cared about the most, Xue Ningxiang, and the man toppled their future, along with three other dragons.
Who the hell would wait a hundred years to settle that kind of a bloody score?
At least they were wise enough to let the matter slide for now, since Dugu Zhantian said it. Even if there was no verbal confirmation.
But then a brash voice resounded, “Regent Estate, listen up. From this very moment, the Luo clan and you are now mortal enemies!”
The crowd was in complete shock.
Luo clan simply got up and broke all pretenses, falling out with the Regent Estate in the open as well as in the dark. What came next was the worst outcome, war. To a clan having only one Radiant Stage expert, it meant death.
People whipped their heads to see who was the ignorant buffoon spouting such words. What came into view was the face of a dignified youth.
Luo clan’s young master, Luo Yunhai!
Long Yifey, Xie Xiaofeng and Grandmother’s eyes shrank, giving desperate signals to Zhuo Fan with their eyes. Luo clan going to war meant dragging them into it as well since they were allies.
There was no hope for victory at this point.
It was understandable for Luo Yunhai to be overcome by rage and make such a declaration. He may be the young master, but Zhuo Fan handled everything in the clan. His words represented the Luo clan’s stance.
So these three pleaded with Zhuo Fan to think of the bigger picture.
The man in question took a long look at Luo Yunhai, then smirked at the rest, “What’s with those faces? Is there a problem with what our young master said? Humph, the Luo clan has that name for a reason. Young master may not be the official Clan Head yet, but he represents the Luo clan with every word. From now on, we and the Regent Estate are at war!”
As the people went through endless shock, Long Yifey and company were lamenting.
No one took Luo Yunhai’s words seriously, but all of that changed when Zhuo Fan nailed the matter in.
[But what’s going on with Zhuo Fan? Did he really lose his mind in revenge over a girl?]
Huangpu Tianyuan was overjoyed. He feared the imperial family would stick its nose in again and stop them from making moves against the Luo clan.
But now with the Luo clan declaring war by itself, the imperial family had no grounds to interfere. Windgaze City could no longer save the Luo clan.
“Ha-ha-ha, something must be wrong with todays’ kids, they are so brash and cocky. You think that a single peak Radiant Stage expert is enough to protect the Luo clan? Hilarious!”
Huangpu Tianyuan laughed, “You may be able to cower the other houses, but you have another thing coming now that you’ve set yourself against us. Just ask the geezer next to you how strong we are if you don’t believe me. You can’t match our thousand year old legacy!”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Are you sure? We’ll just have to wait and see.”
Spinning on his heel, he kept on walking. While Li Jingtian left them with some final words, “As a former Venerable of yours, let me give you some friendly advice. Think long and hard before touching the Luo clan.”
Then he turned around and followed after the others.
But his words had the intended effect, to stun Huangpu Tianyuan and his elders.
As an ex Regent Estate Venerable, Li Jingtian knew all about its power. Yet even so, he still judged the Luo clan to be a tougher enemy.
[Does that mean Luo clan is on par with the Regent Estate?]
[Impossible! How can our thousand year legacy be surmounted just like that?]
Turning to Leng Wuchang, Huangpu Tianyuan found him silent.
Luo clan was now wrapped in a thick fog, with no one able to pierce it. This effect had even Regent Estate feel their previous confidence fading.
The swift rise of this clan had left more and more people unable to comprehend them...
Dugu Zhantian watched Luo Yunhai’s back bitterly. He treated Luo Yunhai as his own son, and the kid always listened to him.
But he had just spoken and the first one to reproach him was his own godson.
For the sake of the clan, the godfather and godson had to break ties. He never wished for this to happen, but could never stop it.
[Why must we serve a different master...]
...
Six hours later, the Luo clan returned to Dragon Cloud City and Zhuo Fan slammed the door to his room, “Don’t bother me!”
Luo Yunchang saw Zhuo Fan acting odd and was afraid for his sake. She wanted to go to him but Li Jingtian stopped her.
Luo Yunchang turned to him puzzled.
Li Jingtian shook his head, “Young miss, sometimes men need to be alone. Let him be.”
Her pure eyes shook as Luo Yunchang watched the door and bit her lip before leaving.
But then a bestial roar came from beyond Zhuo Fan’s door before she managed to leave.
“Ahhhh!”
Covering her mouth, Luo Yunchang couldn’t fight the tears.
She saw Zhuo vent his rage for what was done to Ning’er, but only now could he release some of the pain scarring his heart.
The wail of agony made her heart bleed. She wanted to comfort him and mend his heart, but Zhuo Fan would rather face it alone.
He was never one to open up to anyone, choosing to bear the pain by himself, becoming forever a solitary steward.
The pain in Luo Yunchang only grew as her mind wandered. The others sighed, watching over Zhuo Fan’s door along with their young miss...

chapters.title: Chapter 339, Ning’er’s Hope
chapters.content:
Chapter 339, Ning’er’s Hope
Translator: StarReader
The sun fell and rose and yet people stood still outside Zhuo Fan’s door. Listening to the howling growing hoarse into the night, when they finally stopped.
Luo Yunchang stood with red eyes before the door, with salty tears streaming down her cheeks.
“Young Miss, Pavilion Lord Long and the others have come!” Captain Pang bowed.
Luo Yunchang frowned. They would usually send someone over, not come in person. [Why at this time…]
Luo Yunchang merely glanced at Elder Li who had his eyes closed next to her and she knew, “Humph, what noble houses? They’re all clinging to another’s power!”
Because Li Jingtian’s display of power yesterday shocked them all, Veiled Dragon Pavilion, Sword Marquise Abode and Drifting Flowers Edifices found the Luo clan to be on the same footing as them, if not higher.
That demanded a certain amount of respect. So they lowered themselves by coming in person.
Otherwise they wouldn’t be caught dead going to a third rate clan even at Zhuo Fan’s urging.
“Captain Pang, show them in.” Luo Yunchang held her head high, benefiting from their newfound status.
Captain Pang bowed, “Understood.”
Captain Pang soon arrived with the three house lords and their entourage.
Luo Yunchang bent her waist slightly in greeting, “House lords, please forgive me for not welcoming you in person.”
“No need, no need. How is Steward Zhuo?” Grandmother didn’t care at all, only eager to know about his situation.
Luo Yunchang sighed as she glanced at the sealed door, “This bothers me as well. He’s been cooped up for an entire day while I am here by myself with worry.”
The three house lords were startled. But then saw Mad Dipper guarding the door with closed eyes.
The three greeted, “Hello, Elder Li.”
But Li Jingtian was quite the stuck up, not even sparing them a wink.
The house lords shook their heads, while the ones behind them gasped.
[Now that’s a damn expert right there! He’s so cool to act all self-important and rude to even the noble house lords.]
Yesterday’s event was yet to fully sink in. A man of such power was willing to listen to Zhuo Fan’s every word.
Long Jiu, Long Kui and the rest knew Zhuo Fan fairly well, and saw his potential before anyone else. Watching him take decisive steps till today, when he could contest with the powers of Tianyu, left them sighing.
Xie Tianshang’s eyes were blazing, thirsting for something.
As a martial fanatic no less driven than Li Jingtian, he understood that to make someone like them listen to orders, required only one thing - power.
The fiendish Mad Dipper following Zhuo Fan’s every word showed Zhuo Fan had the power to make him submit.
Xie Tianshang’s respect for the steward shot through the roof then and there, bordering on worship!
The house lords looked at each other, but only Grandmother spoke, “Young miss Luo, would it be possible to see Steward Zhuo? We have matters to discuss. “
“I’m afraid not. It’s best that we wait for him to calm down and rest. I will relay your message when he comes out.” Luo Yunchang glanced at the door with a shake of her head.
The three frowned.
When Zhuo Fan was off doing god knows what, they had no choice but to discuss things with this lass. Now that the man of the house was back, of course they’d only want to see him. Now more than ever, when it concerns the safety of their houses. How could they simply leave it in the hands of a girl?
But looking at Mad Dipper, they didn’t say anything.
With that fiend watching the door, they won’t even get to touch it.
As the three house lords were internally debating, a white figure walked out from behind, Chu Qingcheng.
“Edifice Lord Chu, what are you doing?” Luo Yunchang frowned seeing her going for the door.
Chu Qingcheng rested her dainty hand on it and said, “This is between me and him. I ask that young miss Luo does not interfere.”
And then she continued walking, to Luo Yunchang’s distress.
Luo Yunchang couldn’t stop her, but a thick arm blocked her advance.
Li Jingtian’s eyes were still closed, but his voice was firm, “Steward Zhuo needs rest. Without his explicit approval, you can’t go in. Or would you like me to stop you even if I have to pick on the weak?”
Everyone shivered.
None saw it coming. That the great Mad Dipper Li Jingtian would be so heavy handed with a junior. He was just like a guard to a vault, leaving no room for negotiation.
This also proved his loyalty towards Zhuo Fan and earned the other’s envy.
[Just what did Zhuo Fan do to get this fiend on his side? And such a devoted one too!]
Chu Qingcheng didn’t push the issue, knowing she was beaten and shouted instead, “Zhuo Fan, I need to talk to you! Get out and stop hiding like a coward!”
Sss~
Gasps all around.
Zhuo Fan wasn’t the same person from yesterday, he had an invincible bodyguard. Not to mention he was currently unstable. Getting him pissed off was the last thing on anyone’s mind.
It was just yesterday when after getting consumed by rage, he had declared war with the Regent Estate. He might even attack them if he was angry enough.
And none of them could fight off Li Jingtian. If Zhuo Fan gave into his demonic side, there was quite a high possibility of suffering untold cruelty they just bore witness to last month. Nobody wished to be the spark that lit that keg.
They were all tense, watching the door nervously.
But what they received was total silence.
Only fifteen minutes later, a hoarse voice came, “Elder Li, let them in.”
“Alright.”
Li Jingtian nodded and withdrew his hand. The people followed Chu Qingcheng in to see a shocking situation.
Chu Qingcheng and Luo Yunchang’s eyes went red.
A white-haired man sat leaning on the bed, his clothes a mess, his hair thatched, and his eyes red and lifeless.
His hand held a censer releasing a pure light.
He was and wasn’t Zhuo Fan. How did he end up like this though?
“Brother Zhuo…” Luo Yunhai cried.
But Zhuo Fan didn’t reply, his dead eyes stared at the floor. After a long time, his muttering came, “Sorry everyone, if you came because of the declaration of war, you can return. Yunhai is young, but he is our future Clan Head. His words are law. The Luo clan will be fighting Regent Estate. But it’s up to you if you wish to join.”
Stammering, the house lords knew Zhuo Fan had received a devastating blow to have a mental breakdown. He looked anything but capable of taking decisions.
He was like those fanatic people hellbent on revenge, willing to be torn apart as long as they could bite into the enemy’s flesh.
[That’s too rash!]
They saw Zhuo Fan dead and cold like a block of ice. He was a pragmatic and cunning monster devoid of emotion, but look at him now.
Now that he was lost to his emotions, he had sacrificed everything and was reduced to this weak state.
Intense emotions were cruel, they cut like a sharp blade and reduced even the strongest to an empty husk.
Sighing, they shook their heads with regret. But some girls were overwhelmed with affection and pity.
This was a true man, one that would risk his all for a woman. But because of the cold demeanor he usually displayed, no one saw what lay buried in his heart…
“Steward Zhuo, don’t be so down. You can’t let emotions cloud your judgment in dealing with the Regent Estate.” Grandmother said in all sincerity.
Zhuo Fan merely gave a mocking laughter.
Chu Qingcheng went to him and pulled his hand, “Come with me!”
No one understood what was happening. Zhuo Fan was the same, but had no mind to care, following her like a walking corpse.
They were soon gone from everyone’s sight.
An hour later, Chu Qingcheng brought him to Drifting Flowers Edifices’ location in Dragon Cloud City, to her room.
Zhuo Fan snorted, “Edifice Lord Chu, why have you brought me here? You don’t intend to deepen our feelings, are you? I am not in… “
His voice trailed off as he noticed the girl on the bed.
She was fair, young and naive looking. Xue Ningxiang.
But she didn’t look dead at all, merely sleeping.
“Ning’er’s body. How…”
Zhuo Fan watched closely and she looked just like a sleeping, living person. Frowning, Zhuo Fan noticed the shining jewel in her mouth.
“Anchoring Soul Bead!”
Zhuo Fan cried out in joy, “This… Ning’er can be saved…”

chapters.title: Chapter 340, It’s You I Want
chapters.content:
Chapter 340, It’s You I Want
Translator: StarReader
th grade spiritual weapon Anchoring Soul Bead. It was an astonishing treasure for soul defense never seen before in Tianyu. It was unique. A defensive treasure everyone was willing to die for.
When Radiant Stage and above experts fought, the emphasis shifted towards the soul. And with the Anchoring Soul Bead, one’s soul was safe and sound.
It even had the miraculous ability to simulate one’s essence when their soul was gravely damaged.
With Xue Ningxiang’s essence stolen for three days, she had collapsed. It was the strength of her soul that waned, unable to support her consciousness. In fact, her soul had yet to fully scatter back then.
If she had the Anchoring Soul Bead then, her life would’ve been saved.
And with the help of some medicine, she would regain her essence to connect with her soul and regain her consciousness. This was the only way to recover.
Looking at her sleeping face, it was clear that she was saved in the nick of time.
Zhuo Fan was overjoyed, “Edifice Lord Chu, than-“
“Call me Qingcheng!” Glaring at him, Chu Qingcheng snapped, but then her eyes bloomed with joy, “Now you can no longer be depressed.”
Flushing, Zhuo Fan scratched his pale face awkwardly and switched topics, “Uh, right, where did you get the 9th grade spiritual weapon, Anchoring Soul Bead? Was Drifting Flowers Edifices hiding it?”
“Of course. We may not be the strongest of the houses, but our treasury has filled over the last thousand of years. Is it that strange? Did you think we only had Bodhi Root?”
Chu Qingcheng held her head high like a proud lady. The powerful image left even Zhuo Fan speechless.
But Zhuo Fan was unable to see the sorrow hidden in her eyes.
Gasping, Zhuo Fan said, “Now we just have to find some ingredients to heal her mind and Ning’er will wake up!”
“Do you know where to find them?” Chu Qingcheng smiled.
Zhuo Fan shook his head and shrugged, but his mind was set, “No, but with Ning’er’s soul affixed, we have the time to look for them. I will even search outside Tianyu’s borders if I have to!”
Chu Qingcheng looked at the sleeping Xue Ningxiang with envy.
[He will do anything for her. But what will he do for me?]
Chu Qingcheng said, “Zhuo Fan, what were you trying to say?”
“Uh, I want to thank you…” Zhuo Fan looked at her oddly.
Chu Qingcheng smiled, “That’s it? How are you going to thank me?”
“Uh, how do you want me to…” Zhuo Fan scratched his white hair clueless.
Chu Qingcheng grinned, “First… close your eyes.”
[Eh?]
Zhuo Fan looked at her oddly, but then he saw the glare in her eyes and closed them on the spot.
[What’s she planning?]
Chu Qingcheng drew near Zhuo Fan and pecked his cheek.
Shivering, Zhuo Fan was about to open his eyes but only heard Chu Qingcheng’s soft voice in his ear, “Don’t look!”
Zhuo Fan snapped his eyes tighter than before.
With a graceful smile, Chu Qingcheng rested her head on his shoulder and whispered, “Hold me.”
Zhuo Fan’s heart thumped, freezing for a moment, but he did embrace her lovely body in the end.
Held close to his chest, Chu Qingcheng’s soft and peaceful voice came, “I want to go back to the time we spent in the run-down house in Drifting Flowers City, just the two of us. Zhuo Fan, you are not allowed to think about other girls at this moment, even Ning’er!”
Zhuo Fan shuddered, and bobbed his head without realizing.
Thus, the two held each other with closed eyes, as their mind drifted to those peaceful days.
After a long time, Chu Qingcheng opened her eyes and flicked his forehead with a smile, “Now you can open them.”
Zhuo Fan showed a pair of dazed eyes. Upon seeing the perfect beauty in front of him, his heart felt lost. He didn’t want to wake up as his hands still held her delicate waist for a long time.
Boring holes into him with her eyes, Chu Qingcheng giggled, “What’s wrong? Are you regretting it now? Too late. That’s the last time. From now on we are mere associates. Later you will stay with Ning’er and I’ll lead Drifting Flowers Edifices. We will never cross paths again, lest we be led astray.”
“Uh, that’s what I want as well, ha-ha… ha.” Laughing dryly, Zhuo Fan scratched his head awkwardly. But his heart still had the same sense of loss as before.
He wanted to only be cordial with Chu Qingcheng, but after her request, he felt unwilling.
[Men are so despicable! But… since when have I become despicable?]
Zhuo Fan shook his head.
Chu Qingcheng said, “Zhuo Fan, you should go back. Perhaps… you will soon find the way to save Ning’er.”
Zhuo Fan looked at her puzzled.
[What’s up with her? Being so mysterious all of a sudden. And you need 9th grade ingredients to heal a soul. How can it be so easy?]
[Or is it her way of telling me to shoo off?]
[Probably.] Since she dragged me here and also the one to initiate the kiss, kicking me out could only be her as well. [Really, unlike men, women make no sense at all.]
Zhuo Fan shook his head and sighed inside, “Then, Qingcheng, goodbye.”
Zhuo Fan walked out.
Chu Qingcheng watched him go with glistening tears falling down.
Whoosh!
A shadow landed behind Chu Qingcheng, “Girl, remember our deal. When she wakes up, everyone and everything here will no longer concern you.”
“I know. I’m fine as long as I could see him.” Chu Qingcheng bit her lip.
The shadow vanished once more…
Zhuo Fan was walking down the street, his mind playing Chu Qingcheng’s odd words over and over again.
Just then, a whisper sounded in his ear, “Kid, if you want to save the girl, come fifty miles south of the city, in the forest!”
Startled, Zhuo Fan released his divine sense but couldn’t sense anything.
His Discerning Field was so strong that he could even detect a Radiant Stage expert. But how was it that he couldn’t find a trace of that voice. [What kind of power is that?]
Recalling Chu Qingcheng’s odd behavior, Zhuo Fan still couldn’t make sense of it. His only choice was to go south of the city and see for himself.
With how strong this man was, not even Li Jingtian could stop him. Since nothing could guarantee his safety, he might as well go and see what tricks were being played on him.
Four hours later, Zhuo Fan arrived. But what he saw were just trees and more trees.
Just then, an eerie voice came from behind, “He-he-he, you came!”
Zhuo Fan whipped his head back to see a gray shadow floating and cried, “Above Radiant Stage, the Ethereal Stage!”
Yes, the Ethereal Stage!
Only this stage allowed one’s soul to leave their body. Even if the body died, the soul could linger on. It was a stage attained only by those who cultivated their soul to perfection.
The Radiant Stage employed mere parlor tricks when it came to a soul’s power, while only an Ethereal Stage expert could bring out its full potential.
When a soul left the body, its attacks would only be soul based. And their power was at a level no Radiant Stage soul could survive. They’d fall the same way as if being killed with intent.
One could go as far as to say no Radiant Stage expert could take even a finger from this shadow. Because his finger would pierce your soul dead.
Without a way to focus one’s soul to attack, the flesh could be as invincible as you want, but it wouldn’t pose the slightest problem for an Ethereal Stage expert.
Even if Huangpu Qingtian, the peak of body cultivation, might have reached the peak of Radiant Stage, he’d still be a mere ant before an Ethereal Stage expert.
The gap between the two stages was a gaping abyss.
It was why many people were stuck at peak Radiant Stage and were unable to advance. It was also why for the past thousand years Tianyu had never had an Ethereal Stage expert.
As one transitioned from body to soul, the quality jumped, and the gulf widened…
But Zhuo Fan couldn’t understand why an Ethereal Stage expert would appear here all of a sudden.
The shadow cackled knowing his thoughts, “Hi-hi-hi, Zhuo Fan, it’s you I want. Now let’s talk terms…”

chapters.title: Chapter 341, Please Let Go
chapters.content:
Chapter 341, Please Let Go
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
“Who are you?”
Zhuo Fan asked the shadow in a cold tone.
After another cackle, the shadow’s reply was, “Hi-hi-hi, where are my manners. I am Demon Scheming Sects’ Sect Leader, Xie Wuyue!”
“One of the empire’s three guardian sects, Demon Scheming Sect?”
He had heard of them as protectors of Tianyu from invasions, yet they wouldn’t meddle in Tianyu’s internal affairs.
Not even when Gu Santong brought the imperial family to the brink of annihilation three hundred years ago did they interfere. But now, the Demon Scheming Sect’s Sect Leader showed himself here to see him of all people?
This had him second-guessing.
“What do you need me for?”
“Hi-hi-hi, didn’t I tell you? It’s you I want. All that’s left to settle is your price.” The shadow cackled.
Frowning, Zhuo Fan understood. The man wanted him on his side. But why? The Sect Leaders disdain worldly affairs, so how did he know about him while also willing to travel leagues to get him.
The shadow easily picked up on his conundrum, “You don’t have to be so suspicious. I never knew about you and only came this time to get Tianyu’s number one genius, Huangpu Qingtian. But you, kid, are far better. The genius of the millennium that is rarely seen even in my sect. Who knew there’d be an even more outstanding genius out there? Your presence made me give up on him and choose you instead. Hi-hi-hi, you should be honored. By putting your life on the line and defeating a far greater opponent, you are blessed with the fortune of catching my attention.”
[Humph, how smug!]
Zhuo Fan snorted.
Was there a sect in the mortal domain capable of catching the eye of this grand Demonic Emperor? He didn’t feel a hint of honor even when some Sect Leader came to see him.
It was all in the Sect Leader’s head, thinking he was so great, superfluous!
Seeing Zhuo Fan’s contempt on his lips, the shadow laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, good, great even. I like brash guys like you the most, like a true king. Then let’s talk business. In my capacity as Demon Scheming Sect’s Sect Leader, I invite you to join my sect. State your terms, but let’s get one thing straight. If there’s anything out there I can’t have, I’d rather see it destroyed.”
“We’re both demonic cultivators, looking out only for ourselves. I understand it perfectly, but... there’s something I have to finish here before I can leave.”
“The Luo clan? Who knew a demonic cultivator could be so loyal? It won’t matter. I’ll give you three years to settle your affairs and then I will take you with me. It should be enough for you to get everything in order. If there’s anything you need, I will help you as much as I can.”
Xie Wuyue’s proposal was quite tempting. It was the same as Luo clan getting the Demon Scheming Sect behind it. Not even the imperial family would dare touch them after that.
The situation right now was highly volatile and this sudden arrival of a powerful backer was heaven sent.
But the expert negotiator Zhuo Fan didn’t let it show and sighed, “I’ll need time to consider.”
Xie Wuyue faltered a second.
[Consider my ass! For my Demon Scheming Sect to have your back is the greatest fortune of your life! You should be damn grateful.]
[What’s with that long face? As if you’re the one losing.]
Noticing him playing the loser, Xie Wuyue’s mouth twitched. If he were back in the sect, any elder that would’ve spoken to him like that would receive a beating to make them forget where they were.
Hadn’t he dumped those four pricks in Thunder Swarm Mountain just the same?
But when facing Zhuo Fan’s cunning nature, he both loved and hated it. He had looked down on Zhuo Fan as if he didn’t have a scheming bone in his back, but at this point, he had accepted him without question.
“Ha-ha-ha, fine. I like your greed. The stronger you are, the greedier you can be! What I said just now was a welcoming gift to the sect, not a term. Now, speak what you want.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Don’t you know already?”
“Save that girl?”
Xie Wuyue laughed, “Zhuo Fan, I know you’re vile and insidious from how sinisterly you tormented Huangpu Qingtian and the other three. Who knew you still had a soft spot? But I hope you won’t enter the sect with such a weakness. We, demonic cultivators, are dead the instant we let emotions take hold. I don’t want to destroy you, nor see the sect fall. Have I made myself clear?”
Xie Wuyue treated him with ridicule at first, but as they talked, he grew colder, finishing with a warning. Zhuo Fan knew it to be a rule of the sect, to not get attached. He nodded and said, “I know it far better than you do. This will be the first and last time.”
“Alright then.”
Whoosh!
With a pop, a bright pill shot for Zhuo Fan. Zhuo Fan caught it and looked at it in shock, “9th grade pill, Soul Returning Pill!”
“Indeed. You have good eyes. I wasn’t wrong about you.”
Xie Wuyue continued, “The Soul Returning Pill can heal wounds of the soul, strengthen the essence and protect the mind. To an Ethereal Stage cultivator, it is like a second life, very sought after. Even I have only one pill of this kind. But I will give it to you in good faith. I hope that you will live up to my expectations and return this investment.”
The shadow was gone with these last words, leaving Zhuo Fan staring at the shiny pill as hope burned in his eyes.
Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan clenched the pill and ran for Drifting Flowers Edifices. The disciples there watched in shock as he stormed into Chu Qingcheng’s chamber.
“What, you already found a way to save Ning’er?” Chu Qingcheng said seeing Zhuo Fan gasping.
Zhuo Fan frowned, “Did you know Xie Wuyue would come for me?”
“Who’s that?” Chu Qingcheng’s eyes trembled.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes searched her face for any clues, “Xie Wuyue is the Demon Scheming Sect’s Sect Leader. You don’t know him? Then why were you so sure I’d have a way to save Ning’er? “
“Someone told me without leaving their name. So don’t ask.” Chu Qingcheng smiled, “All that matters is that Ning’er will be saved. Right?”
Sizing her for a while, Zhuo Fan nodded, “You’re right. As long as Ning’er lives, I’d even sell my body, ha-ha-ha...”
Laughing, Zhuo Fan went to Xue Ningxiang on the bed. He took the Anchoring Soul Bead out, then returned her essence before feeding her the Soul Returning Pill.
Ripples passed all over Ning’er’s body and the spiritual energy also gathered within her in waves, reshaping her soul.
Zhuo Fan sighed, gratified Ning’er would be alright soon.
Yet in his moment of joy, he didn’t notice Chu Qingcheng staring at him with deep yearning.
“Qingcheng, send someone for Ning’er’s clan. She’ll soon wake up and would like to see her family.” Zhuo Fan said but never looked away from Xue Ningxiang.
Chu Qingcheng found it difficult to swallow the bitterness as she nodded, “Alright. I’ll send someone now. You are so thoughtful.”
Those words contained deep sarcasm as well, but they shot way over Zhuo Fan’s head, deeply moved by Xue Ningxiang’s recovery as he was.
He only nodded and a wide smile spread to his ears.
Chu Qingcheng sighed.
Fifteen minutes later, the Xue clan came as well as Xie Tianyang looking distressed. Everyone looked at Ning’er with tears flowing.
They had heard of the possibility of saving Ning’er, but no one believed it. How could one come back after losing their essence? When Chu Qingcheng said she had to take her body, they didn’t refuse, thinking all would be for naught.
But here she was, dead for a month now, yet coming back to the living. Everyone was overjoyed.
Ning’er was their darling. Her survival was their greatest joy.
Zhuo Fan was also overcome with emotion for the first time in his two lives and a genuine smile formed on his lips.
Xue Dingtian turned to him and said after hesitating, “Steward Zhuo, may I have a word with you?”
Zhuo Fan didn’t understand. But he followed after Ning’er’s grandfather.
The two only got ten meters from the room, when Xue Dingtian kneeled before Zhuo Fan, his tears flowing in rivers, “Steward Zhuo, please let go...”
Zhuo Fan was stunned and baffled seeing the old man do this.
[What does he mean...]

chapters.title: Chapter 342, Severing Emotion For Supremacy
chapters.content:
Chapter 342, Severing Emotion For Supremacy
Translator: StarReader
“Elder Xue, why…” Zhuo Fan began.
Xue Dingtian kowtowed in tears, “Steward Zhuo, you are a man of great ambition while we are simply a poor simple clan. Ning’er is also still ignorant to the cruelty of this word and is unable to survive your battles. I know it disgraces Steward Zhuo’s act of mercy in saving Ning’er by doing this, but none of us wish to see her go through it again. I beg Steward Zhuo to help me.”
Xue Dingtian kneeled there and shuddered, before a shocked Zhuo Fan.
The Xue clan didn’t want Ning’er to be involved with Zhuo Fan any longer and were begging him to let her go. But was it that easy for his heart to accept?
“Ning’er’s awake!”
Xie Tianyang’s cry of joy came from inside. Zhuo Fan woke up and rushed inside, ignoring the kneeling old man. Xue Dingtian wiped his tears and came as well.
But what they witnessed wasn’t a face filled with joy, but one filled with doubt. Xue Ningxiang rubbed her eyes, looking over each of them, “Who… are you? Who… am I? Where am I?”
They all cried in shock. [What’s wrong with Ning’er? Did her soul not mend completely? A mental scar?]
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “People, don’t be nervous. Ning’er had a damaged soul and recovering is the same as being born anew. It is normal for her to forget everything. But as her essence was the original one, she will be the same Ning’er we all know. She won’t change.”
The people understood. Ning’er had lost her memories after that ordeal. But that was for the best. Forgetting such dreadful memories was a blessing for the kind and pure Ning’er.
Everything was fine as long as Ning’er was back to her bubbly and naive self. They’d just have to get reacquainted.
“Ning’er, I am your dad!” Xue Wanlong cried.
“Ning’er, I’m your grandfather.” Xue Dingtian approached with shaking hands.
“Ning’er, I am your elder brother, Xue Gang!” “Ning’er, I am your second brother, Xue Lin!”
Everyone circled around Xue Ningxiang to introduce themselves. Xie Tianyang even straightened his hairdo and put on a weird smile before jumping in front of Xue Ningxiang, “Ning’er, do you remember me? I’m your husband!”
They all went quiet.
Zhuo Fan came over looking glum as he said, “Xie Tianyang, are you trying to take advantage of this chance and get close to Ning’er now that she has lost her memories? I’ll give you a thrashing!”
Xie Tianyang rubbed his head, “Ha-ha-ha, Ning’er don’t mind it. It was only a joke. Actually, I am…
“Your childhood sweetheart and fiancée!” Xie Tianyang proceeded with his shamelessness.
Everyone rolled their eyes. Zhuo Fan’s fist crackled, “Xie Tianyang get the hell out. I promise not to kill you, much!”
Xie Tianyang glared at him but then closed his mouth.
He was crystal clear that there was no chance of beating Zhuo Fan.
“Ha-ha-ha, coward!” Seeing his sullen face, Ning’er giggled as she showed a bright smile.
Xie Tianyang wasn’t about to accept it, “Who called me a coward? I can’t beat him, but for you, I will still fight him!”
Xie Tianyang rolled up his sleeves and went with Zhuo Fan outside to start the duel.
Xue Ningxiang waved, “Wait, why are you picking a fight if you can’t win? Please don’t take my joke to heart. I didn’t mean it. I don’t want to see you hurt over something so meaningless.”
“Ning’er, you’re still the same. You may have forgotten me, but you’re so kind and caring. I’m relieved.” Xie Tianyang sighed.
The rest nodded. Ning’er didn’t remember them but she hadn’t changed at all.
Xue Ningxiang turned to Zhuo Fan standing farther back with a bewildered look, “Who are you? Do you know me? They all rushed to introduce themselves but why aren’t you saying anything?”
Whoosh~
Everyone looked at Zhuo Fan with complicated looks.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes trembled. Seeing her sincere face and then recalling Xue Dingtian’s pleading, he smiled, “Ha-ha-ha, me? I’m a bad guy!”
Ah!
Xue Ningxiang jerked in fear.
Looking at the crystal clear eyes, unmarred by the ugliness of the world, Zhuo Fan grinned. He knew he had made the right choice and said, “I eat people and even hurt you.”
“W-why did you hurt me?” Ning’er trembled. She ducked behind Xue Dingtian, peeking at the white haired Zhuo Fan like a startled kitty.
Zhuo Fan looked at her with tenderness, but his mouth said, “Bad men hurt people. Do I even need a reason? So miss, for your own sake, you should stay far away from me!”
Zhuo Fan then walked outside sighing.
[Goodbye, Ning’er!]
They watched his solitary figure leave, filled with admiration. He was a true hero to own up to his actions and make prompt decisions.
They didn’t want Ning’er to be by his side and suffer. But they had to admit, Zhuo Fan was a reliable man…
Xue Ningxiang saw him go and for some odd reason she felt pain in her chest, “Why does my heart ache when I see this bad man?”
“Hey, bad men only know how to cause pain, Ning’er. Just forget it.” Xie Tianyang gave a rushed explanation.
This was for the best. With Zhuo Fan letting her go, Ning’er could now return to living a normal life. If the two got close again, Xie Tianyang wasn’t afraid of being smacked around, but he could never stand for Ning’er being used again and turning expendable simply to constrict Zhuo Fan.
Xue Ningxiang nodded, the passing Zhuo Fan already forgotten as she laughed along with her relatives.
Zhuo Fan stood outside and listened to the laughter. He closed his eyes, neither happy nor sad.
[This is… for the best.]
An hour later, Xie Tianyang came out of the room and sighed at the bleak figure, “Thank you.”
“What thanks? We had the same intentions right?” Zhuo Fan looked ahead as he said.
Nodding, Xie Tianyang walked before Zhuo Fan and placed two items in his hand.
Zhuo Fan trembled.
Sighing, Xie Tianyang looked downcast, “Forgive me. I shouldn’t do this to a brother, but Ning’er…”
“You want to break all ties with me?” The two Thunder Rings shook in his trembling hand.
Nodding, Xie Tianyang sighed, “We are cut from a different cloth than you. You want to fight for supremacy in this world, while we merely drag along with our meager existence. We do not want glory, nor do we want you to disturb our peaceful life. I have spoken with the Xue clan. Tomorrow, I will take them to a remote place in the mountains and never come down. I no longer want to be Sword Marquise Abode’s second young master!”
“Few are like you, to sacrifice so much for another.” Tightening his hand, Zhuo Fan said evenly, “I hope you live a happy and peaceful life.”
“I wish you the same, for one day to lord over all and be remembered for eternity.” Grinning, Xie Tianyang said, “Alright, let me give one last hug to the man who I shared life and death with. After we part here, we will become total strangers.”
Xie Tianyang squeezed Zhuo Fan into a bear hug as Zhuo Fan just stood there.
Xie Tianyang then returned back into the room. Neither looked at each other, with all ties broken.
“Zhuo Fan, did Xie Tianyang give you the rings?” Chu Qingcheng asked.
Nodding, Zhuo Fan looked at the flickering Thunder Rings in his palm with pain, “Qingcheng, you were right. A cold and heartless man like me doesn’t deserve a woman’s love nor to have a sworn brother. I am destined for loneliness.”
“No…”
Chu Qingcheng was about to explain, but Zhuo Fan tightened his fist and threw the rings as his gaze steeled, “From this moment on, my eyes shall only have the world in sight!”
Zhuo Fan walked home, his eyes no longer hesitant.
Chu Qingcheng saw where the rings fell and sighed seeing Zhuo Fan’s cold back, “Did you know… you’re not at all lonely…”
Chu Qingcheng flew towards the rings…

chapters.title: Chapter 343, The Grand Scheme of Things
chapters.content:
Chapter 343, The Grand Scheme of Things
Translator: StarReader
Zhuo Fan returned to the Luo clan in the evening. The whole day had passed yet Grandmother and her other two allies remained, waiting for his return.
Seeing them, Zhuo Fan washed away any dejection he had and cupped his hands, “House lords, I had some matters to tend to. But we can talk now since they are over.”
Everyone looked amazed.
The Zhuo Fan, Chu Qingcheng dragged away with her and the one that had returned were totally different. He was back to his swift and decisive self, without a hint of grief.
[What’s going on? What did Chu Qingcheng do to get him back?]
The Luo clansmen saw him looking thin, but his bright eyes let them know that he had pushed through the haze. They were overjoyed.
Luo Yunchang especially. She didn’t get along with Chu Qingcheng but she was at least grateful the woman got her Zhuo Fan back to his normal self.
“Zhuo Fan, y-you had me worried sick!” Luo Yunchang came to him in tears.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “It’s all in the past.”
Zhuo Fan turned to the three houses, “People, I know what’s on your mind. You fear that our declaration of war was impulsive and would ruin everything. But I will tell you that the faster we dispense with this charade with Regent Estate, the faster we can grow.”
They were all startled.
The seven houses were at peace until now, all because of pretense. But once the war broke out, the dead would pile up just like they did a thousand years ago. Their houses were in danger of annihilation!
How were they going to grow after that?
Zhuo Fan had a cryptic smile in reply to their thoughts, “In fact, the world hasn’t really changed. “War and peace shift places just like yin and yang. War does not mean the absence of peace or suffering. It all moves according to the bigger picture. The situation will change after the Esoteric Debate. You need to consider what happened in the Esoteric Debate, and the changes in our enemies. The best choice right now is to fight Regent Estate.”
They all entered deep thought, mulling over his words.
Then, the three house lords’ eyes brightened and they nodded.
“I see. Steward Zhuo wants to turn it into a three-way confrontation! But… where do we find the power to fight Regent Estate to a draw?” Grandmother asked.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Do you remember my words? In ten years, you will see a brand new Luo clan. But I no longer need those years as I can show you a powerful ally in the form of the Luo clan already. Don’t worry, we will restrict the Regent Estate without a doubt!”
The house lords found it hard to believe Zhuo Fan’s bold proclamations.
He just said that the Luo clan had the power to challenge Regent Estate, alone! But how? Eight years couldn’t compare to a thousand year’s legacy. It was normal for Zhuo Fan to create miracles, but to grow a clan to such a height so fast was impossible.
But when they looked at Li Jingtian, they fell quiet.
Was there something he couldn’t do after he turned a peak Radiant Stage expert into an elder?
They had now changed their thinking and were looking forward to seeing how big of a shock would the Luo clan give, the next time they appeared along with their entire might.
The three house lords sighed. [Zhuo Fan is truly astonishing.]
“Ha-ha-ha, since Steward Zhuo is certain of success, we will make preparations and move according to your instructions. I have to admit, when I saw Steward Zhuo taken over by rage, I never expected you’d still be capable of deep thinking. I am in awe!” Grandmother praised.
Zhuo Fan returned her gesture, “Grandmother exaggerates!”
The three houses took their leave. Besides the three house lords, everyone else was in the dark about what just happened.
“Father, why didn’t I understand a thing you guys talked about?” Long Xingyun asked.
Long Yifey smiled as he lifted his head in pride, “Boy, this concerns the grand scheme of things. If you could understand it, you’d have been the next house lord by now!”
Long Xingyun was shocked, “It contains such profound topics? That means Zhuo Fan could understand it while we had to be reminded. Won’t that mean…”
“Zhuo Fan is a truly rare genius. I can’t help but wonder where he comes from. Such a young lad with such a wide gaze that not even we can match. No wonder Leng Wuchang fell for his handiwork.” Long Yifey sighed in amazement.
Long Xingyun had admiration as well.
They were peers yet Zhuo Fan was far stronger than any of them…
After the houses left, Luo Yunhai asked, “Brother Zhuo, I made the declaration of war yesterday. I was overcome by anger from their insidious nature in dealing with you. But I had never imagined it would have so many implications.”
“Ha-ha-ha, if you knew, you’d already be Clan Head.”
Zhuo Fan then turned serious, “Yunhai, following Dugu Zhantian has sharpened your senses and familiarized you with war tactics, all for this day. But this has only made you a talented general and not good enough to take on the clan’s burdens. This is the perfect chance to teach you a monarch’s methods and the way to infer the bigger picture from small events.”
Luo Yunhai was serious as he nodded in glee. It was the first time Zhuo Fan was going to teach him in person.
The others looked lost.
The past Zhuo Fan would cook up the plans and then send others to do the dirty work. Like he did with Luo Yunhai’s education, leaving it in another’s hands. Now that he was going to involve himself in teaching the young clan head, everyone was excited.
Zhuo Fan was known for his treachery and even played Leng Wuchang, the Unwonted Contriver, like a fiddle. His teachings couldn’t be average.
How were they supposed to know that Zhuo Fan had struck a deal with Xie Wuyue for three years. If he didn’t get Luo Yunhai to mature fast enough, the instant he left, Luo Clan would be met with disaster.
It was the same as sending them to the slaughter. How could he leave with a peace of mind?
So, he sped things up a little.
“Yunhai, do you know who our former allies, backers and enemies were?” Zhuo Fan asked.
Luo Yunhai considered, “The allies were Drifting Flowers Edifices, Sword Marquise Abode and Veiled Dragon Pavilion. The backers are the imperial family and Marshal Dugu. While the enemies are Regent Estate and the rest of the houses.”
“And now?” Zhuo Fan followed.
Luo Yunhai’s eyes flashed with uncertainty, “Now… isn’t it the same?”
“No, it changed.”
Zhuo Fan turned serious, “Yunhai, you have to keep in mind that every man looks after himself. Allies and enemies are all but fleeting. The one true reason that connects everyone together in this tangled web is interest. Yin and yang switch places, they suppress each other, then switch again. The same transformation happens with enemies and allies alike. If you understand the grand design you will never fail. This is the way of inferring the big picture from the events around us. To become a Clan Head you must also grasp it!”
Luo Yunhai gasped and nodded.
“Then, let us begin.”
Zhuo Fan said, “Speaking of the Esoteric Debate this time, Marshal Dugu and the imperial family were our backers before it started. Because our interests aligned, to fight Regent Estate. But after the Esoteric Debate, through luck or otherwise, I received the dragon soul, becoming the imperial family’s enemy. No imperial family would allow those bearing the Dragon Vein Soul, and heaven’s blessing, swagger their way through the nation and shake its foundations. Thus our enemies changed. Fang Qiubai and Marshal Dugu’s loyalties lie with the imperial family. They were friendly before but have now shifted to neutrality, with a high chance of becoming enemies at any given moment. We can’t overlook them.”
Luo Yunhai never imagined that in just two short days his cherished godfather would become his enemy. It was too much to bear.
Regardless of his inner turmoil, Zhuo Fan’s platitude prattled on, “As for the Regent Estate, they remain our enemies. But now we have the right to become their enemies as well. Because we lost the imperial family’s support, the Regent Estate can come at us whenever they want and stomp us into the ground. Of course, we do not need to fear them. But once the war starts, both clans will incur heavy losses and neither wants to let another faction reap from their misfortune. For this reason, we declared war on them and now all that remains is to think of a way to let them bask in our power. They are no fools and know a war would bring too many losses so they will refrain from engaging in it.
“This way, we restrict each other. While the emperor will take notice of our power as well and won’t intervene either, lest he’d like to let the Regent Estate pick us both off. This way, we become one of the three major players in Tianyu, with neither side winning or losing. The court, including Zhuge Changfeng, Dugu Zhantian and the emperor, has already been one such player, bringing balance to the equation. This would keep us safe for a while. All that’s left is to wait for a blind schmuck to lift the deadlock and then we would come down hard to reap the world for ourselves.”
Everyone was slack jawed. They never imagined that Zhuo Fan had such a comprehensive understanding of the powers that be and even had the same objective as the Regent Estate, the world.
This had never happened in the history of the Luo clan. They were a mere third rate clan with petty ambitions, wanting nothing more than to go down at peace.
Zhuo Fan laughed at their thoughts, “Ha-ha-ha, in this world, the weak will be pushed around while the strong fight for greed. There’s no such thing as a man or clan of integrity in this world. If you want peaceful days, then get strong until no one can ever catch up to you.”
I do not want to see those around me suffer the same disaster as Ning’er.” Zhuo Fan sighed.
They hesitated, but soon determination shined in their eyes.
[Isn’t it merely stealing the world? With you, Steward Zhuo, it’s a done deal!]
As their power grew, Zhuo Fan made sure to bring the Luo clan’s ambition to a more appropriate level…

chapters.title: Chapter 344, Resolute
chapters.content:
Chapter 344, Resolute
After Zhuo Fan’s analysis, the Luo clan now understood what to do next. Luo Yunhai was feeling hurt, but the light in his eyes grew stauncher.
At dawn break, people left Dragon Cloud City.
The Esoteric Debate this time was particularly cruel and devastating, but no one expected for a clan to rise after a thousand years and kill its way to the same footing as the seven houses.
Luo clan’s legend spread like wildfire throughout the Tianyu Empire.
Luo clan and its allies said their goodbyes at the gates, then went home. Luo clan was getting ready for its big reveal into the limelight, to fight on equal footing with the true powers.
Their allies had already invited their Venerables to fight alongside the Luo clan. Now that they were in the same boat, they had one course of action. Because when the Luo clan fell, Regent Estate would turn to them.
They were backed into a corner.
Why else would they accept following this madman after finding out that Zhuo Fan had just become the imperial family’s enemy number one? Now they will go along for the ride called Zhuo Fan. They will thrive and fall together. Neither one could abandon the other.
Dugu Zhantian patted Luo Yunhai’s shoulder with a hard face, “Yunhai, won’t you join your godfather in battle instead? “
“Godfather, you still have the other four to help you, but I am the Luo clan’s only heir. I can only go with my clan. Please forgive me godfather.” Luo Yunhai nodded.
Dugu Zhantian sighed, “Alright, Yunhai, you’ve grown and are responsible now. A true soldier from my army...”
“Godfather...” Luo Yunhai interrupted, “Thank you for your guidance these past five years. If the day ever comes when we cross swords, I ask that godfather shows no mercy, as neither shall I...”
The Four Tigers of Tianyu jerked. Why was their younger brother being so heartless?
But Dugu Zhantian’s eyes shrank and he sighed,”It seems you already know the situation. That brat must’ve told you. But he is he and you are you. As long as the Luo clan has him...”
“Godfather, without him there wouldn’t be a Luo clan, nor the relation we have today. You have taught me loyalty so how could I betray him? Moreover, he is the pillar of the Luo clan. A man does not clip his own wings so how can I, a warrior, make the folly of cutting off my arms?”
Dugu Zhantian nodded and laughed, “You are indeed my godson, both righteous and loyal. It will be my pride and joy to meet you on the field.”
Dugu Zhantian smiled and turned, “Yunhai, we may be on opposite sides, but our bond will never change.”
“Take care... godfather.”
Luo Yunhai watched the imposing back and banged his head on the pavement three times.
As for the four tigers, they were totally lost. [What is going on? Why are they suddenly saying goodbyes?]
Not far, Chu Qingcheng had Luo Yunchang called to the side, “Young miss Luo, Zhuo Fan will be in your care.”
“That has never changed. What, should he be in your care?” Luo Yunchang pouted, showing her hostility.
She had no clue what Chu Qingcheng did to get him out of his shell but was still grateful. That didn’t mean she was about to step back from fighting over her man.
Chu Qingcheng smiled, “I mean that you should take great care of his heart. Help him understand this world. He isn’t alone.”
Chu Qingcheng then pushed a flickering ring into her hand and left.
Luo Yunchang was shocked. It was a Thunder Ring like Zhuo Fan was wearing. [How did she get it?]
Zhuo Fan only made three, with two given to Xue Ningxiang and Xie Tianyang. [Does that mean there was a fourth? And given to Chu Qingcheng?]
[Why didn’t I get one?]
Luo Yunchang was annoyed as she ran to Zhuo Fan. She showed the Thunder Ring and snapped, “Zhuo Fan, what’s the meaning of this? Are you giving everyone gifts now? What about me?”
“Where did you get this ring?” Zhuo Fan squinted in a cold tone.
Luo Yunchang let out a shrill cry from fright. Then she lowered her head and mumbled, “Edifice Lord Chu just gave it to me. Saying I need to look after you...”
“Throw it away!”
Zhuo Fan cut her off, “Ning’er and Xie Tianyang have broken ties with me. I don’t need these baubles anymore. “
Zhuo Fan set out with the rest of the Luo clan. Captain Pang rushed to Luo Yunchang as her guard.
Trembling, Luo Yunchang now understood Chu Qingcheng’s meaning.
Xie Tianyang and Ning’er broke it off with Zhuo Fan. She knew how close the three of them were. For a lone wolf like Zhuo Fan, it was a rare friendship.
But now the two had left him and he had truly become alone.
Luo Yunchang looked at the Thunder Ring and put it on as the light in her eyes changed...
In a lush forest, a black-clothed man looked towards the leaving Luo clan in the distance with a savage glint. Upon closer look, one would recognize him to belong to Hell Valley.
“Wretched Luo clan, you actually have a peak Radiant expert. At this rate, we will never be able to deal with them!” the 5th elder gnashed his teeth.
You Wanshan’s eyes were cold, “5th elder, don’t let anger get to you. Even without Li Jingtian, Zhuo Fan still wasn’t one we could handle. Have you forgotten? He actually bit Huangpu Qingtian to death!”
“Yes, with the Luo clan having Zhuo Fan, a cunning mind like Leng Wuchang, and a powerful expert to protect them, they have reached our level, a true colossus. Hell Valley alone can no longer contend with them. Even worse, if we don’t handle it right, we will be eaten whole and our house razed.”
Just then, another black robe fluttered over but the owner had a young voice. Compared to all the old guys here, it made quite an odd contrast.
th elder mocked, “You Ming, you’re becoming more and more cocky. You dare interrupt an elder?”
The cowl was removed and it revealed a youth with a grave face, You Guiqi’s disciple, You Ming. Just that he had lost his cowardly nature and had gotten bolder instead.
He looked at the elders and house lord without the slightest reaction.
You Wanshan gave him a hard look, then smiled, “Grand Elder, you raised the kid well. He’s starting to look like the 7th elder.”
“Ha-ha-ha, Valley Lord is exaggerating. He was the 7th elder’s disciple to begin with. I only gave him tips. It was a good decision to not let him join the Esoteric Debate, or he would’ve been another unmarked grave at the hands of that monster. Then Hell Valley would have truly lost all hope.”
Recalling the dreadful way Zhuo Fan dealt with Huangpu Qingtian, even Grand Elder shuddered, “Ever since the 7th elder’s passing, all our actions have been a mess. We’ve suffered greatly and even ended up being used. I hope You Ming can assume 7th elder’s duty and assist Valley Lord in making the house thrive. As for past grievances, ha-ha, it’s best we don’t mention them.”
“Yes, Zhuo Fan is too much of a menace. Not even that old fox Leng Wuchang could handle him. Now that he has spread his wings, it will be even harder. We’d best rethink our options and take a step back.” You Ming approved.
You Wanshan was pensive for a while before nodding .
Thinking back, ever since they came upon Zhuo Fan, everything went south. With Zhuo Fan of today reaching such power, they would lose even more going against him.
You Wanshan turned to You Ming, “Do you have a plan?”
“Valley Lord, master once said that all machinations are revealed when looking from the outside. With the Regent Estate and Luo clan at war, it’s best for us to stay clear and think of another course of action.”
“And that would be...” You Wanshan asked.
Grinning, You Ming continued, “Zhuo Fan and Leng Wuchang are treacherous men each with his own devices. We won’t be a match for either of them even if we join. The best choice will be to play for the future!”
“Future?” You Wanshan asked, as did the rest.
“Correct. Our goal is in the imperial capital!” You Ming spoke with confidence.
As they talked, they were completely oblivious to the fact that every action the houses took in Dragon Cloud City was in plain sight to two gray shadows.
“He-he-he, Xie Wuyue, Tianyu is becoming more chaotic by the day. Not only the seven houses are fighting amongst each other, even the Four Pillars and Imperial family are about to step in. Can your kid survive among these errant armies?”
An aged voice mocked the other shadow.
The only response he got was a sinister laughter, “Hi-hi-hi, my affairs have nothing to do with geezers like you. He caught my eye and I’m sure he won’t fail me. After three years, I’ll return and you will face humiliation.”
“Oh, are you that confident? The other sects’ monsters aren’t any weaker, you know.”
“Humph, a 9th grade pill for a single man. You think I’d take that gamble without some assurance? What about you then? You lent that Anchoring Soul Bead and cheated a lady. Compared to us demonic cultivators, you, a righteous Sect Leader, is far more despicable. Hi-hi-hi...” Xie Wuyue laughed.
The shadow snapped, “Xie Wuyue, if it wasn’t for me giving the Anchoring Soul Bead to maintain the girl’s soul, your pill wouldn’t have worked. How then would you have gotten that crafty brat? Humph, we merely cooperated and got what we wanted. What’s despicable about that?”
“True, both of us got what we wanted. But this is where our partnership ends. The next time we see each other, I won’t hold back.”
“That goes without saying. You think you and your disciples will win? Humph!” The other shadow vanished with a snort.
Xie Wuyue cackled, “Before Zhuo Fan, perhaps not. But the kid will join my sect and I guarantee you will even lose your shirt, hi-hi-hi...”

chapters.title: Chapter 345, Master and Disciple Reunion
chapters.content:
