Chapter 345, Master and Disciple Reunion
Translator: StarReader
Three months later, the Luo clan finally arrived home, to Windgaze City. As the Blackwind Mountain appeared in view, Zhuo Fan’s heart called to it in longing after five years of separation.
He had gone through ecstatic and despair filled moments during this time. And now that he had returned, he felt even more attached to this place.
The word family or clan had been etched deeper into his heart. Absence only made the heart grow fonder.
“Steward Zhuo, let me open the array and give you a proper welcome!” Standing before Blackwind Mountain enveloped in thick mist, Li Jingtian laughed.
Zhuo Fan waved him off with a hint of smile, “No need. I’ll do it myself. Five years have gone by and I want to open the door myself.”
Li Jingtian nodded, while others watched him with warmth.
“Yan Fu, come!” The kid had been traveling along with the Luo clan, and under constant pressure from Li Jingtian’s valiant aura, he had been left a shivering mess.
Yan Fu rushed before Zhuo Fan with even more respect, “Steward Zhuo, orders?”
“Nothing of that sort. You will soon meet Elder Yan, master and disciple will be reunited at last. And you will become one of us now. So I will now teach you how to open the array. Watch closely.”
Yan Fu was excited. He will finally get to see his master, something that had only happened in his dreams so far. His heart was overwhelmed and he nodded instantly.
Under his dazed gaze, Zhuo Fan’s hand made a sign and he shouted, “Open!”
The fog parted in the form of a path up Blackwind Mountain. Zhuo Fan turned with a smile, “Yan Fu, this will be your home from now on. You and your master…”
Boom!
The reverberating explosion cut Zhuo Fan’s speech short. A gale kicking up dust slammed them right in the face and covered the foremost two in dust and grime.
And then came the shrieks.
“Hi-hi-hi, old hag, old geezer, who do you think you are, Zhuo Fan or Li Jingtian, to dare mess with us Four Scheming Demons? You can’t handle us! See how us four will blast you to pieces!”
Violent Demon’s familiar sneer came to Zhuo Fan, then the cheers from the other three demons, “Yep, yep, you two know nothing of how to stop us. There’s nothing you can do to us!”
Zhuo Fan’s mouth twitched, and his fist clenched.
[These little sh*ts won’t sit still for a second. They completely ruined one of my rare good moods!]
The rest sighed and felt vexed. Elder Li brought these Four Scheming Demons five years back as new elders. Everyone was happy, at first.
And then they got to know these pygmies just a bit better. They were outrageous, squabbling and powerful, of course, but they were nothing more than bickering children. A menace every third day and a disaster every fifth. These guys almost had the entire Blackwind Mountain run into the ground with their toying. Even after Li Jingtian’s heavy handed punishment, it only took a day after his departure for them to start cursing him, and the second day for their demonic minds to cook up new mischief.
Everyone knew this was Li Jingtian cheating the four into thinking that he knew the way to control the Bloodworms and make them fall in line. Or hell would’ve broken loose.
“Steward Zhuo…” Yan Fu pointed at Blackwind Mountain with a sunken face, as if to say. [Why is this home of yours not one bit peaceful?]
Waving him off, Zhuo Fan laughed in anger, “Calm down, I will handle it. Just ignore the little sh*ts!”
“Uh, Steward Zhuo, I’ll go set the four sh*ts straight.” Li Jingtian ran over.
Zhuo Fan waved him off with a dark face, “No need. I’ll do it.”
Zhuo Fan stepped forward and the rest followed. Li Jingtian was snickering inside. [Those four twerps will finally get what’s coming for them.]
They all reached the peak to see holes everywhere and even the gate blown outward and slanted.
No doubt about it, those four sh*ts were responsible for all this.
All this while the sound of explosions kept on coming from within. Xue Qingjian raved like an insane hag, “Ah! You damn bastards dare break my thousand year old mirror? I’ll kill you!”
“Hi-hi-hi, biddy, what are you doing with a mirror when you’re so old? We did you a favor!” Sly Demon poked where it hurt with his mocking laughter.
Xue Qingjian grew enraged in her howls, “Bastards, thieves! I’ll have your heads today!”
“Qingjian, stop wasting time with them and use Life and Death Art!” Qiu Yanhai’s own raving voice came.
Li Jingtian paled.
Him and the two had sparred quite often and he knew of the power behind that art. It could blast ten Radiant Stage experts into dust on the spot. All he could do was turn tail.
With the two using Life and Death Art on the four demons, they’d blow Blackwind Mountain sky high.
Li Jingtian rushed, “Steward Zhuo, I’ll stop them.”
“No need.”
A vein popped on Zhuo Fan’s forehead as his finger trembled, “Those four demons were wrong in the head from the start. There’s no point arguing with them. But were these two so quick to lose themselves? Humph, they need to be taught a lesson!”
Zhuo Fan’s hand signal changed and four blissful heartrending wails came from within, music to the ears of every Luo clansman.
“What’s going on? My belly hadn’t hurt in five years. What’s with the sudden cramp?” Violent Demon rolled around, followed by five others.
“I know, it’s the Bloodworms! That damn Li Jingtian is back!” Sly Demon cried.
Xue Qingjian and Qiu Yanhai collapsed as they cursed, “Dumbasses, you still don’t know that the old man conned you? He is a victim too and doesn’t know how to use the Bloodworms. Or you’d think all the chaos you caused five years ago would only result in some scolding?”
“What, he played us?” Violent Demon roared, “Bloody bastard! That old foggie dares to play the demonic hero quartet? I’ll tear him a new one if it’s the last thing I do! Hold on, if he didn’t do it, then why do I feel cramps all over and can’t even move?”
“Humph, morons, do you even need to ask? Who in this world has such cruel ways?” Xue Qingjian was sweating and her eyes jerked in fear, “The kid’s back!”
“What kid?” The Four Scheming Demons asked together.
Then a prideful voice echoed, “Correct, I have returned. So listen up!”
Zhuo Fan walked into the rundown place with fire in his eyes.
The Four Scheming Demons wailed, “Ah! A ghost!”
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched, but he took it in stride. Xue Qingjian howled and begged, “Steward Zhuo, the four little sh*ts did it! It’s not us who started it!”
But Zhuo Fan walked right past them.
Li Jingtian sighed, “You guys, how can Steward Zhuo not know that the four demons are behind it all? But you two should never ever think about using Life and Death Art here. Are you planning on wiping out the Luo clan? Steward Zhuo just came back and was in a rare good mood. But you…”
“But… we were only talking about it, not meaning to use it!” The old pair grew frantic and looked hurt.
They now looked to see Luo Yunchang pass them. They grabbed onto their final hope, “Young miss!”
Luo Yunchang knew their intention and nodded and gave a thumbs up. [No worries, leave it to me.]
The two were in deep pain, but felt relief.
[We haven’t spent all that time with the young miss for nothing. She comes through for us when it matters…]
In the hall, Zhuo Fan took the main seat and saw no one inside, not even guards. [Those six must’ve scared them off.]
As the others came in, Zhuo Fan had Captain Pang look for Yan Song.
While Captain Pang ran along, Luo Yunchang pleaded the old couple’s case. Zhuo Fan knew they were innocent, only incited by the pygmies.
Not even he could quell his rage when dealing with those freaks, not to mention others. So with another sign, the couple was released from their torment.
The two came to the hall and bowed to Zhuo Fan, giving a look of gratitude to Luo Yunchang.
Luo Yunchang gave Xue Qingjian a cheering gesture. [Sister, we look after each other!]
The females in the Luo clan were few in numbers. And with Xue Qingjian often spending time with Luo Yunchang, their age may be different but the two were now practically sisters.
Yan Song had heard of Yan Fu’s arrival and rushed to the hall. He first bowed to Zhuo Fan then looked with joy for Yan Fu.
He soon found him.
“Disciple!” Yan Song’s mouth trembled from the overwhelming emotion.
Yan Fu was stunned. He looked at him long and said, “Y-you’re my master?”
“Uh…”
Yan Song slipped for a second, then smiled, “Ha-ha-ha, of course. I took Steward Zhuo’s 8th grade pill and washed away the poison, making me dozens of years younger. Handsome, aren’t I? I had told you many times if it weren’t for training in the Rainbow Cloud Palm from a young age, I’d be an elegant and refined gentleman, wooing thousands of girls with a mere wink. See, I wasn’t lying!”
Pff!
The people let a giggle slip. It was their first time seeing their Alchemy House Elder boasting like that. Just like a certain vile steward they knew. Indeed, bad habits do rub off when standing so close.
But Yan Fu shuddered and nodded, “Yes, you really are my master. Master only boasts like that with me. That’s our secret, master!”
Yan Fu fell to Yan Song’s feet. Yan Song was tearing up too. Master and disciple, finally reunited like father and son.
The rest didn’t disturb them.
Afterward, Zhuo Fan thought Yan Fu was too young to assume a position, so he made him an assistant. As for the Four Scheming Demons, Zhuo Fan threw them somewhere far off and only three days later was he reminded of them. He released their seal and gave them a tongue lashing.
Ever since their return, under Zhuo Fan’s tight supervision, the four were on their best behavior and Blackwind Mountain finally knew peace after five long and nerve wrecking years.
Meanwhile, Fang Qiubai and Dugu Zhantian stepped foot in the imperial capital’s palace with the Esoteric Debate’s report…

chapters.title: Chapter 346, Son’s Visit
chapters.content:
Chapter 346, Son’s Visit
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
“Dugu Zhantian and Fang Qiubai greet His Majesty!”
The dignified emperor sat on the golden throne as the two bowed.
The emperor waved for them to get up and asked, “You two have been supervising the Esoteric Debate in my stead. Tell me, what has come off of it? What surprises have cropped up?”
The two nodded and Fang Qiubai took the lead, “Your Majesty, of the six dragons that had participated, Huangpu Qingtian, Yan Bangui, You Yushan and Lin Xuanfeng died at Zhuo Fan’s hands. Luo clan became the true winner.”
“What? T-that number one genius in Tianyu, Huangpu Qingtian...”
The emperor was stunned.
He had hoped for Zhuo Fan to mess with him, and that he only had a half chance of success. But then Zhuo Fan went all out and well beyond his duty, bringing him a wonderful piece of news.
Regent Estate and the other houses’ future was now snuffed in the cradle. At the very least, a monster like Huangpu Qingtian wouldn’t crop up anytime soon and the Regent Estate’s power remained in check.
Taking a deep breath to control the overwhelming excitement, the emperor asked, “Anything else?”
He may have quelled his body’s reaction, but his beard was swaying from glee. That alone was enough to see what a thrill this news had become.
Fang Qiubai and Dugu Zhantian hesitated.
That was the good news and what followed was the worst news ever.
“Your Majesty, in the Esoteric Debate, Huangpu Qingtian revealed that he had a Dragon Vein Soul. Even though the Regent Estate talked its way out, I believe they are intent on drawing out the dragon souls from the imperial family’s Dragon Vein and rebel!”
“What?!”
The emperor slammed the armrest, glowering, “You’re saying the Regent Estate has grown so bold as to go after the imperial family’s Dragon Vein and even had someone become the master of a dragon soul? Wait, that’s not right. If Huangpu Qingtian has the dragon soul, he should be under the world’s protection. How can...”
Fang Qiubai and Dugu Zhantian sighed.
“I’m afraid Your Majesty’s assumptions are correct. Zhuo Fan is a man to be reckoned with. He killed Huangpu Qingtian and subdued Dragon Vein Soul, making the world quake for nine days. From what I saw, he is a man who can change fate.”
The emperor’s face darkened, “You mean to tell me Zhuo Fan has the dragon soul and has now become a rightful king, by providence no less?”
“Yes. But although he has providence and dragon soul’s protection, the wielder of Dragon Vein ruling the lands has been foretold by the High Priest since a thousand years ago. Over these years, the Parish’s prediction hasn’t changed. There’s just one thing I am unable to clarify. If dragon soul’s protection was providence and heaven’s blessing, why did Huangpu Qingtian end up getting killed? Is this a flaw in the prediction, or Zhuo Fan defies the heavens themselves?”
Fang Qiubai was pensive.
The emperor said with cold eyes, “How did Zhuo Fan kill him?”
“Bit him to death.” Dugu Zhantian reported with his head hanging.
The emperor was stunned, “Bitten to death? Did he... eat him?”
“Your Majesty, is something wrong?” Fang Qiubai asked.
What shocked the people was Zhuo Fan killing Huangpu Qingtian, with none paying attention to how he did it.
But from the emperor’s reaction, it seems it held a deeper meaning.
The emperor continued, “What happened afterwards? What was the reaction of the houses after Regent Estate’s eldest young master died?”
“Regent Estate’s hatred for Zhuo Fan ran bone deep and when the kid returned to Dragon Cloud City, the four house lords besieged him, however...”
“What, you saved him?” The emperor eyed them.
Fang Qiubai sighed, “Your Majesty, the kid has the dragon soul now, and sooner or later, will become a thorn in the imperial family’s side. Thinking about how he has done so much for us, we couldn’t just kill him ourselves. So letting the Regent Estate attack him was the best conclusion. That is why Marshal Dugu and myself did not interfere. However, Mad Dipper Li Jingtian did.”
“Mad Dipper? Wasn’t he Regent Estate’s Venerable? He went missing six years ago but why did he suddenly show up to protect Zhuo Fan?” The emperor frowned.
Fang Qiubai shook his head, “I am not clear either. All I know is that he turned his back on the Regent Estate and sided with the Luo clan, becoming their elder. He also follows Zhuo Fan’s orders to a fault. It was evident from Zhuo Fan’s order to annihilate the Regent Estate. He didn’t hesitate in attacking Huangpu Tianyuan and the others.”
“What, Regent Estate was destroyed in Dragon Cloud City?”
“Of course not!”
Fang Qiubai replied at the emperor’s shock, “If all the elders of Regent Estate died, the world would be in chaos and that would only harm Your Majesty. That is why I stepped in. But Li Jingtian was truly strong. He has already reached peak Radiant Stage. All I could do was fight him to a draw. I am deeply ashamed.”
The emperor’s eyes shrank, incapable of believing what he was hearing. Luo clan, a third rate clan, was actually hiding an expert that could tie with a Divine Dragon?
[Doesn’t that mean the Luo clan is on the same level as the seven houses?]
In fact, they are now second only to Regent Estate!
“In less than ten years, that wretched clan has grown so much. In less than a decade!” The emperor sighed.
Fang Qiubai and Dugu Zhantian sighed as well. The events were too astonishing.
Zhuo Fan was incredible, capable of turning everything around.
Who could turn a bunch of ants in such a short time into an elephant? Zhuo Fan!
Taking out the paper from his sleeve, the emperor sighed, “Take a look. When the world quaked, Parish sent these words.”
The two read it and after a pensive silence, they said to the emperor, “May we ask what is Your Majesty’s view of these words?”
“I didn’t understand at first, but listening to what transpired in Dragon Cloud City, I can guess now.” The emperor stroked his beard, “The earth dragon points at Huangpu Qingtian, representing the Regent Estate. While the celestial dragon ought to be Zhuo Fan descending from the heavens. When the two dragons collide, the land and rivers shall each call their king. This is the most worrisome part. The world will fall into chaos, with kings appearing and Tianyu sundering!”
The two generals paled. If these words were true, the empire was at an impasse.
“Your Majesty, I may be close to the Luo clan, but for Tianyu’s safety, allow me to march on Windgaze City!” Dugu Zhantian cupped his hands.
The emperor waved his proposal, “No, know yourself and your enemy and you shall be ever-victorious. The intelligence of the Luo clan is thin. To the point that we didn’t even know of Li Jingtian. It’s obvious that Zhuo Fan is hiding deep secrets. And even if we do march on them, we can’t do it without a good reason. It will only give others the chance to take advantage of the chaos.”
“Then what shall we do, Your Majesty?” Dugu Zhantian cupped his hands.
The emperor grumbled about something, then spoke with a dark face, “As per our promise, inform that all of the Luo clan has to come to the imperial capital for its reward, to receive their title as the eight noble house. Call upon the clans of the land and the seven houses to bear witness to this ceremony!”
Fang Qiubai’s eyes lit up, catching the emperor’s drift. He nodded, “Your Majesty is wise. With so many experts gathered in the imperial capital, we won’t have to lift a finger as they will tear each other apart out of hatred and vengeance. Any misfortune that befalls the Luo clan now, even if by Regent Estate’s insidious hand, would have nothing coming back to us. We will even see the Luo clan’s true power come to light. That’s two birds with one stone!”
“No, it may very well be possible that the Regent Estate has long been powerless to deal with the Luo clan. I only wish to see the Luo clan’s power to its full extent, ha-ha-ha...” With a sinister laughter, the emperor’s eyes shone.
Three months later, a red light shot before Blackwind Mountain. A seven year old kid appeared before the mountain, looking on with a sigh, “This must be dad’s home. And it even has 5th grade arrays. Not bad at all.”
“Dad, I’m here. Open up or I’ll bash my way in!” The kid roared.
The very next second, fog parted and Yan Fu walked out from within. Seeing the shouting kid, he was lost, “Kid, where did you come from? Who told you to come here? Don’t you know this is the Luo clan, the one even the seven houses fear? I’ll give you a thrashing if you keep shouting.”
“Tch, a mere lackey is so cocky? The Luo clan’s fame must be quite something. Not beneath those houses at least.” The kid grinned, ignoring Yan Fu and turning to the distant Blackwind Mountain peak as he assessed, “Not bad. Dad picked the perfect place with ample spiritual energy.”
Yan Fu’s face twitched and he snapped, “Brat, you dare call me a lackey? Do you know who I am, who my master is?”
“Tch, showing off and talking about your backing proves loud and clear that you are, in fact, but a lackey.”
Ugh!
Yan Fu faltered, stunned speechless at the kid’s flawless logic.
He had gotten used to scaring others with his master’s name. Even though for the last few years, he was down on his luck, but after seeing his master, he was in high spirits, back to his same old habits.
But getting mocked by a kid left a bad taste in his mouth. Even more so when the kid made perfect sense. Everywhere he went he’d show off his backing, like a true lackey. As if he was afraid of getting a thrashing.
Yan Fu sighed in the end, “Out with it brat, what do you want?”
“I’ve come for someone.”
“Who?”
“My dad, Zhuo Fan!” The kid stuck out his chin...

chapters.title: Chapter 347, Monstrous Father and Son Duo
chapters.content:
Chapter 347, Monstrous Father and Son Duo
Translator: StarReader
[Uhm… what?!]
Gasping, Yan Fu stammered, “Who did you say you were here for again?”
“Zhuo Fan.”
“N-no, I mean, is Steward Zhuo your…” Yan Fu gulped.
The kid raised an eyebrow and spoke genially, “My dad, why?”
“What, Steward Zhuo is your dad?” Only now did the words register in Yan Fu’s grinding mind. He gasped with bulging eyes, “Steward Zhuo has a child? Why didn’t he say anything?”
The kid put on his thinking cap, “Eh… he probably didn’t have the time. Since the two of us only recently met.”
[An out of wedlock child!]
Yan Fu’s heart was pumping at full throttle as a cryptic smile formed on his face and he rubbed the kid’s head, “Little guy, wait here while I get your dad.”
The kid flicked Yan Fu’s hand off, “Listen bud, I hate it when people touch my head. If not for being one of dad’s men, I’d pummel you into the ground and leave you to the wolves.”
Shivering, words left Yan Fu.
The kid was so tiny yet packed a mean attitude, threatening him left and right. [Just like Steward Zhuo.]
He now somewhat believed that the two were related. They were just too similar. Not to mention the kid sure was mighty, his hand was still stinging.
Sss~
Gasping, Yan Fu cradled his inflamed hand and darted inside to report.
[This is breaking news! Zhuo Fan’s love child is at the door!]
In a jiffy, a stream of people rushed down the mountain, with Luo Yunchang in lead. The report had her thunderstruck, freezing on the spot.
She should’ve known Zhuo Fan had other girls out there besides Chu Qingcheng and Ning’er. With a child no less. That was the last straw!
[You damn player, once I get to the bottom of this, you’re dead!]
Raging like a volcano, Luo Yunchang stormed down the mountain along with Xue Qingjian, Qiu Yanhai, Captain Pang and many more joining the bustle.
They were looking forward to meet their Steward’s son. With such an attitude, his child ought not to be as fiendish as his dad, no?
But when they arrived, the kid looked so cute and bright, everyone just wanted to hug him.
“Awww, I didn’t think the Steward’s son would be so adorable. His mother must be gorgeous!” Xue Qingjian’s maternal instinct kicked in high gear.
Luo Yunchang’s mood only sank, mirthless. But seeing the kid she squeezed a smile as she asked, “Little guy, is your dad really our steward Zhuo Fan? Mind telling me your name?”
“Are you calling me a liar? You, rude bint, I’ve come to see my dad. You all better not stand in my way and take me to him, now!” The kid snapped.
Luo Yunchang’s face twitched.
That was a first, for a kid to call her a bint. The others were having a blast and broke out in laughter.
Yan Song sized the kid and said, “The child may be young, but quite spirited. His tone is just like Steward Zhuo’s, as brash and egotistical. We no longer have to fear the Luo clan’s decline. We even have the next steward, ha-ha-ha…”
Yan Song laughed, rubbing the kid’s hair.
But the kid’s brow shivered and his face looked positively dark.
“Elder Yan is right. I find the kid clever and with Steward Zhuo’s teachings, we will have endless generations of stronger and stronger geniuses. Come, call me uncle Pang!”
Captain Pang laughed, getting his turn to ruffle the kid’s head, who only glowered.
But the crowd hardly noticed or cared. A child was getting teased by adults. What could he do other than bear it?
And so, after the second came the third, and on and on it went. Everyone rubbed his head and teased him. But the child’s only reaction was an increasingly darker face.
The last draw was when Qiu Yanhai came over laughing. But before he could speak, the kid flung his hand off and snapped, “I told you not to touch my head. Take me to see my father!”
“Oh my, he’s pouting, ha-ha-ha… The spitting image of Steward Zhuo!”
Qiu Yanhai laughed, further aggravating the kid by rubbing his head again, “You twerp, you are so young yet have such fire in you, just like your old man. A shame you don’t have his strength. Look, I’m touching your head. What are you gonna do about it? I can’t mess with your dad, so why don’t I mess with you? Ha-ha-ha…”
Qiu Yanhai toyed with him until the kid’s face was practically throbbing with rage.
Xue Qingjian poured more oil, “Geezer, stop poking him. He is only a child. Worry about when his dad finds out that we teased his son and he’ll come toy with us. “
“Ha-ha-ha, what’s there to fear? Steward Zhuo is in seclusion to nurse his wounds. He won’t be coming out soon. A child’s memory is like a fish anyway, gone the next day. He won’t remember, right twerp?” Qiu Yanhai smirked.
The kid snorted, “Quite right. I don’t have a good memory. Because anybody that pisses me off, I’ll make sure to deal with them on the spot.”
With a bang, the kid’s tiny hand clamped on Qiu Yanhai’s wrist like a vise.
Qiu Yanhai felt his wrist about to break and paled. Nothing he did could get him out of the hold. Only now did he realize that the kid was more than he seemed, way more.
While others were still blissfully oblivious.
The kid’s eyes left him cold and shivering, “I don’t need dad for help. I’ll let you have a taste myself.”
The kid flung Qiu Yanhai, under the bug-eyed crowd, smack into the ground.
Boom!
Qiu Yanhai cracked the earth, the gap extending farther and farther. In a blink, it crossed a whole mile and passed into Windgaze City.
Rumble!
No one could believe their eyes as to how Windgaze City was suddenly sporting a bottomless gap.
Pff!
Qiu Yanhai coughed blood, filled with shock.
[What kind of monster is he? How does he have so much power to wound an 8th layer Radiant Stage expert just like that?] He had never imagined the kid would be so freakish.
The rest went slack jawed, with eyes wide as saucers.
This seven year old scamp had the power to kill a Radiant Stage expert in one blow! [What the hell?]
The people gulped from shock.
[That’s Zhuo Fan’s kid alright. Neither of them is normal, but monsters! With the son even more outrageous than the father.]
Luo Yunchang forgot about her jealousy then and there. She stared at the previously adorable kid with raw fear.
Letting go of Qiu Yanhai, the kid tended to his hair, and mocked, “Geezer, know what’s good for you. If not for you being under my dad, I’d have snapped your twig of a body in two. Humph, try touching me again and see where that gets you.”
Qiu Yanhai felt like crying.
He, a Radiant Stage expert and an elder, was manhandled like a child, by a child!
The others looked startled and their hands shivered. Who among them hadn’t touched the kid’s head? It was just Elder Qiu’s rotten luck to do it last. If it were them, their entire skeleton would be dust by now.
The crowd looked at the kid with even more fear, yet no less amazement. Zhuo Fan was a monster, but that didn’t guarantee his son would be one too. At least not a freak of nature like this one.
[Holy hell! A seven year old kid can shoot down a Radiant Stage expert in one blow. How are the rest of us supposed to survive?]
Tears began to well in their hearts…
“Enough wasting time. Take me to my father!” The kid spoke with pride after that little display.
This time, the people were amiable enough to nod, and led the way shivering.
The kid held his head high, strutting before them as he walked into the Luo clan’s manor.
Just then, five figures appeared, Li Jingtian and the Four Scheming Demons.
Seeing Luo Yunchang and the rest, Li Jingtian asked, “What’s wrong? What was all the commotion outside?”
The faces of everyone sank as they pointed at the kid.
Li Jingtian merely looked at him and became a blundering shivering mess, “I-Invincible Scamp Gu Santong! What in god’s name are you doing here?”

chapters.title: Chapter 348, I Want to Use the Qilin Leg
chapters.content:
Chapter 348, I Want to Use the Qilin Leg
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
“Ah! It’s that little monster, he just won’t leave us alone!” The Four Scheming Demons hugged their heads and rolled on the ground in fear.
And everyone went speechless.
This was a first for all, seeing Mad Dipper frantic and the four fearless pygmies scurrying around like headless chickens.
Then again, the power this kid showed was almost out of this world...
“Uh, Elder Li, you know this child?” Luo Yunchang asked with a trembling lip.
Li Jingtian looked oddly at her, “C-child? Young miss, he may be a child to you, but to us, he is the oldest monster. Just three hundred years ago, he threw Tianyu into chaos and defeated everyone. And now he is the strongest Divine Dragon of the imperial family, Invincible Scamp Gu Santong. We won’t even be able to scratch him with all of us working together.”
What a shocker! All eyes on Gu Santong were now full of fear.
Who could’ve seen that coming? Certainly not them! That a sweet, sweet child could be such an abomination.
Qiu Yanhai was the most bitter. Glancing at the adorable Gu Santong, he felt like crying. If he had known the kid was a centuries old freak, he wouldn’t even get near him.
Everyone was now trying to make sense of what this force of nature was doing coming to the Luo clan.
“But... isn’t he Zhuo Fan’s son? How can he be three hundred years old?” Luo Yunchang was skeptical.
Li Jingtian looked puzzled as well, “Who told you that?”
“He did!” And the crowd had spoken, pointing at Gu Santong.
Now it is Li Jingtian’s turn to be floored. He looked at Gu Santong’s genial face, filled with doubt. All the renowned experts cared about the world’s view of them and Gu Santong was no different. [What possible reason would this almighty expert have to lower himself and say he was some guy’s son?]
The non committal Gu Santong had clearly admitted it to be the truth, leaving Li Jingtian even more confused.
“Where’s dad? Take me to him!” Gu Santong said.
Li Jingtian hesitated but nodded in the end, “Wait a moment while I inform him.”
It wasn’t long before he was back, but this time with an even odder look for Gu Santong, “Uh, Steward Zhuo asked everyone and... the child to come inside.”
Those words were enough for everyone to see that Zhuo Fan was indeed Gu Santong’s dad. There would be no point for Elder Li to call him child otherwise.
Yet nobody had a clue about how a worldly expert, Tianyu’s strongest Divine Dragon, ended up as his son.
One thing was certain though, they saw Zhuo Fan’s handiwork in a whole new light. Only he could make this possible.
Walking in a single file, they all marched into the Luo clan’s main hall. Zhuo Fan was already seated with a bright smile, “Young Sanzi, it’s been ages!”
“Dad!”
Gu Santong skipped cheerfully in Zhuo Fan’s arms. He didn’t look like a three hundred year old monster to anyone, just a sweet child.
But the instant he saw Zhuo Fan’s empty right sleeve, his eyes snapped, “Dad, your right hand! Who did this to you? I’ll kill them all!”
“No need, I’ve already handled it.”
Zhuo Fan shook his head. With Tianyu’s factions in a delicate balance, he didn’t want Gu Santong to be the spark that blew everything sky high and affected his plan.
“And what are you doing here? It can’t be that you’re here just to see little old me.” Zhuo Fan switched topics with a smile.
Gu Santong nodded, “I came to give the Luo clan a decree. For the Luo clan’s exemplary performance in Esoteric Debate, three months from now, the emperor will bestow upon it the title of 8th noble house in the imperial capital, in front of the clans of Tianyu. All heads of the clans and houses will be there to celebrate.”
[What?!]
Everyone was stunned.
Who would’ve thought the imperial family would hold up their word so fast? But it also worried them. Zhuo Fan had the Dragon Vein Soul, and the emperor’s attitude would definitely change towards them.
But by giving them a title in such a grand style while also inviting every clan, was there a hidden agenda that might affect the Luo clan?
Zhuo Fan squinted, but smiled in the end, “Ha-ha-ha, I see. Now I know that you’ve come to give me this information. Thanks young Sanzi. And how have they been treating you in the Imperial Palace, do they feed you well?”
Gu Santong’s glee was replaced with heartache, “Don’t remind me. Those stingy creeps only know to give me 1st and 2nd grade ingredients. Ever since I ate dad’s high grade ingredients, those low ones seem stale.”
“Ha-ha-ha, then why don’t you stay here for a little while and live it up like a young master?”
Laughing, Zhuo Fan presented an ingredient rich in spiritual energy. Gu Santong perked up on the spot, “8th grade ingredient! F-for me?”
“Of course. What’s mine is yours!” Zhuo Fan pushed the ingredient to a cheerful Gu Santong.
At the side, Yan Song’s heart was bleeding. [That’s an 8th grade ingredient!] With the secret alchemy art Zhuo Fan had taught him, he might even be able to refine a 9th grade pill with that ingredient.
[Giving it away just like that is such a waste.]
But the pain had only just begun.
Zhuo Fan waved Yan Song over, “Elder Yan, my son will be staying with us for a few days. He just loves ingredients. For every meal, you have to give him at least one 6th grade ingredient. Got it?”
Face twitching, alchemist Yan Song’s poor heart was at its limit.
But since Zhuo Fan had commanded it, he could only suck it up and nod. Gu Santong was ecstatic, hugging his neck and kissing him, “You’re the best dad in the whole world....”
All of this happened before a mute audience. Where did the fiendish monster go? In front of Zhuo Fan, he was nothing but a cute seven year old.
“Alright, alright...”
Zhuo Fan waved, telling Gu Santong to get down as his face turned serious, “Young Sanzi, there’s something I must talk to you about. Perhaps you won’t agree, but I must ask.”
Gu Santong cocked his head.
Zhuo Fan sighed and said, “Young Sanzi, I want to use the Qilin leg.”
“What?” Gu Santong cried.
“I know, it is very dear to you, and I never intended to do this either. But now I have no choice...” His eyes trailed to his empty right sleeve as he continued, “If you don’t agree I’ll have no choice but to force you to take it from me or make you agree and have you resent me forever.”
Raising his arm, his Thunder Ring flashed as he looked Gu Santong straight in the eye.
He knew how important the Qilin leg was to Gu Santong. It was his elder’s remains that he treasured greatly.
If he had just used it without even telling Gu Santong, there would always be a wall between them. It might even break off their relationship.
Gu Santong’s first godfather was a scholar, who taught him to repay gratitude in kind.
Before he made this request, Zhuo Fan had first dumped a pile of ingredients in this kid’s lap, earning a few brownie points coupled with the statement, [What’s mine is yours.] – sharing the profits.
Forcing a great battle to take place in Gu Santong’s heart.
Zhuo Fan treated him like his kin, but to avoid any arguments in the future, he still came out clean to make Gu Santong give him the Qilin leg willingly.
Zhuo Fan held his breath as he watched him. Gu Santong was silent for a long time before nodding, “If it were anyone else, I’d definitely refuse. But like dad just said, what’s mine is yours.”
“Ha-ha-ha, oh son!”
Zhuo Fan laughed, hugging him tighter and kissing him twice until Gu Santong giggled.
The people in the hall sighed. Steward Zhuo was a true miracle worker to get so close with that little monster. They were no different from true father and son.
Not to mention this monstrous duo would one day take the empire by the storm with no one to stop them.
Everyone could practically see the two go on a rampage and the Luo clan entering into an era of prosperity at the top.
[It was the right choice to come over to the Luo clan’s side.] Was the unanimous sentiment.
Only Luo Yunchang didn’t care much for interests, feeling her heart swell at the touching reunion.
[Zhuo Fan is no longer lonely...]
Zhuo Fan and Gu Santong chatted for a while and then Zhuo Fan took him to have his fill of ingredients. Especially high grade ones. These were all taken from that 6th grade spiritual beast’s cave back in Beast King Mountain.
Their amount was neither plenty nor few to start with. Yan Song was the Alchemy House Elder and was ecstatic at seeing them the first time.
But now he had to watch them get stuffed down Gu Santong’s gullet. In no time at all, almost none were left, much to the misery of the old man.
Not that Zhuo Fan cared. As long as he could use the Qilin leg while Gu Santong agreed, he took it as a bargain. As for the ingredients, they were merely worldly possessions, nothing compared to the Qillin leg and the ongoing relationship he had with Gu Santong.
Two weeks later, Gu Santong’s time was up and he had to leave, despite his reluctance. But before he left, Zhuo Fan gave him a pile of ingredients as snacks, making the separation somewhat bearable.
When Gu Santong was gone, Luo Yunchang and the rest were preparing to leave as well, for the imperial capital. But Zhuo Fan wasn’t coming with them.
He was almost completely healed and what was left was to deal with his severed right arm. Then he would be reborn, with newfound power coursing through his veins tens of times greater than before...

chapters.title: Chapter 349, Qilin Arm
chapters.content:
Chapter 349, Qilin Arm
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
“Elder Li, the safety of young miss will be your responsibility on your way to the Imperial capital. Myself and the other elders will meet you later.” At the foot of Blackwind Mountain, Zhuo Fan patted Li Jingtian’s shoulder.
Li Jingtian nodded.
Zhuo Fan let out a relaxed chuckle and left a few instructions for the rest before sending them off.
He was letting Li Jingtian go on this trip to the imperial capital out of fear that the other houses might harbor evil plans.
In that regard, the tough and loyal Li Jingtian was the best choice.
When they were gone from his sight, Zhuo Fan took Xue Qingjian, Yan Song and the Four Scheming Demons back to Blackwind Mountain. They soon arrived before the familiar Misty Forest.
Zhuo Fan said, “I will enter seclusion for a few days and you must protect me. No one is allowed entry into Blackwind Mountain’s surroundings. Is that clear?”
“Crystal!” They all cupped their hands.
Zhuo Fan relaxed and vanished among the fog. The rest assumed their role and guarded Blackwind Mountain from all directions.
After arriving at a wide clearing, Zhuo Fan found it adequate and began to carve a familiar body refining array. The only difference was that this array was a great deal larger.
When finished, Zhuo Fan’s hand flashed and he inserted tens of thousands of spirit stones into the array core with a wave.
With a boom, a pillar suddenly shot for the clouds.
This was the same Qilin leg he obtained from the Lightning Canyon, the one he was planning to make his new right arm from.
But the effort to convert a sacred beast’s leg into a human’s arm was far too difficult. The scale of the Qilin leg alone posed a huge problem.
Luckily, he had come prepared. With the Shaping Spring he got from Beast King Mountain, this problem was solved by itself. Shaping Spring’s mystical ability would turn the Qilin leg into a human’s arm and safely replace his lost limb.
He had had this idea since the first time he heard of Shaping Spring. But because of the dangers involved, he had vetoed it.
Yet the fight with Huangpu Qingtian had taught him to steel himself and throw away any hesitation. [It’s just a hand, how hard can it be?]
Grinning, Zhuo Fan sighed. [When the going gets tough, the tough gets going.]
Zhuo Fan flew atop the Qilin leg and poured the Shaping Spring all over it. He then slowly floated back down, stepped out of the array and made a hand sign.
A tremendous boom echoed and the array exploded with light. Even the thick fog found it hard to conceal it.
The elders outside were stunned, in the dark about Zhuo Fan’s plan.
Then the Qilin leg released a bloody glow echoing the array’s own light. It trembled and crackled with lightning. At the same time, the white liquid on its surface slowly seeped in.
It wasn’t long before all of it was absorbed.
Squinting, Zhuo Fan capitalized on the timing and changed his hand sign, “Heaven and Earth’s sacred power shifts ying and yang, the Qilin leg will turn into an arm. All shall be fused as one and the sacred arm will break the heavens!”
It started off with a buzz. The array released a ripple from its center and the Qilin leg never stopped shaking.
It reached the magnitude of an earthquake as even the surrounding mountains started rumbling, including Blackwind Mountain. Not even the four 5th grade arrays could take the strain when rocks fell everywhere.
Qiu Yanhai, Xue Qingjian and the rest of the elder contingency were overwhelmed. [What is Steward Zhuo doing? Is he going to wreck his own clan’s foundation?]
The Four Scheming Demons wailed as they panicked all over the place, “The sky is falling...”
Only Zhuo Fan was stirred, seeing the Qilin leg shrink by half in a blink.
The body refining array from the Nine Serenities Secret Records was truly something to be able to refine even a sacred beast.
The next part was crucial, fusing the sacred arm. Success would be achieved only when the Qilin leg would calmly rest below his right shoulder.
[Or all of this effort would go to waste.]
[I hope there won’t be a rejection. This is, after all, the sacred leg from the mighty Qilin...]
Squinting, Zhuo Fan took a deep breath and focused on the shrinking red pillar. Once it was the size of an arm, he shouted and jumped inside the array.
Ah!
A wail of agony similar to the one in the Allbeast Mountain Range echoed. Zhuo Fan felt his body disintegrate under the onslaught of the thunderstorm within the array.
What made it worse was that this pain was a hundred times more excruciating than last time.
Last time the array size was much smaller, and he had only used Diamond Sand and a 6th level spiritual beast’s wings. But this time, he thirsted to make the mighty Qilin’s leg his arm.
Weighting the price and the benefits of having it rest below his shoulder, he found it more than worth it.
But not for the life of him did Zhuo Fan expect to endure such agony. Watching his body chipping away, his flesh splashing onto the array, Zhuo Fan’s eyes widened with pain, ready to explode.
This pain went beyond the conceivable realm. The last refining was but a bug bite by comparison.
But Zhuo Fan held fast.
The last time he had done it for Ning’er, while this time he was doing it for everyone, so that Ning’er’ misfortune would never repeat itself.
Ah!
Howling at the sky, the elders outside freaked out. They watched the Misty Forest with concern.
[Steward Zhuo, just what cultivation method are you practicing to make even a tenacious demon like you scream at the top of his lungs...]
In the array, Zhuo Fan’s flesh floated about and even his organs were gone. All that was left was his skeleton and his trembling eyes.
Zhuo Fan would’ve been long dead by now in these circumstances, but within the array, his life force didn’t scatter.
Hum~
The Qilin leg released a bloody glow and Zhuo Fan’s pieces of flesh flew around it and bathed in the red glow before shooting for his body and reforging it.
With a long sigh, Zhuo Fan’s heart eased. [It’s finally combining.] This meant that the refining was nearing its end, bringing him one step closer to success.
His thinking was quite logical. When the body was reformed, the refining would end.
Although, he didn’t take into account the fact that the target of his refining was a sacred beast.
Whoosh~
The flying flesh reformed on Zhuo Fan’s skeleton and released a pale red glow, with only the right arm missing from its place.
And then the Qilin leg floated over, slowly approaching his shoulder to fuse.
He didn’t get to rejoice though as a heaven shaking howl announced the trembling of the Qilin leg.
A red glow flashed from the leg and pierced his brain.
Zhuo Fan blanked out for a second and felt his head splitting, about to explode. A bellow like that of a savage beast tore through the deepest corners of his mind and knocked him out.
[I failed...]
Sighing in his heart, this was his last thought before he passed out cold.
A blood red Qilin was roaring in his soul, wanting to tear the place apart.
[A mere human dares to covet my sacred body? You are judged unworthy!]
Roar!
While the Qilin was having a literal blast in the depths of his soul, a dragon roar came from within Zhuo Fan’s body. The Dragon Vein Soul charged at the Qilin.
Zhuo Fan was now its master and its duty was to protect him. It was aware that it was no match for the Qilin, but it was going to try and protect Zhuo Fan with its life.
The Qilin only had disdain for the dragon soul, “Humph, if you were a celestial dragon, I would’ve graced you with a strike. But a tiny earth dragon dares to bar my path?”
The Qilin lifted its leg and stomped on the dragon soul.
Bam!
The dragon soul was kicked out of Zhuo Fan’s soul and back into his Dantian with the face of a kicked puppy.
[Master! I did my best, but it just wasn’t enough!]
“Ha-ha-ha, a snail dares contend with me? Die!” The Qilin cackled and raved at the surrounding darkness, “Ha-ha-ha, this human brat has some nerve. See how I’ll tear your soul to smithereens!”
It didn’t get the chance though as a sharp cry announced the pain in his back. A huge bird made of azure flame clawed at the tough Qilin’s back.
Qilin looked back in shock, “You!”
“Yes, old partner, I’ve chosen this kid and one day he will return our help many fold. You have long since died and removing this grief from your soul will be for the best.”
The huge azure fire bird exploded into flames and swallowed the Qilin. With a tightening of its claws, the Qilin vanished in a red glow.
Then, the huge azure fire bird vanished as well. Only then did Zhuo Fan’s ever throbbing right arm, the Qilin leg, finally became still as it began to fuse with his body...

chapters.title: Chapter 350, Comprehensive Advancement
chapters.content:
Chapter 350, Comprehensive Advancement
“I wasn’t devoured?”
After a long time, Zhuo Fan opened his eyes and saw the clear blue sky.
When the Qilin leg connected to his shoulder, he felt a terrible resentment tearing at his soul.
But what had him shocked was that a mere Qilin leg, dead for god knows how long, was still bearing such strong resentment.
As it came from a sacred beast, the magnitude was amplified.
It had instantly cut off his consciousness before he could even cry for help. The last thought that went through his mind was a lament for having failed it all.
The sacred beast’s resentment pierced his soul, yet it didn’t get destroyed?
[How am I still alive? Did the Qilin resentment turn noble and let me off?]
Even he found that impossible. Resentment was a mass of rage, how could it develop a conscience?
Zhuo Fan just couldn’t make heads or tails of it. He shook his head in the end, crawling to his feet. Then he realized he had done that with his right arm…
He looked at his right hand in shock and a glowing red arm entered his eyes.
[The refining succeeded.] He had turned the Qilin leg into a sky-piercing Qilin arm!
Overjoyed, Zhuo Fan took in all the details of his new arm, yet it wasn’t one bit different from his other arm. But when he moved his fingers, he could feel the space itself vibrate.
The power behind his right arm was just as freaky as Gu Santong’s!
Zhuo Fan was confident that no one in Tianyu could match this arm of his. He wouldn’t balk even against Gu Santong’s attacks.
Zhuo Fan was ecstatic and jumped in glee. But he could only jump to a thousand feet of height above the mist.
Zhuo Fan had forgotten that he had lost his wings and couldn’t fly as a Bone Tempering expert. So why was he still hovering here?
[I… have advanced!]
Zhuo Fan checked his cultivation in a rush.
Sure enough, the refining had jumped his cultivation into the 3rd layer of Profound Heaven Stage. Not to mention the dragon soul’s power within him had already fused with him and brought his body to a new level.
Through the dragon power tempering and with the dragon soul within him, the power in his body shot had through the roof. Not even Huangpu Qingtian could match him now.
And that wasn’t even half of it. He found with great delight that Blood Infant had advanced as well. It had broken the shackles and advanced into the Profound Heaven Stage.
The Profound Heaven Stage Blood Infant’s speed had reached an unprecedented level. Not even a Discerning Field could catch up to it.
Squinting, Zhuo Fan flexed his mind.
Whoosh!
A red glow flew out of him, took a tour of Blackwind Mountain’s surroundings for a hundred miles and was back inside in the blink of an eye.
At the core of Blackwind Mountain, watching over the arrays, Xue Qingjian and Qiu Yanhai, were cultivating with closed eyes when they felt a chill pass through them.
“Old hag, did you feel that?” Qiu Yanhai’s eyes trembled.
Xue Qingjian nodded and gulped, “A-as if something passed by. But why couldn’t I sense it? It’s all based on my instinct.”
“You too?”
Gasping, Qiu Yanhai’s aged face shuddered, “Then it mustn’t have been just a coincidence. I felt the same. But why? Is there anything in this world that can fly past our divine sense without getting detected? If not for the instincts we honed through battles for a century, we wouldn’t have felt the danger either.”
“Yeah, just what was that? If it was a human, how dreadful would he be? We could never hope to reach him.”
Qiu Yanhai sighed, scratching his head, “I only hope he has no ill will towards the Luo clan…”
In another area, the Four Scheming Demons were on duty, to fend off anyone going into the Misty Forest where Zhuo Fan lay.
But were these pygmies that bored? It didn’t take fifteen minutes before they were back to squabbling and fighting. And they had kept at it all this time.
Whoosh!
When the red glow flashed by, the four pygmies stopped mid swing.
“Bro, did something pass by just now?” Sly Demon frowned.
Violent Demon’s punch faltered, his eyes roaming about, “No way. What could possibly pass us four heroic demons without so much as a sound? Such a thing doesn’t exist in this world.”
“Yeah, there’s absolutely no way!” Wimp Demon shook his head.
The other two paused for a second before doing the same.
“That settles it. Now, where were we?” Violent Demon swung his hand with a grin.
Sly Demon said, “Uh, you were about to punch my face.”
Bam!
And that was what Violent Demon did, smacking Sly Demon’s nose, “Ha-ha-ha, now I remember. I really wanted to bash your face in.”
Sly Demon returned blows of course, right at Violent Demon’s head. Thus, the four resumed their ever bustling bonding.
But just then, Zhuo Fan’s dignified voice came from above Blackwind Mountain, “Elders, come to the Misty Forest.”
Steward Zhuo was out!
Xue Qingjian and Qiu Yanhai rushed post haste. Yan Song came out of the Alchemy House as well, flying to the forest.
The Four Scheming Demons stopped their sharing tough love and gathered at Misty Forest.
Soon, all of the Luo clan’s elders were watching the forest. Zhuo Fan walked out of the bloody fog and nodded.
The elders saw that Zhuo Fan didn’t only recover his arm but had also reached the 3rd layer of Profound Heaven Stage.
Leaping four layers in just one month? His speed was faster than a rocket!
Monster!
The word was on everyone’s lips. [How could Huangpu Qingtian possibly compare? He was just a novice.]
Zhuo Fan smiled, “How long was I away?”
“A month.” Yan Song bowed.
Nodding pleasantly, Zhuo Fan said, “Perfect, I just let my demonic creature check your situation. You’ve done well this month.”
“What, it was you just now?” Xue Qingjian cried out, “What is that demonic creature that moves so fast?”
“Ha-ha-ha, I have many more tricks up my sleeve. You will get to see them in time.”
Zhuo Fan replied with a vague smile, which only made the others more baffled. [Just how many tricks is Steward Zhuo Fan hiding to catch everyone off guard? Truly frightening.]
Even though they were Radiant Stage experts, they were like kittens in front of a tiger when Zhuo Fan was around.
“From what I saw, that was a quick reaction. Elder Qiu and Elder Xue, you’re quite sharp. Elder Yan is still in Profound Heaven Stage so it’s fine, and he is quite dedicated to alchemy too. Only you four, what the hell is wrong you sh*ts?”
Zhuo Fan’s smile turned demonic as he glared, “I told you to defend this place yet all you do is squabble. Talk, how should I punish your negligence of duty?”
Shuddering, the four put on hurt looks in sync.
“Uh, Steward Zhuo, anything but the Bloodworms. Any other punishment is fine. How about you beat us up?” Sly Demon pleaded.
Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan laughed, “You must be thinking I can’t hurt you, to ask for that, right? Fine, we’ll do it your way. I’ll beat you silly!”
The four were ecstatic.
With Zhuo Fan’s tiny cultivation in comparison to theirs, in the 6th layer of Profound Heaven Stage, he couldn’t even make it sting. As long as the Bloodworms were out of the picture.
Even standing there and taking Zhuo Fan’s hits, they figured Zhuo Fan’s fist would be the one hurting in the end.
The four showed crafty smiles.
Zhuo Fan didn’t mind, merely eying them coldly as he spread his arms, “Take your pick, left or right?”
“Ha-ha-ha, whichever you wish.” Violent Demon laughed nonchalantly.
With a snicker, Zhuo Fan stretched out his left arm and said, “Left it is, so I won’t beat you to death and waste all the effort dumped into you the past five years.”
[Transformation!]
Zhuo Fan roared in his mind…

chapters.title: Chapter 351, Two Beast Fists
chapters.content:
Chapter 351, Two Beast Fists
Roar!
A dragon roar reverberated and Zhuo Fan’s face turned more and more savage as his left arm released a golden glow and a dragon image flowed along it.
Constant snapping sounds were heard and his skin actually transformed into dragon scales.
Lastly, his entire hand turned into a dragon claw. A mere twitch of his fingers was enough to tell you how sharp they were as they whistled through the air.
“Earth Dragon Claw!”
Zhuo Fan said. He turned his vicious eyes at the four scared cats and said, “Over the last month, I’ve trained to integrate with the Dragon Vein Soul. So transforming goes without saying, ha-ha-ha…”
Then he swung his claw at the ground.
Boom!
A yellow glow flashed and a glowing arc split the ground on the spot. It passed through everything, snapping things in two. Not even the mountains were spared.
It went strong for the better part of a mile, before the yellow wave attack vanished.
Everyone watched on in shock.
Zhuo Fan cultivated for just one month and he came out not only layers above, but even his body was monstrous now.
Even the renowned body cultivators in the Radiant Stage would be reduced to pieces under that claw.
They all watched Zhuo Fan with dread. Now even if he didn’t use the Bloodworms, he could still put them in their place, not that they dared mess with him to begin with.
Zhuo Fan’s body strength far exceeded theirs…
“Abominable four, which one of you little sh*ts would like to go first?”
Zhuo Fan waved the dragon claw around, like a Demon Archon about to hand over the sentence to some imps.
The Four Scheming Demons were scared to death, choking on their own words.
[Holy hell! Is this a joke? What’s going to be left of me after that punch?]
They were truly regretting it now, knowing Zhuo Fan’s capacity for abnormality. Each time Steward Zhuo went into seclusion was like being born anew, coming up with new and outrageous ways to be overpowered.
Case in point, Zhuo Fan’s current seclusion shot him way beyond all those present. They were totally unprepared, but now they had to roll with it.
They should’ve seen this coming and should’ve dropped on their knees to beg for mercy instead. But how were they supposed to do that now?
The four sighed, their smiles laid thick with a heavy sense of begrudging and self-deprecation.
But soon, Sly Demon’s eyes probed, “Steward Zhuo, your Earth Dragon Claw is marvelous! I wonder though, can you do that with both hands?”
“Only the left.”
Zhuo Fan could see his thinking from a mile away, yet he didn’t hide it.
Sly Demon lit up and he gathered his pals around for a little bro talk, then they came out laughing.
Violent Demon puffed up his chest and stuck his chin out, “Steward Zhuo, didn’t you say we can choose which hand? You’re a man of your word, right?”
“But of course, though it won’t change anything.” Zhuo Fan smiled, “So I decided to use the left in dishing out your punishment.”
“No, we’ve changed our minds. We want the right one.” Violent Demon pointed at his brand new hand with a cackle.
Sending a condescending gaze his way, Zhuo Fan looked at his own right hand and shook his head, “This… won’t end well…”
“And why not? Come on, Steward Zhuo, you are a clan’s steward, your words are worth gold. You can’t go saying something on one hand and do another on the other. Or no one would trust you.”
Violent Demon urged on seeing him hesitate.
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow and smiled, “Oh, reverse psychology. Not bad at all. Alright, we’ll do it your way. Here comes my right.”
The four rejoiced, with Wimp Demon even giving a thumbs up and sucking up to his bro, “That’s our bro, insightful and glib! He has just received that arm and hasn’t practiced using it yet. It must be the weakest. It will snap like a twig the instant it touches us. Good going bro!”
“Dang right, or I ain’t your eldest bro!” Violent Demon stuck out his chin.
Sly Demon was annoyed and backhanded Wimp Demon, “Cut the bull, that was my idea. Who’s ass are you kissing? By all rights you should be kissing mine!”
Wimp Demon looked aggrieved with that red face.
Violent Demon was growing irate and backhanded Sly Demon too, “You’re the bullsh*tting one! I’m the eldest bro. Without my wise leadership you’d never come up with this plan. All credit goes to me!”
“You’re the one bullsh*tting. I said it first. It was my idea. Why should you take credit?”
Sly Demon was pissed off and started throwing punches at Violent Demon. The other two demons were cheering, but it wasn’t long before they joined in for a much needed bonding.
And so, four little demons played their little act per usual - same old same old.
The elders having front row seats of the spectacle had brooding moods. [These little sh*ts are a lost cause. They’ve already forgotten why Steward Zhuo was angry, why he was punishing them.]
They were going at it right in front of him, like everything was right as rain, no harm done.
Glancing over at Zhuo Fan, everyone could see the throbbing vein on his forehead.
“You four, are you ready for my fist?” Zhuo Fan’s patience was running dangerously low.
The Four Scheming Demons weren’t stopping on his account, yet they had the time to speak in unison, “Don’t mind us, do your thing. Knock yourself out and have your fill of punching!”
Despise, condescension and contempt, these four demons weren’t buying Zhuo Fan’s bravado, thinking his right arm wasn’t up to snuff.
Zhuo Fan smiled in anger and moved his hand around, “Ha-ha-ha, you sure are experts to want so many punches. That’s fine, let’s give you a little taste first, shall we?”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed with bloodthirst and he punched, “Tangible Projection, Sky Piercing Qilin Arm!”
Boom!
Like a flood, Zhuo Fan’s right arm shined red and swelled. His thick arm became like a giant steel wall barreling straight for the demons.
That terrifying might stole the breath of even these 6th layer of Radiant Stage experts. Ducking their heads instinctively.
Whoosh!
The red glow shot over the demons into the sky.
Boom!
Like an artillery blast, the Qilin sacred arm rumbled the space wherever it passed and pulverized everything else.
With the space in front of the fist taking the brunt of the hit, warping constantly and making a three hundred feet tall cliff crumble into nothing.
Once silence sat in, all that was left in the eyes of the onlookers was desolation and not much else.
The shock was so great that they were in denial.
Everyone knew Zhuo Fan would have an outrageous power boost, but who’d have seen that one coming? Not them. That thing could crush the world. The Four Scheming Demons were shivering on the spot, their faces void of blood.
It was a deja vu moment for them. Gu Santong had done the same thing. One invincible punch to crush everything.
Gulping, the Four Scheming Demons found it hard to look at the red pillar in the sky. They knew they had messed up and were on the verge of crying.
[You call that a hand? That’s a pylon! The slightest touch will turn us into meat patties! I’d take the dragon claw anytime, thank you very much! ]
They blindly took Zhuo Fan’s new arm for a newborn’s, when in fact it was a weapon of mass destruction.
[Moreover, are those the arms of a human?]
Gasping, Zhuo Fan withdrew the Qilin leg back to being his arm and nodded pleasingly.
Transformation was a secret art of changing shape. That meant turning his left arm into The Earth Dragon Claw, of a sacred beast taking human form .
While Tangible Projection meant transformation of returning to its original form.
His Qilin arm looked like an arm and was tough beyond imagination, but only through this Tangible Projection of turning the Qilin arm back to the Qilin leg, could he unleash the Sky-piercing Qilin power.
Yet this wasn’t all the Qilin leg could do, limited as it was by his low cultivation. Had he put too much power into the blow, he’d be going down with it.
But even when limited, for the whole of Tianyu, it was more than enough.
With the Earth Dragon Claw on his left and the Qilin arm on his right, no enemy could contest him in Tianyu.
Zhuo Fan grinned, awfully full of himself.
Now that he took notice of the others, their minds had taken a vacation it seemed, betrayed by their dumb looks. While the four demons were shaking like leaves.
With a demonic smile, Zhuo Fan swished his right hand, “You four said to keep ’em coming right? Want another one?”
“No no no, Steward Zhuo, you’re too awesome! We don’t dare to play in front of you. How about you use the Blood Infant to punish us. That punch of yours will splatter us! You wouldn’t want the Luo clan’s last five years of investment to be for nothing, would you?” The four demons’ heads were pounding and snot was coming out of their noses.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Ha-ha-ha, you four just keep begging for mercy. Fine, I’ll let it slide just this once, but you better get this straight. If I find you slacking on the job again, there won’t be a next time. I’ll flatten your heads on the spot! “
“Steward Zhuo, worry not, it won’t happen again… ” The four demons shook their heads and vowed.
Only then did Zhuo Fan nodded and looked in the distance, “Good. It’s time we go to the Imperial capital and regroup with the others.”
“Yes!”
Everyone cupped their hands as they accepted the order. Even the playful and sly demons turned respectful on the spot…

chapters.title: Chapter 352, Imperial Capital Ceremony
chapters.content:
Chapter 352, Imperial Capital Ceremony
Imperial capital, the Imperial Palace’s gates.
There were 360 copper inlays in the nine heavy three meter tall gates. Set in the shape of Macrocosmic Orbit Array, it was an everlasting symbol of peace and imperial power.
Guards strapped in golden armor stood before each grand gate with grace and dignity, releasing a heavy pressure on anyone who came close.
Even fresh cultivators could feel the presence of a thousand of these Profound Heaven experts. The Imperial family’s power had always been the strongest in Tianyu.
A crowd had gathered outside these gates since the crack of dawn, now in awe of such a display of power.
How long had it been since the imperial family had held a ceremony? No one knew since this was their first. On such occasions, delegates were to come from every clan in Tianyu, from the biggest houses to the smallest.
The last time such a gathering took place was centuries ago when everyone banded together and repelled invaders from their border.
It was quite plain to see how much weight the imperial family had attributed to the bestowal of the 8th noble house title. The Luo clan, a mere third rate clan, was now going to be wallowing in honor.
They had simply won the Esoteric Debate, but was it that great an achievement to have the whole of Tianyu take part in its award ceremony?
Some small clans, waiting in the biting cold outside the gates, begged to differ. [Why don’t we get that kind of treatment?]
The many clans gathered before the Imperial Palace’s gates were feeding the rumor mill as they discussed.
Some were envious and some were in awe, but what predominated everyone was reverence.
It had never happened before and the difficulty could be imagined. A third rate clan was, in their time, entering the rank of houses and even receiving the imperial family’s approval.
Since a third rate clan could be so hardworking, the other lowly clans had no reason to stagnate and contend with the status quo…
“Y-young master, wait…”
Among the tight crowd, a proud and dashing youth, wearing a scholar’s hat, kept on walking even as the apprentice scholar behind him yelled.
He only stopped when he reached the front of the throng of people. His eyes shining like stars, looking all around him, “I’m finally out.”
“Y-young master, we have to go back or I’ll be punished!” The child squeezed in front as well, her cute and squishy face made him so adorable.
The young master only smiled, “I’ve been stuck home for ages. Now that I’m out, time to have some fun. Why the hell would I go back now? This is the Imperial Palace’s 8th house award ceremony, the event of the millennium. The last time this happened was at the empire’s founding.
“I want to see with my own eyes what makes this 8th house so great, so powerful to make imp-, ugh, His Majesty break the thousand year long convention.”
Looking about, assured that no one noticed his slip of the tongue, the youth stuck out his tongue and smiled.
The child was even more distraught, “Y-young master, you’ve had your fun for four hours already. It’s time we head back, or with your temper we won’t get away with a simple punishment if anything happens.”
“Stop yapping!”
The young master bopped the child on the head, annoyed, “You dare talk to me this way? When I get back, it’s the cane for you!”
“Then why did you bring me with you? To punish me? If anything happens to you, my life’s on the line!”
“You…”
The young master glared, angry. Was he that weak to not survive one hit in front of so many people?
Seeing how he wanted to slip away all the time, he was just like a human trafficker. Was he that useless?
“His Highness, the Crown Prince, has arrived!”
With a sharp cry, a refined sedan chair entered everyone’s eyes. Once it stopped, an elegant and dignified youth wearing a golden robe with four dragon claws on it stepped out.
The purple golden guards rushed forward to steer clear the clans, forming a three meter wide path. The Crown Prince walked in front towards the Imperial Palace’s gates.
“Damn, its eldest brother. Don’t let him find us!”
The young master lowered his head and pulled the child into the crowd. The child could only follow.
The Crown Prince suddenly stopped, then bowed to his surroundings in apology, “Before the seven houses arrive, we are unable to open the gates. I am dreadfully sorry to have everyone wait out here in the biting winds and piercing cold. Please accept my sincere apology.”
The Crown Prince gave a half bow.
The crowd was frantic in returning the bow.
Their hearts went to him. He was such a proud and wise figure. He was sure to go places.
“Ha-ha-ha, eldest bro is making nice again. Did you earn some sympathy points?”
Some rather sharp and venomous words resounded. The people whipped their heads to see who dared be so crass towards Tianyu’s Crown Prince.
What they saw was a glum youth bearing a striking resemblance to the Crown Prince. He wore the same dragon clawed robe, just that he only had three.
The people realized he was Crown Prince Yuwen Bo’s brother, second prince Yuwen Yong.
Crown Prince eyed him coming over with a trace of anger, “Second brother, what are you suggesting? Every clan in Tianyu has gathered at our great imperial capital at the invitation of the imperial family. Shouldn’t I, the Crown Prince, show these people gathered here in the biting winds and piercing cold some care?”
“Humph, a mere act! You think they’re worth inviting? That was the imperial decree. They had to come.” Yuwen Yong sent a mocking glance to the ants, “Eldest brother, how can an irresolute man and sympathizer like you be the next leader of this nation? “
“Second brother, by treating Tianyu’s people like this, how are you going to rule with justice, how are you going to earn their respect? This is why the imperial father didn’t make you Crown Prince!” The Crown Prince glared.
Yuwen Yong’s eyes were spitting fire at this point, his face barely stopping itself from exploding, “Yuwen Bo, don’t patronize me! Based on wisdom and approaches, I’m no different from you! Isn’t it all because you came into this world a year before me that you’ve earned such a glorious title? Isn’t it because you are firstborn? Other than that, I am just as capable as you are to be Crown Prince!”
The Crown Prince stammered, but sighed in the end, “Second brother, so this is what’s been bothering you. This is why you’ve always looked at me with hostility since we were young. But what would you have me do? This is the work of providence. I cannot change the world. If I could, I would’ve long since given my brother this Crown Prince title!”
“Humph, sophistry! Who doesn’t want to be emperor? Even that Regent Estate has been stirring for centuries, yet you, pansy, wish to give it up?”
Yuwen Yong snarled, “But I don’t need you to hand it over. I’ll take what’s mine for myself!”
The Crown Prince looked long at him and sighed, feeling vexed.
Then, a very familiar voice came.
With it, the people began to feel the earth throbbing. A mountain of a man, panting and sweating, was rumbling over with a thundering gait. He was sweating buckets, but was mighty happy, “Elder brother, second brother, it’s been ages since we last saw each other. I missed you so much!”
He was the one, the only, Tianyu’s third prince, Yuwen Cong. He was a rarity in this world of cultivation filled with trained, fit bodies, one of the very few fatties!
The young master hiding in the crowd and the child held their heads, “Sigh, third brother, can’t you sweat that fat off a little? Every time you come out, you scare everyone. I don’t even want to be seen around you!”
Yuwen Yong glanced at the tub of lard with loathing, “God dammit, hasn’t this pig left the imperial capital yet? What’s he doing back here?”
“Ha-ha-ha, he must’ve finished his mission and the imperial father had him return. With the 8th noble house award ceremony of great importance, it’s imperative for the third younger brother to be present as well. “
The Crown Prince came out with open arms and a smile, “Ha-ha-ha, third brother, welcome back!”
“Eldest brother!”
With a cry of joy, Yuwen Cong jumped into the Crown Prince’s arms.
And landed with a bang.
At the same time, a snapping sound marked the wincing of the Crown Prince as the pavement beneath him cracked all over.
“Your Highness, Crown Prince!”
Crown Prince’s guards rushed over, seeing him hugging the hulking slab of meat.
“I’m… fine!”
Shaking his head, the Crown Prince put on a reassuring smile, “I-I’m a 9th layer Bone Tempering Stage cultivator after all, but… even I can’t hug my younger brother…”
Crash!
With another sound, Crown Prince’s face paled and he looked at his third brother with glistening eyes, “Old third, did you get heavier?”
“Uh, just a bit. Last month I weighed 375 kg, but this week I’m 400. It must be all that traveling getting to me that I gained so little!”
Everyone’s face twitched. [The third prince sure is an oddball. Where can you find so much fat in the world?]
“Oh, right, eldest brother, are you ok?” Yuwen Cong asked, seeing his brother’s sweaty face.
With a pained smile, Crown Prince begged, “Third brother, could you get down first? My waist is killing me…”
The crowd blanked out for a whole two seconds…

chapters.title: Chapter 353, Vie For Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 353, Vie For Power
“Ha-ha-ha, my dear third, they say Huangpu Qingtian is a monster, but I think you’re the biggest monster among them all! I’ve seen you be constantly on the move these few years so how come you’ve gained more weight instead?”
Yuwen Yong looked at the two brothers get out of the hug and mocked the one with the creaking waist, “What about you Crown Prince? Always posing around has finally taken its toll!”
The Crown Prince grew angry but sighed in the end, emphasizing that the younger brother didn’t understand his pain. Yuwen Cong glared, “Second brother, I know you don’t like me, but leave the eldest brother out of it.”
“Save it. I don’t like you because I find that blob of yours an eyesore! Moreover… humph, it’s absolutely revolting!” Yuwen Yong’s eyes glinted with bloodthirst.
Crown Prince and Yuwen Cong wanted to respond, but sighed instead.
The young master hiding in the crowd flushed, wanting to go out there and give him an earful, “Second brother is too much. Eldest brother is always modest and thinks about the good of the people. Yet my second brother is always complaining. I need to go out there and give him a piece of my mind.”
“Young… master, stop causing trouble! If anyone finds out you’ve sneaked out, I’ll take the fall as well.” The child pulled him.
Just then, a cry came from the crowd, “Look, Hell Valley has arrived!”
Everyone turned around to see a group of men in gray robes with You Wanshan in the lead.
He was flanked by his elders and a striking young man with stern eyes. He was Hell Valley’s brightest mind, You Guiqi’s last disciple, You Ming.
Behind them were four strong elders that struck fear in the hearts of others with a mere glance.
A single thought from them could annihilate them all.
These were Hell Valley’s four Venerables. There used to be a fifth, but that one fell in the battle of Windgaze City.
This made You Wanshan’s hatred for Zhuo Fan reach bone deep. He had not only killed so many elders but even murdered one of their Venerables.
The only reason they weren’t marching on Windgaze City to kill the Luo clan was because they knew it would be foolhardy. Who the hell cared about some imperial family’s restrictions?
As weak as they were, they could only endure.
“Valley Lord You, long time no see. Please forgive me for not welcoming you here in person!” The Crown Prince cupped his hands.
You Wanshan returned the greeting with a smile, “Your Highness is too kind!”
“Valley Lord You, how have you been the last three days?” Second prince Yuwen Yong walked over with his head held high.
Crown Prince’s eyebrows twitched and You Wanshan frowned as he gave a mirthless laughter, “Ha-ha-ha, thank you second prince for your concern. I have been well.”
“Oh, it’s almost time for the gates to open. I am going in first to prepare.” Afraid of saying more than necessary, You Wanshan came up with an excuse to extricate himself and made his way to the gates.
The nine gates had a particular importance, the Nine Dragon Guard.
In every major event, Tianyu’s clans gathered in front of these gates and the nine gates opened at the same time. The emperor walked through the middle one, while the others were reserved for the houses and princes.
It displayed to the public that the seven houses and the imperial family were equals, with the rest of the clans following behind.
This time the emperor was about to appoint the 8th house so of course the sealed final gate was now reserved for the Luo clan.
At the time of opening, the clans making their choice of which house to follow would stand before their respective gates.
But since most of the eight houses were running late, You Wanshan saying that he was going to get ready to enter was an obvious excuse that he was avoiding them.
When they arrived before a gate, You Wanshan looked back at the second prince in anger, “That rotten bastard. Has he lost it to be so impulsive? Wasn’t he clearly pointing out to everyone that there’s something going on between him and us?”
“Ha-ha-ha, Valley Lord, relax. If he were shrewd, our partnership would’ve been in danger. It’s his rash attitude that makes him an excellent pawn.”
With a twisted smile, You Ming said, “He just wanted to show off his power before the Crown Prince. Let him be.”
“But what about our secret plans? Won’t they get exposed?” You Wanshan snorted.
You Ming shook his head, “Valley Lord, no need to be angry since it will all be revealed anyway. And in the current situation, the rest of the clans will take the same path as us. Once the Luo clan becomes the 8th house, they will turn into the last power and will turn the empire into a tripartite nation. At that time everyone will be tied down. To break the stalemate, vying for the throne will be the only option left. The side that controls the future emperor will be the one to use the imperial family to destroy the other houses. The last step will be removing the puppet emperor and taking hold of the world.”
“Is this… what you mean by playing for the future?” You Wanshan squinted.
You Ming nodded, “Correct.”
You Wanshan gasped and nodded.
So even with the second prince being impulsive, it was this impulsive nature of his that made him grade A pawn material. As for the Crown Prince, no one could gauge him…
You Wanshan was finding You Ming more trustworthy now.
In another location, Crown Prince frowned at Yuwen Yong, “Second brother, imperial father has warned us not to get too close with the houses. You…”
“Crown Prince, you are the rightful emperor, so of course you’d listen. You only need to wait for the throne to fall in your lap. But without any power behind me, how can I fight for it? I told you, I’ll take everything from you, ha-ha-ha… “
Yuwen Yong cackled.
Crown Prince’s eyes flashed with bloodthirst, though hidden deep behind his facade.
Yuwen Cong came beside the Crown Prince and grumbled, “Second brother, how can you say that? Openly going against the imperial father’s decree? I’m going to tell on you…”
But the sight of a certain mesmerizing beauty left him speechless. He forgot all about his brothers and ran towards her laughing, “Sister Kui, you’re here! It’s been so long, did you miss me?
The two brothers were dumbstruck and sighed.
[Our third brother truly is a rare fatty, a rare starry-eyed one. The girl has shot him down 108 times yet he still can’t face the music.]
Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s detail approached.
Pavilion Lord was in front, flanked by his elders, five venerables following them, and lastly, the younger generation.
One of them, of course, was the target of young tubby Yuwen Cong’s fantasies, Long Kui.
Yuwen Cong was hammering the earth with each step, barreling onward like an out-of-control mountain. After a quick hi to Long Yifey and the rest, he went to Long Kui’s side, making her sick, “This guy got even fatter. He’s inhuman!”
“Ha-ha-ha, sister Kui, have you been well?” Yuwen Cong fumbled his thick fingers, looking bashfully at her.
Long Kui glared at him, “I thought I told you last time that I like someone else. What are you sticking around me for?”
“Uh, you mean brother Zhuo Fan? Ha-ha-ha, we talked it out. You were only using him as an excuse. We even became sworn brothers afterward. And brothers don’t go after another’s wife.”
Yuwen Cong licked his lips and giggled.
Long Kui mocked, “And what if what I said was all true?”
Yuwen Cong froze and stared her in the eyes, but couldn’t find a single lie.
Ignoring him, Long Kui left him there and returned to her house. After exchanging greetings with the other two princes, they walked towards a gate.
Only Yuwen Cong was left there lonely and lost. Then his brows furrowed…
The rest of the houses arrived one by one with their elders, venerables and extras.
The only difference was that the three houses had four venerables, while Drifting Flowers Edifices only had three, making them the weakest.
And for some reason, Edifice Lord Chu was nowhere to be seen, with Iris Overseer and Grandmother leading their house.
The people had no time for assumptions as the guest of honor showed up.
