They instantly drew all eyes.
Even with plenty of clans seeing the Luo clan’s performance in the Esoteric Debate, the great majority hadn’t. They all wished now to catch a glimpse of the Luo clan’s might and what made it the 8th house.
Especially that youth hiding in the crowd. He watched excitedly, “They say the Luo clan’s steward is a hunk. Which one is he though…”

chapters.title: Chapter 354, On the Brink
chapters.content:
Chapter 354, On the Brink
Translator: StarReader
Tap~
With a steady gait, the Luo clan walked forward.
The first were Luo Yunchang and Luo Yunhai, the leaders of the Luo clan. Right behind them were Captain Pang, Lei Yuting and other important people. And finally Li Jingtian and Lei Yuntian, the elders.
It was clear as day that the Luo clan hardly had any elders, merely two, and their strength was far weaker. Only Li Jingtian’s power stirred the hearts of men.
Yet the way Lei Yuntian, a Profound Heaven expert in the 5th layer stood next to Li Jingtian, it was like an ant marching side by side with an elephant.
Yuwen Yong only had disdain for them, “Humph, weak. Does that look like an 8th house to you? Don’t they barely qualify with just one peak Radiant Stage expert? “
“Second brother, don’t say that. The Luo clan had been a third rate clan recently. But in the last ten years they have grown so much to reach here. What do you say to that?”
Yuwen Cong returned to his brothers, and although downcast, he admired the Luo clan.
Crown Prince frowned a bit, “Third brother, I must say, this is some very rare and hard oddity to come by. But the way they’ve developed seems skewed.”
“Do you guys think the Luo clan only has one Radiant Stage expert? When the day comes that they have to fight other houses and their only defense would go into battle, wouldn’t they be left wide open for attack? Compared to other houses, the Luo clan will be the quickest to fall. This clan truly is a marvel, but far too soon to be called a house.”
Yuwen Yong watched the approaching group and sighed, “This is not our concern but for that kid Zhuo Fan to think about.”
“Zhuo Fan?”
The Crown Prince and the second prince raised an eyebrow. The former was quite excited, “I’ve heard about him. Luo clan has managed to see today all because of him. He is a genius not unlike Zhuge Changfeng and Leng Wuchang!”
Staring at the Luo clan, Yuwen Yong spat, “I’ve heard of him too. Ever since he showed up, he has turned Tianyu upside down and even fought against the seven houses. In the Esoteric Debate, he alone fought against Huangpu Qingtian’s team of four, making a name for himself. The Luo clan can now stand abreast the seven houses all because of its two pillars. The sharp Steward Zhuo and the mighty Li Jingtian!”
“Who is Zhuo Fan anyway?” Yuwen Yong scrutinized the Luo clan in search of his query.
The Crown Prince was also on the lookout.
Only Yuwen Cong who had become a sworn brother with the man said after a glance, “He’s not here.”
“What, on the eve of their award ceremony, their steward still won’t show?” The two cried.
Shrugging, Yuwen Cong said, “That’s just how he is.”
With that last word, he went to Luo Yunchang and cupped his hands.
The two were puzzled and even more curious about Zhuo Fan. But the Crown Prince still went to greet the Luo clan.
Only Yuwen Yong disdained them from afar.
He did not care one bit if the Luo clan was becoming the 8th house. He just knew one fact. Their odd discrepancy in ranks assured that it was only a matter of time before they crumbled.
And he had no intention of making nice with a soon-to-be-dead clan.
The young master in the crowd stuck his head out and scanned the Luo clan’s detail, “Who’s Zhuo Fan? Why does none of them look anything like the rumor? Is he perhaps that guy?”
The youth pointed at Yan Fu.
The child next to him looked in disdain, “Young… master, that guy sure looks fair but nothing alike.”
“How come?
“This… uh, I overheard my clansmen say that Luo clan’s steward is vicious and fiendish, not like that pretty boy. Not to mention that he is the highest person in the Luo clan that even that Radiant Stage expert listens to. While that kid only knows how to bob his head, not speaking a word to the two elders. How is that fiendish? If he were indeed the rumored monster, the Crown Prince wouldn’t dare neglect him.”
The young master was stunned, then nodded, “Y-you’re quite good at deductions. Who knew you had a good head on your shoulders?”
“He-he-he, young master exaggerates.” The child giggled, her cheeks rosy.
“But if he isn’t Zhuo Fan, then who is it? The others don’t look the part either.”
Seeing her young master so focused, the child shrugged, unsure as well…
“Look, Regent Estate is here!”
A shout caught everyone’s attention. Even Crown Prince’s attention, who was chatting with the Luo clan.
That one look left everyone gasping and drove fear into their feeble legs.
A group in golden garb strutted with Huangpu Tianyuan in the lead.
Next to him was their steward, Tianyu’s second greatest mind, Unwonted Contriver Leng Wuchang!
Following were the Profound Heaven elders, fifty in number, releasing their mighty auras.
Yet that was hardly impressive.
What got everyone so shocked was the Venerable contingency. A total of thirty people radiating incredible power.
Any one of their gazes was enough to raze everything to the ground.
Crown Prince gulped at the ostentatious display. He never imagined the Regent Estate’s power would reach such a height, almost catching up to the imperial family.
Second prince was dumbstruck. His jaw hanging, eyes popping, forgetting himself as he spoke, “Dang, now that’s what you call a thousand year old legacy. How can that upstart Luo clan compare?”
Li Jingtian watched them with a cold gaze.
He was very clear on the Regent Estate’s power. 15 of the Venerables were below the 3rd layer of Radiant Stage, ten of them between 3rd and 6th, and five above.
In this aspect the Luo clan wasn’t falling short.
The Luo siblings glanced over and nodded.
It all came down to Steward Zhuo and the rest if they reached in time…
The Crown Prince excused himself from the Luo clan and greeted the Regent Estate, “Estate Lord Huangpu, I trust you have been well!”
“It’s only thanks to your blessing, Crown Prince, that I am well.” Huangpu Tianyuan smiled.
Just then, the second prince skipped the Luo clan and rushed over to Regent Estate with a smile, “Royal uncle, it’s been a while.”
Hiding the disdain, Huangpu Tianyuan put on a smile, “Thank you, second prince, for your concern.”
The Regent Estate and the imperial family were distant relatives at first, but the imperial family had its dignity. That wouldn’t change even among relatives. If anybody wished to get close and use such a way of addressing, it had to be peers.
Just like how the emperor called him cousin while never lowering himself.
Yet this second prince had walked up and called him royal uncle, his tone thick with flattery. Anyone with an ear could tell he wanted Regent Estate on his side.
Not to mention the guy had made a beeline for the Regent Estate, slighting the Luo clan and earning their malcontent. The prime example of the worst ruler.
The Crown Prince glared at his brother, then sighed.
Huangpu Tianyuan’s group only had contempt for the second prince. Narrow minded, brash, blind ambition, all talk, and unable to accomplish a single thing in his life.
Glancing at Leng Wuchang, the two’s minds connected and they smiled.
“High Venerable, your old friend is here. Why don’t you go greet him?” Leng Wuchang pointed at the Luo clan with a smile.
Huangpu Fenglei nodded and grinned, making his way to the Luo clan.
The Regent Estate’s top expert drew gazes as he walked. Li Jingtian knew his purpose and stepped out as well.
Everyone knew the strongest of two clans were now facing off. With Li Jingtian turning his back on the Regent Estate, the latter had to settle this disgrace or it would become a stain on their name.
People watched with rapt attention as the two got closer. How were they going to settle this?
Even the other houses watched.
It seemed like a problem between two men who represented a conflict between two clans. Any side’s loss meant shame for their clan.
Regent Estate couldn’t afford to lose.
Regent Estate had lost the Esoteric Debate, but that was pertaining to the younger generation. While losing here meant their thousand year long legacy would crumble, as would they.
Yet the Regent Estate was still willing to do this confrontation, confident of their success.
Eying Li Jingtian, Huangpu Fenglei snickered, “Mad Dipper Li Jingtian, you had lost to me once. How about showing me your progress from these past years, ha-ha-ha…”

chapters.title: Chapter 355, Princess Yongning
chapters.content:
Chapter 355, Princess Yongning
Translator: StarReader
The two stopped twenty meters from each other. Huangpu Fenglei started off with mockery, “Ha-ha-ha, Li Jingtian, when you first came to Regent Estate, it was for the Imperial Tyrant Body Art. For you to betray us in favor of the Luo clan, it must’ve been over something similar, right?”
“Quite!”
Li Jingtian was blunt, “My entire life, I’ve always been obsessed with martial arts, all in pursuit of power. But you guys are too selfish, not willing to impart me the complete Imperial Tyrant Body Art. So why would I ever give my all to you?
“Humph, our Imperial Tyrant Body Art is a second to none profound ranked cultivation method in Tianyu. Training even a fraction of it would’ve benefited you for life! But, fortunately, I was right to judge you untrustworthy and refused to give it to you. Or today would’ve been another story entirely.”
Huangpu Fenglei snickered, “Not to mention that I heard you joined the Luo clan for the same thing we didn’t give you, a cultivation method, right?”
Li Jingtian admitted, “Among other things.”
“Humph, absurd! In the whole of Tianyu, the quality of our cultivation method is second only to imperial family’s. Can a third rate clan give you something like that?”
“Ha-ha-ha, only a fool would believe that. Haven’t you heard? Luo clan has a miraculous steward. He gave me something you can’t even dream of!” Li Jingtian talked back.
Huangpu Fenglei’s voice dropped, “Zhuo Fan? Humph, what can a glib punk ever achieve? He is only a king among scamps. And since you hold him in such high regard, you’ve made me curious to watch him myself. But first, let’s see what you’ve received from the Luo clan.”
Huangpu Fenglei’s power surged and nine golden dragons roared as they twisted around him. He was glowing with might and devastating power, the Imperial Tyrant Body Art of the Regent Estate was revealed in all its glory and trained to the max.
“Ha-ha-ha, perfect timing. It’s time I pay back for the resentment from all those years.”
Laughing, Li Jingtian became enveloped in dark energy, swallowed in the belly of a huge dragon with red eyes thirsting for battle.
The two were moments away from a death match.
The Crown Prince was shocked and rushed forward to stop it. But a man in golden robes stopped him before he got the chance.
Huangpu Tianyuan smiled, “Crown Prince, they are peak Radiant Stage experts. For your safety, please stay away from our Venerable.”
Crown Prince shuddered and noticed his brothers were also behind some Venerable from the Regent Estate. All he could do was sigh.
It was obvious that the Regent Estate wanted no interference. Before the award ceremony even began, he wanted to show the Luo clan the might of the head of the houses.
But with a full blown battle raging over here, what about the imperial family’s reputation?
At this critical and dire moment, a Divine Dragon would usually interfere… no?
The Crown Prince shuddered all of a sudden. How come there were no Divine Dragons around? [It goes on to show that they’ve planned for this all along.]
[Is the imperial father behind this?]
Crown Prince’s worry eased as he looked at the two fighters, puzzled.
The emperor was clearly intent on praising the Luo clan for their exemplary conduct. But letting Luo clan and Regent Estate fight at the gates, he was unclear if it was directed at humiliating the new house or stomping Regent Estate’s cocky attitude.
Even so, attacking the Regent Estate was impossible at this point. Which meant…
The Crown Prince was even more puzzled. [Just what are you up to, imperial father?]
Only Leng Wuchang was calmly tending to his beard. He had easily surmised that the emperor’s stance with the Luo clan changed from the moment Zhuo Fan got the Dragon Vein Soul.
Hence this award ceremony was the perfect time to test the Luo clan’s waters. With how Zhuo Fan’s actions in the past years were shrouded in mystery so that not even the emperor knew, he was feeling a little more than mere unease.
Case in point, only god knew when Li Jingtian had switched sides yet only now did he show his face.
And the emperor wasn’t about to let a viable threat fester.
Thus today’s show was all set up courtesy of His Majesty, with Regent Estate as the main actor. Since the two’s interests aligned, to fish out the Luo clan’s dirty little secrets…
In the heart of the imperial capital, on the top story of the tallest restaurant, Fang Qiubai and Sima Hui sat.
Their eyes never left the nine gates and the waves of power coming from there.
“Old Fang, the two are as strong as us. Leaving them to fight will spin this out of control.” Sima Hui frowned, fiddling with a chess piece.
Fang Qiubai held a brand new flute as he shook his head, smiling, “It’s His Majesty’s order. Let them fight. And even if it blows things out of proportion, we have young Sanzi to deal with them, ha-ha-ha…”
“True, in the end it all depends on the little monster.”
Shaking his head, Sima Hui sighed, “But won’t that make us utterly useless? Look at us, the invincible Divine Dragons, Jade Flute Divine Sword and Monochrome Chess Sage, now reduced to mere relics of the past, obsolete! Huangpu Fenglei aside, for even a third rate clan’s Venerable to outclass us, we won’t be having such an easy time going wherever we want in Tianyu now.”
Sima Hui’s mood sank and Fang Qiubai shook his head, “You’re right, but even so, be it Huangpu Fenglei or Li Jingtian, they were both powerful men of ambition back in the day. Getting caught up is normal. But if a new and upcoming expert suddenly reached our level, I’d smash my head and die!”
Sima Hui found wisdom in his words. They no longer chose to dwell on it and resumed to watch the act unfold.
The clans in the audience were thrilled at the prospect of a good show, but now they were downright terrified, scurrying to and fro for cover.
Of note were those particular clans present at the Esoteric Debate, who were positively dreading the aftermath.
They knew better than ever what a clash between colossi entailed. Getting near was suicidal and getting a stray hit would bury you! If they didn’t flee now, they would never get the chance.
That said, while the two were measuring their auras and powering up, the crowd went wild in hightailing it out of there.
The young master in the crowd stumbled in the confusion but stayed put. The ignorance in him had no clue what was coming.
Then his robe was yanked by the rushing crowd, revealing a fair hand and a dazzling jade bracelet.
The young master cried, trying to cover it, but it was perhaps a bit hard with the frantic mob running around.
Pa!
The bracelet fell and started rolling on the ground.
The young master panicked and chased after it, “Imperial mother’s bracelet!”
“Young… master! Don’t, it’s too dangerous!” The child saw him rush after the rolling bracelet, towards the two experts’ battle.
It was impossible to reach him in time as the mob dragged him further away.
Finally, the young master squeezed out between the last people and finally picked up some speed, catching the bracelet with a smile.
But just then, the two experts moved. With a boom, they charged at one another. While the youth stood there frozen, in the middle.
“Imperial Tyrant Body Art!”
“Soaring Demonic Dragon!”
As they roared, their power reached the masses before they even clashed. The youth had no time to dodge, feeling the godly pressure bearing down on him and coughed blood.
Sharp winds slashed at him, ripping his robe and revealing a lavish garment. The scholar hat fell, draping long flowing black hair.
He was a she!
“Yongning!”
The three princes cried, “Stop!”
Not that it did much good. The two only heard their own roars. When an expert attacked, he had no reason to stop.
Fang Qiubai and Sima Hui jumped to their feet, “Princess!”
They rushed to the rescue.
Even though they knew the futility of it. Not even them could save her, trapped in the maelstrom of power born of two clashing peak Radiant Stage experts.
Li Jingtian and Huangpu Fenglei never even registered the girl there. To them, she was as important as an ant. All they saw was their enemy!
Roar! Roar!
With two dragon roars, the two sped up. The princes and the two Divine Dragons, watched on with bloodshot eyes.
They couldn’t understand how His Majesty’s beloved daughter had ended up here.
The danger of the situation finally dawned on Yongning as blood trickled from her mouth. She was akin to a dinghy in the middle of a storm, with the two waves coming down on her any minute to render her void. Fear gripped her heart as she shook like a leaf.
“Mother…”
Hugging the bracelet, Yongning cried and cried, her lips trembling as she pleaded, “Someone s-save me…”
But who could save her from the jaws of death brought on by the might of two clashing peak Radiant Stage experts?
The princes were beside themselves in fear, the two Divine Dragons knew it was hopeless but still tried to reach her, and the child in the crowd was wailing, “Princess…”
Yet none of those acts was of any help.
The two experts finally reached her with bloodthirsty eyes. Their gaze pierced her heart as their punches drew closer.
A fierce wind snapped at her face. She knew her end was nigh, at their hands. Her heart was in deep regret, for slipping out of the Imperial Palace and ending up here.
But in her final moment, all she could think of was her mother watching her from above as she raised the bracelet and prayed, “Mother, you said there’s someone who will protect me. Please, come save me…”
Whoosh!
Then the gale and pressure vanished, to make way for the cold voice drifting in her ears, “Lass, a rabbit has no place wandering where savage beasts are on the prowl…”

chapters.title: Chapter 356, The Might of Luo Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 356, The Might of Luo Clan
Translator: StarReader
Shivering, Yongning realized that she wasn’t torn apart by the two mighty powers and was in fact caressed by a breeze. She cracked her eyes open just a hint.
But what she saw made her cry out and fall down in fright.
Before her was a man in every sense of the word. With broad shoulders, white hair floating in the wind and a deep gaze looking down on all creation.
But the greatest shock was how this man actually put a stop to the raging tempest the two peak Radiant Stage experts unleashed.
His left hand was twisted into a savage dragon claw, holding Li Jingtian’s wrist unscathed by Li Jingtian’s black energy trying to eat it. While his right arm made a simple block with his palm. Yet this plain act seemed to contain endless power as Huangpu Fenglei’s nine golden dragons couldn’t budge an inch.
The people cried out in shock, seeing the situation take an impossible turn. Two peak Radiant experts were handled like a bunch of chickens!
Huangpu Fenglei and Li Jingtian were overwhelmed watching the man. Then the once lost feeling of fear slowly crept into their soul.
They were peak Radiant Stage experts, fearless against any adversary in Tianyu. But now they were reacquainted with this feeling of dread a century later by this man in front of them.
The fact that these two peak experts couldn’t match their enemy brought a deep sense of loss to them.
They had roamed Tianyu all their lives and reached the peak of power, so where did this guy come from that could trump them?
Not to mention he was young…
“Who… are you?”
Watching the youth sent from the heavens holding the evil dragon claws at bay, Yongning’s cheeks flushed. A single question plagued her mind, “Did the imperial mother send you to protect me?”
Ignoring the shell shocked princess, the youth’s right hand moved and Huangpu Fenglei was forced back with a groan.
Rumbling!
The pavement crumbled, as Huangpu Fenglei skidded back, leaving deep scars. He only stopped when he was in his original spot, ten meters away.
Raising his head, his face was pale.
He had just used Imperial Tyrant Body Art, a profound ranked martial art to attack, yet the opponent easily took it and even pushed him back. Just what power did this man have?
[Who the hell is this guy?]
Not sparing him another moment, he looked at Li Jingtian and pushed back the black dragon claw of his, “Elder Li, you’re still not backing down?”
That woke Li Jingtian right up. What had happened was too shocking and he withdrew his attack only now. Then he showed his respect, “Steward Zhuo!”
“What, Zhuo Fan?!”
As if rehearsed, the Crown Prince, second prince and Huangpu Fenglei cried out.
They looked at him like a zoo animal. They had all heard of Zhuo Fan’s glorious name, but never thought he’d be so much of a freak in person. Was there anyone in the world who could take on two peak Radiant Stage expert’s attacks?
Leng Wuchang and Huangpu Tianyuan were dumbfounded. How could that monster grow so much in little under half a year? He was a completely different being from the one they saw in the Esoteric Debate!
Then their faces turned heavy.
With how true power could topple anything and the more Zhuo Fan grew stronger, the more futile Leng Wuchang’s attempts were to deal with him. To say nothing of what a treacherous knave Zhuo Fan was to begin with. Add to that his power and they felt as powerless as when facing Gu Santong.
Fang Qiubai and Sima Hui stopped dead in their tracks, watching dumbstruck for two seconds before their faces sank.
“Old Fang, should we bust our heads and keel over? The youth of today seem to have overtaken us. Hard days await us…” Sima Hui sighed.
Fang Qiubai’s face twitched.
One thing had to be said though. Following Zhuo Fan’s explosion of power, the emperor would have to change his plans for the Luo clan. The two of them were sure they’d be seeing Zhuo Fan far more often in the future.
For the imperial family, they were ready to face any danger, endure any psychological torture this youth stronger then them might subject them to.
And since the inception of the great Divine Dragons, this would probably be the hardest thing yet…
“Zhuo Fan, you came!”
Luo Yunchang moved with the Luo clan to his side. Watching him come down like a god filled her with joy, then she glanced at the dumbstruck Yongning and asked, “Miss, are you alright?”
Yongning blinked for a long time at Zhuo Fan before she could find her words, “Are you that… Zhuo Fan? You’re ten times more handsome than the rumor goes!”
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched, but Luo Yunchang got ahead of him as she said coldly, “Miss, please mind yourself. Steward Zhuo isn’t someone you can casually address.”
“But the way he casually dropped was unlike any human, ha-ha-ha…”
A laughter came followed by a mountain of flesh running over in excitement, “Brother, I missed you so much!”
With one last step, he jumped on Zhuo Fan.
Glancing over, Zhuo Fan only kicked the meatball two meters away as it landed with a boom.
Face covered in dust, Yuwen Cong put on the look of a kicked puppy, “Brother, what did you do that for?”
“I’d rather not get crushed to death, thank you!” Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes.
“Humph, who are you trying to play here? You stopped two peak Radiant Stage experts but can’t take a bit of my extra weight?”
Zhuo Fan cocked his head and ignored him, which only worked to enrage him.
Yongning looked at them for a second before saying, “Third brother, you know him?”
[Third brother?!]
Everyone looked at her stunned. Luo Yunchang gasped, “Then you’re… the princess?”
“Yes.”
Yongning held her head high and revealed a proud face, but when she glanced at Zhuo Fan and found him not at all interested her mood sank.
“Yongning, how did you get out? What are you doing here? Do you realize how dangerous that was?” Yuwen Bo rushed over and chastised his sister, then bowed to Zhuo Fan, “Thank you young master Zhuo for your timely rescue. I am…”
Zhuo Fan had already left, leaving the Crown Prince in an awkward position.
He then noticed that Zhuo Fan was going in the Regent Estate’s direction.
[What is he going to do, fight?]
Everyone grew excited and nervous. What they saw when he stopped Li Jingtian and Huangpu Fenglei was positively incredible. How would the Regent Estate, the unrivaled head of the seven houses over the past millennium, cope?
The people were eagerly awaiting the good show.
This was unprecedented. Anyone messing with the houses got annihilated, but a few years ago, Zhuo Fan began chipping at the seven houses’ power.
Outside of the seven houses, Tianyu now had an eighth, Luo clan. And their steward, Soaring Demonic Dragon, was someone neither house wished to test, all while he was more than delighted to step on their toes.
What was more, the Luo clan was about to be officially acknowledged, setting up Luo clan’s roots for all eternity. After a long thousand years, the ranks of the houses would finally be redefined…
Whoosh!
Huangpu Fenglei flashed before Zhuo Fan with a grave face. His eyes staring down on him, “You’re Zhuo Fan? What are you trying to do?”
The rest of the Regent Estate was on high alert.
Zhuo Fan merely smiled, “Oh nothing. On this auspicious day, the Luo clan is receiving its title and I hoped everyone would keep to themselves, or a war might break out…”
“War? Humph, Luo clan only has Li Jingtian, what can you possibly do? An upstart clan like you with no legacy dares fight a house? To me, Luo clan has only two people. There is no war! What a joke, ha-ha-ha…” Huangpu Fenglei mocked.
The rest had to agree.
The Luo clan’s biggest problem was being shorthanded. Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian were great experts and strong to boot…
But take them out and the rest would be easy pickings. They weren’t even useful as cannon fodder.
Luo clan’s weakness was clear for anyone to see.
Second prince snickered. [Ever heard the saying, shorthanded? You two are great but the rest are junk. Once surrounded, the rest will fall like flies.]
Zhuo Fan mocked, “Dumb bigot, you think I don’t have a way to fight that legacy of yours?”
Zhuo Fan pointed at the sky, “Feast your eyes on the Luo clan’s power, a power to crush any house!”
Pa!
With a crisp sound, powerful surges came from the heavens above…

chapters.title: Chapter 357, Fiendish Elders
chapters.content:
Chapter 357, Fiendish Elders
Translator: StarReader
Whoosh~
Seven figures dropped down like meteors, spreading their savage energy around Zhuo Fan.
The overflowing power got even Regent Estate to shirk back. With a startle, they realized that all they could do was endure the pressure.
People went pale on the spot. Regent Estate had thirty Venerables so why couldn’t they even fight back when they had the numerical advantage?
However, upon closer look, they got the shock of their lives, with their hearts threatening to burst out of their chests.
Of the seven newcomers, only one was a peak Profound Heaven expert, who they didn’t recognize. But the other six had fiendish reputations. Even as rogue cultivators, no one dared to touch them.
“Raging Ancestor Qiu Yanhai, Ice Moon Witch Xue Qingjian, what are you two doing beside Luo clan?” Leng Wuchang’s eyes flashed with regret.
It was the Regent Estate who wanted them first and Leng Wuchang found their power impressive. An art to harmonize fire and water was rare. It would’ve been such a shame burying such an asset. He thought it was better to let them go and think of another way to have them join.
Since the two hardly posed a threat to the Regent Estate.
But who’d have thought they’d side with Zhuo Fan instead, becoming their bitter enemies. If he knew, he’d have culled them when he had the chance.
But who could have seen this one coming?
Not even he, Unwonted Contriver with his foolproof plans, had thought it possible that what Regent Estate couldn’t recruit, it would be done by others.
However, it was far too late for regret.
Xue Qingjian easily spotted his dilemma, “Sir Leng, are you regretting not killing us? Hi-hi-hi, a shame it’s all too late now. Steward Zhuo is far stronger in this regard. He truly was vile in his recruiting. I get the chills just thinking about it.”
Xue Qingjian played coy and put on a knowing look. This got on Leng Wuchang’s nerves, “A pair of masochists that don’t know how to accept a favor. I realize I’ve been too kind to you.”
“Yes, what you can’t obtain, you destroy. The more precious the item, the more this logic stands. Since there is a high chance it might come back to bite you, ha-ha-ha. Elder Xue is right. This is where you are beneath me!” Zhuo Fan cackled, “If one day you fall at my hand, you will experience complete failure. That is why as a fellow steward, I can lead the Luo clan to new heights, while you can only assist the Regent Estate, by cooking up some elaborate schemes.
“Humph, this is the difference between rulers and their ministers. And this is what you lack, bringing your downfall.”
Grinning, Zhuo Fan stared at Leng Wuchang and laughed.
Leng Wuchang was about to explode from anger, his eyes bloodshot. For the first time, someone had dared to taunt him. Not even Zhuge Changfeng dared talk to him like that.
Zhuo Fan though, jabbed at his wisdom in his mockery, yet the man couldn’t even retort.
Who was it that caught him off guard in the Esoteric Debate and killed everyone? Zhuo Fan said it was a draw at the time but it was plain as day that Leng Wuchang lost.
What could he possibly say to that?
Leng Wuchang’s anger grew and grew, gasping yet unable to speak.
Everyone looked at him stunned.
The second greatest mind in Tianyu, Leng Wuchang, was being pushed back in a verbal contest with Zhuo Fan.
Huangpu Fenglei’s face sank. And seeing the Luo clan’s forces, he trembled. But when he caught sight of the four pygmies, his eyes grew serious.
“The Abominable Four Scheming Demons! Weren’t you in the Thunder Swarm Mountain, locked away by the Demon Scheming Sect? What are you doing with the Luo clan?”
“Hi-hi-hi, foggie, are you talking to us?” Violent Demon held his chin up, “How could a mere mountain hold the four demonic heroes?”
“Hear, hear, the mountain can’t hold us. That goes double to you, hi-hi-hi…” The other three jumped up in glee.
Squinting, Huangpu Fenglei said, “Oh? And what if I tell the Demon Scheming Sect…”
Sss~
The four pygmies shivered on the spot, filled with fear.
Huangpu Fenglei smiled inside as he mocked, “Humph, you must’ve escaped your prison, right? If I report you to the Demon Scheming Sect, not just you, but even the Luo clan will…”
“I’d like to see you try.”
Zhuo Fan cut him off with his derision, “These four twerps are here to help the Luo clan by the order of Demon Scheming Sect’s Sect Leader, Xie Wuyue. Go ahead, report. I won’t stop you.”
Ugh!
Huangpu Fenglei choked on his words.
It was because Zhuo Fan’s information was too credible. Knowing who Demon Scheming Sect’s Sect Leader was, proved the Four Scheming Demons were sent to help the Luo clan. Did that mean the Luo clan had one of the empire’s three guardian sects, Demon Scheming Sect, on their side?
What hope did they have in fighting the Luo clan then? Not a snowball’s chance in hell. How could a house fight a sect?
Yet he was still unwilling to believe all of Zhuo Fan’s words, staring him in the eye for any trace of lies.
The Four Scheming Demons looked at him in shock. Wimp Demon couldn’t hold his curiosity in check as he whispered, “Steward Zhuo, is it true?”
Zhuo Fan nodded.
It was all fiction of course. Xie Wuyue had no idea the four sh*ts were with the Luo clan. But he was sure Xie Wuyue wouldn’t object anyway.
The Demon Scheming Sect’s Sect Leader was even waiting three years before taking him to his sect yet wouldn’t give this little bit of help?
The Four Scheming Demons, having got their answer, were ecstatic. They suddenly gathered around and pooled their tiny minds for a little chat. They nodded and a savage glint sparked in their eyes.
The four turned into black smoke and charged at Regent Estate.
Huangpu Fenglei jerked and shouted, “Look out, these four are hard to deal with!”
Too little, too late. Four trails of black smoke shot at Regent Estate’s Venerables. In a blink, a Venerable in the 4th layer of Radiant Stage was taken to the skies.
In the sun’s glaring rays, the black smoke squeezed in on the Venerable, despite his futile struggles.
Snaps were clearly heard as the Venerable wailed and broke in four. The blood sprinkled everywhere to the horror of everyone.
[Since when did a 4th layer Radiant Stage expert get dismembered so easily?]
[Those things are abominable!]
“Let that be a warning. Their unity tactic is hard to defend against. Don’t let them get the drop on you.” Huangpu Fenglei shouted, his face grave.
He had roamed Tianyu back in the day and knew of the four demons’ dreadful power. They were few, but vile and insidious like fiends, not to mention stronger than an average Radiant Stage expert.
Qiu Yanhai and Xue Qingjian’s fire and water combination art could hold back ten Radiant Stage experts. The four demons’s unity tactic could deal with another ten. And with freaks like Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian in the mix, he reckoned they’d handle ten as well, each.
Luo clan could now deal with 40 Radiant Stage experts, 10 more than Regent Estate had. This was something no one in the Regent Estate saw coming.
In just ten short years, this clan had reached such an astonishing height. The Crown Prince, second prince and many others were dumbstruck.
[Who the hell said Luo clan had no legacy? That it was made of only two people? In a blink, all their elders were on duty and freaking Radiant Stage experts at that!]
[What upstart? They were clearly a clan hiding for a thousand years!]
“Hi-hi-hi, geezer, weren’t you about to report us? We’re no longer scared of you. If you still have the guts, run away from us four demonic heroes and snitch!”
The black smoke in the air let out Violent Demon’s cackle.
Huangpu Fenglei felt a headache. He stuck close to Huangpu Tianyuan, as the latter and Leng Wuchang looked on with worry.
The four demons were notorious. They were madmen, doing whatever whenever, regardless of circumstances and orders.
They were a bigger threat than even Zhuo Fan!
The Crown Prince ran to Zhuo Fan and cupped his hands, “Steward Zhuo, today is Luo clan’s award ceremony. You can’t shed blood. Please cease hostilities, and call back your elders.”
“A red sky is an auspicious sky! We should make it so in reality as well. We shall turn the ceremony into a sign of prosperity!”
Zhuo Fan waved him off with his trademark evil grin, “Elder Li, who was it that struck first?”
“We did it at the same time. But he taunted me first!” Li Jingtian answered.
“In that case, we can’t turn back as cowards.”
Zhuo Fan laughed, “Elders, it’s showtime!”
Zhuo Fan gave the start with his left hand turning into the Earth Dragon Claw while his right shined. Li Jingtian grinned and black energy roamed. Xue Qingjian and Qiu Yanhai held hands as fire and water fused, releasing waves upon waves of power.
At such a display of power and glancing at the four black spots in the sky, Huangpu Fenglei felt like crying.
[What is wrong with today?] They only wanted to cut some of the Luo clan’s momentum and curb the new house’s development. [So how did it turn the other way around with us getting curbed?]
Not to mention this had stopped being a mere beating; they already had a casualty. If this went on, Luo clan’s fiends would kill them all.
They were all hoping their allies would back them up, but Hell Valley, Pill King Hall and Merry Woods, who usually cheered them on every chance they got, now looked anywhere but here. No help was coming from them, that was for sure.
The Luo clan and Regent Estate’s war had had them loose too much already. And now that the Luo clan had come in full force, they’d be dumber than a rock getting caught up in that maelstrom of carnage…

chapters.title: Chapter 358, Yield
chapters.content:
Chapter 358, Yield
Translator: StarReader
Glaring at those houses, the Regent Estate’s people looked around tensely.
They were in a real bind here. They had the numbers, true, but the enemy had the quality. Albeit less than ten, but against them, they didn’t dare make rash decisions.
More importantly, they were being singled out.
Alone, they’d be easy pickings. Not that going as a team would make much of a difference when the enemy used a unity tactic. They were at a severe disadvantage.
Looking at the four balls of blackness in the air, then at the grinning Zhuo Fan, Huangpu Tianyuan’s heart shivered.
The four demons moved like ghosts, elusive and deadly. Raging Ancestor and Ice Moon Witch united had their power multiplied, with hardly anyone hoping of getting near them. Mad Dipper Li Jingtian needed no introduction from the astonishing display earlier, and was on par with their High Venerable. While the last, Zhuo Fan, was the freakiest of all. He clearly had a power beyond Huangpu Fenglei.
In this particular hopeless situation, the best outcome would be with both sides sporting heavy losses and neither getting a clear advantage over the other. Especially when the Regent Estate’s thousand year long legacy was on the line here, ’bout to be burned to the ground.
He never thought nor hoped to be in such a crisis. That beside the imperial family, Tianyu had another house who could push them back.
Huangpu Tianyuan’s heart was torn with anxiety. He kept giving Leng Wuchang the eye.
He just wasn’t about to let Regent Estate fall under his leadership, he just couldn’t accept it.
The Crown Prince was tense as well. These two houses were about to jump at each other’s throat, with no one to mediate. [Where in the name of all that’s holy had those damn Divine Dragons gone off to?]
What would become of the imperial family’s public view when an all out skirmish took place in their backyard? Or front yard, to be precise.
[Right under the Emperor’s nose!]
Fang Qiubai and Sima Hui were watching from afar. They were in awe of the Luo clan’s military might, but stayed put. Waiting for the spark to blow this place sky high.
As for the audience, they were smart enough to clear the heck out of there. And only after all safety precautions were taken, and a very solid cover in front, did they begin to enjoy the bustle.
In one corner, they had a house with a thousand years old history and in the other was an up and coming behemoth. [It doesn’t get any better than this.]
As for who would ultimately be crowned head of houses, clans and the like? They were very much looking forward to seeing it.
The common clans weren’t the only ones. The other houses looked tensely at the stand off as well, observing as the situation devolved, or evolved.
Luo clan’s power blew their minds. Which had made the future house contest all the more confusing. Who would be the final winner? Earlier, the odds were 70-30, in Regent Estate’s favor. But now they looked pretty much even.
Luo clan had given them the shock of a lifetime…
Leng Wuchang’s eyes roamed about and then settled on his target, “Steward Zhuo, is it alright to do this? We both know how this is going to end. You’re not the one to go to war knowing there’s a third party involved and risk losing everything.”
“Perhaps… not!”
Zhuo Fan taunted with his cryptic smile. His eyes flashed, “Sir Leng, there’s a difference between me, you and Zhuge Changfeng. I’m not all brain and no brawn. Sometimes I go a little nuts you see. It’s normal. I’m sure you understand this by now, having felt it on your own skin, ha-ha-ha…”
Leng Wuchang’s face twitched and anger spiked.
He understood alright. Zhuo Fan was hinting at the Esoteric Debate where he went berserk. At the time Zhuo Fan, in his madness, carried out his vendetta regardless of tricks or the bigger picture.
He was quite conceited of himself back then, but now it somehow became Zhuo Fan’s cover, rendering all his readings of the steward void.
With enough brawn, one would lose their head, so much so they didn’t care about their own lives. They’d be willing to take the fall as long as they could take down the opponent with them.
Against a man without restraints, the crazier he was, the more horrifying he became. With nothing in this world to chain him down, you’d have no idea what insane idea he’d come up with next.
And that was Zhuo Fan.
If his revenge had yet to cool down back in the Esoteric Debate, he might really engage in this battle, regardless of a third party. Then they’d both lose. To the Luo clan, a new house, that was quite a good ending. While for Regent Estate, having a long history behind them, the resentment couldn’t be imagined.
Leng Wuchang sighed, “Then… what would make you step down?”
Regent Estate’s people were stunned. The great Leng Wuchang was actually negotiating his terms of surrender? This has never happened!
Not even Regent Estate’s people had experienced a case like this. He’d never submit even in front of the Estate Lord.
With a creepy grin plastered on his face, Zhuo Fan held his head high and began, “To be perfectly honest, our two houses are now in a stand off because of your taunt. If you want to give up, it couldn’t be easier. Apologize.”
[Apologize?]
Regent Estate shivered to the very core as every one of them glared back.
Regent Estate had been the head of all clans for a thousand years. All its actions were beyond reproach and righteous. Even if they weren’t, who would do anything about it? Yet now, they were being asked to apologize?
Wasn’t that a poorly disguised surrender? How would they get the nerve to get out into the world after this?
Not that Zhuo Fan gave a hoot about how they fumed, “As for your sincerity, just wing it.”
“Humph, you take that apology and stick it where the sun doesn’t shine. We’d rather choose death before dishonor. You and me, little demon, we’re gonna settle this right here!” An aged voice spat as he charged.
Going by the readings on his power surge, one would place him in the 6th layer of Radiant Stage.
“Don’t take him on by yourself!”
Leng Wuchang cried, for naught. The man got to Zhuo Fan, his golden glow revved up, dragon roars in the background and even the space fizzling out as he punched Zhuo Fan.
Any other guy out there would’ve been a smear on the ground long before he was even hit, but he was dealing with Zhuo Fan.
Lifting his right arm, the red glow flashed for a second and Zhuo Fan stopped the attack just like that. That mighty fist softly landed in his palm.
Before he could get another swing in, Xue Qingjian and Qiu Yanhai attacked with their hands united.
Life and Death Art!
Fire and ice combined to release an unspeakable power. It shot a blinding white light swallowing the man and catapulting him into the sky.
With a fairly loud bang, the sky itself shook, and the Radiant Stage expert was robbed of his last chance at wailing, pulverized. Not a sign of him was left that he ever even existed.
One blow!
Sss~
Gasps resounded everywhere. Everyone knew of the might of this old couple, but their expectations were blown at the display of a unity tactic.
Fear was etched on their faces, especially on Huangpu Fenglei. Not even he could take that.
[Why is the Luo clan a den of monsters?]
Li Jingtian grinned, taking on a cocky air as he heckled Huangpu Fenglei, “High Venerable, see that? That’s why we side with the Luo clan!”
Huangpu Fenglei was floored.
Did the Luo clan have much stronger cultivation methods than the imperial family and Regent Estate? They’d have to reevaluate their power if it were true.
This also snuffed out the last hope of victory Regent Estate had.
Huangpu Fenglei paled as he nodded to Huangpu Tianyuan. [Yield!]
Huangpu Tianyuan gasped, his fists clenched, nails digging into his palm. But in the end, he shouted, “Everyone, listen up…”
With a trembling lip, Huangpu Tianyuan found it unbearably hard to open his mouth and spoke those humiliating words. All he could do was make a deep bow. It was plain to see his meaning, and even the rest felt a little humiliated too.
But when they saw their Estate Lord lower his head, they couldn’t say anything and bowed as well.
Leng Wuchang felt his heart bleeding but he was all out of options. This was the only way out. Giving up before the madman found a reason to go crazy was the best outcome.
Leng Wuchang bowed as well, speaking for Huangpu Tianyuan, “Steward Zhuo, it was I who offended you. Please forgive me!”
Every clan looked at them stunned.
The head of houses, Regent Estate, surrendered to a new house. This had never happened in… ever!
The Regent Estate was stuck up even before the imperial family.
But before Zhuo Fan, they had completely yielded. The three princes were speechless.
Luo clan’s fame had reached an all time high…
“So you can learn!”
Zhuo Fan nodded, satisfied, “As long as you know your faults and keep them in mind for the future. The seven, uh no, from today it should be eight. The head of the eight houses is no longer the Regent Estate, but Luo clan! “
Zhuo Fan finished with a laugh, a snap of his finger and a spin on his heel before leaving.
The Four Scheming Demons landed, along with the other elders. Everyone walked on victorious towards Luo Yunchang.
The people witnessing this miracle felt hope surging in their chests. While the rest of the houses were utterly speechless and stunned to even react.
The head of the seven houses, Regent Estate, had humble pie shoved down their throats before the entire empire. And even had their head title stolen by the new house.
“Elder Chu, is that our ally?” A lady among Drifting Flowers Edifices’ disciples asked Chu Bijun.
Grandmother nodded happily, “Venerable Bing, it is!”
“Good, Elder Chu, we truly bet on a treasure this time. There’s hope for Drifting Flowers Edifices to rise again.”
Grandmother smiled…
Cheers exploded at Veiled Dragon Pavilion and Sword Marquise Abode houses as well. While only Pill King Hall and Merry Woods looked positively glum.
Regent Estate’s decline meant the fall of their backer. As for Hell Valley, they looked on with a cold eye, having already found their path…

chapters.title: Chapter 359, Award Ceremony
chapters.content:
Chapter 359, Award Ceremony
Translator: StarReader
“Who’d have thought that secretive kid from Luo clan would reveal his entire hand only now. A truly unpredictable man!”
In the Imperial Palace, Zhuge Changfeng stood on a hundred meter tall gate tower, watching, sighing. Next to him were the yin yang elders.
With a frown, the white haired elder’s eyes turned hard, “How did he reach such an inconceivable level? It’s mind boggling. It makes me recall that man…”
“You mean…”
The black haired elder’s eyes flashed and he shuddered at the mere mention, “Invincible Scamp, Gu Santong?”
The other nodded, “Besides that little devil, I’ve never seen anyone in the Profound Heaven Stage capable of taking a peak Radiant Stage expert’s attack with such ease. It used to be only him, but now…”
“Ha-ha-ha, Zhuo Fan is far worse than Gu Santong.”
Zhuge Changfeng smiled, “Gu Santong is but a humble man. With a bit of trickery he’d fall for anything. With the Imperial Palace trapping him for three hundred years, it makes his godlike feat back then look like a lie. He is but a mere child.”
Zhuge Changfeng’s eyes squinted and he turned to the white haired figure, “But Zhuo Fan is a true master of cunning and trickery. To play or con him is harder than taking the throne! Now that he has Gu Santong’s power as well, no one in Tianyu can deal with him.”
The yin yang elders looked at each other puzzled.
The white elder paused then, “Prime Minister, didn’t you say everything was put in place by the Emperor? He wanted to incite the Regent Estate and Luo clan to sink further into killing each other. The two were so close to doing it as well, with Zhuo Fan’s high and mighty display, and killing two of Regent Estate’s Venerables, doesn’t that mean he fell for it? As far as my old eyes see, Leng Wuchang just had to endure and the two houses would be tearing each other apart by now.”
“Ha-ha-ha, you guys only see what’s in front and not from every angle.”
Zhuge Changfeng shook his head, “The Emperor might have set the stage, but couldn’t care less about how this drama played out. Be it Zhuo Fan or Leng Wuchang, both are wise enough to see it. Neither of them wishes to fight and to let the Emperor win.
“But with this, Zhuo Fan has found Leng Wuchang’s limit. Because of what transpired in the Esoteric Debate, Zhuo Fan’s actions had gone beyond human understanding leaving Leng Wuchang in the dark about his next move. It had robbed him of his initiative in this situation, ending up getting smacked around like a child. Even if Zhuo Fan had been stronger, he’d still not do it. A trained eye would see that the Emperor wanted to use this excuse to force Luo clan to show its hand and thus, was a partial winner. While Luo clan used the stage to push back at the Regent Estate and shake their public image, also winning some. While only Regent Estate, suppressed by a new house, suffered the worst, ha-ha-ha…”
The two elders shivered, eyes stunned.
A mere scuffle between the two houses actually had so many implications and consequences, fighting over interests below the surface.
If humble people like them were caught up in it, they reckoned they’d be toyed with and spat out mangled. The complexity of the ploys were mind boggling.
Now they understood why Zhuo Fan was more dreadful than Gu Santong.
If Gu Santong had but half of Zhuo Fan’s smarts, no one could’ve been able to fool him into ending up trapped.
Zhuo Fan was a combination of Leng Wuchang and Gu Santong in one.
“Prime Minister, it’s best this threat is dealt with fast, before it affects sir’s plan!” The black elder cupped his hands, “While the kid isn’t invincible, we two can still handle him. Please let us cull him and spare you the suffering.”
Zhuge Changfeng waved, “Now, now, he isn’t my enemy yet. Quite the helper in fact. Taking him out earlier will only benefit the others. I don’t take kindly to letting others enjoy the fruits of my work.”
The elders were puzzled.
Zhuge Changfeng merely shook his head, “I have figured out that old bean’s mind. Eight houses, a thousand year old secret order, they have all been long in play, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuge Changfeng stepped down the tower, “Come, the ceremony is about to begin…”
The elders followed in silence.
In another area, Fang Qiubai and Sima Hui saw the two houses cease hostilities. But even with Regent Estate losing two Venerables, the two were cursing them for being useless and running scared on their way to the Imperial Palace.
Zhuo Fan had rejoined Luo Yunchang with the elders and went to the ninth gate.
Watching the aloof white haired figure not once glance over, Yongning glared at him annoyed and pouted, “Humph, what’s with being all pretentious-like? You’re nothing but a steward of a no-name clan.”
“Yongning, he isn’t your normal steward. In his hands, the Luo clan has become Regent Estate’s equal. You know what power the Regent Estate has, even we have to show respect. Keep in mind the next time you meet people from the Luo clan to show some courtesy!” Crown Prince instructed.
Yongning was having none of that. Second prince came over and looked at Luo clan as he said, “Luo clan isn’t to be taken lightly. Their steward is a man to befriend.”
“Second brother, don’t forget about our imperial family’s rules.”
“Leave me be!”
Second prince didn’t give a damn about the Crown Prince’s warning.
“Princess, princess, are you alright?” A shout revealed the child coming running from among the crowd.
The princess smiled while the Crown Prince sighed and facepalmed, “Almost forgot, Yongning, how did you get out?”
“Uh, snooping.” Yongning and the child hanged their heads in shame.
Crown Prince turned blue from anger and barked, “Yongning, you not only snuck out of the Imperial Palace by yourself but even dared to snoop to do it? You’re only making it worse for yourself!”
“How’s it my fault? The entire Imperial Palace is filled with tunnels with no guards around them. How else did you expect me to get out with my 5th layer of Bone Tempering Stage cultivation?” Yongning grumbled.
Crown Prince was royally pissed now. He couldn’t vent as Yuwen Cong came laughing, “Ha-ha-ha, eldest brother, breathe, breathe. Sister likes to mess around. The ninth gate will soon open and we’ll take her back. What’s the point of making the matter worse than it is?
“Third brother, you’re the best! Your head looks like a pig, but your brain is sharper than one!” Yongning giggled.
Yuwen Cong turned cold, “Eldest brother, I think handing her over to imperial father is best. Ground her for half a year and seal all the tunnels in the Imperial Palace. See how she’ll get out then!”
“No! Third brother, I was wrong. Please forgive me! Don’t tell the imperial father! You’re the most handsome man ever. Even… even more than Zhuo Fan!”
That had all of them laugh and look at her with a shaking head.
They were all brothers and sisters and had no reason to hate each other.
After fifteen minutes, with a sharp creaking sound, all the gates rumbled open to reveal the refined interior of the Imperial Palace.
“Open!”
The eight houses each had a gate, while the three princes and Yongning took the center one.
The other clans walked behind the houses as they entered. But this time Regent Estate had far less people following them, even less than the other houses.
While Luo clan, a newcomer, had the longest trail, making it hard to even pass the gate. The previous fight had done wonders for the Luo clan’s prestige.
They all knew Luo clan was above Regent Estate as the new head of all clans and houses. Only around ten elders, but each was valiant and hardy like true warriors.
This also meant that Luo clan cared about quality not quantity.
Following the entrance of the eight groups into a wide hallway, the two sides were lined with guards. From their bearing it was easy to see that they were hardened soldiers and one could even detect arrays all over the place.
Looking ahead, one could guess them to be above a thousand in number!
Zhuo Fan’s eyes trembled and he nodded inwardly. Based on every house’s legacy, the imperial family’s legacy ruled supreme.
Once they passed the eight golden bridges, they arrived an hour later before a lofty palace. There, the second of the Four Pillars, Marshal Dugu Zhantian, was standing guard on the right side of the throne with Dragonslaying Crescent Blade in hand.
While on the left was Prime Minister Zhuge Changfeng.
The two looked at Luo clan, Zhuo Fan in particular. Dugu Zhantian took a deep breath with a calm gaze as Zhuge Changfeng tended to his beard with a faint smile.
With another loud shout, an old man in yellow gown entered their sight.
“His Majesty has arrived!”
The eighth noble house award ceremony was about to begin…

chapters.title: Chapter 360, Best Steward Beneath Heaven
chapters.content:
Chapter 360, Best Steward Beneath Heaven
Translator: StarReader
The man in yellow gown walked slowly towards the throne as the servants on either side followed with deep bows. He looked quite thin, but his bright eyes looked at everyone present, lingering ever so slightly longer on the Luo clan.
This man was the current emperor of the Tianyu Empire.
“May Your Majesty live a long and prosperous life!” The instant he took his seat, the eight groups bowed.
The emperor waved, “As everyone knows, I have called you all here today to bear witness and rejoice, by the grace of Tianyu’s ancestors, to the rise of a new house in our empire!
“Tianyu has survived the past thousand years in no small part due to our seven houses’ assistance, bringing stability and prosperity, safeguarding peace along the ages. In all these years, the imperial family dared not neglect its duty, looking for talents to defend the wellbeing of its people. That is the purpose of the Esoteric Debate, to see a clan rise up and make Tianyu great. I am sad to say that this has never happened!
“We are fortunate that the heavens finally took pity on us and my rule, and presented us with a new house, working alongside the seven houses in strengthening our foundation. This is a blessing to myself, to the nation, and to everyone else!”
“Congratulations, Your Majesty! The land shall grow even stronger!” Everyone bowed.
Luo clan did the same, with humility, “We dare not accept Your Majesty’s praise!”
Everyone present knew this was just a high class act, and thus was shortly ignored. Even those who had never seen this new house knew that the seven houses never stopped fighting among each other since the empire’s foundation. [What working together? More like stabbing each other’s backs.]
With the coming of the 8th house, the fights would only grow bitter. A prime example was the two houses duking it out at the ruler’s gates.
While the emperor was saying all that, the empire was in fact on the verge of collapse, hanging by a thread. He didn’t believe what he himself said and neither did those people who were bowing. It was all make-believe.
Despite all of this, neither side was about to unravel the white lie. These were appearances and decorum that had to be maintained. Or poking holes in the paper thin charade would lead to Tianyu going up in flames, something no one wanted…
The emperor looked at them one more time and smiled, “Praise heavens!”
The Imperial Palace guards came forward and prepared the incense. The emperor bowed before it and even began reading a prayer.
It was more or less being thankful to the heavens for the prosperity of Tianyu. While every paper was perused, an hour passed by and the rest rose up along with the emperor.
He took his rightful place on the throne with traces of sweat on his brow, a clear indication that he was reaching the limit of his life.
He knew that, yet he would still put on a cheerful face, “Good, after we showed our respects to heaven and earth, we then have the son of heaven, which is myself. Luo Clan’s Head, Luo Yunhai, step forward!”
“Yes, Your Majesty!” Luo Yunhai stepped down on one knee.
“Young Luo Yunhai, your father has been taken from you at an early age, yet with your bravery and resolve, you have led the clan forward alone. You have followed Marshal Dugu in battle and showed marvelous skill in the Esoteric Debate. You are a true model of Tianyu’s heroes. I bestow upon the Luo clan, the title of the Eighth Noble House. Windgaze City shall be your domain along with the hundred cities around it. You shall be known as Regent of Prosperity, allowed to own a prince’s manor in the imperial capital!”
Raising his head, Luo Yunhai was bug eyed and so were the rest, looking at the emperor in disbelief.
None of them expected for Luo Yunhai to actually become a nobleman and even have a title!
Among the seven houses, only Regent Estate had the marquis title because they were related to the imperial family.
But Luo clan was a run down third rate clan. And it had just jumped in front of everyone with the title of prince!
Only Zhuge Changfeng, Zhuo Fan and Leng Wuchang understood. The emperor wanted to place the Regent Estate and Luo clan on opposite fronts.
Since the world couldn’t hold both of them, so too the eight houses could only have one boss. Two kings was one king too many!
The emperor’s title came with vile intentions!
Not that Zhuo Fan gave a hoot since his sole plan for Regent Estate was to drag it out. And Regent Estate wasn’t about to sway under the emperor’s taunt. So when the tripartite division took shape, all those titles became empty words.
On the contrary, the hundred cities offered made Zhuo Fan pleased as a punch.
What was of greatest importance in the cultivation world? Resources.
A hundred cities included the mountain range close by and the tens of spirit mines and endless herbs it offered. And all of that was the house’s private property.
Adding to that a part of the empire as well, Luo clan would soar with so many resources. It would no longer need its allies’ support. It had finally gained independence.
This was why many clans wanted to curry favor with the houses. Without resources, they’d wither and die.
And these resources were either the empire’s or the houses’.
Monopoly on the resources controlled Tianyu’s clans’ development. With Luo clan having a hundred cities to its name, if the clans wanted to join it, they’d have to move to the border.
Zhuo Fan finally showed a twisted smile.
Two servants came before Luo Yunhai, offering him a golden cape, embroidered with a majestic dragon. It only missed the four claws, or it’d be just like the princes’.
This was a symbol that showed the house was equal to the imperial family, not to mention Luo Yunhai was a regent.
“Thank you, Your Majesty!” Luo Yunhai bowed.
The emperor nodded and turned to his sister, “Young miss Luo, come forward!”
Luo Yunchang was stunned.
A male would take on the mantle of Clan Head along with titles, so where was he going by calling her?
Luo Yunchang still kneeled, “May Your Majesty live a long and prosperous life!”
“Luo Yunchang, dignified and virtuous, strong and loyal. After the misfortune that befell your clan, you held strong against all adversity, raising your little brother and guiding the clan. You are a model of virtue to all of Tianyu. I take you as my goddaughter, naming you Princess Yong’an, and expect you to become a good sister with my daughter Yongning in safeguarding Tianyu!”
Luo Yunchang turned to Yongning hiding behind the princes, who stared blankly back at her. Neither expected that from the emperor. They were to be sisters.
“Uh, Your Majesty, I would never…”
“This is an imperial decree!” The emperor cut her off with a stern face.
Luo Yunchang sighed, “Then, I shall accept!”
The emperor beamed and Luo Yunchang withdrew.
“Luo clan’s steward, Zhuo Fan, step forth!”
When everyone thought the award ceremony was over, the emperor called one more time.
Zhuo Fan was puzzled. He was just a steward, not the Luo Clan Head. [Why’s he giving me something?] But since the emperor decreed, he could only oblige and gave a half bow, “May Your…”
“You dare not bow before His Majesty?”
A sharp cry pierced the ears of everyone.
Zhuo Fan looked on with a frown, at the servant next to the emperor and his face grew cold, “You’re the one with the nerve calling it to attention when the Emperor said nothing, trying to kiss someone’s ass. Do you think of yourself better than the Emperor?”
“Uh, no no, His Majesty…”
The servant panicked. They had always been next to the emperor and basked in second-hand glory, getting used to pushing others around.
They were proxies dishing out the emperor’s orders, but as long as the emperor didn’t say anything, anything went. Perhaps they were even doing what His Majesty intended.
While other scared people never dared to refute in fear of the emperor’s anger.
But Zhuo Fan was a tough nut to crack. Would the grand Demonic Emperor from the Sacred Domain kneel before a no name emperor from the mortal domain?
The servant was way out of his league messing with him.
Especially when he knew the emperor needed him and wouldn’t sweat this particular detail.
The emperor waved and smiled at Zhuo Fan, “Then, Zhuo Fan, why do you not kneel?”
“My knees are wounded. With Your Majesty’s brilliant and wise character, I’m sure you won’t pressure the future house’s steward.”
Zhuo Fan’s words were a work of art. Throwing the emperor’s words right back at him.
[In layman’s terms, you just called us irreplaceable, in order to strengthen the nation’s foundation. So why the hell would you nitpick? Only a poor ruler would do that. Won’t that shame you? Won’t you lose Tianyu’s respect?]
Those words even contained a hint of threat.
Luo Yunchang lowered her head, filled with worry and anger at Zhuo Fan’s crass act. [Before the mighty Emperor, you kneel when spoken to! What the hell are you doing looking for an early death?]
[Offending the imperial family will give us a death sentence!]
She was unaware that this was a fine balance not even the emperor wished to break. Since he didn’t want to let Regent Estate come out on top?
Hence Zhuo Fan’s leverage was very much real.
Giving him a long look, the emperor smiled, “You truly are a worthy steward for the Luo clan, Zhuo Fan. Your reputation precedes you!”
“Then, Zhuo Fan will receive your title!”
The emperor coughed and shouted, “Steward Zhuo Fan of the Luo clan, you are a man of bravery and wisdom, holding your clan together through hard times, loyal and caring, a pillar of the empire! I bestow upon you the title Best Steward Under Heavens, wielding the power of the three armies and the bearer of my authority!”
Sss~
The people gasped in shock. Even Zhuo Fan…

chapters.title: Chapter 361, Emperor’s Invite
chapters.content:
Chapter 361, Emperor’s Invite
Translator: StarReader
What did the best steward under heavens mean? His orders were second to the emperor in court and he was the supreme commander of the three armies. He was literally beneath the emperor and above the world.
He was the epitome of power, a Prime Minister and Marshal in one, albeit with the emperor standing above him still.
With how the imperial reign was built on this authority alone, it was no different than capitulating the very ground that was holding his throne!
Dugu Zhantian’s eyes twitched, looking at the emperor with a dumb look. Zhuge Changfeng was doing the same, albeit with a casual glance.
[The geezer’s plan is obvious, he wants to give Zhuo Fan a power even above that of the Four Pillars.]
As a Prime Minister, he had figured out the old schemer on the spot. The emperor wanted to balance the factions. [His reign had been steady all these years because of Dugu Zhantian and me.]
[But won’t this trouble addict, who goes on withdrawal if he doesn’t cause a mess once every three days, have all this power go to his head and blow everything sky high? Or maybe…]
Zhuge Changfeng squinted, scoffing inside.
[The old coot can’t take it anymore. He wants to speed up the chaos by getting the monkey added incentive to do just that, and flip the board while he is at it…]
While Leng Wuchang tensed, his heart was resentful.
He had already guessed what the emperor was up to, but that didn’t mean he liked it. He was Regent Estate’s steward, the one famed across the whole empire as Unwonted Contriver.
Yet for a neophyte to suddenly call himself best steward under heavens didn’t sit quite right with him, to say the least.
Though Zhuo Fan’s deceit and shrewdness had him pensive, by right, that title should be his!
Sunk into depression, Leng Wuchang took a deep breath, twice, to regain his cool. He looked at Zhuo Fan with jealousy and greed…
“Present the violet mantle!”
The emperor had spoken. A servant responded on point, presenting a plate with a purple cape and golden thread.
The cape was unraveled, presenting a golden dragon with its four claws in the corners, while also a hint of a possible fifth claw, on a visibly empty pattern.
The imperial family’s robe was characterized by dragon claws, it was a symbol of their rank, authority and power.
Four made one a prince, while five lifted him to be the son of heaven, an emperor. This cape was proof that Zhuo Fan was just shy of having the entire empire at his feet.
Such controversy would never have stood. Since it held a strong feeling of outrage and rebellion against the current court.
Yet the emperor himself bestowed Zhuo Fan with this contradiction. It went on to show that along with the best steward under heavens, Zhuo Fan was truly beneath the emperor, in both name and power. Not even the seven houses, princes, or even crown prince could compare.
Crown Prince trembled and finally fell to one knee, “Imperial father, this is most unbecoming. Please reconsider!”
The rest followed his example, shouting in unison, “Please reconsider, Your Majesty!”
“I order you to stand down!” The emperor’s piercing cold tone sent shivers down their backs. They could not defy him.
The emperor was the son of heaven, his word was solid gold. No man could sway his mind!
They were all awakened to this simple yet painful truth, knowing any persuasion would fall on deaf ears.
Without further ado, Zhuo Fan was entitled as the First Steward Beneath Heaven. His glorious radiance stabbing the eyes of all below, while also pricking no few hearts with discontent.
Now that Zhuo Fan had both power and right, any defiance would be ill-advised, in a manner of speaking. He could stick the imperial family’s army on anyone’s ass at the drop of a hat!
Pill King Hall and Merry Woods exchanged a pained glance.
They never gave Zhuo Fan and Luo clan a second thought up till now, yet against fierce adversity they had become a behemoth. If only they’d known, they’d have it snuffed in its cradle.
Regent Estate took this news quite well, too well, in fact. That was because they knew something everyone else didn’t, Zhuo Fan’s title was totally void of authority…
The emperor didn’t stop at Zhuo Fan’s cape, showering the other high value members of the Luo clan with a title each, albeit far lesser than the first three. It was all so that the people would recognize who the Luo clan was, to open their beady eyes in the face of greatness and not step on their toes.
Even still, there was one teeny-tiny matter that had everyone’s dumbstruck faces on full display; while Pill King Hall and Drifting Flowers Edifices were slack jawed.
Luo clan’s second elder, Pill House elder, was Vicious Pill King Yan Song!
Even the emperor was taken aback. Didn’t Zhuo Fan waste him? What’s he doing as Luo clan’s elder?
The emperor gave Zhuo Fan a deep look, “Steward Zhuo, you’ve fooled the entire world for eight years with your devious schemes. Just how many secrets are you hiding?”
“Ha-ha-ha, please don’t kid Your Majesty. With Your Majesty’s astute mind, how could I possibly hide anything.” Zhuo Fan bowed.
The emperor shook his head.
He wouldn’t be the emperor if he believed every outright lie. [This kid’s tricks are so twisted even I am getting a headache.]
With inconceivable matters cropping up one after another, fear crept within the emperor’s heart. Without even realizing it, this pawn he nurtured for so long had outgrown his control.
[I hope this game will still play out.]
The emperor sighed inwardly…
After four to six hours of dishing awards and titles, the ceremony came to a close. The emperor had the clans leave the Imperial Palace, but not without a bow from them and a deep respect towards the Luo clan.
This new house was budding, yet it was very much capable. It had both experts and alchemists, at the top of their fields.
Even their steward had surpassed the wisest steward of all, Unwonted Contriver, and became known as The Best Steward Beneath Heavens.
A team such as this, excelling in power and management, was bound to hit it big. There were quite a number of clans entertaining the thought of bending a knee for the Luo clan after the ceremony.
That went double after seeing their ranks. Of the Luo clan’s elders, Lei Yuntian was the weakest, yet a Grand Elder. Second elder Yan Song was even in front of those Radiant Stage experts. These two were a complete discrepancy for the powerhouses around them.
That line-up was like a flare to the people. This told everyone that the Luo clan was an honorable clan. First come, first served. Then again, one would always pick a true helper in favor of a poser.
This had the clans competing to get into the Luo clan’s graces rather than see it played out first. Luo clan had it made, no doubt about it.
Luo clan was also the only one who made such strong elders work.
All made possible by the grace and power of their steward, Zhuo Fan. Was there anyone among the elders who dared show discontent for their positions? To another clan, such a huge discrepancy in power would’ve ended up in infightings.
Didn’t might always make right?
Yet in the Luo clan, that right was worth sh*t. Any and all that dared preach such an outdated philosophy were served a huge piece of humble pie on a silver platter…
“Zhuo Fan, walk with me!”
Zhuo Fan was leaving with the Luo clan when an aged voice called him. He turned to meet the emperor’s steel gaze.
With a deep breath and a nod, as if expecting it, he went with the old man.
The two arrived at a pavilion in the imperial gardens. The emperor took a seat on a stone chair and invited him to do the same, “This is where I and Mr. Sima play chess. Here, we’re simple people, without rank. Please, make yourself at home.”
With a raised eyebrow, Zhuo Fan plopped his butt on the chair, then took a casual bite out of a fruit he picked from the platter. He really was at home.
The servant at the side almost blew a gasket.
[That was His Majesty’s courtesy, not for you to take it literally! Not even Mr. Sima, being friends with His Majesty for ages, would be so crass!]
Not that the emperor cared, smiling as a grandpa did for his dotted grandson.
“Zhuo Fan, I’ve heard so much about you but this is our first meeting.” The emperor smiled.
Zhuo Fan just nodded.
The emperor laughed, “I first heard of you from my third son. He said that Luo clan has a clever steward helping them and that I needn’t worry. Thus I supported this new clan. As for your ability, I never gave it a second thought. How strong can a third-rate broken-up clan’s clever steward become? I mean, the scope was just so limited, it was impossible for it to grow. Wouldn’t you agree?”
The emperor chatted as he looked at Zhuo Fan with a smile.
Zhuo Fan gave a curt nod again.
Sure enough, before meeting face to face, all information was about the clan itself. How one’s view changed depended on one’s position. Since no clan had ever come out of a border town like Windgaze City, what scope, what ambition could this one have?
Even he would jump to the same conclusion given the chance. He’d have the same disinterest in Luo clan and himself upon hearing of them.
It was this lack of vigilance that made people like him be the ones in control. Or if Hell Valley or any other house focused on his clan, death was certain, unable to grow into what it was today.
There was no one to blame here. Hell Valley was not some fool to let the Luo clan slip through its fingers, it was Zhuo Fan’s uncanny mind to come up with some of the most insane and mystifying plans…

chapters.title: Chapter 362, Paving the Way
chapters.content:
Chapter 362, Paving the Way
Translator: StarReader
“However, killing You Guiqi in Blue Expanse City gave me quite a shock.”
With a deep breath, the emperor looked to the heavens, a faint smile traced across his face, “The only thing on my mind in those days was how could the third mind of Tianyu, Hell Valley’s schemer, die at the hands of a nobody. It was then that I began to take notice of you. I reckon I was among the minority who held you in such high regard.”
Zhuo Fan secretly sighed.
He planned to keep his head low back then, to build up his strength and avoid unwelcome scrutiny. But then Ning’er showed up and the circumstances forced him to go all out.
Then Hell Valley followed up with their kill order, harassing him on every step.
Come to think of it, he wasn’t all that level-headed as he believed, but a mindless savage charging through. [But I liked the charge, so staunch, so invigorating!]
In reply to his thoughts, the emperor patted his shoulder, “You don’t have to feel sorry, I understand. A patient man like you would never face such strong enemies so early. But as gold can’t dull its radiance, or how a diamond can’t hide among the sand, you too will meet with these events; whether you like it or not. Only, your radiance is perhaps a bit too gaudy. Even I was almost blinded, ha-ha-ha…”
The emperor continued, “After my poor heart calmed down at last, months later, you pulled another one. You wrecked Drifting Flowers City and killed three house elders. That scared me. I wanted to build the Luo clan up to strike a balance, but you, the chick I had been raising, almost bit a wolf to death. You were close to ruining everything. I was wondering if renouncing your clan would be the better part of valor.”
“Uhm, many apologies, Your Majesty, I was too reckless and almost wasted Your Majesty’s hard work. I am ashamed of myself.” Zhuo Fan bowed slightly and cupped his hands.
Yet his mind was thinking the opposite.
[His words feel sincere, but lack any truth. He goes on and on about balance and stuff, but from today’s attitude, he wants anything but. All he wants is chaos!]
[Actions speak louder than any sweet words.] Zhuo Fan had drilled this lesson into Lei Yuting for years, being a devoted follower of this saying himself.
Hence, in reply to the emperor’s convoluted speech, his mind was that of a mirror, not so easily pulled under.
The emperor’s eyes shined with wisdom, then he laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, it’s fine. It’s all in the past anyway. It was only then that I realized my son was right. You truly are a man of many talents. How else could you have incited so much chaos? And so, I came to a bold and radical decision. Do you know why I sent Marshal Dugu to Windgaze City for rescue?”
“I am moved to tears by Your Majesty’s extreme favor for my Luo clan!” Zhuo Fan’s bow was on point.
Shaking his head, the emperor gave a vague smile, “No, it wasn’t for the Luo clan, but for you.”
“I am shocked and dare not accept such praise!”
“Ha-ha-ha, is there anything you won’t dare to do? I wholly appreciate your strength. The next set of events only proved that my decision to send a million soldiers in defense of one man was the right approach. You haven’t let me down!” He held Zhuo Fan’s shoulder, showering him in praise.
Zhuo Fan lowered his head.
The emperor squinted, watching, scrutinizing, and only now he came back to the main topic, “Zhuo Fan, I have called you here to come to an understanding between us.”
“Command me, Your Majesty!” Zhuo Fan’s bow came again.
“What do you think of becoming… The Prime Minister?”
Shuddering, Zhuo Fan was stunned inside, but he put on a quizzical face, “Your Majesty, the empire already has Prime Minister Zhuge. Why…”
“Ha-ha-ha, of the empire’s three great minds, You Guiqi only knew how to manipulate and scheme, a disgrace. Leng Wuchang has the talent, but a petty character that lacks any drive. Prime Minister Zhuge is the best candidate, holding his office for decades, his conduct exemplary. Only… he is just like me, old. Once I’m gone, am I to just leave an old man behind as support, to drag his feet and the nation? It is not something I want to see, and I’m sure my successor would be in agreement as well.”
Quirking an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan got the gist. The emperor wanted to pave the way for his son, the new emperor.
As with any new emperor who took over the throne, their position will be shaky. With a wily old fox like Zhuge Changfeng around, with a cunning mind and wielder of power, the emperor’s three sons would fall like flies.
It would be an age of a weak ruler with strong followers. How could the Yuwen clan ever hold on to Tianyu?
[Ha-ha-ha, it’ll change hands of course!]
This was where Zhuo Fan came in. He had no basis in the court, so even if a new emperor cropped up, the case would be that of a strong ruler and a weak follower, him ending up as the new emperor’s pawn.
