The fatty gasped, then put on a bitter smile, “Yongning, are you sure you aren’t playing with half a deck? That little sneak of yours outside the gates was out in the open for all the houses to see. Why mention the shadow guards when everyone knew? Besides, the shadow guards are father’s secret force. No one knows who they really are. All that is known is their captain, the fourth pillar, Shadow King! Even the other pillars are cautious around him. Aren’t you perhaps having an overinflated idea of yourself thinking a big shot like him would set his eyes on the little old you?”
“What little old me? Aren’t I a princess?” Yongning threw a tantrum.
Fatty sighed, “Yongning, we’re getting nowhere. Might as well accept father’s punishment. Princess Yongning, receive the edict!”
“Yongning obeys. May His Majesty have a long and prosperous life!” Yongning fell to her knees, with utmost respect.
Fatty turned solemn as well, “By order of the emperor, Yongning has sneaked out of the palace and lost all semblance of propriety. You are hereby confined for one year, subjected to change depending upon your behavior!”
“A year?!” Yongning fell to the ground in shock, her face ashen.
A whole year stuck in the Imperial Palace, that was the heaviest blow she had ever received.
Fatty regarded the downcast princess in pain and was going to say a few words, but a child rushed over in panic, crying all the time, “Princess, something terrible has happened!”
“What happened? Why are you panicking?”
Yongning sighed, “What could be worse than being grounded for a year? And didn’t I tell you to invite Shuang’er to read me? Where is she?”
Gasping, she blurted, “Didn’t get the chance. Miss Shuang’er and Zhuo Fan were kidnapped.”
“What?” Yongning and fatty cried.
“I saw it with my own eyes, princess!” Lu Zhu vouched.
“Who did it?” The fatty frowned.
“I heard them mentioning the second prince!”
“What?” Fatty and Yongning jerked at once. Fatty’s face was whiter than paper.
“Second brother has really done it now. A prince engaging in kidnapping? And with the High Priest’s Holy Maiden and a house’ steward no less! Lu Zhu, you come with me. I am going to give him an earful, humph!”
Yongning scoffed, pulling Lu Zhu towards the emperor’s study. Lu Zhu merely bobbed her head and followed. While fatty ran out of the palace aghast.
“Third brother, where are you going? Shouldn’t we tell father?” Yongning shouted.
“It’s too late for that!” Fatty gnashed his teeth.
“Late?” Yongning was bewildered, “Since the second brother had them kidnapped they should be safe for the time being. “
“How can I rest easy? And I’m not worried for them, but for my second brother. Old second must’ve lost his mind to move against that savage. You can mess with the King of Hell, but god help you if you step on Steward Zhuo’s toes! That line said back in the Esoteric Debate wasn’t just for show!”
Fatty wiped his brow and his face was flushed. His blubberbutt actually moved with uncanny grace for once, gone like the wind.
Yongning figured the situation was far graver and rushed as well…

chapters.title: Chapter 371, The Savage Rouses
chapters.content:
Chapter 371, The Savage Rouses
Whoosh!
The image of a perfect blue sky was ruined when a yellow smoke made erratic movements all over it. It landed in a huge yard, revealing the person within.
It was Ancestor Huang Mei and his cronies. Each was holding a knocked out hostage, Zhuo Fan and Holy Maiden Yun Shuang.
Throwing the baggage to the ground, the trio cackled.
Clap~
With a slow clap, a nice-looking youth came over with a dozen people behind him. It was Yuwen Yong.
Second prince gave the baggage a curt nod, “Whenever the yellow wind blows nothing can catch him. Ancestor Huang Mei lives up to his reputation. To have even Zhuo Fan, the pain in the rear of all the houses, tied up, I am in awe, ha-ha-ha…”
“Hi-hi-hi, thank you, Your Highness. I am not like those nobodies, undeserving of their name. I had him captured even before I got to show what I was made of! I feel ashamed sometimes, undeserving of the second prince’s praise.”
“Ha-ha-ha, Ancestor is so modest. I’m sure that it is not Zhuo Fan who is weak, but Ancestor’s skills are out of this world to have achieved such swift success. Ancestor, you will have the ten 8th grade pills, rest assured.”
Second prince clapped and laughed while Ancestor Huang Mei gave out his creepy cackle.
With that out of the way, the second prince turned to the baggage. He flipped Zhuo Fan over and snickered at his dreamy look, “Is this all the Best Steward Beneath Heavens amounts to? This is what you get for ignoring my invite!”
Then he turned to Yun Shuang in confusion, “Ancestor, who is this?”
“He-he-he, not a clue. Since she was with Zhuo Fan, she has to be someone important to him. I figured the girl would be of some use to Your Highness so I brought her along.” Ancestor Huang Mei shrugged.
Second prince chapped his lips with so many praises, “That’s so nice of you, Ancestor, ha-ha-ha…”
He flipped her over as well, putting on display all that made her pretty. He was amazed, “Holy Maiden Yun Shuang? Ancestor, how come you’ve kidnapped someone from Parish?”
“You mean I can’t?” Ancestor Huang Mei was confused.
Squinting, the second prince took a deep breath and showed a twisted smile, “No, you are perfect, Ancestor. In fact, I’ll add two more pills as thanks!”
[What?!]
Ancestor Huang Mei blanked for a second then laughed, “Thank you, Your Highness!”
He thought he had brought along a mere girl but she proved to be of value, earning him a bonus.
Giving Yun Shuang a good look, second prince said, “Ancestor, could you wake her up. I have some questions.”
“Easy.”
Ancestor Huang Mei nodded and pulled out a vial from his ring. He hovered it under Yun Shuang’s nose and said, “This is my prized narcotic, Thousand Years Dream. Not even a Radiant Stage expert can fight it. Their only chance at waking up is if I help them, he-he-he…”
“Ancestor’s skills are amazing. I am in awe.”
Second prince cupped his hands, then waited for Yun Shuang to wake up.
Fifteen minutes later, with a melodious sound, Yun Shuang stirred. The first thing she saw was the second prince’s warped smile. She cried, “Ah, second prince…”
“Miss, there’s no need to fear. You are a valued guest of my manor. You’re safe here. Grinning, second prince made a gesture for silence.”
Yun Shuang looked at him distraught. She shuddered backwards as she took in his accomplices with a heavy heart.
Her 5th layer of Profound Heaven Stage could hardly count as anything against the 9th layer Profound Heaven experts around, to say nothing of the five Radiant Stage experts.
The biggest shock was the yellow eyebrow Ancestor, in the 8th layer of Radiant Stage.
Looking at so many bigshots around her, all she saw was death. Then she glanced at Zhuo Fan having the sweetest dreams imaginable and shook him, “Steward Zhuo, wake up! Wake up!”
No use. Zhuo Fan was sleeping like a baby.
“Ha-ha-ha, miss, save your energy. Only my antidote can wake him!” Ancestor Huang Mei laughed.
Yun Shuang bit her lip, growing frantic and fearful of the men around her. She knew Zhuo Fan couldn’t do a damn thing as he was, but she stuck close to him either way. The closer she was the safer she felt.
Snickering inside, the second prince put on a genial smile, “Miss Shuang’er, I’ve heard of you being a Holy Maiden. But with all of Parish’s rules and other obstacles, I’ve never had the pleasure of paying you a visit. Imagine my surprise when you came to me instead. You honor and humble me with your presence.”
“Humph, what valuable guest, you kidnapped us!” Yun Shuang scoffed.
Second prince laughed, “True, but it’s fine. All that matters is that you are in my home and that makes you a guest. And let me tell you, I do know how to treat my guests. Though there is just one small detail that has been vexing me for a long long time, something that I hope you can clarify for me.”
“What?” Yun Shuang asked.
Second prince gave a deep bow, “I’ve heard that Miss is the same as the High Priest, with eyes that can read the heavens, able to look into a person’s fate. Would it be possible to glimpse upon mine? Am I…”
Second prince was getting excited and shouted, “Fit to rule?”
“Not in your life!”
Yun Shuang was stubborn and shot him down there and then, “By Yun clan’s ancestral teachings, we have always been neutral. We look after the people, not the rulers. Peeking into the empire’s fate is taboo and against the Yun clan’s principles. I cannot help you!”
Second prince’s face fell and he snorted, “I see, ancestral teachings, is it? Why then I heard that twenty years ago, the High Priest had read Huangpu Qingtian’s fate?”
“How is that the same?”
Yun Shuang explained, “Huangpu Qingtian was a child then. His fate was full of twists and turns. He had yet to mature into someone being fit to rule. You, on the other hand, are fully grown and have fewer turning points. If you do have a dragon’s disposition, it will come to pass more often than not. And reading it will mean revealing heaven’s plan, inviting heaven’s wrath and bringing hell upon the masses!”
She shouldn’t have said that. Now the second prince’s heart was thrumming in his chest out of excitement.
When Huangpu Qingtian died, his fate as an emperor wasn’t certain and even if he had the disposition of a king, he still couldn’t overcome the tribulation called Zhuo Fan. But the second prince was different, his fate was set in stone. Once determined, it would come to pass.
Summing it up, all Holy Maiden had to do was to say that he had it in him to be an emperor and no one would stop him. He’d have a smooth sailing towards the throne!
Second prince’s delusion of grandeur grew so much that his eyes were bloodshot, “What are you waiting for then? Bask your eyes on my regal self. Tell me if I have what it takes to reach the top!”
“I told you already. I mustn’t…”
Second prince held a 5th grade spiritual sword and poked at Zhuo Fan’s throat in his lunacy, “I heard you two are close. Look already or he dies!”
“Easy, Your Highness. He is after all the one His Majesty bestowed the Best Steward Beneath Heavens title. We will also have to answer if anything happens to him.” Someone urged in the second prince’s ear.
Second prince glared and roared, “Codswallop! Once I take the throne, Best Steward Beneath Heavens isn’t worth sh*t!”
He now turned to Yun Shuang and threatened, “Look or I will kill him! Didn’t the Yun clan always come to people’s aid? Are you going to let this man suffer?”
Yun Shuang was torn. She couldn’t watch him die nor go against her ancestor’s teachings. She just couldn’t choose.
She glanced at Zhuo Fan’s dreamy face and recalled her grandfather’s warning.
Zhuo Fan was an anomaly that changed fates and she was to guide him on the straight and narrow path. Recalling Zhuo Fan’s selfless act of jumping in front of her to meet the poison, she finally made her choice.
Zhuo Fan had to survive!
“Fine, I will!” Yun Shuang nodded.
Second prince was jubilant. He took back the sword and straightened his tunic, “Then, Holy Maiden, if you please.”
Yun Shuang closed her eyes and the next time she opened them they turned into a sucking abyss. Just that in that endless darkness faint glimmers shone, like stars.
After a while, she regained her normal sight and sighed.
“What is it, Holy Maiden, am I…” Second prince couldn’t control himself with joy.
Yun Shuang nodded with a relaxed smile, “How fortunate, you are not fit to rule. I didn’t go against my ancestors. Oh, such a blessing!”
Boom!
Second prince’s mind exploded. His face twitched as he babbled, “H-Holy Maiden, aren’t you mistaken? Do it again!”
“Grandfather has taught me since I was a child. There’s no mistake.” Yun Shuang stated, “You are unfit for the throne. Don’t waste your breath. But I will tell you this, my kindness to you. The path you tread is fraught with danger, towards eternal doom. Turn back and you may live a life of peace. If you don’t…”
“You damn liar! You dare to deceive me? I’ll kill you!”
With a roar, the second prince denied this wretched fate with all his being and even lost his mind. Holding out his sword again, he slashed at Yun Shuang.
Yun Shuang shrieked and curled.
The sword failed to cut even a hair from her head as it clanged in the vise of a dragon claw.
What came next was the cackle of a demon, “Ha-ha-ha, you fool, even if you were fit to rule, the instant you grabbed me your fate was doomed…”

chapters.title: Chapter 372, Leveling the Prince’s Home
chapters.content:
Chapter 372, Leveling the Prince’s Home
Translator: StarReader
Clang!
With a sharp and faint sound, the second prince’s prized 5th grade spiritual sword snapped in two in that dragon claw’s grip, to everyone’s horror.
Zhuo Fan stood proud and tall before Yun Shuang, roaming his cold gaze on the guards and stopping on the second prince with a snicker, “He-he-he, simply because of a declined invite you decided to kidnap me? I gotta hand it to you, that takes guts!”
“Z-Z-Z-Zhuo Fan!” Second prince babbled, staggering back in fright. Yun Shuang burst in joy at the high and mighty figure, “Steward Zhuo, are you alright?”
“Ha-ha-ha, never been better. Like I said, stick with me and you’ll be going places! Only I can push others around. The others won’t ever get the chance. Stick with me and no one will touch you!”
Zhuo Fan gave a thumbs up and a grin, going back to showing off his swag. Yun Shuang giggled and blushed. His ‘jokes’ worked wonders in easing her worries.
Ancestor Huang Mei cried in disbelief, “How?! Only I can wake you from my Thousand Years Dream!”
“If there’s one thing I don’t care about, that’s poison. Be it narcotic, or necrotic, they got nothing on me. I am where I am because neither Regent Estate nor the likes of those seven houses, Pill King Hall included, could cope with me. So what could a rookie like you do? I only faked being asleep, curious as to who had the nerve to pull something like this.”
Squinting, Zhuo Fan kept on mocking, his hand swirling with black energy as he turned to the second prince, “Lo and behold, it was this dumbass! Something’s still bugging me though, how in god’s name did the wise and shrewd Majesty end up with this gung ho fool of a son? Even Miss Shuang’er’s reading proves you are the farthest thing from a ruler. Does that make you… not a prince?!”
Pff!
Yun Shuang giggled and punched her cute fist on Zhuo Fan’s chest, then rolled her eyes. Second prince’s shock had now turned into full blown rage, his breathing ragged as he glared at Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan had spat the bastard right in his face. And the all-important prince had only one logical reaction to this, to snap at this naked humiliation.
“Ancestor Huang Mei, what are you standing around for? Get that miscreant!” Second prince roared and pointed at Zhuo Fan.
Ancestor Huang Mei had had enough as well and shot yellow smoke for Zhuo Fan, “You little scamp, do you think everyone is beneath you? Have a taste of my power, Thousand Years Dream!”
Yun Shuang ducked behind Zhuo Fan, who only smirked in disdain as the black energy covered them.
Hu~
The yellow smoke wrapped around the two in seconds. Ancestor Huang Mei stuck his head out in pride at the second prince.
But an explosion cut his chance at boasting. The yellow smoke went for a spin, and as it did it only got thinner to reveal the black mass in the center.
[Demon Transformation Art!]
Zhuo Fan called the blackness back inside, his eyes looking icier by the second.
“W-what happened to my Thousand Years Dream?” Ancestor Huang Mei stammered.
Zhuo Fan looked at him with a cold stare, his voice dripping with malice, “Ate it.”
Ancestor Huang Mei was sweating buckets. Zhuo Fan was more of a monster than the rumors had him pegged. He had shrugged the narcotic off like it was nothing.
The Ancestor knew Zhuo Fan was a body cultivator, his greatest weapon were his own two fists. Now that the narcotic was a bust, a poison user like him was a sitting duck, fated to die at the crazed Zhuo Fan.
That being the case, his best and only choice of action would be to run like hell. Ancestor Huang Mei gave a quick salute to the second prince and said without the slightest hesitation, “Your Highness, may fate allow us to meet again, fare the well. Oh, and don’t forget, Your Highness still owes me 12 pills~.”
Ancestor Huang Mei flicked his sleeve and ran like the yellow wind he was.
Second prince stomped in anger. [This old coot can’t do a damn thing and still expects me to pay?]
[I hate his type the most!]
He didn’t get to curse though as the yellow wind slammed back into the yard, hard.
Ancestor Huang Mei was sprawled on the ground, blood leaking from his mouth. Next to him was Zhuo Fan’s cold face, his red flashing right hand clutching the old man’s neck.
“Humph, you mess with me and now you want to run? You think you can just get away with it?” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone with savagery.
Ancestor Huang Mei cried, “Steward Zhuo, spare me! Second prince made me…”
Pa!
A resounding cuff over the old guy’s face cut his whining short. Zhuo Fan snickered, “We both know I’m no fool, so stop stating the obvious. While he is the culprit, you are his lackey. In both cases, no one’s leaving this place alive!”
Sss~
Gasping, Ancestor Huang Mei was overwhelmed by Zhuo Fan’s capacity for cruelty, going so far as to kill any who wronged him.
If he had known, he’d never have accepted the job even for 20 pills!
As the black energy oozed out from Zhuo Fan and he noticed the naked bloodthirst in his eyes, Ancestor Huang Mei turned white as paper, including his eyebrows, as he begged, “Wait, Steward Zhuo, don’t kill me! Let me go and I’ll do anything. Isn’t your Luo clan newly promoted? You must be short on men. I am an 8th layer Radiant Stage expert, I can stand on your side, pledge my life to you!”
The black energy hovered for a second while Zhuo Fan was weighing the proposition. Ancestor Huang Mei’s eyes lit up and he grasped at straws.
Too late though, as Zhuo Fan shook his head and the black energy shot forth, “Sorry, we already have a poisoner, the Alchemy House’s elder, Vicious Pill King. We don’t need you.”
“Him? He’s just a Profound Heaven cultivator, while I’m in the Radiant Stage!” Ancestor Huang Mei cried.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Ha-ha-ha, I’ve hand-picked every elder of the Luo clan myself. None of them will balk in the face of death. This is where you fall short.”
Zhuo Fan punctuated by having the black energy cover swallow Ancestor Huang Mei whole. Funny how he did the same thing Ancestor Huang Mei had done to him.
The stark contrast was that the black energy was far deadlier.
Everyone had a front row seat to Ancestor Huang Mei’s miracle diet. He was thinning under the naked eye. Swallowed by the black mass, his face twisted every second. The diet only came to an end when his very being was reduced to absolutely nothing.
Second prince crumbled to the ground in horror. His Radiant Stage men were all shaking as well. Holding their lord as they made a slow crawl backwards.
Zhuo Fan was only in the third layer of Profound Heaven yet to everyone present he was nothing short of Tianyu’s number one expert, a freak. With how even Ancestor Huang Mei was dust in the wind, how could they fare any better?
Yun Shuang pursed her lips, watching the cold stone-killer with fear.
It was a first for her, to watch a man die through such means.
Grandfather had told her that he was the vilest person to walk this earth, and she was there to set him straight. But they were chatting and laughing just a little while ago. He even jumped to her defense in her dire need. He looked nothing like an evil spawn.
Only now did she come face to face with Zhuo Fan’s cruel and insidious nature.
Clap~
Zhuo Fan showed an evil grin seeing the empty space in front of him, then turned to the pretty boy and his gang.
Shaking like a leaf, the second prince turned guileless, acting like a bad boy who had gotten caught and huddling with his guards while waiting for punishment.
“S-S-Steward Zhuo, I know my mistake. I won’t do it again, honest. Please let me go, just this once?” Second prince’s voice quivered.
Zhuo Fan got before him and snickered, “Next time? If there ever will be a next time, that old fart’s death will look like a joy ride compared to yours! Got that?”
“Y-y-yeah.” Second prince’s teeth clattered as he bobbed his head. The guards kept mum, despite the clear humiliation their lord was facing.
What else could they do? They could fight the monster to their last breath, but would it do any good?
[Who’d be dumb enough to mess with this savage that not even the seven houses dare to?]
[Oh, right, the second prince is one…]
They all were wailing inside, though neither criticized their lord out loud.
Zhuo Fan saw him rooted in place and patted his cheek, warningly, “For your pretty boy face, I’ll leave it at that…”
Second prince eased his breath.
But Zhuo Fan kept on talking’, “Though I won’t go easy on you either. Leaving you with a little homework will do good for your character.”
Zhuo Fan’s right hand flashed red and he smashed the ground.
The savage’s fist leveled prince’s home…

chapters.title: Chapter 373, The Worst Evil
chapters.content:
Chapter 373, The Worst Evil
Translator: StarReader
Hum~
A red wave shot out from the point of impact. The sudden explosion blew the entire area it covered, pulverizing anything within a hundred miles and sending the sand sky high.
Second prince’s group was too out of it to notice the floating sand that had buried them the next second. All that they knew was gone in a wink.
That included the eighty-mile-wide residence of the second prince as well as the surrounding buildings.
In the aftermath of Zhuo Fan’s fist, the entire imperial capital shook, reaching the brink of collapse.
In the Imperial Palace’s gardens, the emperor was having another round of chess with Sima Hui. Only this time, the emperor wasn’t as peaceful. With all the players coming to the imperial capital, it had gotten even the emperor to worry.
A large earthquake happened and flipped the chessboard. The emperor shouted, “What is it now?”
“Your Majesty, we only know that it came from the second prince’s manor!” A guard reported.
The emperor was glum and snapped, “What has the old second done this time? Go find out!”
“Right away!” The guard rushed away.
Sima Hui paused then cupped his hands, “Your Majesty, that wasn’t just a small commotion. May I go check on the second prince? I fear for the worse.”
The emperor waved him off with a sigh.
Sima Hui bowed and shot to the skies.
At the Prime Minister’s residence, a man in black was whispering in Zhuge Changfeng’s ear. But the sudden rumbling broke all the pottery. Zhuge Changfeng stared for a moment, then mocked, “Humph, the young sure are bold. That little monster isn’t easy to handle, even for me. Yet that lamebrain kid went and provoked him? Ha-ha-ha, that’s a calf for you, ignorant and foolish. This lesson I reckon ought to be a cruel one.”
Zhuge Changfeng closed his eyes and a faint smile appeared.
Meanwhile, at Hell Valley’s residence in the imperial capital, You Wanshan and his elders were in a small room when the earth wobbled under their feet, though it never broke their calm.
“He finally acted… and got crushed at last…” You Wanshan sighed.
They knew since long ago that the second prince wanted Zhuo Fan on his side. They weren’t the second prince’s first allied house for nothing. They even gave a stern reminder to that halfwit. Zhuo Fan was one tough customer.
But they figured, did this obstinate twerp know good advice when he heard one? It would only work to incite him. So, these wise foggies shut the door in his face instead of being under the same heel of that savage as the second prince was right now.
Zhuo Fan’s action was loud and clear for everyone.
You Wanshan turned to You Ming, “This kid is too rash. Is cooperation still viable?”
“We have no choice, not when all eyes are on Regent Estate. The fodder is always the first to fall and that is what we will become if we stick too close to it. Of all the princes, the eldest prince is too shrewd to side with and the third prince sloppy. Leaving the second prince as the only viable pawn with some use. The choice was made for us!” You Ming sighed, “We are at the crossroads.”
Hell Valley’s posse sighed as well, [How could we be so foolish to end up like this…]
The other players also noticed the obvious flagrant disturbance.
Fatty and Princess Yongning were gunning for the second prince’s home when the earthquake struck, followed by a wave of sand. It pressed so heavy on them, they found it hard to even breathe.
Once the sand settled, Princess Yongning blew it away with a gale, “Imperial capital is a picturesque landscape. Where did all this sand come from?”
“I bet that brat had something to do with it.” Paling, fatty wiped his brow as he sped up while muttering, “I hope we’re not too late. They say the kid is hellbent on toying with others. Hope he hasn’t made his move yet.”
Princess Yongning asked, “Third brother, did you say something?”
“If we are too late, we’ll be seeing the second brother’s corpse. No, there might not even be a corpse left. For god’s sake, what is wrong with the second brother to keep harassing that guy?” Fatty facepalmed.
Princess Yongning was clueless, “Eh? Aren’t we going to save Zhuo Fan and Yun Shuang? Why is the second brother the one in danger?”
“Humph, that freak never needed our help from the beginning. You think the second brother’s thugs can hold him? Who knows what state the second brother will be in after Zhuo Fan’s done with him. I sure hope there’s still a breath left in there somewhere.”
The fatty shook his head and Yongning looked more than a bit puzzled, “You mean to tell me that Zhuo Fan is so amazing that even as a victim, he is the one wrecking second brother’s home? And that he’d go as far as to kill a prince?”
“Oh, Yongning, these matters are beyond what your pretty little head can comprehend. The world is filled with evil. But Zhuo Fan takes the cake, the worst evil of all. It’s fine if you don’t step on his toes, but once you do, god help you. There is no low he won’t stoop to!”
The fatty sighed, “Do you know the Regent Estate’s eldest young master? Do you know what a hero he was? Well, even he didn’t get away, ending up being bitten to death by Zhuo Fan. From then on, the saying ‘you can mess with the King of Hell but never with Zhuo Fan’ spread everywhere.”
Yongning blinked her purty eyes. Yet no matter how gruesome a picture fatty painted, it only worked to incite her to figure Zhuo Fan out.
[I wonder, just who is this worst evil to make the whole world, even princes and Regent Estate, fear him?]
Her step quickened, to save second brother, sure, but more so to see with her own eyes the oddity called Zhuo Fan.
The streets flashed by and the duo arrived in no time at the scene of the crime. But the scenery had them speechless.
The grand second prince’s mansion was nowhere to be found, replaced by sand and more sand.
All the people stared around dumbfounded at the desert in the heart of the flourishing imperial capital.
Two people were noticed in the vast sea of sand, Zhuo Fan and Yun Shuang. The girl was even standing on a tile, as if to not mar her beauty.
Nevertheless, the sudden change in scenery even had Yun Shuang slack jawed.
It finally dawned on her. Steward Zhuo was not just evil, but a calamity. One whose very existence was to torment others!
Yun Shuang’s eyes flashed with resolve as she stared at him.
Ugh~
Groans came from the guards as their heads popped out of the sand. They paled at the world of sand around them and shouted, “His Highness! Where is His Highness?”
Zhuo Fan’s first order of business was his trademark evil smile and then strolling before a flat portion of sand. He shoved his hand in and pulled. His harvest, a pale human being.
And not just any human, but the second prince himself, Yuwen Yong.
Just that the guy was in torn clothes and a retarded look painted on his face. Without the cocky attitude, he looked more like a refugee, shivering all over.
“Second prince!” The guards shouted, but stopped the instant they saw Zhuo Fan’s cold gaze.
Zhuo Fan smiled and shook the prince like a rag, “You want the throne, right? Hi-hi-hi, what a wonderful dream. See how I’ll peel the respect off of you, flogging you on the streets of the imperial capital, and subjecting you to all humiliations imaginable. Such a prince can never get the throne, since he has no respect to speak of, unless… he’s the only successor…”
Zhuo Fan squinted, as if he was teaching. Second prince was shaking like a leaf, his head too, “N-no, I beg you, please don’t do this to me. Or I can never remain a prince…”
“Brother, please do me a solid and leave the second brother be.”
A simple laughter echoed. Zhuo Fan knew who he was, pinpointing the incoming wobbling ball of lard, “Ha-ha-ha, fatty, you sure are a worthy brother! I’m sure you know of my temper by now, yet this second brother of yours had the balls to kidnap me!”
Zhuo Fan finished with two resounding slaps on the second prince’s face, so strong that he spat two teeth and blood. Then he resumed in his standard evil tone, “I merely want to tie him up and parade him in the streets. Besides, I’m only trying to help. Who knows what idiotic and retarded idea some other miscreant will come up with next to use against me. I am not a patient man and don’t feel like dealing with each one of them.”
Fatty nodded, “Brother Zhuo, I see. The world is crawling with ignorant and reckless people, but he is my second brother. Please let him go. You already made an example of him, right? Ha-ha-ha…”
“Yeah, you turned the second brother into looking like this, and leveled his house. Isn’t that enough revenge?” Princess Yongning pouted, glaring at Zhuo Fan yet she couldn’t put her heart in it.
She was even partial to Zhuo Fan. By speaking of ‘revenge’ she was justifying Zhuo Fan’s actions.
The fatty twitched and rolled his eyes.
He knew Yongning didn’t mean it, but still felt forlorn. [He is your second brother while you’ve only seen Zhuo Fan in passing a few times. What are you doing giving an outsider an excuse to trash your family?]
[Have you finally got your eyes on someone?]

chapters.title: Chapter 374, Fated Marriage
chapters.content:
Chapter 374, Fated Marriage
Translator: StarReader
Looking at the fatty and Yongning, Zhuo Fan laughed, “Alright, I guess I can spare the kid, for your sake. But get this straight, you two owe me one, each. And sooner or later, you’re going to pony up!”
“Uh, brother, we only have one second brother. Let him go and we will owe you a favor of course, but what are you doing asking one from each of us?” The fatty’s face darkened.
Zhuo Fan’s eyebrow rose as he chuckled, “It’s not my fault that both of you asked me to let him go. That makes it two favors. When the time comes and I need you, you better own up!”
[Damn grubber!]
That was the unanimous thought on everyone’s mind. But the more they looked at the second prince hanging by a thread in Zhuo Fan’s claw, the more they had to nod.
Zhuo Fan laughed and threw away his pawn. He went to Yun Shuang and said to fatty, “Let’s stop here. When I need something, I’ll be sure to drop by. See ya!”
And left with Yun Shuang.
Princess Yongning rushed to hold Yun Shuang back, “I and Shuang’er are practically sisters and wish to get together after not having seen each other for ages. I mean, Shuang’er must be shaking from that terrible fright and as her sister, it is my duty to look after her. Third brother, you go on without me.”
“Yongning, I am not really…” Yun Shuang explained, but Yongning shot him a look.
Zhuo Fan snickered, “Princess Yongning, Shuang’er is a Profound Heaven expert, while you are far below her. Why would she need you?”
“Humph, how about this then? When a girl suffers a devastating trauma, it is irrelevant to one’s cultivation. What do you men know?” Yongning’s eyebrows kept moving as he taunted Zhuo Fan.
Fatty frowned, “Yongning, that’s enough. You think I can’t tell what you’re up to? You’re trying to get out of being grounded. Even if you do go with Miss Yun Shuang to Parish, imperial father will have someone drag you back.”
“Oh, fatty, you’re mistaken about something. Miss Yun Shuang is coming to Prosperity Compound, to be with the Luo clan and not returning to Parish.”
[What?!]
The two jerked in shock, then looked at Yun Shuang.
She was the Holy Maiden of Parish, the next in line to be its Clan Head. [Then why did the High Priest send her off to someone else?]
Yun Shuang’s eyes reddened and she nodded, “Grandfather had me become Steward Zhuo’s attendant and tend to his needs…”
[Nani? Needs?!] (StarReader: nani is the literal translation here. Loanword from Japanese, meaning what. Guess author tried making a funny.)
Fatty’s eyes burned with a fire not even the second brother’s plight could stir, “Zhuo Fan, you vile beast. I used to think you were only 90% evil, but now I see that you’re capable of stooping so low as to even force yourself on innocent maidens! Talk, how did you blackmail the High Priest into making such a humiliating decision?”
Princess Yongning glared at Zhuo Fan and stopped in front of Yun Shuang, whispering, “Shuang’er, don’t worry. I won’t let this vile demon lay his claws on you.”
Zhuo Fan glanced at the two and shrugged.
Yun Shuang was waving all over the place, beet red, “You’ve got it all wrong. It’s not like that at all. Grandfather found Steward Zhuo too evil and wanted me to guide him. That’s why…”
“Oh, I see!”
The two royalties saw the light at long last. Fatty only gave Zhuo Fan a long look and sighed, “Miss Yun Shuang, your clan strives for the betterment of the people, which I admire, but I must stress one important fact. This person, or whatever you want to call him, doesn’t have just evil proclivities, but is pure undiluted evil, a demon. A wretched, revolting, vile spawn that even hell spat…”
“Hey, hey, wasn’t I only 90% evil? How did I become pure evil? I haven’t forced a lady in my entire life, now have I?” Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes.
Fatty mocked, “What does that count? With your infamy, such an act is second nature to you.”
“You’ve got a point there.” Zhuo Fan nodded pensively.
Pff!
The girls giggled next to Zhuo Fan. When Zhuo Fan didn’t flip out, he was quite a nice-ish human being. He didn’t bother with the details, nor was pedantic. Quite refreshing compared to some gentlemen.
One would go as far as to say that he was leagues above those self-righteous officials.
That, of course, applied to his time off of killing and unleashing mayhem…
“In any case, changing him is like moving mountains. Not getting corrupted yourself along the way is already a miracle!” The fatty sighed, “Luo clan’s young miss used to be so kind and polite. But now I hear she’s been broken in, shrewd and cunning!”
“All the more reason I should stay with Shuang’er, to not let her be led astray!” Yongning found a good excuse for once.
Fatty shook his head, “Do what you will. But don’t think I’ll take the blame when the imperial father hears about this.”
Yongning giggled and hugged Shuang’er close. Even kissed her.
Zhuo Fan didn’t argue either, leaving with a salute to fatty. As for tubby, he had to stay behind to clean up all this mess and calm down the traumatized second prince.
But the fatty did care for his sister, not forgetting to give Zhuo Fan some stern warnings.
Zhuo Fan took her with open arms, of course. [Who knows, the apple of the emperor’s eye might hold some use yet.]
In every moment of every hour, the only thing on Zhuo Fan’s mind was the grand scheme of things. Even while trashing the second prince, he still knew when to stop, as to not yet set the imperial family against him.
But letting him off easy was out of the question as well.
Each and every word he spoke to the second prince was beautifully woven in meanings beyond mere rebukes. Second prince knew now that he was not cut out for the throne. And in his moment of despair, Zhuo Fan gave him a good nudge.
[Kill the rest and you’ll be the true successor!]
The imperial family was boiling on the inside and all he had to do was to be a patient angler. In the tripartite plan, everyone wanted out of the deadlock, but neither wanted to stick their neck out.
[That only leaves forcing them to stick out!]
The emperor uplifted the Luo clan with the same purpose in mind. And Zhuo Fan incited the second prince for the same thing.
[I’m only curious if fatty figured it all out since he stopped me from giving further ‘advice’ to the second prince. Not that it made a difference. The seed of a power play has already bloomed in the second prince’s heart.]
Glancing at the dazed second prince laying on the sand, Zhuo Fan showed a grin then walked away with the girls.
Fatty turned from Zhuo Fan to his second brother and sighed…
An hour later, Zhuo Fan arrived at the Regent of Prosperity’s Compound. All of the Luo clan was in awe after his short explanation of the facts.
Zhuo Fan was out on a stroll to Parish, yet returned with not just the great Holy Maiden, but a princess.
“Young miss, settle them in. I will be in seclusion for three days.” Zhuo Fan said to Luo Yunchang and walked out back.
Luo Yunchang nodded and took the guests to their rooms. On their way, she turned a hopeful gaze to Yun Shuang, “Miss Shuang’er, can you really read fate?”
“En.” Yun Shuang nodded, puzzled inside.
[Where is this young miss going with this? Does she also want to know if the Luo clan is fit for power?]
She couldn’t be further from the truth. Luo Yunchang blushed as she said, “Uhm, miss Shuang’er, could you perhaps look into my fated marriage? “
“Ah?”
Yun Shuang was stumped, then sighed. [A girl’s heart sure isn’t like a man’s.] She smiled, “Of course.”
Luo Yunchang laughed, “Please tell me when my wedding will come.”
Yun Shuang nodded and her eyes turned into sucking abysses. Once she returned from her reading, “Odd, your wedding should’ve long passed. It’s not necessarily bad, but I find that it was broken at some point in time. Maybe…”
Her eyes shone for a second, then she shook her head, “Forgive me, but I cannot see your wedding.”
“Why?” Luo Yunchang cried.
Yun Shuang sighed, “Because of Steward Zhuo. Your wedding should’ve been eight years ago. But Steward Zhuo, who is outside fate, changed it, changed your fated marriage. This drove your current fate into chaos and I can no longer see it.”
“You mean… he broke my fated wedding. That makes him responsible, right?” Luo Yunchang’s eyes shined in glee.
Yun Shuang was startled, then nodded, “Ostensibly… he is of some fault.”
“Great! Thanks, Miss Yun Shuang!” Luo Yunchang had never been happier.
Yun Shuang was clueless. Yongning at the side, shook her head and said, “Shuang’er, what about mine?”
Meanwhile, in a dark, damp cell, a grizzled and bloody old man was nailed to a pole. His shoulder blades had been run through, he was robbed of his cultivation, and was on his last breath.
He was the Parish’s High Priest, Yun Xuanji.
He was surrounded by shadows.
“High Priest, you crossed the line!”
An aged and familiar voice came from behind the veil. The High Priest gave a weak laugh, “Yun clan has always strived for the people. We’ve never crossed it, unlike… you.”
“Did you talk about it to anyone, including Zhuo Fan?” The voice turned cold.
The High Priest shook his head, “That matter is too dangerous and can’t be spread. I will never harm the common man!”
“Well done!”
Whoosh!
A chain flew from behind the veil and into the High Priest’s heart. The High Priest shuddered and his head slumped.
“Ha-ha-ha, since he didn’t talk, the game is still on…”
The cold and sinister laugh came again…

chapters.title: Chapter 375, Ill Tidings
chapters.content:
Chapter 375, Ill Tidings
Translator: StarReader
In a hundred-square-meter stone room, Zhuo Fan nodded after looking around.
Although not as huge as the second prince’s compound, the Regent of Prosperity’s Compound had everything. [Not a bad cultivating room.] He set up a body refinement array on the floor and took out the Abyss Phantom Butterfly’s wings.
Instead of turning it into a flying demonic treasure, he had gotten so used to having wings that Zhuo Fan found it a better choice to have them stick on his back.
Tracing his hand over the twenty-meter-long blue wings, Zhuo Fan sighed and grinned. He was mighty pleased when the Crown Prince came bearing this gift.
Staring at the dazzling light show from below and feeling the coolness from the array, Zhuo Fan’s hand moved through the gestures.
Along with a flash of lightning, the wings slowly melted into the array. Zhuo Fan trembled.
Having since refined the Qilin leg, doing the same with a mere 7th level spiritual beast’s wings was a cinch. Even the shattering of his bones got no reaction out of him.
Zhuo Fan sat in the array for three days, with eyes closed uncaring for the outside matters. All this time the array worked its magic in reconstructing his body in every which way, but it always returned to his original form in the end.
Zhuo Fan opened his eyes and stood up. His back writhed and spectral wings unfolded, releasing a charming and enrapturing aura.
With a flap, a gale took the room by the storm. It was then that the shades of blue shone all over and wrapped around Zhuo Fan.
As if he was walking among blue sunshine.
Zhuo Fan knew his body best. If there was any expert near him, the glow would’ve sent him to dreamland.
[It all depends on one’s soul strength, but the least it can do is buy me a moment.]
Thus, this 3rd layer Profound Heaven Stage cultivator with his new 7th level spiritual beast wings, not only had his speed bolstered but that blue glow around him made for a natural defense. It was a neat trick good in offense and defense, independent of his actions.
Zhuo Fan laughed in pride. With a twitch of his brows, the wings withdrew and he walked outside.
His mood soured though, when his right eye stung. With a hum, a blue glare shot from his eye and three golden halos flashed within it.
Divine Eye of the Void, 3rd stage!
Zhuo Fan was stunned and then laughed again.
By sheer luck, his refining actually upgraded his Divine Eye of the Void!
When he thought about the 3rd stage’s skill, he knew why. It was because of resonance, taking a different path towards the same goal.
It would’ve taken him far longer otherwise.
But since he got it already, he wasn’t about to look a gift horse in the mouth. He got stronger, didn’t he? He could finally put up a fight against an Ethereal Stage expert.
That had his blood boiling, briskly walking outside. He was on the lookout for a good sparring partner to test the 3rd stage on.
Rumbling!
He creaked the stone door open and the glaring sun’s rays along with the fresh air lightened his mood.
“Now, who’ll fight me?” Zhuo Fan roared.
Before he got to play hide and seek with Li Jingtian and his other elders, graceful curves approached, nudging him to be quiet, “Steward Zhuo, all evil begins with violence. Please exercise restraint.”
Zhuo Fan was stunned. He turned around to see Yun Shuang there.
“Uhm, excessive is all I know. And how did you know I was coming out of seclusion?” Zhuo Fan frowned, “Did your eyes reveal it to you?”
“Be that as it may, they can’t see you. I’ve been waiting here all this time for you to come out.” With a smile, Yun Shuang struck the image of a fairy as she handed him a towel, “Here, freshen up after your toil, and let it brighten your day!”
“Uh, thank… Hold up, what are you up to?” Zhuo Fan came to mid-wipe.
Yun Shuang’s sweet smile came along with her genial tone, “I am your attendant. It’s in my job description. And I do need to guide you towards good. To do that I will have to keep you happy all day, every day. Lest emotions run amok and you’ll turn evil again. I also got you this…”
Yun Shuang took out a booklet. Zhuo Fan read the title, Three Character Classic!(StarReader: a text written in the 13th century to help kids learn the language. Made up of three character verses, easy to read and learn i.e. kiddie stuff.)
“It’s for children…” Zhuo Fan blinked at Yun Shuang in daze.
Yun Shuang nodded with a smile, ” People at birth are naturally good. It’ll do good for your spirit. Try it!”
“I won’t read a god damned word! I’ve roamed the world for too many years to have any use for a bint’s teachings!”
Zhuo Fan slammed the book on the pavement and shoved his finger in her face, “Miss Shuang’er, I didn’t ask you to be a servant, nor a tutor to right my wrong ways. I only need you to read the heavens and tell me the future. All you have to do is tell me what the other players are doing and I can take it from there in figuring out their plans. With your eyes and my smarts, we will have control over everything. That’s your role!”
Yun Shuang gave him a long look. Her smile deflated and she picked up the book in sadness.
Zhuo Fan shrugged and asked like nothing happened, “Now, what have the factions been up to these days?”
“I didn’t look!”
Yun Shuang pouted, then stomped away, “To save the people, you must have a righteous heart. Until you’re re-educated, I won’t even peek!”
“You…”
Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth and spat, “Then what are you still doing here if you aren’t looking? I’m taking you back. We’re going to Yun Xuanji and having him look!”
Zhuo Fan pulled her outside. Yun Shuang was so distressed, tears welled up in her eyes. Dragged around, her feet left deep marks in the ground.
Luo Yunchang and the princess were chatting merrily when they saw them whiz by and caught up in distress.
“What’s going on?”
Luo Yunchang only had to see Shuang’er in tears to know. Zhuo Fan must’ve shown his evil side again.
Zhuo Fan did the same thing back then, at the foot of Blackwind Mountain. Though these crass and harsh outbursts had tended to die down over the years of spending time around his clansmen.
While to outsiders, he had no restraint whatsoever, the vilest of the vile.
Yun Shuang hadn’t been around him long enough to see this side. Anyone who’d witnessed one of his rage episodes would be just as frightened.
Shielding Shuang’er, Luo Yunchang glared at Zhuo Fan, “Steward Zhuo, what did Shuang’er do for you to scare her like this?”
“Yeah, Shuang’er is so kind, doing everything you ask of her. You must be at fault here to pick on our Shuang’er.” Princess Yongning puffed out her chest, hugging Yun Shuang close, “Apologize this instant, or I’m telling imperial father!”
Zhuo Fan looked at the three of them and sighed.
[It hasn’t been that long and these girls are already a clique?]
Shaking his head, Zhuo Fan took a long breath to cool his jets, “Princess Yongning, are you going to His Majesty to get me punished? Tell me then, has the second prince’s matter settled?”
“Of course. But that is all because of the third brother asking you to take it as the second brother’s fault. The Imperial father wouldn’t have wasted words with you and would’ve had you!” The princess looked mighty pleased.
Zhuo Fan snickered inside.
[Fatty’s request was only to save the emperor’s hide.]
In the current state of things, where all factions were at a stalemate, if the imperial family moved against the Luo clan, Regent Estate would be celebrating.
It was waiting for the Luo clan and the imperial family to fight so it could deal with them both in one fell swoop. The imperial family wasn’t about to blow all pretense for a mere second prince only to suffer in the end.
Zhuo Fan was sure of it. Only this ignorant princess was still delusional, thinking that the emperor was the number one in the world.
Zhuo Fan turned to Yun Shuang, having vented his earlier rage, turned serious, “Miss Shuang’er, when your grandfather put you in my care, he said many things. But one thing he did stress, that you are useful. If you can’t help me, what reason do I have for keeping you? Our clan doesn’t need two bickering matrons.”
Luo Yunchang’s eyes went red and she glared at him, yet positively giddy inside.
The bickering matron he was referring to just now had to be her.
Whether unintended by the speaker, or by the listener’s delusions, for Zhuo Fan, who was the steward, to say matron, she took it as if it was more than that.(StarReader: it’s a pun. 管家 is steward and 管家婆 lit. means steward’s wife, but also busybody, housekeeper.)
When Luo Yunchang looked at Zhuo Fan, her gaze drifted and her heart fluttered.
Zhuo Fan, though, only had eyes for Yun Shuang, waiting for an answer.
Yun Shuang broke out of the princess’s and Luo Yunchang’s hug, then stormed out of the door. Zhuo Fan sighed.
[This works out just as well]. With Yun clan neutral, he didn’t fear that Holy Maiden would end up in another faction…
Yun Shuang opened the door and bumped into an eight-year-old child, throwing him to the ground.
Yun Shuang cried, “Xiao Dongzi, what are you doing here?”
“Sister Shuang’er!” Xiao Dongzi sobbed, “Grandfather is… is dead…”
[What?!]
Yun Shuang seized and paled. The calm Zhuo Fan also froze and then an incredulous look appeared on his face.
[Someone killed Four Pillars’ High Priest, Demigod Yun Xuanji?]
[Who dares commit such an outrageous crime in the heart of the empire…]

chapters.title: Chapter 376, Sealed Capital
chapters.content:
Chapter 376, Sealed Capital
Translator: StarReader
Yun Shuang refused to believe it. She was stiff for a minute and then bolted for Parish.
“Call the elders! We’re going as well!” Zhuo Fan shouted.
Luo Yunchang nodded and called them. Li Jingtian and the power couple arrived. They were around the young miss and princess, protecting them as they went along to Parish.
At the parish, Xiao Dongzi took them to where Yun Xuanji received guests.
But what they saw inside had everyone stunned.
Yun Xuanji was still in his seat, but covered in blood. He was clearly more than a little roughed up. His eyes gouged and his head slumped.
“Grandfather!”
Yun Shuang held the body and cried. Luo Yunchang and the princess were taken in by sadness, going to her to soothe her pain.
Having lost her father as well, Luo Yunchang could relate with Shuang’er’s pain. Her eyes grew red and tears soon fell.
Zhuo Fan watched it all with a critical eye, turning to Li Jingtian, “What do you guys make of this?”
“The Yun clan has stood for a thousand years in Tianyu. Always neutral and respected. Not to mention it is the third pillar. Just who could’ve done this at such a crucial time?” Li Jingtian frowned.
Qiu Yanhai nodded as well, “He’s been reduced to such a state yet everything around him lies undisturbed and clean. That means he was brought here dead. Moreover, were his eyes scooped up because of their ability to see fate?”
“If it were just for the eyes, Yun clan would’ve long since been kidnapped in the past thousand years. The death of Yun Xuanji is for a different reason. And since he died, the killer took his eyes while he was at it to do a little research.”
Gasping, Zhuo Fan spoke with calm, but his mind replayed his encounter with Yun Xuanji. He found Yun Xuanji’s tone odd at the time.
The way he gave his granddaughter away, felt less like gaining a helper rather than fulfilling the old man’s will. [Did he see his end coming?]
Zhuo Fan squinted as his thoughts wandered…
Luo Yunchang said, “You’re all experts. After all this talking, have you found who killed Shuang’er’s grandfather or not?”
Yun Shuang’s sobbing stopped and her ears sharpened. Princess looked interested as well.
“The imperial capital is in troubled waters right now. Who knows who did it?”
Zhuo Fan shrugged, “What matters now is finding a safe place for the Yun clan. Now I know why Yun Xuanji gave me Shuang’er. It was his final wish, having foreseen his own death…”
“It’s all my fault. With grandfather always doing the reading, I never tried doing it on him. If only I’d been more aware…” Yun Shuang’s tears resumed from pain.
The two girls rushed to console her. Zhuo Fan smiled, “Don’t blame yourself. Your grandfather did it with this in mind. For his principles, the High Priest knew he was at his end and chose to go like this. I truly admire his resolve and righteousness. To honor him, I will not only look after you, but your clan as well. Young miss, what do you say?”
“Of course!” Luo Yunchang nodded with resolve.
Yun Shuang wiped her tears, moved by her new sister’s kindness. Then she said to Zhuo Fan, “Forgive me, Steward Zhuo. I always took you for a demon, but you aren’t even a bad man. Thank you…”
“It’s fine. I’m quite the baddie sometimes, you know. Ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan had a vague smile, “With the imperial capital in unrest and the Yun clan without a leader, it will become the pawn of every player in pursuit for power. I propose that we move the Yun clan to Blackwind Mountain. There, they will be safe. What do you think?”
“It’s great, but… Yun clan has thousands of people. Moving them all will require His Majesty’s approval!” Yun Shuang muttered.
Zhuo Fan gave an evil grin, “Fret not. Have you forgotten who I am? I am the Best Steward Beneath Heavens! Leave it to me.”
He handed Li Jingtian the cape that the emperor gave him, “Elder Li, take this and leave with the Yun clan as quickly as possible. You three will look after them. Once outside the imperial capital, send someone to report what has happened to the Imperial Palace.”
“Understood!”
Li Jingtian nodded and bowed. But used silent transmission when he noticed Zhuo Fan’s look, “Steward Zhuo, when did you become a saint? It’s not your style. Or did you suddenly take a liking to that miss?”
“Stuff it! I’m not that dirty-minded!”
Snorting, Zhuo Fan sent back, “Ignore what happens around you and you’ll soon be knee deep in trouble. Every generation of the Yun clan has had a person that can read fate. With them in dire straits, it is the best chance to use them. You can’t even see something that obvious?”
Li Jingtian got it at last and gave Zhuo Fan a sneaky thumbs up, “Steward Zhuo, you’re stupendous! You’re reaping rewards from the hard work of others…”
“Cut the crapola. They’re here to take the heat, while we reap the fields. If the mastermind knew all his effort was in our favor, he’d probably have blown a gasket, or two, he-he-he…” Zhuo Fan snickered.
Li Jingtian said, “Steward Zhuo, then you know who…”
“Can’t say. But this game… sure is fun.” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone.
Li Jingtian nodded and obeyed. With Yun Shuang as the Clan Head successor, she was most important. With her explanation, Yun clan accepted the transition, now marching for the Luo clan’s domain.
At the city gates, the guards were about to stop the mass of people, but Li Jingtian unfolded the Best Steward Beneath Heavens cape, shutting them up.
Everyone knew by now that the Luo clan had Zhuo Fan as the Best Steward Beneath Heavens, who was of immense power. He moved the armies and governed the nation’s affairs. A man such as him was not to be stepped on by a bunch of guards.
Hence, under the three elders’ escort, Yun clan left the imperial capital. Ten miles out, they had someone report to the emperor.
“High Priest is dead?!”
The emperor slapped the armrest of his throne, then slumped in it as tears flowed, “High Priest, you’ve helped me and the people so much. How… Now that you left, who will help me? Who will show me the way… “
“Your Majesty, please restrain your grief. The death of the High Priest affects the entire nation. I vow to find the killer and bring him to justice!” Dugu Zhantian cupped his hands.
He was in pain just as well. The High Priest was the one to recommend him to the emperor. But in a time like this, he still kept the attitude of an upright marshal.
Sima Hui advised, “Your Majesty, Marshal Dugu is right. We need to find the culprit. For the third pillar, High Priest, to die in our own backyard, this is a grave insult to our empire. It must be one of those factions. Your Majesty should summon and reprimand them!”
“That’s right. I have put up with those deceitful scoundrels for too long. They’ve gone too far!”
The emperor shouted, “Dugu Zhantian, seal the city! No one gets in or out. Call for the Eight Noble Houses, Zhuge Changfeng, and Yun clan’s survivors. I will question them personally!”
“Understood!”
Dugu Zhantian bowed and rushed outside.
The imperial capital was abuzz. The army moved like lightning in sealing the gates. The small-time merchants were clueless as to the reason and closed up shop as well.
Within minutes, there was not a trace of people on the main street. It had turned into a haunted city!
Zhuo Fan and his people waited in the Yun clan, looking after the body. Hearing the disturbance outside, Zhuo Fan grinned, “Hmm~, music to my ears.”
“Humph, you just want the world to burn!” Yongning scoffed.
Zhuo Fan nodded with a winsome smile, “True, that’s just who I am. How else do you expect me to use my bag full of tricks? And now it’s only rowdy, not a complete stalemate…”
Zhuo Fan’s gaze was sharp and deep…
Meanwhile, on Regent Estate’s side, despite the hubbub outside, Huangpu Tianyuan, Leng Wuchang and the elders sat quite casually in their seats in their hall.
The door burst open and Dugu Lin in heavy armor stomped over. He cupped his hands, “Estate Lord, by His Majesty’s decree, please come to the Imperial Palace!”
“What is it this time? Why all the commotion?” Opening his lazy eyes, Huangpu Tianyuan said.
Dugu Lin’s reply was cold, “High Priest, Yun Xuanji, was killed. His Majesty is tracking down the culprit!”
“The High Priest is dead?!”
All the calm left Huangpu Tianyuan and even Leng Wuchang found it hard to believe.
The news spread like wildfire through the clans, everyone beset with the same reaction.
Among the cries of shock, there were many doubts as well.
[Who in this land dares to strike down the High Priest…]

chapters.title: Chapter 377, Court Debacle
chapters.content:
Chapter 377, Court Debacle
Translator: StarReader
In the expansive palace, the emperor sat on his throne with a hard stare cast below.
Zhuo Fan, Huangpu Tianyuan and the house lords were on the left side, while Dugu Zhantian, Zhuge Changfeng and other officials were on the right. In the middle of the court lay the body of High Priest Yun Xuanji.
Next to the body was his charming and sobbing granddaughter, Yun Shuang.
The eight houses sighed at this loss, along with every official. The emperor eyed every single one of them before snapping, “To lay a hand on Tianyu’s High Priest is to think of oneself above the law, a taunt to the empire! Every one of you here is a person of renown in your respective field, all vying for power. What do all of you make of the High Priest’s death?”
“Your Majesty, High Priest seldom left his home and lived a dull life. Parish has few guards as well, being a peak Profound Heaven expert himself. The suspect could only be someone extraordinary, since it required power to kill him. And to move in and out without a sound, that would make the suspect someone with great sway within the empire!”
Dugu Zhantian bowed before the emperor and concluded his analysis, making sure to flick a cold gaze towards the left side at the end of his speech.
Leng Wuchang caught it and snorted, “Marshal Dugu’s vague explanation clearly projects the blame on the eight houses. But have you forgotten? Besides the eight houses, Tianyu has another strong power, the Four Pillars. Especially the first two…”
“What did you say?”
Dugu Zhantian flared, “Leng Wuchang, are you accusing me of something? Humph, I’ve always been above board, upright and honest. I would never repay the High Priest’s kindness with such a vile act!”
Leng Wuchang flapped his fan open, “Old Marshal, take it easy. I wasn’t talking about you. It was a mere reminder to expand the list of suspects, to include everyone, lest the suspect slips away.”
“Humph, in any case, I had nothing to do with the High Priest’s demise. I vow on my army’s name! Only the culprit knows who he is, but I will be damn sure to wring him out!” Dugu Zhantian roared at the heavens.
Leng Wuchang merely shook his head in disdain.
[The old guy is good at fighting but he’s dumb as a post when it comes to politics. He’ll never find the killer in his life!]
[Though this affair has gathered many big players, and has a high potential of breaking the stalemate. It’s as if an unseen hand moved everyone here from the shadows. The feeling is most unsettling.]
Leng Wuchang frowned in Zhuo Fan’s direction.
But what he saw was a tranquil and omniscient face.
The emperor looked at their reaction and said, “Only an extraordinary person could’ve done this, that much is true. However, that does not give enough credence to make everyone here a suspect. Then… Holy Maiden, may I ask, who was the last person to see the High Priest alive?”
“Uh…”
Yun Shuang’s eyes drifted to Zhuo Fan and she continued after his nod, “Your Majesty, it was the Luo clan’s steward, Zhuo Fan.”
Sss~
The hall was filled with gasps and all eyes turned to him.
The emperor had just named him to be the Best Steward Beneath Heavens and now he was involved in High Priest’s murder. What validated him more as a suspect, was Dugu Zhantian’s analysis!
[This brash kid has run amok even in the imperial capital?]
Who hadn’t heard of Zhuo Fan’s handiwork? Wherever he went, he left chaos in his wake. He feared nothing and killed anyone that even looked at him funny; a Demon Archon.
[Did he kill the High Priest after a dispute?]
Funnily enough, everyone believed it. [But to go as far as to kill the High Priest, painted a target on his back, making him the public enemy number one.]
All their gazes turned morose…
The emperor demanded, “Was it you, Zhuo Fan?”
“Was what me?”
Zhuo Fan furrowed an eyebrow and smiled, “If Your Majesty is referring to the last person to visit High Priest, then yes, that would be me, mostly. But if we were to jump to conclusions and state that the High Priest’s killer and his last visitor were the same, that would be ill-advised.”
“And how are you going to prove your innocence?” The emperor stared at him.
With a smirk, Zhuo Fan shrugged, “Easy, I have a rock-solid alibi. Me and the High Priest got along so well together that he saw me out and even gave me miss Shuang’er. Ever since I left the Parish, I was always with miss Shuang’er. She is my first witness. Next would be the second prince, since he kidnapped us. And then he asked miss Shuang’er if he had the right…”
“Fine, I get it. You’re absolved.”
With a wave, Zhuo Fan’s voice drifted off and the emperor clenched his jaw in hatred.
Zhuo Fan was clearly hanging the second prince’s matter over his head. If the emperor let that matter come out, he’d be in even more of a mess.
Then his thoughts drifted to his second son asking Holy Maiden to ascertain his right to rule and his claim on the throne. But how could he let Zhuo Fan say that? With Zhuo Fan’s cunning nature, he was sure Zhuo Fan would drag his son down with him, dragging the entire imperial family in these muddy waters. They would not only lose initiative but it would be a miracle if they could wash this shame.
The emperor wished he could snap his second son’s neck, [You just had to do that now?]
Glaring at Zhuo Fan, the emperor nodded, “Steward Zhuo, wise and brave, honest and upright. It is highly unlikely for you to have done this savage act.”
Zhuo Fan beamed back a calm smile. Zhuge Changfeng and Leng Wuchang snickered inside.
The two were aware of the second prince’s fiasco alright, although not entirely. But Zhuo Fan, who was involved as a victim, had no qualms in pushing the emperor’s buttons.
[The emperor is losing what little grip he has on the Luo clan…]
“However, Zhuo Fan, was there anyone else in the Parish before you left?” Since Luo clan gave him the slip, the emperor moved to the next best thing, Regent Estate.
Zhuo Fan nodded. He was quite blunt about it too, “Estate Lord Huangpu Tianyuan and Sir Leng were guests there. And let me tell you, they weren’t very friendly either.”
Huangpu Tianyuan and Leng Wuchang’s faces sank.
They were clear of their innocence, but feared Zhuo Fan and the emperor would join hands in dragging them in. The emperor lit up, [The scamp finally got on point for once.]
He didn’t get to enjoy barking at them though, not while Zhuo Fan said, “But after only raising their voices a bit, they left. At the door, they bumped into me, where they raised their voices at me for a time…”
“Irrelevant!” The emperor dissed him.
But Zhuge Changfeng had a faint smile, raising his hand, “No, Your Majesty, it is very crucial. Regent Estate is cleared of charges as well.”
“How…” The emperor shuddered.
Zhuge Changfeng continued, “Your Majesty, consider this. The two were furious yet didn’t strike the High Priest even when oblivious to the fact that there was someone outside. To not attack at that time, thinking they’re alone, it goes on to show that they never wanted him dead. They are ruled out! “
“That’s a fairly good point.” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, putting on the most innocent look he could muster.
Zhuge Changfeng chuckled at his reaction.
The emperor’s eyebrows jumped in rage. He was livid.
Try as he might, he couldn’t find anything in his investigation to tie the rest of the people there to the case. He finished with telling them not to leave town.
Zhuo Fan was walking outside when Leng Wuchang left Huangpu Tianyuan behind and approached with cupped hands, “Steward Zhuo, we may be enemies, but thank you for that.”
Zhuo Fan grinned at his meaning and deadpanned, “We are enemies, yes, but we also need to coexist. Besides, I didn’t do it for you.”
“I know that, but one needs to give thanks when it’s due, Steward Zhuo.”
“Ha-ha-ha, since when have you two been so close?”
As Leng Wuchang bowed, a cheerful laughter announced the coming of Zhuge Changfeng.
“Oh, Prime Minister Zhuge, thank you as well.”
“It’s nothing. Steward Zhuo guided me.” Zhuge Changfeng smiled, “I picked up on Steward Zhuo’s intention of helping the Regent Estate when he recounted what happened at Parish and thought of lending Luo clan a hand. His Majesty’s plan would’ve worked otherwise.”
“Indeed, the emperor is using the High Priest’s death to summon the clans, an excuse to deal with the Luo clan and Regent Estate. Our houses may be strong, but the emperor took this chance to use the power of the court and to eradicate us both. This sudden development could’ve been the end of us.”
Zhuo Fan squinted, “Even with Luo Clan in the clear and the Regent Estate becoming the patsy for murder, the emperor would’ve charged us to annihilate you, pitting us against each other. It drew every bit of power from the Best Steward Beneath Heavens title the emperor bestowed upon me. I can’t just bear the title and shirk responsibility now, can I?”
“Ha-ha-ha, Steward Zhuo is sharp as a tack, able to analyze the bigger picture with a glance. I approve.” Zhuge Changfeng cupped his hands.
Leng Wuchang sighed with a nod, “If we three pool our minds, no one could touch us, not even the emperor. What a shame…”
“There’s nothing to feel sorry about. With how lonely it is at the top, it’d be boring.” Zhuo Fan grinned.
Zhuge Changfeng and Leng Wuchang laughed, lamenting about the ill circumstances they met in.
Interest made them enemies, but that didn’t stop respect from forming. And now that they had worked together like clockwork to fight off the court, they felt like old friends.
How often did one find a person after his own heart?
“What do you guys think? Who killed the High Priest in the end?” Zhuge Changfeng asked.
Zhuo Fan and Leng Wuchang exchanged a smile.
“Do you need to ask? It all became clear the instant the emperor asked me who else had been at Parish. When everything is said and done, the imperial capital is still in the hands of the imperial family…”
The others saw the wisdom in his words and nodded, their hearts clear of all doubts.

chapters.title: Chapter 378, Shadows Descend
chapters.content:
Chapter 378, Shadows Descend
Translator: StarReader
“The fourth pillar, shadow guards’ captain Shadow King, answers directly to His Majesty. He may even be around us right now!” Zhuge Changfeng’s eyes shone.
Zhuo Fan and Leng Wuchang nodded.
Zhuo Fan had heard of this Shadow King. Unlike the first three pillars, the fourth was very secretive and never left a trace.
Secretive to the point that only the emperor in all of Tianyu knew his face. Coming and leaving like a shade, worthy of being called just that.
“Steward Zhuo!”
A charming voice caught Zhuo Fan’s attention. Yun Shuang rushed towards him in worry as she pleaded, “Xiao Dongzi and the others are in danger. Please save them!”
Zhuo Fan knew that she was talking about her clan on its way to Blackwind Mountain. [But how did she know they’re in danger?]
Yun Shuang answered his thoughts, “Intuition!”
“Holy Maiden can read fate, so her intuitions must be true.” Zhuge Changfeng nodded.
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Then I’ll go take a look outside the imperial capital. Gents, please see that Miss Shuang’er arrives at the Luo clan safely.”
“Ha-ha-ha, nothing to worry about.” Leng Wuchang and Zhuge Changfeng smiled.
Leng Wuchang frowned though, “Is Steward Zhuo going to fight his way out of the sealed imperial capital?”
“Ha-ha-ha, you’re quite shrewd. I’m not that stupid to give the emperor an excuse!” Laughing, Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed golden and he poofed out of existence.
Leng Wuchang praised, “Zhuo Fan is a true freak, with freaky skills to boot. If he wants to leave town, no one will know.”
“Ha-ha-ha, so true. How else would you have suffered at his tricks?” Zhuge Changfeng nodded.
Leng Wuchang flushed.
He gave Huangpu Tianyuan a word, then fulfilled his promise of escorting Yun Shuang to the Luo clan with Zhuge Changfeng. While he was at it, he made sure to investigate the Yun clan and Luo clan’s ties.
He learnt that the High Priest left Yun Shuang in Zhuo Fan’s care, to even assist him.
Leng Wuchang and Zhuge Changfeng shared a look and realized the High Priest’s cause of death, [He crossed the line!]
What still eluded them though was why the High Priest was willing to give his life for the Luo clan?
“Oh, we’re here. Thank you so much for escorting me.” Yun Shuang bowed deeply.
The two returned the gesture, then Leng Wuchang asked, “Miss Yun Shuang, what will you be doing with the High Priest’s body?”
“Oh, as gratitude for His Majesty’s favor, grandfather will be laid to rest in the imperial cemetery!” Yun Shuang spoke, subdued.
Leng Wuchang sighed, “As it should be, although… Will the High Priest ever rest knowing his enemy will pose at his funeral all to look good in front of the people?”
“What?”
Yun Shuang shuddered, “Sir Leng, what did you say?”
“Oh, did I speak out too loud? Ha-ha-ha, sorry. I was only mumbling to myself. Just take it as if it never happened.” Leng Wuchang played the fool.
Yun Shuang frowned, “There’s no way. I clearly heard you say enemy. Do you know who killed my grandfather? Please tell me.”
Yun Shuang looked at him in tears, holding Leng Wuchang’s arm.
Leng Wuchang gave her a long look, but removed her hands with a sigh, “Forgive me, but I know nothing. It’s best if you ask Steward Zhuo.”
Leng Wuchang turned away, yet glee danced in his and Zhuge Changfeng’s eyes when they met, leaving with one final bow.
Yun Shuang just stood there dazed, muttering to herself, “Ask Steward Zhuo… Does he know who killed grandfather?”
After Leng Wuchang caught up, Zhuge Changfeng shook his head, “Sir Leng, that wasn’t very nice of you. Zhuo Fan helped you in the court yet now you are leaving him with a headache. With the Yun clan and Luo clan’s close relationship, if Yun clan causes trouble, Luo clan will be dragged into it.”
“Ha-ha-ha, oh please, Prime Minister Zhuge. Didn’t Zhuo Fan say we’re only saving our own skin? And we’re still enemies, aren’t we? I’m sure he would’ve done the same thing if he were me. With how everything’s a stalemate, there will be someone who will stir the water, no matter how much neither of us wants to be the one in the limelight. And since someone has stirred up the pot, we all have much to look forward to, don’t we?”
Zhuge Changfeng’s eyes shone with joy as well…
Meanwhile, twenty miles out of the imperial capital. A throng of thousands of people was marching towards Windgaze City. Li Jingtian and the power couple were hovering above, ensuring their safety.
Among the cooling breeze and the sun glaring through the mountains, this trip felt like a scenic route.
It was then that the wind came down fast and hard, stirring the birds. The entire sky turned black in seconds.
Then came the wails, grating at people’s minds.
“Humph, they’re finally here!”
Li Jingtian snickered and his knuckles cracked, his eyes shining in excitement. A martial fanatic would start feeling moody if he didn’t get his daily dose of brawl.
Qiu Yanhai and Xue Qingjian showed a wide grin as well. Fire and ice spread as they looked up at the encroaching darkness.
Wu~
The howling of ghosts announced the incoming black figures descending in droves.
They all wore black armor and black helmets that hid their faces. Only the thin slits in those helmets showed heavy gazes, the only sight in this world of black and shuddering cold. They were not human, but closer to asuras from hell.
With each of them wielding a half-a-meter-long curved blade, the image of demons was further engraved in the hearts of men.
Swallowing dryly, the mass of people fell back.
Although they had the numbers, these hundreds of black men released such an icy chill that it crumbled any notion of resistance.
Li Jingtian frowned, “These Profound Heaven experts aren’t normal. They’re about to act, be careful!”
“Tch, what can some weirdo Profound Heaven experts do? I refuse to believe there is a second freak like Zhuo Fan on this earth!”
Xue Qingjian snickered and shot forth. Qiu Yanhai was right behind her.
Only Li Jingtian just stood there, affixed on these interlopers’ movements.
“Look out, it’s the Luo clan’s Ice and Fire Lords!” The calm voice turned everyone in black armor serious. They held their curved blades ready, the blue glint on their tips indicating poison.
On top of being a 4th-grade spiritual weapon, of course.
Not that Xue Qingjian had a mind to care. With a laugh, she shot a white ray from her hand.
Bang!
Dozens of black men were encased in one huge iceberg then and there. And the subsequent explosion made sure only pieces of them were left.
The black army fell back two steps, making Xue Qingjian laugh harder, “What did I tell you, they’re only Profound Heaven. They’re not worth a single blow!”
Qiu Yanhai laughed as well, sucking up to his bossy lass, “Lady’s gaze is so sharp, seeing their bluff with one look. Unlike that scaredy-cat old Li, less than even a woman!”
He shot a fire dragon, resulting in an explosion that turned another batch of dozen black guys to ashes. Xue Qingjian covered up her sweet and charming giggle.
Yun clan eased up, knowing their safety was in the hands of three bodyguards. They will safeguard their journey to their new haven.
Li Jingtian twitched, ticked off by the happy couple, yet he just couldn’t shake the feeling that these black guys were not the pushovers like they looked.
In confirmation to his suspicions, the black guys watched their own teammates fall like flies, yet all they did was to be on guard.
As endless crackling commenced, the three elders watched in horror as the bloody pieces of bodies Xue Qingjian blew up shook.
With a sinister energy signature, the pieces let out a black smoke, each black mass forming a humanoid shadow.
The shadows re-assembled as each of them picked up their curved blade. And just like when they arrived, they released the same creepy snicker.

chapters.title: Chapter 379, Mad Dipper’s Showcase of Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 379, Mad Dipper’s Showcase of Power
Translator: StarReader
Hi-hi-hi…
“Luo clan’s Ice and Fire Lords are nothing to look at either!” The shadows let out ghastly laughter while the other black men looked on from a distance.
Qiu Yanhai and Xue Qingjian were startled yet being unable to accept the situation, charged at them for another attack.
It was utterly ridiculous how some Profound Heaven cultivators were mocking two 8th layer Radiant Stage experts.
Ice and fire surged once more towards the shadows, but it merely phased through them and made a loud bang far behind them.
Those shadows weren’t even real to begin with.
The two jerked back, to which the shadows cackled louder and sharper. With the blow of an eerie wind, it was now the shadows’s turn to go on the offensive with their glinting curved blades.
Boom~
The duo sent blows all this time, but not even one was of use. They couldn’t lay a finger on them.
As the shadows drew closer, they shot silver lights at them, forcing the tense couple back. A moment of carelessness was enough for one of the lights to land, dissolving their clothes. It was this close to poisoning their bodies too.
That only got the two of them even more frightened. And while they were pulling back, the shadows grew cocky with laughter and movements.
Qiu Yanhai and Xue Qingjian grew grave, unable to block the shadows’ advance. And there were still many more of those black men glaring over as well.
Li Jingtian watched it all with a cold trembling eye. [Their cultivation method is like those pygmies’ unity tactic, but not quite.]
The four Scheming Demons’ every move matched flawlessly, in tune with each other, while these guys fought by themselves. There was no mystical art behind it to allow them to phase in and out of reality either.
[It ought to have the same weakness either way.]
Li Jingtian’s eyes flashed with resolve.
The power couple had had enough, by the looks of it. Xue Qingjian cursed back, “Old Li, what are you standing around for? Do something!”
“Ah!”
Xue Qingjian cried, getting scared by a curved blade flying at her neck. Qiu Yanhai was distressed, yet he was blocked by six shadows himself. All he could do was watch his dear wife get skewered.
Li Jingtian roared, “They have no bodies. Use soul attacks!”
The couple woke up to this obvious truth.
[Of course! We’re Radiant Stage experts while they’re only in the Profound Heaven Stage. Killing with intent may not do them in, on account of their strong souls, but it should give them a pause.]
Two hums later, a pulse flashed past.
Bam!
Like a tidal wave, it flung the black men dozens of meters back.
The effect perked up the two.
They were finally getting somewhere with removing these creepy guys. But it also stunned them as to how these Profound Heaven shadows had such strong souls.
The duo’s powerful souls were unable to even make them pause, and only pushed them back.
Nevertheless, they could see a solution to their headaches, restoring their calm.
While they were calm, the enemy was deadly calm as well, not one bit phased about the fact that their weakness had just been found out.
“Fall in!”
From among the calm black observers, one aged and hoarse voice came. The cackling shadows gathered together.
As they linked, they formed a giant net, floating in the sky.
As more of them joined, their soul power surged.
Squinting, the couple turned grave as they stepped backward. They had felt it too. The shadows’ combined soul power had reached the Radiant Stage.
“Unity tactic!” Li Jingtian gasped.
The black men laughed in pride, “A soul unity tactic to be exact. One made particularly with Radiant Stage experts in mind. He-he-he, get ready, attack!”
The shadows snickered and released a sound at Qiu Yanhai and Xue Qingjian, who were balking under the pressure.
As they pulled back, they fought back with their own souls.
Much good did that do.
Their soul attacks against the shadow’s combined attack was like a breeze against a wall.
The two panicked, sweating buckets. [What’s with these guys? They’re way too creepy!]
No matter what they did, it proved to be pointless.
