Scratching her cute button nose, Yongning snorted and stuck her head out, “This is a once in a hundred years occasion. It’s so kind of me to invite you to see the bustle so the least you could do is thank me!”
“See the bustle? More like you wanting to jump right in!” Zhuo Fan mocked, spinning on his heel back inside.
Yongning flustered, “Quanrong’s delegation has come. They’re about to enter the city. It’s a chance to see exotic cultures that you should never miss.”
“What, Quanrong?”
Zhuo Fan stopped in his tracks and turned right back out and kept on going.
He wanted to check them out. How strong they were, how many had come, to assess the threat to his house.
Princess cried, “Wait for me…”
Luo Yunchang was stunned, sensing the seriousness of the matter. She called Yunhai and they went together as well.
And so, the whole gang stepped out of the compound’s gate. They had just taken a turn on main street when they bumped into a literal mob.
You couldn’t swing a dead cat without hitting something. They tried to find something besides heads, but nope, there were heads everywhere.
The exotic foreigners were so in vogue right now, the whole capital was out to see them.
“Brother Zhuo, here!” A shout turned Zhuo Fan’s head, coming from a building’s second floor. Long Xingyun waved for him to come sit with his allies.
Zhuo Fan nodded and took everyone over. Every one of his peers was there.
Not just his allies, even the likes of Hell Valley and Pill King Hall. But on account of all the bustle, they decided to keep the friction to a minimum.
So much so that the arrival of Zhuo Fan made them look anywhere but at him.
With Zhuo Fan being a moody beast, who knew what excuse he’d come up with to trash them? If the elders chose to stand clear, it went double for these disciples.
Long Xingyun’s group chuckled, [This brother sure is feisty!]
A pain for the enemy and a shoulder to rely on for the allies…
“Brother Zhuo, the entire second floor is reserved for the houses’ disciples to get a clearer view of the Quanrong’s delegation.” Long Xingyun invited them to sit.
Xie Tianshang was stern, his hand never leaving the hilt of his sword, “I wonder how many experts they have.”
[Like you can expect anything else from a martial fanatic.]
Zhuo Fan and Long Xingyun’s eyes met and they chuckled. After the Esoteric Debate, Xie Tianshang’s mood had never changed.
Quanrong’s delegation had yet to parade into town, so Zhuo Fan looked around. He picked up on a sneaky figure and shouted, “Yan Fu, you’ve come to see the excitement and won’t even greet me?”
Yan Fu ducked out of sight on the first floor when he froze. With a forced smile and a scratch on his head, “Steward Zhuo, I… what a coincidence…”
His words got cut off by a prideful voice, “Yan Fu, my master and martial aunt are almost here and you didn’t get us seats… eh?”
Xiao Dandan came with Peony and Iris Overseers when she noticed Zhuo Fan’s unnatural gaze and blushed, ducking her head.
“Brother Zhuo, they had long since been an item. But you were so cooped up that you never noticed.” Long Xingyun gossiped with a snicker.
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, “You guys…”
Yan Fu was scared out of his mind, even losing his voice. Everyone knew Xiao Dandan was more than a little crazy for Zhuo Fan. He ignored her every step, true, but that didn’t mean anyone could just show up and take what is Steward Zhuo’s. It was a no-brainer what would happen now.
Peony Overseer saw the two shaking in their boots and snapped, “What, Zhuo Fan, you didn’t want Dandan and now you’re going to ruin her life? That’s just evil of you!”
Zhuo Fan flicked his hand, his eyes roaming over the happy and shivering couple. Then he cracked up, slapping Yan Fu’s back, “Ha-ha-ha, ma man!”
He was simply overjoyed at having thrown away one pesky baggage.
Everyone’s faces twitched and turned dark.

chapters.title: Chapter 389, Rampant
chapters.content:
Chapter 389, Rampant
Translator: StarReader
Ugh!
Yan Fu was having mixed feelings about this.
He should be happy as a clam that Zhuo Fan wasn’t here to deck him, but the more he thought about it the less Zhuo Fan’s word fit. [As if I’m picking his trash, his damaged goods.]
Xiao Dandan had a sour taste in her mouth as well, her burning heart crumbling from disappointment.
What did Zhuo Fan mean by this? Did Xiao Dandan mean absolutely nothing to him given any time of the day? He didn’t take her seriously, labeling her as an extra baggage from the get-go.
Her disciple standing there all lonely had Peony Overseer’s temper explode to protect her, cursing, “Zhuo Fan, what’s that supposed to mean? You felt nothing for Dandan all this time? Are you dead inside?”
The outburst earned silent looks from everyone.
Then sighs, [It’s truly a mystery how a woman’s mind operates.]
Iris Overseer pulled on Peony Overseer’s clothes awkwardly while scolding her through transmission, “When one man has eyes for Dandan, you curse. When another man ignores Dandan, you curse again. Just what do you want exactly? To have a deathmatch for the lady’s hand?”
[That’s…]
Words left Peony Overseer.
Could Yan Fu versus Zhuo Fan even be called a deathmatch? [Who in this world can even beat that brat?]
She only found that Zhuo Fan’s cold reply had cut her disciple too quickly. Her disciple had alway carried a blazing torch for him for seven years, and counting. [If not for the matter with Qingcheng, maybe…]
“This is fine as well.” Sighing, Peony Overseer consoled Xiao Dandan. Then signaled for Yan Fu to come with her to teach him proper manners.
Yan Fu waited for Steward Zhuo’s instructions, but the guy only flicked him away, “Go, your future mother-in-law is calling you. Better listen to her!”
“You, zip it!” Peony Overseer snapped with a glare on him.
Zhuo Fan struck the perfect bystander figure looking at the street. His heart however was doing somersaults!
Xiao Dandan was a love-struck fool, always behind him like a lost puppy. Now that someone had taken that puppy in, he was over the moon.
Yongning asked Luo Yunchang about the ins and outs of this drama, and sighed. But her gaze for Zhuo Fan was now a heavier one.
[Getting this sugar husband won’t be easy…]
Roar!
The rumbling sound announced the opening of the city gates to reveal fanged savage beasts strutting onward in orderly fashion.
The people cheered.
Most of them had never even seen spiritual beasts, least of all these 5th-level ones.
The noisy second floor fell silent, with everyone focusing on the procession. Five men and one woman were leading, on those 5th-level spiritual beasts.
The crowd fell back at the imposing aura, avoiding their eyes. The ones behind had no problem seeing those foreigners perfectly.
Especially the girl, of stunning beauty. She had a certain wild vibe the Tianyu women lacked, leaving the men enraptured and drooling.
Gulping, Long Xingyun squinted, “A fair and virtuous lady, a great catch!”
[Perv!]
The women around rolled their eyes at him.
“Quanrong are famous for their beast rearing skills. But it’s my first time seeing the combined power of a man and beast! “
Xie Tianshang’s sword was out of its sheath, flashing dangerously. His two eyes filled with thirst for battle, wishing nothing more than to jump down there and take the foreigners for a spin.
Everyone shook their heads, [Martial fanatic!]
Long Xingyun advised, “This is a chance for our nations to shake hands. You can’t go start a war! Especially with that woman, he-he-he…”
Their talk went in one ear and out the other in Zhuo Fan’s case. All his attention was focused on the riders.
They had three Profound Heaven cultivators, three Radiant Stage cultivators, and a thousand veteran cavalry in the Bone Tempering Stage. They rode on a thousand 3rd-level spiritual beasts and six 5th-level spiritual beasts. [Can this army threaten the Luo clan?]
Zhuo Fan sighed.
“Zhuo Fan, what are you looking at?” The princess was piqued by his heavy gaze.
“At oddities!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes twitched.
The princess was puzzled, “What oddities?”
“If I am looking, that means I clearly can’t find them, now can I? I wouldn’t be looking otherwise, you daft girl!” Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes.
The princess flushed red and glared in a pout.
Roar!
The sky shook under the noise and the Quanrong delegation stopped. Zhuo Fan’s side watched one leader’s mount roaring and getting ready for attack.
In front of it was a five year old child, crying on the ground.
A grizzled and thin old man charged out of the crowd and hugged the child, “Forgive me, the child is too young to understand running in front of you. I’ll take him away!”
“It’s fine, uncle…” The woman smiled.
But the jacked-up leader snickered over her, “Are all Tianyu’s people without decorum? I am Quanrong Empire’s general and for you, an ant, to bump into me is a gross act of disrespect. Can you bear the responsibility of a war between us?”
“Cut the act. How could we start a war over this? We’d have been at war for ages by now otherwise.” Zhuo Fan mocked.
The princess bobbed her head.
So did the other young masters, looking at the buffed tough guy with contempt. Those words of his only worked on the common people.
While the houses were too wise to fall for some cheap provocation.
The old man was but a common man however, paralyzed on the ground in fear of what he’d done. He had just condemned his fellow countrymen to a life of pain and suffering.
He dropped to his knees and begged, “Spare us lord, I am at fault. Please don’t aggravate the matter!”
The tough guy snickered, filled with contempt. But the woman frowned and glared, “Zha Lahan, stop making a scene!”
“He-he-he, young miss, I was only messing with Tianyu’s pests. It won’t change anything!” The tough guy waved his hand, turning to the old man, “I can overlook this for Tianyu, out of the kindness of my heart. But my mount here has special tastes, you see. Every time it bumps into someone, it feels the urge to swallow something. Or his bad mood might affect my own. So tell me, how will you settle this?”
The old man paled. Figuring the general wanted to feed his spiritual beast with the child. And he wanted the old man to do it too!
But how could he?
The woman snapped, “Zha Lahan, having fun is one thing, but don’t cross the line!
“He-he-he, young miss, it’s just a game. No harm no foul!” The tough guy chuckled, yet his vicious eyes never left the old man. Waiting to see him give the child to the spiritual beast.
The spiritual beast bared its fangs and licked its maw with bloodshot eyes.
“Humph, absurd, they’ve come to our land and yet act all high and mighty!”
Xie Tianshang slapped the table, his sword half-drawn. Long Xingyun advised, “Brother Xie, they were invited. We can’t interfere, not with the officials having yet to appear. It will only invite trouble.”
“Ha, the great noble houses, afraid of stirring trouble? “
The princess snapped, “I never saw you stop once from looking for trouble yet now you’ve decided to sit back? Chickens! Zhuo Fan, follow me as we teach them a lesson!”
“Knock yourself out. I don’t feel like it.”
Zhuo Fan flicked his hand, “Like you said. The seven houses have made looking for trouble practically a tradition. So you can handle it. Oh, Xiao Dandan, weren’t you once high strung as well?”
“I…” Xiao Dandan blushed with a lowered head, “I was more confused than angry then. Why bring it up…”
“Yan Fu, you’re no better either!” Zhuo Fan glanced at him.
Yan Fu nodded with calm, “True, every time I went out with my master I’d be throwing my weight around. But since I’ve joined the Luo clan, with its tight rules, I never get the chance.”
“Well said. You’ll show off again one day, not to worry!”
Zhuo Fan snapped his fingers and snickered, “See that, princess? We may look calm and kind on the surface, but there’s a festering evil in our bones, like those guys below. Aren’t you expecting too much, sending us mean guys into another mean guy’s business?”
The princess blushed in anger, “Then I’ll go!”
Meanwhile, the old man was hugging the sobbing child tighter, under cold hard pressure and indecision. It was then that a scoff came.
“Quanrong are guests and nothing more. Since when have they started acting as hosts?”
Whoosh~
Yun Shuang stood before the elder and the child.
Zhuo Fan sighed.
He didn’t give a hoot about others, while being unable to ignore his own people.
His eyes glinting, Zhuo Fan’s mouth curled up in his trademark evil smile. [Time to probe the Quanrong for a bit…]

chapters.title: Chapter 390, A Dragon Can’t Repress a Snake
chapters.content:
Chapter 390, A Dragon Can’t Repress a Snake
Translator: StarReader
“Shuang’er!” Yongning cried.
The others looked on as well, stunned to see the empire’s Holy Maiden coming out in the people’s defense.
Then they turned eager.
After the High Priest’s death, the Holy Maiden had become the apple of the empire’s eye. They’d go as far as charging into the Quanrong delegation if it meant defending her.
Something the Quanrong were not privy to, evident by Zha Lahan’s mockery, “Missie, are you out for a quick death? Hasn’t your emperor taught you how to receive guests? You’ll now butt into another’s problems, even Quanrong’s delegation?”
“If you call yourselves guests, just act like one. I’ve never seen a guest as outrageous as you!” Yun Shuang stood tall and bold.
Zha Lahan glared then cackled, “What a charmer you are. As for falling in with the customs here, it will depend on the host. I’m going to take those two for my mount as a snack. What’s the host going to do about it?”
Zha Lahan shouted and the beast roared in its pounce on the old man and child.
“No!”
Yun Shuang shot a palm at the beast’s skull. Zha Lahan merely snickered and released his aura.
Bang!
Yun Shuang rebounded as if hitting a wall.
“Ha-ha-ha, a Profound Heaven girl dares to interfere? I wonder what gave you the gall?” Zha Lahan cackled.
Yun Shuang’s heart was beating frantically. Watching the old man and child becoming the spiritual beast’s dinner about to be engulfed by those fangs, she teared up.
[Have mercy on my people, for they are suffering so…]
The old man and child closed their eyes, knowing their end was inescapable, waiting for the jaws of death to close on them.
The Quanrong woman shouted, “Zha Lahan, stop this instant!”
Too little, too late. Zha Lahan turned a deaf ear to her orders, having gone drunk on power.
The people sighed with a shake of their heads.
This was the fate that awaited any common man’s stumble upon the Quanrong delegation. With it being a matter concerning the future relations between the two nations, how many people would dare to step in to solve this mess?
Holy Maiden was one, albeit weak…
Under everyone’s gazes, the fangs inched closer and closer on their meal. The aura had the old man and child unable to even breathe.
Pff!
With a groan, the savage aura withdrew and the spiritual beast halted mid-charge with its maw open. Only the stench kept coming.
Zha Lahan was shocked.
And the audience was shocked, regaining their hope, “Who was it?”
The old man and child were still waiting for death, but the beast was running late, making them crack open their eyes to watch the stunning spectacle.
The savage beast’s huge body was stopped by a red hand. What stood before them was a youth with white hair.
They knew who he was. Everyone did after the fiasco outside the Imperial Palace.
The savage no one in Tianyu messed with, Zhuo Fan, had arrived…
“How is that possible?!”
The calm Quanrong now cried out. Zha Lahan’s eyes flashed with a thirst for battle.
[Tianyu has someone capable of holding back a 5th-level spiritual beast with one hand?]
The agitated lads on the second floor rested easy now, sitting back to enjoy the show with one leg over the other.
Once Zhuo Fan stepped up, everything became a foregone conclusion.
And all thanks to Zhuo Fan’s harsh, cruel and heavy-handed lessons.
Xie Tianshang was grumbling, “What a hypocrite. He says he washes his hands of this matter yet here he is jumping right in.”
“Ha-ha-ha, isn’t it great though? He’s the only one who dares to butt in such an affair. Brother Xie, don’t mind it.” Long Xingyun laughed.
The others bobbed their heads in total agreement.
It begged the question though, would the dragon come out on top, or the snake?(StarReader: a Chinese saying meaning that one was above the law. The snake I mean.)
Zhuo Fan paid no attention to the savage glints. He merely glanced at the old man and child, “What are you looking at? Do you still want to get eaten?”
The old man darted away with the kid in his arms, expressing his gratitude, “Thank you, Steward Zhuo. I will never forget this…”
“What arrogance!”
Zha Lahan barked, holding the beast by the mane, causing it to roar as well. It thrashed around trying to escape from Zhuo Fan’s grip.
Zhuo Fan was using the Qilin arm, proving its efforts were in vain.
Zhuo Fan snorted and flicked.
To the audience’s shock, the 5th-level spiritual beast slammed into the ground like a ton of bricks, knocked out cold.
Zha Lahan took to the air, outraged. [A mere flick knocked a 5th-level spiritual beast unconscious? Who is this guy?]
[I’ve never heard of anyone like that in Tianyu!]
The Quanrong delegation was just as stunned.
“Steward Zhuo’s might is boundless!”
It started with a shout and then it turned into a roar as more voices joined in, throwing their fists in the air, “Steward Zhuo, Steward Zhuo…”
The shouts came in waves, rumbling across the sky!
The Quanrong delegation looked around in shock and then focussed at Zhuo Fan.
[A steward has such power? How come we’ve never heard of such an outrageous being in Tianyu? His fame is great as well. The people practically love him.]
[Blast it! What is the intelligence department even doing? An expert like this that every common man knows about yet we’ve gotten no wind of? They’re all nothing but two-bit rejects!]
Ignoring it all, Zhuo Fan strode over to Yun Shuang. She had put on a wide smile, being relieved for the people’s safety. At some point, her heart knew that as long as Zhuo Fan was around, everything will be a-ok.
Zhuo Fan was the one who gave her such a sense of security.
“Steward Zhuo!”
Yongning squeezed in with Yan Fu through the crowd, running at them. She bowed, “Forgive me, Steward Zhuo, for our tardiness in buying the goods you asked for. Please don’t blame us. We are mere servants, nothing in your eyes, but we are hardworking. Someone blocked our path!”
Zhuo Fan noticed her wink and laughed.
[This girl hasn’t been around me for long, yet she has developed quite the flair for the dramatic!]
The Quanrong delegation was overwhelmed.
[Say what? That lady just now and the new kid are only errand boys?]
Everyone from Quanrong felt a chill.
[Mommy, which house is bursting at the seams to have a Profound Heaven expert doing errands? Weren’t Profound Heaven experts supposed to be clan elders in Tianyu?]
Gulping, the Quanrong looked at them in fear.
[If a servant’s requirements are at least the Profound Heaven Stage, then what about their elders, Clan Head, and even Venerables?]
[More importantly, how many clans like these are there in Tianyu?]
They all knew Tianyu was a hidden den of monsters, but this was ridiculous!
[No, how is that hidden? Even the common man knows their outstanding blue blood!]
[God damn you Hu Lianchai! How the hell did you perform your investigation?]
The Quanrong glared at the last rider on the 5th level spiritual beasts, a thin middle-aged man.
The guy was bewildered as well, lowering his head in shame. [When did Tianyu whip out a fresh batch of clan members?]
[Or are they… bluffing?]
But a glance at Zhuo Fan had him sighing instead, losing all nerve.
Zhuo Fan was a 3rd layer of Profound Heaven expert but a hand of his trashed a 5th-level spiritual beast. Not even Zha Lahan could do that.
[For a freak like that to be a steward and the clan to have Profound Heaven experts as servants may not be such an oddity.]
The Quanrong looked at Zhuo Fan’s group with solemn gazes, with all their arrogance washed away.
The younger generation on the second floor felt their cheeks twitching in tandem.
[Zhuo Fan is the worst influence. He is pushing them deeper on the path of violence!]

chapters.title: Chapter 391, Tuoba Liufeng
chapters.content:
Chapter 391, Tuoba Liufeng
Translator: StarReader
“You know you’re wasting time, so why are you still here? If you run late and the young master isn’t satisfied, I for one can’t suffer the consequences and you sure as hell can’t either!”
Flicking his sleeve, Zhuo Fan strutted forth. He might as well go with the flow and take the play as far as it took him.
The Quanrong grew tense. [This outrageous thing is afraid of his young master? This clan must have harsh rules, with experts in droves!]
[So much so that the steward who has such godlike power isn’t of high status in the clan and has to cater to the young lord’s whims?]
Everyone knew the strong ones in the clan were revered and even the Clan Head watched his tone around them, let alone the young master.
[From the sound of it, he isn’t much in the clan. But what does that make his clan, an abomination?]
Pff!
Yongning and Yun Shuang shared a sneaky smile and the people hid their joy.
All of Tianyu knew of Zhuo Fan by now, a steward in name yet the de-facto leader of the Luo clan in the Clan Head’s absence. Only gooks would actually fall for his antics.
And the Quanrong were shaking in their boots.
With the intel and their numbers, they figured they’d boss Tianyu around, with no house or clan messing with them.
Reality proved otherwise, however. They’d just met a servant who was a Profound Heaven expert while their steward was a godlike freak capable of doing anything.
Case in point, didn’t the steward wipe the floor with their general’s mount?
It was by this clan’s grace that they weren’t dead already.
The Quanrong slumped, losing their haughty air. A handsome youth even cupped his hands, “My subordinate was too impulsive and I apologize for the trauma he caused!”
[Thugs on the outside yet pushovers at heart.]
His attitude earned the contempt of everyone. Be that as it may, having the delegation apologize for its transgressions was enough, no?
Tell that to Zhuo Fan. He never once looked at them, treating them like air as he turned to Yun Shuang, “What are you standing around for? Back to shopping!”
[Ridiculous!]
Zha Lahan’s eyes spat fire, his fists tight.
The princess snickered inside, yet not quite content with how subdued the drama was. She wanted it blown sky high and pointed at the Quanrong, “Steward Zhuo, how are we to do that when they’re blocking the road?”
Zhuo Fan eyed her for a second, picking up on the glint in her look.
[Perfect timing. Let’s get those guys to act and get a feel of the situation, shall we?]
“Hold on while I deal with this!”
Turning a cold look to the Quanrong, he walked over, “The imperial capital’s main street is for walking, not parading your pets. Anything on all four, out!”
“What did you say?”
Zha Lahan snapped, his muscles tightening like steel, his body primed to explode any minute.
The youth next to him turned glum. Zhuo Fan was treading on thin ice.
The Quanrong were beast-rearing people, they’d lived all their lives among them. Asking them to throw their beasts out was like demanding them to give up their advantage and pride. The answer was an obvious no.
The eight houses’ people on the second floor snorted.
Most of them had first hand knowledge of Zhuo Fan’s style. He’d even steal candy from a baby. No low was beneath him. He’d wrung them off of all dignity and still act like the sore loser.
Per Zhuo Fan’s m.o., he’d first taunt his victim so he’d act in self defense leading them to strike first. The result? [Of course beating the crap out of you, all while standing on the moral high ground. Let’s see if anyone can top that!]
How many innocent victims had fallen under Zhuo Fan’s malignant thumb, with nowhere to vent their loss and were forced to suffer in silence?
Everyone knew that. Zhuo Fan’s infamy was practically built on it. Exceptions being the Quanrong, the new guys, the fresh meat; falling for it hook, line and sinker.
There wasn’t a soul out here who wasn’t snickering inside, waiting for the show to start.
[That’s what you get for being obnoxious. Clueless as you are, you should keep your head down anywhere near Zhuo Fan…]
The Quanrong youth walked up to Zhuo Fan, his heart unsettled. A deep breath helped a bit before he began, “We are Quanrong warriors, our beasts never leave our side. We only know how to advance and never retreat. If you are capable, then you can make the spiritual beasts fall back!”
The people cried [Holy moly!] inside.
Zhuo Fan blinked once, then stared back, an evil grin playing at the corner of his mouth.
“That kid sure is something.” Long Xingyun sighed. The rest agreed.
His words were impeccable. Neither an outright refusal nor taking it lying down, but he had shifted the issue onto Zhuo Fan. To have him deal with it.
Everyone knew the youth probably had no clue what Zhuo Fan was made of, thus he chose the middle ground to neither sound threatening nor a coward, thinking that Zhuo Fan was a man of importance. It was a perfect blend of tone and words to defend his self-respect.
And thus he had dumped the issue on Zhuo Fan’s head.
Failing to scare the beasts back would put Zhuo Fan on the spot; two birds with one stone.
He had avoided the taunt and forced the other person to take action.
Now it begged the question, who on earth could push back a thousand spiritual beasts? Not even Quanrong’s best beastmaster could do it.
The Quanrong watched the youth with gratitude and gave Zhuo Fan a wide grin.
Long Xingyun gasped, inspecting the youth, “Who is he? So young yet versed in politics and strength.”
Luo Yunhai nodded, “He is leader material, with an air about him that could’ve only been gained in battle.”
“Ha-ha-ha, brother, your eyes are getting sharper.”
Four people stepped on the second floor, the Four Tigers of Tianyu. Looking at the stand-off outside, Dugu Feng laughed, “We’ve been waiting for the delegation to reach the Imperial Palace’s gates yet they just wouldn’t show. Turns out the scamp cut them off.
“I just can’t make sense of him. He’s picking a fight with anyone! He isn’t called Tianyu’s number one thorn for nothing, ha-ha-ha…”
“Big brother, could you please not talk like that. It wasn’t Zhuo Fan who started it this time!” Luo Yunchang tried to salvage the situation.
Dugu Feng smiled, “Brother is so jumpy, but I didn’t mean it as Steward Zhuo’s responsibility. We had figured there’ll be some hostilities with the Quanrong. That’s what happens when we battle each other for years and years. Their delegation is only here to showcase their superiority, something we planned for. Yet here they are, dead in their tracks, and saving us plenty of trouble too!”
The others understood.
[Their march to the Imperial Palace was to set up their powerful position, cut short by Zhuo Fan’s interference.]
[Sigh, it’s a darn shame too.]
It was one thing to raise your tone against the Four Tigers of Tianyu, and a whole nother against Zhuo Fan.
“By the way, brother, do you know that youth?” Luo Yunhai asked.
Dugu Feng sighed, “Not just know him, but he is an old rival. He is the Quanrong Empire’s commander Tuoba Tieshan’s only son, Tuoba Liufeng!”
“He’s a young commander?” Luo Yunhai exclaimed, “I was wondering why I got a general’s vibe from him.”
Dugu Feng nodded, his eyes fixed on the youth, “Tuoba Liufeng is shrewd, brave and adept in leading his men. A bit on the young side, but he has earned his place in the army. We four have tangled with him more times than I can count, and always came at a disadvantage. They say he will take his father’s place, a prime candidate to be the next commander!”
Luo Yunhai’s eyes trembled and he ingrained the youth’s image in his mind.
The next Quanrong Empire’s commander meant their future enemy.
“Elder brother, what about the others?” Luo Yunhai asked.
Dugu Feng said, “There are Eight Wolf Wardens under Quanrong Empire’s commander, of great mettle and are unstoppable. Three of them are currently present!”
Dugu Feng pointed at the tough guy stirring trouble, “He is second among the Eight Wolf Wardens, Savage Wolf Zha Lahan. His innate power and unmatched bravery paint him as someone able to tear apart a 5th-level spiritual beast. A fierce opponent.
“That one there is Obscure Wolf, Hu Lianchai. In charge of intelligence and scouting; a hidden danger.” Dugu Feng pointed at the thin figure, “He isn’t much to look at, but he is sure to be watching you. His operatives are sharp and capable.” “
Luo Yunhai nodded. Dugu Feng turned to a masked man with only half his face visible, “That is Quanrong Empire’s most famous archer, ranked third in the Eight Wolf Wardens, the Sky-piercing Wolf, Zhe Bie. His Heaven-shaking Bow and Cloud-nailing Arrow are 6th-grade spiritual weapons. His shots are deadly, taking out the enemy generals. Even the Marshal suffered at his hands. He is one opponent you can hardly guard against.”

chapters.title: Chapter 392, Thirst for Blood
chapters.content:
Chapter 392, Thirst for Blood
Translator: StarReader
“You’re telling me that godfather, a 6th layer of Radiant Stage expert, actually…”Luo Yunhai widened his eyes.
Dugu Feng nodded gravely, “Yes, Eight Wolf Wardens are all tough, all Radiant Stage experts, all veterans. Never underestimate them on the field of battle.”
Everyone nodded.
If not for the Four Tigers of Tianyu saying it, who were engaged in wars all year round, the eight houses’ youths would’ve never known that the Quanrong had sent a mean bunch this time.
Luo Yunhai turned to the last two, his eyes never leaving the oldest person from his sight. Hair white, small yet sharp eyes, casting a veil of mystery over him.
“Elder brother, who is that?”
Dugu Feng mumbled, “Quanrong Empire’s Imperial Tutor, Han Tiemo. He is our Prime Minister Zhuge Changfeng’s equivalent!”
“Does that mean the enemy has sent his best over?” Everyone was startled, “How could they send someone of such importance to Tianyu? Don’t they fear an assassination?”
Dugu Feng shook his head, morose, “Quanrong Empire is unlike ours, who have the Four Pillars to hold up the nation yet each of them is filled with their own designs. Take godfather and Zhuge Changfeng for example, neither will accept the other. With years and years of constant fights at the border, they say Zhuge Changfeng had planned to go to the Quanrong Empire once, for peace talks, but never carried it out. Do you know why?”
“He feared the old marshal’s betrayal!” The chorus sounded.
Dugu Feng nodded, “Godfather isn’t the type to do this, but it’ll be impossible for the Prime Minister to believe Godfather completely. While Quanrong Empire’s commander Tuoba Tieshan allowed his son to come on this delegation because the Imperial Tutor is here to look after him. Why Han Tiemo has come in the first place is because Tuoba Tieshan has five million troops stationed at the border sending the delegation off. If any danger were to come upon the delegation, the army would march south and the empires would be tangled into a heavy war. This is the general’s accord!”
Everyone felt a shiver run down their spine.
[The enemy emperor’s left and right arm help each other while our Four Pillars are stuck in a conflict. If not for Tianyu’s vast lands and many talents cropping up, as well as the seven noble houses and the empire’s three guardian sects, we’d have long since fallen.]
Everyone shook their heads…
“What about the babe?” Long Xingyun licked his lips, enraptured as he was, pointing at the girl.
Dugu Feng deadpanned, “She is Tuoba Tieshan’s only daughter and Tuoba Liufeng’s younger sister, Touba Lian’er. Hailed as the number one beauty in Quanrong and owner of impressive beast rearing skills. But she is yet to show up on the battlefield and is of weak cultivation. There’s nothing about her worth mentioning.”
“Oh, brother Dugu, what kind of man are you? How can you use strength to judge such a fine specimen?”
Stomping his feet in admiration, Long Xingyun said, “She and our women are different, but it’s all in the style. I wonder if I can invite her over during her stay in Tianyu. A night in the warm candlelight, a beautiful entanglement, and the war of the nations may very well be a thing of the past!”
[Perv!]
The women rolled their eyes.
The men twitched and sighed. Dugu Feng said, “Brother Long, it’s best that you forget about her. She is the commander’s daughter for one, and although no one has seen her skills, she is no pushover. Don’t test her and turn this into an even bigger issue.”
“No biggie, some flowers you can pick, some you can only admire. This young master has his self-esteem, ha-ha-ha…” The beauty below simply danced in the infatuated eyes of Long Xingyun.
The others merely shrugged.
Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s young Pavilion Lord was a casual romantic, unlike the savage Zhuo Fan. He ought to know when to stop, no?
Meanwhile, Zhuo Fan stared down Tuoba Liufeng in thought. Then he grinned, “Telling you to step back is out of respect for you, far away guests. Do you really want me to do it?”
“Ha-ha-ha, if you must!”
Tuoba Liufeng grinned back and the Quanrong were looking at Zhuo Fan with mockery.
The spiritual beasts under them were their lifetime companions, listening to nobody’s orders but them.
As for cowering them, [Ha-ha, like that’s gonna happen!]
These weren’t your average beasts mind you, but comrades in arms as they had shed blood and sweat on the battlefield together. Their wills were tougher than ever.
It came as no surprise that no one believed Zhuo Fan was up to the task.
[Have it your way!]
Zhuo Fan snorted inside, took all the spiritual beasts in his eyes and his grin spread wider and wider.
Tuoba Liufeng’s instincts kicked in and his heart shuddered. As for the cause of the queasiness, he had no idea.
“Shove off!”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes glinted azure along with his bark. It rang louder and louder in the spiritual beasts’ ears.
It was then that a ripple swept across them.
The still cheerful spiritual beasts froze and their riders looked down stunned.
Before the riders could even grab their mane, the beasts were howling away.
Under the stunned gazes of everyone, the thousand spiritual beasts scampered off towards the city gates, running for their lives, paying no heed to the riders’ orders.
Something of incredible dread and terror consumed their minds, driving them insane and leaving them with only the instinct of fleeing. The bond between man and beast, forged in the thick of battle, through happiness and sadness, now laid broken.
“What the hell? Stop this instant!”
Tuoba Liufeng’s mount was also frantic, but no matter what he said, it wouldn’t listen.
So he took to the sky, watching the thousand beasts on the ground stampeding for the gates, the six 5th-level spiritual beasts included. It only took a second for them to clear the city.
They left behind a bunch of rattled and sorry-ass riders, with an unlucky few trampled under the horde, ending up with broken bones by the dozen.
There was not a face out there in another state than bugged-out and slack jawed. Except of course Long Xingyun’s gang on the second floor who only chuckled.
They had been through this kind of thing back in the Esoteric Debate, where Zhuo Fan scared away the Blood Crocs with a glare.
Using savage beasts in front of Zhuo Fan, was like asking for a beatdown.
Quanrong Empire, founded on beastmasters, had met their nemesis in Zhuo Fan…
The six people in the air faced this incredulous, inconceivable and preposterous scene with blank minds. Tuoba Liufeng even looked at his sister, “Lian’er, you’re the best at controlling beasts. Just what is going on here?”
“H-how should I know…”
Touba Lian’er soured for a second then recalled something. He squinted at Zhuo Fan for a whole fifteen minutes before crying, “It’s you!”
Zhuo Fan turned towards her, [Someone from Quanrong knows me?]
Zhuo Fan took a single look at her and his heart started beating a mile a minute. She was that same girl he had saved back in Beast King Mountain! The one he had swindled out of the Shaping Spring she had stuck her claim on.
[Oh, so she’s from the Quanrong Empire.]
Perhaps he didn’t care then to look closer, or it’s been too long that he didn’t spot her. When the Quanrong got here, all he cared about was their level. He had no intention to care about some woman’s looks.
Unlike that loaf Long Xingyun, who could tell on the spot how many moles a girl had.
Touba Lian’er hadn’t guessed either since Zhuo Fan now had a thick mane of white hair. But the instant Zhuo Fan scared the beasts off, she was brought back to Beast King Mountain.
On a closer look, she figured him out.
The two stared off, in silence and puzzlement.
[Who is he? What is he doing in the imperial capital? Who’s house’s Steward is he?]
[So the girl is a Quanrong. But what was she doing on Beast King Mountain, at the time of the Esoteric Debate no less? Does it have something to do with the Quanrong delegation’s aim for coming here?]
Zhuo Fan pondered.
On the second floor, Luo Yunchang’s face was hard, “That rotten, stinking prick! He knows another lady!”
“Sigh, another hottie falls into brother Zhuo’s clutches. I admit defeat.” Long Xingyun sat back with hands behind his head, “Just how many chicks does brother Zhuo know anyway? For him to get close to even the Quanrong Empire’s girls, he is one casanova!”
“Lian’er, do you know each other?” Tuoba Liufeng asked.
Touba Lian’er whispered, “Brother, he is the one I had talked about, the weird one I came across.”
[What?!]
Tuoba Liufeng set his bloodthirsty eyes on Zhuo Fan.
[There’s actually a man in this world with such absolute power over beasts. He is the greatest threat to us. He has to be put down…]

chapters.title: Chapter 393, Tianyu’s Number One Thorn
chapters.content:
Chapter 393, Tianyu’s Number One Thorn
Translator: StarReader
Ice-cold and unbridled killing intent shot forth. It stabbed into the people’s hearts like biting winds in the coldest winter.
“Damn, Tuoba Liufeng is usually calm. Why then, the sudden thirst for blood?” Dugu Feng grew nervous.
Long Xingyun grinned, “Why indeed. But even if they show their tough side again, brother Zhuo is sure to nail them dead. What’s there to worry about?”
“That’s exactly what I’m afraid of! Who here doesn’t know about Zhuo Fan’s temper? Irritated enough, those guys won’t see tomorrow. If anything happens to them, what will Tuoba Tieshan’s five million army at the border do?” Dugu Feng shook his head.
The rest stirred, [Makes sense.]
Zhuo Fan merely curled an eyebrow in glee, [Come on, make a move already…]
“Zha Lahan, Zhe Bie, falcon formation! We’ll do it in one move!” Tuoba Liufeng’s eyes trembled watching Zhuo Fan coldly.
The masked man nodded and Zha Lahan was exuberant. His flesh trembling in joy.
Imperial Tutor Han Tiemo wasn’t quite in agreement, “Liufeng, we don’t know what he can do or who’s behind him. Attacking him rashly is thoughtless…”
“Him being a threat is enough. He has got to go now or our beast armies will suffer.” Tuoba Liufeng set his jaw, “We are in an altercation with him now. This is the best excuse to ice him. When we see Tianyu’s emperor later, we’ll just say that the guy got too confident of his blue blood in stopping us and got killed by a stray attack!”
Han Tiemo nodded after a long pause, but his heart was still unsettled.
From the moment he had laid eyes on Zhuo Fan, the Imperial Tutor felt a thorn in his heart. This was his intuition he had built over the decades.
Thinking of the last time this feeling came, it was when he met Zhuge Changfeng…
[Sigh, Tianyu has so many talents.]
Han Tiemo noticed the sharp look in Zhuo Fan’s eyes and sighed.
“Attack!”
Zha Lahan laughed, going after Zhuo Fan with bloodshot eyes, his face twisted and savage. Zhe Bie took out a glittering golden longbow, pulling the string like second nature as he aimed for Zhuo Fan.
Snickering, Zhuo Fan flicked his right hand in contempt.
“Stop!”
An aged voice towered over the commotion and Zhuo Fan was found overshadowed by a figure pointing his long blade at the six, “Tuoba Liufeng, Han Tiemo, what do you think you’re doing?”
Rumble!
Zha Lahan paused at his arrival. Tuoba Liufeng sighed in the end, “Withdraw.”
Zhe Bie figured that was the case and put away his bow.
Tuoba Liufeng cupped his hands at the towering figure, expressing respect for once, “Marshal Dugu, it’s been ages.”
With the two nations tangled up in war for decades, the commanders had long since grown accustomed to one another, forming mutual respect. A hero valued another, regardless of which side they were on.
Quanrong’s entire leadership present here showed their respect to the man called Dugu Zhantian.
At the arrival of the marshal, everyone sighed, knowing the fight was a bust.
Zha Lahan snorted, unwilling to let Zhuo Fan just walk away. Zhuo Fan couldn’t care less. Oh, he did find it a darn shame as well, having lost the chance to probe them well.
Though not a complete waste of time as he did get a ballpark figure.
“Marshal Dugu, how can your people lack even common decency? We represent the Quanrong emperor in presenting your nation’s Majesty with a gift. Is this how a host acts? Scaring our mounts and harming our warriors?”
Touba Lian’er glared at Zhuo Fan while hurling her accusations. The way she figured was, with Dugu Zhantian’s position in Tianyu, if he didn’t give Zhuo Fan a heavy punishment, he’d at least give him something. Maybe a slap on the wrist?
That would settle her current and past hatred nicely.
A shame Dugu Zhantian saw Zhuo Fan lollygagging behind, sloppy, bored and uninterested; the perfect picture of an innocent bystander. Sighing, the old man went in the air towards the six.
The six were still very much respectful as Dugu Zhantian whispered, “Imperial Tutor, Tuoba Liufeng, seeing you far-away guests, I’ll give you a good-natured suggestion. Forget about your rancor and drop this issue here, for your sake. You can’t mess with that guy!”
The six were startled, looking at Zhuo Fan in shock.
The grand marshal of Tianyu was dead serious, even advising them against pushing it.
As the Quanrong delegation, they represented their empire. No matter which noble or powerful figure appeared, everyone ought to show a modicum of decency to pave the way to the nations’ peace talks.
And Dugu Zhantian was a man above a sea of people in Tianyu, respected and admired. Who would dare put on a tough front in front of him?
But the way he had worded his advice and his tone, all pointed towards the fact that the kid downstairs was above his station?
[Who the hell is this guy?]
After one last look at Zhuo Fan, they snapped their evil glares behind them, on Obscure Wolf. [Just how do you gather intel when you missed such a glaring threat?]
Hu Lianchai was downcast too, returning an angry stare, then lowering his head in shame.
Well he did have a look at all of Tianyu’s great men and houses. But who knew where this brat had popped out of, having such godlike power?
“Marshal Dugu, who is he? How come even you are reluctant to face him?” Touba Lian’er asked.
The rest of them put on the same inquisitive expression as well.
Dugu Zhantian sighed, “I am not reluctant, but simply find him a pain, a thorn to avoid. The second prince stepped on his toes and he leveled his home. You are the Quanrong and I fear that if anything happens to you, it will plunge our nation into a bitter war. I can’t have that. Ha-ha-ha, you must be thinking I stopped you for his sake, right? When I was in fact helping you!”
Rumble!
All of their minds were shell-shocked at the impact this news had.
Dugu Zhantian had revealed two crucial pieces of info. Zhuo Fan’s authority in Tianyu burst at the seams to ignore the emperor and kick a prince around.
Second was Zhuo Fan’s power. Not even the six of them could stop him, but instead might end up with casualties and worsening the ties between nations.
[Why is it that we’ve never heard a word of such a valiant character?]
On cue, they glanced at Hu Lianchai again, but the guy wiggled his body away and avoided the stabbing gazes. He wished he could stuff his head in his pants from shame, [How mortifying for an intelligence officer…]
“Let me take you to the Imperial Palace. Now remember, keep your distance as much as possible.”
Dugu Zhantian sighed, then flew towards Zhuo Fan, “Kid, I don’t care what happened, just please let this one go on my account. They are our guests!”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Fine, since the old Marshal asked, I will. Please do pass this along, this is my turf and not their backyard to jaywalk!”
Zhuo Fan was talking to Dugu Zhantian, sure, but he was so loud even deaf geezers could hear him.
And before he forgot, he left the six with a middle finger as goodbye, making the six’s face boil in rage. Only then he sauntered off to Yun Shuang, taking her through the Quanrong army like a champ.
The men pranked by Zhuo Fan were wailing. And now that he was parading among them, their anger pushed them to the edge.
But without the six’s orders, neither budged an inch, forced to let Zhuo Fan’s group swag their way across.
He didn’t leave them in the dust, but sure as hell left the Quanrong army without an ounce of dignity.
“Awesome!” Long Xingyun gave a thumbs up, “Sticking close to brother Zhuo is the best!”
Dugu Feng sighed, “Thank god Godfather mediated before the matter escalated. This maverick demonic dragon was assumed to be the wolves’ next meal, yet now they were the ones left wimping.”
Dugu Zhantian shook his head and led the outraged Quanrong’s six to the Imperial Palace.
Only this time, the six no longer had their cocky attitude, not after the bruises their pride took just a while back. Not in their dreams had they thought it humanly possible that in this trip to Tianyu, while they had barely crossed the city gates, they would be molded into shape. Forget about dignity, they had lost all self-respect.
Meanwhile, Prime Minister Zhuge Changfeng and all the officials stood before the Imperial Palace’s gates. They had waited and waited, until finally, by some miracle, the Quanrong arrived.
Except the six behind Dugu Zhantian, the rest looked like shuffling and dragging their feet, some even had to be carried.
Face twitching, the Minister of War whispered, “Prime Minister, are they the Quanrong? Why do they look like stragglers from a routed army?”
Zhuge Changfeng pondered and soon came to a conclusion with a smile, “Ha-ha-ha, I believe they were indeed routed. I reckon they went head to head with Tianyu’s number one thorn!”
The officials were stunned, then snickered inside.
[This new generation…]

chapters.title: Chapter 394, Same Side
chapters.content:
Chapter 394, Same Side
Translator: StarReader
Zhuge Changfeng welcomed them, ignoring their sorry states out of respect.
He led them inside the Imperial Palace, where a feast was held along with the officials. With how the emperor’s birthday had yet to come, the emperor wasn’t present.
After the feast, the delegation was taken to their quarters, outside Imperial Palace.
They stayed silent all this time, a veiled contempt at Tianyu’s lavish and exaggerated style. [You had us come in all this way, and now you want us out? We didn’t even see the emperor yet.]
[That’s a custom for you!]
[Going in for a feast is having good manners. But you’re not the big cheese here to live in the fancy and grand Imperial Palace!]
Quanrong’s six leaders entered a high class tavern, while the soldiers were housed in garrisons.
Garrisons guarded by Dugu Zhantian’s army. He said guarding, but it wasn’t much different from keeping an eye on them to curb any violent behavior on Quanrong’s part.
In the dead of night, a slim figure dodged the patrols and sneaked up to a lit up house, knocking twice, “Brother, it’s me.”
The door opened just a crack and the figure slipped right in. Looking up, she was no other than Touba Lian’er.
Six people were in the room, the leaders of the Quanrong Empire’s delegation and one who had yet to reveal his face.
“Who is he?” Touba Lian’er pointed at the robed person.
Tuoba Liufeng and the Imperial Tutor exchanged a smile.
When the hooded figure raised his head, he spoke in a familiar tone, “Ha-ha-ha, miss Lian’er, we’ve been chatting all day at the feast yet you’ve already forgotten me?”
Sss~
Touba Lian’er glanced at the aged man and stuttered, “Z-Zhuge Changfeng?! What are you…”
“Lian’er, don’t make a fuss, Prime Minister Zhuge…” Her brother smiled, “Is on the same side as us!”
[What?!]
Touba Lian’er stared at Zhuge Changfeng for a good while, not quite able to wrap her head around that notion. The great leader of Tianyu’s Four Pillars was on Quanrong’s side?
Zhuge Changfeng smiled at her obvious confusion, “Miss Lian’er, I and your esteemed father, Imperial Tutor and your emperor, have been in secret contact for decades. “
Lian’er blinked her big purty eyes, turning to her brother, only to find him nodding. Now a believer, she said, “I finally get why you were so confident in this mission. You had Prime Minister Zhuge on the inside. He’s the one you called the most reliable spy. “
Tuoba Liufeng merely grinned.
He then said, “Prime Minister sir, has there been no changes to the plan? I get the feeling the situation in Tianyu has gone through upheaval.”
“Ha-ha-ha, the young general is keen. It has indeed been so over these past few years. Our plan will just have to keep up with the times.” Zhuge Changfeng nodded, “Worry not though, the stage has changed in our favor and not against it!”
“How can you be so sure?” Han Tiemo said.
Zhuge Changfeng had a confident smile, “The original plan was to use the centennial jubilee as an excuse to bring high ranked Quanrong into the imperial capital. When the time is right, Commander Tuoba will put pressure on the borders, taking Dugu Zhantian away and leaving the playing field open for the Regent Estate to incite chaos in its conquest of the houses. With the emperor’s men busy with the mess, he’ll have no one next to him, giving us the perfect opportunity to cut his head. The plan was 90% assured of success. Once the emperor falls, the rest will follow. With no support, the veteran Dugu Zhantian will be beaten back as well. At this point, the Quanrong army will have free reign to go across the country, with Tianyu all for the taking!”
“The crucial point is for all these scenarios to happen at the same time. By the time the empire’s three guardian sects find out, it’ll be too late. We’ll just give them a little something to soothe them later and Tianyu will be ours!”
“Yes, that’s the original plan. But what has changed?” Han Tiemo asked.
Zhuge Changfeng’s eyes flashed, “This change came out of the blue to everyone. Tianyu no longer has Seven Noble Houses, rather eight. It is now in an even more tangled mess, with three factions in a deadlock. Even the ambitious Regent Estate finds this situation hard to overcome.”
“How can…” Tuoba Liufeng was frantic.
Zhuge Changfeng gave him a long look, “Actually, you’ve already met with the eighth house today. Luo clan, led by that steward, Zhuo Fan.”
“Zhuo Fan? The same one who blocked us?” Everyone cried out.
Tuoba Liufeng thirsted for blood, “He can’t be left alive. Since they are foiling our plan, then we will help Regent Estate in rooting them out!”
“Young master Tuoba, take it easy!”
Zhuge Changfeng threw a mocking smile, “If Zhuo Fan was such an easy target, he’d be dead ages ago. With all due respect, as you are now, facing Zhuo Fan will end with you all getting annihilated.”
Each of them was shocked and looked at Zhuge Changfeng incredulously.
Touba Lian’er snapped, “Prime Minister Zhuge is trying to scare us. I’ve met with Zhuo Fan before. He is strong, yes, but not invincible. Zha Lahan or Zhe Bie, in fact anyone here can easily kill him. With two against him, he is sure to breathe his last for good!”
Zha Lahan and Zhe Bie swelled with pride, [We ain’t top Quanrong warriors for nothing!]
Zhuge Changfeng shook his head, “Ha-ha-ha, miss Lian’er, when did you meet him? What was his cultivation?”
“Around… a year ago. He was a peak Bone Tempering cultivator then.” Touba Lian’er recalled, “Now that he’s in the 3rd layer of Profound Heaven Stage, it proves he’s incredible, but nothing we can’t handle.”
Zhuge Changfeng sighed, “Anything can change, given enough time. For a monster like Zhuo Fan, a year is more than enough! Ha-ha-ha, look beyond his low cultivation. Pitting your Radiant Stage experts against him is overconfidence and blind ambition. You’re setting yourself up for failure!”
Zha Lahan and Zhe Bie glowered as Zhuge Changfeng continued uncaringly and spoke with an exceedingly cold gaze, “Not to mention, Tianyu’s every faction is in a deadlock. Looks quiet from the outside but a storm is brewing underneath the surface. It’s the best time for our plan. And the best candidate to break the stalemate is none other than the dauntless Zhuo Fan. You can’t touch him before that, understand?”
Zhuge Changfeng’s speech ended with a command.
Not something the Quanrong’s top dogs would be keen to readily accept.
Only Han Tiemo was pensive before nodding, “You know the situation better than us. We will listen to the Prime Minister.”
Zhuge Changfeng nodded pleased. He chatted for a while longer and then slipped away.
His two elders were waiting outside.
With Zhuge Changfeng gone, Zha Lahan was the first to act out, “Imperial Tutor, young master, are we just going to do what the old fox said?”
“We have no choice. We are strangers in a strange land and shouldn’t act on a whim.” Han Tiemo said, “Obscure Wolf, you have three days to find out about Tianyu’s latest events. And this time, don’t let the factions’ relations and their actions escape your notice.”
Face red, Hu Lianchai bowed and left in the pitch-black night…
Meanwhile, in the Imperial Palace’s study, the emperor was reading the reports when a reportee came.
A black figure kneeled, “Your Majesty, news has come that the Quanrong delegation is housed. Also, the Prime Minister has made contact.”
The emperor’s beard shook and he grinned, “Ha-ha-ha, it has finally begun…”
The emperor took black and white pieces from a chess box beside him and threw them on the ground, “The pieces are in play. All that’s left is a checkmate…”
At the Parish’s observatory, Yun Shuang inspected the sky with the Heaven Communing Apparatus. Zhuo Fan stood watch with a frown, replaying today’s events.
That Quanrong girl in particular kept coming back to him.
Hum~
The Heaven Communing Apparatus stopped and Yun Shuang looked winded, with faint sweat on her brow.
“How is it, Shuang’er? Any changes for the better?” Zhuo Fan asked.
Shaking her head, Shuang’er was grave, “Not only there are no changes for the better, but the Crouching Dragon looks more imposing, ready to take flight.”
Zhuo Fan knew it to be the sign of being on the brink of ruling this land.
In other words, Quanrong’s arrival made the imperial family more powerful. [That’s terribly strange, unless…]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes glinted.
Yun Shuang begged, “Steward Zhuo, this sight has shown me that the land will be in even more chaos. The people will be in pain, suffering and will be wretched. I beg of you, please save them! You alone can change this fate!
“Yun clan people are so strange. You’ve set aside your revenge for your kin and instead care for others.” Zhuo Fan grinned, “No worries, you are with me now. I will help you achieve your wish.”
“No, it’s for the people…” Yun Shuang justified.
Zhuo Fan teased, “I’ll do it for you, but don’t feel like doing the same for the people. Now, who do you want me to do it for again?”
“For… me…” Blushing, Yun Shuang lowered her head.
Zhuo Fan laughed, his mind filled with constant thoughts.
[Everyone is dead focused on the Luo clan…]

chapters.title: Chapter 395, Picking a Spot
chapters.content:
Chapter 395, Picking a Spot
Translator: StarReader
For three days, the Quanrong delegation was confined to the garrisons. Lacking the emperor’s direct summons, the guards looked dangerously close to wardens by now.
They were bored out of their minds, waiting for Hu Lianchai to send back something, anything.
Hum~
With a ripple, a tall wall of the courtyard wiggled at one spot, followed by the sneaky Hu Lianchai finally making his appearance.
With no guard being any wiser, Tuoba Liufeng signaled them to get back in the room to discuss.
“Hu Lianchai, have you found out Tianyu’s situation?” Tuoba Liufeng asked.
Hu Lianchai gave a heavy nod and saluted, “Young master, Tianyu is just like we’ve learnt from Prime Minister Zhuge, having experienced great change. All brought upon by the same man that stopped our march, Zhuo Fan. He is a hard man to deal with.”
“Eh?”
Tuoba Liufeng raised an eyebrow, staring him in the eye and motioning to continue.
After taking a moment to organize his thoughts from his overexcited heart, Hu Lianchai stressed every word, “Based on my investigation, there was no eighth noble house eight years ago, but a nameless third-rate clan. But under Steward Zhuo’s leadership, this clan struck like lightning, killing everyone in their path to reach the status of Eighth Noble House. He is a rare talent, with a sharp mind and boundless might…”
Hu Lianchai gave a systematic recount of the clan’s history. Sighing now and then, but all out of respect and fear. The narration took half a day.
Everyone watched him blankly, their lips dry, unable to believe. Tuoba Liufeng and Imperial Tutor were downright plagued with worry.
In less than a decade, he had raised a third-rate clan into a house, even surpassing their thousand-year-old legacy. This man was a true rarity.
He wasn’t just some guy with a gimmick, but an unheard of genius in the truest sense of the word.
“Hu Lianchai, are you sure you aren’t wrong? How could this have happened? How is he so strong?” Zha Lahan protested in his denial.
Rolling his eyes, Hu Lianchai was just as bitter, “Do you think I want to believe this fairy tale? Am I that much of a fool? Everyone on the streets knows about this, down to the last bum. I am forced to believe it!”
“That’s why Zhuge Changfeng told us to stay clear of him. He is a serious threat. It’s best we follow his advice for now.” Han Tiemo said.
Tuoba Liufeng squinted while pondering but nodded in the end, “He will become our end if we don’t get rid of him. But with how few we are, it’ll be hard if he possesses the skills they say he does. We need to think of the bigger picture.”
Tuoba Liufeng had to accept it no matter how much it pained him.
Zha Lahan was completely against it still.
[Didn’t Tuoba Lian’er just say that me and Zhe Bie are enough to waste him?]
[This is absurd!]
The young commander had complete trust in the Eight Wolf Wardens. Any impossible mission would be completed once they stepped in. So why was it that against a Tianyu whelp, he had lost all confidence?
Zha Lahan grumbled inside, glancing at Zhe Bie. From his icy look, he figured the guy was of the same mind.
“Now we know Tianyu’s situation and need only to wait for the emperor’s summons. Hu Lianchai, resume scouting and report anything you find, even rumors. The rest of you are dismissed.”
“Understood!”
Tuoba Liufeng had them all withdraw. Hu Lianchai bowed.
As they all went their separate ways and Hu Lianchai was all hush-hush in his sneaking out, someone called out, “Hu Lianchai, wait.”
Hu Lianchai turned to see Touba Lian’er bringing Zha Lahan and Zhe Bie. He bowed, “Young miss, do you need me?”
“Hu Lianchai, your stealth cultivation method is rare in this world. Can you also take us along?” Lian’er looked at him with hope flashing in her eyes.
Hu Lianchai frowned, “Young miss, are you…”
“Ha-ha-ha, to be perfectly honest, old pal, we want to get rid of that insufferable prick!” Zha Lahan shouted, his face twisted with malice.
Hu Lianchai paled, “You can’t! Let’s say the rumors about him are inflated, but that doesn’t mean you can beat him. We still don’t know what he did to reach such a high position, all by himself too. Moving without the Imperial Tutor and young master’s consent will affect the plan. We can’t take responsibility for that. I just can’t take you!”
The three nodded, figuring as much.
Still, Touba Lian’er continued, “Then we won’t kill him, and will just teach him a lesson. Hu Lianchai, you’ve heard it as well, how brother isn’t confident in you Eight Wolf Wardens. We have to prove him wrong, to wash away this shame as Quanrong warriors.”
“What if the kid is as godlike as they say…”
“Enough ifs. Rumors always tend to exaggerate. When have you seen someone that strong around? Taking the attacks of two peak Radiant Stage experts at the 3rd layer of Profound Heaven Stage? That’s inhuman.”
Touba Lian’er cut him off with a strong objection, “Zha Lahan, with your innate power, you’ve lived among spiritual beasts deep in the mountains until twenty. Can you do it? Do you believe such a ridiculous thing actually took place on this earth?”
Zha Lahan shook his head with a smile, “Young miss, I don’t mean to brag but I have yet to find someone who can survive my strength. When I entered the Radiant Stage, I could handle a peak Radiant Stage body cultivator’s attack, while two would be somewhat harder. This is why I do not give credence to what Hu Lianchai says about the prick’s masterstroke. It is a fantasy, a made up fairy tale!”
“Yeah. I’ve met the guy and even though he is fast at cultivation, that doesn’t make him invincible. We’re only going to expose the charlatan for who he is and showcase the divine might of Quanrong!” Touba Lian’er’s face was filled with pride, “Not to mention that bastard was mean to me back in Beast King Mountain. He even stole my stuff. And I’m supposed to just let him get away with it? We, Quanrong, are no pushovers!”
Hu Lianchai nodded.
They were warriors who didn’t know how to retreat. Of course they’d be sure to vent their miss’ temper tantrum.
With no more preamble, Hu Lianchai nodded, “Alright, young miss, enter my beast holding ring. I’ll take you out.”
Eyes aglint, Touba Lian’er and the other two perked up.
In a flash of white, Hu Lianchai had them tucked away.
Hu Lianchai’s figure shimmered and he soon blended in with nature, moving around like a heat wave…
Meanwhile, in the Regent of Prosperity’s Compound’s garden, Zhuo Fan was sipping green tea under a pavilion. In front of him were a handful of rocks scattered around on the table.
Zhuo Fan was steadily looking at them.
“Steward Zhuo, what’s on your mind?” A soft voice broke his reverie, noticing Yun Shuang coming over.
The stones had names on them, to which Yun Shuang said, “I see, Steward Zhuo is brainstorming how to get out of this impasse.”
“Yeah, the four factions, including Quanrong, are now in a stand-off.” Zhuo Fan smiled, sipping his tea, and weighed a rock, “Neither side wants the deadlock to persist, looking for a palooka so hard in the head that he’d smash this stalemate wide open. But who’d be willing to become the eye of the storm, the public enemy number one, whose fate is to be torn to shreds?”
Yun Shuang looked at him at a loss, scratching her head.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “I didn’t want to do it, but Shuang’er, what I understood from your readings is that all these insidious players have one thing in common, they all want to make me the scapegoat. Such a fate is hard to change, even if I’m willing.”
Yun Shuang saw the look in his eyes and started to worry.
Zhuo Fan laughed at her look, “Relax, since I know heaven’s direction, I’ll just move against the grain. They want me to become the center of it all, that’s fine by me. They’ll just have to witness the second coming of Gu Santong!
“But unlike him, I’m not one to fall so easily, he-he-he…” Zhuo Fan snickered.
Yun Shuang sighed. She had yet to get used to seeing his evil grin, but felt at ease knowing Zhuo Fan had made up his mind.
Yongning took this moment to make her presence noticed, in her fashionable and cross-gender-cross-cultural-cross-age-cross-dressing scholarly getup, “Shuang’er, Zhuo Fan, to celebrate imperial father’s centennial jubilee, the imperial capital is holding a lantern festival. Let’s all go.”
“You sneaked out again?” Zhuo Fan was in no mood, “Not interested!”
Yongning deflated and turned to Yun Shuang. As the good sister she was, Yun Shuang knew what Yongning was thinking, “Steward Zhuo, the imperial capital is in turmoil and for two weak girls to go alone…”
“Fine, fine, you’re an asset I have to protect and keep close.” Zhuo Fan waved to her and shook his head.
The girls hid a sneaky smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 396, Ambush at Lantern Festival
chapters.content:
Chapter 396, Ambush at Lantern Festival
Translator: StarReader
On the night of the Lantern Festival, you couldn’t swing a dead cat without hitting someone. With their emperor’s birthday fast approaching, the buildings were decorated with lanterns turning the capital into a breathtaking scene.
Many romantics and couples took full advantage of this rare occasion to get together and whisper sweet nothings to their better half.
Then again, an exception was almost guaranteed to exist. Sticking out like a sore thumb was a guy with white hair, surrounded by three belles and at the admiration of the crowd.
[Buddy, you’re one daring trailblazer on the righteous path of love. We, poor fellows, only date one on the night of Lantern Festival, while you’ve come out with three. I tip my hat to you sir!]
The eerie looks came everywhere he went. Zhuo Fan’s face was twitching looking at the girls with a sigh.
Yongning wanted to come with Yun Shuang, but since Luo Yunchang overheard them, she just had to join. She even shot down anyone else who wanted to join them, lest they became a third wheel.
[Sister please, isn’t it already a crowd with three girls in tow?]
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes, hearing the bubbly girls giggle and chatter. All this time he was sighing and sighing.
At some point, a sharp and heavy sound came followed by a mighty pressure clearly focused on Zhuo Fan.
“Dodge!”
Zhuo Fan waved at the girls, sweeping them off their feet and sending them a hundred meters away.
Yongning ended up sputtering dust from the maltreatment. She slapped the ground, getting to her feet and told him off, “Zhuo Fan, what the hell is wrong with you?”
She was royally pissed. Here she was taking the guy on a night out and earning some brownie points, and the twit had sent her flying.
[That’s no way to treat a friend, especially a princess!]
But noticing that Zhuo Fan was staring at the sky, she did as well and gasped.
The other girls paled as well, filled with worry for Zhuo Fan.
A bludgeon easily ten meters in diameter came smashing on Zhuo Fan’s head. On the other end of the mace was Zha Lahan, with bloodshot eyes and a malignant face.
He wanted to flatten Zhuo Fan in one strike.
[He-he-he, you pompous cretin, weren’t you godlike? Try this on for size!]
Zha Lahan cackled inside. The average people participating in the lovely festival shivered all over and scurried for their lives.
[Where did that meteor come from? It’ll ruin the celebration…]
The ever cold Zhuo Fan flicked his Qilin arm, now shining red.
Bam!
Zhuo Fan smacked the bludgeon into the pavement, sending an earthquake that flattened anything in its path, destroying the lanterns.
The girls flew again from the shock wave, with blood coming from their mouths.
Finally recovering their wits after the fall, they found a dozens of meter wide crater at the epicenter. The golden bludgeon stood there majestic and Zhuo Fan was buried under it.
“Zhuo Fan!”
The girls’ cries went unanswered.
Zha Lahan floated above, pleased as punch, holding the mace, “Ha-ha-ha, I knew you weren’t up to snuff. One smash and I’ve plastered you. I should’ve just used a third of my power instead!”
“Zha Lahan!”
A figure flashed above the mace, Touba Lian’er, “Look what you’ve done? Didn’t we say we’re only teaching him a lesson? Why kill him? And there’s not even a corpse left. How will we explain this to the others?”
Shrugging, Zha Lahan chuckled, “It’s not my fault that the brat was weak and was posing around with that cocky attitude. What taking two peak Radiant Stage experts’ attacks? That was clearly a lie! If I had known he was a wimp, an average Profound Heaven cultivator, I’d have used only 1%. Humph, he had it coming.”
“That’s besides the point. It was us who acted first. With such a ruckus, our plan…” Touba Lian’er facepalmed.
Her rant came to a halt when a casual voice said, “What ‘is’ your plan?”
The two watched the massive bludgeon rocking, unleashing heavy tremors.
“Y-young miss, that power…”
Zha Lahan felt himself being lifted along with his arm no matter what he did to stop it.
The force came from the crater and he realized that he didn’t have enough strength to fight it.
[This is impossible! Since when did the world have such a mighty being!]
Zha Lahan narrowed his eyes and watched Zhuo Fan lifting the mace up with one hand, like a giant holding the heavens.
His casual look gave the feeling that he wasn’t even pushing it.
“Zhuo Fan!” The girls cheered.
Touba Lian’er pointed with a trembling finger, “H-he’s still alive and not a scratch on him. Zha Lahan, use everything to push him back!”
“I already am!” Gnashing his teeth, Zha Lahan’s face twisted as he swelled under the strain. But no amount of strength proved to be of any use, still being unable to budge the mace.
Touba Lian’er paled, looking at Zhuo Fan like he was a monster.
[Can the rumors be true? Does he truly surpass the strongest of our people, Zha Lahan?]
She used to think that her father’s Savage Wolf was the strongest person there was. But today, Zhuo Fan was handling him like a child.
Zhuo Fan put on a savage grin, “This doesn’t look like a good place to chat. That makes this stick an eyesore.”
With a cold glint, Zhuo Fan gripped harder.
Crack~
Snapping sounds jarred the ears of everyone as the bludgeon was covered in fractures.
Zhuo Fan added just a hint more oomph and the giant stick fell into pieces.
Everyone watched in stunned silence. The Quanrong were even more shocked.
[The purple gold-forged Heaven Breaking Bludgeon was a 5th-grade spiritual weapon and this guy used his brawn alone to crush it in his hand.]
[What is he?]
Zha Lahan’s face was unnatural, to say the least. He had never heard of such freakish power and was now shocked to his core.
As a typical narcissist, he took it upon himself as being the best there was, only to face the harsh and cruel reality. There would always be someone better.
Zhe Bie and Hu Lianchai acted as spectators, scared out of their minds. The rumors didn’t even do Zhuo Fan’s power justice.
[That damn hearsay is asking us to get beat! In what way is he any weaker?]
Hu Lianchai felt like crying. His intel gathering had hit a snag again…
Zhuo Fan drifted over to a panicked Touba Lian’er, his smile wide and creepy, “About that plan of yours, care to fill me in?”
Gulping, Touba Lian’er was lost for words in fear.
Zha Lahan sweated buckets, his eyes only reflecting fear. But he wasn’t part of the Eight Wolf Wardens for nothing. He wouldn’t give up just like that.
It went double for when his young miss was under threat.
While Zhuo Fan was focused on Lian’er, he took out an identical bludgeon. After a short wind up, he socked Zhuo Fan’s head with it.
Zhuo Fan never even looked, merely flicking it away in pieces.
While the weapon’s owner’s arm snapped from the power running through the crumbling bludgeon.
Zha Lahan still hadn’t woken up to smell the roses. A mere wave from Zhuo Fan broke Quanrong’s best warrior’s arm like a twig.
[This freak is not human. He is worse than a spiritual beast!]
Zha Lahan’s arm dangled while he sweated like a pig. His heart was consumed by fear and in denial of what was right in front of him. It took a long time for it to sink in, the fear, the dread, the futility of it all.
Touba Lian’er gave the wretched Zha Lahan a long look, then looked at the grinning Zhuo Fan. [The poor girl was about to cry.]
She was really regretting it now, messing with a monster without rhyme or reason.
Zhe Bie at the side, had his bow and arrow primed, aimed between Zhuo Fan’s eyes. He was also soaked in sweat, it was Sky-piercing Wolf’s first time facing such a thorn.

chapters.title: Chapter 397, The Tragic Case of the Divine Archer
chapters.content:
Chapter 397, The Tragic Case of the Divine Archer
Whoosh~
Flashes of golden ripped the sky, each one going for Zhuo Fan. Upon a closer look, those golden lights were nothing more than golden arrows.
They pierced the clouds, surging with relentless power and, what’s more, were in the hundreds.
It was beyond comprehension how one man could shoot so many arrows. And those weren’t your run-of-the-mill arrows either, but 5th-grade spiritual weapons.
Each arrow was locked onto Zhuo Fan’s vitals. Even before they arrived, Zhuo Fan already got the feeling of turning into a pincushion.
“That’s Sky-piercing Wolf’s ultimate skill, Ninth Heaven Impaler?” Raising an eyebrow just a smidge, Zhuo Fan nodded, “Not bad, he does have the skill of a divine archer to be able to injure Dugu Zhantian.”
Touba Lian’er looked grave, “Y-you know Zhe Bie?”
“Sure, I heard of him from my young master. And he heard it from his foster brothers, Four Tigers of Tianyu!” Zhuo Fan smiled, “Miss Lian’er, now don’t go thinking only you do your homework. Our side likes gossip too. Of course I got to hear of our dear friend’s remarkable skill.”
Zhuo Fan lifted his right arm towards the incoming rain of arrows. It shone red and he grinned, “His bow and arrow can be as strong as he likes but they still won’t ever get to best my sacred arm!”
Touba Lian’er realized he knew everything about them. Taking him by surprise was nigh impossible now. A darn shame Zhe Bie was the exception…
“Humph, posh prick, people don’t just pace around, they improve. Everything you know about us is outdated!” Touba Lian’er snickered, grabbing Zha Lahan and flying away.
Zhuo Fan was at a loss seeing her pull some distance.
And then it happened.
The shining arrow rain split in every direction. They surrounded Zhuo Fan and only then shot towards him.
Now Zhuo Fan had no way to dodge, being at the center of an imploding sphere of arrows.
Any weakness Zhuo Fan had would be most clearly struck. His two beast fists were in no way capable of defending every inch of him either.
He was at death’s door!
“Ha-ha-ha, see that rotten jerk, that’s Zhe Bie’s newest ultimate, Thousand Arrow Focal. This is his first time using it on the field. Try and block that!” Touba Lian’er was delighted in Zhuo Fan’s plight.
The girls below were worried sick.
The smile on Zhe Bie grew and grew.
He knew exactly what this move could do. Each arrow was a 5th-grade spiritual weapon, each fired at full power and now had the guy surrounded. It was impossible to make a perfect dodge or block. Even if Zhuo Fan survived, he’d be in a world of pain.
[This is called flawless archery!]
Zhe Bie had moved himself by what he had accomplished. Using his newest ultimate on a super expert like Zhuo Fan was the best field test.
Zhuo Fan wasn’t that thrilled. He sighed and dropped his hand, “Word on the street is that Ninth Heaven Impaler is incredible. I thought of giving it a shot and to see how my arm fairs. Yet instead I’m stuck with some thousand arrow something, how droll.”
Pff!
Zhe Bie almost spat blood.
His toil and sweat in creating this ultimate skill had earned a huge ixnay by Zhuo Fan’s evaluation. His heart couldn’t take it.
[Humph, ignorant sad sack, we’ll see who’s crying later!]
Touba Lian’er stuck out her head, having the same reaction, “Humph, cut the act. You may be strong, but not even you can fend off this attack. You’re finished!”
The sparkling arrows were this close to prick Zhuo Fan, not that he cared, “How about a bet? If even one arrow touches me, my head is yours. If not, I ask Miss to be kind enough to explain that little plan of yours.”
“Fine!”
Touba Lian’er was incensed, replying on the spot. While Zha Lahan was panicking, “Young miss…”
Lian’er dissed him with a wave. The glittering arrows were now a meter away from Zhuo Fan. There was no way he could get out of that, not when they covered all exits.
Touba Lian’er thought this bet was a foregone conclusion.
Zha Lahan nodded as well, snickering inside.
[The kid is strong, but not capable of avoiding all of that. Young Miss will win by a landslide!]
But their next reaction was, [Holy mother of god, how can he do this?!]
Zhuo Fan squinted, a soul ripple flashed and he picked up on Zhe Bie hiding behind a tree a thousand meters out.
Zhe Bie sensed it as well and knew that Zhuo Fan had found him. Though he wasn’t afraid.
The arrows were this close to turning Zhuo Fan into a pincushion. He had bigger things to worry about than the shooter.
Under the shocked and disbelieving gazes, Zhuo Fan lifted his right arm like a king and snapped his fingers just as the first arrow reached his chest, demanding, “Go.”
Whoosh~
The hundreds of arrows disappeared, appearing a thousand meters away, aimed at Zhe Bie’s hidey hole.
“What the hell?”
Zhe Bie was scared out of his mind and dropped all demeanor, now surrounded by his own attack.
With blasts galore, each arrow went for where it hurt.
Flashes streaked the night sky on and off, in tune with the wails of agony in between. Venturing a guess, it was safe to assume that the divine archer had no friggin’ clue how the hell this had happened.
His first lab rat for his newest ultimate was himself?
Something black and smoking plopped onto the ground, twitching now and then, squirting blood from god knew where. All that was secondary though, what mattered was the gibberish coming from his mouth, with shock reflecting clearly in his eyes.
More or less along the lines of cursing and wailing.
Zhuo Fan’s right eye’s golden halo subsided and he laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, a true Sky-piercing Wolf and of flawless aim. Every last one of those hundreds of arrows hit true. I bow before the master!”
Touba Lian’er and Zha Lahan were slack jawed. Their minds were spewing curses, obscenities and vulgarity faster than that divine archer’s shot.
[What… just happened? What did he do? Oh, god!]
Lost was the look of confidence and pride on the two. All they could express was fear and shock.
[Where the hell did he come from? The arrows just turned on their own maker without so much as a warning. How in blazes is that even possible?]
Zhuo Fan smiled his creepy grin, “Miss Lian’er, it appears that we have a winner in our little bet. I do hope you’ll concede.”
Gulping, the two faltered away from Zhuo Fan. Looking at him like he was a monster hell itself spat out.
Zhuo Fan wasn’t just brawn, but armed with fancy tricks.
Now they realized how true Zhuge Changfeng’s warning rang. He had cleaved through the seven houses by himself so far for a damn good reason!
[Sweet mother of mercy, just who in hell would ever mess with this freak?]
They even praised Regent Estate’s balls for actually fighting this guy for so long…
“Miss Lian’er, there are two kinds of people I abhor. The overconfident ones, and weasels. You’ve checked the first type. Now I hope, for your sake, you won’t make the mistake of checking the second. I may have to actually get serious.” Zhuo Fan stared them down.
Touba Lian’er’s heart was in pain. Zhuo Fan had appropriated all of her Shaping Spring back in Beast King Mountain and along with all those ingredients on top, leaving her high and dry.
And now he had the cheek to preach to her about welchers. This guy was a filthy skeeve.
Zha Lahan was turning red wanting to plunge his head into something, anything.
He was Quanrong’s finest in terms of strength, cleaning the battlefield like a reaper on his day off.
