With a gesture, the arrays opened up a path for Zhuo Fan to walk in. The Luo clan responded on the spot at the commotion, only to burst with joy.
“Brother Zhuo, I thought something happened to you after what happened with the emperor, that you were hounded on every side. Only when I met with sister Shuang’er, I realized it was all part of your grand plan. I could finally breathe easier, ha-ha-ha!” Luo Yunhai welcomed.
Zhuo Fan nodded, seeing everyone here took a weight off his shoulder. Leng Wuchang kept his word.
“You jerk! Why didn’t you tell us it’s part of the plan? We were worried sick…” Luo Yunchang blamed him.
Zhuo Fan merely waved his hand, “Elder Li, did you finish what I asked?”
The elders looked at each other in sorrow.
Li Jingtian was forced to speak up, “Steward Zhuo, we were eager at first, to get the materials, ingredients and spirit stones you asked of us. But we are a new house and the mines in our domain are few. And ever since you’ve been added to the top of the empire’s wanted list, those vassals stay clear of us, not wanting to have anything to do with this mess. We were unable to get everything in such a situation.
“Also, our guards are defending the thousand members of the Yun clan, who, per your instructions, are at the foot of Blackwind Mountain, digging a thousand mile wide bunker.”
“Good. As long as the bunker is ready, it’s fine. I’ve brought the rest.” Zhuo Fan snickered.
In a flash, Blackwind Mountain was overloaded with heaps of materials and ingredients as well as spirit stones.
Everyone’s mind froze. How did Zhuo Fan get so many riches? Did he have an empire under him?
He had brought out a hundred times of what the rest of them had scraped together.
“Now, follow my earlier plan and handle these. The lands will soon be ours!” Zhuo Fan’s step was firm as he walked before them.
Everyone was still out of it even as he was gone from sight.
[What did Steward Zhuo do in the last few months to get filthy rich? He’s a total upstart!]
[You won’t even need to fight for the lands when you can just buy them.]

chapters.title: Chapter 417, Taunt
chapters.content:
Chapter 417, Taunt
Translator: StarReader
A chilling wind blew that night as the stars glittered like eternal fireworks.
The light was still on in the Imperial Palace’s study. The eerie sound of the wind rattling the window was putting everyone on edge.
A sigh came now and then, reflecting the same state on the inside.
“Mr. Sima, why do you think that rotten Huangpu Tianyuan is still so late in making his move? I even handed him the power over the seven houses. Such perfect opportunities don’t come cheap!”
The emperor’s fingers drummed the table, his eyes sharp as blades.
Sima Hui replied, “Your Majesty, Leng Wuchang is no fool. He asked for the Luo clan to gain an excuse for its expansion campaign. His delayed start, however, points at his sight on the imperial capital.”
“How can Regent Estate start a war with a peaceful imperial capital? If anything, he’ll wait for all his forces to be in place, to respond to Zhuo Fan and Your Majesty at the same time, before beginning.” Fang Qiubai offered.
The emperor smiled in anger, “Every one of those cunning old foxes are just standing by, watching. Zhuge Changfeng is doing it, and so is Leng Wuchang. Humph, the spark to ignite both the court and the nation can happen any moment. But no one wants to stick their neck out, in fear of getting hunted by a third. Both conflicts have to happen at the same time.
“Out there, the civil war of Regent Estate with Zhuo Fan is a battle of supremacy. But is my struggle here with Zhuge Changfeng any different? Just that this crafty geezer leaves me no opening to grab onto. The people will denounce me if I start attacking the Prime Minister without a good excuse. But with how quiet it is in here, how can the war start outside?” The emperor sighed.
Sima Hui bowed, “Your Majesty, Zhuge Changfeng brought the Quanrong with his authority using the celebration as an excuse. He must be colluding with them. The event has passed yet the delegation is still around. Your Majesty will soon get the best reason to cast them out. It won’t be long before Your Majesty will… “
“Cough, cough, cough…”
The emperor’s violent coughing fit broke his speech. Taking away the handkerchief, there was blood on it.
“Your Majesty!” Everyone panicked.
The emperor had them relax, took his medicine and eased a breath, feeling much better.
Turning to the others, the emperor smiled, “It’s fine, but my life is coming to an end. I can’t hold on for long. An emperor is different from a cultivator. With so many affairs taking up my time, I have little time left for training and to increase my lifespan. Ha-ha-ha, not even I can fight it. Yes, Mr. Sima is right. We have no time to lose. The only one suffering from dragging this any longer will be me.”
Sima Hui bowed and sighed inside. The others showed their utmost respect for the emperor in a flourish of their own.
An emperor, beset by court affairs and limited by time, still wanted to fight with all he had to leave a peaceful and unified world, his legacy, for a successor.
The people might remember him for being weak and mock him for his incompetence, but only his men knew the truth. He was just like the emperors of old, bold and powerful.
“Hear my edict!”
The emperor boomed, “Divine Dragons Sima Hui, Fang Qiubai and Shadow King are to set for Regent Estate and assist the Estate Lord Huangpu Tianyuan in capturing Zhuo Fan. Set out at once!”
[What?!]
The men were in complete shock.
Sima Hui urged, “Your Majesty, the imperial capital is still in unrest. Who will protect you if we go? Please delay your order!”
“Please, Your Majesty!” The others bowed.
The emperor smiled, his gaze set, “I am just giving them a chance to run amok, ha-ha-ha!”
The emperor flicked his hand and left with a carefree laughter.
Only the men were still standing there looking at themselves lost.
They knew their lord’s character. His orders were final. The Divine Dragons and Shadow King had to obey…
Whoosh~
Three dots flew out of the imperial capital, but the news spread like lightning.
In Prime Minister’s home, Zhuge Changfeng was sipping wine in his backyard, enjoying the moon. The ground at his feet swelled and turned into a human shape.
Hu Lianchai looked excited, “Prime Minister Zhuge, we’ve just got word that all experts around the emperor went after Zhuo Fan. Young master and Imperial Tutor wish to ask if we should act now.”
“Ha-ha-ha, what act? You couldn’t have enjoyed all what the imperial capital has to offer now with it being so large. Won’t it be better to take a stroll around town, partake in the customs and just live in the moment?” Zhuge Changfeng snickered as he sipped his wine.
Hu Lianchai shouted, “Prime Minister sir, Quanrong warriors haven’t come to watch the sunset, you know that!”
“Of course I know. It is why I’m telling you to relax and do whatever. Don’t play into the old man’s hand.” Zhuge Changfeng shook his head.
Hu Lianchai didn’t understand, “Prime Minister sir, is this all a trap? But I am certain the two Divine Dragons and Shadow King have left. The emperor is defenseless!”
“Ha-ha-ha, how naive. No Divine Dragons around and being defenseless are two different things. Don’t be hasty, the old coot has come prepared.” Sipping again, Zhuge Changfeng waved him off.
Hu Lianchai turned and muttered as he left, “Humph, Tianyu is filled with cowards. Not acting even at such a golden time…”
“What did you say?”
Zhuge Changfeng warned in his most serious tone, “Give your young master and Imperial Tutor a message. For the next few days, stay calm. You can all die for all I care, but if you threaten the success of my plan over something trivial, you have another thing coming.”
Zhuge Changfeng might be a mere Profound Heaven cultivator, but he was the Prime Minister. His icy tone sent shivers even into Hu Lianchai, a Radiant Stage expert.
“Go back!” Zhuge Changfeng barked.
Hu Lianchai nodded, sinking back into the mud. Left alone, Zhuge Changfeng resumed tasting his wine, “Old man, you’ve finally cast your net. But isn’t using this bait a little dangerous? Or is there something else you’re hiding besides Divine Dragons and Shadow King?”
Zhuge Changfeng contemplated.
Meanwhile, in the second prince’s brand new manor, the prince was pacing around the lounge, his hands shaking all the time.
A shadow slipped in under the cover of the night, Hell Valley’s newest mastermind, You Ming.
“Your Highness, you asked for me?” You Ming bowed.
Second prince shot for him in restlessness, “Sir You Ming, perfect timing. I’ve just heard a crucial piece of information…”
Second prince’s eyes darted around, then he whispered when the coast was clear, “Imperial father’s two Divine Dragons and Shadow King went after Zhuo Fan. Imperial father is defenseless.”
Even a moron could see that this was a taunt, [And only a dumbass like you would fall for it! Then again, if not for your dimwittedness, I’d never get to play you like a fiddle.]
You Ming hid his thoughts well, only showing a faint smile, “Second prince, I do not understand what you wish from me.”
“To, uhm, Sir You Ming, you should understand. The situation right now… “
Second prince was jittery, flailing his arms around, but still couldn’t quite get the nerve to say those few little not-so-innocent words.
“Sir You Ming, you know how Holy Maiden judged me unfit to rule…”
“Second prince is too anxious. Regarding fate, three parts are heaven’s will and seven parts hard work. You’re no believer to enter the stage, nor would you have let Yun Xuanji read Huangpu Qingtian’s fate. And didn’t Huangpu Qingtian with his right to rule get killed in the end?”
“Yeah, I also believe all this hype about providence is nonsense.” Second prince agreed, “That is why I asked for you, Sir You Ming, to help me rewrite fate.”
“Second prince, I cannot even read fate.” You Ming played the fool, knowing fully well the schmuck’s mind.
Second prince took a breath to cool his jets, “Sir Leng, I want you to advise me on my next course of action.”
“Wait and see.” You Ming spoke.
Second prince was disappointed, “But the situation now…”
“Your Highness, why ask for me if your mind is set?” You Ming cut him off with a smile.
Second prince shook his head, “To me, Sir You Ming is the brightest mind in the world, better than Leng Wuchang and Zhuge Changfeng. None of them could play Zhuo Fan, but Sir Ming’s advice of asking Yun Shuang’s hand got the kid good. He isn’t just on the ropes, but has the entire nation after him. Sir Ming is a true mastermind! Since you’ve told me to stay put, then that’s what I’ll do.”
You Ming nodded with a pleased smile, but snickered inside.
[You fool, do you take Zhuo Fan for a mental case to fall for such a gimmick? He was in on it the whole time! Who do you think had me use you to set it up in the first place?]
[Humph, this moron is hopeless. Better to side with Regent Estate and Zhuo Fan and take the first chance I get to sell out this fool.]
You Ming’s grin earned the second prince’s complete trust, then he praised, “Good child.”

chapters.title: Chapter 418, Pushing Through
chapters.content:
Chapter 418, Pushing Through
Translator: StarReader
“Sir Leng, what are you doing here?”
At the super secret huge array thousands of meters under Caged Dragon City, the tough and muscled figure of Huangpu Fenglei walked up from behind Leng Wuchang.
Heart tense, Leng Wuchang replied, “What I must.”
“Sir Leng should oversee the situation outside and not keep watch over the Dragon Vein seal. You need to deploy the Venerables!” Huangpu Fenglei’s tone was cold, “Information has been received from the imperial capital. The Divine Dragons are on the move and the emperor is alone. You must have an idea about what we need to do next!”
“Wait and see.” Leng Wuchang’s reply was on point.
Huangpu Fenglei frowned, “Sir Leng, please reconsider before making hasty decisions. This is our best chance.”
“Nothing is more important than this moment. Our best choice is to wait and see.” Leng Wuchang’s eyes never left the array.
Huangpu Fenglei felt something was off. Being around Leng Wuchang for so long, he knew this was not his usual style.
[Wait for what?]
Huangpu Fenglei glanced about, “Sir Leng, how come I haven’t seen Estate Lord around? Usually when one of you is around, the other is not far behind. What is he up to being missing for so long?”
“Estate Lord has his own thoughts. It’s not something High Venerable needs to worry about.” Leng Wuchang tightened his fists, doing his best to maintain calm.
Huangpu Fenglei scanned the trembling face and frowned, his suspicions heightened, “Sir Leng, Estate Lord is the leader of Regent Estate and in these pressing times he needs to be on duty, to look out for the house’s interests. What exactly is going on with him? Sir Leng, you are the steward and must tell me as the High Venerable. It is within my right to know.”
Leng Wuchang took a deep breath and maintained a straight face.
Huangpu Fenglei grew ashen by the second, his aura flashing stronger.
He didn’t get to squeeze harder as dragon roars came from the center of the array.
Roar~!
Wails of agony echoed in between every roar. Huangpu Fenglei could identify that voice from anywhere.
“W-wha-, is Estate Lord inside the seal?”
Huangpu Fenglei watched it stunned, then became shocked as the eight dragon souls inside the seal raved. He snapped a savage look on Leng Wuchang, “Sir Leng, what the hell is going on here? Why did the Estate Lord enter the array?”
Knowing when to quit, Leng Wuchang sighed as he explained the events. High Venerable instantly identified the issue. The two had gone over the gathering of elders and used the Bodhi Root to train the Nine Dragons Diamond Body.
Huangpu Tianyuan was the Estate Lord, but this crucial decision was too important to be left to one man’s decision.
“This isn’t a game!”
Huangpu Fenglei spat, “Have you two forgotten the rules of Regent Estate? How can the two of you make light of the entire house’s future? And that Huangpu Tianyuan’s talent is lacking, not reaching the Radiant Stage in decades. He cannot bear the power of the dragon souls!”
“Letting him go in there, you’ve sent him to his death. No, I have to get him out!”
Huangpu Fenglei made a sign to open the seal.
The question was, did he care so much for that poor man’s life? Hell no. If the Estate Lord kicked the bucket, there’d be plenty more candidates where he came from.
What the High Venerable cared about the most was the eight dragon souls getting tamed and by someone other than him.
He was the High Venerable here, the peak of Regent Estate’s power. The Nine Dragons Diamond Body should be his. Why waste it on a waste who couldn’t even enter the Radiant Stage?
He couldn’t and wouldn’t accept it!
Leng Wuchang moved faster, grabbing his hands, “High Venerable, don’t be rash. With the Estate Lord training in the Nine Dragons Diamond Body, it has incited the dragon souls. Open the array now and the dragons will doom us all! “
Huangpu Fenglei was still considering, but let his hand rest in the end.
Leng Wuchang saw through his desires and advised, “With Estate Lord’s talent, achieving it will be for the best, but any mistake is life-threatening. Albeit a tragedy, at least the dragon souls will remain and finding the next candidate will be easy. We won’t be losing much at all in this.”
The speech hit right where it mattered, making him relax.
[Yeah, once he drops dead, only I’ll be worthy of training in Nine Dragons Diamond Body. I can’t just risk my future by releasing the dragon souls in the heat of the moment.]
Ah!
A shout of pain came from the center, easing Huangpu Fenglei’s worries, [Humph, with the prick’s meager talent, he has next to no chance. Waiting will be better.]
Huangpu Fenglei sighed, “If only Estate Lord can come back from the brink. May fortune smile upon him.”
Huangpu Fenglei left, just like that, “Sir Leng, I will have ten Venerables watch over the array to prevent any dragon soul from slipping out.”
“Thank you so much, High Venerable!” Leng Wuchang bowed.
Huangpu Fenglei was gone.
With a snicker, Leng Wuchang shook his head. Anyone could tell what Huangpu Fenglei wanted, to have someone inform him of the situation.
When there was no more peep coming from Huangpu Tianyuan, he’d strut in, take the Bodhi Root and train himself to glory.
Just that his plan wouldn’t be fulfilled any time soon.
Training in Nine Dragons Diamond Body needed the dragon souls to gnaw on the user and refine the dragonic soul, leading to the creation of the diamond body. The body could break any time under the process, but with a little nifty doohickey called Bodhi Root and it’s endless vitality to offset this, the chances went through the roof.
All that mattered now was the mind. With a little mettle to push through the pain, success was practically a given.
Huangpu Tianyuan had an average talent, but he was a tough cookie baked through years and years of experience as Estate Lord.
All of these facts led to Leng Wuchang believing that his chances were perfect.
Leng Wuchang mocked, “If there’s one word you can use to sum up human nature, it’s greed…”
Huangpu Fenglei did send his men to keep an eye on things.
But as months passed, the guards only got to hear wails upon wails, growing louder and louder, with a dragon roar mixed in every now and then. It was mind-boggling how a human being could even make such sounds. But one thing was clear, the man wasn’t anywhere near done.
Huangpu Fenglei’s mood soured as he counted the days, [What’s taking him so long to die?]
[Just croak already so I can have a shot!]
Three months later, Fang Qiubai’s group of three came with the Emperor’s edict to Caged Dragon City, urging Regent Estate to deal with Zhuo Fan. Huangpu Fenglei had had enough of waiting and came down to the array.
“Sir Leng, the emperor has sent the Divine Dragons saying they’ll help us capture Zhuo Fan.” Huangpu Fenglei proclaimed his excuse.
Following up with his real intention, “How is Estate Lord fairing?”
It sounded so innocently caring, but reaching anyone’s ears was [Is he dead yet?]
Leng Wuchang snickered inside, just as the wails and dragon roars stopped.
“Can it be…” Leng Wuchang whipped his head on the array.
Huangpu Fenglei lit up like a christmas tree.
He rushed to open the array and peer inside.
But the bang halted all movements. The engraved array exploded in a shower of colors, revealing a bloody figure gasping for air crawling out.
Huangpu Tianyuan!
Even his wretched figure couldn’t hide the violent power surging out of him. Everyone stood agape and aware of one truth. The man was reborn.
As for the limit to his newfound strength, if it was legend-compliant and Nine Dragons Diamond Body was invincible, they had no way to know.
Only Huangpu Fenglei’s eyes went bloodshot, gnashing his teeth in anger. [The punk pulled through? Are the eight dragon souls in him right now?]
“Estate Lord!”
Leng Wuchang shouted in joy, “Congratulations, Estate Lord, upon your success in training the Diamond Body!”
Huangpu Tianyuan nodded weakly, his smile faint.
The Venerables showed no change.
Then a sour and insidious voice came, “Estate Lord, you have gone over the Venerables’ counsel, opened the seal and broke the house’s rules. What right do you have to remain it’s lord?”
The others nodded. Huangpu Tianyuan’s eyes, though, shone like a savage…

chapters.title: Chapter 419, Earth Dragon Head
chapters.content:
Chapter 419, Earth Dragon Head
Translator: StarReader
He looked up at the white haired elder bearing a twisted smile and a violent aura around him. He was the second Venerable under Huangpu Fenglei.
With Huangpu Fenglei around, he was in fact speaking his boss’ thoughts.
Huangpu Fenglei looked coldly at the show.
“Second Venerable, what did you say? I couldn’t quite hear you from way over there.” Huangpu Tianyuan’s face fell, dragging his beaten body to the old man and leaning his ear over.
Second Venerable only got more cocky at his feeble look, raising his head to declare in pride, “Like I said, I…”
Roar!
A bellow like a caged dragon came, shaking the hearts of all.
Even High Venerable tensed.
And second Venerable, the target of that howl, had his eardrums punctured and started bleeding from his ears.
With a puff, his entire head vanished in a black and reeking mouth.
Sss~
The rest recoiled.
They watched the second Venerable just standing there, headless, with blood sprinkling from his neck.
In place of his head, there was now a beast’s. Triangular eyes, rough scales and the size, all pointed at it being a dragon head.
But the owner of the head was human in body, Huangpu Tianyuan.
In a blink, his head had turned into a dragon’s, ripping off grand peak Radiant Stage’s head clean off.
The hearts of the rest shuddered as blood seeped from that maw, any complaints lodged in their throats.
Huangpu Fenglei was bug-eyed, “Nine Dragons Diamond Body, Dragon Head Transformation?”
This transformation boosted invincible defense and sharp fangs to tear into even a Radiant Stage body cultivator.
Huangpu Tianyuan took three months to step into Zhuo Fan and Gu Santong’s level of freakishness. To everyone here, he might have even surpassed Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan relied on his two fists, while he had the Nine Dragons Diamond Body, leaving no part untransformed, becoming truly invincible.
Cold eyes glanced around the rest. Huangpu Tianyuan’s head regained its normal form, though the blood still leaked from his mouth, amplifying the dread.
“Regent Estate’s rule is to listen to the Estate Lord. I hope Venerables will remember that, for your sake…” Huangpu Tianyuan snickered a threat.
It was about time he felt like a true Estate Lord.
Power demanded authority, demanded the respect and obedience of the world.
The Venerables lowered their heads, “We obey Estate Lord!”
Huangpu Fenglei sighed, parroting the others. He knew his chance would never come.
In the Regent Estate, he was no longer the grand poobah, but a mere thug to send on errands.
Glancing over at the second Venerable’s body, it just stood there headless, with blood bubbling non stop; a swift and pointless death.
Sighing, everyone turned morose.
Their endless glory era as Venerables in the Regent Estate had come to pass…
“Congratulations, Estate Lord. We now have the power to fight this war!” Leng Wuchang laughed.
Huangpu Tianyuan nodded, “Zhuo Fan, Gu Santong, we will be seeing each other soon enough, ha-ha-ha…”
“Estate Lord, the emperor’s men…” Leng Wuchang spoke of the details.
Huangpu Tianyuan nodded and showed a cold smile, “Humph, just some Divine Dragons and a shadow captain to monitor me? Naive!”
Huangpu Fenglei rolled his eyes.
[Just?]
[Presumptuous much? To look down on even the likes of Divine Dragons. Then again, it does make sense. Even united, those three can’t do anything to him.]
[Mocking them is only natural!]
Huangpu Fenglei’s envy grew with each thought, his drool leaking. [It would’ve been so nice if it were me instead.]
[Alas, it’s wasted on an average person like him when it would’ve shined in the hands of a High Venerable.] Like yours truly!
[A darn shame…]
High Venerable shook his head which Huangpu Tianyuan ignored, saying to Leng Wuchang, “But since they’re here to ‘assist’, we’d do well to use them. No matter what insidious plot they have, my strength will trump it.”
“Estate Lord is brilliant. This is what I’ve been waiting for! With Estate Lord’s unstoppable power, anything can be settled. Even a fight with Zhuo Fan or the imperial family!” Leng Wuchang bowed, excited that his long cherished ambitions were about to come true.
Huangpu Tianyuan laughed, strutting, “Come, let us meet these experts, ha-ha-ha…”
The others bowed and followed…
They soon arrived in a lounge, where the Divine Dragons waited.
But the relaxed look on Huangpu Tianyuan had them all tense.
[Peak Radiant Stage?]
The trio exchanged shocked looks. They all knew Huangpu Tianyuan was a peak Profound Heaven cultivator, yet he had now shown up, three months later at the same level as them?
His speed was more freakish than Zhuo Fan’s!
They could feel the threat coming from his blood-reeking figure.
It only put the three on guard. Huangpu Tianyuan’s sudden transformation had them on edge.
“Estate Lord Huangpu, it’s been ages. I am impressed. I wonder what miracle art the Estate Lord used to undergo such an amazing transformation.” Fang Qiubai probed.
Sima Hui and Shadow King paid their respects as well, tense and eager for the answer.
Huangpu Tianyuan grew bolder at their reactions but dodged the question, “Please, sit. You have come by the order of the emperor to help Regent Estate capture that traitor. I am truly grateful. Let us discuss our plan of action.”
The three glossed over Huangpu Tianyuan’s obvious secretive nature and said, “How should we proceed, Estate Lord?”
“Ha-ha-ha, I and Sir Leng have already discussed it.”
He and Leng Wuchang showed a vague smile, before the first continued, “To kill the rider, you first need to remove his horse. We will first clip Zhuo Fan’s wings. As you all know, Drifting Flowers Edifices, Veiled Dragon Pavilion and Sword Marquise Abode are on Zhuo Fan’s side. Before we move against Zhuo Fan, we need to cut him off, beginning with his allies…”
[You just want the houses!]
Fang Qiubai squinted.
Huangpu Tianyuan’s wild ambitions were already an open secret.
But it all fell under His Majesty’s plan anyway, and the three nodded.
“Then let us begin according to Estate Lord Huangpu’s plan!” Sima Hui nodded.
Huangpu Tianyuan was giddy inside. That line was the same as having the imperial family validate his thirst for power, that they wouldn’t interfere in his campaign.
[This is the best chance in history!]
Though clear that the imperial family wouldn’t butt in because it had its own hands full. He had to move faster, before the imperial family finished settling up its affairs and the situation would enter a deadlock again.
Huangpu Tianyuan thus put in action the plan of attack on the three houses and notified Hell Valley and Pill King Hall to coordinate.
What neither side knew was that in the middle of their talks, subtle signals kept pouring out from their location.
They spread to the tree outside, then to the stone table.
And they kept going further beyond, going from one location to another.
It went on for miles.
A dozen miles out of Caged Dragon City, in a forest, a figure in black leaned on a huge tree in meditation.
When the tree let out a signal as well, the figure opened his eyes and used a sending jade. It flew high in the sky, gone in a blink…

chapters.title: Chapter 420, Zhuo Fan’s Thoughts
chapters.content:
Chapter 420, Zhuo Fan’s Thoughts
Translator: StarReader
“Where’s Zhuo Fan. I have crucial intelligence!”
In the Luo clan hall on Blackwind Mountain, Lei Yuting in all black, skipped over. She asked once she saw only Yan Fu was around, playing the assistant and handling resources.
Yan Fu pointed at the floor, “Go to the bunker. Steward Zhuo has been there for the past few days.”
“Thanks!” Lei Yuting waved.
Yan Fu asked before she got away, “Captain Lei, just what intelligence has got you so giddy?”
“Nothing much, just that the Regent Estate is on the move. Not to attack us, but our three allies. We have more time to prepare!”
“What?”
Yan Fu shouted, rushing over, “Is the information accurate? Let me see!”
Lei Yuting raised an eyebrow, “What’s got you in such a tizzy? Its got nothing to do with you. And this is for the steward’s eyes first. An assistant has no right to see it. “
Yan Fu paused and nodded.
It was one of Zhuo Fan’s rules to prevent a leak and maintain secrecy. Anyone caught breaking it would be in for a severe punishment.
Even with this rule, he was still worried, “Captain Lei, let’s go to Steward Zhuo. Even if you do report it, with me there as well, he’ll allow it.”
Lei Yuting nodded.
The two soon arrived at the bunker.
There were people everywhere. Luo clan’s guards with the Yun clan’s people made up for ten thousand heads, busying themselves in every corner of the cave according to the orders from the front.
That was where Zhuo Fan and Yun Shuang were.
He was ostensibly making an array, unknown as of yet to what end.
“Humph, Steward Zhuo, you sure are a good headhunter. Flirting and working at the same time, not missing a single second!” Lei Yuting saw the two close and jealousy reared its head.
Yun Shuang blushed and lowered her head.
Zhuo Fan only raised an eyebrow, “Miss Lei, what brings you here? You should be out there gathering intel!”
“Humph, I came here to report!”
Lei Yuting threw a jade slip, her tone cold at the lovely couple, “Steward Zhuo, how’s it going between you and miss Shuang’er? Any progress?”
“Be nice. Shuang’er is Yun clan’s Holy Maiden. We’re only discussing how to direct her people.” Zhuo Fan turned his attention to the jade slip.
Zhuo Fan’s cold attitude had her even more enraged. So she turned a broken smile to Yun Shuang, “Miss Shuang’er, let me give you a warning. Zhuo Fan is unreliable. He draws a pretty crowd, but he only sticks around for three months at most, taking the girl and all her possessions. Your sister here is a living witness and victim. So I warn you, as someone who has gone through this already, be on guard around the thieving Zhuo Fan.”
“So you are soft toward Steward Zhuo as well… I thought it’s only young miss Luo…” Shuang’er blinked her large innocent eyes.
Lei Yuting flushed, still holding her head high in stubbornness, “No way! Why would I look at him?”
“Yeah, you don’t like me, so don’t talk behind my back, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan opened his eyes and chuckled, “Regent Estate is finally moving, and against those houses. Not bad at all, just as I predicted.”
The others were stunned, [Why is he so happy if his allies are in the dumps?]
[If our allies cave, won’t we be without cover?]
Yan Fu grew frantic, “Steward Zhuo, when will Regent Estate strike? How will we assist?”
“Why would we assist?”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed, “This is exactly what I want, for the Regent Estate to attack them. If I had to deal with them personally, besides making it awkward for me, it’ll be hard to get them on my side.”
[What?!]
Everyone was in complete shock.
Zhuo Fan had no intention of repelling the Regent Estate’s raid, but was thinking about how to integrate his allies.
Those houses were his support, with Veiled Dragon Pavilion being the very first. Selling them out like this and even turning on them would be a new low.
Zhuo Fan snickered at their thoughts, “You’re too naive. There’s no such thing as an everlasting friend in this world. Even if we beat Regent Estate and the rest back and crown ourselves kings, our alliance with the houses would have run its course and we’d have a conflict of interests. They’ll look at us as the new Regent Estate.
“It’s better to take this prime opportunity and deal with them, ending with a truly peaceful community. This is the way to go. Ain’t that right, miss Yun Shuang? “
Zhuo Fan snickered, “Doesn’t your clan always advocate salvation? That’s just what I’m doing.”
Yun Shuang mulled over his words. Zhuo Fan was as despicable as it got, but changing perspective, it would be for a noble cause, for the people’s future. She nodded.
Lei Yuting remained silent. Only Yan Fu was fretful, “Steward Zhuo, y-you really don’t care about them?”
“How can I not? Am I not taking them all in with open arms instead of wiping them out? I do have a modicum of conscience, you know.” Grinning, Zhuo Fan paused, “Here’s how it’s going to play out. Going by the intel, Regent Estate will act in three months so we’ll notify our allies two months later. Without any preparation, their thousand year legacy won’t save them, though they can still flee.
“Leaves us as the only option to turn to. And since they’ll be in our house, they’ll know to keep their heads down. We’ll use this chance to integrate them while making them eternally grateful for our help. That’s just how good I am, doing them a favor. Now ain’t that a twofer!”
[Rotten!]
Everyone revolted. They were sickened by his methods, yet bowed in respect. Such a heartless move could only come from the bottom of a blackened blood pump of a demon like Zhuo Fan.
Watching the world aflame and swooping in to reap the spoils, that was his style alright.
He would profit and earn fame, more devious and sly than a fox could ever be. Killing their whole house yet the victims would be ever grateful? That was only something a conscience-free lowlife scum who felt no remorse about snuffing out a human life would do.
But this was the only way for the Luo clan to come out as the biggest winner.
Though Yan Fu was morose after hearing the plan.
Zhuo Fan asked, “Yan Fu, why the long face? With your usual self, you’d never care about the next person.”
“Steward Zhuo, could you please save Drifting Flowers Edifices? Dandan…” Yan Fu hesitated.
[The brat must be head over heels.] This thought led him to a more worrying one.
“Nice, I approve of a man like you. You stand up for that woman in times of danger. Not like a certain unmentionable someone, so callous and scheming even after spending time with their Edifice Lord.”
Lei Yuting slapped Yan Fu’s back in praise, sneaking a glance at Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan frowned, then shut his eyes. After a sigh, he left.
His voice traveled to the shocked ears of everyone, “Send word to Drifting Flowers Edifices. Tell them to evacuate to Luo clan. As for the other two houses, two months later.”
“T-thank you, Steward Zhuo!”
Yan Fu perked up and left happy.
Lei Yuting watched Zhuo Fan’s lonely back, then gave Yun Shuang one last word of sincere advice, “Miss Shuang’er, give up while you have no feelings for him. His heart belongs to someone else.”
Yun Shuang was puzzled.
Lei Yuting sighed, “I know him to be a principled man of strength and decisiveness that won’t change no matter what. The only two times he has lost himself was in Beast King Mountain, over Ning’er, and now. I reckon it’s over the Drifting Flowers Edifices’ Edifice Lord.”
Sighing, Lei Yuting left, “As I cannot move that man, I will give up…”
Yun Shuang shuddered.
She was an ascetic Holy Maiden with her mind solely focused on the future. But now, she has sunk into perplexity…
As Zhuo Fan left the bunker, he went deeper into the forest, sullen.
A blue robed person popped up in front of him, Vicious Pill King Yan Song.
“Elder Yan, what is it?” Zhuo Fan glanced.
Yan Song was flushed from worry, “Steward Zhuo, I heard you’ve let them use 6th-grade ingredients to make 3rd-grade pills.
“Yes, won’t it raise their success rate?” Zhuo Fan nodded.
Yan Song’s heart was bleeding, “But Steward Zhuo, isn’t that a waste?”
Zhuo Fan grinned, “Elder Yan, here’s the thing. In half a year, I plan on seeing a hundred thousand 3rd-grade pills, the Spirit Melding Pill. After so many years of being in your care, that batch of hundreds of people can only make a 3rd-grade pill at best, with a low chance of success as well. To get a hundred thousand pills, I can only use high-grade ingredients to boost the odds.”
“But isn’t it still a waste?” Yan Song was an alchemist and felt pain seeing them go like that.
Zhuo Fan mocked, his eyebrow high, “It’s fine, we’re rich.”
Zhuo Fan left suddenly and came back with the biggest haul of the century. And the original plan to bake ten thousand pills was upped to a hundred thousand.
It not only meant more work for them, but it had an even lower chance of success, so Zhuo Fan compensated with riches.
No matter how much Yan Song cherished every leaf and petal, he had to accept it, going back slumped and depressed.
Zhuo Fan’s voice was heard from afar, “Oh, Elder Yan, tell Elder Li and the others to gather. We’re leaving for Hell Valley soon. And those Profound Heaven fakers, have them come as well.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes glinted as his mouth curled in a twisted snicker…

chapters.title: Chapter 421, Raiding Hell Valley
chapters.content:
Chapter 421, Raiding Hell Valley
Translator: StarReader
Whoosh~
Thousands of people landed, their gaze forward.
A misty valley stretched just out of reach, black and violet, sinister and creepy.
A jacked-up old man walked into the thick mist with a smile. At some point, Li Jingtian looked back at Zhuo Fan, “Hell Valley sure is cautious, activating their 5th-grade array already. We’ll need at least a day to break it.”
“Which house doesn’t have misgivings in these troubled times? It’s all within my calculations.”
Zhuo Fan went to the front and investigated the mist with a mocking gaze, “As for punching through, it won’t take that long.”
Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed in a double golden halo, [Divine Eye of the Void’s 2nd stage, Void Annihilation!]
Whoosh~
A vibrating ray shot out of Zhuo Fan’s eye and into Hell Valley.
Followed by a series of booms and bangs, the mist trembled twice before lifting completely.
Li Jingtian looked at Zhuo Fan in glee and a thumbs up, “He-he-he, that’s our Steward Zhuo. Breaking an array like this is so damn convenient!”
“When it comes to arrays relying on space, you just have to burst their bubble and the array would unravel by itself. That’s what this move of mine is all about. There’s nothing great about it.” Zhuo Fan casually said.
But Li Jingtian sighed inside, [If it’s that easy, do you see anyone else doing it?]
Zhuo Fan’s every move was simple yet astonishing to anybody who witnessed his feats.
Li Jingtian held Zhuo Fan in even higher regard.
“The array is open, attack!” Zhuo Fan motioned.
Li Jingtian led the charge, taking thousands of Bone Tempering cultivators and rare Profound Heaven ones deeper inside.
The men shouted and roared, the black cloud unleashing a frenzied raid on the valley, swallowing it.
The patrols couldn’t even shout as the massive influx of people was in their face. The shock and fear was buried so deep inside that they were reduced to standing there dumbly rather than sound the alarm.
[Oh gods above, what the hell is this? Did the array fail for so many to come in? How did they all get in so fast?]
They were so out of it, they simply waited for the attackers to reap them.
The only reaction out of the patrols was when spiritual weapons pierced their chests.
The cries became wails as blood and gore splattered everywhere. Their bodies slumping lifeless.
The assault kept on charging unimpeded.
“Enemy attack!”
A final shout rose up every disciple, discovering their home was invaded and they shouted out in panic.
Zhuo Fan’s timing was excellent, catching them at their lowest, finishing off the panicking Hell Valley disciples.
Oh, there were some brave defenders popping every now and then to stem the tide, but they didn’t even get to take out their demonic treasures as a group of elite youths surrounded them for a second, then left behind a mangled body as they moved on to the next target.
The captains in this assault were the stalwart guards Zhuo Fan had Captain Pang train in the Wraith Art ten years ago. This was their first sortie of this scale, and for some, their very first kill.
Yet they all took to it like fish to water, showing no remorse.
Unlike the wretched and excruciating torture called training, watching the friends around them fall one by one, the killing here was a breeze.
Zhuo Fan had sent them to hell to come back as fiends that not even the likes of a cruel and bloody war could shake.
“These kids will be the cornerstones of the house!” Zhuo Fan stood on a distant peak, watching and analyzing the situation.
Li Jingtian nodded in praise, “Steward Zhuo, the training of all those years has paid up, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan closed his eyes, tuning in to the natural symphony around him, of cries, wails, pleadings, slumping bodies in their own blood, forming a sweet melody to his ears and bringing an innocent and genial smile to his lips.
These sounds gave the signal for the Luo clan’s expansion, Luo clan’s march to rule them all with an iron fist.
It was what he had hoped and aimed for. This goal of his was finally taking shape…
Meanwhile, a stone gate flew open as a bloody and filthy Hell Valley disciple plopped inside, blood gurgling from his throat.
The four elders inside cried, “What is going on out there?”
“Enemy… attack…” The disciple gave his very life uttering those two words. His head slumped, his life gone.
All that remained were eyes filled with horror, further unnerving the men.
“This is absurd! Just what the hell is going on? Who are the ignorant fools that dare set foot in Hell Valley?” The leader roared.
Another said, “But why has there been no reaction from the array? Has it been breached?”
The four panicked. It had to be done swiftly for these elders to not notice until now that they had been invaded.
[What power must’ve done this?]
The four released their Discerning Fields.
Their mind’s eye view had them all gasping.
They saw a swarm of people shouting as they killed anyone they saw. Their ten thousand disciples couldn’t muster a token of resistance against a meager few thousand.
The four’s senses looked further and noticed two men on a hill.
One was in the 3rd layer of Profound Heaven Stage and was ignored, turning to the peak Radiant Stage expert next to him. The four men felt like crying.
The number of peak Radiant Stage experts in Tianyu could be counted on one hand. How come one of them has come to Hell Valley?
The High Venerable was in the 5th layer while the rest were only in the 4th. Not even together could they hope to beat that freak.
“For god’s sake, who the hell is it? Regent Estate or imperial family? What did we do to have them wipe us out?” One complained.
High Venerable shook his head, “No, Valley Lord said we’re still allied with Regent Estate. As for the imperial family, it’s now stuck dealing with problems cropping up in the last thousand years. It won’t come. And that Radiant Stage expert’s aura feels familiar…”
“High Venerable, do you know him?” The rest shouted.
High Venerable shuddered and sighed, “How could I ever forget? We all know him. Didn’t we witness him clashing with Huangpu Fenglei on the eve of the Luo clan’s ceremony?”
“Mad Dipper?” They all cried.
High Venerable nodded depressed, “What’s worse, what other Profound Heaven expert do you know of who stands by his side? It’s Zhuo Fan, that demonic steward of Luo clan. We all saw him taking Li Jingtian and Huangpu Fenglei’s all out attacks like nothing. We have no hope of winning!”
The other three’s hearts sunk to the bottom, their faces ashen.
They couldn’t even handle one of them.
The four old men felt like weeping.
[Zhuo Fan has finally struck! We get it that you have to attack at some point, but why come to us? Wasn’t the Regent Estate always against you at every turn?]
[We’ve already lost enough elders to you, so why come back for more? Think we’re pushovers now, is that it?]
They all felt like heaven had beset them with the greatest grief in the world.
But reality came knocking and they had to man up to the danger.
High Venerable’s eyes flashed with resolve, “Old third, you are the fastest. Fly to Valley Lord and report the situation. We three will buy you time.”
“Elder brother!” Old third teared up.
But High Venerable nodded with a reassuring smile.
Zhuo Fan had his eyes turned to the source of those Discerning Fields, “Oh, four senses have picked us up. So what’s taking those geezers so long to come out? Are they scared and huddled together?”
“He-he-he, totally!” Li Jingtian laughed…

chapters.title: Chapter 422, Singing Another Tune
chapters.content:
Chapter 422, Singing Another Tune
Translator: StarReader
Whoosh~
Three figures flashed on the battlefield, ignoring the wails below and going in Zhuo Fan’s direction.
Zhuo Fan mocked, “Humph, such guts to come at me instead of running.”
“He-he-he, I think they are instead coming here to die.” Li Jingtian snickered.
The three Venerables appeared in their sights.
They all came with clear thoughts of becoming martyrs while holding the enemy back. But seeing the two savages had them shaking still.
High Venerable scrutinized them, gulped and found any word lacking in this situation.
The other two sighed.
[Scared before even fighting. Now what?]
[Brother, we have to buy the old third some time…]
Recalling his mission, High Venerable took a deep breath and scrounged up the scraps of courage within to shout, “Zhuo Fan, you’ve gone too…”
Zhuo Fan had no time to indulge in this guy’s pedantic style and asked, “Weren’t there four senses? Where’s the other one?”
High Venerable’s courage got stuck in his throat. Zhuo Fan’s haughty and obnoxious attitude, like a big kahuna, lorded over them with such pressure that their heads jerked back.
This was called the power gap. They were like 1st level spiritual beasts facing a 6th level spiritual beast, with no chance whatsoever at coming out alive.
The three threatened to burst out in tears.
They were Radiant Stage cultivators, Hell Valley’s Venerables, but they couldn’t even get a worthy death?
Li Jingtian cracked up, jarring to their ears.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Not like one missing person would make a difference.”
Zhuo Fan took out a gourd and let Bloodworms wiggle out. They looked downright eager to get out of that darkness they had known all their lives, ready to enjoy the big outdoors.
“Here’s the deal. Eat it and you’re one of us, becoming Luo clan’s elders. Don’t, and I’ll just have to take you back as corpses.” Zhuo Fan was like a tyrant in his demands.
The three jerked and panicked. Zhuo Fan had actually come to them to offer an olive branch.
With Zhuo Fan’s illustrious reputation of a savage demon - and the bad blood between the houses - they had the impression that he had come here to cull them. They were even ready to lay down their lives. So why were they so happy?
To a dead man, a glimmer of hope would blossom in his heart, the instinct of self preservation with a force that couldn’t be denied.
It was like jumping off a cliff and then finding out that there was an extra rope beside you. Would you capture it, or let it slip?
[What kinda dumb choice is that? Who’s so retarded to take splattering as an upside to life?]
But the life veterans that the old fogies were, agreeing so quickly would net them what, a lower status?
Hence, ergo and propter hoc, High Venerable stroked his beard, held his head high and put on airs, “Zhuo Fan, if you’re going headhunting, isn’t it a bit thin? We are, after all, Hell Valley’s…”
“Elder Li, kill ’em.” Zhuo Fan deadpanned.
Li Jingtian grinned, cracking his knuckles as a fire lit in his eyes.
The three jerked like mice, waving around in panic, “Let’s be reasonable. D-don’t resort to violence…”
“Humph, you old coots, I’ve already said my piece. One more or less will hardly make a difference. Yet you dare posture before me? It’s to the afterlife with you!” Zhuo Fan snorted.
The three jerked and bobbed their heads like cute children.
Holding out the gourd, Zhuo Fan watched them each swallow a Bloodworm.
And so, easy peasy lemon squeezy, Luo clan gained three more Radiant Stage elders. Though Zhuo Fan didn’t give a flying fig about them, they were of even less value than Yan Song, a peak Profound Heaven expert.
But every penny counted, even if those pennies were so thin and corroded that you wanted to throw them, they all had their use sometime… in the long future.
And the newly baked elders? Now they were clued in as to why a die-hard expert like Li Jingtian fell in with Zhuo Fan. Besides Bloodworms’ control, Zhuo Fan’s attitude left no room for dissidence.
“S-Sir Zhuo…”
“Steward Zhuo!” Zhuo Fan’s icy tone warned.
High Venerable jerked and nodded, “Steward Zhuo, we have another elder sneaking out to report. He is still close. Should I call him to join Steward Zhuo’s camp?”
The other two bobbed.
The four of them were a clique. With three of them coerced into working under Zhuo Fan, the day would come when they’d have to kill their brother.
So having the old third join the gang in one big happy family worked out smashingly.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “No need, one less won’t make a difference.”
The three looked downcast. [Steward Zhuo never gave a hoot about us.]
It was best to play it safe and not get on the young master’s nerve.
They reckoned not even Li Jingtian could take his punishment if he did. While they would downright breathe their last in the process. [Better wag my tail at every order.]
[Luo clan is a den of monsters. We are three Radiant Stage experts here, yet this young master doesn’t bat an eye.]
Tears welled up again, the fond times of being at the top seemed so far away…
“You three, the fighting isn’t over. Go lend a hand!” Zhuo Fan glanced at the slaughter below and ordered.
They shuddered.
The fighting was one-sided to begin with and them going would only speed things up. Zhuo Fan was having them go for another reason, to make them kill their own disciples.
A second ago they were still Hell Valley’s Venerables, yet in the next moment they were ordered to go kill their own clansmen. It was a little hard to take.
“Steward Zhuo, a man of power should look after the ones below him. How about I try and get Hell Valley’s disciples to join the Luo clan?” High Venerable looked on pleading.
Li Jingtian nodded, “It’s not a bad idea, Steward…”
“Kill!”
Zhuo Fan snapped, “Your status in Luo clan is based solely on merit. With no merit, we’ll be off with your head. Luo clan does not raises pansies!”
Sss~
Zhuo Fan clearly wanted Hell Valley dead to the last man, dog and weed.
If the three Venerables dragged their feet any longer, they’d soon join the bloody mud.
This wasn’t as simple as turning coats, but was cutting off any relation with Hell Valley. And these three were demonic cultivators, without shame or remorse. Now that they had grasped a lifeline, would they let it get cut over something as insipid as integrity?
The three swooped in without preamble.
They had tried their best to plead the kids’ case to Zhuo Fan. [It’s not our fault Zhuo Fan wants us to kill you.]
“Kill, brothers. Stand your ground!”
One tall disciple shouted, waving his sinister sabre, pushing back the five enemies around, “I’ve already notified the Venerables. They will soon provide help. Just hold on!”
Whoosh~
A grey robe appeared before him,
The disciple shouted in joy, “High Venerable, you’re finally…”
Pff!
The bright smile froze on his face as his chest gained an extra large breathing room, with blood seeping out.
The High Venerable flashed to his next target. Just that this one, who had been holding on for the better part of an hour, froze on his spot as happiness was replaced with doubt.
[What the hell? Why is the High Venerable attacking us?]
In this moment of greatest doubt in his life, he lost his life.
Each Venerable flitted across the battlefield, across every corner.
Because they were Radiant Stage experts who were Hell Valley’s Venerables, once they joined the war effort, they mowed down the disciples by the scores.
Zhuo Fan watched it all with a cold critical eye and a snicker.
Li Jingtian didn’t get it, “Steward Zhuo, why did you shoot down that old guy’s proposal…”
“In times of war, one needs to avoid surrendering before even battling. We are on the brink of clashing with Regent Estate and I can’t have unknowns left in our midst. If anything, I don’t have enough Bloodworms to control them all.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed, “Besides, what Luo clan lacks is experts. These three coots got invited to cover this weakness. Letting them come on board with their entire clan will make this harder, maybe even capsize us.”
Li Jingtian shuddered inside and cupped his hands, “I am in awe of Steward Zhuo’s impeccable scheming.”

chapters.title: Chapter 423, Slaughter and Desecration
chapters.content:
Chapter 423, Slaughter and Desecration
Translator: StarReader
The raid on Hell Valley ended as quickly as it had begun.
Valley Lord You Wanshan and the elders were visiting Regent Estate for the plans on how to deal with Drifting Flowers Edifices and the others. Of the four Venerables guarding the valley, one escaped, three turned and the valley now looked like the aftermath of a tornado.
Even with a number of ten thousand, the disciples couldn’t handle the incoming raid of just a few thousands of Luo clan’s guards, for more than a few short hours and were killed to the last one.
At the first light of a glorious red dawn, the hellscape of the valley laid bare. The howls halted, the place deserted, with only streams of blood flowing down the mountains, releasing its repugnant stench.
And as a true picture of hell, it couldn’t do without corpses, lots and lots of them to make a mountain. All strewn about, waiting for anyone to come give them a proper burial.
“Steward Zhuo, it’s done.” Li Jingtian glanced below at the genocide and turned a flat face to Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan spoke after a pause, “Take the bodies back to Luo clan. We can now get on to more serious matters.”
“Getting serious? Taking Hell Valley wasn’t serious enough?” Li Jingtian asked.
Zhuo Fan grinned, “Ha-ha-ha, did you think I’d need so many people to destroy Hell Valley? Us two are more than enough.”
“Then…” Li Jingtian probed.
Zhuo Fan said, “Desecration!”
Sss~
Li Jingtian shuddered and gasped, “S-Steward Zhuo, the dead are to be respected. Is your hatred with Hell Valley running so deep that you need to dig up their ancestors?”
“Ha-ha-ha, you’re jumping too far ahead. I never cared a whit about Hell Valley nine years ago, and it goes double now. Besides, the most people I’ve killed came from this house. They should be the one hating me to the bone, not the other way around.”
“Then why…” Li Jingtian was lost.
Zhuo Fan had a crafty smile, “Go do your part while I do mine.”
Li Jingtian left because he believed Zhuo Fan’s every decision was backed by reason.
The Luo clan obeyed Zhuo Fan’s orders to the letter, taking it like any ordinary day back at the job. Only the Hell Valley Venerables were jumpy.
They had turned their backs on Hell Valley in exchange for their lives and were now forced to do such tasks.
Faced with the order of digging up their ancestors, they just couldn’t do it. That was where Hell Valley’s elders, Valley Lords and Venerables were laid to rest.
What logical explanation did the posterity have to dig them up?
[This is outrageous!]
The trio were going to see Zhuo Fan about this. Preach reason, that the two clans weren’t enemies to such a degree.
Li Jingtian saw through their intent and glared, “You, newbies, listen up and listen well. In Luo clan, Steward Zhuo’s word is law. Any complaints you have will be met with a quick trip down under.”
Li Jingtian flew away.
The trio sighed in helplessness, stopping in their tracks.
A guest could only play a guest in a host’s home.
[Since Steward Zhuo wants us to shame our ancestors to get our trust, we’re his men.]
They took this task as Zhuo Fan’s test of loyalty, to have them break all ties with Hell Valley. After flipping over one’s granddaddy’s tomb, one lost all right to call this place home.
A darn shame that all their conjectures were wrong from the get-go. Zhuo Fan never cared about them.
But to prove their change of heart, they worked the hardest in tomb raiding their long long ancestors.
Li Jingtian didn’t take much to have them figured out and laughed.
“Steward Zhuo, these old coots will do anything to get your trust, ha-ha-ha…” Li Jingtian mocked.
Zhuo Fan had a faint smile, “Nothing strange about it. Respecting one’s ancestors is the righteous way, while demonic cultivators only pay attention to power. That makes digging up one’s old man more common with demonic cultivators. When taking people in, one needs to keep an eye on their character. These three are expert demonic cultivators. I don’t care if they bear any grudge for me after this since all you have to do is, sit on them and they’ll be as meek as lambs.”
“Steward Zhuo is a genius. That’s why you sent the order to have them dig their ancestors. You never feared their resentment. You truly know the heart of a demonic cultivator!” Li Jingtian laughed.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Hardly. Righteous cultivators aren’t any different. Give them enough incentive and they’ll do the most menial and nasty thing you ask. Just that they had to always dress it up with fancy justice. Like they do it, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan had a strange smile, throwing Li Jingtian off on a loop.
Li Jingtian’s eyes lit up, having picked up something in the corner.
The Luo clan members were digging up Hell Valley’s ancestors, everywhere but there. Two dozen people moved around the place and looked around, not doing much of anything.
They were the emperor-bestowed Profound Heaven fakers.
While the rest of the Luo clan was putting their backs into it, they didn’t do so much as lift a pebble.
“Blast it, these guys were last in the battle of Hell Valley and now they’re goofing off when it comes to work. See how I’ll give them an earful! “
Li Jingtian stomped but Zhuo Fan stopped him from going, “Elder Li, easy, let them go. Besides, they’ve completed their mission. When we return, take care of them and make sure the three newbies see it to drive fear into them.”
“T-their mission?”
“Yep, leaking!” Zhuo Fan snickered, “Why else would I bring these losers along? To drag me back?”
“Then you…”
“Let them inform the emperor.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Even before the Luo clan rose to power, the emperor had these guys play the moles. That’s why I had Elder Lei handle them all this time, letting them report only what we wanted. After feeding them for so long, they finally have a use, to report to the emperor!”
“What? B-but… Steward Zhuo, why do this? Isn’t the emperor focused on you?” Li Jingtian jumped in fright.
Zhuo Fan was reckless. If the imperial family joined Regent Estate in coming here, they were finished!
Zhuo Fan could escape with his ridiculous power, but the Luo clan members would fall for sure. All the effort spent raising them for the last decade would go to waste.
Zhuo Fan laughed, “Elder Li, that’s only half true. He isn’t focused just on me, but on everyone. Taking the lone road means everyone in this world is your enemy, be it in the court or outside it.”
Blinking, Li Jingtian was still lost, and Zhuo Fan continued, “Elder Li, who do you think he wants to kill right now?”
“You of course. He even allowed the seven houses to use the Demon Purging Decree.”
“Ha-ha-ha, wrong. He wants to get rid of chess pieces. Me, Regent Estate and Zhuge Changfeng included. How will the nation change if he only gets rid of me? Regent Estate will get the houses, becoming the biggest power outside court and a threat to him. While in court, Zhuge Changfeng will be against him every step of the way. This is something he wants to avoid at all costs. So after getting wind of what we’re doing here, he will not only sweep it under the rug, but even help me.” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shined, his voice firm.
That confused Li Jingtian even more, “Help you?”
“Indeed.” Zhuo Fan smiled, “I can’t kick the bucket just yet, or Regent Estate will have free reign. We got word that he has sent Divine Dragons to assist the Regent Estate. To help alright, but it’s only a thinly veiled disguise to force them into fighting us. He doesn’t want us to remain in a stalemate. But when I make my move, because Regent Estate is stronger, they will act faster than me. At that time, the help will drag the Regent Estate down, to give us room to build strength and fight only when we’re on equal footing. That’s the best way for the emperor to swoop in and swallow us both.
“By letting those fools snitch to the emperor, I am in fact telling him that I’ve made my move and plan on removing his biggest thorn, the seven houses. This will make his day for sure and he’ll tell Fang Qiubai to hold back Regent Estate’s campaign against our allies while giving me time to take these corpses back and refine them. That’s all we need. Once we get these bodies ready, no one in Tianyu can stand up to us. It will be ours for the taking, ha-ha-ha…”
Cackling, Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone with confidence, “The emperor had taken into account every step across the board. But what he overlooked were my killer moves. This will be his downfall!”
Li Jingtian stared at him befuddled, then exclaimed, “Steward Zhuo, although I am rough and a boor and can’t understand a word, I do sense you have victory in sight. He-he-he, that’s great. You guys play your schemes as mere games. If I had my own faction, I’d be twisted around your fingers till I breathed my last…”

chapters.title: Chapter 424, Worse than Death
chapters.content:
Chapter 424, Worse than Death
Whoosh~
The Luo clan needed ten days to dig the entire cemetery three feet deep, the ancestors across countless generations seeing the light of day once again.
There were over a thousand Profound Heaven experts and hundreds of Radiant Stage experts. Zhuo Fan looked mighty pleased at the line up, [The thousand year legacy of the seven houses isn’t just for prop.]
Li Jingtian flashed before the Profound Heaven fakers, “Take the bodies to the clan.”
“Understood!”
The fakers bowed and got ready, but Li Jingtian blocked them.
The two dozen fakers looked at him doubtful.
Snickering, Li Jingtian said, “That is meant for the others. I have something special in mind for you.”
“What?”
Li Jingtian grinned, “To add you to the pile!”
The men cried, “E-Elder Li, why? What did we do wrong?”
“Leaking information, playing tricks, disobedience, to name a few.” Li Jingtian stressed every word with malice.
The fakers shivered having been exposed as spies. They were on their knees in a heartbeat, “Spare us, Elder Li, it’s not what we wanted either…”
Boom!
A mere flick sent such a violent wind that scattered them all over the place, blood and gore raining down.
“Humph, had you just owned up you’d still have a corpse, but you just had to caw in my ear making me do it myself.”
Li Jingtian flicked, ignoring the gory sight.
The Luo clan’s disciples were used to their elder’s methods, taking it in stride. They moved the corpses like nothing had happened.
While the newbie trio gulped and panicked more as they saw the people’s faces.
[Are these guys asuras from hell? Don’t they feel anything? Their comrades in battle just got wasted yet there’s no reaction? Are they made of stone?]
Most of the Luo clan’s disciples were around twenty years of age, but this sight had the elders shaking in fear.
They had no clue how Zhuo Fan shaped them up into such cold-blooded killing machines.
Watching the dead faces of the youths filled them with dread.
[Is this the real Luo clan?]
The trio rejoiced for turning sides. Even if Luo clan wouldn’t get to rule the lands soon, these youths would grow into a fiendish squadron that would level the nation in the future.
Compared to Luo clan’s strong elders, these youths were the most frightening asset.
[Zhuo Fan isn’t normal.] Even though they were demonic cultivators themselves, they’d never thought of running their disciples through hell, to say nothing of doing it en masse.
Besides fear, the trio now had respect when looking at the distant Zhuo Fan.
Demonic cultivators worshiped strength. Zhuo Fan not only had power, but endless tricks opening their eyes to the true meaning of the term demonic.
“You three, listen up!”
A shout roused the trio out of their reverie. Li Jingtian stared at them and they lowered their heads.
“Escort the people carrying the bodies back to Luo clan. Don’t mess up. If I find out that you’ve been up to no good, humph! Well let me tell you, you’ve taken Steward Zhuo’s Bloodworm and in a thousand miles he can have your heads. Get the picture?”
“Yes, totally. Don’t worry, Elder Li, we will never slight this!” The three bowed in unison.
Li Jingtian nodded and flew back to Zhuo Fan.
The elders had finally taken their betrayal seriously, not like they had a choice. Be it Zhuo Fan or Li Jingtian, both of their methods were cruel.
They didn’t even flinch slaughtering their own men. [Won’t killing us come easier?]
Scared of Li Jingtian’s display, the trio became meek, taking their mission as their calling, being stuck on escort duty.
Zhuo Fan took out a parchment with many lines on it, Hell Valley’s domain map and its cities. There were also thousands of red dots on it.
Handing it over to Li Jingtian, he said, “Elder Li, gather a thousand swift men and have them dig three feet on these spots. Also, send word around of our purging of Hell Valley, have those vassals of theirs, crumble in fear.”
“On it.”
Regardless of doubts, Li Jingtian followed his orders as always.
The thousand-men detachment spread in all directions, sweeping the Hell Valley domain in search of their targets.
Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian began their own search. Beneath a huge tree, they dug up a man-sized clay figure.
It looked human yet lacked the feel of one. It also had a natural vibe to it, just like ginseng, yet this one was in the shape of a human.
It had closed eyes and withered just like a plant. The more Li Jingtian looked at it, the odder he felt, like this thing in front of him was human yet wasn’t.
“Steward Zhuo, just what is this thing? Why haven’t I heard of it?” Li Jingtian asked.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “It is a man, and our clan’s scout. He had to be buried here for 3-4 years.”
“What?!” Li Jingtian cried.
Zhuo Fan explained, “Elder Li, you understand the cruelty of Wraith Art. To a martial fanatic like you, it means nothing, but if those children train in it… Well, you know the odds of success are slim at best.”
Li Jingtian nodded.
“But do you know what happens to the rejects?” Zhuo Fan had a deep look as he regarded Li Jingtian and patted the clay figure, “Yes, they turn into this, becoming our ears.”
Sss~
Gasping, Li Jingtian looked stunned. The clay doll had no human feel. No matter how he scanned it, it was just not human, [Yet it once was?]
[Steward Zhuo said just now that it can send information, but how?]
Zhuo Fan continued, “On failing to cultivate the Wraith Art, one would die at worst, while at best they would have their meridians shattered and live the rest of their life as a vegetable. But the demonic path has a skill, Myriad Breaths, a soul cultivating cultivation method. Though not without its caveats. Only the soul alone can be trained, turning the vessel into a dried husk. In time, the soul’s aura will, along with the body, blend in with nature, turning into this human pillar.
“Don’t take it for just a clay man, when in fact it has a soul stronger than a Profound Heaven expert’s. And with its sublime feel, tuning in with nature itself, not even a Radiant Stage expert can pick up on it. I had the kids who failed to train in Wraith Art, train in this Myriad Breaths and become human pillars. Miss Lei and her team buried them in the seven houses’ vicinity, at their doorsteps. Through their souls, they send out the information in a thousand meter radius. In this way, it is relayed to our scouts a hundred miles away where it is decrypted through another method and safely brought back to me.
“How else could we have known of Regent Estate’s plan to attack our allies? That Valley Lord took his elders to Regent Estate and left his home empty for us to attack? Although Luo clan was late in setting up its intelligence network, we are without a doubt the best in Tianyu.”
Zhuo Fan laughed at Li Jingtian’s goony look. [There is such a magical art in this world? And Steward Zhuo used it to gather intel!]
Looking down at the silent clay man, Li Jingtian sighed, “Just who could make such a degenerate cultivation method? What’s the point of having a strong soul if you’ll end up like this, a frozen husk? This is a life worse than death, living in constant pain.”
“Correct. That’s just what this cultivation method offers, a life worse than death. And its creator didn’t even train in it.” Zhuo Fan smiled, “When that old demon created it, he had his disciples train in it to devour their souls and boost his own. Because of the soul’s natural feel, it was easily assimilated. In just one year, the geezer entered the Radiant Stage from the Profound Heaven Stage. In three, he was in the Ethereal Stage!”
“You can actually do that?” Li Jingtian’s sad look turned brighter, drooling at the clay man.
[The kid training in Myriad Breaths can be such a wonderful tonic. Who knew?]
Zhuo Fan mocked, “Elder Li, let me stop you right there. There’s no such thing as shortcuts in cultivation. I haven’t finished telling you how the old demon met his end. His speed was fast, but the souls of his disciples were filled with anguish and despair. And because anger and despair built up so much inside of him, his soul disintegrated under the strain. If not for this, I’d have used the thousands of Luo clan human pillars for myself! “
Shuddering, Li Jingtian chuckled awkwardly.
[I should’ve known by now, Steward Zhuo isn’t one to let any chance slip. This goes to show the method has issues…]

chapters.title: Chapter 425, Fodder Is Fodder
chapters.content:
Chapter 425, Fodder Is Fodder
Translator: StarReader
Zhuo Fan took Li Jingtian across the central area of Hell Valley, picking up human pillars and spreading rumors of Hell Valley’s destruction at the hands of the Luo clan.
This breaking news created a wave that shook all of Tianyu.
No one had seen it coming, that Luo clan would ignore everything and strike down Hell Valley without a rhyme or reason.
Any Tianyu citizen worth his salt knew that the seven houses and imperial family were in a balance and that the imperial family would never allow for another house war to break out.
The Testament was Regent Estate holding onto its ambitions for Drifting Flowers Edifices for the past thousand years, just so that the imperial family wouldn’t get an excuse.
But Luo clan, in all its insufferable boldness, had ruined everything. It tore its confinement, lashed in the face of the people, and ripped Hell Valley off the face of this world.
It was not just a petty house squabble either, but a show of force to the emperor.
All clans had now turned their gazes to the emperor, waiting for his response. They were also praising Zhuo Fan’s powder keg-like temper, thinking that lashing out at the emperor wasn’t bad enough for him to go ahead and drag his clan down with him as well. This was a hefty crime deserving of total annihilation.
In the face of the new house’s rebellion, the people were looking forward to the emperor’s response.
But the average citizen had no clue how the big bosses above him were clashing. That every faction was looking at this development with eagerness.
The emperor was the most excited,who should be laughing his heart out right… about… now.
“Ha-ha-ha…”
The emperor was having the time of his life reading the latest report, “I didn’t help him all these years for nothing after all. He finally showed himself, and not with half-measures, but while striking Hell Valley off the map. He didn’t even spare their ancestors’ graves. Ha-ha-ha…”
“Your Majesty, desecration may be a bit excessive here. Even I have to disagree with this.” Dugu Zhantian at his right nodded in anger, “I get the feeling that the kid is a real man sometimes, while also a degenerate rest of the time!”
“It’s all fine. All I wanted was for him to make his move. He can do anything else for all I care. The more revolting his actions the better. It will help me a lot when going against the houses. They’ll have no way to use the excuse of rewarding my loyal officials with the axe. He-he-he, how can you cherish someone who does crimes against humanity.” The emperor revealed a twisted smile.
Dugu Zhantian nodded.
The setting the emperor had laid out was cunning and vile, unlike his candid nature as a god of war. But for the safety of the people, on eliminating these variables, he would fall in line and obey the orders.
“Your Majesty, when will I act?”
“No rush, let them squirm around a little longer.”
The emperor sighed, “However, I do need to show the people my stance.”
The emperor yelled at the servants at the door, “Draft my orders. The Eighth Nobel House, Windgaze City’s Luo clan, is accused of manslaughter and desecration, of most heinous crimes. By my order, the clans are to root out this evil and bring me their head. The reward shall be the title of Noble House!”
“Understood!” The servant left.
Dugu Zhantian’s face twitched and he sighed inside.
[Your Majesty, that right there is pure rubbish.] If it were that easy to get Zhuo Fan’s head, he’d have taken it ages ago.
Though the edict still had its perks. Giving Dugu’s Army the righteous reason to purge him.
While the Luo clan and Regent Estate would be duking it out, Dugu Army would swoop in to obliterate the former, only to destroy them all.
The emperor was aiming for this, but thinking of his godson, Dugu Zhantian’s heart couldn’t bear it…
Meanwhile, You Ming was at the second prince’s new house, waiting on Valley Lord’s orders.
Second prince stormed into the room, “Something huge has just happened, Sir You Ming.”
“Second prince, easy. There’s a solution to everything if you keep your calm.” You Ming waved.
Second prince paused to cool his jets, and bowed, “Sir You Ming, you are truly cut from a different cloth. You have my complete admiration. I have always been on edge and can’t calm down. But I still need sir’s help in the future.”
“Second prince is too kind.”
You Ming nodded and asked, “Now, Your Highness, just what happened to get you so flustered?”
“Uh, nothing much, just that Zhuo Fan razed Hell Valley…”
“What?!” You Ming was outraged, “W-what did you say? Where’s the report?”
“Uh, here.”
Second prince took out the paper from his sleeve, “Sir You Ming is so open-minded, tranquil in the face of anything. Even as your own home lays in ruins, you don’t bat an eyelid. I am truly amazed…”
[God damn it, why so long winded?]
Reading the paper turned You Ming’s face pale.
The paper fell to the floor as he stood there frozen.
“Slaughtered and desecrated? Zhuo Fan, are you that cruel?”
You Ming’s eyes trembled, his body rigid, and only his mouth moved, “Zhuo Fan, you rotten lowlife. He forced me, forced me!”
“Uh, Sir You Ming, is everything alright?” Second prince asked.
Sighing, You Ming resumed calmly and said, “Your Highness, I have some matters to attend to. I will be gone for a few months. Please don’t act rashly in my absence, goodbye.”
You Ming left right away with hurried steps, his eyes flashing.
He had to plan his escape carefully.
Only the second prince was left behind hanging and speechless…
At the same time, in a valley a hundred miles away from Drifting Flowers City, many experts were gathered, even the heads of many powerful clans.
Bam!
You Wanshan slammed the jade slip into the ground, “This is outrageous, Zhuo Fan! I will have you ripped to pieces!”
“What happened, Valley Lord You?” Huangpu Tianyuan asked.
You Wanshan panted and cupped his hands, for the first time ever, tears trailing down his face, “Estate Lord Huangpu, you are the head of houses. You must give Hell Valley justice. I just got word from the third Venerable that Zhuo Fan along with Li Jingtian has raided Hell Valley. The other three Venerables fought back but I fear they have fallen as well. Please, Estate Lord Huangpu, send your men to assist!”
[What?!]
Huangpu Tianyuan was stunned, “We haven’t even begun our attack on Drifting Flowers Edifices and yet he struck Hell Valley?”
You Wanshan gave a mournful nod. The Hell Valley’s elders were enraged, turning to Huangpu Tianyuan with expectant looks.
They all looked on with hope that their boss would give his support.
Huangpu Tianyuan only stroked his beard, “Sir Leng, what do you think?”
“Hell Valley is our ally. Valley Lord You is our close friend. Of course we’d go out on a limb to help him.” Leng Wuchang shouted.
Hell Valley’s contingent perked up, looking at him with gratitude.
Huangpu Tianyuan looked at him dazed though. [Since when did the shrewd Sir Leng turn righteous?]
But Leng Wuchang showed his true color soon enough.
“Be that as it may…”
Leng Wuchang sighed, “Zhuo Fan’s treachery knows no bounds. Going without a plan will like playing into his hand. We have to avoid that. Valley Lord You, rest assured, we will avenge your home. But we are now on the eve of striking Drifting Flowers City. We must first handle Drifting Flowers Edifices.”
Huangpu Tianyuan nodded, “Drifting Flowers Edifices is in cahoots with Zhuo Fan. Taking them out will soothe Valley Lord You’s anger!”
Everyone nodded. Pill King Hall and Merry Woods enjoyed the show, sneering all the time at Hell Valley.
You Wanshan was fuming, his face red. He flipped around and shouted, “Sir Fang, you are His Majesty’s reinforcements to quell Zhuo Fan. That wretched servant is running amok in Hell Valley and you are just going to do nothing?”
“Uh, Zhuo Fan’s mind is a maze and his actions a mystery. Sir Leng is right. We need to take it one step at a time. First comes Drifting Flowers Edifices, sweeping clean all places he might turn to when he is desperate. Then we will go after him when he has no place to hide. Valley Lord You, you don’t need to worry.” Fang Qiubai spoke.
He had long since received the emperor’s order, to have Zhuo Fan and Regent Estate mind their own business for a while longer. Of course he’d drag this out as well instead of pitting the two ahead of schedule.
As for the fate of cannon fodder dubbed Hell Valley, neither cared a whit.
Fodder was fodder. They’d all die sooner or later. The hegemony for the world would ultimately come down between Zhuo Fan and Regent Estate. The rest couldn’t affect it one damn bit.
You Wanshan saw the open taunts and his anger reached boiling point, yet he was unable to do a thing…

chapters.title: Chapter 426, Drifting Flowers Edifices’ Siege
chapters.content:
Chapter 426, Drifting Flowers Edifices’ Siege
Translator: StarReader
In Drifting Flowers Edifices’ main hall, Grandmother took the seat of honor with a frown. On each side of her, were the fifteen overseers.
Bang!
Grandmother threw a sending jade on the table and sighed, “This is the Luo clan’s 10th message. And like the ones before it, they all warn of a great disaster, that we need to retreat to Luo clan. What do you all say?”
“Humph, that vile ingrate, our Edifice Lord sacrificed so much for him and this is how he repays us? By stealing our most sacred treasure. Who’d believe his messages? I bet it’s just another one of his sick twisted schemes.” Peony Overseer was the first to show a negative attitude, her anger having reached a boiling point.
Iris Overseer nodded after a pause, yet the frown never left her, “Nevertheless, even with Zhuo Fan’s insidious mind putting us on guard on every one of his actions, it’s better to believe the worst than be skeptical and suffer because of it later. Taking up arms won’t harm us in the least.”
“I have already activated our defenses, for any eventuality.” Grandmother nodded, “As for the credibility of these jades, it remains to be seen…”
Boom!
A rumbling sound came from outside, rattling their ears.
All overseers looked on in shock. Grandmother shook and turned downcast.
Xiao Dandan burst in as fast as her legs could carry her, “Oh god, enemy attack!”
“Dandan, speak clearly!” Peony Overseer said.
Xiao Dandan gasped a few times, “Drifting Flowers City’s guarding array is under attack. Senior sisters are now inside to defend it. What do we do, Grandmother, master?”
“We’re really under attack?”
The overseers were incredulous, turning to the jade slip with regret.
Zhuo Fan meant nothing more than to simply inform them by sending those messages.
“Grandmother…” The fifteen pairs of eyes turned to her. She was feeling as much regret as the next woman there.
But she couldn’t let it show. As the leader, everyone believed her words were always right, even when wrong.
Any doubt would cripple their morale and the battle would be half lost from the start.
