Grandmother flashed her eyes with steel determination, conveying confidence in this great crisis, confidence she didn’t have.
“Iris, ask the three Venerables to come. Peony, send jade slips to our allies for help. The rest of you, follow me to meet the enemy. Let’s see which bastards dare challenge Drifting Flowers Edifices!”
Grandmother hammered her staff as she made her way forward with dignity and strength.
The others regained their calm and flew out of Drifting Flowers City. Iris and Peony set about their tasks.
Only Xiao Dandan was left there pouting, “Didn’t he tell us again and again that this’ll happen? Now even if you do believe him, we are cut off and can’t run…”
“Dandan, what are you mumbling? Who taught you to talk of your betters behind their back?” Peony Overseer glared.
Xiao Dandan retorted, “What talking back? It’s the truth. We got a clear warning for three months that this was going to come…”
“You know nothing!”
Peony Overseer barked, “Don’t you know who Zhuo Fan is? He even stole Bodhi Root from us. How can we trust him? How can we be sure it’s not another trick?”
“But it was Yan Fu who told me. He’d never lie to me!” Xiao Dandan was stubborn.
Peony Overseer shook her head, “You brat, Yan Fu was never good to begin with. Now that he’s with Zhuo Fan, he’s even worse. No matter how sincere, he needs to first prove that Zhuo Fan had nothing to do with it, that it wasn’t false. You think I don’t know where you’d been running to these months? Besides bringing the ten sending jades, you still have 28 more love letters from that kid. How can a pure girl like you be like this? Have you no shame?”
Xiao Dandan blushed and huffed, “That’s beside the point. They have been giving us real information all along yet you always second guess his intentions, thinking there’s a plot where there’s nothing.”
“You silly girl, you’ve been growing bolder I see, to talk back to your master. My lessons haven’t been thorough enough it seems!” Peony Overseer was at a loss and blushed with shame and anger.
Xiao Dandan ran away with Peony Overseer on her heels. Their mission, forgotten…
Grandmother took her overseers outside and gasped at the sea of black.
Leading the army were Hell Valley, Merry Woods and Pill King Hall’s lords.
Against such a lineup, even with the home field advantage, Drifting Flowers Edifices’ array would be under immense strain.
Gulping, Grandmother grew anxious. The overseers were scared out of their minds, shaking all over.
You Wanshan’s side laughed.
“Grandmother, we three vow to take Drifting Flowers Edifices. Surrender now, cease these needless hostilities and there won’t be casualties.” You Wanshan held his head high.
Grandmother squinted, “Valley Lord You, what’s the meaning of this? Have you forgotten Tianyu’s laws? The seven houses are banned from engaging in civil war! Marching towards Drifting Flowers Edifices with such fanfare, His Majesty will hear of this and will exact punishment!”
Grandmother’s speech was full of dignity and logic.
But You Wanshan laughed harder, his mocking gaze thicker.
“He-he-he, old hag, why else would we be here in the first place? It’s all by His Majesty’s leave.” You Wanshan shouted, “There’s no one out there coming to help a bunch of broads, ha-ha-ha…”
[What?!]
Grandmother was incredulous.
Keeping the seven houses in check had been the imperial family’s policy since the dawn of the empire. How can they change tactics, letting the land devolve into anarchy?
“Impossible!” Grandmother refuted, “What crime could we possibly have committed for His Majesty to treat us so, to let you attack us?”
“Ha-ha-ha, old crone, don’t play dumb. Who doesn’t know of your ties with that wretched spawn Zhuo Fan. With the mess he made in the Imperial Palace, he is the nation’s number one criminal. And with your connections, you aren’t far behind either.”
At You Wanshan’s cackle, Grandmother shuddered and sighed.
[Zhuo Fan raised us and now he crushes us.]
While Zhuo Fan was on his power trip, Drifting Flowers Edifices had never been safer. But now that Zhuo Fan had become the national enemy, the others used this excuse to get to Drifting Flowers Edifices.
Their thousand year old legacy would lay in ruins.
[Was it truly the right choice to have an alliance with Zhuo Fan?]
Much good did that thinking do at this point. All they could do was buy time for their allies to come help.
Grandmother flew up and shouted, “If you want to destroy Drifting Flowers Edifices, then come! I will face any contenders!”
“Ha-ha-ha, I’ve heard so much of the Lady of Steel and have long wished to try you out!”
You Wanshan flew forth, covered in gray energy letting out eerie cries of infants.
Hatred and grief filled the sky, sweeping Grandmother in its clutches. With the shrieks of agony, malignant specters made of anguish, bit at her.
Hell Valley’s profound ranked martial art, Demonic Face Seal!
The hearts of the overseers were in their throats.
Demonic Face Seal was a soul attack, creepy and powerful. Grandmother had no power against it.
You Wanshan laughed, finding victory in his grasp.
It was then that a glaring white light flashed.
The howling sea of agonized faces came to a halt as ice spread all over them.
They cracked to pieces, pulverizing the demonic faces, leaving room for Grandmother to walk out and send You Wanshan flying with a palm to the chest.
And leaving behind a scarlet trail…

chapters.title: Chapter 427, Crisis
chapters.content:
Chapter 427, Crisis
Translator: StarReader
Pff!
You Wanshan spat out frozen blood as he wobbled to his feet, “Drifting Flowers Edifices’ profound ranked martial art, Heavenly Austere Ice Palm, trained to such perfection it can even freeze my Demonic Face Seal. Congratulations, Lady of Steel.”
“Valley Lord You’s Demonic Face Seal is too exquisite even for me to take lightly. It’s all thanks to decades upon decades of hard work that I had the honor to match Valley Lord You’s skills.”
With how Grandmother wheezed, looking thin and pale, she wasn’t fairing much better either.
You Wanshan cupped his hands and withdrew.
Yan Bogong laughed, stepping in next, “Ha-ha-ha, Grandmother has aged with grace, coming above even the likes of Valley Lord You. How about you humor this old man next?”
“Yan Bogong, you lowlife, you just want to take advantage of Grandmother having fought a hard battle and being exhausted! You’re just picking on the weak!” One overseer cursed.
Yan Bogong took it all in stride and showed a light smile, “That’s a little off, my lady. We three houses joined hands just so we don’t have to go one on one, how does picking on the weak fit here? We just want to duel with Grandmother right now for a bit instead of starting the assault. We’re doing you all a favor!”
Yan Bogong justified himself, leaving the overseers speechless.
Grandmother let out a cold laughter, her eyes icy.
Yan Bogong implied he was giving Drifting Flowers Edifices leeway, but one thing remained unchanged. In an all out war, Drifting Flowers Edifices had the disadvantage, but it wasn’t going to fall that easily, not when having a defensive array.
While Grandmother was the pillar of Drifting Flowers Edifices. With her being dead, the battle would already be over.
Even with the array, when there was no one to direct it, defeat was certain.
Yan Bogong and company wanted to cut the head and the body would follow. These duels were in fact in their complete favor.
The astute Grandmother picked up on their little trick right away.
But she accepted anyway. The three lords’ defeat would have the same drastic effect on the enemy as her death.
It went without saying that it would work wonders in cutting Drifting Flowers Edifices’ casualties short and would stall for their allies’ support.
It really was the best choice in Drifting Flowers Edifices’ current situation.
No matter how weak Grandmother felt, she had to push on. Just that revulsion at Yan Bogong preaching righteousness always came to her.
[Both sides are fighting a battle of minds, for their own interest, yet you want to look cool doing it?]
“Yan Bogong, come!” Grandmother had an icy air and a smirk.
Yan Bogong smiled there, calm and carefree. But the next second he turned savage, launching Rainbow Cloud Palm with both hands, Pill King Hall’s signature move.
Grandmother knew it was coming and had a shield of ice around her as she went on the offensive.
The poison was acidic, but it wouldn’t eat through the clear ice that fast.
It took no longer than a flash for Grandmother to pass through the heavy poison cloud and reach Yan Bogong with a palm strike.
Watching the icy palm inching towards his chest, Yan Bogong’s heart tensed. His fate would soon be the same as You Wanshan before him.
He might be on edge at the incoming ice, but not panicked. He even had time to show off a creepy smile.
Grandmother had a bad feeling about this.
Whoosh~
From the thick fog, one man shot in front of Yan Bogong and punched. It was Merry Woods’s Lin Rufeng.
“You?” Grandmother cried.
Lin Rufeng grinned, “One and only!”
The punch and palm collided. Lin Rufeng’s savage power pierced the ice on her palm and wreaked havoc in her body.
With a sharp sound, the icy shield collapsed and ten fierce blows hammered her body, sending her flying.
She shot through the poison cloud and into the ground. The blood she spat tinted the ground in eerie colors.
This was the worst outcome.
Grandmother was heavily wounded and poisoned by the Rainbow Cloud Palm.
Pff!
Puffing out more blood, Grandmother glared at the two above with endless hatred, “Merry Woods’ profound ranked martial art, Empty Cloud Art!”
“Our Empty Cloud Art is based on speed, splitting an attack into several blows to tear up your insides. The more advanced the cultivation, the more splits. You may have ice protecting you, but not even that can block all of them. I have managed to unleash twenty splits, ha-ha-ha…”
Lin Rufeng laughed in pride.
The overseers rushed at Grandmother’s side, giving a hateful glare at the two lords above, “You no good two-bit filthy scumbags! Is that how a house lord acts nowadays, stabbing people in the back?”
“Oh, no, no, no. Didn’t I say that already? This is a coalition of three houses; anything goes. Besides, us two work great together and we haven’t even surrounded you with our forces yet. What’s wrong with that?” Yan Bogong snickered.
The women’s eyes spat fire from all the rage boiling in their hearts.
Grandmother panted, finding it hard to even speak, “Take me back, now!”
Yan Bogong snickered, “You won’t get away that easy. Attack! Their head is down. It’s the perfect moment to take them all down!”
“Understood!”
The sea of people came in like a tide.
The overseers rushed to get Grandmother back to safety. But Yan Bogong’s team of two was faster, making a sinister strike at the retreating Grandmother.
Take her out of the picture and the Drifting Flowers Edifices would follow.
The other women rushed to defend her.
The overseers stood no chance in front of two house lords. They were dead in one blow, unable to stall one second.
Two more turned back to attack, but Grandmother stopped them.
“Grandmother!” They all cried.
Grandmother sighed, “I won’t be able to survive this but you are the future of Drifting Flowers Edifices. Go, withdraw. Let Iris become the Edifice Lord. I will hold them off!”
“Grandmother, no!” They all teared up in sadness.
Grandmother barked, “You bunch of ignorant girls, how can you not see what’s in front? I have to hold them back or we’ll all die. Go back and wait. We will get our chance when support comes…”
Grandmother trailed off.
Not even she was certain that Drifting Flowers Edifices could come out alive, but held on to hope still.
The women saw the steel gaze of Grandmother and despite their distress, they nodded and withdrew to Drifting Flowers City.
Grandmother showed a clear smile, watching them go, “Silly girls, take care…”
“Ha-ha-ha, Chu Bijun, you should care about yourself first!”
The two closed in, Yan Bogong’s creepy voice reaching her ears.
Grandmother had a cold smile, her mind set, “Humph, Yan Bogong, Lin Rufeng, as long as there’s one breath left in this body, you will never tread one step in Drifting Flowers Edifices!”
Grandmother flew high at the two.
The two met her fearlessly. She had the Lady of Steel moniker, but with how downtrodden she was from that last blow, they wouldn’t qualify as house lords if they backed off now.
With a bang, the two sides clashed.
The shock wave turned everything around them to dust. The two kept on attacking, even as Grandmother was spurting blood and lost consciousness.
Her frail and damaged body slammed into the ground.
“Grandmother!”
The women shed tears of pain, at their helplessness and their weakness.
Yan Bogong walked over and struck again, “Ha-ha-ha, the great Lady of Steel’s head is mine for the taking!”
Something shot straight for Yan Bogong.
He squinted and looked shocked.
[Killing with intent. A Radiant Stage expert…]

chapters.title: Chapter 428, Three Venerables
chapters.content:
Chapter 428, Three Venerables
Translator: StarReader
Bam!
Yan Bogong panicked at the incoming soul attack and put up his defenses, despite being a mere Profound Heaven cultivator with no chance against a Radiant Stage expert.
The intent left the two groaning.
Yan Bogong even flew away, leaving a trail of blood in the air. Lin Rufeng stopped dead in his tracks, trembling and rooted.
Rustle~
Three graceful figures floated between Grandmother and the lords, Drifting Flowers Edifices’ Venerables.
Looking back at the unconscious Grandmother, one shouted, “What are you waiting for? Get her out of here!”
“Understood!”
The overseers’ morale soared, flying away with Grandmother. They were at ease knowing the Venerables had their back.
The tide of people came to a halt as well.
“Humph, you lowlifes dare set your eyes on Drifting Flowers Edifices?” The Venerables faced the thousands with angry rebuke.
Yan Bogong barely stood his ground, pale and weary, yet not a trace of fear, “He-he-he, big words for just a bunch of broads. If not for the imperial family’s help in the past millennium, you’d never see today. Don’t think for a second that being in the Radiant Stage will change anything. Which of us houses doesn’t have its own Venerables? Now more than ever, when we have the great Regent Estate taking the lead!”
“Ha-ha-ha, we are the ones behind this siege!”
Laughter shook the area. To everyone’s shock, an astonishing power surged as a grizzled old man showed his face.
His eyes flashing like lightning, his face excited.
Each of his breath felt like the world was sucked away then unleashed back as a storm.
The three Venerables squinted and shouted in shock, “Huangpu Fenglei!”
“My purpose here is to deal with you three!” His head held impossibly high, Huangpu Fenglei flicked his hand with disdain, “I am not one to pick on women, so I’ll take you all on.”
Twitching, the three turned grave.
Despite living in seclusion, they had all heard of Huangpu Fenglei’s name. He was a rare peak Radiant Stage expert in this world. The ones capable of fighting him in Tianyu could be counted on one hand.
Sure there were three of them, but the strongest was only in the 5th layer. It’d hardly make a difference. But as Drifting Flowers Edifices’ Venerables, having enjoyed its resources for decades, they weren’t about to flee in the face of danger.
They were women, but they were principled, even more so than some men.
With a deep breath to steady their nerves, one showed her will to fight or die trying, “Sisters, today’s the day we will fight for justice!”
“Ha-ha-ha, it won’t matter. We’ve lived together and we’ll die together. A fitting end for our hundred year friendship!” The two laughed.
The first smiled.
Having reached an understanding, all flew at the mighty Huangpu Fenglei with not one ounce of fear.
Huangpu Fenglei praised, “I’ve heard of Drifting Flowers Edifices’ women being staunch and now I see it for myself. You are far better than some male wolves drunk on power.”
Huangpu Fenglei continued, “I will give you three free shots at me before I attack, seeing as I’m so kind. Begin!”
“Humph, thank you for your consideration, sir. We’re happy to accept.”
Huangpu Fenglei was tough and the three were not fools. If the guy gave them three free moves, they weren’t about to refuse.
They had a non-zero chance, impossible odds true, but there was always the luck of the moment. The least they could manage was injure him, stopping him from breaking the array.
It would give some value to their deaths, knowing to have returned the kindness Drifting Flowers Edifices offered them for so long. With one less warrior on the enemy’s side, Drifting Flowers Edifices’ chances would rise.
The three turned solemn, each taking a direction and making a sign.
The wind picked up and the Yuan Qi surged. A white mist formed between the three, linking them and feeding off each other’s strengths, to their very peak of power.
An ice phoenix took form between them, three hundred meters large and shrieking.
Huangpu Fenglei’s brow shuddered, “Combination martial art? I never knew you’d be so in tune with each other, of the same heart and mind.”
“Humph, who needs your praise? You should take this instead!” The leader of the three scoffed and pushed out her palms.
The other two matched her perfectly.
Shriek~
The ice phoenix unleashed its full killing intent on Huangpu Fenglei as it charged. All in its wake turned to ice, even air itself.
Yan Bogong cried out in shock.
Radiant Stage experts weren’t without their fame. While a combined attack from three went farther. Such an attack would wipe them out, peak Profound Heaven experts, along with half the people there.
Forget about fighting Drifting Flowers Edifices at this point. It was a miracle if the army stuck together.
Yan Bogong and Lin Rufeng exchanged a glance and cold sweat ran down their spines. Thank the maker they had Regent Estate on their side, with High Venerable’s personal interference.
The casualties would’ve been horrible without him.
[These broads sure are tough…]
Unlike everyone’s panicked look, Huangpu Fenglei praised and looked on with a calm expression.
When the ice phoenix got near him, he waved, “Humph, this skill sure is dangerous, but not to me.”
Huangpu Fenglei clutched the ice phoenix’s neck and squeezed.
With a bang, the phoenix crumbled into glittering ice.
Huangpu Fenglei grinned, “First!”
The ice fragments released an unbearable coldness, unleashing a frosty wave straight towards Huangpu Fenglei.
It swallowed him in its midst, leaving behind nothing, not even Huangpu Fenglei’s body, just a sparkling human-sized ice sculpture.
“High Venerable!” Everyone cried.
With Huangpu Fenglei getting done in from the three hag’s attack, how would the rest fare?
Amidst their anxiety and fear, cracking sounds revealed the breaking of the sculpture.
With a bang to finish, Huangpu Fenglei was revealed in all his glory with a manic laughter, “Who knew such an attack hid an even stronger one? Ha-ha-ha, how amazing. Not that it did any good to the likes of me.”
“High Venerable is invincible…” The crowd cheered.
Whooshes sounded as the three Venerables flashed right in Huangpu Fenglei’s face.
“Huangpu Fenglei, we knew this attack won’t work, so we prepared a little something.” The leader shouted.
The other two also yelled and their fingers formed a sword.
Profound ranked martial art, Dark Heaven Finger!
Huangpu Fenglei gave his all to resist this time around. But the ice and coldness from before had him slowed down.
Giving the three Venerables enough time for their sword fingers to hit his pressure points.
With the sound of freezing water, Huangpu Fenglei felt icy coldness invade his body and freeze his veins. He was shocked that Yuan Qi could hardly stop it.
[This can’t be!]
With his power, not even these three together could freeze him, yet now…
Huangpu Fenglei turned grave, and doubt sprouted. His fists clenched and body shuddered…

chapters.title: Chapter 429, Death Before Dishonor
chapters.content:
Chapter 429, Death Before Dishonor
Translator: StarReader
The leader had a cold smile, “Huangpu Fenglei, did you think that combination art was all to deceive you? Wrong, so very wrong, ha-ha-ha…”
The ice on Huangpu Fenglei grew harder and thicker, his body soon became rigid and only his eyes were moving. He ended up getting caged inside the ice like a lion, poised to jump out at a moment’s notice and rip its query to pieces.
“Don’t look at me like that. There’s no chance of coming out of this. The ice phoenix’s cold energy is keeping you frozen, not to mention the icy energy in your body keeping your Yuan Qi sealed. This way, our Dark Heaven Finger works in tandem with the first attack and freezes you solid.”
The leader’s eyes sparkled with the joy of victory, “Ha-ha-ha, you may be a peak expert, but with your Yuan Qi on ice, even if you get out of our move your power will be cut in half. Huangpu Fenglei, you brought this on yourself!”
Despite being frozen stiff, Huangpu Fenglei didn’t panic, speaking in a sinister tone, “Hags, don’t write me off so early. Your parlor tricks are no match for me!”
Huangpu Fenglei let out dragonic roars and exploded in a golden shower.
Roar!
Nine golden dragons shot from inside him. The powerful Yuan Qi waves shook the ice off and sent the three women flying as well.
The three left a trail of blood as they hit the ground.
Looking up, they watched Huangpu Fenglei come down like a god, wrapped in nine dragons and with an overbearing aura.
That relentless power surging around him was testament to his state of health, undamaged, untouched.
It came at an even greater shock to the women, followed by despair. If even their combined attacks couldn’t do anything, this man was a freak, godlike!
They lowered their heads, bitter, having lost all hope.
Huangpu Fenglei eased up on the glaring light show and overlooked them like the emperor as he raised a second finger, “Imperial Tyrant Body Art is the strongest cultivation method among the houses. No one can stop me. That was the second move.”
“Sisters, we have one more chance. Have you thought about it?”
The leader showed resolve, ready to die. The other two smiled, “What’s there to think? Of our peak skills, we can only use that!”
“Let’s do it!”
The leader nodded, getting their feet under them and watching Huangpu Fenglei above without any fear, “Huangpu Fenglei, you better keep your word. Since you said, you’ll give us three free moves, then three is what we have!”
“Of course. My word is my bond. But what could you possibly come up with that can work, humph…” Huangpu Fenglei snorted.
The leader was calm, “Nothing, only our blood for our house!”
The three jumped high at Huangpu Fenglei, with power and speed.
Huangpu Fenglei frowned, unclear of their aim.
[What other combination art are they using? Why can’t I sense anything?]
The Venerables took three directions around him and shot their palms forward.
With three sounds, the palms impacted Huangpu Fenglei’s perfect body, without so much as a scratch.
Huangpu Fenglei just took it like a champ, with arms crossed. He looked at them curious, “Is this your final move, a palm? There was not even a skill behind it. There’s no way you can harm me with that. You’ve lost your last chance.”
“Ha-ha-ha, thank you Sir Huangpu for giving us these free moves, but this palm is only half of it.” With an odd smile, the leader made a sign.
The other two followed.
Huangpu Fenglei was puzzled, [Do they want to use some super secret art?]
But why did that sign feel so familiar? He shot his eyes wide open and cried, “Self-destruction?! You…”
“This is our last move, death before dishonor!” The women grinned.
Huangpu Fenglei was scared silly. With the three Radiant Stage experts so close and primed to blow, not even Imperial Tyrant Body Art could bear it.
He used all his Yuan Qi to unleash a golden glow and make the trio fly.
Too little, too late. With one last smile, to Huangpu Fenglei’s frantic look, three earth-shattering explosions wrecked the place.
Boom~
The huge balls of flame swallowed the sky, shaking up everything. Even with the array in place, Drifting Flowers City was now in ruins.
Yan Bogong ducked just as the tide of flames passed him. One careless twitch could burn his head clean off.
Once the cool wind set in again, the people looked shell-shocked.
The mountains around them were now flatlands while the trees floated around as ashes.
The Bone Tempering disciples had their meridians crushed and died. Maybe they wanted a closer look at death, or just sheer bad luck, they stuck their neck out to see the glorious apocalyptic flame, only to have half their body burnt, testament to their folly.
Yan Bogong’s heart was shaking all over.
[What a frightening explosion! And that came out of three Radiant Stage expert’s self-destruction. Then what about the person at their core, their High Venerable…]
He looked around in panic and shouted, “High Venerable, are you alright?”
Bam!
A black figure slammed the ground.
Yan Bogong rushed over to see Huangpu Fenglei’s face burnt black, laying there broken and robbed of any air of superiority.
Pff!
Blood spurted out and Huangpu Fenglei wheezed. Looking around at the faces, he rejoiced at his new lease on life.
“High Venerable, you’re amazing to come out alive from that. You’re the only one in Tianyu to pull it off!” Yan Bogong gave a thumb’s up and a good ass-licking.
Huangpu Fenglei had no time for his gibberish, frowning, “Why did they do it?”
“Uh, you mean those Drifting Flowers Edifices’ Venerables?” Yan Bogong smiled, “Who cares? They couldn’t beat you so they decided to drag you down as well. But they never thought, even this couldn’t kill you. You’re still in one piece. He-he-he, they died for nothing, the idiots!”
“No!”
Huangpu Fenglei shook his head weakly, “A cultivator that has reached the Radiant Stage would cherish his life above everything. They would never throw their lives away unless it is the very last resort. They could’ve used the Drifting Flowers Edifices’ array to stall me and escape. So why…”
Yan Bogong paused, “Pigheaded… perhaps?”
“Ha-ha-ha, that’s putting it mildly.” Huangpu Fenglei barely propped his body, “Drifting Flowers Edifices, a women’s domain, hasn’t survived all these years on empty words alone.”
Huangpu Fenglei limped away.
Yan Bogong asked, “High Venerable, aren’t we attacking?”
“Of course we are, fool. But that’s your problem. I need to dress my wounds. Can’t you see I can’t even fly and have a busted leg? ” Glaring back, Huangpu Fenglei cursed.
But he didn’t leave without a final piece of advice, “Don’t get careless, Drifting Flowers Edifices’ womens can’t be underestimated.”
Yan Bogong nodded, exchanged a glance with Lin Rufeng, [Looking at your wretched state, we can glean that much. Though…]
They looked back at Drifting Flowers City and felt a headache coming.
Without a Radiant Stage to support them, how many years would it take to break through?
The Regent Estate’s experts only acted as support, leaving the heavy lifting to them. The only helper, Huangpu Fenglei, was now away on medical leave…

chapters.title: Chapter 430, Baiting the Aid
chapters.content:
Chapter 430, Baiting the Aid
Translator: StarReader
Boom!
The explosion shook all of Drifting Flowers City, houses crumbled and turned to dust.
Drifting Flowers Edifices’ main hall had calm and wise women handling everyday’s affairs but they were now crying in panic.
Grandmother, pale and weak, lay on the floor, rocking to the explosion’s rhythm. The odd bump into the ground of her head had her frowning and opening her eyes.
“Aunt Tao, Grandmother’s awake!” Peony Overseer perked up.
Drifting Flowers Edifices’ head alchemist, Tao Danniang, rushed over, “Grandmother’s injury is stable, but…”
“What?” Peony Overseer asked.
Tao Danniang sighed, “Removing the Rainbow Cloud Palm’s poison is beyond these wrinkled hands’ ability. They alone hold the antidote!”
“W-what do we do now?” Peony Overseer asked, “Pill King Hall is right outside our gates. Are we supposed to go out there and grab one to force an antidote out of them?”
Everyone shook their heads from how powerless they were.
Pill King Hall was already strong by themself, but now in the three house coalition it would be even tougher for Drifting Flowers Edifices to deal with them. Going out now was plain suicide.
Iris Overseer smiled, “Peony, don’t be nervous, Pill King Hall had a monopoly on the Rainbow Cloud Palm’s antidote until now. Did you forget how Zhuo Fan deciphered the antidote at the Hundred Pill Meeting, curing Grandmother, Aunt Tao and many of our sisters. Even their top alchemist, Vicious Pill King is now under the Luo clan. And with him as an ally, there’s no need to fear any poison!”
“Yeah, we just have to get in touch with them and Grandmother will be fine.” Aunt Tao nodded, relieved.
She felt like having Zhuo Fan as an ally was the best thing that ever happened to them. The Rainbow Cloud Palm squeezing on them every minute of every hour was now a thing of the past.
Peony Overseer pouted, her face unnatural, “But that prick stole our precious heirloom. How can we trust him? “
“It will be great if he returns it. But if he doesn’t…”
Grandmother’s faint voice trailed off weakly. Then she came to a decision and spoke firmly, “All we can do is move on. If Drifting Flowers Edifices is to survive, we need to compromise. We need allies like him the most right now. What is the point of getting the treasure back only to find a city filled with corpses?”
All became pensive.
Their respect for Grandmother was growing.
Grandmother had earned the respect of all houses for a reason. And for the same reason she kept Drifting Flowers Edifices afloat all this time. As a house lord, she had to have the mind and eyes that went beyond the scope of the common man, with vaulting ambition and steel resolve.
Always thinking long term and never nitpicking on the details.
And in their final hour, Drifting Flowers Edifices needed allies the most. They couldn’t throw away Zhuo Fan over some Bodhi Root.
It was the same as cutting off one’s legs!
“So you want to lean on Luo clan?” Peony Overseer pouted, still against it.
Zhuo Fan stole their stuff yet they still turned to him for help? Wasn’t that like asking a thief for asylum?
Drifting Flowers Edifices’ name would be dragged through the mud, her sisters’ as well.
Grandmother smiled in reply, “Yes, Zhuo Fan had made us a promise back when he was in trouble. We can rely on him. Now that he is one of the big players, he is our support. It’s all just a repaid investment, ha-ha-ha…
“Peony, you usually go off the deep end and are frank. You are kind at heart, but not suited to be the Edifice Lord. As the one bearing the responsibility of Drifting Flowers Edifices, one has to be flexible and set your gaze beyond the present moment. A useless thing like reputation will only drag us down.” Grandmother shook her head.
Peony Overseer blushed, knowing her own defects as well.
“What was that large noise just now anyway?” Grandmother turned to the rest.
They all shook their heads.
Someone burst in tears, “Grandmother, overseers, the three Venerables…”
“What about the Venerables?” Grandmother asked frantically.
Sniffing, the girl wailed, “The Venerables self-destructed to deal with Huangpu Fenglei!”
“What?!” Grandmother shuddered then spat blood, tears streaking her face.
“Grandmother!” The others panicked.
Grandmother waved them off, “It was my mistake to lead them to their doom. If only I heeded the Luo clan’s warnings and retreated, they would’ve been alive and wouldn’t have died in vain.”
“Grandmother, the only one to blame is Zhuo Fan. He betrayed our trust first. We could never overlook this transgression!” Peony Overseer advised.
Grandmother shook her hand, talking after a pause, “The three Venerables’ death is on me. But we can’t bicker over Drifting Flowers Edifices’ calamity. What about Huangpu Fenglei, what’s going on outside?”
“Grandmother, Huangpu Fenglei is badly hurt and has withdrawn from battle. Yan Bogong and the others are attacking our barriers while sisters are pushing them back. They can hold on for the time being.”
“Regent Estate’s High Venerable? What about the Regent Estate itself?” Grandmother asked.
The girl shook her head, “Grandmother, there’s no sign of them.”
“That means Regent Estate isn’t involved!” Grandmother squinted, “Overseers, join the defenses and never attack, only resist. Guard Drifting Flowers Edifices and wait for our allies!”
“Understood!” Everyone bowed.
Meanwhile, Yan Bogong, Lin Rufeng and You Wanshan attacked the city for three months.
Although three houses united was a force to reckon with, Drifting Flowers Edifices’ defenses were like a steel wall. Even after all this time, they had only punched through 26 barriers, with dozens more to go.
How many years would that take?
“For god’s sake! I should’ve just brought all my Venerables!” Lin Rufeng panted, peering over the city and at the mountain in the distance, “What the hell is Regent Estate and those rotten Divine Dragons doing? They decided on this attack, yet now they are taking the backseat while we risk our necks? What’s so scary about Drifting Flowers Edifices anyway? If we’d all pitch in, it’d be over and done with by now!”
“Calm down.”
You Wanshan advised, “Sir Leng said we’re baiting the aid. While we have Drifting Flowers Edifices on the ropes, they’ll attack the reinforcements. I heard Veiled Dragon Pavilion and Sword Marquise Abode’s forces have been beaten back many times already.”
“Humph, Regent Estate can handle those guys with a modicum of effort. What’s the point of having all of them in the back as support?” Lin Rufeng mocked.
Yan Bogong shook his head, “House Lord Lin, don’t say that. They aren’t much hassle, true, but what if Zhuo Fan comes?”
Rumble!
Lin Rufeng’s face fell and his voice was cut off.
On the day of Luo clan’s ceremony, they all witnessed its power and glory. Besides the abomination dubbed Zhuo Fan, they had ten elders, each stronger than the next, violent and savage.
Not even Regent Estate wanted to pick a fight with them.
Lin Rufeng waved his hand, “Let’s just keep attacking.”
You Wanshan and Yan Bogong chuckled inside. You Wanshan slapped his chest in full confidence, “Worry not, the city will soon fall. My three Venerables are coming in two days. With Radiant Stage experts clearing a path for us, their guarding array will be no obstacle!”
You Wanshan beamed with pride.
[Want to break Drifting Flowers City? Only we can do it.]
Yan Bogong snickered.
“With Valley Lord You’s home a wreckage, you don’t need Radiant Stage experts to defend it. While our men are just too homesick to leave, ha-ha-ha…” Lin Rufeng mocked.
You Wanshan’s face fell.
It cut him deep, each time he was reminded of the ruined Hell Valley. What he wanted was to get merit in this battle and earn Regent Estate’s compensation. But Lin Rufeng and Yan Bogong, the bastards, had to poke where it hurt.
[Humph, you’ll see! Zhuo Fan will take good care of your shacks just as well. We’ll see who’s laughing then.]
You Wanshan’s mind was filled with malicious curses…

chapters.title: Chapter 431, Most Dangerous Ally
chapters.content:
Chapter 431, Most Dangerous Ally
Translator: StarReader
“Sir Leng, any updates?”
In a quiet little room, Leng Wuchang was sitting at a desk deep in thought when Huangpu Tianyuan came in laughing, “With Drifting Flowers Edifices under siege for three months now, small fries keep on coming. It’s so boring. When will a big fish bite anyway? Sir Leng, what do you reckon that big fish is planning right now?”
After a bow, Leng Wuchang sighed, “Estate Lord, our plan and reality do not match, I’m afraid.”
“Where exactly?” Huangpu Tianyuan asked.
Leng Wuchang spoke, “Our main plan to bait the aid involved faking an attack on Drifting Flowers Edifices to draw Zhuo Fan out. With Estate Lord’s Nine Dragons Diamond Body, we’d catch Zhuo Fan by surprise and finish him off in one swift blow. However…”
“What?” Huangpu Tianyuan asked impatiently.
Leng Wuchang shook his head, “The way it has played out is that we’ve fallen for it.”
“What, how?” Huangpu Tianyuan jerked.
Leng Wuchang said, “By being a borrowed knife.”
Unsettled, Huangpu Tianyuan eyed him.
Leng Wuchang explained, “It may be that we predicted Zhuo Fan’s aim all wrong. His vision is far wider. We thought he would protect his allies to secure his power. But with Drifting Flowers Edifices under siege for months yet there being no sign of Luo clan, it goes to show that he has abandoned them. If anything, he was counting on us to destroy Drifting Flowers Edifices for him!”
“What?”
Huangpu Tianyuan trembled, “To what end? What does he get from this?”
“Humph, plenty.”
Leng Wuchang snickered, “A man without roots is the easiest to sway. Even if Drifting Flowers Edifices survived and he won in the end, Drifting Flowers Edifices, being who it is, will remain only an ally. But when Drifting Flowers Edifices falls, he’d accept the women with open arms, getting them on his side and leaving only the world for the taking. Such a cunning plan, what a twisted mind. Even I could only deduce this from the current state. Zhuo Fan is a truly diabolical mastermind.
“By my calculations, he not only wants us to destroy Drifting Flowers Edifices, but all his allies. He will then take them in like a good samaritan and they, in their moment of gratitude and weakness, will accept the conversion wholeheartedly.”
Even Leng Wuchang felt cold sweat on his brow at this point.
Zhuo Fan’s insidious ploys never left room for errors, using cloak and daggers to stab at his own allies through his enemies.
Even Leng Wuchang had fallen for such a mastermind’s devious schemes.
[Zhuo Fan is the most dangerous ally so far!]
Huangpu Tianyuan panicked inside, “Veiled Dragon Pavilion was the first to care for the Luo clan and Zhuo Fan once had close ties with Chu Qingcheng. Is he that dead inside to throw everything aside and plot against them?”
“That’s what makes Zhuo Fan such an abomination.”
Leng Wuchang sighed, “A man of ambition only looks at things from a perspective and never lets some platonic relationships drag him down.”
Huangpu Tianyuan nodded, “But how did he know we’d attack Drifting Flowers Edifices with the three houses?”
“Ha-ha-ha, Estate Lord, do you remember when we planned to divide our forces into three and take them all down at the same time? Who was it that proposed we attack one house at a time and bait the aid?” Leng Wuchang’s eyes glinted.
Huangpu Tianyuan shouted, “Fang Qiubai!”
“Him indeed.”
Leng Wuchang nodded, “I didn’t think much of it at the time, figuring flushing Zhuo Fan out and removing him from the picture at the earliest was better. But now, ha-ha-ha, it has been the imperial family playing us all along.”
“The emperor’s involved too?”
“Yes.” Leng Wuchang patted the shocked Huangpu Tianyuan.
Huangpu Tianyuan was still finding it odd, “Doesn’t the emperor want us to eliminate Zhuo Fan? Why is he on his side now? Was that ruckus at the palace all an act for the Regent Estate’s eyes?”
“Not at all. Estate Lord is overthinking things. Back when Zhuo Fan and the emperor had a falling out, the emperor wanted to get rid of Zhuo Fan, but also of us!”
Leng Wuchang explained with a smile, “Ha-ha-ha, here’s what I think happened. The emperor had Divine Dragons come to us as helpers but used them to find our plan of attack on Drifting Flowers Edifices and gave it over to Zhuo Fan. With the prick’s cunning nature, he knew that standing on the side and taking a beating will get his allies wiped out. So he attacked Hell Valley.”
The emperor caught on to his action and had the Divine Dragons propose the baiting the aid plan, not to draw Zhuo Fan out but to give him time to ruin Pill King Hall and Merry Woods. The imperial family’s master plan isn’t to have one of us two destroyed, but to have both of us on our last leg, at our weakest. “
Leng Wuchang got the gist of it, more or less. Except for one thing.
It was Zhuo Fan’s intelligence network that got wind of their plans and it was him cueing the emperor in, leaving the imperial family to be one step behind.
Zhuo Fan had complete control of the situation across the board, something the imperial family never intended to happen.
But it wasn’t something one could hold against Unwonted Contriver, since the human pillars were a super secret art from Zhuo Fan’s endless bag of tricks. Even if he smashed his head and combed through the gray matter, he’d still not figure it out.
Figuring as much as he did was quite commendable though.
Sighing, Huangpu Tianyuan nodded, “Damn the emperor and his sharp mind. Just how can I take advantage of you? What’s the point in staying here then if Zhuo Fan is a no show? Men, everyone go back to Drifting Flowers Edifices and capture it in one move. We’ll then handle Veiled Dragon Pavilion and Sword Marquise Abode the same way. We just have to be faster than Zhuo Fan. Catch him when he’s down then take the emperor’s head!”
“Not so fast.”
Leng Wuchang said, “Estate Lord, we have to follow the emperor’s intent. Or instead of watching from the sidelines, he’d see Zhuo Fan weak and help him from the shadows. That’s the worst outcome for us.”
“What’s there to fear? With my Nine Dragons Diamond Body, the world…”
“It is for this reason that we need to exercise caution.” Leng Wuchang cut him off, “Your secret is to deal with Zhuo Fan. If it comes out now, he’ll place some counters and we’ll have an even harder time dealing with him. Estate Lord, don’t you want to take in these vagrants?”
Huangpu Tianyuan showed a wide smile, “Sir Leng, you mean…”
“Zhuo Fan’s scheme is groundbreaking and ingenious. Why not apply the same idea to our side?”
With a sneaky smile, Leng Wuchang continued, “He wants us to help him get his allies in line and that’s what we’ll do. But won’t he help us getting our own allies as well? Hell Valley’s people are already homeless and can only turn to Regent Estate for shelter. That only leaves Pill King Hall and Merry Woods. Estate Lord only needs to seize this chance to subdue them and their lands for the future. Isn’t it a shame to let such a prime chance go?”
Huangpu Tianyuan cackled, “Sir Leng, you’re saying we should thank Zhuo Fan for giving us such a wonderful idea. We’d never thought such an ingenious trick can get us all the seven houses and without any bad blood between us either.”
“Ha-ha-ha, you should show your thanks by leaving his corpse intact.” Leng Wuchang smiled.
Huangpu Tianyuan laughed.
After all the talks, nothing had changed. Regent Estate’s experts were still lazily waiting for the “baiting the aid” to catch something and Huangpu Tianyuan’s three allies were still working their asses off attacking Drifting Flowers City.
A few more days later however, Drifting Flowers City was still holding solid, but with heavy casualties. Seven overseers had died as well.
The defenses wouldn’t hold for long if this kept up.
Whoosh!
In their moment of great despair, a green jade slip flew into Grandmother’s hand.
Grandmother laughed, “It’s from our allies. We’re saved!”
Hope blossomed.
Grandmother scanned the jade slip and froze. With a crack, the jade scattered into pieces on the floor…

chapters.title: Chapter 432, On Your Own
chapters.content:
Chapter 432, On Your Own
Translator: StarReader
“What’s wrong, Grandmother?” Everyone cried.
Grandmother sighed, “It is a message from Pavilion Lord Long. Regent Estate has indeed assisted in our siege. But instead of helping Hell Valley and the others, it is stopping our reinforcements. Pavilion Lord Long’s side has suffered heavy casualties and was forced into retreating. We’re on our own.”
“What?”
The women shook their heads in grief. They had held on so far hanging on to the hope that help was on the way.
But with even their support under heavy attack, they had sunk into the pits of despair.
They could hold on for just a few short months before they would be breached.
Drifting Flowers Edifices was hanging by a thread.
Everyone sighed, feeling death closer than ever.
Grandmother’s eyes flashed with determination, “Overseers, split into five teams and break out tonight. We will meet again at Flying Cloud City a thousand miles away!”
“Grandmother…”
“I know this is dangerous, with a high chance of being wiped out, but it’s better than sitting around for the axe to drop. We still have dozens of defenses in effect. They will never expect us to make such a risky move. Breaking through is our best bet. If we wait any longer, they’ll raise their guard!” Grandmother squinted.
The others nodded.
It was the most dangerous, yet most promising course of action. Waiting any longer would have even this chance robbed off of them.
The overseers bowed, “Understood, Grandmother…”
The moon hung high in the night sky, with a seldom cloud marring its glow every now and then. Outside Drifting Flowers City, the disciples of the three houses withdrew after a long day of work, leaving a few hundred guards.
One overseer took its thousand disciples under the cover of the night outside the city. They moved fast, like panthers, and were upon the unsuspecting guards in seconds.
“Ah, ene-“
The guard’s cry was cut short at the swipe of a Drifting Flowers Edifices’ disciple’s blade across his neck. His eyes were still wide as he hit the pool of blood on the ground.
Drifting Flowers Edifices’ disciples split in teams of 3-5 members, robbing the lives of guards and ensuring the success of this mission.
Slip-up was bound to happen at some point regardless.
A guard threw a jade slip into the air.
The jade slip exploded in a shower of light, revealing the shadows in its glaring display.
The overseer shouted, “We’ve been spotted. Sisters, forget everything and just attack!”
“Charge!”
The thousand disciples rushed together towards the garrison of the three houses as they shouted.
The house lords were out at the first sign of warning, guiding their disciples. Seeing it was just a thousand people coming at them, they relaxed.
“That’s it? These broads make a night raid with a thousand warriors? That’s not nearly enough to get us warmed up, ha-ha-ha…” Lin Rufeng disdained.
Yan Bogong nodded with a smile, “True. With only some average overseers in the lead, what can they do even if they reach us? Since when did that Chu Bijun shrew turn senile? You should send more people if you want to attack. These few are of no use!”
“And what if they have different plans? I intend to capture an overseer and wring it out of her. This’ll be some nice and easy merit.” You Wanshan’s eyes glinted.
The other two nodded inside.
[You Wanshan sure makes sense.]
They both charged as well. With their level, this would be a walk in the park.
You Wanshan snickered in the back, carefree.
Bam!
Lin Rufeng was the first to arrive with his uncanny speed. A single palm had the overseer flying and heavily wounded.
Lin Rufeng snickered, glancing at Yan Bogong coming over with cock-sure attitude, “Ha-ha-ha, it looks like the credit is all mine.”
“Humph, of course it comes easy to you when you run faster than a hare. As for how much credit you get, it remains to be seen.” Yan Bogong smiled.
Lin Rufeng brushed his remark off, grabbing the woman, “Merit is merit either way. Ha-ha-ha, lass, why are you attacking at night?”
The overseer merely held her head high, watching the moon.
Her thousand disciples were defeated as well, most dead, others captured, and very few escaped.
Lin Rufeng’s hand tightened and flooded her body with Yuan Qi.
The woman’s brow creased and sweated from the unimaginable pain, but she still didn’t make a peep.
“Humph, you sure are tough. Let me relieve you of a hand first!” Lin Rufeng shouted.
The woman was still moon gazing. Lin Rufeng was pissed, but Yan Bogong stopped him before he got to any cutting, “Ha-ha-ha, House Lord Lin, this girl is an overseer. Standard interrogation won’t work on her. I have with me a Hundred Ant Pill. It will feel like thousands of ant bites all over the body. Such pain and torment is worse than death. Can I give it a try?”
[Humph, you rotten geezer. You’re stealing my thunder.]
It was obvious to Lin Rufeng’s what the old man’s game was, but it wasn’t like he was getting anything out of the stubborn lass either.
If by some chance the info she had was priceless, delaying it would have Regent Estate yell Merry Woods’ ears out.
Lin Rufeng sighed and handed her over, “Fine, let’s see if your Hundred Ant Pill is as good as you say.”
“Prepare to be amazed, ha-ha-ha…”
Yan Bogong forced her jaw open and threw the pill in.
The woman twitched and jerked and started sweating harder than ever.
But she still kept her lips tight, even chewing them to the point of bleeding.
“Ha-ha-ha, it must hurt like hell. Stinging, itching, tingling, and let’s not forget the excruciating pain!”
With a cackle, Yan Bogong approached her ear, “No one can stand it more than two hours. You better fess up and I’ll relieve you of your torment. Why must you be so stubborn? Talk, why are you attacking?”
The woman gnashed her teeth harder and her face contorted.
Yan Bogong wasn’t going anywhere, just looking at her in confidence, “Then help yourself to a world of hurt. Just let me know when the going gets too tough, alright? I’ll be waiting, ha-ha-ha…”
Yan Bogong spoke like a winner. You Wanshan at the side had a lazy and vague smile.
An hour into the torture, the woman was red like a ripe tomato and could no longer take it, “Give it to me now! I’ll talk! I’ll tell you everything!”
Yan Bogong glanced at Lin Rufeng in pride and threw a pill in her mouth.
The woman calmed down while shivering.
“Ha-ha-ha, now talk. Don’t think for a second that I’ll believe you if you say you came to capture our camp with so few people. What’s your aim? Speak the truth!” Yan Bogong smiled.
The woman looked at the sky and showed a pleased smile, “Ha-ha-ha, it’s too late! You’re too late!”
“What’s going on, talk!” Yan Bogong frowned.
The woman mocked him, “I led my team here knowing full well that all we’ll find is death. Our mission was quite simple really. To kill the guards and fake a raid and, once discovered, stall. Grandmother and the rest have already left. You’re too late in catching up, ha-ha-ha…”
“What, this was a diversion?”
Yan Bogong shuddered and cursed, “Damn that bitch and her schemes. That hag acted all dignified for so long and we never thought she’d sacrifice an overseer, to save herself no less. Humph, you really showed me, Lady of Steel!”
Yan Bogong fumed under the woman’s sneer. Lin Rufeng was already thinking about how to explain this to Regent Estate.
Only You Wanshan had a prideful look and a crafty grin…

chapters.title: Chapter 433, Life in Desperation
chapters.content:
Chapter 433, Life in Desperation
Translator: StarReader
The sun’s morning rays spilled on the land, dispelling the darkness and promising hope.
In a gloomy ravine, Grandmother took her group to a creek for a drop of water. They all looked weary and tired, with Grandmother having it worse due to the poison.
“Grandmother, here’s some water.” One disciple showed consideration for her.
Grandmother patted the child’s head and looked to the east heartbroken, “I heard from last night’s five teams, Guelder Rose’s team was spotted. For the sake of our journey to safety, they drew the enemy and must have died by now. I have let them down!”
“Grandmother, Overseer Guelder Rose is like all of us, willing to lay down their life for Drifting Flowers Edifices! She would never blame you.” Peony Overseer appeased.
Grandmother shook her head in tears.
Whoosh!
Iris Overseer flashed in front of them.
Her face turned heavy looking around as she spoke, “Grandmother, the way forward is blocked and they’re now searching for us on their way over here.”
“What?”
Grandmother cried and shook. If not for someone holding her steady, she would’ve collapsed by now.
“Did they foresee our plan to escape? How?” Grandmother asked incredulously, “Who is coming after us?”
Iris Overseer replied, “Grandmother, their group is made of youths led by Hell Valley’s Grand Elder and 5th elder.”
“Did Hell Valley guess our attempt to flee? Ever since You Guiqi died, they’ve never had such guile.”
Shaking her head, Grandmother felt bitter regret festering inside.
[I’ve completely lost…]
Back in Drifting Flowers Edifices, they could still hold on for a couple of months with their defenses, but here, turned into stragglers, they stood no chance against any group.
Their escape was a bold gamble.
Win and Drifting Flowers Edifices would one day rise from the ashes. Lose and their deaths would be all the more tragic.
It was quite obvious now what hand she had played.
“I have been farsighted all my life only to make mistakes over and over at the end, ruining Drifting Flowers Edifices’ legacy. I am ashamed to meet my ancestors in the underworld.” Grandmother cried.
The others sighed as well, hanging their desolate faces.
On a hill behind them, footsteps sounded that had everyone on edge.
All the eyes looked over tense and frightened…
Meanwhile, Hell Valley’s army of thousands was combing through the area, zeroing in on Grandmother’s location. Between Grand Elder and 5th elder was a man in gray, You Ming.
Taking in the lush vegetation, You Ming’s eyes flashed.
“You Ming, you’ve grown so much in skill over the years. I still can’t believe that old hag would leave the city and its defenses and make for such a daring attempt. We never would’ve had such an easy time trapping so many of them if it weren’t for you. I wonder how much merit will this get us? Ha-ha-ha…” Grand Elder praised.
th elder nodded, “Ha-ha-ha, You Ming is turning out to resemble the 7th elder more and more.”
“No, I do not want to become my master. I want to surpass him!”
You Ming sighed, “Grand Elder, has Grandmother been caught?”
Grand Elder shook his head, “In their attempt to flee, we’ve captured four teams, but neither had that old hag among them.”
“Perfect.”
You Ming nodded.
He gave the signal to stop, peering at a hill in front of them, “Wait here while I look ahead.”
“You Ming, why is it that you always go ahead? Are you trying to take all the credit?” 5th elder asked.
You Ming smiled, “I am only an adviser, 5th elder. How can I take down thousands of people by myself and steal your credit? I only want to check for signs of them passing through here and their direction. With all of us going ahead, it will mask all the clues.”
“Old 5th, you’re so petty!”
Grand Elder glared, “You Ming earned the most merit in the first place with his plan. Why would he steal ours then?”
“He-he-he, I was just messing around. Don’t mind it, You Ming.” 5th elder scratched his head.
You Ming nodded, rushing up the hill.
What he saw beyond the hill had him wide-eyed.
Grandmother and her people were tense, but ready to fight to the last.
The only choice now was to go down fighting.
Yet You Ming made a signal for them to stay quiet.
They all looked stumped.
You Ming turned around and shouted to Grand Elder, “Drifting Flowers Edifices’ team passed through here. They must’ve gone in that direction. You might catch them if you give chase!”
You Ming’s finger picked a random spot. Grand Elder was overjoyed and led his men into a chase. With their trust in You Ming and the hill separating them, they had no clue their quarry was just over yonder. They were so close yet oh so far.
The women were stumped, looking tensed at You Ming.
Why would someone from Hell Valley help them?
With the army behind him gone, You Ming said, “Everyone from Drifting Flowers Edifices, east and west are blocked. Only north and south have been searched already and there’s no one there. But I highly recommend going south. In those tall mountains and dense forest, it’s easy to hide.”
You Ming left.
“One moment.”
Grandmother cried, “Thank you, sir, for your timely rescue. But why did you help us?”
You Ming mocked, “Help you? Ha-ha-ha, you’re rich. It’s never worth betraying my house over some strays. Just send this message to Zhuo Fan. He owes me one.”
You Ming flew after Hell Valley’s men.
Grandmother felt bitter and despondent.
Zhuo Fan had cast such a huge shadow that even the enemy had people hoping to get on his good side. The youth just now wouldn’t have helped them otherwise.
They all felt sour at the revelation.
Grandmother was known to all houses for a hundred years, yet her name had less weight than an upstart. [Who’d have thought Zhuo Fan’s name can make one betray his house?]
[How could we be so different?]
No one knew that the true mastermind behind their current plight was none other than their savior, You Ming.
He did it all for Zhuo Fan.
Not that Zhuo Fan asked him, of course, but Zhuo Fan’s handiwork had left him with no other choice.
Ever since Zhuo Fan razed Hell Valley, the guy was homeless.
It hit him the instant the news reached him. Zhuo Fan took care of Hell Valley to force him to renounce his unflinching trust for his house.
As long as Hell Valley stood, he was one of them and betraying one’s king never came easy.
But with his home up in smokes, Hell Valley was gone for good. Even though You Wanshan took his elders to follow Regent Estate to attack Drifting Flowers Edifices.
And Regent Estate would never entertain the notion of helping them rebuild, deciding on a far better approach, to absorb them.
As it stood, this vagrant who used to be at a three-way crossroads found only two paths forward, Regent Estate and Zhuo Fan.
Under these circumstances, he had put aside the good of the house and was putting himself first.
Breaking Drifting Flowers Edifices was gaining credit in front of Regent Estate, while letting Drifting Flowers Edifices go was doing Zhuo Fan a solid. No matter which of these two behemoths ended up ruling the lands, he had a way out.
This was his plan, to be a double agent!
“I can’t help but wonder, who’ll be my lord in the end? Ha-ha-ha…” You Ming shook his head.
The women heeded You Ming’s advice and escaped the four houses’ siege and bumped into their rescue team.
“Grandmother, Steward Zhuo has had us waiting for you here for ages!” Qiu Yanhai cupped his hands…

chapters.title: Chapter 434, Rescue and Attack
chapters.content:
Chapter 434, Rescue and Attack
Translator: StarReader
The women got startled thinking the enemy was upon them.
But on a closer look, it was only Luo clan’s power couple and thus they breathed easier.
Bowing, Grandmother spoke, “Elders, it’s so good to see you in this hour of desperate need.”
“Our houses are allies after all. It’s only natural to help.” Qiu Yanhai replied in kind then turned serious, “Grandmother, there’s something I don’t understand. We’ve clearly given you ample warning about Regent Estate’s assault yet why were you so passive?”
Grandmother and the overseers flushed, hanging their heads in shame.
[These elders are clearly hinting at our mistrust in the Luo clan. That we stalled making a decision for so long.]
That was like calling them petty and suspicious. But at least they did rescue them.
With a cough, Grandmother fought through the awkwardness, “To be honest, I’ve been in seclusion for so long and the information was left to the others. They were too shallow in their thinking and didn’t take it seriously that the Regent Estate would attack. When I came out, I was beset with enemies at the gates and it was already too late. I am truly ashamed, a-he-he-hem~”
Grandmother coughed with a red face.
It was a first for her to tell such an obvious lie in front of everyone and to shift the blame on her girls. It only made her more ashamed.
What other choice was there? She couldn’t just come clean and say it was an honest mistake on her part. It’d cut away at the houses’ trust.
With how they had turned into strays, they couldn’t afford to push away Luo clan’s help.
“Oh… I see.”
Qiu Yanhai and Xue Qingjian said, while beaming inside. Zhuo Fan had called it ever since he got Drifting Flowers Edifices’ call for help. And these two were obviously clued in as well.
Just that, to complete Zhuo Fan’s master plan of adding Drifting Flowers Edifices to the Luo Clan, these two had to reign in the teasing, lest they ruin the demonic steward’s scheme.
So they could only laugh inside, nodding at the hag’s lame excuse.
But they couldn’t wipe that silly grin off their faces.
Grandmother figured out on the spot that the two were in on her difficulties and turned away from those taunting stares.
[Humph, you don’t know how to take help at face value so you suspected our info? He-he-he, look who’s down in the dumps now.]
Grandmother felt bitter inside.
Peony Overseer was outraged, “Since you knew about the attack on us for so long, why didn’t you come help earlier? Were you waiting for us to be destroyed before acting? What kind of an ally are you?”
“Girlie, we wouldn’t be here in the first place otherwise.”
Qiu Yanhai was a Radiant Stage expert. He showed class to the women on behalf of Zhuo Fan, but would he let a Profound Heaven overseer just talk back to him?
Grandmother mediated, “Elder Qiu, please calm down. Peony is just so brash. Please don’t mind her.”
Grandmother then chastised, “Peony, Elder Qiu has come from afar to help us so the least you could do is show some consideration. Apologize!”
“Humph, screw apologies! If their rescue is real, why are there so few of them and without even Zhuo Fan? They have no intention to help us, clearly!” Peony Overseer shouted.
Qiu Yanhai snickered in rage, “Ignorant lass, what does a bunch of thoughtless broads like you know of Steward Zhuo’s intricate planning?
“When he received your plea for help, Steward Zhuo knew you’d never look at him the same way for taking your Bodhi Root or believe his messages. Steward Zhuo even warned us not to say this or it would break the ties between the houses. But you’ve given me no choice!”
“Humph, does that give him the right to steal our precious treasure?” Peony Overseer didn’t back down even against a Radiant Stage expert. Grandmother kept on pulling her but it was no use.
[These two are with Luo clan now, but they’re still known as monsters in Tianyu. How could you irk them?]
Confronting them here was the dumbest thing one could do.
Qiu Yanhai clenched his fists, “You listen here girl, if not for Steward Zhuo, I would have snapped your neck for this gross lack of respect!”
Qiu Yanhai’s savage aura exploded and sent shivers down everyone’s spine.
Grandmother paled, pulling Peony Overseer behind her and glaring at her to keep her trap shut.
They had barely gotten out alive from one siege and were now about to find their end at their own allies’ hands over a petty squabble.
[They are stronger than everyone here, yet you’re still nagging?]
Grandmother sighed, feeling like giving Peony Overseer a good ass kicking. [It’s been so long yet your temper has never mellowed. We may even die from it!]
They all gulped with fear, watching Qiu Yanhai on edge.
Xue Qingjian defused the heavy mood with a smile, pulling Qiu Yanhai over, “Ha-ha-ha, we’re all on the same side. Why must we bicker? Right, Grandmother?”
“Yes, Elder Xue is totally right!”
Grandmother was quick to grab the lifeline, bowing to Qiu Yanhai, “Elder Qiu, forgive me. I have failed to teach her properly. It is all my fault and I ask that Elder Qiu restrain his anger.”
Grandmother’s bow was real low, her Lady of Steel vibe gone, leaving her with no prestige.
This scene dawned on every overseer that they were now homeless and had lost all their pride.
Qiu Yanhai snorted.
Xue Qingjian smiled, “Big lug, they’ve already apologized. Show some consideration.”
“Humph!”
Qiu Yanhai flared his nose, his chin still way out.
Xue Qingjian turned serious and kicked his ass, launching into a tirade, “Now you’re ignoring me, is that it? I thought I told you to show some consideration!”
Qiu Yanhai’s cocky attitude was gone, looking at Xue Qingjian like the victim. Then he waved it all off with a cough at Grandmother, “It’s fine. I am not so petty, a-he-hem…”
Perhaps it was all too awkward, but he coughed and raised his head again.
Drifting Flowers Edifices’ women were stunned, even Grandmother. She snapped out of it with a thanks though while the women laughed inside.
[Ah, that explains it. The savage Elder Qiu is whipped…]
Xue Qingjian came to Grandmother and Peony Overseer with a smile, “Don’t mind him, his temper is always burning hot. It comes and goes just as fast. As for the Bodhi Root, Steward Zhuo forbade us from mentioning it. You will have to ask him when you meet.”
“I wouldn’t dare!”
Grandmother shook her head, relieved. Xue Qingjian had her consideration in mind, guaranteeing Qiu Yanhai wouldn’t mess with them later.
The stress of having an 8th layer of Radiant Stage expert after you would give one nightmares.
“Also,” Xue Qingjian said, “After hearing your plea for help, Steward Zhuo split his forces. While we were here as relief, he led an attack on Pill King Hall.”
“Pill King Hall? Why?” Peony Overseer became a sourpuss again. But a glare from Grandmother shut her up.
Qiu Yanhai mocked, “That’s why I said you are ignorant. In his infinite wisdom, Steward Zhuo knew of your siege and was thinking about how to assist. He foresaw Sword Marquise Abode and Veiled Dragon Pavilion coming to help but getting pushed back with heavy losses. You thought Steward Zhuo would lead his own people into a trap?
“I’ll have you know that Steward Zhuo is attacking Pill King Hall to get them to fall back. Reports on the attack on Pill King Hall should be coming in right about now, getting Regent Estate and the rest to come to its rescue. Wouldn’t that relieve your city of the siege? We would then come in with our thousands of troops and coordinate with you in destroying them. A shame you couldn’t even last that long.”
Drifting Flowers Edifices’s people felt like crying.
[Blast it! We got out too soon!]
[We should’ve stayed put a few more days and the relief would’ve come, saving Drifting Flowers Edifices.]
Grandmother felt sick to her stomach. It was a severe lapse in judgment.
Only the power couple giggled inside at their mournful looks.
[Sigh, Drifting Flowers Edifices almost got played to death, tossed between Steward Zhuo and Regent Estate. But this is sure to guarantee their change of heart…]

chapters.title: Chapter 435, True Expert
chapters.content:
Chapter 435, True Expert
Translator: StarReader
“Ha-ha-ha, Valley Lord You had his men capture the Drifting Flowers Edifices runaways and have earned great merit. A toast to you, Valley Lord You!”
In a wide courtyard, Regent Estate held a feast. Huangpu Tianyuan sat in the main seat, with the house lords and Divine Dragons at his sides.
Huangpu Tianyuan looked flushed, laughing like the world was his oyster and toasting to Hell Valley’s success. You Wanshan faked modesty, “Huangpu Tianyuan, Estate Lord is too kind. It was my duty.”
[Humph, hypocrite!]
Yan Bogong and Lin Rufeng spat in their minds, eying him with ill intent. While the two of them were breaking their backs attacking the arrays, this guy had it easy casting his net and capturing the fleeing women.
[Like a treacherous scum.]
The two wanted to tear into You Wanshan there and then.
You Wanshan noticed their envy and turned around with a genial smile. It only worked to stoke their anger, [What are you gloating about, you stray? You have no home!]
“Oh, Valley Lord You, impressive move there, capturing Drifting Flowers Edifices’ women. Only, how exactly did you know what they were going to do?” Leng Wuchang asked.
You Wanshan bowed and reported, “Sir Leng, the success isn’t all mine, but the credit falls on my capable assistant!”
You Wanshan pointed at a gray robe, “He is Hell Valley’s new adviser, You Ming, the last disciple of the late You Guiqi!”
Everyone turned to You Ming.
You Guiqi was the third greatest mind in Tianyu. Although a shame, he fell at the hands of Zhuo Fan, he was quite the character.
It went without saying that his disciple ought to at least live up to the name of his master.
So everyone scrutinized You Ming, even Huangpu Tianyuan.
You Ming bowed and took his seat again.
Leng Wuchang sized him up, nodding, “I see now why Hell Valley has moved with purpose and precision as of late. You have an adviser now. Ha-ha-ha, heroes always come young. Sir You Ming, by your guess, where do you think the fleeing Drifting Flowers Edifices women turned to?”
“To be quite frank, I do not know. However, knowing how stubborn Grandmother is, and going by her name as Lady of Steel, she isn’t one to give up. Sooner or later this day was bound to come and she planned accordingly. I just never imagined she would be so bold as to break the siege while they still had some fight left in them. Capturing so many of her disciples was just a happy coincidence. Although it is regrettable that Grandmother and the overseers got away.”
You Ming sighed, “My skill is still poor and many things escape me. Hope Estate Lord can forgive me.”
Yan Bogong and Lin Rufeng’s faces twitched in tandem.
[Poser!]
[My stars and garters, this punk is just like You Wanshan. Bragging and faking humility.]
[If you grabbed all those prisoners by mistake, does that mean the two houses who got jack squat should hang themselves?]
The two lords flared their nostrils and panted in rage.
The siege of Drifting Flowers Edifices had come up with the vagrant Hell Valley as the definite winner. Something these two would never accept.
Leng Wuchang smiled, “Sir You Ming is so modest. How can it be a mistake when you have gained such merit? Ha-ha-ha…”
Huangpu Tianyuan nodded, “You Ming, you truly take after your master. Hell Valley will go far with you by their side.”
“Estate Lord is too kind.” You Ming nodded.
You Wanshan laughed in pride, believing rebuilding Hell Valley was just around the corner.
Yan Bogong mocked, “Humph, what future can a house with a robbed home ever have?”
“What did you say?” You Wanshan roared.
Despite Hell Valley’s heavy looks, Yan Bogong still had a look of contempt, turning his head in mockery.
A whoosh announced the arrival of a green flash. Yan Bogong caught it.
He read the jade carefully and paled. He dropped to his knees then and there and begged, “Estate Lord Huangpu, I beg of you, rescue Pill King Hall!”
“What on earth has happened, Hall Lord Yan?” Huangpu Tianyuan asked.
Yan Bogong was erratic, “Z-Zhuo Fan is laying waste to Pill King Hall. My house’s legacy is about to be turned to dust. Please, Estate Lord, send aid!”
“What?”
They couldn’t believe their ears. Zhuo Fan was now after Pill King Hall?
Huangpu Tianyuan and Leng Wuchang looked shocked, but a glimmer of a smile was hidden in their eyes.
You Wanshan enjoyed how the tables had turned, laughing carefree, “He-he-he, talk about righteous retribution.”
“You!”
Yan Bogong’s eyes went red. Who told him to look down on another man’s misfortune? He had no way to retort and looked pleadingly at Huangpu Tianyuan, “Estate Lord Huangpu, you must help me. The entire Pill King Hall will be eternally grateful.”
Stroking his chin, Huangpu Tianyuan turned to Leng Wuchang.
Leng Wuchang had come prepared, putting on a heavy look, to match the mood, “Zhuo Fan is too vile and insidious. Going in without a plan will set us up for disaster, falling for his devious ploy. To the best of my knowledge, we should instead attack his allies to force him away. We will attack Veiled Dragon Pavilion and that will make him come to their rescue. Won’t that relieve Pill King Hall?”
Zhuo Fan would’ve given Leng Wuchang the biggest thumbs up if he was here.
[Nice, you took the words right out of my mouth!]
The two were in tune with each other on this, using each other’s actions as an excuse to further their personal agenda.
[Besides, I’m providing relief, just not directly. I have my best insider working on it as we speak. So you can’t fault me for being a bad ally.]
The result? The Eight Noble Houses were falling one by one, leaving Luo clan and Regent Estate the only ones left standing. The exodus had no choice but to rely on them, boosting their power.
In short, all of them would be laid to waste, with only these two masterminds making out alive like bandits.
You Ming saw through it as well and sighed inside.
[Now ‘this’ is an overt plot. You may know every detail but would still be powerless to stop it. Each side has their own mastermind acting as coordinator and the houses are the fodder. Be it an ally or an enemy, all of you will end up getting chewed and spit out!]
Seeing You Wanshan’s condescending look for him, Yan Bogong sighed inside.
He had finally figured out the difference between You Guiqi, Leng Wuchang and Zhuge Changfeng. [Skilled at working behind the scenes yet powerless in the face of an open scheme.]
[Zhuge Changfeng, Zhuo Fan, Leng Wuchang, the emperor… all are true experts.]
Meanwhile, within two months, Xue Qingjian finally got the thousands of Drifting Flowers Edifices women back to Windgaze City.
Zhuo Fan had long since come out to welcome them of course.
“Grandmother, as I live and breathe. I welcome you!” Zhuo Fan spoke with hands behind his back.
Grandmother bowed from dozens of meters away, “I thank you, Steward Zhuo, for the assistance in Drifting Flowers Edifices’ hour of need, for taking the time to come see us in person. I can’t say how honored I am.”
“How can you say that, Grandmother? We are allies. Of course I’d help you. It must be that Grandmother must still be hurting for what I did back then…” Zhuo Fan sighed, “It is all my fault for betraying your trust and for your suffering now.”
The more Zhuo Fan showed his remorse the more guilty she felt.
She had been suspicious of him from the first message that arrived and still blamed it on him leaving her with an even worse feeling of making the wrong accusations.
Peony Overseer had no such qualms, “Talk then, why did you steal our heirloom?”
“Peony!” Grandmother glared.
Zhuo Fan waved, “I admit, it was wrong stealing from you. I have no excuse. For that, I have let everyone down when you needed me the most. I didn’t wish for this to happen…”
“There’s no need for excuses. Steward Zhuo, you have done nothing wrong.”
Xue Qingjian intervened, “Did you know that Regent Estate had young miss and young master in their clutches, forcing Steward Zhuo to commit such a vile act? What would you have done, Grandmother?”
“Elder Xue, you’re out of line!” Zhuo Fan berated.
But Drifting Flowers Edifices got the full picture. That the bastards from Regent Estate had pushed him…

chapters.title: Chapter 436, Refining a War Puppet
chapters.content:
Chapter 436, Refining a War Puppet
Translator: StarReader
“That devious Regent Estate, and Leng Wuchang, that snake!” Grandmother gnashed her teeth.
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Grandmother need not say that. They’re not that vile. It was me who betrayed you despite our ties. It is all on me. The only one you can take it out on is also me. A man has to do what a man must. I can take it.”
“Oh, no, no, no, Steward Zhuo, I am not so unwise as to take it out on you. I could never blame you now that I know the source of our misfortune. Elder Xue is right. Anyone would’ve done it if it were them, including me. It is not within my right to judge you, Steward Zhuo!”
The more Zhuo Fan gave his head on a platter, the more he made Grandmother feel bad; riddling her with guilt and shame.
She ended up cursing Regent Estate some more, “That wretched and vile and degenerate Regent Estate wanted to incite discord among us. Leng Wuchang is even worse. I bet he came up with that despicable plan. He stands back while Regent Estate is put to work, forcing you into driving a wedge between us. Alas, I did fall for their ploy, doubting Luo clan and resulting in today’s calamity. This is all my fault.”
Grandmother cried again. Zhuo Fan blinked.
Whether Leng Wuchang aimed for this when forcing him to get the Bodhi Root, he didn’t know. But one thing he was certain of, Regent Estate was packed with experts, while Drifting Flowers Edifices’ women are impulsive.
Not to sound narcissistic, but the task of stealing their great treasure could and would only be done by yours truly. No one else had the skills nor the expertise to pull off such a heist.
Yet Grandmother was here denouncing Regent Estate and he couldn’t agree more.
Zhuo Fan patted her shoulder, “Grandmother, now you know that it was all a trick. We must now stand more united than ever, to have nothing come between us again.”
“Yes, Steward Zhuo, Drifting Flowers Edifices is now at its weakest and we will do everything you ask of us, for vengeance and rebuilding Drifting Flowers Edifices!” Grandmother nodded with conviction.
Zhuo Fan did the same, “You honor me with your deep sense of duty. I will never let you down. I noticed you are poisoned with the Rainbow Cloud Palm. I will have someone give you the antidote.”
“Thank you, Steward Zhuo.” Grandmother bowed again and the disciples helped her into the city. Zhuo Fan watched her go.
Drifting Flowers Edifices’ every member passed by him with apologies.
At Peony Overseer’s turn, she dodged his gaze and was no longer as fiery.
“Well I’ll be honest. Steward Zhuo, you sure know how to turn excuses into a high class act. We could’ve just told them when we first met. Why drag it all out till now? I felt my ears explode hearing that Peony nag us on and on.” With the coast clear, Xue Qingjian looked at him puzzled.
Zhuo Fan sighed, “These ladies have just experienced a change of heart.”
And supplied with, “Elder Xue, do you know the difference between fetching and sending?”
Xue Qingjian shook her head.
“Ha-ha-ha, like they say, easy come easy go. When someone gives you something, you don’t give it much value. If you had used the same excuse from the start, no matter how good, they still wouldn’t believe you. Only through their constant inquiry, forcing me to say it, did they take it as truth. And another thing, these excuses cannot come out from me. It has to be from a third party. That’s why, Elder Xue, thank you for your hard work along the way. Your ears must be in agony, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan laughed, “Drifting Flowers Edifices are in ruins and my helping hand will be seen as godsent. Now that all doubts are cleared as well, they will trust no one more than me. This trust will also affect the incoming houses as well, making the reform of the three houses a done deal.”
“Elder Xue, Regent Estate must be gunning for Veiled Dragon Pavilion and Sword Marquise Abode now. Send them a word. Urge them to leave their homes and come to Luo clan. Homeless, they will only have us to rely on in the end.”
“Yes, Steward Zhuo.” Xue Qingjian cupped her hands. But paused, “Steward Zhuo, what is sir’s age again? Why do you look more and more like a sly old fox? Human yet vile at the same time, you still got the three destitute houses moved to tears from your generosity.”
“Ha-ha-ha, it’s not me who made them homeless, but society.” Zhuo Fan said, “The signs of conflict and chaos have appeared, and I can’t stop it. All I can do is stave off the anarchy at my gates. Elder Xue, you will learn in due time. What I have in store for them is for their own good. While I want them integrated and re-educated, everyone else would have them purged.”
Xue Qingjian just bobbed her clueless head.
[You’re telling me it’s common sense to thank the guy for wrecking your thousand year old legacy? It makes total sense.]
[The vile and deceitful Steward Zhuo sure acts quite a nobleman!]
Xue Qingjian didn’t understand, and it wasn’t like Zhuo Fan wanted her to, “How is it going on Elder Qiu’s end?”
“Per your orders, I escorted Drifting Flowers Edifices’ disciples while the old guy is waiting for Regent Estate to vacate their city before they’ll desecrate Drifting Flowers Edifices’ ancestors and fetch you those bodies.”
“Marvelous.”
