Snickering, Huangpu Tianyuan had Zhuo Fan’s Earth Dragon Claw busy while using another claw to slam his brainpan.
Bam!
This time the clashing sound came from the impact between Zhuo Fan’s right arm with the Earth Dragon Claw. The pitch-black eyes looking at him dead in the eye made him clench his teeth.
“I am more than clear on your left arm, though I am curious, how did you get your right arm to match the Earth Dragon Claw? He-he-he, quite a fine specimen. I guess I’ll just have to rip it out of your cold dead body!” Huangpu Tianyuan’s mouth revealed rows of fangs.
Zhuo Fan snorted, “Estate Lord Huangpu, your sons were naive, and you’re no different. If my head was such an easy target, I’d have long since lost it by now. But where the emperor and Gu Santong failed, do you think you’ll succeed?”
“He-he-he, that only makes it vintage, becoming my life’s prized trophy!” Huangpu Tianyuan laughed, his left Earth Dragon Claw tightening on Zhuo Fan’s Qilin arm.
Zhuo Fan fumed inside. He tensed his arms to get away, but found them in a vise.
Huangpu Tianyuan laughed, “Even if you use an Earth Dragon Claw like me, I am a peak Radiant Stage cultivator, while you are a stage short. Now that you’re going nowhere and your arms are locked, you’re like a gimp. But even without these two arms, I can still take your life!”
Huangpu Tianyuan unhinged his jaw and bit on Zhuo Fan’s head. The whistling wind between those sharp fangs made Zhuo Fan shiver.
His allies were shaking with worry.
Zhuo Fan was pinned down and had no place to dodge. Huangpu Tianyuan had to just clamp down, cutting short his life and this war.
Zhuo Fan squinted, his brow soaked, waiting for the last moment as he stared into the mouth of darkness and found the tooth decay of logic festering therein, before ducking his head.
Bam!
The snap of those fangs rattled the ears of everyone while almost blowing out Zhuo Fan’s eardrums.
It was a testament to its savage power.
Zhuo Fan sighed relieved, unlike the tense audience. He had made a lucky escape, but his position was still very much precarious.
His hands were still in deadlock, making him easy picking for the monster looming above.
Zhuo Fan struggled, but those arms just wouldn’t budge.
Huangpu Tianyuan toyed with him, “He-he-he, Steward Zhuo, everyone reaches their end and today it’s yours! You dodged my bite from above, but how will you escape when I attack from below as well?”
Huangpu Tianyuan opened his mouth again as the tail whipped at Zhuo Fan.
The shrill sound that tail made as it traveled stung his mind and vexed his heart.
It was more than capable of splitting his head down the middle. But dodging it would put him right between those fangs.
Zhuo Fan was pushed into a corner.
Luo clan was worried for him, their hearts in their throats. They wanted to come to his rescue, but with how not even Zhuo Fan could overpower Huangpu Tianyuan, their odds were slim at best.
Regent Estate’s allies had it better, everyone smiling at Zhuo Fan’s plight. They’d see the hatred for their ancestors’ desecration be repaid in full.
“Estate Lord Huangpu reigns supreme…”
You Wanshan and others got to an early celebration.
But in the face of such a problem, while tied and facing the jaws of death, Zhuo Fan showed no fear. Maybe his flashing right eye had something to do with it…

chapters.title: Chapter 447, Stomp Ya
chapters.content:
Chapter 447, Stomp Ya
[Divine Eye of the Void’s 1st stage, Shift!]
Whoosh!
Zhuo Fan appeared a hundred meters away just as Huangpu Tianyuan chomped down with another resounding snap.
The tail swept in tandem, cutting the air with such force, a shockwave flew at a lonely hill a kilometer away.
Whipping it out of existence.
The people tensed up at the overbearing display of power. [The slightest twitch from that tail will have any one of us gone from this world, just like that hill!]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes were fixed on the ghastly creature, rejoicing at his timely escape.
He had Divine Eye of the Void to thank for the lucky break.
Alert as he was against Nine Dragons Diamond Body, facing it was still deadly. The earlier display was enough to make his skin crawl.
[That’s what got him so confident that he can handle me and Gu Santong once he got the Bodhi Root.]
Zhuo Fan settled his frantic heart with a long breath.
Crack~
Turning his head, Huangpu Tianyuan’s neck let out snapping sounds, mocking, “Ah, almost forgot you have that as well. You’re fast, sure, but are you faster than me?”
Huangpu Tianyuan flicked his tail and was on Zhuo Fan in a blink.
Zhuo Fan saw two claws going for his head and the steel tail coming at him again.
Zhuo Fan’s eye flashed golden again and he was gone. But just as he appeared, Huangpu Tianyuan flicked his tail to be in his face moments later.
While Zhuo Fan was popping all over, Huangpu Tianyuan was with him every step of the way, leaving no room to even breathe.
Everyone was a bundle of nerves watching them go. It was a first to see the ever cocky Zhuo Fan being on the run, taking with him the confidence they had in winning this war.
With Zhuo Fan on the run, who else was left to deal with Huangpu Tianyuan?
Zhuo Fan was overwhelmed as well. No matter where he went, the guy was there to welcome him, putting the squeeze on him more and more.
It worked to show that his Divine Eye of the Void had room for improvement, his training lacking.
You Wanshan and the others were overjoyed, grinning from ear to ear.
Hu~
Two blue wings sprouted from Zhuo Fan’s back, Sea Phantom Wings.
Their bluish glow spread and Huangpu Tianyuan felt his mind slowing down, his view becoming hazy.
But as he had trained in Nine Dragons Diamond Body, he was a peak Radiant Stage expert and had the soul to fight back the illusion.
But It proved to be a delay enough for experts of Zhuo Fan’s caliber.
“He-he-he, this is my chance.” Zhuo Fan used this gap to use his red right arm to punch.
Bam!
Huangpu Tianyuan was blown away.
Zhuo Fan’s mouth curled up, but then his face froze and trembled, “N-no way! The mighty Qilin arm actually…”
Rumble!
Huangpu Tianyuan tumbled in the air a few times before getting upright again. He looked at his chest and grinned.
There was a faint imprint there, but nothing he couldn’t handle.
“Hi-hi-hi, Zhuo Fan, is that all you could muster after finally catching me open? Humph, that barely even tickled!” Huangpu Tianyuan cackled, with his allies tooting their horns in tandem.
Drifting Flowers Edifices and the rest were only getting glum.
Huangpu Tianyuan was like an unbreakable monster, robbing them of any chance at victory, even if they got lucky enough to take a shot at him.
Since besides luck, one had to target his weakness, scoring them the win. But Huangpu Tianyuan didn’t have any weaknesses.
Zhuo Fan’s side was in the pits of despair…
Shadow King, Sima Hui and Fang Qiubai, the innocent bystanders close by, were speechless.
“We all sensed Huangpu Tianyuan was reborn, but never imagined he’d train in Nine Dragons Diamond Body. Zhuo Fan can’t do anything.” Shadow King sighed, “If this keeps up, it’ll be Regent Estate’s victory. And…”
“And Huangpu Tianyuan becomes our greatest threat!” Sima Hui sighed, “We would’ve lent the Luo clan a hand earlier if we had known. But now Huangpu Tianyuan has an overwhelming position and this will only make dealing with him harder.”
The others nodded and Fang Qiubai said, “Gu Santong may be the only one who can fight him. But ever since he went after Zhuo Fan, the bugger has gone missing.”
“Maybe… Zhuo Fan finished him off.” Shadow King snorted, “The kid is tough, but a child at heart. With Zhuo Fan’s schemes, even being weaker he’d have supreme advantage. It’d be simple to kill him in some way or another.”
“Without Gu Santong, how are we supposed to deal with Huangpu Tianyuan? We were supposed to work with Huangpu Tianyuan to nab Zhuo Fan, and then get him later. But now… even if we team up with Zhuo Fan, the Nine Dragons Diamond Body isn’t easy to surmount. All we can do is watch. His Majesty’s plan already has deviations.”
Sima Hui sighed.
Shadow King nodded, “Don’t be so sure. We still have two more people!”
“Who?” Sima Hui asked.
Shadow King’s eyes flashed in anger, “His Majesty’s five Divine Dragons are real and he does have two experts back in the imperial capital. They were tasked to constrict Gu Santong, but by the looks of things, they’ll be going against Nine Dragons Diamond Body!”
“What?!” The two cried.
These two Divine Dragons were in the dark about this, while Shadow King knew them quite well judging by his tone.
Shadow King smiled at their bewilderment and recalled out loud, “They’re old friends of mine, in a way, and more than worthy to be called Divine Dragons. It’s natural to not know about them since you came later. Wouldn’t you have been quicker to leave His Majesty’s side otherwise, knowing he’d be defenseless?”
The two exclaimed.
[It’s all part of His Majesty’s plan.] But they’ve been by his side for so many years yet the emperor not once let it slip about the extra two Divine Dragons. It went to show how uneasy he felt about them.
The two sighed, souring inside…
Back to Zhuo Fan, he glared at his enemy, plans running wild in that head of his. His right arm shone brighter.
“He-he-he, still won’t give up? Stop wasting time, I am invincible. You can struggle all you want but your destiny is to lie dead at my feet. Zhuo Fan, there’s no getting out of this one!” Huangpu Tianyuan’s eyes flashed with savagery.
Zhuo Fan snickered, flicking his shining red arm, “Who can tell? Since my punch does nothing, I’ll just have to stomp ya!”
“Stomp?” Huangpu Tianyuan glanced at his legs in derision, “You only have powerful arms. You think your puny legs can do what your arms can’t?”
“We won’t know until we try, humph…” Zhuo Fan’s twisted smile came.
Huangpu Tianyuan’s common sense was tingling, but seeing how Zhuo Fan’s latest tricks were for naught, he had stopped paying it any attention.
No matter how sly and slippery Zhuo Fan was, in the face of true power, it was all moot.
Huangpu Tianyuan swished his tail and shot for Zhuo Fan. The latter used Shift to pop a hundred meters above.
Huangpu Tianyuan flicked his tail to go after him, just as Zhuo Fan’s mouth curled into a creepy smile, his red right arm smashing down at him.
Huangpu Tianyuan scoffed, using an Earth Dragon Claw to block.
On contact, the red fist exploded in size, changing its shape from a fist into a spiritual beast’s hoof.
In the face of the rippling winds, the ridiculous power and boundless might, Huangpu Tianyuan knew he had fallen for it good.
With Zhuo Fan coming from above and him from below, it was far too late to dodge. The red hoof even brought along a sense of danger.
He hated himself for not keeping his guard up around this punk.
Zhuo Fan was laughing, “Huangpu Tianyuan, I’ll trample those old bones of yours. Tangible Projection, Soaring Qilin Leg!”

chapters.title: Chapter 448, Returning Dragon’s Roar
chapters.content:
Chapter 448, Returning Dragon’s Roar
Translator: StarReader
Editor: Elitecoder
Bam!
It looked like a hunk of rock was coming down as the red Qilin leg impacted Huangpu Tianyuan’s face, stomping down hard enough to crack something, going by those sounds.
Huangpu Tianyuan put up all four claws, but nothing had any damn use in stopping it.
He kissed the ground so hard the shock wave engulfed the battlefield. Many experts spat blood from it, taking some much needed safety distance.
The dust rose and covered both of them.
As the dust settled, light showed a horrifying scene.
Zhuo Fan’s right arm had turned into a hundred meter tall blood red pillar. It stood upright and tall as it held up the sky.
Zhuo Fan was so tiny next to it, making the contrast sharper on how a human being could release such a pillar.
Shadow King’s side was dumbstruck. Just when they thought they’d seen it all, Zhuo Fan had to get freakier with an even crazier move.
[That’s what he meant by stomping. He has a third leg. But what kind of savage beast has such power?]
Staring at the 7th-level spiritual beast wings on Zhuo Fan’s back and at the hoofed right arm, it got them wondering. [How many inhuman parts does he have?]
[Monster!]
They all thought of it, gulped and shook with fear.
Zhuo Fan was still within the limits of a human monster up till now, but he had gone beyond with this display.
No one there took this conclusion as a good thing.
Drifting Flowers Edifices, Veiled Dragon Pavilion and Sword Marquise Abode jumped in fright, albeit happy at the reversal. He finally had the upper hand against the Nine Dragons Diamond Body.
His advantage was directly proportionate with their odds at winning this war.
You Wanshan’s side slumped, their hearts a mess. Just a minute ago, they were hollering that Huangpu Tianyuan had surpassed the freaky Zhuo Fan.
Only to find out that Zhuo Fan was in fact a human-faced monster. [How do you top that? You can go full earth dragon for all I care, you still can’t take even one of his hits!]
You Wanshan’s side found their earlier confidence maybe just a tiny bit premature.
[Every single move of Zhuo Fan is filled with mystery and tricks! You can’t take him down so easily…]
Zhuo Fan had better things to do than to mind them, like smiling evilly. The Qilin leg stuck deeper into the ground, compressing hundreds of meters into a mere dozen.
You Wanshan and Regent Estate’s Venerables felt like crying.
Unknown as was the fate of their Estate Lord under that hoof, but now they wondered if there’d even be a corpse left. [If you go on trampling any more, we won’t even find a bone left. That’s just barbaric.]
Zhuo Fan’s belief was that true ruthlessness grasped certain victory.
Crack~
Zhuo Fan just kept on pushing, snapping the bedrock like twigs. Each sound only helped drive fear and dread into You Wanshan and allies.
Drifting Flowers Edifices’ side was glad Zhuo Fan had made a comeback, but even they found it hard to see him still going at it.
[Dude, take it easy. Do you have to turn him into a bone meal?]
Zhuo Fan’s capacity for cruelty was only in relation to Huangpu Tianyuan’s danger. He wouldn’t leave the enemy the slightest chance. He had to finish him off.
[This ought to do it.] Zhuo Fan’s arm glowed red and returned to being an innocent arm.
Peering into the hole, he was speechless.
The bedrock was turned to powder under the Qilin leg’s power.
And a man everyone knew rested in the middle of all the sand. Albeit cracked all over, with blood leaking, it was safe to say that he was barely breathing.
“He’s still alive despite Qilin leg’s full power?” Zhuo Fan gasped.
Everyone had witnessed the might of the Qilin leg, and now they bore testament to the tough Nine Dragons Diamond Body. [The guy’s freakin’ tough!]
“Cough~”
Blood spewed with every motion, from his nose and mouth, ears and eyes, but Huangpu Tianyuan got his feet under him, laughing, “Zhuo Fan, I definitely didn’t see that one coming. But even with that killer move, you still can’t take me down!”
“To hell with you and your body! You’re now broken and wounded. Since I couldn’t kill you with the Qilin leg the first time, the second attempt will finish you off. Humph, you’re half dead!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed.
Huangpu Tianyuan only laughed harder, “Half alive is more like it. Did you forget already? My Nine Dragons Diamond Body has reached this step with the help of Bodhi Root. It’s not just tough, but unbreakable!”
Huangpu Tianyuan made a sign and barked, “Nine Dragons Diamond Body, 8th dragon soul Transformation, Returning Dragon’s Roar!”
Roar!
Under the shocked looks of everyone, a green dragon soul shot out of his body and roared as it circled above him.
Green lights fell upon him, healing him to perfection, not even leaving a scar as the scales knit back together.
When the dragon soul returned back inside, he was now the very picture of health.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes trembled in shock.
The Ascending Dragon fused with the Bodhi Root, [And gets this bastard back to full health every time he’s damaged!]
Adding that tough body into the mix and you’d have an indestructible killing machine.
Zhuo Fan frowned. Shadow King’s side was keyed up.
Huangpu Tianyuan’s outrageous power blew their minds. How were they going to beat that?
“Even if Gu Santong steps in, not even he can do anything. With this old monster healing back whenever, no one can beat him!” Fang Qiubai shook his head, “What about the other two Divine Dragons, can they do it?”
Shadow King said, “All I know is that they can handle Gu Santong, but cannot kill him. I reckon Huangpu Tianyuan falls in the same category.”
“As long as there’s a way, we’ll just think about killing him later.” Sima Hui muttered.
Huangpu Tianyuan stretched his limbs in taunt to Zhuo Fan above, yet the man was calm and cool.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed and he punched with his right arm again.
[Since I have no way to finish him off yet, I’ll stall him. Torturing him is better than nothing. And who knows, maybe a way to kill him will come out of it.]
Classic delaying tactic.
First bind the enemy then get some time to think.
It was such an obvious choice that even Huangpu Tianyuan could see it. So he retaliated with a flick of his tail and jumped out.
Boom!
Zhuo Fan’s leg smashed the ground, but not Huangpu Tianyuan.
Frowning, Zhuo Fan sighed inside. [And of course it never goes as planned.]
He only got Huangpu Tianyuan the first time because of how close they were and having the element of surprise.
But Huangpu Tianyuan was a fast learner. He had to keep some distance and that speed of his was enough to stay clear.
What was even worse was that Huangpu Tianyuan wasn’t a cocky old coot like he acted, but was cautious instead.
The worst enemy was a cautious one.
Zhuo Fan sighed.
Coming out empty with the enemy on guard, left Zhuo Fan in truly dire straits!
Case in point, he didn’t have the time to take back his Qilin leg as a bloody maw came from behind.
“Zhuo Fan, now it’s my turn, ha-ha-ha…”

chapters.title: Chapter 449: Qilin Shield
chapters.content:
Chapter 449: Qilin Shield
With a roar of laughter, a sharp sound came from behind Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan used his left arm to fend it off as his right arm returned to normal size for receiving the next blow.
Pff!
Zhuo Fan’s red hand was now holding a tail.
But he wasn’t out of the woods yet, as Huangpu Tianyuan’s second claw came for him. With both hands busy and being unable to use Divine Eye of the Void at such short notice, Zhuo Fan resorted to using his wings as a cover.
Rip!
The Earth Dragon’s Claw pierced them like paper, soaking him in blood.
Zhuo Fan’s brow trembled with pain, yet he was covered with sweat.
At least the Sea Phantom Wings were from a 7th-level spiritual beast and were tough enough to hold the Earth Dragon’s Claw back with the both of them.
Zhuo Fan’s wings trembled, giving his all to resist. Huangpu Tianyuan opened his mouth as the claws and tail struggled in their confinements. Zhuo Fan needed the slightest distraction and his head would roll.
The sight of Zhuo Fan getting pushed back got everyone tense. He couldn’t do anything but be on the receiving end.
It was hard to believe Huangpu Tianyuan was just that strong with his Nine Dragons Diamond Body. Zhuo Fan was only in the Profound Heaven Stage and even his two beast arms weren’t enough to save him from a hard time.
[Blast it! I can only retreat.]
Zhuo Fan sighed, not liking it one bit as his eyes shined golden.
Huangpu Tianyuan could see it clear as day that he wanted to hightail away from the battle.
With Zhuo Fan’s cunning, falling for his tricks once was bad enough. He had to finish him off now, when he had the upper hand.
Who knew what this guy might cook up the next time around.
Zhuo Fan was weak here and now, but his endless bag of tricks made him unpredictable. If by some miracle he escapes this time, it’d be even harder to beat him next time.
And he needed to deal with Zhuo Fan fast. There was the imperial family to consider as well. Leaving Zhuo Fan alive now would be cutting his own feet in his fight with the imperial family.
[This has to end now!]
Huangpu Tianyuan’s eyes flashed with bloodlust, making even Zhuo Fan shiver.
But that wasn’t important, as the golden halo in his eye promised safety.
“Ha-ha-ha, Huangpu Tianyuan, since I can’t beat you, we’ll be sure to meet again!” Zhuo Fan snickered as he poofed away.
Hum~
The ripple was faint and where a peak Radiant Stage expert might fail to pick it up, a Nine Dragons Diamond Body could.
His creepy ears flinched and Huangpu Tianyuan mocked, “Hi-hi-hi, fat chance, Zhuo Fan!”
“Nine Dragons Diamond Body, Earth Dragon Wave!”
Roar!
Huangpu Tianyuan howled at a spot a thousand meters away.
A beam of yellow shot from his maw, just as Zhuo Fan appeared, panting.
Zhuo Fan cried inside, but it was too late.
Boom!
The explosion shone bright and Zhuo Fan caught the yellow pillar right in his chest. He paid a summary visit to the bowls of five mountains before being buried under their rubble.
There was so much dust that it formed a hurricane.
It soon cleared and revealed everything in ruins. A red trail came out of the rocks like a bloody spring, and robbed any hope of Zhuo Fan being alive.
“Steward Zhuo!” Qiu Yanhai and the rest panicked. Drifting Flowers Edifices and Veiled Dragon Pavilion were also worried.
Huangpu Tianyuan mocked, “Dragon Vein Soul is a guardian spirit of the lands. Since I train in the Nine Dragons Diamond Body and am also in the Earth Dragon form, I can pick up any changes in the area. Messing with space around me is like painting a target on your back. That Earth Dragon Wave is my true power. Not even the Earth Dragon Claw can handle it, to say nothing of getting hit squarely in the chest. He’s dead beyond any doubt!”
“Huangpu Tianyuan is invincible!” You Wanshan’s side cheered.
While the Luo clan paled, their hopes seeping out of them like the blood from those rocks.
Huangpu Tianyuan’s declaration wasn’t just to brag. Steward Zhuo had the worst luck this time.
But without him, what were they supposed to do?
Despair set in faster than they could accept it.
Huangpu Tianyuan only had eyes for Zhuo Fan. To a peak Radiant Stage expert, only he mattered, the rest were mere flies.
As long as Zhuo Fan died, everything else would be forgone conclusion.
He had a firm grasp at victory already.
Fang Qiubai’s side sighed, lamenting and shaking their heads.
“A mighty character like Zhuo Fan ended up getting one shot by Huangpu Tianyuan. This power is outrageous.” Sima Hui watched the monster with fear.
Shadow King sighed, “Nine Dragons Diamond Body having a tough body was bad enough, but with the Bodhi Root, he’s invincible. He’s worse than Gu Santong. I wonder if those two and I can fight him off.”
“Senior, that’s not all. When Gu Santong wrecked Tianyu, he did it alone. His fists were too few to handle so many and ended up limited. But Huangpu Tianyuan wants the world, he has both an army and power. It will be far harder than Gu Santong!” Fang Qiubai said.
The others considered and sighed again.
The battlefield turned quiet, with all fighting stopped and everyone turned towards Huangpu Tianyuan. Either in fear or joy or respect.
But to Huangpu Tianyuan, neither allies nor enemies mattered.
Ever since killing Zhuo Fan, he understood one thing from those worshiping gazes. Allies or enemies meant nothing, only ultimate power mattered.
With enough power no one could touch him. With enough power no one would question him.
“Ha-ha-ha…”
Laughing, Huangpu Tianyuan flew to Zhuo Fan’s tomb, roaring, “Zhuo Fan, it’s time you return the last dragon soul. I want to reach the Ethereal Stage, becoming the first in Tianyu!”
Hum~
Before reaching the mound, a wave from the rubble caught him first.
Huangpu Tianyuan halted, looking in the sky, “Zhuo Fan, how are you still alive?”
Hum~
Zhuo Fan was up there the next moment, albeit pale, bloody and out of breath. His chest sported an extra large hole as well.
How convenient that it never went through him completely. He was only heavily wounded, but still alive.
Qiu Yanhai’s side sighed.
Zhuo Fan’s very existence kept hope alive.
“What trick did you pull? That Earth Dragon Wave had the power of eight dragon souls. Those hands might have saved you but anywhere else it hits, it’d run through you and blast you apart. Even if you used the two arms to defend, the shock would’ve wrecked your body. How is it that you’re barely wounded?” Huangpu Tianyuan cried foul.
Zhuo Fan snickered, “Humph, while you have the Earth Dragon Wave, I have the Qilin Shield. Don’t think you can write me off in one hit!”
Zhuo Fan looked at the red glow over him in joy.
As luck had it, from refining the Qilin arm into his body, it even released a red shield.
It was the same red cover he saw back in Lightning Canyon, the Soaring Qilin’s defense.
With how not even Heavenly Emperor’s purple lightning could pierce it, how could anything else?
Zhuo Fan was badly hurt by the impact with the Earth Dragon Wave and not the subsequent shocks.
Or he’d be in pieces by now.
Zhuo Fan sure was glad that he made the trip to Lightning Canyon.
Huangpu Tianyuan’s eyes grew savage. Zhuo Fan was playing too close to the now hollow chest, with too many skills. Dread started pouring in, thinking of the future.
Zhuo Fan snickered, “This round is yours. Will be seeing ya!”
His wings carried his broken body away. Huangpu Tianyuan roared after him, “Where do you think you’re going? Your head stays right here!”
The two were gone in a blink.
The battlefield was filled with dumb faces, [With the commanders gone, what are we supposed to do?]
Leng Wuchang shouted all of a sudden, “Damn it, it’s Zhuo Fan’s trick! Fall back!”

chapters.title: Chapter 450: Poisoners Collide
chapters.content:
Chapter 450: Poisoners Collide
“What’s wrong, Sir Leng? The enemy’s morale is weakened. How can we retreat now?” You Wanshan asked.
Leng Wuchang’s mood was heavy, pondering before speaking, “I am not too clear myself, but this situation reminds me of the fight in the Esoteric Debate.”
The house lords’ hearts seized.
“You can also feel it, right? Zhuo Fan was on the ropes, with no way out but we all know how that turned out.” Leng Wuchang’s heart thumped.
You Wanshan stood dumbstruck and fearful, “Turning utter defeat into complete victory! Sir Leng, are you saying this time as well he… No! He’s clearly wounded, defenseless, routed…”
You Wanshan refused to believe, but still droned, “Though the same happened to him in the Esoteric Debate. No, he had it far worse then. Yet he still won, breaking Huangpu Qingtian’s team and torturing them to death…”
“Sir Leng, do you mean today’s defeat is a trap?” Yan Bogong shuddered.
Since the Esoteric Debate, Zhuo Fan’s savagery had left him traumatized.
In any case like this one, the enemy was left for dead, waiting for them to take their head. But everyone knew Zhuo Fan was an anomaly.
As long as there was breath in his body, anything could happen.
They’ve seen it far too many times how Zhuo Fan flipped the tables in the worst cases, and ways imaginable.
Leng Wuchang sighed, “I am not sure. The kid is one of the few I can’t see through. But one thing is certain, Zhuo Fan was defeated today, but even so, he fled. This is a trap to lure the tiger!”
Everyone shuddered and looked at the two armies. Without Huangpu Tianyuan to back them, they were losing ground.
In this war, they would end up defeated.
With both sides’ experts around the same level, only Luo clan’s fiends stood apart. Not to mention the power couple could waste a Regent Estate Venerable in a blink, each.
While the Four Scheming Demons could keep twenty of them busy and suffering.
If the fight started, they would have heavy casualties. And even if Huangpu Tianyuan made a lucky return, they would only get a bitter victory.
And to think that they still had to fight the imperial family, they all found it not worth it.
The house lords glanced at Leng Wuchang and nodded.
But they had to get the Luo clan’s approval first.
Qiu Yanhai and Xue Qingjian showed a creepy smile.
Qiu Yanhai roared, “Brothers and allies of the Luo clan, together now! Let’s crush them!”
“Elder Qiu, our morale is low, how…” Grandmother cried.
Xue Qingjian waved, “They say Lady of Steel fears nothing, so why are you so shaky? Don’t you see, with the superpowers gone from each camp, the situation is in our favor. Even if it’s a bitter victory, it’s still a victory, hi-hi-hi…”
Grandmother looked at everyone to find it was true.
She and the other house lord were too caught up in their despair over Zhuo Fan’s loss to see with fresh eyes. With those two freaks out of the mix, they were the strongest…
Grandmother eyed her allies, “Was it… Steward Zhuo’s plan?”
“Uh…”
The two looked at each other, then nodded.
The couple was out of the loop just as well though. Zhuo Fan would never do things half measured. His loss had to be real, but that wasn’t the issue here, instead turning it into a chance at victory.
Something Zhuo Fan gave them.
To get their spirits up, the power couple had to say it’s Zhuo Fan’s idea.
Grandmother and company got fired up, “They fell for Steward Zhuo’s trap. Attack!”
Roar!
The depressed Luo clan faction perked up on the fly and roared.
In a war, the losing side would technically be down in the dumps.
But led to believe it was all part of Zhuo Fan’s ingenious and foolproof scheme, and reminded of his sly character, none took his defeat as real and stormed the enemy.
The enemy froze, like sitting ducks.
[Does that mean we fell for his trap?]
Regent Estate’s side turned to the powers that be. But they were now listening to Leng Wuchang’s conjecture. They knew it was not like Qiu Yanhai painted it, [So how can they still get their spirits up?]
Those leaders joined them in putting on the same dumbstruck face.
Regent Estate faction’s morale hit rock bottom, with some even believing that the Estate Lord was now Zhuo Fan’s punching bag in a convoluted scheme of his.
Estate Lord was tough, but nothing could stand Zhuo Fan’s freaky mind games.
[Wasn’t the eldest young master toyed to death in a four versus one battle?]
Everyone paled, their hearts sinking and losing all hope.
While the other side was roaring to go. Looking at them like a bunch of sheeps waiting for the axe to fall.
You Wanshan cursed, “For gods’ sake! How the hell did it come to this? It’s too late to fall back now. They’ll hunt us down. It’s better to fight. Is Estate Lord Huangpu so dull as to not see such a simple trick?”
“Yeah, how did he get duped by such an old trick?” Leng Wuchang sighed.
But he knew the truth. Huangpu Tianyuan was never duped, but was only taking a calculated risk.
Zhuo Fan was a bigger threat than the fate of this battle. Regent Estate’s experts might die here today, but as long as Zhuo Fan fell, it was a win in his book.
He was overconfident in his Nine Dragons Diamond Body, thinking of himself as unstoppable.
[Estate Lord, has the taste of victory gone to your head? Did you forget about Gu Santong three hundred years ago?]
Leng Wuchang sighed…
The armies clashed.
“Rainbow Cloud Palm!”
Yan Bogong in the lead unleashed his poisoned mist to gain the advantage.
But his efforts were met with another poison mist from the Luo clan, pushing it back.
“Nine Poison Fantasy Palm!”
Yan Song roared. The mist vanished and appeared every now and then, making defense useless.
It not only absorbed the Rainbow Cloud Palm, but even poisoned many experts, to the point that even Radiant Stage experts took a breath of it at some point, getting their power cut.
“W-what poison art is that?” Yan Bogong stammered.
Yan Song snickered, “He-he-he, Hall Lord, time sure flies, eh? Do you perhaps find Steward Zhuo’s Nine Poison Fantasy Palm a bit stronger than Pill King Hall’s Rainbow Cloud Palm?”
“Damn traitor, you dare show your face to me?” Yan Bogong cursed.
Yan Song grinned, “Yan Bogong, I never fought you out of respect, but after leaving Pill King Hall, how did you treat my disciple? Today, we’ll settle all debts!”
“Debt? The both of you are Pill King Hall’s traitors. I will kill you where you stand and cleanse my house!”
Yan Bogong shot for Yan Song, who did the same.
Boom!
Two palms clashed and the poison spread so far that everyone moved a thousand meters away. They knew the Rainbow Cloud Palm all too well and had no trouble dodging it.
But in Nine Poison Fantasy Palm’s case, with its endless variations, it was impossible to defend all 81 poisons from seeping in. In seconds, Yan Bogong was riddled with five colored spots, poisoned and in pain.
As a fellow poisoner, he knew the hellish power this move had.
But with how this move was stronger than Pill King Hall’s, along with its eerie movements, he failed to stay clear, ending up losing power as he was poisoned.
The more he fought the worse it got, and the tears welled.
[Where the hell did Yan Song get this art? Wasn’t Pill King Hall the best in Tianyu when it comes to poison and pills?]
His face fell as he recalled every Luo clan’s experts’ unique and amazing art. Yan Bogong knew Zhuo Fan was a monster, [Is he a living library or what? How the hell does he come up with so many cultivation methods and even a poison one at that?]
[A damn conniving deceiver…]
Yan Bogong cursed as his face fell. He knew the poison ran deep within him…

chapters.title: Chapter 451: The Turning Specialist
chapters.content:
Chapter 451: The Turning Specialist
The armies smashed into each other like floods.
The side who pushed the other, who pressed their momentum, would soon gain control over the entire battlefield.
A role most suited to a poisoner, especially when it came to wars.
Zhuo Fan looked down on poisoners, saying that they were useless in a battle of experts, but when it came to culling, no one was better at it.
And in a battle like this, a poisoner was a force to be reckoned with, a veritable grim reaper doing his job as god intended.
Yan Bogong knew of his importance, wishing to use this chance to showcase his power.
But against the traitorous Yan Song, his chance was gone and he had instead suffered from poisoning himself in a cruel twist of irony.
It only worked to shame him further.
The great Hall Lord using poison to kill others was now being served the same coin. And Yan Song’s poison wasn’t limited to affecting him, but Regent Estate faction’s experts en masse. If he pulled back now, there’d be nothing left of his name to speak of.
You Wanshan watched the poisoned mist as he retreated. A dozen Radiant Stage experts, confident in their strength, pushed through it to take Yan Song down.
He had to die for their army to survive.
Luo clan’s power couple entered the scene mid way pushing these oldies back with miserable faces.
And that wasn’t even half of it. What got them so wretched and wishing they could tear the two piece by piece, was that Luo clan in its entirety had inherited Zhuo Fan’s expert turning skills.
With the fall of Hell Valley, Pill King Hall and Merry Woods, Luo clan had bolstered their elder ranks with every fallen house. The Venerables and elders who did not crack under Zhuo Fan’s masterful silver tongued promises, ended up as an example for those who did.
But some stragglers were bound to have escaped the destruction of the houses and returned to their house lords.
It was all good and well, so far. With these new elders being quite close to each other, and Yan Song’s poison to clear a path, once Luo clan had the upper hand, they’d follow Zhuo Fan’s vile plan into striking their hearts, and not chase a vanquished enemy.
When push came to shove, these experts would choose self-destruction and that would’ve been a far worse scenario.
So before the war started, Zhuo Fan taught them to target their minds, appeal to their compassion and friendship. The best plan so far.
And so, within the cruel battlefield, some very touching and sappy reunions cropped up in remote corners.
“Brother, y-you turned over to Luo clan?” Hell Valley’s third Venerable looked at the other in shock, “I thought Zhuo Fan had you killed three…”
The Ex High Venerable of Hell Valley sighed, “It’s a long story. All in all, we’re with the Luo clan now. Zhuo Fan is a tyrant, but as long as you don’t anger him, he has quite the respect for us. And he even welcomed us with cultivation methods the likes of which Tianyu has never seen. We are certain that in fifty years we can enter the Ethereal Stage!”
“What?” The third Venerable stood dumbstruck, “Brother, didn’t you say there’s no chance for us to reach it with our talent?”
“Ha-ha-ha, that was earlier, with Hell Valley’s limited resources. But after getting to know the Luo clan, I realized that those Seven Noble Houses are nothing but ignorant whelps. Luo clan has a far bigger legacy than even the imperial family. There are rare ingredients piled up in mountains in countless rings. Vicious Pill King Yan Song’s only job is to take some alchemy disciples and bake in the Pill House. They even use 6th-grade ingredients to raise the success of making just 3rd-grade pills; a hundred thousand of them.”
“A true waste, such moneybags!” High Venerable praised.
Third Venerable was stunned. [Why is a third rate clan so awesome? With their stuff, no one in Tianyu can compare. It’s like they’ve harvested the nation for a thousand years!]
High Venerable turned serious, “Old third, we each have our lords. I hate for being the one to hurt you, brother, and can only present you with three choices. Leave and live in seclusion far away from here, stay and I will have no choice but to fight you, or join Luo clan and live together with your brothers.”
“That…” Third Venerable was conflicted.
“Since you do not want to join us, I can only hope you’d leave. We four have worked together for so many years. I’d hate to see my brother’s bloody face.” High Venerable shook his head.
Third Venerable waved all over the place, “Oh, no, no, no, elder brother, you’re wrong. I just want to ask, are you for real?”
Third Venerable’s eyes shone with greed.
“Of course, have I ever lied to you in all these years?” High Venerable stuck his head out, “Old third, Zhuo Fan is a master tactician and already has a plan in place to handle everything. Did you really think Regent Estate was going to win? Look around you, Luo clan is on a constant rise. Even if Huangpu Tianyuan is strong, he is chasing his grave. There will only ever be Zhuo Fan in this world. He has destroyed all houses in Tianyu, even his allies’…”
High Venerable whispered, “Steward Zhuo has set up the Luo clan as the biggest, making it the supreme power in Tianyu. I am not going to lie to you. Come, join us as a new elder. This will be your only chance!”
“What, a single power? Zhuo Fan has such ambition?”
Third Venerable pondered and nodded, “Elder brother, I wish not to ruin our brotherhood and can only hope to stand by your side as we make history!”
“Good, old third, I expected nothing less!”
High Venerable grabbed his palm, taking a vial from his back with a Bloodworm inside, “Brother, to enter Luo clan, you must take this Bloodworm.”
[Uh…]
Third Venerable found it improper, but from High Venerable’s stern look, this was no game.
Recalling again the promise of resources from Luo clan, the third Venerable swallowed it.
High Venerable laughed, going together on a nice little trip to Regent Estate to murder the rest of ’em.
The same exchange happened all over the place. Saying it’s out of brotherhood when the dangling bait was just too damn good.
These guys were homeless anyway, they didn’t even have time to worry about resources. Along came the Luo clan extending its gold plated hand. Who in their right mind would refuse it?
As an extra proof of sincerity, it came from old pals.
The battle was a few hours in when You Wanshan and the other lords found something strange. [What are the Venerables and elders doing, slaughtering their way over? Wasn’t it a bit early to come back? And why are there so many of them?]
Taking a good deal of time to process this, they all came to one conclusion, “Fall back!”
[Much of a war this turned out to be. The enemy didn’t come to kill us, but to turn us.] How could they win now? All that was left was for them to turn as well.
Leng Wuchang sighed. [Zhuo Fan’s psychological warfare is otherworldly.]
[Just what did he use to achieve it? There must be something off about this to get so many in such a short time.]
“Back to Regent Estate! We’ll think about it then!” Leng Wuchang shouted to his faction. Luo clan was hot on their tail.
Shadow King’s trio watched the odd ‘war’ with dumb faces.
“W-what the hell? What did Luo clan do to them? Isn’t it too fast?” Shadow King was flabbergasted.
Fang Qiubai sighed, “If you’re looking for a specialist in turning experts, go to Windgaze City’s Luo clan and find Zhuo Fan!”
Shadow King’s face twitched. Even with Zhuo Fan away, everything still played by his rules.
Regent Estate’s victory was based on Huangpu Tianyuan’s Nine Dragons Diamond Body alone while Zhuo Fan had some tactical counters in place besides just himself.
To put it another way, this trick of his had a heavier impact than his strength.
In this aspect, Zhuo Fan had Leng Wuchang beat by miles.
“Again using himself as bait!” Fang Qiubai sighed, “Zhuo Fan used the same tactic in the Esoteric Debate with flying colors. While now, he has caught Leng Wuchang unprepared, his schemes working at full power even while he is away. He won in every aspect!”
“In your opinion, was his defeat fake?” Shadow King looked at the sky, “Then he must have a way to deal with Huangpu Tianyuan. I’m really curious about what can possibly hold Nine Dragons Diamond Body in check. Zhuo Fan’s final rivals may very well be us!”
Fang Qiubai and Sima Hui nodded while flying away to watch the events play out…

chapters.title: Chapter 452: Little Qilin’s Support
chapters.content:
Chapter 452: Little Qilin’s Support
Whoosh~
A flash of red dotted the sky every now and then, in sync with Zhuo Fan’s right eye’s golden glow.
Right behind him was a yellow light, just missing him with each jump but so fast that no one could identify what it was.
Zhuo Fan appeared a mile away, just to see the same yellow light on his trail. He gnashed his teeth, spat blood a few times and went right back to running.
Zhuo Fan kept popping up every mile, but no matter what he did, he just couldn’t shake his yellow tail.
Huangpu Tianyuan was right behind him.
Three whole days, that was how long the two played around.
Zhuo Fan’s chest hole was still leaking, his face whiter than paper. Yet he never stopped Shifting, not even to catch a breath.
Even a minute delay would have that freak tearing him a new one.
Zhuo Fan shook his head.
His only gripe with Nine Dragons Diamond Body was its capacity to get Huangpu Tianyuan to the Ethereal Stage once all nine dragon souls were together. Now that would spell doom for even him.
Thus, he just let the old guy have those eight dragons, reaching peak Radiant Stage, while thinking that no matter how strong he got, he would be no match for the sacred beast Qilin’s leg.
With Tangible Projection, the Qilin arm would be like a strike from the heavens, smashing everything, if not killing him outright.
Reality confirmed this truth as well. Huangpu Tianyuan laid twisted under the Qilin leg even with the Nine Dragons Diamond Body.
But out of Zhuo Fan’s calculations, the Bodhi Root was integrated in the Nine Dragons Diamond Body to use that Returning Dragon shtick and it let him get right back in action.
It made his body truly invincible and even left Zhuo Fan speechless on how to counter it.
Huangpu Tianyuan didn’t give him room to work his brain either, counterattacking and turning this into Zhuo Fan’s second life’s second loss.
First was Gu Santong, of course.
Zhuo Fan had to admit, he had come short of Nine Dragons Diamond Body. And even though he did lose, it did not mean defeat.
As the ill-reputed steward of Luo clan directed his allies like a conductor, no one could stand up to those twisted and vile schemes of his.
So when this chase was the only option left, he said to hell with honor and left the battlefield in the hands of his most capable peons.
He was totally convinced, based on Luo clan’s experts and those enticing tricks, that the Regent Estate would fall.
Tricks only effective if Huangpu Tianyuan was out of the picture, even if momentarily. Otherwise the old bag of diamond bones would have been a beacon of hope and the turning would have to be cut short.
Who wouldn’t be afraid of this freak breaking their melon? Certainly not a fresh traitor.
Zhuo Fan just had to get Huangpu Tianyuan away for his devious plan to work.
But was the great Estate Lord Huangpu gonna take the bait? Just like that?
Yep. Zhuo Fan was that certain.
For starters, after beating Zhuo Fan, his confidence in his strength exploded to new unseen heights. With Zhuo Fan’s seminal value for Luo clan’s victory, if he was dead, Luo clan would be done for. If Zhuo Fan was around, no matter how ruined Luo clan would become, or how many times it was beaten, it would still be like grass in spring, sprouting from god knew where, with more power than ever. It was only a matter of time.
Huangpu Tianyuan could not let that happen. Zhuo Fan’s badly wounded state was the best chance to take him out for good.
Secondly, Zhuo Fan was just too damn bright, hiding Luo clan’s glow.
Each time Regent Estate faced Zhuo Fan, they had suffered great losses. To the point that all of Regent Estate believed that this war was in fact a fight against Zhuo Fan alone. Li Jingtian and other experts were negligible.
Besides, the moon shined brighter than any star.
Zhuo Fan was just too obnoxious, too outstanding, blinding their dog eyes to the reality and Luo clan’s other experts.
Even Leng Wuchang fell for it.
He only had Zhuo Fan in his sights. If this guy lost, all was over. He focused on getting Huangpu Tianyuan to boost his power, the Nine Dragons Diamond Body, just to face Zhuo Fan.
But Zhuo Fan went against their thinking, leaving the fate of the war in the hands of others, giving Leng Wuchang no plan to counter and forcing him to go on the run.
Funnily enough, it wasn’t even Zhuo Fan’s fallback plan, but just plan B. If he’d wrecked Huangpu Tianyuan back there, he would’ve been leading the god damn attack by now instead of running around the place.
Zhuo Fan shook his head and sighed, staggering in his flight.
Huangpu Tianyuan had given him far greater damage than he had accounted for. [I wonder if I can hold on for plan B to complete.]
Zhuo Fan looked ahead and took a deep breath, “Cough~, just a bit more.”
Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed again, just as the yellow light behind him whistled close and he felt his head hurt in pain from the sound of the attack.
Zhuo Fan blocked with his arms.
Bam!
He slammed into the rocky ground and in his place was a savage dragon’s tail, “Ha-ha-ha, Zhuo Fan, after a three day long chase, you’re finally out of steam.”
Zhuo Fan pulled himself from the pile of rocks, out of breath, “Just 20 more miles and I would’ve made it. But getting away now…”
Zhuo Fan squinted, noticing his enemy’s fixed gaze for any movements, and sighed.
It was hard getting out now with his beaten body. But giving himself over was never part of Zhuo Fan’s style.
“Huangpu Tianyuan, did you know that I played you? Your men are being killed just about now!” Zhuo Fan mocked.
Huangpu Tianyuan laughed, “Zhuo Fan, your life is worth a thousand armies. If they lost because of Luo clan, it only proves they’re useless. And I don’t take kindly to dead weights around here. But if you die, there’ll be no one to stop me. Be it Luo clan or the seven houses, none will matter at that point, ha-ha-ha…”
Huangpu Tianyuan’s sharp eyes glinted and he shot for Zhuo Fan with his claws out, “Humph, where’s that Qilin Shield? My claw is about to take your heart. Can your shield take it?”
Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth, straining to even lift his arms. He only had the beast arms to rely on.
But those hands of his only trembled.
Sighing inside, Zhuo Fan knew he was on the brink of collapse from his wounds. Not even his arms could take an attack now.
Huangpu Tianyuan was excited, “Zhuo Fan, today’s your funeral!”
“Cut the bull, I won’t die here!” Zhuo Fan dredged the last bit of energy to cross his arms.
Huangpu Tianyuan smirked, putting more power in his attack, his eyes trembling in joy.
The great hero Zhuo Fan, having rained havoc in Tianyu for a decade, would find his end at his hands. For him, who was about to establish his own dynasty, it was the greatest feat of strength.
The collision was imminent, unless that red glow coming in from far had something to say about it.
It smacked Huangpu Tianyuan away into a hill a mile away, breaking it to pieces.
Once his head popped out from the rubble, he saw a pint-sized figure next to Zhuo Fan.
His eyes widened and he shouted, “Invincible Scamp, Gu Santong?!”
Zhuo Fan laughed at the timely rescue, “My life stays with me still! Old Huangpu, you loach, I can’t take you down, but this little Qilin of mine will bury you, ha-ha-ha…”

chapters.title: Chapter 453: Gu Santong’s Awesome Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 453: Gu Santong’s Awesome Power
Hearing the free laughter from Zhuo Fan, Gu Santong turned to him, enraged at how close he was to the door of death, “Dad, who did this to you? Didn’t you say we’re going to ambush him? I’ve been waiting for ages. Figured you were done with him and came here to check but now I see…”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “A miscalculation. The main plan was to cut him off if he fled. But his strength exceeded my expectations and I had to resort to a new contingency, as in, to have you deal with him. But be careful.”
“Don’t worry, dad. Since you’ve asked for help, I will not disappoint!” Gu Santong was fired up, turning a stone cold face towards Huangpu Tianyuan.
Huangpu Tianyuan’s face twitched and he shivered.
Gu Santong was number one in all of Tianyu, his name echoing through the last three centuries that no one alive could catch up to. His power was otherworldly, so much so that not even with Nine Dragons Diamond Body was he confident to take the kid on.
Gu Santong and Zhuo Fan were somebodies to be careful around. He had planned on taking them down one at a time, starting with the cunning Zhuo Fan. Gu Santong was outrageously strong, but naive. Once Zhuo Fan fell, he’d finish Gu Santong the same way as last time, with numbers.
How was he supposed to know that just when he was about to put Zhuo Fan’s head on a pike, Gu Santong would show up?
If they teamed up, he’d be worse for wear.
Huangpu Tianyuan shouted, “Gu Santong, weren’t you ordered to take down the traitor Zhuo Fan? I was just about to take his life, helping you as well. Why then did you save him instead?”
“Bullshit, he’s my dad. What son out there would help someone kill his dad? Humph, you freak of nature dares to hurt my dad and I will get you for this!” Gu Santong waved his tiny fist.
Huangpu Tianyuan jerked, “What? Y-you mean, Zhuo Fan is-is your father? That’s impossible!”
“A godfather is still a father. Got a problem with that?” Gu Santong snorted.
That cleared it all up for Huangpu Tianyuan, but it also worked to put him in a heavy mood.
He couldn’t for the life of him figure out how Zhuo Fan pulled it off, getting this little menace to become his godson.
If they teamed up, nothing could stand up to them in Tianyu.
More importantly, [Since when?] With Zhuo Fan’s guile, he’d be keeping it hidden and cook up a scheme to make Gu Santong chase him when he fell out of grace with the imperial family.
Huangpu Tianyuan felt a chill run all over him.
If he knew Zhuo Fan even a bit, he was sure the guy would keep his aces hidden for the best occasions. With how everyone scrambled for power, just when he thought he had the lands in his control, this bastard Zhuo Fan ought to be gone from the picture with Gu Santong on his tail but in fact made a tactical retreat to build his forces.
And this sudden change would make the enemies underestimate Zhuo Fan and fall for his trick.
In the ‘know yourself and your enemy and you shall be ever victorious’, Zhuo Fan had one-upped everyone by hiding Gu Santong away.
Huangpu Tianyuan gasped at the implications. Thanks to his lucky stars, he had discovered it before it was too late to suffer at this insidious killer move.
He still had the power to turn it around.
Huangpu Tianyuan cooled, bloodthirst seethed and with Zhuo Fan down from his wounds, all that was left was Gu Santong.
He just had to beat Gu Santong and he’d have taken two thorns out like nothing!
Huangpu Tianyuan’s tension flowed out of him and he started rejoicing. The prospects of taking two bigshots’ heads off were looking up, finishing off Luo clan and Imperial family in one strike.
“Ha-ha-ha, Gu Santong, I’ve heard of your almighty power and wished to try it out for myself. Now that there’s chaos all around us, allow me to take that invincible title off of you!” Huangpu Tianyuan laughed.
Gu Santong mocked, “Humph, quite the pair you have there. In the last three centuries, there’s been no one as stuck up as you, to come talking to me. You two bit vermin, wait for me to twist your head!”
“Young Sanzi, his Nine Dragons Diamond Body is tough. Keep in mind…”
Zhuo Fan advised, but Gu Santong was already off, totally taking the other guy for granted.
Huangpu Tianyuan laughed.
Bam!
The claw and fist collided, shaking the ground around them. The shock wave leveled anything within a mile.
Huangpu Tianyuan staggered back ten steps, while Gu Santong only five, startled.
It was his first time being pushed back when dishing punches.
Huangpu Tianyuan was shuddering inside, having newfound knowledge of the extent of Invincible Scamp’s power.
With Nine Dragons Diamond Body’s power backing him, he only got Gu Santong a few steps back. If it were Zhuo Fan, the guy’d be blown away into rubble somewhere by now…
Huangpu Tianyuan looked for a way to deal with him.
Gu Santong couldn’t accept it. He had just used 80% of his power and yet was still pushed back, unlike the time he played around with Zhuo Fan.
Gu Santong lifted his cute face and shouted, “Again!”
Gu Santong and Huangpu Tianyuan clashed.
But this time around, Huangpu Tianyuan didn’t take the fist head on. His claw attack was a feint, jumping back and avoiding the fist.
While retaliating with his tail at Gu Santong’s back.
Gu Santong frowned, flying into a hill and reshaping the landscape.
“Ha-ha-ha, against my tail, even if you’re the Invincible Scamp, you’d still end up bruised!” Huangpu Tianyuan laughed at the pile of rubble.
Zhuo Fan’s eyelids twitched, shaking his head.
It wasn’t that easy injuring young Sanzi, because he was a sacred beast. But with his simple mind and simple attacks, it was equally simple to whip him.
Gu Santong jumped out of the rubble, feeling his back, “Ow~, that hurt like hell! Blast it, how did he do that? And why is it so hard?”
Raising his clothes and looking behind him, Gu Santong was unable to see any wound and could only feel around, “At least it’s not an open wound.”
What he didn’t see, Huangpu Tianyuan did. Staring at his back with a gloomy look, his eyes were popping out.
He just used all he had in that lashing, enough to split Zhuo Fan in two. But Gu Santong didn’t even have his skin peeled, only a light imprint.
[What kind of freak is this kid?]
Huangpu Tianyuan’s confidence in beating him hit rock bottom.
Before one was to defeat another, you’d best be able to harm him first. But he couldn’t do even that.
Huangpu Tianyuan felt like a three year old in front of a buffed uncle. His tiny fist could do nothing against that tower of muscle.
Zhuo Fan snickered inside. Gu Santong’s strength was innate, used to handle everything with his two fists.
So while Huangpu Tianyuan had no chance to beat him, he did not have the brains to keep Huangpu Tianyuan here either. He reminded him, “Young Sanzi, this guy just called you an idiot for falling for his whip like a kid. He just doesn’t know fear!”
“As if, when did I ever say that?” Huangpu Tianyuan glared.
He knew Zhuo Fan was playing dirty, to instigate a bigger conflict.
As young Sanzi’s godfather, of course he’d believe his dad over another. His face steeled and snorted, “I’m… an idiot?”
Huangpu Tianyuan gulped, wracking his brain for a way out.
His eyes lit up. Since claws and tail didn’t work, he’d use secret arts.
[This freak has no weakness!]
While Gu Santong was firing up his rage, Huangpu Tianyuan shouted, “Earth Dragon Wave!”
Roar!
A yellow glow shot for Gu Santong.
But the kid just stood there, shining all red.
Bam!
Earth Dragon Wave slammed into him, but the scene made the other bug-eyed. Gu Santong took the attack and didn’t budge an inch. In fact, he was walking towards Huangpu Tianyuan, against the godly might of the eight dragon souls. He pushed them all back like nothing.
Huangpu Tianyuan was dumbstruck, [This is insane. The kid is a true monster…]

chapters.title: Chapter 454: Original Form
chapters.content:
Chapter 454: Original Form
“You old bag of bones, who are you calling an idiot?”
Gu Santong stomped the ground with every step, shuddering his heart each time.
As for the yellow beam, it got smaller and smaller.
Huangpu Tianyuan’s mouth was wide open, words stuck in his throat.
Gu Santong roared, trembled and the red light exploded from him. The Earth Dragon Wave just bounced away like a soccer ball.
Boom!
With a rattling explosion, the attack returned to Huangpu Tianyuan’s mouth, throwing him sky high in a spectacular fashion.
Kissing the ground hard once more, his dragon jaw was gone, leaving behind a black hole giving off a thick black smoke.
Gu Santong flicked his arm in disdain at the tittering figure, “Vermin, I can use my head, but there’s no one in this world worthy of me doing so, humph…”
[Tyrannical!]
Zhuo Fan was dumbstruck too. He liked to showboat, and be all cocky, but all his acts were nothing in front of his son’s high class act.
Power trumped everything. [Who the hell would use their head when their fist was enough?]
Young Sanzi only looked dull in the head, but he saw through everyone, the real number one in Tianyu. And that Qilin Shield even reflected such an attack; a Soaring Qilin’s mighty ability!
“Young Sanzi, your old man takes his hat off to you. The weak scheme, while the strong punch holes in their schemes. Wonderful, genius!”
Zhuo Fan sighed, giving Gu Santong a thumbs up.
Gu Santong might have just been saying it, but it got him thinking. Zhuo Fan controlled the whole stage, with the Imperial family and Regent Estate moving at his will. He was like a king.
While it only showed just how weak he was.
[Would a mighty tiger lay a trap for a weak little lamb?]
[Obviously not. As the king of beasts, he’d eat anyone that popped in his vision, why waste time thinking about it?]
Gu Santong was the same, punching holes in any who stepped up, not wasting time with even martial arts. He was just that strong, pulverizing anyone with a snap.
Zhuo Fan spoke honestly, “Young Sanzi, I shall take this lesson to heart. Compared to you, your old man falls short.”
Gu Santong scratched his head, “Dad, are you praising me? He-he-he, you flatter me. You know, the uncle in Allbeast Mountain Range is praising you as well. That I have much to learn from you, to not be so stubborn.”
“No, it is I who should learn from you. I plot against others for interests alone. But those interests are ephemeral, hardly affecting my own person. While you, nothing chains you, and you can walk the path of the strong!”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Demonic cultivators are selfish. I used to think it refers to self-interest, or maybe being alone. But that may not be the case. I will have to simplify my demonic path it seems.”
Zhuo Fan’s heart achieved peace, like a new world had opened to him…
Roar!
The sudden noise wrestled him out of that marvelous state.
Zhuo Fan shuddered, bursting with unbridled rage. [For gods’ sake, I’m having an epiphany here. Can’t you break it up a little here, please?
He saw Huangpu Tianyuan bursting with green light and his busted jaw was growing under the naked eye.
“It’s that damn Returning Dragon’s Roar!”
Zhuo Fan shouted, “Young Sanzi, this geezer can recover from anything, his body undying. Breaking a few bones won’t work, you have to kill him! “
Gu Santong was watching Huangpu Tianyuan flicking his tail in laughter, “Gu Santong, you may be strong, but you can’t kill me. So how about we each go our own way and see each other in the future?”
Huangpu Tianyuan cupped his hands and fled.
“Future your head! Today is the day you die!” Gu Santong was not one to give up, shooting towards him and punching.
Boom!
Huangpu Tianyuan got buried underground again, into a hundred meter deep hole. His Earth Dragon Head was bleeding, his mind hurting like hell.
But he was still alive. With another green glow, his body burst with vitality, patching him up in no time.
Gu Santong could hardly believe his eyes. Zhuo Fan frowned in sadness.
[He’s far beneath young Sanzi’s power, so much so that five strikes should punch his lights out for good.]
But with that ridiculous Returning Dragon’s Roar cheat of his, he’d be back on his feet like a cockroach.
Huangpu Tianyuan was still laughing, “Gu Santong, I told you, you can’t kill me. You’ll only waste your breath…”
“Shut it!”
Gu Santong roared, “I have crossed Tianyu for so many years and there’s nothing alive that I can’t kill. Humph, worm, you will now witness the true face of a Qilin!”
Roar!
Gu Santong shone red for a moment before turning into a thirty meter red Qilin.
He was back to his original form as a sacred beast, Soaring Qilin!
He was still young, but the power of the sacred beast radiated out. The entire mortal domain, its spiritual beasts, everything was cowering and wailing.
Huangpu Tianyuan shouted, “Gu Santong, w-what move is this?”
“Humph, this is no move, just my true form!”
Gu Santong showed his sharp fangs, “I am a sacred beast and in this form I can display all my power. He-he-he, that punch of mine? That was only 30% of what I can do. Worm, one stomp will nail you dead!”
Gu Santong trampled and Huangpu Tianyuan slammed into the ground.
Boom!
With the fall of the red hoof, the world shook and the earth caved.
A thousand meters, then ten thousand, soon stretching out for nine kilometers.
While the surrounding hundred miles shook harder than an earthquake, the landscape changed forever.
Fang Qiubai’s team were rushing over when they felt this impossible power. The shockwave was so great it was hard for even them to take it.
“What is going on out there? What caused such a power spike?” Sima Hui cried.
The other two shook their heads.
“Anyway, it’s those two that are the cause of it for sure. We better take a look!” Shadow King advised.
The two looked below. Gone were the green meadows and flourishing forest, giving way for endless sands.
The two monsters were these spies’ main targets for observation…
After Gu Santong’s stomp, Zhuo Fan crawled out of some hole to watch the aftermath.
[Welp, that’s the real Soaring Qilin’s leg for you.]
Albeit a cub, he could still break the world.
Zhuo Fan admired a sacred beast’s power even more. How else could they be on the same level as the ten ancient emperors? What got him so envious though was that this power came naturally.
It made him look like an ant, impossible to reach!
[Sigh, why wasn’t I born as an awesome beast?]
“Ha-ha-ha, worm, let’s see you come back from that!” Gu Santong laughed and lifted his hoof from the broken and bloody Huangpu Tianyuan. Guts, gore and blood spewed up from his mouth.
What was even more amazing was that he was still alive, followed by a resplendent green glow.
[Still alive?]
Gu Santong was outraged, “There’s nothing I can’t kill!”
Gu Santong stomped again, with all four this time.
A thousand miles around shook non-stop, with some volcanoes even erupting.
But not even dozens of stomps could cut Huangpu Tianyuan’s life string, no matter how twisted a mess he became.
Gu Santong was fuming, but Zhuo Fan stopped him, “Young Sanzi, it’s no use. The Bodhi Root is too strong, protecting his life. If you can’t remove that Returning Dragon soul it won’t matter how much you stomp, it won’t change anything.”
“What do we do now? I want to kill him but I can’t. This has never happened in three hundred years. I’m boiling mad!” Gu Santong was getting pissy.
Zhuo Fan snickered, his trademark evil grin getting back in business, “Ha-ha-ha, easy. I got just the thing. And I am quite piqued by those eight dragon souls as well. Purely academic, of course…”

chapters.title: Chapter 455: Nine Dragons Combined
chapters.content:
Chapter 455: Nine Dragons Combined
Gu Santong was clueless, but Zhuo Fan propped his weak body over, his evil smile looking glorious on his face.
Hum~
The green glow had started by now, filling Huangpu Tianyuan’s body with brimming vitality and healing him all over again.
“Ha-ha-ha, I am undying. You got nothing on me!” Huangpu Tianyuan cackled.
Gu Santong was raging again.
Boom!
Huangpu Tianyuan was stomped into the ground, his face twisted in pain so bad you couldn’t even see his features.
He may be undying but not pain free. Young Sanzi’s trampling hurt like hell.
Not that he minded. He just felt good putting up a tough front in front of peak experts like Gu Santong and Zhuo Fan seeing how they could do nothing to him. Other than the excruciating pain, he felt peachy.
“Ha-ha-ha, you may have joined hands but it doesn’t mean squat!” Huangpu Tianyuan smiled.
Zhuo Fan grinned, taking one step at a time like climbing mountains, “He-he-he, old codger, don’t get ahead of yourself. Nine Dragons Diamond Body is but an earth ranked martial art, far from invincible.”
“Your point? You still can’t take me out either way. Unless you enter the Ethereal Stage and destroy my soul, nothing will work, ha-ha-ha…”
Huangpu Tianyuan sneered, looking at them saying [Take your best shot. I’ll just sit here, waiting.]
Gu Santong was about to flip out, squeezing harder on the guy with the hoof but Huangpu Tianyuan just toughed it out.
Zhuo Fan still took slow steps over. He placed a bloody hand on the guy’s head.
“Young Sanzi, hold him down good.” Zhuo Fan warned.
Gu Santong nodded.
Huangpu Tianyuan mocked, “Zhuo Fan, you’re on the verge of collapse with no energy left. What could you possibly do? You couldn’t even best me at your peak! Ha-ha-ha…”
“Ha-ha-ha…”
Huangpu Tianyuan laughed, as did Zhuo Fan.
Huangpu Tianyuan frowned, “I’m mocking your weakness. Why are you laughing?”
“I’m laughing at your ignorance.” Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed with a black glow and his body released a black energy, “The world is filled with countless arts and techniques. Do you think that Bodhi Root has truly made your body undying? Humph, feast your eyes on the real world. Even with your Nine Dragons Diamond Body, you’ll still have a horrid death.”
“Demon Transformation Art!” The black energy flowed through his hand into Huangpu Tianyuan.
The rock solid Earth Dragon Body was stained with pitch-black energy, as it seeped into him, dissolving him, despite how hard the dragon souls fought the invasion.
Especially the Returning Dragon soul, it turned black, as if poisoned.
[How come?] Bodhi Root was the essence of life, a panacea for all poisons. Fusing it with the dragon soul would make the Returning Dragon soul immune as well.
Not like he could tell this was no poison but Zhuo Fan’s Yuan Qi built through the Demon Transformation Art.
Demon Transformation Art could assimilate anything and everything. Taking all that it had and leaving nothing but dregs. He was putting Huangpu Tianyuan through the same process, robbing him blind, dragon souls included.
“Zhuo Fan, what the hell are you doing?” Huangpu Tianyuan lost his smug attitude.
It even contained dread.
Zhuo Fan just grinned, “Hi-hi-hi, what, he asks? This!”
Zhuo Fan worked his art and took it all back now. Huangpu Tianyuan felt his power leaving, his Yuan Qi, his breath, even the dragon souls. Everything going into Zhuo Fan.
Overwhelmed, Huangpu Tianyuan struggled to get away. With a monster above him, he was going nowhere fast though, made to endure this naked humiliation as the power ebbed from him.
Roar!
The wail of a dragon shook Zhuo Fan as a dragon soul entered his body. With the loss of one dragon soul, Huangpu Tianyuan’s claw returned to normal.
Panicking, Huangpu Tianyuan was horrified.
He guessed what Zhuo Fan was doing, but the reality was just that much crueler, of how easy it all came to Zhuo Fan.
He had refined them himself, through blood and sweat, yet they jumped ship like it was nothing?
[What demonic art is Zhuo Fan using to rob me?] That dragon soul he got from Huangpu Qingtian was because his life faded away.
But Huangpu Tianyuan was very much alive right now.
Huangpu Tianyuan’s heart was going a mile a minute, yet he did not have the time to mind the doubts, finding himself at death’s door, “Stop, stop I say!”
“Humph, old Huangpu, you’re so stuck-up, so obnoxious, where has all that attitude of yours gone?” Zhuo Fan laughed.
Huangpu Tianyuan felt like crying, fighting the process with all he had, to no avail. As the dragon souls left him, his body weakened, coming back to his human form.
Roar~!
Roars came from Zhuo Fan this time, wrestling inside him for a way out.
Huangpu Tianyuan grasped at his chance at victory, “Ha-ha-ha, they aren’t refined by you. You may have taken them, but they won’t listen to anyone but me. Return them and I promise not to fight you again. We will split the world between us.”
Huangpu Tianyuan was at a disadvantage and started speaking terms.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “The world was mine to begin with. Why would I ever share it? Moreover, these earthworms, since I’ve pulled them out of you, do you think I can’t tame them?”
Zhuo Fan’s forehead revealed an azure flame making the dragon souls fall back.
Huangpu Tianyuan’s eyes teared up.
He had now lost even his bargaining chip.
Zhuo Fan’s tricks were that weird and insidious. Regent Estate had a hold of the Dragon Vein for a thousand years yet never could get the souls to submit. And Zhuo Fan just showed up and they’d behave like children?
Sighing, Huangpu Tianyuan showed a powerless expression of remorse as he thinned out.
As the last dragon soul roared, Returning Dragon soul entering Zhuo Fan, Huangpu Tianyuan became human again, stripped of all arrogance.
In another hour, Huangpu Tianyuan turned to ashes, lost in the wind.
Gu Santong sneered at the empty ground and turned back to a child.
He had no clue if Huangpu Tianyuan ever felt endless remorse at having messed with the father and son duo, that he dared pose before them, but with the loss of the dragon souls, despair was all those old eyes showed.
It was then that the old man lost his will to live as well…
“Dad, I never knew you had such a trick. Is that Nine Serenities Emperor’s master skill? You robbed the old guy of even his temper…” Gu Santong smiled.
Zhuo Fan cut him off, “Young Sanzi, defend me while I unite the dragons. I’m breaking through.”
He sat cross legged, eyes closed and cultivated.
Gu Santong saw him rush and figured this had to be a rare chance for his old man. He stopped talking and was earnest in protecting him.
Two days went by, time in which Zhuo Fan’s power grew. Going one layer per day, reaching the 5th layer of Profound Heaven Stage. And with this change his body healed as well.
But Huangpu Tianyuan was a peak Radiant Stage expert, brimming with power.
Whoosh!
With a bang, a black chain shot for Zhuo Fan’s skull.
Gu Santong grabbed it, “Who’s there? Come out!”
“Gu Santong, you are the imperial family’s Divine Dragon, yet you collude with traitors of the empire? Did you forget the promise you made three hundred years ago?”
As the black smoke twisted, Shadow King with Sima Hui and Fang Qiubai made their appearance.
All while Zhuo Fan was calmly sitting there, ignoring the world around him…

chapters.title: Chapter 456: The Ex-best in the World
chapters.content:
Chapter 456: The Ex-best in the World
Gu Santong mocked, “My promise refers to keeping imperial family alive for a thousand years. It says nothing about dogs. I’ll help if I feel like it. If not, no one can make me, humph!”
The three stared in shock.
[Check out the new big brain on the bugger. He figured out some loopholes.] As to how, it didn’t take them long to see that Zhuo Fan had something to do with it.
These kinds of snappy and taunting remarks were more up Zhuo Fan’s alley. The kid had no chance in figuring it all out by himself.
The three turned heavy.
Gu Santong was the strongest right now, but they couldn’t just leave Zhuo Fan alone either. It would be unwise, to say the least.
Shadow King said, “Then keep your promise by destroying all of imperial family’s enemies. With Zhuo Fan being a national traitor, abusing his power, he is a threat to all of us. Be it as a Divine Dragon or just to keep your word, you must root him out, not protect him!”
“Humph, to hell with your protection. A son looks after his old man, it’s the most natural thing in the world.” Sticking out his chin, Gu Santong giggled, “Moreover, dad has guaranteed that he’d leave the imperial family alive. He wants power, not status.”
The trio gasped. Fang Qiubai was astonished, “Young Sanzi, what did you just call him?”
“Right, you still don’t know that he’s my godfather. Just try touching one hair of him and I promise to break your bones one by one, he-he.” Gu Santong had a savage smile.
Fang Qiubai was dumbstruck, a bad feeling creeping up on him.
If Gu Santong only went to Zhuo Fan’s side because of some fancy speech, they could still get him back on the straight and narrow path. Gu Santong had always been their strongest asset.
But with this new relationship, like a family, they had no chance.
[What the hell did Zhuo Fan use to get the kid so eager to call him dad?]
Imperial family had been feeding the kid for centuries, yet nothing had worked to get him closer to them. Yet Zhuo Fan just came along and did it like nothing. The trio was speechless.
[When did it all start?]
But recalling the big war just a few days back, with Luo clan turning experts faster than flipping pancakes, the trio had to bow towards the master. Zhuo Fan was an expert when it came to manipulation.
While also making them have a hard time facing Gu Santong right about now.
Gu Santong was the best in the world for a reason.
“Uh, senior, should we make a tactical retreat? Young Sanzi and Zhuo Fan make for the worst enemies. It’s best that we report to His Majesty first.” Sima Hui proposed.
Fang Qiubai nodded, finding it the best choice.
Shadow King was somewhat angry and reticent, “Gu Santong, I used to respect you as being a man of your word, a hero. I don’t resent you even in the current situation. But I never thought you’d be so despicable and wretched. Going by Zhuo Fan’s speech, big things are happening. Even if the imperial family isn’t overthrown, they’ll end up as puppets. How is that any different from robbing their lands?
“Gu Santong, if there’s still some decency left in you, you’d keep your promise and protect the imperial family’s lands. Do your duty and not resort to petty tricks like reading between the lines. It is not how a man of honor conducts himself!” Shadow King shouted.
Gu Santong found it odd, “And who are you supposed to be? I don’t know you. Your creepy look, it has nothing to do with me.”
“Ha-ha-ha, Gu Santong, you don’t need to know. I only hope that you’ll fulfill your promise.” Shadow King’s tone was tragic but firm.
Gu Santong felt odd. The guy was speaking like an old friend, but he had never seen him in his life.
With a wiggle of his nose, he got his answer. Shadow King’s smell gave him a deja vu.
“Who are you? Have we met?” Gu Santong said.
Shadow King flicked his chain at Zhuo Fan, “Top profound ranked martial art, Heart-piercing Nebula Chain!”
The chain split into a thousand chains in a blink, all going after Zhuo Fan.
The powerful aura being emanated turned everything to dust. Even the air was vibrating.
Gu Santong blanked out, waking up when the chains reached Zhuo Fan. He jumped in between and punched.
Boom!
The thousand chains disintegrated, leaving a shimmering air around Gu Santong’s trembling fist.
Fang Qiubai and Sima Hui looked at Shadow King stunned.
With Gu Santong around, even together, the trio had no chance of harming Zhuo Fan. So why was Shadow King so persistent?
[Is he looking to be humiliated?]
Shadow King just stood in place, uncaring how easily his move was thwarted.
He spoke again, “Gu Santong, do you know me now?”
Gu Santong turned sad, “You’re still alive. I thought…”
“Humph, alive?”
Shadow King mocked, “Does this look alive to you?”
Gu Santong only had a look of sorrow.
Shadow King spoke heavily, “If not for your punch back then, I, being on the brink of entering Ethereal Stage, wouldn’t have turned into a spirit puppet, into neither human nor shade. I am filled with rage every time I think about it. But I don’t hate you, because you always kept your word to me. But now…”
“I am still a man of my word!” Gu Santong justified.
“No, you’ve just found a way around it, unprincipled!” Shadow King snapped.
Gu Santong staggered back.
The other two were shocked to the core.
Shadow King had been loyal to the imperial family since even before the two came to office as Divine Dragons.
But never once knew of his history.
His reprimands were the biggest clue. He was the one to trap Gu Santong in a promise three hundred years ago.
Gu Santong gasped, restless, to which Shadow King shouted, “Didn’t your godfather teach you about loyalty and justice? Are you going to turn your back on them?”
Gu Santong shook all over.
His first godfather was his savior, teacher and mentor. He would never forget. Anyone could call him a demon or a monster, he didn’t care.
But to question his respect for his godfather, he could not accept.
Shadow King found his words hitting something and showed a twisted smile among the black mist.
“The great Shadow King, the once best in Tianyu, the Immemorial Sage, comes back three centuries later to use some shoddy righteousness? Is this how a true man acts, deceiving children?”
Zhuo Fan sighed, opening his sharp eyes, looking down upon all creation with his overbearing power. He snapped his eyes on that shadow, “Before speaking of promises, shouldn’t you straighten yourself first?”
“Zhuo Fan!” Shadow King gnashed his teeth, “You rotten bastard, I don’t know what fancy words you’ve used to deceive Gu Santong, but his first godfather was a scholar, a man of principle who taught his children virtue and honor. Unlike you, who leads him astray!
“Gu Santong, ask yourself, did your first godfather earn your respect and love, or is this despicable and vile thing is who you value more?” Shadow King asked, putting Gu Santong on the spot.
Shadow King was more than clear about his game, to strike at Gu Santong’s heart by putting his two godfathers on a scale.
Zhuo Fan walked in front of Gu Santong, rubbing his head, with a bright smile and speaking platitudes, “Be it your former righteous and honorable godfather, or the current despicable and repulsive one, we each have our own paths. But one thing we have in common is our love for our young Sanzi, which will never change.”
Gu Santong showed a bright smile.
“You sneaky little devil!”
Shadow King’s cheek twitched in outrage…

chapters.title: Chapter 457: Insidious Tongue, Insidious Eyes
chapters.content:
Chapter 457: Insidious Tongue, Insidious Eyes
With a crafty smile, Zhuo Fan asked Shadow King, “Look who’s talking. Luring and deceiving the young and innocent Sanzi into a backbreaking oath, does that make you a gentleman? Since you’re no saint, why go around asking others to treat you like one?”
