Ignoring the flabbergasted looks he always got, Zhuo Fan finished with Yue’er and directed the dragon soul towards Kui Gang.
Following the same process, the kid was back in prime shape in no time. Kui Gang was filled with lashes from his veins bursting, yet now he didn’t even have a scar on him.
Zhuo Fan had the dragon soul return back to his body, leaving behind two bodies like newborn babes, with smooth and perfect skin.
Kui Lang and Yue Ling gulped at the children’s peaceful sleepy faces. They had endless admiration for Zhuo Fan.
But now that they’re healed, why weren’t they waking up?
Then, Yue’er slowly opened her eyes and Yue Ling cheered, “Yue’er, you’re alright!”
“Sister, I…” Yue’er was filled with doubt, “Why am I…”
Yue’er moved but then found something wrong with her hand. Someone was holding it.
She saw Zhuo Fan’s lewd look and creepy smile.
Uh, that was what she saw at least.
“Ah! What are you doing, sicko?” Yue’er pulled her hand away and slapped him.
Pa!
A sharp sound accompanied the stinging on Zhuo Fan’s cheek and his mood sank.
[For crying out loud, what have I been doing? I saved this girl’s life and this is how you repay me?]
Yue Ling was scared witless, “S-Steward Zhuo, please calm down. She is still out of it, please don’t mind it.”
Yue Ling berated her sister, “Damn girl, Steward Zhuo just saved your life and yet you’ve hit him? Apologize!”
Yue’er looked puzzled from her sister to the glum Zhuo Fan, her brain turned to mush.
[What’s going on? Why is sister who has always hated Zhuo Fan sticking up for him? And she’s even fawning over him!]
She knew her sister to be tough and hardheaded, not lowering her head in front of some wastrel…
Yue’er was vexed over her sister’s attitude and made Yue Ling stomp her foot.
[Is this girl blind? Can’t she see the hints I’m giving? He was holding your hand to save you but now he can also end you.]
[And there’s no way I can save you from that!]
Seeing Zhuo Fan’s throbbing cheek and heavy look, Yue Ling became jumpy…
“What’s all this ruckus?” Kui Gang woke up groggy only to see his father move and he felt his hand in Zhuo Fan’s hand.
[What’s this punk doing here? Didn’t father hate him?]
Kui Lang feared that he’d copy Yue’er and rushed over to push him back down, “Damn brat, Uncle Zhuo here just saved your life so hurry up and kowtow!”
Everyone’s faces twitched as they were lost for words.
When Kui Gang had been seeing Zhuo Fan as a senior uncle, Kui Lang only had mockery and derision. But how time flies, now sucking up to the guy in any way possible.
[So even this tough guy has an immoral side.]
That was how a puzzled Kui Gang found himself sitting on the bed and his dad pushing his head down again and again, so hard it could snap his waist.
Though one thing was certain, for his dad’s attitude to do a one-eighty flip, he knew something was going on and as he was a good boy, he cupped his hands in gratitude, “Thank you uncle, for saving me.”
“Mmm-hmm, that’s more like it.” Zhuo Fan glared at Yue’er who simply turned her head away.
Yue Ling sighed.
Yue’er was stubborn as a mule and that wouldn’t change until someone explained it to her.
Yue Ling shook her head as she told the kids, circumstances of their situation.
A truly cruel irony how the ever helpful Hu Mei’er turned out to be the viper plotting in the dark, while the ever loathed Zhuo Fan saved their lives in their final hour.
At long last, the two kid’s eyes shone with gratitude.
Yue’er even felt guilty seeing his red cheek.
“F-forgive me…” Yue’er mumbled, still playing tough. Yue Ling sighed.
[Girl, you call that sincere?]
She knew though that those three words were already Yue’er’s limit. No matter how much she knew herself to be wrong, she’d never admit it.
The fact that she spoke those words was remorseful enough. Well, he did save their asses, yet what did he get in return? A slap. Anyone would be sour about it, to say nothing of Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan mocked, “Ha-ha-ha, I wouldn’t have accepted Miss Yue’er apology, not with her stubborn streak. But for saving miss Yue’er, I had to encroach on her dignity, feeling her soft skin. A slap is what I deserve. Now we are even, or perhaps miss will still hold a grudge.
“A lady’s hand is invaluable.” Zhuo Fan finished with a snicker.
Yue’er’s guilt ramped up, her heart was a mess, her eyes red.
Yue Ling worked so hard to make peace with this godlike being only to fall out again. At least Yue’er was out of the woods and could just return to the peaceful days as an outer disciple. Not if Zhuo Fan could help it.
Zhuo Fan snickered and threw Kui Lang a vial.
He then said, “Open it and see what it is.”
Kui Lang did so and his eyes bugged out. Everyone else gasped, so shocked their hearts were about to jump out of their chest cavity.
“10th grade pill?!”
They all exclaimed at the thick spiritual energy coming from it.
Grinning, Zhuo Fan said, “The Heaven Reaching Pill to be precise. The wounds on these kids were so heavy that their meridians were shot as well. While I did heal them and their cultivation has been saved, advancing in this state is another matter. But with the Heaven Reaching Pill, your son will toughen his meridians, reaching higher than before. Even the Ethereal Stage isn’t a problem.”
“I-it’s that good?” Kui Lang was touched to the core, words failing to describe how thankful he was.
Then he pulled Kui Gang from the bed and both kowtowed as Kui Lang taught his son, “Hurry up and thank uncle Zhuo. He just gave you your entire future!”
“Thank you Uncle Zhuo, thank you…” Kui Gang knew this was beyond kindness, bowing again and again.
He was truly fortunate. Without popping his veins, there would be no Zhuo Fan to save him, and no 10th grade pill to lift his prospects.
It was godsent. [Who in the entire sect could consume a 10th grade pill?]
While Yue Ling looked bitter and crushed.
[Steward Zhuo didn’t cure them completely?]
[That slap must be eating you inside right about now, baby sister.]
Zhuo Fan gave Yue Ling’s sorrowful look a smug grin.
[That’s what you get for being an ungrateful lass…]

chapters.title: Chapter 542: Orders
chapters.content:
Chapter 542: Orders
Crack!
A shattering sound came from Kui Gang who was meditating as his cultivation soared.
He was now in the 8th layer of Profound Heaven Stage lifting up from the 7th.
Kui Lang lit up in joy, forever grateful for Zhuo Fan’s aid. His son took the pill and powered up just after some meditation.
That’s the 10th grade Heaven Reaching Pill for you, not just re-molding one’s body but increasing cultivation too.
Kui Gang let out a deep breath and his eyes flashed.
Then he kneeled before Zhuo Fan and kowtowed again.
While his dad had forced him the first time, this gesture came from the bottom of his heart. Now he knew what it meant to be reborn.
The simple act of lifting his hand contained unimaginable power, his meridians thrumming with Yuan Qi.
Even though the increase was only one layer, his wide meridians translated it into a power increase of dozens of times.
He felt unstoppable and was certain he might never feel so amazing ever again.
The three bumps on his head were totally worth it, while Kui Lang laughed in joy.
Zhuo Fan glanced over and stated, “My work here is done. It’s time for me to hit the cemetery and mind my own training.”
But Yue Ling had a different opinion, “Wait, Steward Zhuo, please help Yue’er as well. Else she will forever be in the 6th layer of Profound Heaven Stage!”
“Your point being?”
Zhuo Fan cocked an eyebrow, and spoke in an icy tone, “I came to save them and that’s what I did. As for how much, it’s all up to my whims. Since I don’t feel like it, I’ll leave it at that.”
Zhuo Fan snorted and walked away.
Yue Ling slumped to the ground in despair. Her begging eyes landed on Elder Yuan, to say a few words.
But Elder Yuan sighed and shook his head.
Getting Zhuo Fan involved was already a miracle in itself. [Opportunity comes knocking only once, it is best to treasure it.]
He was annoyed and getting him to finish healing was nigh impossible.
The Four Scheming Demons resumed their creepy laughter, with Violent Demon getting delighted in other’s suffering, “Told you so. Steward Zhuo is petty to the core. You deserve it after getting on his bad side, hi-hi-hi…”
Yue Ling wallowed in remorse.
“Wait!”
Though Zhuo Fan’s step slowed, he did not turn around. Yue’er watched his back with a victimized face, “I would like to thank you first. And apologize, but I’m not begging you to help me. I’m satisfied with being able to keep my cultivation and not turning into a cripple. Yes, that’s it…”
Zhuo Fan paused for a second then kept walking.
The Four Scheming Demons jeered.
[Dumb broad, no amount of pleading and begging will move Steward Zhuo. You’re barking at the wrong tree.]
Kui Lang sighed at Yue’er’s fate. Yue Ling felt bitter at her sister’s mistreated look.
[She’s just too damn pigheaded. When will she learn to be more flexible.]
Everyone sighed at Yue’er’s missed godsent opportunity. Oh, Four Scheming Demons were not included, still mocking in the background.
But soon, the four stopped and scratched their heads.
“Boss, didn’t we forget something?” Sly Demon asked.
Violent Demon nodded with a frown, “I have the same feeling that we’ve overlooked something. What were we doing again?”
“Weren’t we talking about how after being around Steward Zhuo for so long we should get something out of the Luo clan’s share? Why only Li Jingtian and those other foggies get to have something and not us?” Scrooge Demon exclaimed.
The four nodded.
“Yeah, that’s it. We gotta demand Heaven Reaching Pills from Steward Zhuo, ha-ha-ha… ugh…” Violent Demon’s laugh was short as they all shouted, “The Heaven Reaching Pill!”
Whoosh~
Violent Demon jumped at Kui Gang’s throat as he howled, “Our precious Heaven Reaching Pill! Damn brat, spit it out, now!”
His brothers came to help, pulling and shouting.
“Executives, please, you’re choking him!” Kui Lang said to break them up, knowing he couldn’t do much else.
The Four Scheming Demons were freaky in temper and strength. They might very well take it out on him instead and wouldn’t stop till he was torn to pieces.
While Kui Gang was gasping through the choke hold, he said, “Uncle Zhuo gave it to me. How can I spit it out? And there’s no way one pill is enough for the four of you. You’d be better off asking Uncle Zhuo.”
The four jerked to a halt and nodded to each other.
Without preamble, they shot after Zhuo Fan as trails of smoke.
With them gone, the people breathed easier.
Those pygmies were outrageous, outlandish and impossible. Not only were their brains useless, but they were a ticking time bomb. It was only a matter of time before the four took their heads.
[Just how on earth did Steward Zhuo tame them? He really is a god… ]
The four caught onto Zhuo Fan who was just standing in the shadow of a tree.
They made a beeline for him.
Zhuo Fan grinned, “Took you long enough.”
“Steward Zhuo was waiting for us?” Violent Demon laughed.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “I know your thoughts like it’s my second nature. I knew you were after my pills the minute you said healing the kids will need medicine.”
Whoosh~
An azure glow shot for the four and Violent Demon caught the vial.
“You might not have joined the final battle of Tianyu, but you’re on my side and I don’t skimp on my people.” Zhuo Fan crossed his arms, leaning on the tree, “In there, you have four Heaven Reaching Pills. Split them amongst yourselves.”
Grinning, Violent Demon felt awkward though he had no shame putting the vial in his ring, “He-he-he, with Steward Zhuo as our boss, the way forward is limitless. We may be in the Demon Scheming Sect, but we’ll follow Steward Zhuo through hell and high water!”
“Yep!” The brothers echoed, then turned their angry stare at Violent Demon, “Boss, Steward Zhuo told us to share so why are you hogging them. Take them out!”
Violent Demon spoke with entitlement, “I am the boss, so of course I am the one to keep them.”
“Bullshit!” The other three pygmies raved, raining fists on him.
Zhuo Fan waved to stop them, “Sharing is for you to decide, but later. I need you to do something for me.”
“We await your orders, Steward Zhuo!” The four cupped their hands the next second.
Zhuo Fan said, “As executives, there’s little information you have access to, but you should pick up clues about the elders from their actions. So keep an eye out for the slightest disturbance and report back. And more importantly, see if the elders intend to have Kui Lang and Yue Ling reinstated.”
“Why do you ask, Steward Zhuo? You know that once someone is dumped in the Labor Office, coming out is almost impossible. There hasn’t been a pardon in centuries!” Violent Demon asked puzzled
Zhuo Fan smiled, “When Hu Mei’er went to the Labor Office, she taunted the two. Was it all just showing off and acting smug? She plotted against the juniors just to get to them. In short, help me keep an eye out. If they are to return and I have no choice but to do as Xie Wuyue said, then these two are my ticket into the inner sect. “
The Four Scheming Demons cupped their hands…

chapters.title: Chapter 543: Taunt
chapters.content:
Chapter 543: Taunt
Three days later, Yue’er and Kui Gang jumped back on the horse or, in this case, back to the outer sect promotion to beg the elders.
Everyone at the competition was stunned.
With their gruesome wounds, everyone was aware of their fate, yet here they were a couple days later. To top it all off, Kui Gang had even advanced.
[What the hell did you eat to get on your feet so fast?]
The elders were even more shocked with how these two had made a full recovery not just in body but in cultivation as well.
It left them speechless.
No one healed completely was a saying everyone knew. Yet these two were back in action better than before.
But since the two had shed their status as a waste and had yet to piss off any important people, there was no point leaving them in the Labor Office.
So the elders welcomed them back into the outer sects without even an inquiry.
Meanwhile, Hu Mei’er swung her hips walking towards a pavilion. Liu Xu was there, playing the zither in the marvelous scenery, the river on one side and the mountain on the other.
Though the tone of the music gave an insight into his foul mood…
“Second senior brother, this is absurd…”
Hu Mei’er was rushing now and appeared with a flabbergasted face.
Hu-
The zither stopped as Liu Xu sighed, “Mei’er, what has got you so shocked? Is the sky falling?”
“Not yet, but what I found is far more wicked!” Hu Mei’er shook her head.
“Just what could have gotten you so unnerved?” Liu Xu raised an eyebrow.
Hu Mei’er had a bitter smile, “Second senior brother, I bet you won’t believe it either. Those brats have made a full recovery and are back in the outer sect.”
“Say what?” Liu Xu was incredulous, “There’s no way, not with their broken meridians. And so fast too. Just healin-, no, not even healing is possible!”
“That’s why I said it’s absurd.” Hu Mei’er stomped, her dainty complexion ruined by her frown.
Liu Xu paced around the pavilion in thought, “No, this is an impossible feat for Kui Lang and Yue Ling. Some big shot must’ve lent a hand. But who? Not even the elders can do this, while the Venerables that can are too few to count.
“Moreover, the price is too big. Would a Venerable waste all his hard earned capital just to save some nobodies? Not even Kui Lang saving his master from death would get his master to help so much.” Liu Xu speculated.
Well of course not, since no Venerable had the good stuff like Zhuo Fan, nor were they so filthy rich to throw away 10th grade pills like nothing.
They were clueless as well about the golden goose hiding in the Labor Office.
Or the Labor Office’s doorstep would fall every day because of the crowd of people coming to hug that big tree…
Hu Mei’er frowned, “Second senior brother, the brats are too freaky. I made some inquiries and it only gets weirder. Just that I don’t know how it’s related to the two.”
“What?” Liu Xu asked.
Hu Mei’er said, “The same day the brats recovered, someone said they saw Kui Lang and Yue Ling fawning over Zhuo Fan they’d cast out in the cemetery to come see the brats. But it wasn’t long after that Zhuo Fan was back in the cemetery while the brats improved…”
“Zhuo Fan again?” Liu Xu’s brow shook.
Hu Mei’er surmised, “Maybe Zhuo Fan got his backer to save the two…”
“Out of the question. Zhuo Fan has no status in the sect and has no one to ask.” Liu Xu shot it down.
Hu Mei’er cried, “He has no one in the sect? But isn’t he a wastrel?”
“Ha-ha-ha, that was just us jumping to conclusions.”
Liu Xu sighed, “I asked for master’s help to get to the bottom of this and Zhuo Fan has no ties to any elder or Venerable. He’s a nobody!”
“Then why would the Sect Leader bring him in just to demote him?” Hu Mei’er couldn’t understand.
Liu Xu shook his head, “No one understands the Sect Leader’s mind. We can’t make wild guesses. More or less he found a kid with great potential but who lacks experience so he dumped him in the Labor Office as a trial. You know how ruthless Sect Leader is to his disciples. “
“Didn’t you just say not to make wild guesses?” Hu Mei’er put on her charming smile.
Liu Xu smiled, but his mood soured soon, “We may not know how these two events are related but one thing is certain, the punk will rise sooner or later and become a threat to our position!”
“Second senior brother, you mean…” Hu Mei’er frowned.
Liu Xu nodded, his eyes icy.
Hu Mei’er hesitated, “So he isn’t a wastrel, but the Sect Leader has brought him into the sect and he will even become his disciple one day. That means the Sect Leader will look into what we’re doing… “
“No worries, Sect Leader is unyielding. He may appreciate the kid’s talent but shows his cruelty by throwing him into the Labor Office where one’s very life is at stake. No disciple of the Sect Leader is a weakling!”, Liu Xu’s eyes glinted with bloodthirst.
Hu Mei’er nodded, blossoming in a smile, “Leave him to me. His 7th layer of Profound Heaven cultivation is good but I never touched him before fearing his wastrel status. But now I have no qualms.”
“Junior sister, a dreamboat is nice but getting greedy is a no-no. Watch out for Kui Lang and Yue Ling. If they report you to the sect, it will bring you trouble.” Liu Xu snickered.
Hu Mei’er waved him off, her smile intoxicating, “Second senior brother, I know what I’m doing and won’t let greed get the best of me, hi-hi-hi…”
Hu Mei’er swung her hips on her way back, catching Liu Xu’s content eyes.
In their oblivious states, they were going to piss off this easy pretty boy on the surface yet mean and ruthless beast on the inside.
Hu Mei’er and Liu Xu were digging their own grave. Calling it ‘I told you so’ couldn’t be more fitting…
Hu~
The biting wind whistled past Zhuo Fan in the cemetery, swallowed by the black energy around him.
Hum~
With a few shakes, Zhuo Fan showed a bright smile. Reaching the 8th layer was just around the corner.
Pa!
Though the snapping of a branch dampened his good mood.
[For crying out loud, what is it this time? Who the hell is messing with my quality time breaking through?]
Zhuo Fan grumbled as he took back the black energy and looked at the newcomer coming over.
Even before he saw her, her voice reached him, hypnotic and intoxicating.
Not even Zhuo Fan’s steady heart could fight the attraction off completely.
“Oh, junior brother Zhuo Fan, it’s been a while. I have longed for you so much.” Hu Mei’er swung her ass, ramping up the charm.
Any male would be reduced to a bumbling drooling idiot right about now, wishing nothing more than to jump into the sack. Though the green grass would do just fine as well when it came to jumping like rabbits. It wasn’t Hu Mei’er’s average looks doing this either, but the way she carried herself, her every gesture, her every blink, got every male hooked.
Zhuo Fan included. Though as he wiped the drool off his face, his heart turned into an ice block.
[Miss me, is it? Miss your head!]
[Two months back, you took me for a wastrel yet now you’ve come to toy with me?
[He-he-he, isn’t it just because I saved those two? Heh, you’ve come to the right guy.]
Licking his pearly whites, Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed with savagery, waiting to pounce on the oblivious prey inching closer to its doom…

chapters.title: Chapter 544: Fiendish
chapters.content:
Chapter 544: Fiendish
Her devilish swing of hips drew nearer with every intoxicating step. In front of him, she rolled her coquettish eyes in a frown of revulsion, “Oh my, what is this place? How can you stand it? Just how could those two send darling to such a foul place?”
“Ha-ha-ha, but senior sister, I like it here.” Zhuo Fan’s smile leaked a jeer.
Rolling her eyes, Hu Mei’er grumbled, “How can you deprecate yourself, junior brother? You may not care about your body, but I am heartbroken.”
Hu Mei’er placed a hand on her chest, this killer move got even Zhuo Fan dazed.
Hu Mei’er snickered inside, “Dear Fan’er, I’m going to give those two a piece of my mind and make them take you back. I can’t bear to see you wither in this awful place, enduring the cruel winds, when you’re already sporting white hair…”
Hu Mei’er traced Zhuo Fan’s hair with her dainty hand, then his head, then his cheek.
Her hand fell on Zhuo Fan’s cheek like a feathery touch, making his heart skip a beat.
With a bright smile speaking endless promises, Hu Mei’er fell into his arms. His face flushed, his ears reddened and his mind blanked.
“Uh, junior sister, w-what are you doing?” Zhuo Fan stammered.
Giggling, Hu Mei’er said, “Silly, I found you so pitiful enduring so many hardships, and wish to reward you.”
“Reward? What is it?” Zhuo Fan showed an odd smile.
Hu Mei’er rolled her eyes, pouting, “Meany, you know. You want me to spill it out? Why play hard to get when it’s so obvious.”
Hu Mei’er’s soft hands wound around his neck like vipers, making him freeze.
With a giggle, Hu Mei’er’s sexy lips touched his neck.
Like a bolt out of the blue, Zhuo Fan shivered, just like a vir-, alright a real virgin, not knowing what to do with his hands.
Hu Mei’er had a cold smile looking at his nervousness, proud of herself too.
[This pretty boy is in the bag!]
Hu Mei’er’s hot lips kissed him along his neck, like a general sieging a city.
All this while Zhuo Fan had a dumb look on his face and was rooted in place. She took all the liberties she wanted, attacking his frail heart with every action.
He was like a lamb in front of a tigress, puny, weak and helpless to even cry out.
Better yet, not wanting to cry…
Her full lips finally reached Zhuo Fan’s mouth.
“J-junior sister… no…”
Zhuo Fan could hardly speak.
Hu Mei’er figured, [That should do it.] and her eyes took a darker tone.
[Time to die!]
Hu Mei’er’s power surged.
A thick aroma wafted from her, stopping any of his movements with a whiff.
He couldn’t move even if he wanted to.
Grinning, Hu Mei’er wiggled her tongue in Zhuo Fan’s mouth like an eel, sealing them together.
Seeing her succubus eyes, Zhuo Fan’s blood boiled, his Dantian roiled, wanting to escape.
[So that’s it, she’s training in some charm method to steal men’s yang for herself.]
To men, their yang was their essence. It was through it that they grew closer to the Dao, their cultivation rose. It was the foundation of their very existence without which no spiritual energy would gather upon them.
Or at least they couldn’t hold it and turn it into one’s own Yuan Qi.
Losing one’s yang meant turning into a cripple if not a corpse.
A man’s yang made for good medicine as well to a woman’s yin; an intact yang even more so.
Thus the world had ways to nurture yang through yin and the other way around.
A shame that her wiles fell short when it came to Zhuo Fan, not something here meager 3rd Layer of Radiant Stage cultivation could overcome.
[Your funeral.]
Zhuo Fan activated Demon Transformation Art.
Whoosh~
Thick black energy shot from Zhuo Fan as his blood cooled and Hu Mei’er’s poison inside it vanished, offering his joy of movement once more.
The pitch black energy wrapped Hu Mei’er in its black abyss.
Hu Mei’er’s expression froze in that prideful smile as the horror in her eyes soared.
[Why can’t I take his yang and why is such a dreadful power seeping into my body? I can’t stop it.]
[What the hell did he do?]
Hu Mei’er was panicking, wishing nothing more than to bolt.
But having lost the means to escape, she became the prey of a ruthless savage beast. The prey and hunter had switched places.
Sss~
Zhuo Fan’s trademark evil smile was back in the works as the black energy rushed back to him and seeped out of Hu Mei’er.
Hu Mei’er felt her Yuan Qi plunging out of her control.
“D-don-…”
Her frail hands pushed Zhuo Fan’s chest, wanting to escape from this demon. Alas, no prey had ever left Zhuo Fan’s sight, unless dead.
As the Yuan Qi left her, Hu Mei’er grew weaker and so did her attempts.
Realizing her life was leaving her as well, Hu Mei’er cried.
She was regretting coming to mess with this freak. [How is this enjoying a pretty boy when I am the one turning to dust.]
If she had a second chance, she would never ever come at him even if it killed her…
“Steward Zhuo… ugh…” A hoarse voice grunted to a stop.
The two of them noticed four people watching them, Kui Lang, Yue Ling and the kids.
Hu Mei’er was thrilled finding her enemies here, crying, “Save me!”
Grasping at straws, Hu Mei’er cared not about sides right now, but only about her survival.
The four of them bumping into such a touching scene were too out of it to react.
[Is Steward Zhuo shagging the fox? That means we’ve come at the worst time!]
“Uh, sorry to disturb you, we’ll be going now. But Steward Zhuo, she is evil. Having fun is one thing, but never let it become serious or you’ll be sorry.” Kui Lang sighed awkwardly.
The other three went crimson.
Knowing it was all a misunderstanding, he shoved Hu Mei’er off, giving back her freedom much to her joy.
Not for long though because here came Zhuo Fan’s coup de grace, clutching her neck and hoisting her.
“This woman came to steal my yang!” Zhuo Fan spat.
The four exclaimed. [So they’re not bumping uglies, but she came to kill him.] But having felt Zhuo Fan’s power on their own skin, they laughed at her predicament.
While they were also happy that they didn’t tell this vixen about Zhuo Fan’s real strength or this scene wouldn’t have happened.
[Evil begets evil, as they say. The bitch is finished!]
Hu Mei’er was filled with remorse, tears streaming down.
[What is wrong with me messing with an obvious hidden expert?]
She was regretting her decision so much that she was getting an ulcer…

chapters.title: Chapter 545: Rearing
chapters.content:
Chapter 545: Rearing
“Hu Mei’er, I didn’t feel like joining your inner sect politics, but since you’ve come knocking… you will get just desserts.”
Zhuo Fan grinned and flicked Hu Mei’er away.
She landed hard and watched him with fear.
Zhuo Fan waved her off, “Take a hike, I’ll leave you with a warning. This is far from over, your reckoning is at hand!”
Hu Mei’er chilled and quaked as she stumbled away, far from this monster.
Never had she felt such dread as she did from Zhuo Fan and wished to leave this place at once.
How ironic, she had come to suck him dry only to enter the wolf’s jaws instead.
Kui Lang and Yue Ling wanted to chase but forwent it on account of Zhuo Fan’s icy face.
Being in a demonic sect for so long they knew not to encroach on a strong man’s dignity. With Zhuo Fan here, their opinions were moot. Or dealing with that fox would earn this big shot’s ire.
For now, at least, they let their bitter enemy alone to live another day.
Glancing over, Zhuo Fan said, “Clever, you know how to defer to me, though it’s also what saved you. There’s no point in venting, adding to your crimes and nullifying your return to the inner sect.”
“What?” The two cried out, “Return?”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “I’ve been inquiring around for you. In light of your great achievements in the Labor Office, the elders and Venerables are going to pardon you. Or Hu Mei’er wouldn’t have taunted you after targeting the kids. It’s all smoke and mirrors to hide their true plan.”
[So that’s why!]
Kui Lang and Yue Ling rejoiced at the near miss they just survived. They’d have plenty of time for revenge once they are back in the inner sect, no pressure.
Two lives for one was so not worth it.
“Steward Zhuo, why did you spare her?” Kui Lang wondered, “You’re not in the Labor Office because of punishment, killing her was just a disciple dispute, within your right and rules. It might even get you out of labor duty and straight into inner sect.”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “I’d be leaving myself open. Killing her here would force her handler to implicate others and your return to the inner sect might even fail. Besides, I have different plans. She’s not worthy of dying at my hand.”
Kui Lang and Yue Ling had puzzled looks.
[Do his words have another meaning?]
Zhuo Fan laughed at their looks since they didn’t know the intricate political schemes the higher ups employed.
“Now why have you come for me?” He eyed the four despite knowing all about it.
With a bow, the gang recalled their objective and said, “Steward Zhuo, we have come for Yue’er…”
“I’ve made up my mind and that won’t change. No amount of begging will help.” Zhuo Fan cut her off, turning away, “Having debated with Elder Yuan on Dao, he understands the most. Ever wondered why he isn’t here as well?”
Yue Ling gasped.
They had asked Elder Yuan to come as well but he knew nothing would change.
[Zhuo Fan is a true man of ambition, never going back on his words, never regretful of his decisions.]
All sighed.
Then Zhuo Fan added, “Although, your timing is perfect. I need you to do something for me.”
“Steward Zhuo has saved my son and I would go through hell or high water for you!” Kui Lang declared.
Yue Ling cupped her hands as well though she wasn’t into it, having lost the jovial mood.
Zhuo Fan knew she wasn’t much keen on doing anything since he stopped helping her baby sister half way.
But Zhuo Fan did it on purpose, all for this moment.
“Not from you, but from the juniors.” Zhuo Fan spoke
The two jerked, [What could he have for them?]
Zhuo Fan grinned, “I need them to deal with someone.”
“Who?” All echoed.
“Hu Mei’er.”
“What?!”
Startled, the four couldn’t believe their ears. He wanted the kids to deal with a 3rd layer of Radiant Stage cultivator?
Besides the fact, this task was impossible, Hu Mei’er’s life was in his hands just now yet he let her go. The hell had he been thinking, sending kids after her?
Expecting this reaction, Zhuo Fan smiled, “Not right now of course, but in three months, when the outer sect promotion ends and the inner promotion begins. I want everyone to see that outer disciples can beat an inner disciple.”
“This can’t be!”
Kui Lang was incredulous, “The inner disciples are all excellent talents showcased in the outer sect competition. They all show promise of reaching Radiant Stage within five years of becoming an inner disciple. And that Hu Mei’er is in the 3rd layer, even more well known, with a high chance of being chosen as an elite. What can two children do against a Radiant Stage expert at their level? Steward Zhuo, if you hate them so much, I would do it in their stead and appease your anger.”
“You’ll do no such thing. I can kill her anytime I want. I’ve only let her go so that she’d attract attention in the inner competition after losing to some juniors. I want her to be disgraced. You and Yue Ling better not do anything the following few months, or you’ll be sorry.” Zhuo Fan snorted.
Kui Lang sighed.
[This Steward Zhuo is a deep mastermind in one moment and a spoiled brat the next.] For the kids to finish that woman on the stage would definitely make her a disgrace but the question was, could they do it?
They were a stage of cultivation below her. Everyone knew the difference between Radiant Stage and Profound Heaven Stage.
But then he turned to the anomaly in front of him and words left him.
[He might be the only monster in the Profound Heaven Stage as strong as a peak Radiant Stage.]
Kui Lang shook his head, “Steward Zhuo, not everyone is as special as you. The only time they might be her match is in ten years.”
“Enough baloney, I am asking them. It’s their choice. I will personally teach them in these three months, guaranteeing their rise.”
“Be that as it may, there’s no way they’d reach the 3rd layer of Radiant Stage in such a short time. They’re going to die.” Kui Lang lamented, “If an outer disciple challenges an inner disciple, they have all the right to kill the former.”
Yue Ling nodded.
Ignoring the two Labor Office bosses, Zhuo Fan turned to his victims, “Well, any complaints? I’m looking at you, Yue’er. To boost you, I’ll have to give you a Heaven Reaching Pill. Better think it over.”
Kui Gang shook his head in the end, offering his apologies while stepping back.
He had just gotten better and his body had grown a level. His future was limitless and he didn’t need to take unnecessary risks.
While Yue’er’s gaze hardened and she nodded, “I agree.”
“Fool, do you want to die?” Yue Ling cried.
Yue’er gave an innocent smile, “Sister, I do not care about my stagnant cultivation but I do know that I will become your weakness. Here is a chance to not only advance but defeat our enemy. I have to try. At worst, you’ll just refuse to see me as your little sister and I won’t drag you down anymore.”
“Oh child, you’ve never burdened me.” Yue Ling rubbed her head, choking with emotion.
Zhuo Fan jumped up and grabbed Yue’er, “Good, you’ll be following me for the next three months!”
And the two blinked away.
Yue Ling panicked, looking everywhere but finding nothing. All she heard was Zhuo Fan’s disembodied shout, “People, I’ll give you the new and improved Yue’er in three months. Look forward to it, ha-ha-ha…”

chapters.title: Chapter 546: Black Wind Blade
chapters.content:
Chapter 546: Black Wind Blade
Pff!
In an elegant and tasteful pavilion on a mountain peak, Hu Mei’er stumbled her way over to the stone table where she splattered, bathed in crimson.
Her delicate complexion had now taken a sickly turn.
Whoosh~
An azure person flashed over, the second senior brother.
Liu Xu gasped at her wounds, “Junior sister Mei’er, what the hell happened? Did Kui Lang and Yue Ling attack you while you dealt with that punk?”
“They didn’t have to. It’s all that rotten punk’s fault. He played us!” Hu Mei’er shook her head, lamenting, “This must be my most unlucky year. I just ran into a monster, a beast this close to tearing me apart!”
Liu Xu asked, “Junior sister, what are you saying? I don’t understand anything.”
“Ha-ha-ha, you’re not the only one. He’s supposed to be some weak lamb, yet underneath it all, he’s a monster ready to pounce. I would’ve never risked today if I knew him for what he was.” Hu Mei’er sighed with a pained face.
Having complained enough, she detailed her ‘battle’ to Liu Xu.
Liu Xu was dumbstruck, “That brat is stronger than you? How?”
“Why else do you think he had me immobilized in one move? I couldn’t resist at all!” Hu Mei’er sighed.
Liu Xu paced around the pavilion, his face heavy, “With a power like Zhuo Fan, this changes things. Sect Leader brought him in for a reason after all. But why dump him in the Labor Office? What is Sect Leader up to?”
“Second senior brother, don’t be rash.”
Hu Mei’er cut in his train of thoughts, “We can’t beat that guy, so don’t taunt him. We’re already on his bad side from today, but let’s not do something we’ll regret.”
“So? This is the Demon Scheming Sect, no matter how great he is, he still needs a stable footing to stand tall. What slips my understanding is the Sect Leader’s design revolving around him. Will it affect the elite selection? “
Liu Xu’s eyes glinted, “This is no longer something as simple as a disciple affair. I’ll take it up with the master and hear his opinion.”
Hu Mei’er cried, “Venerable Shi?”
“Yes.” Liu Xu nodded, “Let him probe Zhuo Fan’s importance to Sect Leader and we’ll just ask him or an elite senior brother to deal with the brat depending on how much Sect Leader values him. If the Sect Leader has his eyes set on him, we’ll block the Labor Office and he won’t get any merit to leave this place. With no excuse to base his rise on, he’ll be stuck there forever!”
Hu Mei’er nodded, and her charming smile was back, yet was soon replaced with a frown, “But with his strength, he simply has to challenge an inner disciple before the elders and Venerables and he’s out. Moreover, our competition is in three months. He is our biggest threat!”
“Ha-ha-ha, that’s even easier. If we meet him, we’d just forfeit.” Liu Xu said.
Hu Mei’er was still puzzled.
Liu Xu beamed, “Junior sister, everyone that ends up in the Labor Office is either a criminal or a reject. The first type will either die of old age stuck in there for the rest of their lives or gain enough merit to recover their status. Exactly how Kui Lang and Yue Ling created the Asura Circle.
“Laborers are the lowest rung, no matter how hard they work, how strong they get, they’ll never become disciples again, only elders or Venerables to safeguard the precious inner disciples. Zhuo Fan is a laborer but not a criminal, that means he’s lower than a bug. So no matter how much he proves his strength, he’ll be a Venerable or elder at most. Unless…”
“What?” Hu Mei’er asked eagerly.
Liu Xu shook his head, “Junior sister Mei’er, it doesn’t matter. It’s just impossible. Unless he flips the world on its back and has the whole sect acknowledge him. That’s the only way to become an elite.”
“They say the High Venerable came from the Labor Office as well, with unstoppable power, the highest in the sect. But even so, he’s still just a Venerable falling short of becoming the Sect Leader. It is a rule unchanged for eternity.”
Hu Mei’er nodded, “That means Zhuo Fan and us will never cross paths.”
“That’s how it should be, but I worry that the Sect Leader has brought him here not to deal with disciples but those old guys.” Liu Xu’s eyes glinted, “If their situation does not settle, our structure will change.”
Hu Mei’er nodded after a pause.
Meanwhile, back among the tombstones, where the yin was thickest, a guy and a girl popped out of nowhere.
Achoo~!
Yue’er sneezed from the biting wind, hugging herself from the cold.
The creepiness of this place had her feeling threatened.
The sneeze was the most obvious sign. Even at her 6th layer of Profound Heaven cultivation, some cold wind actually managed to pierce her body.
Zhuo Fan had an ineffable smile, “From now on, you will be under my guidance. You are to follow my words to the letter, no matter if the path is rugged, torturing or deadly. You ‘will’ obey. And get it out of your head that someone’s going to save you. I’ve set up a barrier those two will never find. Got it?”
“Yes!” Yue’er nooded with a steeled face, disregarding her gruesome fate.
Zhuo Fan beamed, “No questions? How strong you’ll get or your survival rate…”
“None.” Yue’er said, “Knowing that you can restore my meridians to keep me cultivating is enough. Nothing else matters.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Great!”
He made a gesture and pointed, “Place of yin, gates of heaven; howls of wraiths, gather within me; biting winds lash my body; rip the sky, destroy this world!”
Hum~
The air shimmered under Yue’er’s incredulous look and a two meters tall door appeared.
It opened with a creak to reveal nothing but a black abyss and howling winds like banshee’s screams. Yue’er stood frozen before the eerie door and ice formed on her hand, robbing her of feeling from it.
“W-wha-” Yue’er lost her composure, now panicking.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “This is the 7th grade array I’ve set up, Black Wind Array. I’ve gathered all the biting winds, strongest here in the cemetery’s center. Entering this place will have one’s bones and tendons snap like twigs, their soul pulverized. A feeble mind would end up soulless just looking at the door.”
“But not you, because you have a death wish!”
Yue’er turned her shocked face at him. [How does he know my thoughts?]
Zhuo Fan continued, “From the moment I laid my eyes on you, I knew your character, ruthless to the extreme and even more so to yourself. I thought you were just putting up a tough front, but after all that’s happened to you, I knew it all came from your steeled will. It’s because of you that your sister ended up in the Labor Office and made you feel like a burden. You worked hard to live up to her expectations while also hellbent on succeeding or die trying. So that maybe, dying will free her of this burden.”
“That’s why not fully healing didn’t come as such a disappointment to you, because you’re a lost cause, hopeless. Right?” Zhuo Fan’s eyes pierced her.
Yue’er stared right back, though her eyes were in shock. [He saw through me. Not even my sister knows me so well.]
“Now, this temper is quite good, perfect to train this top profound ranked martial art, Black Wind Blade!” Zhuo Fan’s trademark evil smile was back in business, his hand revealed a jade slip, “This art is trained with the biting winds here, far stronger than your Demon Devouring Sabre. And since your meridians are shot to begin with, this yin seeping into you is a blessing in disguise and you don’t need my help. Follow this art and these winds will be your deadliest weapon!”
Yue’er took the jade slip, about to read it, when Zhuo Fan threw her inside the door, “No time, just get to it!”
“Ah!”
The devil’s hand pushed a wailing Yue’er into hell.
Zhuo Fan stayed behind with a wide smirk.
The crucial point of the Black Wind Blade was to stay calm in the face of certain death. Or the second one panicked, the yin would devour him.
Zhuo Fan planned for Yue’er to learn this art, the minute he saw her. All his actions lead to this point, even forgoing healing her. He wasn’t that petty, just cruel.
Or no matter how much she agreed, her sister would never let her…

chapters.title: Chapter 547: Probing
chapters.content:
Chapter 547: Probing
Wu~
The biting winds howled in the cemetery, brushing up the white hair and making them dance.
Zhuo Fan closed his eyes and sat on a rock. Then, with two shakes of a lamb’s tail, he got another layer under his belt.
After Hu Mei’er’s interference half a month ago, Zhuo Fan finally got the feeling of reaching the eighth layer again and grasped it.
He eased a breath and gazed at the endless black before him. The winds sounded like wailing wraiths, drowning a the sound of a faint sharp swing.
[Yue’er had been in there for half a month. The first week was only wails of agony, but now it’s replaced with the sharp sound of blade swings.]
Zhuo Fan perked up knowing thay Yue’er had blended in with the array.
“Zhuo Fan, congratulations. In just a few months you’ve reached the 8th layer of Profound Heaven Stage.” The voice was saying one thing and the tone another, thick with sarcasm.
Zhuo Fan saw a hazy shadow floating over, its vibe was ice cold.
“Xie Wuyue?” Zhuo Fan blinked. Even as a soul, Zhuo Fan recognized the voice.
Xie Wuyue faltered then snapped, “Its Sect Leader for you!”
“Oh~, Sect Leader.” Zhuo Fan nodded, “What wind brought the great Sect Leader here, I wonder?”
“Just checking up on your progress.”
Xie Wuyue sighed, “You’ve done well for yourself by the looks of it, hogging the cemetery to yourself and cultivating in peace. But you never once considered my words!”
“You wound me. Am I not doing it as we speak?” Zhuo Fan stuck out his chin.
Xie Wuyue sneered, then sighed, “What are you up to now, placing some arrays over here? Zhuo Fan, where’s that fire from back in the Luo clan gone to? Why are you so… boring here, not doing anything.”
“Sect Leader, what ever gave you that idea? You told me to earn merit and that’s what I’m doing.” Zhuo Fan stuck his chest out, pointing around him, “Did you want me to fight my way up to the elites? It’s fast, crude and brutal, but I doubt it’s your intention.”
“If it were that easy I’d have had you do it by now. Why else did I put you here to earn merit?” Xie Wuyue sighed, “With how deep the still waters of Demon Scheming Sect run, using brute force will end with…”
“Getting besieged on all sides.” Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed.
Xie Wuyue nodded, “You’re a smart guy and should’ve guessed by now why I pardoned those four shits and made them executives, even sent them as guides for you. All so they could work under you and make it easier for you. I reckoned they should’ve gathered juicy info after all this time eavesdropping.”
“Demon Scheming Sect is filled with factions. Besides the disciples’ conflicts, there’re also the elders and Venerables behind them. Like that elite selection, becoming an elite will get one showered with resources. With their masters dipping their fingers in this wealth as well. By bursting into this act, everyone will be out to get me. And besides, Sect Leader doesn’t want me for this.”
Xie Wuyue’s shadow eyed him for a long time.
He nodded in the end, “Zhuo Fan, you’re very clever. Fighting your way into the inner sect, you’ll have elders and Venerables wishing to take you in. But that’s not what I want to see. You’ll just be integrated into the system and that won’t change anything.”
“A rot has been festering inside the Demon Scheming Sect for years and years. Not even I and High Venerable can touch these old fools’ interests. It’s because of their selfishness that the disciples fight each other and end up looking like trash outside. The disciples’ strength has degenerated so much since the last Double Dragon Gathering… “
Xie Wuyue was overcome by sadness and changed the subject, “So when I mentioned you to High Venerable, he had you placed in the Labor Office. To watch you and free you from those choppy waters since no one coming from the Labor Office will ever become an elite. Unless you have the whole sect’s respect, that means overthrowing the elders’ and Venerables’ selfishness, while also crushing them into submission.”
“That’s the same as bitch slapping them and getting them to thank me for it. Isn’t that impossible?” Zhuo Fan pondered, then shook his head.
Xie Wuyue smiled, “That’s why I’ve brought you. At first I figured, I’d just take Huangpu Qingtian to enter the elites, but witnessing your skills, I decided to go big and have you do the unthinkable. I want you to sit on the elders and Venerables, to reform the elites so that the next Double Dragon Gathering won’t be a crushing defeat. High Venerable’s wish is even loftier, to reform the entire sect. That’s why he sent you to the Labor Office.”
“You just made up your mind on your own without even asking me if I am up for it.” Zhuo Fan sighed.
Xie Wuyue laughed, “Now you understand everything. So how will you work towards that merit?”
Zhuo Fan pouted.
Xie Wuyue followed his eyes and saw the black hole with howling winds.
Not getting it, he waited for the kid’s explanation.
“Sect Leader, in the next inner sect competition I will make my challenge.” Zhuo Fan stated.
Xie Wuyue said, “I just told you I wouldn’t have put you here if it’s just about throwing fists. You’ll become an executive or elder at most.”
“It’s not me doing the fighting, but an outer sect disciple.” scratching his nose, Zhuo Fan had an evil smile.
Xie Wuyue pondered, exclaiming, “You want to smack those oldies in public and affect their repute?”
“Not only that, but also probe for their limits. And I can’t get on everyone’s bad side either. But win one faction while slapping another. I just got on Kui Lang and Yue Ling’s good side. Their masters…”
“Venerables Bai and Qi. They had lost faith in their disciples but nowadays, their inner disciples were done in by sparring with Gui Hu. So they were hasty to make the Asura Circle as their great merit to bring them back. I get your plan, so I’ll have the two return as inner disciples in no time and establish your faction.” Xie Wuyue nodded.
But frowned the next second, “But how is an outer disciple supposed to beat a seasoned inner disciple in just three months of training?”
“Ha-ha-ha, leave that to me, Sect Leader. And that competition will just be the start. I will have the entire sect trembling and crush the old geezers’ venues. Though, will the Sect Leader be kind enough to lend a hand when they start raving?” Zhuo Fan snickered.
Xie Wuyue said, “I am the leader of the Demon Scheming Sect and must be obeyed. By the way, do you know our rules?”
“Of course.” Zhuo Fan nodded.
“As long as you’re within the purview of the rules, you have me on your side.”
[Fricking weasel, you want to use me and still won’t stick your neck out.] Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes.
Xie Wuyue soothed him, “Even I have my problems. You’re a smart guy and can use the rules. Like how Venerables and elders can’t touch the disciples, the higher ranks can’t mess with the lower rung. Any issue will be dealt with by capital punishment. Better remember these important rules and use them well, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan nodded, mirroring his grin.
Xie Wuyue clearly wanted to instigate him. [Go ahead and kill to your heart’s content. With me around, no one will touch you.]
[It’s not my fault that you’re the lowest rung there is, a laborer. You can beat anyone you want, even kill ’em. Just win!]
What was the lowliest status in the sect became Zhuo Fan’s best shield, working in his name to cleanse the Demon Scheming Sect of those selfish pricks.
As for the old timers in question, they were blissfully oblivious of Sect Leader’s cruel plan he had in store for them, still fighting among themselves over crumbs…

chapters.title: Chapter 548: Assassin
chapters.content:
Chapter 548: Assassin
“Greetings master, Grand Elder, second elder.”
“Greetings master, Venerable Shi, Grand Elder!”
In a quaint wooden house, second senior brother and Hu Mei’er bowed before three people.
They were tall and imposing elderlies. The one in the middle had a hard look and sharp features, immovable as a rock.
Venerable Shi, master of Liu Xu.
On his left was a scrawny old man with beady eyes used particularly in devouring Hu Mei’er, this hunk of feminine pulchritude. He was none other than the second elder, her master.
As for the one on the right, he had a dull face and a shaky beard. He was in charge of distributing the sect’s resources, Grand Elder.
He had a weight no other elder in the sect had. In fact, most average Venerables had to show him respect.
The trio sat on a couch, watching the two while a buff man at the side sported a savage look.
Not even his silence could conceal his ruthless vibe.
“Gui Hu, I know it’s hard to hide the fiendish aura of that cultivation method, but you can at least control it and forge it into a weapon.” Grand Elder glanced over.
The man bowed, “Thank you master, I shall take it to heart.”
Gui Hu breathed in and the savage aura got cut down in half.
Grand Elder didn’t react while Venerable Shi smiled, “Gui Hu is the head inner disciple for a reason. At the 7th layer of Radiant Stage and the top profound ranked cultivation method, Underworld Fiend, there’s hardly any elites that could fight him.”
“Master is right, head senior brother is remarkable. I cannot wait, with the head senior brother’s help no other fellow disciples can stand in our way of becoming elites.” Liu Xu spoke in the most humble tone.
Venerable Shi smiled.
Grand Elder waved his hand, “Of no importance. Gui Hu helping you is all part of the agreement. Though Venerable Shi has many elite disciples, I will trouble sir to look after Gui Hu.”
“Ha-ha-ha, naturally. Gui Hu will remove many obstacles for us. He just cleared one elite position. We’re all on the same side here and of course should help each other.” Venerable Shi’s eyes shined.
Grand Elder nodded.
Not ganging up in Demon Scheming Sect did not mean just the elders and Venerables couldn’t skim the profits, but even their disciples would have an untimely end.
The same way the promising future of elites found their demise at Gui Hu and other’s hands.
Going by the current trend, only these three were hopeful of becoming elites and lavish in resources.
Grinning, Venerable Shi could hardly wait to dip his fingers, “I just can’t believe Venerable Qi and Venerable Bai found so many allies to get those two criminals to return. With their strength, they’re bound to take two spots.”
“No other choice, enviable talent exists everywhere. Decades ago, we were the ones to become elites, but those elders and Venerables had no disciples to use and favored Venerable Qi and the others. They must be jumping in joy that they stole two spots from us.” Second elder mocked.
The rest nodded.
Venerable Shi warned, “Are we just going to stand for this? Are we to let others take our bread? Why not incur public anger, we’re no pushovers either. By removing those seeds we’d do it from the shadows, even if those oldies find out, they’d have no proof. We’ll make them pay for our loss.”
The others nodded.
But Liu Xu spoke, “Master, I have a request.”
“Speak.”
“Sect Leader has brought in a disciple, Zhuo Fan, from outside and placed him in the Labor Office. I ask the honored master to investigate him.” Liu Xu looked Venerable Shi right in the eye.
Venerable Shi had never seen his disciple show such a calm expression, with so much eagerness too, “Isn’t he just a laborer? What’s the problem?”
“It’s grave, peculiar and convoluted.”
Liu Xu cupped his hands, “He has just joined the sect and was sent to the Labor Office, without any crimes. Even though the Sect Leader has brought him, they’ve never met. And finally, his outrageous power doesn’t fit his 7th layer of Profound Heaven cultivation. So much so that not even junior sister Mei’er could beat him. Master, something stinks here.”
Venerable Shi’s brow was locked in a frown, “It is indeed peculiar, and such strangeness is bound to hide something deeper. It must be Sect Leader’s plan.”
“Venerable Shi, won’t Sect Leader come for us if we interfere? We have been a bit brash over the past decades after all.” Grand Elder worried.
Venerable Shi sank into his thoughts before coming to a decision, “Sect Leader’s methods are cruel and cunning. He can’t come at us in the open and can only play some tricks. Letting his plan come to fruition will threaten our future. Humph, the first to strike has initiative. No matter how crucial that brat is to Sect Leader’s plans, getting rid of him will solve everything.”
“You want to… handle him?” Grand Elder cried, “But who should we send?”
Looking at the others, Venerable Shi said, “Based on Liu Xu’s words, the kid is an anomaly, stronger than what his cultivation dictates. Even Gui Hu will fail. That will give the Sect Leader an excuse to blow this out of proportions. By going myself, I’ll finish it in one blow with none the wiser…”
“You want to do it yourself?”
Grand Elder waved in panic, “Out of the question. The rules state no elder or Venerable can touch a disciple, not even a laborer. Even when picking up materials, we have to wait for the right time. But now that the Asura Circle is in effect, none of us can touch the Labor Office at all. Failure means ruining everything.”
Venerable Shi dismissed his worry, “It all comes down to getting some dirt on us. He won’t get squat if I don’t leave it! Or do you think a kid not even in Radiant Stage can do that? Hiding isn’t among the sect rules. Humph, Liu Xu, where is he?”
“Master, he is in the cemetery.”
“With a moonless night and fierce winds, it’s the most secluded location.” Venerable Shi made a sign, “Look after my body while I go!”
A shadow flew from his body and shot away in Zhuo Fan’s direction.
The rest remained to watch over the vessel.
An hour later, a shadow whistled into the cemetery in search of Zhuo Fan.
[Where the hell is that brat hiding?]
Venerable Shi’s eyes shone like the sun in search of his target.
As he flew around in soul form, he picked up something and by following its trace, he found something rippling.
[The punk has even set up a barrier, a shame everything is moot beneath Ethereal Stage. I’m going to take your head!]
Venerable Shi charged right in.
But before he could enter, something slammed into him and knocked him away.
Crying out inside, Venerable Shi sensed something oddly familiar about that gray mist that had hit him and he ran without a moment to lose.
The gray mist chose to let him go, looking back at the barrier, before vanishing.
Silence reigned once again, with Zhuo Fan oblivious to his near brush with death.
Pff!
Venerable Shi’s soul got back in his meat suit, and his first reaction was to bleed out.
“Venerable Shi, what happened?” Grand Elder was restless.
The others were the same. What could make an Ethereal Stage expert suffer such a heavy wound?
Venerable Shi stammered, “I-it’s High Venerable!”
[Say what?!]
Everyone was speechless. [The punk has High Venerable acting as his bodyguard? Who the hell is he? ]

chapters.title: Chapter 549: Inner Sect Competition
chapters.content:
Chapter 549: Inner Sect Competition
The eerie silence gnawed at their shocked minds. Demon Scheming Sect’s number one expert, High Venerable, was a bodyguard.
[Who on earth is that punk?]
Grand Elder said, “Venerable Shi, are you sure it’s him?”
“No mistake. No matter how mysterious High Venerable is around the sect, with most only seeing his soul form, but that aura and power are without a doubt from High Venerable. “
“Does that mean the High Venerable knows everything?” Grand Elder sighed.
Venerable Shi frowned, “Not sure. High Venerable stopped me before I could get to the kid. It felt more like he didn’t want to fall out with me, and only warned me. That’s the only reason I’m still alive.”
Everyone pondered. [True.]
“Does that mean the High Venerable wants to keep the sect from plunging into chaos?” Grand Elder mulled.
Venerable Shi said, “I think so as well. No matter how strong High Venerable is, we aren’t pushovers either. Taking us out will have the inner and elite disciples flip while the other elders and Venerables will use this opportunity to get their own disciples to climb ranks. The sect will be in a mess. High Venerable has always cared about just cause and will never let that happen. All we have to do is not push him.”
“Master, does that mean we cannot kill the kid?” Liu Xu was apprehensive.
Venerable Shi rolled his eyes and pointed at himself, “Isn’t it obvious from my state? Don’t touch the kid. I’ll be probing Sect Leader in the meantime and figure out who he is and why is High Venerable so fixated on him.”
Liu Xu frowned.
[No matter how much of an anomaly Zhuo Fan is, we can’t get to him now…]
After further deliberations, they reached an accord. No one was to make a scene, especially move against Zhuo Fan before the inner competition, lest they provoked Xie Wuyue and High Venerable.
At dawn, they disbanded just as they received notice that the Sect Leader had called a meeting of elders and Venerables.
There, they heard Xie Wuyue pardoning Kui Lang and Yue Ling and reinstating them as inner disciples.
Venerable Qi and Venerable Bai were wild with joy, their hopes rekindled with promising disciples for elite positions. They had even banded together with other fellow elders and Venerables to petition their case.
Yet Sect Leader announced it on his own accord and just before the big inner sect competition, a last ditch effort for these oldies to grab some profits.
Venerable Shi’s faction refrained from fighting and handed over the two spots with modesty and grace. On and off, Venerable Shi made some remarks about Zhuo Fan to test the waters, but Xie Wuyue didn’t rise to the occasion.
With Kui Lang and Yue Ling back in the inner sect and him coming out empty in regards to Zhuo Fan’s matter, this lofty Venerable sulked out of the Sect Leader hall.
Kui Lang and Yue Ling were reinstated and worked hard for the inner competition three months later, as did the other disciples.
Everyone was giving their all in grasping even the smallest chance of becoming an elite.
The cultivation trend was in vogue in the sect which made these months fly by without an incident.
On a ten meter tall stand, the elders watched the competition with a cold eye.
On the highest seat was Xie Wuyue, his chest was out, his head high, like a true Sect Leader. On his left were the Venerables, starting with Venerable Shi, while on his right he had Grand Elder and other elders. The new elders were not worth mentioning.
The audience was packed, with outer disciples enjoying the bustle and learning what to look for when they become inner disciples.
All were buzzing and commenting, waiting for the Sect Leader to start the competition every disciple yearned, a cruel battlefield.
“Ha-ha-ha, it seems High Venerable isn’t around to join us.” Venerable Shi commented next to Xie Wuyue.
Xie Wuyue merely glanced over.
Venerable Shi was the second Venerable. In High Venerable’s absence, he had the right to stick closer.
Xie Wuyue didn’t let his derision show, “High Venerable enjoys peace. The inner competition isn’t so great to make him come, even less than the outer competition. I wouldn’t be here either if I didn’t need to.”
Ugh!
Venerable Shi’s beard shook in anger.
Xie Wuyue jabbed him, knowing that he had rigged the inner competition. He gave a roundabout criticism leaving him speechless.
All because they had full control of the spots.
Three of those were taken by their disciples, Gui Hu, Liu Xu and Hu Mei’er. The rest were thrown to the other elders and Venerables to appease them, i.e. Kui Lang and Yue Ling.
As for the rest of the disciples, none had the strength to take them, or they’d be snuffed out if they tried.
The inner sect competition had devolved into a mere formality with time.
“Sect Leader, we aren’t so selfish not to care about others.” Grand Elder didn’t catch on to Xie Wuyue’s mockery and smiled.
Xie Wuyue frowned, seething in hatred.
Him and Venerable Shi were in cahoots and hard to counter.
A shame that High Venerable only cared about Dao and left Venerable Shi room to seize power. Or with the Venerables and elders keeping each other in check, this never would’ve happened.
Even if High Venerable returned, seizing control couldn’t be harder.
It left the only glimmer of hope shining down on Zhuo Fan, the anomaly, to break this corruption.
Xie Wuyue sighed, not finding Zhuo Fan down below and shook his head.
[No more waiting. I just hope he shows up in time.]
“Begin.” Xie Wuyue flicked his sleeve.
The judging elders bowed to the Sect Leader and the rest, before shouting, “Let the inner sect competition begin!”
The disciples all hollered.
The judges took a ribbon and read the names on it.
The fighting started with the arrival of the contestants while the audience grew livelier.
None however noticed three shadows a thousand meters away, sitting on a tree.
“Ha-ha-ha, another boring competition. At this rate, the elites are nothing but average, with the promising disciples left for dead in the inner sect.” One laughed.
The other sighed, “Such is the rot festering inside our sect. It makes Wuyue’s actions so dull. What’s the point of rewatching the same thing over and over again? If it were me, I’d explode by now. Looking at it now, I think not having a Sect Leader is still a blessing in disguise.”
“Ha-ha-ha, true, our luck is great. Reminds me of that Double Dragon Gathering, when only the four of us survived after those rich boys killed the rest. Our luck is practically godlike, weaving the same cloth that ruined us then.” The third’s laughter ended in rage.
The first person sighed, “Yeah, some elites are still excellent…”
“Yeah, crazy good, but who’ll then lead the Double Dragon Gathering team? Who the hell cares how great and mighty one is, even the best across the lands, when you can’t work together? What can they possibly achieve?” The third voice ranted.
The second shook his head.
The first looked at the second, “By the way, Wuyue brought some tough guy from Tianyu, right? How is he?”
“Don’t remind me. I know of Tianyu’s Regent Estate, plagued by narcissistic tendencies. Providence this, providence that; annoying up to here. I don’t feel like seeing him.” The third shot it down.
The other two shrugged.
Not that they knew the one to come to the Demon Scheming Sect was not Huangpu Qingtian but Zhuo Fan, a demon like no other.
Meanwhile, in the cemetery, a lovely figure came out of the Black Wind Array, her eyes flashing with a piercing gaze.
Zhuo Fan nodded and handed over a vial, “Hurry and take it, then complete your task…”

chapters.title: Chapter 550: Brutality
chapters.content:
Chapter 550: Brutality
Crack!
With a kaboom, a thin man spun out of the ring and spat blood on his way out.
His adversary was tall and sturdy, ruthless and cruel, the reinstated Kui Lang.
“The 8th match in the 3rd ring goes to Kui Lang!” The judge pointed at him.
The audience was abuzz.
“See that, in just one strike senior brother Lin Feng lost, despite having the same cultivation of 4th layer of Radiant Stage. Not even decades in the Labor Office held Kui Lang back.”
“It’s only natural. Who could hold his own against Black Yama back then anyway? With his appearance, an elite spot might be taken.”
“The chances are high. But senior brother Lin Feng worked so hard these past years yet nothing came of it. No one expected an old fiend to make a comeback.”
They sighed at the unconscious Lin Feng being taken away. Others lamented his poor luck.
Just when he was soaring through the rounds, this nemesis knocked him down to earth.
The sighs were short lived though, stunned by the cries coming from another ring. Yue Ling eyed a bloody figure with cold and merciless eyes.
Like he wasn’t even human, but an object.
“The 7th match on the 4th ring goes to Yue Ling!” The judge shouted the result.
Everyone shook their heads.
Their senior brothers were out of luck in this competition. With the already scarce spots, two monsters had returned and cut their chances at victory.
As for the other three…
Three shouts came in succession.
“The 6th match on the 9th ring goes to Liu Xu!”
“The 7th match on the 8th ring goes to Hu Mei’er!”
“The 13th match on the 1st ring goes to Gui Hu!”
The audience twitched, then shrugged. They should’ve known the ones to take the elite spots would be those five.
The rest were just extras to make them look good while doing it.
Everyone turned to the 1st stage and looked at the thirteen cold corpses lying there due to the insidious hand of head senior brother Gui Hu.
He was too fast and too brutal, killing them in a flash every time. Just as one corpse hit the ground, thrown from the ring, another was already falling, just like a murder machine.
“H-head senior brother, I-I forfeit!” A lanky guy in the 3rd layer of Radiant Stage shook to the core at Gui Hu’s savage look. He gave up even before going up there.
The judge eyed him coldly, “The 14th match…”
Crack!
The sound echoed in everyone’s ears, resulting in the lanky guy opening his eyes wide before collapsing on the ground as blood flowed from his forehead.
Gui Hu ended him in one palm strike.
Sss~
Everyone gasped, their hearts shivering from the horror.
[Why kill him when he forfeited? We are demonic cultivators, true, we are cruel, also true, but at the very least we’re also fellow disciples.] The only deaths in this competition came from Gui Hu, out for blood.
The judge looked irked.
He didn’t kill on the stage but outside of it and after the opponent had quit. [I was going to declare the result and you killed him under my nose?]
Gui Hu turned his cold gaze at him, “He shouldn’t have entered.”
[Shove it! How’s he supposed to know your savage ass will be waiting for him in the ring?]
The judge breathed in to soothe the incoming anger, “The 14th match on the 1st ring goes to Gui Hu. Next…”
“We forfeit…” Shouts came from below as they fled in fear.
The judge felt for them. No one wished for death. He declared, “The final winner of the 1st ring, Gui Hu!”
Roar!
The audience cheered, though Gui Hu had the same dead look in his eyes as he left the ring.
The other rings’ competitors looked over and shivered.
After an hour, each ring had a winner, Liu Xu, Hu Mei’er, Yue Ling and Kui Lang were the obvious ones.
While the rest had a much harder time grasping victory.
They were spent in body and mind, knowing they were going to lose in the fights that came.
“Only five may become elites. Come, draw your opponent but only the strongest five may move on!” An elder presented a box.
The five seeds of the competition were indifferent while the others were bitter.
They were far from being their match.
But still braved through.
A handsome man sighed over to the box and gave the ticket to the elder, “Elder, it’s the 5th ring!”
The elder nodded, then came a rough hand plunging into the box, soon revealing a creepy smile.
“He-he-he, what a coincidence, I’m in 5th ring as well!” Gui Hu landed his bloodthirsty eyes on the first man.
Shivering with shock the man waved his hands, “H-head senior brother, I qui-“
Crack!
The guy was down from a single slap from Gui Hu.
Everyone’s hearts sank, their eyes twitching, [Gui Hu is a cruel beast.]
The elder frowned, “The match hasn’t started!”
“What’s the point? It’ll end the same way anyway, ha-ha-ha…” Gui Hu cackled.
The elder sighed.
The strong were respected in a demonic sect and Gui Hu was the strongest disciple. He couldn’t say anything when the guy could back up his attitude. Besides, as the Grand Elder’s disciple, he had all the reason to flaunt his airs.
“Rest of you, continue!” The elder gave the box to the next one.
The other four drew their spot while the extras shivered from Gui Hu’s display as they reached inside.
[For crying out loud, the inner competition is a death sentence! I thought only the Labor Office’s Asura Circle was a killer!]
Their pained faces shuffled the contents of the box, hesitating on and on before finally drawing.
“The 4th ring, vs. Hu Mei’er!”
A pale disciple with slumped shoulders gave the paper to the elder who announced.
But then the guy’s eyes lit up as he saw Hu Mei’er’s delectable curves.
His heart was blooming, his soul about to fly out in happiness.
[Oh, it’s senior sister Mei’er. I’m not dreaming, am I? Everyone talks about her smooth skin, how even dying is worth it at this dainty flower’s hands. Since I’m going to lose, at least senior sister Mei’er will be the one to deliver the blow.]
He gawked at Hu Mei’er who was giving him coy looks, “Junior brother, my body is frail, please be lenient.”
“Of course…” The guy bobbed his head, drooling as his heart thumped harder.
Everyone was jealous, [What dumb luck on this punk to meet her. Leave something for us, aren’t we all friends?]
While Kui Lang’s face was heavy and serious.
Only the elders sneered, “Idiots, you won’t get anywhere with such poor self-control.”

chapters.title: Chapter 551: Challenge
chapters.content:
Chapter 551: Challenge
“Senior brother Kui Lang, please.”
With everyone getting their numbers, one tall guy faced Kui Lang. In front of this demon of days long past, the guy turned meek, bowing on the spot in hope of leaving this ring with his life.
As he bowed there, the lowest he could, Kui Lang came kicking, snapping countless bones like twigs.
While the victim shot for the ground and left behind a crater.
All the others saw was that guy spurting blood and slumping unconscious.
[Well shit, all of them are savages. None of them hold back at all.]
They gasped in fear as they watched Kui Lang cursing, “Humph, once you’re up here, it’s either death or life!”
The others gulped at the cruelty.
The other matches went down just the same, Liu Xu and Yue Ling getting their win just as easily.
While their opponents had a ghastly exit, at least their lives were safe and they weren’t crippled; they’d be back in shape in a year.
Wiping their brow, the audience lamented. [These geniuses are the essence of demonic cultivation, unhesitating.]
[They’re easier than Gui Hu, though not by much.]
Among the five, senior sister Mei’er was somewhat compassionate.
At this thought, they turned to her match, where she swung her hips and batted her intoxicating eyes at her opponent.
The guy was lost in those wonderful curves, those charming eyes, that sexy body.
“Humph, that fox is using charm again.” Kui Lang eyed her with bloodthirst.
While the audience watched on with jealousy, [Damn that punk, he’s so freaking’ lucky!]
The victim thought the same, sniffing Hu Mei’er’s aroma, bringing him into the ninth heaven.
Hu Mei’er giggled, “Hi-hi-hi, junior brother, what are you waiting for, come.”
“Right away, senior sister.” With a dumb look and lustful smile, the guy grabbed for her two most prominent features.
Hu Mei’er’s smile turned cruel, and she said, “Junior brother, where are you aiming with that?”
“He-he-he, it’s my special art, ches-, uh, Heart Piercing Dragon Claw. Senior sister, do be careful, ha-ha-ha… “
The guy eyed her like a wolf in heat, throwing himself at Hu Mei’er’s chesties.
[No good two bit filthy lowlife!]
The audience cursed, in jealousy and envy. [God damn it, why isn’t it me up there?]
Hu Mei’er’s face changed tunes the instant that guy closed in, her eyes taking a darker and savage tone.
Pff!
Hu Mei’er’s dainty hand clawed the guy’s throat out.
The victim gurgled in his feeble attempts to breathe, even as the lust remained in his eyes and his smile remained ever so vulgar.
Hu Mei’er drew closer and sucked the guy’s yang out.
Everyone watched in shock. [She’s even more vicious, stealing his essence.]
Ugh…
The victim groaned in pain, twisting but in vain. He was growing weaker by the second and soon his Yuan Qi scattered.
He slumped on the ground, without a breath and life.
All that remained was a lost look in his eyes.
Loosing one’s mind to charm would only result in one ending, death at the hands of the fairer sex.
Bang!
Hu Mei’er flicked the mummified corpse away and walked off the ring.
Hu Mei’er dabbed her lips with a hanky and giggled at the crowd. But no one bought it anymore, looking at her in fear.
It dawned on them what it meant to be burned by a woman’s scorn.
[Beneath that intoxicating look, she is hiding a deadly venom.]
Letting out a breath, they looked at the dried husk with pity instead of envy.
[No matter how deserving it is to die under a flow, who the hell would want that?]
If it came to choose between life and a hot number, most of those true characters would choose the first option hands down. When faced with this choice, all anyone would ever care about was their lives.
Moreover, before reaching success, it would be a darn shame ending up killed from lust.
Everyone had endless regret and remorse for the corpse…
“The 4th ring’s winner, Hu Mei’er!” The judge announced.
Which drew a close to the elite spots’ candidates, just as planned. Though Xie Wuyue didn’t like it any more.
Xie Wuyue eyed Hu Mei’er, “Venerable Shi, Grand Elder, I won’t speak about the rest but how could even she become an elite with just charm? The elites are crucial this time for the Double Dragon Gathering. The participants there are all known figures, with staunch wills and high cultivations. How can they fall for something as simple as charm? It’s not worthy for a charm user to become an elite.”
“Ha-ha-ha, Sect Leader isn’t exactly right.”
Venerable Shi shook his head, “Our demonic sect is based on strength, with the winner taking everything. Since Hu Mei’er won, she has earned her spot among elites. Changing the rules will earn everyone’s ire. Then again, if there’s a 6th person beating her, it’s also acceptable. “
Venerable Shi revealed a nasty grin, with Grand Elder and second elder nodding.
Only Xie Wuyue felt like cursing to high heaven.
[God damnit, with you fools killing everyone worthy, how will there be a 6th challenger?]
[Wait, didn’t Zhuo Fan say he’ll come slapping? What’s taking that punk so long?]
Xie Wuyue looked around for his figure.
Meanwhile, the three shadows in the tree a thousand meters off sneered at the outcome, while being regretful and sorrowful.
“Humph, see? These bastards are crossing the line. Are they that damn short of talents to let a charmer become an elite? Her eye batting would be worth a damn in the Double Dragon Gathering and we’ll end up ridiculed.” One shadow snapped.
The others nodded, “With the elite’s tempers and cultivation, it’s unique to have her charm among them. Raising her as our elite will be for nothing. These old timers only care about using their disciples to steal the sect’s resources. “
“Be that as it may, I find Gui Hu quite capable; as is Kui Lang.” A shadow pointed out.
The others nodded, “Even the most average batch has some talents. At least this time we have something to work with, unlike before.”
The three sighed bitterly.
“Gui Hu, Liu Xu, Kui Lang, Yue Ling and Hu Mei’er, Sect Leader has some words for you!” An elder shouted for the five to approach.
The audience watched excitedly.
What came next was the official declaration from the Sect Leader that these fives were elites, granted the highest honor.
The least they would be in the future was elders, men among men.
“Greetings, Sect Leader!” The five bowed.
Xie Wuyue hid a sneer as he fulfilled his duty, “Congratulations, from now on you will be eli-“
“Hold it!”
As space warped on the ring, a guy and a girl appeared..
The familiar voice continued, “Sorry, it seems you five still have a challenger left…”

chapters.title: Chapter 552: Double Play
chapters.content:
Chapter 552: Double Play
“Who’s there?”
Venerable Shi barked in annoyance because of the sudden appearance of the interlopers. Not even the venerables, Ethereal Stage experts picked up on their arrival.
How could this happen?
Venerable Shi soon found a young man with white hair and an attitude to boot holding a broom over his shoulder. As if to say ‘Come get your spanking’.’
His insufferable arrogance had Venerable Shi crawling up the walls.
He had never met another person more deserving of a beating than this punk.
The other arrival was an eighteen years old girl, her lovely looks ruined by the cold disposition and the icy air around her.
Even as an Ethereal Stage expert, his heart seized for a beat.
[These brats are up to something!]
While Xie Wuyue’s face turned sinister, “Who are you to show up here?”
“Outer disciple Yue’er. Greetings, Sect Leader!” Yue’er was familiar with Demon Scheming Sect and its rules, showing her respect.
Xie Wuyue nodded but Zhuo Fan still held that broom like a broadsword over his shoulder one second and the next second he cupped his hands, his voice booming, “I am laborer Zhuo Fan. Greetings, Sect Leader!”
Xie Wuyue’s face twitched at Zhuo Fan’s straight back. He was the picture of heroism, with not one submissive bone in his back, not even in front of the Sect Leader.
[This brat, casualness is fine, but doing it in broad daylight, you’re taunting my name!]
[Humph, you must’ve had an easy time ruling on the outside that not even the Labor Office could curb your tendencies.]
Xie Wuyue grumbled inside, but he did need Zhuo Fan at the end of the day so he overlooked his fallacies.
At Zhuo Fan’s declaration, everyone was stunned, even Venerable Shi and Grand Elder.
They eyed him with suspicion, looking for any clues.
[So he’s the one Sect Leader brought. Let’s see how great he really is…]
While the big shots had eyes only for Zhuo Fan, the five elite candidates watched Yue’er.
Yue Ling sensed the cold vibe coming from her baby sister and was left with a blank stare.
[How can she release such an icy aura? Just looking at her makes me shiver.]
[What did Zhuo Fan do these past months?]
Yue Ling was perplexed by Yue’er’s aura.
Kui Lang was dumbfounded as well, but unlike Yue Ling, what had him stumped was the lass’ growth, to the 9th layer of Profound Heaven Stage.
And that thick bloodthirst made even the great Black Yama feel threatened.
