Zhuo Fan’s pearly white smirk was chilling to the core.
Rip!
The sounds came from his surroundings as the wind blades found their target. They tore his clothes and were just a hair’s breadth from striking his body.
With Second Elder taking his focus, he had no time to spare the attacks any attention before they were upon him.
Second Elder’s death came as a great surprise for Seventh Elder; of joy.
He used this tactic to attack while the kid was busy with Second Elder so there’d be no way to cope with two sides coming at once. Yet the brat was so vicious he forwent the sneak attack and went to deal with Second Elder for good.
Though in this way left himself open for the soul wind blades. No matter how tough he was, it was bound to hurt him good.
[Second Elder, die knowing you helped me get revenge for you, he-he-he…]
A bit too soon to celebrate however, since Zhuo Fan was still alive. He wasn’t about to let the guy have his way, or the great steward would be ridiculed to no end.
Zhuo Fan spoke, “Blood blade.”
Hum!
The sharp wind blades and their sharp ringing stabbed him with pain, but then a red light came from his body and crushed the wind blades before they touched him.
It then sped straight for Seventh Elder with impunity.
[What the hell is that?]
The old man was startled by it and sent another wind blade.
Yet it just kept coming.
It entered his body and made him shiver as blood leaked from his mouth.
[This isn’t a soul form, just a Radiant Stage soul attack.]
He never knew such an insidious soul attack existed, so strong it matched his soul form.
[What kind of monster is this kid?]
Seventh Elder was wracked with fear. Zhuo Fan was an abomination shrouded in a thick fog of mystery.
Everything he got from Zhuo Fan till now only scratched the surface, and he bet it was all bait to lure the fools and conceited idiots.
Seventh Elder shook at the sight of Zhuo Fan and ran.
Second Elder got done in like nothing even in the 3rd layer of the Ethereal Stage. He stood no chance only in the 2nd layer.
Without any preamble, Seventh Elder threw away his dignity and bolted, all to save his life.
It always paid to live and die another day. He understood this saying the best, especially now, caring about nothing but fleeing.
Didn’t he just see Second Elder monologuing in his flight only to get cut short? Respect mattered, sure, but even that paled in favor of keeping one’s poor little life.
So he ran.
Though Zhuo Fan was even faster.
Whoosh!
Zhuo Fan was barring him in a flash, thanks to a nifty little golden halo in his eye.
“Ha-ha-ha, Seventh Elder, aren’t we fighting? Why are you running away?” Zhuo Fan grinned and struck his chest.
Seventh Elder put up a tough front, “Zhuo Fan, you dare kill an inner sect elder?”
“I got the sect’s rule on my side. Killing you is nothing, so take it like a man! Besides, I already killed one, so what’s one more?” Zhuo Fan sent another Ghostly Dragon Claw to splatter him on the ground.
Seventh Elder learned from Second Elder’s misfortune and knew resistance was futile, so he abandoned his vessel as the attack came. He used his meat suit as a shield to fly away unharmed in soul form…

chapters.title: Chapter 596: Pep Talk
chapters.content:
Chapter 596: Pep Talk
Bam!
While Seventh Elder was fleeing, he smacked into something out of the blue.
It was a bloody infant, though the creepy aura and the faded body made him shiver.
[What the hell is this?]
Seventh Elder sent dozens of blue wind blades in response.
A fierce whirlwind formed, one that could rip a soul apart, and it shot for the Blood Infant.
Blood Infant’s only reaction was contempt.
“Hi-hi-hi…”
With a burst of creepy laughter, Blood Infant glared back at the incoming attack.
Hum!
A sharp blood ripple shot forth and crushed the wind blades like they were nothing.
Seventh Elder’s blue soul shook.
[This is the thing that helped Zhuo Fan last time! But what is this thing? How precious must it be to unleash soul attacks? The kid has many tricks up his sleeve.]
Seventh Elder got nowhere in figuring it out as the Blood Infant charged for him.
Blood Infant was as fast as lightning, swallowing him under the shocked eyes of everyone.
He scrambled around Blood Infant’s stomach to get out, but each time he made the skin bulge, it would just return to normal.
Blood Infant was a spirit of this world and capable of unimaginable things. Seventh Elder was now in it, and even as a soul, he had no way out. It was just like a soul prison.
The audience was freaked out.
Some of these demonic cultivators reared their own demonic creatures, but they were all physical beings and unable to harm one’s soul.
But Zhuo Fan’s Blood Infant showed them how mystical demonic creatures could be and what gave him confidence.
It was like having an able partner all the time, with both him and the demonic creature unleashing deadly attacks.
This display earned everyone’s envy. [Just how many gadgets is this guy hiding? How is it he keeps taking out greater and greater things?]
[With a freak like him, the only thing he’d come with is freak demonic creatures…]
Whoosh!
Blood Infant flew back to Zhuo Fan, and like a good hunting dog, it spat out Seventh Elder’s soul before going into Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan grabbed the blue glow and snickered, “Run, run as fast as you can. That’s why I let my demonic creature out earlier, to intercept you. So, did you get far even after ditching your body?”
“Steward Zhuo, please let me go. I will never come at you again…”
“Ha-ha-ha, I’m sure you won’t.”
Seventh Elder was at his mercy, and he could do nothing but beg. Though not like it worked on Zhuo Fan.
At the kid’s killer smile, Seventh Elder resorted to threats, “Do this, and you’ll make an enemy of the inner sect!”
“Enemy? Humph, you’re sadly mistaken. It’s you who made an enemy of me!” He paraded the soul before the Labor Office’s people, “This is our turf and this old coot is threatening me with that? Tell me, are we pushovers?”
“No, no, no!”
Venerable Qi and Bai shouted, taken by the mood as all the resentment dripped off them.
The entire Labor Office roared with one purpose, one mind. This was their steward, Steward Zhuo of the Labor Office! A disciple with more testicular fortitude than anyone, killing elders and anyone in his path!
[This is a hero to follow!]
The oldies from the inner sect alternated from blue and green, about to flip against Zhuo Fan. But the sight of the entire Labor Office roaring had them threatened.
Zhuo Fan’s victory brought back the dignity and glory the Labor Office lost. Attacking now when morale was high was suicide.
To say nothing of the devious Zhuo Fan playing by the rules, or more like making sure the rules were on his side.
All they could do was walk away in silence, engulfed in the flood of shouts coming from the Labor Office.
The outer and inner disciples were stumped.
The Labor Office was like a dead fish just now, yet Steward Zhuo injected them with courage with just one win.
They watched Zhuo Fan in awe at how he flounced Seventh Elder’s soul around, a mocking smile on his lips. It was one image they wouldn’t soon forget.
Zhuo Fan faced the soul again, “Seventh Elder, what do you think, is the inner sect reliable? Ha-ha-ha, all of us are selfish. The Labor Office now has enough people to stand up to you all. None of them would stand up to fight for you either. Do you know why? They fear me.”
“Today I challenged you and killed you, and tomorrow I will go for them. I am just a laborer and the rules are on my side. Tell me something, do you think they’ll accept my challenge?”
Zhuo Fan’s smile turned sinister, “Ha-ha-ha, you two were fated to die to make a statement. Now those fools won’t be so jumpy. Inner sect elder is just an empty title, it won’t protect you at all. Once it loses its worth, you’ll be thrown away.”
The blue wisp shuddered and fell in abject despair.
Inner sect elders were respected, but that applied only when alive. They lost everything the instant they died.
At the end of it all, the only one reliable was yourself.
Unable to understand this simple truth, these two were sent to the slaughter. Not that anyone foresaw this apology banquet would turn bloody or that a fresh Radiant Stage laborer would kill them like lambs.
[Demon Transformation Art!]
At the downcast blue wisp, Zhuo Fan knew Seventh Elder had lost all motivation. Zhuo Fan enveloped the wisp in black energy and refined him.
It was then the prismatic heaven dragon in his mind opened its dazzling eyes.
By forming his soul, Zhuo Fan could use Demon Transformation Art on souls to increase his own.
It would speed up his cultivation a lot.
Easing a breath, Zhuo Fan watched his empty palm and revealed a grin. He turned to the Labor Office’s people, “Are you still down now?”
They all shook their heads, bearing excitement on their faces.
“Ha-ha-ha, you’re on my side. Your loss is my loss. And I am one who will get back at them for it.” Zhuo Fan nodded.
The people looked at Zhuo Fan with starry eyes.
“However…”
Zhuo Fan changed tunes, “You’re weak. You just got challenged once and look at you, crying all over like children. I’ve decided that all laborers shall do what a laborer does, sweep and clean. Don’t think about running, not even the ones from the Elite Labor Office. For god’s sake, you got too cocky after just a few days and forgot who you really are!”
“Eh?”
The disciples were startled, but their smiles still remained.
Venerable Bai’s group chuckled.
An expert should know when to retreat, lose, and win. They wouldn’t achieve anything losing their heart after one setback.
Especially now when some of them wanted to leave the Labor Office. It had to be removed and not let it fester.
Zhuo Fan had them learn humility and determination, to not break in the face of adversity. Though it only worked after Zhuo Fan’s pep talk.
No one would’ve listened to him before his win, not even the Elite Labor Office.
The venerables saw the inner and outer disciples watching the thrilled laborers and smiled.
[Zhuo Fan has great charm and is meant to do great things. He will become the next Sect Leader…]

chapters.title: Chapter 597: Worth
chapters.content:
Chapter 597: Worth
“What are you all staring at? You saw them ask for it even after I went to such lengths to apologize. I even had their well-being in mind when I challenged them to not get the sect’s punishment. How is it my fault they were too weak and died off? I’ve done it by the book and in an open manner, so glare elsewhere.”
Zhuo Fan noticed the stink eyes he got from the inner sect’s oldies and shouted, “Keep this up, and I’ll challenge you!”
Whoosh~
The threat worked like a charm, and all those malevolent glares lost their target.
They all saw what Zhuo Fan could do, and from the looks of it, he had it easy just now.
Zhuo Fan didn’t even get to take his soul out to play, giving them no way of guessing his limits.
The unknown held the greatest fear, especially when a soul showed its true power when it came out. So no one was about to mess with a freak that left two elders as nothing but smears on the ground.
Though it didn’t save them from resentment.
[So damn strong, yet only a freakin’ laborer is outrageous.]
One just had to look at him the wrong way, and he’d smash them dead. It was the least this law-abiding disciple could do to uphold the rules. Hey, that rule about challenging a superior holding no consequence for both parties shouldn’t be left gathering dust.
[There will be tough times ahead of us.] These oldies’ conflicts were all handled within reason. Now this freak showed up, and he was just a mere disciple whom no one wanted to do anything with.
It was a guillotine hanging over them, waiting to drop.
They sighed. It was the inner sect’s turn now to be humiliated, to be pissed on, and no way to be able to deal with it.
The Labor Office looked at them with scorn, and even the outer and inner disciples had contempt.
[The Labor Office is still the best by the looks of it. The inner sect is off its game.]
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan landed, and Kui Lang’s group came over with glee.
“Steward Zhuo, you’re so strong! You’re truly the best disciple in the sect to even swat Ethereal Stage experts like flies.” Kui Lang gave a thumbs up.
The others bobbed their heads.
Zhuo Fan dissed them with a smile, “First, cut the ass-kissing. I saw your long faces before. Did you actually think I’d apologize for their fault?”
Ugh!
They all sheepishly scratched their heads.
“Ha-ha-ha, Steward Zhuo, since you didn’t tell us…”
“You’d have let it slip!”
Zhuo Fan cut Kui Lang off, “This great scheme of mine was all psychological. To make those two take the bait, I had to unbalance them. It worked to allow challenging and weakening them easier. Consumed by anger, I bet they didn’t even give half of what they could do. You think it’s that easy to kill an elder once his soul is out? “
“Playing mind games is the best solution. The swift shift from glee to anger to grief did them in. Thanks to you, I had them reach the highlight of their happiness, setting the stage for me to come in and smack them down to earth and fall for my ploy. Demons come from the heart, always remember this.”
“Yes!” The four bowed.
Gui Hu was still frowning behind them, “Steward Zhuo, you should know why I’ve come to the Labor Office. Where am I to begin training my heart? It was first Chi Feng that told me I was weak because of my weak heart, then you come and tell me one grows weaker as their heart’s in chaos. How then…”
“I’ll tell you here and now, the heart isn’t trained, but tempered.” Zhuo Fan’s tone was serious.
Zhuo Fan saw his doubt, “The heart isn’t cultivation, using spiritual energy to train your soul and body. All its levels come from insight and experiences. Without experience, there will be only ignorance and no way to come to gain insight into the world. That is the meaning of enlightenment. The world is filled with people going through a wide range of experiences, which makes everyone’s hearts different.”
“Does that mean I’ll never be able to train it?” Gui Hu didn’t want to give up.,
Zhuo Fan pondered, “I’ll be honest with you. I never cared much for you, so never mention this little secret. You are the product of your environment, the same applies to your heart. Following wise people will give you insight, but how much depends on you. You should stick closer to Elder Yuan instead.”
“What could a Bone Tempering old coot possibly do?” Gui Hu was stumped.
Zhuo Fan’s finger moved left and right, “Ignorant fool, Elder Yuan is a man with a vast wealth of experiences. He is wise and thoughtful. Here I am going to him many times to debate the world’s meanings, and you’re just taking him for granted. Learn to appreciate things. Besides, do you really take him at face value? Humph, the only reason I’m kind enough to explain his worth is that you’re on our side and did so much for the Labor Office. “
Gui Hu tried to blink the confusion away without avail, though one thing he did get.
[The old man is more than he seems for even such a great talent to speak of him like that.]
“Senior brother Gui Hu, the old guy is quite nice. Go to him.” Kui Lang spoke.
Gui Hu asked, “How do you know?”
“Because nothing he says makes sense to me.”
Gui Hu’s face fell. [That makes him more of a wise guy than a wise man. How is that logical?]
Though Kui Lang made him exclaim, “Though Steward Zhuo can understand it, that’s why I think we’re far from the level of these two.”
Gui Hu gave a solemn nod.
Master told him Zhuo Fan’s heart was in high places, and since Elder Yuan came at his recommendation while Kui Lang bearing witness, the old guy ought to have some use.
[He might have something that can help me with my heart problem.]
Gui Hu ran for the Labor Office, “Steward Zhuo and everyone, see you later.”
The others chuckled, and Zhuo Fan laughed, “This guy’s so simple, quite like Elder Li. I knew ages ago he wasn’t cut out to be a spy, yet I still watched him all this time. Haaa~, I still have a long way to go to reach the fourth stage of human nature, or I’d have seen through his worth at a glance. I’ll need to get more experience under me, ha-ha-ha.”
“Don’t be modest. More experience? Any more and you’ll become a demon…”
Fiend Yang laughed, coming over with the other fiends. Gone was his grumbling hearing Zhuo Fan messed up the elite area and was now beaming with joy, “Sonny, you’re a tough one. Facing two elders alone and still killing them. Becoming an elite and joining the Double Dragon Gathering will definitely get us among the middle three sects. Your feats will become legends! “
Fiend Yang patted his shoulder, though Zhuo Fan’s face was cold, “Sorry, I don’t do well with being elite.”
“H-how can…” Fiend Yang was stumped, “What are you playing at? This fight alone sets your status in the sect. Now no one will object to you entering the elite area, yet you refuse? Isn’t this the whole reason why Wuyue brought you?”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Xie Wuyue had me over for Double Dragon Gathering, not to be an elite.”
“How else are you supposed to participate? The elite area’s sole purpose is to rear disciples for the Double Dragon Gathering.”
“Then you’ll just have to change the rules. The disciples going to Double Dragon Gathering will only be from the Elite Labor Office. None of the others will come from the elite area!” Zhuo Fan shouted his conviction.
Everyone was baffled by him.
Zhuo Fan scratched his nose, “When all is said and done, it was the elite area that taunted us, even if instigated. I’ve said that I’ll take back the Labor Office’s glory, and I will. First was the inner sect, and now all that’s left is the elite area. Didn’t you all say we’re not worthy of becoming elites? Fine then, to join the Double Dragon Gathering, you’ll just have to come to us and do menial tasks. Though it’s up to me to see if you’re worthy of being a laborer.”
“H-how can you say that? We didn’t say anything like that. Why should we pay the price for those two brats’ crimes? And aren’t they dead already?” Fiend Yang advised, “Zhuo Fan, your amazing talent has us on your side but learn when to back down.”
“I need to be tough since it concerns my disciples’ dignity.” Zhuo Fan said, “Tell Xie Wuyue, if he accepts, I’ll join Double Dragon Gathering. And if he refuses, I’ll just stay here as the laborers’ steward.”
The fiends’ faces fell while Kui Lang’s side was awed.
[He’s the best manager the Labor Office has ever seen.] Going as far as to talk back to the powers that be for them.
[That’s why those Four Scheming Demons follow him. It’s not just their interest in him, but his worth too.]

chapters.title: Chapter 598: Worth
chapters.content:
Chapter 598: Worth
The trio turned apprehensive, not wanting to accept Zhuo Fan’s request yet unable to refuse.
Zhuo Fan was an irrefutable participant in the Double Dragon Gathering. It was his worth, worth none of them could ever replace.
“Steward Zhuo, congratulations, this time the entire sect will hum with your name. I bet tomorrow will be busy for the Labor Office with its new recruits. Ha-ha-ha, even becoming elite will be a cinch. None of those inner sect oldies will make a peep.” Venerable Bai praised.
Venerable Qi said, “I bet there’s no one else like you in the nine sects to kill two Ethereal Stage elders as a disciple. You’ve topped them all. The disciples must be worshiping you by now, their role model. They’ll all want to get closer to you. We had to work hard to get those that left back so they wouldn’t offend you, he-he-he… “
The other oldies of the Labor Office nodded, all a smile.
Zhuo Fan gave a thin smile back, turning to the fiends, “As I said, I won’t enter the elite area. Though venerables sirs can do what they think about my conditions.”
Zhuo Fan grinned, spun on his heel, and walked away, not before flipping a nasty smirk back a few steps after, “By the way, your elite disciples are in a world of pain, you know. Shouldn’t you be hurrying back?”
“What?!”
They all cried out in shock, noticing Zhuo Fan’s gaze.
[Oh, shoot!] They forgot the kid burst into the elite area, and there was no way he’d take it easy on anyone.
Venerable Qi and Bai’s grandchildren were still there as well.
Everyone was anxious, “Steward Zhuo, were you that hard on them?”
The two were even more concerned than the fiends, but they also grew nervous at the prospects.
While no one liked those leeches, they were the strongest disciples of the sect meant to go to Double Dragon Gathering.
Zhuo Fan just shrugged, “Ha-ha-ha, lighten up. I’m not one to get rid of anyone I do not know, or I’d be making too many enemies for nothing. Though not too easy either, or they could’ve just gotten up and reported me…”
Whoosh~
Venerable Bai and Qi shot for the skies in panic, followed by other venerables and elders with kin in the elite area.
On the other hand, the fiends eased a breath the minute Zhuo Fan assured them they were still breathing.
Fiend Yang eyed Zhuo Fan, “We will consider your condition. The rules the sect has been built upon for thousands of years aren’t changed overnight. No matter how great a display you pull, some rules just won’t bend.”
“Ha-ha-ha, people make the rules. And they will change as long as the people want them to.”
Zhuo Fan threw a box with a snicker, “Venerable Fiend Yang, take this to Xie Wuyue with the words ‘a favor for a favor’. If he can’t do it, return it.”
Fiend Yang’s face twitched, “T-this is plain bribery.”
“Is it that bad?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, “With you at the top of the sect, you have priority in taking your pick from the pile of wealth. Who can ever bribe you? You finally have me, the magnate, here to get a little something at long last. If you don’t want it, then return the earlier demonic treasures as well. Take the Elite Labor Office as the enemy of the elite area. I don’t need peace.”
“Now wait a sec. These matters aren’t the same. You beat our disciples and apologized. That ends that.”
The fiends glanced at their storage ring and the trinkets they got and didn’t quite feel like giving them up, rethinking Zhuo Fan’s proposal and the demonic treasure within this new box.
It was part of Zhuo Fan and Xie Wuyue’s agreement to annex the elite area and make the Labor Office the only faction, though it didn’t come with outright acceptance from the three. When he fought the inner sect, they didn’t give a hoot no matter how many burned or how many fell since the cream of both parties would end up in the elite area.
Now Zhuo Fan wanted the elite area abolished, aiming for their bread and butter. No matter how much they cared for the sect’s future and liked Zhuo Fan as a talent, no one would be that happy to throw away their livelihood.
[We’re digging our own grave.]
[Should we just… take these treasures for ourselves and leave Wuyue to decide?]
The trio pondered a good while, then nodded with a sneaky smile.
They not only came out one treasure richer, but they also had a way out.
[We’re not as selfish as the inner sect to block the sect’s growth. We will leave it to Sect Leader to be fair and just in his ruling, to avoid despicable methods such as bribery.]
Zhuo Fan grinned, “Sugarcoat it with as many excuses you want, it’s still selfishness. You need but take this single step, and you’ll be falling in the inner sect’s footsteps. I held my end of the bargain, and it’s up to him to decide what to do with you when you stole his gift…”
The trio shuddered and faltered, covering the fear with anger, “Are you a mind reader?”
“Ha-ha-ha, of course not. All I see is your greedy eyes, oblivious to anything else.” Zhuo Fan added, “No gain satisfies a greedy mind. One wrong move and death awaits. It’s best you think this through, sirs. Ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan left with a laugh, the trio lost at what to do and looking from the box to themselves.
[Are we just going to give this to Xie Wuyue and dig our elite area’s grave?]
While they were at an impasse as to what to do, a mile out, Xie Wuyue saw everything.
“The kid just entered the Radiant Stage and already formed his soul, so strong too; an abomination. Since I last saw him in Tianyu a decade ago, he has become a new man in character and strength. But this will only make the Demon Scheming Sect’s rise come faster. He’s a true gem.”
Xie Wuyue was full of praise for him but scowled as he eyed the Three Fiends of Hell, “Don’t tell me the fools are going to take Zhuo Fan’s respectful gift for me for themselves. I even came over to see if the kid could handle the elders, lest everything would go to waste.”
[You better be damn sure you three bring me that gift, or else…]
Xie Wuyue squinted before leaving.
Venerable Bai’s gang stepped into the devastation around the elite area, and the disciples were strewn about.
Each of the oldies found their target and breathed easier the next second.
[They’re only hurt. If they died, with how savage Steward Zhuo is, the sect will run with blood.]
“Lian’er…”
“Changlong…”
“Grandpa, we’re here.”
As Bai and Qi called out, Bai Lian and Qi Changlong replied. The two went over and breathed easier too.
“Inner organs are shaken up and only sealed vessels. You’ll be back on your feet in a few days. The kid was truthful. He only killed Chi Feng and Yujuan.” Bai Lian hugged Bai Lian.
Venerable Qi nodded, “Old Bai, should we have these two go to him? He has to know his allies or the next time he flips…”
“With his glorious reputation now, making friends is the best thing for these children.” Venerable Bai’s eyes flashed.
Bai Lian asked, “Grandpa, you mean… that wild beast?”
The venerables nodded.
“Venerables sirs, he wrecked the elite area and breached the rules. You should uphold the sect’s laws and not let him off.”
Lu Xie was outraged, “Two elites are killed, and the three venerables won’t stand for it. Venerable Shi will surely make use of it and fight. Sirs will do well not to make the wrong choice…”
Venerable Bai laughed, “What a foolish disciple. What do you think the rules are for, to raise the strong! With enough worth and strength the sect itself will pave your way!”
“As for the three venerables, they must be grinning right about now from the demonic treasures they got from the kid. As for Venerable Shi… his two prized helpers, the second and seventh elders were challenged and killed by the kid; in plain sight too. There’s not even the chance of getting revenge. With the inner sect’s elders and venerables cowering, who will stir up more trouble?”
[No way?!]
Bai Lian, Lu Xie, and Qi Changlong gasped in disbelief.
Venerable Bai shook his head, “Disciples all the same yet so much above everyone else. He twisted the rules to his will, and there’s nothing you can do about it. His worth trumps anyone else’s. You better sit down if you know what’s good for you.”
The three were speechless…

chapters.title: Chapter 599: Pave the Way
chapters.content:
Chapter 599: Pave the Way
“Venerable Shi, this is horrible…”
Venerable Shi enjoyed some fine wine under a pavilion, a smile tracing his lips as his plans came to a head.
That was until the shout ruined his mood. Grand Elder scrambled over in a panic.
Venerable Shi dissed him, “Grand Elder, you’ve been through a lot at your age, yet a trifle riles you up?”
“Trifle?” Taken aback, Grand Elder asked, “You know, Venerable Shi?”
Venerable Shi grinned in pride, “I planned for it.”
Ugh!
Grand Elder stammered, [You had those two… go to their deaths?]
“Grand Elder, how can you still not understand?”
Venerable Shi raised an eyebrow at his dumbstruck face, “Think about it, the second and seventh elders went to make a mess of things in the Labor Office. I bet the place must be in turmoil right about now. But it’s all fine, with how loose they are, giving them some incentive will have most of them back with us. We’ll then use the excuse of disturbing the sect to crush the Elite Labor Office for good. Since they held the apology banquet, the chaos ensuing will be on them!”
Grand Elder nodded, “Oh, that’s what sir means.”
“Isn’t that why you’re here?” Venerable Shi sipped his wine.
Grand Elder scratched his nose, “These matters are different, yet surprisingly the same…”
“How come?”
The two elders did make a scene at the banquet per your orders…” Grand Elder began.
Venerable Shi nodded all naturally.
And Grand Elder softly continued, “Though… they ended up killed.”
Bang!
The wine cup slipped and scattered to pieces on the floor. Venerable Shi turned an incredulous eye to Grand Elder.
“G-Grand Elder, c-can you repeat that?”
“I said the two elders ended up getting killed at the banquet.”
Grand Elder’s repeated disillusioned Venerable Shi, “How? W-who had the gall… to do such a thing? No venerable has such a right!”
“A venerable would’ve been much better, at least would give us an excuse. But…” Grand Elder shook his head in sorrow, “The one to do the deed was a disciple, in plain sight too. He used the rules to challenge and kill them so that we can’t touch him.”
Venerable Shi trembled like a leaf, “A disciple? Who was it? Who can kill Ethereal Stage elders? Since when did our sect have such a disciple?”
“Who else but Zhuo Fan.” Grand Elder shrugged as he explained everything.
Venerable Shi slumped in his chair, “A bloody feast, it was premeditated, a trap all along. There’s no such thing as apologizing in advance. This was done with full intent of the crime!”
“In regards to this, Zhuo Fan planned on killing the two from the start. But he did it flawlessly.”
Grand Elder sighed, “He first went to challenge the elite area using the same rule that states in a duel between different statuses there are no repercussions. No matter how much damage he caused, it’ll be those three venerables dealing with it, not us. But Zhuo Fan soothed them as well. Then the kid challenged the elders and under the eyes of everyone, they died, all for nothing too. We can’t use this to get to him.”
Venerable Shi’s face sank in rage, “That devious punk played us. But that pales when he has the power to threaten us. He even killed two Ethereal Stage elders to prove it. This never happened in the history of the sect. It will make him the single most important figure in the sect. And with the Double Dragon Gathering on our doorstep, he’ll have the sect at his whim.”
“He is a great genius that might even get us in the middle three sects at the Double Dragon Gathering.” Grand Elder sighed.
Venerable Shi’s eyes glinted, “What’s the point if it’s not on our side? We’ll only suffer for it.”
“Then…” Grand Elder probed.
Dang~
The meeting bell answered for him and Grand Elder’s words were drawn out, “It’s the inner sect meeting. The Sect Leader must’ve called for it!”
“Who the hell else is there that would have the gall to mess with me and strike the bell?”
Venerable Shi felt more and more suffocated, “Xie Wuyue saw his dog got some awe under him and wants to promote the punk for it. He wants to send him to the elite area! “
“What do we do?” Grand Elder asked.
Venerable Shi sighed, “Nothing. By killing our two elders, he established his worth and might. Now even some elders and venerables from the inner sect see hope for the sect in him. The brat has earned great merit and advancement is imminent. All we can do is bide our time.”
Grand Elder’s brow shook.
Venerable Shi spat, “I know Xie Wuyue like the back of my hand. He’s uplifting Zhuo Fan for the Double Dragon Gathering. But once it passes, Zhuo Fan’s talent will threaten his status. We just have to wait for when they’ll be at odds and each other’s throat. While we will be laying low until they do…”
Grand Elder pondered and nodded with glinting eyes…
An hour later, in the grand hall, Xie Wuyue was on his throne bearing a majestic vibe, with the elders and venerables on either side of him.
Even Three Fiends of Hell were among them.
The sour Venerable Shi looked at Xie Wuyue’s wide grin, laughing in the end, “Something amazing happened today; the new replacing the old. A disciple challenged two inner sect elders, a testament to the promising new generations, to the Demon Scheming Sect’s great new future and glory.”
The oldies’ faces twitched on cue. [We just had two of our elders killed in cold blood, and you call that an achievement? It’s brazen humiliation, is what this is!]
While the Labor Office’s oldies were smugger than ever, joining in Sect Leader’s joy.
Xie Wuyue saw Venerable Shi was still brooding and continued, “Now all of you know of Zhuo Fan’s might, and I can assume there’ll be no objections in having him participate in Double Dragon Gathering, will there?”
“No!” The Labor Office’s side echoed and the inner sect remained silent, their eyes converging on Venerable Shi.
Yet Venerable Shi was like a stone.
“Zhuo Fan doesn’t want to be elite while requesting for the Double Dragon Gathering’s participants to be from the Labor Office. That is the only condition for joining the gathering.” Xie Wuyue eyed Venerable Shi in doubt.
The entire hall exploded with noise. The Labor Office’s side supported Zhuo Fan of course, while the inner sect was totally against it.
“Sect Leader, it’s against every rule!”
“Sect Leader, the brat is conceited and should rein him in instead of indulging him!”
“Sect Leader, the rules are clear and must be upheld!”
…
They all voiced their strong objections to this outrageous proposal.
“Enough!”
Venerable Shi sneered and the hall was silent.
Venerable Shi’s eyes flashed, “The rules have always been made to pave the way for the strong. Since it was Zhuo Fan’s request, I agree!”
[No way!]
Everyone was slack-jawed, Xie Wuyue included. [What is the old weasel up to this time…]

chapters.title: Chapter 600: Relocating
chapters.content:
Chapter 600: Relocating
Silent as the grave.
[Did Venerable Shi wake up on the wrong side of the bed today? Why is he on Zhuo Fan’s side?]
Allies and enemies alike were stunned, watching the old timer as a cow looked at a new gate.
“Have I said something wrong?” Venerable Shi smiled at the rest, “Only a blind man can’t see Zhuo Fan’s talent. He is the best chance our sect has in Double Dragon Gathering. We have to remove all obstacles for him to join it, including this quaint rule.”
Ugh!
The stunned silence persisted for a good while. Wuyue had to blink again and again to gain some semblance of reasoning back.
“Venerable Shi is quite right. I agree. The Double Dragon Gathering’s candidates shall be chosen from the Elite Labor Office, with Zhuo Fan in charge. The inner, outer, and elite areas are to cooperate!”
“Er, that is good and all, but we guide the elite area’s disciples for the Double Dragon Gathering. With how the candidates are chosen from the Elite Labor Office, do we still hold our posts?” Fiend Yang asked.
Having received Zhuo Fan’s good-natured gifts, they never opposed such a decision, and Xie Wuyue had planned for the kid to be the team leader from the start. All the more, since Zhuo Fan had such a wild reputation and everyone’s side. No matter what ruckus he stirred, it’d be swept under the rug. He even got the right to choose his teammates. All this old fiend could do was fall in line.
As long as there was no conflict of interest or principles, Xie Wuyue would be behind him all the way.
This was the power of bribes. Why else would a Sect Leader accommodate some guy by even changing the rules?
All rules were, at the end, made by the strong for the strong.
Xie Wuyue scratched his nose, “The kid can take you in, and it’ll be all the same. Having the three of you in the Labor Office where there are already so many more venerables won’t harm it.”
The trio shrugged. The day had come that these venerable coaches had to balk at the whims of a disciple.
It never happened in the history of the Demon Scheming Sect, not once.
While the inner sect’s oldies’ hearts jumped. No matter how godlike Zhuo Fan was, he was still a disciple. With such authority behind him, he could even affect the other oldies’ fate. That was a bitter pill to swallow.
Though a glance at Venerable Shi told them they had nothing to worry about and sighed in the end.
If their boss was silent, all they could do was follow.
The decision came to pass, and after ironing in some more details, the meeting came to a close.
“Ha-ha-ha, how times have changed. The lowest rung of a sect, a mere Labor Office, has now become its center, even above the elite area. Yet those rotten laborers are still sweeping the disciples’ and mine lodgings…”
“What’s so hard to accept? That side had sported a sudden monkey that even challenged the elite area. The entire sect sees him as the apple of their eye, even fonder than their ancestors. And all to regain the sect’s dignity and interests in Double Dragon Gathering. I reckon you’d be flaunting him by now if he was your disciple. When all is said and done, might makes right.”
…
The elders and venerables gossiped in groups of three or five, grumbling and complaining as they left the hall.
Left alone with Venerable Shi, Xie Wuyue turned a quizzical eye at the old man, “Did the world flip, Venerable Shi, to take my side?”
“Ha-ha-ha, Sect Leader, you jest. When have I ever gone against you? I only ever argue for the good of the sect. I hope Sect Leader is kind enough to overlook my past transgressions. Zhuo Fan is beyond anything anyone could expect, earning the public’s favor. I only hope he can take our sect higher.” Venerable Shi bowed.
Xie Wuyue eyed him with the complete skepticism his position came bearing.
Venerable Shi chuckled, “If that is all, Sect Leader, I shall take my leave.”
Xie Wuyue had never said anything all this time.
But the old man turned just as he was about to cross the door with a crafty smile, “Ha-ha-ha, Sect Leader, you were right about one thing. The new replaces the old. But his drive may be too strong. Today he has the sect change the rules for him, tomorrow, he’d have a certain someone’s chair…”
“What’s that supposed to mean?” Xie Wuyue roared.
Venerable Shi grinned, “Just the ramblings of an old man, Sect Leader.”
Venerable Shi left laughing with another bow, “With the new replacing the new, I wonder just how far it will go, how decrepit will the old become? Ha-ha-ha…”
“Damn geezer.”
.
Xie Wuyue spat, his knuckles white. The more he thought about it, the more he saw Zhuo Fan’s power within the sect taking root. His speed was too fast even for this Sect Master’s comfort…
The decision spread to the entire sect leaving inner and outer disciples dumbstruck.
The Elite Labor Office had only been a lure so far for a shift in power in the sect, yet its status was still in the lowest rung. The only reason disciples forwent its bad name was because of free stuff.
Yet it hadn’t been long since it formed, and it already stood above the elite area, holding the right to judge Double Dragon Gathering’s candidates.
It meant there was no getting into the Elite Labor Office without strength any longer.
Only the best of the best entered the elite area, but now that the Elite Labor Office had authority, the entrance would be all the harsher.
The chances were next to nothing.
The ever spectating inner and outer disciples were now hating their guts for the previous indecision of joining the Elite Labor Office.
It took just a couple of months for the lame Elite Labor Office to become all the rage.
While laborers grew cockier and more confident, especially when the three coaching venerables led a gaggle of elites to join Elite Labor Office after passing Zhuo Fan’s strict testing. if they were any more stuck up their heads would reach their ass.
It was they who used to resort to any means to get into the elite area.
But lo and behold how the tables had turned, with the elites’ turn to do the same thing.
And all of this came to be by the grace of one laborer, Steward Zhuo Fan, the manager of the Elite Labor Office.
His popularity spiked then and there, to the point of being worshiped. But while the Labor Office was enjoying the high life, the inner and outer disciples were down in the dumps.
All because of Zhuo Fan’s order. ‘Even elite laborers are to sweep the floors.’ The entire sect couldn’t afford to mess with him.
Bam!
A vase crumbled to pieces as it made intimate contact with the hard cold floor. Kui Lang picked up the broom and swept the remains while looking sullen at a corner, “Your vase.”
“That’s a high-class China worth a hefty sum!” The youth cried.
Kui Lang barked, “What’s a damn cultivator wasting spirit stones on these damn decorations? You’ve soured my mood, now get out and let me clean!”
“Oh no, no, no, senior brother Kui Lang, this is my fault. I could never have you…”
“Shut it. Steward Zhuo gave us a job, and we’re to sweep the sect clean. Are you trying to make me slack on the job and get punished? Scram!” Kui Lang glared.
The youth ran like the wind, though just outside the door, watching in anxiety and nervousness.
The room ended up eliciting a wondrous symphony of sounds, from the dullest to the sharpest.
In under fifteen minutes, Kui Lang strutted out with the broom in tow, “Now it’s spotless. I’ll leave the rest to you.”
“Thank you so much, senior brother.” The youth bowed and Kui Lang left with a puffed-up chest.
The youth went in to watch a horror show. The table was only good for tinder now, and the walls sported extra-large breathing holes.
[This is not sweeping, but demolition!]
Thinking about how he’d get his room ‘cleaned’ every day brought a dark cloud over his face. The guy was on the verge of tears.
[Is there no presentable laborer out there?]
Well, the good ones were sent to the oldies, while the best of the best, the elite laborers went to inner and outer disciples’ homes.
Having never done this, they tended to put too much oomph into it, resulting in this wonderful work of art yet unique every time.
Though the demolition men knew full well no inner and outer disciple would dare make a peek as they went to work. Since the Elite Labor Office was the cream of the crop in the sect, everyone was dying to join.
No matter how they grumbled, they couldn’t even fight back, not when it would only get them killed.
Laborers had the sect rules at their back yet the power of elites. It was so ridiculous that not even oldies messed around.
“I will definitely get in the Labor Office tomorrow!” The youth couldn’t take it anymore but then recalled his meager strength and sighed.
[With so many vying to get in, the Labor Office now holds a test to take in only the best…]

chapters.title: Chapter 601: Demon Soul Sect’s Visit
chapters.content:
Chapter 601: Demon Soul Sect’s Visit
The hazy rays of the morning sun shone upon a small little courtyard.
The imposing and immovable figure stood upright like a statue. The only change happening was his shadow, shrinking as the sun rose.
He had been standing there for seven days, unmoving and silent. His thick brutal aura kept anyone at bay, sending them shivering.
A faint tune wafted over as some small-time elder passed over.
The statue’s ears twitched, and his eyelid trembled, turning his head, “Ol’… Elder Yuan, you’re back!”
The statue wanted nothing else but to spew curses, but thought better of it, opting for a respectful reply.
Elder Yuan started, then grinned, skipping over, “Ha-ha-ha, sir Gui Hu, what would you need of me?”
“Er…”
Gui Hu frowned, lost for words. Zhuo Fan and Kui Lang did say this guy was more than it seemed, but he just couldn’t figure out how. The old man was just that, old and average. He had always been subservient and flattering like any other nobody and made it all the harder for the grand top inner sect disciple to bend a knee and ask for help.
Zhuo Fan’s words of respect for the old coot rang in his mind once again, and his discomfort faded. Throwing his little pride away meant nothing when Zhuo Fan got off his high horse to debate with this guy.
Gui Hu stammered at long last, “E-Elder Yuan, Steward Zhuo had sent me for advice in the way of the heart. Please enlighten me.”
Gui Hu flushed in an instant, dying of embarrassment for speaking like a three-year-old.
Elder Yuan raised an eyebrow, then smiled, “Ha-ha-ha, very well done to have overcome your hubris in talking to little old me. This act alone marks great progress in your near future. Being next to Zhuo Fan for so long does have its perks.”
[Eh, how come his mood changed?]
Gui Hu was dumbstruck, seeing the old Old Yuan losing his ingratiating air of a nobody and gaining an air of mystery.
His eyes were so deep that Gui Hu felt like he was sinking into a bottomless well.
[Who the hell is this guy? What’s with the Labor Office hiding so many freaks?]
Gui Hu’s heart jumped. Elder Yuan’s imposing aura left him feeling a majestic air that not even his master or Venerable Shi could unleash.
“Ha-ha-ha, Gui Hu, come, I shall impart to you the way of the world.” Elder Yuan smiled as he walked deeper into the Labor Office.
Gui Hu was right behind him.
Elder Yuan stopped before an ant mound, seeing those busy little critters carrying food.
He said, “How would you go about killing these ants?”
Gui Hu was baffled, “With a stomp, how else.”
“Ha-ha-ha, right you are. These little creatures can die just from that. Try it.” Elder Yuan held his beard with a vague smile.
Gui Hu did as he was told despite the increasing doubt about where this was going. When he lifted his foot, he saw tens of ants dead, but some crawled back up still, going about their way.
Elder Yuan shook his head, “See that? Someone slipped through. This is your current state, having power but no means to use it, making fighting even someone in the Radiant Stage like you a challenge. You’ve had your way in the inner sect all this time, not because you’re strong, but because there was no real expert around. You will see that Double Dragon Gathering will have only people with a firm heart, especially those from the middle and superior three sects. Being pushed, they’ll be sure to push back harder.”
Gui Hu was flustered, urging Elder Yuan, “W-what should I do?”
“We come back to the same question. How to kill the ants.”
Elder Yuan leaned over and picked an ant, “Your kick was casual because you took these ants for nothing. What if you were dying of hunger and these ants were the only thing around?”
“Er… Elder Yuan, I’m a Radiant Stage. I don’t get…” Gui Hu blinked.
Elder Yuan shook his head, “How thick-headed. I was only making an analogy. Or you can also take it as being a child and hungry. How would you have dealt with these ants?”
Gui Hu stared at the scurrying little bugs, and his eyes turned red.
“Yes, that’s right, you’ll eat them all, or you’ll die.” Elder Yuan nodded, releasing a bloodthirst so thick it left Gui Hu shivering, feeling icy water dumped over him.
He turned a dumbstruck look to Elder Yuan, putting that ant in his mouth and swallowing.
But the shocking bloodthirst continued, and doubt came then, [Who is this man?]
Elder Yuan held his beard with a smile, “See, even when dealing with an ant, you must give your all or starve. You must find your own reason to kill, or you’ll never give your all in killing anything. Heaven is cruel to all living things, yet also fair. Thus demonic and righteous paths coexist. The righteous love life and the demonic pursue slaughter. But killing must be done for life to give it meaning.
“Or slaughtering all in your path would end up consumed by it, erring from the right path. To pursue the path one must become demonic, that is the only way. Tell me, when you killed any disciple you came upon, was that your true strength? You do not even know what that even is. You’ve seen Zhuo Fan, his simple yet precise strikes, they all were meant to kill.”
Gui Hu shuddered and respect painted his always stern face for this old guy.
“Go, be a laborer like Zhuo Fan said and it will help your heart grow. Youth is arrogance, it is something every one of you has, and that goes double for talents. But the road is filled with twists and turns, and sometimes, it pays to show restraint. When you learn to do it like Zhuo Fan, you will have made progress. It will be of great help to you in future cultivation.” Elder Yuan said.
Gui Hu gave a deep bow and left.
His leaving was followed by a clap.
Clap~
“Ha-ha-ha, Elder Yuan’s words ring true and home as always. It’s the first time I heard you need to be demonic to thread the right path. I’ll have to analyze it further.”
Elder Yuan smiled then shook his head, “Steward Zhuo, now don’t make fun of these old bones. You’re much better at it than me.”
“How kind of you, Elder Yuan. I only wished to have a night chat with you. As Gui Hu waited seven days for you, so have I.”
“It happens to be a wait in vain. It’s best if you return.” Elder Yuan shook his head.
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, “What purpose does this serve?”
“That’s my line. When did you get on Demon Soul Sect’s bad side? They’re at our door and asking for you!” Elder Yuan shrugged.
Zhuo Fan said, “Third young master Han?”
“Him too, but someone else as well. His second brother, second young master Han is here to challenge the elite area. But that should be no problem to you.” Elder Yuan nodded.
Zhuo Fan mumbled, “He’s after my laborers?”
“What man would come to poke in your Labor Office’s affairs? Though Sect Leader had the Labor Office clean up the ring. It is your duty, but if you won’t go, it’ll have to be one of the elites.”
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes and cursed as he left, “Xie Wuyue is forcing my hand. They came for the elite area so why the hell are you dragging the Labor Office into this?”
“It’s not my fault, he’s the Sect Leader paying attention to the sect’s reputation. As the manager of the Labor Office, that’s something you don’t have to worry about.” Elder Yuan chuckled…

chapters.title: Chapter 602: Ghost-chasing Shadow
chapters.content:
Chapter 602: Ghost-chasing Shadow
Bam!
A youth got flung through the air in the great hall before hitting the ground with a crunch.
Xie Wuyue and the rest watched in cold silence while the disciples felt their legs shaking.
“You call this an elite, Demon Scheming Sect? They can’t take one hit.” The old man with black hair sat in the guest seat with a cold eye and a snicker.
The youth next to him bore the same condescending look, “Third brother, are you sure he was from the Demon Scheming Sect?”
“Beyond a shadow of a doubt, second brother. I heard those little shits even calling him Steward Zhuo.” A vicious youth in the center of the hall shouted, “Where the hell is that punk? Stop hiding like a coward and fight my second brother!”
Venerable Shi held his nose, “Elder Mo, you may be from a middle three sect, but that’s no reason to force yourself in. I told you once, and I’ll say it again. This is a sect, not a clan to have stewards. Why don’t you pick from our extensive range of elders and venerables?”
“We came here for my disciple’s spar and to promote our sects’ friendship. How is that possible between elders? Some will take it as an act of war instead.”
All the elders and venerables there turned glum, with Xie Wuyue giving him a withering gaze.
The Demon Soul Sect might have status over them, but they were one of Tianyu’s three guardian sects.
[Not some thug they can intimidate.]
Xie Wuyue barked at the trembling disciples, “What are you standing around for and get in already! You’re elites for crying out loud. Act like it! Lose, and it’s your life on the line!”
The disciples felt like crying.
Oh, the humanity! What elites when the Labor Office stole all the good ones?
[We got nothing to fight Demon Soul Sect’s third young master with!]
With how Third Young Master Han wiped the floor with them, there was no way even if they took turns they could beat second young master Han.
Third Young Master Han sported a mocking smile, “So these are the peak talents Demon Scheming Sect has to offer. No wonder you were so lame in the last Double Dragon Gathering. I alone might even win it the next time around, ha-ha-ha…”
Xie Wuyue’s anger reached a boiling point. Last Double Dragon Gathering was the greatest pain for him, and now a damn punk was picking his scars.
Elder Mo and Second Young Master Han only sneered.
“You think you got what it takes to challenge the whole elite area?” Three people in rough clothes and holding a broom walked in.
Qi Changlong was in front, with Bai Lian and Lu Xie at his sides.
They were the best of the elite area, yet had to do menial tasks all the same after turning to the Elite Labor Office. That included the work attire and tools.
Third Young Master Han turned a skeptical eye over, finding them to be nothing more than a sect’s nobodies that butted in his affairs.
What was odd was how the elite area’s other disciples here relaxed at their coming.
“Senior brother Qi, you’re here. Any later and we’d be goners.”
“Yeah, they’re just too savage, always going for the kill.”
…
The elite area’s disciples complained in anger and fear. Qi Changlong grew enraged, while the third young master Han was dumbstruck.
[The hell? Why are young masters pleading with beggars for help? What is Demon Scheming Sect playing at?]
A single look at the slumped junior brother had Qi Changlong grasp the situation. The opponent was tough to even dispatch a 6th layer Radiant Stage expert in one blow.
He turned to Third Young Master Han and found him in the 8th layer and shouted, “I’ve long since wanted to meet you, Third Young Master Han, if you would.”
Hu~
Third Young Master Han squinted and said, “9th layer Radiant Stage? What is your name?”
“Labor Office’s Qi Changlong!” He snorted.
Third Young Master Han turned to Elder Mo.
[Laborer?]
[Since when do laborers achieve such cultivation? Demon Scheming Sect has no respect for talent to throw him into labor.]
But noticing the other two were of the same cultivation, he fell silent.
[Is that why the Demon Scheming Sect always came last, because it ruins its talents?]
Not that he cared. Since they came to die, he was most accommodating.
Third Young Master Han snickered, “9th layer Radiant Stage, this should be fun. Not that having one layer over me will be any damn good!”
“You’ll see soon enough!”
Qi Changlong attacked. Third Young Master Han replied with a palm strike.
Bam!
The two palms met, and Third Young Master Han trembled in his spot. Qi Changlong had to stagger ten feet back.
[How could this be?]
Qi Changlong was incredulous. [How am I the weaker one when I’m above him in cultivation?]
Third Young Master Han mocked, “Ha-ha-ha, oh, I saw alright. While a layer above me, your meridians are smaller than mine, all because of treatment. Do you have any idea how many pills I had to eat? And I started small too. How about you, did you get any even? This is the gap between our sect. And with the coming of Double Dragon Gathering, we’ll only get farther ahead. There’s no way a lower three sect will ever topple a middle three sect.”
All of the Demon Scheming Sect trembled in rage.
Third Young Master Han saw the hard and stubborn faces of the trio and grinned, “Don’t believe me? Then come at me, all of you. That should bring you down to earth!”
“You asked for it, so don’t come crying when you lose!” Qi Changlong knew he was the weaker one from that exchange and agreed.
Third Young Master Han snickered, “You three aren’t enough, even for a warm-up.”
“Bastard!”
Qi Changlong snapped, and the trio shot for him.
They exploded with power and unleashed devastating attacks that made all other elites hopeful.
[There’s no way Third Young Master Han can take the combined attack of all of them.]
Second Young Master Han and Elder Mo were calm as ever. Third Young Master Han even smirked.
“Fetid Flood!”
“Meteor Shower!”
“Earth Shatter!”
Green, white and yellow shone ever brighter, combining and bearing down on Third Young Master Han. His reply was to shimmer black and make a sign.
“Quasi-earth-ranked martial art, Ghost-chasing Shadow!”
Eerie black figures loomed around Third Young Master Han, wailing and shrieking as they lunged for the trio’s attack.
Pff!
The three were sent flying, yet the shadows pressed the advantage, grabbing their heads.
It was their turn to howl in pain from the agony. Third Young Master Han grinned in pride.
“He wants to crush their souls!” Venerable Bai cried out in worry.
Venerable Qi was the same.
Elder Mo saw them and chuckled in a most annoying way, “Should elders and venerable be interfering in a disciple’s fight? Or does the Demon Scheming Sect not understand this most basic rule?”
“Sect Leader…”
The two venerables pleaded to Xie Wuyue with their eyes, but he was silent. He took the sect’s reputation above anyone’s fate, even the disciples’.
The venerables were in pain seeing their kin about to lose their souls. Their nails cut into their palms and drew blood.
The more demonic the sect, the more strict the rules. Any violation would be met with swift demise. No one would save their kin now, not when both choices meant death all the same…

chapters.title: Chapter 603: Encroachment
chapters.content:
Chapter 603: Encroachment
Hu~
A strong wind blew just then, scattering the shadows from creeping any deeper into the three’s souls.
And it kept going still.
Forcing Third Young Master Han on the defensive.
Boom!
The crushing force pushed him dozens of meters back, leaving cracked tiles in his wake.
When he did stop, his feet were knee-deep in the floor.
“Who did that?” Third Young Master Han broke into a cold sweat, lowering his trembling arms to see.
Second Young Master Han and Elder Mo frowned, their gazes fixed on the thin youth coming in bearing a cold face and a broom.
And by the feel of him, he was just a fresh Radiant Stage disciple.
Third Young Master Han was in shock, turning to his brother, “S-Second Brother, that’s him!”
“You got nerve kid, coming here again. Was last time not enough for you?”
Zhuo Fan spared him a single glance before tending the trio, “You aren’t dead yet, now scram. A laborer’s only job is to sweep, not be a pain in the ass seeking the limelight. What’s their challenge on the elite area got to do with us?”
Zhuo Fan had no restraint, but at least the trio was saved.
They rubbed their aching heads and gave Zhuo Fan a nod and a look of dread to Third Young Master Han before leaving without complaint.
They knew all too well they were just too weak, even in a three-on-one exchange.
Venerable Qi and Bai breathed easier.
Zhuo Fan spun on his heel and was already walking away.
“You think you can just come in here and leave after interfering?”
“And who are you, an elder or venerable of the Demon Scheming Sect?” Zhuo Fan threw over his shoulder at the youth resembling Third Young Master Han.
Second Young Master Han mocked, “I am Demon Soul Sect’s Second Young Master Han. I heard the Demon Scheming Sect had a presentable disciple and came to be enlightened. May I be honored to know your name?”
“Demon Scheming Sect’s Labor Office’s honcho, Zhuo Fan. But everyone calls me Steward Zhuo.”
Swishing the broom, Zhuo Fan scoffed, “Since you’re no elder of mine, I don’t have time to waste on you. I got work to do, bye.”
“Hold it right there. Is this how you treat an honored guest?” Second Young Master Han shouted again at the gross lack of disrespect.
Zhuo Fan’s mouth worked as he walked, “An honored guest needs honored elders and venerables to look after. What are you doing, going after this little old laborer for? We’re here to sweep the floors, not tend to guests. It’s not in our job description.”
“Sect Leader Xie, didn’t you say I can challenge anyone in the sect?” Second Young Master Han turned to Xie Wuyue seeing he was talking to a wall.
Xie Wuyue gave a mocking nod, “As long as you want to, second young master.”
“Oh, I will!”
With red eyes and a sneer, Second Young Master Han jumped, ready to strike with his two fingers, “Zhuo Fan, let’s see you get away now, pseudo earth ranked martial art, Underworld Blade!”
Whoosh!
An eerie energy shot from those fingers for Zhuo Fan’s head. The air shimmered as it passed, releasing creepy howls and sucking the warmth out of the hall.
Venerable Shi cried, “Demon Soul Sect’s patron art, the mystical soul art, Underworld Blade!”
“I hear low Ethereal Stage experts will die all the same from a peak Radiant Stage cultivator using this art. It’s an art focused on killing.”
Xie Wuyue frowned and sighed, “The Han clan’s three young masters are all true talents. A shame the second one had to meet such a monster.”
All the oldies snickered alongside.
Elder Mo had full confidence in Second Young Master Han. But soon found the Demon Scheming Sect’s higher-ups were sporting grins.
[You’re telling me an attack to kill an Ethereal Stage expert isn’t enough to crush a Radiant Stage cultivator?]
Not like anyone told him Zhuo Fan just a few days back killed two elders like nothing.
Second Young Master Han could only kill early ones too, making the whole of Demon Scheming Sect’s echelon find him sorely lacking.
As the blade came for Zhuo Fan’s head, he brushed with his broom behind him.
Roar!
The draconic roar crushed the blade like a hammer smashing a needle and then went for Second Young Master Han himself.
The young master got flung way up high and left a trail of blood in his wake.
Though he gnashed his teeth to bear through the pain as his body shook all over.
“Second young master…” Elder Mo started. Second Young Master Han signaled him back, watching the smug sweeper with shock and fear.
Third Young Master Han got his trembling feet under him and sported the same look of dread as his brother.
[Is he even human? How can a fresh Radiant Stage cultivator take down Second Brother in a single strike?]
[Body strength aside, is his soul that freakish too?]
[How are we supposed to compete with such perfection?]
The added mockery of Zhuo Fan only amplified the fear.
Zhuo Fan snickered, “Now the hall is clean. Don’t make it dirty.”
Second Young Master Han was outraged, but he was choking on blood and couldn’t retort.
Zhuo Fan sported the same condescending smile as he left with a snort.
Xie Wuyue was overjoyed, never had he been made to look so good, “Elder Mo, sorry, he’s just too rude. That’s why I left him in the Labor Office. I hope you can forgive the offense.”
“Oh, so Sect Leader Xie is in the hobby of demoting strong disciples.” Elder Mo snorted, “Are you going to have them join the Double Dragon Gathering?”
“What do you think?” Xie Wuyue smirked.
Elder Mo nodded with a small bow, “Then we shall disturb you no further and we’ll meet again at Double Dragon Gathering. Farewell.”
“Farewell.” Xie Wuyue showed him the door.
Elder Mo flicked his sleeve and took his disciples. The oldies cracked up when they were gone.
“Ha-ha-ha, look at them. They’re in the middle three sects yet never saw them so wretched.”
“Don’t get too happy. They’re still no pushovers.”
Xie Wuyue sneered, “They came to probe us. Zhuo Fan must’ve messed with Third Young Master Han and they came to assess the threat. They just accomplished their objective.”
“Won’t that mean we’re exposed?” Venerable Bai frowned.
Xie Wuyue waved his hand, “Such a flimsy cover wouldn’t have lasted anyway. It’s best to reveal it spectacularly like today. To tell them my sect aims for a middle three sect position!”
“Brilliant, Sect Leader!” The elders bowed.
A disciple burst in shouting, “Beast Taming Sect’s elders and disciples request an audience!”
“Beast Taming Sect now?” The elders looked baffled, “What is with today, sect encroachment?”
Xie Wuyue mocked, “Just another scouting party. Last time we took three of their elders in Tianyu, so they want to do us in at the Double Dragon Gathering.”
“What’s there to fear of another lower three sect like us?”
One elder cursed, “Just sic Zhuo Fan on them and that’s that. “
“Fool!” Xie Wuyue showed a nasty smile, “We need to show off to the middle three sects so that they don’t kick us around, but for the lower three sects, the secret weapon, Zhuo Fan, is not to be divulged. They’ll bite more than they can chew when he shows himself in the Double Dragon Gathering.”
They all exclaimed and admired him, [Brilliant!]

chapters.title: Chapter 604: Target, Middle Three Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 604: Target, Middle Three Sect
Bam!
A figure in fine clothes and bright colors got flung out of the hall with a bang, again. Blood flowed, and the body banged up and rolled three times on the ground, yes, but he was still alive at least.
What faced him was a buffed man in gray robes with a snickering look sent at the rest of the disciples around, “Is Demon Scheming Sect’s elite area that shorthanded to have only your wastes?”
The disciples watched the 8th layer Radiant Stage thug with anger. But the sight of Sect Leader’s cold face had them bury it deep.
[For crying out loud. The elite area isn’t shorthanded, it’s that damn Labor Office taking everyone good from us. First was Third Young Master Han and now this cocky bastard. ]
[The only reason you’re still standing is because the Sect Leader doesn’t let us get Zhuo Fan, or even Qi Changlong could waste you, you pompous prick!]
Regardless of their thoughts, Xie Wuyue’s glare let them know not to do that.
A grizzled old man looked smug, “Sect Leader Xie, I hear the elite area has many fine geniuses. How come I don’t see them?”
“Elder Lu is too kind. What you see here is all my sect has in terms of elites for your disciple to spar with. Are you not satisfied?” Xie Wuyue faked anger.
The old guy admitted, “Sure you’re not hiding some?”
“My great sect has nothing to hide. Or is Elder Lu doubting my words?” Xie Wuyue slammed the table.
The elder’s eyes darted to and fro then nodded, “Ha-ha-ha, with Sect Leader Xie’s prestige, such a lie is beneath you. I of course believe you.”
Xie Wuyue spoke with a dark face.
“Then I shall no longer disturb you. Please forgive my presumptuous tone.” Elder Lu eyed Xie Wuyue one last time as he bowed and left.
He said to the thug on his way, “Hui Xiong, let’s go. We best not overstay our welcome. Thank you, Sect Leader Xie, for accommodating us and the sparring.”
“Thank you Sect Leader Xie for reading these punching bags. While useless, they did get me worked up. You’ve been far too kind.”
Hui Xiong cupped his hand with a snicker.
Xie Wuyue’s face was ghastly though no word slipped. Elder Lu grinned, throwing more biting remarks, “Hui Xiong, that’s no way to treat Sect Leader Xie. You can’t be so blunt about it no matter how true it is. They are going to fight in the Double Dragon Gathering and hold some flimsy hope still… “
“Good. Bye!”
Having enough theatrics for one day, Xie Wuyue shouted.
Elder Lu waved dismissively as he left with his grinning disciple.
They just cut the corner and Xie Wuyue in the hall showed a devious grin, “A bunch of ignorant fools, we’ll see who laughs last at the Double Dragon Gathering. “
The oldies joined him in rambunctious laughter. They were dying to see Zhuo Fan wiping that ridiculous grin off their faces, preferably with blood. That got them giddy.
“Ha~, ha~…”
A mile off Demon Scheming Sect, second young master Han spat blood again, his face blanching.
“Second brother, I told you we should’ve asked big brother, but you just wanted to show off. Now, look at what became of you. Both of us suffered from the same prick!” Third Young Master Han lamented his brother’s fate.
Second young master Han glared, “Quit it. How was I supposed to know that a nobody lower three sect would have such a sicko?”
“Based on his strength, no one in the Radiant Stage can take him on. Our only hope against him lies with the eldest young master in the Ethereal Stage. “
Elder Mo’s eyes flashed, “At least we made some use of this time, probing Demon Scheming Sect. It’s definitely aiming for middle three sect status. We have to keep our own position at all costs, come what may.”
The Han brothers nodded.
Two figures walked over, “He-he-he, master, now we can rest easy. The Demon Scheming Sect has nothing but punching bags. I’ll run through them in the Double Dragon Gathering to pay them back for the humiliation in Tianyu. I’ll make them stay in the lower three sects forever, ha-ha-ha…”
[What brash talk! We, Demon Soul Sect, are stressed out from that freak and you want to run him through? What are you a superior three sect?]
The Han brothers turned glum and Elder Mo flashed before the two figures piqued.
“Who’s there?”
Elder Lu and Hui Xiong jerked back, startled at the figure’s eerie vibe, “A-a demonic cultivator?”
“I come from Demon Soul Sect.”
Elder Mo nodded, “Who are you, and did you come from the Demon Scheming Sect?”
Elder Lu rushed to reply, “I am but an elder in the Beast Taming Sect. Here is Hui Xiong. As you said, we come from the Demon Scheming Sect.”
“Why did you go there?”
“Elder, I took my disciple to spar.”
“Spar?” Elder Mo sized Hui Xiong up and found him only in the 8th layer Radiant Stage, period; nothing else special. “Did it go that… easy?”
Master and disciple shared a most egotistical grin if the elder ever saw one. Hui Xiong even puffed up his chest in absolute pride, “Demon Scheming Sect is nothing. In less than ten moves, I wiped the floor with them. The Demon Scheming Sect is not worth the trouble in the Double Dragon Gathering. Our real opponent is Mystical Heaven Sect.”
“Everyone? In ten moves? You?” Second young master Han glared. [I ended up sucking pavement from one hit and you think you can take that guy on?]
Third Young Master Han was puzzled. [Is this guy an even freakier monster?] and asked, “Which disciples did you defeat?”
“The strongest, the elites!” Hui Xiong stuck out his chest harder, if possible.
The Han brothers found one profound truth in his words, “Did you meet any laborer?”
“Laborer? Whatever for? What do the lowest of the low have to match my greatness?” Hui Xiong snorted.
The trio shared a knowing smile. [They’re the fools alright.]
“Uh, what’s wrong?” Elder Lu bowed.
Elder Mo deflected, “Nothing at all. Just thinking how such a genius from the Beast Taming Sect dealt with all elites from the Demon Scheming Sect, you truly are worthy of becoming the best among the lower three sects in the Double Dragon Gathering.”
“Naturally. Among the lower three sects, we are the best!” Hui Xiong hit his chest, feeling more pride swelling in his bloated head.
Elder Mo’s side laughed harder.
Hui Xiong took it as if they were laughing with him. While Elder Lu found it off, [Why does it sound condescending?]
Elder Mo gave a wave and they left, leaving the other elder stumped with his disciple.
Third Young Master Han mocked, “Those two are the biggest idiots I’ve ever seen. The Demon Scheming Sect left nothing out. They will suffer the most in the Double Dragon Gathering.”
“Xie Wuyue played them like a fiddle. No one will ever expect the strongest disciple of the Demon Scheming Sect to be coming from their lowest rung. The only reason we didn’t fall for it as well is because of forcing them to call Zhuo Fan over. The more reserved Xie Wuyue is, the more it shows his great ambition for the Double Dragon Gathering.”
Elder Mo scratched his beard in thought.
The Han brothers nodded.
The Demon Scheming Sect’s aim was clear, the middle three sect position. And the one to fall would be the lowest in the middle three sects…

chapters.title: Chapter 605: Double Dragon Gathering
chapters.content:
Chapter 605: Double Dragon Gathering
Hu~
In a quaint room, Zhuo Fan sat on his stone bed with his eyes closed and a raging azure flame on his forehead. Deep in his mind, a prismatic dragon with the same azure flame on its forehead rested with its eyes closed. Its majestic figure brimming with more power with every flicker of the flame.
Hum~
Zhuo Fan flashed his eyes open and shook all over as his aura exploded.
The dragon soul did the same and roared, the azure flame covering it and turning the dragon into a flaming dragon, spreading the flames in every corner of his mind.
Roar!
Zhuo Fan howled at the heavens for a full fifteen minutes.
Zhuo Fan took a deep breath and took a feel of his boosted power. Three months was all it took to reach the 2nd layer.
[Training the soul with azure flame is way faster than any cultivation method out there.]
And with azure flame and dragon soul combined, his soul achieved perfection, making his soul attacks even deadlier.
“Steward Zhuo, may these old bones come in?” An aged voice had Zhuo Fan quick an eyebrow, “Venerable Bai, please.”
A flick of the hand had the array torn down, and with a point, the crude wooden door opened.
Venerable Bai smiled, and his eyes brightened at his advance with a cup of his hands, “Ha-ha-ha, congratulations, Steward Zhuo. Oh my, you’re moving up in the world in just three months. Steward Zhuo is a true gem in this cultivation world. So many so-called geniuses would be dying of envy.”
“You’re too kind, Venerable Bai. I’m just putting in a little bit more effort than the rest. I always tell these youngsters my success came from slow and steady progress, devoted day and night to one goal. But all they want are my pills. Such feisty children.” Zhuo Fan shook his head.
Venerable Bai’s cheek twitched at his touch of the dramatic.
[Good frickin’ actor!]
[The world is saturated with those going at it harder than you but do you see any other freak around? While having talent is innate, it gives you no right dangling before others.]
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Venerable Bai, to what do I owe this visit? Why aren’t you speaking?”
[Why do you think so?]
Venerable Bai shook his head, “Steward Zhuo, Sect Leader and the three coaching venerables have asked for you. But with you being in seclusion, they haven’t disturbed you. Judging from the sound the array gave, they figured you advanced and sent word.”
“Oh, thank you for waiting for me, Venerable Bai.” Zhuo Fan bowed most respectfully.
Venerable Bai smiled, “It’s my duty.”
“Why does Sect Leader need me?”
“Well…” Venerable Bai gathered his thoughts, “Sect Leader and the coaching venerables are asking, so it must be related to Double Dragon Gathering.”
Zhuo Fan nodded. Xie Wuyue treated the event with such importance he never told him anything.
[For him to ask about my situation, he must be ready to set off.]
Zhuo Fan squinted.
Leaving Venerable Bai, Zhuo Fan went for the hall to find Xie Wuyue and the fiends waiting.
Xie Wuyue smiled, “Finally showed up?”
“What can I say? I needed a few days to enter the 2nd layer of the Radiant Stage.” Zhuo Fan shrugged.
Xie Wuyue nodded, “I know that. Venerable Bai told me. Why else do you think you’re not punished for denying my summons.”
Zhuo Fan remained silent, taking a random seat.
Xie Wuyue’s face sank, [The prick still has no respect after all this time, not even for me.]
[Let’s calm down, he still has his uses…]
Xie Wuyue gnashed his teeth.
Fiend Yang laughed, “Zhuo Fan, you’re advancing so fast, a true talent. We aren’t ones to nitpick slights from such geniuses. Rules are made for the strong, after all, right Wuyue?”
“You’re one to talk, having the same attitude decades ago. I thought I told you it’s Sect Leader!” Xie Wuyue glared.
Fiend Yang chuckled.
Xie Wuyue went down to business, “Zhuo Fan, Double Dragon Gathering is just around the corner, and there are some things you should know about it.”
[Figured as much…]
Zhuo Fan nodded.
Fiend Yang continued, “Zhuo Fan, to talk about Double Dragon Gathering we need to start with the world’s situation. Have you ever heard of a sacred spirit stone mine?”
[I have one on my finger.]
However, he was curious how the mortal domain even heard of a sacred mine. But to avoid suspicion, “What is that?”
“Ha-ha-ha, coming from a backward place like Tianyu, of course you’d not know.” The four chuckled, with Fiend Yang explaining, “Sacred spirit stone mine is the place where an even greater spiritual energy gathers, greater than any spirit stone can hold. The mining is harsh but it has great applications in arrays, soon making it the target of every sect and empire on these lands. And this world has five!”
“You’re serious?”
Zhuo Fan gasped.
Sacred spirit mines made sacred stones, a rarity even in the Sacred Domain such that every grand clan monopolized them to the point not even a Demonic Emperor like him could get one.
Yet here he was, in the mortal domain with five of them. [Wonder if the clans there would be invading it en masse at the news.]
Though it got him thinking from another angle. For the land to give birth to sacred mines, it had to have thick spiritual energy. Why was the mortal domain’s so thin instead?
While the four had an even greater reaction to his reaction. [Didn’t he just say he doesn’t know? Why so jumpy?]
Zhuo Fan gave a strained laugh, “For the sacred spirit mine to be so precious it must be quite rare. Yet there are five of them? One can hardly be divided while five makes it even easier…”
The latest_epi_sodes are on_the ʟɪʙʀᴇᴀᴅ.ᴄᴏᴍ. website.
“Zhuo Fan, you’re no fool. You call five mines for the entire world many?” Zhuo Fan eyed him, “Plus, sacred spirit mines are in a different class from common spirit mines. A spirit mine assists one’s cultivation and even without it, a cultivator can just take the spiritual energy from the air. He can go anywhere with a bit of talent. While a sacred spirit mine assists your cultivation ‘and’ improves your constitution. It’s the best ingredient to grow experts. That’s what makes it invaluable. Why else do you think middle three sects and superior three sects are so powerful?”
Zhuo Fan turned solemn, “They use sacred stones for cultivation?”
“Right you are. This is the basis behind Double Dragon Gathering.”
Fiend Yang nodded, “The five mines are split between eastern lands, western lands, southern lands, northern lands, and central area. To defend their sacred mine, each area’s power formed a union. We belong to the Ten Sect Alliance of the western lands, with Double Dragon Manor as our head. While it might be like a sect, it is not, because it has no disciples. It is more of a group formed of strong people, our strongest force in western lands. They guard the mine against any invaders.”
“To raise the power of western lands, Double Dragon Gathering holds a Double Dragon Gathering every three centuries, selecting the best seeds to groom in the Double Dragon Gathering.”
Xie Wuyue picked up, “However, they do not take these disciples for themselves, returning them after a decade or two. But even a decade under their teachings and sacred stone cultivation will earn one more progress than simple cultivating for centuries. It will be of great benefit for the future. While the chosen disciple’s sect will be greatly rewarded as well.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes jumped. [The sole purpose of Double Dragon Gathering is to protect western lands, to prepare for war.]
While the nine sects, to raise themselves, participated in it, wishing their disciples were chosen, raised for free into experts, while also earning a big profit for themselves.
[That explains their almost fanatic desire for growth.] No one knew more about sacred stones than him. Take a plain ol’ Spiritual Gathering Array and supply it with sacred stone and you’d have a sect with the same environment as those in the Sacred Domain; to raise dozens of talents.
Who could possibly resist the allure, certainly no man, and without a doubt no sect…

chapters.title: Chapter 606: Set Off
chapters.content:
Chapter 606: Set Off
“If it’s just to raise experts, why aren’t the sacred mines divided among the sects and give everyone a share?”Zhuo Fan asked, “Won’t it make defending western lands easier?”
The four had bitter smiles, with Fiend Yang sighing, “I wish it were that easy. The mines are oddities of nature to such a degree that it makes mining them hard and slow, and that is only at the fringe. Not even the strongest man in these lands can pierce that tough wall. It forces us to wait for a few centuries before we can mine just a bit of it.”
[Someone planted it!]
