Ye Lin bore a mystical smile, “This is too soon for you to bother with. They’re the ten ancient emperors, though you’ve never heard of them, I’m sure. Ha-ha-ha, it’s fine, since all you focus on is the strength in the now. The ones pursuing the end of the path are me and him!”
Ye Lin’s eyes flashed as he watched Zhuo Fan, “Yes, him. Of the entire continent, just the two of us know of that place and are working towards it…”
Startled, Yan Mo and Wu Qingqiu paused, not understanding anything he said. All they could feel was how far away the two were from them…
Meanwhile, Exalted Double Dragons found the oddity around the formation as well, placing another name right under Zhuo Fan’s, Chu Qingcheng.
“Bai Mei, the lass has no water element, but the legendary Empty Spirit Body.” Exalted Hei Ran was grave.
Exalted Bai Mei nodded, “The Empty Spirit Body, a container of everything. There is no way otherwise for the formation to unleash such natural energy. In other words, the reason for the formation’s power surpassing the elements’ is all due to her. I am amazed the Mystical Heaven Sect found her.”
“Chu Qingcheng is a true rarity, but so are the other three. Since the formation needs all of them, we will accept them all.” Exalted Hei Ran wrote down the other three girls as well.
Exalted Bai Mei nodded…
While the exalted were chatting over candidates, the audience was a sea of noise, all discussing what they just witnessed.
Most gaped in awe and some mocked Lu Xie for ending up beaten by four girls one stage under him.
These jeers were made to reach his ears too, making his face fall. He wiped the blood from his mouth and looked at his opponents with a poisonous glare of hatred.
Lu Xie sized the formation up, removing all the early contempt he had before and seeing it as a real opponent.
He soon noticed how the formation flowed, centered around Chu Qingcheng and painting a target on her.
Grinning, Lu Xie shook and a five-meter tall and green image of a spider formed around him.
Its cruel eyes reflected its four targets.
Showing his soul meant he was going all out.
Everyone turned serious now that his soul lay bare. Even the audience. It was a rare occasion for an Ethereal Stage expert to go all out.
Chu Qingcheng and her teammates’ mood was heavy.
“Encompassing Poison Net!”
Lu Xie grinned and the huge spider spewed out green gas. The columns of gas slithered like reptiles for the four girls.
But when they touched the Four Elements Cycle Array’s limit, they went around it.
Just like a massive spider web, it trapped the girls within.
Zhuo Fan knew what the kid was after. The Four Elements Cycle Array looked impregnable, but enough force trumped everything. In face of true power, no matter how intricate the formation, it would fall like a tower of cards.
It all came to how strong this force was and how it was used. Lu Xie’s first head-on attempt didn’t work so now he used his head.
The girls were solemn now that their adversary was getting serious.
Whoosh~
The huge spider shook and sprung for the girls. Its great aura made it hard to breathe.
Shocked, they sent all their power to Chu Qingcheng. Permafrost in her hand shone ever brighter and ever colder. She lifted her sword and sent a white wave.
The instant the attack was about to hit, the spider turned to green smoke and scattered. The white wave hit nothing.
The smoke moved around the formation’s barrier and tightened.
The audience could now see that the gas was no poison, but minute threads, thousands upon thousands of spider threads spun around the girls.
Lu Xie grinned, “He-he-he, Soul Poison Explosion!”
Boom~
The string of endless explosions obscured everyone’s sight of the girls. All they could see was endless green smoke and hearing the stage’s barrier rumbling.
Zhuo Fan tightened his fists, more worried than ever.
The spectators were first stunned and then amazed by Lu Xie’s meticulous plan. His insidious gaze easily found out the formation’s weakness.
The formation used the power of the world itself and seemed perfect, by all means, but it needed four people to work together, to blend their powers into one.
So just now, the spider faked an attack to force them to pour everything into Chu Qingcheng, thus a shift in balance.
As Chu Qingcheng got stronger, the rest weakened.
Lu Xie dodged her attack at that moment, going after the three girls instead at their worst moment.
Wu Qingqiu and everyone else watched with bated breath. Lu Xie smirked, going forward to clean up the pieces once the booming stopped.
What welcomed him was a white cold flash coming from the thick dust. Before he could even react, it reached as close as his neck before it stopped.
Lu Xie looked in shock, only to see the three girls he targeted bleeding from the mouth.
As Chu Qingcheng alone, with her cold eyes, was pointing her blade at his throat. Around her was a crystal clear ice formed, and not just her, but all the girls as well that kept the poison at bay.
At the same time, the power of the world came from the girls and into Chu Qingcheng, brimming her with the power to fight an Ethereal Stage expert…

chapters.title: Chapter 649
chapters.content:
Chapter 649: Heartless
[This can’t be!]
Lu Xie wasn’t the only one so shocked. Wu Qingqiu, Yan Mo, and all geniuses from the superior three sects bore the same incomprehensible look.
Exalted Double Dragons eased a breath.
“It’s incredible how the lass controlled the entire world’s energy all by herself.” Exalted Bai Mei sighed.
Exalted Hei Ran nodded, his eyes sparkling with curiosity.
Most of the people below had no clue what just happened, or what incredible feats Chu Qingcheng could do.
A mere Radiant Stage cultivator yet had an uncanny control over her strength.
The formation required four members to run it, four people that had complete trust in each other to unleash its power. But since four people meant four wills, it was impossible for them to always work with one mind.
That was where Lu Xie struck, using explosions to exploit their weakness by attacking all of them at once. He needed just one of them to feel fear, panic, and not cooperate with the others, and the whole thing would fall apart.
That was the truth of it too. Shui Ruohua and the other two’s heavy wounds proved it. The formation had fallen that instant the bombs went off.
That’s when Chu Qingcheng came in, taking it all onto herself, availing herself of her Empty Spirit Body to take and give the power as she wished to keep the formation up.
At that sole moment, the three girls had no other use than as batteries, supplying Chu Qingcheng with Yuan Qi.
They turned a shocked and dull gaze towards the upright and gentle figure. The Four Elements Cycle Array needed four of them to use, but now it seemed, Qingcheng was enough.
The trio was filled with admiration and disheartened like someone stole something from them.
Lu Xie glared in hatred at Chu Qingcheng, but as he noticed the endless roaming world power, fear crept in.
[This woman is a frickin’ monster as well!]
How the hell did a person like her exist on this god’s green earth?!
Lu Xie gnashed his teeth, glancing at the people doing a poor job at hiding the sneers, and his heart blackened.
The cold blade edge was still breathing down his neck as Chu Qingcheng said, “You lost. You did hurt my sister, but since you are with Steward Zhuo, I will keep my hand from doing the same.”
Chu Qingcheng glanced over to Zhuo Fan, who just happened to find the clouds far more interesting. He was sulking like a little child, thinking the fact a woman was looking up to him was shameful.
His mind, however, eased up on the worry. [She won at last.]
Fiend Yang was outraged, “That rotten Ol’ Yun played us. Now we’re at a damn draw! Sigh, guess luck wasn’t with us. Six in the Ethereal Stage yet only one ended up fighting those broads. If only one more was around, there was no way they’d win.”
“Patience is also a weapon.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Ol’ Yun was waiting for this moment, one that had little chance of pulling off. If four Ethereal Stage experts ended up being drawn against the girls, the formation was worth nothing. He had everything in place, lacking only luck. Now that luck has sided with him, nothing can be done, ha-ha-ha.”
Fiend Yang glanced at him, “Our win just fell through so why are you so calm about it? I knew from the start that you had no intention of winning this round. If you had just gone up there, with four more points, the loss of this match wouldn’t matter.”
“What’s the big deal anyway? We still have a team match that we’ll surely win.”
“Oh please, individual battles, team battles, and overall scores are rewarded differently.”
“All the more reason it doesn’t matter. Worst case scenario, we’d end up tying in individual battles.”
“I don’t want to tie up with them and split the reward! Ugh…” Fiend Yang ranted and grumbled, “I just can’t take it seeing them win anything…”
[Petty much?]
Zhuo Fan smirked.
The judge noticed the outcome on stage and said, “The four individual fights go to Mystical Heaven Sect!”
The din of the crowd grew louder at the outcome, with some even openly jeering. Was this Ethereal Stage expert the weakest of the Demon Scheming Sect? The weakest? Weakest?
Lu Xie’s face was twitching all over from rage, his fists tight. Chu Qingcheng withdrew the blade at the judge’s declaration and let the world’s energy scatter.
Lu Xie struck Chu Qingcheng’s shoulder with a palm attack then and there.
She spat blood as she got thrown away by the impact.
“Qingcheng!” Shui Ruohua cried, rushing over to help her. Only to see her white as paper and in a heavy frown from pain.
The judge jumped in front of Lu Xie, blocking him from attacking again, “Boy, what do you think you’re doing? I already gave the verdict!”
“I haven’t lost yet!” Lu Xie roared.
The judge glared, “The outcome was obvious, and fighting after that will only mean death. What’s there to be so indignant about?”
“Who wouldn’t be?”
The shout this time came from the Demon Scheming Sect, and everyone turned to see Zhuo Fan’s dark face coming over.
Lu Xie woke up at that moment and shook all over.
Patting his shoulder, Zhuo Fan looked at the judge and then at Chu Qingcheng, “The true winner is decided by death. As long as there’s still a breath in the opponent’s body, he can make a comeback. So on this particular stage, unless the other side killed this one or knocked him out of bounds, there is no winner. Elder, haven’t you been a little hasty with the verdict?”
“Well…” The judge had no idea how to answer.
Dan’er was outraged, “Sister Qingcheng spared him because of you! Why else do you think he’s still standing?”
“For me you say? I am from the Demon Scheming Sect, you are from the Mystical Heaven Sect. Once we entered the Double Dragon Manor, we were nothing more than bitter enemies. The slightest weakness will get you killed, your fault not mine!”
Zhuo Fan snorted and turned away while hinting to Lu Xie to follow, “We are in the Double Dragon Manor and follow their rules. Since the elder judged the match so, we also shall accept it. But the next time they end up dead cause of their mercy, don’t come crying to me.”
“Bastard…” Dan’er was furious. Chu Qingcheng held her hand and shook her head.
She turned one last delicate smile for Zhuo Fan as her world darkened.
“Qingcheng, Qingcheng…” Shui Ruohua cried, seeing Chu Qingcheng’s right shoulder seeping black smoke, “Oh no, she’s been poisoned…”
Faltering, Zhuo Fan’s fists clenched, and his eyes turned cold. But only for a moment, as he took back his seat with the same tranquility.
The ever nervous Lu Xie breathed easier at last. [It seems Steward Zhuo doesn’t care so much about those women.]
Shui Ruohua glared back at Zhuo Fan, filled with fury. [ Every demonic cultivator is heartless. We were wrong for thinking otherwise!]
Holding Chu Qingcheng’s unconscious body, the Mystical Heaven Sect team was overcome by anger.
They could understand the Demon Scheming Sect’s anger of before, but this time, they were lenient only to receive a despicable blow. This was not something they could just swallow.
Elder Yun took this chance to admonish them, “See that? That is how a demonic cultivator operates! Changing their attitude in a blink of an eye. You must never go easy ever again, let Qingcheng be a lesson to all of you.”
They looked at the pale Chu Qingcheng and nodded, their eyes burning with anger.
“The fighters for the 8th match walk on stage!”
After a short commotion, the judge declared once more.
Mystical Heaven Sect had a handsome youth fighting in this match, vowing to take revenge for senior sister Qingcheng as he took firm and large steps on stage.
Only when he met face to face with Yue Ling in the Ethereal Stage did reality come crashing down on top of him and was this close to begging for mercy.
His puny skills were worth jack squat to get Qingcheng’s revenge.
Bam!
Yue Ling slapped him out of bounds, never to get up ever again.
Yue Ling strolled away, bored to death from the opponent being so weak. Fiend Yang was barking, “That’s more like it, no mercy! They cheated eight points from us and now we’ll make them pay for it!”
“No worries, Venerable, the next fight will be a cinch. They don’t have any Ethereal Stage experts after all. There’s no way they can pull another formation, ha-ha-ha… “
Kui Lang laughed, ready to go on stage. Fiend Yang nodded.
But seeing who it was, Elder Yun’s face bloomed in a nasty grin…

chapters.title: Chapter 650
chapters.content:
Chapter 650: Choice
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“It’s Kui Lang!”
Elder Yun’s shifty eyes scanned Kui Lang as he walked on stage, saying to Xuan Shaoyu, “Young master, I would have never let you go up there even if it was to forfeit; you’re too important. But since it’s Kui Lang, ha-ha-ha, I have the perfect counter. Take Qingcheng’s Permafrost sword, and when you walk on stage you…”
Elder Yun’s voice lowered as he whispered in Xuan Shaoyu’s ear. The youth bobbed his head now and then with a cunning look glinting in his eyes.
Per the elder’s instructions, he took Chu Qingcheng’s Permafrost from her unconscious body, and went to meet his opponent.
Kui Lang mocked, “Well, well, well,  if it isn’t the great young master of Mystical Heaven Sect. You’re looking for a thrashing as well?”
“A-he-hem, do you know who I am?” Xuan Shaoyu began.
Kui Lang replied in his most sarcastic tone, “Is there anyone in this world who does not know the crippled young master from Mystical Heaven Sect with the elements in him out of whack? Are you looking for a whopping coming up here? Sect Leader Xuan must be sick of you, I guess. Wonder if he found this the best chance to get rid of you, or maybe you never were his son, to begin with, and he sent you here to die, ha-ha-ha… “
That set the whole crowd into a round of laughter. Only Mystical Heaven Sect’s side glared back in anger.
“I am on stage to fight!”
Xuan Shaoyu ignored the taunts. His hand shone as he held Permafrost, “This sword’s previous owner, I hear, vowed never to harm a single person from Demon Scheming Sect. I wonder if the sentiment was mutual.”
Kui Lang started, his face solemn, “Permafrost? Isn’t Chu Qingcheng the one wielding it? What are you doing holding it? Think it will be your good luck charm in this fight?”
“Ha-ha-ha, I am the great Mystical Heaven Sect’s young master. I don’t cower behind anything. I am holding this sword only as a reminder…”
Xuan Shaoyu’s mouth took an evil smile, his lips moved, but no words came out. He was sending a message.
Kui Lang squinted, his face twisted in shock, then he turned pensive for a moment before sighing, “I… surrender.”
The entire arena burst into an uproar. Even the judge was taken aback. An Ethereal Stage expert surrendered to a cripple? How come?
Fiend Yang started raining curses like a madman, “Kui Lang, you damn freaking useless bastard! A slap, that’s all it would have taken! What damn surrender? Why is this always happening? Are you all trying to make me look bad?”
Demon Scheming Sect’s team looked at Kui Lang, waiting for an explanation.
Only Zhuo Fan, who witnessed it all, knew what happened, “Mystical Heaven Sect pulled out all the stops in dealing with the Demon Scheming Sect. I bet they must’ve found a way to twist his arm.”
Kui Lang’s face darkened as he left the stage, leaving Xuan Shaoyu with a sinister smile and pride for pulling such a glorious achievement with this win.
“Brother, what just happened? I was afraid that fiend would hurt you. How is it that he just surrendered?” Shui Ruohua asked hurriedly.
Xuan Shaoyu put on a vague smile, downplaying it,  “Can’t say. This was Elder Yun’s plan and a little secret between us, ha-ha-ha…”
The two laughed out loud, leaving the girls out of the loop.
Kui Lang lowered his head as he took his seat among his teammates, even as he got everyone’s questioning gazes on him. He never once spoke about it, just giving them a guilty look.
Even his son, Kui Gang, struggled to understand what could drive his father to do this.
“Kui Lang, you made the entire sect pay a heavy price with your loss. Because of your forfeit, we are now four points behind. We lost the individual fights. You better have a damn good explanation, or I will put you down per the sect’s rules!” Zhuo Fan glanced over.
The others rolled their eyes at the threat.
[You’re one to talk since you started all this forfeiting mess.]
Zhuo Fan took out Xie Wuyue’s token, dangling it, “By the power vested in me by the Sect Leader, I am, for all intents and purposes, the Sect Leader here. No matter what I decide, the sect won’t make a peep. Got it?”
“Yeah, you’re awesome, sir!” They all sighed, even the venerables.
“Great then, Kui Lang, you have some explaining to do to prevent such a mishap from happening again. If you find your mouth glued, it might be easier just to send me the explanation.” Zhuo Fan pointed at his ear.
Kui Lang ground his teeth, but due to his trust in Zhuo Fan, he chose to whisper in his ear.
Zhuo Fan’s face lit up, “Oh, so that’s why. You’re excused. Now that the matter has passed, none of you will speak of it again, nor start spreading it back at the sect!”
“Thank you, Steward Zhuo!” Kui Lang cupped his hand in gratitude.
The rest were more stumped than ever. Kui Gang could not fight the question, “Dad, what happened? What made you step down?”
“Even if you were up there, you’d do the same.” Kui Lang hesitated. Zhuo Fan snorted, then took out the token, “What did I say just now? Are you disobeying the Sect Leader’s orders?”
“No!” Everyone bowed with respect.
Zhuo Fan nodded, pleased, while Kui Lang was puzzled.
The judge shouted the verdict to all the matches, “Mystical Heaven Sect has eight points, Demon Scheming Sect has four. This round goes to Mystical Heaven Sect!”
The crowd gasped, none of them seeing it coming. Against all logic, Mystical Heaven Sect, the weaker one, pulled a fast one on Demon Scheming Sect.
Everyone was baffled. Mystical Heaven Sect’s formation was a neat trick but nowhere near enough to turn the tides which made the outcome more surprising.
Mystical Heaven Sect’s disciples were smug, while Demon Scheming Sect’s side was glum.
“Next is the team fights which are conducted in another area-” The judge began.
Elder Yun butted in with a bow and a smile, “Ha-ha-ha, elder, we, the Mystical Heaven Sect, forfeit this round!”
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, and he spared him a glance.
[Ol’ Yun here is devious alright. Confident in victory, he sacrificed his disciples over points, all just to turn it around.]
Now that his forces were cut down to size, fighting would be pointless, thus forfeiting altogether. Such confidence in one’s choices was a rarity.
[At least better than most other fools stumbling with their problems.]
Zhuo Fan glanced at Fiend Yang, who was stomping around and cursing from the missed chance to get back at them.
“Hey, Ol’ Yun, now that you caught us unprepared, you’re running away? Do you think it’s that easy? You played us well in the singles. Now fight us if you have the guts…”
Fiend Yang rambled and blustered about. Zhuo Fan had enough and left with a shake of his head.
The other left as well, leaving only Fiend Yang hooting.
When he woke up from his frenzy, he rushed after them, “Hey, why didn’t you wait for me? I’m still your Venerable…”
The comic relief helped the crowd lighten up and even laugh.
The lower three sects stage came to a close with Mystical Heaven Sect having won the singles, Demon Scheming Sect winning the team battles, and the overall score placing them in first place.
Though everyone knew Mystical Heaven Sect played the rules in their favor to squeeze a win against the deadly Demon Scheming Sect.
“Zhuo Fan, the best in Tianyu, you should be fighting in the middle three sects stage! Ha-ha-ha…” Wen Tao grinned, “Tianshang!”
He called behind him, “Where is he?”
Zhuo Fan took the Demon Scheming Sect’s disciples to their lodgings. They were all in a foul mood after today’s fights.
“If we fight again, I’ll break their formation!” Lu Xie justified himself to Qi Changlong and Bai Lian.
The two only sneered.
The outcome was quite evident. Did he have to die for him to admit defeat?
Bam!
Following the loud crack, Lu Xie’s face kissed the pavement with a crunch. He returned from the hard touch of the ground with blood running down his lips and two fewer teeth.
The others jerked, looking back to see Zhuo Fan’s angry face glaring at Lu Xie.
“Boy, I have had it with you!” Zhuo Fan was fuming now. Even the venerables looked shaken up…

chapters.title: Chapter 651
chapters.content:
Chapter 651: The Same
Proofreader
: Papatonks
With a heavy step, dark energies swirled around Zhuo Fan as he made his way to Lu Xie. His eyes flashed with bloodthirst.
Lu Xie froze, shaking all over, “Steward Zhuo, what’s the meaning of this? I haven’t done anything wrong.”
The rest were tense but not enough to make them talk.
Pff!
Zhuo Fan got next to Lu Xie and clutched his throat, lifting him off the ground. The overwhelming aura made breathing hard as he demanded, “Where is the antidote?!”
Antidote?
Lu Xie’s brow shook with understanding.
[Zhuo Fan still cares about that broad!]
He used to think Zhuo Fan’s cold front implied he did not give a damn about that woman, but he was holding it in to settle the accounts now.
Lu Xie’s heart was filled with indignity as he croaked, “Steward Zhuo, you can’t do this to me. I have given my all for the sect. You didn’t punish someone that forfeited, but you go after me for harming some woman? Where’s the fairness in that?”
“Zhuo Fan, Lu Xie had fought hard just now. I understand you want the antidote, but you can’t just demand it like this…” Fiend Yang found an excellent excuse to try and talk some sense into him.
Zhuo Fan snorted, “This is my business. Any that interferes will be severely punished. I will be the judge here about what is excessive or not. You have no say in this. Don’t think for a second Venerable Shi can protect you. You have always gone against me all the way here. Ignorant fool, hand over the antidote now, or else… “
“T-there isn’t one…”
Lu Xie’s brow trembled, feeling the power in Zhuo Fan’s grip, “My poison isn’t deadly. She will suffer for 49 days, and that’s it. The judge had given his verdict, so I didn’t dare kill anyone. I’m also afraid Double Dragon Manor will interfere. Otherwise, the other side’s elders would’ve also asked for the antidote, don’t you think?”
Zhuo Fan’s eye twitched, and his heart filled with rage. His body was flooded with a raging power current as the black energy roamed all over Lu Xie before entering his body.
Lu Xie felt like a tight black net robbed him of all movements as it ate away at his body. He had never felt such danger before, sweating buckets in fear.
Zhuo Fan was going to kill him over some woman…
Zhuo Fan’s icy eyes felt like a sucking abyss, his voice eerie, “Hand over the antidote, or you’ll get out of my sight for good.”
“Wait, Zhuo Fan, he just said there isn’t any. The woman is in no danger as well. This is still the Double Dragon Gathering, and we need all the help we can get. You can’t just kill him!” Fiend Yang tried to reason with him.
Zhuo Fan wouldn’t hear it; the black energy coiled more and more around Lu Xie, moments away from enveloping him in complete darkness.
The venerable was panicking yet still didn’t make a move to stop him. Lu Xie could no longer hold it and cried, “Wait, wait! I-I have the antidote!”
Lu Xie’s hand shone, and a vial appeared.
Fiend Yang stood agape and then glared at him.
[The prick had the antidote all along. He could’ve just handed it over from the start, but he had to make us all worried for nothing.]
Bam!
Not even sparing him a glance, Zhuo Fan flung him away. As he slammed to the ground, he spat blood, and the vial in his hand soared through the air and into Zhuo Fan’s hand.
Zhuo Fan eyed the rest with a cold gaze, “Every poison user has an antidote for their poisons, lest they get poisoned as well. Maybe some extremely deadly poisons do not, so the enemy will never survive, but as for the milder ones, especially used in torture, they are bound to have an antidote. The next time I do something, stay out of my way!”
Ugh!
Fiend Yang was embarrassed, then glared at Lu Xie.
[This bastard was faking it all along so much that we even bought it.]
Zhuo Fan ignored them, walking away. But just after a few steps, he stopped again, looking baffled.
“Long time no see, Zhuo Fan!”
A familiar figure stood in the doorway of their courtyard. Xie Tianshang came along with two girls, Shuang’er and Yongning.
The girls looked from Lu Xie, bleeding on the ground, to Zhuo Fan’s dark expression and gasped. They had never seen him so furious before.
Xie Tianshang hardly cared, evident by his smile,  “Ever since what happened to Ning’er at the Esoteric Debate, I never saw you so out of control. Edifice Lord Chu must’ve made some progress, I see, ha-ha-ha…”
“Xie Tianshang, why are you here? Are you representing Tianyu as well?”
“Not at all. While you did not notice me in the sects’ stands, I had a clear view of your arrogant and overbearing self. Ha-ha-ha, you haven’t changed a bit after all these years.”
Xie Tianshang’s gaze sharpened, “Zhuo Fan, do you remember my old goal? Since you left Tianyu, then I did as well. I am now a disciple of the Sword God Sect, competing in the middle three sects. I’ll be waiting!”
Zhuo Fan frowned and gave the nod after a pause. He flicked his sleeve and threw the vial, “Let’s leave that aside for now and help me with this.”
Xie Tianshang caught it and chuckled, “Just like always, exercising extreme caution, never doing it yourself.”
“Alright, I’ll deliver the antidote for you.” Xie Tianshang turned around and walked for a few steps before looking back at the girls, “How about you two come along? You haven’t met with Edifice Lord Chu yet, have you? Come on, if you know your enemy and yourself, you’ll surely win, ha-ha-ha…”
Xie Tianshang went on with a faint smile as the girls tensed. They shared a glance, then looked from Zhuo Fan to the disciplined Lu Xie, bleeding on the ground. Their eyes lit up and rushed to follow.
They didn’t even greet Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan grumbled for a bit, then left as well.
With them gone, the heavy mood slowly returned to normal. Fiend Yang sighed and couldn’t help but a curse, “You idiot, are you that blind to not see how much Zhuo Fan cares about that woman? And you struck her? You must be damn lucky you got away from Zhuo Fan in one piece.”
“But didn’t they break it off? Didn’t they both say they’ll go all out the next time they meet?” Lu Xie gnashed his teeth.
Kui Lang sighed, “They said one thing, but their hearts thought another. In this world, when a man meets a woman, what they say and what they feel are opposite. They might say they won’t hold back, but who is to say that will truly happen when they meet again? The girl didn’t skewer you because of Steward Zhuo. And Steward Zhuo almost killed you because of her. This is called saying one thing and doing another. In any case, you just had a brush with death.”
“Shit! Why the hell are they faking then, and why am I taking the fall for their duplicity?” Lu Xie was raging mad, “Venerable, I was just following your advice, to be ruthless to those bastards that burn bridges!”
“No, no, no, you’re not dumping this on me. I was talking about the others and did not say that girl specifically. You could’ve at least come to this conclusion yourself and thought of Zhuo Fan.”
Fiend Yang was waving all over as he tried to get out of this mess, “Zhuo Fan was right in the end. He had put up with you for too long. You not once showed an ounce of respect all the way here. Everything else he may overlook, but this time you have struck where it hurt him the most. Did you not see how he dealt with Yan Mo?”
“You got what was coming to you this time. I have been around more than you and can tell. In matters between a man and a woman, it’s best not to get involved, or this is how you’ll end up.”
Fiend Yang finished his reprimand, and Kui Lang followed, making him sullen and angry.
[What the hell did I get into? I was just beaten up and now seen as an outsider?]
[And that Zhuo Fan, he was going to kill his teammates over some woman? How is he fit to lead us?]
But then he looked around, and all he saw were faces saying he got what was coming. He was fuming mad.
[God damn it, Zhuo Fan, just you wait! You haven’t seen the end of this. Mark my words!]
Lu Xie gnashed his teeth, his eyes sinister as he looked at everyone around him.
These people, teammates for lack of a better word, were Zhuo Fan’s lackeys, taking every one of his words as law, even ignoring the good of the sect. His heart just could not accept it.
This resentment was bound to be the seed of calamity…

chapters.title: Chapter 652
chapters.content:
Chapter 652: If He’s Safe
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Qingcheng, how are you feeling?”
The cramped room was now crowded with Shui Ruohua and others all looking worriedly at Chu Qingcheng, sitting cross-legged on the bed.
The floating light green traces from her body made her body tremble and her face contort in pain.
Xuan Shaoyu gnashed his teeth as he cursed, “Those repulsive demonic cultivators even resorted to sneak attacks, and heavy-handedly too!”
“We don’t even know if sister Qingcheng will be alright. She took so many pills and antidotes, but none of them worked.” Dan’er shouted in anger.
Everyone gave a nod of worry.
Only Elder Yun waved his hand, his voice calm. “It’s fine. You guys don’t need to make such a fuss. I inspected Qingcheng and found her life wasn’t in danger. This is Double Dragon Manor. How can anyone just resort to murder? Just that these days, Qingcheng will be in suffering and pain.”
“Humph, damn those demonic cultivators, making junior sister Qingcheng suffer so much. I will never forget this!” Xuan Shaoyu gnashed his teeth.
The rest were just as angry.
“Young master, elder, Xie Tianshang of Sword God Sect has paid a visit!” A shout came from outside the house.
“The first middle three sects?” The two looked at each other, then wondered, “What is someone from the first middle three sects doing here?”
While they were wondering, the pained Chu Qingcheng opened her eyes. She had a faint smile as she said, “Show him in. He is an old friend from Tianyu. He must want to see me.”
[Another old friend?]
Xuan Shaoyu’s mood darkened.
[Not another shady pursuer, is it?]
He said, “Junior sister Qingcheng can’t receive guests in her state. It’s better if you don’t see him.”
“Wait, young master!”
Elder Yun spoke first, advising, “A simple old acquaintance of Qingcheng could be sent off, but he has the Sword God Sect behind him. We can’t ignore them. It’s best to receive him still.”
Xuan Shaoyu was annoyed by Elder Yun’s idea but could only nod, even as his mind was frantic.
Xie Tianshang brought Yun Shuang and Yongning along. After greeting Elder Yun, he noticed Chu Qingcheng sweating and pale.
He cupped his hands, “Edifice Lord Chu, it’s been a long time. Have you been well?”
“Enough of your crap. Can’t you see she isn’t well at all?” Dan’er rolled her eyes as she grumbled.
The others fell silent.
[He only said that in passing, yet you got annoyed so fast.]
Chu Qingcheng patted her shoulder.
Xie Tianshang chuckled and bowed again, “Forgive me for my crudeness. Edifice Lord Chu, I have witnessed how you got poisoned, and I have brought a secret antidote from my sect that should alleviate the pain.”
Xie Tianyang presented the vial.
Chu Qingcheng’s eyes lit up and she nodded, “Thank you for your kindness, young master Xie.”
“Please, we have the same homeland. There’s no need for that.” Xie Tianshang smiled and handed it over.
Shui Ruohua gave it to Chu Qingcheng, who was still trembling in pain. “Young master Xie, Qingcheng had taken many pills, but none helped. Could it be that this…”
“It will work!” Xie Tianshang smiled with conviction.
Chu Qingcheng smiled as well, “I believe so as well.”
She opened the vial and took the pill.
She remained cross-legged, meditating quietly. The others were still looking at her nervously, but after fifteen minutes, something magical happened. Chu Qingcheng’s trembling stopped. Her face became rosy, and the green energy around her slowly faded away.
“Young master Xie, your pill is amazing. It actually worked.” Dan’er’s eyes lit up.
Xie Tianshang simply smiled in reply, while Xuan Shaoyu and Elder Yun were amazed by the middle three sect’s power.
[I don’t know what that poison was, but it was removed so easily. Is this a universal antidote, I wonder?]
Chu Qingcheng revealed the answer soon enough.
She opened her eyes and smiled, “Ha-ha-ha, he’s still the same, never wanting to take credit for anything.”
“You knew?”
“Of course, such a specialized antidote can only come from the poisoner himself.” Chu Qingcheng was filled with happiness.
Shui Ruohua asked curiously, “Qingcheng, you said the antidote belongs to the poisoner. Does that mean it’s Demon Scheming Sect’s Lu Xie…”
“Yes, it’s his. Though I bet he wasn’t so keen on giving it.” Xie Tianshang spoke like she knew everything.
Xie Tianshang smiled and nodded, “Edifice Lord Chu, it’s like you’re him to know him so well. Just as I went to see him, he was beating up the guy to force him to give the antidote. But you know his style. He would never admit to doing such a kind act.”
“He’s just as stubborn as always behind that cold face. I’ve seen him do it too many times in the Esoteric Debate…” Chu Qingcheng’s gaze wondered, recalling the fond memories.
The girls were even more puzzled. Dan’er asked, “Senior sister, you can’t mean that Zhuo Fan gave you the antidote, can you? He had even been scolding you on stage to be crueler and forget the past.”
“And? He only did it because he pitied me, not wanting me to be in danger again. In fact, I was quite happy to hear him say that. As for his coldness, ha-ha-ha, he’s always been like this.” Chu Qingcheng did not mind it in the least.
The girls were speechless.
[What is it between these two exactly? It just feels more complicated by the day.]
Xuan Shaoyu was very hateful right then. The antidote came from him again. He would’ve surely stopped it if he knew. He could never allow the two to contact each other, even if it meant offending Sword God Sect.
Xie Tianshang nodded and sighed, “Edifice Lord Chu, you have changed over the years. You used to be so forceful and tough. Sometimes you’d be so scared by that arrogant and almighty Zhuo Fan you’d never see him.”
“Really?” Dan’er looked intrigued at Chu Qingcheng, but she flicked the girl’s nose, gave her a deep look, and the girl shied back.
Chu Qingcheng sighed, “I used to want an explanation from him at all cost, but after I saw how far he went for Ning’er, I knew. This man has his own path, and I should let him take it…”
“Ning’er?”
Chu Qingcheng was roused by the voice and looked at Yongning, “You know Ning’er? Then you aren’t Sword God Sect disciples either.”
Xie Tianshang smiled, “Let me introduce you. She is Tianyu’s princess, Yongning, and this is Tianyu’s Holy Maiden, Yun Shuang. They are both Edifice Lord Chu’s main rivals. You should be careful.”
Yongning and Shuang’er were put on the spot. Chu Qingcheng simply smiled at Xie Tianshang, “Who’d have thought the great martial fanatic of yesteryear would crack jokes?”
Then she looked deeply at Yun Shuang, “You’re Shuang’er? Peony Overseer said in her messages that Zhuo Fan declared in front of everyone that he wanted you. I must say, with your pure look, you sure bear a striking resemblance to Ning’er.”
“No, no, no, please don’t say that.” Shuang’er panicked, her face going beet red. Then she said quietly, “I was only his pawn. Nothing actually happened…”
[A pawn?]
The girls looked at each other, and anger appeared on their faces.
[To treat such a nice girl as a pawn, that Zhuo Fan is a cold bastard!]
Xuan Shaoyu used this chance to fling dirt, “Hear that? That vile demon only knows how to deceive innocent girls. Qingcheng, you must see him for who he is and not buy into his lies. He first had you injured and now sent someone with the antidote. He clearly wants to get to you. You must not let him.”
“I know him far better than you ever will.”
Chu Qingcheng sneered, her smile icy, “Besides, as long as he is safe, I don’t care if I become his pawn. What I fear is that he’ll abandon me without even finding a use for me.”
The girls watched Chu Qingcheng in shock.
This prideful ice queen wanted to become someone’s pawn, forever by his side. Was this still the same cold and determined beauty of before?
While Elder Yun shook his head, Xuan Shaoyu was fuming mad because of this.
[The poor lass had fallen victim to a vile demonic cultivator…]

chapters.title: Chapter 653
chapters.content:
Chapter 653: Where the Heart Is
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Qingcheng, wake up! You’ve been taken in by that demon!” Shui Ruohua shook Chu Qingcheng and shouted at her.
Chu Qingcheng shook her head, “Senior sister, I have been taken in, but that is because I wanted to…”
“Nonsense. How is it logical to let yourself be bewildered?” Shui Ruohua did not believe it.
Chu Qingcheng gave up, turning to Shuang’er and gesturing the two to come over.
Shuang’er and Yongning tensed in front of their archrival in love.
[She won’t do anything to us, will she?]
But the two relented at Chu Qingcheng’s bright smile that looked like an angel’s.
Chu Qingcheng smiled, “I know you both want to be by his side, but to do this you must understand him. You must also know what happened to Ning’er…”
“I heard from the Luo clan that Zhuo Fan saved her in the end but she forgot about him so he let her go.” Yongning said.
Chu Qingcheng nodded, “You know some, but not everything, not what he went through to do it. I was still stubborn back then, forcing him to accept me…”
Chu Qingcheng began narrating the days of old, from how the seven houses’ conflict started, to Zhuo Fan’s cruel path, of Ning’er’s death, of Zhuo Fan’s fall to madness, of his struggle and his white hair. She had told them everything, every little detail, well, except the part about her and Zhuo Fan separating because of it, going to different sects.
Whether it was telling her story, or Zhuo Fan’s, she always had that reminiscing smile.
“It was then that I knew this man was far from dead inside. He is only holding himself back, is all. The path he threads is destined to be cruel and cold. So how could I want to be an obstacle? That’s why I left, so that he would never fall into such despair again after what happened to Ning’er. If he is safe, I will be content. “
Chu Qingcheng smiled at Shui Ruohua, “I’m so happy to find that he still cares about me. That’s why I was glad when he asked senior sister about me.”
The girls were taken aback. They would never have imagined a cruel and cold demonic cultivator like Zhuo Fan would go through such pain and agony.
When Ning’er woke up, he did not cling to her, but let her go for her own good.
Chu Qingcheng had made the same choice then as well, all for him.
They all sensed that even by walking different paths, righteous and demonic, they were actually so similar. To them, the factions had no meaning, not when they knew each other completely.
The girls instantly had the desire to play matchmaker. Yun Shuang and Yongning lowered their bashful heads, coming to see just how little they knew Zhuo Fan compared to Chu Qingcheng.
What right did they have to be with him?
Xuan Shaoyu had long since been grinding his teeth in silence. The two had too many deep memories. It was impossible to make her forget about that bastard.
So what was left to be said about his chances?
“I see. So that’s why Edifice Lord Chu does not cling to him because you trust him completely.” Xie Tianshang sighed, “But by the looks of it, he will always be conflicted. Which is more important, the demonic path or love? This will be his final trial. I only hope he will be able to overcome it quickly and get stronger with it. That way I can also follow my goal by following him forever… “
The girls raised an eyebrow.
[That’s some bromance.]
Xie Tianshang noticed their quirky looks and was baffled.
[What, did I say something wrong?]
Outside of Mystical Heaven Sect’s courtyard, in a remote corner, stood a tall man, Zhuo Fan.
Ever since Xie Tianshang entered, he had been standing here for six hours. He only wanted to see him come out, proving that Chu Qingcheng was alright.
Whoosh!
Someone flashed behind him and said in a familiar tone, spreading a strong scent of alcohol, “Ha-ha-ha, you just can’t let her go, can you?”
Zhuo Fan looked back to see the drunk Danqing Shen smiling at him.
“Senior, how are you still here?” Zhuo Fan asked.
Danqing Shen said, “He-he-he, I told you, there’s no place that can bar me on these lands. I can go wherever I want. What, you have a problem with people coming from behind? “
“Uh, no, you can do what you wish.” Zhuo Fan’s face twitched.
Danqing Shen gave him a long look, then snickered, “Why does love exist in this world? To teach people about the meaning of life? Kid, if you want that lass, just go get her. What’s there to be conflicted about?”
“Senior, please don’t joke. You know as well that… this isn’t my path.” Zhuo Fan sighed inside.
Danqing Shen nodded, “Oh, quite true. That only means you’re fickle. You had two girls and now you got a third one. You don’t deserve her. What about all those bachelors? Leave some for them.”
“Senior, don’t joke. You know what I mean.”
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched again, and he sighed, “I walk the demonic path, a dead road filled with cruelty and no emotions. How can I let emotions take me? If I do, it will harm me and especially her. So why bother? The past is a living testament to that…”
Danqing Shen gave him a long look then said, “Then what are you standing around here for? Since you’re dead inside, kill all emotions. Standing out here, spying on a girl’s window is doing neither of you any good.”
“Senior is right, but after all that has happened, I just can’t let go.” Zhuo Fan sighed, “I never owed anyone a favor, I have only had others owe me. The minute I owe someone, it would be very hard to pay it back.”
Danqing Shen grinned, “He-he-he, a story. I just love stories. Come here and tell me. Maybe I can help you solve your troubles.”
“Uh, alright. It’s my fortune to have senior’s care.” Zhuo Fan began narrating the seven houses’ conflicts, the Esoteric Debate, in every detail.
“Saving Ning’er was my problem. She had nothing to do with it. In the end, she was forced to go to Mystical Heaven Sect so I could save Ning’er. I don’t even know what kind of conditions she had to accept either. I just don’t know when I will ever be able to return the favor. If I don’t, then I will never know peace for as long as I live.”
Zhuo Fan shook his head.
Danqing Shen turned serious as well, “A strange girl indeed. To save your friend she trapped herself. Now I understand why you regarded Lu Xie’s attack as if he attacked your friends. This is a heavy debt. The only way I can see it returned is if you give your heart and soul for her.”
“Hey, senior, I’m a demonic cultivator here!”
“Yeah yeah, a dead and cruel path, yadda yadda!”
Danqing Shen said casually, then turned solemn, “Kid, I may not be a demonic cultivator and don’t understand your way, but all paths lead to the truth, the Dao. That, at least, I do know. Even on the emotionless and cruel path, you need to feel first before you can squash your emotions. How else can you remove something that wasn’t there to begin with?”
“Just like us righteous cultivators who pursue justice, where would justice be if not for evil? How would you know justice without understanding evil? Here’s an example. That Universal Righteous Sect, they just love preaching justice left and right, but how many do you think are aware of what that even means? Is justice fighting some demonic cultivators? That’s not even breaking the surface!”
Zhuo Fan pondered, having noticed the wisdom but had yet to unravel its profound meaning. It seemed there was a thick shroud covering his sight, never lifting.
“Kid.”
Danqing Shen sighed, “You have so many girls around you, yet only that lass is a bit special. I thought you were serious about her, but after hearing your story, I’m having second thoughts. Do you feel guilty about her, or is it really love?”
Zhuo Fan frowned and shook his head, “I… I do not know…”
“Ha-ha-ha, you’re still naive!”
Danqing Shen shook his head, “Then let this old man teach you. Close your eyes and recall that perfect moment of bliss and happiness.”
Zhuo Fan did so and relaxed, his mind at peace. Through the stream of memories, he only found two that fit the old man’s question.
“I have two peaceful memories. One is in the Allbeast Mountain Range, with Ning’er and Xie Tianyang…”
“Ha-ha-ha, three people’s happiness!” Danqing Shen shook his head, “But they are nothing more than your precious friends. That’s not the one. There’s no such thing as happiness between three people. One always finds himself a third wheel. Ha-ha-ha…”
“Then there’s the other, in a run-down house…”
“How many?” Danqing Shen asked.
“Two.”
“Man? Woman?”
“Woman?”
“Who is she?” Danqing Shen shouted now.
Zhuo Fan opened his eyes and his face grew grave.
Danqing Shen laughed, “That one is where your heart is. Whether or not it is this lass, only your heart knows, ha-ha-ha…”
Danqing Shen was gone with that last laugh, leaving Zhuo Fan alone and sighing…
[What am I supposed to do…]

chapters.title: Chapter 654
chapters.content:
Chapter 654: Have Been Around
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Three days, that was how long Zhuo Fan was cooped up in his room, with one leg over the other and not moving a muscle.
He had been at this ever since he saw Xie Tianshang coming out of that courtyard, showing that the antidote was effective and Chu Qingcheng had recovered.
Today was when the middle three sects stage began, yet, he did not feel like inspecting his enemies, letting Fiend Yang take the disciples to watch the fight.
Zhuo Fan frowned deeply. His mind was uncertain, filled with Danqing Shen’s words. How did one remove love when it wasn’t even there? This was one question he had never thought about.
Maybe he had been on this lonely road of demonic cultivation for so long that he had gotten used to being alone and everything going his way. But heaven played a sick joke on him, bringing him back and tying him down again and again.
He could no longer go back to just being a demonic cultivator.
Was it heaven’s way of taunting him, or maybe a trial?
[Maybe Yun Xuanji was right. This is my chance to restart my demonic path.]
It was just that this path was too foreign that he did not know how to proceed. Unlike the breezy demonic path he trod in his previous life, he didn’t know if this new path would bring him to the pinnacle of Dao.
[Just what am I to do?]
Demonic cultivation emphasized a dead heart. Once emotions sprouted, they would drag him back. But how was one supposed to remove them when one had yet to experience them?
[This is so messed up.]
If one took those emotions to train in the demonic path, would these emotions remain pure? Could they be called the feelings one had at first? They were nothing more than a means to an end.
But if one fell to emotion, how could one just up and cut them off? If they could be removed so easily, why then still call it true love?
[Holy shit! If I see it as a trial, that means no path is the right one!]
Zhuo Fan facepalmed, hesitating if he should insist on going down this road.
[Better go with the flow and trust where my heart takes me.]
If it were so, would he ever return to his demonic path?
[I’m only getting further and further away…]
Feeling powerless, Zhuo Fan just did not know what to do. He had been in his man cave for these three days, struggling with his greatest problem yet.
[It just goes to show my previous path was too plain!]
“Zhuo Fan, another dark horse showed up! I don’t think we’ll even get to pass the middle three sects fight now!” A shout came from outside the courtyard.
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes at Fiend Yang’s distraught voice, turning over and resuming his conflicting thoughts.
Bam!
He was in for a rude awakening as Fiend Yang just would not let him, smashing the door open, rushing over, and shaking every bone in his body, “Damn brat, don’t you know anything besides sleeping? You’ll get all the sleep you want when you’re dead. We have more important things to worry about right now!”
“What’s the hurry? Aren’t we challenging the middle three sects tomorrow? Just leave it.”
“Leave your ass!”
Zhuo Fan’s lazy attitude ticked Fiend Yang off, “Damn brat, you did not come to see the middle three sects stage. Do you know how it ended?”
“Don’t wanna.”
“Why you…”
Fiend Yang’s face twitched in rage. He worked hard to keep it bottled up and prevent it from leaking into his voice, “You wouldn’t be so relaxed if you had seen what happened at the middle three sects stage. I bet you’d freak out more than me. Sword God Sect is a freak of nature, all ten of its disciples are in the Ethereal Stage, even your old friend.”
Zhuo Fan recalled his old friend, then nodded, “Oh, right. I never paid him much attention when he came. But now that you mention it, his aura did place him in the Ethereal Stage. He’s always been a martial fanatic, a genius cultivator, but for him to enter the Ethereal Stage so fast is beyond my expectations. The middle three sects sure are rich. Well, congrats to him.”
“Congrats your sister! You still have the free time to care about someone else? He is our greatest threat!”
Fiend Yang was itching to smack some sense into this sloppy Zhuo Fan, but he reined it in, “Dude, you’re our leader. Can’t you show some interest? Sword God Sect’s lineup is as strong as a superior three sect’s. Do you know how they fared in the matches? They won all of them, both singles and teams. Demon Soul Sect and Heaven Trailing Sect haven’t won once!”
Zhuo Fan looked at him curiously, “That amazing?”
“Yes, that amazing.”
Fiend Yang sighed, “Sword God Sect has always been the top middle three sects, but the other two sects weren’t this far behind. Even with the superior three sects’ dominance over the middle three sects, none of the superior three sects could guarantee such a complete victory…”
Fiend Yang’s worry grew as he sighed, “And then there’s that Gentle Sword, he showed great power, but I am sure he didn’t go all out. The entire Sword God Sect came prepared, then they even gave us taunting looks. They clearly aren’t afraid of us, or more particularly, you. They must have something ready for you. That’s what worries me the most!”
“Oh, then we should be more careful.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, finally getting serious. “I’ll just have to use my foolproof strategy to make losing impossible!”
Fiend Yang lit up, “You have such a thing? Tell me!”
“We don’t fight them. We can’t lose if we don’t fight.” Zhuo Fan grinned, “Or we’ll just have to settle being a middle three sect.”
Fiend Yang’s face twitched, and his eyes were burning with a newfound rage he could no longer contain, “Zhuo Fan, is that how you don’t lose? Shit! Who was it that said we’ll challenge the superior three sects? It was you who proclaimed such great design! But now that you met the Sword God Sect blocking your path, you shy away? You’re nothing more than…”
With an unbridled yawn, Zhuo Fan walked away as Fiend Yang was in the middle of his rant.
He had more pressing things to worry about, like his inner conflict. Other stuff was just extra.
He cared even less about some good of the sect motto. Getting them in the middle three sects was enough to fulfill his end of the bargain with Xie Wuyue.
[Superior three sects? Ha-ha-ha, that’s your problem!]
Fiend Yang felt powerless at Zhuo Fan’s disinterest.
[This young master is so damn stubborn, only doing things based on his mood. If he were in good spirits, he’d be arrogant and fight everything under the sky. If he were in the dumps, he would rather sit back. What a pain in the ass, and there’s no way to deal with him.]
“Steward Zhuo, Venerable, people from the Heaven Trailing Sect have come to see you!” Kui Lang shouted as he entered. Looking at Fiend Yang’s red face and Zhuo Fan’s laid-back attitude, he knew what had happened. So he bowed and declared.
Fiend Yang glanced at Zhuo Fan, “We’ve been here for so long already and haven’t paid each other any visits. So why is it today they come to us?”
“Punk, this isn’t over. We’ll talk when I get back!” Fiend Yang slammed his hand hard on Zhuo Fan’s shoulder and left in a huff.
Zhuo Fan had a faint smile on his face. Kui Lang did not disturb him and closed the door behind him. Zhuo Fan then recalled something and shouted, “Hey, Kui Lang, come back. I want to ask you something.”
“Steward Zhuo, is there anything you need?” Kui Lang bowed.
Zhuo Fan waved his hand, turning dead serious, “Kui Lang, you and your one must have a deep love for each other, right? Why else would you forfeit knowing it could kill you?”
“She keeps me at peace. She chases my fears…”
“Alright, I got it. You don’t need to mention it.”
Kui Lang looked at the sky sorrowfully, but Zhuo Fan cut him off right as he started, “I just wanted to ask. You know demonic cultivation is emotionless, so why do you do this for…”
Kui Lang gave him a long look, then sighed, “Steward Zhuo, I know the sect has a rule not to fraternize. But love is like a torrent, sweeping anything in its path. I have been around and understand this better than most. Both its sweet and bitter sides, with all in between. All I can say is that I have no regrets. Even when I got cast down to being a laborer.”
“Uh, you misunderstood me. This isn’t about the sect’s rules. I’m talking about the demonic path. Now that you’ve known love so much, it’s hard to progress. Why did you dive in without hesitating?”
Kui Lang had a strange look, “Steward Zhuo, I may be a disciple on the demonic path, but I haven’t once thought about it. I only followed what others did and did not break the sect’s rules. That is all. When I got close to her, I wasn’t thinking about anything, just that we might be exposed and suffer for it.”
Zhuo Fan paused for a moment and nodded.
An ordinary cultivator like Kui Lang was still at the start of the demonic path and probably would never traverse it to reach the Dao. So he didn’t consider things too much.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, feeling foolish.
[What was I thinking asking him? He doesn’t know the difference between a path and a demon. All he does is follow the herd.]
Because of this, Zhuo Fan admired him. Faced with simple-minded choices, one did not have regrets.
“You can go. I need some peace and quiet.” Zhuo Fan shooed him.
Kui Lang nodded and bowed before leaving. But just as he was at the door, he said, “Steward Zhuo, I don’t know if it’s my place to say this. My insight into the demonic path is way shallower than yours and Elder Yuan’s, but there is one area I know for certain. I chose the demonic path over the righteous because of their many restrictions. While I do not know what is on your mind, I get the feeling you are also restricted by yourself. Why must you do so? I have been around, and when it comes to emotions or love, I won’t hesitate.”
“Why do you suddenly sound so wise?”
Zhuo Fan shook, and a realization struck him as he gaped at him.
Kui Lang scratched his head, “I can never be wiser than Steward Zhuo, that I know. All I can say is that I know about feelings, ha-ha-ha…”

chapters.title: Chapter 655
chapters.content:
Chapter 655: Contradiction
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Freedom of action stood at the base of the demonic path, but one could feel restricted by walking down this path.
[Such a contradiction!]
Zhuo Fan started, returning to the old unanswered problem plaguing his mind.
“Damn that Ren Cong! How dare he look down on me, like it’s beneath him to talk to me. This is bullshit!” Just when Zhuo Fan was finally alone with his thoughts, a loud voice complaining sounded.
A bang followed, and the door was slammed open again. Fiend Yang stomped inside and saw Zhuo Fan. “You, the Heaven Trailing Sect is asking for you! Go see them!”
“Me? What for?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, “You’re a great Venerable, aren’t you? You’re not enough?”
“Of course I am, but those sons of she-dogs have holes for eyes.” Fiend Yang grumbled, then sighed, “But they want to meet you specifically, so you must go. They are the head of Tianyu’s three guardian sects. We have to show our respect. “
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes and went. Fiend Yang led the way to the front of the courtyard.
Four stood inside, looking around while Gui Hu and the others accompanied them.
“Your place sure is tiny, but what can you expect from a lower three sect, ha-ha-ha…” A young master in silken robes fanned himself as he laughed.
The two youths in green around him laughed as well, looking at Gui Hu with derision.
The grizzled old man said nothing.
Gui Hu was angry, but the two fiends left here stopped him and the other disciples from shouting. Zhuo Fan saw this and asked Fiend Yang, “Is Heaven Trailing Sect here to look for trouble? Quite the tone they have.”
“I’m not sure. However, there hasn’t been any issue between our sects. Just go there, and you’ll know.” Fiend Yang rolled his eyes.
The two approached.
Gui Hu’s side bowed before Steward Zhuo and stood aside. The four instantly set their eyes on him.
The young master snapped his fan closed and barked, “So you’re the dark horse of the lower three sects? I saw you when your sect fought with Mystical Heaven Sect. But why did you not participate? I am not sure how tough you are, but you sure know how to be cocky.”
[You know I’m cocky, yet you come at me with that attitude? Are you itching to be pummeled?]
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes, “That makes two of us. Why have you all come here? And for me in particular?”
“Ha-ha-ha, we heard you’re running rampant and that the sect cherishes you. The venerables must’ve exaggerated, so we came to see the truth!”
The young master showed a nasty smile filled with contempt.
Zhuo Fan’s eyelid twitched. Now he got the gist of what they wanted. They came for a fight.
[A puny middle three sect wants to waste my time? Ha!]
The young master took Zhuo Fan’s silence for fear and grew more courageous, “Ha-ha-ha, now don’t be so nervous. I came with good intentions. I presume you also saw the middle three sects’ stage today and should already know what to do. I only came here thinking you have been complacent and thought of reminding you how things stand.”
Demon Scheming Sect’s disciples knew where he was going with this, and their faces fell. Only Zhuo Fan played the fool, sporting the same baffled look.
“How was the result in today’s stage anyway? Please tell me.” Zhuo Fan smiled.
The young master’s face twitched and turned dark. He glared, “Are you mocking us when you already know? Humph, we may have had poor results this time in Double Dragon Gatherings, ending up last in the middle three sects stage, but nothing a puny and insignificant lower three sect could ever compare to.”
“Oh, so you’re the runt! Afraid you might end up kicked further down, you came to beg for mercy, is that it?” Zhuo Fan snickered, “Ha-ha-ha, what a good little doggy, wag your tail for master. But you’re missing the right attitude when begging. You’ll never get any attention if you keep barking and snarling.”
“Bastard!”
Two shouts sounded in unison, one from the young master and the other from the elder.
Hu~
Pressure had come at Zhuo Fan. The elder was furious and shot a palm attack toward his head. Zhuo Fan only squinted, standing his ground like a statue and awaiting this reckless old fool’s death.
[Humph, you’ve gone senile if you think you can beat me in the 5th layer Ethereal Stage!]
Bam!
The old man’s attack never reached Zhuo Fan, as Fiend Yang blocked the palm.
They both staggered five steps back before stopping.
The old man glared at Fiend Yang, who hurriedly waved his hands, “Ha-ha-ha, Elder Qi, Zhuo Fan hasn’t been at the fights today. He doesn’t know your sect’s situation. He wasn’t trying to offend your great sect with his ignorance. Please forgive him.”
“Ignorant? Then what did he mean by his last words? What dog?” Elder Qi grunted.
“Uh…”
Put on the spot, Fiend Yang chuckled.
Zhuo Fan had the same stoic face as he said, “Then why have you come here?”
“We came to warn you to know your place and don’t participate in the challenge stage. Just stand aside and watch before you humiliate yourself.” The young master mocked Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan sneered, “Isn’t that the same thing? Why would you bother coming here to run your mouths if you aren’t scared of us? That only means you’re scared. If that is the case, try to at least act like it. Stop with the tough act. I ain’t buying it!”
“Why you…”
The young master was burning with rage and shot his two green friends a signal.
The two nodded and went for Qi Changlong, Bai Lian, and Lu Xie, the strongest disciples.
The trio was on guard, knowing they couldn’t be careless against these two, having the same cultivation as them, 3rd layer Ethereal Stage.
But then the two vanished and appeared behind them with a palm attack.
Bang~
Three explosions sounded, and Qi Changlong, with the other two, was sent flying, bleeding from their mouths. As for the two in green, they were back in their spots.
Zhuo Fan’s heart tensed, “A combined attack again?”
“Humph, let this be a warning to you. If you dare meet us on stage, I won’t care if we’re sects from the same empire. We’ll slaughter you!” The youth flicked his hand, and he left with his friends in green and elder. Qi Changlong and the others barely got to their feet, their eyes filled with hatred.
Zhuo Fan calmed down and said, “Will you let them have it?”
“We’ll give them shit! Why the hell would we do what they want anyway? We’ll be the middle three sect when we throw them back!”
Fiend Yang snorted, “Zhuo Fan, remember this well. That cocky kid is Ren Cong. He is Sect Leader Ren’s son. You can teach him any lesson you want, except killing him. As for the rest, you decide. But those two in green are Cong Shan and Cong Lin. They train in the Mountain and Forest’s Shadow. Their location isn’t constant, and they are hard to avoid. They almost scored two wins from Sword God Sect in today’s battles. But they met with Gentle Sword Wen Tao. If not, just by score alone, they would have Demon Soul Sect beaten and in second place since Demon Soul Sect only had one point over them.”
“Thank you, Demon Soul Sect, for bringing him to me. See how I’ll kick them out of the middle three sects.” Zhuo Fan snickered and turned to the rest, “Tomorrow, we’ll be fighting together!”
Roar!
The others cheered. After taking a round off of fighting, Steward Zhuo was back in action.
[Hump, cocky brat of Heaven Trailing Sect, your days are numbered!]
Meanwhile, Ren Cong and the other three looked smug about their success. “Elder Qi, the kid isn’t much after all. You went to attack, yet he just stood still like a moron. Cong Shan and Cong Lin attacked those disciples, and he still didn’t help. Our fears were unfounded, ha-ha-ha…”
The four came to the Demon Scheming Sect to warn them and test the waters. They hadn’t seen Zhuo Fan fight and came to probe him.
A shame their testing not only ended up fruitless but even managed to yank the enemy’s chain into biting them back harder.
They failed because of their stupidity. But the biggest irony was they were oblivious of it…

chapters.title: Chapter 656
chapters.content:
Chapter 656: Qu Shen
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“But they say that Zhuo Fan obliterated Beast Taming Sect’s disciples with one fist; even the elder. It can’t be that he could not even react to my palm attack.”
Elder Qi found it suspicious. Ren Cong saw it too but waved off his suspicions, “Ha-ha-ha, no need to think too hard about him, Elder Qi. Zhuo Fan is only at the 3rd layer Radiant Stage. How strong can he be? The rumors must be exaggerated. Why else would he suddenly sit out when every sect was there to see him? I bet he was scaring the middle three sects’ disciples into surrendering when it came to fighting him. Only petty people resort to petty tricks.”
“As for Beast Taming Sect’s elder’s death, Exalted Double Dragons already announced he broke the rules for attacking the guests and was executed by Exalted Hei Ran. It had nothing to do with that punk. I bet it’s just another rumor he instigated to scare others. But not me, yours truly won’t fall for it, ha-ha-ha…”
Elder Qi regarded Ren Cong and nodded in the end. “Young master is wise. I must’ve gotten too old to fall for a kid’s trick.”
“The new is replacing the old, ha-ha-ha…”
Ren Cong was extra full of himself, looking at the two youths, “Cong Shan, Cong Lin, in tomorrow’s fights, if the others bought it, make sure you kill Zhuo Fan at once to break their spirit and show everyone what a liar he is. Leave the rest for after, alright?”
“Understood, young master.” The two nodded.
Ren Cong’s smile grew wider.
Tomorrow, everyone would see how they fell for the kid’s inflated lies.
[Only I, Ren Cong, from Heaven Trailing Sect, saw the truth.]
[Since strength can’t beat him, I’ll use intelligence, he-he-he…]
On the morning of the second day, the arena was packed. Even though it was the middle three sects’ challenge stage, the superior three sects also showed up.
Only this time, they were curious about two people. One was the darkest horse of all times, hailing from Demon Scheming Sect, Zhuo Fan.
The other was one who they paid even more attention to since not just him but his entire sect was the strongest among the middle three sects, Gentle Sword Wen Tao from Sword God Sect.
“Ha-ha-ha, the ever dauntless superior three sects for thousands of years are now stirred. But the one to climb isn’t Demon Scheming Sect, but Sword God Sect! I wonder who is going to take the fall.”
Wu Qingqiu chuckled, watching the flood of people coming in.
Yan Mo was there too, “What’s the point in asking? The most likely sect to drop is the Universal Righteous Sect. That’s what it gets for always being last.”
“Are you so sure it’s going to be last this time too?” Wu Qingqiu raised an eyebrow.
Yan Mo nodded without delay, “Of course, it has always been like this. The number one spot among the superior three sects was always fought between us two sects, while the Universal Righteous Sect was just the wheel.”
“I don’t mind if they were last, or even if we are last. I just hope that guy gets to fight with me already. That’s all I wanted. One can never find peace unless he fights one’s destined rival!” Ye Lin was bored to death, looking for his target from the audience.
Yan Mo asked, “Hey, I feel like sparring with you.”
“You?”
Ye Lin mocked, “No point, now shoo!”
“You…” Yan Mo choked, and Wu Qingqiu laughed.
Whoosh!
The judge once more made his appearance on stage, bowing before the empty air, “Welcome, Exalted!”
“Welcome, Exalted!” The rest of the people bowed as well.
Exalted Double Dragons appeared in their seats of honor and gestured for them to be seated.
Exalted Hei Ran spoke, “Begin!”
“Middle three sects and lower three sects, enter the arena!” The judge shouted.
Sword God Sect, Demon Soul Sect, and Heaven Trailing Sect walked into view. After them came Mystical Heaven Sect and Demon Scheming Sect.
Seeing Zhuo Fan in his team’s lead, he did not look like he would be sitting back this time. The people lit up, knowing he would be fighting.
Yan Mo, Wu Qingqiu, and the others were excited as well. Wu Qingqiu really wanted to know what this kid could do to earn his freaky junior brother’s high evaluation.
Wen Tao grinned at Zhuo Fan, filled with fighting spirit, “Zhuo Fan, your reputation precedes you. We’ll finally get a glimpse at your skills. I wonder if you’ll live up to your name.”
“Fight me, and you’ll see.” Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes.
Wen Tao paused, then nodded, “I’ll be waiting.”
Han Yunfeng stared at Zhuo Fan, then finally said, “Well met, Zhuo Fan, I am Demon Soul Sect’s eldest young mas-“
“Big young Han!” Zhuo Fan cut him off, earning a few snickers from Demon Scheming Sect and Demon Soul Sect. (StarReader: play on the words big=eldest.)
Han Yunfeng coughed and said, “I am Han Yunfeng. Because of my father’s harsh teachings, he only gave us three brothers names after age five, depending on our strength. Only the strongest earned his name, while the rest didn’t have one. That is why only I have one. They are the second son and third son.”
“Oh, your dad sure is cruel. That’s a demonic sect’s Sect Leader for you.” Zhuo Fan nodded, then a question nagged at him.
[If the Sect Leader is cruel to such a degree, does he not feel any love for his sons?]
[Ugh, the demonic path is filled with mysteries.]
Han Yunfeng said, “I planned to fight you in the Double Dragon Gathering, but I reconsidered. It’s unwise to do something you already know you’ll fail. So despite some regrets, if you want to challenge us, Demon Soul Sect will have to refuse your invitation.”
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, giving him another look of admiration.
[The kid knows when to call it quits, like a true man of ambition does. And he is a Sect Leader’s son too. Quite unlike a certain someone…]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes drifted to Ren Cong, who had a constant sneer on his face, “Fool, he has you believing a lie. You’re still falling for his bluff?”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, scratched his nose, and gave him a moment of silence in tribute.
Exalted Double Dragons saw Zhuo Fan on the scene and were startled. They shared a glance and nodded.
They were under the impression Zhuo Fan was too strong this early in the competition, but after watching the middle three sects’ stage, they realized the disciples this time were anything but weak.
Without Zhuo Fan’s help, Demon Scheming Sect would have nothing to fight with today, effectively going against their fair judging of the sect’s potential. Therefore, they allowed Zhuo Fan to fight.
Zhuo Fan glanced up and noticed their faint nod, knowing he was free to let loose.
He was on a roll!
“In the lower three sects singles, the Mystical Heaven Sect won. In the team matches, the Demon Scheming Sect won. By the Double Dragon Gathering’s rules, Mystical Heaven Sect can take the initiative to challenge another sect only in the single matches while Demon Scheming Sect can only challenge other sects in the team battles. Sects, who will you challenge?”
The judge turned to the teams.
Elder Yun bowed, “My Mystical Heaven Sect has always been under the Heaven Trailing Sect’s guidance. And while we had the fortune to take first place in this time’s lower three sects stage, we only wish to hold our position and not offend any middle three sect. Mystical Heaven Sect refuses to make a challenge.”
[Boot-licker!]
Everyone there felt like retching at this slick old man’s words.
[He’s kissing ass at his age? Has he no shame?]
[What Heaven Trailing Sect guiding you? You’re just its dog!]
The girls blushed in shame under the contempt of the crowd. They looked at Elder Yun filled with resentment.
[We’re still a sect! So why must we sell our dignity and become someone else’s lapdog?]
Only Ren Cong felt like he got even more full of himself, nodding like it was natural.
Zhuo Fan found Elder Yun’s action admirable.
[He has no damn ounce of shame, just like me back in the day.]
Since he turned the loss into a win, Zhuo Fan had noticed Elder Yun’s patience and scheming mind.
Playing the innocent while the play was in disfavor, then striking when the moment was right.
He might look like he was ingratiating and shaming himself, but he was, in fact, the Heaven Trailing Sect’s most dangerous servant.
When the master lost its focus on this dog, the dog would definitely go for the master’s throat.
That’s the definition of flexible!
The judge turned to Demon Scheming Sect.
Zhuo Fan stepped out before Fiend Yang could speak, “Fight, of course!”
While the Mystical Heaven Sect could only submit, the Demon Scheming Sect had gone beyond this level, ready to kick these rampant middle sects off their throne and take the crown for ruling Tianyu’s three guardian sects for itself.

chapters.title: Chapter 657: Mountain and Forest’s Shadow
chapters.content:
Chapter 657: Mountain and Forest’s Shadow
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Zhuo Fan’s determined voice echoed in the ears of everyone in the arena, filling them with excitement and expectations. Especially the nation’s representatives. The nine sects in the western lands had been stuck in their respective rankings for thousands of years.
It all became foggy. When exactly was the last time an underdog tried punching above its status? Now, they were witnessing history in the making.
Everyone was thrilled and eager for a good show. The teams from every sect had known this was coming and were watching in anticipation.
Only Ren Cong’s face fell, glaring at Zhuo Fan like he was an abomination on this earth.
[A tiny Demon Scheming Sect like you dares to challenge your superiors? Humph, you’re going to pay for it. Mark my words.]
Turning to Cong Shan and Cong Lin, Ren Cong nodded and gave them the signal.
In all honesty, they were shaken by the Demon Scheming Sect’s team for a good reason. With six in the Ethereal Stage, their side only had himself and the twins.
In other words, besides him, in the 2nd layer Ethereal Stage, and the brothers, in the 3rd layer Ethereal Stage, the other seven disciples in the Radiant Stage could hardly pose a challenge. They were the only three who could put up a fight and score a win.
So why was it that even though Demon Soul Sect had only Han Yunfeng and the second young master Han as their sole two Ethereal Stage experts, they were still above them in rank? It was their overall strength that made all the difference.
The hope of keeping their name rested entirely on Cong Shan and Cong Lin dealing with six Ethereal Stage experts.
As such, striking first and hard to cripple the enemy’s morale was a tested tactic through the ages.
The Cong brothers’ eyes flickered coldly, fixing Zhuo Fan in their sights.
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow. His thoughts were mocking them.
[It’s obvious that their target is me.]
He shook his head and sighed.
[Ignorance sure is bliss.]
“Since the Demon Scheming Sect has decided to challenge, please enter the Sumeru Dimension. First will be lower three sect Demon Scheming Sect versus middle three sect Heaven Trailing Sect in a team battle!”
(StarReader: Sumeru is the center of all Buddhist cosmology’s physical, metaphysical, and spiritual universes.)
The judge shouted at the crowd.
Then, two familiar figures appeared on the stage. They were none other than the elders posing as gatekeepers of Double Dragon Manor.
Their hands worked through the gestures quickly, and with a bang, they shot their hands forth. The space in front rippled like a curtain about to be lifted. As the ripples took form, the two elders grabbed what looked like seams and pulled with all their strength until the veins on their arms bulged outward.
Creak~
The space was split apart with a heavy sound to reveal a new world.
The view presented a magnificent valley with a tall and imposing mountain behind it, covered in a lush and beautiful forest. This world’s limits were so vast that one could not even see the edges. Such a considerable expanse could easily accommodate a battle against armies in the hundreds of thousands, not just a measly twenty people.
Turning back to the audience, the judge said, “The disciples of the two sects are to enter. You are free to fight to your heart’s content.”
Zhuo Fan nodded and was the first to walk forward, but someone gave a taunting snort just before he entered the barrier.
“Ha-ha-ha, what a grand world. I bet this will be your first time seeing it since you’ve never had a team battle. But don’t even think about hiding in this vast world. We’ve been here so many times. We know it better than you!” Ren Cong snickered at Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan mocked, “You took the words right out of my mouth. Not like if you hide, it will change anything. It will just be taking a little more time. Come to think of it. I can’t remember the last time I played cat and mouse. I should relish the moment, ha-ha-ha…”
“We’ll see who plays with who here!” Ren Cong just had to have the last word.
But those who knew Zhuo Fan’s real strength looked at him like he was an idiot.
[I say, I don’t think I’ve ever seen anyone so quick and excited to die. Life must be tough for him.]
Zhuo Fan shook his head with a mocking smile as he entered the world. His team snickered and followed right after.
Ren Cong gave the Cong twins a signal, and the two nodded. They shot into the barrier, soon followed by the rest of their team.
Soon, everyone entered the fray, leaving behind a faded image from inside to let the audience know how it progressed.
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan was the first to appear in a small valley, with Demon Scheming Sect’s disciples behind him, gawking.
The spiritual energy in this valley was thick, tens of times better than in Double Dragon Manor. Cultivating here was paradise.
[Double Dragon Manor is the strongest sect in western lands to have such a great place!]
However, Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow as he looked around in curiosity.
[The spiritual energy is too thick. There’s no way a simple Spiritual Gathering Array can do this.]
[It seems there are world crystals here. Maybe…]
Zhuo Fan’s brow furrowed. In a dark corner of this world, Danqing Shen’s eyes stared over with a flickering gaze…
Whoosh~
Suddenly, as the Demon Scheming Sect team was stunned by the world around them, two familiar men appeared in front. They were Cong Shan and Cong Lin.
But they did just keep on coming at Zhuo Fan, who just cocked an eyebrow.
They did not attack, passing through him and coming before the six Ethereal Stage experts.
“Mountain and Forest’s Shadow, the Mountain!” Cong Shan growled.
(StarReader: Shan=lit. mountain.)
As he finished, his body glowed in an earthly yellow light, his strength surging so much at the same time it felt like he was pushing the heavens aside.
The others squinted and cried, hurried to fight back the twin attackers in the form of a combined palm.
In an instant, the six Ethereal Stage experts’ powerful palm attack rolled at the twins like a huge boulder. Cong Lin’s eyes flashed, and he made a sign. “Mountain and Forest’s Shadow, the Forest!”
(StarReader: Lin=lit. Forest)
Hum~
A green image formed, draping over the two like a curtain, starting with a green glow spreading around.
Just in time to welcome the six’s attack.
But instead of pushing through the green image, it only grew weaker as the curtain wiggled and swiveled, nullifying the attacks’ momentum.
Then, with a bounce, it kicked back the six palm strikes at the attackers.
At the same time, the lofty yellow power also fused with it.
