In am instant, a prismatic attack of incredible power came for the six people. They were caught off guard by the attack and scattered around like bowling pins, up to a hundred meters away.
Eyes squinting, the six could hardly believe what had happened. They were astounded how two Ethereal Stage experts could push back six others.
While it looked like each side was taking their time in moving to strike just now, it all happened in the blink of an eye.
In other words, in just one move, the six were defeated by two people with the same cultivation as three of theirs.
Even the audience outside was shocked by this development.
The combined attacks of the twins were indeed impressive.
[They were at an advantage against six enemies!]
Only Sword God Sect and Demon Soul Sect, who fought them, understood how deadly the duo was. No way your average Ethereal Stage expert could fight them.
They could fight as many as ten opponents!
In other words, while in singles, they could get four points at most, their full potential had no limit in a team battle. For Demon Scheming Sect to challenge Heaven Trailing Sect to a team battle was entering their domain!
“Mountain and Forest’s Shadow combines reality with illusion, switching between force and flexibility. It is as strong as a relentless assault, crushing anything in its path, and as flexible as a raging torrent blowing them away. The two make a truly rare team!”
Looking at the screen, Wen Tao squinted and smiled. “When we fought the duo, we also seemed to have taken a long time to win. Tianshang, how long do you think it will take your old friend to beat them?”
Wen Tao asked Xie Tianshang, who turned pensive for a moment before he shook his head, “Zhuo Fan is a monster, exceptionally gifted and advancing at unimaginable speeds. I haven’t seen him in years, so I cannot tell how strong he has become.”
“Fifteen minutes at most!”
The voice startled Wen Tao. Looking over, he saw Demon Soul Sect’s Han Yunfeng with his eyebrows raised.
Wen Tao chuckled. “Brother, would you be kind enough to share what you know?”
“It’s not anything of real value anyway. We have fought Zhuo Fan and the Cong twins before. And even though we lost in both cases, we knew who was the true master among them.”
Han Yunfeng took a deep breath. “Cong Shan and Cong Lin used at least 90% of their power when they fought us, while Zhuo Fan less than a third, maybe just a fifth. Every move of his was casual yet unbelievably intricate. If we were to compare, the twins would be a lake while Zhuo Fan the sea. We cannot imagine anyone among the disciples here who can make him go all out!”
“Oh, then I’ll make sure to watch closely. If I’m not mistaken, Cong Shan and Cong Lin’s attack on the six Ethereal Stage experts is a feint while their real target is him. What this brother said is true.”
Wen Tao’s eyes shone like he knew everything.
And sure enough, after the six were blown away, the twins turned around and went for Zhuo Fan…

chapters.title: Chapter 658: Pulverized
chapters.content:
Chapter 658: Pulverized
Proofreader
: Papatonks
[Oh-ho, so they’re after me, is it? They wanted first to take care of the pesky flies before they came for me, ha-ha-ha…]
Despite the two coming at him with murder in their eyes, Zhuo Fan replied to their savage glares with a faint smile.
For the audience, it was the moment they had all been waiting for.
Wen Tao and Han Yunfeng were also eager to see how Zhuo Fan would put the tough and flexible twins in their place.
Whoosh~
Darting around a few times, the two closed in on Zhuo Fan as their hands weaved gestures.
“Mountain and Forest’s Shadow, the Crushing Mountain!”
Boom!
With Cong Shan’s shout, a yellow light shot straight for Zhuo Fan like a raging bull.
Such destructive power was enough to pulverize even the body of an Ethereal Stage expert!
“Mountain and Forest’s Shadow, the Spreading Forest!”
Hum~
As green light pervaded and rippled forward, Cong Lin’s eyes flashed, his hands making signs as he followed his brother to strike down Zhuo Fan.
Wen Tao’s brow shook. “The two sure are paranoid about being so cautious around Zhuo Fan. They’re using a different attack than they used on the six.”
“When dealing with the six Ethereal Stage experts, Cong Shan used power to shake the six’s attack’s momentum while Cong Lin used time to store up the attack as we saw. So the six palm attacks were all guided under the green ripples, turned back at the attackers. So in truth, the six did not lose to the two’s power but their own!”
Han Yunfeng nodded, “But this time, they switched tactics. Cong Shan became more forceful, like an earthquake, while Cong Lin forwent deflecting attacks for dispersion. If Zhuo Fan came at them with force, his attack would be useless, being redirected away from them. This combination is truly a great blend of power and flexibility, covering attack and defense!”
Wen Tao smiled and nodded, “It truly is a pesky little tactic, but do you know why they decided on using it?”
“Fear. Since storing power has its limits. Having not seen Zhuo Fan’s attack, they at least heard of it. So if the power was truly that overwhelming, Cong Lin had no way to contain it, leaving them crushed. To make sure that didn’t happen, he chose to deflect.” Han Yunfeng analyzed.
Wen Tao sneered and nodded, “Right you are. No matter how amazing their skills are, even they pale against relentless force. It depends on Zhuo Fan’s punch and how strong it is. Will he withstand Cong Shan’s brutal attack after Cong Lin’s deflection? By the way, you’ve seen Zhuo Fan’s punch, so what do you think of it?”
“See for yourself!”
The Han brothers returned to the screen.
[Stingy!]
Wen Tao shrugged and kept watching the events unfolding. Cong Shan and Cong Lin were right in Zhuo Fan’s face. The mighty yellow power was seconds away from blasting him, yet Zhuo Fan wasn’t doing anything, just standing there.
The audience was at the edge of their seats for what was about to happen to Zhuo Fan.
[Will, the legend of the darkest horse in history, fizzle out here and now?]
The Cong twins sneered.
[I knew it, the punk was nothing but talk all along. He’s nothing!]
[We are almost upon him, about to rob his life, yet he doesn’t do anything. This proves the rumors were exaggerated. He’s either scared to death or can’t even react. He’s no expert!]
[What expert would just let himself be pushed in a corner anyway?]
While the two were giggling to themselves for having this in the bag, a soft buzzing came, and the two’s scalps tingled for some odd reason.
Hum~
The earth started disintegrating a hundred meters around Zhuo Fan from the high-frequency vibrations. Cong Shan’s yellow attack was just about to strike.
A pity disintegrated the next moment into nothing.
At the same time, Cong Lin’s green light curtain started sporting black lines, running through it like a spiderweb before it collapsed.
The two’s eyes shook, and their hearts fell. They jumped back at once, looking at the still unmoving Zhuo Fan in shock and awe.
They watched as the rest of their attacks crumbled before their eyes. Even before they got out of the hundred-meter range, it had vanished. Moreover…
“Ah!”
Two wails of pain pierced the skies as, in that instant, their attacks fell through. They were also just one moment too late to clear the area. One hand from each of them was chipped away at high speeds before they also vanished.
All that was left behind was blood dripping from the stumps, a testament to the vibrations’ power.
[What the hell was that?]
Sss~
Watching how everything in a hundred meters of Zhuo Fan was pulverized, the audience gasped at the spectacle. Wen Tao and company were even bug-eyed.
Even Exalted Double Dragons’ eyes twitched in amazement.
[Just what is this astonishing martial art? It is beyond belief!]
Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed with four golden halos, and his mouth perked into a condescending smile, “Divine Eye of the Void’s 4th stage, absolute domain, Space Crusher!”
The twins looked at each other, and their gazes hardened. Zhuo Fan had been keeping to himself to a ridiculous degree.
[Who the hell is he? It’s not just about strength. Just how the hell does he know such baffling skills? ]
Glossing over their obvious shock, Zhuo Fan closed one eye and stopped the attack. His mouth traced a wide, bright smile as he jumped straight for the two.
The twins thought about running away. Zhuo Fan’s left hand turned into a dragon claw as it pursued Cong Lin while his right eye flashed golden twice with Void Annihilation, aiming for Cong Shan.
Cong Lin felt a chill down his spine.
[He’s not just what the rumors painted him, but far more terrifying!]
They had no chance whatsoever.
Though it was a bit late for regrets, they could only choke on it since they bit more than they could chew.
Helpless, Cong Lin had no other choice than to fight, shouting, “Mountain and Forest’s Shadow, the Spreading Forest!”
Hum~
Another ripple traveled from Cong Lin with a green hue.
“Wraith Style’s 2nd move, Ghostly Dragon Claw!”
Zhuo Fan snickered and went straight for it with a grab. However, Ghostly Dragon Claw’s power faded just as the ripple grew unstable.
[How amusing.]
Zhuo Fan smiled and let purple lightning flicker through the claw. As the purple lightning passed, the already strong claw gained an edge.
Crash!
With a huge bang, the green light around Cong Lin’s body was decimated, along with Cong Lin’s frail body.
Blood splattered everywhere, gore squelching as it touched the ground. Zhuo Fan’s claw had turned a human being in a shower of blood and giblets.
“Ah!”
The audience gasped and cried. Ye Lin’s eyes squinted, piqued by the appearance of purple lightning. “I was right, after all. That’s…”
Zhuo Fan stepped again with one down and closed in on Cong Shan.
Watching his brother reduced to fertilizer, Cong Shan was scared out of his mind. But even if he ran, could he escape the likes of Zhuo Fan?
Seeing Zhuo Fan upon him, he could only stake it all!
“Mountain and Forest’s Shadow, the Crushing Mountain!”
Boom!
He pushed out both his palms as he shouted. With a loud rumble, the yellow power rolled forward, like a thousand-meter tall mountain, straight for Zhuo Fan.
Such a blow would render anyone’s body to a pulp.
A shame he wasn’t dealing with just anyone.
In the face of Zhuo Fan and his Soaring Qilin arm famed through the world for its unmatched strength, he might as well be attacking with a toothpick.
Zhuo Fan’s mouth split into a nasty grin. His right hand flashed as he punched.
Boom!
The earthshaking sound came from Zhuo Fan’s sacred arm striking the yellow power the same way towering waves fell upon a sand castle. It crushed it to harmless motes of light.
What came next was a relentless gale that ripped at Cong Shan’s body. His figure was gone and replaced with a red cloud, raining down thick crimson droplets into red rivulets.
It was clear to all this was the miserable ending!

chapters.title: Chapter 659: Rain Check
chapters.content:
Chapter 659: Rain Check
Proofreader
: Papatonks
The once excited audience gawked. With how many of them were seeing Zhuo Fan’s handiwork for the first time, they were still reeling over how such a monster existed. His power was out of this world.
Everyone bore testament to the twins’ strength last time. They were no less than the level of the superior three sects’ disciples that proved to be a thorn in many of the middle three sects’ disciples’ sides.
Yet these brave and bright geniuses were squashed to nothing at Zhuo Fan’s hands with the lightest of actions and in the most horrendous way possible.
Zhuo Fan’s display had everyone shaking in their seats.
Even those that witnessed Zhuo Fan’s punch were still unnerved. That strike was unintended and random, while in this fight, the strikes were done with purpose and resolve.
The constant show of baffling martial arts had left the people thrilled.
“Every time I see him, it feels like he’s a new man, a new abomination. It puts all my effort into cultivation over the years to shame. Even if I were to fight him, I still can’t beat him.”
Xie Tianshang shook his head and sighed.
Wen Tao’s face twitched. “Tianshang, what the hell had your friend been eating to end up like this? He’s inhuman! And you, Han Yunfeng, didn’t you say he’s going to take fifteen minutes against the twins? He barely took a second!”
“How should I know?”
Han Yunfeng rolled his eyes, “I told you he’s terrifying. I bet the last punch wasn’t even his all. I just can’t imagine where all his strength ends. How could a freak like him be allowed in the Double Dragon Gathering anyway? How are we supposed to compete with that?”
Wen Tao eyed him and gave a firm nod of approval. Then his face fell as he spoke bitterly, “For crying out loud. I had confidence that many of my plans to deal with the Demon Scheming Sect would work. But how the hell will any of them work when they have such a freak? “
“Humph, ignorance is bliss. That so-called confidence was nothing but blind faith!” Han Yunfeng mocked.
Wen Tao glared, then sighed.
Others had it worse. Heaven Trailing Sect’s elder thought the challenge match with Demon Scheming Sect would still go to them. Now though, victory was the last thing on his mind. His team was going to be slaughtered!
That valley was a hellscape, fraught with one certain and imminent danger that would pull everyone in, Zhuo Fan.
[And to make matters worse, their leader Ren Cong is completely oblivious to it!]
And that was the truth of it. In that world, Ren Cong had warned the twins to go for Zhuo Fan from the start rather than picking up the leftovers from Demon Scheming Sect.
However, the fight was already over. This mighty young master Ren and the other disciple had not received any message either, a testament to how brief the fight was.
Elder Qi was most worried that the young master was still stubbornly holding on to his belief that the enemy was showboating.
[That’s suicide!]
Elder Qi felt like crying, his heart in a mess.
[The rumors were true, if not failing to live up to his power. The punk is a terrifying existence…]
Wu Qingqiu took a deep breath and sighed, “His reputation precedes him. Zhuo Fan is outstanding. There might not even be many from the superior three sects who can take the twins on, yet this guy did it like nothing…”
“You haven’t seen anything yet. Wait till he becomes a true savage. That’s when you’ll see his power!” Yan Mo recalled his miserable experience and sighed, “We didn’t even get to see his soul yet.”
Wu Qingqiu cried, “Soul? He’s in the Radiant Stage and already formed his soul?”
“Oh please, how the hell is he supposed to fight an Ethereal Stage expert if he didn’t have a soul formed?”
“I figured he has some defensive soul treasure on him. That and his incredibly strong body are what helped him score wins. At least, that’s how it looked until now. But if he has a soul formed…” Wu Qingqiu’s face was heavy.
Glancing over, Yan Mo sighed, “Here’s a newsflash for you. He doesn’t just have a soul form, but it is also something incredible!”
“How do you know? Did you see it?” Wu Qingqiu looked at him hard.
He nodded, then shook his head, “What I mean is, I sort of saw it and didn’t. At that time, he only half released it. Yet that was enough to almost take my life. If not for the girl in his arms stopping him, I wouldn’t be here talking to you.”
“You fought him and lost?” Wu Qingqiu gasped.
He knew just how strong Yan Mo was, while not better than him, of course, but he was a true expert in the western lands. The best genius in western lands could beat him, no problem, but getting him to leave his life was another matter.
It was this expert that almost got culled by Zhuo Fan’s power.
[Just what level is this guy at anyway?]
Wu Qingqiu turned a startled face at Ye Lin. “Junior brother, your opponent is freakishly strong.”
“Of course. How else is he to match me?”
Ye Lin grinned excitedly, “I told you, none of you are worthy of fighting him except me. Because we are destined rivals, he-he-he…”
Wu Qingqiu gave him a long look, then nodded…
Meanwhile, Zhuo Fan finished dealing with two flies and started looking around with a devious smile.
Zhuo Fan’s eye twitched and charged forward. He clawed at some bush and grabbed a mote of green, Cong Lin’s soul.
Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed golden again, and the mote vanished. Then he disappeared again, appearing high on a tree’s branch. He swiped his hand and caught a yellow mote this time.
It was Cong Shan’s soul.
With one last disappearing act, Zhuo Fan was back to his original spot, but this time with an extra nasty grin on his lips as he said to the two motes in his hands. “Go ahead, run! Did you think I didn’t see you slipping away when your bodies were pulverized? And you, Cong Shan, what the hell were you doing perched up there under a bird’s butt? Are you trying to become a chick in your next life?”
Demon Scheming Sect’s disciples snickered over. The two souls were shaking in fear.
“You picked the wrong guy to mess with this time. You up and challenged Steward Zhuo and got what’s coming to you. Ha-ha-ha…” Kui Lang patted the two souls and mocked them.
The others laughed along.
The Cong twins were ashamed, crying out in anger. “You destroyed our bodies, and now you dare kill us? We are from the Heaven Trailing Sect, the head of Tianyu’s three guardian sects!”
“Head my ass! When we kick you down a notch, we’ll be the head! Ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan grabbed the two and knocked them into each other so hard they saw stars.
The rest were laughing even harder now.
In flashes of light, Ren Cong and his gang entered the stage.
Seeing the Demon Scheming Sect team laughing and joking, Ren Cong looked around, puzzled.
[Where are Cong Shan and Cong Lin? Did they get sent to a different area?]
The plan was to go after Zhuo Fan to catch him off guard the minute they got here. But now, there was no sight of them, and the chance was lost.
As for the two in question being defeated, that never crossed his mind.
He wasn’t one to entertain such flights of fancies. The two managed to make it hard against all other middle three sects, so how would they get done in a flash?
But the cruel reality was he couldn’t even register what was before him. He just had to mess with the wrong person.
“Are you thinking they should have been on me the moment they came here?” Zhuo Fan mocked.
Ren Cong’s brow shook, and he looked at Zhuo Fan incredulously.
[How does he know that?]
Zhuo Fan grinned as if he had read his mind, then shook his head as he extended his palms holding the two motes. “Because they did it just now. A shame they lost, ha-ha-ha!”
Zhuo Fan squeezed, and under Ren Cong’s shocked eyes, he watched as the two cried their last and scattered into the air.
“From now on, the head of Tianyu’s three guardian sects has changed!” Zhuo Fan squinted.
Qi Changlong and the others behind him snickered, strutting for Ren Cong’s team with taunts and jeers.
From now on, Tianyu’s first guardian sect was taking a rain check…

chapters.title: Chapter 660: Sacred Mine
chapters.content:
Chapter 660: Sacred Mine
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Ren Cong squinted as he jerked in fright.
It blew his mind, and all his understanding, that Cong Shan and Cong Lin should charge one enemy only to be squeezed to nothing in the enemy’s hands. Such a display left him crushed!
And with his hopes gone, that left nothing but fear when he looked at Zhuo Fan.
He never saw Zhuo Fan in action, but this was enough to get it through his thick skull that the rumors were true enough to get him killed.
[He is a monster I can’t mess with!]
A shame he had done it already. However, he had more present and serious matters to worry about, like the ever-approaching Qi Changlong and his friends with cold smiles.
Now even without Zhuo Fan’s help, the six Ethereal Stage experts against the only Ethereal Stage expert on his side, him, and damn Radiant Stage experts, the rest could do nothing to curb the fear they all felt.
Ren Cong was sweating buckets, his mouth fell, and he teared up. His teammates looked at their young master with pleading gazes.
Even as they knew their young master was in the same boat as them.
Qi Changlong was coming down on them with a savage grin, snapping his finger joints as he made fists.
Ren Cong kept staggering away, filled with sweat.
“Young master Ren, who is the cat and who is the mouse, I wonder?” Zhuo Fan snickered.
Ren Cong gnashed his teeth and turned red in anger.
[The punk is mocking me!]
Zhuo Fan shook his head and smiled, “That’s right, I’m here to shame you, but on account of your exquisite manner yesterday, I am inclined to give you a chance. In a team battle, the rule says that the door outside will open after six hours, and the fight finishes regardless of the outcome. So didn’t you say you’re quite familiar with the area? So be a good mouse and scurry along for a hidey-hole. And if we find you all in the next six hours, then it’s only right that the cat gets to eat its prize, ha-ha-ha…”
Demon Scheming Sect’s disciples cracked up, filled with contempt for them.
Steward Zhuo wanted to toy with them to their last breath.
[He’s the same as Yan Mo!]
The audience chuckled and sighed.
[Such is the way of demonic cultivators.]
“All demonic cultivators are the same, I see. They just love making a show out of their savagery. Ha-ha-ha…” Wen Tao shook his head.
Han Yunfeng glanced over and said, “This is called absolute power. You think you’ll see something like this in an equal match?”
“True cruelty only shows when one side has an overwhelming advantage. Maybe Zhuo Fan is telling the others through this act that they shouldn’t mess with them no matter how strong they are.” Wen Tao sighed.
Han Yunfeng grinned, “Then will you still stand in his way?”
“Regardless of the outcome, I would be happy to know I could fight such an expert!”
Han Yunfeng’s heart shook and fell silent.
Wen Tao’s words cut deep.
Fighting a losing battle was unwise. From the sect’s standpoint, retreat was welcomed against an impossible adversary.
However, to a cultivator whose nature was to go against the natural order, they should fight regardless of adversity and brave any dangers. Having been close to the leadership of a sect, he had forgotten this simple truth, the basic nature of a cultivator.
If he balked in fear against this mighty opponent, how would he progress in his cultivation?
Suddenly, his eyes focused and flicked in Zhuo Fan’s direction. “It seems I was mistaken…”
Wen Tao eyed him and nodded with a smile.
[That’s how a demonic sect’s young master should be!]
“Ten, nine, eight…” Zhuo Fan lifted his arm and started the countdown. Kui Lang and company grinned in Ren Cong’s direction, waiting for them to flee like rats.
[I have never been more insulted in my entire life!]
Yet when it came to choosing between dignity and life, Ren Cong could only think of himself as he ran like the wind under the audience’s ridicule.
The other disciples thought even less, going after their young master like good gofers.
“Three, two, one!”
Zhuo Fan’s counting was slow, but it ended either way quickly. Kui Lang and the others grinned as they began the hunt. They sure loved playing around at another’s expense.
But just as they started, Zhuo Fan’s smirk started, “People, let’s all relish the game!”
They looked at each other and nodded before vanishing. Zhuo Fan smiled and was gone as well.
The little valley regained its tranquility once the game of cat and mouse began. The two gatekeepers closed their eyes, changing the screen outside the dimension by switching through the monitoring arrays already set up inside in search of any movement.
It didn’t take long for a Heaven Trailing Sect disciple to appear, frantic in his run for his life.
He barely made a few steps as Lu Xie came from behind. He pointed, and green light shot his ankle. Then thick green energy spread from his heel to the rest of his body.
“Hi-hi-hi, run, kiddie, run! The faster you go, the faster the poison spreads. And when it reaches your innards, you’re done for!” Lu Xie cackled.
The guy felt his heart beating out of his chest, and he was so scared he was close to soiling himself. Lu Xie, however, was enjoying the moment of tormenting the poor devil.
“Ah!”
Noticing the green energy was almost at his thigh, he could no longer tarry. He instantly chopped his leg off and started jumping around in an attempt to flee.
Lu Xie sneered and shot another green light on the other leg.
He was again forced to choose between his leg and his life.
The guy was horrified and crying in indignity while Lu Xie was taking his sweet time to see what he’d decide, to relish in his sweet torment…
It took only half an hour for the guy to be without arms and legs. Finally, Lu Xie cackled one last time and wiggled over.
The audience sighed in sorrow. Exalted Double Dragons did the same, but out of boredom.
Such an event was happening all over the place in that world. This was no longer a team battle but a one-sided slaughter.
[Just how on earth did Heaven Trailing Sect offend the Demon Scheming Sect to incur such cruel revenge?]
Holding their foreheads, the two exalted no longer bothered to watch and closed their eyes. However, none noticed that no matter how the view changed, Zhuo Fan was nowhere to be seen among the tortures.
He had been gone ever since the hunt began. It was as if he was no longer in there…
Whoosh~
Deep in the forest, a figure appeared. The proud Zhuo turned around and nodded, “Good, this must be the blind spot in the monitoring arrays.”
Then his hand held a sparkling and pure crystal, a sacred stone.
The black energy curled from his hand around the sacred stone and slowly dissolved it. Zhuo Fan focused on the drifting spiritual energy, following its every shift. Then his eyes lit up in glee, “Over there!”
He was gone once more.
This time, Zhuo Fan was sidestepping the monitoring arrays while following the flow of spiritual energy from the sacred stone until he arrived before an unending mountain. The spiritual energy was so thick here it felt like the previous valley could not compare.
To the point that the entire mountain range was like a bright azure dragon as it emitted spiritual energy.
“I knew it. This is a western land’s sacred mine. Who knew they’d sealed it up in here?” Watching the distant mountain range, his heart shivered.
The instant he got here, he was convinced that this place had to have a sacred mine.
But since this was someone else’s home, it was closely monitored. Looking for their treasury under Double Dragon Manor’s nose was asking for the noose.
So, the ingenious Zhuo Fan used Heaven Trailing Sect’s hunt to cover his tracks and let him inspect in peace.
That was why he kept telling the disciples to take it real slow, to give him time to have his share of fun.
Now that he was here, his doubts were cleared…

chapters.title: Chapter 661: Sacred Weapon
chapters.content:
Chapter 661: Sacred Weapon
Proofreader
: Papatonks
[From what Xie Wuyue said, the five lands’ sacred mines could only be exploited at the edges. Most of their ores are being protected by a strong array that can only be placed by the likes of experts from the Sacred Domain.]
Who then, besides him, blowing himself up and ending up in the mortal domain, would fall so low?
Moreover, the path to descend from the Sacred Domain was closed shut. Even a Saint would find it hard to breach it, to say nothing of the others.
[In that case, the answer couldn’t be more obvious.]
Squinting, Zhuo Fan pondered.
[This must be related to the five sacred beasts.]
Kunpeng had him look for the other sacred beasts while keeping young Sanzi hostage.
[That has to be it!]
Zhuo Fan looked around the place then his brow shook. “The sacred mine is so important that there are tens of monitoring arrays just a hundred meters from it. Not to mention they are all discreetly setup.”
“A shame you guys met me. When it comes to arrays, yours truly is your great-great-great ancestor, humph!”
Grinning, Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed golden. “Besides, you should now be drawn to watching Lu Xie and the other’s actions and have no attention to spare on me, he-he-he…”
Whoosh~
With a snicker, Zhuo Fan vanished. He kept showing up and disappearing all over the mountain range, but all were spots where the monitoring arrays could not reach.
Whoosh!
Zhuo Fan finally stopped before the dimly lit mouth of a cave.
As he entered, he did not trigger one of the hundreds of monitoring arrays outside.
He sighed in relief.
Zhuo Fan looked at the cave’s walls filled with sparkling crystals shining in a faint light. The sheer density of the spiritual energy was so great it gave him goosebumps.
His eyes lit up at the sight.
This was the entrance to the sacred mine, and these crystals were the sacred stones the vein formed.
All sacred mines had to be formed on top of a World Array to condense such a high concentration of sacred stones. That meant that apart from the sacred array, the sacred mine was not suitable for setting up other arrays, or it would end up disturbed by the natural power of the world.
Thus, Zhuo Fan was not worried there might be any monitoring or defensive arrays here. Unless, of course, they could set up sacred arrays.
Which was an impossibility in the mortal domain.
So Zhuo Fan just waltzed in curiously. He wanted to see who this expert was and what kind of an array he set up to protect the sacred mine.
Hum~
He barely took a few steps, and an ear-piercing ringing came.
His eyes shook, and Zhuo Fan stopped.
[What’s going on? Is there someone inside?]
Carefully walking deeper, Zhuo Fan noticed that the ringing intensified. When he reached the end, he was stumped.
A two-meter longsword covered in a prismatic haze floated just above the cave floor. It would sometimes shake and release a mesmerizing ringing sound.
The rich spiritual energy from the sacred stones converged on the longsword.
Like a newborn pup growing on the sweet milk, the long sword was also sustained under the sacred stones’ care.
“Is that a… sacred weapon?”
Zhuo Fan squinted and cried out. “By the looks of it, it’s even a 6th-grade sacred weapon, the strongest of the Sacred Domain!”
Above the 12-grade spiritual weapons were the sacred weapons!
Only a person from beyond the mortal domain could unleash this weapon’s true might. And since sacred stones were needed to refine them, making such beauties was an extremely complicated process. They were a rarity, even in the Sacred Domain.
At least, when Zhuo Fan was the grand leader of the Eight Emperors, he could only refine a 3rd-grade sacred weapon, and that was only in theory as well, having never actually done it.
The materials weren’t available everywhere either. Just going by the requirements of the sacred stone alone, he did not know just how many lands of the Sheng clan he had to cheat and how difficult it was to get them off his tail in the process.
He never expected the tiny mortal domain to contain such a beauty, the legendary 6th-grade sacred weapon. Such a wonder made his little heart flutter.
He had plenty of sacred stones on hand but no sacred weapon. Since he stumbled onto one, was he just going to pass by?
Zhuo Fan grinned and walked towards it. “Ha-ha-ha, I know that all sacred weapons have a conscious, so you must be able to understand me. Look, this place is so damp and gloomy, with no sunlight ever getting in. Aren’t you bored sitting here all day, every day? Why not join me out to play?”
Hum~
The sword understood Zhuo Fan’s intention and shook faintly before emitting a sharp light.
“Wait, wait!!”
Zhuo Fan jumped back at once and waved his hands. “I mean no harm and don’t intend to take you for myself. I know sacred weapons need sacred stones to shine and replenish their energy. I have plenty of them with me. If you come with me, you get to soar in the endless sky as we travel the world and have your fill of all you can eat. I’ll make sure to make you content.”
Zhuo Fan was like an uncle swindling children. He showed such an obscene smile too. His hand flashed and took out a sacred stone. “See, I’m not lying. I can replenish your energy just as well in my ring. The only difference is that you can also come out to stretch your legs.”
“Would you like to… check my ring for yourself? If you don’t like it, you’re free to come out. You’re a sacred weapon, and I can’t lock you up.” Zhuo Fan tentatively showed his Thunder Ring in enticement.
The longsword looked hesitant. It hummed and went still.
Zhuo Fan knew he almost had it and was bursting with excitement.
[Holy hell, I’m about to have the strongest sacred weapon! This is both of my life’s dreams come true!]
His trip to Double Dragon Gathering had paid off hundreds of times over. Even if he weren’t forced by Xie Wuyue’s task or Kunpeng’s threat, he’d have come here ages ago for this sweet trinket.
Hu~
However, just as Zhuo Fan was about to hoodwink the sacred weapon, a blue flame flared up from his Thunder Ring.
At the same time, Zhuo Fan’s forehead sported the same azure flame, his body crackled with purple lightning, and his right arm flashed crimson.
[What’s going on?]
Startled, Zhuo Fan was stumped.
A chilling bloodthirst swept the cave, and Zhuo Fan’s heart tensed as he looked incredulously at the longsword.
[What just happened? We were getting to the good part, so why the sudden hostilities?]
He didn’t have time to think as the longsword ruthlessly attacked him.
Whoosh!
With a cold glint, killing intent shot out of the longsword and reached Zhuo Fan in a blink.
Zhuo Fan squinted and hurriedly raised his right to block it.
Pff!
The most astonishing thing happened. Zhuo Fan’s invincible Qilin arm offered no resistance to the sword’s attack.
In a flash, gurgling blood flowed out of it, but Zhuo Fan was too stunned to realize it.
[H-how can this be?]
That was just sword energy, yet it pierced through a sacred beast’s body.
[Just what on earth is a 6th-grade sacred weapon made of to be so strong?]
Whoosh~
However, he had no time to ponder as the sword shook and rushed at Zhuo Fan, its blade shining in a dazzling light.
Zhuo Fan was horrified. For the first time, Zhuo Fan was scared to death.
Its sword energy was enough to pierce a sacred beast’s body. So now that it came for him, how would he stop it? It was going to make mince meat out of him.
Zhuo Fan panicked, not knowing what to do. Just as the longsword reached him, he was hit by a stroke of genius.
[Since you can’t beat them, flee!]
His right eye flashed golden, and Zhuo Fan had moved a hundred meters away in a blink.
As for the longsword, it lost its target and searched for him, unable to find him.
When Zhuo Fan appeared again, the sword closed in on him in a blink.
He cried out on the inside but did not dare to leave the cave, or those monitoring arrays would spot him. Zhuo Fan had no choice but to stay in this narrow cave and dodge the sword’s attacks.
This couldn’t go on forever since his Yuan Qi would run out if he kept this up. At the same time, the sword would keep replenishing its stores in this sacred mine. It could go on forever.
A fight for attrition was his worst gamble.
[For god’s sake, I’ll make another tunnel since there’s no other path. I could use it to escape the monitoring arrays and take to the skies!]
With that thought in mind, Zhuo Fan dodged one more time, and his right eye flashed with two golden halos.
Divine Eye of the Void’s 2nd stage, Void Annihilation!
Bam!
The space shook as the attack struck the cave wall, yet it bounced back. All the attack did was give the whole mountain range a good shake.
Zhuo Fan narrowed his eyes and panicked.
[Does that mean that since this is a sacred mine, breaking the space is still not enough to break the layers of sacred stones?]
But that wasn’t the end of his shock. The longsword was in front of him once more…

chapters.title: Chapter 662: Subdued
chapters.content:
Chapter 662: Subdued
Proofreader
: Papatonks
[Damn!]
Zhuo Fan narrowed his eyes and paled as his scalp went numb.
At this very moment, the longsword was already on top of him, just a hair’s breadth away. With Void Annihilation fizzling out, he had no more time to employ Shift.
His only fate was to be skewered to death!
Well, there was one option left, to use the Void Annihilation that had yet to disperse and route the longsword.
[Like that’s ever going to happen!]
Regardless of Void Annihilation’s strength, it couldn’t compare to the Qilin arm. If it got pierced by this thing’s sword energy alone, how could a mere Void Annihilation block the longsword’s attack?
Zhuo Fan was at the end of the road.
However, watching the longsword just about to tear him a new one, Zhuo Fan could only grit his teeth and risk it all!
[It’s worth a shot, even if it’s for nothing!]
Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed golden again, “Divine Eye of the Void’s 2nd stage, Void Annihilation!”
Hum~
Zhuo Fan’s right eye shot out a spatial ripple that collided with the longsword.
Clang!
It was like it hit metal. The longsword was pushed back by the blow. It flipped twice in midair before plunging into the wall filled with sacred stones.
Zhuo Fan was stunned, then he looked at his right arm, still bleeding heavily. With a flick of his hand, he smashed a big hole in the wall next to him.
[Sure enough, the Qilin arm is way stronger than Void Annihilation. So why couldn’t it defend against this sword while the latter could?]
Crack~
As he was sinking into his thoughts, the cracking from the wall jerked him away. The longsword twisted around in the wall and was fricking wiggling out of the stone and charging for Zhuo Fan one more time.
Zhuo Fan narrowed his eyes, his face solemn. He no longer hesitated to use Void Annihilation on the spot.
Bam!
The sword was spun through the air again on impact.
With a deep frown, Zhuo Fan was curious why the puny Void Annihilation succeeded where his prized Qilin arm failed.
[Maybe they’re naturally opposites?]
Zhuo Fan pondered over some more, and a realization struck him. Since Void Annihilation could handle it, what about the other skills of Divine Eye of the Void?
Whoosh~
The longsword was back again with a ferocious and far more savage attack than before.
Zhuo Fan narrowed his eyes, and this time Zhuo Fan no longer panicked. He was like an old fox biding his time for his prey to fall into his trap.
Finally, the longsword was within a hundred meters, and Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed golden four times. “Divine Eye of the Void’s 4th stage, Space Crusher!”
Hum~
The whole cave shook, and the sacred stones littering the walls fell to the ground. But that was a mere jiggle, unlike how it usually behaved outside, where it pulverized everything.
[It shows that a sacred mine is tough beyond reason!]
Zhuo Fan nodded inside, then returned his attention to the incoming longsword. It was also shaking all over as it stopped approaching. All it could do was tremble and shake in the air.
It couldn’t even get near Zhuo Fan to strike.
[Just as I thought, Divine Eye of the Void can restrain the sacred weapon.]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes narrowed, and his right eye flashed again in three golden halos. “Divine Eye of the Void 3rd stage, Mirage World!”
Hum~
Suddenly, the vibrations stopped. Only the longsword was enveloped in invisible fluctuations preventing it from stabilizing itself. It spun around in place, unable to make heads or tails of what was happening around it.
“Humph, since you don’t want to work with me and even tried killing me, there’s no need for you to have consciousness.” Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed with killing intent.
He knew fully well that sacred weapons had a mind of their own, and this one was no different, housing a spirit that controlled it.
Now he and the sword spirit were at odds. He would have to crush the spirit if he wanted to obtain the sword’s recognition. Therefore, he was using illusions to control the sword spirit and calm it down.
If a sacred weapon lost its sword spirit, its quality would fall sharply. He had to put another spirit in its place.
Zhuo Fan looked around, pensive. A flash of red came out of his body and sank into the longsword.
Zhuo Fan started making signs while shouting, “Demon Transformation Art, turning the sword as one’s own body, sword spirit renewal!”
Whoosh~
Black tendrils of energy flashed over the longsword along with Blood Infant’s creepy snicker. A cry of fear echoed out of the sword. It was the original sword spirit.
However, because Zhuo Fan suppressed its divine sense with Mirage World, it had no way to fight back even if it wanted to. As Zhuo Fan used the Demon Transformation Art along with the Void Annihilation, the sword spirit slowly disintegrated, becoming nourishment for the new sword spirit.
Hum~
With a light ripple, the hovering longsword started trembling, and its previous glossy and impeccable blade now slowly took on a black color while crimson stripes spread over its surface, making it let out a sinister aura.
Stopping Mirage World, Zhuo Fan beckoned, and the sword fell into his hand.
Looking closely at it, Zhuo Fan smiled in satisfaction. “Henceforth, the world has lost a 6th-grade sacred weapon, but it has gained a sacred demonic sword! Little guy, you shall now be the spirit of this sword and my Blood Infant, the strongest 6th-grade sacred demonic sword of the Sacred Domain! How awesome is that? How annoying I can’t unleash even a fraction of what you’re capable of, not as I am now at least.”
The sword shook, then it flew from Zhuo Fan’s grip. It spiraled in the air, and Blood Infant appeared in a flash of light.
Then Blood Infant shot into Zhuo Fan’s body without so much as a peep.
Zhuo Fan started, then he shook his head, “Little guy, are you trying to say that even if I can’t use the sword, you’re still one with me?”
Blood Infant simply rested in Zhuo Fan’s body, like a child having gone to sleep.
“No wonder you’ve been my Blood Infant for so many years. You’re so much better than some sword spirit. With you controlling the sacred weapon, I can rest easy, ha-ha-ha…”
Chuckling, Zhuo Fan’s hand flashed, and a dozen sacred stones appeared, bringing them to his stomach. “Though this sacred weapon needs sacred stones to replenish. Eat up, little guy, eat up and grow strong.”
Whoosh~
The sacred stones vanished, and when he looked inside, he noticed Blood Infant had taken them.
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “With so many sacred stones in me, I hope I won’t get kidney stones, ha-ha-ha. Wait, with so many sacred stones around, why the hell am I forking them out of my purse?”
Looking at the ground, it was now littered with sacred stones from all the shaking. He sighed.
[I’m so stupid.]
No harm was done since he would just take these pickings, which would be all the same.
Zhuo Fan had no shame whatsoever. But then he noticed his still bleeding right hand and frowned, “Returning Dragon’s Roar!”
Roar!
Following the roar, his hand was covered in a flash of green, filled with life, yet the Qilin arm was still wounded like before.
Startled, Zhuo Fan frowned.
[Is it that the Qilin arm can’t be healed, or maybe the wounds from a sacred weapon can’t be healed?]
Since this was his first injury to the Qilin arm, Zhuo Fan was a little unsure.
[Nevermind, I’ll just let it recover with time. After so many years, I ended up bloody wounded in action. I best keep this under wraps, or my actions here will be revealed.]
Holding some bandage, he wrapped it tight around his arm. Then he let his sleeve hide it before he went deeper into the cave.
In the end, his main objective was to investigate the array. He wouldn’t be at ease going back with just a sacred weapon.
“This is the place where the sacred mine is sealed. The cave couldn’t be dug any further since it must have hit a wall.” Touching the end of the tunnel, Zhuo Fan pondered.
He noticed light flowing along the wall, like some kind of barrier, covered in all kinds of symbols. His eyes widened, “I knew it. The one who set this array up must be a master. It’s so ingenious I can’t find the slightest weakness. It’s as if…”
Zhuo Fan narrowed his eyes, “It is just like Lightning Canyon’s who trapped Soaring Qilin. It can’t be the same person or expert that set it up, right? That would mean this was another remnant of an Emperor!”
[Just what on earth happened in the mortal domain in the past? Why would such an expert leave his mark here?]
Even with the Nine Serenities Secret Records, breaking through this ingenious array was impossible as he was now.
He only got to enter the Lightning Canyon because Soaring Qilin used its life to make a hole. As for the other two forbidden zones, he wouldn’t get in even if he risked his life. Their arrays were intact.
Forget about even getting in touch with those sacred beasts, not when he couldn’t open the door…

chapters.title: Chapter 663: As You Should Have
chapters.content:
Chapter 663: As You Should Have
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Tracing his fingers over the wall, Zhuo Fan was mulling over something. Then he opened his eyes wide, and two golden halos flashed in his right. “Divine Eye of the Void’s 2nd stage, Void Annihilation!”
Bam!
The spatial power struck the wall loudly. Then it was over. The barrier didn’t even shake.
Though it did flash a bit after as if to mock Zhuo Fan that he was all bark and no bite.
Zhuo Fan sighed.
[This array is ridiculously strong. Not even Void Annihilation, specialized in breaking arrays, can do a thing to it.]
He would never get it open as he was now, a mere ant against the world.
[My only choice is to wait until after I go beyond the mortal domain to try again.]
Zhuo Fan gave up the search and was about to return to the valley. However, he made sure to spruce this place up with how messy it was.
And so, without further ado, he picked the walls clean of any and all sacred stones.
By using Shift now and then, Zhuo Fan popped all over the mountain as he avoided the hundreds of monitoring arrays.
All he left behind was now a bare, dark cave like he was some thief who couldn’t get enough.
It was a good thing the Exalted Double Dragons didn’t see him, or they’d be spitting blood right about now. Those sacred stones were tens of times the reward the Double Dragon Gathering offered the nine sects this time. It took a thousand years to form, and yet they were gone just like that.
[May you rot in hell, Zhuo Fan!]
How fortunate indeed, the two exalted were oblivious. Of course, Zhuo Fan could never let them know, though his wounded right arm was a giveaway.
Zhuo Fan frowned and held it close. It was its first wound, and he was a little worried.
In the last few fights he had, no one could even scratch it, so coming out wounded all of a sudden would definitely attract the exalteds’ gazes.
[That’ll be bad for sure.]
Squinting, Zhuo Fan was pondering on a solution…
Whoosh!
An hour later, Zhuo Fan reappeared in the valley. Alas, gone was the natural beauty and lush scenery, now covered in ever-flowing blood that gave it a nasty stench.
One should not forget the constant symphony of wails and cackles that accompanied such a view. It brought this work of art to life.
Bang~
“Don’t hit me, please. I give, I give! Just let me go!”
“Damn you. Now you know when to surrender? What were you doing before then? Where’d your arrogance go? What about yesterday’s cockiness? Hi-hi-hi, if I don’t set you straighter than an arrow now, then I’m no Demon Scheming Sect’s disciple!” Kui Lang’s laughter echoed through the valley, filled with the promise of brutality.
Zhuo Fan looked around, and he saw punches and kicks raining down on one helpless victim. Gui Hu, Kui Lang, and the rest were dishing out all the beatings they could, like a master lashing out at his servant. As for the one who wailed beneath their feet, that was Ren Cong.
Yue’er and the girls stood aside with a thick, loathing gaze on their faces. When they noticed Zhuo Fan, they bowed, “Steward Zhuo, welcome back.”
“Did you get the prick?” Zhuo Fan asked.
The girls turned to the others and nodded.
Bai Lian bowed a bit as she reported, “Steward Zhuo, Heaven Trailing Sect’s disciples have all been killed, except Ren Cong. Based on his status, we can’t kill him. So we captured him, sealed his cultivation, and let the others thrash him until now.”
“As you should have. Ren Cong can’t be killed, or it will force Heaven Trailing Sect to desperate action.” Zhuo Fan nodded, then he showed a nasty smile, “Though that doesn’t mean we shouldn’t put him in his rightful place. Since he liked showing off yesterday, he-he, let’s show him how it’s truly done. By the way, how come you aren’t enjoying the kicking festival along with those guys?”
The three girls blushed and fell silent.
Zhuo Fan paused, but then he noticed something. “Ha-ha-ha, I get it. A lady is to be reserved and shouldn’t lower herself to such barbaric and vile actions. But as someone treading the demonic path, you should learn to let go. Come, let’s kick him a couple of rounds. It’ll make us feel better.”
Zhuo Fan waved as he strutted over. But the girls still hung their heads in the same spot.
“This isn’t like you at all.”
Zhuo Fan looked back with an odd gaze, “Especially you, Yue Ling. When you were the boss of the Labor Office, you were more arrogant than ever. Why the sudden shyness over kicking someone?”
“Steward Zhuo, uh, it’s better if you see for yourself.”
Yue Ling blushed harder and pointed at the crowd.
Zhuo Fan was intrigued now. Going over, he looked from behind the kicking frenzy, “A-he-hem, brothers, please make way. Allow me to join!”
“Steward Zhuo is back! Make way. Steward Zhuo wants to let off steam!” Kui Lang looked back, and his eyes lit up when he saw Zhuo Fan.
The others moved away with bright smiles, letting Zhuo Fan have his fun.
Now the scene was revealed in all its glory to him that had him stumped. He gave an odd look to the rest, especially those ‘shy’ ladies.
Now he got the gist of their reluctance.
Ren Cong was nothing more than a curled-up ball of bruises and wounds, twitching and even whimpering. That wasn’t the least of it, though, he was stripped of clothes, and blood was also gathering underneath him.
Zhuo Fan couldn’t help sneering at them, “You should know not to take it too far in your games. You even stripped him naked! He is, after all, the young master of the Heaven Trailing Sect. Doing this in front of thousands of people, he won’t have the shame to get out of his room!”
“He-he-he, that’s just what I wanted. I bet he won’t be able to get out of his home even back at his sect.” Kui Lang snickered. He pointed at the blood under Ren Cong and followed the trail of blood. “Look, Steward Zhuo!”
Zhuo Fan did look and was speechless before crying out, “You sure have… unique tastes.” He gave them a funny look, then gave a loathing handshake. “Next time, don’t talk to me. I am not a sicko but a perfectly normal human being. No wonder even Yue Ling, with her nasty temper, stood behind. You guys just aren’t normal.”
The three girls from afar shook and covered their ears, trying anything to stop hearing his words.
The curled-up Ren Cong twitched on cue, and his sobbing increased.
Kui Lang’s face twitched, “Steward Zhuo, who do you take us for? We’re not sick, at least not to that degree. Didn’t we vent for you? The prick had gone overboard yesterday, so… we used a club to…”
Kui Lang lifted a bloody wooden stick. Zhuo Fan hurriedly held his nose and jumped back a couple of steps. He glared at them in disgust, “Put that away, you filthy animals!”
“Animals, animals, wu~”
Ren Cong shook as he cried. For the first time ever, he agreed with Zhuo Fan.
Giving him a long look, Zhuo Fan shook his head, sympathizing with him. Then he turned to Kui Lang and the others, barking, “You’re the ones who’ve gone overboard! Ever heard the saying, death before dishonor?”
The guys were stumped. They did not get Zhuo Fan. Didn’t they do what he asked? Why was he angry?
Ren Cong lifted his wretched and crying face and gave Zhuo Fan a strange look. Was he the rescuer among this band of scumbags?
However, Zhuo Fan’s next line made his mouth twitch.
“Couldn’t you have just gotten rid of the flesh and taken a round with his soul? That kind of pain is the most exquisite. Moreover, it’s far less nasty and messy.”
[I should’ve known that all vile demons are the same!] Ren Cong thought.
With a plop, the club fell to the ground. Zhuo Fan spoke with deep loathing.
The others were stumped for a moment, then cackled.
“That’s the Steward Zhuo we know. Even if left alive, it won’t do without scarring him good. You’re the best team leader ever!” Kui Lang snickered and patted his chest, “Rest assured, sir! We shall have no compassion, no shred of sympathy, and will be sure to make him pay. Thrashing him was going too easy on him. It’s just that you said we should take our sweet time, so there’s plenty of stuff we haven’t yet tried, ha-ha-ha…”
[I told you to take your time so you could buy me time! It wasn’t so you could turn him into your punching bag.]
[Then again, the result ain’t half bad.]
Recalling his haul, Zhuo Fan grinned. Then he looked at the shivering mess on the ground, afraid the act was about to resume, and Zhuo Fan shook his head.
[This beating will leave a deep trauma in Ren Cong’s psyche. He’s done for.]
[Well, not my fault he had to prance in my face.]
[Hold on…]
Zhuo Fan squinted suddenly. Then he looked at his right hand…

chapters.title: Chapter 664: Respect
chapters.content:
Chapter 664: Respect
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Alright. Brothers, get rid of his body, and let’s have a go with his soul. One last push, and we’re done for today!” Gui Hu looked at everyone. He got Zhuo Fan’s implied meaning and acted accordingly.
With a nod, everyone returned to Ren Cong with a sinister smile.
Ren Cong was so scared he was shaking like a leaf.
However, with a spatial ripple as the only sign, a white pillar sprouted in front of everyone. At the same time, an aged voice echoed, “Alright, kids, that’s enough playing around. The six hours are up. The team battle between Demon Scheming Sect and Heaven Trailing Sect is over!”
“Over? Isn’t it too fast?” Kui Lang looked baffled. “We still haven’t destroyed this prick’s body. How come it’s over when we’re just getting started?”
The others’ interest fell at this point since the time was up.
Zhuo Fan snickered at Ren Cong’s scarlet butt and added. “Good things never last long. Now that the time is up, we must abide by Double Dragon Gathering’s rules and stop. When it’s all said and done brother Ren, you are still the young master of the Heaven Trailing Sect, the head of the Tianyu’s three guardian sects. We’re rivals on the battlefield but friends outside of it. Friendships come first and rivalry second. Do you think you can make it back, or do you need me to get someone to help you?”
[Hypocrite!]
Every face in the audience twitched, scoffing at him on the inside.
They bore witness to the true essence of a demonic cultivator, cruel to no end and a hypocrite to the core. And Zhuo Fan seemed to be the culmination of all evil.
Ren Cong’s face sank, silently taking out a shirt from his ring to put it on. Then he barely got his feet under him. He clenched his ass cheeks as he wiggled towards the saving light, soon vanishing.
Looking at each other, Zhuo Fan and Kui Lang laughed at his expense.
The girls only blushed harder and glared at them with a shake of their heads.
Zhuo Fan’s gang followed into the light right after. Their vision shifted from the mountains to the Double Dragon Manor’s arena.
Yet the welcoming committee was not in the least bit happy, showering them in scornful looks rather than applauses.
The team battle between Demon Scheming Sect and Heaven Trailing Sect was not as intense as the crowd hoped. Instead, it was completely one-sided. And at Zhuo Fan’s behest, it devolved even more into a sick chase for torture and pain.
[No, a sick game is more accurate!]
Because Heaven Trailing Sect’s people weren’t killed but toyed with instead. If one could still call it that, this fight was nothing more than a show of Demon Scheming Sect’s endless capacity for brutality and savagery.
Heaven Trailing Sect’s young master Ren Cong would have gone through even more cruelty if not for that title shielding him from death.
Not like this outcome was any better…
Shuddering, Ren Cong, with Elder Qi’s support, stood opposite of Demon Scheming Sect’s team. But his head was still lowered, fear having twisted his character from an overly proud man to the shell he was now. He was unable even to look his torturers in the eye.
Elder Qi saw his young master’s appearance and gnashed his teeth in hatred, glaring at those demons.
Not like Zhuo Fan and co. ever cared. They still bore that twisted smile from before. [Bring it, if you dare!]
The judge’s cold eyes swept both sides as he spoke, “In this team battle between Demon Scheming Sect and Heaven Trailing Sect, the former had sent in ten people and ten returned while the latter had sent ten and only one returned, a battle won by an absolute margin. Demon Scheming Sect, do you wish to keep challenging? Your next opponent is the second place in the middle three sects, Demon Soul Sect!”
“Damn right we are!”
Zhuo Fan blurted out without even thinking.
Judged had expected this kind of answer and continued, “Then you are free to decide whether it will be right now or after a rest of three days.”
“We didn’t even break a sweat. We fight now, of course!” Zhuo Fan snickered.
The judge nodded and turned to Demon Soul Sect. “Do you accept the challenge? If you don’t, it will automatically declare Demon Scheming Sect as the winner and you the loser!”
Han Yunfeng squinted in thought.
Zhuo Fan paused, giving him a long look. [Didn’t he say he’ll give up earlier? Why the hesitation?]
“We accept!” However, at this moment, Demon Soul Sect suddenly decided to fight. Turning to Zhuo Fan, Han Yunfeng was filled with battle intent. “The best choice is not to fight, but it will only leave us with regret. But don’t think for a second you can humiliate us as you did to Heaven Trailing Sect. Demon Soul Sect is filled with battle demons. We’ll rather die than be shamed!”
“Humph, we’ll just see about that…” Lu Xie snorted in contempt but was stopped by Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan gave him a long look and nodded, “Good, but you better come prepared. We’re not ones to go easy!”
“Humph, we don’t need your pity!” Han Yunfeng scoffed.
Zhuo Fan’s nasty grin resurfaced, turning to his team, “Demon Soul Sect is unlike the Heaven Trailing Sect. They won’t balk under fear. We can’t mess around with them and have to take them seriously.”
“But they only have two Ethereal Stage experts. Why so serious?” Kui Lang paused and gave the opponent an odd stare.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Look at their eyes, and you’ll see they have made peace with death. You might want to have fun, but they are serious. They won’t let it go your way. That is why it’s better to face them head-on and give them proper respect. They have come to the gathering fully aware that they might never return and are ready to go all out if they do; the true spirit of a cultivator. They are nothing like kicking around some wastrels. We need to act according to our opponents, some are to be toyed with while others should be shown respect!”
Startled, the gang turned in Demon Soul Sect’s direction.
Sure enough, although they were around the level of the Heaven Trailing Sect, they were determined to see this fight through, one way or the other. Despite witnessing how they trashed Heaven Trailing Sect, they still showed no fear.
“They really must be taken seriously!” Kui Lang took a deep breath and nodded. His face was solemn.
Looking at them, they were suddenly reminded of themselves from before. If not for Zhuo Fan bumping their strength, they would probably be at the level of Demon Soul Sect and could only throw their measly lives away in this Double Dragon Gathering.
They all let out a sigh of lament.
The judge turned from one team to another. “Disciples, please enter the Sumeru Dimension. The second challenge of the middle three sects challenge round begins!”
Zhuo Fan led his team towards the gateway. Han Yunfeng followed as well. Whether intentionally or not, Zhuo Fan paused for Han Yunfeng’s team to catch up.
Just like that, the two walked abreast, entering the valley simultaneously.
“The prick sure has his charm, not always an insufferable bastard.” Wu Qingqiu couldn’t help but smile.
Yan Mo’s eyes shook at the side, and he had to nod. “Indeed, Demon Scheming Sect is at its peak, and he should be brash and wild. But when he entered the valley, he chose to wait for Han Yunfeng to catch up and go in at the same time. It is a sign of respect.”
“That is true. Respect me, and I shall do the same. Insult me, and I’ll make you pay a thousand times over. It seems to me the fact that he drove Demon Scheming Sect into butchering Heaven Trailing Sect is justifiable. But all we saw in that battle was Demon Scheming Sect’s cruelty and not Heaven Trailing Sect’s arrogance. That is why we all labeled the Demon Scheming Sect’s men as thugs. This is why demon cultivators earned their bad name, ha-ha-ha… What a world!”
Eyeing him, Yan Mo nodded, “Who’d have thought a righteous disciple would know the toils of us demonic cultivators?”
“Ha-ha-ha, it’s because I’m a righteous cultivator that I need to have tolerance. Demonic cultivators are paranoid yet not necessarily wrong. I will not be prejudiced.”
Wu Qingqiu chuckled and said to Yan Mo, “By the way, I don’t find this Zhuo Fan that unreasonable. Just that he acts differently depending on the people and situations, while also a bit heavy-handed. You said he almost got you killed. How did you manage to piss him off?”
“Uh, well… it’s none of your business!” Yan Mo turned red and shifted his head away.
Wu Qingqiu snickered at his reaction.
[Demonic cultivators love to make a scene, are narrow-minded, and must have what they want. Therefore when the two of them meet, sparks fly. Sigh, while righteous cultivators love to don the mask of hypocrisy. That should level things out, right?]
Wu Qingqiu shook his head at this thought.
[Demons are frank and irritable, while the just are fake and calm. Though who can tell who is the demon and who is just?]
Meanwhile, when the two teams entered the valley, they stood across from each other. Zhuo Fan jumped and landed behind his team.
Han Yunfeng and the others frowned. Zhuo Fan, however, smiled, “I’ll say it again, who can get on my level? Pass all nine of them. Then you can face me!”
Han Yunfeng’s eyelid twitched, and he stared at Zhuo Fan furiously…

chapters.title: Chapter 665: Round Robin
chapters.content:
Chapter 665: Round Robin
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“That’s odd. How come the prick is up to his old tricks and won’t fight this time either?”
Wu Qingqiu’s side was puzzled as they watched Zhuo Fan. Hadn’t he always treated Demon Soul Sect with respect? Why the acting? Why the antagonistic display?
By not fighting in a team battle, he clearly looked down on them, holding them in contempt. His action was a hard and cold slap to Han Yunfeng’s team’s face!
Leaving the slapping aside, why lift their hopes just now only to knock them down again?
[Just what is that prick thinking?]
They would never have guessed that it wasn’t that Zhuo Fan did not want to fight. It was because he couldn’t.
His right hand got hurt from the brief encounter with the sacred sword. If misfortune had it that he exposed it, the Exalted Double Dragons would see it, and he’d be finished. As for his left, it was nowhere near that strong.
Favoring his weak left instead of that strong right would incur the same suspicion.
So the best way to avoid it all was to show off and stay out of it.
[If Demon Soul Sect had just forfeited and let me fight Sword God Sect’s Wen Tao straight out, then with his strength similar to a superior three sects disciple, it would fit my plan perfectly. Then I wouldn’t have to hide from anyone and not be so passive!]
[But just what the hell got into Demon Soul Sect all of a sudden? While I do admire their guts, they’re just too weak. I can’t fake it with these weaklings. It’ll only get seen through.]
[The only choice is staying still.]
Scratched his nose, Zhuo Fan sighed inwardly.
Han Yunfeng witnessed his action and was fuming mad, gnashing his teeth in hatred.
[What the hell’s the meaning of this? I get you look down on us, but did you have to do it in front of everyone? Won’t you even give us a few moves? Since you’re so stuck up, what’s with the show of respect from before in walking side by side? Are you toying with us?]
Han Yunfeng glared and said, “Zhuo Fan, I will make you fight!”
“Humph, to fight our Steward Zhuo, you’ll have to go through me first!” Qi Changlong stood in Han Yunfeng’s way. “This is a team battle, but we won’t take advantage of your weakness and will go one-on-one. If you have what it takes to beat our six Ethereal Stage experts, then there will be no one to stop you from fighting Steward Zhuo!”
[What, a round robin of one against six?]
Third young master Han cursed, “You have no shame at all. My brother is in the 2nd layer of the Ethereal Stage, while just three of you are in the 3rd layer. Why not ask him to stand still so you can beat him…”
“Quiet, brother!”
Han Yunfeng cut off the third young master Han’s rant, “If it’s a team battle, with only two Ethereal Stage experts, they could have two of theirs hold us back while the rest would kill our teammates. Then it will turn into six versus two. How long do you think we will hold on then?”
Third young master Han paused, then let out a long sigh.
Han Yunfeng’s eyelid twitched and said, “That’s why this round robin looks like one against six. The fights will never be one on one. This is in our favor. I accept! “
“Great, then let’s go!” Qi Changlong walked forward.
Giving Zhuo Fan a look from beyond the others, Han Yunfeng’s eyes narrowed. His body shook, and with a reverberating roar, a blue hundreds of meters tall winged lion appeared in a flash of light.
With its appearance, the temperature dropped sharply, and a biting wind formed that chilled one to the bone.
The crowd cried out.
[That’s Han Yunfeng’s soul?]
At once, the audience was boiling.
Everyone knew the soul was an Ethereal Stage expert’s strongest weapon but also its weakness. So unless they had no choice, the fight was to the death, or they did not fear a heavy injury, the average man would not take it out.
Since if the soul was finished, so were you!
So even in the middle three sects round, the audience had not once seen Ethereal Stage experts taking out their souls. Even when Ren Cong was being pummeled from all around, he would rather have his cultivation sealed than show his soul in fear of having it crushed.
No one imagined that in the second stage of the middle three sects challenge round, Han Yunfeng would actually lay his soul bare at the very start. He was ready to go all out!
“Elder brother!” His younger brothers cried in panic.
Han Yunfeng waved them not to worry, his face hard, “They are all tough opponents. I have to go all out from the start, or if the time drags out, it will work against me.”
“Ha-ha-ha, what a brave man you are, eldest young master of Demon Soul Sect. Then allow me to accompany you with my own soul.” Qi Changlong laughed and felt as if he had met a kindred spirit. His body shook, and yellow light spilled from him.
In a blink, a huge seal of sixty meters appeared overhead, giving an oppressive feeling.
Wu Qingqiu’s brow shook, and he cried, “It’s actually a rarely seen tool soul, the Seal of Upheaval!”
“Correct. Souls are commonly divided into beast souls, elemental souls, and domain souls. As for this tool soul, despite being rare, it is on the same level as a beast soul. And Han Yunfeng’s soul is that of Ascending Howling Lion. Of bitter cold and extreme yin, the opposite of the seal’s extreme yang. This makes it that the match will be decided on the strength of their souls!” Yan Mo nodded as he analyzed.
Ye Lin looked from the side, bored. “It’s Han Yunfeng’s win.”
“Why?” Startled, the two turned to him. Reason dictated it should be Qi Changlong who won since he had the higher cultivation.
Ye Lin huffed, “Because he stakes his life!”
Bam!
The loud sound came just as Ye Lin finished. Ascending Howling Lion and the Seal of Upheaval clashed in a terrifying rumble.
However, in that short exchange, the Seal of Upheaval had five claw marks, with ice spreading around them.
Pff!
Qi Changlong shook all over and spat blood. At the same time, he took back his soul. He cupped his hands in admiration. “Respect!”
“You’re too kind.” Han Yunfeng returned his gesture even as his brow was soaked.
Should this be his victory? He was, in fact, the more injured party of the two.
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, and he admired Han Yunfeng.
[The kid is a damn feisty guy. He’s unlike those fake young masters from sects and even staked his life on the first attack. His upbringing must have had a heavy role to play in it.]
[Demon Soul Sect is remarkable.]
Wu Qingqiu’s brow shook as well, “How can there be a fight like this in this day and age? As the forefathers say, ‘pride comes before the fall.’ Even in a life and death struggle, one holds back some energy just in case, to change the tides and win or escape. But this guy had put up all he had and more, cutting off all his paths. If he couldn’t have shaken off his opponent in the first strike, he would have been dead by now. The guy is ruthless! “
“He is staking his life just for the chance to fight him. How can you guys even understand him?”
Ye Lin mocked, “He has to fight six people, even in rounds. Even if he comes out victorious, he will be exhausted to death. The only way to save energy is to go out in full force. While he gives his life in every exchange, his opponent doesn’t have the nerve to meet him. This leaves him with a margin to win and conserve his strength. But even so, one cannot say just how much energy he’d have left in the end.
“By the way, Yan Mo, you said you wanted to spar with senior brother. But do you have the courage and thirst as he does?” Ye Lin asked Yan Mo.
Yan Mo’s brow shook as he watched the next fight. This time Bai Lian went forth only to be defeated in one strike. But even though he saw Han Yunfeng panting, Yan Mo shook his head with no admiration for the man.
[This guy is consumed with cultivation.]
[Doesn’t the demonic path contain obsession as well? This is the road he is walking!]
Huff~
Despite having only struck twice in the valley, Han Yunfeng was breathing heavily, his head soaked in sweat.
His brothers rushed over to help him. “Brother, are you alright? Let’s just forget it. They’re making it hard for you and toy with you. With the way you are now, what’s the point of defeating the six of them when you won’t be able to even stand? This is pointless!”
With a slight twitch of his eyebrows, Han Yunfeng slowly looked at Zhuo Fan, only to see his solemn face and bland look. As if he looked down on him.
Taking risks despite knowing it would fail was useless!
But when Wen Tao’s words came to him, that cultivation meant going against the natural order. If he lost this chance to fight the strongest, he would feel regret for the rest of his days.
Han Yunfeng once again straightened his back and took a deep breath as he stared at Zhuo Fan.
[Even if you do not put me in your eyes, mine will always be on you. My cultivation will never stop!]
“Yes, that’s the way, demonic young master!”
Wen Tao spoke as he witnessed the fights. “This fight isn’t to defeat him but to prove you fear no challenge. This is the only way you can go further!”
Xie Tianshang, next to him, looked at Han Yunfeng and then at Zhuo Fan. He nodded.
Just like when he set Zhuo Fan as his rival, it wasn’t to surpass him per se, but for himself to never stop pushing forward…

chapters.title: Chapter 666: Soul Burst
chapters.content:
Chapter 666: Soul Burst
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Young master Han, your next opponent shall be me. I won’t be like the two you faced and won’t hold back at all. Please be ready.”
Lu Xie walked before Han Yunfeng with a leisurely gait, bearing a twisted smile.
Glaring at him lightly, Han Yunfeng said, “I know. These days have shown me that you are the foulest person of all Demon Scheming Sect, ha-ha-ha…”
“You’re asking for it!” Lu Xie’s face fell, a bone-chilling bloodthirst flashing in his eyes. Then his body shook, and a huge green spider appeared in front. The green gas it released spread along the ground like a poisonous net.
Han Yunfeng’s brow shook and turned serious. He’d seen Lu Xie use this move before, with Mystical Heaven Sect, to cut the enemy off from all directions.
In other words, Lu Xie planned on surrounding him instead of attacking him head-on; to finish in one move.
In this way, he became passive, making his plan to save energy fail here. He was sure this would become a stalling battle to wear him out instead.
If it were just a single fight, this wouldn’t matter. But in a round-robin, he could not let this happen.
Qi Changlong couldn’t help but sigh, “Why is Lu Xie doing this? For young master Han to fight all six of us is incredibly brave. Even if we are not exactly honorable, there’s no reason to take it so far.”
“You know as well his character. It’s obvious one strike can win this. It’s easy to win or give him a pass, but he would rather toy with him.” Bai Lian scoffed, “He plans on dragging this own, something Han Yunfeng could never accept.”
Qi Changlong sighed and shook his head…
Meanwhile, Han Yunfeng looked around the spreading poison, and with a roar, the Ascending Howling Lion flapped its wings. The fierce gale slammed into the ground, turning the area around him into sparkling blue ice crystals.
It was then that the spreading poison stopped. The moment the green gas touched the crystals, it would stop in its tracks.
Han Yunfeng shouted, and Ascending Howling Lion shot for the green spider, going all out once more.
[Humph, useless. I’m not going to take you head on.]
Lu Xie snickered and made a sign. The green spider scattered like before into thick mist. The thousands upon thousands of tiny spiders raced for Han Yunfeng under the cover of the mist.
Whoosh~
Ascending Howling Lion’s strike hit nothing, but it turned back and went straight for Lu Xie. Ignoring the incoming flood of spiders, he actually opted to go down with his enemy!
“Han Yunfeng is truly ruthless. Meeting someone like Lu Xie, who wants to exhaust him, he instead stakes his life, going all out!” Wu Qingqiu sighed.
Yan Mo nodded, “The kid’s obsessed, and I like it. I hope to see him in the Double Dragon Manor.”
“For a person from middle three sects and just a 2nd layer of Ethereal Stage as well, it will be hard to enter Double Dragon Manor.”
“It’s all up to the Exalted…” Yan Mo and Wu Qingqiu turned to the highest seats in the audience, where the exalted sat.
Lu Xie looked at the lion with a smug grin, “Ha-ha-ha, the more anxious you are to end this, the more you’ll tire.”
Lu Xie made another sign, and lines of green flashed all over the lion. Just like a net, those lines connected and trapped it.
At the same time, the green pattern on the ground released green smoke, connecting to the net.
Roar!
With a mighty roar, the lion found it could not advance at all, stuck in place.
Grinning, Lu Xie gave Han Yunfeng a cocky look, “Young master Han, it’s your bad luck to have met me. Do you know how a spider feeds? It traps its prey in a web, letting it struggle and beg for death, then slowly eats it alive. This is quite a lengthy process too. You were rash for a quick battle, but then you got me, hi-hi-hi…”
“Humph, that remains to be seen if your net is that tough.” Han Yunfeng made a sign as his brow sweated harder. The lion roared as it struggled, and it trembled.
Uncaring about the lion’s actions, Lu Xie grinned, “Poison Explosion!”
Boom~
The lion’s body kept popping with great bangs sounding through the air. Han Yunfeng shook with every blow and even coughed up crimson blood.
“Brother!” Third young master Han and second young master Han cried out in panic.
The flying lion was Han Yunfeng’s soul. Its wounds meant Han Yunfeng’s soul wounds. It was such a heavy and sharp pain few could endure.
The two gnashed their teeth and looked at Lu Xie in hatred.
But Lu Xie only laughed, “Young master Han, you’re Demon Soul Sect’s eldest young master, so I can’t take your life, but you should know when to give. It’s time for you to admit your defeat to me. This is as far as you go!”
Han Yunfeng was Demon Soul Sect’s young sect leader, and defeating him would give him great merit back at the sect. Lu Xie was blinded by greed, so he did not follow in Qi Changlong and Bai Lian’s footsteps in fighting head-on.
Victory and merit were worth more than anything. He would be willing to do anything as long as it would help his ascent.
Han Yunfeng’s face twitched in pain, but he actually mocked Lu Xie, “Kid, you’re not worthy!”
“We’ll just see about that!”
Lu Xie’s face fell, and his sign changed. The thousands of tiny spiders charged for Han Yunfeng, but they froze in place when they touched the blue curtain of light.
Just then, Lu Xie shouted, and the tiny spiders exploded, breaking through the blue curtain and allowing the spiders behind them to advance.
Han Yunfeng was now at his most dangerous. With a string of constant explosions, the barrier of light shrank more and more until it was gone. Lu Xie trapped his flying lion, and explosions also assaulted it.
He was stuck, unable to neither attack nor defend.
Han Yunfeng’s face was heavy, feeling the sharp pain stinging his soul. He paled, and Lu Xie grinned as he changed his signs.
The spiders drew nearer with every step, every second, and with them, Lu Xie’s web closed around him.
Everyone, including the audience, was at the edge of their seats for Han Yunfeng’s fate.
Third young master Han shouted, “Brother, just give up! You defeated two experts and are weary. It’s no loss even if you concede!”
“This isn’t about reputation, but whether I can walk further on the path of cultivation.” Han Yunfeng’s eyelids shook, looking in Zhuo Fan’s direction. His eyes flashed and roared as his aura exploded once more.
“Brother!” His brothers cried out in worry.
“What’s he up to?” Wu Qingqiu was startled, having a bad feeling.
“Soul Burst!”
Han Yunfeng made a sign.
The trapped flying lion wailed in pain and then exploded. Streams of blue light shot in all directions like a tidal wave.
Everywhere and everything froze under a layer of blue crystals. Those spiders were about to explode again, but they froze immediately before shattering to dust.
Pff!
Lu Xie spat blood, looking at the light show slowly diminishing. Followed by a roar, a lion without wings burst out and came for him.
The sudden impact caught Lu Xie off guard knocking him flying, trailing blood behind him.
This was not as light as before, with just his soul a little bit shaken up. This time his entire innards were crushed, and there was a high chance his body was ruined.
However, the people did not care about him, not even Demon Scheming Sect’s members. In their eyes, there was a lion that had lost its wings, and despite its thinned state, it held its pride as it lay on the ground…

chapters.title: Chapter 667: Man on the Path
chapters.content:
Chapter 667: Man on the Path
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Young master Han, why did you do that?”
Watching the weak and frail lion lying on the ground since it struck Lu Xie, Wen Tao shook his head, “If I had known you were so obstinate, I wouldn’t have said what I had. Seeing you fall in such a plight feels like I harmed you myself.”
Xie Tianshang’s eyes shook as he stared at the scene for a long time before sighing, “I had spent my life only on martial arts, yet not even that can compare to Han Yunfeng’s accomplishment.
