Wu Qingqiu, next to him, shook his head. Not just Zhao Dezhu, but even the entire Universal Righteous Sect, would become western lands’ laughingstock.
And they did it with their own two hands.
Wu Qingqiu smiled, seeing everyone around him having the time of their lives.
The only one who wasn’t that pleased by the teasing was Zhao Dezhu…
His face twitched, and he glared at Zhuo Fan as he ridiculed him. He passed through the curtain of light and returned to the arena.
Next was Demon Scheming Sect vs. Hellion Flame. But because Hellion Flame had suffered great damage in their fight with Ultimate Clarity Sect, the fight didn’t last long against Zhuo Fan, even with Yan Mo giving his all.
At long last, Demon Scheming Sect was facing the strongest of the nine sects, the Ultimate Clarity Sect. Zhuo Fan was now standing across from his strongest opponent, a fellow sacred beast inheritor, Ye Lin, the Decimating Dragon Ancestor’s disciple…

chapters.title: Chapter 694: Fighting Ye Lin
chapters.content:
Chapter 694: Fighting Ye Lin
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Roar!
The crowd was beyond excited now that the time had finally come to see these two teams face off and fight for the crown!
On one side was the strongest sect in western lands, under Double Dragon Manor and above many, the Ultimate Clarity Sect. For thousands of years, their position had been firm, with no one able to challenge them.
On the other side was the greatest underdog the history of Double Dragon Gathering had ever seen, hailing from the lower-three sects and killing their way up. Even though everyone knew it was due to one man alone, that wasn’t enough to wipe out the excitement the crowd had felt throughout its journey in this competition.
As this underdog pulled down one sect after another, the people’s hearts were in their throats, thinking the next one would be the one to cast them down.
Some even hoped that a sect could halt this rampaging dark horse in its tracks while at the same time wishing to see it reaching higher and higher, doing something that had never been done in ages.
This contradiction further increased their expectations for what Demon Scheming Sect was about to offer in this fight, one between the current and prospective kings. Would Ultimate Clarity Sect rule unfazed for ages more, or would the new reign of the Demon Scheming Sect over the nine sects be established?
It wasn’t just the audience. Even the nine sects’ teams were tense. Their nerves stretched taut, as were their muscles.
“How many years has it been since we last saw such an exciting match?” Exalted Bai Mei let out a refreshed smile.
Exalted Hei Ran nodded, “The sects haven’t shifted their seats in thousands of years, letting the western lands enjoy peace. But sooner or later, someone will come and change all that. This is for the best. The shift in order will drive the sects into teaching their disciples harder, ha-ha-ha…”
Exalted Bai Mei nodded, the eyes of both of them settling on Ye Lin and Zhuo Fan. They knew the outcome of this fight rested entirely on their shoulders.
As for the rest, except Wu Qingqiu, all were useless no matter how hard it was to accept.
As long as anyone in the audience wasn’t completely blind, they would also look at the two in excitement.
This fight wasn’t just to settle who was the top superior-three sect, but also who was the best disciple in the western lands, the future best cultivator in the western lands…
“The two teams are here. Now I know what your intentions are, I still need to ask you. Demon Scheming Sect, do you want to challenge the head of the nine sects, Ultimate Clarity Sect?”
The judge was fired up as well. He hardly used the ‘head of the nine sects’ title in his announcements. This clearly showed he wanted to spur them on.
Not even he could stay calm in front of this excitement. The audience started chanting, “Fight, fight, fight…”
“As you all wish, we shall fight!” Zhuo Fan raised his fist, shouting.
The cheers reached the heavens once more. The judge nodded and smiled, “Open the dimension!”
Hum~
The two gatekeepers once again opened the door to the secret valley. Wu Qingqiu smiled at Zhuo Fan’s team, taking the lead to go through first.
Zhuo Fan’s eyelid twitched, touching his ring. He then led his team through. He didn’t forget that Danqing Shen was still hiding in his ring. He had to think of a way to let this old coot slip out with none the wiser.
As for the right timing, he would have to wait it out.
Zhuo Fan’s mission weighed heavily on his shoulders. He not only was going into a fight to the death with Ye Lin, but now he had Danqing Shen to worry about.
Any of these two tasks could be done alone if he put his all into it. But since he had to do them at the same time, that required some careful planning.
At the very least, it would require some skill if he wanted to get the ring back after throwing it without raising any eyebrows. He did have a plan in mind, but it was all up to Ye Lin and his role in this act.
Easing a breath, Zhuo Fan focused as he stepped through the white curtain. He was back in the small valley.
This was his sixth time here, and he was quite familiar with it. He knew where the monitoring arrays were placed and where their blind spots were.
Hum~
His teammates followed next, and the two sects faced each other.
“Ha-ha-ha, brother Zhuo is so strong that I have been eagerly waiting for us to fight. A shame that this is not my chance. My younger brother insists on letting him have you. I am not one to take this joy from him and would have to settle for the next time.”
Smiling, Wu Qingqiu backed away, cupping his hands at Zhuo Fan and his team. He went before Ye Lin and said, “This might be a team battle, but we also understand the situation of their sect. They have only one person able to bear this fight, so we will also have just one person settle it. As we watch from the sidelines, I will let junior brother represent us on the field.”
Ye Lin walked forward, bearing a wide smile.
Qi Changlong and the others felt down. Wu Qingqiu was right, without a doubt, but he was being modest about it. Though the way it was registered, it felt more like contempt.
As if they only managed to get so far on the back of one person. They were utterly useless.
[We know that’s true, but could you at least not say it? It hurts our feelings!]
Zhuo Fan noticed their annoyance and slowly moved forward as he stared at Ultimate Clarity Sect’s team, “Brother Wu is right. Our two sects’ fight has to be one on one. But once the battle starts, even if your disciples want to help, they are not to interfere. What do you say?”
“Right, that’s how it should be, ha-ha-ha…” Qi Changlong, Kui Lang, and the others laughed.
Zhuo Fan said in reply to his statement.
[You dare call us useless? Once these freaks fight since you won’t be joining either, you’re just as useless!]
[Besides sounding nice, it’s just conforming to our intent of having a one-on-one fight. Actually, none of you have what it takes to join the fight. Even if you do, you’ll be nothing more than cannon fodder. So what’s so funny?]
Holding his forehead, Wu Qingqiu smiled and shook his head.
He did not deny it. Since his words were heard by all, he still had to keep his earlier words.
However, Ultimate Clarity Sect’s disciples grew angry at being disregarded by a lower-three sect.
The audience saw the two sects were ready to fight and throwing verbal attacks. They grew even more excited.
[The fight is bound to be intense!]
“Junior brother, aren’t you going to say something? Say what you feel!” Wu Qingqiu saw his junior brothers were fuming and asked Ye Lin.
Ye Lin eyed him and scratched his head before nodding. He turned to Zhuo Fan and admitted, “You’re right. These people, besides senior brother Wu, can be ignored. This fight is between you and me!”
Wu Qingqiu’s face twitched, and he held his forehead. His junior brother had always been a lone wolf.
[He doesn’t know anything about respect for his fellow man.]
The others cursed. For him, though, it didn’t matter if the sect hated him.
The Ultimate Clarity Sect’s disciples looked on with dark glares and shook their heads.
[This little junior brother is a professional at making fun of others.]
They were clueless that Ye Lin took pride in his status as a sacred beast inheritor. So how could he give a damn about some common folks?
In his eyes, even Wu Qingqiu wasn’t worth it. He only treated him better since the senior brother had looked after him all these years. Only Zhuo Fan was like him, a grand sacred beast inheritor.
“All of you stand back. I don’t care if any of you die from our fight’s aftershocks.” Ye Lin flicked his hand with a stern look.
The others knew his temper and shook their heads as they cleared the area.
Taking his time walking forward, Zhuo Fan looked around this place.
[This is a good spot.]
He signaled Qi Changlong and the others to leave, “Stand a mile behind me, less you want to be squashed.”
They all started, but they left either way.
[Why is it that he insists on standing behind him?]
Zhuo Fan had just found a blind spot in a monitoring array. With the disciples in this area, it would be easier for him to get Danqing Shen out of his ring.
So even while they were clueless, they trusted Steward Zhuo, doing what he said.
Everything was in place. All that was left was to fight!
Zhuo Fan focused his eyes and shot forward, his right hand unleashing a terrible red glow.
Ye Lin grinned and faced him head-on with a golden flaming glow. He reached Zhuo Fan even faster than the other, the golden flaming fist punching forward…

chapters.title: Chapter 695: Melee
chapters.content:
Chapter 695: Melee
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Eyes squinting, Zhuo Fan was startled. Although he knew that Ye Lin was fast, he didn’t expect him to be that fast. He was now seeing just how fast he was with his own eyes.
It felt like he was in front of him in a blink, almost faster than he could react.
With little choice against the sudden punch, Zhuo Fan had to withdraw his earlier attack, turning it into a block. Even so, he had lost momentum.
Bam!
The explosion resulted on impact unleashed a ray of violent golden flames while Zhuo Fan was sent flying. The scorching heat was enough to feel pain even from his Qilin arm.
Zhuo Fan’s face looked grave.
The fiends were more shocked than ever, “How can this be? Steward Zhuo actually lost in terms of raw power?”
Zhuo Fan was just as shocked as they were.
He used to think that when Ye Lin refined Decimating Golden Flame of the Decimating Dragon Ancestor, his power was destructive in nature, not physical.
So as long as he avoided clashing with it, even if he traded fists with his mighty Qilin arm, he should be able to get the upper hand against him.
However, Ye Lin’s body was so tough it didn’t lose out against the Qilin arm at all.
[Are you telling me he’s not human but a damn dragon?]
But Zhuo Fan shook that thought away. A real dragon taught by the dragon emperor had to be a little more freakish like young Sanzi. So while he was strong, it was nowhere near young Sanzi’s terrifying level.
[Did he refine his body as well?]
Frowning, Zhuo Fan looked ahead just in time to see Ye Lin’s evil look. That fist unleashed golden flames that burned everything it touched.
Golden scales appeared on the fist, emitting sharp glaring lights.
Zhuo Fan now understood. Those were dragon scales.
[This guy is anything but a plain human. A half-dragon half-human at the least.]
But this robbed Zhuo Fan of any chance of winning in melee.
He only had the arm of a Qilin. Everything else was pure human. Who knew how many changes his opponent had?
If his entire body was turned draconic, that would be bad. He had no hope at all in close quarters.
Frowning, Zhuo Fan’s face was wrought with worry. Chu Qingcheng stared at the screen just as worried.
She had never seen Zhuo Fan show such a serious face in a fight. While he faced Huangpu Qingtian and was once surrounded by the expert of the seven houses, he always found a way out, even if at a disadvantage. He not once looked as lost as he was now.
Ye Lin was just too strong, as anyone could see. He might even be stronger than him. But that was not the reason for his worry.
He was faced with the same situation before. So why was he showing such a weakened look, like he was about to lose?
Chu Qingcheng’s fist tightened, so nervous her hands were sweating.
The two only clashed once, but it was clear to anyone how matters stood between them.
Zhuo Fan was on the defensive. This single strike had almost already decided how this fight would end…
Whoosh~
Ye Lin snickered and capitalized on his advantage. He again shot for Zhuo Fan, fist forward, as he changed into a gold light.
Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed in a golden halo, and he was gone, reappearing behind his opponent and striking his back.
This fist carried all his power, the Qilin arm exploding with red light. And this was something Ye Lin’s golden fist could not block.
However, just as Zhuo Fan was about to hit, Ye Lin’s other hand was encased in golden flames as he flicked it behind, meeting the Qilin arm.
A rumble like no other echoed, one born from the striking of two arms unseen in the mortal domain. It unleashed frightening spacial waves and searing golden flames everywhere around them. It left nothing but destruction in its wake.
A thousand meters around them was leveled in a blink, removing from existence even the dust. All matter trapped in this area had been wiped out of existence.
Sss~
Everyone gasped in fright at such a sight. Especially Ultimate Clarity Sect and Demon Scheming Sect’s teams. They were so scared that they were sweating buckets.
Wu Qingqiu’s eyes shook as he had a bitter smile.
As the audience enjoyed the show, the experts noticed something more.
The average man wouldn’t care much about what he saw, only finding it strange at best. It was common for the ground to be leveled when two fought.
Even Radiant Stage experts could do it. There was nothing to it.
However, the crux was this was not just simply leveling the playing field but clearing it out. To the extent that not a single particle of dust remained. This showed the two’s raw power and how focused it all was.
Not even experts above the Ethereal Stage could unleash such pure Yuan Qi that it could erase matter from existence.
Yet these two did it through Zhuo Fan’s power and Ye Lin’s golden flame.
This was the purest power the five great sacred beasts had refined from the primal chaos.
Exalted Double Dragons were overwhelmed.
[How the hell did these two freaks train to be so abominable?]
Pff!
With a groan, the two separated from their second clash, evenly matched. Zhuo Fan’s hand was somewhat singed and he was gasping a hundred meters away from the burning heat he felt on it.
Ye Lin’s hand was shaking nonstop and even looked inflamed. Soaring Qilin was famed for its great strength among the five great sacred beasts. Even with the dragon scales protecting him, Ye Lin still suffered damage.
However, he wasn’t angry but excited. With a manic grin plastered on his face, he muttered to himself, “That’s how a sacred beast inheritor should be. Soaring Qilin’s punch is indeed fearsome. He-he-he, the dragon soul used Soaring Qilin’s power, and so did that punch. I already know who your master is. Now I don’t have to hold back. Soaring Qilin is the top of the five great sacred beasts when it comes to raw power, but you’re just a Radiant Stage cultivator, not in the Ethereal Stage. For anyone else, using the Qilin arm is enough, but against our kind, this is nowhere near enough to win.”
Ye Lin turned into another golden light as he shot for Zhuo Fan again. His hands, encased in golden flames, were seeping with bloodthirst. It caused Zhuo Fan to gasp from way over there.
The first two clashes were a warm-up.
[Now the punk is coming at me for real!]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes squinted, and his right eye shone golden as he used Divine Eye of the Void’s 1st stage, Shift.
He knew all too well that with Ye Lin’s speed, only with Shift would he be able to get the upper hand.
Whoosh, a golden and a red trail crossed each other in unending explosions as they entered a frenzied melee.
When the audience saw them clash in one spot, they popped into another, bouncing all over the place. They could not catch a glimpse of each of their figures even through the screen.
If they were at the scene, they would surely die without knowing how it happened.
The nine sects’ disciples were shocked to the core.
Was this the two freaks’ real power? Holy hell, they were worlds apart from them. They couldn’t even take them on in a fistfight.
It seemed like Zhuo Fan had never fought them in earnest, or they wouldn’t even last five hits.
And that begged the question in Wen Tao’s mind.
[Since Zhuo Fan is so tough, how did I get to wound him?]
[This is too strange…]
The Demon Scheming Sect and Ultimate Clarity Sect’s team were even more scared. They could all feel the incredible winds and fierce waves striking their skin. While they couldn’t see the two, they were all so scared that they were ashen.
In this fight, the two had reached an unknown height in terms of power and speed. The other disciples all realized one unmistakable truth, the minute they set foot anywhere near the pair, they would be ripped to pieces smaller than the eye could see.
Ultimate Clarity Sect’s disciples finally understood why this team battle became a single match and why they shouldn’t interfere.
Ye Lin had never seen them as real teammates, just as Zhuo Fan didn’t recognize them as real opponents. If they managed to get Ye Lin to use half his power that was already commendable.
But now, the two were evenly matched, using all they had and more.
Such a ferocious power let everyone know what it meant to be a world apart.
All they ever amounted to in front of their battle was to be spectators. Any attempt to butt in would be met with swift death…

chapters.title: Chapter 696: Fated Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 696: Fated Battle
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Bang~
Ear-splitting explosions ripped the skies as Zhuo Fan, and Ye Lin’s figures flashed all over the place. They just clashed east then they were west in the next moment.
Everyone was engrossed in the show they two were putting on, swishing their heads left and right, up and down to catch a glimpse. But even that proved impossible.
[Just how is their fight going?]
Only a very limited number of experts could see every move they made.
“Sure enough, Ye Lin still has the upper hand.” Exalted Hei Ran sighed, “In this melee, Zhuo Fan is simply making himself a target for Ye Lin. While everyone knows his body is tough, Ye Lin’s is not even a bit lacking.”
Exalted Bai Mei nodded, “Zhuo Fan’s body cultivation is just too specialized, toughening only one arm. It was enough to sweep the floor with everyone else, but Ye Lin’s training has been full-bodied!”
“Maybe this mystical arm was trained when he felt extra lonely.” Exalted Hei Ran raised an eyebrow, “We’ve all been young once, so it’s understandable, ha-ha-ha!”
(Proofreader’s note: imagine, if it was that easy, millions of guys with “Qilin”)
Bai Mei teased, “You’re so despicable. You’re even joking about this?”
Exalted Bai Mei turned a hard face towards the fight, “However, focusing all his training into that one arm had given him a miraculous power in it, the drawback of doing so is now revealed. He’s already having a hard time against Ye Lin’s mad assault.”
Exalted Hei Ran returned his focus to the screen and nodded heavily.
Glossing over Ye Lin’s arms wrapped in golden fire, he could even get his two legs to burn golden too. He could attack any way he wanted from any direction, while Zhuo Fan only had a single Qilin arm to fight this onslaught. No wonder he was at a disadvantage.
Other than that strong arm, Zhuo Fan was all human. The slightest touch with any of the enemy’s strikes would reduce his body to nothing.
Zhuo Fan frowned while his heart sank lower and lower.
This was what he had feared. One who had no weaknesses against one who had just one arm would sooner or later lead to the latter’s defeat.
This situation brought out the fight he had with Nine Dragons Diamond Body. Huangpu Tianyuan’s state left him helpless. Luckily, young Sanzi lent a hand in finishing the old guy off.
[Wait a sec. The Returning Dragon’s Roar made the old guy so tough. I wonder if this guy has a similar trump card hidden away. If not…]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes glinted in the constant clashes as if he had found a way out. He punched one last time to get the other to fall back then he got some distance by flying into the sky. It looked just like fleeing.
“Zhuo Fan, you’re not getting anywhere!”
Ye Lin laughed and turned into a golden ray as he shot after him, his eyes flashing with bloodlust.
Just like how a savage beast found another and had to tear it to pieces.
Just as he was about to catch up, Zhuo Fan slowed down, hovering in the air. His eyes flashed with an eerie glow, and his right arm glowed a thick red as it punched.
Ye Lin was caught off-guard, but against a punch, he had nothing to fear. His two arms were coated in golden flames, and dragon scales sprouted all over them as he crossed them to take the punch.
Something happened that floored him in more ways than one. The arm expanded and expanded. It was like a massive pillar sent from the heavens above, smashing right into him.
Tangible Projection, Soaring Qilin Leg!
[I’ll just stomp ya!]
Zhuo Fan roared in his mind, and the Qilin leg’s massive power slammed into Ye Lin.
Bam!
The Qilin leg hit Ye Lin’s arms with a resounding boom. Not even he could withstand such might. The bones in his arms were fractured, and his face went red, forced by the immense pillar to be stomped into the ground.
Rumble!
A loud rumbling echoed in everyone’s ears, dust clouding the entire area. Under this single strike, that little valley sported a hundred-meter-deep hole. Ultimate Clarity Sect and Demon Scheming Sect’s disciples felt the whole world shaking with them, their faces overcome with shock.
When the dust finally scattered, the people gazed upon the magnificent Qilin leg with stupefaction.
[Holy mackerel! What is that thing? Is it human?]
Some were so overwhelmed they just stared into space.
Even the exalted were having a hard time comprehending this sight.
[We’ve been on this earth for so many years, yet this is a first for us too! Just what the hell did the kid do to train that right arm?]
The exalted found it hard to believe their eyes.
Only Wu Qingqiu was quick to react, “Junior brother, are you alright?”
No reply. The Qilin leg had nothing living under its feet. He couldn’t sense anything. Wu Qingqiu frowned, filled with worry.
Was his incredible junior brother gone just like that, stomped into hereafter by an even freakier freak?
[This can’t be!]
He refused to believe it. From what he knew about Ye Lin, he would not go down that easily. Zhuo Fan agreed, even if there was no sign of Ye Lin being alive underneath all that red.
So, he just kept adding pressure to the Qilin leg to cut off any means of escape.
However, even as the crowd had yet to overcome their shock, an explosion came from under the Qilin leg.
Golden flames flicked around it.
Zhuo Fan felt his leg hurt, a searing heat that made him sweat buckets. However, he clenched his teeth and added more power in his leg to stop that punk from getting out.
Not that it helped anyway. Zhuo Fan was giving all he had, yet the leg was rising.
Like a volcanic eruption, a burst of fire came from beneath it.
“Ah!”
A shout of exertion came from within that inferno as the flames only grew in size, and the leg was pushed back. Soon, a man in golden flames appeared, using his arms to push the leg higher.
Golden flames flitted all over his body, now covered in sharp dragon scales. That was no human, no matter how one looked at him, but a freak covered in scales.
He was only missing a tail and horns, and he’d be a dragonborn.
The audience gasped in shock.
[These freaks are freaks in bodies as well!]
[No wonder the previous disciples were being finished off in seconds. These guys aren’t humans…]
Zhuo Fan could feel the immense power lifting his Qilin leg, and his face sank. It was also very pale.
[I just knew the guy has a full transformation, unlike me. Maybe the Qilin leg comes from a sacred beast and can hold him back a bit, but it stands no chance against his full body tempering.]
[I lost in melee…]
Zhuo Fan frowned and sighed, admitting that he stood no chance.
“Ah!”
With another shout, Ye Lin used all he had as he pushed the Qilin leg off him.
Zhuo Fan staggered in the air. What shocked him more was that Ye Lin was now in his face in the blink of an eye.
“Zhuo Fan, you lost in close quarters even with that Qilin arm. You have no chance!” Ye Lin came at Zhuo Fan like a savage dragon while cackling, “Qilin has the greatest power among the five great sacred beasts. Today I surpassed the Qilin, and you’ll become my stepping stone to reach the Dao, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan shuddered and finally understood the meaning of this fated battle. At the end of this battle, one would go on higher and higher, to the peak of Dao, while the other would be cast in his shadow of defeat, finding it hard to even move on.
In other words, the path forward would only get even harder for the loser. This battle, he had to win…

chapters.title: Chapter 697: Soul Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 697: Soul Battle
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Cultivating was going against the natural order, fighting adversity. As long as one had a staunch belief, he would be able to walk his own path. That did not apply to beast thought. There could be only one beast king. When two brutal beasts met, they had to fight for a winner.
The winner was king, and the loser was banished.
The five great sacred beasts had ruled the lands together, not because of their friendly ties or rank. It was because each excelled in something that was seen with pride and made them feel like kings. Thus no one could compare with another.
However, if two beasts fought for hegemony, the loser would never be able to raise their head, forever in the other’s shadow. This was savagery, and the winner was king.
Humanity had followed this principle as well, but humans had some sayings, change was constant, and revenge was a dish best served cold.
That was why, to the average onlooker, the fight between him and Ye Lin didn’t have much significance. The loser would live as well and could win the next time a few years later. As long as one had a steel heart, he would get back on his feet.
This, however, did not apply to them. They were sacred beast inheritors. The nature of beasts flowed through them.
Their fight was actually a representation of Decimating Dragon Ancestor versus Soaring Qilin. If one side lost, it would never again be able to reach the other. This was the way of the beast.
But they were humans as well. Though not quite crucial, the beast way more or less affected their beliefs.
That was what the fated battle meant. The winner would have his horizon broadened by standing on the other’s shoulders and would be much closer to Dao. The loser would be like a beast, being left with a shadow in his heart, shaking at the mere sight of the other, and would find his path incredibly hard to tread.
Zhuo Fan never thought much of it till now, only his heart pounding and telling him that he should fight. Now though, after hearing Ye Lin, he understood.
In this battle, they were betting their future. This only made it even more crucial he should not lose!
He wasn’t fighting for Soaring Qilin’s honor, only for his path, for no one to stand in his way…
Zhuo Fan’s previous desolate heart was now rekindled with a burning fire. Seeing Ye Lin coming, his eyes squinted, and he swept the Qilin leg as he roared. “If you think you’re just going to stand on my shoulders, you have another thing coming! This fight will be my win!”
“Humph, You didn’t receive Soaring Qilin’s inheritance, did you? Why else would you be using a sacred beast’s ability in such a crude way? You’ll never get to beat me by using such half-assed methods!”
Squinting, Ye Lin saw through him and faced the incoming Qilin leg, “Golden Dragon Tail, Spatial Rend!”
Roar!
With the roar echoing across the skies, Ye Lin swept his leg, and the image of a golden dragon tail took shape as it whipped at the incoming leg.
The golden flames appeared on it again and came down on the Qilin leg like a sickle.
Bam!
The heavy collision revealed the unexpected to the crowd. The unbeatable Qilin leg was flung aside by the tail swipe.
A dark gash was left on the red leg, and fresh blood seeped out.
Whoosh!
With one last red flash, Zhuo Fan’s right hand was back to normal. In this clash, he was truly outmatched. Ye Lin’s swipe had pushed him back.
This had never happened before in Zhuo Fan’s life!
The sacred beast Qilin leg had lost in strength. It was the only reason why it would revert to its original form.
Startled, Zhuo Fan was flung backward and found it hard to believe what he saw.
[Ye Lin is truly strong!]
[He’s just the Decimating Dragon Ancestor’s inheritor, so how can his strength…]
[Is this the difference between a true inheritance and a meshed-up one?]
Frowning, Zhuo Fan’s face was heavy. Then he recalled the matter of Danqing Shen. Looking around, he found he was flying right for Demon Scheming Sect’s disciples. This was a good chance.
So he flicked his hand and let the Thunder Ring fly off his ring, looking as if Ye Lin’s strike shook it off.
The tiny ring glittered brightly as it fell behind the Demon Scheming Sect’s disciples, where the monitoring arrays were blind.
The instant the ring touched the ground, a flash of light came out of it that was hidden by the disciples. Without the monitoring arrays, no one was the wiser when something came out.
Even the Exalted Double Dragons were entirely focused on Zhuo Fan and not on the ring.
“Heavens, it even shook his ring off. Brother Zhuo has lost this melee!” Wen Tao sighed and shook his head.
Xie Tianshang felt somewhat disappointed. “Next will be a battle of souls.”
“Soul Battle?”
Wen Tao sighed and said, “Zhuo Fan is a freak, but Ye Lin is freakier. Zhuo Fan is only in the Radiant Stage, while Ye Lin is in the Ethereal Stage. Does he have any chance at all?”
Xie Tianshang was startled for a long time.
Wen Tao’s eyes flashed, and he sighed, “Ever since the fight started, brother Zhuo rested his hopes on winning in melee. If he lost in close combat, that means it’s only a matter of time before it ended.”
Xie Tianshang shook, looking at Zhuo Fan as he sighed.
It wasn’t just Sword God Sect; Hellion Flame and Demon Soul Sect were reaching the same conclusion.
Chu Qingcheng couldn’t sit still and stood up, staring intently at Zhuo Fan. Her eyes scrunched up in worry, “When he showed that look, was it because he put all his confidence in melee? But when he discovered that the other has a much stronger body, he no longer had any hope of winning…”
Chu Qingcheng’s eyes were filled with tears. “He went all out knowing he had to do it, even knowing it didn’t work?”
“Sister Qingcheng, doesn’t he have the strongest soul, heaven dragon soul? He might still win!” Dan’er tried cheering her up.
Chu Qingcheng shook her head, “If he could win with his soul, he would’ve done it from the start. Why drag it out? He must know the other’s soul is far better than his, so he went for a close-quarter battle. But…”
“But he got completely crushed, he-he-he…” Xuan Shaoyu spoke with incredible joy.
The girls glared at him, and Chu Qingcheng ignored him. She only had eyes for Zhuo Fan, “You, who never faltered once, what are you going to do now…”
Chu Qingcheng was asking him and herself, trying to think of a way to help Zhuo Fan. That deep emotion only made Xuan Shaoyu’s hatred burn hotter.
The Exalted Double Dragons stared intently at the fight, then shook their heads.
“It seems Zhuo Fan must know something about Ye Lin’s soul that we don’t. That’s why he didn’t go for a soul battle. Otherwise, just when he lost in melee, switching for a soul attack would’ve caught the adversary off-guard.” Exalted Hei Ran spoke.
Exalted Bai Mei nodded. “Now that melee is a dead end, and he’s not going for a soul battle, the outcome is clear. There’s no point in fighting now. Zhuo Fan has lost.”
“All that’s left is for him to admit it or fight to his last drop of energy.” Exalted Hei Ran’s eyes glinted.
[Though I hope he’ll fight till the very end…]
In the corner of the valley, Danqing Shen slipped out of the ring and did not rush for the sacred weapon. He closely observed the fight, feeling his chin with his rough hand, “Boy, the melee was but a test. Have you found all you need for the soul battle? I want to see if your meshed-up dragon soul can turn it around. I hope you won’t let me down…”
Whoosh!
Stopping himself from flying backward, he also spat blood. After wiping his mouth, his eyes took on a hard gaze.
“Zhuo Fan, your greatest asset, strength, has been trumped. Qilin’s disciple had just lost to the Decimating Dragon Ancestor’s disciple. Admit your defeat! I’ll take you under my wing as my right-hand. With me, your path won’t be so affected. We will both make our way to the Sacred Domain!”
Ye Lin flashed in front of him with a smile, “After all, on this wide green earth, there’s only us who are half-human, half-beast.”
Zhuo Fan snickered. “The winner lords over the loser. For the loser to swear allegiance to the winner is the best path. So that the loser can attain Dao by following the winner. Otherwise, his path would be cut from the pain in his heart!”
“It’s good you realize it. Who had it, so we become sacred beast inheritors? To gain their power and inherit their path? So admit defeat. It’s for your own good.”
“Ha-ha-ha, sorry, I’ve gotten used to always calling the shots. Being the little guy doesn’t suit me!”
Zhuo Fan sneered, his eyes flashed, and he roared, “You won in close quarters, but I’ll win in soul. The final victory will be mine!”

chapters.title: Chapter 698: Decimating Golden Heaven Dragon King
chapters.content:
Chapter 698: Decimating Golden Heaven Dragon King
Proofreader
: Papatonks
[Soul Battle?]
Raising an eyebrow, Ye Lin heard the biggest joke in his life as he cracked up, “You’ve already compared your heaven dragon soul with mine, haven’t you? Yet you still want to fight the heaven dragon soul of a dragon ancestor’s disciple? Ha-ha-ha, how cocky can you get?”
“If you still aren’t clear on the five great sacred beasts’ unique powers, I can enlighten you. Qilin has the best raw power but is the worst when it comes to anything else. The fact that you lost in melee means you lost it all. There’s no hope for you to turn it around. So listen to my advice and give up!”
Holding his head high, Ye Lin shouted with resolution.
Zhuo Fan knew it very clearly as well, but he was even more sure that his inheritance did not limit itself to Qilin. It was a jumbled-up array of skills from many great experts.
While not a master in either of them, victory lay in their amount. Now that he fused them all, he could mold them any way he wanted. Maybe one such variation was the answer to this battle.
Just like how Danqing Shen put it. His second-rate dragon soul might win against the orthodox one.
While having no hope of winning, Zhuo Fan was far from losing also. He would have to see where this action took him, be it defeat or victory.
Therefore, Zhuo Fan no longer wasted words, “Sacred beasts are sacred beasts. We are humans. You’re too naive if you think you can compare their fights with ours. Wraith Style’s 2nd move, Ghostly Dragon Claw!”
Roar!
With the roar, Zhuo Fan’s Qilin arm flashed red, and a claw ripped through the air as it grabbed for Ye Lin.
“Humph, pigheaded! Since one is a sacred beast inheritor, a master’s power determines a disciple’s power. The master’s skill is the disciple’s skill. No one in this world can surpass the five great sacred beasts. Your only hope of winning is by using the inherited Qilin’s power. But now you no longer have that chance!”
Ye Lin’s eyes flashed coldly. He jumped straight ahead as he coated his dragon claw in golden flames. “Nine Revolving Golden Dragon Claw, Space Ripper!”
Bam!
A loud blast resulted from the impact, and they entered a deadlock. Then came the two dragons’ roars.
Two hundred meters tall dragon souls came out of their bodies as they traced the skies. They glowed in a prismatic light, and their tail flicked at the space, almost cracking it before going against each other.
Boom!
Another explosion came. The two dragons set against each other, the noise covering the little valley’s every corner and the mountain range around. Its ripple sent dust flying.
As for the disciples of the two sects, the ripple sent them into the air, filling them with shock.
They knew Zhuo Fan had a heaven dragon soul, but not that Ye Lin had one too.
Wu Qingqiu’s side was stunned. They had never seen Ye Lin’s soul, and now that they did, they were stumped.
Everyone knew that in the thousands of years of western lands, only the Exalted Double Dragons had such a soul. Since then, no one had gotten such a powerful soul.
Now, however, it not only reappeared, but it came twice. Everyone looked shocked and more excited than ever.
A clash between heaven dragon souls meant a clash between western lands’ strongest exalted. Not even they could imagine how it would look. However, today they would witness such a great fight.
The delegates and even the Exalted Double Dragons were eager to see this exciting fight.
“How come Ye Lin also has a heaven dragon soul?” Blinking hard, Exalted Hei Ran found it incredulous.
Giving a stiff nod, Exalted Bai Mei sighed, “This is a truly rare soul. Seeing how a demonic and a righteous cultivator have the same heaven dragon soul is like I’m seeing us in the olden days.”
“They’re really like us back in the day.”
Exalted Hei Ran recovered from his shock and laughed, “It’s like these two were sent by providence. They’re like identical molds!”
Exalted Bai Mei smiled and nodded.
[Western lands will have a successor…]
Chu Qingcheng understood why Zhuo Fan did not take out his soul so soon. Ye Lin’s soul was just like his, if not better.
In this soul battle, Zhuo Fan looked to be at a disadvantage.
Looking at the two heaven dragon souls fight, she saw that Ye Lin’s was better, pushing back Zhuo Fan’s. Chu Qingcheng was worried again.
On the field of battle, the two were in a deadlock. Ye Lin looked up at the retreating dragon soul belonging to Zhuo Fan and snickered, “I told you. When it comes to dragon souls, you’re not my match. It’s still in its base form, yet you’re still losing ground. If I add the dragon ancestor’s teachings, you’re finished!”
“Humph, we’ll just see about that!”
Zhuo Fan squinted and snorted, “Variant, Almighty Scarlet Dragon King!”
With a draconic roar, Zhuo Fan’s dragon soul shifted. It exploded in scarlet light, and its scales hardened like rocks, tougher than steel. Its fangs grew and turned savage.
Its tail swished and whipped Ye Lin’s dragon soul, causing Ye Lin to shudder. As his soul shook, he flew back from Zhuo Fan’s punch. He was pushed back from the soul and raw power combined.
Demon Scheming Sect’s disciples cheered, and so did the crowd. Only the nine sects remain silent, staring at the screen with hard faces.
Ultimate Clarity Sect’s disciples were confident. It was like they knew Ye Lin had no way of losing.
[The amateurs rave while the experts are aware.]
Only the nine sects’ experts could see that before Zhuo Fan showed his variant, he was at a disadvantage. They all knew Ye Lin had yet to show his dragon soul’s change.
Zhuo Fan knew this as well. So after shaking him off, he quickly fell back. He wasn’t after pressing his chance but wanted to get the opponent to take out all his cards. The one that showed all his moves was the one who was at a true disadvantage.
Grinning, Ye Lin flew backward, saying in a casual tone, “Since you want to see the truest way to train your dragon soul, then feast your eyes! Ha-ha-ha…”
“Variant, Decimating Golden Heaven Dragon King!”
Widening his eyes, Ye Lin’s eyes had a crazed look as he shouted.
Ye Lin’s body and his dragon soul stopped. Golden flames rose from around the dragon soul, they pierced its body, and the prismatic glow soon died against the flames. Now the old dragon had turned into a brilliant golden and burning divine dragon.
Its talons grew from within the scorching flames like a pyre, their sharpness glinting in the sun’s rays.
All could practically see anything turning to ribbons the instant they met those claws.
Zhuo Fan stopped and stared at the golden dragon. He could feel it from there, the blistering heat coming from that huge dragon’s flames.
He knew the might of this creature, but after pondering, he made up his mind, making Almighty Scarlet Dragon King charge head-on.
In the end, knowing both sides’ features was what got you victory. He had to figure out everything with the other hand up his sleeves.
Seeing through Zhuo Fan’s tactic, Ye Lin grinned and laughed, “You want to see the Decimating Golden Heaven Dragon King’s power that much? Suit yourself. Not like you have a choice in the matter, ha-ha-ha…”
Roar!
As if to agree with Ye Lin, the golden dragon roared, surging up as it charged at the scarlet dragon.
The clash was unlike the previous one, but one of life and death. This was Zhuo Fan’s most dangerous moment of his second life…
Bam!
The Almighty Scarlet Dragon King swished its tail and flung the golden dragon back. However, the golden dragon used its claw to sink it into the scarlet dragon at the same time, right under Zhuo Fan’s incredulous eyes.
The searing flames entered the scarlet dragon, and it roared in pain. Its heavy bulk shook under pain.
Zhuo Fan’s face went red, and his mind was in pain as he spat sizzling blood…

chapters.title: Chapter 699: Counterattack
chapters.content:
Chapter 699: Counterattack
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Ha-ha-ha, Zhuo Fan, see that? You lost faster comparing our dragon souls than our fists! Give up while you still can…”
The golden dragon was about to be flung away, but because its claw dug deep into the scarlet dragon, it stayed put. The golden dragon then coiled around the other one and tightened its hold. No matter how it thrashed around, the scarlet dragon could not break free.
Let’s not forget the golden flames cooking it from the inside out. Its only saving grace was the red glow around it shielding it somewhat, or it would’ve been burned alive.
Despite that, the scarlet dragon kept wailing in pain due to its sizzling flesh.
Zhuo Fan was shaking like a leaf from having his dragon soul subjected to such a cruel attack. He was pale and sweating buckets.
Ye Lin laughed at Zhuo Fan’s discomfort, “What more do you want? Your soul is clearly weaker. Taking it any further would mean the end of your soul and the end of you. So just give up!”
To add insult to injury, the golden dragon had received Ye Lin’s order and opened its maw to breathe searing heat on the scarlet dragon.
Zhuo Fan was now close to collapsing from how much he was shaking. He clenched his fists and gnashed his teeth. But his eyes held a most staunch gaze.
The audience sighed.
[The soul battle is worse than the melee one. Trapped the moment the fight started. He knew his soul wasn’t up to par, so he started with his fists.]
[Yet not even fighting in melee proved helpful, having lost in the end.]
Now, being stubborn and unyielding, he had gone to fight with his soul. But power was everything, and he clearly couldn’t win it.
[Not even going all out worked.]
[Zhuo Fan has no chance of making a comeback.]
Everyone wrote Zhuo Fan off as having lost. With his soul in the other’s claws, what else could this be if not a loss? Only Chu Qingcheng kept staring at him with her pure eyes filled with hope.
“Sister Qingcheng, it’s done. Ye Lin is too strong. Z-he lost.” Dan’er did not know how to comfort her.
However, Chu Qingcheng’s gaze was firm, “I know he had no hopes for this battle, but as long as he did not give in himself, I still believe he will win. For sure…”
The girls watched her with a start, then they sighed.
[This is called blind faith…]
The exalted shook their heads, more and more amazed by Ye Lin.
“Who is this kid? His tempering of the heaven dragon soul is so thorough. We used to think Zhuo Fan’s version of heaven dragon soul was better, but I never thought it possible for Ye Lin’s to be even greater. I fear that not even our knowledge of it can compare!” Exalted Hei Ran sighed in shock.
Exalted Bai Mei had to admit. “Yes, just like in a meeting of rivals, there’s someone better. The same applies to heaven dragon souls. Ye Lin had followed the best path for his strengthening. I can hardly believe the heaven dragon soul could reach such a level of power. Just like they say, the new replaces the old. Old-timers like us… “
Exalted Bai Mei sighed, and Exalted Hei Ran nodded. He sighed as he stood up, looking at the judge, “Ye Lin won. Have them return!”
“What?!”
The judge jerked and sent the two exalted an incredulous look.
In all the Double Dragon Gatherings, the exalted had only been silent observers, being a symbol of fairness, not once interfering and always going by the rules.
Only this time, even as plenty of time remained, the exalted wanted to cut it short and declare a winner. This never happened. Ever!
The judge was dumbstruck.
Exalted Hei Ran sighed, “The outcome is obvious. Do you want to let it go on until one of them loses their life?”
The judge reacted at last and looked at the little valley.
The exalted were afraid of losing Zhuo Fan, so they stepped in.
[Such an honor!]
In the eyes of the highest leaders, the life of a human was worthless. The Double Dragon Gathering had had too many deaths than none could count, yet not once did they want to save one, except Zhuo Fan…
[Sigh, from now on, the exalted will have a favorite pupil, what honor!]
Sighing, the judge bowed to the exalted, then eyed the gatekeepers as he cleared his throat. He was just about to announce it!
But then, creepy laughter came out before the judge, or the gatekeepers could act. The eerie laughter made one’s spine tingle.
It was the kind of voice a demon would make in the dead of night as it banged on your door…
“Hi-hi-hi, self-righteous punk, even arrogance has its limit. You want me to surrender? Humph, no dice!” The creepy laughter came from Zhuo Fan who was looking just as frail as before, but his eyes were sharp and clear. He had lost his previous stern look and was now looking positively insane.
“Is that all your Decimating Golden Heaven Dragon King can do? Then consider it my win! Variant, Heaven Devouring Demonic Dragon King!”
Everyone, even Ye Lin, did not react as Zhuo Fan’s dragon soul once again roared.
The scarlet glow faded, its eyes closed, as if asleep, and when he opened them again, they were pitch-black.
The previous rampant aura of the scarlet dragon was lost as well, giving way for one of pure evil. Its pitch-black eyes only amplified the dread, feeling as if it sucked the very soul out of you.
Its huge bulk was turning black as well, releasing unspeakable danger even as it was trapped.
Ye Lin gaped.
[W-what the hell? How did it change colors? Even its aura is different. It’s like I’m looking at a different soul!]
The exalted were frozen in place as well.
Logic dictated that one’s soul changed depending on one’s cultivation methods and insights. Once it took the owner’s characteristics, it could never change again. So why was this one doing it twice?
First it was brutal and savage, but quite upstanding. Now it turned vicious and cruel, like the worst killer in history.
For these two changes to appear on a single soul was beyond everyone’s comprehension. The exalted themselves would vow such a weird thing had never happened.
Not just them, but even Danqing Shen who guided Zhuo Fan had a goony look. “Is this what the kid understood by soul variation? It’s too damn weird? It’s as freaky as him. Then again, just what is his cultivation method anyway? It brings together many aspects…”
Everyone went slack jawed. Even the judge and the gatekeepers.
Zhuo Fan ignored the obvious dumb looks and snickered. “With all the intel gathered, it’s time for me to counterattack!”
The huge black dragon roared and it caused everyone’s scalp to tingle, even Ye Lin’s.
The black dragon flicked its tail, uncaring about the golden flames, and it was now its turn to wind around the golden dragon. It then opened its gaping mouth and sank its teeth into the golden dragon, forcing it to wail.
Ye Lin’s mind felt a sharp pain as his soul was damaged. As a reaction, the golden flames exploded like a huge volcano, wrapping around the black dragon.
However, the black dragon was creepy like its owner. It did not fear them unlike the Almighty Scarlet Dragon King.
The dark aura around it absorbed the flames as they approached,
Ye Lin was shocked beyond belief at this.
[W-what?! That’s dragon ancestor’s Decimating Golden Flame!]
Even so, Zhuo Fan’s cultivation method from the Nine Serenities Emperor, the Demon Transformation Art, combined with the heaven dragon soul, resulted in Heaven Devouring Demonic Dragon King, able to absorb anything and everything in existence.
Ye Lin’s Decimating Golden Flame stood no chance against such a dragon soul.
Ye Lin looked grave and gnashed his teeth, “Is this Qilin’s ability?”
“Ha-ha-ha, what do you think?”
Zhuo Fan grinned, “I told you, we’re humans in the end. Sacred beasts’ path isn’t completely useful to us. Do you still think you got what it takes to win against me in a soul battle?”
Ye Lin’s brow shook as his eyes looked sharp, “I misjudged you. You still added more tricks to your soul. In that case, allow me to show you the purest heaven dragon soul!”
Ye Lin’s hands flashed through a series of signs, his eyes flickering with golden flames…

chapters.title: Chapter 700: Vaulting Dragon King
chapters.content:
Chapter 700: Vaulting Dragon King
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“A dragon is the strongest and toughest creature. Your demonic dragon is very weird and can handle my flames, but it’s still too soft. Let me show you how a true dragon should be!”
With a shout, Ye Lin’s signs came to an end. “Reveal your brutality, Decimating Golden Heaven Dragon King, Scale Shedding!”
Roar!
A brutal roar came from his dragon and it released a blinding golden light. As it shook, it threw off the demonic dragon.
The demonic dragon had no chance to latch on again as the golden dragon’s scales bristled and shot like tiny blades at the demonic dragon. Those scales contained scorching flames that could burn anything.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes narrowed and he had a very bad feeling. Without any hesitation, based on his double lives’ intuition, he had his soul move away.
It proved to be too late as the scales fell from the golden dragon like rain, hitting the demonic dragon fully and sending its golden flames right into its body. The demonic dragon had no time to absorb them as they instantly detonated.
The violent power and the searing flames left the demonic dragon to jerk from pain and torment.
Zhuo Fan was also assaulted by the pain in his mind.
Ye Lin snickered, getting his dragon free from the demonic dragon and ordering it to claw the other’s skull, to attack it from two fronts.
The pitch-black aura on the demonic dragon scattered from the explosions and its ears were deafened by it, making the claw that came take it by surprise.
Grinning, Ye Lin saw his dragon clawing the demonic dragon’s face as if he was slapping Zhuo Fan’s. “Ha-ha-ha, even if your dragon can handle my golden flames, it’s too soft. A dragon should be strong and tough. That dragon you got by meshing up all kinds of sundries are no match for pure perfection! My dragon has you beat in power alone! You’re no match to me, even in soul!”
Ye Lin had a crazed look in his eyes as he cackled. The audience saw Zhuo Fan just make a comeback yet was being pushed back the next second, burning his last hope.
Exalted Double Dragons shook their heads. They were shocked by Zhuo Fan’s tactic, but they had to admit Ye Lin’s dragon soul was far more complete in its adaptation, simply perfect.
Zhuo Fan’s scarlet dragon and demonic dragon each had their strong suit, but it had heaps of weaknesses as well. It was very easy for them to be routed and pushed back, unless…
The exalted seemed to recall something and quickly denied it.
[Like that will ever happen. A twice altered soul is already miraculous enough, so how can two different forces… Moreover, they just don’t fit. It’s impossible…]
Zhuo Fan had given his all in this fight but it still was not enough…
“If he could fuse those two variants…” Sword God Sect’s Xie Tianshang said.
Wen Tao shook his head on the spot, “That’s downright impossible. I have no idea how that demonic dragon even came to be, but what is certain is that it is an extreme yin. Yin is soft, and virtue can restrain the golden flames just how our soft sword can handle attacks. However, that scarlet dragon is extremely brutal and hard. While yin and yang can engender each other, they can also repel one another. If these two dragons are united, it will become unlike anything in this world. Nothing could stop it. But if they clash, the result will only harm oneself.”
“That’s why brother Zhuo’s dragon soul can take both yin and yang forms. This is truly amazing in itself. If he were to fuse them, their engendering is still not enough. Even if he does, it might not be Ye Lin’s match because he is still lacking?”
“Still?” Xie Tianshang raised an eyebrow.
Wen Tao spoke with a stern face, “A dragon’s brutality. A dragon is extremely strong and hard, but Ye Lin’s dragon soul is also a flame dragon. Fire is very explosive and once attacked it would rain havoc. Brother Zhuo’s dragon soul lacked in this department on both accounts. His attacks just don’t make the cut while his defenses are still too weak to take those blows. As you saw from the Scale Shedding…”
However, as he was commenting on the fight, a roar came from within the screen that startled everyone. Zhuo Fan’s dragon soul was shifting again, back to his scarlet form. It flashed its claws and stopped the golden dragon’s attacks. With a roar of fury, it then smashed the other’s head with a claw and threw it to the ground.
Almighty Scarlet Dragon King was truly a king in terms of raw power. Not even the golden dragon could match it. As for hardness, he was among the best.
The audience once again clamored in excitement. Zhuo Fan used the two variations to fight back.
But then, the golden dragon twisted and flicked its tail, striking the scarlet dragon with its golden scales.
The scarlet dragon whipped its own tail, to protect its head. As the explosions echoed, it still wailed. Its tough scales were falling from the relentless assault, its power waning from the wounds.
Xie Tianshang now understood what Wen Tao meant by brutal. Zhuo Fan’s variations could not stop Ye Lin’s Scale Shedding.
Against such an explosive attack, Zhuo Fan could do nothing.
The experts noticed it as well. Even with the two forms of dragon soul, Zhuo Fan could not get out of that impasse.
Everyone lamented and the exalted gave the judge a look to get to it in calling it off…
Shaking, Zhuo Fan bled from the mouth but he did not mind it. He had the Almighty Scarlet Dragon King turn back into Heaven Devouring Demonic Dragon King to absorb the remaining golden flames on its body. Finally breathing easier, he knew the two forms were not enough.
“Zhuo Fan, its the end of the line for you. Your variations can’t take my dragon. A second-rate is a second-rate. How can it ever match a perfect dragon soul, ha-ha-ha…”
Ye Lin looked at Zhuo Fan with pride, filled with confidence. The golden dragon was shaking its tail as well, giving the black dragon a look of disdain.
Zhuo Fan sneered. He never was one to take to others showing off, especially in his face. So he scratched his nose and said, “Brat, enough with the patronizing or you’ll be sorry. It’s not over until it’s over!”
“Still trying to fight the inevitable? Humph, it’s your funeral. I’m being serious when I tell you that I haven’t gone all out. Or you’d be dead.”
“He-he-he, you’re not the only one. When I go crazy I can’t control myself!” Zhuo Fan snickered.
Ye Lin’s face twitched. “Are you calling me lunatic? Humph, we’ll just see who goes crazy first! Decimating Golden Flame is called decimating because it can burn the heavens.”
“Proceed at your own risk. You might collapse the heavens, by burning them but I will hold them up, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan had a creepy grin.
Ye Lin’s brow twitched, finding it odd.
[What’s got this punk so confident when his two dragon souls are useless?]
He didn’t get to find an answer as Zhuo Fan’s dragon soul turned into Almighty Scarlet Dragon King as it soared higher and higher.
Ye Lin mocked, “You’re going up even as you’re about to lose? This time you won’t get to change your dragon soul. I won’t let you. Scale Shedding!”
His dragon sent golden scales like rain upon the scarlet dragon.
Only this time, the scarlet dragon did not dodge and it was not releasing black energy to stop it either.
Everyone was stunned. Was Zhuo Fan going to make the scarlet dragon face the scales head on?
[That’s suicide!]
[It won’t help you at all!]
But as the golden scales approached, the red glow on the scarlet dragon dimmed and its body was see-through.
The huge dragon then lit up in an azure flame, engulfing its body. It went on like this, like an azure fire dragon.
“Dragon soul variant, Vaulting Dragon King!” Zhuo Fan’s hand made some new signs as he shouted…

chapters.title: Chapter 701: Four Dragon King Variants
chapters.content:
Chapter 701: Four Dragon King Variants
Proofreader
: Papatonks
[He’s changing again?!]
Everyone was becoming stone statues with how often they got stunned by Zhuo Fan’s skills. First, the mere fact there were two variations of the same soul was incomprehensible, and now they found out there was a third one as well.
All around was nothing but gasping and slacked jaws.
[Just what on earth is this kid’s cultivation method and path to end up with three variations?]
They had no way of knowing Zhuo Fan’s Demon Transformation Art contained everything in existence. The azure flame was a true mediator between yin and yang, holding every aspect of everything in this world. It fits everything to perfection, not causing a single conflict.
So to say Zhuo Fan had three variations was a gross understatement. He could go for hundreds if he wanted to.
As for Ye Lin, who received a dragon ancestor’s inheritance, his soul’s path ended at Decimating Golden Heaven Dragon King. Anything deviating from it was impossible. Wen Tao’s soul was the gentle sword, overcoming strength with softness. If he changed his sword soul into a greatsword, it just did not fit his path, thus impossible to achieve it.
It was because Zhuo Fan’s cultivation method conformed to all paths, coming from the Nine Serenities Emperor himself. He focused all his knowledge on making it, allowing him to go on without having disharmony among the wide array of skills he got from all those experts.
It was also why he failed to grasp a deeper understanding of Dao. It was just like he concluded. While Ye Lin and the others were plumbing the depths of Dao, he was taking in all its broadness.
This fight was no different. No one knew better about being a sacred beast inheritor than Ye Lin. The Almighty Scarlet Dragon King, a sacred beast inheritance variant, was not inferior to Decimating Golden Heaven Dragon King at all. It was just that Zhuo Fan’s knowledge of Qilin’s power was lacking and could not showcase its true might.
While on the opposite side, Zhuo Fan could use the shifts in the soul to compensate for his shortcomings. For this particular instance, he needed something to curb the brutality of that raging fire, and who better than the Vaulting Dragon King, in harmony with all things?
Roar!
The azure dragon showed no fear beneath the hail of thousands of burning scales. It even charged on excitedly.
The eyes of the audience widened, and their hearts skipped with worry that the azure dragon would meet the same fate as the other two.
But then they watched in shock as the scales went right into the azure dragon. They exploded, and then the golden flames released a golden flash covered in azure flames to soothe its savagery, turning it into azure flames at the end.
The people went crazy when the savage scales entered the azure dragon, to see them turned into azure dragon’s power, whose flames were burning stronger now.
The azure dragon roared to mock the golden dragon as it kept charging.
“Is this Vaulting Kunpeng’s Chaos Flame?”
Ye Lin cried out in shock, “Master said that of the five great sacred beasts who harnessed primal chaos’ power, only two wielded divine flames. One was he, Decimating Dragon Ancestor, wielder of a fierce flame, the Decimating Golden Flame that can destroy everything, and the other was the head of the five great sacred beasts, Vaulting Kunpeng, wielder of the gentle flame, Chaos Flame of Creation. The flames also earned them their titles. The fierce flame destroyed, and the gentle flame created. The five great sacred beasts can bring heaven down, and the gentle flame can hold it up.
“One can say they are yin and yang, engendering and clashing with each other. The only thing that can soothe the brutality of the strongest fierce flame can only be the strongest gentle flame. I just can’t believe it’s on him! Does Vaulting Kunpeng have his back? Then whose disciple is he? Qilin’s or Kunpeng’s?”
Ye Lin found Zhuo Fan as one huge enigma, impossible to unravel.
He didn’t know which sacred beast’s inheritance he got. Zhuo Fan hardly ever displayed the azure flame to anyone. Then there was the mighty Qilin arm he relied on the most that got Ye Lin to side with him being a Qilin disciple.
As for the purple lightning, it had to be because he got drowned in it in that canyon; it didn’t count. Why else would his use of it look so clumsy?
So, after careful analysis, he was certain that Zhuo Fan was a Qilin disciple, wasting a power he was unfamiliar with. Glossing over the melee battle, there was no way he could be defeated in a soul battle!
Now he found out that all of this was wrong. Zhuo Fan finally revealed the power that could contain his own. The Chaos Flame changed the heaven dragon soul into Vaulting Dragon King in complete opposition to his Decimating Golden Heaven Dragon King.
[If you only consider the powers’ character, yes, but once you add them to a dragon soul…]
Ye Lin’s eyes flashed, and he no longer sat still as before. Having discovered Zhuo Fan’s nature, he ordered his golden dragon to charge at the azure dragon for an attack.
“Humph, the azure flame and the golden flame are against one another, but when it comes to dragon souls, strongest and hardest is the way to go! You really think that you can overcome my fierce flame’s strength by using that gentle flame on the dragon soul?”
Ye Lin glared at Zhuo Fan and roared.
Grinning, Zhuo Fan knew from the start where he stood and had never had any certainty he would win. Now though, he sneered, having found all he wanted to know.
This proved that Zhuo Fan’s tactic worked.
[The punk is anxious. All that’s left is to go all out.]
Showing a creepy smile, Zhuo Fan taunted, “Haven’t you heard of overcoming hardness with softness? Are you sure your fierce flame golden dragon can beat my gentle flame azure dragon?”
“Without a doubt!” Ye Lin raised his head as he declared. “A dragon is tough and strong. No matter how opposing are our two flames, when it comes down to it, my golden dragon will trump yours!”
Ye Lin made a sign, and the golden dragon roared as his body exploded in golden flames. In a blink, it was on the azure dragon, bearing its claws.
Bam!
The golden dragon claw struck the azure dragon’s spine. The berserk golden flame charged into the azure flame, burning the azure dragon’s back. Yet the azure flame quickly shifted and wrapped around the golden flame, swallowing in a blink of an eye.
That did nothing to stop the mighty and hard claw from making the azure dragon’s spine creak and cry out.
Zhuo Fan’s brow hardened as he felt a stab of pain in his mind. He chose to clench his teeth and bear it. Seeing his moment was here, his eyes flashed and sent the azure dragon to claw the golden dragon now that it was wide open.
Ye Lin mocked, “Useless, the azure dragon with the gentle flame is good for defense, not attack. This claw won’t harm my dragon at all!”
“I don’t think so!” Zhuo Fan grinned, his eyes glinting evilly.
Hum~
A flash of red appeared on the dragon soul.
Ye Lin expected it as he sneered, “I knew you would change back to Almighty Scarlet Dragon King. Only the scarlet dragon can really attack among all your variations. Well, too bad he only has strength. In a soul battle, power is the last resort. At most, it will only push my dragon back and not harm it…”
“When did I say I had only three?”
Cutting him off, Zhuo Fan’s evil grin was on full display.
A rumble echoed in everyone’s ears, a prelude to the shocking scene that came.
The Decimating Golden Heaven Dragon King’s belly was run through by a dragon claw, throwing spiritual energy everywhere.
Ye Lin shook, and his eyes bugged out in shock. Blood flowed from his mouth and dripped onto the ground, but it still couldn’t lift the confusion in his eyes.
[How is this possible? Logically, those three dragons can’t harm my dragon!]
Ye Lin’s brow shook. He turned his stiff head around to see the golden dragon with a huge body, unlike any of the three variants he had seen before. It was covered in purple lightning.
The crackle of thunder rumbled each time it streaked its body. Its sharp claw flickered purple as it came out of the golden dragon’s other side.
“T-that’s Heaven Crushing Phoenix’s Berserk Purple Lightning…” Ye Lin’s eyes shook, recalling having seen the purple lightning on Zhuo Fan. Since he got three types of dragon souls, what stopped him from having one with purple lightning as well?
But he got careless when he was focused on dealing with the azure flame…
Zhuo Fan could read him like a book and sighed, “Finally… nailed you!”
“What do you mean?” Ye Lin wore a mask of confusion.
Zhuo Fan chuckled, in no hurry to reply. He pointed at the purple dragon and took his time, “Dragon soul variant, Heaven Crushing Dragon King. It’s the only one that can do some damage to you. So before I could use it, I had to make you forget it ever existed…”
Ye Lin shook as it dawned on him. The blood leaked from his mouth, bloodening his shocked face.
[You’re telling me everything so far has been to lead me into this trap?]
Wu Qingqiu was also shocked, “Damn it, he’s been duped!”

chapters.title: Chapter 702: Brutalized
chapters.content:
Chapter 702: Brutalized
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Senior brother, what did you say?” A disciple asked, confused.
Wu Qingqiu frowned and pondered before sighing, “I’m not too clear either, but from what I see of the last strike, I have a vague feeling Zhuo Fan had been stringing junior brother along.”
The disciples were startled. Wu Qingqiu continued, “Look at Zhuo Fan’s four dragon souls. Neither of them can stand up to junior brother. But in the end, his dragon soul ended up heavily wounded. Don’t you find it odd? It’s been obvious so far that Zhuo Fan had been on the ropes all along!”
“Yeah, did that punk blindside him?” One shouted.
Wu Qingqiu sighed. “Even if he did, he needed perfect timing. This timing was either when the opponent was the most careless or if he created it himself. Zhuo Fan likely chose the latter.”
“How can you be sure?”
“Based on Zhuo Fan’s purple dragon’s claw attack. He grasped it perfectly to turn the fight around. I find it hard to believe a true expert like junior brother would be so careless as to give his opponent such an opening to exploit. That is why he was made to play along with the other’s tunes.” Wu Qingqiu frowned, “But when exactly did all of this start? I just can’t see it.”
There were so many people just as shocked as he was. Zhuo Fan flipped the table a bit too fast, even by their standards. He had been stomped at every turn till now!
However, a few crafty old foxes around saw through it.
[So young, but not just strong but also cunning. Even we were duped by his act and thought he couldn’t win!]
Exalted Hei Ran held his beard and glanced at Bai Mei, “Old timer, see that?”
“Yeah, four dragon souls paving the way to success!”
Exalted Bai Mei nodded, his eyes flashing, “The scarlet dragon was first taken out to test the golden dragon’s power. The second variant was to lower the golden flame’s threat and lay the groundwork for the coup de grace. The third variant was bait. The azure dragon was in direct opposition to the golden dragon king, and since it was weak in direct battle, it was the perfect cover to get him close.”
“And to attack the azure flame and wound his opponent, the golden dragon used all its golden flame to strike the azure dragon’s flames within it, but it also left itself wide open for an attack.” Exalted Hei Ran finished.
Exalted Bai Mei nodded, “All of this had been prepared in advance. Ye Lin revealed an opening in the end because Zhuo Fan’s three variants left a huge impression on him, causing him to lower his guard. The demonic dragon and azure dragon had weak attacks, with only the scarlet dragon strong but not explosive enough. It was the only one that could have attacked him. But who would’ve thought the real killer move was yet to come? “
“I don’t find this purple dragon impressive at all, but the purple lightning is savagely brutal, just like the golden flame. But Zhuo Fan had yet to train it to its peak, or at least stand up to the golden flame. Ye Lin just had to leave a bit of golden flame around his body, and the purple dragon would’ve failed.”
“However, hadn’t Zhuo Fan done everything to get him to lower the golden flame guard?” Exalted Hei Ran sighed, “Especially that azure dragon. Its defense is the best, but it had no power to attack. It’s like a three-year-old fiddling with a golden bauble surrounded by two bodyguards with one arm and one leg. Any self-respecting thug wouldn’t be caught dead missing such an obvious easy target. He’d go as far as ignoring the crippled bodyguards as he went for that bauble with a blade out.”
Bai Mei sighed, “Old timer, that’s a bit crude. Being confident of victory, Ye Lin fell for Zhuo Fan’s trap. If he had been coolheaded, the victory might have been his. A shame…”
“What, the world doesn’t lack people yearning for a win. If you were to see your adversary removing your advantages one step at a time, wouldn’t you go for the kill when you find the best chance show itself?” Exalted Hei Ran raised an eyebrow.
Exalted Bai Mei chuckled, “It’s all due to that weird kid Zhuo Fan’s twisted mind. Ye Lin is stronger than him but fails in terms of mentality. This battle was like a spider biting at its prey until it fell over. You can’t guard against something like that!”
Exalted Hei Ran gave an understanding nod. “The kid has his path and heart. His future’s going to be bright. The western lands are going to change…”
In the little valley, Danqing Shen watched the fight clearly and nodded, “Ha-ha-ha, I bet those two coots could tell how the soul battle would turn, yet they never would’ve thought this outcome had been set up ever since the melee.”
“Did you really think I couldn’t beat you in melee?”
Zhuo Fan looked at Ye Lin with a smug look. Ye Lin glared at Zhuo Fan, his heart in shock.
[You’re telling me the whole thing was staged?]
Zhuo Fan shrugged, “Fine. I guess I lost the melee. I can’t beat you there.”
Ye Lin’s face twitched as he glared.
[Are you toying with me?]
“However, while I had been prepared to lose in that aspect, that didn’t mean I liked it.”
Zhuo Fan squinted and showed a crafty look. “An ever-winning general isn’t always victorious because he never lost, but because he turns defeat into victory. You’re the dragon ancestor’s disciple, a sacred beast priding itself on its strong body. Since you’re his disciple, your body can’t be any weaker. You got its entire inheritance, while I only got bits and pieces from a Qilin. It was obvious melee was lost to me.
“Though the loss had its perks. Sacred beasts are hugely arrogant, and you’re not far off either. You had let the melee win get to your head, thus giving me the advantage. Moreover, when you beat me in melee, you already thought you had crushed my strongest form and were sure of victory. This led to being careless in the soul battle, my second advantage. As for the third, when you used the golden flame in melee, it gave me time to analyze it and set the best way to fight you in soul.”
Ye Lin shook, staring at Zhuo Fan’s evil grin in complete stupefaction. He never thought Zhuo Fan would be so invested in this fight that he took everything into account. His master never taught him that.
Master only said that the winner lorded over the loser and that power was everything.
What could possibly be more important in a fight than one’s strength?
Reality showed his master was just a wild beast. Their fights were crude and simple, while humans’ used their brains. He was so strong that no one could have played him. Adding to that, he had never met someone as crafty as this prick among the simple people of the Ultimate Clarity Sect. That was how he ended up like this.
Now that he met Zhuo Fan, lording over him with power, but not in brains as well, being duped all the way. He only realized it when he fell for it.
[So a simple fight has so many aspects when humans are involved. The human world is so complicated.]
“Later, you still held me in contempt when you were stronger than me, to the point you went easy. Why? Because you overlooked my purple lightning!”
Zhuo Fan continued, “While it’s still fairly weak, it’s not useless either. As the three dragon souls were laid to bare, and you defeated them one by one, stroking your ego and startling you, the sudden mood changes made you forget my purple lightning. Making you rush was part of the plan, like insurance, in case you were paranoid to the extreme and this attack of mine went bust since I stood no chance against you in a prolonged battle. But now, ha-ha-ha… Didn’t I tell you, punk, that you’re too self-righteous… “
Zhuo Fan made a sign, and the purple dragon flicked its claw, pulling it out of the golden dragon’s body before letting purple lightning flash and sink into its chest again.
Ye Lin cried out. His soul was already damaged; if this one hit, he would be a goner.
So he had the golden flame cover its body and defend against the purple lightning attack. The purple lightning struck the flames but fizzled out.
This showed Zhuo Fan’s purple lightning wasn’t up to par.
Ye Lin felt like crying. He shouldn’t have been so eager to win and let himself suffer for it. Even if he had Zhuo Fan beaten to a pulp, he still couldn’t hurt him with four rubbish dragons.
But now, that same rubbish did him in.
The golden dragon was wrapped in golden flames, so the purple dragon turned into the demonic one and bit down to suck the flames right out of it.
When the golden dragon shot its scales in defense, the other just turned into an azure dragon to cancel the attack.
Then it changed into a scarlet dragon as it flicked its tail and sent the golden dragon flying. This wouldn’t have hurt, but since he was so heavily wounded, it added insult to the injury.
The scarlet dragon aimed for its wound as it clawed at him. Even if its claws didn’t harm the golden dragon, the heavy impact went deep into the wound and made the whole affair highly unsettling.
Ye Lin had to spit blood every time because of it. The pain in his head got so bad he felt it would explode.
Four rubbish dragon souls were ganging up on a perfect heaven dragon soul. The Decimating Dragon Ancestor would’ve exploded in anger if he saw this…

chapters.title: Chapter 703: Soul Harmony
chapters.content:
Chapter 703: Soul Harmony
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Bang~
Those were the sounds of dragon souls clashing, though they weren’t that intense, just a one-sided beating.
Decimating Golden Heaven Dragon King was fatally wounded, leaving it at a severe disadvantage. The attacks of the scarlet dragon were shrugged off before. The other dragons couldn’t do much against it, even the most brutal purple dragon couldn’t break its golden flame defense.
To sum it up, no matter which of these four dragon souls attacked, none could threaten the golden dragon.
However, after the purple dragon’s sneak attack, it left a huge opening in its defenses. To the point, the scarlet dragon’s attacks passed through and could deal some damage.
The four dragon souls thus kept switching, the azure and demonic ones, for defense against the golden flames to put him in a position where any attack was useless.
So when he stopped attacking, the scarlet dragon joined the fray, slamming into its wound. If he wanted to fight back again, the azure and black dragons would only be waiting for him.
The strong azure flame could completely contain the brutality of the golden flames. Even if he went all out, it would only give the azure dragon a slight wound, then it would turn into the purple dragon, and send those savage purple lightning strikes when it was most vulnerable.
This way, the golden dragon was stuck in a passive position. It was like how a big guy was having his arms and legs tied up and letting a bunch of brats try to beat him. Oh, but one of them was carrying a blade.
He’d shiver every time he watched the blade approach, dodging as much as possible but never attacking since there was a risk the blade would take his life.
The purple lightning was the weakest of Zhuo Fan’s powers, making the purple dragon the weakest of his four dragons. But the threat remained regardless.
To the point that the golden dragon feared another sneak attack and did not fight back. This way, he could only let Zhuo Fan’s four dragon souls rain claws and fangs on it as it was beaten repeatedly.
The audience was gaping at the sudden turn of events.
[How come the mighty golden dragon tuned up to be like a scaredy-cat?]
The people were excited, feeling life was a play because of how the positions could change so fast.
The girls were even more shocked, buzzing about and pointing, “Sister Qingcheng, what just happened? I don’t get it. How did he get the upper hand? “
“Er…”
Chu Qingcheng needed a few times to recover. She shook her head and gave a bright smile, “I always thought I understood him, but I was wrong. I never thought that he’d win by using his weakness.”
Shui Ruohua’s brow shook as she looked at Zhuo Fan in shock, “A true and capable man. Who would dare to even consider looking for victory among its faults?”
“Humph, for Ye Lin to be defeated when he was at the top of his game, he must be a moron!” Xuan Shaoyu spat in hatred.
Sword God Sect saw the big turn around and looked on in shock. Wen Tao held his head, “Tianshang, your brother has opened my eyes. I always thought it was strength that made him a freak, but now I see what it means to be ever victorious. It’s all about the mind. This is not a win gained through power since those four dragon souls couldn’t beat the golden dragon. Yet look at the golden dragon now, being beaten black and blue. Heavens, just how did he come up with such a strategy?”
“Ha-ha-ha, what’s so hard to believe? Haven’t I been saying that he comes from a lowly third-rate clan all this time? Yet, in just ten years, he got it to rule the empire. It’s not just guts alone.
