He’s been in constant danger as he schemed with the other sides. One wrong move, and it would be the end. He had dealt with many old foxes on his way too.”
Xie Tianshang smiled, “Senior brother, you should know how cruel the vie for power in a kingdom is. It’s not as simple as the competitions between sects. He also got the three greatest minds under him as well. This proves his mind is unlike anyone else’s. Ye Lin might be an amazing genius that is stronger than him, but when it comes to schemes, no sect’s young master can defend against him.”
Wen Tao eyed him and then turned to look at Zhuo Fan, “This was a big ploy all along. However, regardless of what it is, people would always lean on what they are best good at. I just can’t believe he didn’t scheme to win in melee and waited for when their souls were out. Such courage earned my respect. Who could have such confidence in him?”
“The lone breach!”
Three voices echoed out. Two were the exalted, and the other was Danqing Shen.
Their voices carried praises.
Danqing Shen held his beard and was ready to go, “The lone breach is a dangerous tactic. On a battlefield where the defensive position has its strongest defense, it caused them to neglect it, leaving fewer troops. It’s always assumed the enemy would attack the weakest points in defense, so that’s where the main force was placed. But experienced generals always do the opposite. Concentrating all their forces on the lone point of the defenses, winning in a single blow and catching the opponent off guard. By the time he reacted, the battle was over.
“This requires courage and wisdom. Failure means disaster. Zhuo Fan did the same with Ye Lin. He stroked his ego for the soul battle and caught everyone by surprise when he went for the win. Ha-ha-ha, the brat is truly bold and cunning. The winner is settled, and now I can do what I came here to do.”
Danqing Shen was carefree, as if he had been fighting, and left. However, a roar came from behind that caught everyone’s attention.
“Zhuo Fan, one of us will stand on the other’s shoulder to reach the peak, but that won’t be you!” Ye Lin roared and spewed blood as he did. His eyes were filled with fighting spirit, unwilling to give up yet.
Zhuo Fan totally got him.
The two were more or less sacred beast inheritors, so it stood to reason that it had some influence in their fight. In Ye Lin’s case, the influence was greater as the dragon ancestor’s disciple.
Losing this battle means being in the other’s allegiance. This was the way of the beast. It will leave a huge scar in one’s mind that he did not want to have.
Zhuo Fan was the same. He didn’t want his mind to become burdened and stay in Ye Lin’s shadow. It would severely impede his pursuit of Dao.
So the two had entered a stalemate.
Grinning evilly, Zhuo Fan made a sign, and the four dragon souls constantly shifted, speeding up the beating of the golden dragon. He wanted to get it over with fast. Yet he was stalling with his speech as he taunted, “Humph, the winner is settled. Give up! If dragon ancestor knew you lost to me, an inheritor of three sacred beasts, he’d understand it too. Not even he can fight three alone!”
“Bullshit, sacred beasts are arrogant. Master won’t bat an eye even if he were to fight four by himself!” Ye Lin roared.
Zhuo Fan grinned, “A wise man submits to circumstances. In a sacred beast battle of four versus one, defeat is obvious. Your master must be a fool if he fought in those circumstances.”
“Your master’s the fool…” Ye Lin cursed back.
At this time, Zhuo Fan’s Almighty Scarlet Dragon King once again whipped its tail right on the golden dragon’s wound and made it shudder.
Ye Lin spat blood again and could hardly keep going.
Zhuo Fan snickered and kept making signs while taunting. Just then, Wu Qingqiu noticed something and shouted, “Junior brother, don’t let him get to you. If you have a way to strike, now’s the time. He’s stalling! Do it now before it’s too late!”
[I’ve been duped again?!]
Startled, Ye Lin glared at Zhuo Fan and spat, “Zhuo Fan, you wretched scumbag, you dare play me again? Are you even a sacred beast inheritor?”
“I already told you, we’re humans. In war, there’s also deception. Haven’t your elders ever told you before setting out that you need to use both your fists and your brain in a brawl?” Zhuo Fan raised a taunting eyebrow.
Ye Lin was furious and about to curse, but Wu Qingqiu’s warning woke him up again.
Gnashing his teeth, Ye Lin stomped and flew a hundred meters back. He had the golden dragon flick its tail and get away as well.
Ye Lin’s face twitched as he stared at Zhuo Fan in rage, “Let me show you how a real sacred beast disciple fights. Strength is everything! I fear none of your petty tricks! “
Ye Lin made a sign and shouted, “Soul origin, golden dragon transformation, Soul Harmony!”

chapters.title: Chapter 704: Flawless
chapters.content:
Chapter 704: Flawless
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Roar!
The golden dragon coiled in the air around Ye Lin. The golden flames burned hotter and yet faded with time.
The golden dragon’s huge bulk shrank as it drew closer to Ye Lin. But the dragon did not enter his mind. Instead, it focused on his body, blending with his flesh and spreading through every cell.
With a fashionable golden flame explosion, Ye Lin’s body was covered in a thick dragon scale armor, each individual scale containing the volatile and destructive golden flame.
A mere flick of the wrist and the effect was like the golden dragon whipping his tail, sending a rush of superheated air storming everywhere. Whether it met the mountains, plants, or wildlife, they were all decimated.
[This can’t be…]
Zhuo Fan was shocked to the core. The exalted showed the same reaction as they jumped to their feet. “This is something only a Soul Harmony Stage expert can do, harmonizing body and soul!”
The Soul Harmony Stage was what came after the Ethereal Stage. It allowed one to focus their soul power into their flesh, for soul and body to become one. The body would thus become a natural defense of the soul, keeping it from harm.
In other words, while Ye Lin’s soul was greatly damaged and could no longer fight, by combining it with his body, his soul power could be fully displayed. His body would also protect it from any more harm, completely nulling the effect of Zhuo Fan’s sneak attack through the use of the purple dragon.
Ye Lin was back to when his soul was in its best shape. Moreover, since the soul and body were now one, Ye Lin’s soul and body power combined to make him even stronger. This outcome left Zhuo Fan frowning once more.
[For crying out loud… am I going to fail right at the end? We’re back where we started! No, it’s worse actually, far worse…]
Zhuo Fan clenched his fists and gnashed his teeth.
The others gasped in shock at the incredible development.
[What’s going on? An Ethereal Stage expert can use a Soul Harmony Stage’s ability? This is insane!]
Then again, if one would take a simple look at Zhuo Fan, in the Radiant Stage, one would see him using his soul as an Ethereal Stage expert would.
[Gods, these people are aberrations, one more than the other. We’re the normal ones here, yet we can’t hold a candle to them. Ugh, it pisses me off!]
Only Chu Qingcheng and the girls were worried for Zhuo Fan. Seeing the tables turned once more, they held their deep gazes on his figure, hoping for the best.
“Ha-ha-ha, didn’t see that coming did you? A sacred beast’s body is the best, and it becomes flawless when the soul harmonizes with it. As the dragon ancestor’s disciple, this soul harmony skill comes naturally.”
Ye Lin mocked, seeing Zhuo Fan’s shaken face, and grinned, “Now I’m a miniature version of the Decimating Dragon Ancestor. Let’s see you beat me now!”
Ye Lin shot for Zhuo Fan, the powerful golden flames surging into a typhoon. Zhuo Fan could feel the blistering heat before it reached him, practically cooking him alive!
Zhuo Fan squinted, and his face became stern. He made a sign and called the dragon soul to protect him.
A hundred-meter-long savage dragon appeared before Zhuo Fan. The scarlet glow was so strong it struck fear in the average man, containing unspeakable raw power.
Roar!
The Almighty Scarlet Dragon King saw Ye Lin was coming and clawed at the tiny human. A great power pressed on Ye Lin’s shoulder, but Ye Lin only huffed as he spat.
A stream of golden flames covered the dragon, even though it came from a tiny human.
In a flash, the golden flames spread and scorched the dragon until it wailed. Its attack had no chance of continuing because of it.
Ye Lin laughed in contempt.
Zhuo Fan merely smirked, bearing through the piercing headache as he made a sign. The Almighty Scarlet Dragon King turned into the Heaven-Devouring Demonic Dragon King. The black aura around it swallowed the flames, and the pain vanished. Zhuo Fan eased a breath as well.
However, Ye Lin was not about to let all that bashing Zhuo Fan put him through go with just a little singeing, now would he?
And this demonic dragon only knew how to gulp down flames. Other than that, it was pretty much useless. So Ye Lin jumped in front of it and waved his hands, sending thousands of fire motes at it in the form of rain, “Scale Shedding!”
Bang~
The explosions didn’t let up as the demonic dragon was bombarded under the heavy rain of attacks. It wailed in pain and twisted its body.
Zhuo Fan shook and rushed to turn it into the Vaulting Dragon King. The azure flames swallowed all the incoming golden scales and removed the danger.
However, Ye Lin snickered now that the azure dragon was out. It was all this dragon’s fault that pushed him into giving his all and leaving himself open to the purple dragon.
It had to suffer for its transgression!
So to get his sweet vengeance and prove his limitless power to Zhuo Fan for the last time, Ye Lin used a different move.
Ye Lin jumped above the azure dragon’s head and punched down. All the golden flames were gathered in that tiny fist, leaving himself open again.
“Ye Lin, you dare?” Zhuo Fan cried out threateningly.
Ye Lin mocked, “Just watch me! Go ahead, use the purple dragon to attack me! “
Ye Lin’s golden flamed fist smashed down just like the golden dragon claw attack from before.
The powerful golden flames scattered the azure flames on the azure dragon, and it hit its spine, making it howl in pain as it took the entire blow.
But soon, just like before, the azure dragon turned purple, and it clawed at Ye Lin’s chest.
Pa!
The crack of thunder sounded, and Ye Lin’s body was flung away, but not too far. Looking down at his chest and the singed area, he merely dusted it off as he taunted in a condescending tone, “It didn’t even tingle. Your purple lightning is so utterly weak. I just can’t imagine how on earth you even got to hurt the golden dragon the first time…”
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, and he held his head as it felt like it was splitting.
Ye Lin was different from before. The sneak attack worked last time because the golden dragon’s defenses were down.
While this time, Ye Lin harmonized with his soul, making the body become a shield for the soul. In other words, Ye Lin was flawless. Nothing could harm him now.
Unless, of course, by a powerful attack.
While he could fight for longer against the battle-hungry Ye Lin, and the azure dragon could hold on for longer, but even then, he could not see how he could come on top in this.
He was facing a dead end unless he could breach that tough body of his…
Squinting, Zhuo Fan thought.
[Lucky yours truly comes prepared for anything. As for its effect, that remains to be seen…]
Zhuo Fan went right to it and made a different sign as he jumped on the huge dragon.
Ye Lin started and wondered.
[Soul harmony too?]
However, Zhuo Fan was no orthodox sacred beast inheritor. Soul harmony wasn’t in his bag of tricks.
Pa!
With a flick of the tail, the azure dragon turned and darted through the air further and further… away. Ye Lin froze in shock.
[What the hell?! We’re in the middle of something here, and he bails? How is he even a sacred beast inheritor?]
Then came Zhuo Fan’s enervating taunt, “Ye Lin, the time’s almost up. We’ll settle things next time!”
“So that’s why! The punk knows he can’t fight, so he wants a draw!” Ye Lin figured out his motive and exploded in rage.
In a sacred beast battle, it was all about meeting power with power, not running away from it!
[You had me beaten around like a punching bag, but the second things look tough, you just take off? Do you think it’s that easy?]
Ye Lin went right after him. Zhuo Fan snickered, revealing his evil smile.
Ultimate Clarity Sect’s disciples were worried, “Senior brother Zhuo Fan is a bag full of dirty tricks. It can’t be that junior brother’s going to fall for another, can it? “
“He shouldn’t.”
Wu Qingqiu shook his head, “Junior brother is now without weakness. His earlier trick won’t work again, and the only way to defeat junior brother is by raw power…”

chapters.title: Chapter 705: I’ll Think About It Later
chapters.content:
Chapter 705: I’ll Think About It Later
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Whoosh!
A huge figure shot through the air, straight for Demon Scheming Sect’s disciples.
The disciples saw Zhuo Fan was riding his dragon soul at them with the even more dreaded Ye Lin on his tail. They instantly panicked as they fled and cursed.
[There are so many other, better directions when choosing to escape. Why did you have to come to us? Why are you leading death straight at us? We didn’t do anything to you to die at another’s hand!]
They were all trying to escape the area as quickly as possible.
Danqing Shen was also cursing.
[What’s the punk up to this time? Why is he moving the battle here? Does he know I’m hiding here and wants me to lend a hand? Damn kid, that will expose me!]
With no choice and raving in his mind about Zhuo Fan’s rash behavior, he hid in a corner somewhere where the monitoring arrays couldn’t find him.
Only his mind was still cursing.
[Damn brat, I’ll get you for this…]
Exalted Double Dragons looked lost. Exalted Hei Ran said, “Hey, old timer, what’s he up to this time? In this particular situation, even we can see that Ye Lin has covered all bases. No matter what tricks he is pulling, only meeting his opponent head-on wouldn’t produce any results.”
“Ha-ha-ha, true.”
Exalted Bai Mei smiled, “But did this kid ever follow common sense? Just like moments ago, how many here actually thought that the soul battle would go through another shift?”
Exalted Hei Ran smiled as well, “You’re right. All this kid does come as a shock. But now, Ye Lin has combined his soul and body. This fight has now changed from a soul battle to a melee one. You might as well say he’s without flaw. What plan could the kid possibly have? Wait!”
Exalted Bai Mei gave him a look and then nodded.
Everyone else thought the same thing, looking at Zhuo Fan in worry. Ye Lin, now having united his soul and body, his speed was off the charts, catching up to Zhuo Fan in seconds.
Looking back with a frown, Zhuo Fan made a sign and had his huge right speed up.
“Ha-ha-ha, don’t waste your breath. You’re too slow!” Ye Lin cackled, his eyes red. “No matter what dirty little scheme you have cooked up, it’s nothing my perfect form can’t handle. The only way is to break my body to reach my soul. But you lost in melee to me already!”
“Well, I wouldn’t be so quick to judge.”
Zhuo Fan squinted, glancing back to see the Thunder Ring that got ‘shaken off’ earlier was close. He smiled and shouted, “Qiao’er!”
Shriek~
The piercing cry rang throughout the sky. Just as Zhuo Fan’s mount passed the ring, with Ye Lin close behind him, purple thunder crackled out of it.
A thunderbird a hundred meters big and streaked by lightning appeared and slammed into Ye Lin when he had his guard down.
[What?!]
Ye Lin’s eyes widened in shock. He was more than familiar with the purple lightning. And this purple lightning’s level was way above what Zhuo Fan used.
This was a true Thunder Phoenix!
“Shattering Thunder Claw!”
With a sharp shout, Qiao’er flapped her wings, unleashing a deep rumble as she shot for Ye Lin.
Then came the two sharp claws, flickering with deadly purple lightning, raking that chest covered in golden flames.
Pff!
It was a clash between the lightning above and the fire below. The two incredibly destructive forces clashed and unleashed a monumental explosion. Qiao’er’s claw came down on Ye Lin’s hard scales just like how a spear screeched in contact with a tough shield.
However, since Qiao’er’s attack came out of the blue, he could not mount a defense, so two scales were pulled off.
A patch of dark red was exposed on his chest. Ye Lin was taken over by severe pain and coughed blood as he was flung into the air.
Everyone was dumbstruck, watching the thunderbird gobsmacked. It displayed its grandeur as it flapped its wings with pride.
[Where did this spiritual beast come from?]
The exalted were back on their feet again as they cried, “I knew it!”
“Old timer, see that?” Exalted Hei Ran said excitedly, “The kid’s plans go back from the start. He even had such a move taken into account!”
Exalted Bai Mei nodded, “I doubted from the start. How did the kid lose his ring in the melee so easily? Now I see it was all planned out. He sent it flying to catch Ye Lin right when he least expected it!”
“Which means one shouldn’t get too confident, even if you’re stronger. Today, Zhuo Fan had given Ye Lin a few harsh but good lessons. Wonder how many he’ll remember, ha-ha-ha…”
Exalted Hei Ran turned to the thunderbird with a frown. “But with Ye Lin’s strength, no average spiritual beast could scratch him. Just what beast is this?”
Exalted Bai Mei pondered before he said, “It’s just a 6th-level spiritual beast but far stronger than one. Not even a spiritual beast in the 8th level might be its match. It truly is strange. And from the looks of it, it resembles a Thunder Skylark yet far stronger.”
“Ha-ha-ha, like master, like spirit animal. Zhuo Fan is a monster in himself, so of course, he raises a monstrous spirit animal! He’s truly something!” Exalted Hei Ran smiled.
Exalted Bai Mei chuckled, casting his admiring gaze on Zhuo Fan.
If Ye Lin were an unseen cultivating talent, then Zhuo Fan would be an all-rounded talent, just as astounding.
Unlike Ye Lin’s amazing cultivation, Zhuo Fan’s incredible and broadened use of skill left them more impressed.
After all, strength can only get you so far…
“Senior brother, look! I just knew the punk had a trick in mind!” A disciple of the Ultimate Clarity Sect pointed at Ye Lin’s patch of red on his chest.
Wu Qingqiu’s face twitched as he hit the other guy’s head, “And you’re happy junior brother got duped?”
“That’s not what I meant! I just wanted to say that I saw through his trick…”
“You call that seeing? It was just a wild guess. The punk set up so many tricks, even an idiot can see that junior brother, in his perfect state, will get taken in.”
Glaring at him, Wu Qingqiu sighed, “However, why did you brainless fools have to be right? The punk had another trick, and it worked. And where the hell did he find such a weird spiritual beast? There’s no way the average spiritual beast can harm junior brother!”
The others frowned at Qiao’er, also shocked by her display.
As Ye Lin’s senior brothers, they knew how truly monstrous he was. They had seen many amazing spiritual beasts that couldn’t even scratch him.
So Ye Lin chose to overlook getting a pet himself, fighting all others with one without fear. But who’d have thought the day would come he’d suffer for it? It wasn’t just about falling for another trick but being hurt so much as well.
He was hurt by a spiritual beast!
Danqing Shen sighed at the flickering purple lights.
[This bird is out of this world, and so is its cunning handler.]
He finally understood that Zhuo Fan didn’t just look for a good chance to get rid of his ring. He had planned on coming up with a good excuse for the Exalted Double Dragons as well, that of sneak attacking Ye Lin.
[See what I did there? I used my ring to set up a trap. Danqing Shen running to the sacred mine and stealing Atlas Sword has nothing to do with me. I’m innocent!]
“Ha-ha-ha, this kid’s mind is truly frightening!”
Shaking his head, Danqing Shen sighed. He was even sure Zhuo Fan came up with this tactic the minute he mentioned using the storage ring to slip in here.
He had to take his hat off at this one.
In the audience, Xie Tianshang and Chu Qingcheng saw Qingcheng and felt relieved. They had seen Qiao’er back in the Esoteric Debate. They felt closer to her because Zhuo Fan had brought her out again.
“She has grown so much over the years…” Chu Qingcheng looked with a soft gaze.

chapters.title: Chapter 706: Reverse Scale
chapters.content:
Chapter 706: Reverse Scale
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Father, he’s amazing. I clawed him with all I had but only managed to take two scales off. There’s no real damage either!” Qiao’er had flown back to Zhuo Fan in disappointment.
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, his eyes grave, “And this was from a sneak attack. For him not to have gotten a heavy wound even from that, shows his body is tough beyond measure. No average spiritual beast can scratch him.”
Squinting, Zhuo Fan looked at Ye Lin, who had been flung into the air like a ragdoll after the attack, yet his heart tensed.
Qiao’er’s attack was his last ace. If even that failed, all that was left was to fight head-on, the worst option from how he saw it.
He knew fully well that would mean using a very dangerous move not just for his enemy, but for him too. It was the last thing he wanted to resort to.
After all, he only came up with it a short while ago and didn’t even have time to test it…
Hu~
As the wind whistled, Ye Lin flipped into the air, spitting out blood on the ground.
Whoosh!
Ye Lin halted his movement and looked down at his chest and the exposed flesh. His face was a mask of rage, his eyes turning cruel.
“Ever since I inherited master’s drop of blood, having been implanted with one of his reverse scales to refine this golden dragon body, I have never been reduced to this state. Zhuo Fan, you’re the first!”
Ye Lin glared back at Zhuo Fan, his eyes sometimes darting at Qiao’er filled with bloodthirst. “A dragon’s scales are his dignity, and you just crushed it. Zhuo Fan, you’ve really gone and pissed me off!”
Zhuo Fan’s heart shivered and now knew why this guy’s body was so hard that even Qiao’er could barely harm him.
[He’s just like me, having received a part of a sacred beast’s body.]
His Qilin arm came from Soaring Qilin’s leg. That was what gave him such power. Ye Lin’s scale armor came from Decimating Dragon Ancestor’s reverse scale, which is harder than anything.
Dragons were covered in scales, but only that particular one at the back of their necks, the reverse scale, was the toughest and the best to draw out its power.
In simple terms, touching it was the same as crossing the line no one could tolerate.
Since he placed the reverse scale into him and forged his body with a drop of dragon blood, he had made him nigh indestructible. No wonder he was so tough in this state. This was how much he valued the scales.
Zhuo Fan just got two of those pulled off. It was no different than slapping him hard on the face. No wonder he said that he was just like Zhuo Fan and only wanted to defeat Zhuo Fan. Now though, he really wanted him dead.
Zhuo Fan’s heart sank, knowing this had stopped being a simple match to see who was stronger. Now his life was on the line.
It was either one or the other.
He wanted blood now, and if he won…
[My head will fly.]
So Zhuo Fan took a deep breath, and his eyes went cold. Qiao’er, next to him, noticed the change in mood and grew serious as well.
Silence fell between the two sides, one of death.
They no longer cared about a winner now, only to kill!
Startled, Wu Qingqiu seemed to have sensed the shift as well, “What’s going on? Why do I feel a thick killing intent? Does that mean junior brother really wants blood?”
“Can’t be, senior brother. That kid has always been carefree. He’s been acting like he wants to kill but never going that far. Even when he was blindsided, he was only enraged…”
One disciple spoke confidently, but Wu Qingqiu waved him off, “I’ve yet to see junior brother truly wishing to kill someone. Maybe because he never met anyone worthy enough to go that far. This time though….”
Wu Qingqiu frowned, filled with worry.
As the team leader of the Ultimate Clarity Sect disciples, he did not want to see something happening to Ye Lin or Zhuo Fan.
In the fights seen the past few days, everyone’s style and character were laid bare, and everyone had an understanding of each other. They saw how they related, how similar they were. Just as Zhuo Fan wanted to go further as they did on their path. That was why he didn’t want to see him fall.
Seeing how this shifted into a deathmatch, his heart was hesitating…
The Exalted Double Dragons noticed the shift thanks to their years of experience.
“This stillness… is eerie.” Exalted Hei Ran spoke heavily.
Exalted Bai Mei nodded, “The two kids are going for the kill. No matter what, these two are western lands’ future. They can’t fall here. If it comes to it, we old timers will have to violate Double Dragon Gathering’s rules for the first time.”
“It will be a severe blow to our impartial image, but worth it.” Exalted Hei Ran nodded, but then sighed, “Old timer, when Sheng went through so much trouble, we pacified the lands in the name of fairness. Have we turned soft or… have our principles changed?”
Exalted Bai Mei shook his head in silence.
Exalted Hei Ran did not speak anymore. He knew well about the regret the two felt about how they handled Danqing Shen’s matter. It had festered for so long and so much that they felt the fairness they had groomed all these years no longer looked as important…
“Qiao’er, attack!”
Zhuo Fan shouted and rode his dragon soul as he shot for Ye Lin. Qiao’er shrieked alongside him.
Zhuo Fan had run out of tricks and schemes. All that was left was to meet blow for blow.
The two men and one bird clashed!
Ye Lin, in his new form, was a mighty challenge. He didn’t suffer even against Zhuo Fan and Qiao’er. The screech and clanging of metal resounded as the dangerous shockwaves traveled everywhere.
Ye Lin’s body was harder than steel. No matter how hard Zhuo Fan hit, it didn’t do much. At the same time, he was having a hard time resisting the incoming blows.
Since he was combined in soul and body, all the strikes were packed with not just the golden dragon’s power but its searing flames as well.
Zhuo Fan had no choice but to keep shifting his dragon soul. The four variations could take an occasional hit or two, but Zhuo Fan’s soul was under threat once more.
Fortunately, he had a helper, Qiao’er. Being born out of purple lightning and imposing like the Thunder Phoenix, she would meet the golden flames without fear. The purple lightning rained down on Ye Lin’s body and exploded when meeting the flames. Ye Lin had no choice but to shift some of them for defense.
Qiao’er’s purple lightning was unlike the junk Zhuo Fan’s purple dragon used. That was a power gained after being trained for years. It had reached such a degree, and Qiao’er might just be the new Thunder Phoenix.
Ye Lin could not ignore the power of a 6th Heaven purple lightning and had to defend with his golden flames, thus giving Zhuo Fan some breathing room.
Even so, the pair had yet to do any real damage ever since that last sneak attack. In fact, the two were being pushed back under Ye Lin’s onslaught.
The fight had entered a stalemate. Despite the obvious discrepancy in strength, the two sides had no way of defeating the other for a while.
Zhuo Fan knew he was at a disadvantage but still kept his cool. He knew the time was almost up, and the fight would be judged as a draw. While he wanted to win, he was not that desperate.
He knew Ye Lin wanted to win much more than him. When Ye Lin was restless enough, he would get an opening to use. That was why good things happened to those who waited.
Seeing through Zhuo Fan’s intent, or maybe he showed it on purpose, Ye Lin was getting tense and impatient.
He wanted to strike Zhuo Fan down for good, but Qiao’er would not let him. Time was running out…
Bang~
Ye Lin threw a bunch of scales, and Zhuo Fan used the azure dragon to mitigate the explosions. Ye Lin wanted to claw the azure dragon, but Qiao’er butted in, and the impact of the purple lightning sent him flying and refocused on defense.
He might have the advantage, but his hands were tied.
[Blast it! I have to get rid of that damn bird and fast!]
Ye Lin gnashed his teeth…
“Yin Yang Dragon Claw!”
Ye Lin’s eyes flashed and shot for Zhuo Fan. His hand turned into a claw enveloped by raging flames as he aimed at Zhuo Fan’s heart.
Zhuo Fan used the Qilin arm to block, but behind it, he grinned, “Kids these days have no patience, ha-ha-ha…”

chapters.title: Chapter 707: Orthodox
chapters.content:
Chapter 707: Orthodox
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Whoosh!
The golden claw whistled through the air and was about to strike while Zhuo Fan used his Qilin arm as a shield, ready to take it on.
[The Qilin arm comes from the Soaring Qilin. At the very least, it won’t get me broken bones if you hit me anywhere else!]
[It will take your blow!]
Shriek~
Qiao’er rushed in support, wanting to use this chance to strike. The claw was about to hit!
If Ye Lin kept attacking, the claw would do nothing to Zhuo Fan’s Qilin arm. Only the golden flames would seep in a little and barely cause any harm.
[Why else would I use that arm for all my attacks?]
Then Qiao’er would come bearing brutal purple lightning to make another heavy wound on him after focusing all he had in that claw.
It was, without a doubt, a bad tactic to use this attack.
This scene had been recurring many times already. When one attacked with everything, the other would come to take advantage of the opening, only to force the attacker to shift to defense.
This time was no different. Only Ye Lin was at the end of his patience. He would rather suffer another hit from Qiao’er to get Zhuo Fan. It was an eye for an eye.
“You dare, boy? With two against one, going for mutual harm isn’t worth it!” Zhuo Fan once again intimidated him while sneering inside.
[He’s rash enough now!]
Ye Lin snorted, “Mutual harm? Humph, I might have fallen for your tricks so far, but that’s going to change. This time, I’m going to get rid of your spirit animal!”
Ye Lin was gone and left behind him his golden flames. It was like he was still attacking Zhuo Fan but lacking in power.
But just the golden flames wouldn’t be able to even singe Zhuo Fan’s clothes since Zhuo Fan had the azure dragon and Demon Transformation Art to absorb it.
However, Ye Lin’s figure appeared next to the golden flames and unleashed another claw, but this time at Qiao’er.
Everyone gasped.
Since Zhuo Fan revealed his purple dragon, they knew the purple lightning was a force to be reckoned with. It was brutal and powerful but lacked in defense.
So Ye Lin feinted, striking Zhuo Fan, who had the Qilin arm for defense. While going for the defenseless Qiao’er would show much better results.
Qiao’er would be gravely wounded if struck, the two’s cooperation would fail, and Ye Lin would gain a real advantage. Dealing with Zhuo Fan later would only take a minute.
This was the most definitive moment in this long and bitter match.
Qiao’er was startled, having not expected this. Feeling on her feathers the sharpness of that dragon claw, she tensed.
“Yin Yang Dragon Claw. One real, one fake!”
Ye Lin snickered as his strike was about to land. He laughed, “Zhuo Fan, you schemed for so long against me, but now it’s my turn. My strike against you is fake, while the one against your spirit animal is real. This time, your cooperation failed, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook as he floated in the air.
The audience grew tense, having not expected Ye Lin would also start using feints. Wu Qingqiu chuckled, “Ha-ha-ha, junior brother finally used his head. Not that he’s slow, but that his opponents were never worth the effort.”
They all felt it was curtains for this long and exciting match!
However, Zhuo Fan’s grin was most devious. His right eye flashed golden, “Ha-ha-ha, I don’t really care how you go all out, just as long as you do. Divine Eye of the Void 1st stage, Shift!”
Whoosh~
In a flash, Zhuo Fan and Qiao’er did the ol’ switcheroo so that Zhuo Fan was on the receiving end of Ye Lin’s real strike.
Ye Lin cried out. “What the hell? Where’s that damn poultry?”
Pff!
Just then, the golden flame image was flapped away by Qiao’er’s wings, and she unleashed her purple lightning storm and clawed at Ye Lin’s chest.
The last claw had taken away his hard scales, and this one was bound to send purple lightning right into his innards.
This had long stopped being an issue of winning for Ye Lin. He had to first protect his little life from being cooked from the inside.
Wu Qingqiu cried out and tensed. The exalted shot to their feet and were just as nervous.
It all happened so fast!
One minute it was Ye Lin’s obvious advantage, and the next, his target switched places, putting him in grave danger.
Sss~
Gulping, Ye Lin was scared out of his mind. He halted his attack on Zhuo Fan and tried to get into a stance to defend, though it would take some time.
Left with no choice, Ye Lin could only lean, taking Qiao’er’s sharp claws on his back and letting her remove two more glittering scales.
Scarlet blood flowed from his back, and he gnashed his teeth from the pain. The sudden heavy blow had also interrupted the claw now meant for Zhuo Fan.
Even after careful planning, he was still the one ending up hurt again while his adversary was untouched.
Qiao’er flew back to Zhuo Fan, throwing away the scales in her claws, “Father, he just turned around, and I couldn’t get him in the heart!”
“It’s fine. He’s just too quick to react. In fact, we dealt a great blow this time. He now has two weaknesses. We’ll now resort to pincer strikes and see how long he’ll last, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan laughed as he snickered at Ye Lin, “The clearer it is you can win with brawn, the more you need to use your head. Don’t you know using your faults to fight an enemy’s strengths is dumb? Trying to use feints against me, who had been among schemes all his life? Kid, you’re unbearably naive!”
Ye Lin’s face twitched in anger, gritting his teeth.
The audience had to agree on that. They thought Ye Lin finally played Zhuo Fan, only to be toyed with instead.
[Getting trapped as you lay a trap must sting…]
Wen Tao sighed, seeing Ye Lin boiling mad. “Using brains to crush the other. Ye Lin is clearly stronger, but Zhuo Fan keeps leading him, making this focused disciple lose his bearing. If he had kept to his beliefs, he wouldn’t have to suffer so much.”
“Focused?” Xie Tianshang raised an eyebrow.
Wen Tao nodded, “Yes, cultivators like us all have a focus as we advance. Some do it for power, some for status, some for fame, and some for supremacy. Each of us is walking the path we want that lead to the birth of personal beliefs and convictions. Isn’t Ye Lin blunt? Then he should just take any adversary head-on!
“But after meeting Zhuo Fan, he’s been toyed with so many times that he lost his way and stooped to fumbling on the other’s path. He’s been strung along all this time!”
Wen Tao looked above and smiled, “The time’s almost up. Now Ye Lin will become even more restless. He won’t fall for another trick soon, and Zhuo Fan won’t snatch a win soon, either. It’ll be a draw.”
But then he heard Zhuo Fan looking at the pretty sky and exclaimed, “Oh my, would you look at the time? It’s going to be a draw at this rate.”
Staggering, Wen Tao stared at Zhuo Fan, then shook his head. “Zhuo Fan is really devious. Even in the last moment, he can’t help but prod Ye Lin. Wishing for victory just as much, Zhuo Fan is savage and cunning to stir the other even more.”
Xie Tianshang chuckled.
[That’s always been his nature…]
Huff~
Gasping, Ye Lin was close to exhaustion both mentally and physically. He glared at the bird and man in hatred but with no way of finishing them off.
[This frickin’ punk is too sly!]
If he were too rash, he’d be duped. If he went too slow, he’d suffer for it even worse. The adversary always aimed to toy with his mind, thus making him unable to cope.
He was now left confused and lost as to how to proceed.
It was his first time meeting such an adversary. He was clearly stronger yet could do nothing to win.
Just as he was filled with confusion, a shout broke through the haze, “Junior brother, he’s rushing you on purpose. Don’t fall for it. If you don’t know what to do, ask your heart!”
Shaken up, Ye Lin looked back to see his head senior brother, Wu Qingqiu…

chapters.title: Chapter 708: Win
chapters.content:
Chapter 708: Win
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Ye Lin’s face twitched, and it finally dawned on his foggy mind. He had been strung along until he was lost, veering off his path.
With a deep breath, Ye Lin regained his calm and closed his eyes…
“Master, my sect is going through the outer sect competition tomorrow. There can only be ten new inner disciples, but I’m just an outer disciple in the 21st place. What do I do?” A young Ye Lin asked the dragon ancestor.
The huge dragon eye stared coldly as his voice rumbled, “Get rid of all those twenty people in front of you.”
“But I can’t beat them!”
“Beat them all, or don’t bother seeing me again!” The dragon ancestor said coldly, then turned his back.
Face sinking, the young Ye Lin felt put on the spot. “They’re better than me in martial arts and cultivation methods. How can I beat them? And the first ten get to be inner disciples. I only need to beat ten.”
“Worthless! Get lost!”
“Master, why are you cussing at me? Did I say something wrong?”
“Humans are devious and seize any chance to win, while also being weak. But if you think of yourself like that, you’re not worthy of calling me master.” The huge dragon spoke, “Among spiritual beasts, every creature knows its position. Its place is clear to all. Do you know why?”
Ye Lin shook his head.
[Why would I know that crap?]
The dragon ancestor mocked, “That’s because since ancient times, since the primal chaos, once a spiritual beast lost, its rank is set. Every generation knows this. Once you lose, you will always lag behind. We, the five great sacred beasts, are at the peak of all spiritual beasts. We had fought among ourselves, but we could never win against each other, so we stood together. But in their hearts, they all wish to stand above everyone, to be the one true king! “
“That’s why, our path, that of spiritual beasts, is to win! Winning means life, glory, and respect. It doesn’t matter who is in front of you, how weak or strong, or how many. You are to remember my words, boy. If you are to be my disciple, you just have to win! Even if there were a hundred people in front of you in the sect, you still have to go through all of them. You have to risk your life and fight them to win! There are still three months as well. I will see your progress afterward…”
The dragon ancestor closed his eyes and curled up to sleep. The young Ye Lin bowed and withdrew.
Three months later, a flash of fire revealed Ye Lin once more. His meridians were crushed and hanging by a thread.
“M-master… I won…” Ye Lin wheezed out.
The dragon ancestor cast a cold gaze, “All of them?”
“I beat all of them. I staked my life, and they thought I was crazy. None wanted to meet me head-on. Finally, I came out first.”
With a faint smile, Ye Lin continued, “Master, you were right. Humans are opportunistic and weak. None dared to face me. But now my body is ruined, and the inner sect doesn’t want me anymore. Someone even laughed at me for being a fool. But I didn’t care. I won, and I felt great! It was all worth it…”
The dragon ancestor nodded, “The average man is blinded by fame and can’t see the value of winning. You, however, now know the value in being first and have earned your right to be Decimating Dragon Ancestor’s disciple.”
Hum~
The dragon ancestor’s brow creased as a burning drop of blood flew out from between. It glittered like a ruby as it settled on Ye Lin’s forehead.
The dragon ancestor then clawed the back of his neck and came out with a sharp scale, the hardest reverse scale. Like a huge quilt, he settled it over Ye Lin.
The dragon ancestor then breathed out golden flames onto the kid. After a full 49 days passed, the true dragon ancestor inheritor, the one we saw today, was born!
He also inherited his master’s path, to win!
Losing once meant losing everything…
Opening his eyes, Ye Lin had no hesitation left in them. He knew his path, his beliefs.
Bouncing around from one trick to another was not a sacred beast’s style. For a sacred beast disciple, all that mattered was to win.
Even if he was facing a fierce pair, he just had to stake it all and win!
Ye Lin’s spirit was lifted and caused even Zhuo Fan to shudder.
“Qiao’er, be careful. This punk has made up his mind. He won’t fall for it again. This time, we’re fighting to the end!” Zhuo Fan warned.
He had seen his fair share of resolute people like Ye Lin, and all of them were a big thorn to deal with.
He had to keep his guard up no matter what came!
Pa!
Ye Lin put his hands together as he went through a series of signs. When he finished, his entire body exploded with power.
The powerful Decimating Golden Flame surged higher and higher like an endless sea. Zhuo Fan was in shock.
[Just what is he trying to do?]
The Exalted Double Dragons were stunned as well. They could see that Ye Lin held in his eyes the desire to win, one that drove him mad!
Hu~
Ye Lin made the final sign, and the torrent of golden flames rolled around him, and the image of a huge dragon appeared behind him, bearing its fangs and savagery.
The flaming inferno gathered around the dragon head and was ready to strike at any second.
“T-this…”
Wu Qingqiu gasped, “Is this Soul Scorching? Junior brother is going to burn his soul just to win?”
“What?!”
Ultimate Clarity Sect’s disciples were in disbelief, “That’s only used when one fights to the very end. If not careful, he could burn his entire soul away! The enemy only got him twice with his tricks, so why must he use such a definite strike? This is too extreme!”
“You don’t understand. This is the real junior brother!”
Wu Qingqiu shook his head and sighed, “Did you all forget that outer sect competition? How did junior brother become the first to enter the inner sect?”
The others recalled those brutal fights and nodded, “I’ve never seen a crazier lunatic in my life. Just to win, he staked his life. To the point, he got everyone so scared they soiled their pants. He even managed to beat the first outer disciples, but he broke his body to do it. The inner sect elder saw him ruined and didn’t want him. He then asked senior brother to take him to the secret realm. Then, after 49 days, he returned as a true genius. This made people talk about the secret realm as being not just a heaven to refine the soul but the body as well. A shame that it never worked for anyone else!”
“What you don’t know is that after I saw his desperate struggle since he yearned to go to the secret realm, I chose to honor his last wish. But when I left his body, I soon found it gone. I used to think someone took it, only to find out 49 days later that he entered the inner sect. I believe there’s a real secret in there, but he didn’t want to tell anyone. “
Sighing, Wu Qingqiu said, “Now I understand that that was where he found his path. Now, his mind is back to that time, and he sees Zhuo Fan as his bitter enemy.”
Everyone turned to Ye Lin and nodded.
Ever since Ye Lin was reborn, no one could force him to show all he had; until Zhuo Fan came along.
That was why the kid was back to that time when he staked his life…
Biting winds and searing hot air washed over Zhuo Fan, who was creasing his brows hard at the problem he faced.
Such power was clearly meant for him and Qiao’er together.
[He has stopped trying to deal with us one by one and wants to end us together. This is a madman no matter how one sees him!]
The best way to deal with a team was to pick them out individually. Taking them all out at the same time was too dangerous and pricey.
Ye Lin, however, was a sacred beast inheritor. In his eyes, winning was everything; and worth everything.
“Qiao’er, no matter what happens, you must stay behind me. I can take it!” Zhuo Fan warned carefully.
Qiao’er nodded, despite the odd glimmer in her eyes…

chapters.title: Chapter 709: Divine Eye of the Void’s 5th Stage
chapters.content:
Chapter 709: Divine Eye of the Void’s 5th Stage
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Hu~
Golden scorching flames surrounded Ye Lin. That concentrated and frightening power erupted now and then, singing more and more of the valley’s flora.
Demon Scheming Sect and Ultimate Clarity Sect’s disciples had long since ducked for cover four miles out, yet never taking their eyes off this grand and brutal battle. Yet even at this distance, the burning heat made them all sweat, only to be vaporized the next instant.
All of them were strong kids of their generations, except for Yue’er, in the 3rd layer Radiant Stage, who had to take cover forty miles away.
Regardless, they all had difficulty resisting the fire, feeling as if it might pulverize them any second.
Ye Lin’s burning soul had made the Decimating Dragon Ancestor’s golden flames reach a new height of power, a power that could wipe anything out of existence.
Even the audience watching the screen seemed to feel that dreadful power around them.
The exalted stood up in shock and worry. Could Zhuo Fan even take such a strike?
If their lives were put in danger, they would definitely intervene.
Chu Qingcheng and the girls held their fists tight. Their brows scrounged up in deep worry for Zhuo Fan’s fate…
If others could feel close to dying so far away, it went without saying that Zhuo Fan was getting the worst of it.
Thick black energy covered his body. Heaven Devouring Demonic Dragon King coiled its body to protect him. It used the Demon Transformation Art to refine this scorching heat.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shook and grew tense as he used his dragon soul to keep Qiao’er out of harm’s way behind him. He said, “Qiao’er, this might be the last clash to settle this fight. Help me at the start, but then you are to leave as fast as possible. Leave this to me!”
“Yes, father!”
Qiao’er gave a hard nod, but her eyes shone with hesitation, something Zhuo Fan completely missed in his precarious state.
He was only focused on Ye Lin.
[This has to be the punk’s last ditched effort. I just got to live through this and…]
Zhuo Fan’s gaze became hard as his hands made signs.
In the eleventh hour of the fight, these two were ready to stake it all. Zhuo Fan was going to use every dirty trick and skill he had learned to block this attack Ye Lin would unleash after he burned his soul to unleash it.
Ye Lin watched Zhuo Fan with a ragged breath. The strain on his soul was immense, but his eyes had never been more focused. His thirst for victory was like no other.
“In a fight of sacred beast inheritors, the last winner shall be me!”
Ye Lin shouted, “Zhuo Fan and that pet of yours, take this, Decimating Dragon Roar!”
Roar!
The huge dragon image around Ye Lin roared, shaking the world, the mountains, and the skies.
With this roar, the golden flames shot for Zhuo Fan like a flamethrower, disintegrating anything in its path with its deadly heat.
Zhuo Fan was overwhelmed. The exalted were in shock.
They had never seen such focused power. Moreover, this power was focused on the Decimating Golden Flame, which was already deadly to begin with.
Just taking this attack would wipe one out of this world.
Danqing Shen, hiding somewhere to the side, jerked, and his fingers were moving, wanting to come to the rescue. Against such power, not even a peak Ethereal Stage expert could survive it, let alone Zhuo Fan in the Radiant Stage.
Just as he took a step, he halted. If he went out there now, all his efforts would be lost.
He found himself unable to make a decision.
The Exalted Double Dragons saw this scene with tense looks, ready to step in as well. However, they were hoping, more than anything, that Zhuo Fan would give them a shocking surprise.
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook. Not even he had foreseen the other would unleash such an almighty attack. His heart was quivering, but the die was cast. All he could do now was shout, “Qiao’er, now!”
“Yes, father!”
Qiao’er spread her wings, and flickering purple lightning gathered within them as they cracked the air. “Heaven Destroying Thunder Phoenix!”
Rumble~
The earth shook, and the air quivered as Qiao’er’s flap of her wings sent a three hundred meter large thunderbird straight for the incoming fire.
At the same time, Zhuo Fan shouted as well, “Wraith Style’s 3rd move, Necro Dragon’s Screech!”
Roar!
The demonic dragon shifted into the golden flame’s bane, the Vaulting Dragon King. The huge dragon roared as it charged, its azure flame surging over its body. It combined with the purple thunderbird to unleash an even greater power.
The audience was at the edge of their seats, fervent and expectant. They were all excited seeing these three mighty strikes being unleashed. Even Yan Mo, a genius in his own right, was overwhelmed.
Ye Lin and Zhuo Fan’s fight had to be the strongest clash in thousands of years of Double Dragon Gathering. None of the geniuses of western lands could hold a candle to them.
Now, they wanted to see who among these two would be the best disciple in western lands, the future best in western lands!
Boom!
The three powers finally came to a head. Only the audience watched in awe as Qiao’er and Zhuo Fan’s powers were crushed almost instantly by Ye Lin’s golden flames.
They went right through the thunderbird and azure flames in an overwhelming defeat.
Everyone was tense, and Zhuo Fan’s face fell, his brow soaked with sweat.
Ye Lin’s attack was beyond anything he had dreamed of. He had some guesses, but not to this extent.
In the face of such might, all the ways he thought of to deal with it left him shaking; they were not enough.
Now that it had come to this, he could only do all he could and leave it to fate.
“Divine Eye of the Void’s 5th stage, Void Wall!”
Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed with five golden halos and a hundred meters around him formed a spatial barrier.
This was the unexpected benefit of the three-day soul training he went through before this fight, allowing him to set up spatial walls to defend.
Alas, he never had a chance to get familiar with this move and didn’t know if it would keep back the flames.
Zhuo Fan tensed as the sweat mounted.
Bam!
The golden flamethrower slammed into the barrier and was stopped in its tracks.
[It worked?]
Zhuo Fan was happy, yet the audience was stumped as to what he did now.
The Exalted Double Dragons tensed, then admired.
[This kid has an endless bag of tricks…]
However, no one got the chance to breathe easier as cracks resounded, spreading all over the air around Zhuo Fan like a spiderweb.
Zhuo Fan also felt his right eye was on fire from all the pain. But he gritted his teeth. The five golden halos were still shining, even as blood seeped out.
Bam!
Finally, the barrier cracked open, and the burning flames went straight for Zhuo Fan, even if more subdued than before.
It was clear that the Void Wall was truly strong. Despite failing in the end, it brought Zhuo Fan hope.
[It might be strong, but it can be blocked!]
“Agh!”
Zhuo Fan held his bleeding right eye as he wailed. Yet his mouth was perked in a smile.
[Since this barrier works, I’ll just slow the attack down bit by bit.]
Zhuo Fan ignored the wound in his eye and took away his arms to reveal four golden halos.
Divine Eye of the Void’s 4th stage, Space Crusher!
Hum~
The powerful vibrations consumed a hundred meters around him, yet the fierce flames were still getting closer as if they were unaffected. The scorching flames were so strong that they actually burned the oscillations.
Zhuo Fan’s heart tensed as he watched incredulously. Space Crusher had no effect whatsoever. Now he had nothing left to wear down the flames.
That meant he would have to bear the heat all by himself.
Zhuo Fan’s heart sank, his eyes reflecting the still almighty burning flames. His face had never been more grave…

chapters.title: Chapter 710: Sacrifice
chapters.content:
Chapter 710: Sacrifice
Proofreader
: Papatonks
[If I knew it was going to be like this, I’d have used that tie-breaker. Though I’ve just learned it and it’s still dangerous.]
It was not only dangerous for himself, but for the enemy as well.
[Am I seeking stability too much?]
Seeing the flames right on top of him, Zhuo Fan was filled with regret. Why couldn’t he have done like Ye Lin did, and risk his life to unleash all he had?
Alas, it was already too late to do anything…
Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan finally decided to face the golden flames head on. He sent the Vaulting Dragon King to coil around him and wrap him in thick azure flames.
This was his last chance, to use the azure flame’s quality as a mediator between yin and yang to subdue the golden flame’s brutality. But with how the azure flame and golden flame engender each other, it might combine with the golden flame. He had to first wear it down or with how strong the golden flame was, it would simply scatter his aside.
The crux was, after the azure flame was blown away, all that was left was his defenseless dragon soul. This was his last defense. Afterward, his soul might perish.
Outside of using the azure dragon, he had no other way.
That was why he was finally giving his all in this fight.
Frowning, Zhuo Fan glared at the dazzling flames. As they drew closer, his sweat kept pouring out. He offered one last prayer of hope.
[Let this be enough.]
Ye Lin looked on coldly as he gasped, “It’s no use. I burned my own soul to unleash this Decimating Golden Flame. A half baked sacred beast inheritor like you stands no chance. Farewell, my fated adversary…”
Bam!
The flames slammed into the azure dragon at last. The powerful force made the dragon shake and howl in pain.
Zhuo Fan’s mind was overcome with pain as well. It felt like his head was exploding from the thousands of blades sinking into it. But he held on still. He had the azure flame face the incoming attack, wanting to submerge the golden flames in an ocean of azure.
He had no chance. The long stream of scorching flames was like a needle, piercing the azure flame sea. Even as they touched, the azure flame offered no resistance.
He was lucky enough if his own power wasn’t worn out instead.
He had never imagined that Ye Lin’s attack would be condensed to such a degree. It was so strong that his last ditch effort was useless.
The azure flame had no way of chipping away at the attack, not a damn use it had. Going at it with such a defense was practically suicide.
If he had known, he would have done that. That was what he should’ve done from the start…
Suddenly, Zhuo Fan’s body shook from endless despair and regret. Unfortunately, it was too late to come out of this one.
Hu~
As the golden flames came closer, a burning storm swept the entire body of the azure dragon and immediately removed its flames.
Before the golden flames reached it, its heat was constantly burning the dragon soul. Zhuo Fan’s head was boiling as he spat out crimson blood.
[It’s over!]
Once the flames entered the dragon soul, he was a goner.
He had been aware of Ye Lin’s power but it seemed that he still underestimated his opponent. Even if he wanted to use a real desperate move now, it was far too late.
This fight was going to take his life away.
Letting out a long breath, Zhuo Fan was overcome with regret. Chu Qingcheng was distraught, her eyes tearing over.
Xuan Shaoyu snickered all the while at his misfortune.
The Exalted Double Dragons were just about to put an end to this fight.
However, a cry pierced everyone’s ears. They all saw as purple lightning flickered and a familiar figure floated in front of the dragon soul.
Zhuo Fan squinted and he saw the tens of meters of a big purple bird, Qiao’er.
Did he not tell her to stay clear?
[Why…]
Qiao’er faced the golden flames coming at the azure dragon without remorse.
“Wait, Qiao’er…” Finally dawning on him, Zhuo Fan shouted. But Qiao’er, streaked with purple lightning, had already met the golden flames.
The purple lightning and the golden flames were brutal powers between heaven and earth and as they clashed, it was almost like a resonance, issuing endless explosions.
Maybe Qiao’er had used every ounce of purple lightning she had as the golden flames were stopped.
Even though the mighty flames were stopped, its power was still incredible. The golden flames swallowed Qiao’er in its searing heat, even as her eyes were stubbornly holding on, using every drop of energy she had, even willing to use her life just to stop the flames.
In the clashes between the purple lightning and golden flames, the flames were subsiding, seen with the naked eye.
The purple lightning was like a chisel, chipping away at its power. The golden flame was like a viper, tearing at Qiao’er at every chance it got, burning her plumes.
She did not care, holding on with all she had to crush the golden flames.
Zhuo Fan’s heart was in pain. He knew now that Qiao’er was sacrificing herself for his sake.
Finally, the golden flames made a last bang as they dissipated. Qiao’er was now burned all over, the purple flickering on her body long since exhausted. She just plopped on the ground powerlessly.
Zhuo Fan shook all over as he took one hard step after another closer to her. Chu Qingcheng held her mouth, her eyes glistening with tears. “Thank you, Qiao’er…”
“Such a protective spirit animal.” Wen Tao sighed.
Xie Tianshang was the most familiar with Zhuo Fan and sighed as well, “Zhuo Fan raised this spiritual beast as his daughter.”
“I see. No wonder she’s so loyal.” Wen Tao gave Qiao’er a long look of admiration.
Xie Tianshang shook his head, “Senior brother, you didn’t understand me. I mean to say that now that Zhuo Fan’s daughter, Qiao’er, lays dead, he will be truly enraged. The last time that happened, he ate his enemy alive. Just thinking about it gives me the chills.”
“But, can he even do it? Ye Lin’s power…” Wen Tao frowned.
Xie Tianshang smiled with a shake of his head. “In the Esoteric Debate, he wasn’t that guy’s match either. Trust me when I say this, those that he wants dead have no chance of living.”
Wen Tao’s heart shook in shock and looked at Zhuo Fan with a grave face.
“Foolish girl, didn’t I tell you to run? Now that you’re so big, you won’t listen to your dad?”
Slowly walking to Qiao’er, Zhuo Fan bent down, caressing the sizzling body, burned by the golden flames. He felt one last trace of energy in her and rushed to take out a pill to give her, smiling calmly.
Yet that calm hid a dreadful bloodlust. After they heard his words, they all shivered to their bones.
Ye Lin panted from that heavy exertion and shouted, “Zhuo Fan, your spirit animal had saved you from death. But it’s only a matter of time now. It shows that I will win by staking it all. While you, who don’t have such power, will lose!”
Ye Lin was once again making signs, gathering the same power he used before to unleash it again.
“Wait, junior brother, he doesn’t have the spirit animal’s help now. You don’t have to go that far!” Wu Qingqiu cried out.
Ye Lin didn’t even hear him as he kept going, even as his breath grew heavier and face paler.
There wasn’t much time and Zhuo Fan was beyond cunning. He wanted to win and that meant he had to use all he had to destroy his opponent and leave no room for error.
This was his beast path. Victory above all else!
Tightening his fists, Zhuo Fan stood up and gnashed his teeth with bloodshot eyes, “You want to stake it all? Ha-ha-ha, you asked for it!”

chapters.title: Chapter 711: The Deadliest Variant
chapters.content:
Chapter 711: The Deadliest Variant
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“These kids still want to fight!”
Exalted Hei Ran watched the battlefield intently as he sighed, “It had now stopped being a simple match to declare a winner. It’s a battle to the death. Just what grudge could they have to go so far?”
Exalted Bai Mei sighed, “Let’s ignore that for now. Let’s assume Ye Lin’s soul can take unleashing that attack again, Zhuo Fan would still have no chance of stopping it. It is a high chance that this fight will end in both of them dying. If we could, calling it a draw would be better than losing both.”
“Judge, how much time is there?” Looking below, Exalted Hei Ran asked.
The judge checked the sun’s position and bowed, “Exalted, there are still fifteen minutes left.”
“Enough for one more hard clash. I hope those two will be fine.” Exalted Bai Mei shook his head, both of them looked at the two kids with pity.
[A mountain can only have one tiger…]
Hu~
The golden flames flared hotter and hotter as the image of a huge dragon head formed behind Ye Lin, glaring at Zhuo Fan.
The audience gasped, but mostly cheered at the development. It was a real eye-opener to see such a destructive attack being unleashed.
Now that it was happening again, they couldn’t be happier.
Chu Qingcheng was wrought with worry once more. The girls saw how Zhuo Fan had nothing that could deal with such an attack, not even to defend himself.
“Young Sect Leader, Steward Zhuo, just be reasonable and give up. You’ve done more than enough. There’s no need for you to give your life for the sect!” Fiend Yang prayed, fearing the worst.
Yan Mo frowned as he clenched his fists. Yu Mei next to him asked, “Senior brother, are you sympathizing with your once enemy or cheering Ye Lin to finish him?”
“The strong need not sympathy. All I know is this. After this, one of them will be the best disciple in western lands, the future best in western lands!”
Yan Mo’s brow shook, yet even as he spoke, his eyes never left Zhuo Fan.
Yu Mei scowled at this and shook her head.
[He already picked a side yet he just doesn’t want to admit it.]
He hoped Zhuo Fan would win this. And while Zhuo Fan wouldn’t admit it, to him, the two had become friends through the fight they had.
As demonic cultivators, Zhuo Fan had earned his truest respect. That was why he hoped Zhuo Fan would win, despite knowing full well the hopes were slim at best.
Everyone around the screen was eager to see the conclusion of this grand fight. Especially the sect teams, all hoping Zhuo Fan would come out alive, even if losing.
Only Zhao Dezhu, Xuan Shaoyu and a few others were reveling in his misery.
[This punk will finally leave this world for good!]
Pa!
Ye Lin’s signs came to an end and the power around him exploded in size, while his body grew weaker.
However, he didn’t care, grinning as he laughed, “Zhuo Fan, I win! Are you ready for the Decimating Dragon Roar?”
With a roar, a spray of molten golden flames spewed straight for Zhuo Fan just like before.
The crowd was stretched taut, afraid of missing anything.
Zhuo Fan perked up his mouth and wiped the blood off. He looked at the unconscious and badly wounded Qiao’er, and gave a shake of his head, “Qiao’er, did you know your dad never owes anyone anything, especially favors? But today, this debt I have to repay is heavy. You risked your life for me when I couldn’t put mine on the line for myself. Ha-ha-ha, I’m such a fool.
“This time, even if it’s now even more dangerous, I will do it. I will stake my life for you and obliterate that obnoxious punk!”
Zhuo Fan’s hands began his own signs.
The azure dragon’s flames vanished, yet it didn’t turn into another variation, returning back to its prismatic and original form as it guarded him.
Startled, the crowd was taken by surprise.
[Right at the most crucial moment, he renounces his variants and goes for the basic dragon soul?]
Zhuo Fan closed his eyes as he finished the last sign with a vague smile.
An azure flame flickered on the dragon’s forehead.
Sss~
Purple lightning streaked its body like thousands of snakes. They reached the dragon head, where they vanished with a rumble.
Dark mist, black as night, shifted all over the dragon, converging at the head once more and disappearing.
Ye Lin was puzzled. Then an explosion happened and the dragon head released the aura of three different powers.
The azure flame burned on the forehead, with a purple streak flashing inside it. Then the black mist enveloped them all as a fourth power, Qilin’s red glow, covered them like a furnace to get them to combine.
As they did, a terrible aura was unleashed.
“T-that’s…” The others could barely feel it, but Ye Lin, being the closest, felt its raw power rise.
Grinning, Zhuo Fan said, “You guessed it, this is my way of combining the four dragon souls. I didn’t do it before because even I’m scared of this power, scared I can’t control it, and kill myself with it. But now I thought that since I’m fighting with my life, I have to show something for it. If I die by failing to do it, then that’s my luck. But if I succeed in combining them, then you’re dead!”
Startled, Ye Lin looked overwhelmed as he stared intently at the dragon’s forehead. Yet somehow, even as the powers mingled, they did not combine.
It was also then that Ye Lin’s spray of molten flames reached Zhuo Fan.
“Ha-ha-ha, your time’s up! Maybe it can never combine at all. These powers all come from a sacred beast’s raw trait. They are inherently repulsed by anything else.”
Maybe for Zhuo Fan or for himself, Ye Lin cackled as he saw his attack about to reach Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan simply stated, “Ye Lin, you just don’t get my cultivation method. I walk the common path of all the others. Moreover, the five great sacred beasts all come from the primal chaos, each wielding one aspect of it. Hasn’t it ever occurred to you that they were once a whole? Ha-ha-ha, it might be just a wild guess, or the actual truth. Regardless, today, one of us will die. If I die from my own combined power instead of yours ain’t a bad way to go either.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed and he raised an eyebrow. “By the way, since I figured the five powers could fuse, I find the three of them just lacking. So let’s add another one!”
With a boom, on the dragon’s forehead appeared a golden flame, the Decimating Golden Flame!
“Wha-, h-how?!” Ye Lin cried out.
Dismissing him with a wave, Zhuo Fan fibbed, “Easy now, it’s just a smidgen my demonic dragon stole from you. Nothing to it. Then again, it is a great boost in my realization of combining these powers. After all, you need both gentle and brutal flames to get them to combine, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan turned to the dragon head, eager for the result.
Just like he thought, since the golden flame was introduced, it began to quickly combine with the azure flame. Then the purple lightning constantly zapped them as it joined the fusion.
It was all going quite smoothly.
With the Qilin power as the furnace, Demon Transformation Art the base and the purple lightning as the medium, the two flames stabilized as they united.
Hu~
The searing heat of the golden flame was right on top of Zhuo Fan. The power was so much that it caused Zhuo Fan’s white hair to wither.
The audience gasped in worry. Some girls even cried out and looked away.
Hum~
A ripple spread from the dragon’s forehead just then and revealed a black flame, with streaks of purple flashing now and then. Its almighty power swept everything, disintegrating all in its path.
Ye Lin’s spray of flames had met its match as it stopped.
It was more accurate to say that it did not stop at all. Even as it kept going, it was just being pulverized once past a certain point so that it never reached Zhuo Fan.
Pff!
Zhuo Fan spewed blood and shook. He looked back at his dragon soul and saw it twitch all over as the black flame was going crazy.
“Just like I thought, the deadliest variant. I have no way of controlling it as I am. Its power is even above the five great sacred beasts…”
Zhuo Fan rejoiced inside, even as the blood kept pouring out of his mouth…

chapters.title: Chapter 712: Dreadful Thunder Flame
chapters.content:
Chapter 712: Dreadful Thunder Flame
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Hu~
The dreaded power blew over, making even Ye Lin, covered in flames, shiver and take a step back.
His always invincible golden flame was pushed back and subdued. The dragon image around him was also on the verge of falling apart.
The moment the palm-sized thunder flame showed up, it brought with it unspeakable change.
The spray of golden flames never even touched Zhuo Fan, pulverized ahead of schedule due to the thunder flame.
Ye Lin was dumbstruck.
[H-how can this be?]
[What the hell is that thing anyway? How can it make the Decimating Golden Flame unable to fight back at all?]
[How much terrifying power does that guy have?]
Ye Lin squinted, his eyes vacant as he stared at the thunder flame on the dragon’s forehead.
To him, the five great sacred beasts’ powers were supreme. When was there a time they would shirk away instead? Never!
Not even the five great sacred beasts would believe the world would have such kind of power either.
Yet reality proved otherwise.
A terrible power that surpassed all was about to be born. All of it came from Zhuo Fan’s powers he got from those Emperors and sacred beasts then fused them.
“This aura… is the same I felt when Steward Zhuo came from his room. No, even worse!” Kui Lang shuddered at the sight of that power capable of destroying anything and everything. He gulped in fear.
The rest bobbed their heads in reflex, staring at it with soaked backs.
They had no clue what ultimate move Zhuo Fan pulled to unleash such power but they were afraid of it.
The Ultimate Clarity Sect team had it worse. Wu Qingqiu’s face fell the instant the thunder flame showed up.
He had no clue about what Zhuo Fan did, but he could feel that this power was beyond Ye Lin’s golden flame.
He had an inkling this power was not something a human should have. It felt like it was an omen to the destruction of this world.
Face twitching, Wu Qingqiu gnashed his teeth and forced a smile, “Gods, just how far did those two’s fight go? I have no doubt the two would be leveling Double Dragon Manor if they fight like this again.”
“Senior brother, y-you’re exaggerating. They’re only at the Ethereal Stage. The Double Dragon Manor has the exalted so they can’t let it happen.” One disciple said.
Wu Qingqiu shook his head with a solemn look, “You’re still green and can’t see it. This isn’t about strength, but being worlds apart among each other. You all know just how deadly junior brother’s golden flame can be, but that black thunder flame gives me an even worse feeling. I firmly believe the exalted couldn’t block this thunder flame that isn’t any less than the golden flame.”
Wu Qingqiu’s brow was soaked as he watched on.
[This frickin’ fight is beyond outrageous. One more dreadful than the other. They’re just not human…]
Sss~
The audience watched the image on the screen fading to static and the gatekeepers made constant signs to change the angle to restore the signal. The thing was, it was always further and further away from the fight.
When the image finally stabilized, they were watching from three miles away. All the audience saw were the two dots standing still, while the dazzling flame spray and the black flame on dragon’s forehead were at odds.
“What happened? Why is the image so far away?” Exalted Hei Ran asked the two elders.
One of them bowed, “Exalted, the monitoring arrays around the two have some interference and stops us from looking closer. The closest one working is this monitoring array three miles away.”
“What?!”
Exalted Bai Mei cried out. “All the monitoring arrays in that valley were set up with sacred stones. You can’t even destroy them easily. And now, when the two are even fighting each other, we can’t even…”
Exalted Bai Mei thought about something and gave a shocked look to Exalted Hei Ran.
Exalted Hei Ran was a bit lost, “Don’t tell me that just the shockwaves of their fight was enough to damage the monitoring arrays! Not even we can do that…”
Exalted Hei Ran turned to look at the screen and stared at the black flash and Ye Lin’s alarmed face. Even with Zhuo Fan’s pale face, the flame did not get any closer. It was the exalted that sprung into action.
Exalted Bai Mei reacted as well and was shocked.
[You mean to tell me that black thing’s ripple can destroy sacred stones?]
This never happened no matter how many times the azure flame or golden flame clashed. Yet it happened with the black flame.
That meant this black flame was a cut above those other two, a terrifying existence.
[But can Zhuo Fan control such power?]
Looking at Zhuo Fan shaking and spitting blood, Exalted Bai Mei tensed and got his answer.
[He can’t for now.]
But since it was now out, he had to withstand its pressure to the end, unless he wanted the flame to lash out and destroy him.
[No wonder he never used it in his fight with Ye Lin till his spirit animal got heavily wounded.]
This was a move that put one’s life on the line, only worth taking out when you wanted the other one deader than dead. It was going even further than Ye Lin burning his soul.
If Zhuo Fan’s move fizzled out, his soul would go down with it. If he succeeded, then Ye Lin in his soul and body combined form would be toast.
One was bound to die here. Hei Ran saw this and sprung into action.
Whoosh~
With a flick of the hand, a black glow flashed and then a white tunnel appeared. Exalted Hei Ran went through it and entered the valley.
The audience was speechless.
[Where’s Exalted Hei Ran going now?]
They never saw the exalted being nervous before.
In the valley, Zhuo Fan kept puking blood, his body popping and spreading blood as well. Even so, he bore it. The dreadful thunder flame was so insidious it ate his body as well.
His dragon soul was shaking, on the verge of crumbling under the thunder flame’s power.
Zhuo Fan grinned, despite it all, seeing the flames unable to touch him.
[There’s always a way out in every crisis!]
The thunder was dangerous, but quite handy at the very least.
[Only with this dreadful power can I waste you, punk!]
Zhuo Fan narrowed his eyes and began to move his hands. His dragon soul jerked and slowly opened its maw. The thunder flame slowly moved from the forehead to its throat.
Yet they both looked ready to fall to the ground at the slightest breeze.
To Ye Lin, though, it was pure horror. He was actually scared for once, and backed away.
Maybe it was the first time he felt something like this. This minute thunder flame was giving him the worst filling he ever felt.
Gulping, Ye Lin stared at Zhuo Fan, nervous and shaking.
Zhuo Fan’s signs finally drew to a close and he sported a nasty grin, “It seems my risk paid off and you, brat, are going to suffer for it. Wraith Style’s 3rd move, Necro Dragon’s Screech!”
Roar!
The shockwave shook the world around as the dragon roared. The thunder flame turned into a snake in its throat and darted forth.
It was a snake no bigger than a meter. In all of Zhuo Fan’s Necro Dragon’s Screech he used, this was the worst looking by far.
Yet, this tiny snake gave Ye Lin the feeling of impending doom…

chapters.title: Chapter 713: Finale
chapters.content:
Chapter 713: Finale
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Boom!
The small black thunder flame struck like lightning. It entered Ye Lin’s flames then exploded into nothing.
Yet it just kept on going, right for Ye Lin!
[What?! A mere thunder flame is so strong?]
Squinting, Ye Lin now witnessed its power while also feeding his fears. That thing was incredibly deadly, no matter how tiny it looked.
Ye Lin backed away, now soaked in sweat. He rushed to make signs and ignite his soul to bolster the golden flame around him. He formed around himself a dazzling barrier of flames which made him very pale.
He knew better than anyone just how powerful his flames were. Even so, he knew the tiny thunder flame had to be even worse.
Ye Lin gnashed his teeth, but his body kept on shaking.
Wu Qingqiu was filled with worry. It was the first time he saw his prideful junior brother so afraid…
Exalted Bai Mei was stupefied as the flames were gone in a blink. The thunder flame was even stronger than he thought.
The black flame shouldn’t have been able to do that, since the golden flames were unleashed through Ye Lin’s burning of his soul. It’s power was just short of blowing one’s soul up. Yet even so, it still did it.
[Thank god, that old timer is going, or Ye Lin might be a goner.]
Seeing the black thunder flame shot forward, Exalted Bai Mei gasped.
The audience was simply slack jawed. None saw Zhuo Fan’s comeback to be so utterly overwhelming. He didn’t just turn the tables, he even forced the enemy to face death.
It was only made more apparent after Zhuo Fan and Qiao’er barely managed to stop the attack last time.
Wen Tao was dumbfounded and sighed, “Tianshang, I think I get what you mean. Brother Zhuo isn’t one to be messed with. I never thought that angering him would result in taking out that deadly thing. I bet Ye Lin must be feeling the worst right now. He’s facing something that shirked off his attack that he burned his soul to unleash!”
“Ugh… I didn’t know he was hiding this either…”
Xie Tianshang shook his head, “Zhuo Fan’s bag of tricks is bottomless. No one ever knows what his final ace is. All the mystery revolving around him is what makes everyone fear him. Only when fighting him for real, will people feel true terror.”
Wen Tao gave him a look and then nodded.
Ye Lin’s devotion to his path was strong, but even deadlier was Zhuo Fan, who had endless tricks up his sleeves.
[Then the outcome…]
Whoosh!
A crisp sound entered the people’s ears and the thunder flame was right at Ye Lin, cracking space on its way.
Zhuo Fan stared with a smile. The people were tense and excited. Exalted Bai Mei was frowning in worry.
[What’s taking that old coot so long?]
But no one was more frantic than Ye Lin, having to face the thunder flame.
His face hardened and his brow knitted as his hands made a sign, shaking as he stared at the deadly thunder flame.
The golden flame around him was everything he had put out. All his power was now on display, focused on defense.
He had given all he had and now he was pale. Yet even this was of no comfort to him, feeling not even this was enough in this matter of life and death.
But that was all he could muster.
The two thus unleashed their very last drop of power, the outcome about to be decided in this final clash.
The two looked grave, waiting for this to end.
Whoosh~
The black thunder flame finally struck Ye Lin’s flaming defense.
Ye Lin’s heart tightened and the golden flames erupted. The audience looked on, tense.
Zhuo Fan’s face fell as he glanced at the unconscious Qiao’er, waiting for the finale…
Bam!
The loud explosion destroyed Ye Lin’s wall. He shook from the blow and spat out blood, but kept his fearful eyes forward.
The black thunder flame snake was coming for him.
[I’m done for…]
Ye Lin felt crushed in the face of such terrible power.
“Junior brother!”
Wu Qingqiu cried out, without any use. He wouldn’t be able to help even if he got there.
The others looked on tense. Exalted Bai Mei frowned harder.
Only Zhuo Fan had on an evil smirk, his eyes glinting with joy.
[That’s what you get for harming my daughter, you prick!]
“Seizing Dragon Claw!”
An aged voice gave signal to the appearance of a faint dragon claw, grabbing the thunder flame snake and stopping it from skewering Ye Lin.
The thunder flame halted on the spot and Ye Lin could breathe easy at long last.
[I’m saved!]
Zhuo Fan frowned and saw an old man approaching.
The people looked on in shock.
[What’s Exalted Hei Ran doing there?]
Then it was made obvious as he saved Ye Ling.
[Ye Lin must be somebody to get an Exalted to save him.]
