Exalted Bai Mei eased a breath at Exalted Hei Ran’s success.
[Thank god he made it, or Zhuo Fan would’ve finished Ye Lin off.]
“What’s the meaning of this, Exalted Hei Ran? Is the time up yet?” Zhuo Fan glared at the old man in a foul mood.
Exalted Hei Ran shook his head, “Kid, the outcome is obvious. What does it matter now?”
“Double Dragon Gathering has rules. Unless one side admits defeat or is crushed can the other win. Exalted should be more clear on this than me!” Zhuo Fan huffed, “Exalted, the western lands are watching. You can’t go about doing what you will, you’ll damage Double Dragon Manor’s name…”
Exalted Hei Ran’s face twitched.
[The brat is so stubborn. I get you want Ye Lin’s head on a platter but must you mock me with the competition?]
Exalted Hei Ran knew Zhuo Fan’s anger came from his hurt spirit animal. He would need to be diplomatic in this if he wanted to appease him. So he gave Ye Lin a look.
[Call it quits already, boy. Face the facts. Besides, you already won by getting saved.]
Getting his hint, Ye Lin turned to Zhuo Fan yet he couldn’t for the life of him open his mouth. As a sacred beast inheritor, there were no quitters, only dead ones who lost.
The golden flames around Ye Lin were still shielding him, his eyes still thirsting for battle.
Exalted Hei Ran sighed.
[Pigheaded!]
A bang sounded just then and Exalted Hei Ran’s claw made the thunder flame snake explode.
The thunder flame snake was soon reduced to nothing, yet a sliver of black slipped through, shooting for Ye Lin.
It entered his body in that instant.
Explosions came one after another, followed by flashes of lightning. After a long torrent of blood was spewed out, Ye Lin looked on with wide and incredulous eyes as he feebly said, “That thing is… brutal. I can’t fight it even if I stake my life. Master… I lost!”
Plop!
Ye Lin fell in his own blood, shocking everyone. Exalted Hei Ran’s hand shook, his face a mask of shock.
Even though it was under his control, a bit escaped and entered Ye Lin.
[What is that thing?]
Exalted Hei Ran glanced at Zhuo Fan in fear…

chapters.title: Chapter 714: Open
chapters.content:
Chapter 714: Open
Proofreader
: Papatonks
The Exalted Double Dragons were the strongest in western lands and no one could take a life around them unless they allowed it, not even Danqing Shen could do it.
Evidently, this incident left everyone gasping, even the exalted.
Zhuo Fan, not even in the Ethereal Stage mind you, released some black snake that no matter how strong, Exalted Hei Ran still caught it.
It was plain for all to see. Yet even so, when Exalted Hei Ran felt in control, the unexpected happened. His claw was overcome in the explosion and the one he was supposed to save got hit hard. It left the entire crowd picking their jaws off the floor.
“Zhuo Fan is a frickin’ savage. He actually got to hurt someone under the Exalted’s protection in front of everyone. This has never happened!”
Yan Mo chuckled, “The entire western lands are going to know him now. One day, he’ll even be the best in western lands as well.”
The crowd started talking to each other in hushed tones.
Mystical Heaven Sect’s girls were gesticulating and clamoring. Only Xuan Shaoyu went dark there, his heart consumed by rage.
[This accursed bastard still got on top!]
The entire scene was noisy, all shocked by what they witnessed.
Exalted Bai Mei stood there for a moment, lost. Even he found it hard to believe even with that old timer’s intervention, it would still end up like this.
[I should’ve gone there as well!]
But then he shook his head, “Ha-ha-ha, hindsight truly is 20-20. With how fast it all happened, it wouldn’t make a difference if I went too. The one to blame is that weird thunder flame, able to destroy the claw. The question now though, is Ye Lin alive?”
Bai Mei looked on with worry, since this was his future disciple.
“Junior brother!”
Wu Qingqiu rushed as he saw Ye Lin collapsing and held him up.
Exalted Hei Ran was still too out of it to react. Now, when he came to, he glanced at Zhuo Fan with utter disbelief.
[If he has the power to ruin my move now, what will his future hold?]
[A true battle of freaks…. with limitless potential…]
Pff!
Zhuo Fan saw Ye Lin was going down and sported a most pleased smile. Then he puked blood and went down next to Qiao’er, feeble and pale.
The black thunder flame was damn strong, but to withstand its power, Zhuo Fan’s body had to pay the toll. He was only standing by sheer willpower and now that it was over, he fell down.
Exalted Hei Ran understood why as well.
[Choosing to hurt himself if it meant taking down the enemy. Zhuo Fan may be just as wounded at Ye Lin because of it.]
[Oh, Ye Lin! Is he dead?]
Finally getting his wits about him, Exalted Hei Ran rushed over, “Wu Qingqiu, how’s your junior brother?”
“Thank you for your concern, Exalted. Junior brother is in a very critical state, but he still has a breath left. He should recover.” Wu Qingqiu bowed.
Exalted Hei Ran nodded and then heard Zhuo Fan sighing, “Humph, he still breathes after all. It’s all that damn old coot’s fault, ruining most of the thunder flame’s power and leaving just a sliver.”
“Hey, that old coot is right here! Don’t think I can’t hear just ’cause you’re mumbling. Are you trying to make me look even worse?”
Exalted Hei Ran glared at him then shook his head, “You and Ye Lin are rare talents in western lands. We don’t want to see any of you die. I might have come to Ye Lin’s rescue, but I would’ve done the same if it were you instead.”
Zhuo Fan simply lay there in silence.
He knew the instant the old guy showed up that getting revenge for Qiao’er and killing Ye Lin was almost impossible.
But even he didn’t think the thunder flame was so nifty it escaped Exalted Hei Ran’s control and struck that punk half-dead.
Now his anger was mostly abated. That left Qiao’er’s worst state as the problem.
Hum~
The beam of light showed up once more in the valley. Exalted Hei Ran was the first to walk to it, “Time’s up. The fight’s verdict is up to the judge!”
Then he was gone.
Wu Qingqiu glanced at Zhuo Fan with a complex look. He just sighed and signaled for his team to retreat.
Demon Scheming Sect’s disciples rushed over for Zhuo Fan’s orders. After they got the Thunder Ring and put Qiao’er inside, someone helped him go through the light.
All soon left the valley, leaving only Danqing Shen hiding in a corner, “Kid, you’re the first in history to wound someone in front of Exalted Hei Ran, ha-ha-ha…”
Danqing Shen vanished from his spot as well…
Clap~
When the teams were back, they were showered in applause. Ye Lin and Zhuo Fan’s fight had been an amazing display of power, the best of the best.
The people had also come to terms with who was the future best in western lands as well.
“Cough, cough, cough…”
The judge cleared his throat, looking from the unconscious Ye Lin on Wu Qingqiu’s back to the weary Zhuo Fan held by Kui Lang. “I have been a judge at Double Dragon Gathering for five times. I had seen my fair share of disciples, but only you filled me with hope for the western lands. You’ve done well, ha-ha-ha…”
The judge then turned serious, “It’s time to pass the verdict. In this Ultimate Clarity Sect versus Demon Scheming Sect challenge fight, Ultimate Clarity Sect came back with one wounded and Demon Scheming Sect came back with one wounded. The result is a draw!”
“Wait!”
Wu Qingqiu cried out. They all watched as he looked at Zhuo Fan, “The team battle’s outcome is dependent on Ye Lin and Zhuo Fan’s fight. Junior brother will most likely not like it, but a loss is a loss. Ye Lin lost to Zhuo Fan and that means Ultimate Clarity Sect lost to Demon Scheming Sect.”
The judge froze then nodded. “Wu Qingqiu, the loss of a team battle affects the entire sect. Will your elders approve of this? As far as I know, you’re one of the few sects that did not come with a venerable. It shows how confident the sect is in you.”
“Ultimate Clarity Sect has always been carefree, not after fame and wealth. A loss is a loss. There’s nothing more to it. Twisting our path just for a bit of something goes against our sect’s teachings.” Wu Qingqiu held his head high as he declared, earning everyone’s admiration.
The judge nodded. “In that case, the first of the nine sects will be…”
The judge paused for effect, looking at Demon Scheming Sect. The fiends were overexcited now, never believing their eyes. They were at the top!
Then a cold voice came, “Wait!”
Now the eyes darted on Zhuo Fan.
“Ugh, now what?” The judge frowned.
Zhuo Fan said, “Nothing really, just that we can’t take the top position.”
“Brother Zhuo, it’s what you get for winning.”
Zhuo Fan waved his hand at Wu Qingqiu, “Brother Wu, since it’s a team battle, it is ten against ten. Ye Lin and my fight was just a single fight. If I still had some fight left afterwards, then I would’ve taken it of course, ha-ha-ha. However, you can all see my state. And the rest of our disciples are no match. This team battle is our loss. I may not be a nice guy, but I am open in my actions. I don’t take more than I deserve. I can’t take it or I’ll see it as charity and will be nothing more than an insult. “
Wu Qingqiu shook and cupped his hands. “Brother Zhuo, you may be a demonic cultivator, but you truly are a gentleman!”
“No, I just have a mean guy’s pride, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan chuckled…

chapters.title: Chapter 715: Ranks
chapters.content:
Chapter 715: Ranks
Proofreader
: Papatonks
The judge looked from one to the other and nodded, “Good, since you both don’t care about it, Zhuo Fan’s words make a lot more sense as to how this team battle ended. Thus, I shall declare Ultimate Clarity Sect as the slightly better victor.”
The crowd exploded in applause, not just for the nominal winner, Ultimate Clarity Sect, but for Zhuo Fan as well, this soft meanie.
Zhuo Fan’s open manner of only taking what he deserved let the people see that nasty demonic cultivators had their own elegance.
Demon Soul Sect nodded, looking at Zhuo Fan as the model example of a demonic cultivator.
Yan Mo sighed as he watched him, “Even demons have their path. Maybe I’ve been indulging too much as of late, ha-ha-ha…”
“Sister Qingcheng, he just gave up the glory of being at the top. Those venerables of theirs have to be fuming mad.”
Dan’er batted her purdy eyes in shock, “This chance may come only once. Maybe the next time they come to Double Dragon Gathering, they won’t get any higher. “
Chu Qingcheng smiled, her gaze soft as she was reminded of Hundred Pill Meeting. “That’s who he is. He’s the same as before…”
The girls noticed what she meant and nodded. As they looked at Zhuo Fan, their gazes were taking different meanings.
Only Xuan Shaoyu was raging inside.
Zhuo Fan’s win had earned everyone’s approval, he even refused fame. Funny how this was exactly Mystical Heaven Sect’s aim when they plotted against Demon Scheming Sect.
There were already people whispering and mocking Mystical Heaven Sect. Some even reached his ears.
It only worked to make his heart rage harder. Zhuo Fan had been up to his tricks many times in his fight yet Mystical Heaven Sect only did it once.
Now Zhuo Fan was hailed as a hero and them as hypocrites.
[How is that fair?!]
He had no clue though, that Zhuo Fan was no goodie-goodie, but was cunning and vile. Even so he had principles, principles that he would not cross.
This was what got everyone’s attention.
Xuan Shaoyu’s side, on the other hand, was a righteous sect that had deviated from their path. That was why they were given dirtier looks than the demonic cultivators.
That showed that an open meanie was better than a shameless hypocrite to make friends with. It was all because the former had a code they knew he followed.
While the latter could stab you in the back anytime anywhere they saw fit.
Though these reasons weren’t noticed by many, their basic instinct made them feel who was the better choice.
So the voice of the people hailed Zhuo Fan, a demonic cultivator, while it denounced Xuan Shaoyu, a righteous cultivator, the hypocrite.
“That old coot, he’s been five times a judge at Double Dragon Gatherings yet this is the first time I see him so biased. Ultimate Clarity Sect is the winner and that’s that. What’s with that slightly better, ha-ha-ha…” Exalted Hei Ran chuckled.
Exalted Bai Mei smiled, “He meant to say that this was Zhuo Fan’s win, but since it’s a team battle, Ultimate Clarity Sect has nine more members that are slightly better then Zhuo Fan’s current state. That’s why they won. He’s clearly giving your demonic disciple some fame. Old timer, I wasn’t going to say he was siding with you but you started it, ha-ha, being petty even after looking good.”
“How is it looking good? When Zhuo Fan enters Double Dragon Manor, it will be the two of us who teach him. You’re in it as well…”
“Please.”
Exalted Bai Mei rolled his eyes and teased, “He’s a demonic cultivator, right up your alley. My teachings to him can only be assistance. The one to truly learn from me can only be Ye Lin. He might have lost, but under my wing, he will soar. You better remember our deal then, old timer!”
“Of course, the two will fight again to see who’s better.” Exalted Hei Ran smiled.
Exalted Bai Mei nodded, “Good, we still don’t know who among us is better after so many years so we will let the disciples decide, ha-ha-ha…”
The two burst out laughing…
The judge saw the noise around him and raised his hand for silence.
“Western lands’ Double Dragon Gathering has now come to a close. Next comes tallying up the score for singles and team fights to assess the sect’s ranks as well as see the ten best disciples in western lands.”
The judge shouted with a cold gaze, making everyone’s mood turn heavy.
The Double Dragon Gathering was over and that meant settling the sects’ future income and development. It affected the future of the disciples who came here as well.
The judge looked at the two sects’ disciples in stage and welcomed them. “The assessment will take time so you can step down to get some rest.”
The disciples cupped their hands before the judge before going to their group.
Back to Demon Scheming Sect’s side, Kui Lang put the wounded Zhuo Fan on a recliner to rest. Fiend Yang waltzed over with a grumbling look, “Hey, Steward Zhuo, what the hell were you thinking? You won yet still passed on the reward? Do you have any idea just how much the top of the nine sects earns?”
The other venerables sighed, feeling this rare chance slipping them by.
“Brother, you just let Ultimate Clarity Sect get their win without a care. But do you know how much it pains me? How much the sect lost? With this win we might have gone from lower-three sect to middle-three sect then to superior-three sect and…”
“And then to heaven. Are you willing?
Zhuo Fan mocked as he finished Fiend Yang’s speech.
Fiend Yang started.
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes, “The tallest tree gets the wind. Demon Scheming Sect was but a tiny lower-three sect yet it suddenly became the top dog? Don’t you think that’s highly dangerous?”
Fiend Yang’s fat shook as they saw the implications.
“People must have self-awareness, as do sects. Without power to support such status, they’ll crumble.”
Zhuo Fan squinted and looked at the judge discussing with the gatekeepers about the score. “In terms of Double Dragon Gathering’s interests, I don’t want it to get too high too fast in the Double Dragon Gathering. Wealth can be a burden. Demon Scheming Sect is too weak and can’t take the pressure, becoming an easy target.”
Fiend Yang nodded, “Right, right. I finally get that you thought about it a lot. We can’t be the top sect or it will be too dangerous.”
“Just how can great venerables like us be so blind? For shame! Zhuo Fan, thank god you were the one in charge in this Double Dragon Gathering.” Fiend Yang wiped his brow and sighed.
The other venerables bobbed their heads.
They could already see what would have happened after becoming the top of the totem pole, assaulted from all directions.
They also held Zhuo Fan in high esteem.
[No wonder Sect Leader gave him his badge. He made the right choice.]
The venerables’ big picture couldn’t hold a candle to a kid’s.
The three felt more ashamed now.
The reason they followed Zhuo Fan so far was because of the badge. They never would’ve agreed to feeding the Zombie Pill to the disciple otherwise.
But now, they were in full agreement with Zhuo Fan’s actions. The more critical the situation became, the cooler Zhuo Fan was.
His gaze looked farther than these old bags of bones who only had seniority on their side…

chapters.title: Chapter 716: Future Allies and Enemies
chapters.content:
Chapter 716: Future Allies and Enemies
Proofreader
: Papatonks
At the center of the stage, the three elders were holding a silk sheet and were constantly writing and calculating the sects’ scores. All were watching with tense faces.
However, that did not apply to the Demon Scheming Sect. They did not care much about those three oldies and swept the crowd.
Zhuo Fan pointed out as he explained, “No one must become fat in one haul, or the consequences would not be worth the gain. In the Double Dragon Gathering, we have earned a good result, enough to support the sect’s future and development for a long time. So, in the end, our ranking doesn’t matter. What we need to focus on is doing that without outside interference. That depends on checks and balances between the major sects present here. That’s where we need to focus.”
“Getting to be an underdog in the Double Dragon Gathering for a huge reward is only a small part of our gain in this competition. The real win is getting friendly with the sects.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed and pointed at each one, “Among the middle-three sects, Demon Soul Sect owes us a favor and should be friendly. The Sword God Sect became friends through battle and should be a good ally. As for the superior-three sects, although I heavily wounded Ye Lin, Wu Qingqiu is a man of honor and should be easy to get close to. Hellion Flame, by definition we have a little scuffle with them. But I don’t see any hatred in Yan Mo at us so we can consider them neutral…”
Zhuo Fan then frowned as he decided with a sigh, “Hellion Flame can be approached.”
“What?!”
His team cried out, “Zhuo Fan, you almost killed Yan Mo last time. How can we get close when he loathes us?”
Zhuo Fan nodded and said, “That’s called judging a book by its cover. Yes, Hellion Flame can be approached. While last time we fought, meeting Hellion Flame again, Yan Mo and the others did not hate us, fighting us just like everyone else. Although I don’t know why that happened, I am sure there’s no bad blood between us anymore.”
“They say love and hate are both sides of the same coin. If such deep hatred is resolved, we’ll become even closer.”
Clapping, Zhuo Fan came to the last names, “There are four sects we need to befriend, Ultimate Clarity Sect, Hellion Flame, Sword God Sect and Demon Soul Sect. They may very well help us avoid many troubles later on.”
“But we only made friends with four disciples. It’s not their venerables. How can they ask their sects to help us?”
Kui Gang asked hesitatingly.
The others looked at Zhuo Fan for an answer.
Zhuo Fan grinned, his eyes sparkling, “Ever heard of growing into one’s role? That means becoming friends before they become big to help you later. Every participant here is but a disciple, but all are pillars of their sect, especially the ones returning alive. They will become eminent figures. All those old timers back home are just going to offend these future bigshots? As long as the sect’s foundation ain’t threatened, they will listen. Especially with Wu Qingqiu and Ye Lin, they can even decide the sect’s future. That’s why it’s totally worth getting closer to them.”
“But, what trouble could we possibly have?” Yue’er frowned.
Zhuo Fan shook his head and patted her head, “Lass, you really have holes for eyes. In these days of Double Dragon Gathering, haven’t you realized how many toes we crushed? We need to keep our guard up around the Universal Righteous Sect, Heaven Trailing Sect, Mystical Heaven Sect and Beast Taming Sect. As to why they hate us, I’m sure you can tell.”
“Sigh, if I knew this, I wouldn’t have gone against them…” Fiend Yang shook his head. “It’s unclear if those new friends can be of help, but those four we really pissed them off. Nothing good will come of it.”
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes and mocked, “You must be delusional. Joining the Double Dragon Gathering, you can offend anyone in the deathmatches, it’s the only way to go forward. The question is who to offend and who to get close to. The good thing is the sects we chose are all stronger than our enemies and far more trustworthy. The Universal Righteous Sect, for instance, throws away its own people. Even if we hadn’t messed with them, I still wouldn’t want to get anywhere near them.”
The rest nodded in unison.
“Moreover, there’s no absolute neutrality in this world. There are allies and enemies. Absolute neutrality will only make you a target. That’s why through these battles, I was choosing allies and your future enemies.”
“Us?”
Everyone looked at Zhuo Fan in shock.
Zhuo Fan grinned, “You’re going to know this sooner or later so I might as well tell you now. I’ve had a talk with the Sect Leader before coming here. After Double Dragon Gathering, I will be leaving the sect. What I say now is my last piece of advice for the Labor Office. Although I don’t much care for the Labor Office, but I raised it and don’t want to see it in danger of destruction. You will be the sect’s future bigshots and need to remember your allies and enemies. Otherwise, the Demon Scheming Sect will crumble after it sticks out of the crowd.”
“Wait, why are you leaving? You got all the credit for the Double Dragon Gathering and Sect Leader Ren will name you as the next…” Fiend Yang cried.
The others were anxious and nodded as well.
Zhuo Fan might be a bit harsh, but without him, there wouldn’t be a ‘them’. This made all of them appreciate him more.
Zhuo Fan smiled and waved, “You don’t have to say it. I only came with the Demon Scheming Sect because of a deal. Now that I have finished my part, it’s time to head home.”
[Home?]
They all looked at Zhuo Fan in shock as their hearts were overcome with sadness.
[Steward Zhuo has his own home.]
[He never saw the Demon Scheming Sect as one.]
Fiend Yang sighed and nodded. “Then we won’t force the issue. But remember, from now on, you don’t have just one home. All the disciples, elders and venerables at the Labor Office won’t ever forget you. No matter when you’ll return, you’ll always be Steward Zhuo!”
“The Labor Office never had a steward to begin with but ever since Steward Zhuo came, everyone always called you that. It sounds just like a clan’s. Brothers should be closer, to stand united and repel outsiders…” Yue Ling looked at him with a soft gaze.
The others also cherished Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan’s eyelids shook. He didn’t care much for that place. He only saw it as a base to seize power. But he had to admit that he left something there after all.
From helping Yue’er and Kui Gang recover their cultivation, to establishing Elite Labor Office, laughing at the inner sect, all of it did make the disciples gain self-respect and power.
The Labor Office was a tight group now, no different from a home. But it was not what he yearned for.
Zhuo Fan took a deep breath and smiled, his journey in the Demon Scheming Sect had come to an end.
[And it wasn’t such a bad trip either…]
“The Double Dragon Gathering scores have been set. Please check them, Exalted!”
The elders on the stage had finished and they bowed as the judge declared.
Exalted Hei Ran took the silken sheet and nodded alongside Exalted Bai Mei.
The judge turned around, at the nine sects and shouted, “The nine sects ranks at the Double Dragon Gathering have been set. Disciples, step on the stage to hear Exalted’s words!”
“Yes!”
They all cupped their hands and assembled on the stage with hard looks. Even the heavily wounded Zhuo Fan was helped up.
Who fell, who rose? All was written clearly on that thin silk sheet…

chapters.title: Chapter 717: Nine Sect’s Positions
chapters.content:
Chapter 717: Nine Sect’s Positions
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Everyone looked up at the highest seats and at what Exalted Hei Ran held with deep frowns, gulping and sweating in anxiety as their nails dug into their hands.
Only the Demon Scheming Sect was chill. They just didn’t care about the ranks. Just like Zhuo Fan said, a weak sect like theirs shouldn’t aim too high.
Without high expectations there was nothing to be tense about.
They were more sad about their leader, Zhuo Fan, leaving them.
“I shall now declare the nine sects’ positions in the Double Dragon Gathering!”
Exalted Hei Ran cleared his throat, “We begin with the Beast Taming Sect, the last in the lower-three sects!”
Exalted Hei Ran’s declaration earned a mocking look from the crowd.
At the start of the lower-three sects stage, Zhuo Fan wiped them out in one punch. Even their elder was culled soon after. If they wasn’t dead last, who would be?
They were indeed shit out of luck to meet a freak like Zhuo Fan right off the bat. Zhuo Fan’s power was soon made public in a fantastic display. Their demise… obvious, ha-ha…
“The last among the middle-three sects…”
Exalted Hei Ran continued and the people tuned in. Heaven Trailing Sect’s young master was even more attentive. That was their spot since coming here. Though unclear if they kept it after all the changes.
They were sweating now, eyes bloodshot, as they awaited Exalted Hei Ran to say those little words.
It was never meant to be though, as Exalted Hei Ran said, “Demon Soul Sect!”
The Han brothers shook their heads. They planned on moving up at least a spot but ended up moving a spot backward. They had no idea how they were going to break this to their harsh old man.
While they were hesitating, Ren Cong was frozen in place. If Demon Soul Sect got last place in the middle-three sects, then Heaven Trailing Sect was in the lower-three sects?
The young master felt like crying. Getting home would get his dad to thrash him.
[How could we fall so low?]
“The last among the superior-three sects…”
Ignoring those two sects’ sadness, Exalted Hei Ran kept on declaring, “Sword God Sect!”
Wen Tao’s team was stunned, then went wild with joy. They actually upgraded their class, from middle-three sect to superior-three sect.
They thought that by losing to Zhuo Fan and being wounded in the challenge stage, they lost their chance. Now, it seemed that they did it.
Even if it was the last spot, it was still worth an achievement.
Zhuo Fan’s side stuck to their ally-making policy and congratulated them. Wen Tao kept cupping his hands in reply with a beaming smile.
Though one sect’s fortune was another’s sadness. Universal Righteous Sect’s Zhao Dezhu was dumbstruck.
For Sword God Sect to go up, one had to go down. As to who that was, it went without saying that it was the weakest.
Zhao Dezhu’s lip shivered, feeling endless sadness.
This was the worst performance in all Double Dragon Gatherings. How was he going to explain it back home?
Looking aside, Exalted Hei Ran showed a mocking smile as he continued, “Lower-three sects mid position, Mystical Heaven Sect!”
Xuan Shaoyu and the elder eased a breath. This was the usual result at least.
Though they failed to be the first lower-three sect.
The girls didn’t care much about it. Those glistening pairs of eyes only watched Zhuo Fan, as if the Demon Scheming Sect’s spot was far more important.
“Middle-three sects second spot, Universal Righteous Sect!” Exalted Hei Ran looked right at Zhao Dezhu when he shouted.
The crowd was in an uproar. A great superior-three sect had not only fallen from grace but went down to ranks.
The Universal Righteous Sect’s elders were bound to go mad from the news!
While the people did not know if they would, they did hear Zhao Dezhu go insane first as he argued, “Hold on, Exalted! What is this? Universal Righteous Sect is a superior-three sect, how did it fall so much?”
“Humph, you should be asking your scheming mind.”
Exalted Hei Ran disdained, “When you fought Hellion Flame and Ultimate Clarity Sect, you always held back, so much so you earned little points. In the superior-three sects challenge stage, you routed Demon Scheming Sect but in the end, your score dropped to rock bottom, earning your current rank as second middle-three sect.”
Zhao Dezhu shook like a leaf, his butt hitting the ground hard from shock. “How can this be? The points for fighting in the superior-three sects singles are far more than in the other categories. How…”
“You’re right, but that’s because the superior-three sects’ disciples are much stronger. But that only means by forfeiting the deduction is even greater.”
Exalted Bai Mei’s eyes were sharp as he said flatly, “Your great scheming has brought you this low. I hope that as a second middle-three sect you and your sect will calm down and focus on your path and not scheme for fame and wealth. As you know scheming comes with risks. If it fails, you’re the one to suffer for it.”
Zhao Dezhu sat there on the ground, lost, not even hearing his advice.
The exalted shook their heads and Exalted Hei Ran continued, “Superior-three sects mid position, Hellion Flame!”
Yan Mo nodded and eased a breath. At least they kept their spot.
They were really scared the Demon Scheming Sect would’ve taken it.
“And now, it’s time to announce the top positions!”
Exalted Hei Ran finally came to the final three names. The crowd went quiet and waited with bated breaths.
“Lower-three sects top position, Heaven Trailing Sect!”
Exalted Hei Ran’s shout pierced Ren Cong’s ears. He had seen it coming but it still came as a blow. He was shaking so hard, the breeze might topple him.
It was too much for him to take.
In the end, he chose to glare at Zhuo Fan.
[It’s all that punk’s fault. I won’t ever let you go! Just wait, you’ll get yours!]
Ren Cong’s eyes flashed as he started making his plans.
“Middle-three sects top position, Demon Scheming Sect!”
Exalted Hei Ran finally uttered the greatest underdog’s name, but the gang were all smiles.
That threw the crowd off. Even the exalted were curious.
[They got such restraint?]
They were clearly something more to keep their cool after hearing they went from lower-three sects to top middle-three sects.
[Or was it the least of their expectations, since they aimed for superior-three sects?]
How would they know the Demon Scheming Sect team’s mood was more affected by Zhuo Fan’s leaving?
Zhuo Fan had got them all the way here without a scratch. Now that he left, they couldn’t be happy even if they wanted to.
Shrugging, the exalted scratched their heads. Exalted Hei Ran declared the last spot, “Superior-three sects top position, Ultimate Clarity Sect!”
The king in the western lands, Ultimate Clarity Sect, had never fallen off his throne. But everyone, even Ultimate Clarity Sect were clear how dangerous it was to maintain it.
Giving Zhuo Fan a long look, Wu Qingqiu sighed, “I hope the next Double Dragon Gathering we won’t meet that freak again.”
Wu Qingqiu wiped his brow recalling the fight.
The nine sects now had their new status. What followed next was what they were waiting for. The share of sacred stones the Double Dragon Manor bestowed at Double Dragon Gathering.
Exalted Hei Ran sat down and Exalted Bai Mei began, “According to Double Dragon Gathering’s results, the sacred stones shall be split as follows: the top superior-three sect, Ultimate Clarity Sect, will receive a hundred thousand, the Hellion Flame fifty thousand and Sword God Sect thirty thousand.”
Everyone was shocked.
[So much?]
Only the elders that had been to past Double Dragon Gatherings shook their heads.
[Much? That goes to the winner.]
[Double Dragon Manor ain’t so generous to losers…]

chapters.title: Chapter 718: Crownless King
chapters.content:
Chapter 718: Crownless King
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Top of the middle-three sects, the Demon Scheming Sect, receives ten thousand, the Universal Righteous Sect receives five thousand and the Demon Soul Sect three thousand.”
Exalted Bai Mei’s shout echoed in everyone’s ears, shocking them to the core. The middle-three sects had received so little compared to the superior-three sects, only a little over ten thousand in total.
The people that thought Double Dragon Manor was generous changed their thinking.
[They’re so restrained with the sacred stones!]
The rewards for the middle-three sects took a sharp decline. Then what about the lower-three sects?
Some were happy, some were despairing.
The Demon Scheming Sect had only ever got a bunch of scraps of sacred stones whenever it came to Double Dragon Gathering. They hardly had anything to develop when they used most of them in the sect’s defenses.
Only this time, they got a whole ten thousand of them. The fiends were ecstatic. It was something they would never get even in dozens of Double Dragon Gatherings combined. They really won big this time.
The Demon Scheming Sect felt they were loaded all of a sudden. These stones would help develop the sect for the decades to come and finally shed their former lower-three sect self.
All became possible under Zhuo Fan’s leadership. They looked at him with respect and admiration, yet it only made his leaving that much harder to bear.
However, Zhuo Fan did not care about it at all. Ignoring the fact he cleaned Double Dragon Manor’s sacred mine, that had around a million of those glittering baubles, the stuff he got from Kunpeng should last him for lifetimes.
As the Demon Scheming Sect was cheering at their wealth, the Universal Righteous Sect found itself dirt poor.
Five thousand sacred stones were substantial to anyone, but the Universal Righteous Sect had been a superior-three sect and earned thirty thousand in their last spot there.
As a large sect, they were used to having a large treasury to fund their disciples and elders.
But just these scraps now hardly made the cut. Until the next Double Dragon Gathering hundreds of years from now, they’d have to tighten that belt, a lot. Maybe they would weaken so much they would never reach superior-three sects again.
The dark faced Zhao Dezhu felt like crying.
[We lost too much this time.]
How was he to know the greatest underdog, Demon Scheming Sect, along with Sword God Sect, would reach such a level?
If he had known, he’d just fought with all he had and gotten those points instead of falling so much.
[Vile demonic cultivators, it’s all because we saved our strength to deal with you that I fell so much! Just you wait!]
Zhao Dezhu glared at Zhuo Fan, totally forgetting Exalted Bai Mei’s words.
Exalted Bai Mei shook his head and sighed.
[He’s a lost cause…]
The Demon Soul Sect had fallen as well, but just by one spot. They only lost two thousand sacred stones, something they could take.
Unlike the one that had it worse, they were quite calm about it.
The Han brothers looked at Ren Cong to see his dark look as he listened to Exalted Bai Mei’s words, “The top of lower-three sects, Heaven Trailing Sect receives a thousand sacred stones, Mystical Heaven Sect receives five hundred and Beast Taming Sect three hundred. This concludes the Double Dragon Gathering sacred stone distribution.”
“Thank you, Exalted!” Everyone cupped their hands and bowed, even as some were angry, some were happy and some were dejected.
Mystical Heaven Sect’s Elder Yun glanced at Ren Cong and saw his anger, “Young master Ren, that vile Demon Scheming Sect has just got a lot of sacred stones but they don’t have the power of a middle-three sect. They’ll need at least a hundred years to grow into their new status. Plenty of time for our chance…”
“Does Mystical Heaven Sect think so as well?” Ren Cong glanced over with a vague smile as he spoke.
Elder Yun picked up on something and probed, “Young master Ren already has a plan?”
“Humph, not mine. Someone already has his eye on that punk, waiting for the right moment. When the time comes, I hope Mystical Heaven Sect will join us and not run away.”
Elder Yun shook and frowned. He only wanted to comfort the young master of the top-three guardian sects and get them to push down the speedy growth of the Demon Scheming Sect.
However, he never thought the Heaven Trailing Sect already had a plan to deal with him and wanted the Mystical Heaven Sect to join them.
[Just what are they planning? If it gets out of hand, Double Dragon Manor will step in and Heaven Trailing Sect will be finished.]
Mystical Heaven Sect didn’t want to go down as well.
Elder Yun frowned as he pondered.
Ren Cong saw his hesitation and said, “No worries, I know what you’re afraid of. Double Dragon Manor doesn’t want western lands’ power to drop and is on the lookout for any conflict between sects. But you should know not everyone’s house affairs are so easily settled.”
“You mean…” Elder Yun was stunned.
Ren Cong cast a nasty look at Zhuo Fan as he smiled eerily, “Even in Demon Scheming Sect, not everyone took a liking to this punk. When the time comes, the Demon Scheming Sect would fail its duties so much, the Exalted can’t do anything. Unless they don’t want to lead the western lands…”
Elder Yun pondered and nodded.
“Next are the individual scores in the Double Dragon Gathering for the best ten disciples in western lands and their rewards.”
Exalted Bai Mei and Exalted Hei Ran spoke up. The people turned solemn and eager.
Yan Mo, Xie Tianshang and the other competitive ones were looking forward to it as well.
Exalted Hei Ran stood up and spoke, “In this Double Dragon Gathering, the tenth disciple in western lands is third young master Han from Demon Soul Sect! A hundred sacred stones!”
Third young master Han was stunned. He never thought he’d be among the ranking.
Exalted Hei Ran continued, “The ninth place goes to second young master Han, two hundred sacred stones!”
The brothers shouted in joy. They both made it and now had a chance of getting into Double Dragon Manor.
“The eighth place goes to Ren Cong, three hundred sacred stones. 7th place, Xie Tianshang, four hundred. 6th place, Han Yunfeng, five hundred. 5th place, Wen Tao, six hundred. 4th place, Zhao Dezhu, seven hundred. 3rd place, Yan Mo, eight hundred. 2nd place Wu Qingqiu, nine hundred. First place…”
Exalted Hei Ran paused for effect, getting everyone excited.
The two strongest in this Double Dragon Gathering were Zhuo Fan and Ye Lin, but none of their names was among those nine places.
[Did Ye Lin die? Is that why Exalted Hei Ran didn’t announce him?]
The people started looking dejected at this though and sighed.
[So young and so strong. What a shame.]
[Then again, it’s all his bad luck’s fault for meeting one worse than himself. There’s always someone stronger out there…]
Exalted Hei Ran continued at long last, “First place Ye Lin, one thousand sacred stones!”
[What?!]
At this news, the crowd was aboil, then confused eyes focused on Zhuo Fan.
Why didn’t the final winner get a spot as well but the loser did?
[Does the Double Dragon Manor have some shady agenda for the Double Dragon Gathering?]
[But this is too shady! You think we’re so blind we can’t see the outcome?]
They recalled how Exalted Hei Ran rescued Ye Lin and they started making wild guesses that Ye Lin had something to do with the exalted to be shielded.
Thus forcing the best in western lands, Zhuo Fan, to be a crownless king.
From the moment Ye Lin fell, everyone saw Zhuo Fan as the number one. Even if he wasn’t officially recognized, everyone saw him as such.
All looked at the Exalted Double Dragons with doubt and suspicion.
[What strings are you pulling here?]

chapters.title: Chapter 719: Challenge
chapters.content:
Chapter 719: Challenge
Proofreader
: Papatonks
The exalted shared a look, knowing what they were thinking. The Double Dragon Manor, which was renowned for being fair for thousands of years, was now facing everyone’s doubts because of one brat.
They had to work hard to build up their image, only for it to collapse in an instant before they could even explain why.
This only showed just how much Zhuo Fan grew in their eyes.
Such charisma had the exalted appreciating him more.
“Exalted, why isn’t Zhuo Fan among the top ten disciples?” Wu Qingqiu bowed and asked.
The crowd grew noisier as their doubts mounted.
Exalted Hei Ran didn’t say it, “It is Double Dragon Manor’s rule!”
Exalted Hei Ran made it so no one could challenge his decision again.
None wanted to offend the strongest in western lands.
“Is it?”
However, Wu Qingqiu smiled, bowing again, “Since it’s Double Dragon Manor’s rule, I won’t pry, but I ask Exalted to take down Ye Lin’s and my name as well.”
[What?!]
The crowd was speechless from shock.
Wu Qingqiu continued, “Exalted, I just don’t want my name to be on a meaningless ranking. I wouldn’t want to disgrace Double Dragon Manor’s rankings. With junior brother’s temper, I think he will want the same.”
“So you mean our ranking was unfair and dishonors you?” Exalted Hei Ran growled.
The anger the crowd felt caused them to shiver.
Wu Qingqiu shook his head, but the meaning was obvious. “Ha-ha-ha, Exalted, how can a disciple from the Ultimate Clarity Sect say something like that? I just felt junior brother and I will only dishonor Double Dragon Manor’s ranking by being on it. If it’s possible, I hope that we are taken off.”
The crowd gasped as to the meaning.
[This kid is being sarcastic, saying that Zhuo Fan isn’t on the list and so he doesn’t want to be on it either. By saying he dishonors the ranking he is criticizing it for being unfair and doesn’t want to stay on it.]
The people showed endless admiration for Wu Qingqiu’s courage to speak up against the exalted.
Zhuo Fan felt the same.
[Just like I thought, Wu Qingqiu is worth befriending.]
“Ha-ha-ha, since none want to, then I’ll be the first in western lands!”
Then came sudden laughter that caught everyone’s attention. It was Yan Mo.
Giving Wu Qingqiu and Zhuo Fan a vile smile, Yan Mo shrugged, “However, being called a king among these people is so boring. It’s better I step out as well. Without a worthy opponent I’d only slack off and get further and further behind.”
“Ha-ha-ha, brother Yan Mo is mocking everyone else. You can look down on anyone, but not the younger generation. We, the Sword God Sect, are the last among the superior-three sects and next time we will take your place! Don’t you run away! Why don’t we run together?”
Wen Tao joined the bustle.
Xie Tianshang, Han Yunfeng and others renounced their spots for Zhuo Fan.
The people saw for the first time how so many were against Double Dragon Manor’s decision.
Even the exalted didn’t see it coming. This showed how much charisma Zhuo Fan had. They only met for a few days yet these four great sects’ disciples were on his side.
The exalted smiled in appreciation.
In those days, Sheng only gained recognition through power, but now this kid was truly the best in western lands.
Exalted Hei Ran raised his hand for silence.
He spoke calmly, only far more relaxed than before, “There’s a reason why Zhuo Fan isn’t on the ten best disciples in western lands. One is Double Dragon Gathering’s rule, based on single matches that evaluate your skills. In these matches, Zhuo Fan only fought in the lower-three sects. So no matter how amazing he is, his points are lacking.”
“Of course, his outstanding display in the last challenge team battle showed otherwise. It’s even reasonable to break this rule and have him on the rankings. But…”
“What?” Everyone asked.
Exalted Hei Ran shook his head, “The ten disciples in western lands is something we decided on, with Zhuo Fan having exceeded our evaluation. In other words, we can’t appraise his strength. Just that last strike of his, injured his opponent even as I interfered. One can say that even I lost to him. Though it is a matter of being careful…”
“Exalted exaggerates!” Zhuo Fan immediately cupped his hands.
Exalted Hei Ran smiled, “It’s fine. We both know our own strengths, yet to wound someone with me around is already incredible. That is why we have lost the means to judge you.”
“Ah, youths, you have your pride and beliefs but so do we. Zhuo Fan didn’t make it on the list, not because he’s unworthy, but because he’s gone beyond it. That is why we decided, for the first time in millenia, to add one more rank to this list. Rank 0, the crownless king, Zhuo Fan. It means no one can grant him a title, or reward it to him. As for sacred stones, two thousand!”
The crowd went slack-jawed, incredulous the Exalted Double Dragons admitted they couldn’t judge a disciple.
They even went as far as making a new rank just for him…
[The kid will definitely grow strong under the care of the two Exalted.]
The crowd looked at Zhuo Fan, the future best in western lands that had been recognized by the exalted, in shock.
Wu Qingqiu and the others looked happy. As if Zhuo Fan’s glory was only natural.
But Zhuo Fan did not care, only making small talk with some just to get closer.
As for Xuan Shaoyu, Ren Cong and others, their faces fell seeing Zhuo Fan look so proud. They all turned to Lu Xie with sharp eyes.
[Best in western lands? Humph!]
[I’ll make sure you never live to reach it!]
“Everyone calm down now.”
Exalted Bai Mei stood up with a smile.
Clearing his voice, Exalted Bai Mei began, “The Double Dragon Gathering is over, with all the sects’ ranks being decided. The disciples may return home. As for the disciples that enter the Double Dragon Manor, we will need some time to debate. I will then send a jade slip to notify each Sect Leader. You are now free to leave… “
Boom!
Exalted Bai Mei got cut off by a huge explosion, making everything shake.
The exalted cried out, “The sacred mine!”
“Start the monitoring array and see what’s happening!” Exalted Hei Ran cried out at the gatekeepers.
The two elders made the signs and a screen formed to reveal a long mountain range, with an old man with a red nose hovering at the end of it with a dark look.
The gulf half a mile around him was there for the audience to see as well.
[Just what kind of power can cause this destruction?]
Danqing Shen!
The exalted knew on the spot that this guy was challenging them…

chapters.title: Chapter 720: Genesis Stage
chapters.content:
Chapter 720: Genesis Stage
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Senior sister, isn’t that the drunkard we met in that small town?” Dan’er pointed at the old man in the air as she asked Shui Ruohua.
Shui Ruohua was startled, “That’s definitely him. Zhuo Fan said he was an unfathomable expert and we later realized it as well, but I didn’t think he’d be this strong. His power must be tyrannical to cause such a huge gulf.”
Chu Qingcheng nodded as well.
Zhuo Fan looked on with a frown.
[Why go about sneaking in when he’s now showing himself?]
[Maybe he got pissed he didn’t find the sacred weapon and figured the Exalted screwed him over. So now he drew them out.]
[Since the cover is blown, it is over!]
But were the exalted easy targets?
[You might be the best in western lands, but that is when it comes to personal strength. Just how much do you have it in you to fight your two former masters?]
[There’s strength in numbers.]
Zhuo Fan frowned.
He figured this might happen. The two sides would meet and after a brief talk they’d figure out he stole the sacred weapon. Then Danqing Shen and the exalted would come to deal with him.
Then again, in this deadly situation, there was still a chance they had some bad blood between them. This would lead to a misunderstanding.
They all knew the sacred weapon was strong and not just anyone could wield it. But who knew the Divine Eye of the Void could control it?
This way, the sacred weapon had disappeared into thin air. They would have no choice but to ask each other for clues. Because only the three of them could get it while forgetting about him.
Next would be fighting it out only to settle nothing in the end. It was his most favorite item of the day!
Zhuo Fan hoped his sneaky plan would go as he wished, to have both sides think the sacred weapon was on each other. And not to resolve their issues while fighting.
Or they would soon suspect him.
[That’s when I’m done for.]
However, the chances of that happening were highly unlikely. Or Danqing Shen wouldn’t just sneak in.
“What is he doing there? We clearly sealed the entrance, only leaving this side. Did he enter right under our noses?”
Exalted Hei Ran took a deep breath and roared in fury.
Exalted Bai Mei just frowned in thought.
Danqing Shen stood before the sacred mine as he shouted at a monitoring array, “Masters, I’ve come to visit. Won’t you see me?”
[Master?! He’s from the Double Dragon Manor?]
The audience was stunned at this development.
The exalted felt helpless. Exalted Hei Ran shouted and a white gate appeared in the air. He stepped through it, with Exalted Bai Mei right behind him.
The audience was even more perplexed.
[The guy called for his master so why isn’t he showing up? Does he want the Exalted to go there? Wait, does that mean the Exalted had disciples? But we know they only ever had one…]
The best in western lands, Danqing Shen!
Everyone exclaimed.
[That old man standing in that storm is that strong!]
Yan Mo had already guessed his identity, but hearing him admitting it still came as a shock.
He was Danqing Shen, and only he dared to say that none of western lands’ ten sects could stop him.
Now he came to see his old masters, the Exalted Double Dragons, the strongest in western lands. He did not come for a social visit though. A battle was about to break out.
[Seeing the three strongest in western lands fight makes this trip all the more worthwhile, ha-ha-ha…]
Yan Mo was shaking in excitement.
Shui Ruohua was dumbstruck. The girls knew the old man was beyond them, but they never thought he was that formidable.
Yet these ignorant lasses actually tied up this monster. If not for Zhuo Fan stopping these fools, they might have done something they’d regret.
Shui Ruohua realized that their being alive was all thanks to Zhuo Fan.
All the girls looked gratefully at Zhuo Fan, only to see him calmly watching the screen.
Whoosh!
The exalted appeared before Danqing Shen and looked at the deep gulf beneath him with a dark look.
“Sheng, is this how you welcome us?” Exalted Hei Ran squinted.
Danqing Shen looked over at him then bowed before the two, “Greetings, masters. If you still see me as a disciple…”
“Humph, you caused such a mess back then and have been cast out of Double Dragon Manor. You’ve since stopped being our disciple!” Exalted Hei Ran flicked his sleeve as he huffed.
Danqing Shen’s face twitched and said, “If that’s the case, why then did you accept my greeting?”
“A day a master, a father for life. Did we not teach you? Even if we don’t see you as a disciple, you don’t see us as masters? You won’t greet us upon meeting us? Humph, you’ve become worse I see.” Exalted Hei Ran replied.
Ugh!
Danqing Shen groaned and sighed, “Master Hei Ran, you’re the same as always, still so shameless.”
“You dare talk to your master like that? As if you’re any better!”
“Yes, I’m nothing to look at, but isn’t that what my master taught me? With your shameless style, I got half of your so-called integrity. That’s called rubbing off on me, ha-ha-ha…” Danqing Shen mocked.
Exalted Hei Ran rolled his eyes and ignored him. He actually felt better hearing this, being brought back to those days as he taught this kid.
Exalted Bai Mei knew his thoughts and smiled, then turned serious, “Sheng, what are you doing here? What do you want?”
“I broke in to take back my sword.”
“Sword?”
Exalted Bai Mei exclaimed, “The Atlas Sword? It’s no longer yours. Why should we return it?”
“Of course it’s mine, you agreed. On the day I can beat the both of you, I have the right to inherit it.”
“That is a promise we made to our disciple, which you no longer are.” Exalted Hei Ran snorted.
Danqing Shen smiled and shrugged, “No matter, I’ll be taking that sword today. No matter how much it costs! I didn’t want to fight with masters, planning on taking it and leaving, but since you found out, we can only go by the old agreement. No matter if it’s one or two, I’ll beat you both and take that sword.”
“You sure can talk. Don’t think you can defeat us just because you got to stab me with a sword when you were banished!” Exalted Double Dragon shouted, “In a single battle, you are the best in western lands, but don’t forget we two never separate. You still have a long way to go to be the best!”
Danqing Shen was angry as he gnashed his teeth, “It doesn’t matter, we’ll know once we fight!”
His entire aura exploded.
The sky dimmed as sword waves covered the heavens and cut everything they touched.
The world was breaking apart before he even attacked!
Everyone cried out. They would all be wiped out in an instant if that happened here.
The best in western lands!
Zhuo Fan shouted, “The peak of mortal domain, Genesis Stage!”
Above the Soul Harmony Stage was returning to one’s ancestry, the Genesis Stage. When the soul made a link with the world’s power, one could truly destroy this land. It was without a doubt, the strongest in the mortal domain.
And this stage was where one broke the shackles of mortality, to enter Spirit King Stage. Only that kind of cultivator had the right to roam the Sacred Domain…

chapters.title: Chapter 721: Master and Disciple Fight
chapters.content:
Chapter 721: Master and Disciple Fight
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Danqing Shen’s surge of power covered the entire realm as it shook under it. The biting winds brushed past the Exalted Double Dragons, forcing them to become grave as they faced this power.
Hundreds of years had passed and Danqing Shen, of course, had grown in power, so much so that they were having doubts of fighting him together.
The people looked tense, and a bit excited even, at the screen, showing a scene that could only be described as a prelude to total destruction.
Three Genesis Stage experts were about to fight. This was a once in a blue moon fight!
“Sheng, before we fight, I want to ask you something.” Exalted Bai Mei began.
Danqing Shen grumbled something before finally saying, “Say it.”
“After all these years, why did you come for the sword now? Did you meet someone strong or do you just want to rule some place? Give me a reason!”
Exalted Hei Ran looked straight at him, waiting for an answer as well.
Danqing Shen squinted and said, “Must I say it?”
“It’s fine either way, since you’re no longer our disciple. You have no reason to explain yourself to us.” Exalted Bai Mei spoke coldly.
Exalted Hei Ran stared hard at Danqing Shen, “We must’ve taught you that regardless of what you do, you should always have a reason for doing it, even if it’s wrong. That way, you at least won’t feel lost.”
As the exalted spoke, Danqing Shen felt he was in a particular mood.
They were clearly asking Danqing Shen if he still saw them as masters at his very core. They were testing his intentions for taking the sword and whether he was worthy of inheriting it.
Danqing Shen took a deep breath as he pondered, “To be honest, three years later, I will have a life and death fight with the old freak from the central area. I’m sure that if I have the help of western lands’ treasure, the Atlas Sword, I will win!”
“Central area’s Sword Star Empire’s Invincible Sword?”
Exalted Bai Mei gasped in disbelief, “How did you end up messing with him? You’re even having a life and death battle? Are you crazy?”
Exalted Hei Ran shook all over, his fists clenched tight as he cursed, “Rotten brat, you must be so damn cocky to think that being called the best in western lands means you’re the king of the world! You think that that freak is someone you can toy with? Why do you think four areas joined hands to resist the central area yet were still at a disadvantage?”
Danqing Shen only took a long breath and made up his mind.
Exalted Bai Mei saw his determination and asked, “Sheng, you’re not impulsive and should know when to step back. Why…”
“A man’s gotta do what a man’s gotta do!”
Danqing Shen held his head high as he sighed, “What was it that I told Exalted before I left the western lands? That I had finally found my path.”
The two nodded, “Peace on this world.”
“Yes, that is my path, that is her path!”
Danqing Shen’s eyes flashed, “It was both of our hopes to create a better world. Ever since she died, I have gone crazy and I have fallen into despair. But then I thought to myself, rather than go mad from the pain and hatred, it’d be better to achieve this dream she wanted to see. That’s why, for the past centuries, I have created such a place, a paradise between areas!
“Alas, nothing good lasts forever. My strength keeps all those petty thieves away but I have been in constant conflict with the central area’s Sword Star Empire’s expansion, always wanting to wage war. I used to think that no matter how strong it was, my slice of heaven was insignificant, that they would at least talk with me on account of being a Genesis Stage expert. Yet I did not expect that old freak to come straight for me and make a bet. If I lose, my land will be razed to the ground. Hundreds of years, gone…”
The exalted picked up on his problem and said, “And the old monster is coming for you still?”
“Ha-ha-ha, that’s right. Masters are the wisest.”
Danqing Shen sighed, “My place is only the size of a small empire. It has no riches and no grudge with anyone. How could happy normal people incite the wrath of others? How could they get the great Sword Star Empire to come after them? Unless that old bag of bones…”
Danqing Shen’s voice trailed off, switching to sending words instead.
The exalted sported an astonished look.
Danqing Shen sighed, “The old guy has been in seclusion for hundreds of years and now that he came out and is far stronger, he wants to go big. The four lands are in danger and I hope masters will be ready. With fortune, I saw that this time’s Double Dragon Gathering has some good seeds that might give the western lands some hope.”
The exalted nodded and sighed.
But then Exalted Hei Ran raised an eyebrow, “I just don’t know if I should give you the sword or not anymore.”
“Ha-ha-ha, yeah, it’s quite the conundrum. Without the sword, I’ll lose for sure. But if you do give it to me, maybe it will become the weapon by which the western lands would run with blood. I’d be just as conflicted by this if I were masters.”
Danqing Shen chuckled, then his power exploded once more, “Since that’s the case, just like the old agreement, strength will determine the victor!”
The exalted nodded and said, “Strength it is!”
The two exalted were showing off their strength as well, their dragon power tracing the lands and skies as it clashed with Danqing Shen’s fierce sword waves.
With loud noises, the space began to shake from the impact, about to crack under their power.
The audience watched agape.
[Are these the strongest experts in the world? This is outstanding! If they fight, the world might be ruined!]
This was what everyone thought. Even if exaggerated, they knew a saying.
[The top of mortal domain are like gods!]
Only Zhuo Fan eased a breath.
[Fight, don’t talk. And don’t solve the riddle of the sacred weapon.]
Though it was too soon to celebrate. It all came down to how they fought, and if they would settle this problem instead.
So Zhuo Fan’s eyes were fixed on the fight…
“Double Dragon Art, Double Dragon Emergence!”
The Exalted Double Dragons met their palms and shouted. Black and white powers came out as they spun on each other, just like a yin-yang symbol.
The world was filled with a majestic power as it gathered around them in the form of a black and white roaring dragon.
They then pushed out their palms and unleashed the dragon upon Danqing Shen. The mighty force kept pushing him back.
Danqing Shen pointed his finger at the skies and a draconic roar sounded. A dragon revolved high above around his finger, as if it was climbing the heavens.
The immense sword energy had reached its peak and gathered on his finger, forming an illusory Atlas Sword.
The huge dragon roamed on this sword as it kept roaring.
Under all of this immense power, the skies, the earth, everything was constantly shaking…
“Dragon Cleaving Art!”
Danqing Shen shouted and brought his sword down upon the black and white dragon.
The explosion from the impact was monumental. The skies dimmed, while the land around the sacred mine was leveled and barren.
It went on for hundreds of miles, leaving in its wake an apocalypse.
The crowd was overwhelmed. Just one blow from a Genesis Stage expert unleashed such deadly power. Zhuo Fan and Ye Lin’s fight was astonishing in its own right, but not as frightening as this. They still had a way to go before they could burn the world to cinders.
Everyone paled after seeing such might for the first time.
[No wonder Danqing Shen could come and go in the western lands’ ten sects as he wished. One snap of his fingers can erase a sect…]

chapters.title: Chapter 722: Misunderstanding
chapters.content:
Chapter 722: Misunderstanding
Proofreader
: Papatonks
The two great powers clashed and released constant explosions as they were in deadlock. Even so, the powers slowly weakened as time passed.
With a crack, Danqing Shen’s sword soon vanished, while the Exalted Double Dragon’s black and white dragon crumbled away.
Yet just as the attacks collapsed, a trace of power zipped between sides.
Pff!
A powerful dragon force hit Danqing Shen in the chest, making him groan and forcing him back as he spat blood.
Whoosh!
While two sharp sword waves whistled into the exalted. Unable to react, the waves passed through the exalted’s shoulders and left two red lines.
As masters and disciple fought, it ended up with both sides suffering and neither getting the upper hand.
The crowd was astounded. Danqing Shen was the best in western lands for a reason. Now, two against one, and against his old masters, he still fought to a draw.
This however, left the three feeling complicated.
Exalted Hei Ran glanced at his shoulder and sighed, “Shen, just leave.”
“Old timer…” Exalted Bai Mei looked at them then at the sacred mine having lost its familiar feel and sighed.
Danqing Shen’s eyes shook. He wiped his mouth and looked at the imprint in his chest. He could feel his innards close to boiling as he sighed.
He and the exalted would only end up hurting each other. He could not defeat them, thus he could not take the sword.
[The Exalted are still thinking of western lands’ peace, ha-ha-ha…]
Danqing Shen shook his head, giving a deep bow to the Exalted Double Dragons before vanishing. Seeing him leave, Exalted Double Dragon frowned, “Old timer, will you just let him take the sword?”
“With no trace of it coming from the cave, that means he must have it. He made a big ruckus and called us out just to prove that he could take the sword openly. However, even if he loses, I don’t think he’ll leave the sword behind.”
Exalted Hei Ran shook his head and looked at his wound, “Two against one yet we’re evenly matched. If he had taken out the sword, we’d have lost. Why didn’t he?”
Exalted Bai Mei was worried, “Old timer, you’re right. We had planned on giving him the sword, but just like he said, that old freak from the central area is on the move. If we don’t have the lands’ treasure…”
“What comes, will. So what if we had it, won’t the old freak have one as well?”
Exalted Hei Ran shook his head, “When the old freak takes the central area’s divine sword over to us, we’ll still be of no match. It’s better if we give it to Sheng, letting him fight for his beliefs. We’ll have no regrets regardless of the outcome, since he’s already stronger than us.”
Exalted Bai Mei sighed as he agreed, “Yeah, last time we didn’t protect his beliefs and forced him to leave. At least now, we can make amends by letting him take the sword. We sealed the entrance at the Heaven Reaching Pavilion yet never believed he would come out in the open and take the sword like this. Ha-ha-ha, what does it have to do with that old freak from the central area anyway? He just took it and left!”
Exalted Bai Mei seemed to have accepted this truth but then frowned, “But how on earth did he sneak in? Did he really slip in under our noses?”
“Ha-ha-ha, he took the sword so what difference does it make?” Exalted Hei Ran vanished, “We need to get in touch with the other three lands’ experts, get ready for that old freak.”
Exalted Bai Mei raised an eyebrow and nodded, vanishing as well.
Unfortunately, neither Danqing Shen nor Exalted Double Dragons figured out that it was just one giant misunderstanding.
The Exalted Double Dragons thought they lost so they left Danqing Shen thinking he already had the sword. But Danqing Shen always thought the exalted knew he came here so they took the sword on purpose, keeping it with them.
Adding to that the draw, Exalted Hei Ran let him leave, making him think this was their way of driving him away. Since he couldn’t beat him, he wouldn’t get the sword. That was why he left sadly.
Thus, the prized Atlas Sword of the western lands became an enigma. Danqing Shen thought it was with the exalted, while the exalted thought he had it.
They were both wrong though, as it was on Zhuo Fan all along.
When the exalted returned, they had the crowd disperse. Looking back at the screen, Zhuo Fan sighed.
[The misunderstanding took hold between them, and I am left getting away with it.]
Danqing Shen was still oblivious he’d been made the scapegoat.
[Nothing but the lack of communication!]
Zhuo Fan sighed inside.
Even though the two sides were master and disciple, since they broke it off, meeting again was a tense experience. The trio had to stick their pride out as well, so of course they ignored the trifles, leaving simple communication out of the equation.
It was the perfect setup for a big misunderstanding, what Zhuo Fan had hoped all along.
If Danqing Shen had heard Exalted Hei Ran’s words after he left, he would’ve asked more about the sword and Zhuo Fan’s plan would’ve unraveled.
While it wouldn’t happen on the spot, the doubt in Danqing Shen would grow and would find him out sooner or later.
[A shame this expert is too prideful, too nice.]
Not winning meant he had no right to get the sword. Danqing Shen thought so and admitted defeat, leaving without a word.
[Ha-ha-ha, this way I can move about without a care.]
Zhuo Fan snickered inside as he stuck his chin out.
The fiends found it odd, “What’s got you so perky all of a sudden?”
“Being the top middle-three sect isn’t a cause for celebration? Ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan quirked an eyebrow.
Ugh!
Fiend Yang looked lost, “But Exalted already announced our spot. How come you’re happy only now?”
“Uhm, I just came to!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes darted all over as he smiled.
Fiend Yang’s eye twitched and rolled his eyes.
[This guy is being weird again. It’s been said for an hour now and you’re just reacting?]
[There’s no way he’s happy over that. But if he doesn’t want to say it, whatever.]
The guys shrugged, then shook their heads. Sometimes, Steward Zhuo was just plain weird and sometimes mysterious.
They helped Zhuo Fan to get back to his room, planning on leaving once he recovered.
They had completed the Double Dragon Gathering mission and would be rewarded once they got back to the sect. The fiends couldn’t wait to break the news back home.
“Zhuo Fan, get better while I settle the details with others about our bragging speech once we get home, ha-ha-ha…” Fiend Yang closed the door and laughed.
Zhuo Fan merely smiled.
The instant he was alone he heard someone, “Kid, you’d best leave as well in a few days. I find it hard to leave you even though we met for a few days.”
Zhuo Fan jerked in fright. He wiped his head around to see Danqing Shen disappointed and drowning his sorrow with wine.
“S-senior, what are you doing back here?” Zhuo Fan’s heart skipped a beat and gulped as he forced a smile.
[He didn’t find out anything, right?]
Zhuo Fan was worried the old guy might have spotted something that gave him away.
Danqing Shen watched him through drunken eyes and sighed, “I failed in the end. The Exalted were on guard and took the sword. I could not take it.”
“That can’t be. I saw senior wounding the Exalted. Who else in western lands but senior is fit to have that sword?” He gave him a thumbs up and good flattery while being on guard as to why Danqing Shen was back here again…

chapters.title: Chapter 723: Treasure Your People
chapters.content:
Chapter 723: Treasure Your People
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Danqing Shen smiled through hazy eyes as he cursed, “Rotten brat, enough of your flattery. A loss or a draw is still a loss, thus not worthy of the sacred sword. This will make matters so much worse in the next fight…”
“Senior has another battle?” Zhuo Fan probed.
Danqing Shen nodded, “The strongest in the central area, Invincible Sword. Lasting ten moves would be a feat in itself.”
“Senior is so strong, but can’t handle ten of his moves? Just how strong is he?” Zhuo Fan was astounded, “Are the best in western lands and the best in the central area so far apart?”
Danqing Shen sighed and took a large gulp of wine, “Kid, you’re too green, young and cocky. But remember this, there’s always someone stronger out there. What can the best in western lands amount to when in the central area? He wouldn’t even be in the top ten experts.”
“What?!”
Zhuo Fan was shocked, not because of Danqing Shen’s disparity compared to the central area, but of the gap between areas.
Zhuo Fan had been a Demonic Emperor from the Sacred Domain, there was hardly any expert he hadn’t seen. Yet the sharp difference in power on the same continent left him stunned.
It was like a three year old holding huge wealth only to have a towering thug for a neighbor. Who’d ever feel safe?
He would’ve been robbed blind ages ago.
[But why is the central area so strong?]
Danqing Shen saw through him and mocked, “Of the entire continent, only the central area differs from the other four. Do you know why?”
Zhuo Fan showed he didn’t.
“It’s their structure.”
Danqing Shen turned serious, “The four lands are governed by sects, with hundreds of empires serving them. This makes them a loose force. Since when it comes to waging war, it’s still the empires that are stronger. When did you ever hear sects going to war?”
Zhuo Fan nodded as he contemplated.
Danqing Shen continued. “Here’s where the central area is different. There’s an old monster there and a huge empire, Sword Star Empire. Invincible Sword, its ancestor, had founded the empire ten thousand years ago. He is not only strong, but even swallowed all the nations and sects around him until he achieved this form, an area ruled entirely by one empire.”
“A-an entire area with just one empire?” Zhuo Fan was shocked. Now he knew why the central area was so strong.
With just a sole empire, its development was much sharper than many conflicting empires.
The fact that it was a single empire was an amazing feat by itself. The other four lands weren’t like this at all. While all wanted to achieve it, they had no one to take the lead.
Take western lands for example. Exalted Double Dragons were tough, but they were just cultivators and lacked vision and a calculating mind.
Danqing Shen gave him a long look and patted his shoulder, “Kid, I can tell you are a man of ambition, and even a trace of that old freak’s nature. Lead your heroes, take your turf, but you best hurry it up and get stronger too. Central area is on the move. It will still take some time, but you’re way too young. You’re just out of time.”
“You mean that the central area’s action has nothing to do with me?” Zhuo Fan started.
Danqing Shen smirked, “That old freak took thousands of years to get his tiny empire to rule the entire central area. Now he’s set his eyes on the world. Everyone is involved in this, you included. Even if you hide, can those girls hide as well? Can their empire, Tianyu, hide?
“Ha-ha-ha, the future of western lands is yours. As a western lands’ man, maybe the future will be your opponent’s. But now, I hope you’ll get ready and not regret what comes.”
Danqing Shen stood up and bent his waist, about to leave, “I best be going now. I’ve wasted enough time on a kid. I just hope the western lands’ youths will grow. It will be up to fate if you’ll get over this calamity.”
Zhuo Fan’s heart sank.
He just wanted to focus on cultivating and get back to Sacred Domain. But Danqing Shen just said that chaos would soon envelop the five lands.
He didn’t care much, since he was a lone wolf. No one would find him if he wanted to hide.
It was another matter for the Luo clan. It would be hard to not get dragged into this mess.
[Maybe I should get some things ready, just in case. Then I’ll leave in peace.]
Zhuo Fan was deep in thought as Danqing Shen was fading away, yet he did say one last thing. “By the way kid, you better take care of that girl. Treasure your people.”
“Oh please, I’m a demon. Why would I care about some girl?” Knowing who Danqing Shen was speaking of, Zhuo Fan blushed.
“Ha-ha-ha, what does being demonic or righteous have to do with it? You’re just one man. Better not live to regret it later.” Danqing Shen vanished at long last.
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes, yet he now had more to worry about.
[It’ll be hard to meet again after the Double Dragon Gathering. Just that my path…]
Zhuo Fan closed his eyes.
Three days later, Zhuo Fan was in his room cultivating, his wounds halfway to being healed. It was around this time the sect teams were leaving.
Demon Soul Sect and Sword God Sect had come to say goodbye to Zhuo Fan, wishing him a quick recovery.
Zhuo Fan nodded with a smile.
[It looks to me we’re practically relatives with these sects. It’ll be up to Kui Lang and the others now, on how they cherish their allies.]
He could now return to the Luo clan at ease.
“Zhuo Fan, Shuang’er and I are returning to Tianyu. When will you leave?” Zhuo Fan opened his door to find that it was Yongning.
Zhuo Fan frowned, “I’ve yet to recover and I still need around ten days before I leave at ease.”
“At ease? Who is after you?” Yongning started.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “I don’t know since I’ve got many enemies. Better to be safe than sorry.”
The two girls nodded. Zhuo Fan did gain plenty of enemies this time and should be ready just in case. It wouldn’t do to let the enemy make use of his wounded state.
“Then we will go on ahead.” The girls waved with a smile, their eyes shining brightly.
Zhuo Fan found it odd and pondered, “Aren’t you two girls afraid of going back to Tianyu alone? Why don’t you wait a few days and we’ll go together.”
“Really?” Yongning perked up.
Shuang’er pulled her clothes, then she came to and smiled, “It’s fine. Going back with sister Qingcheng, we’ll be talking about plenty of girl stuff. Like how to figure out your mind, win your favor… mmhmm…”
A blushing Shuang’er rushed to cover her mouth.
“Is Mystical Heaven Sect leaving as well?” Zhuo Fan frowned after hearing her. Danqing Shen’s words came to him and so he stood up to leave.
The two hurried after him.
They soon arrived at Mystical Heaven Sect’s place. The disciples were gathered around, ready to leave.
Shui Ruohua noticed him and all the girls turned to Chu Qingcheng.
“Sister Qingcheng, he’s here…” Dan’er got Chu Qingcheng’s attention.
Shaking a little, Chu Qingcheng turned around to meet Zhuo Fan’s cold eyes. She smiled and walked closer, “How are you feeling?”
“Much better. Why only ask now? Isn’t it a little late?”
“Ha-ha-ha, doesn’t Steward Zhuo dislike chatter, always being alone? How come you’re blaming me for not seeing you?” Chu Qingcheng teased.
Zhuo Fan looked deep into Chu Qingcheng’s eyes, “Give me half a year and… and I’ll give you an answer for back then.”
Zhuo Fan then left, but Chu Qingcheng was stunned. She then smiled, her eyes filled with tears of joy.
Turning around, she floated back to her team like a butterfly.
The others were stumped at their icy teammate being lively and having a bright smile.
[What did that guy say?]
“Sister Qingcheng, what’s wrong?” Dan’er hesitated.
Chu Qingcheng beamed with joy, “He said he’ll give me an answer. He finally faltered…”
The others were lost.
[What does that mean?]
That was something only Chu Qingcheng knew. It was a question she asked Zhuo Fan a long long time ago.
Xuan Shaoyu looked on with cold eyes and clenched fists.
[Half a year, is it? Perfect…]

chapters.title: Chapter 724: Yun Clan Ancestral Home
chapters.content:
Chapter 724: Yun Clan Ancestral Home
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Ten days later, Zhuo Fan opened his door to take a deep breath of fresh air. He was in a better mood now that his wounds were healed.
What awaited him outside was his team, the nine disciples and three fiends of Demon Scheming Sect. They had always been waiting for Zhuo Fan to get better and get home.
These days, the other sects had already gone, leaving them behind. They came last and now they were leaving last.
Though the mood was completely different. They were no longer tense, but jubilant.
“Zhuo Fan, you’re the only one left. Can we go now?”
Fiend Yang grinned at Zhuo Fan, “I’ve sent the sect a sending jade already, saying that we’ll get back in two months, but… he-he, I have yet to give them the good news.”
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow and noticed Fiend Yang’s rotten smile. “You’ll be making them sick with worry.”
“Ha-ha-ha, that’ll make things more interesting. While we risked our lives here, they’d just been casually waiting for the news. That’s too easy for them.”
Fiend Yang winked at Zhuo Fan, “You’re going to leave anyway. You should use this chance to get back at those old fools now while you still can. Besides, once we sent them the great news, their towering fury would just fizzle out, right?”
The others laughed along.
Zhuo Fan shrugged. “Fine, I’m leaving anyway, so I’ll just take this burden. Take it as my prank.”
“Ha-ha-ha, wonderful. That’s our great steward!” Fiend Yang patted his shoulder and the others nodded with soft eyes.
They knew their days with Zhuo Fan were running out…
“Zhuo Fan, are you… leaving the Demon Scheming Sect?” A girl cried out. Zhuo Fan turned to see Yongning who suddenly looked at him in shock. “Where are you going? You better give us a clear location or we won’t be able to find you?”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes softened, “You don’t have to look for me. Once I finish reporting to the Demon Scheming Sect, I’ll be going home to Tianyu.”
“Really?” The girls cheered.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Of course, why else did you think I asked you to wait? Forget Mystical Heaven Sect and come with us. Once I finish over at the sect, we’ll be going home together so you won’t meet any trouble on the way.”
The girls bobbed their heads in elation. With Zhuo Fan back in the Luo clan, the girls would no longer have to suffer the bitter loneliness of being so far apart.
But the fact that Chu Qingcheng couldn’t come along made them sad. No one else knew Zhuo Fan better than her.
Even though they were love rivals, for her not to be around Zhuo Fan, they thought it was a great loss.
Actually Chu Qingcheng’s graceful stance had moved the girls. If they could all go together, it would be so much better.
“Now, let’s set off!”
Zhuo Fan shouted, breaking their thoughts. Seeing them all go, the girls caught up.
But then Shuang’er stalled and her eyes turned black as they reflected the starry sky. Her heart throbbed in her chest and she was gasping for breath.
“What’s wrong, Shuang’er?” Yongning started in worry.
Zhuo Fan frowned, coming over, “What happened?”
“I don’t know. My heart suddenly became frantic. I’m better now.” Shuang’er looked lost as she shook her head.
She felt a sudden danger, as if someone was coming for her. But then the feeling went away as quick as it came.
Zhuo Fan looked around the area with a careful gaze before setting his mind at ease.
[It must be that Shuang’er is unwell. Once we return, she’ll be getting better.]
