And so, they left the Double Dragon Manor, unaware that Shuang’er’s frantic heart was an omen of the future…
Bam!
In a forest, a rock covered in moss was pulverized.
The sun’s bright rays shone down deep in the dark and humid cave, long hidden from the world. Two panting figures stood before it in joy.
“Second prince, we finally found the Yun clan ancestral home! Ha-ha-ha…” A mere Profound Heaven expert, wearing all black, looked at the other in glee.
Grinning, the youth nodded, clenching the yellow silk tight in his hand, “So many years and now we finally found this accursed place.”
“Big brother, imperial father, once I crack the Yun clan ancestral home’s secret, I will find the best in western lands and will return the lands to the Yuwen clan. I will avenge you. And you, old third, dishonorable pig, your days are at an end. Ha-ha-ha!” The youth cackled like mad, his eyes consumed by hatred.
The guy in black sighed, nodding to himself.
[The lies Crown Prince weaved had the second prince seek revenge rather than instruct us. He was truly wise.]
[Only hatred can make one seek revenge!]
These men were Crown Prince’s men. They had no feud with the imperial family or Yuwen Cong. After the Crown Prince’s death, all of his loyal men were wanted across the nation. Scurrying like rats for so many years had worn the fight out of them.
That went double for those who went with the second prince after the Yun clan ancestral home. After the bitter life they had been through the past years, it proved to be too much for most as they left one by one.
Leaving him all alone. Even so, even he had to beat a hasty retreat against some of the dangers they faced.
Now, thanks to the Crown Prince beguiling Yuwen Yong into exacting revenge, with his help, they finally arrived.
This was just another proof of how hatred could drive a person to no end.
If it was their mission, they would have long abandoned it. Only the second prince persevered, to restore the empire without fail.
The guy in black even found himself admiring the second prince. Though the clueless royalty was being played like a puppet on a string.
Looking ahead, the guy in black took the lead, “Your Highness, I’ll be scouting ahead. Stay behind me and be careful!”
“Thank you, Hei Ying!” Second prince nodded.
(StarReader: the name is lit. black hawk.)
After years of toil, the second prince finally shed his overconfidence as an imperial prince. Finally showing respect to the wise.
The guy in black was touched, “Your Highness, you’re too kind. It’s my duty.”
“You’re too humble. Hei Ying, without you, I would’ve never reached here.” Being close all their journey, the second prince sighed, “To find the Yun clan ancestral home, we’ve been through so much danger, and lost our way more times than I can count. We have even been trapped again and again. In the end, how many died, how many are left? Now I am alone, with you as my sole companion to share life and death with. From now on, you are my brother!”
The guy in black shook, touched to the core. He never imagined that the second prince they were ordered to use as a pawn would treat him so.
He felt ashamed. He wanted to spill the beans about everything and not let His Highness suffer for another’s revenge.
Everyone had a heart, even the Crown Prince’s die hard followers. Having spent so many years with the second prince, he had a change of heart.
He couldn’t bear to see his new master being hurt for following this stupid hatred. But that would mean the Crown Prince’s final wish…
“Your Highness, actually…” Hei Ying was conflicted, frowning as he wanted to say something…
In his moment of carelessness, he stepped onto something and fell.
Plop!
In the darkness, Hei Ying suddenly vanished and the second prince cried out, “Hei Ying…”
What followed was him falling as well, and beneath him was nothing but utter blackness, a dark hole swallowing him whole…

chapters.title: Chapter 725: Emperor Yun’s Fragment
chapters.content:
Chapter 725: Emperor Yun’s Fragment
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Aaaah~!”
Two sharp yells broke the silent darkness, yet only their own ears could hear them. Second prince and Hei Ying then looked around but beyond the eternal darkness there was only more black.
“Hei Ying, can you fly out?” Second prince asked.
He shook his head, filled with dread, “No, this cave is just weird, preventing me, a Profound Heaven expert, from flying. Yet we’re still falling. Just when will we reach the end?”
“We’re finished! With such a deep cave, once we hit the ground, we’ll be plastered! My life will return to the heavens!” Second prince wailed, filled with resentment.
He hadn’t gotten revenge yet. How could he die just like that?
Hei Ying sighed, biting back the words that threatened to come out.
Though he would die having never fulfilled his revenge, it was a notch better to die for one’s ideal. While telling him the truth would mean saying he was a pawn in the hand of a dead Crown Prince for years.
Now that would be even more devastating.
[Letting him go in peace is better. He’s been bitter enough these past years already…]
Hei Ying sighed, “Your Highness, you’ve spared no effort these years. Your Highness and Crown Prince know your devotion and will rest in the underworld.”
“How can he rest? The nation isn’t a nation, Yuwen clan’s lands are in the hands of another and I couldn’t do anything. Imperial father, big brother, they’ll never know rest!”
Second prince started shedding tears, “It’s because I’m too weak to get back the ancestor’s lands. It’s I who failed in earning imperial father and big brother’s deep love!”
Second prince sobbed, making Hei Ying shake his head as he waited to meet his doom.
This was the only way to repay his two master’s care…
Hum~
However, there was an odd sound and the two suddenly slowed down before finding themselves afloat in pitch-blackness.
The two were stunned and looked around.
“I am one of the ten ancient emperors, Emperor Yun’s remnant, sent by her to guard my clan. Are you the sons of my clan, coming to pay your respects?”
A deafening voice rocked their ears, threatening to blow their eardrums. A white image hundreds of meters wide appeared. He looked like an aged immortal, with power and wisdom.
He had silvery flowing hair, a white beard, and a deep and profound aura. The entire void was filled with glittering stars the next second, flowing in a mystical pattern.
The two stared agape at the display.
[Who’s he? He’s like a god walking on this world, holding everything in his palm. He can’t just be a damn human!]
Skipping over Zhuo Fan, have they ever seen someone so awesome anywhere on this continent?
Even Danqing Shen couldn’t hold a candle to this guy.
Yun clan’s ancestral home hid such an astonishing expert.
[I can’t frickin’ believe it!]
Emperor Yun frowned, “If you are my descendants, you may take refuge with me from any difficulty. If not, trespassers shall be forever buried in my clan’s forbidden land to atone for your crimes.”
“What?” The two cried out. Only Yun clansmen could come here, if they wanted to live.
The two were frantic, with the second prince having no shame as he said, “Ancestor, I’m from the Yun clan. I’m Yun Yong.”
Hei Ying’s face twitched and he sighed.
[This guy changes tunes too fast. He even renounced his name. Then again, being chased for so many years, he lost his arrogance as a prince.]
[All he ever cares about is survival, even using a sharp tongue.]
“Ancestor, I’m also from the Yun clan. I’m Yun Ying.” Hei Ying cupped his hands.
Emperor Yun mocked, “It doesn’t matter if you say you are. I will be the judge of that.”
Emperor Yun’s eyes shot prismatic lights as it scanned the two.
“Humph, my Yun clan have mystic eyes that can read the heavens. Yours are normal and you think you can pretend to be of my clan?” After the scan was over, Emperor Yun snorted, “Common fools, die for trespassing in the Yun clan’s forbidden grounds!”
The pitch-black world began to burn, as stars started falling on the two. Thousands of city wide bright lights were coming down on them at full force.
With so many coming to plaster them, there was no way two puny Profound Heaven experts could take it, not when even Ethereal Stage experts would have a hard time.
The two panicked in fear.
Fortunately, the thick and impenetrable skin second prince grew over these torturous years in search for revenge was finally put to good use, “Wait, we are just Yun clan’s average clansmen. Only the clan head has awakened those eyes…”
“Humph, wrong. Not just the Yun Clan Head is able to awaken them. Only a Yun clansman who does is a true Yun clansman.”
Emperor Yun spat, “My blood allows the awakening of a single person in every generation of my clan. That is my successor. Everyone else, even if from the Yun clan, is a stranger. Don’t you know that only the Clan Head can come here? Even as Yun clansmen, you only came to your deaths!”
Emperor Yun finished just as the incoming starfall was about to pulverize the two home invaders.
Second prince gnashed his teeth and his eyes flashed. He took out Yun Xuanji’s eye and said, “We’ve come out of Clan Head’s final wish. This is our proof!”
Whoosh!
The stars halted and soon vanished.
Hei Ying closed his eyes and shivered. Second prince’s hands shook as well, waiting to be erased from this world.
However, death did not come. He watched as a pair of eyes stared down at the orb in his hand. “It’s the mystic eye of my Yun clan. But since it’s just proof, I can only agree to one request.”
[One?]
Startled, the two were jubilant. They turned it all around. Emperor Yun switched from being their greatest enemy to their strongest backer. That was just too sudden. Didn’t he doubt where this eye came from?
Though it worked in their favor.
[Why look for some Danqing Shen when we have this guy to raze the world!]
So the second prince bowed and whined, “Ancestor, my empire has been taken by an evil spawn. I hope ancestor will set things right!”
“Help you restore the nation?”
Emperor Yun quirked an eyebrow. Second prince bobbed his head and the emperor shook his, “Denied.”
“Why? Didn’t you say you’ll agree to one request? With your power, this will be as easy as breathing.” Second prince complained.
Emperor Yun said, “I told you, I am Emperor Yun’s remnant left by her to protect our clan and show it the path forward. I cannot leave, thus, I cannot help you.”
“What can you do, then?” Second prince was annoyed and shouted.
Hei Ying jerked and hurriedly pulled his hand.
[Master, don’t get carried away. He can’t leave, but we’re here stuck with him. He’s the boss and you better not anger him.]
[It’ll be so easy to kill us like squashing bugs.]
Second prince finally came to his senses and cupped his hands, “Forgive me, ancestor, I got carried away. I just want to know how you could help us.”
“Read the heavens and show you the way! Ask your questions and I shall answer all I can!” Emperor Yun’s heavy words fell…

chapters.title: Chapter 726: Back to the Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 726: Back to the Sect
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Hei Ying’s eyes lit up and held his hand out, pointing with a trembling finger at the second prince’s ring.
Catching his drift, the second prince showed a painting, the Lands of Our Nation.
Second prince shouted, “Ancestor, please tell me where the best in western lands, Danqing Shen, is. Can I find him?”
Hum~
Emperor Yun’s eyes shifted and became like the starry sky. The stars around him were on the move as well, releasing their aura and making the two home invaders step back in fright.
“Danqing Shen is in the central area. You will find him in the imperial capital of the Sword Star Empire. He will fulfill your wish.” The stars halted and silence once again reigned after Emperor Yun spoke gravely.
But there was now doubt in his eyes, something the two below were blind to.
Second prince cheered, “Ancestor, is it true?”
“Don’t call me ancestor! I have read the heavens and know you’re not Yun clansmen. I also know everything that your clan did. But I am but Emperor Yun’s remnant and have to follow the rules. Since you brought the Yun clan’s mystic eye, I have shown you the way.” Emperor Yun’s flat tone came.
Second prince’s heart sank, and he was getting nervous. He only breathed easier seeing him still calm.
Since he was a remnant, he had no feelings. If ol’ Emperor Yun was here, he’d be watching their entrails dripping down the walls after swatting them for trying to con him.
Not that his little mind could figure that one out, thinking this bigshot was nagging. So he bowed and braced himself, “Senior, when will I be able to meet Danqing Shen?”
“That’s your second question that I won’t answer. You better leave!” Eyeing them with a flat look, Emperor Yun flicked his wrist.
A gale formed and the two were blown away and were now kissing the ground in the most unpleasant way.
When they finally woke up, they were shocked.
Before them was a lofty mountain, with a peak hiding behind the clouds and snow high on its sides.
Hei Ying cried, “Your Highness, how did we get here? How are we at the foot of the mountain? We’ve been climbing…”
“For three whole years!”
Second prince sighed. “Three years of toil as we worked our way through dangers and lost trails. Thousand died, thousand left, leaving only us to carry on. I can’t believe that Emperor Yun would take us back down with a flick of his wrist. He’s beyond monstrous.”
Hei Ying nodded, never imagining one of the Four Pillars had such a freakish backer.
If this freak could move, the world would be his oyster.
Sparing one last long look at the snowy peak, Hei Ying sighed, “So many years, so many deaths. All but for a few words from an old man. This result, ha-ha-ha…”
“That’s more than enough. We now have a way to get revenge.”
Second prince shouted as he strutted towards the central area, “As the Yun clan’s ancestor, his prediction must be right. We finally found Danqing Shen and a way to regain our nation. Zhuo Fan, Luo clan, and the old third, you will all pay for stealing our land, ha-ha-ha…”
Second prince could practically see the glory of victory, and taste it. Hei Ying stared at him and followed in silence.
[Never mind. If revenge is all that’s driving him, let him have it. Maybe when he sits on the throne, it won’t be too late to tell him.]
[Maybe he’ll thank the Crown Prince then for this revenge…]
That was how these two loners walked forward to restore their nation.
Unaware as they left that Emperor Yun was still hovering in that black space, the doubt in his eyes only increasing.
“That’s odd. His goal is to get revenge on the Luo clan, Zhuo Fan and his third brother. But the Luo clan and his brother’s destiny are clear, only Zhuo Fan’s fate is unreadable. Can it be that he lives outside fate? That will make him a huge variable…”
Emperor Yun sighed and vanished, letting the darkness consume everything in this domain…
Two months later, Zhuo Fan’s team was back before their sect at long last. Xie Wuyue and the elders were waiting for ages.
“Ha-ha-ha, Wuyue, what a grand welcome I see!” Fiend Yang laughed, as if basking in their adoration.
Yet Xie Wuyue glared back instead. He flashed in his face and stomped.
Bam!
The resounding boom sent Fiend Yang flying like a cannonball. The ball of flesh sped through the air and smacked into a cliff, leaving a man-shaped hole in it.
The disciples ready to celebrate with their elders stood stock still.
[Did we do something wrong? Why is the Sect Leader so pissed?]
Giving them a glare, he was filled with bloodthirst watching the cliff tumble down.
Fiend Yang came out of the rubble, barking, “For god’s sake! Are you a Sect Leader or a lunatic? We’ve risked our lives in the Double Dragon Manorfor the sect’s glory and this how you repay me? What did I ever do to you?”
“You got the nerve to ask?”
Xie Wuyue snorted, “Two months ago you sent me a sending jade, telling me that you’ll be back in two months, not giving me any details as to what happened. You got some nerve, making me unable to sit still all this time. You damn fatso deserve more than just a light kick!”
The others chuckled.
[Ah, so that’s why, it’s because of the sending jade that Sect Leader is pissed. He should know what happened at the Double Dragon Gathering yet was kept in suspense all this time.]
Fiend Yang grinned, “Oh. Did I forget to mention it?”
“Bullshit, how can you forget something so big? Even if you forget to write your will, you can never forget this!” Xie Wuyue snorted, “Talk! Did we lose so much that we got last place in the lower-three sects? Is that why you didn’t say anything?”
Pff!
Yue Ling and the others giggled.
They couldn’t believe their Sect Leader had so little faith in them.
[He’s sure to get the shock of his life!]
The disciples snickered. Fiend Yang was also grinning, though he was still mincing words, “What do you think, Wuyue?”
“Think your ass! “
Xie Wuyue glared, then turned to Zhuo Fan. But the guy walked into the sect with some two girls.
Shouting for two laborers, Zhuo Fan pointed at the girls and said, “Settle them in.”
“Yes, Steward Zhuo!” The two bowed.
Zhuo Fan was yet to rule over the Demon Scheming Sect, but his word was law in the Labor Office, above even the elders’.
The laborers got down to following his orders despite there being a throng of elders and venerables around, even the Sect Leader on top.
Xie Wuyue was outraged, “Zhuo Fan, who said you can bring some foreign girls into the sect? That’s against the rules..”
“Just coming and going. Didn’t you agree to let him go after all the fighting?”
Fiend Yang held his shoulder and smiled, “Besides, the kid got most of the credit at Double Dragon Gathering. Letting him do whatever before leaving ain’t much.”
Xie Wuyue was now interested and turned to face him, “How… did it go?”
“What do you think?” Fiend Yang quirked an eyebrow, starting the posturing all over again.
Xie Wuyue’s face twitched and he clenched his fists as a scorching fire burned in his heart, a volcano ready to pop…

chapters.title: Chapter 727: Sect Celebration
chapters.content:
Chapter 727: Sect Celebration
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Xie Wuyue squinted and the anger in his eyes burned hotter, “Fatty Yang, better give me that explanation right now or so help me, I’ll make you suffer if you keep showing off, regardless of our friendship.”
“Easy, easy, I’ll tell you for sure, ha-ha-ha…”
Fiend Yang smiled and whispered in Xie Wuyue’s ear, “Actually, we…”
[What?!]
Xie Wuyue was bug-eyed, “Say that again!”
“Ha-ha-ha, I knew you’d make that face. No one would believe our ever cold Demon Scheming Sect Leader Xie lost his cool!”
Laughing it up, Fiend Yang turned to the oldies, shouting, “I’m saying that at the Double Dragon Gathering, we became the top middle-three sect and brought home ten thousand sacred stones!”
[Are you for real?]
The oldies were frozen in place, sporting a dumb and incredulous look as they looked at the disciples.
The Demon Scheming Sect was but a lower-three sect. How the hell did it get to being the top middle-three sect?
[This is insane!]
Venerable Shi, the leader of the inner sect’s oldies was just as stumped. Never in their wildest dreams would they have thought this time’s team would come back with any success.
Yet they didn’t feel like celebrating, feeling downcast instead.
The Double Dragon Gathering team was made of Elite Labor Office’s disciples. It had nothing to do with the inner sect. That meant the Labor Office would become more valuable and more important now.
He bet Xie Wuyue would soon use this credit to announce the Labor Office would receive all resources while his inner sect would crumble.
“Venerable Shi…” One elder spoke with worry.
Venerable Shi said nothing as his eyes flashed with a calculative glimmer. “No matter, there’s fortune in disaster. We still have to play along. However, I must say that Zhuo Fan is incredible. If he weren’t the Sect Leader’s man, I would actually admire him, ha-ha-ha… “
Glancing at the calm Zhuo Fan, Venerable Shi had a crafty smile.
The others looked lost.
[Why is Venerable Shi praising the enemy when the Sect Leader is about to throw the inner sect to the curb?]
Xie Wuyue was out of it for a couple of minutes after Fiend Yang’s news. When he came to at long last, he glared and smiled as he grabbed his fat arm, “Fatty Yang, is that true? You’re not fooling around, are you?”
“Who would joke about something so huge?”
Fiend Yang grinned as he cursed, “Besides, your bug-eyed look at our strong disciples isn’t becoming of a top middle-three sect.”
Fiend Yang came to the disciples and put on a smug look. As if they got so strong all because of his dedicated training.
Fiend Yin and Fiend Gui shook their heads. Kui Lang’s side stuck out their chests, of course, releasing their aura and pride.
The others’ faces twitched. They could not believe it as they watched the returned disciples with eyes as wide as saucers.
They didn’t look at it at first but now they saw it.
[Just how long has it been? These little guys’ strength is unrecognizable!]
Except for three in the 6th layer Radiant Stage, the other nine were in the Ethereal Stage!
[Just what the hell brought on this miracle?]
Venerable Qi and Bai were ecstatic. Four of those six were related to them.
Bai Lian and Qi Changlong were their grandchildren while Yue Ling and Kui Lang were their disciples. In one move, they had four extra Ethereal Stage experts under them. That was sure to make them look good as hell.
They were also qualified to work for his faction, consolidating their position.
The Labor Office’s oldies looked at these bright disciples with beaming smiles.
Only the inner sect faction stood there glum from envy and embarrassment.
This kind of credit never happened before, yet it didn’t have a damn thing to do with them.
What none noticed was a pair of eyes from Venerable Shi’s faction that never looked away from Gui Hu. It was Grand Elder.
[I was right in making you enter the Labor Office. You’re now far sharper than before…]
Grand Elder smiled in pride.
“Hold on, let’s all calm down first.”
As the crowd became noisier, Fiend Yang started shouting. Everyone settled down and spoke seriously, “People, our success at the Double Dragon Gathering, the great improvement of our disciples, are all due to one man. Labor Office’s steward, Zhuo Fan!”
Roar!
The oldies went wild again, looking at Zhuo Fan in veneration. Even the angry Xie Wuyue was now filled with joy.
He made the best move of his life when he got this kid to the sect.
For thousands of years and tens of Sect Leaders, finally, in his lifetime, the Demon Scheming Sect had become the head middle-three sect. This merit was monumental!
Even the ever cold Xie Wuyue started smiling.
“Although…”
In the middle of their excitement, Fiend Yang’s tune changed, “You should also know that desperate times call for desperate measures. These kids got to improve so much so fast through many deadly perils. Those that hadn’t succeeded, well, you can tell what happened to them…”
Ugh!
The rest now realized Fiend Yang’s words. To get these guys to grow up fast, Zhuo Fan used life and death to train them.
Brave the danger and one would become a worldly expert. Fail and you’d be nothing but bones on the road. But weren’t those casualties the babies of some oldies?
This hatred was falling right on Zhuo Fan.
Fiend Yang said this to show Zhuo Fan’s feats. Without him training the other disciples, they wouldn’t have gotten their flashy new rank. So he was also telling the oldies not to look for revenge.
[Your disciples died for the sect!]
However, while they got his meaning, some were still hit hard by the loss of their precious disciples.
Xie Wuyue turned heavy and said, “Before setting off, I had appointed Zhuo Fan as my representative, bearing my power. His word was my word. If you’re looking for revenge, blame me. I have said it already, Double Dragon Gathering is of grave importance to the sect, not a place where you can butt in to gain some perks. They deserved their fate. But since the success has been so amazing, I’ll be generous even to them for all their efforts.”
“Sect Leader is brilliant!” Fiend Yang shouted and clapped.
The oldies’ grief had now become a sacrifice to the sect, though all here knew even alive, those disciples couldn’t do a thing at the gathering.
Xie Wuyue said this to be fair. As for being generous, how could one be to a dead guy? That benefit would be given to their masters, no?
That is, a token to soothe their hard feelings.
The oldies were silent. Wasn’t it obvious for one to give his life to the sect? So they bowed in respect, “Sect Leader is brilliant!”
Zhuo Fan’s pesky troubles were now washed away by Fiend Yang’s timely intervention. It was the least he could do for Zhuo Fan.
He knew the grudges of demonic cultivators. Once he left the sect, he had no one to protect him from those oldie’s revenge.
So simmering down those flames of hatred before he left was perfect.
Zhuo Fan got his meaning but didn’t care. He only chuckled at Fiend Yang, as thanks for his efforts.
[Less trouble is always better…]
“We’ll be holding a sect celebration for having become a middle-three sect, even the top one! We’ll hold a feast for three days straight!”
Xie Wuyue saw that all was settled and got excited as he laughed. The rest cheered…

chapters.title: Chapter 728: Testing Dangers
chapters.content:
Chapter 728: Testing Dangers
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“I told you, when we fought the head of the nine sects, Ultimate Clarity Sect, there were many dangers. Besides the best talent in western lands, Wu Qingqiu, there was also that freak Ye Lin. Tch, that power was really scary. Even Zhuo Fan was tense. At that time I was the most in danger as I told them how to face such a monster…”
In the main hall, all the elders and venerables attended. Wine flowed freely in these three days and everyone had red faces and hazy looks. Except for the disciples who went on this trip, who were standing at the same table as them, the other disciples were feasting outside the main hall.
Fiend Yang finally got to make use of his winding and drawn-out silver tongue as he retold the events of Double Dragon Gathering. The others were amazed, “Hold on, Fiend Yang, you’ve said it five times already. But didn’t you always say that Steward Zhuo earned the greatest credit. Why does it sound like he didn’t do anything while all the glory was thanks to your brilliant leadership? Is that how you got to the top middle-three sect? And did Steward Zhuo really beat Ye Lin according to your plan?”
“Uhm… yep! Steward Zhuo has the greatest credit, but that is one of a fighter, while I paved their way to success outside the ring with my plans and cunning, ha-ha-ha… ” Fiend Yang’s eyes darted all over, still talking big.
The disciples snickered, but remained silent.
[Fiend Yang sure likes to brag. I must admit, he even got them all looking amazed by his speech.]
Among the avid listeners, some were highly skeptical.
[How come we never noticed Fiend Yang likes to blow his horn?]
So they looked to another, “Steward Zhuo, is what the fatso said true?”
Ugh!
Zhuo Fan turned to see Fiend Yang giving him signals galore while pleading and shaking his head. Zhuo Fan ignored his nonsense, “Sure is. Under Fiend Yang’s bright leadership, we finally earned our spot as top middle-three sect. We wouldn’t have made it half as far without him!”
The rest gave the fatty an incredulous look.
[This guy’s actually that good.]
[He actually got to conduct all the fights.]
Fiend Yang stuck out his chin in pride.
[I’m the real hero here!]
Only the disciples shook their heads and sighed. While the two girls sitting across from Zhuo Fan, were giggling to themselves.
They’ve seen shameless, but not to this level, showing off before the whole crowd.
But since Zhuo Fan didn’t care, the girls, outsiders, didn’t poke holes in the fatty’s theatrics…
“Did Elder Yuan return yet?” Zhuo Fan asked Kui Lang.
Ever since he came back three days ago, he couldn’t wait to find Elder Yuan to talk to him about the heart. He really needed an answer to his questions, because Chu Qingcheng was waiting for his response in the Mystical Heaven Sect.
Yet there was no sign of Elder Yuan around. Some laborers said he’s out on sect business. He’d be back in months or maybe years.
Zhuo Fan shook his head.
[Years?]
He could only wait for a couple of months. If he didn’t get an answer, he couldn’t give her a reply.
He didn’t know if Elder Yuan would even answer him, but he was the only one he knew that could.
Cupping his hands, Kui Lang spoke, “Steward Zhuo, I just heard that Elder Yuan still isn’t back.”
“It’s fine. While I wait for Elder Yuan, I’ll have a talk with Xie Wuyue.” Zhuo Fan sighed and walked out.
Seeing him leave, they knew he was going to the Sect Leader for his freedom.
They all sighed.
Only the girls were cheerful, eager to have Zhuo Fan back. Yongning was crafty in this, now she would take the credit before Luo Yunchang that she got Zhuo Fan home.
[We’ll see if Miss Luo will be able to compete with me, he-he-he…]
Knock~
Zhuo Fan went to Sect Leader’s home and saw Xie Wuyue smiling. He looked at the green storage ring with a lost gaze, sometimes chuckling. He woke up when he heard the knocking.
Xie Wuyue was startled to see Zhuo Fan outside his door and frowned, “Zhuo Fan, you’ve done great in the Double Dragon Gathering. What are you doing here instead of celebrating?”
“Visiting a miser.”
He took a seat before him like he owned the place and Zhuo Fan pointed at the ring, “Ten thousand sacred stones has you looking so dumb?”
Xie Wuyue was ticked off, “Just ten thousand? Ha-ha-ha, you’re talking as if you got more, just two thousand!”
“You heard that?”
“Fiend Yang likes to talk too much so I had Fiend Yin report instead.” Xie Wuyue sighed and nodded, “You’re really something kid, to get even the Exalted to look at you, even making a special rank just for you and getting two thousand sacred stones. Even if I don’t officially make you the next Sect Leader successor, the entire sect would not sit still until they know it’s you who will be sitting in my chair!”
Xie Wuyue stared hard at Zhuo Fan, but he had no reaction. “Xie Wuyue, we talked about this. After the Double Dragon Gathering, our deal is done.”
“Going home?”
Xie Wuyue’s brow shook, his heart unsettled as he showed a sneaky smile, “To what, the Luo clan? You mean to tell me Demon Scheming Sect can’t compare to a measly mortal clan? Ha-ha-ha, having come back with so much merit, you will be the next Sect Leader after me. With the sacred stones, in a century, we’ll become a true middle-three sect.
“A tiny mortal clan would mean even less then. You will be king here. Now you’re telling me being stuck as a butler for the Luo clan is way better?”
Zhuo Fan gave him a long look, “Where I like to go, is my business. No one can change that. You better not break your word, Sect Leader Xie!”
Xie Wuyue said nothing, but his sharp eyes stabbed into him like daggers.
But then he shrugged, “Actually, letting you stay was thinking of your future. After being on Double Dragon Manor’s list, you’d be going even higher. You might even be at the top of the western lands. But since you’re set on leaving, I won’t stop you.”
Xie Wuyue waved him off, looking disappointed as he sighed, “People always work to better themselves. Yet I never saw someone so complacent like you. Zhuo Fan, you’ll be sure to regret it.”
“That’s none of your concern.” Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes and walked out.
Just as he left, Xie Wuyue muttered to himself, “Ha-ha-ha, he left at last. The sect isn’t big enough for the both of us. Sigh, Zhuo Fan if you had shown the slightest interest in my position, I…”
Xie Wuyue’s eyes flashed with bloodthirst…
Back at the feast, Zhuo Fan looked at the girls, “Get ready, we’ll leave right after the feast.”
“So soon?” Kui Lang and the others were stunned.
Zhuo Fan nodded. Xie Wuyue was good at covering up his intent, but he was more than familiar with that kind of baiting.
He was paying attention to every last word Xie Wuyue said and every meaning they had told him to leave, to not aim for the Sect Leader’s position.
He believed that if he showed the slightest interest in the chair, Xie Wuyue would’ve went for the kill.
He didn’t know Xie Wuyue’s cultivation and since this was the Demon Scheming Sect, Xie Wuyue ruled. Once a fight broke out, Zhuo Fan was at a disadvantage.
So he honored his own word and left. As for Elder Yuan…
Zhuo Fan frowned, “Kui Lang, though I’m leaving and no longer of the Demon Scheming Sect, I hope you can do something for me.”
“Just say the word, Steward Zhuo!” Kui Lang cupped his hands.
“When Elder Yuan returns, stall him then send me a jade slip. I’ll be here before you know it.”
“No problem, Steward Zhuo!” Kui Lang nodded.
Zhuo Fan stood up and left with the girls. But just then, a laborer rushed into the main hall.
“Halt, this is the elders’ feast. Disciples can’t enter!” One attendant barred his way.
The guy shouted, “I’ve come to give a message to Steward Zhuo. Elder Yuan is back.”
Zhuo Fan shook and frowned, then he brightened up.
[Just in time…]

chapters.title: Chapter 729: Advice
chapters.content:
Chapter 729: Advice
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Elder Yuan…”
Shouts were heard in the rundown area of the Labor Office as Zhuo Fan rushed to a shabby door. The door opened with a creak as a familiar figure greeted him.
Elder Yuan sighed and patted his chest, “Oh, so it’s Steward Zhuo. What’s got you so anxious? You’re scaring this old man. I thought I missed giving out Wang Erma’s pill. It’s not that I didn’t want to give him, but he did a poor job on his errands and the executive punished him…”
“Elder Yuan!” Zhuo Fan cut him off and rolled his eyes.
Elder Yuan scratched his head, “Oh, right, Steward Zhuo is a man of ambition and has no time for trifles. Oh, I almost forgot, I heard that Steward Zhuo earned great credit in the Double Dragon Gathering. You should be out there celebrating and not run here…”
“Elder Yuan, I’m leaving.” Zhuo Fan interrupted him off again.
Startled, Elder Yuan said, “Leaving? Where?”
“Home.” Zhuo Fan sighed, “I already talked with Xie Wuyue. I have done my part and the Demon Scheming Sect is now a middle-three sect. He also let me go.”
“Is that so?”
Elder Yuan closed his eyes and sighed in disappointment.
[He still…]
“Elder Yuan, I hoped to say my goodbye to you before I leave. You are the only one I respect in this sect, and the only one that understands me.”
Zhuo Fan looked at Elder Yuan’s dark face and sighed, “Also, I wanted to ask you an important question. I fear that only you can give me a good answer.”
Elder Yuan opened his eyes and smiled. He was no longer sad and was back to his kind self, “Tell me then. If I can help Steward Zhuo, then it’s my honor.”
“Elder Yuan is too nice.”
Zhuo Fan bowed slightly, and was a bit tense as he began, “Elder Yuan, can… demonic cultivators know love?”
Elder Yuan was stumped for a second. “B
y love… you mean, familial, friendship, or… “
“The last one…” Zhuo Fan blushed.
Elder Yuan shook his head, “A love between a man and a woman is of course not possible. It’s very dangerous. Why else do you think the Demon Scheming Sect forbids it? “
“I see.”
Zhuo Fan felt disappointed and sighed. But then hope rekindled in his eyes, “But someone said that how can you be emotionless if you never knew emotion? You must feel it before you can squash it.”
“Who told you that?”
“Danqing Shen.”
“Ha-ha-ha, so it was him.” Elder Yuan shook his head, “He is the best in western lands, but he is a righteous cultivator, unable to comprehend our demonic heart.”
Zhuo Fan’s heart sank because Elder Yuan had clearly shot down this theory. It would seem that his final answer to Chu Qingcheng would be a negative one.
But the old man laughed before he got too disappointed, “The expert was right though. No wonder he is the best in western lands. He’s gone far.”
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched. After being thrown in despair, he was brought back up.
“Elder Yuan, can you not toy with me? I’m serious here!”
“Ha-ha-ha, but I’m not. It’s you who toys with yourself. Since you already have your answer within you, why ask me?”
Elder Yuan teased, “Steward Zhuo, do you want me to say that there’s no harm to your demonic path by feeling love?”
Zhuo Fan tensed and bowed, “Elder Yuan is wise. My heart is treacherous and I ask Elder Yuan to be the judge. An outside perspective sees much more. If this love will harm my path, then I…”
“Will squash it?” Elder Yuan’s mocked.
Zhuo Fan hesitated but nodded.
Elder Yuan sighed, “If some youngster came at me with this question, I’d have answered on the spot, that love is taboo for demonic cultivators. Touching it will mean endless pain and torture from which one can’t escape. The demonic path is cruel and emotionless and any feelings are its bane. But to you, Steward Zhuo, I offer you one piece of advice. Let yourself go and accept it.”
“Why?” Zhuo Fan was stunned.
Elder Yuan shook his head, “Because you’re already caught in its grip. Instead of breaking it, take it all if you don’t want to have a heart demon.”
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook in shock.
“Do you know why we, demonic cultivators, warn never to feel love?” Elder Yuan asked Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, lost.
“Ha-ha-ha, I don’t know either. But after years of pondering, I think I have an inkling. It’s not that demonic cultivators can’t feel love, but it’s better reserved for those advanced players to tackle.”
“Eh?”
Zhuo Fan was stumped.
Elder Yuan continued, “At the birth of the world, the righteous and demonic paths came to be. As the human heart has desire, it leads to two different ways to cultivate. The righteous path abolishes desire, to be one with the world, unshackled by any greed. While the demonic path is the opposite, experiencing endless desire through which to break the mortal coil and reach the Dao. In other words, righteous means to be above everything, while demonic implies sinking into it. This shows that the paths are neither good nor evil, but once you enter them, it’s easy for desires to be born and end up at their mercy. This is a demon. By overcoming it, you reach Dao.”
“So the demonic path means passing through the demon state to reach Dao. What we want to do in the end is to attain Dao. Because it’s easy to be constantly tempted along our cultivation journey, we end up being demonic and earn such a bad name. But all those that achieved success in the demonic path are not demons, and certainly won’t be like those Four Scheming Demons, pillaging and killing at a whim. Because they had gone beyond in their path and have come closer to Dao.”
Zhuo Fan nodded as he understood it.
He used to think the demonic path implied selfishness, but now he saw it was just prejudice. By becoming a demon and rising above greed could one reach the Dao. Zhuo Fan finally saw the path wide open before him.
“As for love, it’s nothing by itself, but it’s the most tempting desire from which escape is nigh impossible. Many demonic cultivators have been unable to distinguish love from desire and sink further and further, moving away from the Dao. That is why demonic cultivators are so ruthless when it comes to love, not getting anywhere near it. This is because it’s hard for anyone to come back from it. To righteous cultivators, this is easier. They walk the path of abandoning all desire, neutralizing the desire and keeping them safe.”
Elder Yuan continued, “But you must understand, nothing ventured, nothing gained. The world is cruel but also fair. The demonic path is filled with more pain than the righteous path, so when all these trials are overcome, the demonic cultivator would attain a higher level than a righteous cultivator. “
Zhuo Fan nodded, “In other words, love isn’t scary, as long as I don’t let it take me.”
“Ha-ha-ha, that’s besides the point right now, since you’re already in it.”
Elder Yuan pointed at his heart. “Do you know what a demonic cultivator’s greatest heart demon is? Regret. Since you’re already taken by love, if you don’t settle it, it will turn into regret and will be much worse. As to how you are to escape the maelstrom of love, that will be up to you alone. That’s why I said that it is for advanced players only. A child has no place toying with it. But I believe you’re the exception. I hope that even if you are taken over by love, you will be able to see your path, and not be like Danqing Shen, almost collapsing because of it, consumed by revenge. Though he’s also amazing, getting back on his path in the end, ha-ha-ha…”
Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan nodded and bowed, “Thank you for everything, Elder Yuan. I know what to do now. I can finally give her an answer. I feel so much better.”
“Ha-ha-ha, I’m only speaking what your heart tells you. It might not be the truth. While there’s a demonic and righteous path, the world has thousands of other trails. Who is to say that yours is the right one? That’s why it’s all up to you to do what you feel is right.”
Elder Yuan spoke heavily, “Steward Zhuo, your heart already had an answer but was conflicted under the traditional beliefs. That’s why you came to me. But the closer you are to Dao, the fewer people there are understanding it. There will come a time when no one can explain it to you. You will only have yourself to believe in. My past experiences might not be the right path. You will know it when you walk your own road.”
Starled, Zhuo Fan bowed again and said, “I will take it to heart.”
Zhuo Fan left afterward. His next goal was Mystical Heaven Sect.
Seeing his light steps, Elder Yuan nodded and sighed, “The child has his own road, but why do you keep losing yours, Wuyue…”

chapters.title: Chapter 730: Help
chapters.content:
Chapter 730: Help
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Master, is it really impossible?”
“Damn miscreant, have you already forgotten that pain? Didn’t that girl hurt you enough? No matter how much merit you’ve done for the sect, rules are rules. Sect Leader won’t budge in this matter, so just give it a rest. And don’t even think about going to him with this, or you’ll only make it worse. That time, even I can’t save you!”
Zhuo Fan’s heart was free, unshackled and light. He felt so carefree as he walked, eager to get to the Mystical Heaven Sect. But then his ear picked up two familiar voices that caught his attention, Venerable Qi and Kui Lang.
Even puzzled, Zhuo Fan would hardly ever butt in someone’s problems, but today he was in such a good mood, he walked right over. “What’s wrong? Why are master and disciple arguing?”
“Oh, Steward Zhuo!”
Kui Lang immediately bowed and Venerable Qi nodded in respect, “This brat only knows how to cause trouble. He got a bit of merit and it got to his head. He even forgot the last transgression that got him kicked into the Labor Office.”
Kui Lang looked ashamed and lowered his head. Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow. “Just what happened? Can I hear it?”
Kui Lang hesitated before giving Zhuo Fan a glance, “Steward Zhuo, you know already. It’s my girl…”
“Oh, because of you she’s been detained in the Mystical Heaven Sect? That’s why Xuan Shaoyu threatened you in the Double Dragon Gathering…” Zhuo Fan exclaimed.
Venerable Qi’s eyelid twitched and he glared at Kui Lang, “You actually gave up for an enemy in the Double Dragon Gathering? This is absurd! If the Sect Leader finds out, you’d be lucky to keep your life! Sigh, damn vixens…”
Venerable Qi stomped in anger. Zhuo Fan waved his hand with a smile. “Venerable Qi, there’s no need for anger. Only the three of us know this. Besides, I’m also about to leave anyway.”
“Thank you so much, Steward Zhuo!” Venerable Qi gave a deep bow then glared at Kui Lang, making him feel even more guilty.
However, he still clung to one last thread of hope. “Didn’t we earn a great merit? Sect Leader is cheerful as well. I think using this chance to ask him to use the Demon Scheming Sect’s glorious name to ask the Mystical Heaven Sect to get my girl back…”
“Bullshit!”
Venerable Qi snapped, “The Demon Scheming Sect is against fraternizing. And you even expect he’d lower himself to the Mystical Heaven Sect for a mere disciple like you? We’d be lucky if the Mystical Heaven Sect wouldn’t take advantage of our weakness and just let her go. But even so, our sect would have lost its name because of it!”
Venerable Qi’s torrent of words smashed into Kui Lang’s ears, causing him to lose hope. And yet, he still looked at Zhuo Fan with a fixed gaze.
His master couldn’t help him, so now it was up to Zhuo Fan if he was willing to pass it on to the Sect Leader.
Even if a mere disciple, Zhuo Fan was the Sect Leader’s confidante. Having gotten such a glorious win at the Double Dragon Gathering, putting the sect in the top middle-three sects, the Sect Leader might hear him out when not even elders or venerables could get his ear.
Zhuo Fan frowned, rubbing his chin, “Your master’s right. Let it go, or you’ll only make it worse. Xie Wuyue doesn’t care about anyone. He won’t help you at all, in fact, he would fly into a rage and punish you. You’re better off not mentioning it. “
Venerable Qi nodded like it was obvious, glaring at his disciple.
[See that, even Steward Zhuo said it.]
Kui Lang’s face fell in despair…
“Although…”
Zhuo Fan switched topics with a crafty smile, “Getting someone out isn’t necessarily done using the sect’s name. I’m just about to go to Mystical Heaven Sect and fetch someone. You can just come along.”
Ugh!
The two gave him dumb looks. Then Venerable Qi gasped, “Steward Zhuo…”
“Ha-ha-ha, if I won’t do it, who else will?”
Zhuo Fan smiled as he looked above, “I’ve been absorbed with the demonic path for years and have discovered many truths. That should make me a somewhat advanced player. No matter how deep you sink into the sea of desire, I shall not fear, ha-ha-ha…”
The two looked lost at him.
Zhuo Fan turned to Kui Lang and said, “What are you staring at? Come on, Mystical Heaven Sect had been a lower-three sect for all these years and shouldn’t have many sacred stones. I’ll use the two thousand on me to smash their face in and get those girls. One for you and one for me.”
Zhuo Fan started walking towards the gate. Kui Lang came out of it at some point and rushed after him, “Steward Zhuo, y-you’re really going to give your sacred stones for my girl?”
“Of course. Sacred stones are just invaluable things compared to people.”
“S-Steward Zhuo, you’re truly kind. I’ll never forget this for as long as I live. No matter what happens, I will do anything you ask…”
“Lighten up. We’re just two guys bearing the same trouble. Though, there may be a use of you yet. Who knows, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan and Kui Lang chuckled in the distance, leaving Venerable Qi dumbstruck.
[Two thousand sacred stones over two girls? T-this is such a waste!]
Their sect had at most one thousand of those glittering baubles that had to last the sect for centuries. Yet now, this Steward Zhuo was going to squander twice that on some broads…
Venerable Qi looked ahead as his face twitched and heart bled.
[No matter how loaded you are, you can’t just throw it all away!]
[Sigh, how can a nouveau riche understand the pain of poverty?]
Venerable Qi shook his head, unable to make sense of Zhuo Fan’s actions, but also envious and admired him.
Zhuo Fan was spending so much for his girl and was going to do the same for Kui Lang. Such a nice boss was a rarity in this world.
[It’s Kui Lang’s fortune to land such a boss.]
While theirs, Xie Wuyue, was stingy to the core, fighting for every scrap.
He had no idea, though, that those two thousand rocks were a drop in a bucket for Zhuo Fan while a life fortune to Xie Wuyue.
Putting them side by side, one could see how one spent…
“Zhuo Fan, can we go now?”
At the Demon Scheming Sect’s entrance, Shuang’er and Yongning were waiting for him. Yongning asked, “Brother Kui Lang, you’re coming along?”
Kui Lang had a bright smile, but it was Zhuo Fan who said, “No, he will only accompany us to Mystical Heaven Sect.”
“Mystical Heaven Sect?”
“We’re going to get Qingcheng and then go home together.” Zhuo Fan had a wide smile on his face.
The girls’ hearts skipped a beat, but then smiled. Shuang’er found Zhuo Fan’s look even more enchanting. “No wonder I found your attitude off. You’re no longer as depressed as before. So you have your answer for sister Qingcheng!”
“I’ve dragged out this question for far too long…” Zhuo Fan sighed.
The girls nodded, finally able to rest their intentions and be happy for him.
The four were now on the road to Mystical Heaven Sect. Since Zhuo Fan said he’d answer Chu Qingcheng half a year later, they were in no rush. In fact, Zhuo Fan was actually dragging his feet, as if nervous.
This question had been on hold for almost a decade. How would he answer? How would she react?
[How would I react?]
These were all pressing questions to Zhuo Fan.
Suddenly, Zhuo Fan felt as if he was like a tense bride before her wedding.
The girls giggled.
[The high and mighty Steward Zhuo balks when it comes to talking about relationships.]
The team had gone like this for a month yet they were only a third of the way to Mystical Heaven Sect.
Even Shuang’er was starting to dislike this and pouted, “We’re not here to sightsee. If we go any slower, you’ll miss your due date with sister Qingcheng.”
“Really?” Zhuo Fan let out a dry laugh, “But how am I to answer her? All these years I’ve been so cold…”
Whoosh!
A red figure came smashing down a hundred meters from them, kicking up a cloud of dust.
The group was stunned to see Mystical Heaven Sect’s Dan’er, Chu Qingcheng’s junior sister.
As he was going to Chu Qingcheng, Zhuo Fan had to mind her junior sister, no? So he rushed over to help her up. “Dan’er, what’s wrong? What happened?”
“Z-Zhuo Fan?”
Dan’er looked in joy then said, “Y-you have to save sister Qingcheng…”

chapters.title: Chapter 731: Qingcheng’s Danger
chapters.content:
Chapter 731: Qingcheng’s Danger
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“What happened to Qingcheng?” Zhuo Fan hurriedly shook Dan’er’s frail body.
Panting, Dan’er teared up, “And sister Ruohua, Qing’er, they… they…”
Zhuo Fan hardened, “I don’t care about them. Tell me now, what happened to Qingcheng?”
Zhuo Fan was sweating as he stared down Dan’er until she was scared.
“Steward Zhuo, let her speak. You’re scaring the poor child…” Kui Lang spoke and said to Dan’er, “Little girl, tell us what happened. We’ll definitely help.”
Dan’er looked at them and finally said, “S-Sect Leader wanted us five sisters to cure the young master’s illness.”
“What?” Zhuo Fan’s face fell and gnashed his teeth. “I knew the punk was born a cripple with lacking elements, but now I see even his brain is screwed on wrong. He dares to touch my girl…”
Sensing the seething hatred seeping from Zhuo Fan, Dan’er was in shock from fear. Yet for some reason, his towering bloodthirst gave her a sense of safety.
Kui Lang patted Zhuo Fan’s shoulder to cool him down. “Just what happened exactly? Please tell us everything so we can save them.”
“Well…”
Double Dragon Gathering nodded and began, “After the Double Dragon Gathering, we got back to the sect. The day barely ended and some elders came to us in the dead of night to seal some of my sisters’ cultivation then put them in a room with the Sect Leader and the young master. That was when we knew that the Four Elements Cycle Array was all to heal the young master’s illness for lacking elements.
“The only reason we went to Double Dragon Gathering was to test the limits of the Four Elements Cycle Array, whether it fit the bill. Only in a life and death battle would the power of this array be brought out. The elder found it eligible so they took our sisters to cure the young master.”
Shuang’er hurriedly asked, “Cure how?”
“The Four Elements Cycle Array relies on maidens with elemental constitutions to draw out their power and purify the young master’s body to rebuild his elemental balance. Finally…”
Dan’er blushed as she spoke in a lower tone, “Using a maiden’s blood to draw out the five elements and completely cure the young master.”
Bam!
Zhuo Fan’s hand pulverized a rock nearby, “In other words, the perverted young master wants Qingcheng’s body?”
“Not just that…”
Wiping her tears, Dan’er sobbed, “It would be fine if it were just curing young master since we were dedicated to this and we’ve also seen young master grow up. Bearing some sacrifices to save him was acceptable to us, but I never thought…”
“What?” They all asked.
Dan’er’s sobbing grew louder, “Young master actually sucked out all of sister Qing’er’s spirit and soul. He was so scary. Qing’er became a dried husk and even Sect Leader looked shocked…”
“This is a demonic art of stealing yin to further yang. The punk has turned demonic.”
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, his teeth clenched, “I fear that ever since that little town he’s been like this, ever since Yan Mo drew him to the demonic path. But Yan Mo is a demonic cultivator and he’s used in this matter. Unlike Xuan Shaoyu, who has no restraint being so new to it all.”
“So that’s why. It’s all Yan Mo’s fault…”
“Shut it!”
Seeing Dan’er sobbing, Zhuo Fan glared at her. “The righteous path means to be above everything, to be an ascetic. One shouldn’t fall prey to the demonic nature so easily. Yet desire has taken hold of his heart and it was just a matter of time before he fell. Yan Mo was only a trigger. It was his twisted heart who was tested in the end, and it was found lacking. Now whose fault was it?”
Dan’er’s heart shook and closed her eyes in silence.
Zhuo Fan frowned and sighed, “How are the girls? And how did you get out?”
“Sister Qingcheng seemed to have seen this coming and was prepared. She held a poison pill in her mouth. The moment they force her, she would take it. She said she had an agreement with you six months later. If you weren’t there after this time, she would do what the Sect Leader asked. If you arrived and gave her an answer, she would be able to rest in peace. And she’s also protecting the others.”
Dan’er sobbed, “Then we had our cultivation sealed, but we could still move. SIster Qingcheng seemed prepared since one day she took us to the Permafrost Cave. There was senior sister Han Qianying in a wall there and she broke through it to unseal our cultivation. We killed our way out afterward, but the elders blocked us. Only I managed to escape while the others got caught…”
“What, Qianying?!” Kui Lang cried out.
Dan’er looked at him and nodded. “Sect Leader Qianying was the previous wielder of Permafrost. She should’ve been one of the girls in the Four Elements Cycle Array, but after hearing of her sect rule violation two decades ago, for colluding with demonic cultivators, she was cast out. Why else would the sect throw away such a rare water constitution like hers? In the end, the Sect Leader had looked high and low for a replacement, thus coming with sister Qingcheng.”
“Qianying…” Kui Lang’s eyebrow shook, “How is she?”
Dan’er shook her head, “I don’t know. After I got away, they were caught. But I believe sister Qianying knew what was going on so that must be why sister Qingcheng was prepared. After all, sister Qingcheng had been in contact with sister Qianying ever since she came to the sect and inherited Permafrost.”
Closing his eyes, Kui Lang shook all over, gnashing his teeth and showing his deep worry.
Pa!
Zhuo Fan slammed his heavy hand on his shoulder. Kui Lang started and looked at Zhuo Fan’s dark and scary face.
“Is Han Qianying your girl?”
Zhuo Fan squinted, “Don’t worry, Qingcheng is smart. Since she can save one person, she can save many. In any case, without your girl, I would now probably be late to the rescue. I alone have no chance of getting two girls out. But now, since there’s still time before the appointment, it’s enough to send a team in and take down Mystical Heaven Sect! “
Kui Lang shuddered and looked at Zhuo Fan in amazement. Dan’er was also shaken up.
Mystical Heaven Sect was one of the nine sects in western lands. While conflicts between them existed, an all out war was out of the question, not when it would draw Double Dragon Manor’s attention.
No one was about to take such a blame!
Yet Zhuo Fan, in a fit of anger, didn’t care about these things. Even if the consequences would be dire, that would be then. If he did not do this, he would regret it for as long as he lived.
Zhuo Fan was seeping with bloodthirst, shocking everyone around him. Dan’er was even more dazzled by his aura.
[This guy’s insane, but also a mover and a shaker…]
Whoosh!
Two elderly in white flashed before the group, in the 4th layer of Ethereal Stage.
“I-it’s Elder Li and Elder Chang!” Dan’er cried out in fear.
The elders showed mocking smiles. Seeing Kui Lang was the strongest at 2nd layer of Ethereal Stage, they thought they were easy pickings.
“Dan’er, you dumb girl, did you really think you could escape Mystical Heaven Sect?”
Bam!
One elder looked at her with contempt, yet he did not finish as the sky was filled with blood. Gone was his presence, as was his irritating voice.
In his place was a huge scarlet dragon, Zhuo Fan’s Almighty Scarlet Dragon King. Its sharp claw clenched the tenderized flesh, spreading the bloody smell as it squirted what blood it had left.
On that dragon was Zhuo Fan and his cold, dead eyes.
In a singular strike he wiped a 4th layer Ethereal Stage expert off the face of this world, destroyed in body and soul. The other elder was close to having a mental breakdown.
Dan’er was standing there in shock at Zhuo Fan’s action.
She knew Zhuo Fan was strong but she didn’t think he would let anger take him to the point he would not let the others even speak.
It only showed how much Chu Qingcheng’s plight grated on his nerves.
“Heaven dragon soul, Almighty Scarlet Dragon King?”
The elder looked on in shock, shaking all over, “Y-you’re the one young master talked about. The freak at the Double Dragon Gathering, Demon Scheming Sect’s Zhuo Fan!”
Smirking, Zhuo Fan mocked, “Right in one guess, though I have no prize for you.”
Bam!
With another loud noise, the Almighty Scarlet Dragon King’s other claw slammed down, crushing him before he even got a chance to wail. His guts and everything sprayed all over the place…

chapters.title: Chapter 732: Charisma
chapters.content:
Chapter 732: Charisma
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Whoosh~
With the two pursuing Mystical Heaven Sect elders dealt with, Zhuo Fan took back his soul and used a sacred stone to set up an instant concealing array around the group.
Hum~
In a blink, all of them vanished from sight.
“You guys wait here and don’t move. I’m going back to the sect for help.” Zhuo Fan gave them a quick look then left.
Kui Lang suddenly said, “Steward Zhuo, Sect Leader will never agree to go to war with Mystical Heaven Sect!”
“It’s of no consequence. I will bring our people.” Squinting, his eyes flashed. Zhuo Fan’s heart had a plan in motion as he flew for the Demon Scheming Sect, “Kui Lang, I’ll leave the girls in your care!”
“Don’t worry, Steward Zhuo, I will do my duty!” Kui Lang cupped his hands, sighing inside.
[Steward Zhuo, please find a way to get Miss Chu and my girl. It’s all up to you now…]
Whoosh~
Half a month later, Zhuo Fan was back in Demon Scheming Sect. With a sign, the space warped to show an entrance.
“Halt! Who goes there?”
One disciple popped before Zhuo Fan, but upon recognition, he jerked back and apologized, “Ah, Steward Zhuo is back. Forgive my rudeness.”
“It’s fine.” Zhuo Fan waved him off.
The disciple scratched his head. “Thank you Steward Zhuo. That brat kept saying Steward Zhuo has left the sect and won’t be coming back. It made me so sad these past two weeks. Aren’t you back now? Ha-ha-ha…”
“You really missed me?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow.
The disciple instantly nodded, “Of course, it’s all thanks to Steward Zhuo that we, laborers, no longer live as cattle. You brought us hope for tomorrow. Although now it’s different and I don’t have the strength to enter Steward Zhuo’s Elite Labor Office, at the very least I have a future now. I will definitely join next year, ha-ha-ha…”
“Good for you!”
Zhuo Fan patted his shoulder with a smile. “How many others share your thoughts?”
Startled, the disciple was still honest, “Steward Zhuo, all of the Labor Office is immensely grateful for all that you’ve done for us. All those inner and outer disciples that entered Elite Labor have gained a lot from it. I believe that most disciples and elders hold Steward Zhuo in favor for doing so much for the sect.”
“There’s still some left?”
“They’re likely inner sect elders’ trustees. They must be hating your guts, ha-ha-ha…”
The two burst out laughing.
Zhuo Fan nodded and turned serious, “Then, how many of you are willing to help me with something?”
“Steward Zhuo, you need but say it and we’ll brave any dangers!” The guy cupped his hands.
“Good. Is Sect Leader around?” Zhuo Fan nodded and plotted as he walked for the inner sect.
“Ha-ha-ha, Steward Zhuo, this is because of your feats.”
The guy sighed. “Sect Leader has been very busy lately and has no time to stay at the sect. Ever since you shone at the Double Dragon Gathering, many empires want to throw their lot with us. They even want us to move in with them, something only the superior-three sects can do. Sect Leader has been so happy these days, always moving from one empire to another for talks.”
Zhuo Fan shook and turned his head back with a devious smile, “So Sect Leader isn’t home?”
“Uh, that is the case.” The disciple gave a numb nod.
Grinning wider, Zhuo Fan laughed, “Perfect, this makes it easier.”
Zhuo Fan strutted forward for the inner gate, leaving the disciple scratching his head.
[Steward Zhuo is acting strange…]
Dang~
A bell toll was heard throughout the sect. All elders and venerables jerked at the sound, rushing for the Main Hall.
“For god’s sake, who the hell is the fool to mess with the bell and call for a meeting? The Double Dragon Gathering is over and it’s only been two days since last time. What’s so important this time?” One elder grumbled as he dragged himself over to the hall.
A venerable came to him and mocked, “Are you stupid? The Sect Leader isn’t around. Only the High Venerable has the right to toll. But he has always been a simple man and never used the bell. Though there is one with the nerve to do it…”
“Venerable Shi?” The elder’s mouth twitched, “Their inner faction had been losing all the time. We, from the Elite Labor, are twice as many as them. Yet he still has the never to make a fuss? Is he after a power play now that Sect Leader isn’t here?”
The venerable shrugged, “Who knows. Ha-ha-ha, one thing’s for sure, he doesn’t have the strength.”
All oldies were going towards the Main Hall filled with doubt.
Venerable Shi frowned in his home. Next to him was his prized disciple, Lu Xie.
“Lu Xie, did you make contact with him?” Venerable Shi muttered.
Lu Xie spoke in earnest, “Master, they have all agreed and await something to happen here.”
“What can happen when they all run off?”
Venerable Shi mocked, “It looks like there are still people out there unconcerned by fame and fortune, shirking off their merits. Zhuo Fan, that’s mighty noble of you, leaving after your big win. Do you not care about your career? Or is it that you sensed the danger around you and made the logical choice?”
Venerable Shi’s eyes shone as he sighed. He had been waiting for the moment to act for so long it made him depressed.
Lu Xie was also helpless.
[Zhuo Fan has always been unexpected and unpredictable…]
Dang~
The clear sound of a bell echoed out in the courtyard. Venerable Shi raised an eyebrow and looked at the inner sect with a frown, “That twerp Xie Wuyue isn’t home, so who’d dare toll the Main Hall’s bell instead of me?”
Venerable Shi’s eyes shone. “Maybe this is the chance we’ve all been waiting for!”
The two rushed over.
In the Main Hall there was now a sea of people. All elders and venerables had gathered, all looking stumped at the man in center.
[He tolled the bell!]
“Elders and venerables of Demon Scheming Sect, have all of you come?” Zhuo Fan looked at them with a cold eye.
Ugh!
They all started, with Venerable Bai looking at Zhuo Fan curiously, “Steward Zhuo, what is this? Only the Sect Leader and High Venerable can toll the inner sect bell. Though they had been some using it without permission in the past, you’re still a disciple. If you need us to do something, you could have just asked and not made a scene.”
“He-he, Venerable Bai, who are you talking about here?”
One elder of Venerable Shi’s faction barked, “High Venerable hardly interferes in sect matters and goes where he wants. For Venerable Shi to come forward is only natural. What’s wrong in him tolling the bell?”
“Isn’t it above his status still? What’s hard to understand, he schemes for power.” Venerable Bai mocked.
The other elder was enraged. Zhuo Fan held out a bright badge, with Xie written on it, “Is this authority enough?”
[Sect Leader’s badge?]
The oldies shook and bowed, “Greetings, Sect Leader!”
Zhuo Fan was akin to Xie Wuyue holding that badge.
Since Xie Wuyue wasn’t home, it left Zhuo Fan room to weasel in. “Elders and venerables of the Demon Scheming Sect must obey Sect Leader’s orders!”
They all bowed and none dared refute him.
Zhuo Fan shouted, “Demon Scheming Sect’s elders and venerables will now listen to my commands, or they will be punished by sect rules!”
“Yes, sir!” The crowd bowed again.
“The entire sect is to come with me to Mystical Heaven Sect!”
[What?!]
They all looked at him in shock. He wanted everyone to go to Mystical Heaven Sect? What for? That would leave their sect empty and would cause god knew what by going into another sect’s turf.
Everyone was hesitating.
[Is this Sect Leader’s true intention?]
Even Venerable Qi and Bai, people on Zhuo Fan’s side, were looking lost.
Only one person looked joyfully at Zhuo Fan on the highest chair, Venerable Shi.
[He-he-he, Zhuo Fan, you’re back at last. The bigger the noise you make, the better!]
[Allow this old man to lend you a hand as well.]
Venerable Shi grinned like a winner…

chapters.title: Chapter 733: All the King’s Men
chapters.content:
Chapter 733: All the King’s Men
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“What’s going on here? Who tolled the bell?”
Acting like he just showed up, Venerable Shi looked tense as he walked in front.
Seeing his elders were also here, one came before him and pointed at Zhuo Fan, “Venerable Shi, Zhuo Fan holds the Sect Leader badge and rang the bell, convening this meeting. Now he wants everyone in the sect to march for Mystical Heaven Sect.”
“What?” Venerable Shi looked deeply at Zhuo Fan then at the badge.
Zhuo Fan gave him a cold look. He knew that Venerable Shi was the boss of the inner sect. Even though Xie Wuyue was the Sect Leader, he was still being contradicted in cases. Which made it even harder just by having his badge.
In this case, if he was blocked, he would just have to set Venerable Shi as an example for the rest of them.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed with bloodthirst while the oldies looked at his defiant gaze with mockery.
[You’re just a mere disciple with a bit of merit to your name. Even if you’re Sect Leader’s right hand, not even Sect Leader himself would be able to do what he wanted if Venerable Shi was against it.]
[Wanting to use some piece of wood to cower us? You don’t know the power of the inner sect by the looks of it!]
Venerable Qi and the others from the Labor Office watched while calculating gains and losses. If Zhuo Fan was going against Venerable Shi, they would side with him.
Although Zhuo Fan’s order was casual, it had deep implications and should be treated with care. But he had Sect Leader’s badge and was also Labor Office’s representative.
Be it in a vie for power in an empire or the clashes between sects, it always came down to following the one that adhered to their goals.
Zhuo Fan was the rock of the Labor Office. So no matter how ridiculous his request was, they would back him up. This was a fight for interests.
The hall was split in two groups on the spot, glaring at each other as they were on the brink of war, plunging the sect into a bitter fight.
However, Venerable Shi’s action left everyone shocked. Both factions stared at him in stupefaction.
Bowing before Zhuo, uhm, the badge, Venerable Shi spoke with utmost respect, “Greetings, Sect Leader, I obey your order!”
“Venerable Shi…” His faction looked at him lost, the same for Labor Office’s side.
[What’s with Venerable Shi all of a sudden? Why did he cave so soon when he always fought tooth and nail with Sect Leader? ]
[Is Zhuo Fan’s aura so grand that it shook him?]
Everyone’s mind was thrown for a loop at the sudden development.
Glaring at them, Venerable Shi spoke earnestly, “Impudent! Zhuo Fan carries Sect Leader’s badge which makes him the highest power beneath Sect Leader. His words are Sect Leader’s. How dare you defy his orders!”
“We won’t!” They all hung their head.
Zhuo Fan and Venerable Qi’s side were filled with doubt.
[Did he wake up on the wrong side of the bed this morning?]
Ignoring their puzzled gazes, Venerable Shi smiled, “Ha-ha-ha, since this is Sect Leader’s will, we can only follow it. Only, we can’t leave the sect empty. May I leave a few inner sect elders and disciple to defend it, Steward Zhuo?”
Eying him, Zhuo Fan nodded.
He didn’t want to take them in the first place, only Labor Office’s elders or if they came as well, it might spell trouble at the worst moment.
Though Venerable Shi’s attitude was very peculiar, queer in fact.
[Why is he helping me for a change?]
Frowning, Zhuo Fan looked dead in the weasel’s eyes, pondering and finally letting it go.
Time was no longer a luxury right now.
“Alright. We’ll do as Venerable Shi said. The inner sect elders and venerables shall stay behind while Labor Office’s will follow me!” Zhuo Fan nodded and boomed.
Everyone nodded and bowed in response. Venerable Qi’s team had their doubts but now, to support Zhuo Fan, they kept silent.
[Since even Venerable Shi who was always against us didn’t make a fuss, why should we?]
So, Zhuo Fan led the oldies’ group as they walked out of the Main Hall with great fanfare. Soon, the entire sect was in a clamor as the disciples gathered to set off.
Watching the lively scene, Venerable Shi had a nasty smile. An elder next to him frowned, “Venerable Shi, why would you allow such a serious action…”
“It’s because it’s so serious that we must let the kid do it. I can’t let him run off again without stirring things, ha-ha-ha…”
Venerable Shi stroked his beard, his eyes glinting, “Getting rid of him alone isn’t enough. We must remove the Elite Labor Office down to the root as well. Or they would just rise again and we’ll regret it. Now that he’s asking for it, we should further his manic plans and let him destroy himself.”
The others frowned, with only Grand Elder able to see the wisdom in it and shaking his head.
[The kid has done it this time…]
Demon Scheming Sect’s disciples had their orders and soon gathered. Kui Gang and Yue’er were obviously there, since they were the closest to Zhuo Fan.
Soon there were tens of thousands of disciples at the ready.
Zhuo Fan looked around before setting off with all of them. The entire Demon Scheming Sect was now empty and eerily silent with only a hundred elders holding down the fort..
Two weeks later, Kui Gang and the girls were tense, waiting for news from Zhuo Fan. Seeing how another month passed, the four were tense about Chu Qingcheng and the other’s fate as well as if Zhuo Fan would be able to bring any help.
Rumble~
The sky darkened and thunder rolled. The black clouds loomed overhead, reflecting the downcast mood they felt inside. It was so oppressive it was hard to breathe.
Looking above, those were not clouds but a sea of people that came right for them.
The one leading them was none other than Zhuo Fan!
Kui Lang cried out, “Heavens above, Steward Zhuo got the entire sect to come? Why are there so many people here to get our girls?”
“How high could Zhuo Fan even be in the Demon Scheming Sect? Your Sect Leader is willing to fight Mystical Heaven Sect all because he asked?” Demon Scheming Sect looked stunned.
The other two girls were excited. Across all western lands, only one man had such a charisma to get so many people to move, Zhuo Fan.
Not that others lacked the power, but none were crazy enough to go to such lengths as attacking a sect for a girl.
None but Zhuo Fan…
Whoosh!
Zhuo Fan led the descent. Kui Lang’s group rushed over with gratitude, “Steward Zhuo, your name is so widespread and heavy that Sect Leader gave you such force. I am in awe of being able to follow someone like you!”
Zhuo Fan however made a gesture for him to keep silent. “Keep it down. This isn’t Xie Wuyue’s doing. Luckily he was away and I could bring so many.”
“Eh?” Kui Lang’s scalp was numb.
“Also, these guys don’t know why I’ve brought them yet. So don’t say anything and leave the explaining to me.” Zhuo Fan grinned at the four.
Yet they were all shellshocked. Kui Lang was even shaking all over.
[Steward Zhuo, you didn’t tell them anything and still brought them? When they find out we’re going to save our girls, won’t they turn on us?]
Kui Lang felt like crying.
[I can even see my master over there!]
His master was against being with Han Qianying and he was wondering just how pissed off he’d be once he found out he was here just to save her…
Zhuo Fan patted his shoulder, “Do you want to save her?”
“I do!”
“How much?”
“With every fiber of my being!” Kui Lang spoke heavily.
Zhuo Fan nodded and smiled, “Then leave it all to me!”
With a wise look in his eyes, Zhuo Fan turned to the elders and released his mighty aura.
Seeing him so high and mighty, Kui Lang finally realized that he was unlike any of them.
They were still hesitating even if they wanted to do this, while Zhuo Fan was a man of action and determination. That was why he, as a mere disciple, led most of the Demon Scheming Sect’s elders and venerables…

chapters.title: Chapter 734: Join Forces
chapters.content:
Chapter 734: Join Forces
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Cough~”
Clearing his throat, Zhuo Fan looked at the elders and venerables, his face hard and dead serious, “People, we’ll stop here for now. I have to make you understand why we’re going to Mystical Heaven Sect. Everyone get ready and prepare for action!”
They all frowned at how he spoke.
They already found the fact he got all the experts from the sect strange, but Zhuo Fan’s hard look seemed to show this matter had far more implications than he let on.
They all looked at him, tension clear in their expressions.
“We’re going to Mystical Heaven Sect to…” Zhuo Fan squinted and shouted, “Attack! To teach them a lesson!”
[What?!]
They cried out instantly at such a preposterous idea.
Venerable Bai even refuted, “Steward Zhuo, t-that’s going over the line. The nine sects’ scuffles are minor, but to attack a sect like this without justification is criminal! The Double Dragon Manor will definitely intervene at some point and will punish us. None of us can take such blame. Not even Sect Leader!”
Zhuo Fan scratched his nose.
[Justification? Did grabbing girls sounded better? Who the hell would risk their lives then?]
“Steward Zhuo, is this really… Sect Leader’s intent?” Venerable Qi looked at Kui Lang and figured something out. “If Sect Leader has no real reason, it’s best we go back. It’s not too late. If we go now, none of us can take on such a heavy responsibility for what may come.”
Venerable Qi looked long at Zhuo Fan as he advised.
He was reminding Steward Zhuo.
[A mere girl ain’t worth going crazy over. We can still turn back. Let’s pretend that nothing happened before we lose more than we can afford.]
Venerable Qi didn’t expose Zhuo Fan’s intent, as a huge gesture of respect, but would Zhuo Fan balk so easily?
Zhuo Fan huffed and glared at them all, “Do you know why I never stated the reason back in the sect? It’s because I feared Venerable Shi’s lies would block the attack on Mystical Heaven Sect. Why? Because if they lost this battle, they would lose everything. We, however, aren’t afraid, because we came from nothing and everything will be earned after. It’s never in the now!”
They all shook and looked on with serious faces. The laborers were even echoing him.
“Many things had happened in the Double Dragon Gathering but I did not let the three venerables speak of them, out of fear that you would be impulsive.”
With a drawn out sigh, Zhuo Fan continued with a crestfallen tone, “Actually, our achievements could have been higher. But because of Mystical Heaven Sect’s schemes, we suffered in singles, losing our chance to be a superior-three sect.”
[That really happened?]
The oldies whispered among each other in anger.
Zhuo Fan eyed Fiend Yang, shouting, “Venerable Fiend Yang, isn’t that so?”
“Y-yes…” Startled, Fiend Yang bobbed his head. Though Zhuo Fan had deliberated with the team on this matter before, to report only the good news for a greater achievement.
Yet Zhuo Fan had now used it as an excuse to get Chu Qingcheng. He was going to do anything to instill hatred into these people and save his girl.
Fiend Yang had no clue about this so he just agreed.
With a dark look, Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth, “Sect Leader was enraged when he heard the dire consequences. Mystical Heaven Sect is a lower-three sect like we used to be. Now that we’re about to be a real middle-three sect, are we about to stand their humiliation? That’s why Sect Leader sent me a month earlier to return the favor, to show off our sect’s power.”
Having seen Steward Zhuo’s light, they now knew he didn’t leave for the secular world as it was said, but because of Sect Leader’s order!
“But just as I got to Mystical Heaven Sect, something grave happened.”
Zhuo Fan’s tone shifted, “They want to combine with Heaven Trailing Sect. This will raise them above the middle-three sect’s power just so they would suppress us from the shadows. Hearing this news, I rushed to report to Sect Leader. In this time, there were even two elders who came to silence me, but of course I killed them instead!”
[What?!]
The oldies exploded in rage. Mystical Heaven Sect was too damn presumptuous.
[Leaving Double Dragon Gathering’s schemes behind, sending elders to kill our greatest contributor must be punished.]
[Do they think Demon Scheming Sect can be messed with?]
Seeing their anger, Zhuo Fan grinned on the inside, “Sect Leader was also furious hearing of this and wanted to deal with them personally. But you all know Sect Leader is holding talks with all kinds of empires. If we get pushed back because of two sects, it will affect our name. That’s why Sect Leader had me make the first move. Since we can’t win Heaven Trailing Sect, that doesn’t mean we can’t touch its little bro!”
“So Sect Leader gave me his badge, leaving me in charge. Even if Double Dragon Manor would punish us, we have to fight for our name. We are a middle-three sect now, not something a lower-three sect can mess with. This fight will establish us among the middle-three sects. As long as Mystical Heaven Sect isn’t destroyed, what’s so grave about some punishment? I would even return the two thousand sacred stones if I had to, just to preserve our name in the western lands!”
“Steward Zhuo is truly honorable. If you do it, how can’t we? Let’s mess ’em up!”
The crowd cheered with a roar, ready to go kill their way into Mystical Heaven Sect.
Kui Lang had a dumb look on his face.
[Steward Zhuo’s wild boasting had the sects’ elders thirsting for battle. Now even if Sect Leader shows up, they won’t stop either. ]
Just how did these shrewd old guys end up taken in by Zhuo Fan’s words so easily?
That was because Zhuo Fan had preyed on their minds.
To get someone to give their life for you, benefits were a must; pillaging Mystical Heaven Sect. On the other hand, there was also a need for a reason; Sect Leader’s order was the perfect excuse.
