While also making him the scapegoat. Zhuo Fan even said he would return his sacred stones if he had to. It showed he’d take the blame as well. And finally, focusing their anger on a common enemy, getting everyone roaring to go.
Everything went as Zhuo Fan wanted it to. He got every oldie on board, even if they had some doubts.
Because Zhuo Fan had smoothened over their worries already. Now all they had to do was follow Zhuo Fan into battle and get those girls back.
Hu~
Zhuo Fan eased a breath and sported a strange grin.
Dan’er was stumped. This big talker actually got this motley crew to save someone!
“Even I would’ve believed him if I didn’t know something about this, ha-ha-ha…” Venerable Qi shook his head.
Fiend Yang’s brow shook, “Wasn’t that badge used to be the leader in the Double Dragon Gathering? How did it become Wuyue’s proof to attack Mystical Heaven Sect?”
Fiend Yang was perplexed. The disciples who went to Double Dragon Gathering were also aware of the gaps in that glorious speech. But they were on Zhuo Fan’s side.
The previously puzzled Demon Scheming Sect’s crowd was now united under a single thought, to kill. All that was left was to get to Mystical Heaven Sect.
Seeing as he could not stop Zhuo Fan, Venerable Qi proposed a valid point, “Steward Zhuo, Mystical Heaven Sect is mostly the same size as us, but we are now going without everyone and are about to attack their home ground. It’ll be hard to beat them behind their array.”
The people stopped being noisy and frowned.
[True.]
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook and grinned. He turned around to look at a black cloud coming over, led by a familiar figure, “Brother Zhuo, we’ve come to help?”
[Who?]
The Demon Scheming Sect’s people looked up to see the sky covered by a throng of men as they flew over.
In the lead was a man in his twenties, filled with vigor and regal.
Zhuo Fan’s features softened as he smiled, “You’ve grown, Yunhai.”
“Brothers have come to answer the call!”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed and laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, now we have enough men. My two armies will join forces and win.”

chapters.title: Chapter 735: Young Sanzi Came to Help
chapters.content:
Chapter 735: Young Sanzi Came to Help
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Whoosh~
Just like pitch-black rain, they all landed like a downpour behind Luo Yunhai. He came before Zhuo Fan in excitement, “Brother Zhuo, it’s been ages. How have you been?”
“Alright.”
Zhuo Fan grinned and patted his shoulder, “I’m relieved you’ve now grown into your role as clan head. You must be skilled now in leading the Luo clan.”
Luo Yunhai shook his head, “It’s all because brother Zhuo set the stage. With the three stewards minding everything, even as a Clan Head, I didn’t have much worry.”
“Ha-ha-ha, a clan head’s greatest ability is to manage his people. If you’d micromanage everything in the clan, then you wouldn’t be a Clan Head.”
A smile was splayed on Zhuo Fan’s face, “Those three are called the wisest three in Tianyu. It’s clearly not for nothing. With them by your side, I had no worries.”
Luo Yunhai was worried though, “But big brother Zhuo, I always hoped you’d come back. I’ve always kept the Grand Steward spot empty for you. Even Steward Zhuge won’t touch it. As for the other two, you got their positions set. When will you be coming back?”
“I’ll be a steward again when I return?” Zhuo Fan grinned at him, “I’m currently soaring through the ranks, yet to come back down…”
Startled, Luo Yunhai blinked at Zhuo Fan, “He-he-he, there’s another empty seat as well, my sis’ husband. You could always…”
“Uhm, forget it. It’s better to be a steward.” Zhuo Fan shook his head, “I already have a wife. I sent a jade slip over to call for help just to save her then go back to the Luo clan.”
“Truly?”
Luo Yunhai was overjoyed. Just then, a rough voice sounded from behind, “Steward Zhuo, you’re coming back at last? We’ve waited ages for this.”
Zhuo Fan looked up to see a very familiar face, his number one aid, Li Jingtian.
He was already in the 6th layer of Ethereal Stage, bursting with power and might. His grand aura even forced the weaker cultivators back.
Next to him was Qiu Yanhai, Xue Qingjian, the two sages and tens of others in the Ethereal Stage. While foreign to him, they all held Zhuo Fan in high regard.
“Elder Li, everyone, long time no see. I’m indebted to you for this.” Zhuo Fan cupped his hand before them.
Returning the gesture, they said, “Steward Zhuo, it’s our duty!”
“Thank you all. Let’s rush to Mystical Heaven Sect!” Zhuo Fan cupped his hands again and shouted.
The Luo clan bowed and took to the skies, “Till the end!”
The Demon Scheming Sect’s crowd was in shock at such display. These guys only had around forty Ethereal Stage experts, yet Zhuo Fan only told them to fight and they obeyed, no questions asked; not caring about their safety.
The Demon Scheming Sect had many reservations in this battle, yet they…
They looked at Zhuo Fan’s serious face with a lost look then sighed.
[They are Steward Zhuo’s clansmen, of course they trust him. They didn’t even ask for a reason to fight, only for Zhuo Fan to tell them to.]
It went to show just how highly he was seen among them.
[No wonder Steward Zhuo abandoned Demon Scheming Sect’s prospects to return home.]
[This clan was worth it…]
Fiend Yang and Venerable Qi sighed.
“Dad!”
A childish voice came from the skies once more. The people looked up to see a red glow flash before them, taking the shape of a seven-year-old.
Only this kid could fly and from the faint aura he gave, he was definitely in the Ethereal Stage. All of Demon Scheming Sect was shocked.
[How did this kid train? This is ludicrous.]
Only Zhuo Fan and Luo clan knew that he was Tianyu’s number one freak, Invincible Scamp Gu Santong. No matter how freaky and tough Zhuo Fan was, he fell in second place.
Not that it mattered when they were practically related.
“Dad!”
Gu Santong landed right in Zhuo Fan’s arms, cheering. Zhuo Fan smiled, “Kid, you came at last. I thought the old guy wouldn’t let you.”
“As if. Even if uncle said no, I’d just sneak out to help my old man, he-he-he…” Gu Santong was so glad he was holding Zhuo Fan in a tight and long hug.
Zhuo Fan was also happy to see him.
However, the Demon Scheming Sect was dumbstruck.
[A freak like Zhuo Fan had a seven-year-old in the Ethereal Stage?]
[His entire family is made of freaks!]
They could only sigh and shake their heads.
“Eh?”
Gu Santong pointed at the two sages, “Why aren’t you two dead yet? Last time you had me trapped real tight. Now you dare show your faces again before me? Let me just send you off then, permanently!”
Gu Santong was about to jump out of Zhuo Fan’s arms and straight at the two. The sages tensed and fell back.
“Young Sanzi, they’re with me. I also helped you by teaching them a lesson. It’s all in the past now.” Zhuo Fan grabbed Gu Santong and explained.
Startled, Gu Santong turned to him and only after a while did he nod, “How smart of you. You’re only alive for being on dad’s side, humph…”
Snickering, Gu Santong raised his tiny fist at the two and the sages sighed.
[Young lord, it’s you who always messed with us. You’re just as unreasonable as your old man.]
[Scratch that, you’re worse!]
The sages felt helpless before the duo bearing the same insufferable attitude.
“That’s enough catching up. Let’s see how we’re going to attack Mystical Heaven Sect.”
After pleasantries, Zhuo Fan turned serious, “Yunhai, how many did you bring?”
Luo Yunhai cupped his hands, “The Four Tigers of Tianyu are defending the border, Elder Yan is handling alchemy, while the stewards handle the internal affairs. Except for them, Luo Alliance’s entire power is now present. We have fifty Ethereal Stage experts, five thousand in the Radiant Stage and a hundred thousand large Flying Tiger Army!”
Demon Scheming Sect’s oldies clicked their tongues.
[For a mere clan to gather such force sure is a rarity. As our agent in Tianyu, he really is amazing.
“Then we will make up for each side’s gaps. Next will be crushing their home advantage.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed and waved at the two armies to come and hear his plan. They all lit up and looked at him in stunned silence.
Two months later, in a dark room in Mystical Heaven Sect, the sound of the door unlocking was heard as the heavy iron door creaked open.
A savage face was revealed, yet he wore the lavish clothes of a gentleman, Xuan Shaoyu.
In this dark place sat three girls, Chu Qingcheng, Shui Ruohua and a woman in her thirties, of soft skin and black eyebrows. Despite being pale, she kept her grace.
“Senior sister Qianying, is this really necessary?” Xuan Shaoyu bore a twisted smile as he mocked, “Your confinement will soon end. Twenty years have passed, yet you still cling to this. You’re unmarried so I don’t need you. Why must you cause such a scene?”
Glancing at him with a cold look, she spoke, “Shaoyu, I’ve watched you grow and thought you’d be different from your father. I was wrong. Your demons are worse than your father’s. Your father loves his son dearly. Which is yours?”
“My father, the Sect Leader is your master, no? The way you talk is like you don’t see him like that anymore.”
Xuan Shaoyu huffed and turned to Chu Qingcheng’s flawless beauty with intoxication, “Everything I do is for love. Junior sister Qingcheng, half a year is almost up and he still hasn’t showed up. You better hold your end. Don’t worry I won’t suck you dry, I know restraint. I wish to grow old with you.”
Chu Qingcheng’s brow rose and she spoke flatly, “He will come. Since he said he’ll be here in six months, then he will be here. If he won’t show, it’s because you stopped him. I will always hold on until he comes before me.”
“Humph, a demonic cultivator entering a righteous sect?”
“Demon? Ha-ha-ha, who is the real demon here, I wonder?” Han Qianying mocked.
Xuan Shaoyu was furious and clenched his fists. But he controlled himself. Then, a frantic disciple rushed over to report, “Young master, there’s someone outside the sect asking for you. He said he’s Zhuo Fan from Demon Scheming Sect.”

chapters.title: Chapter 736: Arriving at Mystical Heaven Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 736: Arriving at Mystical Heaven Sect
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Zhuo Fan?”
Xuan Shaoyu’s eyes widened in shock, “This manic demon dares to knock on Mystical Heaven Sect’s door?”
The girls were startled and Chu Qingcheng was smiling.
Looking at her, Han Qianying smiled, “Junior sister, your guy ain’t bad. Just the fact he faces Mystical Heaven Sect alone shows he’s worth it.”
“But I’m not content. I want to see him and hear his answer.” Smiling, Chu Qingcheng sighed.
Shui Ruohua looked on in envy, “Junior sister, a man that cares for you will be with you forever. I believe his answer will be the one you wanted… “
“Enough!”
Xuan Shaoyu snorted, “Demonic cultivators are cruel. How can a damn demonic cultivator be fit to stand next to junior sister Qingcheng? His flowery speech has duped her. I will never let her be deceived by such a shameless fiend!”
Shui Ruohua sighed, “Junior brother, how did you turn out like this? So petty and greedy. You weren’t like that before.”
“I changed you say? It’s you who changed. You’ve always been cold like ice and against demonic cultivators. While now you let yourself be taken by the demonic path.” Xuan Shaoyu’s eyes turned bloodshot from anger, “Even if you changed, it doesn’t matter. I refuse to let Qingcheng sink any lower!”
Han Qianying watched his crazed attitude and sighed to Shui Ruohua, “Junior sister, let it go. He’s been taken by his demons. He’s even worse than a demonic cultivator. He won’t wake up. His father must know this as well, yet what does he do? He still caters to his crazed son’s whims yet says he purges demons? His son wouldn’t have ended up like this if he hadn’t pampered him to this extent.”
“Sigh, his father has been overcome by his demon as well, or he wouldn’t have dragged junior sister Qingcheng into this. Mystical Heaven Sect has long since stopped being righteous… “
Shui Ruohua’s heart was crushed and she sighed.
Mystical Heaven Sect was where she grew up, always being righteous as it was. But at some point, she noticed that it had turned rotten. Its glory, hiding a deep shadow more dreadful than a demonic sect.
Her sadness only deepened.
Xuan Shaoyu mocked, “Junior sister Qingcheng, you really think I’ll let Zhuo Fan go since he came alone to Mystical Heaven Sect?”
“Or what, you’ll detain him, someone so important to Demon Scheming Sect?” Chu Qingcheng sneered.
Xuan Shaoyu gnashed his teeth, “There are plenty of ways to keep him here. Don’t underestimate me, junior sister!”
“You can’t beat him and I advise you not to taunt him, lest you want your life to be over.” Chu Qingcheng spoke.
Xuan Shaoyu’s heart shook, then he was enraged. Her cold attitude showed how little she cared about him.
He clenched his fists, and came to a decision, “Junior sister, you’ll see! I will make him crawl like a dog before me. We’ll see who’s the final winner!”
“Guard!”
“Yes, young master!” One disciple bowed.
“Did Zhuo Fan come alone? Is there anyone with him?” Xuan Shaoyu squinted.
The disciple reported, “Young master, there is one man with him, one called Kui Lang.”
“Kui Lang? Isn’t that Senior sister Qianying’s close friend? Ha-ha-ha…”
Xuan Shaoyu snickered at her, “Senior sister Qianying, you were just praising Qingcheng’s yearning but yours isn’t any humbler. Because of his love for you, Kui Lang had abandoned his match with me in the Double Dragon Gathering, risking his sect’s punishment. How else would we get to beat Demon Scheming Sect in singles? Now that he came waltzing in here like an ignorant fool, I bet senior sister must be wanting to see him too.”
Han Qianying shook.
Xuan Shaoyu snickered, “Don’t worry, I’ll make sure to leave his corpse for senior sister to bury, ha-ha-ha…”
Xuan Shaoyu laughed as he left, the iron door closed shut behind him. Han Qianying clenched her fists, her heart a mess of joy and sorrow.
Then she started blaming Kui Lang.
[This foolish man, coming to Mystical Heaven Sect. But I’m relieved that he still remembers me after all these years. I didn’t suffer twenty years in vain.]
Chu Qingcheng smiled at her, “Senior sister, rest easy. With Zhuo Fan around, he will be fine.”
“That guy of yours is that amazing? Can he stand tall before Mystical Heaven Sect?” Han Qianying asked curiously.
She admired Zhuo Fan’s courage, but she was still skeptical about his power. Mystical Heaven Sect was a sect after all, and he’d be trapped in its array once inside.
How was he to protect Kui Lang when he had to worry about himself first?
She knew Zhuo Fan was revered in Demon Scheming Sect, but Xuan Shaoyu had become obsessed and would not care if the sects became enemies.
[Young master must be planning to get rid of them at all costs. Who will save them then?]
Chu Qingcheng smiled to ease her worries, “I know Zhuo Fan better than anyone, so relax. He never was one to lose out. I have never seen him lose in any of his fights. I believe he came prepared this time as well.”
Chu Qingcheng’s face was one of absolute trust.
Han Qianying watched, stunned. Shui Ruohua nodded as well, “Senior sister, I’ve seen Zhuo Fan as well, he’s not normal. Kui Lang should be safe with him.”
Han Qianying looked at them and took a deep breath to calm her heart.
All she could do was pray that this unknown and mysterious Zhuo Fan would be capable of a miracle to keep both of them safe…
Hum~
Outside of Mystical Heaven Sect, an opening popped into thin air, followed by a disciple coming out and welcoming Zhuo Fan and Kui Lang.
“Honored guests, Sect Leader welcomes you in his hall.” The disciple was in the Profound Heaven Stage. He bowed and spoke amiably.
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow.
[Mystical Heaven Sect wants to play around, huh? This is clearly a trap.]
Not that they were scared, since they came willingly into the tiger’s den.
The two cupped their hands and Zhuo Fan spoke, “Thank you for leading us.”
The disciple bowed again and took them in.
“Steward Zhuo, they didn’t attack outside because they want to get rid of all traces on the inside. They don’t want to take any chances.” Kui Lang sent to Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan smiled and nodded, sending back, “That’s for sure. They went for the girls and know why I’m here, since they welcome us in, it shows they want to kill us outright, not caring about the Demon Scheming Sect. Then we don’t need to hold back at all. But before we start, we must make sure the girls are safe.”
“We can’t have them using them as hostages!” Kui Lang’s eyes flashed.
They soon arrived at the flashy Main Hall. The disciple led Zhuo Fan and Kui Lang inside, but on the main seat they saw an old man that was barely skin and bones with a hard look and dignified arua.
The disciple bowed, “Greetings, Sect Leader. The honored guests have arrived.”
“Leave us.” Sect Leader Xuan spoke and the disciple left.
Sect Leader Xuan looked Zhuo Fan in the eye, “It is you, Zhuo Fan.”
“Does Sect Leader Xuan know me?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow.
Sect Leader Xuan nodded, “Ten years ago, in Tianyu Empire, I chose Chu Qingcheng to prepare for Double Dragon Gathering, while Xie Wuyue chose you. I thought I had him pay a heavy price for you but I was astonished to find out how much you shone in the Double Dragon Gathering. Your name shook the western lands. I can see that Sect Leader Xie’s eyes were sharper than mine.”
“Ha-ha-ha, Sect Leader Xuan is too kind.” Zhuo Fan smiled,
[This old bag of bones, what’s with that heavy look? What Double Dragon Gathering preparations? You clearly took her for your son! You think I don’t know?]
[Hypocrite!]
Zhuo Fan and Kui Lang despised him on the inside…

chapters.title: Chapter 737: Bargain
chapters.content:
Chapter 737: Bargain
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Sect Leader Xuan’s face was flat as he said, “I can’t help but wonder, what has brought you to my sect?”
“Can it be that Sect Leader hasn’t heard?”
Zhuo Fan raised a taunting eyebrow, “Qingcheng and I come from Tianyu and have known each other since. I owed her a clear answer since then and never got to give it yet. At the Double Dragon Gathering, I came upon a realization, so I had told her that I would give her an answer half a year later. Now I have come to fulfill that promise.”
Sect Leader Xuan squinted and turned colder on the spot, “Is it love?”
“Oh, Sect Leader Xuan is so wise to see it.” Zhuo Fan nodded with a smile. Kui Lang at the side had to hide his chuckling.
Bam!
Sect Leader Xuan slammed the armrest in anger and jumped to his feet, “Zhuo Fan, you’re a Demon Scheming Sect disciple. If you’re here on sect matters, I’m most open for discussions, but my sects has rules too. My disciples are forbidden from being friendly with demonic cultivators, especially about fraternizing. For you to mention this to me, are you perhaps doing it to mock my sect rules? “
“Men, seize them!””
“Yes!”
Sect Leader Xuan issued his order and the Main Hall was flooded with people from everywhere, all Profound Heaven disciples.
Zhuo Fan sneered.
[Did this guy not hear about my feats at Double Dragon Gathering?]
When even Ethereal Stage experts were no match for him, what was he doing throwing small fries at him?
Since so many came at a mere shout, it was obvious this was premeditated. This wasn’t to capture them, but to force them to strike first.
Sect Leader Xuan knew killing Demon Scheming Sect’s best disciple just from a mere offense was the worst way to do it. He had to get this disciple to make the first move, by killing Mystical Heaven Sect’s people and sealing his fate.
The fact one killed their men, even in their own home, was inexcusable, making it so killing him in turn was totally justified. Not even Double Dragon Manor might get involved.
[This sly dog wants us killed!]
Zhuo Fan squinted and just stood there. Kui Lang looked calm as well, giving Zhuo Fan a look of admiration.
[It’s all going as Steward Zhuo predicted. This old coot really wants to make us start killing. First is to lure us into a crime then use experts to purge us for the demons we are.]
[Thank god Steward Zhuo saw it coming or we’d have started killing.]
“Not so fast.”
Zhuo Fan shouted, “Sect Leader Xuan, you knew long ago why we’re here. Why all the theatrics? Let’s be blunt about it and talk business.”
Sect Leader Xuan watched the two as the tide of people only surrounded them. He knew his plan fell through and waved, “All of you leave.”
The disciples started, then receded as the tide, gone in a blink and leaving the three alone once more.
“You’re worthy of your reputation in Tianyu Empire. To have your name echoing far and wide after Double Dragon Gathering as well, Steward Zhuo sure is something!”
Steward Zhuo nodded, “If anyone else would’ve come to me with this, I’d hardly care. But Steward Zhuo, since it’s you, I’m a little intrigued. What kind of business are you talking about?”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Sect Leader Xuan, Mystical Heaven Sect has lost in the Double Dragon Gathering and hardly got anything.”
“Ha-ha-ha, not that much. It’s pretty much the same as always.” With a sharp glint in his eyes, Sect Leader Xuan noticed something, “Zhuo Fan, where are you going with this?”
“Nowhere, really, only considering Sect Leader Xuan’s position. Demon Scheming Sect and Mystical Heaven Sect have always been at odds. Demon Scheming Sect now has ten thousand sacred stones to grow. Mystical Heaven Sect only got two hundred. A hundred years from now, Demon Scheming Sect will soar while Mystical Heaven Sect will be stuck. Even if there were more Double Dragon Gatherings, do you really believe you have the power to turn it around? What are the odds of something like Demon Scheming Sect’s sudden rise happening again? At that time, who knows what our Sect Leader would do…”
Zhuo Fan had an evil smile on his face as he looked at Kui Lang. “Getting a little bit of kick out of it, right? Ha-ha-ha…”
“Steward Zhuo, you have a much too kind opinion of our Sect Leader. When the time comes, he won’t stop there, he’ll make sure none of those that offended him will ever return.”
“Right, right, it’s you who’s been in the sect for longer and got his temper. Ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan patted Kui Lang’s shoulder.
Kui Lang laughed as well.
Sect Leader Xuan’s cheek twitched. “Zhuo Fan, just say what you want!”
“Let’s make a deal.”
His face back to being serious, Zhuo Fan began, “You know what I want. I got two thousand sacred stones from the Double Dragon Gathering, almost the same amount the last spot in middle-three sects got. If you have them and grow up fast, in the next Double Dragon Gathering you won’t fall so far behind of Demon Scheming Sect.
Sect Leader Xuan’s eyes lit up. He probed, “You mean you’re willing to give me two thousand sacred stones?”
“It’s not give, but trade.”
Zhuo Fan squinted, “We only want Chu Qingcheng and Han Qianying, then these sacred stones are yours to do what you please with them. Quite the bargain.”
Sect Leader Xuan frowned, his heart filled stirred by all kinds of feelings, even as his face looked stone cold. “You want me to give my disciples to two demonic cultivators just for that. What do you take me…”
“Businessman.”
Zhuo Fan cut him off with a smile, “You made a deal with Qingcheng the first time. Now I am the one making a deal with you. You had Qingcheng come to your sect for Double Dragon Gathering. Now it’s over, and you didn’t get to win much either. And now that I come to you with a losing deal on my part, you’re not going to take it? “
Sect Leader Xuan’s beard shook as he frowned. “Using disciples in a deal is not the righteous path. But seeing how you’re so willing, then of the two, just one…”
“It’s either both or the deal is off. We’ll just leave and won’t even take them. Demonic cultivators are cruel at the core and we want the two just so we can ease our regrets. But if the price is too high, we’d rather not take it. Breaking emotions is a road we all must take.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed, giving Sect Leader Xuan no chance to haggle. “Sect Leader Xuan knows that I only have two thousand sacred stones on me. I also only want the two girls. From the start, our chips were called, and this deal can only have two outcomes. Please, enough with the games, Sect Leader Xuan. You’re looking down on our sincerity.”
[Amazing!]
Sect Leader Xuan was dumbstruck, but then he sighed, “Men, bring Qingcheng and Qianying.”
“Yes!”
One disciple outside the doors shouted and rushed to comply. Zhuo Fan and Kui Lang nodded and grinned.
It all went perfectly so far. The old coot was taken in by the sacred stones…
Easing a breath, Sect Leader Xuan felt stuck. He discovered that ever since Zhuo Fan showed up, everything went his way. Being led around like this left him feeling most unsettled.
Not even when talking with Xie Wuyue would he lose so much ground.
Sect Leader Xuan was glum inside so he said, “Zhuo Fan, Does Xie Wuyue know you’re giving up two thousand sacred stones for two girls?”
“If Sect Leader knew, would we have reached here?”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “We all know using resources on the enemy isn’t good for the sect, but demonic cultivators are selfish. For our girls, we sometimes have no choice but to ignore the sect.”
Sect Leader Xuan nodded.
[Just like I thought. Xie Wuyue has no clue about this. That’s good.]
[They came by themselves. That means they don’t have Demon Scheming Sect backing them. Even if I take the stones, then I can…]
Sect Leader Xuan’s eyes flashed with bloodthirst as he made a sinister grin.
Xuan Shaoyu just came out of that room and was about to go to Main Hall, to prance around as Zhuo Fan was at his death door. Yet he saw a disciple rushing to where the girls were held and shouted, “Hey, what are you doing?”
“Young master!”
The guy bowed, “Young master, I am obeying Sect Leader’s order, taking Chu Qingcheng and Han Qianying to the Main Hall.”
[What?!]
Xuan Shaoyu looked at the Main Hall in shock, “Father, what the hell are you doing…”

chapters.title: Chapter 738: The Answer
chapters.content:
Chapter 738: The Answer
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“What happened to the two from the Demon Scheming Sect? Are they dead yet?” Feeling restless for some reason, Xuan Shaoyu grabbed the disciple’s shoulder as he asked.
The disciple was slightly scared, holding in the pain coming from his shoulder as he faltered, “They and Sect Leader were at odds at first. Sect Leader gave the order to kill them, but then…”
“Then what?” Xuan Shaoyu stared fixedly at him.
Gulping, the guy hesitated, “Then Sect Leader had us leave. They talked some more, seemingly reaching a conclusion, then Sect Leader had me bring the ladies…”
“Beat it!”
Xuan Shaoyu roared, pushing him. His cheek twitched, his eyes exploding with fury, “Reaching a conclusion? What the hell is that old coot doing? Didn’t I tell him Zhuo Fan must be killed? Why are they just chatting?”
The disciple slowly got back to his feet, not even looking the angry young master in the eye, “Young master, if that is all. I have to pass the order…”
“Hold it!”
Xuan Shaoyu barked and the guy almost cried in fear. He didn’t know how he was supposed to face such a crazed young master. He feared the young master would explode and kill him.
Ever since Double Dragon Gathering, the young master was unnatural, his mood volatile. Many junior brothers were killed at the slightest whim.
It would not be much if this was a demonic sect.
[But we’re a righteous sect here! How can you kill left and right?]
But since he was Sect Leader’s son, everyone had no choice but to bear it.
The guy spoke on the verge of crying, “Young master, how may I help you?”
“I’m coming with you. I want to see what game Zhuo Fan is playing to unsettle the old man.” Xuan Shaoyu clenched his fists as his face twisted in rage.
Fifteen minutes later, the heavy iron door opened with a creak. Xuan Shaoyu and the disciple were back inside.
Chu Qingcheng mocked, “Back already?”
Xuan Shaoyu was vexed. He didn’t answer. The disciple walked up, “By Sect Leader’s order, senior sisters Qingcheng and Qianying, please come to the Main Hall.”
“Why should we?” Chu Qingcheng asked back.
The disciple shook his head. “I don’t know. After Sect Leader talked with the two disciples from Demon Scheming Sect, he told me to get…”
Pa!
Before he finished, the disciple was met with disaster in the form of a hard slap. It hit his cheek with so much force, he was bleeding from the mouth and collapsed.
“You’re supposed to relay the order, not run your mouth!” Xuan Shaoyu glared.
The disciple was overcome with injustice, but did not voice a word. The girls were overjoyed. Zhuo Fan got Sect Leader Xuan to get them out.
Han Qianying was startled as she muttered in disbelief. “The crude Kui Lang knows how to negotiate? It has to be Zhuo Fan. Qingcheng, your man is really something to make Sect Leader yield.”
Chu Qingcheng smiled, her pride in Zhuo Fan could not be explained with mere words.
Xuan Shaoyu was annoyed at their faces and was about to blow a gasket.
“Don’t get too happy. You might be going to Main Hall just to see Zhuo Fan begging on his knees for my dad’s mercy. Give it up!”
Xuan Shaoyu snapped, “Men, take them!”
“Yes!”
Someone came over to escort them. “Wait!”
They turned to Shui Ruohua.
“Can I come to the Main Hall to see as well?” Shui Ruohua spoke.
Xuan Shaoyu squinted then nodded with a mocking smile, “Sure, senior sister Ruohua, you’ve always looked after me before, but since the punk showed up, you’ve changed. Were you entranced by him as well? Then I’ll bring you along as well, to see who the real winner is between us.”
Xuan Shaoyu flicked his hand and another person came to Shui Ruohua to take her.
Flushing red, Shui Ruohua glanced at Chu Qingcheng, but what she got in reply was a curious look. She had to lower her beet red face, unable to look straight at her.
Xuan Shaoyu and the three girls strutted over to the Main Hall.
“Qianying!”
Seeing the girls, the restless Kui Lang rushed to his feet and went to the girl he hadn’t seen in twenty years to grab her soft face.
Han Qianying shook, her own hands gently tracing the aged face as she spoke tenderly, “It’s been so long, Kui Lang.”
“Yeah, yeah, the child is all grown up…” Kui Lang nodded, choked with emotion.
Zhuo Fan smiled, then he looked at Chu Qingcheng yet in no rush to go to her. He just gracefully put down the teacup and simply walked to her. “I’ve come to take you.”
“Hold on.”
Zhuo Fan didn’t get to reach her as Chu Qingcheng stopped him, “You came to take me? That’s it? Why?”
Everyone started, not understanding her. Shui Ruohua was the most confused.
[Didn’t she always want to see Zhuo Fan? Why refuse now?]
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Yeah, I didn’t come just to take you. I want to give you a ten years late answer.”
Chu Qingcheng’s eyes shook as she smiled. “Do you still remember the question?”
“Of course I do.”
Zhuo Fan took a deep breath as he began, “I remember you asking me in Drifting Flowers City, whether I had any reason to stay for longer.”
Chu Qingcheng nodded, “And I recall you telling me no.”
“I lied and for that I even coughed blood, the reason for the blood you saw.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes glistened with tears, as if recalling that feeling. “Now I want to answer you once more. In the Drifting Flowers City, the only reason I had for wanting to stay was to spend my life in that run-down house. Because there I lived with the person I never wanted to leave.”
Chu Qingcheng’s mouth shook then widened in a mesmerizing smile, “Is this just another lie?”
“Who knows? You’ll have the rest of your life to see.” Zhuo Fan smiled as he opened his arms. “Are you willing to live your life by this demon’s side, to verify this answer?”
Chu Qingcheng giggled, “Brazen demon, I will watch you all my life to see if you lied. If I find out you did, humph…”
Chu Qingcheng stomped her feet then rushed for Zhuo Fan to hold him in a fierce hug. She closed her eyes and listened to his heart as she muttered, “From now on, I will always listen to this sound, to know you.”
“I couldn’t be happier.” He wrapped his hands around her waist as tenderness was evoked on his features. He took a deep breath, feeling like the whole world was at peace.
Or maybe that he possessed the entire world.
Shui Ruohua watched stunned and sighed in disappointment, yet wished them well.
Kui Lang was also smiling, happy for him.
Only Xuan Shaoyu was fuming mad, ready to spew fire like a volcano, “Vile demon, I’m not giving junior sister Qingcheng to you!”
“Father, what is this? Why are you giving them to these demons? If word got out, who would respect Mystical Heaven Sect again? What about me and my illness…”
Xuan Shaoyu turned to Sect Leader Xuan, who started pointing out the reasons to not do this.
[By giving Chu Qingcheng to Zhuo Fan, how am I supposed to repair my elemental imbalance? I still need her virginity! She can only be my woman!]
Sect Leader Xuan knew all of this but remained undeterred. Because he wanted both his son alive and those stones.
Sect Leader Xuan spoke, “Zhuo Fan, you already have what you wanted. Are you going to honor your promise?”
“What promise? When did I promise you anything?” Zhuo Fan mocked, going back on his word on the spot.
Sect Leader Xuan roared, “Zhuo Fan, you dare toy with me? Don’t forget, you’re in Mystical Heaven Sect now!”
“And? I got what I wanted anyway, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan’s eyes glinted, his smile devilish…

chapters.title: Chapter 739: Blatant Taunt
chapters.content:
Chapter 739: Blatant Taunt
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Sect Leader Xuan’s face fell as he barked, “I knew demonic cultivators aren’t to be trusted, but I never believed you had the nerve to go back on your word right in my sect!”
“Go back on my word? Ha-ha-ha, Sect Leader Xuan, you’re blowing things out of proportion.”
Zhuo Fan sneered, “Speaking of trust, there’s nothing of the sort between us. Let’s be honest here, did you really go that far, all the way to Tianyu to get Qingcheng, just for Double Dragon Gathering? Wasn’t it to save your poor excuse of a son?
Sect Leader Xuan shook as he spoke, “Where did you hear that?”
Pa!
Zhuo Fan snapped his fingers and in a flash of blue, the Dan’er everyone knew appeared.
“Dan’er!” The girls cried. Dan’er was shocked to appear here, but was happy to go to them. “Sister Ruohua, Qingcheng, I told Zhuo Fan everything. He’ll take us out!”
The girls smiled in joy.
Sect Leader Xuan knew Zhuo Fan knew everything and no longer faked. He stood up, unleashing all his power and his bloodlust. He clearly wanted to rob Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan sneered, “Sect Leader Xuan, it was you who showed no trust in us. Our deal was never going to work. But now, I will give you one last chance. Two thousand sacred stones for Qingcheng and Han Qianying. You now have a choice to make, between the future of the sect and your son’s life.”
The people started and turned to Sect Leader Xuan to wait for his answer.
The girls now understood how Zhuo Fan convinced their Sect Leader to get them here. Two thousand sacred stones were very enticing for a sect.
No wonder even the Sect Leader, who was always thinking about his son, was enticed.
But when Zhuo Fan only mentioned Chu Qingcheng and Han Qianying, Shui Ruohua was crushed. How did he forget about her?
Xuan Shaoyu stared at his father, soaked in sweat, and waiting for his decision. It couldn’t be that his dad was going to forsake him for two thousand sacred stones, right?
“Zhuo Fan!”
Sect Leader Xuan squinted as he spoke, “I want the fish and I also want the bear paw. How will you settle it?”
Zhuo Fan stared hard at him, “Isn’t it giving up the fish for the bear paw?”
(StarReader: Mencius saying. The meaning is you have to sacrifice something in order to gain something. For the entire story: https://ethicsofsuicide.lib.utah.edu/selections/mencius/)
“Wrong, it’s eating the paw and taking the fish. That’s how you have them both!” Sect Leader Xuan’s aura exploded as his bloodthirst spiked, making everyone shiver.
The power of an 8th layer Ethereal Stage expert caused these Radiant Stage cultivators to feel like they were under a mountain, suffocating under its pressure.
Xuan Shaoyu was overjoyed. He got his dad’s intention, to get both Chu Qingcheng and the stones. That meant killing the two.
His joy was short-lived, however, as a scarlet fist slammed into his chest.
He couldn’t even react as the power went through his chest like a sword. He sprayed out blood from his mouth as he was sent flying, making a three meter large hole in the wall.
The bright sunlight shone from the outside, on his bloody figure and glinting off the golden scales of his armor, now dented.
Shuddering, Xuan Shaoyu looked at his original spot with hatred, “Z-Zhuo Fan…”
“Tch, a 9th grade spiritual armor. It must be your lucky day to survive a blow from me.” Zhuo Fan said in disdain.
Sect Leader Xuan went pale. A thirty meter long red spear appeared behind him and pierced at Zhuo Fan’s small build as he roared, “Zhuo Fan, you harmed my son! Die!”
At the incoming immense power bearing down on them, Han Qianying paled and wanted to warn Zhuo Fan, but Kui Lang stopped her with a smile.
Han Qianying was puzzled. Zhuo Fan looked to be in the Radiant Stage. Fighting Sect Leader in his crazed state was a death sentence.
However, Kui Lang showed not an ounce of worry.
[Do they all believe Zhuo Fan can live after Sect Leader’s soul attack?]
She had no way of knowing, all the people here had seen Zhuo Fan’s might, and they knew it was out of this world.
“Sect Leader Xuan, you’re using power to have your way! Since you wanted this, then I won’t hold back, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan snorted and looked at the long spear. He squinted and a dragon roar echoed out as an astonishing light came from his body.
Bam!
The loud bang grated the others’ ears, the flood of power sweeping everything and making the Main Hall erupt, its pieces falling everywhere.
The mighty force made the whole sect quake. The elders and venerable were startled and rushed over. While the clueless disciples just watched the Main Hall in stupefaction.
[What’s going on over there?]
The ground kept shaking as dust engulfed the skies, covering the bright sun above. The girls held their ears, shaking with the earth as they tried to hold on.
When the dust settled, Han Qianying watched in shock, “T-that…”
“Qianying, that is the proof Steward Zhuo is the best disciple in western lands, a heaven dragon soul like Exalted Double Dragons!” The large scarlet dragon flicked to its tail and wrapped the spear tight. It could not budge an inch. Zhuo Fan sneered at the spear, hardly caring about it. Kui Lang atched in pride, as he made the introductions to his woman. As if the soul was his to begin with.
Stumped, Han Qianying now came to and sighed, “Junior sister, your man is just like you said. It’s my first time seeing a disciple stopping Sect Leader’s enraged blow.”
Chu Qingcheng smiled in pride. Kui Lang was also smug, “Qianying, Steward Zhuo isn’t just a disciple, in the Double Dragon Gathering he…”
“His strength has got nothing to do with you. Don’t talk like his glory is yours…” Han Qianying cast her elegant eyes on him and shook her head. “You haven’t changed after all these years. You still like to brag, I see.”
Kui Lang gave a bashful smile, looking at Han Qianying with joy and bliss…
Sect Leader Xuan watched Zhuo Fan’s dragon and was shocked. He heard the disciples that came back that Zhuo Fan was tough, but not by this much.
He was at the 8th layer Ethereal Stage yet Zhuo Fan was only in the 4th layer Radiant Stage. The gap was more than ten layers. Even with the heaven dragon soul, there was a limit to how much one could bridge it.
Yet his ever trusted long spear could not even touch Zhuo Fan, trapped by that scarlet dragon. It was so strong it even overwhelmed an expert like him.
Zhuo Fan saw through his shock, “Sect Leader Xuan, I might be of lower cultivation, but my soul formed when I entered the Radiant Stage. In other words, my soul is like a 4th layer Ethereal Stage soul. Not to mention it’s the strongest there is, the heaven dragon soul. You’ll have to try harder if you want to take my life, ha-ha-ha…”
Sect Leader Xuan was outraged, his fists clenched.
[This is a blatant taunt!]
Never in his life had he been taunted by such a young Radiant Stage expert!
What made it worse was that the taunt was irrefutable.
Looking at the trapped long spear, Sect Leader Xuan grew angrier. On his turf, he was the one that looked bad, his son was smashed, and he couldn’t do anything about it. He felt he had no face left.
Whoosh~
Sect Leader Xuan shook and recalled the long spear. His eyes were fixed on Zhuo Fan, glinting coldly.
“Zhuo Fan, you really are the best disciple you showed at Double Dragon Gathering. But don’t think for a second you can go where you want in western lands. You’re not the best yet! Here is the Mystical Heaven Sect, not your backyard! “
Sect Leader Xuan roared and tens of figures littered the sky…

chapters.title: Chapter 740: Hiding a Million Army
chapters.content:
Chapter 740: Hiding a Million Army
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Whoosh~
One after the other, Ethereal Stage experts gathered around them, numbering more than sixty. Their huge auras turned into a cage, trapping all of them in the middle.
Their hearts sinking, the girls looked at the savage faces they each had and shook. These were the highest powers of the sect. Alone, Zhuo Fan could beat them, but not like this.
The girls were worried for Zhuo Fan, but he and Kui Lang were calm as ever. Not even Dan’er twitched. As if it was all in the plan.
Dan’er sneered at those elders even, rolling her eyes.
[Ganging on? We’ll show you the real meaning soon enough!]
“Zhuo Fan, there’s nowhere for you to run!”
Seeing that help was here, Xuan Shaoyu regained his ego. Struggling to get to his feet from the heavy wound, he cackled, “Ha-ha-ha, weren’t you tough? Let’s see how tough you are in my home! Men, finish him!”
Xuan Shaoyu ordered and the elders were about to act, but Sect Leader Xuan held them back.
Ignoring his clueless son, Sect Leader Xuan eyed Zhuo Fan, “Hand over the stones and I’ll let you go.”
“Father…” Xuan Shaoyu cried out but Sect Leader Xuan waved him off.
With an evil grin plastered on his face, Zhuo Fan said, “Sect Leader Xuan, you take me for a three year old? If word got out that Mystical Heaven Sect not only wanted to kill me from the start but now wants to rob a mere disciple of his sacred stones, the whole western lands will look down on you. Would you actually allow that to happen? Ha-ha-ha, in the end you’ll still use power to have your way. I’m no fool, so please don’t insult my intelligence. No one would believe you.”
“Zhuo Fan, your biggest flaw is that you’re too clever. It would’ve been so much better if you just died without knowing so much.”
Sect Leader Xuan’s brow shook, “Since you already guessed it, then no more mincing words. I’ll just have to search your corpse for my prize.”
“Are you sure you’ll find them?”
“Ha-ha-ha, even if I don’t it won’t matter. In the end, an astute man like you won’t ever leave this place alive!” Sect Leader Xuan shouted, “Everyone attack! Kill him at all costs!”
The others roared and converged on Zhuo Fan, unleashing their souls and surrounding the Almighty Scarlet Dragon King.
The thick bloodthirst had even Almighty Scarlet Dragon King shaking.
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow and waved, “Sect Leader Xuan and the mighty Mystical Heaven Sect is ganging up on someone. My, if only the world knew…”
“You’re wrong. No one will know with you dead!”
Sect Leader Xuan had a nasty smirk on his face, “Western lands will soon find out the best talent in western lands, Zhuo Fan, invaded Mystical Heaven Sect in his madness to violate and kill a female disciple, causing havoc through our sect. The elders fought to contain you but the demon was berserk and had no choice but to put him down. Not even Xie Wuyue can question that!”
The others were shocked. Sect Leader Xuan wanted to kill them at all costs, then make up some excuse.
Seeing the elders closing in, they turned serious, with the girls ready to die in this.
Only Zhuo Fan took it in stride, “Nice speech, but what about this take? The best talent in western lands, the distinguished and carefree Zhuo Fan, was the victim of a most nefarious ploy. The Mystical Heaven Sect planned on robbing him of the two thousand sacred stones and even killing him for them. However, the sect elders came to the rescue, carving a path of blood!”
Zhuo Fan’s ring flashed and fifty Demon Scheming Sect elders came out, displaying their souls with a bang as they met the Mystical Heaven Sect’s strike.
The elders returned to Zhuo Fan’s side with a heavy face as they watched the enemy warily. While Mystical Heaven Sect’s elders were stunned to see fifty more people coming out of nowhere.
“What? This kid’s ring can hold people?” Xuan Shaoyu’s eyes shook as he cried out.
Sect Leader Xuan shook his head, “At most, his ring can only hold these many. Calm down.”
Sect Leader Xuan mocked Zhuo Fan, “Your version isn’t bad, but a shame it’s not going to happen. This is the Mystical Heaven Sect. I have all the men and power I need while you only have fifty people. What’s fifty more corpses anyway?”
Sect Leader Xuan shouted, “Inner elders and venerables, hear my order!”
At his summons, the sky was soon filled with people flying over one after the other. There were hundreds of them.
“Zhuo Fan, today you’ll be buried along with these people!” Sect Leader Xuan smirked with pride.
Xuan Shaoyu was overjoyed.
Yet against the tripled doubled layers surrounding him, Zhuo Fan and the new Demon Scheming Sect elders on the scene were unperturbed.
They had it all planned out.
Laughing at the sky, Zhuo Fan lifted his ring, his eyes shining, “Sect Leader Xuan, you think only you can call people out? Ha-ha-ha, this might be your turf, but not even you’d expect, with my cautious nature, how can I come without assurances? Just to die?”
Sect Leader Xuan shook, his heart uneasy. Then he looked dumbfounded as the rest of the elders at what happened.
“Brothers have come to answer the call!”
Zhuo Fan’s Thunder Ring flashed blue. Lights started coming out of it and an aura covered the skies.
The pressure of the Mystical Heaven Sect’s group was now dispelled in an instant. When the light show finished, what came out was a shocking scene.
Even Sect Leader Xuan was stunned and watched agape, “E-enemy attack…”
In an instant, none could believe their eyes. It was not much of an exaggeration to say the whole sect was stunned. They were under attack!
This cry had spread throughout the Mystical Heaven Sect. Many disciples stood stunned at the news.
[Where? How are we attacked with such a clear blue sky?]
[Besides, isn’t the array on? Where are the attacks?]
They were still oblivious that while an attack at night was a night raid, one in broad daylight was called an enemy attack!
In this situation however, the critical point here was who the enemy was, and whether it could threaten them.
Zhuo Fan and Kui Lang were looked down upon by Sect Leader Xuan. Zhuo Fan called fifty helpers yet Sect Leader Xuan still did not call out.
But now, he shouted this and proved they had the power to threaten the sect. And this power was now within their prized array defending the sect. They were in their home.
This attack out of the blue was just too inconceivable for the disciples to understand and prepare against accordingly. This was a concealed danger for the future…
“H-how is this possible?” Xuan Shaoyu looked dumbstruck at the army, “Where did they come from? And so many! How can he hold so many people in his ring?”
The girls were looking shocked as well. The once clear sky was now covered by a sea of people, in the tens of thousands.
It was literally an army.
[How can this be? A mere storage ring held an army on standby?]
Everyone gasped at Zhuo Fan and at his ring.
[Where did this guy get that kind of treasure? That’s too outrageous!]
Didn’t that mean he could strike anyone with an army whenever, wherever?
[This is freaking unheard of!]
How would they know that Kunpeng reforged the ring into a sacred ring? Its space was not only huge, it could even hold a nation!
This was not the point though, the crux here was Zhuo Fan got the army and hundreds of Ethereal Stage experts from Demon Scheming Sect to easily slip past Mystical Heaven Sect’s array.
Next was obvious, a huge war on the sect’s lands. Now, only strength would be the judge as to who would win.
In this war, Mystical Heaven Sect’s fate was at stake. Would it perish?
Ha-ha, quite possibly.

chapters.title: Chapter 741: Necro Dragon’s Claws
chapters.content:
Chapter 741: Necro Dragon’s Claws
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Venerable Qi, Venerable Bai, you will take the right flank and stop the enemy. Elder Qiu, sister Xue, you take the left flank. Elder Li, you will take the remaining Ethereal Stage experts and carve a path through the middle. The disciples are to go with the Flying Tiger Army on a killing spree. Get the treasury and cut off their reinforcements.”
The army just showed up and Luo Yunhai started giving orders, just like how a real marshal would.
The men roared and went to execute. The Mystical Heaven Sect oldies were still slow on the uptake when the Demon Scheming Sect’s force came at them with the intent to kill.
Now they had to react.
However, Demon Scheming Sect’s force had Luo Yunhai preparing them till now, teaching them formation. The sheer display had struck fear into the Mystical Heaven Sect, caught unprepared as they were, and it made them frantic in their response.
In a single fight, a commander had little importance, while in a group, that was where he showcased his ability, taking initiative on the battlefield through strategy and awareness.
In a split second, the battle turned out to be an enactment of the strategy Luo Yunhai and Zhuo Fan devised early on, taking the higher ground.
They were the ones surrounded by hundreds of elders, yet now, the left and right sides were freed while in center, Elder Li’s force was having an easy time clearing a path. Luo Yunhai then took Flying Tiger Army, the Radiant Stage and Profound Heaven Demon Scheming Sect disciples as he shot forth, ignoring the Ethereal Stage experts’ fights so as to not suffer needless losses.
Their targets? Mystical Heaven Sect disciples. They aimed to kill them and take the treasury’s arms and pills to cripple the enemy’s backup.
Although the reinforcements were close, knowing that it was taken out so fast it would strike a blow at the Ethereal Stage experts’ morale, sapping them of the will to fight.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Yunhai is becoming more and more outstanding. He doesn’t cower even when ordering Ethereal Stage experts. He’s just like me back in the day!”
“There’s the Luo clan as well?” Looking at the familiar faces, Chu Qingcheng was startled.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Yep, they heard the Great Steward Zhuo’s madam was taken and came in full force to help me. Ha-ha-ha, well? Even though it’s been so long since I left the Luo clan, they still hold me in high regard.”
She rolled her eyes and shook her head.
“But what about the Demon Scheming Sect? How did you get the Sect Leader to give you so much power?” Han Qianying asked in shock.
She had grown in the sect and knew of its might. But why would Demon Scheming Sect’s Sect Leader spare nothing in saving Zhuo Fan’s wife. She just couldn’t figure it out.
Was Zhuo Fan so important to the Sect Leader, much more than the sect?
Zhuo Fan and Kui Lang looked at each other and chuckled, “That, well, we’ll talk later. Now, we need to finish what we started.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone and stared at Sect Leader Xuan. Grinning, he shouted, “Sect Leader Xuan, it seems to me, my version isn’t far from becoming a reality, ha-ha-ha…”
Sect Leader Xuan’s face twitched. Watching the frantic battlefield, he grew startled and angry, clenching his fists as he shook all over.
Zhuo Fan’s sudden attack was out of his predictions and that had him scared, to the point it even made room for panic to set in.
But he was a Sect Leader after all. He took a couple of deep breaths to calm down, “Mystical Heaven Sect, fight! Beat back the invaders! Toll the bell!”
“Agh~!”
Yet not far from the Main Hall, howls came as it started burning.
Sect Leader Xuan cried, “That’s the treasury! They’re stealing our arms and cutting off our supplies!”
“Damn it! They were ready for it from the start. That’s why they started this war,” said a venerable with a long beard who was standing next to Sect Leader Xuan. He started cursing. “But how the hell did these outsiders know where our treasury was? Who the hell told them?”
Sect Leader Xuan gnashed his teeth and held a girl in his bloodshot eyes, “Dan’er, you damn traitor! You even told everything to your enemies! You’re giving Mystical Heaven Sect no chance of survival! If I had known I wouldn’t have taken you in!”
“Well…”
Shaking, Dan’er looked scared as she hid behind Chu Qingcheng. But she soon got over her fear and stuck out her nose, “Master, didn’t you take me in for your own devices? Enough of your noble act, stop trying to look benevolent. As Zhuo Fan said, we each take what we need, regardless of the other. You want our lives and I’m supposed to just give it? No way!”
Shaking all over, Sect Leader Xuan was fuming mad as he barked, “Filthy traitor, you’ve been lied to by that demon punk. I’ll make sure to get rid of you for this betrayal!”
Sect Leader Xuan pointed and the long spear soul shot straight for Dan’er.
“Agh!”
Dan’er once again ducked behind Chu Qingcheng. Then, the dragon roared once more and Zhuo Fan’s Almighty Scarlet Dragon King blocked the girls. It flicked its tail and slammed the long spear.
From the immense power surge that was released, many Ethereal Stage experts that were fighting were blown away as the long spear was beaten back.
Almighty Scarlet Dragon King also had a scale on its tail destroyed from the clash. This was a draw.
“Sect Leader Xuan, the lass is my wife’s little sister, which makes her my little sister. Are you looking down on me so much by targeting her?” Zhuo Fan walked on the scarlet dragon and mocked Sect Leader Xuan.
Sect Leader Xuan gnashed his teeth as he spat, “Zhuo Fan, you’ve brought all of them here to ruin my sect. I won’t let you off for this!”
“Tch, you’re talking as if you would’ve if I was alone, hypocrite!” Zhuo Fan sneered. “No matter what, today I vowed to accomplish three things. One, to answer my wife’s ten year-long question. Two, to take her from this place she gave herself for my sake. And three, humph…”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone with bloodlust. “To get rid of any that dare threaten my wife! That’s why your death is at hand, so you will never touch her again!”
Zhuo Fan roared as the scarlet dragon shot for Sect Leader Xuan. Sect Leader Xuan gnashed his teeth and charged as well.
The huge long spear and the mighty scarlet dragon clashed in a mighty display of force. The power surge made the fights around look like a children’s scuffle, forcing the Ethereal Stage experts to back away before they could resume the fight.
Demon Scheming Sect’s oldies saw for the first time Zhuo Fan’s soul and were shocked by its power.
Looking at the two fight, that was not between a disciple and a Sect Leader, but between two Sect Leaders.
Every elder and venerable sighed, then nodded. At some point it seemed Zhuo Fan wielded the power of a Sect Leader…
“Sect Leader we’ll help you!” The two venerables next to Sect Leader Xuan shouted.
But a black shadow appeared in front of them, Li Jingtian.
Li Jingtian gave them a cold look, “Sorry, I hope you won’t disturb Steward Zhuo’s fight. You’ll be fighting me!”
The two mocked, “You’re only in the 6th layer while we are in the 7th layer Ethereal Stage. You hope to take us all by yourself? Fool!”
“Ha-ha-ha, idiots, we are Steward Zhuo’s people. How can our cultivation be normal?” Li Jingtian sneered, “Only dumb homegrown cultivators would ever think that!”
The two were outraged, “Humph, you’ll know soon enough old man. Behold the power of Mystical Heaven Sect’s Double Axe Exterminators!”
The two shook and a huge axe as well as battle-axe appeared behind them. Their power was so mighty it felt like they would rip space as they hacked at Li Jingtian.
“Ha-ha-ha, our double axe souls are famous throughout western lands for their sharpness. Even a domain soul will have a hole ripped in it. Your death is certain with your weak cultivation!”
“Sorry to disappoint you, then.”
Li Jingtian’s eyes flashed and grinned at the incoming axes. Then, a malevolent aura exploded from him.
[Soul variant, Necro Dragon Claws!]
Roar!
A roar shook the skies as a pitch-black dragon enveloped Li Jingtian. The two dragon claws oozed sinister power as it grabbed the axes.
The two mocked, “Fool, that’s no heavenly dragon soul. There’s no way that it can, ugh…”
Crack!
The two shook and their eyes bugged out, dying like that. As for the axes, they were torn to pieces, dissipating in the wind.
On Li Jingtian’s black dragon claws, there was even a faint black glow.
“I’m no heaven nor earth dragon soul, but that doesn’t mean I’m going to lose to some overconfident fools.” Li Jingtian’s eyes shone and he left, leaving the surrounding elders to gape in shock.
[D-did he come from the secular world? For him to be tied to Zhuo Fan, he must be something else…]

chapters.title: Chapter 742: Loyal and Righteous Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 742: Loyal and Righteous Clan
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Stop those damn brats from getting to the treasury!”
Under Luo Yunhai’s leadership, Flying Tiger Army and Demon Scheming Sect’s disciples quickly got away from Ethereal Stage experts’ fights and charged straight for Mystical Heaven Sect’s critical areas.
Sect Leader Xuan wasn’t the only one able to see their plan, many other elders were concerned about this as well.
At the shout of one man, many others got away from their opponents and went after Luo Yunhai.
A great pressure was instantly upon them from behind, and even though most were blocked by Demon Scheming Sect elders, there were still six that got through.
Under those mighty auras, Luo Yunhai frowned, his scalp tingling.
They were all mere Radiant Stage and Profound Heaven disciples. Going against an Ethereal Stage expert was suicide. Even with thousands of people on his side, it would still end up with their cruel demise.
They had no way of stopping those Ethereal Stage experts’ souls with their puny divine sense. They would be mowed down like grass.
Whoosh!
Suddenly, two very familiar figures appeared next to Luo Yunhai, Yue’er and Kui Gang. Looking tensely at him, Kui Gang hurried, “Luo Clan Head, what do we do? Master told us to listen to your every order.”
“You’re brother Zhuo’s disciples? He actually took disciples? He always refused when asked. Even Elder Yan was only imparted skill and never taken as a disciple. You…”
Luo Yunhai shook from the shock. Then nodded, “I see. No wonder brother Zhuo picked you two to come here among the thousands of disciples of the Demon Scheming Sect. You’re on our side.”
Kui Gang nodded, “Yes, master said we always listen to him, and while Demon Scheming Sect disciples will obey an outsider’s order, you, that won’t go on for long. So he let us two be the middlemen. In any case, we’re also Demon Scheming Sect disciples. They trust us more. If you have any orders, tell us and we’ll make sure these disciples will follow your lead!”
“Then take all of them and attack the treasury!” Luo Yunhai shouted, then flew behind.
Startled, Kui Gang quickly grabbed Luo Yunhai who wanted to leave. “Wait, what are you doing? We’re attacking the treasury, but what about you?”
“I’m going to stop the Ethereal Stage experts on our backs and buy you time.” Luo Yunhai flew again.
The two were stunned. Kui Gang held much tighter now as he grew nervous, “You’re looking to die? They’re Ethereal Stage experts! No matter how many people you have, they’ll end up dead, all of them! “
“And? I am a soldier at heart. A soldier does not fear death on the battlefield! In any case, this way we’ll reach our goal.” Luo Yunhai grinned.
Kui Gang was stumped then gnashed his teeth. “Master had us obey your orders. You’re the commander here. How can we let you be in danger? I’ll go! Demon Scheming Sect disciples, listen up…”
Pa!
However, he didn’t finish as Luo Yunhai grabbed his shoulder, “Since you’re brother Zhuo’s disciple, with the Luo clan here, how can I let you face danger? Moreover, brother Zhuo told me that in this war you must be safe. Later, he’ll be giving you a great surprise.”
“But you…” Kui Gang’s eyes shook.
Luo Yunhai waved his hand, “This is the way of the Luo clan, of righteousness and loyalty, a teaching passed down through generations. As the Clan Head, I have to uphold it. Brother Zhuo did so much for us so I won’t ever let his disciples be at risk. Moreover, you said it yourself. Your master told you to obey my orders. Then listen to my command!”
Luo Yunhai flicked his sleeve and got away from them, flying behind to welcome the six Ethereal Stage experts.
“Flying Tiger Army, with me! Focus your divine sense, breaking formation!”
“Yes!”
The Flying Tiger Army converged and charged at the enemy with Luo Yunhai. They all knew what awaited them.
But life meant nothing before a soldier’s duty to obey.
This was the Luo clan’s style. Combined with the original Luo clan’s literary reputation, of being righteous and loyal, Zhuo Fan’s bold and fearless nature, as well as Dugu Army’s inviolable orders, it became just like an impressive army!
Seeing this fearless and brave army, Kui Gang and Yue’er were stunned. Then they sighed, “No wonder master always wanted to go back. This clan cares so much for him. For our lives, as mere master’s disciples, this Clan Head is willing to pay with his. This is crazy, idiocy, or is it… true righteousness?”
“Ha-ha-ha, I never imagined a demonic cultivator like master’s home would be the most righteous clan!” Kui Gang sighed, “But this righteous clan is not as loathsome as the other righteous sects. Yue’er, let’s go… eh…”
Kui Gang wanted to take Yue’er to attack the treasury but he found that she just stared at Luo Yunhai, still.
Yue’er’s eyes grew hazy, “Kui Gang, you listen to Luo Clan Head. I have another task!”
Yunhai shot for Luo Yunhai at full speed, leaving Kui Gang stumped. He gnashed his teeth and shouted, “Demon Scheming Sect disciples, follow me to raid their treasury. Don’t squander Luo Clan Head’s sacrifice!”
“Yes!”
With a roar, the disciples looked at Luo Yunhai, touched by his actions, before going on to do their part.
Behind them, Luo Yunhai took the hundred thousand Flying Tiger Army to pose as a shield for their backs. They had no chance in stopping the Ethereal Stage experts, but their dauntless aura gave a feeling of security.
[No wonder Steward Zhuo came from the Luo clan. All of them are amazing.]
Whoosh~
The six Ethereal Stage experts were now upon the army. Luo Yunhai shouted, “Charge!”
The Flying Tiger Army obeyed without question.
“He-he-he, ignorant fools. Radiant Stage and Profound Heaven cultivators dare block our way?” They sneered and mocked Luo Yunhai and the Flying Tiger Army. The elder with the long beard flicked his hand and a lightning arrow hundred meters long shot like lightning for them.
[Soul variant, Heaven-breaking Arrow!]
Hu~
A huge pressure, one bearing death, descended upon the army. They found it hard to breathe, their mind in pain. Yet not even this could stop Luo Yunhai as he shouted, “Focus all your divine sense before us. We’re a hundred thousand men!”
“Yes!”
The men shouted once more and with a strong wind, the divine sense gathered as it stuck together into a wall before the incoming arrow. The divine sense just kept getting stronger and stronger.
However, the bearded old man mocked, “What can the divine sense of Radiant Stage cultivators do? It’s no match for an Ethereal Stage expert’s condensed soul! Quantity can’t beat quality. Humph, a bunch of rats are looking to die so have at it!”
The other five Ethereal Stage experts laughed loudly, not in a hurry to join and instead enjoyed seeing these ants getting squashed.
Whoosh!
With a thunderclap, the lightning arrow struck the divine sense wall hard. It breached it without delay and went for the army unimpeded.
Pff!
The men all spewed blood, feeling their heads splitting apart from the pain. The few Profound Heaven cultivators in the Flying Tiger Army had it worse, their eyes lost their light and died on the spot, leaving their empty shells of a hard body to fall to the ground.
Next came the fall of a thousand bodies as they died from the attack. Luo Yunhai was in pain with every thump.
The Flying Tiger Army was made of war puppets Zhuo Fan refined, and would not even be called humans, having only a divine sense. But these people were Luo clan’s guards, brothers Luo Yunhai had spent years by their side. He saw them as family.
Watching so many fall to their deaths tore Luo Yunhai apart. But he bore through the pain and held on.
This was the Luo clan’s military style. Remembering the martyrs was done after the war. Now they had one mission, to charge!
The brutal lightning arrow had not slowed at all, as if to prove to Luo Yunhai and his men that all their efforts were for naught, a fool’s errand.
The Ethereal Stage experts sneered, but then their smiles fell. Luo Yunhai and the Flying Tiger Army wore the same hard faces as they faced this deadly adversity.
It was as if they did not know the meaning of weakness.
Even the six Ethereal Stage experts began to show admiration. How long has it been since they last saw such determination?
[But you still have to die!]
The bearded elder’s eyes flashed with bloodthirst and sent the lightning arrow flying even faster with a flick of the wrist. It was in front of Luo Yunhai in a blink. The burning lightning was so powerful he felt pain before it struck…

chapters.title: Chapter 743: Different Path
chapters.content:
Chapter 743: Different Path
Proofreader
: Papatonks
[Damn it, it’s faster than predicted!]
Luo Yunhai squinted at the incoming lightning arrow and gnashed his teeth as he shouted, “Even if I die, you are to hold them back down to the last man!”
“Yes, sir!” The Flying Tiger Army roared in unison.
The six Ethereal Stage experts’ hearts shook at their devotion, touched by their devotion.
They were amazed there were people in this world with such commitment, facing death regardless of what happened to them all to complete their mission.
[Thank god they’re only in the Radiant Stage and Profound Heaven Stage and can’t harm us.]
Letting them grow would bring about a calamity!
Such dreadful power made them wonder just where they came from. The Demon Scheming Sect had no way of having such loyal disciples, that was for sure.
The five Ethereal Stage experts were puzzled and sighed, but most of all, they were afraid. While the bearded elder was more determined than ever to end them.
[They all must die!]
Crack!
The lightning arrow crackled as it ripped through the air, ready to annihilate the entire Flying Tiger Army.
Luo Yunhai clenched his teeth with a frown. His biggest worry was not his death, but that he bought enough time for Kui Gang’s team to complete their raid…
“Luo Clan Head, focus all of your men’s divine sense on me!” A soft voice echoed, that of a girl in white as she landed before them. She parted her red lips and spat out an azure flaming bead.
Luo Yunhai’s eyes widened on seeing Zhuo Fan’s disciple, Yue’er, “Flying Tiger Army, focus all your divine sense on this lady!”
Hu~
In an instant, the huge wall of divine sense that everyone formed was now flooding Yue’er’s body, the soldiers acting without an ounce of hesitation.
Shaking, Yue’er was shocked as the power flooded her, it was even too much to handle as she had to cough up blood.
She never imagined Luo clansmen would be so quick and direct. They gave her everything without the slightest hesitation.
They were not even familiar. Even if they were on the same side, not hesitating to give her everything while risking their lives was never seen anywhere. Yet now, the Luo clan’s army did it just like that.
Smiling, Yue’er’s heart turned soft. She grew up in the Demon Scheming Sect, where everyone was out to get everyone. The only one she could trust was her sister. Now that she was being trusted by strangers moved her, almost forgetting her plan.
Soon though, she came to and used all that power to focus on the azure flame bead.
The bead shone brightly and the azure flame roared stronger and stronger, into a firewall that safeguarded everyone.
Just in time to welcome the lightning.
Boom!
The fierce explosion resulting from the impact caused a violent firestorm.
While the lightning arrow’s power passed the firewall and struck Yue’er. She cried out and spat blood as she was flung in the air.
The lightning arrow was, in the end, also affected by the azure flame, shuddering and turning black.
The bearded elder felt pain shoot through his mind, threatening to split his head open. As for the lightning arrow, it was slowly coming back to him.
The azure flame bead fell to the ground as it used up all its power. The azure flame on it turned into a mote, threatened to be extinguished.
A hundred thousand divine senses were focused and through the azure flame, they stopped an Ethereal Stage expert soul’s attack. It only worked to prove the disparity in strength between Radiant Stage and Ethereal Stage.
Luo Yunhai rushed to Yue’er. Seeing her white as paper, he was worried, “Miss, how are you? Why did you come? I thought I told you to go with the Demon Scheming Sect disciples and take their treasury!”
Yue’er took a deep breath and looked at him through half-lidded eyes, “Why did you give me all your divine sense without hesitation? If I didn’t block it, you’d be all dead!”
“Uh, what’s the point of saying that now? You’re brother Zhuo’s disciple. You’re one of us. Since you came and decided to take that soul attack, no matter if it worked or not, we must show our trust by giving you all our strength.”
Luo Yunhai spoke naturally, then he looked at the bead, “Reality proved you did block it!”
Staring hard at him, Yunhai chuckled, “I planned on blocking twice, but you guys just had to give me all of your divine sense and forced me to be injured from the overflow, wasting some of it. Now I only blocked once!”
“What?!”
Startled, Luo Yunhai made a weird face, “You mean to tell me it’s my fault? You should’ve said how much divine sense you needed!”
Yue’er shook her head, “It’s the first time we met, it’s even while we’re at death’s door. How should I know you would give your life in some stranger’s hands without hesitation? I said I wanted all your divine sense expecting to get a mere third at the most. If I said half, I might have gotten a tenth. But who knew you’d be so trusting?”
Luo Yunhai shook and gave her a long look. Despite looking downcast, he saw an odd sense of glee on her. He knew why and sigh. “I see, you don’t trust anyone. But rest assured, we, Luo clan, completely trust our allies.”
Luo Yunhai stood up and once again faced the five Ethereal Stage experts with his army, “Miss, thank you for your help, but you’re hurt now and can’t take another strike. You’d best leave from here. We will stop them down to the last man!”
Yue’er looked at him and struggled to stand, walking next to him.
“Master gave us a mission. No matter what happens, you must live. I will protect you till my last breath.”
She flicked her hand and the azure flame bead landed in her palm. Yue’er stepped up before Luo Yunhai and the bead once again was ignited.
Ignoring her frail body and the blood flowing frm her mouth, Yue’er shouted, “Give me all of your divine sense! I can take another one!”
Luo Yunhai’s eyes shook and he held out his hand, “Give me the bead. You can barely stand.”
“No, it’s my mission!” Yue’er turned her head around.
Luo Yunhai sighed then turned serious, “I’ll be ashamed to face brother Zhuo after this but I must tell you. For brother Zhuo, the end justifies the means. He only cares about his goals. To him, my life is so much more precious than anyone else here, even more than his own disciple. All are worthy sacrifices. That’s why, you don’t have… “
“Why did you tell me then?” Yunhai raised an eyebrow, “It’s your honor for master to sacrifice everyone for your life.”
Luo Yunhai shook his head, “Brother Zhuo is just protecting me, but I don’t want to do this, I don’t want to live when others die. I know that brother Zhuo raised the Luo clan by himself, but he didn’t force me to walk his path. That is why, as the Luo Clan Head, I hope to bear the lives of all my clansmen and not have them shielding me. I want true righteousness and loyalty, the path of kingship. So you don’t have to admire…”
“Then don’t say it!”
Yue’er smiled, her eyes flashing, “You want to protect everyone, but you can’t stop others from protecting you. It no longer has anything to do with the mission… “
Luo Yunhai shook as he looked at Yue’er, “You…”
“I’ll use the bead master gave me to block again. No matter how it ends, with your life or death, I will do all I can.” Smiling, Yue’er said, “And this is my will, as thanks for your trust.”
Yue’er showed a rare bright smile.
Luo Yunhai cupped his hands.
The bearded elder wounded by the azure flame finally recovered and spat, “Curse you! Mere ants dared to harm my soul? I’ll make mincemeat out of you!”
“Hey, Elder Xu, you can’t even handle a few Radiant Stage cultivators yet still act tough?”
One mocked. “Why not let me handle the brats for you, lest you want to get hurt again and make you look bad, ha-ha-ha…”
The person flicked his hand and a sharp longsword hovered in the air. Its might bore down harder than the lightning arrow.
The army’s heads started hurting even before it struck.
Luo Yunhai and Yue’er were shocked, their faces sinking. Yue’er held the azure flame bead tight in her shaking hand.
[Not even the azure flame bead can stop such power…]

chapters.title: Chapter 744: Heaven, Earth, Fire, Water, Madness
chapters.content:
Chapter 744: Heaven, Earth, Fire, Water, Madness
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Nation-crushing Sword!”
With a flash of contempt in his eyes, the person flicked his hand and the longsword fell from the heavens above. The powerful pressure slapped into the soldiers, halting their breaths.
In addition to the pressure, the sharp sword also had a piercing soul power that caused their head to hurt as it burrowed into their minds.
Luo Yunhai’s expression turned heavy and he looked at the shaking Yue’er in front of him. He came next to her and snatched the azure flame bead, then shouted, “Soldiers, give me all your divine sense!”
“Yes!”
Flying Tiger Army shouted in response as everyone powered their power like a tornado into Luo Yunhai. Luo Yunhai shivered, almost unable to take it all as blood seeped from his mouth. But he didn’t care, focusing all the power into the bead.
The azure flame once again exploded, releasing a large fire snake.
Yue’er cried out, “What are you doing? Give it back now!”
“Ha-ha-ha, it’s too late.”
Luo Yunhai chuckled. “Miss, I now control the bead and only I can maintain its power. If you take it, then the defense will fail and I’ll suffer its backlash, dropping dead. You’re brother Zhuo’s disciple, so I don’t think you’re going to make such a rash decision.”
“You…” Yue’er’s heart tightened, giving up soon after. She should have been the one defending him, but now…
Luo Yunhai chuckled, “Miss, hurry up and leave. If I die, then just tell brother Zhuo it has nothing to do with you. There is no way I can hide behind a woman’s skirt in the face of danger. I am the Luo Clan Head!”
Luo Yunhai shouted and focused all his energy. The azure flame on the bead went crazy as it flooded out of it. The Flying Tiger Army was also standing at the ready, to face their enemy!
Yue’er was stunned, and then added her own soul power to Luo Yunhai.
“Miss…” Luo Yunhai started, “With your wounds, how can you do such a thing? Just leave this place while you can!”
Yue’er frowned as she turned stubborn, “Master gave me that bead and there’s no way I’m leaving here without it! We’ll stop the soul attack then you’ll return it.”
Luo Yunhai looked at her deeply then shook his head with a sigh.
“Cocky much? You actually want to stop my dipper sword soul?” The person snickered at them. “I’m unlike that Elder Xu, in the 3rd layer, nor is my soul weaker. You have no chance of blocking it with your cultivation!”
The person shouted and the sword soul increased its plunge.
The heavy pressure increased even more, making the earth crack under their feet and kicking up a cloud of dust. The azure flames were shaking before it struck, about to crumble at any second and making Luo Yunhai and the army cough blood. The azure flame snake was also weaker.
The person had a sadistic smile as he watched them suffer.
His power was far stronger than the previous one. They may be a hundred thousand but it was not enough to even take one of his attacks.
They were going to perish, without a doubt.
Shaking his head, Luo Yunhai turned to Yue’er, “Miss, it seems you lost your chance to leave. We shall die together.”
“Is dying alongside me not fitting for Clan Head?” Yue’er cocked an eyebrow.
Luo Yunhai chuckled, “No, this may be the only upside in our demise.”
Yue’er grinned and closed her eyes as she waited for the sword to drop.
The terrible pressure had sapped most of the azure flame’s power. The glinting swordedge came closer and closer, ready to crush this hundred thousand army.
“Yue’er!” Yue Ling cried out, wanting to help, but she still had an opponent to deal first. All she could do was watch her baby sister die.
The other Demon Scheming Sect experts were tangled in their own battles and could not give aid either.
The disaster seemed imminent. Zhuo Fan, who fought Sect Leader Xuan, had no intention of helping either.
Though he could do it in an instant, he did not. He wanted to see after all these years if the elders and venerables he arranged would jump to the rescue.
If they proved unable, he would give them a thorough lesson back home. If they proved unwilling…
[A house cleanup is in order!]
“Luo Clan Head, did you know? I’ve always been someone’s burden, unable to die even when I wanted to. Then I met master and my life finally changed. Though there hasn’t been much to change my mind. But now, I want to live on, just when I’m about to die…”
Yue’er no longer looked at the sword and closed her eyes as she felt death creeping in, “Is it karma, or providence?”
Luo Yunhai gave her a deep look and held her hand, “Death may come at any time. All that matters is that you make it worth it. Though now, in the face of death, I don’t think it’s that bad.”
Pff!
Yue’er giggled, no longer afraid of what was to come.
Face twitching, the elder of the sword soul was annoyed.
[For god’s sake, if there’s one thing I hate most, it’s seeing couples getting all lovey-dovey before death. Stop ignoring me!]
He made a sign and the sword soul sped up, its sharpness making their heads hurt. Their time of death was swiftly approaching.
However, a burning light flashed and a scorching ball of fire appeared before the two, striking the heavy sword soul.
Boom!
The longsword and the fireball separated, but their power swept the area, making the weaker Ethereal Stage experts falter back.
Whoosh~
The longsword returned to the person’s side and caused him to shiver as blood spilled from his mouth. He stared back in anger.
“Hi-hi-hi, it seems to me the Luo clan got itself a madam. That’s a cause for celebration, ha-ha-ha!” An elegant figure in white floated down before the army.
Luo Yunhai was overjoyed, “Sister Xue!”
Xue Qingjian looked rather pale at this moment, her breathing ragged. Yet she still put on a smile.
