Qiu Yanhai coughed, wiping the blood and walked next to her, “Clan Head, we came to help Steward Zhuo. So could you possibly keep your mind on track?”
“Old Qiu, that’s my line.” A mocking voice came from the side, Li Jingtian. “In the Luo clan, you’re one of the few couples back home.”
“True, true…”
“Indeed…”
On the other side were Heaven and Earth Sages, expressing their approval of Li Jingtian’s words.
Seeing everyone here, Luo Yunhai was overjoyed. Yue’er was stunned. She knew Ethereal Stage battles were savage, so how did they finish their fights so fast?
But looking at them closer, they could see blood.
Luo Yunhai’s brow shook, “Elder Li, how could you…”
Looking at the blood on him, Li Jingtian chuckled, “It’s nothing. This is just the price for cutting the fighting short.”
“What?”
Luo Yunhai looked at the five of them and saw each bearing a wound, some even a dozen, but they did not care. This made him tear up.
He knew they risked their own lives by forgoing their battles to save him.
This great favor filled him with gratitude.
Zhuo Fan grinned. Heaven, earth, water, fire and madness, the five High Venerables he got for the Luo clan didn’t let him down…

chapters.title: Chapter 745: Strongest Five Elders
chapters.content:
Chapter 745: Strongest Five Elders
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Whoosh~
Two dozen more Ethereal Stage experts showed up on the six’s side. They were now thirty Ethereal Stage experts!
Eight were in the 6th layer, ten in the 5th, and the rest were in the 4th and 3rd layer. While on Luo Yunhai’s side, only Li Jingtian and the sages were in the 6th, with the power couple in the 5th.
The Luo clan was at a clear disadvantage. Mystical Heaven Sect’s thirty Ethereal Stage experts had them surrounded with a look of scorn.
“Where’s the fire? Ha-ha-ha, you ran all the way over here, just to save some Radiant Stage and Profound Heaven cultivators? Now you’re in an even worse state, with them as your shackles that seal your fate.”
An elder with a large mustache laughed.
The five did not care. Li Jingtian turned to Luo Yunhai, “Clan Head, take Flying Tiger Army away. We’ll stop them from coming after you.”
“Five stopping thirty?” Yue’er cried, “No way! They have experts stronger than you!”
Qiu Yanhai mocked, “Lass, don’t lump us with your rowdy Demon Scheming Sect elders. Our words to Clan Head are just like in the military. We do what we say. We won’t let one of them slip past us, or my head is on the line.”
Yue’er looked at him hard.
[Are the Luo clan’s rules that strict?]
Five holding back thirty was pushing it beyond their limits. It was simply one to six.
[And now they add another harsher condition, to not let anyone slip by?]
Luo Yunhai nodded heavily, “Then I’ll leave it to Venerables. We’ll go join the Demon Scheming Sect at the treasury!”
Luo Yunhai pulled Yue’er’s soft hand and flew away. “Flying Tiger Army, with me!”
“Yes, sir!”
The soldiers shouted and converged, following Luo Yunhai outside of Ethereal Stage experts’ range.
Yue’er was frantic, watching the five in worry, “Y-you truly believe they can fight one on six?”
“Ha-ha-ha, don’t worry. They are the strongest force brother Zhuo left for the Luo clan, they’re Luo clan guardians, keeping their word. If they said it’s alright, then it’s all in their hands.”
Luo Yunhai kept pulling Yue’er’s hand as he flew away.
Li Jingtian chuckled, then his eyes turned savage, “With Clan Head safe, we can let loose!”
“Humph, show off. So you’re telling me you couldn’t go all out before?” One Ethereal Stage expert mocked, “Did you forget who gave you that fresh wound?”
Qiu Yanhai sneered, “We got hurt on purpose. How else were we supposed to save Clan Head? That was your only shot at harming us.”
“Indeed.”
An elder with white hair stepped out, his dreadful aura made him the strongest. “You five do stand out of the crowd, stronger than the common Ethereal Stage experts. But you forget, you were in a deadlock before you saved the juniors, and couldn’t get any advantage either. And now, you are much more tired than us. You’ll be fighting one against five. You’re finished!”
The five just cracked up.
“Why are you laughing? Aren’t I right?” The old man asked.
Li Jingtian nodded, “Ha-ha-ha, right, you’re totally right. Though, that was when we fought alone.”
The elder had a sinking feeling.
“Who knew the day would come for old coots like us that would need us to work together, ha-ha-ha…” Qiu Yanhai chuckled and said, “In any case, we’re also fighting for Steward Zhuo this time around, who showed us so much favor all this time. We best not drag our behinds any longer or Clan Head might actually suffer and we’ll be worse off.”
The other four grinned, “Sure.”
Heaven and Earth Sages made a sign and one black and one white glow each shot from them. The two used this shining light to vanish.
When the light dispersed, the scenery around the thirty enemies changed. There was no more clamor of the fights from other people, just a world in shades of gray.
“Shit, this is a domain soul. We have to get out of here before we fall victim any further!” One elder shouted.
The others took out their souls, a glittering display of swords, spears, axes and other weapons.
“It won’t change anything. The two had a domain soul but we will smash it with thirty souls attacking it at once! “
The others shouted as well but when they took out their souls to attack, the world shifted. Black and white kept changing and turning their power into nothing. Even their soul power was being consumed.
Outside the domain, the sages stood before the black and white ball as it spun around, “Ha-ha-ha, our domain is the Yin-yang Reversal. Your strength will be sapped from the constant change, given back to the world. Until you have nothing left and your soul crumbles. You’ve got no chance in forcing your way out.”
The elder startled and thought of another way, “Don’t waste your energy, or the domain will take it. Gather your soul power together and breach the domain. We’re thirty Ethereal Stage experts! It can’t dissipate so much power all at once.”
“Ha-ha-ha, right you are. Yin-yang Reversal has the yin and yang characteristics. No matter how many people are inside, their power will be taken away if acting alone. But together, you can get out.”
Heaven Sage mocked, turning to Li Jingtian, “They’re about to join hands and won’t be able to hold it. You should fight as well.”
“Ha-ha-ha, well said.”
Li Jingtian’s black aura surged and roared. A black dragon took to the skies and shot into the black and hite ball. “Soul variant, Necro Dragon Chained Claw!”
Roar!
As the soul power of all inside the domain gathered, a draconic roar entered their ears.
Before they could figure out what was happening, black claws fell from above like spears. They carried a sinister power as they pelted their souls and forced them to scatter.
Everyone coughed blood and grew pale. The weaker ones took it harder, their souls gone from this world.
The other cried out in fear. They never thought a large-scale attack would hold so much power in each strike.
In a blink, the thirty Ethereal Stage experts were reduced to around half.
What they didn’t know was while they were scared inside the dual ball, Li Jingtian was spent outside, gasping, “It’s not easy taking on so many. Old Qiu, I leave the rest to you two.”
“Tch, of course you’d be exhausted taking out half!”
Qiu Yanhai grinned, “Old Li, you’re just showing off. Wasn’t there five of us? It should be one to six.”
“Fine, then don’t join and leave the rest to the sages.” Elder Li rolled his eyes.
Now, though, Qiu Yanhai’s face fell, “No way. Since you got half, how can I fall short?”
Qiu Yanhai turned to Xue Qingjian with desire, about to spew fire.
Xue Qingjian shook her head and giggled. She rolled her eyes.
[Looks who’s showing off now!]
The two made their signs as one hot and one cold soul came out and made contact. In a blink, they became a scorching and bright light as it shot for the domain.
[Yin-yang Convergence, World Annihilation…]

chapters.title: Chapter 746: Winning With Fewer Numbers
chapters.content:
Chapter 746: Winning With Fewer Numbers
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Hu~
A fierce gale blew over, even as the remaining experts in the domain shivered in fear. They thought they’d see the claws again, but this time, what welcomed them was a blinding light.
Its heat was burning them even before it reached them as it turned everything in its wake to cinder. This astonishing power had shaken their hearts with dread.
One elder warned, “Be careful and don’t get near it!”
[Thank you for stating the obvious, but how are we supposed to keep our distance?]
They all looked for a place to flee but then someone looked on in fear…
“Why is it becoming bigger?”
“Fool, it’s not becoming bigger, it’s the domain shrinking! We got nowhere to dodge! The people looked around in panic as the white scorching light closed in and only exacerbated their fears.”
“Agh!”
One could no longer escape and got too close to the light, disintegrating on the spot, starting with the hand.
The others watched in shock as he was slowly erased from existence, yet none came to help. They knew they would be next.
“Use your souls!”
At the shout, their eyes lit with hope. Yet none liked to be the first to test that theory.
So without a choice, the one who shouted used his soul first to strike the light.
Bam!
However, the soul melted on contact with the light, vanishing as well.
The people’s eyes bugged out, no one wanting to risk it any more.
So, the light closed in more and more, unaffected by the soul attack it took just now. Its scorching heat was taking one soul at a time.
Cries sounded that filled the rest with even more dread.
Finally, only four remained, in the 5th and 6th layer, watching the light as they prepared to die.
“Curses, if I’m going to die, I’m going to make you pay! Soul explosion!”
One elder with bloodshot eyes roared. The scarlet longsword shot for the white light, scattering in an explosion after making contact. The old man’s soul was gone and his body slumped to the ground.
But the white light shook now, with Qiu Yanhai and Xue Qingjian frowning outside the domain, with blood leaking from their mouths.
But to intimidate the remaining three, they held on, covering up the weakness of the light.
Watching the light coming after them still, the three were deathly pale. With their souls unable to do anything to it, they were out of options.
They gnashed their teeth and spat, “Since we’re going to die, we’ll go out with a bang!”
Someone had his soul explode against the light, then the second.
Qiu Yanhai and Xue Qingjian kept spurting blood.
Now that only one elder remained, he clenched his teeth, ready to die as well, but then the light puffed out.
The elder looked dumbly, then knew what happened. Regret took him.
The white light feared soul explosion. If they used it from the start, then many would’ve survived. But everyone only thought about themselves and none wanted to sacrifice their lives for another until they had no chance but to go down fighting, when it was too late.
The elder shook his head and sighed. Now what could he do alone?
Outside the domain, the white light faded and turned into cold and hot lights as they returned to the power couple.
The two spat more blood, “That’s it. We can’t take it anymore. Those guys are insane, going for suicide.”
“We can’t hold on much longer either. This domain is made of our souls. With so many explosions, we’ve been injured as well.”
Blood leaked from the sages’ mouths and looked within. “There’s just one guy left. Let him out and just beat him up.”
“Agreed.” The others nodded and the sages undid their domain.
The elder saw the light of day once more, but now he was the picture of solitude.
Everyone on the battlefield looked over and saw how thirty got trapped and now only one survived. The shock was palpable.
But the lone survivor had no time to even stand straight as the five were on him in a blink.
Boom!
Fire, water, savagery, yin and yang, all came down on his head like heaven’s wrath. In moments, the old guy did not even have the chance to take a breath of fresh air before he was put down, his body gone.
Every onlooker stood there dumbfounded.
[Who are they to be so strong? Killing thirty by themselves?]
The Mystical Heaven Sect was stunned, the Demon Scheming Sect was looking dumbly, and even Zhuo Fan flinched. Then he nodded.
[These five sure are strong. I didn’t waste all that effort after all.]
Not even he thought they would make such an effective team.
Yue’er kept looking back and now was stumped as well, he stammered at Luo Yunhai, “T-they…”
“Ha-ha-ha, brother Zhuo taught three of them himself, while the other two merely gave them hints. That’s why they became our first generation of venerables.”
Luo Yunhai chuckled, “They are stubborn and prideful people, always acting alone, but they actually joined hands this time.”
Yue’er sighed, “They’re all freaks.”
“Like master, like disciple. They never became brother Zhuo’s true disciples. Who’s to say what his disciples would become later on? Maybe even stronger, ha-ha-ha. Calling them freaks is a bit premature.” Luo Yunhai chuckled.
Yue’er’s face grew hard, “But master doesn’t seem to care much about us. He also said that he only got into the Demon Scheming Sect because of the Sect Leader’s deal…”
“Oh, acting cool. Let me tell you what I know from my time with brother Zhuo. He does care about you, ha-ha-ha…” Luo Yunhai chuckled.
Yue’er gave him a long look and smiled.
“Kill!”
In front of them, someone started shouting. They saw Kui Gang’s team fighting Mystical Heaven Sect disciples.
They all had around the same cultivation, making the fighting bitter and harsh.
Luo Yunhai shouted, “Flying Tiger Army, wing formation. Charge! “
“Yes, sir!”
The soldiers followed Luo Yunhai’s lead into battle.
They were like wolves among sheep. One side had forty thousand men, the other a hundred thousand war puppets. One side was made of secluded disciples, while the others were veterans of war.
Despite the similar cultivation, the outcome was obvious.
Luo Yunhai’s Flying Tiger Army turned the previous deadlock into a win. Flying Tiger Army was like a cleaver, cutting its way through Mystical Heaven Sect disciples, leaving Kui Gang’s side stumped.
[Fricking hell, master, how are master’s clansmen so strong? They’re at the same level as us but so much better in group battles. That’s what it means to be in the military. ]
Kui Gang directed the Demon Scheming Sect disciples to attack as well, and the Mystical Heaven Sect disciples had no way of stopping such brutal assault.
Soon, they arrived before the treasury, but the gates were closed tight.
“We’re here!” Luo Yunhai lit up and ordered, “Attack the treasury and cut off their supplies!”
Roar!
The men shouted, even the Demon Scheming Sect disciples, all excited about burning it to the ground.
However, in a yellow flash, an immense power swept them and spread blood and gore in every direction.
Ten thousand died just like that, with thousands being from the tough Flying Tiger Army.
An aged voice sounded, “Who dares come to my treasury?”

chapters.title: Chapter 747: Heaven Cycle Elders
chapters.content:
Chapter 747: Heaven Cycle Elders
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Sharp winds blew as four old guys came out of nowhere. Their backs crooked, their eyes lidded, and sitting cross-legged before everyone.
The powerful auras coming off them made the army not dare take a step closer.
Luo Yunhai frowned, his heart tense as he clenched his fists. He never imagined the number of Demon Scheming Sect elders Zhuo Fan brought at the Main Hall would not make all the experts of this sect converge there. At least these four had stayed behind.
And from their vibes, they were in the Ethereal Stage. Yunhai was now pensive, unsure how to proceed.
Li Jingtian’s team looked from afar at the four and cried out, “Damn it, t-those are…”
The five shot for Luo Yunhai’s side, growing serious.
Luo Yunhai did not know the four’s power, since he was not at their stage to even feel it. But Li Jingtian found they were actually in the 9th layer of Ethereal Stage, just shy of reaching Soul Harmony Stage.
For these kind of experts to show up, and four of them, not even them, as Ethereal Stage experts in their rights, could beat them.
There was no way their weak Clan Head could even touch them.
Li Jingtian’s team of five rushed over at top speed, afraid their Clan Head would die the next second.
Zhuo Fan looked over and was worried for the first time, yet he did not have the chance to interfere. The long spear was coming for him once more.
With little choice in the matter, Zhuo Fan continued directing Almighty Scarlet Dragon King to flick its tail, sending it away. He turned around to go there, but he saw Sect Leader Xuan’s sinister smile.
“Humph, Zhuo Fan, if you had just escaped, with so many people showing the way, I had no way of stopping you. But you just had to be so greedy and started fighting. Now our four High Venerables came out, leaving you no chance of escape, ha-ha-ha…” Sect Leader Xuan cackled.
Zhuo Fan gave the four old guys a long look, “Four Ethereal Stage experts in the 9th layer sure are amazing, but only a smidgen better than Sect Leader’s 8th layer cultivation. And you think they’ll turn the battle around? Think again!”
“Ha-ha-ha, a smidgen you say? Zhuo Fan, then you don’t know much about western lands, do you? You have no idea of my sect’s power.” Sect Leader Xuan smirked, pointing at the four as he mocked, “Then feast your eyes on their power, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan looked harder then his brow shook.
The four old guys still had their eyes closed, sitting there in midair.
They sat in a three meter circle spinning around. Each elder released a special glow, red, green, white, golden. As the four lights merged following a certain pace, it turned into a blinding earthen light.
Following the roar of a dragon, an earthen colored dragon flew around the four of them. The ground constantly shook, feeling like the rapids on a stormy sea.
The Radiant Stage and Profound Heaven cultivators couldn’t even sit straight. As the earthen glow shone, they felt their innards shake and started puking blood. Many of them had their eyes roll into their skull and dropped dead.
In a mere blink, thousands died. Yet the four old guys didn’t look like they moved at all, just sitting there as they moved in circle with eyes closed.
Luo Yunhai cried out, “Get in the air and away from those four! Don’t let their wave strike you!”
No one was a fool here and rushed into the air and away from the yellow curtain of light.
“Ha-ha-ha, why would us four care about bugs like you lot, as they scurry away? But this time you dared to invade Mystical Heaven Sect and came for the treasury! As the highest Venerables in the sect, the four of us can’t ignore this transgression!”
One elder smiled, making all of the four old guys change their signs they made. They finally moved, or more precise, their circle moved.
Even though they never cracked an eyelid, spinning around in a circle, the invisible circle formed felt more like a wide disk. It whooshed over the crowd and the yellow dragon looming overhead spun with them. But the powerful force made by the constant spinning slammed into everyone in its path.
No one had time to react as blood and gore flew every which way. The spinning yellow disk just went right through a group and mowed down thousands of people, reducing them to a bloody pulp. The disk made a return trip and thousands more received the same gruesome death.
In just one move, ten thousand people lay dead.
Everyone was too shocked to react, filled with fear as they watched the yellow disk.
Luo Yunhai was also overwhelmed. Seeing the disk so deadly, as it reaped through his men’s lives, his heart was panicking.
By the time he reacted, thirty thousand men were gone from this world. He shouted, “Break formation! Everyone flee! We can’t beat them! Save yourselves!”
He gave the Flying Tiger Army a signal and everyone scattered.
“Oh, the commander survived.” One old man smiled, sending the disk straight for Luo Yunhai this time.
Luo Yunhai rushed to flee. Yue’er and Kui Gang wanted to dodge but had no way of reacting to Ethereal Stage experts’ speeds.
In a blink, the disk was upon them. Feeling that raw fear its power sent, Kui Gang shook his head, “My poor life is now over. Just why did master have to attack Mystical Heaven Sect? Is it really just to teach them a lesson? It looks to me that we’re the one on the receiving end.”
Luo Yunhai did not speak, but his eyes were firm.
Even he didn’t know why Zhuo Fan wanted to do this, but since he planned for it, he would see it through to the end. This was the unflinching trust the Luo clan had for him.
Even now, with death looming overhead, he still had no regrets.
Whoosh~
Suddenly, a familiar figure blocked Luo Yunhai’s sight. It was no other than Yue’er, “Miss, it’s not use. It’s not like before. Being in front or back won’t make a difference.”
Yue’er said nothing, just stood there unrelenting.
Luo Yunhai decided to stand by her. “Why not, stand together? That way, maybe brother Zhuo’s other disciple might be able to come out alive behind us.”
“I’m Kui Gang!” Kui Gang rolled his eyes and stood next to them, “Before we die, you should at least know my name. Master was too busy and had no time to make the introductions before. Dying without even knowing my name is such a miserable fate.”
“Then I’m Luo Yunhai, the Luo Clan Head!” Luo Yunhai laughed.
Yue’er smiled, “Yue’er, Demon Scheming Sect disciple.”
“Ha-ha-ha, young lads, so close even before death. No wonder you’re so amazing leading these kids.”
The elders from the circle overheard them and laughed, “But that still won’t mean you’re going to live. It’s your fault for not being our disciples, ha-ha-ha…”
Whoosh~
The strong disk flew at them, just an inch from turning them into a bloody smear on the ground.
The trio closed their eyes, ready to meet their doom.
However, the three found that nothing happened to them even after a while. While the strong power was suddenly gone from their front.
When they opened their eyes, they saw a white and black ball spinning in front. Not far from them, the sages had their hands locked in a sign and looking tense.
Yin-yang Reversal!
In this critical moment, the Heaven and Earth Twin Sages intervened, using their domain soul to isolate the area around the four old guys.
However, this action had made the two suffer for it…

chapters.title: Chapter 748: Four Earth Dragons
chapters.content:
Chapter 748: Four Earth Dragons
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Elders, thank you…”
Luo Yunhai’s eyes shone and laughed. He cupped his hands but the sages shouted, “Elder Li, don’t just stand there, get them out of there!”
Whoosh~
A black figure flashed and before the trio could react, a thick hand grabbed their shoulders and got them out.
It was no other than Li Jingtian.
“Elder Li…” Li Jingtian looked stunned, but seeing his heavy look, he did not finish.
He followed Li Jingtian’s gaze to see the sages shake then cough blood while their domain soul instantly collapsed.
Roar~!
The world shook as four dragons roamed above the Mystical Heaven Sect. They broke out of the domain and circled around before vanishing as they returned to the four elders.
While the spinning circle, the yellow dragon, was still there and just as powerful. The four elders sitting in the air did not show any sign of disturbance.
The sages looked at the four and revealed fear on their faces.
“Ha-ha-ha, I never knew they had people that can use such a domain soul. It’s our first time seeing such a soul; such a rarity.”
One elder chuckled, “A shame you’re too weak. You’ve been taxed before attacking us and were injured. Or you might have made us get serious.”
Another elder nodded, “This soul domain sure is fantastic. Using yin and yang to turn the world around. An average cultivator would’ve had no way to cope with it. However, this domain’s weakness is glaring. It’s great for wearing the enemy out, but also leaving him with enough time to deal with it.”
The other three nodded, discussing things as if the sages weren’t even in their radar.
“If not for this, I would’ve actually wanted to see what they looked like.”
“Humph, fogies sure know how to talk. So you’re saying we’re not worth a glance from you, is that it?”
However, following the shout of anger at the four, a gaudy white light shot for them, “Why don’t you old freaks look at this then?”
Whoosh!
Like an arrow from above, a searing heat approached the four old guys.
Boom!
Once the glaring light was gone, the four’s position became a white ball of light, making the air shimmer from the heat.
Qiu Yanhai and Xue Qingjian panted as they looked over as grave as before. They knew the four were by no means dead even from the Life and Death Art they just used. But when the light scattered, the couple still gasped in shock, “H-how can this be!”
The elders were still spinning around, relaxed as ever. Their eyes were closed still, their mouths perked in a mocking smile.
The yellow dragon above was still circling, unphased.
The couple trembled all over, their hearts sinking.
They had been hurt before they attacked just now but that Life and Death Art was a strike backed by all their power. Even so, it couldn’t even scratch them, nor make them budge.
To the four elders, the couple was not even worth a look.
Everyone felt terror at this moment. They were just no match for them.
Zhuo Fan looked over and frowned, “Four earth dragon souls?”
“That’s precisely it!” Sect Leader Xuan laughed, “Didn’t I tell you? While you don’t know of western lands’ sects’ powers, you at least should know of the Demon Scheming Sect’ High Venerable.”
Zhuo Fan looked long at him and nodded. “I heard of him but never saw him.”
“Ha-ha-ha, then allow me to tell you. In the western lands, we are known as Tianyu’s three guardian sects, with each sect their own guardians.”
Sect Leader Xuan spoke with pride, “One Sword Five Dragons is the name our guardians go by.”
“What? You mean to say…”
Han Qianying cried out in disbelief. “I’ve always thought it to be just a rumor. But it’s real? Then the four venerables are them?”
Dan’er asked from the side, “Senior sister, what are you talking about? Why don’t I know this?”
“You haven’t been in the sect for long so of course you don’t know.” High Venerable shook her head, “Some elders of the sects know that our sect has four great venerables defending our home, Heavenly Cycle Elders. Demon Scheming Sect’s elusive Sacred Dragon is equally renowned. But with how much time has passed and they didn’t show themselves, everyone stopped believing this rumor…”
High Venerable turned to the four sitting elders with fear and despair, “If they come out, not even the Demon Scheming Sect’s entire force can beat them. Even with the High Venerable, we still won’t win.”
“Ha-ha-ha, exactly. They are truly Mystical Heaven Sect’s elders, knowing when to gauge the situation.”
Sect Leader Xuan laughed, “One Sword Five Dragons, Tianyu’s three guardian sects, is made of Heavenly Sword, guarding Heaven Trailing Sect. Of the five dragons, four of them are Wood Dragon, Fire Dragon, Ice Dragon, Metal Dragon, the four elders in our sect. This leaves the Demon Scheming Sect’s only High Venerable, Hidden Dragon. Although he is said to be the strongest of the five dragons, how can one defeat a team of four? Thinking back when he with the Impermanence Five attacked the Heavenly Cycle Elders, they were defeated. So even if he shows up, we have nothing to fear!”
Zhuo Fan squinted as he spoke heavily, “So these four great experts that were always in hiding finally came out.”
“Humph, our four venerables have been in seclusion for years and years, readying to enter Soul Harmony Stage. But with your assault, they had no choice but to come.”
Sect Leader Xuan snarked, “Zhuo Fan, you and your men will die here, ha-ha-ha…”
Xuan Shaoyu was bouncing from joy. “Zhuo Fan, a vile fiend like you dared to attack a righteous sect and now you see the power we have, ha-ha-ha…”
Seeing the father and sun so full of themselves. Zhuo Fan stayed silent.
[My head is still sitting on my shoulder. Aren’t you two jumping the gun a little?]
He then turned an eyebrow at the four old guys.
[They sure are strong. Guess these two aren’t that full of it either.]
“Agh~!”
Cries resounded after Li Jingtian saved the trio. Luo clan’s Ethereal Stage experts arrived there as well. Thirty six people surrounded the four.
However, the four made a sign and the dragon roared. As they spun around in a circle, dragons came out of them and then made a round trip back.
Each time it did, a dragon soul would always take at least a victim. The powerful earth dragon soul along with the might of this combination made these Ethereal Stage experts feel like entering hell.
They couldn’t even get near the circle, ending up dead before they could do anything.
Everyone was shocked, even Demon Scheming Sect’s oldies, Knowing the four were the High Venerables and also known as the four dragons, they were struck with fear.
[Since High Venerable can’t beat them, we’re only going there to die!]
Mystical Heaven Sect’s group came out from their disadvantage with high morale. Their support was here.
“I never knew these old devils weren’t just rumors. Four earth dragon souls and even forming a Heaven Cycle Array… How to cope with it?”
Han Qianying sighed. She looked at Kui Lang protecting her, “Kui Lang, it seems we’ll only be together for a brief moment.”
OLo!1ao
Kui Lang held her hand, “With you by my side, a moment is enough.”
Han Qianying gave a bright smile and nodded.
The onlookers were gratified but also sad. The two’s feelings never changed after all these years, yet when they reunited, they were about to be separated once more.
Demon Scheming Sect’s defeat meant their deaths.
Sect Leader Xuan’s side snickered.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes were the only ones bright. He took a deep breath.
[I really really didn’t want to do this, but what choice is there…]

chapters.title: Chapter 749: Despair and Regret
chapters.content:
Chapter 749: Despair and Regret
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Boom~
Following the string of explosions, wails of agony filled the area. The Heavenly Cycle Elders spun in the air like a disk, calm and unphased, yet with every spin, they sent out hundreds of dragon souls like a storm upon the enemy.
Luo clan’s Ethereal Stage experts had no way of approaching the four under this onslaught. In fact, they were the one getting slaughtered. In mere moments, the remaining dozen still left alive from the last attack were now gone as well.
Everyone could not believe what they saw. Even Li Jingtian, a martial fanatic, shook at such power.
Roar!
A draconic roar sounded as the yellow dragon shot for Li Jingtian. Startled, Li Jingtian flicked his hand in a rush, sending a black dragon to meet the attack.
Necro Dragon Chained Claw!
Black claws came at the yellow dragon, sharp enough to whistle through the air as they approached. However, the yellow dragon still came at him relentlessly.
Bam!
The deafening sound made the others cover their ears. Whether mistakenly or not, they even heard sounds of tearing.
The next moment, they saw Li Jingtian spit blood, his body powerless as he fell to the ground. The black dragon soul had also vanished…
“Elder Li!” Luo Yunhai shouted, his eyes shaking.
Just then, a black figure flashed before Li Jingtian, holding him before he collapsed.
Qiu Yanhai sensed the faint breath in Li Jingtian and roared, “Old bat, take young master and the others away from here. Elder Li’s soul must be almost shattered. The four old guys are impossible to deal with as we are. Hurry up and get out of here!”
“Sure, old coot.”
Whoosh~
In a flash of white, Xue Qingjian came to Qiu Yanhai. With her white silk, she wrapped it around them and left. “Sages, protect us!”
The sages’ mouth twitched, but sighed.
How were they supposed to do that against such an opponent? But when it came to Clan Head’s safety, it was their duty.
“Yin-yang Reversal Domain! Soul variant, Yin-yang World Lock!”
The two shouted and made their signs. The rattling of a chain was heard, followed by the coming of one white and one black chains, twisting around and releasing a strange aura.
In a blink, the chains circled around the Heavenly Cycle Elders and locked them in place. The circle was going to move again, but with the chains, it wouldn’t budge.
“How amusing, it’s not just as simple as a mere domain soul.” One elder spoke in amazement.
Another elder nodded, “Yin-yang chain, connecting heaven and earth. It looks like they shrunk their domain, down to the size of a chain, but it is in fact the opposite, they enlarged it. Because the chain’s yin yang energy, connecting the world, it makes us connect with it and taking out power with it, forcing us in place. I never thought these two’s domain soul would have such a variation. Truly amazing.”
“Humph, that’s right. In the Radiant Stage we have comprehended this move and even used it to seal off one true monster.” The sages smiled, recalling the time they had Gu Santong trapped with pride, “Now that we’re in the Ethereal Stage, with domain soul as support, this move is perfected. We refuse to believe you four old coots are worse than that monster and can remove the chains.”
Heaven Sage shouted at the distant couple, “Take Elder Li and Clan Head to a safe place. Leave this to us. We promise to not let these old guys leave this place before the battle is over.”
“As expected of the strongest sages in Tianyu. You truly are reliable, ha-ha-ha…” Qiu Yanhai gave a thumbs up and a laugh.
Luo Yunhai smiled as well, seeing the four old guys trapped.
However, they had no idea how much the sages were suffering.
The reason their domain soul was strong was because of its size, capable of dispersing the enemy’s power.
But now, the domain was the size of a chain. The Heavenly Cycle Elders’ mighty power made them feel a pressure like never before.
While the chains connected the world around them, shifting the pressure, but even that fraction of power left behind was enough to strain every fiber of their being. But they held on, even if their tendons broke.
They knew that if they could not hold the four freaks back, then the Clan Head was dead. That was why they would use their own lives to keep the four here.
However, none around understood this. Some Demon Scheming Sect elders saw the Heavenly Cycle Elders stuck and cried, “These secular cultivators are amazing. They actually trapped the four dragons! This isn’t possible for any Ethereal Stage cultivator in the lower three sects!”
“Yeah, yeah, just how are they so strong? No wonder they’re Steward Zhuo’s aids. They’re as weird as him.”
“But why didn’t they used this move from the start? Why wait for so many to die?”
“Yeah! Was it to show off at the last moment?”
After the admiration faded, suspicion rose. The sages’ faces twitched as they made signs.
[Who the hell would use a last ditch effort if not at the end?]
After this, it’d be a miracle if they were still alive. If not for the Clan Head being in peril, they would’ve never used it.
But how could these fools know? Not even Luo Yunhai and Qiu Yanhai knew this truth. Only Zhuo Fan saw how hard it was, touching his ring.
[Guess I do have to use it after all…]
“Ha-ha-ha, Zhuo Fan, you can’t possible think those two can stop Mystical Heaven Sect’s four guardian dragons, do you? You must be dumber than I thought.”
Zhuo Fan did not get to act as Sect Leader Xuan’s bragging caught his attention, pointing at the four elders, “Just watch and witness true despair!”
The four elders were still sitting with their eyes closed when one started, “Ha-ha-ha, ignorant juniors, don’t get too cocky. Your domain soul might have merit, but it’s nothing to us four.”
The four made different signs and the dragon soaring above increased its speed, sending wave after wave of yellow energy, rattling the yin yang chains.
The sages’ brow furrowed as they made their own signs, “No use! We have joined heaven and ear- ugh!”
Before they finished, their bodies shook and spat blood before slumping to the ground.
Boom!
With an explosion, the yellow energy rippled like a wave and crushed the yin yang chains.
“Ha-ha-ha, our souls are earth dragon souls, born of the earth. While you can make our power touch the world, we can touch upon the earth to resonate with. We drew its power and used the ones we had to attack the chains from both sides. “
The four old guys still sat there in midair. One of them smiled, “It’s not your souls that are weak, it’s because you met us that happened to have the way to deal with you.”
The sages were on the ground, powerless, with barely a breath left in them. Their eyes were filled with regret.
The elders never once looked at them, “The two’s souls are in a worse state and can’t move. We should first deal with those pesky bugs and finish them for good.”
The other three elders nodded.
The four spun once more and moved into the crowd of people, the Ethereal Stage experts of the two sects that were now fighting.
The minute they joined the fray, it spelled doom for the Demon Scheming Sect’s experts. Cries and wails rang everywhere.
Mystical Heaven Sect’s elders were overjoyed. With their sect guardians fighting, the tables had turned. Demon Scheming Sect’s early advantage was now crushed.
The faces of all the people from Demon Scheming Sect was now painted in the bleak colors of despair and regret…

chapters.title: Chapter 750: Ace
chapters.content:
Chapter 750: Ace
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Agh~!”
Wails and mournful cries kept echoing about.
Roar~!
Among them, there were also cheers.
One side was happy, the other was in the pits of despair as the four old freaks struck the Demon Scheming Sect side hard. Mystical Heaven Sect’s people were roaring their joy.
In a flash, Demon Scheming Sect’s tens of experts fell dead, their morale crushed. Some were so taken by fear that they lost all will to fight, resorting to fleeing.
Defeat looked certain.
“Zhuo Fan, what do we do? We’ll lose if this keeps up. We have to get away!” Fiend Yang came to Zhuo Fan to report this disaster, “My eastern side is on the brink of collapse!”
Venerable Bai and others came flying as well, “The western side is almost finished. The Heavenly Cycle Elders rain death wherever they go. We can’t go on!”
“Steward Zhuo, the path forward is almost shut. We should unite our forces and break through before it’s too late!” Venerable Qi urged.
Zhuo Fan spoke, “It’s pointless even if we do get away from them. Our tactic to get in and attack from the inside now has us trapped in their defensive array. We’re left with only one option, to either win or die.”
“You mean there’s no point even if we try? We can’t break Mystical Heaven Sect’s array? Are we going to die here?” Venerable Qi wailed.
Fiend Yang took a deep breath to calm down then stared hard at Zhuo Fan, “Then what should we do? Are we really going to fight to the death?”
“Of course not. Take down the leader and the rest will follow.” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone as he stared at Sect Leader Xuan.
They all started, getting his meaning.
[Of course, we just have to grab that old weasel and the Mystical Heaven Sect will give in.]
Seeing the bloodthirst in their eyes, Sect Leader Xuan got their plan and mocked as he retreated, “Ha-ha-ha, you want me? You would never reach me!”
“He-he-he, we’ll only know when we try!” Fiend Yang snickered, “Brothers, attack! Get that old coot! Our lives depend on it!”
Roar!
They all shouted knowing they had a way out and focused all their power, flying straight for Sect Leader Xuan. Their eyes were that of a thug eying a hot girl.
Sect Leader Xuan shivered and turned grave. At a critical time like this, he became the sole focus of everyone. Everyone wanted him as a shield.
Mystical Heaven Sect’s experts saw their Sect Leader was in danger and came to help.
So, the bitter battle had taken another huge turn. It was no longer a spread battlefield, but one with Sect Leader Xuan at its center.
Like he was the hottest commodity out here and everyone had to have a piece…
“Hi-hi-hi, Ol’ Xuan, sit tight and be a good meat shield to let us out!” Demon Scheming Sect’s thirty plus Ethereal Stage experts stared at him from a hundred meters and launched soul attacks.
Sect Leader Xuan gulped, feeling the sweat trickling down his brow. Not even he could take on so many attacks.
However, just when he was in danger, a draconic roar echoed.
In a flash of light, a sea of dragon souls rushed at them. In a single moment, howls echoed out and the thirty plus experts were now pushed back.
As for Sect Leader Xuan, in front of him was the circle of elders with the terrible yellow dragon flying above.
The Demon Scheming Sect’s side cried out, “Heavenly Cycle Elders! How did they get here so fast?”
They gathered close to Zhuo Fan, watching the four freaks. Mystical Heaven Sect’s side also focused around Sect Leader Xuan, filled with smiles of disdain.
In a blink, there was no more fighting as the parties stood in opposition. While the Mystical Heaven Sect was filled with courage, the Demon Scheming Sect was now fearful.
All because of just four very monstrous elders…
“Ha-ha-ha, Zhuo Fan, fighting you is beneath me. With Mystical Heaven Sect’s four guardians, you are finished. You want me? Humph, you’ll have to go through our venerables first!”
Sect Leader Xuan shouted in pride. Xuan Shaoyu had to show off as well, being his son and all, “Zhuo Fan, vile demon, you fooled my junior sister and are lower than a dog. I will soon have you ripped apart in tiny pieces and throw them to the wolves. Ha-ha-ha…”
Demon Scheming Sect was outraged but powerless. Their last hope was in Zhuo Fan, turning to him for a resolution.
[What now, Steward Zhuo?]
“You pushed me this far so don’t you regret it later. I’ll have to use my final ace!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed as he played with his ring.
Fiend Yang turned serious, “Zhuo Fan, are you going to fight yourself?”
“You want to fight?” Han Qianying frowned, “They have those four venerables. You can’t beat them.”
Kui Lang waved her off with a smile, “Qianying, you don’t understand Steward Zhuo. He has an ultimate move. You haven’t seen Steward Zhuo’s black flame. Any kind of freak met their maker… “
Ahe-hem…
Zhuo Fan cleared his voice before Kui Lang finished.
To be completely honest, he was also stumped on how to deal with the four elders. That black thunderflame was indeed of incredible destructive force.
But after Double Dragon Gathering, he never used it because the thunderflame needed the Decimating Golden Flame and the azure flame to be combined with purple lightning.
He had no way of getting his hands on the golden flames. The ones he got on Double Dragon Gathering were stolen from Ye Lin, not his own.
So that method was out and had no way of beating the freakish old coots.
As for the other method, it was something he stole from Double Dragon Manor, the sacred weapon. But it could only be used as a very last resort. Exposing it would paint a huge target on his back.
But Kui Lang’s words made everyone turn to him. Everyone was now eager to see what the great Steward Zhuo would reveal. Even the four freaks believed it possible, “Oh, so you’re the boss of this little rabble? Show me then, what a babe can possibly do to the four of us. I hope you can at least open our eyes, ha-ha-ha…”
“Zhuo Fan, come and challenge our venerables if you have the guts! What difference does it make since you’ll be dead anyway even if you don’t, ha-ha-ha…” Sect Leader Xuan snarked.
Zhuo Fan smiled at them all, though sighing within him, “I’ll have to disappoint you all, I don’t plan on fighting.”
The Demon Scheming Sect was stumped and shook their heads.
[Even Steward Zhuo can’t find a way?]
Zhuo Fan then continued, “However, I have to take out this ace. Remember this, you forced me to do it, so don’t go crying later!”
Zhuo Fan flicked his hand and in a glorious light, a seven year old kid showed up, Invincible Scamp Gu Santong.
With a long yawn, Gu Santong stretched his waist, looking bored at Zhuo Fan, “Dad, what took you so long? I almost fell asleep.”
“Ha-ha-ha, haven’t I taken you out now? You’re our ace. How can I just show you to them? I needed to wait for the right moment.” Zhuo Fan grinned as he showed a bright smile like an innocent child.
Gu Santong nodded, totally buying it.
The crowd, however, was stumped. Even Fiend Yang began cursing him, “What the hell? Why did you take out a kid when you were talking about an ace?”
“He is my ace!”
With an obvious nod, Zhuo Fan spoke with pride, “As a father, my son is my biggest ace. Mystical Heaven Sect, listen up and listen well. To get to me, you’ll have to go through my son first!”
Zhuo Fan’s loud voice made Gu Santong puff out his chest in pride. To hold back the flood for his old man was this kid’s greatest honor.
However, no one else here saw it that way. Both sides were stumped, looking from father to son as they cursed.
[You animal!]

chapters.title: Chapter 751: Little Monster vs. Old Freaks
chapters.content:
Chapter 751: Little Monster vs. Old Freaks
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Humph, I’ve heard so much about the best and most talented disciple in western lands, how he was so heroic at the Double Dragon Gathering. In the end, you’re hiding behind a child. You really opened my eyes in this.”
Sect Leader Xuan mocked, while the Mystical Heaven Sect was jeering at Zhuo Fan’s expense.
When disaster struck, a babe was taken out!
Demon Scheming Sect were facing a fierce enemy now but they were all veteran cultivators. They had status and respect, even as demonic cultivators. Even they wouldn’t stoop so low as to use a child to take their burdens. It was beyond disgraceful.
They all cast blaming looks at Zhuo Fan.
[This war was a big misunderstanding to begin with. We can even forget the fact you brought us to our death, but can you at least let us die with honor?]
[What the hell did we do to deserve this?]
“Uhm, Steward Zhuo, if you’re at the end of the rope, fighting to the death is much better than leaving it in the hands of a child. Are you maybe going easy on your enemy?” Venerable Qi sighed.
Fiend Yang blamed, “Zhuo Fan, I know your whole clan is a den of freaks, obvious from how this child is in the Ethereal Stage at such a young age, but he’s way too young and never knew war. It’d be better to let him escape and take revenge for us. Why must you push him forward, crushing our hopes and making a fool of yourself?”
“Hey, did you just say something, chubby? Yours truly can dish it out! Are you calling me weak?” Gu Santong wrinkled his nose in anger.
Fiend Yang sighed and rubbed Gu Santong’s head, “See that, look how much he resembles you. But no matter how strong, you can’t grow overconfident. He’s just in the Ethereal Stage, how can he fight those old freaks at peak Ethereal Stage? Have you no heart to send your child…
Gu Santong was about to blow a gasket. Zhuo Fan shook his head but said nothing.
[Fatty Yang, you asked for what’s coming. Young Sanzi won’t go easy on you.]
Pa!
Gu Santong grabbed Fiend Yang’s hand and startling him, “What is it, little guy?”
“I hate it when people touch my head!” Gu Santong gnashed his teeth, but just then, a fair hand touched his as a delicate voice spoke, “Are you young Sanzi? I heard of you.”
Startled, young Sanzi looked at the pretty lady with a stunned gaze, his hand easing his grip on Fiend Yang.
“Then, young Sanzi, our safety is in your hands.” Chu Qingcheng leaned and touched Gu Santong’s cheek. Her bright smile blew the child’s mind, nodding out of reflex.
Zhuo Fan sighed.
[No one can resist Qingcheng’s beauty, not even this brat.]
So he coughed and pointed at Chu Qingcheng, “Young Sanzi, this is my lady. She’ll be your mother from now on.”
“Mom?” Gu Santong shook and looked at Chu Qingcheng, “Great, I like her!”
Chu Qingcheng blushed and rolled her eyes at Zhuo Fan. Then she turned to the enemy, at the Heavenly Cycle Elders, and asked concerned, “Young Sanzi, can you beat them? Won’t it be hard?”
“Humph, what’s so great about some small fries?”
Gu Santong mocked, then strutted over, “Dad, mom, in half an hour I’ll make mincemeat out of them!”
Chu Qingcheng looked at him then at Zhuo Fan with red cheeks.
“Ha-ha-ha, this kid is just like his dad. He called you mom without hesitation.” Zhuo Fan chuckled.
Chu Qingcheng glared at him, but felt warm and fuzzy inside.
The others was watching the queer scene in stunned silence.
[What kind of parents sent their child to die? Even if unrelated.]
Han Qianying frowned and asked, “Qingcheng, how can you agree with Zhuo Fan, letting a child…”
“Senior sister, he’s no child.” Chu Qingcheng said, “In Tianyu, he has never lost a fight. He’s called Invincible Scamp for a reason.”
“Yeah, even I couldn’t beat this kid!”
Zhuo Fan sighed, then smiled, “Qingcheng, you sure know young Sanzi quite well.”
Chu Qingcheng smiled, “Of course. I might have come to Mystical Heaven Sect earlier, but my sisters from Drifting Flowers Edifices have sent me jade slips with all you’ve been doing in Tianyu. So the fact you have such a godlike godson, I knew as well. I just find it odd though. Just what did you use to cheat this great force to be your son?”
“Uhm, the same way I charmed the most gorgeous woman to be my wife.” Zhuo Fan grinned.
Chu Qingcheng rolled her eyes and cursed, “Since when were you such a smooth-talker?”
As the two were in a rare moment of flirting with each other, Gu Santong was a child on a mission. This monstrous scamp wearing the face of a cute child was finally unleashed on the battlefield.
Everyone stared at him, sighing and helpless. They knew Zhuo Fan was a bastard, but not without morals. To send a child on the cruel field of battle, and even calling him a glorified ace. How revolting.
Seeing that sweet little face, and those chubby hands, they all found him adorable.
[That’s no ace, but a small fry!]
Sect Leader Xuan mocked, “Is this Demon Scheming Sect’s trump card? With both parents dead, this child will have to wander alone the cruel road of cultivation? Ha-ha-ha, a shame that this won’t work on us. We may be righteous cultivators but no saints.”
“Humph, yah, this demon brat is so young and in the Ethereal Stage. It’s best to cull him now before he grows!” Xuan Shaoyu gnashed his teeth.
The Heavenly Cycle Elders agreed. One elder even shouted, “Kid, do you really want to interfere for demonic cultivators? We won’t go easy on you just because you’re young.”
“Cut the crap, I came to stomp you!” Gu Santong stuck out his head and charged.
Demon Scheming Sect was shocked and praised him.
[How brave!]
[Like father like son, they’re both stubborn.]
Mystical Heaven Sect clenched their fists, clear this was a demon in the making that was treating everyone beneath him. They had to get rid of him now.
The elder smirked and nodded, “Fine then, since you’ve been taken in by the demonic path even at your young age, then the four of us will have to cleanse you and release you from your mortal coil!”
The four made signs and with a draconic roar, a dragon soul shot for Gu Santong.
Everyone was shocked, worried for the sweet child. Then they looked at Zhuo Fan.
[Aren’t you going to rescue your own son?]
Zhuo Fan just stood there with a smile.
“Hypocrite, get in here and fight. Stop with your prattle! You’re nothing more than a bunch of hypocrites using numbers!”
Seeing the dragon about to strike, Gu Santong mocked, flicking his hand at it.
Bam!
With a loud explosion, the dragon was sent flying with a wail before anyone could react, back to its circle.
The four elders shook, not believing their eyes a child was capable of so much power to bash their earth dragon soul away.
Gu Santong wasn’t finished with his attack, he stomped and was right in front of their spinning circle. He let his almighty fist smash down on them.
Boom!
With another explosion, the yellow dragon constantly floating around the circle had its body cave in and cry in pain. Its body was broken and turned into pretty lights before vanishing.
As for the circle, with the vanishing of the dragon, the power of his strike traveled straight for the four, who lifted a hand to block.
Bam~
The four were sent hundreds of meters away. They were forced to open their eyes at last, having no luxury to show off any longer.
Looking at Gu Santong, they had shock painted on their faces.
“W-what the hell are you?”
“Oh, you weren’t blind? I thought you were cripples so I held back. Damn fakers, ruining my sympathy. Now I see there’s no need to anymore.”
Gu Santong clenched his fist and mocked.
The audience was still very much out of it after seeing a seven year old brat punch the four old freaks.
[No wonder Steward Zhuo says he’s his ace. He was serious!]
[But what the hell, there’s just one freakier than the next!]
Looking from Gu Santong to Zhuo Fan, they sighed, having no idea what to call them anymore.
[How are we supposed to make a living with so many monsters around…]

chapters.title: Chapter 752: Ender
chapters.content:
Chapter 752: Ender
Proofreader
: Papatonks
A shock like no other overrode their minds and all common sense.
Everyone was now watching with empty eyes as Gu Santong stood in the air.
“Z-Z-Zhuo Fan, what the hell is that kid of yours?” Fiend Yang gulped. The others were looking at the grand Steward Zhuo with overwhelming emotions.
He did not reply and ordered instead, “Everyone scatter! Get some distance from them!”
Zhuo Fan was the first to move back, with others quick to react, flying a thousand meters. While the Mystical Heaven Sect’s side were still too stunned to react, not even noticing their movements. They just stood there, watching Gu Santong with a dumb look.
“This distance should be safe.”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Do you know why I had young Sanzi come out now to fight?”
They just shook their empty minds, still dazed.
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Because this kid has a foul temper and mean strength. Once he gets worked up, nothing can stop him. Our main objective you all know, is to teach Mystical Heaven Sect a lesson, crush their attitude, not destroy them. Or Double Dragon Manor will not sit still.”
The oldies nodded. No matter how many conflicts there were between sects, Double Dragon Manor would never allow for them to blow out into a bloody war and weaken the western lands.
“Only as a last resort could I let this troublesome kid out. Or one strike from him could even wipe this thousands of years old sect off the face of this world.”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “A shame they just don’t listen, insisting on making me take out my last move. They reap what they sow. It’s not my fault at all.”
[Dude, we’re the invaders here.]
Fiend Yang scratched his nose and felt helpless.
[Steward Zhuo is such a dirtbag. He has no morals. You came here to mess them up and you expect them to welcome you with wide smiles?]
Then again, those were demonic cultivators for you. Especially Steward Zhuo’s arrogant self-righteous kind, they were everywhere.
However, there was something he failed to see. “Steward Zhuo, is your son that strong? The Mystical Heaven Sect is still a sect…”
“Don’t believe me? Watch. My kid was known as an ender in Tianyu, destroying everything in his path.” Zhuo Fan shrugged.
Everyone frowned, then focused on the fight. Just in time to see Gu Santong walking for the Mystical Heaven Sect with an obnoxious attitude, like none were up to his standards.
“Uhm, Steward Zhuo, your son is your spitting image of your heroism and brutality, ha-ha-ha…” Venerable Bai chuckled.
Zhuo Fan shrugged and smiled.
The Heavenly Cycle Elders watched Gu Santong’s insufferable attitude and were fuming mad. They knew the kid was more than he seemed, but his blatant disdain was getting to these elders’ nerves.
“Enough of your arrogance, kid. We have underestimated you before, but don’t think you will get rid of us so easily!”
“Really? Then let’s continue!”
Gu Santong snickered and hooked a finger in mockery, “You’re all bark and no bite. Come and get me if you want!”
Heavenly Cycle Elders were red with rage. Mystical Heaven Sect’s side cried out, worried by their looks about the terrible kid.
This was the first time seeing someone humiliate their four venerables.
[Though he does have the strength…]
They looked on with bated breaths as the two sides were ready for a grand battle.
The four elders made signs, followed by draconic roars. Four dragons took to the skies.
Yellow light shone from the ground beneath and bathed the dragons, transforming them into a yellow dragon hundreds of meters long.
The thick pressure was crushing on everyone’s shoulders, and it was all focused on Gu Santong.
However, the kid’s face fell a bit and that was it.
The audience, even Demon Scheming Sect’s side a thousand meters out were gasping from shock.
This power was hundreds of times stronger than what the four unleashed before.
Han Qianying was bug eyed, “T-this is the Four Elements Cycle Array?”
Fiend Yang saw the formation and cried as well. His face was heavy. It was an array that was made by Radiant Stage experts and defeated four Ethereal Stage experts. Now that four peak Ethereal Stage experts formed it, its power must be unimaginable.
“The Four Elements Cycle Array borrows the power of the earth and four elements to unleash the world’s energy. Its power is endless. I fear that not even an early Soul Harmony Stage expert can block an array formed by the four High Venerables. That child is in danger…” Shui Ruohua was worried.
They all turned their eyes on Zhuo Fan, but he was as calm as ever.
Ye Lin was a Qilin. His soul and body were one to begin with. Reaching the Soul Harmony Stage would hardly make a difference to him.
[Since Ye Lin could do it earlier, so can young Sanzi, but his will be stronger.
Sect Leader Xuan saw the four venerables unleash such might and wrote off the kid as dead already, ignoring him, “Ha-ha-ha, get ready for a funeral. You must’ve seen the power of Four Elements Cycle Array, but I must tell you that it is far deadlier in the hands of the venerables. Even more so when the venerables aren’t using the Four Elements Cycle Array, but the stronger one, Heavenly Cycle Dragon Array, formed by using four earth dragon souls. Your end is nigh!”
Xuan Shaoyu heard his dad brag and laughed as well, looking the part of the winning side.
Mystical Heaven Sect snickered. Demon Scheming Sect was silent, gnashing their teeth. Only Zhuo Fan just watched Gu Santong as he said, “Young Sanzi…”
“It’s fine.” Gu Santong waved his hand. His face was hard, but still mocked, “Before me, even earth dragon souls are nothing more than worms.”
Zhuo Fan knew where young Sanzi’s confidence came from. His body was that of a Qilin, his soul that of a sacred beast. Not even a heaven dragon soul could top that!
Zhuo Fan just eased a breath and relaxed.
Young Sanzi’s confidence was seen as a joke by the Heavenly Cycle Elders, mocking him, “Ignorant young devil, do you even know what earth dragon soul is known for? It connects to the world. By combining with the earth, one’s power grows tens of times. It’s unlike the previous dragon soul you beat. “
“And? They’re still worms!”
Gu Santong mocked and taunted, “If you don’t strike, I’ll do it first!”
The Heavenly Cycle Elders was outraged, “Damn brat, you have the nerve to mock us? It’s best we get rid of you at once with all we have!”
The four made a sign in unison, then pointed at Gu Santong. The huge dragon roared and charged at the little figure.
Everyone watched with their hearts in their throat. Only the few who believed in young Sanzi’s strength were calm.
Roar!
Along with the draconic roar, the dragon soul slammed down, making the ground cave in thousands of meters.
Despite not feeling the dragon’s brunt force, they could still feel the aftermath, the biting winds that cut at their skin.
They were overwhelmed. The power was so incredible even bystanders would suffer from a stray wind. Just how would that kid stand it?
When the eyes turned to Gu Santong, they were stumped once more. The kid wasn’t harmed in the slightest, as if he was only standing in a mild rain.
Gu Santong looked up at the incoming lizard, and took a deep breath. His body flashed scarlet, his eyes shining as he got ready to lash out with the might of a true Qilin. His body as well was itching to strike and explode with power…

chapters.title: Chapter 753: Qilin Roar
chapters.content:
Chapter 753: Qilin Roar
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Roar!
As the huge dragon soul was right on top of him, Gu Santong perked his mouth up in one eerie smirk as he roared.
An image of a scarlet Qilin came out of his body. As it howled, there were scarlet shock waves spreading out.
As for the huge dragon soul, it faltered like it met obstacles. The scarlet ripples shock waves slammed into it, making it feel great pain with every strike and pushing it back.
“That’s not possible! Just by roaring he can push back the earth dragon soul us four formed?” Their eyes shaking, Heavenly Cycle Elders cried out in unison from this shocking revelation. They could not believe their eyes that this was happening, their hands shaking nonstop.
They felt an immense power coming at their array, to the point it wanted to tear it out.
They could not believe what was happening. This unbridled power came from a mere child’s howl.
His soul was also sending the four eerie vibes, a fear they hadn’t sensed in centuries.
The Qilin flexed its claws, ready to tear the sky open as it howled. Anything and everything that stood in its path was feeling the brunt of its power, plunged into hell.
Heavenly Cycle Elders’ brows shook, feeling feeble. None wanted to admit it, even as they knew it already. The four had met a tough opponent this time around, one that was a freak beyond them.
Roar!
Gu Santong saw the huge dragon soul just kept retreating and was on the brink of collapse. He grinned, having a nasty smile on his face as he shouted at the sky once more.
Boom!
In a split second, a red sound wave came at the huge dragon soul like a tsunami.
This time, the huge dragon soul barely lasted a few seconds before crumbling down to nothing.
Following the defeat of their combined earth dragon souls into the heavenly cycle dragon soul, the Heavenly Cycle Elders spat blood in unison. Their soul had a deep wound, evident from their ashen face.
They had no time to even catch their breath as the red sound wave came straight for them.
“Fricking hell, what monster is this brat…”
The four watched as the red wave came with dumb looks. They cursed in defiance, like dying old men, before being pulverized. All that was left of them was blood sprinkled down from four “clouds”.
Not even their souls could withstand Gu Santong’s Qilin roar, shaking their very core and ripping it apart.
The dreaded red sound wave boomed in the distance and warped the space, sending shock waves everywhere.
Everyone was too speechless to react.
The four dragons of the great Tianyu’s three guardian sects, One Sword Five Dragons, had been killed by a seven year old just like that.
[Holy hell, just where the hell did this freak come from?]
Sect Leader Xuan and his Mystical Heaven Sect were sweating. They watched the still roaring Gu Santong with blank stares.
Not just them, even the Demon Scheming Sect was dumbstruck at such display of raw power.
They never thought it possible that Steward Zhuo would call someone of such caliber, all packed neatly in a monster that was barely seven years old. They thought the kid had a high chance of winning, but not to the point of being as easy as they saw.
Those were Mystical Heaven Sect’s four dragons!
[Killed just like that by a kid? What’s wrong with this world?]
The Demon Scheming Sect experts sympathized with Mystical Heaven Sect.
[What sin have they committed to suffer this father-son disaster?]
They all looked at Gu Santong then at Zhuo Fan, chuckling to themselves.
[Thank god he’s on our side…]
Roar!
As the red sound wave faded into the horizon, Gu Santong’s bloodlust was far from quenched.
He spread out his arms and legs, making the scarlet glow on him flicker brighter.
Zhuo Fan cried out, “Oh shit, the kid is high on his win and won’t stop. Get back five more miles!”
Zhuo Fan was the first to get the hell out of there. The rest followed. They had no clue who Gu Santong was, but his pops should be more than clear on this.
The Demon Scheming Sect team retreated again, while Mystical Heaven Sect was just too out of it to react. By the time they came to their senses, all hope was lost.
“Qilin soul might, Shock and Awe!”
Gu Santong shouted and flicked his childish hands. The red Qilin image once again came out and roared.
Hum~
A dreadful shock wave flew from Gu Santong in every direction. One could see with the naked eye how the scarlet wave was moving through the air.
This wave was different from before. It carried death and nothing else, like a scythe coming to reap lives. The space itself warped and threatened to crack as all that stood in its way was erased from this world, going out in a puff of dust.
Sect Leader Xuan and his team gasped, “Run!”
Mystical Heaven Sect panicked, each going every which way.
Alas, they were just too slow…
They were the closest to Gu Santong to begin with and had missed their chance in getting to a safe distance from this monster.
In this chaotic retreat, hundreds of people shoved, pulled, screamed, all trying to get just a little bit further.
Yet in a blink, the red wave caught up to them and even passed them.
“Agh~!”
The cries of pain littered the sky, losing their lives like they were no Ethereal Stage experts, but mere mortals.
Nothing survived, even as they used all their soul power to protect themselves. Their bodies were ashes in a blink of an eye, as for their soul, it kept being shaken until it fell apart.
And the enactment of this slaughter only took a few brief moments.
The people watching their friends die like that were filled with shock and dread.
They watched as the red wave annihilated everything in its path, not even sparing a blade of grass, or a speck of dust.
Rumble~
It was doomsday. The beautiful and amazing Mystical Heaven Sect was being laid to waste with Gu Santong at its center. The worst part was, the destruction only increased.
“Steward Zhuo, what do we do if the red wave comes here?” Seeing the horrors the Mystical Heaven Sect was going through, Venerable Qi spoke with fear.
Zhuo Fan waved his hand, “Just leave it to me.”
Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed in five golden halos as he shouted, “Divine Eye of the Void’s 5th stage, Void Wall times three!”
Hum~
The space rippled and in front of them appeared three thick invisible walls. The red wave came and stopped before the walls, but not without giving them a good rattling…
Crack~
As the intense sounds echoed, everyone was on tenterhooks and fear. With a loud bang, the first wall was peeled away and the red wave moved on to the second one.
Everyone’s face sank, looking tensely at Zhuo Fan.
[Hey, uhm, Steward Zhuo, what’s with your son not knowing friend from foe? He’s coming after us as well!]
Zhuo Fan easily understood their fears and just stared at the second wall without replying.
Pff!
The red wave slammed into the second wall and started rattling it too, but this time, it was far weaker. With a bang, signaling its collapse, the wave came upon the third wall, but very much dimmed.
It struck the third wall, shaking it a little, just like in arm wrestling, none giving an inch.
Everyone tensely watched the scene. If Zhuo Fan’s last Void Wall couldn’t stop it, they would end up just like Mystical Heaven Sect.
Though they would be in a better spot, as the wave was much weaker than the one that culled their enemies…

chapters.title: Chapter 754: Waste
chapters.content:
Chapter 754: Waste
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Crack!
With a sharp sound, Zhuo Fan’s last Void Wall was about to fall, giving way for the red wave to attack.
The Demon Scheming Sect team’s faces turned heavy, their hearts in their throat as they used all they had to protect themselves.
Kui Lang held Han Qianying close, as he used his soul power to protect both of them.
Bam!
Zhuo Fan’s third Void Wall collapsed at last and caused the others to jump. The red wave swept for them the next second.
But before it reached them, it faded away into nothing and Gu Santong’s dreadful power never touched them.
Startled, they all looked at each other before bursting in joy.
“Hu~, the kid’s vibration wave was like a shock wave. My Void Wall used separate spaces to lower its power. One can say they’re mutually exclusive.” Zhuo Fan eased a long breath, “If not, in the face of that high intensity vibration, even an Ethereal Stage expert would receive a heavy wound, if not killed outright.”
The others nodded, exuberant they just got out alive. Venerable Bai gave a thumbs up, “Steward Zhuo, you really know your son the best. If it were anyone else, they’d suffer for it. Only you could resist it. You are his father after all, ha-ha-ha…”
The others laughed alongside him.
“Ha-ha-ha, you don’t have to say that. I’m so much weaker than my kid. Since we’re so far away and the kid didn’t use a targeted move, I could block it.”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Now do you understand why I didn’t want to take him out? Because this brat forgets himself, just like a child.”
The others nodded and felt Zhuo Fan’s pain.
Such a mighty power in the hands of a rash kid. It was not just deadly to the enemy, but even to oneself.
The only reason Steward Zhuo let the boy out was because the Heavenly Cycle Elders intervened.
“I worry he just destroyed Mystical Heaven Sect with this move. How are we going to explain it to Double Dragon Manor?” Zhuo Fan frowned and sighed.
[With sacred beast’s pride, they never go easy. Ever since young Sanzi was taught about being a Qilin, he’s been going further and further down the path of a king of beasts.]
Just like earlier, the enemy was clearly crushed, but he still showed off his power as if to show he was the best in the world. He gave no thought to the consequences.
This was the difference between beasts and humans. Beasts only cared about power. While humans were shrewd, turning the strong into weak, defeat into victory.
Young Sanzi was a Qilin son, so following the beast way was a given, though throwing him into the world of man was far from sensible.
If he lacked the tiniest bit, Zhuo Fan, his godfather, would’ve died alongside the enemy.
Sighing, Zhuo Fan shook his head. Fiend Yang spoke in a shaken tone, “Z-Zhuo Fan, look there. Your son didn’t ruin Mystical Heaven Sect, though there’s barely anything left. He really is an ender! For crying out loud, what kind of monsters is your clan made of? One is worse than the last. The father ruled Double Dragon Gathering and the son stomps a sect? This is unnatural…”
The rest turned their heads to look only to be staring agape.
Gu Santong was still acting almighty in the sky, looking down on everything, but turning to Mystical Heaven Sect, the previous nice scenery was reduced to rubble, with corpses strewn everywhere. There were also sobs and cries here and there, while blood trickled from every corner. This was hell, no two ways about it!
Han Qianying and Shui Ruohua looked away in tears. This was their home.
Chu Qingcheng looked away as well, even if she hadn’t been here for long.
“Dad, mom, I mowed them good. It hasn’t even been half an hour.” Gu Santong smiled as he sped for them.
The others were so scared they didn’t even look him in the eye.
[What kind of child can raze a lower-three sect to the ground?]
Fiend Yang looked worried by his attitude. He still recalled the child’s annoyance with him.
To any normal kid that whined, Fiend Yang would only tease him more; except for young Sanzi. He didn’t have it in him.
He was better off keeping a safe distance. If the guy’s temper went off, there wouldn’t be just whining and tears, but blood and gore.
Looking at the ground littered with corpses and victims, Fiend Yang felt utter regret.
[Am I that bored to rub a kid’s head?]
Zhuo Fan looked around then smiled at Gu Santong, “Young Sanzi, you did great. Leave the rest to me. You don’t have to do anything now.”
“Sure!”
Young Sanzi bobbed his head like a good kid, giggling innocently. Only the guys around thought…
[Who’d ever believe that pure smile?]
Seeing the bloody aftermath, Venerable Qi said, “Steward Zhuo, this isn’t easy to settle. We need a very good reason for all of this to make the Double Dragon Manor stop even if they come here.”
“I know that.” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone. “Find Sect Leader Xuan and Xuan Shaoyu fast. They’re our only hope of coming clean out of this mess.”
None knew what he meant but they obeyed, “Understood!”
They all began their search. Venerable Qi and Bai shared a look and grinned.
Crash!
In a pile of rubble, Sect Leader Xuan crawled out from all that rock, bleeding from his mouth. He had no time to address his condition as he felt the rubble shift under him and a youth clawed his way out, Xuan Shaoyu.
Only Xuan Shaoyu looked deathly pale, the spiritual armor on him had long since broken into two, dangling from his body.
“Thank god the 9th grade spiritual armor was here to save his life.” Sect Leader Xuan touched his hand and sent his soul power to check Xuan Shaoyu’s condition. He laughed in joy, “Shaoyu, I’m so happy you’re fine!”
Xuan Shaoyu opened his eyes to see his father, but then he gasped, “Dad, Zhuo Fan ruined our sect. We can’t let him get away with this!”
“Don’t worry. I will definitely make sure he’ll be ripped apart for you.” Sect Leader Xuan’s face was hard.
Xuan Shaoyu showed a weak smile, “Great… Zhuo Fan, I won’t ever let you and junior sister Qingcheng be happy together…”
“Ha-ha-ha, you can’t even protect yourself, young master Xuan. Yet you still have the luxury to worry about Qingcheng and my happiness? Why thank you…”
Xuan Shaoyu did not get to finish as a mocking tone came.
Sect Leader Xuan looked to see Zhuo Fan bearing a sinister smile as he came over with the girls.
Sect Leader Xuan spat, “Zhuo Fan, demon fiend, you ruined my sect and still dare to show your face here?”
“Why not? With your heavy wounds, what can you possibly do to me?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, “Mystical Heaven Sect’s experts are now dead or wounded. Even you can’t protect yourself. So why the high and mighty attitude?”
“You…” Sect Leader Xuan was filled with fury, but didn’t get to finish as he coughed blood again.
Zhuo Fan shrugged, “See, you have no power left. Your life is now in my hands. I’ll be honest here. Your death or survival is at my whim. You have no choice in the matter.”
Sect Leader Xuan remained silent, only biting his lip.
Utter humiliation.
A Sect Leader like him had never been in such a state before. Taunted by the enemy and with no way of retorting, because he knew what he said was the truth. He was now powerless.
The Demon Scheming Sect team grinned at him. Han Qianying and the girls just sighed.
The great Mystical Heaven Sect had gotten theirs, now reduced to this.
“Well, do you want to live or die?” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, getting to the main point…

chapters.title: Chapter 755: Rules
chapters.content:
Chapter 755: Rules
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Sect Leader Xuan’s brow shook. He looked with gnashed teeth at Zhuo Fan but said nothing. Despite that, the humiliation was so great he clenched his fists.
Zhuo Fan ignored it all and leaned over him, reaching with his venomous claw and hoisting Xuan Shaoyu by the neck, “In that case, there’s nothing more to talk about!”
“Wait, what are you doing? Let him go!” Sect Leader Xuan cried out. He wanted to move but he only coughed more blood.
Zhuo Fan snickered as he shouted, “Do you want to live or die?”
“I…”
Sect Leader Xuan’s eyes shook, but the words were stuck in his throat, because speaking meant surrendering.
As they say, ‘It is better to die on your feet than live on your knees’. Many of the secular cultivators could do it, so why couldn’t the great Sect Leader of Mystical Heaven Sect?
But looking at his son, turning red from the grip on his neck, Sect Leader Xuan sighed and shook his head, “When even an ant clings to life, what more’s there to say about man’s desire to live? What do you want, Zhuo Fan?”
“Sect Leader Xuan, that’s an attitude more befitting of moving with the times, ha-ha-ha…”
Grinning, Zhuo Fan relaxed his hand and Xuan Shaoyu slumped to the ground, gasping for breath. He looked at Zhuo Fan in fear, having lost his cocky attitude.
Ignoring the useless son, Zhuo Fan gave Venerable Qi a look and he threw an empty jade slip over to Sect Leader Xuan.
Taking it, Sect Leader Xuan asked, “What’s this?”
“Ha-ha-ha, nothing much, just hoping Sect Leader Xuan can help me write something down.” Zhuo Fan beamed.
Sect Leader Xuan’s hand tightened at his words and his brow furrowed, “Zhuo Fan, you can’t possibly be thinking of twisting facts and making my Mystical Heaven Sect be the culprit here!”
Sect Leader Xuan knew the minute he put any word on the jade slip, his soul signature would be imprinted on it. Then no matter how much he begged Double Dragon Manor for justice, no one would believe him.
They would have no choice but to live with this stain.
His hands shook and his teeth clenched together. All while the Demon Scheming Sect team was looking at him with mockery.
[Yeah, that’s right. We bet you and now we’re robbing you of any means of fighting back. What are you gonna do about it? It’s not our fault you turned out to be so weak, ha-ha-ha…]
Looking at the piles of rubble around him that were once his sect, at the dead experts and few survivors, they had no other fate than to be under someone’s thumb.
Sect Leader Xuan sighed, his hand twitched as it held the jade slip.
“Sect Leader Xuan, if you don’t do this, we’ll leave no survivors!” Zhuo Fan snickered, “We might even turn this place into a wasteland…”
“You’d dare?”
“Why the hell not?”
Zhuo Fan shouted back, “The central area is getting ready for war with the other lands. Mystical Heaven Sect’s demise can be written off with hundreds of excuses. Moreover, the girls were your disciples and with a few words to Double Dragon Manor, your case will be put aside. Who would want to test the relations because of a lower-three sect only to give room for the enemy to strike?”
Shaking all over, Sect Leader Xuan’s face fell.
“At the end of the day, rules are gimmicks used in times of peace. When the enemy comes knocking, even Double Dragon Manor would focus on the good of western lands. Who’d have the time to waste on rules?”
Zhuo Fan grinned, “Sect Leader Xuan has been around for so long and should know this better than anyone.”
Sect Leader Xuan’s clenched fist finally eased and sighed, “If the central area is indeed attacking, ha-ha, the Mystical Heaven Sect’s matter will be forgotten…”
“I talk, you write!”
Ignoring him and his last probe, Zhuo Fan spoke in a cold tone, as if he already knew the central area would come. When he was just being full of it. But because he was acting like this, Sect Leader Xuan bought it.
“Firstly, the matter with Qingcheng. You came to her for Double Dragon Gathering. Now that’s over, the deal is also over. But you still forced her to stay. As her husband, I came to take her but you started pushing me around which led to war.”
Zhuo Fan narrated while Sect Leader Xuan wrote down like a machine.
“Next, Mystical Heaven Sect’s elders picked on me with their superior numbers and then Demon Scheming Sect’s elders came to the rescue, leading to both sides entering a bitter fight.”
Sect Leader Xuan’s eyes shook, but he stayed silent.
