Zhuo Fan grinned, “Yes, come take my head. You must do it, for providence. But it’s also providence who dictates how many of you actually come out alive out of this. Look at the twenty heavily wounded. They were no less brave than you yet what did they get? At the end of the day, only the survivors get to enjoy the victory. You’d better think this through. Do you want to be expendable or a winner? You decide.”
Ugh!
They all faltered, coming to a halt. As they looked like each other, no one seemed to be so keen on being first anymore.
“Brother, you take the lead, I’ll watch your back!”
“And end up dead? You do it! Humph.”
With but a casual reminder from Zhuo Fan, their inner self-preservation was brought to the surface before they realized it. They had lost all the courage and panicked now.
No matter how many they are, once their hearts were shaken, they became nothing more than a rabble. Their numbers meant nothing.
Zhuo Fan grinned in disdain seeing them being so petty. At the same time, he held his stomach as blood kept flowing from his mouth.
He was wounded gravely as well. If they came at him again, just a dozen would’ve been enough to finish him.
But by driving a wedge between them and bringing out their selfishness, the paper tiger that was now Zhuo Fan stalled these hundreds of experts from coming over.
Anyone would laugh at such a scene. The great force of a sect was reduced to bickering fools, unable to get their hands on a wounded guy…
Zhao Dezhu was stomping in anger, cursing, “You damn morons! What are you scared of? He’s hanging by a thread, attack! Get me his head and I’ll make Sect Leader commend you!”
“Then why don’t you go?” However, it had the opposite effect. One Universal Righteous Sect disciple gave him a glare.
Ugh!
Startled, Zhao Dezhu stammered.
[Me?!]
Zhuo Fan was filled with deceit and endless trickery. Even if wounded, no one really knew what scheme he was hiding.
[And you want me to go there? When he had toyed with Ye Lin to such an extent?]
[If I go there, keeping my life will be a miracle! Why the hell would I go? I’m too young to die.]
[What did I bring you all for then if not to get him instead?]
However, seeing him scared, they were even more so. Now no one was willing to attack.
Thus, the five hundred experts of Universal Righteous Sect stared like fools at a wounded guy.
Zhao Dezhu was outraged while Zhuo Fan grinned. He wasn’t after escaping though. While defeating five hundred of them was impossible.
He only hoped that by fighting them he bought the girls enough time.
Zhuo Fan felt his insides burning as blood got caught in his chest and made it hard to breathe. Even so, he still stood there, pretending like he was fine.
Clap~
Someone clapped, “Ha-ha-ha, even though a wounded paper tiger, you still managed to shake the resolve of five hundred Universal Righteous Sect experts. No wonder Zhao Dezhu said you’ll be the righteous path’s biggest calamity…”

chapters.title: Chapter 775: None Shall Pass
chapters.content:
Chapter 775: None Shall Pass
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Frowning, Zhuo Fan turned his head back as he felt his heart sinking.
Not far from him, a thin middle-aged man in white clothes came out from the trees. Seeing his mild smile but sharp eyes, Zhuo Fan knew this guy was anything but nice.
What was more, he was also a Soul Harmony expert.
Squinting, Zhuo Fan thought to himself.
[It seems Universal Righteous Sect’s expert they got is ready to strike.]
Following his thought seven lights flashed as more Soul Harmony Stage cultivators showed up beside him, including the silver haired old man he saw in the town.
Such a display of force left Zhuo Fan sighing.
[I could scare off five hundred Ethereal Stage experts, but I have no chance against eight Soul Harmony experts.]
Glancing at the eight, he began to calculate how to block them from going after Chu Qingcheng.
At this time, Zhuo Fan had no care for his life at all. All he wanted now was to stall for as much as possible…
“Zhao Dezhu greets the elders!”
Seeing the eight people, the pissed and stuck Zhao Dezhu finally found his thick leg to hug. The other Ethereal Stage experts calmed down as well.
Ignoring them, the silver haired old man frowned, staring at Zhuo Fan and at the powerful dragon soul. “There’s so many of you yet you couldn’t even get rid of a brat after so long? I thought that when I’d come everything would be settled by now. But look at this mess! You have shamed the Universal Righteous Sect!”
Everyone’s heart chilled and they lowered their heads.
“But weren’t there four of them? Why is there only one? Where are the girls? At least show me their bodies.”
The silver haired old man asked.
Zhao Dezhu beamed with a deep bow, “Elder, the three girls had run away. This brat blocked us here. We were about to take him down and then follow after them.”
“What?! One man holding back five hundred?”
The silver haired old man was outraged, “Humph, good, very good. You really are pathetic. There are hundreds of you yet you can’t even handle four people, ending up stuck dealing with just one. Do you want me to step in, is that it? To pick on the weak? If word gets out, the Universal Righteous Sect will have no name left, ha-ha-ha…”
“Zhao Dezhu, you petitioned the sect for so many people to help you. I thought you were dependable but now I see you’re nothing. You can’t even take four people down with so many on your side? Would you like five hundred more to get the job done?”
Zhao Dezhu jerked back after being harangued. He went red from shame and unwillingness.
[Elder, this isn’t about numbers, but how devious this brat is. Using his devil’s tongue to incite chaos, turning all these people into a rabble.]
[It doesn’t matter even if they were a thousand, they’d still end up the same. The more they are, the more chaos it’ll be.]
[Moreover, it’s not exactly all our fault. Didn’t I ask you to cut their escape, now…]
Zhao Dezhu gave the contended elder in white a careful look, but did not dare to speak up.
The silver haired old man followed his gaze and asked in a dark tone, “Elder Bai He, we’ve discussed this before, that we would work together in cutting off every chance of escape. Why didn’t you step in when the girls fled?”
“Ha-ha-ha, how’s it my fault?”
The elder chuckled and mocked, “Elder Yin Chui, you were waiting together with me, yet always wanted to make a move and get them. So I figured that with a Soul Harmony expert and five hundred Ethereal Stage experts, getting four brats still in the Radiant Stage would be a piece of cake. That’s why my intervention would be pointless, just wandering around here on a leisure stroll. But who ever thought you’d let them freaking escape.
“Humph, and after I came back, I found it even more ridiculous how five hundred experts were being stopped by one brat. Ha-ha-ha, that’s the biggest joke I’ve heard. Elder Yin Chui, that happened with your help even. Does that mean that all these disciples would be wiped out if it weren’t for you? I now have a new understanding of your strength. From elder to executive, to disciple, not one is worth anything.”
Elder Yin Chui’s face twitched and went red then he glared at Zhao Dezhu, wishing he could pulverize him.
Seeing how the four ran away and Zhao Dezhu led the five hundred experts after them, he figured winning was in the bag. That was why he took his sweet time coming here rather than getting it over with fast, scared they would talk behind his back that he picked on someone weaker than him. Even if it was for the sect, it still hurt to hear it.
But who knew that Zhao Dezhu would be such a moron to not even complete this simple task, even getting the elders involved and shaming them with this shameless act. If not for this brat being Sect Leader’s disciple and the future pillar of the sect, he would’ve died on the spot.
Gasping, Elder Yin Chui’s eyes flashed. Zhao Dezhu did not dare to look at him, lowering his head. He cursed Zhuo Fan to high heavens.
[If not for this punk, I wouldn’t have made a fool of myself before the elders.]
The other could see Elder Yin Chui was furious and smiled, giving him a way out, “Elder Yin Chui, the girls shouldn’t have gone far. It should be easy to catch up to them. Zhao Dezhu has his faults, but it won’t matter. You’re an important man and should be letting him remember this mistake. After we settle this, we’ll handle it back at the sect.”
With his rear kissed, Elder Yin Chui nodded.
The eight looked at each other then passed Zhuo Fan together, totally ignoring him.
“Zhao Dezhu, we’ll leave this to you. If you still can’t do it with so many men, humph…” Elder Yin Chui warned.
Zhao Dezhu bobbed his head, Elder Bai He smiled, “Children, don’t let his words confuse you. If you manage to kill him, you’ll all earn merit. If you let him escape, you’ll all die.”
“Yes, sir!” Everyone shouted.
An elder’s order was different from Zhao Dezhu’s, a disciple. He easily stirred these Ethereal Stage experts’ fighting spirit.
The elders nodded then passed Zhuo Fan without minding him.
They didn’t feel quite right by killing him themselves. They still had their name as righteous cultivators to keep. It was better to let them settle it.
As for the girls, they had good use for them. Those constitutions should not go to waste…
Boom!
However, they did not get far, as an incoming explosion of power sent their clothes fluttering from Almighty Scarlet Dragon King’s tail.
“I told you, as long as I’m here, none shall pass me!” Zhuo Fan spoke coldly.
The eight elders looked at him with anger and shock because they did not care about an Ethereal Stage expert at all.
Zhao Dezhu mocked, “Ha-ha-ha, Zhuo Fan, you ignorant fool, you actually want to try and stop the eight elders? Do you know the difference between Soul Harmony Stage and Ethereal Stage?”
“Yeah, we don’t want to waste time on a pup, we have our status to maintain. So don’t push it!” Elder Bai He sneered, “And besides, you’re not worthy.”
Zhuo Fan had a sinister grin, “Oh? Since you don’t want to attack, then just sit there, alright?”
The eight elders’ faces fell.
Elder Yin Chui gave Zhuo Fan a long look and took a deep breath, “Fine, since this evil spawn wants to die at Soul Harmony experts’ hand, then I’ll oblige you.”
Elder Yin Chui suddenly shook and an incredible power came from him. The sudden surge forced the Ethereal Stage experts to falter back from the hundred meter huge hammer forming behind the elder.
“Humph, my soul is a tool soul, Heaven-smashing Hammer; its might is unprecedented!”
Hum~
The huge hammer then combined with his body, making his body swell and releasing silver light. The mere clasping of his fists sent powerful ripples.
“After achieving harmony, my body is like a diamond, my punch crushes mountains. Even your heaven dragon soul will be turned to dust.”
With a creepy glint in his eyes, Elder Yin Chui grinned, “If you had fought these Ethereal Stage experts, you might have lived longer. But since you want to die, humph, then be my guest!”
Elder Yin Chui shot straight for Zhuo Fan, the relentless fists smashed into his chest, brutal and savage…

chapters.title: Chapter 776: Demon Sword’s Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 776: Demon Sword’s Power
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Ha-ha-ha, Zhuo Fan, you’ve angered our Soul Harmony Stage elders. You must really want to die!” Zhao Dezhu pointed at Zhuo Fan’s cold face and laughed at his suicidal act.
Elder Bai He shook his head in mockery. “We’re not picking on the weak this time, it’s the weak who taunts us.”
“Yeah, he must think that dying at a Soul Harmony expert’s hand would be so much more honorable.” Another elder shook his head, looking with contempt. “There’s plenty of idiots like him around, as if the more incredible the death, the better the glory, ha-ha-ha. But that doesn’t mean you should die at some underling’s hand. After all, even experts sometimes can’t help but squash a few bugs.”
Everyone nodded and snickered. The hundreds of Ethereal Stage experts were even excited. They were going to see their glorious elders attack!
Hu~
The wind brought terrible power at Zhuo Fan, pushing him down and making him pant and shake.
Despite that, he stood firm, his back straight, as he took Almighty Scarlet Dragon King back into himself.
Elder Yin Chui raised an eyebrow, writing it off as fear and laughing at Zhuo Fan for it, “You took your soul back? You think it’ll save you? I am a Soul Harmony expert! This fist will crush your body and pulverize your soul. You can’t escape!”
“Ha-ha-ha, you’re wrong about that. I took it back not out of fear, but to reduce the defensive range.” Zhuo Fan smirked.
Elder Yin Chui had to laugh harder at that. “Defensive range? Ha-ha-ha, do you really think you can block my punch? Even with a 9th grade spiritual armor, you’d still die!”
Elder Yin Chui put more speed into his strike, arriving at Zhuo Fan in an instant. The terrible power was so great it made Zhuo Fan’s face split, bleeding all over.
His soul was restless, as if afraid of this might, of this punch.
Zhao Dezhu was having the time of his life. In the Double Dragon Gathering, his name became nothing and now it became nothing in front of the elders. But the freak Zhuo Fan would finally die.
The other Ethereal Stage experts were shouting in excitement. The seven other elders shook their heads.
[With how deep the gap is, this fight is boring.]
It was like a thug looming on a three-year-old.
Just when everyone thought this would be over, Zhuo Fan’s fate changed.
A bloody glow with traces of black came in contact with Elder Yin Chui.
The elder’s punch was just about to hit Zhuo Fan, but then it split in two, whistling right by Zhuo Fan’s ears as traces of blood landed on his brow.
Elder Yin Chui was dumbstruck. But then, a chuckle grated in his ears.
“Ha-ha-ha, did you really think I would lower the defensive range just to block your attack?” Zhuo Fan showed a sinister smile, his eyes flashing coldly. “I was only getting ready to hack you!”
Elder Yin Chui shook, at a loss, but then he quickly shivered. He looked down to look at himself.
He was bisected in two halves, with blood dripping from his innards. Because he had attacked, the halves simply went past Zhuo Fan.
Now he looked at Zhuo Fan in the eye. He had no determination to try and take them down with him, he was actually ready to kill a Soul Harmony expert.
Though the elder didn’t understand how it came to dying like this.
Elder Yin Chui wanted to at least know what happened before dying, but time waited for no one. As he turned around, his eyes went blank and he splattered to the ground.
Dying with a grievance…
The shock was so great everyone was in denial of what they saw.
The Ethereal Stage experts and the elders all gasped watching the bloody halves.
[That’s a Soul Harmony expert! How can he die just like that?]
Clang!
A sword having a bloody glow and black veins on it circled the air and flew in Zhuo Fan’s hand with a cheerful hum.
Like it was excited of the kill it just took. The hungry hum echoed and made the rest shiver from fear.
[That sword…]
Elder Bai He and the six elder shared a glance. This was supposed to be a simple task now that the eight of them came to deal with some brats. They came just to make sure all went well, but not that they would actually intervene.
But none could have fathomed that they would actually lose a Soul Harmony expert just like that at the hands of a weapon. The hearts of the other elders were tense, no longer looking down on the kid.
Zhao Dezhu was scared to death and stumbled backward, “No, that can’t be! How did you kill a Soul Harmony Stage elder?”
“Humph, I told you, none shall take one step beyond me!”
Ignoring him, Zhuo Fan flicked the sword and smiled coldly. He was like a supreme monarch bearing down his mighty order.
The elders did not care about him before, but they would not be so hasty this time around. That weird sword would sure promise them death otherwise.
[What the hell is that thing?]
Elder Bai He squinted as sweat trickled down. The others were the same, stepping back from that sword.
In an instant, the two sides were in a deadlock.
The Ethereal Stage experts had a morale boost with the eight elders, about to attack even. But then one of them had to die and shake the elders’ resolve, making them useless.
Their morale hit rock bottom, looking at Zhuo Fan with dread. If their elders feared him, how couldn’t they?
Zhuo Fan grinned and nodded at the sword.
[Sixth grade sacred weapon, Atlas Sword!]
He was lacking in using the sacred weapon’s full power, but it was sharp enough to kill a Soul Harmony expert. Thanks to this trinket, he could now stall for longer and make sure Chu Qingcheng got away.
Zhuo Fan sighed, yet he was showing a pleased smile.
This might be the last time he could help Qingcheng…
“Use your weapons!”
Elder Bai He shouted then he charged for Zhuo Fan while a broadsword appeared in his hands.
“9th grade spiritual weapon, Heaven-slasher. Moon-cutting River!”
The other six elders lit up. Since the demon sword was amazing, then they’d use spiritual weapons. Even if they lacked, they could press on with their Soul Harmony Stage power.
And so, they all took out their spiritual weapons and came at Zhuo Fan.
Squinting, Zhuo Fan knew he could not let them circle him. So his right eye flashed golden once and was gone from their sight.
[Divine Eye of the Void’s 1st stage, Shift!]
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan’s vanishing act had the spiritual weapons strike air. The next second, he was behind Elder Bai He, slashing.
Elder Bai He’s heart shook and he dodged that sharp edge. With a flick of his hand, the Heaven-slasher carried out his entire power as it hacked at Zhuo Fan.
Bam!
A loud sound echoed as the blade and sword collided. Zhuo Fan shook from the Soul Harmony Stage power seeping into his body. He spat blood and fell back.
However, Elder Bai He’s Heaven-slasher fell apart, pieces crumbling from it. A 9th grade spiritual weapon was ruined just like that.
“This can’t be!”
Elder Bai He widened his eyes in shock, “What kind of weapon is that? How can a Radiant Stage kid destroy a 9th grade spiritual weapon in the hands of a Soul Harmony expert?”
The others’ eyelids quivered, thoroughly stumped…

chapters.title: Chapter 777: Never Surrender
chapters.content:
Chapter 777: Never Surrender
Proofreader
: Papatonks
While spiritual weapons had grades, that didn’t mean anyone could use them. Their power was also different. A 3rd grade spiritual weapon wielded by a Soul Harmony expert was much stronger than a Radiant Stage expert holding a 9th grade spiritual weapon.
But that did not seem to be the case since even with the cultivation gap, a Soul Harmony Stage expert was using spiritual weapons against a Radiant Stage expert.
If not for Zhuo Fan’s sword being so outrageous, they would not have resorted to such a shameless act as using spiritual weapons to pick on the weak. Yet even so, their spiritual weapons were as useful as toothpicks. It only helped taking one blow.
This had them shaken. Just what was that thing Zhuo Fan was holding for even 9th grade spiritual weapons to be solely lacking?
They began to take this fight more seriously.
In terms of strength, Zhuo Fan was clearly weaker, as weak as a lamb in fact. But that sword turned the lamb into a wolf with a ravenous appetite.
These almighty elders of the Universal Righteous Sect were scared. Elder Bai He glared with such fury at Zhao Dezhu, “What the hell is wrong with you? How could you miss telling us he has such a godly weapon?”
“Elder Bai He, I-I didn’t know!” Zhao Dezhu felt wronged, then stared daggers at Zhuo Fan.
[Just how much is he hiding? Why didn’t he take it out when he fought Ye Lin?]
How was he supposed to know this sword, no matter how incredible, had to be kept hidden. He could not just flaunt it and end up dead as a result.
Just like these elders, while clueless of being western lands’ guardian treasure, they all felt greed to possess such a mighty bauble.
If it was so awesome in Zhuo Fan’s hand, then what about in a Soul Harmony expert’s?
They all started attacking Zhuo Fan. Their spiritual weapons fell down like rain. At the same time, they also unleashed techniques to cover all bases.
Zhuo Fan could defend against one attack, but not both. And when he died, they could finally steal that sword.
Zhuo Fan squinted. He saw through them and grinned. His right eye flashed golden once more.
[Divine Eye of the Void’s 1st stage, Shift!]
Zhuo Fan vanished and reappeared before Elder Bai He, who didn’t have a spiritual weapon.
Bai He was stunned and dodged as he cursed.
[For crying out loud! Stop coming at me! You already ruined my spiritual weapon and now you come to finish the job? If you have the nerve, leave the sword and fight me like a man!]
Elder Bai He fled with Zhuo Fan on his tail. The surrounding Ethereal Stage experts were dumbstruck. A Radiant Stage cultivator was chasing a Soul Harmony Stage one. Talk about baffling.
This was unheard of.
Elder Bai He’s heart collapsed in hatred, but that was it. A Soul Harmony Stage’s soul and body combination was tough, but was no different from paper before that sword.
[How humiliating! Being chased around before such a crowd by a damn brat!]
Though it was much better than getting killed.
So he ran with Zhuo Fan behind him. The only thing missing was a cry for help.
“Elder Bai He, here I come to help you!” Another elder shouted and lifted his spear as he charged Zhuo Fan.
At the same time, he also combined his soul with his body, while punching at Zhuo Fan. This was using two different attacks!
Zhuo Fan had no way of keeping the pursuit of his quarry. As for shifting again…
Zhuo Fan frowned as the other elders were now on guard at his every move. No matter how he tried to ambush them again, they were ready.
He could only fight.
With a creepy glint in his eyes, Zhuo Fan flicked his sword and threw it at the spear then his arm flashed red as he punched the incoming attack.
The elder was overjoyed, “Ha-ha-ha, no matter how strong you are, my fist is backed by my soul! You can’t escape!”
“Ha-ha-ha, I know that…” Zhuo Fan grinned and his eye flashed golden, “So I’m smashing your spiritual weapon!”
The other was stunned to see that he and the Atlas Sword switched places.
Bam!
Zhuo Fan’s punch struck the spear, making him fly back and cough blood. While the elder’s fist was now faced a demonic sword, sending terror through his bones.
Whoosh~
With a mournful cry, another Soul Harmony Stage elder met his demise. His body fell in a pool of blood and the sword came back to Zhuo Fan’s hand.
Panting, Zhuo Fan wiped his bloody mouth and showed a crazed grin, “That’s two…”
Sss~
The others were gasping in fright. The six elders looked at Zhuo Fan like he was a monster, their fists shaking.
In just a short time, two elders were gone.
[This kid’s tricks are twisted!]
“Everyone attack!”
Elder Bai He gnashed his teeth, “The punk is using every gap in our attacks to pick us one by one. With his sword and those creepy skills, even we might end up dead by his blade.”
The others shook and nodded after a short moment.
“It looks like we’ll have to lower ourselves. The kid is worthy of us doing this!” Elder Bai He looked around then set his eyes on Zhao Dezhu. “Take a hundred men and go after the girls. The rest of you attack the vile spawn together!”
“Yes, sir!”
They all shouted, even Zhao Dezhu, “Zhao Dezhu, I hope you’ll be alive when I come back with those girls, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhao Dezhu then took his men to pass Zhuo Fan.
Boom!
However, an explosion came as a huge scarlet dragon once again appeared before them.
Zhuo Fan spoke deadly, “I told you, none shall…”
Bam!
He did not finish as his body shook and coughed blood.
He saw that a Soul Harmony Stage elder appeared before the dragon and punched it. Almighty Scarlet Dragon King’s hard scales crumbled to pieces as it howled.
“Ha-ha-ha, the dragon soul is finally out.”
Elder Bai He gave a devious smile, “You took your soul back to have an easier time with Elder Yin Chui and not expose your weakness. However, you want to stop them so you have to take it out again, exposing it before a Soul Harmony expert. It seems to me, those girls are very important to you, more than your life.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shook. Even with the blood flowing from his mouth and his woozy body, he still stood his ground.
Elder Bai He sighed, “There’s no point. With another punch, your dragon soul will crumble. Your sword is amazing, but it can’t stop everything.”
“Ha-ha-ha, yes, you have a choice now. Give up your life or let us pass and get the girls!”
Zhao Dezhu laughed, “Though I hope you’ll pick the latter. If you don’t take your soul back, the next punch will kill you and won’t be able to save those girls. But if you take it back, won’t you see the girls again soon? Ha-ha-ha, well, what will you choose…”
Zhao Dezhu was having a kick out of Zhuo Fan’s plight, mocking him for it.
Zhuo Fan had a vile grin, his eyes still firm, “I told you, none shall pass me!”
“Die then!”
Zhao Dezhu shouted, then he turned to the elder before the dragon, “Elder, if you would.”
The man showed a bloodthirsty glint and punched into the dragon’s back.
Just then, what shocked everyone was that when the punch landed, everything was quiet.
Then, with a cry, the dragon turned pitch-black, oozing black energy as it engulfed him…

chapters.title: Chapter 778: Chopping Galore
chapters.content:
Chapter 778: Chopping Galore
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“What? The soul changed!”
The elder who punched the black dragon gasped and could not get away from it.
Zhao Dezhu cried out, “T-that’s Zhuo Fan’s dragon soul variant, Heaven Devouring Demonic Dragon King!”
“Correct.”
Zhuo Fan snickered then spewed blood, “Heaven Devouring Demonic Dragon King can take on any power for itself. Even if a Soul Harmony expert punched, it would lose most of its power. You want to smash me? Humph, think again…”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed with bloodlust and his right eye shone golden as the demonic sword vanished again.
It came back from the front of the elder.
The elder was scared to death and panicked, but nothing he did could get his fist out of the Heaven Devouring Demonic Dragon King’s black energy.
In the end, another wail adorned the sky as the demonic blade robbed him of his life by cutting him in two.
Blood fell down like rain as the creepy demonic sword returned to Zhuo Fan’s hands. It shone a blood-red light that reflected in the others’ eyes.
“Moreover, trapped in Heaven Devouring Demonic Dragon King, you won’t get out so easily, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan’s laughter pierced their ears, making everyone shiver. The remaining five elders felt fear now, with sweat gathering on their brows.
That was the third one!
If they didn’t see it, they wouldn’t have believed it. A great Soul Harmony expert actually died at the hands of a kid not yet in the Ethereal Stage; and not just one.
The blade was just too strange and savage. Not even a Soul Harmony expert with his soul and body united could handle it. But what else did the kid have beside the sword? Nothing else he used could threaten them.
Even so, they understood fully that sword’s power and were on high alert. Even as they all were cautious to dodge its edge, they still fell one by one.
This was no longer an issue with the sword, but with Zhuo Fan. He was a threat to everyone!
The tragic deaths of three of them had the elders admit that they were up against a dangerous enemy.
It wasn’t just the sword, but the wielder as well.
Elder Bai He squinted and shouted, “Everyone attack! No matter what it costs, we have to take the vile spawn’s head! We’ll go after the girls after we have his corpse!”
“Elder Bai He, his sword is too strong. Our losses will be heavy!” One elder spoke, shaken.
Elder Bai He shook his head and gnashed his teeth. “We don’t have a choice. The kid is too weird. If we try anything else, we won’t win. The best method is to drown him with numbers, to use superior strength on the weak. When he’s so busy fending us all off, he’ll die for sure!”
“But…”
“No buts!”
Elder Bai He cut him off with a flick of his hand, “We’ll only leave a hundred Ethereal Stage experts anyway. The Universal Righteous Sect can take it.”
Elder Bai He led the charge, but did not dare to face Zhuo Fan head on, going for the dragon soul instead, “Those with spiritual weapons, attack his body. The rest, go for his soul!”
“Yes, sir!”
Seeing an elder beginning the assault, the rest shouted and took out their souls.
The remaining four elders saw this and nodded. They gripped their spiritual weapons and went for Zhuo Fan as they unleashed their mighty power.
It was like two mountains came crumbling down. One went for Zhuo Fan and the other for the dragon soul. No matter which struck home, he would die either way.
However, he could not dodge because behind him were the girls…
“Ha-ha-ha, Zhuo Fan, you want to use yourself to shield the girls? Then I’ll walk all over your corpse and grab them!”
Zhao Dezhu followed Bai He closely as he shouted, “See how in fifteen minutes you’ll end up dead and ruined. And with your fall, those girls will be next. All you’ve done would be for nothing! You can’t save anyone!”
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook. He looked rather frail, but his eyes held a vague glint, “Oh really? Thanks for the reminder. It seems I’ll survive a while longer at least…”
Showing a devilish smile, Zhuo Fan made a sign.
Soul variant, Vaulting Dragon King!
Whoosh~
The demonic dragon withdrew its black energy and azure flames began to cover its body.
Elder Bai He jerked but before he could react, the azure dragon opened its maw to unleash a torrent of azure flame at the hundreds of souls around.
“Agh~!”
Wails and cries were heard all around as the wave of souls had not even reached the dragon soul and they were burning in an azure inferno. Their bodies jerked and twitched from pain.
The unlucky ones unable to withdraw had been burned down to nothing.
In a blink, dozens of Ethereal Stage experts were gone from this world.
Everyone gasped from shock. Even Zhao Dezhu didn’t think that the azure dragon that had been passive in Ye Lin’s fight would unleash such power. It killed so many and heavily wounded a hundred.
How could any of them know the chaos azure flame might be a gentle flame, weaker in a fight than a fierce flame, like Decimating Golden Flame, it still came from a sacred beast. It was only weaker in relation to that golden dragon.
If you thought azure dragon was weak because of that, then what happened now was only natural.
Elder Bai He glared at Zhao Dezhu, as if blaming him.
[Why couldn’t you report his strength sooner?]
How was Zhao Dezhu to know? He was only watching the fight, not participating in it. He only knew that Almighty Scarlet Dragon King was tough while the others were always on defense.
Zhao Dezhu felt like crying.
Now he knew just how bitter Ye Lin and Zhuo Fan’s fight was. Their fight was beyond their stage, something the audience could not comprehend.
“The brat still had some more damn skills? Tell me everything you know already!” Elder Bai He gnashed his teeth and barked.
Zhao Dezhu shook his head, his eyes hazy, “There shouldn’t be any great moves left. Although he has another variant, a purple dragon, but that is used for ambushes, and it’s weak…”
Rumble!
As if on cue, purple lightning flashed in waves and crossed the inferno to strike at the hundreds of souls.
Dozens of more souls fell right then and dozens more withdrew with heavy wounds.
“Is this what you mean by a weak variant?” Elder Bai He’s face twitched and wanted to slap the kid into the hereafter.
Zhao Dezhu lowered his head, puzzled on the inside.
[Why did Zhuo Fan look so weak when fighting Ye Lin in the Double Dragon Gathering? How is he so strong now?]
“Never mind. I won’t ask you who knows nothing. I’ll break his dragon soul myself!” Elder Bai He flicked his sleeve enraged, shooting for the dragon soul with the power of Soul Harmony Stage. He easily broke the purple lightning and the azure inferno.
“Elder Bai He, the purple dragon variant has the weakest defense.”
“I won’t believe a word you say. Now get lost!”
Zhao Dezhu’s reminder got a reprimand from Elder Bai He, making him jerk back and stay silent to stew in anger.
[I was only trying to help! It’s your fault if you die!]
At the same time, in front of Zhuo Fan, four elders wielding spiritual weapons came to take his life with their superior cultivation.
Zhuo Fan clashed with them as he wielded the demonic sword.
Elder Bai He arrived at the purple dragon and raised his fists but did not strike, looking instead at Zhuo Fan.
He saw Zhuo Fan’s skill back then. That Shift was insanely powerful.
Now that he faced four experts at full power, if he went head on, he would die even if the demonic sword ruined the spiritual weapons as the power would transfer to him and kill him on the spot. But if he shifted away, that would be the best moment for Bai He to kill his soul and end this.
He was afraid that he would get stuck like the other elder and end up dead.
To make sure this didn’t happen, Bai He stayed his hand, not wanting to give his enemy an opening to exploit.
Even if Zhuo Fan got to him, he could instantly flee and draw him out while the four elders would focus on the dragon soul.
So no matter the choice, Zhuo Fan would die for sure. Details made a plan come together and Elder Bai He was a sharp man. That was why he chose to stay his hand, to see what Zhuo Fan would choose…

chapters.title: Chapter 779: Chaotic Fight
chapters.content:
Chapter 779: Chaotic Fight
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Bam!
Zhuo Fan’s sword clashed with the four elders’ spiritual weapons, turning them to pieces. Zhuo Fan had to cough blood from that encounter, their power wreaking havoc in his body.
Elder Bai He laughed, “This kid doesn’t have the strength to move like that again? Of the three choices, he picked the quickest to die. Did he give up resisting?
“This is much better. His insides must be mush right about now and can’t use the sword again. Next I’ll just smash his dragon soul to pieces!”
Overjoyed, Elder Bai He’s eyes shone and punched, sending all his power forward.
The purple lightning struck the attack, but it did nothing to stop it.
Boom!
With a mighty sound, Elder Bai He grinned at the shaking dragon. “This time you’re going to fall, heaven dragon soul!”
Whoosh~
Black energy covered the dragon, switching from purple lighting as it roared.
“Ha-ha-ha, I see it now. At the critical moment you’ll change to a demonic dragon to disperse my power?” Elder Bai He mocked, “So what? Even what remains will be enough to wound you. The only thing great about this dragon soul is that it can change forms and only drag out its death. But I will still kill you either way.”
Elder Bai He was about to strike again, but he found that he couldn’t. His fist was stuck just like that elder’s.
Sneering, Elder Bai He’s body shook and unleashed more power to scatter the black energy as he pulled out his fist. “Humph, Zhuo Fan, your body is already useless and can’t use that instant movement. Your dragon can only stall for a couple of moments. Fighting your body might be a threat to us, but your soul alone can’t be saved. Die!”
“Elder Bai He!”
However, a cry came from the four elders. Looking over he asked, “What?”
“O-our spiritual weapons aren’t ruined.” An elder held his spiritual weapon in shock as he shouted.
Bai He jerked and looked careful to see that they were holding their weapons while Zhuo Fan was coughing blood in front of them. He was wobbling yet the demonic sword had the same strong vibe.
[What… just happened?]
If the four elders’ spiritual weapons were not ruined that meant they did not clash with the demonic sword. But why would Zhuo Fan get himself killed by doing this? To leave his soul alone?
Elder Bai He was perplexed.
However, a sudden wave of bloodlust came from behind.
Startled, Bai He panicked and tried to dodge, only to find that his hand was still stuck in the black dragon, though it would only last four a couple of moments.
More than enough to kill him.
Pff!
As blood spurted, Elder Bai He’s body was severed.
“I-I’ve been had…”
Elder Bai He’s lips trembled, forcing himself to turn around, to see Zhuo Fan’s cold eyes and bloody mouth, “W-what happened?”
“Cough~”
Zhuo Fan kept coughing, though his face was flat, “No matter how cautious you are, the moment you win, you’ll feel invincible. I only gave you that moment, that’s all.”
Elder Bai He looked at Zhuo Fan hovering in the air then at the Zhuo Fan behind him with hazy eyes.
[Why are there two of him?]
“Ha-ha-ha, ignorance is crime. You have no way of knowing all I’m capable of!”
Grinning, Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed in three golden halos, “Divine Eye of the Void’s 3rd stage, Mirage World.”
Whoosh~
The one holding the demonic sword kept spewing blood yet vanished the next second, leaving only the Zhuo Fan behind Bai He, grinning at the four remaining elders.
Illusion!
Everyone understood that even if Zhuo Fan popped behind Elder Bai He, he still couldn’t kill him even with the dragon soul holding him. He had to lure him first.
But with the elder seeing his trick once, was he going to fall for it as well?
So Zhuo Fan set up an illusion, letting Bai He think he faced them head on and letting him attack the soul in peace.
The illusion was easy to break, as the four elders found their spiritual weapons didn’t crumble when meeting with the demonic sword.
But Elder Bai He, who was not around, only saw that the plan worked and couldn’t help but strike as well. At that moment, Zhuo Fan capitalized on the elder’s mistake.
Elder Bai He looked at the sky as his eyes became empty and he died. The two halves of his body fell to the ground, his eyes forever open in regret.
Who’d have thought a great Soul Harmony expert would die with such regret?
[That’s four…]
Shaken to the core, the four remaining elders looked at Zhuo Fan panting heavily and spewing blood, yet all they felt was fear as they backed away.
He wasn’t even in the Ethereal Stage, also wounded and surrounded yet still killed a Soul Harmony expert. The first time was a miracle, the second was a mishap, but the third one had them all attacking to prevent any more from dying.
Then the fourth kill came and proved he had the power still.
The four elders felt their hearts sinking looking into those savage eyes.
[Who the hell is this guy?]
In the end, they were hardened cultivators of many years, soon recovering their calm after a bit of shock.
They were Soul Harmony experts. How could a mere Radiant Stage prick kill four of them?
“Attack! All of you attack! No plans, just kill the damn kid no matter the cost!”
Finally, as four of them died, the elders went mad as they shouted, going for Zhuo Fan head on. The remaining Ethereal Stage experts followed them.
Zhao Dezhu was even in front, his eyes bloodshot. He had asked for this fight from the sect. Now four elders lay dead and if he didn’t get his head, he could never get back to the sect.
Zhuo Fan looked at the flood of people charging over and tightened his grip on the demonic sword. He took a deep breath and gnashed his teeth as he charged as well with his weary body.
This had never happened before in the history of time. Hundreds of experts ganged up on a lower cultivator. This was a bloody and thunderous chaotic battle.
If the Universal Righteous Sect had gone all out from the start, their losses wouldn’t have been so great. But in this chaos, the death toll only rose.
The Ethereal Stage experts unleashed their souls on Zhuo Fan without regard for their safety. Zhuo Fan’s azure dragon spewed fire that killed many, the purple dragon sent purple lightning that singed even more.
But the tide could not be stopped, slamming into the dragon soul.
Zhuo Fan spat blood again, his eyes going dark and about to fall unconscious. But he had someone to protect. He bit his tongue to wake up.
The purple dragon shifted into the demonic dragon, to absorb as much as possible of those soul attacks. Then it switched to Almighty Scarlet Dragon King and with a lash of the whip, destroying dozens of more souls.
This was how the dragon soul kept changing form to deal with the storm of souls coming to rob his life. He instead robbed their lives, bodies falling from the sky after giving out one last mournful cry.
Under the constant attacks, the dragon soul was battered as well, howling constantly.
Zhuo Fan endured the pain his soul was suffering and charged head on with the demonic sword in hand, his eyes bloodshot. Everywhere he went, someone would fall to pieces.
Another pile of bodies started hitting the ground.
The four elders held their weapons and charged at his body. Zhuo Fan wielded the demonic sword and clashed with them a hundred times yet no winner was revealed.
The demonic sword forced the elders to keep retreating after each attack, its savage blade reaped dozens of Ethereal Stage experts with every swing. No one could approach their battle as each fought to gain the advantage.
This had long stopped being a trap, becoming a bitter war, five hundred people against one man. It was utter chaos…

chapters.title: Chapter 780: You’re Not Worthy
chapters.content:
Chapter 780: You’re Not Worthy
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“W-where am I?”
The heavy night descended as a bloody man crawled out of the grass. The stench of blood around him made him cough, sometimes even vomit.
The clear moon sent her soft rays, shining its light on this weary man’s face.
Facepalming, Zhao Dezhu pondered before getting up. He was ordered by his sect to kill the demon Zhuo Fan. But he was just too strong, unable to get him even with superior numbers. That last tail swipe from the Almighty Scarlet Dragon King killed so many, and since he was at the front, even if he survived it, only now did he wake up from the heavy blow.
He was in the dark about whether that Zhuo Fan was finished or not.
Zhao Dezhu looked at the moon above and sighed, “It’s already dark. He has to have fallen by now. But how many died?”
As if on cue, the world seemed to answer him as the moon shone on the limbs and bodies laying in bloody mud.
Where he was right now, was right in the middle of a river of blood…
“T-that many?” Zhao Dezhu looked around in shock at the hellscape and gruesome display, at the limbs without a body to match.
Zhao Dezhu shook and muttered, “What now? What now? I can’t take the blame for these losses…”
Boom!
However, his musing to weasel out were put on hold at the sound of that explosion and the incoming gale whipping his face.
Startled, Zhao Dezhu rushed forward, flying towards the fire in the sky.
The Universal Righteous Sect still had a hundred Ethereal Stage experts gasping for breath and staring at their enemy with fear and shock. But what was more pronounced were the feelings of hatred and terror.
In front of them stood three elders in dirty and ripped clothes, the spiritual weapons in their hands shaking.
“N-no way! He’s still alive?”
Zhao Dezhu’s heart sank and flew over, squeezing between the men and getting in front. But the scene he saw left him shellshocked.
Before them was the same dragon, although wretched and with broken scales, about to breathe its last, it still swiped its tail as it fought the crowd with utter determination. Just like Zhuo Fan, it was going to fight to the last breath.
In front of it stood a man covered in blood, holding a demonic sword as blood dripped from his face. His eyes were welcoming death, his face was flat. The tens of ghastly wounds on his body kept spewing out blood. Some of the wounds even had dried blood on them. Despite all the pain and damage, he still stood. He stared at the men before him with a dead and firm look.
Pa!
An elder shifted his leg and shot forth. The sword pierced forward but then he jerked back even faster.
Frowning, the elder looked at the others with fury, “Is Zhuo Fan even human? We’ve ruined his body to this degree, his innards are crushed, but yet he still killed an elder. He had killed four hundred Ethereal Stage experts and took down five Soul Harmony elders as well. He had paid for it, getting so many wounds on his body and soul. I just can’t believe he’s alive even after all that. Will he die only when his soul is ripped apart?”
“This kid is too tough. Is he really in the Radiant Stage?”
Another elder panted, his whole body covered in blood as he stared at Zhuo Fan with bitterness, “If we want to destroy his soul I fear we’ll all be annihilated. He might be on his last breath, but I know that his body is as tough as a zombie’s. If we want to kill him, we’ll have to pay the price. And to think this used to be an easy mission. Now look what came of it.”
The other two nodded, “Yeah.”
“What?!”
As the trio discussed, a shout had them all startled. They saw Zhao Dezhu in shock as he wobbled over, “Elders, what are you saying? We’ve lost so many? Five Soul Harmony Stage elders and four hundred Ethereal Stage experts?”
The elders sighed and nodded.
Shaking all over, Zhao Dezhu turned around and looked outraged at Zhuo Fan panting in the distance, “Zhuo Fan, why aren’t you dead yet? I personally asked for this mission from the sect. With so many dead, how am I to explain it?”
Zhao Dezhu’s raving was unheard by Zhuo Fan. He just stood there with a cold gaze.
“Five hundred Ethereal Stage experts and eight elders were sent yet we can’t even catch a Radiant Stage cultivator after a whole day of fighting? We even lost so many men and five elders!”
This outcome had finally sinked in to Zhao Dezhu as he raved, “Just what the hell are you? Why can’t you just die? You just kept fighting the Universal Righteous Sect’s five hundred experts to not overtake you for one day. You ruined my life, you ruined my future!”
Zhuo Fan just stood there in silence.
The others reminded Zhao Dezhu, “Senior brother, we’ve been fighting for three days, not one.”
“What?!”
Zhao Dezhu’s butt hit the ground from the shock, “I’ve been out for three days? He’s been holding on for three days?”
The three elders flushed and lowered their heads in shame. So many men were fighting yet they could not take one Radiant Stage cultivator down even after three days? Talk about a humiliation.
The ever silent Zhuo Fan finally let out a stiff voice, “Ha-ha-ha, I see, it’s been three days. That means you won’t catch them…”
WIth those words, Zhuo Fan collapsed and the dragon soul closed its eyes and vanished.
Only the sword entered Zhuo Fan and was gone.
Startled, the men looked around stumped. Why did he suddenly collapse when no one did anything when he lasted three days of fighting?
Zhao Dezhu was also startled. An elder came to Zhuo Fan and sighed, “I see, he’s already dead.”
“He’s dead?!” Zhao Dezhu cried, “But he was still…”
The elder shook his head, “He was holding on that last breath to stop us from chasing the girls. With this last effort he held us back for three days. In fact, his body must’ve died long ago, only his soul remaining.”
“How strange, he is covered in deep wounds, each deadly, yet he could still stand. He must’ve died on his feet.”
Taking a deep breath, another elder stared at Zhuo Fan, “When any other’s body is destroyed, their soul would scatter. But he could drag out the last breath with his body up till now. Such willpower, even for a demonic cultivator, it’s that of a hero.”
“How freakish, he’s an unheard of monster.”
The third elder’s eyes flashed, filled with bloodlust, “Don’t forget, he controlled his heavily wounded soul and this broken corpse to fight us for three days. No matter how heroic, how can one breath last him for so long? Who can control both the body and the soul? This thing would be to dangerous to be left alive.”
The three elders nodded and shouted, “Kill!”
They all struck at once, holding nothing back even against his corpse. They were Soul Harmony experts and their blows would sure wipe off every trace of his existance.
However, a flash of golden slammed the trio away. When they stopped, they saw a youth in a golden cloak.
“Ye Lin! What are you doing here?”
Zhao Dezhu cried out.
Ignoring him, Ye Lin only looked at Zhuo Fan, placing him on his shoulder.
The elders shouted, “Put him down right now!”
“You want to kill him?”
Ye Lin sneered as he looked at them with despise, “You’re not worthy!”

chapters.title: Chapter 781: Inferno
chapters.content:
Chapter 781: Inferno
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Shaking all over, the three elders’ expressions turned heavy. They might have not gone to Double Dragon Gathering, but they heard of him from Zhao Dezhu’s report.
Ye Lin, Double Dragon Gathering’s runner up. He fought with Zhuo Fan on the same level, even being able to push Zhuo Fan back for a while.
Such an expert had to be on the same level as Zhuo Fan. Zhuo Fan alone was bad enough, reducing them to this state, but adding Ye Lin into the mix and their hearts sank.
However, they were not about to let Zhuo Fan, who was barely even alive, go. They had paid too much already, and if they did not achieve some manner of success, they would be too ashamed to return to the sect.
So, one elder flicked his spiritual weapon and stepped forward as he urged, “Ultimate Clarity Sect is a righteous sect like the Universal Righteous Sect. Ye Lin, we have heard of your great name, the future of our righteous path. Why then would you have come to save a demonic cultivator whelp? If we don’t get rid of him now, he will be a calamity upon the righteous sects, you included. I’m sure you don’t want to be beneath another, to let western lands’ strongest man title fall in the hands of a vile demonic cultivator!”
“He-he-he, today, the Universal Righteous Sect stepped in to eliminate him, to purge demons and protect western lands’ righteous path. Just turn a blind eye and leave him here. You won’t be reprimanded for it, being called cynical or jealous. You won’t get your hands dirty and you’d get famous as well. Two birds with one stone…”
“Shut your trap!”
The elder appealed to his devotion and on his practical side, thinking Ye Lin would surely agree since he’d be the biggest winner in this.
However, the elder was rudely cut off.
He stared at Ye Lin’s dark look as the young man raged, “A loss is a loss, a win is a win. I will never lower myself to these filthy schemes and stain my name as a sacred beast inheritor.”
[Sacred beast inheritor?]
The others looked at each other puzzled.
[What’s that?]
“Humph, nothing but a bunch of despicable dirtbags from the mortal domain. It’s like talking to retards.”
Ye Lin mocked them, then looked at Zhuo Fan on his shoulder and sighed, “This man might be the only one like me in the world…”
Ye Lin’s hand shone golden and a fist sized ball appeared, releasing golden flames that burned hot.
The others jerked back in fear.
They did not know what that was, but it released a true power of destruction.
They could feel it in their bones that it was terrifying. Not even the three elders could take it on. They gulped and sweated as they looked at it.
“Ye Lin, what is that?” Zhao Dezhu shook backward, finally working up his courage.
Ye Lin snickered, “The dead don’t need to know. And who the hell would be on the same side with you? In this world, only one man is worthy. The rest are worthless!”
Ye Lin flicked his shoulder and the golden ball shot into the crowd.
Their instinct screamed at them to flee, not that they could.
Boom!
In a huge explosion that scattered the clouds, even the earth cracked.
The golden ball exploded in everyone’s faces unleashing its scorching flames everywhere. In a blink, an inferno was born. The fire burned high and warped the air as it did, on the verge of breaking space itself.
Zhao Dezhu and his hundred experts, the three elders included, had no time to even cry out, obliterated down to the last vestige.
The inferno spread for a thousand miles, burning everything and turning it into hell. Nothing living remained.
Ye Lin looked coldly and then faded away from this place…
Meanwhile…
Whoosh~
In the dead of night, three girls fled, with the leading one showing signs of crying.
“Sister Qingcheng, it’s been three days. They shouldn’t chase us now. Let’s rest.” Dan’er saw Chu Qingcheng’s weary look and proposed.
Shui Ruohua nodded, “Qingcheng, in your sadness you gave all you had and are hurt. It’s best we rest for now. Maybe Zhuo Fan would even catch up.”
“No, Zhuo Fan is using his life so we can escape. How can we fail him?”
Closing her eyes, Chu Qingcheng gnashed her teeth, her eyes tearing up again, “We’ll only stop when we get to Double Dragon Manor.”
Chu Qingcheng’s voice was firm. The girls shook their heads and sighed.
Boom!
A huge explosion came from far away, followed by towering flames. Such an intense heat spread everywhere as it scorched everything.
The girls were flying yet could still feel the heat wave reaching them, pushing them into the ground.
When they finally got up, they stood dumbstruck. The inferno reached the heavens, like a gateway to hell. Nothing alive was spared. Even though they were thousands of miles away, they could still feel its scorching heat lick their faces.
“Gods, what happened there? Where did this fire come from?” Dan’er gasped and then cried out, “Isn’t that where brother Zhuo is…”
“Dan’er!”
Shui Ruohua shouted and glared at her.
Startled, Dan’er noticed Chu Qingcheng looked at the fire with a stunned look, her eyes shedding tears, “Zhuo Fan!”
With a wail, Chu Qingcheng flew onward but Shui Ruohua stopped her, “Qingcheng, are you crazy? With such a raging fire, you’ll die if you go!”
“I don’t care. Zhuo Fan!” Chu Qingcheng lost her calm, giving a mournful cry and struggling to go.
Shui Ruohua steeled her heart and struck her neck, rendering her unconscious.
Looking at Dan’er, the two sighed at the crying Chu Qingcheng.
They had never seen the always dignified girl be so frantic. She really cared for Zhuo Fan.
Heart in pain, Dan’er pitied Chu Qingcheng, then she asked, “Senior sister Ruohua, what do we do now?”
“What else can we do? Get Qingcheng to Double Dragon Manor. Only there will we be safe.”
“A-and brother Zhuo?” Dan’er asked.
Looking back at the blaze, Shui Ruohua sighed, “This inferno is not something we can handle. I hope he’s alright. But…”
Shui Ruohua shook her head and her eyes were filled with sorrow.
Dan’er lowered her head, her eyes moist. She knew that under such devastating destruction, Zhuo Fan had no chance at all…
The two took Chu Qingcheng with a heavy heart and resumed their journey to Double Dragon Manor.
In Windgaze City, Luo clan.
“Zhuo Fan!”
Shuang’er was sleeping when she suddenly jolted awake and shouting. Her eyes were shining like the clear starry sky, her face a mask of fear.
Creak~
The door opened and Luo Yunhai with Luo Yunchang entered.
Luo Yunchang sat next to her and asked, “Shuang’er, what happened? Why did you shout with all your strength? You have everyone scared. What exactly is going on? “
“Sister Yunchang, Z-Zhuo Fan is… dead.”
Shuang’er’s lips quivered as tears fell.
Luo Yunhai shook in disbelief, “Shuang’er, what are you saying? He is married to Edifice Lord Chu and a Sect Leader. He should be happy right now, not…”
Luo Yunchang’s eyes teared up, her heart frantic.
“I don’t know.”
Shuang’er shook her head, “I just saw, really saw how Z-Zhuo Fan fell in a pool of blood, then the golden flames…”
“Clan Head, sister Shuang’er is the Holy Maiden of the empire, peering into the workings of the world. Steward Zhuo might be outside such machinations, but this premonition might not be unfounded.” Leng Wuchang analyzed, “It seems it has gone as I feared, and so quick at that…”
Luo Yunhai flicked his hand and shouted, “Guard, send a spy to the Demon Scheming Sect to feel them out. Report back at once!”
“Yes, sir!”
A shout came from beyond the door…

chapters.title: Chapter 782: Ren Xiaoyun
chapters.content:
Chapter 782: Ren Xiaoyun
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Knock~
In a dusky room, with few lights arranged, the face of High Venerable was reflected as he sat cross-legged.
A heavy voice came from outside, breaking his peace, “Who is it?”
“Master, it’s I. I came to pay my respects.” A familiar voice spoke with respect.
Elder Yuan spoke, “Wuyue, you haven’t done it for centuries, so what made you pick the habit again?”
“Ha-ha-ha, it’s not so strange, master.”
Xie Wuyue spoke, “I have been a Sect Leader all this time, keeping with the sect’s norms and could not pay my master any respects. Now that I have stepped down and I’m free, I of course have to make up for all those years.”
Elder Yuan felt doubt inside, but softened in the end. Wanting to go back to those close times with his disciple, he lifted the seal on the door, “Enter.”
The heavy stone door was pushed open and Xie Wuyue stepped in with a smile. He kneeled and kowtowed three times.
“Master, I came to pay my respects.” Like a good child, Xie Wuyue put on a genial face.
Nodding, Elder Yuan’s eyes held a hint of sneer, “Wuyue, you only came here for your own reason, not to pay me respects.”
“Master, I would never.”
“Humph, a master knows his student. You were never so honest.” Elder Yuan sighed and waved, “Say your piece.”
Xie Wuyue looked Elder Yuan in the eye as he chuckled, “The older, the wiser, as they say. I can’t hide anything from master. Ha-ha-ha, master, I have reflected deeply on your guidance a month ago and ask that master gives me another chance.”
“You still want to be a Sect Leader?” Elder Yuan eyed him.
Xie Wuyue nooded with a smile, “Yes, a nation can’t be without a king and the same applies to a sect. Zhuo Fan has gone to Double Dragon Manor just as he became Sect Leader, leaving the seat empty. If it was just a couple of days or so, it wouldn’t matter, but he will be gone for decades. Not handling the matters a Sect Leader does will lead to the sect becoming a mess.”
“Don’t worry, there’s also me. Moreover, there are venerables helping…”
“Master, you’re the High Venerable, leading the sect’s matters in the name of the Sect Leader will lead to bad rumors. If it drags out, some might say that High Venerable wants to break the sect’s ancient rules, to take matters into your own hand and the seat.”
“Who would spread such gossip?” Elder Yuan looked squarely at Xie Wuyue.
Xie Wuyue’s head jerked back, lowering it as he bowed, “I could never try to surmise what my master thinks, but others will surely prattle and ruin master’s name. Especially those venerables, who only scheme and fight each other. They may be agreeing with everything you say now, but when their power grow, they would take matters into their own hands. As a Venerable, since you can handle the sect’s affairs, why can’t they? That’s why there are ancient rules. Deposing and even fraternization is possible, but only a Sect Leader can lead. Or it will affect people’s hearts and invite disaster.”
“Humph, who would scheme to exceed Sect Leader’s authority?”
Elder Yuan stood up and flicked his sleeve as he shouted, “I am an open man and only handle the matters of the sect in Zhuo Fan’s stead for the next years. When he returns, he will be taking up his duty as Sect Leader.”
Face twitching, Xie Wuyue’s expresson darkened, “Master, you’re too heartless. You’d rather wait on him then let me lead for these decades, rather than give me a chance? I promise that in these years, I will see to the public opinion. Once he’s back, no one will follow him. Let all know that there’s only one Sect Leader, Xie Wuyue!”
“Wuyue, I see now you not once reflected on what I told you.”
With a saddened look, Elder Yuan shook his head, “Public opinion is merely a method, while what matters is wisdom. That is what makes people follow you. Without it, you might catch their hearts in short term, but they would soon scatter later. When you understand the meaning of Dao, when you find your path, we’ll then speak of the Sect Leader position.”
Taking a deep breath, Xie Wuyue’s eyes went cold, clutching his fists, “Dao? Humph, master, you’re only being vague. Who can understand such unreal things? You’re only using it as an excuse to stop me from being a Sect Leader.”
Slowly turning away, Elder Yuan no longer looked at him. He sighed in disappointment.
“Master, you’re casting me out. I am trying so hard here, but you…”
Xie Wuyue tensed and his clenched fists crackled. Then a hint of bloodthirst appeared in his eyes. He made a claw with his hand and struck Elder Yuan’s waist, “High profound ranked martial art, Flood Dragon Claw!”
Whoosh~
Xie Wuyue’s dark claw arrived right before Elder Yuan.
Elder Yuan was outraged. He never thought his disciple would have the nerve to strike his master down.
Elder Yuan unleashed his power as well, his heavy power pressed on Xie Wuyue, stopping the claw in its track.
Elder Yuan flicked his hand and grabbed his arm to throw him out.
Bam!
Xie Wuyue was slammed into the wall like a ragdoll before slumping to the ground. He coughed a lot of blood.
“Xie Wuyue, you’re insane. I’m your master yet you dare raise your hand?” Clenching his fists, Elder Yuan’s eyes were bloodshot from anger.
Xie Wuyue gave a crazed mocking smile, “Master? You threw me off the Sect Leader seat and you dare call yourself master?”
Elder Yuan’s face shook, his heart overcome with grief.
Hum~
A green glow evelopped the dusky room.
Xie Wuyue mocked, “Impermanence Five, you finally came out. You make for poor bodyguards. What if I had hurt High Venerable?”
“No one in the sect can surpass High Venerable in power. You can’t hurt him. Our duty is only to prevent an ambush and disturb High Venerable’s cultivation.”
Elder She’s voice came from green glow, “As you’re master and disciple, we should not interfere, but Sect Leader Xie, you need to understand, High Venerable had never mistreated you. He had handled the matter of the Sect Leader position perfectly. Or did you really think you’d be alive if Zhuo Fan started a fight?”
Xie Wuyue wiped the blood from his mouth and nodded, “You’re right and I know that. That’s why I gave him one last chance to change his mind, help me take my seat back while Zhuo Fan was not here. However, he cast me out. It’s not my fault here. Moreover, since I did not kill him with my strike, you can take it as repaying his favor for saving me.”
“You’ve simply lost it! Xie Wuyue, you really think you could’ve harmed me?”
Elder Yuan shouted, “Impermanence Five, arrest Xie Wuyue!”
“Yes, sir!”
The elders nodded and made a sign. The green glow flashed and sent green lights for Xie Wuyue and around him.
With an evil glint in his eyes, Xie Wuyue mocked, not minding it at all, “Ha-ha-ha, lost it? Yuan Xinggang, don’t think you’re the strongest in Demon Scheming Sect, that you’re untouchable. I could have really killed you back then, but I didn’t to break the ties between us. We don’t owe each other anything now. Watch!”
Xie Wuyue shook his arm and the storage ring on his hand flashed. A mighty power exploded from within and slammed into the Vicissitude Domain.
Boom!
The green glow shook and the Impermanence Five had no cough blood.
“Who did this?” Elder She roared.
A cackle entered their ears, “Demon Scheming Sect’s Impermanence Five sure are something. You still breathe and only your domain is broken despite suffering the might of a Soul Harmony Stage.”
Whoosh~
A gray figure of a middle-aged man appeared tall and imposing before Elder Yuan.
Elder Yuan gasped in shock, “Heaven Trailing Sect’s Sect Leader, Ren Xiaoyun?!”
“Ha-ha-ha, it is indeed I!”
Ren Xiaoyun turned to Xie Wuyue’s ring, “It was a smart move to use the ring for an ambush. How did you came up with it, Sect Leader Xie?”
Xie Wuyue bowed slightly, “I only learned it from a certain shameless traitor. I didn’t think it would work to bring you so easily before High Venerable.”
“High Venerable, now do you believe me?”
Xie Wuyue turned to Elder Yuan with a smile, “If it wasn’t me who struck you before, but Sect Leader Ren from the ring, you would’ve died instead of preaching to me.”
Elder Yuan’s beard shook as he gnashed his teeth.
“That’s why I said I went easy on you for being your disciple, ha-ha-ha…” Xie Wuyue snickered.

chapters.title: Chapter 783: Shocking Changes in the Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 783: Shocking Changes in the Sect
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Why?”
High Venerable squinted at Ren Xiaoyun, “As the sect leader of Heaven Trailing Sect, the head of the empire’s three guardian sects, how could you side with this stubborn disciple and enter my sect to do this despicable thing?”
Ren Xiaoyun waved his hand in disdain, “Oh no, no, no, High Venerable you misunderstand. That stubborn disciple is a great Sect Leader. I only accepted Sect Leader’s invitation to help him settle the chaos.”
“What chaos…”
Elder Yuan soon realized as he watched the two’s devious grins, “I see. I was wondering how the Heaven Trailing Sect would dare meddle with the Demon Scheming Sect unafraid of Double Dragon Manor. Heaven Trailing Sect, you two already have your excuse ready. Using settling the chaos to eliminate the opposition and put him on his seat.”
Grinning, Ren Xiaoyun nodded, “High Venerable sure is wise, figuring out so fast. But you shouldn’t say it. After all we’re righteous cultivators and labeling us like this would hurt our name.”
“Humph, yeah, Heaven Trailing Sect is mighty righteous.”
Elder Yuan squinted and gnashed his teeth, turning to Xie Wuyue, “You consorted with another sect to shame your ancestors and master. Do you really think you have any right to be a Sect Leader?”
“Consorting? Didn’t Zhuo Fan do the same by bringing outsiders to steal my power? Why did you still take his side and spit on me?”
“Zhuo Fan brought his own men and did not take the sect. But you had Heaven Trailing Sect come here. Just what did you have to pay for this?” Elder Yuan roared.
Xie Wuyue clenched his fists but did not speak.
Ren Xiaoyun smiled, “I’ll answer that. To help Sect Leader Xie regain his seat, my Heaven Trailing Sect would offer its support for the low price of five thousand sacred stones. The Mystical Heaven Sect didn’t want anything, happy with just getting revenge by killing all that ruined his sect.”
“What?!”
Elder Yuan shook, looking at Xie Wuyue in disbelief, “You actually gave half of the rewards of Double Dragon Gathering to an outsider and even brought our enemy to kill us?”
As they talked, there were shouts and battle cries coming from outside. Elder Yuan was furious.
He knew the sect had a traitor working with the outsiders to lead to the ruin of the sect. It might never recover from this.
Xie Wuyue fell silent, but then he spoke coldly, “If the sect isn’t mine, what use do I have for it? Why would I let anyone who won’t obey me live?”
“Why you little…”
Pointing a shaking finger at Xie Wuyue, Elder Yuan went red from anger as he barked, “You’re just like Tianyu’s emperor! Xie Wuyue, you were never worthy to be a Sect Leader. You’re a traitor to the Demon Scheming Sect and I will remove you in the name of our ancestors!”
Elder Yuan charged at Xie Wuyue, the power he released pushing Xie Wuyue back.
He never thought that as a peak Ethereal Stage expert, he would be unable to resist High Venerable’s pressure.
But then Ren Xiaoyun laughed and blocked his palm, “Ha-ha-ha, High Venerable, aren’t you looking down on me by killing someone with me here? You do know we’re here to help Sect Leader Xie settle the chaos. If the Sect Leader died, how could our excuse stand? You’d go and get Double Dragon Manor to fight us. Ha-ha-ha, that just won’t do.”
“Ren Xiaoyun, screw off, or today is your funeral!” Elder Yuan roared.
Ren Xiaoyun smiled, “Yuan Xinggang, you must be so full of yourself. As far as I know, you’re nothing but a peak Ethereal Stage expert, while I’m in the 2nd layer of Soul Harmony Stage. You won’t kill me even if you want to!”
The two’s attacks clashed.
Bam!
A fierce sound echoed and Elder Yuan was pushed back five steps while Ren Xiaoyun ten steps.
[How is this possible?]
Ren Xiaoyun looked at him in disbelief while crying out, “You’re in the Soul Harmony Stage?”
“What?!”
Xie Wuyue was shocked and perplexed, “No way, that’s impossible. Master told me his constitution is lacking and won’t go beyond the Ethereal Stage in his life. How can he be in the Soul Harmony Stage?”
With a smile of disdain, earthen dragon scales appeared on Elder Yuan’s hands, “It was my blessing to meet Zhuo Fan, giving me a 10th grade pill, Heaven Reaching Pill to change my constitution and break through. My soul is also that of an earth dragon. Once uniting it with my body, I’ll be as strong as the earth. I might be in the 1st layer, but to deal with a 3rd layer isn’t a problem, that goes double for the 2nd layer.”
“Curses! How could this happen? I underestimated you, Demon Scheming Sect’s High Venerable!” Ren Xiaoyun turned searious and unleashed all his power, no longer looking down on him.
Xie Wuyue could hardly believe it as he asked, “Is that why you sided with Zhuo Fan, because he helped you?”
“Humph, fool, I’ve always been impartial. You know that very well.”
Elder Yuan mocked him, “You only asked to come up with an excuse for Zhuo Fan taking the seat as a result of siding with him, making you feel that being the Sect Leader is justly. But I already told you, Xie Wuyue, you’ll never amount to what Zhuo Fan is! He replaced you and brought back Dao. For trying to take back the Sect Leader position in betrayal, you had incurred heaven’s wrath!”
Xie Wuyue’s eyes were bloodshot from anger as he bellowed, “Enough! Why do you keep trusting an outsider but not your own disciple? You must die for this!”
“Humph, we’ll just see who goes first!” Elder Yuan shouted and shot for Xie Wuyue, but Ren Xiaoyun blocked him.
Bang~
Powerful shockwaves spread, making even the 9th grade array shake from how much power was unleashed.
Elder Yuan and Ren Xiaoyun were tangled up for now, unable to make a winner clear so soon. Xie Wuyue looked from the side, feeling like not even Sect Leader Ren could keep him safe and wanted to slip away.
But Elder Yuan shouted, “Impermanence Five, grab that degenerate disciple!”
“Yes, sir!”
Impermanence Five shouted and released their Vicissitude Domain, trapping Xie Wuyue as countless green lights wrapped around him.
[Curses!]
Xie Wuyue hurriedly made a sign, calling for a flood dragon, his soul.
It was not up to earth dragon soul’s standard, but it was still a top beast soul. The Impermanence Five would have a hard time for a while.
In this room, Elder Yuan and Impermanence Five were fighting with Heaven Trailing Sect’s Sect Leader and a traitor. Outside it, fires and chaos reigned as bodies piled up.
Heaven Trailing Sect was a middle-three sect, with tons of experts, adding to that Mystical Heaven Sect hell-bent on revenge and Venerable Shi working behind the scenes, Venerable Bai’s faction was caught unprepared.
Under the sudden onslaught, they had no power to fight back, only dying one after the other, with a wail or a pleading for mercy.
The best in the sect, High Venerable, was now caught up in a fight with Ren Xiaoyun. The second venerable, Venerable Shi, was a traitor, joining their killing. Who could save them now?
At the brink of despair, they could only breathe their lives in this hell.
“Curses, why is there an enemy attack? Why hasn’t the sect array given a sign- agh!”
“What’s going on? Why are there so many enemies…”
“Save me! Help! What- ugh!”
…
Wails reigned as Sect Leader Xuan led the charge in a crazed assault, “Kill them with joy, kill them good! Let them pay for ruining Mystical Heaven Sect, for killing my son! I won’t let any of them escape! Kill them to the last man, ha-ha-ha!”
Venerable Shi was silent at the side, just fiddling with his beard.
The elders and venerables behind him sighed. They were from the inner sect and against the Labor Office, but they were from the same sect.
Seeing their own people slaughtered filled them with pain…
“Sect Leader Xuan is enjoying his revenge so why are you here to watch this hellish brutality?”
A cold voice reached Venerable Shi’s ear, “Moreover, the dead are all part of your sect. Even if you have differences, they’re on the same side. Shouldn’t you at least not want to see the disciple fall like this?”
Venerable Shi shook and looked back and shouted, “Y-you?”

chapters.title: Chapter 784: Heaven Trailing Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 784: Heaven Trailing Sword
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Heaven-trailing Sword of the one sword five dragons!
Appearing before Venerable Shi was a cold man in his thirties. He had sharp brows and shining eyes, with but a hint of white on his temples.
He gulped.
He might look young, but Venerable Shi knew that he was as strong as High Venerable, known as Heaven Trailing Sword and even above the five dragons High Venerable was part of.
He never thought that since this operation was a cinch with the two sides joining up, Heaven Trailing Sect would send such a powerhouse here as well to make sure everything run like clockwork.
Venerable Shi hurriedly bowed, “Forgive me for not being there to welcome you, senior. I did not expect Sect Leader Ren to show so much care in our cooperation to even have senior here…”
“Sect Leader didn’t ask me to come. I came by myself.”
Heaven Trailing Sword cut him off, “Rare are those in the western lands’ nine sect that can catch my eye. While your High Venerable is of a past generation, I still respect him. “
Ugh!
Venerable Shi tensed and his face froze.
[What’s that supposed to mean? Did he come to help the old coot? As long as he lives, the betrayal will be ruined!]
Sweating like a pig, Venerable Shi was filled with worry.
The man mocked him, “No need to fret. Since it’s Sect Leader who leads the attack, the Heaven Trailing Sect will join him as well. I of course won’t disobey him. I only came to see him before he dies.”
He then showed a sad look and asked, “By the way, I heard that Sect Leader came to fight him. Were is he?”
“In the Main Hall’s side room. Go a mile forward and then you’ll find it on your side.” Venerable Shi eased a breath and guided him.
The man nodded and flew away, but not before saying his last piece, “Oh, right, you still haven’t answered my question. What are your thoughts on seeing your fellow people getting butchered?”
“Uhm, well…” Venerable Shi was lost for words.
The man laughed and mocked, “There used to be men in the Demon Scheming Sect, but from now on, there won’t be any more!”
The man was gone.
“Venerable Shi, who was that man? He’s too cocky!” One elder huffed, wanting to deal with him, “He was clearly mocking us. He may be from Heaven Trailing Sect but he’s too arrogant. We’re working together now, but not even Sect Leader Ren disregarded us. Everyone stands to gain from this…”
“Shut your mouth!”
Venerable Shi glared at him and sighed, “Even in the Heaven Trailing Sect, that man is an absolute existence, only beneath Sect Leader. He’s just like our High Venerable, if not more amazing.”
The man couldn’t believe it, “You mean…”
“Yes, he’s Heaven Trailing Sect’s High Venerable, Heaven Trailing Sword Xiao Yunshan!”
Venerable Shi sighed, “Thinking back to when Heaven Trailing Sect was still a lower-three sect, he alone rose the sect to be a middle-three sect in the Double Dragon Gathering, solidifying the sect’s position. That year, only he entered the Double Dragon Manor. He was a monster like Zhuo Fan is today.”
The elder gasped, “I didn’t think Heaven Trailing Sect would send even him. It’s too much. Our forces are more than enough, why…”
“Are you deaf? Didn’t you hear he came by himself?”
Venerable Shi sighed, “Heroes respect heroes. He and High Venerable had been friends back then and now he came to send him off.”
The elder nodded and frowned, “As long as he won’t help him…”
“Relax, Heaven Trailing Sword is most loyal to his sect. Since Heaven Trailing Sect works with us, High Venerable is their enemy. The fact he came only assures of our success.”
Grinning evilly, Venerable Shi said, “High Venerable is dead for sure…”
The others nodded, with only Sect Leader Xuan ignoring them completely, focused as he was on dishing out pain and death. His eyes were crazed, “Kill, ha-ha-ha…”
[Ever since his son died, the old coot lost his marbles, ignoring even Heaven Trailing Sword.]
Venerable Shi pointed and the others sneered at the mad geezer…
Meanwhile, in the room, powerful waves spread out constantly that shook the room. Wiht one more explosion, the barrier was about to give.
Elder Yuan and Ren Xiaoyun fought bitterly, with every punch and kick enough to rend space and destroy everything. Such power made the Impermanence Five’ Vicissitude Domain shake as well and hard to maintain.
Xie Wuyue was panicking at the side because he could see that Sect Leader Ren was slipping. If he did not leave now, he would die at Elder Yuan’s hand.
Elder Yuan actually entered the Soul Harmony Stage and became such a powerhouse. Now that he fused with the earth dragon soul, he was tough as nails. Not even Ren Xiaoyun in the 2nd layer of Soul Harmony Stage could cope.
Xie Wuyue’s heart sank.
The violent flood dragon soul clawed at the Vicissitude Domain to get out, but it was just too strong even for the Sect Leader.
At this time, the worst happened.
Bang~
Elder Yuan flicked a dragon claw and slammed Ren Xiaoyun’s fist away, then used this chance to land three heavy palms on his chest.
Pff!
With a groan, Ren Xiaoyun spat blood and flew backward.
“Sect Leader Ren!”
Xie Wuyue cried out in fear.
[I’m done for. Sect Leader Ren lost! Now High Venerable will come for me…]
As Xie Wuyue lost his grip, Impermanence Five used this chance to send green rays at him to seal him up. Even the flood dragon had to howl at being stuck.
Xie Wuyue jerked and his heart sank in despair.
He would soon die…
Whoosh~
Elder Yuan’s palm struck with all his might for Ren Xiaoyun’s head, to finish him for good.
Ren Xiaoyun was startled and was about to dodge, but he was slow from the previous wound.
He was feeling regret for coming here in person instead of sending a bunch of oldies after this old coot.
Maybe he wanted to see the Hidden Dragon among the five dragons, Demon Scheming Sect’s High Venerable. He was after all the only person respected by Heaven Trailing Sect’s Heaven Trailing Sword.
Now look what happened. This old coot was so tough that he entered Soul Harmony Stage and now was about to kill him.
He brought this on himself.
He finally knew what it meant by curiosity killed the cat.
Not that it helped him now. Seeing the palm coming closer and the death it promised, Ren Xiaoyun’s heart sank, finding hard to swallow this outcome.
Whoosh!
However, they saw as a flashing sword wave came and Elder Yuan’s palm did not get to touch a single hair on Ren Xiaoyun, forced to take it back and jump tne feet away.
He then noticed his dragon scale arms were dripping blood, the armor ruined.
That was just one hit!
Everyone was in shock at the turn of events. Then came a cold face that stood next to Ren Xiaoyun. Those dead eyes, were devoid of joy or sadness, staring at Elder Yuan…

chapters.title: Chapter 785: Demon Without His Path
chapters.content:
Chapter 785: Demon Without His Path
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Yuan Xinggang, it’s been a while.”
“So you came as well, Xiao Yunshan…”
Elder Yuan and Xiao Yunshan stared at each other, like old friends that hadn’t seen each other in ages, but it also felt like a meeting of strangers from how cold the reception was.
Ren Xiaoyun was overjoyed, “High Venerable, you came just in time. This old man is in the Soul Harmony Stage and harder to fight than we thought.”
“Soul Harmony Stage is it?”
Xiao Yunshan rose an eyebrow, “Yuan Xinggang, you surprise me again. With your aptitude, I thought that Ethereal Stage would be the end for you. It’s truly amazing you reached Soul Harmony Stage. You’re a miracle worker.”
