Elder Yuan shook his head, “There’s nothing mirculous about it, just perseverance. All I had was endless focus to reach my goals.”
“Yeah, but even so, you’ve opened my eyes.” Xiao Yunshan nodded.
Elder Yuan shook his head and sighed, “I fear this would be the last time. Have you come to kill me?”
“No, I only heard of the sect plan and knew you would pass away and came to see you one last time.”
Xiao Yunshan looked at the pale Ren Xiaoyun then said, “But by the looks of it, I’ll have to intervene. Yuan Xinggang, we both know each other well. The vow we made in a fit of fury is still fresh in my mind. You should know my determination.”
Elder Yuan nodded, “All that matters is the sect. Since High Venerable decided to take my life, as its High Venerable, you must carry it out. I understand and always have.”
“Then words are unnecessary. Our 102nd fight will also be the last!” Xiao Yunshan made a flourishing gesture as he said, “Let us put a final end to our friendship.”
Elder Yuan squinted and nodded, “I shall show you what I gained these years.”
“Ha-ha-ha, right back at you. You won’t touch a single hair on me. “
“We’ll see!”
Elder Yuan unleashed his power, making earthly scales cover his entire body. He went all out from the start.
Even Ren Xiaoyun found it hard to breathe. He was shocked by the power he had despite being a fresh Soul Harmony cultivator.
[This coot is strong!]
Xiao Yunshan’s eyes shook, “I knew you won’t let me down. Then I should get to it as well and give you a proper parting.”
Xiao Yunshan showed his power as well, releasing bitting winds. He draw out two fingers and the sharpness his body had was enough to cut the world.
Heaven Trailing Sword, the invincible!
None could stand up to that sword. This was his power, as the best of the one sword five dragons.
Elder Yuan’s eyes shook and sighed.
[Heaven Trailing Sword indeed.]
He knew what would come next but his determination was firm. He shouted and charged.
With a draconic roar, immense power exploded and ruining the room.
Xiao Yunshan charged as well, meeting him half way.
Ugh!
The two crossed each other then stopped. There was no boom and no sign anything happened, yet the outcome was already obvious.
But the speed was too fast for any to see.
Elder Yuan fell to one knee as blood seeped from his mouth, but his face was still the same, having known how it would end.
Behind him, Xiao Yunshan stood there on his two feet, with a little blood on his fingers from Elder Yuan…
“Lost in the end.” Elder Yuan’s eyes grew hazy, “You still won, just like every other fight we had…”
Xiao Yunshan remained silent, his face calm.
Ren Xiaoyun was overjoyed High Venerable was so powerful to defeat such a thorn so easily. He really was the Heaven Trailing Sword.
Xie Wuyue was cackling, “Ha-ha-ha, you’re finally done for, old man? Humph, with Heaven Trailing Sect helping me, none can touch me!”
Elder Yuan frowned and his weak body stood straight, his fist clenched.
“Xie Wuyue, even if I die today, I will take you down with me!” Gnashing his teeth, Elder Yuan exploded with power as he shot for Xie Wuyue with a palm.
Xie Wuyue panicked. He was trapped by the Impermanence Five and could not even defend himself.
Ren Xiaoyun shouted, “High Venerable, don’t let him kill Sect Leader Xie or High Venerable will suffer…”
Elder Yuan was about to strike Xie Wuyue but then he spat blood as he slumped to the ground.
Behind him, Xiao Yunshan’s two fingers released a sharp glow with a cold face.
“High Venerable!”
Impermanence Five cried out. Just then, a boom came and the Vicissitude Domain crumbled with the five elders blown away.
Ren Xiaoyun laughed and flicked his fist covered in Yuan Qi as he sneered at them. He turned a smile to Xie Wuyue, “Sect Leader Xie, you’re alright?”
“Thank you, Sect Leader Ren, I am.” Cupping his hands, Xie Wuyue sighed then mocked Elder Yuan, “High Venerable, sorry to disappoint, but you never got to kill me. From now on, Demon Scheming Sect is mine. No matter who it is that tries to fight me, he will die, even you!”
Xie Wuyue raised his hand and a black claw formed and was sent towards the defenseless Impermanence Five.
Pff!
Coughing blood, Impermanence Five lost their lives, leaving only Elder She’s last words, “High Venerable… us brothers will go on ahead…”
Plop~
Their bodies fell to the ground with a resounding sound. High Venerable heard it yet his face remained flat. He forced himself to sit, showing a happy smile, “Xiao Yunshan, after not having seen for so long, allow me to tell you something. I have another disciple, a true genius. The day will come that he would surpass all other geniuses. I am a waste, but I have a true genius disciple. Smart, filial, reasonable and dignified…”
Elder Yuan’s eyes grew moist, feeling he would not see his disciple again. But he did not get to finish as he turned to Xie Wuyue and gnashed his teeth in anger, “Xie Wuyue, you’re only a demon without his path. Demon Scheming Sect will one day be condemned under you!”
“Shut it, geezer, Demon Scheming Sect is now a middle-three sect, under my rule. Zhuo Fan has nothing to do with it. He’s nothing but a pawn of mine. Only I can take Demon Scheming Sect to the top. Why won’t you believe me?”
Xie Wuyue was angry, shaking Elder Yuan’s shoulders and shouting at him.
But Elder Yuan could no longer hear as blood fell from his mouth, his eyes still smiling…
Elder Yuan had passed away.
Looking at Elder Yuan’s body, Xiao Yunshan turned to Xiao Yunshan’s crased look and sighed, “Yuan Xinggang, how sad you left nothing behind- ugh!”
He suddenly clutched his belly and spat blood.
“High Venerable, what’s wrong?” Ren Xiaoyun cried.
Xiao Yunshan waved him off and looked at Elder Yuan with laughter, “Yuan Xinggang, it’s almost been a thousand years and 101 fights, but this time, I had lost to you.”
“I take it back. You’re not useless, but a true genius in the western lands, a genius worthy of entering Double Dragon Manor.” Overcome with sadness, Xiao Yunshan sighed and left.
Ren Xiaoyun saw Xie Wuyue was still lost in his insanity and figured the matter was done, ignoring him and going after High Venerable.
Meanwhile, the slaughter outside went on and on, endlessly…

chapters.title: Chapter 786: Master and Disciple
chapters.content:
Chapter 786: Master and Disciple
Proofreader
: Papatonks
In the middle of the night, a blaze reached the heavens.
Coming out of the Main Hall, Xiao Yunshan observed the hellish scenery around accompanied by an endless strings of wails and cries of agony. His heart sighed with disappointment.
Ren Xiaoyun came from behind to stand next to him. He bowed, “High Venerable, is it possible that you and Demon Scheming Sect’s High Venerable were friends? Why would you care so much that he died? If you really were friends, why…”
“Kill him?”
Ren Xiaoyun finished his thought then frowned, “We’re not friends, but the opposite, bitter rivals.”
“Rivals?”
“Yes, rivals that have been fighting for a thousand years.”
Xiao Yunshan sighed looking at the sky as he recalled those times. “When Heaven Trailing Sect and Demon Scheming Sect sent their disciples to compete, I was the best then and had defeated everyone. Even elites would quiver at the mere whisper of my name. In the arena, most of them would lose before they even struck. While I was filled with vigor and power, the Demon Scheming Sect’s team was like a bunch of rats. But then he came.”
“Demon Scheming Sect’s High Venerable?”
“But he was no Venerable then, not even a normal disciple, just a laborer.”
Xiao Yunshan smiled, “One laborer actually dared to challenge me. Like anyone else in my position, I looked down on him and mocked him. Only to find out at the end how much trouble he was. Not even twenty years passed and he came challenging me again. I asked him what a laborer was trying to do, while he answered that he would definitely revitalize his sect and keep surpassing his limits. I laughed in his face, saying that I was far beyond his limit and he will never reach me. But he was stubborn regardless, fighting me again and again.
“I first found him amusing so I humored him since he was easy to beat. But then I felt threatened. This kid, this laborer of poor constitution, was gaining on me one step at a time. I did not accept it and lashed out, telling him he was useless, that he couldn’t touch a hair on me. In the end, he still came to fight me, I sometimes wanted to kill him. He sensed it as well and urged me in fact. As if by killing him I showed that I was scared of him.”
“Ha-ha-ha, how was he worth it? But what came next proved I was indeed afraid he would overtake me. A laborer actually forced me to get serious about training, a genius like me, to reaffirm my position. Sounds like a really bad joke. But that’s how it was. This is how we became bitter rivals over time.”
Xiao Yunshan gave a sad smile. “Our fights soon evolved to being a comparison of our sects. Who will be the first to take their sect higher? He’s been High Venerable of the Demon Scheming Sect for years and years, but our fights never stopped. I’ve gotten used to them over the years. Now that he’s suddenly gone, I do feel a sense of loss and loneliness. Now there’s no one to match my strength.”
“Oh, I see. I didn’t think Demon Scheming Sect’s High Venerable would have such a story. Truly inspiring!” Ren Xiaoyun nodded.
Xiao Yunshan sighed, “He was amazing, but failed in the end. For wealth and fame, he tore up his sect. Xie Wuyue, with all his skills, is nothing more than a common man that won’t amount to anything.”
“Yes, only with him as Sect Leader can we rest easy, ha-ha-ha…” Ren Xiaoyun laughed.
Xiao Yunshan nodded, “As their adversary, the weaker they are the better. After this, Venerable Shi will have Xie Wuyue’s weakness and will hardly be neutral. Middle-three sect? Ha-ha-ha, it’s way too soon for them. A shame for all the effort Yuan Xinggang put in…”
“Is High Venerable regretful?”
“No!”
Xiao Yunshan shook his head, “I did not want him to die, but for the sect’s good, I had to step in and do what needed to be done. He would’ve done the same. This was a kind of promise between us. He understood this the best.”
Ren Xiaoyun sighed.
[These two High Venerables were men among men, looking at the bigger picture and in impressive manner, becoming rivals.]
It would’ve been a touching story in times of peace, but when the sect’s interests were involved, one of them would end up as a sacrifice. Demon Scheming Sect’s High Venerable did not die, in fact, from Xiao Yunshan, but by Xie Wuyue, his own disciple…
“The old man said something about having another disciple. He spoke with pride about him. Who is he? I’m interested to meet him.”
Xiao Yunshan asked.
Ren Xiaoyun shook his head, bowing, “High Venerable, the disciple he’s talking about must be Zhuo Fan who took Double Dragon Gathering by storm. Only, you might not see him again?”
“Why?”
“I heard Xie Wuyue saying that the Universal Righteous Sect went after him…”
“Fine, you don’t have to say it.”
Xiao Yunshan sighed, “Since men from the superior-three sects came forward, he has no chance. What a shame, I really wanted to see his prized disciple…”
Xiao Yunshan vanished from his spot, leaving Ren Xiaoyun standing there.
Meanwhile, deep in a forest, Gui Hu, Qi Changlong, Yue’er, Kui Lang and other disciples all fell limp on the ground and glaring at the person in front. “Lu Xie, you poisoned us?”
“Yep, how else would your Yuan Qi get sealed? Ha-ha-ha…”
Snickering, Lu Xie mocked them as two inner Ethereal Stage elders came along.
Clenching his fists, Qi Changlong shouted, “Lu Xie, why would you do this?”
“You dare attack us? High Venerable will soon find out and there’s no escape for you!” Bai Lian threatened.
The three laughed, “High Venerable? They can hardly defend themselves and you expect them to save you? Don’t you see the chaos and smoke coming from the mountain? Humph, the Labor Office is finished.”
“What are you talking about?” Gui Hu shouted.
Lu Xie sneered, “You’ll soon be dead anyway so I might as well explain. In fact, my master and I have planned in detail just for today. The tallest tree catches the most wind. Weren’t you showing off with Zhuo Fan? At the Double Dragon Gathering, you’ve been looking good, but that meant you earned many enemies as well. I followed master’s instructions and made contact with all the ones that hated Zhuo Fan, all for today.
“I bet the Universal Righteous Sect must’ve already gone for Zhuo Fan. Heaven Trailing Sect and Mystical Heaven Sect worked with us to destroy the Labor Office, Zhuo Fan’s factions, to avoid any mishap. Such a shame the Beast Taming Sect team at the Double Dragon Gathering was destroyed, or I bet I’d get them on board too. Well, not that it mattered, ha-ha-ha…”
“You went to get other sects involved?” Qi Changlong roared, “Double Dragon Manor will interfere…”
Lu Xie waved his hand in derision, “You think we didn’t know about it? Since you guys came up with an excuse to attack Mystical Heaven Sect, why couldn’t we as well? Humph, Zhuo Fan has only been a Sect Leader for just one day. Who’d recognize that? With Heaven Trailing Sect and Mystical Heaven Sect helping us stem the chaos in Demon Scheming Sect, Xie Wuyue would be back as Sect Leader and that made you with Zhuo Fan as traitors. How’s that for logic? We’re in the right here, ha-ha-ha…”
They all gnashed their teeth in hatred.
They knew as well that Double Dragon Manor would not interfere in a sect’s inner conflict.
“Also, master had set this plan for a long time, suffering in silence. He figured that Zhuo Fan and Xie Wuyue would at some point butt heads, just as expected. Well, isn’t my master much more cunning than Zhuo Fan?”
Lu Xie raised a taunting eyebrow and raised his fist with Yuan Qi, “Qi Changlong, I told you, the best disciple in the sect will be me in the end. With you finished, all problems are solved…”
Bang~
He didn’t get to finish as three rays of red erupted.
Lu Xie shook and looked down at the huge hole in his chest. Looking around, he saw the elders looking the same.
Only then he noticed a familiar figure, “Y-you… Grand Elder… why…”
“Lu Xie, you talk too much, or I’d have struck faster. Ha-ha, still green in the end.” Grand Elder smirked and made a sign. A falcon a hundred meters big came out and struck the two bodies on the ground, ripping their souls apart.
Next, the falcon grabbed the weakened Lu Xie, and he cried, “Wait, aren’t you part of the inner sect? Why…”
“Yes, but…” Grand Elder’s eyes flashed and roared, “I’m Gui Hu’s master first and foremost!”

chapters.title: Chapter 787: Hounded
chapters.content:
Chapter 787: Hounded
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Shriek~
With a sharp cry, the falcon swooped in on Lu Xie. He got so scared he wanted to run right away, but that was impossible with his wounded body. To fight back was an even worse decision with his meager power.
So he resorted to begging, “Wait, Grand Elder, I know Gui Hu is your disciple and never planned on harming him…”
“You take me for a three year old?”
Grand Elder mocked, “Gui Hu has a good body and for you to become the best in the sect, you’ll have to go through him. I know perfectly well how Venerable Shi and the inner sect operates. And besides, you might not harm Gui Hu because of me, but what of Xie Wuyue? Humph, I know his nasty temper the most. He will leave nothing to chance, spare no one. With Gui Hu being part of Labor Office, he won’t be left alive. It’s safer if I just take him away.”
Grand Elder’s eyes flashed, he made a sign and the falcon’s talons took on a sharp glint.
It passed through Lu Xie’s body and came out holding a green spider in its claws.
“Grand Elder, don’t! Please, let me go…” Lu Xie cried out in panic.
He finished his pleading with a mournful cry, the spider torn apart in the falcon’s claws.
Lu Xie’s eyes became empty and he plopped on the ground.
Grand Elder sneered, “Didn’t I tell you? Don’t take me for a three year old. Was I supposed to let you live so you can come back for revenge? Humph…”
Grand Elder hastened over to Gui Hu and showed a vial. He took out recovery pills and shared them with the disciples.
“This is the antidote, take it and you’ll be fine.” Grand Elder spoke calmly. None hesitated and ate it.
In fifteen minutes, they all could move again.
Qi Changlong asked, “Grand Elder, what’s going on? Lu Xie said High Venerable wanted us here for special training but then poisoned us as we heard people dying behind us. Did they really ask outsiders to bring enemies here? What about High Venerable?”
“All he said was true.”
Grand Elder sighed, “Venerable Shi planned ahead, and even brought Heaven Trailing Sect’s expert. I fear not even High Venerable can hold on.”
Qi Changlong frowned and clenched his fists in hatred, “I never thought that Venerable Shi would sell the sect for power. And that Xie Wuyue, he was the previous Sect Leader! He’s so vile to join as well.”
“This is called lust for power. If Xie Wuyue hadn’t joined, Venerable Shi would’ve never do this…” Grand Elder sighed.
Bai Lian muttered, “Grand Elder, aren’t you with them? Since you did this for Gui Hu, why then didn’t you notify High Venerable beforehand?”
“Bai Lian, are you saying master sold out his sect?” Gui Hu glared at her, “Master just saved our lives!”
Bai Lian only stared at Grand Elder, wanting an explanation.
Grand Elder looked hurt, nodding, “Yes, I am an inner sect elder, with Venerable Shi. But we have different goals. Venerable Shi wants power in the sect and I want more resources to train my disciple. In any inner conflicts I stood by his side, but this time he sold out the sect and I could no longer do this.
“However, Venerable Shi was very cautious. When dealing with the two sects to attack us, he not once mentioned anything to any of us in the inner sect. All was done by him and Lu Xie. When we found out, it was already too late. I figured that when Xie Wuyue regained his seat, he will cull all those that stood with Zhuo Fan. Gui Hu might not escape, so I turned on them. You can believe what you want, but all I’ve done is for my disciple.”
“Master!” Gui Hu was touched to tears.
The others nodded, believing him for now. That was because they did not find any other reason why he’d save them.
He only did it to save Gui Hu and that meant saving them as well, his friends. The more people, the more they could correlate and the more the chances of Gui Hu to live.
This meant saving him and saving them.
“Come with me, I’ll sneak you out of the sect. We’re on the same team now. To survive Xie Wuyue’s pursuit, we must work together.”
Grand Elder coughed and his face grew hard.
Qi Changlong flicked his sleeve, his eyes filed with fire, “No, my grandfather and the others…”
“Your own life is at stake and you have time to worry about others?”
Grand Elder cut him off with a yell, “Heaven Trailing Sect and Mystical Heaven Sect have the place surrounded. But your grandfathers aren’t weak either. Maybe they can get out. But if you go back now, they will have to look after you and you’ll drag them down. I think that saving yourselves is the best way for you to help them.”
Qi Changlong’s mouth shook and his shoulders slumped powerlessly. Bai Lian understood his feelings and lowered her head.
The rest bit their lip, feeling hatred at being powerless.
Grand Elder said, “If you got that settled let’s go. Let’s go even if you’re unconvinced. Staying here won’t help anyone.”
Grand Elder took the lead, putting the roaring fire behind him.
Grand Elder was right, all they could do with their meager strength was to bury their hatred deep within. They would cull these traitorous spawns in the future.
Meanwhile, ten miles off Demon Scheming Sect, in a dark corner of a forest, the three fiends panted after their run. Seeing no one was behind them, they stopped to catch their breath.
“Curses, just how in the hell did the sect fall so fast?” Fiend Yang looked at the others in disbelief.
They shook their heads.
Fiend Yang frowned, looking behind him in pain, “After living there for centuries, to see it gone like that… Shit, who did this? The nine sects of western lands? I’m going straight to Double Dragon Manor. This revenge I must have!”
“Fiend Yang, something’s wrong about this.” Fiend Yin said, “Unless there’s an involvement outside of western lands, there’s no way they would not listen to Double Dragon Manor’s rules…”
Fiend Yang shouted, “You mean this was done by someone from other lands?”
“Bullshit!” A shout came followed by a palm attack on his back.
Startled, Fiend Yang struck back, “Enemy attack!”
Bam!
The two palm met and Fiend Yang’s fat body stood in his pot while the attacker was flung back and spat blood.
[Isn’t he weak?]
Startled, Fiend Yang blinked his eyes wide and laughed, “Sending someone so weak after us? They must want us to take revenge and kill them I see.”
“If I wasn’t hurt, a fatty like you wouldn’t have survived my palm!”
The man’s white hair was in disarray, covering his face yet easily recognized through his voice.
The fiends was startled. They cried, “Venerable Bai, why did you ambush me? Did you bring enemies over? Now you want to kill me?”
“Stop playing the victim when you already know who did this!” Venerable Bai roared and gnashed his teeth at them.
The trio was perplexed.
Venerable Bai mocked, “A bunch of fakers all of you. You and him have been pals for so long yet you don’t know his plan? If I had known, I’d killed him when we had the chance and push Steward Zhuo up…”
Venerable Bai was filled with regret.
“Who the hell are you talking about?”
“He’s talking about me, Demon Scheming Sect’s true Sect Leader!” A cold voice came as Xie Wuyue led a dozen Ethereal Stage experts over…

chapters.title: Chapter 788: Break All Ties
chapters.content:
Chapter 788: Break All Ties
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Looking at Venerable Bai’s furious glare with a cold eye, Xie Wuyue mocked, “Ol’ Bai, you sure are something to run so far. Men, slaughter him!”
“Yes!” The guys behind him bowed and cupped their hands.
The fiends hurriedly intervened, “Wait, just what is going on? Wuyue, why are you trying to kill Venerable Bai? The sect is under attack. Shouldn’t we first deal with the enemy and then talk this out?”
“Deal with the enemy?”
Venerable Bai disdained, “Fatty Yang, I thought you were with him, appearing here to stop me. That’s why I attacked. I never thought you’d be so stupid! Ha-ha-ha, what enemy attack? There’re only traitors!”
Fiend Yang shook and looked in shock, “What, traitors?”
Venerable Bai smirked, looking only at Xie Wuyue with disgust.
Xie Wuyue was filled with bloodlust, “Ol’ Bai, I am the true Sect Leader of Demon Scheming Sect. You wanted to take my seat, you are the real traitors.”
“Rotten scum, someone like you who brings an outside sect to kill your sect disciples and hunt down the stragglers is not fit to be a Sect Leader.”
“I only requested Sect Leader Ren and Sect Leader Xuan’s help to pacify the chaos. You forced me to do this.” Xie Wuyue squinted, “Where have I gone wrong? Why must you choose a kid only five years in the sect over me? You even changed the rules for him!”
“Humph, your cruelty knows no bounds. You only know fear and never to be benevolent. The sect has been weak with you at the helm. You’re not worthy of that seat!”
“Demons like you have the gall to talk about kindness? We’re a demonic sect! How am I to get you to fall in line if not by being a bit harsh? What about the sect rules?”
“Hi-hi-hi, Xie Wuyue, this is where you lack. Zhuo Fan is also stubborn, but he does it so everyone accept his decisions. You only know how to bluster and threaten. An aimless demon like you has no future…”
Xie Wuyue’s face twitched and clenched his fists, “What path, what Dao? You’re just like that old geezer. Ha-ha-ha, In the end, I only took another method to take back my seat, pushing Zhuo Fan off it. Ha-ha-ha, in the end, it’s just a way to make me step down and get Zhuo Fan on top. Ha-ha-ha, unfortunately, you’ll never get the change. The final victory is me! Die!”
Xie Wuyue charged at the weakened Venerable Bai, clawing at his chest.
Under the savage attack, Venerable Bai’s beard fluttered, but he glared in hatred at Xie Wuyue with the same mocking smile.
As if to say…
[You were never worth being a Sect Leader.]
Xie Wuyue grew outraged and put more power in his attack, wanting to take his heart.
“Hold on a minute!”
The shout was coming from Fiend Yang, who stood between them.
Ugh!
Startled, Xie Wuyue halted, glaring coldly at him, “Stand down!”
“Wuyue, is this true?”
Fiend Yang did not wait for his response, “Did you bring other sects to kill your fellow people, just to steal a seat?”
“It’s not stealing a seat when it’s mine to begin with… “
Bam!
Xie Wuyue did not finish as a punch sent him ten meters backward, blood leaking from his mouth.
Fiend Yang’s fist shook, but what was more overwhelmed was his heart.
“Is this what you meant by doing everything for the sect, to take it higher?” Fiend Yang roared with a shaky voice.
Wiping his mouth, Xie Wuyue glared, “Since I worked for it, I have to be compensated. It makes no sense that I’d be kicked away after we became a middle-three sect and let some ungrateful bastard take over!”
“Fatty Yang, step down! Or I’ll put you down!”
Xie Wuyue stomped forward with a cold face, the fierce bloodlust coming from him was heavy, “Fatty Yang, you were never my match!”
Fiend Yang raised an eyebrow and faltered, but he steeled himself and shouted, “I am a Demon Scheming Sect Venerable and I won’t stand and watch as my fellow sect member gets killed!”
“Fine, then, step down. This is Sect Leader’s order. I want to take down this traitor!”
“Bullshit, you’re no Sect Leader, not after you brought enemies and killed your fellow sect members!” Fiend Yang shouted as he exploded in power.
Xie Wuyue shook and roared, “Even you betray me?”
Xie Wuyue charged.
Fiend Yang’s heart shook, but he gritted his teeth and made a sign. A yellow fireball appeared and smashed for Xie Wuyue.
“Meteor!”
“Humph, just an earthen soul. It’s truly a fit for a fatty, all empty inside and useless.” Xie Wuyue mocked.
With a draconic roar, a black flood dragon came out from Xie Wuyue. It flicked its tail and struck the fireball.
When the fireball faded and returned to Fiend Yang, he shook and spat blood.
Being hurt so easily it showed the gap between them.
“Die, fatty!”
Xie Wuyue clawed at his chest with all his bloodlust, “Flood Dragon Claw!”
The other two fiends cried out, never imagining Xie Wuyue would be so ruthless as to kill Fiend Yang, his friend for centuries.
But not even they could stop Xie Wuyue. They unleashed their souls to block, but the flood dragon’s tail whipped them away and sending them coughing blood.
Sss~
Its sharp claws came like lightning on Fiend Yang.
Xie Wuyue grinned cruelly.
Fiend Yang sighed and shook his head with closed eyes, “I have been overconfident when I never managed to beat you once. If I knew it would come to this, I would have never saved you. Ol’ Bai was right, seizing your power was better than letting the sect fall like this…”
Ugh!
Xie Wuyue’s claw halted before his chest.
Xie Wuyue remained like this, then took back his attack and simply kicked Fiend Yang.
“Agh!”
With a wail, Fiend Yang was sent a dozen meters away and forced to spit blood, with teeth in it.
“M-my tooth!”
Fiend Yang’s mouth shook and shrieked, “Damn you Xie Wuyue, kill me if you want to but don’t torture me like this! At least on account of me saving you back then…”
“Fatty Yang!”
The shout startled Fiend Yang. He looked up to see Xie Wuyue’s cold face.
Xie Wuyue turned to the other fiends and siad, “And you two, I’ll let you off today, but the next time I see you, all ties are broken. Then I’ll treat you like the traitors you are, sparing none!”
Xie Wuyue flicked his sleeve and ripped it off to prove his decision.
He turned around and led his men away. Only the three of them shook and looked at the sleeve on the ground with a sigh.
From now on, they and Xie Wuyue were no longer brothers…
Venerable Bai took a deep breath and made a heavy bow, “Forgive me, Venerables, I misunderstood you. We’re on the same side.”
The trio shared a bitter smile.
[Yeah, we’re no longer with Xie Wuyue from here on out.]
They took the wounded Venerable Bai and sped away, not wanting any more pursuits. Xie Wuyue said that he would kill them if he met them again.
So the farther they went the better.
At the same time, other survivors were frantically fleeing for their lives from Xie Wuyue’s men…

chapters.title: Chapter 789: Support
chapters.content:
Chapter 789: Support
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Grandfather!”
In the black forest, the fiends were helping Venerable Bai run away under the pale moonlight.
Suddenly, a cry got them all to stop and look to see Bai Lian coming over with others.
Venerable Bai was relieved to see his granddaughter. “Lian’er, thank god you escaped!”
“Ol’ Bai, we just met with these kids. How are you together?” Venerable Qi came out of nowhere and looked at the fiends.
Understanding his wariness, Venerable Bai explained what happened, making him let go of all suspicion and treat the fiends as fellow people in need.
They all talked about what they knew and sighed at the whole story.
“I never knew Venerable Shi was such a schemer after Steward Zhuo. We’re just too careless. Because the inner sect calmed down, we thought they gave up, but they had us in the end!” Venerable Qi growled in anger.
Venerable Bai frowned, “High Venerable and Sect Leader Zhuo might be dead by now. Stragglers like us are barely numbering fifty. Now that we have Xie Wuyue hunting us, where are we to go?”
“In any case, western lands’ territories had already been fixed. No matter where we go, we’ll either be hunted or cast out. We have no choice but to flee western lands and think of another place.”
Grand Elder shook his head, “You think it’s that easy? Thousands upon thousands of miles around us belong to the empire’s three guardian sects! Our only way is to go through Tianyu and then Quanrong. But there’s the Beast Taming Sect there and the empire’s three guardian sects in Tianyu…”
“Tianyu?”
Yue’er lit up and shouted, “Isn’t master’s clan Tianyu’s number one? When we attacked Mystical Heaven Sect, we fought side by side. Now that we’re in danger, they have to help us.”
[Well…]
Grand Elder frowned and hesitated, “Forget it, mortal clans are cold. They might look after us if Sect Leader Zhuo had been around, but with him gone, they would never accept us. Maybe they would sell us out the minute we meet, handing us over to Xie Wuyue.”
“No way. I’ve met their Clan Head and he’s a very upright and loyal man.”
“Ha-ha-ha, girl, you’re too young. How can there be a loyal man in the world? Everyone only looks after themselves. Moreover, Sect Leader Zhuo is a demonic cultivator. WIth his shrewdness, his clan must be devious as well. Why would they get on the empire’s three guardian sects’ bad side just for a bunch of stragglers?”
Grand Elder shook his head, “The way I see it, we’re better off not entrusting our fate to others.”
The others nodded as well. Only Yue’er pouted and grumbled. She had been in dire straits with them and saw Luo Yunhai to be trustworthy.
Venerable Bai’s eyes lit up, “Maybe we should give Tianyu a try.”
“Eh?”
The others turned to him. Venerable Qi frowned, “Tianyu is part of the three sects’ territory. It’s too dangerous with so many ears about.”
“It’s because of that it’s safe.”
Grinning, Venerable Bai was sure of it, “Think about it. Xie Wuyue would never think we’d lay low under his nose, right in Tianyu. He’ll be sending his men anywhere else. So as long as we’re fast enough, we’ll be out of it before they find this out and escape danger.”
Startled, the others gave a thumbs up.
And so, the group planned on using Tianyu’s vast area to leave western lands for a new place to live…
Three months later, in a thick forest, gasps were heard as dozens of men passed through.
In this time, the group had split up to lure their pursuers away, then take the long way around to Tianyu and escape.
“Are we all here?” Venerable Bai shouted.
They all nodded, “Venerable Bai, everyone is accounted for.”
“Then let’s pass through Tianyu and reach Quanrong soon!” Venerable Bai nodded and took the lead.
They had yet to go far before a cackle reached their ears, “A bunch of oldies think they can live after what they did in Mystical Heaven Sect?”
Whoosh~
Figures had the group surrounded as a hundred experts in the Ethereal Stage showed their power.
The group was mixed, and Venerable Bai saw among them people from Heaven Trailing Sect, and a few from Mystical Heaven Sect and Demon Scheming Sect.
[Curses! There’s so many of them! If it were just Mystical Heaven Sect and Demon Scheming Sect, we might’ve fought our way out of this mess, but there’s Heaven Trailing Sect as well!]
There was no way these few men could handle so many experts.
Venerable Bai frowned and gnashed his teeth.
“Ha-ha-ha, Venerable Bai, you’ve been in the Demon Scheming Sect for a while and should know Venerable Shi’s cunning. You think he couldn’t figure out your plan? The safest place is the most dangerous, ha-ha-ha. You sure worked hard to run us around in circles but too bad none of us fell for it!”
An elder in black came out and mocked.
Venerable Bai knew he was an inner elder and was filled with regret. They had been going around all these days only to end up playing in their hands.
Venerable Bai looked at Venerable Qi, who said, “Ol’ Bai, let’s fight to the last!”
“Fight? You can’t do anything as you are!” Grinning, the elder in black sneered, “Ever since you decided on Tianyu, everything else was but a string of mistakes that settled your fate!”
They were outraged but helpless.
This decision had indeed led them to a dead end, from which none could escape.
But then a voice filled with disdain came from the forest, “A mistake? Ha-ha-ha, that’s what you’ve done. Coming to Tianyu was the right choice!”
[What?]
The elder in black shook and looked around, “Who’s there?”
“Their support!”
A couple dozen people, Ethereal Stage experts, with five being above the 5th layer showed up. Yue’er cried in joy, “Elder Li, is it really you?”
Snickering, Li Jingtian laughed, “We came to help you, now attack together!”
“Sure!”
Venerable Bai was excited, never imagining their ally would come to help in this dire time of need. The Luo clan was a godsend!
Venerable Bai’s group unleashed their power and charged while Li Jingtian’s side attacked from the outside.
In a blink of an eye, the hunter became the hunted, thrown into chaos.
The black elder cried out, “Who are you to stop Tianyu’s three guardian sects?”
“Ha-ha-ha, I don’t know much about three sects, just that you’re blocking our guests!” Elder Li laughed and slapped.
The man replied with a palm attack.
Bam!
Li Jingtian was both powerful and ferocious, making the Demon Scheming Sect elder spew blood and fall back.
The others were unsettled at this event.
With the Luo clan’s five experts in the lead, they were charging like a relentless force.
The pursuers of Venerable Bai had no chance whatsoever. They might be a hundred, but the Luo clan and Venerable Bai joining forces only numbered around sixty while having a different level of quality, not lacking in power at all.
No matter how many they were, when morale fell, they would only retreat.
Finally, the pursuers were now caught in the middle, having lost their savagery, forced to scurry around and flee. Even as they did so, they could not understand why they were routed despite having more people.
On a far peak, a man and a woman stood, Luo clan’s shadow corps leader, Lei Yuting and commander of Luo clan’s forces, You Ming.
Seeing the fight was settled, Lei Yuting nodded, “It’s just like you said. The elders were enough to defeat them all.”
“In a meeting of rivals, the ferocious one has the upper hand!”
You Ming’s eyes flashed, “Sometimes, a fight can be as brief as a thought; to fight or not to fight. This is enough to settle it. The elders had struck hard from the start, winning with merely twenty people. All right, our rescue mission is over. Now it’s up to Leng Wuchang’s plan.”
You Ming left and Lei Yuting watched him go with a smile before following. Not far, in a city, Leng Wuchang and Luo Yunhai were enjoying a wee cup of tea…

chapters.title: Chapter 790: The Three Sages Act
chapters.content:
Chapter 790: The Three Sages Act
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Clan Head, you don’t look the least bit nervous.” Sitting refined in the lounge, Leng Wuchang sipped on his tea while giving Luo Yunhai a smile.
Luo Yunhai was unphased, “With Sir Leng so certain in his plan, then all must be assured. How would worry help at this point?”
“Ha-ha-ha, Clan Head, you hold me in such high regard and trust.” Touched, Leng Wuchang smiled.
Over the years, Luo Yunhai had shown complete trust in his aids, making these old coots feel their efforts being rewarded and being loyal in return.
Luo Yunhai did not speak, only smiled…
Later, footsteps were heard as Li Jingtian’s booming voice echoed, “Clan Head, we have brought them!”
“Show them in!” Luo Yunhai stood up and shouted in joy. Leng Wuchang smiled and stood as well.
The door was opened and Li Jingtian led Venerable Bai’s group to sit in the lounge. Seeing Luo Yunhai, they all showed their thanks, “Thank you, Luo Clan Head for the timely rescue!”
“Please don’t mind it, take a seat.”
Luo Yunhai glossed over, “The Luo clan had been brought up by brother Zhuo alone. As you are his trusted aides, then we are all on the same side. Finding out that you’re in peril, it’s only my duty to come help! We have fought shoulder to shoulder after all, ha-ha-ha…”
Luo Yunhai’s bright laughter entered their ears and made them lower their heads. They were still doubtful the Luo clan was to be trusted yet the Clan Head himself proved that loyalty hadn’t yet died in the world. Just because of their connection with Zhuo Fan, the Clan Head risked his men to save them.
This action of the Luo clan had painted a target on them, becoming an enemy of the three sects.
They all felt ashamed, with Venerable Bai taking a step forward and making a deep bow, “Luo Clan Head, we’ve dragged you into this. You could’ve stayed outside of the three sects’ troubles but now…”
“Elder Bai, it’s fine. Since someone wants to take out brother Zhuo, we, the Luo clan, are already involved!”
Luo Yunhai’s eyes flashed, his face hard, “When I became Clan Head, I vowed that brother Zhuo’s enemies are Luo clan’s enemies. No matter who it is, or how many, the Luo clan will have brother Zhuo’s back all the way!”
Shaking, they all were impressed by Luo Yunhai’s valor.
Just what kind of friendship could he have to give everything for one man, even his whole clan?
[No wonder Steward Zhuo wanted to give up being Sect Leader. This man was worth following.]
Venerable Bai and the others admired him. Not even in their long years in the Demon Scheming Sect had they seen such a worthy man to follow.
The Demon Scheming Sect only cared about self-interest, while the Luo clan was a united group.
Now they understood why Zhuo Fan was so eager to get back…
Boom~
Explosions came followed by the world shaking around them, with the lounge about to collapse.
The men panicked and Luo Yunhai frowned. He turned to Leng Wuchang with a questioning look.
Leng Wuchang smiled, “Ha-ha-ha, easy now. They’re but the pursuers attacking the defensive array.”
“Pursuers? Those hundred Ethereal Stage experts?” Startled, Venerable Qi cried, “That’s bad! An average array can’t hold back so many Ethereal Stage experts!”
The others grew tense and were ready to fight at any moment.
Leng Wuchang and Luo Yunhai shared a look and laughed, “It’s fine. I already surmised you’d want to escape western lands through Tianyu. That’s why three months earlier I had men set up 18 arrays all above 7th grade. Also, they all use sacred stones. And since the elders are overlooking it, those hundred thugs can’t put a dent in it.”
[Thugs? Them?]
Shocked, they all were flabbergasted.
[Who’s he to call a hundred Ethereal Stage experts thugs? Isn’t he too cocky? He’s only in the Radiant Stage too. Maybe he’s like High Venerable, hiding his power behind lower cultivation?]
They then looked behind to see Li Jingtian gone.
“Uhm, sir, may I ask…” Venerable Bai bowed.
Leng Wuchang cupped his hands, “I am Leng Wuchang of Tianyu.”
“What? You’re Unwonted Contriver, one of the three sages?” Venerable Bai and the others were stunned, “Sir’s reputation precedes you.”
Leng Wuchang waved his hand, “Please, as a cultivator, I am nothing to you. But as a supervisor, with enough pawns in my hand, I can beat any one of you.”
“Indeed, sir’s genius has long since been known. I never imagined you’d stay in the Luo clan. We’re shocked.” Venerable Bai and the others nodded.
They knew that while Leng Wuchang wasn’t much in terms of cultivation, but as a supervisor of the clan, he had countless people he could direct and multiply their effective power.
In the cultivating world, especially in the western lands, there were hardly many large scale conflicts where his advantage could be used. But now, since they were hunted by three sects, they needed a sharp mind like Leng Wuchang more than anything.
Understanding their intent, Leng Wuchang smiled, “From the report You Ming sent, these people fled at the first sign of battle. No one can focus their power and thus shows they are headless. They look to be made up of Ethereal Stage experts but as a whole they’re nothing but thugs.”
“The best way to deal with them is in three clashes. First is an all out attack, second will be their crushed spirits and third comes their feebleness. Afterward, they would scurry away. That’s why you need not worry. They’ll soon be running back home.”
“Uhm, Sir Leng, the You Ming you’re talking about, is he perhaps Insidious Demon You Guiqi’s disciple?”
Leng Wuchang nodded, “You heard of him too?”
“You Guiqi wanted to join the Demon Scheming Sect to get Hell Valley an ally, but his aptitude was poor and he was disregarded. But then he became one of Tianyu’s three sages, earning his name. To gain fame with a shrewd mind is much harder. I never thought his disciple would be with the Luo clan. No wonder the Luo clan evolved so much with two sages.”
Venerable Bai admired and the others echoed him.
Leng Wuchang and Luo Yunhai shared a smile.
Fifteen minutes later, the booming stopped and You Ming came in with the elders.
Leng Wuchang asked, “Is it over? Didn’t I have you strike them as they fell back to push them further?”
“No point.” You Ming shrugged, “You wanted to exhaust them completely and buy time when calling for help for Zhuge, but I have convinced them to leave. They won’t be back for a while. It all worked out the same.”
“Leng Wuchang smiled, “Convinced?””
“Yes. Their group consisted of sixty-five from Heaven Trailing Sect, twenty-six from Demon Scheming Sect and eleven from Mystical Heaven Sect. We held complete advantage over the fight and could finish them off without a problem, but that would ruin your plan, right? Ha-ha-ha… “
You Ming sat down, “So I took it upon myself to kill the twenty-six from Demon Scheming Sect, heavily wound the eleven from Mystical Heaven Sect and as for Heaven Trailing Sect’s… I told them I received news that we and Heaven Trailing Sect had made peace. I had them go back to their Sect Leader and ask him themselves.”
Leng Wuchang raised an eyebrow, “News? Why haven’t I heard of it?”
“It should come at some point, or you wouldn’t have let me fight with Heaven Trailing Sect’s safety in mind.”
“You trust him that much?”
“As the previous Prime Minister of the empire, foreign affairs were his strongest suit.” Grinning, You Ming ignored the extra people around and dangled one leg over the other after taking his teacup.
Leng Wuchang laughed, “True, the old guy has that for him.”
“Uhm, Sir Leng, who are you talking about?” Luo Yunhai was confused.
Leng Wuchang’s eyes flashed as he bowed, “Clan Head, that old guy Zhuge Changfeng had sent a message two months ago, saying that he’ll return from visiting other nations.”
“Steward Zhuge is coming back?” Luo Yunhai cried.
Leng Wuchang smiled, “I have informed him of our situation and of my plan and proposed that he not return yet, but make a trip to Heaven Trailing Sect.”
“Heaven Trailing Sect?” The rest went bug eyed.
Venerable Bai was shocked. Leng Wuchang smiled, “Yes, that sect. In fact, the Luo clan has a third sage as well. With his silver tongue, your life should be guaranteed.”
Venerable Bai blinked in disbelief.
“I mean that with all three sages from Tianyu acting up, we’ll turn your situation around and get the pursuit off you. Or if we had let Clan Head go ahead with the whole clan and be ruled by emotions, we’d never have agreed to save you so easily. “
Leng Wuchang shook his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 791: Distant Allies, Close Enemies
chapters.content:
Chapter 791: Distant Allies, Close Enemies
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Tap, tap!
In a dusky hall, two rows of faint candlelights burned gently. The only sound was the rhythmic steps of a single person.
Sitting on the guest chair, an aged man was sipping on his tea as the footsteps came. He placed the cup down on the table and waited.
“The grand steward of the best clan in Tianyu, Zhuge Changfeng, ha-ha-ha…”
Following the bright laughter, a sturdy middle-aged man came out from the shadows and into the light, taking the seat of honor, Heaven Trailing Sect’s Sect Leader Ren Xiaoyun.
“Yesterday Tianyu Empire’s Prime Minister, and now Luo clan’s first steward. The title might have changed but the power is no less than that of a prime minister. Zhuge Changfeng, what are you doing here instead of minding Tianyu’s affairs?”
Zhuge Changfeng stood up and made a light bow, “Sect Leader Ren, Heaven Trailing Sect is the head of the Tinayu’s three guardian sects and I am ashamed to say that in all my decades as Prime Minister and now steward of Luo clan, I have failed in paying my respects to your glorious sect.”
“Secular clans and sects hardly ever meet. No apology needed.”
Ren Xiaoyun waved his hand, “I wonder what brought on this visit from miles away?”
Zhuge Changfeng smiled and bowed again, “I shall be frank, Sect Leader, I have come with a defined purpose in mind. I am before Sect Leader with a request.”
“What is it?” Ren Xiaoyun raised an eyebrow.
Zhuge Changfeng’s eyes flashed, “I hope that Sect Leader Ren may be willing to go easy on the Demon Scheming Sect traitors.”
“Oh?”
Ren Xiaoyun stared hard into Zhuge Changfeng’s tranquil gaze, then mocked, “You’re from Tianyu but nonetheless informed. You heard of western lands’ nine sects’ affairs quite fast. But why do you want to save them? Is it for your previous steward, Zhuo Fan?”
Ren Xiaoyun’s tone dropped and became chilling.
One word out of line and Zhuge Changfeng would find himself gone from this world.
Zhuge Changfeng smiled still and nodded, “In a way, but not fully.”
“How so?”
“Of course there’s the respect and gratitude towards Steward Zhuo’s former efforts. Even if strays, they were once under Steward Zhuo’s wing and we have to lend a hand, lest we’d be taken as ingrates. Sir must know by now of our young Clan Head’s personality, holding loyalty above all else. By not doing this now, it will harm his name. “
Squinting, Ren Xiaoyun sneered, “So what you’re telling me is that the Luo clan is helping the traitors for their reputation?”
Ren Xiaoyun’s hand flicked and bloodthirst flickered in his eyes.
“Not entirely, since there’s still respect for the previous Steward Zhuo, even if not enough to warrant the destruction of the clan. That’s why it’s most out of reputation. The world is filled with people striving for fame, and our Clan Head is no exception.”
Zhuge Changfeng chuckled and sighed, “Over the years, Tianyu has flourished and, in turn, filled the three sects’ coffers, with the tribute growing yearly. Sect Leader Ren is sure to know this. Why? All because of the Luo Alliance, drawing in dozens of clans, big and small, from the nearby nations and empires. But why could the Luo Alliance attract so many people? It is without a doubt our Clan Head’s righteous and loyal nature that set their minds at ease. This is a reputation we have to protect and, most of all, make excessive use of it.”
Ren Xiaoyun’s eyes shook and his hand stopped to ponder.
Zhuge Changfeng grinned inside.
He knew very well that the wrong word would have his blood paint these walls. Ren Xiaoyun was only testing him to check just how far the Luo clan would go for Zhuo Fan alone, just how much were the two tied up.
If the Luo clan still cared for Zhuo Fan, or if they were outraged over Zhuo Fan’s actions, Ren Xiaoyun would’ve killed Zhuge Changfeng then and there, following with the Luo clan.
He had no intention of fostering a group of enemies.
However, Zhuge Changfeng’s answer was smooth, avoiding all pitfalls. If he had said there was no loyalty for Zhuo Fan left, then it would have been an outright lie.
Zhuo Fan had been the Luo clan’s previous steward that made the Luo clan what it was today. Yet the clan would just ignore all that?
Ren Xiaoyun would’ve slapped him in the hereafter where he stood.
Zhuge Changfeng was shrewder than most, saying there was some loyalty left, but not the main cause for the clan’s decision.
[We’re not disregarding Zhuo Fan’s gratitude, just thinking of profits. Furthermore, we’re using that bit of loyalty to earn even more by making use of our reputation.]
This was enough to get Ren Xiaoyun to relax. Since they held interests above their past relations, he put them getting revenge for Zhuo Fan at the back of his mind. They had nothing to gain by fighting Heaven Trailing Sect anyway.
As a man with an eye for profit himself, there was no way they would risk it all just for Zhuo Fan’s hatred to be sated. That was what made this line so believable, it appealed to his own principles.
While a Luo clan without an ounce of gratitude would’ve been worse, totally unreliable. He only wanted to see what the Luo clan cared about, happy to know now that it was proft.
Zhuge Changfeng was also sharp in pointing out Tianyu was doing so much better now.
[You guardian sects get almost double every year, all because of the Luo clan. Without us, you’d end up starving.]
This struck where it hurt the most and made him withdraw his impulse of slapping the Luo clan’s envoy dead.
“So, your request to let the traitors go was all about keeping your loyal reputation?” Ren Xiaoyun probed after a pause, “I have promised Sect Leader Xie to cull any traitors…”
Zhuge Changfeng shook his head, “Sect Leader Ren, I would’ve never taken the risk if it was just merely out of reputation. We want to take them because we will fight the Demon Scheming Sect!”
“What?” Ren Xiaoyun’s eyes bugged out, his hand tightened with bloodthirst, “A secular clan wants to fight a sect? What a joke!”
Ren Xiaoyun was enraged.
His heart was once again beating frantically. Heaven Trailing Sect was in cahoots with the Demon Scheming Sect right now. Fighting them was fighting Heaven Trailing Sect, no?
[The Luo clan still cares about getting revenge for Zhuo Fan!]
Zhuge Changfeng read him like a book, sighing dramatically, “Sect Leader Ren, that’s not my meaning at all. We of course would want to live at peace with the three sects for thousands of years to come. But that doesn’t mean the Demon Scheming Sect wants to. I heard that the Demon Scheming Sect’s Sect Leader Xie Wuyue has a nasty temper and is ruthless. He can kill Zhuo Fan all he wants, not like we can do anything. What I fear though, is that he’ll drag innocent people into this. Because Zhuo Fan came from the Luo clan, he’ll cull us all. We thus have no choice but gather anyone that can help and fight to the death.
“As sir knows, the enemy of my enemy is my friend. The Demon Scheming Sect traitors don’t hate you and Mystical Heaven Sect the most, since they already attacked Mystical Heaven Sect before. The two sects coming to attack was natural. They hate Xie Wuyue with a passion. So we must work together and resist the Demon Scheming Sect!”
“Oh, so that’s how it is.”
Ren Xiaoyun eased a breath.
[Luo clan is using its power to defend itself, not target Demon Scheming Sect specifically and our alliance.]
This made him relax.
He did not noticed that Zhuge Changfeng’s wording made it so Venerable Bai’s group hated only Xie Wuyue, keeping Heaven Trailing Sect out of it.
This was how Ren Xiaoyun decided to let them be.
When he joined Xie Wuyue in culling everyone, he feared retaliation. And since he had nothing against them to begin with, why push things so far?
[Besides, these men might become a weapon to keep Demon Scheming Sect in check.]
Ren Xiaoyun thus made his decision, but he decided to play along for now, frowning, “In the end, letting them go is up to the Demon Scheming Sect. Heaven Trailing Sect can do it, but I can’t say the same about Demon Scheming Sect.”
“Ha-ha-ha, Sect Leader Ren, who doesn’t know that Heaven Trailing Sect is the leader in the empire’s three guardian sects. Would the other two sect go against your word?”
Zhuge Changfeng praised, “I’ll be frank here, Demon Scheming Sect and Mystical Heaven Sect are nothing more than dying dogs. Can they still be part of the guardian sects? Especially Demon Scheming Sect, after that calamity, how many experts does it have? How can it protect Tianyu? Our Clan Head decided to cut ten percent out of their tribute and give it to Heaven Trailing Sect.”
Shaken up, Ren Xiaoyun’s heart burst with joy, but he didn’t let it show, “How can we? They have been through so much pain and doing this…”
“Sect Leader Ren, no need to be polite. Those capable always earn more. With the Demon Scheming Sect’s miserable state, it’s not worth twenty percent of Tianyu’s resources. Tianyu’s safety would in the end depend on Heaven Trailing Sect.” Zhuge Changfeng cupped his hands as he finished his speech.
Ren Xiaoyun frowned in fake anger, “Are you trying to turn the three sects on each other? Demon Scheming Sect is about to become a middle-three sect…”
“Sect Leader Ren!”
Zhuge Changfeng cut him off with sneer, “After such an event, regardless of power and fame, would it still be fit to be a middle-three sect?”
Ren Xiaoyun jerked awake and then laughed before slapping his shoulder.
“Ha-ha-ha…”

chapters.title: Chapter 792: Revenge
chapters.content:
Chapter 792: Revenge
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“That settles it, Sect Leader Ren. Will sir want to look at this year’s shares?”
Zhuge Changfeng made a bow and gave a smile that was easy to understand.
Ren Xiaoyun nodded, “The flourishing of Tianyu depends on your Luo clan. Don’t worry, as the empire’s three guardian sects, no one will dare to stir chaos in Tianyu, not even from the three sects.”
“Ha-ha-ha, thank you, Sect Leader Ren!” With another deep bow, Zhuge Changfeng withdrew from the hall.
Seeing him go, Ren Xiaoyun nodded, feeling pleased with himself. From now on, the Demon Scheming Sect would cease to be a threat to him while Tianyu’s representative was now under Heaven Trailing Sect.
Tianyu’s resources, even trades, all would be in Heaven Trailing Sect’s pocket.
[The other two sects? Humph, they dare think about my money when they’re hanging by a thread?]
In all honesty, after all this chaos Zhuo Fan stirred up, the Mystical Heaven Sect ended up ruined while the Demon Scheming Sect crippled. Only Heaven Trailing Sect was the big winner here, taking all of Tianyu’s income for himself.
[I’ve won big time in this, ha-ha-ha…]
Ren Xiaoyun was giddy on the inside, then shouted, “Guard!”
“Yes, sir!”
A man in black up and appeared in a bow.
Ren Xiaoyun spoke, “Use a sending jade to tell the pursuers of the Demon Scheming Sect remnants to come back. Also, use my name to warn the Demon Scheming Sect and Mystical Heaven Sect that they are forbidden from interfering inside Tianyu and disturbing it.”
“Yes, sir!” The man bowed again but paused.
Ren Xiaoyun frowned, “Why are you still standing there?”
“Sect Leader, you’ve been talking with that man so far and I have yet to notify you. Actually, the pursuers of the Demon Scheming Sect remnants have already returned.”
“What? Who told them to come back so soon? I didn’t even get to send them a message!” Ren Xiaoyun raised an eyebrow.
The man hesitated, “Sect Leader, from the elder’s recounting, they pursued the remnants at Tianyu’s border when they met Luo clan’s experts blocking them. They trapped the elder’s team but then let them go, telling me to tell sir that they have reached an agreement with Sect Leader. They were unclear and had not received sir’s message, but since they were let go, they came to confirm this. Uhm, Sect Leader…”
Stumped for a long time, Ren Xiaoyun came to and muttered, “They said they had a deal with me? Even if that’s true, it just took effect moments ago…”
Ren Xiaoyun turned to where Zhuge Changfeng was gone and sighed, “They truly believed a mere old man’s ramblings could persuade me. Truly cunning… the Luo clan has talents and it keeps growing…”
“Sect Leader!”
The man asked, “Do I send the message?”
Ren Xiaoyun gnashed his teeth, “I hate how a secular clan toyed with me, but I have to admit, Zhuge Changfeng’s words moved me.”
“Send it! Let the two sects know Tianyu’s head of power, Luo clan, is Heaven Trailing Sect’s representative. It has no ties with the Demon Scheming Sect.”
“Yes, sir!”
The man nodded and vanished, leaving Ren Xiaoyun with his muttering, “Zhuge Changfeng, the three sages, humph, I’ve now come to see what you are…”
A month later, Zhuge Changfeng was back in the Luo clan’s home, Windgaze City. Everyone gathered in the hall, waiting for his news.
Venerable Bai’s group was the most tense, wanting to rush through Tianyu still and enter Quanrong to escape pursuit. Luo Yunhai had to advise him many times to wait.
Now that Steward Zhuge was back, they all gathered around eager to know the answer.
Zhuge Changfeng calmly looked at them and smiled, milking the tense moment for all it was worth.
The only ones calm were Leng Wuchang and You Ming, sipping tea at leisure.
“Steward Zhuge, how is it?” Luo Yunhai could not hold it in.
Smirking, Zhuge Changfeng was about to speak, but Leng Wuchang put one leg over the other as he began, “Clan Head, just look at his obnoxious grin. Of course he did it.”
“Hey, Old Leng, I risked my life in mediating the problem while you just relaxed in your comfy chair.” Zhuge Changfeng glared.
Leng Wuchang stuck his chin out, “And? I’ve been making plans here.”
“Shitty plans more like it. You think I or You Ming can’t do the same?” Zhuge Changfeng mocked, “Try having a chat with that stone-cold Ren Xiaoyun. See how you’d fair then.”
“This time I have to agree with Steward Zhuge. He is much better at us in being a mediator. I am best at strategizing while you are at shooting your mouth.”
You Ming grinned.
Leng Wuchang’s face twitched, “Hey, are you two ganging up on me now? My tactics aren’t for show. Old Zhuge, did you divide Tianyu’s resources again? Cutting ten percent from the Demon Scheming Sect and adding to Heaven Trailing Sect? He-he, I’m not an Unwonted Contriver for nothing.”
“Since when was it your plan?”
Zhuge Changfeng mocked, “Since the Demon Scheming Sect wants to fight us, there’s no point in holding back at all. And we needed a new cover too. Giving ten percent to Heaven Trailing Sect will make the two sects look cross, but Demon Scheming Sect’s hatred will turn on Heaven Trailing Sect. While Mystical Heaven Sect’s unchanged income would make it look from the side at their scuffle. This way, it won’t mind us as well. Adding Heaven Trailing Sect’s cover to that, the matter is settled.”
“Really, Steward Zhuge, is it really over?” Luo Yunhai cheered.
Zhuge Changfeng nodded, “Of course, Clan Head can rest easy. It wasn’t much anyway, far more relaxed than Tianyu’s previous tangled mess. First of all, the three sects aren’t being difficult, especially Heaven Trailing Sect. It sent troops to help the Demon Scheming Sect but it was only to control their growth. With it becoming a middle-three sect, it posed a threat to Heaven Trailing Sect. It was not for some meager five thousand sacred stones, but to make sure that never happened, even going against Double Dragon Manor’s rules openly.
“Since he has a goal, then that made it easier. Now that we’re on his side, suppressing the Demon Scheming Sect together would sure to put a wide smile on his face.”
“And to avoid the Demon Scheming Sect from being up against the wall, we only took just ten percent, making it turn on Heaven Trailing Sect as well, and not us. Otherwise, if we had cut every supply with it, it would be against western lands’ rules and force it to invade Tianyu. At least with some income from us, they’d think twice about ruining Tianyu. This makes us appear more neutral.” Leng Wuchang explained.
Zhuge Changfeng mocked, “Easier said than done. Implementing it has a lot of dangers. Sir Leng, if it had been you who went, you’d have been obliterated.”
“Hey…” Leng Wuchang shouted.
Luo Yunhai smiled as he eased up the tension.
While none of these intellectuals boasted they were the best, neither was about to back down, always butting heads when they met.
Venerable Bai’s side was stumped.
They had been hounded by three sects yet the matter had been solved just like that.
This was the power of the three sages.
Looking at them bickering, with Luo Yunhai mediating, Venerable Bai was gratified.
They had little in terms of cultivation, but they had their own skills no one could surpass…
“Alright now, we should get ready to avenge brother Zhuo.”
The bickering stopped and Luo Yunhai turned serious, his eyes red.
The others were pensive as well.
“According to our scouts, Steward Zhuo had been under attack, resulting in an inferno for a thousand miles and a barren wasteland for many more.” Leng Wuchang grumbled, “Just what has the Universal Righteous Sect done?”
Zhuge Changfeng muttered, “For revenge, we must first gather our strength. Our enemies are four sects, with one being a superior-three sect.”
“You still want revenge?” Venerable Bai looked at them in disbelief. “The enemy is stronger than you can imagine, a sect for thousands of years…”
Luo Yunhai shouted, “No matter who it is, this vengeance shall be paid in full! The Luo clan rose under brother Zhuo’s protection. We all owe him our lives. This is something we must do!”
Luo Yunhai’s bold words echoed in everyone’s ears.
Venerable Bai shouted, “Then… count us in as well…”

chapters.title: Chapter 793: Price
chapters.content:
Chapter 793: Price
Proofreader
: Papatonks
In the silent and cold hall, the glorious and dazzling throne struck a lonely figure. Xie Wuyue sat there, running his hands over its cold texture with a pleased grin.
[This seat is finally mine again.]
“Sect Leader!”
An aged voice came from behind, “It’s been months since we last heard of anything from the men we sent to pursue those traitors in Tianyu. I fear…”
Xie Wuyue’s brow shook. “Tianyu? Humph, I almost forgot that Zhuo Fan came from there. Those ignorant fools must’ve sided with the traitors. How else could those weak fools escape from my palm? Venerable Shi, contact Heaven Trailing Sect and Mystical Heaven Sect to send more men. It’s time we change our representative in Tianyu.”
“Yes, sir!”
Venerable Shi nodded and was about to withdraw when a disciple rushed inside. He presented a jade, “Sect Leader, Double Dragon Manor sent word!”
“Double Dragon Manor?”
Xie Wuyue mocked, “Just what has that Universal Righteous Sect done? They even let those girls escape and report to Double Dragon Manor. Not that it matters, humph. Double Dragon Manor’s elders are coming to investigate. We’ll just stick to our story, making them the traitors. I have been Sect Leader for centuries, it’s the least my status can do. The only one who could speak up, High Venerable had been silenced forever. They can look into us all they want, it’ll still be as I say it. This has been an internal fight, resulting in the death of High Venerable. They won’t meddle in that, ha-ha-ha…”
Venerable Shi nodded, “Sect Leader is brilliant!”
“Yes!”
Xie Wuyue nodded, looking smug. Then he read the jade and burst out laughing, “It’s just like I thought. Double Dragon Manor warns us not to go too far. What worry can I have when they won’t do anything?”
Pa!
The jade slip was thrown to the ground like trash and Xie Wuyue mocked.
Venerable Shi smiled, “Sect Leader, Double Dragon Manor has been respected by the nine sects because of their strength, but also fairness, not involving itself in a sect’s matter. This is also what ties its hands. As long as we paint it as having traitors, they can’t do anything. Or who would’ve respected them, turning the entire western lands into chaos. This is something they want to avoid at all costs.”
“You’re right, Venerable Shi. The plan has been thought out, ha-ha-ha…” Xie Wuyue waved his hand, “Get it done. Make sure you get those dregs tied to Zhuo Fan…”
“Report!”
Another shout came followed by another disciple. He held a jade slip as he bowed.
Xie Wuyue was dubious as to who would send one now.
But after reading it, his rage blew. He smashed the jade to the ground and cursed, “Damn that Sangha Empire! Only months before they begged Demon Scheming Sect’s men to come and now they go back on their words, refusing us…”
“Is it the great empire of the previous superior-three sect Universal Righteous Sect?”
“Those rotten bastards!” Xie Wuyue cursed, “I never thought a great empire would actually resort to being so shameless.”
Venerable Shi scratched his nose and shook his head.
Report~
Then came a long string of shouts as disciples came in one after the other before Xie Wuyue.
Xie Wuyue had a sinking feeling, but took them one at a time. Yet after each one, his anger only spiked higher before smashing them to pieces.
“This is absurd! What’s going on with all of these empires? We’ve talked and agreed on something, to be under our protection, now they’re all backing out? Even those middle-three sects empires I ignored when the superior-three sects empires were fighting over us now dislike us. Just what the hell is going on here?”
“Sect Leader!”
Venerable Shi was quite calm, “Maybe they think that without Zhuo Fan, there’s no growth.”
Xie Wuyue glared at him, “What did you say? They did it for Zhuo Fan? No way! Demon Scheming Sect’s Sect Leader is me, Xie Wuyue!”
“Sect Leader, stop lying to yourself.”
Venerable Shi shook his head. “Zhuo Fan showed off in the Double Dragon Gathering, destined to be the best in western lands. Those empires were fighting to be under his wing, not under a lower-three sect meant to grow into a middle-three sect. Without Zhuo Fan, our value dropped sharply, making them back down.”
“Shut your mouth!”
Xie Wuyue spat, “You dare say that? Don’t forget the sect has reached middle-three sect status under my rule!”
Venerable Shi nodded, “Yes, Sect Leader had done great things, but your greatest achievement was bringing Zhuo Fan.”
Xie Wuyue’s face twitched, about to spit blood.
“Sect Leader, I’m not here to criticize you, but as a Sect Leader you need to understand your limits.”
Venerable Shi laughed, “To be fair, I must agree on Zhuo Fan replacing you. High Venerable had made the right choice. You became a Sect Leader to begin with because there was no one else better. Now that one appeared, a change was in order. As to why I have been always against Zhuo Fan, wanting to kill him, that’s because he’s my enemy. But regarding competence, I admire him wholly.”
“Venerable Shi!”
“Also!”
Venerable Shi snickered as Xie Wuyue shouted, “Sect Leader, your temper better change. As you know, the entire sect is now made up of us, old guys. I helped you get your seat, now just sit on it and not stir things up like before. When you want something that’s not yours to begin with, there’s always a price to pay, ha-ha-ha…”
Xie Wuyue was livid from anger, glaring as Venerable Shi just walked away. He then slumped in his lone and cold throne.
He got his seat, but that was it…
“Report!”
Yet another disciple rushed in and Venerable Shi blocked him. “Let me take those jade slips. Sect Leader needn’t bother.”
“Uhm, yes!” The disciple nodded and Xie Wuyue shook in rage and powerlessness.
Reading it, Venerable Shi pondered before saying, “Sect Leader, Sect Leader Ren is telling us not to make a scene in Tianyu and upset the peace between the three sects. And that from now on, Tianyu’s tribute to us is ten percent lower.”
[What?]
Xie Wuyue jumped to his feet. Venerable Shi sighed, flicking the jade slip backward as he walked away, “It seems Tianyu has some smart people to string Heaven Trailing Sect along…”
Meanwhile, in Blackwind Mountain…
As a show of good faith, Luo Yunhai took Venerable Bai’s group to where war puppets were made, in the bunker. But war puppets were no longer here, replaced now by a sparkling mountain of crystals.
“Scared stones?!”
Fiend Yang cried out, “H-how did you get so many?”
Luo Yunhai looked at him perplexed, “This is a lot? After attacking Mystical Heaven Sect, brother Zhuo saw our heavy losses and gave us a million of these rocks, saying they had way more spiritual energy than common spirit stones. They should help us raise many experts in a short time and recoup our losses. I was not sure what he meant then, though they sure have some good uses.”
“We’ve just put them all here in bunker for a couple of days and already had a good few Radiant Stage elders enter Ethereal Stage. Using them for arrays, they also boost their power quite a bit.”
“A… million…”
Face twitching, Fiend Yang grabbed Luo Yunhai’s hands, touched to tears, “Luo Clan Head, we’ll follow you. I bet only Double Dragon Manor would have so many sacred stones in western lands. No superior-three sect could come close. With these resources, our power will rise higher and higher. Damn that Zhuo Fan! He lied to us, whining on his poverty, that cheapskate, when he could take out so many. If I knew, what was the point of going to Double Dragon Gathering anyway?”
The others nodded, then they crowded around Luo Yunhai, proclaiming their lifelong allegiance to the Luo clan. Luo Yunhai nodded in reflex, still shocked.
[Are these baubles that enticing?]
Seeing them so lively, two figures left the bunker in silence.
They looked at the setting sun in sadness. Shuang’er noticed her grief and said, “Don’t worry, sister Yunchang, with so many sacred stones, brother Zhuo will be avenged.”
“What’s the point? It won’t bring him back…”
Tearing up, Luo Yunchang’s empty eyes reflected the fading twilight…
In the Double Dragon Manor, Chu Qingcheng and the two girls watched the same sun, their eyes filled with unwillingness.
Footsteps were heard as Wu Qingqiu came from behind, “Miss Chu, are you dissatisfied with Double Dragon Manor’s method? Who here isn’t? Brother Zhuo’s death is unjust, but we must also take into account Double Dragon Manor’s stance. It involves four sects. Then there’s grave news from eastern lands and their unrest. The Exalted have no choice but to settle western lands first.”
Clenching her teeth, Chu Qingcheng said nothing, her eyes hazy from tears of hatred…

chapters.title: Chapter 794: Infernal Valley
chapters.content:
Chapter 794: Infernal Valley
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Sss~
In a pitch-black space, a golden flame raged. It grew and grew, taking the shape of a mile long dragon, shedding some light to this dark place.
Roar!
A draconic roar came from the golden fire and it looked below at the tiny humans, only two of them.
One stood there with utmost respect and a slight bow, Ye Lin. The other was an icy corpse, covered in gaping wounds from head to toe.
Looking at the corpse, the dragon rumbled, “Is he the one you spoke of?”
“Yes, master. I have brought him.” Ye Lin bowed.
Squinting, the fire dragon sized him up, “You sure were vicious. I only asked you to bring him and use the Dragon Breath Pill if necessary to warn him, not to show up here with him beaten so bad there’s not a breath in him. Is it revenge for last time? But if he’s the one you told me, why did he get hurt so easily? And you’re completely unharmed, unlike last time being carried here from the Double Dragon Gathering.”
“Master, am I so petty?”
Ye Lin sighed, “I fought in the Double Dragon Gathering with my name as a sacred beast inheritor on the line. A loss is a loss, why be so narrowminded about it? Moreover, since I already lost once, I wouldn’t have the heart to fight him again.”
The huge draconic eye shook, waiting for his explanation.
Ye Lin bowed, “Master, when I rushed over, he was already surrounded by the Universal Righteous Sect’s hundreds of people. I have used the Dragon Breath Pill master gave me to get rid of them then brought this half dead body here.”
“I see, he’s been attacked.”
The fire dragon looked down and became astounded, “Just who on earth is his master? He has too many inheritances! Many of them belonged to astounding figures, no less renowned than myself.”
Ye Lin nodded, “Yes, master, when I fought him, I also felt his inheritance was complex, not just from one person. But even against his chaotic and incomplete powers, I still lost. I have shamed master.”
“No, if you were to lose to anyone else, that’s when you would’ve shamed me. But losing to him is justified.” The fire dragon’s face was solemn.
Startled, Ye Lin wondered…
[Why is the always competitive master suddenly soft? He actually admitted his disciple is weaker than another?]
The fire dragon said, “Ye Lin, you must’ve heard me telling you about the ten ancient Sovereigns and us five great sacred beasts, with many other strong beings in the Sacred Domain.”
(StarReader: the ten ancient emperors are actually in a stage far above the one the Demonic Emperor was in, despite having the same title. Now I changed it to reflect that.)
Nodding, Ye Lin blinked, waiting for him to continue.
“Now I’ll share with you the source of his inheritance.”
The draconic claw whistled in the air and pointed at Zhuo Fan’s right arm. “This arm comes from Soaring Qilin, a part of a real sacred beast that was born from the primal chaos. It’s on an entire different level from you who has been transformed to be in between man and beast. If he had known how to use it, one fist would’ve been able to render you heavily wounded. At most, only three punches could you take on.”
Sss~
Ye Lin gasped in shock, staring hard at that arm.
He thought Zhuo Fan and he were the same, sacred beast inheritors, their bodies transformed by sacred beasts. But now he realized that he had a real sacred beast part on him. There was just no comparison.
Ye Lin sighed, feeling down.
“However, how could a sacred beast simply give their body to humans? When the rejection happened, it would’ve taken his life. Can it be then that Nine Serenities’ research was a success?”
Ignoring his disciple’s glum look, the fire dragon frowned, “That settles it, he’s Nine Serenities’ successor. Only that old freak could resort to such twisted and outrageous methods.”
Ye Lin cried out, “The third strongest of the ten ancient Sovereigns, Nine Serenities Sovereign?”
“Yes, I noticed the peculiarity of his Yuan Qi in his Dantian and found it to be a blend of thousands of things. I once heard that Nine Serenities comprehended a skill that can vie with Heavenly Sovereign’s Void Eye, compatible with any kind of constitution. Now that I see it, the cultivation method has indeed been passed down.”
The fire dragon nodded, “It’s because of this that his body can hold so many different powers without clashing. Especially the power of us, five great sacred beasts. Vaulting Kunpeng’s Chaos Flame merged with the spirit, Soaring Qilin’s almighty flesh, Thunder Phoenix’s Berserk Purple Lightning flooding his veins, all lay quiet. If it were anyone else, these three alone would’ve ended him if they clashed.”
[What?]
Ye Lin was shocked, “You’re telling me he has three great sacred beast powers?”
He also sensed it while fighting Zhuo Fan, but hearing his master confirm it was still a shock.
One would already be immensely prideful for having one, yet this guy up and had three of them!
[What kind of a lucky bastard was he anyway?]
He would rather believe Zhuo Fan was just a sacred beast inheritor, with the other two coming from who knew where but had to be given back. The other option was simply insane!
“Humph, three sacred beast powers? You still have no idea.”
The fire dragon mocked, moving a sharp claw to peel the eyelid off Zhuo Fan’s right golden eye. “Ye Lin, see here? Remember it, the Divine Eye of the Void of the strongest in Sacred Domain, Heavenly Sovereign. He is also the one us sacred beasts could never defeat.”
Eye twitching, Ye Lin was overwhelmed, “H-Heavenly Sovereign’s successor?”
“Precisely!”
Flaring his snout, the fire dragon’s eyes flashed with hatred, “But for him to have Heavenly Sovereign’s skill, it must be that he’s unrelated to him, instead getting the treasure Qilin stole. Humph, Heavenly Sovereign would be so pissed to know his precious skill got leaked, ha-ha-ha…”
The fire dragon cackled, imagining the look of anger on Heavenly Sovereign’s face. Ye Lin cried, “Three great sacred beasts, two Sovereigns? That’s five peak inheritance! Who the hell is he?”
“It doesn’t matter, for in the end he’s a really lucky winner.”
The fire dragon raised an eyebrow, “Also, Ye Lin, I have something to tell you but don’t be jealous. He doesn’t have just five, but one more.”
The fire dragon pointed at Zhuo Fan’s belly.
Whoosh~
A light flashed and Blood Infant turned into a demonic sword, under the immense heat of the flame and the fire dragon’s might.
The demonic sword shook, then returned back to Zhuo Fan’s body.
Ye Lin was stumped, “Master, is that… a sword?”
“No, a spirit.”
The fire dragon said, “There was a rumor about Patriarch Blood Demon I told you about. He was only in the Saint Stage yet refined a Blood Infant that none in the Sovereign Stage dared to mess with. But after he died, his skill was lost. I never thought I’d meet it here, added to a sacred weapon to become a sword spirit.”
“Ha-ha-ha, the power Blood Infant has when reaching Saint Stage while using a sacred weapon will be unthinkable. I bet it can easily dispatch average Sovereigns.”
The fire dragon laughed, his eyes pensive.
Ye Lin looked at Zhuo Fan with a complicated look, “Six peak inheritances. Now this is heaven’s favorite. How can I compare to him, when I only have one?”
“Ahe-hem, getting my inheritance is the highlight of anyone’s life. And what’s the use of having so many anyway? Unable to reach their peak will still get you beaten up.” The fire dragon scolded.
Ye Lin grinned, “And if he does train them?”
“Uhm, well…” The fire dragon sighed, “Then he’ll be unstoppable.”
Ye Lin stood there stunned.
But then, the fire dragon shook his head, “Which is impossible. The ultimate skills of Sovereigns and the abilities of sacred beasts came about after millions of years. To master them all is just not feasible. It’s better if you stick with mine, on the path of the fire dragon, rather than bite more than you can chew. And you don’t have Nine Serenities Sovereign’s inheritance either and can’t agree to having so many powers. You’ll only die.”
Disappointed still, Ye Lin nodded in the end, then he looked down on Zhuo Fan, “Master, his body shows no sign of life, ruined. But his soul might be saved.”
“Ha-ha-ha, his soul is under Chaos Flame’s protection and should recover by himself. But wounded as he is, only if I trigger it. As for his body, it’s not ruined just yet. He has the Blood Infant protecting it. It holds the source of life. As long as Blood Infant is around, his body will never die. His severely damaged body needs to be repaired, is all.”
