The fire dragon hissed as he ripped a golden scale, placing it over Zhuo Fan’s body. Then a scorching golden flame engulfed him, burning hotter and hotter…

chapters.title: Chapter 795: Revival
chapters.content:
Chapter 795: Revival
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Golden flame refining, Decimating Dragon Scale Armor!
Eyes squinting, Ye Lin watched the familiar spectacle for a long time. It was the same way he was saved back then. “Master, you’re using your reverse scale again and Decimating Golden Flame to refine his body. Won’t that mean he’ll be just like me?”
“Why, jealous?” Never once considering his disciple’s opinion, the fire dragon nodded.
Ye Lin’s face twitched and sighed, “That’ll give him a seventh peak inheritance. The Decimating Golden Flame that only I had now he has it while I don’t have what he has. It’s hard to feel at ease, master.”
“Humph, rotten brat, what’s there to be unsettled about?”
The fire dragon smirked, “Can you even do what I told you to do alone? Ha-ha, I know how improbable that is. Since such a perfect and rare specimen came, a kindred spirit as well, I’ll be sure to use everything to save him, to strengthen him so he could finish my work.”
Ye Lin’s brow twitched, “Kindred?”
“Yes, kindred.” Fire dragon’s eyes flashed and revealed a nasty grin. Those huge eyes never left the ball of fire below…
…
[Nine Serenities…]
In a hazy area, a lonely shadow floated around perplexed, “Who is it? What are you calling?”
His questions went unanswered, the voices coming and going, showting Nine Serenities’ name on and on…
The shadow questioned some more, but no answer was provided. He chose to ignore them, just floating there in this desolate place…
Suddenly, an aged figure stood before him, with clothes as black as night.
The old man faced away from him. The shadow had a peculiar look as he asked, “Who… are you?”
The old man was ever silent, ignoring him just as the voices did. It just floated forward.
“Wait!”
Then the old man spoke, “Forward is the great beyond. If you step any further, there’ll be no going back.”
Frowning, the shadow asked, “What’s this great beyond?”
“A place where your spirit fades.” The old man replied.
Looking around, he saw nothing but mist, with no paths around. But when he looked in front, there was pitch-black darkness. “Where should I go?”
The old man paused, left speechless. He finally sighed, “Wait here.”
“Oh.” The shadow nodded, standing there like a good child. In front there was pitch-blackness and behind, darkness. Around him there was nothingness swirling, with only he and the old man standing here.
“Nine Serenities… we’ve waited your return…”
The drawn out calls came once again. The old man shook. The shadow asked, “Are they calling… for you?”
“Yeah.”
“Why don’t you answer them?”
“They can’t hear me, nor would they dare to talk back.” The old man’s back shook a bit and sighed, “I have promised something I failed to do and can’t return.”
The shadow looked around, at the endless haze without any path in sight. “Yeah, there’s no return without a path. Unless…”
The shadow point at the pitch-blackness in front, “You go there.”
“But once I do, I’ll never come out, never coming back.” The old man sighed, “I still want to return. I can’t ever go forward.”
The shadow nodded after a pause then floated forward. As he went, pitch-blackness crept behind him, cutting his retreat.
The old man shouted, “What are you doing? Didn’t I told you not to go?”
“But this is the only way.” Shaking, the shadow looked at the old man, puzzled.
The old man shivered, as if afraid.
The shadow just kept going forward.
“Hold on a minute!”
The old man cried, “Before you go, mind answering a question of mine?”
“What question?”
“Who are you?”
Startled, the shadow frowned for a long time then shook his head, “I don’t know. Who am I?”
“Promise me this, before you can answer my question, you can’t go forward.” The old man spoke solemnly.
The shadow scratched his head and nodded. But then he was perplexed again as he took another step forward unconsciously. “Who am I? Who am I?”
“I have let you all down. I can’t go back…” The old man sighed and shook all over. “My spirit is barely holding on. It’s so weak I can’t even remember my name, ha-ha. I… want to go with him…”
“Who am I…”
The shadow passed by the old man and failed to noticed that the old man was walking by his side, deeper into the abyss.
Then, in this hazy world, a blinding light flashed. A huge ball of golden fire shone.
It cast its light upon the shadow, revealing a very familiar face.
As if by agreement, an azure flame ignited on his forehead, soon covering his entire body and turning him into a human-shaped azure fire.
“Who am I…”
The shadow’s eyes were hazy as it muttered. But as the azure flame spread to his eyes, he woke up shouting, “I-I’m Zhuo Fan! Demonic Emperor Zhuo Fan!”
Like a vow, the shout dispelled the abyss, making the ever encroaching pitch-blackness fade away.
The darkness faded and gave way to glorious and vibrant light.
Zhuo Fan floated now towards the golden flames, but before he melded with them, he turned to look at the old man fading away from the light.
“Who are you?” Zhuo Fan shouted.
The old man was no longer visible, but just as Zhuo Fan was entering the golden flame, the old man’s voice reached him, “We will meet again. On the edge of death, or when we achieve Dao, ha-ha-ha…”
Boom!
With a huge explosion, fire motes flew all over and Zhuo Fan came out of it with golden shining in his eyes, filled with flames. His body was covered in golden scales releasing blistering heat, capable of melting anything.
“You’re finally back, child!”
Zhuo Fan was still out of all that was happening when he heard a rumbling voice.
He turned his head with a start and saw a huge dragon head staring right at him with an eerie look. The golden flames burned so hot it warped the space around it.
Zhuo Fan cried out, “One of the five great sacred beasts, Decimating Dragon Ancestor? Am I in Infernal Gorge?”
“He-he-he, right you are. This is my domain, welcome!”
The dragon ancestor let out a wave of scorching air, forcing Zhuo Fan back.
Zhuo Fan was perplexed.
[What am I doing here?]
Ye Lin read his mind, “I brought you. When you were fighting the Universal Righteous Sect’s siege, you were at the end of your life, your soul and body about to go cold. Only my master could save you. That’s why I brought you here.”
“Ye Lin?” Zhuo Fan’s brow shook. Zhuo Fan pondered then shouted, “What about the girls? How are they?”
Ye Lin raised an eyebrow, “Since when did you care about someone else?”
“Just tell me, are they alright?”
“They’re fine. When I arrived, only you were fighting, blocking hundreds of men from Universal Righteous Sect. I did you a favor and killed them all. There should be no pursuers.”
“Good, that’s good.” Easing a breath he’d been holding, Zhuo Fan was relieved. In his persistent determination to hold on for three days, his consciousness had faded at some point. One might have even ruled him dead. But he went on, hanging on to that last breath. That was what kept him fighting for so long, while he knew nothing of what was happening nor if the girls got away.
The Decimating Dragon Ancestor asked curiously, “Child, are those people related to you?”
“Uhm, Dragon Ancestor, my wife is with them.” Zhuo Fan bowed, knowing how to clean up his act before such an almighty existance.
His answer made the dragon snort, flaring its nostrils. “Heed my warning. Break all ties with them. You’re not even aware you sunk so deep because of them? If you really do care about your wife, stay away from her.”
“What?!”
Zhuo Fan stood there dumbstruck…

chapters.title: Chapter 796: Ten Sovereigns, Ten Paths
chapters.content:
Chapter 796: Ten Sovereigns, Ten Paths
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Glancing at the dumbstruck Zhuo Fan, the dragon ancestor turned to Ye Lin, “Leave us, there’s something I want to speak to the kid.”
The dragon then clawed the air.
Following the wave of heat, the space tore, revealing on the other side a magnificent landscape.
Ye Lin looked at the dazed Zhuo Fan then bowed and left. The tear sealed behind him and this area was once again a searing inferno.
“Just what’s going on? What do you mean by that?” Zhuo Fan’s brow shook and he felt uneasy.
The dragon ancestor had touched his greatest fear.
The dragon shouted, “Before I answer, you must first be honest with me. Who are you? Why do you have so many great legacies despite being so young?”
Zhuo Fan did not reply. It was his greatest secret, and not something that could be shared.
“Talk, or you’ll one day be sorry. Don’t say I didn’t warn you.” The dragon ancestor’s roar gave a stern warning.
Sighing, Zhuo Fan felt helpless. He had lost all grounds in this negotiation. Not that it mattered much. Vaulting Kunpeng had him explain himself and now talking to this dragon ancestor wouldn’t be much of a difference.
He wanted to know why the dragon ancestor wanted him detached from others, especially Qingcheng…
So he began detailing his two lives, making sure to include his meeting with Kunpeng and his request to find the other sacred beasts.
The dragon ancestor was stunned. He sighed, “Kid, you’re really something to have such strange circumstances. You must know that any one of those legacies is a dream come true for others. Yet you took them all for yourself, ha-ha-ha. Congratulations, especially on Nine Serenities’ dubious arts, allowing you to come back through grudges. Even I have to show my admiration for such skill.”
Zhuo Fan chuckled and nodded, feeling the same way towards Nine Serenities Sovereign’s research.
“However…”
The dragon ancestor changed his tone, his maw perked in a savage grin, “Kid, despite the amazing luck on you, it fails you when you most need it. You’ve been had by Ol’ Kunpeng and now you’re stuck with us. Your life is destined to be spent in fear, under constant despair your life might end the next moment.”
Zhuo Fan’s heart trembled from shock, “W-where did that come from?”
“The ancient period.”
With a long sigh, the dragon ancestor released a heat wave and his fiery bulk shook. As he gazed at the sky, he struck a lonely figure, “In the time of the primal chaos, when heaven and earth began to take shape, we were born, graced with five primal abilities. Everywhere we went, the beasts saw us as kings and the humans unable to reach our level. But us, five great sacred beasts, only had interest in each other, to duel and settle once and for all who had supreme dominion over this world. The fights were endless. The disregard for humans was so severe, we saw them as nothing but snacks.
“This is how we spent the next few millions of years, always fighting and never winning, unable to settle on a one ruler. Kunpeng, the old geezer, maybe his gentle Chaos Flame being able to harmonize yin and yang had something to do with it, was slick and cunning. This made him be seen as a friend by the other four sacred beasts from the constant mediating of our conflicts. But he was far from being fit to be the leader of us five great sacred beasts. None of us was any weaker than the other to begin with!”
Zhuo Fan nodded. Sacred beasts were not much different from wild beasts. Unless beaten into submission, it would just not listen. Preaching and smooth-talking was pointless.
“But…”
Dragon ancestor continued, “One day, beyond our knowledge, our carefree days ended. The humans we disregarded so much revealed to have ten strong members. They had deep insights in the workings of the world, creating remarkable arts, arts that held the power to contend with our might. To the point the top three were able to beat us. These ten later on became the ten ancient Sovereigns. Their power was called The Ten Paths to Heaven. They can break the world and seize all!
“Under their guidance, humanity began to comprehend the Dao, beginning to cultivate and grow stronger. Countless experts rose to prominence while the supremacy of the sacred beasts upon the world began to wane. They were driven back to the forests and mountains. Only then did we realize that heaven was impartial. While our might was incredible, our intelligence was not. Be it sacred beasts or spiritual beasts, none could understand the heart’s mysteries, blocking our advance. Humanity was weak, but was very sharp too, with the chance to rise to the top. Especially those ten, they have become the peak of this world’s power.”
Dragon ancestor sighed, “By the way, kid, don’t you have Patriarch Blood Demon’s Blood Infant in you as well? That’s borrowed power, something that will never get you to the top. Do you know why Patriarch Blood Demon was stuck in the Saint Stage and the Sovereigns avoided him?”
“Uhm, isn’t it because he was a show off and ended up being killed before reaching the Sovereign Stage?” Zhuo Fan asked.
Dragon ancestor laughed at his answer, mocking, “Even you’re giving credence to rumors, kid? An outstanding expert will treasure his life the higher he rises. With how cultivation takes ages to advance, who would show off? Knowing he was in the Saint Stage, no matter how strong, he’d be suicidal going against a Sovereign.”
Startled, Zhuo Fan pondered a bit before nodding.
[True, if I were in Patriarch Blood Demon’s stead, getting to the Sovereign Stage was a much better option than to flex.]
“Then why…”
Dragon ancestor spoke, “The Ten Paths to Heaven are finite and all accounted for. For one to rise, another had to fall. This is why the Patriarch Blood Demon always lived on edge, challenging the Sovereigns, which ended up being his downfall as well. As an ex Demonic Emperor of the Sacred Domain, you should have a broader horizon. Haven’t you ever noticed that all the arts and skills in the world have their roots going back to these ten paths?”
Trembling, Zhuo Fan was in a state of shock.
[That means…]
“Precisely!”
Dragon ancestor’s eyes flashes, “As long as the ten Sovereigns live, even if humanity cultivates, it will never reach higher. This is a world constant, it’s balance. It places a limit on the number of ultimate experts at one time to maintain it. The Ten Paths to Heaven are in balance. That’s why one can only rise when another has fallen. Everything revolves around them.”
Stunned, Zhuo Fan clenched his fists in denial, “Doesn’t that mean that all cultivators are stuck in the Saint Stage?”
“Not necessarily.”
Dragon ancestor shook his head, “I already said, if one falls, another may rise. Humanity cultivates to comprehend the Dao, to the point of reaching the peak and seeing the nature of the world. Only most cultivators’ insight falls in line with the ten paths, thus cutting off your future. But by gaining insight in a path outside of these ten, then you’ll be a fully fledged Sovereign in your own right. Then, as heaven wills it, with the rise of one, another has to fall.”
“When Patriarch Blood Demon challenged the Sovereigns, he did it in belief that his blood path was outside of theirs, a new path that allowed him to dethrone one of the ten Sovereigns. He was mistaken, unfortunate, as the blood-, no, demonic blood path fell under Nine Serenities’ path. This bound him to the Saint Stage for the rest of his life. His Blood Infant was amazing, yes, but it was only a skill, while his cultivation could never reach the height of power the ten Sovereigns enjoyed.”
Zhuo Fan nodded.
[This explains why after years and years, there was no other Sovereign appearing besides the ten ancient Sovereigns. The requirements are too high. Even if the ten Sovereigns weren’t there, one must first comprehend their path to become its patriarch before rising into the Sovereign Stage.]
In a meritorious world such as this, hardly anyone had such qualifications.
[My master, Elder Yuan, has a high chance of comprehending the heart path. A shame his aptitude lacks, stunting his cultivation stage despite his deep insight.]
Zhuo Fan shook his head and sighed.
[The road to the Sovereign Stage is beyond difficult.]
Dragon ancestor looked at him hard then smiled, “Ha-ha-ha, kid, you think that’s hard? Wrong again, for us, the five great sacred beasts and the ten Sovereigns, the Sovereign Stage is in the past. What all of us really care about is that even in the Sovereign Stage, we’re all nothing but the world’s toys, under constant threat and unable to dominate the world in the truest sense. The Ten Paths to Heaven might look unflinching, but they aren’t without dangers. They are at risk of being replaced. That is why we wanted to strive for a higher stage. This is what brought the next series of great events. It even included your fate.”
Trembling, Zhuo Fan’s expression turned heavy as he frowned, waiting for the explanation…

chapters.title: Chapter 797: Heavenly Sovereign’s Prison
chapters.content:
Chapter 797: Heavenly Sovereign’s Prison
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Humanity focuses on insight. To advance, they need to go through the stages. Sacred beasts rely on power and need to amass greater power to advance. This ended up being the root of the most terrible war of all time.”
Dragon ancestor’s eyes shone as he grit his fangs, showing his bloodlust, “All humans searched for a way to advance, with almost none succeeding. But two Sovereigns and one beast had their own ideas. They were the strongest Heavenly Sovereign, the most devious Nine Serenities, and the most unscrupulous geezer Kunpeng. If not for him, Thunder Phoenix would’ve never had suffered so much at Heavenly Sovereign’s insidious blow.”
Zhuo Fan’s heart shook, “H-Heavenly Sovereign hurt the Thunder Phoenix?”
“How else do you think the Purple Lightning Gold Eye came to be?”
Decimating Dragon Ancestor mocked, “Each of these three had their own way of overcoming the Sovereign Stage. Heavenly Sovereign wanted to do it through the Divine Eye of the Void that contained everything. By holding all the world offered, he’ll become its supreme ruler. Nine Serenities Sovereign pondered that all things had the same source, the world’s Dao. By wielding the world’s power, wouldn’t you have it all? Through their own understanding, each ruled!”
Zhuo Fan shook and nodded.
[This must be the source of the Demon Transformation Art. A shame Nine Serenities Sovereign never got the chance to train it, having gone missing.]
“As for Kunpeng…”
Dragon ancestor grew angry, his burning claw swiping around, “He actually wanted to steal our four great sacred beasts’ power. By means of returning them to primal chaos, he would go beyond a sacred beast and reach the highest level.”
“What, combining five great sacred beasts powers?” Zhuo Fan was shocked. Thinking about it, he had considered it as well at some point. But he was not the first, Kunpeng came up with it in ancient times.
If he hadn’t combined four of them already, Zhuo Fan would’ve labeled Kunpeng as a madman. Five extreme powers clashing into each other? It’d be a miracle if you were still around to tell the tale.
But having gone through that preliminary process, he knew that the result would be beyond the five great sacred beasts’ power.
So much so, it was in another realm.
While Kunpeng’s intentions were dubious at best, this avenue showed promise. As for success, it all came down to how he handled these powers.
Dragon ancestor continued in a dark tone, “Ever since the ten Sovereigns appeared, we could no longer overlook humanity. But humans are deceitful, unlike the frank spiritual beasts. To come in contact with the ten Sovereigns, we elected the most glib sacred beast among us, Kunpeng. We had no way of knowing the crafty Kunpeng who only mediated our conflicts had been corrupted by humanity’s twisted minds.
“To test whether the five powers could be combined, he created the Word Crushing Array that five beasts could use. He came to us with it by lying it was to counter the ten Sovereigns. The day the array was employed, no matter how strong the five powers were, there was no sign of joining together. Disappointed, he figured the powers were still inside each of us and that’s why they could not fuse correctly. So he sought the help of Heavenly Sovereign. The first victim ended up to be Thunder Phoenix!”
“That means young Sanzi is in terrible danger?!” Zhuo Fan panicked. He had severe doubts about Kunpeng from the start, but since he had done nothing untoward so far, he let down his guard.
But hearing Kunpeng’s goal from dragon ancestor, letting Gu Santong in his charge was like handing him on a silver platter.
Dragon ancestor shook his head, “Worry not, the old coot won’t touch the kid. He’s still growing. All the powers in the world are in balance. A tiny Qilin won’t put a dent in his appetite to begin with. It’s too soon for his plan. Besides, he has yet to find the right way to even achieve it.”
Nodding, Zhuo Fan eased a heavy breath. But even so, he was still worried about leaving young Sanzi with that geezer.
“Especially since he painted a pretty picture when he asked you to come save us. It’s obvious to everyone that with your immature Divine Eye of the Void, there won’t be any rescue. His meaning was to make peace since we all have a common enemy.”
“Heavenly Sovereign?”
Zhuo Fan’s heart thumped.
Dragon ancestor’s mood was heavy, “Yes, when he went to ally with Heavenly Sovereign, it was the worst mistake of his life. Heavenly Sovereign’s ambition was far greater. After stealing Thunder Phoenix’s Berserk Purple Lightning, he turned. Heavenly Sovereign is a proud man, considering everyone beneath him, even us, sacred beasts. But he feared our powers. Especially Thunder Phoenix’s, known to be a destructive force of raw power, the most terrible of the five. If he took the purple lightning for himself, then nothing in the world could escape his Divine Eye of the Void!”
“He worked with Kunpeng, but only to test his limits. Once he assessed them, he went to work on his true plan, which included all living things.”
“What is it?” Zhuo Fan asked even as his mind worked some guesses.
With a sneer, the dragon ancestor said, “As an inheritor of the Divine Eye of the Void, you still don’t know its power?”
“A new world?”
“Yes, creating an entirely new world and having everything moved there, to become its supreme ruler.” Taking a deep breath, the dragon ancestor revealed a hint of fear, “This is without a doubt a catastrophe to this world. With everything contained in his eye, we’ll be nothing but cattle. Or, worse, he plans on using the power of the entire world to advance beyond the Sovereign Stage and attain true dominion.
“Sacred beasts being against this was obvious, but even the other Sovereigns would defy it! This marked the start of a great war among the ten ancient Sovereigns. It ravaged the lands for millennia, taking a heavy toll on its inhabitants. No matter how strong Heavenly Sovereign was, not even he was assured of victory. To make sure his ultimate skill did not go out, he used an Imparting Stone, hiding it behind a realm. Finding out about this, we planned on stealing it and figuring out its weaknesses.
“But soon, Heavenly Sovereign noticed our plan. Enraged, he hunted us four sacred beasts down. With the power of his eye, he created the mortal domain to trap us. In essence, the mortal domain is Heavenly Sovereign’s prison, and we the inmates. We were being assaulted by Berserk Purple Lightning every day, wanting to take back his art. He had no idea Qilin had taken it, ha-ha-ha…”
Dragon ancestor laughed, but his joy was with tears. For the great sacred beasts to be trapped by a single man, this was no longer shame, but humiliation.
And? He was Heavenly Sovereign, the strongest Sovereign for a reason.
Zhuo Fan was dumbstruck. Every Sacred Domain denizen believed the lowest rung, the mortal domain, was made naturally. Now he found out the truth that Heavenly Sovereign had created it to trap the sacred beasts.
[Just what power is that? Isn’t this like being the ruler of a world? Is this the power of a Sovereign?]
Dragon ancestor broke him out of his dazed look with a smile, “Heavenly Sovereign is the very peak of this world.”
Zhuo Fan sighed.
“Afterward, we roamed the mortal domain, suffering every day, oblivious of how the ten Sovereigns’ war was going…”
“Then the ten Sovereigns vanished practically overnight. The rumors say they fell, dead fighting each other…” Zhuo Fan sighed.
Dragon ancestor cracked up, “Ha-ha-ha, they fell? Don’t make me laugh. Granted, others might fall, but Heavenly Sovereign? What about this prison, isn’t it still standing?”
“The mortal domain will stand as long as Heavenly Sovereign lives?” Craning his head up, Zhuo Fan asked in disbelief.
Dragon ancestor shook his head, “I’m unsure either. The mortal domain was something he made with his eye. I don’t know if it would vanish once he’s dead. But I can still feel his piercing gaze on this world, to see if we have yet to still be under the purple lightning’s onslaught. “
“Heavenly Sovereign still watches this place?”
“Maybe not watch, since everything here is in the palm of his hand.” Dragon ancestor gritted his fangs, “Just like in the new world he wants to make in his own image, the people here are at his whim. As if the world laws or The Ten Paths to Heaven, the amount of experts are limited. He appears to be the overlord of this world, pressing down on the strong cultivators. Kid, you came from the Sacred Domain, but have you ever heard of anyone from the mortal domain reaching the Sacred Domain?”
Zhuo Fan frowned, “I have never thought about it like that. But the mortal domain’s spiritual energy is thin and makes it hard for…”
A thought struck Zhuo Fan, “You mean…”
“Quite.”
Dragon ancestor’s voice was firm, “In the mortal domain, Heavenly Sovereign’s world, not only is cultivation suppressed, but no one is allowed to leave it. If there’s a true outstanding genius that comes out, humph, Heavenly Sovereign’s rage would bore down on him, snuffing him out. In the end, this place is a test for Heavenly Sovereign’s new world. He is the lord over it and we are merely the guinea pigs populating it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 798: Apocalyptic Thunderflame Eye
chapters.content:
Chapter 798: Apocalyptic Thunderflame Eye
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Zhuo Fan was overwhelmed by what dragon ancestor declared, finding it very hard to believe it was true. “T-that’s simply godlike. It goes beyond what any expert can do.”
“Humph, no god has the power to create world laws.”
Dragon ancestor sighed, “But in the mortal domain, Heavenly Sovereign is tantamount to the Creator, having everything in this world under his control. This is the greatest ability of the Divine Eye of the Void, a new world!”
Zhuo Fan stood there, dazed, unable to conceive the ten ancient Sovereigns could hold so much power, having never seen them before.
Although from the dragon ancestor’s words, he did know one, it was obvious the rest were no pushovers either.
“Dragon ancestor, I see that you control this place as well!”
Zhuo Fan looked around at the fiery place, “There’s no Berserk Purple Lightning here and Ye Lin can come and go whenever. Getting out of here should be easy for you. Are you perhaps stalling it out of fear of Heavenly Sovereign?”
The huge fiery head nodded, “Yes, I’m not sure if the Sovereigns have gone like you said, Heavenly Sovereign included. They might be just heavily wounded. But even so, he’s still the master of the mortal domain, while disregarding feeble ants like you scurrying around, he will definitely look closer at us sacred beasts.”
“Especially when he had made preparation in the mortal domain. Back then, he and Sword Sovereign had created five sacred weapons, to guard the mortal domain. The moment they sense our energy, they would suck the five sacred mines dry then come to kill us. And since this is the mortal domain, under Divine Eye of the Void’s suppression, our power is severely weaker than in the Sacred Domain and can’t block them. Speaking of, you already got one to accept you.”
“The mortal domain’s five lands’ defending sacred weapons were made by Heavenly Sovereign and Sword Sovereign for you in mind?” Zhuo Fan cried out.
Dragon ancestor nodded, “Among the ten Sovereigns, Sword Sovereign specialized in refining weapons, and also Heavenly Sovereign’s confidant. While Heavenly Sovereign made this place, Sword Sovereign placed the many arrays. Even if we overcame years of purple lightning torture, we won’t leave still. Those sacred weapons are our jailers. We have nowhere to run.”
“I see. I was wondering why the Divine Eye of the Void could resist the sacred weapon. It’s because it won’t fight what came from its master.” Zhuo Fan nodded as things began to fall into place. When he went to the sacred mine, he was attacked by the sacred weapon all because it sensed the Qilin energy on him.
But then he frowned, “What of Vaulting Kunpeng? He’s in no prison, able to go wherever in the mortal domain. Why isn’t he afraid of Heavenly Sovereign? Is he still on Heavenly Sovereign’s side?”
“Not at all. To be honest, Heavenly Sovereign has no use for him any longer. Heavenly Sovereign wanted to capture him and force him to give up his techniques, but always failed.”
“He failed? Showing off as the king of beasts in the Allbeast Mountain Range…” Zhuo Fan was stunned.
Dragon ancestor smiled, “That’s Heavenly Sovereign’s only lapse. He is but a Sovereign, no matter how powerful, and not the master of the real world to govern everything. Kid, you know as well that Kunpeng geezer’s Chaos Flame can harmonize yin and yang, able to blend the primal chaos power at the source of every being. He hides in the Allbeast Mountain Range so that the beasts there mask his energy. Not even Heavenly Sovereign can find him like that, unless he comes out himself. With the beasts hiding him, he’d be no different from the other humans mingling about in the mortal domain.
“Moreover, Heavenly Sovereign would never think that having us imprisoned in these spaces, that old geezer long ago hid in the Allbeast Mountain Range, still within the range of his prison. The safest place is also the most dangerous. I bet Heavenly Sovereign must be scouring this world for the coot but won’t ever find him.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, now realizing the azure flame was so ingenious.
[Or maybe Kunpeng is so devious.]
“Now I’ve explained to you all the ins and outs and you be my should understand the world better. My warning should now be much clearer.”
Dragon ancestor finished his sad story and returned back to the main topic.
Shaking all over, Zhuo Fan’s eyes glazed over, still reluctant.
“You should know by now who Heavenly Sovereign is. He made the mortal domain, imprisoning us and using purple lightning to torture us. Why didn’t he kill us? Isn’t it to find his art and not get anyone to learn it? This just shows how much he cares for it.”
Staring at Zhuo Fan, the dragon emperor spoke, “Which is obvious, with how much of a threat someone stumbling upon the Divine Eye of the Void would become. It’s something he will not tolerate. If not for the crisis he was under when the other Sovereigns attacked him, he would never make a record of his art to safeguard it.”
Zhuo Fan shook and closed his eyes, his fists clenched.
Dragon ancestor sighed, “Kid, you’re the successor of the strongest Sovereign. It’s your fortune and curse. When Kunpeng pushed you to find Qilin, it was to get you on his side, but in the end it all came down to your greed, wanting that supreme treasure. Now you know the Divine Eye of the Void and that makes you Heavenly Sovereign’s target. Your enemy is the strongest in the world that can take your life at any time. And you still want to involve your wife and friends into this danger?”
“And what if I give it up, what if I destroy it?” Zhuo Fan shook and clenched his teeth.
Dragon ancestor shook his head, “Kid, do you know what successor means? It’s not just the skill, but the path. Divine Eye of the Void is Heavenly Sovereign’s greatest skill, containing within is his void path. As you train it, you’ll gain insights and blend with the Dao. It seeps into your bones, it fills your soul. It will never leave you for as long as you live. What’s the use ruining the skill? Heavenly Sovereign will still find you from your aura.”
Zhuo Fan shook all over, feeling regret flooding his heart. His jaw was locked so tight blood flowed.
“Just why did I train this skill…”
“Kid, it seems you still don’t want to give it up. But…”
Dragon ancestor continued, “If you don’t let go, you’re killing the others. You don’t want them to suffer for your mistakes, but one day they’ll die at Heavenly Sovereign’s hand. The more you hang on to it, the more it slips away. Let it go and it will come. Isn’t it enough to see them safe from afar…”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes were filled with loss.
He had been alone all his first life, but not anymore. But providence played the biggest joke on him. To stop being alone, he had to walk alone…
“Ha-ha-ha, if fate exists, who planned this out for me, toying with me to such extent…”
Zhuo Fan showed a self-deprecating smile, one filled with endless sorrow and malcontent at the world.
Dragon ancestor used a sharp talon to pat his shoulder, “Hey, kid, don’t go losing it over something so small. Heavenly Sovereign is strong, but not invincible. As long you follow my teachings, we, sacred beasts, will overcome him, and you will overcome this suffering as well. Before that though, don’t let trifles bog you down. Always follow my words above all else…”
As he finished, Zhuo Fan’s body ignited in a golden flame, then the azure flame appeared as well, along with the crackling of purple lightning and Qilin’s red glow.
Four of the sacred beast powers came out.
Even dragon ancestor had to pause.
[What… just happened?]
Then a pitch-black energy came spread over Zhuo Fan, sucking in the four powers and slowly combining them.
[This… this…]
With wide eyes, dragon ancestor shook from disbelief.
Crack!
With the crack of thunder, black flames exploded, and under Decimating Dragon Ancestor’s incredulous gaze, Zhuo Fan’s body was covered in black flames with peals of black lightning flashing within.
A dreaded power was released making even the Decimating Dragon Ancestor shudder.
“Is this the form of our combine powers?”
Standing there, dragon ancestor muttered, “But our powers come from the primal chaos, with life at its core. So why then do I feel total destruction when I sense this power? Even I’m feeling fear from it.”
Dragon ancestor tapped the black flame with his claw. A bang went off and he quickly took his claw back.
Looking close, the scales on the claw were erased.
[This can’t be…]
Gasping, dragon ancestor looked at Zhuo Fan’s black flame like it was a monster.
[Is this what Kunpeng was after? But this is no power to dominate, but to destroy.]
The black flames shrunk and entered Zhuo Fan. But when Zhuo Fan looked at the dragon ancestor, he jerked in fright.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes were stone-cold, containing endless destruction. Especially his left eye, holding the same black flame and black flickers.
“Dragon ancestor, what I give up today, I will take it back one day. I’ll use this, different from Heavenly Sovereign’s, Apocalyptic Thunderflame Eye!” Zhuo Fan’s will was firm.
Decimating Dragon Ancestor was dumbstruck, only bobbing his huge head, having felt fear like no other.
The destruction aura combing off that black thunderflame made him feel pure terror…

chapters.title: Chapter 799: Dragon Breath Pill
chapters.content:
Chapter 799: Dragon Breath Pill
Proofreader
: Papatonks
In the searing space filled with golden flames, there was one spot untouched. Or better yet, the golden flames always went around it from fear.
Zhuo Fan stood in the middle, staring hard at Decimating Dragon Ancestor’s bulk with sharp eyes.
His left eye was pitch-black with flashes of black flames and flickering black lightning. While his right eye now sported six golden halos. Divine Eye of the Void was in the 6th stage!
Decimating Dragon Ancestor looked at this freak and trembled. He felt like he struck a familiar figure, like Heavenly Sovereign.
Yet he feared this little kid even more, especially that left eye. Despite only being in this form, the Apocalyptic Thunderflame Eye was made of four sacred beast powers, its level was above the five sacred beasts, bearing down on them.
Logically, the black eye was on a weak user and that shouldn’t work on him. But instinct told him to fear it.
He felt slight regret from imparting the Decimating Golden Flame to Zhuo Fan and leading to the creation of something so abominable. Kunpeng had been thinking of every way possible on how to get his hands on ultimate power, only for a pup to stumble into it.
[I wonder what face he’ll make when he finds out.]
Dragon ancestor relaxed at this point…
Pa!
A sound came from Zhuo Fan’s left eye and he clenched his teeth. Holding his eye, when he took the hand away, the eye was back to normal, with blood seeping from it.
“What’s wrong?” Dragon ancestor asked.
Zhuo Fan shook his head. The immense loss he felt made him think of how to fight Heavenly Sovereign when the time came, where normal methods were useless.
Then he recalled the dreaded thunderflame, the power that was always out of Kunpeng’s reach.
His head felt hot and the four sacred beast powers came out on an impulse, using Demon Transformation Art to fuse them just like when he fought Ye Lin.
But after he succeeded, he noticed the thunderflame was truly abominable. His own body couldn’t take the strain. He had no way of keeping it in his body, or it would eat him alive.
So he thought of how to dispel it when it came undone by itself. The thunderflame was made of powers within himself. As these powers’ source was him, it would be coming back, and could ignite from a single spark. It was unlike in the Double Dragon Gathering, where it was only temporarily.
[Aren’t I playing with fire here?]
Luck had it, he was suddenly thinking of Divine Eye of the Void’s art. It emphasized space and emptiness, able to contain everything and nothing.
Then he entered Divine Eye of the Void’s 6th stage, Void Domain, just like that.
In the void, a space was created, similar to Heavenly Sovereign’s new world he wanted to create.
He then thought of the Apocalyptic Thunderflame Eye and understood. The Void Domain was inside his left eye and stored the thunderflame, turning it into the Apocalyptic Thunderflame Eye.
It became clear to him why the Heavenly Sovereign would say that by understanding the Divine Eye of the Void one could train in the Purple Lightning Gold Eye.
[This was the secret!]
While he learned the core art, accidents happened. The thunderflame eye rebelled on him, hurting his left eye.
[Is the thunderflame too strong for Void Domain to hold or just unstable?]
[Am I missing the fifth sacred beast power? Is the thunderflame eye incomplete?]
Decimating Dragon Ancestor’s eyes flashed and eased a breath.
[Thank god the thunderflame isn’t complete, or the kid would’ve been more terrible than Heavenly Sovereign.]
[Or we’d have been inviting a worse disaster to deal with the first, one of our own making too.]
Both were deep in thought, each to his own devices.
When the wounded eye recovered, Zhuo Fan wiped the bloody tears and spoke in a heavy tone, “Dragon Ancestor, you said that you have a way. What is it? What can you possibly do when you’ve been caught so easily?”
“Humph, kid, don’t look down on us so much.”
Dragon ancestor grumbled, “I might have simplified things, but Heavenly Sovereign paid a heavy price to get us deeply wounded. Maybe that’s why he’s been in hiding all this time after facing the other Sovereigns. From how I see it, he should be hovering on the edge. I mean, it’s been ages and there’s no sight of him in the Sacred Domain or before us. Doesn’t he want his art back? This is the only explanation.”
Zhuo Fan’s heart shook.
[This dragon does have a good point. Since he ain’t dead yet hasn’t recovered, that means he’s stuck like that. Maybe he’s really that wounded…]
“That’s why we must take this chance!”
Seeing recognition in Zhuo Fan’s eyes, the dragon ancestor said, “Before Heavenly Sovereign comes back, we must break open the mortal domain and get ourselves out then kill him while he’s weak. There hasn’t been a better time to take down the strongest man in the world.”
Dragon ancestor’s eyes flickered. Zhuo Fan looked up then frowned, “The mortal domain isn’t something simple as an isolated space made by a barrier, but a world in itself, even if smaller. To break it won’t be easy. Without the power of a Sovereign…”
“Ha-ha-ha, don’t worry. I already have a plan.”
Dragon ancestor laughed confidently, “We’ll use a recoiling array to attack with extreme power and break its seal on us. Then we, the sacred beasts, can simply walk out of hiding and no one can stop us, ha-ha-ha.”
Brow shaking, Zhuo Fan said, “Recoil array? That’s something I used in a town to deal with a demonic twerp’s fog array. It’s not hard, but to strike at something the size of mortal domain, it needs something huge and of immense power.”
“The entire mortal domain’s power.”
Dragon ancestor’s eyes flashed, “The five lands of the mortal domain will each set up a recoil array. Their power will be enough to break it, crushing Heavenly Sovereign’s world.”
[What?]
Zhuo Fan shook as he cried out, “With the entire lands as the basis, setting up a complete recoil array? Just how big would that make it? Aside from the obscene amount of resources needed, the five lands are still in conflict with each other. Who’d go along with your plan in setting up some crazy array?”
“Uhm, you make a fair point. That’s the crux of the problem.”
Dragon ancestor nodded, “Before you become the lord of the mortal domain, setting it up will be impossible. The factions will fight you every step of the way. That’s why I believed relying on Ye Lin alone was impossible. Luckily, there’s you. Now that you’re stuck with us and have the same enemy, we should be fighting alongside, and unite our efforts. If we, sacred beasts, weren’t stuck from coming out, enslaving humanity to set the array would’ve been easier than coming to you.”
Zhuo Fan’s face was hard and then he nodded.
Whoosh~
Dragon ancestor opened its maw and spewed out tremendous heat. Then, three huge glittering golden balls came out.
They were just like the golden ball Ye Lin used when he saved Zhuo Fan, only thousands of times bigger.
The three scorching light balls drifted before Zhuo Fan. Sensing the decimating flames inside, he had to falter a few steps in fear.
Dragon ancestor looked tired after that effort. “Kid, you’ll have to help us out as we can’t do anything to offer direct support. Just take these three Dragon Breath Pills and use them to save your life.”
“This…”
Zhuo Fan felt the huge light balls’ immense power and gulped.
With a snicker, dragon ancestor held his head high, “These Dragon Breath Pills hold the power of one fully powered dragon breath of mine. Not even a Sovereign or other sacred beasts will take it head on. As for the Sheng clan in the Sacred Domain, one of them is enough to wipe them out. But giving you these three made me tired and need rest. Since I’m in a prison there’s no one who’d come to take advantage of my weakness. Ha-ha-ha, despite being trapped, I’m quite safe…”
“Uhm, Dragon Ancestor…”
Startled Zhuo Fan looked conflicted, but then he cupped his hands. “Thank you, Dragon Ancestor for giving me these three precious Dragon Breath Pills. But there shouldn’t be anyone near that strength…”
Dragon ancestor cut him off with a heavy tone, “Kid, you’re my hope of getting out of here. I’ll be sure to grasp it fully. It might be the mortal domain, but it’s hard to say you won’t be stumbling into something outrageously hard. There’s Kunpeng and… ha-ha-ha, other deviant freaks out there. If they come after you, it always pays to have a last resort.”
Shaking all over, Zhuo Fan pondered and bowed in gratitude, “I am immensely grateful, Dragon Ancestor!”

chapters.title: Chapter 800: Qiao’er’s Transformation
chapters.content:
Chapter 800: Qiao’er’s Transformation
Proofreader
: Papatonks
With a wave of the hand and a flash of light, the three terrifying golden spheres were stashed away in Zhuo Fan’s ring.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed.
Dragon ancestor’s Dragon Breath Pills were enough to kill anything beneath Sovereign Stage. It’d be a shame to use it on some nobodies.
Zhuo Fan hesitated. He now had a truly insane last resort, but he found no use for it in the mortal domain.
[When I get ambushed by an army, I’d much rather fight it out than waste it.]
Zhuo Fan shook his head. He’d been throwing his money around for the past years like a magnate, yet now that he had these three killer Dragon Breath Pills, he found himself back to the olden days as a miser.
[They’re just too damn valuable to waste…]
Staring at Zhuo Fan’s happy and worried look, dragon ancestor couldn’t understand it. The dragon had always been indulging in showing off its power and wealth, so how could he understand ZhuoFan’s predicament?
“Uhm, I know this will be hard for you, but this is the extent of help I can offer.” Dragon ancestor clearly misunderstood, blaming himself.
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes, driving the misunderstanding home with a sigh and a shameless nod.
[Because it’s hard, the success is that much worth it. Because winning is everything, you’ll do all you can.]
So Zhuo Fan was back to thinking about how to fleece this mighty dragon ancestor for all he was worth.
But then, as a array grandmaster, he found a problem, “Dragon Ancestor, you want to set up a recoil array. But where does its power come from? The spiritual energy in mortal domain is thin and supressed as well. Even if the array is set, it won’t have much effect. Unless we use the five sacred mines!
“Dragon Ancestor, I urge you to lend me a hundred Dragon Breath Pills and I’ll snatch the sacred mines.” Having found a perfectly logical excuse, Zhuo Fan roared with hope.
Pff!
Dragon ancestor was about to spew blood.
[A hundred? What do you take me for, a dispenser?]
Glaring at him, the dragon ancestor shook his head. “No use. Ignoring the fact the five mines have Sword Sovereign’s arrays to block their mining and lower the sacred weapons’ power in killing us when needed, even if we had them by some miracle, it won’t be enough to break this barrier. This is a world in itself, even if a bit smaller than the Sacred Domain.”
“What then? There’s not enough juice to power it.” Zhuo Fan frowned and sighed.
Dragon ancestor said, “I’ve already figured it out. It’s also the second problem of this plan. Setting up a drawing array in the World Wind Tunnel!”
“World Wind Tunnel?”
Zhuo Fan was startled, “What’s that?”
Dragon ancestor explained, “This is the perfect example why despite how great Heavenly Sovereign’s eye is, it’s still in the Sovereign Stage. This mortal domain he created is like a small world, but it has its weakness, tied to the Sacred Domain, the World Wind Tunnel.
“Think about it. With the Sacred Domain’s incredible spiritual energy, it should seep into the mortal domain through this tunnel, but it’s being suppressed by the mortal domain’s barrier. It ends up gathered in one place, leading to the formation of a strange pocket over time. Just how the spot where this prison of mine is placed in a similar wind tunnel, the Ultimate Clarity Sect’s secret realm. Here, the spiritual energy is thick and leads directly to Sacred Domain. That’s why their disciples’ enlightenment comes fast and can form the particular Taiji domain soul.
“That means we can reach the Sacred Domain through this tunnel?” Zhuo Fan cried out.
Dragon ancestor shook his head, “If only it were that easy. It is but a cave that barely lets any spiritual energy pass through. Nothing else can cross it. We can only use its spiritual energy to break out of this place. By using a drawing array it will draw out a lot of energy from Sacred Domain. With this power, we’ll break the barrier.
“But this solution comes with a problem. Because this wind tunnel has created many strange pockets, like this one, while some are good for cultivation, others are deadly. Though there’s one common ground to all of them. Whether they’re a hellscape or paradise, all are under a strong faction’s ownership. So to set a drawing array in them, you not only have to brave their dangers, but also go through any who oppose you.”
Zhuo Fan nodded.
[Since the power supply is settled, the recoil array is feasible. Although…]
“And how am I supposed to find the World Wind Tunnel with the mortal domain as big as it is? You can’t expect me to run around day and night, right?” Zhuo Fan frowned.
Dragon ancestor smiled, his eyes flashing with pride, “Easy, when the Infernal Gorge I am in was drifting across the five lands of the mortal domain, despite the constant strikes from Berserk Purple Lightning, I was still able to sense the rough location of where the World Wind Tunnel is.”
Dragon ancestor raised his huge claw, touching one sharp talon on Zhuo Fan’s forehead.
Hum~
A visible ripple shot and Zhuo Fan could feel warmth on that spot. A crude sketch appeared in his mind, with eight dubious markings on it.
“Uhm, Dragon Ancestor, the sketch ain’t much to go by. Who knows where these tunnels even are?” Zhuo Fan’s face twitched. Aside from the eight spots, the surrounding landscape could hardly be distinguished, whether they were mountains, forests, or plains.
Dragon ancestor reddened and snorted, “I’ve been stuck all this time in the Infernal Gorge while under constant attack, unable to see the outside world. The fact I got their positions is already a blessing, yet you still nag? Anyway, once you go there, you’ll definitely find some secret pocket realm, the place where the World Wind Tunnel resides.”
Zhuo Fan nodded and sighed.
“Hey, kid, you’re Nine Serenities’ successor, don’t tell me now I also have to teach you a drawing array?”
“No, I know how to set it up.” Zhuo Fan sighed longer, “Let me out. I’ll get right on it and get you back to Sacred Domain.”
“That includes you as well.”
Dragon ancestor smiled, “Don’t ever forget, we’re on the same boat.”
Zhuo Fan nodded. Dragon ancestor grinned and swiped his claw, making a tunnel in space for Zhuo Fan to pass, “Wait!”
“What is it now?”
Frowning, the dragon ancestor asked, “For case of minor matters, I’ll have Ye Lin assist you.”
Zhuo Fan shook his head and waved. Qiao’er came out with a flash in this infernal place. Only this time, Qiao’er was still unconscious and fading.
Dragon ancestor started, “This…”
“My daughter.”
Zhuo Fan spoke firmly, “She has remained in this critical state ever since she took on Ye Lin’s heavy blow. No matter what I tried, nothing could help her. I hope Dragon Ancestor has better chances.”
Sizing Qiao’er up, the dragon ancestor cried out, “This spiritual beast’s source of power is the Berserk Purple Lightning! Is it the same as Thunder Phoenix’s? And that old coot Kunpeng opened her mind?”
“Yes, Qiao’er was born from purple lightning…”
“Ha-ha-ha, I see. Heaven truly helps us, sacred beasts! There’s now thirty percent higher chances we can fight Heavenly Sovereign!”
Zhuo Fan did not finish as the dragon burst out laughing. “Kid, I don’t know how you made this miracle happen. Any common sense has within them powers of life and destruction. When hurt, the life energy would recover. But she is different, she hasn’t recovered because she lacks such energy. She’s imbalanced. Pills will do for minor scratches, but the Decimating Golden Flame’s damage is no small matter. With her heavy injury and having no life energy in her, any kind of pill won’t work.”
Zhuo Fan pondered, “Yes, I had used her to absorb purple lightning through her. Demon Transformation Art is no healing art. At that time, the power she absorbed, whether the Demon Transformation Art’s demonic energy, or Berserk Purple Lightning’s brutal force, all are elements of destruction, with no life in them…”
“How else would such a pure seed of purple lightning germinate in her? How else would she become the next generation of Thunder Phoenix!”
“T-Thunder Phoenix?” Zhuo Fan was shocked, “Dragon Ancestor, what are you saying?”
“That the five great sacred beasts will once again gather. At that time, Heavenly Sovereign will have no chance of getting away, ha-ha-ha…”
Dragon ancestor spewed golden flame on Qiao’er, “I shall help you open your mind once more, so you’ll transform into a true sacred beast!”

chapters.title: Chapter 801: Journeying Once More
chapters.content:
Chapter 801: Journeying Once More
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Sss~
The scorching golden flames singed Qiao’er’s frail body, leaving the impression it snuffed out the final trace of life she had left.
Zhuo Fan looked on with worry.
Dragon ancestor consoled him, “Fire is a source of life. Be it my fierce flame, Decimating Golden Flame, or Kunpeng’s gentle flame, Chaos Flame. Only gentle flame is good for alchemy and the soul, while the fierce flame is for refining weapons and the body. Letting the golden flame enter her body won’t just remake her body, but open her mind further, setting her on the path of a real sacred beast.”
“Further?”
“Precisely!”
Dragon ancestor said, “Fire is the source of life and knowledge. Kunpeng’s azure flame helped open her first mind, to speak and cultivate, to overcome the shackles of a spiritual beast as it grows stronger and stronger. My golden flames take it a step further, giving her the body of a sacred beast capable of transformation, what a true sacred beast can do.”
Zhuo Fan shook, “Does that mean all spiritual beasts can become sacred beasts?”
“Hardly, or the world would be in chaos. Ha-ha-ha, you best remember that the number of experts are limited.”
Dragon ancestor looked at Qiao’er, “Your daughter is special because she is like us at core, born from the strongest power of this world, with Berserk Purple Lightning taking hold within her. That’s why, our two flames that resonate with her body will help her develop her mind and spirituality. If it were a common spiritual beast, it could only take one flame. By using both of them though, it would lead to them clashing inside and exploding.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, recalling the Three-headed Crow at Kunpeng’s side, his aide, had received Kunpeng’s azure flame but would never become a sacred beast.
Because at core, its body did not have any of the five powers.
Zhuo Fan could not help but smile at dragon ancestor, “What about me? Don’t I have both of your flames?”
“A freak Nine Serenities Sovereign created? Beat it!” Dragon ancestor’s face twitched and grumbled.
Zhuo Fan’s weird constitution made him jealous actually. Who wouldn’t want a body that could hold four of sacred beast powers and fuse them into an unheard of power? Even he had to admit it.
Zhuo Fan smiled, looking smug.
Everything was connected, that was the core belief behind Demon Transformation Art. Everything could be transformed for the user’s use. It was truly obscene.
[Sacred beasts can’t train in human cultivation methods or he’d long have stolen it.]
Kunpeng especially, if he knew Demon Transformation Art was the way to combine sacred beast powers, he’d have acted on the spot.
Hum~
Zhuo Fan was startled awake and watched Qiao’er being covered by azure flames with the searing golden flames on top.
Azure flame and golden flame overlapped and combined, forming a savage tornado, lifting Qiao’er up in the air.
Zhuo Fan was baffled while dragon ancestor was calmer than ever.
Boom!
After the explosion, purple lightning burst forth, erasing the fire tornado.
What followed was a flood of lightning everywhere, surrounding an eight year old girl with long purple hair and a purple robe. She was the most adorable creature, with her pink cheeks, bright eyes and white teeth.
Zhuo Fan was startled. Dragon ancestor laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, the transformation is complete. With some training, this child will be the next Thunder Phoenix. Adding Qilin’s son as well, the five great sacred beasts will once more gather!”
“Uhm, Dragon Ancestor, is she my daughter?”
“Of course, father.”
Zhuo Fan blinked dumbstruck. The girl floated down, as the purple lightning crackled around. She bore a bright smile as she skipped over to Zhuo Fan and jumped into his arms, “Of course I’m your daughter. Can’t you recognize me?”
“Uhm, of course not.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyelid twitched, hugging the little girl. Seeing the familiar expression in her eyes, he was feeling overwhelmed, “If I could choose, a Thunder Skylark would be better.”
Qiao’er asked, “Why? Now that I took human form, I’m really your daughter.”
“Ha-ha-ha, you won’t understand.”
Zhuo Fan turned solemn, “With the way you are now, that means you’ve become a sacred beast, taking on Thunder Phoenix’s mantle. That means you’ll become a target for Heavenly Sovereign. Then… you might even die.”
Blinking her big eyes, Qiao’er was confused, “Who’s that? Father, if you didn’t want for me to transform, why let me?”
“I had no choice.”
Sighing, Zhuo Fan glanced at dragon ancestor, “It wasn’t my decision to make.”
Smiling, the dragon ancestor nodded, “Yes, I’d have it even if you refused. We need strength right now. Only with all five great sacred beasts will we have the greatest power. Alone, we’re no match for Heavenly Sovereign.”
Zhuo Fan knew this, but was still conflicted.
“Leave the second generation in my care for now. I’ll make sure to unearth all her potential!” Dragon ancestor continued, his tone was irreproachable.
Zhuo Fan nodded, but Qiao’er wouldn’t have it, hugging his neck and whining, “No, I want to go with father!”
“No matter how amazing this kid is, he’s just a human and has no idea of the true might of the glorious Thunder Phoenix.”
However, the dragon ancestor’s tone was firm, “Your mind might be sharp right now and can even understand Berserk Purple Lightning’s usage, but that’s too slow. By training with me, you’ll soon know all of Thunder Phoenix’s skills. You’ll go home with him later on, but now you must stay with me, to make sure you don’t stray.”
Zhuo Fan acknowledged this as well, “Yes, since you’re meant to enter this storm, the best way is for you to get stronger. I can’t teach you. Staying with Dragon Ancestor is better.”
Zhuo Fan placed Qiao’er down, then turned around without hesitation, “Dragon ancestor, open the door and let me out.”
“Sure!”
Dragon ancestor clawed and a tunnel formed to the beautiful world outside, “Kid, you’re a man of ambition, knowing what must be done and not hesitating.”
“Father!” Seeing him go, Qiao’er’s voice trembled, “I’ve never left your side since I was born!”
Zhuo Fan halted, struck by a pang of guilt, but he settled his heart, leaving without looking back.
He knew from the moment dragon ancestor saw Qiao’er, that he would want her to improve and make this simple Thunder Skylark enter the deadliest battle.
As her father, Zhuo Fan had to do the best he could to give her the highest chance at survival.
“Father~!”
As the door faded, Qiao’er cried out after him, with tears of abandonment flowing down her cheeks. But Zhuo Fan not once looked back till the end.
Pa!
When the door closed, Qiao’er’s cries were cut off and Zhuo Fan sighed. His eyes closed to regain his calm, then walked forward with purpose.
Heavenly Sovereign, the greatest threat was bearing down on him. No one could help him and he couldn’t help anyone either. All he could do was give his all to not get those he cared dragged down into this.
The rest of his life was bound to be filled with solitude. He could only rely, no, use, the five great sacred beasts, stuck with the same misfortune.
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan barely took a step and Ye Lin appeared, looking hesitant.
Zhuo Fan simply brushed his shoulder as he walked on with a cold look.
“Hold on!”
Ye Lin finally spoke.
Halting, Zhuo Fan asked, “What?”
“Uhm, master must’ve told you about everything.” Ye Lin scratched his head, “Our goal is the same. To help master, we’ll have to cooperate. As for the eight World Wind Tunnels, I’ve already placed the drawing array in this secret realm. The others will be harder, even the ones in western lands. We are, after all, disciples in the western lands…”
“Are you done? I’m leaving.” Zhuo Fan spoke coldly.
Ye Lin started, “Wait, master asked that we set the recoil array together…”
“I don’t need you.”
Zhuo Fan cut him off, “You just stay being a western lands disciple. I can do it on my own. Also, you saved my life and I’ll definitely repay you.”
Shaking all over, Ye Lin watched Zhuo Fan go. He set his jaw and shouted, “Brother!”
Startled, Zhuo Fan finally paused his step, looking at him oddly, “What did you call me?”
“Elder brother!”
Ye Lin hesitated with a lowered head, “Sacred beasts have rules, making the winner king. Since I lost to you, you’re the elder brother.”
Zhuo Fan turned around and resumed leaving, “That is a beast’s rule, we are men. Anyway, I’ll return the favor for what you did. There’s nothing else between us.”
“Elder brother, it doesn’t matter. Since I lost, I see you as king.”
Zhuo Fan never stopped walking.
“Also, senior brother sent a jade slip. Miss Chu is fine. They all think you’re dead. Double Dragon Manor is rushing me to come back and report. Elder brother, come with me, or would you like me to send her a message?”
Trembling, Zhuo Fan stopped again, then left faster, “No, just say… I’m dead.”

chapters.title: Chapter 802: Quanrong Capital
chapters.content:
Chapter 802: Quanrong Capital
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Come get your furs! The finest 4th level spiritual beast furs you can find…”
“Iron, black iron, anything you need to make the sharpest spiritual weapons…”
“Get your herbs right here! For miracle 3rd grade cures…”
…
The market was packed with peddlers shouting out their wares. They got swallowed in the tide of noisy people coming and going, haggling and bickering, always fighting for a profit.
Among this sea of people, one lone figure seem to drift through it, his black cloak fluttering in the wind.
When he looked up, his cold face contrasted with the bustling scene.
Looking around, he found people with long noses, big eyes, and foreign faces unlike anyone he saw in Tianyu. Zhuo Fan lowered his head again and milled through the crowd and out of here.
Down here, in the capital of Quanrong Empire, he was the foreigner.
Like a nimble cat, Zhuo Fan’s trace was gone without anyone taking notice.
Zhuo Fan took a deep breath and floated through the bustling street like a ghost.
Ever since he left Ultimate Clarity Sect, Zhuo Fan knew the danger he was in, fated to go in this world alone. But after giving it some thought, he still could not help but want to see them again. Elder Yuan, Luo clan, and …
[Ha-ha, nevermind Qingcheng…]
He feared he’d never leave if he saw her.
This was a kind of silent goodbye. He would be facing Heavenly Sovereign by himself.
It was so convenient there was a World Wind Tunnel from dragon ancestor’s sketch on his way. Since he was passing through, might as well leave a drawing array behind.
But the dragon ancestor’s map was a dubious sketch, a true amateur painter. He might as well know only the eight locations of the tunnels and that was pretty much it. At least he knew the rough location, with nothing to go on as to its exact spot.
“Best keep an ear out while I’m here.”
Zhuo Fan halted his steps with a grin. Next to him was a rowdy restaurant.
When it came to listening, this place was the best location.
[With World Wind Tunnel’s gathered spiritual energy, it’s bound to cause some strange occurrences that people can’t miss. A native is sure to know more.]
Zhuo Fan looked up as he walked up to it, finding that it was made up of eight three meter big rocks.
[Quanrong are so crude, even their culture shows it. From the gate to their homes, nothing here inspires grandeur.]
Taking the capital’s gate for instance, it was twice as tall as that of Tianyu, but not as polished. The capital of Tianyu was a work of art, filled with beauty and refinement. Every corner was thought out, every nook and cranny used.
While the Quanrong capital, only looked huge. Size was good, sure, but the rocks used in the buildings were uneven, as if made up at random.
Maybe this was how their culture, one based on power and disregarding the details. As they associated themselves with spiritual beasts every day of the week for years and years, their belief in power would only be strengthened. There was a low chance for any sage like the three in Tianyu to appear.
[But this is also why the Quanrong stand united while Tianyu is filled of bickering fools weakening the empire.]
This aspect alone would paint the barren Quanrong nation as stronger than Tianyu.
[Heaven really is amazing to create such wonderful discrepancies, weak yet strong, ha-ha-ha…]
Zhuo Fan smiled as he walked in.
The waiter spotted him and waved, “Will you be dinning or staying? We have a quiet room, but it’s a bit on the expensive side.”
“No need, I’ll stay in the hall.” Zhuo Fan shook his head and took a random seat at a table.
The waiter lowered his head and saw that the cloak hid Zhuo Fan’s features, “Guest, you’re a foreigner?”
“Yeah.”
“Then where do you…”
Zhuo Fan eyed him, “What, do I have to explain myself to stay here?”
“No, it’s just that there are hostilities recently and foreigners have to report…” The waiter was put on the spot.
Sighing, Zhuo Fan ignored him. He didn’t give much thought to a lower-three sect protecting some third-rate empire.
Ever since the dragon ancestor used the golden flame to remake his body, his cultivation reached the 8th layer of Radiant Stage. As for his power, it grew exponentially, not limited to the draconic form Ye Lin had, tough and filled with Decimating Golden Flame, but also wielding the Apocalyptic Thunderflame Eye.
That was why he had no qualms coming here. Just that he would much prefer it if he kept his nose down.
“I come from Tianyu, any problem?”
“You’re from Tianyu?”
The waiter shouted in shock and looked at him in hatred.
That got everyone to turn their heads over with some unfriendly looks.
“Why, you don’t like Tianyu?” Zhuo Fan eyed the people around.
Gnashing his teeth, the waiter was spat, “That’s the least of it. We’re mortal enemies. Eight years ago, Tianyu stole our richest lands, forcing us to leave our homes and live in poverty. Many of our soldiers died in the war with Tianyu, so you tell me if I could forget such hatred!”
“War is all about death. Either you die, or I die. This is normal. Moreover, it was you who invaded us first. The war was also within Tianyu. You’re the attackers, although you failed in the end.”
Scratching his nose, Zhuo Fan spoke, “You struck first yet failed. Now you blame us for fighting back?”
The waiter glared in hatred and cursed, “Humph, what do you know? This is all Tianyu’s twisted plan. They say we should help them settle their unrest, only to label us as invaders later and steal our land on top of it. All of you from Tianyu are nothing but snakes and greedy wastrels!”
The others nodded, looking at Zhuo Fan with red eyes.
“Oh, that does make sense.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “True, it was Tianyu’s emperor at the time that invited you to help. I didn’t think such a secret would reach the ears of a waiter. This must be the Quanrong emperor’s campaign to keep his seat. But that’s the truth and I have nothing to deny it. But this was settled by the leadership, with the common people of Tianyu wholly disagreeing. Now that emperor lost so of course he can’t honor his promise to you. On the contrary, the enemy you two joined to fight ended up taking the power and came to settle scores with you. Since they had no deal with you, their enemies, of course they used you.”
The waiter’s face twitched, then flicked his hand and barked, “Who cares? All we know is that anyone from Tianyu worked to cheat us!”
“No no no, Tianyu has many factions. If you side with one, the others are bound to become your enemies. Losing in the end means you bet on the wrong horse. This isn’t a matter of Tianyu people’s character. For them, you looked like the aids of their enemies who came to kill them.”
Zhuo Fan waved his hand, “The only one to blame is your emperor and his faulty reasoning, involving himself in an another empire’s matter before understanding its workings. Also, with feeble soldiers, it’s best to stay home and defend it, then invade and incite things.”
“Shut your pie hole!”
The waiter had had enough, shaking from anger, “Our emperor is the best in the world. After we lost our lands, he still made sure to settle us in the capital. Our commander is the best in the world, kind to his men and undefeated…”
Zhuo Fan mocked with a raised eyebrow, “The best emperor? Ha-ha-ha, he lost your land and you call him that after giving you some crumbs? Isn’t that his duty to begin with? If he didn’t even do that, he’d be failing as an emperor.
“The best commander? Tuoba Tieshan ain’t a bad old coot, but undefeated is a bit of a stretch at this point. At least in Tianyu, he lost all the way. How else would you end up without a home?”
“Why you little…”
Zhuo Fan’s sharp mockery cut deep. The waiter and the others around were fuming mad. In the end the waiter roared, “You dare slander our emperor and commander? You won’t leave this place alive, man of Tianyu! We’ll kill you!”
Everyone stood up and unleashed their bloodlust on Zhuo Fan as they came charging.
Zhuo Fan had nothing better to do than yawn, “A few Profound Heaven experts among a bunch of Bone Tempering cultivators. What can nobodies like you do against a Radiant Stage expert in the 8th layer?”
[Wait, Radiant Stage?!]
Eyes wide, they all looked dumstruck.
[We were too impulsive and got caught up in the flow…]

chapters.title: Chapter 803: Asking Around
chapters.content:
Chapter 803: Asking Around
Proofreader
: Papatonks
The silence was deafening.
Everyone here looked at each other then at Zhuo Fan with a dumb look, though neither budged an inch.
The waiter was sweating now, shaking like a leaf next to Zhuo Fan and on the verge of tears.
[What’s wrong with me? The least I could do was check his level before I let anger take me.]
Only now he saw that his Bone Tempering cultivation wasn’t enough to see through him. This was an obvious sign the other’s level was way higher.
The people in the restaurant sized Zhuo Fan up, then lamented their fates.
[We can’t tell anything! We can’t even touch him as we are.]
They all stood stiff in the same spot, while Zhuo Fan snickered, “What’s the hold up? Didn’t you want to kill me?”
“No no no…”
Everyone shook their heads. Passersbys like them would never reach his level. They’d just be mowed down if they attacked now.
Zhuo Fan shook his head. “I was wondering why the Quanrong Emperor would be so impulsive as to step into Tianyu’s unrest. Now I see Quanrong are all brawn, attacking before even looking. It might sound like bravery, even heroism, but it’s just a fancy way of calling someone an idiot. Before you start attacking, you should start flexing that thing you have for a head. Well, I guess you lost those hundreds of miles fair and square, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan’s mockery made everyone’s faces turn red.
Zhuo Fan started off with defending himself but now he was openly disregarding their emperor and their entire people.
It made the Quanrong so angry and filled with hatred.
Though not enough to attack, not when Zhuo Fan had the biggest fist around.
Seeing them all so tense, Zhuo Fan smiled, though no longer toyed with them, since he had no intention of quarreling with the common folk.
“Since you guys won’t do nothing, I’ll…”
“Attack?” The waiter shouted, scared to death. A Radiant Stage cultivator could kill them with a thought. They’d be slaughtered.
The others panicked and fell to their knees, begging for their lives.
Rolling his eyes, Zhuo Fan huffed, “Who’d kill you? You’re not even worth it. I was gonna say that since you won’t start anything, I’ll ask some questions and then you can just scram.”
[Oh, just questions. Who the hell jumped the gun and said he’ll attack?]
They relaxed at once, but then, they recalled their panic and shameful act, looking for the instigator.
[Shit, that scared me to death!]
All eyes glared at the waiter. He lowered his head with resentment.
[Can you blame me? How would I know this guy is against the norms? Shouldn’t it be if we don’t attack, he will?]
Ignoring their reproaching looks, Zhuo Fan said, “Waiter, I’ll ask you first. What were those fights you were talking about? With who?”
“Eh, you don’t know?” The waiter was stunned.
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes and cursed, “Why else am I asking you?”
“Yeah, senior asked you a question and you’re quibbling?”
“Hurry up and answer before senior gets impatient.”
“Waiter, cut the crap and answer!”
…
Everyone in the restaurant began to curse at him and make him feel glum.
[Damn these fools, switching sides at the drop of a hat. They were patriots a second ago alongside me, now they’re this Tianyu guy’s loyal dogs!]
[Since you can’t mess with a Radiant Stage cultivator, you take it out on a waiter?]
Zhuo Fan frowned and glared at them to quiet down.
The waiter bowed, “Sir, we’re at war with Tianyu. Since you’re from Tianyu, I thought you knew…”
“They’re fighting again? Why? For how long?”
“Around a month, the rumor is His Majesty received the full support from the guardian sect, vowing to get our land back.” The waiter sighed, “And His Majesty wanted to make up for his mistake eight years ago, so there’s been a martial law in place at the borders, to prevent any Tianyu spies from coming in. That’s why when sir…”
The patriotic waiter forgot who he was talking to, forgetting he was giving a strong guy from Tianyu a report.
So he sewed his mouth shut. Something had to be wrong with his head, to talk when he was aware of the situation.
[He may be…]
“Don’t worry, I’m no spy.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Have you ever seen a spy exposing himself like me? Besides, it’s common knowledge what you told me so far. I’ve been away from Tianyu for so many years and want to return. I couldn’t know these things.”
The waiter sighed, relieved.
[I haven’t sold my country.]
Zhuo Fan pondered carefully, “There’s a serious problem here. I saw the Luo clan’s power and Quanrong didn’t have the strength to invade Tianyu. Also, Beast Taming Sect is offering full support? Humph, it is only one sect while the other has three helping it. Unless something fishy is going on here. Did the higher powers reach some debased deal?”
“What are you talking about, sir?” The waiter asked puzzled.
Zhuo Fan waved his hand, “Nothing, it doesn’t involve you anyway. Quanrong won’t win in any case. There’s still something I want to know. Ha-ha-ha, do you guys have some wonderful scenery around, of immense beauty?”
“Scenery?”
The waiter was stumped, the people puzzled. He shook his head, “Sir, Quanrong isn’t like Tianyu, with rich lands and great sceneries. We’re barren, so where can there be such a place here? If you want to enjoy some places, you’re better off going to Tianyu. They have far better sceneries.”
“Then what about harsh mountains? Which is the most treacherous area, the place where livestock vanishes the most?” Zhuo Fan squinted.
Where the wind tunnel gathered spiritual energy, it did not mean paradise would always form. It might not be unlike the local areas, making it truly a danger zone.
The waiter was still looking lost, “Sir, where have you heard this? We’re barren, but not in hell, with a poisoned land. Wouldn’t we have died off by now?”
Frowning, Zhuo Fan pondered.
[Were the ol’ dragon’s senses out of whack when he made the sketch? There’s no sign of the wind tunnel here.]
That would mean all the other spots were wrong as well.
[How am I supposed to find eight wind tunnels on these huge lands? ]
Zhuo Fan was worried.
The waiter and the rest did not make a peep, afraid he would kill them.
Everyone waited there for his words.
“Where’s the owner?”
In this tense mood, heads turned as loud footsteps were heard coming into the locale. Two built men in lavish clothes walked forward, their strong physique clearly making them out to be at peak Profound Heaven Stage.
“The sixth prince has booked this place. All of you are to leave!”
The two tough guys stuck out their chests, looking smug and cocky. Though they did not see the panic that unusually followed. In fact, the people were making shushing gestures in a rush.
“What’s going on here? Are you all deaf? The sixth prince booked this place. Get out now!”
The two barked once more and the people looked at the two tough men, trying to hint at them.
[See him? He can’t be offended so keep it down. Don’t disturb him or we’ll all get it.]
However, the two muscles did not get to shout again as Zhuo Fan’s cold tone echoed, “Who are the crazed dogs barking in my ear?”

chapters.title: Chapter 804: Number One Fan
chapters.content:
Chapter 804: Number One Fan
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“How dare you!”
The two got so used to having their way, they began shouting at Zhuo Fan’s complaint. “Who are you to disturb the sixth prince…”
Boom!
Their tirade was cut short by an explosion. They exploded in a mist of blood while Zhuo Fan lowered his punch, lamenting.
[Where am I supposed to go from here? The sketch is a bust…]
The people in the restaurant paled, with some even slumping on the floor.
[Just one punch from an 8th layer Radiant Stage expert and two peak Profound Heaven cultivators were dead without even a corpse left behind. They died before even knowing what was coming.]
[This guy is brutal, not holding back at all. Those two were the prince’s men…]
The fear in everyone only grew as they looked at Zhuo Fan, shivering in their spots.
“Hua Laer, Hua Lasha, are you done? The prince is about to arrive.”
An aged voice sounded from a man with a white beard. Seeing the blood around, he shouted, “What’s with all this blood? Haven’t I told you brats not to kill? How can you feast when there’s blood around? Cleaning it up is such a pain too…”
The people glanced at the old guy but remained silent.
[He must think the blood comes from us. If only he knew they were his own two men…]
The old man walked inside as he shouted, “Hua Laer, Hua Lasha, get out here right no-, ugh…”
The old man bore a weird look, “Why are there so many people around? Sixth prince is about to arrive!”
The others gave him a pitiful look, then waited for Zhuo Fan to make his move.
[What’s a prince against an 8th layer Radiant Stage cultivator?]
[If we take a single step without his permission, we might just end up like those two.]
Zhuo Fan was frowning and pondering what to do. The sketch lost its value and he was now stuck. He was so distracted, he did not notice the eerie mood in the restaurant.
“Uhm, sir…”
The old man wasn’t as impulsive as the late two. Noticing where all eyes were looking, he grew stiff as he sized Zhuo Fan up.
[Oh crap, an 8th layer Radiant Stage expert.]
He was only in the 4th layer and the prince’s household had no such expert either. That was the reason behind his bow and address.
Zhuo Fan was still vexed with his problem to pay him any mind. The old man turned to the waiter, “Who is this sir?”
The waiter shook his head.
The old man looked around and got the same answer from the rest.
Sighing, the old man asked, “Where are the two tough men that came in?”
“You’re stepping on them.” The waiter pointed at the blood.
The old man shook and looked at all the red on the floor, then at the stumped Zhuo Fan in realization.
[The two’s brash attitudes must’ve irked this man and they ended up like this.]
This was bad. Messing with such a strong expert was anything but good.
[I have to settle it now. But he shows complete disregard to me, who is four layers beneath him.]
[Since there’s nothing I can do, I’ll get help!]
The old man tiptoed two steps back, then ran like hell.
The people were stunned.
[And you call yourself a man in sixth prince’s service? Mere thugs that scare the weak ones and flee from anyone strong.]
