Only Zhuo Fan was still lost in his thoughts, not registering this event…
Whoosh~
Four powerful energies came into the restaurant moments later and forced the guests to falter back.
Four elders enter, with one of them being the same guy from before. But the leader was a blond man with sharp eyes and far stronger.
The people in the restaurant knew then and there that this guy was a true expert.
Many who met his eyes felt dizzy and in shock.
[With these four so powerful, are they planning to take on the Tianyu expert? That will mean a brutal battle!]
[Won’t that end with us as collateral?]
The people were restless now, praying to anyone out there not to get dragged into this mess.
It was beyond their expectations when they saw the blond elder bowing before Zhuo Fan, “I am High Venerable Jin Buhuan of the sixth prince from Quanrong Empire. I ask that you overlook the rude attitude of my men.”
“Get lost!”
Seeing as the strongest, Jin Buhuan, was only one layer lower than him, Zhuo Fan couldn’t care less.
Stunned, Jin Buhuan felt awkward, then his mood sank. He might be slightly weaker, but to get no respect at all?
He had more men as well. If a fight broke out, it might even go in their favor.
The white bearded old man knew this and shouted, “Sir, we respect you as fellow Radiant Stage cultivators and don’t wish to fight. We are even willing to overlook killing our men, but even with your 8th layer Radiant Stage cultivation, among the best in Quanrong, it still won’t be enough against numbers. Getting on the imperial family’s bad side is ill advised. I urge you to rethink and let’s work this out as friends.”
Jin Buhuan smiled and nodded at his appraoch.
[Neither humble nor confrontational, with words said with respect and reason. That should do it.]
Too bad they weren’t dealing with your average Radiant Stage expert. Even a rotten bastard would listen, but not Zhuo Fan, who was loftier than the loftiest freak…
“All bark and no bite.”
Zhuo Fan mocked, “You old coots yap for so long because your teeth must be dulled, ha-ha-ha…”
Jin Buhuan’s face twitched and grew red. He clenched his fists in rage.
[Damn punk, we’re clearly being nice and you spit on our faces?]
Zhuo Fan smirked at them.
He was annoyed the sketch was a bust and needed a good punching bag to feel better. It just so happened a few poor devils came right at his door.
Jin Buhuan glared, “Sir, I don’t care who or how strong you are, but you’re over the line. I will not take this lying down!”
Jin Buhuan exploded with power and bloodthirst as he charged at Zhuo Fan. The other three elders were right behind him.
The oppressive power shook the entire restaurant.
The people were pushed back under such pressure, while Zhuo Fan just smiled.
He was looking at four clowns doing their act.
Zhuo Fan mocking gaze enraged Jin Buhuan. He shouted and was about to strike. “Stop!”
Ugh!
Halting all of a sudden, Jin Buhuan looked back and bowed.
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow and saw a fashionable youth walking over.
[He must be their lord, that sixth prince.]
Ignoring the elders, the prince looked at Zhuo Fan in shock. His steps were shaky, his lips trembling, “You’re…”
“Yes, I’m the one that killed your two dogs. Now four more dogs came to bite me, so you should be coming in only after this is done. There’s no need for any blustering either, being more than familiar with this play. Wait till I kill them. If you still want to die, I don’t mind sending you off as well.”
Zhuo Fan waved him off like he was a beggar.
The elders were furious and wanted to rip Zhuo Fan to pieces.
But the youth was dancing in joy, “Y-you’re Zhuo Fan! How are you still alive? I’m your biggest fan!”
“Uhm, huh?” Zhuo Fan was perplexed, to say the least…

chapters.title: Chapter 805: Sixth Prince
chapters.content:
Chapter 805: Sixth Prince
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Giving the youth a long look, Zhuo Fan grumbled and scratched his head, “Have we met? Why can’t I remember?”
“Zhuo-, uhm, Sir Zhuo, you never met me, but I have!”
Shaking from excitement, the youth came next to Zhuo Fan and looked at him with stars in his eyes.
Zhuo Fan was put off, “And who are you supposed to be? When did you see me?”
“At the Double Dragon Gathering, Sir Zhuo!”
Recalling those glorious fights, the youth trembled, his voice shaky, “I was Quanrong Empire’s representative and witnessed sir’s punch erasing all of Beast Taming Sect’s team and your rise to fame. From a lower-three sect disciple, to the best disciple in western lands. I was moved to tears!”
Startled, Zhuo Fan finally reacted.
[So the kid saw me fight. No wonder I never noticed him.]
With so many people around, it would’ve been strange if he had.
Though he finds this guy’s choice of words peculiar, “Kid, you’re the sixth prince of Quanrong Empire?”
“Yep!” The prince was so excited just by the fact Zhuo Fan talked to him, like it was his honor or something.
“That would make Beast Taming Sect your guardian sect, so why would you be so thrilled to see me pulverizing them?”
Zhuo Fan was quite curious while the prince wrote it off, “Them? They’re nothing more than our puppet masters. Their heinous disciples got used to doing anything they wanted, with no one standing up to them. That’s why they looked like that at Double Dragon Gathering. They have nothing to do with us. In fact, Sir Zhuo’s punch truly helped us vent.”
“Oh, no problem, though you shouldn’t call them heinous, since those guys behind you aren’t any better.” Zhuo Fan nodded.
The prince chuckled, totally accepting the blame, “Sir Zhuo’s lesson is true. I have indeed neglected my men’s conduct.”
“What does it have to do with me if you care or not?” Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes.
The sixth prince did not mind at all, taking all his words at face value, “Yep, yep, Sir Zhuo is a man of ambition, so why would you care about little old me’s faults. But since sir mentioned it, I’ll be sure to rectify it.”
The sixth prince turned around and spoke harshly at the four elders, “Venerable Jin, tell everyone they are forbidden from using their power on the people, or their heads will roll. How can we be seen the same way as those rotten bastards from Beast Taming Sect? How will Sir Zhuo see us then?”
“Yes, sir!”
Jin Buhuan bowed and then sighed at Zhuo Fan.
To be honest, sixth prince was a whimsical guy who was only out to have fun, ignoring everything else. Quanrong Emperor tried teaching some sense to him, but he just wouldn’t listen.
Yet now, a short word from Zhuo Fan got him on the straight and narrow.
[This is the power of an idol!]
Zhuo Fan felt helpless too.
[What’s it got to do with me?]
“Sir Zhuo, I’ve been hearing rumors that you’ve been killed. I’ve been offering bitter prayers in tears for your safe passing. You can ask them if you don’t believe me.”
“True…”
Sixth prince looked excitedly at Zhuo Fan then turned to his elders to echo him. They nodded their heads and attested to his conduct.
[Our prince is your biggest fan!]
“Though what is sir doing here all of a sudden? Are the rumors fake?” Sixth prince asked.
Grinning, Zhuo Fan mocked as his eyes took on a savage glint, “They’ll have another thing coming if they think I’ll just drop dead!”
“Cool!”
Sixth prince squealed in adoration at Zhuo Fan’s inadvertent posing. Then he turned to his elders, “See that? This is Sir Zhuo, the best in Double Dragon Gathering and my idol. Isn’t he awesome?”
Ugh!
The four bobbed their heads with a bright smile, “Yes, cool, very cool…”
Though the four’s hearts weren’t that much into it. As the kid’s men, they had to cater to his whims and lower themselves by idolizing his idol.
Even Zhuo Fan was of the same opinion, feeling put off by this crazed fan. Though he was about to pick a fight despite the other backing down, the sixth prince’s adoration deflated his anger.
How could he when the kid was worshipping the ground he walked on?
[I better get out of here fast.]
Sixth prince saw him go and rushed to block him, “Sir Zhuo, where are you going? You’re finally in Quanrong, so how can you go without me being your host?”
“Uhm, that’s fine. I couldn’t find anything here I need so I’ll be going.”
Zhuo Fan chuckled and walked on.
Sixth prince sparkling eyes rolled about in thought then he said, “Sir Zhuo, what are you looking for? I know this place the best, so let me help!”
“You?”
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, sizing him up.
[Of course, the World Wind Tunnel, with how weird it is, has a high chance of being taken by some really rich and powerful people. How can a nobody know about it?]
[This kid is the sixth prince of Quanrong, of illustrious pedigree, and can hear many interesting tidbits.]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes lit up, “Great, then tell me, are there any spectacular places around here, or any harsh and deadly ones?”
“Spectacular?”
The prince paused, then clapped, “Have you come to enjoy our wonderful lands?”
“Uhm, in a way.” Zhuo Fan strained to agree. “Are there any particular landscapes about?”
Sixth prince beamed, “You came to the right man. We have barren lands, but don’t lack in some good views either. My new mansion just got built around a wonder like no other. You might even say it’s heaven on earth. I dare say, you’ll never see anything like it in the whole five lands! “
“Really?” Zhuo Fan grinned.
Sixth prince nodded in pride, “Of course, the mighty are bound to steal it from me if they knew of it. Imperial father saw it and wanted to build a summer palace, but I fought him against it and took it from him. That marvel is mine and mine alone. Imperial father will have to ask me if he wants a peek, ha-ha-ha. Sir Zhuo, now that you’re here, I’ll hold a feast at once. Let us enjoy the beauty together, with wine in hand!”
“That’s such a waste. Let’s just go right now!” Zhuo Fan was overjoyed and couldn’t wait to get there. Such a godsend, coming right when he was at his lowest.
Sixth prince nodded, leading the way with a bright smile. It was his pride and joy to do anything for Zhuo Fan.
Jin Buhuan came before the sixth prince before they could go, “Prince, please wait. You had a fight with Elder She over a girl and His Majesty asked you to make amends. I get that you did not want to receive him at your home, so you came here instead. But if you leave, won’t you stand Elder She up? We can’t have him blow up in anger.”
“Why do I have to apologize to that snake? Humph, not happening!”
Sixth prince was stubborn, “I saw that girl first and that snake came to take her. He even killed all my men. Now imperial father wants me to apologize? Whatever for? A has-been elder of Beast Taming Sect is nothing. All he knows is to come to Quanrong imperial capital and be vile. Humph, the only reason I set a feast is because you cowards made me.”
Seeing the prince’s attitude, Jin Buhuan shook his head, “Prince, it’s just some jealousy over a girl. And those guards weren’t much worth either. And Elder She is an Ethereal Stage expert that not even His Majesty can mess with. If not for Beast Taming Sect holding him back, he’d be killing us as well. You have to apologize and settle his anger. You also said they lost power in the Beast Taming Sect and it’s nothing big yet. So let’s make it stay like that…”
“No and no!”
Sixth prince pointed at Zhuo Fan in his temper, “Sir Zhuo fears nothing, winning Double Dragon Gathering by himself. I will follow his example and won’t fear that snake! Sir Zhuo, let’s go to the mansion for a drink. Let these old fools attend to that damn snake.”
Zhuo Fan watched the situation go out of hand and did not mind urging the prince to leave. He did not care about offending some Ethereal Stage expert that one day might come to take the prince’s life.
Jin Buhuan saw through his intention and bowed, “Sir Zhuo, sixth prince has always worshipped you. The news of your death had made him cry for three days. All of it is true. Have mercy and don’t push master into the fire. Convince him to make amends with Elder She. As for the marvel, you’ll be seeing it shortly after. Or I would be taking sir while master attends to the guest.”

chapters.title: Chapter 806: Fuming Elder She
chapters.content:
Chapter 806: Fuming Elder She
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Zhuo Fan pondered and nodded.
[All in all, the kid is my fan. While I have no intention of getting dragged into his problem, that doesn’t mean I should make his situation worse. The old man has a good idea. Let the master deal with him and someone else will just take me there.]
Since he was after the World Wind Tunnel, what difference did it make on who took him there?
While he might agree, the prince was totally against it, “Not happening. Sir Zhuo is my honored guest. I have to do my utmost in fulfilling all of Sir Zhuo’s requests. As for that damn snake, let him rot for all I care.”
Sixth prince stormed out in anger. Zhuo Fan shrugged and followed.
But just then, Jin Buhuan rushed next to him and spoke, “Sir Zhuo, I’ve long since heard of the prince praising you, but he’s also known to boast a lot, especially about the people he likes, to no end. That’s why I do not believe anything he said about you. You heard it yourself, an Ethereal Stage expert. If angered, he’d go to His Majesty and it would not end with his son taking the fall, but you becoming the scapegoat.”
“For the sixth prince and for your safety, I urge you to convince him to placate Elder She and not let his temper flare out.”
“True, a crazed fan like the sixth prince sure has it in him to do that.”
Zhuo Fan grinned, “Only this one time, your master hasn’t been boasting. A mere Ethereal Stage expert is nothing to me. If the prince truly helps me in finding what I seek, I don’t see why I can’t help you all skin this snake to spare you the trouble, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan walked out after the sixth prince, leaving Jin Buhuan dumbstruck.
“Is he nuts? An 8th layer Radiant Stage cultivator wants to fight an Ethereal Stage expert? No wonder the sixth prince became so obnoxious of late. What good is copying an idol like this…”
Closing his eyes, Jin Buhuan felt pain in his heart.
“Elder Jin, the sixth prince is gone. What do we do when Elder She comes?” The white elder asked tensely.
Shaking his head, Elder Jin sighed, “Master is too stubborn and we can only help him. I just hope Elder She will accept it. He shouldn’t want to blow things out of proportion either, making His Majesty send for Beast Taming Sect to take him away.”
Elder Jin turned towards the dumbstruck crowd in the restaurant, “What are you standing around for? Didn’t you hear our shout? We booked this place! Now scram!”
[Uhm, right…]
They all bobbed their heads and ran like the wind, finally getting their pardon.
They were about to lose their lives under Zhuo Fan’s demonic threat, shaking like leaves in fear. Now that they could leave, they were overjoyed they escaped with their lives.
Furthermore, the people vowed never to set foot in this accursed restaurant again.
The head of the restaurant would’ve cried if he knew his business had collapsed…
“Clean this place up and prepare the finest meals and drinks. We’re holding a feast!”
Jin Buhuan eyed the messed up place and shouted. The head of the place and the waiter went to work.
In just fifteen minutes, the restaurant looked brand new. Slow steps were heard and a youth with sharp eyes approached the locale.
Looking it over, his mood sank, “When you fall, all want to kick you. I might have made a mistake that one time and the sect threw me out, but I’m still an Ethereal Stage expert dammit! The emperor should be welcoming me! Yet now, a stinking brat is treating me in this wretched shack? Humph, where’s the apology in that?”
“Elder She, we’ve been waiting for you!”
Jin Buhuan shouted as he led his three men outside the restaurant to bow in welcome.
Elder She eyed him coldly, “What’s this supposed to mean? Where’s your lord? That brat isn’t welcoming me?”
“Uhm, well, please don’t be upset, Elder She.”
Wiping his sweaty brow, Jin Buhuan hurriedly apologized, “Prince was feeling unwell and could not come, so he had us…”
“Enough!”
Boom!
Elder She flicked his sleeve and a powerful gale swept the four. They left a trail of blood as they flew.
Elder She gnashed his teeth, “You four better get this straight, the only reason I tolerated some punk’s affront and agreed to this apology feast, is all because of Quanrong Emperor. But since he doesn’t care, he forced my hand!”
Whoosh~
Elder She shot straight into the air.
Jin Buhuan’s group cried out, “He’s going for the sixth prince’s mansion! The prince’s in danger!”
“Venerable Jin, lighten up. Isn’t the prince taking Zhuo Fan to his other mansion? He’s not home right now.”
“Yeah, and besides, we still got time to report. We can’t delay or the prince might die!” Jin Buhuan bobbed his head, straightened his wounded body and flew away, with blood dripping from him.
The other three bore through the pain and followed closely…
Meanwhile, Zhuo Fan and the sixth prince arrived at a remote mountain, at a place among a forest where a mansion was perfectly blended with the surroundings. Its guards were Profound Heaven experts.
The prince bowed to Zhuo Fan before the door and smiled, “Sir Zhuo, after you!”
Zhuo Fan nodded and strolled right in. Sixth prince skipped after him like a good servant, and was happy for it.
The guards were dumbstruck. The rash, impulsive, outrageous sixth prince of theirs knew how to be polite?
Even when seeing the emperor, this kid would never show any respect. Being the youngest, His Majesty doted on him, which made him grow up without any restraints. The fact that he gave up and let his son have this spot for his mansion showed just how much he cared.
But now…
“Hey, who’s he? Why’s the prince acting like that?”
“Don’t know. Maybe the father-in-law or brother-in-law? Why else would he be more respectful than when seeing his father?”
“Oh, so the prince finally met his other half. It’s good that he stopped visiting brothels, ha-ha-ha…”
…
The guards whispered while the sixth prince led Zhuo Fan to a large building.
Zhuo Fan shot the prince a puzzled look.
Grinning, the prince pointed at it, “Sir Zhuo, the magnificence of the land can only be enjoyed in the truest sense from atop this building.”
“Oh, really?”
Zhuo Fan frowned, though not bothered that much. Since the wind tunnel couldn’t be just seen, might as well just play the guest.
And so, the prince took Zhuo Fan eighteen stories high, to an elegant room.
The prince then walked to the window and opened it, letting in the fresh breeze of humid mountain air.
Beyond the window was a three hundred meter waterfall. Its immense drop felt like it was descending from the heavens above.
Zhuo Fan was stunned, turning his stiff face around, “Sixth prince, is this the view you were talking about?”
“Yes, isn’t it marvelous?”
The prince spoke with pride, “Sir Zhuo, you know as well how poor the land in Quanrong is. Such a waterfall is a rarity. That’s why I had an array placed to hide it and only enjoyed from this place. Even imperial father can only come once a month to appreciate this wonder while I can come every day, ha-ha-ha. Sir Zhuo, this view…”
“Is great my ass!”
Zhuo Fan snapped as he rained curses, “The waterfall is nice and that’s it. There’s plenty more like it in Tianyu. You think I wasted my time coming here for this thing? I wanted a place with strange occurrences, out of this world even. Something like getting in but can’t get out, or a spot where meditating a day equals ten years…”
The sixth prince looked like a hurt puppy with his lowered head, “But, didn’t you say you came to see Quanrong’s scenery? This is the best we could find…”
“It’s fine, I was wrong here for not being clear. It seems Quanrong doesn’t have what I seek. I’m leaving.” Zhuo Fan sighed and turned away.
The sixth prince rushed to stop him, “Wait, Sir Zhuo! You’re leaving so soon? At least stay for a few days!”
“No thanks. It seems the sketch is useless. I’ll go look someplace else…”
“Hold on!”
The prince cried, “Uhm, you said you wanted to see strange places. Well big brother has such a place. I’ll take you there!”
“Your brother?”
“Yes, my elder brother, Quanrong’s crown prince!” Sixth prince nodded, his eyes shining with hope…

chapters.title: Chapter 807: Suicidal
chapters.content:
Chapter 807: Suicidal
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Zhuo Fan nodded after a pause, “All right, let’s go to your brother.”
Sixth prince perked up, skipping over to Zhuo Fan and about to lead him like an overexcited child.
Zhuo Fan chuckled.
[He really is my greatest fan. Is he that happy to be around me?]
“Sixth prince, run! Elder She’s coming!”
A shout came from the window and the two saw Jin Buhuan’s group covered in blood and collapsing from their flight, spitting blood again.
Sixth prince helped them up, “What happened, Venerable Jin? Why are you all like this?”
“Cough, run, prince! Elder She went on a killing spree to your mansion. We used this chance to warn you!”
“You have to get to the imperial palace! With His Majesty around, maybe his anger can be subdued.”
“That bastard did this to you?”
His brow shaking, sixth prince hissed, “Absurd! Even for a Beast Taming Sect elder, this is too much. Those three have been thrown out of the sect for their mistakes and now they’re taking it out on the common folk!”
“Beast Taming Sect did cast them out but they’re still its elders, they still have power. The sect will cover for them as long as nothing serious happens.”
Jin Buhuan shook his head and sighed. “Ignoring the fact they were thrown out, they’re still in the Ethereal Stage, who in the empire would fight them? Prince, we all admire your principles, but I’ll have to step out of line here. You’re too naive. There are some things, some men, that you can’t mess with!”
Sixth prince’s brow quivered as he cursed, “Those damn geezers, making the entire imperial capital restless and now they even have the nerve to come after me! Won’t that mean they have no restraint against anyone else? How can we rule the Quanrong Empire in this state? No, I have to plead that imperial father to remove those three bastards!”
“It’s no use. Of course His Majesty would want that as well, but no one is strong enough!” Jin Buhuan was filled with pain.
“Those three geezers got kicked out of Beast Taming Sect and now are running amok!”
Sixth prince shook in anger, but then he suddenly went still and peeked at Zhuo Fan. In the end, he spoke his mind, “Sir Zhuo, what do you think I should do?”
“If I weren’t here, your best bet would be hiding in the imperial palace. And you old coots, you were better off sending someone to give us a message while going to imperial palace to seek help instead.”
Jin Buhuan jerked and facepalmed in regret, “Why didn’t I think of that? Right, I should’ve sent someone to report to His Majesty…”
“What am I to do since you’re here then?” Ignoring Zhuo Fan’s proposal, sixth prince wanted to know his stance, whether he’d help.
Zhuo Fan spoke calmly, “Nothing at all. As long…”
“What?” Sixth prince asked in hope.
With an evil grin, Zhuo Fan replied, “As long as you take me to the strange place of crown prince, you can then do like I suggested, hide in the imperial palace.”
Ugh!
The prince’s face twitched. He knew Zhuo Fan’s power yet the man refused him in the end.
“Humph, sixth prince’s life is at an end and you still want to go to crown prince?” Jin Buhuan growled, “Sixth prince treated you like a guest and this ridiculous idea is your reply? I knew you wouldn’t want to get involved as you’re not in the Ethereal Stage, but at least your plan is sound.”
Zhuo Fan admitted, “Then you go hide in the imperial palace while I go see crown prince alone. The great crown prince’s manor should be an easy find.”
Zhuo Fan shot to the skies.
“Wait, Sir Zhuo! Let me take you!” Sixth prince rushed after him.
Jin Buhuan shook his head and followed as well, about to blow a gasket, “Prince, let him go. Your safety’s more important!”
“I can’t let death scare me from living. The great Sir Zhuo I admire is now here, so how can I not go hang out with him?” The prince glared and rushed on, “Sir Zhuo, wait for me…”
They quickly left the building and went away.
Whoosh!
Just then, a savage cackle resounded, “Ha-ha-ha, brat, so this is where you are! You offended me and against my better judgment, I decided to hear your father out in letting you apologize. But you actually stood me up! Humph, now even if the emperor pleaded for you, it still won’t save you!”
“Damn, Elder She caught up. Why so soon?” Jin Buhuan rushed to protect the prince.
The Ethereal Stage expert floated down, looking at the four elders with a twisted smile, “Mere Radiant Stage cultivators. Don’t you know the fear of Ethereal Stage experts? Sixth prince, today is the day you, ugh…”
Elder She looked at the prince’s grave face but then he paused. His face twisted like he saw his worse enemy, “You!”
Elder She stared at Zhuo Fan next to the prince. Zhuo Fan paused, looking around, but didn’t see anyone.
“Stop faking! I’m talking to you!”
Elder She clenched his dists, his bloodshot eyes squinting at Zhuo Fan as his rage exploded, “Eight years have gone and now I finally get to meet you again!”
Scratching his head, Zhuo Fan asked, stumped, “We… know each other?”
“Know? Ha-ha-ha, not just that. If it weren’t for you, bastard, I would have never been thrown out of the sect and lived miserably like this.”
Howling in sadness, Elder She’s eyes reflected only hatred, “I had nightmares more nights than I could count about that white hair and those eyes. I swore to never forget the pain you brought me!”
Zhuo Fan was perplexed, “What’s your beef with me? Why can’t I remember you? Who’re you supposed to be anyway?”
“Ha-ha-ha, you’re so forgetful I see, though it’s natural since I’ve changed my looks.”
Snickering, Elder She said, “Brat, you still remember the war eight years ago in Tianyu. You ruined my body! Eight years, I bore that shame with me for eight damn years. With my body ruined, even getting a new one, my cultivation had stagnated. When I could have managed to reach the 5th layer of Ethereal Stage but now the 2nd layer is all this body can allow. But this wasn’t the reason for Sect Leader’s banishment. It’s all due to losing that war and letting the Demon Scheming Sect grab hold of proof of our involvement then the other two sects forced our sect to pay up in spirit stones, making us the criminal.”
“Henceforth, my path was ruined, abandoned by the sect as well. All of this is your fault! You ruined my life! Brat, now that we met, I’ll end you and sixth prince, getting rid of all the rancour!”
Ignoring the cawing, Zhuo Fan squinted in thought then exclaimed, “Oh! So that obscene snake shed his skin. Almost didn’t recognize you there.”
“He-he-he, Sir Zhuo, it’s seems you’re involved now. You can’t stand aside as it is.” Sixth prince was overjoyed.
The four elders were startled.
[What use would he have if he joins? We’re all in the Radiant Stage anyway, unable to face an Ethereal Stage expert.]
Only the prince had complete confidence in Zhuo Fan.
Scratching his nose, Zhuo Fan nodded, “Yeah, I can’t go around going easy on my enemies, now can I? Since…”
“I already suffered for it once!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed with coldness and bloodthirst.
Elder She shook for some reason, feeling like a beast had its eyes on him and sending a deep-seated fear in his bones.
But then he shook his head to shake it off.
[There’s no way! He’s just a Radiant Stage punk. How can he threaten me…]
Boom!
Before he could make sense of it all, an explosion resounded. A force like no other shot through Elder She, the large building behind him and then stopped in the large waterfall where it went off.
A tornado of dust engulfed the sky, mixing with the water turned into mist, roaring as it grew, linking heaven and earth.
When the dust finally settled, what reflected in everyone’s eyes was utter destruction.
The eighteen story high building was gone, so was the three hundred tall waterfall. But what was more important was that Elder She was nowhere in sight.
Everywhere the people look, they were welcomed with a flat and barren land.
Zhuo Fan lowered his fist, his eyes cold, “Annoying!”
Sss~
Gasping, Jin Buhuan and everyone else were lost for words.
“Cool!”
Sixth prince was the first to recover and whooped in joy…

chapters.title: Chapter 808: Outstanding Crown Prince
chapters.content:
Chapter 808: Outstanding Crown Prince
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Lowering his mighty right hand, Zhuo Fan looked like he had done a trifle thing. He patted the sixth prince’s shoulder. “Now hurry along and take me to the crown prince. I hope I’ll find what I seek there.”
“Sure thing.”
After a brief pause of shock, the prince shouted in excitement as he went first. Jin Buhuan and his three men were shell shocked, just watching the two go with a dull look.
[Holy hell! He really is as strong as sixth prince said! For once, he didn’t boast! He’s way stronger than he lets on, killing an Ethereal Stage expert in one punch even.]
[Thank god we didn’t fight him before. We’d have been killed as well!]
The four shivered when they recalled the scene at the restaurant.
Zhuo Fan and the prince were a way off when a rumble echoed out and the earth shook. A huge image of a python came out of the ground, hissing, “Damn punk, you ruined my body again! I’m going to eat you alive!”
“It’s Elder She’s soul!”
Jin Buhuan cried out, “In the Radiant Stage, the body might be strong but the soul isn’t up to an Ethereal Stage expert’s level. We’re done for!”
Jin Buhuan panicked and Elder She snickered, “Yes, brat, you ambushed me again and ruined my body, but there’s no way a Radiant Stage like you can deal with my soul…”
Whoosh!
He didn’t finish as a scarlet dragon claw came out of Zhuo Fan and gripped the squirming oversized garden snake. He choked on his words, with those sharp eyes reflecting fear like no other.
[T-this is a soul?]
[How? He’s only in the Radiant Stage…]
“Humph, this is what you get for being stupid. You could’ve just floated away as your soul, but no, you had to be suicidal. Ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed and the scarlet dragon claw squeezed. The oversized snake wailed one last time as it was reduced to motes of spiritual energy scattered around.
The dragon claw went back to Zhuo Fan and resumed following sixth prince like nothing happened. Jin Buhuan’s face twitched with a dumb look.
As they watched Zhuo Fan going about his way, they all had the same shocked look and idea.
[Since when can a Radiant Stage cultivator form his soul?]
[A true freak…]
Meanwhile, a man and a woman were sitting in a pavilion next to a graceful lake.
The man wore a crown and was presentable, stacked in jewelry. Though his elegance was ruined by his sinister smile, especially when aimed at the woman next to him.
As for the woman, she was a beaut, bright eyes, sculpted eyebrows. Alas, the image was marred somewhat by her constant frown.
Around them were singing and dancing girls.
But as the obscene music and suggestive dancing of the women in their sheer attire continued, Lian’er, the daughter of Quanrong’s high commander, bit her lip. The man smirked, one hand groping around a woman’s waist, opening his mouth and letting her tender finger feed him fruits. Sometimes, it wasn’t just the fingers…
The man let out an obnoxious laughter now and then, filled with lust. Lian’er was sickened by it, but helpless against it.
Lian’er gathered all her bravery to ask, “Crown Prince, would it be possible to release my brother?”
“Him?”
The man raised an eyebrow, “In front of the whole nation, he punched me! How could I just let him go after his blatant disregard for authority?”
Clenching her fists, Lian’er bit her lip harder, “Brother was wrong in striking Your Highness, but he was doing it to protect me. It was all my fault. I hope Your Highness would consider Tuoba family’s wholehearted service to Quanrong and release my brother at once. Lian’er will never forget Your Highness’s gesture.”
“Oh, never you say?”
Crown prince sized her fine figure up and broke out in a lustful grin, “I don’t need that long, just attending to me for the rest of your life would do, he-he-he…”
“Your Highness!”
Lian’er cried out and jerked away at his obscene gaze on her. Then she trembled as she spoke, “Please mind yourself, Your Highness!”
Throwing the beauty in his arms away, the crown prince became bored, speaking coldly, “Touba Lian’er, don’t you play coy with me. Be grateful I have the time to waste on you. Touba has been a great family for a long time but ever since your defeat eight years ago, costing the empire heavily, you’re now criminals. Imperial father did not execute the old Tuoba Tieshan and only demoted him to captain of the guards. This is already gratitude enough for all his service. All of this was possible because I pleaded your case. What do you think would’ve happened if I hadn’t? You’d be stripped of everything and goddamned hanged!”
Lian’er bit her lip with a lowered head.
“And what do you do? Humph…”
Crown prince went on with his tirade, “Damn ingrates, I even asked for your hand yet that old Touba coot actually refused my kind gesture! I thought his mind woke up when he came to visit me in person afterward, but he only came to me for help. That Elder She had set his eyes on you ever since the war in Tianyu. His soul was redeemed by the sect so that geezer now wants to use my name to curb Elder She’s tendencies. As my future concubine, if a sect cast out touched you, even an Ethereal Stage expert, he’d still pay for it.”
Shaking all over, Lian’er lowered her head in silence.
The crown prince walked before her with a hard face, “I accepted becoming your shield, but as long as you’re mine. That old coot won’t ever touch you then. But you just don’t know when to quit. Saying you want to be with me only to drag out the wedding. This has been going for eight years already! Are you taking me for a fool you use for your own amusement?”
“Forgive me, Your Highness!” Jerking, Lian’er faltered with teary eyes.
Looking at her pretty face with a dead look, the crown prince caressed her soft cheek. As she shivered, his eyes shone with desire, shouting, “I don’t need your apology, I want you!”
The crown prince threw himself at her and hugged her, wanting to take her by force.
“No, Your Highness!”
Lian’er struggled and wailed. In the end, she had to use her Yuan Qi to throw him off. He broke four stone pillars and wailed in pain.
The crown prince, in his ostentatious attire, a pill grown peak Profound Heaven expert, had just been thrown on the ground by a girl in the 8th layer. His neverending lust had sapped his body of all the power that would make his cultivation high.
He was the very opposite of Zhuo Fan. While Zhuo Fan’s strength overshadowed his cultivation, crown prince’s was nothing but an empty shell, worse than that of some rich boy.
Getting a grip on his aching body to stand up straight, crown prince was enraged, “Y-you!”
“Your Highness, i-it wasn’t on purpose…” Lian’er cowered, on the verge of tears.
Panting like an animal, the crown prince snarled, “You have the glory of becoming my concubine, far above those dissolute women. But over these eight years, despite not getting married, I not once got to touch you. When I tried to get closer, your brother punched me and today you do this! You’re my concubine, yet I’m forced to go to someone else?”
“Uhm, n-no, Your Highness. Please listen…”
“Enough!”
The crown prince shouted in anger, “Guards, bring that Tuoba Liufeng!”
“Yes, sir!”
At his order, a few men left to carry it. Soon they had a tied and familiar man brought over.
He looked roughed up, judging by the battered face, though his features were still clear enough to see he was Tuoba Liufeng, commander Tuoba Tieshan’s sole son.
Only now, the young commander was wretched, having lost his heroic air years back…

chapters.title: Chapter 809: Take Her and Run
chapters.content:
Chapter 809: Take Her and Run
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Brother!”
Lian’er saw her brother having experienced torture under the crown prince and her heart was in pain, with tears in her eyes.
Tuoba Liufeng cried out, “Sister, what are you doing here? Run!”
“Humph, why else would she be here if not to plead for you?”
The crown prince grinned, “Laying your hands on a member of the imperial family is punishable by death! No matter who pleads for you in court, I have the final say if you get to be released! I can even have the Tuoba family removed from the Quanrong Empire. Ha-ha-ha, Tuoba Liufeng, everyone says you’re a brilliant warrior, a wise young commander, so why were you so impulsive to hit me? That punch has shattered the future of your entire family!”
Tuoba Liufeng shook and spat, “Crown Prince, I had no intention of doing anything but you went too far when you tried to force yourself on my sister… “
“Force? She’s my concubine to begin with! What business does her brother have in this? Humph!”
The crown prince cut him off and turned to the girl with a twisted smile, “Lian’er, you’re my concubine. Fulfill your duty and, ha-ha-ha, I’ll forget about this, letting this brother-in-law keep his life. When I ascend the throne, the Touba family will rise again to its former glory. Refuse and well…”
The crown prince threatened, “It won’t be just your brother’s life on the line. Your father, and your family’s eight servants will follow him to his grave. I vow there won’t remain even a Touba dog alive after I’m through with you!”
Shuddering, Lian’er paled from dread.
Tuoba Liufeng cursed in hatred, “Crown Prince, take it out on me if you’re a man. Leave my family out of this! Lian’er, don’t listen to his twisted words! Your life will be ruined if you agree. Father and I will never agree to marry this…”
“That’s enough, brother.”
Lian’er shouted, looking frail as she spoke, “Your Highness, let him go. I’ll do all you ask…”
The crown prince had a winning smirk. Tuoba Liufeng cried out, “No!”
Lian’er’s crystal tears began rolling down her cheeks as the despair took her…
“Your Highness, sixth prince is here with a strange youth. He requests an audience.” A guard came to report.
The crown prince flicked him away in annoyance. “That idiotic little brother of mine has the worst timing. I won’t see him. Tell him to scram. Today’s my most glorious day. I’m not in the mood to cater to his whims.”
“I’ll notify sixth prince at once!” The guard left.
The crown prince drew closer to Lian’er with a disgusting leer in his eyes. His hands shook and his mouth watered in anticipation of having his fill of this fine lady’s exquisite curves, “Lian’er, I finally have you. This is heaven on earth, ha-ha-ha…”
“Then my brother…” Lian’er muttered.
The crown prince sneered and waved, “After we seal the deal, he’ll be my brother-in-law. I won’t go hard on him. Ha-ha-ha…”
“Great, that’s great…” Lian’er nodded in despair, her eyes losing their light. Tuoba Liufeng’s eyes burned with hatred and humiliation.
A man like him actually needed his sister to save him.
Boom!
The sudden huge explosion rattled everyone’s composure. The crown prince cried out, “What’s going on here?”
Whoosh!
A guard flew over in panic, “Your Highness, sixth prince’s guest is forcing his way over.”
“What? Does brother plan on rebelling to fight his way into my home?” The crown prince was fuming, “What are you doing standing around for? Take the men and capture them! Tie him up and bring him here. I’ll have imperial father sort him out. For god’s sake, imperial father spoils him too much. He even dares to barge into my home!”
The guard was hesitant, “Your Highness, sixth prince’s guest is too strong. We can’t even hold him back! All the men we send over are dead. I barely made it out alive to report to you and urge you to flee. They’re almost upon us…”
Boom!
His words were cut short by the rumbling explosion from behind, sending a fierce gust of dust all around.
When it settled, two men waltzed out of fresh ruins around them. To make it worse, the joking manner they carried themselves with made it look like they weren’t just walking all over the crown prince’s lavish home, or what was left of it.
“Sixth prince, is this the way?”
“Sir Zhuo, just up ahead, yes. Last time I saw the amazing scene in crown prince’s manor right around here, the still pond.”
Sixth prince was all smiles as he led the way, “It’s truly a wonder. I wanted this manor too, but elder brother just wouldn’t budge. Not even imperial father would help me, saying crown prince’s manor is too important to give to me. That is not proper.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “True, this ain’t just about the manor, but the name of the crown prince. If the crown prince’s stuff gets shared to everyone, won’t that make him useless? So no matter how much the emperor dots on you, he still won’t do something so absurd as to affect the imperial family’s image.”
“That does make sense actually.”
Sixth prince nodded, then became confused again, “Doesn’t that mean barging in like that will affect elder brother’s image just as well? He is crown prince after all, so ruining his manor is a bit…”
Zhuo Fan glanced at him, “Why should I care?”
Sixth prince jerked and his eyes glittered, “Cool~”
The two enjoyed the short stroll to the pavilion, looking about like they were window shopping, anywhere but at the host of this now ruined manor.
It didn’t get more disrespectful than this.
The crown prince exploded in fury, “Sixth prince, what the hell? Are you revolting? Why did you barge your way in here?”
“That’s totally not it, elder brother. My idol came so I had to play the kind host. Since you have a marvelous natural attraction here, I just brought him over for a look-see.”
“Look your ass!”
The crown prince had had it, roaring, “This is the crown prince’s manor! Yet you destroyed it regardless just for that damn flimsy reason? You’re outrageous!”
Zhuo Fan and the sixth prince didn’t pay him any mind. Zhuo Fan was still looking around the place with a frown, “There’s nothing special about this place as well. Where’s that wonder you talked about? “
“That lake over there, it’s a real rarity. I promise it won’t disappoint, Sir Zhuo, he-he-he…” Sixth prince stuck to him like glue as he flattered.
The crown prince was outraged at the blatant disregard.
Lian’er’s dead eyes picked up Zhuo Fan looking everywhere and her hope renewed, “Zhuo Fan… y-you’re Zhuo Fan?”
“Yeah, you…”
Zhuo Fan had to focus for a second to really place where he had seen her before. “Oh, Tuoba Tieshan’s daughter, Lian’er. It’s been a while, how have you been?”
With a weak smile, Lian’er sighed in response.
Zhuo Fan shrugged and walked next to the lake, ignoring all the extra people around, “It’s not at all what I need. Oh well, I knew it was a long shot even when I came here. Sigh, so where exactly is this amazing scenery, sixth prince?”
“Sir Zhuo, it’s the lake.” The prince skipped before him and pointed. Zhuo Fan scanned the place, still ignoring everyone else.
Lian’er felt pain in her heart. Why was it that he was always so disregarding to everyone when she saw him?
But this had to be why the people he did notice would forever be in his mind.
Lian’er’s features softened gazing at his inquisitive look.
Ignoring the rare gentleness on his concubine’s face, the crown prince shook from the humiliation and anger, “Call all the venerables in this manor. I want this obnoxious fool to meet a swift end! Let him know the price of ruining my home!”
“Yes, sir!”
The guard bowed and left at once. Zhuo Fan didn’t know this, still looking at the lake.
The hogtied Tuoba Liufeng saw this and shouted, “Zhuo Fan, Crown Prince is calling reinforcements. Take my sister and run! Never come back to Quanrong!”
“Eh, who’s he now?” Zhuo Fan turned to where the voice came from…

chapters.title: Chapter 810: Thrashing Crown Prince
chapters.content:
Chapter 810: Thrashing Crown Prince
Proofreader
: Papatonks
The crown prince’s eyes were on fire from the hatred he put in his glare at Tuoba Liufeng. He went over and kicked the tied up young commander into the air, “Humph, you must have a death wish inviting enemies!”
“Brother!” Lian’er cried out.
Zhuo Fan looked on with a frown at the unrecognizable Tuoba Liufeng from all the beating. He then nodded, “You’re that guy playing commander back in Tianyu, Tuoba Liufeng? My, how cool you are now, almost can’t hold it in even.”
(StarReader: a play on words, since the same character is used for cool and commander.)
Pff!
Sixth prince grinned, “Ha-ha-ha, Sir Zhuo, do you have something against young Touba? He’s in serious trouble right now, yet you’re still being mean?”
Lian’er glared at Zhuo Fan in anger.
“Well, on the last battlefield we were on opposite sides, though nothing more than that.”
Shrugging, Zhuo Fan had a flat look, returning to inspecting the lake, “Sixth prince, where’s that marvel you keep talking about?”
Tuoba Liufeng shouted in panic, “Zhuo Fan, Crown Prince has many experts. Don’t be reckless and wait for them or it’ll be to late. I only hope you’d take my sister with you when you go! Help her out of this hell!”
“Goddamn it! You’re still talking, you’re still spilling the beans?”
Tuoba Liufeng’s kind reminder had no effect on Zhuo Fan whatsoever, instead it only incensed the crown prince further.
And so, the crown prince did what he knew best, kicking the helpless Tuoba Liufeng over and over again.
Zhuo Fan ignored it all, his mind on the lake still.
Lian’er was panicking and begged, “Zhuo Fan, please save my brother. He’ll die!”
Her voice fell on deaf ears.
“Zhuo Fan, my brother is being beaten up for informing you and you’re just going to stand there?” Lian’er teared up, her tone becoming sharper, “You damn ingrate!”
Zhuo Fan glanced over, “Ingrate? Did I ask him to? He gets what he deserves for running his mouth.”
Zhuo Fan bit back. Lian’er only grew angrier, but all she could do was stare as the crown prince was beating her brother.
“Sixth prince, the lake is as plain as it gets. You aren’t toying with me, are you?” After one last look at the water, Zhuo Fan threw a cold look at sixth prince, while Tuoba Liufeng’s mournful howls sounded in the distance.
Sixth prince had a vague smile, “He-he-he, it needs to be triggered first!”
“What trigger?” Zhuo Fan lit up.
Pointing at the brutal crown prince, sixth prince grinned, “By throwing snow lotus seeds in, a 6th grade pill ingredient that only grows on our Quanrong’s Woollahra Snow Peak, will definitely get a reaction. Those seeds are something only elder brother has.”
“Crown Prince?” Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed.
“But…” Sixth prince followed with a frown, “Brother is petty and would never use the snow lotus seeds when asked. The only times he take them out was at holidays or imperial father’s birthday. Uhm, Sir Zhuo, what do you plan to do?”
Zhuo Fan was walking towards crown prince and grabbed him in mid swing.
Startled, the crown prince looked back at Zhuo Fan in anger. “What do you think you’re doing? Are you planing on saving this traitor? Humph, of course you would, since you’re on the same side. He even informed you just now. You really think you can save him and leave…”
“Now hold on a second!”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Your Highness, even if you beat him to death, that’s your problem. It has nothing to do with me.”
Lian’er glared at him, the hope she had when he grabbed crown prince now turned into hatred.
The crown prince took Zhuo Fan for being afraid and grew bolder, “Humph, rotten punk, are you begging for mercy? Humph, well too bad. When my venerables come, you’ll all leave this place as corpses!”
“Oh, let’s just leave that for later.”
Zhuo Fan was calm as he spoke, “I just need a snow lotus seed from you. I want to see just what fascinating spectacle you got here.”
“Snow lotus seed?”
The crown prince mocked, “You want to see the beauty of this marvel? Ha-ha-ha, this is Quanrong’s proof of good fortune and only the imperial family is allowed to appreciate its beauty…”
Bam!
Zhuo Fan flicked his hand and slammed his head into a nearby convenient stone pillar. The crown prince’s delicate features were now marred with blood, and even some teeth fell off. This was how an eminent figure was reduced to a grotesque creature, looking worse off even when compared to the beaten Tuoba Liufeng.
Startled, all were shocked Zhuo Fan was actually so savage against the crown prince.
Bringing crown prince’s head around, Zhuo Fan spoke coldly, “The snow lotus seed.”
“D-don’t even think… my men are coming…”
Bam!
Zhuo Fan returned to having crown prince’s face make intimate and brutal contact with a hard rock, again and again for good measure. When he thought it was enough, he brought crown prince around, his face unrecognizable.
“The snow lotus seed.” Zhuo Fan demanded.
“Y-you…”
Bam~
“The snow lotus seed!”
Bam~
Zhuo Fan just kept on smashing his face into a rock while asking. The crown prince might think himself some bigshot from the imperial family, but Zhuo Fan thrashed him all the same, until he bawled.
“The snow lotus seed!”
Zhuo Fan roared this time but crown prince had long since fallen silent. Enraged, Zhuo Fan returned to smashing, but then he noticed the flailing arms, pointing at his bloody and toothless mouth.
Zhuo Fan now realized the guy was unable to speak. The victim pointed to a building on the side as he groaned in tears.
Pondering for a bit, Zhuo Fan looked at sixth prince, “Is he saying the seed is in that building? Sixth prince, you know how it looks, so go look for it.”
“Sure thing.”
The prince laughed and skipped over to the building. He didn’t so much as bat an eye as his dear elder brother’s face was tenderized into an unrecognizable slop.
[He’s one evil brat!]
Zhuo Fan thought, flicking his hand and throwing the limp crown prince away, returning to the lake and staring down at it.
Lian’er and Tuoba Liufeng were dumbstruck.
Zhuo Fan was cold as a rock when talked to, but when he struck, he was a volcano. Even Lian’er felt a pang of sorrow when looking at the new makeover done on the crown prince’s face.
[No matter how big the grudge, such an outcome is too brutal. Going after his face when it was so charming before.]
But then the two awoke at the dire situation they were in.
[Oh no!]
Tuoba Liufeng shot to his feet and shouted, “Zhuo Fan, by harming the Crown Prince you became Quanrong’s enemy. Take my sister and go! You won’t make it out when the experts come!”
Lian’er looked tense at Zhuo Fan then at Tuoba Liufeng, “Brother, why don’t we just go with father and the rest? This place doesn’t want us anymore!”
“I also thought about it, but father is ever loyal to his country. He will never betray it.” Tuoba Liufeng sighed.
Lian’er lowered her head in worry and vexation.
Glancing over, Zhuo Fan finally recalled the past dealing and said, “Dugu Zhantian also died because of his loyalty to his country. I must say, these two geezers sure are alike, ha-ha-ha…”
The siblings nodded.
The marshal and commander had received such praise from the people was not just from their glorious military victories, but also their loyal character…
“Zhuo Fan, my father and I may die, but Lian’er must not lose her life in a place like this. All I ask is that you take her, let the Touba line go on.”
“No, I still need to see the spectacle here.”
Tuoba Liufeng begged Zhuo Fan once more but Zhuo Fan refused, his reason only making the brother feel helpless.
“Brother, is that eye candy more important than our lives?”
“Eye candy?” Zhuo Fan frowned.
[Is that all this place amounts to, some fancy view?]
A laughter broke his concentration, “Ha-ha-ha, you think you can just walk away after ruining Crown Prince’s home? Are you taking us for props?”
Nine powerful energies surrounded the place as elders appeared before them.
“Damn it, the nine venerables of the Crown Prince manor are here. They’re at the 8th or 9th layer Radiant Stage, with four even at the peak. We’re doomed!” Tuoba Liufeng cried.
Lian’er clenched her clammy fists, while Zhuo Fan frowned. Not because of the elders, of course, but that he got to the wrong place again…

chapters.title: Chapter 811: Stop Bothering Me
chapters.content:
Chapter 811: Stop Bothering Me
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Whoosh~
Nine old men landed, sporting cruel looks at the trio. Among them, one guy with scattered hair, the strongest, stepped up and spat, “Humph, you must have a death wish to destroy Crown Prince’s manor. Where is His Highness?”
Ugh!
Tuoba Liufeng’s heart sank, feeling sweat trickling down his spine. Just this guy alone was enough to deal with them, a peak Radiant Stage expert.
In a couple of years he should be a true Ethereal Stage expert as well, becoming one of the empire’s legends, one of the best.
With him here, the three had no chance of getting away. Tuoba Liufeng sighed at the grim outlook, his hopes gone.
[I wonder if Zhuo Fan’s sudden arrival was a blessing or a curse.]
His sister was free of the crown prince for now since Zhuo Fan’s intervention, but now the Touba family would be killed because of his aggressive handling of the crown prince. They might even be labeled as traitors.
Touba Lian’er understood they were in serious danger and her eyes still gave contemplative look to a somewhat oblivious Zhuo Fan.
“I asked you a question. Where’s His Highness?” Seeing them silent, the old man roared.
Tuoba Liufeng shook, finding speaking difficult.
Touba Lian’er pointed to where the crown prince was lying with a cold face, “Over there. I onder if you still recognize him.”
“T-that’s Crown Prince?”
They all gasped at the sobbing, gruesome mish-mash of features that barely hinted at what once was.
Their elegant and handsome crown prince was now reduced to this… thing. Those eyes were swollen out of their sockets, the nose more twisted than a ravine, and the former spotless denture turned into a bloody hole.
The only reason they even noticed him was because Touba Lian’er pointed out.
Stunned seeing a face only a mother could love, the old man roared, “It’s Crown Prince’s signature feature. How, who, what gave you the nerve to harm the Crown Prince like this? You’re done for!”
Whoosh~
The old man’s anger exploded, “Talk, who did this? I’ll peel his skin and crush his bones. It’ll be ages before I’m through with him!”
Tuoba Liufeng panicked under the nine’s auras. Zhuo Fan was still in his own world, contemplating more important stuff.
“Venerables, I did it. If you want to kill someone, kill me!” Lian’er scrounged up her courage and declared.
Tuoba Liufeng cried, “Sister…”
“It’s fine.”
Lian’er cut him off, “This is all my fault. Tianyu used to say women were deadly and now I have to admit they were right. If it weren’t for me, the Touba family would never have ended up like this. It’s all my fault and I should settle it…”
Lian’er spoke with sadness and despair. Tuoba Liufeng’s clenched fists shook, feeling utterly useless.
Lian’er wanted to use her life to settle it all and save the Touba family. No, the family was already finished. She was giving him and Zhuo Fan the chance to get away.
But how could her brother just let his sister take the blame…
Tuoba Liufeng roared at Zhuo Fan, “Zhuo Fan, you bastard, is that how a man behaves, letting a woman take the fall for you?”
“Brother!” Lian’er cried out, having made up her mind. So why was her brother dragging Zhuo Fan into this?
Tuoba Liufeng was firm when he saw Lian’er’s despair. Harming the crown prince was a heavy crime, akin to assassinating a royal member, or rebelling. He could not let it hang over Lian’er’s head. All of this happened because Zhuo Fan showed up.
The nine venerables finally noticed Zhuo Fan that they ignored since he looked so quiet to the side.
The nine people tensed.
[8th layer Radiant Stage! He does have the power!]
The leading elder squinted and snickered, “I see what’s going on. You’re the one who made a mess of Crown Prince’s manor. Ha-ha-ha, I knew it was odd for a girl to admit it. When the guard reported to us, he said that none of them could fight back. How could a wee girl be so tough? Seeing your high cultivation, it all makes sense. If we nine hadn’t come, none in the Crown Prince manor would be able to hold you, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan’s mind was still processing.
The leading elder took it for cowardice and mocked, “Ha-ha-ha, here I thought you had guts when attacking Crown Prince but now I see you’re full of it. It’s understandable, as not even an 8th layer Radiant Stage cultivator can escape from us nine. Being scared is normal. But to have a girl take the blame for you, talk about useless, ha-ha-ha…”
The other eight looked at Zhuo Fan with the same disdain as their leader.
“Sir Zhuo, I brought the snow lotus seeds!”
A whoop of joy sounded in the distance. Sixth prince skipped over to Zhuo Fan in excitement.
Zhuo Fan woke up at last, staring only at the sixth prince’s figure, “Took you long enough. Hurry up and throw them in. I want to see just how fancy this thing is.”
Ugh!
The mockery was stuck in the nine elders’ throat seeing him ignore them. The two soon joined and started throwing seeds into the lake while watching for any signs. The elders’ faces sank.
[For god’s sake, here we thought he was scared when in fact he didn’t give a damn about us. He’s toying with us!]
“Boy, don’t think that your high cultivation is enough to do what you want in Quanrong. You ruined Crown Prince manor and I’ll have you pay for that…”
“Sixth prince, I heard this is eye candy. Isn’t that so average?”
“Uhm, Sir Zhuo, this is a true marvel, I promise. It’s a true rare spectacle in this world that won’t disappoint, he-he-he…”
“Oh, I’m relieved. Let’s just watch…”
Zhuo Fan and sixth prince were curious about the lake, even ignoring the elder’s raving curses.
Blatant disregard, that was what this was.
The old man’s face twitched as he barked, “Let’s get this damn faker, men. I want him dead!”
“Yes, sir!”
The other elders bowed and shot for Zhuo Fan. Their mighty auras, filled with bloodthirst, covered the sky.
Lian’er cried, “Look out, Zhuo Fan!”
“Oh no, the bloodthirst is affecting the lake and it’s too scared to react.” The sixth prince shivered and cried.
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched and his face sank. Turning around, and seeing the incoming eight elders, he roared, “Damn geezers, stop bothering me!”
Hu~
A mighty gale shot out that went through the eight elders.
The old men lost their lives before even knowing what happened, slumping to the ground like a ton of bricks.
Tuoba Liufeng and Lian’er were shellshocked.
[W-what was that?]
Bang!
A crisp sound echoed and the leading elder felt his legs soften, kneeling on the ground. He was in the lead when the gale had struck him as well. Now he looked deathly pale and overcome with horror, “N-no way! T-that’s soul impact! An Ethereal Stage expert?!”
Zhuo Fan went back to his problem, the lake. He asked, “Sixth prince, now it’s quiet. Will it show up?”
“Yeah, soon.” Sixth prince grinned.
The two looked like they came to sightsee. They were calm and the mood was calm too, finally.
Only Tuoba Liufeng, Lian’er and the surviving elder looked at Zhuo Fan with fear.
[This guy is even more terrible than before!]
All kinds of thoughts ran through Tuoba Liufeng’s mind…

chapters.title: Chapter 812: Flower Fairy
chapters.content:
Chapter 812: Flower Fairy
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Hum~
Fifteen minutes later, the still lake rippled. The snow lotus seeds floated inside, releasing bubbles. As each bubble burst, the seed below it was gone.
The ripples became more and more numerous.
Zhuo Fan looked focused, watching as flowers floated to the water surface from deep below, swaying in the sunlight.
A total of a thousand flowers appeared, moving about as if they were dancing.
Zhuo Fan’s eyelid twitched, looking straight at the sixth prince. The prince was smug, “Well, Sir Zhuo? Isn’t it fab? He-he-he…”
Zhuo Fan nodded.
If it were only a couple of flowers having spirituality, it wouldn’t be much, maybe it was something related to their species. But with a thousand different flowers all showing the same reaction, living at the bottom of the lake, now that was different.
Just what was the deep hiding for such a scene to occur?
[Is there really a World Wind Tunnel in here?]
Zhuo Fan asked the sixth prince, “You just say this won’t be just some eye candy, a fancy view. What did you mean by that?”
“He-he-he, well…”
The sixth prince wiggled his eyebrow with a vague smile, “Revival, something I bet not even Sir Zhuo has ever experienced.”
[Revival?]
Zhuo Fan frowned.
Understanding his thoughts, the sixth prince skipped over to the ghastly-looking crown prince, “My elder brother is the perfect candidate for sir to witness this event.”
Sixth prince grabbed snow lotus seeds and threw them high, shouting, “Eat it, Flower Fairy!”
Bang!
With a loud burst, the lake exploded, with a water sprout jutting out and wiggling in the air to catch them all. then it shot back into the lake, sending a shower of fine water droplets.
Each drop released a faint golden glow in contact with anything. When they touched the crown prince, one could see how with every drop, his disfigured face was recovering. Even his teeth grew back.
Even the somewhat far Tuoba Liufeng, who the golden glow did not reach, was healed in moments.
Zhuo Fan was looking inquisitively, hand on his chin, “Quick recovery, along the lines of my Returning Dragon’s Roar, if not stronger…”
“Sir Zhuo, well, isn’t it amazing?”
The sixth prince grinned. The crown prince shot to his feet, looking at Zhuo Fan with fear. Then he scurried away, wanting nothing to do with him.
Zhuo Fan nodded, taking one step to pop in the crown prince’s face. He grabbed his skull, cracking it on some random rock and giving him that revolting look again before throwing him to the ground.
“W-why?” The crown prince wailed, his bloody and toothless mouth straining to speak, “I didn’t do or say anything. So why…”
The sixth prince was curious as well.
Zhuo Fan shrugged, “It’ll be more peaceful without his bullshit poisoning the air again.”
“This works?” The sixth prince started.
The crown prince cried, filled with grief. Yes, this worked like a charm…
While the Touba siblings looked at Zhuo Fan in silence, he was the only one running his mouth and showing off.
His Highness had been a victim to maltreatment twice now, at the hand of the same demon, yet the second time made no sense.
This was just not crown prince’s day. He got beaten in his own home and twice on top of that…
Ignoring the others, Zhuo Fan stared at the lake then at the eight dead elders. It was obvious the golden glow was not capable of true revival, only good at healing, just that it was far stronger than most pills. With them having their soul crushed, there was no way to make a comeback.
Next was finding out where this golden glow came from.
Zhuo Fan lifted his right hand, covered in a red and brutal glow.
Qilin Arm!
Zhuo Fan flicked his hand right at the lake.
Boom!
The motion was that of a savage sword, splitting the lake in two. The water towered up to three hundred meters as it rumbled to the sides.
It left the lake bed completely exposed.
“Sir Zhuo, what are you doing?” The sixth prince was shocked by his action.
Zhuo Fan spoke, “Checking what’s below?”
“But there should be nothing there.” The sixth prince sighed, “Ever since discovering this marvel, elder brother had sent people down there but found nothing.”
Zhuo Fan stared hard at it then said, “Just because they failed, that doesn’t mean I will too. Something odd is going on here.”
Squinting, Zhuo Fan’s soul covered the lake, feeling every nook and cranny, with no results.
[Is there really nothing?]
Just then, when he was about to give up, he felt something to one side.
Focusing on the spot, Zhuo Fan still got nothing.
Hum~
Then it happened again. Zhuo Fan focused and his right eye sported six golden halos.
Divine Eye of the Void 6th stage, Void Domain!
Bang!
Feeling like he had hit a wall, Zhuo Fan snickered. He then pointed forward and his eye released its power. A palm-sized space pocket formed before him, holding in it a finger-sized golden person. It had transparent wings, humming as they flapped.
Its hand was holding on to some snow lotus seeds, looking at Zhuo Fan in panic.
“What’s that thing?” The sixth prince cried out in curiosity.
Zhuo Fan said, “Flower spirit, a being born of this world, like a fire spirit or blood spirit. It’s nurtured by the world, until it gains spirituality. The flower spirit is a being of wood, an element with brimming vitality. That’s why it can heal so perfectly. Although weak in battle, having it around is much better than having pills.”
Blinking, the sixth prince looked confused, but the least he could catch from that was that it was precious.
“The flower spirit is nature’s favorite and good at hiding. No powerful expert would ever sense it, least of all catch it. A shame my Void Domain can create a space pocket. As long as I can sense the location, setting it up will trap this little guy, ha-ha-ha…”
Holding the flower spirit, Zhuo Fan had a manic grin, “Isn’t that right?”
It kept struggling to flee, but Zhuo Fan tightened his grip, making its effort useless, until it gave up.
Boom!
The huge water expunged from the lake finally came down in a mighty roar. Zhuo Fan ignored it and held the fairy as he left.
The sixth prince hurriedly asked, “Where are you going, Sir Zhuo?”
“Finding what I came for.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone in glee, “A special place with thick spiritual energy is needed to give birth to a fairy. This lake has none of that, which means it moved here. Now I’ll have this guy lead the way, taking me to my destination, he-he-he…”
The sixth prince followed after him, “Sir Zhuo, I’m coming too!”
The fairy crossed its arms and looked at Zhuo Fan in resentment, like that was not gonna happen.
“Ha-ha-ha, little guy, you sure are feisty.”
With an evil grin, Zhuo Fan stared at its hard face as a black thunderflame flashed in his left eye. “Sometimes, being stubborn comes with a price. Are you ready for it?”
Shuddering, the flower spirit sweated, bobbing its head and water gathered beneath it, as if it peed itself from fear.
That thunderflame made it feel like destruction was nigh.
Zhuo Fan held a tight grip on the spirit as he left, the sixth prince his faithful fan. As for the Toubas, Zhuo Fan had better things to do than mind them.
The peak Radiant Stage elder now scared to death, was still kneeling and shaking like a leaf. He still couldn’t get over the fact Zhuo Fan killed eight of his men in a flash…

chapters.title: Chapter 813: Unstoppable
chapters.content:
Chapter 813: Unstoppable
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“He not once looked at me.”
Watching Zhuo Fan’s back, Lian’er’s mood fell. She started off feeling despair, then hope, then shock, then despair again. But she ended the cycle with anger.
Tuoba Liufeng sighed, “Lian’er, cut me loose and remove the seal on me.”
“Uh, right.”
Lian’er now recalled her brother’s predicament and rushed to release his Yuan Qi.
Tuoba Liufeng finally got his freedom back.
Looking around, seeing the old man lost in his own world, Tuoba Liufeng said, “Lian’er, this time it’s grave. We best rush to father. We have to try and flee with him. With the Crown Prince’s manor ruined, the consequences are dire. Zhuo Fan is an uncaring monster, stirring things up and making us suffer for it. We have no choice but to flee our home.”
“Brother, how can you say that?”
Glaring at him in dissatisfaction, Lian’er pouted, “If not for him, we both would’ve suffered at Crown Prince’s hand. I can’t even think about what he’d have done.”
Tuoba Liufeng nodded, “Yeah, while the punk ruined everything, he did help us. We should be grateful for it. But we first have to flee from here and not get dragged into this any further!”
Lian’er nodded and the two flew away, leaving the elder behind, still too horrified to react.
“High Venerable…”
Footsteps were heard as a guard looked around to see only the shellshocked elder.
The elder still didn’t react.
Sighing, the guard shouted in his ear, “High Venerable, the monster is gone!”
Shaking, the elder finally came out of his stupor. Seeing Zhuo Fan was nowhere around, he sighed and got up. But then he felt chilly below. Looking down, there was a wet patch.
Pff!
The guard chuckled and the old man went red. His glare wiped the smirk off the guard’s face.
“Ahem, did that guy leave?”
“Long ago.”
“How long?”
“Fifteen minutes.” The guard bowed.
Squinting, the elder nodded, “Why did you only wake me up now?”
“Because the Touba siblings…”
Bam!
The guard’s words were cut short by the old man’s palm, slapping him dead.
Glancing over, the elder’s eyes grew hard, “Damn fool, you think you’ll still get to live after seeing all that? Humph!”
The elder’s eyes darted around. Assured no one else was around, he took out a fresh pair of pants from his ring and changed. He then rushed to the crown prince’s side, “Your Highness, what’s wrong? Here, take this healing pill!”
“No!”
The crown prince’s eyes glinted with hatred, slurring his words through nonexistent teeth, “Take me to Elder Hu, I want them to take revenge!”
The elder bowed, “Understood.”
He grabbed the prince and left…
There was a wide courtyard in the capital, one that had a large lion statue with the words honor and loyalty engraved on it. Above the gate were the words Touba Manor written.
Unlike the imposing gate, the wind that blew was a cold and bitter one, carrying with it a bleak tone along with the dust of the capital.
Inside the manor, two men sat upright in the middle of the room, the former commander of Quanrong and the Imperial Tutor, Han Tiemo.
Frowning, Tuoba Tieshan hesitated before finally jumping to his feet in revulsion, “Guards, summon the Eight Wolf Wardens. I’m going to Crown Prince manor myself!”
“Wait, brother Touba! You can’t let it devolve any further!” Han Tiemo urged.
Shaking his head, Tuoba Tieshan was vexed, “Brother, Liufeng is my only son, now trapped in Crown Prince manor. How am I supposed to calm down when His Highness is capable of anything?!”
“No matter how restless you are, you can’t just go with the city guards!”
Han Tiemo shook his head, “The minute you resort to using the guards, and against the Crown Prince too, that would be the moment you’ll be taken as a traitor. Then no one can save you. Let’s say you get to mobilize all the men, what then? You’re now the captain of the guards, not Commander Touba, leader of millions. Commander Touba manor is packed with experts, nine venerables of immense power. Even if you go, it won’t make a difference, so what’s the point?”
Bam!
Slamming the table, Tuoba Tieshan glared, “Even so, as a father, the least I can do is try!”
“Calm down, brother Touba.”
Han Tiemo sighed, “Why don’t we assemble the court’s officials and plead to His Majesty, to be lenient on account of your past?”
Tuoba Tieshan shook his head, “No use, His Majesty issued an unbreakable decree this time, leaving Crown Prince in charge of this. Any that interferes will be executed. Who in the court would be willing to meddle in this?”
Han Tiemo sighed, “His Majesty is too easy on the Crown Prince, yet cruel to his ministers. People’s opinion of him will sour.”
“Master!”
A cry came as a servant rushed before Tuoba Tieshan, “Y-young miss, she…”
“What about her?” Tuoba Tieshan cried.
The servant girl jerked, “Young miss knocked me out and ran away. She must be going to Crown Prince manor to save young master!”
“Damn that girl! Is she trying to anger me to death?” Tuoba Tieshan was panicking, shouting, “Have the Eight Wolf Wardens assemble the men, surround Crown Prince manor!”
“Brother Touba, you must calm down! “
“No, not this time. At the very least, I’ll have the two children flee while I shoulder the blame!” Tuoba Tieshan’s mind was made up.
Sighing, Han Tiemo shouted after him, “Tuoba Tieshan, do you really plan on throwing away all you accomplished? Are you going to become a criminal to Quanrong?”
Tuoba Tieshan shook, but his eyes were firm, “As the Commander of Quanrong, I have fought for my country all my life, and shall never betray it. No matter how much His Majesty forsakes me, I will not complain. But I am also a father! How can I just sit by and watch my children bear unjust crimes?!”
“Han Tiemo, today I may be convicted of crimes and my head will hang high above the city gates. I will have no regrets knowing I did all I could for the future of my children.”
Tuoba Tieshan was soon gone. Han Tiemo sighed and got up to follow.
“Commander, the men are here. We await your orders!”
Outside the manor, the Eight Wolf Wardens were gathered. Tuoba Tieshan eyed them and shouted, “We march!”
“Yes, sir!”
The Eight Wolf Wardens bowed, glee dancing in their eyes. The last eight years had been spent in unrest, hardly ever fighting and always held back. Now they were going to let loose, against the crown prince no less. Yet they were still joyful.
It was their honor to serve under the commander.
“Wait, Tuoba Tieshan!”
Han Tiemo caught up. Tuoba Tieshan didn’t even look back, “My mind is set!”
“I’m not trying to sway you. I want to come with you, old friend. It would be great if I can convince His Highness to let them go. If not, I’ll be most willing to be labeled a traitor alongside you.”
Shaking, Tuoba Tieshan laughed, “Good, ha-ha-ha…”
The army marched, their spirits uplifted, their drive ignited. Yet after two steps, a staggering figure entered their vision, an imperial palace guard.
[Did His Majesty find out already? Did he come to stop us?]
Tuoba Tieshan and the rest were tense. If this was the emperor’s decree, then before them had to be a huge army to block their path.
But the imperial guard actually went and panicked at their sight, “Commander Touba, you truly are the empire’s God of War, of such brilliant mind as to foresee the imperial palace is in peril and send the men to aid it.”
“The imperial palace is in danger?” Tuoba Tieshan and the rest were stunned.
Panting, the imperial guard showed fear, “Yes, the sixth prince brought a youth as he barged into the imperial palace. He’s unstoppable, he’s almost at His Majesty’s chambers…”

chapters.title: Chapter 814: Assaulting the Imperial Palace
chapters.content:
Chapter 814: Assaulting the Imperial Palace
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Boom~
Waves upon waves of imperial guards poured out of the palace gates, only to be blown away by rumbling explosions as pieces of their former selves.
With a constant drizzle of blood going on, it marked the dark and cruel end of tens of thousands of soldiers.
Zhuo Fan flicked his red right fist and looked uncaringly at the flower spirit held tightly in his left. It was like he was out mowing a lawn or something, and not butchering people, “Which way is it this time? Don’t try to play me, you pint!”
Shuddering in fear, the flower spirit shook its head and pointed at a large wall.
Boom!
Another rumble sounded. Zhuo Fan found it a waste of time circling around to use the front gate, so he just made a new one right here, in the fifty meter tall wall.
The sixth prince, sticking close like any true fanboy would, was mulling over whether Zhuo Fan had stopped being human at this point as he kept charging in like a raging beast.
If there was no way, he’d find it.
Anyone that stepped between him and his goal would leave the scene as a corpse. Or maybe, Zhuo Fan no longer registered these people as living beings, merely as obstacles.
“Sixth prince, Sir Zhuo is truly reckless. This is the Imperial Palace he’s barging into, killing left and right. With his insane power, it won’t matter who he steps on, but once he’s gone, you’ll be left behind. He’ll go, wiping his hands of it all and you’ll take the fall.”
Jin Buhuan and his three elders were overwhelmed by what they saw, crying and fearful as he urged the prince.
They had followed the two all the way here, following Zhuo Fan’s wake of destruction from the crown prince manor. Now that they saw Zhuo Fan’s brutality for themselves, they feared for their lord.
“Sixth prince, we have to leave now, while His Majesty is yet to realize your involvement. We’ll then say he forced us when we’re questioned and be absolved of any blame.”
Sixth prince was thinking, but he snapped, “Humph, Sir Zhuo is my honored guest. I said I’ll take him to what he’s searching and that’s what I’ll do. Since it’s about to be found, I will accompany Sir Zhuo to confirm this. If you’re scared, you’re welcome to leave.”
Flicking his sleeves, sixth prince huffed and shooed the four away as he caught up to Zhuo Fan with a chuckle, “Sir Zhuo, wait for me~”
“This is insane…” Jin Buhuan sighed, but then decided.
[To hell with it.]
Then he went after as well.
Sixth prince was their lord after all.
Zhuo Fan stepped through anything that came before him, men or stone, with a few men following behind him with worry.
What would they do once Zhuo Fan walked away?
Sixth prince didn’t look to have given this problem much thought, always beaming as he watched his idol at work…
“Y-Your Majesty, the criminal is just a thousand meters away. I beg Your Majesty to flee.”
“Y-Your Majesty, he is at eight hundred meters. Please flee, Your Majesty!”
“Your Majesty…”
In a tranquil garden, the peace was broken as all kinds of nervous voices shouted. The imperial guards just kept on coming one after the other, fully distraught and panicking as they reported.
What they said was almost always the same, that the criminal was getting closer and they could not stop it.
The people in the palace were afraid now, but also suspicious. Where did such a freak come from all of a sudden? When did Quanrong mess with such a godly expert?
None could make sense of it, not even the emperor in his golden robe. He was now frowning, stressed out by the sudden and brutal development. He had no idea what unforgivable sin might have been committed to deserve such retribution.
The Quanrong Empire had the Beast Taming Sect’s protection. While totally disdained, Beast Taming Sect would still care about its name and defend it.
[So why…]
Boom!
The emperor’s thoughts were blown away by the sound. Looking over, he saw a hill being blown away not a hundred meters from where he was.
When the dust cleared, a handful of people walked out. In the lead was Zhuo Fan, the main culprit, with the emperor’s sixth son at his side. Following a few steps behind were his venerables.
The emperor’s mouth twitched, his face falling, “Son, now you’re trying to rebel? What are you doing charging into the imperial palace with an outsider? Is it because I didn’t give you Crown Prince’s manor? Haven’t I made it up to you with that glorious waterfall? Did you have to go this far? I’m such a fool looking after you.”
“Imperial father, what are you saying? This is no rebellion, nor do I want your seat. You just have to sit tight and not move. Have a feast, get the girls to dance and ignore us.” Sixth prince rolled his eyes.
The emperor was stunned, “If this is not a rebellion, why are you barging into the imperial palace?”
“How’s it my fault?”
Sticking out his chin, the sixth prince spoke with pride and honor, “I wanted to go in, but those guards just wouldn’t listen. My dear guest is quite impatient as well, wanting to get in at once. Those guards stopped us without reason, so we just went through them.”
The emperor’s brow shook as he sized Zhuo Fan up, “You broke into the imperial palace because you’re impatient? Have you lost it? Couldn’t you have waited for an audience with me?”
Shrugging, the sixth prince remained silent.
Ignoring their argument, Zhuo Fan looked at the spirit pointing the way to a rock garden, “This way?”
“Wait, what are you doing?” The emperor shouted in panic.
Zhuo Fan never paid him any mind. The sixth prince also followed Zhuo Fan like before, making the emperor twitch.
The emperor roared, “Son, stop him!”
“Can’t do, imperial father. How can I do what thousands of guards couldn’t?” The sixth prince shrugged with a chuckle.
