“That doesn’t mean it ain’t true. Didn’t Danqing Shen get to have two as well? Ha-ha-ha, having met him already, I then knew how to get two souls as well. But since you never heard of it, that just proves what an ignorant lout you are.”
“Danqing Shen?!”
Sect Leader took two shaky steps back, his face dark.
He’d never have taken Zhuo Fan’s words about having a second soul seriously, but since Danqing Shen was involved, he had no choice.
Danqing Shen was legendary in the western lands. Anything could happen around him. Since he did it, then a freak like Zhuo Fan had a probable chance of doing it as well.
Sect Leader’s face fell, “You’re really Zhuo Fan?”
“In the flesh!”
“Humph, Zhuo Fan, you are simply looking to die coming back again!”
Sect Leader snickered, “Your domain soul was too strong for us to handle, but with just a domain soul out, humph. Even if the type is stronger than a beast soul, with so many souls in your domain, you’ll die either way. If we charge right out, your domain soul will be pulverized or heavily wounded. Ha-ha-ha, Zhuo Fan you’ve miscalculated. Not all domain souls are stronger than a beast soul.”
Sect Leader shouted, “Men, release your souls and scatter this damn domain!”
“Yes, sir!”
Everyone followed his orders and gathered their souls.
A horde of beasts thundered, releasing their devastating power and increasing their pressure inside the domain.
Lian’er and the other two were gasping in shock. With such a horde of mighty beasts, any domain would fall.
[Zhuo Fan will…]
Lian’er was tense, her hope of hearing Zhuo Fan was back from the dead being shaken.
Sect Leader cackled, “Zhuo Fan, it’s too late to take your domain back. Everyone attack!”
Roar!
With a thunderous yell, a stampede formed as it charged at the black dome’s peak, the weakest point in a domain soul. It could not resist an attack and would collapse.
Sect Leader shook in glee.
[Humph, Zhuo Fan, I didn’t kill you the first time, but I’ll make sure you’re finished now!]
A clanking sound echoed out before he got to gloat at his glorious achievement.
The stampede stopped charging, as if trapped by something.
Sect Leader cried out, “W-what’s happening? Why aren’t you attacking?”
“Sect Leader, we don’t know why but we are lacking the strength to move…” The elders panicked, “As if our Yuan Qi and souls are out of our control…”
[What?]
Sect Leader’s legs were shaking like jelly.
A cultivator needed Yuan Qi and soul power to show their might. With both of them locked, that stopped one from being a cultivator altogether; nothing more than a lamb to the slaughter.
[H-how can this be?]
Zhuo Fan grinned as he floated, “I formed the Devouring Domain inside the Abyssal Swamp, so of course it has its power. Didn’t you say anyone would die once stuck in this quagmire? Ha-ha-ha, now all of you are in the same situation. The only difference is that this is worse.”
Everyone shook in fear and horror.
[The domain is the same as that weird swamp? Does that mean we’re screwed?]
None caught in the swamp’s sludge ever made it out alive…
“Beast Taming Sect’s Sect Leader…”
Zhuo Fan’s coy grin was plastered on his face, “You’re wrong about one thing. Demon Transformation Art said the condition to form a second soul was for it to be stronger than the first. So you tell me if the Devouring Domain is weaker than dragon soul. Ha-ha-ha, you’ve really underestimated me. Not that taking me seriously would’ve changed things. So be good and die already, Demon Transformation Art… “
Whoosh~
As Zhuo Fan’s voice traveled, black energy clutched around every Beast Taming Sect soul. Without their soul power and Yuan Qi, they had no chance of even resisting.
“Hold on, Zhuo Fan, if there’s anything…”
Sect Leader begged while the elders howled. Zhuo Fan just ignored him.
The black energy wrapped around them all, turning them into black statues and snuffing out their pleas.
With a sound, the Devouring Domain faded, along with the statues. The Crescent Pool once again appeared with the bright moon shining from above.
Only this time, the Beast Taming Sect’s higher ups had now been devoured by Zhuo Fan, boosting his power…

chapters.title: Chapter 826: Nether Sea
chapters.content:
Chapter 826: Nether Sea
Proofreader
: Papatonks
The gentle moonlight fell on the clear pond as the pretty birds around it began to chirp in their beautiful voices. The previous rowdy area now became one of peace.
In this scenery, Lian’er and the other two were still there.
When the blackness vanished and the moonlight shone on their dumb looks, the trio felt their hearts thump harder. They felt like they had survived hell and felt so much better for being alive.
They were still looking stunned. Maybe it was the beauty around them, or they didn’t want to disturb the mood…
Crash!
A sound came from the pond and the waters parted to reveal a man with defined muscles and traced by golden hues as scales began appearing on his skin.
His long pitch-black hair danced in the wind like a black dragon. As he approached, his dark eyes absorbed anyone that dared look into them.
“Z-Zhuo Fan!”
Shaking, Lian’er was teary. The utter despair she felt before was now replaced with joy upon seeing Zhuo Fan’s familiar face. She did not care about his unclothed disposition, throwing herself in the arms of her savior and clutching tight to his manly chest, “Zhuo Fan, you’re still alive! You scared me to death…”
Feeling warmth on his chest and the soft girl’s body rubbing on him, Zhuo Fan didn’t even twitch a muscle, “Miss Lian’er, I understand you’ve been through hell, but can’t you at least let me get some clothes first?”
Ugh!
Lian’er trembled, now realizing her teary face was stuck to his warm chest, in direct contact.
Looking up, she realized Zhuo Fan was buck naked.
“Ah!”
Lian’er cried out and flicked her head away with a red face. “W-what are you doing coming out naked?”
Glancing over, Zhuo Fan flicked his hand and clothes came out of his ring to change, “My clothes dissolved in the swamp. And besides, changing inside the pool will get them wet. It seems to me, you have a long way to go before using your head to not have figured this out.”
Pouting, Lian’er snapped, “Are you done changing?”
“Yep.”
Whoosh~
Lian’er swished around and grumbled at him.
Zhuo Fan felt baffled.
[What did I do this time?]
He sized Lian’er up again, pointing at the evident ruined clothes on her chest, “Now that I’m decent, shouldn’t you look after yourself?”
“Aah!”
Lian’er shrieked and turned around, rushing to get her clothes fixed. She then looked back with a red face, only to see Zhuo Fan’s teasing eyes, “W-what are you grinning at? Don’t look!”
“It’s not like I haven’t seen it before, tch.” Zhuo Fan clicked his tongue and flew to the shore.
Lian’er’s face was burning now, with even her ears red.
She was taken back to when Zhuo Fan saved her life in Tianyu, when she was the one naked instead. A flood of emotions had her overwhelmed, but most of all feeling embarrassed.
Ignoring the missie’s budding affection, Zhuo Fan looked at the other two. They were ecstatic for being saved in the nick of time, and also because Zhuo Fan was fine.
The sixth prince was over the moon, “Sir Zhuo is truly godlike, killing all those bastards in a blink. I can’t thank you enough.”
Sixth prince immediately gave a deep bow.
“Please, you were after this as well.” Zhuo Fan grinned and waved him off.
Scratching his head, the sixth prince beamed, “Sir Zhuo is so sharp. I knew I couldn’t hide anything from sir. When we return to the palace, I’ll be sure to tell you all about it.”
“I don’t wanna know. I didn’t kill them for you anyway. They were just in my way.” Zhuo Fan shook his head.
Sixth prince bobbed his head, but Zhuo Fan’s look made him hesitate, “Sir Zhuo, how come your hair isn’t white anymore?”
“To keep my nose down, ha-ha-ha…”
Chuckling, Zhuo Fan brought a black strand to his eyes, only to shake his head. The white hair was due to the grief that once assaulted his heart. Maybe because Demon Transformation Art and the swamp had combined that his hair was now raven, if not blacker. A kind of black that came from absorbing anything, even light.
Maybe it was the result of his second soul, Devouring Domain, after swallowing everything.
Regardless, it wouldn’t matter much while being a lone operator. Being eternally away from any friends, the more he changed the better.
Zhuo Fan flicked his hand and threw the hair behind before walking towards the pond.
He was sure one of the eight World Wind Tunnels was inside.
[That ol’ dragon’s sketch ain’t so crummy after all. Let’s set up the drawing array and get it over with.]
“Ah, what is that?”
Lian’er cried while pointing at the pond.
Everyone looked over and shook. In the pond appeared huge and strange things. Each of them was thousands of meters wide and bore savage looks.
But the pond was akin to a mirror, as each creature minded its own business, not even registering they were there.
This, however, did not stop their power from shaking their core. These things weren’t mere spiritual beasts.
Tuoba Liufeng was grave, “W-what are those things? It’d be a disaster if they come out.”
“Nether Sea!”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed.
The others looked at him cluelessly. Zhuo Fan did not offer any explanation.
The Nether Sea was the biggest ruthless area in the Sacred Domain. Not even a Saint would tread inside it. Scores of 12th grade aquatic spiritual beasts roamed it, while the entire sea was covered in a dark air. It was a place of extreme yin.
Anyone’s power would drop sharply there.
This World Wind Tunnel connected the Nether Sea, which explained the weirdness of this swamp. Affected by the Nether Sea, it changed in a bizarre way.
The creatures inside the pond were not really monsters living within it, but what the light of the moon reflected on its surface due to the thick yin that had gathered, allowing a glimpse into the Nether Sea.
With that settled, Zhuo Fan started waving his hands around, sending sacred stones all over the pond, disturbing its surface.
The trio was afraid of disturbing him.
Three hours later, Zhuo Fan had enough of throwing stones around and made a sign, shouting, “Moon spirit seal this field of flowers, draw onto the mortal domain until the mountain forms, to break the heavens!”
Hum~
A spatial ripple passed and the clear pond shook, as if the space warped. But then it stilled again like nothing happened.
What they saw was the same field of flowers spreading everywhere.
Sixth prince was curious, “Sir Zhuo, what about the pond?”
“I sealed it.”
Zhuo Fan entered the field of flowers and no longer sank like last time. The Abyssal Swamp was no more, “I sealed this place so there won’t be anymore swamp, nor will it open under the moonlight.”
Sixth prince nodded, “Is this Sir Zhuo’s aim?”
“Yep.” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, then left, “I’m done here so I’m leaving. Since you’ve helped me along the way, I’ll return the favor to be fair and square.”
A bloody glow flashed from Zhuo Fan and the dao blood aura came out again. It flew high in the sky and vanished, but then wailing was heard from everywhere.
Lian’er asked, “What’s that?”
“Beast Taming Sect’s higher ups are dead, which leaves the disciples. Since you won’t be able to handle them, I’ll do it for you.” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone coldly.
Lian’er shuddered, realizing Zhuo Fan was destroying the entire sect.
The sixth prince was overjoyed, bowing at once in tears of gratitude, “Thanks you, Sir Zhuo for all you’ve done. Quanrong will never forget this…”

chapters.title: Chapter 827: Quanrong’s Matters
chapters.content:
Chapter 827: Quanrong’s Matters
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Commander Touba, are your aides gone?”
Behind Quanrong’s palace, the forlorn emperor sat on a rock as he sighed.
Tuoba Tieshan nodded heavily at the side, “Your Majesty, I’m aware of the gravity of this matter to take such measures, going as far as sending away the people I trusted for decades. Regardless, I still need to know just what is going on.
“Old commander, there’s no harm in telling you now that you’re in this mess.”
Looking at the moon, the emperor took a deep breath and began, “Oh, the disgrace, the Quanrong’s greatest humiliation. For so many years, in this palace…”
Whoosh!
His words got cut off as a figure came out of the dark cave, soon followed by three more.
The emperor was startled and cried out, “Y-you weren’t found out?”
The trio looked at each other and shook their heads.
[More like this bigshot here was strutting inside out of fear of not being found out!]
Zhuo Fan scratched his head.
Sixth prince chuckled and bowed, “Imperial father, they found us the second we got in and that led to a long fight.”
“Then why…” The emperor was in disbelief.
[You were found out and fought, yet still got out? What’s going on here? Since when was the Beast Taming Sect so weak?]
He had been waiting here for the Beast Taming Sect to come for revenge, to kill him. Now he found out that none came, instead greeted by the people who should, by all accounts, be dead instead. Even the emperor found it hard to cope with such facts.
Sixth prince laughed, “Imperial father, Sir Zhuo’s power is unmatched. He has gotten rid of all the bastards making the Beast Taming Sect!”
“All of them?”
The emperor and Tuoba Tieshan blinked in shock, “W-what?”
The sixth prince’s eyes shone with joy, “Imperial father, Sir Zhuo has purged the world of the Beast Taming Sect. We will no longer suffer at those bastards’ hands!”
Shaking all over, the emperor and Tuoba Tieshan stared at Zhuo Fan like he grew a second head.
[One guy destroyed a sect? Is that possible?]
“Son, is this true?” The emperor was still in denial, but hope began to blossom.
Lian’er and the other two smiled. She took a step forward and bowed, “Your Majesty, sixth prince is correct. He was so ruthless as to remove all the disciples as well. Not one survived.”
Lian’er complained, but her words sounded pleased, like Zhuo Fan did her a favor.
Giving Zhuo Fan another long look, the emperor became grave.
“Son, come here!”
The emperor grabbed him and threw himself at Zhuo Fan’s feet, “I’m but Ha Lichai, Quanrong Emperor. I am immensely grateful for saving Quanrong of this calamity. We shall never forget this.”
Tuoba Tieshan and the rest were in shock at his display, “Your Majesty, you can’t do this. You’re the lord of our nation…”
“Some lord I am. Without Sir Zhuo, I would’ve still been a figurehead even now.” The emperor rose and showed a bitter smile, “Commander Touba, didn’t you want to know how hard it has been? It is the greatest shame and humiliation for Quanrong and the imperial family!”
The emperor looked at the sixth prince, “Son, you know as well, don’t you?”
“I know everything, even how my mother died.” Desolate, the sixth prince sighed, looking at Zhuo Fan with gratitude, “Sir Zhuo, all these years, Quanrong’s palace had been nothing more than a place for the Beast Taming Sect’s elders to vent their lust.”
[What?]
Tuoba Liufeng cried out with the others. Only Zhuo Fan had guessed it and was calm, “Since the tunnel was located near the imperial harem, it has nothing to do with politics. Then there’s that woman you killed in tunnel. She’s the emperor’s…”
“Concubine.”
Eyes flashing with murder, sixth prince gnashed his teeth. “In the entire western lands, the guardian sects don’t involve themselves in a nation’s politics, except Beast Taming Sect. Being just ten miles from the imperial capital, it held Quanrong in a tight grip. This was the usual practice in the past. Only later they went even further, cutting a tunnel to the imperial harem to indulge.”
The emperor nodded. “This tunnel has been around for centuries, throwing the harem in chaos. Every emperor was aware of this but none could expose Beast Taming Sect’s debauchery. All the girls of the palace would be taken in by force by those elders. Any that refused still, would be dealt a savage blow. In face of such a situation, many women compromised. But some, who were loyal, like the sixth prince’s mother, chose death instead.”
“They had come begging for help, only for them to turn a deaf ear and play the inapt ruler.” The emperor shook his head with teary eyes.
Tuoba Tieshan clenched his fists in anger.
The ruler of a nation couldn’t even protect his women. It was a national disgrace!
Commander Touba’s fury hadn’t subsided as sixth prince continued, “But then it got worse. These rotten bastards plotted against Quanrong’s leadership. Many of imperial father’s sons, including Crown Prince, aren’t even his.”
“What?!”
Outraged, Tuoba Tieshan shook, “Does that mean… they wanted to affect the imperial family’s bloodline?”
The emperor was filled with hatred, “Yes, with the backing in the shadows, they planned on taking control of Quanrong from me. Especially that Crown Prince, appointed as the next emperor by the Beast Taming Sect’s Sect Leader himself. No matter how I saw it, he was his son. Humph, woe is me, the great emperor of Quanrong, reduced to passing the throne to someone other than my son.”
“This is absurd! A secluded sect wants imperial power? What empire in western lands would ever want to have them as support then? You have to report this to Double Dragon Manor at once! How can we bow down?”
Bam!
Tuoba Tieshan punched a nearby rock to dust as he cursed.
The emperor and sixth prince sighed, “Commander Touba, you’re too naive. There’s no such thing as good and evil in this world. Righteousness is nothing more than a rule to enslave mortals.”
Seeing their downcast looks, Tuoba Tieshan was startled.
Zhuo Fan nodded.
“Commander Touba, if the emperor had told Double Dragon Manor, would they purge Beast Taming Sect?” Zhuo Fan asked Tuoba Tieshan.
Tuoba Tieshan paused then shook his head, “The nine sects of western lands are its main power. Taking one out meant crippling themselves. Double Dragon Manor would never do this.”
“Exactly. As long as Beast Taming Sect exists, a few years later this news would die down. But would you, a third rate nation, was able to bear their revenge?”
Tuoba Tieshan turned grave and sighed.
Zhuo Fan laughed at the sky, “I can now understand somewhat the feeling Danqing Shen had when he stomped on the nine sects. Western lands is nothing more than a tranquil hell. Order and righteousness are nothing more than filthy excuses. There’re some things only demonic cultivators can do. Evil begets more evil, ha-ha-ha…”
“Sixth prince, this is what you had in mind when you took me to Crown Prince and then the imperial palace.” Zhuo Fan laughed, eying him, “Though I’ve been searching all the time, even without clues, I’m still willing to bet you’d take me here. All so I would clash with the Beast Taming Sect…”
“I would never!”
The sixth prince rushed to bow, “I know Sir Zhuo’s style more than anyone, hating being used. I never ever dreamed of using you either, no matter how much I wanted to when we met. Seeing sir’s display at Double Dragon Gathering, I knew your character and that you wouldn’t stand for these hypocritical bastards. All I entertained was a thread of hope that sir would help free Quanrong of their suffering.”
“I would’ve been happy even if I only helped sir to find what you sought. You must believe me that I’m just a fanboy!”
Looking him dead in the eye, Zhuo Fan nodded, “I know. I’ve been testing you all the way here. Even when you were excited, you still didn’t try to shift my decisions. This was good enough…”

chapters.title: Chapter 828: Closure
chapters.content:
Chapter 828: Closure
Proofreader
: Papatonks
The sixth prince’s eyes lit up and beamed.
Zhuo Fan chuckled, turning to leave, “Well then, it’s time for me to leave. Take care.”
“You’re just going to leave?” Lian’er cried out. The sixth prince was also taken aback, “Hold on, sir. After destroying the Beast Taming Sect, you’ll have a hard time moving through western lands…”
“It’s fine. Western lands has no way of restricting a dead man.”
Zhuo Fan spoke, “Moreover, after paying them a visit, I will leave western lands for good.”
“Y-you’re even leaving the western lands? Where will you go?” Lian’er looked with deep longing hearing that he would be gone to who knows where.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Anywhere I can in this vast world, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan jumped and flew away, out of sight.
Sixth prince jumped to his feet and shouted, “Sir Zhuo, I’m your fan! Won’t you learn my name?”
“Say it.” A faint voice came from the night sky.
“Zhuo Er!”
“Ha-ha-ha, you have my family name. I’ll remember that.”
“That’s not it. My entire name is Hulalsharutiastti Zhuoer. You can’t forget it!”
A pensive silence fell over the world, before an irate voice snapped, “The hell I will!”
The others smiled.
[Sir Zhuo is such a blunt guy.]
Only Lian’er sighed in desolation.
“Commander Touba!”
Tuoba Tieshan looked back to see the emperor looking at him with a stone-cold face, “Commander Touba, you are henceforth reinstated as the head of the Quanrong army, its commander. Gather all the city guards and sweep the imperial capital clean of anyone related to the Beast Taming Sect, including those concubines. The empress, the princess, all of them are to be put down. Don’t let any of them escape. Even with Sir Zhuo destroying all of the Beast Taming Sect, there are still many of them waging war at the border with Tianyu. Do this without letting any of them catch wind of this and come back for revenge!”
Tuoba Tieshan shook and ventured, “Your Majesty, all of them? There’s just too many people?”
“Every single one!”
The emperor spoke with an edge to his tone, “I’ve had enough of these bastards over the past years. It’s time for their penance. No one shall steal Quanrong from me, ha-ha-ha…”
The Touba brothers glanced at the crazed emperor in fear.
He was meek before Beast Taming Sect, he was miserable before Zhuo Fan, but now, His Majesty got hold of his power and his actions were swift and cruel in getting rid of any vestige the Beast Taming Sect had on this earth.
By comparison, Zhuo Fan was blunt and determined, although seeing himself as the bad guy.
Lian’er looked at the sky with longing.
Tuoba Tieshan bowed and carried out his order.
Zhuo Fan was somewhat far from here but he still heard the man clearly having entered the Ethereal Stage.
[Humans, they need but a thought to become saints or demons. No one is better than the next. They all turn demonic once they grasp power.]
This was the way the world worked. The nobles oppressed the people, who had the emperors oppressing them, who had the sects breathing down their necks, with finally the very top experts coming down on the sects. As for those experts, they were at their turn at the whims of the world’s laws, unable to break from them.
One must constantly improve, grow stronger and stronger if they hope to shed their shackles, even above the entire world.
Zhuo Fan had gleaned into the way the ten ancient Sovereigns were thinking. They did not want to be under anyone either!
Smirking, Zhuo Fan flashed out of there…
Three months later, in an open field of sand, military tents were arranged in perfect order, with no end in sight.
In their center lay the biggest tent, the one that also released the strongest aura.
“The war has been going for six months now without bearing any result. We’ve lost scores of good men and sent out a jade slip for aid but help is late to arrive. We can no longer fight!”
An old man with a twirled beard looked at his men with a sigh. The others sighed as well.
“In the previous wars as long as Quanrong’s warriors fought, we’d still make some headway since the strongest in these wars would be in the Radiant Stage and the common people could still handle. But with Tianyu growing so fast, they just sent Ethereal Stage experts on the battlefield forcing us to send our own to withstand the pressure. But this is no war. It’s now been reduced to showing off one’s power. It’s more apt to call it a war between sects than nations.”
“Who said it isn’t? Do any of you think Tianyu’s three guardian sects didn’t send anyone, that they’re all Tianyu’s men?” One elder spoke.
The others shook their heads.
“Ever since the Luo Alliance formed in Tianyu, its power grew close to that of a sect. They may as well be a tenth sect in western lands in the future!”
“Yeah, yeah…”
“Tianyu is just too strong for a mere empire…”
All the officials here nodded their heads as they discussed among themselves.
A shout came from beyond the tent, “Imperial capital’s jade slip has arrived! “
“The imperial capital’s response is here. Did reinforcements come?”
Perking up, the top elder laughed as he hurriedly said, “Give me the jade slip!”
“Yes, sir!”
A soldier bowed and walked in to give the jade slip. The elder snatched it in joy, but then froze.
The others were curious, “Old man, what’s up? What does it say? Did the Sect Leader send curses for being useless and that no men are coming?”
“If only…”
The elder’s shoulders shook, putting on the most heart-wrenching expression he could, “It’s Quanrong emperor’s jade slip. He said that three months ago, some power infiltrated the nation and wreaked havoc in the imperial capital. To make it worse, it destroyed the Beast Taming Sect. W-we’re homeless!”
[What?]
Everyone looked stumped. While they were fighting here with their lives on the line, their home was getting pillaged.
[What the hell?]
“It must be Tianyu! They must’ve sent someone to attack our backs. I’m going to kill them!”
“Is it really them though? The sect is stronger than just the few we have here and it has a defensive array as well. Tianyu would’ve long since killed us if it could destroy our sect. What kind of an idiot would drag this useless war on instead?”
“Oh, right…”
“True, true…”
Everyone pondered but the same guy just wouldn’t give up, “Then who else could destroy our sect?”
“Demon Scheming Sect!”
Another man shouted, “Think about it. Demon Scheming Sect is guarding Tianyu yet suddenly gives us a thousand sacred stones to attack it. This is clearly a trap. We never saw through their intentions but now we know. It’s cutting off our escape!”
“Blast it! I’ll kill them all!” Someone jumped to his feet, about to march to Demon Scheming Sect.
Another one cursed, “Cut the crap, with the sect gone, we alone are nothing. Are you suicidal to get revenge like this? “
“What else are we supposed to do?”
“Go to Double Dragon Manor. We’ll have them take revenge for us. The Exalted will settle it!”
The others nodded, having met consensus. So, the Quanrong’s army withdrew.
Across from Quanrong’s camp, Luo Yunhai and Elder Li were discussing their plans when a report came, “Marshal, Quanrong is retreating! They’re all leaving!”
“They’re leaving?”
Luo Yunhai looked at him with a dumb look, “Why? Just yesterday they pushed hard at us with their spiritual beast army. We only managed to hold thanks to the sacred stone array. But that still didn’t give us any advantage? Why the sudden withdrawal?”
Leng Wuchang spoke, “Maybe the cost was too much. Since nothing worked, they wasted too many resources and men. Or maybe something happened back home, to their leaders.”
Leng Wuchang’s eyes flashed, “Guard, scout Quanrong at once! Just what happened?”
“Yes, sir!” A man bowed and left swiftly.
Luo Yunhai sighed, much relaxed now, “This war took six months but it’s finally over. Demon Scheming Sect wanted to wear down our will to fight but now that the enemy withdrew their troops, everything is ruined. It’s like brother Zhuo is watching us from beyond.”
“Clan Head, you shouldn’t give Steward Zhuo’s spirit all the credit.” Leng Wuchang scratched his head.
Eying him, Luo Yunhai said, “Sister said that one should respect immortals. We also should respect the Luo clan’s ancestor and brother Zhuo just the same.”
“That’s just superstition. If Steward Zhuo is up there somewhere, he should just get rid of the Demon Scheming Sect and do us a solid. Don’t you agree, Clan Head?”
Leng Wuchang glanced at Leng Wuchang then shook his head, “Sir Leng, ha-ha-ha…”

chapters.title: Chapter 829: Back to Demon Scheming Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 829: Back to Demon Scheming Sect
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Before a magnificent and lush forest stood a man. He was all black, including his hair and those deep black eyes. The biting wind traced his face.
Zhuo Fan was at the entrance of the Demon Scheming Sect.
His mind made on leaving western lands, now that he set up the array, he still felt like paying his old friends one last visit. The first on the list was his esteemed master.
Who said a demonic cultivator didn’t value his master? He might just be the only one he’d bid farewell in person. Regarding Luo Yunhai and the rest, he’d settle for watching them from afar before leaving…
Hum~
He made a sign and despite all the warping space, it just settled down soon after.
“Did the method to open it change?” Frowning, Zhuo Fan muttered, “While that may be when there’s a traitor among the sect, to stop them from returning, by all accounts, they should think I’m dead. Does this mean this was set by another?”
Zhuo Fan was pensive then shook his head, “Whatever, after saying goodbye to Elder Yuan, none of it would matter. You might’ve closed the door, but I have another way in, humph…”
Zhuo Fan made a different gesture.
It was something Elder Yuan taught him when he became the new Sect Leader. Only he could use it.
As long as the sect’s defensive array didn’t change, this method would remain. With how utterly expensive and time consuming it was to change it completely, no sane sect would ever do that.
Hum~
Zhuo Fan had no trouble opening it this time, seeing as how a path opened up.
Grinning, Zhuo Fan walked right in.
He could’ve used the black flame too, but he went for subtlety this time around…
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan moved from hiding to hiding, searching the Demon Scheming Sect for Elder Yuan, yet there was no sign of him even in High Venerable’s secluded room.
What baffled him was that the Demon Scheming Sect was no longer as lively as before. There was not one familiar face in sight, no Venerable Bai, no laborer.
Frowning, Zhuo Fan’s heart sank with unease.
After Ye Lin brought him to Ultimate Clarity Sect, he was stuck in the Infernal Gorge with the dragon ancestor. Ye Lin had told him of the outside’s state, but the Demon Scheming Sect wasn’t included in the news.
Now that he was here, something was off about this place.
“Did you hear? The Beast Taming Sect withdrew from the battle without so much as a word. Those damn fools in Tianyu have gotten away again!”
“Didn’t we give those bastards a thousand sacred stones already? They even said they’d root out the clan from Tianyu so why are they suddenly backing down? I just knew we couldn’t trust those fools who only know to hang around beasts. Sect Leader Xie and Venerable Shi are going to be pissed.”
“Isn’t he already? I just heard Sect Leader’s roar coming from the Main Hall. Well he did spend a thousand sacred stones. You think we’d have asked them if we couldn’t do it ourselves? To avoid a repeat of last time, with Heaven Trailing Sect messing it all up, Sect Leader gave those guys plenty of stuff. At this rate, all the winnings Zhuo Fan got us will soon be used up.”
“What? Just how many is it this time…”
Two people were grumbling while passing by Zhuo Fan’s hiding place. They were inner sect elders.
Squinting, Zhuo Fan checked his surroundings and then shot for the two.
Whoosh~
They had no chance when the shadow descended upon them, clutching their throats and sealing their Yuan Qi before leaving the place.
They looked around confused when they suddenly slumped on the ground, only to find themselves on the mountain behind the sect.
The two cried out, “Who dares attack the Demon Scheming Sect? We’re its elders!”
“I know.”
Walking closer, the sunlight shone over Zhuo Fan, “Why else do you think I grabbed you. Remember me?”
The two’s eyes got used to the glaring sun and were then rooted in shock, “Z-Zhuo Fan? Aren’t you dead?”
“Ha-ha-ha, I figured as much, you did have something to do with those bastards from Universal Righteous Sect.”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “But I’m from the Demon Scheming Sect and the Sect Leader at that. As long as you’re not behind it, I am willing to let the elders of my sect go, ha-ha-ha…”
Shaking all over, the two bobbed their heads, pleading. “Sect Leader Zhuo, this had nothing to do with us. It’s all Venerable Shi and Xie Wuyue’s plot…”
“I know, I know.”
Zhuo Fan waved them off in annoyance, “I don’t care about that. What I want to know…”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes hardened, “Where is High Venerable and Venerable Bai with the rest? Where are the laborers?”
The two shivered, lowering their heads.
Zhuo Fan’s heart sank, putting on a savage smile, “I see, since you don’t see me as a Sect Leader, then you’re no elders to me. I should get rid of traitors like you.”
Zhuo Fan raised his hand, gushing black smoke.
“Wait, please, Sect Leader Zhuo! We’ve always seen you as our Sect Leader!” The two panicked.
“Then why don’t you answer? Are you defying my orders?”
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan’s aura exploded with bloodthirst, making the two elders feel chilled to the bone.
The two bowed once again and begged, “Sect Leader Zhuo, please, we won’t hide anything from you. Please spare us, Sect Leader…”
The two then spilled everything that had happened. Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, hatred building in his eyes.
He thought the Universal Righteous Sect attack was only to deal with him, but that piece of garbage Xie Wuyue even struck High Venerable before removing any that was tied with him in the sect.
As far as going after the Luo clan who rescued the stragglers, using Beast Taming Sect to do it.
“Sect Leader Zhuo, it’s all Venerable Shi and Xie Wuyue’s fault. We didn’t do anything, we just followed orders.”
The two begged in tears.
Zhuo Fan clenched his fists with bloodshot eyes. The most respected elder in the mortal domain, the only one who he took as his master was now dead, before he could even say goodbye.
[Curse you, Xie Wuyue!]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes were filled with bloodthirst. He flicked his hand and had the two wrapped in black smoke.
The two shouted, “Sect Leader Zhuo, spare us! We’ll remove the traitors with you! Please let us go! We’re also elders of the Demon Scheming Sect. As a Sect Leader, you have to let us live!”
“Screw being a sect leader.”
Zhuo Fan cursed, “I became Sect Leader only because Elder Yuan asked. Now that he’s gone, I’d be a moron to become one for you fools. You really think I’d let you live after killing my people with Xie Wuyue?”
[Demon Transformation Art!]
The two howled as the black smoke enveloped them. Their pain and grief was laid bare until the very end.
Once the black smoke scattered, dust fell in the wind.
Zhuo Fan flicked his hand. He was out for blood, his bloodthirst increasing as he marched for the Main Hall…

chapters.title: Chapter 830: His Spirit Above
chapters.content:
Chapter 830: His Spirit Above
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“God damn it! Damn that Beast Taming Sect! Taking my money yet it won’t do its part?”
Bam!
Xie Wuyue pulverized a mahogany table to dust in a fit of rage. His eyes were burning with hatred.
Venerable Shi sat nearby with a frown. He sighed, “This is odd indeed. A sect wouldn’t back out of their deal just like that. What could have led to this?”
“Nothing, that’s what! A bunch of savages got scared after hitting a snag.” Xie Wuyue snapped, “What’s worse is that they ran with our damn sacred stones! Curse them all! Then bribing Heaven Trailing Sect is also costly. There’s almost nothing left of the winnings from the Double Dragon Gathering!”
Venerable Shi shook his head, “Ha-ha-ha, can’t bear to see them go? You shouldn’t have taken the seat back then. That way the Demon Scheming Sect would’ve surely flourished.”
“Venerable Shi, what’s your point?” Xie Wuyue squinted with malice.
Venerable Shi lazily put one leg over the other while shaking his head, “Isn’t it obvious? All inner conflicts are sources of heavy loss at core, with no fruits when overcome. Funny thing is people never get tired of doing it. And why, you ask, just so they can sit their ass in the biggest chair. Ha-ha-ha, that’s what happened to Tianyu’s emperor and the same goes for you. If the Luo clan didn’t rise and stop the emperor’s scheme, Tianyu would’ve lost a tenth of their lands and would’ve weakened greatly. Now though, Tianyu still has the Yuwen clan at the helm.
“As for us, if we hadn’t gone after Zhuo Fan so hard, we’d still have the ten thousand sacred stones to grow the sect. With Zhuo Fan, the Sect Leader, sent to Double Dragon Manor, the future was bound to have us as middle-three sect at the very least. But rather than enjoy such a great future, it was much better to have your ass stuck to that chair. Ha-ha-ha, you win some, you lose some. The sect is in a dump, but we have our Sect Leader and I’m still the first venerable!”
Xie Wuyue gnashed his teeth, “Are you saying that all of this is my fault? That Zhuo Fan was a better Sect Leader than me?”
“That’s not it at all. I’m only stating facts.”
Venerable Shi squinted, “Besides, what’s the point of a strong Demon Scheming Sect if I don’t have my seat. Ha-ha-ha, I’m only urging Sect Leader to ease up and stop minding the lost sacred stones. What matters is that we’re still the leaders here.”
Xie Wuyue faltered, then sighed, “Yeah, Venerable Shi is right. As long as we are here, winning or losing doesn’t matter. Everything is ours, not someone else’s.”
Venerable Shi nodded pleased, but discontent still flashed in his eyes.
[Xie Wuyue, what a shame for High Venerable, so astute and sharp, working for the betterment of the sect, only to have such dumb disciple.]
[Greed has taken root in your heart, turning you into my puppet. Having a Sect Leader as my pawn ain’t that bad, ha-ha-ha…]
Grinning, Venerable Shi stayed silent.
“Ha-ha-ha, what a shameless disciple, being proud of running the sect into the ground. Elder Yuan’s toil for a thousand years was ruined in a blink by bastards like you. His spirit above wouldn’t know rest watching you.”
Startled at the sudden cold shout, the two jerked in panic, “Who’s there? You dare toy with the Demon Scheming Sect? Come out now!”
“Toy? Ha-ha-ha, this is no game though.” Zhuo Fan came out from a shadowy corner with a mocking smile.
Xie Wuyue and Venerable Shi were shellshocked, “Y-you’re supposed to be dead!”
“Of course you’d want me dead.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes were cold, “But I’m still alive. Who else would take revenge for Elder Yuan? As his disciple, it’s my duty to clean up the dregs and the rats.”
Xie Wuyue recoiled, but then steeled his heart, “You want to kill us? Humph, you, who hasn’t even entered the Ethereal Stage in ten years here…”
Whoosh~
A golden light shone and Zhuo Fan flashed in their faces. The aura made them choke on their words.
[So fast!]
“To be honest, I just entered it.” With an evil smirk, Zhuo Fan punched at Xie Wuyue.
Sss~
The almighty power of his fist made it hard to breathe before it even landed. It forced the two to stagger back, right as the punch passed by.
Whoosh~
The scorching gale reached his face, burning him, while the mighty strike hit a wall, blowing a huge hole in it. The force then shot into the sky, making it quiver, punching a gap in it.
Xie Wuyue was overwhelmed, stumbling backward as he was covered in sweat.
When he finally stood straight, the punch had ripped his robe on his chest open.
Xie Wuyue was even more shocked, watching Zhuo Fan in fear.
It was his first time really fighting Zhuo Fan, but as it happened, Zhuo Fan was at his strongest.
Zhuo Fan had been in the Profound Heaven Stage when he got to Demon Scheming Sect and even when he entered Radiant Stage and formed his dragon soul, he still was no match.
Now though, in the Ethereal Stage, with two souls, dragon ancestor’s refining and Qilin arm, Zhuo Fan was in perfect form.
Not even a Soul Harmony expert could survive a clash with him, let alone peak Ethereal Stage Xie Wuyue.
Xie Wuyue staggered backward two steps. Venerable Shi did the same, coming next to Xie Wuyue.
Zhuo Fan was beyond strong, even forcing Xie Wuyue back with one casual punch.
Zhuo Fan did not care what they did since they couldn’t stop him. He only had a devious smile on his face, “That punch was a miss on purpose. Xie Wuyue, weren’t you always in denial about me? Weren’t you always questioning why Elder Yuan chose me to be Sect Leader? I’ll let my strength do the talking. You and I are worlds apart. You’re not fit to be a Sect Leader, not even worthy to lick my shoes!”
“Zhuo Fan!”
Shuddering, Xie Wuyue found Zhuo Fan’s taunt insufferable. His biggest regret had been when his master accepted someone else over him.
He wanted to prove to himself that he was better than Zhuo Fan, that his master was wrong.
But with Zhuo Fan before him and taunting, he found himself lacking the nerve to fight. That punch alone told him Zhuo Fan was terrifying.
Venerable Shi glanced at Xie Wuyue, “Sect Leader, we can’t fight him. I’m going to get help while you stall him.”
Venerable Shi trembled as he went for the door and fled.
Xie Wuyue didn’t react the whole time, only looking at Zhuo Fan in panic. It was either fight or flight, but he was struggling to make a decision.
He did want to fight to prove himself, but instinct told him fleeing was healthier.
Zhuo Fan ignored Venerable Shi, “We’re both Elder Yuan’s disciples. His spirit is watching us from above. Xie Wuyue, today we’ll see if master was right or not. If you win, you are the one in the right. If I win, I absolve master!”
Xie Wuyue’s fists clenched, a fire burning in his eyes. “Master, watch me, I’ll prove to you I’m right. Zhuo Fan is no match for me!”
“We’ll let facts speak for themselves!”
Snickering, Zhuo Fan looked at the sky with a soft gaze.
[Elder Yuan, I and Xie Wuyue will be fighting. It is a fight between disciples, but also for you. Judge for yourself, master…]

chapters.title: Chapter 831: Wiping the Shame
chapters.content:
Chapter 831: Wiping the Shame
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Whoosh~
Xie Wuyue’s hand went through gestures with bloodshot eyes. He was in a crazed state, obsessed with beating his enemy just to prove himself right, that he was the best Sect Leader the Demon Scheming Sect could ever have, that his master was wrong all along.
By contrast, Zhuo Fan was standing there, waiting for him to finish without even paying him any attention.
It was complete disregard.
Xie Wuyue, as he was now, was nothing more than a bug to him.
The condescending look only worked to drive Xie Wuyue’s rage to new heights. Finally done with wiggling his fingers around, a deep roaring came from the sharp winds exploding into existence. The flood dragons wound around each other before shooting for Zhuo Fan with their claws and maws ready to maul him.
“Quasi earth ranked martial art, Dragon Crushing Flood!”
Boom!
The three flood dragons slammed into the dull Zhuo Fan, enveloping into a tri-colored tornado that covered the entire Main Hall.
The storm was so savage that it pulverized the Main Hall’s ceiling as it touched it.
Anything that got near it would be turned to dust.
Xie Wuyue panted, then snickered, “Ha-ha-ha, against my quasi earth ranked martial art, not even a Soul Harmony expert could come out alive. Especially not you who didn’t even defend, overconfident in your strength. You’re suicidal taking it on like that. One more reason you’re unfit to be a sect leader…”
Bam!
His gloating was cut short as the tri-colored storm vanished.
Zhuo Fan eased down his hand, standing there like it hardly was worth the effort.
“Going by that skill alone, nothing you do can harm me. I have an unbreakable body, not something a dog’s bite can even scratch.”
Brushing the dust off his shoulder, Zhuo Fan’s clothes were broken in places, revealing his perfect and unmarred build. His skin even had a golden hue to it.
It was obvious Zhuo Fan didn’t use Yuan Qi to shield himself from the storm, evident by his shabby clothes. This only made it even more scary, proving he really had one obscenely tough body that not even a peak Ethereal Stage expert’s quasi earth ranked martial art could break.
This outrageous fact had never appeared in the entire world, least of all the western lands.
[Abomination!]
Xie Wuyue was still in denial, but more so helpless. That was his strongest skill but Zhuo Fan just shrugged it off.
Next was a battle of souls.
Xie Wuyue’s eyes shook and a flood dragon came from his body in a gray light.
“Tear the sky, Flood Dragon Claw!”
Roar!
The flood dragon bared its claws at Zhuo Fan’s chest.
“Humph, I know you have the heaven dragon soul, but you only formed it five years ago. My soul has…”
Bam!
Xie Wuyue’s eyes had a savage glint as he raved, only to see his flood dragon getting smacked away before even reaching Zhuo Fan.
Xie Wuyue shook and spat blood. Looking ahead, he saw a scarlet dragon claw in front of Zhuo Fan.
With a look of scorn, Zhuo Fan said, “When it comes to souls, power isn’t determined by just time. Strong is strong and weak is weak. My dragon soul needn’t even come out to finish off your flood dragon. Xie Wuyue, you are nothing to me!”
“Zhuo Fan!”
Roaring at the top of his lungs, Xie Wuyue had lost his mind, throwing himself at Zhuo Fan. His hand flashed and revealed a bloody spear in the 10th grade..
“Your body can be invincible for all I care, but you still can’t defeat me…”
Bam!
The spear was smashed in his very hands and turned into red motes as they flew away.
Startled, Xie Wuyue was in disbelief.
[How did a 10th grade spiritual weapon just break?]
Looking forward again, he saw Zhuo Fan holding a pitch-black longsword.
Zhuo Fan’s gaze was still, devoid of any feelings. “I’m also a refiner. 10th grade items are nothing.”
Shaking all over, Xie Wuyue’s mind was having a meltdown.
Utter defeat.
He was outclassed in every way imaginable, from skills and soul, to equipment. He had no chance in hell of winning now. His futile attempt at proving himself better only backfired with Zhuo Fan coming with strong responses beyond anything he could ever do.
The feeling of failure closed in on him, squeezing his chest and making him shiver. It wasn’t born out of fear, but out of helplessness.
[Just why did I lose?]
Zhuo Fan hid the demonic sword, his eyes stone-cold. His lofty position akin to an emperor looking down at a beggar.
“Zhuo Fan, I cannot lose to you!”
A shrill cry came from Xie Wuyue as he shot forth to strike again, clawing Zhuo Fan’s head.
“Xie Wuyue…”
Zhuo Fan spoke in a low and dark tone, “I didn’t strike you out for master, to show he made no mistake. Now, it’s time to wipe away the shame you brought.”
Whoosh~
His dead expression turned savage in a flash, twisted with rage. The ruthless aura spread around, decimating anything in its path.
Xie Wuyue’s claws were halted and he was filled with shock.
Zhuo Fan’s brutal Qilin arm took the moment to grab his head and slammed him head first into the pavement in the middle of shouting.
The Main Hall crumbled then and there, down in a deep crater.
Zhuo Fan was far from finished however, dragging Xie Wuyue around on the ground for a thousand miles.
“Xie Wuyue, I have brought the ten thousand sacred stones to the sect on my own merit. Now I am using my power to drag you around like a ragdoll. I had also gathered the respect of most of the sect. You lack in merit, a mere paper tiger in strength and are utterly useless when it comes to leading. So why can’t you just accept it, instead of insisting on fighting me for a seat? As well as…”
Zhuo Fan held Xie Wuyue’s hand into the dirt, speaking with red eyes and a ruthless tone. There were even some tears mixed in as well as he roared, “Going as far as killing your own master. I’d have failed master’s spirit watching us if I don’t rip you limb from limb!”
Rumble!
Zhuo Fan snatched Xie Wuyue out of the dirt and flung him into the air.
Xie Wuyue was looking mangled, his face beyond recognition and barely any teeth left. Alas, the glow around his body protected him from taking his meager life.
Zhuo Fan looked up, noticing the glow as well, coming from the 10th grade spiritual armor he gave Xie Wuyue before.
“Sect Leader, we came to help!”
Venerable Shi was back with reinforcements, all the elders and venerables in the sect, to surround Zhuo Fan.
Xie Wuyue showed a crazed smile, feeble as he was, “Zhuo Fan, you came very close to killing me, but too bad, you can’t now. This is all thanks to the spiritual armor you gave me. Ha-ha-ha, what a shame. With the other Ethereal Stage experts here, you have no chance at all. Providence is by my side all the way. I’ll live while you’ll die! The Demon Scheming Sect will be mine still, ha-ha-ha…”
“Moron, there’s no way a spiritual armor I made would protect someone who killed their own master.” Zhuo Fan’s left eye flashed with the black thunderflame.
Xie Wuyue’s spiritual armor exploded then and there in a gush of black thunderflame, searing his body. “W-what the hell is this! The armor…”
Zhuo Fan’s cruel smile said it all.
He never trusted Xie Wuyue, ever. So he laid a few tricks just in case. When they were still on friendly terms, he thought it best to place a spatial array inside the spiritual armor that connected to his Divine Eye of the Void.
Thanks to that neat trick, Zhuo Fan could use the power of Void Annihilation through the spiritual armor Xie Wuyue was wearing and take his life.
But since he had something much better, like the thunderflame, it was a shame not to use it.
Xie Wuyue’s squeals of pain soon died out, his figure burned wholly by the black thunderflame until there was nothing left. Zhuo Fan took a deep breath, looking at the sky.
[Master, I’ve wiped away the shame….]

chapters.title: Chapter 832: No Home without Kin
chapters.content:
Chapter 832: No Home without Kin
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Sect Leader!”
Xie Wuyue’s howls of agony inside the black thunderflame died out along with the signature of his soul. All that remained was the violent black thunderflame flickering in his place one last time before fading out as well.
Demon Scheming Sect’s elders were panicking. Xie Wuyue’s very existence had been erased from this world.
They slowly turned to the still figure beneath and gulped in horror.
It only took fifteen minutes for Venerable Shi to gather the elders and come here, just fifteen minutes.
It proved to be more than enough time for their Sect Leader, a peak Ethereal Stage expert, to die like nothing.
What did that say about Zhuo Fan’s power? Just how strong was he?
Seeing Xie Wuyue’s cruel demise, everyone’s heart was in their throat, looking at Zhuo Fan in fear.
Ignoring their fear mixed with hatred and anger, Zhuo Fan just walked away with a stone-cold face.
The ones surrounding him broke out in cold sweat and stepped back in fear each time he advanced. Fear had taken root in their hearts, robbing them of any will to fight.
Venerable Shi looked around with gnashed teeth and shouted, “Don’t let him escape! As long as he’s alive everything will unravel. Double Dragon Manor will side with him and ruin us. He has to die now for the Demon Scheming Sect to be ours.”
Shuddering, the elders halted, looking grave and finally releasing their bloodthirst.
Zhuo Fan stopped as well, glancing at Venerable Shi.
“Humph, no matter how strong, he’s all alone. Together, we’ll crush him to pieces!” Seeing his speech worked, Venerable Shi lifted their morale, “Letting him go will make him join Tianyu’s traitors. That will be the moment we’ll lose everything, even our lives. We can’t let that happen! We must end him here and now!”
Roar!
The old weasel sure knew how to use people, inciting them to fight. The fearful elders in front roared to mask their dread, releasing their souls and sending them to attack Zhuo Fan.
The air felt heavy as the horde of souls unleashed their power at Zhuo Fan, making the earth he stood on sink a hundred meters. The immense might brushed his cheek and fluttered his black hair.
But not even this grand display of raw force from Demon Scheming Sect’s best was enough to move Zhuo Fan. In fact he had on a mocking smile.
Looking around at the souls coming for his life, Zhuo Fan sneered, “I see, so there aren’t even a hundred Ethereal Stage experts left. Ha-ha-ha, and you wish to kill me now that the sect is so weak? Aren’t you a bit naive?”
“Humph, we may be weaker, but united. A hundred Ethereal Stage experts are enough to kill a prick like you…”
Whoosh~
Venerable Shi grinned, his words cut off by a shadow covering the sky and everyone around.
Their bodies and souls had black creeping over them, halting them in place.
Everything turned eerily quiet…
The elders were overwhelmed.
[What is this?]
Venerable Shi was the most shocked of all.
Zhuo Fan’s flat voice pierced their ears, “What a pity, Elder Yuan had toiled for this sect yet you fools snatched it. I’m sure his spirit wouldn’t want to see this. As his disciples, I should do my part in wiping away the disgrace…”
The endless shadow opened its maw like a deep abyss as something dragged them down to hell. The fear they felt was out of this world.
“W-what the hell is this?!”
Venerable Bai shouted, switching to begging, “Zhuo Fan, you can’t kill us or the Demon Scheming Sect is finished. The sect is High Venerable’s pride and joy. I know you care and respect him, and as his disciple, you wouldn’t want to see High Venerable’s efforts go to waste. Let’s make up, putting you as Sect Leader. We’ll listen to anything you say. Venerable Bai and the others can come back. We’ll hand over power and become laborers as penance.”
“Yeah, we’ll do anything as long as you spare us.”
“Sect Leader Zhuo, please let us go! We’re from the same sect. We should help each other…”
…
Everyone turned to pleading now that he had them in his tight grip.
Zhuo Fan paid their cawing no heed, “So now you appeal to my humanity, for being from the same sect? Ha-ha-ha… what about, the elders and Labor Office’s disciples, did you think about them the same?”
“Humph, that’s rich, using High Venerable as an excuse when it suits you. Venerable Shi, I’ve never seen such a crass and revolting act, going as low as using the same person you had killed.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed, “I’ll say this. I do see High Venerable as my master, but never Demon Scheming Sect as my home. It’s nothing but bullshit. High Venerable would’ve fallen for it and spared you and I would listen to him. Too bad you killed High Venerable and I ain’t as soft as him for the sect.”
“There’s no home without kin. Elder Yuan is gone from the Demon Scheming Sect and that broke any ties I had with this sect. Venerable Shi, I wonder if you’d spared High Venerable if you knew this day would come.”
Shuddering, Venerable Shi had no response.
“Ha-ha-ha, Venerable Shi, this is called a deadly sin, brought on by yourself. You’re to blame for your own death.”
Zhuo Fan flicked his hand and the blackness flooded the space. Wails were heard as it swallowed everyone.
[Demon Transformation Art!]
Pa!
The black domain faded away and Zhuo Fan stood alone.
His face never changed, still walking out of the sect.
The demonic sword flew out of him, whistling through the Demon Scheming Sect’s grounds as it painted the skies with the agony of its disciples.
Zhuo Fan’s step never faltered, his smile sad.
[Elder Yuan, I told you I only cared about you in this sect…]
A month later, in the Luo clan’s hall on top of Blackwind Mountain, Luo Yunhai sat in his main seat with elders on either side of him, each frowning and grave.
“Clan Head, I don’t know why Beast Taming Sect withdrew, but Demon Scheming Sect must’ve had something to do with it for sure. And with Heaven Trailing Sect giving the cold shoulder, it seems they’ll become our enemies at some point. We must be on constant guard around these three sects!” Venerable Bai spoke.
Everyone around agreed.
Fiend Yang shook his head, “It’s all our fault for bringing this disaster.”
“Venerable Yang, you mustn’t say that. Brother Zhuo had approached us in person and that makes us brothers. How can I just let you suffer? “
Luo Yunhai sighed, “We need to send more scouts to the Demon Scheming Sect just in case.”
They all nodded.
Rushed stepps approached, with Leng Wuchang bursting in with a jade slip. He bowed, “Clan Head, we know why Beast Taming Sect withdrew. The scouts report that six months ago some strange power invaded the Quanrong imperial capital, stamping Beast Taming Sect out and causing chaos in the city. Many princes died as well as other minor nobles. With their roots cut out, of course they’d withdraw, ha-ha-ha…”
“That really happened?”
There were gaps of shock around.
The more affected were the group from Demon Scheming Sect, “No matter how antagonistic the nine sects in western lands, none would go as far as total annihilation. Not even Danqing Shen went so far that time. There’s no way the force that did it was from western lands.”
“Who cares, it did us a solid, ha-ha-ha…” Leng Wuchang laughed.
Luo Yunhai nodded, “Yes, if any reinforcements came, we wouldn’t have lasted much longer. Regardless of where this power came from, it was godsent, brother Zhuo’s blessing!”
“Clan Head, you’re giving Steward Zhuo’s spirit all the credit again. If Steward Zhuo’s spirit had acted, he’d go pay his debt…”
“And kill Xie Wuyue, right?” Leng Wuchang smiled with a sigh, “Sir Leng, I’m not superstitious here and was only thinking. Brother Zhuo is a miracle worker, so much so that anything utterly baffling that is happening makes me think brother Zhuo was behind it, that his spirit is watching over us.”
Luo Yunhai’s passionate look touched the others.
“Report!”
A scout in black rushed into the hall, presenting a jade slip. “Demon Scheming Sect’s scouts say that somehow the Demon Scheming Sect was gone overnight!”
[What?!]
There was a collective gasp in shock.
Leng Wuchang shook, stunned for a good while, “Hell, Steward Zhuo’s spirit appeared for real…”

chapters.title: Chapter 833: Western Lands’ Unrest
chapters.content:
Chapter 833: Western Lands’ Unrest
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Hum~
With barely a sound to announce their arrival, many tense figures filled a small path.
They weren’t the only ones, as on all the hills around were rows upon rows of people.
In front of the path was a man in black, with black hair and black eyes. His gaze chilled everyone to the bone despite the sun shining above.
“Who the hell are you to break Mystical Heaven Sect’s barrier?” One disciple in white shouted.
The man in black simply walked on with an eerie vibe around him.
The disciples shook, feeling sweat trailing down their brow, yet none made a move. They knew this man was in the Ethereal Stage.
Only elders could face such power.
“Heed me well, stranger! Stop right there. This isn’t the outside world where an Ethereal Stage expert can just walk wherever. This is the Mystical Heaven Sect, with many peak elders and venerables. You have no business stirring up things here!”
Another one barked at the man in black, not that he gave a damn, still walking on.
The disciples were getting tense, feeling something bad would happen.
Whoosh~
The disciple in front looked over at the sound and was overjoyed to see the Sect Leader and the venerables here.
The power of 7th, 8th and 9th layer Ethereal Stage flooded the area, giving the disciples confidence and safety.
Even below Ethereal Stage as they were, they could tell the man in black was only in the 1st layer. With the best of the sect arriving, they could squash the interloper with their thumb. This fact filled them with confidence.
The first disciple even grew smug, “Ha-ha-ha, I told you to leave while you can. Now that Sect Leader is here, you have no chance. There’ll be no mercy for anyone who steps into our sect!”
“Tch, like sect, like people. I was kind enough to spare you last time, but now look at you, all lively and forgetful of past misfortune. You’re even yapping at me, ha-ha-ha…”
The man walked on uncarignly.
Sect Leader cupped his hands, “Sir, who are you? Which sect has come to Mystical Heaven Sect?”
Sect Leader was no fool like those disciples, being on his seat for centuries, he knew how to act.
Who cared if this guy was in the 1st layer. Did you know who had his back, or how strong they were? What kind of guy just waltzed in through a sect’s array set up with sacred stones? He had to be someone to do that.
It was common knowledge that such a man was representing the force behind him when he acted.
The floundering ignorant people would only earn a quick death at his hands. Only the sect grown disciples like Mystical Heaven Sect had would act like this too. The elders, however, knew more about the world, that cultivation wasn’t everything.
This gap in knowledge left the disciples stumped as to why Sect Leader showed such courtesy.
[He’s just in the 1st layer Ethereal Stage, Sect Leader? Why waste words with him? Are you scared?]
Sect Leader glared at them then sighed inside.
[These brats can only show off here, in the sect. Once they go out, they’ll be sure to step on someone’s toes and die without even knowing how.]
“Ha-ha-ha, Sect Leader Xuan, it’s been a while.”
The man in black stopped in front of him, revealing a familiar face, “Did you forget me already?”
Sect Leader Xuan narrowed his eyes, cupping his hands once he snapped out of it with gnashed teeth, “Zhuo Fan, you’re still alive, brat?”
“Fortune must smile upon me to come back from so many brushes with death.”
Zhuo Fan smirked, “You must know why I’m here, right?”
Sect Leader Xuan spat, “Why, it’s to take revenge, isn’t it?”
“Right you are.” Zhuo Fan spoke.
Sect Leader Xuan’s laughter was filled with sorrow, “Ha-ha-ha, you dare talk to me about vengeance? You took the life of my son!”
“Yep, I killed him.”
Zhuo Fan said, “A man’s gotta do what a man’s gotta do. I won’t deny it. You have all the right to attack me. However…”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone coldly, filled with bloodthirst. “You should’ve turned down Xie Wuyue instead of taking revenge on someone else. Demon Scheming Sect’s High Venerable is my revered master in Dao. I didn’t plan on nitpicking over this matter, but the killing of my master… “
“Ha-ha-ha, so now you know the pain of loss?”
Sect Leader Xuan cackled, “I see, the old coot mattered to you. If I knew, I’d have his corpse thrashed after Heaven Trailing Sword killed him. A son’s mistake is a father’s fault. A disciple’s fall is a master’s shortcoming. I should’ve taken all the rage I had for you on that old coot’s…”
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, gnashing his teeth, “Say that again!”
“I’ll say it a hudndred times if I want to. I’ll thrash his body, maul it, butcher it. You came just in time. Once I kill you, I’ll go to the Demon Scheming Sect and take that old fool’s head so you two would enjoy being mutilated together to quell my hatred.”
Zhuo Fan’s face fell, showing a cruel smile, “I was going to go easy on Qingcheng’s master and fellow disciples, only coming to deal with you. But now, Mystical Heaven Sect has no place in this world!”
“You, want to destroy us?”
Sect Leader Xuan laughed like mad, “Ignoring the fact it’s impossible for you alone, even if you bring help like last time, it won’t do squat! Destroying a sect in western lands will have severe repercussion to you and them!”
Zhuo Fan smirked, his eyes flashing with savagery, “To a dead man like me, no rules of western lands can hold me. Mystical Heaven Sect will never see tomorrow ever again!”
Zhuo Fan shot straight for Sect Leader Xuan enveloped in black.
“Kill him!”
Sect Leader Xuan roared, leading the charge.
A flood of people came at Zhuo Fan, while his darkness spread to every corner, covering the world…
…
Three months later, the Heaven Reaching Pavilion in Double Dragon Manor.
The Exalted sat in their seats with tightened brows. Below them were fifty Ethereal Stage experts, the survivors of Beast Taming Sect.
“So you’re saying it’s all Demon Scheming Sect’s scheme?” Exalted Hei Ran’s piercing gaze washed over them.
The men bobbed hteir heads, “Exalted, it’s without a doubt their plan. They first wanted us to wear down Tianyu, helping them eliminate their traitors only so they could ambush our sect from behind, even destroying it. If not that, how else would our sect barrier be broken so easily and have our home in ruins? Maybe Sect Leader’s guard was down since we were in agreement with Xie Wuyue, giving him the chance to raid us. I ask that Exalted make it right, for our righteous Beast Taming Sect…”
Bam!
Exalted Hei Ran slammed the table, barking, “Damn that Xie Wuyue! I warned him not to cause trouble. Does he realy think I’m blind to his twisted methods? I overlooked it this time but he actually went as far as bringing outsiders to weaken his sect.”
“Exalted is right. Xie Wuyue is vile and repulsive.” Beast Taming Sect’s elders echoed at once.
It only worked to have Exalted Hei Ran vent on them, “You fools aren’t any better. His sect had gotten peaceful again yet you stepped in as well?”
“We’ll take Exalted’s lesson to heart.” The elders bobbed their heads. Exalted Hei Ran snorted and glared, “What now? Your entire sect is gone?”
“Hei Ran, let’s leave this matter for now. The most important thing is if the Demon Scheming Sect really did it or not.”
Exalted Bai Mei spoke, “Demon Scheming Sect’s power aside, will he really have the nerve to do such an outrageous act? The conflicts between the nine sects would never go as far as total annihilation. Everyone in western lands knows that. The minute a sect violates it, the others will remove it. Would he actually do such a thing? But if it’s not Demon Scheming Sect, then who? In one night, not a single soul was left in the sect…”
Exalted Hei Ran frowned…
“Report!”
A Double Dragon Manor’s elder scrambled to present a jade slip with trembling hands and pale face. “Exalted, the Demon Scheming Sect and Mystical Heaven Sect have been destroyed in the span of a day!”
[What?!]
The two shot to their feet in shock.
Beast Taming Sect’s elders were stunned.
[Demon Scheming Sect is gone as well? So it’s not them who ruined ours?]
[Did we blame the wrong person…]

chapters.title: Chapter 834: Investigation Team
chapters.content:
Chapter 834: Investigation Team
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Dang~
Crisp sounds came from far and wide.
Bam!
A golden light flashed from the depths of a stream, revealing Ye Lin’s tense look. He was covered in golden flames as he slowly withdrew them within himself.
Ye Lin looked in the distance, “What’s gotten the Exalted so anxious to call a meeting of everyone in Double Dragon Manor? An enemy attack perhaps?”
Thinking it over, Ye Lin flew for Heaven Reaching Pavilion.
[He-he-he, this should be fun.]
Hu~
In another part, colored lights faded to reveal three lithe figures. Through much toil this past year, Chu Qingcheng, Shui Ruohua and Dan’er finally entered the Ethereal Stage.
“Qingcheng, Empty Spirit Body is amazing. We’re fresh Ethereal Stage cultivators but together we can even fight one in the 6th layer.”
Shui Ruohua revealed a wide smile.
Catching her breath, Chu Qingcheng wiped her brow, not relaxing for a moment as she shook her head, “Still not enough. This isn’t nearly enough to face the guardians of the lower-three sects, let alone an entire sect.”
“Qingcheng, you still want the Demon Scheming Sect…” Shui Ruohua sighed, “You have to understand already that the Exalted won’t ever let you do this. Double Dragon Manor is already conceding more than enough by allowing Xie Wuyue to be taken down and putting Zhuo Fan’s spirit to rest.”
Dan’er nodded, “Western lands has its rules. No matter how strong our array is, we still can’t destroy its core. We’ll end up being hunted down.”
“I don’t care. None who harmed Zhuo Fan shall escape!” Chu Qingcheng’s eyes flashed with hatred, her fists clenched. “For my late husband’s revenge, anything is worth it, even becoming western lands’ enemy!”
The two girls sighed, “We’ll have to leave western lands together…”
“Senior sister…”
“You don’t have to say it. A sister in need is a sister indeed. You want to betray western lands and we shall stand with you all the way.”
Shui Ruohua held her shoulder with a giggle, “Besides, Zhuo Fan sure left a good impression. If not for you two being together and us being sisters, I’d might have made a move. Revenge for one’s husband doesn’t sound so bad.”
“Hi-hi-hi, senior sister, you finally admit it. You like your junior sister’s husband!” Dan’er teased.
Shui Ruohua raised an eyebrow, bit back, “You’re one to talk, always sticking so close to her husband. Don’t think for a second your innocent act fooled anyone…”
“As if…”
“You’re still denying it?”
The girls burst out laughing. Chu Qingcheng felt comforted having them around, the only two sisters who would go with her…
The sound of a bell echoed in the distance, startling them. They rushed towards Heaven Reaching Pavilion.
It was their first time hearing the bell being sounded, knowing it was only rung in dire situations…
The bell’s ringing reached one particular pond.
Once the blaze faded, Yan Mo’s stern face was revealed. A breeze went by and Wu Qingqiu appeared as well.
“Did something happen?”
“We’ll know when we get there.”
They flew in the bell’s direction as well.
People from all around the Double Dragon Manor had heard the call and answered by converging to Heaven Reaching Pavilion.
The Exalted sat on their main chairs, with the elders seated just below them. Behind them were Chu Qingcheng and all the other disciples Double Dragon Manor had taken in to nurture. The image was complete with some laborers who bowed at the further end.
The Exalted scanned the crowd to see all had come. Their faces were grave, finding it hard where to begin.
“Lords, what has happened to warrant an urgent meeting?” One elder bowed.
Exalted Hei Ran took out a jade slip, sighing, “News just arrived that in just six months, the western lands’ lower-three sects, Beast Taming Sect, Demon Scheming Sect and Mystical Heaven Sect had been wiped out overnight. There are no survivors.”
[What?!]
Panic spread among the crowd, with the elders whispering among each other. Order had been instilled ever since the nine sects of western lands came to be, preventing anything remotely as grave as this from taking place. So how all of a sudden…
Chu Qingcheng’s group was taken aback for a moment before smiling.
[The criminals behind Zhuo Fan’s death had been put down before we could. Is this providence?]
[Ha-ha, good for them!]
Ye Lin was looking mighty uncomfortable, to say the least.
[Oh hell, don’t tell me elder brother did it. Master had him go around setting arrays but he went for revenge first.]
[Not that it has anything to do with me. I do wonder, though, was it really possible for him to actually kill every last one of them?]
[Won’t that mean elder brother got even stronger? I better put my back into it before he leaves me way behind.]
Ye Lin’s mind was set.
“Exalted, was this done by an insider or by other lands?” Wu Qingqiu stood up.
Exalted Bai Mei nodded, appreciating his valor. While others were too overwhelmed, he was focused on unraveling the problem. “It’s too soon to tell, but I suspect it wasn’t done by anyone from western lands. There’s just too few that can actually do it. A simple investigation is sure to expose them, and they would never go that far either. This only leaves other lands as the probable suspects.”
Wu Qingqiu nodded, having reached the same conclusion. This was the only logical explanation.
“I bet it was a ghost!”
The snort drew everyone’s attention to Ye Lin’s mocking look.
They gave him a weird look then Wu Qingqiu asked, “Little junior brother, why do you say that?”
“Uh, nothing. It’s just that I find these sects odd.”
Ye Lin darted his eyes around before saying, “Just think about it. Beast Taming Sect aside, the other two lower-three sects had all engaged in murder just a year ago.”
The Exalted exclaimed at once, “Zhuo Fan!”
“Zhuo Fan?”
Chu Qingcheng swayed, her gaze vacant as she looked at Ye Lin, “W-what are you trying to say?”
Ye Lin and Zhuo Fan had a bone to pick in Double Dragon Gathering which made Chu Qingcheng give him the cold shoulder in Double Dragon Manor. It was certainly odd to hear this ever silent man talk of his own accord.
Ye Lin glanced over. Zhuo Fan had warned him to not say anything about him, but at the end of the day, this woman was his elder brother’s wife. The least he could do was offer some comforting words to his sister-in-law.
Gazing into Chu Qingcheng’s hopeful eyes, Ye Lin spoke, “I’m saying that it’s possible that someone took revenge for Zhuo Fan. Or, his ghost did it instead. How else could an entire sect have not a single soul survive. It’s too strange, especially when it’s filled with Ethereal Stage experts.”
The Exalted shook.
[Why didn’t we think of that?]
It might be revenge for the cruel event involving the Demon Scheming Sect, Mystical Heaven Sect, Heaven Trailing Sect and Universal Righteous Sect.
[Did that make Beast Taming Sect a smokescreen?]
“Won’t that mean the next target is…” Exalted Hei Ran panicked. Exalted Bai Mei appeased him, “Don’t get too excited. Heaven Trailing Sect isn’t like the other three. It’s a middle-three sect, with plenty of Soul Harmony experts. They’ll be fine. Still, we’ll have to look into this event thoroughly. It will have a great impact on western lands’ order.”
Exalted Bai Mei looked below, “I’m forming an investigation team to look into these three sects. The team will be led by an elder, taking disciples along as a trial.”
“I will go!”
Chu Qingcheng was the first to speak, her eyes shining with hope. Ye Lin’s words made her want to see just who took revenge for her late husband. Who would go as far as destroy three sects?
But what she really wished for was the avenging ghost Ye Lin talked about…
Chu Qingcheng’s heart jumped.
Ye Lin grinned.
[Elder brother, I didn’t say anything…]

chapters.title: Chapter 835: Avenging Ghost
chapters.content:
Chapter 835: Avenging Ghost
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Under the sun’s warm glow, a soft breeze touched a still lake. The warm air traced the flowers, grass and trees, which they received by sprouting new leaves.
Despite the blissful scenery, one man in black had a permanent scowl on his face, looking like a ghost from hell with that stone-cold expression. The icy aura coming off him was biting as he stood in the lake.
Hum~
He gently pointed in the air, making the air shimmer around his finger.
Smirking, he muttered, “So this is Heaven Trailing Sect’s defensive array. I might have not come here before, but I’m sure I came to the right place.”
A crackling sound came as his left eye held a black thunderflame. It spread in the air and burned a three meter hole in space, revealing a totally different scene.
The man had a mocking smile as he entered with confidence. A piercing sound rang out throughout the sect the next second.
“Enemy attack!”
The shouts came from everywhere as they all converged around the man in black. There were tens of thousands, mostly disciples in the Radiant Stage, with few at peak and even fewer in the Ethereal Stage.
The man shook his head, “Heaven Trailing Sect is a middle-three sect after all so why do I only see ignorant pups in the Radiant Stage and some even in the Profound Heaven Stage? Why, did all your elders die out?”
“You dare barge into Heaven Trailing Sect? Do you have a death wish?”
A familiar face popped in just a hundred meters away, still as cocky and obnoxious as ever, “Weren’t you looking for an Ethereal Stage expert? Well, here I am. Humph, a 1st layer Ethereal Stage cultivator isn’t even worth our elders’ time.”
The man in black halted, looking at him with a shake of his head.
The disciples around were excited, buttering up, “Young master is the best! Your mere presence has rendered him mute. You’re truly the best model for any of us.”
“Right you are. Young master had shown extraordinary valor and bravery in the Double Dragon Gathering. With you here, no elder is needed to deal with outsiders. He-he-he…”
Everyone clamored while the young master looked even more smug and cocky, if that was possible.
The man in black let out a thick condescending chuckle for some odd reason.
The young master barked, “What are you laughing at?”
“At how you twisted facts. You, brave at the Double Dragon Gathering? Did you even get to showcase yourself?” The man in black mocked, “Ren Cong, you’re lying to your poor junior brothers who haven’t seen the Double Dragon Gathering just so you could bask in their praises?”
The son of Heaven Trailing Sect’s Sect Leader, Ren Cong, shuddered.
Well sure, he was a genius in his own right, reaching Ethereal Stage quite early, but that was relative to the scale. When compared to the whole of western lands, he didn’t make the cut.
To say nothing more of Double Dragon Gathering, where geniuses are a dime a dozen. The top genius of Heaven Trailing Sect ended up suffering more than ever.
But who was dumb enough to say that after returning? What then would become of his name, his image, the attention he was getting? So he made himself the tragic hero, having his team set up by demonic cultivator experts, with only him surviving after he fought with his life.
This earned him greater fame and the disciples’ admiration.
As the future sect leader, fame couldn’t be more important, far more than his integrity. This was why the elders kept silent too.
Now that some weirdo showed up exposing his clowning at Double Dragon Gathering, he was revolted, “Who the hell are you?”
“Who am I? Ha-ha-ha…”
Raising his head with a chuckle, he revealed the one face Ren Cong hated the most in this world, “Young master Ren, how’s your rose bud faring? Does it still hurt?”
Face twitching, Ren Cong clenched his glutes in reflex, hiding his trauma with rage and hatred, “Zhuo Fan, you haven’t died yet?”
“Die?”
Zhuo Fan cocked an inquisitive eyebrow, his smile ever mocking, “Who knows? Maybe I’m dead already. But seeing you bastards so carefree, it rubs me the wrong way. I’d be so much better to have you join me in hell.”
“Cut your damn act!” Ren Cong shouted.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “You think I’m playing? Ha-ha-ha, maybe I’m just a ghost right now, one that wants to drag you all to hell.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed with bloodlust.
Ren Cong shuddered backward in fear. He knew very well what Zhuo Fan could do. But with so many fellow junior brothers around, he couldn’t fail to perform his role, “All you know is how to be cocky. You can’t do anything to us by yourself. What a joke! An obnoxious prick like you isn’t worth getting my hands dirty. Guys, get him!”
Ugh!
No one moved. The disciples looked at Ren Cong in hesitation.
[Hey, young master, aren’t you being mercurial here, sir? We get that you’re far too precious and don’t want to do it yourself, but can’t you see his level?]
[Most of us are in the Radiant Stage, with just a few fresh Ethereal Stage cultivators. Are you telling us to give our lives away?]
[You’re the only real Ethereal Stage expert here, so stop mincing words and attack!]
All looked off at Ren Cong, who noticed his mishap and froze.
[Ignorant fools! You think I can win? My butt’s still aching here! And you want me to fight this freak? Waiting for the elders is much better.]
[What’s taking them so long anyway…]
Ren Cong was waiting tensely while the disciples waited for him to move. It was truly comical how stiff the entire situation was, especially with all of them surrounding one guy.
Zhuo Fan caught on and laughed, going for Ren Cong, “Since you won’t come, I’ll go to you. Young master Ren, weren’t you a hero at Double Dragon Gathering? Show your juniors what their great senior can do, ha-ha-ha…”
“Yeah!” The disciples cheered, eager to see a good show.
“Zip it!”
Face twitching, Ren Cong glared at the culprit, on the verge of crying.
[That’s Zhuo Fan we’re talking about. Aside from the fact I’m not his match, I’ll be sure to die in a few blows!]
