[These heartless fools, they only know how to flatter. Now that an enemy has come, you throw me to the wolves. You’re killing me here!]
Ren Cong was seething in anger at his juniors’ betrayal while also waving his hands around at Zhuo Fan, “Wait, let’s talk this out. I don’t want to fight.”
“Oh, but I do, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan laughed, not stopping for a second.
Ren Cong’s heart thumped in shock, his first instinct was to flee, even forgetting to put up a Yuan Qi shield.
“Don’t you harm my son!”
Whoosh!
A mighty pressure spread as a strong man appeared before Ren Cong and punched Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan’s Qilin arm flashed red as he punched as well.
Bam!
Zhuo Fan fell back to his previous spot while the man trailed the ground for ten meters.
There were clear marks left on the ground while his fist shook from the clash.
“Sect Leader!”
Dozens of elders arrived just then, shocked at the result
Ren Xiaoyun looked grave as he glared at Zhuo Fan, “Who are you, sir, to trespass into Heaven Trailing Sect?”
“Father, he’s Zhuo Fan. He came for revenge.”
Ren Cong was giddy about reporting this fact with hateful eyes.
[My help is here, Zhuo Fan. Now you’re done for, ha-ha-ha…]
Ren Xiaoyun looked baffled, “Aren’t you supposed to be dead?”
“Ha-ha-ha, that’s not important right now. What is though, is that everyone here will die today!” Zhuo Fan had an evil smirk plastered on his face.
Shuddering, Ren Xiaoyun laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, a ghost coming back for revenge. So Demon Scheming Sect and Mystical Heaven Sect some time ago must be your work as well, I assume. But don’t you go lump Heaven Trailing Sect with those two. Since you bothered coming here, though, then let me send you off to hell! I’ll make sure you won’t come back this time either!”
“Well, aren’t you confident?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow and mocked…

chapters.title: Chapter 836: Corpse
chapters.content:
Chapter 836: Corpse
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Bam!
Ren Xiaoyun stomped and shot for Zhuo Fan, focusing all his power and bloodthirst into his fist.
Zhuo Fan raised the Qilin arm to block. The resulting clash had actually sent Zhuo Fan flying for a thousand meters, his prized arm unable to take all the brunt.
Frowning, Zhuo Fan’s red arm shook, which made Ren Xiaoyun laugh, “Ha-ha-ha, I didn’t believe it when everyone told me what a monster you are, but now I do. My soul is that of the cold steel sword, tougher than anything. Anything below the Soul Harmony Stage, even if made of black iron, can never stand up to it. Who’d have thought I’d see the day a mere fresh Ethereal Stage punk would do the impossible? You really are an abomination.”
“Is that praise or mockery I hear?”
He was still going backward, even as his right hand was shaking. Zhuo Fan eyed him coldly.
Grinning, Ren Xiaoyun’s eyes flashed red, “Praising, what else? You’re the first Ethereal Stage cultivator to take on a Soul Harmony cultivator’s punch. Though, that’s pretty much it.”
Ren Xiaoyun’s fist swung like a hammer, coming at Zhuo Fan’s face from the side.
Zhuo Fan felt an incredible pressure, taking his breath away.
Squinting hard, Zhuo Fan’s was quick to act and a draconic roar echoed as a scarlet dragon tail came from behind, lashing at the punch.
“Is this your heaven dragon soul, Almighty Scarlet Dragon King?”
Ren Xiaoyun lit up and laughed, wearing a nasty grin, “A shame no matter how strong the soul, it’s nothing against a Soul Harmony expert!”
Boom!
The tail and the mighty fist finally clashed.
The dragon howled, its tail flung back from the punch and landed hard on Zhuo Fan’s face. He was sent flying once more, this time for miles, blasting any house or building in his way.
Sss~
Everyone gasped in shock at the display.
[Sect Leader is so strong!]
[He killed him in one blow!]
“Father is supreme! Sect Leader is amazing!”
Ren Cong exploded in glee after a moment of stupefaction. The others bowed in respect, “Sect Leader is amazing!”
One elder came before Ren Xiaoyun with a smile and a bow, “Sect Leader’s power has improved again. Congratulations on your imminent advancement.”
“I think so too as well, ha-ha-ha…”
Ren Xiaoyun pointed in Zhuo Fan’s direction, “Someone check and see if he’s still alive.”
“Ha-ha-ha, highly unlikely.”
The elder smiled, “It was a fluke for the boy to survive Sect Leader’s first punch, so how could he take a second one?”
“It always pays to be cautious. This kid’s too tenacious, ha-ha-ha…”
Ren Xiaoyun laughed in pride. Even he wrote Zhuo Fan off after that almighty punch of his, but he still wanted to be safe.
If he survived, one more light strike should correct that.
The elder’s gaze was full of admiration, his words oozing flattery, “Sect Leader is so cautious, for the future of Heaven Trailing Sect. I shall now do my duty.”
Ren Xiaoyun nodded and the elder shouted for two disciples to check Zhuo Fan’s body.
How could young master Ren ever miss the chance of seeing his enemy’s mutilated corpse, “Father, can I go as well? In case he survives, I’ll be sure to not let my junior brothers suffer any problems. I can make a quick decision if anything happens.”
[Our hero!]
The disciples were touched to the core.
It never occurred to them to ask that since checking a corpse was so dangerous, why not send an elder instead?
This showed Sect Leader was utterly confident Zhuo Fan would never crawl back out. Ren Cong thus was only taking this chance to be in the limelight.
Ren Xiaoyun admired his son for knowing to be prompt in any circumstance, when to retreat and when to flex.
“Sect Leader, young master is so brave and always has his fellow disciples’ wellbeing at heart. It’s a blessing to have him in our sect.” The same elder went for another round of kissing rear, elating Ren Xiaoyun.
“Ha-ha-ha, my child is always so reckless, making his father worry.”
“Sect Leader is right, young master’s valor is beyond anyone’s. He’s a blessing to the sect, but he’s also got Sect Leader concerned. Sigh, such woe to your heart.” The elder was far from finished it seemed.
Ren Xiaoyun eyed him and laughed.
[Hmm, the elder is strong enough. He’ll make a good venerable, ha-ha-ha.]
He gestured for Ren Cong to go.
Ren Cong skipped over to the ruins in all his childish exuberance, “Humph, Zhuo Fan you finally got yours. Now let’s see just how wretched your death is. Is your head popped like a melon or your limbs all over the place, he-he-he…”
Ren Cong shoved his hand in, to grab Zhuo’s body.
An explosion sounded next, with a scarlet claw coming out ahead of him and grabbing his head.
“Aah!”
The wail echoed throughout the sect.
The people shuddered, watching as a dusty and shabby person came out of the rubble. In his right, he had a familiar figure, Ren Cong.
“Cong’er!”
Ren Xiaoyun cried out, overwhelmed by what he saw, “Z-Zhuo Fan, that punch should’ve killed you!”
Zhuo Fan turned his head, his eyes cold as ice. After spitting out the blood in his mouth, he sneered, “How is a ghost supposed to die again?”
With a roar, a scarlet dragon head appeared next to Zhuo Fan.
“H-How is this possible?”
Ren Xiaoyun was in disbelief, “How is his soul intact after a Soul Harmony punch? How is it so strong? This can’t be happening!”
Zhuo Fan mocked, “Ignorance is bliss. A soul’s strength depends solely on the cultivation art. As for this dragon soul, the other variants won’t be able to show its true potential. Only by changing its core is its power revealed!”
The scarlet dragon head shifted, turning golden with raging flames around its frame.
Its power was the true difference, increased dozens of times, maybe even enough to pressure a Soul Harmony expert.
Decimating Golden Heaven Dragon King was the strongest form of a heaven dragon soul. The only one capable of fighting a Soul Harmony expert.
Ren Xiaoyun and everyone around him stood dumbstruck.
It was a first for them to see a soul unharmed after taking a Soul Harmony expert’s strike. Reason dictated Soul Harmony Stage was the bane of souls, but this soul was just way too strong.
Wu~
Ren Cong struggled in Zhuo Fan’s grip, whining and wailing.
Ren Xiaoyun came to at last and shouted, “Zhuo Fan, let my son go or…”
Pa!
Zhuo Fan flicked his hand and threw Ren Cong to the golden dragon behind. It opened its fiery maw, swallowing Ren Cong whole. With a crunch, blood started spilling between its fangs in all directions, some even landing on Zhuo Fan’s face.
Zhuo Fan’s cold smile never faltered, now creepier with all the blood.
Ren Cong shook a couple of times before stilling.
Turned into a golden dragon’s chew toy, his soul was suffering the same fate, torn to bits.
Seeing the blood of his son dripping on the ground from the dragon’s teeth, Ren Xiaoyun was lost for a moment.
Then his eyes went bloodshot and he spat Zhuo Fan’s name with all the hatred he could muster…

chapters.title: Chapter 837: Animal
chapters.content:
Chapter 837: Animal
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Zhuo Fan!”
The shout of grief was filled with hatred and sadness. The disciples shook under it and fell back in fear.
They had never seen their revered Sect Leader so bent on killing.
Zhuo Fan didn’t care, even giving a taunting smile.
Bam!
The anger was too much for Ren Xiaoyun to take, ignoring Zhuo Fan’s power and how he survived, he charged right at him.
His rage-fueled punch was actually stronger than before, smashing at Zhuo Fan’s head, wanting to pulverize him.
Zhuo Fan just stood there, watching the punch come, yet still deciding to block with his Qilin arm.
Bam!
Rattle~
He was once again sent backward, a hundred meters, but then Zhuo Fan exploded in golden flames as golden scales appeared on his skin.
Ugh!
Zhuo Fan halted there and Ren Xiaoyun’s raging fist could push him no further.
Even through the anger, Ren Xiaoyun was shocked, “How… a mere fresh Ethereal Stage…”
“Yeah, just how…” The elders and disciples around stood dumbstruck.
Zhuo Fan grinned, “Soul Harmony Stage is merely borrowing the soul’s strength to improve the body. A sword soul would make a body tougher than ever, while a beast soul would turn one into an animal of extraordinary strength. Though it’s not much of a difference in reaching the Soul Harmony Stage if a body already possesses such power.”
“There’s no way! No one can train their body that hard! A human isn’t a tool, nor an animal. Going so far will break it. That’s the whole point of the Soul Harmony Stage. A strong soul in a strong body.” Ren Xiaoyun gnashed his teeth.
Zhuo Fan nodded in praise, “Very good, Sect Leader Ren, for understanding the core of Soul Harmony Stage. The true character of Soul Harmony Stage is to bring a human’s body to the strength of a spiritual beast, a notion passed on from antiquity. I wouldn’t have known either if not for hearing some old myths. It seems that the arts, skills and cultivation stages all came to be as a way to fight back the spiritual beasts. Sect Leader Ren is sharp to figure on his own.”
“Why can’t I understand a word you’re saying?” Ren Xiaoyun shouted.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “You don’t need to understand, just know. You’re a Soul Harmony expert, but I am a true animal! Man and beast had fought since the dawn of time, with the result going either way depending on the case. But don’t think for a second you’re stronger than me as a Soul Harmony expert!”
Zhuo Fan’s Qilin arm shook and sent Ren Xiaoyun flying.
Ren Xiaoyun cried out.
[What’s going on here?]
He was a Soul Harmony expert but a mere shake of a fresh Ethereal Stage cultivator sent him flying.
Ren Xiaoyun refused to believe it, while his sect was watching dumbfounded.
Zhuo Fan snapped in front of him, punching his chest with the Qilin arm.
“Sect Leader!”
The audience cried out. Ren Xiaoyun rushed to block with his hands.
Bam!
Feeling as if a mountain struck him, Ren Xiaoyun shot like a meteor from Zhuo Fan’s red punch, leveling everything within five miles of where he landed.
Cries echoed as Radiant Stage disciples rushed out of the way. Even Ethereal Stage and Soul Harmony experts looked with lost gazes.
[How’s this guy so strong? How is he forcing Sect Leader back?]
[And he’s just an Ethereal Stage cultivator? Not even a Soul Harmony expert can do that…]
Crash!
As the dust fell, Ren Xiaoyun shot from the rubble with blood dripping from his mouth. His eyes were hard as he looked around in search of Zhuo Fan.
The famed Zhuo Fan was actually so strong as to even pummel the Sect Leader of a middle-three sect. He was a Soul Harmony expert, a rarity in the western lands too, wielding power way above the rest of the masses.
Yet a kid was toying with him still.
Ren Xiaoyun gnashed his teeth.
Whoosh!
Following the whistling wind, Zhuo Fan appeared in a golden flash behind Ren Xiaoyun, punching with his Qilin arm.
“Sect Leader Ren, where are you looking?”
Ren Xiaoyun swished around, only to meet the punch. Forced into a corner, he used his hands again to block.
Bam!
Ren Xiaoyun went flying again.
In mid flight, Zhuo Fan appeared ahead of him and punched his back hard as he arrived.
Pff!
The immense power connected this time and Ren Xiaoyun spat blood, looking pale and slamming into the ground again.
Golden flashed once more and Zhuo Fan appeared where Ren Xiaoyun was about to land to punch again.
In a twisted game of catch, Ren Xiaoyun acted as the ball while Zhuo Fan just punched him around, making sure not to drop him. He appeared all over the place, to make sure to give Ren Xiaoyun some serious damage.
The audience was looking dumb at this point.
[That speed is insane, like a ghost’s!]
They all knew this was no skill’s doing, but brought about by pure speed, something not even a Soul Harmony expert could achieve.
Who’d ever believe an Ethereal Stage child could be so abominable?
If the late Ren Cong would be here right now to witness such a familiar scene, he’d be shocked to the core. It was the same thing he saw in Zhuo Fan’s battle with Ye Lin. The only difference was, Zhuo Fan was more gruesome.
While both had the dragon ancestor’s golden flame inheritance, Zhuo Fan had a true sacred beast’s body, the Qilin’s arm.
The new and improved Zhuo Fan, coupled with the mighty arm and golden flame, was no longer your run of the mill monster. Saying he was a half sacred beast wasn’t a stretch either.
Bang~
Booming came constantly from up above as Ren Xiaoyun was punched around while spilling blood every time. Despite being in the Soul Harmony Stage, he was powerless to stop him.
He was looking worse and worse, he won’t last long in this world.
Ren Xiaoyun felt downcast at this truth. A great sect leader like him was going to die in his sect as his son did from an Ethereal Stage cultivator. This was disgraceful.
“Sect Leader!”
Shouts came from below and he woke up to the fact he was not alone. Seeing their leader about to breathe his last, the elders sprung into action.
A dozen Soul Harmony venerables finally came to their senses and charged towards Zhuo Fan.
Ren Xiaoyun was moved to tears.
[God damn it, those geezers finally come to help. I’ve been waiting for ages!]
No matter how much of a freak the brat was, with these dozen Soul Harmony experts, even he would suffer since he was still in the Ethereal Stage.
Zhuo Fan glanced over at the incoming enemy and ignored Ren Xiaoyun to deal with them.
“Brat, are you looking to die coming at us?”
“You killed our young master, harmed the Sect Leader, now you shall pay for your crimes with your life, ha-ha-ha…”
The men of Heaven Trailing Sect looked smug, talking about winning before they even clashed, like Zhuo Fan was finished.
A shame reality never conformed to their delusions…
Whoosh~
Golden flashes shot around as Zhuo Fan clashed with the dozen Soul Harmony experts. Wails resounded the next moment as the men were split apart, crumbling to the ground.
Their scarlet blood gave the sky a red tint.
Zhuo Fan was the only one standing with a pitch-black longsword in his hand…
Ugh!
The hopeful Ren Xiaoyun felt his face twitch.
[Just how strong is this brat to kill a dozen Soul Harmony experts in a blink?]
[But why use the sword on them but only punch me around?]
Hope turned into despair in a matter of seconds. Ren Xiaoyun was so ‘touched’ by Zhuo Fan’s attentive care that he almost cried…

chapters.title: Chapter 838: To Each Their Own Path
chapters.content:
Chapter 838: To Each Their Own Path
Proofreader
: Papatonks
The witnessing elders, disciple and venerables looked stupefied. Gasping at the totally outrageous outcome.
The sect only had those Soul Harmony experts, yet all were killed in a flash.
As the bloody rain fell, with squishy parts in between, the audience froze. No one made a single peep.
Zhuo Fan took back the sword, turning around to grin at his previous trusty punching back, Ren Xiaoyun.
Shuddering, Ren Xiaoyun’s mood hit rock bottom.
[Again? Why me? I can’t take it anymore, dying in two hits. You, elders, don’t just stand there, help!]
Everyone was still looking lost. Maybe the shock was so great it upended all their common sense, or it just might be that they were smart enough to play dumb and not die like the others before them.
Ren Xiaoyun wanted to curse.
They just loved buttering him up every day all day, but when it counted, none would help.
[A bunch of double-crossing degenerates!]
The elders were having difficulties themselves, though. With the best Soul Harmony experts removed so easily, as Ethereal Stage experts, they’d only go there to die.
[Sect Leader, you gotta take us into consideration, to preserve the strength of the sect]
Ren Xiaoyun looked to be in the pits of despair.
[It’s over. Who’ll help me now?]
Zhuo Fan snickered, shooting for him, “Ha-ha-ha, Sect Leader Ren, the great middle-three sect, Heaven Trailing Sect, is nothing short of a letdown. All your elders are cowards, none willing to risk themselves to save you. Talk about a useless Sect Leader.”
Ren Xiaoyun’s face twitched.
“Sect Leader!”
The elders finally cried out in anger, though none thought of coming over.
[Fine, fine, I already knew your stance. I’m about to hang so what’s the point of faking sympathy, to console me?]
[Humph, hypocrites!]
Ren Xiaoyun huffed and sneered.
He was wondering if these geezers were really after sympathy, or maybe they had been hypocrites for so long, they forgot how to act natural.
One thing was certain, these ingratiating oldies were useless when the going got tough, like now.
[I should’ve just sent them first to fight. What was wrong with me when I went to fight that freak?]
Ren Xiaoyun was wallowing in regret.
A shame none of this mattered at this point. Zhuo Fan popped next to him and punched at his head.
It didn’t follow the same game from before, the strike was filled with the desire to kill. Even Zhuo Fan got tired of playing.
Ren Xiaoyun’s heart sank and sighed.
[I just had to mess with the wrong monster…]
Whoosh!
Just before Zhuo Fan’s killing blow landed, a whistling sound passed by his ear.
Zhuo Fan’s punch halted and he jumped back while leaning his head back. Just in time too, as a sword wave was inches from his nose. The sharp golden energy even made his face sting despite not touching him.
Boom!
The sword wave destroyed a faraway forest in a huge explosion. Fire and dust covered the skies, erasing everyting in dozens of miles.
That attack was even stronger than his punch!
Zhuo Fan gulped, hovering in the air and sweating bullets. Looking up, he saw a tall man in white, looking rather young. He was holding the heavily wounded Ren Xiaoyun, looking down with a calm gaze.
“High Venerable!”
The audience cheered at seeing their savior, bowing in respect. Ren Xiaoyun grinned, “High Venerable, you came…”
“You’d be dead if I didn’t.”
High Venerable threw Ren Xiaoyun down. The spectating elders rushed to catch him, looking after his every need. Though Ren Xiaoyun’s opinion of them already dropped.
[Disaster came at our doors and you only now show care? Too little, too late!]
Ren Xiaoyun remained silent with a dark look.
High Venerable laughed and turned to Zhuo Fan, “What problems might you have with Heaven Trailing Sect to cause such a big scene?”
“Heaven Trailing Sword, Xiao Yunshan?”
Zhuo Fan squinted then mocked, “You’re out at last. I’m Demon Scheming Sect’s High Venerable Yuan Xinggang’s disciple, Zhuo Fan!”
Shaking, Xiao Yunshan looked at him hard before nodding, “I see, so you’re the one he mentioned. Your master was very proud of you till the end. I’ve never seen that look on him before. It even got me curious to see you. But then I heard rumors of Universal Righteous Sect targeting you and that you didn’t survive. Who knew…”
“I’d survive and come find you?”
Grinning, Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed with bloodthirst, “Xiao Yunshan, I heard you killed my master. That’s why I came here, to take your head!”
Xiao Yunshan was as calm as ever, turning to the heavily wounded Ren Xiaoyun, “That’s why you kept him alive, to make me step in.”
“True, but you came rather late. Now your great sect is a dozen Soul Harmony experts short.”
“Ha-ha-ha, sorry, but I’ve been in seclusion and couldn’t hear the commotion until now.” Xiao Yunshan smiled, not minding his own sect’s experts had been mowed down.
Zhuo Fan was puzzled.
[Is the High Venerable not on good terms with those oldies, or maybe he stands above taunts and ingratiations?]
Xiao Yunshan spoke, “You must’ve come for revenge. Would you mind answering a question first?”
“I’m the most accommodating to dead men.”
“Ha-ha-ha, how cocky, although,” Xiao Yunshan looked around and nodded, “You do have the power to back it up. I can see now why the old man was so proud of you. You’re truly gifted. Only, I just heard that the Demon Scheming Sect is in ruins. Did you do that?”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Correct.”
“You knew the Demon Scheming Sect was the old man’s most cherished place. Even with the traitorous elders, having a hand in killing him, they were all the core of the Demon Scheming Sect. Their death means the end of Demon Scheming Sect and the end of all his efforts. Is this revenge to pay your respect, or get rid of everything?”
Xiao Yunshan’s eyes stared hard, waiting for an answer.
Zhuo Fan’s gaze didn’t falter, then laughed, “Who said I’m taking revenge for master?”
Xiao Yunshan was stunned.
“In the end, master is dead and he won’t come back just because I took revenge.”
Zhuo Fan spoke with a sage look, “Everyone is looking to avenge themselves, and I’m no different. Demon Scheming Sect had been my master’s cherished place, but not mine. I only cared about master and not the sect. I even told him that Demon Scheming Sect will be home as long as he was there. When that ceased, ha-ha-ha, there’s no home without kin. Master had his path and I have mine.
“Even as master was killed, I’m sure he still didn’t want to see the sect in ruins. But from how I saw it, every last one of them are his killers. If I don’t destroy those bastards, I’d have not let down master, but myself and my path. Xiao Yunshan, do you get it now?”
Xiao Yunshan shuddered, looking at the sky in ponder. Elder Yuan’s final words echoed loud in his ears.
[Xie Wuyue, you’re damning the sect…]
[So that’s what he meant.]
Taking a deep breath and turning to Zhuo Fan, Xiao Yunshan laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, I see it now. Old man, I finally understand why you’re so proud of him. He’s good, no, great, ha-ha-ha…”

chapters.title: Chapter 839: Heaven-reaching Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 839: Heaven-reaching Sword
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Xiao Yunshan’s laughter confused everyone, even Zhuo Fan.
[Has the old man gone senile? Why laugh? Did I trigger an epiphany in him?]
Xiao Yunshan’s gaze on Zhuo Fan was even more appreciative, “Truly worthy of that old man’s praise, having surpassed your master. I’m not talking about strength, but your heart. The old man toiled all his life for the sect, only to have it fall at your hand. It may look like you went against your master, but you actually received his true inheritance.”
“The old man worked hard on his path, as do you. Moreover, you don’t let anything interfere, not hesitating even when your master is involved. Ha-ha-ha, this is the essence of an inheritance, walking your own path. Old man, you failed in your toil, but rest easy now that you left such a disciple behind.
Xiao Yunshan sighed.
The next moment, his eyes sharpened, staring at Zhuo Fan with bloodthirst, unleashing sharp winds from all around him.
“I, however, have my own path I shall stick to!”
Raising his hand and sticking out two fingers, sharp sounds echoed around. “I know you came to destroy my sect, but to me, like your master, the sect is everything. No matter what, even if you’re a junior, when it comes to the fate of the sect, I’ll still fight you despite liking you as I liked your master. Your death is the only way!”
Zhuo Fan had a creepy grin, “Enough friendliness. Attack already!”
“Very well!”
Xiao Yunshan slashed with his hand and a sword edge extended from his fingers, coming down on Zhuo Fan’s head.
Like death from above, the immense power of the sharp attack pressured Zhuo Fan.
The incredible power that was enough to split the earth in two made Zhuo Fan gasp and force him down.
[This is the might of the first sword in the middle-three sects!]
Zhuo Fan squinted. The audience was gaping, but also cheered inside.
[This is High Venerable! His attack has the power to shake the world.]
Even the weary Ren Xiaoyun nodded in shock. He never saw High Venerable unleash his ultimate skill, Heaven-reaching Sword to such a degree.
It only showed how much Xiao Yunshan cared for Zhuo Fan.
“The kid is done for with High Venerable’s attack!”
“Yeah, High Venerable is different from those other Soul Harmony experts. He is unique even among the western lands’ Soul Harmony experts!”
“Yeah, the brat never saw it coming. Heaven Trailing Sect might be the last middle-three sect, but our High Venerable is the guardian of the sect! The brat is finished, ha-ha-ha…”
Despite the cawing grating the two’s ears, it did not affect their mood. Xiao Yunshan showed no reaction to their buttering and Zhuo Fan showed no panic to their taunts.
They were fully committed to the battle, like veterans. They only had eyes for each other.
Rumble~
The huge and mighty sword strike was imminent. Zhuo Fan’s Qilin arm let out an eerie red glow while his body erupted in golden flames. He wanted to use the half beast form to withstand the sword attack.
Roar!
Zhuo Fan shouted as he punched, clashing with the huge sword with a loud boom. The shockwaves spread everywhere, containing invisible sword energy.
Ren Xiaoyun shouted, “Scatter! An Ethereal Stage cultivator can’t take a Soul Harmony battle’s shockwaves!”
The elders flew away with Ren Xiaoyun. But there were still some Ethereal Stage disciples lagging behind and falling victims to the stray sword energy.
Whoosh~
The traces of sword energy fell like meteor rain upon the entire sect. When one pierced a disciple, the victim was pulverized as well. When it touched the ground, it would leave a crater, shattering any poor devil around it.
Cries of agony resounded from every corner, turning this place into the end of days as tens of thousands of disciples met their end.
Ren Xiaoyun’s group had gotten to a safe distance and were aggrieved by the losses, yet too scared to help.
Xiao Yunshan was ignoring all these, focused fully on fighting Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan’s red arm released a scorching glow as he struck above. The two were in a deadlock, but every time they pushed harder, it spelled doom for the rest of Heaven Trailing Sect.
“The brat is actually so strong. He blocked High Venerable’s attack and had our disciples suffer around him.” Ren Xiaoyun looked at the two in a deadlock with a grave look, “The brat can’t be left alive or it’s over for us!”
The elders nodded, grave as well.
“Good one, kid. My Heaven-reaching Sword borrows the power of the world to form sword energy. It is like a sword from the heavens above to split the earth below. Few Soul Harmony experts can take it. I’m amazed you can too.”
Xiao Yunshan watched as Zhuo Fan lifted the huge sword, “Yuan Xinggang had gotten himself a great disciple. Not just any talent can pull this off.”
Zhuo Fan showed a smug grin, “Only taking it? I think you’re underestimating me here, ha-ha-ha!”
Zhuo Fan’s left eye flashed with the black thunderflame then two golden halos in his right eye. The Divine Eye of the Void and Apocalyptic Thunderflame Eye were working together. Zhuo Fan was using them at the same time for the first time ever.
Divine Eye of the Void’s 2nd stage, Void Annihilating Thunderflame!
Boom!
A rumble sounded from above and a black fire pillar shot forth, unleashing its almighty aura. The pillar of fire pierced the sword and reached the heavens.
Crack!
Something broke then as Xiao Yunshan watched in disbelief while his prized Heaven-reaching Sword crumbled to pieces.
All the power he put in it also scattered.
Zhuo Fan capitalized on this opening to use his right fist and break the rest of it, making it turn back into spiritual energy.
Xiao Yunshan was overwhelmed.
[H-how?]
His prized skill, Heaven-reaching Sword, was broken just like that!
Ren Xiaoyun and the elders were shocked. They knew the power of Heaven-reaching Sword, connected with the world and using its power. One had to be way above High Venerable’s level to break this flawless skill.
[So how did it fail now…]
They had no idea Zhuo Fan used Void Annihilation along with the thunderflame to break it. Nothing in this world could survive the scorching power of the all-destructive thunderflame, let alone a sword made of energy.
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan shot forth for Xiao Yunshan with his scarlet fist ready to draw blood.
Xiao Yunshan hastily retreated, using his fingers to release golden sword energy at Zhuo Fan.
Having seen his sword energy’s power, Zhuo Fan knew very well that being kept at a distance would give the old man an advantage.
Zhuo Fan chose thus to not block the attacks, making the Decimating Golden Flame explode around him and using Divine Eye of the Void’s 1st stage to dance between the attacks and reach Xiao Yunshan with his punch.
Xiao Yunshan felt the brutal power bearing down on him and he replied by unleashing the Heaven-reaching Sword once more.
A sword from above once again struck Zhuo Fan, only this time it was at a much closer distance.
Dodging now would make some distance between them and if Zhuo Fan blocked it, it would result in entering a deadlock like before, letting Xiao Yunshan pull back. It would help Xiao Yunshan regardless of blocking or not.
The two tough choices were once again thrown before Zhuo Fan…

chapters.title: Chapter 840: Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 840: Master
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Knowing the result, Xiao Yunshan was ready get some distance since any choice Zhuo Fan made would give him this chance.
He would get away from the brat and then use the huge sword energy to gain the upper hand.
Zhuo Fan’s savage right hand once again came into play, out of his expectations. The guy was determined to block the sword while having a weird grin on his face.
Xiao Yunshan was uneasy, watching as the sword energy and the right hand made contact. The attack went through Zhuo Fan, tearing him to pieces and then to nothing.
Xiao Yunshan rushed to move away, looking puzzzled.
[W-what’s going on here? His punch should block my Heaven-reaching Sword so why didn’t it now? He was destroyed in a second.]
[Did he use up all his energy?]
Xiao Yunshan looked around to see the audience was overjoyed.
“High Venerable is amazing! He killed the kid in an instant. That’s our Heaven Trailing Sect’s guardian!”
“As long as High Venerable is around, Heaven Trailing Sect fears no one!”
“High Venerable has grown again, a blessing for our sect, ha-ha-ha… “
Ren Xiaoyun bobbed his head in total agreement. It felt off how Zhuo Fan got done in just now, but it also made sense in a way.
The first time Zhuo Fan blocked High Venerable’s attack, he had time to prepare and inspect it. Even so, it was still tough. But now, High Venerable having unleashed the same destructive attack so close, Zhuo Fan had a lapse in attention that proved to be fatal.
Death would come from just one strike in a battle of experts.
Xiao Yunshan was in total disagreement. Having witnessed Zhuo’s calm and weird smile, he knew for a fact that wasn’t a suicidal one.
Xiao Yunshan felt uneasy when he recalled it and his feeling only grew stronger.
“High Venerable is amazing! Sir has earned the greatest merit in fighting off the enemy attack. Please receive my and all our elders’ respect!” Barely getting on his feet, Ren Xiaoyun looked grave, giving Xiao Yunshan a deep bow, with the rest following after him.
Giving an annoyed wave, Xiao Yunshan was feeling restless…
Whoosh!
A sharp cry came from behind followed by an icy bloodthirst. Startled, he looked back to see a pitch-black blade in his face.
Caught by surprise, Xiao Yunshan worked on instinct, raising two fingers to stab with Yuan Qi.
Pff!
The fingers flew before Xiao Yunshan, seeing Zhuo Fan’s weird grin in front of him, “Xiao Yunshan, you got soft.”
Xiao Yunshan’s brow shook, feeling pain from below. What he saw made him sigh.
He had ended up just like the other Soul Harmony experts, cut in two.
The black sword had cut through his belly and his soul.
“Double Dragon Manor’s divine weapon, Vaulting Sword!” Xiao Yunshan had blood coming from his mouth, yet he looked quite calm.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “You’re going about what killed you when you’re already dead?”
“Ha-ha-ha, of course, since the Heaven-reaching Sword was gleaned while training in Double Dragon Manor. I had the chance to stand a hundred meters from this divine weapon and sense its aura. While I don’t know its current aura, I can tell it from its appearance.”
Xiao Yunshan smiled, “My skill can block any spiritual weapon for some time, with just this divine weapon able to cut it.”
Zhuo Fan said, “Your power and heart are high and I wouldn’t have won if not for trickery. You’re no ordinary Soul Harmony expert. I didn’t want to kill you either, but you’re shielding Heaven Trailing Sect and have killed my master. I could never let you go.”
“Ha-ha-ha, I know that as well.”
Xiao Yunshan smiled, “I shouldn’t fight you as you’re my old friend’s disciple. But with your strength and coming to destroy my sect, I had to do it to avoid its demise. We each have our reason to kill the other, just that you came out on top and I lost. That’s all there is to it. Though I’m curious about one thing, what just happened?”
Sensing he was close to the end, Zhuo Fan humored him, “I have a lot of great skills and one of them is capable of setting up a space and creating an illusion. What you have cut was just my illusion while I hid in that space. I waited for you to be consumed by this strange event and struck when your guard was down.”
“I see, so there’s a strange skill like that in the world.”
Xiao Yunshan looked white, looking at Zhuo Fan through a haze, “Such a skill had never been seen in western lands. I’m sure that the whole world hasn’t one user, especially that old man. Although he said you’re his disciple, who is your true master?”
Zhuo Fan pondered his hopeful gaze, “Elder Yuan is my master in Dao that I respect and admire, while the master that passed on his skills to me is someone else. He is a reclusive expert. I don’t know if he’s dead or alive, but I’m sure he’s very strong, stronger than anyone in these lands, already in the Genesis Stage. Everything is nothing more than an ant to him.”
“He’s better than the central area’s Invincible Sword…”
“Invincible? Humph, only an ignorant fool would call himself that.” Zhuo Fan mocked, “Even when that master can flick him to death, he still won’t proclaim himself invincible.”
Xiao Yunshan shook and sighed, “This is fate. With such a strong master, why did we even go to offend you? Even if you die, your master would come for revenge. Western lands wouldn’t be able to stop him and the sect would perish. I had given my all and have no regrets. Old man, I lost to your disciple. You should rest now…”
Spewing blood, Xiao Yunshan’s eyes lost their light as he fell.
“High Venerable!”
The elders below were shocked. Their protector, High Venerable, was dead…
Everyone was by themselves with fear as they watched the lone figure in the air.
How could they let Xie Wuyue’s twisted words entice them and bring about such calamity?
Zhuo Fan looked coldly at the body on the ground and sighed. None of them wanted to fight, but their position made it impossible to avoid a clash.
[Life is so frustrating.]
After this frustration, what he loved the most was sending these bastards to hell!
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone and turned on Ren Xiaoyun’s group with a twisted smile. The victims shook in terror…
A month later, Blackwind Mountain was packed with people, as well as three new familiar faces, Chu Qingcheng, Ye Lin and Wu Qingqiu.
Luo Yunhai saw that everyone was here and began, “People, everyone should be familiar with Edifice Lord Chu. She now represents Double Dragon Manor and has come to investigate the recent sect destructions. The other two are Ultimate Clarity Sect’s senior brothers Wu Qingqiu and Ye Lin!”
Everyone bowed in respect and caution. None from superior-three sects could be offended, especially from Double Dragon Manor.
“There’s no need for courtesy. We only came to ask some questions. Just think of us as guests.”
Wu Qingqiu was quite respectful, “After our investigation of the Demon Scheming Sect and Mystical Heaven Sect, we found not a soul alive yet also no traces. The more people there are, the more clues there should be. While the less there are, the more powerful they had to be. As we have nothing to go on as of now, we could only ask the help of the greatest faction closest to the two sects, the Luo Alliance.”
Everyone jerked, “Are you suspecting us?”
Pff!
The sudden outburst got everyone to turn to Ye Lin.
“Ha-ha-ha, sorry, but have some self-respect. None of us are fools here. You’re the last suspects if you ever were, especially with your strength.” Ye Lin mocked, earning angry glares.
[We may be weaker than you, but are you looking down on us by voicing it?]
Chu Qingcheng mediated, “Sorry, everyone, he’s always so rude. Don’t mind him. We only came to understand something. Who knows where Zhuo Fan’s master is?”

chapters.title: Chapter 841: Special Background
chapters.content:
Chapter 841: Special Background
Proofreader
: Papatonks
[Steward Zhuo’s master?]
Everyone present was taken aback. Then they started talking amongst themselves in hushed tones.
The members present here were all from the Tianyu Empire, and many from the former seven noble houses. Yet all here, once foe or friend, looked into Zhuo Fan with no results.
Chu Qingcheng’s sudden question had them thinking again.
[With Zhuo Fan’s capacity for power and shrewdness, just where’s his master? That’s what we’d like to know too!]
“Uhm, Edifice Lord Chu, you’re asking the wrong person. All of us are in the dark as well. Steward Zhuo came from the Luo clan, so you’re better off asking them.”
An elder of ex-Sword Marquise Abode pointed to Luo Yunhai on his main seat. The others bobbed their heads, “Yeah, you should be asking the Luo clan. Steward Zhuo is theirs. If they don’t know, no one does.”
Luo Yunhai shrugged, “People, brother Zhuo might have come from the Luo clan, but not even we know how he got all those skills. I believe that all of you, having roamed Tianyu for decades, are far wiser and capable of getting some hints into his background.”
[You think we’d have lost to you so badly if we’d known already?]
Rolling their eyes, the people from Hell Valley, Pill King Hall and many, many others twisted their heads away in annoyance.
Wu Qingqiu’s team frowned.
[Did Zhuo Fan just pop out of a rock or something? There were so many powers in Tianyu yet none figured out his master?]
Luo Yunhai shook his head and cupped his hands, “Sorry, senior brother Wu, brother Zhuo had grown up in the Luo clan just like any ordinary person. Only after the Luo clan was facing disaster did brother Zhuo reveal his talents. Not once had he ever remotely mentioned anything about his master either so we didn’t press the issue either. Even though you came a long way to check on his background, I’m sorry to say that not even we know.”
“How can that be…” Wu Qingqiu was stumped. Chu Qingcheng looked disappointed, hoping to get a trace of Zhuo Fan through them, that maybe…
[We didn’t get anything.]
Ye Lin was calm as a cucumber, though he was smart not to show it, only displaying a vague smile. Zhuo Fan’s master was among the greatest in Sacred Domain, and the oldest. It was obvious they were clueless.
This secret was privy to a very few sacred beasts and himself, a sacred beast inheritor. Others would ever know such a heavy secret.
[Not like they deserve it, humph…]
Ye Lin dangled one leg over the other, looking quite smug.
[The grasp of secrets embodies the gap between people, ha-ha-ha…]
Just as the investigation hit a dead-end, an aged voice said, “Lass Chuchu, why exactly are you looking into Zhuo Fan anyway? Are you perhaps suspecting that the fall of the three sects have something to do with him?”
Chu Qingcheng looked back at the group with hope.
The one to call her that had to be an elder close to her from years back.
“Uncle Jiu!”
Chu Qingcheng turned to Elder Jiu from the ex-Veiled Dragon Pavilion, Godeye Long Jiu. He was the first senior involved with Zhuo Fan in Tianyu. The two grew so close they became brothers.
Godeye Long Jiu had to know something about Zhuo Fan. Chu Qingcheng bowed in joy, “Uncle Jiu, how have you been all these years?”
Godeye Long Jiu smiled, “Ha-ha-ha, still kicking, though aggrieved having heard of brother Zhuo’s passing. If only I had the strength, I would’ve…”
Long Jiu’s eye flashed with bloodthirst. Chu Qingcheng clenched her fists.
[Yeah, they don’t have the power, or they’d have long destroyed the Demon Scheming Sect.]
Wu Qingqiu sighed at the sudden shift in mood, also saddened. As a member of the investigation team, he didn’t come to incite revenge though. So he bowed, “Junior sister Qingcheng sees sir as Uncle Jiu, so I’ll be presumptuous to call sir that as well, despite my inadequacies.”
“Oh, there’s no need for that, young master Wu.” Long Jiu returned the bow. Wu Qingqiu was nice and very polite without any arrogance, he was still a disciple from a superior-three sect, not to mention in the Ethereal Stage. Long Jiu would never take advantage and presume himself his elder.
Wu Qingqiu smiled, “Uncle Jiu is too kind. It’s only natural to treat seniors as such. Moreover, I also noticed sir has been referring to Zhuo Fan as brother. I would be very grateful if Uncle Jiu would be willing to answer some questions.”
“Young master Wu, please ask away.” Long Jiu bowed as Wu Qingqiu did.
Wu Qingqiu nodded, “Uncle Jiu, to be quite honest, we suspect the culprit in the destruction of the three sects to have come from outside our lands, or someone taking revenge for what happened to Zhuo Fan a year ago. Thus I ask for everyone’s help, in telling us if Zhuo Fan had been close to anyone in Tianyu besides you all. As far as I know, his skills did not come from the Demon Scheming Sect, so where could they come from?”
“Are you implying that his master took revenge?” Long Jiu cried out.
The others jumped, perking their ears to not miss a thing.
[It has to be! To train an abomination like Zhuo Fan, the power achieving this must be a force to be reckoned with.]
They had begun to have an inkling just how great his background was.
It was not like just any average power could just ruin three sects in western lands overnight.
The ones to rejoice the most were the ex-houses.
[Thank god Zhuo Fan won in the fight for Tianyu. If he lost at our hands, then Tianyu would’ve been plunged into hell.]
When it destroyed the Demon Scheming Sect, of western lands’ nine sects, ruining Tianyu would’ve been child’s play if they thought about it.
[So that’s why he was so obnoxious. I always felt it off. His backing explains it. Demon Scheming Sect never figured it out so that’s why they’re now six feet under.]
[That’s what you get for messing with someone stronger than you thinking you’re better. So easy when you have no clue who’s behind him… ]
Everyone sighed. Only Long Jiu pondered, “Brother Zhuo’s master, hmm, well he did mention it once, though I’m not sure if it was real or not…”
“Really, who?” Wu Qingqiu lit up.
Long Jiu was grave, “Overlord Nine Serenities!”
Ugh!
Wu Qingqiu’s group was stunned.
[Overlord Nine Serenities? Is there someone like that in western lands?]
Ye Lin almost did a spit take.
[Is that a reference to Nine Serenities Sovereign? Elder brother, are you toying with these yokels for not knowing about the ten sovereigns?]
Everyone around looked perplexed.
“Uncle Jiu, uhm, Overlord Nine Serenities does sound great, but I’m ashamed to say I’ve never heard of him. Who is he, where does he come from?” Wu Qingqiu asked.
Long Jiu shook his head, “I don’t know. He just dropped that full of smiles, so I always thought it was a joke. Now that you’re asking about his master, it feels like it might be true.”
“Overlord Nine Serenities…”
Wu Qingqiu’s eyes shone, “Who is he? No one in the entire world with any amount of name to himself or power knows such a person. Do any of you know?”
Wu Qingqiu turned to the rest, only to see them stumped.
Wu Qingqiu frowned. He came to know more about Zhuo Fan and got a clue, only to have more questions left unanswered.
[Overlord Nine Serenities, what the hell is that anyway? Sounds as grand as the best in the central area, Invincible Sword, but never heard of him.
Ye Lin played dumb while his senior brother was getting nowhere.
“Why don’t you go ask Devil Mountain?” A girl spoke.
Wu Qingqiu’s team turned to Lei Yuting, Luo clan’s shadow corps captain. Lei Yuting continued, “When the Luo clan was stationed in Blackwind Mountain, Zhuo Fan took me to set up the arrays around it. I overheard him say something about creating a second Devil Mountain here. Maybe that’s where his master is.”
Wu Qingqiu had found a direction at long last, though his hopeful look was met with equally lost gazes.
Wu Qingqiu’s face twitched.
[No point asking about Devil Mountain then. Where the hell is that even?]
[The more we dig, the more secretive Zhuo Fan’s background is. All I got for my questions are more questions.]
Where should they go next?
Wu Qingqiu sighed.
[Brother Zhuo, did you really pop out of thin air? Why can’t we find anything about you…]

chapters.title: Chapter 842: Overlord Nine Serenities
chapters.content:
Chapter 842: Overlord Nine Serenities
Proofreader
: Papatonks
With his hair billowing in the wind, a tall and bright man stood on a tall peak, looking free and easy.
This made the deep sigh that came after from this eminent middle-aged man as he watched the sky uncharacteristic.
Whoosh~
Three people suddenly landed in front of him and bowed, “Elder Du!”
“Have you learned anything from your investigation in Tianyu?” Elder Du looked at them and asked, “Is the destruction of the Beast Taming Sect, Demon Scheming Sect and Mystical Heaven Sect related to Zhuo Fan? Or did someone else have a hand in it….”
The trio shook their heads with a sigh.
Elder Du was confused, “Was that a tough question? If Zhuo Fan has a strong force behind him, we’d continue our investigation in this direction. If not, that leaves our revenge and we can focus on the powers coming into western lands. This may very well be the first time western lands has been assaulted and requires the Exalted’s full attention in looking into the three areas. Once again, people are suffering…”
Elder Du gave a bemoaning sigh while the trio hung their heads with heavy looks.
Elder Du was curious, “What’s wrong with you? Just what did you find?”
“Uhm, Elder Du, we have found something about Zhuo Fan’s background, although…” Wu Qingqiu hesitated, “Luo clan, his home in Tianyu, has now gathered many clans and formed the Luo Alliance. Their growth is swift, beyond anything a small nation could become. It’s steadily heading towards becoming a top empire…”
Elder Du cut him off impatiently, “I know of Luo Alliance. No matter how fast it grows, it’s nowhere near capable of destroying even the weakest sect of western lands, especially not without some noise. Only an absolute power can pull it off, They, ha-ha, are way behind. They may have the motive, but since they lack the power, they’ve been ruled out. Now, is there any other power?”
“Uhm, well, there might possibly be just one.”
The trio exchanged looks and Wu Qingqiu hesitated.
Elder Du found it strange, “Wu Qingqiu, you’re always calm and collected about everything so why are you dawdling? Speak up, what did you find?!”
“Elder Du, have you heard of Devil Mountain or Overlord Nine Serenities?” Wu Qingqiu probed.
Elder Du asked, “Where is that supposed to be? Who’s Overlord Nine Serenities?”
“I just knew sir hadn’t heard of them either.”
“You think I’d know every damn name in the vast western lands? You think I have time to learn some nobody’s name?” Elder Du huffed.
Wu Qingqiu sighed, “If only he were a nobody. The master of Double Dragon Gathering’s best disciple, Zhuo Fan, is Overlord Nine Serenities from Devil Mountain. Being the master of the future best in western lands can’t be said to be a nobody in some way…”
“You’re saying he taught Zhuo Fan?”
Elder Du turned solemn, “Since Zhuo Fan had always been showing remarkable and bizarre skills, some of the likes western lands has never seen, then the master has to be just as monstrous. But the name and location…”
Elder Du frowned, while the trio waited for him to come up with a response.
As he was wracking his brain, an elder and three familiar figures came over, Yan Mo, Wen Tao and Xie Tianshang.
Double Dragon Manor had formed three investigation teams. Chu Qingcheng’s went to Tianyu, to look into Zhuo Fan’s avenger, while Yan Mo’s checked out Beast Taming Sect’s side, in Quanrong.
The Beast Taming Sect was the only one unrelated to Zhuo Fan. If the investigation in Tianyu reached a dead end, at least over there could offer some clues.
But by the looks of them, it was plain to see nothing came of it.
“For god’s sake! What kind of ridiculous power did the attackers on the Beast Taming Sect have? It’s too crafty. There’s not a trace left in the Beast Taming Sect, with the entire Quanrong being clueless as well. The imperial capital had lost a large part of imperial members overnight yet none was the wiser. This definitely stinks!”
The fat elder shook his head while whining about his lack of results. Chu Qingcheng bowed, “Greetings, Elder Ou!”
“It’s fine. Ugh, so damn annoying!” Elder Ou waved her off while still whining.
Yan Mo sighed, “What a waste of time, the culprit left not one damn thing behind, none! I’m really starting to think a western lands outsider did this!”
Wu Qingqiu frowned. Besides outside influence, the only viable suspect would be Zhuo Fan’s avenger, though his investigation had hit a snag…
Alas, they had let the clues slip right through their fingers.
Zhuo Fan had wiped Beast Taming Sect and Demon Scheming Sect from this world, down to the last soul while none saw him, though he did leave a trail in Quanrong’s imperial capital. They just had to look closer and they’d have caught a glimpse of Zhuo Fan’s ghost appearing among mortals.
Though the Quanrong emperor censored anything related to him in the imperial capital right after.
He didn’t fear Zhuo Fan being found out, but that the destruction of the Beast Taming Sect had something to do with his clan, earning the ire of Beast Taming Sect’s elders.
It was best keeping a scandal in the family, or they might even be overthrown if word got out they were involved.
Quanrong emperor covered for Zhuo Fan, but more for his scandal since there was common interest.
With all of Quanrong tight lipped, Yan Mo’s team had no success.
“Old Du, what are you mumbling about? Can’t I even get a hello?” Elder Ou saw Elder Du pensive and found it odd.
Elder Du said, “Old Ou, ever heard of Devil Mountain or an expert calling himself Overlord Nine Serenities in all your years roaming the western lands?”
“Where did you hear that taunting title?”
Elder Ou asked, “Anyone calling himself Overlord Nine Serenities is asking for it. He’d be thrashed the minute one was foolish enough to utter it. Only that Invincible Sword dares call himself like that. Though no one in all the lands could beat him. This Overlord Nine Serenities sounds just about the same. But that would mean peak Genesis Stage!”
Elder Du shook his head, “Right? If Overlord Nine Serenities is so powerful, he’ll be a calamity upon western lands. We can’t go looking into this case any longer. We best stay far away from it instead.”
“Who is Overlord Nine Serenities anyway? Did you piss him off?” Seeing Elder Du so helpless, Elder Ou asked.
Elder Du was vague, “I know not how he looks or his cultivation, so how could I piss him off? Demon Scheming Sect and the rest probably did though, to earn their destruction. They say he’s Zhuo Fan’s master…”
“What?!”
Elder Ou cried out, “You’re telling me that his master destroyed sects out of revenge for his disciple? Just who is Overlord Nine Serenities? How strong is he? I don’t recall any in western, uh, the whole world bearing that title!”
Elder Du sighed, “I know that, but to call himself such, he can’t be a pushover. You said it yourself. To use such a taunting title, he had to be able to back it up. What’s most important is that he’s Zhuo Fan’s master. With the disciple such a monster, what would that make the master? “
“This clears things up.”
Elder Ou spoke firmly, “This is a classic case of revenge by annihilating sects. Demon Scheming Sect and Mystical Heaven Sect are done for which means the next is…”
“Heaven Trailing Sect!”
Everyone cried out.
“But Heaven Trailing Sect isn’t a lower-three sect like the others. It has a dozen Soul Harmony experts and the renowned Heaven Trailing Sword with his Heaven-reaching Sword protecting it. Taking it out will be harder!” Elder Du analyzed.
The others nodded, with Elder Ou looking tense, “However, if that Overlord Nine Serenities is in Genesis Stage as we surmised…”
Elder Du’s heart sank and his face was hard.
Shui Ruohua’s team, lead by her elder rushed over, shouting, “This is bad! We went to check Heaven Trailing Sect only to find that the entire sect is destroyed just like the others!”
[What?!]

chapters.title: Chapter 843: Dragon Breath Pill’s Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 843: Dragon Breath Pill’s Power
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Whoosh~
With the breaking news of Heaven Trailing Sect’s destruction, the three teams now trailed the sunny skies at full speed to reach Universal Righteous Sect.
“Old Du, if Overlord Nine Serenities wants revenge, then the next target is definitely the Universal Righteous Sect!” Elder Ou said as the two flew shoulder to shoulder.
Elder Du nodded with a frown. Wu Qingqiu spoke up at this point, “Universal Righteous Sect is a superior-three sect, with many Genesis Stage cultivators, not like the previous two categories. I just can’t see how it’s possible for it to end up the same as the others!”
“Child, you’re too young, having yet to witness true experts.”
Elder Ou sighed, “You must’ve heard by now of Danqing Shen trampling on the ten sects. Did you think he wasn’t strong enough to destroy one, even a superior-three sect? Humph, it was western lands’ rules that stopped him. He’s part of western lands after all. But this Overlord Nine Serenities is ready to kill down to the last soul to take revenge for his disciple. Coupled with Danqing Shen’s strength, then a puny Universal Righteous Sect stands no chance at all. In front of true and ultimate power, a sect is nothing more than a house of cards, left to be stomped under his foot at his whim.”
Elder Ou’s eyes flashed with a deep look, fearful of such display of raw force.
Wu Qingqiu shuddered and nodded.
Yan Mo mocked, “Elder Ou, since he’s so mighty, with even a superior-three sect worthless, won’t that makes us small fries?”
“No. As we represent Double Dragon Manor, someone with the authority to move all of western lands’ forces.”
Elder Du’s eyes flashed, “As long as he’s not dead set on it, we can leverage our names to talk it out. Not just anyone is willing to become a public enemy of the entire western lands. Not even Danqing Shen of old.”
“And if he is dead set on revenge?”
“Well…”
Yan Mo asked, to which Elder Du sighed, “Then it’ll be a second Invincible Sword.”
“Invincible Sword?”
“Yes, going by his rumored strength, he alone has the capacity to fight an area’s entire force.” Elder Du spoke heavily, “Only with the alliance made up of the other four areas could we stop his advance. However, now he has reached peak Genesis Stage, from which he can’t advance an inch. If there was a stage beyond Genesis Stage, he’d have achieved it with his talent, becoming the undisputed strongest man in the world. His invincible title is warranted.”
The others grew tense at the revelation.
Ye Lin’s eyes flickered with the flames of battle.
The only reason Invincible Sword was stuck at that level was because the mortal domain had a limit imposed on it.
[Though how did he train to reach such great power then? I wonder who’d win if I’d reach Genesis Stage, a sacred beast inheritor or a mere human?]
The thirst for battle thrummed in Ye Lin’s heart, surging like a volcano…
“Look, we’re almost at the Universal Righteous Sect!”
Elder Du pointed in the distance, at a verdant forest, “Let’s hurry up…”
Boom!
An explosion of fire like no other erupted and drowned his words. The golden inferno rose beyond the clouds, like it had swallowed the heavens.
The heatwave came next, slamming into them like a hammer.
The three elders cried out, “Protect the disciples!”
The elders unleashed their Yuan Qi, and with the world’s power, they formed a shield in front.
It proved to be of no use, as a shockwave came and blew it to pieces. It attacked the elders and forced them to spew blood, before sending them flying.
The next were the disciples, faring no better, spilling blood from their mouths and falling unconscious.
An hour had to pass for them to come to, but what they were seeing was nothing their tiny minds could prepare them of the devastation.
For thousands upon thousands of miles, not a blade of grass grew. Any sign to indicate a lush and verdant forest once grew here was now gone, replaced by ashes and burning soot.
Pff!
Elder Du spat blood once more, “W-what the hell is this? W-why is… there’s nothing left!”
“We must’ve arrived just as the explosion happened. But for even we, in the Genesis Stage, to suffer such heavy wounds, I can only dread what power it has at its epicenter…”
Elder Ou got up on shaky legs, his words waking everyone up.
[Right! The Universal Righteous Sect was just there. Then…]
Looking ahead, all they saw were golden flames billowing higher and higher. Its searing hit burning on their skin, so strong it evaporated the blood they just spilled.
It worked on their bodies as well, baking them alive and drying them up in just fifteen minutes.
Chu Qingcheng found this view eerily familiar, her eyes filled with tears as she muttered, “Z-Zhuo Fan…”
“What?” The elders jerked, “Qingcheng, what are you saying?”
Chu Qingcheng sobbed, “On the day of Zhuo Fan’s death, the same inferno happened, spreading for five hundred miles, taking even his body. This fire may be much stronger, but I’ll never forget such flames…”
The elders looked at each other in realization.
“Junior brother, this fire feels similar to yours.” Wu Qingqiu asked Ye Lin.
Rolling his eyes, Ye Lin huffed, “Senior brother, are you mocking me? This is far more powerful and concentrated. If I had this in the Double Dragon Gathering, I wouldn’t have lost.”
“Really?” Wu Qingqiu eyed him, still suspicious.
Ye Lin was faking it on purpose. Of all the natural golden flames in the world, he knew only one that held such unbridled power, Decimating Dragon Ancestor’s Decimating Golden Flame.
As to how it ended up here, he was positive Zhuo Fan got a Dragon Breath Pill from the dragon ancestor.
[Elder brother, what a waste of a Dragon Breath Pill to use it here.]
He knew the Dragon Breath Pill Zhuo Fan got was a sacred beast’s strongest attack. That thing he used was a mere toy.
Throwing such a Dragon Breath Pill around the mortal domain was like burning ants, an utter waste.
Ye Lin sighed inside.
[That’s supposed to be used to save yourself, not get revenge…]
“Let’s see what exactly happened.” The elders nodded with grave looks.
They all knew the Universal Righteous Sect had been wiped out, but an investigation still had to take place.
The three elders carried their damaged bodies as they led the disciples towards the inferno…
Zhuo Fan was walking away from the blaze in a black robe and with a smile on his face.
[Ha-ha-ha, Dragon Breath Pill is the best! I just poke a hole in the sect barrier then threw it in. No matter how many Genesis Stage and Soul Harmony Stage experts it has, they’re all toast!]
This had to be the easiest revenge yet for Zhuo Fan. He didn’t have to waste time and sully his eyes with their presence, just throw something in and send them to their maker.
[Worthy of dragon ancestor’s true power!]
Though seeing such destruction, Zhuo Fan found it unbearable, not remorse for anybody, but that the Dragon Breath Pill was such a waste here.
Though he used it in the end, wiping any sign of life from every corner.
Humming a tune, Zhuo Fan walked on. But then he frowned as he looked further ahead.
[Eh, someone’s coming?]
[Whether friend or foe, an away team or a fugitive, I’ll know once I’ll look.]
Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed in six golden halos.
Divine Eye of the Void 6th stage, Void Domain!
Hum~
The air rippled under his power, forming a barrier. Zhuo Fan entered it and vanished from the world.
All he left behind was a world of flames…

chapters.title: Chapter 844: Heart’s Reaction
chapters.content:
Chapter 844: Heart’s Reaction
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Whoosh~
The blistering heat coming off the golden inferno burned anything and warped the air. Chu Qingcheng and the other teams from Double Dragon Manor soon arrived, where no living being could survive.
Even the Genesis Stage elders were feeling the hot air burning their throats, to say nothing of the disciples.
They all looked pained and panting for breath, like staying here any longer would directly sap their life.
“For god’s sake! How can a human do this?”
Everywhere they looked all they saw was golden flames and even more golden flames. Elder Du’s face watched in shock, “The superior-three sect, Universal Righteous Sect, had been destroyed in a flash. Is this the power of Devil Mountain’s Overlord Nine Serenities?”
[Overlord Nine Serenities and Devil Mountain?]
Zhuo Fan, in his little hidey-hole, had his heart jump at that name.
[How did they come to know that?]
Soon he figured they must’ve looked into Tianyu.
[Double Dragon Manor started investigating the destruction of western lands’ sects.]
[Great, pinning it all on the fake Overlord Nine Serenities should buy some time before Double Dragon Manor gets to the real answer.]
Who knew the little joke he pulled ages ago in Tianyu would be so useful?
If Double Dragon Manor had kept investigating, they’d soon catch up to him.
[And that wouldn’t do.]
While he feared no one, he wasn’t looking for trouble either and getting chased to death all the time wasn’t a good thing. Obliterating four sects of western lands was a heavy crime from which he could never escape.
“Did Overlord Nine Serenities do this?”
Elder Ou looked around in shock, “There’s just no way! No person could have such power. I bet not even the world’s strongest, Invincible Sword, could pull this off.”
“You mean…”
“Something stinks around here!”
Elder Ou’s eyes flashed at Elder Du’s words, “This can’t be done by just one man. There has to be another explanation we’ve yet to figure out. Maybe something volatile was happening beneath Universal Righteous Sect that he made use of to do this. Why else then of all the other sects, only the Universal Righteous Sect ended up like this? In any case, I refuse to believe that a cultivator could be so strong.”
His analysis earned the nods of others.
[Of course, if he’s so powerful, what’s the point of investigating anyway since they’d end up killed all the same. If not, the whole western lands would fall.]
But if it were like Elder Ou said, using the earth’s unstable power to create such a disaster, then he wouldn’t be as strong.
[We could fight him!]
Zhuo Fan nodded inside.
[At least there’s someone in the team that can use his head. Yes, there’s no one in mortal domain capable of such might.]
As this was the strongest attack of a sacred beast from Sacred Domain that none in the mortal domain had ever heard of, coming to the conclusion the power of the earth was borrowed instead was not a bad logic.
This, however, meant the team would keep going and affect Zhuo Fan in turn. Ye Lin was well aware, though clueless how to ease this problem, “Elder Ou, maybe Overlord Nine Serenities didn’t do this by himself, but the entire Devil Mountain perhaps. Do you think by finding this sect, can western lands fight it?”
The elders shook and grew tense.
[Right! A guy doesn’t have the power, but if Devil Mountain was packed with experts, then anyone could resort to such cruelty. This proves their sect is stronger than western lands.]
There was no point in looking further into it when they couldn’t even beat it.
“Impossible!”
Elder Ou spoke with determination among the hesitant looks, “Kid, look closely at this catastrophe, could all the power of the world gathered together recreate it? That’s why, only the world’s power can be the culprit, and not a man’s. I still believe Overlord Nine Serenities used this method to shake us, a mere bluff. All so we would mistake his level and drop the investigation. This only proves he hasn’t that kind of power western lands should fear.
“How else would you explain his secretive actions, vanishing after ruining every sect? Even as we came here, we saw no sign of anyone around, clearly done to cover his tracks.”
Elder Ou sputtered on in a loud tone, finding his logic even more sound. It even sounded smug for being so smart.
The others nodded their heads.
[When did the old coot’s melon get so sharp?]
Even Zhuo Fan had to give him credit. He might believe the old guy’s logic if he hadn’t done this himself.
Only Ye Lin was not about to let it go, sighing, “What if going after Overlord Nine Serenities is us playing with fire? When we face him, what then?”
“There’s no ‘what if’. I don’t believe anyone is almighty unless I see him for myself. Like hell he’s even more unstoppable than that Invincible Sword!”
Elder Ou flicked his hand, looking smug and convinced, buying into his own excuse.
The others nodded, finding the logic sound and continuing the investigation.
Zhuo Fan chuckled with a shake of his head. Having ruined four sects in western lands, it was safe to say, the sooner he left here, the better…
Zhuo Fan gave one pair of eyes, with the golden inferno reflected within, one last look, finding it hard to look away.
[We won’t be seeing again, Qingcheng…]
Sss~
As thunder exploded, he saw sparked lighting flashing between his hands. Startled, Zhuo Fan watched the Thunder Ring flicker to life.
Chu Qingcheng’s own ring reacted the same.
Zhuo Fan looked at the two rings in shock, “How? This space is cut off from reality, so how are the Thunder Rings reacting?”
As this ring had been with its master for so long, it molded to his true nature. The yearning Zhuo Fan and Chu Qingcheng had for each other triggered the rings, breaching the confines of this space.
“Z-Zhuo Fan?”
Chu Qingcheng looked at the Thunder Ring in shock, her eyes tearing up as she cried out and searched everywhere, “Zhuo Fan, you’re not dead! You’re here, aren’t you?”
[Zhuo Fan ain’t dead?]
The elders turned to her, “Qingcheng, what are you saying? How do you know that?”
Chu Qingcheng only cried out Zhuo Fan’s name, her eyes filled with hope. She knew that only his Thunder Ring could connect with hers. These rings were their oaths.
“Junior sister Qingcheng, maybe you just think you saw him from how much you long for him. Zhuo Fan is dead, so how can he be here?” Ye Lin started.
[If they find elder brother, then he’ll become western lands’ enemy.]
While shouting, he rushed to Chu Qingcheng, holding her hand and the ring, hiding its luster.
Chu Qingcheng only knew him and Zhuo Fan as enemies and that didn’t change. His sudden action earned her hatred, “Beat it! I know you only see Zhuo Fan as your enemy and can’t wait for him to die. But he’s still alive, and he’s here! Zhuo Fan, it’s me, Qingcheng! Come out…”
Ye Lin shrugged, his kindness scorned.
[What good will it do calling him out? You’re just letting western lands hound him. This chick has lost it, thinking my gesture was out of ill will.]
[If only you weren’t sister-in-law…]
Ye Lin gnashed his teeth.
“Use your souls to scan the area!” The elders immediately started looking around for any signs, but all they sensed the was the searing heat.
The three elders shook their heads, sighing at Chu Qingcheng’s frantic cries.
[Is this how an excellent disciple fell into darkness by the loss of her husband?]

chapters.title: Chapter 845: Scared to Death
chapters.content:
Chapter 845: Scared to Death
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Qingcheng, don’t do this. Zhuo Fan’s gone. He’s not here…”
Chu Qingcheng was frantic in her search and cried even as Shui Ruohua and Dan’er hugged her, tearing up at her pain.
The others shook their heads.
[This is called being obsessed…]
Chu Qingcheng did not listen to reason, shaking her head and pointing at the flashing ring with joy, “Senior sister, he’s still alive and here too. Just look, only we have this pair of rings, and they only react when the other is around. This is his keepsake. He’s definitely here…”
Chu Qingcheng was desperate in convincing everyone of this reality, but they only saw it as her lying to herself, wanting to believe with every fiber that Zhuo Fan was in this world.
“Qingcheng, I may not know that ring, but we have scanned this place for a hundred miles around yet there’s no one here but us.”
Elder Du soothed.
Chu Qingcheng bit her lip, not giving up, “No, he’s close by. It’s just that you can’t find him. No one can find him with his skills. Only I, as his wife, know in my being that he is here…”
“That’s enough, Chu Qingcheng!”
Elder Ou shouted in anger, a vein popping on his forehead, “We’re Genesis Stage experts, yet you’re saying we can’t even find some brat? We can find something as small as an ant, let alone him. Since we did not find him, then he isn’t here. How long are you going to continue this crazy act?”
Glaring at him, Chu Qingcheng still called out Zhuo Fan’s name, “Zhuo Fan, it’s me, your wife! Please come to me…”
“Don’t just stand there, take her away!” Elder Ou’s patience was at an end as he stared at Wu Qingqiu.
Bobbing his head, he went to Chu Qingcheng with a sigh, “Junior sister Qingcheng, there’s something off about the ring, I’m sure of it. Zhuo Fan is gone now and there’s no way he can be here. Let’s just get you back to Double Dragon Manor and get some rest.”
“No, the ring never lied to me! He’s here!”
Struggling with all she had, Chu Qingcheng kept crying out, “Zhuo Fan…”
In his sealed space, Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth and shut his eyes, even though tears gathered at the corners.
He knew he shouldn’t have met her, because he could not take the parting…
“Qingcheng.”
The heart prevailed in the end and Zhuo Fan spoke in a low tone.
All shuddered at the heavy tone, unable to overcome their shock. Chu Qingcheng was overjoyed, “Zhuo Fan, is it really you? I knew you’re alive!”
“Is Zhuo Fan actually alive?”
The elders looked around frantically, “With him alive, the case of the sects’ destruction has a solution!”
Yet no amount of searching helped.
A laughter came then, “Ha-ha-ha, three imps trying to scan with your souls in face of yours truly? How pitiful!”
With a whoosh, black thunderflame erupted from that space, as high as a kilometer and spreading for miles and miles.
The black thunderflame took the shape of a giant with golden eyes, the flame within like two erupting volcanoes.
The sheer dread coming off him slammed into the three Genesis Stage elders. They shuddered and felt like mere insects that could be stomped at any time.
“T-this…”
All craned their necks to watch the black fire giant, feeling their knees going soft at its power.
Ye Lin fared no better despite knowing the truth behind it. He gulped.
[What is this? Did the Nine Serenities Sovereign descend?]
This power was at the level of his master and only the ten sovereigns wielded it.
[Everyone knows Nine Serenities Sovereign is missing so how can he suddenly be in the mortal domain?]
Ye Lin was too shocked to make any sense of it.
When a sacred beast inheritor was scared, much couldn’t be said about the rest, looking white as paper and gasping for breath.
The three Genesis Stage elders were overcome with fear, looking at the huge face gazing at them with scorn, “Ha-ha-ha, weren’t you great before, you weaklings? Did the cat get your tongue?”
“S-senior…”
Elder Du’s shaky voice barely got a word out as he bowed, “May I know who senior is?”
The two golden balls of fire flashed as he cackled, “Ha-ha-ha, mistaking respect for fear. I’ve heard this saying many times, but weren’t you three pipsqueaks, shouting about wanting to see me? You won’t believe it until you see it, right? Well, here I am, do you believe it now?”
“Overlord Nine Serenities?”
Sss~
The elders gasped in shock. Elder Ou, who had analyzed Overlord Nine Serenities’ power just now almost soiled his pants.
The sheer power rolling off this giant was enough to rob them of all of their courage.
They knew now Universal Righteous Sect’s demise wasn’t made by borrowing power, but by unquestionable might.
Overlord Nine Serenities had never been seen before, but now they felt it all too well, the destructive power he wielded.
The trio fell to their knees on the spot, “Senior, please forgive our foolish words of ignorance!”
“Ha-ha-ha, brats, do you take me for someone as petty as you?”
The black giant mocked, “The missy has gone against your words and contradicted you, yet you wanted to attack a helpless woman? Humph, who knows how pissed off I’d be over the last three hundred millenium if I were as petty as you.”
Sss~
Gasping for the third time, they all looked in shock.
[Oh hell, three hundred damn thousand years?! What the hell is he? Even the oldest sect in western lands is barely ten thousand years old, but this guy is three hundred times that?]
[For crying out loud, he’s an old freak through and through. What Invincible Sword, he’s nothing to this guy. No wonder he’s so amazing and overpowered.]
[Wonder what stage he’s at. Definitely above Genesis Stage.]
The trio broke out in sweat, scared to death from even moving.
Ignoring them, the black giant stared down at Chu Qingcheng with a sigh. He waved and a flickering ring floated down, “Qingcheng, may I call you that? Is this what you were looking for?”
The ring rested in Chu Qingcheng’s palm, staring at the keepsake belonging to Zhuo Fan.
“This is Zhuo Fan’s…”
Chu Qingcheng looked at the giant, wanting to ask more but too afraid to know the truth.
The giant spoke, “Child, forget about him. He won’t be coming back.”
Chu Qingcheng’s fists shook.
“I had founded Devil Mountain three hundred thousand years ago, when no one could stand up to me!”
Recalling ancient memories, the black giant spoke, “But after two hundred thousand years, I grew tired, focusing on understanding Dao and entered seclusion, vanishing from the world. As it happened, in my rare travels in between across the world, I have met with disciples worthy of note. Zhuo Fan is one such disciple.
“To understand Dao, one must live in the world then rise above it. Most disciples do not roam the lands, but Zhuo Fan was still young and so I let him go before taking him back to dwell on the experiences. I thought the skills I passed on to him were enough to safeguard him. But never have I imagined he’d be tricked by some rotten people. This is life, this is fate…
The black giant sighed in mourning.
The elders broke out in sweat.
[It’s obvious now that it was revenge, but it’s not like we can do anything to him either.]
[Didn’t you hear him? He was already at the top of the world three hundred thousand years ago, stopping all infighting before withdrawing. He’s on a different level than our petty wars.]
[All of western lands’ power won’t be enough to even scratch him!]
[Not to mention Devil Mountain isn’t made up of one man. There’s still plenty of disciples. If they come out, what would happen to the world?]
The elders were scared to death. Looking into this case any further would poke the hornet’s nest.
[Not even the Invincible Sword would be so stupid…]

chapters.title: Chapter 846: Consideration
chapters.content:
Chapter 846: Consideration
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“But senior, I’ve seen the same fire when Zhuo Fan died that I see today. Was that senior as well?” Unafraid of this giant’s power, Chu Qingcheng looked up with hope.
The golden balls of fire flashed, “Yes, that was me snapping my fingers.”
[Well crud, if just snapping your fingers turned five hundred miles into a wasteland, then the old guy must be beyond almighty.]
The elders’ heart jerked.
Ye Lin barely held himself from lashing out. He knew what happened the best, since that was actually his doing. The fact that this black guy took credit for it proved…
[This is no Nine Serenities Sovereign, but Zhuo Fan’s high class act!]
[How did he make it so real though? He’s even got three Genesis Stage elders shaking in their boots.]
Glancing at the said elders, Ye Lin snickered inside.
“Then Zhuo Fan…” Chu Qingcheng was still hopeful.
The giant was blunt, “Is dead.”
“Dead?” Chu Qingcheng recoiled from shock, paling.
Zhuo Fan was in pain seeing his lover showing such utter despair. His nails drew blood as they dug into his palms, but his voice was firm, “When I arrived, Zhuo Fan’s soul was gone, his body mauled. In my rage, I removed everyone, down to the last man. I then took his body to bury him on Devil Mountain before coming to handle any resentments.
“Some puny sects of western lands showed some truly outrageous nerve to kill Devil Mountain’s disciple, humph! It’s all thanks to my insights in Dao that tempered my spirit or else the whole of western lands would have burned.”
The elders hung their sweaty heads, fear already prevalent in their terrorized hearts.
[Holy hell! The four sects had poked a god this time. Only fortune has it that his temper got milder and he did not drag down the rest of western lands with them.]
They could practically imagine him changing the world’s landscape three hundred thousand years ago like it was nothing.
[Good the four are done with, lest they troubled western lands further.]
The elders instantly switched tunes, no longer looking into the unfortunate loss of four sects, but actually cursing them for asking for it and getting what they deserved.
[You’d be better off messing with the Invincible Sword than this old freak!]
“Does that mean he’s… truly dead…”
Not registering all of his words, Chu Qingcheng gazed with dead eyes before slumping…
Shui Ruohua rushed over, “Qingcheng! What’s wrong…”
Zhuo Fan wanted to go as well, to hold his wife, but he reined in his impulse, lowering his hand and shaking his head.
His heart was bleeding, but he found no other solution, not when his enemy was just too strong. It was tantamount to suicide, with no idea when he’d appear.
He didn’t want to drag her into this and chose to cut off this cherished marriage he had barely formed…
Hum~
