The Thunder Ring in Chu Qingcheng’s hand vanished and appeared before the giant’s face.
“Listen up, you brats, Qingcheng is my disciple’s wife and now, a part of Devil Mountain!”
The black giant looked at Chu Qingcheng, “Tell her when she wakes up, that all of Devil Mountain will recognize her ring. To stay calm in the face of trouble, for it will flicker and shine with new hope.”
The giant vanished then, along with his power.
Looking at the remaining inferno around them, the elders stood up at last, only to slump back down, gasping and lamenting their fate.
“Old Du, that was scary as hell. That freak, uh, senior felt worse than when meeting the Exalted.”
“You think? I bet not even facing Invincible Sword would get such a reaction out of me like that… senior. His dreaded aura was just terrifying.”
“Yeah.”
The trio felt like they went through hell, now fortunate the came out alive.
Then they looked at Chu Qingcheng, “Hurry and take her to the sect!”
“Elder Ou, junior sister Qingcheng has fainted from heartache. We can’t disturb her, yet sir wants to return?” Wu Qingqiu sighed.
Elder Ou sputtered, “Cut the crap! Who said anything about dragging her back? I’m telling you to carry this lady carefully and tend to her health! She has to recover!”
Ugh!
Everyone made weird faces.
[What’s with the elder’s mood flipping like that? One minute he snapped when Chu Qingcheng contradicted him and now he…]
Elder Ou rolled his eyes.
“Are you fools, or what? Didn’t you hear senior? Chu Qingcheng is seen as his disciple’s wife and now under Devil Mountain’s protection. If anything happens to her while in Double Dragon Manor, then the ol-,uh, senior, will take it out on us! On the other hand, with the senior backing us, not even Invincible Sword will sound scary.
“That makes the young lady the brightest gem we have that we must nurture.” Elder Ou was firm, with the other elders nodding.
Now they understood and agreed with him.
[These elders are damn practical at least.]
Ye Lin realized why Zhuo Fan assumed the role of Overlord Nine Serenities, to protect Chu Qingcheng.
He witnessed Chu Qingcheng going against the elder and while not able to defend her in person, he used Overlord Nine Serenities to give a pretentious speech and raise her value in the elders’ eyes.
It was the same as looking after her while being worlds apart. He figured that no matter what danger might befall western lands, none would touch Chu Qingcheng.
Ye Lin sighed and said, “Elder, the case of the four sects’ destruction now has a resolution. But there’s still one problem. Overlord Nine Serenities has taken revenge for his disciple, but what about Beast Taming Sect…”
“Let’s just lump it in as well.”
Elder Du waved, “Senior had us so scared there’s no way we’ll still be looking into Beast Taming Sect. Since it and Zhuo Fan have grudges, we’ll say it’s the master looking out for his disciple since we can’t look into it now. That settles it.”
Ye Lin nodded, grinning inside.
[That’ll be a perfect closure.]
They took the unconscious Chu Qingcheng and left the area, with the elders taking the lead, not wanting to stay a moment longer.
After they were gone, Zhuo Fan came out of his space with a pained look.
It was his last goodbye to Chu Qingcheng…
“Elder brother, that was one high class act! You got us soiling ourselves from fear. I even thought Nine Serenities Sovereign was here.”
Zhuo Fan frowned and turned to see Ye Lin coming back.
Zhuo Fan asked, “Why are you here?”
“He-he-he, there’s still some things I don’t get. I had left with the old coots then, but I have come back for elder brother’s wisdom.” Ye Lin bowed.
Zhuo Fan walked away, “Don’t feel like it.”
“How cold, after bringing sister-in-law so you could see her one last time before leaving western lands.”
Zhuo Fan paused and sighed, “What is it then?”
“Just how did you turn into a Demon Emperor and even got those three Genesis Stage experts scared to death?” Ye Lin beamed.
Zhuo Fan spoke, “Easy, a grain of truth in a sea of lies. The figure was an illusion I made, but it’s not enough to scare those three by itself. But since they were wounded and weaker, they couldn’t sense properly. Also, the black giant contained a trace of the destructive thunderflame. But what sold it was the eyes, the remaining two Dragon Breath Pills.”
“Those held the power of dragon ancestor, of unquestionable power. This way, truth mixed with lies to make the fear they felt undoubtedly real.”
“Amazing! You’re one shrewd guy to not only defeat me but achieve this as well.” Ye Lin gave a thumbs up.
Ignoring him, Zhuo Fan left but paused again soon after, “I’m leaving western lands. Make sure that in the Double Dragon Manor, Qingcheng…”
“Don’t worry, with me around, sister-in-law will be safe.” Ye Lin declared.
Zhuo Fan grinned and vanished from the lit up night by the blazing inferno…

chapters.title: Chapter 847: Explanation
chapters.content:
Chapter 847: Explanation
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Exalted, Overlord Nine Serenities was at least three hundred meters tall, reaching the heavens and stepping on the earth, even without being able to see him fully. He was covered in black flames as they swallowed the skies, his eyes burning like the midday sun, around ten meters big and unleashing a terrible light…”
In the Heaven Reaching Pavilion of the Double Dragon Manor, the three elders returned with their teams of disciples to report, now kneeling before the Exalted Double Dragons. The fear had yet to recede from their features ever since that encounter.
The Exalted looked at them, then at each other with dumb looks.
Exalted Hei Ran was astonished, finding it hard to speak, “Three hundred meters tall, with eyes as big as ten meters… you call that a man?”
Ugh!
The three elders recoiled and shook their heads.
They saw this reaction coming, since not even they would believe an old monster like him would still be around without having borne witness.
“Exalted sir, we saw it with our own eyes. We’d never lie about this. Sirs can ask the kids too, they were there as well, under the expert’s overbearing aura.”
Elder Ou sighed, “We saw the Universal Righteous Sect being razed to the ground, replaced by a scorching inferno. The senior’s power is beyond anything we know, a true monster cultivating for three hundred thousand years. There may not even be anyone to challenge him in the world, not even Invincible Sword.”
“However, Devil Mountain has secluded itself, with its disciples no longer roaming the lands. If such an ancient and outstanding sect would’ve stayed around, that Invincible Sword wouldn’t even have had the chance to show himself.”
The Exalted were skeptical still. This was a tough pill to swallow.
[How can the world hide such an overbearing existence?]
But seeing the group so flustered and honest, then recalling Zhuo Fan’s obscene power, the one to teach him had to be a freak in itself.
The Exalted shared a nod, choosing to trust it somewhat.
That Overlord Nine Serenities might not be such a literal giant, since there were skills to make one look big, though he had a giant’s power to shake three Genesis Stage experts like nothing.
That made looking further into Devil Mountain’s vendetta a complex issue now that was better put off. No one wanted to kick the hornet’s nest.
Exalted Hei Ran waved his hand, “Since no other area is behind this incident, it shouldn’t affect western lands so we’ll let it go for now. With five sects gone, they were asking for it to be destroyed by messing with the wrong man. We don’t need to stir it further and plunge western lands into more mess either. Elder Du, inform every sect of this, that it was not a conflict with another area. You’re also to warn them, to keep to themselves and not run amok. Who knows if there isn’t a second Devil Mountain out there?”
“Yes, sir, I’ll be right on it.” Elder Du bowed and withdrew.
Exalted Bai Mei frowned, “So the five sects killed themselves through their actions, but what are we to do now about the empty seats?”
“With the western lands so vast, with just four out of nine remaining, it will leave a great vacuum across the board. It may even prove to be a weakness for others to exploit…”
Exalted Hei Ran sighed, “We can’t touch Devil Mountain but now western lands has suffered heavy losses, affecting its stability.”
The people below sighed as well.
It wasn’t as simple as having western lands’ power cut short with the loss of those sects, but also its control over it. This only grew worse since a superior-three sect and a middle-three sect were included.
A superior-three sect didn’t just have some mere venerables, but oversaw a large empire as well as dozens of other neighboring nations, watching them for any infiltration from other areas.
While Heaven Trailing Sect was the last middle-three sect, located around a third-rate empire like Tianyu, it still overlooked the dozens of other nations around. Adding to that was the Beast Taming Sect being gone as well, leaving no one in the Quanrong Empire.
At least a fifth of western lands was now out of the nine sects’ control.
It was a severe blow to western lands’ stability.
Western lands’ sects didn’t just share control, but also danger. The chances were high that the central area might take advantage of this breach, crushing western lands’ force like nothing as it invaded.
This was the Exalted’s greatest fear…
Elder Ou pondered before speaking, “Exalted sirs, this land might be empty, but not that big, with only Universal Righteous Sect’s territory on the large side. Why don’t we just split it among the other four sects?”
“Absolutely not!”
Exalted Hei Ran shot it down, “The domain of every sect is based on strength, on what they can take. Not having the strength aside, the sheer manpower required to be sent will be too much to get all that land under control. Don’t forget the Demon Scheming Sect’s lesson.”
Elder Ou shook and hung his head in shame.
[How could I forget such a crucial point?]
The nine sects had stabilized the western lands, but that was due to their hostility among each other and not unity. When one betrayed, the other eight destroyed it.
The same applied to every sect. The group held together under the same principle, watching each other like hawks. If one betrayed the sect, he’d be culled on the spot.
But once a faction rose from a sect and settled outside, you could be sure it would grow and fight the original. Especially now, when the lands need support and help to prevent the outside enemy from creeping in.
Xie Wuyue was rubbed the wrong way when he was kicked off his chair and even brought outsiders to rebel. This situation was even worse, as when a sect would be split, internal discord would rise.
Elder Ou was sweating buckets, cursing his loud mouth for such a rotten idea. He almost sent western lands to its doom.
Exalted Hei Ran knew it wasn’t on purpose and only frowned at the problem.
Wu Qingqiu bowed, “Exalted sirs, I might have a proposal, though unsure if I should speak.”
“There’s no harm in speaking.” Exalted Hei Ran urged.
Wu Qingqiu began, “The nine sects overlook their own domain, safeguarding western lands. This makes it so only those people of every sect know their domains the best. Calling them local thugs isn’t wrong in this sense.”
The Exalted looked at him hard.
“Exalted sirs, since five thugs died, rather than take one from the other five, it’s better if we pick a new thug from the empty places, to defend western lands.”
“You mean…”
The Exalted heard Wu Qingqiu’s proposal and spoke at the same time, “Foster a new power to make up for the empty five sects?”
Wu Qingqiu nodded.
“But what group in the secular world has what it takes to take on the duty of a sect?”
“Exalted, I know of one that can take such a burden.”
Wu Qingqiu’s eyes shone with determination, “In our journey to Tianyu Empire, I discovered the Luo Alliance, filled with capable people, experiencing swift growth and looking out for others. Among their men there are also experts from the Demon Scheming Sect that the alliance took in. With Double Dragon Manor’s assistance they are certain to grow even faster, to support western lands’ peace!”
Exalted Hei Ran’s brow shook, then looked at the rest, “What do you think?”
“Agreed!”
“Agreed!”
“Agreed!”
Ye Lin, Yan Mo, Wen Tao and the other disciples spoke together. The Exalted were curious about this.
[What’s their connection to Luo Alliance to side with it?]
[Then again, since the Luo Alliance could gain such outstanding geniuses’ favor, it shows it’s capable.]
Exalted Hei Ran turned to Elder Ou, “Look into it, see if they are worthy and help them. This shall be western lands’ fortune!”
“Yes, sir!”
Elder Ou bowed and carried the order.
The meeting went through some minor matters before ending.
Wu Qingqiu and the disciple flew for a waterfall when he smiled, “Having secured the Luo clan a seat among the sects, brother Zhuo’s spirit should be pleased in heaven.”
“I don’t know about that, just that I can’t let my rival down.” Yan Mo sighed and shook his head, “Let’s tell Chu Qingcheng the news as well. It should help her ease her sadness.”
“Hard to tell. She doesn’t look like the type to chase glory.” Ye Lin sighed.
Yan Mo smirked, “Hey, Chu Qingcheng doesn’t like you much so what are you doing coming as well?”
“Her not wanting to see me is one thing, and another for me to go to her. What’s it to you anyway?” Ye Lin huffed.
Wu Qingqiu chuckled, “Don’t fight now, we’re here.”
The group landed in an elegant yard around a clear pond.
They were only greeted by Shui Ruohua and Dan’er, looking lost and scared.
“What’s wrong?” Wu Qingqiu rushed over and then froze.
A graceful figure leaned on the bed with a heartbroken look, her silver hair fluttering in the breeze coming from the window…

chapters.title: Chapter 848: Back to Allbeast Mountain Range
chapters.content:
Chapter 848: Back to Allbeast Mountain Range
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Shriek~
Roar!
The howls and cries of animals of all kinds shook the forest.
The densest area in the Tianyu Empire, while also the most dangerous, was Allbeast Mountain Range. Any average person setting foot in it was tantamount to suicide, with even the stronger ones not faring any better going deeper.
Rumor had it that the range held some true supreme beasts that no cultivator could defeat or escape its claws.
Over the ages, it gave this range the thickest air of mystery humanity had yet to unravel even though people trekked it now and then.
Or maybe there had been some, only to never escape its domain with the truth.
Now though, a man in a black robe was walking casually deeper in, with only the spiritual beasts howling and growling as company.
In the end, there were always some ignorant beasts baring their fangs and pouncing on the man’s flesh.
One got pretty close to him, but the spiritual beast’s eyes blanked out, slumping dead.
The man though, went on without a care, his smile vile.
The sudden weird intruder stirred up all the spiritual beasts in the Allbeast Mountain Range. Some savage ones scrounged up their courage to challenge this interloper, only to fare no better than the first foolish creature.
It went all the way to the 6th level spiritual beasts. Only after three 7th grade spiritual beasts fell dead at his feet did the beasts of Allbeast Mountain Range finally know fear and the demonic power of this man.
As if on cue, the beasts scattered, the birds fled, leaving no one but the interloper in this wild environment.
Finally, with no beast around to growl, the Allbeast Mountain Range’s true king descended…
“Who are you? How dare you venture deep into the Allbeast Mountain Range?”
With a reverberating roar, the man looked up and the huge shadow bearing down on him.
A three headed bird looked at him in fury. On its forehead was an azure flame, flickering around.
Snickering, the man said, “Three-headed Crow, it’s been a while.”
“You know me?” The Three-headed Crow started.
The man in black lifted his head and showed his smile, “Forgot me already? Remember when you took me and young Sanzi here, to see senior Kunpeng?”
“Sir Zhuo?”
The Three-headed Crow was stunned then landed with a bow, “Forgive me for not welcoming you, Sir Zhuo. You honor us with your presence. I only heard there was a human making a scene and was unaware it was you.”
Zhuo Fan waved him off, “Ha-ha-ha, it’s fine. I only came to see Kunpeng. Since you’re here, take me there.”
“Well…”
The Three-headed Crow looked conflicted, “Sir Zhuo, a thousand pardons, but I need to inform master first of your sudden arrival. Please wait here for a moment. No beast will harm you with the master’s azure flame protecting you.”
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, hearing the scorn.
The Three-headed Crow sounded respectful, but it was just veiled mockery. What he meant by ‘master’s azure flame protecting you’ was in fact telling him he was nothing without it.
[How else would you have had an easy time coming here? You’d have long been a spiritual beast’s meal by now. Don’t get cocky!]
[He’s clearly mocking me for only coming here thanks to Kunpeng’s power.]
[He couldn’t be more wrong…]
Zhuo Fan squinted, “Three-headed Crow, I’ve met senior Kunpeng before, so why make it so hard? Just take me there.”
“Can’t do. Allbeast Mountain Range has rules. To see master, all must be announced first. You can only see him with his permission. Master would otherwise punish me for bringing you unannounced.”
The three heads shook, his stance clear.
Zhuo Fan sighed, “That’s such a waste, going back and forth when I’ll meet the old guy anyway. How about this? You take me and I’ll take full responsibility. Just say that I forced you.”
“You?”
The Three-headed Crow cracked up, his eyes shone with disdain.
[Please, and here I thought humans have brains. Why sound so dumb then? I’m a great 9th level spiritual beast and you think you can force me?]
[You’d have a better chance with any other spiritual beast, thanks to the azure flame, but that treasure won’t work on me. I have it as well! Forcing me? What a joke, ha-ha-ha…]
It was plain to Zhuo Fan what he was thinking, so he smiled.
While his left eye shone with the black thunderflame, unleashing its dreaded aura.
Hu~
As if smacked by a mountain, the Three-headed Crow slammed into the ground, its azure flame flickering to stay alive before dying out.
The six beady eyes widened in shock.
The greatest gentle flame, Chaos Flame, belonging to the lord of the sacred beasts, the head of five great sacred beasts, was just destroyed.
[How?!]
It was one of the five greatest powers born out of chaos, so how could it just cave?
The Three-headed Crow refused to believe what happened, but looking back at the blackness burning in Zhuo Fan’s eye made his heart shudder. It felt like staring death in the face.
[This human has the power to kill sacred beasts!]
The Three-headed Crow was smart enough to figure all that out instantly, its feathers standing on end, sweat trickling down.
With a nasty snicker, Zhuo Fan stepped on the still shaking spine, “Now you can raise your head high and declare to Kunpeng that I forced you.”
The heads shook in fear. This overlord of the Allbeast Mountain Range, in the 9th level, was scared to death.
“Then let’s go.” Zhuo Fan’s right eye closed and the aura faded.
Without terror seeping into its bones, the Three-headed Crow slowly got its feet under him and took flight without a peep, spreading its five hundred mile long wings as he flew to Kunpeng.
The man and beast arrived in fifteen minutes, the familiar cave appearing in view, like a beast ready to swallow you whole.
The Three-headed Crow landed next to it, since he couldn’t just bring someone unannounced, having already defied his rules.
Not like he had a choice, not when the human was stronger.
The Three-headed Crow braced and shouted, “M-master, Sir Zhou has come to see you!”
“Dad’s here?”
The first to shout was a cheerful youth, followed by a flash of red. Gu Santong shot out of the cave and into Zhuo Fan’s arms, “Dad, you came at last!”
Zhuo Fan softened and smiled, “Young Sanzi, I didn’t come just to see you, your old man will always be by your side!”
“Really?” Gu Santong cheered, “Great, dad will stay with me! Awesome, dad is…”
A bright laughter announced Kunpeng’s buffed body coming out as well, “Ha-ha-ha, brat, are you so free to see me? You didn’t even drop a hint you’re coming. I’d have sent the crow to bring you.”
“Thank you for that.” Zhuo Fan nodded.
Kunpeng sounded polite, but Zhuo Fan read in his eyes a grudge.
[What kind of king has people coming and going as they please…]

chapters.title: Chapter 849: Things Changed
chapters.content:
Chapter 849: Things Changed
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Zhuo Fan jumped down with Gu Santong in his arms and gently patted Three-headed Crow’s warm plumage, like a good pet he was, “Thanks for dropping me. You can go now.”
Ugh!
Kunpeng’s smile crumbled as his face shook. His cold eyes stared straight at the crow with fury.
Three-headed Crow was Kunpeng’s subordinate, his right hand, obvious by the Chaos Flame he loaned.
As things stood now, even this trusted aide went against him, bringing an outsider without his approval. To top it off, he listened to another’s orders. If that wasn’t betrayal, what was?
Zhuo Fan had done it to undermine his authority, to poach his aide.
As the king of beasts, anger was a given. Alas, Zhuo Fan was a distant guest that had yet to push things too far, not enough to warrant conflict. The same couldn’t be said about the Three-headed Crow…
He directed killing intent towards the crow, releasing bloodlust.
The Three-headed Crow shuddered, tearing up in fear as the three heads looked hurt.
[Master, it’s not me! He made me!]
Not like Kunpeng would believe him. His mind was set on dealing with the three heads and how he was going to vent.
“Uhm, senior Kunpeng, I’ve come too suddenly and I’m imposing on you. I had forced the Three-headed Crow to take me before informing you. Do forgive me.”
Looking between one angry and one bitter face, Zhuo Fan chuckled inside. Speaking at the perfect moment, whether intentionally or not.
Kunpeng was outraged, not bothering to mask it as he cursed inside.
[He’s under me and I can do what I want with him. What are you doing helping him out?]
Since he still had use for Zhuo Fan, he had to rein it in. He let out a long breath, pushing the anger down and speaking in a calm tone.
Gu Santong got ahead of him though, “What’s so bad about it? Dad’s one of us. Wherever I am, it’s dad’s home. No point of informing when he’s just coming home anyway. Right, uncle?”
“Uh, yeah, ha-ha-ha…”
Kunpeng turned to Gu Santong with a weird look then let out a dry laugh, “Three-headed Crow, listen here, Zhuo Fan is one of us, so he can come see me anytime. Understood?”
Kunpeng’s smile turned into gnashed teeth at the end, glaring at Three-headed Crow.
Gu Santong was oblivious to the subtleties, taking it at face value. Kunpeng was just teaching his men to look after Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan knew how to read between the lines though.
[Sour since his own man was listening to another’s orders.]
Zhuo Fan shook his head.
The Three-headed Crow felt victim here, bobbing his heads.
“Don’t just stand there looking dumb, stand aside and wait for Zhuo Fan to leave!” Glaring at him one last time, Kunpeng found Three-headed Crow even more of an eyesore.
Three-headed Crow didn’t make a peep, it just sat there at the side, like a good subordinate.
Gu Santong asked, “Uncle, you’re looking mighty angry today. What’s up?”
“Nothing, nothing, just a toothache.” Kunpeng waved his hand.
Pff!
Zhuo Fan almost cracked up.
[Toothache?]
[You’re a sacred beast for crying out loud, immune to cold weapons and the world’s elements, yet you’re telling me you got a toothache? Are you alluding to something here, that maybe I pissed you off?]
Gu Santong frowned, even for him this reason was hard to accept, but he didn’t push it. He returned to hugging Zhuo Fan’s neck, “Uncle, you can just have the bird leave. He doesn’t need to send him off because dad said he’ll always be by my side. He ain’t leaving, he-he-he!”
“Oh, rea-, what?”
Kunpeng jerked around at Zhuo Fan and shouted, “Is young Sanzi right? You’re staying as well? What about your affairs? What about mine? Aren’t you sorting them out?”
Staring at his shocked face, Zhuo Fan smiled, “Senior Kunpeng, before I answer, let me tell you my latest exploits. I’ve already completed half of your task. Not long ago, I met with the Decimating Dragon Ancestor.”
Shuddering, Kunpeng looked amazed, “W-what did he say?”
“Everything, including the events ages ago, as well as my situation.” Zhuo Fan smiled and then sighed.
Kunpeng gasped and nodded, looking serious, “Since you know everything, what will you do?”
“What else is there but being on your side, hunted as I am as well?” Zhuo Fan looked lonely, “Kunpeng, thanks to sir’s aid, I have gone from nothing, to having everything. Wife, son, friends, family… but it’s also due to you that I had to cast them all out. I just don’t know if I should hate you or thank you…”
Kunpeng eyed him coldly, “When we met, you had nothing, and the same applies now. What changed? Ha-ha-ha… anyway, to have everything, you need to keep your life and be the last victor. I’m not asking you to like me, nor to be grateful, because we’re all in this together.
“Me and the other sacred beasts can’t escape and we’ll need you to do some things for us. So when you said you wanted to find Heavenly Sovereign’s remnant and get his inheritance, I knew you’d be one of us. Ha-ha-ha, just like I thought, you didn’t let me down and survived Lightning Canyon. A true disciple of Nine Serenities. Also, did that old fire dragon have a solution out of this?”
Zhuo Fan sighed and explained.
Kunpeng lit up and nodded, “I see, so the mortal domain has eight large gaps, the World Wind Tunnel. Ha-ha-ha, the old fire dragon’s cell has been thrown around yet still found such a secret to help us escape. Far better than me, stuck here in Allbeast Mountain Range. Oh, since there are gaps in the mortal domain, then Heavenly Sovereign’s Divine Eye of the Void isn’t perfect. If we unite, winning might very well be in sight.
“Boy, live on well. We’ll just might make it in the end, ha-ha-ha…” Patting Zhuo’s shoulder, Kunpeng laughed like he was the winner.
Zhuo Fan wasn’t in the mood to join him. This was a grudge since ancient times, yet now he got dragged into this mess.
He even had to forsake everything…
Zhuo Fan’s heart was in pain. He sighed and left with Gu Santong, “Young Sanzi, you’re coming with me now. We’ll never separate again.”
“Wait, where are you going?” Kunpeng shouted.
Zhuo Fan spoke, “I need young Sanzi’s help to deal with Dragon Ancestor’s task. Since he’s in this mess as well, I don’t need to push him away.”
“The task he gave you should be much easier with just you alone. If in trouble, you can always send me a message for help, so there’s no need to take the child with you. It’s better for him to stay here and learn from me. Maybe Qilin will be needed later, for the five great sacred beasts to unite.” Kunpeng squinted.
Zhuo Fan sneered at his words, “Teach? I know exactly how Sundering Thunder Phoenix died. I don’t want young Sanzi to die without even realizing, just so you could take his power. There’s no way I’ll leave my son in such danger.”
Gu Santong looked lost.
“Young Sanzi, come with me if you believe me. I’ll explain it later.” Zhuo Fan spoke.
Gu Santong looked deep in his eyes then nodded.
Kunpeng’s eyelid twitched and he mocked, “You think you can just leave, Zhuo Fan? Where do you think you are, your backyard?”
“Maybe not before, but now, ha-ha-ha, things have changed.”
Zhuo Fan pointed and a huge golden flame appeared.
Kunpeng gasped, “Old dragon’s Dragon Breath Pill?”
The Three-headed Crow jerked back in fear.
“Humph, you think it can hold me?” Kunpeng sneered, “It may be his strongest attack, but I’m no weakling either. We’ve been fighting for ages with none coming out on top. You think you can scare me?”
“You’re not?”
Zhuo Fan had a vile smirk, “Oh, yeah, you sacred beasts never had a winner amongst yourselves. Dragon Ancestor can’t beat you, so of course Dragon Breath Pill won’t work. Though that was before. Kunpeng, remember why you can’t leave Allbeast Mountain Range!”
Shuddering, Kunpeng’s face fell.
“Yes, you need the aura of the beasts to hide your own. The Dragon Breath Pill can’t take you, but it will destroy Allbeast Mountain Range. I wonder if you’ll manage to survive when Heavenly Sovereign finds you out and comes to kill you.”
The azure flame eyes shook and Kunpeng sighed, “Clever brat, just take young Sanzi. But are you confident you can keep him safe? He’s a sacred beast offspring, but has yet to mature. Many in the mortal domain have the strength to end him.”
“Not before, but now I can!”
He took back the Dragon Breath Pill and Zhuo Fan’s left eye shone with the black thunderflame, “Because I am his father!”
He took Gu Santong’s hand and left.
Kunpeng watched in shock.
[What was that?]
The Three-headed Crow rushed over, “Master, he did indeed force me to bring him here.”
He looked from the crow to the distant Zhuo Fan. Kunpeng sighed, “I see, so things have indeed changed…”

chapters.title: Chapter 850: Central Area
chapters.content:
Chapter 850: Central Area
Proofreader
: Papatonks
The central area, strongest of them all, and ruled by a single nation, Sword Star Empire.
While the entire world lay fragmented, the central area was the most united, filled with experts. While Ethereal Stage experts ran things everywhere else, here, they were errand boys just to earn a living.
To the point the guards and patrols in cities were mostly made up of Ethereal Stage experts. This came as a shock to any cultivator from the other areas.
This was a land where one nation ruled, where one power held control, not like theirs, split apart in bits and pieces.
Since Ethereal Stage experts were treated as such, that made all the cultivators below be nothing more than waiters and other odd jobs.
So while the outsiders might be seen as young masters in their homes, here, there were strong people at every step, enough to squash them. All they could do was keep their nose down and not make a scene.
Among them was one odd pair of father and son. The days of being brash, obnoxious, killing whenever and running away when they wanted were long gone. This wasn’t their home and they had to be cautious, especially when their lives were on the line.
“Halt! Where do you come from?”
The gate had a huge board over it, engraved with the words Flying Cloud City. All flying cultivators were landing before it, making a nice queue to enter the city with calm and order.
On each side of the gate stood two grizzled old men, releasing their mighty power for all to feel and declare they were rare Ethereal Stage experts in other areas, but a dime a dozen here.
They were given orders to check all newcomers. Something must’ve happened for the situation to be so tense.
A man in black robe, pulling along a cute and adorable seven-year old boy, approached the guards with a bow, “Seniors, I come from western lands. We’ve been hunted down by an enemy and forced to escape here. I hope seniors will help us?”
“Hunted by an enemy?”
The two squinted and nodded with contempt, “Ha-ha, 5th layer Radiant Stage, and with a child dragging you back. Of course you’d be hunted. Just go, not like a weakling like you can cause anything.”
“Yes, thank you, seniors…”
Bobbing his head, the man in black rushed in and dragged the boy, running even.
The two watched the pair with derision, “This is being weak, unable to rise above their station all their lives.”
“Right? Those bugs will soon find the central area much harder than western lands, ha-ha-ha…”
The two mocked at their expense and continued with the queue. But then they felt a sudden chill in this clear weather that made them shudder.
Like there was some savage beast looming behind them. Swishing around, all they saw was a busy street, with people going to and fro.
The two looked around in doubt.
“Did you feel that, old man?”
“Yeah, like some viper was staring me down, about to take my life. You too?”
“Yeah…”
The other old man nodded, but then he shook his head, “Must be our imagination. It’s only been a month since Lord Dongfang slaughtered hundreds of Soul Harmony experts, driving fear into us. Now everyone is in a panic, but there’s no way those thieves would do anything in broad daylight. Especially not targeting nobodies like us, ha-ha-ha…”
“Yeah, sometimes weakness is good. At least those that are strong will ignore us…” The other one said with a dry laugh. Then he turned serious and went on with his job. Ironic how they already forgot that just now they laughed at the father and son’s weakness.
In a dark corner of the city, the man in the black robe held the child’s mouth without budging. When the gate situation calmed down, he eased a breath and let go.
The child threw a fit, roaring, “Dad, did those old coots look down on me? This hasn’t happened since I came out the first time. If you hadn’t stopped me, I’d have their heads in my hands right now.”
“If you’d have done that, then we’d be doomed as well.”
The man in black smiled. Zhuo Fan was like a totally different man now. His eyes looked bright, his face calm, curbing his evil tendencies to the max.
Patting Gu Santong’s head, Zhuo Fan smiled, “This isn’t western lands. Flying Cloud City is the center of one of the central area’s nine domains. The ruler is one dreadful expert. Meeting him will make it very hard for us.”
“What’s there to fear? Don’t you have Dragon Ancestor’s Dragon Breath Pill? Just blow it in his face and he’s toast!” Gu Santong stuck out his head while shouting.
Zhuo Fan sighed, “There are only two Dragon Breath Pills left. I don’t want to use them unless absolutely necessary. In the mortal domain, a treasure like Dragon Breath Pill is of utmost value. Especially that…”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes were firm, “People have to be strong themselves to be safe. I don’t want to ruin my cultivation with tools.”
“That’s why these past two years you trained in that True Self Art thingy, regressing your cultivation?” Gu Santong pouted.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “True Self Art is an art for the heart, not to set my cultivation back. Looking weak is just that, appearances. When in fact, it brings me close to self. If not for the two years spent training in it, who knows how broken my heart would be in this situation. Thoughts give birth to demons and saints. Maybe I’d have already sunk into a demonic state by now, unable to see the surface.
“My true cultivation easily reached the 5th layer Ethereal Stage all thanks to True Self Art’s calming effect. Elder Yuan truly was my master…”
Seeing his vibrant eyes, Gu Santong sighed, knowing he was recalling the people he forsook. But then he pointed at his neck and grumbled, “What’s with this golden locket then? It’s hideous, like I’m some wee child…”
“Uhm, aren’t you?”
Zhuo Fan pinched his cute cheeks, teasing, “Young Sanzi, any parent would want to see their child grow up healthy. I made the Everlife Locket myself, with all my love. You have to wear it.”
Gu Santong’s face twitched, “Dad, but I’m three hundred years old, not some kid! You think I don’t know what it does? It just hides my strength. I’m in the 6th layer Ethereal Stage but with this thing on, I look like a defenseless seven-year old. All the way here everyone’s been pinching and ruffling my hair so much, I’d be dead if you didn’t stop them.”
“Hold it in for now. You’re just too freaky. Have you seen any other Ethereal Stage kid around?”
Zhuo Fan waved his hand, “Exposing your strength would be the same as a jester, getting everyone’s attention in the central area. How are we supposed to work then?”
“I know that. Dad made the demonic treasure to hide my aura, but couldn’t you have made it smaller and not so flashy? It’s humiliating wearing this huge thing…”
“Yes, you’re so precious!”
Zhuo Fan cut his grumbling short, “Look at your childish and cute face. Isn’t it innocent? Adding the Everlife Locket and you’re an angel. No one would ever believe an angel like you hides a savage beast. You’ll be the ultimate weapon! Think about it. When we meet some enemy too tough to fight, everyone will ignore you, leaving you room to break them with your fist. Ain’t that cool?”
Gu Santong scrunched up his cute face, then nodded.
[Makes sense. That’s my dad, already setting up the stage…]
“Dad, when will we fight him?”
“Hopefully never.”
Zhuo Fan’s eye twitched and turned around at the city’s center, “The former best of eastern lands, Shangguan Feiyun, now the lord of one of central area’s nine domains lives there. It would be best if we can avoid him…”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes grew hard…

chapters.title: Chapter 851: Stopover
chapters.content:
Chapter 851: Stopover
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Going by Dragon Ancestor’s extremely sketchy map, a World Wind Tunnel should be around here. And since the strongest takes everything rule, it should be in the Flying Cloud manor.”
Closing his eyes, Zhuo Fan annalyzed the situation, “But with Flying Cloud manor being Shangguan Feiyun’s that means there’ll be tons of experts. Sneaking in is nigh impossible.”
(StarReader: feiyun= flying cloud)
Zhuo Fan opened his eyes, feeling a headache coming.
Gu Santong sighed, “What do we do then? Since dad says there’s a ton of experts, two of us can’t stop them, short of using the Dragon Breath Pill.”
“Dragon Breath Pill is the very last resort. I don’t want to waste it.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, “Young Sanzi, you saw how tight the security at the gate was, how cautious the old guys were. We’ve been in central area for months now and seen plenty of cities, but only this one’s guards were cautious.”
Gu Santong shook his head, “Maybe because it’s one of the nine domains’ central city?”
“No, there’s gotta be something else.”
Zhuo Fan shook his head and smiled, “The central area has been overbearing and even declaring itself unafraid of the other areas’ spies. Because they’re strong enough that no matter what leaks, they could still flatten anyone and anything. That’s why the central area is relaxed and casual, instead of being tense and earning ridicule. Yet Flying Cloud City is different. This goes to show that something happened recently to make even Shangguan Feiyun grow cautious.”
“This means that with how tight the security is, even at the manor, we have no chance at all of checking it out.” Gu Santong shrugged.
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Fortune favors the bold. With Shangguan Feiyun tense, that means he’s threatened. I may not know where this threat comes from, but there’s conflict going on. These troubled waters might just be what we need to slink through.”
“Why didn’t I think of this earlier? Dad’s the smartest, ha-ha-ha…”
Gu Santong laughed, “Then what now, dad?”
Zhuo Fan smirked, “Find a stopover and observe the changes. We may be staying here for a while, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan flicked his sleeve and walked towards the most packed district, with a puzzled Gu Santong behind.
Three hours later, the duo stood before a large courtyard, looking abandoned for some time. Next to them was a bearded man, in the 6th layer Radiant Stage.
“Good eyes, sir, Flying Cloud City has few great homes. If not for an urgent need for spirit stones, I wouldn’t have given it up.” The man saw no one around and made his pitch.
Gu Santong rolled his eeys.
When he first saw the old man in the market, and in Radiant Stage, pulling them to the side, he thought he was someone special, only to try selling them a house.
[It seems central area really is packed with experts, so much so Radiant Stage experts are useful only as real estate agents. What will that make of Profound Heaven experts, sweepers, or chamber pot cleaners?]
Sizing the house, Zhuo Fan nodded inside, saying, “Say a price!”
“How about eight million spirit stones? “
“Eight million?” Zhuo Fan mocked, “Why don’t you grab it? You take me for a moneybag? Even in western lands, the most a house would go in an imperial capital is a million. A house is just a place to stay, while spirit stones are the core of one’s cultivation. Buying houses instead of looking after your training is breaking your future.”
The man showed a despising gaze, “You think this is western lands? In central area, unless you’re of amazing talent, you’re a nobody. Look at me, if I roamed the western lands a bit, I’d already have some prince or noble bowing to me. Here, though, I’m just an agent.”
“Run out of central area then! Be someone among nobodies than a nobody among geniuses. Or is it that someone of sir’s strength can also make you rise?”
“What rise? With my talent, I can’t even get out of central area.”
The man gave a heartbroken sigh, “I’ll be honest with you, I came here with my lord. He is a Soul Harmony expert, a guard in Flying Cloud manor. He’s one of the best in this region too…”
“And later?”
Zhuo Fan cut him off impatiently, “Since your lord is cared for by the Flying Cloud manor, then he should be valued, so why…”
“Sigh, it’s all fate in the end.”
The man waved his hand, “We’ve been having it well at first, eating and drinking our fill, but just a month ago, the manor had a break in, with the thief almost making out with some great treasure. The Sword King Shangguang Feiyun found out and flew into a rage, killing hundreds of Soul Harmony experts on the spot, including my lord.”
“It wasn’t his fault though, since the thief broke in even with Genesis Stage experts in the manor. But when the lord got angry, they are the ones suffering… “
“So your lord died and now you’re selling his home?” Zhuo Fan figured it out. Now he knew why the city was so tense.
[Someone snuck into the manor!]
Since the thief went for his target but still didn’t succeed, now waiting for another chance, the Flying Cloud City must now be under tighter security to stop him from getting help as well.
[Otherwise, the Sword King would have just focused on tracking him down instead if he succeeded.]
Since the treasure was still in the manor, the thief would try again.
[The perfect moment for us to slip in.]
Zhuo Fan grinned inside, a plan already forming in his mind…
“Actually, you can tell yourself by looking at me that I’m an errand boy. How could I pocket eight million?”
Afraid Zhuo Fan might label him disloyal, the man played the victim here, “Sir, just think, even with my lord a city lord’s guard, I am just a guard’s servant. Could a Radiant Stage cultivator handle a lord’s house? When my lord died, the treasures and pills in the house were stolen by Ethereal Stage experts, leaving this place empty.”
“So they let me look after it, deal with the asset then move back home to have some status, rather than a nobody here. That’s why, the eight million won’t be mine alone, but split among many experts. If you still find it excessive, I will lower it to five but that’s my final offer. I’m only cutting the price since I’m in a hurry to leave. If you don’t agree, I’ll just have to sell it to someone else…”
The guy looked aggrieved, but none of it got to Zhuo Fan, who kept staring at the house.
The guy frowned. He already played his role to perfection and even cut the price.
[What’s the hold up?]
[Is he poor? Doesn’t look like it.]
[Since he’s pensive, then he’s on the fence about buying it and should have the money. Just that the price is steep.]
His eyes lit up and rushed to say, “Sir, I’ll come clean. This house is special.”
“How special?” Zhuo Fan cocked an eyebrow.
The guy shook his head, “I don’t know, since my lord had many secret rooms in it, for cultivation, refining, maybe even alchemy. Others split its wealth after his death, but it’s not clear if they took all of it. As long as you find one item, maybe you’ll break even. Take it as a freebie of sales and try your luck.”
Zhuo Fan chuckled. The greedy ones might fall for such a tactic, but not Zhuo Fan.
Though he still needed a stopover from where he could check things out.
Grinning, Zhuo Fan turned to the guy, “Brother, didn’t you say five million?”
“Uh, that was without the freebie.” The man beamed.
Zhuo Fan waved his hand, “You’d have long found it if there ever was one. Nothing to do with me. Five million, you either sell or I walk. I’m sure there are plenty of others in the market with how hundreds of experts died like you said.”
Shuddering, the man felt like ripping his mouth off for saying more than necessary.
He was in a rush to leave though. If he didn’t sell it now he’d be stuck. He had no choice but to lower the price.
And so, the two finished the deal and Zhuo Fan brought Gu Santong into the house, unaware that this place already had an owner…

chapters.title: Chapter 852: Freebie
chapters.content:
Chapter 852: Freebie
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Freebie, freebie~”
Like an innocent child, Gu Santong was all smiles as he skipped into the house in excitement.
One moment he was on a beam, the other in the pond, looking up every nook and cranny for that previous stuff.
Zhuo Fan let out a chuckle, “Young Sanzi, that man only said it to bait us into buying the house. There’s no freebie. If there was any, they have long found it and left us with nothing.”
“Maybe not, dad!”
Skipping still, it did not put a damper on Gu Santong’s excitement, “Maybe those idiots couldn’t find it while we can. With dad’s smarts and my nose, we’ll sniff out any secrets.”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Young Sanzi, and what if you find it? A puny Soul Harmony Stage’s toy is junk to us. There’s dozens of stuff in my ring, and any one of them is superior by far. Why waste your energy? “
Gu Santong shook and looked back, though his searching never missed a beat.
Zhuo Fan found it odd, then he exclaimed.
[Young Sanzi is a child at heart. It’s not about finding something, but the journey.]
[Young Sanzi used to search for herbs not just to fill his belly but also to play.]
Then Zhuo Fan and Kunpeng gave him more herbs than he could swallow, but took away the fun.
His belly was stuffed, but had nothing this child could do for fun.
Zhuo Fan looked at young Sanzi ashamed. He failed as a father, feeling guilty for not having understood his heart.
“Young Sanzi, go search. If you find it, tell me. I want to see it as well.” Zhuo Fan shouted at the child darting around.
Gu Santong looked back with a wide smile, “I’ll be sure to find it…”
Gu Santong was gone.
Looking at the flash of red, Zhuo Fan shook his head, smiling inside.
“Dad, I found it! There’s a treasure here!” Gu Santong’s cheerful cry came, “I bet this is something dad hasn’t gotten yet.”
Zhuo Fan was stunned, “There’s actually something here? That was quick. Maybe that thief was right about being a freebie here.”
Zhuo Fan followed young Sanzi’s voice, arriving before a run down building. Zhuo Fan sized it up.
[Isn’t it just a shed?]
[The lord must’ve been a weirdo to set up his cultivation room here. Or is it out of paranoia? Yeah, that has to be it. Those Ethereal and Radiant Stage experts wouldn’t think twice about looking here.]
Zhuo Fan not once thought about the stuff that might be hiding here, since hardly anything could impress him now. He only came to cater to his son’s excitement.
[It’s what a father must do…]
“Young Sanzi, what did you find? Let me, uh…”
Zhuo Fan cheerfully entered the shed, only to freeze in shock.
In the middle of the shed lay a girl, with an egg-shaped face, sharp eyes, rosy skin and thin waist.
By the looks of it, heavily wounded, if the pale face and red line from the mouth were to be trusted. Young Sanzi squatted next to her and pointed in excitement, “Dad, treasure, woman, he-he-he…”
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched, revealing a vile smile at young Sanzi and bopping his head, “How old are you? How is a woman a treasure?”
“I’m only three and a half centuries old!”
Gu Santong was annoyed, “I’m no child. I know plenty of stuff!”
Ugh!
Zhuo Fan was speechless.
[I stand corrected, he isn’t a child at heart, but a shifty old man using his appearance to his advantage. He doesn’t need compassion, but a heavy hand!]
Zhuo Fan eyed Gu Santong, “Young Sanzi, what will you do with your ‘find’? Since you’re three centuries old, it doesn’t look like you can use it as you are.”
Blushing hard, Gu Santong knew exactly where Zhuo Fan was going. He glared in shame and anger, “Dad, you’re nasty!”
“I’m nasty? When you called a woman a treasure, what else could you have been meaning other than something nasty, oh wise guy?” Zhuo Fan stared back.
Pouting, Gu Santong huffed, “I found her like this, unconscious and weak. The way I see it, she must be the cauldron the lord used to cultivate. If so, I only saw her as a cultivating treasure. What’s wrong with that?”
“Damn brat, are you splitting hairs with me?”
Zhuo Fan didn’t shirk and touched the girl’s icy wrist. He laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, you got it all wrong. How’s a maiden supposed to be a cauldron…”
Gu Santong turned to the girl with a puzzled gaze.
[Was I wrong? Then what is she doing in this place? Was she left behind?]
Zhuo Fan mocked, “Kid, what are you thinking? This girl ain’t from this house. Think about it. With her looks, even as a cauldron, they’d take her for sure. Also, judging by her wounds, a month at least…”
Zhuo Fan faced his son, showing off his wisdom. but then he squinted.
“But that means…”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone and walked behind the house, “Young Sanzi, get a room ready. I’m going to heal her.”
Gu Santong was taken off-guard by his actions.
[Never knew dad as a caring guy, going as far as healing a stranger. Especially a girl…]
Gu Santong had a coy smile, “Sure, dad, you’re going to use healing as an excuse to dual cultivate. Wait till I tell mom.”
Zhuo Fan jerked, then glared back, “Why you little miscreant, since when have I dual cultivated? Did you forget what happened a month ago in Flying Cloud City?”
“Flying Cloud manor had a break in.”
Gu Santong bobbed his head then pointed at her, “Dad, then…”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, nodding, “More likely than not, this girl is involved. By saving her, we’ll get some valuable info out of her. So don’t just stand there, get a room ready!”
“Oh…”
Gu Santong bobbed his head and darted for the house, setting up a room in a jiffy. Zhuo Fan came in with the girl, and set her on the bed. He used his energy while touching her forehead, “Returning Dragon’s Roar!”
Roar!
A green glow started entering the girl’s body, healing her under their very eyes. When the glow vanished, the girl didn’t wake. Her breathing faint, still in danger of vanishing.
“Dad, it didn’t work? When we beat that old Huangpu, he gave us a hard time with this skill.” Gu Santong was puzzled.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “We were just in the Radiant Stage. But once in the Ethereal Stage, the real wound isn’t on the body, but the soul. The lass is in the 8th layer Ethereal Stage. Her wounded soul comes first, then her body. It won’t matter if her body is healed but not her soul. I only gave her some first aid, letting her hang on a little longer. Now comes the hard part, healing her soul.”
Gu Santong nodded.
“Young Sanzi, look after her. I’ll be cultivating for three days to make an 11th grade pill to heal her soul. Don’t disturb me.” Zhuo Fan walked out.
Gu Santong said, “Aren’t the pills we have enough?”
“It’s not just her soul wounded, but her odd state, like…”
Zhuo Fan frowned in thought. He lifted the Qilin arm, looking at the scar Vaulting Sword left, “A wound made by a sacred weapon. The strange energy is still there. Since it’s a heavy wound, it needs special pills…”

chapters.title: Chapter 853: Waking Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 853: Waking Up
Proofreader
: Papatonks
In a dark room, a ten meter tall bronze cauldron sat on a raging fire that spewed out thick smoke.
The light shone upon a man, casting a black shadow and revealing his face.
He had his eyes closed, his hands poised in a sign, as he sat before the cauldron.
Hum~
The cauldron started shaking then, blowing out its lid with a bang. It revealed a round and shiny pill, with a golden luster. It floated in the air and darted away.
Zhuo Fan’s flashed his eyes open and saw the pill flashing by him. He made a sign and pointed, “Hold!”
The pill froze in the air, not budging.
Grinning, Zhuo Fan took a vial and placed it inside. The pill looked like a victim as it just slumped dully on the glass wall.
Zhuo Fan closed the vial with a smile. He walked outside, taking a deep breath of fresher air.
“Three days refining feels like ages.”
The gaudy sun above and the deep breaths helped lighten his mood as he took large steps towards the guest house.
Creak~
He found Gu Santong inside, bored out of his mind, sitting at a table and watching the bed with a dead look. The pretty girl was like a sleeping beauty.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “The young miss, how has she been these days?”
“Dad, you’re finally out! Any longer and I’d have gone stir-crazy in here!”
Gu Santong complained.
Zhuo Fan teased, “Many others wouldn’t have been able to sleep from the excitement to spend three days close to such a flower, but only you’d see it as a chore.”
“Humph, like you said, I first need to be equipped!” Gu Santong looked at his small stature and sighed.
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched, rolling his eyes, “Damn brat, you will one day. I heard sacred beasts mature when their powers increase. So grow up well!”
Patting his head, Zhuo Fan chuckled, turning to the patient. Gu Santong held his chin, then shook his head.
Zhuo Fan touched her wrist, “There’s still hope, her situation hasn’t worsened.”
Zhuo Fan took out the vial and placed the still warm pill between her soft lips.
The pill flowed into her body and she shook wildly, her unmarred face turning into a frown.
The change was brief, as the girl eased a breath and calmed down again.
“Dad, why isn’t she waking up? Was your pill a dud?” Gu Santong saw the girl laying as always and complained.
Feeling her condition, Zhuo Fan nodded and smiled, “Brat, that was an 11th grade soul pill, Sacred Soul Pill. A dud? No, it’s her heavy wounds that need more time to heal. In a few days she will recover. You watch over her and don’t let her flee and make it all pointless.”
Zhuo Fan walked out.
“Hold on!”
Gu Santong complained, “Dad, why am I stuck babysitting? You do it!”
“Uh, I… will make some tonic pills for her, ha-ha-ha.” Zhuo Fan beamed, his pace quickening. He justified himself, “Refining is so taxing. I wouldn’t have done this if didn’t want her to wake up…”
Whoosh~
Just as he reached the door, a flash of red blocked him. Gu Santong pouted and snapped, “Dad, my head might not be as quick as yours, but I’m no fool. You said no ordinary pill can help her so you had me watch her while you refined. And don’t we have plenty of tonic pills? What do you take me for, a three-year-old?”
[Uh…]
Zhuo Fan froze, darting his eyes around for a solution.
Gu Santong shouted before he could find one, “It’s your turn to babysit. I’m out to play!”
Gu Santong was gone.
“Hey, wait!”
Too little, too late. The kid was long gone.
Turning from the sleeping beauty to the distant son, Zhuo Fan sighed, “Can’t this kid share just a little of my burden? Watching a comatose person is boring as hell. I still need to find more about Flying Cloud City’s situation…”
Yep, Zhuo Fan was like Gu Santong in this regard, not wanting to be stuck here.
Like father like son. Waiting here for the slow trickle of time was worse than killing them.
But since the son fled, that left his old man to do this rotten task.
Helpless to the extreme, Zhuo Fan slumped in the chair with Gu Santong’s dead expression on his face. Yawning, he looked at the bed, then checked her condition now and then.
He soon noticed that her state was improving, though she showed no sign of stirring.
Frowning, Zhuo Fan gave her a few more pills, with no result. Three days trickled by painfully slow, and the damn girl was still sleeping!
Zhuo Fan’s was far more impatient than Gu Santong, pacing around the room. The rare glance at the bright outdoors with chirping bird only worked to taunt him. Anyone would’ve lost it at this point, “For crying out loud! Where the hell did he run off to? He just couldn’t wait to get far away from his dad? Didn’t he want to stay with me at all times, to rely on each other, be each other’s support? Now look at him, it hasn’t been a week and he’s already fled! What kind of son leaves his dad for three days?”
Scowling, Zhuo Fan paced some more, and glanced at the bed even more, now turning his irritation on her, “And you, brat, I’ve already healed you so why aren’t you awake yet? If you keep sleeping I’ll just thrash you!”
Silence welcomed him.
A raging fire roared in his belly, with no place to vent. These three days were spent doing nothing at all. He couldn’t even cultivate, out of fear the girl woke up and messed his concentration.
These long and arduous, but mostly flat, three days were getting to him.
He was no saint either, not shirking from hitting a woman. But he had an image to uphold, that of a father.
[Hitting a defenseless girl will ruin his image of me.]
As a father, only in front of his son did he curb his evil tendencies.
So, his sneaky eyes darted from one corner to the next, making double sure there was no young Sanzi in sight. He showed a vile smile as he approached the bed, rubbing his hands, “Missie, it’s for you own good. A couple of slaps ought to wake you up. If not, it’ll make me feel better too. See, win-win, right? He-he-he…”
Zhuo Fan spat in his hands, lifted his hands high, and let them fall on the girl’s most delicate face.
There was no real force in it, of course, doing it just to let off steam. Anything more and her head would fly.
The wind behind it though made her black hair float.
The slaps weren’t harmful, but they were sure to leave some lasting impressions.
But then her eyes shot open, staring straight at Zhuo Fan in anger.
Stunned, Zhuo Fan’s hands faltered in the air.
Pa!
The pause gave the girl time to grab his hand and fling him on the bed. She jumped on him the next second, clutching his throat as she spoke in a loving voice, “Who were you trying to thrash?”

chapters.title: Chapter 854: Oopsie
chapters.content:
Chapter 854: Oopsie
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Since her actions didn’t seem serious, Zhuo Fan let her have it, pushing him on the bed. Being under her, on the bed, and looking at her fine features, he looked lost, “You’re awake? Since when?”
“Humph, for a day now.” The girl glared, “Oh, are you mad you didn’t get to slap me?”
Zhuo Fan only heard the first part about waking up.
[At least she didn’t hear me and young Sanzi. The show can go on then.]
Though there was some shift in the script.
He wanted to appeal to her gratitude for saving her life to get her to spill the beans, but after this oopsie, it was a miracle they didn’t become enemies. Getting information now would prove to be a hassle.
[Sigh, idle hands are the devil’s playthings.]
[Why the hell would slapping some girl even cross my mind?]
Zhuo Fan shook his head inwardly, looking at the girl pinning him with a bitter smile, “Miss, since you’re awake, why fake it?”
“How else was I supposed to get a grasp on the situation? Were you a friend or foe? There’s only two kinds of people one would drop their guard around, a dead man and an unconscious one.”
The girl raised an eyebrow in pride, “Your actions proved it. The fact that you’d be rough on an unconscious person shows you’re not friendly. Only by faking sleep for a day could I see through your evil nature.”
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched and nodded, “Miss, you’re a genius, a true veteran of the cultivation world. I am in awe seeing how you see through my little vile intent…”
“Damn right, since I am eastern lands’…” The smug girl grew conceited.
Zhuo Fan had his ears peeled, though the girl sure was cautious, stopping midway.
Sighing inwardly at the missed chance, Zhuo Fan changed his approach, “Miss, you’re so young yet you’re in the 8th layer Ethereal Stage, so much stronger than western lands’ best geniuses. You must be quite famous in the eastern lands.”
“What’s it to you? Are you testing me for information?” The girl roared, her gaze showed she was on guard.
Zhuo Fan’s heart sank, knowing any further attempts were pointless. To avoid any aggravation, he played dumb, “No, miss, that’s not it. I was just saying. I don’t mind if you won’t say it.”
The girl huffed.
Bang~
Zhuo Fan was hearing the front door being knocked on.
[We’ve been in Flying Cloud City for a few days. Who could be looking for us?]
[Don’t tell me young Sanzi is at it again, stirring things all over the place.]
“Don’t move!”
Ka!
The girl sounded far more nervous than him. He was choked so hard his neck sounded cracking.
Zhuo Fan’s face was beet red, tapping her hand quickly, “Miss, you almost choked me…”
“I should have, with how vile you are. It’s what you deserve for not only holding me unconscious but even trying to slap me.” The girl scoffed and ignored his protests. Her attention was completely taken by the knocking on the door.
Zhuo Fan knew she had no intention to kill, or Zhuo Fan would have long since killed her instead.
[Though getting choked is getting me nowhere.]
What was worse, if his son found him like this, what of his righteous image of a doting father?
Zhuo Fan resorted to faked pleading, “Miss, I’m but an alchemist. I healed you. You shouldn’t harm your savior.”
Eyes shaking, the girl hesitated before easing her grip.
“I know that, clearly your mind is skewed since you wanted to slap me just now. But after waking, I sensed you giving me pills and knew you saved me. I’ll let you go now, but don’t you scream or try anything. Got it?”
Zhuo Fan bobbed his head, his hand zipping his lips.
Only then did the girl take away her hand…
“Dad, there’s someone at the door. Should I go see, eh?” After having his fill outside these three days, Gu Santong popped out of nowhere.
Only to come upon this vivid picture.
Quite the compromising position too.
Zhuo Fan on his back, with a girl straddling him, what took the cake was her hand on his chiseled chest. Though it was the one that choked him just now, the kid didn’t know that.
Gu Santong, of course, took the burning image at face value, labeling it as not safe for children. His reaction to this more than obvious adult affair was disgust, “Dad, is this what you mean by unable to sleep from excitement? Since I can’t understand nor partake, I’ll let you enjoy yourself.”
Gu Santong left the room with a flat look, going to see who was knocking.
“What did he mean?”
The girl looked below her with a lost look.
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched, “Miss, you’re more immature than a child. Don’t you find our state even a little indecent?”
“Indecent?”
The girl now reacted, having been pointed out. Looking down on Zhuo Fan being under her, she went red in a flash and cried, “What are you doing in my bed? Get the hell out!”
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes, “Sister, don’t tell me you don’t know. It’s you who dragged me on the bed here. And how am I supposed to go when you’re sitting on me?”
“Oh, right…”
Flustered and panicking, the girl rushed off him and off the bed. Zhuo Fan glanced at her, like an innocent bystander.
Whoosh~
This mystery girl in the 8th layer Ethereal Stage, in her panic, got tangled in the sheets and fell as she got off.
It resulted in one perfect angle impossible to reproduce, sending her falling on Zhuo Fan.
The calm Zhuo Fan, still on the bed, pretended to be weak, willing to take anything she’d dish at him, even the incoming looming shadow on his face. So while this unknown had hit his head, Zhuo Fan found a peculiar scent overtaking his mind, along with sweet and soft lips gracing his own.
The two were firmly joined at the lips.
The pair of eyes had never been so close, watching each other.
The two went wide-eyed, and the heat coming from the other made their hearts race and their faces red.
“Dad, there’s a bunch of people outside…”
Gu Santong’s timing was flawless, looking at the even more explicit view with a lost look, “Should I let them, uh, I better go.”
Gu Santong left like natural…
“Aah!”
The girl shrieked and jumped off the bed with a burning face. Her eyes teared up too. Zhuo Fan looked embarrassed, sitting up.
Clang!
A sharp sound then revealed a jade longsword at Zhuo Fan’s throat. The girl spat through gnashed teeth, “T-that was my first! You stole it from me and now I’ll tear you to pieces!”
“Wait wait wait, who stole what here? You did it, not me!”
Zhuo Fan faked panic, “You know very well I did nothing but lay here. It’s all on you! Miss, let’s be reasonable here. In any case, I’m your savior.”
[T-that…]
The girl was ready to cry, but then she glared, “I don’t care! You used me and now you die!”
The girl pushed on the sword, about to pierce Zhuo Fan’s throat.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes turned cold and the Qilin arm shone red.
He wanted the girl’s knowledge, but since she lost it and wanted to kill him, he’d have to return the favor.
[You brought this on yourself.]
[Dumb girl, since I can save you, I can also kill you. At the very least, dumping your body in a public place should stir something and give me clues.]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone with bloodthirst.
The girl was oblivious of it in her panic and shame. She’d never believe a wee 5th layer Radiant Stage cultivator would be a demon in disguise…

chapters.title: Chapter 855: Inspection
chapters.content:
Chapter 855: Inspection
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Clang!
This was the only sound made by the sword as it flashed for Zhuo Fan.
The scarlet glow that followed hid within a bestial nature, one of power and wildness to turn any ignorant to mush.
Zhuo Fan stood there at ease, ready to grab the sword and snap it like a twig.
“Boy, you’re newcomers in Flying Cloud City?”
“Yeah.”
“We’re Flying Cloud manor guards. We have orders to inspect every recent newcomer. Where is the master of this place? Call him out…”
…
The loud shouts from outside entered the duo’s ears.
Pausing, the girl’s blade went back to her body, stopping the attack. Her brow tensed at the sudden interruption.
Zhuo Fan pondered before he smiled inwardly.
[This chick must’ve gotten scared when she heard Flying Cloud manor.]
[Being found out was the last thing on her mind.]
Which helped confirm Zhuo Fan’s guess. The girl had been involved in the break a month ago.
With a sinister smile, Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone.
The girl grew angry at his rotten smile. The jade sword once again went to touch his neck as she barked, “What are you smiling at? Stop that!”
Zhuo Fan turned a deaf ear.
[It’s not me who’s scared, but you. So what’s there to fear?]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes looked up, looking amused and condescending. The girl was outraged, and found he ignored her even as she pressed the blade on his neck. Like he got confident all of a sudden as he looked elsewhere. Yet no amount of anger from her part would change that.
Flying Cloud manor’s guards were at the door, making killing right now highly ill-advised.
[Once they’re gone, humph!]
The girl squinted, sticking out her lip in anger…
“Miss…”
Zhuo Fan showed a vile look as he uttered, “You’re better off killing me. I’m not a nice guy, even planning on slapping you while unconscious.”
“Humph, I already knew that. But I’m not killing you over that, but…” The girl huffed and glared, then went red in the cheeks.
With a weird smile, Zhuo Fan nodded, “Yeah, I stole your first kiss, but I don’t think that grounds for murder. I’ve done something more foul to earn your anger and kill me.”
“More foul? What?” The girl was stunned.
Zhuo Fan chuckled, then squinted as he sized her up, whispering in her ear, “Miss, congratulations, you’re now a woman!”
“What?!”
The girl shuddered, unable to believe his words, “W-what did you just say?”
Zhuo Fan mocked, “Wasn’t I clear enough? Fine, let me be completely transparent. I broke you in.”
Boom!
A storm exploded in the girl’s head, shocked to the core as she shook her head, “No, impossible, that can’t be..”
“You think so?”
Zhuo Fan snickered, “Miss, you should know better than me just how fine you are. Just think, a man was by your side while you were unconscious, a fully adult male. Could something happen? Did something happen? You decide…” “
“I’ll kill you!”
The girl lost it as she howled, pointing her sword at Zhuo Fan amidst the tears.
As if that wasn’t enough for him, Zhuo Fan incited her more, “Come, kill me, but it won’t matter since someone already took you. That won’t ever change. With the Flying Cloud manor guards at the door, if you kill me, you’ll soon follow. Maybe we’ll even die together, be with each other forever. He-he, well not that I mind, since my son can look after himself. As long as Miss doesn’t have any others to worry about, let us die in the name of love!”
“Y-you…”
Her eyes shook as she gnashed her teeth. The sword trembled but didn’t budge an inch.
[I knew it. She’s not alone in the city.]
[She might have relatives far from here, but that wasn’t enough to make her hesitate.]
Subjected to such humiliation, impulse was a human’s first choice.
But she hesitated because her people were still around and in danger. If something happened to her, it would distract them and make it easy for the guards to catch them.
The thought of their safety had her hesitate even in the face of death.
Zhuo Fan was more sure than ever that the girl was a great lead.
The sword fell to the ground and the girl hugged her knees while sobbing. Anyone would be heartbroken hearing her.
Wu~
Zhuo Fan smiled and went to pat her head, “Miss, aren’t you gonna kill me?”
“Beat it!” She roared like a banshee, wishing to swallow him whole.
Zhuo Fan ignored it, of course, with a smile, “Then let me tell you a little secret. You’re still an untouched chick.”
“What?” Shuddering, the girl lifted her head in shock, “Y-you aren’t lying?”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “It’s your body and you don’t know? Why even ask?”
Blushing, the girl sensed herself and lowered her head in shame, “T-then why…”
“I thought of letting you see what’s most precious.”
Zhuo Fan said, “Once you found out you were broken, you didn’t have the mind to care about some kiss, right? When you’re about to die, who the hell cares if you’re broken in? People always have a line they do not cross, but since it was broken and done with, why think about it? You should always think more about what you have and not cling to what you lost.”
Zhuo Fan walked outside, “Now, let’s see Flying Cloud manor’s guards. The more you hide, the more you bring suspicion on you. It’s better to face them calmly. Even if you are who they’re after, there’s no way some nobody guards would recognize you.”
Zhuo Fan chuckled and went on ahead with a pleased look.
The girl was too dumbstruck to react.
Zhuo Fan now looked like a sage, of great wisdom, and not like the bastard he just played as. Even the girl felt like what happened was ages ago.
Zhuo Fan was but a 5th layer Radiant Stage cultivator, but his confidence and resolve made the girl’s heart skip a beat.
“Also…”
Zhuo Fan paused, lifting his hands, “Try not to get smart when you don’t even know yourself. Cleverness may overreach itself, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan walked away laughing.
The girl glared and then giggled. Her cheeks were becoming red, and for some odd reason, her heart wouldn’t calm down.
[The sudden arrival of Flying Cloud manor guards must be the cause.]
The girl took a deep breath to calm herself, and followed Zhuo Fan. The safest place was amidst danger.
“Seniors, how may I help you?”
Rushing to the entrance, Zhuo Fan found dozens of Soul Harmony experts, all wearing the Flying Cloud manor symbol, a white cloud.
Zhuo Fan bowed at once, like a humble man.
Seeing his meager cultivation, the men ignored him and asked as a formality, “Are you new in town?”
“Yes.”
“Who is this child?” A man pointed at Gu Santong.
Zhuo Fan bowed, “Senior, he’s my only son.”
“Where did you come from?”
“Western lands.”
“Why?”
“To avoid pursuit.”
“Are there any other people here?”
Ugh!
Zhuo Fan paused, unsure if the lass would follow him to meet these men.
Saying yes but the lass not coming would be ruining himself. But if he denied and then found her, the result would be the same.
The guard frowned as he repeated, “Are there any more people here?”
“Here I am!”
The girl rushed over with a bright smile…

chapters.title: Chapter 856: Interrogation
chapters.content:
Chapter 856: Interrogation
Proofreader
: Papatonks
The girl skipped over, bringing with her a fresh breeze. She stopped behind Zhuo Fan with a bashful look, like an innocent girl. The guards were dumbstruck by her behavior, looking lost.
It only made the girl feel self-conscious and hide behind Zhuo Fan, like a baby sister oblivious to the world’s evil protected by her big brother.
The gentle nature instilled in the people a sense of protection.
Zhuo Fan was stunned.
[Hell, this lass is versed in the world and an even better actor than me.]
He could still remember her outburst from before.
He wouldn’t tease her for this, since they were in the same boat. He just forced a smile and calmed himself.
Moments later, the guards woke up and pointed at her, “Is she staying here?”
“Yes.” The girl’s gentle voice echoed, soothing the guards.
The guard had to take a moment to recover and pointed at Zhuo Fan, “Who are you two? Why have both of you come from the western lands?”
“Uhm, she…” Zhuo Fan’s eyes focused, thinking of a good name for her, but the girl got ahead of him, “He’s my husband. We came from western lands together.”
[Oh… wait, what?]
The men nodded but then froze, looking from one to the other in disbelief, “He’s your husband?”
“Why, what’s wrong with that?” The girl nodded with a smile, then dragged a stumped Gu Santong next to her, “Look, our child is all grown up.”
The inspection team was shocked, with Zhuo Fan looking lost.
[Hey, chickie, moments ago you were trying to stab me and now you say I’m your man?]
[What are you looking at? You’re already getting the best of it by being my husband. What are you crying about? Keep staring and see if I don’t poke your eyes out!]
Glaring at Zhuo Fan, the girl warned as her hand gripped Gu Santong, clearly using him as hostage to force Zhuo Fan.
[Fall in line or your son will fall first.]
Zhuo Fan shook his head inside and sighed. He didn’t worry about Gu Santong.
[Not like the lass could do anything to young Sanzi.]
Zhuo Fan found this trap difficult. He could not admit just any random girl as his wife. Though it was fake, given the circumstances, he had to agree if he wanted to get over this mess.
Regardless, he could not say it so easily since there was only one person in his heart. He wouldn’t want to sully her image even if it was fake…
Eying the odd couple, a guard asked, “Uhm, miss, the man is only in the 5th layer Radiant Stage, while you are in the 8th layer Ethereal Stage.”
They just couldn’t get it. The world had many cultivating couples of different levels, but it was also a world where the man was the head. His power represented his status. There was no woman willing to lower herself to a weaker guy.
The odd thing here was not their gap in strength, but the reversed roles of this couple. This could’ve happened only if the girl was just too damn strong, so that she wore the pants in this relationship. Such a woman couldn’t have just one guy either.
“Miss, with your strength, you must be someone important in western lands. Can it be you started a harem to replenish your yin and dual cultivate?” The guard asked.
The girl blushed hard as she flared, “Y-you’re making a harem! We’re just a family with a child. How can I do something as vile as replenish yin…”
“With how the world is ruled by strength, people would resort to anything for power, even women.” The guard had a nasty smile, “Brothers, search the place. If she has a harem, they must be many. There’s no way there’s just the three of them. Humph…”
“Yes, sir!”
The men shouted and shot inside, already on it. The girl’s face looked conflicted and depressed. Zhuo Fan glanced over and sighed.
[Even I wouldn’t believe you, let alone others, since we’re too different in cultivation…]
Whoosh~
An hour later, the guards returned with shaking heads and the main speaker frowned.
He refused to believe such a strong woman only had one guy.
Zhuo Fan smiled and stepped forward with a bow, “Senior, please don’t listen to her nonsense. She’s not my wife.”
“No?” The guard shook and grew grave. The girl tensed, sweat trickling down.
[Is he selling me out?]
“Then who is she? Why is she staying here?”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Senior, the truth is, she is my cousin. Our clan is hunting us so we had to run here.”
“Your cousin? Then why did she say she’s your wife?” The guard shouted.
Turning to the girl, she looked nervous. Zhuo Fan pondered, “Actually, she does want to be my wife, but… my heart belongs to someone else. No other girl can have it. She was only playing a joke before, please don’t mind it, senior.”
“Tell me exactly what is going on here, or I will have her arrested.” The guard barked.
Zhuo Fan smiled and nodded, “Yes, of course, senior. Allow me to tell you everything. My cousin and I grew up together, inseparable. I know she loves me, but I could not accept it. Seniors can see that her talent is better than mine, cultivating much faster. That’s why I could not accept her love, finding myself undeserving of her.”
“Oh, we can tell that much. You aren’t a fit for her at all.” The others nodded.
Zhuo Fan continued, “Then I met a lady at the Ultimate Clarity Sect, got married and had a child. But this earned the sect’s rage and we were hunted down. I could only take my son and flee all the way to the central area. Fortune was with me for having my cousin along as well to look after me, or we would’ve died a long time ago. I could never return her feelings, and…”
Zhuo Fan turned to the girl, “Cousin, I already have someone I love. Your love….”
Zhuo Fan sighed, looking elsewhere as he was unable to accept her feelings.
The men exclaimed.
[Oh, so a love triangle! With this girl being love-stricken!]
“Ha, what a waste of good seed. An 8th layer Ethereal Stage expert with pretty looks going after a waste leagues behind her. How can we, experts, find fault in that?” The leader sighed.
Another one nodded, “Yeah, it makes too much sense, actually. Why did they have to be childhood friends? Brother, the place is clean, or at least the thief would’ve used some flat excuse, not go for such a convoluted melodrama. Just look at how conflicted they are.”
They all turned to the two to see Zhuo Fan’s guilty look. The girl’s gaze never left him, her eyes glazed over.
[Fools blinded by love, crashing marriages!]
The guards shrugged then the leader coughed, “We understand, then we’ll write that. This place belonged to a fellow guard of ours. Since you bought it, it’s yours. Now, there’s only the three of you here? What are your names?”
“Oh, senior, I’m Gu Yifan!”
Cupping his hands, Zhuo Fan spoke, “My son is Gu Santong, and my cousin…”
Zhuo Fan hinted at her.
Feeling sour for some odd reason, the girl spoke, “I’m Gu Qingyan.”
“Noted.”
After writing down on a jade slip, the guard nodded, “From now on, you are the owners of this place. If there’s anyone suspicious hanging around, report to the Flying Cloud manor at once. You can also shout and make some noise. Our patrols will respond swiftly!”
Zhuo Fan bowed, “Thank you, senior, only… what suspicious people?”
“You don’t know?”
The guard mocked, “Homeless, wandering, shifty, repulsive and guilty-looking people. If you see anyone that fits that description, give us a signal. Got it?”
“Yes, yes…”
Zhuo Fan nodded. The guard smiled then waved his hand, “Brothers, the next house. Ha-ha-ha, let’s see how those thieves can hide as we search every place! Ha-ha-ha…”

chapters.title: Chapter 857: One Step Back Two Steps Forward
chapters.content:
Chapter 857: One Step Back Two Steps Forward
Proofreader
: Papatonks
