As the laughter grew faint in the distance, the auras of the guards faded as well. The trio watched them go with a sigh of relief.
“Now, close the door and see her out.”
Zhuo Fan clapped and said. Young Sanzi woke up and pulled the girl posing as his mom outside.
Gu Santong didn’t use force, just playing the role of a child. Anything else and he’d be throwing her out.
The girl was stunned, “What are you doing?”
“What, you ask? Humph…”
Zhuo Fan glared at her, “Didn’t you hear senior? Meeting any homeless…”
“Wandering…” Gu Santong added.
“Shifty…”
“Repulsive…”
“Guilty-looking people…” The father and son finished together as they stared at the girl, “Anyone suspicious is to be reported to the Flying Cloud manor! You should be thankful we’re only kicking you out!”
The two threw her out like nothing then shut the door behind her.
She only woke up from her daze when she was outside. But seeing the door shut, anger burned in her gaze and she kicked the door open.
The two held the door and pretended to be shaken from the impact by staggering back. They looked at her in panic, “W-what are you doing? The guards are just around the corner!”
“What of it? That’s more than enough time to end your lives!” The girl glared.
Zhuo Fan shuddered in fake fear, then wailed, “Big sister, we don’t know each other. Us two have been drifters for years before finally coming to the central area, avoiding western lands’ pursuit, and starting a new life. We don’t want any trouble. I don’t know if you’re related to the guards’ search, but for our safety, please leave! Take it as a returned favor for saving your life. Please don’t drag us into this. “
The girl looked hard at the two, biting her lip.
But then she asked, “Hey, was what you said true?”
“What did I say?”
“About you and your wife. Did the sect break you up? What about your wife? “
Startled, Zhuo Fan didn’t think she’d be hung up on that in this critical situation. But it was also related to Zhuo Fan’s pain.
Zhuo Fan mocked all of a sudden, “As if! To get them to ignore you, I made that on the spot. While I cast out my wife for better things and a brighter future. She’s just a hindrance, that’s all. She should be having the time of her life…”
Pa!
The girl gave him a heavy slap in anger.
“You rotten bastard, I’ll kill you for your wife’s sake!”
Her sword was once again pointing at Zhuo Fan’s throat.
Zhuo Fan waved his hands frantically, “Wait, wait, attack now and the guards will hear you. And I’m your savior. Attacking me is being ungrateful!”
“Humph, I’ll spare you for now, but pray we never meet again!”
The sword shook and the girl roared as she sped away, “I’ll never stay a second in a bastard’s place, or I’ll end up as vile as you!”
Seeing her vanish in the night’s sky, her curses growing faint, the duo shared a crafty smile.
“Dad, are you just going to let her leave after all the trouble of saving her?”
“Leave? Where would she go?”
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, “Did you forget why the guards came? They are combing through the city. The Flying Cloud manor wants to have eyes on every corner in the city, on every citizen. The taverns are the most conspicuous, with no way of hiding under such heavy monitoring.”
“Leaving, her? Ha-ha-ha, as long as she’s in Flying Cloud City, she’ll soon come back here. She’s got no choice.”
Gu Santong nodded but wanted more details, “But even so, why did we drive her out? Isn’t it over the top?”
“Not at all, this is psychological warfare. One step back, two steps forward.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes glinted, “We didn’t kick her out because of her, but the people behind her. Think about it. Since we saved her, but by also hiding her, then we’ll become suspicious about having our own designs. Maybe her people will think that we’re on the guards’ side, baiting them to come out. That will make gaining their trust harder.
“Now though, we kicked her out, like scared average cultivators avoiding trouble, making saving her just a coincidence. As time passes, those people will be pushed into a corner by the guards’ monitoring and would think of using us. When in fact we’re using them. The roles reverse as the schemes become twisted from every little detail, giving us the perfect win.”
Gu Santong nodded inside, “I see it now. You know she can’t go anywhere so might as well kick her out. All so the people behind her would come, right?”
“Ha-ha-ha, exactly. Now’s just a matter of time.” Zhuo Fan closed the heavy door and took Gu Santong behind the house, “Young Sanzi, where have you gone the last three days? I didn’t see you at all.”
“Around town, but since they took me for a child, they didn’t let me enter many places. You said I couldn’t force my way in so…”
“I’ll take you there tomorrow, what do you say?”
“Truly?”
“Of course, we’re waiting for news now so we can afford some leisure, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan smiled at the child.
Gu Santong was overjoyed.
On the second day, Zhuo Fan took Gu Santong to every known place in Flying Cloud City. They played around, had fun, not thinking about anything, not bothering with anyone.
On the third day, Zhuo Fan and Gu Santong went to enjoy the local cuisine and the fine dishes, relishing in these rare father-son moments. They put their plan behind them.
So it went for ten days, carefree and relaxed. Only that night, when Gu Santong was skipping towards home with Zhuo Fan smiling behind, the sudden sight stunned them.
The same girl ten days ago was now back, only this time she looked far more downcast.
She hesitated upon seeing them.
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched, faking shock, “Big sister, what are you doing here?”
“Don’t just shout!”
Her jade sword was out and pointing at Zhuo Fan, though looking awkward as she had to shout with hatred, “Listen here, I’ll be staying here from now on. You can’t kick me out nor report me. Try anything of sorts and I’ll kill you!”
[The lass was forced for sure to come back against her will.]
The father and son mocked her inwardly.
[Where can an Ethereal Stage cultivator hide in a city with Soul Harmony patrols? Instead of acting nice to get a place to stay, you’re like a thug stealing it.]
[Would you have been so tough when you left back then if you knew? Would you have still burnt your bridges, ha-ha?]
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Miss, I get you’re back, but can you not shout at us? I’m not one to look for trouble, but since our lives are in your hands, I don’t have a choice. But where did that gentle and kind miss from ten days ago go? How did you become a shrew stooping so low as to steal someone’s home?”
Shuddering, the girl looked hurt at his words, feeling like the victim instead.
“You dare say that when you kicked me out?”
The girl raged, “Do you know what I did these ten days? Skulking like a rat in the streets, scared that every person I met would call the guards. I couldn’t go to a tavern, I couldn’t stay in another place from fear of being found. Flying Cloud City is so huge yet there is no place that can have me. All I’ve done is run and run, in constant fear. If I hadn’t come back, they’d have found me. Yet you call me a shrew…”
The girl broke down crying.
Zhuo Fan sighed inside.
[She kicked herself out. But only by encountering despair on the streets would she be willing to come back here…]
The Novel will be updated first on this website. Come back and continue reading tomorrow, everyone!

chapters.title: Chapter 858: A Family of Three
chapters.content:
Chapter 858: A Family of Three
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“This room will be yours from now on, cousin.”
Zhuo Fan creaked the door open, showing the same bed where she was healed, while jesting.
Scrounging her nose, the girl eyed him with a deep and grateful gaze.
After wandering the streets like a dog for days, she now returned to the place where she recovered in peace. Anyone would be touched at this point, feeling like this place was home.
Making a flourish, Zhuo Fan invited her in while he left.
Looking at him leave, she shouted, “I saw you and your son having fun in town these days.”
Pausing, Zhuo Fan frowned and looked back, “You mean we can’t?”
“You’re very good to your dear son.” The girl said, “From the ten days you spent roaming Flying Cloud City, one can see how close the two of you are.”
Zhuo Fan asked, “That’s a father for you. What’s wrong with that?”
“But you said you abandoned your wife.” The girl looked in doubt, “Going by your close relation with your son, it can’t be that you would do such a thing to his mother.”
Zhuo Fan squinted, “Women are women and a son is a son. Men are very clear on the differences. What does an unbroken chick know?”
Rolling his eyes, Zhuo Fan walked away, his eyes glazing with grief as he shook his head.
The girl was furious at the taunt, but then thought about it another way. Zhuo Fan was erratic in his affairs, switching tunes at the drop of a hat, making him mysterious in her eyes, that he had secrets.
The girl did not enter her room and walked behind the house…
The moon hung in the sky above the sea of stars, bringing light to the night.
In the backyard, Gu Santong sat at a stone table, playing with a wooden toy; looking rather cute. He might be three centuries old, but his puerile nature never changed.
Especially the last few days, having Zhuo Fan prioritize leisure activities in the city over work, he felt paternal love after ages. This brought out the child he buried inside, whining to Zhuo Fan to get him some nice toys.
He was now having the time of his life, until a girl popped up behind him.
Gu Santong frowned, but faked oblivion as he played. Zhuo Fan kept telling him to play dumb and act like a wee child.
“Gu Santong, was it?”
The girl showed the child a bright smile, looking at his toy, “Wow, how pretty! Did your dad get it for you?”
Eyeing her, Gu Santong was vague, “Get on with it, or sleep it off!”
Ugh!
The girl froze at such hostility, her face twitching hard.
[Why is he so mean?]
[Wait, it’s not the child’s fault, but who he lived with; that guy’s bad influence. I must hold it in.]
Smashing down the anger, the girl showed a kind face as she said, “Santong, you shouldn’t talk like that to me. It isn’t nice.”
“Who in hell would be nice to a broad that tried to kill the both of us?” Gu Santong bit back.
Pff!
She almost spat blood in anger, her body shuddering.
[The apple doesn’t fall far from the tree. These two’s words are so biting, always antagonistic, and it’s pissing me off!]
[That’s not the problem here, since all is that guy’s fault, not the child. I must stay strong!]
The girl’s face twitched like no tomorrow, showing a look worse than crying, “Child, can’t you use kinder words? I just wanted to ask you…”
“Out with it already!” Gu Santong snapped.
Outraged, the girl gnashed her teeth, “Ha-ha-ha, child, you sure are feisty. Then I’ll be frank. Did your dad really abandon your mom?”
Gu Santong shook then paused from playing. He then nodded, his reply cold, “Yes.”
The girl looked disappointed, the outcome out of her presumption.
“Do you like your mother?”
“Yes.”
“Don’t you hate your dad for what he did?”
“No.”
“Why?” The girl was stunned.
Gu Santong went silent as he stared at the toy in his hand. He sighed, “If dad had stayed with mom, she would’ve died. What do you think he should have done?”
[What?!]
The girl stood speechless.
“Young Sanzi, are you playing there? You’re supposed to be in bed at this hour!” Zhuo Fan’s shout came from afar.
Gu Santong ignored the girl and went to Zhuo Fan’s room, “Dad’s calling me. I need to go.”
Gu Santong’s young appearance that contrasted with the upright stance left the girl in stunned silence.
[The son resembles the father, but not to the extreme.]
[It looks like he isn’t as cruel as he lets on…]
Meanwhile, Gu Santong got in the room to find Zhuo Fan sitting at a table, giving him an annoyed and sad look. “What are you doing telling her so much?”
“I just don’t want her to curse you every time you meet.”
“What’s the problem? I’m no saint either and I’ve been cursed more than I can count.”
“But I don’t want to hear anyone curse my dad.” Gu Santong climbed on the bed with a bored look, “I used to smash any that cursed you, but since you don’t want me to fight, I want to not hear people cursing my dad.”
Zhuo Fan gave him a long look and nodded.
[Son…]
The next morning, Zhuo Fan and Gu Santong woke up refreshed from cultivating, welcoming the coming of a new day.
Gu Santong smiled, “Dad, the broad is back. Are we still toying with her?”
“Of course, the more carefree we are the better. The real fish has yet to bite, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan nodded.
Gu Santong cheered in excitement, showing out to be the child he was.
Zhuo Fan nodded, enjoying this rare moment of fatherhood.
But the girl’s gentle figure suddenly popped in his face.
Zhuo Fan asked, “What are you doing? Me and young Sanzi are going out.”
“Great, now take me with you.” The girl gave a bright smile.
Zhuo Fan furrowed his brow, “Why?”
“Yeah, my dad and I are having fun, so why bring you along, to be a stick in the mud?” Gu Santong shunned her, making his position clear as day.
She wiggled her cute nose, made a pout at the kid, then turned to Zhuo Fan to impose, “Who’s to say you won’t report me once you go out? That’s why I have to keep an eye on you.”
Squinting, Zhuo Fan paused before showing a wide smile.
“Fine, since miss wants to, then come along. As long as you don’t misunderstand.”
“Misunderstand what?”
The girl was curious, but Zhuo Fan’s reply was a shifty grin…
An hour later…
“Oh, Sir Gu, you brought your son to play again. What a great father you are spending these days with your son. And now you even brought the madam…”
“My, sir’s madam is a world beauty. No wonder she has been cooped up at home for so long, ha-ha-ha…”
…
The trio walked down the street with many shouts aimed at them. Zhuo Fan just replied with a smile and nod.
The girl was blushing harder than a tomato.
She now realized what he meant and grumbled, “W-why aren’t you saying anything? I’m not your wife, but cousin!”
“There’s no point talking to these chatterboxes. They’ll say whatever they want anyway. And I don’t want to talk to some sellers either.”
Zhuo Fan grinned, his eyes always scanning his surroundings. By his calculations, the girl had been hiding the past days, making it hard for her friends to find her. Now that she walks in broad daylight, they should get in touch.
One of the reasons why he accepted to take her along, as bait.
“Stop, who are you people?”
A patrol came by and barred their way. The girl tensed, ready to bolt, but Zhuo Fan held her.
Smiling, Zhuo Fan did the talking, “We’re the Gu family from a nearby house.”
Taking a jade slip, the man read it and waved them off, “Oh, the new Gu family, Gu Yifan, Gu Santong and Gu Qingyan. You’re free to go.”
The patrol resumed their duty.
The girl was stunned.
[They let us go that easy?]
Zhuo Fan easily guessed her thoughts, “Did you forget we got registered a few days back? That jade slip has our portraits and details. In this Flying Cloud City we are a family of three.”
“Then what have I been doing these days, skulking around like a scared mouse?” The girl was stumped.
Zhuo Fan shrugged, “Yeah, why did you run? That’s what’s called guilty-looking…”
“Shifty…”
“Homeless…”
The father and son enjoyed teasing the hell out of the blushing girl. None of them noticed a pair of eyes watched from a dark corner…

chapters.title: Chapter 859: Relative Invasion
chapters.content:
Chapter 859: Relative Invasion
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Dad, I want this, and that. Oh, this as well…”
In the noisy street, the trio strolled through the shops, like one big happy family. Gu Santong, like any child, would jump around at anything that caught his attention, which was everything.
Zhuo Fan spoiled him like a true rich guy, forking out spirit stones without a twitch, and throwing them to the shopkeeper with an attitude, “I’ll take it all, ha-ha-ha…”
“Thank you, sir. Thank you…” The shopkeepers were overjoyed seeing their profit soar.
Gu Santong was having the time of his life with this new batch of toys. The two’s happiness was infectious, as it finally got through the girl, making her smile.
“Candy figurines! Come and enjoy candy figurines!”
The shouts had Gu Santong turn around with sparkling eyes as he saw an old man and his stall, “Dad, what is that?”
“All looks and no substance. You can just ignore it.” Zhuo Fan spoke.
But the sweets were all that were reflecting in Gu Santong’s childish eyes.
The girl lit up and smiled, “Young Sanzi, I’ll buy you some, alright?”
Gu Santong grumbled, then looked at Zhuo Fan for permission.
“Ha-ha-ha, the girl’s a freeloader so getting something out of her is natural.”
Zhuo Fan scratched his nose and teased, “Young Sanzi, go all out and get what you want. Fleece her down to the last stone!”
Gu Santong bobbed his head in glee, then looked around for his targets, wanting not just the candy but heaps of other stuff. He showed a brilliant smile, extending his cute hand at the girl.
The girl’s face twitched and glared at Zhuo Fan, “I just knew you’re a bad influence on the child.”
“You’re not buying? You liar!”
Zhuo Fan twisted his head away, grinning inside. Gu Santong pouted and complained.
The kid sure knew how to use his adorable puppy eyes to melt her resistance.
And so she nodded with a smile, “Don’t worry, young Sanzi, I’ll buy it all, ha-ha-ha…”
She went to the candy seller but not before glaring at Zhuo Fan and making faces. It was hard to tell if she was being cute like Gu Santong or plain angry.
Zhuo Fan held Gu Santong’s hand as they looked around, enjoying themselves…
“How much for a candy…”
Whoosh~
But then a shadow fell on her, holding her mouth and taking her away.
He took but a second to vanish from the crowd. Not even the people near noticed a thing.
The seller looked ahead curiously, “Didn’t someone call me just now? Am I hearing things? Strange…”
The seller got over it fast, returning to shouting his wares.
Wu~
In a dark and desolate corner, the girl struggled in fear under the attacker’s hand.
But the hand clamped down like an iron vice, not letting a sound escape.
She panicked, wanting to unleash her power to break free.
There was no point playing now, not when the attacker had to be from the Flying Cloud manor.
“Yan’er, it’s me!”
The attacker spoke hastily before she did anything rash.
Halting, the girl stopped her resistance at the voice. She instead turned a shocked look at the handsome guy that just let her go.
“You’re alive, cousin!”
…
The father and son were enjoying themselves, but when they looked back, they found the girl gone.
“Where’s the girl gone to?”
Gu Santong asked Zhuo Fan, “Did we scare her off from asking for so many things from her?”
Pff!
Zhuo Fan staggered and shook his head, “All those things you asked for are barely a few spirit stones, not to mention she’s someone important in the eastern lands with her high cultivation. Scaring her off? And where would she be staying if she did?”
“Oh right, the past ten days were spent homeless and in suffering. She doesn’t have the nerve to wander around town alone.” Gu Santong pondered, then cried, “Did the guards take her?”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Flying Cloud manor is the leader here. Why would they resort to subterfuge when they could just waltz in and grab her? And she came from our place too. If they got her, we’d be in for it as well.”
“That’s…”
“I bet this is the hand of her friends.”
Zhuo Fan smiled at Gu Santong’s lost look, “With her walking in broad daylight all casual, her friends must be stunned and wanted to take her for answers.”
Gu Santong showed a vague smile, “Dad, this time, we hooked a big fish.”
“Yeah, but that will put an end to our vacation.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Young Sanzi, this may be our last day having fun, so let’s make the most of it. I’ll take you anywhere you want to go.”
“I heard there’s a street packed with food stalls a hundred miles east of the town. Let’s go eat our fill!”
“Brat, you only think with your stomach…”
“Food first and then the rest, he-he-he…”
Zhuo Fan and his son walked to their target, having everything under control, enjoying their last day of leisure.
Only in the dead of night, with the moon high above them, did they return home. But what welcomed them was a hand grabbing each of their mouths.
The door was quickly closed and the Soul Harmony experts took them into the house.
Gu Santong tensed in shock, about to fight back, but Zhuo Fan looked at him to calm down. The two only put a token of resistance as they got taken.
Though they had to do their acting to perfection, trying their best to scream, looking red from their efforts.
Finally, the two were taken to the parlor, where two overbearing experts sat.
A middle-aged man took the main seat, with grizzled temples, and sporting a genial face. He was a Genesis Stage expert.
Zhuo Fan knew then and there he hooked a big one.
The two men saw the owners of the house were here and struggling, he shouted, “Make one peep and you’re dead!”
Zhuo Fan shuddered in fake fear, nodding his head.
“We’re the guests here. That’s now way to treat a host. And there’s a child present as well.”
The middle-aged man frowned and waved his hand, “Release them. Is this how the name we nurtured for ten thousand years is going to be ruined?”
“Yes, Clan Head!”
The two bowed and withdrew, leaving Zhuo Fan and his son.
The middle-aged man smiled, but Zhuo Fan cried out in panic first, “Sirs, you got the wrong guy. I just came from the distant western lands. I don’t even know the former owner of this place. Don’t take your revenge on me, I’m innocent!”
“Ha-ha-ha, little brother, you misunderstand. We didn’t come for revenge…” The middle-aged man smiled.
Zhuo Fan shouted again, “Did you come to rob then? Oh god, I heard Flying Cloud City’s security was solid. How did it come to this?”
The middle-aged man’s face twitched.
[Robbery? Revenge would be better!]
“Little brother, listen to me, we…”
“Big brother, sir, you can see that I’m a meager Radiant Stage cultivator, not worth anything in Flying Cloud City. I only have my son with me and nothing of value to you. I know I bought a former Flying Cloud manor guard’s house but I’m not rich. I’m actually dirt poor…”
Zhuo Fan kept cutting the man’s explanation, crying and whining…

chapters.title: Chapter 860: Best Clan in Eastern Lands
chapters.content:
Chapter 860: Best Clan in Eastern Lands
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Eyes twitching, the man looked at himself then at the rows of men on either side, “Tell me, do we look like robbers?”
The people shook their heads with a genial smile.
“Clan Head, don’t listen to this civilian’s nonsense. What does a Radiant Stage cultivator know?”
“Yeah, Clan Head, just ignore him. Sir’s brilliant martial renown is above thievery. He’s just scared to death and babbles on.”
“Yeah, yeah…”
“Indeed…”
They all agreed, looking at Zhuo Fan in disdain and disregard.
“You don’t have to say that.”
The middle-aged man shook his hand, turning to Zhuo Fan, “By barging into this man’s home, we invite suspicion of being less than we are. This is excusable. But we are righteous men, forced by circumstances to resort to such debase methods, making us look like killers and criminals. How are we any different then, from Shangguan Feiyun that betrayed our clan, our greatest shame?”
“Clan Head is wise!”
They all stood and bowed to the middle-aged man.
The man nodded and smiled, “Little brother, to be honest, we’ve barged into your peaceful abode from lack of choice. I hope you could let us seek refuge for a few days. I would be most grateful.”
The middle-aged man stood up and bowed a little to Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan nodded inwardly.
[Regardless of methods, he knows how to win someone over, fishing for compliments while also being very wise and worthy of respect.]
[In any case, quite remarkable for a leader. As for the rest…]
Glancing at the extras, Zhuo Fan scrunched his nose, waving his hands like a victim, “Big brother, you already have your blade on our necks. I have no choice but to give you shelter, even drag me through the latrine if you want to.”
Pff!
The middle-aged man burst out and the rest laughed.
“Little brother, no need to be so tense. We’ll be gone soon. We’re not here to hurt you, just borrowing.”
“Who would believe that? Anyone of you is stronger than me and can kill me with your thumb.” Zhuo Fan complained, “Big brother, where do you come from?”
“You want to know who we are?” Someone shouted at Zhuo Fan’s question, scaring him back and hugging young Sanzi close.
Glaring at the speaker, the middle-aged man smiled, “There’s no point in hiding it. We’re from the eastern lands.”
“Eastern lands!”
Zhuo Fan pondered, then sighed, “When I was hunted down in the western lands, I thought of going through the central area to flee to eastern lands, but I’m glad I didn’t. It seems eastern lands isn’t any better than western lands for all you experts to resort to this. Eastern lands must be in dire straits.”
Pff!
The middle-aged man almost spat blood, bearing a crestfallen look, “Little brother, after all I’ve said, you still see us as robbers?”
“H-how could I?”
Zhuo Fan panicked, “How could I see heroes like yourselves as mere robbers? You’re temporary guests, borrowing and taking for now. If this becomes permanent, I won’t mind it either.”
The middle-aged man’s face sunk, holding his head and sighed. This great and known Clan Head was now seen by a little guy as nothing more than a murderer and thief. If eastern lands heard it, all the sects would laugh.
Shortly after, bright laughter echoed, followed by a familiar girl, “Father, I told you not to see him. He’s a petty guy with a nasty tongue, completely opposite of your righteous character. Look at you, a Genesis Stage expert angered to the extreme by mere words. Why is that? Ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan looked to see the mystery girl from before, entering with a handsome youth behind her staring at them with sharp eyes. He was young and already in the Soul Harmony Stage. He’d be a worthy candidate for the title of the best if this was the western lands.
“Uncle!” The guy bowed before the middle-aged man, ignoring Zhuo Fan as he returned behind the girl.
The middle-aged man chuckled, turning to Zhuo Fan, “Do you know my daughter, little brother?”
Zhuo Fan bobbed his head with a lost look.
“I heard she’s your cousin.”
With a sinister smile, the middle-aged man laughed, “Since I’m her father, that makes me your uncle. And uncle here came to visit his kin, not rob. Is this easier to accept? Ha-ha-ha…”
Ugh!
Zhuo Fan gave him a long look then chuckled inwardly.
[This guy is a man of principles, but not pedantic, looking to justify himself. First you take our house and now you write it off as a family visit. How amusing…]
“Big brother…”
“It’s uncle!”
Sighing, Zhuo Fan put on a strained face as the middle-aged man tried to become Zhuo Fan’s senior.
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes and returned to the main topic, “Us two come from western lands and only found the girl wounded just as we bought the house. I’m an alchemist and I saved your daughter’s life. In the end, when the guards came to search us, your daughter threatened me to bluff my way out, even using my Gu name. It’s dangerous enough to hold one person, but now, will all of you unknown people in my house, if you’re found…”
“I understand your concern.”
The middle-aged man waved with a stern face, “Little brother, I know everything from Yan’er. As a father, I’m most grateful for sheltering her and saving her life. But our operation has countless lives in eastern lands at stake. Success is a must. While some decisions are not to my liking, I still have to make them. We must take your house!
“Because we can’t find any better place to stay. You know as well how tight security has become. Because of you, Yan’er is now a member of this household. Whether you like it or not, she is above suspicion.”
Zhuo Fan choked, “Are you saying you’ll silence us?”
“That’s not it at all. I just hope you will work with us and not force us to resort to such vile acts.”
The middle-aged man sighed, “We won’t do anything to you, just keep you here at most. Once our business is done, we’ll be out of your hair. But if you wish to work with us, it will make our interactions easier. Since you’re my nephew, right? Ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan hesitated as he looked at Gu Santong, considering his child’s safety first, “But, how can I believe you won’t hurt us?”
“With the name of the famed Shangguan clan!”
The middle-aged man’s eyes shone.
Zhuo Fan cried out, “Shangguan clan? The same best clan in eastern lands?”
“Yes, I am Shangguan clan’s Clan Head, Shangguan Feixiong.”
The middle-aged man declared, then pointed at the girl and youth, “She is my daughter, Shangguan Qingyan, and my nephew, Shangguan Yulin. Everyone else is a venerable or elder of the Shangguan clan.”
Shaking, Zhuo Fan could hardly believe the best clan of eastern lands’ entire experts were here en masse, “That means that Shangguan Feiyun, one of the Nine Sword Kings is your…”
“Younger brother.”
Shangguan Feixiong gnashed his teeth. “But ever since he betrayed eastern lands, casting his lot with Invincible Sword, I no longer have a brother. We came here to take back the eastern lands’ treasure he stole. Little brother, I hope, on account of the alliance between the four areas, that you’d help hide us.”
Zhuo Fan’s heart sank, looking into Shangguan Feixiong’s wise eyes, and nodded, “Don’t worry, uncle, we’re all on the same side. I will definitely help the Shangguan clan succeed!”
“Grea-, uh, wait, what?”
His heroic valor got Shangguan Feixiong to nod in reflex. But then he cried out, startled, “W-what did you call me?”
Zhuo Fan scratched his nose with a chuckle, “Uncle, didn’t you see yourself as such? Did you forget already?”
Zhuo Fan patted Gu Santong’s head proudly, “Young Sanzi, we’re hailing for a renowned clan. Once we return with uncle to eastern lands, none shall pick on us. We’ll see if they dare lay a finger on us after uttering the name Shangguan. We’re no longer vagrants, ha-ha-ha…”
“Yeah, let’s also go slaughter western lands later, kill all our pursuers!” Gu Santong bobbed his cute head, bearing a nasty smirk.
Everyone else looked on, speechless.
[For crying out loud! One moment they were scared like mice and now they have no shame with power behind them…]

chapters.title: Chapter 861: Opportune Nephew
chapters.content:
Chapter 861: Opportune Nephew
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Everyone looked dumbstruck at the crass father-son pair.
[What’s wrong with these two? They have yet to come from old money and power, yet they’re acting more obnoxiously than a clan with a deep heritage. What, drop the Shangguan clan’s name around so no one will pick on you? I bet you’re planning the opposite, to use the name to pick on people.]
[We came from the renowned Shangguan clan in the eastern lands, but we’re educated and know honor. We definitely won’t let some disrespectful guys like you ruin our good name.]
Everyone turned to Shangguan Feixiong.
[Clan Head, you started it, now finish it!]
Shangguan Feixiong shook his head, his face twitching. There was no way he would just accept someone as his nephew.
He only used it as a leverage to become friends, but how was he to know there was such a brazen guy in the world, trying to leverage him instead.
[He’s just a punk!]
[I didn’t think the owner of the house would be a bastard!]
As everyone had nothing but contempt for the two, Shangguan Qingyan laughed. Having been around them the past few days, this missie had gotten quite friendly, or maybe she understood them the best.
Seeing them declare this with a straight face, she liked it, “Hey, how about you become my real cousin.”
Zhuo Fan turned to her and shook his head.
[Who the hell would? It’s that I don’t have a choice.]
Shangguan Feixiong would be pissed if she could hear him.
[Oh please, for me to accept you as one is the greatest fortune of your lifetime. It’s leapfrogging into power, yet you freakin’ shun it?]
[You’re nothing but a moron!]
Which was a moot point since he didn’t know where to begin. He only felt that taking this pair into his fold would be the greatest mistake of his life.
But as the leader, his word was gold. Once spoken, he couldn’t just take it back. He sighed, “Then you will become Shangguan clan’s front, blocking the Flying CLoud manor’s investigation. When we all go to eastern lands, you’ll be rewarded for your efforts!”
“Yes, uncle!”
With a genial smile, Zhuo Fan was open in his attempts. Shangguan Feixiong only felt pain instead. He looked from his real nephew, showing valor and attitude, then at the new one, with a shrewd gaze and wretched-looking.
He’d better brace himself for when he returned home for a world of humiliation.
Sighing, Shangguan Feixiong waved his hand, tired like never before, “Since we’re now in understanding, you are dismissed.”
Shangguan Feixiong stood and walked towards the backyard.
“Uncle, let me get you a nice room.”
Zhuo Fan skipped next to him, like the most obvious toad there was, beaming, “Ha-ha-ha, allow your nephew to lead you.”
“No, we already got our rooms. You just have to play your part.” Shangguan Feixiong shunned him.
Zhuo Fan just didn’t know when to quit, “How can I? I have to do my duty for the family!”
[Screw your duty! That was just a blunder of mine!]
Rolling his eyes, Shangguan Feixiong wanted to push Zhuo Fan away, but Zhuo Fan stuck with him with his nauseatingly sweat flatteries. It only vexed the Clan Head more.
Bam!
With a sudden sound, Zhuo Fan was suddenly pushed back hard. Looking up he found the genuine cousin there.
Shangguan Yulin gave him a cold gaze, then took Shangguan Feixiong’s arm and left. This time he didn’t refuse.
The rest shrugged at the event, mocking Zhuo Fan as they left.
It just so happened that some of the mockery reached the duo’s ears.
“Humph, a social climber who doesn’t know when to quit.”
“Shangguan clan will be shamed now, having these thugs.”
“Exactly, but what can you do? They just got lucky to meet us when we need them, ha-ha-ha. The name of Shangguan clan is enough for these fools for several lifetimes…”
…
Gu Santong clenched his fists, but Zhuo Fan pulled him back.
“Young Sanzi, now I’m your real aunt, hi-hi-hi…”
Shangguan Qingyan skipped over with glee, holding young Sanzi’s face with a smile.
Young Sanzi looked at her with a cold gaze and slapped her hands away, “You’re no aunt of mine!”
Gu Santong gave her the cold shoulder as he left.
Zhuo Fan sighed inside. Invincible Scamp had never been so humiliated in his life.
[It’s all for the sake of the mission…]
[Maybe I should’ve just left him with Kunpeng. He’s too young and Kunpeng won’t touch him yet. There at least he’s king…]
[I shouldn’t make choices for young Sanzi, whether good or wrong…]
Shangguan Qingyan looked stunned, “What’s with young Sanzi? Did I say something?”
“It’s not you. You know kids, so volatile. Don’t mind it.” Zhuo Fan went after Gu Santong, “I’ll look after him. See you.”
Seeing them go, Shangguan Qingyan looked concerned.
A tall man loomed from behind, Shangguan Yulin, smiling at her lost look, “Cousin, what are you looking at?”
“I was just wondering why young Sanzi looked so annoyed.”
“Annoyed? Ha-ha-ha, for a pair of greedy people, getting into Shangguan clan should be a moment of celebration. What’s there to be annoyed about?” Shangguan Yulin sneered.
Shangguan Qingyan glared at him, “What do you know? They aren’t like that.”
“No? They just acted like brazen and obnoxious people. Anyone could see it. Why is it only you taking their side?”
“You don’t know anything.”
Shangguan Qingyan flicked her head away in annoyance, “I’ve been around them for the past days and they’re kind and cherish one another, and not power hungry people. If they were, they’d long since reported me to Flying Cloud manor…”
“That’s because they were weak, afraid you’d kill them…”
“No, they were never afraid or tense around me. In fact, they always had biting remarks, pissing me off!” Shangguan Qingyan was firm, “They have their own problems. The jeers and harsh tones are only a front. Don’t misunderstand them.”
“Cousin, why do you always side with others?”
“They’re no others, haven’t you heard dad calling sir Gu nephew?”
“That’s just the shameless punk trying to squeeze his way into the clan. Uncle is a man of virtue, not for someone like that thug to get close to.”
“I told you, don’t judge a book by its cover!” Shangguan Qingyan glared and left.
Shangguan Yulin’s eyes flashed with anger, his fists clenched.
[I’ll deal with you soon, you damn bastards. Just you wait…]
Zhuo Fan was back in his room and saw Gu Santong on the bed with sad look as he lay on the pillow.
Zhuo Fan patted his back and chuckled, “What’s wrong, brat, angry? Ha-ha-ha, think about it. They mock us for our weakness. It’s this weakness that will drop their guard and earn their trust. That when we use them to punch through. We’re deceiving them, we should be the one laughing at them. Those morons, ha-ha-ha…”
Gu Santong began after a long pause, “We’re being watched by five Soul Harmony experts not a hundred meters away.”
“I know. We’re outsiders so of course they won’t believe us. They fear we’ll snitch. But they’re wrong. Don’t you think having five of them watching us is kind of small?”
Zhuo Fan showed a devious grin, winking at Gu Santong.
Gu Santong smiled at last, “Yeah, I can deal with five in one punch…”
Meanwhile, Shangguan Feixiong entered into a dark room.
Three elders were already here, sitting on the bed with eyes closed.
“Feixiong, what is it?” One spoke.
Bowing, Shangguan Feixiong’s tone was respectful, “Venerables, the owner of the house is a nobody. He even has an eight-year-old son. We can relax for now and deal with Feiyun!”
“Good, we’ll use this foothold to make a second ambush!”
One elder shouted, “This time, we will take the divine weapon back to eastern lands!”

chapters.title: Chapter 862: Just Wait
chapters.content:
Chapter 862: Just Wait
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Morning, seniors, ha-ha-ha…”
Bright and early, Zhuo Fan and young Sanzi were heading towards the door and were startled to see someone already there. But that didn’t stop him from greeting with a smile.
The exit had guards in place, Soul Harmony experts with mighty auras.
Glancing over, the two men put their hand out, blocking the way.
Zhuo Fan looked at them puzzled as they mocked, “Sorry, Sir Gu, you’re the Clan Head’s nephew. For your safety, it’s best you stay inside.”
“Oh, I see, now I’m someone of value, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan gave a strained laugh, “You’re taking our safety very seriously I see. He-he-he, why thank you.”
Bobbing his face with a bright smile, Zhuo Fan took young Sanzi back, not thinking of leaving again.
The men held nothing but disdain for the two.
Gu Santong looked bleak, gnashing his teeth, “Damn these bastards, they take our home and now are locking us in!”
“Easy now, young Sanzi. Didn’t I tell you already? Yesterday was going to be our last day of leisure.”
With a sinister smile, Zhuo Fan continued, “Which works best for us. They want to keep us here so we’ll use this to see their every move. Once they act and fight with the Flying Cloud manor, we’ll be sure to reap the rewards, completing our mission.”
Gu Santong nodded, but that didn’t mean he liked it, “With these cowards, who knows how long we’ll be stuck here before that happens?”
“Ha-ha-ha, these blokes won’t last long. The more they wait the more dangerous it gets. They’re more desperate than us to finish and go home.”
Rubbing Gu Santong’s head, Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, feeling in complete control of everything, “All we have to do now is just wait.”
Gu Santong sighed a nod.
[Let’s go back to our cell. Not like I haven’t done it in Tianyu…]
“Did you come from outside?”
The two were startled by a bright voice. Turning around, they saw the young miss.
First came her unique fragrance, then Shangguan Qingyan’s graceful figure. Seeing Gu Santong, she went for a hug, pinching his cheeks, “Young Sanzi, did you miss auntie last night?”
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes.
[Hey lady, it’s only been a night, not years. Not even your relatives will miss you.]
[And you’re not close to young Sanzi anyway. Who’d ever miss you?]
Gu Santong was of the same mind, judging by that cold look, “Who’d ever miss you?”
Ugh!
That one went straight to her heart as Shangguan Qingyan showed a bitter smile, “Young Sanzi, you’re still so stubborn.”
“Let go of me! I’m going back to sleep.” Gu Santong huffed, looking elsewhere.
Shangguan Qingyan was stumped.
[Why is he so cold to me, and angry? Who is he angry at? ]
Glancing at Zhuo Fan, he chuckled, “Don’t mind it, he’s just being a brat. I promised to take him out to play, but… You know how I’m now a new man, with the clan worried for my safety. So I have to stay inside for now, and the child…”
“They’re holding you here?”
Shangguan Qingyan exploded, “This is your home and we’re just guests. How can they do this? That’s just crossing the line! Humph, Shangguan clan isn’t so shameless! Young Sanzi, don’t worry, auntie here will take you out.”
Shangguan Qingyan carried Gu Santong as she marched for the door; a woman on a crusade.
Zhuo Fan smirked, enjoying the show that followed.
“Young miss!”
The two men bowed before Shangguan Qingyan, unlike how they treated Zhuo Fan.
Shangguan Qingyan barked, “What do you think you’re doing? This is the Gu household, so why are you stopping the two of them? Are you settling in the role of robbers, taking another’s home? Have you forgotten all the values Shangguan clan stands for?”
“Young miss, please…”
The two bowed again, feeling conflicted, “It’s Clan Head’s order. We’re just the messengers.”
Shangguan Qingyan’s brow shook, “Dad? No way! He clearly said to look after the father and son, to be friendly. He even sees him as nephew…”
“Uh, yeah, yeah, it must be that Clan Head was worried for his new nephew that he didn’t want him to go out. The town isn’t safe…”
“Bullshit!”
Shangguan Qingyan cut them off with her outburst, “You can’t lie to me! They have nothing to do with the Shangguan clan. No one’s after them in Flying Cloud City. You’re just trapping them here. Humph, I brought you all here and this is what you do? It is my duty to hold the true owner of this house’s side. Now shove off! I’m taking young Sanzi and Sir Zhuo for a walk.”
[Uh…]
Frowning, the two were very conflicted, indecisive.
Zhuo Fan looked from the side. He wanted Shangguan clan to pave his way, but it wasn’t bad making waves and stirring things up either.
Lest some guy from the Shangguan clan wanted to push him around. If he didn’t stand out, he’d suffer.
This noise came at the best time, showing everyone Shangguan clan’s young miss was on their side and scaring off some bored chaps looking for trouble.
Zhuo Fan simply watched the show unfold with a hidden smile.
As the situation became tense, a shout came, “Cousin, uncle is calling you. The Gu father and son can come as well. “
The two men sighed, the Clan Head finally asked for young miss. It was getting a bit too tense for them, having to choose between duty and respect.
“I’ll go see dad and then we’ll go out.”
Glaring at them, Shangguan Qingyan hugged Gu Santong as she went, “Sir Gu, we’ll explain it all to dad.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, walking behind her.
Bam!
Something blocked his view then, knocking into it and stumbling five steps back.
It was Shangguan Yulin.
Zhuo Fan sneered inside.
[Here it comes, making it hard on me. First last night and now today. He’s clearly looking for trouble.]
Shangguan Qingyan was enraged, holding Gu Santong as she went, while oblivious to Zhuo Fan’s predicament.
Shangguan Yulin watched her go then mocked Zhuo Fan, “Stay away from young miss. Wretched social climbers like you two won’t get anywhere.”
Shangguan Yulin left after that.
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, staring hard at him, then he shook his head.
[Such are clansmen, empty of talent yet full of conceit and petty. While you’re looking after the Shangguan clan’s name, I have a way bigger goal in mind.]
Zhuo Fan shook his head before going as well.
People gathered into the parlor, where Shangguan Qingyan and Shangguan Feixiong were already present. Seeing her dad, Shangguan Qingyan started whining.
“Ha-ha-ha, alright, I was only thinking of the two’s safety. I’ll make sure to berate those insensible men.”
Shangguan Feixiong was a leader after all, easily handling this trifle. Then he turned to Zhuo Fan, “Yifan, you’re part of the Shangguan clan now and must shoulder the burden. None of us can walk outside and the task of gathering information falls to you. Qingyan, Yulin, you’ll provide assistance in the light and in shadows.”
Shangguan Qingyan lit up, “Then young Sanzi can go outside?”
“Of course!”
Shangguan Feixiong smiled, “I said that they misunderstood my intention. I never wanted to hold the two here.”
“Great!
Shangguan Qingyan cheered, hugging young Sanzi close. Young Sanzi was also smiling.
Only Zhuo Fan had a calculative look…

chapters.title: Chapter 863: Only Him
chapters.content:
Chapter 863: Only Him
Proofreader
: Papatonks
A family of three was seen walking down the bustling street, the picture of happiness.
Zhuo Fan and Shangguan Qingyan held Gu Santong’s hands between them. The image of the parents taking their child to play earned the jealousy of many, especially from bachelors.
And even more so from a certain shadow from a certain corner, gnashing his teeth with bloodshot eyes.
Shangguan Feixiong had them go out to gather info, since everyone else was too conspicuous with their build and aura. The Flying Cloud City’s guards would find them on the spot.
Being in the Radiant Stage and Ethereal Stage, the lovely family blended naturally in the urban jungle, raising no eyebrows and no warning. Even the Shangguan Yulin, a fresh Soul Harmony Stage cultivator, found nothing wrong with this picture.
The four of them thus went out as scouts, making it look easy. Which it was since no one minded a few ants.
They acted on two fronts, Shangguan Yulin in the shadows, while the family in the open.
Which was the only choice since Zhuo Fan was recorded to be the owner of that house. Shangguan Yulin was a vagrant. And while the patrol might ignore his cultivation, the papers showed he wasn’t on them. So, what could an undeclared bachelor supposed to do? Slunk from the shadows with tears of jealousy streaming down his cheeks at other’s happiness.
“Dad, that one!”
“Here.”
“Auntie, I want one!”
“Here.”
“Dad, auntie, I want everything!”
“Give me all of them!”
…
Zhuo Fan and Shangguan Qingyan looked quite happy holding Gu Santong’s hands. Only Shangguan Yulin was their complete opposite.
The worst thing wasn’t seeing the person he admired being with another man, but being unable to block it.
This helplessness was driving Shangguan Yulin nuts. Who told him to be a vagrant anyway? All that a shadow could do was just bottle it up.
Dang~
The sudden sounds of a gong captured the people’s attention and the family of three approached the source.
It was an announcement, with a Soul Harmony Stage guard banging the gong.
With all gathered, the man ahemed before announcing, “People of Flying Cloud City, take heed, a message from the imperial capital. Sword Star Empire’s best talent, His Highness the Crown Prince, has suffered from cultivation deviation and his Dantian is ruined. Countless alchemists had lent a hand but nothing they did helped. Now we are welcoming any and all alchemists from all over to the imperial capital to consult. If any of you have the skills, you can report to the Flying Cloud manor. After careful screening, we will then recommend you to imperial capital. Whether you can heal Crown Prince or not, your future will be assured. Don’t let this chance pass you by…”
The crowd’s eyes shone with ambition.
In the central area, there were no sects, only the Sword Star Empire ruling supreme. Getting a job in the imperial capital would set them for life.
Whispers spread around, with many looking excited, like they were bound to win.
Zhuo Fan just squinted in thought.
[Whether the Crown Prince’s situation is real or not, it’s also a great chance to slip into Flying Cloud manor.]
Getting an early grasp of the terrain and assets would make his mission that much easier.
“Gu, uh, cousin!”
Shangguan Qingyan looked excited, but she didn’t speak before making sure there was no one around, “We’ve been walking for a while now. Let’s go back, young Sanzi must be tired.”
Eyeing her, Zhuo Fan knew exactly what she wanted, to report.
Zhuo Fan nodded and they went back.
A sudden shadow flashed by them after a few steps, vanishing them from the street and taking them into a dark corner.
Shangguan Qingyan asked, “Cousin…”
“You go back with the child. I need brother Gu for a moment.”
Shangguan Yulin was tense, “I saw some people from Flying Cloud manor moving around in secret but I can’t do much as I am. I want brother Gu to cover for me to investigate.”
Shangguan Qingyan took it at face value and nodded, “Alright, but you have to stay safe, cousin. You must bring Sir Gu back safely. He’s just a Radiant Stage cultivator. Anyone can beat him.”
“Don’t worry, cousin, he’ll be back safe and sound.” With resentment in his eyes, Shangguan Yulin put on a smile.
Shangguan Qingyan chuckled, while Zhuo Fan could read more into it. Though too curious about his plan to expose him.
Shangguan Qingyan took Gu Santong back while Shangguan Yulin grabbed Zhuo Fan’s arm towards a forest with a brutal gaze…
“Flying Cloud manor is recruiting alchemists?”
Shangguan Qingyan started at the news, then turned serious, “Yan’er, is this true?”
Shangguan Qingyan nodded, blurting, “Yes, the whole street heard it.”
“Then it must be real.”
Shangguan Feixiong’s eyes flashed, “This is our best chance to get into the manor. But what if it’s a trap?”
Shangguan Feixiong then looked around, “Where’s Yulin?”
“Cousin found clues into the manor and wanted Gu Yifan to cover for him.”
“Yulin has always been level-headed. He must have his reasons for doing this. Gu Yifan will be fine with him.”
Shangguan Feixiong squinted, muling over this information before walking outside.
He went to a familiar room, where the three old men sat.
Bowing, Shangguan Feixiong made his report and added, “I’m yet unclear if this is a chance or a trap.”
“Danger and opportunity often walk hand in hand.”
An elder spoke, “Regardless, this is our chance to scout the manor. It’s far better than going in head first. We lost too many last time, with even your daughter suffering a heavy wound, threatening her life. We shouldn’t have taken the kids with us.”
Shangguan Feiyun shook his head, “Venerable, the Shangguan clan isn’t afraid of death, nor are we conceited. The same goes for my daughter. I brought them along because Shangguan Feiyun
doesn’t know them, but can keep a lookout for us. Last time they followed our trail and attacked our base, scattering the kids. But this time we’re thorough and won’t be as dangerous.”
“I hope so.”
The elder sighed, “We were indifferent to having them at first, coming to the central area with the intent to take the divine weapon even in death. But they are still young, they are the future of the eastern lands. I can’t bear to see them go.”
Shangguan Feixiong nodded.
Another elders spoke, “Second, none of us can leave if we want to now. Why talk about it then? Our goal is to find where the divine weapon is located. The fact that it recruits alchemists, is a chance for us, regardless of anything. But who can we entrust with infiltrating the manor?”
“None of us can go, since even after a hundred years since Shangguan Feiyun left eastern lands, he’d still remember us. No matter how we try to hide, he’ll find us.”
Shangguan Feixiong frowned, “That means we can only give it to a junior. But who among them has the alchemical skills to get into the manor?”
The men shook their heads, “Our clan has many talents in cultivation, but none in alchemy.”
“Yeah, alchemy is related to cultivation, skill and arts to become a grandmaster!”
The elder sighed, “Alchemists will flock to Flying Cloud manor with this announcement. Without the power of a Soul Harmony Stage it’s difficult to stand out.”
“We can only have Yulin try…” Shangguan Feixiong muttered.
The three elders nodded helplessly.
[He may not be an alchemist, he’s the only choice among the juniors…]

chapters.title: Chapter 864: Fifty Mile Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 864: Fifty Mile Plan
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Does that mean the Crown Prince’s situation is a lie?”
In a wide and lavish hall, sparkling with wealth, a handsome man sat in the seat of honor. With a teacup in hand, his eyes crackled with lightning as he looked at the seat left of him.
The calm and smiling youth there looked like even a slight breeze would topple him, lacking the bold air a man would have.
Though his eyes told another story, making the middle-aged man turn serious and not disregard him.
“Prime Minister sir, what act are you enacting?”
With a wide grin, the youth turned to the seat of honor, “Ha-ha-ha, that would be my line, Sword King Feiyun. Two months ago there was some loud ruckus coming from the hundreds of experts entering the manor. Why is it that the Sword King didn’t inform the imperial capital?”
One of them was the best in eastern lands, now turned traitor, Shangguan Feiyun, and the other Sword Star Empire’s Prime Minister, Baili JIngwei, one of the very few able to wield power equal to Nine Sword Kings.
Baili JIngwei came from the very distant imperial capital and straight to Flying Cloud Manor. The moment he entered, he ordered the guards to announce alchemist recruitment for the Crown Prince’s situation.
Now he was saying it was all fake. Shangguan Feiyun was pissed, to say the least, as well as the youth ordering everyone around like this was his own home.
[Hey, I get you’re the Prime Minister, but then you come to my turf and start barking orders to my men.]
It was fine if it was critical, but this here was some baffling ploy and the suddenness of it all and without a word made him feel that he was played with. Anyone would be angry at this point.
“Just some minor vermin I had to deal with. There was no need informing the imperial capital of this trifle.” Shangguan Feiyun eyed him coldly, then looked to the right seat, “By telling the imperial capital all that crops up will make the Nine Sword Kings look incompetent. Wouldn’t you say so, brother Danqing?”
Drinking from a yellow gourd without a care, at Shangguan Feiyun’s question, the man stopped drinking.
Belching, Danqing Shen rubbed his red nose, feeling tipsy, “Brother Feiyun, this is between you and Prime Minister Baili, not me. You guys talk it out and don’t involve me. I’m just an escort. I still have to get Prime Minister to imperial capital safely, ha-ha-ha.”
“Thank you, Dragon Cleaving Sword King, but I’m sure the trip will be quiet and won’t disturb you.”
Baili Jingwei leaned a bit and nodded before turning to the host, “Shangguan Feiyun, don’t mince words. If those were but small thieves two months ago, why is it that the guards are looking tense and silent? Why else would you have asked Dragon Cleaving Sword King for protection?”
Shangguan Feiyun’s eyes shook, his mood sinking.
Baili Jingwei stood up and smiled, “Sword King and I are more than clear that it was the Shangguan clan who was behind it. Their goal is to take back the same treasure you brought from eastern lands, the Soaring Sword. Patriarch had long since wanted to gather the other areas’ divine swords. Sword King’s feat is truly commendable. Patriarch would be most pleased at the news. Taking Patriarch’s stead, allow me to bow to you, Sword King. Thank you for donating the sword.”
Baili Jingwei bowed to Shangguan Feiyun.
Shangguan Feiyun’s eyes shook, somewhat touched by the perfect bow of the youth.
Baili Jingwei stood up with a flat look, “However, Patriarch is in seclusion and is unaware of this matter, needing me to take the sword. Wouldn’t Patriarch’s joy plunge knowing that in this time the divine sword ended up stolen? He would surely explode…”
“Humph, are you using the Invincible Sword to threaten me?”
Shangguan Feiyun slammed the table and shouted.
Baili Jingwei shook his head with a sigh. “The Patriarch himself appointed Sword King Feiyun as a Sword King, together with the imperial family. This is not my intention at all. I’m only extrapolating. When Patriarch is angry, it won’t be just a Sword King affected, but the entire empire. I only ask for help in the matter of the Crown Prince. He cannot set foot outside, his grave situation having spread to the entire central area, all to help the Sword King remove all thieves and secure the divine sword. It affects both of us and cooperation is most advised.”
Eying him, Shangguan Feiyun pondered as his rage subsided.
“What good would spreading this do? They’re no fools to fall for it and attack Flying Cloud manor.”
“Ha-ha-ha, it’s alright, Sword King. I’m certain that as we screen alchemists, we’ll be trapping the Shangguan thieves! “
Snickering, Baili Jingwei’s eyes flashed, “People don’t do crime out of stupidity, but out of greed. Greed is humanity’s most base trait. None can escape its clutches. I know from their first ambush of the manor they suffered heavy casualties. The second ambush would fail if they come without a plan, but it will also make it less likely to end them all.
“So it’s better to give them a chance to slip in, luring them with the sword by screening alchemists. Once they come, we will trap them like rats, with none coming out alive. This will cripple the power of eastern lands by damaging the top clan. It will prove beneficial for our future advancement into eastern lands.”
Shangguan Feiyun looked at him hard and nodded, “Prime Minister wants not just the Soaring Sword, but to take precautions for when you attack eastern lands. “
“Ha-ha-ha, didn’t I tell you? Greed is the basest trait of humans, one that even I can’t escape from.”
Baili Jingwei’s eyes glinted with wisdom, “This is the perfect moment to shoot two birds with one stone.”
Shangguan Feiyun nodded, “I am in awe of Prime Minister’s wisdom. But the Shangguan clan has no alchemists. Would they take the bait?”
“It’s because it doesn’t fit them which makes it more real and enticing.”
Baili Jingwei said, “Worry not, paving the way to people in crisis will only scare them away. The harder the journey, the more they’ll consider it. Sir Sword King, I ask that you give me the power to command the guards, loosen security and recall patrols. I promise by this time next fortnight, all the rats will be found and removed.”
Shangguan Feiyun gave his accord.
Baili Jingwei showed a pleased smile, “Sir Sword King, I heard the manor has a true marvel, no less than the imperial capital’s Ringing Thunder Temple. May I see it?”
“Prime Minister, you’re most welcome. The guards will take you.” Shangguan Feiyun nodded.
Baili Jingwei bowed and walked, “Thank you.”
“Dragon Cleaving Sword King, don’t you want a look as well?”
“Ha-ha-ha, I’m only into books, painting and wine. Prime Minister may enjoy himself alone.”
Baili Jingwei turned to Danqing Shen, who waved him off as he drank.
Baili Jingwei shook his head and left, “Ha-ha-ha, what a shame, books and paintings are tied to marvels of nature…”
When he was gone, Shangguan Feiyun squinted and sighed, “Brother Danqing, see that? Look how much Baili Jingwei and even the imperial capital revere us and now look at all the spies they placed around. The minute something happens, the imperial capital is bound to know it the next. Humph, and they call us Nine Sword Kings.”
“We’re nothing more than generals in the army!”
Danqing Shen shook his head and sighed, “It doesn’t matter how many spies are there, as long as I can keep it safe.”
“I never pegged you for an idealist, wanting to build utopia. I didn’t follow Invincible Sword for an insipid and useless title like Sword King, but to stand next to the strongest, to find my own land.”
Shangguan Feiyun’s eyes flashed, “The day will come when I’ll wield the Soaring Sword and rule eastern lands!”
Danqing Shen put down the wine and mocked, “Eastern lands’s ruler? Don’t let fantasy consume you. The day will come when the whole world will be Sword Star Empire’s. We’ll be nothing more than some governor of a slice at the most, not rulers.”
“That’s you!”
Shangguan Feiyun glared at him, “I won’t, absolutely won’t…”

chapters.title: Chapter 865: Backstab
chapters.content:
Chapter 865: Backstab
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Whoosh~
Deep in a thick forest, two shadows cut through the trees, before finally stopping and revealing their features.
One, looking imposing and having sharp features, with Soul Harmony Stage aura, was Shangguan Yulin. The other, looking plain yet having deep eyes, was Zhuo Fan.
Looking ahead, Zhuo Fan feigned puzzlement when seeing the bamboo, “Uhm, cousin, what’s odd here? I can’t see anything out of place.”
[Who the hell’s your cousin? This rotten bastard knows only how to claw his way up through another’s power. That’s why she fell for his fancy speech.]
Shangguan Yulin rolled his eyes, but didn’t show his anger, “Brother Gu, when I watched the guards, I thought I saw them pass through here. I couldn’t look alone so I brought you along. If you meet them, just say you’re here for the view, ha-ha-ha…”
“Really? But I don’t see any signs of people around.”
Zhuo Fan frowned, his eyes darting around.
Shangguan Yulin pushed him lightly with a vile smile as he enticed, “Look ahead, there’s definitely some guards here. Go see what they’re doing and help report to uncle for merit…”
“Then I shall…” Zhuo Fan took slow steps walking forward.
Shangguan Yulin, however, did the opposite, getting some distance and watching Zhuo with a cold gaze.
There was even some bloodthirst mixed in there…
Hu~
Shangguan Yulin sent a sudden palm to Zhuo Fan’s back.
Zhuo Fan cried out. He knew Shangguan Yulin was up to something, but not so soon.
He wasn’t the only one in this, but the entire Shangguan clan’s safety would be affected. If something happened to the Gu family of Flying Cloud City, the manor would definitely investigate it.
Next was obvious, fleeing like rats, especially now when they were at their weakest.
Shangguan Yulin was no moron to not realize the consequences.
Zhuo Fan frowned, stuck in hesitation.
[To dodge or not?]
Dodging would expose his level and he might have to silence the kid. But he’d also had to make up a damn good excuse to avoid Shangguan clan’s suspicion.
The other option… How was he to react if it hit?
[As a Radiant Stage, Ethereal Stage, or Soul Harmony Stage cultivator?]
Well, his body was as tough as a Soul Harmony expert now.
The problem wasn’t the hit, but what came after. Well, he’d just wing it.
[If found out, killing him is still on the table.]
Zhuo Fan’s vexation was unrelated to his safety, but his reaction.
Shangguan Yulin would’ve been so pissed if he knew.
He was a strong and outstanding member of the Shangguan clan’s younger generation, widely known throughout eastern lands. Now this pipsqueak didn’t give a whit about the backstab but how to fool him instead. The fact he entertained the thought of silencing him as well was what really took the cake.
[How conceited can you get?]
Not that it mattered since it was all hypothetical…
Hu~
Zhuo Fan looked stunned for a moment then reacted, sensing the biting wind on his back.
[It won’t take the life of a Radiant Stage cultivator as it is. He’s not out to kill me at least, but wound me.]
[Let’s play along, and then…]
Zhuo Fan made a plan and struck his body, giving himself a flesh wound and showing some blood from his mouth.
Only then did Shangguan Yulin’s palm strike.
Bam!
Pff!
At least he got the timing right, spitting blood right as the attack hit and crumbling on the ground in feigned faint.
Snickering like a fox, Shangguan Yulin muttered “Damn bastard, I warned you to stay away from my cousin. You brought this on yourself, humph…”
Shangguan Yulin walked over to Zhuo Fan, his right hand growing cold.
Sensing the chill behind him, Zhuo Fan was stumped.
[What’s he trying to do now?]
“Punk, don’t think for a second that by being the Shangguan clan’s cover, no one will touch you.”
With a cold glint in his eyes, Shangguan Yulin lifted his icy hand with a creepy grin, “We may need you for cover and can’t kill you, but that doesn’t mean we can’t hurt you. This Crippling Hand of mine is nothing fancy, but at least it leaves no tracks. I just need to press your major pressure points and your meridians will rot!”
“In ten days, your Yuan Qi flow will fall. In twenty days, your cultivation will plunge. In a month, you’ll be a full fledged cripple. And the best part, you’ll never know why. A cripple, even as part of the Shangguan clan, will have no right to be around cousin. Humph, what a joke, ha-ha-ha…”
“There’s still clues leading to today though. Aren’t you scared Shangguan Feixiong will notice your rotten character and won’t let his daughter around you?”
A heavy and gruff voice entered his ears.
Not even that worked to wipe the smug smile off Shangguan Yulin’s face. “As if, since I thought it through. The punk didn’t see who struck him. I’ll just say we met with a patrol and in the fight, he was backstabbed before bringing him back. Uncle might doubt his crippled status, but will think it had something to do with today’s wound. He’ll never place the blame on me. Ha-ha-, wait, who are you?”
Shangguan Yulin’s laughter got stuck in his throat.
[Who said that?]
“Hi-hi-hi, kid, seeing you so devious, petty, greedy, immoral and cocky, you’re right in tune with my demonic path. Why not leave the Shangguan clan and join me down the path of evil?”
Whoosh~
A shadow shrouded the sky, turning everything pitch-black and cutting Shangguan Yulin off from reality.
Shangguan Yulin panicked, “Domain soul!”
But then he mocked, “You think you can contend with me, a Soul Harmony expert, by using a domain in the Ethereal Stage? Ha-ha-ha, you wish! I’ll break it with this punch!”
Shangguan Yulin did just that.
“Dragon Trapping Chain!”
The voice came before he could finish the attack.
Whoosh~
Something huge slithered around his body and seeped into his body and blocking his Yuan Qi in place.
A great power fell on him, stopping him from even budging.
Shangguan Yulin, a Soul Harmony expert, found himself trapped and cried, “W-what is this?”
“Hi-hi-hi, kid, the world is far and wide. Not all Ethereal Stage cultivators are weaker than Soul Harmony cultivators. You’re too cocky.”
The creepy voice echoed around, filling Shangguan Yulin with fear.
[Who is he? How does he have such a strange skill?]
This never happened before. No Soul Harmony expert ended up trapped by a mere Ethereal Stage cultivator’s domain soul.
Shangguan Yulin’s heart shivered with dread. Looking around, all he saw was darkness, and the unknown only fed his fears.
While he was blind as a bat, the other side saw clearly.
Smirking at Shangguan Yulin being squeezed by the chain, Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed with a toying gaze. His voice was gruff, “Kid, I find your wretched and debased style reminding me of my olden days. Those were the days. I’ll make an exception and take you in, so kowtow a hundred times and call me master, ha-ha-ha…”

chapters.title: Chapter 866: Play
chapters.content:
Chapter 866: Play
Proofreader
: Papatonks
[A hundred?!]
Shangguan Yulin’s face twitched in anger as he snapped, “In your dreams! Do you have any idea who I am? I am the best genius in Shangguan clan, of ultimate honor! Why the hell would I bow to you?”
“Ha-ha-ha, kid has some spunk.”
Zhuo Fan mocked from the shadows, “I know everything about you, how many you are and where you’re hiding. I’m not scared of Shangguan Feixiong, let alone a kid like you. Humph, having you kowtow is my way of appreciating you. But since you don’t want to… “
Zhuo Fan paused for effect.
Bam!
A huge dragon tail lashed at his cheek, leaving a red welt with blood seeping from his mouth.
There were even some teeth mixed with the blood, clattering to the ground.
Pain assaulted his senses, with half his face double the other.
Shangguan Yulin shuddered, his eyes tearing, his mouth shivering, “W-what are you doing? Why did you hit me?”
“Humph, you have the nerve to ask why?”
Zhuo Fan snickered, “I’ve always been conceited, looking down on every youth who wanted to learn from me. Now that I found a good seed, you actually dare refuse me?”
Bam!
Another tail lash struck the other cheek and relieving him of a few more teeth.
Lips quivering, Shangguan Yulin’s heart was against it, “I, Shangguan Yulin, appreciate your care, but I can’t accept it. I’m part of the Shangguan clan, I…”
Bam!
Zhuo Fan kept lashing his face with glee, “Cut the crap. I want you. You should be honored, but instead you turn me down. Of course I’ll hit you, ha-ha-ha…”
Bang~
A dozen lashes later, Shangguan Yulin was seeing stars, tears falling like a river.
[What did I do to deserve this? All I wanted was to get the Gu guy here and cripple him.]
[But I didn’t even get to do that as I stumbled into the devil who wants me as his disciple.]
He knew he was amazing, from all the seniors wanting him as well, but he was born from a great and righteous clan. How could he fall so low as to become a demon’s disciple?
[I don’t even know what his status is in his faction. Won’t I lose out trading glory for being some commander’s disciple? If I go from eastern lands’ best clan’s future inheritor to some nobody devil’s disciple, who do I blame then?]
Not like he had a choice. The devil had him trapped and leashed. He wasn’t long for this world if he kept this up.
“Senior, tell me your request and I will brave hell or high water in achieving it. Please release…”
“No, I want you as a disciple. Refuse and I’ll just kill you, ha-ha-ha…”
Shangguan Yulin cried bitter tears over his swollen face, pleading for his life. Zhuo Fan laughed at his expense, shouting and demanding instead.
Shangguan Yulin’s heart was in despair.
[Why am I so amazing to earn the attention of this devil? Fame has its price and now I have to pay for my greatness.]
As Shangguan Yulin’s face was being flung from side to side, he had the time for a flight of fancy, actually taking pride in it.
In the end, Shangguan Yulin couldn’t take it anymore and sighed, forcing himself to say, “Fine, since senior cherishes me so, I will concede.”
Bang~
The lashes came still. Zhuo Fan didn’t seem to hear over the loud smacks.
“Hey, senior! I give up. Why are you still hitting me?” With his face swollen bigger than an overripe melon, Shangguan Yulin cried out as the strikes continued to fall on his numb face.
Zhuo Fan finally reacted, “Hmm, did you say something. My ears aren’t as sharp as they used to…”
[Screw you!]
Shangguan Yulin lashed out in his mind.
[You clearly heard since you replied. Goddamn playing with me!]
But as a hostage, he had to play his part and hung his head.
Since he said his ears were bad, then he’d have to speak louder, obviously, “Master, I pay respects to you. Please stop!”
“What, you want me as your master? Ha-ha-ha, that’s great…”
Bam~
With not a single intention of stopping the dragon tail lashing, actually growing in strength instead, Zhuo Fan himself joined the punishment with his Qilin arm, sending heavy punches to his gut until blood spurted from his mouth.
Face twitching constantly, Shangguan Yulin wailed, “Master, I wish to be under you so why do you still strike me?”
“Oh, your master is a great demonic cultivator and loves thrashing people from joy.”
Zhuo Fan toyed with him, “With such an amazing talent so eager to be learning for me, the excitement got to me. Since there’s no one around, I’ll use you to calm my overstimulated heart.”
Shangguan Yulin’s face was twitching like there was no tomorrow.
[Geezer, I get you want to pummel me, so why make up such lame excuses?]
Though sensible enough not to voice it.
[This coot is insane! If he thrashes people when excited, what about in anger? Will he flay them alive?]
Anywho, he’d rather not test that theory, “Master, don’t hit me. You might beat me to death too if you’re too excited.”
“Oh, hmmm.”
Zhuo Fan sneered inside, “Oh, being in my domain you couldn’t sense that the guy you hit woke up a while ago and left. That left only you to beat up.”
[What?!]
Shangguan Yulin shuddered in anger. He wanted to ruin Zhuo Fan but instead the punk got away while he instead ended up suffering at the hand of this freak.
[What did I ever do to deserve this?]
Shangguan Yulin howled, “Master, how could you let him go?”
“He’s too weak. What was I supposed to do with him? But you, you’re going to wear my mantle, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan laughed and gave two slaps and another overexcited punch to Shangguan Yulin’s chest, caving it in, “It always gets my blood going just thinking about it. I just have to punch something!”
Pff!
Blood and gore spurted from Shangguan Yulin’s mouth. He paled like paper and his face swelled up more, if that was even possible.
Shangguan Yulin’s face twitched again, out of habit perhaps, as he wailed and pleaded, “Master, do you want me as a disciple or one to toy around with? You’re going to end up killing me…”
“Oh, oops, I just can’t control myself in all the excitement, he-he-he…”
Zhuo Fan coughed, “I’m sure you know by now that all demonic cultivators have their peculiar hobbies. I’ve had mine for far too long now, or I would have gotten a disciple ages ago.”
[With such love taps, all your disciples would end up dead.]
With the flogging finally ended, Shangguan Yulin sighed, slumping weakly with hatred.
[God damn lunatic!]
Zhuo Fan let him off seeing him so worn out, but his play had yet to finish, “That only leaves a hundred kowtows and that should do for ceremony.”
“Kowtows… still?”
Shangguan Yulin was so bitter, he hardly spoke.
Zhuo Fan raged, “You won’t? Does that mean you don’t want to be my disciple? Then…”
“I’m doing it, look…”
Shangguan Yulin waved his hands around, frantic.
But before he could start, he asked, “Master, they say three bows to the elders and four to those who passed. Shouldn’t it be just three then? Why would sir want a hundred then?”
“Oh, nice thinking.”
Zhuo Fan grinned, “The three are for me, of course, while the rest are for your late departed senior brothers. To watch over you so you won’t follow in their footsteps. One for each one should appease their spirits.”
[You drove 97 disciples to death already?]
Shangguan Yulin eyes rolled in his head, blanking out from fear.
The black domain faded and Zhuo Fan revealed his mocking smile, his grin turning devious as he watched his puppet…

chapters.title: Chapter 867: Degenerate Demon
chapters.content:
Chapter 867: Degenerate Demon
Proofreader
: Papatonks
On a pitch-black night, the black clouds drifted away, revealing a round moon that shone its graceful light upon the cold land and the unmoving man.
Upon a closer look, he was covered in wounds. His clothes were in tatters, his face so swollen only a mother would recognize him.
His brows quivered as the moonlight stirred him, opening his hazy eyes.
“Where am I? W-why am I…”
Confusion laced his gaze from his unsettled mind, but then it all came pouring in. He sat quickly and darted his eyes all over in panic, “Where’s that sicko? Where is he?”
He looked around but there was no one around except for him.
The man nodded for some reason, muttering to himself, “It was all just an illusion. Yes, that’s it. There’s no sicko and that never happened. It was just one horrible nightmare, ha-ha-ha…”
Pa!
His crazed and delusional justification came to an abrupt halt as a stone graced his most sensitive and swollen face, slamming him into the ground.
The flood of pain brought him to tears, his mouth quivering…
“Hey, disciple, who’re you calling a sicko?”
A most familiar and dreaded voice came from the darkness.
The man shuddered, but he actually remained silent.
[That’s the old demon’s voice. The nightmare is real, the devil is still here!]
Eyes twitching, Shangguan Yulin wailed in tears, “Master, I would never! I was only referring to the people of Flying Cloud manor. Those old freaks suck at even being guards. How could they let just anyone into the city…”
Shangguan Yulin wailed while making excuses as his voice trailed off, growing so tiny no one could hear him.
He just dumped all his hatred on the guards.
[What the hell is wrong with you? You call yourself guards and yet you let this sicko disturb public peace?]
It not once occurred to him that if security was that tight, Shangguan clan had no way of getting in.
From the shadow, Zhuo Fan listened with a laugh, “Oh, disciple, so you’re cursing the guards. They sure deserve it. They ignore their duties and let anyone in, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan continued, “However, thanks to their sloppy attitude, we got to slip in, no? This is where a Sword King is stationed, you know?”
Shangguan Yulin flushed, knowing fully well the old guy was mocking him, but his mouth remained shut.
“Seeing you all worn out, we’ll leave the hundred kowtows aside for now.”
Shangguan Yulin lit up in joy, “Really? Thank you, master, thank you, ha-ha-ha…”
A total discrepancy from the hatred he felt in his heart.
[This decrepit geezer, I won’t take a sicko like him as master ever, even if I would’ve been put to bow a hundred times. The minute I get to uncle, you’re dead to me.]
[And if I catch you around me again, I’ll sic people on you to skin you alive, flay your flesh and break your bones…]
Zhuo Fan could easily see through those crocodile tears, making a most devious grin, “While the ceremony will be on hold for now, we’re now master and disciple. Don’t you ever forget that.”
“Yes master, absolutely!” Shangguan Yulin bobbed his head with a fake smile.
Zhuo Fan laughed and shook his head, “Heh, do you really think I’ll believe that disciple? That’ll make all those centuries roaming the world for nothing.”
“No no no, master, you have to believe me. I’m serious about having you as my master. My vow shall never be broken…” Shangguan Yulin panicked as he explained.
Zhuo Fan mocked, “It’s fine. I’m not that easy to fool and I came prepared. Now take your shirt off…”
“What do you want to do?”
Shangguan Yulin froze, on high alert.
[The sicko’s first twisted hobby was enough as it is. Who knows if he doesn’t have any others even worse than this.]
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Easy now, disciple, I am a great demonic cultivator, but I won’t ever swing that way. Also, why would I have waited so long if I had that intention to begin with?”
Shangguan Yulin paused for a moment before realizing it as well. So he complied.
Seeing his perfect body riddled with wounds, Shangguan Yulin’s hatred grew hotter.
[This is all this sicko’s fault!]
“Try using Yuan Qi.” Zhuo Fan said.
Shangguan Yulin did as he was told and on his caved in chest, two words in golden letters appeared.
Degenerate demon.
Shangguan Yulin looked gobsmacked. He pointed at his chest with a dumb look, stammering, “W-what is this?”
“Ha-ha-ha, disciple, the demonic path has always been unpopular, so anyone who becomes my disciple needs to have these words engraved on them as a reminder. So you’ll never lower yourself again nor get trapped in lofty dreams.”
Zhuo Fan laughed, “You’ll soon leave with me and strike out in the world! You’re best off forgetting everything about inheriting the Shangguan clan. There’s no way they’ll let someone with such words on their chest lead the Shangguan clan. They’re too renowned for that.”
Shangguan Yulin’s eyes twitched, about to explode in anger, “Master, you’ve ruined me. I only ever wanted the supreme glory of the Shangguan clan. We can even rule it together, but please don’t take everything from me…”
“Share, you say?”
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, “You’re serious?”
Shangguan Yulin bobbed his head, “Yes, of course, as long as I get to lead Shangguan clan, then half of it will be yours, as my master.”
