“You truly know how to return favors. I bet your uncle would be fuming if he heard you. But I like it, ha-ha-ha… “
Zhuo Fan made a sign and the gaudy golden letters faded from Shangguan Yulin’s chest. Shangguan Yulin perked up.
A bit too soon though, as Zhuo Fan’s icy tone came right after, “Remember your words, disciple. You are to follow my every word from now on. Or else it won’t be as easy as letters appearing on your chest next time, maybe your life will expire.”
Shangguan Yulin shuddered, but looked confused.
“Why did those words appear? Ha-ha-ha, that’s because I gave you a Blood Curse.”
Zhuo Fan snickered, “As you saw, the words popped on your chest the minute you used Yuan Qi. What you don’t know is that in fifteen minutes you would’ve been splattered everywhere if I hadn’t kept the Blood Curse in check with my signs.”
Panicking, Shangguan Yulin’s eyes bugged out, “No way!”
“Ha-ha-ha, yes way. You just became my disciple and have no idea what I’m capable of. Now do you understand how your 97 senior brothers passed? Humph…”
Zhuo Fan squinted, “Press the sacred pool pressure point on your right hand and use Yuan Qi.”
Shangguan Yulin did just that. He heard a bang then and his right arm exploded in a golden pillar of flames, followed by the breaking of his meridian.
Blood dripped on the ground as the hand now hung limp.
He was now in extreme shock.
He never thought this old freak would be so brutal, planting a bomb in him to detonate at any second.
Zhuo Fan grinned at his dumb look, “The golden flame shows I’m going easy on you. If it were the black flame, then the second it appeared, losing your hand would be the least of your problems. Then again, even this display was only a fraction of the golden flame’s power. If you don’t listen…”
“Master, I’ll do everything you say, no questions asked. Please show mercy and release the Blood Curse!”
Shangguan Yulin was looking afraid now, starting to slam his head on the ground without Zhuo Fan’s urging.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed, “Good, now tell me everything about Shangguan clan and why you have come to Flying Cloud City.”
Pausing, Shangguan Yulin sighed after some hesitation…

chapters.title: Chapter 868: Entrusted/Charged
chapters.content:
Chapter 868: Entrusted/Charged
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“I see, so eastern lands’ divine weapon, Soaring Sword, was brought to eastern lands by Shangguan Feiyun,”
Zhuo Fan nodded after he finished, “So that’s why Shangguan clan left home. It was all to get the eastern land’s treasure back.”
Looking at the black void around him, Shangguan Yulin found to shadow of Zhuo Fan, “Master, you said you knew everything so does it look like you just found out?”
“You talk too much.”
Zhuo Fan glared, “You only need to answer my question. Try to hide anything and when I’ll find out…”
“I know. I will never lie to you.”
Shangguan Yulin bobbed his head while cussing on the inside.
[The old coot is so sly. With how he acts, I don’t have any chance of hiding anything.]
[The minute I do, he’ll activate that golden flame he stuck in me and blow me sky high.]
Shangguan Yulin sighed.
[This marks the beginning of my betrayal of the Shangguan clan.]
Zhuo Fan had since known him to be twisted inside. That was why he believed he wasn’t a zealot for the clan, choosing self preservation over glory. That made his words believable, turning him into a usable young master.
Zhuo Fan probed, “What if I wanted you to get me the Soaring Sword? Will you give your life for the Shangguan clan or offer me the sword?”
“Master, why do you even ask? My life is in sir’s hands. Of course I’ll give you the sword for my life.” Shangguan Yulin sighed.
Zhuo Fan had a hard look, but then laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, great, you know when to compromise, kid. It brings me relief knowing this as I charge you with an important task.”
Shangguan Yulin asked, “What task?”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “I’ll contact you when the time is right. Until then, you are to play your part in the Shangguan clan, to make sure there are no incidents. I’ll notify you when I’m ready. That will be your glorious achievement for your master’s sake!”
“Yes, master!” He’d rather not, but it wasn’t like he had a choice. He bowed and cupped his hands.
The tranquility of the forest was the only reply.
Looking around, Shangguan Yulin tested, “M-master? Are you there?”
The night breeze blew by.
“Curses, did he really leave?” Shangguan Yulin took a deep breath, depression evident on his face. Just what did he do to deserve this fate? Why him? How could he become a turncoat just like that and become some devil’s toy?
All he could do was hang his head and trudge along dejectedly until the devil whispered in his ear. After the cruel ceremony to be the devil’s disciple, he still had no idea what he was. He lost big this time.
He only came to take care of his love rival, yet ended up with him being some sicko’s puppet instead.
Shangguan Yulin teared up again.
With a beaten look, Shangguan Yulin dragged his weary body as the night wind grazed his swollen face.
As he faded out into the night, Zhuo Fan faded in, at the same spot.
Looking at the poor sap of a young master, Zhuo Fan smirked, “I finally got myself a usable pawn. I no longer have to be part of the audience, but actually flip the board, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan left with one final laugh…
Meanwhile, in the parlor of Gu household, the face of Shangguan Feixiong on the main seat shone in the light of candles. He was frowning, focusing on the entrance with a heavy look.
Shangguan Qingyan paced around the parlor, looking nervous and restless.
A stark contrast to the young child sitting there with a toy in his hands, cheerfully playing.
Thump~
The two’s eyes snapped up to see a Shangguan clan guard rushing in.
“Well? Are they back yet?” Shangguan Qingyan asked first.
The guard bowed with a sigh, “Young miss, Clan Head, young master and Sir Gu have yet to return.”
“You may go.”
A Shangguan Feixiong’s gesture, the man withdrew.
Shangguan Qingyan complained, “Just where did cousin take Sir Gu? What’s taking them so long? Dad, tell me they’re alright!”
Shangguan Feixiong frowned in thought, shaking his head.
“Young Sanzi, aren’t you worried since your dad is late?”
Shangguan Qingyan turned to the carefree child playing with the toy. She knew the father and son were very close, sticking to each other like glue. So why was it the kid showed no care when his dad went missing? It made no sense.
Gu Santong glanced at her, not stopping his playing for her sake, “My dad is too great for something to happen to him. Even if it does, it’s the other side who’ll suffer.”
“What do you mean by that?” Shangguan Qingyan was baffled.
Gu Santong had a vague smile on his face in reply. It only worked to puzzle this young missie to the extreme.
Hurried footsteps were heard as a guard barged in with a cheerful cry, “Clan Head, young miss, young master is back!”
“Truly?”
Shangguan Feixiong shot to his feet and walked for the door, with Shangguan Qingyan right behind him.
They didn’t get far, as Shangguan Yulin’s wretched figure and swollen face entered the parlor with a casual step.
The two were stunned, scanning Shangguan Yulin’s remaining obvious facial features and crying in shock, “W-who are you?”
“See? I told you it’s unclear who had incidents, humph…” Gu Santong was still in his seat and glanced over with a sneer as he played on.
Shangguan Yulin’s mouth quivered, looking at his uncle and cousin with a heavy heart. Seeing them so happy, he was choking on his words, “Uncle, cousin, I’m back.”
“Y-you’re Yulin?” Still incredulous Shangguan Feixiong stammered.
The guard explained, “Clan Head, he is indeed young master. He just came back and had us all jump. But we knew him from his aura.”
Shangguan Feixiong finally took notice of the air around the swollen head, finally putting a name to this strange face. What shocked him wasn’t that though, “What happened? Why are you like this?”
“What about Sir Gu? Where is he? Wasn’t he with you?” Shangguan Qingyan asked.
Shangguan Yulin’s face fell, his anger spiking.
[Cousin, you’re my kin, yet instead of asking about me you worry about someone else? Am I that insignificant to you?]
Shangguan Yulin felt wronged, remaining silent. This had Shangguan Qingyan growing frantic, “Cousin, where’s Sir Gu? Didn’t I tell you to watch over him? Why are you returning perfectly fine while he’s missing?”
Shangguan Yulin shook, on the point of spewing blood.
[Fine?]
[Cousin, does anything about me look perfectly fine to you? I just came back from an encounter with a patrol. But seeing me so roughed up, they pitied me and didn’t interrogate me. You call that perfectly fine? Why do you only care about him? What is going on between you two? What are you to each other?]
Shangguan Yulin’s heart was crushed, wanting to howl at the sky. Only his uncle’s presence stopped him…
“Did cousin come back yet?”
Cries were heard from outside and soon, Zhuo Fan’s figure rushed in. He looked drenched and tense as he asked quickly, “Uncle, cousin just left me!”
Shangguan Feixiong’s face twitched, looking from him to the unrecognizable Shangguan Yulin. They shook their heads.
[What did they do anyway…]

chapters.title: Chapter 869: Shadow Emperor
chapters.content:
Chapter 869: Shadow Emperor
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Sighing, Shangguan Feixiong pointed at the youth with a warped face, “Yulin is already back. He’s standing right here.”
“That’s cousin?”
Looking shocked at Shangguan Yulin next to him, Zhuo Fan’s eyes shook in disbelief, but then he changed tunes to, “While there’s no resemblance to speak of, I can vaguely sense cousin’s valor and grandeur, the imposing posture…”
Pff!
Shangguan Qingyan rolled her eyes and giggled. Shangguan Yulin was fuming.
[Is he toying with me or praising me?]
Shangguan Feixiong glared at his daughter, making her smile fade but she stuck out her tongue. He sighed and frowned at the two, “What have you been doing all this time? Why do you look like that?”
“Uncle, actually…”
Zhuo Fan began his report, making Shangguan Feixiong look stern and focused. But Zhuo Fan’s next words had this mild Clan Head actually ticked off, “I have no clue whatsoever.”
Pff!
Shangguan Feixiong was so close to popping in anger, barking, “Why are you talking then? And weren’t you two together, how can you not know anything?”
“Uncle, while I and cousin were out searching, I was struck unconscious out of nowhere. By the time I woke up, there was no one there, not even cousin. I searched for him, fearing the guards might have found him. But despite all the searching, I found no sign of him and rushed back, only to see cousin wasn’t home either. I truly don’t know anything about what happened when I was out cold.”
Zhuo Fan muttered, playing the victim, “Uncle, at your question, I of course responded swiftly as a sign of respect. Yet you do not appreciate me, but shout at me. A-aren’t you from a righteous clan…”
Ugh!
Shangguan Feixiong was stumped, feeling ashamed seeing Zhuo Fan’s look. But he was also gratified.
While Zhuo Fan was a flippant rogue, he could still tell from that recounting he forwent his safety in danger, worrying for his friend and searching all day through the city to find him.
Such loyalty was just the kind Shangguan clan preached.
Clueless that all of it was merely an elaborate excuse for his late arrival. All of it was to get closer to the clan. Loyalty was the farthest thing from his mind.
With Zhuo Fan’s vile character, what the hell kind of loyalty would he have after meeting you guys for just a day?
But since the old man wanted to believe it, Zhuo Fan was happy to play along, all to get more out of it later…
Shangguan Feixiong took a deep breath and patted his shoulder, “Yifan, I was wrong. Don’t mind it.”
“With no parents in this world, you are my only elder. I have no right to complain.” Zhuo Fan beamed and bowed.
Shangguan Feixiong was even more gratified, “You’re looking more and more like a true Shangguan clansman. I haven’t made a mistake taking you in, ha-ha-ha…”
Shangguan Yulin shook, a feeling of dread drowning him.
[What the hell? The kid only knew how to run his mouth, forcing uncle to take him in with a reluctant heart. So why is it that now the punk got uncle’s approval?]
[Won’t that make it harder to touch him later?]
“Yulin, Yifan doesn’t know what happened. You tell us!”
Shangguan Yulin was thinking about his next plan when Shangguan Feixiong’s shout brought him back to the present. “Uncle, is right, brother Gu truly is like a Shangguan clansman, only difference is his surname…”
Shangguan Feixiong eyed him, “Yulin, what are you spouting? I’m asking here where have you been all this time? And how did Yifan get attacked?”
“Oh, that.”
Wiping the cold sweat off his brow, Shangguan Yulin had a dry smile as he made excuses, “Uncle, I and brother Gu had followed a patrol in the forest since they were being suspicious in their actions. I never thought they had a sentry post hidden as well, ambushing us. I panicked and blocked in reflex, not even realizing the shockwave would catch brother Gu by surprise and knock him out. Six people then showed up, forcing me to flee upon facing such strong opposition.”
Zhuo Fan’s brow rose, sparing him an approving glance.
[He’s a genius alright, making perfect lies on the spot that encompasses all doubts. He’s one crafty guy. Even I would’ve believed him if I wasn’t there.]
Shangguan Feixiong frowned, “So, you abandoned Yifan?”
“Uh, no no no, Uncle, please hear me out.”
Shangguan Yulin rushed to come up with another lie, “With so many enemies after us, if I had taken brother Gu as well, it didn’t matter if escape was impossible, but that brother Gu would’ve been caught up in our fight and die. Brother Gu’s cultivation is also low and I feared the enemy would have no remorse for him. That’s why drew them away as we fought, hoping to give brother Gu the time to flee. Once I threw off their pursuit I came back to find brother Gu wasn’t there. That’s why I rushed back home, hoping to find him safe. If he hadn’t returned, then I would’ve gone back, risking my life to save brother Gu!”
Shangguan Yulin’s vehement speech coupled with his sorry state made for a tragic impression.
Everyone admired him. Zhuo Fan might have even thought him heroic if he didn’t know the truth.
[For crying out loud, is all Shangguan clan filled with high class actors? Then again, I’m not lacking in that department either.]
Zhuo Fan grabbed his hands firmly, touched to the core, “Cousin, I am unable to bear such loyalty from you.”
“Aren’t we brothers?” While Shangguan Yulin was revolted of Zhuo Fan, in front of uncle he had to show his big brother side.
In this case, Zhuo Fan milked it for all its worth, tearing up, “Cousin, I’m just a nobody. How could I be worthy of cousin’s glorious sacrifice and friendship? I can feel my heart beating out of my chest every time I think about it. If cousin had died because of me, I’d deserve death…”
Zhuo Fan looked particularly mournful right about now, driving his point with his snot and tears dripping on Shangguan Yulin’s hands.
Filled with disgust and loathing that could not be expressed with Shangguan Feixiong around, he revealed instead a brilliant smile, “Brother Gu, we are true brothers under oath!”
“Cousin!”
“Brother Gu!”
“Cousin…”
“Brother Gu…”
The two sighed at the touching words, with the father and daughter of Shangguan clan admiring their camaraderie.
Gu Santong, who kept on playing felt his mouth twitch constantly.
[Lookie here, dad got some more simps falling for his act. Then again, this ‘cousin’s shamelessness can challenge dad’s. They’re both shadow emperors.]
He might be a child but had more than three centuries of experience. Then there were the years spent along with Zhuo Fan on top, and Gu Santong could see through any of his acts. He held the play in disdain, though he never said a word, playing on with his toy.
“I’m grateful to know you brothers are so close. But no matter how close you are, you should let go of your hands now. How do you think it’ll look seeing two grown men hold each other and sniveling?”
Shangguan Feixiong found the two’s friendship too strong for his eyes, teasing them about it.
The two beamed and let go.
Shangguan Yulin wanted to let go ages ago. Zhuo Fan had been dripping snot all over them and left him with disgust.
But he was forced to smile through the ordeal.
Shangguan Feixiong nodded, “All that matters is that you’re both safe and sound. Yulin, were you followed when coming back?”
“Don’t worry, uncle, I was careful not to pick a tail.” Shangguan Yulin’s eyes flashed.
Shangguan Feixiong nodded, “I think so too. Yulin, there’s an important job I have to entrust you with.”
[Another one?]
Shangguan Yulin’s eyes looked lost.
First was the devil and now his uncle.
[What’s the world coming to, dumping all its troubles on my head?]
[I’m just too amazing, too strong and too responsible.]
The delusions of grandeur were strong with this one…

chapters.title: Chapter 870: Overreaching
chapters.content:
Chapter 870: Overreaching
Proofreader
: Papatonks
In the dead of night, Shangguan Feixiong brought Shangguan Yulin through the halls towards a plain room. He bowed, “Venerables, I’ve brought him.”
“Enter.”
Shangguan Feixiong nodded at the aged voice and went in with his nephew. There sat the three oldest venerables of the Shangguan clan.
Knowing this was serious, Shangguan Yulin bowed and shivered in excitement.
[Another heavy task is entrusted!]
“Greetings, Venerables!”
“Stand up.”
The elders smiled, but then they looked at him oddly.
[What’s with that swollen face?]
“Feixiong, w-what is this?”
Shangguan Feixiong was embarrassed, but went to whisper in their ears. The trio nodded, “Oh, so he was scouting for the clan and had a bitter fight with the enemy.”
“Exactly, ha-ha-ha…” Shangguan Yulin beamed, “I’d do anything for the clan, come hell or high water!”
The elders eased a breath, “The fight must’ve been truly desperate. Beaten so much that not even his mother would recognize him.”
Shangguan Yulin’s mouth twitched while Shangguan Feixiong chuckled with a shake of his head.
“But they’re all mere flesh wounds, needing a few days to recover, ha-ha-ha…”
But then the elders laughed out, focusing their aged eyes on him, “Shangguan Yulin, you are the best disciple of Shangguan clan, renowned for your cultivation. This time, the clan has a critical and deadly task for you. Do it well and you’ll gain the most merit. Fail and you may die. Will you accept?”
Shangguan Yulin cupped his hands and shouted, “For all the care the Shangguan clan gave me all these years, I will not shy from any danger!”
“Good, you got spunk!”
An elder elaborated the task, “You know by now that the manor is recruiting alchemists. In a few days, it will open its doors for them. We hope you can play as one and sneak in. You will scout the place for us, so that we can make a better plan of attack the second time.”
Shangguan Yulin cried out, “You want me to play the role of an alchemist? B-but I don’t know alchemy…”
“We know that. The Shangguan clan hardly has any such talents. That’s why it can only be you.”
The venerable sighed, “Alchemy combines cultivation, skill and arts to achieve greatness. While we lack in arts, we’ll just have to make up with cultivation and skill. It’s known that a Radiant Stage cultivator can be a 7th grade alchemist, an Ethereal Stage cultivator an 8th grade, a Soul Harmony Stage cultivator a 9th grade and a Genesis Stage cultivation a 10th grade. In this world 11th grade alchemists are the true masters of this art.
“With our skills, we can only make average 9th grade pills, with a rare 10th one. We’re not real alchemists in this sense, let alone outstanding grandmasters. While you, I bet you can’t even reach the 7th grade. But since we lack alchemy arts, we’ll use cultivation. You’re in the Soul Harmony Stage, so we’ll use these days to beat a few secret alchemy arts into you, in hope you reach the 8th grade. Maybe it will be enough to gain you entry into the manor.”
Shangguan Yulin’s brow shook, “You want me to become an 8th grade alchemist in just a few days? No way! I know next to nothing about alchemy. I may have an easy time making some casual pills, but I never tackled anything more complex.”
“Oh, why not have brother Gu go instead. Ain’t he an alchemist?”
Shangguan Yulin proposed. He knew just how deadly it could turn out if he went into the manor. In case he was exposed, his death was certain.
[It’s better to let that punk brave the danger than stay here, humph…]
The people shook their heads, “Yulin, we’ve already taken him in consideration, but he’s not good. Like I told you, a Radiant Stage cultivator can only reach 7th grade in alchemy, with average 8th grade at the most for true grandmasters. The limit is tied to one’s cultivation. The child is in the 5th layer of Radiant Stage, but not at the rank of grandmaster, a good 7th grade alchemist is all. It might’ve worked in the other lands’ tiny nations, but not in the Sword Star Empire.
“He’s also an outsider that has yet to earn our trust. A task so critical can only be handed down to a trusted clansman.”
Shangguan Yulin’s face twitched.
[Damn geezers, you’re saying it’s better for a clansman to die than an outsider?]
[Curses! Why aren’t you old farts going then? Don’t drag me into this!]
Shangguan Yulin frowned and worked hard to find an excuse.
He stuck out his chest and declared, “Venerable sirs, I think your judgment of brother Gu is unfair. Maybe he was dubious before, but today showed he is loyal. He helped me in my search and proved he’s worthy of trust. Right, uncle?”
“Yes, it’s indeed so.”
Shangguan Feixiong nodded, “I was about to tell Venerables, and since Yulin mentioned it, I will do it now. Today, Gu Yifan had not been under our surveillance, but still didn’t betray us. This shows his loyalty. I think holding him and his son confined is no longer needed. We should see them as part of the Shangguan clan. And from what we saw today, he has quite the valor, fitting the nature of the Shangguan clan.”
The venerables looked at him long then nodded, “Feixiong, we’ll trust your judgment. But this task of infiltrating the manor…”
“Venerables, please give brother Gu a chance. He’s working hard to join our clan.”
Shangguan Yulin cupped his hands and urged.
Shangguan Feixiong nodded, touched by the two’s camaraderie.
[Though why did this happen after a single trip together?]
[Is it growing close through suffering? Has to be.]
Shangguan Feixiong added, “Venerables, Gu Yifan is a true alchemist. Even if he’s in 7th grade, he’s still a gem. He might even get into the manor. I believe casting a wider net will work in our favor. Why not have them both go? It will be the same as long as any one of them enters.”
Clueless that Shangguan Yulin wanted to throw Zhuo Fan to the wolves.
“Should we… let the outsider try as well?”
The venerables sank in thought.
Shangguan Yulin nodded and Shangguan Yulin rushed to add, “Yes, you must give brother Gu a chance, he-he-he…”
“But leaving it to an outsider makes us uneasy.”
The venerables looked worried, “He may go, but someone must keep an eye on him for any mishaps and dangers.”
Shangguan Yulin beamed, “Not a problem. As long as we treat brother Gu as family, giving him the chance to prove himself, all will be fine, ha-ha-ha…”
“Although we’ll have Yifan do something for us, we’ll also send someone to watch him. This might lower his opinion of us.”
Shangguan Feixiong frowned, “I have seen the kid’s character today. While he likes to mess around, his heart is good. And this is how we treat him?”
“Feixiong, a man of ambition doesn’t mind trifles!”
“Yeah, uncle, brother Gu won’t mind it.”
Shangguan Yulin and the venerables urged Shangguan Feixiong, who felt ashamed still, “Maybe, but he will definitely be against having some stranger with him. It will alienate him. Why not let Yan’er go? She’ll observe him under the guise of support. They’re also familiar to each other so he won’t mind.”
“What, cousin?! No, no…” Shangguan Yulin waved his hands around.
“Yes, that’s what we’ll do. Yan’er is the best choice.”
“Feixiong, you’re really thorough. We’ll go with your plan.”
“All of us are in agreement!”
Ignoring Shangguan Yulin’s outburst, the elders nodded, putting an end to this discussion, having disregarded him completely.
While the four laughed, their minds made up. Zhuo Fan, the second candidate, was going to sneak into the manor with Yan’er as his helper and watcher.
Shangguan Yulin was dumbstruck.
[What have I done? Did I just hand my cousin to that punk?]
That was not his intention at all. He had overreached himself.
Pa!
Shangguan Yulin slapped himself hard. The four gave him a look, “What’s wrong?”
“Nothing, just a… toothache…”

chapters.title: Chapter 871: Pill King Convention
chapters.content:
Chapter 871: Pill King Convention
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“You want me to join the Flying Cloud manor’s alchemy screening and sneak in?”
At the crack of dawn, Shangguan Feixiong was seeing Zhuo Fan and Shangguan Qingyan in the parlor with a bright smile. Zhuo Fan was stunned, then nodded.
It fit his plan of wanting to test the waters as well after hearing this announcement.
Putting it off until Flying Cloud manor and Shangguan clan faced off would leave too much room for error, something he wished to avoid.
And this proved to be his best chance to do it while also entering Shangguan clan’s good graces.
Zhuo Fan cupped his hands without delay, agreeing with a smile, “Doing my part for the Shangguan clan, after the clan took us both in, is an utmost honor. Thank you, uncle, for giving us this chance.”
“As long as you know.”
Shangguan Feixiong smiled, “I’m sure you know that my decision of taking you in hasn’t been met well by other members. But if you do this well, you’ll prove yourself in front of everyone. No one will question you again. “
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone.
Shangguan Qingyan giggled, “Sir Gu, work hard. Whether you stand with Shangguan clan will depend on this task. Maybe you’ll even earn everyone’s approval and become a true young master of our clan. You might even get the chance to get back your wife. It won’t matter who you offended in western lands when the Shangguan clan has your back. You’ll finally be together!”
Zhuo Fan gave him a long look, but seeing her clear eyes, he returned a smile.
[Oh, I see. I was wondering why this missie cared so much for me and my son. I wrote it off as being my immense charm’s fault.]
[Who knew she wanted to get me and my wife together again. How kind. A shame it’s not that simple…]
With a dimmed gaze, Zhuo Fan shook his head.
“Even if you become one of us, you can’t go on a rampage.”
Shangguan Feixiong glared at his daughter. But then he smiled at Zhuo Fan, “Don’t worry, Shangguan clan is no pushover. Do this well and I will definitely help you out. Even if Double Dragon Manor is involved, I’ll give you justice!”
“Thank you so much, uncle!” Zhuo Fan bowed.
[Double Dragon Manor… if it were that easy, I’d have done it myself…]
“Yan’er, we planned on sending Yulin with Yifan at the competition.”
Shangguan Qingyan continued, “Yulin is a steady man and can take charge. Yifan’s cultivation is low so you will have to assist him in making sure he’s selected. Got it?”
Shangguan Qingyan gave a firm nod with a happy look, “Yes, father.”
“He-he-he, Sir Gu, you better listen to me now.” She gave Zhuo Fan a teasing smile.
Zhuo Fan chuckled as well, but he saw through Shangguan Feixiong’s plan on having her spy on him.
[Yesterday’s play wasn’t enough to remove all doubts of the clan.]
Which was normal, especially with such an important task. Caution was paramount.
Zhuo Fan and Shangguan Feixiong exchanged a few more words before he left with a bow. Shangguan Qingyan skipped behind him.
The next few days, Shangguan Yulin and Zhuo Fan went through a personal hell.
Shangguan Yulin, being the most promising seed, was instructed personally by the three venerables in the intricate arts of cooking herbs into pills. Day in, day out, he was found hovering over the cauldron, soaked in its fumes, instructed in the fine arts the elders were hardly familiar with. That was because Shangguan Yulin had the cultivation but not the skills. Thus the elders went harder on him, in hope his skill improved faster.
On the other hand, Zhuo Fan’s days were paradise by comparison.
Everyone knew him as an alchemist, so that was that. That was why he was left to his own devices.
All he had to make up for was cultivation.
But cultivation wasn’t to be rushed either. Which made this backup, Shangguan Yulin’s replacement, disregarded in this aspect.
With the confinement ending, Zhuo Fan was out in the world again, with his son. With Clan Head’s daughter leading along, he was the envy of anyone as he enjoyed himself.
Shangguan Qingyan’s role was the observer, but young Sanzi’s infectious playful nature got the best of her, making her grow closer and closer to the pair.
It went as far as going in the back of the house to have a blast with them. This only worked to sour Shangguan Yulin’s mood, being wiped like a donkey over the cauldron by the elders.
“Ha-ha-ha, young Sanzi, loosen your hand a bit or your kite’s going to fall. Yes, that’s it…”
“Auntie, hold it while I get a fruit.”
“Sure… hey, Gu Yifan, stop being lazy! You should be the one to hold your son’s kite…”
“Young Sanzi gave it to you, so you guys play with it. Now stop messing up my nap, stingy!”
“Hey, whose son is young Sanzi anyway? What kind of father doesn’t care…”
“Then you care instead.”
“Wretched brat…”
Banter and teasing was heard from beyond the walls. Shangguan Yulin sat cross-legged near a cauldron over a scorching fire, his mouth constantly twitching, his eyes burning hotter than the fire before him.
[Damn that accursed punk! I warned him to stay away from her! Now he’s flirting instead? Once I get out of here, I’ll throttle you…]
“Calm your heart and focus. The gestures are the key as you employ the art.”
Noticing Shangguan Yulin’s attention was slipping, a bamboo scroll smacked him over the head, making him wince. He looked at the venerable standing behind him with a cold gaze, “Calm your heart and focus on the gestures…”
[Screw you! My cousin is out there with that degenerate pair and you’re telling me to frickin’ calm down?]
Pa!
Another smack came on point, “Empty your mind, calm your heart. Your thoughts should only be on the gestures.”
Face twitching, Shangguan Yulin’s heart was grumbling as he nodded.
He got himself to blame for this mess.
[I get you wanting me to go into the manor, but why the hell is that bastard coming too?]
[Now look at him! Even before we reach it, I’m in hell, wasting my time with alchemy while you guys are giggling so hard, afraid I won’t hear you.]
[This is torture!]
[Heavens above, mother earth below, what did I ever do to deserve this? Why are you so cruel to me? ]
[Gu Yifan, this isn’t over, not by a long shot. Once we’re done with the manor, I’ll make sure you’re dead!]
Pa!
The smacking came on point, as did the warning, “Calm your heart…”
Flinching, Shangguan Yulin grumbled some more…
A week passed like this, with Zhuo Fan and Shangguan Yulin enjoying their special and contradictory training. What they had in common was the annoyance with it.
What Shangguan Yulin saw as hell in the pungent herbs boiling their noxious fumes in his face, Zhuo Fan saw it as relaxation. He was most happy to switch places.
It should be Zhuo Fan the main with Shangguan Yulin as backup in this scenario.
However, the bitter days finally ran out as Zhuo Fan returned home at noon with Shangguan Qingyan and Gu Santong. But they were far from relaxed.
“Dad, the manor made another announcement. Three days later, it will hold the Pill King Convention to select true alchemists to heal the Crown Prince in the imperial capital.”
Rushing into the parlor, Shangguan Qingyan made her report.
Jumping to his feet, Shangguan Feixiong’s eyes shone, shouting, “Since they mentioned the alchemist selection, the security eased up, the patrols eased, and people swarmed this city. The day finally came. In three days, we move, ha-ha-ha…”
Shangguan Feixiong walked behind the house, “I’ll inform the venerables.”
Shangguan Qingyan beamed and nodded, “Gu Yifan, your moment is near. Don’t mess it up. While a backup…”
“No worries, I won’t.” Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed.
Shangguan Qingyan nodded, rushing after her dad.
Gu Santong muttered, “Dad, is it a trap.”
“Definitely.” Zhuo Fan grinned.
“But Shangguan clan’s spies in the central area have reported for the last few days that the Crown Prince is indeed hurt badly. Won’t…”
Zhuo Fan patted his head, “It’s too strange of an event. Not about the number of reports confirming it, but the timing is what reveals it being a trap.”
“Yet they’re still going. Don’t they know this?”
“People always believe what they want to believe.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Knowing it’s a trap, the fact that they make all kinds of plans around it, they don’t see it as one, but an opportunity. Such is the mentality of men, greedy. There’s no way opportunity lies at every corner, ha-ha-ha. Though this trap is clever, what’s truly ingenious is that it fits the Shangguan clan’s character. Flying Cloud manor has a cunning mind among them.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone coldly, “I’ll have to watch my step in the manor as well…”

chapters.title: Chapter 872: Gathering at the Manor
chapters.content:
Chapter 872: Gathering at the Manor
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“If it isn’t Grandmaster Zhang! You’ve also come to join the bustle, sir?”
“What do you think? With such a rare chance of shooting for the moon, I’m not one to pass it up. Are you any different, Sir Li? You must want to get a post in the imperial family with this, right?”
“Please, I don’t hold such high hopes. I’m only here to enjoy the occasion, ha-ha-ha…”
Bright and early, as the rooster crowed, Flying Cloud manor entrance was packed with a huge crowd, alchemists drawn in by the rumors.
As far as skills went, only some were real alchemists who came here to seize their chance.
The people laughed, joked, teased, greeted, yet what all had in common was their reserved stance. They were ready to sweep the opposition.
While warm smiles were everywhere, they were each wise enough to know the cruelty hidden within. They were rivals!
At long last, Zhuo Fan and Shangguan Qingyan arrived as well among this sea of hypocrites.
“Miss, are you an alchemist too? How rare.”
Shangguan Qingyan got quite a few curious glances, when they were actually trying to get some info out of her. “Alchemy is filled with fumes and toil, hardly an interest to women. I’m truly amazed you are an alchemist, miss.”
Shangguan Qingyan shook her head, pointing at Zhuo Fan, “You misunderstood, brother, it’s my elder brother who’s an alchemist. I’m only here to keep him company.”
“Oh, he is?”
The man turned his attention to Zhuo Fan, giving off a smile of contempt, “So brother is an alchemist coming to participate in the Pill King Convention. Greetings. Oh, there’s an old friend of mine. Better say hi. Let’s meet again.”
The man quickly left the two, being all friendly to another group, “Ha-ha-ha, one look told me you’re all seasoned alchemists. May I know from where…”
“Er…”
Shangguan Qingyan was taken aback then glanced at Zhuo Fan, “Who is he? He looks friendly yet bolts after a few words.”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “He’s being nice to you, figuring you’d be a strong contender if you were an alchemist coupled with your cultivation. He was only assessing the competition. As a result, he saw me, in the Radiant Stage, as the only one to participate and was happy. Since alchemy skill is tied to cultivation as well.”
“He’s mocking you then?”
Shangguan Qingyan cursed, “What a snob! You may be weak, you may be average in alchemy, but you’ve come to join the grand Pill King Convention as an alchemist. Much better than those fakers coming fighting for scraps. I never liked their type!”
Ugh!
Staggering, Zhuo Fan’s heart fell, “Sister, they might look down on me, but at least you should appreciate me. Why are you calling me weak and average in alchemy? Don’t you know you’re bruising my ego?”
“Oh, sorry, I was just trying to help you out.”
Shangguan Qingyan beamed as she apologized, “I got too excited and didn’t mean it like that. Moreover, I’m stating facts, as a 5th layer Radiant Stage cultivator, just how great of an alchemist can you be? If you were entrusted with such a heavy task, why then did dad force cousin to go through alchemy the past week?”
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched hard and almost spat blood, “Sister, I beg of you, never try to take one’s side again. I have great tolerance and can take it, but others would fly into a rage by now. You’re not helping me here, but the other!”
“Isn’t it all because of you two?”
Shangguan Qingyan blushed and glared at him with a pout, “Hanging out with the two of you every day, my mind’s jumbled up and don’t even know what I’m saying anymore. Yesterday, cousin failed in making an 8th grade pill and father was concerned if he would pass the selection. I tried soothing cousin but he took my kind words the wrong way and almost blew a gasket…”
Pff…
Zhuo Fan almost laughed out loud. Shangguan Qingyan was flabbergast, beating his spin in embarrassment, “What are you laughing at? It’s all your fault for teaching me this!”
“I didn’t teach you anything. You’re just a natural when it comes to cutting someone down to size, ha-ha-ha…”
“Don’t laugh!” The light punches kept coming, with Shangguan Qingyan looking distraught, “My Shangguan clan is one of virtue. The only reason I became like this is because I spent too much time around you. It’s all your fault. Can’t you be more gentleman-like? All the time you only know how to talk back and mock, ruining your son and even a lady like me…”
“Don’t blame me. Who told you to stick around every day…”
“No, it’s all on you!”
The two argued in front of everyone, having fun regardless of the audience. Only one pair of eyes watched them with hatred and fury.
It was none other than Shangguan Yulin.
To not cast any doubts on them, the Shangguan clan planned for Shangguan Yulin and Zhuo Fan to act like strangers. Zhuo Fan was registered in Flying Cloud City, so nothing he did was eye catching.
While Shangguan Yulin had to be subtle about it before falling back, faking that he was like everyone else, attracted by the Pill King Convention.
This way, with one egg in another basket, the chances of failure dropped. At the very least, if Shangguan Yulin was found out, there was still Zhuo Fan safe, making the Gu household safe in turn.
Shangguan clan’s plan was ingenious, just that they omitted this young master’s mood. Watching the two having fun, Shangguan Yulin was about to explode, with veins popping on his hands.
“Oh, is brother an alchemist? A Soul Harmony Stage cultivator too.”
A most unfriendly voice sounded, from the same man who probed the others before, showing his fake smile, “Brother’s alchemy must be amazing, in the 9th grade I bet. May I ask from where…”
Shangguan Yulin spat, “Buzz off!”
“What did you say, brother?”
His anger made the words somewhat unrecognizable, and the new guy asked again despite the danger he was in.
Squinting, Shangguan Yulin showed a nasty grin, “Do you want to know my master? Humph, he is the most amazing man in the central area that everyone knows. But I can’t say it here, let’s go somewhere quiet and I’ll tell you.”
Shangguan Yulin walked to a corner and was gone.
The man was excited as he followed.
But just as he made a turn, his mouth was covered. What followed was an endless string of dull sounds as punches rained down on the hapless fool.
An hour later, Shangguan Yulin came out in the light looking refreshed and smiling, “Ah, much better.”
He went back to mingling, with a faint groan coming from behind.
“W-why…”
A bloody hand stretched out of the corner, before slumping down and slowly crawling out was an unrecognizable man into the light. He cursed, “What the frickin’ hell? We were just talking. Why the violence? What did I ever do to you? I didn’t kill your father, nor steal your wife. Sob~”
How was he to know that the man he accosted had indeed had his girl taken. Just that he couldn’t vent on the culprit and had him be the target instead since it just so happened he was the wrong guy at just the right time.
It was just now his day for this unfortunate soul.
Wiping the blood from his nose, he gnashed his teeth, “Curses, wait till I’ll tell on you!”
With a creak, the manor gate opened and a Soul Harmony Stage guard stepped out and cupped his hands to announce, “Alchemists, the lord welcomes you!”
He turned around and led the way in.
The crowd followed excitedly, eyes brimming with hope. They felt glory was just around the corner…

chapters.title: Chapter 873: Wronged Agent
chapters.content:
Chapter 873: Wronged Agent
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Prime Minister, lords, that guy is a Shangguan clan spy, no doubt about it!”
In a lavish and grand hall, three figures sat in front. On the left, Prime Minister Baili Jingwei, in center, Shangguan Feiyun, and on the right, Dragon Cleaving Sword King, Danqing Shen.
The three looked calm, their eyes lowered at the bloody mass below.
The man wore a victimized look, his hand constantly wiping his bloody nose as he recounted, “Sirs, you must believe me. He is most definitely a spy Shangguan clan sent into Flying Cloud manor.”
Glancing at him, Baili Jingwei had a faint smile, “Is the Shangguan clan ever brutal? Are they that cocky to think they can get away with doing something so conspicuous?”
“Yeah, I, for one, would keep my nose down in another’s home. Avoid trouble like the plague and not go around beating people.”
Danqing Shen covered his teacup with the most mocking smile.
Baili Jingwei smiled, turning a deep gaze on the victim. His tone was anything but kind, “Try to repeat that. Just tell me again that he’s related to the Shangguan clan.”
“Uhm, well…” His eyes darted all over as he spluttered.
Bam!
Baili Jingwei slammed the table, “I had you sent out there to scout for information, to be the first outpost. It’s to gather information not to let it go to your head and get revenge!”
“Yeah, an undercover agent is to blend in just like a spy would.”
Sighing, Danqing Shen mocked, “But I guess with how the guards are always conceited, they have a hard time staying unknown, ha-ha-ha…”
The victim looked hurt by that remark and hurriedly explained, “Sirs, Prime Minister, I have been keeping a low profile.”
“Then why are you here like this, a bloody pulp?” Shangguan Feiyun barked, pointing at his nose.
The man’s mouth quivered.
[Why was I beaten black and blue anyway? I was only talking to him.]
Baili Jingwei shook his head and muttered, “There are no true coincidences in the world. Everything has a reason. Why is it that of all the quiet alchemists at our gates, only you stand out? And the other left you breathing as well. This shows he didn’t find you out as being an agent. Being exposed would definitely have gotten you killed by the Shangguan clan.
“Yet this didn’t happen, only suffering some bruising. Now you’re coming here and tell us he’s from the Shangguan clan? Ha-ha-ha, you take us for fools? You think Flying Cloud manor is your backyard to do as you please?”
“No no no. I’d never, never!” The man panicked and shivered in fear.
Baili Jingwei mocked, “Then I’ll ask you again. Is that man really from the Shangguan clan?”
“Uhm, well…” His heart fell, his body shook, and words came hard.
Having it all figured out, Baili Jingwei ignored him and turned an angry stare at Shangguan Feiyun, “Sword King Feiyun, he’s your man. I was only borrowing him for something but now he even refused to take responsibility for his own mess. I just don’t know how to deal with him. Though one might ask, if sir’s agents are all so outrageous and abuse their status, I can only wonder, are your ears capable of hearing the truth? Can a Sword King who doesn’t know his own domain safeguard…”
“Ha-ha-ha, I won’t say it. I’m just an outsider, while here is Sword King Feiyun’s world. I shouldn’t meddle. Oh, the Pill King Convention is about to start. I’ll play the host in sir’s place, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Jingwei waved his hand and left with his guards, leaving an indifferent Danqing Shen, a shivering and bloody agent, and a furious Shangguan Feiyun.
Knuckles cracked as Shangguan Feiyun clenched his fist, staring at the writhing mess below, “Answer the question. Is he part of the Shangguan clan? Or are you just trying to get back at him for the beating?”
“L-lord, h-he’s suspicious.”
Bam!
The agent cowered, blabbering, and Shangguan Feiyun flicked his hand. The bloody mess now turned into a bloody mist, with the soul destroyed as well.
Shangguan Feiyun’s brow shook, his teeth clenched, “These damn arrogant fools lord around the streets daily, but the least they can do is not shame me in front of Baili Jingwei!”
“Brother Feiyun, easy. Baili Jingwei is the Prime Minister, and it won’t be easy to fool him.” Danqing Shen patted his shoulder.
Annoyed, Shangguan Feiyun flicked his hand and spat, “Who the hell is fooling who here? It’s all these morons’ fault for not playing their part…”
“Hey, that can be taken different ways!”
Shangguan Feiyun reacted, glowering at Danqing Shen, “You mean to tell me these men fooled me till now, only getting exposed now Baili Jingwei came?”
Danqing Shen beamed and waved his hand, “This definitely isn’t from just yesterday. Since today they used your name for revenge, it goes to show you handle them poorly. In fact, Baili Jingwei knocking you down a peg came at the right time for…”
“Whatever, it’s none of my business anyway. Ha-ha-ha, by the way, I hear you have quite the wine collection in the cellar. Hope you won’t mind, ha-ha-ha… “
Danqing Shen waved his hand at Shangguan Feiyun’s dark look, slipping away while leaving those snide remarks to pierce the host’s ears.
Shangguan Feiyun gnashed his teeth, “For god’s sake, these bastards made a fool of me. Even Danqing Shen dares to mock me now. Humph, I’ll be sure to cleanup the manor once this is all over with…”
Shangguan Feiyun’s eyes flashed.
Yet all were clueless that this agent was a wronged agent. He really did find the Shangguan clan’s spy, though by chance, by becoming the other’s punching bag.
Yet his suffering did not go rewarded. Then again, he was doing it for his own selfish reasons too.
At the end of it all, the fact remained, heaven gave him a shortcut to success, though brutal, his bosses were too smart for their own good, not believing a word. Man proposes, god disposes. A saying held true now more than ever.
Luck was not to be neglected…
Meanwhile, in the garden behind Flying Cloud manor, the crowd gathered around a stone stage. A rough glance saw close to a thousand heads.
Being brought here yet told nothing on the way, the people formed little groups, talking to each other and picking on the other’s faults.
“Hey, look there, it’s Xue clan’s elder, Xue Dingxian. I heard the rare 9th grade alchemist is on the cusp of reaching 10th grade.”
“That’s him? He had placed in the top twenty of the last Pill King Competition held at the imperial capital. Coming here, he’s sure to come out on top.”
“No no, not if you consider him!”
Someone recognized with shock the candidate of another competition while another shook his head in disdain, pointing at an old man in white, “That right there is Divine Pill Meng Feitian, in the top ten of the last Pill King Competition!”
“I thought the top ten would be given a post in the imperial capital. What’s he doing here, stealing our bread?”
“Heh, who knows. These old coots are all weirdos. Who knows what craziness is going on in that head of theirs? They got their fame last time and now they came here for some more.” The man looked puzzled as well.
The others felt their hearts sink.
Having no clue how many spots were for the imperial capital, they were afraid that with such tight competition, they wouldn’t make the cut.
All they could do was mock others and make themselves feel good.
The two seeded candidates finally bumped heads and were looking at each other with fire in their eyes.
“Old Xue, you’re here as well?”
“Humph, Sword King Feiyun controls these parts. My Xue clan is the best in alchemy for thousands of miles. If I didn’t show up, calling it the Pill King Convention would be an overstatement.”
“Ha-ha-ha, what a mouth on you. In the last competition at the imperial capital, you placed five spots behind me, yet now you show off in my face? Xue Dingxian you have no shame. Ha-ha-ha…” Meng Feitian looked smug.
Xue Dingxian’s lips twitched in anger, “Meng Feitian, time changes everything. Especially when the last competition was a decade ago. We’ll just see whose skills are the best soon enough!”
“Ha-ha-ha, then I can only oblige you and have you taste the bitter flavor of defeat once more.” Meng Feitian laughed…

chapters.title: Chapter 874: Elimination
chapters.content:
Chapter 874: Elimination
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Xue Dingxian was fuming, his hands shaky, his face all red.
Baili Jingwei just arrived to see the petty Meng Feitian and held his head, “Wasn’t he supposed to have a post in the imperial family’s alchemy department? What’s he doing here?”
“Prime Minister sir, after hearing the Sword Star Empire is selecting alchemists from every corner, Sir Meng resigned his post in the imperial capital and came to join. He said he wanted to start all over again.” A guard chuckled.
Sighing, Baili Jingwei shook his head, “These crotchety geezers are nothing but weirdos. He was doing just fine in the imperial capital, so why the hell would he quit it all just to go back to it all over again? God knows what’s cooking in that brain of his.”
Baili Jingwei looked around and walked over to Meng Feitian with cupped hands, “Old Meng, it’s been a while.”
“Hm? Oh, there’s someone else who knows me? You won’t get far sticking close to me, boy.”
Meng Feitian frowned, but as he turned, he shivered, “S-sir Baili…”
Signaling to keep quiet, Baili Jingwei laughed, leaning on him, “Old Meng, the last time we saw each other in the imperial capital. How have you been lately?”
“Thank you, Prime, uh, young master for your concern. I’ve been doing very well, ha-ha-ha…”
Wiping his brow, Meng Feitian’s smile was strained. Xue Dingxian gave him a funny look.
[What’s with the usual smug Meng Feitian looking so scared all of a sudden? A look at this youth and he has him shaking in his boots.]
He scanned Baili Jingwei with quizzical eyes.
“Old Meng, I heard you’ve done well for yourself in the imperial capital. Why leave and come here? Didn’t you earn your place in the imperial family?”
Baili Jingwei’s eyes flashed as he patted Meng Feitian’s shoulder, questioning him.
Shuddering, Meng Feitian was put on the spot, “He-he-he, I’ll be honest. Since the Crown Prince suffered an incident, he’s been isolated and no alchemist in the imperial family was allowed to check on him. We were baffled. When we heard alchemists were being selected across the empire, we thought we were inadequate. So I resigned stubbornly to come here and prove once again my value and not let others pass me.”
“Oh, really?”
Baili Jingwei raised a mocking eyebrow, “Why then all the way to Sword King Feiyun’s place? Of the nine domains, you oughtn’t be here.”
Meng Feitian’s face twitched, staying silent.
Xue Dingxian stepped closer, explaining, “Young master, this coot wants to compete with me. He and I have been studying under the same master, always competing, always excelling. But in the last competition in the imperial capital, he got five spots ahead of me, entering the imperial family while I failed. Despite the regret, I had no choice but to accept it. Once more, this rare occasion presents itself and I joined with high hopes, but who ever thought this eyesore would show up and ruin things. But he’ll be sorely disappointed if he thinks this will be a repeat of last time.”
“As if, this win will be mine again!” Meng Feitian was annoyed, flaring his nose.
Baili Jingwei got the gist of it.
[Two rivals testing their mettle.]
The fact remained, for Meng to resign from the imperial capital showed just how much he cared about his rival.
Baili Jingwei patted Xue Dingxian’s shoulder in encouragement, “Oh, a fellow brother of Old Meng, and only five spots shy of him in alchemy. Senior must be a true grandmaster then. A shame the last competition ended like that, but this time will be different. I hope you will both strive hard for the empire. That’s all I want, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Jingwei left with a smile.
Xue Dingxian looked at Meng Feitian with a skeptical look, “Old man, who exactly was that youth?”
“What do you mean who? You’ll know once you enter the imperial capital.”
Meng Feitian gave him a look and said, “Since a man of his greatness does not want to reveal himself, I can only oblige. And so should you.”
Xue Dingxian’s face fell and mocked, “What greatness? Look at you, knowing all the secrets of the empire. But isn’t it just being a royal alchemist? If you lose to me this time, that spot will be mine.”
“He-he-he, when pigs fly!” Meng Feitian mocked.
Baili Jingwei walked before the crowd, with guards converging from around to protect him.
The clamor stopped then and there, with all eyes on the youth. Zhuo Fan was watching him too, his eyes shaking.
[He feels… oddly familiar…]
Stepping on stage, Baili Jingwei waved his hand for them to settle down, “Alchemists coming here from every corner of the central area, I’m gratified for your devotion to His Majesty, your desire to help the Crown Prince in time of need, and efforts for the empire. I shall be presiding over the alchemist selection at the Flying Cloud manor!”
The people started whispering, looking lost.
[Who is this kid? Isn’t the Pill King Convention important? Shouldn’t there be someone with more renown leading it? Why is this kid here instead? What about Sword King Feiyun?]
Baili Jingwei easily read their minds, “The Pill King Convention has three rounds to select the best ten alchemists to go to the imperial capital and heal His Highness. The preliminary and second rounds shall be overseen by me, while the last will be presided by the Sword King in person. A man of Sword King’s renown will only meet those worthy of his time.”
That set the crowd aboil.
It wasn’t just about the Pill King Convention here, but about their worth. If they couldn’t reach the last round, they would be seen as nothing, unworthy of the Sword King’s attention?
Many of the ambitious candidates had a fire lit under them.
Baili Jingwei approved. By getting all worked up, it would force Shangguan clan’s spy to stand out.
Baili Jingwei’s eyes flashed as he smiled. He waved and a thousand guards carried trays to the alchemists, with a simple storage ring on it.
“What? So many precious ingredients, rare treasures and even ingredients for a 10th grade pill!” The people scanned the rings and cried out.
The crowd once again stirred in excitement. Many of the alchemists here were dirt poor. It would’ve been a miracle if they ever got their hands on a 10th grade ingredient, let alone the pill.
They got to touch such precious ingredients in this Pill King Convention. Their lives were complete.
Baili Jingwei watched them with a grin, pointing out alchemists to his guards, “Kick them out!”
“Yes, sir!”
The guards moved with purpose, hoisting the alchemists like some chickens and dragging them outside the manor.
The people were indignant, to say the least, “What’s going on? Why are you throwing us out?”
“You’ve been eliminated.” Baili Jingwei smiled.
The men complained, “Why? We haven’t even started refining so why kick us out?”
“Alchemy needs a calm mind. If you can’t even control your joy from seeing 10th grade ingredients, it only shows you’re not great alchemists.” Baili Jingwei disdained.
The men kicked out naturally responded in a bout of rage, “Screw you! We’re just poor alchemists, not like you, in the lord’s employ. Who wouldn’t be excited to see such great ingredients? I won’t accept your rule…”
Baili Jingwei shook his head.
The crowd whispered. The Pill King Convention turned out to be harsher than they realized, even involving an alchemist’s joy.
“Wow, it’s my first time being at such a tense competition.”
Shangguan Qingyan smacked her lips.
Zhuo Fan nodded with a smile. But looking back at Baili Jingwei on stage, he turned grave.
It might look like it was out of requirement of an alchemist, but what Baili Jingwei did was eliminate the ones less likely to be Shangguan clan spies.
Shangguan clan was the best clan in eastern lands. No way they would bat an eyelid in front of some meager 10th grade ingredient.
So while it looked to be selecting alchemists, it was more to filter Shangguan clan spies.
[I just knew the Pill King Convention was a trap.]
“Now I know why I found him familiar. He’s just like Zhuge Changfeng.” Wearing a crooked smile, Zhuo Fan shook his head.
[The kid is something alright…]

chapters.title: Chapter 875: Preliminary Round
chapters.content:
Chapter 875: Preliminary Round
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Of the thousand plus candidates, a mere third remained, most of which were seasoned in deception. As for the rest, they looked at each other stumped, grumbling to themselves.
[What kind of preliminary round is this?]
Baili Jingwei’s eyes flashed, “Now that the extras are out of the way, we can start the preliminary round!”
Everyone chilled, having lost their early disregard of this youth. It never crossed their mind the alchemist selection would be so cruel. It hadn’t even started and only a third was left…
“The goal of this round is to refine a 7th grade pill.”
Seeing them so tense, Baili Jingwei wore a playful smirk, “You’ve received the ingredient, now refine!”
Ugh!
Everyone was taken aback, with one scrounging up the nerve to open his mouth, “Uhm, sir, is that all we have to do in the preliminary round, refine a 7th grade pill? What about speed, quality or features?”
The people waited for Baili Jingwei’s answer.
With how harsh the alchemist selection started, the preliminaries had to be even crueler. One extra condition, at the least.
[There’s no way it’s as simple as a 7th grade pill.]
“There are no hidden targets. All you have to do is make a 7th grade pill.” Baili Jingwei had a wide grin on his face.
The candidates were still skeptical.
[Is it that simple? Most of us here can do it.]
The crowd was tittering from indecision, considering what they were after in the end.
“Don’t just stand there, hurry up and start!”
Baili Jingwei saw them with that dumb look and urged them. He was better off not saying anything as now everyone’s eyes shone, having figured out the aim of the test.
Speed!
All now wore knowing smiles. They heard him loud and clear ‘hurry up and start.’
The candidates ignited their flame and started refining with a smug grin.
[I’m so smart, getting sir’s condition so fast, ha-ha-ha…]
But as everyone raced to the finish, problems cropped up. The flames differed, some were heaven and earth spirit flames, others beast flames, and even the poorest, Yuan Qi flames.
The most basic flame, that of Yuan Qi, was feeling the pressure of the other two types, so much so it was hard for it to even light up.
[Curses, this is the worst fear of any alchemist in a competition, getting your flame snuffed out. How am I supposed to refine when it won’t even burn?]
They’d have to wait till the others finished. But with speed being the crux in this round.
[Dude, while others finish the race, I’m just running in place.]
That had the group of average alchemists with the most plain flame growing frantic by the second. They looked around with tense faces as the others showed off their precious otherworldly flames and the clear contempt in their eyes.
Shangguan Yulin now took out his faint blue flame, releasing its own mighty aura, that of a rare heaven and earth spirit flame.
It was what the three venerables had prepared especially for this Pill King Convention.
With this wonder flame, coupled with his high cultivation and week of hell, he ought to barely make an 8th grade pill.
Grinning, Shangguan Yulin glanced at his precious heaven and earth spirit flame then looked at the far Zhuo Fan in disdain.
He reckoned Zhuo Fan was just a 5th layer Radiant Stage nobody, chased out of his home land. What could he possibly amount to?
[A Yuan Qi flame tops.]
With so many promising candidates in the Pill King Convention, Yuan Qi flame was like a bug, trampled around by the other ones.
[What can you do now?]
[The punk must be panicking right about now, crying for his mommy, humph…]
Shangguan Yulin was relishing in his delusion of Zhuo Fan’s predicament. But then his eyes glazed over from shock.
He wasn’t the only one, as many around Zhuo Fan were dumbstruck.
Hu~
A surge of a scarlet flame, ten meters high, burned hot as the sun. Zhuo Fan looked at the towering blaze with a flat look.
While all around him were bugeyed, unable to get over their shock. Shangguan Qingyan was even more so, “G-Gu, your flame…”
“Yuan Qi flame, why?” Glancing at her, Zhuo Fan spoke lazily, leaving her dull and the others with twitching faces.
[Are you bloody kidding here?]
Shangguan Qingyan gasped, “I know that, but why is it the only one unaffected by the many beast flames and heaven and earth spirit flames? “
Everyone strained their ears to catch every word.
Zhuo Fan looked around then said, “I have better control. I’m sure you know that flame control is crucial to an alchemist.”
Bang~
Something just kept on falling in the background while Shangguan Qingyan merely staggered as she said in disbelief, “What alchemist here doesn’t have control? But look at their Yuan Qi flame, it’s not even out. So how is it that yours is so lively?”
The candidates had hopeful looks, wishing to know the secret. As alchemists, they all wanted to improve their skills.
“This is different.”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, putting on the most grave look he mustered as he ran his mouth and weaved inanity, “A fire has spirit, making it so a high grade fire would suppress a lower one. But people have spirit as well, just of different character from a flame’s and aren’t affected by higher grade flames. This is where the problem lies. If a flame spirit joins with a human’s, would it still be suppressed?”
The people gapped in shock. They never heard of this theory in their lives. Wasn’t fire fire and man man? How could they join?
Zhuo Fan smiled, “This is where your control lacks. If fire is fire and man is man, how can your control excel? I’m different, I reached that stage where I’m one with the flame. It is an extension of me, going where I want with a thought. I fear no higher grade flame and my Yuan Qi flame doesn’t by relation. This is the pinnacle of flame control!”
“Oh, I see, brother is a true genius. I’m in awe of your skill in control!”
“Brother is only in the Radiant Stage, but your skills are a marvel. Brother must’ve been focused on alchemy so much you forwent cultivation. Or you’d be in a much higher stage, brimming with power. I truly admire brother’s perseverance in alchemy.”
“Yes, we thought we knew enough about alchemy and came to the Pill King Convention. Now we witnessed brother’s amazing skill. It would be such a shame to fail because of your low cultivation. But from brother’s diligent focus, we’re sure that brother will one day soar. Your name will be known throughout!”
“Hear hear, ha-ha-ha…”
Claps resounded from all around Zhuo Fan. Shangguan Qingyan was looking at him with bright eyes and a wide smile.
Only Shangguan Yulin was seething in anger.
He never thought Zhuo Fan was so skilled, to make a Yuan Qi flame reach such heights. It was the miracle of a true underdog in making others look inadequate.
Even he had to admit Zhuo Fan’s control was out of this world, crushing the experts’ reality.
Totally unaware that Zhuo Fan’s so-called fancy control didn’t exist to begin with. It was a hoax.
His Yuan Qi flame stood taller than the rest because of the three mighty flames he had. Control had nothing to do with it.
Chaos Flame, Decimating Golden Flame and the dreaded thunderflame.
These three were like emperors, housed in one body. While he only let out a Yuan Qi flame, it was backed up by the three emperors’ aura, so how would the beast flames and heaven and earth spirit flames be so blind as to not bow before true power?
It was akin to a four-year-old girl sucking her lollipop strutting cluelessly through a ghetto, under the greedy eyes of everyone around.
But looking closely behind the wee lass, they’d find a million strong army. Who’d be dumb enough to touch her at this point?
This wee and frail lass was Zhuo Fan’s Yuan Qi flame, while the army was the three mighty flames, growling at the others to stay away.
Thugs could scare children, but scare the army behind them? That’s a no-no.
Though this was one secret only Zhuo Fan was privy to, while others were completely taken in by his guise of faux control.
This way Zhuo Fan didn’t have to use azure flame and scare off all the other flames.
When the emperor came, his way was paved. And that would be showing off a tad too much for his liking…

chapters.title: Chapter 876: Top
chapters.content:
Chapter 876: Top
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Cousin, I never knew you to have such skill.”
Shangguan Qingyan looked at Zhuo Fan filled with admiration. Zhuo Fan had a smirk on, sticking out his chin, “Ain’t I awesome? Now, who was it, I wonder, that said my alchemy sucks just a minute ago?”
“Humph, since when did fire control equal being amazing in alchemy?” Shangguan Qingyan blushed, sticking to her guts, “Dad said Radiant Stage cultivators can at most become a 7th grade alchemist. Now that it is a requirement for preliminaries, it remains to be seen if you can pass it.”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, muttering , “Aside from the harsh mandatory cultivation stage in alchemy, the core of it is secret arts and control. The last one being imperative to one’s results. You and your dad are amateurs and don’t know the details. But any alchemist worth his salt is clear on this. What do you guys say?”
Zhuo Fan turned to the crowd.
“Yes, yes…”
Everyone bobbed their heads, with one even speaking out, “Miss, your cousin is right. The situation now proves just how frickin’ important it is. Why else would we be standing here like this, waiting for them to finish?”
His colleagues nodded, sharing his pain.
[Right, if these bums had Zhuo Fan’s amazing control skill, they wouldn’t be affected by others’ special flames and look so down.]
Shangguan Qingyan returned her eye to Zhuo Fan, “But anything can be said, when the actual results count. Isn’t it all about speed? Say that again once you get into the top ten.”
“Miss, you’re being too hard on him. It’s not so easy to achieve it in today’s Pill King Convention, now with such a tight competition.”
Since nothing could be done, these guys talked it out to soothe their worries, “Your cousin has an insane control, but not on the level of a beast flame or heaven and earth spirit flame. It would be amazing if he makes it to the top hundred.”
“He-he, so you admit it. Control has little to do with actual refining.” Grasping the excuse she wanted, Shangguan Qingyan laughed at her great wisdom.
Shrugging, the people only smiled, “Miss, there’s so many factors when it comes to alchemy. Control is just one of them. Whether or not your cousin will stand out will depend on his grasp of other aspects. Besides, while we have been debating here, the others have started already. Some are even close to finishing. I now stand corrected, it’d be a miracle if your cousin gets into top hundred.”
“What?!”
Shangguan Qingyan’s startled eyes looked around, finding hundreds of special flames finishing refining the ingredients, with some of them wrapping up. While their side hadn’t even begun. This sudden delay made her feel the pressure and grow angry, “Don’t just waste time with idle chat! Time’s a wastin’!”
The candidates shrugged with a plain look, “It’s not us chatting here, but young miss yapping on around your cousin.”
“True, I have to give that to them.” Zhuo Fan nodded, “Have you come to help or hold me back?”
Shangguan Qingyan’s face fell and glared with a pout, “How can you say that? It’s you who’s wasting time yet blame it on me. Look, they’re almost done…”
Shangguan Qingyan pointed over to Shangguan Yulin but then caught herself.
She at least had the mind to not expose their relationship. Zhuo Fan followed her finger and nodded, “He sure is fast, though…”
Zhuo Fan returned to his blaze, throwing ingredients in it and beginning the process.
[Humph, feeling guilty so you only start now?]
Shangguan Yulin smirked seeing Zhuo Fan start at long last. He focused on his own flame then, as the pills were about to be finished.
“Starting now will only get you north of three hundred.”
Shangguan Qingyan was feeling the pressure from all the other exuberant flames around, “I hope the preliminaries won’t kick too many out so you can squeeze in.”
“Yeah, it’d be such a shame for brother to fail after having such amazing control. But, that’ll be hard…” The crowd nodded, filled with sarcasm.
Glaring at their audience, Shangguan Qingyan huffed and stared tensely at her new ‘cousin’.
Zhuo Fan merely smirked, the blaze in his hand warping and readying to finish the pill.
The others cried out, “Brother, what are you doing? You only got the ingredients in and have yet to refine them!”
If Zhuo Fan doused his blaze, all the ingredients would turn to ash, a great carelessness for an alchemist.
They thought that with Zhuo Fan’s control, he’d be a seasoned alchemist. Was he making such an elementary mistake to make up for lost time?
[But no amount of rushing is worth taking the foolish approach of ruining the pills. The judge up there clearly said the one to make a pill will qualify.]
[But by failing to make the pill, it’s all going down the drain. Brother, are you touched in the head perhaps?]
“What’s wrong?” Shangguan Qingyan was clueless, though noticed the tense looks of the crowd. She guessed Zhuo Fan might have done something he shouldn’t.
Zhuo Fan beamed, his eyes focusing on the fire, “Nothing, they’re just droning on. Ignore them.”
The blaze shrunk quickly, vanishing in moments under the incredulous eyes of his audience…
Meng Feitian and Xue Dingxian were right now in a tight competition.
They had rare heaven and earth spirit flames, with fires so hot that dyed the sky red.
“Ha-ha-ha, Old Xue, I’m just about done. The preliminaries are mine, just like before, ha-ha-ha…”
“Humph, stop with the prancing. My pill is about done as well. We’ll see who takes first soon!”
The two lifelong rivals fought with everything. But one thing was certain, they were both grandmasters and the win could go either way.
Baili Jingwei stood on stage and nodded at the two oldies’ rivalry, smiling to a guard, “They’re true alchemists, Old Meng and his junior brother. They’re the only ones leading the round. The closest to them are still only halfway. Such disparity is incredible. They’re sure to take the top two places in preliminaries.”
“Well of course, since Old Meng was an imperial family alchemist. His junior brother, Xue Dingxian, had been competing with him for decades so of course he’d be outstanding as well. Those random alchemists around stand no chance.” The guard nodded.
Baili Jingwei sighed, looking down somewhat, “The main reason for this Pill King Convention was to draw out the rats and take down Shangguan clan’s thieves, but also to get some good seeds for the imperial capital. I didn’t think it’d be so hard to go headhunting. Sword King Feiyun’s domain only has Xue Dingxian worthy of attention. The others are subpar, lacking sorely by comparison with Old Meng. They don’t deserve to enter the imperial capital.”
“This only goes to show the Prime Minister’s brilliant track record of recent years. Recruiting talent throughout the central area all this time has made them all be under Prime Minister now. Few are those remaining, making it hard to find such a commodity among the people.”
“Ha-ha-ha, you sure have a slick tongue.”
The guard bowed and Baili Jingwei patted his shoulder with a sigh, “Maybe so, all I wish is for the empire to be strong and use talents to their best.”
“Ha-ha-ha, old man, I’m almost there. This is my win!”
A laughter echoed, drawing looks. Meng Feitian held a shiny pill in hand, needing but to take away the flame to finish.
Xue Dingxian’s pill was still lacking, needing but a few more moments to finish. Yet this was enough to settle a victor.
Xue Dingxian shuddered in fury, but powerless to fight it. He watched Meng Feitian’s revoltingly prideful face, with a smile going from ear to ear as the fire was doused to take the pill.
Baili Jingwei and the guard smiled, “It’s still Old Meng who won in the end, even if only by a hair. Ha-ha-ha, these old guys are funny…”
Boom!
Meng Feitian’s flame had yet to die out as an explosion rattled their heads.
A drawn out voice resounded, “Sir, I’m done…”

chapters.title: Chapter 877: Doubt
chapters.content:
Chapter 877: Doubt
Proofreader
: Papatonks
[What?!]
Baili Jingwei jerked and turned to the corner where Yuan Qi flames failed to even ignite.
[To go faster than Old Meng, an imperial family alchemist, does that mean there’s still a genius here?]
Meng Feitian shuddered at the sudden outburst and caused his attention to lapse and the pill to be in danger of being ruined right at the end.
[No way! You’re telling me this backwater city holds another talent than Xue Dingxian?]
Meng Feitian frowned, wrapping up his refining and ending up being the runner-up. Then he looked nervously where the shout came from.
Xue Dingxian was startled as well, but then looked lost. As far as he knew, living in this area for so long, there was no other than his clan as real grandmasters in alchemy around these parts.
[Where did he come from then to be faster than us brothers?]
In the end seeing was believing. Since he was close to finishing as well, he wrapped it up and finished third.
Baili Jingwei, Meng Feitian and Xue Dingxian thus turned their dubious gazes to the speaker. The rest gasped in shock and stopped their refining, wanting to see what kind of outstanding, marvelous and ridiculous being could outdo these two grandmasters.
“Prime Minister sir, should I go and get to the bottom of this?” A guard glanced at Baili Jingwei and asked.
Baili Jingwei shook his head, “No, since he took the lead in the preliminaries, I want to see him myself. If he’s a true genius, I’ll personally take him back to the imperial capital. But if he’s a quack looking to make it big, I’ll have to show my less kind side!”
Baili Jingwei took large steps over, with Meng Feitian and Xue Dingxian rushing after.
Three men and one guard, overcome by curiosity, made their way to where Zhuo Fan was, who still held his hand closed.
“Who said he’s done?”
Baili Jingwei scanned the competitors.
All fingers pointed at Zhuo Fan, out of fear of being put through the wringer as well. So they rushed to put some distance between them.
Shangguan Qingyan gave him a reproachful look, then worried.
They all saw how quickly Zhuo Fan closed his fists moments after he dumped the ingredients into the blaze.
No matter how one looked at it, it was a bust. That was why all figured him for a lunatic who had given up in despair.
Only to realize…
[He’s no lunatic, but a moron, a suicidal one.]
Well he did close his fist just as the ingredients went in the fire, then shout out he was done, stealing the grandmasters’ thunder.
[This isn’t your average friendly Pill King Convention, where you can talk trash. It won’t end with just a simple expulsion. Consequences are deadly in a competition held at a Sword King’s manor. Declaring you’ve finished when the pill is obviously ruined, are you toying with Sword King Feiyun? Your head is on the line here!]
Maybe there’d be some innocent bystanders who’d suffer as well from such crass transgression.
So the same one who appreciated his talent and wanted to get close moments before, made the sound judgment of keeping their distance and playing dumb.
Shangguan Qingyan was hopeless in standing there, unable to escape.
[Why is he so crazy all of a sudden? Playing around with the Flying Cloud manor? That’s a swift trip down under.]
A grin split Shangguan Yulin’s face, enjoying the show. Moments ago he was still mulling over how to use the manor to remove this thorn in his side. When lo and behold, the guy did it himself and he didn’t have to lift a finger.
[It sure saves me the trouble.]
He was feeling a sudden and uncontrollable need to cackle.
[Rotten punk, your day has come, ha-ha-ha…]
Baili Jingwei figured it all out from the obvious looks and turned to Zhuo Fan, “Was it you?”
“Yes, sir.” Zhuo Fan smiled.
Baili Jingwei sneered as he began, “Brother, I’ve seen many cheats trying to catch my eye at the imperial capital, obsessed with fame and willing to do anything to gain status. I’m more than happy to cater for real talents, of course, but if there’s one thing I hate, it’s to have some clown think he can pull the wool over my eyes.”
Baili Jingwei squinted, “If you’re some special talent, you could’ve approached me in trying to offer your services. But this is a pill competition, where results are judged on one’s grasp of alchemy, not baiting me like this to showcase your value. Humph, in fact, even if you might be a fairly decent talent, I’ll still only judge your action as a means to toy with me and will have to enforce the rules of the competition upon you. Have I made myself clear?”
“Crystal.” Zhuo Fan nodded.
Baili Jingwei raised an eyebrow. This was rare, seeing one held his own under his rebuke. Baili Jingwei had a whole new respect for him.
Regardless, if Zhuo Fan put on a show, the result would be the same, no mercy.
Baili Jingwei patted Zhuo Fan’s hand and warned, “This is your last chance. Are you really done?”
“Of course.” Zhuo Fan replied.
While he was nonplussed, the crowd was sweating bullets.
[Dude, learn when to quit. The other guy even took the time to explain the process while also giving you a way out.]
[Plead guilty and you might walk. Why so adamant? Who here doesn’t know just how done you are?]
The crowd lamented inwardly.
Baili Jingwei looked from the audience to him with a smile, “I like your mentality the best, able to keep cool in my presence. But toying is still toying and would all be revealed in the end. Since you’re so done with your pill, show it to me. I will be kind enough to give you one last chance. Walk away with your fist closed and I’ll ignore it, but this offer is gone the minute you pry open those fingers.”
Clutching his clothes, Shangguan Qingyan glared hard at the calm Zhuo Fan.
“Ha-ha-ha, thank you sir for your kindness, but I’m not playing anything here.”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, his eyes shining as he opened his fist, “Also, it’s not my mentality that’s great, but my clear conscience. Sir’s question must’ve come after noticing the bystanders’ reaction. However, by definition, a bystander is a mere spectator and their reaction isn’t always to be trusted.”
Hum~
A ripple spread from Zhuo Fan’s hand, followed by a colorful aura and thick fragrance of medicine.
The crowd felt their mind sharpen, their bodies livelier, making these alchemists immediately label the result as a top 7th grade pill.
Whoosh!
The pill had taken a life of its own as it hovered for a moment before shooting away. Meng Feitian made a sign and the pill froze before bringing it to his hand.
Feeling the warmth it gave off and the specific scent of a freshly baked pill, Meng Feitian rushed before Baili Jingwei and gasped, “Young master, it’s a newly refined top 7th grade pill! No mistake about it.”
