It’s only a matter of time before the Shangguan clan will be under Sword King Feiyun’s rule. To receive his help so early is your fortune. Moreover, you said you’re Sword King Feiyun’s nephew. Being so close is bound to bring splendor in young master’s future.”
“Shangguan Feixiong and the others shunned me, but I’m still part of the Shangguan clan. As long as any member is willing to come to me, I will look after them, especially when it comes to my dear nephew. Is your mother perhaps…” Shangguan Feiyun was more amiable now.
Shangguan Yulin bowed, reporting his entire life to the man. Shangguan Feiyun exclaimed, “Oh, so you’re sister Yuheng’s child. It truly has been ages. We were so close in those days, ha-ha-ha…”
“Mother has talked about how she misses uncle. Ha-ha-ha….” Shangguan Yulin used the perfect moment to grab his lifeline.
Shangguan Feiyun nodded.
Baili Jingwei smiled at the exchange, “Sword King Feiyun, it’s truly a rare occasion for an uncle to rejoin with his nephew, but before we can delve deeper into the memory lane, I will have to ask young master Shangguan if you have any other clansman among these two?”
Glancing at the quivering messes, the two gave begging looks. They knew now this was a chance for Shangguan clansmen. As long as they became one as well, they’d see tomorrow.
So the two made doe eyes at Shangguan Yulin. He was their only hope in this abyss…
“Prime Minister sir, the Shangguan clan doesn’t have filth.” Shangguan Yulin spoke in a cold tone.
The two’s legs gave from under them, falling paralyzed and in despair.
Baili Jingwei nodded and said, “Sword King sir, the previous act was to find young master Yulin. Since he’s the only one, take them away.”
“No, that will mean they’ll leak this event. When Shangguan Feixiong finds out, he’ll hunt me down!”
“Ha-ha-ha, no worries, young master Yulin, I’ll be sure to have men look after you. Take them away and let them go!” Baili Jingwei waved.
The two nodded with hope. Shangguan Yulin frowned, his head shaking anxiously, “You can’t. I can’t have peace as long as they live. Only the dead can hold a secret.”
Shangguan Yulin struck before the other two spoke again, taking their lives.
The two peak Ethereal Stage cultivators were scared to death just moments ago, this gave this fresh Soul Harmony Stage cultivator the chance to kill them easily.
Baili Jingwei squinted.
Shangguan Yulin gave them an awkward look as he bowed, “Uncle, Prime Minister, forgive me for overstepping…”
“Ha-ha-ha, lighten up. It’s I who was too nice. Young master Yulin did well.” Baili Jingwei chuckled and turned serious, “Young master, now that you have Sword King Feiyun’s support, can you tell us your purpose here?”
Shangguan Yulin nodded, completing his betrayal by revealing Shangguan Feixiong’s entire plan.
Baili Jingwei smiled, “Just like I thought, they’re ready for a second assault. That means they’ll all work as one, and not scatter. Then where you’re staying in Flying Cloud City is…”
“Eastern Gate’s Gu household.” Shangguan Yulin’s eyes shone, his voice steady.
Baili Jingwei mumbled, “Gu household? That does sound familiar.”
“Of course it is, Prime Minister, since it is the house of the same guest you honored today, Gu Yifan!”
“What?!”
Baili Jingwei shook, “Grandmaster Gu is one of you? But Sword King Feiyun said your clan isn’t great with alchemy. How can you have someone like him?”
“Him, one of us? As if! Humph, he’s nothing but a frickin’…” Shangguan Yulin gnashed his teeth at his mere mention, spilling everything once again, warning for good measure at the end, “Prime Minister sir, Gu Yifan is also Shangguan clan’s spy, even if my sub. You must erase him before he reports back.”
[Sub? You’re the sub if you ask me.]
Baili Jingwei glanced over and shook his head with a sad gaze. Grandmaster Gu, a truly rare talent, was now an enemy?
[At the very least, he and Shangguan clan aren’t that close, only making use of each other. This gives me room to work with and use him.]
Baili Jingwei came back from his machinations with a smile, “Young master Shangguan, you’ve done your uncle, Sword King Feiyun, a great service and revealed a great weakness to me. I wanted to bring Grandmaster Gu to the imperial capital, having no caution around him at all. Please accept this bow from me, young master, for opening my eyes.”
Baili Jingwei bowed. Shangguan Yulin helped him up at once, though he looked prideful.
[See, the great Baili Jingwei is bowing to me! Ain’t I awesome, or what?]
Shangguan Feiyun snickered…
“Prime Minister, how are you going to kill him? Should I do it?” Shangguan Yulin looked way too eager to dole out violence, but then he thought about it and said, “Just that the miss next to him is my cousin. Allow me to take care of her, Prime Minister. Don’t harm her, I vow that she won’t hinder you.”
Baili Jingwei read him like a book, “Young master must admire that miss.”
Shangguan Yulin blushed and gave a weak nod.
“Ha-ha-ha, sure, since she’s with young master, I won’t touch her.” Baili Jingwei promised.
Shangguan Feiyun promised, “The hostility between my brother and me won’t spread to a helpless girl, especially one such as my niece.”
Shangguan Yulin eased.
“Then, when will you strike against that Gu punk?”
“We need him to live for a while longer.” Baili Jingwei denied.
[What?!]
Shangguan Yulin panicked, “Why?”
“After the Pill King Convention, his name will reach far and wide. If anything happens to him, it will send alarms.” Baili Jingwei smirked, “Besides, we still need him to report back to the Shangguan clan.”
“What do you need him to report? I can do it as well!” Slapping his chest, Shangguan Yulin showed that what Zhuo Fan could do, so could he.
Baili Jingwei sized him up then shook his head, “Young master Yulin, this you must not, because you’ve been eliminated out of the competition.”
“I-I have?”
“Yes, how else are you to watch Shangguan Feixiong’s every move?”
Baili Jingwei showed a sly grin, “I thought Shangguan clan would only send one spy and planned on passing you to help Flying Cloud manor. But now, since there’s two of you, it will turn out far better. Besides giving the Shangguan clan the information I want, I’ll also know what they’re doing. Any slight delay will lead to different plans of action. That’s why I decided to have Gu Yifan report back and you watch Shangguan Feixiong and read his doubts. This will make my plan of attack all the more precise. Understand?”

chapters.title: Chapter 889: To Each With Their Own Greed
chapters.content:
Chapter 889: To Each With Their Own Greed
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Squinting, Shangguan Yulin spoke hesitantly, “You know Shangguan clan is staying at Gu household, so why not attack? Why…”
“Ha-ha-ha, young master Yulin, you still don’t get my idea.”
Baili Jingwei smirked, “Shangguan clan has many experts. Even if we attack, they’ll scatter and we’d hardly get any of them. But even if we do, experts aren’t so quick to give in. By setting traps around the household, they’ll soon notice as well. This leaves the best solution to use the manor. We’ll take adequate precautions so once they come in, they’ll never get out.”
Shuddering, Shangguan Yulin gasped, “You want to kill them all?”
“Ha-ha-ha, it does sound greedy when you say it like that. You either do it right or not do it at all.”
After sipping his tea, Baili Jingwei smirked, “Most of Shangguan clan’s strength will be crushed here and thus weaken eastern lands. As the sole survivor of this disaster, you’ll be our eyes and ears inside the eastern lands. This will be its downfall. When Sword King Feiyun will rule it, young master will become the first minister, showered in endless glory. Getting some cousin couldn’t be easier. It’s all up to you what image suits you. You can be the grieving hero or a sufferer as you become Sword King Feiyun’s right hand. I can make it happen, I can make it so you will have the right to embrace any girl you want without repercussions.”
Shangguan Yulin’s brow shook, betraying his excitement.
Baili Jingwei peeked at him and continued, “Young master, to the survivor goes everything. Regardless of morality and name, it’s at the whim of the winner. History is written by the victor. So young master need not be concerned that the death of these Shangguan experts will label you a traitor of eastern lands because we have the power to make you its hero. Everyone will bow at your feet, even your cousin. If you keep this secret, we won’t speak a word of it either.”
Baili Jingwei’s name as prime minister of the Sword Star Empire wasn’t just for show. He could read Shangguan Yulin like a book, twist his words and paint a fantastic future the clueless youth would get lost in.
The kid knew that an attack on Gu household would result in heavy losses on Shangguan clan’s side, but his uncle and the venerables were too strong to be captured. Not even if Shangguan Feiyun was included.
Baili Jingwei wanted them all gone, an entirely different problem. Not to mention, Shangguan Feixiong was his uncle who looked after him since young, as well as his cousin’s father.
If one day Shangguan Qingyan learned that her father’s death had something to do with him, her hatred would know no bounds.
But now, Baili Jingwei’s intricate speech hit home, right at his core.
[Weren’t you scared of being found out and end up shamed for your betrayal? Well we have a solution. You’ll not only be worry free, but gain all the glory too.]
[Ain’t that a good deal?]
[The best!]
Shangguan Yulin’s mind made instant peace with his betrayal, all under the cover of fame and fortune, willing to become the devil’s right hand.
Without blame or guilt, men would be damned for all eternity.
He was still caught up in that fantasy of his and oblivious that once Baili Jingwei helped him rise, he could also crush him as well. Having your weakness exposed tended to do that.
You would be nothing more than his puppet, the whole point to the saying, one mistake lead to ruin. The only chance of overcoming it was by embracing it, facing it head on, or forever be bound by it.
Or maybe it was simpler than that. He might have figured it out, just that he was looking for excuses to let Baili Jingwei use him.
Since being used meant Baili Jingwei needed him alive.
At the heart of all his desire, it was not fame, glory, uncle or even cousin, but himself.
“That settles it, young master Yulin!”
Baili Jingwei cupped his hands at Shangguan Yulin with a smile. The youth replied in kind and left.
Baili Jingwei finally showed his disdain once he was gone, “Hypocrite.”
“Also beyond selfish.”
Shangguan Feiyun added looking at the extra blood around, “Misery loves company. Even if there’s no friendship involved, there’s no rush to finish them off. More like he’s to scared to lose his puny life.”
Baili Jingwei nodded, “I never planned on letting them leave, only testing your cousin’s character. And what a test. This guy is a good pawn, but not trustworthy. Guard, have someone watch the Gu household. That guy in particular!”
“Yes, sir!”
The guard obeyed. Shangguan Feiyun called before he left, “And that cousin of his. Since he thinks of himself a lover, then let’s give him a shameless reason to give his life for us, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Jingwei nodded, “Good one, Sword King Feiyun, but there’s some things I wish Sword King would clarify for me.”
“Prime Minister, there’s no need for such a courteous tone. Please speak.”
“Sword King sir, are you that close to his mother?”
Shangguan Feiyun’s mouth twitched and mocked, “The hell I am. She’s always been a shrew that one, and a tomboy. The mere sight of her annoyed me. Who knew she’d have a son? Humph, the guy who had her must be one poor devil to deal with all that craziness.”
“Ha-ha-ha, sir Sword King is quite the actor, making yourself a friend of the dead.” Baili Jingwei chuckled, then frowned in all seriousness, “It’s clear Grandmaster Gu is only stopping over in the central area, but I never consider him to be tied to Shangguan clan. At least they’re not too close. I have to get him on my side. It’ll be such a loss to this world for a grandmaster to die along with these rats. My heart would bleed.”
Baili Jingwei sighed as he walked towards the manor. Shangguan Feiyun followed.
[Prime Minister sure loves talent…]
…
Fifteen minutes later, one old man and a youth were casually sipping tea in a gazebo close to the manor. No one was around to disturb them.
Zhuo Fan checked the sun’s position and said, “Old Dan, they should be finished by now. Baili Jingwei should’ve gotten his spy. Don’t worry though, nothing will change. I wager he’ll be even more differential.”
“Humph, like a true egomaniac. You should thank your lucky stars that he won’t kill you.” Danqing Shen rolled his eyes.
Laughter broke out, “Ha-ha-ha, Grandmaster Gu, Dragon Cleaving Sword King, so this is where you were! You had me look all over for you.”
The two turned to Baili Jingwei walking over with Shangguan Feiyun.
Zhuo Fan stood up and bowed, looking afraid, “Prime Minister sir, forgive my early disrespect, having not realized who sir was.”
“Grandmaster Gu, you’re too modest. There’s nothing to forgive, ha-ha-ha. Please, get up, or I’ll feel guilty.”
Baili Jingwei had a bright smile and looked quite respectfully at Zhuo Fan. That stunned Danqing Shen.
[The boy’s right. Baili Jingwei didn’t mention the spy, but treated him even more courteously than before.]
[Does Baili Jingwei even know who he really is?]
[It’s like two weasels are fighting to better the other…]
Zhuo Fan was quite humble as he noticed Shangguan Feiyun, “Sir is…”
“He is the lord here, Sword King Shangguan Feiyun!” Baili Jingwei introduced.
Shaking, Zhuo Fan gasped and bowed again, “Sword King Feiyun sir, forgive me, forgive me!”
“It’s fine. Sir can rise.” Shangguan Feiyun helped him.
Straightening his clothes, Zhuo Fan beamed, “Ha-ha-ha, I’m a mere Radiant Stage cultivator but actually got to meet two Sword Kings and the Prime Minister in one day. I’ve never been more excited in my life. Prime Minister, when Sir Dragon Cleaving Sword King said he was defending his home, he almost shocked me to death. I’m truly ashamed.”
Danqing Shen frowned in silence.
[This boy’s acting is out of this world. Even I’d buy into his role if I didn’t know his ruthless nature.]
“Ha-ha-ha, Sir Gu is truly funny. Come, sit!” Baili Jingwei laughed and started, not letting him make a fool of himself, but also quite appreciative of him.
[By the looks of it, Grandmaster Gu is a simple man who only knows alchemy. Shangguan Yulin was right, the Shangguan clan made him a spy and he’s unrelated to them at all. ]
Shangguan Feiyun and he shared a nod. This neophyte spy was the best pawn to use and implement their counter.
As smiles traced beneath the gazebo, each hiding their greed and plans…

chapters.title: Chapter 890: Flawless
chapters.content:
Chapter 890: Flawless
Proofreader
: Papatonks
In a quaint little gazebo behind the Flying Cloud Manor, four people were enjoying the good life, laughing and chatting to their full content like old pals.
The totally harmonious mood felt surreal to the lass watching them, “C-cousin…”
Pausing, the four put down their teacups and turned towards the newcomer, Shangguan Qingyan.
Shangguan Qingyan looked complicated at the uncle she never saw before.
“Oh, Grandmaster Gu’s cousin, Miss Gu. Ha-ha-ha, come, please sit!”
Shangguan Feiyun looked at his panicking niece without exposing her, merely pointing at the chair next to him, “We were just having a chat with your cousin. If you don’t mind it, take a seat as well.”
Shangguan Qingyan’s brow shook. As a young miss of the Shangguan clan on her first undercover mission, she had been warned by her father and the elders many times to close her heart. But seeing the betraying uncle, she let her nervousness slip.
Shangguan Feiyun and Baili Jingwei understood at a glance and merely smiled.
[Shangguan Feixiong must be lacking men to send a naive child like her as spy, ha-ha-ha…]
Zhuo Fan grinned inside. The appearance of Shangguan Qingyan and her reaction made her suspicious, but Shangguan Feiyun ignored it having known everything and since Baili Jingwei was fond of Zhuo Fan.
As the four chatted moments before, Baili Jingwei had tested him to ascertain the panicky reaction all newbie spies were endowed with. He did not disappoint. Thus, Baili Jingwei lowered his guard and accomodated to this greenhorn playing spy in the big world. Shangguan Qingyan came here to cover both herself and Zhuo Fan.
Shangguan Feiyun grinned and stared at her, making her tense. He laughed in the end, “Ha-ha-ha, I’m inviting her for a chat but she’s just standing there looking at me in silence. Is she thinking something bad?”
Shangguan Qingyan panicked and sweat trickled down her brow.
Shangguan Feiyun shared a look with Baili Jingwei as the two enjoyed teasing her.
“Yan’er, are you alright? Why the grimace? Is your illness acting up?”
Zhuo Fan walked to her to block her flustered face and signaling her with his eyes.
Shangguan Qingyan used this chance to get away, “Yes, cousin, it has been acting out and I feel weak. Help me back.”
“Oh, sure. Take out Sword King’s token.”
“Here.”
“Thanks.”
Zhuo Fan took it and rushed to the three to bow, “Forgive me, the elements in my cousin’s body are unbalanced and can only go on with pills. I’ll be saying my goodbye now.”
Danqing Shen nodded and accepted the token, “Then I won’t hold you any longer, Grandmaster Gu. Go and look after Miss Gu.”
“Thank you.” Zhuo Fan walked away.
Shangguan Feiyun raised an eyebrow, “Grandmaster Gu, since miss Gu is hurting, why not heal her here? We have all the ingredients you need and Grandmaster Gu may use them at his discretion.”
“Uh, it’s fine.”
Zhuo Fan looked guilty and gave a silly smile, “Thank you sir, but making the pill for my cousin is complicated and takes too long to be made on the spot. I still have some at home and I need to return quickly to avoid complications.”
Baili Jingwei squinted, “Then we won’t be delaying you, Grandmaster Gu. But sir needs to get ready. In around five days we’ll be leaving for the imperial capital. Grandmaster Gu has to make sure Miss Gu’s medicine will be accounted for on the journey as well.”
Stunned, Zhuo Fan gave an awkward nod then left with Shangguan Qingyan.
“Grandmaster Gu’s words are full of suspicion.”
Danqing Shen glanced at the other two and said, “If Miss Gu has such a deadly illness, how could he leave the medicine at home? Their reactions are off too…”
“Of course it’s off, since it’s hard for a couple of green spies to stay calm around us. Slipping is a given, ha-ha-ha…”
Shangguan Feiyun waved carelessly.
Danqing Shen started, “You mean they’re…”
“Dragon Cleaving Sword King has just missed a good play and doesn’t know yet.”
Baili Jingwei grinned, his eyes shining with wisdom, “We have already caught one spy, who gave these two to us. Shangguan clan had sent one overt and one covert to cover all bases. However, they’d never guess regardless of spies, they’ve overreached, ending up playing in our palms, ha-ha-ha…”
Danqing Shen gasped.
[It’s going just like he said. Baili Jingwei knows who he is but doesn’t expose him. Is it out of cherishing or logic though?]
Danqing Shen asked, “Why then did you let them walk?”
“Well, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Jingwei grinned, “Grandmaster Gu is a man among men, a rare alchemical talent. It’s such a shame to see him fade away. And the spy already told us Grandmaster Gu is hiding from his pursuit in the central area. That’s how he stumbled upon the Shangguan clan and got wrapped up in this mess. He has no real ties to the clan. This will make it easy for him to be made use of in the service of the empire, as long as his wishes are met.”
Danqing Shen nodded, “True, I’d do anything to make use of such a talent as well. Why not expose it and make him work for us?”
“Won’t that make him one of us for sure?” Shangguan Feiyun mocked.
Danqing Shen frowned, “What does that mean?”
“Ha-ha-ha, Dragon Cleaving Sword King, it’s like this.”
Scratching his nose, Baili Jingwei’s eyes shone, “Getting the spies is easy, but I want one to pass on my words, to get them to come and destroy them all. That man can never be Grandmaster Gu!”
Shangguan Feiyun nodded, “As a spy, Gu Yifan is as green as it gets. He seemed calm but botched when pressed for details. If we had laid the cards on the table then, we’ll be putting him in a tough spot when asked to give a fake report to the elders of Shangguan clan, giving himself away. It was better to keep him acting as their spy and provide counter-intelligence. He believes we gave him real information when it’s actually fake, but coming from him, the Shangguan clan will definitely buy it. It will make their destruction all the more assured. At worst, we’ll just get him on our side right at the end. It’s all the same.”
“Amazing!”
Danqing Shen praised.
Baili Jingwei waved casually, “It’s nothing praiseworthy, Dragon Cleaving Sword King. It’s nothing but a little trick, ha-ha-ha…”
Danqing Shen was silent.
[It’s not for you, so why so smug? It’s that brat who’s truly great for seeing through the great prime minister’s plan to the last detail. To the point he made sure to use emotion and logic so you won’t kill him. You’re now just playing in his palm.]
[One more treacherous than the next. But what’s the boy after anyway? Regardless…]
Danqing Shen glanced at Baili Jingwei and shook his head.
[Sir Baili, a Prime Minister of the empire, of your marvelous talent, is going to get it now. The same kid you’re trying to use, is in fact a shrewder monster than you…]
Meanwhile, Zhuo Fan and Shangguan Qingyan left the manor and were rushing back. They looked tense and jittery.
“Are you nervous?”
“Yes.”
“Me too.”
The two held hands and felt the other’s anxiety. While Zhuo Fan’s was fake, Shangguan Qingyan’s couldn’t be more real…

chapters.title: Chapter 891: Triumphant Hero
chapters.content:
Chapter 891: Triumphant Hero
Proofreader
: Papatonks
After a good deal of walking, Zhuo Fan looked back to see no one on their tail and stammered to console Shangguan Qingyan, “I-it’s fine, they don’t seem to doubt us…”
“B-but I’m still so nervous.” Looking behind as well, Shangguan Qingyan’s face was stiff and unnatural.
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes.
[Hey, Shangguan Feiyun is your uncle, so what’s so scary about him? Not even I, an outsider, am scared of him!]
Though seeing her anxious demeanor, Zhuo Fan shook his head, bringing her into a hug and slowly giving her pats on the back, “Feeling better now? We still need to hurry back to uncle. You can’t be seeing him like this or he won’t give us any heavy missions!”
When he was worried Shangguan Qingyan’s naive nature would give them away to Shangguan Feixiong.
Raising doubts in Baili Jingwei’s presence with their acting was faked to gain their trust since they already had another spy spilling the beans and wanted them to give their report. It was the only way for him to get the two sides to duke it out so he come out as the sole winner.
However…
[Once Shangguan Feixiong sees this chick like this, he’ll seriously doubt us. We even deceived them with such obvious signs.]
Who knew what this might lead to? Maybe the factions would fight only ages later.
He didn’t do it out of compassion for this wee girl, but to fit Baili Jingwei’s plan by drawing the enemy under their roof, while also gaining the Shangguan clan’s trust.
He was the glue tying the two fuses together and it was his job to get rid of any reason that might split them apart.
[All to enact my flawless plan!]
The poor girl had no idea of the devious plan in the man’s mind. Being hugged all of a sudden like a child and rubbing her back, made her feel warm and she started to blush.
She did not hate it though, her hands sliding around Zhuo Fan’s waist in time with his rubbing.
Startled, Zhuo Fan froze with a weird look on his face, stopping his hand on her back.
[What’s this chick up to? Is she making use of me in this situation? I’m consoling her but she’s out to get more out of this. How selfish!]
Luck had it Shangguan Qingyan did not read minds or she’d spew blood.
[Who’s using who here, when you started it?]
Feeling Zhuo Fan get stiffer than her, Shangguan Qingyan showed a bitter smile. She took back her hands and left his embrace, “Thank you, I’m much better now.”
“Great, I’m used to doing this to young Sanzi to get him to relax. It looks to be working, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan gave a dry chuckle and nodded at her recovered state, resuming their walk.
Shangguan Qingyan peeked at him and muttered, “You looked quite calm in front of those great people. You even smiled, like you’re of the same cloth. Why then now…”
“Was I scared?”
Zhuo Fan smiled as she finished her question, “Ha-ha-ha, I had to force myself through it or they’d found me out. My life doesn’t matter, but what about young Sanzi? Like my master once said, all living things have their own path. Even the tiniest creature lives in its own mundane way. I am weak as an ant and no royalty, but to secure my life, I have to keep a straighter face than anyone. You don’t believe me, touch it!”
Zhuo Fan stuck his face closer to Shangguan Qingyan and made her giggle, pushing him away in fake anger.
Shangguan Qingyan then found Zhuo Fan much closer to her heart, “Actually, you’re not that insignificant, you’re a rare 11th grade alchemist. If not for the Pill King Convention, I’d never know your good side!”
“What’s the use?”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “In a world where only power matters, a great alchemical skill would only make you a strong faction’s supporter. As a Radiant Stage cultivator with average talent, I’ve gotten used to being shooed and giving me orders. While I’m not a bug in the truest sense, I do have the strength of one.”
Shangguan Qingyan stared into Zhuo Fan’s bitter look and felt sad, and something peculiar that made her heart throb.
Zhuo Fan looked vulnerable, but she saw behind it the drive to push through the suffering, to go against his own destiny, which filled her vision.
Unlike her kind, who were born with a silver spoon in their mouths, Zhuo Fan had to work his way up. This fortitude was very attractive.
Zhuo Fan liked to toy around or suck up to someone like a lowlife, all was done with a purpose in mind, to live on with his child.
That was why he was so much calmer than her in front of the central area’s Nine Sword Kings.
Seeing him braving through hardship had moved her.
Of course, that was just Shangguan Qingyan’s misconception. Zhuo Fan was just a fallen angel upon this mortal world, of the noblest ilk, with total disregard to all so-called experts. Why would he care about some Genesis Stage cultivators?
Though she was right about one thing. Be it in the former or current life, Zhuo Fan was used to staying low and working his way up. That was why struggle was at the core of his being.
Especially since he had once seen what the top offered, making fame and fortune look dull to him. All he wanted was to return to his peak!
Taking a casual stroll, the lovely couple arrived home. Shangguan Qingyan grew nervous seeing the door, feeling sad their walk was so short.
She never felt like this when the three of them went out having fun, making this trek all the more valuable.
Zhuo Fan sensed nothing, going up to the door. Shangguan Qingyan stopped him from knocking, “Wait.”
“What is it?” Zhuo Fan asked.
Shangguan Qingyan gnashed her teeth, “Uhm, is young Sanzi’s mother still alive?”
Zhuo Fan frowned, then nodded.
“Do you… love her?”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shook and gave a firm nod.
Shangguan Qingyan took the lead and knocked on the door.
Zhuo Fan was startled.
[What’s with this chick and her questions?]
Shangguan Qingyan never looked at him and kept her head low.
Gu Santong opened the door with a bored look, “What took you so long? That rotten guy has returned ages ago!”
“He-he-he, you mean cousin, right? He’ll soon become your uncle, my brother. You should show him some respect and not call him names.”
Gu Santong’s appearance washed away all of Shangguan Qingyan’s troubles, hugging the pouting child and pecking him, “Come, young Sanzi, let me kiss you!”
She put him down then went on cheerfully.
Gu Santong eyed Zhuo Fan oddly, “Dad, what’s up with auntie?”
“How should I know?”
Rolling his eyes, Zhuo Fan paused, then started, “Young Sanzi, what did you call her?”
Ugh!
Gu Santong blushed, “Auntie.”
“Humph, you little brat, you’re truly getting into your role, I see.” Rubbing his little head, Zhuo Fan chuckled and went in, unaware of Gu Santong’s earnest face.
In the parlor, Zhuo Fan looked around to find it empty.
[What’s going on? Did the Shangguan clan get scared of being ambushed and left?]
Noises came from around as Shangguan Feixiong came in with three elders.
The other experts of Shangguan clan streamed in, a few hundreds, clapping hard and looking happy at him.
Zhuo Fan felt awkward, “Uncle, what…”
“No need to say anything, we know!”
Shangguan Feiyun laughed, “We know you’re a hero that gained Shangguan Feiyun and Baili Jingwei’s trust and became their guest. Yifan, I knew you were going to pull it off, slipping into the Flying Cloud manor. And you’ve been hiding yourself well, 11th grade alchemist. If I knew, I’d only be sending you, ha-ha-ha… “
Slapping Zhuo Fan’s chest hard, Shangguan Feixiong was greatly relieved by his success, “Yifan, you’re truly a hero to our Shangguan clan!”

chapters.title: Chapter 892: Complement the Map
chapters.content:
Chapter 892: Complement the Map
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Uh, you’re too kind, uncle. It’s my honor to give my services to Shangguan clan, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan waved his hands around. He might sound humble but the broad smile betrayed his thoughts.
Shangguan Feixiong chuckled and shook his head. Zhuo Fan looked like was still up to his old habits, unlike their blue bloods cultivators, but he had to admit the kid had done a great merit to him. A feat no other clansman could take from him.
This alone made the details unimportant. They’d be adressed in the following days anyway. Even if he had the habits of a common man, the true style of a young master would be instilled into him in the coming years, and not shame Shangguan clan.
Shangguan Feixiong found Zhuo Fan all the more pleasing, laughing. The same went for the rest of the people here, all welcoming now.
It was not their fault all of Shangguan clan’s heroes sucked for the job and only he could do it. The step nephew of the Clan Head had risked life and limb for the clan. It was strange if they didn’t welcome him. Using one’s life to prove oneself had that effect on people.
The constant looks of disdain in the recent past had now been replaced with approval. Some had yet to even stop clapping.
With a slow step, someone came behind Zhuo Fan and patted his shoulder.
Zhuo Fan looked back at Shangguan Yulin. Only to find not an ounce of hostility in his eyes, even cupping his hands, “Brother Gu, congratulations. Your great efforts had given the Shangguan clan stuck in despair a way forward. You have also helped me by covering my mistake.
“If not for you entering the manor, I, who has failed, would be condemned by the clan. Who knew how many lives would be lost as we burst into the manor blindly. Brother Gu, has done a great service to the Shangguan clan not seen for thousands of years and saved so many of us. On behalf of myself and all my clansmen part of this attack, you have my deepest thanks, brother Gu!”
Shangguan Yulin was tearing up and giving a low bow. His action touching, his respect commendable, earning the approval of all.
Zhuo Fan sneered inside. He would’ve bought his act if not for already knowing this brat’s twisted character.
[Since you wanna play, let’s play!]
Zhuo Fan’s face split into a grin, blabbering as he helped him up, “Cousin, don’t say that. We’re all in this together. We’re all doing it for the Shangguan clan. There’s no difference between us. It won’t matter if you die, for there’s me. So rest easy, ha-ha-ha…”
Ugh!
Shangguan Yulin’s face twitched.
[Did he just wish for me to die?]
“Yifan, what nonsense are you talking about? How can he die? Aren’t you all back safe and sound? Stop speaking ill in these times!” Shangguan Feixiong frowned and chided.
Zhuo Fan noticed his ‘blunder’ and explained, “No, uncle, that’s not it. What I mean is I finished cousin’s botched mission…”
Shangguan Yulin’s eyes shook, his face twitching.
[How is this better? At least it was a presumption before but now it’s like I’m literally dead since you carried out my mission. He really wants me dead!]
“Uh, no, uncle, I mean…”
Noticing Shangguan Yulin’s dark face, the others chuckled at Zhuo Fan’s act, making him nervous, “I want to say that if the mission would’ve taken him from us, I would’ve taken it upon myself to finish it and give him peace…”
Shangguan Yulin was choking in rage, his chest rising with every breath, but he couldn’t throttle him, not with so many witnesses.
[This punk is fumbling and ranting nonsense. Why did I even bother talking to him, to make myself look worse?]
[I can’t touch him now, not when he has everyone’s approval for finishing the mission.]
[Thought the punk looks like he’s spewing stuff in panic, but every time he doesn’t realize he always comes back to wanting me dead.]
[Have I done anything to him to deserve this slander?]
Zhuo Fan was growing flustered by the minute while Shangguan Yulin held his head. Shangguan Feixiong didn’t want this play to continue and said, “Alright, alright, you don’t need to say it. I’ll speak in your stead. What you mean is that you’re of the same heart with Yulin, that you both gave your all for the clan, right?”
“Yes, that’s exactly it.”
Zhuo Fan slapped his leg and beamed, “I wanted to say that cousin deserves some of the credit, ha-ha-ha…”
“Brother Gu, you’re too kind.” Shangguan Yulin was bashful.
Shangguan Feixiong laughed, “You’ve always been so sharp tongued, kid, but now you’re quite vague. How can you be such a downer when you’re that excited? Now I know why Yan’er has been so crude lately. She’s been hanging out with you and you ruined her!”
“Please forgive me, uncle, for ruining cousin!” Like a child in the wrong, Zhuo Fan immediately played the victim card.
Shangguan Feixiong ignored it, “It’s fine. As long as the heart is true, the details don’t matter. Also, Yifan..”
Shangguan Feixiong grabbed Zhuo Fan’s shoulder, “I used to think taking you as my nephew was my greatest regret. I didn’t think you’d help Shangguan clan so much so soon. I was right to take you in.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes were filled with emotion looking at his uncle.
“Feixiong, we’re also caught by surprise with the kid’s character, smarts and determination. It was the right choice in sending him on this task, ha-ha-ha…”
The three venerables threw in their two cents, laughing.
The two rolled their eyes. These coots wouldn’t have placed him as sub or put a watch on him if that was true.
With Shangguan Feixiong and the venerables’ approval, the rest of the clansmen were more open with Zhuo Fan.
Shangguan Yulin’s darkness only grew as he observed their joy…
After the happy moment was gone, Shangguan Feixiong turned grave, “Yifan, what have you found out while being a guest in the Flying Cloud manor?”
“Uncle, I wanted to explore the place, but I was accosted by Dragon Cleaving Sword King for a long time. That’s why… “
“Dragon Cleaving Sword King is here as well?” Shangguan Yulin turned to Shangguan Yulin with a shocked look.
Shangguan Yulin bowed, “Uncle, I haven’t seen a shadow of Dragon Cleaving Sword King in the manor. I did not know of this.”
Shangguan Feiyun nodded and sighed, “Shangguan Feiyun was bad enough, now another Sword King came as well as Prime Minister Baili Jingwei. This mission is becoming more dangerous by the second. If we can’t get an idea of the area, rushing head on will incur heavy losses, even more than last time.”
Everyone gave a hard nod.
“Don’t worry, uncle, I’ll be sure to scout it perfectly!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone as he declared. He didn’t want the Shangguan clan’s attack to fail, since it’d ruin his own operation.
Shangguan Feixiong was vexed, “Yulin said Baili Jingwei will take the selected alchemists to imperial capital in five days. Do you have enough time to scout a manor so large?”
“Yes!”
Someone else responded this time.
Everyone turned to Shangguan Qingyan rushing inside.
Shangguan Feixiong asked, “Yan’er, you didn’t even come to greet us when you came but run here now? What are you up to?”
“Up to this!”
Shangguan Qingyan’s brow twitched and Shangguan Qingyan giggled, spreading a sketch on the table for all to see. Shangguan Feixiong gasped, “That’s…”
“The map of the manor!”
With a smug grin, Shangguan Qingyan continued, “While Dragon Cleaving Sword King had been bothering brother Gu, I used his token to wander the premises and assess the situation. But everything looked mostly normal, with some few places not allowing me entry even with the token. These are five in total, which makes me believe what we want is in one of these places.”
Shangguan Feixiong looked at the map and nodded, “That means…”
“My task is to complement the map!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone…

chapters.title: Chapter 893: Control
chapters.content:
Chapter 893: Control
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Whoosh!
In the backyard, Shangguan Yulin sneaked out a jade slip when no one was around. He made a sign and shot into the sky.
As if nothing happened, he returned to his room and shut the door, “Humph, Gu Yifan, laugh while you can these two days, under uncle and other’s care, but once Shangguan Feiyun ends them, you’ll go down as well, ha-ha-ha…”
The mad cackle bounced off his walls, including his desire and hatred.
“Mmm, not a bad idea. But will it work?” A rough voice pierced the quiet room.
Shangguan Yulin was still caught in his fantasy, mocking, “Damn right. Flying Cloud manor aren’t fools, ugh.”
Shangguan Yulin caught himself as a blackness swirled around him. Everything went dark, even his vision.
“M-master?”
Sss~
Shangguan Yulin gasped and soured. He was more than familiar with this image, or lack thereof. He met that sicko last time in the woods, but now it seemed he’d been followed back. Stuck in the same blackness once more left a bitter taste in his mouth.
[This place is packed with Shangguan clan experts, yet you just barge in. Can’t a guy live in peace for once? Is there no safe place for me out there? Am I ever going to be free of this sicko?]
Shangguan Yulin whined, cursed and complained, in his mind of course, “Master, what is sir doing here?”
“Why, you’re not happy to see me?”
“No no no, I’m ecstatic you treat me with such care!” Shangguan Yulin put away the sour tone and switched to flattery.
Zhuo Fan smirked, “Punk, don’t think for a second Shangguan clan being here will stop me from taking care of you. Humph, there’s no place out there I can’t enter!”
“Yes, yes, sir is so amazing, I’m in awe!” Bobbing his head, Shangguan Yulin kowtowed. Though his insides were bitter, finding this old sicko so able as to enter even here.
This place was under Shangguan clan’s supervision at all times to prevent any attack. Where Flying Cloud manor’s people would be found, and yet this old freak could just stroll right in.
[Don’t tell me the sicko’s stronger than those guys. ]
It was better he didn’t know that this sicko was next door. Ignorance was truly bliss in this case.
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Did you get the word out?”
“Uh…”
Shangguan Yulin wore a bright and dumb smile, “Master, what do you mean? I don’t…”
Bam!
Zhuo Fan lashed his face with the dragon tail, sending him sprawling, “Humph, boy, don’t be a smart ass. I know your rotten character better than anyone. You have sided with Shangguan Feiyun and Baili Jingwei today and you still try to act dumb?”
“Master, please don’t say random things. I didn’t side with them at all! I’m completely innocent!” Shangguan Yulin denied it all with a victimized look, “The Shangguan clan knows I’ve been eliminated from the competition and I’m not even hurt. How could I just betray my clan? Last time I agreed with sir since you had me beaten to an inch of my life.”
Shangguan Yulin completely destroyed his image by tearing up.
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow and mocked, “You think I’m like your clansmen, ignorant? I’ve seen the three round competition Baili Jingwei set up from the side. The first was a 7th grade pill, testing one’s patrimony. Second was doing one’s best, only worded so you go easy. While on the last round, that was the true test of one’s alchemy, a topic I foresaw, the making of a perfect or top pill.
“Ha-ha-ha, don’t you think it’ll raise an eyebrow when you can make an 8th grade but not a top 7th grade? The first two rounds attested to you being an 8th grade alchemist, so making a top but lower grade pill was a given. This was Baili Jingwei’s final aim. Going up but never coming down. So don’t insult me by telling me you lied your way out of Baili Jingwei’s clutches.”
Shangguan Yulin shuddered while his insides were frozen in shock. He was completely sold by the sicko’s flawless analysis, whether he hid to watch or just plain guesswork.
“Also, Baili Jingwei is known as the wisest man in the empire, not some brash musclehead to force you like me. Humph, he definitely struck your unsound mind at the time. What’s so hard about convincing an anxious whelp anyway?”
Zhuo Fan berated, “Kid, did you already forget the vivid and heavy vow you made me? To think you’re trying to fool me, ha-ha. Nice, very nice, it seems to me I should go search for another disciple…”
The black area seeped with bloodlust.
Shuddering, Shangguan Yulin paled and begged, “Master, forgive me! I was only joking! I didn’t realize master’s ingenious intellect and made a mistake. Yes, I have sided with Shangguan Feiyun, but I didn’t have a choice. They threatened my life. If I hadn’t given in…”
“Fine, you betrayed Shangguan clan and not me, anyway. Why should I care?”
Zhuo Fan huffed, “Besides, I just knew you have no bone in your back when I took you. There’s nothing odd about a few atrocities or a doublecrossing here and there…”
Shangguan Yulin’s face twitched.
[For god’s sake! The sicko’s mocking me!]
He did hold his tongue though, since he knew it was true, even if forced.
[I used to be such a compassionate young master back in the eastern lands, always upholding righteousness. How did it get to betraying one’s roots the minute I came here?]
[Twice even! But even if others don’t know this, I’m still hurting from it. Then that punk kept on mocking me earlier and now this sicko. This has got to be the worst year of my life!]
Shangguan Yulin lamented his fate as he heard the mockery coming from the darkness. Unaware that the ones he was cursing were one and the same. Though it was better this way, lest he die from anger.
Having been condescending enough for today, Zhuo Fan got down to business, “Now why am I here bothering wasting words with you? It’s for two reasons. You can betray anyone but your master. You still have my mark on you so do watch out if you value your puny life.”
“Yes yes, I’ll hold your warning to heart!” Shangguan Yulin shuddered in fear.
Sneering, Zhuo Fan continued, “And don’t forget your promise. What’s yours is mine. What the Shangguan clan wants, I also want!”
“Yes yes, I’ll never ever forget!” Shangguan Yulin slowered his shaking head and bowed again.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Since you know now, next is the word you sent. Walk me through it!”
“Yes yes, master. It’s nothing much, just that the Shangguan clan has a rough grasp of Flying CLoud manor, lacking in a few places. They need that punk, Gu Yifan, to scout them.”
“Oh, a map of the manor!”
Grinning, Zhuo Fan said, “This way the map will be complete. Disciple, make me a copy as well.”
Shuddering, Shangguan Yulin’s eyes darted around.
[What’s the sicko planning to do with it? Is he after the manor’s things as well? Then…]
Shangguan Yulin squinted, his mind calculating. Then he clenched his fists and said, “Yes, I will have it, master.”
“I’ll leave it to you then, ha-ha-ha…”
The darkness receded, revealing the room again, but the weird laughter echoed in his ears, “I’ll be dropping by again when the map is finished…”
As the cackling faded, Shangguan Yulin revealed an icy smile.
[Humph, you damn freak, I’ll be sure to give you a thoroughly deadly map!]
Meanwhile, Zhuo Fan felt great lashing at Shangguan Yulin, it was oddly therapeutic, walking back to his room to see Gu Santong bored on the bed and playing with a new wooden toy.
Zhuo Fan knew it wasn’t from him, “Did the girl give it to you?”
“Yeah.”
“Quite childish, I see, for a three hundred year old man.”
“Aren’t you the same? Scaring children again?” Gu Santong quipped back as he played.
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “It’s not scaring him, but controlling. While I am the connection between Flying Cloud manor and the Shangguan clan in the open, he has two dark ties. I can control the Shangguan clan’s actions, but he can influence Baili Jingwei’s decisions. By controlling him, I control the whole stage…”
“Is he that happy to listen to you?” Gu Santong asked, “He can’t be trusted!”
Zhuo Fan nodded with a vague smile, “He doesn’t need to listen to me to use him. I just have to prod him in the right direction and we’re set. While the two sides are at war, we’ll be getting what we want and flee.”
“And auntie?” Gu Santong spoke casually.
Zhuo Fan shrugged, “That’s Shangguan Feixiong’s problem, since she’s his daughter. We just need to focus on ourselves. We’ll finish our end and then go to the next area.”
Gu Santong stiffened then sighed…

chapters.title: Chapter 894: Sword King’s Visit
chapters.content:
Chapter 894: Sword King’s Visit
Proofreader
: Papatonks
The world was tranquil around one gazebo, as a stream trickled by and birds danced in the light breeze. Paradise.
Baili Jingwei, Shangguan Feiyun and Danqing Shen were having tea here, when something flashed closer and closer.
Baili Jingwei put out his hand and a jade slip rested in it.
Scanning it, Baili Jingwei grinned at the two, “The plan went perfectly. Shangguan clan doesn’t suspect a thing while Shangguan Yulin had done a great job in finishing his mission, dispelling any doubts anyone might have.”
“Who knew that feisty girl had a son so cautious and sinister? That means she must’ve gotten a doormat for a man, ha-ha-ha…”
Grinning, Shangguan Feiyun said, “Did he say what Shangguan Feixiong is planning next?”
Baili Jingwei nodded, “Of course, it appears your niece has been going around the manor and got a grasp of the area. But there’s still five places she couldn’t go to. Now they want to have Grandmaster Gu to scout them to be safe.”
“Humph, I see.”
Shangguan Feiyun sneered, “I’d have opened the manor from the start if I knew this, to let them scout to their hearts content so they could attack already. It makes taking them all down faster.”
Baili Jingwei shook his head, “Sword King Feiyun, you’re wrong. Haste makes waste. If it’d be that easy to get into Flying CLoud manor, it would only make them more suspicious.”
“And?” Shangguan Feiyun looked him in the eye, “When Grandmaster Gu arrives, the ban will still be there. With such a tiny Radiant Stage cultivation, he’ll hardly take a step inside. He won’t find anything, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Jingwei chuckled, “Going by Sword King Feiyun’s words, who knows when our plan will take effect. But like I said before, we’ll destroy them in two weeks and not a day later. I don’t have the time to play around Sword King manor. I’m a busy man.”
“Then what do you want to do?”
“Have someone show him the way and fill in the blanks.”
With a confident smile, Baili Jingwei said, “Starting tomorrow, we’ll invite him to the manor, for fun, drinks and meals, while giving him room to finish up the map. In this process, we need to adjust our attitude, make him believe we appreciate his alchemical talent while dispelling any doubts. When the Shangguan clan makes its move, we can also contain Grandmaster Gu so the thieves won’t disturb him.”
Shangguan Feiyun nodded and mocked, “Prime Minister Baili, you’re still placing Grandmaster Gu’s safety as top priority. You sure like your talents, ha-ha-ha…”
“As the empire’s Prime Minister, it’s only natural for the empire to seize talents!”
Baili Jingwei smiled and looked at the ever silent Danqing Shen, “Dragon Cleaving Sword King, I and Sword King Feiyun are more familiar with the Shangguan clan. It would arouse suspicion if any of us would go. I ask that sir go tomorrow and invite Grandmaster Gu to the manor, to show my great regard for him.”
Danqing Shen nodded.
Meanwhile, at Shangguan clan’s interim base, there were a dozen people in the three venerables’ room. Clan Head was present with the best experts his clan had, all in Genesis Stage.
Yet they all had shadows flitting across their faces.
Rubbing his forehead, Shangguan Feixiong replied in annoyance, “I didn’t want to affect morale while in the parlor, and only celebrated Yifan’s great success. But with all important figures of the clan here, the pillars, I must be frank. There’s too many unknowns regarding this second ambush which amplifies the danger beyond our estimates.”
“Clan Head, are you referring to Baili Jingwei and Danqing Shen?” The men all knew the source of his vexation.
Shangguan Feiyun sighed, “Yes, they are the greatest variables to our mission. Danqing Shen is the best of western lands, Shangguan Feiyun’s equal. With them working together, the manor’s power just doubled. And that isn’t even the worst part, since our three venerables can hold them back for a time. The crux is that Baili Jingwei!”
“Sagely Statesman, Baili Jingwei, is cunning and devious. For almost a century now, the four lands have suffered from his tangled schemes.”
One venerable sighed, “If he draws us into a corner and works with the two Sword Kings, our losses will be catastrophic.”
The others nodded heavily.
“However, Baili Jingwei isn’t like the two Sword Kings. In this game of chess, he is deploying the men. As the leader, he must know the other side’s moves lest he comes under a surpise attack and throws his own side into confusion. Just how much does he know about our mission?”
Shangguan Feixiong’s eyes flashed, “If he’s oblivious, we can use the map to assault the manor and increase our chances even with two Sword Kings. While the opposite is also true…”
“Of course he knows! He’s Baili Jingwei, the wisest man in the Sword Star Empire. Nothing escapes him…”
“I wonder about that. He came here to hold the Pill King Convention and help heal the Crown Prince. He might not know about us…”
“You mean Shangguan Feiyun wouldn’t tell him?”
“Ha-ha-ha, you don’t understand Shangguan Feiyun. He’s too prideful and arrogant. He’ll never lower himself and call for help when his domain is in trouble, especially a sage.”
…
Shangguan Feixiong’s words threw the room into chaos as everyone started talking. Some were for the mission now that they had such a great chance. Getting eyes and ears inside the enemy base was too rare of an occasion to pass up.
While others opted to wait for Danqing Shen and Baili Jingwei to leave first, as they posed the greatest threat.
Shangguan Feixiong was plagued with indecision. This choice affected the life and death of his clan’s main force. It was too much for him to bear.
A rash choice here would damn his clan.
It led to the Shangguan clansmen arguing on and on, well into the evening and then into dawn. Yet they showed no signs of stopping still.
Noon found Shangguan Feixiong’s ears clogged with all the buzzing, but no outcome arose even now.
The safe return of his spies, Shangguan Yulin and Zhuo Fan, proved Baili Jingwei was none the wiser, or he’d have already caught them the minute they raised his suspicions.
Shangguan Yulin assured him as well that Baili Jingwei was only here to select alchemists to heal the Crown Prince’s condition. Everything pointed to him being here for the Crown Prince and not them.
Thus, Shangguan Feixiong called this meeting, to discuss how to proceed. He could never otherwise ignore someone like Baili Jingwei appearing out of nowhere, especially when he came with the Dragon Cleaving Sword King.
Shangguan Feixiong has so much trust in his nephew, that he was willing to go against his principles. It was also why he was now having a headache from all the shouting.
Cries came from outside that broke the noise within the room. A man burst into the room, scared to death, “Clan Head, t-there…”
“How dare you barge into the venerables’ room! We’re in the middle of important talks! What the hell got you so shaken to run here?”
Shangguan Feixiong wiped his head around to bark at the Soul Harmony Stage guard.
With no time for manners, the guard looked like he’d seen a ghost, “A-an old man… came…”
“And just an old man sent you in a panic?”
“H-he said he’s Dragon Cleaving Sword King!”
“What?!”
Everyone froze, their faces paling. Shangguan Feixiong was really anxious now, “Is he alone? Was there anyone else with him?”
The guard stammered, “N-no, but he said that he came to see Grandmaster Gu. Young miss had me come notify you, Clan Head, on what to do.”
“You idiot! What are you coming to me for? Go see Gu Yifan! He’s the Clan Head of this house! Go have him deal with Danqing Shen!” Shangguan Feixiong cursed.
The guard startled, darted from the room, and bobbed his head in panic, now rushing to Zhuo Fan’s room.
Sweating buckets, Shangguan Feixiong and the others were shaken up, giving a stiff nod.
[Let’s go check what Danqing Shen’s up to…]

chapters.title: Chapter 895: Invite
chapters.content:
Chapter 895: Invite
Proofreader
: Papatonks
A few chairs and a stone table were placed in the front yard, one of which was taken by a casual old man, sipping tea like he was right at home.
Next to him was a fine girl, carefully peeking at him and looking conflicted.
Danqing Shen knew at a glance why, but played dumb, “Miss Gu, what has gotten you so nervous? Feel free to return to your matters if you have too. I’ll just wait here for Grandmaster Gu.”
“It’s not right. Cousin will surely blame me for leaving Sir Sword King unattended. Please overlook my uncouth and unfamiliar courtesy, ha-ha-ha…”
Shangguan Qingyan stiffened and had a weird smile while her heart was burning in anger.
Not in her whildest dreams did she think Danqing Shen would pay a house visit. Leaving him alone was out of the question as well. The old guy might wander around and stumble upon her clan.
Once exposed, everything would be laid to ruin when they were so close. They’d suffer heavy losses before the second ambush even began.
That was why even if she was wound tighter than a violin, she held it in like a champ. On top of that, she was pissed.
[Where the hell is that guard I sent to report to dad? What should I do? Why aren’t you saying something, dad?]
[And where’s that Gu Yifan? I’m close to dying here…]
With a knowing smile, Danqing Shen began, “Miss Gu is too kind. I just came on a whim, so you can treat me like any other old man. I wouldn’t feel at ease otherwise.”
“Dragon Cleaving Sword King is so modest, seeing yourself as an average old man.” Shangguan Qingyan smiled.
Danqing Shen waved casually as he teased, “Well, if Miss Gu insists, seeing how Grandmaster Gu has yet to arrive, would it be possible to take a stroll around the back of this place? “
Danqing Shen already got up.
“Er…”
Shangguan Qingyan shook then grew a notch more nervous, “This humble abode is nothing impressive compared to a Sword King’s manor. I wouldn’t want to let you down.”
“How can it be? A mountain needn’t be high/It is famous for the deity residing there./ A lake needn’t be deep/ It is magical with the dragon slumbering beneath the surface./ My home is humble/ But my presence brings it virtue. No matter how shabby Grandmaster Gu’s home is, an 11th grade alchemist’s house is leagues above anyone else’s, ha-ha-ha…”
(StarReader: An Epigraph in Praise of My Humble Home by Liu Yuki)
Danqing Shen started walking away.
Sss~
Gasping, Shangguan Qingyan was scared to death. Rushing to stop him, she teared up, “Sir Sword King, there’s really nothing impressive about this place. Please relax here and enjoy your tea…”
“Miss Gu, you’re looking a bit off there. Are you ill?”
“Uh, yes yes, I am feeling somewhat unwell.”
“You have to take your medicine quickly and get some rest! You don’t need to look after me, I can walk around by myself, ha-ha-ha…” Danqing Shen snickered as he toyed with the wee lass.
Shangguan Qingyan shook all over, tears welling in her eyes.
[What do I do? How do I stop him?]
A laughter came from behind, “Sir Sword King, you honor this house with your presence. What could have made sir come here? What can I do sir for?”
“C-cousin!”
Zhuo Fan was walking over at his own casual pace. Shangguan Qingyan burst with joy, looking at him like a savior.
Zhuo Fan laughed inside at her frantic look. “Yan’er, your condition isn’t stable. Go back in and rest. Leave Dragon Cleaving Sword King in my care.”
“Alright.”
Shangguan Qingyan nodded and gave him a look. With a respectful gesture to Danqing Shen, she left free, like an inmate finishing his sentence.
Watching her skip away in glee, Danqing Shen mocked, “Ha-ha-ha, this girl is like an escaped bird. Guess she had been terrified.”
“And whose fault is that, I wonder? What are you doing messing with a little girl anyway?” Zhuo Fan chuckled.
Danqing Shen shrugged, “Can you blame me? Since when is receiving guests done in the front yard and not the parlor or even backyard? Now that’s just rude!”
“It’s not like you don’t know. It won’t help anyone’s case when everything comes to light.”
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes, pointing at a stone stool, “Let’s just talk here, lest you want everyone to soil themselves in fright.”
“Why, am I that scary?”
“What do you think?”
Sighing, Zhuo Fan said, “You just haven’t seen for yourself how close to losing it that Shangguan clan guard who came to tell me was. Anyone would be scared to death when one of the central area’s Nine Sword Kings pays them a visit. Even before coming here, I saw the Shangguan clan huddled together in fright as they watched me come here, with even Shangguan Feixiong spilling his tea.”
Danqing Shen sneered as he returned to his chair, “Shangguan Feixiong? Ha-ha-ha, the last time I saw him he didn’t look scared.”
“The last time he was eastern lands’ strongest clan’s Clan Head while now he’s a spy in the central area. How is that the same? Would you have attacked him in eastern lands? Would he attack you now, in the Flying Cloud City? “
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes and mocked, sitting next to Danqing Sheng.
Danqing Shen nodded, “Harsh, but true, it’s not the same, ha-ha-ha…”
“So, why are you…”
“Baili Jingwei sent me. Like you predicted, they want to sow dissension…” With a smirk, Danqing Shen began to retell everything they spoke, ending with a sigh. “Boy, you’re really something, I’ll give you that, to hold your own against that old weasel Baili Jingwei. To the point you’re having complete control over everything from the shadows.”
Zhuo Fan showed a wide smile, “Great, since they want to sow dissension, he’ll make things easy on this little old spy. Exactly how I like it, ha-ha-ha…”
“Little weasel!” Danqing Shen snickered.
Zhuo Fan gave him a long look and they both cracked up. They were both happy in their own way. Zhuo Fan, for seeing his plan coming along, and Danqing Shen, for helping a good friend.
Regardless, the two were in high spirits and nothing could curb their good mood…
“Clan Head, young master Gu is quite good. He’s handling Dragon Cleaving Sword King like a pro. There’s not a trace of fear in him, amazing! Now I get why Baili Jingwei didn’t spot him.”
The Shangguan clan’s experts were watching from the shadows as they hid in the elders room.
While words did not reach them, the mood was enough to tell them how friendly they were. Shangguan Feixiong nodded in pride, “I’ve made the right decision taking in this step nephew.”
“Clan Head is brilliant!” The others sucked up to him and praised, with only Shangguan Yulin feeling sour inside.
Zhuo Fan and Danqing Shen finished their short talk, called Shangguan Qingyan to tell her about something, then stunned the Shangguan clan as they just went out.
Once they were gone, Shangguan Feixiong rushed straight for Shangguan Qingyan, “Yan’er, what happened? Why is Danqing Shen taking Yifan?”
“Oh, dad, it’s you!”
Having a mob of experts assaulting her scared her for a second. But seeing it was Shangguan Qingyan and the rest, she spoke heavily, “Father, Danqing Shen invited Sir Gu to the manor. He looks to value him. This time it’ll be a good chance to finish the map!”
Pa!
Clenching his fists, Shangguan Feixiong was overly excited, turning to the rest, “Did Danqing Shen notice us while he was here?”
“Clan Head, we have a barrier in the back to cover our auras. He shouldn’t have noticed us.”
“Great, this is providence!”
Shangguan Feixiong’s eyes flashed, his tone firm, “Men, we’ve quarreled enough on this mission. Flying Cloud Manor wants Yifan so bad while ignoring this house. This shows they don’t know about us, not to mention we saw Yifan’s attitude just now. He and Dragon Cleaving Sword King are friendly and I bet so are the other two. Then we must relax and make use of this rare opportunity! All we need now is for Yifan to finish the map and the attack will commence!”
They all cupped their fists and shouted, “Yes, sir!”
Shangguan Yulin grinned.
Shangguan Yulin was by the side smiling in pride, with something sinister hidden within…

chapters.title: Chapter 896: Jade Falls
chapters.content:
Chapter 896: Jade Falls
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Back at Flying Cloud manor once more, he was met with the same imposing gate, the same impressive guards, yet a most contrasting welcome.
Danqing Shen and Zhuo Fan were met with bows of respect all around, “Welcome Dragon Cleaving Sword King and Grandmaster Gu, a blessing to you!”
Zhuo Fan shot up to the level of the Nine Sword Kings practically, and literally, overnight. Even he was taken aback at the treatment.
He noticed Danqing Shen shrugging and leading the way with a smile. Zhuo Fan rose an eyebrow, following with a peculiar smile.
Passing many pavilions and gardens, the two arrived at a fabulous and grandiose hall. Baili Jingwei and Shangguan Feiyun were waiting for them in their seats.
“Ha-ha-ha, Grandmaster Gu, you’re here at last. Have you handled your matters home?” Shangguan Feiyun welcomed him with a laugh.
Zhuo Fan gave a short bow, “Sword King Feiyun needn’t trouble. There’s not much to look after at home, mostly finishing the chores and I swiftly accepted Sword King’s invitation. Might I ask what was the reason?”
“Grandmaster, you’re talking like I’m forcing you, ha-ha-ha…”
Shangguan Feiyun laughed again with a casual wave. He took Zhuo Fan’s wrist, being overly friendly, “There’re just five days before Grandmaster will be leaving for the imperial capital with Prime Minister Baili. With your skill and potential, you’re sure to become the main alchemist in the imperial capital in no time. Grandmaster may even be under Invincible Sword, patriarch’s favorite. Those days will make it even harder for me to see Grandmaster in person. Before it comes to past, I wanted to get to know Grandmaster better and have you leave my jurisdiction with peace of mind, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan nodded, chuckling and cupping his hands, “Sword King, you’re just too kind to me.”
Shangguan Feiyun was a typical flatterer right now. Striking before he reached fame to get close and earning returns when he went big.
But what was even clearer was Shangguan Feiyun’s utmost respect was to give him the chance to scout the place.
[I’m not denying you anything because I’m fawning all over you!]
Making intelligence gathering too easy would rouse suspicions instead. But now this problem was solved through this most logical explanation.
Taking a look around him, Zhuo Fan knew this was one of the five blank spots on Shangguan Qingyan’s map.
He just got to the manor and already filled one gap in the map.
[Baili Jingwei sure is meticulous, filling in all the details.]
From indulging his scout role, to setting up the place for this guest, all was done within reason. He figured all of this out only because he had someone playing triple agent with every side.
“Ha-ha-ha, the world is going down the drain if even the proud Sword King Feiyun mastered the art of ingratiating.”
Baili Jingwei laughed and walked over to them, afraid Zhuo Fan didn’t get such an obvious hint.
[Kid, Shangguan Feiyun won’t do nothing to you no matter what you break in this manor, or what place you barge into. All because he wants to get closer to you, so don’t doubt for a second a scheme is afoot.]
This confirmed Zhuo Fan’s conjectures even more. They were throwing the info to his feet.
[Why am I being tough? The time is now!]
Zhuo Fan grinned.
Shangguan Feiyun found his act lacking so he went on, grabbing Zhuo Fan’s shoulder and glaring at Baili Jingwei, “Prime Minister, how can you say that? Grandmaster Gu is a genius coming from my own domain. What’s wrong with being a good host in my own home by looking after Grandmaster Gu? Don’t use your corrupt official rules on me. I appreciate talent just as you do, and I value Grandmaster Gu the most… “
“Sword King Feiyun, does the manor have some marvels and sceneries that I can enjoy?” Zhuo Fan cut him off with stars in his eyes.
Shangguan Feiyun shook, giving him a flat look. Baili Jingwei was taken off-guard as well.
[I-I haven’t even finished my script to justify your visit to the manor yet you drop this sudden line?]
[That saves us the foreplay, showing you right in, spy.]
Shangguan Feiyun laughed and gestured in invitation, “Of course there are. Right this way, Grandmaster Gu. I dare say my manor has the best views, comparable even with the Thunder Pavilion in the imperial capital. You, sir, will be amazed at the breathtaking experience, ha-ha-ha…”
“I can hardly wait!”
Zhuo Fan was excited as well, rubbing his hands as his eyes shone. He cared not what the Shangguan clan and Flying Cloud manor were up to, just that his goal just so happened to be here.
[While they want dissension, I’ll use my role as a spy this time to find what I want in this place. It just doesn’t get any better than this, he-he-he…]
Shangguan Feiyun grabbed Zhuo Fan and walked him out like an old friend.
Danqing Shen chuckled and turned serious, “Prime Minister Baili, you guys have made a script for hours to get Grandmaster Gu to play along. Now, instead of affirming your fears of finding it out, he just went head in with the script, falling for the first line in scouting the manor. If you knew, you and Sword King Feiyun would’ve just took him strolling instead, ha-ha-ha…”
“Right you are.”
Baili Jingwei chuckled as he shook his head, “I’ve never seen a newbie spy like Grandmaster Gu in my life. He’s not meandering at all, but reveals his goal from the start. We’d have long since thrown him into a torture chamber to squeeze the info out of him if we hadn’t already known everything. So much planning, all gone to waste on this green spy. Even if we continued to fake it, he’d still not care because he was no spy, but an alchemist.”
Danqing Shen remained silent, showing only a smirk.
[Know everything?]
[Ha-ha, Prime Minister, why this kid here knows way more than even the greatest sage in the empire…]
Danqing Shen and Baili Jingwei smiled, following after them.
Shangguan Feiyun took Zhuo Fan in the backyard, where another blank spot on the map was located.
Zhuo Fan was excited.
[Now, is there another World Wind Tunnel here?]
The roaring of a waterfall rumbled in his ears. Zhuo Fan barely contained his joy, as even his body shook.
Shangguan Feiyun didn’t notice it as he led the way. They soon arrived before a three hundred meter tall waterfall, revealed to them in the form of a white curtain, glittering stars rained down from above.
What made this waterfall so special was the lack of any cliffs. The water just fell from the air in an unending suspended river that wound through unseen obstacles before climbing back into the skies.
This was a waterfall made of one complete circle of water, with the flow shaping all kinds of spaces, even tumbling in some areas.
The sheer spectacle was enough to leave Zhuo Fan speechless. As water went down, man climbed up.
A common saying that was toppled here and now. Water was not only taking form, but expressed different states, from soft to hard.
Even without Sword King Feiyun’s words, he knew this was the World Wind Tunnel he wanted to find.
With a prideful look, Shangguan Feiyun pointed, “Ha-ha-ha, Grandmaster Gu, wasn’t I right? This here is the most amazing sight in the world, Jade Falls, endless and flowing. The water just stands in the air held by nothing, unmarred by the mortal world, yet solid as any mountain. It is a cultivator’s paradise with its incredible spiritual energy, even more so for a water cultivator. It also helps calm one’s restless heart. The ones who can’t make use of it are those related to alchemy and refining.”
“I can see that.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Even so, it’s still a great place to cultivate. Truly everyone looks upon Sword King Feiyun with envy for you to have such a paradise at your disposal.”
Shangguan Feiyun chuckled, “Oh, no, this is bestowed by the world. I couldn’t possibly take it for myself. And I’m also not gaining as much from it from our incompatible attributes. The only help comes from clearing one’s Dao Heart.”
Zhuo Fan nodded.
Hum~
Zhuo Fan’s right arm flashed an eerie red glow and a thick bloodthirst shot from the waterfall at him.
Zhuo Fan was shocked, so were the rest.
Shangguan Feiyun welcomed him in his own home, yet now someone dared to attack…

chapters.title: Chapter 897: Soaring Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 897: Soaring Sword
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Whoosh!
As the water sprayed everywhere, a flash of red sword aura from the falls shot right at Zhuo Fan. The icy piercing bloodthirst bit into his face, making his skin crawl.
[A sacred weapon?]
Zhuo Fan’s heart thumped, his fists balled up.
This was his second time seeing a sacred weapon, first being in the Double Dragon Manor where the Vaulting Sword got him good. Not even the nigh indestructible Qilin arm could hold it back. With such a sharp edge, there was hardly anything out there that could truly resist it.
[The sacred beast aura must’ve triggered it. The only way to stop it is with my Divine Eye of the Void.]
Forged by the Heavenly Sovereign and Sword Sovereign, this sacred weapon would be meek in the face of its master’s power. Unfortunately, he wasn’t alone this time around, with three other spectators. By pushing back a sacred weapon now was the same as blowing his cover.
It would make all his effort so far useless.
Zhuo Fan’s heart tensed in hesitation, not knowing what to do.
As the crimson sword aura drew closer and closer, he was stuck in a dilemma. Nonetheless, his right eye flashed golden, ready to act if needed be.
First priority would always be his life, of course…
“How dare you come out when I’m with an important guest? Leave at once!” The roaring voice of Shangguan Feiyun echoed out.
Zhuo Fan chuckled with a sneer.
He’d never believe it for a second that Shangguan Feiyun could control the raging sacred weapon.
Genesis Stage they might be, at peak of the mortal domain, but mortals all the same. Yet they thought of commanding a sacred weapon?
[You should be grateful the great weapon a Sovereign forge would even allow you to wield it.]
[Instead of respecting its parent, you holler at it and expect it to bow down? That’s a 6th grade sacred weapon, not some spiritual toothpick. It demands respect.]
Only to look on with a dumb look at what he was witnessing the next moment…
The red sword faltered in midair and hovered, actually listening to Shangguan Feiyun.
Zhuo Fan’s eye twitched.
[No way!]
[What’s a 6th grade sacred weapon doing listening to some mortal domain’s citizen? Bruh, you’re the best of the best, made by a Sovereign himself, so how can you just fall so low as to obey some Genesis Stage expert?]
[Where’s your dignity? Where’s your pride? Did you lose them on your way down to the moral domain?]
Zhuo Fan watched the inconceivable play with mixed emotions. He had to switch Vaulting Sword’s sword soul with Blood Infant to get that one.
Now though, Shangguan Feiyun had done him one better, with this one’s sword soul completely capitulating to him. It was the only logical explanation for this ridiculous scene.
It made him wonder though.
[Why is a Sovereign made sacred weapon giving in just like that? Why is it going against Heavenly Sovereign’s order to kill the sacred beasts and listening to Shangguan Feiyun instead?]
Zhuo Fan stood there, rooted in doubt.
Shangguan Feiyun took it for fear and laughed in apology, “Grandmaster Gu, forgive me. This sword is the greatest treasure of eastern lands I brought along, Soaring Divine Sword, which needs a place of thick spiritual energy to reside in. So I just placed it in the Jade Falls along with sacred stones. Unlike any spiritual weapon, this divine weapon has a will of its own and shuns strangers. It must’ve sensed you and burst out. Forgive me for letting it scare Grandmaster.”
“It’s fine, it’s my honor to witness the great eastern lands’ divine weapon, Soaring Sword, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan chuckled.
Shangguan Feiyun and Baili Jingwei shared a nod and an evil grin.
[With the Soaring Sword’s location known, all that’s left is for them to make a move, humph…]
Hum~
But then the red sword aura flashed once more, followed by the Soaring Sword disregarding Shangguan Feiyun’s order as it attacked Zhuo Fan again. The immense pressure and savagery took his breath away.
Shangguan Feiyun narrowed his eyes and barked, “Soaring Sword, stop this instant! He’s my honored guest!”
Clang!
The Soaring Sword expressed its refusal with a ringing sound, still coming at Zhuo Fan to end him where he stood!
“Curses, I thought I told you to stop already!”
With a mask of rage, Shangguan Feiyun drew two fingers together and swiped. A sword energy shot straight at Soaring Sword.
Bam!
The sky cracked with a deafening thunder clap. The shockwave spread throughout the whole of Flying Cloud manor.
The guard held their ears in pain as they bled from eyes, nose and mouth. The weaker ones had it worse, knocked out on the spot.
Not that the closest Soul Harmony and Genesis Stage experts closest to Baili Jingwei and Zhuo Fan fared any better.
Lucky that Danqing Shen was there to take the brunt, canceling it with the gale he sent with a casual swipe of his hand.
It by no means managed to relieve Zhuo Fan of his frown, amazed by what he was seeing instead of feeling fear.
Soaring Sword actually halted at Shangguan Feiyun’s attack, even if it kept shaking in midair.
[This can’t be…]
Zhuo Fan was stunned once more by the Soaring Sword.
The sacred weapons were outrageously strong. He should know, since just one meager sword energy was enough to pierce his Qilin arm. How was it that now some guy’s attack got it stuck? Zhuo Fan was finding it hard to accept.
[Is that attack so much stronger than the sacred weapon?]
[That’s absurd! Even if it wasn’t a Sovereign made weapon, it’s a 6th grade sacred weapon for a reason. It just can’t be so weak as to be trapped under some mortal’s attack.]
But reality couldn’t be denied. Sword King Feiyun held more strength in handling Heavenly Sovereign’s sacred weapon than he who used tricks.
Hum~
The Soaring Sword rang as it shook in the air, but it was soon apparent it was growing weaker.
Shangguan Feiyun kept his fingers out all this time, “Getting weaker? Then get back in there and recover! Don’t let me catch you bursting out and scaring my guests again!”
Shangguan Feiyun flicked his hand and the Shangguan Feiyun was flung back. It tumbled through the air before entering the waterfall.
Zhuo Fan eased a breath, giving Shangguan Feiyun a long look.
[He really is the best in eastern lands for a reason.]
“Grandmaster Gu, everyone, I must apologize. I don’t know what has gotten into that divine sword to scare you. Please forgive me.” Shangguan Feiyun looked contrite as he cupped his hands.
Baili Jingwei laughed off-handedly, “That divine weapon has always been weird. It must be our sudden arrival into its domain that provoked the divine weapon. No apology necessary. We wouldn’t have gotten to witness Sword King Feiyun’s great skill otherwise. Sword King Feiyun’s Soaring Sword Art has improved even more, ha-ha-ha…”
“Prime Minister, there’s no need to joke. I take full responsibility for this mistake.”
Shangguan Feiyun chuckled and turned to Zhuo Fan, “I must’ve startled you, Grandmaster Gu. Why don’t you go to your room, now that it is ready, and rest for the day? I shall be personally giving you a tour of the garden tomorrow and use the chance to get closer.”
Zhuo Fan bowed, looking disturbed, but forced a smile. “Sword King is too kind. I can only accept the offer. Let us continue tomorrow.”
The others bowed and Danqing Shen said, “I’ll show Grandmaster Gu to his room.”
At the nod of the other two, Zhuo Fan and Danqing Shen walked out of sight. Baili Jingwei whined out of earshot, “Shangguan Feiyun, I only asked you to reveal the Soaring Sword to Grandmaster Gu to patch up the map, but you went overboard with making a scene and scaring him as well. He’s just a Radiant Stage cultivator. What if you scared his wits away too? How are you going to find me another talent with the potential to become the best alchemist in the world?”
“Prime Minister Baili, it wasn’t me!” Shangguan Feiyun frowned.
Baili Jingwei gave him a look, “Who else is there? You’re the only one in the Flying Cloud manor that commands the Soaring Sword.”
“That’s just it.”
Shangguan Feiyun gave a perplexed sigh, “I wanted to lead him to Jade Falls to give him a peek of the Soaring Sword. But for some strange reason, the sword came out by itself and attacked Grandmaster Gu. It had such a thick bloodlust too, that it overrode my command. This has never happened before.”
Baili Jingwei frowned, filled with doubt, “Does him being a stranger have anything to do with it I wonder?”
“The manor is filled with strangers, but none triggered Soaring Sword’s bloodlust. Just what is going on here?”
Shangguan Feiyun gnashed his teeth, his eyes flashing…

chapters.title: Chapter 898: Sacred Weapon Get
chapters.content:
Chapter 898: Sacred Weapon Get
Proofreader
: Papatonks
In the peaceful gardens, an old man and a youth walked shoulder to shoulder. The guards didn’t mind them once.
Zhuo Fan saw the coast was clear and gave Danqing Shen a questioning gaze, “Old Dan, how come Shangguan Feiyun has such an easy time controlling the Soaring Sword? Back in Double Dragon Manor the Vaulting Sword got me good. Its power isn’t something just anyone can block.”
“Can’t you tell? It’s because he grew up alongside the sword and understands its nature.” Danqing Shen glanced at him.
It only worked to puzzle Zhuo Fan more, “What’s that supposed to mean?”
“Boy, why do you think the factions covet the five divine weapons that can become guardian divine weapons?” Danqing Shen had a smirk on his face.
Zhuo Fan blurted, “Since the five divine weapons are outstanding, can cut anything, making the wielder fight ten at a time and can even kill a stage above the wielder. There’s nothing strange about being called a guardian divine weapon either.”
“Ha-ha-ha, wrong. What you describe there is anything with a sharp edge, not nearly enough for a divine weapon to earn the respect of all experts in the world. Why would the Invincible Sword be afraid and desire them then? I guess you haven’t entered Double Dragon Manor yet.
