Ha-ha, do you want to know why the nine sects of western lands would just send their disciples thousands of miles away to fight in the Double Dragon Gathering for the chance to cultivate in the Double Dragon Manor?”
“Since Double Dragon Manor monopolized the sacred stones, right?”
Zhuo Fan continued with a frown, “Sacred stones are the fastest way to groom outstanding disciples and guard western lands along with its resources and interests. What other reason is there?”
With a teasing grin, Danqing Shen nodded, “You’re not wrong there. But sacred stones aren’t limited to having a thick spiritual energy, they can also wash one’s marrow, improving a cultivator’s constitution. As for the most important reason, well, ha-ha-ha…”
Danqing Shen pointed at his head.
“Brains?” Zhuo Fan lit up.
Danqing Shen rolled his eyes, “Speaking of brains, there are many wise men out there who can use their heads far better than cultivators. Like Baili Jingwei and other high officials of empires, smarter than cultivators alike. Why is it that the Double Dragon Manor didn’t invite them over?”
“You mean…”
“Insight.”
Danqing Shen’s eyes shone, his voice firm, “Cultivators gain insight in the world around them. It’s a must to learn all the arts and skills out there. The level of insight will make two cultivators feel completely different despite using the same skill and having the same cultivation. Double Dragon Manor is holding their contest to look into the sects for seeds with high insight. I’m sure you noticed by now that power isn’t enough to get you in. While insight and power go hand in hand, it’s not always the case. You’ve seen the four girls’ array at the gathering, how weak it was. Yet they got invited anyway. This is the reason. That array holds the world, giving the four girls value in being nurtured.”
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow. Having mentioned Chu Qingcheng’s group, Danqing Shen reminded him of his pain. But he soon recovered, “What’s that got to do with the five divine weapons?”
“Plenty.”
Danqing Shen turned grave, “The divine weapons can open one’s mind, helping the user understand better arts and skills. That’s understanding, not learning. It’s not just handed to you on a jade slip, but something you discover out of nowhere. This is insight. A low insight blocks you from understanding the inner workings of the world and its Dao, while also stopping you from gaining a unique skill of your own.
“It’s why I have twin souls and the Dragon Cleaving Art. Everything stemmed from the insight the Vaulting Sword invested in me. The same applies to Shangguan Feiyun’s Soaring Sword Art he understood from the Soaring Sword. Almost every top expert of the lands has their power stemming from the understanding of the divine weapon. The level of their strength is set apart only by their insight. The most known is Invincible Sword Baili Yutian. That old freak’s Sundering Sword Art has reached perfection. Nothing and no one can stop him. But it’s not enough to make him relax, fearing there might be someone out there that would gain equal insights from other divine weapons like he did. That’s why…”
Shuddering, Zhuo Fan was so overwhelmed he blocked out Danqing Shen’s last words. He came to know a shocking secret. The five sacred weapons weren’t just in the 6th grade, but also contained Sword Sovereign’s sword path.
The mortal domain cultivators were walking the path of the sword Sword Sovereign treaded through these sacred weapons.
[That’s why Shangguan Feiyun can control the Soaring Sword. He got most of the Soaring Sword’s core sword skill that the Soaring Sword is based on.]
Heaven Trailing Sect’s High Venerable’s words came to mind just then. He was near the Vaulting Sword and understood in three days his unique skill, Heaven Trailing Sword.
Only his contact with the sacred weapon was very short, making his understanding lacking compared with Shangguan Feiyun and Danqing Shen who had great insights on top of being around the weapons for longer.
This was not to say the Heaven Trailing Sword wasn’t in a league of its own. Now that was a unique skill!
It meant that Shangguan Feiyun and Danqing Shen, who spent their days understanding the sacred weapon, more fully comprehended the Sword Sovereign’s sword. They of course were even more amazing.
Zhuo Fan now lost all his disdain for the top brass of the mortal domain. Looking at it from a certain angle, they were training in the arts of Sacred Domain, with the knowledge a Sovereign left behind.
Zhuo Fan turned serious, regretting how he had the Vaulting Sword with him for two years yet it was used as nothing more than a glorified paperweight, having learned nothing from it. Even if the sword spirit got swapped, the knowledge was still there somewhere.
He didn’t pick up swordsmanship all this time since he didn’t want to practice it and also because he saw no one around him worthy to teach him. Now though, the sacred weapon had inside a Sovereign’s legacy. How could he just let this monumental occasion slip by?
[That’s for later though. What takes priority is the job: sealing the World Wind Tunnel and giving this town the slip with young Sanzi.]
Seeing him deep in thought, obviously oblivious to his words, Danqing Shen rolled his eyes, “Anyways, be extra careful. Divine weapons are treasured anywhere in this world. The Shangguan clan isn’t here to get the Soaring Sword back just cause it’s sharp, but escape from Invincible Sword’s oppressive yoke, while also bearing the responsibility for future experts. This applies to all lands. If you plan on going after the divine weapon, know that not just Shangguan Feiyun, but even Baili Jingwei will come for you!”
“I know that. I’ll be extra careful.”
Zhuo Fan chuckled with a carefree smile.
Danqing Shen nodded after a long look. He knew just how smart Zhuo Fan was and that he had his own plans, so he just reminded him.
He then left Zhuo Fan in his room.
The next day, Shangguan Feiyun came to knock on his door to give him a tour of the premises and complete the map.
Zhuo Fan milked his new role for all its worth in the meanwhile, exploring the manor’s every corner. Raising questions and earning answers to any and all things he didn’t know or understand. The only thing missing were the holes the mice left in Shangguan Feiyun’s room. Other than that, he knew the place like the back of his hand.
In face of Zhuo Fan’s brazen and absurd requests, Shangguan Feiyun’s group acted off-handedly, answering every time. While grumbling inside.
[This spy is getting a bit out of hand here. He’s even asking about the guards’ shift change for god’s sake! Do we look like idiots to you? Anyone with half a brain will know you’re Shangguan clan’s spy the minute you ask that. What are you doing even asking them?]
Shangguan Feiyun noticed Zhuo Fan didn’t ask out brazen attitude, but out of awkwardness.
Just when Baili Jingwei was having enough of this poor excuse of a spy, Zhuo Fan’s next question took the cake, “I wonder if there are any secret escape tunnels out of the manor.”
[Not telling!]
Shangguan Feiyun’s face twitched and chuckled, “Grandmaster Gu, how can Flying Cloud manor have something like that? Why are you asking anyway?”
“Run.”
Zhuo Fan spoke with utter conviction, “I heard the manor was under attack by assassins a while back. I need to know so I can flee if they come again.”
Shangguan Feiyun gave him a long look. This was a sore spot for him.
[Why is he so cheerfully asking about it? Isn’t he scared I’ll suspect him?]
Baili Jingwei was far more astute.
[Grandmaster Gu isn’t as green as I thought. He knows how to probe for information.]
“Flying Cloud manor has the Sword King. There’s no thief who’d dare enter here. And we’ll be returning to the imperial capital soon. We’ll need Grandmaster Gu to look after the Crown Prince’s condition soon.”
Baili Jingwei’s meaning was clear.
[I came for the Crown Prince and have no time to dawdle around. Do what you need, attack the manor while at it, but I’ll be going either way.]
Zhuo Fan smiled and nodded, meeting Baili Jingwei’s eyes and sharing agreement.
The five days flew by and Zhuo Fan’s map was made whole as a result. Though he wasn’t exactly keen on giving it to the Shangguan clan.
As the Soaring Sword and the Jade Falls happened to be in the same place, he and them now had a conflict of interests. He needed lots of time for his job and that meant the Shangguan clan had to fight it out with Shangguan Feiyun, preferably elsewhere…

chapters.title: Chapter 899: Reporting
chapters.content:
Chapter 899: Reporting
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Grandmaster Gu, we’ll be setting off first thing in the morning.”
The dawn of the fourth day came yet Zhuo Fan hadn’t even asked to go back to his home, while Baili Jingwei had since been wanting him to do so from the start, so he gave Zhuo Fan the perfect excuse to report back, “Going to imperial capital will mean seeing the His Majesty and then His Highness to cure him. Things will get very complicated for a long time, making settling your family hard. You’re going to have to leave your family for a while, Grandmaster Gu. So before we go, would you like to go home and say your goodbyes? So you won’t appear cold.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, getting the gist, “Prime Minister is so thoughtful. It’s my intention as well.”
“Then Grandmaster Gu can return to his family for today and the Dragon Cleaving Sword King shall escort us to the imperial capital the next day. It’s been half a month now since I left the imperial capital and we can’t delay addressing the Crown Prince’s state any longer.” Baili Jingwei’s eyes flashed, looking restless.
Zhuo Fan grinned inside while giving a nod, “I admire Prime Minister’s devotion, a pillar of the nation and its people. Be at ease, sir, I shall give my very best in curing the Crown Prince once we arrive, as gratitude for Prime Minister’s favor now.”
“Thank you, Grandmaster Gu. The day is nevertheless short, so hurry back to your family!” Baili Jingwei waved him off with a kind smile.
Zhuo Fan retreated after a bow. Just as he faded from view, it was Shangguan Feiyun’s cue to step in from a side door, snickering, “Going to give his report?”
“Yes, now it’s their move, ha-ha-ha…” Beaming, Baili Jingwei leaned back on his chair, easing into it and feeling control over the entire board. None could escape his palm…
Zhuo Fan went to the Shangguan clan with a clear mind and intent, to give them the map they tasked him to patch up.
He just opened the door and Shangguan Qingyan yanked him in, not forgetting to stick her head out after and check if the coast was clear. She closed the door shut and pulled him to the parlor.
“Hurry up, dad and everyone are getting impatient!”
“Uncle’s waiting for me?”
Zhuo Fan asked, “Baili Jingwei only let me off today. How did you guys know so fast?”
Shangguan Qingyan rolled her eyes, “Of course we didn’t know. Dad and the venerables had always been eager for good news ever since you left, waiting and waiting. But then it took five days. Any longer and dad would’ve sent me over to ask for you.”
Nodding, Zhuo Fan saw just how crucial the operation was for Shangguan Feixiong, and how tense they were because of it.
Better for him, actually, since it made fooling them easier. Getting to be the final winner in this mission was going to be a walk in the park now.
Zhuo Fan grinned, letting Shangguan Qingyan take him to the parlor. Shangguan Feixiong and the others were beyond restless, pacing all over the place. Maybe the chairs had splinters in them?
“Dad, Sir Gu is back!”
Her bright voice echoed throughout the room, pulling on everyone’s jittery heartstrings. Every pair of eyes were fixed on Zhuo Fan’s plain face with a burning gaze.
Seeing him so casual filled them with respect and expectations. It was like meeting their ancestors.
Shangguan Feixiong stepped forward and took a deep breath. He grabbed Zhuo Fan’s shoulder and spoke eagerly, “Yifan, y-you’re back at last.”
Sss~
The wait was too much on Shangguan Feixiong’s nerves, forgetting himself and squeezing hard. Zhuo Fan winced.
“Uncle, y-your hand…”
“Oh, sorry, I got a little too excited there, ha-ha-ha…” Letting go, Shangguan Feixiong gave an awkward smile, then he turned serious, “Yifan, how is it? Is the map…”
Grinning from ear to ear, Zhuo Fan’s hand glowed to reveal a white paper cover in squiggles most defined and intricate.
“Uncle, rest easy knowing that there’s not a stone unchecked in the manor when I made this map!”
Snatching the map in eagerness, he also took out the map Shangguan Qingyan made for comparison, “Ha-ha-ha, it is indeed more detailed than Yan’er’s. And it includes the five blank spots as well with added details. But where exactly are these five places? Why are they under heavy guard and restricted? Do you know, Yifan?”
“How could I have not looked into it? That would mean I’d be endangering my Shangguan clan’s brothers!”
Zhuo Fan beamed and pointed at the map with pride, “Uncle, here is the treasury, filled with the manor’s valuables. Here is the barracks, where the guards rotate and the armory is located, holding demonic treasures and spiritual weapons. And this here is Shangguan Feiyun’s private quarters, holding his wives, children, cultivation partners. What a rotten degenerate, how come he has so many cultivation partners? What about me?”
Zhuo Fan looked green with envy, wishing to replace Shangguan Feiyun in nightly cultivation.
But then his words got cut off by the sharp kick in the leg, making him cry out.
He looked back to see a pair of raging eyes boring holes into him.
Shangguan Qingyan glared and was ticked off, “You’re supposed to be scouting the manor, not the guy’s harem. Did you already forget about your wife in western lands?”
“Yifan, you’re going overboard here. This is no time to think about dual cultivation, you’re on a mission here. Be more serious!”
Glaring at him, Shangguan Feixiong chided as well, now also holding his shoulder, “Though to train in Shangguan clan’s Soaring Sword Art, we have no choice but to resort to dual cultivation as well as we need to expel the savage energy inside us. Once we get back to eastern lands, I’ll personally teach you this ultimate skill. No need to rush it.”
Zhuo Fan was intrigued.
[So that’s why Shangguan Feiyun didn’t look like a genuine horn dog. It’s because he’s doing it to cultivate.]
He got the shock of his life when Shangguan Feiyun took him to his private quarters. With seventy-two concubines around, this Sword King was an emperor in his own right.
When he thought Sir Sword King was about to give him a couple, he found that he was here to take a peek and that was it.
[Thank heavens I’m no leecher, or that glorious view would’ve haunted me for the rest of my life.]
Now he knew that this was related to the skill in the Soaring Sword. It was too savage for just anyone to learn and they had to vent it somehow before it did more harm than good. The best way just happened to be dual cultivation.
Zhuo Fan nodded and the other Shangguan clansmen gave back a knowing smile.
Shangguan Qingyan was looking a bit dark there, among them, “Humph, with a degenerate master one only gets degenerate disciples. Is that how a Clan Head acts? Where’s the honor in that?”
“Ahe-hem, right, right, let’s get back on topic.”
With an embarrassed smile, Shangguan Feixiong patted Zhuo Fan’s head, pinning the blame on him, “Don’t lead us along kid, this is serious, deadly so. How could you distract us so much? Now, what about the remaining two areas?”
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes and cursed.
[You’re just upright in the wrong place. I hardly ever did dual cultivation myself while your clan does it on a daily basis for cultivation. You have the nerve to point your finger at me? Just how many maidens have you ruined?]
He made sure to keep that part to himself, while giving them a knowing nod, giving this discount uncle a scapegoat. He continued, “This is Shangguan Feiyun’s resting room, under tight guard of course. And this is something called Jade Falls, a paradise with thick spiritual energy. It is here where I saw a peculiar item, eastern lands’ divine weapon, Soaring Sword!”
[Soaring Sword is in there?]
Shangguan Feixiong’s eyes shook, his face filled with joy. He turned to see the rest were just as happy.
They had charged in last time without knowing of Soaring Sword’s location and had spent half an hour searching to no avail. Now they knew where it was, they had a target to follow.
[The mission will work!]
Everyone was excited, with Shangguan Feixiong’s face growing red, unable to calm down…

chapters.title: Chapter 900: Real and Fake Maps
chapters.content:
Chapter 900: Real and Fake Maps
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Yifan, you’ve done exemplary work once more, ha-ha-ha!”
Shangguan Feixiong’s lips quivered as he laughed, unable to hold himself from slamming Zhuo Fan’s shoulder again and making Zhuo Fan wince under the force.
He only had those teary eyes to show for the pressure he was under.
Blocking the man from crushing him some more, Zhuo Fan beamed, “Uncle, are you after the Soaring Sword?”
“Yes, with how you’ve done the clan such great service twice, I’ll tell you.”
Shangguan Feixiong sighed, “The highest powers of Shangguan have gone through a great journey from the eastern lands to the central area. But it wasn’t to get the traitor Shangguan Feiyun, since we couldn’t defeat him even back home, to say nothing in his own turf. We did it all for the greatest treasure of eastern lands, Soaring Sword. It must be hard to imagine just how important it is to us.”
Zhuo Fan kept his understanding of the matter silent.
Though if it weren’t for Danqing Shen’s mention, he’d still be oblivious of the five sacred weapons’ roles. That the sacred weapon was not just a single man’s strength, but the glory of a clan.
[Of course they’d go through hell to get it back…]
Shangguan Feixiong took his silence for ignorance and chuckled as he thanked, “Anyway, Yifan, because of you, Shangguan clan’s glory will continue. The clan will never forget what you’ve done for us. You’re our most glorious member!”
“Really? Does that mean I can strut around the clan?”
Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan chuckled, putting on a mischievous act.
Shangguan Feixiong laughed and the rest no longer disdained him, but found this step young master to be trustworthy and valuable, even cute.
Shangguan Yulin was the only one watching from way back with a poisonous stare.
Shangguan Feixiong signaled the men to calm down and looked at them with confidence, “Men, we’ve been at odds because of the dangers regarding the mission, now I dare say this chance is providence. With this map, the Flying Cloud manor can have two Sword Kings, and can have Baili Jingwei, but it means nothing! We will strike fast, take the Soaring Sword and return to eastern lands at once. And they won’t be able to do anything to stop us!”
“Uhm, uncle, I don’t know about two Sword Kings, just that Flying Cloud manor only has Shangguan Feiyun.” Zhuo Fan grinned.
Shangguan Feixiong started, “What?”
“Ha-ha-ha, Baili Jingwei is worried about the Crown Prince’s condition and wants to take me as the main alchemist back to the imperial capital, with the Dragon Cleaving Sword King acting as guard.”
Zhuo Fan muttered, “That’s why Baili Jingwei had me return today to look after my family before we go tomorrow.”
Shangguan Feixiong looked at him long with a stumped gaze, “You’re serious?”
“Baili Jingwei said it himself and so did Dragon Cleaving Sword King. It has to be real.” Zhuo Fan said.
Shangguan Feiyun shuddered, then finally reacted, ” Ha-ha-ha, providence indeed! Heaven has blessed the Shangguan clan. Baili Jingwei and Dragon Cleaving Sword King are leaving, with only Shangguan Feiyun remaining. Now our success is nigh, ha-ha-ha…”
“Congratulations, Clan Head, with heaven’s gift, we will succeed for sure!” The rest joined in with their excitement.
Everyone was happy, so much so they were acting as if it was a blowout, like the Soaring Sword was in their hands.
Shangguan Feixiong used the lively spirits to work on the plan of attack on the manor for the second time.
Looking at them fired up, Zhuo Fan had a quirky smile.
[On this earth, it’s not providence, but me helping you. Though I do have to thank you for helping me as well, ha-ha-ha…]
Whoosh!
Hours passed and after intense debates, Shangguan Feixiong’s team settled on a strategy. They would engage three days after Baili Jingwei left.
Standing in a somewhat hidden corner, Shangguan Yulin learned of this and slipped away, to a secluded spot to send a jade slip flying towards the manor.
Darting his head around, looking for any faces, Shangguan Yulin returned in equal silence to his room.
Closing the door, a quite familiar darkness took him once more. His senses were blind in this abyss, unable to see his own fingers.
Face twitching, Shangguan Yulin’s heart reached rock bottom, lamenting his fate as he groveled on the ground. He banged his head three times and declared, “Greetings, master!”
“Ha-ha-ha, you’re looking quite sharp this time around, kid.”
“Master, it’s only natural for a disciple to greet this master with the respect sir deserves.” With a revolted look, Shangguan Yulin looked to be used to it by now, being as meek as a wee lamb.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, “I must say, you’ve elevated your shamelessness to a whole new level. You truly live up to the title I bestowed upon you, degenerate demon, ha-ha-ha…”
Shangguan Yulin turned a deaf ear, his face stony.
“Well, that’s enough smalltalk. Where’s the map? “
Zhuo Fan squinted, cutting straight to the chase, “And before you say it’s not done yet, I saw the kid return with my own eyes.”
Shangguan Yulin inhaled deeply and revealed a white paper, a copy he made, “Master, I prepared this map of the manor for you. I ask that master receives it.”
“Well done, for being tactful too, he-he-he…”
The map flew into the darkness and Zhuo Fan inspected it
[Is Shangguan Yulin that sincere to not mess with it at all?]
Soon though, Shangguan Yulin looked at the abyss and reported, “Master, you must be after the Soaring Sword as well, right?”
“Well, aren’t you chatty?”
Glancing over, Zhuo Fan said, “What’s it to you?”
Shangguan Yulin paused and said, “He-he-he, if yes, I urge master to act three days later.”
“Why?”
“It’s the same day that Shangguan clan will attack and master can use the chaos to your advantage.” Shangguan Yulin sported a nasty smirk.
Zhuo Fan mocked, “Why are you so nice to me?”
“A master a day, a father for life. I can no more be rude to master than I could denounce my own father.” Shangguan Yulin raised an eyebrow as he spouted corny stuff with a straight face.
Zhuo Fan had a total disbelieving mocking tone, “What about your clan, or your lord?”
“They are nothing compared to master.” With a wide smile, Shangguan Yulin said, “Only you dictate my fate!”
Zhuo Fan gave him a long look, “That does make some sense.”
“Also, master, you know that I’m working for the Flying Cloud manor. That means the Shangguan clan’s attack to get the Soaring Sword will be a trap. Master would gain nothing if you plan on taking the divine sword from them.”
Shangguan Yulin gave another deep bow, as if advising Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan faked anger, “What’s that supposed to mean? First you want me to use the chaos to my advantage and now you’re telling me not to ? Are you mocking me?”
“No, that’s not it, master!”
Shangguan Yulin snickered, “Barging into the manor after Shangguan clan isn’t a good plan. Only when the two sides fight will the chance become obvious. It won’t get any easier than then to steal the divine sword. That’s why I suggest master capitalize on this diversion to get away with the sword.”
Zhuo Fan squinted, “Speak!”
“Master, please consider giving the map a careful look. There are two areas, the easternmost one where Jade Falls where the Soaring Sword is and the northernmost one where Shangguan Feiyun’s resting room is. First is the original place of the sword while the second where Shangguan Feiyun will hide it. In my time at the manor, I’ve seen Shangguan Feiyun taking the Soaring Sword to his room. The spiritual energy there is also thick, not just for cultivating, but to store the Soaring Sword as well. “
Shangguan Yulin had an evil smile, “They know the Shangguan clan’s moves and will hide the divine sword. So it has to be in the second location. When the two sides meet at the Jade Falls, master can slip into the Sword King’s room and steal the sword with none the wiser.”
[Talk about twisted words.]
Zhuo Fan had a cold smile.
Having turned every pebble over in the manor, there was no one who knew the Flying Cloud manor better than him.
[This punk’s nonsense is meant to incite me to go in and get me killed.]
[I bet he sent fake info as well, making Shangguan Feiyun place a trap there. Too bad for you since I fiddled with the map from the start and reported a fake, humph…]

chapters.title: Chapter 901: Twisted Reality
chapters.content:
Chapter 901: Twisted Reality
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Whoosh!
On the half a meter wide table between Baili Jingwei and Shangguan Feiyun were placed the finest drinks and dishes, adding to the enjoyment of the tranquil lake nearby.
The two were relishing the view, the company and the wine without a care.
There was a sound and Baili Jingwei held out his hand for a jade slip to land in it.
Shangguan Feiyun’s eyes flashed, “Ha-ha-ha, already?”
“I have to say, Sword King, your nephew is certainly a go-getter, ha-ha-ha…” Baili Jingwei chuckled.
Shangguan Feiyun waved him off, “As if, it’s more like that brother of mine is too rushed, or, like Prime Minister said, greedy. How else do you explain his hastily drawn out plan?”
Their eyes met and burst out laughing with ridicule.
Baili Jingwei scanned the jade slip closely and nodded with a smile. Though something did catch his attention, so much so he was feeling suspicious.
“What is it, Prime Minister? What is the problem?”
“Shangguan Feixiong will strike three days after we leave.”
“Isn’t that great? The trap is set and all that’s left is for them to spring it. Prime Minister, is there something nagging you?” Shangguan Feiyun looked curious at first, but dismissed his worries after he heard the info inside the jade slip.
Baili Jingwei’s doubts remained, “Shangguan Feiyun plans to raid the Jade Falls with his experts while the three strongest venerables will be going after your resting room to kill you. If all goes well, great, but if not, they will hold you back while the others steal the Soaring Sword.”
“Humph, a mere pipe dream!”
Shangguan Feiyun disregarded his worry, “They want to cut me off? Then I’ll lay two traps, real experts in my room where I’ll stay guard as well and send the rest of the men to Jade Falls, where Prime Minister will direct with brother Danqing’s assistance. They can get in, but there’s no leaving with two Sword Kings around, ha-ha-ha….”
Baili Jingwei nodded, but his conscience wasn’t eased, “Be that as it may, something is strange here…”
“Prime Minister, what is it now? Is something off?”
“The plan is solid, only the details are weird.”
Baili Jingwei’s eyes flashed and passed the jade slip over, “Sword King Feiyun, notice the map Shangguan Yulin attached inside.”
Shangguan Feiyun was starting to be suspicious as well.
[I let that Grandmaster Gu make it so what’s there to see? It’s not like I don’t know my own home.]
“Three days later, the Shangguan clan will split in two before attacking. Shangguan Feixiong will lead his men to attack the easternmost area of the manor, Jade Falls, and steal the Soaring Sword. While the three venerables will ambush Sword King’s room, the northernmost place. To kill and to stop the enemy so the Clan Head can succeed, ugh…”
Shangguan Feiyun was casual as he read, but then his eyes landed on the map, “Jade Falls in the east? But it’s in the west side. And then my room in the north is actually in the southeast. Just what is up with this map?”
Baili Jingwei wore a mask of doubt, “Shangguan Yulin supplied this map and, by all accounts, shouldn’t be an attempt at cheating us. At least he was so blatantly obvious about it. He is oblivious to everything in the Flying Cloud manor, unlike us. The only logical explanation is that this is the same map he got from Shangguan Feixiong, this fake. The clan got a fake map!”
“A fake?!”
Shangguan Feiyun was baffled, “How in hell is it fake? You’re saying Grandmaster Gu handed this fake to them? Why would he do that?”
Baili Jingwei frowned, deep in thought.
[Logic says Gu Yifan is relying on Shangguan clan, a crutch to lean on and ride their coattails to success.]
[But he gave them a fake map, botching their plans and turning from their confidante to a traitor. He only gets to lose from it.]
[Is he committed to becoming the Sword Star Empire’s alchemist? Is that why he’s breaking it off with the Shangguan clan?]
[That’s not right either or he’d be throwing his lot with us by using the fake map to catch the clan in one fell swoop.]
[Any betrayal should be done fully, not randomly, or he won’t get anything out of it.]
The Shangguan clan had patched their lacking knowledge with the fake map, but they wouldn’t lose that much because of it. And with the failure of the second ambush, they would no longer have any chance of attacking the manor while the Shangguan clan would hate Gu Yifan’s guts.
While on the manor’s side, being in the dark to the source of this fake map, they couldn’t give Grandmaster Gu any credit for the results.
[He gets nothing from either side. So why?]
The Prime Minister Baili Jingwei was having a headache as well with this conundrum, let alone Shangguan Feiyun.
Baili Jingwei finaly shouted, “Who were the ones watching over Grandmaster Gu in the manor? Call them here, now!”
“Yes, sir!”
Someone shouted and soon two guards were before him, bowing, “Prime Minister, Sword King, how may we be of service?”
“Are you two the ones who looked after Grandmaster Gu during his stay at the manor?”
“Per the lord’s order, we kept Grandmaster Gu safe!”
“Was anything off about Grandmaster Gu’s actions?”
Baili Jingwei’s eyes flashed, his words startling the guards as they replied, “Many things earned our suspicion. Like constantly asking about the path between Jade Falls and Sword King’s home, about the restricted areas. Prime Minister and lord might not know, but he also had us show him the way…”
“I get it. We already know about that, but is there anything else?” Shangguan Feiyun waved him off.
[That’s something I allowed so Gu Yifan could finish his map.]
Baili Jingwei’s brow shook and jumped in, “Wait, you mean he constantly asked you? Why?”
“Prime Minister, what’s wrong about that? All spies will inquire…”
“We’ve taken him everywhere through the manor, so why is he still asking others? And not just once either.” Baili Jingwei cut him off with a serious look.
Shangguan Feiyun was stumped.
[Yeah, now why is that? Afraid he won’t be found out? We personally toured him around the place so why? Maybe…]
Shangguan Feiyun glanced at Baili Jingwei, who was fixed on the guards.
One guard finally spoke, “Grandmaster Gu is very suspicious. He kept saying he’ll go to Jade Falls, but always ended up at the barracks saying the manor was too big every time…”
“All right, we get it. You may go.”
Baili Jingwei dismissed them.
The guards bowed and left puzzled.
Baili Jingwei chuckled, “Sword King, you get it now?”
“Of course, the guy has a direction problem.”
Shangguan Feiyun’s face twitched and sighed, “Who’d have thought a great 11th grade alchemist ends up being directionally challenged? What makes it worse, he’s a spy! Ha-ha-ha, well that’s a first, using a guy with poor direction as a spy. Of course the map is all jumbled, not knowing which is north, south, east or west. I bet Shangguan Feiyun would’ve spurted blood feet high if he knew his map was drawn by a disoriented guy, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Jingwei smiled, “Nobody’s perfect, being drafted by them, he acts like the terrible spy he is. Of course he’s liable to slip up, ha-ha-ha…”
“Slip up? Such poor direction is worse than anyone’s!” Shangguan Feiyun mocked, but then frowned, “Though are you sure he’s directionally challenged? An 11th grade alchemist at that?”
Baili Jingwei’s brow shook, and paused, “This is the only explanation for what I know so far. Consider him having poor direction.”
“Then our plan…”
“We stick to it. The only change is that we’ll be following this fake map.”
Baili Jingwei grinned, “Even with the twisted reality thanks to the fake map, the Shangguan clan will be caught all the same, ha-ha-ha…”
Shangguan Feiyun nodded, “I thought of moving the Soaring Sword, just in case, but since the map is fake, there’s no point…”

chapters.title: Chapter 902: T’was the Night Before The Ambush
chapters.content:
Chapter 902: T’was the Night Before The Ambush
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Dad, are they really dragging the fight elsewhere?”
In the pitch-black night, only the moonlight was shining some light upon the world, giving it a chilling air. The many houses in the city had their own faint yellow candlelight, in hope of dispelling the coldness.
Gu Santong lay in bed, eyes staring at Zhuo Fan polishing his demonic sword under the lamplight.
With an evil grin, Zhuo Fan replied, “Yep, Flying Cloud manor’s move hinges on Shangguan clan’s attack. While Shangguan clan’s moves are following the map I provided. By now, the same map should be back in the manor. Ha-ha-ha, this way both sides’ actions are under my control. They’ll fight wherever I want them to without a choice, humph…”
Zhuo Fan looked mighty pleased with his handiwork, confidence stemming from manipulating the whole board and its rules.
“What will we be doing then?”
Gu Santong muttered, “Could we help Shangguan clan after we set up the drawing array in the Jade Falls?”
Zhuo Fan gave him a glance before fixating back on his precious demonic sword, “Who cares about them? We do our own thing and ignore the rest so as to not invite more trouble. Flying Cloud manor now has two Sword Kings and a Prime Minister on top. The Shangguan clan stands no chance. I used Shangguan Yulin to send fake info and scatter their forces. That should be enough breather for the Shangguan clan. Though not like it’ll be for long.”
“When the experts waiting in Shangguan Feiyun’s room realize the attack won’t be coming, the trap stemming from the fake info I had Shangguan Yulin send will collapse. When the two sides converge, the Shangguan clan will fall, but it’s not certain if they will get wiped out. But their annihilation will work in our favor, their dying struggle buying us time to set the array. He-he-he, at least they died for something.”
Zhuo Fan mocked, a tyrant lifting his sword above a mountain of skeletons, using the blood of all living things to write his own rise.
Gu Santong sighed in silence.
Zhuo Fan’s hand paused from cleaning the demonic sword, picking up on young Sanzi’s mood. He no longer looked evil, now giving his son a bright smile, “I know you don’t like hanging with these people and grew tired of this place. Anyway, these three days will go by fast, so just bear with it. Ha-ha-ha, then according to Shangguan Feixiong’s plan, the experts will attack while the juniors will leave. You’ll slip away from them in the meantime to where we established. Don’t forget the escape we set up before we got to Flying Cloud City, the Big Dipper Flinging Array, he-he-he…”
“That means there’s only the two of us surviving, walking all over their lives…” Gu Santong muttered downcast.
Zhuo Fan didn’t notice, too caught up in cleaning his great demonic sword and his dream of learning to use the sword…
Knock~
Someone was at the door. Zhuo Fan paused from cleaning and asked, “Who is it?”
“It’s me.”
Zhuo Fan heard Shangguan Qingyan saying, “Mister Gu, are you free?”
[What’s this chick up to at this hour?]
Giving Gu Santong a puzzled look, Zhuo Fan knew he had to reply, “I’ll be right there.”
Zhuo Fan gazed upon the frail figure as she stepped in, “What got you coming here so late?”
“Is young Sanzi asleep?” Shangguan Qingyan was being awfully subtle.
Zhuo Fan gave a casual answer, “Kids are in bed at this hour. What do you…”
“Come with me!”
Shangguan Qingyan cut him off by pulling his hand outside, in the back, then relaxed seeing no one around, “No one will disturb us here…”
“Disturb us?”
Zhuo Fan watched the clear face reflected in the moonlight and rubbed his hands, “Miss Shangguan, first you made sure young Sanzi is asleep and now you invited me in this secluded area. Ha-ha-ha, I’m shocked by your forwardness. I know my charm and I am quite fascinating that some girls just can’t keep away from me, but I’m a married man and have a child. I’m not that kind of guy. But since you insist, I guess I, ugh…”
The sudden attack had him crying out.
He saw Shangguan Qingyan pinching his thigh and twisting hard.
Zhuo Fan struggled out of her clutches, “What was that all about?”
“Why else if not for talking trash?”
Shangguan Qingyan huffed and glared, “I asked for you for a good reason but your mind is clearly in the gutter. The only reason you’re still conscious is because you’re married.”
Zhuo Fan ignored her tantrum, “How noble of you, despite being in a clan that trains in dual cultivation to vent. Isn’t uncle a married man too?”
“It’s because the Shangguan clan’s men are like that so I can’t stand it…”
Shangguan Qingyan waved her angry fist around, though she put it away without using it, “Fine, let’s just forget it. But you must get your wife back. Focus only on that and don’t do anything that might break her heart.”
Zhuo Fan shook, his face heavy, “What’s it to you?”
“Nothing, I just… it’s what I hope.”
Shangguan Qingyan sighed, “Tomorrow you’re going with Baili Jingwei to the imperial capital and we might never see each other again. But don’t worry, I’ll look after young Sanzi and do my best to find his mother so that all of you will be reunited. I just hope that once you achieve success, there won’t be another woman.”
Zhuo Fan stared at her, “What do you mean? Didn’t uncle want to take me to eastern lands?”
“Dad did promise you that, but now, ha-ha…”
Shangguan Qingyan gave a wry smile, “Everything’s changed. Dad is the Clan Head and sometimes the clan’s future comes first, at the detriment of being disloyal on occasions. If you were still the same Gu Yifan that lent us your house to hide, dad would’ve taken you. But Baili Jingwei treated you as his most honored guest. And now, having helped the clan draw out their attack plan. So they…”
Words came hard to Shangguan Qingyan the longer she spoke, “They decided to be practical.”
“Practical?”
“Favor you if alive or abandon you if dead.”
Shangguan Qingyan looked crushed as she continued, “You know that dad will attack three days after you and Baili Jingwei leave. Regardless of the outcome, there’s only two endings for you. Baili Jingwei will find you out for giving us the map, executing you on the spot, or Baili Jingwei will still see you in high regard and you will forever remain as Shangguan clan’s spy in the central area.”
“Didn’t uncle say they’ll accept me after the ambush succeeded?”
Shangguan Qingyan shook her head with a bitter smile, “With Baili Jingwei, the Prime Minister, having so many experts at his side and Dragon Cleaving Sword King on top, after dad gets Soaring Sword, they aren’t about to risk it over the likes of you. Their plan is to use you. If you die, the Shangguan clan will be ever grateful, raising young Sanzi as their own. If you live, young Sanzi will become hostage and force you to work for eastern lands. But don’t worry, I will definitely get you back one day.”
Zhuo Fan squinted and nodded.
Zhuo Fan’s speculation reached this part as well and totally ignored it. He was just that confident since…
[We’ll see who uses who.]
[In a clash between bigshots, there’s no room for niceties nor kindness, only interest.]
That was how Baili Jingwei was and the same applied to Shangguan Feiyun. So how could Shangguan Feixiong, known for his righteous character be any lesser?
It didn’t change the fact they were still going to lose in this endeavor because they failed to even realize that there was another player having sneaked into their little game.
[Ignorance gets you killed.]
Zhuo Fan grinned and nodded, “Thank you.”
“No need for thanks, just be careful. If all goes well, I’ll be sure to send young Sanzi to you, to help you two be reunited.”
Shangguan Qingyan spoke with resolve then bid her goodbye.
Zhuo Fan waited for her to leave, “Young Sanzi, come out. The chick is gone.”
Whoosh~
Gu Santong was by Zhuo Fan’s side in a flash of scarlet.
“The chick spouted so much tripe.”
Zhuo Fan snickered, his eyes cold, “I’ve never trusted one of them from the start. My life will always be in my hands. I won’t ever give it to anyone else!”
Zhuo Fan walked back, patting young Sanzi’s head, “Come, young Sanzi, this doesn’t change anything.”
Gu Santong nodded but sometimes peeked behind.
[Auntie does care about him…]

chapters.title: Chapter 903: Blindsided
chapters.content:
Chapter 903: Blindsided
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Before the rooster could announce the coming of a new dawn, a group of men were packed and ready in front of the Flying Cloud manor gate. All wore their finest, oozing nobility, yet just thirty of them were so excited they were bursting with joy and glee at their meteoric success. Such were the selected from the Pill King Convention.
Giving them a look of disdain, Baili Jingwei sneered. Talents like these, and that was already overstating it, were only good as props for his plan. He’ll just hand them over to the real alchemists as servants when they got to the imperial capital.
[Imperial family’s alchemist? Ha!]
Shangguan Feiyun’s thoughts were the same, watching these delusional bums with equal scorn.
Thump~
A man and a woman were approaching this group with light steps.
Baili Jingwei cupped his hands and sported a vague smile, “Grandmaster Gu, have you settled your matters? May we set off?”
“Thank you, Prime Minister, for your concern. Everything is in order.”
Zhuo Fan returned the gesture with a light bow before turning to Shangguan Qingyan and putting on a yearning face, “I’ll be gone for a long time in the imperial capital and I’d be grateful if cousin will look after young Sanzi.”
Shangguan Qingyan’s expressive eyes were filled with complex emotions, but only nodded, “Don’t worry, I’m young Sanzi’s aunt and will give my all to take care of him. I’ll be sure to bring him to you personally and reduce the longing.”
“Thank you.”
Zhuo Fan sighed and cupped his hands at Baili Jingwei, “Prime Minister, we can go.”
“All is in order for mister as well.”
Then he shouted, “Set off!”
“Yes, sir!”
The guards, over a hundred, made of Soul Harmony and Genesis Stage experts, escorted the others in a grand fashion. Dragon Cleaving Sword King had a flat look, at the side, while Sword King Feiyun cupped his hand and saw them off.
Shangguan Qingyan watched them go, her worried eyes ever on Zhuo Fan.
Shangguan Feiyun grinned and teased, “Miss Gu, Grandmaster Gu will be part of the inner circle now, gaining a nobility rank and having anything he could ever want. There’s no cause for worrying either, not with Danqing Shen and Prime Minister watching over. Everything will be fine, bar treason. You should be happy for him, ha-ha-ha…”
Shangguan Qingyan’s lips fell in dismay, looking at him with a crooked smile worse than crying, only to sigh and leave.
“The minute Prime Minister Baili is out, seal the city and impose a curfew!”
The commanding voice echoed behind her, “Those thieves might have slipped away with the visit of Prime Minister, but I’d rather be on the safe side. Comb the city and root them out! I won’t tolerate the Shangguan clan causing chaos in my Flying Cloud City!”
Shangguan Qingyan paused, her face hard as she rushed faster for the Gu household.
Looking at her so eager to report, Shangguan Feiyun’s eyes flashed, his smile particularly crafty.
[By Prime Minister’s plan, we should ease their minds. No, we should incite their greed, ha-ha-ha…]
Minutes later, Shangguan Qingyan rushed into the parlor to see Shangguan Feixiong and his experts waiting for her news.
“Dad!”
Shangguan Qingyan flushed with anger, “Shangguan Feiyun will place the city in lockdown and search it for our people once Baili Jingwei left. He said that he only loosened his guard and gave us the chance to escape only because Baili Jingwei happened to come.”
Shangguan Feixiong looked at the three venerables and his experts and saw their nods.
“It’s as we thought. Baili Jingwei came with the Crown Prince’s matter in mind and not for us. With Shangguan Feiyun’s prideful character, he’ll never admit his manor was attacked, hiding it from Baili Jingwei. He’d then resume the search once he leaves.”
“Yes, that’s Shangguan Feiyun’s style, everything for appearances. That means Baili Jingwei and Danqing Shen won’t be a part of this plan, not when they are oblivious of it. Our enemy is only one, Shangguan Feiyun!”
“Right…”
“Great, now we don’t have to face two Sword Kings…”
…
Everyone voiced their agreement with joy.
A shout came as a man barged in and bowed, “Clan Head, Baili Jingwei’s procession is fifty miles out with no sign of turning back. They’re almost out of sight and gone for good. They’re also looking to be in a rush, with nothing flashy to denote Prime Minister is among them…”
“That explains why Baili Jingwei came to Flying Cloud City without notice. He’s truly worried about the Crown Prince’s situation.”
Shangguan Feixiong nodded, “Now all doubts have been lifted, knowing Baili Jingwei has only been a guest here and nothing more. Now that they left, we don’t need to bother with them.”
They all nodded, with a venerable’s eyes shining as his voice rose, “The Shangguan clan won’t miss this chance providence laid before us. In three days, we strike! “
“Yes, sir!”
They all cheered, as if victory was in sight. Only Shangguan Yulin, in his little dark corner, sported a creepy smile…
While the Shangguan clan got fired up and ready for the big raid, Baili Jingwei’s group was now a day away when he stopped.
Zhuo Fan faked obliviousness as he asked, “Prime Minister, do you need rest?”
“Ha-ha-ha, I may not be much of an expert, but I am an 8th layer Ethereal Stage cultivator. A day of walking isn’t enough to tire me.”
Baili Jingwei grinned.
Zhuo Fan gave him a long look, “Then…”
“Return!”
Baili Jingwei casually pointed at the Soul Harmony experts, “You, you and you, are to escort the thirty alchemists to the imperial capital. The rest of you will follow me back to Flying Cloud City!”
Zhuo Fan shuddered and showed a bright and clueless smile, “Prime Minister, what do you mean?”
“Ha-ha-ha, Grandmaster Gu, you’ll know soon enough.”
Baili Jingwei showed a vague smile and waved for two Soul Harmony experts to flank Zhuo Fan and grab his shoulders, taking him away.
Zhuo Fan started, “Prime Minister Baili, what are you doing?”
“Taking Grandmaster Gu back to the city.”
“But we just got a day away from Flying Cloud City and had those other alchemists escorted to the imperial capital. I should go with them. If you have a pressing matter, you can return by yourself, why take me as well?”
Paling and panicking, Zhuo Fan forced himself to sweat to make the act even more believable.
Baili Jingwei gave a mocking smile, taunting, “Grandmaster Gu, I’m bringing you along to enjoy the show.”
“A show?”
“Quite.”
Baili Jingwei’s eyes shone, “This act shall be known as ‘Blindsided’!”
Zhuo Fan shook harder, overwhelmed
Baili Jingwei signaled the guards to hold Zhuo Fan as they flew to Flying Cloud City. Prime Minister’s many powerful guards were gone in a blink, gone back to the city in secret.
All that remained were three Soul Harmony experts and the stumped alchemist looking at each other like a cow looking at a new gate.
[What just happened?]
[Are you taking us to the imperial capital, to enjoy riches and live glorious lives? Why are there just two guards left and the others up and ran off? Do we mean so little?]
[We’re future imperial alchemists here!]
“Step it up!”
As they were trying to make sense of it and failing, the Soul Harmony experts barked at them.
The prideful alchemists were annoyed, with someone having the bright idea to voice his discontent, “What’s the rush? Don’t you know I’m to be an imperial alchemist? Who the hell are you to order me…”
Bam!
His ranting came to an abrupt stop, only a bloody mist remaining of his trace in this cruel world.
A guard wiped his hand, glancing at the others with disdain, “Prime Minister ordered us to escort you to the imperial capital, and kill any who refuse!”
That was the cruel truth. Baili Jingwei never gave a hoot about them. All he cared about was not letting them flee, to plug any leak, though only for these three days…
The alchemist watched the blood soak the earth with empty eyes, their minds out of commission.
[Weren’t we imperial alchemists? How can a mere guard treat us like cattle?]
[Just what jobs awaits us in the imperial capital anyway?]
They were wrecked with fear, doubt and terror. They were sensible enough not to speak any more, the hope in their eyes now turned into despair…

chapters.title: Chapter 904: Night Raid
chapters.content:
Chapter 904: Night Raid
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Grandmaster Gu, you must find it strange why we’re back out of the blue. Or you already know that but just want our confirmation, ha-ha-ha…”
Back in Flying Cloud manor, to the same smell, to the same hall, Shangguan Feiyun, Baili Jingwei and Danqing Shen had him surrounded with creepy smiles.
As a hidden big player himself, Zhuo Fan knew how to get into his role, playing dumb with a straight face and bright smile, “Prime Minister, what are you saying? I don’t get your words, ha-ha-ha…”
“Don’t get it, don’t you? Ha-ha, Grandmaster Gu, you don’t have to pretend any longer. We know everything there is to know about you.”
Baili Jingwei’s eyes shone, “Grandmaster Gu, since you just can’t seem to understand, I’m sure the names Shangguan Yulin, Shangguan Feixiong and Shangguan Qingyan should ring some bells.”
Shuddering, Zhuo Fan tensed, his face paling.
Baili Jingwei stared right at him, his grin wide, “Grandmaster Gu, you’re an alchemical gem and gaining success through the Sword Star Empire’s court is easier than breathing. So why must you stand up for those kinds of people?”
Zhuo Fan lowered his head, like a condemned man waiting for his verdict.
Pa!
Baili Jingwei patted his shoulder from behind, noticing the problem eating away at him, “The act of being Shangguan clan’s spy, in playing a role of destroying the foundation of my empire, would never make me waste so many words with any such criminal.”
Baili Jingwei’s grip tightened and Zhuo Fan winced with clenched teeth while adding a perfectly timed frantic image of himself.
Baili Jingwei smirked, immensely pleased at his reaction.
“Grandmaster Gu isn’t just any criminal, but a one of a kind genius. It weighs heavy on my heart having you pay with your life along with those thieves.”
Baili Jingwei looked heartbroken, his tone softening, “The loss I feel isn’t just mine, but the empire’s as well for losing such an outstanding alchemist. The pain I feel is only amplified if Grandmaster Gu won’t be able to reveal his talent to the world…”
Baili Jingwei spoke lower and more saddened, the heartbroken state he was in would bring anyone to tears.
If anyone else heard him right now, they’d be so moved they’d become sworn brothers.
A shame this failed on Zhuo Fan, who didn’t fall short in the subterfuge department.
As a fellow specialist himself, Zhuo Fan had to give him props for playing it right. Using psychology to threaten and coax, making it sound logical and sensible.
[There’s no way Shangguan Yulin had any chance against such an assault, turning his back to his own family on the spot.]
[Baili Jingwei isn’t called the wisest in the empire for nothing.]
Though Zhuo Fan was no pushover either. Furthermore, he was never truly invested in his alchemist role, making this touching display feel flat.
Though it was one thing to not feel it and another thing altogether to not show it. It was easy to tell in which situation he was in and he had to play his part.
How nice of Baili Jingwei to set the stage for him.
Zhuo Fan teared up on cue, his face overwhelmed, “Prime Minister, a wise man’s words are invaluable. Prime Minister is my best friend. If only I had met sir sooner. I wouldn’t… wouldn’t have…”
Zhuo Fan was taken by abject regret, of the mistake he made joining the thieves and botching his future.
Baili Jingwei and Shangguan Feiyun shared a smile, with the first saying, “I’ve considered Grandmaster Gu a friend the moment I saw you. Grandmaster Gu has just strayed, holding no deep repercussions and offering the chance to come back on the straight and narrow. I promise you this, Grandmaster Mu, give your all to the empire and I’ll even be more than happy to give my position to you!”
“Prime Minister, y-you’re just too good to me.” Zhuo Fan was so touched he was choking, tears filling his eyes.
Baili Jingwei waved his hand, “Then, can Grandmaster Gu tell me of their movements?”
“Of course. Prime Minister has given me a new lease on life and the least I could do is return the favor. Unlike them…”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, his eyes shining with loss and hatred.
Baili Jingwei was puzzled, but soon came to understand once he heard his story. “Humph, fools who only throw away talent, that’s what they are. And they talk about being pragmatic with grandmaster’s fate? Furthermore, they’re even using your own son as a shield. How vile, how repulsive!”
“Right? I didn’t know they were like that, treating me like family. Until Shangguan Qingyan told me everything two days ago. She’s such a nice girl. “
Zhuo Fan sighed.
Baili Jingwei sparkled, “Grandmaster Gu, we’ll get every last one of them for sure and give you justice. You just go take some rest in your room and await the good news tomorrow.”
“But my son…”
“He won’t be harmed.”
Zhuo Fan sighed, letting two guards escort him away. Shangguan Feiyun spoke out of earshot, “Prime Minister, did Grandmaster Gu really switch sides?”
“He wasn’t close to them to begin with. Thanks to my smooth and enlightened words, he has surrendered to us.”
Baili Jingwei spoke, “Most of what he told us fits with the report Shangguan Yulin gave us through the jade slip. The only discrepancy is the missing chat between him and Shangguan Qingyan, but that’s normal. He has no business butting into a private chat. Shangguan Feixiong’s pragmatic plan had to have been discussed with his high elders late in the night, making Shangguan Yulin unaware of it.”
“Now that I believe.”
Shangguan Feiyun nodded, “Shangguan Feixiong loves to play the nice guy, but that ends when his clan’s future’s at stake, all niceties are thrown away. Humph, nothing but a rotten hypocrite.”
“Don’t say that.”
Baili Jingwei smiled, “It comes with the territory. Even Shangguan clan’s Clan Head would sometimes place his clan first. I can sure understand it. Ha-ha-ha, Sword King Feiyun, I find you rather biased about your brother. “
Humph!
Shangguan Feiyun huffed in anger.
Baili Jingwei smiled, his mouth quivering with a confident grin in Zhuo Fan’s direction, “We finally got the alchemist grandmaster to switch sides. I’ve yet to lose my touch, ha-ha-ha…”
“Prime Minister Baili!”
Danqing Shen, who had been keeping silent while the two mighty actors played their role, finally spoke up, “Since we trust Grandmaster Gu now, then the eyes that are on him…”
Baili Jingwei cut him off with a flick of his hand, “One is reality and another is necessity. He has just switched to us, but even if we do believe him, the monitoring can’t stop. It’s only for a day anyway. I’d rather not have my plan fall to ruin from a simple slip up. “
Shangguan Feiyun and Danqing Shen shared a nod.
[Baili Jingwei is meticulous and cautious…]
Despite the house arrest he was under, and the couple of Soul Harmony experts watching him outside his door, Zhuo Fan was sporting a weird smile.
[The plan’s moving along nicely.]
The next night, Shangguan Feixiong assembled his experts in the garden and looked at the bright moon, ordering, “Begin!”
“Yes, sir!”
The men saluted and faded into the night sky, closing in on their prey, the Flying Cloud manor.
Shangguan Yulin looked at Shangguan Qingyan, smiling, “Yan’er, they’re off. When the manor turns to chaos, the security for the city entrances will slack. We’ll use this chance to get out, go to the meeting place with uncle.”
“I’ll take young Sanzi.”
Shangguan Qingyan nodded and left to find Gu Santong.
Shangguan Yulin’s face fell in annoyance.
[Is he your kid? Why do you even care so much?]
Shangguan Qingyan suddenly cried out and rushed over, “Oh no, something bad happened…”
“Yan’er, what is it?” Shangguan Yulin asked.
Shangguan Qingyan panted in panic, “Y-young Sanzi is gone…”
“Tch, the brat is nothing but trouble. Where could he have run off to? Forget about him. Time waits for no one.” Shangguan Yulin snaked.
Shangguan Qingyan glared, “How can you talk like that? He’s but a child who’s now lonely and sad without his father. We can’t just leave him. Did you forget how much his father helped us?”
[To hell with his help. Come dawn, it won’t matter, he-he-he…]
Rolling his eyes, Shangguan Yulin smirked inside. Once the curtain fell on tonight, Baili Jingwei promised him the Shangguan clan’s top experts would be done and Gu Yifan would become a traitor hunted by the eastern lands leaving him with no choice but to take asylum with the Prime Minister. And the juniors escaping from here would be led by him, to restore the Shangguan clan.
Then, as a central area spy, he’d work with the Sword Star Empire to unify eastern lands. Shangguan Feiyun would become the leader and he would become Shangguan Feiyun’s right hand, ruling over everyone else, ha-ha-ha…
“Oh no!”
Shangguan Yulin’s fantasy was cut short by a cry, “Young Sanzi must think his dad is at the manor so he must be going there. I never told him his dad left and his dad didn’t say goodbye fearing he couldn’t let go. I have to go to the manor and find him.”
“Yan’er, uncle is attacking the manor, you can’t go there! It’s too dangerous!” Shangguan Yulin grabbed her shoulder.
Shrugging his hand away, Shangguan Qingyan ran off, “That’s why I must go. Young Sanzi is just a child!”
Shangguan Qingyan was gone.
Shangguan Yulin gnashed his teeth and followed.
Their exchange was, however, under the watch of a red and cute figure behind a tree, looking on with guilt.
“Dad and I want to step on your bodies for our job, but you still went back to save me. Dad, I’m sure you won’t step in even if auntie is about to die. Then…”
Gu Santong faded into the night…

chapters.title: Chapter 905: Sudden Breach
chapters.content:
Chapter 905: Sudden Breach
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Whoosh~
Shadows made use of the night’s dark cover to cross the moonlit clearings with ease and arrive before a grand manor.
The plaque hanging above identified it as the Flying Cloud Manor.
Patrols of Soul Harmony guards moved about, ensuring its safety.
Shangguan Feixiong witnessed their shift changing, right in front of the manor gate with hardly any attention to their surroundings.
Whoosh~
Hundreds of Shangguan clan experts, wearing black, struck, having readied themselves for this moment. The earth shook under the thunderous sound as the veritable army attacked as one with enough force to split mountains.
The guards never knew what hit them, their voices robbed as the wave of power smashed into them.
The guards eyes grew bloodshot and then each of them started popping like overripe tomatoes, spreading blood and gore everywhere.
Two teams, fifty people, were dead in a few seconds..
Shangguan clan’s experts moved with purpose and speed, taking the smooth start as a good sign for what was to come.
The men ignored the carnage and went deeper…
Rumble~
The early power wave had shook the whole manor awake.
In a quaint little room, sitting at his table, gently picking the rattling tea cup, sipping from it and hiding a peculiar smile.
The pale yellow light of a lone candle reflected off his bright visage, and the unmoving Soul Harmony experts behind him, in the hundreds.
“Prime Minister, they’re here!”
A man holding the candle bowed with utter respect, unleashing his late Genesis Stage power.
Baili Jingwei’s face bloome into a smile, “Just wait for them to get closer, ha-ha-ha….”
The man nodded and withdrew. Baili Jingwei snickered and drank his tea. His demeanor, the coldness of those eyes and the hard face made everyone’s hearts shudder every time he placed the teacup down…
“The manor’s under attack! Activate the array, protect the Sword King!”
As the earth shook, the manor shuddered with it while the guard captain issued frantic orders.
The men nodded and executed their signs.
It was not due to the ambush, but having gone through the same terror once before.
The images were still burned into their eyes of the time the last attackers just came and went to the manor. What followed was Sword King Feiyun’s wrath unleashed upon hundreds of Soul Harmony guards. It was so bad the real estate market experienced a collapse at the sudden influx of empty houses; the fall of many outstanding guard families scattering from ending up broke, a given.
People always said serving men in power came with its own danger, but working under a Sword King wasn’t any easier either.
Now it was their turn to be put to the test, with another raid. Talk about rotten luck.
[They could’ve come earlier or later, but no, they just had to pick tonight when I’m on duty to make sure I suffer for it. Is that it? What did I ever do to you? I don’t even know you, so why me?]
All the guards were outraged at the attack, but equally helpless. They knew their luck had run out and blaming others wouldn’t help any one.
They could only do their duty to the best of their ability, to stop these attackers where they stood.
Hum~
As the guards finished with their gestures, a faint barrier came to life, covering the core of the manor and dividing it from the incoming thieves.
The guards smiled for once.
[We’ve done our job and they can’t get in.]
The joy was short lived as three elderlies appeared before them out of the blue.
One’s eyes shone, “It’s still a breeze getting in before the defensive array is truly activated.”
The three shared a look and smiled, making their own signs and attacking.
Their hands extended in a most peculiar stance, intertwined as their index fingers came out from each palm and unleashing devastating power.
“Three break the skies as one, Soaring Cloud Luan Sword!”
A savage blade sword wave rushed out, of such power that it felt like a god unleashed it. And all of it was sent at the helpless guards and the incomplete array.
Boom!
The array formed by three hundred guards held all but for an instant – exploding into nothing.
The force ravaged the area, crushing their hearts and blowing them away. The only lucky survivors were around a hundred of the original four hundred guards.
These meager dozens of Genesis Stage experts still suffered greatly at the attack.
They looked shocked at the devastation, there was nothing around the manor for dozens of miles. All those gardens and trees, lakes and ponds, all gone.
As to where the sword wave struck, that went on for fifty kilometers. There was a clear endless line of utter nothingness left in its wake.
Sss~
The guards gasped in fear at these elders’ power.
[Who the hell are they?]
[They’re in the Genesis Stage as well, but how can their combined attack be so strong? Not even Sword King can take that!]
Figures populated the area as hundreds of Genesis Stage experts went past the three elders and straight for them.
The elders let them take the remaining guards.
Genesis Stage experts as well, the guards had been too damaged by that ferocious attack to put up any resistance to the rest of the Shangguan clan’s strength.
Their wails and cries echoed soon after, until silence was once again restored.
Shangguan Feixiong grinned. While he lost ten of his men, it was worth it since the enemy lost scores.
The emphasis on this ambush was speed, evident by how fast they went through the entrance and the second line of defense.
Even he found it astonishing how smooth it all went and smiled.
[At this rate we’ll be in and out of Jade Falls with the Soaring Sword before Shangguan Feiyun even gets wind of us, ha-ha-ha…]
Shangguan Feixiong spurred on, “Let’s push on!”
“Yes, sir!”
The men nodded in excitement. Who could blame them when everything was a walk in the park so far. The odds looked mighty high for the whole team to finish the mission and come home in one piece.
So the men pushed harder and faster, feeling like nothing could stand in their way.
[We’re invincible!]
Wholly unaware this was merely an elaborate bait they fell for, its line reeling them into an inescapable net…
Shangguan Qingyan reached the manor to see the hellscape. The deafening silence was proof her father had been here.
In face of such destruction, how could a child survive it?
The men might not lower themselves to harm him, but the shockwaves would still spell his end…
Shangguan Qingyan frowned in deep worry. But her gaze was firm and her step quick as she went in.
“Yan’er, don’t!”
Shangguan Yulin blocked her path, grabbing her shoulders and speaking with distress, “Uncle is in there, fighting. Soul Harmony experts are nothing and even Genesis Stage experts are sure to die. What can you do with an 8th layer Ethereal Stage cultivation? You’re only going to die! Don’t throw your life away!”
Shangguan Qingyan bit her lip, “No, since I am in such danger that means young Sanzi must be having it worse.”
“Who cares? He asked for it. He’s a brat causing trouble.”
Shangguan Yulin spoke with hatred, but Shangguan Qingyan was unflinching. “Yan’er, if not for yourself, then do it for uncle. Uncle won’t tarry in the Flying Cloud manor anymore than he needs to. Genesis Stage experts can flee, and so can Soul Harmony experts. But not you and you’ll be holding them back. You’ll only make it harder for uncle and might even harm him. Can you live with that?”
Shangguan Qingyan hesitated, but her gaze was firm once more, “I know and that’s why I won’t let father find me. I’m only looking for young Sanzi and then I’ll leave. If I die from this, then so be it. It’s just one of the things an aunt must do.”
Shangguan Yulin pushed Shangguan Yulin away and shot into the manor.
Shangguan Yulin sighed and followed.
Then a flash of red came as well, who was not far behind them. All that remained here was the ground covered in blood and limbs, a sign that this world was lawless…

chapters.title: Chapter 906: Plot Within Plot
chapters.content:
Chapter 906: Plot Within Plot
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“That sure is fast, passing the second defense line.”
In a quiet little room, an old man caressed his beard while listening in on the outside ruckus.
A Genesis Stage cultivator saluted, “Dragon Cleaving Sword King, the thieves are quickly on their way here. They’ll reach our line in fifteen minutes.”
“Shangguan clan…”
Danqing Shen’s eyes shone coldly and he said, “I have nothing against them, yet here I am clashing with them. How frustrating.”
The guard merely listened.
Danqing Shen dismissed him by muttering, “Leave, since there’s still time, let me enjoy the remaining minutes in silence.”
“Yes, Sword King sir!”
The guard left, fading into the darkness. Around this room, just like Baili Jingwei’s, hundreds of experts lay in wait, ready to strike.
On the other side of the manor, Shangguan Feiyun set his forces for an ambush. Hearing the noise in the distance, he closed his eyes to focus on it, wearing a faint smile, “Ha-ha-ha, by the sound of things, it’s those three’s Tri-talent Surging Cloud Art. There’s no way the manor’s barrier can hold them. Those three coots want to get my head quite fast. Think again!”
Shangguan Feiyun mocked, flicking his sleeve and sitting in his chair, “I shall wait right here. We’re all Shangguan clansmen, so let’s see whose Soaring Sword Art is better. Tonight we’ll see who is the strongest, the Three Soaring Cloud Swords of eastern lands or the best in eastern lands?”
Shangguan Feiyun squinted, filled with battlelust.
But no one would be joining him, neither the venerables nor Zhuo Fan.
Since Zhuo Fan used Shangguan Yulin to set up a different act, all to split the two Sword Kings and give him ample room to wiggle.
With two Sword Kings joining hands, they’d make handling the three venerables of eastern lands a walk in the park. The Shangguan clan could hardly fight back and would collapse then and there.
How was Zhuo Fan supposed to play in these conditions?
[Since you’re done with them, won’t that make me next?]
Which made this subterfuge a stalling tactic. Zhuo Fan wanted it to stretch for as long as possible, which clearly worked by all appearances.
Rumble~
The whole of the manor shook under the attacks. The table, chairs and cupboards fell, smashing the chinaware on display in Zhuo Fan’s room.
Peacefully sitting on his bed meditating, Zhuo Fan sported a sudden grin as his eyes flashed open, “That must be my cue, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan climbed out of bed and cracked the door open…
“Damn, did you hear that? Just what could make all that noise? Is there another break in?”
“That has to be it. The same thing happened last time, two months ago. Only this time, it sounds stronger.”
“What about Sword King Feiyun? Should we go guard him? You know how those brothers ended up last time just for being moments slower.”
“Don’t worry about it. Sword King sir has it under control. It’s fine.”
“How do you know?”
“Dumbass, Sword King said it himself in this morning’s warning. No matter what happens, we’re never to leave our post. You could practically feel the premeditation in his tone. Not to mention the manor is stuffed with elites in every shadow. They must have a special task for sure.”
“You’re saying Sword King knew that we’ll be under attack tonight? Why didn’t he notify the guards, strengthen them?”
“Ever heard of baiting, dumbass?”
“But our brothers at the gate…”
“Died for nothing, yes.”
The two guards discussed the ruckus reaching them and sighed at the implications.
“Nobodies like us look haughty posing as the manor’s guards once making our rounds, when in fact we’re all just our lord’s pawns to throw away at a whim. Let’s say Sword King did give us the order to go die, would you refuse? Humph, dying under Sword King’s order will mean going down with honors. Your family will be compensated, their safety assured. But if you cling to life too much, humph, you saw yourself how those brothers two months ago ended up, how their families are in ruins. It’s not as simple as just you dying. Now which of the two endings do you find more worthy?”
Shuddering, the other guard grimaced and shook his head. Now he held a bit of joy in his tone, “I suddenly find the crappy detail of babysitting a Radiant Stage alchemist to be quite nice. At least I get to keep my life, ha-ha-ha…”
The first guard nodded and grinned, though something sad hid behind his smile.
[That might work now, but what about next time?]
“Ahem, lord’s matters are of no concern to us. Now stop the chatter.”
A third guard made his presence known as he walked over to berate them, “A loose tongue will only bring trouble. If you plan on living for years to come, learn how to keep your mouth closed.”
The two guards shook and nodded.
The third guard returned the nod and the mood eased…
Creak~
The door slowly opened and Zhuo Fan stepped out with a peculiar smile.
The three guards looked oddly at him.
[What’s Grandmaster Gu doing showing his face now of all times?]
A guard blocked him, “Grandmaster Gu, what do you need that requires you to leave the room?”
“Ha-ha-ha, nothing much, I just heard the noise and wanted a closer look.”
“Grandmaster Gu, it’s dangerous out there. Please go back inside. We’ll keep you safe!” The guard refused.
Zhuo Fan smirked, “And if I insist?”
The guards were puzzled.
[He’s clearly toying around, but why?]
The only reason they treated a 5th layer Radiant Stage cultivator with such respect was due to Baili Jingwei’s courteous attitude around him.
So they ignored Zhuo Fan’s posing, showing a look of ridicule.
“Grandmaster Gu, please don’t make it any harder than it has to be. Our job is to keep you safe and, if the situation demands it, restrain you. It’s all for your own good. It’s too dangerous out there so please go back inside. Don’t make us use force.” A guard replied respectfully but firmly.
Zhuo Fan chuckled, with a hint of evil inside it that gave them the chills.
[What’s with that laughter?]
“You were saying earlier, that the most worthy death is that done for the manor?”
The trio were stunned.
[Where’s he going with this?]
“Let me fulfill your wish. I sincerely hope your families have good fortunes from your passing.”
Zhuo Fan ignored the baffled guards, sighing, “Though I find such a death cowardly. Is that what a cultivator that defies the heavens should choose?”
Whoosh~
A shadow extended from Zhuo Fan’s feet that swallowed the guards in a blink.
Darkness was the only thing that was present in this world.
[Domain soul?]
One of the guards shouted, “Grandmaster Gu, enough games! Take the domain down or we’ll have no choice but to get serious. Won’t the lord make us account for you getting hurt?”
“Account for? Ha-ha-ha, you’re overthinking things. There’s nothing you can explain, ever. Since the only place you’ll be accounted for is right here, right now.”
The distorted mocking voice raised the guards’ hackles.
[Damn brat, learn when to quit! We don’t want to hurt you. Why all the damn theatrics?]
[But since it came to this…]
A guard shouted, “Grandmaster Gu, you asked for it, so don’t blame me for hurting you.”
He made a fist and punched at the abyss, only to find himself unable to follow through his move, paralyzed.
The trio cried out, “W-what’s happening? I can’t move!”
“Ha-ha-ha, I guess I forgot to tell you that my domain is a twin domain, unlike any Ethereal Stage cultivator’s. The two intersect and amplify their strength to hold even Soul Harmony experts like you from ever escaping.”
Zhuo Fan’s eerie voice came again, “Though freeing yourself is far easier…”
The darkness crept up their bodies and seeped into their very flesh, gorging on their strength.
The trio wailed in terror, consumed alive by the darkness, they turned into dark statues.
As the blackness faded to give way to the moonlight, Zhuo Fan was the only one present.
A look at the sky and an ear on the ever-increasing clamor, Zhuo Fan smirked as he shot for Jade Falls.
[My turn…]

chapters.title: Chapter 907: Dreadful Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 907: Dreadful Sword
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Whoosh~
Hundreds of men in black landed in a wide space, with the moon hanging overhead. Before them were a row of buildings, though not the watery paradise they all were aiming for.
“Clan Head, this place isn’t right. It’s not what it says on the map!”
One man looked around before going to Shangguan Feixiong to express his doubts.
Shangguan Feixiong frowned, his face unnatural. He was getting a really bad feeling.
There were some heavy sounds that cut off his thoughts. The black rows of houses all were filled with candlelight and an age voice sounded, “Shangguan Clan Head, it’s been ages. Have you been well?”
Shangguan Feixiong shuddered at the familiar voice. His face grew hard as he stepped back in terror.
The rest were shocked at seeing their calm Clan Head out of his element.
[Just who is in there?]
Creak~
An old man slowly stepped out of a lit house.
With him came hundreds of Genesis and Soul Harmony experts, all releasing their power and bloodthirst.
“Former best in western lands, now Dragon Cleaving Sword King of central area, Danqing Shen. Y-you didn’t leave?”
Eyes shaking, Shangguan Feixiong gnashed his teeth, his suspicions confirmed, yet his heart sank.
[Trap!]
Three days ago, their scouts watched Danqing Shen and Baili Jingwei leave. Yet here he was now.
It was all just a cover Baili Jingwei set up. Making a show of leaving and then returning to kill them.
[Everything was fake so we’d take the bait.]
Danqing Shen’s mere presence confirmed Baili Jingwei was the one running the show.
He was in the worst danger possible, far beyond just fighting two Sword Kings, but also being snared by Baili Jingwei’s trap. It just didn’t get much worse than this.
Shangguan Feixiong was soaked in sweat, his eyes frantic as panic and despair set in on his face.
Danqing Shen easily read his mood, sighing, “Shangguan Clan Head, I have nothing against you but as we stand on opposite camps, I’ll have to offend you.”
“Retreat!”
Shangguan Feixiong shouted in anger, his eyes bloodshot. He was wrecked with regret, over his lapse in judgment, over his carelessness in getting his clansmen into this danger. If they were all to perish here, Shangguan clan would be threatened, eastern lands would be threatened, and he would become his homeland’s stigma.
Shangguan Feixiong’s guilt was so deep his eyes looked dead. He would not hesitate to give his own life if it could save everyone else out of this disaster.
His men were startled at first, but then realized from Shangguan Feixiong’s ashen face that they had been trapped.
They trusted their Clan Head’s decision and withdrew at once from where they came.
Danqing Shen shook his head, “Sorry, but my position demands me to stop you. You’re never going to leave this place…”
Danqing Shen hacked with two fingers.
A draconic roar echoed as the world changed. An outrageous flood of sword energy came, turning into dragons and converging into a half kilometer long draconic sword.
With the howls of dragons sounding in the background, the gigantic sword’s might spread terror into its quarry. It felt like it could split the world in two.
Sss~
Every man there gasped, feeling for the first time a power like no other robbing their courage and draining their resistance. It was akin to the three venerables’ combined attack, just that it came from one man and was on a much more insane scale.
[Is this the power of the central area’s Nine Sword Kings?]
The people watching the gargantuan sword hanging overhead were overwhelmed with fear.
Shangguan Feixiong watched their shocked faces, the terror in their eyes and roared, “Don’t stand there! Wake up and flee!”
[Uh, right…]
Startling awake, the men gave Danqing Shen one last look of fear then fled with all they had, even as their backs were icy-cold.
“I never wanted to harm anyone. But it’ll be up to your luck…”
Danqing Shen sighed and his hand shone as he hacked.
Hu~
The grand sword descended upon the earth like a cataclysmic meteor, its pressure robbing the men of breath and the ground of stability, making it crack and pieces beginning to actually float.
While the true targets, the men that wanted to follow their Clan Head in fleeing, found themselves under a mountain, sinking into the earth and unable to budge an inch.
Panic dominated their hearts, all stemming from the obscene power such a skill could unleash, from looking death in the face.
This strike would kill most of them and put an end to their mission, all in one move.
[Dragon Cleaving Sword King’s power is terrifying!]
Fear had reached a breaking point in their minds, now giving way to despair…
Shangguan Feixiong gnashed his teeth in defiance, cursing the sword as it came for them. He drew his fingers and made a circle, unleashing a scarlet sword wave, filling the air with life and smashing into the huge sword.
