Gu Santong understood this and noticed how Zhuo Fan was falling behind. He focused and pulled Shangguan Qingyan behind him. With a stomp, his body shot for the obliterating sword attack with no remorse.
“Young Sanzi!”
Zhuo Fan and Shangguan Qingyan cried out but Gu Santong’s mind was set, punching at the huge sword with his fist wrapped in scarlet.
“I am the Invincible Scamp Gu Santong! I have never known defeat and no puny sword energy can harm the likes of me…”
To the eyes of any onlooker, he was no whelp, no child wet behind his ears, but a brave hero unflinching in the face of death and welcoming with open arms.
A pity he was up against one of the Nine Sword Kings, Shangguan Feiyun. He might have held his own against any other Genesis Stage expert, but not against Shangguan Feiyun…
The sword went through Gu Santong’s arm with a muffled sound, going after Shangguan Qingyan. His challenging declaration came to a stop, forced to spat crimson blood.
His rosy complexion turned deathly white as his frail body swayed in the wind and fell backward.
But his fist had managed to slow the sword for less than a second, something anyone would disregard, but it held utmost importance in a crisis such as this.
The sword finally grew slower than Zhuo Fan’s Divine Eye of the Void.
Whoosh~
Shangguan Qingyan vanished in an instant, now appearing next to Zhuo Fan, behind the glowing curtain of light.
The next moment, the sword crossed the now empty space and struck the crowd with a mighty boom. The howls and cries pierced the sky as anything in fifty kilometers was turned to rubble. The Genesis Stage experts standing there were the ones to suffer for it, with more than thirty dead. It was testament to Shangguan Feiyun’s power.
Everyone was shocked inside at the outcome, not at Shangguan Feiyun’s strength, but at Zhuo Fan’s skill, able to save someone from right under Sword King Feiyun’s nose.
Shangguan Feixiong noticed his daughter was safe and eased a breath he forgot he was holding. He felt conflicted now about Zhuo Fan, torn between gratitude and hatred, but admired him nonetheless.
[The boy can do the impossible, unflinching as the world is collapsing on him. Just who is he?]
Zhuo Fan cared not about other’s reactions, his right eye flashing once more. He saved Shangguan Qingyan but now he was staring at Gu Santong as he floated there.
However, in a fight between experts, using one skill might not work a second time.
Someone darted and grabbed Gu Santong’s neck. The man flicked his hand and canceled the Shift.
The golden glow in Zhuo Fan’s right eye faded and looked up with hatred and clenched fists, “Shangguan Feiyun!”
“Gu Yifan, so you’re not just an unknown 11th grade alchemist but also in possession of some weird skills.”
Shangguan Feiyun dangled Gu Santong in front, splattering the blood flowing for young Sanzi everywhere, “One is a freak and the other is a monster. You two sure opened my eyes wide today. The old man is crafty and shifty while the young son wields savage power. That punch really hurt and I lost myself there and almost killed them. How lucky your son is so capable in stopping my sword and still come out alive. But try anything else now and I’ll snap his neck like a toothpick!”
Zhuo Fan’s heart sank.
Shangguan Qingyan cried, “Young Sanzi…”
She turned to Zhuo Fan, “Gu Yifan, you have to help him! Just give up the dead sword. He’s your son! “
“Yeah, give it up. Nothing can come close to the importance of your son’s life, right? Ha-ha-ha…” Shangguan Qingyan mocked while holding young Sanzi.
As blood flowed from the ruined arm, young Sanzi’s condition was growing worse by the second.
Others were feeling for him. Such a monstrous strength, but all in the body of a little child. His act of sacrifice earlier only made him more admirable.
If it were anyone else holding Gu Santong, some of them might even lend a hand.
[What kind of man are you, bastard, to pick on a child…]
Zhuo Fan hesitated as Gu Santong’s grew weaker. But then the child strained to look at his father, giving him a a look and a smile. He then closed his eyes, at peace with his fate.
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, his fists clenched. But ultimately he let it all go. He grabbed Shangguan Qingyan’s shoulder and made the last sign.
“We’re leaving.”
“What?!”
In Shangguan Qingyan’s moment of anxiety, worry and shock, the starlight shone brighter and the two faded away, followed by the vanishing of the curtain of light.
Everyone gasped, even Baili Jingwei.
[Is Gu Yifan so cruel? Did he give up on his son for a damn sword?]
Shangguan Feiyun’s face twitched, his eyes dimmed and shook from anger. His hand gripping Gu Santong tensed in reflex. The child was only still alive thanks to his sacred beast heritage.
“This is utterly preposterous…”
Shangguan Feiyun howled at the sky, regarding the child with bloodlust, “Damn you, Gu Yifan! Since you don’t want him, then I’ll get rid of him for you!”
Shangguan Feiyun waved his Yuan Qi charged finger at Gu Santong.
He didn’t finish as another curtain of light came down from the heavens above. The Big Dipper shone again, only this time, it landed in Flying Cloud City, in Gu household.
What followed was a beam of light shining across the sky that made Shangguan Feiyun’s sword pause from falling down.
“Wait!”
Baili Jingwei shouted in haste, looking at the distant light and turned to the array masters, “What is that?”
One array master stepped forward and bowed, “Prime Minister, the world has its own laws and so does arrays. In general, the more power is amassed the greater the effect. This is true for all arrays, teleportation arrays included. He has set up such a star array so fast and small scale in the Flying Cloud manor and using sacred stones, proving his skill and quick thinking. But such array won’t work over large distances. It would have needed a larger and more time consuming array to do so. Something impossible in the central area where someone would have easily noticed. This means he has only used it to escape the manor…”
Pa!
Baili Jingwei instantly reacted with an angry slap and cursing, “Damn it, fool, say it from the start! Since he hasn’t gotten far, we have to give chase. Sword King Feiyun, take the kid and let’s go!”

chapters.title: Chapter 919: Light/Glow
chapters.content:
Chapter 919: Light/Glow
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Baili Jingwei turned to the ever silent Danqing Shen. Understanding his gaze, Danqing Shen came to his side and grabbed him before shooting for the light.
As a mere Ethereal Stage cultivator, he’d never catch up to the others with his meager speed unless he had a Genesis Stage expert helping him.
Shangguan Feiyun figured out the little brat still had his uses as a hostage. Without further ado, he also flew after them with Gu Santong in his clutches.
As for the other Genesis Stage experts, they followed without question.
Of the packed manor of experts so far, now it turned to have only five who were just staring dumbly. Shangguan Shangguan Feixiong, the three venerables and one tittering between life and death, Shangguan Yulin.
All of them felt weirdly at a loss seeing the others just ignore them outright over someone else.
[You’re telling me, that us big shots from eastern lands have no worth? They just treat us like decorations, not even locking their house.]
The clear humiliation got to these four oldies.
They had been hiding to stay alive all this time and now that they were given the cold shoulder their life was over. Talk about being self-critical.
Then again, Gu Yifan was so young and toyed with both parties like nothing; truly commendable, brave, amazing and extraordinarily talented.
In any other place, even they would’ve disregarded the Shangguan clan over the kid, since he was just too good.
First he snatched Soaring Sword, which was eye-catching enough, then there was his glorious talent that shone like no other here.
What if he were such a marvelous youth, what then?
That was of course paying close attention to such a dangerous element. And while these Shangguan oldies were tough, part of a bigger faction, it’s been millennia since such a gem appeared within their ranks.
Gu Yifan was like a younger Invincible Sword now, even if striking it out on his own, that infinite potential sent shivers down anyone’s spine.
It was for the same reason Baili Jingwei and Shangguan Feiyun went after the kid. The Soaring Sword might even be secondary…
Shangguan Feixiong sighed at the light pillar, “The new replaces the old as every generation surpasses the last one. I just can’t believe how the glory of our Shangguan clan has faded compared to some unknown kid… “
“It’s not faded, but overshadowed!”
One venerable nodded, “The stars shine brighter upon the night sky only because the clouds hide the moon’s glow. The moon can cast her light upon the world all because the sun has fallen beyond the mountains. When the moon comes out, the stars fade. When the sun rises, the moon vanishes. He is the sun and the moon, and as long as he lives past today, his light would be glorious.”
They all gave a nod at his assessment.
[The new dawn is herald by its new heroes. Our time… has ended…]
“Should we give chase? I’m worried about Yan’er…” Shangguan Feixiong pondered as he looked at the distant light.
One venerable spoke, “There’s no need. We’ve been in such a dangerous situation just now and we couldn’t even keep Yan’er safe, but the kid did. He easily walks the path he made for himself to escape so of course he will. Yan’er will be fine with him. While we can never catch up to him and get the Soaring Sword, going after him is pointless.”
“While we no longer take priority with him still around, once he’s gone, all that attention will be focused on us. Baili Jingwei will come with us hard once more and we hardly have the men to fight. Even if we do escape, there’ll barely be anyone left. Only a fool would do this, ha-ha-ha…”
Shangguan Feixiong nodded and sighed. [Kid, you’ve been wicked and shrewd, using us however you wished, but I haven’t exactly been good to you either. Yan’er isn’t like that, she truly cared for the two of you. I just hope you’ll take care of her and keep her safe and this old man will be content.]
Shangguan Feixiong sighed and turned a dark look at the slumped Shangguan Yulin in his hole,”Then, venerables, what about this bastard?”
“A traitor is to be taken back and fully questioned!”
One venerable’s eyes shone and snapped. Shangguan Feixiong nodded and went to lift a bitter, pleading and panicking Shangguan Yulin.
The four experts flew out of town.
They couldn’t mess with the matters as they stood, but a traitor was a different matter…
The four sported nasty smirks.
Shangguan Yulin was feeling worse and worse.
[What did I do to deserve this? No one wants me! I gave my all as a spy, I worked hard for the clan, but no one cares!]
[Is the world going to let this wrong go unanswered? Oh, snow in June…]
(StarReader: reference to ‘The Injustice to Dou E’, a play by Guan Hanqing of a girls unjust ending and vindication)
How fast had he forgotten just who he was really working for, even turning on everyone else. The triple agent had nothing helping him in his endeavors, no morals and not even loyalty for his own family.
Alas, all of these were secondary, paling in comparison to messing with the one man no one ever should, ending up as a stray no one would even take pity on…
Meanwhile, with the flash of the light pillar, Zhuo Fan and Shangguan Qingyan appeared in the backyard of the Gu household. With no time for her to make sense of everything, Shangguan Feiyun’s team had already shown up. A Genesis Stage expert’s speed was nothing to scoff at. He held Gu Santong and barked at Zhuo Fan inside the light pillar, “Gu Yifan, you didn’t want him, but I was kind enough to bring your son to you. Hand over the sword now or you can say goodbye to this brat!”
“Young Sanzi, we…” Shangguan Qingyan started despite how Zhuo Fan sported the same cold face, his hands making signs, “Merak!”
Whoosh~
In another flash, the two were gone along with their light pillar. Shangguan Feiyun’s face twitched, “Shit! This bastard is hardcore, ignoring everything and just running off.”
“He didn’t care at all?” Baili Jingwei and Danqing Shen just caught up.
Shangguan Feiyun shrugged helplessly, his anger burning hotter than the sun, “He showed not the slightest hesitation. I’ve seen my fair share of stone cold people, but he’s to the point of being inhuman!”
Baili Jingwei frowned heavily.
He’d been using his sharp wits and quick tongue to come up on top every time, but Zhuo Fan wouldn’t even stop to listen. He couldn’t work his magic, not when the other wouldn’t even let him in.
Whoosh~
Another beam of light was cast upon the world, down yonder. Baili Jingwei signaled at once and everyone gave chase.
Shangguan Feiyun huffed and took Gu Santong to find his dad.
“Gu Yifan, your son-“
Whoosh~
Shangguan Feiyun’s roar reached Zhuo Fan first, but only the first words as he went away once more. The chase went on and on.
The glorious Flying Cloud City of the empire was given quite the funny show. The Flying Cloud manor was out in force trying to catch some light from the heavens, yet it kept slipping through their fingers.
Shangguan Feiyun, with a kid in his arms, was looking like a nagging old biddy chasing her husband to give him an earful. The only thing missing was shrieking and whining in the streets like a banshee.
[You coldhearted man, don’t just leave your wife and son in the harsh cruel world!]
It only helped to fuel Shangguan Feiyun’s anger, his turning face red.
[For god’s fricking sake! Isn’t this your damn child? I’m here giving him to you and you don’t want him? Do it again and I’ll just bury him!]
Of course he was only thinking about it and not putting it into action. They weren’t about to get rid of the one thing that might just tie Gu Yifan down.
On Zhuo Fan’s side, seeing how young Sanzi’s life was assured, he had no qualms about really leaving this place.
It might look heartless and cruel and harsh, but it was the smartest thing to do.
With father and son together, their chances were nonexistent. While if one ran with the Soaring Sword, the other was sure to survive.
Shangguan Feiyun dangled young Sanzi in front of him for the Soaring Sword so Zhuo Fan of course was going to use it as a way to keep him alive.
He was stuck on how to save young Sanzi so the only choice was to make the enemy keep him alive longer. As for a rescue, Zhuo Fan’s mind was still hard at work among the constant flashing around town.
Young Sanzi’s sacrifice to save Shangguan Qingyan was unexpected, outside his plan. To try again, he would need to lay serious groundwork first.
Soaring Sword was nothing much to him, not when young Sanzi was part of the equation.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed, his face filled with conviction…

chapters.title: Chapter 920: No Winner Tonight
chapters.content:
Chapter 920: No Winner Tonight
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Phecda, Megrez, Alioth, Mizar…
With every star shining down on earth, Zhuo Fan’s hands shifted and changed locations. Each time he was brought hundreds of miles away from Shangguan Feiyun, now over five hundred miles out of Flying Cloud City.
Shangguan Feiyun’s team were like flies drawn to the glorious light, always in pursuit yet always coming short. This short delay was compounded with each transfer, making the gap over fifty kilometers wide.
But the men could only grit their teeth and keep at it. They were like a bunch of fools made to chase something that was not there for another’s amusement.
So after the fourth light came, Shangguan Feiyun had had enough, his rage exploding, “To hell with it! Is this bastard playing fetch with us? Humph, let him try it again. I won’t budge an inch. At worst, I’ll just end his son and settle it with Gu Yifan later. He can’t run forever, not while he’s in central area!”
“Sword King Feiyun, enough nonsense. All that matters is the Soaring Sword. So long as the sword is out of reach, we can’t harm a hair on his son. What if he snaps and just throws it in some dark hole forever? What then?”
Baili Jingwei gave him a warning look, then he turned to the ten array masters keeping up with them, “Grandmasters, you’re among the best array experts in the empire. Have you managed to glean anything into the array after all this time?”
The ten experts shared looks and hesitated. Finally one spoke, “Prime Minister, at first we understood little about this star array, but we now have begun to notice things. Normal teleportation arrays uses ley lines to travel, shortening the distance between points. All that needed was to break these paths and the transfer will halt. With star teleportation arrays, they follow the heaven way, using star power to connect heaven and earth, thus unbreakable. It’s far beyond any ley line teleportation array there is.”
“I don’t give a damn about his skill in arrays, or how better he is than you. I just want to know how do we get to the part where we catch him!”
Baili Jingwei’s face twitched in annoyance, “If he keeps flashing around, won’t it go on forever? While he’s rested, we’ll be weary running all over to catch him.”
“Uh, not likely. Prime Minister can rest assured.”
The array master pointed at the sky, explaining, “The world’s forces are in balance, governed by its own laws. These can never be breached by any mortals. The star array is sublime, but it can’t escape following the world’s nature. It will end. Judging by what we’ve seen so far, he has borrowed the power of six of the seven stars in the Big Dipper in order, catering to the arrays he set on the ground below. By our reckoning, the next one should be the last, the power of the stars will have been used up through Alkaid. This star, having correlated with the previous location, will be shedding its light on this earth right over there!”
The array master pointed to some random bush hundreds of miles away with a stuck up nose.
[He-he-he, see that? That’s called specializing. With just a little time watching a new array, I can already surmise it’s process. This is the awesome power of a 11th grade array mas-]
Pa!
He didn’t get to gloat for long as a sharp slap sent him spinning, his mind included.
Coming around at some point, he was face to face with an irate Baili Jingwei.
Flinching, the array masters looked dumbfounded, even wronged.
[What did we do now? Why’s Prime Minister angry with us? How are we in the wrong?]
Baili Jingwei spat through gnashed teeth, “You bunch of old decrepit fools, why the hell didn’t you say it earlier? Giving me such a drawn out and useless explanation instead of just pointing to the guy’s destination. Humph, ignorant wastes! Sword King Feiyun, let’s go, we have to keep him there the moment he lands.”
“Right!”
Shangguan Feiyun followed after Baili Jingwei with Gu Santong in his grip. There they would lay in ambush for the moment Zhuo Fan came. They were finally one step ahead.
“Prime Minister Baili, all the array grandmasters you brought seems to have atrophied brains with how slow they are.”
“What can you do when they spent their lives in scrolls about arrays yet missing the workings of the world. They can’t read the mood at all. I do find them valuable for that, but also vexed. Be it alchemists or array masters, they all wish to reach the apex in their fields and for that they study and study some more, in isolation from the rest of the world. They’re like pedantic scholars.”
“True, all known great alchemists and array masters have simple minds.”
Shangguan Feiyun nodded, then his eyebrow twitched, “Yet the kid’s the exception. He’s got great alchemy skills yet he’s slipperier than a snake. How did he get so good in alchemy when all he’s done was focus on mind games?”
Baili Jingwei’s brow shook as he nodded, “He really is the weirdest aberrant I’ve seen. Baffling everyone yet instilling in them great danger.”
Shangguan Feiyun’s eyes flashed. As the two talked, Danqing Shen was content to just carry Baili Jingwei in silence.
[Mediocrity breeds no hatred and envy, while brilliance draws danger. Boy… ]
Whoosh~
The figures dashed through the air and Baili Jingwei’s group reached the bush just as the last light came down from the heavens above just like that array master predicted.
Zhuo Fan and Shangguan Qingyan faded in behind the light.
“Ha-ha-ha, the old coot was right. The kid is coming here!” Shangguan Feiyun laughed with Gu Santong in hand, looking smugh, “Let’s see how you run now! Grandmaster Gu, I’ve come to deliver your son, ha-ha-ha…”
Shangguan Qingyan gasped at Shangguan Feiyun’s vile expression, “How are they so fast now? We just stopped and they already caught up!”
“They must’ve noticed the array’s process. Quite normal when you have ten array masters in tow.”
Zhuo Fan watched as the enemy was looking at him like a piece of meat to gorge on. Other than that, his face was flat, his hands steady as the signs flowed, “Not that it makes a difference. Alkaid!”
Hum~
The pillar of light exploded in a blinding light that turned night into day in an instant.
The violent surge spread everywhere, including Shangguan Feiyun’s group. They were forced to a halt and gasping for breath as they covered their eyes from the light.
Baili Jingwei covered his face but let only a slit to see the smirking Zhuo Fan behind the curtain of light. He shouted at the array masters, “Just what is this? They array’s power is too strong for even a Genesis Stage expert to get close!”
“Prime Minister, we don’t know at the moment. We need to observe for longer!”
“Screw you!”
The array masters were covering their eyes as well and their response only made Baili Jingwei angry.
[These old geezers always mess up when I need them most!]
Zhuo Fan laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, Prime Minister sir, of course they don’t know. But I can give them a tip. The name of the array is Big Dipper Flinging Array. The crux of it isn’t the seven stars but the Dipper, get it?”
Whoosh~
Giving a most annoying smile, the two were gone along with their pillar of light, leaving behind his last solemn words, “Thank you, Prime Minister, for looking after my wretched son. If you still feel the need to have the Soaring Sword, I ask that you raise him big and strong for when I’ll be coming to take him back, ha-ha-ha…”
Whoosh!
The seven stars up above sported faint lines between them, connecting each one.
With one last flash, Big Dipper shone brighter and shot a ray of light like a shooting star, splitting the sky in two.
At the end of the ray was none other than North Star. Right after, one last pillar of light smashed onto earth, shaking it hard.
This time, however, there was no chase. It was just too far away, needing days for even Genesis Stage experts to catch up.
Zhuo Fan had just gotten away from right under their noses.
Looking at the sparkling light, everyone had a dull gaze.
The entire force of the manor had been running around in circles for the better part of the night, yet they had nothing to show for it. All they had been doing was ending up as the butt of another’s joke. The worst part was he was only in the Radiant Stage…
Humiliation did not even begin to describe the utter shame and crushing defeat.
It was not reduced to Flying Cloud manor’s disgrace, but it included Baili Jingwei’s, Sword Star Empire’s and the Nine Sword Kings’.
Baili Jingwei held his head and sighed.
The great sage of the empire had been led by the nose all night long…

chapters.title: Chapter 921: Back at the Start
chapters.content:
Chapter 921: Back at the Start
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Ha-ha-ha, we have it!”
All watched the fading light with crushed looks. Flying Cloud manor’s hundreds of Genesis Stage experts, with a Sword King and the sage of the empire, found themselves utterly helpless in stopping one small thief.
The news was hard to swallow to anyone and the mood was bleak. But not for all, evident by that bright laughter.
With twitching faces and angry glares, they knew the laughter wasn’t mocking them, but it still felt like scorn in their ears.
So they turned towards the culprit, one of the ten array masters.
Totally oblivious of the hatred he gathered, the array master looked positively radiant at his discovery, skipping like a child to Baili Jingwei, “Prime Minister, we got it! The intricacy of the star array is obvious now!”
Baili Jingwei frowned and didn’t speak, but seeing their innocent smiles made him shake his head.
“Prime Minister, the Big Dipper Flinging Array isn’t just a short teleportation array but also a gathering array. He had been moving seven times, six times between Dubhe and Alkaid while the last transfer unleashed all the power the array gathered. It is just a minor teleportation array but acts like a major one. Using the connection between the North Star and the Big Dipper, he formed a large transfer. That’s why he said the focus wasn’t on the stars but on the Big Dipper, which is none other than a hint at North Star. By flinging he meant by using all the star power in the Big Dipper through the North Star!”
Baili Jingwei’s disappointed face didn’t even register to the ecstatic array master, growing more and more exuberant. The sudden venue of research he discovered was too much excitement for him to bear, “The star array is truly wondrous. I did say you must have the skills to do it, and power. Without it, it wouldn’t get you far. I just didn’t imagine he’d used seven stars’ power into one. That’s why there was such a great surge right at the end. But too much power would damage a minor array such as this, which is why it only works once. See for yourself, the array formation is ruined!”
The array master went to the bush and after a bit of searching he came out with sacred stone fragments, shouting, “See? It’s exactly as we deducted. The power overwhelmed the array and ruined it, ha-ha-ha…”
The other nine array masters broke out in laughter alongside him. This proved their conjecture was without a doubt correct.
Baili Jingwei was drained of the energy to even cuss at them. He just sighed and flew back to the manor. Danqing Shen went after him.
The array masters were stumped.
[Is Prime Minister mad at us? He was so eager to know just a minute ago.]
“It’s too late…”
Shangguan Feiyun sighed, “He’s gone now so what’s the point of explaining? Humph, some array grandmasters you are…”
Shangguan Feiyun left as well with the guards. Some even shot them some looks of disdain.
[Bookworms only like to show off!]
The ten were left baffled and clueless.
[Too late? Sure it is late, but not ‘too’ late. The guy might’ve escaped but getting this long lost star array is invaluable. Do you have any idea what it’s worth?]
“Humph, what does a dumb philistine even know?”
The array master mocked them, “They’re gone so let’s research the array the man set up. Careful not to damage it further. This is a star array we’re talking about. Those uncultured swines have no idea what they’re dealing with here. Unlike them, our research might even lead us to develop many new arrays!”
“Hear, hear…”
“Well said…”
His friends wholly agreed, getting to work at once. They treated each remnant as an archeology site, turning every nook and cranny and speck of dust to get the most out of it.
This was the difference between a specialist and a politician. The first focused on his own world, going for new discoveries and innovations. While the second only cared about reputation and his pockets.
These two groups had no tangent whatsoever while also shunning each other. The politician laughed at the specialist for being pedantic, while the specialist disdained a politician’s sophistry. When a politician became a specialist, he’d show no result. If a specialist changed sides, his life would be ruined, always pulled in all directions and blocked from committing himself to his research. There would be no progress as well.
Baili Jingwei had a healthy respect for specialists, since all he cared about was the benefits these men brought along. As for their academic research and goals, he knew nothing nor was he willing to try.
They were each stuck with a different perspective, abhorring the other’s style in every way.
Though Baili Jingwei understood one truth, that only the obsession and pedantic made one a specialist. Disapproval and poor communication aside, he wholly approved of them.
For he had only to gain from these kinds of specialists. With all the anger and frustration in their interactions, it was still not enough to snap and just kill them.
This was just one of the crucial qualities for a man in power…
Back in the manor, at the Jade Falls, Baili Jingwei gasped at the icicles on the ground. He’d been going against people his whole life, yet this time he failed so miserably. He had gained nothing in this fight.
“Gu Yifan, you’re a true genius, but one that I found most revolting!”
Baili Jingwei took a deep breath, “We were born with conflicting personalities. Bemoaning a new contender. As we’re both deep thinkers, clashes are unavoidable. Guess scholars always tend to criticize another, ha-ha-ha…”
Whoosh~
Shangguan Feiyun came over with Gu Santong, “Prime Minister, what about the brat?”
“Lives for now. Until Gu Yifan takes the bait then he dies with him!” Baili Jingwei gnashed his teeth.
Shangguan Feiyun mocked, “That’s rare, for the talent cherishing Prime Minister to have such bloodlust against another talent. He must really have gotten under your skin, ha-ha-ha…”
“Today has nothing to do with it. Even knowing his real talents, I’d have never let him take another breath all the same. Especially if I could use him.”
Baili Jingwei’s eyes flashed and left while leaving behind a chilling tone, “I loath anyone like me!”
Shangguan Feiyun smirked, “Scholars never call themselves the best while fighters always fake modesty saying their second. Fighters shed blood and sweat in their savage fights while scholars pit their minds in convoluted schemes. So even the great Prime Minister Baili cannot live this down. He must really feel threatened, ha-ha-ha…”
Shangguan Feiyun turned to the now ruined water garden and gnashed his teeth, “Gu Yifan, you ruined my paradise and I’ll ruin you!”
Shangguan Feiyun huffed and walked away, the wounded Gu Santong dangling in his hand and leaving a trail of blood behind.
Danqing Shen stroked his beard while shaking his head.
[Boy, you now have a pair of rabid dogs after you. This will only get hard for you from now on…]
Meanwhile, as the beam of light fell, Zhuo Fan and Shangguan Qingyan appeared among the glittering motes in a thick forest leagues away from Flying Cloud City.
Shangguan Qingyan was still shellshocked by what had transpired. She had been going a hundred miles at a time in each jump then out of nowhere they were so far she couldn’t see a shadow of Flying Cloud City.
Shangguan Feiyun was not getting to them now.
Relishing the thought, Shangguan Qingyan turned to Zhuo Fan, “Mister Gu, how did you…”
“Wait here. I need to blow off steam.”
Zhuo Fan spoke coldly and went deep in a dark cave. Shangguan Qingyan looked worried, apprehensive at his words as she waited tense.
Howls of beasts soon reverberated from the cave, filled with anger and frustration.
Shangguan Qingyan jerked, lowering her head as she understood his grief. He needed to let go. All that perfect planning to get him and young Sanzi away from Flying Cloud City failed.
[Because of me, his son was taken.]
She blamed herself for everything, shedding tears of remorse in solitude.
The howls went on for a long time into the black night, all the way till dawn.
Shangguan Qingyan was conflicted about what was happening, how he was, but could not gather the courage to venture inside the cave. When Zhuo Fan finally did come out, he had a flat look, deader than before.
What got Shangguan Qingyan curious was that Zhuo Fan’s aura felt dimmer in a way and that his cultivation fell to the 4th layer of Radiant Stage from 5th…

chapters.title: Chapter 922: Goodbye
chapters.content:
Chapter 922: Goodbye
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“H-how…” Shangguan Qingyan’s lip quivered as she stared at Zhuo Fan’s flat expression in shock and doubt.
Zhuo Fan sighed, having figured out her question, “What’s the problem? I just advanced in these two days, is all.”
“Advance? Then how…”
“I use a different cultivation method than the rest. It focuses on the mind, into going back to one’s nature, the True Self Art.”
Zhuo Fan spoke, “What looks like regression is in fact hiding one’s aura, blurring inside as cultivation returns to inception and purest chaotic form; all while the power grows. At the same time, the heart and mind attain peace, impulses drop and help one’s character. Every time something bothers or triggers me, I cultivate. I’ve been doing this for the past two years.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes looked peaceful, but there was a sadness deep in there that nothing could cover.
He had been cultivating Elder Yuan’s cultivation method for these two years, to calm his mind. All that sorrow and longing had been quelled for so long…
Shangguan Qingyan noticed something and asked, “You mean because your wife, these years…”
“That’s enough of that!”
Zhuo Fan shouted, cutting her off, “Where’s your Shangguan clan meeting? I’ll take you there.”
Shangguan Qingyan jerked and then saw the calm look he still had. She dropped the subject and led the way.
Glancing at her, Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed as he followed.
One man and one woman flew one in front and one behind, eastbound. As the sun rose again in front, two days passed.
They had not spoken a single word all this time. Zhuo Fan sported the same dry look while Shangguan Qingyan was anxious all the time, stealing glances. She wanted to ask more, or better yet, know him more. But that distant expression of his quelled any such curiosity.
Another day stuck like that, Shangguan Qingyan descended next to a lake. Zhuo Fan floated down next to her and scanned the surroundings, “Is this where the Shangguan clan is retreating? Quite hidden.”
“How did you know? I didn’t tell you.” Shangguan Qingyan gasped.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Did you forget I dabble in arrays? The barrier around the lake is invisible to the average eye, but it can’t hide from mine. If it wouldn’t be bad manners barging in, I would’ve popped it already.”
She batted her big purdy eyes, once again stunned.
Even as Zhuo Fan gave her a funny look, she still didn’t react, just staring at him like a statue.
“I-is there anything else you can do that I don’t know about?”
“Aplenty, but why should I tell you? Just ring the doorbell already!” Zhuo Fan sighed and shook his head. He flicked her head, jerking it and making her pout in pain.
She wasn’t really angry, just blushing. With a bright smile, she made a sign to open the barrier but didn’t finish as someone shouted, “Who’s there?”
Two youths in white pooped in front in high alert.
“It’s me, can’t you see it?” Stucking out her chin, Shangguan Qingyan declared.
The two paused then exploded, “Young miss, you’re back! Clan Head has been so worried about you!”
Shangguan Qingyan nodded with a smile.
“Hold up. Gu Yifan, you dare show your face here? Die!” The two finally noticed Zhuo Fan and their bloodlust exploded, backed by their Soul Harmony Stage cultivation.
Shangguan Qingyan panicked and wanted to stop them, “What are you doing?”
“Young miss, Clan Head and the venerables told us Gu Yifan was a spy. All our losses are due to him. Now we’ll have our revenge for our kin!”
The two spat, advising Shangguan Qingyan, “Young miss, step aside. Don’t let his pretty words fool you. He has got to die!”
The two’s savage looks had her tense. She stood before them still, defending Zhuo Fan, “As long as I’m here, no one will harm a hair on Mister Gu’s body!”
“Young miss!”
The two regarded Shangguan Qingyan’s determination and sighed in defeat and pain.
Shangguan Qingyan looked behind her and whispered, “Leave quickly, before dad comes out. Now, while I can still protect you. Once everyone is here, I won’t be able to do anything.”
“No one asked you to. I came just to see your dad. Now move along and lead me to him.” Zhuo Fan stated.
Shangguan Qingyan glared hard at him, “Is this the time to show your brave side? You had so many of our clan killed. My dad is the head and won’t just let you go. Are you that intent on dying?”
“All the more reason the young miss of the Shangguan clan should call out her daddy, to punish this criminal and get retribution. Well, what are you standing around for? “
“Why you…”
Shangguan Qingyan was stunned and then she cursed, “Can’t you see I’m helping you? Why do you insist on walking to your death? If you die… what will I tell young Sanzi?”
Zhuo Fan’s tone was cold, “None of your concern. I came here for your dad. If you won’t lead me, then I’ll just barge in by myself.”
Zhuo Fan was getting ready to make good on his words.
Shangguan Qingyan hastly stopped him while grumbling, “Barging in will only make it worse. Fine then, have it your way. I’ll go tell him you’re here. Maybe I can…”
Shangguan Qingyan shook her head, feeling that her request would most likely land on deaf ears. But since no persuasion worked on Zhuo Fan, she had no choice but brace for the worst.
Shangguan Qingyan made her sign and the tranquil lake water rippled. A black hole formed as the entrance of a deep cave was presented to them.
“You two, be nice. You’re not to do anything until I return. Is that clear?” Shangguan Qingyan was about to go in then she warned the two guards to not make a mess of things.
The two looked at each other and bowed most respectfully, “As young miss commands! We understand!”
“You better!”
Shangguan Qingyan nodded and her dress flicked as she entered. She gazed back in worry even as she did, “Mister Gu, you can still walk away.”
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes.
Shangguan Qingyan sighed and went deeper. The cave echoed with her ever distant steps, until they vanished…
The guards were listening to every noise, to make sure she was gone. Then they sported nasty grins.
Their bloodlust was directed at Zhuo Fan, ready to pounce.
Zhuo Fan gave an insufferable smirk…
“Young miss is back…”
Shangguan Qingyan didn’t go too far and a patrol announced her return with joy.
The Clan Head rushed over at once, unable to contain his happiness to find his daughter was alive. He hugged her tight, “Yan’er, you’re here at last! Are you hurt?”
“I’m fine, dad, thanks for asking.”
Shangguan Qingyan was happy too. Then Shangguan Feixiong asked in a rush, “Yan’er, how come you only got back now? Did he do anything to you?”
“No, Mister Gu has been nice ever since he saved me. He even escorted…”
“What, he brought you here?”
She just wanted to put Zhuo Fan in a good light, but Shangguan Feixiong was stunned, “Where is he now?”

chapters.title: Chapter 923: Renegotiations
chapters.content:
Chapter 923: Renegotiations
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Ugh!
Shangguan Qingyan’s heart sank, stuck on what would be a good response. She wanted to start off by making Zhuo Fan sound good and get her clan to change their impression of him. This way, the request wouldn’t sound so harsh.
Now her dad wouldn’t even let her speak her intention. The two might even come to blows. It was like bringing fire to gunpowder.
[What do I do?]
Shangguan Feixiong noticed her hesitation, “You don’t know? After escorting you, did he leave or not?”
“Father, please calm down first. You have to only just talk with him. He could have his own share of problems.”
Shangguan Qingyan didn’t reply, trying to mediate in Zhuo Fan’s stead. Shangguan Feixiong got the gist of it, “So he’s outside? With who?”
“We met two clansmen and are watching…”
“Damn it!”
Shangguan Feixiong clenched his fists and rushed out. The other elders and experts, venerables included, went with.
“Whenever kids clash, it always leads to a fight. Gu Yifan must be…”
Shangguan Feixiong frowned and Shangguan Qingyan was happy at his reaction, “Father, are you worried about Mister Gu? Great, so you don’t hate him. But don’t worry, I already warned them. They won’t do anything to Mister Gu and wait for you to come.”
“Worried about him? Ha!”
Shangguan Feixiong snapped, annoyed, “The last few days we spent interrogating that bastard Yulin. Now we know that Gu Yifan destroyed him in one strike. There’s no way the two guards can even harm him. Once they fight, they’ll only get killed. The Shangguan clan will never allow anyone to trample over us!”
Shangguan Qingyan jerked and stuck her tongue, “I told you that I warned them. Mister Gu came to see you as well so he won’t make a scene…”
“Warn? Do you actually think some hotheaded youth will just listen just because some wench told him to?”
Shangguan Feixiong sighed, “Boldness is good for youths, but too much leads to recklessness and unforgiving mistakes. Second elder, are those two yours? No matter what happens, you have to stay calm. We’ll handle it after we know his reason for being here.”
The elder in question nodded at once, “Clan Head, I’ve been cultivating for so long now, my mind is like a rock. You still don’t know me?”
[Ha-ha-ha, it’s because I know you too well that I’m warning you. You never once smoothened your nasty temper all these years!]
Shangguan Feixiong shook his head.
The Shangguan clan’s big men made their grandiose entrance, or exit, outside. They all looked tense, like they were meeting another big faction.
Shangguan Qingyan clicked her tongue.
[What’s up with them? Father’s more than enough to see Mister Gu. What’s the need of coming out in full force?]
Her tiny mind was still telling her that Zhuo Fan was her peer, waiting for his punishment like any disciple in the wrong. He was no different from Shangguan Yulin, who was also a traitor.
Shangguan Feixiong’s thinking was different. For the job he planned on Flying Cloud manor, the Shangguan clan saw Shangguan Yulin as a spy, but not Zhuo Fan. Zhuo Fan ended up being the master in the shadows.
He was the third party in the clash between the manor and the Shangguan clan. Not to mention he made a fool out of the greatest sage in the empire, Baili Jingwei.
There was nothing reasonable about judging Zhuo Fan. Not when he exceeded the limits within which any normal youth should operate. He was a faction leader in his own right.
Their coming in force at Zhuo Fan was not in any way to label him a traitor, but to negotiate from one leader to another.
It sounded ridiculous to anyone’s ears.
[Hundreds of your Genesis Stage experts are coming out to see a Soul Harmony Stage kid at best? And for what, negotiations?]
That there was the problem. He wasn’t just of Soul Harmony Stage strength, but a calculative man of Baili Jingwei’s level. Wasn’t Prime Minister Baili worthy of their talks?
It only gave Zhuo Fan more value.
One other aspect was worth mentioning. The Soaring Sword was with him and that left them with even fewer choices. They refused to believe a youth shrewd enough to clash with Baili Jingwei would let his hormones do the talking and hand it over just because hundreds of experts were giving him mean looks.
As such, negotiations…
Hum~
Shangguan Feixiong’s group opened the barrier and came out in power. But then his face twitched.
The worst case scenario he pictured came true…
Zhuo Fan was just casually standing next to a bush. The problem started when one looked down at the blood under his feet. The two young Shangguan clan guards were battered and bleeding on the ground, giving an on and off groan to signal they were still in this world.
One was sure that even they were baffled how a Radiant Stage youth would just wreck them like nothing.
Their eyes were filled with sorrow and pain, but no amount would change reality…
[The info came too late. We didn’t get to notify the clan of his strength. Damn it, just where did this pair of monstrous son and father come from? One’s freakier than the next!]
The elders sighed. The elder declaring his rock steady nerves to Shangguan Feixiong was now boiling at the humiliation his disciples were given. His mighty aura of a Genesis Stage expert was on full display.
Zhuo Fan spared the man no glance, laughing and being friendly, “Uncle, these three days felt like years. Did you miss me, ha-ha-ha…”
“Cut the bullshit! I saw exactly what you are three days ago. Stop with the damn acting, Gu Yifan!” Shangguan Feixiong’s face tensed and snapped, “Why are you here? What’s your angle?”
Zhuo Fan paused in his step, revealing a bright smile.
Shangguan Qingyan interjected, in hopes of easing the tension, “Father, Mister Gu cared about my safety and walked me back…”
“Nah, I asked her to lead me here to chat with Shangguan Clan Head.”
Zhuo Fan didn’t let her sugarcoat it and cut her good intentions short. With his words, his tone grew colder as well, “Shangguan Clan Head, I have an offer for you. Interested?”
Shangguan Feixiong stared at the cold and savage face, “Speak.”
“Then I’ll be blunt.”
Zhuo Fan began, “For the sake of your precious daughter, my son was captured by Shangguan Feiyun. As the Shangguan clan is a clan devoted to righteousness, wouldn’t it be natural for you to return the favor and help me save my son?”
Shangguan Qingyan shook.
[Mister Gu is risking so much for his son. He came to see dad for this]
“Yeah, for me, young Sanzi…”
“This doesn’t concern you. Leave!”
Shangguan Feixiong cut her off, staring hard at Zhuo Fan, “Ha-ha-ha, save my daughter? You two used her as bait to control my clan. We’ve danced to your tune for the better half of a month and cost the lives of so many of my people. If I could, I would give up my daughter in exchange for their lives. Now you want us to take such a high risk for saving my daughter? Whatever for?”
Shangguan Qingyan shook, gasping at her father’s words. Her heart was in pain, hanging her head and shedding tears in distress.
[Father cares more about others than me.]
This was her father, devoted to good.
[If I could give my life for them, then I would…]
Shangguan Qingyan’s heart was crushed, but understood that this came for what her clan believed in.
Shangguan Feixiong paid her no heed, still glaring in anger at Zhuo Fan.
The elders declared, “We will follow our righteous Clan Head to death!”
Righteous?
Zhuo Fan quirked an eyebrow as he searched Shangguan Feixiong’s eyes. He wasn’t buying it.
[Throwing away your flesh and blood for mere sympathy points. Hypocrite!]
[Nothing more than a trick of negotiation. Did you really think I’d fall for that gimmick? Humph…]

chapters.title: Chapter 924: Successful Cooperation
chapters.content:
Chapter 924: Successful Cooperation
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone with disdain, his face skewed in the most condescending way possible, “Shangguan Clan Head, that’s quite a fact twisting. It’s no different than saying that I and my son ended up causing your heavy casualties. Even with saving your precious daughter, it pales to the hundreds of lost lives. But ask yourself this, was your clan’s losses the result of my design?”
Shangguan Feixiong shook, winced and became solemn.
“Humph, your clan fell for the scheme, one, because of Baili Jingwei’s deliberate and devious ploy and two, because of you, Shangguan Feixiong, due to your narrow minded view and your shaky decisions. Take me out of the picture and the Shangguan clan would have suffered all the same. You’d still have your traitor. You’d still be jumping at the chance to send Shangguan Yulin to the Pill King Convention Baili Jingwei set up just for you. That punk would still turn on his clan. And, of course, your clan would still suffer and die in Baili Jingwei’s trap. You can’t blame this one me, not when I had no hand in it. It’s all you, Shangguan Feixiong. It’s what the incompetent and greedy Shangguan Clan Head brought to fruition. I was only there for the ride, a mere passenger. Your disaster has not a thing to do with me!”
Zhuo Fan shouted, filled with mockery and disdain, “Quite the contrary, if you think about it. It’s my very existence that stirred things at the falls and caused Baili Jingwei to panic into breaking your trap and allowing you stragglers to be standing here. You might even say that I’m not just your daughter’s savior, but everyone’s. You’re spitting on another’s favor and going as far as poisoning the well by throwing all your incompetence on me. Talk about being ungrateful. Is this how the righteous number one clan in eastern lands operates? I spit on you, hypocrites!”
Zhuo Fan’s roars rang into their ears, cutting them deep. Some were so overcome with realization that they hung their heads in shame.
[He didn’t care about us, but he only used both of the parties’ fight for his benefit. He has not endangered Shangguan clan at all.]
[As he said, is there no one who wouldn’t play the third party and kill the remains of the first two? How can we just blame our shortcomings on an outsider?]
[This isn’t how the best clan in eastern lands takes responsibility!]
[He did offer us a fake map, but even if it was real, Baili Jingwei would still have trapped us.]
When all was said and done, their fight with Flying Cloud manor was only on them.
[Like he said, if not for his involvement, we’d remain mere fish in a barrel, awaiting our demise. We have no right to blame him.]
[He really is the Shangguan clan’s savior…]
The elders behind Shangguan Feixiong were chattering, forcing him to shake his head. The imposing stance he had was now crushed.
They were Genesis Stage experts and would not pick on the weak, especially with their righteous reputation. They always had to find the moral high ground for their every action.
This was why excuses were everything. Even if one was up to no good, they had to find a good explanation first. This… righteousness was like a chain holding his clan’s experts back.
Their original plan was to come out in force and flex a bit in hope they’d scare Zhuo Fan enough to fork out the sword as to gain absolution. Now that he tore their groundless excuses to shreds, they had no right to demand it.
They were not vile, or hypocrites to such a degree. If they could use the proper means to get their wish, good. They would never stoop so low as to stain their beliefs, they didn’t have the nerve to.
Seeing them stuck, Zhuo Fan stared at their conflicted looks. Shangguan Feixiong was looking gloomier than ever, not knowing what to do as the whispers behind him continued.
The Shangguan clan’s position had been crushed from the start.
Shangguan Feixiong pondered and this time regarded Zhuo with seriousness, “Gu Yifan, you may be right. This loss was on us and not you. But to have us rescue your son, I’m afraid that’s not possible. We’ve suffered heavy losses and can’t even fight the Flying Cloud manor. As a Clan Head, I cannot unjustifiably risk my people’s lives. You may be our savior, but I’ll still have to refuse…”
“Faker!”
Zhuo Fan mocked him, “Shangguan Clan Head, a true man doesn’t talk behind another’s back. You’ve come to the central area with so many people yet had not once considered the risk, how many you would lose? Humph…”
Shangguan Feixiong regarded him in silence.
Zhuo Fan scoffed, “Death is either heavy or worthless. Every life has its value. Hasn’t that value been long established for all of you?”
“Soaring Sword!” Shangguan Feixiong’s eyes shone.
With an evil smirk, Zhuo Fan nodded, “Right? Shangguan Clan Head, let’s be honest for once. You all came to the central area for the Soaring Sword but now it lies with me. In other words, I can use it to buy your lives for my purpose, right?”
“Of course not, even with so many of us here, we still have our principles. With excessive losses.”
“Oh, right, my bad. I wasn’t talking about all of you, just a few experts. I mean, there’s no point in using some weak fools like these two here. They’d just die anyway, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan cut Shangguan Feixiong’s off, dispelling his misgivings while driving his point by kicking the beaten and helpless guys on the ground.
Shangguan Feixiong approved.
[That’s reassuring.]
This was his limit. The pain of just letting these youths die in the central area instead of going back home was too much for him to accept.
These kids were the future of the Shangguan clan. Their deaths meant the crippling of Shangguan clan’s power and a bleak fate.
Regardless of times, the greatest power of a clan or a sect would always be its heritage. With just some awesome experts at the helm, one just had to wipe them all out and your faction would crumble by itself.
While this intermediate part would in a couple of decades turn into heroes. The clan would flourish and it would be glorified.
As for the experts, they could enter the enemy camp no problem. So long as they weren’t trapped like before, escaping couldn’t be easier.
When Zhuo Fan offered the Soaring Sword to some experts, he instantly weighed the pros and cons, agreeing to the deal. Though some skepticism remained, “Gu Yifan, I can lend them to you, but how are you going to handle Flying Cloud manor’s overwhelming force? Do you have any guarantees?”
“Who do you take me for, you? Humph…”
Zhuo Fan scorned, “Lighten up, I’m not going brain dead like you and won’t incur heavy losses. The chances are not one of them might even die while you’d be getting a bargain with the Soaring Sword, Shangguan Clan Head, ha-ha-ha…”
Shangguan Feixiong shook. The biting words entered his ears yet didn’t get a rise. All he did was stare at his confident eyes before nodding.
[We’ve seen just how shrewd he is. I just hope it’s the case. Since he’s only asking for some experts, they could react to anything.]
Not how he was always passive and ended up with sacrifices…
Shangguan Feixiong frowned. Agreeing was one thing and his restless mind was another. Though unlike him, second elder’s rage could not be quenched, “Humph, so now we’re supposed to listen to some brat?”
“Yep, got a problem?”
“Damn right! Shangguan clan’s elders follow the Clan Head, not some rotten punk.”
Second elder’s fury peaked as he regarded the disciples at Zhuo Fan’s feet, “Moreover, we’re not about to just turn a blind eye to you harming our disciples without a reason!”
Zhuo Fan sported a crafty smile, egging him on, “Senior, you’re welcome to step forward and I’ll be more than happy to justify myself for these two juniors’ predicament.”
“Humph, you had your chance to apologize!” Second elder huffed and stomped before Zhuo Fan, shouting, “These two are my disciples. Harming them means…”
Pa!
The crisp and snappy sound of the slap rang in everyone’s ears. Second elder’s thin cheek now sported a very conspicuous mark.
Zhuo Fan waved his hand around, “What are you waiting for, for a face slap?”
Sss~
Everyone else gasped in stupefaction. Second elder was a Genesis Stage expert that warranted Clan Head’s respect when being addressed. Now though, a mere Radiant Stage brat slapped him, shaming and humiliating him in the worst possible way…

chapters.title: Chapter 925: Love Between Father and Daughter
chapters.content:
Chapter 925: Love Between Father and Daughter
Proofreader
: Papatonks
[Gu Yifan, you’re finished. The old man’s going to kill you!]
They all watched, sighing helplessly and stunned. This kid had such a gall on him that he’d go and just slap a Genesis Stage expert’s face, literally.
Second elder had his mind black for a second there.
But the feel of his scorching sting on that cheek made his face twist in fury as he howled. He unleashed all his power filled with bloodlust, thinking only about killing Zhuo Fan as he went to smash his brains out.
“You goddamn punk, now you’ve done it!”
“Why not? The question is, what are you going to do about it, hit me back?”
Zhuo Fan jabbed, “Did your atrophied mind already forget about the Soaring Sword? Kill me and you can say goodbye to it. You’ll be the shame of the clan!”
The sudden palm attack stopped just as fast as it started, though it kept shaking for some reason. Second elder glared at Zhuo Fan with bloodshot eyes, but his only option was to grind his teeth, stop with his attack midway and come to terms to reality.
Zhuo Fan’s words cut right where it hurt the most. They came all the way here, to the central area, just for that particular sword. If, say, they failed because of his lousy temper in offing the kid, he’d end up destroying all his clan’s sacrifices and hard work so far.
Second elder’s every fiber screamed to just let go and do it, but he reined in all the fury, thinking about who he was doing it for. But the rage was bouncing around in his skull with nowhere to go and affecting his mood.
“Rotten punk, just you wait. If it weren’t for the clan…”
Pa!
Zhuo Fan gave a quick response in the form of another quite resounding slap on the other cheek, just to match, “Why wait? Geezer, enough of playing your seniority card. I already said that I’m using the Soaring Sword for your lives. Haven’t you come after this thing anyway? Forget about those meager slaps, even killing these two at my feet still won’t give you any worth to haggle with me!”
“You!”
Second elder’s heart jerked, pointing at him but his mind was so overwhelmed cursing came hard.
The brat was too obnoxious and insufferable in his gloating. It was even worse knowing he could get away with it too, mocking the other as much as he wanted since the victim had to just sit there and take it.
So he huffed and puffed for a while now, but that was it.
Everyone else was dumbfounded. Their second elder, who was always like a powder keg, just got manhandled by a kid!
The same kid had the Soaring Sword, granted, but the other was a veteran who fought in hundreds of battles. Was it that easy to just deflate him?
The three venerables nodded with hard faces.
[What a shrewd tactic. It’s only more obvious he’s capable of it since he beat Baili Jingwei…]
Ignoring second elder popping a vein there, Zhuo Fan walked over to the cave like the others weren’t even there, “I’m going in to pick the men and I’ll be gone.”
The other looked from him to the still fuming second elder with dumb looks.
Shangguan Qingyan was stunned by this new side of Zhuo Fan. That he’d have the nerve to mess with a Genesis Stage expert. It only worked to make her heart race faster…
“A Demon Archon!”
A whisper traveled, completing her thought.
[Savage as a demon and dominating like a king.]
There was no other explanation.
She turned to see who it was that said it and found it to be her own father.
Only to find his face solemn.
Feeling her gaze, Shangguan Feixiong told the elders, “Go and watch the kid. Read his pattern, but don’t incite him. He is shrewd and brave, with a subtle mind and having the one thing we want the most. What’s worse, he doesn’t fear us at all.”
“Alright, Feixiong, we will. At the very least, we won’t get slapped out of nowhere by a kid, ha-ha-ha…”
Glaring at second elder, the venerable mocked. Then he turned serious and led the men into the cave after Zhuo Fan.
For all intents and purposes, the kid was just that, a junior, but his twisted mind and subtleties left these men of power seeing him as nothing less than a fearsome character, their equal.
As for second elder, he got coaxed by other elders to come along, recalling at the last minute there were two disciples Zhuo Fan thrashed and picked them up to heal them.
The place was soon left to Shangguan Feixiong and his daughter.
He called to her as she was leaving, “Hold on, Yan’er.”
“What is it, father?” Shangguan Qingyan asked.
Shangguan Feixiong paused in hesitation, but spoke honestly, “Yan’er, now that we’re alone, I want to apologize.”
“Apologize?”
“Yeah.”
Shangguan Feixiong sighed, “Yan’er, your mom passed away early and I have remarried many times to cultivate our art, but you’re the only daughter I ever had, and no one can replace you in my heart. I have said those words, of exchanging your life with others, but it was only part of the plan, not actually feasible. What parent on this heaven’s green earth would have the heart to give his child away? Even for ten or a hundred, no one will.”
Shangguan Qingyan shook and her eyes shone with hope.
Shangguan Feixiong sighed, “I only said it to chip away at Gu Yifan’s stance in the negotiations and take the initiative. I could not let him, just because he saved my daughter, offer everything on a silver platter, even paying with our people’s lives. Saying some falsehoods is natural in negotiations. Maybe you think I’m a hypocrite instead of open and direct, ruining Shangguan Clan Head’s righteous name, but this is the world we live in, Yan’er. If my words hurt you, then I want to apologize. A father can always see his daughter’s tears no matter where you are.”
“Father!”
Shangguan Qingyan was overjoyed as she went to hug him, tears gushing, “I knew that father cared about me the most. No matter how stubborn I was or how I always annoyed the aunties, father won’t ever change. I knew father loved me the most. Father may not be the most righteous man, but you’re the best father a daughter could have.”
Shangguan Feixiong smiled and nodded, “I’m glad you understand. I thought you’ll no longer respect me after seeing me lying. Now, ha-ha, that it’s out in the open, I feel so much better…”
“Father, you said it was only a trick to switch the negotiations in your favor. Did it work?” Shangguan Qingyan looked at him in curiosity.
Shangguan Feixiong’s face twitched and he sighed, “Uh, the kid’s too cunning and I wasn’t able to get any advantage, crushing me at every step. Did you not see his outrageous arrogance? He even dared mock me! He now holds all the cards in this deal while I’m the loser. I just want to get him to finish his goal and get the sword from him. With his cocky attitude, if he stays for too long, something’s bound to happen. He really is the devil!”
“Oh.”
Shangguan Qingyan nodded with a bright smile.
Shangguan Feixiong noticed the sparks in her eyes and sighed.
[She’s all grown up and a man is going to take her from me. The day is fast approaching. But he’s just too dangerous.]
Shangguan Feixiong took a deep breath. Feeling for the first time that even as the Clan Head, he could not assure her happiness.
For the man she had her eyes on was uncontrollable…
Zhuo Fan walked around the cave like he owned the place, with the elders and venerables in tow. It was as if an emperor went out on a stroll with his guards.
The other clansmen there were struck dumb, especially the juniors.
[Isn’t that Gu Yifan, the traitor? Why does it look like the elders are catering to him like a Clan Head in this secret base?]
They all wore goony looks as Zhuo Fan passed them…

chapters.title: Chapter 926: Expendable
chapters.content:
Chapter 926: Expendable
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Say kid, just what are you looking for in the cave?”
Having looked over most of the cave yet not particularly interested in anything there, or maybe they were beneath him, one man got curious since he also didn’t start choosing his party.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone and looked at the puzzled people, “Looking for someone, a messenger.”
“Messenger?”
“Precisely!”
Zhuo Fan grinned, “I need a runner, someone to send a letter to Flying Cloud manor to set a place for a hostage exchange.”
The clansmen were curious, “Exchange hostages?”
“Sure, the Soaring Sword for my son, humph…” Zhuo Fan scoffed.
Shangguan clan elders were stumped but also annoyed.
[For crying out loud, wasn’t that sword supposed to be for us? How’d you use it in an exchange?]
Zhuo Fan easily read their faces and smiled, “It’s obviously a ruse. If it were that easy to get my son in an exchange with Baili Jingwei, I’d have done it already. Why would I waste time coming here of all places? Since I can’t put stock in Baili Jingwei to follow through with the switch, I’ll be needing you guys’ help. Though if you feel disinclined to lend a hand, or two, I’ll just have to go out on a limb. It’s all the same to me, really.”
“Uh, no no no, we’re glad to help, glad…”
The elders rushed to reassure him, feeling sweat trickling down their necks.
[For god’s sake, if this punk makes the switch that’ll make all the losses we incurred all for nothing.]
They could trade with the kid to get the sword, but once it landed in Baili Jingwei’s hands, all hope was lost.
So Zhuo Fan had them on a leash, dangling the sword in front of their eyes to do his bidding and making them readjust their attitudes. They were scared that any mood change would push the kid into skipping them for their enemy. One man’s pain is another man’s joy.
This led to the elders treating Zhuo Fan like their ancestor, hanging on every word and following it without question. While the onlooking disciples were looking baffled all this time.
[Do our elders have no dignity? What are they doing hanging around some brat? What about the honor of the Shangguan clan?]
[Why… not me?!]
Every disciple there looked at Zhuo Fan with envy. Not even the successors of the clan were given such respect, and they were the future…
Ignoring the blatant dagger stares on his person, Zhuo Fan took a round trip around the place, only to end it with a frown and a sigh, “Isn’t there any Soul Harmony Stage disciple around?”
“Boy, such disciples are rare, barely a few of them around. Of the ones we brought, leaving Shangguan Yulin, the only ones left are the two you beat up.” One venerable rushed to answer but then was puzzled, “Does it have to be a Soul Harmony Stage disciple? What does cultivation have to do with sending a message?”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “If only it were that simple. This job comes with a high risk of dying.”
“What?” Everyone gasped.
Ignoring their squeaks, Zhuo Fan chided, “What’s with the whining? What’s the big deal about using one life? Didn’t you already use so many back in Flying Cloud manor for the Soaring Sword? I’m only asking for one, so that’s a win for you. I need a Soul Harmony Stage cultivator because his self-destruction has to be at that level at the least. An Ethereal Stage one would hardly have any effect in deafening Shangguan Feiyun. I want a disciple out of consideration for you elders. Since you’re all mighty important to the clan, I can’t just as well ask you to die. Then again, since there’s no disciple around…”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes scanned the oldies with a creepy smile.
They shuddered and jumped in fright.
[Why the hell would we go back to Flying Cloud manor, just to blow up?]
Would they fear Shangguan Feiyun, a Sword King, if blowing up had worked? No, it was precisely because it couldn’t even scratch him that they didn’t feel like blowing themselves up for nothing.
Now that Zhuo Fan asked them this, they were put on the spot.
Zhuo Fan was totally right, so many died to get the Soaring Sword and now only one more was needed.
But sometimes, a clan had to ignore the pragmatic solution in favor of the ethical one.
So many died in their raid of the manor for Soaring Sword, but that was in the name of the clan. Because of their deaths, the survivors cared even more about the clan. That was called being united.
While being ready to sacrifice one member to get to their goal, that was the same as throwing away all ethics, morals and the clansmen’s devotion all these years. The collapse of the clan would only be a matter of time.
Standing united was the clan’s foundation!
Zhuo Fan was no Shangguan clansman and would simply write this off, but the elders could not just destroy the clan’s morale because of a bit of danger.
They’d rather take the worst outcome, with them dying in hundreds for their goal, instead of killing off one of them for it.
This was never about gain and loss, it was about spirit. With their morale crushed, there was no team…
The elders looked at each other, but they all shook their heads.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shook.
[They’re not the fools I took them for, at least. They know when to put their foot down.]
[But I need a man for my dastardly plan. Since Shangguan clan is out, what now?]
Zhuo Fan sunk into deep thought.
“Aah!”
A cry echoed throughout the cave, like a squealing pig. It was oddly familiar to Zhuo Fan, “Who’s whining like that?”
“Humph, who else but Shangguan Yulin, the traitor!” one venerable spat in disgust.
Zhuo Fan lit up and a broad smile crept on his face, “People, is this condemned traitor still considered one of you? Could you lend him to me? Though I don’t plan on returning him.”
“Well…”
They looked at each other and then sported smirks. A venerable laughed, “Sure, please do. We were still uncertain if we should go for death penalty or torture him first for his heavy crimes. Since Mister Gu wants him, I believe using his life for the divine sword is enough to absolve him. That’d be so great, what do you guys think, ha-ha-ha?”
The others laughed along, with knowing looks.
Alas, the poor Shangguan Yulin had once again hit rock bottom, in the hands of the devilish Zhuo Fan.
[Now that’s fate, or maybe a nightmare, he-he-he…]
Zhuo Fan snickered along with the other elders, the sound bouncing off the walls and making it even creepier.
A sudden chill crawled down everyone’s spine, feeling like demons were cackling in their ears…
“Agh~!”
In a closed room, Shangguan Yulin was having the torture of his life. He was deformed in the process, hung to a stone pole and sealed of his cultivation.
An elder with black beard clamped his shoulder and sent Yuan Qi inside him without qualms, so that his bones would creak and his tendons would snap in the most gruesome way possible; hence the agonizing cries.
The elder demanded, “What else did you tell Shangguan Feiyun? Talk! Does he know about this place?”
“Sixth elder, have mercy!”
Sobbing from all the pain, Shangguan Yulin wailed, “Sir’s asked me a thousand times already. I already told you, Shangguan Feiyun only wanted to kill the experts, not to eliminate you completely. He doesn’t know of this place. He still wanted me to get back to eastern lands as a spy. He didn’t even ask about our meeting place. Please, have mercy…”
Sixth elder huffed and ramped up the pain, “So you want to go back as a spy, is it? No matter how many times I hear it, it still fills me with absolute rage, making me wish I could skin you alive!”
“Screw you! You don’t care but I am being asked the same thing over and o-, agh! Mercy, I was wrong, sixth elder! Spare me! I want to see my uncle! Uncle, save me!”
Shangguan Yulin once again howled in pain and tears.
The heavy stone door opened with a creek in his most desperate need and a familiar and most unwelcome laughter reached him, “Ha-ha-ha, easy with the cries, your uncle can’t save you now. But your master might have something that does.”
Startled, the two inside looked to see Zhuo Fan walk in with a wide smile, his ridiculing words mocking Shangguan Yulin’s wretched situation…

chapters.title: Chapter 927: Show Pony
chapters.content:
Chapter 927: Show Pony
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“G-Gu Yifan?”
Shangguan Yulin’s pulse quickened, his eyes widened, his face bore shock.
[What is going on here? What’s this traitor doing here? And, more importantly, what got him so confident to come here?]
Since every Shangguan clansman saw him as a traitor, it made not one ounce of sense for him to just waltz in here.
Questions upon questions filled Shangguan Yulin’s mind, yet there was no answer to lift the confusion, no sign to clear his doubts. Soon though, none of it even mattered, not when the hatred of revenge took over his faculties and was reduced to just crunching his teeth in rage.
It was all this guy’s fault that he, Shangguan Yulin, had his bright future as a double agent ruined.
It all went down the drain the minute Gu Yifan popped into the picture. He betrayed the Shangguan clan and was now under their strict and creative torture, while also losing his value to Shangguan Feiyun.
He was now so revolting, none saw him as a human being anymore. Everyone despised him, everyone hated him. What was worse, he now had no future, all because of this demon, Gu Yifan.
Shangguan Yulin’s fury only grew as all his failures came to mind. Looking at the insufferable smug face and that demeaning smile, he’d want for nothing more than to tear him apart piece by bloody piece.
The thing that took the last straw was that the punk faked being some bigshot demonic cultivator to toy with him and even had to knock his head on the floor for that. It was a humiliation this young master could never ever accept.
What emperor would prostrate to a filthy flea-ridden beggar?
[Anyone would be better than this freak!]
Everyone had their limits, whether aware of it or not. Shangguan Yulin’s was Zhuo Fan.
[Anyone can be better than me but not this bastard. I’m superior to you in every way!]
This was none other than Shangguan Yulin’s pride talking. It stemmed from his deep disdain of Zhuo Fan from the very start; he just couldn’t let go of it. Or maybe his obsession with Shangguan Qingyan, who ended up getting close to Zhuo Fan, that he couldn’t overcome.
In any case, while the entire event was made clear to any casual observer, he was still stuck in the past, blinded with his head stuck in the sand.
The same guy he viewed as inferior, as a mere smudge towards his glorious future ended up being an expert in deep disguise.
He would never accept it and would do anything to justify this fact to himself, to the point of being incapable of thinking basic questions as to why Zhuo Fan could just strut in here. All that came out was vitriol and bloodlust, “Sixth elder, he is the reason why we lost so many people in the Flying Cloud manor! He gave us a fake map! Sir has to grab him and avenge them all!”
Sixth elder gave Zhuo Fan an icy look.
He hardly talked with Zhuo Fan in the Gu household and knew how things transpired, thus labeling him as a double agent as well. Since he was too busy carving into Shangguan Yulin in here, he was not part of Zhuo Fan’s enlightening and inexorable speech held outside.
In short, he was oblivious of Zhuo Fan and the Shangguan clan’s deal.
He was now thinking of nothing else but catching this traitor and giving him a re-education he wouldn’t forget.
Sixth elder hated his kind the most.
He shot for Zhuo Fan, bearing his bloodthirsty palm on Zhuo Fan, to grab him. Late Genesis Stage power slammed into Zhuo Fan and pinned him on the spot.
Yet it didn’t seem to affect him, as if he chose to stay put, if that smile was anything to go by.
Shangguan Yulin snickered, relishing his mortal enemy’s plight.
No matter how sixth elder was raging and his attack seemed deadly, it was only meant to seize and not kill.
[That’s how you deal with spies. You capture them for interrogation, not kill them.]
Though that wasn’t to say the process was pain free. The grip on Zhuo Fan’s shoulder would be so tight, all the bones would snap like twigs.
[Then there’s the pain, he-he-he…]
[Followed by a world of hurt, as each day something new is done to you to relish newfound agony, he-he-he..]
Shangguan Yulin was actually looking forward to what came, snickering to himself as he pictured Zhuo Fan hanging from a rack with hooks in him.
[He-he-he, I’m the young master of Shangguan clan! A traitor will be deformed, twisted, tormented under all the pain he’s inflicted upon. To an outsider like you, that goes double. Let’s see how long you last under sixth elder’s deft hands!]
[Ha-ha-ha, I bet you’ll be far more miserable than me, but at least you’ll put me at ease, hi-hi-hi…]
Shangguan Yulin cackled in his mind, rapture clearly painted on his face, his eyes obsessed with turning those twisted thoughts into reality that he was already picturing Zhuo Fan bleeding, even as the attack had yet to land.
He perked his ears, ready to relish Zhuo Fan’s shoulder crumble like glass, the symphony soothing his disturbed mind.
[Ah, I’ve waited days for this. There’s no better joy out there…]
“Sixth, stop!”
An aged hand came out of the darkness and grabbed sixth elder’s cruel hand before it even reached its target.
Sixth elder started and found one of Shangguan clan’s three venerables next to him and the many other elders coming in.
Sixth elder shook, “W-what…”
“Mister Gu is a guest and needs to be treated with respect.”
The venerable gave him a look and pulled sixth elder to the side to whisper in his ear. Sixth elder jerked, bobbed his head and returned to Zhuo Fan with new eyes, “I ask Mister Gu’s forgiveness for my earlier ignorant transgression.”
Dong!
While the cave was awfully peaceful, the same didn’t apply to Shangguan Yulin’s mind, feeling like bombs went off constantly.
Gone from his elated state of hoping to see Zhuo Fan suffer, Shangguan Yulin’s mind was broken.
[What the hell? Why are the elders treating him like some prized pony? They weren’t like this even around uncle!]
“There’s no fault in ignorance. I may not be much, but at least I’m kind, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan never registered Shangguan Yulin’s shocked eyes, closing in with his chest held high, putting on some mighty airs while taking a look around, “My, what base chambers. There’s not even a chair around…”
“S-since Mister Gu says it must, then it has to have one.”
One elder shouted, “Guard, get Mister Gu a laurel chair! What do you mean we don’t have one? Get Clan Head’s from the meeting hall if you have to!”
“Yes, sir!”
A reply came from outside and in no time flat, a disciple brought the chair behind Zhuo Fan for him to rest his laurels. But not before the thoughtful disciple gave it a good cleaning with his sleeve, “Mister Gu, please, he-he-he…”
“Since there isn’t, there isn’t. Why bother? I’m not one to nitpick, ha-ha-ha…”
With a smug grin, Zhuo Fan faked modesty as he made himself most comfortable in the prized chair.
But this wasn’t the end of it, not by far. Zhuo Fan gave a disapproving look around, like something was missing, and coughed.
Catching his drift, one elder shouted, “Get a table and tea! Damn fools, are you blind? How could you forget about the rest when you brought the chair?”
“Yes, elder.”
Two disciples were quick to arrive, gently placing a table next to Zhuo Fan. The other carefully placed the tea for their prized guest.
Grinning from ear to ear, Zhuo Fan leaned into the chair, the Clan Head’s chair, like a boss. He then made a show of picking his cup and sipping once with one of the most exaggerated expressions of joy ever.
[This is the life.]
Shangguan Yulin, dangling from his pole, twitched, his broken heart now in pieces.
His greatest hope these past torturous days was to see Zhuo Fan go through the same agony.
[What the hell? Why is showing off?]
[What’s with the elders? Why are they serving him like their ancestor, if not better?]
[Have you no dignity, old coots?]
Shangguan Yulin howled in his mind, but Zhuo Fan’s taunting face made him gnash his teeth in fury.
[Gu Yifan, did heaven placed you on this earth just so you can torture me? Ugh…]

chapters.title: Chapter 928: Leading
chapters.content:
Chapter 928: Leading
Proofreader
: Papatonks
With the fragrant tea safely in his belly, Zhuo Fan casually held the cup with a relishing sigh as he smiled and gestured at Shangguan Yulin, “In a damp and dark hole such as this, some hot tea feels like heaven. Ain’t that so, guys? Ha-ha-ha…”
“Yeah, yeah…”
“Mister Gu knows how to enjoy life, ha-ha-ha…”
The elders went into a constant praising spree, all while sporting wide smiles. Zhuo Fan could pretty much say anything and they’d still accept it.
Shangguan Yulin’s face twitched from anguish, it cut so deep that death was starting to look oddly inviting. Then it dawned on him. Zhuo Fan was putting this overblown display after all those days spent under the knife and now actually turned out to be the worst torture of his life.
In the words of Confucius, “With socialism, fear not scarcity but inequality, not poverty but instability.”
The reverse applied just as well. In these two’s case, the pain was amplified greatly when one was having the time of his life. While if the other had suffered, then no matter the torture received, it would never strip away the joy he felt if he got to see the other suffer.
