This was divergence, this was human nature.
But to a most ambitious young man that had struggled all his life, he could never bear to watch another enjoying the dreams he yearned for. Zhuo Fan was basking in the elders’ attention and praises, wallowing in more respect than a Clan Head would receive.
What made it worse, it was none other than Zhuo Fan who was reaping the rewards, the one guy he despised with all his being. It translated into more than just bruised ego for the young lad, it was crushed, along with his heart.
[Why? We’re both spies for Shangguan Feiyun so why do you hail him and not me? I’m still a young master of Shangguan Feiyun! He’s just an outsider! Why are you treating him so?]
Shangguan Yulin’s heart was consumed with jealousy, tinting his suffering in a harsher light.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone.
[That ought to do for foreplay.]
He regarded the elders, “Seniors, please give us the room. I wish to have a private word with my disciple. Would it be possible?”
“Sure, sure, we’re here to fulfill all of Mister Gu’s requests, ha-ha-ha…”
The venerables saluted and led the men out, “Then we’ll be taking our leave. Mister Gu, if there’s anything at all, just ask.”
The heavy stone door rumbled and shut this dark cave.
Shangguan Yulin felt numb.
[How are they the great elders of Shangguan Yulin? All I see is lap dogs with no dignity! ]
The minute the door was shut, the elders’ beaming smiles turned upside down, grief taking hold.
Sixth elder taunted, “Brothers, big and small, who knew you had such nasty sides to you, Ha-ha-ha…”
“Just don’t. The punk wanted us to play along, that’s the only reason we’d gone through such indignity!” The elder who asked for a chair and table rolled his eyes, certain he’d never hear the end of this from his brothers since he hated this disgraceful crap the most.
The others’ teasing glances proved it.
One venerable waved and became serious, “That’s enough banter. This is a crucial matter. Using an already compromised spy to send a message is dangerous enough and might lead to unforeseen mistakes. Understanding this is the most important. The boy is adept in mind games, and the faster we get our pawn, Shangguan Yulin, to fall in line the better. We’ll lose everything if he unravels on his way there.”
“Gu Yifan is shrewd and daring, never leaving anything to chance. We’ve seen it for ourselves. How can he fail when he played Baili Jingwei as well? Although, he did that from the shadows and held the advantage of being overlooked. Now that he’s going against Baili Jingwei in the open, with his son on the line, he’s bound to be doubly careful. What’s so bad about using some of our integrity in exchange for the Soaring Sword?” Another venerable spoke up.
The men nodded, no longer depressed by the demeaning act they were forced to perform…
After the elders left, Zhuo Fan was left alone with Shangguan Yulin in the dark cave. He placed the cup down gently and stood, “Aren’t you curious about how they’re hanging on my every word?”
Shangguan Yulin rolled his eyes.
[Screw you! Go ahead, you bastard, keep pretending till you get sick of it!]
“You’re a prisoner here, and so am I. We’re both traitors to the clan, so you shouldn’t hate me. I’ll be honest, we’re both the same.”
Zhuo Fan sighed, his eyes taking a forlorn tint, “Out of consideration to young Sanzi, I only wanted to take Shangguan Qingyan back to the clan and then leave, but they just grabbed me after being found out. I’m just as trapped as you are at this point.”
Shangguan Yulin glared and mocked, “Trapped? From this angle you’re more like a king. All the elders are kissing your feet, almost throwing Yan’er at you and the Clan Head spot. What’s there not to like about that?”
“Clan Head? Ha-ha-ha, I’m not their kin and have priors. My track record isn’t exactly spotless. You think they’ll put someone like me at the helm?”
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, “You’re overthinking things. And besides, the only reason they show respect is so they can get the one thing they want the most.”
Shangguan Yulin gasped, “Soaring Sword!”
“Yes, that thing.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, “I have possession of the Soaring Sword and they have to play ball, all while attempting to string me to let it slip where the divine sword is at. Even honey trap is considered…”
“What?!”
“Slow your roll, they haven’t cracked me yet.”
Shangguan Yulin tensed in reflex. Of the Shangguan clansmen coming to the central area, there was just one girl included.
[The honey trap could only mean…]
Shangguan Yulin’s mind did not finish the thought as Zhuo Fan came to reassure him.
Then he snickered, “My nerves are of steel, though I don’t think they’ll last much longer. You know it too, that Yan’er…”
“Shut your mouth! You can’t call her like that!” Shangguan Yulin cursed.
Zhuo Fan waved him off, having found his leverage on the punk, and went on the offensive, “It’s not my fault. Those guys keep getting us together. They promise that I just have to give them the Soaring Sword and I’ll become their son-in-law, having all the power. You know I’m stalwart. The thought of my son in the hands of Shangguan Feiyun is what kept me from refusing for so long. I still wish to use the sword to get my son back.”
“Off you go, then. Why the hell are you rambling about Yan’er to me?”
“Don’t you think I’d have done it by now if I could? Dumbass. Would those bastards outside ever allow me to go through with it?” Zhuo Fan sneered.
The oldies were just outside, ears glued to the door and boiling mad.
[Bastards? He knows we’re here listening yet has the nerve to call us names?]
Shangguan Feixiong and Shangguan Qingyan just came over and listened in. The minute Zhuo Fan’s words about hooking them up were heard, Shangguan Qingyan went beet red, her eyes furious. Though for no particular reason, she had a bashful smile as well.
She knew it was all part of Zhuo Fan’s plan…
Shangguan Yulin’s brows shook at the mere mention of Shangguan Qingyan, “Then what do you want?”
“I’m under constant watch, but only kept here. I am confined to this cave like a prisoner.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, “That’s why I need someone to send Flying Cloud manor a message, to set up an exchange place. The minute I get a breather, I’ll rush to get my son back. As for my trail, I’m sure the people of the manor are more than happy to settle them. It’s simply borrowing strength.”
Shangguan Yulin stared hard at Zhuo Fan.
[Of course it is, using Flying Cloud manor to help yourself get away.]
This, in turn, let him see Zhuo Fan’s point and smirked, “You mean to have me go?”
“Exactly. I did say we’re the same, you and I. We can’t stay with the Shangguan clan and you need a new home, no? That makes you the only one I can trust since our goals align. Since we both want to leave, you won’t sell me out.”
Grinning, Zhuo Fan said, “Since I have the Soaring Sword, Shangguan clan sees me as precious. They won’t just let me go but they’re happy to fulfill all my wishes. I’ll ask them to free you and then you can send my message. We’ll work together so we’ll both get what we want, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 929: Take Notes
chapters.content:
Chapter 929: Take Notes
Proofreader
: Papatonks
[Win-win?]
Shangguan Yulin squinted and mocked, “Sounds too good to be true. You win, I win, everybody wins. But tell me this, why on earth should I help you?”
“You said it yourself, everybody wins. Or do you plan on spending the rest of your life in Shangguan clan’s torture chamber, spending every second of it in unadulterated agony?”
“And?”
Shangguan Yulin haughtily said, “I’d willingly stay in the ninth circle of hell so long as you’re a couple circles above. I may know only pain, but seeing you right there beside me with a wretched look will be a sobering experience, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Do you hate me that much? We don’t have anything against each other. I only fooled you a few times now. Getting you to knock your head on the floor, carved degenerate demon on your chest, made you shout master this and master that, had you grovel at my feet – but only for a couple of times – then… Was that all? I honestly can’t recall. Meh, that should be it, right?”
“You want more? Isn’t that goddamn enough?!”
His face twitched with every sore spot that Zhuo Fan thoroughly skewered, bringing his anger to an all time high, “Gu Yifan, you’re nothing but a foul rat. I come from a respected house, the Shangguan clan. Do you really think that having toyed, humiliated, and tortured me so many times does not warrant my burning hatred for you? I rather choose death before dishonor. The world isn’t big enough for the both of us. I’ll be sure to return every indignity you subjected to me a thousand times over, and I’ll start with your precious son, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan just stared as Shangguan Yulin cackled.
The elders eavesdropping shook their heads. One venerable sighed, “I never knew Shangguan Yulin knows only cruelty. Such luck we managed to see his true colors in time. He would’ve only grown to become a disease upon the clan once he takes the seat, just as wretched as Shangguan Feiyun.”
“Yeah…”
Shangguan Feixiong sighed, feeling regret. Yulin was a good seed among the disciples, only to find out he had a twisted mind…
One venerable was not so quick to agree, “Although Shangguan Yulin is vile, he has his reasons. It was that endless humiliation that brought him so low. Tell me, would any of you be able to take the high road and have a clear conscience when Gu Yifan toyed with you?”
“Hmm…”
That had them all second guessing their rash nods. “Ha-ha-ha, maybe we couldn’t. This just goes to show what a real ‘player’ this guy is.”
Shangguan Qingyan giggled and Shangguan Feixiong glared, “A man is never to be demeaned. Dignity is most important to a practitioner. Gu Yifan is even more twisted, having humiliated and played Shangguan Yulin like a fiddle, so why are you laughing?”
Shangguan Qingyan covered her mouth before any laughter slipped again.
She knew this wasn’t right, but just picturing Shangguan Yulin banging his head on the ground before Zhuo Fan’s feet was most hilarious.
Has her proper and handsome cousin ever gone through such low times?
[Mister Gu is such a bad guy…]
Her mind was saying something while her curving lips betrayed her true feelings.
Shangguan Feixiong sighed and shook his head…
“So you won’t help me?”
Zhuo Fan asked earnestly after he waited for Shangguan Yulin’s cackle to die out, though the guy didn’t know when to quit, “Help you? Maybe in another life, ha-ha-ha. Even as I’ll be cooked alive, I’d still laugh just thinking of the grief of losing your son, hi-hi-hi….”
“Such pain is definitely there.”
Zhuo Fan sighed but then smiled, “Though it’s bound to last five years, a hundred tops. With our long lives, it’s like a drop in the bucket. It’ll pass anyway. Having descendants and spending time with them will be sure to numb the pain.”
Shangguan Yulin shook, “Time with descendants?”
“Well you can’t expect me never to move on. He’s only a son. “
Zhuo Fan put on an evil smirk, “Speaking of, the chance of a house filled with children is right now knocking on my door. Your uncle and elders are begging me to take the apple of their eyes, all for a measly Soaring Sword. So you can keep your help and I just have to accept the loss of a son to move on and make some more. I’ll go to Yan’er right now, get the buns in the oven so they can’t weasel out. It’ll make giving the Soaring Sword all the more a sound decision. Your uncle can’t have his little girl turn a widow so fast either.
“As for you, my good disciple, whether stuck in hell or pushing through it, remains to be seen if you’ll see me wallow in misery over the loss of my son or bask in the laughter of my kin, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan walked to the door having finished his piece.
Shangguan Yulin was left stumped.
[How could I forget? He doesn’t actually need to get his son, not when there’s another choice with an endless future waiting. His son might die, but he’ll have a pretty wife and be surrounded by kids.]
[And I, nothing more than a patsy, fated to die either way. Seeing him smile from hell will only pour acid on my wounds.]
[How can I have such rotten luck? Any choice will get me killed while his choices all promise a nice and cozy future.]
[And by not saving his poor son, he’d become Shangguan clan’s son-in-law, rising higher.]
It was something this young master with an ‘if you’re there to suffer along’ mentality could not accept.
So Shangguan Yulin cried out, “Wait, back up. I-I agree. How can I not? All I’m asking is that you keep your distance from Yan’er.”
Zhuo Fan paused and looked back with a devious smile.
[Finally fell for it, bastard…]
“Amazing!”
A venerable praised, “The kid’s mind games are ridiculously good, toying with Yulin’s feelings and thoughts. He has the other’s state of mind under control, ergo his desires. What do you guys think now of the previous indignity? It was because of that little show we put on that Shangguan Yulin believes we value the Soaring Sword so much that we would listen to Gu Yifan. Especially about using Yan’er as leverage. That hit him right where it hurt.”
They all bobbed their heads like wise men, with another venerable turning to Shangguan Feixiong, “Feixiong, take notes, this is the kind of mentality you should have as a Clan Head, as the leader of eastern lands!”
“Me… learn from him?”
Shangguan Feixiong went red in the face, “Gu Yifan is just a… a junior…”
“And? The way I see it, you’re the youth in his twenties here, with how naive you are. While he’s the real monster living through ages with his cunningness.”
Smiling, the venerable said, “Don’t you see? Even old guys like us are learning from him.”
The venerable pointed and Shangguan Feixiong was shocked to see his oldies taking out jade slips and recording.
Shangguan Feixiong’s face twitched, “That…”
“Is called taking notes!”
Shangguan Feixiong was this close to spewing blood from the shock. These millenia old geezers were as shameless as rash teenagers.
[Where’s your self-respect?]
Shangguan Qingyan was the only one angry, stomping away through them, “Don’t just write everything! It’s nothing but empty words! Stop at once?”
Everyone gave her odd looks.
[What’s up, Yan’er?]
Shangguan Feixiong sighed and shook his head, “Yan’er, are you angry at him for his untrue words and sulling your name? Or is it at him for not following through with it? Ha-ha-ha…”
Ignorant of all the ruckus outside, Zhuo Fan flicked his hand and the chains were off Shangguan Yulin. Then he threw him on the ground.
“Hey, what’s that for? I agreed didn’t I…”
“Quiet!”
Zhuo Fan shouted for him to stop talking, “You did agree, but there’s nothing trustworthy about you. I’ll have to leave my mark on you again in case you get any ideas along the way. Just you try…”
Zhuo Fan chopped at his neck and the guy was out like a light.
He placed a hand on his back and his right eye flashed with the black thunderflame, surging as it followed the hand and into Shangguan Yulin…

chapters.title: Chapter 930: Bloodworms
chapters.content:
Chapter 930: Bloodworms
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“So let me get this straight. Gu Yifan wants to make a deal with me, the Soaring Sword for his son. But since Shangguan clan has him confined, he sent you as messenger?”
Three days later, at the Flying Cloud manor, in the dazzling hall to be precise, Baili Jingwei was in the main chair, sipping his tea and muttering. His eyes shone while staring forward, Shangguan Feiyun and Danqing Shen at his sides.
A shivering, distraught and familiar guy, also covered with wounds, was fighting to keep his composure as he just stood there.
He kept on shivering and looking worried as he bobbed his head, “He really asked me to pass this message. Here’s a jade slip he personally made if you don’t believe me. It also holds his soul signature.”
Shangguan Yulin presented it with shaky hands and Baili Jingwei casually took it. He nodded to Shangguan Feiyun, “It’s Gu Yifan’s alright. He wants us to meet up a hundred miles from here on Flourishing Mountain.”
“Tch, what an utter waste of time. Back when he was here, he said he wanted to give the divine sword for his kid but then he just ran off. Now he makes the request himself? Humph, I can’t tell if he’s brilliant or boneheaded.”
Shangguan Feiyun read the jade slip as well and just threw it to Danqing Shen.
It looked as if Zhuo Fan was giving up with this message, but only Baili Jingwei could read between the lines, “You can’t say that, not when Gu Yifan is so sharp. A man of character doesn’t take risks. With how we had them surrounded before, if the exchange took place, he’d never be at ease. He wouldn’t accept it even if I came to another place. But then he comes back with this proposal which means he made himself an exit again; quite sensible. Now he must be thinking how to taunt both sides into fighting so he could slip away.”
“Humph, as if that’ll work. Hasn’t he had enough toying with me and now he comes back for more?” Shangguan Feiyun mocked, his eyes spewing flames of rage. The humiliation of being made to play catch was still fresh in his mind.
Baili Jingwei had an explanation for that too, his eyes shining, “Sword King Feiyun, don’t let emotions cloud your judgment. We’re after the Shangguan clan in the end. Now we just have to get the Soaring Sword and there’s no harm if he uses us once more. Not since it’ll work in our favor, ha-ha-ha…
“Only…”
Baili Jingwei’s collected smile showed his decision was made, but then his sharp eyes landed on Shangguan Yulin below, making him reel under the intense gaze. “There’s something I can’t figure out, young master Shangguan. Sure, asking for the Shangguan clan to release you sounds fair, but there’s only bad blood between you two. Not even desperate times warrant him trustworthy. Does he actually trust you so much to send his message? This involves his son, after all..”
Shangguan Yulin grimaced, bowing before them with a distraught face, “Prime Minister is correct, the guy never trusted me. That’s why he left something in my body. Look!”
Shangguan Yulin showed his arm.
The trio’s eyes twitched at once, their heartbeat spiking. Shangguan Yulin’s arm had something foul and vile wiggling under his skin, like hundreds of worms fighting to come out.
Shangguan Feiyun yanked his wrist and checked with his Yuan Qi, but the discovery had him gasping.
“Damn, you’re a nest for worms now?”
Shangguan Feiyun’s face shook hard, pointing at him, “This guy has thousands of bloody worms borrowed inside him that just won’t die. Not even my Yuan Qi had any effect on them. This is freaky!”
The other two regarded him gravely.
Once the disgusting arm was back under wraps, Shangguan Yulin’s pale face looked astonished. “Prime Minister, now you see why he let me come? He knocked me out throughout the process, only for me to wake up and realize my body was swarming with these putrid maggots. He told me they’re Bloodworms, like Marrow Burrowing Maggots. Only he or my body’s destruction will release me of these things.”
“But giving up my body will mean a decrease in cultivation and halt in progress. He only had me deliver a message, something I found wholly beneath the worth of ruining my future. Now if you agree, I still have to get back with the answer. He only gave me ten days before the worms act up and feast on my blood essence. That’ll ruin my body!”
Baili Jingwei nodded at Shangguan Yulin’s whining like an old biddy, his doubts removed and now believing in the letter.
“Who’d have thought an alchemist like Gu Yifan would be capable of such nasty business.” Shangguan Feiyun huffed.
Baili Jingwei nodded, “All men of renown have walked over thousands of corpses to get where they are since time immemorial. A true man knows when to act and be decisive. It’d be so much easier to handle Gu Yifan if he were kinder. At least we didn’t need to be so wary of him.”
“Young master Yulin, there’s just something that evades my understanding. I hope you can clear it up for me.”
Baili Jingwei began, “Since Shangguan clan let you go, they must’ve gotten ready for it. I’m sorry to say but they switched places the moment you left, since no one trusts you and all. So then, how are you going to get back to Gu Yifan?”
Shangguan Yulin bowed, “Prime Minister, I cannot find him, but we have a meeting spot where he can find me. He just has to pick up the reply I’ll leave him there and he’ll release control of the Bloodworms. As for removing them, that will have to wait for after the exchange takes place.”
“That’s quite cautious of him, unafraid you might botch it and even giving you a sliver of hope so you’d follow through. A truly pragmatic man who knows when to act in his benefit. His methods are terribly effective.
Baili Jingwei turned to his left and right, “Sword Kings, do you have any questions?”
Shangguan Feiyun and Danqing Shen shook their heads, speaking at once, “Prime Minister’s decision is enough. We have nothing to add.”
“Great, that settles it then. Regardless of the Soaring Sword’s location and whether Gu Yifan’s intentions are real in this exchange, I still want to try, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Jingwei’s eyes shone as he laughed. He took out a jade slip and put something in it before giving it to Shangguan Yulin. “Young master, here’s my reply. Take it to Gu Yifan. I accept his offer and we’ll meet in half a month!”
Shangguan Yulin gave a deep bow as he took it, though he looked hesitant standing in the same spot.
Baili Jingwei asked, “Aren’t you on the clock? What’s holding you back from finishing your mission?”
“Prime Minister, well, Gu Yifan has another matter for sending me. Its conclusion will decide whether Prime Minister’s reply feels honest to him or not, if he would come or not.”
“And what’s that?” Baili Jingwei followed.
Shangguan Yulin began, “Prime Minister, I would like to see if his son is safe.”
“Absurd! A felon like him will get his son only when he gives the Soaring Sword! Why on earth will I reveal his location to that bastard beforehand? You take me for a three-year-old, using slick words to get me to spill his location so you could bust him out?”
Shangguan Feiyun snapped in rage.
Shangguan Yulin sighed, “Uncle Feiyun, please don’t be angry with me. I don’t want to see the brat either. But that’s what Gu Yifan said. If his son is dead, then the Soaring Sword exchange will go to the dogs.”
“Goddamn it! Who are you calling a dog?”
“No, no no, uncle, that’s not me, but Gu Yifan’s words.”
Shangguan Feiyun exploded in rage and power, making Shangguan Yulin shudder and turn frantic in explaining himself.
[Curse you, Gu Yifan! You have me go send a message and even mock the other. Now my head is on the line while you’re just laid back home.]
[The only reason I’m doing this job for you is because of those damn Bloodworms!]
All he could do now was brace, “Uncle, please calm down. It’s quite normal for a father to miss his son after such a long time and be concerned about him, ha-ha-ha.”
Shangguan Feiyun sighed and nodded.
Baili Jingwei’s eyes shone, never leaving Shangguan Yulin out of sight as his lips curled dangerously…

chapters.title: Chapter 931: Hanging by a Thread
chapters.content:
Chapter 931: Hanging by a Thread
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Then you can go and tell him his son is safe and sound, treated like a prince. He can make the exchange without worry. As for seeing him, ha-ha-ha, I find it unnecessary.”
Baili Jingwei showed a crafty smile as he sipped tea.
Shangguan Feiyun mocked, “Yep, so go ahead and tell him that. It’s not like he has some divine eye that can tell him if you have seen the kid or not.”
“I wish it were that simple.”
Shangguan Yulin sighed in distress, “You know as well the punk is lively as a monkey. He won’t be fooled with just that. He told me he and his son had a signal. I need to see the child in person and relay this signal. When I reply, he’ll only believe if I come with the matching signal, or he’d believe his son is dead and the deal is off. He’ll just give the sword to Shangguan Yulin and throw his lot with them…”
Shangguan Feiyun cried out, “There’s something like that? You just have to see the brat?”
“It seems like it…” Shangguan Yulin had no intention of seeing Gu Santong if he could help it, which he couldn’t.
He was always scared here, in the Flying Cloud manor and the faster he left, the better. There was no way he could feel safe, not when Shangguan Feiyun was right there flexing his power.
Shangguan Feiyun frowned and turned to Baili Jingwei, but the man was deep in thought.
Shangguan Yulin’s heart sank, having a really bad feeling. “Y-you didn’t actually kill him, did you? Don’t you want the Soaring Sword? If Gu Yifan doesn’t get confirmation, then there’s no deal. You won’t get the sword and my body will be ruined. H-how could you just kill him? You could at least wait to get the divine sword. Prime Minister, you’re a man of wisdom so how…”
“Silence!”
Shangguan Feiyun glared, “Enough of your chattering! He’s not dead.”
[Oh, so he’s alive.]
[Then why are you so sensitive to the topic? Just let me see the brat and don’t make it harder on me. I almost had a heart attack thinking I’d see a corpse…]
SIghing, Shangguan Yulin unclenched, regarding them with renewed hope and waiting for an answer.
Baili Jingwei glanced over and nodded, “Fine, I’ll take you to the boy. Though it’s up to luck if you can squeeze even a word out of him.”
“W-what does that mean? What did you do? Did you beat him to an inch of his life and now he can’t even speak?” Shangguan Yulin cried out.
Seeing their eyes had him trembling in fear.
[These savages won’t spare even a child, how brutal!]
Not like Shangguan Yulin was any better. At the very least he would not start tormenting women and children.
He was the young master of a renowned clan and had to act like it, knowing how far to take his cruelty.
[But these men…]
Shangguan Feiyun snapped at him, “What’s with that look? Are you thinking we did this to him? You call a monster like that a child?”
“That’s…”
“This way, young master Shangguan.”
Baili Jingwei interrupted, standing up and leading the way with the Sword Kings by his side. Shangguan Yulin scratched his head as he went along.
The four passed through many places before arriving at a rock garden. Shangguan Feiyun made a sign and the space warped to reveal a dark hole.
The four went down the dark abyss then lights came to life. As they descended, two rows of Soul Harmony and Genesis Stage guards welcomed them, standing there like statues, fifty in total.
Their auras had Shangguan Yulin scared silly.
[Flying Cloud manor’s secret jail is under such a tight guard.]
Yet all this secret place had locked up was none other than a child. This went to show just how wary Baili Jingwei and the Sword Kings were of him or maybe Gu Yifan.
The four reached the end, but it was beyond the gloomy and damp hell Shangguan Yulin pictured. Instead he saw silk and lights, a carved table and a granite chair; quite fancy. The bed in particular caught eyes with its carved and intricate jade supports buffed to a shine.
[You call this a jail cell? More like a king’s chambers!]
Shangguan Feiyun patted his shoulder and pointed at the pale and resting child on the bed, “Here’s the brat you wanted to see. Does it look like I touched him?”
[He’s Gu Yifan’s son?]”
Shangguan Yulin cheered.
[He’s still alive!]
“Young Sanzi!”
In the Flying Cloud City, in a dark corner bordering the manor, a sitting shadow made signs as it cried out.
He slipped into Flying Cloud City, right behind Shangguan Yulin, and lay in ambush.
Out of anyone’s perception, the swarming maggots in Shangguan Yulin’s belly withdrew to reveal a scarlet image of an infant.
The idea behind dumping so many Bloodworms into Shangguan Yulin was not to threaten him into submission. He had other ways to do that. The Bloodworms worked to those below the Ethereal Stage since it tortured one’s body. But it hardly posed a threat to a cultivator’s soul.
The other would just have to take the consequence of ruining his body and you had no way of using him after.
Zhuo Fan stuffed him with Bloodworms to hide the Blood Infant’s scent.
Zhuo Fan had him knocked unconscious to blind him of the process and just what else was hidden in there. Blood Infant was one, Bloodworms were another, while also sealing the guy’s senses. So when Shangguan Feiyun came to check, he’d only see the Bloodworms, unaware of the Blood Infant lurking beneath.
It was the perfect way to get Shangguan Yulin to help him find young Sanzi.
All of it was set up to find young Sanzi as soon as possible. Any rescue attempt could only start when the target’s location was confirmed.
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, seeing through Blood Infant’s eyes the frail child behind the silk covers. His fists clenched, his heart shuddered in pain.
But calm soon returned.
It was not the time for action, but patience…
Shangguan Yulin approached Gu Santong’s side and checked his vitals. He turned to Shangguan Feiyun in shock, “How is he?”
“He’s weakened by severe blood loss.” Shangguan Feiyun rolled his eyes.
Shangguan Yulin checked again and noticed Gu Santong’s damaged arm. Even with the bandages to staunch the bleeding, blood was seeping still, following the arm and dripping into a bowl.
Startled, Shangguan Yulin asked, “Are you letting out blood? Why?”
“Bullshit!”
Shangguan Feiyun cursed, “I’m no saint, but never this vile as to bleed out a child. I never once tortured him and even used my personal training room to heal him. And you’re asking if I bled him?”
“This is your personal room?”
“What else, a prison?”
Shangguan Yulin huffed and glared at him, turning to Gu Santong, “The kid is weird. I planned on using him to threaten that Gu guy after my blade hurt him, so I had my alchemists heal him. But the odd thing is that no medicine can halt the bleeding. That’s why I was hesitating about letting you see him. While not dead, he’s not long for this world. It’s unclear if he can get us the sword as he is.”
Shangguan Yulin’s brow shook.
[So that’s what all that stalling was about. The brat is hanging by a thread. He might not even live past a fortnight to see the exchange.]
[Gu Yifan will never go with the damn thing if he knew and will throw his lot with Shangguan clan, raising a family, but without his son…]
Zhuo Fan was overwhelmed at the truth about his condition, worried and flustered.
[Young Sanzi can’t heal? W-why…]

chapters.title: Chapter 932: Weird Signal
chapters.content:
Chapter 932: Weird Signal
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Checking Gu Santong’s pulse, Baili Jingwei turned to the others with a shake of his head, “No change. His wound didn’t mend at all and his blood kept flowing. He’ll soon die like this. Sword King Feiyun, you really went all out back then.”
“How’s it my fault?”
Shangguan Feiyun sighed, “I’ve just been wounded myself and the rage made it hard to control my power. But I didn’t try to kill him either, trying to heal him afterward. How was I to know he’s weird? Any other guy would be on their feet right about now. But look at him, he’s only getting worse!”
Shangguan Feiyun was perplexed at this outcome. Baili Jingwei shook his head and smiled, “Ha-ha-ha, nevermind. What’s done is done. The issue now is Gu Yifan wanting his son’s response for the deal. How is he going to reply like this? Maybe, young master Shangguan, will you give it a try? Maybe a father’s love is so great that it may rouse the son.”
Baili Jingwei chuckled.
“I guess I’ll give it a go…”
Shangguan Yulin had no hesitation, not when this involved his future. He had to get an answer out of the brat one way or another.
The other option would be Gu Yifan thinking his son was gone and the deal was off, and so was his body. His cultivation would drop and the worst part was the punk was going to become Shangguan clan’s son-in-law.
[Yan’er, my dear Yan’er, I’ll never let that bastard lay a hand on you!]
Howling inside to psych himself up, Shangguan Yulin went to Gu Santong and showed a more hideous grimace than when crying as he cooed, “Young Sanzi, wake up, your father sent me. Come on, wake up…”
Young Sanzi was as still as a corpse, blood dripping down his arm.
Shangguan Yulin was panicking, sweat trickling down forehead. Zhuo Fan’s brow shook.
He was in the dark about young Sanzi’s critical condition and had to wait until he saved the child before addressing it. But from how things looked, his life was on the line.
Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth and his fists tensed, only to slump back in helplessness…
“Goddamn brat, be a good sport and wake the hell up. Tell me the signal you share with your old man before I get serious!”
Since the soft approach was a bust, Shangguan Yulin flung his finger in Gu Santong’s face and cussed, “I don’t give a rat’s ass about your rotten dad or you dying, but my life’s on the line here! If you and your old man are going to risk my life then, brat, see how I’ll squeeze the last drops of your miserable life!”
Awkward~
Young Sanzi lay there as if he had left this world, calmly resting without a twitch.
Shangguan Yulin winced and dismay struck his heart.
Here he was thinking the biggest problem was Baili Jingwei and the other two making it harder on him, only to find out that it was this snot-nosed antique of a brat that wouldn’t play ball.
[If this brat doesn’t wake up, everyone here will lose!]
The great young master Shangguan Yulin in particular. What did he do to suffer so? Each time the factions clashed it was always Flying Cloud manor and Gu Yifan, not Shangguan clan and the manor.
Well, he wasn’t completely unrelated since last time he was with the Shangguan clan. But he was totally tangential with Gu Yifan.
[Why does this punk and Baili Jingwei’s deal have to drag me down as well?]
Their ruined deal had nothing to do with him.
[I sure didn’t botch it. It’s this Gu brat who won’t wake up!]
And the one at fault for that was Shangguan Feiyun for being so cruel. None of this was his fault, he was innocent!
[Why then does your ruined deal end with me losing the most?]
[Why am I the one to always take the fall?]
Shangguan Yulin’s heart was filled with complaints after complaints, having a worse fate than anyone in the world. While others might die out of the blue, he was worked to the bone by both sides and what did he get, suffering and death!
[And for what?]
[Heavens above, why the cold shoulder, why the cruel fate?]
Shangguan Yulin’s heart was bleeding, finding the world’s misfortune dumped on his wee shoulders.
Baili Jingwei mocked him, “Young master Yulin, I thought Gu Yifan sent you to give a message to his son. Do so and maybe the strong bond between a father and his son will bring about the signal. Maybe even wake him up? Give it a go, ha-ha-ha…”
Shaking all over, Shangguan Yulin turned solemn and nodded with hope.
[Fine, anything’s better than dying.]
He lay next to young Sanzi on the bed, whispering sweet nothings, “Young Sanzi, your dad asked me to tell you about your agreement. Do you remember? ‘Whenever you’re in danger, I’ll always come save you. A gentleman can’t forget his promise!'”
“Is that what a father tells his son? Why does it feel like a talk of equals?” Shangguan Feiyun was puzzled.
Baili Jingwei was the same, but his mind was working on a solution.
Then a faint whisper resounded, “A gentleman never forgets his promise! Ha-ha-ha…”
Startled, the men looked to find the weak Gu Santong open his eyes and let out a faint laughter.
“I’ll be, he actually woke up! What’s up with that signal anyway?” Shangguan Feiyun shouted in astonishment.
Baili Jingwei chuckled and shook his head, “These two are a pair of oddballs. I heard that some fathers and sons see each other as equals, ignoring outdated traditions. This must be the case as well. A gentleman’s promise, ha-ha-ha…”
The others nodded, but Shangguan Yulin was not one to give a flying hoot about how much of a weirdo the Gu members were. He only wanted the deal to take place so he could keep his own skin, quite literally.
Shangguan Yulin perked up, “Brat, it’s damn time you wake up! Hurry up and tell me your answer to the signal. I’ll be off telling him the minute you do.”
“Degenerate demon, why the hell would I tell it to you?”
Gu Santong’s angelic face took on a savage smile. Pale as he was, he nevertheless succeeded in getting across the dripping disdain and scorn he had for Shangguan Yulin, cutting the man deep.
[For god’s sake, even the Gu brat is mocking me! How is that normal?]
Crunching his teeth, Shangguan Yulin clenched and spat, “Screw you, brat! Hurry up and give me the signal like a good kid so your dad can give the sword for your petty life. I win, you win, everybody wins. Cross me and I’ll be sure to make both your lives a living hell!”
“Degenerate demon, why the hell would I tell it to you?” Gu Santong rolled his eyes.
Sss~
Shangguan Yulin was fuming now, “Brat, didn’t I just say this is for your own sake? Staying here any longer will only get you killed. Your dad just has to give the sword and only then you’ll survive. Talk, what’s the signal?”
“Degenerate demon, why the hell would I tell it to you?”
“Screw you! Why can’t a rotten kid fricking understand reason?!”
Shangguan Yulin was on the verge of having a meltdown as he held his head, his knees softened and kneeled at Gu Santong’s side, pleading, “Child, I’m here to help your father get you back. I’ve said my signal so can’t you do the same? We’re on the same side. Give me your reply and everyone will be happy.”
Gu Santong gave him a long look, then sported a wicked smile, “Degenerate demon, why the hell would I tell it to you?”
Shangguan Yulin’s face twitched hard, his body shook, and his mouth bled. Turned out that Gu Santong’s repeated onslaught had popped a vein in him.
“Uhm, young master Yulin, pardon the interruption.”
Baili Jingwei intervened, “Is it possible that the reply is ‘Degenerate demon, why the hell would I tell it to you?'”
Shangguan Yulin’s eyes blanked out, dumbstruck. Then he turned to Gu Santong’s cute and mocking smile.
The wounded brat couldn’t be more obvious in his scorn, “I already told you the signal, but who was the deaf one here?”
Shangguan Yulin’s face twitched, his heart cracking like glass, tears seeping from the seams.
[These two are toying with me, they’re getting their kicks until I die…]

chapters.title: Chapter 933: Boom
chapters.content:
Chapter 933: Boom
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Gu Yifan and his son sure know how to have fun. It’s such a weird signal that it makes no damn sense!” Shangguan Feiyun shook his head at the twitching, crushed and seething Shangguan Yulin.
Baili Jingwei was just as clueless, so he just shook away the thoughts, “It’s how oddities are, or maybe it’s just a way to obfuscate others from randomly guessing the signal. There’s no point reading into it.”
“At least we now know his response and can make the deal. Young master Shangguan, you should be going. Weren’t you on the clock?”
Baili Jingwei smiled at the depressed Shangguan Yulin with the intention of kicking him out.
Shangguan Yulin got his meaning of sealing the deal fast so he stood up and bowed to them, “Then I shall go to Gu Yifan with the reply. I shall be the first to congratulate Prime Minister getting the Soaring Sword from the punk.”
“Why thank you, young master!”
Baili Jingwei smiled, as did the other two. While this guy had lost all his value, he was still smooth. Such flattery was neither forced nor overblown, said just right to make others feel good.
[Maybe he’s still of some use after all, ha-ha-ha…]
With that done, they all went out of the cave, giving no attention to the weakened Gu Santong on the bed.
Gu Santong eyed them and smiled. He let out a breath and closed his eyes, though muttering, “Dad’s coming to save me, ha-ha-ha. But did he get what I meant?”
Thump~
Baili Jingwei and the two Sword Kings led Shangguan Yulin outside, being nice and friendly with him, like he was a real guest of honor. He was cautious as he walked, the rows of powerful guards giving him a bad feeling every time their aura flared.
Staying just one extra second in this accursed place felt as if his life would be over. The peculiar thing was, the closer he was to the exit, the more pronounced it was.
Hum~
Shangguan Yulin shivered out of nowhere and halted.
They had only reached halfpoint of the tunnel and still had a way to go.
Shangguan Feiyun paused, giving him an odd look, “What is it? Why did you stop?”
Shangguan Yulin just stood there, frozen in panic with horror in his eyes. He did all he could to move his jaw, but it felt he had lost control.
Shangguan Feiyun scanned him since he was acting even weirder.
[What’s he playing at?]
Shangguan Yulin gave them some hopeful looks, trying to convey something, impossible in a gloomy place such as this, and the others walked over.
Just as Shangguan Yulin was feeling terror, a hundred miles away, in a dark corner outside the manor, someone was using those same eyes as he waited for the target to approach.
Squinting, Zhuo Fan was like a patient hunter on the prowl. He made a sign to nail Shangguan Yulin on the spot, while using the Blood Infant’s eyes to see Shangguan Yulin taking slow steps towards him. The closer it got, the colder his gaze was.
Boom!
The instant Shangguan Feiyun reached Shangguan Yulin, Zhuo Fan’s hands shifted.
Hu~
Shangguan Feiyun’s senses flared with grave danger coming from within Shangguan Yulin, something he hadn’t felt in ages.
Though sensing did not equal reacting. Shangguan Yulin’s sudden explosion as a Soul Harmony expert swept everything in its path, most of it focused on Shangguan Feiyun in front.
Though a peak Genesis Stage expert was far from defenseless. As one of the very best in this world, it would bring about endless disgrace from being even hurt by a Soul Harmony Stage self-destruction.
On the instant the explosion was triggered, Shangguan Feiyun’s strong Yuan Qi was unleashed to shield him from the blast and leave him untouched.
It did not go as well for the guards though. Sure, they copied him to resist the blast, but the worst off among them were the Soul Harmony Stage guards.
In a narrow place like this, with no place to hide, they could only rely on their Yuan Qi. Survival and death came to one simple fact, whether they were just a bit stronger than the suicide bomber or weaker. Some would come out with heavy injuries while some never got up again.
In but a blink, of the fifty guards in the tunnel, a dozen fell victims, and that was ignoring the many others who were now too weak to fight.
It went to show just how devastating a blowout of a Soul Harmony Stage cultivator could be. It had to be, or no one would be doing it.
But this was just the start. As everyone rejoiced the worst had passed, black thunderflames shot from the center of the blast. It was Zhuo Fan’s third trump card he stashed in Shangguan Yulin, the apocalyptic thunderflame.
Not even the likes of Sword King Feiyun saw this one coming. It was common knowledge that a self-detonation used one’s Yuan Qi, something a Genesis Stage expert had to spare just based on the difference in stages.
But when the black thunderflame was included, one with the power of total destruction, it was fundamentally a universal killer, all ending up suffering the same miserable fate until its power ran out.
Like a claw from hell, the black thunderflame shot like lightning in all directions. Anything it touched, be it flesh or hard bedrock, all burned, wiped out of existence.
The Genesis Stage guards hardly registered when the black thunderflame touched their Yuan Qi shields, and only heard as it sizzled and was eaten away. The flames then crept on them, swallowing each one as it devoured.
It was so deadly, there was no cry released as their souls got submerged in this terrifying black thunderflame.
And so, the rest of the guards, thirty plus in number, all met their end in some unknown tunnel.
Even the two Sword Kings were panicking around such deadly force. The worst off was Shangguan Feiyun, who was closest, now surrounded by this dark burning killer.
His only saving grace was the strong Yuan Qi that kept the flames at bay, away from his body.
Though this was not meant to last. He felt as his Yuan Qi was sapped every moment around this thunderflame. He had to leave at once.
Sss~
The crackling of the flames reached their ears, adding to the fear this black fire incited even in the likes of a Sword King.
Shangguan Feiyun was not alone in this peril, with Baili Jingwei and Dancing Shen being in danger as well.
Baili Jingwei was only in the Ethereal Stage and could not muster a token of resistance against the hell’s beckoning. It was all thanks to Danqing Shen for surviving as he used his Yuan Qi to protect them both. Judging by the tense brow and shocked eyes, it was not easy at all, he was also fearful of this strange black fire.
[That boy’s eerie flame has grown to such an extent already. The more I feel it the more terrible it becomes.]
Danqing Shen’s heart tensed as he watched the ravenous black flames. It felt like just yesterday Zhuo Fan used just a finger-sized dark flame in the Double Dragon Gathering to harm Ye Lin despite him being under Exalted Hei Ran’s protection. This earned his title as best disciple in western lands.
That tiny flame now became a sea of fire, swallowing anything in its path.
[The boy has become terrifying in just a few years…]
Danqing Shen took a deep breath and sighed…

chapters.title: Chapter 934: Lure
chapters.content:
Chapter 934: Lure
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Brother Dan, we can’t stop this strange black flame even as it eats it away. It won’t do us any good if we just stay here in this tight place!”
Looking from the everexpanding black sea, Shangguan Feiyun turned a nervous glance to Danqing Shen.
The man shouted, “Alright!”
He pointed two fingers at the sky and a Soaring Sword of energy shot out in a loud boom, letting the sun cast light in this dark place, while also shedding some light on the demonic black thunderflame.
Whoosh!
Looking at the clear sky with a stray cloud here and there, Danqing Shen hoised Baili Jingwei on his shoulder and flew away from the black flame. As the flames latched on his Yuan Qi shield and crept all over it, Danqing Shen shook once and sent his shield away from himself, letting the flames chip away at it from a safe distance, disappearing once their meal was finished.
Whoosh~
Shangguan Feiyun and a few strong Genesis Stage guards arrived, shedding the terrifying flames in the same manner Danqing Shen did. They were at last out of danger and could breathe easier.
These mighty and respected Genesis Stage experts had just escaped a brush with death, something that hardly happened to them.
The more they watched the thunderflame swallow the manor, the deeper their fear ran.
[What the hell is this this? Why is it so horrible?]
Of the fifty or so guards in the tunnel, only five escaped. It was testament to the warranted fear they had for the black thunderflame, and of its destruction. The flames kept spreading, eating and destroying all of the manor, and they were powerless to stop it.
Shangguan Feiyun stood there stunned, his face grave from the dangerous experience. It was a first for him, to see his men die out without even making a sound.
It echoed in him the same amount of powerlessness he saw in them.
There was a limit to what a man could do, a saying he would not soon forget…
“Prime Minister, brother Dan, what is this thing? Do any of you know?”
Shangguan Feiyun flew over to them and spoke with no little shock in his voice, “It’s just a flame but Yuan Qi can’t stop it nor break it. Only by letting it consume everything will it make it stop. The only reason we’re still here talking is because we had the Yuan Qi to keep it at bay. Any stronger and even this Sword King would’ve fallen! This is absurd!”
Baili Jingwei and Danqing Shen nodded gravely.
Danqing Shen kept the knowledge about it and Zhuo Fan to himself. While Baili Jingwei grimaced, “It’s not a question of what, but how strong. With this black flame, nothing in the world can stop it. We’ve only survived it because it’s power has a limit. Yet even so, it still managed to threaten the likes of a Sword King. Sword Kings, think for a second. We’ve been hard pressed to use Yuan Qi and keep the flames away, but if just one mote touched us…”
“We’d be dead!”
Shangguan Feiyun shook and Danqing Shen’s voice cracked in shock, “The black flame needs but a touch and nothing will remain of us.”
Baili Jingwei sighed, “Such a deadly power is hard for even a Sword King to escape. Then what about Patriarch? This is our first time seeing such a thing. But what if there’ll be more of it? Then…”
Baili Jingwei trailed off but Shangguan Feiyun understood his worry loud and clear.
[There just has to be more of this thing and it could drive fear even into Invincible Sword.]
[The question is, where did this outrageous thing come from?]
Shangguan Feiyun frowned, while Baili Jingwei was lost in worries.
“In any case, Shangguan Yulin’s detonation has something to do with the Shangguan clan!” Baili Jingwei spoke coldly.
Shangguan Feiyun cursed, “Those bastards must be behind it! I don’t know where they got this dangerous thing, but they stuffed it in the brat and got him to explode. It was clearly aimed at us. I was right to be wary of the detonation even if its blast was meager. Any carelessness from my part and the flame would’ve eaten me alive! Damn you, Shangguan Feixiong and your cruelty!”
“Shangguan Feixiong?”
Shangguan Feiyun had instantly dumped all the blame behind this devious and savage attack on his brother. But Baili Jingwei frowned, “Would such a kind and upright Clan Head resort to something so vile? Let’s not forget that the mind behind everything is still Gu-“
Boom~
A sudden distant explosion cut off his words.
The trio jerked and looked over in its direction. From the manor’s east side, a surge of power came, followed by a most familiar sword energy, Shangguan clan’s Soaring Sword Art.
Shangguan Feiyun gnashed his teeth, “Prime Minister Baili, see that? They just took an attempt on our lives. They had Shangguan Yulin blow up in our faces while the main force was charging in. They want to take my head in case I escaped alive. Humph, there’s no way they’ll get rid of me that easily!”
Shangguan Feiyun shot towards the scene. The rest looked at the spreading sea of black and went after him. It was better to fight with the Sword King than stay here, powerless.
“Sword King Feiyun, wait…”
Baili Jingwei cried but Shangguan Feiyun’s anger deafened him to anything but his target.
Baili Jingwei squinted and looked back at the flames. He sighed and gave Danqing Shen a look, flying together after Shangguan Feiyun.
All the excitement and suddenness had made them blind to the on and off red infant going deeper into the flames and using them for cover.
It went through the tunnel filled with flames and arrived to where the weakened Gu Santong rested.
“Young Sanzi!”
Gu Santong shook at the familiar voice and smiled, “Dad, you’re here!”
“Of course I am. I’ve come to get you out.”
The Blood Infant turned into a pitch-black sword floating under Gu Santong. It then took the child and disappeared without a trace…
Shangguan Feixiong had come with his three venerables and the Genesis Stage experts to cause a scene in an area of the manor. They burned and killed without stopping as no guard could match the power of the three venerables, not when they could hold back a Sword King.
What was more, there were few guards around, far weaker than the carefully picked Shangguan experts.
Boom~
A string of sword energies were unleashed wreaking havoc to anything that moved.
As lavish buildings fell around him, Shangguan Feiyun hovered in the air and heard hundreds of people coming over, “Damn it, the guards are mobilizing here! Did the brat do it? I don’t know if Shangguan Feiyun and the rest are with them. It will make getting out with just ten men hard. It may even require to leave some behind…”
“Shangguan Feixiong, you rotten relic, you sent me a suicide bomber and almost cost me my life. I’ll make sure you’ll never walking out of here alive!”
Shangguan Feiyun roared as he stormed over.
Shangguan Feixiong saw Shangguan Feiyun coming at him like a storm, with Danqing Shen and Baili Jingwei not far behind. He ordered, “Everyone fall back! They took the bait!”
The rest of the Shangguan clansmen enjoying senseless violence shot off at once, leaving this place a broken pile of junk and destruction…

chapters.title: Chapter 935: Joint Tactics
chapters.content:
Chapter 935: Joint Tactics
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Shangguan Feiyun just arrived and Shangguan Feixiong was gone with his team.
It only worked to drive his fury ever higher, cursing at their fading figures, “Damn lily-livered fossil! Seeing me here got you shaking in your boots? You’re nothing! Since you can’t beat me you resort to living bombs? Even an old coot like you has fallen so low. But if you’re to send a human bomb you could at least go all the way and send a Genesis Stage expert! What was the point of a fresh Soul Harmony punk? And you call yourselves heroes? If you’re dirtying your hands, go all the way, not act like the cowards and useless bag of bones you are! What a Shangguan Clan Head you turned out to be…
Shangguan Feiyun’s mouth was an endless well of curses born out of the hatred and rage from the earlier blast he had been under. He did not only aim for Shangguan Feixiong’s shamelessness but also Shangguan Yulin’s weakness, unable to harm him at all.
The soul of Shangguan Yulin would’ve fallen into depression if he heard it from whatever hell he was in.
[Why me? I’m just the messenger. How did I even die?]
He just went out with a bang without even knowing. The thunderflame then consumed his soul, robbing him of any chance of survival.
One could say he was a… poor, unfortunate soul.
(PN: Any Little Mermaid fans out there?)
Never knowing what got him even after death. But the moment he decided to be Zhuo Fan’s messenger was the second his fate as martyr was set in stone, taking one for the noble cause of this Demonic Emperor’s grand rescue plan.
Zhuo Fan had no intention to send any messages, only to send him to his death. That stuff with deals and exchanges was only an excuse.
“Sword King Feiyun, save your breath. They never were after you. You’re cursing the wrong tree!”
Whoosh~
Danqing Shen and Baili Jingwei arrived and the latter shook his head seeing the Sword King consumed by rage.
[A man of status he is, but only a martial practitioner at heart, unable to escape his crude disposition..]
Shangguan Feiyun shook and asked, “What’s that, Prime Minister? They didn’t want me dead? What about that detonation and then that sudden attack? I have lost the Soaring Sword so their only reason to come here is to go after my life! Not to mention the punk blew up right next to me. If that isn’t already obvious, what is? How is that not an attempt on my life?”
“Ha-ha-ha, Sword King Feiyun, everyone knows how amazing you are.”
Baili Jingwei shook his head, “If they were after your head, they’d come up with a far more intricate plan and not some hasty idea. Just look at yourself, there’s not a hair out of place.”
“That’s being cautious, blocking the black flame in time…”
“The flame is deadly, but your instincts are much honed as a Sword King than any other Genesis Stage expert. Not even a Soul Harmony kid’s detonation can escape your senses. It’s easy to tell from the sudden surge that a detonation was coming as well. The only way the ambush would have worked was if they used one in the same stage.”
Baili Jingwei gave a wry smile, “Sword King, you need to think about it. What kind of a ambush points to using a tactic that guarantees not to take the target down?”
Shangguan Feiyun shook and exclaimed, “Prime Minister, you mean…”
“They just wanted us to think it was a temporary attempt on your life.” Baili Jingwei had a creepy smile on his face.
Shangguan Feiyun’s heart jumped in shock, “Temporary?”
“Yes.”
Baili Jingwei laughed, “For Sword King to understand it better, I invite you to go back to the secret room together, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Jingwei flew with Danqing Shen as his loyal guard. Shangguan Feiyun was quick to follow.
Back at the tunnel, of the sea of black flames, only a few motes remained here and there.
Shangguan Feiyun waved his sleeve and sent the still burning rocks in the tunnel away. This cleared the way for the trio.
The tunnel was just as narrow, just that its length was now cut in half, making it easy for them to reach the room.
Danqing Shen and Shangguan Feiyun gasped to see the bed empty.
Sensing the cold sheets, they knew the child was long gone. Shangguan Feiyun cried out, “Where is he? When did he leave?”
“Rescued while the attacking Shangguan clan drew our attention.” Baili Jingwei analyzed.
Shangguan Feiyun shuddered and gasped, “Prime Minister, you knew?”
“From the very start…”
Baili Jingwei’s eyes shone and smirked, “Our opponent wasn’t the Shangguan clan but Gu Yifan!”
Shangguan Feiyun cried out, “Him? How did he do it? Didn’t we agree on an exchange? Why…”
“We did agree, but do you trust ourselves to let the father and son go free after we got the Soaring Sword?”
Baili Jingwei shook his head, “If I don’t trust the deal, then you can be sure Gu Yifan won’t either. The Soaring Sword is his leverage. Once removed, nothing can stop us from killing him. How far do you think a Radiant Stage father can run with his injured son? It makes sense he’d need Shangguan clan’s cover. But would they help him without the Soaring Sword? From the start, he never planned on following through on the deal, only after taking our bargaining chip.”
Baili Jingwei looked around the empty room and chuckled, “I have yet to figure out how he slipped in and succeeded in taking his son through the chaos, but the minute Shangguan Yulin demanded to see the child, I knew he planned a rescue. The rest were a series of plans. Shangguan Yulin’s detonation, then the black flame’s invasion of the tunnel, all a show of strength to unbalance our state of mind.
“Anxiety causes men to be irrational and fall for his trap. That’s why I said, Sword King Feiyun, that the attempt on you was temporary. If you had calmed down and discovered the child was missing, you’d see the target wasn’t you to begin with.”
Shangguan Feiyun’s brow shook, looking tense at Baili Jingwei and nodding.
[Everything makes sense now!]
“Next came Shangguan Feixiong, leaving as quickly as they attacked, to lure us away. This was all to enrage and strike at your name, so Sword King Feiyun would believe this was an attempt on yourself so you’d strike in anger and away from here. Then there’s the black flame covering the tunnel. With the guards fearful of it, the only sensible thing for them was to follow you.”
Baili Jingwei smiled as he unraveled the mystery, “This gave him the opening to slip in when no one was around and save the child. He had Shangguan Yulin deliver a message so he’d ingrain in our minds that we’d make the exchange in two weeks and anything that happened within this time was out of his hands. This led to us immediately believing it to be the Shangguan clan behind Shangguan Yulin’s detonation while excluding him as being part of the equation.”
“Ha-ha-ha, Gu Yifan makes us feel a swirl of emotions all at the same time. Truly amazing how his schemes are so meticulous. I’ve traveled the five lands for years but not once met with such a thorny opponent. Just thinking about holding his head fills me with a sense of achievement!”
Baili Jingwei cackled.
Shangguan Feiyun nodded, feeling his back soaked, “He’s fast, precise and deadly, stooping to any low. A more twisted mind on this earth is hard to come by. Then there’s the fact he had the Shangguan clan’s ten experts work with him to get his son, with no casualties. At least he’s not part of the Shangguan clan or it would’ve turned dire!”
“This is the core of every manipulator, not personal strength, but turning every pawn around him into a deadly weapon. The worst danger central area’s Sword Star Empire can have right now is if by some chance the four lands place value on Gu Yifan.”
Baili Jingwei’s eyes flashed with murder as he spoke with resolve, “We have to get rid of him now once and for all!”
Shangguan Feiyun stared at his hateful face and nodded, “He is a very real danger, but has Prime Minister ever thought of winning him…”
“Not even once!”
Baili Jingwei shook his head, “I have said once, that I don’t like anyone like me. I alone am enough to govern the central area. I certainly don’t need a second one, and certainly not Gu Yifan!”
Danqing Shen played the silent observer. He had never seen Baili Jingwei so agitated.
[He feels his authority coming being questioned, his position…]

chapters.title: Chapter 936: Outdoing
chapters.content:
Chapter 936: Outdoing
Proofreader
: Papatonks
With the entire string of events clinically presented to him, it dawned on Shangguan Feiyun what it all represented. Though, like in anything, doubts still remained, “Prime Minister, you knew this was going to happen so why didn’t you stop us from falling into his trap?”
“Sword King Feiyun, you’re underestimating Gu Yifan.”
Baili Jingwei smiled, “Ever since my previous interaction with him, it should be obvious just how meticulous he is. If we were to set up a counter for him, he’d see it at a glance, making the endeavor pointless. I want not just the sword, but his life as well. Now that such a cunning devil finally walked into our domain, I would shame his kind intentions and heaven’s gift letting this chance slip, now won’t I? Humph…”
Shangguan Feiyun nodded after a pause, “Prime Minister is right. You can’t bring a small hook to catch such a big fish. He’s unlike that simple minded Shangguan Feixiong. But does this mean Prime Minister knows where he’s going after saving the brat?”
“Brother Feiyun, don’t you find the question redundant? Just look at Prime Minister brimming with confidence, ha-ha-ha…”
Danqing Shen smiled and turned to Baili Jingwei, “I dare venture a guess that Prime Minister Baili already has everything under his control.”
Baili Jingwei couldn’t stop himself from laughing, “Dragon Cleaving Sword King is truly a close friend. Yes, I have everything ready.”
“Then where is he?” Shangguan Feiyun asked eagerly.
Baili Jingwei waved his hand, his eyes shining as he spoke, “Humph, the punk’s key to his joint tactics was speed. From the moment Shangguan Yulin detonated to Shangguan Yulin’s strike, they all happened at perfect timing and speed. It was enough for just one aspect to be off-beat by one step and it would’ve ended in disaster.
“Speed also dictates the rushed actions he took, resorting to haste and leaving many oversights unattended. This joint tactics demanded that of him, to not be as cautious. Now all he’s doing is being on the run as far away as possible, with little attention to anything else. Therein lies our success in beating him and outdoing him, with even more speed.”
Baili Jingwei had a prideful smirk on his face as he took out a vial. Opening it, he shook it and something green landed in his palm, finger-sized and wiggling.
“1st level spiritual beast, Lovesick Larva?”
Shangguan Feiyun gasped and eagerly awaited Baili Jingwei’s answer.
The prime minister nodded with a smile, “Lovesick Larva, yes. ‘The red bean trees in the south grow/ By spring they yield in heaps above./ I hope you pluck in plenty soon,/ Because it is the gift of love. It yearns for those beans and it’s lack of spiritual energy only classify it as a simple insect, but there’s one thing it excels at that dwarfs other spiritual beast. It’s what earns its place among them.”
(Lovesickness by Wang Wei, tang Dynasty)
“The pair of larvae, even leagues apart, all they’d yearned for is to be together again, to show his lovesickness.” Danqing Shen sighed.
Between the heaven and earth nodded, “That’s exactly right, Dragon Cleaving Sword King. The Lovesick Larva come in pairs, intertwined always until the very moment of death and ever loyal in love. Even if worlds apart, the two insects will eventually find each other again. That’s why happy couples and sweethearts give each other one to proclaim their undying love.”
“Humph, the larvae are inseparable but their owner, always saying goodbye in love and hate, so how many are there that their love lasts until the end? Aren’t men worse then bugs? Ha-ha-ha…” Shangguan Feiyun mocked.
Baili Jingwei nodded, “People are far more complex than this simple pair of insects. Most often than not, these larvae aren’t used to proclaim undying love, or chase skirts, but in a much more practical way.”
“Seperate the two, with the male placed on oneself while the female crushed to be refined into the Thousand Leagues Scent. Though named scent, it is odorless and colorless. Not even Genesis Stage expert can find it. Only this male larva always crawls towards her direction undeterred. That’s what makes it the best tracking method!”
“Does that mean Prime Minister smeared the Thousand Leagues Scent on the brat? When?” Shangguan Feiyun lit up at the promising idea.
Baili Jingwei smiled, “Of course, right when I was checking his pulse. Gu Yifan must have no idea I’ve long since planted the perfect bait for him. Though it won’t change even if he does realize. His plan is based on speed and has no time to check for details. That is unless he threw the brat away, but then it would mean all his work would go to waste. So he’ll bet that I did not take precautions. But you can see that he clearly lost, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Jingwei laughed and Shangguan Feiyun joined him. Danqing Shen just watched them with a shake of his head, his saddened eyes landing on the Lovesick Larva.
The world had such devoted and lovestruck beings, only to end up being a tool for humans and their twisted plans.
[The heavens are so cruel, following with pain after every success.]
[Will the upright and righteous path of the world ever prevail in winning over the demons plaguing our hearts?]
“Sword King Feiyun, we now have his direction. We’ll give chase and grab the divine sword from his stiff cold hands!”
In minutes, the Lovesick Larva found the sent of his better half, struggling to reach her. Nothing could dissuade it from reaching her, not the impossible journey nor the slow crawl.
Its efforts brought a smile to Baili Jingwei’s face, his eyes shining with cruelty as he signaled for Sword King Feiyun to go on a hunt.
Danqing Shen took a deep breath, following them close…
As the demonic sword took Gu Santong out of the manor, Zhuo Fan fled as well. He held Gu Santong close and ran like the wind, with the demonic sword slipping back in his body.
Per Baili Jingwei’s speculation, Zhuo Fan was focused on speed and wanted to put as much distance as he could between them before taking young Sanzi somewhere safe to heal.
Holding a Gu Santong that never once got a scratch, now hanging by a thread, plagued Zhuo Fan’s mind.
Whoosh!
Zhuo Fan rushed through the air, not stopping for anything. This hour of flight had taken him a thousand miles off Flying Cloud City.
With Shangguan Yulin’s detonation and Shangguan Feixiong’s sudden attack, the chaos at the manor drew all the experts in Flying Cloud City over. This gave Zhuo Fan a clear path to get out with ease.
Zhuo Fan’s lure was not only for Shangguan Feiyun and Baili Jingwei, but for all the guards in the city and manor.
It thus made his extraction easier, just like he expected and as Baili Jingwei foresaw.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flash, feeling in control…
With the wind whipping around his face, Gu Santong awoke now and then to find himself in a warm and strong embrace and in safety.
Looking at the familiar face, Gu Santong winced and felt forlorn for some reason, having never had to rely on his godfather, until now, and tears flowed without stop, “Dad, you came back for me…”
“Of course I did. Who else would come save my son if not I?” Zhuo Fan looked stern but smiled in comfort at seeing his missing godson these past days.
Gu Santong’s lips quivered as he apologized, “Dad, I’m sorry…”
“Why would you be? You did nothing wrong.”
“I’ve been so stubborn and father’s perfect plan… It’s all on me. I rushed in and got dad worried and endangered you to come save me…”
Gu Santong sobbed, unable to finish his thoughts. As his cheeks were streaked with tears, his heart was wrecked by regret.
Zhuo Fan looked at him in silence, flying farther and farther away….

chapters.title: Chapter 937: All-encompassing Love
chapters.content:
Chapter 937: All-encompassing Love
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Gu Santong cried for a long time, even as his first tears dried, with Zhuo Fan smiling, “Young Sanzi…”
“Ah?”
“Since you admit you’re at fault, given the chance to do it again, would you still save the wench?”
Gu Santong shook and tensed as he got lost in thought. When he replied he gave a weak nod, “Yes, father!”
“Oh? Then why would you repeat the same mistake?” Zhuo Fan flew as he looked at him with a flat look.
Gu Santong sighed, “Because I want auntie to be safe.”
“Then why do you say it’s your fault?”
“I meant for making you worried and risking yourself for me. But I couldn’t watch auntie who was always nice to me be hurt. That’s why… I’d save auntie again if I could, but I don’t want father to be in danger because of me either…” Gu Santong’s fidgeting betrayed his nervousness.
Zhuo Fan spoke calmly, “Young Sanzi, then you shouldn’t say sorry.”
“Father…” Gu Santong shook, looking stunned. Zhuo Fan’s cold tone sounded angry to him.
Then Zhuo Fan sighed and smiled, “We’ve all been young and rash once. We’ve all made mistakes. Right and wrong are relative, not set in stone. As long as you think it’s right, give it your all. Even if it’s wrong, as long as it’s worth it for you, do it if you are ready to face the consequences of your choice.
“A real man doesn’t utter apologies lightly, or they would hold no value. A man needs to be liable, regardless of wrong or right. Since you saved the wench, you need to be responsible for what follows, including having me spare the effort to save you, even my life…”
“No, dad, I never wanted you…” Zhuo Fan’s words sounded like his will and Gu Santong was only getting frightened as he cried.
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Think thrice before acting, young Sanzi. You’re not the same as before. Your every move has ramifications. Since you couldn’t let the wench get hurt, does that mean I could leave you be? I’m your dad!”
Gu Santong’s lip trembled, overwhelmed by his love.
This was a father, one who would accept him as he was in his entirety…
Gu Santong experienced for the first time Zhuo Fan’s endless love he had for his son, feeling this father reliable.
It had always been the case of Zhuo Fan being the weaker one and needed his help, accepting every time because of the fondness of having a dad. Only now, when he was in trouble, he felt his father’s arms protecting him.
Zhuo Fan had become his everything, not just a mere godfather, but a true father, one such as he could always lean on…
“Also, is there anything a father and son can’t talk about? If you wanted to save the girl, you could’ve just told me and I would’ve.”
Zhuo Fan continued, “Although, my attention has been lapsing that day from always focusing on sealing the falls and never noticing your changes. It’s my fault and I should be the one to apologize.”
Zhuo Fan sighed with guilt. Gu Santong’s regret only grew at his words, “No! It’s all on me. I always thought dad’s attention was only on the World Wind Tunnel, ignoring everything else. All plans were coming to a head all at once and did not want to say anything, fearing you might yell at me…”
Zhuo Fan shook and regarded Gu Santong’s gloomy face.
[My own son thinks I’m so cold and unreasonable? That might’ve been before…]
“Young Sanzi, listen closely, all-encompassing love. We are family. What you like I’ll make all efforts to like as well. Trust me from now on!”
Zhuo Fan was resolute as he stared at Gu Santong.
Looking deep in his father’s eyes, Gu Santong bobbed his head, finally showing his usually bright smile.
Zhuo Fan smiled back in relief…
As the father and son grew closer as family, a cackle from behind startled them, “Ha-ha-ha, got you now Gu Yifan. Try and escape this time!”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes hardened and looked back with a sinking feeling.
[Those rotten bastards caught up too fast…]
Whoosh~
Three pretty trails were left in the sky as Shangguan Feiyun, Baili Jingwei and Danqing Shen appeared.
Though Danqing Shen carried Baili Jingwei since his speed was limited.
The wisest man in the empire and two Sword Kings were hot on Zhuo Fan’s tail. Their power slammed into him and made him gasp, his frown deepening.
“How did they get here so soon? It’s like they knew our heading!” Gu Santong cried out.
Zhuo Fan stomped harder with Gu Santong in his arms, “It’s obvious they’ve done something to you so these dogs could sniff you out.”
“I drew them?” Gu Santong’s eyes shook, feeling ashamed, “Dad, forgive me…”
“Young Sanzi, what did I say? A man shouldn’t always apologize…”
Then Zhuo Fan smirked, “Besides, it’s all within my calculations.”
“Truly?”
“Trust your dad!”
Whoosh!
Zhuo Fan sped up, his eyes flashing with cold determination. It was not like Sword Kings were hot on his tail, but mere wild dogs.
The odds were, hardly anyone in the whole central area actually got away from any of these three big shots. But Zhuo Fan was confident in his skills, going fast while holding his happy son.
Shangguan Feiyun cussed, “He just won’t give up! Does he really think he can escape from the likes of us? Then again, it’s not like we’ll show mercy even if he stops, ha-ha-ha…”
“Gu Yifan must be removed!”
Baili Jingwei gave a vile snicker, looking at the larva in his hand crawling for Zhuo Fan, and mocked, “His son has Thousand Leagues Scent on him and not even a teleportation array can throw us off. The more frantic he is in his run, the worse his already dying son will be. Let’s see how he’ll deal with that, ha-ha-ha…”
“Prime Minister Baili, you might find torturing him fun, but I’m done waiting!”
Shangguan Feiyun swiped his fingers at Zhuo Fan, “Gu Yifan, hand over the Soaring Sword and I’ll spare you, or else…”
Whoosh~
A sword wave in the form of Soaring Sword shot for Zhuo Fan, its sharp edge making his spine tingle, like death was crawling up his back. He reacted by leaning out of the attack’s direction.
Whoosh~
The sharp edge glanced by his cheek, leaving behind a trail of blood.
It exploded in a distant mountain range, leveling everything for a hundred miles. The shockwave came seconds later and staggered Zhuo Fan’s pace as he faced it head on in his run.
What he saw before him was a thick cloud of dust, dying the sky yellow as it covered even the sun.
To Zhuo Fan, it felt like the wall of dust was there to block him from moving forward.
Zhuo Fan had no choice but to stop, his face grave.
[A Sword King’s power sure is something.]
One strike was all that was needed to block him.
His only choice now was to go all out.
Squinting, Zhuo Fan twisted around and let the black thunderflame flash in his left eye while his right eye shone in golden halos, ready to stake it all…

chapters.title: Chapter 938: Fighting a Sword King
chapters.content:
Chapter 938: Fighting a Sword King
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Shangguan Feiyun stopped a thousand meters away with a sardonic smile, “Why, Grandmaster Gu, tired of running, perhaps?”
“When a fight’s unavoidable, no amount of running will change things!” Zhuo Fan smirked back, his one last hurrah before dying. Quite heroic, one might say.
Shangguan Feiyun grinned, “Fight? Grandmaster Gu, you alright there? Why would you fight me? Do you even have the strength? Ha-ha-ha…”
“Regardless if I have or not, I won’t just let you take me without a struggle!”
Zhuo Fan huffed and held Gu Yifan tighter, “Besides, my name might even travel to every corner, talking about my honorable death fighting a Sword King. What’s the difference from all others you killed, you ask? I, Gu Yifan, have become a 11th grade alchemist at such a young age, a heaven’s favorite one might say. I shall never go down without a few ripples! Ha-ha-ha…”
Shangguan Feiyun eyed him as his cocky words stabbed his ears. He turned to Baili Jingwei and mocked, “I say, Gu Yifan just doesn’t know when to quit, even in death he wants to be on top, remembered through the ages.”
“Youngsters are filled with ambition, there’s nothing odd about that. Between dying nameless like mowed grass and going down with dignity with their name spread throughout the world, anyone would always choose the latter.”
Baili Jingwei smiled, “Grandmaster Gu, you very much know I have a soft spot for talents. You more than qualify to be one. So give us the Soaring Sword and why not think about giving your service to the emperor?”
Baili Jingwei sounded sincere, but all Zhuo Fan did was mock him for it, “Prime Minister Baili does like talents, but in my short year in the central area, I’ve not once heard of any notable brilliant people in Prime Minister’s service. Could it be that the wide and expansive central area has none? Or is it likelier that Prime Minister’s wisdom outshines everyone else’s. That doesn’t sound right either. With sir’s virtuous nature, how can you do that? It’s better to say that sir had been at odds with them when…”
Shangguan Feiyun hid a snicker while peeking over at Baili Jingwei.
[Gu Yifan sure is a genius. He’s like a god or something to figure it all out.]
Baili Jingwei loved his talents but to a point. He could employ all of them under his wing, but there was just one type that he abhorred the most, those like him, good in politics. He’d strike hard and fast, out of fear of being replaced.
This empire was just not big enough for two Prime Ministers.
Baili Jingwei would’ve happily welcomed Gu Yifan into his fold, so long as he was but an outstanding alchemist and only that. But late events showed time and time again what a twisted and calculative mind he had, not unlike Baili Jingwei.
By bringing him to the empire, the Prime Minister’s post might just slip from under him.
Gu Yifan had to die here and now beyond any shadow of a doubt. Stealing the Soaring Sword had nothing to do with it, but just because Baili Jingwei found him an eyesore.
“Grandmaster Gu has some good eyes, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Jingwei’s face twitched, “Since Grandmaster Gu insists on this action, I won’t dissuade you any longer. While I understand you don’t care about yourself, but what about the other life involved? Grandmaster Gu just has to give us the Soaring Sword and I promise your son’s safety.”
Zhuo Fan turned to Gu Santong, seeing the determination in his eyes and chuckled, “Prime Minister, there’s no need to toy with me. My son is just like me and I’m sure you’ve already seen this. Rooting out the weeds isn’t uncommon. None of you would be so willing to let your enemy’s son live, now would you? Ha-ha-ha, Prime Minister should save his breath. The both of us will live or die together in this fight!”
Zhuo Fan used his belt to tie Gu Santong close to him, filled with the will to die. His son was no different.
Shangguan Feiyun was touched by their determination. They were sure to become great in the future.
[A shame it will be cut short today.]
“Since Grandmaster Gu can’t see reason, I’ll oblige!”
Lacking the appreciation a fellow warrior would have of another’s valor, Baili Jingwei signaled Shangguan Feiyun, “Shangguan Feiyun, send them off.”
Shangguan Feiyun nodded and swiped with his fingers, unleashing a terrible energy rumbling forward, giving the feeling the world might collapse.
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, watching the fingers intently as sweat trickled down his brow.
