He wouldn’t last five moves against Sword King Feiyun, but then again, he wasn’t in it to win, but to survive. Therein lay the slim chance at life.
He was now following the plan he made, but each step was accompanied by mortal danger. One slip and nothing would remain of him.
He found the best solution was to get a mortal wound and then escape, since anyone would disregard a dying person…
Hum~
Waves of power came from those two fingers, shaking the world around them. Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed in golden halos, ready to act even as sweat poured from his brow.
Shangguan Feiyun’s sword had such power and speed that not even Shift might get him out of the woods.
The only hope of survival was to use it the instant the attack was released. Any later and life was forfeit. Any later and the enemy would notice and just switch directions, resulting in death.
Life and death hung on that one tiny window. There was no room for errors.
Zhuo Fan was under a lot of pressure because of it, as this was his first time facing a Sword King, the peak power of the mortal domain. The soaked back attested to that…
Whoosh~
Shangguan Feiyun moved his fingers in Zhuo Fan’s direction and the sword was released. It was then Zhuo Fan’s Divine Eye of the Void activated.
Just as the attack reached Zhuo Fan, he flickered and was gone. The sword struck the wall of dust behind, blowing it away.
“He dodged it? How?”
Shangguan Feiyun exclaimed. But soon there was a ripple coming from his front.
Zhuo Fan wasn’t going for an escape, but to attack a Sword King!
All of them were shocked.
[How much nerve does this punk have?]
His keen senses made him aware of Zhuo Fan’s location, and although shocked, Shangguan Feiyun used his Yuan Qi again to form sword energy in his fingers even as Zhuo Fan was in the middle of appearing.
Shangguan Feiyun’s second attack was ready just as he became visible and mocked Zhuo Fan, “Humph, you have some guts to face me instead of running. You must really have a death wish…”
“Thunderflame Void Annihilation!”
His right eye flashed in two golden halos while his right burned, unleashing the attack he had in store.
Hu~
The thunderflame shot for Shangguan Feiyun like a black pillar of death, right for his head.
Shangguan Feiyun shook from seeing the deadly thunderflame again and his heart jumped in fright. He was frantic in using a Yuan Qi shield, doing anything he could to keep that thing from touching him.
All while his second sword struck Zhuo Fan. At such close range, Zhuo Fan had no chance of dodging or running. Not even his soul would survive this.
This great and deadly power made Zhuo Fan’s face burn and his scalp numb.
It was now reality that had strayed from Zhuo Fan’s flawless predictions. Shangguan Feiyun, who had always been looking down on him so far, had been so scared he began to take the youth seriously.
It was at the same time that he felt threatened from the core of his heart…

chapters.title: Chapter 939: Shock
chapters.content:
Chapter 939: Shock
Proofreader
: Papatonks
With a muffled sound, the black thunderflame struck, but unlike sticking to the Yuan Qi shield as before, it went right through it like paper and straight for his flesh.
Shangguan Feiyun panicked in fear, overwhelmed by the power of the thunderflame going beyond his expectation.
What Shangguan Yulin had demonstrated through his detonation was the thunderflame’s intrinsic power, not when it was used as a skill like now.
As for the Thunderflame Void Annihilation, that was Zhuo Fan combining his two ultimate skills, to break any kind of obstacle and letting the thunderflame’s deadly nature capitalize on its true power.
What could a measly Yuan Qi shield amount to when it could cut through the Shangguan clan’s 12th grade array made with all their experts?
With fear vivid in his look and with terror in his heart, Shangguan Feiyun rushed to dodge this deadly move.
This in turn affected his aim on the sword that was meant for Zhuo Fan, leading to it shooting someplace else and leveling another fifty miles area, turning into a dust storm.
The destructive black thunderflame streaked past his shoulder and far beyond. Shangguan Feiyun felt its vibrant and burning power as it passed, making his blood run cold.
The amount of times the great best in eastern lands, now a Sword King, felt such unfiltered terror from his incredibly close brush with death could be counted on one hand.
It was far too soon to relax though, as sizzling jarred his ears. He whipped his head around and the view had his legs feeling like jelly.
The deadly black flames were on his clothes and were eating their way to his body.
Shangguan Feiyun shook at once and used Yuan Qi to shake the clothing off, making the flames die out as the remnants of clothing burned out.
Whoosh!
Then another sound entered his ears and watched as Zhuo Fan with young Sanzi in his arms appeared again in front. His left eye was filled with violent black flames while his right shone in two golden halos, planning to make a repeat of the previous move.
But the horror had been too memorable for Shangguan Feiyun the first time to allow it to happen again.
Not even facing death felt so horrible. Shangguan Feiyun saw Zhuo Fan appearing and jumped back with no delay, ten kilometers in fact.
When he finally sensed some semblance of safety, he eased a breath he didn’t know he was holding, feeling drained as if from a fight with Invincible Sword. He gasped for breath, his feeble legs barely keeping him from falling. There was even a conspicuous change in color on Sword King Shangguan’s pants, quite obvious to any observer…
Baili Jingwei and Danqing Shen had their jaws hanging.
[Come on, Sword King Feiyun! You’re supposed to be a Sword King, so what are you doing looking so worn out after an exchange with a puny Radiant Stage cultivator? What a scandal! Your top is naked for having your clothes ruined and your lower half wet from being scared to death by a measly Radiant Stage alchemist!]
Baili Jingwei’s mouth twitched, anger clearly showing. Just as he was about to curse, he then understood the thunderflame’s fatal danger.
So Prime Minister looked heavily at the panting Zhuo Fan, “Gu Yifan wasn’t just making wild boasting when he said he’d fight a Sword King.”
“This kid is truly frightening.”
Danqing Shen nodded, “The black flame’s power can kill a Sword King. If only he was a bit stronger, then that attack…”
He stopped, hearing the snapping of Baili Jingwei’s knuckles and his heavy tone, “There’s no way he’ll get any stronger. First I wanted to kill him because I wanted to but now it’s for the safety of the empire. There can only be one Invincible Sword in this world. There’s no room for a second dreaded existence!”
Danqing Shen’s brow shook, his eyes flashing.
[The boy’s too outstanding. And then there’s that black flame that can threaten a Sword King from as weak as a Radiant Stage. He may, no, will become, the second Invincible Sword!]
[Baili Jingwei is sure to even disregard the Soaring Sword if it means killing him.]
Danqing Shen held his beard, deep in thought…
Shangguan Feiyun was looking worse for wear. Then the anger exploded from him as he glared at Zhuo Fan with bloodthirst.
[I’ll not stand this punk for drawing another breath after that humiliation!]
Shangguan Feiyun brought his fingers out and struck with another sword. He no longer looked casual, but focused like when fighting an equal, while keeping his senses sharp for any disturbance within a kilometer, just in case.
Zhuo Fan sighed.
[I know I’m still too weak to deal with a Sword King. Any other Genesis Stage cultivator would’ve burned alive by now.]
After attacking a Sword King, if the first time failed, the second time would never present itself.
Though it all fell within his parameters, thus taking the sensible option and bolting.
Baili Jingwei and Danqing Shen did not follow, knowing Zhuo Fan was Shangguan Feiyun’s prey. He was not about to let this guy escape!
“He-he-he, it’s a bit late for that!”
Shangguan Feiyun snickered out of reflex, his fingers shining as he unleashed a world-shaking surge of power. No matter how far Zhuo Fan got, it would still kill him.
This was the terrible power of a Sword King. Zhuo Fan could shake him with his earlier display of thunderflame, but that was all he could muster.
Shangguan Feiyun was more clear on this than any as he spoke after calming down, “Humph, Gu Yifan, I got to hand it to you, you’re a real genius. You’ve excelled in strength and in alchemy. That flame of yours had me running scared there and given time, you might kill me one day, becoming the next overlord to this world. Too bad you showed yourself so soon and you won’t get the chance, I’ll make sure of it. That black flame is only useful if it touches me. Gu Yifan, you have no chance now!”
Shangguan Feiyun swiped his fingers and the Soaring Sword Art was deployed in the form of a third sword, straight for Zhuo Fan and his son.
Whoosh~
The edge was behind him in a flash.
Zhuo Fan looked back in shock and used the five shining halos in his right eye, “Divine Eye of the Void’s 5th stage, Thunderflame Wall times five!”
The black thunderflame appeared once more, forming five layers in total, to block the incoming sword.
Shangguan Feiyun gaped, not expecting Zhuo Fan to come up with that, using the strange black flame as defense.
It would’ve worked wonders if it were anyone else than a Sword King.
Boom!
The walls disintegrated in a flash, turning into motes of black fire as they faded in the air. Zhuo Fan shook and spat blood from the strong aftershock, both of his eyes were also bleeding.
As for the sword energy, it still went for Zhuo Fan.
“Ha-ha-ha, Gu Yifan, even with that oddity helping you, with your power, you have no…”
Shangguan Feiyun cackled victoriously, but then he choked, turning incredulous, “W-what the hell? My sword energy…”

chapters.title: Chapter 940: Edge of Death
chapters.content:
Chapter 940: Edge of Death
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Sss~
The sizzling was the only prevalent sound around, stinging Shangguan Feiyun ears as he watched his ultimate sword skill going through Zhuo Fan’s walls of thunderflame only to be eaten away by the same fire.
By the time the fire died out, the sword energy was a quarter weaker. It was still strong, yes, but it was without a doubt cut down to size.
If before the sword came from Shangguan Feiyun, now it looked to be resembling any average Genesis expert’s sword attack.
Sure, it’d be a peak one but the gap was huge all the same.
Central area spread beyond anyone could imagine and was teeming with peak Genesis experts. Despite that there were only Nine Sword Kings, that was because they were a cut above the masses.
Shangguan Feiyun’s casual sword strike had crushed thirty Genesis Stage guards a while back. Danqing Shen’s sword was the same, putting most of the Shangguan clan’s experts in a pickle.
This was the power of a Sword King, unlike any other peak Genesis expert, able to take on five of them with ease.
Even with the mortal domain’s limit stuck at peak Genesis Stage, these Nine Sword Kings stood above all others.
If not for the mortal domain’s limit, these would’ve long since become Saints, at the same level as the experts in the Sacred Domain, if not higher. They might even shake some monsters out there.
This peak worldly power had just been cut down to size by Zhuo Fan’s thunderflame, turning into something common and weaker.
The shock was palpable to the trio watching, and so it was for Zhuo Fan too. He was the one on the receiving end in this fight, yet none underestimated him.
Shangguan Feiyun’s eyes shook, “The black flame ate at my sword energy so quickly. This is insane! How the hell does such a thing even exist?”
The other two sighed.
Their fear of Zhuo Fan was not for his strength, but because of the apocalyptic thunderflame. The flame was too destructive, burning anything and everything in creation.
Not even martial arts could survive it. Such a thing had never happened ever.
It was only a question of quantity in the black flame’s case. With enough of it, any cultivator would be erased from this world. Their Yuan Qi shields would be eaten and their martial arts would fare no better. It wasn’t a leap in logic to assume spiritual items would end up the same.
This thunderflame was like hellfire, bringing eternal and absolute doom. If word got out, Zhuo Fan would become this entire world’s enemy.
Wielding the thunderflame was like having a weapon of mass destruction…
The trio tensed as they watched Zhuo Fan, each with their own thoughts.
Zhuo Fan was bleeding from his eyes, but not enough to shake his calm, even finding time to smirk. By cutting the sword energy down to size, he could now handle it.
Zhuo Fan ignored his damaged eye and had his right eye shine in two golden halos while his left flickered with the thunderflame, unleashing Thunderflame Void Annihilation once more at the Soaring Sword Art.
The flame struck the sword, but they were once more dispersed as it went after Zhuo Fan still.
Zhuo Fan suffered from it as well, with a splitting headache and spitting blood even as his eyes bled more.
None of it mattered though, since he had the pride to grin.
In the moment of clashing, even as his attack failed, the thunderflame’s character was unstoppable.
And with Void Annihilation to complement it, it sent the flames right into the heart of the sword energy.
This in turn, made the deadly sword weaker and weaker. By the times the flames died, the sword energy was at a fresh Genesis Stage cultivator’s level.
Shangguan Feiyun was dumbstruck.
In two moves, this great Sword King’s prideful sword art was reduced so much that that was all the damage it could actually do after the other tried to stop it.
Any meager Genesis Stage cultivator could easily flick it away, something that bruised Shangguan Feiyun’s ego.
At least Gu Yifan was just a Radiant Stage cultivator and even this much was enough.
If Sword King Feiyun couldn’t kill a guy in even three moves, he might as well just kill himself.
Sure, the other was just a Radiant Stage cultivator, but a Sword King still had his pride.
Zhuo Fan had other plans in mind, besides giving his life to heal this Sword King’s hurt ego…
Grinning, Zhuo Fan showed confidence against the cut down sword attack from a Sword King and used Divine Eye of the Void’s 4th stage.
Thunderflame Domain!
Boom!
A thousand meters around him, the space hummed, with the black thunderflame spreading everywhere with each vibration.
The sword energy did not disintegrate under the vibrations, instead it slowed down, while being drastically weakened from the thunderflame.
This was Zhuo Fan’s method of dealing with the deadly sword energy, chipping it away until it was easy for his wounded self to take it.
Of course, it was not enough to halt the sword energy completely, as it finally reached Zhuo Fan.
But through the many trials, it was now at the power of mid Soul Harmony Stage, more than enough for Zhuo Fan to handle.
Grinning, Zhuo Fan had his scarlet right hand lifted in complete confidence.
[So much for a Sword King’s power. I can still take it…]
Zhuo Fan had forgotten about one crucial fact about this sword, something that made it pierce his almighty right hand even weakened as it was.
Blood spilled all over and Zhuo Fan’s smugness turned to shock.
[How? Why can’t the Qilin arm stop even a Soul Harmony expert’s sword?]
[Did I miscalculate?]
Spewing blood again, Zhuo Fan held Gu Santong close as he fell to the ground with a bang. Resting in his crater, his blood stained the earth around him.
“Dad, dad…” Gu Santong cried, his weary eyes tearing up.
Zhuo Fan gasped, “Young Sanzi, I’ve forgotten to take something into account, but to think it led to such a heavy wound. Now I can’t even use the Dragon Breath Pill…”
“Dad, are we going to die?” Gu Santong was just as powerless.
Zhuo Fan rubbed his head, “Are you afraid?”
“No!”
“Then leave it to luck!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, “Our lives are now in his hands, as long as he remembers the deal…”
Gu Santong gave an understanding nod.
Zhuo Fan’s wretched state was all due to forgetting an important detail, one that led to the weakened sword energy reducing him to this.
To the other three, the outcome was beyond their imagination. Shangguan Feiyun was the most shocked, “There has never been anyone in this world I can’t kill after three strikes besides the other Sword Kings and Invincible Sword! Gu Yifan, since you’re first, let me end you with the fourth sword.”
Shangguan Feiyun aimed the fingers at the wounded and unmoving man in that crater, filled with the intent to end this.
There was hatred and resentment, but most of all, humiliation.
His quarry was now defenseless yet he was the one feeling defeated. The great Sword King had failed to kill a Radiant Stage alchemist in three strikes, the same way a buffed man couldn’t squash an ant with his fist.
People would disregard the ant’s strength and mock instead the weakness of the man.
Shangguan Feiyun’s next sword held all his bloodthirst, the most dangerous one the damaged Zhuo Fan was going to face.
It was within his calculation, but deviated somewhat. Yet this little shift meant true death, even for Zhuo Fan…

chapters.title: Chapter 941: Back Against the Wall/Backed into a Corner
chapters.content:
Chapter 941: Back Against the Wall/Backed into a Corner
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“First is a show of strength to unsettle the mind, second is baiting to get every guard out of the jail and give me time to rescue him. The whole guards throughout the city will be drawn as well, making our escape all the much easier…”
“The plan does sound solid, but will they fall for it so easily?”
“Shangguan Yulin hates Shangguan Clan Head to the marrow, thus making Shangguan Yulin detonate himself in his face and with you raiding the manor, his mind will jump to conclusions I wanted out of rage. He’ll believe beyond any shadow of a doubt that Clan Head is behind this. While I’ll also scare the guards with this attack, making them feel safe only around Shangguan Feiyun, thus leaving the jail free to rescue him.”
“This plan has a very good chance of duping Shangguan Feiyun, but that might not go the same for the wisest man in the empire, Baili Jingwei.”
“His reputation precedes him and it’s guaranteed he’ll see through it. But no matter how shrewd he is, he has one glaring flaw I can exploit.”
“What?”
“Untold greed, ha-ha-ha. Though it’s not really a glaring weakness, since any highly skilled manipulator will feel greater desire in always wanting things to go his way. The Pill King Convention is the perfect example. He knew where all of you were hiding and laid a bait for the perfect trap to catch all of you. He is a man with a clear objective and great patience. So no matter what doubts he might have about anything, he won’t act on them, but instead seek to outdo me in the same field by using this alluring bait. In that case, we should outdo him as well by following his plan of saving young Sanzi from the manor.”
“Then what?”
“Hunting me down to the ends of the world. I reckon they’d catch up in an hour of two. Escaping again will be even harder.”
“Won’t they just kill you?”
“Yeah, only with death staring you in the face will you see the light of tomorrow. This is the only way for the two of us to escape Baili Jingwei’s hunt and leave the central area. Shangguan Clan Head should just forget about it since I have my own plans…”
Boom~
Heavy rumbling came from afar, with a cloud of dust rising in the horizon, so high it covered the sun and the blue sky.
Shangguan Feixiong’s team was hovering high in the air. As he recalled Zhuo Fan’s foolproof plan back in the cave, his eyes were fixed on the source of those loud sounds, his gaze heavy.
He sighed, “Everything went exactly as the kid speculated. Baili Jingwei and the other two went after the kid to catch him.”
“He’s got valor and smarts, anticipating the enemy’s moves, even Baili Jingwei.” One venerable shook his head in worry, “Just what could the kid do to escape from two Sword Kings and a Prime Minister?”
The rest wore heavy frowns, “Yeah, what can he do? There were so many of us and not even we could save anyone from the two Sword Kings.”
“There’s no point worrying. He said he had a way and that’s that.” Shangguan Feixiong sighed, “It’s quite amazing how everyone started caring about him in just a few days, ha-ha-ha…”
One venerable huffed, “Who is? We’re only lamenting the death of such a genius. And who are we going to take it out on if he dies without giving us the sword?”
“Ha-ha-ha, Venerable can relax in this case. He said back in the cave that he’ll hand it over once he escapes with his son. I had already sent men over to wait. Once Baili Jingwei and the others leave, we’ll look for the kid to hand it over.”
“Feixiong, are you just going to believe his words? He’s too cunning!” Another venerable chuckled.
Shangguan Feixiong showed a look of glee, nodding determined, “I do, because he swore on his son. I don’t believe any parent would toy with their children. He will keep his word.”
The others shook and nodded.
“And if he dies? There’s a chance his plan will fall through.”
“He’ll still leave us with a trail so we can find the divine sword.” Shangguan Feixiong looked at the disturbance once more with shaky eyes, “Even if they die, he’ll keep his words, only wishing to give the two of them proper burial, to give his son his blessing…”
The men looked at the Clan Head and then nodded in silence.
Gu Yifan’s mind was more twisted than a gnarled root, but one thing they could all swear on was his undying love for his son…
Hum~
Shangguan Feiyun’s fourth sword unleashed a terrible aura, making the air shimmer around it. Zhuo Fan stared back with a grin, in utter calm. As he waited, he chuckled at some point, closing his eyes and resigning himself to fate.
It was done without an ounce of regret, welcoming the end with a free heart…
With no hope of the two lovers getting back together, with enemies too strong to be overcome, nothing could ever get him out of such a hopeless situation. Zhuo Fan had carried so much weight inside him these past years, coming to bear too much alone. Even with the faint glimmer of hope presented to him, it felt always out of reach, always unattainable.
The stress and grief had eaten away at his mind for such a long time. It was a recipe for disaster, avoiding insanity only because he trained the True Self Art to center himself.
The deeper the love, the heavier the wound. He now came to see why love was forbidden to demonic cultivators, for one man alone might never escape its torment.
He found being in a situation where another was giving him a mercy killing was a fit ending. He should’ve died ages ago…
Showing a smile only he understood, Zhuo Fan welcomed the end.
Hum~
Shangguan Feiyun’s sword rang constantly, aimed squarely at Zhuo Fan’s head. As the bloodthirst in his eyes focused, the devastating sword was released. Zhuo Fan could feel its terror but all he had for it was a faint smile…
Shangguan Feiyun’s fingers did not finish cutting the air and sending the sword, as they were caught mid-move by a tight hand.
Shangguan Feiyun spoke in a chilling tone, “Brother Dan, what are you doing?”
Baili Jingwei was taken aback.
“I just think we should save it for after we find the Soaring Sword.” Danqing Shen’s beard swished as he spoke.
Shangguan Feiyun huffed, “With his character, there’s no way he’ll say anything. And is this a time to think about the Soaring Sword? He has now become a far greater danger than the sword’s value. He has to die, right, Prime Minister?”
Baili Jingwei nodded after a pause, “Soaring Sword is missing and the Patriarch will at most feel a longing for a lost toy. What we can’t allow however, is to permit anything that might endanger his life. The moment I saw the kid release the black flame, I was even more sure that he must die.”
“It’s clear to anyone here that it must be so, but wouldn’t it be better to have it both ways?”
Danqing Shen nodded and turned to the unmoving Zhuo, “Gu Yifan, you heard it. Today’s your funeral and you can’t take the Soaring Sword where you’re going. I am willing to fulfill your last wish, your will. You’ve come from the western lands and have been in the central area for a year now. You should understand that I hardly make promises, but when I do, I always keep them. Now tell me your dying wish.”
Zhuo Fan looked him in the eye with a smile, “Ha-ha-ha, let my son go!”
“Impossible!”
Baili Jingwei denied it on the spot, “Gu Yifan, you yourself said something about weeding out the remains. We’ll never allow this threat to live!”
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Then there’s nothing else…”
“Damn rotten dying brat! Since you love death so much, have it all!” Shangguan Feiyun’s fingers cut the air again.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes lit up and waved him off, “Hold up, there is one other, however. It just came to me…”
“Then go ahead, say it!” Danqing Shen frowned.
Looking from him to Shangguan Feiyun, Zhuo Fan smirked, “I only wish for Dragon Cleaving Sword King to be the one ending me.”
“Why?”
“I’d hate to see Shangguan Feiyun happy. Three times he failed to kill me and I’d rather not have his fourth sword touch a hair on me. Let this Sword King carry the shame with him always, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan cackled.
Shangguan Feiyun’s face twitched and roared, his fingers finishing the move, “Goddamned bastard! I’ll frickin’ kill you!”
“Wait!”
Baili Jingwei stopped him, turning to Zhuo Fan with a sharp gaze, “Alright, we agree!”

chapters.title: Chapter 942: Sand Burial
chapters.content:
Chapter 942: Sand Burial
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Baili Jingwei’s eyes flashed, “Even without Dragon Cleaving Sword King’s promise, I would guarantee your last meager dying wish in exchange for the Soaring Sword. We all promise.”
“Prime Minister…” Shangguan Feiyun’s brow shook, but Baili Jingwei’s wave stopped him, “Sword King Feiyun, please think of the bigger picture. Which is more important, your name or the Soaring Sword? Its loss affected Sword King’s reputation all the same. In other words, Soaring Sword’s name has already suffered, so what is a little more? Please bear this indignity, for the empire!”
Shangguan Feiyun took a look at his most pathetic state. It wasn’t the missing sleeve from one arm that got to him, but the damp pants that fueled his rage and shame. But in the end, he gave an angry wave and turned around, taking out fresh clothes to change.
Baili Jingwei nodded and smiled, “Sword King Feiyun has promised you as well. That should be all, yes?”
“Ha-ha-ha, yeah, now I can tell you where the Soaring Sword is. Only, it’s another matter entirely if you can get it…”
Zhuo Fan showed a crooked smile to an eager Baili Jingwei, toying with him, “Soaring Sword is now with the Shangguan clan.”
Baili Jingwei gasped, “They have it?! Grandmaster Gu, are you making fun of us? How can a cunning mind like yours just hand it over to them? “
“Ha-ha-ha, what else was there?”
His loud laughter made him spray blood as well, “We all know I’ve had priors with Shangguan clan so I had to give them something to help me out.”
Shangguan Feiyun’s brow shook, his face heavy as he said, “Baili Jingwei, letting those Shangguan bastards get the sword will be even worse. With their power and numbers, they’ll just flee and we won’t catch them. It’ll be hard even if a Sword King gets involved. Moreover, once they hole up in the expansive central area, it’s like finding a needle in a haystack. Even if we do get wind of them by some miracle, the scouting team will just die for nothing without a Sword King leading them. This is really getting out of hand…”
Baili Jingwei squinted, his face grave. But he did not once let his eyes stray from Zhuo Fan, “Grandmaster Gu, stop with the games. You’re on your deathbed. You said you had priors with them and they won’t believe you. But this goes both ways. Do you trust them? You’d have gotten the short end of the stick if you’d have just handed them the sword. They’d have just taken it out on you to vent for their losses. For a smart guy like you, such an obvious mistake is impossible. Humph, Grandmaster Gu, don’t take us up for idiots.”
Baili Jingwei huffed, his eyes sharp. Shangguan Feiyun’s face twitched.
[Who is Baili Jingwei calling an idiot? Humph, damn that Prime Minister, acting like the only wise guy in the world.]
“Prime Minister, would you say I’m in a position to insult you? Ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “But yes, neither I nor Shangguan clan trust each other so the handing of the sword is done at the right time so that we’d work out together against the enemy. Once the deal is done, neither will mind the other.”
Baili Jingwei’s eyes shook, “You mean…”
“You are our enemy, all three of you, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan chuckled as he explained, “I used them to lure you all away and rescue young Sanzi, then handed over the sword to the clansmen following behind me. This was the only way to make both sides agree. We knew that fighting would be bad as it would draw the guards over, leading to them losing the sword and us getting captured. So even with the mistrust between us, the timing called for us to overlook all our past problems and think of the bigger picture. Wouldn’t you say so, Prime Minister Baili?”
Baili Jingwei shook all over, believing Zhuo Fan’s perfectly strung arguments. Shangguan Feiyun asked, “Prime Minister, can we believe him?”
“We don’t have a choice!”
Baili Jingwei was tense, “We were clear on the hostility between him and the Shangguan clan, and working together was out of the question. The only reason they did it anyway was for the Soaring Sword. The question is, when will it be handed over? Too soon and the Shangguan clan will go back on its word. Too late and anxiety mounts, so much so the tense mood will make them settle old scores even after getting the sword. But with the threat of another enemy around, the deal will be completed, each going their own way.”
Baili Jingwei stared hard at Zhuo Fan and spoke with frustration and hatred, “Grandmaster Gu, you’re a true mastermind. You’ve done great indeed. If I were the one facing such a challenge, I don’t think I’d come up with such a brilliant plan on the spot. You have my respect.”
“Ha-ha-ha, why thank you for the honor, Prime Minister.” Zhuo Fan waved his flattery away.
Baili Jingwei read the mockery in his eyes and turned to Danqing Shen in anger, “Dragon Cleaving Sword King, fulfill Grandmaster Gu’s will and send them off!”
“Right!”
Danqing Shen drew two fingers and a deadly power surged in their tips, followed by a dragon roar and the space shimmering around him.
Cold eyes gazed upon the feeble Zhuo Fan and Danqing Shen raised his hand. Zhuo Fan stared back with a broad smile…
Whoosh~
A sword of the same level as Shangguan Feiyun’s was unleashed upon Zhuo Fan. Along with thousands of dragon roars, the sword energy surged as it fell on him.
Following the devastating explosion, hundreds of miles around Zhuo Fan and his son were leveled. There was nothing there than a wasteland and thick dust that dyed the world yellow.
Once the breeze scattered it away, there was no trace of anything left behind. Everything was gone, buried with the sand.
The entire landscape had been reformed into this desolation.
Baili Jingwei sighed at the destruction, “It is finished. Such an alchemical genius of his generation found his bones resting along his son’s in this sand burial. What a pity.”
“Prime Minister, isn’t it a bit late for that?” Shangguan Feiyun glanced over.
[Hypocrite much?]
Baili Jingwei said, “Cherishing talent is one thing, but seeing my opponent gone brought me such relief. Dragon Cleaving Sword King, Sword King Feiyun, let’s go. We need to hurry back and send word to every corner of the central area. We have to track down the Shangguan clan and stop them from getting the sword out of the central area!”
“Easier said than done.”
Shangguan Feiyun shook his head, “I’ll say it again. They only need to hide and even a Sword King will hardly have a better chance of finding them, let alone the rest. The chances of getting the Soaring Sword back are less than ten percent.”
Baili Jingwei sighed, “We’ll do our part, while the rest is up to fate. In any case, this has been my, no, our failure!”
Baili Jingwei flew for Flying Cloud City.
Shangguan Feiyun shook, balling his fists and steeling his gaze.
[Baili Jingwei isn’t the only one culpable.]
With the Shangguan clan escaping and the Soaring Sword gone, Shangguan Feiyun was liable as well.
Gu Yifan might have lost in the last fight, as a mere Radiant Stage cultivator, he had avoided three sword skills from a Sword King and even talked his way out of being executed by the fourth strike at his weakest.
It was Shangguan Feiyun’s worst defeat. Gu Yifan and Shangguan Feiyun neither won nor lost.
But Zhuo Fan’s last will and the mockery it contained was something Shangguan Feiyun would never forget. The shame and anger were ready to explode.
It was the same as saying Shangguan Feiyun had no hand in his death.
Shangguan Feiyun’s face twisted, a vein popping on his forehead, from being utterly humiliated by a nobody.
Now he had no one to take it out on, for the culprit died laughing at him.
Shangguan Feiyun stomped in rage and flew behind Baili Jingwei. Danqing Shen was the only one remaining, looking where Zhuo Fan once was with a vague smile…

chapters.title: Chapter 943: Deceptive Outcome
chapters.content:
Chapter 943: Deceptive Outcome
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Gu Yifan, young Sanzi, where are you…”
Six hours later, in the area where a brutal cleansing had taken place, where not even a blade of grass grew, a pure and naive girl was shouting.
The frail lass cried at the silent heavens as a gale blew across this desolation. Her tone was filled with worry, her cracking voice showing signs of breaking down crying.
There were a dozen more youths looking around and shouting with her. “Mister Gu! Young Sanzi!”
All their shouting and searching proved fruitless in these strong winds, swallowing their voices.
They finally gave up hope an hour later, leaving only the girl still frantic and consumed with the thought of finding them. She never stopped, never rested, always crying out till hoarse, “Gu Yifan! Young Sanzi! Where are you?”
“Young miss, save your energy. You’ve seen what attack did this. They had no chance against such misfortune. There’s no point searching.”
One youth sighed, “It’ll be a miracle if someone could survive two Sword Kings. Mister Gu… let’s follow Clan Head’s words and look for any clues Mister Gu left us to reach the Soaring Sword.”
The girl glared back at him, “Shut up! Gu Yifan is fine! They can hear us and we’ll soon find them. They have to be, or…”
Shangguan Qingyan trailed off.
“Young miss, in this desolate place, any kind of sign would’ve been noticed easily. If we can’t see them, it makes no sense for two Sword Kings to be blind to anything obvious. That only leaves death, destroyed completely. Young miss, our top priority still is finding Mister Gu’s clues…”
He shook his head, trying to make her see reality, but then a ripple echoed out.
Two figures slumped to the ground, popping out of thin air, and soaking the yellow dust with their scarlet blood.
Shangguan Qingyan shook and cheered, crying tears of joy as she rushed over, “Mister Gu, young Sanzi, you’re alright! You’re still alive!”
“In the name of all that’s holy, the guy actually got away from two Sword Kings! What did this freak do?”
The guy held his head in complete shock, needing some time to react to this sudden realization. Then he rushed over to help, only for a bloody arm to clutch his shirt, dragging him down.
He looked stunned at Zhuo Fan, who was gasping for breath, using the last of his energy to shout, “I told you to come and help not give me a burial. The least you could do is see if we’re still alive, not go straight to business!”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes rolled back and he was out like a light. Only his other hand held an unconscious Gu Santong, never letting go.
“Uhm…”
The youth who got stained, looked at Zhuo Fan holding Gu Yifan close and spoke with respect, “Gu Yifan is truly amazing. He’s hurt so much but still has the energy to curse. He had been protecting his son all this time, not letting anything happen to him…”
Shangguan Qingyan nodded, choking with emotion and pain from seeing Zhuo Fan covered in those deep wounds.
“Get Mister Gu and his son back now! They need healing!”
Noticing Shangguan Qingyan was in no state to boss them, the guy shouted for the others, carrying the two away.
Across the large expanse of this yellow wasteland, a conspicuous stain of scarlet blood on the dry dirt was the only proof that someone had survived this ordeal…
It took Zhuo Fan three days to wake up, finding himself in a dark cave. Nothing came as a surprise for him, knowing that they had been rescued.
It was part of his deal with Shangguan Feixiong. As long as they were drawing breath, they had to be tended to, or death was sure to grasp them in its cold grip if left out there in the desolate place.
Shangguan clan thus sent the juniors to save them.
This was why Zhuo Fan knew that after saving young Sanzi, the Shangguan clan would comply since he still held the sword they wanted.
This was the perfect time to use it for all its worth.
[With this sword around, the Shangguan clan won’t ever let me die!]
If the chances were death would have come instead, he’d have set the sword out of his ring for Shangguan clan to take. He didn’t need it where he was going. Zhuo Fan had taken all aspects into consideration.
On one hand, he had bluffed Baili Jingwei into leaving and on the other, he had Shangguan clan eating out of his palm.
The thought brought an insidious smile to Zhuo Fan’s lips, resting as he was on the cold hard bed. [Ha-ha-ha, at the end of it all, be it Flying Cloud manor or Shangguan clan, all danced to my tune.]
[I have turned despair into hope once more…]
Cackling like mad, Zhuo Fan stood up, only to feel a sudden pain stab at his mind. The agony coming from every part of his body made him grit his teeth, “Damn that Danqing Shen, couldn’t he have taken it easier?
“Then again, being ruthless was the only way of fooling Shangguan Feiyun’s senses and intuition.”
A faint and childish voice came, “Dad, you told him to and now you’re blaming him for it. If the old man knew you’re cursing him, he’d wished he’d killed you instead.”
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, smiling, “Young Sanzi, you knew?”
“Of course!”
Gu Santong just woke up, still pale but quite happy, “Is there anything I don’t know about you? Ever since you had Shangguan Yulin sent to give me some nonsense signal, I knew that it wasn’t meant for me. We never had private code phrases. What’s that stuff about a gentleman’s promise and wanting to save me anyway? I knew then and there it was for that old guy’s ears, he-he-he. Too bad Baili Jingwei and Shangguan Feiyun had no clue whatsoever, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Yep, the signal was for Danqing Shen, though I was still skeptical if he’d help or not. The most uncertain part of my plan was whether the old guy would play ball for the greatest deceptive outcome ever. His sword was savage and powerful, but scattered on impact, shaking the space around and hiding us from Shangguan Feiyun’s senses. I used this chance to activate Divine Eye of the Void 6th stage, Void Domain, and hid us in a pocket space. It also helped cement the idea of our demise to Baili Jingwei and leave the area.”
“And what if the old guy didn’t help us?” Gu Santong asked.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “The idea was to make an opening for Danqing Shen to strike by becoming heavily wounded in three clashes with Shangguan Feiyun. Next was up to him. If he was going to help, he was sure to speak up. If not, I’d have no choice but to resort to a Dragon Breath Pill. But then everything went south when Shangguan Feiyun struck me so hard that I couldn’t even move, making throwing the Dragon Breath Pill useless. There was only one way of getting out of there alive. Thank god the old guy was still nice. I finally get it now, there’s no ‘man proposes, god deposes,’ not when you have enough friends. More friends means more lives, he-he.”
“Why all the hassle, dad? Just throw him a Dragon Breath Pill to his face and be done.”
“Young Sanzi, we only have two of them.”
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes, “It’s easy to kill them all with one, but then what? With a Prime Minister and a Sword King dead, the Sword Star Empire will then send the other seven Sword Kings after us. That’ll be the end of us. Even with one Dragon Breath Pill left, can we get them all?”
“Young Sanzi, no matter what a man does, even if it’s wrong, he has to suffer the consequences. Using the Dragon Breath Pill will end with us being hunted down and killed. We’re not the Shangguan clan, we have no one to shield us. The central area’s Genesis Stage experts can’t handle them even if found. We, on the other hand, are finished. That’s why a trump card like that can’t be used unless it’s the only one available. We’re not on Invincible Sword’s level so we can’t use it to mow down grunts.”
Young Sanzi nodded, but then muttered, “But you used one on Universal Righteous Sect and only got two now. Dad, didn’t you mow them down?”
“Uh…”
Zhuo Fan flushed from being stuck, “Men are impulsive. I just wanted to know its power, that’s all, ha-ha-ha…”

chapters.title: Chapter 944: Bane
chapters.content:
Chapter 944: Bane
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Father and son were having the time of their lives by themselves in that dark cave. Every now and then, Zhuo Fan had to wince and gasp from having pain stab his every wound for being too much into their game and ignoring his heavy condition yet found it passing faster by cursing their savior each time.
“Damn rotten Danqing Shen, you just couldn’t take it easier! Just that sword aura was enough to flay my skin. The old coot never heard of a softer touch!”
Danqing Shen’s rage would’ve blown sky high, only if he was here of course.
[Damn punk, I just saved your pathetic life and this is the thanks I get, being called names?]
Gu Santong had a grin on his pale face, thoroughly enjoying his dad’s lively and childish act.
“Young Sanzi, how are you feeling? I’m now too wounded to tend to your situation, but once I’m better, I’ll get you back on your feet in no time!” Zhuo Fan hurriedly asked.
Gu Santong’s smile fell for a second, shaking his head, “Dad, it’s fine. I’m just feeling weakened and the wounds are healing. The Shangguan clan gave me plenty of healing pills.”
“That’s great. Even their poor pills, unlike mine, can help your wounds, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan chuckled, at ease.
Gu Santong’s smile soon turned upside down, taken by melancholy. Zhuo Fan could tell that it was different with the other hand as the blood was still seeping out despite the tight wrap around it…
Rumble~
The stone door opened, breaking the heavy silence. Shangguan Qingyan and the same youth Zhuo Fan grabbed back in the wasteland entered. The girl saw them waking up and cheered, “You’re up!”
“Thanks for the save.” Zhuo Fan smiled.
Shangguan Qingyan smiled back, coming over to him and looking concerned, “Mister Gu, your body is a wreck. Are you sure it’s fine? We’ve used many pills and while your other wounds healed…”
“You don’t have to worry about it. I’m an alchemist too. As long as my soul is fine, the flesh can be mended.”
Zhuo Fan’s hand shone and a vial came out, taking out a green pill.
The thick aroma was intoxicating, making the other clansman cry out, “By god, using a 10th grade pill just for some flesh wounds? An alchemist is a different breed than our clan.”
“Ha-ha-ha, it’s only for the common ones, while young Sanzi will need a more particular solution. That’s why I need to get back in shape to make him the right pill.”
Zhuo Fan ate the pill and used the Returning Dragon’s Roar.
As dragons roared about, Zhuo Fan was brimming with vitality. The Returning Dragon’s Roar was the best thing when it came to patching up the body. A shame it didn’t work on souls as well.
With the healing pill complementing the Returning Dragon’s Roar, the two watched in shock as Zhuo Fan’s wounds barely closed at all.
Zhuo Fan then felt a stabbing pain from every inch of his body.
Zhuo Fan looked down with a frown.
[What’s with these weird wounds that can’t heal? They feel the same as the one Vaulting Sword gave me back in Double Dragon Manor…]
The Shangguan clansman chuckled, “Mister Gu, you must’ve been hit by Dragon Cleaving Sword King’s Dragon Cleaving Art. Despite the difference between his sword art and ours, they both come from insights in a divine sword. Wounds inflicted by such weapons will be hard to heal. I still thought you’d need ten more days before you could stand. It’s a miracle you are doing this now. An 11th grade alchemist sure heals fast, ha-ha-ha…”
“Wounds from those sword arts heal slowly?!”
Zhuo Fan soon came to his own conclusion as to why. The wound Vaulting Sword inflicted back then took ages to heal too.
Since Danqing Shen’s art came from the Vaulting Sword, which hurt him.
[Does that mean the sword art captured the divine sword’s essence?]
Regardless of doubts, this was the conclusion he came to. Common folk being around a sacred weapon for long enough, they’d have its sword energy used for their cultivation, facilitating not only their training in a godlike sword art, but also unleashing greater power when using it.
It was top-notch regardless of the stage it was used in. [Is it maybe the power of the Sword Sovereign?]
Deep in thought, the casual movement of his right reminded him of the pain and winced. The pain coming from his body earlier subsided after using the pill and the Returning Dragon’s Roar. The issue now was the right hand.
Shangguan Qingyan took his right hand and complained, “Easy, we’ve just bandaged it but the bleeding won’t stop…”
Zhuo Fan shook, seeing as the wrap was dyed red.
“Young miss, Shangguan Feiyun’s Soaring Sword Art must’ve caused the wound on his right. Anyone else would have their heal slowly, but this is so baffling that no pill works. The bandage is only temporary and if this continues, he’ll bleed out.”
The Shangguan guy explained.
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, looking at his right in fright. He felt his forehead and, though wounded, did not bleed, healing slowly.
Shangguan Feiyun caught his gesture and said, baffled, “Mister Gu, I looked over your condition. The wounds on your right arm have to be from Shangguan Feiyun’s sword. The strange thing is, it just won’t heal, while the shoulder heals the same as the rest of you. I’d almost thought Shangguan Feiyun’s sword was stronger than Danqing Shen’s.”
“It’s the Qilin arm…”
Zhuo Fan’s eyelids shook, coming to a conclusion. “That’s why the Soaring Sword Art at Soul Harmony Stage could pierce it. The secret lies with Soaring Sword and Soaring Qilin. The Soaring Sword and, in turn, the Soaring Sword Art targets the Soaring Qilin in particular. That means young Sanzi…”
Zhuo Fan felt sharp pain as he rushed to young Sanzi’s side, holding the bandaged arm that was bleeding just like his.
Shangguan Qingyan gasped, hurrying to change the binding, “Young Sanzi is bleeding again. We have to stop it!”
“Young miss, that’s only a symptom. They are both so strange, unable to heal the areas struck by the Soaring Sword Art.”
The Shangguan guy shook his head.
Shangguan Qingyan wouldn’t give up, looking after young Sanzi with teary eyes, “Even if it doesn’t heal, we have to do all we can. Having not even reached the Ethereal Stage, they’ll die for good and won’t come back.”
“Young Sanzi, why didn’t you tell me?”
Zhuo Fan balled his fists and clenched his teeth. Being in the Ethereal Stage, Zhuo Fan would have halted cultivation, at worst, but he’d live. Young Sanzi was a sacred beast by comparison, with their body and soul as one. When one died, the other followed, and there was nothing to bring him back.
Young Sanzi’s bleeding condition was potentially deadly…
Young Sanzi teared up, his pale lips trembling, “Dad, I felt ever since the Soaring Sword Art hurt me that I met my bane. I can barely hold on. I didn’t want to worry you…”
“Why didn’t you say anything? I’m your dad, I’m supposed to worry!”
Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth, taking out a vial from his ring and revealed two 11th grade pills.
Under the Shangguan guy’s gasp, Zhuo Fan took one and gave young Sanzi the other, “Listen, this is from when I refined to save Shangguan Qingyan. She had been hurt by the Soaring Sword Art as well. It worked on her and now we’ll see if it works on us as well. If all else fails, I’ll take you back to western lands.”
“Western lands?” Gu Santong jumped.
Zhuo Fan nodded with resolve, “We’ll ask those old coots to save you. They have to know a way. So just hold on, young Sanzi…”

chapters.title: Chapter 945: Back to Western Lands
chapters.content:
Chapter 945: Back to Western Lands
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Hum~
With the ingestion of the pill, Zhuo Fan and Gu Santong flashed green, meditating to work its power to heal their wounds through their body, especially that bleeding arm.
The green energy gathered on the wound but that was it. It just could not go deeper and work its magic as something was keeping it away, soon fading out.
With a soaked brow, Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth and his nails dug into his palms.
Shangguan Qingyan was looking very worried from the side.
Hum~
With a ripple, Zhuo Fan resorted to force, using Yuan Qi and the healing energy to slam into the wound, all he hit was a wall. But as he kept pushing, the green energy seeped ever so slowing into the wound and began to heal it.
As it improved, the bleeding slowed to a stop.
Shangguan Qingyan lit up with joy. Zhuo Fan eased a breath and looked at his Qilin arm with a nod.
[This pill has some use…]
Zhuo Fan turned to young Sanzi with hope, only to find despair.
Gu Santong’s arm looked to have improved, but it was marginal. The bleeding had slowed down, but not completely, his life was still in a very real danger.
Shangguan Qingyan gasped, “Mister Gu, you managed to heal so why is young Sanzi…”
Zhuo Fan was in a constant frown, feeling bleak inside as the worst case crept among his thoughts.
[The Soaring Sword Art may be Qilin’s bane. The two conflicting energies can’t be resolved with pills alone. I fear that only a sacred beast can heal another sacred beast.]
[I can only take him to Kunpeng and dragon ancestor in western lands. The question is if I’ll reach them in time. I only have a Qilin arm and since the rest of me is human, the Soaring Sword Art isn’t so harsh on me. Just who can save you?]
Zhuo Fan has made up his mind, holding Gu Santong in his arms and walking out.
“Mister Gu, where are you going?” Shangguan Qingyan asked, taken aback.
Zhuo Fan spoke, “To western lands to save him. Only western lands has someone that can heal him.”
“Western lands…”
Shangguan Qingyan muttered, “But Mister Gu, you’re still hurt. Let us take you.”
“No time!” Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth, “And staying with you will only get more dangerous. It’s better if I go alone with young Sanzi.”
Zhuo Fan had pointed out to Baili Jingwei that the Shangguan clan had the Soaring Sword. Regardless of ever being able to stop them and get it back, Baili Jingwei would still take precautions.
The Shangguan clan was bound to be running around the central area for the next while and might even resort to fighting central area’s experts a few times. The two were too hurt, with the son in critical condition, to join the chaos. It would only make it worse.
Zhuo Fan barely got away from Baili Jingwei so why would he go looking for more trouble?
Zhuo Fan had come to a firm decision to leave the Shangguan clan.
Shangguan Qingyan watched his straight back and sighed.
She wanted him to stay, but she knew he’d do anything to save young Sanzi. There was nothing she could say to keep them here.
The rollercoaster of emotions she was feeling had her forget why the Shangguan clan saved them in the first place. It was all to finish the last part of their deal.
So while her love-addled brain refused to work, the Shangguan guy next to her had no such handicap, crying out, “Mister Gu, we won’t keep you if you want to leave, but you have to first give the divine sword you promised us…”
Whoosh~
A clank cut him off as a scarlet sword stabbed into the bedrock.
Zhuo Fan had then vanished with Gu Santong.
“It’s good that we got the sword, or I don’t know how I could’ve explained this to Clan Head, ha-ha-ha…” The guy held the sword in pride and said, “Young miss, we should go see Clan Head.”
Shangguan Qingyan was too overwhelmed to register his words, still staring in empty space, where Zhuo Fan had been standing.
He didn’t even say goodbye, not so much as look at her…
Three days later found the Shangguan clan’s three hundred meditating in a quiet forest in white robes.
Shangguan Feixiong was frowning with worry, letting heavy breaths yet never speaking up.
Pa!
A thick hand grabbed his shoulder, startling him, “High Venerable, what can I do for you?”
“It’s nothing. But seeing you eaten up inside these days… Are you worried?” The old man smiled.
Shangguan Feixiong nodded, “Despite lacking danger, it’s the juniors’ first mission. I just can’t rest easy knowing the kid didn’t want me to send some experts instead of youngsters.”
“The kid is sharp. With our experts around him, he figured they’d settle the score, ha-ha-ha.”
High Venerable shook his head, “Feixiong, you believed him when he swore on his son, so why the needless worry?”
“I do believe him, but no one says incidents can’t happen…”
Whoosh~
The sudden sound reached his ears and his eyes lit up. He saw dozens of figures in the air, the juniors he sent for Zhuo Fan. In the lead was the apple of his eye, Shangguan Qingyan.
Shangguan Feixiong’s worries over these days finally eased.
The rest of the experts gathered around the juniors, eager to know the result.
Shangguan Feixiong rushed to Shangguan Qingyan to ask, “How did it go? Did you get the Soaring Sword?”
Shangguan Qingyan sighed and left with a lowered head.
The rest felt uneasy.
[Why is young miss so glum? Did the kid die and leave no trace of the Soaring Sword?]
[Why then did they took so long to come back?]
“Clan Head, here is the Soaring Sword!”
The guy who was with Shangguan Qingyan around Zhuo Fan bowed and presented the scarlet longsword.
Ha-ha-ha lit up and touched the blade, “Ha-ha-ha, it really is the Soaring Sword! Our mission is a success and we can go home to eastern lands!”
Everyone cheered and jumped in joy.
“Then what’s with that girl having a long face? I thought you failed for a second there, ha-ha-ha…” Shangguan Feixiong eased a breath and glanced at his daughter looking depressed by a pond.
The Shangguan guy bowed again, “I believe it’s because of Mister Gu that young miss…”
He explained everything that transpired and everyone looked stunned.
“You’re saying he’s alive?”
Shangguan Feixiong’s eyes shook, “He actually came out alive from not just two Sword Kings but the Prime Minister of this empire?”
They were aware of Zhuo Fan’s plan and how reality followed its every step, but to actually achieve the last and hardest part alive was inconceivable.
They found it far more believable for Zhuo Fan to die and leave clues for the divine sword instead. This made the news of Zhuo Fan’s flawless execution of the plan a total shock…

chapters.title: Chapter 946: Solitude
chapters.content:
Chapter 946: Solitude
Proofreader
: Papatonks
The guy paused, seeing everyone wearing dumb looks, and bowed again, “Clan Head, Gu Yifan is wise and brave, a real hero. When we found him, he was still protecting his son despite the heavy wounds.”
“His character isn’t the issue here, but being a miracle worker is!”
Shangguan Feixiong’s face twitched and sighed, “A single Sword King has enough power to do everything he wants. Two of them around, they are invincible. Then there’s Baili Jingwei, the wisest in the Sword Star Empire. His intellect alone could make him a Sword King if it was strength instead. Yet none of them, despite covering every aspect, could stop a Radiant Stage from toying with them and come out alive…”
Shangguan Feixiong sighed, actually relating to them, “Since when could the opponent we feared so much could be controlled so easily? What’s worse, can’t any of the experts of our best clan in the eastern lands match to one Radiant Stage kid? Ha-ha-ha, what an utterly ridiculous joke! The cruel irony is even more obvious from how we lost so many people with our plan while the kid easily got the sword without losing anything, ha-ha-ha…”
Shangguan Feixiong shook his head hard, in defeat.
The precious divine sword they all wanted so much all this time was now in their hands but it felt flat, dull, giving them no sense of achievement whatsoever.
It was because of the circumstances of the retrieval. The Soaring Sword wasn’t recovered through their blood and sweat, but a kid did it and sold it off to them. They not once won against Shangguan Feiyun. It was the kid all along who did everything, fighting, toying and surviving.
Shangguan Feiyun was the Shangguan clan’s biggest traitor, but the victory belonged to a kid’s resourcefulness.
None of them were better than a meager Radiant kid.
Clan Head’s desolate figure holding the divine sword, killed everyone else’s joy.
They felt nothing from it, not when another scored a win and just handed it over. It was a subtle contrast between taking and receiving the win that made all the effort worthwhile.
By taking it yourself, you proved that you had the ability to do it, while having someone just hand it over was a humiliation. It proved the other guy was better than you, being thrown to the side by the enemy and focusing on the better adversary.
Such a win felt empty to them, having no value.
They believed Shangguan Feiyun’s group, when they fought, did not show any regard to them, always thinking about Gu Yifan.
[Shangguan clan? They’re nothing…]
Gu Yifan, a Radiant Stage kid, came around out of nowhere and robbed the Shangguan clan of their honor.
Sure he got the Soaring Sword for them, but they didn’t look quite as thankful…
The three venerables knew their feelings and chuckled, “Feixiong, the Soaring Sword is back where it belongs. We now should focus on leaving the central area. Name, reputation, glory, they come and go many times in life.”
“As a Clan Head I know none of these are important before the clan’s righteousness. We’re lucky to have suffered a few losses this time, ending with our win. I am very happy to see this, but…”
Shangguan Feixiong tensed and sighed, “Having thought about everything that happened, I can’t help but wonder if I’m fit to be the Clan Head. Feiyun was right, I’m beneath him in power and potential. I’m headstrong and can’t see the bigger picture, unable to be proactive like Gu Yifan and Baili Jingwei. Their convoluted and intricate plans opened my eyes at how deep their schemes can go, of how detailed they are.
“I think that the next time we clash with Baili Jingwei, I will cause the death of everyone. I, Shangguan Feixiong, am plain, with no outstanding quality. Will keeping this chair of mine help or lead to disaster? Ha-ha-ha, the clan might not grow much under my helm. I’ve seen Gu Yifan’s handiwork, his cruelty. No low is beneath him, even detonating someone, but one can’t deny the results either. Having him as a son-in-law might not be such a bad idea. Leaving him to take over from me will raise the clan to new heights. At least he’s far more capable than me…”
The venerable looked him in the eye, “Feixiong, we all knew there’s a limit to what you can do, but do you know why we picked you?”
“The choice was between me and Feiyun. But he was too conceited and erred constantly…” Shangguan Feixiong frowned.
The venerable chuckled, “Everyone makes mistakes. You think we didn’t let him take the seat because of some mishaps? We even had a long dispute back then over Shangguan Feiyun’s talents…”
“Why then…”
The venerable smiled, “The ruler is to be wise and not rash, average and not proud. The former is for the royal succession to avoid vies for power. The latter is to avoid the biggest faults in one’s character. Average people hardly achieve success, but they also represent stability. They need but find a capable official to assist and they can thrive. As for the egotistic rulers, they think themselves above everyone, that they can do everything and won’t ever take advice. They can take the clan out of trouble, yes, but one day it might lead it to disaster. That is why an emperor would always choose the average son over the proud one if there’s no one talented and having virtue. Virtue has always been the main criteria for all ancestors.”
Shangguan Feixiong nodded, “I see. You were afraid Feiyun’s arrogance would lead to the clan’s demise so you renounced him. Then what of Gu Yifan’s virtue…”
“The kid’s virtue ain’t bad.” The venerable waved Shangguan Feixiong’s question with a vague smile.
Shangguan Feixiong jerked, “Second Venerable, you mean he has it? How come I don’t see it?”
“Ha-ha-ha, if you could, you’d have seen Shangguan Yulin’s degenerate character. Feixiong, you can’t judge a book by its cover. He may behave cruelly, but deep down he’s a man of principles. Don’t lump cruelty with being insidious. Insidiousness always strays you from the path, but his path stretches far and wide. “
The venerable smiled, “He may be cruel and unscrupulous, but everything has a purpose. He was only after his goal when he clashed with us, but did nothing despicable. Think about it, did he forgo righteousness for gains? Did he go back on his words? And most importantly, he’s a loving father that would do anything for his son. How bad can he be? Well, I’ve seen people far worse than him, looking dignified but resorting to atrocities when no one’s looking. Such a kind and dark youth is worth making friends with, better than those insidious and petty ones.”
Shangguan Feixiong nodded after a pause.
“Yeah, the kid only clashed with us in our goal. But all he said and done is to my liking. He’s like a demonic gentleman. Then my plan…”
“Feixiong, you should just forget it.”
The venerable cut him off, “It’s not a bad idea to have him as your son-in-law. He’d also benefit the clan by having him around, but not the Clan Head.”
“Why? He’s far more qualified than me. Is it because of his scheming…”
“No, his scheming is very much within reason. He’s in conflict with our beliefs, as he walks the demonic path, regardless of how upright he is.”
The venerable said, “It’s just that he walks in solitude, unfit for a Clan Head.”
“Solitude?”
“He has no ties with anything but his son, let alone a clan. He can’t take the helm of a clan.”
The venerable sighed, “A Clan Head bears on his shoulder the fate of his people, holding within him their lives and deaths. But he is alone, without such responsibility. He is indeed capable, but not fit for a Clan Head. As for being like Baili Jingwei, governing the empire, or a Clan Head’s right hand, there’s no one better.”
Shangguan Feixiong nodded after digesting his words.
He bore too much solitude to carry the weight of a leader, a loner meant to roam the world.
But a cultivator communing with the world had such a quality as well. While too many mundane affairs hindered one’s comprehension of the inner workings of the world.
[Doesn’t that mean it’s us who’re led astray from the straight and narrow?]

chapters.title: Chapter 947: Sword Patriarch Appears
chapters.content:
Chapter 947: Sword Patriarch Appears
Proofreader
: Papatonks
The sky was sifting large snowflakes as far as one could see, dyeing the world in shades of white.
A month had gone since Zhuo Fan’s battle, with autumn making way for winter with its cold snow in the Flying Cloud City.
Danqing Shen watched the heavy gray clouds outside, peaceful as they filled the air with snowflakes, covering the sun’s every ray of warmth. Despite the glum outside, he was sitting cozily by a lively fire in a lavish room sipping his delectable tea with a most conspicuous smirk.
“Ol’ Dan, when little old me’s in trouble, please look after me.”
“Boy, I didn’t do it for you.”
“I won’t make it hard on sir’s old bones. All I ask is for you to strike hard and I shall find life in death.”
“Ah?”
[Ha-ha-ha, boy, where are you now, I wonder? Winter has come and I’m sure even aiming my sword away from you still gave you no light injuries. Dragon Cleaving Art’s power isn’t something you can heal. Look after yourself in these winter days.]
Recalling their promise, Danqing Shen sipped his wine, yet joy danced in his eyes.
[The boy has been suspicious of me till the end, going as far as sending someone to remind me in Shangguan Feiyun’s hidden room. Ha-ha, how pointless.]
“Dragon Cleaving Sword King, you’re in a good mood. Mind sharing with me so I could enjoy it too? I’ve hardly ever saw Dragon Cleaving Sword King smile, ha-ha-ha…”
Rows of guards entered, bowing and making way for Baili Jingwei in fur clothing. He made himself at home, sitting right next to Danqing Shen with a smile.
Shangguan Feiyun came next, sitting nearby, sticking one leg over the other, looking bored to death, “Brother Dan, share with us this fine mood you’re having. This past month, if not dull, it has been glum.”
“Ha-ha-ha, getting your paradise ruined and the divine sword taken tends to do that.”
Danqing Shen took out a jade slip, “Here’s my report on my domain. There were signs of the Shangguan clan around and I have come to ask for the next course of action.”
[What?!]
Shangguan Feiyun snatched the jade slip and cried, “Those old fools ran off to your side of the empire? But that leads to northern lands. What are they doing there?”
“They must be taking the long way around, through northern lands.” Baili Jingwei’s eyes flashed and resumed sipping tea by the fire’s cozy warmth.
Shangguan Feiyun followed, “Prime Minister, what do we do?”
“Nothing.”
Baili Jingwei sighed, “The Central area is just too large and gives the Shangguan clan too many places to hide. I had notified the Nine Sword Kings to look out for them in their domains, but without concrete signs to look for, they’ll find nothing. Furthermore, with some Sword Kings’ laid back attitude, some not even present in their domains, things would only get harder.”
“Prime Minister Baili, I’m here, aren’t I…”
“Dragon Cleaving Sword King, I wasn’t talking about you, but that Wine Sword Immortal that loves to hit the bottle.” Baili Jingwei’s eyes flashed and gnashed his teeth, “He’s a Sword King but all he does is partake in local beverages at every chance instead of leading his domain. How damn superficial! He even makes trips to other lands too, humph. Just what was the point of giving that domain to him? At least with Shangguan clan’s faint traces, even around he won’t be of much use.”
Danqing Shen grinned, “I have to say I admire that old guy, so free and casual. Brother Feiyun, he’ll be back in a few days. Want to ask him out for a drink? Maybe he got back some good stuff from where he’s been.”
“You go, I’m not in the mood.”
Shangguan Feiyun gave an impatient wave, “Just how did you manage to do it anyway?”
Danqing Shen raised an eyebrow, “How else? When they asked me how to do it I told them to play dumb. The Shangguan clan came here en masse and with three old coots strong enough to face a Sword King, so while I wasn’t around, they were bound to die if they pushed them. So they just let them go.”
“Why you…”
Shangguan Feiyun’s face twitched, turning to the other, “Prime Minister, see that? He’s lazy at his job. When the Invincible Sword comes along, I’ll be sure to tell him!”
Glancing at him, Baili Jingwei chuckled, “I advise Sword King against pettiness for I’m with Dragon Cleaving Sword King on this.”
“What?!”
“Doing something pointless is utterly idiotic!”
Taking his teacup, Baili Jingwei took a sip and drawled, “Looking for the Shangguan clan was just a matter of appearances, never intent on following through. What’s the point of handing them the lives of hundreds of people? We lost, pure and simple. There’s no shame in it. Now we need to get ready for the Patriarch’s admonishment…”
“Report!”
A guard barged in and presented a jade slip, “Prime Minister, imperial capital summons you!”
“A summon?”
Baili Jingwei smiled and took the jade slip, “I’ve been away for three months and His Majesty wants me back? Ha-ha-ha, I hardly get any vacation time like this. There are so many places I haven’t seen yet. Sigh, no rest for the wicked. Just what got the imperial capital so on the edge they need me to solve it…”
[How pretentious can you be? The empire can’t go a single day without you!]
Shangguan Feiyun’s mouth twitched and revealed a crooked smile, “Prime Minister, politics sure keep you busy. Without sir in the empire, the sun loses its shine, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Jingwei caught his jab, but chose to ignore it as he read the summons with an unspeakable calm. Though minutes later, he winced and cried, “What?”
“What happened?” Shangguan Feiyun flinched.
Baili Jingwei said, “Patriarch has come out and is calling court with the Nine Sword Kings and all officials. He wants to move in on northern lands!”
“Invincible Sword is out?”
Shangguan Feiyun and Danqing Shen cried out at the same time, “The world will be in turmoil soon.”
“What do you mean?”
“Uh, followed by prosperity I mean, ha-ha-ha…” At Baili Jingwei’s long look, Shangguan Feiyun and Danqing Shen gave a dry laugh.
Baili Jingwei shook his head, “I’ll ignore it this time, but please watch your words, Sword Kings. You are the revered Nine Sword Kings of the central area, the cornerstones of the Sword Star Empire. If the empire is flourishing, so are you. If the Patriarch is powerful, so are you. Above all else, never treat Patriarch as your adversary. While I do understand the urge in practitioners to find worthy opponents to test their mettle, a house divided against itself cannot stand. Understood?”
The two nodded.
With how little impact he had on these strong Sword Kings, Baili Jingwei did not press the issue, shouting instead, “Guard, prepare to return to the imperial capital! I and the Sword Kings are going to greet the Patriarch!”
“Yes, sir!”
A man bowed and rushed to work. Baili Jingwei spoke again, “Also, I had you look for a reliable person from western lands. Did you find any?”
“Prime Minister, I have.”
“Then send him to western lands and keep an ear out for anything of note.” Baili Jingwei sighed.
Shangguan Feiyun asked, “Prime Minister, why are you sending someone to western lands? Can a single random guy slip through the lands’ defenses and arrays to spy?”
“I don’t need him to find me secrets, but a man’s background.”
“Who?”
“Gu Yifan!”
Baili Jingwei’s eyes flashed, “Gu Yifan has been a worthy opponent. Even though he died, I still want to know everything about him to remember him by. As a manipulator, he had very few pieces in his hands, and who knew, maybe if he were but a little bit stronger, he’d have won, ha-ha… “
Baili Jingwei did not finish his thought. Who was to say who came on top when two equal opponents collided?
Shangguan Feiyun spoke, “Gu Yifan has been nothing but cunning. He came to act against my manor, so there’s no way he would leave clues to his true identity.”
“The greatest lie isn’t based on just deception, but mixing lies and truths.”
Baili Jingwei spoke, “Gu Yifan is a clever guy and I’m sure he didn’t give me only lies, for it would’ve made him too suspicious. It’s especially easy to be exposed when lying about local customs and products. While his name might be fake, his origin isn’t. And with his smarts, there’s no way he’s unknown in the western lands. So I want to find who he was, just what kind of man could hold his own against me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 948: A Time of Need
chapters.content:
Chapter 948: A Time of Need
Proofreader
: Papatonks
In a world of white, with snow piling up incessantly, dyeing everything in its pure color, even a mountain of a man would find that he would have to trudge along through waist deep snow to cross this place.
On this final month of the year, the earth’s vitality was subdued, with hardly any man venturing out in this harsh environment. Even a powerful cultivator would rather avoid such blizzards, not wanting to face the heavens and this desolate world of white.
Though in these particular parts, two lone figures, two mere specks in this sea of white, appeared on and off among the snowfall.
Crack~
Under the crumbling snow with every step, a thin man paused to readjust the young child on his back, puffing out white with every breath before resuming his trek.
He swayed under the biting winds, only to press harder and regain his stalwart stance.
The frail child looked at the bitter and icy world around him, then at the man’s body, toiling to carry him. He parted his cracked lips, sobbing, “Dad, I won’t make it. You’ve been making me 11th grade pills to slow the bleeding and recover my blood, hurting your already wounded soul in the process. Then you still insisted on carrying me for months. Now you can’t even fly. You can’t keep doing this. Dad, let me go and move on. My time is up. I don’t want to be a burden…”
“Quiet!”
The man panted and raised his waned face, only his eyes shining with unflinching determination. He just gritted his teeth and pressed on.
“Young Sanzi, listen up. I am your dad and I won’t have this. No matter what, I’ll get you back to the western lands alive, so those two can heal you.”
“But the western lands is so far away. How can we reach it in time? Dad, you can’t go on doing this either.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shook, moving on by sheer stubbornness, “Even if I have to walk all the way, I’ll still make it. We don’t need to keep moving much longer. In half a month we’ll reach Goldbough City. There’s a teleportation array to every land there we can use. We’ll be back to western lands before you know it.”
“Teleportation array?”
Gu Santong shook his head bitterly, “Dad, you know as well as I do that the five lands teleportation array is split into official and commercial routes. The official one belongs to the Sword Star Empire and we couldn’t use it even when we arrived in the central area. This won’t change now. And the commercial route belongs to the biggest merchant union in all the lands, ignoring any politics involved between them. To use their teleportation array we need the consent of the leader in each land first. How are we going to pass their questioning when we’re supposed to lay low?”
Zhuo Fan squinted, his brow shaking, but his eyes were firm, “With me around, I’ll definitely use it!”
Zhuo Fan took a heavy step and as the sweat built up, he not once stopped from rushing.
“Dad… you’re the best…”
Feeling Zhuo Fan’s kind and wide back, Gu Santong teared up, sobbing and slowly falling silent from feeling so weak. Blood trickled down his hand and onto the pure white snow, taking with it just a bit more of his vitality, leaving him defenseless against the elements, with the coldness seeping in.
Unaware of young Sanzi’s situation and oblivious to his last words, Zhuo Fan’s mind was set in one direction, to push on.
Eyes flashing, Zhuo Fan took step after step, trudging forward slowly and leaving deep marks behind.
Four hours of toil brought Zhuo Fan to gasping, but nothing deterred him from walking. Only in the sixth hour Zhuo Fan’s foot began to slip, barely able to raise it for another step. Even relying on his weight to push away the snow no longer helped as it did.
In the tenth hour, Zhuo Fan was at a turning point, fully spent. His mind was willing but the body hardly made any progress, numb and cold. His spirit had been so tense and focused all this time that it finally gave in, rendering him unconscious.
Gu Santong had fallen asleep a long time ago, his tender face growing hard as coldness sapped his warmth and the slow dripping of blood from his arm seemed to announce the end was nigh.
The howling wind never ceased, the biting snow never stopped blocking the two’s hard journey, soon burying them in white. It did not take long before any sign of their passing was gone, and the same went for them, erased by nature’s cold embrace.
The world was a cruel place, swallowing every being alike. All of us were nothing but visitors on this plane, bound to return in its arms…
…
Rumble~
A carriage with huge wheels was pulled by three twenty-meter tall spiritual beasts, actually stomping through the thick snow with relative ease. These were 3rd level spiritual beasts, having no trouble galloping through this harsh weather.
Inside the carriage were thin curtains along with the fragrance from an incense burner lingering about, hiding the pretty figure inside, unmarred by the bleak desolation outside.
“Halt!”
As the carriage stormed through the snow, a loud voice came from within the carriage.
The three spiritual beast stopped on the spot.
“Young miss, what is it?”
A young voice asked.
“Zhui’er, is there blood outside?”
“Blood?”
The curtain was lifted to reveal a charming face of a seventeen year old girl. Her eyebrows were sharp, focused as she looked around, “Are you perhaps mistaken, young miss? There isn’t any.”
The first voice spoke again, “Zhui’er, go outside and check if they’ve been buried under the snow. They may be alive.”
“Ah?”
“Don’t ‘ah’ me! Do what I say. I’ve been a healer for so long the scent of blood is easily recognized. But with such heavy snowfall, they must be under it. Zhui’er, go already!” The voice was sweet but carried with it an irreproachable tone.
Shrugging, the girl jumped down and searched while complaining, “I’m going, damn. What a young miss you are.”
“What was that?”
“Uh, nothing, nothing at all. Ah, I found someone!” As she pushed away the snow, Zhui’er suddenly cried out, plunging her thin arms into the snow and pulling two people out.
Seeing the blood on the ground, Zhui’er shouted, “Young miss, you have such a sharp nose. There were two people buried in snow. The older one seems frozen while the younger one is bleeding, close to dying…”
“Bleeding in such bitter cold?”
The rushed voice from within said, “Zhui’er, get them inside, hurry! The little one must be gravely wounded. I have to heal him.”
“Right away!”
Zhui’er was about to act but then paused, “But young miss, they’re male. It’s not right to have them in your magnificent carriage. No man has yet to step foot in it. It’s fine if its the child but…”
“There’s no time to mind the rules, lives are at stake!” The tone coming from inside went cold.
Zhui’er bobbed her head and threw the two inside. She jumped in herself and the carriage resumed its mad dash. All that remained was a stain of scarlet in a world of white, slowly fading beneath the endless snow…

chapters.title: Chapter 949: Immortal Healer Murong Xue
chapters.content:
Chapter 949: Immortal Healer Murong Xue
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Zhui’er threw the frozen father and son into the warm carriage, before a thin curtain, “Young miss, here they are. Only the child’s blood is dripping on the tapestry. What a shame.”
“Nothing is more precious than life. The tapestry can just be cleaned later.” A scarlet thread slipped from behind the curtain and grabbed Zhuo’s wrist and sent Yuan Qi through it.
Zhui’er grumbled, “Why would you care? You’re not the one washing it.”
“Zhui’er, is that another complaint I hear?
“No, nothing. Young miss is so magnanimous and kind, I could only work myself to the bone for young miss.” Zhui’er proclaimed her undying devotion on the spot.
The figure behind the curtain giggled, “Stop being so sour, girl, and try to be more serious. He only has some heavy wounds, overstraining himself and his Yuan Qi. Give him Yuan Qi pills and let him rest. He’ll then wake up.”
