“Yes, young miss!”
Zhuo Fan helped Zhuo Fan in swallowing an azure pill, but then said, “He’s in the Radiant Stage yet overworked himself? He’s no beginner cultivator that can’t control his strength.”
“It’s not always about control, but giving one’s every drop. It’s out of their control. The child must be why he’s been out in the snow.”
Whoosh~
The scarlet thread came out from behind the curtain once more, going for young Sanzi’s pale wrist this time.
Her voice was laced with shock at the discovery, “This child is strange! There are two energies inside clashing constantly and not letting his right hand stop bleeding. I have to stop the bleeding quickly before it’s too late. Zhui’er, a clotting pill!”
“Yes, young miss!”
Zhui’er sensed young miss’ urgency and restrained her playful nature as she fed Gu Santong without question.
The pill turned into a red stream that flowed through his body and to his wound. It never reached it, clashed into something inside and was forced to dissipate outside.
The bleeding did not stop, flowing harder now due to the violent reaction of the pill. The scarlet thread on young Sanzi’s wrist shook, sending a ripple behind the curtain.
The young miss cried out, “Since a 5th grade Hemostatic Pill doesn’t work, then use the 7th grade Hematoma Pill. The child won’t stop bleeding as long as those energies aren’t settled.”
“Yes, young miss!”
Zhui’er had never seen her young miss so distraught and fed young Sanzi the pill.
The result was the same even with the Hematoma Pill. The force was too strong for the pill to harden, forced out without any effect.
The consequence was even dire in this pill’s case, causing Gu Santong to bleed even harder.
All the effort Zhuo Fan spent these months, the toil he went through to make the pills and slow down young Sanzi’s bleeding, were all thrown away here and now.
The road to hell is paved with good intentions.
Zhuo Fan would surely scream himself hoarse at this idiotic pair.
[Don’t do anything if you don’t understand it! You’re killing a child!]
The two girls were blissfully unaware of the child’s severe condition. Watching things get even worse, the girl and the young miss started to panic.
The young miss started demanding frantically and the girl fed many pills to young Sanzi.
All ended the same, with young Sanzi’s blood flowing in torrent now and dyeing the tapestry scarlet.
Zhui’er was losing it, “Young miss, what do we do? We’re only making it worse!”
“What’s going on with his wound? Nothing works!”
The young miss was grave, but then she exclaimed, “Did a divine sword harm the child? That can’t be it. Even those wounds aren’t as grave, slowly healing in the end. Just why is he showing no improvement?”
“Young miss, it doesn’t matter why. The older one might wake up any time now and how will I explain how his son just died? Though there’s nothing scary about a Radiant Stage…”
Zhui’er spoke with a sorrowful smile, “It’ll affect young miss’s eminent reputation. We should’ve just left them there.”
After a pregnant pause, the young miss spoke, “Saving a life is better than any fancy honor. SInce I have seen them, I can never turn a blind eye. Zhui’er, use the North Sea Gel on the child!”
“What?!”
Zhui’er gasped, “No no no, that’s too valuable to be wasted on simple flesh wounds. We paid too high a price and worked too hard to get so little of it from the northern lands. It’s meant for Clan Head’s use for emergencies. You can’t just use it on a stranger! It’s too much of a waste!”
The young miss was pondering this as well, but soon her firm voice came, “I, Immortal Healer Murong Xue, have not once have anyone die on me, and certainly no child! No matter how precious the gel is, it can be earned again, while the child only has one life. And with big brother’s strength, it’s hard to say when he’ll actually need it.”
“But won’t it be wasted if it ends up the same as the pills?”
“It’s never a waste to use spiritual herbs to save one’s life!”
Murong Xue was very detached from the material as she spoke, “Zhui’er, what are you waiting for? Are you the young miss here, or me?”
Zhui’er hesitated, totally against the idea, but young miss’ tone demanded obedience and she had no choice but to suck up her grumbling and take out a gourd. She let a transparent liquid drip out, releasing a sweet odor as it covered Gu Santong’s wounded arm.
By miracle, every place the liquid touched, the blood stopped leaking. Soon, the liquid covered the entire wound and hardened, keeping the blood inside.
The foreign energy inside the arm struggled to fight this interference only to be crushed without remorse by a sudden silvery light. The liquid had a faint silver glow as it seeped deeper into young Sanzi’s body, vanishing completely. Behind it was left young Sanzi’s pristine arm, unmarred by any scar or wound.
Zhui’er cheered, “Young miss, it worked! The child’s saved!”
“The North Sea Gel is a world wonder, a wonder drug for healing.” The young miss relaxed a breath.
The joy was short as Zhui’er recalled the loss of most of the gel and spoke sadly, “Ten million sacred spirit stones… down the drain. Clan Head is bound to flip at the news.”
“Ha-ha-ha, my brother is refined and won’t be angry knowing we saved a life.”
“I hope so. Ugh, ten million, sniff…” Zhui’er was still in pain over such bitter losses. She glanced over to the unconscious Zhuo Fan, “Hey, you owe us ten million sacred spirit stones! Don’t you ever forget it!”
A chuckle came from beyond the curtain, “Zhui’er, how can a Radiant Stage have such wealth? Kindness isn’t done for a reward. When he wakes up, we’ll send the father and son off.”
“Humph, they got it too good!”
Zhui’er pouted, “What kind of fortune did they have to stumble upon the young miss in their hour of most desperate need? Not just saving them, but for free too. It’s better to fleece them of everything once they wake up. We can’t have them think money falls out of the sky at every turn!”
Murong Xue smiled.
They were oblivious to the fact they had lent a helping hand to a Demon Archon, one who’s wealth belied his slovenly appearance.
He had so much on him that he could repay that North Sea Gel many times over, with room to spare…

chapters.title: Chapter 950: Filthy Rich
chapters.content:
Chapter 950: Filthy Rich
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Rumble~
The huge carriage was rushing through the snowy wasteland, shaking now and then Zhuo Fan who lay inside on the carpet.
Maybe one bump had been too hard to ignore, maybe his Yuan Qi reserves were back, all that it mattered was that he roused, his dried lips parting to speak weakly, “Young Sanzi, young Sanzi…”
Then he just bolted to his feet, shouting his son’s name in panic. He was filled with fear and regret of what might have happened.
He knew he just woke up from blacking out.
But what about young Sanzi? With no one to stop his bleeding or take him to western lands, his life would slip away with every drop of blood.
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook and clenched his fists. The regret inside him threatened to consume him whole. How could he just black out and leave his wounded son uncared for while he rested?
He was so consumed in his thoughts and feelings he failed to notice the missing cold and snow.
“God damn it! What’s with that racket? You scared me to death!” Another shout came that made him flinch.
Only now he took in his surroundings, the ever moving carriage. Across from him was a cute and lovely lady of seventeen.
She was holding an adorable boy of eight, who was looking pale and recovering.
Zhuo Fan eased a breath and scanned the place before asking the girl, “Miss, did you save us?”
“Why, you don’t like it? Then give me your life back!” Shooting him a look, the girl scoffed.
Zhuo Fan grumbled at the most rude reply. Guess he got used to always having the final say, always having the last word. Finally being on the receiving end had him stuck and irate.
The only reason she wasn’t a bloody smear on the carriage’s walls was for saving them.
[Thanks to the True Self Art, my violent tendencies had been curbed a lot over the past two years. You should be lucky you met me only now, humph!]
Zhuo Fan forced down his anger, strained a smile and cupped his hands, “Ha-ha-ha, I first want to thank you miss for all you’ve done. And may I ask what got you in such a bad mood? Do I owe you a fortune? Ha-ha-ha…”
“What do you think?”
Zhuo Fan was joking but hit the lass right where it hurt and made her more depressed and annoyed.
Startled, Zhuo Fan was even more baffled.
[I’ve only just met her so how could I owe her? By her extreme reaction, I must’ve really done something at some point.]
Zhuo Fan was perplexed but the girl just rolled her eyes at him in despair.
[Ten million, oh, ten million…]
The two were stuck in a complete tangent from another, with neither getting the other’s intentions. It was then Murong Xue’s soft voice came from beyond the curtain, “Zhui’er, act like a lady and not so stuck up. It’s been five days and you still aren’t over it?”
“Holy! Someone else is in here?”
Zhuo Fan jumped, now noticing the fourth presence. The sudden rousing and all that happened made him forget to scan the area.
From her voice, he could tell that she was the boss lady and this girl only the servant.
[Humph, what a pretentious maid.]
Zhuo Fan lost his early amiable air, looking coldly at Zhui’er, “I see, it’s your young miss that saved the two of us, not you. Why the sour look then? You didn’t do anything anyway, only using her name.”
Zhuo Fan saluted the curtain with all respect, “Thank you, young miss, for saving the two of us in our time of need.”
“You!”
Zhui’er was fuming mad and whined to Murong Xue, “Young miss, see who you worked so hard to save?”
“Zhui’er, it’s you who started it. Don’t blame others for your problems. Take it as a lesson and try not to do it again.”
Murong Xue scolded her maid and spoke coldly to Zhuo Fan, “Sir’s words weren’t propper either. As all life is equal, I do not need any reward for saving you. I only wish for you to be upright and do no evil, making my efforts worth it. Please don’t make me regret saving a demon.”
Ugh!
Zhuo Fan let out a dry laugh.
[I only just put the maid in her place and she’s calling me a demon. Then again, I’m certainly no saint, ha-ha.]
Zhui’er glared at him and turned the lecture on him, “Hear that? Young miss wants you to be nice later on, or we can take back your life any time we want to.”
“Ha-ha-ha, being nice is all up to me. You have saved me but don’t need to worry about it. As for taking back the life you just saved, only I decide how I go down.”
Zhuo Fan sneered with a glint in his eyes, “I, Z- Gu Yifan, never owed anyone any favors. I’ll make sure to return this grand gesture at the first chance. So thank you for all the trouble these days, but now it’s time to leave. May we meet again!”
Zhuo Fan grabbed Gu Santong’s hand and stunned the two with his actions.
Zhui’er was stumped by the nerve of this guy, having just been saved from certain death. Then he started being all cocky-like, as if it was these two’s endless glory for saving him!
Murong Xue was stunned and sighed, “Not nice at all.”
“Eh?”
Zhuo Fan exclaimed having noticed the smooth arm of Gu Santong, with not even a scar on it to show his past suffering, “W-what’s going on? Young Sanzi…”
Zhui’er found the leverage to snap back, “Young miss, in her infinite mercy, had brought this poor child back. He is unconscious but stable. What a pity, the young one is such an innocent creature, while the elder one is so vile. Young miss saved the wrong person.”
“Thank you!”
Zhuo Fan forwent his rude attitude and thanked, “I don’t matter, but you’ve done me a great favor for saving my son. Any request you may have, I will fulfill it, no questions asked.”
Murong Xue sook and nodded, “Sir is quite peculiar, but fond of his son. This proves your heart still has some good in it. My only reward is for you to come back on the straight and narrow.”
[Ugh, good?]
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched.
[I thought you were joking. I’ve been evil all my life. I have no clue what good is. How does it even work?]
“Young miss, he’s getting off too easy. Just look how cocky he was, it’d be a shame not to ask for anything.”
Luckily, Zhui’er stepped in to clarify it all, holding out her hand, “Since you wanna pay, then pay your fees.”
Zhuo Fan chuckled and nodded, “As it is right. How much?”
“Just a smidgen, ten million sacred stones.” Zhui’er sported a vile grin.
Zhuo Fan flinched, “Why so expensive? What kind of pills did you use?”
Not like he couldn’t pay, but that he was stunned. Even without the fees as an excuse, he’d still give ten million as it was only right.
Those dead rocks meant nothing when young Sanzi’s life was concerned.
Zhui’er misunderstood completely, of course, thinking so many zeros scared him and laughed, “You can’t, can you, you penniless! I bet you don’t even know what sacred stones look like. Then just give me all you have, even though it’s hardly anything of worth.”
“Zhui’er!” Murong Xue admonished.
Zhuo Fan spoke, “Miss Zhui’er, I can give you that much, but I’m curious what kind of drug you used that is so valuable. If it’s not the drug, then I can still pay it as favor for saving us.”
“You think we’re lying?”
Zhui’er huffed, taking out a gourd and showing it to him, “You know what’s inside? Miracle drug, North Sea Gel. If not, listen well. It’s a valuable recovery medicine even in northern lands. We had to spend ten million sacred stones to get this little and used almost all on your son. Isn’t it normal for you to pay at least that much?”
Sniffing the gourd, Zhuo Fan frowned.
North Sea Gel?
[There’s no mention of it in the Nine Serenities Secret Records. Is it from the mortal domain? But to save young Sanzi, it has to be miraculous.]
He smiled at Zhui’er, “Miss, since you only have a little left, give it to me for my son and I’ll give you twenty million to make up for it.”
“Ha-ha, twenty million? I bet you don’t have spirit stones as much.”
“That’s not the issue here. Will you accept?” Zhuo Fan asked.
Zhui’er raised her head, not believing a word, “Fine then, only a fool won’t take advantage of such a damn deal.”
“Give me your ring.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone and chuckled. Zhui’er did so and Zhuo Fan’s ring touched hers.
Zhuo Fan then took the gourd and his son and was off, laughing, “Miss Zhui’er, a deal’s a deal, bye!”
“Wait, I still haven’t checked…” Zhui’er cried out.
Murong Xue gasped, “What is it, Zhui’er?”
“Young miss, twenty million sacred stones are inside the ring. The guy is actually loaded…” Zhui’er was bug eyed, struck dumb by the glittering rocks in her ring…

chapters.title: Chapter 951: Greatest Merchant Union
chapters.content:
Chapter 951: Greatest Merchant Union
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Goldbough City, a name that implied wealth and riches, all gathered in one place.
There was some truth to the saying ‘money makes the world go round’. Most of the central area was under the imperial family and the officials’ control, with one exception. Goldbough City. The largest merchant union in the lands, Serene Shores Trading, held its main office in this very city, where even the imperial family wouldn’t get involved.
Couldn’t they, really?
Of course, it couldn’t be farther than the truth. This empire held so much power that it shocked the other four lands, let alone a tiny trading company. It didn’t matter how many ties you had across the world, or how much wealth, since with great power came greater wealth. Just how commoners didn’t fight with nobles, neither did they fight with high officials.
As to why a trading company controlled a city was all due to the empire’s permission. Even with the Sword Star Empire standing against the four other areas, it still relied on trade with them to exchange resources and local products with each other. In order to facilitate these trades, a neutral party was needed, the Serene Shores Trading in this case.
The empire gave it supreme power in linking the five lands, so it set up relations between all of them and played a pivotal role in any land.
Millennia later, through its subdued lust for power, never stepping into any land’s power struggle, it had earned the trust of every faction in the lands, opening their doors for its business. It led to a boom in revenue, growing larger and larger, becoming the main trade hub between the lands.
These last few hundred years in particular showed great expansion. It was all due to Baili Jingwei coming to governance. With his brilliant mind, he urged the trading with the rest of the lands to get bigger and faster, giving the Serene Shores Trading more power by building their own teleportation array within the lands to facilitate this.
Only the bold would take such a risk.
The minute the five lands teleportation array fell in another’s hands, they would lose control and could invade the empire’s heart from thousands of miles away. It also worked as a perfect retreat too, giving them an easy way to withdraw without losses.
That was why out of the central area, no other land had a teleportation array in the hands of another, even a trader. Only the higher ups of every land could activate a teleportation array to another land, so order could be maintained.
This showed just how bold Baili Jingwei was in giving so much power to a trading union.
It wasn’t done out of impulsiveness either, backed up by real power. The Sword Star Empire didn’t fear other lands’ spies, nor any kind of trouble they might stir here.
The central area had the Invincible Sword and only his defeat would crumble the central area. Which was impossible since he was way stronger than anyone else. You couldn’t kill him even with human wave tactics. Adding to that, the Nine Sword Kings stationed in their domain, and the central area became a connected hell. Even the best clan in eastern lands was feeling tense spending even one more day in this place. They were so close to getting shredded too.
Because of such indomitable backing, Baili Jingwei had an even easier time with politics, displaying his talent without fear or repercussions.
Be that as it may, the commercial teleportation array had its restriction. First, one had to wear the Serene Shores Trading’s badge and the other was to gain Goldbough City’s nominal lord’s approval, Baili Jingyu, a member of the imperial family. Lest the enemy took action while they were oblivious and taking this place for themselves.
As in any system, leaks always sprouted, even with this double safety net. Maybe the people were too confident in their empire, or they just didn’t care how the commercial line was used and trusting Serene Shores Trading completely, or maybe their contempt of the other lands had grown unchecked, regardless of the reason, the second safety net, Baili Jingyu, was so insipid and useless, he barely made for a good figurehead, always indulging himself and not to mention he had a lousy cultivation.
With the central area teeming with talent, the only reason the three century old Radiant Stage bag of bones got this job was thanks to being part of the imperial family.
I.e. he has the Patriarch watching his back.
It thus led to the Serene Shores Trading holding the real power in the Goldbough City.
Zhuo Fan did his homework on this city and was now standing before the grand and ostentatious gates with a weary Gu Santong on his back.
Gu Santong might have had his wound healed and some time to replenish his blood would’ve got him back on his feet, it just didn’t happen. He was still very weak and his energy just wouldn’t recover.
The countless pills Zhuo Fan gave him showed no effect either. It was like anything the child ate would be washed away without any result.
Zhuo Fan did not understand this condition, nor know how to fix it. So he stuck to the old plan, in taking him back to the two monsters in western lands.
They were the same type as Qilin, having been alive since antiquity, and should know what this ailment was.
To make this trip as smooth as possible, Zhuo Fan chose to use this five lands teleportation array and get young Sanzi home. At the very least, young Sanzi’s life wasn’t at risk.
On the bustling street filled with riders and carriages, a lone father blended with the crowd, looking all over the place as he went.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone at some point and grinned as he fixed his gaze on a lofty courtyard. Before it were two Soul Harmony experts standing guard, totally devoted to their duties like stone cold machines.
Above them was a most dazzling, flamboyant, and utter money-wasting sign he saw, with Serene Shores Trading written in big fancy, golden letters..
“To use the commercial line, one first must get this clan’s approval, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan stepped lively for the entrance, but the guards barred his path.
Zhuo Fan felt it awfully familiar.
[Didn’t the same happen back at the Veiled Dragon Pavilion? Ha-ha, guess lap dogs can be found everywhere.]
The guards, however, were off script this time around, not having the least bit of scorn, even bowing, “Sir, what might have brought you here?”
“Business!”
“What kind?”
“Why would I tell you? I want to see your manager!” Zhuo Fan demanded.
[These watchdogs want to use their master to intimidate me.]
The guards did not mind it one bit, “Ha-ha-ha, sir, we’re not questioning you. We’re here to receive guests. But as there are all kinds of people, business can be big or small. We largely deal in big deals which makes every visitor an important customer. I advise that sir visits our shops for small buys, only half a mile down the street. We welcome any and all cooperation, thank you.”
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow.
[The best merchant union sure is something else. They even trained their guards to be nice. No wonder they exploded in size. ]
He found no reason to make the situation worse, so he revealed a bottle with glittering rocks, “Tell me, is this deal big or small?”
“Sacred stones!”
The two gave Zhuo Fan a long look and advised, “Sacred stones are under tight control throughout the lands. Not just anyone can have them. Just who are you… sir?”
Zhuo Fan looked elsewhere and scoffed.
The two winced, knowing they made a serious blunder, “Forgive me, sir. It was a slip of the tongue.”
“Trust is crucial in any business. I heard when Serene Shores Trading makes a deal, it never asks the other party’s history, thus dealing with every aspect of society. But your actions today, if the head knew of it… “
“Forgive us, please, I forgot myself, sir.” The guard bowed deeply in fear.
Their training comprised of being robotic, to give short replies and not eavesdrop. Most importantly, to treat guests with utmost humility and respect. They could never go after anyone unless ordered to.
But because of shock, all the wrong words came out, looking into the guest.
It was plain to see that Zhuo Fan with a child on his back looked like a househusband, not someone important enough to have sacred stones.
The sacred stones were so important in the central area as well that only the really important figures had them, and they never came through here.
That was why it baffled the two guards to no end.
[He can’t be from the imperial family, can he? One word to the manager and we’ll go bye-bye.]
[What rotten luck! What was I thinking blabbering so much to such a mystery guest?]
The two looked nervous and grimaced on either side of Zhuo Fan.
He had no intention to whip a guard dog, not when he was so nice, but he had to show off his style, to intimidate and swing the negotiations in his favor. These were guidelines Zhuo Fan always adhered to when doing high-profile negotiations.
A bark came out of nowhere, “Who’s making a ruckus at the Serene Shores Trading door?”

chapters.title: Chapter 952: Soul Harmony’s Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 952: Soul Harmony’s Power
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Second young master!”
With light steps, a youth in lavish clothes came along which made the guards bow at once.
Zhuo Fan chuckled to himself, “They say the eldest young master of the Serene Shores Trading is able and efficient, having the Clan Head’s favor, while the second young master is a hot-head, making trouble and pissing off his elders. It can’t be you, can it? Ha-ha-ha…”
“Are you done spouting crap?”
Looking angry, the youth’s face sank and released the power of a 3rd layer Soul Harmony Stage cultivation as he spat, “I don’t care what mutt you are, barking at my company, but to insult me? You’re dead!”
Bam!
He never got the chance as two stalwart men shielded Zhuo Fan from any harm.
The young master flipped out seeing the guards go against him, “What do you think you’re doing? I’m doing this for you, teaching this punk some manners yet you defy me? Do you want to die too?”
“Second young master, the master commanded us to always keep the peace and never raise a hand on our guests. Especially to a noble guest such as he, a possible imperial family member. We can’t ever…” The guards grimaced and bowed.
The guy exploded in rage and cut them off, “Who cares? That’s only on the surface when he’s utterly useless at everything else. Stop exaggerating!”
“Isn’t bloodline enough?”
Zhuo Fan gave a taunting smirk, “Second young master’s reputation precedes you. You mean you don’t know that in this world, strength is second while heritage is first? Just how many people can actually reach the peak of their skills? The majority is in fact walking around with the noses up and puffed up chest thanks to riding someone’s coattails. And you, second young master, are no different. You’ve been brought up as well, and quite good in fact. The only reason these two guards show you any kind of respect and not send you to your maker, is because you’re the second young master of the Serene Shores Trading, he-he-he…”
Zhuo Fan finished by looking elsewhere, further incensing the enraged second young master till he was beet red.
The guards sighed, their hearts bleeding from seeing the second young master ready to pop and the indifferent Zhuo Fan of his own handiwork behind them.
[This guest has a sharp mouth as well.]
Taking deep breaths, the second young master glared at the two and declared, “So you dogs want to stop me, right? You asked for it!”
Second young master charged for the two, unleashing his great power on them.
The guards cried out, “Second young master, please don’t force our hand.”
“Oh, I will, or you can say goodbye to that imperial family guy! That’s what you get for blocking me!” Second young master was out for blood.
The two guards felt put on the spot, but soon came to a decision and met him head on, “Second young master, stop making a scene! Harming anyone from the imperial family will lead to problems for the company! We have no choice but to stop you!”
Clang!
The guards took hard stances and punched with great power towards the second young master, tough and sharp like swords. Such a state could only be achieved with soul harmony.
Zhuo Fan nodded inside like a judge, acting like a bystander to the scene he caused.
[Not bad sword souls, these two, a shame they’re against…]
Rumble~
The mighty sword arts were unleashed as the two punches passed through the second young master’s belly, astounding them, “Second young master, w-why didn’t you dodge…”
The second young master stood in place with an icy gaze, “Two puny sword souls think to harm me? Humph, your sword training is nowhere near enough to even pluck a hair from me. Train harder next time!”
“T-that…” The guards were panicking and about to retreat when they found their hands stuck in place.
The second young master smirked, “I hardly ever fight with Soul Harmony Stage experts so you don’t know. I have a once in millennium elemental soul, making me nigh untouchable, phantasmal, the instant my body turns to ice. You can use your sword soul to harm me if you harden them enough, but you’re just too weak compared to me. Ha-ha, the moment I formed my soul I surpassed most people around. My superiority in the Ethereal Stage only became more pronounced in the Soul Harmony Stage. You only lost due to soul levels. Better work harder next time! Train and make up for your weakness!”
A crackling sound could be heard and the two guards’ hands iced over, the cold spreading over their entire body and freezing them in place.
The second young master dealt with them in a flash, slipping backward and letting their hands come out while his body returned to normal.
Did the two guards attack at random?
Not many Soul Harmony Stage people knew what exactly happened, except for Zhuo Fan. The soul harmony combined one’s soul and flesh, but it wasn’t as simple as addition.
Compared to Ethereal Stage, the Soul Harmony Stage takes the cultivators to a new and improved level, to a flawless state.
There were three kinds of souls. Beast souls and tool souls were the lowest rung, while the elemental souls were formed through condensing an element and becoming intangible, thus they were better. As for domain souls, they encompassed everything, the highest form where one’s rules were supreme.
This led to variation in strength in the Ethereal Stage, despite equal cultivation yet different souls. And once one reached the Soul Harmony Stage, this gap only broadened.
A soul harmony of a beast or tool soul would exhibit great power, the savagery of a beast or the hardness of a tool. They were so destructive it could cause real damage even in the Ethereal Stage.
Though there were always exceptions, such as monsters like Zhuo Fan with his double soul empowered domain that could crush even a Soul Harmony Stage cultivator.
As to why they ranked so low in the Soul Harmony Stage, that was because when doing soul harmony with an elemental soul, the body combines with it and turns the user phantasmal. As long as the opponent’s soul was weaker than yours, he could never touch you.
The same happened to those two poor guards. They were on a different level despite their okay-ish cultivation. This was where a soul type made all the difference.
As for a soul harmony domain, that was turning yourself into an area and assuming complete control, even more outrageous.
Though enough Yuan Qi, like in Danqing Shen’s case, to crack the earth and rend space, soul type no longer mattered.
While soul type was an advantage, it was not a blowout. One’s true strength was what made the real difference.
Though for average people, soul types meant different power levels…
Ignoring the stiff and frozen guards, the second young master passed them by and walked before Zhuo Fan.
“No killing?”
Zhuo Fan smirked, pointing at the popsicles, “They just tried to attack you. I have to say, you’re quite forgiving for an arrogant master when teaching your dogs.”
The second young master’s eyes twitched in rage, “They attacked me to save your life. Is that how you return their favor, by having me kill them?”
“Return what? I have nothing to give them.”
Zhuo Fan had a crooked grin, “I came to do business and I’m your guest. Protecting me is in their job description. Besides, they most likely did it for the company’s name to go untouched for longer. Speaking of, they didn’t do it for me, but because the second young master started it, no? Anywho, shouldn’t dogs that bite back, regardless of reasons, be put down? Ha-ha-ha…”
The fury in the second young master reached a boil as he shook all over and punched at Zhuo Fan, “Shut up!”
Zhuo Fan grinned as the punch stopped an inch from his face.
“Scared that I’m from the imperial family?” Zhuo Fan cocked an infuriating eyebrow, “This shows you’re not all muscle, up there, and know when to stop. Now be good and kowtow…”
“Shit!”
The second young master snapped, “Damn cocky bastard, I don’t care who you are, but today you die! Just, put the kid down. I don’t strike children.”
Zhuo Fan glanced behind at young Sanzi and smiled.
[I see.]
Zhuo Fan nodded and stepped in the second young master’s personal space, catching him off-guard.
Bam!
A loud explosion tore at the peaceful sky and the second young master felt pain in his gut, making him keel over and spit blood. He looked down in utter shock at the scarlet punch buried in his stomach.
[H-how?! I have an elemental soul harmony! How did he touch me? No Soul Harmony expert…]
Blood dripped from his incredulous face. His legs failed him and fell down with hazy eyes.
“Elemental soul harmony isn’t invincible, and a man carrying a child isn’t always weak.” Grinning, Zhuo Fan turned around to walk inside, leaving his laughter behind, “Second young master, you’re amusing. I’ll remember you. Maybe we’ll get to work together someday, ha-ha-ha… “
[Wait, w-who are you…]
Second young master wanted to shout, but the pain robbed him of his voice, his sight and his consciousness.
A sacred beast was born with soul harmony, then he also had the heaven dragon soul with godlike power. Zhuo Fan was not in the Soul Harmony Stage, but with the heaven dragon soul and Qilin arm, he made up for it. Nothing could stop him, not elemental soul harmony, and neither domain soul harmony…

chapters.title: Chapter 953: All Business Is Good Business
chapters.content:
Chapter 953: All Business Is Good Business
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Now past that tiny inconvenience, Zhuo Fan no longer gave the two icicles and the unconscious second young master any thought, walking into the main hall of the building.
The first step into the reception hall was met with an explosion of wealth, blinding the eyes from the gaudy and glittering gems and stained glass decorating it. The columns supporting the high ceiling were even more outrageous, some made from the rarest ores and gems handpicked from the South Mountains, while others came in the form of rare beasts from the North Sea, like the flood dragon.
The raw and thick vibe of wealth coming off this hall slammed into Zhuo Fan
As for the strange, average guy waltzing in, just having entered this place proved he meant business. An aged man stepped closer to ask with a deep bow, “Ha-ha-ha, sir, with what may we help you today?”
“Let’s talk business.”
Sensing he had a Soul Harmony Stage cultivation yet showing no reaction to a Radiant Stage cultivator like himself, Zhuo Fan had to reassess the Serene Shores Trading just how ingrained business was to them.
The old man smiled, “Right this way, sir. We have strict confidentiality rules here and all talks are done in private rooms. Once we arrive at sir’s room, a specialized receptionist will attend to you. Of course, as I’m your current receptionist, the content of our talks and their result shall only be kept between us two and my immediate superior. This is the reputation our company prides itself with. So please, rest assured sir!”
Zhuo Fan nodded.
[Serene Shores Trading values secrecy so much, going as far as minimizing the flow of information to prevent a leak while taking its reputation as a guarantee. This is how they managed to deal with both good and bad people, gaining the trust of all the lands. Its policy vows the company as being completely safe in business, taking no side and spying on no one.]
Its neutrality was thus assured, with no parties being offended, while neither receiving any special treatment either. But this business plan shows its genius by allowing them to get in touch with all factions.
It is the law of nature for everyone to have something needing taking care of hidden from the eyes of all. Serene Shores Trading’s neutrality allowed it to swim freely among these dealings, with no repercussions.
Once into a fine and classy room, Zhuo Fan got into a sculpted lavish chair, one leg over the other.
The old man was calmly closing the door then made a sign to seal sounds in this room by erecting a barrier.
Now the old man turned to Zhuo Fan and smiled, “Sir, we can now begin.”
“They’re right about Serene Shores Trading, serving any customer with utmost attention to detail.”
“You’re too kind, sir. This is our job, ha-ha-ha.”
“While your people skills are pristine, I can’t help but wonder if your power is just as great, able to ease my worries.” A rare praise came from Zhuo Fan, one followed by a taunting eyebrow and switch of topics.
The old man smiled, “Sir, it’s plain to see to all the five lands just how strong we are. Regardless of the request and its outcome, we are confident enough we can do it. If by some absurdity we can’t, then no one else in the world can, ha-ha-ha…”
The old man sounded humble, but anyone could sense the pride and confidence in his tone, in the Serene Shores Trading’s power.
“Ha-ha-ha, I can only hope.”
Zhuo Fan didn’t pursue it and went to business, “I would like to use the company’s five land teleportation array, your commercial line. Will this be acceptable?”
[What?]
The old man winced, his strolling air changed to one of shock, “You want to use our commercial line?”
“I can’t?”
“No no no, that’s not the issue here. But…”
The old man was put on the spot, “It’s not just our company that controls it, but also the city lord. We can’t use it as we wish. I’m afraid I can’t complete your request. Please allow me to call my superior, sir. I’ll be only gone for a moment…”
The old man made a gesture and the barrier was down so he could leave.
Zhuo Fan knew using the commercial line wasn’t going to be easy, yet was content in waiting having long ago made a plan for it.
It hardly took much time for the door to open again and the same old man arrived, along with another in his twenties of the same cultivation. Zhuo Fan reckoned his true age to be close to a hundred.
The old man resealed the room and made the introductions to Zhuo Fan, “Sir, here is our company’s eldest young master, Wu Ranze, and my immediate superior. It’s best if you talk with eldest young master about your business.”
“Hello, sir, I’ve been told you wish to use our commercial line.”
Wu Ranze bowed lightly, despite being a successor like that second young master, he showed only courtesy, like the whole of Serene Shores Trading did with all their customers, even if some were weak Radiant Stage cultivators or still unaware just how big of a deal they were here for.
Zhuo Fan squinted.
[So he’s the eldest young master. Word has it that he’s sharp and able, the Clan Head’s right-hand man. Looking at him now, he does follow the company’s rules.]
That wasn’t enough to remove all of his skepticism, however, finding something a bit off about him…
Unable to clear his doubts at the time being, Zhuo Fan just nodded, “Yes, that is why I’m here.”
“I see, ha-ha-ha…”
Wu Ranze was blunt, “Sir, while the commercial line is something Serene Shores Trading set up, it is under Goldbough City lord’s control. You need both approvals to use it. Each instance requiring its use also needs to be submitted a day in advance, along with the items carried, quantity, destination and so on. I’m sorry to say, but today’s report has already been given. Using it for our own selfish needs will incur the empire’s wrath. I’m sorry, but this is something we cannot do.”
Zhuo Fan mocked, watching his fake business smile, “So you’re saying a company as huge as yours needs to make reports each time?”
“Yes, this is a handicap, but no matter how big we are, we can’t go against the empire. Please forgive us.”
“So I just need the city lord’s approval and I can use the commercial line, right?”
“Of course. All that’s required is the city lord’s approval and with a big enough deal, making it worth using it, the commercial line will be available to you. As for what you wish to carry, be it contraband or even people, we’ll do it regardless, with none catching wind of this. I stake my company’s name on it!”
“Quite a good name too, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan gave a smirk and his eyes glinted while fuming inside.
Before even coming to Goldbough City, he knew Baili Jingyu was useless, ignoring his duty most of the time. At best, he’d go to the company to get some crumbs. There was no way a company as big as theirs would let some moron control it.
They made sure ages ago to fill the fool’s appetite. That was the extent of their collaboration.
Name dropping in this case was only used to jack up the price, to rip him off.
[I bet that even if I do go to him for approval, you’re going to work behind my back so he’ll make it harder on me, then split the profits later.]
Zhuo Fan had seen this tactic done plenty of times before. Sure, the Serene Shores Trading cared naught who came knocking their door since they made sure to fleece them.
[Business and treachery go hand in hand.]
The bigger the deal, the shrewder the tactic. The dignified presentation proved it…
“Eldest young master sure is wise and able.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed in thought. Wu Ranze wore the same flat smile, not betraying any thoughts he might have about his praise, “Thank you.”
“Then let’s talk business. I wonder if your company can smooth it over with the city lord, with a big enough business that is.”
“Ha-ha-ha, that counts as a second deal.” Wu Ranze beamed.
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Yes, eldest young master is a shrewd businessman, ha-ha-ha…”
“It’s the company’s rule, sir, nothing more. We can’t do business without capital and the city lord needs to be on the take as well.”
Wu Ranze’s gaze was fixed on Zhuo Fan, “But sir, what is the deal anyway?”
“A large one, the biggest one your company had in millennia, he-he-he…” Zhuo Fan gave a crooked smile…

chapters.title: Chapter 954: A Bit Low
chapters.content:
Chapter 954: A Bit Low
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Wu Ranze lit up, “Huge deal? Could you tell us two about it, sir?”
“Ha-ha-ha, you’re awfully slow for someone praised to be sharp, eldest young master. How else are we supposed to trade if I don’t tell you about it? Eldest young master, aren’t you being redundant?”
Zhuo Fan toyed.
Wu Ranze nodded with a smile, “Indeed, sir is right and I’ve been rude.”
“Before we get to it, I have something for you.” Zhuo Fan took out a bright crystal and a vial from his ring.
Wu Ranze started at the sight of them and asked, “Sacred stones and 11th grade pill? Sir, is this the deal you spoke of? While they’re both uncommon, there’s plenty of them between men of true worth. Our company has traded in fairly large amounts of them as well. I fear that this deal…”
“Eldest young master, you’re being slow again. I just said that I have something to show you before the real deal.”
Zhuo Fan smirked.
Wu Ranze’s cheeks reddened, not liking being prodded again and again for over minor things. His flat business smile slipped for a second as well, “Then sir…”
“Identity!”
Zhuo Fan chuckled and shook his head, “The company does not check its customers out of consideration, but I’m willing to go the extra mile for a more solid cooperation. I am an 11th grade alchemist. This is one of my pills and these sacred stones are something I got from selling some of them. I am among those men in power and have the right to deal big!”
Ugh!
Wu Ranze and the old man chuckled then bowed, “Sir, revealing your identity isn’t necessary. You’re a valued customer the moment you stepped into our company. We sincerely…”
“Oh, don’t say that.”
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “All that enter are noble guests because your guards filter them at the door. Any that passes them are bound to be important so there’s no need for screening. That, however, was not how I got here and I need to facilitate our big deal through increasing our mutual trust.”
“Wait, you didn’t go through…” Wu Ranze was stunned and baffled.
[Then how did you get here? There’s two Soul Harmony experts outside!]
Zhuo Fan read his doubts on his face, “I fought my way in, knocking them out…”
Wu Ranze flinched.
[That’s Soul Harmony Stage and two cultivators at that. How…]
“Also, your second young master passed by, so I knocked him out too. He should be having a nap at the door.” Zhuo Fan threw the last part in.
[Yes, I beat your baby brother. What are you gonna do about it?]
Zhuo Fan waited for the stiff faced Wu Ranze to react. The guy let out a long breath and bowed, “Forgive me, sir, the guards must’ve been rude to you and deserved it. I’ll be sure to look into it and deal with them. As for my brother, I ask that sir overlook his recklessness. May sir speak of the huge deal you mentioned?”
[Your flaw is your humanity.]
Seeing the unfazed gaze of Wu Ranze, Zhuo Fan chuckled.
While respect was imposed to make dealings better, it has been so enforced that morals have been thrown away.
[I told them I beat the guards and the eldest young master didn’t care. As all men of ambition would rather lose to the enemy and not because of having wretched clansmen.]
There was no harm in having some clan flunkies take the brunt as long as a huge deal was coming their way.
Though this would take a different aspect when his brother got involved. That he was too impersonal.
Zhuo Fan was cold as well, not impersonal, since ruthlessness was also a part of one’s humanity. He might not like his little brother, but at the very least, it should’ve concerned him.
As for those who cherished their brother, they’d be flipping out about now. There were many ways to keep a straight face, but none were perfect.
In the other extreme, hearing your brother suffered, you might be overjoyed since you two were vying for the clan’s power. Such was humanity, good and bad, envious and passionate.
Zhuo Fan saw none of this in Wu Ranze. He only cared about his interest and nothing else. The worst part, he was only chasing profits and wealth out of instinct, going through life with a frozen heart.
[So this is Serene Shores Trading’s wise and able?]
[Ha-ha, I’d rather not have such company. It’s too hard to control…]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed and he spoke, “Eldest young master is so open about it. I was standing here afraid of facing you. I didn’t even realized he was second young master before acting.”
“I understand my brother the best. He must’ve started it and incited sir. Hope you’ll forgive us.” Wu Ranze continued, “Can we now talk about the huge deal?”
Zhuo Fan nodded and revealed a gourd, “Look at this.”
He opened it and Wu Ranze gasped, “North Sea Gel?”
“The North Sea Gel?!”
The old man cried out, “It’s northern lands’ specialty yet also a local rarity. Not even their factions’ leaders have much of it. I heard only the sea demons of the North Sea are guarding it. It’s so dangerous there that even a Sword King can die. Sir, is this what you want to trade? We’ll take everything you have, money isn’t a problem.”
The old man blurted out like a broken record, leaving the plotting Zhuo Fan to be taken aback.
[This thing’s that valuable?]
[So that’s why the wench wanted ten million sacred stones!]
“Uhm, is this thing valuable?”
“I heard that it can heal any wound in an instant, even one made by the five lands’ divine weapons. When Invincible Sword ran amok in the northern lands, the other three lands joined to drive him back, but many have died. It’s all due to this item that the strongest survived Sundering Sword’s wounds. You have such a thing and don’t know this?” The old man gasped.
Zhuo Fan grumbled a bit and said, “I recently obtained it and I’m not familiar yet. Then, tell me a number.”
“Thirty million sacred stones!” The old man spoke first on the spot.
Zhuo Fan was shocked inside.
[Does that mean the twenty million and the fact it was used on young Sanzi still isn’t worth its value?]
Seeing him silent, Wu Ranze thought it was from hesitation and spoke, “Fifty million!”
“Fifty?”
Zhuo Fan jumped in shock. From the sheer fact Wu Ranze, a man obsessed with profits, to call out such a number without a twitch, showed it had to be way more valuable.
[Holy hell! What the hell is this to be so expensive? It’s like sacred stones are just dull rocks to him compared to this!]
His silence was taken as dissatisfaction again and Wu Ranze sighed, “I know fifty million is very low, that even a tiny bit of North Sea Gel is invaluable, with all the lands fighting for it, but the most money we can access is fifty million.”
[I actually struck gold with this!]
[They saved my son and I just gave them double the asking price, to return the favor. But this was by no means calling it quits, not with its value. I simply robbed them of it!]
[Sigh, I never owe anyone anything and now I owe tons. I have to pay it all back.]
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched and took the gourd back, “Who said this is the item of trade? I was only asking.”
Zhuo Fan stashed it away.
The two were dumbstruck, red eyes fixed on that ring, their hearts burning with greed and anger.
[Dude, are you toying with us? Talking about some huge deal then you take that out. Here we are sincere about buying it so why not make the trade?]
[Are you mocking our addiction by saying that?]
[Or are you saying you got something better than North Sea Gel? Not happening…]
To Zhuo Fan, that was just it, he had something so huge and outrageous that it could buy the whole company…

chapters.title: Chapter 955: Demon Spirit Stone
chapters.content:
Chapter 955: Demon Spirit Stone
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Now don’t get too excited. This right here is what I’m trading!”
Seeing the hunger in their eyes, as if he stole the juiciest morsel right from their mouth, Zhuo Fan gave a dry cough and reveal the main star of this deal, some pitch-black rock.
Wu Ranze weighed the odd rock in his hand, speaking in doubt, “And what is this supposed to be? Never seen it before. It doesn’t seem to have much use either. Our company never has things we can’t use. Sir, I recommend you put the North Sea Gel back on the table. I know our capital is limited and lacking, but it will soon be amended. We’ll sign an IOU as well if we have too. Our credibility has been carefully groomed for thousands of years…”
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched and grinned inside.
[He must really want that North Sea Gel with a passion to turn from an eminent gentleman into a street peddler, forgoing his status and his leverage.]
Zhuo Fan however had no intention of handing over, he had some research in mind for it. Maybe it was exactly what young Sanzi needed to wake up.
“Eldest young master, I’m sure you know what saving the best for last means. First I took out an 11th grade pill, then the North Sea Gel. But neither of them are part of the deal. Are you perhaps thinking the third item is lesser than the two?”
Shaking his head, Zhuo Fan gave a mocking smile, “The item I intend to trade is no less valuable than the North Sea Gel, scout’s honor.”
[You talk a mean game, saying you actually have something better than the priceless North Sea Gel.]
Wu Ranze gasped, then gave the plain, black rock a second look.
[True, everything he took out was better than the last. First was an 11th grade pill, the second was the North Sea Gel and lastly this thing. Maybe this black rock is better than the North Sea Gel, but we can’t see it?]
Wu Ranze got the rock to eye level and focused on it, using all his concentration to find anything that might betray its supposedly amazing value, only to come up empty.
[What the hell is this thing?]
Wu Ranze wore a constant frown, finally turning a perplexed look to Zhuo Fan.
“Try using Yuan Qi, the same you use when cultivating.”
Zhuo Fan grinned and lightly instructed.
Wu Ranze tried doing what he said and absorbed spiritual energy around.
The shock came in seconds. He was just giving it a casual try yet the rock’s seemingly infinite energy surge into his body.
Moreover, unlike spirit stones or even sacred stones, what he got from this was Yuan Qi that blended with his. It cleansed his meridians as the energy traveled on the way to his Dantian, filling it with power.
In a mere blink, the black rock vanished, while his body was filled to the brim with Yuan Qi, so much so his meridians were aching. He was on the verge of advancing.
Wu Ranze was dumbstruck in his seat, trying to blink away the fog…
Any cultivator worth his salt knew the sacred stones and spirit stones were first emptied of spiritual energy then had that energy turned into Yuan Qi to train. It was a time-consuming process, taking hours, days and even years.
This was where this black rock came in, cutting the time to zero by feeding the boy pure Yuan Qi. In case of a fight, this rock would make one’s Yuan Qi reserves endless, giving one supreme advantage.
While in terms of cultivation, it saved tons of time. Just that little pebble he absorbed translated into half a month of constant sacred stone usage.
What was more, the Yuan Qi he got was the same obtained through usual practice. Through the process of taking the spiritual energy from a sacred stone or a spirit stone, most of it would be cast away, keeping only what the user needed before turning it into his own Yuan Qi.
Unlike the common convention, this black rock had fully usable Yuan Qi.
It would make advancing so much easier since it added an extra oomph which made a whole difference when pushing through to the next level.
Wu Ranze’s mind was overwhelmed from shock and fear. This small thing was a game changer. It could speed up cultivation tremendously.
The old man was looking puzzled, having not felt it to believe it, “Eldest young master, what’s wrong? Is it any good?”
“Not just good, but perfect!”
Wu Ranze’s eyes shone with an even hotter gaze on Zhuo Fan, “Sir, what is this and how many do you have?”
Giving a devil smile, Zhuo Fan drawled, “It is the demon spirit stone, from Serenity Vein. In the entire world, you won’t find a second person to have it. As for the amount, ha-ha-ha, as much as you want. Well, is it worth it? Is it a huge deal?”
“Sir is without a doubt amazing. This deal is beyond huge!”
Wu Ranze’s brow shook, his eyes blazing with excitement, “The North Sea Gel is only great at healing, but the demon spirit stone can revolutionize cultivation as we know it. It can greatly increase one’s cultivation, but its greatest asset is to guarantee one’s life. I know understand what sir meant by being better than the North Sea Gel. Although, my only wish is for sir to keep it that way.”
Catching his drift, Zhuo Fan gave him a long look, “Why, planning on having a monopoly on it?”
“Exactly. As sir is the sole owner of this stone, with our company’s deep connection throughout the lands, you’ll earn the most with us acting as middlemen. Sir has only to gain from a cooperation with us.”
“Then about my deal…”
“Consider it done!”
“And the city lord…”
“A foregone conclusion!”
Wu Ranze waved off all of Zhuo Fan’s doubts, his face solemn, “All we need from sir is constant cooperation with us. You, sir, are our most noble customer. Everything can be resolved, our company willing to solve all of sir’s issues.”
Zhuo Fan nodded with a chuckle, “Great, then I shall take my leave and wait for eldest young master’s good news.”
Zhuo Fan got up to leave.
“Wait!”
Wu Ranze cried out, still smiling, “Just how many does sir have? Could sir offer some? I still need to convince my father and the city lord…”
“Afraid I’m bluffing?”
“Ha-ha-ha, no, not at all. Just…”
“A hundred thousand, but I must have first pick of all the goods you got from all the lands in exchange for it.” Zhuo Fan seemed to struggle as he talked.
Wu Ranze nodded, “Sure, that settles it. Here’s the highest commercial card, sir. Wherever you may go, our company’s assets will be at sir’s disposal. Only five such cards have been handed out, with sir’s being the sixth.”
“Five?”
“The leaders of every land has the right to own one since war is costly and we’d be helping them in times of need.” Wu Ranze beamed.
Zhuo Fan gave him a look.
[So they’re into war finance as well.] Not that he cared, since it was all the same to him, so he held out his ring, “Eldest young master, here are a hundred thousand demon spirit stones. I’ll await the good news.”
“Rest assured, sir!”
Bam!
The two rings clinked and the transfer finished. Wu Ranze got his rocks and Zhuo Fan got some shiny golden card, taking his leave with Gu Santong on his back.
Wu Ranze and the old man walked him out well beyond the reception. The other guests there was stunned, then gave Zhuo Fan astonishing looks.
[Who’s he, to have even the eldest young master show him out? Out of even the reception?! Eldest young master only ever walked even the most important customers to the reception, but today…]
“Eldest young master, second young master was beaten up outside the company!”
Someone was running towards Wu Ranze and whispered, while second young master was being carried over by some guards.
Not sparing him a glance, Wu Ranze spoke, “No matter, he asked for it. Keep an eye on him from now on, make sure he doesn’t disturb the customers.”
He then walked back to Zhuo Fan, all smiles, “Sir, I asked for a room to be ready for you. If it’s not up to sir’s standards, please mention it to the tavern and the whole of Goldbough City will be at your disposal. I need to talk about our deal with my father and won’t be able to accompany you for the following days. I ask sir to be patient.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, finding it a waste of time to talk to a man with no soul.
“Who are you? You dared to ambush me? Fight me like a man!” A roar resounded in the hall.
Zhuo Fan paused and turned to second young master.
Wu Ranze was the fastest to shout at him, “Brother, stop making a scene! You’re disturbing the customers. Father will deal with you. Did you forget already what happened three years ago…”
“It’s because I can’t that I loathe these grand customers more!” Second young master pointed at Zhuo Fan and screamed, “Duel me if you have the guts! I, Wu Randong won’t fall so fast the second time!”
Wuran Dong?
Zhuo Fan cocked an eyebrow, then grinned as he lightly stepped outside with the same old man attending to him.
Wu Ranze signaled the guards to take his screaming brother towards a lofty manor…

chapters.title: Chapter 956: Duel
chapters.content:
Chapter 956: Duel
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Knock~
An old man was inspecting a document over a finely carved jade table when someone knocked.
He raised his aged face and asked, “What is it?”
“It’s me, father. I have something urgent that needs your attention.”
The old man recognized the voice and said, “Oh, Ranze, come in!”
Creak~
Wu Ranze lightly stepped forward, followed by six Soul Harmony guards carrying a wounded and an aggrieved second young master.
The old man’s eyes showed he understood the situation as he sighed.
Wu Ranze bowed and spoke flatly, “Father, I request that brother is to be confined for half a month, lest he ruin the company’s affairs.”
“What did he do this time?” The old man gave a long sigh as he returned to inspecting the document, giving no regard to his sons’ spat.
Wu Ranze smiled but then Wu Randong got out of the guards’ hands and slammed the table as he barked, “Isn’t it obvious from how I look. Someone beat me up!”
“Father, he is an important customer that will propel our company to higher heights in our trading with the lands.” Ignoring the tantrum, Wu Ranze reported, “Brother had a clash with the customer, but fortunately he was not heavy-handed, nor did he much care for this incident, still willing to trade with us. Before brother makes things any worse, I beseech father to confine brother and prevent from irritating our customer and driving the biggest deal our company has ever seen.”
Wu Randong whipped his head at Wu Ranze and spat, “Brother, you’re just going to pin this on me without even hearing the whole story?”
“Ranze, is his deal that valuable?”
The old man ignored his youngest’s annoyance and asked what mattered.
Wu Randong nodded, never looking away from his father, “Not just valuable, but far more important than even North Sea Gel.”
Ka!
The old man paused, his eyes shook and snapped on Wu Ranze, “Like the North Sea Gel?”
“Not just that, but far far bigger!”
“Absurd. We’ve been wanting to trade in the North Sea Gel for thousands of years yet never got the chance. Northern lands have it in short supply and have it on a tight guard. Now you come to me saying there’s something way better? What is it then?”
The old man showed excitement for once.
Wu Ranze spoke, “Father, it’s what I’ve been meaning to tell you about. Take this…”
Wu Ranze presented a black stone.
The old man frowned.
“Father, please cultivate a bit with it.” Wu Ranze had a vague smile, just like how Zhuo Fan did it to him.
The old man did as told. What happened to Wu Ranze before happened with him as well. The rock was gone and a surge of Yuan Qi filled him with endless power.
The old man cried out as he turned to Wu Ranze in shock, “W-what is this thing?”
“Demon spirit stone!”
Wu Ranze bowed, looking excited as well, retelling all that transpired, finishing with, “The customer had given us a hundred thousand in advance then will sign with us an indefinite contract and all he wants is to use our commercial line. I already promised him this and I ask that father works fast to strike a deal with the city lord, to get his approval.”
The old man’s eyes shone as he laughed, “Sure, there’s no way we’re going to miss the deal of the century! I’ll go to the city lord right now and see what he wants in return. That old Baili Jingyu couldn’t just stick to booze and women, but had to play dumb as well, insisting that we have to talk in person. Ranze, you’d be more than enough for something as simple as this. Well, not that it matters, since in two years, I’ll withdraw from being chairman of the company and you’ll be taking over. Then he’ll be your problem, ha-ha-ha… “
Wu Ranze laughed along, his eyes dead, like there was nothing exciting in becoming the top dog.
[Since it’s only obvious.]
He had established himself in the Serene Shores Trading and his father had nothing but praises for him while the rest of the members admired him greatly. So young yet the highest manager under his father, bringing many important deals without the help of his father helped consolidate his value within the company.
It had long gone from his father being assured of passing the mantle, becoming an obvious choice.
But what about vying for power, for status?
Did you expect him to see his poor excuse of a brother as a worthy match? He didn’t amount to even a bucket of spit. There was nothing to be jealous of.
“Wait!”
Wu Randong butted in with a red face and bloodshot eyes, “Father, brother, is money all you care about? He has humiliated the company’s members, and your own flesh and blood got beaten up, yet you don’t even care? What worth would any trade be, regardless of how big, if it’s crooked?”
The old man shot him a cold look, “Randong, I have told you both before, that respect is paramount in our line of work. The people we deal with all come from important clans. We may have spread out throughout the lands, but we never mix money with politics, ever. The moment we cross the line will be the second we become petty and lead the company to ruin. Why else do you think I’ve been wasting so much time catering to that spineless Baili Jingyu? It’s all due to having Baili in his name!”
“Don’t ever say his name around me. I hate him to death!” Wu Randong spat in fury.
Wu Ranze shouted, “Brother, that’s enough! We only grew to our current influence because we value respect above all else in our dealings. It’s what pays for all the resources you get to use to cultivate. How else would you have reached the Soul Harmony Stage so fast? Without power, you’d be weak and at anyone’s mercy!”
“And bowing and scraping isn’t a weakness?”
“We are weak against the top while strong against those at the bottom. But if we break our principles, the clan will be over and no matter where we go, we’ll be the weakest. You think about that.”
Wu Ranze huffed and said to the guards, “Father and I will be going to the city lord’s manor. You make sure to confine him. Above all else, make sure he doesn’t go and disturb that valued customer, or you’ll have to answer for it!”
Father and son walked out without giving Wu Randong a glance as the guards bowed.
Bam!
They didn’t even have to stand straight as the lavish room sported an extra large hole, with the sun’s warm rays falling upon them. As for Wu Randong, he was nowhere to be found.
“Damn it! Second young master ran away! After him!” They all panicked as they scrambled out of the hole.
In their rushed search, they failed to notice the bush just below the room, where Wu Randong stuck his head out to watch them leave. He gnashed his teeth, “There won’t be any deal, not if I can help it!”
Wu Randong stepped cautiously in another direction, towards the biggest tavern in Goldbough City.
An hour later, in a grand room, Gu Santong lay on the bed, weak and unconscious.
Zhuo Fan sat at his bedside, watching over him with constant sighs.
He could’ve carried Gu Santong in his ring, but the fear of something happening to him prevented that. Instead he chose to carry him always to sense every little change in his son. After so many days, he relaxed knowing his condition was stable.
“Serene Shores Trading…”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone as he contemplated, “Wu Ranze and the entire company are capable in trading, but too obsessed with profit. All merchants value gain over parting, especially this one. It’s easy to be stabbed in the back even after the deal is done. As for that second young master…”
“Get out! Whoever you are, get out now and duel me!”
The ravings coming from outside cut his thoughts short.
Zhuo Fan chuckled.
[Wuran Dong?]
[Speak of the devil, ha-ha-ha…]

chapters.title: Chapter 957: Ice Dragon Blast
chapters.content:
Chapter 957: Ice Dragon Blast
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fa flashed in Wu Randong’s face, eyes darting all over the place then grinned when the coast was clear, “Cleared the area before the big fight?”
“I am the second young master of Serene Shores Trading. Anyone would flee!”
Wu Randong spat, “There’s only us now. You won’t get the drop on me like last time!”
Zhuo Fan rose an eyebrow and smiled, “I get it, you don’t want bystanders hurt. Your compassion knows no bounds. But do you have the luxury to worry about others when you’re going to get it? You know I beat you once, yet you’re that confident you can win this time?”
“Shut it! Regardless of outcome, you’ve made an enemy out of Serene Shores Trading! Now suffer for it!” With a furious roar, Wu Randong stomped and charged towards Zhuo Fan. He made hand signs and an icy aura spread from him.
High profound ranked martial art, Ice Dragon Blast!
Knowing Zhuo Fan was no pushover, Wu Randong went all out from the first attack.
With a furious hiss, Wu Randong turned into ice-cold silver lights that spread out to take the form of nine dragons as they smashed forward.
Zhuo Fan squinted.
[The same skill has different power based on each user’s cultivation.]
This skill was a profound ranked martial art, but Wu Randong was a Soul Harmony expert with an elemental soul, Perennial Ice Soul. The soul and the art combined, making him become an ice dragon and boosting its power.
[It also helps emphasize its weaknesses.]
An expert that could contrain his elemental soul could make use his reckless charge and inflict serious damage.
A shame Zhuo Fan was just the type.
With a nasty smirk, Zhuo Fan flew straight at the dragons.
Boom!
His previous spot was assualted by the ice dragon’s explosions, the coldness spreading out and freezing everything around the tavern before disintegrating.
As for the dragons, they were still around despite the move having ended, turning towards Zhuo Fan in the air and chasing after him.
[Divine Eye of the Void’s 1st stage, Shift!]
Zhuo Fan grinned at the nine dragons as his right eye shone golden.
Boom!
The nine dragons clashed in the air and unleashed their icy power, turning the area into ice before crumbling to glittering ice particles.
Whoosh!
Zhuo Fan then appeared elsewhere, giving the nine dragons a mocking grin. Wu Randong was pissed more than ever, roaring and sending the dragons after Zhuo Fan again.
Zhuo Fan had the Divine Eye of the Void as his ace, always keeping him out of danger while the dragons kept blasting the air with ice.
Wu Randong’s face twitched, incensed at his futility, but also grave, knowing know just how strong Zhuo Fan was.
He simply breezed through the blast without a care, proving the gap between the two. It was so large that the other did not feel like fighting back.
The weaker party would make the sensible choice and run away.
But Wu Randong no longer had that option, not after looking at Zhuo Fan with such bloodshot eyes. He didn’t want to beat Zhuo Fan now, at the very least a bruise or a cut.
That would be enough to break their deal…
Wu Randong howled again, the nine ice dragons exploding with coldness and even freezing space, dying it white.
The clear sky was now covered in dark clouds, pouring down snowflakes. And with the dragons’ roars, a savage storm brewed around Zhuo Fan, blocking every direction.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Now this is his actual power. This guy is the type to harass until he’s beaten into the ground. I was kind enough to show him reality but it just didn’t reach him. Oh well, he-he-he…”
Zhuo Fan grinned, pulling his sleeve with a giddy look and an evil smile.
“It’s brother!”
In another side of town, Wu Ranze was talking business in a brightly lit castle. Seeing the disturbance outside and the snow storm, he shouted, “Damn that fool! He’s making it hard for me again!”
Their father frowned and cursed, “What are those servants doing? Did they let him run free and cause chaos? If they ruin my biggest deal, they’re finished!”
Wu Randong knew his father and brother had to be talking about him, or more like cursing, but he didn’t care, still doing his thing in trying to score some kind of hit.
With another draconic roar, the nine dragons’ power reached its peak, spreading in the air and on the ground. The dragons then flicked their tails, targeting Zhuo Fan, only this time way faster than before.
The dragons as well, no longer charged like a stampede, but coming from all directions, to seal Zhuo Fan’s escape.
Though Zhuo FAn just stood there, with only his right hand releasing a scarlet light, shimmering the air around it from his raw power.
Divine Eye of the Void’s 4th stage, Space Crusher!
Even as the nine dragons were close to reache him, Zhuo Fan wouldn’t budge, sporting a creepy grin as his right eye shone in four golden halos.
Hum~
A thousand meters around Zhuo Fan shimmered strongly, wearing down even the air itself as explosions sounded off. As for the nine dragons, eight howled from being fakes, crumbling into glittering ice.
The last one remained though, growling and forced itself forward as it shook under the attack. In the end, it swished its tail and was forced to fall back.
“Ha-ha-ha, it clearly points out the real body!”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed and flew for the ice dragon, catching up to it in seconds and giving it a mean punch, “Of the nine dragons, eight were of Yuan Qi, and only the last one was due to soul harmony, allowing you to withstand the crumbling of space. Second young master, your attack has no effect on me.”
Bam!
The dragon howled and spat blood again and again having suffered such a heavy blow, sent into the ground and leaving a hundred-meter wide crater.
Once the dust cleared, what was left was an ashen youth, with blood at the mouth.
Zhuo Fan drifted over and chuckling, “Well, wanna continue?”
“Humph, guess you win this time. But don’t get too smug, Serene Shores Trading won’t let this matter stand. You’re dead for sure!” Wu Randong spat through gritted teeth and walked away.
Zhuo Fan’s casual tone reached him, “You really don’t want your company to make such a big deal with me?”
Wu Randong winced, but covered it well, showing a mocking smile to Zhuo Fan, “There won’t be any deal! You hurt me so don’t think my father will just work with you. You should be worried about coming out alive, rather than an impossible deal!”
“Is that so? Here I think your brother is much more keen on trading than your situation. Oh, wait, he never cares about you at all, only making deals.” Zhuo Fan mocked.
Wu Randong’s face shook, “My brother is my brother, and dad is dad. It’s still father who has the final say!”
“Seeing their attitude you’ll know I’m right. Just from your brother’s status in the company and his style, I can tell your father’s as well.”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “If your father loved you at all, your brother would’ve shown something for you, hatred or caring, but he has nothing. This goes to show, second young master must have a tough time within your house…”
“Shut up!”
Wu Randong screamed, pointing at Zhuo Fan, “Who do you think you are to tarnish our company’s name? Let me tell you, your deal is through! So get lost, now!”
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “What did I say? You’re clearly aiming for a broken deal. Are you showing your true colors at last?”
Ugh!
Wu Randong’s lip trembled, lost for words.
[Who is this guy? Always seeing through my intent and attacks…]

chapters.title: Chapter 958: Better Not Regret It
chapters.content:
Chapter 958: Better Not Regret It
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Are you looking to mess up the deal?”
Wu Randong stood dumbly under Zhuo Fan’s scrutiny, “Feel like sharing why? Given enough reason, I may be inclined to let this deal fall through like you want.”
[What?]
Wu Randong gave Zhuo Fan an incredulous look, “Aren’t you after the commercial line? If the deal is off, how are you going to use it?”
“You don’t have to worry about that. That’s the kind of guy I am, casual, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, using his guile to sway him, “Second young master, I’m more than sure of your position in the company. You’re an eyesore to your own family, unable to do even the most menial tasks, just like a dead weight.”
“Why you…”
“Before you deny, know that I’m right.”
Zhuo Fan continued, “You can’t strike deals, you can’t break them, you’re weak, and you can’t change my mind. The trade between me and your father and brother won’t be influenced by you. And if you had it in you, you’d have gotten them to break it off already instead of looking to take it out on me. In other words, I’m the only person that can help you. And all I want is to hear your story. Or is it that there isn’t one, with second young master wanting to make a scene out of anger? Are you that much of a child? Of course your dad won’t care about you!”
Wu Randong’s lip shook, staring at Zhuo Fan, and finally sighing, “Fine, you wanted my reasons, here they are. I hate the company. I don’t want it to grow any bigger, I want to destroy it!”
“Why? You’re the second young master and only have to gain from its development.”
Zhuo Fan found a nice ol’ chunk of rock to sit on and look at his furious face, “I’d get it if it came from the guards, being annoyed by their boss and having a hard time. Yet a successor like you, instead of vying with Wu Ranze for the lead, you want to run the family business into the ground, with everyone losing. I gotta say, you’re a true prodigal son to want to destroy your family. Or is it envy from seeing your brother taking the power? Spite makes more sense in this case. Some people would rather destroy what they can’t have. I’ve seen plenty of those to last a lifetime…”
“You’re the spiteful one! I’m a man of virtue and it won’t matter even if I have no real power. How could I just lust for power?”
“Why then…”
“They’re all dead inside!”
Wu Randong squinted and gnashed his teeth, “You went into the company and you’ve seen bowing and scraping, right?”
Zhuo Fan paused and nodded, “It’s not all bad, bowing to…”
“That’s what you think!”
Wu Randong glared and roared, “Serene Shores Trading are always respectful to all clients. That’s how it spread throughout the lands. It used to be my pride as well, thinking being kind is what makes you strike big deals, respecting the other party to achieve your goal. But then I found that this nice attitude has made us weak. Not fighting back or never talking against any dissent aside, they still have a smile on their faces even after the other took a life. This is a disgrace.”
“A business is a negotiation. You respect me and I respect you, but if you don’t why the hell should I respect you? We’ve grown big enough already and don’t need to scrape for deals like beginners…”
“Naive!”
Zhuo Fan chuckled in disdain, “That’s why your dad gives you the cold shoulder, since you’ll get into trouble at some point. Because of your ‘virtue’, you don’t compromise, clueless that you’re still in the palm of the strong. One wrong move and your family is finished!”
Wu Randong cried out, “You’re also saying that?”
“Of course, since business and politics never match.”
Zhuo Fan waved his hand, his eyes shining, “Second young master, was the other party someone important to end up with a fatality?”
Wu Randong nodded heavily, “Three years ago, because the friend I grew up with found out Baili Jingyu took his sister, he barged into his manor to save her, yet they both died. I wanted to take some men and turn his home upside down, but brother told on me to father and had me confined home for ten years, afraid that I’ll offend that bastard. I realized then that our company has grown weak!”
“The company used to mock Baili Jingyu’s incompetence, with Goldbough City’s entire power belonging to us, but that’s when I knew that we were mocking ourselves. A useless fool is able to kill the guard of the merchant company that trades in all the lands without so much as a slap on the wrist. What will happen when a true city lord comes along? The bright and strong company on the surface is shaking from within.”
“Ha-ha, maybe not.”
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “The Serene Shores Trading only came along as a tool to connect the five lands by the five leaderships. But if a tool goes bad, you change it. You can’t get too confident in yourself. While your father and brother are indeed a bit too cautious. Regarding that incident three years ago, it didn’t matter if it was anyone else, but since it was Baili Jingwei that came to power, he knows what matters are crucial and where to draw the line. Did you think it’d change anything if you ruined his manor? You’re a tool that still needs using and Baili Jingwei won’t throw it away.”
“While on the contrary, if you had handed the boy personally to Baili Jingyu, then praise him of his qualities, showing your stance and being suave, the Prime Minister might be even willing to pay back in kind. The Baili clan has plenty of people and can do away with a dead weight, ha-ha-ha…”
Wu Randong gave him a long look and his face grew solemn.
[Right! We could’ve asked Baili Jingwei for help! But thinking they’re all Baili, maybe they’d cast out one of their own, since their relationship is strained…]
“All things hang in the balance. Being headstrong tips it.”
Zhuo Fan had a vague smile as he muttered, “Serene Shores Trading’s pursuit for money made it lack in many areas, making it weak despite its tough front. As for the second young master, he’s too rash and impulsive. It’s only a matter of time before he invites disaster. However, with me in control, there’ll be no problems. Also, unlike his other kin, Wu Randong is passionate and far easier to mold for my use. He’ll make a good lackey…”
“What did you say?”
Wu Randong was stunned at his prattling.
Zhuo Fan gave his most evil smile, “Second young master, I know why you hate the company. Deep love breeds deeper hatred. You hate its weakness, being unable to protect yours and losing your dignity as merchants. It’s one thing when you’re powerless and a whole nother when you’re not. The humiliation is unbearable, right? “
Wu Randong sighed and nodded.
“Great, I got the picture. Now let me ask you this, how will you handle the company if you were to lead it? Will you be a loose cannon like before?”
“Me?”
Wu Randong flinched, shaking his head, “No way, dad decided three years ago that brother will be following him. How…”
Zhuo Fan smirked, “Nothing’s absolute. I’m just asking if you’ll be the same if you’d be leading.”
Wu Randong’s heart shook.
