He never stopped to think of things like that, because he knew how he was, too reckless, unlike his able brother.
“You hate how weak the company became, but aren’t you even weaker?”
Zhuo Fan bewitched him, “Real strength comes from supreme power. If you want to change the company, you must first wield it. I’m here to make it happen but you don’t want to. Whatever happens to your company you don’t like, you’ll have no one to blame but yourself. You don’t want to be strong, so stop showing dislike for the cowardly company. All of you are the same!”
Wu Randong shuddered and grimaced. Then his eyes shone with conviction, “Whenever did I say I won’t take it? If dad gives me the power, I will make the company be born anew!”
“That’s the right attitude! The strong don’t whine, but think of how to step on the weak! Even if they aren’t weak, you’ll make them feel weak. Furthermore, the strong don’t make excuses for their failures because of other’s faults!”
Zhuo Fan gace a creepy chuckle, “Better not regret it later, second young master…”
[Regret?]
Wu Randong had a really bad feeling looking at his strange smile.
All that he could tell was that he had struck a deal with the devil…

chapters.title: Chapter 959: Believe It
chapters.content:
Chapter 959: Believe It
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Whoosh~
Wu Randong felt tense seeing the evil smirk on Zhuo Fan’s face, just as a dozen people landed in front of them, with his brother and father in the lead.
Looking at the ruins around, the two were furious and slapped his face red, “Bastard son, how much trouble do you need to give the company before it’s enough?”
“Guard, take second young master and never let him out of your vicinity or out of his room. I’ll be holding you responsible for him!” Wu Ranze was just as pissed, his eyes icy as he spat.
The guards nodded and grabbed Wu Randong, “Second young master, don’t make the eldest young master and the master any angrier. Just come with us.”
Ignoring them and even his father’s slap, Wu Randong kept staring at Zhuo Fan, more puzzled than ever.
Zhuo Fan returned a beaming smile…
“Sir, a thousand apologies, I’ve failed as a father and had my son disturb you. Please forgive me!” Ignoring his worthless son, the old man bowed before Zhuo Fan.
He was not just at peak Soul Harmony Stage but also the head of the company, yet here he was, bowing and being humble. It only worked to prove just how important the deal was for them.
“I hope my foolish son’s recklessness did not affect our deal!”
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Of course not, me and your second young master were only sparring. It wasn’t done out of recklessness. May I be presumptuous and assume that senior is the head of the Serene Shores Trading?”
“Yes, he is the Clan Head and the Serene Shores Trading’s chairman, Wu Jiangtao.”
Wu Ranze smiled and made the introduction, not forgetting to apologize as well, “Brother has crossed the line earlier and I’m most grateful for sir’s patience, in forgetting his transgression. I represent the company when I say thank you and I apologize.”
Wu Jiangtao bobbed his head, “Yes, sir’s endless patience is an outstanding quality of a great man. Our Serene Shores Trading is most honored to work with you, sir.”
The two of them kept being overly nice and humble to their client, all to ease his anger and not botch the deal of the century.
Zhuo Fan chuckled knowingly and nodded without a single trace of anger.
The father and son let out a long breath.
“Sir!”
Wu Jiangtao hesitated before getting straight to the point, “My company wouldn’t look into sir’s credentials, a practice my company has followed since it was founded and sir can trust us to use everything in our power to seal the deal. However..”
“What, Chairman Wu? You can just say it..”
“Having gone over to the city lord to get his approval, we had no choice but to report on the items being sent and forced to hand over sir’s items. He got so excited that…”
Wu Jiangtao was hesitating, putting on a heavy grimace, “He wants to meet with sir and discuss.”
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, “He wants to talk with me?”
“Of course, as sir entrusts us with all the process, sir wouldn’t want to have to deal with such pesky people. If there’s anything not to your liking, you can leave it to our company to proceed, although I’m afraid that it will take some time. Please be patient.”
Wu Jiangtao and Wu Ranze bowed, looking ashamed
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed, not minding it at all, “It’s fine, there’s no trouble. I’ll just have to go through with visiting the city lord. Since I received his invitation, I’ll be honored to go with you to meet with him, ha-ha-ha..”
“That’s great, we will take you there, sir. I’m afraid the city lord isn’t like us and will demand some information. Please forgive us, sir. If at any time his questions are invasive, sir can leave it to us.”
“You’re so thoughtful, thank you.” Zhuo Fan smiled.
The father and son were humbled, “It’s only right.”
Zhuo Fan followed the two to a grand castle, taking one hour to get there. There were guards on each side standing at attention to welcome them.
They were expecting them, not even sending someone to report their arrival, only showing them in with a bow, before an impressive door…
Knock~
“Who is it?”
“Lord, it’s Wu Jiangtao and we have brought the sir along, ha-ha-ha…” Goldbough City’s true man in charge laughed and was quite humble, as if this nominal city lord was the actual ruler of the city.
A bright laughter welcomed them, “Ha-ha-ha, great, please come in, mogul.”
The door opened for the trio and they entered with shock.
The decoration in this place had them… astounded, or maybe impressed?
The tons of jewelry and wealth notwithstanding, what drew the eyes were the many glittering plates dangling from the ceiling, feasting their eyes with their fragrance. On the floor, there were many channels crisscrossing around until they gathered up ahead to a huge pond, soothing their minds with the smell of wine.
In the middle of that pond was a ball of blubber, his lower body covered with silk, leaving his round and huge reflective belly out in the open.
Two girls hung on his arms, being quite promiscuous in their gestures.
[So this… thing was Baili Jingyu, the city lord of Goldbough City?]
[Well, he’s rotten enough to look the part and even stay at Radiant Stage for so many centuries.]
And he was of the imperial family, having the Patriarch’s blessings and a stream of endless pills and spirit stones that should’ve placed him on the finish line from the start.
Radiant Stage could be overlooked, but that protruding belly he cultivated all these years made him a first-class idiot.
[He must’ve used all those pills and money to get his fat to focus on his huge gut. Humph, one look at that hideous swell and you’d know it was built on people’s suffering.]
Zhuo Fan cared not about stuff like that, he only wanted to know when this fat man would let him use the commercial line.
“So this is debauchery in the truest sense. Lord must really enjoy himself, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan chuckled looking around.
The ball of fat lit up and gave a thumb’s up, “Sir is amazing to notice how I’m recreating the wine pond and lavish food plates of the ancients. We’re the same, ha-ha-ha…”
[Screw you! Even a blind guy could see where all this food and wine comes from. And what kind of ancients have you been following after, the dumbest kind?]
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched.
[This moron is rotten to the core, and the worst part, he takes pride in it.]
Letting Baili Jingwei stay in Goldbough City was giving tons of power over to Serene Shores Trading…
“Sir, I always ask every guest that comes here what they think of the decor. None of them answer, only you. I can tell you’re a man of culture, bosom buddies, ha-ha-ha…”
[Ugh, gag me with a spoon.]
Baili Jingyu stood and the silk on his lower body slipped and drifted with the wine and the girls at his side got a cape to drape on him. It was such an outrageous view that it even got the humbled Wu Jiangtao to turn his head with a red face.
Zhuo Fan was utterly speechless.
[Dude, this is just common courtesy and yet you’re rolling in it without shame. I’ve seen my fair share of degenerates, but you’re the very first to take so much pride in it. You’re a real… eye-opener.]
Though Zhuo Fan was not about to be so blunt, simply chuckling and nodding, “I must say, me and city lord are kindred spirits, friends in the same field. It must be fate that had us meet.”
“I like what you’re saying, sir. In all my years, no one has ever touched me with their words like you do. Sit, sir, please.”
Baili Jingyu’s eyes lit up in joy and pointed at an ostentatious chair at the side.
The father and son looked at each other and sighed.
[Baili Jingyu is such a degenerate he believes anything he says…]

chapters.title: Chapter 960: Ganging Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 960: Ganging Up
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Zhuo Fan and the Wu father and son pair sat down, with Baili Jingyu also taking the main seat, in all his indecency, with just a white silk across his bulging midsection.
As for the two girls, they kept serving him regardless.
“Sir, since we’re bosom buddies, I hope you won’t mind while I talk with you like this. Not like I’ll change even if you do. This is how I’ve always been in Goldbough City, a man of my word and headstrong, ha-ha-ha…”
“Lord, never ever change. I love your character!”
Zhuo Fan waved his hand, showing his admiration, “The Goldbough City is your domain and no one can stop City Lord from doing what he loves. Make sure to kick out anyone who disproves of it. Let the world see who’s the man in charge, who is the true city lord!”
Baili Jingyu’s eyes lit up, then stood and walked to Zhuo Fan. He reached out his blubbery hand and shook Zhuo Fan’s hard, “Brother, friend, why couldn’t I have met you earlier? Everyone says that I should act my station and be more of a City Lord, but only you understand my pain. I wish we could’ve met ages ago.”
“The feeling is mutual, he-he-he…”
Zhuo Fan smiled, taking his hands out of those trotters with a touched expression that got Baili Jingyu even more overjoyed.
This was what it meant to go on an endless search only to just look around to find what you needed.
Anyone would be thrilled about meeting a friend that knew you best.
The Wu father and son’s faces fell, their minds frantic. They worked so hard to get the capricious tub of lard to fall in line, yet this kid showed up with a few words and had him at his whim.
[Baili Jingyu has no sense of self. He’s only being overly nice since he’ll be leaving anyway. He wants nothing to do with you, unlike us who are stuck with you.]
[He doesn’t care, but we do. You just let yourself go and enjoy his praises. Anyway, that’s something we can never stomach.]
Ahe-hem…
Wu Jiangtao cut off the two’s touching friendship and smiled, “City Lord, sir wishes to speak with you about the commercial line. Would it be possible to go easier…”
“Uh, oh, well…”
Baili Jingyu’s face changed, taking back his fat hands and sitting in his chair with a frown, “It’s a problem alright. Chairman Wu, the commercial line is only used to transport goods, a channel approved by the other four states. But as it is on the empire’s domain, it’s under tight jurisdiction. It’s not something to be used on a whim. A serious inspection will have to take place each time it’s activated along with thorough examination. I may be the City Lord of Goldbough City and wield great power, but I have great responsibilities as well. I can’t just approve of it out of the blue. Who will be held accountable of any mishaps?”
Wu Jiangtao frowned and nodded, “We know lord’s pain but sir is our most important client. Please, City Lord, help us out and be a little flexible?”
“What flexible?”
Baili Jingyu huffed, “Do you know who’s behind him? Do you know anything about why he wants to use the commercial line? No, you don’t! So how can I be flexible? Every use of the commercial line must be put on record!”
Wu Jiangtao looked at Zhuo Fan and lowered his head.
Zhuo Fan looked at the three of them with an impassive face.
[Is the fatso that stubborn? He’s been dealing with Serene Shores Trading for years yet never gives them any leeway?]
[Two bosses can’t ever reach a consensus?]
[Then there’s this old Wu’s attitude. He’s acting like he’s doing me a favor but actually telling the fatso what to do.]
[Are they ganging up on me, is that it?]
Zhuo Fan squinted, putting his plan in motion, “Lord, as bosom buddies, I hoped to enjoy lord’s power for one tiny matter. But I guess City Lord is tied down by his duty, your power being so different from any other city lord and can’t do everything. I’m sorry for my rudeness, but I’ll have no choice but to travel all the way to the imperial capital and use talk with the other lords.”
Zhuo Fan stood up, walking and muttering, “The City Lord holds no power here and the city would be better off without one. What a pain in the ass.”
“Who said that?”
The ball of fat rumbled in anger, “My word is law here! If you want to do anything, I vow to make it happen!”
“Truly?”
“Yes!” Baili Jingyu nodded heavily.
Zhuo Fan spoke with a smirk, “I want to use the commercial line.”
“Not a problem. Old Wu, get it ready for him!” Baili Jingyu declared.
Ahe-hem…
Wu Jiangtao had to interject again with a red face, trying to get him to cool off, but the lord was blinded by anger, “Old man, enough with the coughing. Just go home and fix it! Anyway, it’ll take three days to get the commercial line ready. Then you can use it. I’m the lord here and what I say is law!”
“Thank you so much, oh great City Lord!”
Zhuo Fan cupped his hands and left. He only got to the door when the fatty shouted, “Wait, come back!”
“What is it, City Lord?”
“What thanks are you talking about?” Baili Jingyu felt his dignity insulted, put on the spot and made promises while forgetting to ask for demands. Only now he recalled that he was getting nothing for it, so he was downright blunt about getting a bribe.
Beaming, Zhuo Fan held out his ring and the fatty raised his and knocked with it.
Zhuo Fan wiggled his eyebrows, “City Lord, recognize this? It’s amazing!”
“A hundred thousand demon spirit stones?”
Baili Jingyu showed a wide smile and nodded, “Sir is a true friend indeed. Next time you drop by Goldbough City, don’t forget to pay your friend a visit!”
“Of course, City Lord, I’ll never forget you, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan left with a smile.
Bam!
The door slammed shut and Zhuo Fan’s face was ice cold,
[Damn you, Serene Shores Trading, you dare gang up on me?!]
[Too bad the moment I saw the fatso, I kicked you from being the middleman. But next time we meet, all your company will be in my pocket, humph…]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed and smirked…
After he left, Wu Jiangtao turned to the pleased fatty, “Lord, this isn’t anything like we agreed upon!”
“How so? Didn’t I get him to fork some more goodies?” Baili Jingyu fondled his ring and showed a depraved smile.
Wu Jiangtao’s beard shook, “We still know nothing about him. How are we going to hold talks with him, how are we going to negotiate?”
“Isn’t that your company’s rule, to not look into your clients?”
“This is different. You know very well how important these are!” Wu Jiangtao gnashed his teeth, “It’s beyond even the North Sea Gel. With a monopoly on it, nothing can shake our position in the five lands and all the profits will be ours. All the powers will scramble to buy from us and we’ll have control over the five lands’ market. And you will reap immensely from it!”
“You dare give something so serious to other lands? If Prime Minister gets word of this…” Baili Jingyu gave him a cold look.
Wu Jiangtao spoke, “Lord, we’re both clear of your integrity, or lack thereof. Since when did you care about the Sword Star Empire?”
“Ha-ha-ha, yeah, I never did since it won’t collapse. Anything good or bad to it won’t mean anything to me. All I care about is endless wealth!”
Giving the ring a sloppy kiss, Baili Jingyu grinned, “The demon spirit stones in here are way more than you got. With these, I can use them on the other nobles of the imperial capital and take it up a notch, he-he-he…”
[Narrow minded fool!]
Wu Jiangtao gnashed his teeth, “If we had used this chance to know more about him, we’d have a way to keep in touch, making our supply endless. But now, if he leaves for good…”
“He will be back.”
“How do you know?”
“Think about it. Such a big deal is only done with your Serene Shores Trading. And also, with how agreeable I was, he’ll be sure to return.” Baili Jingyu’s eyes flashed.
Wu Jiangtao’s face twitched and his face fell.
[This guy’s confidence is through the roof, eating up every praise the guy gave.]
[Though he’s right about one thing.]
Only their company got to make such a huge deal. He had nowhere else to go to with this.
The father and son eased their worries…

chapters.title: Chapter 961: Popular
chapters.content:
Chapter 961: Popular
Proofreader
: Papatonks
After thinking it over, Wu Jiangtao and Wu Ranze exchanged a glance and sighed in regret.
They planned on bringing Zhuo Fan to the city lord so they could flank him on both sides and gain his trust to lead to a better cooperation.
[But this guy broke it off completely!]
Baili Jingyu was so moronic and useless that a bit of praising got to his head and got him to accept anything on the spot.
Anyone that had met with Baili Jingyu had some, if not complete, disgust for this city lord over his degeneracy. To keep such revulsion hidden and simper in such a smooth way was an amazing talent in and of itself.
Wu Jiangtao took a deep breath and adressed Baili Jingyu, “City Lord, the talk now didn’t even earned us his indentity. What are we supposed to put on record?”
“Just put whatever. Haven’t we always been doing this?”
Baili Jingyu mocked, “Don’t think for a second that I don’t know what you’re doing. Only a couple of the transfers are genuinely reported every day while the rest are fakes. Humph…”
Wu Jiangtao nodded.
[Yeah, it’s hard to keep them all in the open. It’s easy to see it]
Wu Jiangtao sighed and left with his son.
However, Baili Jingyu’s drawn out voice came again, “Old Wu, do you have any good stuff around? Mind sending some my way?”
Wu Jiangtao jerked, knowing where he was going with this and turned to the the two girls, “Lord, don’t you already have them?”
“I’ve been upping my cultivation regime and need many more cultivation cauldrons…”
Wu Jiangtao sighed, “City Lord, it would’ve been so much better if that was so, and you wouldn’t have stayed at just the Radiant Stage. Why lie when you’re clearly out to have fun with them?”
“Yeah, I got bored of them and want new toys.”
No longer bothering to cover up his vices, Baili Jingyu spoke the truth. But then he changed topics, “Also, I don’t want someone from your clan. I don’t wanna get burned.”
Wu Jiangtao chuckled, “Lord, what’s that supposed to mean?”
“You know well enough.”
Baili Jingwu scoffed, “I didn’t use to see what you guys were up to or how things are done, but working together these past two years, even a fool would know. Three years ago, you sent that girl over so your son would make a scene and then threatened me to break it off with Baili Jingwei. Don’t think I don’t know what you’ve been doing these two years. Be thankful I’m still keeping the peace. All I ever care about is going on as I am, enjoying the carefree life of a city lord, so don’t ever try to play me!”
Wu Jiangtao nodded, “Alright, it’s not any trick anyway. I only did that because you were getting out of hand and needed to be reined in. Wealth and politics don’t match, the golden rule of our company. As long as you stick to your business, we’ll stick to ours. Get some rest, City Lord, I shall take my leave. Furthermore, I let you meet our client as you were as a show of strength. Next time, remember to have some decency. You’re the City Lord of Goldbough City, so act like it!”
Wu Jiangtao left with his son.
“It’s my business how I am, not yours, you old coot!”
Baili Jingyu roared behind them then put on a cocky expression as he returned to his wine bath, “What’s so wrong about how I am? Didn’t someone appreciate me just now? Humph, that sir has good eyes at least, a man of culture, he-he-he…”
Meanwhile, Wu Ranze sported a dark face as he exited the castle, “Father, I can’t believe that fool actually figured it out. We can’t have brother know about this, about sacrificing the brother and sister like that. He’ll blow things out of proportions!”
“I know that, but I never expected this to remain hidden forever.”
Wu Jiangtao turned cold, “To control the 250th City Lord, I had to take approapriate measures. The only reason I bother trying to keep it hidden from Randong is due to his temper. Anyway, watch your brother and don’t let him get close to that dumb city lord. Also, where is the client? We have to stick around as much as possible over the next three days and gain this big fish’s trust.”
Wu Ranze nodded with determination, “Don’t worry father, I’ll make it so he will be sure to cooperate with us indefinitely!”
Wu Jiangtao nodded, showing his confidence in his eldest son…
Over the next three days, Wu Ranze was hard at work as the best host out there to Zhuo Fan. His favoritism didn’t stop at showing him the best attractions in town, but also giving no small amount of pills and ores as gifts.
All for the sake of give and take.
Zhuo Fan struck many more deals with Wu Ranze and had given him hundreds of thousands of demonic spirit stones. The joy on Wu Ranze was obvious, taking it as a sign of future wonderful cooperation.
Thus, Wu Ranze threw himself completely into the task of looking after his most important client, while not forgetting to start selling his prized goods to the outsider; at a premium of course, and to the high society of the empire.
Money made the world go round. Baili Jingyu saw the Serene Shores Trading acting like the best host, and since he finally found a true friend who knew him best at long last, he started giving the same honor as well, showing Zhuo Fan the city and its impressive sights.
With the city lord and the company’s eldest young master tending to someone in full daylight, they began catching many eyes and curiousity as to Zhou Fan’s identity.
Of course, they learned nothing as not even the two hosts knew any more after so much research into anything that might give them the smallest idea as to who this mistery client was.
Towards a tight lip man such as Zhuo Fan, any other city lord would instantly grow suspicious and try to get to the bottom of this. Not this lord though, a hedonist who only cared about himself and had no right to even be a city lord to begin with, was content to let matters rest.
As for the Serene Shores Trading, they only had money in their eyes.
Like so, Zhuo Fan stayed in Goldbough City these three days without anyone finding anything about him. Now the commercial line was ready for his personal use.
All formalities were handled by the city lord. Money sure paved the way in this case.
Just as he was taking young Sanzi to go through and to western lands, a shocking news stirred the entire Sword Star Empire.
It led to Zhuo Fan, the vile demon, finally leaving his mark on the peaceful rich town of Goldbough, one of disaster.
“Prime Minister, Goldbough City’s lord, Baili Jingyu has sent a gift. May your future be limitless and live forever!”
In the Prime Minister’s house in the imperial capital, Baili Jingwei just entered his home with Shangguan Feiyun and Danqing Shen, when a servant bowed and presented a black stone.
Baili Jingwei frowned, “You mean that idiot Baili Jingyu sent this? Take it back. I’m going to see the Patriarch and have no time for gifts.”
“Er…”
The man hesitated. Baili Jingyu had warned again and again to give this gift to the prime minister and pave the way to his career. But now the prime minister wouldn’t even hear it.
Danqing Shen chuckled and advised, “Prime Minister Baili, why must you deny his kind intentions? Ha-ha-ha…”
“Dragon Cleaving Sword King, this guy is as useless as it gets from a human being, an annoying fly who clings to his miserable existence. His gift has strings attached, and I’m not about to gamble with the safety of the empire over some moron.” Baili Jingwei spoke coldly.
Shangguan Feiyun muttered, “He’s the lord of Goldbough City, where Serene Shores Trading is. Why then did you placed him there if you disdain him so much?”
“For the exact same reason as you mentioned.”
Baili Jingwei smiled, “Since coming to office, I’ve promoted trade heavily. By leaving any competent lord behind, then Serene Shores Trading wouldn’t have grown to this size. Since this dead weight was laying around, might as well use him for something. On one hand, he’s there as deterrence, to show that we still care about that place and not let the merchants go overboard. And two, he won’t cause any trouble to them. I bet that these past years, that old Wu must’ve gotten him to play along. Anyway, he’s there to keep things in balance and I don’t expect him to do anything worthy of note.”
“Ha-ha-ha, Prime Minister is so shrewd, using everyone to the bone. Not even a dead weight escapes you.” Shangguan Feiyun’s sarcastic laugh came, then turned to the black stone with a curious gaze, “What could this thing be? I’ve never seen it before.”
With a vague smile, the servant bowed, “Prime Minister and Sword Kings, this is a new item sold by the Serene Shores Trading, that’s all the rave right now. In just three days, the imperial capital’s high class have been fighting over it. City Lord had sent to all the princes and generals without any refusing him. Prime Minister, who only came back to imperial capital, isn’t yet aware of this…”
“Just what is it to make it so popular?” Shangguan Feiyun held it out of curiosity…

chapters.title: Chapter 962: Disaster Struck
chapters.content:
Chapter 962: Disaster Struck
Proofreader
: Papatonks
The servant was glad Sword King Feiyun showed any interest, bowing at once, “Sword King, this is called a demon spirit stone, very rare. Unlike spirit stones and sacred stones, it’s made of Yuan Qi that can be absorbed completely without having to transform it like spiritual energy. Great amount of Yuan Qi is at your fingertips, no longer suffering exhaustion while cultivating. It’s benefit is even more apparent at the cusp of advancing, pushing you forth without any impediment.
“My Lord has advanced once more after a pause of twenty years. The high class of imperial capital has also experienced swift growth and improvement. They have only words of praise for this demon spirit stone!”
“That good?”
Shangguan Feiyun’s brow shook, looking from the black rock to Baili Jingwei, “Prime Minister, since it’s so great, give it a try. Maybe in a few years you might reach the Genesis Stage and become seasoned in politics and in power, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Jingwei rolled his eyes, “Sword King Feiyun, since this rock caught your fancy, why don’t you try it? Maybe it will soon take you to Patriarch’s level, if not higher, beyond the entire world…”
Shangguan Feiyun chuckled wiht a shake of his head. He flicked his hand and the stone got thrown back to the servant with disdain.
The servant was stunned.
He’d been running around the imperial capital’s high class district for days now and everyone was excited by such an item, even fighting for it.
Even those clueless of its use changed tunes the minute they heard his explanation.
[So why are these three so disparaging of it?]
[Have they seen too much that they already knew of the demon spirit stone? That can’t be it, it’s obvious from their reaction that it’s their first time seeing it.]
That got the servant even more confused, sighing inside.
[This is the difference between true men and those in the secular world. They show no desire, even in the face of such a prized item. Truly, men of worth…]
“Go tell Baili Jingyu not to send any more of these to the imperial capital. Serene Shores Trading never lacked such items. I don’t care where they end up, so long as it’s not in the central area. Or they’ll have to answer to me!”
Then Baili Jingwei’s tone changed as he shouted, “Also, I didn’t put him there so he could use the official, military line for his convenience and send gifts all over the place. The next time I find he’s using it for something trivial like this, I’ll send him packing!”
The servant was dumbstruck.
[What is this? Is it wrong of the City Lord to use the official line to supply the imperial capital with such important goods?]
[Moreover, even if the grand Prime Minister doesn’t like the gift, he shouldn’t just banish it from the central area. This is something that can make many experts fly through the layers. It’s nothing but good for the empire.]
[My Lord can see it and so can Serene Shores Trading. It makes no sense for the Prime Minister and two Sword Kings not to understand this simple truth and shun such a great item. How peculiar.. Just what are they thinking?]
Danqing Shen came to enlighten him, “Kid, cultivation means going against natural order, a road fraught with suffering and pain. Only through willpower can you cross it and reap the rewards. That little bauble you brought in makes it too easy. Anything too good is against the world, against the essence of cultivation. That’s why Prime Minister had the foresight to forbid it from becoming mainstream in the empire.”
“We’ve been training for years and years, learning one crucial fact, haste makes waste.”
Shangguan Feiyun said, “After taking many pills to advance, time’s needed to stabilize the new power before one can continue cultivating, or mistakes will be made that affect your future. This thing might be taken by those rash and impatient youths, but to the Nine Sword Kings and some peak Genesis old farts, it’s frowned upon. Cultivation in the end is based on you and you alone. That is the only way to reach the top, and not through boosts. Using this thing will make things way too easy, making true experts a rarity. It’s only going to destroy many people’s lives in the end.”
“Prime Minister’s farsightedness is a true rarity. It’s amazing how beside we, old guys, knowing its detriment, Prime Minister as well could see it at a glance, ha-ha-ha.”
Eyes flashing, Baili Jingwei sneered, “I am no Sword King, obsessed with cultivation, but I can still see this truth. Everything is built on hardwork and not by taking the easy way out. Easy come, easy go. The easier it is to make experts using this thing, the faster we’re going to lose them. Everything is in balance. The more you’re willing to give, the more you’ll have to gain from it. Nothing can change this. Sometimes you’re greedy, but most times you need to reign it in, especially against something that moves your very soul. The bigger the greed, the harder the fall.”
“Prime Minister is so wise. I am in awe!” Danqing Shen nodded with a smile.
The servant was frozen in place. What should’ve been something that drove people crazy, these men in power saw it as nothing but a disaster.
[Men of real power see things through different eyes than the rest of us.]
So the guy looked at the rock in his hand with a new light. His early greed of wanting to skim some for himself was now gone, free of desire and no longer influenced by it.
[Yes, the world is in balance. The cultivators using the demon spirit stones might go fast, but they’ll never reach the top.]
[Taking one step at a time assures me endless potential. They only see what’s in front of them, while I keep my eyes towards the future.]
The guy gave three deep bows, looking grateful, “Thank you so much, Prime Minister and Sword Kings for the advice. I’ll never forget it. I shall take these demon spirit stones back and give Prime Minister’s word to my Lord.”
Baili Jingwei nodded and dismissed him.
“Prime Minister, something happened in the Jing manor…”
A sudden shout followed by hasty footsteps was heard as an honored Genesis Stage expert ran to bow before the trio in fear.
Baili Jingwei asked, “What is it? What happened in Jing manor?”
“Prime Minister, Yu manor is in trouble! Please come see, Prime minister…”
“Prime Minister, Master Lu is in trouble…”
“Prime Minister, General Qi has collapsed from heavy wounds…”
“Report!”
“Report!”
“Report!”
…
Shouts were prevalent for a long time as more and more people hurried over to report their own house’s serious problems. They were all nervous and all from important people, close to thirty houses.
Baili Jingwei had a dark look as he knew things were bad, “We’ll first check on Jing manor!”
“Yes!”
The group of guards nodded and followed. Danqing Shen and Shangguan Feiyun were idle right now so they went as well.
Baili Jingwei and his entourage arrived at a lavish manor, with a dazzling plaque hanging at the front gate, Jing Manor.
Baili JIngwei’s face darkened as he rushed inside to see Prince JIng’s crying concubines.
In the main hall, laying down was a husk of what looked like a human, completely black. On a much careful look, it was like a rock, reflecting the sun’s rays off him.
Yet all the women were around this strange rock and crying their hearts out.
“Where’s Prince Jing?”
Baili JIngwei looked around and demanded.
Wiping her tears, a woman looked at him through tears and gave a shaky bow as she pointed at the black humanoid rock, “Prime Minister, you’re finally here. There’s Prince Jing!”
“What?!”
Baili Jingwei gasped, “He’s Prince Jing? How did he end up like this?”
With quivering lips, the woman cried even harder, “We don’t know. Prince Jing has been in seclusion for the last two days and today came out overjoyed having finally reached the Genesis Stage after being stuck at peak Soul Harmony Stage for so long. But then he began convulsing, letting out a black energy as he turned stiff and ultimately taking this rocky appearance as he died…”

chapters.title: Chapter 963: March on Goldbough City
chapters.content:
Chapter 963: March on Goldbough City
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Baili Jingwei’s brow shot up as thoughts raced through his mind.
[How did this happen? Prince Jing’s death is just too odd!]
Danqing Shen and Shangguan Feiyun were listening in silence with baffling looks as well. In all their years of doing and seeing killings, there had never been one as weird as this one.
This situation was downright bizarre, so much so none could come up with any logical explanation.
The servant bearing gifts slipped over and so the black corpse then looked down at the demon spirit stone in hand with a deep frown, “That’s strange, why is it the same as the demon spirit stone…”
“What did you say?”
Baili Jingwei’s sharp ears picked his muttering and shot his piercing gaze at him as he demanded.
Flinching in fright, the servant stammered, “P-Prime Minister, I-I mean, the body of Prince Jing is similar to the demon spirit stone City Lord has asked me to gift…”
“Give it here!”
Baili Jingwei’s eyes shone and yanked the stone out of his hand. He went by the corpse’s side and compared, “It’s identical! Prince Jing has turned into a demon spirit stone!”
Sss~
Everyone around him gasped in shock.
[How does one even turn into something like that? This is absurd!]
Baili Jingwei’s brow shook, his fists clenched as he pondered. He turned his hard gaze on the women, “Prince Jing has been stuck at peak Soul Harmony Stage for three thousand years. How did he advance? Did he use something like this rock?”
“Yes, it was something similar.”
The women looked at each other before finally nodding, “He only had one hundred and twenty years left of his lifespan. If Prince Jing couldn’t advance in the next century, he would pass away. That’s why he’s been working hard on cultivating the past decades. It was around three days ago that someone had given him something to advance, but I never imagined that, that…”
The women burst out crying again.
Baili Jingwei had heard all he needed, setting his fierce eyes on the servant, “Tell me, have you been here, three days ago, to give Prince JIng such a stone?”
“Uh, yes…”
The servant then exclaimed and hesitated, “Per City Lord’s request all high class in the imperial capital have been given some…”
Baili Jingwei’s face was hard as ice, his eyes stony, “Then, all those manors from which the guards came to my house to report, have you been to those places as well?”
“Uhm, that does seem to be it…”
“Then how many more have you gone to?”
“Uhm, two thirds…”
Baili Jingwei gnashed his teeth as he roared, “Guard, take this guy and go to every house that hasn’t come to report. Take every one of those demon spirit stones and destroy them. The rest of you, come with me to the other manors.”
“Yes, sir!”
The guards bowed and split in two groups, one to collect the black rocks, the other to investigate the reports with Baili JIngwei.
Prince Yu, Master Lu, everyone actually that had been reported were turned into the same kind of weird black rocks as Prince Jing. All of them had been frantic in cultivating with the demon spirit stones these past three days.
The answer couldn’t be more obvious. Shangguan Feiyun mocked every single petrified corpse, “Morons, this is what greed gets you. What’s worse is, you’re all officials of the empire yet so gullible to believe in this fantasy. Greed is the root of all evil. You haven’t even reached the end of your days yet have destroyed yourself over it, ha-ha-ha…”
“Yeah, these are all important officials of the empire, some in the court while others in the military. With dozens of empty seats now, it’ll be hard to find able replacements.”
Danqing Shen’s cold eyes watched everyone, “This is bound to reap the lives of a third of the empire’s officials. Prime Minister, you’re about to be a whole lot busier soon, with no one else to delegate work.”
Shangguan Feiyun eyed him and both of them cracked up.
Not like they gave a damn about these poor gullible souls.
[Good riddance. They asked for it.]
The Prime Minister was the one who got the short end of the stick, with no one left to help him out, he was going to have many sleepless nights soon. He’d hardly have the energy to go visit any other Sword King.
Danqing Shen enjoyed his misfortune. Now those piercing eyes would no longer be on them.
It was getting restless having Baili Jingwei behind them every step of the way.
Only the prime minister was about to blow a gasket. A third of the imperial capital’s high class just died. It was bound to affect the empire’s stance. The longer this gross lack of manpower remained, the worse the decline.
This was a matter of utmost importance that had to have a guilty party. As for who, that was left to who did it.
Baili Jingwei squinted and spat through gnashed teeth. “Guards, assemble the entire imperial guard and open the official line! We’re marching on Goldbough City! Humph, Baili Jingyu, you waste of a man, you wanted to bribe, is that it? I hope you’re happy, your bribes have brought me down on you like the king of hell to put you in your place!”
The two Sword Kings were laughing it up in the background…
Meanwhile, back to the city of gold, the clueless city lord and Serene Shores Trading were relishing in their sudden immense success.
“Sir, unlike the official line, the commercial line needs time to be set up. From the central area’s hinterlands there are thousands upon thousands of miles before we reach western lands. The amount of sacred stones needed is sizable. Now, after three days of work, the array is ready for sir to use. Please forgive us for the delay.”
Behind Serene Shores Trading’s main manor, sacred stones were glittering like stars in their specific position. A quick look will easily tell there were millions upon millions. In the center of it there were also flashes of lightning and strong gales as a pitch-black tunnel warped the space.
Eldest young master wore the same fake smile as always, standing before the portal and bowing to Zhuo Fan. Around him were many Genesis Stage elders, over a hundred, here to send Zhuo Fan off.
This went to show just how important this client was to Serene Shores Trading.
Zhuo Fan nodded and placed Gu Santong on his back with a smile, “Please, you’ve been looking after me these days and I can’t thank you enough. Moreover, this parting won’t be forever. We’ll be working together for years to come. I will have to trouble you then again.”
“Truly? That’s great, my company welcomes you with open arms, ha-ha-ha…” Wu Ranze laughed and bowed.
While still clueless as before pertaining to who Zhuo Fan was, he was happy knowing their dealings wouldn’t end soon. They didn’t really care about his identity anyway. And since he was tight-lipped about it, they had to drop it.
They were content with just being his partner in all the deals and gaining so much from them. Merchants were inseparable from profits. They only had eyes on money and more money. Friendship was never part of the package, nor was one’s identity a necessity.
“Sir, how will we keep in touch?”
“I’ll contact you.”
Zhuo Fan gave a vague smile as he changed topics, “How come I don’t see the City Lord around? These days he has been quite close to this fellow brother.”
Wu Ranze showed his disdain as he whispered, “Sir, City Lord only thinks with his lower head and betrays anyone for money. It’s best if you don’t have high hopes for him. Just as sir’s about to leave, the prettiest flower of southern lands arrived in our city, Immortal Healer Murong Xue. He of course was happy to welcome her. To show off his power, he also had father go along. That’s the only reason father would not be seeing sir off.”
“Southern lands’ Immortal Healer Murong Xue?”
Zhuo Fan got curious, “I remember now, she’s the sister of Murong Lie the Ardent Sun Sword God, the best in southern lands. She sure has a lot of guts to waltz into the central area with how tense the two lands’ relations are.”
Wu Ranze nodded, “Sir, the people of the central area cherish their reputation. We aren’t about to use the best in southern lands’ sister to threaten them into submission. Moreover, Prime Minister Baili Jingwei is an expert in mind games. He had succeeded in pursuing Danqing Shen and Shangguan Feiyun to defect to the central area, the once best in western lands and eastern lands respectively. He would never lower himself to touch his sister. That would cut off any means of peace talks. This makes the central area the safest place for Murong Xue. No one will be attacking her, not when they’re actually protecting her. Sure, there are those lusting after her as well…”

chapters.title: Chapter 964: Poisoned Swan
chapters.content:
Chapter 964: Poisoned Swan
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Zhuo Fan chuckled with a resigned shake of his head, “Eldest young master is taking a stab at City Lord Baili Jingyu? But anyone would want to aim above their status, because everyone wants to have swan meat every day, only to realize in the end they had grown overconfident in their skills. Eldest young master, haven’t you wished of being a toad as well?”
“Ha-ha-ha, please don’t joke, sir, my toadie attempt ended in failure. She is the princess of southern lands, and there’s no way she’d look at someone from a mere merchant clan. Actually, business is like courting, the process showing results when each side has similar values while the talks would fail if the balance is tipped. From then on, I not once tried to engage in such businesses.” Wu Ranze showed a self-deprecating smile.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes glinted, “So you went after Murong Xue with the intent for business. I can see why you failed. But the defeat that time doesn’t seem to have taught you a lesson; your toad impulses are still there. Just that if by some chance you get to taste that lovely swan meat, wouldn’t you suffer in the end by finding out it’s poisoned?”
“What?” Wu Ranze was stunned.
Zhuo Fan grinned, “You’ll know soon enough. In any case, thank you so much. I’ll eagerly await our next cooperation.”
“You’re most welcome. It’s my company’s honor to have such dealings with a valued guest such as yourself. I hope the next time we collaborate, we’ll become closer!”
“We sure will, although I can’t say for sure if we’ll meet again, ha-ha-ha…” With a weird grin, Zhuo Fan gave him a long look and carried young Sanzi as he went for the commercial line, “Eldest young master, till next time, ha-ha, I hope we’ll see each other next time, though it might prove difficult…”
Whoosh!
The pitch-black portal swallowed him as he gave one last vague smile to Wu Ranze, leaving him standing there in doubt.
[What did he mean by that?]
A frantic elder ran before him, “Eldest young master, Miss Murong Xue’s carriage is about to arrive. I know your proposal failed last time, but business was still possible. Our branch in the southern lands needs the Murong name to work.”
“I know that. Now that the business with one valued client has been concluded, it’s time for the next.” Wu Ranze sighed and the whole group flew towards the city gate.
There was a huge crowd at the gates, with Baili Jingyu looking prim and proper in the lead and Serene Shores Trading chairman Wu Jingtao standing beside him, neither arrogant nor servile.
Rumble~
Loud noise grew bigger and bigger as a carriage drawn by three 3rd level spiritual beasts rushed towards the city at breakneck speed.
Zhuo Fan would’ve definitely flinched at such a view, since it was the same carriage that saved his son.
Ahe-hem…
Baili Jingyu coughed as the carriage slowed down. He put on a beaming smile, eager to welcome the new guests with the others close behind.
Hooo!
With a pull on the reins, the carriage slowed to a halt and a seventeen-year-old girl jumped out.
Looking at the sea of people, Zhui’er chuckled and looked back, “Young miss, by the looks of it, you’ve got another pursuer here.”
“Just some commoners, Zhui’er. Go right in.”
“Can’t, the people are blocking the road. Unless you want to trample them.” Zhui’er shook her head.
Baili Jingyu rushed over, simpering at Zhui’er then saying, “Welcome, welcome, Immortal Healer Murong! I am Baili Jingyu, the lord of this humble city. I’ve heard so much about you, that when I learned of your passing through here, I grew so excited that I could barely sleep in hoping to meet you. Now that we finally get to talk, would it be possible to allow me a glimpse of your fair face, my lady?”
[Obscene!]
[Immoral!]
[Swine!]
Such were the colorful thoughts of the people around him, knowing he was hitting on her for his own greed. Though none had the stomach to voice it.
While this guy here didn’t give a hoot about the city’s state, he was its lord and had some kind of dignity that shouldn’t be called into question so easily.
Then again, was Murong Xue a nobody? Would she just take his words? Of course…
“Is Serene Shores Trading Chairman, Sir Wu here?” Ignoring him completely, a melodic voice came from within the carriage.
The lecher instantly got hot and bothered the minute that soothing voice pierced his ears.
Wu Jingtao stepped forward and cupped his hands with dignity, “Miss still remembers me? I am most honored. How may I be of help? I’ll do all I can for Miss Xue!”
“It’s nothing much, just that I want to hurry back to northern lands, being travel-worn and wishing to use your company’s commercial line. Would it be possible?”
“Of course, no problem at all. I wholeheartedly approve of Miss’ request!” The one to speak was not Wu Jingtao, but Baili Jingyu, striking the perfect image of a local thug, “If this old man can’t lend you the commercial line, I will have the official line at your disposal instead. It should be far more convenient!”
Zhui’er’s face twitched when she heard the city lord’s outrageous attitude of an upstart.
[How the hell did he even become a city lord to begin with? He’s nothing but a thug.]
[With his type in every city, there’s no point of the four lands alliance, not when the Sword Star Empire would eat itself from the inside.]
Wu Jingtao gave him a look.
[This fool is like a whiny child that wants attention, so I’ll give it to him.]
“Since City Lord said so, I of course allow it. It shall be at Miss’ disposal when she wants it, ha-ha-ha…”
Giving Wu Jingtao a look, Baili Jingyu nodded in excitement.
[The old coot knows when to play along.]
“Then thank you Sir Wu and… City Lord.” Murong Xue had to pause there for a second.
Baili Jingyu beamed like a sun at noon, “It’s nothing at all, he-he-he…”
Whoosh~
Just then, several people flew down before the carriage.
Wu Ranze signaled his father that Zhuo Fan left and bowed to the carriage, “Miss Murong, it’s been a while. I welcome you to Goldbough City!”
“Young master Wu, hello, have you been well lately?”
“Thank you, miss, for your thoughts.” Wu Ranze showed his signature dead smile.
The voice from the carriage came after a long pregnant pause, “Young master Wu is still the same. I hope your company will grow even bigger in the southern lands.”
“Thank you, miss, for your thoughts.” Wu Ranze smiled.
Murong Xue shook her head.
[The eldest young master Wu still only cares about money, it’s the only thing he sees. He has no emotion whatsoever, just like before.]
Murong Xue felt disappointed, having felt something for him last time. But after finding out his character, disappointment hit. After all these years, this man had not shown a single change, not one ounce of growth, becoming such a letdown to her.
Baili Jingyu saw Wu Ranze being all friendly with her and felt envy. He butted in, of course, “Miss Murong, you’ve come such a long way to Goldbough City, allow me to present you with a gift.”
“It won’t be necessary, thank you City Lord!” Murong Xue shot him down flat.
Baili Jingyu didn’t know when to quit, pushing it, “Miss, you must accept my gift. As the City Lord, I vow to not disappoint miss!”
“You all know who my young miss is, right? You think just anything will catch her fancy?” Zhui’er mocked.
Baili Jingyu gave a dumb degenerate giggle, opening a box to reveal a black rock, “Miss, this is a very rare item that in your lifetime you’d never experienced such…”
His words got cut off as a black mist was coming out of his pores from his frozen body.
Bam!
He was then having violent seizures, collapsing and thrashing on the ground with foam at the mouth as black smoke oozed out of his body. In mere moments, his entire body turned pitch-black and hardened.
It was as if he was becoming the same black rock he was trying to gift, the same rock that had now rolled next to his stiff body.
Everyone cried out in panic, with Zhui’er shouting, “Miss, h-he…”
Whoosh~
A figure in white suddenly appeared, coming out of the carriage and standing before Baili Jingyu…

chapters.title: Chapter 965: Haunting Soul
chapters.content:
Chapter 965: Haunting Soul
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Skin white as snow, soft brows like a dancing willow, cheeks rosy like a fresh peach, delicate like a blade of grass, and eyes clearer than the purest spring were the only ways such beauty could be described, yet it still failed to do her justice.
Murong Xue had come out in the open, stunning every single person with her visage.
[She lives up to her name as the best beauty in southern lands.]
The ever writhing Baili Jingyu forgot all about his pain, as he looked at this angel that had graced him with her presence with a goonie look.
Murong Xue kept a frosty expression, checking his pulse and sending warm and fuzzy Yuan Qi in his body. She was better off not knowing, the discovery ending up being the shock of her life as she winced.
[Just what on earth is this?]
“Young miss, h-how is he?” Zhui’er rushed over, watching as Baili Jingyu was hardening under her very eyes and taking a dark color.
Murong Xue was grave, shaking her head, “I don’t know, his body is baffling. Something black is eating him from the inside, even my own Yuan Qi. I don’t know what that thing is, but it has to be brutal.”
Everyone else nodded while scared. They looked at her and wondered how Murong Xue was going to save him.
This young miss wasn’t just a way too pretty face, also known as an Immortal Healer and for good reason.
“Hey, what do you think you’re doing?”
Zhui’er shrieked, getting everyone’s attention. The ever blackening Baili Jingyu’s eyes drunk in Murong Xue’s every lovely and intoxicating feature as he strained with all his being to touch her perfect hand. It was like his life depended on it. His lust was plain for all to see, “Miss… Murong, you truly are… perfection…”
Everyone’s faces twitched in unison.
[A leopard doesn’t change its spots after all, especially a deviant like him. Death is just around the corner yet he still has the time to flirt with girls.]
Murong Xue grew icy, clenching her fists and gnashing her teeth. The only thing stopping her from lashing out and leaving a deep print on his face was his already wretched state.
She had seen her fair share of womanizers who only cared about flirting.
But in regards to Baili Jingyu, she needn’t bother with putting him in his place as his outstretched hand for her delectable soft skin stiffened in place. Though the desire in his eyes was never quenched, his body just wouldn’t follow along with his wants even as his last vestige of life flew away from him, swallowed by the darkness within.
He had become a black rock in the flesh, just like that demon spirit stone nearby.
Everyone was stunned by such a development. How could a healthy man, by all accounts, just turn into a rock without rhyme nor reason?
Moreover, his death was so queer that had everyone around feel a chill down their spine.
“Miss Murong, w-what just happened?”
Wu Jiangtao bowed to her and asked. Murong Xue shook her head with doubt, “I don’t know either. In all my years as healer, I’ve seen my fair share of odd illnesses, but never one as strange as this. It has similarities with poison, from such a violent reaction, but it really isn’t. It’s more similar to a demonic cultivator’s curse or demonic parasite, but even that isn’t entirely true. I just can’t explain it…”
Whoosh~
Hundreds of men suddenly showed up from the heart of the city in an unending stream. The man in front elicited endless gasps of shock from the crowd around, “Prime Minister, what has brought sir all the way to Goldbough City?”
“Where is that rotten bastard, Baili Jingyu? I’ve used the official line to go thousands of miles all the way over here, only to hear he’s out welcoming guests. Humph, now where is he? I have a score to settle with him!”
Baili Jingwei was livid, disregarding anyone around him,
As if on cue, all eyes fell on the weirdly shaped black rock on the ground.
Baili Jingwei followed their gaze and knew immediately what happened as he jeered, “This useless bastard got what he deserved to die the same way. You got lucky you got off so easily, or I would’ve made sure you’d leave squealing!”
“Prime Minister, can I assume from your words that you know what’s happening?”
Oblivious of the crimes Serene Shores Trading had committed, in Baili Jingwei’s eyes, Wu Jiangtao had the poor inspiration of putting himself up for a lashing as he bowed and scraped, “We just witnessed the City Lord die out of the blue. Can it be that something is going on?”
Baili Jingwei cocked an eyebrow and mocked, “Old Wu, you dare show yourself to me? Your company actually have no idea why he died?”
“Prime Minister, what do you mean?”
Wu Jiangtao jerked in fright. He felt like the usual Baili Jingwei who cherished talent and was nice to them was no longer around.
He looked royally pissed and it was their fault. They, however, were oblivious as to what wrong they might have commited to earn Baili Jingwei’s ire to such a degree as to make him lose his temper.
Looking at his dumb look, Baili Jingwei knew he was talking to a wall so he sneered, “Old Wu, you don’t know what fine work Serene Shores Trading has done? I came here to ask you where those demon spirit stones came from. You better have a good explanation!”
“Demon spirit stones?”
Wu Jiangtao and Wu Ranze shuddered, then gasped, “Prime Minister, y-you mean that the demon spirit stone…”
Humph!
Baili Jingwei flicked his wrist and huffed, “I don’t know from where you unearthed those rocks, but you went as far as working with that degenerate Baili Jingyu to spread it to the officials in the imperial capital. You know how that turned out? In just three days, a third of princes and generals that used your special rock have turned black and stiff. They died without even knowing why. The death of the empire’s foundation shook the entire nation. Who do you think is to blame for such a tragedy? Just where the hell did you get it from?”
Everyone from the Serene Shores Trading gasped, then they looked at the demon spirit stone on the ground with dread.
This tiny little thing ruined close to half of the empire’s officials.
[This is a disaster!]
The Wu clan was done for!
Serene Shores Trading had been in the business for thousands of years, only to be cut down in one day…
Wu Jiangtao was ashen and shook like a leaf. He staggered and blood spilled from his mouth, looking to be taken by despair.
“Prime Minister, our company has sold the demon spirit stone but it wasn’t us who made it. It came from a client. We don’t know either how…”
Wu Ranze rushed to bow and plead, feeling unease as well.
Baili Jingwei mocked, “A client, who? Tell me his name, his background, his credentials, everything!”
“Well…” Wu Ranze’s face fell, “Prime Minister, you know our business model as well. We never ask our clients anything unless they wish to share it willingly. All we know about him is that he wanted to go to western lands and just used the commercial line while taking an unconscious kid with him…”
“What, a child?”
The rage Baili Jingwei had so far turned into complete disbelief, “What kind of child? How old? How did both of them look?”
Wu Ranze bowed at once and replied, “Prime Minister, the child looked to be an eight-year-old, quite adorable. Only he seemed to have suffered heavy wounds, always unconscious. As for the sir, he was thin, but very shrewd and good at negotiations. No matter how hard I tried, not once did I manage to get any info out of him…”
“Impossible! He didn’t die? How is this…”
Baili Jingwei shuddered and said in disbelief, “He should’ve been pulverized from Dragon Cleaving Sword King so how is he still among us…”
“Young miss, doesn’t that sound like that Gu Yifan we just saved…”
“Zhui’er, quiet. This isn’t our problem!”
Zhui’er couldn’t help herself from whispering to Murong Xue when she heard them talking, but the miss warned her. Baili Jingwei’s ears however, were just too sharp and gasped, “You met them? He’s called Gu Yifan? When?”
“Three days ago we rescued a child and a man from snow. The older one called himself Gu Yifan.” Seeing Baili Jingwei staring hard, Murong Xue spoke of their encounter.
Baili Jingwei grimaced, his eyes shocked to the core, “Gu Yifan, you’re like a haunting soul…”

chapters.title: Chapter 966: Clan Ruination
chapters.content:
Chapter 966: Clan Ruination
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“What, Prime Minister knows him?” Wu Ranze only now saw Baili Jingwei so baffled and cried out.
Baili Jingwei squinted and gnashed his teeth, “Not only know, but he even humiliated me. I thought I got rid of him for good, but… Now everything’s clear. Gu Yifan, this was just another one of your twisted schemes to destroy the Sword Star Empire. Well the joke’s on you. As long as I’m around, you’ll never succeed!
“Humph, so what if a third of officials are dead? I just need a bit of time and everything will be patched up. So what if you stole the Soaring Sword? The Patriarch is out of seclusion and the Nine Sword Kings have gathered. The sword will soon be returned. A puny and lone Radiant Stage punk has nothing on me, Gu Yifan!”
Everyone heard Baili Jingwei’s declaration and now knew the truth.
[He not only knows him, but they’re mortal enemies.]
But who could be able to get their brilliant Prime Minister so crazed over one guy?
[He must be something to fight Baili Jingwei on equal footing.]
Murong Xue gasped.
“Young miss, who knew the ones we saved would turn up to be so important? He even has the renowned Baili Jingwei worried.”
“Not just worried, but threatened.”
Murong Xue sighed, “Brother once said Baili Jingwei is the Unsung Sword King; just as good. But to see him so furious over one person and losing himself over it, one can see that Gu Yifan is more than he seems.”
Zhui’er giggled, “Does that mean we saved the right guy three days ago? The enemy of our enemy is our friend. Saving Baili Jingwei’s mortal enemy will make this wise Prime Minister lose his focus and will make our grand plan of making the four land alliance fruitful. Once we get back, remember to mention it to Clan Head and get something for it, hi-hi.”
“You think it’s some feat? If I had to do it again, I would have never saved him!” Murong Xue lamented.
Zhui’er flinched, “Young miss, don’t you always say that saving a life is better than any honor? Why…”
“Yes every life is precious, but saving a demon will plunge the world into chaos.”
Murong Xue sighed and glanced at Baili Jingyu’s black corpse with pain, “He’s so malicious and enigmatic. Who knows how many other cruel things he might do. And all of this is my fault. I can only hope evil hasn’t consumed him, that he will return to the right path and do good with his life.”
Glancing at Murong Xue then at the black corpse, Zhui’er fussed, “But that’s our enemy lying dead there…”
“No matter who it is, all life is precious. None deserve such a cruel ending. It’s against all I stand for. No matter what, evil is evil and demonic is demonic. It doesn’t matter where he stands, he will never be on our side!”
Murong Xue shook her head, reaffirming her staunch belief she held within herself. Zhui’er nodded, “Oh, got it. The next time we see him, I’ll get rid of this demon for you, young miss…”
Murong Xue chuckled and shook her head.
[Just from how serious Baili Jingwei is treating this Radiant Stage cultivator, you can see how problematic he is. Yet a girl thinks she can best him?]
[Save yourself the humiliation by keeping your bragging to yourself…]
“Prime Minister Baili, since you know who he is, I ask that you seize him at once. My company, spread throughout the lands, will do everything to help.”
Seeing the deep loathing in Baili Jingwei, Wu Ranze bowed and declared.
Baili Jingwei was not about to let this disaster they caused slide with just that.
Baili Jingwei wore a cruel smile and said, “Eldest young master Wu, I’m an official, not a merchant, so don’t try to haggle with me. Help me? Just how much power do you think your Serene Shores Trading has in the world? Don’t you fear those leading still? Also, I couldn’t get him in the central area, yet you think you can do it in any other area? And speaking of, why the hell would I trust the same person that helped him escape using the commercial line?”
“Prime Minister, you have to believe me, my company will…”
“Enough, Ranze!”
Wu Jiangtao shouted at him to stop his desperate attempt at getting out of it scott free.
Wu Jiangtao’s eyes shone and spoke through gnashed teeth, “Ranze, don’t waste your breath. Prime Minister spoke clearly. He’s an official and not a merchant. He doesn’t bargain, but goes is after settling this matter. With Gu Yifan’s whereabouts unknown and the empire losing close to half of its high class, shaking the world, someone must take the blame. I believe Prime Minister wants our company and Baili Jingyu to be the fall guys.”
“Ha-ha-ha, Old Wu, you haven’t lost your touch to see the obvious.”
Baili Jingwei slowly clapped, “I don’t care how involved you are in this, whether intentional or not, but since you’re in this from the start and it has turned out to be quite the mess, you’re liable to pay the price. It’s the only way I can present His Majesty and Patriarch with an explanation. This is my accomplishment as a politician, always finding the perfect answer, while ignoring the right and wrong.”
Wu Jiangtao’s face shook and took a deep breath, “Then, Prime Minister Baili, how big do you think it has become? Can my life bear it?”
“Don’t you think one meager life for half of the empire’s officials is a little thin?”
Baili JIngwei fixed his cold stare on the old man, “Old Wu, the empire thanks you for all the work you have done these millennia in connecting the five lands. Too bad this grave matter made Serene Shores Trading no longer needed in the central area…”
Wu Jiangtao shuddred at the heavy news, closing his eyes.
The other merchants glared at Baili Jingwei with clenched fists.
Behind Baili Jingwei, all those Genesis experts release their mighty aura, filled with bloodthirst.
Wu Ranze started begging for mercy, “Prime Minister Baili, we can talk about this…”
“Ranze!”
Wu Jiangtao’s shout echoed, giving his intelligent son a warm smile, “Ranze, I always told you business and politics don’t mix. But I never finished it. Wealth can only get you so far, that one’s use has an end, and that everyone’s expendable. Business grows with the high class and falls with it. Prime Minister has taken such a clear-cut stance with us because he believes we have outlived our usefulness. In other words, Prime Minister’s plan to dominate the five lands has begun. Our company, connecting them is no longer deemed important.”
Baili Jingwei showed a vile smirk, “Old Wu, I never knew you had such foresight for a businessman. Yes, with Patriarch coming out of seclusion and the Nine Sword Kings gathering, fighting the other four lands won’t be an issue. Once the world is under one banner, there won’t be any need for middlemen. While this matter had been the fuse, it was only a matter of time before Serene Shores Trading would be cut off.”
“Prime Minister Baili, you’re a fearsome politician. Everyone says that merchant can’t part with their wealth, but politicians? Shameless and unscrupulous, never deserving of any friendship.”
Wu Jiangtao smiled and sighed, “However, Prime Minister, I don’t think it’ll be that easy for you to remove my company, ha-ha-ha. Ranze, I always say your brother is impulsive, but now it’s my turn to be so. Guards, our company will fight them to the death! Even if we all die, we’ll take them down with us!”
“Yes, sir!”
The men bowed and unleashed their power as they charged.
Baili Jingwei had a cold smirk as he flicked his hand, letting the Genesis guards behind him attack, “I knew you were a tough nut to crack, old man. Why do you think I got the imperial guard to come? Ha-ha-ha…”
Bang~
“Aaaah~!”
The sky rumbled under the loud explosions and shouts as the experts from both sides drew blood from each other, all for the purpose of killing the other.
Serene Shores Trading had plenty of strong guards, but could they match the imperial guard?
Casualties soon mounted to a high degree as howls echoed.
Wu Ranze panicked, “Father, we won’t last much longer. Let’s retreat!”
“And where should we run to? There’s no place to go!” Wu Jiangtao sighed and shook his head in despair.

chapters.title: Chapter 967: Lone Survivor
chapters.content:
Chapter 967: Lone Survivor
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Eye twitching, Wu Ranze looked at his father, “What is the point of fighting Baili Jingwei to the death? We’re only dying sooner. Father, this isn’t like you!”
“Yes, not me at all, but like your brother.”
Wu Jiangtao smiled, “Despite lashing out and cursing your brother, I never hated him for who he is. I even felt reluctant to change him.”
Wu Ranze shook and looked at his father in shock.
With a casual chuckle, Wu Jiangtao sighed, “All of us have been impulsive in our youths, but after seeing too much along the years, we smoothened our rough edges and turned to guile. The world matured me to be able to stand and I changed you so there would be no problems appearing. But I like how your brother always tries to mess things up; he reminds me of myself back in the day. Since our new way is unable to keep us alive, let us be true to our natures, that reckless youth. This way we get to buy Randong some time…”
“Buy time?”
“We’re businessmen to the bone and Baili Jingwei will never let us go. Unlike us, Randong might survive given his rash temper, since Baili Jingwei might ignore someone like him.”
Taking a deep breath then exhaling, Wu Jiangtao closed his eyes, “I always dreamed in my youth, of having two sons, one outstanding to take on my business, and one ferocious that is to be ignored, for the harsh day that spelled doomed for the clan and he would be alive to carry it on. Bugs are good at staying alive, not because he’s tough, but because no one’s looking at him. Let Randong have a fulfilling life in our stead. This is what his father and brother should do for him. It’s not like we can run away from this anyway…”
Wu Ranze felt a shock pass through him and sighed in the end, “Yeah, I never did anything for him. Now, at least, I can help him survive. I hope he’ll live past today…”
Wu Jiangtao gave a deep nod.
At this moment, father and son no longer worked for money, their eyes turning warm, despite watching the corpses and blood soaking the ground of their clansmen.
It was because they had no fear and felt calmer than ever having found a reason to fight…
Murong Xue sighed.
[Why are people so oblivious? Why do they only value life when it’s about to slip away from them…]
In the Serene Shores Trading manor’s basement, one lonely man sat on a chair surrounded by many barriers with hazy eyes.
“That’s strange. Just what did he mean?” Wu Randong was still contemplating.
Bam!
The huge sound roused him from his thoughts, seeing an old man smashing into the room, all bloody.
Wu Randong gasped, “Elder Yu, what…”
“Second young master, don’t ask and just run…”
The elder made a sign and the barriers opened. He grabbed his hand and ran.
Wu Randong was becoming anxious, “Elder Yu, what on earth is happening?”
“Second young master, Baili Jingwei has come with his men to destroy us. The Wu clan is being killed off as we speak!”
“How could it have come to this?”
“It’s all that demon spirit stone’s fault! I fear the chairman and eldest young master are now…” The elder’s voice trailed with dejection.
Wu Randong was overwhelmed, his heart consumed by the devil’s words.
[Better not regret it later…]
“It’s him who ruined us…”
Wu Randong’s gaze narrowed and stiffened, carried on only by Elder Yu as he fled.
Bam!
The wall broke just then as the two reached the outside, but what they saw was hell.
Wails of agony and streaks of blood tore the sky as thousands of people were in bitter struggle with one another. Lives were reaped at every second, slumping in the blood of this hellscape.
Wu Randong stood frozen in place.
Elder Yu shouted at him to wake up and pointed at the commercial line still activated since they opened it for Zhuo Fan, “Second young master, use the teleportation array and leave! I’ll cut it off once you’re through!”
“Elder Yu, I-I won’t go. I can’t abandon father and brother, or you. I can’t go on alone…”
“Second young master, this is no time to be stubborn. I’ll clear a path for you!”
Elder Yu gnashed his teeth and grabbed Wu Randong while flying for the teleportation array. He met two Genesis Stage experts midway, risking his own life to force them back, but also suffering greatly for it.
Regardless of his own life, he took Wu Randong to the teleportation array and made the sign special to the Wu clan. With a hum and thunderclaps, the center of the array sported a black portal with a hazy image inside.
Elder Yu shoved Wu Randong towards it, “Second young master, go!”
“No, Elder Yu! We’ll all go!” Wu Randong grabbed his hand and wouldn’t let go.
Giving a wide smile, the elder nodded in contentment, but then many figures arrived.
“Look, someone’s activated the commercial line to flee! Stop them!”
“Rotten old man, who the hell is that kid! You won’t get away that easily!”
“By order of the Prime Minister, leave none alive. There will be no survivors!”
The shouts carried thick bloodlust as they charged over. Elder Yu hardened and used Yuan Qi to send Wu Randong flying into the portal.
“Elder Yu!”
Wu Randong howled as the elder grew smaller and said with a fond smile, “Second young master, you’re not as able as eldest young master, but we, oldies, always liked your character. It’s like looking at our younger selves. Also, the chairman never hated you. Please don’t hold it against him. You are the last hope of the Wu clan and must live on!”
“Stop them, they’re escaping!”
The incoming men rushed faster and Elder Yu’s warm smile fell as blood leaked from his lips, laughing, “Ha-ha-ha, you’ll never catch my young master!”
With ripples coming off his body, the men realized with shock what was happening, “He’s gonna blow!”
Boom!
Elder Yu already began to explode before they could react, sending a wave of dust all around.
The pursuers ended up coughing blood and flung back. By the time they got their feet under them and the dust settled, the commercial line had been broken. They had no way of following now…
The fighting at the city gates was drawing to a bloody close as well. Wu clan’s fighters were down to their last men, with most dead and the rest captured. As for the father and son, they easily fell into Baili Jingwei’s hands.
Clapping, Baili Jingwei gave the men a look and they all flew to the official line, to get back to the imperial capital.
Baili Jingwei walked to the cold spectator of this onslaught, Murong Xue, and smiled, “Greetings miss, I’ve been so caught up with business that I forgot my manners. I offer my sincere apologies.”
“It’s fine. I was just witnessing Prime Minister Baili’s handiwork, and I must say you live up to your name.” Murong Xue spoke flatly.
Baili Jingwei beamed and shook his head, “Ha-ha-ha, there’s no need for sarcasm, miss. I’m sure Miss overheard my decision. The day the empire rules the lands is nigh. Miss should consider your brother and advise him to renounce any pointless resistance.”
“I never interfered in my brother’s matters. Prime Minister, please have a word with him when you can spare the time.” Murong Xue smiled.
Baili Jingwei paused and shook his head.
It was clear from what transpired that a third of the imperial capital’s official were now kissing the dust. Did he had the time to entertain Murong Lie? Murong Xue’s words were no different than a rejection.
He wasn’t the least bit angry though, since he was used to these grand experts’ behaviors. Patience was a must when trying to win them over.
“Miss Murong, what might be the purpose of your visit to Goldbough City? Is there anything I could assist you with?”
“Ha-ha-ha, I wanted to make use of Serene Shores Trading’s commercial line to get back to southern lands, but with Prime Minister sparing none of their men, I’m afraid I will have to walk there.”
“That’s out of the question. Such a small matter shouldn’t be enough to trouble the merchants. I shall offer the official line for miss instead.” Baili Jingwei waved dismissively.
Murong Xue raised a dainty eyebrow and wore sneer, “That wouldn’t do, Prime Minister Baili, to mix personal and official matters…”
“Helping miss is purely official. If your brother would appreciate the gesture and have a chat with me, it’ll be even more selfless.” Baili Jingwei spoke with a straight back.
Murong Xue smiled, “I wonder what Prime Minister is so eager to share with my brother, of being expendable and how life has no value?”
“Miss, after you.”
Baili Jingwei’s face twitched, being jabbed with his own words. His face fell and his expression hardened.
Murong Xue ignored him as she entered the carriage and Zhui’er drove it out of the city…

chapters.title: Chapter 968: Demon Spirit Stone’s Origin
chapters.content:
Chapter 968: Demon Spirit Stone’s Origin
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Elder Yu!”
In the wake of thunderclap and violent winds, Wu Randong drifted further and further into the portal. His vision brightened at some point and passed through a bright exit as he stepped on grassland.
Looking back, the bright light got cut off and the portal vanished. Wu Randong panicked, and shouted, wanting to go save them, but he had no way of going back now.
He could only shout himself hoarse at his weakness, heart filled with hatred and sorrow.
Thump~
Steps approached and a thin man stopped ten meters behind him, carrying on his back a sleeping child, “Second young master, who knew we’d meet again so soon? Well met, ha-ha-ha…
Wu Randong shook all over at the familiar and equally terrifying voice. He turned a stiff head to see the same sharp eyes and fury lashed out from his burning eyes. His desire for this man’s blood was plain to see, his knuckles cracking as he made his fists.
“Second young master, have you been well the past three days?”
Zhuo Fan, still carrying Gu Santong on his back, ignored the warranted killer vibes coming off Wu Randong, showing his bright and cruel grin with ample meaning.
Wu Randong’s face twitched and wheezed, gnashing his teeth in hatred, “You! You ruined my family! You had them all killed!”
“Are you sure?” Zhuo Fan’s smile never faltered, still as infuriating as ever.
Wu Randong shook with hatred, “Elder Yu told me while he helped me flee that it’s because of your damn stones that Baili Jingwei came to destroy our company. Father and brother’s fates are unknown, all because of you, bastard. You owe me thousands of lives!”
Wu Randong stomped and shot for Zhuo Fan with brutal hatred, wanting nothing more than to kill him and end his pain.
Zhuo Fan wasn’t one to follow anyone’s wishes, merely side-stepping at the last second and whacking him with his Qilin arm so hard the tough young man was in a ten-meter-big crater.
Wu Randong bled from the mouth, not even budging in his newfound hole, not like he could from the immense pressure he felt on his spine as a scarlet arm simply held him there.
Giving the struggling and defeated guy a cold look, Zhuo Fan mocked, “Second young master, you can’t beat me, so save your energy. And isn’t this what you always wanted? Do you regret it maybe?”
“Cut the crap, when did I ever say I wanted the company…”
Wu Randong howled in fury, but then he stopped. Frozen stiff, he began to recall something that had him spooked.
Zhuo Fan grinned and took back his arm, standing and saying, “Remember now? Three days ago, at the tavern you said you wanted it destroyed. Shouldn’t you be having a victory dance right about now? Ha-ha-ha…”
“It was only in anger that I said it. How could I want for…” Wu Randong winced as he looked at Zhuo Fan in regret.
There was no way for him to know that this man would take his words seriously and that he had the power to follow through. In three days, the company became the empire’s target and burned to the ground.
[Who is he? The devil?]
Heart overcome with dread, Wu Randong regarded Zhuo Fan in fear.
Zhuo Fan read him like a book and jeered, “Youngster, think before you speak. In anger you say? I took them at face value. You said you wanted it ruined and so I made your wish come true. I also told you not to regret it, but now, ha-ha-ha…”
“No, I regret it. Sir, I know you’re a great man and can save the company along with my father and brother. You have to. I beg of you, save them!”
Zhuo Fan’s gaze left Wu Randong unable to read his intention and grew more nervous as he begged.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Second young master, you can escape every hardship the world throws at you, but never from your own sins. It would’ve been easy to stop it if I was the sole reason for your company’s plight. But since I have nothing to do with it, being the company’s sin, I have no solution.”
“Our sin?”
“Yes, sin!”
Zhuo Fan gave a vague smile as he explained, “Second young master, haven’t you always despised your company’s style? Allow me to open your eyes to the cruel truth you’ll most certainly hate. Three years ago, your friend and his sister were sent to Baili Jingyu by your father and brother. It wasn’t that degenerate suddenly taking a fancy of her.”
