“What?!” Wu Randong cried out in denial, “No way! You’re lying!”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “I have no reason to lie to you. This is something I managed to squeeze out of Baili Jingyu in the last three days. Your dad and brother’s lips are sealed, but that dead weight just loves to prattle. And your dad did it not to win the fool’s favor, but to have leverage over him. The company grew so much because they showed weakness through accomodation, while hiding their strength underneath, doing anything to further their goals.”
“Impossible, those were our guards! Dad would never…”
Wu Randong was still in denial, refusing to hear a word Zhuo Fan said, who continued regardless, “Businessmen value money over friendship. To them, everything is weighed. Throwing away two servants for complete control over the city lord was a bargain for them. Think back on that event. How did Baili Jingyu act around your company before and after? Humph, I only needed to use your commercial line for a bit, which hardly warranted the approval of that dead weight. As a result, your father still wanted to gang up with the lord so he’d milk me for all he could. Simply blinded by greed…”
Wu Randong shuddered but then those events played back in his mind.
[Yes, Baili Jingyu was very cocky before then after that…]
“Then what about that stone? Didn’t you give it to us?”
Whoosh~
A black cover spread and everything turned dark. Wu Randong cried in fright, “Domain soul harmony?”
“Yes, this is my domain!”
With a hum, the domain brightened and Wu Randong could see Zhuo Fan in front. He had many human-shaped black stones, with looks of fear, horror and all kinds of pained expressions. The worst part, there were thousands upon thousands of them.
Zhuo Fan grinned at his achievement, “Second young master, what do you think these are?”
“Demon spirit stone?” Wu Randong stared.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “There’s no such thing like that in the world. A man’s cultivation is based on his own hard work. The world doesn’t give shortcuts. These are people!”
“People?”
“Precisely!”
Zhuo Fan nodded with a stony face, “I have killed many with this rare Devouring Domain of mine, turning them as you see before you. The reason why using the demonic spirit stone got you to fly through the ranks is because you were using another’s Yuan Qi. But this Yuan Qi was made with my special demonic art. I’m fine if I use them, but I can’t say the same for the rest. One’s Yuan Qi becomes infected and would lead to this result as well. Now do you know what got your company to suffer this calamity? It’s because the users of this item had died from it.”
“That means you did this to us…”
“No, you did it yourself!”
Wu Randong accused, but Zhuo Fan berated in an even higher tone, “These Yuan Qi stones are my creation and will be fine using them, but even I won’t be reckless and use so many to cause my cultivation to soar. That’s because I know greed is our downfall. There are no shortcuts in the world. Using all these stones will lead to an unstable cultivation and a messy Yuan Qi. I don’t want to see it happen. I do want to grow stronger fast, for my own goals, but I control my desires, exercising moderation.
“As for your company, they went straight to using it without fully understanding its effects. Now problems arose, huge ones, threatening their lives and causing their demise. Who is to blame, I wonder? Everything is balanced in the world. Going too far in one aspect and giving up everything else will lead to dire consequences. You’ve been too greedy and it was only a matter of time before disaster struck. Not to mention…”
“What?” Wu Randong rushed to ask.
Zhuo Fan took a deep breath, “Sword Star Empire has wanted to restrain your company for a long time. Today was only the trigger. Even without the demonic spirit stones making a mess of things, one day, the Sword Star Empire would have come for your head using some other excuse. It was only a matter of time. While now, with it coming all of a sudden, the other party suffered out of nowhere and came unprepared, leaving you with a glimmer of hope. You ought to thank me for that!”

chapters.title: Chapter 969: Deal with the Devil
chapters.content:
Chapter 969: Deal with the Devil
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“What?” Wu Randong was shocked.
After taking down the domain, Zhuo Fan pointed at the portal’s location with a smile, “Second young master, ever since I arrived here, I’ve been waiting here for any movement. If eldest young master or you came, then it proved your company was in dire straits. If nothing happened in three days, then your company must be struggling on death’s door still!”
Wu Randong squinted.
“I’m watching for Prime Minister Baili Jingwei’s plan!”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone with determination, “Speaking of, businessmen and politicians are all alike. They all work for profit. Especially for a man like Baili Jingwei, who governs the empire, abandoning any grudges or favors just so he could see the five lands as one. If your company had suffered this time, it wouldn’t be because of a mess you might have caused, but for outliving your usefulness. A company so huge that didn’t follow orders would one day have Baili Jingwei eliminate it for his big unification plan!”
Looking dazed, Wu Randong needed a lot of time before he could process this, “But, the connections we make with every land help the empire!”
“True, and seeing how easy he threw your great help showed he didn’t care about you.”
Zhuo Fan gave Wu Randong a vague smile, “How about a wager? In a few days, the Sword Star Empire’s power will be leaving the central area.”
“You mean it’s going to invade the other lands?”
“Obviously, or why else would he cut the middlemen. You guys have always exercised extreme caution, not to give him anything that might be taken as hostility. So when do people kill someone who isn’t your enemy? When they’re in your way.”
Zhuo Fan chuckled all-knowingly, his eyes twinkling like stars, “In the five land war, your company’s connections to every area instantly became the empire’s weakness that had to be cut out. Though killing must always come with reason. How fortunate he had the perfect excuse to act now. When one wants to find you guilty, it was only a matter of time before he found something to pin on you. Luck, however, played a role in your favor, with how sudden it all happened, he was too rushed in his actions, making your branches survive. That’s why I’ve been telling you that you should thank me. I ripped off the band-aid for you, ha-ha-ha.”
Wu Randong was stunned in place, finally coming to terms with the facts as they went through his head.
“Now I must go save all those merchants that have yet to die…”
“Right on. You finally get it!” Zhuo Fan grinned.
Wu Randong looked around, “Where are we? How am I to contact the company?”
“Ha-ha-ha, your dad has always cut you off and you never asked how your family business is run. Since you came through the commercial line that means this is just another exit of it, your branch is at the border between the western lands and central area!”
Wu Randong nodded, then got flustered, “A guard, sent urgent messages to our other branches…”
“Easy on the ears, please. No one’s coming!”
Zhuo Fan mocked with a dismissive wave, “To have a nice uninterrupted chat, I had them leave. I’m the only one here waiting for you for three days.”
Wu Randong started, “Why would they listen to you?”
“It’s remarkable what you can get away with when the company is treating you like their most valued client.”
Zhuo Fan took out a golden card, the greatest and most respected symbol in the company across the lands, “Your brother gave it to me. A shame I’ll never get to see him again.”
Wu Randong’s heart was in pain as he sighed with a nod.
Zhuo Fan stopped him from leaving though, “Hold up.”
“Why?”
“What are you planning?”
“To get someone and send word!”
“What word?”
“Isn’t it to flee?” Wu Randong stated the obvious.
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “With only a couple of vague words, you are laying waste to the foundation your company has built over millennia. Once they hide, everything will fall apart, with everyone abandoning ship. Then what, how will you bring them together again? Do you want to let your father and brother’s hard work get destroyed with one word? Or have you forgotten the promise you made three days ago about wanting to take over?”
Wu Randong shook all over, sinking in deep thought.
[That’s right, I’m naive, rash, and stubborn on changing the company by myself. Now that father and brother are gone, I hold all the power.] But like a child, he has no idea what to even do.
His family business would soon fade away in the five lands under him. His father and brother’s work would be squandered under his command. He’d be too ashamed to meet his kin in the afterlife like this. Was he really going to end up destroying everything?
Wu Randong grabbed his head in regret.
[Why didn’t I work with my father to run the business?]
“You need a mentor to show you the way.”
Wu Randong jerked out of his misery, looking at Zhuo Fan’s flat expression. He sighed, “The elders and venerables must’ve passed away by now and I hardly know anyone in the branches. Where could I find someone to help me…”
“Here!”
Wu Randong just finished and Zhuo Fan declared.
Wu Randong flinched, “You?”
“It’s not that I want to help you, but to cooperate!”
Zhuo Fan set his cold eyes on him, “You showed me your great ambition, of ruling the company and changing it. I made it reality…”
“You did it by killing my father and brother. I don’t want…”
“Wu Randong!”
Zhuo Fan’s thunderous voice swallowed his dissent, “You’re not a child and know there are gains and losses. You think you can just change the company that has been around for thousands of years just because you feel like it? History’s been written in blood whenever any change occurs. Since you decided on changing it, you need to accept the price. The chairman seat isn’t a breeze, but since you’re in it, man up! It’s too late to turn back now. All you can do is get the company to follow your vision, or leave it to waste away and ruin all of your father and brother’s blood and sweat!”
Wu Randong’s eyes twitched then sighed, “I’ll make the company prosper and not let my father’s effort go to waste. But why should I work with you? Why do I feel that when I’m around you, it’s like I’m working with the devil? I’m chilled to the bone and always on edge.”
“Ha-ha-ha, that’s normal. There’s nothing wrong with your instinct, since I am a devil.”
Zhuo Fan snickered, “In a man’s moment of despair, they plead gods or devils. It’s only natural to turn to gods, but do you know why some choose devils?”
“Why?”
“A god keeps you safe, but only if you give up everything. As for devils, they take everything you have, but also help you achieve your greatest desire.”
Zhuo Fan’s creepy smile made Wu Randong uncomfortable, “Your situation is quite close to despair as well. So who will you beseech, the god or the devil?”
Wu Randong squinted, then made his decision, “I can’t let my father and brother’s death be in vain. The company cannot fail. I can never just let go and lead a plain life. We have spared nothing for the betterment of the Sword Star Empire and where did that get us? I’ll make sure Baili Jingwei and the Star Sword Empire will pay for this!”
“Are you willing to take the company and work for me?”
“Are you willing, no…. are you able, to give me revenge? They are Baili Jingwei and the Sword Star Empire!”
“All I need is time and it will be done.” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone.
Wu Randong nodded at his resolve and declared, “Then today I shall make a deal with the devil. Show me how you’ll get me revenge for the thousands of men from my company!”
“Let’s shake on it!”
Zhuo Fan put out his hand with a sinister smile, “I told you, that we’ll be working very closely. Who knew it’d be so soon? Ha-ha-ha…”
Pa!
Wu Randong shook his hand hard, his eyes glittering, “Then, sir, what next?”
“You’ll be sending every branch a message. From now on, the Serene Shores Trading’s personnel will fade into the shadows and from the eyes of the world. Serene Shores Trading will cease to exist in name. When the danger passes, we will come out of the woodwork reborn!”
Wu Randong pondered and nodded, “Then we will suffer silently for now. A gentleman can wait for revenge, even if it’s ten years later!”
Meanwhile, over a vast stretch of water that was covered in thick fog, the raging waves kept lapping at the shore, echoing the deep bestial roar the fog emitted.
Two gargantuan eyes shone in the fog with savagery.
A middle-aged man stood before the fog with fluttering clothes and a glinting sword at the ready as he charged, “Sea demon, for too long you have taken the lives of my people. This stops now. The sea isn’t yours alone. I am going to fight and if I win, you are to never harm them again!”
An echoing roar reverberated through the air from the thick fog, followed by a jeer, “A puny Genesis Stage human dares face me? Enter my domain if you have the stomach and I shall tear you limb from limb, ha-ha-ha…”
Bam!
Explosions sounded and the person charged into the mist, waging a cruel battle…

chapters.title: Chapter 970: The Fifth Sacred Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 970: The Fifth Sacred Beast
Proofreader
: Papatonks
In a lush and verdant mountain forest, a thin man carrying an eight-year-old child was walking through the roaring spiritual beasts of all levels, with none willing to take a single step closer.
Zhuo Fan carried Gu Santong one step at a time through the familiar woods, towards Vaulting Kunpeng’s lair.
Unlike every other time, there was no Three-headed Crow to give him a lift. The spiritual beasts looked to be under strict orders to stand aside while jeering at this conceited man coming to their master to admit his mistake.
With all the spiritual beasts showing up as he walked, none would lead Zhuo Fan, letting him walk under their mockery through their kingdom.
Zhuo Fan finally gazed upon a peak and the familiar cave of Vaulting Kunpeng.
“Ha-ha-ha, what wind has brought the high and mighty sir Zhuo to my humble abode?”
A big and muscled man came out of the cave.
Vaulting Kunpeng snickered, “What has happened to young Sanzi? Why isn’t he even greeting me? Is it possible that he’s hurt to be held on another’s back? Ha-ha-ha, no, that can’t be. Young Sanzi’s father, the great Zhuo Fan, had last left with a loud mouth and absolute confidence that he can protect his child. So why then after only two years the same bubbly child looks to be dying and coming before me? Could he be wanting me to give a burial?”
“Senior Kunpeng!”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “I have been rude and disrespectful to senior and for that I apologize. Young Sanzi’s heavy state is due to my negligence. I proved to be incapable and have come to senior for aid, hoping senior remembers of the five great sacred beasts and would lend your help. I would be ever grateful.”
Kunpeng mocked, “Zhuo Fan, you took the old dragon’s Dragon Breath Pill and looked quite smug. Now that you came to me for help, have you seen your shortcomings? Then go down on your knees and I may just consider it…”
“Senior, I have come to you asking for help, but you shouldn’t push it!”
Zhuo Fan had a cold smile, “I heard people say that when being asked for help, one shouldn’t insult the other but ask for a price. I have apologized to senior but only out of courtesy. If senior still takes it seriously, then I’m afraid I’ll be put on the spot. Ha-ha-ha, I only care about saving young Sanzi, not for me, but for a fellow sacred beast. I do recall you needing to set up some array that needs the power of all five great sacred beast to face Heavenly Sovereign, right?”
Kunpeng’s face twitched and muttered, “Curses, still showing off even when asking for help like I’m owing you. This punk’s attitude hasn’t changed one bit!
“Fine, bring the kid over. Humph, we just had to work together!”
Kunpeng waved and shouted annoyedly before stepping into his cave.
Grinning, Zhuo Fan flew inside and placed young Sanzi on a bed.
Kunpeng placed two fingers on the child’s wrist and then shouted, “Why is his Qilin Shield sporting a gap?”
“Qilin Shield?”
“Yes.”
Kunpeng spoke heavily, “Qilin Shield is a Qiling’s innate protection made of his body, mind and soul that makes up the whole of a Qilin’s power. A damaged Qilin Shield means he can’t gather his strength and will be weakened. That’s why he has been unconscious for all this time.”
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, “Qilin Shield has such a use? But when I refined my Qilin arm I also had the Qilin Shield. It only seemed to offer some protection and that was it.”
“That’s because you’re a human. Qilin Shield isn’t for you, so of course it isn’t the core of your being. While not as strong, getting it damaged won’t be an issue as it’s easy to restore. But to a Qilin, a damaged Qilin Shield means having your very core hurt…”
Kunpeng frowned heavily, “The kid’s wound is baffling. A normal damaged Qilin Shield would recover even with the core being heavily weakened. But his Qilin Shield’s damage is like his whole body is broken. Unable to bring itself together, his energy is constantly sapped and always weak and unconscious. One day, it may even take his life.”
Zhuo Fan panicked inside, “How do we heal it?”
“Before that, why don’t you tell me how he got this wound?” Kunpeng asked gravely.
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Soaring Sword.”
“Soaring Sword?”
“Precisely!”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “The mortal domain has five great sacred weapons made by the Heavenly Sovereign and Sword Sovereign to deal with the sacred beasts, even named after the very sacred beast they target. I didn’t realize this at first, only coming to this conclusion after being hurt by two sacred weapons. These sacred weapons are designed to restrain specific sacred beast. I was once hurt by the Vaulting Sword in the Double Dragon Manor and healed in the end, albeit slowly. But getting hurt by the Soaring Sword proved harder to heal. Maybe because I’m a human that some special pills finally healed me. But young Sanzi…”
Kunpeng squinted, “Kid, do you have a sacred weapon?”
“I have the Vaulting Sword, but I had changed it. Its sword spirit is my blood spirit…”
“It’s fine. The spirit might change, but the sword energy and its skill won’t. Take it out and try it on me!” Kunpeng insisted, “Maybe I can glean into what is happening.”
Zhuo Fan did as he was told and shot the demonic sword at Kunpeng.
Its form now was much weaker than usual, but Kunpeng didn’t care as he tried to block it with his palm, releasing his azure flame into a wall.
The instant the demonic sword touched the wall, it shook a bit and the sword released a sudden light before passing right through and going for Kunpeng.
Kunpeng shook, taken off-guard by the Vaulting Sword’s power, able to bypass his azure flame’s defenses. Though it didn’t matter since he barely showed any of his power.
So this time he added more strength and repelled the demonic sword, sending it back in Zhuo Fan’s body.
Zhuo Fan shuddered and coughed blood, then he cursed, “Senior Kunpeng, wasn’t this a test? Why so serious?”
“I had no choice, because the sacred weapons and us mutually suppress each other.”
Kunpeng’s brow shook and sighed, “Now I know why the child is so hurt. These swords are deadly to us.”
Zhuo Fan started, “What do you mean?”
“Kid, you know that the world is made of endless forms of yin and yang, that everything in this world has a counter. But this is mutual suppression that only the five elements can have.”
Kunpeng grew grave, “Water and fire repel each other. More water destroys fire and more fire pulverizes water. They can’t coexist. This is how we, the sacred beasts, and the five sacred weapons are. Meeting, survival is only based on who is the strongest in this mutual conflict. It’s either the sacred beast or the sacred weapon that survives. Young Sanzi’s state is because of that. The other used an art that is his bane, causing heavy damage, even deadly.”
“Yeah, he trained in the Soaring Sword Art!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shook as he sighed.
Kunpeng was equally helpless, “Yin-yang can only break from yin-yang. When two opposite forces clash, nothing can help. If the child was stronger, he could’ve defended himself. But he’s still young. However, I’m fortunate that I never left the Allbeast Mountain Range or the sacred weapon absorbing the sacred stones’ power and without the barrier here, I would be sure to suffer from it. The Heavenly Sovereign and the Sword Sovereign sure are cruel to leave five ruthless weapons in the mortal domain to deal with us.”
“Is there no other way? Senior Kunpeng, not even you can do anything?”
“I told you already, the powers are mutually exclusive and only each other can solve, with no one able to interfere. Unless…”
Kunpeng sighed then muttered, “Forget it, that old geezer must be lazing around somewhere and can’t find him fast enough…”
Zhuo Fan grasped the slim hope as he asked, “Who are you talking about, senior? Can he save young Sanzi?”
“Yeah, one of the five great sacred beasts, the Heaven Sealing Sea Ao, wielding the world’s innate sealing arts.”
(StarReader: the World Turtle in many mythologies, including Chinese.)
Kunpeng’s eyes flashed, “The old guy’s sealing is so strong it can seal the world, so the elements are a cinch for him. Even in the times of the ten Sovereigns, all feared his seals, panicked about having their power bound and never again able to break it. Also, he was the only one able to give Heavenly Sovereign a hard time, even if he broke out of the seal after a time. This only shows how terrible he is. With young Sanzi’s damaged Qilin Shield, he just has to place a barrier between the two opposite forces and let it heal itself.”

chapters.title: Chapter 971: Heart of a Sovereign
chapters.content:
Chapter 971: Heart of a Sovereign
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Zhuo Fan’s face was in a constant frown, “Heaven Sealing Sea Ao… does that mean he is the only one in the whole wide world that can heal young Sanzi?”
“Yes, but the problem is I have no idea where he is!” Kunpeng sighed.
Zhuo Fan lit up and took out a gourd, looking nervous, “Senior, you just said that only Heaven Sealing Sea Ao can save young Sanzi, but on my way back I stumbled upon this mortal item, North Sea Gel, that proved to be of great help. Does senior know of it?”
“North Seal Gel? First time hearing of it.”
Kunpeng took the gourd and smelled it, “Young Sanzi’s wound, or more plainly spoke, the deadly war between us and Heavenly Sovereign, can never be healed by anything, no matter how special, from the mortal domain, eh?”
Kunpeng gasped, “T-this smell…”
“What is it, senior?”
“Of course!”
Kunpeng grinned and shook his head, then he handed the gourd back with a jeer, “Kid, what did you say its name was? Where does it come from?”
Completely clueless, Zhuo Fan looked at the gourd and muttered, “Senior, on my way back I met someone who used this to save young Sanzi’s life, calling it North Sea Gel. I heard it’s very valuable. I had to pay twenty million sacred stones for just this tiny bit, yet still came up at a huge bargain for me…”
Kunpeng scoffed and gave him a toying gaze.
“What, senior, what’s the problem?” Zhuo Fan asked curiously.
Pointing at the gourd with a smug grin, Kunpeng shook his head, “You humans hail everything that’s remotely rare as valuable.”
Zhuo Fan was still not getting where he was going, but the man continued, “Kid, the old guy’s Nine Serenities Secret Records has plenty of super secret and rare medicines, right? Was this among them then?”
“Uh, no.” Zhuo Fan gave an awkward shake of his head, “Maybe since this is of the mortal domain, Nine Serenities Sovereign has no way of knowing…”
“Bull!”
Kunpeng cussed him on the spot, “There was no mortal domain in the distant past. Nine Serenities most definitely knew what this thing is, but found it unworthy to be noted down.”
“Ah, then this is…”
“Heaven Sealing Sea Ao’s garbage.” Kunpeng cocked an eyebrow as he cackled.
Zhuo Fan froze, then stammered, “You mean t-this thing…”
“You get it now? The waste of a sacred beast looks like an otherworldly treasure to you common folk, but to a Sovereign, it’s junk, trash, shit. Even if it were you, would you actually go and ask some random expert’s stool sample for purely academic reasons? Ha-ha-ha…”
Kunpeng was laughing it up, “Only mortals like you would think this is precious. Nine Serenities knew its use but still didn’t note it down, just so he wouldn’t become the butt of everyone’s joke.”
Zhuo Fan’s face was twitching in all the weird ways, the dirty truth finally dumped on his clueless mind, “Of course it helped heal young Sanzi’s wound, since it came from the Heaven Sealing Sea Ao. Even if it came from the other end, it still has great power.”
“Right you are, and also…” Kunpeng’s eyes shone with a vague light. Zhuo Fan picked up on his thought instantly, “The Heaven Sealing Sea Ao is in the northern lands’ sea. I’ll take young Sanzi there right now!
Zhuo Fan grabbed young Sanzi to leave.
“Wait!”
Kunpeng cut his enthusiasm short, earning a curious expression from him.
Kunpeng took a deep breath, “Northern lands is worlds apart from here and not to mention it’ll take even more time searching for the old coot’s track in the North Sea. Time is of the essence here, as young Sanzi’s life is at stake. He is fading as we speak, each passing day becoming more dangerous for him.”
“Senior means…”
Hu~
Kunpeng’s palm sported an azure flame, shooting both of his hands at young Sanzi and letting the fire pass by his acupoints, while placing the palm on young Sanzi’s forehead.
The azure flame flared and seeped into the child’s body through the acupoints, forming a faint azure glow around young Sanzi to keep him safe.
Easing a long breath, Kunpeng took back his hand, “I’m not at the old coot’s sealing level, but this little is nothing. Fire is the source of life, so I used the Chaos Flame to make a heaven seal and keep young Sanzi’s spirit in his body. It’s not enough to give the Qiling Shield time to recover, but it won’t get worse at least. Now you need to visit the old dragon too, so he’d use the Decimating Golden Flame and keep his energy from leaking as well. This should buy enough time for you to find the Sea Ao and save him.”
“Senior can’t just seal it completely?”
“No, my azure soul protects the soul, while the dragon’s refines the flesh. Against such a problem as two clashing energies, we can only do what we can. I kept his soul intact while the dragon can keep his body from deteriorating. That’s all any of us can do.”
Kunpeng explained.
Zhuo Fan nodded and hugged young Sanzi, but Kunpeng stopped him yet again.
He had a cheeky grin, “Kid, the child’s life won’t get worse for now so there’s no need to be frantic. It’s been two years now since you last visited my Allbeast Mountain Range and I would like to understand some things. Have you made any progress?”
“I sealed three of the eight World Wind Tunnels.” Zhuo Fan spoke plainly.
Kunpeng nodded, “That’s quite fast, but that’s not the issue here. Finding them and setting a drawing array is the easy part, while getting the recoiling array the main issue. Alone, as you are, it’s going to take eons to finish. This is work that involves all of the lands. Do you have any plans?”
“Don’t worry, I found myself a partner on the way back. With their clan’s connections, it shouldn’t take too long.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, giving a full account of the Serene Shores Trading’s situation.
Kunpeng started, then laughed, “In just three days, you had them killed and still got them to give their lives for you. Kid, that’s one good deal right there!”
“Senior Kunpeng, you mean you don’t see it? It’s not I who ruined them, but themselves. I just sped up the process.”
Sighing at the heavens he flatly stated, “In this world, there’s always a way to survive, just that you’re the one digging your own grave through your actions.”
Kunpeng chuckled and nodded, “Zhuo Fan, you’ve grown these two years, getting closer to the attitude of a Sovereign.”
“Sovereign?”
“Yes.”
Kunpeng unraveled his doubtful gaze, “People think the Sovereign Stage is the embodiment of power. Hidden from their view is, however, the heart of a Sovereign. It means being committed to the world around you, discovering its nature and inner workings by taking the path less traveled and tempering your heart and mind, to grasp past and future, the very world itself, in the palm of your hand.
“As you are, despite the lack of power, you made headways in demeanor, following the way the world works. A true man would see the danger he is under and avoid it, but everyone else would find it hard to even distinguish it, unable to dodge calamity. You might not have noticed, but you used to think of the bigger picture, walking towards your fate, half with schemes and half with heaven. Now that you perceive the nature of the world and can grasp its opportunities. Just how the Serene Shores Trading was walking to a doom of their own making, you merely picked the best timing for you to have them escape it while also casually getting them to work for you. You didn’t really do anything but have grasped the trend of the world. Going with the flow is the Sovereign Stage!”
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook in thought, “I never thought about it before, just finding it that by throwing the demon spirit stones at the Serene Shores Trading will cause a huge problem, since their demise was just a matter of time. As for the second young master, he’ll work with me in the end and the company will be mine. All I have to do is be patient.”
“Heart of a Sovereign, to see the future and know fate. You saw their end so you followed the world’s trend, speeding up the process. Every Sovereign is special, having shed the mortal coil, while you have done it in mind.”
Kunpeng smiled, “When I had asked you to find Heavenly Sovereign’s remnants, I believed you would because I had a feeling this would be your future. Ha-ha-ha, I made the right choice. With you helping us, it’s practically over and done with.”
“Now take young Sanzi and go. I’ll have Three-headed Crow go along until you find Sea Ao.”
“Isn’t he an important helper? You’d let me have him?” Zhuo Fan was stunned.
Kunpeng showed a vague smile, “Yep, he is, but you need his help more than I do. Also, when you meet the old coot, you might even think the helper hasn’t much use, ha-ha-ha…”

chapters.title: Chapter 972: The Nine Sword Kings Converge
chapters.content:
Chapter 972: The Nine Sword Kings Converge
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Boom~
In the deepest place of Sword Star Empire’s imperial capital, on the tallest mountain stood a lofty palace. However, the lavish design was marred by the constant thunderstorm above and the incessant thick lightning strikes hammering the area. Each strike teeming with the power to destroy everything.
But there would be no destruction as the palace made it so any strike that landed close or on it would be completely absorbed, with not a single blade of grass even singed. Yet from the flowers to the trees, they all had a distinct crackling sound coming from them, brimming with abundant electric charge.
At the tallest point of the palace, where lightning surrounded it constantly, three golden and sharp words drew attention.
Thunder Pavilion!
“Invincible Sword just got out of seclusion and asked for the Nine Sword Kings, but what does he do next? He comes to Thunder Pavilion to polish his sword skills. What the hell is he thinking?”
Outside the pavilion, the teams of guards stood at perfect attention, all of them peak Genesis experts. The most impressive was their numbers, over a hundred!
Shangguan Feiyun was pacing just outside the pavilion, finding it an utter waste of time and complained because of it, “I’d have left by now if the old man didn’t have something important. I don’t have the leisure like these guards to come over from afar just to stand stiff!”
Danqing Shen beside him chuckled, “Brother Feiyun, mind your words. Someone might just go tell on you. Then you’ll have Sword Patriarch coming at you for a spar. Who are you going to blame then, ha-ha-ha…”
“So what? I already lost, haven’t I?”
Shangguan Feiyun’s face twitched and grumbled, but it was clear the words did get to him. Danqing Shen chuckled.
He then froze, his nose wiggling from the intoxicating scent as he laughed, “A mild 3,200 years aged vintage Harmony Hallow! That’s one good wine!”
“Ha-ha-ha, I knew only brother Dan among the Sword Kings knows me best. You managed to sense it from this far?”
Whoosh~
An aged man with a white beard and a heavily receding hairline, popped up in front of them, holding a wine bottle letting out a conspicuous smell.
Danqing Shen smiled, “Wine Sword Immortal, it’s been ages. Where have you run off to for some fine wine? Mind giving me a bottle?”
“He-he-he, how could I ever forget about my dear friend, brother Dan? But this time, I didn’t bring one for you.”
“Why, hogging it all up?” Danqing Shen poked fun.
Wine Sword Immortal waved dismissively, “Brother Dan, I’m not being rude here on purpose. Such a great wine isn’t enough for myself so how could I share any with you?”
“Humph, you say that every time. To you, I bet not even all the wine in the world would be enough.” Shangguan Feiyun mocked.
Danqing Shen smiled uncaringly. But Wine Sword Immortal was looking nervous as he said, “Shangguan Feiyun, don’t poison the well! I’m a genuine drunkard that loves to hit the bottle, but my dear friendship with brother Dan is so strong, if I had the whole world’s wine, even a bottle… I would not necessarily not share…”
Shangguan Feiyun rolled his eyes.
[This drunkard is so stingy, giving only a taste even if he has barrels of it.]
It was obvious you’d get nothing from this guy. Since all good wines came in short supply, there was no way he’d ever share anything.
Danqing Shen chuckled, “Old geezer, I know you’re a drunkard, but regardless of giving or not, the least you can do is show me some respect in front of everyone? Just a bottle? Do I matter so little to you?”
“No, that’s not it, brother Dan. I feared you’d take it seriously and really ask for some from me!”
The Wine Sword Immortal always had his nose in a bottle, or barrel. But of the Nine Sword Kings, he was the plainest and honest of them all, always saying his piece. At the two’s teasing, he grew nervous, “I’ll be honest with you. This is the only bottle I have of Harmony Hallow and also the most ardent. I had to go through so much to…”
“Ardent Harmony Hallow… like from southern lands?”
Danqing Shen shouted, “You went to Murong Lie for wine? No wonder it has such a pungnant smell. The southern lands have the hottest climate and would ferment the spiciest wines. Murong clan’s is among the best, but…”
“As a Sword King, if Baili Jingwei finds out you went to the enemy for some wine, you’re through!” Shangguan Feiyun butted in with his mock threat.
Wine Sword Immortal signaled for him to be silent with a tense look, “Keep it down! That slob has his eyes on me and if he finds out anything, he’ll lock me up in the same spot! Good brothers keep secrets. Don’t throw me to the wolves!”
“Give half and take half!” The other two spoke in unison while reaching for the wine.
Wine Sword Immortal winced, looking at the bottle in his hand with pain, “Can’t you ask for anything else? This is my only bottle. You’re being cruel wanting half!”
“We’re just that mean, he-he-he…” The two wiggled their eyebrows as they taunted.
Looking like he was the victim here, Wine Sword Immortal fondled the bottle with utter helplessness. But then the sound of strings echoed out followed by a voice sounding even more helpless, “Sword Kings, please don’t pick on the kind and elderly. He risked his life in the southern lands. Why must we Sword Kings play one another despite being outsiders? How petty…”
They all started and looked over at the corner to an eminent man with a calm demeanor as he played the zither while giving them a mocking grin.
“Zither Sword King Liu Mubai, you came as well?”
Wine Sword Immortal lit up in joy as he bounced over with a laughter, “You’re a nice guy, saving me from those two trying to blackmail me. What I hate the most is others using another’s plight for their own selfish gain!”
Liu Mubai smiled and played the zither, “Wine Sword Immortal, you call that blackmail? It’s just a joke, just like what I did just now with them, ha-ha-ha…”
“Really?”
Shangguan Feiyun cocked a mocking eyebrow, “The Nine Sword Kings come from different ares, but Prime Minister Baili treat us all the same. The fact that you spoke of us being outsiders is your attempt at sowing discord?”
The zither rang an odd note in his hand as Liu Mubai stopped, looking at him with a vague glint, “That wasn’t the idea, I’m only stating facts. Of the Nine Sword Kings, five are Baili clan’s, leaving us the only four by ourselves. Don’t tell me you believe that if a bit operation is in play, those five won’t try to steal our share of the reward or downplay our merits. Ha-ha-ha, Prime Minister cares about all of us, but our levels are different among each other. They are a united force while we’re alone. I love the zither, Sword Immortal the wine, Old Dan painting, but what about Brother Feiyun? Ha-ha-ha…”
Brow furrowed they all looked grave.
Liu Mubai spoke what they all knew already.
[Baili’s people are against any outsiders.]
They were four Sword Kings that had been recruited, thus their gains differed.
This made it five against each one of them. When the time came and they were at odds, they would be in serious danger, all because they had no trust among each other.
The four look at each other, their mind already working on a plan.
“Zither Sword King, are you trying to get the other three Sword Kings set up against the Baili clan?”
Rumble!
A thunderous voice followed the appearance of a fierce and hulking man. His eyes flashed like lightning, his power shaking the air around him.
Squinting, Liu Mubai, smiled, “Thunder Sword King Baili Yulei, is it that you disapprove of my words?”
“There’s no point to begin with.”
Baili Yulei jeered, “There’s only our clan the best in the world. It is us who have the final say, and we who gave you your titles, just so that you protect our home. Put bluntly, you’re nothing but better guards. Even if there are conflicts of interests with our clan, you still have to step aside, isn’t that right?”
All the other faces tensed and darkened.
Wine Sword Immortal, who never cared about mortal affairs had had enough, “So you’re saying if a good wine caught my eye and someone from Baili wants it as well, who is it that gets it?”
“Whoever rules!” Baili Yulei thundered.
Wine Sword Immortal was disgruntled, “Wine is my life!”
“Then please have it removed, Wine Sword Immortal.”
“What did you say?”
Bam!
A powerful surge exploded as Wine Sword Immortal roared, standing against Baili Yulei’s icy smile.
Liu Muba rooted for Wine Sword Immortal.
Suddenly, two Sword Kings’ aura flared, pushing Baili Yulei back, but then four other figures descended. The Nine Sword Kings gathered before the Thunder Pavilion…

chapters.title: Chapter 973: The Strongest Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 973: The Strongest Clan
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Rumble~
With the impression of the sky falling on their heads, five Sword Kings’ combined auras reached almost godlike level in raw power, making Wine Sword Immortal groan and forced back three steps.
Danqing Shen released his own aura to help Wine Sword Immortal.
They were outsiders to the Sword Star Empire, strangers, and had to work hard to gain its trust. If they did not stand together, there would be nothing left of them to stand over.
Bam!
With the other two at the side joining the first two, it became four on five, turning into a stalemate. Both sides gave their all with neither budging an inch, yet the raw power they released was so great it affected the Thunder Pavilion, shaking the whole mountain it was on.
The guards were a shaking mess, paling and having lost their previous stone-cold calm. They were all peak Genesis Stage experts here, but one thing was certain, the Nine Sword Kings were a cut way above the masses.
All they could do as these nine powerhouses duked it out was to stand aside, feeling how weak they were by comparison.
Neither side gave, with all the faces frozen in a grim expression. The hundred guards witnessing this were fearing for their lives.
The mountain just kept on shaking as the lightning thundered across the sky, giving the feeling the mountain was going to crumble. And so, this went on for the better part of the next hour, with shaking and more shaking.
While word was the Nine Sword Kings were equal, the four outsiders were short of one in this fight, showing signs of weakness after engaging in this pissing contest for so long. The Baili clan’s five Sword Kings had gotten the advantage and were pressing down on the other four.
The four outsiders were grave when a woman giggled, “You’re only four yet still dare to challenge the five of us? Now it’s too late to back out!”
“Baili Yuyu, you sure are smug for having just one more! Have some dignity and fight one on one with me if you dare!” Wine Sword Immortal challenged.
The graceful figure stuck out her tongue as she jeered, “Stinky old coot, this lady here doesn’t feel like wasting time with you…”
“Humph, lady? Shouldn’t that be hag?”
Shangguan Fenyun’s eyes shone as he taunted, “Baili clan’s Yu generation is of the same age with Patriarch Baili Yutian, around ten thousand years old, I reckon. Yet you call yourself a lady? Ha-ha-ha, a biddy or a hag is more accurate. And yet still so feisty… no man will ever want a shrew…”
Baili Yuyu squinted and gave a banshee of a screech, “Who’s spouting such nonsense that all Yu are of the same generation? The Patriarch bestowed upon the Baili clan members who reached the Sword King rank with this character, to show our power is that of heaven. Did you know that?”
(StarReader: the character 御 or Yu has many different meanings, to resist, imperial, manage, govern, royal)
With bloodthirst flashing in her eyes, Baili Yuyu’s hands glinted coldly as she sent a rumbling silver sword energy for Shangguan Feiyun with her finger.
“You think I’m scared of you, wench?”
Shangguan Feiyun scoffed and drew two fingers as he slashed, unleashing the Soaring Sword Art at her.
Boom!
The loud explosion shook the mountain even more, sending rocks into its streams, with its aura becoming strained to the point of breaking.
The guards panicked, while the other Sword Kings frowned.
So far they kept the confrontation friendly, to a mere display of power, but now someone resorted to violence. With Nine Sword Kings’ power, a clash would lead to total devastation.
On top of that, they might both die from it. Whichever the outcome, it was bad no matter how one sliced it.
This was why both the Patriarch and the prime minister forbade any fighting among them, short of being severely punished.
Whoosh~
The second energy wave shot at Shangguan Feiyun as Baili Yuyu spat, “Curse you, Shangguan Feiyun, I’m going to skin you alive!”
“Bring it on!” Shangguan Feiyun met her challenge with his own taunt and the Soaring Sword Art.
A roar reverberated throughout the skies before the two sword energies ever had a chance to unleash further needless devastation upon the world, “Enough! Are you going to fight in front of the Thunder Pavilion, in front of Patriarch?”
Everyone flinched and found two men rushing over and making them stop as they bowed.
“Greetings, Your Majesty, greetings Prime Minister!”
Next to the young Baili Jingwei stood a middle-aged man with sharp brows and tall stature. His eyes showed wisdom, yet hid the cold glint only the monarch of the Sword Star Empire could have.
Right behind him were ten youths with the most handsome guy taking the lead, looking to only be in his twenties. And yet his youthful look belied the power he wielded, that of a Genesis Stage expert.
The other nine were 5th layer Soul Harmony Stage experts as well, young and strong.
Shangguan Feiyun’s heart sank, looking at his friends and his face fell as well.
[The Baili clan is filled with talents. They aren’t called the strongest clan for nothing.]
The leader of the youths was none other than the crown prince, capable in both the pen and the sword. Now that he was already in the Genesis Stage, his future was set as the next Sword King.
As for the other nine, they were outstanding as well, all having a good chance of becoming a Sword King.
Now the Nine Sword Kings had five from the Baili clan, but by the look of things, there would be more. The power of this mighty clan was on a steady climb, bound to make these foreign Sword Kings’ future even more miserable. There was a very likely possibility—and not at all welcomed—that they would be even removed from such ranks.
Not like they could do anything to change it. The Baili clan was just that strong, and not from coincidences or happenstance, but through survival of the fittest had they created this empire.
Invincible Sword established the clan’s dominance, putting in place his autocracy, with every generation carefully picked and groomed to reach higher.
As for the progenity that failed to make the cut, Baili Yutian sent them to the border and never to step foot in the imperial capital again. Not all of the imperial family held power.
Had the crown prince failed to meet his expectations, he would now be reduced to a garbage position like a city lord. There was no surprise the right to inherit did not exist in this clan. Failing to thrive meant turning into a beggar.
On the off chance a good seed bore fruit among those sent at the border towns, they would be recalled to the imperial capital to be groomed. On very rare occasions, they might even become emperors. At least that was what Invincible Sword said.
The whole empire revolved around this one man, the Patriarch, making his word law.
This was why birthright didn’t mean instant power and the highest seat in the empire. That was because the Baili clan was filled with struggles if one ever wanted to grasp anything.
A degenerate like Baili Jingyu was an exception.
While Baili Jingwei and Baili Jingshi, men of little power but great wisdom, had their station judged through their incredible talent, as a Prime Minister and as an Emperor.
It was all thanks to the Patriarch that they got it, or they would’ve become nobodies. Thus, ever since these two came to power, the empire flourished.
This system was unimaginable elsewhere, because it was bound to lead to chaos. As to why it worked here, that was because there was no one out there in the world that could top Baili Yutian and challenge his words.
Baili Jingwei spoke coldly, “Explain to me what’s happening right now or I’ll have to report this to the Patriarch!”
“Prime Minister, he insulted me!” Baili Yuyu stabbed her finger at Shangguan Feiyun.
The accused man scoffed, “Prime Minister, you always say the Nine Sword Kings do not take sides, but these five from the Baili clan have treated us outsiders as nothing!”
“Is this true?”
Baili Jingwei turned to the five and spoke, “Sword Kings, it was the Patriarch himself who invited these four to be Sword Kings, to serve the empire. My reach is limited and I do not have the power to govern matters between Sword Kings, but we are now meeting the Patriarch and what do you think he will say when he hears about my report on this?”
The five Sword Kings shuddered at once. Baili Yuyu cupped her hands in fright, “Prime Minister, I’ve been too rude and ask Prime Minister not to—”
“Not what?”
A wizen voice rumbled into everyone’s ears like thunder and made everyone shake all over.
The Patriarch of the Sword Star Empire, the strongest in the five lands, Invincible Sword Baili Yutian had arrived…

chapters.title: Chapter 974: Invincible Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 974: Invincible Sword
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Along with the surge of power that shook the ground and the air around them, what stood in front of them was a stout old man with a white beard.
Eyes of amber, hair white as snow, wrinkles so deep as if carved, yet what unnerved everyone, even the likes of the Nine Sword Kings was the piercing stare and the flickering purple lightning within. They felt their hearts quivering from the sharp glare, making them sweat.
Bam!
In a flash of purple lightning, a longsword appeared, its edge cold and sharp, its aura deadly like that of a grim reaper.
Central area’s divine weapon, Sundering Sword!
Everyone’s hearts shuddered at its appearance, then they gave the old man a deep bow, “Greetings Patriarch, we congratulate Patriarch on coming out of seclusion!”
“Now I know what exactly happened here from within the Thunder Pavilion. I won’t be saying anything about it but I’d prefer this not to happen ever again. Am I clear?”
Baili Yutian spoke with a cold face, his eyes flat as if nothing mattered to him at all.
Yet these few words carried with it a heavy weight, like a decree of a god that none could impeach. Follow it they shall, or they might as well sign their death warrant.
The Nine Sword Kings bowed again, Baili Yulei even lowered his head more as sweat trickled down his brow.
Shangguan Feiyun snickered at their plight, while Zither Sword King’s eyes shone and grinned.
Baili Yutian’s icy tone came again, “This goes for the foreign Sword Kings as well, not just the two of them. Watch yourselves, before you touch upon each other’s sensibilities, especially…”
Baili Yutian glanced sideways, his piercing and icy stare shooting straight for Liu Mubai.
Shuddering, the man sweated buckets as he and the other three outsiders bowed in respect, “We shall respect Patriarch’s wishes!”
“As long as you understand!”
Baili Yutian squinted as he passed judgment on all and everything. He then turned to Baili Jingwei, “Emperor, Prime Minister, you’re late. Why?”
Baili Jingshi gave a curt bow and reported, “Patriarch, these days Prime Minister has seized Serene Shores Trading and removed unwelcomed elements. Today they have been receiving the highest punishment as an example for everyone. As such, Prime Minister and I, have gone with the princes and nobles to supervise the execution. We ask your forgiveness, Patriarch!”
[Highest punishment?]
Liu Mubai shook at the words, his fists clenching.
“Highest punishment?”
Baili Yutian pondered, “Serene Shores Trading has established itself for thousands of years in the empire, contributing greatly to our nation’s prosperity. I still recall two thousand years ago how the four lands cut us off from all the spirit mines, and only Serene Shores Trading managed to open them again. Just what heinous crime have they committed to warrant ruination, and even use the highest punishment?”
Baili Jingwei bowed, “Patriarch, I had something to do with this…”
Baili Jingwei began to explain the demon spirit stone debacle.
Baili Yutian pondered, then mocked, “Only a few dozen greedy nobles died, and Serene Shores Trading hardly is to blame for this. The highest punishment is a bit excessive here. But Jingwei, you always have a reason for your actions, so I can only assume it has other meanings.”
“Patriarch has such insight! It is indeed so!”
Baili Jingwei gave off a confident smile as he bowed, “Patriarch, I believe that our empire’s unification plan can now begin. We can now wage war with the other four lands. When we rule the world, Serene Shores Trading would no longer be opening channels with the rest of the areas, but fester our empire like termites that the enemy might exploit. Collapse could come from the slightest weakness, let alone such a glaring one. That’s why I used this chance to have the company removed, for the future of the empire and its complete control over every mountain and river.”
Brows furrowed and hearts shook.
They couldn’t believe Baili Jingwei was so impatient to fight the other lands so soon. The Nine Sword Kings were barely established and quite free. Now they were to strike at every land around?
What was more, was he that confident that this was going to happen?
Baili Yutian stared for long before speaking, “You’re certain?”
“Absolutely, our previous defeat against the four lands was due to a lack of men, weakness. When one land fell, the other three jumped in, leaving our backs bare and pushing us into being defensive!”
Baili Jingwei’s eyes shone, “Only this time, we have the Nine Sword Kings and with Patriarch coming out of seclusion, even with having four fronts, our great armies will crush them before they can join together. I believe it is the Sword Star Empire’s greatest opportunity. Letting this drag on for longer will make the lands find counters for our Sword Kings and will make things worse.”
[Baili Jingwei, you sure don’t go in half-cocked. The Nine Sword Kings barely took shape and you already can’t wait to wage war. Talk about ruthless.]
Everyone thought the same thing in their minds.
Baili Yutian paused and said to the other, “You’re the emperor, do you agree with your Prime Minister’s decision?”
“Patriarch, Jingwei has always done things boldly and with wisdom, something I lack. All my seat can do is curb his eagerness and prevent him for making mistakes.”
Baili Jingshi smiled with a bow, “But after a three-day-long debate, he convinced me. While the plan feels rushed, it’s without a doubt rushed to the lands as well, not just to us and will prove to be effective. Thus I gave my approval of this plan. The empire shall send its troops immediately and strike like lightning!”
Baili Yutian stared at the two and nodded, “Since you’re both for this, then I have nothing to say against it. That’s what we’ll do!”
The two gave a deep bow and a smug smile.
The Nine Sword Kings were amazed inside, but not because of the two’s ingenious plan, but the Patriarch’s ability to use talent.
In this type of empire, with the Patriarch always watching over, the emperor’s power was tied down so there was no need for heavy tactics. The key was tolerance and having insight.
More so when in other empires, the Prime Minister was in charge of affairs far more than the emperor.
This made the seat of prime minister needing a true governing talent and only the likes of Baili Jingwei could fill it. As all positions of power, they came with such temptation that would make the prime minister be rash and let it get to his head in his decision.
For this reason the emperor’s role was not to lead a nation but to curb the prime minister’s zeal. This meant there was no godly genius of a requirement for it, since it would only clash with the first in trying to come on top and lead to grave consequences. What this seat needed was a plain individual that eased the prime minister’s talent.
It did not refer to one’s humble abilities per se, but moderation above all else. That was who Baili Jingshi was, the bucket of cold water for when Baili Jingwei’s talent flared too much and brought him down to earth.
This led to the emperor of the Sword Star Empire hardly ever passing any judgment on matters, always in the middle of things. In fact he was more of a prop, there in the background, as he handled things to work smoothly. He didn’t get involved in policies, but when the situation demanded, he was there to answer the call and avert any foreseeable calamity.
Thus, these two, one impetuous and another reserved, complemented each other in bringing out the perfect solution. Since all their power stemmed from the authority the Patriarch invested in them, they had no clashes, but actually worked hand in hand for a change.
This was nigh impossible to take shape in any other nation, not with the emperor and prime minister always throwing jabs at each other in order to wield more power; sometimes deadly. The prime minister limited the emperor’s authority yet needed his power at the same time. The emperor, on the other hand, wanted to kill the prime minister yet couldn’t exactly do without one either. Such was their paradox.
With both of them going forward with such a plan, Baili Yutian found no reason to dwell on it, immediately approving it.
The Sword Star Empire has been going easy on the four lands so far, but the sound of charging cavalry and marching soldiers, along with the cold edges of its Nine Sword Kings shall soon fill the lands!
They all, however, were unaware of one tiny element, a frozen corpse that suddenly stirred…
“Second young master, let’s go.”
In the public square of the imperial capital, an old man in black pulled along a youth with a sigh.
Watching the ashes of the people who once stood in the middle of the square, the warmth still fresh on his skin, the youth balled his fists and vanished among the crowd.
His vitriol-filled words only reached the elder’s ears, “Elder Ming, I swear we will rise again, as I toll the bell for the Sword Star Empire’s doom…”

chapters.title: Chapter 975: North Sea Battlefield
chapters.content:
Chapter 975: North Sea Battlefield
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Sword King Feiyun, a bird told me you have the Soaring Sword. Where is it now?”
With the mobilizing plant established, Baili Yutian went on to more important things and of great personal interest.
Shangguan Feiyun flinched and Baili Jingwei stepped in to cover for him, “Patriarch, please be calm. We had the divine sword but in a sudden turn of events, the Shangguan clan stole it…”
“What?!”
Baili Yutian glared in fury, “You mean to tell me that Soaring Sword is back in eastern lands? Humph, are my empire’s lands so weak that they can’t even get a grip on the things it has?!”
Shangguan Feiyun bowed at once, soaked with sweat, “Sword Patriarch, I am at fault for failing to protect the sword…”
“Humph, you expect to protect my empire when you can’t even get a grip on the divine weapon in your hands? Why are you even a Sword King? Or is it something else? Tell me, Sword King Feiyun, do you still feel some longing for the eastern lands and you simply gave it up—”
“Shut up!”
Baili Jingwei immediately snapped back at Baili Yulei’s insidious accusation, “Patriarch, I was there as well. Sword King Feiyun gave his all, his loyalty is beyond reproach. It was the enemy that outsmarted him and me, managing to steal the sword…”
Baili Yutian gave him a long look, “A devious enemy? You’re saying you lost in a battle of minds?”
Baili Jingwei shuddered on the inside as he felt utter shame to admit his biggest defeat yet. It was a severe blow to the man’s pride in his flawless intellect.
“Prime Minister Baili’s wisdom has no equal. It must be someone from the inside working with the enemy. And it’s plain to see that this spy has a tie with eastern lands, he-he-he…”
With Baili Jingwei hesitating so much, Baili Yuyu took the moment to jeer at Shangguan Feiyun’s plight and kick him while down.
Baili Jingwei gnashed his teeth and bowed as he came clean, “Patriarch, it has nothing to do with Sword King Feiyun. It’s all my fault for losing the divine sword from his ploy. I take full responsibility for my actions. Sword King Feiyun has only followed my advice the entire time. He never failed his duty!”
“Jingwei, you’re a cunning man who has his sights on the end goal. I believe you.”
Baili Yutian nodded, but then his visage darkened as bloodthirst shone in his eyes, “But you all know that I only care about Dao and my pursuit of it. The only reason I formed this empire is to make it easier for me to get closer. And where do I find it? In the divine swords. I’ve completed my inspection of the central area’s Sundering Sword and it won’t bring me any new insight.
“For this reason I am in need to find the other four lands’ divine swords and understand their design, so that I may one day break the heavens and reach higher. I went as far as waging war with them, all for the swords. Central area wouldn’t care about them as long as they sent them over. But they refused me and fought me. Now that I came out and heard that the Sword King Feiyun has brought with him the Soaring Sword to the central area, I couldn’t be happier. But in only a few days you lost it as well? Are you trying to toy with my feelings?”
Baili Jingwei and Shangguan Feiyun gave a frightened bow as they declared, “Never!”
“I know you wouldn’t, but maybe you didn’t care enough?” Glaring at them, Baili Yutian’s only interest on this wide green earth were those divine swords.
The only reason the strongest man in the world did not immediately use violence to curb his rage on these disappointing men was because they were too important.
Understanding his anger, Baili Jingwei shook like a leaf. Danqing Shen stepped in and bowed as he took their side, “Sword Patriarch, Prime Minister has fallen to the enemy’s cunning ploy and lost the divine sword, but he has been vanquished, no longer plaguing our empire…”
“What does it matter? The sword’s still taken!” Baili Yutian rumbled.
Baili Jingwei scrunched up his nerve to risk it saying, “Patriarch, I’ve been useless and the thief escaped. I did not succeed in bringing him to justice…”
“What?!”
Shangguan Feiyun’s shock echoed around, before even Baili Yutian got to say anything, “Prime Minister, didn’t brother Dan end the kid? Why are you saying he escaped?”
Baili Jingwei spoke with great pain to his pride, “I thought so as well, but the one who sold the demon spirit stones to the Serene Shores Trading was a man with a child on his back, matching his description. Furthermore, Murong Xue saw him as well and confirmed how he announced himself as Gu Yifan!”
“That’s not possible!”
Shangguan Feiyun gasped in disbelief, “How can a dead guy reappear in the central area and in just three days cause a mess of the imperial capital by killing almost half of its officials? Is it some vengeful ghost?”
Baili Jingwei sighed, “If only it were that. I fear he pulled a great escape from right under my eyes and enacted an even crueler ploy. He’s too shrewd, my first time encountering such a vile and calculating mind.”
Baili Jingwei looked filled with regret.
Baili Yutian watched them talk and sighed, “In other words, you don’t even know if he’s dead and that he disappeared from under you after having his fun with you?”
“Yes, Patriarch!”
Baili Jingwei sighed and lowered his head. Ever since he found out Zhuo Fan was still drawing breath, he felt crushed, his confidence gone.
He felt humiliated how the enemy just waltzed around and did his thing to ruin the place under his governance.
Baili Yutian nodded and spoke, “Jingwei, I have noticed your talent in deeper thinking, the best in your field, at the top of your game. First hearing about this matter, I thought it was due to gross negligence, only to see it for the truth. You did your best, but met your true adversary. This is… good.”
“I ask for Patriarch’s punishment!”
“No, your failure is the greatest punishment for you. You’re not the wisest after all!”
Baili Yutian grinned, “A man who only knew success will be excited at meeting his match, only to feel crushed in the end having lost his confidence as being the best. It is the greatest blow to any man of great talent, that to his pride. There’s no need to punish you, not when you’re already punishing yourself.”
Baili Jingwei shook and gnashed his teeth in shame.
Baili Yutian continued, “You should thank the heavens for giving you an opponent. If you were like me, undefeated all your life and only looking at the heavens and dismissing anything around you, you’ll come to understand the meaning of loneliness. Such excellence will always be accompanied by solitude. Maybe it’s heaven’s punishment for me, for I’m too strong…”
[Show off!]
Everyone’s faces twitched at Invincible Sword’s overblown hubris.
[No matter how I hear it, it sounds like you’re tooting your horn!]
[We get it, you’re at the top of the world compared to us in martial arts, but could you keep it down a little? You’re seriously asking for it.]
[Then again, no one will try and give it to you either. At the very least make a bit of effort and think of our feelings, please?]
The Nine Sword Kings were men of status and pride, though now cut to the quick by this guy’s bragging.
Sighing, they shook their heads, feeling like ants in front of such a monster.
However, they would never let their heart speak, ever.
Baili Jingwei bowed convinced, “I shall take Patriarch’s advice to heart and will strive to fight him next time and win. Also, I have one more thing to report that may brighten Patriarch’s mood.”
“What is it?”
“Northern lands’ best in Sea Bright Sect, also the strongest in their land, Ouyang Lingtian, has been gravely wounded from fighting the North Sea’s sea demon and the land is weakened. They have no leader now and it’s the best moment to strike. Very few people there could make use of the Heaven Sealing Sword’s power, with no one better at it than Ouyang Lingtian. This way we…”
“Invade the North Sea’s outback and take the divine sword!”
Baili Yutian’s eyes shone and shouted with joy, “The sea demon of the North Sea is ruthless. I once fought him myself, since no man could best me, but it would’ve been so much worse if I had become weakened in the northern lands. What if someone took advantage and killed me. The greatest shame is dying at a nobody’s hands. That’s why I had yet to truly experience the sea demon’s skills. It seems now that the demon is quite amazing. Going to northern lands might give me another chance to fight him, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Yutian laughed but Baili Jingshi shook his hand, “Patriarch is going into enemy territory by himself? That’s too dangerous? What if they join forces…”
“No matter, because they’ll never get the chance, humph…”
Baili Jingwei was practically basking in victory by now, “This way, in our war with the four lands, the main battlefield will be on the northern lands. It also happens that Shangguan clan took the sword northbound. We’ll snatch that one as well!”

chapters.title: Chapter 976: Devil Mountain Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 976: Devil Mountain Again
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Senior Uncle, did something happen lately? Why are so many experts of our sects going for Double Dragon Manor?”
“Isn’t it obvious? Only something huge could warrant such actions. For an urgent gathering to be held by calling every expert of the sect, it means something happened at the borders of our land. Western lands will no longer be peaceful now, awaiting to be plunged into a sea of blood.”
“Will something happen to us? With us being the head of the superior-three sects, Ultimate Clarity Sect, we would be standing right in front of it!”
“Humph, what does a disciple know? We may be somewhat known in the western lands, but we’re nothing beyond it, to the other lands. Once disaster strikes, the bigger the sect, the higher the body count. It’s all up to the heavens above now.”
“That cruel?”
…
On a clear sky, with the sun’s twilight glow basking unimpeded on the tranquil land, and the murmur of creeks teasing one’s hearing, A man and a youth were hovering in the air with a constant frown, investigating the disaster about to follow. The two sighed.
A piercing shriek rang out, with the sky dimming, birds scrambling away, and a whirlwind causing havoc through the area as a humongous shadow with three heads and wings covered the sky.
The sudden huge surge of power sent all the beasts shivering in their dens, prostrating before it like its eternal servants.
The man and youth squinted and panicked, heart stuck in their throat. The youth felt so much dread he was about to wet himself, clutching tight to his only lifeline, the man, and crying for his life, “S-Senior Uncle, what was that thing? It has such horrible power!”
“N-ninth level spiritual beast, the Three-headed Crow!”
The old man stammered in fear and the youth gulped down hard, “Senior Uncle, can you take on such a beast?”
“The hell I can! The 9th level spiritual beast is a monarch among beasts. It’ll be hard for even dozens of peak Genesis experts to get close, let alone me, in the 5th layer. I’ll only get killed. Be quiet and let it pass. Don’t piss it off!”
Wiping the sweat off his brow, the old man grabbed the youth’s hand, not budging an inch, afraid the slightest movement might irk the shadow passing over and turn them into fertilizer.
But then the humongous beast stopped on top of them, leaving a gust of strong winds to seep into their very bones.
Gulping loudly, the youth looked devastated and saw the old man shivering, “Senior Uncle, why did it stop? Did it find us? Will it eat us alive?”
“Stop panicking. Maybe it’s taking a rest, yes, that’s it.”
The old man’s face twitched, “A 9th level spiritual beast is a king and never needs to hunt, having the spiritual beasts under it feeding it. Something’s off about this 9th level spiritual beast, coming out in broad daylight. Did something happen that caught its attention? Anyway, we should be fine as long as we don’t disturb it.”
“Senior Uncle, is this why the Double Dragon Manor has called for a land-wide meeting?”
“I hope not, or not even a hundred peak Genesis experts will be enough to be considered this thing’s appetizer.” The old man’s face shook at the youth’s wild guess. “Beast and man are quite harmonious. Just why do we have to go out killing each other? Love, that’s what the world is missing!”
“I second that. I hope the big bird will also have Senior Uncle’s capacity for love…” The youth bobbed his head in fear.
Beneath the humongous shadow, one man and one youth stood frozen from fear, only staring at the thing above with ardent wishes that it would just go away.
Though time showed it had no such plans to cater to their whims, with a cold voice coming from up above, “Are you two from Ultimate Clarity Sect?”
“It can talk?!”
The youth gasped, “Senior Uncle, can a spiritual beast at the 9th level gain human speech?”
The old man was quite perplexed, “Such high level beasts are a rarity. It’s unclear if they do speak, but then again, I never heard any rumors about spiritual beasts that could…”
“Hey you, it’s not the spiritual beast talking but me!”
The voice sounded again, this time clearly from somewhere on its back. A tiny dot, popped from the middle head of the bird, looking faintly human in shape, “Could you please tell me if you’re from Ultimate Clarity Sect or not?”
The two were floored, their mouths twitching, and too shocked to reply.
[There’s someone riding a 9th level spiritual beast?]
[What kind of ungodly expert could restrain such a mighty beast? It alone can take on dozens of Genesis experts, a literal king of beasts!]
The two were out of it for ages, making the guy up top have a wry smile at their shock, “If you keep silent any longer, I’ll take you for corpses, and have my spiritual beast eat you!”
“No, no, no, please don’t do that, sir. We are from Ultimate Clarity Sect indeed. How may we help you, sir?” The two waved frantically at him to stop, scared out of their minds, while sweating buckets.
The man continued, “Could you tell me if this is Ultimate Clarity Sect’s domain, or do I still have ways to go?”
“Uhm, why are you going there?”
The old man cranned his head up with a shuddering heart, “Has my sect done something to you, sir? Why would you bring such a ferocious beast to Ultimate Clarity Sect?”
The man laughed, “That’s not it, I have nothing against your sect. On the contrary, having some friends instead, like Ye Lin, Wu Qingqiu and more. You know them? This spiritual beast is only my ride. But if you guys don’t tell me, then something is brewing here and I’ll have to dispense with the pleasantries. First have you for snacks, then destroy your sect, and lastly…”
“Wait wait wait, sir. Please calm down. We’ll tell you!”
The old man was scared to death as he hurried to cup his hands, “To be honest, we are on our way there, but it will take ten days with my speed to reach the sect. While with sir’s spiritual beast’s uncanny speed…”
“An hour will do.”
One of the crow’s heads turned to its middle head and said, “Sir, let us go on.”
The sun’s twilight rays shone the back of the Three-headed Crow and revealed the face of its passenger. Looking at young Sanzi next to him, Zhuo Fan nodded and said, “Thank you. I have once been to your great sect, but it has been a short event and I have forgotten the way since then. Let us meet again someday, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan signaled and the crow flapped its wings.
“I-it really talks!” The youth pointed a shivering finger at the beast with a gaping mouth, The old man was too stunned to react.
It was his first time hearing spiritual beasts speak.
Zhuo Fan chuckled on the bird’s back, shouting, “Yep, that last part wasn’t me but the spiritual beast, ha-ha-ha…”
“Wait, sir! Would it be possible to tell the two of us of your noble reason for visiting our sect?” The old man cupped his hands again and stopped Zhuo Fan from leaving.
[Well, he did show me the way and has no clue who I am. If by some misfortune I had ill will, getting his sect in trouble, he would be crushed.]
[What will Double Dragon Manor’s name become in western lands when he comes to them for justice?]
Getting his worry, Zhuo Fan’s eyes lit up and said, “There have been some vile men hurting one of our fellow disciples and Sect Leader destroyed five sects in his rage. Now that the world has stirred again, the people of Devil Mountain will kick up a storm, ha-ha-ha…”
The Three-headed Crow vanished with its two passengers, leaving behind violent whirlwinds, howling like the demons of the Underworld.
The man and youth were shaking in the savage winds, coughing and looking at the destruction around with shock.
“Holy hell! One flap of a 9th level spiritual beast’s wings is so brutal that the world is in ruins.”
Looking at the devastation, it looked like the end of days, as the youth stared dumbfounded and muttered.
The old man was stunned as well, mulling over Zhuo Fan’s words, “Does he mean that another disciple of Devil Mountain has come out?”
“Senior Uncle, what’s that about Devil Mountain?”
The youth asked the frowning old man, who said, “Disciple, haven’t you heard of the five sects coming to ruin two years ago?”
“You mean…”
“That was Devil Mountain!”
With a shaking brow, the old man sighed, “Because of the fights between the sects, a prominent disciple fell victim. No one knew he was actually part of the mysterious sect, Devil Mountain. Thus, the Sect Master, Overlord Nine Serenities, came himself to avenge his death by purging five sects and left behind his ungodly power that shook the land. Not even Double Dragon Manor could offend him. Yet after only two years, this mystery sect has now appeared again, sending its disciple into the world. And he actually rode a 9th level spiritual beast. They have learned their lesson, I see. As for us, this embodies ill news and turmoil!”
The youth was overwhelmed as he nodded out of reflex, “A 9th level spiritual beast is quite flashy. Devil Mountain is like a tyrant, but where is it? I’d like to be their disciple?”
“What did you say?”
“Uh, nothing, just thinking out loud, ha-ha-ha…”

chapters.title: Chapter 977: A Shrew’s Pep Talk
chapters.content:
Chapter 977: A Shrew’s Pep Talk
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Boom~
There was this space where golden flames licked every inch, with heat turned so high you’d bake, and the constant crackling sounded as if the earth itself was cooked.
Bolts of purple lightning flashed all around, briefly interrupted by the appearance of a hundred-meter large bird. It released violent flashes at the dangerous golden flames, erasing them in a terrifying explosion.
But as the golden flames around vanished, what stood in their place was a three-hundred-meter dragon, towering like a mountain with its huge eye showing pride.
Whoosh~
The purple bird landed, then it turned into a seven-year-old girl, looking curiously at the large creature, “Dragon Ancestor, is today’s training over? That was fast!”
“Ha-ha-ha, it is, since we have guests.” The dragon’s rumbling laughter sounded, then one sharp talon swept the air.
The air ripped and showed a bright sun on the other side and a mild wind rustling the trees around a creek, but also a very familiar man.
He entered into this space and smiled, “Dragon Ancestor sure is amazing. I just came and you already noticed.”
“Father!”
The adorable girl lit up and jumped in the man’s arms joyfully.
The man staggered, but hugged the girl back with laughter, “Qiao’er, it’s been so long. I see you had been doing great in here.”
“Father, did you come for me?” Qiao’er’s eyes sparkled with childish hope.
Zhuo Fan rubbed her head with sorrow, shaking his head, “It’s not up to me when you can leave. Dragon Ancestor has the last say. He will let you go once he believes you have the strength to hold your own in the big world outside.”
“Dragon Ancestor, can I go with father? I’ve learned all you’ve taught me…” Qiao’er swished her head around to the huge dragon with a puppy look.
These two years away from Zhuo Fan had been like ages to her and she had missed her father dearly.
Dragon ancestor stared hard at Zhuo Fan instead, “Kid, it can’t be you came all this way just to catch up. What happened?”
“Dragon Ancestor is amazing yet again. I just can’t hide anything from your discerning eye.”
Zhuo Fan showed a trace of sorrow, then he flicked his hand and young Sanzi’s feeble body appeared.
Qiao’er saw Gu Santong so weary and cried, “What happened to brother?”
“Qilin?”
Dragon ancestor saw young Sanzi for the first time, but one look was enough to recognize his origins, “Tell me what happened.”
Zhuo Fan sighed and nodded with a heavy look as he retold the events he went through the last couple of years, finishing with, “I didn’t know the sacred weapons had such power over sacred beasts. It’s my mistake. Now that I know where Heaven Sealing Sea Ao is, Kunpeng said that with you two’s seal on young Sanzi’s soul and body, it will keep him stable until I find Sea Ao to save him.”
“Oh, Kunpeng isn’t wrong about that. Heaven Sealing Sea Ao can handle this.”
Dragon ancestor nodded and his eyes shone. His huge claw shot forth and golden flames fell on young Sanzi’s body like stars, on his main acupoints.
Dragon ancestor placed the claw over young Sanzi and let the golden flames cover him, letting its power seep into him.
Young Sanzi began to show a golden glow this time, covering him completely and the child’s cheeks looked a healthier pink.
Dragon ancestor sighed, “The little Qilin will be fine for a while. Take him to Sea Ao, but you need to exercise extreme caution around that guy. He hates humans with a passion. When you do finally meet him, you won’t even get the chance to speak before the old bastard would splatter you. The young Qilin will be left for dead and you’ll become a bloody stain under his palm.”
“He’s still wild and can’t speak?”
“No, he just doesn’t trust human words.”
Dragon ancestor sighed, “He lost one of his eyes to a human and healing it proved difficult. This is why he sees humans as bitter enemies, making him go mad!”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shook, “A human took his eye? Who…”
“Sword Sovereign!”
Dragon ancestor let out a long sigh, “You must be fast to explain your purpose, or maybe just throw little Qilin over without even talking. I don’t think you’ll even have time to get even one word out before you become his meal.”
Zhuo Fan was stunned and gave a hard nod with a grim look.
Sacred beasts were the strongest in this world, needing but an instant to kill anyone even if sealed in the mortal domain. With Sea Ao killing any human he saw, talking would be pointless. It dawned on him just how risky his search had now become.
Qiao’er picked up on the dangers around this task and said, “Dragon Ancestor, then I can just go with father and help him!”
“Don’t argue. It’s too dangerous this time. Anything could happen going against a crazed sacred beast. Young Sanzi is bad enough, I can’t have you hurt as well.” Zhuo Fan refused on the spot.
