Dragon ancestor actually took Qiao’er’s side, “This time she can go, maybe she can really help you in this. She is a fledgling sacred beast and that old Sea Ao might give you some time on account of her, enough to state your purpose. And Qiao’er is strong enough to help you out as well, while also turning this trip into a learning experience for her.”
Qiao’er skipped with glee and Zhuo Fan gave a weak nod after a long pause.
He knew dragon ancestor had put a lot of work in Qiao’er and was not just about to give her up. What was the point of the last two years of training anyway?
Dragon ancestor must be convinced she could go out. And if he thought so, then Zhuo Fan had no reason to doubt the old dragon’s judgment.
Zhuo Fan reached out his hand, his tone as earnest as he knew how, “Senior Dragon Ancestor, this is a serious matter. Could you spare some assistance for this noble cause?”
“What’s with you?”
“Could you possibly give me, say, ten more Dragon Breath Pills?”
Blinking his big purdy eyes, Zhuo Fan begged without qualms, “Facing that lunatic, I’ll need further assistance. Facing a sacred beast without Dragon Ancestor’s much needed support will wring my little life dry from these feeble bones. I ask Dragon Ancestor to think of the end goal and give me all the help you can. If not ten, five will do just as fine…”
Dragon ancestor’s big eye twitched, giving a wry smile, “Kid, funny you should mention the end goal, when you used one of my Dragon Breath Pill on that nobody sect in the mortal domain. Did you forget how each of them is an all-out attack from me? With me stuck in the mortal domain and unable to recover my energy, you think I can pop out Dragon Breath Pills like candy? Those three were the limit of my reserves. Yet you, rotten good-for-nothing actually…”
“Oh fine, I get it…”
Zhuo Fan gave a dismissive wave and grinned, “I know you’re stuck here, but think of young Sanzi’s future. Is senior that cold to the child’s fate? And even if you are, you should at least value him for being on the sacred beast team in the final battle. He’s clearly a valuable asset. Are you just going to let him pass on? Humph, Kunpeng is so treacherous, aware of the danger Sea Ao posed but never mentioned it. Yet even so, he still had a 9th level spiritual beast come with me to help on this journey. While you go on and on about how he sold you guys out, but won’t that make you worse than him since you aren’t giving one measly help…”
Zhuo Fan gave him a scornful look, making the dragon ancestor snap at him in annoyance, “You say I’m worse than him? Humph, so he got the Allbeast Mountain Range yet only sent some 9th level spiritual beast? In here, I’m the only one left or I would’ve had an army go with you!”
“Bragging much? Actions speak louder than words.” Zhuo Fan taunted.
Groaning inside, dragon ancestor gnashed his fangs and spewed out ten golden balls the size of a hand.
He then started wheezing, “Kid, don’t ever say I didn’t help you. These small Dragon Breath Pills are all that’s left and you’ll have to make do. They can’t handle the old monster, but you can still use them to clear your path. This is all I can do to help, humph!”

chapters.title: Chapter 978: Full Support
chapters.content:
Chapter 978: Full Support
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Thank you so much, Dragon Ancestor. I’ve gone overboard just now.”
Looking at those now weary eyes, Zhuo Fan expressed his gratitude and turned to Qiao’er, “Take the ten small Dragon Breath Pills and take care of yourself.”
Zhuo Fan placed young Sanzi in his ring and walked for the exit.
Qiao’er bobbed her cute head and placed the golden fireballs in her own ring before following after her dad.
Dragon ancestor shook as he watched Zhuo Fan’s smug figure.
[The kid cheated me out of those ten Dragon Breath Pills, though not for himself but for Qiao’er!]
[What happened to the little Qilin has served as a hard lesson. He really does see those beasts as his son and daughter. A human…]
[Sea Ao, did you ever think that a human would care so much for a spiritual beast…]
“Agh!”
Zhuo Fan suddenly felt his left eye flicker with the black thunderflame and held it in pain as it bled.
“Father, what’s wrong?” Qiao’er cried in concern.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, but the dragon ancestor knew, “Kid, try to use that eye less…”
“Father’s eye?”
Qiao’er looked at dragon ancestor puzzled, “Dragon Ancestor, what’s wrong with father’s eye?”
The dragon stared at Zhuo Fan, who needed a bit of time before recovering. He wiped the blood from his eye and forced a smile, “Thank you, Dragon Ancestor, for your care. I’m fine…”
“Fine?”
Dragon ancestor scoffed, “You know exactly how fine it is, better than me. The danger that eye poses isn’t just to your opponents. I’m certain you noticed from the start. The Apocalyptic Thunderflame Eye’s greatest difference from Heavenly Sovereign’s Purple Lightning Golden Eye isn’t its great power, but volatility. You think the fusion of four sacred beast powers is that easy to handle? Keep playing with fire and you’ll only get burned!”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shook, but then put on a stoic look, “This eye saved me and young Sanzi. If next time it will burn me, I’ll be sure to drag the enemy down with me…”
Grinning, Zhuo Fan pulled Qiao’er’s hand and left the space, to the world outside.
Dragon ancestor remained behind with a speechless look.
[The demonic cultivator brat actually knows the value of sacrifice. He looks more and more like Nine Serenities. Is it the cultivation method or the inheritance, or maybe…]
Zhuo Fan rushed towards the North Sea with his daughter, while the other three lands got northern lands’ call for help. The Central area’s empire was on the move.
At Double Dragon Manor, the nine sects of western lands had gathered at Heaven Reaching Pavilion, all sporting heavy looks. This time’s meeting was a complete shuffle from the one two years ago.
With five sects laid to waste, new powers came out of the woodwork to fill the gap. Despite being weaker, they had the support of Double Dragon Manor to speed up their growth. One in particular among these new up-and-comers was quite eye-catching with its constant expansion of power, the Luo Alliance hailing from the Tianyu Empire.
The head of power in this faction was the top clan in Tianyu, Luo clan.
No one had any inkling how on earth this no-name clan even got to experience such unprecedented growth, not even Double Dragon Manor could explain it.
In just two short years, it went from the previous top lower-three sect power to being a middle-three sect in strength. It simply dwarfed those other new factions that didn’t even have a third of a lower-three sect’s strength. It was the brightest star in the whole of western lands.
And that was just the start. What made the Luo Alliance so incredible and worthy of everyone’s respect was its sudden rise being completely different from the Sword Star Empire’s imperial family’s reign.
What was similar was how they were not like sects, only focused on cultivation and ignoring the people around.
The Luo Alliance and the Sword Star Empire were similar in how they were made up of people from all walks of life, from farmers to officials. At its core was a military clan, leading troops to gain new lands.
The alliance had all grounds covered with the help of its generals and strategists, covering up both the power and the governing aspects, much like a small empire. An empire that was growing by the day. It actually got so good when it came to military matters that the western lands’ military aspects had the Luo Alliance in charge of them.
Some even believed that if not for the Sword Star Empire having the entire central area in its grasp and threatening the other four lands, the Luo Alliance’s mild and nurturing environment would lead it to become just another behemoth.
Alas, ifs had no place in this world. The Sword Star Empire was the strongest, barn one, drawing the fledgling Luo Alliance into becoming a member of the ever growing resistance against their onslaught, and making its future uncertain.
As with all things, only the first would go down in history, while the second would be forever swallowed by the forgotten ages.
In many instances, there was only one victor, with the second plagued with mediocrity. It would either surpass the first or forever be in his shadow.
This painted the Luo clan’s awkward situation. It had the potential to become a second Sword Star Empire but not the time. One needed time, fate and luck.
Zhuo Fan had laid the groundwork for them to build on, but not even he could fight the world’s nature. The timing to hold a land for itself had passed and now they had to wait for the next…
The people had gathered in a narrow room, with Luo Yunhai, the Alliance Leader flanked by Zhuge Changfeng and Leng Wuchang, as he frowned in thought at everyone.
The Exalted Double Dragons had taken the main seats with heavy looks, holding a jade slip and pensive. Exalted Hei Ran began at last, “People, I have called for you today, elders, venerables, sect leaders and clan leaders, to discuss a very sensitive and important topic. Sword Star Empire is on the move!”
“What?!”
Everyone tense at the grave news, throwing the room in chaos from their loud attempts at finding more from the ones next to them. Only Luo Yunhai’s team remained firm and silent.
[More like find nothing! These sects’ decrepit fools have no idea what it means to have someone stab you in the back.]
They did not have the calmness required by war.
Eyeing them coldly, Leng Wuchang and Zhuge Changfeng shook their heads.
Ahe-hem…
Exalted Bai Mei cleared his voice and said, “I have good news and bad news. The good news, eastern lands’ Shangguan Clan Head has succeeded in retrieving the Soaring Sword from the traitorous Shangguan Feiyun. The bad news, not long ago, the strongest in northern lands had fought with the North Sea demon and suffered grave injuries. Sword Star Empires capitalized on this and is now marching on northern lands to plunder the Heaven Sealing divine sword. The Sea Bright Sect is calling for help from everywhere, hoping to unite against the central area’s assault.”
“Exalted, who are they sending in this time for the northern lands to be so desperate to ask for help?” One man asked.
Exalted Hei Ran’s eyes grew dark, “Sixteen people have entered northern lands. The one leading the juniors is Sword Star’s crown prince, to temper himself, while Invincible Sword leads the other.”
“Baili Yutian?!”
Sss~
Everyone gasped from shock, “The monster comes out himself? No wonder northern lands are in panic!”
Exalted Hei Ran sighed, “That’s the least of our problems. Baili Yutian isn’t alone, having with him five Sword Kings of the Baili Clan. Oh, right, you must’ve only heard of this title used in Sword Star Empire but don’t know their power. Then here it is. Our strongest man, Danqing Shen, is now the Dragon Cleaving Sword King of the central area!”
“He’s a Sword King?”
“Yes. In other words, every Sword King is on Danqing Shen’s level at least. There are eight more beside him that are defending the central area, and above them stand Invincible Sword, Baili Yutian!” Exalted Hei Ran’s eyes shook and gnashed his teeth, “I never even realized how Sword Star Empire has gotten so strong. Baili Yutian aside, now the empire has grown so strong it will make even the four lands alliance experience heavy losses in a war.”
Everyone started and paled.
How did one even begin to fight that? And their western lands had just lost five sects two years ago, becoming the weakest area. They would suffer even more in such a war.
Only Luo Yunhai’s eyes shone and cupped his hands, “Exalted, what are your thoughts regarding northern lands’ plea?”
The Exalted gave him a long look and nodded inside.
[The Luo clan is amazing indeed to have that kid come from them.]
All the other sect elders were looking scared for their lives at such grave news while only the Luo clan was firm, thinking of the next step.
[A true military clan…]

chapters.title: Chapter 979: Lucky Charm
chapters.content:
Chapter 979: Lucky Charm
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Luo Clan Head, after we finish the meeting, us two will take half of Double Dragon Manor’s experts along with Ye Lin and the other outstanding disciples, to help northern lands and stop Invincible Sword’s savage power from lighting the whole area on fire!”
Exalted Hei Ran spoke after a pause.
Luo Yunhai pondered and then shook his head, “Double Dragon Manor is the cornerstone of western lands’ power. Taking half of that will leave it an empty shell. The odds are high for the Sword Star Empire to use this to his advantage by luring out our forces.”
“Hear hear, Exalted, please don’t go. We can’t just give up our own home just for the northern lands’ people.” One elder jumped to his feet and cupped his hands.
A Hellion Flame elder.
Luo Yuhai did not let the Exalted speak, continuing, “But not going isn’t an option either. After they take the Heaven Sealing Sword they’ll fix their eyes on us. How long do you think we’ll last? What’s worse, by not answering the call for help will make the four land alliance moot, with neither believing the other. Won’t that also fall in the enemy’s plan?”
Ugh!
The elder deflated as he said, “Luo Clan head, you’ve been talking all this time, but where are you going with this? We can’t save but must save. Are you just running your mouth?”
“Not at all.”
Leng Wuchang smiled, “I ask that elder understands, these aren’t mere ramblings, but Clan Head’s speculations of the situation. Only through analysis of the matter at hand can we take the right course of action. And how we act isn’t our Clan Head’s call, but the Exalted. My Clan Head is only giving advice, ha-ha-ha…”
The man’s face twitched, having just gotten served, but anger got the best of him, evident by the forceful tone, “There’s no end to shrewd men from the Luo Clan I see, knowing how to weave words. Then I won’t spend my time with you!”
“Please, we’re simply stating facts, ha-ha-ha…” Leng Wuchang spoke.
Exalted Hei Ran gave him a sharp look then his firm voice echoed, “It’s true, I almost forgot how Luo Clan has many sharp minds. I would like to ask your counsel about such a complicated problem. I dare presume you to be the two of Luo Alliance’s three sages, Leng Wuchang and Zhuge Changfeng, Sir Leng and Steward Zhuge?”
“Exalted, you honor us.” The two stood and bowed with wide smiles.
Exalted Bai Mei nodded, “Going by your judgment, what do you two think we should do next?”
They shared a smile and Zhuge Changfeng took the lead to explain, “Exalted, our Clan Head has been more than clear. By ignoring the northern lands’ plea, our safety will be short-lived, followed by losing everyone’s respect. On the other hand, jumping to its rescue will invite disaster. Danger will come to the western lands regardless, sooner or later. I could only defer to Exalted’s decision.”
Zhuge Changfeng hadn’t been a prime minister for nothing, his speech was flawless.
He was getting one abundantly clear point across…
[We’re here to dish advice. You’re the one calling the shots, especially since both paths are fraught with danger.]
[Don’t come to us to settle your problems. We’ve already given you an early reminder, but you wouldn’t listen.]
“Steward Zhuge, your reputation precedes you, ha-ha-ha…”
Exalted read between the lines and chuckled.
[He’s still hanging it over us. Sigh, just why are we making the call?]
This would absolve the Luo Clan of any responsibility for when everything went south. Double Dragon Manor just lost a scapegoat.
[Ha-ha-ha, now I see how the tiny clan experienced exponential growth. Not even the gatekeeper is average!]
Sighing, the two faced the problem once more, now with a little more clarity. By assisting northern lands, their own home would be left empty, ripe for the taking. But that was just a short-term loss, while the alliance would stay strong.
While ignoring northern lands’ plea was the knee-jerk reaction, giving them a short respite of safety while losing the trust of the other lands, making the next time they fought the central area that much harder.
Exalted’s eyes shone, having come to a decision, “We go to northern lands’ rescue. I shall leave our home’s safety in everyone’s hands, especially the Luo Alliance and their skilled military conduct. You are to be vigilant against the central area and take full responsibility and authority!”
“Exalted, we will!” Luo Yunhai cupped his hands.
Double Dragon Manor had made its decision, or to be more particular about it, it had been made since the start. They only called this meeting to get them all along with it, lest someone got any bright ideas and screwed everything up.
The two had yet to leave as an aged hand was raised, “Exalted sirs, I wish to report something!”
“What?”
Exalted Hei Ran spoke, “You’re Ultimate Clarity Sect’s Elder Xu, right? What’s so urgent that you need to tell us?”
The elder stood up, revealing him to be the same man that had met with Zhuo Fan on his trip to Ultimate Clarity Sect. Looking hesitant, the old man frowned as he muttered, “Exalted sirs, something of great importance must be shared with you and everyone else. I ask that you refrain from testing everyone you meet in your journeys, lest you invite disaster.”
“What are you yapping about, you old coot? Spit it out already!” The other seated men started getting annoyed with his drawling.
The elder sighed and said something that had everyone’s eyes bugged out, “A disciple of Devil Mountain has appeared again!”
Sss~
A unanimous gasp resounded throughout the room, with everyone freezing on their spots, more panicked than even hearing of Invincible Sword and the Nine Sword Kings.
Two years ago, the western lands had been quaking with the news of a one Overlord Nine Serenities’ power. Now Devil Mountain had sent another of their disciples into the world, and they couldn’t have picked a worse time too.
Hearts racing in their chests, trying to gulp down their anxiety, they along with Exalted would really like to avoid having to meet that dreaded old freak again, even more so than Invincible Sword.
“Old coot, are you certain? Don’t scare us now!”
With all wiping their ever-soaking brows, some in particular were getting panicky. These were all people who liked causing a scene.
They were mavericks through and through, but circumstances called for them to bend a knee and be nice for a change, lest they would like to feel the wrath and destruction that got five sects wiped off the face of this world on their very skin.
They had no concept of turning the other cheek, not when they enjoyed striking first. The only ones that had their blood run cold weren’t stronger and nice folks, but those worse than them. It was safe to say Devil Mountain was such an abomination, a pit of demons that would destroy them—and then some—at the mere sight of any of their disciples.
Last time Zhuo Fan’s display had the sects stirring at Double Dragon Gathering, making the Overlord Nine Serenities come out to wreck five sects. Now that another disciple showed up, what were they supposed to do?
While utterly confused, fear dominated among these men. Exalted Hei Ran snapped at the elder, “Speak clearly and in detail, man!”
Gulping hard, the man nodded and presented his full report.
Everyone was rendered speechless once he finished.
[Oh hell, the guy’s even riding a 9th level… Yep, he’s from Devil Mountain alright. Only that weird place has such freaks. It’s also clear Overlord Nine Serenities learned his lesson last time and sent a freaky spiritual beast to safeguard his disciples.]
Western lands’ sects had better tuck their tails, or else…
Exalted Hei Ran cleared his voice and mumbled, “Bai Mei and I will be leaving in a few days. The rest of you need to behave while we’re gone.”
[Screw you! You’re leaving awfully fast now that you know Devil Mountain is out again! You just can’t wait to save northern lands from Invincible Sword? At least you can fight him, while Overlord Nine Serenities is impossible to even touch.]
[Those scheming old coots…]
The Exalted got only dirty looks from the rest.
“Also, we’re taking Qingcheng as well. As a core disciple, it’s good for her to learn about the world, ha-ha-ha…” Exalted Bai Mei shouted with a dry laugh.
[To hell with you! You old geezers are taking even the lucky charm with you, but what about us?]
Everyone’s faces twitched, with the whole of western lands knowing that Devil Mountain was only ever nice with the widow Chu Qingcheng.
With her along, on the off chance they stepped on Devil Mountain’s toes, they were safe behind her. Under her shield of love, these two old coots would be mighty relaxed, earning everyone else’s ire, of course…
At a crater of a volcano in the southern lands, a girl was holding a jade slip while looking around.
She handed the slip to a man with soaked eyebrows and said, “Brother, northern lands is calling for help!”
“Bring me the Decimating Sword!”
“You’re not even asking for details?”
“Our four lands alliance is a promise set in stone. There’s no need to doubt it.” The large man spoke calmly as he left. Murong Xue watched his back with a smile and turned her bright eyes northbound.
“You just came back and now you’re leaving…”
A scarlet sword whirled through a heavy snowstorm, with three old men surrounding it and making hand signs.
Shangguan Feixiong rushed over nervously, “It’s still sealed?”
“I don’t know what that boy did to it, but not even us three together can’t unseal its sword spirit.”
“Blast it, I knew he gave up the sword too easily! He screwed us over!”
Shangguan Feixiong raged, “Damn you, Gu Yifan! What damn use do I have for this useless thing after you sealed its spirit? How am I supposed to fight Invincible Sword now? Once I get my hands on you I’ll tear you to pieces!”
Shangguan Feixiong gnashed his teeth with Shangguan Qingyan sighing nearby, her eyes filled with longing. She had no idea Zhuo Fan was on a mad dash to the cold north as well…

chapters.title: Chapter 980: Northern Lands
chapters.content:
Chapter 980: Northern Lands
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Northern lands, the northest area among the five, had 80% of it composed of a huge sea, battered by ice and snow all year round; a world of bitter cold.
This harsh environment led to few sects or cultivating clans due to the sparse resources, including spirit mines.
What this land had that no other did, however, was the wondrous and many miraculous ingredients found behind those savage waves.
This made it all the worthwhile for humans to consider this harsh region their home, filled with the prospects of unearthing the sea’s next great miracle. The results proved to be of great satisfaction to them as well, as with how rare the baubles found on the seabed were, the northern lands became the main supplier to the worlds’ rarest items.
What topped them all was the North Sea Gel coming out of the watery abyss at some point and hailed as a wonder cure for anything and every known ailment. It was worth fighting and even dying for. The only problem was, a sea demon was guarding it, making getting it all the more difficult and deadly.
With this strong sea demon’s sudden appearance, their access to the sea was cut off, making it dangerous to even access the usual mining or hunting fishing spots out at sea.
This spelled disaster for the northern lands, especially how barren it was to begin with. They were left to watch the glittering jewels behind a tempered glass and with a buffed guard in front of it.
For every venture into the sea would exact a terrible price whenever the sea demon appeared, making it a miracle if even a tenth survived.
For the good of all the cultivators in northern lands, Sea Bright Sect’s strongest, Ouyang Lingtian, had not long ago taken the greatest treasure of northern lands, the Heaven Sealing divine sword, to challenge the savage sea demon and settle things once and for all.
The hero everyone worshiped, ended up not even able to see the sea demon’s face as the demon flung him back and gravely wounded him in just one clash.
The people were already rejoicing about their returned access to wealth, but then left dumbstruck at the outcome. The sea demon was beyond anyone’s comprehension, even dispensing with the strongest of the northern lands like one does a child.
The sea demon didn’t even have to come out of the mist, taunting and ridiculing the insignificance of humans.
Everyone paled at its words, suddenly losing all interest in the sea’s riches. Sadly, when it rains, it pours.
No one knew who the bastard was that leaked how their strongest man got hurt, but central area’s Sword Star Empire heard it loud and clear, rejoicing by sending their own men over to steal their sword as thanks in the form of a team led personally by none other than Invincible Sword.
This news sent the whole land into panic and fear.
They didn’t even have the chance to prepare, as three months ago, Invincible Sword’s team mowed down any resistance and marched deep into the northern lands’ hinterlands.
The people were now desperate as the strongest and most ruthless man in the world had barged into the heart of their home, his cold blade hanging dangerously close to their heads.
The entire northern lands was in a state of constant anxiety for another three months from the real danger Invincible Sword’s team posed. Yet the strongest man did nothing outrageous and seemed to have vanished.
The unknown was far scarier now. Since they did not know where he could be hiding, in their own home no less, ready to pounce on them when they least expected.
It fell upon the cold and bitter land as another layer of ice to add to the people’s misery, making them shiver without stop.
This, however, proved to be of no concern to a certain someone, not one bit.
Hu~
Zhuo Fan’s breath steamed as he smiled, “Qiao’er, we’re finally in northern lands. Now we just have to get to the North Sea’s shore. I wonder how far it is.”
“But father, why couldn’t we just keep riding that big bird? It’s going to take ages to reach the shore now!”
He was holding the hand of a seven-year-old adorable girl, though she was frowning at him.
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Qiao’er, you don’t know human nature. Northern lands are now wound tighter than a violin, scared of their own shadow. Fear can lead to insanity, and riding the Three-headed Crow would be too eye-catching, painting a target on our backs. We have no chance fighting an angry mob on our tail and would only delay our journey. Remember this well, discretion is the better side of valor. Going in blindly will only make things worse and waste time. Especially with you kids being so fickle, we’ll never hear the end of it.”
Qiao’er brow shook, her confused gaze never leaving him.
Zhuo Fan shook his head with a chuckle. [I must’ve gotten silly. Young Sanzi has been around humans for so many years yet even he had yet to grasp the human’s way of life.]
[Qiao’er just left the safety of home so how could she know the intricacies of humanity? One step at a time…]
Easing a breath, Zhuo Fan continued to hold a confused Qiao’er as he walked towards the city.
“Stop! Who are you and what is your purpose in Sea Bright City?”
They were most unwelcomed by a big guard at the gate, so deadly serious he even let his Soul Harmony Stage aura out.
By all accounts, Zhuo Fan ought to be ignored with his Radiant Stage cultivation and Qiao’er’s power under tight wrap adorned with his demonic treasures. Yet for some reasons, these guards were quite earnest in their duties, not leaving anything to chance.
Or more like fear drove them up the walls so high they would jump at the slightest rustle. They were all tense that they would see even a bug as a threat in disguise.
Zhuo Fan took out a golden card from his ring, the ones only most honored clients of Serene Shores Trading could have, “I’m a merchant with my daughter, here to do business…”
“You’re…”
The big guard’s eyes shook in recognition, then he said to the others, “I know this man, he’s from Serene Shores Trading. I will escort him to handle his business while you stay here and watch anything that moves. Make sure no spy from the central area gets in!”
The other men nodded then ignored Zhuo Fan while the big guard immediately showed the way with no more questions.
On the way, the guard spoke to Zhuo Fan, “Sir, please follow me. I shall take you to our base.”
“Did you guys infiltrate this city? How come even the gate defense…” Zhuo Fan teased.
The man sighed, “Business can never break from politics. The company spread its influence to every domain and worked from the shadows just in case. But then the company’s base had a major incident and all branches began to use all their assets at the young master’s call, tying everyone together. I’m the lowest worker and have been told to show anyone holding that card to the base. I don’t even know the other base members or other valued clients. But I’m sure someone will talk to you there.”
Zhuo Fan squinted and nodded.
[Serene Shores Trading’s reach really is deep in the five lands. Old Wu had been smart, already paving their escape if anything went wrong.]
[I gotta say, I won big time by using the oblivious second young master to make all of this for my personal use. With all the places in northern lands under tight guard, walking around would’ve been that much harder without this company’s help.]
[Now I’m like a fish in water, ha-ha.]
Zhuo Fan grinned to himself…
The big man had brought them to a local store, quite rundown, lacking the glory and polish a big company should have. Zhuo Fan knew that his new contact with Serene Shores Trading was here.
The broken store was a mere front.
“Shopkeeper, you got a customer!”
Walking inside the ten square meters shop, the only display was the counter with some average goods while behind was a wall with an old door. Next to it stood a thin old man, looking washed up.
The big man gave him a look then left. The old man’s eyes shone and stared at Zhuo Fan.
Grinning, Zhuo Fan pulled Qiao’er over to the old man. He sized up the two newcomers then barely spoke, “We were once as glorious as the heavens, now fallen into hell. How may we remedy our plight and once again brave the endless skies?”
“I’ll carve a path through mountains of flesh and blood and lead us out the gates of hell, laughing in the face of death. Follow me and we’ll fight our way back to our peak!”
“Through a sea of blood and mountain of corpses, I’ll carve a path out the gates of hell, laughing in the face of death, until the day we once again grasp the heavens!” Zhuo Fan spoke slowly.
The old man nodded with a sigh, “I can only hope. Right this way, sir.”
The old man opened the door behind.
“Qiao’er, wait here.”
Telling his daughter to stay, Zhuo Fan entered the darkness behind the door…

chapters.title: Chapter 981: Change of Character
chapters.content:
Chapter 981: Change of Character
Proofreader
: Papatonks
The dark corridor had no end as Zhuo Fan walked deeper and deeper. Only after a long time did he notice a glimmer of lamp light.
Arriving there after more walking, he found fifteen people bowing and a table at the side with an oil lamp giving off a poor yellow light.
Zhuo Fan said, “You all know northern lands better than I do. I want to see the North Sea’s shore. What is your solution?”
“Sir can see that ever since Invincible Sword barged into northern lands, the sects are on edge. The guard is very tight everywhere and making it so hardly anyone can move around. And even if there are some who go, they are thoroughly questioned. Any disturbance that might occur would spell disaster!”
One youth bowed to Zhuo Fan and reported, “To avoid such troubles, one must be part of a few special groups. One is made up of disciples, elders and venerables of northern lands’ five great sects, who can come and go at will as long as their aura matches the signature on their token. Another is made of three great merchants in these lands that focus on war preparations. They have three specific trading routes to use and dispatch goods to every sect, having earned their trust and thus exempt from any questioning.”
Zhuo Fan frowned in thought, “Then what did you prepare for me?”
“Sir, we are indeed among those merchants, but to have sir form an identity for cover is too hard. It’s much easier to fiddle with the commercial line sending reports.
The man grinned and showed a token, “None know that one of the three great merchants of northern lands, the Qian clan, is in fact a Serene Shores Trading pawn manipulated from the shadows. It’s to prevent the two lands from engaging in war, while also removing the populace’s hostility and facilitating trade to a greater extent. Now that the Serene Shores Trading hidden operatives have begun to move, the Qian clan has become our front. Sir can use the cover of Qian clan steward to move about. This here is the token of the Qian clan. Sir needs just place a trace of soul inside.”
Zhuo Fan looked at it then said, “Serene Shores Trading’s roots run deep I see. You sure came prepared.”
“Ha-ha-ha, sir, peace is there to prepare for war. And to have our big clients attended to, we need to have assurances. The old chairman had seen these times coming and had arranged for countermeasures. Because Baili Jingwei had acted with such speed, it allowed our company to deal with it.”
The man sighed and cupped his hands, “Sir, we will have a supply transport ready five days from now to the North Sea. All the sects along the way will inspect the convoy. And while the token helps, every inspection will compare it with a report they have on the transport from the Qian clan to verify your identity. As such, I will have to ask that you give us a name so we can make you a true member of the Qian clan in northern lands.”
Zhuo Fan frowned as he pondered.
[With all the lands going against the central area, maybe even Shangguan clan and western lands’ men will show up. It’s best I avoid the usual names. And since it’s the Qian clan, then I’ll take on their name.]
“Qian Fan, no, Fan?”
(StarReader: first Fan is from his name, while the second means annoying, vexing. Qian is money.)
The man’s brow shook and chuckled, “Sir is truly refined, treating money like dirt. No one will ever dislike Qian Fan, ha-ha-ha…”
The others laughed along.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “True, sometimes more money means more trouble, ha-ha-ha…”
Qiao’er, still inside the poor shop, had waited for so long and was bored to death, looking around the place.
Though there wasn’t anything particularly of interest to the average man. While Qiao’er, who was seeing the world for the first time, found everything a curiosity.
Qiao’er lit up as she stared at a purple mask of an eagle, finding it familiar and interesting.
She was a bird as well, thus the eagle mask struck her fancy.
Her hands reached out for it out of her control, but then another dainty hand grabbed it first, “Shopkeeper, I want this one!”
Qiao’er flinched and followed the mask as it was taken by a fair young lady looking it over.
“T-that’s mine!”
Qiao’er didn’t know what to say, just that the mask was something she was fond of and now it felt like someone stole it from her.
The woman raised an eyebrow and turned in the child’s direction and big adorable eyes greeted her, “Little girl, just because you said it, it’s yours? Do you have money for it?”
“What is money?”
“So no then, he-he-he…”
Seeing the child so confused, the woman had a wide smile as she flourishly took out ten sacred stones on the table and teased, “I’m buying it. It’s mine now!”
Qiao’er, still confused, looked at the stones then at the mask with longing and hope.
Qiao’er had no clue what those were, having just come out into the world, but the shopkeeper did all too well.
[Using ten sacred stones over some boring old mask is such a show off.]
The average sect disciple, even venerable at that, would never swagger to such an extent. Those who spent money like water were the imperial family. But with the might of the sects in northern lands, the imperial families were controlled like it was done in western lands.
Throwing away sacred stones was the common trend, but one tended to give sacred stones a second thought. And just like the other two lands, there were moneybags and wastrels everywhere.
But with northern lands on lockdown, who’d be dumb enough to come all the way here to waste their money? As for its three allies, their teams had settled on the North Sea’s shore and certainly not here.
That could only mean this person was from the Sword Star Empire!
Gnashing his teeth, the old man felt rage having guessed her identity. But then he sighed, letting all the frustration seep out and make way for calmness, “Miss, don’t you think it’s disgraceful to fight with a child over a simple mask?”
“What’s it to you? I like fighting, humph!”
Jutting out her chin, the woman taunted with a raised eyebrow, “I’m paying anyway and it’s only natural it’s mine. Don’t tell me that even ten sacred stones aren’t enough for a measly mask!”
The old man shook his head and straightened his back, “This mask is made of the plumage of a 1st level spiritual beast, Scarlet Beak Eagle, valued at…”
“Don’t start me with the price. How much could some 1st level spiritual beast’s feathers be worth anyway?” The woman warned.
The old man shook his head, “Thirty spirit stones. Miss, ten sacred stones is beyond excessive…”
“More for you then. Take it as a reward.”
The woman huffed and held her head high as she snickered at Qiao’er, “Girlie, I’ve never lost a fight in my life, he-he-he…”
Qiao’er frowned, wiggled her cute nose and stuck out her lip.
It only worked to drive the woman’s joy higher, pinching those wittle cheeks, “Little baby, once I’m done with it, I’ll give it to you, if we ever meet again. If not… oh, why not come with me?”
“Miss, are you now a slaver?”
The old man mocked, “You’re just too pigheaded. Not everything in the world can be done with stubborness alone just because you want them only to throw them away later when bored. A truly cherished item will never be thrown away. And I don’t feel like selling my items to someone who can’t even value them. Take back your sacred stones and leave the mask. I’m giving it to the child.”
The old man put on a cold face as he pushed away the sacred stones.
Qiao’er perked up, taking the mask, “This is mine. He gave it to me…”
The woman was faster in getting to the mask first, as her hand darted ahead of Qiao’er’s small hand. She then turned a dark look to the old man with eyes shining with murder, “Money for goods, that’s how it’s always been. Never has there been anyone who could take stuff from me. Old fool, do you have a death wish?”
“Always you say, humph. More like throwing money for something that caught your eye only to throw it away when you find it boring.”
The old man met her glare and jeered, “I believe if that if it had a soul it would never choose to go with you, miss. It would rather have nothing to do with the likes of you.”
The woman’s piercing glare never left the old man, “There’s something else you’re hinting at. Just who are you?”

chapters.title: Chapter 982: Frigid Rain Sword King
chapters.content:
Chapter 982: Frigid Rain Sword King
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“A seller who had his heart broken when master threw him away.”
The old man lamented then derided, “Miss, besides buying goods, there’s still the matter of will to lead to a smooth trade. I, however, am unwilling to sell it to you no matter how much money you give me. So just leave it and go.”
The woman’s face fell while Qiao’er was getting anxious, “Let me have it! He gave it to me and won’t sell it to you…”
“Yeah, he won’t sell it. What a shame. What I want, I buy, even if he doesn’t want to.”
With cold bloodthirst shining in her eyes and a sinister smile, she released her power to pin the old man on the wall.
The woman’s hand oozed sword energy, her tone deadly, “Old fool, I’m no dealer and certainly not here to bargain. I don’t care who you are, but you’re going to pay for defying me, humph…”
The woman flicked her hand and a sword flew out. The old man couldn’t even blink in the face of such mighty power, stuck there on the wall.
He knew this was going to happen from the start, choosing now to welcome the death he knew would come.
He had been ever loyal to Serene Shores Trading. To voice the wrong on the chairman, he dared to spit in the other’s face and now he was bold enough to give up his life for the bond between master and servant.
He had let go of everything and was ready to pass on…
“Stop!”
A shout came from the dark corridor, followed by a calm voice, “Miss, you can kill all you want, but try to do it outside Sea Bright City, lest you’d want to have all eyes on all of us.”
The woman smirked, looking at the dark corridor’s entrance with mockery, “You think I care?”
“Miss doesn’t care about all but one man’s opinion.”
Zhuo Fan walked out of the shadows, his tone flat, “The man doesn’t want miss to make trouble or it will earn his ire. And over what, a shabby mask? Ha-ha-ha…”
The woman’s brow shook and winced. Her heart sank and mulled things over before withdrawing her aura.
The old man slumped from the wall and gasped for his life.
He was ready to die, but anyone alive was happy to have come out of that with his life still.
Staring hard at Zhuo Fan, the woman squinted and clenched her fists as she growled, “Who are you? Do you know who I am?”
“I don’t.”
Zhuo Fan shook his head and bowed, “I am but a steward of the Qian clan of northern lands, Qian Fan. This frail store is in my clan’s care and I hope miss will be forgiving, ha-ha-ha…”
The woman stared hard, “Qian clan? One of the three great merchants?”
“Yes.”
“Lies!”
The woman spat, “Merchants only care for money, always weighing gains and losses. You think they’d haggle with me over some run down shop like this? And by the looks of you and your impassive face, you’re not just anyone either, to not twitch under my killing intent. There’s no way a tiny Qian clan would have someone like you as its steward. Who the hell are you?”
Zhuo Fan gave a slight bow with a wide smile, “Thank you for the praise miss. As for who I am, there’s no need to ask, just how there’s no need for me to ask who miss is. In short, I’m of no threat to miss and if miss doesn’t see me as an enemy, we can each go our own way. There’s plenty of road for the both of us to never intersect, ha-ha-ha…”
“But you already know who I am!”
The woman was confused how someone just popped up that had leverage on her. Who was he?
“How can I trust you mean no harm to us without declaring who you are?”
Zhuo Fan shrugged, “Do I really know? Ha-ha-ha, miss, you’re jumping the gun here. I only feel like miss shouldn’t make a scene, that’s all. Miss needn’t look into me as well. Being able to tell your identity shows you needn’t know any more, that any probing will be fruitless and would only bring more problems than solutions.”
“Is that a threat?”
“A warning.”
With an insufferable grin plastered on his face, Zhuo Fan’s eyes held a sharp glint, “If you’d go to western lands, you’d come to realize the world is vast and that there are people above you still. That no one can avoid certain calamities. Caution is always prized in life, lest the slightest mishap might bring it all down. Growing overconfident helps no one.”
The woman’s frown shook, her eyes bewildered, “Western lands…”
“You’re that…”
The woman gasped and grimaced at the sudden realization.
Zhuo Fan’s mouth curled, playing the mystery card, “Miss doesn’t need to say it, just know it. It’s best we each go our own way and not throw everything into chaos.”
The woman felt conflicted, but then huffed and left in a rush.
“Wait.”
Zhuo Fan held out his hand with a smile, “May miss be so kind as to return my daughter’s mask?”
Pausing, the woman shot Qiao’er a look then scoffed, “Your daughter, ha-ha-ha. Someone as average as you actually has such a pretty and adorable daughter? The heavens must be blind!”
“Ha-ha-ha, there’s nothing strange about it. Her mother takes all the credit.”
“Enough with the smugness. Letting you off is already kind enough on my part. Don’t ever think you’ll get the stuff that I have my eye on!” The woman snorted and refused.
Zhuo Fan said, “Then I don’t have a choice. Among practitioners, the more friends the more options you have. Since miss insists on making a scene, if anything happens and an investigation starts because of you, that man…”
“You say we should go our own way, but you’re clearly butting in our own side…”
“It’s not us doing it, but you who is provoking it.” Zhuo Fan’s cold stare was fixed on her, “Miss, I am just like you, unable to let go of what catches my eye, even if it’s a dime or pin. The same goes for my daughter. What sets us apart, however, is that I have no such thing as the empathy or consciousness holding me back from making trouble over it, unlike miss here…”
The woman’s face shook and growled as she flicked her hand in rage, throwing the mask at Zhuo Fan, “You haven’t heard the last of me…”
The woman left with that threat hanging as she stormed out the door…
Zhuo Fan’s creepy grin surfaced as he caught it, giving it to the hopeful and happy Qiao’er by his side.
“Sir has such valor to talk that witch into giving up. I am in awe!” The old man bowed before Zhuo Fan in gratitude.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “You know who she is?”
“From the central area.”
The old man’s fading eyes shook as he sighed, “Intel says mighty experts have invaded northern lands, ten imperial princes and Invincible Sword leading five Sword Kings. Among the Nine Sword Kings, the only woman is Frigid Rain Sword King, Bali Yuyu!”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Exactly her!”
“Then how did young master manage to scare her away…”
“Fear of consequences.”
Zhuo Fan said, “She fears one man only, Invincible Sword Baili Yutian. They have invaded northern lands yet didn’t show themselves because Baili Yutian demanded it of them to be subtle. All this wait is for the perfect moment to strike. It’s safe to say that any disturbance they cause beforehand will earn his wrath. So I figured she was more afraid of him than being pigheaded. That’s why I did not fear her at all.”
The old man mulled his words and nodded, ‘Why then did she return the mask? She could have…”
“Fear again.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Baili Yutian won’t take anything short of victory in this operation but now they have someone butting in their business, ha-ha-ha. Whoever brought about this disaster is bound to be subjected to Baili Yutian’s rage.”
“But who could hinder them when they have such power…”
“Have you heard of the matters in western lands?” Zhuo Fan looked aside at him, “Your company’s intelligence should know that Baili Jingwei had men looking into me in western lands and should know of the terrible event…’
“Devil Mountain?”
“Precisely!”
Zhuo Fan nodded with a glint in his eyes, “Devil Mountain is too much of an unknown while showing unprecedented strength. It caused the Nine Sword Kings and even Invincible Sword to be weary. Humans fear the unknown so I hinted I’m from Devil Mountain. The stronger I appear, the weaker they feel. Since she knew next to nothing of me, she feared doing anything that might cause trouble. Maybe Devil Mountain is nothing, but on the off chance that it is, their plan would be foiled and who would Invincible Sword take it out on? Ha-ha-ha, that means any that get Devil Mountain’s attention is one poor devil. This is one liability she could not afford to have!”

chapters.title: Chapter 983 - 983, I Wish to Meet
chapters.content:
Chapter 983, I Wish to Meet
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
The old man twirled his beard and took his time running his words through his mind before saying to Zhuo Fan, “Sir is truly outstanding, such insight into the enemy after one look. I had no idea what second young master saw in sir to trust you so, but now I do. Second young master’s vision is without equal…”
“Ha-ha-ha, there’s no need for that. You make it sound like he got me on board.” Zhuo Fan emphasized on his leading position in all of this.
The old man paused then nodded, “Yes, we are your loyal servants, sir. But I do have one doubt. Does sir come from that Devil Mountain?”
“Devil Mountain…”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shook as if from fear, but then he showed a smile as he turned to the hopeful old man, “Do you believe there’s such a thing in the world?”
Startled, the old man hesitated before shaking his head, “It is because I do not know with how wide the world is that I ask sir to clarify.”
“Truth may become a lie as lies can turn to truth. The absence of something does not disprove or prove its existence.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone and laughed to himself, “It doesn’t matter if such a thing exists, only that the people believe in it. In case it doesn’t exist now, nothing stops it from coming into being later, right? Ha-ha-ha…”
The old man’s face twitched and his eyes widened all of a sudden, looking at Zhuo Fan with even more respect. He gave a deep blow filled with awe, “Sir is godlike, setting up such a huge stage, pulling officials, emperors and beggars alike. But if the name proves to be false…”
“Isn’t your company’s model not to look into people? Let it become real with time.” Zhuo Fan grinned.
The old man understood and looked grateful.
Their comeback had just received godly help, no, this mystery man’s help.
Zhuo Fan had given Serene Shores Trading a second chance, only coming by now and then to show them the way, to fight for public opinion.
Since he wanted a power that went from corner to corner of the world, he couldn’t let everything in second young master’s care. Wu Randong was only a guide, while the real leader of the company was a man with talent and vision.
Making his name known and showcasing his skills was one of the many steps he had to take to make it so…
Walking towards a giddy Qiao’er playing with her new mask, Zhuo Fan left with her. The old man had been bowing all this time, proclaiming his endless respect.
The same guard once again popped up as they exited the shop and said with courtesy, “Sir, I have arranged a place for you to stay. Please follow me.”
He led Zhuo Fan and Qiao’er to their room where they cultivated in peace as they waited the five days to pass..
In a quiet groove, deep and hidden, with not a trace of sunlight gracing the ground, the coldness grew thicker, seeping into one’s bones.
It was in this freezing place that a dozen or so men sat on the damp ground. Their leader was an old man with sharp eyes and a powerful spirit.
The four people closest to him were Baili’s four Sword Kings. And behind them were ten youngsters, with the crown prince leading the other princes of the imperial family. They had come along with their Patriarch and Sword Kings to learn on this journey and grow, to continue the legacy of the strongest clan!
Whoosh~
A beautiful woman suddenly appeared in their sight, then started flicking her hand in anger and kicking her feet before plopping next to the four Sword Kings with a deep breath to begin mediation.
“How can you cultivate with such a restless mind?”
Baili Yutian spoke, opening his eyes, “Yuyu, what happened? Is there any news from Jingwei?”
The others looked over as well, with Bali Yulei frowning and chiding Bali Yuyu, “Yuyu, what’s the problem exactly to be so pissed? You’re disturbing Patriarch’s meditation. Have you found something that bodes ill for us?”
“Forgive me, Patriarch, I didn’t mean it.”
She stood and bowed to Baili Yutian in fear, watching from the corner of her eye for any movement from him. His face remained impassive, like a tranquil lake.
Baili Yutian stood up at last and spoke without looking at her, “Speak first then you can apologize. You know I hate it the most when people start throwing tantrums like a bunch of children. Don’t even act like this again without any reason when I’m around!”
“I won’t.”
Bali Yuyu hurriedly bowed, “Per Patriarch’s order, I went to check the area and found nothing strange. Prime Minister has yet to move, but…”
“What?”
“On my way back I met someone…” Bali Yuyu’s tone lowered as she hesitated.
Baili Yulei frowned and interjected, “Someone? Who? Does he have something to do with us? What makes you so restless that you can’t calm down?”
“He… I only just met him, but he appears to be from Devil Mountain…”
“Devil Mountain? The mystery sect from western lands?”
Bali Yuyu was tense as she uttered, only for Baili Yulei to suddenly cry out, “The information we got from western lands say that Devil Mountain’s lord is so strong that may rival Patriarch, and making the western lands’ strongest experts sit back while he destroyed five sects without so much as a warning. How can someone from Devil Mountain just appear in northern lands? Patriarch, we’re not only facing the four lands alliance but also this unknown power!”
Baili Yutian’s features shifted a bit then he spoke coldly, “Yulei, did you just say Devil Mountain’s lord can match me?”
“Uh, no, never, he can’t be up to Patriarch’s level, but he is far stronger than a Sword King!” Baili Yulei shuddered when he noticed his leader’s focus. He knew practitioners never liked to be compared and rushed to explain.
Baili Yutian chuckled, his eyes cold, “Yulei, haven’t I already told you? You don’t have to walk on pins and needles around me and just say it like it is. According to the people in western lands, Devil Mountain’s lord, Overlord Nine Serenities, has long since outgrown heaven in power. There’s no need to be so cautious around me. Being better or lower than me, humph, nothing but wasted words. Have you even seen him?”
“Oh, right, right, Patriarch. We never saw him and not many from western lands saw him either. With how the rumors circulate, they must be inflated.”
Wiping the cold sweat off his brow, Baili Yulei gave a dry laughter, “Patriarch knows not to trust hearsay, not when they get embellished every time they’re passed on. Maybe this is western lands’ plan, to intimidate us. Maybe Devil Mountain doesn’t even exist, nor is there such an expert.”
Baili Yutian nodded, “Yes, while such a possibility does exist, there are many who seek fame and fortune. The world does not lack people with insidious minds. This may be the western lands’ plan. Being subtle about creating Devil Mountain out of nothing to scare me and keep the peace for a moment longer.”
“Patriarch is right!”
“But this man of Devil Mountain really exists!”
Baili Yulei praised the old man, but then Baili Yutian switched topics, “This means that this isn’t a scheme, since the crux of this ineffable mystery is being vague and undecipherable. With the coming of a disciple, that can only mean the Devil Mountain exists. I would like to meet him.”
“Patriarch, you want to meet him?” Baili Yulei cried in shock.
Baili Yutian nodded and his eyes shone, “I have never lost once in my long life as cultivator and have been in a bitter search for a worthy opponent. Now that this ephemeral person appeared, I am excited. I hope that before the war starts to see his disciple and test him. That’s a good idea, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Yutian laughed and turned to Bali Yuyu, “Yuyu, tell me everything about your meeting with me. I need to assess him…”

chapters.title: Chapter 984 - 984, No Holds Barred
chapters.content:
Chapter 984, No Holds Barred
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Yes, Patriarch!”
At his orders, Baili Yutian bowed at once and recounted everything.
Baili Yutian squinted, “Yuyu, you’re a peak Genesis Stage expert, even with demonic treasures hiding your true cultivation, but the moment you released your bloodthirst, the kid saw through your strength and your identity. Yet despite all that, a 3rd layer Radiant Stage pup feared you not, using his persuasive words to retreat, without even the mask. What a rare spirit he has!”
“Humph, I had to listen to Patriarch’s warning or I’d have long since removed his head from his shoulder for you!”
“A loss is a loss, no excuses!”
Baili Yuyu raised her hands in anger, but Baili Yutian snapped at her, “That man has skill to grasp your weakness and leverage it. It’s you at fault for not hiding it well and lost without a doubt. Accept it and not throw a tantrum at me like a teenager. You’re a Sword King, so act like one!”
Baili Yuyu’s face shook as she took a deep breath and bowed deeply, though the grudge only festered inside her still.
Baili Yutian nodded, “Yuyu, tomorrow you’ll go spy on the kid and gauge his reaction. I want to see how Devil Mountain’s disciple compares to our Baili clan’s disciples.”
“Spy, that’s it?”
“Yes!”
Baili Yutian’s eyes flashed, “And I’ll even allow you to kill this time, no holds barred.”
Bali Yuyu lit up in excitement, “Thank you so much, Patriarch. Let’s see that punk be cocky again…”
“But…”
Baili Yutian barged into her joyous occasion, “The only one you’re not to target in your killing spree is Devil Mountain’s disciple.”
Bali Yuyu shuddered, “But Patriarch, you first tell me I can kill and now you say not him. Then what…”
“I want to test him, not to kill him!”
Baili Yutian took a deep breath, regarding the heavens, “Like master, like disciple. I want to see just how the Devil Mountain’s disciple is compared to our clan’s. Would he still keep a straight face with a mad witch out for blood hot on his heels? Ha-ha-ha, this’ll make for a great test!”
Bali Yuyu’s heart twitched.
[Patriarch, I thought I’m a Sword King you yourself entitled, how come I’m suddenly a mad witch. Show some respect at least!]
Baili Yutian didn’t give a damn, grinning to himself.
Baili Yulei frowned, “Patriarch, with Yuyu wreaking havoc in northern lands, it will bring the war closer. Then Jingwei’s deployment…”
“It’s fine.”
Baili Yutian cut him off, “Jingwei is the Prime Minister and values the empire’s victory. While I am only out to find a worthy opponent to learn from and understand the world even better to grasp greater strength. Any that stand in my way, even the empire’s interests, are to step aside, understand?”
They all shuddered on the inside and bowed, “Yes, Patriarch!”
“With business out of the way, now it’s time for personal issues!”
Pa!
Baili Yutian turned icy once more and snapped his hand as he glared at Bali Yuyu. A violent and strong force struck her, spun her around three times before slamming into the ground with a crunch and bleeding from the mouth.
Baili Yulei started, “Patriarch…”
“I asked her to scout, yet she went to a thrift shop? Humph, women are so fickle.”
Baili Yutian’s tone was as cold as his glare, “A thousand lashes ought to set her straight. Yulei, you’ll be enforcing the punishment then have her go on with her task!”
“Yes!”
They all bowed without a choice, with Bali Yuyu not even making a comment, despite the swollen cheek.
Baili Yutian returned to his seat, with others rushing to do the same. Baili Yulei sighed and took Bali Yuyu behind the trees and sharp cracks split the air.
A thousand lashes later, Baili Yutian staggered over with sweat marring her features while blood seeped from her lacerated back. She, however, pushed through the pain, gnashing her teeth and bowing to Baili Yutian before flying to her mission.
Baili Yulei clenched the whip in his hand, sighing as he returned to his seat.
Five days later, the Qian caravan was ready. Zhuo Fan, the fake steward, took the lead of the carriages drawn by 3rd level spiritual beasts while escorted by fifteen guards, the same fifteen he saw back in that dark room.
With a shout, the spiritual beasts roared and pulled the heavy transports in a mad dash, while the people sat inside where it was warm and there was wine.
Though something felt off for some reason. They kept feeling a chill creeping up their spine now and then. Looking outside with vigilance, they noticed a cold woman following from behind with an eerie grin that had them shiver.
“Sir, why does that woman keep staring at us?”
Pulling Zhuo Fan over to the window, the guard pointed her out, “Our transport is secretive in the northern lands so how come we have a tail?”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “It’s fine, just one of the Nine Sword Kings, Bali Yuyu of the central area. Last time we had a bit of a stand off so now she just came to scare us.”
The man almost spat blood from fright.
[Bali Yuyu?! And it doesn’t matter if she’s tailing us? Bro, you sure have a big heart.]
The others’ faces twitched as they watched Zhuo Fan with shock. Never in their wildest dreams did they think a Sword King was on their tail.
What made it worse…
[The new boss doesn’t even care. Is this idiocy or valor? Anyone else would’ve wet their pants hearing a Sword King is onto them…]
Zhuo Fan grinned and rubbed Qiao’er’s head.
Qiao’er giggled, having caught his look, and mocked, “Why are you scared? She’d never touch us anyway or she’d have done it five days ago. Dad got her seething with rage yet still had her give back my mask. If not then, then certainly not now, so relax.”
“You had an argument with her back then?”
Everyone cried out and looked stumped, before bowing in respect, “Sir is truly amazing to have even a Sword King back off. We are in awe. Now we know why second young master wanted to follow sir.”
Zhuo Fan gave a light wave, “Please, you should be thanking Baili Yutian. It was he who set her restriction so that the Nine Sword Kings can’t move without his say so…”
Boom!
The sudden explosion coming from behind shook the carriage, rumbled the earth and scared the spiritual beasts.
The 3rd level spiritual beasts went wild at the sudden noise, bucking and throwing the bindings off it.
The carriage began to wobble under Zhuo Fan and the others’ feet and showed signs of toppling soon. They burst outside and the sudden view had them in shock.
Everywhere they looked, the previously snowy and beautiful painting of nature was now scorched black with holes everywhere.
Of the five carriage, the last one was nowhere to be seen, not even the five 3rd level spiritual beasts pulling it. One could only take a wild guess, from the blackened earth, that they were pulverized in the blast.
Everyone’s face twitched and the knees softened under them from fright. One turned to Zhuo Fan and whined, “Sir, didn’t you say she wouldn’t…”
“Yeah, five days ago she didn’t attack so why now…”
Zhuo Fan was calm, “The old coot had let her loose it seems. Humph, but to what extent, that is the question…”

chapters.title: Chapter 985 - 985, Testing
chapters.content:
Chapter 985, Testing
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Whoosh~
A cold figure landed just a hundred meters from Zhuo Fan’s group with a cold smirk.
Everyone turned to jelly at the sight of this vile witch, staggering backward. Only Zhuo Fan not just stood his ground, but walked closer, with an ineffable smile, “Miss, we meet again. How’ve you been? Good, I hope.”
“Humph, keep your slick words to yourself!”
Bali Yuyu had a crooked grin, mocking, “Kid, didn’t you say I wouldn’t touch you? Just watch me! I made sure to destroy your goods and kill your men. Now it’s your turn, ha-ha-ha…”
Bali Yuyu’s cackle chilled the others to the bone, while Zhuo Fan’s smile never faltered, slowly shaking his head as he walked even closer, “Miss, it was I who offended you. The others have nothing to do with this. Why take it out on the innocents instead of me?”
“Innocent? Humph, no one around you is innocent!”
Bali Yuyu huffed, feeling playful, “Since you care so much about them, I’ll leave you for last while I wring the life of every last one of them in front of you. It’s your fault they will die, their sin for working with you!”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Do you have to? Involving bystanders in another’s disputes is never the way. Here I am, right in front of you, so if you’re going to kill someone, kill me! At least I will be the first to die before them…”
“Humph, not everything goes your way. The more you want to sacrifice yourself and ease your crimes, the more I want to save you for last and let them die in front of you, because of you. I’ll have regret eat you up inside before I move on to you. This is what you get for pissing me off!”
Bali Yuyu growled as she glared at Zhuo Fan who kept coming closer, “Weren’t you from that place? Weren’t you tough? Why, can’t you even save a few lives?”
“It’s not that I can’t, but that I never considered it…”
Zhuo Fan had reached Bali Yuyu at this point, just a meter between them, as his vague smile grew wider, “Miss, did you hurt your face, perchance? That would just not do for a pretty thing like you, miss. You should be using your Yuan Qi to patch it up and not waste time on something as vapid as reaping lives.”
Zhuo Fan reached out, going after Bali Yuyu’s swollen and red cheek.
Bali Yuyu jumped back and shouted, “What do you think you’re doing?”
“Healing you, miss, since it’s too much for you to do it yourself.” Zhuo Fan grinned, his raised hand glowing green and oozing vitality.
“Such a scratch means nothing with miss’ cultivation, healed in a blink. But to keep it like this, despite how it looks, I’ll have to do it myself so that your leader won’t have anything to reproach.”
Bali Yuyu growled and her brows shook, “Keep your hand to yourself! This is Patriarch’s punishment. Only he gets to decide when this is healed, and certainly not you!”
“Am I to assume then that it’s also your Patriarch who egged you to attack us? Is Patriarch letting you kill now?” Zhuo Fan smiled.
Bali Yuyu gave a cold smirk, “Damn right, there’s nothing holding me back. Your luck has run out!”
“Did Patriarch have you kill me as well?”
Zhuo Fan shouted.
Bali Yuyu jerked, needing a moment before sporting a sinister smile, “Right again, kid. Just wait till I kill you!”
“Is that so?”
Zhuo Fan beamed, shaking his head having gotten his answer. Bali Yuyu covered it well, but the split second in demeanor change was enough to betray the truth.
Baili Yutian did tell her to go on a murder spree, but to an extent.
[The old coot wants to test me, or better yet, test Devil Mountain’s disciples and Overlord Nine Serenities.]
[Ha-ha-ha, thanks, Devil Mountain, you’re finally living up to your fake name by reeling in the strongest in mortal domain. That means that even the Nine Sword Kings will need his explicit approval before touching anyone from Devil Mountain…]
[I must say, the name sure has its uses…]
Grinning with confidence, Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone with insight. Bali Yuyu, the great and revered Sword King, was overcome by a very bad feeling, one laced with fear.
Zhuo Fan was too much of an unknown that robbed her of all confidence…
Bali Yuyu grew enraged, unable to accept his ridiculing smug smile, “What are you smiling at? You don’t believe I can kill?”
“Oh, I believe alright. You most certainly have it in you to kill me. That’s why I’m here, before you, at your tender mercy.”
Zhuo Fan gave a dismissive wave and resumed walking towards Bali Yuyu. They were so close now, they could practically touch. Even their breath felt warm on the other, despite the cold weather.
Bali Yuyu flushed red and jumped back again, putting some distance between them and panicking, “J-just what are you doing?”
“Coming before miss, ready to be captured and presenting my neck.” Zhuo Fan raised a taunting eyebrow, “Why, does miss hate it that I completely understand my powerless situation and accept it?”
Bali Yuyu’s lip shook as she saw Zhuo Fan’s bright and insufferable smile with a red face and blank mind.
She was a mighty Sword King from the central area’s Sword Star Empire. Anyone and everyone, almost, would have to scrape and bow at her feet, worship her even. Then how come someone would be so daring and infringing on her personal space with playful smiles?
Bali Yuyu lost her mind, pointing at Zhuo Fan, “Stay right there! Don’t come any closer! Humph, don’t think I’m going to let you off so easily. I’ll be sure to torture you and let you have a taste of real horrors as I kill your men, one every day. Who knows when your turn will come as you wallow in despair.”
Bali Yuyu no longer looked at Zhuo Fan and vanished.
Only the footprint in snow bore testament that a graceful and vicious woman had been here…
Zhuo Fan shook his head and walked back to the others, “People, look at the carriages. We’re moving on!”
None moved, too dumbstruck to react. Their eyes were filled with nothing but respect and awe.
“What’s wrong with you? Get to work already!” Zhuo Fan frowned and shouted at them.
They gave a silly giggle yet in no rush to do their jobs, “Sir, were you just flirting with Frigid Rain Sword King? You’re so awesome, to even do it with a bloodthirsty witch…”
Bam!
Zhuo Fan smacked them on the spot, “Cut the senseless chatter! I was only testing her limits!”
“And did you find them?”
“Of course!”
Zhuo Fan grinned, “That broad got free rein from Baili Yutian to start killing, but the only one who she can’t touch is me. I gave her ample reasons and occasions to end me then and there, but she never went for it. While she was leaning on excuses, those weren’t her style. With how petty and quick to anger she was back in the store, there’s no way she’d gathered the patience necessary to toy with me for so long. So I’ve nothing to worry about her going after my life and can keep going.”
The others sighed, relieved.
Zhuo Fan blinked at them, “That’s only valid for me alone. You all aren’t included. Why then are you so at ease? Be careful not to get her to waste you.”
“You’re wrong there, sir.”
One guard chuckled in joy, “Since she won’t touch you then we’ll be safe as long as we stay close to you. That’s why from now on we’ll eat together, sleep together and ride together. I hope sir won’t mind it, he-he-he…”
Zhuo Fan frowned then nodded, “Sharp guy. That’s a good plan with a high success rate. Though if we want to get rid of her for good, we need a large ruckus and force the man behind her to come negotiate. It’s not good to always be reactive to the other’s actions and under constant watch.”
“The man behind her?”
The men exclaimed, “Sir means to…”
Zhuo Fan gave a resolute nod with a cold smile, “Sooner or later we’ll meet the best in the lands. So we’ll use this chance to get a feel of him, ha-ha-ha…”

chapters.title: Chapter 986 - 986, Sun Sea Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 986, Sun Sea Sect
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Yuyu lost.”
The four carriages were soon repaired, their beasts tied to them and rushed through the snowstorm.
However, unbeknownst to them, Invincible Sword Baili Yutian stood upon a peak a kilometer away, witnessing the entire event with a long sigh.
The four Sword Kings stood behind him with dark looks.
Baili Yutian glanced at them and spoke, “Even with the strength of a Sword King, she still lost. Do you know why?”
The four hung their heads, having no reply, their faces showing only defference and respect as they waited for the Patriarch to enlighten them.
“Crown Prince, what do you kids think?”
Baili Yutian turned to the ten youths at the back.
After some hesitation, crown prince immediately bowed, “Patriarch, Frigid Rain Sword King has stepped forward and has free reign but in my eyes, she appears to be the one to lose. Just like how Devil Mountain appears to have lost yet didn’t. Frigid Rain Sword King was too reliant on raw power and disregarded the mind games one can use, giving the opponent the upper hand and pushing her back by grasping her weakness. The problem with Sword Kings is that they are all brawn and no brains, like they’re at the top of the world. They aren’t aware that on the battlefield, nothing is black and white, in constant change and complex.”
“You’re wrong, Crown Prince!”
Baili Yulei interjected before Baili Yutian could reply, “This world is all about survival of the fittest. The strong don’t need convoluted plans. Eagles fell their prey in one swoop, tigers catch their quarry in one pounce. There’s no room for hesitation. Only mice scurry around unseen for food and sparrows look for seeds with caution. The art of war and all the tactics used in the army are all based on winning against a stronger opponent. While retreat is always advisable against someone beyond your abilities.
“But all these schemes and tactics show is that the user is weak, uncertain of their own strength. Yuyu is a Sword King, with hardly any in this world to match her. She has no need to think hard if someone would be out to get her through some master plan. Only people like you, Crown Prince, having not reached your full potential, would resort to such sophistry. How can you understand the pride of a Sword King, of wielding the power to be on top? The reason why she ended up losing to a kid’s slick words is because, uhm…”
Baili Yulei spoke with disdain and scorn as he chided the young future emperor. It took a long time in his speech to realize he had gone out of line, sweat soaking his brow, and fists clenched.
Crown Prince just stared at him with a smile as he dug himself into a hole.
Baili Yutian spoke, “What? You don’t mean to say that I’ve been holding you back, do you? Is that why Yuyu couldn’t attack? So that means her loss is my fault?”
“Patriarch, that’s not what I mean!”
Baili Yulei rushed into a bow, shivering and taking blame. He was only a Sword King and had no right to hold the Patriarch accountable for anything.
His conceited speech was him running his mouth, letting his overblown pride get the best of him and shift the blame on his boss. He had basically dug his own grave.
Crown Prince smiled in ridicule, “Thunder Sword King, it seems to me you’re not quite at the top, ha-ha-ha….”
Baili Yulei’s face twisted in rage as he glared, but that was it, waiting for Patriarch’s decision.
“Quiet, all of you!”
Baili Yutian gave an annoying wave, watching Zhuo Fan leave, “None of your answers touched on the essence. Be it smarts or brawns, it all comes down to valor, to having the attitude of the strong. Without a brave heart, no amount of cunning and strength matter. Anyone else would’ve been scared witless by Yuyu’s sword, even affecting those that appeared calm. While the kid fought back and took initiative. Nothing would’ve come of it if he didn’t have courage.
“Also, I didn’t let Yuyu attack and she really didn’t. Humph, damn spineless coward. She won’t get far in understanding the Dao, not after she couldn’t even muster the nerve to challenge my authority. Having always been looming over her, she has no way forward, stopped at this level…”
They all shook, with Baili Yulei anxiously saying, “Patriarch, you’re saying disobeying you would’ve been better?”
“Yes, it would, but she would die then.” Baili Yutian’s eyes glinted with coldness. He vanished from his spot, leaving the others confused.
[What’s that supposed to mean, Patriarch? Even if you let us walk our own path, we can’t escape your control or we’ll be dead?]
Crown Prince paused and gave a wry smile, “Invincible Sword is the only one in the world…”
He flew away after Patriarch, the others even more confused and conflicted…
Zhuo Fan’s caravan had been marching for three days, looking out the window now and then, picking up Bali Yuyu’s cold smile watching them from afar and giving all but him and his daughter the chills.
“Sir, the witch keeps following us like a leech. I know you’re certain she won’t touch you but who knows if it’ll stay like this?”
One guard asked Zhuo Fan for advice, “How is sir going to solve this crisis?”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone and smiled, “Nothing to it, since it’s almost time…”
“For what?”
“Our first stop of our trading caravan, Sun Sea Sect!” He picked his teacup from the radiator and sipped.
The all looked clueless.
[Is sir planning on hiding there? Nah, can’t be.]
Sun Sea Sect was one of northern lands’ five sects, but far beneath even one Sword King.
[They can never protect us. They were so quick to close their doors when news of Nine Sword Kings came around. There’s no way they’ll shield a merchant!]
They couldn’t make any sense of his words, but Zhuo Fan was in no rush to explain, giving an ineffable smile as he looked out the window.
In four hours, before a snow valley, the four carriages halted. Zhuo Fan and the dozen guards stepped out and bowed to the guard outside the valley, “The Qian clan caravan is here. I ask senior of Sun Sea Sect to let us pass. Here is my clan’s token!”
The guard took out his own token, identical to Zhuo Fan’s, and threw it behind.
It vanished into thin air, coming back only fifteen minutes later.
The space then warped and the valley had an icy road form in the middle.
The guard gave Zhuo Fan a look and nodded. Everyone got in the four carriages and entered the strange domain.
There was another ripple in the air and the icy road vanished behind them, returning to be a plain snow valley.
Whoosh~
Bali Yuyu flashed not far away, glaring haughtily, “Humph, want to hide in Sun Sea Sect, is it? Then I’ll be waiting right here. The first to come out will be the first to taste my blade. Let’s see you keep your calm then, brat!”
Zhuo Fan’s carriage just entered and fifty men in the Soul Harmony Stage surrounded them with wary looks.
The leader was a shifty middle-aged man in white with split mustache to make him look cunning.
“No need to worry, everyone, just the usual trade caravan. Please present your tokens to asses your identities as Qian clansmen.”
“Oh, Executive Cao, who else would we be? We’ve been doing this route for many times now, he-he-he…”
One guard laughed while giving his token to a disciple.
Executive Cao nodded, “Oh, Guard Wu, I sure recognize you, having been here many times, but it has been tense lately and it doesn’t hurt to be cautious.”
He gave a look to the men around him and started checking the tokens’ signatures with the user to see if no rat slipped in.
Everything checked out, following Zhuo Fan’s turn as he bowed and presented a jade slip, “Executive Cao, here is the the caravan roster.”
“You’re…”
“I am Qian Fan, Qian clan’s steward.” Zhuo Fan gave a weird smirk…

chapters.title: Chapter 987 - 987, Lamb to the Slaughter
chapters.content:
Chapter 987, Lamb to the Slaughter
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Frowning, the executive said, “Qian Fan? How come I never heard of the Qian clan having someone like you?”
“Ha-h-ha, I’ve always been working out in the field and only recently came back at Clan Head’s orders due to these tense times. Executive Cao, it’s natural to not know me.”
Zhuo Fan spoke without any inflection in his voice, while also hinting that the executive hands were tied no matter how suspicious he might be.
“This is my daughter. I didn’t feel at peace leaving her alone at home so I’ve taken her along. I hope Executive doesn’t mind if she isn’t on the list.”
Zhuo Fan called Qiao’er over as a shield, which helped curb Cao’s suspicions. What kind of a spy would bring their daughter to work? She’d only get in the way.
A shame he had no clue this cute and adorable girl was anything but harmless.
Executive Cao nodded, “I believe you, but business is business and we must follow protocol in ascertaining every member, ha-ha-ha…”
Executive Cao gestured and one of his men brought Zhuo Fan’s token over and whispered in his ear before sending him off.
Cao turned from his man to Zhuo Fan, saying, “Since coming out of the field, does sir know about the five sects tightening their guard ever since central area’s operations in our homeland? The names and auras of main figures from major clans have all been included for inspection. In a few minutes we will have confirmation, sir. I only ask for a moment of your time…”
Executive Cao scanned Zhuo Fan for the slightest twitch, to find anything that might give him away. Zhuo Fan was aware of his attempt from the start and Serene Shores Trading made sure everything would check out when they set up his token.
