He had no doubt in his mind there would be no problems whatsoever.
“I knew this when I returned. Thank you for your care, Executive Cao.” Zhuo Fan smiled.
Executive Cao blinked and gave a dry smile. With all his attempts at getting a rise out of the other coming out false, he was now pretty convinced Zhuo Fan was who he claimed.
Soon, his man was back with an answer and the badge, “Executive, the Qian clan list does indeed contain such a steward among them, while the aura checks out as well.”
“Oh, then why wasn’t I aware of this?” Executive Cao asked.
The man continued, “Northern lands has many rare items that the many clans sell to all kinds of regions for a bigger profit by sending their people there. With how dark times are upon us, they all recalled their men and each clan has updated their roster. Over the last few days many clans sent their new list every couple of days, with the Qian clan sending their updated one just five days ago.”
“I see, it was just a misunderstanding, ha-ha-ha…”
Executive Cao confidently nodded at Zhuo Fan’s identity and smiled, “Steward Qian, please don’t mind it. It’s just a precaution.”
Zhuo Fan had no reason to panic, not when everything was foolproof, “It’s all for the safety of northern lands, ha-ha-ha. Oh, can now Executive Cao inspect the goods? We still have many drops to make.”
“Sure, sure, not a problem.”
Executive Cao took a jade slip, placing his trace on it, as a receipt, then took Zhuo Fan’s token and then marked it into the same jade slip to mark Qian Fan as the receiver.
This worked to solidify Zhuo Fan’s new persona, with not just Qian clan vouching for him, but Sun Sea Sect as well.
Taking this proof with him would make the rest of the journey smooth sailing, with each stop adding their own vouching for his identity and sealing his status in the northern lands while making it all the much easier to go to the North Sea’s shore.
Northern lands went through such a hassle every single time to root out any central area spy that might get any ideas. Sure, a bit of luck might get one past a checkpoint, but what about the many more that followed?
Once you got past all these thorough inspections, without any slip up, there would hardly be any more resistance for any, even those from the Sword Star Empire.
All, however, were oblivious of the Sword Star Empire never able to take this approach, while the ‘dead’ Serene Shores Trading could easily do it with their connections throughout the lands.
This was a faction that was under Zhuo Fan’s control. It was bound to become the fifth faction joining this conflict among the lands, without anyone noticing as it lurked and grew from the shadows…
With the stamp of approval, Zhuo Fan had the men unload Sun Sea Sect’s goods then left with the carriages.
“Hold up!” A sudden loud voice intervened with their departure.
“Steward Qian, t-the goods are off.”
Executive Cao had an odd look, “Why are there half of the usual items?”
Zhuo Fan put on a pained face and sighed as he pulled the executive over, “Executive Cao, I ask that you help a brother out and keep this matter hidden. I’ll be sure to give the rest on the return trip.”
“Just what happened?” Executive Cao got curious.
Zhuo Fan sighed longer this time, “Truth be told, the carriage with your great sect’s other half of goods got struck down by a central area’s agent!”
“You met with a central area agent?”
Executive Cao cried out, but Zhuo Fan was fast in covering his mouth with a panicked look, “Executive Cao, brother Cao, keep your voice down! Clan Head might get wind that I failed in guarding the goods and he’ll skin me!”
“What am I supposed to do? Of the promised goods, only half arrived…”
“Not so loud!”
Making a shushing gesture, Zhuo Fan spoke fast, “I told you, I’ll give the rest when I make a round trip. Your sect doesn’t need them right now anyway, and you can store them away. Then I’ll come back with the rest, and with a little bit extra to repay the favor.”
Executive Cao frowned hard and shook his head, “No, this is too important. The amount is too great and I’ll take the fall once it’s checked. There’s no reason for me to take such an unwarranted risk!”
“Fine, I’ll do you one better, but you have to cover for me!”
Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth and hesitated before looking pained, “That agent is right behind us, meant to target our wares. He first ruined half your goods and having gotten a taste of destruction, he still followed us, biding his time for the perfect chance to destroy some more. So I plan on capturing him. You know as well as I do what a grand achievement a captured enemy spy will look on your record, especially in these dark times. So I’ll share the merit with you. We’ll both capture him and I’ll not only be pardoned for my loss of goods but even rewarded for such a feat. The clan would hail me a hero…”
Executive Cao pinched his mustache, calculating, “Will it be that easy to get him?”
“When he ruined our carriage, not even my dozen men could circle him with how fast he moved!” Zhuo Fan shook his head with a frown.
Executive Cao eased a long breath and cursed, “Since you can’t catch him then don’t waste more men over him. Alright, just go, but keep in mind to come back with the rest of the supplies, or I’ll take it up with the Qian clan!”
“Hey, you’re not capturing him?”
“Of course not, our job is to guard the sect, not catch spies for you!”
Executive Cao waved impatiently, “Get going already. The other sect is waiting for your goods. We can’t be lax one moment in tense times like these. Be careful on the road! Open up the barrier and let them leave!”
“Yes, sir!”
Zhuo Fan gave him a long look and shook his head. He went inside a carriage with his men while whining, “I say, irking someone is easier than walking. This rotten sect sure is laid back to not even want such a huge achievement…”
Humph!
Executive Cao, huffed and put on a straight face like he wasn’t there. Once Zhuo Fan’s caravan was off, Executive Cao gestured and called for fifty Soul Harmony experts, “You guys will be following the caravan. Capture anyone that is sneaking behind it, and make sure to bring them back alive! Got that?”
“Yes, Executive Cao!” The men nodded, despite their confusion.
Zhuo Fan grinned to himself in the carriage, “Lighten up. The lambs are out of their pen and straight into the wolf’s mouth. Once the witch gets her fill, she’ll ignore us. Quiet days await us, boys, ha-ha-ha…”
The others gave Zhuo Fan a curious look as he stretched in his seat, looking mighty comfortable…

chapters.title: Chapter 988 - 988, Sheepies vs. Wolf
chapters.content:
Chapter 988, Sheepies vs. Wolf
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Passing the first stop, Zhuo Fan’s caravan continued through the snowstorm, which covered their heavy tracks as fast as they made them. Though even in this weather, one woman with cruel eyes had no trouble following the carriages even in their mad dash through the white desolation.
“Rotten punk, let me send you off with a bang, and a gift, easing you of the burden of one more carriage, a couple of spiritual beasts and the extra mouths to feed, humph…” Bali Yuyu pointed her fingers, readying her sword art with vile intentions.
Whoosh!
Dozens of men in black landed right in front of her before she could finish the attack. They all regarded her with mockery as they released their mighty auras, showing their obvious intent to take her down.
Startled, Bali Yuyu frowned, “And who are you people? You have some nerve blocking my view!”
“Ha-ha-ha, a tiny central area spy thinks that she can just go around northern lands blowing things up like she wishes? Now she’s even asking why? You must be blind as a bat, ha-ha-ha…”
A tall and muscled man stepped forward, sticking out his shredded chest and being cocky on the peak Soul Harmony Stage cultivation he showcased as he jeered along his buddies, “Brothers, talk I don’t think I’ve ever seen a dumber spy than her. She just goes wherever, ignoring her surroundings, to make a scene and actually asks who we are. Now isn’t that rich! So what do you guys think? Should we educate her better, or…”
A sword energy was released the next second, running him through. He jerked once and stopped, frozen with bug eyes in disbelief.
A stronger wind blew over, making his vision split in two, collapsing on the ground in two pieces. His insides were a charred mess, with all the blood evaporated and his soul pulverized.
“Senior brother!”
Sss~
The other gasped in fright and shock. They turned to Bali Yuyu with fear, suddenly feeling sorry for themselves.
[Who the hell is this wench? Couldn’t a dozen Soul Harmony experts scare her off? Why the discrepancy?]
[And there were fifty men here, yet she just offed the strongest of our brothers. Executive Cao even wants her alive. God damn frickin’ piece of garbage, you expect us to capture that? It’s a miracle if we survive…]
Everyone looked pained at the icy Bali Yuyu, their knees turned to jelly, their minds constantly cursing and only wanting to flee for their lives.
[This was supposed to be an easy job of spy capturing, so why did it turn into us going to the slaughter? What normal spy out there even has such ridiculous power?]
Tucking her hair behind her ear, Bali Yuyu, regarded her prey with deadly charm, “I gave you the chance to state your names, but you went on with your incessant prattling, boring me of ever wanting to find out. So I think turning you into nameless graves would be a better fit for you, ha-ha-ha…”
Whoosh~
Baili Yuyu flicked her hand and a loud boom sounded, submerging the fifty strong Soul Harmony experts in the snowstorm and then removing them from this earth, leaving behind not even a drop of blood as proof of their existence.
Boom~
The string of explosions caught up to Zhuo Fan’s carriage, shaking it. The guards looked out the window to see where the shakes came from with gawking faces, “Sir, just what’s happening out there to make such shockwaves?”
“The wolf flipped and had a bonfire for her lambs. Just ignore it and let’s go.” Leaning on his chair, Zhuo Fan closed his eyes with a weird grin.
The others shared a glance, shrugged, and the caravan rumbled forward…
While they put this event out of their minds, members of the Sun Sea Sect couldn’t. More like they had no choice, not with how critical it was.
Executive Cao stood before the sect entrance, smug and awfully overconfident in his success.
[Share merit with a merchant? As if!]
The moment he heard Zhuo Fan talk about this, his mind was made up on taking the credit of capturing a central area spy all to himself.
He never once stopped to think that maybe this was all within Zhuo Fan’s expectations, which of course it was. Zhuo Fan had no intent of giving him further info, he only passed on the troubles to this eager scapegoat so perfectly, that if the whole operation went south, there was no one to take the blame other than himself.
And by the sound and looks of it, the suffering had only just begun…
“Executive Cao…”
A frantic and desperate shout came from a disciple he had just sent, scrambling over to the ever confident and prideful executive.
Executive Cao chuckled and waved dismissively, “Did you get him? Ha-ha-ha, it must be one hell of a fish to get you so excited, ha-ha-ha. Where is he?”
“T-that is not, uhm, is…” The guy was such a mess, shaking and stuttering in fear.
Executive Cao was annoyed, “Well which one is it? Spit it out!”
“Executive Cao, the fish is beyond big, but…”
“But what?”
“Too big for us to handle.” With a bitter look, the guy found it hard to speak, “Senior brother and the others, they had the woman surrounded, but when it came time to capture her, she turned out to be so savage as to wipe everyone out. I had been watching from afar, in hiding, before I ran back here. Executive Cao, what do we do now?”
Executive Cao panicked, “Did you say they’re all dead? I don’t believe it! These are Soul Harmony experts we’re talking about here, with the strongest at the peak even. How can they all just die like that? Wasn’t she surrounded by a dozen Soul Harmony merchants then… she ran off?”
“Executive, might sir have the wrong information? The witch is too strong to be chased away. In fact, we couldn’t run away even if we wanted to.” The man sobbed.
Executive Cao was dumbstruck, but soon it dawned on him, “I don’t have any way of explaining the loss of fifty Soul Harmony experts. I won’t be getting this great merit either. I can only go find Elder Li. Yes, he…”
Executive Cao mumbled while frantically dashing for the sect, his mind unhinged…
A wizen old man sat on a couch in a lavish room, Executive Cao at his side.
“Executive Cao, your greed has made you lose fifty experts. And now that you can’t handle the responsibility, you came to me?”
The old man mocked him.
Wiping his brow, Executive Cao gave a strained laughter as he bowed, “Elder Li is so sharp. I was only thinking of grabbing a spy and didn’t want to bother elder. Once the spy was captured, of course it was a merit to Elder Li, thanks to your leadership. I could never take all the credit, ha-ha-ha…”
“Quite the nice way of putting it, but things have become messy. Are you expecting me to clean up after you?”
Elder Li mocked with a sharp glint in his eyes, seeing the bobbing head of Executive Cao, “Only a Genesis Stage expert can kill fifty Soul Harmony experts so fast. Guard, summon fifty Genesis Stage experts at once and seize this spy, alive! Since there’s a spy, we should at least find out what she knows.”
“Yes, sir!”
Hurried steps sounded outside.
Elder Li turned to Executive Cao, “Little Cao, you owe me big for this. You know as well as I do how reckless endangerment as well as losing fifty Soul Harmony experts is punished. I am now sending others to catch her and make up for your losses, saying they died in the line of duty. With such a heavy loss and nothing to show for it, you’ll suffer worse than in hell!”
“Thank you so much, Elder Li, for your help. I will never forget your kindness.” Executive Cao bowed and simpered. His mind, however, painted a different image, one of rage.
[I not only lost a great chance at merit, but even ended up in debt. God damn it!]
[Qian Fan, you call that information? Nothing about it was accurate!]
Executive Cao was filled with rancor, but squeezed a bright smile instead, a painfully hard one at that. Elder Li stood next to him, like a parent protecting his child.
Alas, any kind of superiority he felt here was about to be squashed, pulverized and splattered by flubbing, sending sheepies once again to catch the savage wolf…
Thump~
Heavy footsteps rushed over and barged into the room, the Genesis Stage expert having no time for common courtesy as he watched the two men with fear and horror.
“Elder Li, this is bad, real bad! The fifty Genesis experts you sent are all dead…”
“What?!”
Elder Li gasped in shock, his jaw hitting the floor…

chapters.title: Chapter 989 - 989, Playing with Fire
chapters.content:
Chapter 989, Playing with Fire
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Keeping that look for a few moments longer, Elder Li was having trouble reacting. Only later did he turned a stiff head to Executive Cao with an eye twitch, “Little Cao, are you sure it’s a… spy?”
“Uhm, I guess…”
“Guess your pea-brain!”
Pa!
Elder Li smacked him real hard as he cursed, “In the name of all that’s holy, are you trying to get me killed as well? What spy out there has such power, erasing fifty Genesis experts off this heaven’s green earth? She has to be a peak Genesis Stage at the minimum! And you! You came to me without even knowing her strength? Now you got me suffering the same thing you have by losing so many men!”
Elder Li growled and Executive Cao only made himself small and winced under the verbal assault, proclaiming his innocence in his mind.
[It wasn’t me who found the spy, but Qian Fan who told me. That a dozen Soul Harmony Stage cultivators scared her off.]
But now things went from bad to worse, first the loss of fifty Soul Harmony experts and now another loss of fifty experts, but a stage above that.
With such a hole in their mismanagement record, the two had no way of covering or straightening it up. Best find help.
Executive Cao lowered his head in silence. He hardly had any power as an executive to get this disaster handled and could only sit there like a statue and listen to the other.
Elder Li was so tense and vexed under this problem, he was stomping all over the room. Sometimes glaring at the trembling Executive Cao, though this was no time to vent. He needed something to make those losses look necessary, not just that they were sent out to die.
After long moments of furious thinking, Elder Li took a deep breath and walked outside, “Follow me!”
Executive Cao rushed along like a meek puppy.
In a room filled with the intoxicating smell of all kinds of pills, a white-haired old man with a valiant face and shocked eyes, shouted, “Is what you’re saying true? To lose so many men then the person must be incredible!”
“Yes, Venerable Ma, he has to be a crucial member and not just a simple spy.”
Elder Li bowed next to him with a bright look, like a good devil on his shoulder, “He must have a special mission coming into northern lands. We have indeed suffered many losses, but all we have to do is capture him and it will become our greatest achievement in the northern lands. It won’t stop at just our Sect Leader, or the other four sects, but we’ll even earn the respect of the other lands in our alliance. Venerable Ma, you are one of the ten High Venerables in our sect, but by pulling such a feat will send you into the top three!”
Venerable Ma was silent, putting pressure on Executive Cao and feeling the need to speak up to drag him into this, “Yes, yes, Elder Li is right. This is a chance of a lifetime and letting it slip by would only leave other venerables to take advantage of it. Please make a quick decision, Venerable Ma.”
“While it does sound nice, I fear she’s already at peak in strength and can’t be handled…” Venerable Ma frowned, pensive, a cautious and weary man.
Elder Li egged on, “Fortune favors the bold, Venerable Ma. She’s just a peak Genesis expert. It would be very simple for you to have her tied and brought back, especially with ten other peak venerables. Ten against one at the same cultivation is bound to result in a win. the only risk that could ever pose this operation is if she detonated.”
“Your words do make sense.”
Mulling it over some more, Venerable Ma’s interest grew, but not enough, “But if she isn’t just a peak expert and instead one of central area’s Nine Sword Kings…”
Elder Li dismissed his worries with a wave, “Venerable Ma, you’re overthinking things. Why so low-key if she were a real Sword King? Why sneak around behind a caravan? I believe she doesn’t want us to discover her since she can’t take on our sect. That’s unlike how an arrogant and obnoxious Sword King acts. Venerable Ma, there’s no need to worry so much, just get her captured!”
Venerable Ma thought it over some more and then nodded.
“Wait here, I will invite some venerables to help capture this central area spy, for our sect’s glory!”
Venerable Ma flicked his sleeve and stormed out the door. The other two bowed, “Congratulations, Venerable Ma, on your success in becoming a top three venerable!”
Venerable Ma was gone soon and the duo sighed, “Damn it, giving the credit to another again!”
“Yeah…” Executive Cao mumbled.
Elder Li’s face fell and smacked him again, “Yeah my ass! Damn useless fool, come, we need to wait at the entrance to congratulate Venerable Ma when he arrives.”
“Elder Li, congratulate…”
“That’s enough out of you. You still want a bit after all this? You can’t have your cake and eat it too. Be thankful if we even get some crumbs. At the very least, we’re the ones who supplied this intel.”
Elder Li’s brow shook, glaring hard at him and mocking, “If we can’t even do something as simple as that, we might not even get the crumbs, that old coot swallowing it whole. You might be fine with that, but not I, humph!”
Elder Li flicked his sleeve and left. Executive Cao needed time before finally exclaiming and rushing after him.
[Of course, with such a big fish, there’s bound to be some leftovers, ha-ha-ha…]
The two credit-stealing old men braved the biting winds, the icy snow pelting their skin, waiting with such bravery before the sect’s entrance, to sing the ten venerables praises upon their return, sucking up to them for even a wee bit of reward.
Though reality seldom conformed to peoples’ wishes. As luck would have it, they were up against a mountain so hard, nothing they threw at it put a dent in it…
They had been waiting for a full hour before the barrier to the sect opened and the two elders lit up, fixing their clothes for their greatest performance yet.
What welcomed them was the most familiar and elderly excited Venerable Ma, on his mission to catch the spy.
The venerable, however, didn’t look so perky at the elders though. Judging by his ruined clothes, his wretched and panicked return, it was anything but joy among the countless thoughts that ran through his head.
“Venerable Ma, you…”
Elder Li began with an expected look, “Did you get her…”
Venerable Ma dished out two heavy smacks on both of them, throwing them off their feet. He did not forget to curse either, “You have the nerve to show your faces to me? Screw you and all your kin! Truly, there’s no one setting you up to fail more than your own dumb people! You came to me to get the spy without even having a clear picture with what we’re dealing here? I ought to strangle you here and now…”
“Uh, Venerable Ms, you don’t mean to say even you fail…” Elder Li gasped in shock.
The sudden warping of the Sun Sea Sect’s barrier, and its subsequent explosion, cut off his voice.
With the vanishing of the barrier, what appeared before them was the picture of grace in the form of a delicate woman yet bearing cold eyes, her fine features in a mask of anger.
Venerable Ma fled without any hesitation, wanting nothing to do with this broad.
Whoosh!
Thousands of people landed just then, as the experts of Sun Sea Sect showed to fight off the invader, unleashing all their power unto the woman.
She hardly cared, though, her icy gaze fixed on the frightened Venerable Ma. She was out for blood.
Thump~
Clear and resounding steps echoed as a middle-aged man in a fancy robe walked before the crowd, glaring at the woman, “I am the Sect Leader of Sun Sea Sect, Bu Xingyun. Who are you miss? Do you not fear death?”
“Bu Xingyun of Sun Sea Sect? Humph!”
The woman mocked him, ” You’ve got quite the apt name for your situation, Unlucky. I have a bone to pick with that brat and have been following his caravan. I have no relationship whatsoever with any of you! Yet why the hell do you pester me time and time again? Buzzing around like flies is starting to piss me off, even if you don’t. So might as well finish you all off and end this incessant pestering!”
(StarReader: it’s a pun. His name sounds just like the characters for unlucky.)
Bu Xingyun frowned and jeered, “Finish off my sect? You talk a big game! Just who do you think you are, miss? Cease your boasting before you earn everyone’s ridicule!”
The men started laughing in disdain. Only Venerable Ma shuddered in his spot…

chapters.title: Chapter 990 - 990, Meeting
chapters.content:
Chapter 990, Meeting
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Who am I?”
Giving a charming smile, the woman darted her eyes to the fearful Venerable Ma and mocked, “You don’t even know who I am and yet you sent people after me? You guys’ won’t get very far in life with that attitude. Now listen up and listen good, I am Frigid Rain Sword King Bali Yuyu, personally appointed by the Patriarch of the central area’s Sword Star Empire!”
[A Sword King?]
Everyone gasped in shock, shivering and watching her with fear in their eyes.
Elder Li and Executive Cao were dumbstruck. The big fish spy from the central area they wanted to step over in their glorious career turned out to be one of the Nine Sword Kings. Who knew? At least it explained why all the men they sent died.
Nothing good ever came when dealing with the Nine Sword Kings.
Sure, they were big fishies indeed, beyond anything they could fathom, but still not enough for even their whole sect to catch.
Bu Xingyun’s face twitched and he choked. He gulped hard, his heart racing and snapped in anger, “For god’s sake, who the hell was the bastard that brought a Sword King over? Show yourself this instant!”
Venerable Ma stood up in tears and pain.
“Oh, so it’s you, old man!” Bu Xingyun growled, wishing nothing more than to end him then and there.
The Venerable was quick to get his wits about him cupping his hands, “Sect Leader, please wait. It wasn’t just me, it…”
Venerable whipped his head on Elder Li, slapping him hard and cursing, “Damn bastard, what are you doing inciting a Sword King? You had so many of our brothers killed!”
“Venerable Ma, Sect Leader, I…”
Elder Li’s lips shook, feeling victimized, then it was his turn to gave a smack, to Executive Cao this time, leaving a red print, “You good-for-nothing fool! You killed all those Genesis and Soul Harmony experts. Just why have you messed with a Sword King?”
Executive Cao choked from the tears, “Sect Leader, Venerable Ma, Elder Li, the intel was faulty. It’s not me, but the Qian clan’s, uhm…”
Executive Cao was looking for a scapegoat, too bad Zhuo Fan was long gone, leaving him all alone to take this monumental responsibility for this disaster. All he could do was pull a wronged face and explain, “A Qian steward told me about this so I went to capture the central area’s agent. I didn’t know it’s a Sword King…”
“Screw you! You actually went and believed some flimsy rumor without vetting it first? You’re just asking to be killed!”
Bu Xingyun cursed louder, then he bowed to Bali Yuyu at once, “Frigid Rain Snow King, this is a total misunderstanding born from these mutts’ idiotic belief in hearsay. You’re free to punish them as you like. Northern lands and central have yet to wage war. We’re only getting ready for it and not starting it. Would you please go someplace else and keep the peace…”
Bali Yuyu snickered, filled with disdain, “Bu Xingyun, you have some nerve. While both sides are about to wage war, you’re going for peace. How come?”
“Ha-ha-ha, isn’t the issue of the two sides because of Ouyang Lingtian of Sea Bright Sect? We have nothing against with your great empire…”
“Spineless coward.”
Bali Yuyu’s eyes shone and spat, “You’re one of northern lands’ five sects and yet when the enemy is barging in your home, you only think of hiding in a corner. Where’s your dignity, your honor in fighting off the invader? You’re the exact opposite of that Radiant Stage brat, who at least had the nerve to argue with me. While you, oh big sect, have no bone in your back. Humph, you’re nothing but garbage. I think I ought to do northern lands a favor by doing some spring cleaning. Ouyang Lingtian might even thank me for it, ha-ha-ha…”
Bu Xingyun’s fave went cold, “I take it then that miss doesn’t want to leave?”
“Take a guess, genius, humph…”
“Then my Sun Sea Sect can no longer back down!”
Bu Xingyun barked, “Bali Yuyu, I know your Nine Sword Kings are great, but don’t think our sect is any weaker. We have hundreds of Genesis experts, with a hundred at peak stage! Not even you alone can face such numbers without consequences. You’re just a peak Genesis expert anyway!”
Bali Yuyu rose an eyebrow, mocking, “Would you like to test that theory?”
Bali Yuyu’s face hardened and the constant snowstorm halted then and there. The skies slip next with the crack of a silver lightning. Sword energy flared and sent sword waves cutting the air, ripping everything in their path,.
The snow that dominated the skies so far has turned into a storm of silver, with silver sword waves in every direction one looked.
Like expected, whatever the waves touched, it ceased to exist, making Bali Yuyu the overlord of this world, with none escaping from her grasp.
Everyone shuddered from fear and chill.
Sun Sea Sect’s tens upon tens of thousand strong were nothing but bugs for this woman to squash, at her whim and mercy.
Bali Yuyu roared and unleashed all his power at her, with all the other Genesis experts doing the same, ready to die.
The heavens were filled with silver waves while the ground was soaked in Yuan Qi. The collision resulted into a hellscape, shaking everything around them.
Zhuo Fan’s carriage was rushing through the snow still, watching at the bizarre event in the sky. He could even see how the air warped, shocking his men.
Zhuo Fan hardly watched out the window, but this time even he was stunned at such power.
“A Genesis Stage expert can wield the power of the world. In a battle between cultivators at this stage it’s all about fighting for control of said power. Bali Yuyu alone, in this case, has the skies on her side, pushing down on all of Sun Sea Sect. They don’t have room to breathe, much less use the world’s power to fight back. The Nine Sword Kings are as strong as they say.”
The other men nodded solemnly.
[The Nine Sword Kings can destroy sects by themselves!]
Hooo!
Their amazement was short lived as their spiritual beast pulling the carriage roared and stopped.
It was so sudden, it almost threw its passengers off their feet.
Once at full stop, one guard looked out the window then said to Zhuo Fan, “Sir, there…”
“Here it comes, ha-ha-ha…”
Grinning, Zhuo Fan knew this was a long time coming, unphased by it as he watched the ten or so people outside standing before their carriage. The one in the lead was a three-meter-tall old man, while the rest keeping a respectful stance behind.
One guard frowned, “Who are they? What do they want?”
“Who we’ve been waiting for to show up.”
Holding Qiao’er’s hand, Zhuo Fan took a deep breath and got out the carriage. He regarded the tough old man with glinting eyes,
“Invincible Sword Baili Yutian, we meet at last!”
[What?]
The guard gasped in shock.
[That’s the best in all the lands? What the hell is he doing here of all places? Why us?]
The were still incredulous about this development, with Zhuo Fan smiling while pointing at the old man’s team, “Take a good look around him.”
The others were frozen in place at the realization.
Bali Yuyu’s silver waves had been spreading for hundreds of miles from the Sun Sea Sect, yet only the space around the old man was still tranquil.
It was like the border of two worlds, cutting off the ravenous storm outside from the peace within.
“I reckon there’s only Baili Yutian on this earth that can overcome a Sword King’s power and not letting the world power be disturbed in any way.”
Looking above, Zhuo Fan smiled and pulled Qiao’er as he walked to Baili Yutian without a care.
The old man waited for him with a deep gaze.
Whoosh~
But then, among Baili Yutian’s team one shot for Zhuo Fan, bent on murder and rage…

chapters.title: Chapter 991 - 991, Invincible
chapters.content:
Chapter 991, Invincible
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Baili clan high profound ranked martial art, Space-rending Sword!”
The opponent was a 6th layer Soul Harmony Stage youth with a fierce gaze, unleashing his most prized art at full force.
All that power, put on display just to trample a measly 3rd layer Radiant Stage cultivator.
The guards cried out, “Sir!”
Baili Yutian’s team were nonplussed, watching from the sidelines on how this turned out. There was not even a twitch as the Baili clan picked on the weak, no shame whatsoever.
Anywhere else a Soul Harmony cultivator went against a Radiant Stage cultivator like this, he’d only be ridiculed even if he won.
But since such a despicable act was done today and right before their Patriarch, the answer to why was quite simple; a test.
Baili Yutian wanted to test Devil Mountain and its overlord, to see if it was worthy of fighting it himself. This measly Radiant Stage cultivator had to just survive this deadly ordeal and Baili Yutian was going to fight Devil Mountain’s overlord one on one.
With the disciple so ungodly, the master couldn’t be that far behind either.
If the outcome would be the end of Zhuo Fan out of this, then Devil Mountain’s overlord was just an overblown rumor. Or that Zhuo Fan was a fake disciple.
He only got what was coming to him for even having the gall to trick the likes of Baili Yutian.
And so, the Baili clan simply watched the attack of one of their juniors unfold.
Zhuo Fan figured it out from the start as well, smirking and walking onward with Qiao’er like he was on a stroll.
With sword and man becoming one and heavy lightning crackling in the sky, the man wielding the power of a divine sword flashed in his face and shot his fingers at Zhuo Fan’s head even as the target simply smiled.
Baili Yutian shifted, looking disappointed.
[So this is all the Devil Mountain amounts to. The disciple is but a common cultivator…]
Whoosh!
Against the crown prince’s awe-inspiring sword attack, Zhuo Fan didn’t budge, but someone else did.
“Devil Mountain’s low profound ranked martial art, Thunder Phoenix Claw!”
A sharp cry echoed in everyone’s ears and the crown prince’s sword attack was moments away from touching Zhuo Fan’s head, even giving him a slight headache from all that power, when a purple thunder claw came out of nowhere.
It grabbed his wrist and shifted aside, making all that power hit nothing but air as the attacker even rolled three times in the air before crashing into the ground in a cloud of dust.
Not only the guards, but even Baili Yutian was shocked at the sudden development.
The crown prince was eating dirt on the grown, with the wee girl Zhuo Fan was holding before, now standing on him. Her cute and tiny hand was holding the crown prince’s spine in a vice, fine flashes of purple running through it and into the prince and holding him nice and paralyzed, prevented from even releasing his soul.
Everyone was dumbstruck, along with Invincible Sword and the Sword Kings.
This little girl wasn’t quite at peak power, but even as a seven-year-old, to handle a core member the Baili clan carefully groomed with such ease was simply insane.
Anyone would think a girl her age wasn’t even weaned. But to the Baili clan, such age would need them to be at the Bone Tempering Stage at the least.
Yet that girl right there handled a Soul Harmony expert like nothing. If that wasn’t ungodly what was? Was Devil Mountain filled with such monsters?
[Then our clan has long since lost first place in the world! We’re nothing but ants to Devil Mountain’s disciples.]
Baili Yutian squinted, worried for the first time in millennia as he began to question his strength.
[Am I really invincible on this wide green earth?]
“Aah!”
The crown prince shrieked under Qiao’er’s purple lightning as it seared his bones. He held it in for as long as he could, not wanting Patriarch to see him being weak and earn his ire for shaming the clan.
But the purple lightning was just too outrageous to begin with. Coupled with the Baili clan learning the Sundering Sword’s art, mutually exclusive with the purple lightning, the pain was just that unbearable.
In mere moments, he was screaming like a banshee.
Baili clansmen frowned, thinking of helping but never moving without Patriarch’s word.
Qiao’er giggled as she tapped his head, “This is but a taste of what I can do. This is for trying to touch my father, he-he…”
Qiao’er’ claw ramped up to a third of her power and the crown prince shrieked harder.
“Qiao’er!”
Zhuo Fan glanced over, “Let him go.”
Qiao’er paused and nodded, bowing to him, “Yes, father.”
She returned to his side, leaving the unsuccessful crown prince in his attempt, still groaning on the ground after trying to get his feet under him only to stumble again.
Qiao’er covered her giggle, while Baili Yutian was looking very dark, hinting Baili Yulei to get the useless fool back before he made them look even worse.
Baili Yutian stared at Zhuo Fan now and gave a light cup of his hands, “I’ve long heard of Devil Mountain’s resounding reputation and now that I see it for myself, I can say for certain it is beyond imagination with how even a seven-year-old girl can wield such power.”
“Sword Patriarch is too kind. Baili clan’s skills have given me a newfound respect for it, wielding such a sharp sword art is unheard of in the mortal domain. It’s all thanks to the girl here that I got to keep my head. Although…”
Zhuo Fan turned to Qiao’er, “Qiao’er, you were still slow there. Do you see the mark on my forehead? We’ll resume training when we get back!”
Qiao’er pouted and bowed, “Yes, father!”
Baili Yutian’s face twitched, his heart in anger.
[The punk knows how to talk. First praising the Baili clan’s skills then chiding his daughter for lack of training.]
This was a clear disregard to all of them.
A child just got a Baili disciple thrashed in one strike yet he was calling that slow, saying more training needed? If that wasn’t disdain what was?
[Rotten punk, that’s my line! I never thought the day would come I’ll have it used against me! God damn it!]
Annoyed to no end for being served, Baili Yutian had no choice but to bottle it in.
Till now he was strongest, he mocked the most since no one could do anything about it anyway. But now that Devil Mountain, a fresh and unknown faction, came out of the woodwork, he was left not wanting to get on their bad side, not until he knew the full extent of their power.
He had been cocky and strong his whole life, but this Invincible Sword wasn’t so blind from pride as to throw reason out the window and look back in anger.
One other reason he didn’t let anger get the best of him was Zhuo Fan.
He just couldn’t see through him, even after all the testing he did, first with Bali Yuyu and now himself. He faced everything with unshakable calm.
He first wrote it off as being the attitude of the strong, but his thinking had now changed.
[Maybe he doesn’t fear the Nine Sword Kings at all, not even me!]
Since a child from Devil Mountain was that strong, what then of the father? What of the overlord?
Invincible Sword felt sweat trickle down his brow for the first time in eons, his expression hard.
It was fear from overthinking.
[From big to small, anyone from Devil Mountain wasn’t to be messed with.]
He got so used to having his way, even disregarding the good of the empire for a moment of joy.
In other words, he always got what he wanted when he wanted. The empire could crumble for all he cared. He could just make another one.
But in regard to Devil Mountain, he was feeling scared, like it was the end to his invincibility…
Baili Yutian was pensive for a long time, making the faces of the rest of them to sink. They had never seen their Patriarch hesitating.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, grinning to himself.
[I finally got to shock and awe the old man with Qiao’er. Now it’s time to have an equal, no, overbearing negotiation.]
[I can’t just have central area’s invaders show up in northern lands and ruin everything I’m after, humph…]

chapters.title: Chapter 992 - 992, Sword Patriarch’s Fury
chapters.content:
Chapter 992, Sword Patriarch’s Fury
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Devil Mountain has some harsh requirements, I see. Your daughter’s attack was excellent, but sir is still so harsh.”
Baili Yutian gave Zhuo Fan a long look, assessing him, before speaking with a smile.
Zhuo Fan gave a dismissive wave, “Sword Patriarch, you don’t have to joke. A child only cares about making it passable, regardless of flaws. Education starts from a young age if one wants to straighten her character. This is the only way to remove any laziness and make sure she overtakes her peers.”
[A little devil like that has tons of peers in Devil Mountain?]
Baili Yutian’s mouth twitched, his heart sinking. The others’ brows shook as well, their eyes widening.
[Just how huge is this sect? Do these little monsters come in bulk, or what?]
Everyone there felt a chill down their spines, even Baili Yutian and his Sword Kings. It was a downright miracle for a clan or sect to have a monster, but to come out in droves? That was a disaster! The world would come to an end!
There was only one Invincible Sword in the five lands, but in Devil Mountain, it seemed to be countless invincible figures. And the more there were of one thing, the lower the title’s value…
Invincible Sword frowned as he became more distraught the further he talked with Zhuo Fan. But his curiosity to know everything was still there, forcing himself to smile to look as casual as he could muster.
His stance, however, was no longer as dominating as usual, but amiable and chatty.
“I’m truly amazed with how many talents Devil Mountain has!”
Baili Yutian gave a firm salute, this time, as he cupped his hands, watching Zhuo Fan with a sharp glint, “How may I address sir? What matters have brought sir here, to northern lands’ outback?”
Glancing over as he returned the salute, Zhuo Fan’s tone showed no inflection, “Sword Patriarch is too kind. I’ve already stated my name the last time I bumped into your nation’s Frigid Rain Sword King. It’s merely Qian Fan. I’m sure you’ve heard of it by now. As for why I’m in northern lands, ha-ha-ha, it has nothing to do with you whatsoever. Patriarch can relax.”
“I find it hard to believe sir’s name to be real, not after becoming Qian’s steward right after coming out of Devil Mountain.”
Baili Yutian squinted, “I won’t be able to sleep well either, not knowing sir’s real reason for coming here. You might be against my people for all I know. As Devil Mountain has shown itself in western lands, I have to be on guard.”
Baili Yutian gave Zhuo Fan a firm salute, holding as much courtesy as demand, “Sir, I ask that you help in easing my worries and not lead to any friction to happen between us two.”
“Isn’t Devil Mountain’s age-long absence from the five lands’ matters proof enough?”
Zhuo Fan gave off an ineffable feeling with his casual demeanor, “Sword Patriarch need only worry about his matters. So long as you don’t disturb us, each will go their own way. Farewell!”
Zhuo Fan nodded and pulled Qiao’er back to the carriage.
Baili Yutian wasn’t finished, cupping his fist so hard he unleashed a tremendous aura upon the world, ringing the ears of the Soul Harmony guards and making their hearts race. As for the 3rd level spiritual beasts, they were so scared they collapsed on the spot and shivered like leaves.
Pausing, Zhuo Fan’s eyes grew cold as he spoke, “What’s this about, Sword Patriarch?”
“Nothing much, I just feel awful that by not knowing your great sect’s goal here it will cause a misunderstanding between our factions from which neither can recover. I just want to be clear on this, in consideration to everyone’s situation.”
Baili Yutian stared at Zhuo Fan’s back, waiting for his reaction.
He needed to know Devil Mountain’s aim, and wouldn’t have no for an answer. It was imperative to know whether they were with, against them, or just passing by. It just didn’t sit right knowing there was such a strong force out there that might just step in when their situation was dire and make them lose everything they worked for.
Invincible Sword’s grand unification plan had simmered for so long now and this time there was a high chance of success in one fell swoop. The slightest discrepancy from his goal had to be thoroughly removed.
Not to mention, he needed to figure Zhuo Fan out. The kid was incredible so the father couldn’t be far behind either, but it still paid to know the details. For the next time he would have to deal with Devil Mountain, he wouldn’t be plagued with so many unknowns.
His clasping hands were done harshly on the surface, to crush stones and the earth, but hid a softness within that didn’t even hurt a fly, a calculative and subtle intent.
For a ten-thousand-year-old monster, he had gone beyond being a martial fanatic, having gained a shrewder side over the ages.
Zhuo Fan took a deep breath and nodded, “Indeed, Sword Patriarch is undoubtedly right in this point. Devil Mountain doesn’t want anyone to disturb us in this affair either. Ha-ha-ha, Sword Patriarch, you can relax knowing that our aim isn’t the same as yours, you who want to unify the lands and take the five divine weapons. We are only after one thing, North Sea demon!”
“The North Sea demon?!”
Baili Yutian and the four Sword Kings gasped. That same demon had wiped the floor with the best in northern lands, Ouyang Lingtian, on the same level as a Sword King. What made it worse, the demon did it in one blow too. Baili Yutian believed it would be a hard battle even for him.
By having fought with Ouyang Lingtian several times already, he had an idea where to place the sea demon, thus his current judgment. The Nine Sword Kings were nothing to him, but they could hold on for five hits at least, ten for the most promising ones. The fact the sea demon beat up someone of that caliber in one strike showed just how strong it really was.
Sure, five hits or one hit might sound semantics to the average man, but this slight difference belied the outrageous gap in strength.
The five moves for the Nine Sword Kings was the utmost limit to Invincible Sword, one that he strove to improve despite the toil it entailed. Yet that sea demon could do it in one from the start. That was just insane!
This meant the battle was over before it began. Like a three-year-old meeting the demon, finished in one move. And the same applied to Profound Heaven Stage, Radiant Stage as well as the Nine Sword Kings. Maybe even Invincible Sword would be lumped in as well.
The first move was insurmountable by all appearances. Only by overcoming this trial one could finally gauge the sea demon’s strength. While Invincible Sword already felt confident he could do it.
So he had come here with the intent to have a go at the demon, to see where he was, what he was missing and where he could improve.
But now Zhuo Fan just stated the sea demon as his goal, stunning Invincible Sword, asking in haste, “Sir’s aim is the sea demon? What are you going to do?”
“Subdue him!”
Zhuo Fan had no qualms about blurting out this huge lie, since there was no harm in talking big. The fact he said it with a straight face only made it more believable by everyone there, looking at him like he grew a second head.
Invincible Sword gasped, “Subdue? But he is a monster that beat Ouyang Lingtian! Why can you do what he couldn’t?”
“Why?”
Zhuo Fan smirked, “Because we’re Devil Mountain!”
Zhuo Fan held Qiao’er as he walked to his carriage, leaving Invincible Sword dumbstruck.
[Is Devil Mountain that great? Have they reached such a level that they can deal with the savage sea demon like nothing for him to be so casual about it?]
Invincible Sword’s eyes shook, feeling against this outcome, shouting, “Wait!”
Zhuo Fan paused once more, turning his head around, and saw Invincible Sword’s anger on his face, “What is it, Sword Patriarch? Is there something else you need?”
“Everyone knows of the North Sea demon’s savagery and even I have reservations of meeting him.”
Baili Yutian’s eyes shone as his face was cold, releasing his aura to the extent the world dimmed, as purple lightning crackled now and then, “Judging how light sir is taking this endeavor, it must mean it’s just that easy for you. It is hard for me to accept this outcome. Since sir has such ability, why not letting me have a try first?”
The thunder rumbled louder now as the sky took a purple hue with purple sword energy flashing all over. Baili Yutian’s bloodthirst spiked, making the air shimmer and giving the feeling the world was ready to be torn apart.
Baili Yuyu’s ever present silver energy up till now was gone in a blink, swallowed by these devastating purple flashes Invincible Sword finally struck with unspeakable might!
He had dominated the world’s power, giving nothing for even the Nine Sword Kings to grasp.
This was the berserk power of the one called Invincible Sword, the best in the lands.
Everyone gasped, with the Sword Kings falling back to avoid the stray lightning. Their Patriarch was about to fight!
The guards, however, were scared witless, cowering in the corner of the carriage, while the dozen 3rd level spiritual beasts closed their eyes hard, not daring to even look.
Zhuo Fan and his daughter were the only ones unphased by the old man’s show of force, yet their eyes spoke of the chill inside, as if he was a dead man…

chapters.title: Chapter 993 - 993, To Each His Own
chapters.content:
Chapter 993, To Each His Own
<<Previous Chapter Index Next Chapter (Patreon)>>
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
The cold eyes of Baili Yutian bore into the calm face not far from him, unleashing the rage and power of an undefeated war god, of a being no one could oppose.
Zhuo Fan simply stood in the savage winds with a flat look and eyes so dead one might think nothing held any value to him. It cut this undefeated old man through the fury and to the bone.
[What’s this supposed to mean? Is my strength that disparaging to him? Or is it that he doesn’t believe that I could deal with him? Is that why there’s no fear?]
Baili Yutian’s firm resolve began to quiver in hesitation…
“Think it through, Sword Patriarch.”
Zhuo Fan’s dull tone sounded in his ears, “By order of master, we’ve come for the sea demon to take it back to the sect and watch the door and not get involved in the secular world’s problems, or your nation’s affairs. But Sword Patriarch is making it increasingly harder for us to do so.”
Baili Yutian’s brow shook, his heart a mess.
[You’re after the sea demon to watch over the entrance?]
Zhuo Fan boasted even bigger, “If Sword Patriarch still feels the need to go on his course, then we will be forced to wiped you and your team for the sake of our mission.”
“Wipe?”
Baili Yutian’s ego was once again pricked, sneering, “You talk a big game. Devil Mountain might be filled with experts, but my clan isn’t a pushover. Here, before you, are my clan’s strongest. How are you going to wipe them?”
Zhuo Fan took a deep breath, then sighed in disappointment, “You poor ignorant mortals, utterly blind to the vastness this world has. I had some hope for you, who stand at the top of the mortal domain, expecting you to at least glimpse into the truth, but you just proved to me how utterly clueless you are of your inferiority, and with such arrogance too.
“Devil Mountain will remove you to the last one, no exceptions, the same way it did with the five sects in western lands. It is hard by myself to get you all so I will just have to use the treasure master left me. It was meant for the North Sea demon and would be a bit of a waste using it on you, but since mortals are so ignorant they insist on damning themselves…”
Zhuo Fan held out his hand and the Thunder Ring flickered, releasing an aura of dread and horror, ready to unleash apocalypse.
Baili Yutian’s heart jumped, his brow soaked.
He knew next to nothing about Devil Mountain’s power and this unknown made it all the more terrifying to him, further amplified through Zhuo Fan’s casual act and the seven-year-old girl’s insane strength.
For the first time, this unrestrained Invincible Sword felt utter regret.
He had been too impulsive, letting anger get the best of him because of his wounded pride. The fact that this man before him had something that could deal with the sea demon, then using it on his group couldn’t be easier.
Especially since the man said that it could wipe them all out…
Baili Yutian was sweating buckets, with his Sword Kings looking grave and scared as they staggered backward.
They now had another figure to fear besides the Invincible Sword, and he unleashed his power on them…
“Invincible Sword Baili Yutian, it was nice knowing you, while it last…” Zhuo Fan regarded him with dead eyes as his ring shone in a golden curtain of light, unleashing its scorching heat.
Baili Yutian was frantic in stopping him, “Wait, hold on!”
“Why, does Sword Patriarch have any last words?”
“By peak of mortal domain, did you mean there’s something beyond the Genesis Stage?” Baili Yutian stared hard at him.
Smiling, Zhuo Fan nodded, “Of course, from mortality through spirituality, imperial, saintly and sovereignty, the five realms of rebirth, reaching the Genesis Stage starting from birth will only comprise the mortal realm or domain. By going beyond this stage can you shed the mortal coil and into the Spirit King Stage, wielding the power of the skies and having endless lifespan, casting away The Five Declines of Heaven and Man. Sickness and aging will no longer plague, only divine tribulation. And this is but the first and meager step on the path of true cultivation. And by stepping into the Sovereign Stage, you shall be immortal, undying and indestructible. Those reaching such fabled profound cultivation have been few and far in between.”
(StarReader: it refers to a concept from Buddhist philosophy, the five realms of existence in the cycle of rebirth or samsara. Each realm is associated with a particular type of existence and level of consciousness; the realm of gods(heaven), realm of humans, realm of animals, realm of hungry ghosts and the realm of hell.)
“There’s a stage that high?” Baili Yutian shuddered at the news, while the other Sword Kings were left speechless.
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Sword Patriarch, anything else you’d like to ask? No? Let’s continue.”
“Hold on!”
Baili Yutian waved his hands around once again. Having heard such a huge secret, his usually dead heart throbbed in his chest, his eyes eager, “What is Devil Mountain? Does it have people that have overcome the mortal domain?”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “That’s a secret and can’t tell you. But since you’re about to die it won’t make a difference…”
Zhuo Fan mocked.
Baili Yutian hesitated before withdrawing his aura with a shake of his head.
“I see that Sword Patriarch wishes to live long enough to find his own answer.”
Zhuo Fan nodded and put down his arm, the ring’s glow fading, “Though let me give you a piece of advice. When you’re probing for answers, tread lightly, as some things are better left alone. Just like the sea demon, needing power beyond the mortal domain to be reined in. You’re best avoiding him.”
Baili Yutian sighed and bowed, “Thank you sir for the advice. I shall. I only came here for the Heaven Sealing Sword and have no intention of offending the demon. When the day comes that I understand the sword path enough to overcome the mortal domain, I hope to pay Devil Mountain a visit. May I have the honor of seeing your Overlord?”
“Fate will decide.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Devil Mountain’s disciples roam the world to train, before returning to the mountain and inheriting master’s legacy. If Sword Patriarch comes across another disciple the next time, you may have the chance of peering into the sect!”
Baili Yutian looked downcast but nodded with cupped hands, “Devil Mountain’s disciples go into the world to learn and don’t meddle in the mortals’ affairs. Not to mention sir said to have come for the sea demon. To each his own, right?”
Baili Yulei’s heart sank as he looked at Baili Yutian, but lowered his head.
While it looked like an agreement, it was more of a request, one coming from the lands’ strongest Invincible Sword. This would have never happened ever.
Baili Yutian was a man of immense pride.
However, here and now, the Devil Mountain proved to be of such uncanny might and had people that have gone beyond the realm of mortals. It came at no surprise for Baili Yutian to take the initiative to go for such an agreement.
“Absolutely!”
Zhuo Fan grinned from ear to ear, “Devil Mountain’s disciple are always inconspicuous as they travel the mortal world and don’t meddle in anyone’s problems. With the northern lands under such tight guard, we don’t wish to draw any attention either. Devil Mountain is a hidden sect and we wish to keep it that way. So long as sir does not bother us, neither will we mind the lands’ affairs.”
Baili Yutian eased a breath, finally at ease.
“Sword Patriarch, may I leave now?”
“Uh, please, go right ahead.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, having reached his goal. Baili Yutian bowed as he gestured with respect.
Everyone else was dumbstruck. Since when was their Patriarch so respectful to anyone?
Whoosh~
A white figure suddenly flashed over, Frigid Rain Sword King Bali Yuyu.
Clueless as to what transpired, she sneered and threatened Zhuo Fan, “Rotten punk, you think that useless Sun Sea Sect could save you? Humph, in your dreams! Now I’ll make sure to send you all to oblivion!”
“Stop!”
She turned back to see who shouted at her and saw her Patriarch standing there.
Startled, Bali Yuyu immediately bowed, “Patriarch, he is that sneaky brat calling himself Devil Mountain’s disciple. He must’ve earned your ire, Patriarch, but you don’t have to lower to his level. I will handle him myself!”
Bali Yuyu pointed again, ready to strike and exact revenge.
A bam resounded just then and she was thrown into the air like a ragdoll. She was forced to cough blood, mixing with the snowflakes and turning them red…

chapters.title: Chapter 994 - 994, Sword King Joining In
chapters.content:
Chapter 994, Sword King Joining In
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
The soft figure rested harshly on the white and red feathery snow, jerking now and then as Bali Yuyu cranked her head up to see Baili Yutian’s icy and reproachful glare meeting hers.
“Patriarch, why?”
Baili Yuyu was utterly confused. Baili Yulei sighed and walked over to help her up.
Baili Yutian’s icy tone came again, “Yulei, who said you can go?”
Baili Yulei flinched and halted with another sigh. He gave one sad look to Baili Yuyu and shook his head before going back to his spot.
[Things have changed. Patriarch finds the kid untouchable now, but you just had to raise your hand.]
[That dreaded power from his ring aside, just his expounding on the realms of cultivation is enough to have Patriarch change his mind about attacking him, let alone us.]
[He truly is an untouchable deep mystery…]
It was the unanimous answer they all reached, with only Baili Yuyu, the new arrival, being in the dark still.
“Sister Yuyu, are you alright?”
Looking from her to the Patriarch, Zhuo Fan smiled and walked over with a helping hand to Baili Yuyu, “Don’t mind it. If others won’t help you, I will, ha-ha-ha…”
Pa!
Baili Yuyu slapped his hand away and glared with hatred, “Beat it!”
“Yuyu!”
Baili Yutian glared, “Is this how you thank Sir Qian’s consideration? I don’t remember ever having such a rude and brash clansman. Should I get my whip?”
Baili Yutian cupped his hands to Zhuo Fan, “Sir, she’s always like this, stubborn and rude. Please don’t mind it.”
“It’s fine. What sort of king would the Nine Sword Kings be if they don’t have some form of pride? Ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan clapped as he laughed, then returned the gesture, “Sword Patriarch, since we’ve reached an accord, it’s time for me to go.”
Zhuo Fan took Qiao’er back.
Baili Yutian’s eyes darted all over in thought, then he shouted, “Sir, I’d be most conflicted if I don’t at least make up for Yuyu’s crass behavior. Why don’t I let Yuyu accompany you, helping sir in his mission. That should make up for all her transgressions. What do you say?”
“You want me… with him? Patriarch…”
Baili Yuyu shrieked and looked from Zhuo Fan to Baili Yutian, her eyes gleaming and begging for mercy. Baili Yulei shuddered from disbelief.
[What’s Patriarch after?]
Zhuo Fan paused again just as he was about to take the first step on the carriage. He looked back at Baili Yutian with sparkles in his eyes and a beaming smile, “Sword Patriarch, I am very much thankful for that, but I’m used to going alone. It’ll be awkward having a travel partner out of nowhere. Also, it’ll be so strange to have a great and revered Sword King as a mere travel buddy.”
“Sir, please don’t refuse my good intentions.”
Baili Yutian waved nonchalantly and said gravely, “Sword King Yuyu is strong enough to give sir no trouble at all. In the case that something does happen, sir can just ignore it and leave it to her. I don’t have Sword Kings that can’t even look after themselves. As for status, ha-ha-ha, in my eyes sir is far nobler. Please don’t shun my deepest sincerity, sir.”
Zhuo Fan looked pensive, “That’s not exactly good…”
“Sir, if you refuse, you’re making me look bad.”
Baili Yutian huffed in fake anger, “We’ve reached an agreement to stay out of each of our ways, but by refusing me now is disrespecting me. I will even take it as a provocation. I can’t vow I’ll be a complete bystander when things get tough for you in your mission, sir. I’ve gotten used to being reckless and regardless of the five divine swords, I don’t shy away from being self-destructive sometimes. But if I’m rash, could sir be as well? What would your honorable master say?”
Zhuo Fan gave him a long look then shook his head, “Sword Patriarch is quite persistent with his help that am I perhaps obliged to accept? Or is it that regardless of the price you’ll pay, you’d still choose to be my enemy?”
“That’s exactly the idea.” Invincible Sword was blunt.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Fine, I agree then. Men, we’re leaving. And you, Frigid Rain Sword King, hop in. Or you’d rather follow behind?”
Ugh!
Everyone froze in place.
Baili Yuyu gave a confused look to her Patriarch.
[Why am I…]
Baili Yulei frowned, but they took the outcome much better than those guards, who looked at Frigid Rain Sword King like their executioner. They could even feel a chill brushing their fair necks.
Zhuo Fan hopped in first, with the guards rushing behind him. Baili Yutian glared at Baili Yuyu, “Don’t just stand there, follow Sir Qian! You are to listen to his every word, you hear. Or you’ll have to answer to me, is that clear?”
Baili Yuyu’s face twisted..
[How on earth did it turn from hounding him to following him?]
But orders were orders and she had to bend a knee.
After squeezing all that anger and hatred and who knew what deep inside, she bowed with cupped hands, “Yes, Patriarch, I obey!”
Baili Yuyu entered the carriage and the spiritual beasts were soon moving, taking their masters deeper into the snowstorm.
Baili Yulei walked next to Baili Yutian, “Patriarch, why would you insist for Yuyu to be by his side? What are you after?”
“Patriarch wants to see the real ability of Devil Mountain, knowing that the next objective would most likely be it!” The Crown Prince smiled from the side.
Nodding, Baili Yutian sighed, “Crown Prince is sharp to see my intentions. On my journey, I have formed a sect, gathered experts, built an empire, everything a true man of power would do, I have done it. With the five lands on the verge of being one, my only adversary would be heaven, to challenge my understanding of Dao. But with how vast it is, the difficulty is just as high.
“It never occured to me that a new objective sprung up, a hidden sect, Devil Mountain. The world has five more stages for us. The more I think about it, the more I regret taking it easy all these years. That’s why I had Yuyu go with him just so that I can assess their ability and not challenge them. I want to know the gap between us.
“Once I reach the peak once more, I’ll visit Devil Mountain and have a glorious fight with Overlord Nine Serenities. I will become a true Invincible Sword!”
Baili Yutian’s eyes shone with savagery, his knuckles white…
As the four carriages rumbled on through the heavy snowstorm, the dozen 3rd layer spiritual beasts puffed steam with every step, ice slowly forming on their bodies and hindering their movements. While the outside was frosty and dead, spring blossomed within one particular carriage.
The guards looked at each other, tense, afraid to even breathe too loud. Baili Yuyu glared at them with a cold smile of disdain.
“Send word to the Qian clan to give us another token with a believable cover for Miss Yuyu.”
Zhuo Fan glanced at them. They jerked and said, “Sir, you actually…”
“Yes, she’s coming with us. While the next sects she can just avoid, once we reach the shores of the North Sea, entering the Sea Bright Sect will be mandatory!”
Glancing at the frosty Baili Yuyu, Zhuo Fan looked at the rest, “She’ll end up in pieces barging in as she is. Even a Sword King will find plenty of others at her level with how deep within the land we go, ha-ha-ha…”
The others hesitated, “Sir, that’s not it. What I mean is if you really want to bring her along…”
“Well I don’t!”
Baili Yuyu butted in, “The only reason I’m here is because the Patriarch said so. Even if it comes to the Sea Bright Sect, I have my ways of bypassing it.”
Zhuo Fan gave her a long look and nodded, “I know you do, but you’re with me now and follow my orders. That’s a must!”
“Ha, what a joke!”
“Then there’s the door. Go tell Invincible Sword that I don’t need an insubordinate flunkey. He should first educate his people better before sending them to me.” Zhuo Fan snapped.
Everyone shuddered in fear, not because of Zhuo Fan’s anger, but dreading the witch exploding anytime soon…
[She won’t snap and kill us all, right?]
Though it was clear by Zhuo Fan’s words, that they hit Baili Yuyu’s sore spots.
Baili Yuyu put on a dark look and gnashed her teeth before growling, “Do what you want and I’ll do whatever, humph!”
Zhuo Fan smirked with confidence…

chapters.title: Chapter 995 - 995, Yielding
chapters.content:
Chapter 995, Yielding
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
An awkward silence dominated.
As the carriage rushed between the snowflakes, the mood inside was strained, to say the least. Ever since Frigid Rain Sword King joined the party, the others felt as if a viper was looming over them, shivering constantly. They were so on edge, they didn’t even twitch, or breathe too loud with their now red faces from strain.
Baili Yuyu was casual, like nothing had anything to do with her. Just that she sometimes gave a disparaging smirk to them and to Zhuo Fan, who she abhored.
[Just why the hell did Patriarch even send me along?]
“Invincible Sword resumed to hide his tracks and the men from Sun Sea Sect aren’t pursuing out of fear of the witch. All is quiet.”
Zhuo Fan sighed and spoke as he looked at the endless snow outside.
Baili Yuyu shot him a piercing glare.
[I’m right here and yet he has the nerve to call me a witch?! If it weren’t for Patriarch’s order, ugh…]
Bali Yuyu gnashed her teeth and reined in her boiling fury.
Zhuo Fan didn’t know when to stop, “We’ve met with Baili Yutian and it could be said we had a nice chat, resulting in an agreement to each mind our own business. Though the old man was quite annoying on insisting in jabbing a thorn in our side, it won’t matter much. The mission will still finish. He shouldn’t be so set against Devil Mountain so soon, we just have to live with things as is. It wouldn’t matter even if he filled us with thorns either.”
The rest were sweating buckets the further he ‘talked to himself’. They just kept hinting at him to stop with painful faces.
[Dude, that’s private talk between brothers. Why do you insist on saying it to the enemy. Are you suicidal? This is a Sword King we’re talking about here. You might find life boring, but don’t drag us down as well!]
Bam!
It came at no surprise that Bali Yuyu’s short temper quickly ran out under Zhuo Fan’s repeated disdain. She made a hard face at him and cursed, “Watch your mouth! There’s a limit to my patience!”
The others shuddered as the witch spewed hellfire.
“Ha-ha-ha, yeah, if you had any patience you wouldn’t be a Sword King.”
Zhuo Fan just kept on going, “But now you’re in my employment and you’ll have to suck it up no matter how little you have. You best not forget Patriarch’s words. He gave you a mission when he sent you to me. It would be a shame to go back empty-handed, no? I’ve seen the old coot’s style and I’m pretty sure he won’t let it go just cause you’re a Sword King, ha-ha…”
Bali Yuyu balled her fists at his mocking grin, spatting, “I don’t even know what Patriarch wants me to do, but you do?”
“Of course, and so do you.”
“I do?”
“It’s public knowledge, actually.” Zhuo Fan gave a vague smile that had her confused.
[Then why do I still not know what it is?]
Zhuo Fan beamed and turned to Qiao’er fiddling with her eagle mask, “Qiao’er, would you be so kind to share with this old crone what the geezer wants from her?”
Glaring at him, Bali Yuyu’s anger spiked, but she turned to Qiao’er with a questioning gaze.
“Have you gone senile already? We just heard him say it.”
Qiao’er rolled her eyes, annoyed someone had to disturb her fun, sticking out her lower lip, “The old guy said to listen to your every word. That’s her mission!”
“Well, ain’t it your mission, senile biddy, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan mocked as he glanced at Bali Yuyu.
The others were still very much afraid of Bali Yuyu’s savage wrath, but even they had to stifle a laughter at that.
Bali Yuyu’s face twitched, going beet red, and yanked at Zhuo Fan’s clothes and shouting in his face, “You’re toying with me…”
“Oh my, you better watch your tone. Baili Yutian had you hang on my every word, not touch me. You’re best worrying about finishing the geezer’s task and not getting punished instead.”
Patting her hand, Zhuo Fan mocked her still.
She was so furious she wanted to slap him into the afterlife. The only thing staying her hand were Patriarch’s words. So she could only push Zhuo Fan aside and grumble into a corner with red eyes and tearing up.
She was a woman of immense pride, favored since she was born, but now she felt the world was coming to an end.
[What is Patriarch thinking?]
Zhuo Fan smiled and turned to the rest, “Frigid Rain Sword King has principles so she won’t bother us. We can just ignore her as we discuss like usual. Our goal differs from the central area anyway so it won’t hurt us at all.”
The guards looked from him to the teary Bali Yuyu and nodded, feeling their admiration for Zhuo Fan soaring.
[This lord is incredible, shaking off the likes of Invincible Sword and the Nine Sword Kings with mere words.]
That worked in removing Bali Yuyu’s threat, almost, and the mood became more natural.
“Sir, having incited the Sun Sea Sect to deal with Frigid Rain Sword King will give us headaches with Sea Bright Sect. How should we proceed?” One guard spoke his doubs.
Zhuo Fan merely smiled, “Not to worry, I only stirred them back there, and not had them pushed to attack. Without any evidence, they can’t do anything to us.”
“You’re the one who made them stop me?” Bali Yuyu jerked her head around, her eyes still having traces of tears.
Zhuo Fan was quite blunt, “Yep, it was becoming a pain to have you constantly on our tail and ruining our stuff, so we let it slip to those guys about you to stall you. Once you started attacking, you’d be sure to make a huge scene too, so big not even Baili Yutian could cover so he had to come out and meet me. That’s how I was able to strike a non-aggression pact with the Patriarch. While Invincible Sword had given you free reign to kill, but you’re here in hiding after all. Once the noise gets loud enough, it wouldn’t stop at fighting one sect, but drawing all of northern lands’ strong into this.
“So I was absolutely positive that when you got back to Patriarch’s side, he would give you some heavy punishment. Giving you the right to kill did not mean you can go on a rampage. Now all eyes are looking here, a huge detriment to central area’s team. So he had enough of your rash actions, sick of you being so bad at your job, and gave you to me to get rid of you, ha-ha-ha…”
“You’re full of it! Patriarch would never think of me like that!”
Bali Yuyu shot down Zhuo Fan’s mockery on the spot. But then she said in confusion, “You just told me your plan. Aren’t you scared that I’ll tell it to Patriarch? Are you trying to trick him?”
Zhuo Fan shook his head in disdain, “That’s why I said your bad at your job. You couldn’t even figure out this simple truth. I was not tricking him, but you. Furthermore, your Patriarch noticed this from the start. He knew the moment you made a scene that you lost so he had to see me fast before the northern lands’ strong showed up and wouldn’t get another chance. So the question is, knowing his nature and going back to him by making it worse through reporting, how would he deal with you? Ha-ha-ha, I heard it was a quite the stinging whip, he-he-he…”
Bali Yuyu grimaced as she gnashed her teeth, “You’re as despicable as that conniving Baili Jingwei!”
Zhuo Fan merely stared at her with bright eyes.
He knew exactly why Baili Yutian got this Sword King to watch him, to see the limits of Devil Mountain. But with such a strong asset around, it would be a damn shame not to use it.
His mind was now filled of countless ideas how things might evolve or devolve…
Over the next three days, the carriages had rode without any issues, only making a stop on the morning of the fourth day, when a guard perked up at the road ahead, “Sir, that’s Galefrost Town. We have a shop here we can use to contact Qian clan and give Frigid Rain Sword King a cover.”
“Then we’ll make a short stop there!” Zhuo Fan decided.
Whoosh~
A whistling wind suddenly passed as a very familiar sent wafted from a carriage pulled by the same type of 3rd level spiritual beasts as theirs got ahead of them.
Zhuo Fan looked ahead at the carriage’s back and his eyes shone.
[That carriage looks familiar…]

chapters.title: Chapter 996 - 996, Meeting Immortal Healer Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 996, Meeting Immortal Healer Again
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
The guard noticed Zhuo Fan’s blank look and looked at the carriage going into the snowstorm, “Sir, these carriages are common. Is there something wrong?”
“Nothing, just very familiar.”
Zhuo Fan was in a dilemma, “I just can’t place where I’ve seen it.”
Baili Yuyu used this chance to mock him, “You rotten man, did you have too many old flames to remember them all?”
“Old flames?”
“Did you ever see a man driving such a fragrant carriage then? Humph, Sir Qian, you sure know how to spread your love.” Baili Yuyu patronized.
The other men sniffed the air and picked up the scent. The notion hit them as well, but kept it to themselves with lowered heads. Though they still smiled.
[A woman?]
Zhuo Fan thought hard for a bit then exclaimed, “Oh, it’s them!”
“Who, a lover on the side?”
“My auntie?”
(StarReader: it can also mean father’s concubine.)
Baili Yuyu capitalized on this chance to mock him. Qiao’er’s eyes lit up as well as she played along. While Bali Yuyu hated Zhuo Fan’s guts, she ended up finding a friend in the small child, the two growing close these days.
Men never were able to unravel a woman’s mind. The two girls became fast friends in no time, with Bali Yuyu leading Qiao’er’s astray, pulling pranks together against Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan ignored all that and said, “When young Sanzi got hurt, the lady inside saved him by sheer coincidence and I’ve yet to thank her. I have to go say hello and figure out a way to repay the favor and not be left owing anyone anything.”
“You owe them a favor so why the long face? Why on earth are you scared you may never return it instead?” Getting the picture, Baili Yuyu was baffled how this cunning and shrewd man would look at favors with such gravity, restless all the time unless he returned them. This was a first for her.
Qiao’er waved her hand with a smile, “Sister Yu, that’s just how dad is, always clear on favors and hatreds. My brother had the fortune to be rescued and my dad used the chance to swindle them out of a treasure and must now be feeling guilty…”
“They saved your son and you robbed them?”
Bali Yuyu’s face twitched, changing the way she looked at him, filled with disdain, “I knew you were bad and this proves it; repaying kindness with malice.”
Zhuo Fan sighed with a shake of his head, “I just thought that twenty million sacred stones in exchange for a bit of North Sea Gel would be a sky-high price, returning the favor. But not only did I not return what I owed, but ended up finding out that I took something worth fifty million sacred stones instead. Curses, how was I supposed to know that thing is so great? It looks as if I strong-armed them, feeling me with guilt…”
Frigid Rain Sword King cocked her head with a wide smile and a roll of her eyes, “Here I was thinking you’re a conniving man, but now I know you’re just a dumb fool. Who in their right mind would ever weigh the North Sea Gel in sacred stones?”
“How was I supposed to know?”
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes, calling the driver, “Hurry up and catch up to that carriage! Don’t surprise them and make things worse either!”
The man nodded and sped up, Bali Yuyu cocking an eyebrow at him with a smirk, “You sure go the extra mile when it comes to your saviors, devious man, even worried you might startle them. I just can’t tell if you’re nice or pure evil. Devil Mountain does have an evil vibe, but does it raise demons or saints?”
Picking up on her angle to squeeze info about Devil Mountain from him, Zhuo Fan didn’t fall for it, returning a mysterious smile.
Bali Yuyu’s face fell and cursed.
Qiao’er grabbed her hand before she could, giggling, “Sister Yu, don’t make that long face, you look so much better with a smile.”
“Yeah, young miss Qiao’er is right. Frigid Rain Sword King’s smile is like a warm spring rain, ha-ha-ha…” One guard teased.
Thanks to Zhuo Fan’s hard work and sharp tongue in putting Bali Yuyu’s nasty temper in its place, everyone pretty much lost their fear of her.
Flushing red, Bali Yuyu glared at him, “Try saying that one more time and see where that gets you!”
The guy flinched and shook his head around, but the more Bali Yuyu looked around at the others, the more she found their eyes odd and her face went redder.
But then she noticed Qiao’er’s bright smile that eased the tension and made her smile as well.
She was one of the Nine Sword Kings, Frigid Rain Sword King. No one had ever said that she had a smile like warm rain…
“The ever-present frost and ice in the north begins to thaw under the warm sun’s rays. Spring has come.”
Zhuo Fan gave his two cents as he looked from Bali Yuyu to the icy world outside with a sigh.
He felt that the changes in the world were going to happen within the heart as well, the heart shifting softly along with the rest of the environment. This ineffable feeling left him dazed, finding it natural and harmonious…
The carriage rumbled through the snow and followed the other one in front. They soon came upon a town looking like a pile of snow from the distance, with a ten-meter-tall stone plaque standing in front, covered in snow yet still able to convey its words, Galefrost Town.
All the carriages stopped and the driver said, “Sir, the carriage in front has stopped in Galefrost Town as well. We’ll be spotted if we follow it in. What should we do?”
“You guys get Frigid Rain Sword King her token and I will find the carriage myself. We’ll meet outside town.” Zhuo Fan spoke and reached out to Bali Yuyu, “Take out your jade slip with your aura signature so they can do their job.”
Bali Yuyu pouted, “There’s no need for that…”
“Is that what Miss Yuyu will say to Sword Patriarch?”
“Fine, here!” Bali Yuyu huffed and threw out a jade slip.
While still difficult, she at least lost her murderous glares from the start.
These few days of chatting had helped in smoothing things over.
Zhuo Fan gave the token to a guard then he took Qiao’er out, “Miss Yuyu, will you go with us or them? We’ll be meeting back outside town anyway.”
“I’m going with Qiao’er, humph!”
Bali Yuyu stuck out her nose as she jumped off the carriage, taking Qiao’er and going ahead, leaving the rest shaking their heads.
