The rest of the carriages stopped as well and Zhuo Fan went to catch up to the girls. It was hard to see Bali Yuyu’s expressions clearly in the dim lit carriage, but now, in full daylight and snowy fields, her red swelling cheek was quite conspicuous.
Zhuo Fan rushed over, “Miss Yuyu, it’s been a week since we first saw each other so how come your face isn’t healed yet?
“It will stay like this until Patriarch says otherwise.” Bali Yuyu was stubborn.
Sighing, Zhuo Fan said, “But you’re with me now. What will people think seeing you like that?”
“Does it give the wrong impression?”
“If only. It’ll only make things worse. Now that I’m going to give thanks, your Patriarch will think I did this to you. How do you think it’ll reflect on me? You don’t care about face, but I do!”
Bali Yuyu giggled, “Fine, I’ll just let your saviors see me, see just what kind of man you are. It should at least make them think twice about saving such an evil brute, he-he-he…”
“You still say I’m evil? Heal it already, or just wait in the carriage!” Zhuo Fan’s face fell as he demanded.
Sticking out her tongue, Bali Yuyu was being childish for once, “Not happening! I’ll be sure to wipe the floor with your name in front of your saviors so you won’t get to repay the favor. What are you gonna do about it? Ha-ha-ha, you kept pushing me every time you got the chance on our way here now it’s my turn, ha-ha-ha…”
Hum~
Zhuo Fan’s hand shone green and looked at her coldly, “Bali Yuyu, I’ll just do your face for you then. It’s been ages since I last used Returning Dragon’s Roar and you’ll make a fine subject!”
Zhuo Fan’s palm went for Bali Yuyu, straight for her swollen cheek, bubbling with vitality.
“Don’t even try!”
With a sinister face, Bali Yuyu giggled and dodged. No matter how monstrous Zhuo Fan was, he could do nothing against a Sword King.
Zhuo Fan and Bali Yuyu ran around Qiao’er for thirty moves, with Zhuo Fan never hitting her once. Qiao’er was having a blast watching them and laughing.
Bali Yuyu held Qiao’er and laughed as well, feeling free for the first time in a long time. She teased and played the victim, “Would no one be willing to save me from this deviant man?”
“Curses, me, a deviant? You have the nerve to say that? Who in this world would ever have the guts to be fresh with you?” Panting, Zhuo Fan glared, “Stop this instant! I’m only going to touch it once!”
“And you call it not being fresh?”
An icy voice echoed…

chapters.title: Chapter 997 - 997, Misunderstanding
chapters.content:
Chapter 997, Misunderstanding
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Just as the three were deep in their own drama, the sudden shout had them pause and looked over at an elegant figure watching them with anger and coldness.
Zhuo Fan was stunned by her incredible beauty, almost to Chu Qingcheng’s level.
[There’s actually someone on this earth as pretty as my wife.]
Though his reaction only pissed her off more, lashing at him, “Had enough, Sir Gu?”
“How do you know me…”
Zhuo Fan started in confusion. On his trip to central area, he had borrowed this name from young Sanzi, but how come it reached northern lands…
Another lovely lady rushed over and lit up at Zhuo Fan’s appearance, “Oh, if it isn’t Gu Yifan, how’s your son? My young miss couldn’t see you then, but she’s still very concerned about the child. She had been hitting the medical books ever since we returned in hope of providing care…”
“Zhui’er!”
The first girl shouted and sent a despising look to Zhuo Fan, “With Sir Gu’s smooth skills, getting fresh with women in broad daylight, it must mean that your son should be skipping about, yes? How else could sir have the peace of mind to enjoy such activities?”
Ugh!
Zhuo Fan froze, looking for one girl to another and ending up sighing.
He wanted to leave a nice impression to their lord and savior, then pay up what he owed, but now all was ruined due to a dumb misunderstanding. And that damn Bali Yuyu was grinning like a cat, only making it worse.
Instead of looking good to them, he turned into a degenerate.
Either way, he was still going to try and Zhuo fan bowed, “Miss must be the lady that saved me and my son back then. You have my gratitude. How may I address the lady? Last time I was in such a rush that I forgot my manners.”
The girl held a cold face, not even looking at him. Zhui’er despised him with a glare, “Sir is quite the hypocrite. Across the whole word, there is not a single man who would not bow, enamored with her beauty, and wanting to hear my young miss’ name. Sir didn’t ask last time since you didn’t see miss’ appearance, which makes this situation obvious. Don’t you think your excuse is pretty lame?”
Baili Yuyu made sure to interject with a giggle at his expense, “Yep, lame.”
Zhuo Fan snapped a glare on her then sighed, so he leveled with the two girls with cupped hands, “Miss is misunderstanding. I have no other intention but to return this treasure I have no clue of when I took it from my son’s saviors. Would there be anything else that I might do for the ladies to repay the favor?”
Zhuo Fan took out a gourd and handed it over.
Zhui’er snatched it and gave it a check, “Young miss, not a drop is missing.”
“Return it.”
The young miss’ icy tone came, “You bought it with sacred stones and we have no right to take it.”
“No no no, those sacred stones are to return the favor, young miss.” Zhuo Fan refused.
The young miss said, “Sir should let me finish at least. It was a transaction and I do not do any returns. Also, I never touch anything filthy.”
The girl flicked her finger and the gourd flew in Zhuo Fan’s hand.
“Miss, I think you got this all wrong.”
Zhuo Fan took the gourd and looked at her to explain, “What Miss had seen wasn’t the truth. I am not that kind of man, it was she…”
Zhuo Fan pointed at Bali Yuyu, but she was not about to let this once in a blue moon chance to make his life miserable.
So she put on her most aggrieved voice, “Miss, I am but a frail and poor woman, yet this savage suddenly started hitting on me. Just look at what he did to my face!”
Bali Yuyu pointed at her red and swollen cheek, while slipping a taunting eyebrow in between to Zhuo Fan only.
Zhuo Fan’s face fell.
But no matter how much he seethed, he couldn’t let it show. With the whole case clear-cut to Zhui’er, she cussed, “We were wrong in saving you. Forcing yourself on a woman is an act worse than an animal’s!”
“Please, girl, can’t you see I have a daughter as well? What man in their right mind would do something like that in front of their child?” Zhuo Fan grew angrier as he shouted and pointed at Qiao’er.
Zhui’er’s brow shook then raged, “It’s one thing to be vile and another to corrupt an innocent mind. You’re nothing but a disgusting brute!”
Zhuo Fan’s lip shook and gnashed his teeth, unable to come up with a proper explanation.
‘There’s no reasoning with a woman’ held some truth after all. Regardless of the ironclad proof you held, they would still not believe you, giving you no chance of defending yourself.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, pointing at Qiao’er, “Can’t you just ask my daughter as to what happened?”
“Gods, you even want to involve a sweet child into your filthy act? You call yourself a man? What could such a young child even understand? And you’re now trying to get her to lie for you just to look good?”
Zhui’er’s imagination ran wild, in the wrong direction, twisting every word Zhuo Fan spoke. He gave a slight nod and sighed, “Fine then, miss, you’re officially my strongest adversary. You win. Think what you want, I give up.”
“Since you admit, then I can’t ignore this.” The first lady shouted.
Zhuo Fan shook his head.
[These broads want to force a confession out of me.]
“So now you want to kill me since I admit it?”
“Yes, the life I gave and the evil I sent out, will all be taken back personally!” The girl’s eyes flashed with murder as she struck at Zhuo Fan.
Hu~
A biting wind whistled as the palm came, freezing the area around Zhuo Fan. Yet the sudden ice contained within it strange flames, turning it into a blistering furnace.
Bali Yuyu cried out, “Southern lands’ high profound ranked martial art of the Murong clan, Glacial Blaze Palm! You’re Immortal Healer Murong Xue?”
Murong Xue ignored her and her hand flicked.
Whoosh~
A cold wind had Zhuo Fan trapped in ice, with the flames within it roaming over his body.
Whoosh~
Murong Xue ignored Zhuo Fan’s fate and turned to Baili Yuyu with suspicion, “You’re no common lady to figure out my clan’s greatest skill. You’re not the victim here, are you?”
“Ha-ha-ha, you know it’s a lie yet you still killed him? If you’d have looked deeper you might have picked up on the clues and not have killed the wrong person.”
With a sinister grin, Baili Yuyu sighed and patted Qiao’er’s head, “Everyone says the Murong clan is righteous beyond fault, saving lives left and right, but then you start killing innocents, leaving this poor child an orphan to wander the cruel world all alone. But you can just come with me now, hi-hi-hi.”
Murong Xue gave her a cold smile, “My clan always strikes with purpose. It doesn’t matter even if you’re at fault today, but he had unleashed a disaster in the central area, killing countless innocents. I have now rid the world of this evil, upholding the Murong clan’s honor!”
“Central area?”
Baili Yuyu squinted and then exclaimed, “You mean Serene Shores Trading’s matter was his doing? He really did a number on all those imperial officials. I had totally underestimated him.”
Looking from her to Qiao’er, Murong Xue spoke coldly, “I am a responsible person and will deal with the consequences myself. I think you’re not very nice either, so the innocent child needs someone to guide her. Since I killed her father, I will take her with me and raise her. I’d hate to trouble you.”
“You think it’s that easy? We’ve gotten very close these days and won’t accept strangers.” Bali Yuyu gave a sneer.
Murong Xue’s aura flared, “I take it that Miss wants to settle this with violence?”
“Stop dawdling and attack if you want. You’re not your brother anyhow. You’re nothing to me!”
Bali Yuyu’s smile turned sinister.
While the two were having a fit over who got custody of Zhuo Fan’s daughter, Qiao’er looked surprisingly calm about this. Sometimes looking over at Zhuo Fan in icy hell and noticing a trace of the black thunderflame swirling around…

chapters.title: Chapter 998 - 998, Holy Righteousness
chapters.content:
Chapter 998, Holy Righteousness
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Boom!
With a sharp crack and a deafening explosion, all the ice encasing Zhuo Fan turned to pieces before being eroded by the black thunderflame into nothing, including the blue flame within the ice.
Zhuo Fan walked on with his left eye shining black, with not a hair out of place from that ordeal.
Turning to the two girls, Zhuo Fan’s face was stoic as he cupped his hands, “Ladies shouldn’t fight, for I shall be the one to raise my own daughter. I can do without anyone else’s help.”
“You actually survived my palm? How?” Murong Xue gasped in shock.
Baili Yuyu stared at Zhuo Fan, filled with curiosity, “You sure are something else, not just of insidious mind, but of great strength as well. What you just experienced was the ultimate skill of the Murong clan, needing two great world treasures to train, the North Sea’s Perennial Ice Crystal and southern lands’ Geocentric Flame, the coldest of the flames. Combining them results in a mix of fire and water, water and fire, engendering one another in any situation. Under such an attack, the chill seeps into your flesh and freezes your meridians while the fire burns you alive. Anyone else would’ve been sent to oblivion. Yet you lived through that? Now you have my respect.”
“Since when was I just anyone?”
Zhuo Fan glared then turned to Murong Xue with a frown and cupped hands, Miss Murong, I never knew you were the young miss of the Murong clan in the southern lands. I believe that with your brother by your side, there’s nothing you’d need help with. Nonetheless, I owe you a favor that I shall repay one day. Now, however, I shall say farewell.”
Zhuo Fan gave another bow and glanced at Qiao’er and Baili Yuyu, “We’re leaving.”
He was the first to start walking after his short speech, like he wanted to avoid Murong Xue, not wanting to stay a second more if he could help it.
“I don’t think so!”
Murong Xue shouted, unleashing another palm on his back. In her hand was a scorching coldness so acute, it quickly reached Zhuo Fan’s back.
Zhuo Fan turned around and his Qilin arm glowed scarlet, meeting the palm. He forced Murong Xue five steps back from the clash, while he staggered for four steps.
Baili Yuyu raised an eyebrow, the only indication of her shock.
First time, Zhuo Fan used some super skill to get out of his confinement, while this attack was met with brute force, and repelled.
Her amazement only grew, finding the two of them on equal grounds.
In her eyes, no 3rd layer Radiant Stage cultivator should be able to handle Murong Xue’s 5th layer Soul Harmony Stage power.
[What’s this punk using to hide his cultivation?]
Baili Yuyu squinted, content with watching from the sidelines and analyzing Zhuo Fan.
Qiao’er would never move a muscle without Zhuo Fan’s say so, striking the image of a most sweet child, especially around strangers.
Of course, that excluded critical moments, but it was obvious Zhuo Fan was in no dire need of rescuing…
“Young miss!”
Zhui’er grew tense as she witnessed her young miss’ moves having no effect. She rushed to her side in worry.
Murong Xue waved her off, her icy glare set on Zhuo Fan, stopping now and then on his Qilin arm.
The ice was spreading.
Catching her gesture, Zhuo Fan raised his right hand with a faint smile, “Is miss still planning to hurt me with that palm? Ha-ha-ha, I’m afraid miss is wrong here. This arm of mine fears neither cold nor heat. Miss’ frozen flames have no effect on me.”
Zhuo Fan’s right hand jerked and ice broke off, leaving an unmarred skin behind, without not so much as a scratch.
Murong Xue’s eyes shook, her face grave.
“Young miss’ palm isn’t the Glacial Blaze Palm, nor was it any martial art. But young miss had trained with the North Sea ice crystal and had long since grasped fire and ice’s natures, imbuing her every attack with them. Even a stronger adversary would feel his meridians burning and freezing, so how come…”
Zhui’er was overwhelmed as well as she muttered to herself.
Baili Yuyu grinned in mockery, “It seems to me that our young miss Murong has found her match. It would’ve been so much better if he was stronger, making this debacle bearable, but since they’re of equal strength, her amazing skill also got countered as well. Gosh, it must’ve been absolute torture to train in fire and ice so they become one with you, but much good did that do, it’s utterly useless, ha-ha-ha…”
“What did young miss ever do to you? Why do you ridicule her?” Zhui’er couldn’t stand her young miss being mocked.
Murong Xue couldn’t care less, only looking into Zhuo Fan’s eyes with a sharp glint.
Zhuo Fan sighed, feeling how his savior was turning out to see him as a bitter enemy. He cupped his hands, “Miss Murong, I’m sure you know by now how devious this shrew is. Who in their right mind would hit on her? It’s a miracle if she doesn’t start toying with others. Why must you then insist on treating me like a criminal?”
“Hey, who’re you calling a shrew?” Baili Yuyu snapped at Zhuo Fan with an angry glare.
Zhuo Fan only looked at Murong Xue, waiting for her reaction. Judging by those sharp eyes, she was not going to forget this anytime soon, still obsessed with getting rid of Zhuo Fan today.
“Hitting on women is a sin but not a capital one. I am not attacking you because of this, I ain’t so petty!”
“Then why…”
“Thousands upon thousands of poor souls faded in the central area, all because of you. I won’t let this injustice stand!” Murong Xue’s eyes glinted with killing intent.
Zhuo Fan was puzzled, “Central area? But isn’t Miss from southern lands, at odds with the central area? If you’d still go for revenge, you shouldn’t do it in the central area’s stead. Miss’ reasoning would’ve been relatable if I had done such an atrocity in the other three lands, since we’re allies and all. But against the central area, ha-ha-ha, it’s both our enemy!”
“The enemy should meet his end, and while the targets were officials in the central area, why did you have to make a patsy out of Serene Shores Trading? You had them take the fall while you ran away. Thousands of lost souls cry for justice. Such evil can’t be left to stand!”
“Oh, I get it. You think they…”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Miss must be so bored, to hunt me down over some nobodies. But did you ask yourself if I was the one who harmed them? It was their own greed that became their undoing. Let me put it another way. They had been relying on the central area’s nobles to start out and should’ve seen it coming. I only just happened to be passing by when it happened.”
Murong Xue huffed and nodded, “You think I didn’t know that? And I’m not doing this for them either!”
“Then why?”
“For the world. I can’t let such evil roam the world for a second longer!”
Taking a deep breath, Murong Xue’s gaze was resolute, “Serene Shores Trading had only money in their sights and would one day bleed over it, cast out by the five lands, no matter how grand it looked from the outside. I was clear on that, but between thriving and decline, there is a process. Ants carry on their lives and so do people, regardless. Serene Shores Trading’s fate was sad, yes, but it shouldn’t have come so soon, nor involve so many countless other lives. This is all on you!
“Demons plague the world and it’s our duty, followers of righteousness, to purge you and uphold these values, regardless of everything. Yesterday you had the greatest company in the central area meet with destruction, causing unrest in the central area. Today you show up in northern lands, in cahoots with people no less devious than you. Any who join the devil will be swallowed by the devil in the end. No one can escape, there are no bystanders. Letting you go today might even make me your next victim, or my family. No, you must be removed here and now!”
Zhuo Fan let out a long and tired sigh, nodding, “I see, these are Miss’ beliefs, even looking quite ahead. Yes, with me still breathing, countless lives will fall. Some might see the harm I do to be in their favor, but nothing is to say the same harm won’t ever befall on them just as well. It is rare to see someone like Miss having such a strong heart and see the truth. What’s rarer is people of miss’ foresight. So long as people have the devil in their hearts, I still have grounds to live. Such a shame the two of us walk different paths…
“Farewell.”
Zhuo Fan bowed with a solemn look of recognition, putting an end to the gratitude he had for her.
He stopped trying to return the favor for he had met holy righteousness, against his demonic ways. Or better yet, she was a warrior who carried such beliefs in her heart, not straying and completely set against demons…

chapters.title: Chapter 999 - 999, Ardent Sun Sword God
chapters.content:
Chapter 999, Ardent Sun Sword God
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Murong Xue watched Zhuo Fan give a heavy bow with full respect and was touched. She could feel his sincerity and sighed, “You are the most upstanding demon among all that I’ve met. Like I said before, in the carriage, as long as you can turn a new leaf and do good…”
“Impossible.”
Zhuo Fan shot her down on the spot, “Miss has her own righteous belief and I have my demonic path. We each go our own way, with nothing in common. Miss, you’re better off not trying to impose your creed on myself.”
Murong Xue shook and grew angry, snapping at him, “Why do you insist on becoming a demon everyone hates? How much evil will you do?”
“Does miss think that the demonic path is evil?”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Miss, you don’t understand us. And since you have no idea of the path I tread, refrain from giving your shallow comments. We all have our beliefs, but it’s best not to let them govern us. True righteousness only exists as a goal, while miss’ cultivation has taken you quite close but nowhere near it. As the saying goes, evil never dies so long as a human heart holds it.”
Murong Xue looked long at him and balled her fists, “I know nothing of sir’s demonic path, but want to know why you’re willing to be so far gone within it, to cause such harm. Since sir insists on his demonic ways, I have no choice but to purge you!”
Murong Xue made a sign and extended her hands.
Thousands upon thousands of silver snowflakes whooshed through the air in a violent storm, gathering into sharp icicles and coming down on Zhuo Fan hard.
Not just Zhuo Fan would suffer from it, but everything in hundreds of miles would be flattened.
The townsfolk scrambled out of the town, turning it empty, except for the few people fighting.
Heavenly Rain!
Sky Dragon Mountain Coil!
Zhuo Fan squinted in shock, but then he grinned. A half a kilometer long prismatic dragon appeared into the world, winding around Zhuo Fan and shielding him from everything.
Baili Yuyu gasped, “The punk is insane! What’s he doing using his soul against a Soul Harmony expert? Those icicles would skewer his soul and destroy him!”
All knew this was the dumbest choice, but they refused to believe someone like Zhuo Fan would make such a fatal mistake. There had to be a trick to it.
So everyone watched as a hail of thousands of icicles stabbed at the dragon soul, leaving big holes in it.
The frigid cold seeped into it and froze it stiff, turning it into an ice sculpture packed with holes. It rattled under the heavy winds, inching towards collapse, moments away from crumbling to pieces on the cold hard ground.
“Qiao’er, since your dad got nailed, wanna come with me?”
Baili Yuyu patted Qiao’er’s head, pointing at Murong Xue with a teasing smile, “Be sure to remember that broad, since she killed your dad. Once I teach you all I know, you can go and kill her and get revenge, he-he-he…”
Zhui’er’s brow shook, glaring at her, while Murong Xue sighed, “You won’t be taking that child anywhere, miss. I said that she’ll be under my care!”
“Humph, you’re just trying to stamp her out!”
“My clan would never stoop so low. I’ll be sure to raise her well and school her to be sensible. It will be entirely her choice to seek revenge or not.”
Baili Yuyu gave her a cold look, “Anyway, she’s not going with her dad’s murderer!”
“Do you take me for a three-year-old, that you’re going to take care of her?”
“What of it? It’s better than letting her go your vile ways.”
“I’m not talking to you anymore. You’re just going to annoy me more!”
The two returned to fighting over Qiao’er’s custody, but the child had enough of their incessant nagging and stuck out her lip, “Why do you yap when my dad’s still here? I may agree, but dad won’t.”
The two looked incredulously at Qiao’er, then at the frozen and ventilated dragon soul.
[You kidding me? Who can survive their soul ending up like that?]
As if to deny the reality in front of them, a laughter echoed, “My daughter knows me best. Miss Murong, I said you don’t know the demonic path. Your attack can’t even scratch me.”
“Demonic Dragon King, dragon soul variant!”
The ice dragon sculpture bled black mist as it started swirling all around it, before being sucked back in.
The black mist faded and so did the huge dragon, leaving only Zhuo Fan behind and his ineffable smile, untouched of course.
“That was young miss’ strongest attack! How is it possible when it struck his soul even…” Zhui’er cried out in shock.
Bali Yuyu reacted with no little amazement at the stunt he pulled.
He had upped her entire understanding of the world, surviving despite having his soul injured beyond repair.
[What kinda cheat was that?]
Zhuo Fan clapped and gestured for Qiao’er to come over. She skipped to him with a smile, leaving Murong Xue filled with doubts.
Zhuo Fan took the child’s hand and offered Murong Xue one last smile, “Miss Murong, I just wanted to return the favor for saving us, but since you insist on being so against my type, I would have to refrain from staying too close to you either, lest my demonic energy would rub off on you and ruin your illustrious name. Thus I chose to take miss’ attack, and let us be square. From now on, miss walks in the light of day, while myself on the narrow flimsy bridge, never to meet. This is the end of my attachment, goodbye.”
Zhuo Fan left with Qiao’er.
“Now hold on. What’s that supposed to mean? You put your soul and life at risk by taking my attack then you see it as if you’re doing me a favor?”
Murong Xue grew anxious, not accepting this outcome at all. She darted for Zhuo Fan, but not to attack, only to grab him and make him talk sense.
“I have always been true in my actions, never asking anything in return regardless of the lives I save. When purging demons, I don’t need your permission either. How is that related to your actions? How does that qualify as becoming even? Halt and speak clearly!”
“Yuyu, stop her.”
Zhuo Fan spoke and Bali Yuyu smirked with a roll of her eyes.
[Why should I?]
Zhuo Fan called once more knowing she wasn’t going to play ball, “The old man, remember?”
“You just keep holding him over my head!”
Bali Yuyu’s face twitched and huffed in annoyance from being toyed with, “You only know to boss me around. I’ll get you for this!”
While she nagged and whined, she did his bidding, flashing before Murong Xue and stopping her.
Murong Xue glared at her and struck with an icy palm, “Move!”
“Humph, lass, you’re quite ignorant thinking you can strike me!”
Bali Yuyu smirked and unleashed her huge aura.
Murong Xue was flung back and bled from the mouth, but was too shocked to care about that little detail, “Genesis Stage expert!”
“He-he, prissy girl, now you understand who you’re messing with?”
Bali Yuyu looked obnoxiously smug with her nose in the air, “You’re eons too early to fight me, humph…”
“Yuyu, cut the chatter and let’s go!” Zhuo Fan spoke without turning.
Bali Yuyu grumbled, her good mood deflated, though she still followed after Zhuo Fan, “What are you so cocky about? You’re only alive because Patriarch wants it, humph…”
Bali Yuyu kept ranting behind Zhuo Fan and gnashing her teeth.
But then, a scorching wind engulfed the town, melting all the snow in a blink across the entire area.
Murong Xue lit up in joy, “Brother!”
“Southern lands’ strongest, Ardent Sun Sword God Murong Lie?” Zhuo Fan’s brow shook and Bali Yuyu paused as well as her face grew grave for the first time today…

chapters.title: Chapter 1000 - 1000, Clash
chapters.content:
Chapter 1000, Clash
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Whoosh~
The first thing that caught the eye was the bright red warrior robe he wore, fluttering in the wind. As one looked higher, they began to notice that this middle-aged man was built for battle, his eyes sharp and having a stubble instead of a beard.
His features only contorted into a savage look as he noticed Murong Xue’s wounded state, “Xue’er, what happened?”
“Clan Head, they did this to young miss!”
Zhui’er sprung up now that backup was here and bowed while pointing at Zhuo Fan’s group with reproach, “Clan Head, you have to make them pay for what they did to young miss. Young miss even saved that punk and his son once yet he only knows how to repay kindness with cruelty, pitting that witch into harming young miss. Clan Head, you must do right by young miss!”
Zhuo Fan shook his head with a wry smile.
He just knew Zhui’er was nothing but trouble. She had front row seats to the truth of the matter, but was sly enough to do a selective summary on the facts she wanted. She even labeled him a repulsive ingrate all to get the Murong Clan Head to fight him in anger.
[This broad sure knows how to incite hatred. Such a waste of a good demonic talent…]
“Brother…” Murong Xue started, wanting to explain everything, but he gestured for her to stop.
Glancing at her impatient look, Murong Lie turned to Zhuo Fan, “I am Murong Lie, from the Murong clan in southern lands. I was taking a short rest from my journey to the North Sea’s shore after being invited, but just a few days ago, word reached me that something happened in the Sun Sea Sect so I came to investigate. May I ask who all of you are and whether or not you have heard of Sun Sea Sect’s predicament?”
Baili Yuyu clenched her fists, her eyes sharp with bloodthirst. Murong Lie gave her a smirk then his finger began to shake.
“Southern lands’ strongest, Ardent Sun Sword God Murong Clan Head, we finally meet.”
Zhuo Fan looked at Murong Lie over his shoulder, “We’re just passing by and aren’t aware what might have happened to Sun Sea Sect. We’re unable to help Murong Clan Head and ask that you see for yourself. As for today, in this town, it was all just a big misunderstanding with your sister, but it’s cleared now. You are free to ask her the details and I believe you will come to understand everything. As we’re in a bit of a hurry, we’ll be leaving. Goodbye.”
Zhuo Fan walked on with Qiao’er, with Bali Yuyu stepping livelier behind them.
Murong Lie raised his voice again, “Wait, what has gotten sir so hasty? I have been around southern lands for many years and not many are those who can’t speak reason, while the Murong name always values righteousness above all else. As there’s an issue between my sister and sir, I would play the middle-man in analyzing the situation. I’ll be sure to give my sister a proper punishment if whatever she’s done was wrong. But if it were just a misunderstanding, then we can move on and sir and I can drink to that as friends. Wouldn’t that be better?”
Murong Lie spoke with respect and dignity, like a true leader of his clan. Murong did live up to its name of being fair.
Anyone else would’ve done a one-eighty on the spot and hung out with the best Clan Head in southern lands for days and days. This was a prime occasion to be moving on up.
A shame Zhuo Fan found such practice in his detriment for this particular endeavor, in which subtlety was much prized, to say nothing of Bali Yuyu.
Zhuo Fan shook his head in refusal, “Murong Clan Head, I thank you for the offer, but I am needed elsewhere and can’t be late. Next time I’m free, I’ll be sure to pay the Murong home a visit. All I hope is that Clan Head wouldn’t mind me troubling him for a few days then. As for now, ha-ha, I shall take my leave.”
Zhuo Fan was getting impatient about making a quick exit.
“Now hold on, sir, there’s still some things I need your help in understanding.” Murong Lie’s suspicions were raised and he shouted.
Zhuo Fan turned a deaf ear, going further away.
Murong Lie felt convinced now. They looked too suspicious and may very well turn out to be central area spies. So he sprinted straight for them.
“Is sir’s haste due to guilt, not even able to look me in the eye?”
Whoosh~
He was about to catch up to Zhuo Fan, reaching out his hand, but then a cold palm got in between.
Thunder flashed and wind howled as a strong sword wave came at Murong Lie’s head.
Murong Lie’s heart skipped a beat in his chest, having rarely met with people so against him as to unleash such deadly strikes. He had no choice but to rush a counter, in the form of a burning sword from his finger.
Bam!
Everything shook from the clash, the shockwave of a Sword King level expert turning the town into ruins as it sent dust everywhere.
The shockwave was so strong that it blew Murong Xue and Zhui’er away with the dust, falling soon after. Looking up they saw an unfamiliar view, with nothing but broken pieces everywhere.
“Brother always knows to hold back so why…”
Murong Xue cried out in distress, looking ahead and then shuddering in fright.
Murong Lie had a solemn gaze in front of the fierce storm, his hand still shaking as lightning crackled along his hand and fingers.
In that storm stood Zhuo Fan holding Qiao’er’s hand, with the icy Bali Yuyu covering them in front.
Crash!
Zhui’er crawled out of some rubble, looking dazed and overwhelmed from the experience. When she noticed her young miss, she rushed over in panic, “Young miss, w-what’s going on? Why would Clan Head destroy the town?”
“It wasn’t him, forced to give more strength then he wished due to meeting such a powerful opponent. Their clash resulted in what we see around us.”
Murong Xue shuddered, looking at the trio in the distance with a heavy look, “The only ones in this world strong enough to contend with my brother are the best in each land, as well as the central area’s Nine Sword Kings. But my brother is very familiar with the other lands’ strongest. Which means this sudden opponent has to be…”
“A Sword King!”
Zhui’er gasped in shock as she stared in Baili Yuyu’s direction with shaky legs. Her heart sank and sweat poured out of her like a waterfall, “Young miss, that was too dangerous, going against a Sword King like that! What if she wanted to kill young miss…”
Murong Xue nodded and sighed, “Even I didn’t think I’d meet a Sword King here. But if she’s a Sword King, then what about Gu Yifan? I have traded blows with him but he lacked the strength a Sword King had, despite using some baffling skill. He’s not even in the Genesis Stage. So how did he get a Sword King to save his life?”
“Maybe he’s a prince?”
“No, the Nine Sword Kings only listen to the Invincible Sword, and sometimes to their Prime Minister. They’d ignore even their emperor.”
Murong Xue sank in thought, “Just who is Gu Yifan? He killed a third of the Sword Star Empire’s officials so how is it that he is together with a Sword King?”
Murong Xue did not understand, while Zhui’er looked perplexed at her.
But then she exclaimed, from shock and fear, “Oh god, oh god! I just talked trash about him and now he’ll send the Nine Sword Kings after me! What should I do? Young miss, I’m too young to die…”
“I told you to not to not talk without thinking, now look where it got you!”
Murong Xue glared at her then shook her head, “But you can relax, knowing that the Nine Sword Kings would assassinate you and turn you into a celebrity overnight. Your death will be worth it.”
“I don’t want to be famous! I just want to live!”
“Girl, that ship has sailed.” Murong Xue shook her head and gave Zhui’er a dumb look.
Murong Lie and Bali Yuyu exchanged an attack, thus giving a huge clue to Zhuo Fan’s identity. Murong Lie was now on guard, staring constantly at Zhuo Fan, while at the same time filled with the same doubts his little sister had.
“I heard that there’s only one woman among the Nine Sword Kings, Baili Yuyu. But I’m afraid I have yet to learn of your great name, having the Frigid Rain Sword King for a guard.”
“You have it all wrong, Murong Clan Head. We’re not from the central area, just crossing paths. Please do not jump to conclusions.”
Zhuo Fan didn’t turn around as he gave a composed smile, “Or it wouldn’t have been me talking to you right now, but that Invincible Sword geezer.”
[Geezer?]
Murong Lie was taken aback there. All of the central area’s nobility and officials worshiped Invincible Sword, with none even daring to speak bad about him.
Not even criminals would show anything less than respect to the Patriarch.
[Yet this guy has no care about all that.]
[Is he not related to the central area? Was there another power besides those obvious experts that can contend with the Nine Sword Kings?]
Murong Lie was then struck by a crazy thought about Zhuo Fan and his suspicion fell as a result. Only Bali Yuyu balled her fists in silent rage.
Calling Patriarch names with her around was the same as spitting in her face…

chapters.title: Chapter 1001 - 1001, Sacred Weapon Fight
chapters.content:
Chapter 1001, Sacred Weapon Fight
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Not letting Zhuo Fan out of his sight, Murong Lie felt very much disturbed, continuing the questioning, “As sir is not from central area, who might you be, where do you come from, and what’s the purpose of your visit in northern lands?”
“I’ve already said it. We are just passing by. There’s no need to look any further.”
“I am not prone to disrespect anyone like today, but the northern lands are now in a precarious state, giving me no choice but to insist, sir.”
“And if I still refuse?” Zhuo Fan squinted with a thin smile.
Murong Lie released his powerful aura, his eyes hard with determination, “You’ll have to excuse me for detaining you until it’s made clear as to who sir is.”
“Ha-ha-ha, it seems to me that Ardent Sun Sword God is a bit on the conceited side.”
Zhuo Fan took Qiao’er’s hand and kept on walking, his voice casually reaching Baili Yuyu, “I’m leaving with Qiao’er. Be sure to catch up later.”
Murong Lie squinted and acted while shouting, “Is sir just going to leave me hanging? Do I mean nothing to you?”
Whoosh~
Bali Yuyu made sure to intercept his attempt, regarding him with a frosty countenance.
Murong Lie knew this was coming and the world around him began to boil as endless fires came into being. The harsh and cold northern lands and its fierce snowstorms turned into a blistering volcano in an instant, the searing heat rising high enough to make lava.
The ice and snow that had been growing for centuries around the area, instantly turned to steam before vanishing altogether.
From icy wasteland, the north had become a scorching hell. The world was at Murong Lie’s whims.
Peak Genesis Stage held the power to make all beings in the world unable to escape his grasp.
While anyone else would’ve soiled themselves at such a display, Bali Yuyu wasn’t impressed by the best in southern lands.
Her icy stare held sparks, just before she released her own awe-inspiring power.
Thunder rumbled incessantly while the world took a silvery glow. The blistering hell had now started to rumble heavily, turning into a silvery ocean, with lightning sword energy snaking across, promising extreme destruction at the slightest touch.
With the world split in two like this, Murong Xue and Zhui’er gasped. They were sure Bali Yuyu was strong, but to find out she could be on equal grounds with her big brother was a whole new concept to grasp.
In an extreme battle of Sword King level adversaries, no place could offer the slightest amount of cover, not when the world could shift at any second from their clashes.
“Ha-ha-ha, miss is a true rarity. You truly have the power to stall me, no wonder he was so confident. We could be fighting for days and there still won’t be any result, let alone thinking of following afterward.”
Looking at the sky split in two from their power, then at the casual Zhuo Fan making his leave, Murong Lie laughed.
But then his smile turned sinister, “You’re missing something, however. Miss may be my equal in power, but won’t last ten moves if I’m serious.”
“Tch, you sure know how to brag.”
Bali Yuyu sneered, “They say the Murong Clan Head is wise, but now I see you’re nothing but an arrogant man. From our earlier exchange, it’s clear that none of us hold the advantage, with a victor coming out only when the situation is dire. But it might take years for that to happen. Now the Murong Clan Head is so cocky to say that in ten moves you can best me? Ha-ha-ha, are my skills so weak compared to your clan’s special arts?”
Murong Lie shook his head, giving a vague smile, “Miss, there’s nothing ordinary about you, having reached a level of power no less than mine. Your clan must have a long legacy, with intricate skills. My clan has earned itself a bit of reputation on the outside, but it’s not so conceited as to dismiss every other hero out there.”
“So why then the declaration of ten moves?” Bali Yuyu gave him a cruel look of contempt.
Murong Lie sighed and shook his head, “It should be my fortune to be able to spar for thousands of blows with such a powerful miss. But in this case, I can’t indulge others’ requests in favor of harming the northern lands. I only hope Miss would be kind enough to forge me.”
Murong Lie gave a slight gesture of respect, then his face hardened. A seething golden fire came from his hand, coalescing into a two-meter-long burning golden sword.
With its appearance, the world shifted.
The inferno around Murong Lie surged higher and higher, unleashing its power like a torrential flood upon Bali Yuyu’s silvery side of the world. It took moments to swallow it whole, even the lightning of sword energy.
Whoosh~
The world took on scarlet hues, the heat spiking higher and higher, making the very ground hiss under the strain. All the world around them was in Murong Lie’s grasp. And with the world growing hotter signified his attacks would be that much stronger.
Bali Yuyu’s eyes shook and cried, “The divine weapon of southern lands, Decimating Divine Sword?”
“Precisely!”
Murong Lie grinned with confidence. He gave it a light wave and held it before him with a sigh, “Miss, forgive me for cutting short our fight, taking out the divine sword and claiming victory. But as I’ve said, I’d be most happy to entertain Miss on any other occasion. Please forgive me.”
Murong Xue and Zui’er lit up with joy that the Clan Head won.
No matter how strong the woman was, the Clan Head had a rare divine weapon to help him tip the situation in his favor.
Unlike the common spiritual weapons everyone else wielded, a divine weapon would only unleash more power the stronger its user was.
That meant that with Murong Lie just holding the Decimating Sword, his victory was certain. It validated his earlier challenge of defeating Bali Yuyu in ten moves.
Zhuo Fan wouldn’t be going anywhere…
Bali Yuyu stared hard at Murong Lie, biting her lip.
To match the Decimating Sword, Patriarch’s Sundering Sword was required. But Patriarch would never let go of his precious, to say nothing of him being nowhere near here.
Her loss was set in stone the minute a divine sword was involved. This rotten outcome filled the Sword King with nothing but anger and chagrin.
As a fellow practitioner, Murong Lie knew her feelings well and sighed, “Miss, please disregard this encounter and not take it as a loss. I am forced by circumstances.”
Murong Lie no longer looked at the resentful Bali Yuyu and regarded Zhuo Fan in the distance, “Sir, miss has already lost. Do you still intend to leave?”
“Why of course.”
Zhuo Fan never missed a step, “She can’t beat you, but it’s enough to give me plenty of time. Even a snail would get thousands of miles in that period.”
Murong Lie cocked an eyebrow, then mocked, “Stall me? She won’t be doing that after ten moves. Both of you know that!”
Bali Yuyu’s face sank, her fists clenched tight.
“If I say she can stall, then that’s what she’ll do. Don’t believe me?”
Zhuo Fan gave off an evil smirk, “Murong Clan Head, earlier you said your clan has a bit of reputation, but won’t disparage other experts. The way I see it, you really are conceited, considering everyone beneath you. Do you consider yourself unique for wielding a divine weapon?”
Murong Lie’s eyebrow shot up and his heart quivered, “You can’t possibly mean…”
“You guessed it. In this fight, the one who slipped up isn’t me but you!”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone and a black edge rose from his palm. A scarlet sword with black lines soon came into view.
Zhuo Fan threw it at Bali Yuyu, “Take it and be sure to enjoy the Murong Clan Head’s fine arts…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1002 - 1002, Upheaval
chapters.content:
Chapter 1002, Upheaval
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Whoosh!
A black lightning cut the heavens as Bali Yuyu grasped the black sword.
Blackness seeped into the scorching world around, giving it eerie hues and vibes. Along with it came creepy sounds, like that of demons, fearful and horrifying.
Bali Yuyu stared at the humming sword agape. She could feel its power, its spirit, no less the likes of Patriarch’s Sundering Sword and Murong Lie’s Decimating Sword.
This was a divine weapon!
[But which land did it belong to? Why haven’t I heard of it before? Was there a strange divine weapon with black lines among the five divine weapons?]
Murong Lie’s brow shook in disbelief. The Decimating Sword in his hand started humming as well.
Filled with rage from meeting its archenemy.
“What’s going on with the Decimating Sword?” Looking at the shaking sword in his hand, Murong Lie frowned and his eyes shone, “What had the divine weapon so excited? It didn’t act like this before, even when meeting other divine weapons. So why now…”
Zhuo Fan, however, knew the reason.
The divine weapon got incensed at the appearance of the demonic sword because it was once the Vaulting Sword, having changed its looks with the new resident sword spirit.
The great five sacred weapons had been forged together and now two met to find one unrecognizable. Even people would be too shocked for words.
Lucky the sword spirits couldn’t talk or the Vaulting Sword would’ve spat fire, “Who the hell are you, bastard, to rob my brother’s home? Where is my brother?”
“He-he-he, six feet under.”
“How did he die?”
“Master wiped him out since he didn’t listen to reason…”
And that was how it went.
With a creepy smirk, Zhuo Fan tuned into the two swords’ alternate humming, supplying his own melodramatic script to fit them.
[No matter how hostile the swords are, their wielders have no clue whatsoever.]
“You have a divine sword now, so don’t just stand there, attack!”
The sword humming had the two stunned for a moment and Zhuo Fan’s shout pierced their confusion.
Bali Yuyu shook and then grinned at the demonic sword, feeling her spirits lifted. She now had the means to give Murong Lie the fight he wanted.
[With both of us having divine swords, no one can tell the outcome.]
Bali Yuyu pushed her power through the divine sword and the humming intensified until an energy shot out of its tip and into the clouds above.
It was a veritable thunderstorm now, with billowing winds and flashes of silver having replaced the predominant scarlet skies. The lightning and the sword energy mixed, spreading around and ripping apart the red clouds of fire.
The world had changed once more in mere seconds. Even though the area wasn’t that huge, a third of the fire clouds were gone. This proved Bali Yuyu now had the power to outlive the next ten strikes.
While Murong Lie’s dominating position had crumbled with the loss of control over the skies.
The two wielded divine swords, cutting any chance of making such a battle short…
Grinning, Zhuo Fan waved and kept walking off with Qiao’er, “You two take your time and have fun. I’ll be going now, ha-ha-ha…”
Murong Lie’s face twitched, furious as he watched Zhuo Fan slip away. Then he turned to his opponent and her evil smile with a sigh.
“This is going to take some time…”
“Yeah, there’s no way ten moves are enough, not even a hundred, he-he-he…”
Bali Yuyu beamed, rushing Murong Lie, “Clan Head, I’ve yet to use a divine sword in my life, so now that I have an opponent to match, be sure to go for a couple of rounds with me, ha-ha-ha…”
[Curses, now I’m reduced to being a sparring partner!]
Murong Lie’s face fell and sighed despite the excited Bali Yuyu coming at him in force.
Murong Lie knew there was no stopping Zhuo Fan now and didn’t feel like fighting. Though Bali Yuyu found herself with a divine sword for the first time and was too excited not to take it up for a spin, or two.
One disappointed man and one excited woman clashed in a devastating battle.
The world shook, the ground quaked, lightning roiled and an inferno backed the skies. This Sword King level fight now got a boost in the form of divine swords, unleashing an upheaval upon the world around them, as if the end of days was upon this wretched world.
Everything ceased to exist wherever the two ended up crossing swords, with plenty of other places ending up wrecked from just their auras.
Such a battle had never been witnessed before, especially if one was sensible enough to care for their lives in front of such relentless destruction and onslaught.
Murong Xue and Zhui’er scrambled away the instant they knew things were about to go down, not even sparing a glance back at the incredible, and equally deadly, display of raw power. The explosions alone could deafen them permanently.
Though even the speedy escape proved to be slow, as many times they were about to be engulfed in the aftermath of a one too strong clash, and remain here forever as corpses.
Zhuo Fan vanished as the smoke and dust grew prevalent, giving Murong Xue no chance to find him.
The battle had the added benefit of wiping his trail, with everyone stuck in finding out just who this mystery man was…
Ahead of the billowing smoke stopped a carriage and Zhuo Fan got in with Qiao’er before it went on its way.
The guards glanced at Zhuo Fan then at the upheaval outside with shock and doubt, “Holy hell, sir, what happened? We just finished our business in Galefrost Town and a hail of icicles struck, forcing us to flee. Then, just like sir said, the whole town got wrecked and we were worried about your safety. And now the world is going for destruction, with the skies filled with lightning and fire.”
“Nothing to be concerned about, you just drive the carriage. Frigid Rain Sword King is only fighting Murong Lie.” Zhuo Fan dismissed his worry with a smile.
The others gasped at the news, “Ardent Sun Sword God Murong Lie?! How on earth did you meet him? What happened?”
“It’s nothing, just got in his sights…” Zhuo Fan made light of things once more but then he coughed blood.
The others were panicking, “Sir!”
“Father, you…” Qiao’er was worried.
Zhuo Fan eased a breath and slipped a pill in his mouth from his ring, “It’s fine. I just settled a favor. We can go now.”
Qiao’er knew the truth and sighed, hugging him in worry.
The world around them still shook a lot, the shockwaves from two Sword Kings battling spreading destruction in every direction.
Only a carriage pulled by four panicking 3rd level spiritual beasts was left…
Ten days later.
The wind and snow battered the road, with a sudden person flashing before a speeding carriage, easily slipping inside.
Seeing who was back, everyone lit up, “Miss Yuyu, you’re finally back. Sir had been worried about you all this time, ha-ha-ha…”
“Worried?”
Looking at the pale Zhuo Fan, Bali Yuyu smirked, “He’s better off looking after himself. He’s the one hurt here, judging by that ashen face, right?”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “My soul got a slight wound and will be fine in a month.
“Tch, idiot.” Bali Yuyu shook her head, mocking him, “You just had to use your soul against Murong Xue now look where it got you. Of course your soul will be damaged from her attack.”
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “I wanted to return the favor, and the only way to do that was by taking her fatal blow.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1003 - 1003, Fooled
chapters.content:
Chapter 1003, Fooled
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“You used to be so shrewd till now so why are you stupid all of a sudden?”
Bali Yuyu mocked him, “Weren’t you scared she might have just destroyed your soul and body?”
“Ha-ha-ha, this much is nothing to the ordeals I’ve gone through to get here.”
Zhuo Fan eased a long breath, “When you return the favor, you have to be sincere, giving the other the chance to have a life for the one he had given you. Only this time, my twin souls were too strong for even her full power to destroy. My dragon soul might be hurt, but my domain can absorb all the harm, within limit. Anyway, I got my life back!”
Bali Yuyu gapped, “You’re such a weirdo, returning a favor at the cost of your life.”
“In any other situation, I could’ve returned the favor easily, but she and I walk different paths. She not only disdains my help, but even if I could help her it would only smear her beliefs, doing more harm than good. Thus the only choice was a life for a life. Though I still have uses for mine and can’t just give it up, happy with just offering the chance for her to take it. It’s her problem if she falls short of success, but all debts have been paid.”
Bali Yuyu blinked in confusion, “That’s one fresh outlook you have that I never seen before.”
“Paying debt can be reduced to just finding inner peace. I don’t owe anyone and neither does anyone owe me. Breaking the ties that bind is nothing more than a formality, so long as my heart achieves tranquility.”
“True, grudges and gratitudes are all about the heart. Why bother haggling over how when the stress is dealt with.”
Bali Yuyu nodded then turned solemn, “What say I give you a chance to get rid of another tie?”
Zhuo Fan gave her a long look, “What are you up to? What tie are you talking about?”
“Why a favor as great as the heavens themselves!”
She rushed over to his side and she looked Zhuo Fan right in the eye, “What do you think of me, Qian?”
Shuddering, everyone in the carriage looked at Frigid Rain Snow King with dumb looks.
[What’s this Sword King doing, confessing?]
[Curses, she’s truly daring taking initiative like that, unlike any woman I know. Wait, that’s just like a Sword King!]
All eyes were now on Zhuo Fan, dropping obvious hints.
[Sir, getting on with a Sword King won’t just help you but also ourselves immensely.]
[Look how eager she is so just accept it. While she’s a bit wild, she has loads of power as well to cower anyone.]
Glaring at them to stay out of it, Zhuo Fan looked into Bali Yuyu’s hopeful eyes, “Uhm, miss Yuyu, what are you saying?”
“Just what I meant. What do you usually think of me?”
“Nothing much.” Zhuo Fan blurted in a flat tone.
Bali Yuyu’s face twitched and yanked his clothes, “Nothing much? Would you like to try that again?”
“Now miss Yuyu, let’s not get hasty. Sir has always been blunt, so please don’t jump to anger.” The others noticed the wild woman was about to flip and rushed to placate her.
Bali Yuyu paused in thought then let Zhuo Fan go. She steadied her heart and gave her sweetest smile, “Sir Qian, your words are so hurtful. You don’t look like a saint and certainly don’t act like one either, but you have one redeeming quality, being grateful. You’d even give your life to return another’s gratitude. I am a woman who respects men with such traits!”
“Out with it woman, and don’t dawdle!” Zhuo Fan huffed.
Bali Yuyu’s lip twitched in anger and glared at him, her fists clenched, but she managed to get all that frustration out of her with one long breath. Her face maintained the warmth she started with as she judged, “What I mean is, Qian, to protect you back in Galefrost Town, I had to face Murong Lie all by myself. Didn’t I save your life? So shouldn’t you be grateful?”
“Nope.”
“Why?”
“You’re a guard Baili Yutian gave me and you just did your duty. How’s that anything like saving my life?”
Zhuo Fan spoke with confidence. Bali Yuyu’s heart sank but she still gave it another try, “You caused that mess back in Galefrost Town, why else would Murong Lie meet us? Since I handled it for you, the least you can do is return the favor!”
“Like I said, you’re working for me now so everything is part of your job description, included, but not limited to, obedience and protection. How is that a favor?”
Zhuo Fan looked at her longing eyes as he drawled, “Besides, any extra reward I was to give you I already did in Galefrost Town. You’d have been beaten black and blue by now if it weren’t for my divine sword, right? I just saved your reputation and your life. Now ain’t that the highest gratitude?”
“But that was obvious, since you couldn’t escape otherwise!”
“As you master, anything I give you, if ever, isn’t out of gratitude, but favor. It is you who should be grateful to me for what’s yours is mine, as a servant.”
Booping Bali Yuyu’s nose, Zhuo Fan had an evil smile while defining her responsibilities, then asked, “Oh right, where’s my demonic sword? Why haven’t you given it back?”
Bali Yuyu twisted and placed her hands behind her while shying away in hesitation.
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, noticing the sword strapped to her waist then and held out his hand, “Give it here now.”
“I was just going to ask you that maybe, perhaps, I can keep it?” Bali Yuyu pleaded shyly.
The others’ eyes widened in realization.
[Frigid Rain Sword King she’s been wishy-washy all this time, but not to confess at all.]
[How boring, and you got us all hopeful for nothing.]
Everyone rolled their eyes and looked elsewhere. Only Zhuo Fan saw her intent from the start and mocked, “Keep it? Do you have any idea what this is? You tell me if your Patriarch is willing to let you even touch the Sundering Sword.”
“It’s because divine swords are so rare that only now I’ve wielded one for the first time and experienced the power it filled me with.”
Bali Yuyu looked excited once more, “Oh, I also heard there’s only five divine swords around. How come you have the sixth?”
Zhuo Fan glanced at her and jeered, “Who told you that there’s only five of them? More like there’s only five in the secular world.”
“Secular world? You mean there’s more divine swords in the world beyond?”
“Of course. Let me tell you, all of these divine swords come from Devil Mountain!” Zhuo Fan huffed with a wide grin.
Bali Yuyu started, shaken to the core, “Devil Mountain made the five lands’ divine swords?!”
“Well yes, the masters will make the disciples about to leave Devil Mountain a sword specific to their skill set. The five lands’ divine swords are nothing but weapons left behind by the ones that perished.” Zhuo Fan smacked his lips, weaving a shocking tale of adulation.
Bali Yuyu was dumbstruck, needing a long time to react and hold the demonic sword tight to herself while pleading, “Then you can just leave this one to me while you can ask your master to make you another.”
“You think it’s that easy? Why would it be called a divine sword if it’s so easy to make?”
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes at her, “Who won in Galefrost Town?”
“Uh, Murong Lie.” Baili Yuyu hesitated, then pouted, “We fought for eight days but still I couldn’t beat him so I left. And since we’re about the same, he couldn’t stop me nor catch up to me.”
Zhuo Fan nodded and asked, “You’re Murong Lie’s equal and could fight him for years. Why did you run after just eight days?”
“How am I his equal? He’s been using the Decimating Sword for a thousand years while I only just got yours. I couldn’t even link with it either. Of course I lost!”
“Isn’t that obvious?”
Zhuo Fan shrugged, “The demonic sword was made with me in mind so of course it’s in tune with me. You learned from Baili Yutian’s Sundering Sword and that’s the sword best for you while mine is useless.”
“But Patriarch will never give me the Sundering Sword. While even the unfamiliar divine sword you have is better than having none at all.”
“Sword follows your will, so you need one in tune to your being too. Using a random sword, especially this divine sword, will only hinder your path.”
Zhuo Fan dismissed her request, “Listen, if you obey me and succeed in the task Devil Mountain gave me, I’ll be sure to take you back with me so that master would make you a divine sword akin to Sundering Sword to fit your nature. Won’t that be better than insisting on taking mine?”
Bali Yuyu lit up in joy, “Really?”
“Have I ever lied to you?” Zhuo Fan gave his winning smile.
Bali Yuyu nodded in joy then handed over the demonic sword.
Zhuo Fan chuckled while tracing his hand over the pitch-black blade. Since the demonic sword was tied to his mind, no one could get its approval without his permission.
[Or this broad would’ve run off with it by now instead of wasting time with me.]
Zhuo Fan made a sign and the demonic sword slipped into his body. He then glanced at the cheerful Bali Yuyu with a hidden smile,
[Power and fame can blind people so easily, turning even this silly girl into being obsessed with a sword. She not once questioned if divine swords are so easy to make.]
[Besides, when was the last time I’ve been honest…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1004 - 1004, Light’s Shadow
chapters.content:
Chapter 1004, Light’s Shadow
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
As the carriage rushed along the snowy roads, the mood within was as peaceful as ever.
Bali Yuyu hugged the cute and adorable Qiao’er, while Zhuo Fan finally started to grow on her. She exclaimed all of a sudden and said hastily, “Oh, Murong Lie couldn’t find my intentions, but he can easily find yours. Maybe he’s searching for it right now and gaining on us. Now that he got a feel of my skills, I can’t stall him for long. I can only protect myself so you need to watch out.”
“Heh, only now you’re worried about me?”
“Who would? But with you dead, who knows when I’ll ever get the chance to touch such a precious divine sword again?” Bali Yuyu went red and whined.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, turning to the others, “How far till the next stop?”
“Sir, we will be arriving at Sea Cloud Sect in around four hours.”
“Go faster.” Zhuo Fan smiled as he said.
Bali Yuyu’s brow shook, “Weren’t you listening? Murong Lie must’ve been looking for you by now. And since he lost our trail, he’ll be sure to ask Sea Cloud Sect for help since it’s the closest to Galefrost Town. Are you going there to get caught?”
“My dear Frigid Rain Sword King, you think I haven’t thought about it as well?”
“Then…”
“Ha-ha-ha, do you know of the light’s shadow?” Zhuo Fan put on a vague smile laying down without a care.
Bali Yuyu was then left utterly confused.
Four hours later, the carriage went on undisturbed and reached a frozen waterfall where they slowed down and entered a barrier.
At the same time, three people stood in an opulent hall, the same three they just shook off not long ago.
Before them stood an old man with an immortal air and white beard, bowing in respect, “Sword God Murong of southern lands and Immortal Healer Murong, you honor my sect with your visit. But from what I know, sir should be with Sea Bright Sect, getting ready with Sir Ouyang to fight Invincible Sword. What wind has brought you here instead?”
“It’s a long story.”
Murong Lie sighed, “I had been staying at Sea Bright Sect in preparation for the upcoming storm, but something happened. Northern lands’ first line of defense, Sun Sea Sect, had been under attack and called for help. So I volunteered to go. Only to find the sect already in ruins, with the survivors escaping for the Sea Bright Sect. I have thus scouted around for the culprit that did this.”
“Isn’t it obvious? The only one who can destroy a northern lands sect can only be Invincible Sword’s team. As you already know, he has those Nine Sword Kings under him who can cause such destruction just as well.”
“Yeah, that was my conclusion as well. While I could not take them on by myself, at least by understanding their journey, maybe we could be prepared for the next time, but…” Murong Lie frowned at the end, filled with hesitation and confusion.
The old man urged, “What, did Murong Clan Head find something else disturbing?”
“Precisely!”
Murong Lie had a dark look on his face, “There’s another group that might have come within the northern lands besides Invincible Sword’s.”
The old man shuddered and gasped, “Murong Clan Head, you mean to tell me there’s another power out there that can do away with a northern lands sect just as easily as the central area? And that it is now here, on our grounds? That’s absurd! We all know very well all of the strongest people in the five lands. With the central area eyeing us like a starved tiger, the other four lands allied together. How can there possibly be a third faction so strong?”
“I didn’t believe it was true either, but having seen it with my own eyes, I must.”
Murong Lie squinted and sighed, “As I was investigating Sun Sea Sect, the trail took me to Galefrost Town where I happened to meet my sister in a dispute with an unknown party. I wanted to investigate further but they were exceptional. A woman among them is as strong as me and wielded a divine weapon unlike any of which the lands knew. We fought for eight days to a standstill. It might’ve gone on for years if the divine weapon was a match for her skill.”
The old man’s face twitched and looked graceful, “She must be something indeed to fight Murong Clan Head with a divine weapon to a standstill. However, what makes you so sure they aren’t from the central area? Maybe that sword might have been the Sundering Sword…”
“Sect Leader Liang, my brother has once met with the Invincible Sword and has seen the Sundering Sword. On top of that, Invincible Sword guards the sword with his life, never giving it to anyone…”
Murong Xue gave a bow of respect and intervened with sharp eyes, “I’ve once seen the man within their group, once. He unleashed a river of blood in the central area, making it so that in just three days, the greatest company, Serene Shores Trading, was destroyed, and the Sword Star Empire to lose close to half their officials. Would someone from the same land resort to such cruelty towards his fellow compatriot?”
The old man’s brow shook, but hesitated still, “What I hear from you, miss, is that he is from the third faction? But since he struck at the central area, wouldn’t that make him a friend…”
“No!”
Murong Xue spoke resolutely, “He is ruthless and cruel, of a twisted mind and insidious cunning. Just because he left the central area in pain does not mean his visit to northern lands bodes well. Maybe he wants northern lands to end up in the same sorry state as the central area, if not worse. You can’t let this happen, Sect Leader Liang!”
Murong Lie agreed with his sister’s judgment, “I’ve also seen him myself, of steady calm, great talent and sharp mind. His bearing points to anything but average. Not to mention he has a Sword King level expert under him. When he acts, he’s bound to make huge waves. We are still in the dark about the purpose of his visit, but it’s best to gain control of the situation as soon as possible. We are on the cusp of waging war with Invincible Sword and can’t afford anything to disturb us, especially a viper staring us from the back.”
“Murong Clan Head, you’re right, we need to gain control of this as soon as possible.”
The beard of Sect Leader Liang shook as he sank in thought, then he cupped his hands, “Then what has brought Murong Clan Head to my sect? Ask and I shall do all in my power to help.”
Murong Lie returned the gesture with a smile, “Sect Leader Liang is too kind. I’ve come to ask for a helping hand. I had fought with the woman guard before, giving them time to flee, and because of the scope of destruction, all trails went cold. I alone will find it hard to search through so much ground, but I’m fortunate to find your sect nearby and wish to ask Sect Leader Liang’s help in this endeavor.”
“Please, it’s our duty to help. Murong Clan Head works so hard for the safety of our homeland that you needn’t be so polite about it.”
Sect Leader Liang cupped his hands, “What may be their description?”
Murong Xue said, “They’re a group of three. The woman among them is very dangerous, and needs only to be seen to know their whereabouts. Beside the man, there’s also a seven-year-old cute girl, making them easily recognizable.”
“Ha-ha-ha, then rest easy. My disciples shall roam for thousands of miles and are sure to spot such a conspicuous group very soon. As for the lady’s worries, ha-ha, rest assured that we know restraint and not incite anyone that could fight with Murong Clan Head for eight days straight. Miss Murong needn’t have mentioned, as we would also be weary and keep our distance, ha-ha-ha…”
Murong Xue smiled and nodded, while Murong Lie looked satisfied with the answer, cupping his hands in respect.
The order was soon given and the sect was on the move, with all kinds of exceptional experts filling the skies and leaving the sect to scout the lands.
In their haste, they failed to notice the four carriages at their gates, and Zhuo Fan holding Qiao’er as he talked business with a round middle-aged man.
Glancing at the swarm of people flying out, Zhuo Fan felt the need to comment, “Executive Qi, what’s going on in the sect? Are you getting ready for war going out in such force?”
“How would I know? I didn’t get any orders.”
Putting his own signature into a jade slip and giving it back to Zhuo Fan, the large horizontally challenged man looked at a flying disciple that passed by, “Hey, what happened? Why the sudden deployment?”
Making a hard stop, the man bowed to the fatty, “Executive Qi, Sect Leader decreed to scout for spies. They’ve even brought a child!”
“A child? Like this one?” Zhuo Fan pointed at Qiao’er, “This is my daughter. Isn’t she adorable?”
The man gave a curious glance at the fatty, who waved his doubts away and introduced, “Steward Qian, in charge of his clan’s supply caravan. You can’t be looking for him now, can you? Ha-ha-ha…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1005 - 1005, North Sea Shore
chapters.content:
Chapter 1005, North Sea Shore
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Probably not.”
The guy’s brow twitched as he looked at the father and daughter bearing bright innocent faces, then at the carriages’ guards and sneered, “Executive Qi, Sect Leader spoke of their dangerous nature, and that there were only three of them, along with a woman. He also made us exercise extreme caution, to report the minute we see them. As for these two, ha-ha-ha…”
“Are we that much lacking?”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes widened, striking his chest to declare, “We’re tough as well, how else would we be ferrying goods around the land?”
The man’s face twitched and nodded, “Yeah, you’re mighty tough alright. Well, I got a job to do so bye!”
The man was gone.
“Hey, what’s that supposed to mean! Weren’t you after a little girl? Aren’t you taking us to your Sect Leader?” Zhuo Fan whined from the injustice of it all.
The fatty cut him off before he wasted more time, “Steward Qian, they have their duties. You shouldn’t bother them and let them get to it.”
“That won’t do at all. Weren’t they after some very dangerous folk? I’m tough, you hear. How can they just overlook me? Where’s the humanity?”
Jerking, Zhuo Fan grew defiant, turning to Qiao’er’s adorable face, “Qiao’er, tell me, isn’t dad strong?”
Qiao’er huffed as she left him there and went inside the carriage. The fatty, chuckled, “Everyone wants to look tough in front of their daughter, ha-ha-ha…”
“Yeah, so you really really won’t check me out?” Zhuo Fan sighed, looking at the fatty with hope, “Since you think I’m that much of a threat, do a slight checkup at least.”
The fatty rolled his eyes and cussed, “Dangerous my ass! What could a Radiant Stage Qian steward possibly do? Besides, what would be the point of this mass deployment if Sect Leader’s target would be right before him? You take those dangerous folks for fools to run right at our base to get caught?”
“But they just said they’re looking for a child…”
“There’s plenty of them in the sea. You think you’re the only one with a daughter? Go, shoo, and stop messing up my job!” The fatty drove him away, having lost his patience.
Zhuo Fan had a long face, taking his guards and leaving. Though before they did, a whiny voice came from a carriage, “Qiao’er, you gotta believe me. It’s not that I’m weak so they aren’t checking me out, but that they trust me wholly…”
The crowd that was gathered from the ruckus he pulled shook their heads at Zhuo Fan’s display.
[A father must always look grand before his kids.]
They were soon taken down memory lane, back to their childhood.
The people dispersed, but they would not soon forget Zhuo Fan’s carriages…
Hum~
Four large carriages came out of the barrier and rumbled down the road to their next stop. Not soon after, a person slipped right inside.
She had yet to get her new token to prove her cover and couldn’t follow inside with the caravan.
“How was it? All good?” Bali Yuyu lit up in hope.
Zhuo Fan said bored, “What do you think? Making such a scene in Sea Cloud Sect, I got those disciples to jump to the conclusions I wanted, to take us for nobodies and ignore us. The news is bound to spread fast and Sea Cloud Sect will soon turn a blind eye to our presence.
“Sometimes, the wrong first impression will stay with you for a long time and fool your thinking. Thinking that since we appeared in the Sea Cloud Sect, we automatically check out. So no matter how much we speed on our trip and rush things, they would ignore us. Murong Lie could get even more men and still wouldn’t help for when they see us, they are oblivious to the light’s shadow.”
“Oh, you’ve got skills, fooling southern lands’ sword god in no time at all.”
Baili Yuyu patted Zhuo Fan’s shoulder, cheering. His face twitched and glared, “No touching, words are enough. You know exactly what I can do also. That hit almost burst a vein inside me.”
Bali Yuyu stuck out her tongue, acting cute, then turned shy with an apologetic look.
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes, wincing every time he touched his swollen shoulder with a hurt look.
[All I wanted was to move undetected through northern lands. But then I stumbled into Invincible Sword and barely made it out alive before meeting Ardent Sun Sword God as well.]
[I talked my way out with Invincible Sword, since his desires are his demons I could leverage, but that Murong clan is too upright, in opposition of my path, not easily swayed.]
[Ardent Sun Sword God has just become a pain in my side.]
[Damn it, those truly righteous and free from desire cultivators just don’t fit with my nature. This will make things harder, ugh…]
Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan leaned back with closed eyes.
The four carriages didn’t stop for anything in their journey, making their scheduled stops at the sects and then resuming their trek.
Five months passed by in total, before Zhuo Fan reached his final destination, having gone through two more sects, the North Sea shore, Sea Bright Sect.
Regarding the boundless snow mountain in the distance, Zhuo Fan sighed, his gaze quivering, “Are your tokens ready?”
“Ready!” The men shouted with conviction.
Only Bali Yuyu smirked at them, “Sea Bright Sect is one dangerous place. It’s packed with experts and leaves me no choice but to stay a bit further this time.”
“Frigid Rain Sword King, that won’t be necessary.”
One guard revealed a familiar token, identical to the ones they have, and smiled, “Three days ago we received your token we requested in that town. Now you’re no longer unaccounted for and can come with us.”
Bali Yuyu was shocked, then her eyes shone, “Since it was three days ago, why not give it to me then?”
“Sir had me hold on to it, to make it a surprise.”
The guy shrugged and Bali Yuyu’s skipped a beat as she looked at Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan grinned, “Not much of a surprise, really. With how Frigid Rain Sword King always acts alone, it was clear you didn’t want such a thing. Now I’m unsure if Sword King would be willing to come with us, to walk beside us with this cover. But it seems my worries are unfounded, ha-ha-ha…”
“Humph, who’d ever go with you? I was just concerned about bringing trouble to you and ruining my mission.”
“Does that mean Frigid Rain Sword King doesn’t want to come in with us? You don’t want the token? Then go ahead, destroy it.”
“I never said that. Why ruin a perfectly good thing anyway?” Bali Yuyu rushed to take it and glared at Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan smiled, his eyes shining, “But by taking that token, you are officially part of this team and must obey my orders.”
Bali Yuyu shook and her grip on the token loosened, but then she gripped it harder, whispering to herself, “Haven’t I been doing it already…”
“Great, now everyone’s an official team.”
Zhuo Fan turned serious and shouted, “So I’ll ask again, are everyone’s token ready?”
“Ready!”
Everyone shouted this time, even Bali Yuyu looked eager. She was going to enter one of northern lands’ five sects for the first time undercover.
While being part of a caravan was a severe step down from a Sword King, she actually treasured the change for some odd reason.
Having traveled with Zhuo Fan and the caravan for so long began to grow on her.
Zhuo Fan looked at them and ordered, “Towards North Sea shore!”
They all nodded and the carriage rumbled uphill, for the snowy peak…

chapters.title: Chapter 1006 - 1006, Perfect Couple
chapters.content:
Chapter 1006, Perfect Couple
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Hum~
Zhuo Fan’s team of four carriages made a ripple in the air as it entered the barrier, appearing before a vast body of water. Above it were suspended stairs leading to the abodes of immortals.
The mountain was nowhere to be seen, replaced by three floating islands of great expanse as its only resemblance to the image outside.
This was where the strongest sect in the northern lands stood, the North Sea’s shores.
While deep in the North Sea was the rumored demon of incredible power, and Zhuo Fan’s target.
The monsters of the sea were mere spiritual beasts, with only this demon able to speak like a human. That was why people called it sea demon.
Only Zhuo Fan here knew the sea demon was in fact one of the five great sacred beasts, the only one that could save young Sanzi, the Heaven Sealing Sea Ao.
Staring at the great rolling expanse of water, Zhuo Fan’s eyes shook and his fists clenched. Qiao’er looked excited as well, finally able to rescue her big brother.
Whoosh~
Black figures suddenly dropped before the team, numbering in the dozens. The leader was an old man with a black and white mustache, presenting them a most kind smile as he greeted, “Thank you, Qian clan, for the trouble you went through delivering these goods. I am Executive Dai Qianchou of the Sea Bright Sect.
“Dai Qianchou? Money trouble, he-he…”
Bali Yuyu couldn’t help herself and giggled at his name, whispering to Zhuo Fan, “Qian, you finally met your half. You dislike money and he’s in need of money, a match made in heaven. You’re destined to make the perfect couple, hi-hi-hi…”
(StarReader: she’s making fun of both of their names, making a pun out of it.)
The others chuckled as well.
Glaring at her, Zhuo Fan gave a wry smile and returned the gesture, “Executive Dai, I am but a steward in the Qian clan, Qian Fan. This is the proof of all the sects we’ve passed.”
Zhuo Fan presented a jade slip with both hands.
The executive wasn’t haughty in the least, taking it with equal respect and a smile, “Yes, these are the signatures of the four sects’ executives. Sir is beyond reproach, but the others…”
“Hurry up and present your tokens to the executive!”
Zhuo Fan snapped at them to obey, making them flustered as they rushed to follow his orders.
Only Bali Yuyu was beyond casual as she took it out and threw it to the man with a roll of her eyes.
Glaring at her, Zhuo Fan could only apologize in her stead, “Executive Dai, she just went through menopause and it’s still unstable…”
“Screw you!” Bali Yuyu hissed under her breath.
Executive Dai gave a careless wave, being quite easy going. He checked their tokens and smiled, “You make for a perfect couple, Steward Qian, braving through so many dangers through the now precarious northern lands to send us these goods. That’s very noble of you.”
[Perfect couple?]
Zhuo Fan looked stumped.
“Did I say something wrong?”
The old man scanned the jade slip in his hand again before looking at Zhuo Fan, “Three days ago we received an update on the Qian clan’s roster that the caravan sending us the goods will be led by Steward Qian Fan and his wife, Qian Yu. Your signatures also check out. Is there perhaps a problem?”
Dong!
Zhuo Fan froze on the spot at the heavy blow to his mind. He made a weird face as he tried to keep his calm, “You mean, Qian Fan and Qian Yu, husband and wife are escorting goods?”
Bali Yuyu was also stupefied, looking at the old man with a dumb look. When reality hit her at long last, she gave Zhuo Fan a seething look with a red face as she whisper-shouted, “You dare use me like that, punk?”
