“As if. I’m as clueless about this as you are, alright?”
“Lies! Aren’t they just doing your bidding?”
“Yeah, they do, but this time…”
Zhuo Fan’s mouth twitched, looking off there, then turned to the rest with an insidious glint in his eyes.
Zhuo Fan had principles. When it came to taking a wife, he would never do it on a whim, even if it was all fake. Just like how he didn’t do it with Shangguan Qingyan.
But this time, at this critical moment, he found himself stuck with this cover, putting him at an impasse on what he should do next.
If he did go with it, his heart would be totally against it, while refusing it then his cover was blown. He was in a real pickle.
The caravan guards saw Zhuo Fan and Bali Yuyu looking dark there and were tense as they lowered their heads.
Executive Dai frowned, “Why, aren’t you married?”
The two were silent, with neither willing to admit it.
Executive Dai was perplexed, feeling the odd situation and raising his suspicion. He withdrew slowly and was about to signal for his men to seize them.
Everything was about to fall to ruin. Even with Bali Yuyu there to help, it wouldn’t matter much in the strongest sect in northern lands. Not only Ouyang Lingtian lived here, but it also held the strongest experts in these parts.
Bali Yuyu had no way of fending so many attackers. She would end up defeated for sure.
In this dire situation, neither Zhuo Fan nor Bali Yuyu were willing to compromise and save the day, all because their hearts were against it.
Dai Qianchou’s suspicion only grew, his hand close to signaling the men and ruining everything they worked for.
The guards were shivering at the side, looking at the two with pleading eyes.
[Please, just save us! Is it that bad to fake being married? It’s not a hanging, so why?]
[If you keep silent any longer, we’re really going to get the noose…]
They were almost wetting themselves as they saw Executive Dai about to give the damning order.
“Dad, mom, I’m hungry! Are you going to keep arguing until I starve?”
Qiao’er jumped in with her adorable voice, looking annoyed and grumbling at the two.
The guards lit up with newfound hope. One of them rushed to Qiao’er’s side and carried her over to Executive Dai with a smile, “Executive Dai, how can they be anything but husband and wife? Look, they even have a child!”
“Then what are they doing?” Dai Qianchou asked in suspicion.
The guard laughed and sighed, “It all started over nothing and escalated, with Steward Qian even threatening to leave her. Now their fighting still hasn’t been settled.”
“Oh, I see.”
Executive Dai gave a knowing nod and his suspicion was washed away. He smiled at Zhuo Fan, “Steward Qian, it takes years to accept someone and decades to fully be at peace with one’s partner. Why must you insist over trivialities?”
Zhuo Fan glanced at Bali Yuyu and said, “She’s not my wife!”
“Well you’re not my man either!” Bali Yuyu glared back.
The two spoke the truth but Dai Qianchou heard it as nothing more than a lovers’ spat.
So he shook his head and waved, “You need to stop fighting, especially before a child, ha-ha-ha. It wouldn’t help her. Since you’ve all been weary from your long journey here, we’ve got a place ready for you to rest for a few days. You’re welcome to tour our sect if you want. The North Sea’s shore is magnificent, with people from northern lands hardly having the chance to see its beauty. You won’t find this anywhere else!”
“Thank you for everything, Executive Dai.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes roamed around and settled on a grunt, recalling his true objective and giving the man a bow.
Dai Qianchou smiled and had someone lead the way to their stay.
One figure suddenly appeared just then, whispering to Dai Qianchou. His face changed and blocked Zhuo Fan’s way, “Steward Qian, Sect Leader requests myself and sir’s presence!”
Zhuo Fan and the others’ faces fell.
What would the high and mighty Sect Leader of the Sea Bright Sect want to do with a nobody steward? Were their covers blown?
Zhuo Fan looked at Bali Yuyu, who had a cold gaze, with murder slowly filling her eyes…
Sorry for the inconvenience. Thank you very much!

chapters.title: Chapter 1007 - 1007, Ling Yuntian
chapters.content:
Chapter 1007, Ling Yuntian
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Don’t make any hasty decisions. I’ll go see what’s going on.
Zhuo Fan squinted and took a deep breath as he made a decision, sending that message to his team. The others flinched and nodded.
Bali Yuyu’s eyes darted around, sizing everything, before nodding at last, “A blown cover means we’d have been detained by now with far more experts surrounding us. Not to mention they’d never ask for you to speak. It’s too early to tell what is going on…”
“While also not grounded enough to rule out the possibility that Murong Lie wants to look into us. So you need to get ready to act at any second. I’ll leave Qiao’er in your care.” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, his face grave.
“What about you?”
“I have my own way of escape, don’t worry.” Bali Yuyu asked quickly at which Zhuo Fan replied casually. “I’m going.”
They watched tensely as Zhuo Fan flew with Dai Qianchou towards the highest floating island while a disciple took them to their rooms.
An hour later, Zhuo Fan and Dai Qianchou were standing before a huge gate, with hundreds of disciples standing guard on each side.
The gate reached thirty meters in height, with 9,999 copper insertions in the shape of a yin-yang symbol to show the natural order of the world.
Dai Qianchou regarded the broad gate and bowed. Zhuo Fan figured it had to be a custom, giving respect to the sect.
[A traveler stopping by needs to show respect as well and might even leave a good impression.]
So Zhuo Fan did the same, standing straight after doing it three times.
Dai Qianchou gave an approving nod, showing a sincere nod as he spoke with reverence at the gate, “Sect Leader, Steward Qian has arrived!”
“Enter!”
Rumble~
With a loud rumble, the gate cracked open. The two rows of disciples bowed at once, all shouting at Zhuo Fan, “Please!”
“Steward Qian, after you.” Dai Qianchou smiled and gestured not unlike the disciples.
Zhuo Fan sighed at this huge welcome.
[This is the Sea Bright Sect, the strongest of the sects in northern lands. Yet the bigger they are, the more aware they are of giving respect and receiving it, instead of acting all cocky.]
He was but a merchant yet the Sea Bright Sect’s Sect Leader showed such deference. This was proof enough to label the Sea Bright Sect as reasonable and righteous as Murong Lie.
That also meant they would never act unless the proof was conclusive.
[Which works great for me.]
While meeting with an impulsive sect, they only needed to believe he was bad news and he was finished.
[Things aren’t for the worst yet…]
Zhuo Fan speculated as he smiled at Dai Qianchou and walked forward with the executive behind.
As he climbed the 999 steps up, the disciples always set their eyes on him, yet none held the slightest contempt.
This was the way Sea Bright Sect welcomed guests, regardless of profession.
Zhuo Fan saw a grand hall and three people waiting for him. Only with one of them he was acquainted, Executive Cao from the Sun Sea Sect.
Zhuo Fan had a clear picture of what this was all about.
[Ha-ha, so it’s him. It’s nothing then. And here I thought Ardent Sun Sword God was going to welcome me. God, that gave me a fright…]
“Sect Leader, he’s the one that made Sun Sea Sect suffer so much. He must be a central area spy!”
Executive Cao instantly pointed fingers and accused Zhuo Fan the moment he appeared. He was boiling with rage and murder, wanting to spill his blood then and there.
Zhuo Fan ignored him and his whining, walking before the three and bowing.
A middle-aged man spoke to an elder next to him, “Sect Leader Ling, it seems the boy is pleading guilty under Executive Cao’s accusations. We need to take him back for thorough questioning and appease the thousands of lost souls of my sect.”
“Steward Qian, I take it. I am the Sect Leader of the Sun Bright Sect, Ling Yuntian.” The old man gave Zhuo Fan a long look but didn’t let the middle-aged man’s words get to him, or stop the greeting.
Zhuo Fan faked shock and bowed as well.
Sect Leader Ling said, “Does Steward Qian have anything to say regarding Executive Cao’s accusations?”
“Accusations?”
Zhuo Fan sneered, “I have no idea of them. What are they?”
“You dare lie to our faces? Executive Cao’s accusations are clear to everyone here. You have nothing to say for yourself that can absolve you and we all know it. Yet you dare act oblivious?”
“Sect Leader Ling, he…”
The middle-aged man shouted, snapping at Zhuo Fan with his finger, but Zhuo Fan regarded him calmly and saluted Ling Yuntian.
Sect Leader Ling made the introductions, “Steward Qian, he is Sun Sea Sect’s Sect Leader, Bu Xingyun. You have delivered goods to Sun Sea Sect but didn’t meet with Sect Leader Bu so you don’t know him, ha-ha-ha…”
“Oh, Sect Leader Bu, greetings, greetings, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan saluted at once, “Sect Leader Ling, there’s a misunderstanding here that I wish to clarify. Executive Cao is someone I have met in Sun Sea Sect, but I don’t know when he came to your sect. When I have just arrived here, I’ve only been hearing Executive Cao’s curses and it got me completely confused. I wish for nothing more than to understand why this happened, but since this is sir’s home and I am a mere guest, it is proper manners to see the Sect Leader and not start arguing.
Zhuo Fan put on a sinister smile, mocking Executive Cao, “I may be a mere merchant, but I am educated enough not to start a fight in another’s home. At the very least, I’ll need Sect Leader’s approval first to prove my innocence and shed light. Acting like a mangy cur, in the master’s home no less, won’t that make him disrespectful? I may not be well read, but my parents had at least taught me proper respect.”
Ugh!
Executive Cao choked, looking red as a crab.
Zhuo Fan was talking with the Sect Leader but kept poking holes in his attitude.
And the problem was that it was all true. It was Sect Leader Ling’s home yet he started shouting at Zhuo Fan. It mattered not if Zhuo Fan was a spy, not when he was dissatisfied with the Sea Bright Sect.
Unlike Zhuo Fan, he gave no respect to the Sect Leader.
And since the Sect Leader wasn’t some nobody but the Sect Leader of the strongest sect in northern lands, the same man he was relying on as well…
Executive Cao’s face twitched hard, looking pained as he regarded Bu Xingyun’s dark face, “Sect Leader, I-I didn’t mean…”
“You’re talking to the wrong person!” Bu Xingyun spoke coldly.
Executive Cao bowed to Ling Yuntian, “Sect Leader Ling, forgive me. Please don’t believe this man’s nonsense. How could I ever disregard the head of the sects in northern lands, Sea Bright Sect? I was just caught in the moment…”
“Fine, fine, Executive Cao is an impulsive man. I understand, ha-ha-ha…” Ling Yuntian dismissed his worries as he smiled.
Zhuo Fan cocked an eyebrow.
[The old guy really is kind to not even be irked by that. Sea Bright Sect’s name as the best sect in northern lands isn’t unfounded after all. Just look at their Sect Leader.]
If the head was weak the rest would crumble.
[With the Sect Leader so collected, it’s only natural that the Sea Bright Sect became the one to lead the other five sects in northern lands.]
Zhuo Fan stared into those kind eyes and felt unease, having failed to stir his emotions and lead the talks.
[The danger comes not from Executive Cao nor Bu Xingyun, but Sect Leader Ling…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1008 - 1008, Leading
chapters.content:
Chapter 1008, Leading
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Bu Xingyun never let Zhuo Fan out of his sight, staring with a murderous gaze and clenched fists.
He only listened to Executive Cao’s account and brought him here to recognize the culprit to use some excuse to make it better for his sect.
The five sects of northern lands were doing fine so far so how come you just had to poke a central area Sword King to get your home wasted? Was it bad leadership, or no leadership? Just hearing it would irk his mood.
There was also the matter of reputation, which had received a serious blow. Only he had his sect which became ruined under his lead and would be lauded as a laughingstock for years to come, if not eternity.
He had to think of something, anything. Something along the lines of giving himself for the good of northern lands, fighting tooth and nail with central area’s spies, only to be betrayed and ending up in this sorry state.
Now the joke would catch a heroic vibe that would turn jeers into calls of respect, and it would be the grounds for extra support in recovering as well.
This was the script he wanted to play. Catch the spy, get the reward and restore the sect to shut everyone up.
Though it seemed that someone was improvising in his little act, shifting the focus of the play. Executive Cao just spoke up and Zhuo Fan mocked him for disrespecting Sea Bright Sect, having no manners.
The problem was, it affected him as well by association since he was the Sect Leader. As he also started ranting without Ling Yuntian’s accord, but Ling Yuntian was nice enough to keep mute about it.
But he already tasted his disrespect and felt their unkind attitude for Sea Bright Sect.
[You can’t follow simple etiquette as a Sect Leader and executive while a mere merchant can? I can only assume from this that you got destroyed for very good reasons, provoking the other into attacking with your arrogance. Loose tongues end lives.]
He not only gained nothing but lost instead, falling out of favor with the big boss. Bu Xingyun’s anger surged as consequence, from seeing Zhuo Fan as a pawn to use in his favor to hating his guts.
He glared hard at Zhuo Fan then spoke to Ling Yuntian. “Sect Leader Ling, my executive has gotten ahead of himself and I’ll be sure to address this back at the sect. But Steward Qian has yet to answer his questions. Would it be possible for Sect Leader Ling to help?”
“Ha-ha-ha, that is why we’re here.”
Ling Yuntian laughed and still spoke on a kind tone while saluting, “Steward Qian is such a courteous man. Having just arrived at my sect, I should play the host and honor your, but some problems have appeared that need Steward Qian’s input. I can only ask that you forgive my insistence.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “You’re too kind, Sect Leader Ling. It’s my honor to be of any help to you.”
“Yeah, Sect Leader, Steward Qian has bowed alongside me before the great gates. He is a respectful man and is sure to not mind this slight inconvenience.”
Dai Qianchou at the side bowed and said.
Anyone else would become suspicious.
[What’s his relationship with Qian Fan? Why is he taking his side?]
But he wasn’t speaking for Qian Fan at all, reporting instead to Sect Leader Ling of his equally respectful demeanor that he reciprocated with at everyone’s salute.
Just because Zhuo Fan had bowed with Dai Qianchou before the gates, Dai Qianchou spoke up so that Sect Leader would keep this in mind.
Otherwise, with Qian Fan being a mere merchant, the others could’ve easily pushed him for answers.
Now however, Ling Yuntian was present as well and Bu Xingyun couldn’t use force.
Zhuo Fan’s act was a minor one, yet the effect was grand, gaining Sea Bright Sect’s protection.
This became evident with Ling Yuntian’s following words, “Steward Qian is thoughtful…”
Bu Xingyun’s face twitched, looking at the three of them with a sigh. Knowing force wouldn’t help him here, he would have to use guile, giving Executive Cao a look.
The executive caught on and started shouting, “Qian, I want an honest answer. When the Sun Sea Sect was destroyed, did you draw that witch, Frigid Rain Sword King over?”
“Frigid Rain Sword King?”
Zhuo Fan looked shocked, “I never met her so how could I’ve drew her?”
Executive Cao sneered, “You’re still lying? Then answer this. Didn’t you say that when you were delivering goods to our sect that a central area spy was following you?”
“Yes!”
“Then you asked me to go grab the spy, right?”
“Uh, I guess?” Zhuo Fan muttered with a frown and a hesitant nod.
Pa!
Executive Cao clapped in success, “Ha-ha-ha, yes, that’s right! We went to capture the spy but it turned out to be Frigid Rain Sword King from the central area. This led her to attack our sect, slaughtering everyone. If you didn’t draw the witch, who did? Sect Leader, Sect Leader Ling, everything’s clear now. I ask that you seize this spy and find out what else has he been leaking through thorough interrogation!”
“Guard, arrest this man! Throw him in prison and activate the barriers so he can’t escape!” Bu Xingyun shouted eagerly.
Dai Qianchou cleared his voice with a bow, “Sect Leader Bu, you’re in Sea Bright Sect…”
“Oh, right, it’s Sect Leader Ling’s right to issue this order. Forgive me, I forgot myself, Sect Leader Ling.” Waking up from his blunder, Bu Xingyun apologized.
Ling Yuntian gave a careless wave but his words seemed to say otherwise, “Sect Leader Bu, we all make mistakes and slip, but as Sect Leaders, we must remember that while being hasty is one thing, and the value of life is another. I only hope that you will work to correct your impulses.”
Bu Xingyun shuddered, knowing Ling Yuntian was chiding him, but was forced to nod.
“As Executive Cao gave his version, it should now be Steward Qian’s turn. Steward Qian has shown hesitation just now so you must have a different opinion, ha-ha-ha…”
Ling Yuntian ignored him and gave Zhuo Fan the right to speak with a bright smile, and the chance to turn it around.
Bu Xingyun’s face sank, but was helpless.
Zhuo Fan bowed and looked grateful as he smiled at the smug Executive Cao, “Executive Cao was right, but there are a few parts I feel that were left out that leaves room for interpretation. Allow me to fill the gaps.
“Executive Cao would you kindly answer me whether or not I was the one who approached you about the spies when I delivered the goods? Have I asked Executive Cao explicitly to go capture the spy?”
“Uh, well…”
Executive Cao hesitated and Bu Xingyun glared, “Spit it out! Did you not insist that he led the witch to us? Why are you stammering then?”
“Yes. Sect Leader, when you wanted to learn about this very quickly, I was being concise, thus leaving some random details out…”
“Random? Like?” Bu Xingyun glared at him.
Executive Cao’s lips quivered, not knowing how to say it. Zhuo Fan laughed and bowed, “Sect Leader Bu, it’s better for me to tell what happened in detail. The fault lies with my caravan. On that day, the central area spy had set her eyes on us and destroyed one of our carriages. So when we arrived at your sect, we only delivered half. We explained what happened and asked for extra days to bring the rest.”
“Is that right?” Bu Xingyun turned to his executive.
Executive Cao nodded, “Yes, that’s exactly right.”
“In other words, isn’t it their fault for failing to guard the goods?” Bu Xingyun asked with doubt.
Scratching his head, Executive Cao gave an awkward nod.
Zhuo Fan interjected, “May I continue?”
“Go ahead…”
Bu Xingyun found no issue and waved at him to resume.
But this in fact helped Zhuo Fan in leaving his own tiny, but crucial, detail, “Executive Cao then permitted us to come back with the rest of the goods and we left. Later I heard a huge ruckus and the world shaking with lighting covering the skies. There were shouts as well, but we were so scared we chose to flee at once…”
“Wait, that’s not how it went…”
“How then?”
“I couldn’t just let you leave when you only gave us half the goods. It’s you who said that you have someone following you and that catching him will earn us a great commendation. Did you not say that these goods are nothing compared to that?” Executive Cao rushed to ask.
Zhuo Fan nodded after a pause, “Yes, and then?”
“Then I let you go.”
“Since we couldn’t give you the goods, how come you let us go?”
“What nonsense! What’s more important, some lost goods or catching the spy? I let you go to draw him out and then grab him!”
“Did you then? Half the credit is mine!”
“As if! What credit is there to share when up against a Sword King? More like share a jail cell! Uh-oh…” Executive Cao grunted to a stop, realizing his slip.
Zhuo Fan smirked, “Hear that? We were bait. They went to grab the spy. How did we go from being on the same side to becoming a central area spy?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1009 - 1009, Blunder
chapters.content:
Chapter 1009, Blunder
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“The bait and hunter work together in capturing the enemy, so how come it turned into a central area spy, Sect Leader Bu?”
Ling Yuntian smiled, teasing, “It seems to me that the Qian caravan was more like the Sun Sea Sect’s spy instead, ha-ha-ha…”
Bu Xingyun’s face fell, glaring at his executive, “Executive Cao, when I had you punished for your gross misdemeanor, you said you were played, that the Qian caravan is a central area spy. Why then do I now hear that you two worked together in capturing a Sword King, thus unleashing a calamity upon the sect?”
“Sect Leader Bu, the capturing of the Sword King falls all on Executive Cao. Please don’t drag us into this when we know nothing of it.” Zhuo Fan interjected quickly, to make his position known.
Executive Cao’s face twitched in anger, losing his temper, “Your sly words lured me into this mess! I would never make such a grave mistake otherwise!”
“Executive Cao, loose tongues end lives. I lured you?”
“It’s all your fault for telling me your tail is a spy that I sent a team to capture her!”
“Ha-ha, well isn’t this funny. You’re one of the five sects in northern lands, Sun Sea Sect, in charge of keeping these lands safe. You’re now saying that after having lost a carriage and being followed should be kept all to myself instead? You might’ve neglected to report my findings, but I had done my duty by telling you!”
Zhuo Fan sneered, then turned to Ling Yuntian, “Sect Leader Ling, am I wrong in any way? If it were a matter of luring, then no one would ever report on the enemy movements to the sect and plunge northern lands into hell.”
Ling Yuntian bobbed his head, “Hear hear, patriotic, responsible, and furthermore, when your own clan’s goods end up ruined, who wouldn’t report? This goes double in these times, with northern lands on the edge.”
“Sect Leader Ling is wise!”
Zhuo Fan gave a bow and turned to Executive Cao, “Furthermore, there were rumors going around that Sun Sea Sect is actually cowardly and didn’t think my report would ever amount to much so I omitted it from you at first. But with you questioning the loss of half the goods, I had no choice but to be honest. It was the only way for you to leave me be.”
Executive Cao’s face twitched harder, with Bu Xingyun darkening by the second.
Zhuo Fan’s passionate speech had simply been accusatory of the Sun Sea Sect. What was worse, this happened in front of Ling Yuntian and so he could do nothing to retaliate, only twitching as he tried to bottle up that anger.
Executive Cao’s heart sank looking at Sect Leader’s sinister face. He had to do anything to get Qian Fan to take the fall or he’d be the one to get it in the end. Finding central area spies was no longer the issue here, but giving his Sect Leader’s self-respect back and letting loose.
“Qian Fan, we don’t need your flimsy opinions. You might be right about the report but what about later? You proposed that we catch the spy together and share credit. It’s your enticing offer that made me act and mess with that witch. It’s all due to you that she came to Sun Sea Sect!”
“Yeah, I did mention this to you, but how did you reply?”
Zhuo Fan raved, “Having lost half the goods, I did not know how to make up for the loss. I planned on doing it alone, but you just had to push the issue. In the end, you frickin’ acted on your own. Are you going to say I made you do that too? If it were an average spy, the success would’ve propelled your career. Would you have come to bother me then?
“Just cause you got bad luck and suffered for it, you want to drag me down with you. Is that how you think the world works, sharing tribulations but not success? I first lost a carriage and to add insult to injury, you stole my credit, what the hell!”
Zhuo Fan rained on Executive Cao, with the conviction in his innocence. He got Executive Cao to shake under the assault and with no comeback.
Because all that Zhuo Fan raved about was damn true. Even his scheme back then was refuted and he had no grounds on which to fight back.
Though he was no fool and nodded, “But you said your dozen guards have chased the spy away. That witch was anything but weak! Your words got me into this mess!”
“Humph, yeah, we had the spy surrounded but then she escaped with her faster speed. Am I wrong?”
“There’s no way Frigid Rain Sword King got surrounded by just your team!”
“How would I know? Maybe she liked to toy with us first. Who knows what twisted hobbies some experts have?” Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes.
“While in your case, you cut her off so she didn’t run, ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan smirked, hitting where it hurt the most. Bu Xingyun shook from rage. Executive Cao looked aggrieved as he peeked at his Sect Leader.
Dai Qianchou chuckled and bowed, “Sect Leader, Sect Leader Bu, it’s all clear now. Ever since Invincible Sword slipped into our northern lands six months ago, Frigid Rain Sword King had to have been following his orders to stay hidden. While she didn’t move against a trade caravan, only following it, its dozen guards would also find it impossible to catch her as well, thus making her feel free.
“But then, Sea Bright Sect blocked her way all of a sudden, giving her a hard time to flee. She would thus have no choice but to retaliate, causing this catastrophe. Baili Yutian’s team was hardly sighted ever since they came to our lands, having their own plans. This disaster wouldn’t have happened if they let her be.”
“Yeah, Invincible Sword’s team has to have a plan for staying low and wouldn’t want to make such a huge scene. The way the Sun Sea Sect got ruined is highly unusual.”
Ling Yuntian nodded, then said, “Executive Cao, how many times did you have Frigid Rain Sword King surrounded in the end?”
Executive Cao’s brow shook, muttering as he counted, “I had sent fifty Soul Harmony experts and when my men died I went to Elder Li, who also sent fifty Genesis Stage experts. When they died, we went to Venerable Ma who went himself along with ten other peak Genesis Stage experts. Uhm, that makes it three. Then the woman came to us…’
Executive Cao’s action had everyone dumbstruck.
Pa!
Executive Cao found himself flying from that hard slap, landing a good ten meters away with a bloody mouth.
As he got back to his feet, he found two teeth had fallen. But then, he noticed Bu Xingyun’s rage as he glared at him in fury.
“God damn it, you useless sack of puss! You had her attacked thrice? Well of course she’d be pissed! Not just the witch, but even I would’ve been fuming!”
Bu Xingyun’s face twitched and shook all over as he raved, “You damn bastards, how can you be so retarded? Fifty died then another fifty, first Soul Harmony experts then Genesis experts, yet you still haven’t learned? You just sent men to fetch instead of at least knowing the opponent? Then you had the enemy come ruining the sect so you pin it on some impossible spy? Of course my sect gets destroyed, especially with you morons in it!”
Bu Xingyun lamented.
Ling Yuntian chuckled and waved his hand, “Sect Leader Bu, please calm down. While it’s all just a misunderstanding, it’s good that everything’s clear now. I was wondering why Baili Yutian’s team would stay hidden all this time, only to enact such a huge disaster later on, then hide again. It’s obvious now, just desserts. Oops, I slipped as well, sorry…”
Bu Xingyun’s cheek twitched and he gave him an annoyed look for his own mistake being used on him, but then he turned apathetic.
Ling Yuntian cupped his hands, “Steward Qian, the misunderstanding is now obvious. Forgive me for any slight that I might have caused. I ask that the Qian clan wouldn’t let this minor event come between us, still working hard for the good of northern lands.”
“I am grateful to Sea Bright Sect being fair and giving me justice in this matter. It is I who should apologize, Sect Leader, having let the matter get to me.” Zhuo Fan hastily spoke.
Ling Yuntian waved it off, “Ha-ha-ha, it’s nothing. Steward Qian is a courteous man and a true man, to my liking. I have rarely seen men of your quality even among all the lands, Steward Qian.”
“Sect Leader is too kind.”
Zhuo Fan gave another deep bow, “Then may I take my leave?”
“Please.”
Ling Yuntian gestured with a constant smile. Zhuo Fan cupped his hands again before leaving.
Bu Xingyun eyed Ling Yuntian, having lost all confidence, bowing to him then taking Executive Cao away.
Dai Qianchou appeared once more next to Ling Yuntian moments later, “A farce, ha-ha-ha…”
“That remains to be seen.” Ling Yuntian spoke gravely, having lost his smile.
Dai Qianchou asked curiously, “Sect Leader, wasn’t the matter clear? The so-called spies never existed.”
“Yeah, but it’s too obvious and that makes me uneasy.”
Ling Yuntian’s eyes shone, “You think in any confrontation, there’s only black and white? Humph, on one hand is the Sect Leader of the Sun Sea Sect and on the other a mere steward of the Qian clan. They couldn’t be more different. But do you really believe that steward would ever have the ability to control the way the confrontation went?”
Dai Qianchou gasped, “Sect Leader means…”
“There’s more to that steward than he lets on.” Ling Yuntian’s eyes shone with conviction.
Outside the hall, Zhuo Fan was on his way back when a chill went through him, “Curses, I’ve just gone to clear my name but showed off too much. What kind of merchant would act like that? I treated those two like rabid dogs! Ugh, what a blunder…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1010 - 1010, Well Met, Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 1010, Well Met, Again
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
What normal merchant out there refuted a Sect Leader?
[I got Ling Yuntian’s favor from the start and I just had to miss a few beats now and then, acting like I was pushed around, and then he would’ve gotten me out of it.]
[But now that this win was too perfect, it only raised suspicion. Sigh, it all comes down to how perceptive Ling Yuntian is. But no random steward should ever be so tough…]
The more he thought the more worried he became, ending up with a sigh as he made his way back. He had really been careless just now…
“M-mister Gu?”
The sudden call snapped him out from his thoughts.
Pausing, Zhuo Fan frowned and his face fell.
Who else could it be but one of his old pals from the central area?
Freezing on the spot, he turned to find the very familiar miss of the Shangguan clan staring at him.
It also worked to make him wonder what she would be doing here of all places.
[Wasn’t she going back to eastern lands? What’s she doing here? They got their sword back so they ought to be home.]
Then it hit him, the four lands alliance. As the Shangguan clan was the leader of the eastern lands, they of course offered help to northern lands in fighting off the enemy. Them being here was natural.
Or better yet, he should’ve been prepared for it, but the sudden meet came out of nowhere, leaving him floored. With the Shangguan clan knowing everything about him, his Qian cover was bound to be blown.
Shangguan Qingyan lit up with unspeakable joy, “Mister Gu, it’s really you! I thought you looked familiar from afar…”
Zhuo Fan moved with speed and precision, landing next to her and covering her mouth.
Shangguan Qingyan jerked but then noticed Zhuo Fan’s sneaky look. There was no trace of fear in her heart, only giving a silly smile, while her eyes basked in the joy of reunion.
Zhuo Fan gave the secluded forest path a once over for anyone else being around then took Shangguan Qingyan deeper into the woods.
Now looking at her excited gaze, he rolled his eyes and let go of her, speaking in a serious tone, “How come I run into you again?”
“Yeah, what a coincidence meeting you as well, Mister Gu, ha-ha-ha…” Blushing hard, Shangguan Qingyan gave a shy smile and looked bashfully away.
Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan stared at her as he mulled before speaking, “Miss Shangguan, I am so happy to see you as well!”
“Really? I think so too!” Shangguan Qingyan lit up and gazed into his deep eyes with a wide smile.
Zhuo Fan rushed to settle her mood, “This isn’t the time to reminisce. I still have important things to do so I must be going.”
“So soon? But we just met!”
“Yes, the matter is urgent, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Also, I’m not Gu Yifan now, so act like you never saw me. You must never ever mention anything about me to anyone or my head would roll. Are we clear?”
Shangguan Qingyan paused, then smiled, “You’re not Gu Yifan? Does that mean it’s a fake name? Then who are you? Tell me or I’m telling dad that Gu Yifan giving him sleepless nights is here, in the northern lands.”
“I gave him sleepless nights? What was he thinking about?”
Zhuo Fan’s brow furrowed, but then shook his head. This was no time to think about some random stuff. So making sure the coast was still clear, “Miss Shangguan, this is serious. I have a secret mission here that no one must know about.”
“Are you up against northern lands now? That won’t do. We’re here to help them…”
“I’m not interested in northern lands. I won’t meddle in their affairs, I promise.”
“Then what are you here for?”
“It doesn’t concern you, just promise me you’ll keep my secret, that you never saw me. Once I finish my mission, I’ll just leave with none the wiser.” Zhuo Fan vowed.
Shangguan Qingyan pouted, “You’re saying you’re gonna leave without drawing attention?”
“Cross my heart and hope to die.”
“I don’t believe it. What about me?” Grumbling with a lowered head, Shangguan Qingyan teared up, “You slip in then slip out so that not even I will be startled?”
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched and sighed.
Anyone else would be wrecked with fear from being involved with such a mastermind like him, then guilt eating them up inside from not reporting.
[But this chick is more worried about not saying goodbye when leaving.]
[Just what’s going through her head? What’s so important about seeing her before I go? It’s not like I’m taking her.]
[Just what does she get out of a fake promise?]
Giving her a long look, Zhuo Fan sighed, “Alright, I’ll drop by before leaving.”
“Really? Does that mean since only I know you came and left, then only I know what you did here?” Shangguan Qianyan grew exuberant once more.
Zhuo Fan cocked his head, “Uh, I guess. But what’s with that twisted logic? Anyone else that knew this would’ve had me exposed…”
“It’s all the same, since you can only trust me in this place. I won’t ever sell you out!” Shangguan Qingyan giggled, hugging his arm.
Zhuo Fan;s brow shook, glancing at her, “Yeah, I guess I trust you. Who else am I to trust if not the one who ran into me? Ha-ha-ha…”
[Besides, if anything happened to the miss of the Shangguan clan, it would draw unwanted attention and soon I’ll be found out. The best way to keep quiet is to silence everyone, if they were a random person that is.]
[No, young Sanzi risked his life for her. Even if she’s a nobody, I can’t treat young Sanzi’s sacrifice so frivolously.]
Zhuo Fan muled things over, settling on letting this miss Shangguan live. That meant he had to speed up his operation to minimize the already increasing risk.
“Miss Shangguan, we promised to forget about ever meeting and ever knowing each other. Farewell.”
Extricating his arm from her tight hug, Zhuo Fan gave a dry smile and ran. Shangguan Qingyan shouted after only two steps, “Gu Yifan, stop right there!”
Zhuo Fan froze, looking back with a bright smile, “What else can I do for you, miss Shangguan?”
“You still haven’t told me your real name. You’re going nowhere until you do!” Shangguan Qingyan smiled.
Zhuo Fan frowned, “Uh, my name’s Qian Fan, ha-ha-ha…”
“Fake for sure, humph!” Grumbling, Shangguan Qingyan rolled her eyes.
Zhuo Fan shrugged, “Anything I say you’ll think it’s fake so what’s the point in saying it?”
“Don’t say it then and I won’t ask again.” Shangguan Qingyan’s eyes twitched and then she grew quiet, “But, I do want to know one thing.”
“Ask away, but it’s up to you if you believe me.”
“Is young Sanzi alright?”
Ugh!
Zhuo Fan’s face fell, taking a deep breath, “He’s still alive, but unconscious. I came here to save him.”
“You sneaked into the Sea Bright Sect for young Sanzi? How are you going to save him?”
“Don’t worry about it. Just know that I must succeed.”
“Oh, I see. Then you can rest assured that I’ll never tell on you.” Shangguan Qingyan turned serious as she promised, “For you or for young Sanzi, I will keep your secret!”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “I believe you will do it for young Sanzi.”
“Then I’ll go get ready.”
“Alright, till next time!”
Shangguan Qingyan was no longer difficult this time around, watching Zhuo Fan with hopeful eyes, that he would pull through. Zhuo Fan nodded then flew away and off this island.
Shangguan Qingyan took a deep breath and had a sweet smile on her face as she went in another direction…

chapters.title: Chapter 1011 - 1011, Northern Lands’ Best Disciple
chapters.content:
Chapter 1011, Northern Lands’ Best Disciple
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Spring is in the air, with the bloom of flowers and the chirping of birds…”
In a quiet little home, Shangguan Qingyan’s voice was heard as she sang, skipping around in a very good mood.
“Oh, Uncle Shangguan said that young miss Shangguan has been down this past year and I thought this silly sister was bothered with something, so I came to help. Now I see that sister is in good spirits. I must’ve gotten worried over nothing, ha-ha-ha…”
Shangguan Qingyan paused and looked back with a smile.
Before her was the southern lands’ Immortal Healer Murong Xue and her servant, Zhui’er.
“Sister Murong, you’re here as well?” Shangguan Qingyan cheered and jumped in Murong Xue’s embrace.
Murong Xue patted her soft hair, “With northern lands in danger and the other lands helping, southern lands is not about to stay behind either!”
“Young miss Shangguan, young miss had missed you so much. When we came last time to northern lands to get medicine, she has always wished to go to eastern lands and see you, young miss, again. But the northern lands came under threat and Clan Head had to rush here. Young miss wanted to visit you in eastern lands, then come to northern lands with Shangguan clan. Only that in the eastern lands we realized you’ve already gone to northern lands so young miss rushed here on the double. She made quite the detour.”
Zhui’er smiled at the two girls as she told them about her hard journey.
Shangguan Qingyan was touched and broke the hug to look into Murong Xue’s clear eyes as she grabbed her soft hands, “You’ve been through so much big sister, how could I repay you?”
“This is nothing to you and Uncle Shangguan’s hardship of taking back the Soaring Sword from the central area.”
Murong Xue glared at Shangguan Qingyan, “Little sister, do I mean so little to you to not tell me about this huge matter about the stolen sword? Our four lands alliance aside, with our two clans so close, we would never have stood by during your plight. I just had to go to Shangguan clan myself in the eastern lands to know you’ve braved such terrible dangers before making a detour to northern lands and for the Sea Bright Sect without so much as a word of notice. Thank heavens you’re all alright. I wouldn’t have known how to take your loss then. Wouldn’t that be an insult to our clans’ close friendship?”
Shangguan Qingyan gave the sullen Murong Xue a tight hug, “Don’t be angry, big sis. It’s all my fault for not telling you. But I’m not the only one who deserves your anger.”
“Who?”
“Dad.”
Shangguan Qingyan giggled, “After Shangguan Feiyun stole the Soaring Sword, someone proposed that we join hands with the Murong clan, but dad refused. He said that it’s our clan’s problem and not to involve others, as it would earn their ridicule once this matter was out. How are we to provide support when we can’t even keep our sword safe? Won’t that disgrace our clan?”
Murong Xue sighed and shook her head, “That’s the Uncle Shangguan I know, obsessed with appearances.”
“Right? Big sister Murong, be sure to teach my stubborn dad a valuable lesson.”
“How could I? He’s a senior and we are juniors. How can we meddle in their affairs? Also…”
Murong Xue chuckled and sighed, “Uncle Shangguan must’ve hesitated out of concern for our clan. With southern lands having no conflict yet with the central area and a relative peace in place between us and the Sword Star Empire, I thus could still move about in their home. But by joining the matter of the stolen sword, it would bring many troubles to us. Shangguan clan is a righteous clan and would never cause misfortune upon another. This is something I appreciate about Uncle Shangguan’s character and pain.”
Shangguan Qingyan nodded in understanding, “Yeah, Shangguan is righteous and the Murong Clan is filled with justice. Despite being apart, we are the prime example for good in the five lands. How else would our two clans would’ve grown so close? Ha-ha-ha, that’s what I call partners in notoriety…”
Ugh!
Murong Xue smiled at first then her face twitched as Shangguan Qingyan finished, whining, “Sis Yan’er, what was that?”
“Uh, nothing, nothing. I meant to say with valor and justice, thick as thieves…oops.” Covering her mouth, Shangguan Qingyan gave Murong Xue an awkward look, growing angry, “It’s all that meanie’s fault for twisting my views…”
Murong Xue frowned and teased, “A meanie? Oh, the one Uncle Shangguan told me about that you’ve been pining for for a year now.”
“Dad told you?”
Shangguan Qingyan blushed hard with a lowered head but a silly smile.
Murong Xue nodded, “Uncle Shangguan avoided specifics, only saying that you had a fling in the central area and turned sulky. But the way I hear it now, it might not be as simple as a fling. Dear little sister, you’re head over heels, completely lovesick, ha-ha-ha…”
“As if!”
“Why not?”
Murong Xue teased, “You used to be such a demure lady and now you can’t even speak straight. You must’ve picked up his speaking habits, ha-ha-ha. I bet your man isn’t just anyone and knows how to be blunt as well.”
Shangguan Qingyan blushed harder, “No way, he’s just a bit harsh with words…”
“What about that cousin of yours, Shangguan Yulin, who used to stick to you like glue? How does he compare?”
“Humph, that traitor isn’t worth his shoes!” Shangguan Qingyan sneered.
Murong Xue shook her head, “Love is blind. You’re truly hopeless. I heard from Uncle Shangguan that Shangguan Yulin has a bad character but he was well known in the lands for his looks and strength. If he can’t even carry the guy’s shoes, won’t that mean your man is beyond outstanding? Ha-ha-ha, I don’t believe there’s anyone as great as Shangguan Yulin. Love is in the eyes of the beholder. Little sis is so in love she thinks the world of him.”
Shangguan Yulin’s eyes shook and said with defiance, “Big sis, you’re too ignorant. The entire Shangguan clan witnessed his ability. Go ask dad if you don’t believe me, see how much dad’s praising him. That traitor Shangguan Yulin is nothing to him.”
“Aren’t you now arguing with me about his overestimated greatness? You even dare talk back to me, saying that I’m blind? Damn girl, want me to knock some sense into you?”
Murong Xue raised her hands with a sly grin and unleashed her tickling attack on the lovestruck girl.
Shangguan Qingyan dodged while laughing for her to stop, “Big sister Murong, please stop! I won’t say it! You’re not blind, you’re narrow-minded!
“Hey, did you pick only his bad habits? This goes to show he isn’t anything good. Yet you’re still saying it?” Murong Xue swung while Shangguan Qingyan kept dodging in good humor.
The girls enjoyed themselves with Zhui’er giggling at the side in encouragement, “Young miss, miss Shangguan, that’s it! Keep at it, hi-hi-hi…”
“The red bean trees in the south to grow/ By spring they yield in heaps above./ I hope you pluck in plenty soon/ Because it is the gift of love.”
In the middle of their fun, a poem drowned the two girls’ shrieks, unable to disturb the speaker’s resounding voice.
The girls halted their fun and looked at the entrance.
Thump~
A man in a long robe and tied hair, a most refined scholar in demeanor and pace, walked in holding a snow plum flower in his hand.
Murong Xue started at his appearance, “Ouyang Changqing, you’re out?”
“Northern lands’ best disciple Ouyang Changqing?”
Shangguan Qingyan giggled, “I’ve been to northern lands a couple of times but never had met you till now.”
Ouyang Changqing gave a bow and smiled, “Young miss Shangguan, I have been most of the time in seclusion. It’s only natural to have yet to see me.”
“Sister Xue, it’s been a while. This snow plum flower is for you.”
Ouyang Changqing smiled as he presented the flower with respect and a smile.
Murong Xue did not take it, “It’s too soon to be calling me like that.”
“How so when it’s just right?” Ouyang Changqing beamed, “Now that father has healed from his wounds and your brother is a guest in the Sea Bright Sect, I shall ask father to request your brother to give me your hand in marriage. Then we can have an early wedding, ha-ha-ha…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1012 - 1012, Suspicion
chapters.content:
Chapter 1012, Suspicion
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
[What?]
Shangguan Qingyan looked in shock from Murong Xue and Ouyang Changqing, before settling on a smile, “Big sis, you’ve been hiding your sweetheart all this time from me while even teasing me about my own. Now we get to celebrate your wedding with rounds of drinks!”
“What’s with that nonsense?”
Murong Xue glared at her then looked into Ouyang Changqing’s hopeful gaze, “Brother Ouyang, have you forgotten our promise?”
“Of course not.”
Ouyang Changqing spoke with pride, “Grasping the heavens, shaking the five lands, standing above everyone, and only below one!”
Murong Xue smirked, “Then, brother Ouyang, which of these four have you achieved?”
“While I have only fulfilled one, the other three are just a matter of time with this head start. While marriage is a way off, we can at least get engaged.”
“My, how certain you are. What gives you such confidence?” Murong Xue toyed.
Ouyang Changqing had his head held high, his chest out, as he said, “It’s obvious I’ll grasp heaven. You know who my father is, the strongest in northern lands, Ouyang Lingtian, wielding the Heaven Sealing Sword! Won’t the divine sword be passed down to me?”
“The five lands’ divine swords aren’t necessarily passed down in one’s family, but based on ability.” Murong Xue huffed.
Ouyang Changqing gave an understanding nod, his pride unaffected, “You’re right, but if we are to leave father out of this, who am I exactly? The winner of the northern lands’ great disciple competition. I am now the best disciple in northern lands and later shall take my father’s place in becoming the best in northern lands. Sister Xue has to agree.”
Murong Xue flicked her head away but still relinquished a nod.
Ouyang Changqing grinned, “As for shocking the lands, it will come with becoming the best in northern lands.”
“And as for being under one man?”
Shangguan Qingyan asked eagerly, “With such high goals, to be still beneath someone, who would that be? Is it that old freak Invincible Sword? Though it’s kinda obvious since he hasn’t been beaten for the last ten thousand years and it’s sure to stay like that for another few thousands.”
Ouyang Changqing mocked, “Young miss Shangguan, you’re totally underestimating me. I am a man destined to cleave the heavens. Once I gain insight into Heaven Sealing Sword’s sword art, his invincible status will be a thing of the past, humph…”
“See, that’s the type I hate the most, overconfident to the extreme. He’s no different from those prancing wastrels everywhere. Saying that you’re above Invincible Sword without even meeting him is sheer lunacy.”
Murong Xue’s face was hard as she made eye contact with Shangguan Qingyan.
Shangguan Qingyan bobbed her head, looking at him eagerly still, “Since even Invincible Sword is beneath you, then who will be the one above?”
“Isn’t it obvious?”
Ouyang Lingtian cupped his hands at the sky with a straight face, “Family ties are most important. No matter how godlike I become, I shall remain father’s son. Only my father can stand above me. As for standing above everyone, that’ll come natural with the defeat of Invincible Sword, ha-ha-ha…”
Ugh!
Shangguan Qingyan’s heart sank as she looked at his obnoxious zealotry, feeling Murong Xue’s pain, “Now I know what you mean by the four goals being simple. Besides you and your dad, everything is relative.”
“Not relative, but destined to happen.” Ouyang Changqing spoke heavily.
Murong Xue rolled her eyes, “Then do come again when the relative becomes reality.”
“Sister Yan’er, let’s go inside and forget about this bore.” Murong Xue threw the snow plum flower, taking Shangguan Qingyan’s arm and walking inside, “I’d much rather have you tell me more about your man than listen to his obnoxious bragging…”
Shangguan Qingyan shrugged and followed after her, having no choice. Ouyang Changqing cried from behind, “Sister Xue, I will succeed, believe me!”
[Believe your foot!]
Murong Xue cursed in her mind.
“Changqing, I believe you!” A laughter came from nowhere as a familiar figure suddenly grabbed Ouyang Changqing’s arm, “Changqing, it’s been years since we saw each other and my how much you’ve grown, already in the 8th layer Soul Harmony Stage. There’s no disciple like you in the other three lands. The sky’s the limit, I tell you, ha-ha-ha…”
Ouyang Changqing lit up, having his ego stoked, “Brother Murong, it’s been a long time. I missed you as well!”
Murong Xue paused and looked at Shangguan Qingyan with a sigh, “I just don’t know what brother sees in him to even give his little sister away.”
“Xue’er, did you say something?”
“Nothing. Now that brother is here, does that mean you found clues to track them?” Murong Xue still held Shangguan Qingyan as she went to give a slight bow.
The smiling Murong Lie suddenly turned dark, “Don’t remind me. Those three are like ghosts, vanishing off the face of the earth. Sea Cloud Sect had been searching for six months now but still came out empty. They must’ve left that area and all clues are gone, I could only come back.”
“Who are they to have escaped the likes of Ardent Sun Sword God? Are they so great?” Shangguan Qingyan asked curiously.
Ouyang Changqing was also confused, “With brother Murong and the mighty forces of Sea Cloud Sect scouring their domain, they should’ve been found in minutes. How can there be no trace at all? It’s baffling. Brother Murong, would you care to tell me more about them? I shall gather all the men of the five sects and check everyone. We’ll leave no stone unturned, but we’ll definitely find them!”
“No, please don’t. It will only unsettle northern lands more. Invincible Sword’s team is hidden and causing such chaos will only work against us. They’ll use this chance to slip in.”
“Yeah, Xue’er is right. There’s no need to go through such lengths for just three people. Our true enemy is Baili Yutian after all.” Murong Lie gave a hard nod.
Ouyang Changqing pondered and relented.
“Does that mean, brother Murong, that they’re not from the central area? Who are they?” Shangguan Qingyan picked up on Murong Lie’s meaning.
Murong Xue sighed, “The man is as cunning as a demon, causing thousands of casualties in the central area then vanishing without a trace. Now he appeared in northern lands along with an expert that can fight my brother to a standstill. Just what is he up to? We’re yet unsure in his stance regarding the northern lands’ conflict, but he is without a doubt a dangerous element.”
“Not even brother Murong could catch him? Just who is he?” Shangguan Qingyan cried out and Ouyang Changqing looked at him with shock.
Murong Xue was the one to explain still, “I don’t know who he is, just that he left one name in the central area, Gu Yifan.”
[What?]
Shangguan Qingyan gaped, almost thinking out loud. But she caught herself in time, though her face sank.
[How can it be him? Why are the Murongs after him? What now?]
As she was thinking of finding out, Ouyang Changqing made it worse with his sigh, “Just from the name I can tell he’s bad. I never heard a more ugly name.”
“Who in their right mind would use their real name when doing evil anyway?” Murong Xue rolled her eyes at him.
Ouyang Changqing shrugged, “Never mind, since we won’t find him soon, not with a fake name and hiding his trail. I’m better off minding my own search. Brother Murong, want to come along?”
“Who are you searching for?” Murong Xue smirked, “Sect Leader Ling actually trusted someone as shallow as you to find someone suspicious? You’re only going to scare them away!”
Ouyang Changqing’s mood deflated, “Sister Xue, don’t underestimate me. Sect Leader Ling personally asked me to make the inquiries. A caravan just arrived at the sect, one belonging to the Qian clan, one of the three great merchant clans in northern lands. Sect Leader found their steward, Qian Fan, to be odd and asked me to look into him.”
“Qian Fan?”
Shangguan Qingyan paled, having recalled Zhuo Fan saying Qian Fan was his real name. While unclear if that was true, she believed that was the name he was using now.
[Curses, he even said to keep it a secret! Barely any time passed and he’s already under suspicion. Now that Murong brother and sister are after you, what do I do?]
Shangguan Qingyan was consumed by anxiety and worry.
[That damn man always knows how to make me uneasy…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1013 - 1013, Strongest Barrier
chapters.content:
Chapter 1013, Strongest Barrier
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Looking at Shangguan Qingyan so distressed and jittery, everyone gave her an odd look, with Murong Xue asking, “Sister Yan’er, what is it? Something wrong?”
“Uh, no no no, I just recalled something crucial that needs all of your dire attention. It all happened so fast that I suddenly cried out and startled you all. Don’t look at me like that, ha-ha-ha…”
Shangguan Qingyan gave a strained laughter, her eyes shining.
Murong Lie said, “Oh, and here I thought you’re familiar with Steward Qian.”
“Brother Murong, that’s a poor joke. Why would I know a northern lands merchant? Just when brother Ouyang mentioned his name I was reminded of a depressing matter. It’s totally a coincidence, he-he-he…”
Shangguan Qingyan strained to cover it all up, while the rest merely ignored it, “Sister Yan’er, you’re all grown up yet so easily stirred. You should worry about being married off.”
“I’ll never marry, and stay with sister Xue, hi-hi-hi…” Shangguan Qingyan raised an eyebrow while hugging Murong Xue’s arm.
Rubbing her cute little head, Murong Xue smiled back. Murong Lie and Ouyang Changqing looked at the two girls being so close and just shrugged.
Murong Lie then smiled at Shangguan Qingyan, “Sister Yan’er, what’s the dire issue that needs my help? You can just say it.”
“Well…”
Looking hesitant, Shangguan Qingyan faltered as she beamed, “It’s something that dad didn’t want me to say, but recently he’s been worried sick over it that I started worrying as well. Actually…”
Murong Lie turned serious, “Brother Shangguan? It must be grave indeed for not even Shangguan Clan Head to not solve it. Yan’er, tell me everything and maybe I can offer my help.”
“Brother Murong, you must not say a word to dad that I was the one who told you. You know how obsessed he is with appearances…”
Shangguan Qingyan put on a pained look as she spoke the big secret.
Murong Lie and the others listened attentively, with Ouyang Changqing looking hopeful, “Of course, sister Yan’er, we won’t ever mention you. I’m actually very curious to know this secret, especially about such a big clan, he-he-he…”
Shangguan Qingyan rolled her eyes, glaring at him and scrounged up her nose, before sighing, “To be quite frank, brother Ouyang, we might have recovered the Soaring Sword from the central area, but it’s now ruined.”
“What?!”
Murong Lie gasped, “The five divine swords of the lands that can peel steel, cleave heavens, crush the earth, the strongest things in the world, had one of them ended up ruined? Is there actually anyone who can do this?”
“Brother Murong, what I meant to say by that is not the sword itself that is broken, but the sword spirit is sealed and can’t unleash the divine sword’s power. It’s nothing more than a glorified paperweight.”
Shangguan Qingyan sighed, “Dad and the three venerables had been tireless in trying to unseal it for the better part of the year, with no results. The sealing was very strong, leaving nothing they could use. That’s why I wanted to ask brother Murong if you could help dad.”
Murong Lie turned grave and jerked as she called to him. He shouted, “Brother Shangguan is just too foolish. This matter isn’t as simple as having only eastern lands concerned so he could just hide it from us. We all know how terrible Invincible Sword is. Without the Soaring Sword’s help, how could we stop him? Thank you for sharing this with me, or I fear we’d be in the dark even as all three divine swords gathered to fight the old monster. Telling us at the last moment the Soaring Sword is broken would be seriously grave!”
“Changqing, you tell your father to see Shangguan Feixiong. Xue’er, we’re going right now to him and understand the situation. That old man, how can he be so blind? By looking for majesty, he endangers the entire alliance!”
Murong Lie grew annoyed and cursed as he rushed for Shangguan clan’s lodgings. Murong Xue was grave as she followed.
With Danqing Shen taking the western lands’ divine sword, that only left three to fight off Invincible Sword. Now that three became two, stopping that monster was impossible.
He wasn’t just strong by himself, but also wielded a divine weapon as well.
Ouyang Changqing started, then said, “Brother Murong, Sect Leader gave me a job to do…”
“Isn’t it just a check-up on a suspicious person? That can wait. The sealed Soaring Sword takes precedence. Go tell your father!” Murong Lie shouted back as he flew away, with Murong Xue and Zhui’er catching up. Ouyang Changqing nodded quickly and went his own way too.
Only Shangguan Qingyan was left standing there all alone.
Giving sneak peeks around, Shangguan Qingyan darted away too, but in a completely different direction than the rest.
[Father, sorry, you’re the only excuse I could think of. I have to warn that devil, that he’s about to be found out…]
Zhuo Fan had left the highest floating island and after asking around, he flew to the lowest island to find his team.
In a lone house in a secluded place, the occasional sea breeze blew, invigorating and refreshing.
Having no mood to enjoy the view, Zhuo Fan went right inside the courtyard then used the brass knocker on the large door. A cautious voice responded, “Who is it?”
“It’s me, Steward Qian.”
Zhuo Fan glanced around for any signs of other people and spoke softly.
Creak~
Opened just a crack, a shifty face came into view, perking up at recognizing his boss, opened the door and welcomed him in.
Zhuo Fan rushed right in and once the door closed behind him, he looked around the room to find everything accounted for.
“Did anything happen?”
“Nothing to us, only you’ve been called out by Ling Yuntian for questioning. You didn’t let anything slip, right?” Baili Yuyu stretched and smiled.
Zhuo Fan’s face sank.
Bali Yuyu started and said, “You didn’t! You, with your twisted and insidious mind, that had even the Patriarch flustered into sending me with you couldn’t even deal with one measly Ling Yuntian? What’s wrong with you?”
“It’s easy to handle the old coot since we had no conflict, but Ling Yuntian is a cautious man, with the slightest mistake making him suspicious. What was I supposed to do?”
“Hey, who are you calling an old coot? Say that again!”
“Forget what I said.” At Baili Yuyu’s suddenly savage look, Zhuo Fan shrugged and frowned at the rest, “What about all of you? Have you found anything in the time you’ve been in the Sea Bright Sect?”
Pa!
One guard stepped forward with a bow, “Sir, we’ve been talking with their disciples on our way here and have a grasp of the surroundings. Sea Bright Sect is made up of three floating islands called Beyond Heaven Island, Mid Heaven Island, and Beneath Heaven Island, The highest is where the important figures of the sect reside. The three lands’ experts are also staying there. It is the place where sir has came from just now.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, having understood this.
“The Mid Heaven Island, one in between the other two is where the disciples live and some executives. The disciples of the three lands who came to help are also staying here.”
The man continued, “As for the lowest island, that’s where we are. Common guests are received and outer sect disciples train here.”
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, his eyes shining, “That’s it? Nothing else?”
“Of course there’s more.”
Bali Yuyu cut the man off with a shout, only this time she was dead serious, “Sea Bright Sect is like a huge prison. You can get in but it will be hard to get out, including me.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes widened as he exclaimed, “Why?”
Bali Yuyu was a prideful Sword King that even barged into Sun Sea Sect on a killing spree for blocking her path. She held no fear even when fighting Ardent Sun Sword God, knowing she could escape anytime.
Yet when faced with the Sea Bright Sect, she came out to say it was hard to leave it. This made Zhuo Fan tense and uneasy.
“Sir, the Sea Bright Sect is far scarier than we thought.”
Bali Yuyu remained silent so the man cupped his hand and continued, “Frigid Rain Sword King is right. The Sea Bright Sect has the strongest barrier among all of the sects in the five lands. Not even a Sword King can break it. The minute our covers are blown, we will all be trapped!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1014 - 1014, Crisis
chapters.content:
Chapter 1014, Crisis
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, his eyes filled with doubt, “The strongest barrier, one that even a Sword King can’t breach?”
They all lowered their heads. Zhuo Fan spoke, “Central area is the strongest. Central area has the most talents, with plenty of array masters. Yet they can’t set up the strongest barrier while the barren northern lands can?”
“Well they have that Heaven Sealing divine sword.” Bali Yuyu added.
Zhuo Fan rose an eyebrow, his eyes sharp, “You mean the barrier is connected to the divine sword?”
“That is indeed so, sir.”
The man bowed again, “From our investigation, the Sea Bright Sect’s barrier relies on their divine sword to remain. No one in the lands knows the extent of the divine swords because no one has managed to unleash their full power. But Sea Bright Sect uses arrays to witness the might of their divine sword.”
“The inner disciples told us that the Heaven Sealing Sword remains at the top of the grand hall on Beyond Heaven Island, while not in use. Through many arrays, the Heaven Sealing Sword’s power is being leveraged to protect the sect by forming the strongest barrier. Sir, watch…”
The man opened a window and pointed at the calm sea, “These waters hold the sea demon, of incredible power, defeating the best in northern lands with one strike. It had unleashed sky-high swells that drowned hundreds of Genesis Stage experts. But even this amazing power failed to scratch the sect’s barrier. This place is so safe and at peace all due to the Heaven Sealing Sword’s power. The sword is beyond anyone’s comprehension.”
“After hearing this as well, I went to check out the barrier. Sure enough, not a trace of my Yuan Qi can slip through, having no gaps I can use. I dare say that not even my full power can scratch it.” Bali Yuyu sighed and shook her head, like a hero past his prime.
Looking at the peaceful waters, Zhuo Fan said, “So what you’re saying is that this great barrier isolates the sea demon from the Sea Bright Sect. If I were to venture deeper into the sea and find the sea demon, I need to first break the barrier?”
“Regarding that…” The same guard frowned, “I believe not even the strongest, Baili Yutian, can do…”
“Ahem!”
Bali Yuyu’s icy glare landed on the man, getting his attention as she cleared her throat.
Sometimes it was best to leave her dear Patriarch out of it.
The man flinched and lowered his voice…
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, “We have no choice but to take the Heaven Sealing Sword and break the barrier.”
“Steal the Heaven Sealing Sword?!” Everyone cried out, “The Sea Bright Sect will know the instant it’s taken and they’ll come at us in force. There’ll be no escape for us!”
Zhuo Fan smirked, “I’ll be the one grabbing it not you, so what are you afraid of? And once I get it, I’ll run straight for the sea to find the sea demon. They’ll only be following me to see the sea demon. As for you, you’ll use the chaos to escape. Your mission is over.”
“Sir, the risk is too great, be it going for the sea demon or having the Sea Bright Sect hunt you down…”
Zhuo Fan raised his hand to stop him, his mind made, “That’s an order.”
“Ugh, yes, sir.” They all saw Zhuo Fan’s firm stance and sighed.
Just then, there was a sudden knock at the door that got everyone jumpy.
[Who can it be? We’re just a bunch of merchants. It can’t be that Sea Bright Sect is suspicious, right? Or is our cover blown so soon?]
Everyone tensed, with sweat trickling down their faces. Zhuo Fan shouted, “Who’s there?”
“It’s me, open up.”
Zhuo Fan jerked and rolled his eyes with a sigh, “What’s this wench doing here?”
Zhuo Fan opened the door and Shangguan Qingyan burst right in, looking happy to see him, “It’s really you! I was right, you’re using Qian Fan as a cover.”
“Ha-ha-ha, yeah, now why are you here?” Zhuo Fan looked bitter.
The rest relaxed finding them so casual with one another. Bali Yuyu mocked, “My, what a romantic you are, Qian Fan. You find charming friends wherever you go.”
“Who’s she?” Shangguan Qingyan started at Bali Yuyu’s presence.
“A grandma the merchants gave us to stitch and babysit.”
“You’re the grandma! Try mocking me again and I’ll pummel you!”
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes at Bali Yuyu’s outburst.
Shangguan Qingyan looked at them and her heart sank. She asked again, “Sir Gu, this is terrible. Sect Leader Ling is suspicious of you and sent the best disciple in northern lands, Ouyang Changqing to look into you!”
[What, that fast?]
Zhuo Fan looked grave. He knew he was too flashy back then, but didn’t think the gentle old man would be so responsive.
He needed to act faster than the inspection.
“Also, how did you get on Murong Lie’s bad side? Sister and brother Murong are looking for you as well. But luckily you sealed Soaring Sword’s sword spirit back then and I mentioned it to them so they can go help dad with it. Or they would’ve come with Ouyang Changqing to see you.”
Shangguan Qingyan complained again.
Zhuo Fan’s heart seized, a chill going up his spine. Not just Sect Leader Ling, but even Murong Lie?
[That was too close!]
With those two coming to see him, he’d be exposed on the spot. He wagered that being part of a merchant group, he’d have some time to use this cover and figure some things out to increase his odds.
But reality showed he had none. Every second he remained here would only exacerbate the crisis.
Zhuo Fan gave Shangguan Qingyan a deep bow, filled with sincerity, “Thank you, miss Shangguan for your timely assistance. Without you, I would’ve been in grave danger. I will never forget this.”
“Hey, it’s all for young Sanzi…”
Shangguan Qingyan turned bashful but a smile still formed, “Since Mister Gu will remember this favor, would you be willing to trust me with your real name? How would I know if you’re sincere if I don’t even know your name?”
Zhuo Fan paused, then looked in her hopeful eyes with a nod, “Alright, I am Zhuo Fan of western lands.”
“Zhuo Fan…”
Shangguan Qingyan’s eyes shone as she smiled wider, “I’ll remember it well. Better not be another fake name or you’ll be sorry!”
“It’s genuine, trust me. Only, you better not mention it to anyone, since I’m supposed to be dead.”
“How come?”
“You’ll know with time.” Zhuo Fan smiled, “Oh right, you said Murong Lie went to deal with the sealed Soaring Sword. What about the others?”
Shangguan Qingyan was quick to reply, “Brother Murong had asked Ouyang Changqing to find his father and go there as well!”
“That’s good. Since war is knocking, the more people unsealing the sword, the better and faster.” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone as he planned his next move.
Shangguan Qingyan hurriedly said, “Zhuo Fan, there’s something I want to ask you. When you returned the Soaring Sword to the Shangguan clan, did you seal it on purpose?”
“Oh, not at all. I sealed it when I had to deal with the Soaring Sword. Everything happened so fast that I forgot to unseal it.” Zhuo Fan said, “You know as well how critical young Sanzi’s condition was. I had no mind to worry about other things…”
“I know, you didn’t fool us on purpose.”
Zhuo Fan explained casually and Shangguan Qingyan perked up on the spot, pecking his cheek.
Everyone stood dumbstruck, even Zhuo Fan, his gaze lost in the distance and unresponsive…

chapters.title: Chapter 1015 - 1015, Striving For to Be the Best
chapters.content:
Chapter 1015, Striving For to Be the Best
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Ugh!
The atmosphere plunged, with the air freezing in place. The others watched with gaping mouths while Zhuo Fan was rooted in place with his mind blown away.
Shangguan Qingyan noticed the awkward vibes from their looks and blushed hard at her impulsive action, choosing to run away at once.
[How mortifying!]
Zhuo Fan gasped at long last, getting some life back in him, instantly treating it like it never happened. He gently closed the door and asked, “You heard Miss Shangguan, right?”
“Uh, yeah, yep, ha-ha-ha…”
They all gave silly laughs, with the guards even bowing, “We never knew sir’s name but now we know how to address you, Sir Zhuo.”
“The crux is, Zhuo Fan is real or just another fake name?” Bali Yuyu smirked.
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes then shouted, “That’s besides the point! What I’m getting at is that Miss Shangguan gave us three important pieces of news. Sect Leader Ling and the Murong siblings doubt us, that they are now working to unseal the Soaring Sword, and that even the best in northern lands, Ouyang Lingtian was called over. What do you guys think?”
“We await sir’s orders!”
Everyone bowed and deferred to him.
Zhuo Fan sighed, “This information allows us to understand the situation. We’re on a timer now, in extreme danger, with escape nigh impossible once Sea Bright Sect and the Murong siblings find out about us. And that this is our chance. With Soaring Sword sealed, every expert around ought to be busy with it, leaving the Heaven Sealing Sword…”
“Unguarded!”
One guard exclaimed, “Sir wants to steal the Heaven Sealing Sword then break the barrier? But isn’t it too hasty?”
“We’re in a race against time, with not a moment to spare.” Zhuo Fan spoke heavily, “Waiting until they unseal the Soaring Sword we’ll soon be trapped with no chance of reprisal. Hesitation will only get us killed. That’s why we must act now while we can. Yuyu, you’re stealing the sword!”
Bali Yuyu jerked, “Aren’t you afraid I’ll run off with it?”
“Run to your heart’s content!”
Zhuo Fan gave an impatient wave, “I don’t want it anyway, just need to lower the barrier and slip into the North Sea. What I need from you is to flee with it and distract everyone. Also, only a Sword King like you has the highest chance of stealing it.”
Bali Yuyu nodded, “I like this deal. I agree!”
“Everyone else get ready to flee. Once Yuyu snatches the sword, break the barrier and make yourself scarce. May fortune be with you!”
Zhuo Fan was blunt. Bali Yuyu would be in no danger once the chaos started, while the rest would be made scapegoats.
At least these men are Serene Shores Trading die-hards, willing to die to make their company great again.
Cupping their hands, the men spoke with resolve, “We shall obey! But when do we act, sir?”
“The sooner the better. Tonight!” Zhuo Fan declared.
Everyone mentally prepared for what was to come.
Bang~
There was a sudden loud knock on the door, too forceful to be from Shangguan Qingyan.
[It must be Ouyang Changqing to check on us!]
Zhuo Fan gave a slight nod and said, “Who is it and what brings you here?”
“I am Sea Bright Sect’s disciple Ouyang Changqing. I learned that you have traveled a long way to bring us supplies and must be weary from your journey, so I came to pay a visit. I hope I’m not bothering you.”
A clear voice came from beyond the door, filled with respect, though the tone hinted at his superior airs.
Bali Yuyu sneered and whispered, “A pompous fool.”
Zhuo Fan shook his head and opened the door, to find Ouyang Changqing straightening his clothes, and putting on a dry smile, “Ha-ha-ha, young master Ouyang, welcome, welcome. You give our minor merchant caravan much honor with your presence.”
“Greetings. Do you know me, perchance?”
Ouyang Changqing’s eyes lit up with joy, “It’s only natural. My dad is the best in the northern lands, Ouyang Lingtian, and I am the best disciple in the northern lands, my name spread far and wide to every ear in the world. You must be filled with boundless gratitude and honor to have me paying you visit, he-he-he…”
Ugh!
Zhuo Fan gave a bitter smile, noticing Bali Yuyu’s smirk.
[The best disciple is indeed a true pompous fool alright, the worst of them all in fact.]
“Ha-ha-ha, sure sure, young master Ouyang’s grand name has us all in awe.”
“You’re too kind, even if it’s true, ha-ha-ha…”
Ouyang Changqing puffed up and laughed as he entered, “You’re all merchants here, and not just pretending, right?”
Zhuo Fan knew where he was going but also knew his unstable character so he smiled without fear, “Young master Ouyang, that’s a good one, ha-ha-ha…”
“She must be the madam, but what about the child? Did you throw her away since she isn’t yours? Ha-ha-ha…”
Getting no rise out of Zhuo Fan, Ouyang Changching ramped up his questioning, bordering provocation.
Everyone’s faces fell and turned to Zhuo Fan.
This was an attempt to provoke their emotions. Any parent would be outraged, with even a flatterer would be offended.
While a suspicious person would try and remain calm. It was this difference in reactions that determined whether there was something off or not about the target.
Being overly angry wouldn’t do since they were merchants and shouldn’t offend some big sect’s disciple. While too calm was also out of the question, as it showed everything was a mere act.
While Ouyang Changqing was scanning their faces for any clue that gave them away, he heard a cursing coming from another room, “You damn brat, you’re the fake son here! You came here to talk rubbish, is that it? Well my dad is going to kick you out!”
Qiao’er burst out and snapped at Ouyang Changqing in anger.
“Hey, where are her manners? Didn’t your parents teach you anything?”
“Please don’t get angry. I’ve always spoiled her. Children speak all kinds of crazy things, ha-ha-ha…”
Ouyang Changqing’s face twitched, being talked back to by a child. Zhuo Fan apologized then shouted at Qiao’er, “What are you doing here? Get back inside!”
Qiao’er huffed and stormed inside, with Bali Yuyu slipping a sneaky thumb’s up.
Ouyang Changqing took a deep breath, annoyed still. He came here to check them and barely got any words out as a damn brat started cursing at him.
[Is the child suspicious too? Was all that an act?]
[Nah, what does a brat know?]
Ignoring all that, having gone through that disturbing event, Ouyang Changqing chose to give up on testing the married couple, now taking a different approach.
But then a familiar shout called to him from outside, “Ouyang Changqing, get out here this instant! We’re not done with yesterday’s fight!”
[That sounds awfully familiar.]
Zhuo Fan frowned, while Ouyang Changqing rolled his eyes and walked outside, “Yan Mo, among western lands’ juniors, you’re among the best, so you should at least act like it. Yesterday I sparred with you but you still want more? Have you no shame coming after me again?”
“Can it! We’ve fought just once and you’re already calling yourself the best disciple in the five lands? That you stomped on the western lands? Where’s your dignity?”
Another shout came from outside, this time filled with rage.
Zhuo Fan jerked.
[Yan Mo? People from western lands are here as well? Oh crap, I can’t let them see me!]
Zhuo Fan gave the others a grave look and pointed at his face then outside with a shake of his head.
They shrugged, stuck as well.
Ouyang Changqing, close by, had yet to notice Zhuo Fan’s reaction, still nagging with Yan Mo outside, “Now you’re saying that defeating you isn’t defeating western lands? When I asked if you represented western lands in our fight yesterday, you were pretty smug calling yourself the strongest in western lands. Now that you lost you no longer represent your home?”
“And?”
Yan Mo sneered, “Always striving to be the best. I finally got a good fight so how can I just let it pass me? Anyway, since I know that I’ll be the best in western lands sooner or later, that’s enough. But then you, the son of the best in northern lands, had to go around all smug as you declared yourself winner over western lands after one fight. Have you no shame?”
“You’re the shameless one, bragging to my face like that!” Ouyang Changqing’s face twitched, lost for words…

chapters.title: Chapter 1016 - 1016, The Fight for Strongest Disciple
chapters.content:
Chapter 1016, The Fight for Strongest Disciple
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Whoosh~
A sudden figure landed next to Yan Mo, who looked at Ouyang Changqing with a smile, “Brother Ouyang, is it? I’ve heard of your matter from brother Yan Mo, and while he thirsts for battle, his conceit is his fault, but brother Ouyang taunted him to fight, and after you won you proclaimed yourself to have beaten western lands’ disciple, leaving us with no self-respect. That’s not very gentleman-like. We’ve been invited to northern lands and to lend a hand as well, but to use us to make a name for yourself isn’t right.”
“How so? I at least am not like you, prancing around falsehoods, calling yourself the best in western lands when you have nothing to show for it. You got me excited about beating you for nothing. Besides, I am the best disciple in the northern lands and don’t need you to be well known, humph, ridiculous!”
Ouyang Changqing mocked, “And who are you anyway?”
The newcomer cupped his hands, “I am Wu Qingqiu from Ultimate Clarity Sect of western lands. I have learned with brother Yan Mo in the Double Dragon Manor, becoming fellow disciples.”
Zhuo Fan’s heart jumped, while his face looked frozen.
[Even Wu Qingqiu is here. Western lands really plan on helping northern lands, or is it to let these kids gain experience?]
[Won’t that mean she is also…]
Zhuo Fan’s heart seized, alarmed.
“Wu Qingqiu, a disciple from Double Dragon Manor as well?”
Not even seeing Zhuo Fan’s wince, Ouyang Changqing sized Wu Qingqiu up and asked, “I know the status of Double Dragon Manor in western lands and any that enter are talented people. I can’t help but wonder how you fare compared to Yan Mo here?”
Wu Qingqiu smiled, “There’s not much difference between us, we’re sparring partners.”
