“He’s a third stronger than me and I have yet to beat him once!” Yan Mo sighed and pointed at Wu Qingqiu, not ashamed to reveal his losses.
Ouyang Changqing nodded, “I see, so you’re the true best disciple in western lands. I understand now why you came so late to northern lands, to save the best for last.”
“Oh, no no no, young master Ouyang, you got it all wrong…”
“No, I don’t. Yan Mo came ten days ago but I understand his character, arrogant and overbearing. Even when I defeated him yesterday, he still wouldn’t surrender, a real man.”
Giving a thumb’s up of praise to Yan Mo’s perseverance, Ouyang Changqing turned to Wu Qingqiu, “But now that he says so much about you, I come to realize that he truly accepts you as stronger. For someone like him to do that, then it can only mean that you have to be the best disciple in western lands.”
Wu Qingqiu shook his head, “Young master Ouyang, you’re still missing the point…”
“There’s no need for explanations. Didn’t you come today to get your brother’s confidence back?”
Ouyang Changqing cut him off, puffing his chest and declaring, “Fine, this afternoon, I’ll meet you on stage! The first disciple in western lands versus the first disciple in northern lands will fight to see who is the strongest disciple in the lands, and the future best in the lands. If I lose, I will take my words from yesterday’s fight back in front of everyone. But if you lose, then you’ll have to admit that the western lands’ juniors have fallen at my feet. But this time, you’re not going to say you were also putting up a tough front and aren’t the best in western lands either, right?”
Wu Qingqiu gave him a long look then showed a cold smile, “Fine, since young master said so much, backing down now will make me look afraid. Then this afternoon, we will fight in the arena on the Mid Heaven Island!”
“Not Mid Heaven Island, but Beneath Heaven Island’s stage!”
Ouyang Changqing raised his head high, “That is where everyone in the sect can come witness our fight. Or you don’t want people to see the battle of the strongest? With all those sharp eyes on us, no one can play dumb on the outcome!”
Wu Qingqiu’s face twitched and nodded, “Fine, since brother Ouyang has a penchant for fame, we will oblige. Though, young master, the higher you aim, the harder the fall from grace, especially from such a big stage.”
“I have always been triumphant in all my pursuits, showered in applause and the crowd’s reverence. I don’t know the meaning of falling!”
Flicking his silky hair away, Ouyang Changqing mocked, “Brother Wu, you’re best worried about yourself, lest you fail miserably.”
Wu Qingqiu squinted and cupped his hand as he shouted, “Goodbye!”
He took Yan Mo away with heavy steps. Watching them go, Ouyang Changqing turned back and came inside Zhuo Fan’s home, “Hear that? I just received a challenge to fight with the western lands for the best in the world. I don’t have time to waste on you and need to tell all my fellow disciples to come see me fight.”
“Oh, of course, talented young master Ouyang is bound to be victorious, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan beamed, easing his tense nerves.
[Great, now this fool is finally leaving. That should at least give me peace and quiet for today.]
Since Ling Yuntian had sent this kid to look into them and had yet to show results, he couldn’t attack them just yet. And since the plan was to move tonight, their odds were looking good.
A true central area spy wouldn’t have acted so soon, but Zhuo Fan’s team was doing it to turn things around and catch them off guard.
Zhuo Fan gave the others a look, who smiled and nodded in return.
His joy was short lived as Ouyang Changqing paused, “Also, Steward Qian, bring your group over this afternoon to watch me crush western lands. You can’t miss it!”
“Uh…”
Zhuo Fan looked conflicted, “Young master Ouyang, we’ve come a long way and aren’t even part of the sect. It’s best that we don’t interfere in the sect and western lands’ disciples’ conflict.”
“You’re too polite. With your group traveling so much, it’s rare for you to come to our sect. It’s my duty to entertain you guys!”
“We could never impose on the young master’s grand hospitality. And we also like peace and quiet, not a fan of bloody fights. Those brutal competitions are…”
“They say merchants know how to read people, so why don’t you get it yet?”
Ouyang Changqing stomped and snapped at them, “You’re a merchant traveling the lands, gathering information, or better yet, bearing information. I want you to witness the fight so you can spread my heroism to others. So that everyone would know of my feats, of defeating the best disciple in western lands and soon to become the best disciple in all the lands. If only our disciples know this and spread it around, they’ll say we’re insidious and conceited. What would be the point of today’s win then?”
Zhuo Fan jerked, giving him a long look and a nod, “Oh, right, young master has such foresight, thinking of the people and their opinions. You’re a true man of valor, the greatest in northern lands. Just the best!”
“Totally, but this isn’t bragging, just the facts. Greatness can never be hidden no matter how modest you are. Like myself, a genius of unparalleled talent, it would be a huge loss for humanity not to let everyone know of my true value.”
Flicking his silky hair once more, Ouyang Changqing had a look of utter pride plastered on his face, then patted Zhuo Fan’s shoulder, “Come early this afternoon, or I’ll send someone for you instead. I’m not to blame if they’re a bit rough compared to me with their invitation. Some people just don’t know a good thing when they see it, so petty.”
Zhuo Fan grimaced as he gave a helpless nod.
[This damn pompous fool only knows how to brag. I really want to punch him in the face!]
Oblivious to the other’s thoughts, Ouyang Changqing, left in glee, “I’ll notify sister Xue of this fight right away. She wasn’t there at my fight with Yan Mo and had missed my greatest moments. But now she’s definitely going to see everything, he-he-he…”
Zhuo Fan sighed as he left, then turned to the others, “I hate his type the most, so impulsive and conceited. They always have a knack of messing things up. Only the heavens know what the hell is going on in that mushy brain of theirs!”
“Goes to show something always goes wrong. You may be able to talk your way out of trouble with the older and cunning seniors, but come short when dealing with brats.” Bali Yuyu smirked.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “This punk only wants to make it big to get as many eyes as possible on him. With there being so many of us, having a couple less won’t be noticed. Also, with his obnoxious attitude, he’s definitely going to blow this simple match out of proportions. This will lax the guard and give us the perfect chance.
“Yuyu, you don’t need to come to the fight. You’ll be scouting out Beyond Heaven Island, especially Heaven Sealing Sword’s location. You only have that afternoon to get a grasp of the place, moving in once night falls. As for the rest of you, the minute the punk finishes the match, rush to the exit of the sect and get ready to leave? Got that?”
“Crystal!” Everyone shouted with solemn looks.
Bali Yuyu showed an awfully cheerful smile watching him plan…

chapters.title: Chapter 1017 - 1017, Her
chapters.content:
Chapter 1017: Her
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Senior brother!”
“Senior brother!”
On that sunny afternoon, what should’ve held a measly ten thousand disciples, the stage on Beneath Heaven Island was packed with over five times that. There were fervent faces anywhere one looked, holding out two spiritual weapons and clanging them together in an unhealthy cheer for the one and only Ouyang Changqing.
Zhuo Fan wore an eagle mask as he looked around the literal mob shouting in one voice bursting his eardrums, and his only reaction was his twitching face, “The fool is the master of the stage. Just the mood alone is enough to bore down on the western lands’ group.”
“Ha-ha-ha, with this being the Sun Sea Bright Sect’s home, Ouyang Changqing is like the big bad boss.” A guard next to him nodded.
Zhuo Fan mocked, “While true, this is clearly overdoing it. Sometimes, the more you hype it the more it makes you look like a thug who’s overcompensating for something. Even if he wins now, it’ll have the vibe of having gotten his way and not that of the modest man striving to do better. In the end, youth is impulsive.”
“Sir, you sound like a droning senile.” Another guard teased.
Zhuo Fan sighed, “It’s called experience that ages the mind and reins in the raging hormones of youth. But this is how youth should be, rash and crazy. To stand out, one must copy Ouyang Changqing here, to grow wings, to pave their future, and to be oblivious to the dangers of the world. He only wants to excel disregarding anyone and anything, making him very susceptible to a crooked and deceptive path.
“As for the old, they have too many things and take measured steps forward lest they lose it all. This brings about a tranquility to them. While youth is easy prey to deception due to their ignorance, the shrewd seniors have their cautious possess them. Being afraid to lose anything, taking hold of just a bit will gain control of them.”
“Thank you sir for these words of wisdom.” The guard bowed, “I see sir acting with force and also making leaps forward. I wonder in which category sir falls?”
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Old, ha-ha-ha, I’m an old demon through and through.”
“If so, sir, I see nothing that could make you relinquish control.”
“That’s because I’m hiding it well, out of sight of any prying eyes. Showing my weakness will be no different than presenting my neck. Many oldies notice, but I do it particularly well. Ha-ha-ha, are you guys planning something for me?”
“No, never, we only listen to the second young master’s words. Sir is wise beyond your years and we’re lucky to hear your guidance.” The guard bowed again.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Wu Randong had gone through a hard time and wants revenge, which means he doesn’t trust anyone. He had you follow me to find out about me, didn’t he? Though I don’t mind. If I can’t even hide my secrets from you guys, an oldie like me is better off retiring while he’s ahead.”
“Sir, we would never.” Everyone bowed.
Zhuo Fan didn’t mind it, his eyes flashing.
Ouyang Changqing finally appeared before them, looking startled at Zhuo Fan’s mask, “Steward Qian, what’s with the new look?”
“Ha-ha-ha, young master Ouyang, I’m just playing with my daughter and lost. Now she made me wear this ugly mask for the day.” Zhuo Fan pointed at Qiao’er as he said.
Ouyang Changqing gave him a long look then mocked, “Why take any game with a child seriously? Having come to my grand performance, you ought to cheer for me. You’re only making others laugh with that childish mask. You better take it off.”
Ouyang Changqing reached for it.
“Hands off! Father promised me! If you don’t like it, shoo!” Qiao’er shouted, stepping between them. Zhuo Fan dodged as well with a smile, “Forgive me young master, I have given my word. I am a father that needs to set an example for my child.”
“Oh, Steward Qian is a great father, putting parenting first.”
Ouyang Changqing gave a nod of admiration, “It takes me back to my own father, who also used to coax me in my childhood, saying he’d let me ride his shoulders.”
“And later?”
“There is no later. He lied to me, never holding his word all these years.” Ouyang Changqing gave a long sigh, “That’s why I hate liars the most. Last night Yan Mo lied to me and today I’m going to give western lands a lesson they won’t soon forget!”
Zhuo Fan looked stunned then nodded, “Oh, young master Ouynag had such a sad childhood. It pains me to hear it.”
“Yeah, I never told anyone about this. You’re the first.” Patting Zhuo Fan’s shoulders, Ouyang Changqing glanced at Qiao’er then at him with seriousness, “Promise me you will never lie to her!”
“Uh, I will!” Zhuo Fan gave a bitter smile.
After giving him one last hopeful look, Ouyang Changqing left.
Zhuo Fan found his attitude quite funny from where he was standing, commenting, “Every little devil has a painful past. No wonder Ouyang Changqing grew up parading himself. His father failed his promise in giving him a ride. How sad to be lied to by your dad all these years.”
Everyone lowered their heads.
[This pompous fool has yet to experience real pain…]
“Ouyang Changqing has such style!”
A shout reached them that sounded familiar. Yan Mo and every elite disciple from western lands made their appearance onto stage. There was also one particular person Zhuo Fan could not take his eyes off.
Zhuo Fan shook all over and caught himself, his eyes laced with pain as he balled his fists and clenched his teeth.
Everyone was taken aback by his reaction, “What’s wrong, sir?”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes began to tear up.
None of them had ever seen the ever wise Zhuo Fan lose his cool. They looked ahead at the fluttering white veil and at the delicate figure hiding behind, shivering even from a light breeze.
She only looked to be holding on thanks to the two girls attending to her.
Ouyang Changqing puffed his chest and strutted before western lands group among the deafening roars, “Can’t I invite some of my fellow disciples to watch my fight?”
“Of course you can.”
Wu Qingqiu cut off Yan Mo’s attempt to speak, “It is your sect and it’s in your right to have the fight between the strongest disciples of our lands witnessed. It’s just that we have someone ill among us that the sudden excitement would be detrimental. Could I ask for your disciples to be a bit quieter?”
[Ill?]
Ouyang Changqing glanced at the white veil and smirked, “Her? Just why have you brought her anyway? Is this how you’re helping our northern lands? Three days ago, Sect Leader ordered me to go to your land and greet you, where I learned that you are bringing an ill person, frail and of vacant mind. Why is she even here? And now you’re telling me a bit of noise will disturb her?”
“Forgive us, her husband passed away five years ago and her mind has been lost since from the pain. We’ve tried everything, even pills, but it is out of our hands.”
Wu Qingqiu sighed and looked at the white veil in sadness, “Her husband died in a huge explosion and now she can’t stand loud noises, scaring her. But her husband was also a rare genius, his most notable battle being against the current best disciple in western lands, Ye Lin. We hoped that by recreating that image would help her recover. Alas, few are those that can be on par with junior brother Ye Lin. Maybe young master Ouyang might just be the one. So we brought her along with this hope in mind.”
Ouyang Changqing roared in anger, “So you’re taking this fight as medicine for a dumb woman? Do you have any idea how important this fight is to me? Yet you’re just trying to use me, is that it?”
“Of course not, I want you to fight the best disciple in western lands, to establish yourself as the best disciple in the lands. We’re only using this chance to save our junior sister. What is wrong with that?” Wu Qingqiu stared Ouyang Changqing in the eye.

chapters.title: Chapter 1018 - 1018, Of One Heart
chapters.content:
Chapter 1018: Of One Heart
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Ouyang Changqing glared at them and roared, “This isn’t a play for you to enact, but a sacred competition! What is equally matched? I’m not about to throw the match over a demented woman just so you can have your act. Brothers, I want to hear you cheer!”
“Senior brother!”
“Senior brother!”
Sea Bright Sect disciples exploded in an even bigger uproar, constantly clanging their spiritual weapons.
The whole stage rumbled from the noise and as it thundered in the lady’s ears behind the white veil, it made her shiver in fright. The two girls helping her held her close to soothe her, their eyes filled with tears.
Wu Qingqiu grew angry as he shouted back, “Ouyang Changqing, you’re a man coming from a respectable clan! Are you not aware that saving a life makes everything worth it? And we’re allies as well. You can’t even do this little effort?”
“I will never give up no matter what, and I’ll be damned if I’ll play your little role you have for me, just over some crazy woman.”
“A fake match won’t deceive her. We’ve tried that already. Her mind might be lost but not her eyes. We only want to see the same power struggle we had in the western lands back then. We think that only you can do it and don’t need anything from you, just to give your all. Is that too much to ask?” Wu Qingqiu shouted at him.
Ouyang Changqing flicked his head away, not willing to cave.
Bam!
A youth filled with savage aura stepped in, Ye Lin.
Glaring at Ouyang Changqing, Ye Lin mocked, “I have no interest in the fight between western lands and northern lands’ strongest disciples. The only reason I even accepted fighting such a mundane guy like you is to help sister Qincheng. But now, humph, I think you’re in need of a harsh lesson. You’re far from ever being my match!”
“You’re the best disciple in western lands?”
Ouyang Changqing squinted with a cold smile, “Fine, come teach me then. If you’re just another pretender, then I’ll have Wu Qingqiu answer for it once I’m through with you. I don’t care who calls himself the best disciple in western lands, I’ll be finding him once I go through all of you!”
“Senior brother’s almighty!”
“Senior brother’s almighty!”
The roaring of the crowd once again exploded and Qingcheng shuddered in the two girls’ embrace from terror.
Western lands’ group gnashed its teeth, with Ye Lin filled with murder.
“Why don’t we take Qingcheng back? She shouldn’t be here and take this!” Shui Ruohua, holding Chu Qingcheng close, said with tears.
The others gave a helpless nod. Since Ouyang Changqing was so against it, staying here would only hurt her more.
[But this bastard Ouyang Changqing has to be put in his place!]
Everyone of them only felt rage and fury for this arrogant prick, wanting to beat him to a pulp.
Ouyang Changqing didn’t care, since this was his sect, his home, and he had the numbers if it came down to a brawl.
As the two sides were at odds, one hand extended in front of Chu Qingcheng’s eyes as a man with an eagle mask spoke, “Miss, it’s much quieter where I’m staying. Would you care to sit with me? A fight between two lands’ strongest disciples shouldn’t be missed.”
“Sorry, sir, she needs peace and quiet. I’ll take her back.” Shui Ruohua gave him a look then an awkward smile as she refused.
Ouyang Changqing was annoyed, “Steward Qian, why would you want that crazy woman around you? Also, I know I chose your seat specifically, but it’s not that quieter either. Once the fighting starts, it’ll be bad for you when the crazy woman starts losing it.”
“Hey, what did you say? Qingcheng’s mind is only vacant, not crazy! Say that again!” Shui Ruohua snapped at him.
The people around got enraged as well, judging by those glares.
Zhuo Fan ignored it all and tearfully gazed at Chu Qingcheng, “It’s really quiet there, believe me. You’ll be safe…”
“Sir, we appreciate the gesture, but Qingcheng is too frightened and would never let strangers touch…”
A sudden chill took her then, noticing that the shivering Qingcheng in her arms no longer shook as she calmed down. Her dainty hand even reached out, to the shock of all present, placing it in Zhuo Fan’s wide hand.
[How is this possible?]
Shui Ruohua widened her eyes as she and the western lands group watched in disbelief.
Chu Qingcheng had lost her fame as a cold beauty ever since her husband passed away and her mind couldn’t take it, few people approaching her. Afterward, she hardly met anyone, shunning almost anyone that approached, finding peace only around her two sisters.
But today, to this stranger, she reached out on her own. Why?
[She’s even scared of her acquaintances…]
“Elder brother…”
Only Ye Lin knew Zhuo Fan to be alive and well. He muttered under his breath, watching the man with the eagle mask with a knowing gaze.
[Bro had been away for so many years. Now he’s finally back!]
Holding Chu Qingcheng’s hand, Zhuo Fan led her to his spot, under the shock of everyone. With every step, his heart bled.
[I left to spare her the pain, but now I see that I hurt her the most.]
[Was I wrong?]
Chu Qingcheng’s veil fluttered, hiding her face, like that of a child, as she followed Zhuo Fan. Despite the uproar outside, her heart has found peace.
The hand felt so familiar to her and it now became her world, knowing there was nothing to fear as long as she held it.
Her mind was vacant and knew not who he was, nor the ones around her, but their hearts had once been one, something that would never change.
Even without needing to see his face, his mere presence made her know by instinct that he was hers.
And she his…
Under the dumb looks of everyone, Zhuo Fan took Chu Qingcheng to his seat, in Bali Yuyu’s place.
Glancing at Qiao’er, Zhuo Fan said, “Qiao’er, say hello to mother.”
“Mother!”
Qiao’er could feel a rare warmth from Zhuo Fan’s gaze and called out. The others looked at him and one guard sighed, “Sir, we only knew you to be cunning and ruthless, but now we see there’s a gentle side as well. But this also revealed to us your weakness.”
Zhuo Fan sighed a nod, “Yeah, but she can never be my weakness, because I’ll always take her with me from now on. They will have to walk over my cold corpse before they can touch her. I will be her shield and as long as I stand no one can use her!”
Zhuo Fan looked at Chu Qingcheng with hazy eyes, not knowing if she understood any of it.
Her eyes were still vacant, her expression tranquil, like that of an infant sleeping. Only her hand shook slightly.
Shui Ruohua and the others saw Chu Qingcheng so at peace around a stranger they didn’t know how to react. Needing a moment to come to and go to her.
Even so, they still couldn’t tell who Zhuo Fan was since he had been dead to them for five years now.
The guards knew how to act and seeing the two girls looking after Chu Qingcheng, they made way, standing with the other disciples to watch the fight.
“Now that the mental patient is taken care of, we can begin! But let me reiterate, I will not throw the fight!”
Ouyang Changqing shouted once more.
At which the mob of disciples coming to cheer roared once more. Only this time, Chu Qingcheng no longer shook in fear, holding to the lifeline, the hand that would give her peace. This only baffled Shui Ruohua.
Ye Lin had a cold smile as he stood on stage, smirking at Ouyang Changqing, “Then allow me to teach young master some manners. I’d hate to shame my elder brother for not taking care of my sister-in-law!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1019 - 1019, You Know Me Best
chapters.content:
Chapter 1019, You Know Me Best
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Hum~
Ye Lin and Ouyang Changqing stood on the wide stage, with the executives present doing their duty in erecting a barrier to isolate their fight.
The loud and raving cheers cut off as well, unable to reach the two fighters.
“One is a great talent of western lands youth, the other is the best disciple in northern lands. I wonder how it will turn out? Ha-ha-ha, this’ll be good!”
“I put my money on Changqing. He’s been training in Heaven Sealing Sword Art since he was young and he also had brother Lingtian to nurture him all these years. While Double Dragon Manor trains the most elite disciples, they have lost the best period in life, starting too late. And with the loss of Vaulting Sword, the kid had no chance of learning of the Vaulting Sword Art. The ending is obvious.”
“That’s too soon to tell. Yes, being trained early will help correct any bad habits that might form, but the way western lands selects its disciple is from their very best, with each having a specialty. After all, Vaulting Sword Art’s character is one of harmony. Western lands does it so that every disciple gets to further amplify their strengths when they learn from the Vaulting Sword. It’s the best way of training in the Vaulting Sword Art and bring about the greatest talent ever seen!”
“But their Vaulting Sword is lost.”
“Be that as it may, I heard that the best disciple in western lands has such an outstanding talent that makes not learning the Vaulting Sword Art a moot point…”
“How reliable is that info? Now I’m really eager to see how far talent alone can get him against a disciple having learned from a divine sword…”
Ouyang Changqing did such a great job at spreading the news of his fight that, just like Zhuo Fan predicted, many elders from Beyond Heaven Island came over as well. They hovered above, with eager and hopeful eyes.
Just like the roaring mob of disciples below, they were just as interested to see who the best disciple among these two was, but without all the fanaticism.
Ye Lin took a deep breath looking at Ouyang Changqing with a smirk and invitation, “After you, lest people say I pick on the weak.”
“You got some nerve acting all smug before me when you’re only in the 2nd layer of Soul Harmony Stage! How in the world did you even get to be the first disciple with that kind of cultivation is anyone’s guess.”
Ouyang Changqing mocked back, although focused on looking around the audience, “Not here still? I even had to insist for two hours to get her to agree. Why isn’t she here yet?”
Ouyang Changqing hesitated.
Ye Lin’s brow shook, “Where are you looking? Scared?”
“Get over yourself! I am a great 8th layer Soul Harmony Stage expert. You must be dreaming if you think I’d be scared of someone in the 2nd layer!”
Ouyang Changqing huffed with disdain, but still scanned the crowd, “Such a grand performance comes by rarely. You’re turning all my effort and grand heroic performance into wasted effort with your absence, sister Xue…”
“Sister Xue, quick, it’s about to start!”
Meanwhile, in another area, Shangguan Qingyan kept pulling Murong Xue’s arm, running over to the hustle and bustle heard for miles.
Murong Xue rolled her eyes, “It’s just that pompous prick showing off, what are you getting all excited about?”
“I know Ouyang Changqing is the best disciple in northern lands with hardly anyone lasting five strikes, but his opponent this time is the best disciple in western lands. Maybe it’ll be a great fight for once. You don’t want to see if there are such experts among our peers?”
Shangguan Qingyan had a very good reason, yet when she arrived at the show, her eyes were everywhere but the stage.
She had even less interest in Ouyang Changqing’s high class act. The only reason she came was because she heard Zhuo Fan’s group was here to cheer for him. So she thought of an excuse to get Murong Xue to come as well.
Was she worried at all that maybe Murong Xue would figure Zhuo Fan out? Absolutely not. She believed Zhuo Fan had taken precautions since he chose to come here. And two, once she spotted him, she’d dump Murong Xue and would shield him from anything. This way they’d also get close. What could possibly go wrong?
Having run her plan countless times through her mind, no matter how shallow, she would have Murong Xue as an excuse when coming to the fight anyway.
Murong Xue had no clue of her intentions, beginning to assess the fight, “Yan’er, Ouyang Changqing is strong in the end. While he always carries himself with flair and idles away like a true pompous fool, his upbringing has been perfect. He had started seclusion with his father when he was five, to understand the Heaven Sealing Sword Art. Not even I can last more than twenty moves against him.”
“Won’t that mean the best disciple in western lands is going to lose?”
Shangguan Qingyan giggled, “Sister Xue is the strongest disciple in southern lands, but for even you to say you’re going to lose, won’t that mean he has won over southern lands’ youth? While eastern lands’ strongest disciple was that cousin Yulin. Though even alive he wouldn’t be a match to sister Xue. That means eastern lands lost as well. Which leaves western lands, needing to defeat their best disciple to be the best disciple of the four lands.”
Murong Xue gave a helpless nod, “Yeah, now you know why he blew this fight out of proportions? He’s about to be the best disciple in the four lands, a very good reason to celebrate. And with western lands being the last among the lands, their best disciple is definitely going to fall way short. Now the entire fight had turned into a spectacle for him to look good. That’s why I don’t feel like coming only to watch his obnoxious grin getting wider.”
“He-he-he, of course he’s obnoxious.”
Shangguan Qingyan teased, “It will go along with your promise. His win will make him the best disciple in the lands and give some credence to becoming the second Invincible Sword one day in the future!”
Murong Xue sneered, “Best in the lands? Second Invincible Sword? Ha-ha, that’s rich! Even if he wins against western lands today, his winning streak will stop here. There’s one among our peers he can never defeat. He has the highest chance of becoming the second Invincible Sword!”
“Who?” Shangguan Qingyan’s brow shook, shouting eagerly.
[It can’t be him, right…]
Murong Xue turned heavy as she spoke, “Central area Sword Star Empire’s Crown Prince, Baili Jingtian!”
“Him?”
“Yeah, just another Baili.”
Murong Xue shook her head with a sigh, “I’ve once gone to the central area and met with the prince on several occasions. The Baili clan is truly incredible, filled with talents and in constant growth. I believe that even a hundred years after Invincible Sword, that clan will shock the world with another incredible figure. At the very least, their top ten princes are on par with the best disciples in the lands. With the first four being above us. I couldn’t even last a blow against Baili Jingtian. He’s really the second coming of Invincible Sword!”
Shangguan Qingyan’s eyes shook, “We really are hopeless. Our homes will all be united under Sword Star Empire’s tyranny, with everything destroyed.”
“Yeah, their strength breeds fear and despair.”
Murong Xue sighed, looking desolate, “It was Prime Minister Baili Jingwei who set up the meeting with the princes. He was then looking to persuade my brother. That’s why he put on such a display to intimidate us. I have to admit, it worked. Seeing those princes’ power and the immense potential of the Sword Star Empire made me realize with each passing day that we are on our last leg. While we are fighting over who’s the best, the Sword Star Empire already took that title, rising to their glory. Maybe the next time, the four lands would end up crushed under its power. That’s why I feel Ouyang Changqing’s fanfare and conceit as the best disciple in the four lands as empty words…”
Shangguan Qingyan nodded in understanding, sighing, “Sister Xue has seen much, unlike us. Being so competitive and drunk on fame is truly childish…”
“Sister Xue, you’re here at last! I’ve waited ages for you!”
Ouyang Changqing’s eager shout reached Murong Xue waving in excitement.
Shangguan Qingyan and Murong Xue had a bitter smile and shook their heads.
In such desperate times, he had the leisure to compete over who the best in the alliance was. It only helped to make his childish image in their minds more pronounced.
Or to be more accurate, naive.
Zhuo Fan tensed seeing Murong Xue here, lowering his head.
Chu Qingcheng reached out by herself and held Zhuo Fan’s hand, gripping both of them tightly, as if to console him. Although, her eyes were still vacant.
“Sorry sir, she doesn’t know what she’s doing.” Shui Ruohua startled at Chu Qingcheng’s action, wanting to take her hand back at once.
It just wasn’t proper to do that with a stranger, especially a man. They’d really take her for a crazy woman.
Zhuo Fan stopped her, sighing as he gazed into Chu Qingcheng’s deep and vacant eyes, “After all these years, you know me best…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1020 - 1020, Tied
chapters.content:
Chapter 1020, Tied
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Sir…”
Shui Ruohua shook at Zhuo Fan’s words, “Have you met Qingcheng before?”
With Chu Qingcheng’s vacant mind, she would usually avoid anyone who got close, except in this man’s case, she actually took initiative. What was even more baffling, no acquaintance could achieve this, not as easily as this man.
It could only mean that he had to be a very close friend to Qingcheng, closer than even her fellow sisters.
Zhuo Fan said, “You could say we are close, but I just can’t believe that after all these years, she became like this…”
“I see, sir must be an old friend of Qingcheng.”
Shui Ruohua nodded and sighed inside, “Life is in constant change and Qingcheng has suffered so much these years. When her husband passed, she…”
Shui Ruohua was filled with grief, speaking of Chu Qingcheng’s matters these years, though it felt more like using a shoulder to cry on.
Zhuo Fan listened quietly, about his loving wife’s troubles, with each word stabbing his heart. The sorrow he felt for her brought him to tears.
But he gnashed his teeth and bore through them, forcing those bitter tears to be buried in his heart.
The others listened in on the hardships and lowered their heads as they glanced at Zhuo Fan.
The stage was drowned in shouts and roars of the crowd, with only this small corner at peace. The pain and sorrow overwhelmed everyone for a long time.
Chu Qingcheng had flinched now and then at Shui Ruohua’s retelling, slowly leaning on Zhuo Fan’s shoulder.
Zhuo Fan could no longer stop the tears, falling down in waves. In all these years as her husband, only now could he lend his shoulder to his weary wife.
He felt pain like no other in all his lives…
The crowd was too busy hollering and shouting to pay any attention to their pain. Their eyes bloodshot while watching the stage with fervent joy and thirst for a good fight.
Crack~
Ye Lin’s knuckles crackled as he stared hard at Ouyang Changqing, “You almost had me for a second there, when you bastard said you didn’t want sister Qingcheng to disturb you. But now I see you went to such lengths to set the stage all to show off to a woman. Humph, you’re a real piece of work. You’d rather show off to some cheap broad than save a life. I vow on my name as a sacred beast inheritor that I’ll put you in your place here and now!”
“Hey, who the hell are you calling cheap? For insulting the woman of my dreams, I will make you pay!” Ouyang Changqing cursed back.
He exploded with power in a blue glow, cold and thick, giving off a chocking feeling under its pressure. The barrier around the stage was unable to contain it, sending the terrifying aura into the crowd, the power of the Heaven Sealing Sword Ouyang Changqing had been training in for many years now.
“Oh!”
The disciples clapped and jumped. “That’s our senior brother Changqing! He has the power to be the best of the best!”
Ye Lin didn’t look remotely impressed. Shaking a bit and unleashing a draconic roar from within as flames soared. The golden flames swallowed his body, releasing a searing heat felt by even those outside the stage.
It was so bad that the tiles began to buckle and warp under the strain.
As for the stage, it split in two, half belonging to Ouyang Changqing’s icy Heaven Sealing Domain, while the other half was Ye Lin’s and his blistering Decimating Golden Flame.
The two had unleashed their powers and were at an impasse.
The audience gasped, too overwhelmed with amazement to keep shouting Ouyang Changqing’s name.
They came here thinking it would be a short fight like all till now, with Ouyang Changqing reigning supreme like always. Now, however, they were met with a standstill, at least from aura’s standpoint.
Silence dominated for once, with faint whispers being heard now and then. None expected a peer of theirs would finally rise that could stand up to Ouyang Changqing’s power. This was bound to be an awesome fight!
The oldies spectating were taken aback as well, smiling and nodding.
[The best disciple in western lands lives up to his name. The fight is going to last a while, ha-ha-ha…]
Shangguan Qingyan pulled at Murong Xue in all her excitement, “Sister Xue, it’s nothing like you said. Ouyang Changqing might not win this one!”
“Oh, it does seem like it.”
Murong Xue was stunned as well, “I would never guess the dry western lands of talent would give birth to such an outstanding man.”
Shangguan Qingyan looked smug.
[What do you think of my Zhuo Fan then? He’s from western lands too…]
“However…”
Murong Xue smirked, “Their display only proved their training is the same, but not who wins. It will solely rest on the skills, cultivation method and attacks. Ouyang Changqing is the son of the strongest in northern lands, Ouyang Lingtian. Such things are nothing for him, but as for that western lands kid…”
Shangguan Qingyan grinned, “We’ll just have to wait and see.”
Murong Xue looked interested for a change, her eyes no longer flat but having a spark of curiosity.
Face twitching, Ouyang Changqing looked at his opponent having matched him in aura, and frowned. He glanced at Murong Xue then at Ye Lin and clenched his fists.
[I’ve underestimated you, boy, you’re nothing like everyone I fought so far. Curses, this fight may not be the show I want it, but since sister Xue is watching, I’m not going to let it disappoint!]
[Speed is of the essence. I’m going to finish him off before he gets any chance to fight back and drag things on. It will only make me look like a fool.]
[I had ignored my adversaries so far, but not this one. The crux is sister Xue is watching and I cannot let it show I’m sweating even a drop.]
Ouyang Changqing gnashed his teeth and shot for Ye Lin.
Ye Lin laughed and met him half way, “You got the wrong guy if you think you can match me in a brawl!”
Bam!
A shocking explosion echoed as the punch and kick collided. The powerful shockwave was so strong it even made the barrier tremble.
The two jumped back to their place, but while Ye Lin stretched out his golden scale arm with a sinister smirk, Ouyang Changqing’s leg was jerking, clearly in pain from holding it up.
[God damn it! Why’s the punk’s body so damn hard? Not even my Heaven Sealing Sword Art strengthened body can match. Is he a monster?]
Ouyang Changqing gnashed his teeth and glanced at the stunned crowd.
[Senior brother actually came out at a disadvantage in the first exchange?]
Even the oldies were amazed, “The western lands kid is great! I had never seen Changqing so distressed.”
“For western lands to have such an amazing talent, it must be once in millennias!” Another elder nodded.
“Western lands is filled with talent that don’t just stop with him.” A sudden speaker said.
The others flinched and gasped, “Exalted Hei Ran, what are you doing here? Aren’t you helping the Shangguan clan unseal the Soaring Sword? Why…”
“That seal is not only strong but queer as well. We’ve been giving our very best for three days and three nights now yet still couldn’t lift it. I came out for a breath of fresh air, letting Old Bai have a go.” Exalted Hei Ran gave a casual wave.
The others bowed, “Exalted Hei Ran is working hard. But what does sir mean by that? You’re saying western lands has more disciples like him? No way!”
“That and then some!”
“Then why is he the best…”
“Because the strongest has died years ago. If he was alive, I dare say he’d become the second Invincible Sword. It would’ve given us hope of fighting the central area’s ambition, but…”nHei Ran grew sullen as he sighed.
The others were startled at the revelation, but also skeptical.
[Is the old guy for real, or mere bragging? Since when did western lands become a trove of talents? For even their second choice for best could push northern lands’ best disciple, what does that say about the western lands’ best?]

chapters.title: Chapter 1021 - 1021, Evoking Heaven Art
chapters.content:
Chapter 1021, Evoking Heaven Art
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Yan Mo, you were right, Ouyang Changqing really can fight junior brother. Maybe not to the level of Zhuo Fan’s fight with junior brother, but it should come close with how they are.”
Outside the arena, Wu Qingqiu commented on the fight, telling Yan Mo, “You’ve done well!”
Yan Mo dismissed his praise, “It’s nothing. I went first with Ouyang Changqing, to test his strength. I lasted twenty rounds with him, while only holding for eighteen with Ye Lin. The best disciple in northern lands is a show-off, but does live up to his name at least. I just hope the fight could stir Chu Qingcheng’s mind, the least we can do for Zhuo Fan’s spirit.”
“Yeah, this fight is our hope to bring Zhuo Fan’s spirit peace. If even this won’t work, then nothing will.”
Wu Qingqiu sighed, glancing at Chu Qingcheng and seeing her peaceful face leaning on Zhuo Fan’s shoulder. Her tranquility caught him off-guard, especially since there was a huge fight going on and she had no sign of being afraid. He signaled Yan Mo and said, “Hey, Yan Mo, who is that guy? Junior sister Qingcheng has been at peace ever since they met. It’s baffling.”
Yan Mo frowned and shook his head, “I have no idea. He’s wearing a mask so I can’t tell. Though I don’t think it would make a difference even if he hadn’t. From Ouyang Changqing’s introduction, he’s a merchant from northern lands. We’ve hardly ever left western lands so we’d definitely not recognize him.”
“Why do I get a familiar feeling about him then…” Wu Qingqiu’s senses threw him into a state of confusion, but he put it all aside and focused on the fight.
Ouyang Changqing looked around after his first loss and saw Murong Xue’s eager eyes. His delusion made him believe she was rooting for him with that hopeful gaze. So he gnashed his teeth and weaved signs.
With every sign, thunder boomed and rumbled as a sudden heavy air overtook the area. Soon, the people found it hard to even breathe. As the warmth was sapped away, ice began to form and spread.
The oldies cried out at his actions, “Evoking Heaven Art? Does he plan to finish it by showing his cards so soon?”
“Evoking Heaven Art?”
Exalted Hei Ran started as well, “Sea Bright Sect’s main earth ranked martial art, that Evoking Heaven Art? The skill is said to have come from understanding the Heaven Sealing Sword!”
One old man nodded gravely, “Yeah, the Heaven Sealing Sword contains the power of seals. By learning its art one gains knowledge about the sealing way and breaking way. The Evoking Heaven Art came from the Heaven Sealing Sword’s breaking way. Exalted Hei Ran, cultivators need to reach Genesis Stage to draw upon the world’s power and grow their sword’s power to unseen levels. But the Evoking Heaven Art breaks the chains of the world and uses its power before one reaches Genesis Stage while unleashing the same type of might as a Genesis Stage expert. It’s an outrageous art, and the more worldly power is drawn, the bigger the impact.”
“In other words, Ouyang Changqing has become, for a brief moment, a Genesis Stage expert?”
Exalted Hei Ran gasped as he looked intently at the fight, “Since they’re even, won’t that mean Ouyang Changqing has gained the upper hand with this boost in cultivation stage? Soul Harmony cultivators are seen as weak to any Genesis Stage expert. Ye Lin is no normal Soul Harmony expert, but neither is Ouyang Changqing in his now temporary Genesis Stage. He is an inheritor of the Heaven Sealing Sword Art. Ye Lin’s hopes are slim at best!”
The elder shook his head with a sigh, “Exalted Hei Ran has to look closer. The Evoking Heaven Art is no secret art, but it has its fair share of dangers. One needs to exercise restraint when it comes to worldly power. Not even a fresh Genesis Stage cultivator has much control over the worldly power, let alone in the Soul Harmony Stage? If he goes beyond his limits, the power will go berserk and it will take it out on him. At worst, he’ll be ripped to shreds, at heaven’s mercy.”
“Ouyang Changqing is the best disciple in northern lands, he has at least that self-control, right?”
“I fear his reckless youth will get the best of him. You can tell by how the fight developed. I fear he will not only hurt his opponent but himself as well, just for the sake of winning.”
The old man sighed, “I can only hope that his opponent will fall quickly so he can rein in the worldly power before it causes harm.”
Exalted Hei Ran smirked, “That’s going to be hard. Ye Lin is quite unyielding. When he fought the best disciple in western lands, he almost bet his life. He’s only standing there because I stepped in.”
Ugh!
They shared bitter smiles and shook their heads.
[Why did it have to be these two pigheaded fools that have to fight…]
The fight was worrying the elders, but the audience was oblivious to the danger, exploding the minute Ouyang Changqing unleashed his great move.
Ouyang Changqing saw the cheers aimed at him and the girl of his dreams watching him, and smiled. His signs formed faster.
The more signs he formed, the harder the pressure of the world bore down, with a bone-chilling coldness spreading. Icy sword waves formed in the sky as they flew around, spreading shock and fear. Ye Lin no longer had a smug look, but became serious, his fists clenching.
Rumble!
With Ouyang Changqing’s final sign, lightning split the skies, unleashing a deafening thunder. One black cloud exploded into myriads of icy swords, gathering around Ouyang Changqing and numbering in the tens of thousands.
Bang~
Some scraped the barrier of the stage and punched holes in it like it wasn’t even there.
The safeguard was now gone. The audience was too incensed to care, shouting harder than ever and chanting his name.
With the fall of the barrier, everyone, even the crowd, was now part of the fight.
And being part of such a fight only meant one thing for them, death.
While they were blissfully oblivious to the incoming doom, the oldies picked up on the crisis, “Blast it! Now if anything happens, it will only become worse. Humph, that kid just had to pick Beneath Heaven Island’s stage for his fight. Doesn’t he know this stage is meant for average disciple’ spars? Its barrier isn’t strong either.”
“It’s because most people are on Beneath Heaven Island. Ouyang Lingtian’s son is like the rumors paint him, vain.” Exalted Hei Ran smiled, “Well, aren’t you going to stop him?”
“Uhm…”
The oldies paused, “Exalted Hei Ran, why don’t you try?”
“Tch, hell no!”
Exalted Hei Ran rolled his eyes, “It’s your home, so how could I step in? Until my disciples are in peril, I won’t budge an inch. Any sooner and it will be taken as western lands’ defeat. While a mere children’s quarrel, we all have our dignity, alright?”
The oldies shook their heads, “We can’t step in either. Changqing is pigheaded but has great talent. He’s going to take his father’s place and wield Heaven Sealing Sword, that is certain. And you want us to barge in into his most prideful moment and his fun?”
“Tch, a bunch of bootlickers. It goes to show how it got to his head and beyond. You always indulged him!” Exalted Hei Ran clicked his tongue and he watched.
The oldies had no comeback, silently accepting his jab. None would step in until it was too late. Like whether the kid was suicidal or not had nothing to do with them.
Below, sword energies roamed around with the world’s energy filling the air at Ouyang Changqing’s whim. He grew excited because none had brought him this far, making him feel the amazing power for the first time. Having the world in the palm of his hand was intoxicating.
Ouyang Changqing shouted and pointed at the skies. The thousands of sword energies combined and formed into a sword image with a cold edge three-hundred-meters tall. Its unstoppable aura shimmering the air around it.
Wu Qingqiu cried out, “This is the power of the world Ouyang Changqing is able to use, but why… Curses, how is that little junior brother able to take such a boosted move?”
“This is not as simple as a mere boost, but a gap in stages. Hardly anything can bridge the gap between Soul Harmony Stage and Genesis Stage!”
Yan Mo gnashed his teeth, “The two were equal but now, with this incredible secret skill Ye Lin will have a hard time overcoming it, even with all he has…”
Wu Qingqiu sighed, glancing at Chu Qingcheng, “I hoped to give her an even fight, but Ouyang Changqing went all out too quickly, becoming overwhelming in power. It took all the thrill out of it.”
The others sighed a nod. Only Ye Lin looked at Zhuo Fan below, his eyes thirsting for battle. After turning to his opponent, golden flames burst from his eyes, as if to prove his resolve.
[Elder brother, watch closely. I have lost to you before, but after these years, I’m just as good as you…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1022 - 1022, Shocking Move
chapters.content:
Chapter 1022, Shocking Move
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Ha-ha-ha, can you feel the extent of my power? Give up while you still can. We’re allies and would hate to leave you hurting and break our lands’ relations. Have some common sense and I will make sure to follow in my footsteps of grandeur!”
[With the heaven’s sword in my hands, the world’s my oyster!]
Ouyang Changqing raised his hand and lifted the terrible and sharp illusory sword, feeding his ego as he spoke with conceit. As for the audience, they only grew more excited with his confidence.
Only Murong Xue gave Shangguan Qingyan a bitter look.
[He has the power, but nothing beats his narcissism.]
[The more I think about it the more I fear for the future of the northern lands with him in the lead.]
Ye Lin gave him a cold look, not at all impressed by the humongous flashy sword above his head. He actually had the nerve to taunt, “Don’t get ahead of yourself. It’s too soon to tell, don’t you think, brother Ouyang?”
“You really think you have it in you to take on this sword?”
“I’m going to crush it!” With golden flames shining in his eyes, Ye Lin shouted, his body exploding with power, “This is a secret art I could only use once in the Soul Harmony Stage. I planned on using it on elder brother when we sparred again, but since we met first, I’ll let you have a taste!”
“Decimating Inferno, Fire Dragon Form!”
Ye Lin roared at the heavens, followed by draconic howls, shaking the air with every rumble. Scorching and golden lights shot from his body like a volcanic eruption, illuminating the whole sky.
A dreaded heatwave spread, enveloping half the world in a red hue and the audience in a hot spell. As for Ye Lin, under the shocked eyes of the crowd, began to change. Golden scales formed on his body and his teeth turned into sharp fangs. He was now like a wild beast, and from the shape of his head, it was that of a dragon.
Everyone gasped at the sudden transformation.
[Is his soul the greatest heaven dragon soul? How else could he take this form in Soul Harmony Stage? His power and Yuan Qi amount had to be multiplied. There are now some good chance he might actually take on the sword.]
Ouyang Changqing huffed, “So what if you have the heaven dragon soul? My sword is from the Heaven Sealing Sword Art. even if you harmonized with the heaven dragon soul, it won’t do a damn thing!”
“Humph, do you really think this is your average soul harmony? Ignorant whelp, just watch. I told you, this is Fire Dragon Form, not your average fake draconic soul harmony!”
Ye Lin smirked and shouted again.
Boom!
Akin to a detonation, the violent golden flames shot from his body in every direction. The great power made the audience squint, feeling on their skin the searing heat he released.
Ouyang Changqing gasped, his mind going a mile a minute as he reproached.
[Brothers, this is but a fight for the best in the alliance, not to the death. Could you not detonate, please?]
The oldies were just as stunned, gaping at the display. Not even Exalted Hei Ran acted with more composure.
[Why’s Ye Lin so panicked to detonate? He’s not even cornered yet!]
Standing there for any longer would let the inferno reach the crowd and would be sure to leave countless casualties.
The elders were ready to stop this from happening. Ouyang Changqing grew serious as well, about to slash with his sword and stop the incoming golden flames.
And yet, the spreading golden inferno paused and pulled back in on the stage, forming a huge fire tornado, punching a hole in the skies.
When the tornado settled, a deafening draconic cry racked the audience’s ears.
The elders, Ouyang Changqing, even Exalted Hei Ran watched with dumb look at the incredulous scene unfolding. Ye Lin had been hiding such a move even in the years spent inside Double Dragon Manor.
Ye Lin was nowhere to be seen on stage, replaced with a three-hundred-meter tall golden and flaming dragon soaring high above.
Where it passed, the air shimmered, as if the skies feared the divine dragon’s roars.
Only a divine beast could have the might to challenge heavens, never content with just holding the world’s power. Ye Lin was now a fire dragon, his power being on the level of heaven itself. Why then should he care if the opponent used worldly power?
Ouyang Changqing’s brow shook, still holding the sword, but his gaze was lost, “Screw you! That’s no soul harmony dragon, but the real thing! Talk, where the hell did western lands get such a monster, you damn abomination?”
Wu Qingqiu and the rest from western lands were floored. They knew Ye Lin was badass, but only now knew he held a skill that could rival heavens.
Ouyang Changqing had now met his match as a fight like no other was about to unfold!
The fight sure was intense, on the level of Zhuo Fan and Ye Lin’s back in western lands.
Wu Qingqiu and Yan Mo shared a smile then looked at Chu Qingcheng.
Shangguan Qingyan was dazzled, looking astonished, “Sister Xue, it’s totally worth it!”
“Yeah, it’s beyond my imagination the best disciple in western lands to be of such amazing talent to fight the son of Ouyang Lingtian. He is on the level of the best four princes of the Baili clan. As for the strongest Baili Jingtian…” Murong Xue sighed, “I don’t know for sure since we never fought, but these two give us hope.”
Bam!
Ye Lin’s huge bulk landed on stage, the large vertical eyes staring at Ouyang Changqing, while sometimes glancing at Zhuo Fan.
[See that, bro? This is my power, just like yours…]
His mood got killed the minute he saw Zhuo Fan never even looking at him. Zhuo Fan’s eyes were only on Chu Qingcheng’s peaceful features as he listened to Shui Ruohua tell him of Chu Qingcheng’s troubles.
Shaking his huge dragon head, Ye Lin sighed with disappointment, focusing on his adversary instead. He opened his maw to reveal the human-sized fangs as he laughed, “Boy, you dare talk big with me? You’re only asking me to tear into you!”
Bam!
The dragon claw slammed on stage, crumbling it to pieces. The powerful shockwave howling as it spread to the audience and burning his majestic visage in their trembling hearts. It was like they were seeing a real dragon in all its glory, robbing them of their breaths.
All the resounding support Ouyang Changqing had been getting from his fellow disciples was now quashed under the oppressive power of the dragon before them. They couldn’t muster the slightest peep, feeling utterly inferior.
Ye Lin was a true dragon, a king in his own right before the masses.
For the first time ever, the stage had sunk in complete silence. No one held more authority than the fire dragon’s royal aura.
Ouyang Changqing started to sweat as he watched the huge dragon, but his heart burned with anger.
He didn’t know what abomination Ye Lin was, with how the average Soul Harmony Stage cultivator merely took on the appearance of the soul beast, bumping up their power a bit. But this guy in front of him became a true dragon.
No matter how he looked at it, that was not a human standing before him, but a dragon made of fire.
He didn’t care how or why it happened, only feeling that his grand performance had been squashed. All eyes were now on Ye Lin’s magnificent and royal form as he became a prop. It was a blow his ego was incapable of taking.
He had fought so many times but when did he ever become the extra? This time there were so many people watching, all thanks to his efforts too, and to show off in front of the girl of his dreams. But all that popularity had gone away in a flash. Would a man of his endless pride allow for another to steal his limelight?
He had to win this at all costs, or it would haunt him for the rest of his days.
Ouyang Changqing gnashed his teeth and resolve glowed in his eyes. The sword above him grew more savage, “I don’t care if you’re a fake or not, I’ll slaughter you where you stand!”
Ouyang Changqing waved and brought down the greatsword on Ye Lin’s huge dragon bulk….

chapters.title: Chapter 1023 - 1023, Berserk
chapters.content:
Chapter 1023, Berserk
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Hu~
The large sword carried the power of the world as it came down on the dragon head. Its chilling aura swept the stage, cooling the heart coming from Ye Lin. The dragon’s surging fires dimmed and flickered as well.
Ye Lin’s brow shook, still having the calm of mind to know that the Heaven Sealing Sword Art held the power to contest the dragon’s. So he willed the flames to reach ten meters once more as he used his big claws to grasp the large sword.
Bam!
The claws screeched as they made contact, with hot and cold fighting for supremacy. Ouyang Changqing strained with a red face to bring that large sword down while Ye Lin forced himself with a soaked brow to keep the flames burning against the icy blade, even as they slowly got put out.
They both used all they had but they were now at a standstill. The prolonged tension brought unease to the crowd, looking on nervously and eager to know the final winner, the best disciple in the alliance.
“You think you can best me with just your power? In your dreams! Evoking Heaven Art!”
Pushing hard for fifteen minutes, yet the claws held the sword at bay still, Ouyang Changqing had lost his patience.
Ye Lin’s true dragon form was too strong, able to counter the power of the world with only his strength. Thinking about it, he realized the Yuan Qi reserves Ye Lin had were gigantic as well. Thus letting it drag out would be to his detriment.
He might have borrowed the world to bump his power, the Yuan Qi he used to gain control over it was too taxing to keep running for long. Speed was of the essence.
Today was also the first time he used Evoking Heaven Art and controlled so much worldly power. And if he tried to take some more…
Ouyang Changqing hesitated but then he saw Ye Lin’s conviction. He just gnashed his teeth and shouted as he made the signs.
Another rumble spread through the skies as sword energy gathered in his hand and flowing into the large sword.
The sword’s coldness flared with power, pushing back harder against Ye Lin’s draconic body, snapping the stage in half from the force.
Ouyang Changqing grew pleased at the results.
[Let’s see you last now.]
The oldies of the Sea Bright Sect were getting tense by the moment, “Evoking Heaven Art again. It should be fine.”
“Let’s hope so.” They shook their heads in worry.
The audience cheered at their senior brother’s comeback, though drowned soon after by another draconic roar. As he pushed at the incoming sword, he also lashed out with the searing and flaming tail.
Bam!
The large sword shook as it dimmed. Ouyang Changqing shook with it, pushed back a bit. But it was his heart that couldn’t take the reality.
Ye Lin smirked and wheezed, while still having the energy to mock, “Brat, let’s see how far worldly energy can take you. Humph, isn’t it something you drew with your Yuan Qi? The minute the sword shakes the slightest bit, your Yuan Qi is affected. How will you draw worldly power in that state? One tiny shift and everything will come down crashing. Your Evoking Heaven Art isn’t anything to look at!”
Ye Lin flared his fire and pushed at the large sword.
Bam!
Ouyang Changqing’s face twisted as he paled.
“Damn punk, I’ll get you for this!”
With his opponent figuring out his weakness, Ouyang Changqing ignored everything and made signs again, “I’ll show you the true power of the Heaven Sealing Sword Art! Heaven Sealing Art!”
The large sword exploded into many cold blades and shot for Ye Lin’s bulk, invisible and unnoticed.
Ye Lin surged in the sky because of the loss of resistance, but then the sword waves battered his body, snuffing out the flames and even forming ice.
Ye Lin cried out, “What is this thing? I can’t move…”
“Ha-ha-ha, see that? This is the true power of the Heaven Sealing Sword Art, sealing!” Ouyang Changqing laughed in pride, “Once caught, strength won’t matter, for you can’t move a muscle. You lost, western lands brat!”
Ye Lin’s face twisted in defiance.
The elders above gasped, “Evoking Heaven Art uses the breaking way, while Heaven Sealing Art the sealing way. Who told him to use both of them at the same time? He’s only making it worse!”
“What’s the problem?”
Exalted Hei Ran felt bad for seeing his disciple lose, but then he heard them and asked, “You’re saying this is more dangerous than Evoking Heaven Art?”
The elders nodded, “Yeah, overusing Evoking Heaven Art only gets the power to run berserk and could step in to get control over it. But with how these skills engender each other, the loss of control will mean a rampant surge of worldly power no one can grasp unless the seal is released. This happened only once, two thousand years ago, with the wielder using the Heaven Sealing Sword to cut off the power of the world from unleashing a disaster. But even then, there were countless casualties and thus was forbidden. I did not expect Changqing to use it today to win a match. Is it because it happened so long ago? Kids these days have no idea of the horrors of the past.”
“Then are you going to do something about it, or just watch?”
“Of course we’ll stop it no matter what!” The elders went down.
But then the dragon roared and as the ice was about to swallow Ye Lin, the golden flames flickered to life once more, breaking it down. But there was also blood flowing from his mouth.
Ouyang Changqing sneered, “Using your blood essence to stir your potential? Humph, it’s no use. The worldly power at my disposal is boundless. How long can you last?”
“Evoking Heaven Art?”
Ouyang Changqing made signs once more.
“Don’t do it!” One elder shouted in panic. Ouyang Changqing was too far gone now, obsessed with winning, with proving himself best.
Worldly power gathered once more, bearing down in the form of another sword.
Ouyang Changqing shifted his signs, “Heaven Sealing Sword Art!”
The elders’ faces twitched, unable to stop him in time.
The sword energies coming from the heavens had yet to fully form and turned into cold energy the next second, gunning for Ye Lin.
It formed another cage in an instant.
Ye Lin’s heart jumped in shock, fighting to keep his golden flames burning and fight off the cold. It was no use, for the two arts had now set free the world’s energy.
Out of Ouyang Changqing’s control, the world formed a sword by itself then transformed into cold blades that struck Ye Lin.
Ouyang Changqing laughed in glee, “Ha-ha-ha, you can actually use both arts at the same time for an even greater effect to unleash all the endless power of the world! My win is set! How come I couldn’t see this before?”
“You saw shit! That’s losing control of the worldly power and bringing about destruction!” One elder flashed before him and shouted at the others, “Send for Lingtian at once! Tell him to come with the Heaven Sealing Sword and break the link!”
Ouyang Changqing looked baffled, “Elder, what’s wrong? Aren’t I the first who used the two arts together?”
[You think yourself so clever, is that it?]
The elder’s face twitched, looking distraught and fearful at the sword coming from the sky.
Ye Lin roared once more, trapped in ice again, but this time the ice was bizarre, working to swallow his bulk until he turned into a dragon statue of ice.
His eyes then flared with savagery behind the ice…

chapters.title: Chapter 1024 - 1024, Ouyang Lingtian
chapters.content:
Chapter 1024, Ouyang Lingtian
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Whoosh~
Sword energies flew around the sky, slamming into the ice dragon and adding to the seal. The ice dragon howled at the sky with such power it crushed the stage, then blew his breath on the audience, one of ice and cold.
The chilling breath swept the unfortunate ones and turned them into statues of ice in mid panic. So deep was the cold that it froze their very souls.
“We’re finished! The heaven and earth has gone berserk!” One elder held his head and sighed bitterly.
Ouyang Changqing was enraged when Ye Lin attacked his fans, “Hey, western lands punk, have you lost your mind?”
“You’re the demented one, Changqing!”
The elder shook his head and snapped at him, “Have you any idea what calamity you caused? Evoking Heaven Art and Heaven Sealing Art engender each other. Evoking Heaven Art breaks, opening a channel into the world so you can draw its power. While Heaven Sealing Art seals this channel and the power. When a cultivator uses the worldly power, it would dissipate afterward and return to the its rightful place, back to the world. This is its nature.
“But you opened a channel into the world then had it sealed in place. The minute you lost all control over that power it started spilling into reality without stopping thanks to locking the channel while also running amok with no one to direct it. And this is the result!”
Ouyang Changqing’s eyes went wide, scratching his head classlessly, “Elder, so you’re saying the dragon isn’t that guy but amassed worldly power? Why is it attacking people then? Isn’t it just energy?”
“The world has spiritual energy so it must have its own will!”
The elder shook his head, “Once a cultivator draws upon the worldly power, they can control it, but now this power has gone berserk, gathering in one place and also gaining sentience from the will of the world. With heaven and earth going crazy, you have no idea what kind of a disaster it can cause, it’s beyond anything humanly possible!”
Ouyang Changqing looked at the far ice dragon with a deep frown, “What about the western lands punk? You’re saying the power focused on him and it’s controlling him? What about his mind, has it been swallowed?”
“You have the nerve to ask?”
The elder’s face twitched and shook his head, “Have you no clue what you just did? You used Heaven Sealing Sword Art and he’s been frickin’ sealed! Now the power of the world is going into the dragon without a conscience, the best thing for it. If the mind was still there, some control would’ve been possible. This time is going to be even harder to deal with than two thousand years ago. Your father is going to tan your hide!”
Ouyang Changqing’s lip quivered, like he was a naughty child caught red-handed and looking guilty.
The roars echoed across the skies as the ice dragon flung its bulk around and spraying ice to freeze everything. The only expressive thing about these lifelike statues were the fearful eyes and the shocked faces.
Wu Qingqiu cried out, “Little junior brother, what happened to you? Stop!”
Hu~
The ice dragon blew ice once more.
Wu Qingqiu knew he was going to fall under such power and rushed to dodge. His leg ended up being caught in the blast, freezing over.
“Sir, what just happened? Go and take Qingcheng away!”
The peaceful storytelling had now come to an abrupt end as a monster rampaged around turning people into popsicles. Shui Ruohua gasped and reached for Chu Qingcheng to take her away from this dangerous place.
Zhuo Fan regarded the peaceful face of his wife and smiled, “It’s fine, there’s no need to disturb her. You haven’t finished the story, miss Shui, please continue.”
[As if! With so much chaos around the world might be ending, and you’re asking me to tell you a bedtime story? Even if I might be suicidal, I will never let any harm come to Qingcheng. What kind of a sister you take me for?]
While she was insisting on taking Chu Qingcheng, one guard grabbed her hand, “Miss, since sir said you may continue, then it’s fine. Please trust him. We’re also here and shall keep the danger at bay from reaching miss.”
Looking into Zhuo Fan’s eyes then into those eyes filled with complete trust, she turned to watch the berserk ice dragon. Shui Ruohua hesitated, but she had no choice other than nod, even if against it.
Zhuo Fan smiled and looked at Qingcheng next to him lovingly.
Bam!
On stage, Exalted Hei Ran shot a sword energy at the ice dragon and break the ice on it and reach his dear disciple. But the dragon shook and all the ice splashing about was soon absorbed into its body along with the power of the strike.
Exalted Hei Ran gasped in fright, “What in the world is that thing?”
“Exalted, please refrain from doing anything. Nothing we do will have any effect.”
One elder with a white beard came over as he explained hastily, “That is the embodiment of the Heaven Sealing Sword Art. No matter what skill is used, it will only be absorbed by the seal and become its own power. That’s why nothing we do to it will help. We can only protect the other disciples and flee from here!”
Exalted Hei Ran was astonished, then he glanced at the panicking disciples fleeing for their lives still ending up in ice from the dragon’s breath and said, “If you say this thing’s unstoppable, how then do we deal with it? We can’t let it run amok and freeze the whole sect!”
“Exalted, it can seal everything but the five great divine swords!”
The man cupped his hands and pointed at the ice swords raining down from above even now, “Please observe, the channel into the world has been opened, turning into an infinite loop. Our only hope is to dodge and wait for brother Lingtian to come with the Heaven Sealing Sword and seal the channel then cut it to disperse all that power. He will also go easy as to save your disciple as well.”
Exalted Hei Ran’s brow shook, looking at the ice dragon freezing anything that moved with a sigh. He relinquished a nod.
This thing was now part of the world, undying and unstoppable. The more power they used on it, the more it absorbed. The only option right now was to wait for Ouyang Lingtian to come to the rescue and fix this damn mess his own son made!
Ouyang Changqing looked at the ice dragon ruining everything, out of his control, and felt so bad he could cry.
[I can’t tell if dad will come to strike me down or the the dragon first, sniff…]
“Ouyang Changqing, this is all your fault. You did this, you caused this disaster to fall on so many lives!” Two girls flashed out of nowhere. Shangguan Qingyan glared at him and started cursing. Murong Xue was furious as well, full of hatred.
Murong Xue’s hatred however was due to having involved innocents. Shangguan Qingyan’s rage was because she worried for Zhuo Fan so she was taking it out on him. She was running her mouth while looking around for Zhuo Fan.
With everyone in panic, it was hard to look. Ouyang Changqing lowered his head in guilt under the chastising look of the girl of his dreams.
He was even more accepting of his guilt than when faced with his father…
[There!]
Shangguan Qingyan spotted Zhuo Fan, still sitting without a worry and listening to everything.
Talk about monstrous, not even having a healthy respect for the worldly abomination running amok just next to him.
Maybe it felt the contempt, or maybe all the targets fled and left only Zhuo Fan’s group still untouched, but the ice dragon roared and set its eyes on them. It shot for them, its icy aura freezing the area around it as it passed.
“Watch out!”
Shangguan Qingyan cried out in fright, a little too late. The others around her looked down just in time to see another poor souls being sacrificed to the calamity.
“Leave this to me!” A resounding voice spoke.
Hum~
The cold humming of a sword was heard as a figure in gray rushed over at full speed.
“Dad!”
Ouyang Changqing cried out, thrilled and scared. While the others looked on in hope.
Northern lands’ best, Ouyang Lingtian, finally arrived with Heaven Sealing Sword to clean up his son’s mess…

chapters.title: Chapter 1025 - 1025, Thunderflame Wraith Claw
chapters.content:
Chapter 1025, Thunderflame Wraith Claw
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Heaven Sealing Sword Art, Heaven Breaking Strike!”
A dignified man with a gray robe fluttering in the wind appeared. He had sharp eyes and sharp features. He wielded an azure longsword, giving a dazzling light.
Its sharp edge promised to cut everything in creation, even the world, humming all along. The sharp sword energy rushed out of the tip and went for the ice dragon, moving with incredible speed through the air.
The others watched in awe as the best in northern lands made his move.
As he was in mid-strike, someone shouted at him, “Brother Lingtian, please go easy. The ice dragon has my disciple sealed. Please spare his life.”
“There’s actually someone in there? Isn’t it like the disaster two thousand years ago?”
Ouyang Lingtian’s eyes shook from the news and he halted the attack. He looked back to see western lands’ Exalted Hei Ran speaking up.
Ouyang Lingtian went back to the raging ice dragon about to run into Zhuo Fan. He was hesitating, not knowing where the sealed disciple was under all that ice and one wrong move would cleave him. By hurting Exalted Double Dragon’s precious disciple would mean ruining their cooperation.
While delaying would also implicate the people it targeted, under the ice’s torment from the dragon. The sudden conundrum had the best in northern lands stuck.
Save one and let many die to keep the land’s friends still? Or accept the loss of a single life for the good of many?
Ouyang Lingtian found it a very tough choice to make. Which was worth it? The alliance or the lives below? It was a headache even for the most righteous characters.
But he had omitted one last choice, inaction, leaving the ice dragon to rampage for Zhuo Fan’s group. Now no one could save them. His attack would be too late for the sword energy to reach them in time. The ice dragon would’ve crushed them to pieces by the time he struck.
To others, it looked like Ouyang Lingtian had made no choice when he actually did.
Ye Lin was brought at their invitation by Exalted Hei Ran with the promise of safety. With western lands’ crucial situation, his safety was just as vital. Far more so than a few random lives.
The righteous path stated that all lives were equal. But when people were involved, that value tended to change to suit their needs.
Ouyang Lingtian held the sword tight and sighed. Down below it was life and death yet the matters of the world had won over his principles.
He wanted to save everyone, but he stayed his hand. Not for the life inside the ice dragon, but the ties among the two lands.
No matter how huge the collateral, the essential personnel had to be kept alive, lest it would cause tension between factions. Such was the secular world.
The five lands’ best experts could be all noble as much as they wanted, but it still didn’t change the fact they were tied in the vicious interests of the world around them.
Shangguan Qingyan had hoped for Ouyang Lingtian’s appearance, so that Zhuo Fan would be saved. But the best in northern lands’ rescuing strike failed to deliver. It astonished her to no end, “Why aren’t you doing anything?”
“Yeah, dad would always help people in need. Why is today any different? Is he afraid of harming innocents from how far we are?” Ouyang Changqing cried out.
Murong Xue’s brow shook and sighed, “It’s not a stray attack he fears, but his already stray heart…”
The ice dragon roared once more, caring unstoppable power straight at Zhuo Fan, surrounding them in a harsh cold mist. The slightest touch would mean being frozen on the spot. Now there was no escape.
“Junior sister Qingcheng, junior sister Shui!”
Wu Qingqiu cried out, with the others around him nervous for their fate. Shangguan Qingyan cried out in panic, “Look out Zhuo-“
There was no stopping the ice dragon’s charge. It raised its claw and went for their lives, to crush them to an icy pulp.
Shui Ruohua and the other girl stood rooted in place. They glanced at the unfazed Zhuo Fan, still sitting in his spot, with reproachful gazes.
[I told you we should run, but you just had to play it cool. Now look what happened, there’s nowhere to go now. If you find death so nice, why the hell did you have to drag us with you as well? Look at Qingcheng, she’s still lost in her own mind. The poor girl is about to fade away all due to some damn stranger!]
[Well, aren’t you all pissed your boss is so stubborn he just had to have you all die as well?]
Shui Ruohua turned to the guards then, only to find them just as cool.
Shui Ruohua was stumped.
[Are they all suicidal? You don’t mind dying with such a master?]
Having been around Zhuo Fan for this long journey, they figured out early on how he operated. From inciting Frigid Rain Sword King, to facing Invincible Sword, whenever he showed complete calm, then it was proof enough that all would be fine.
Zhuo Fan held Chu Qingcheng’s hand, her head leaning on his shoulder, in utter tranquility, even more so than usual. So why would they wrack their nerves?
They had complete trust in Zhuo Fan’s control, worshiping his flawless skills. It could have come from a horde of dragons for all they cared. So long Zhuo Fan was chill, so were they.
Hu~
The ice winds blew, surrounding the area in its great power. Even the seats chilled over and froze their rears. It was then the two claws were right on top of them.
Shui Ruohua’s eyes rolled back, about to faint from terror. The onlookers, Wu Qingqiu, Yan Mo, Murong Xue and the others were filled with worry but equally helpless. Ouyang Lingtian sighed, closing his eyes, unable to bear seeing the result of his choice.
They might be collateral, but lives nonetheless that he brought doom upon. He felt he had lost all dignity.
Exalted Hei Ran looked at the three girls below with a shake of his head and guilt. To save Ye Lin and the western lands’ future, he had given up on the expendables…
It was certain to all here that Zhuo Fan’s group was finished, sighing at the loss. But the deadly ice claws halted for no reason just above them.
To everyone’s shock, they watched as a black claw formed between Zhuo Fan and the ice dragon, blocking the ice claws from coming any closer.
“What is this? Why isn’t he sealed in contact with the ice dragon?” One elder shouted in disbelief, “The ice dragon seals everything, arts, souls and even Yuan Qi, in its body. How is it that someone is still unaffected when touching it?”
Ouyang Lingtian watched the spectacle with equal shock, forgetting to even mind his flying.
[Heaven Sealing Sword Art can no longer seal?]
[That’s not possible!]
Shui Ruohua was waiting for her life to end at the ice dragon’s claw but found it to be late. She cracked an eyelid open and saw the black claw keeping it back with a dumb look.
[Wasn’t this dragon unstoppable? Exalted Hei Ran couldn’t stop it earlier so why can this man?]
“Sir…” Shui Ruohua turned to Zhuo Fan in shock.
Zhuo Fan only had eyes for Chu Qingcheng who still leaned on his shoulder with a smile. Then he glanced at the halted ice claws with a hard expression.
“You ruined the mood, bastard!”
“Thunderflame Wraith Claw!”
His left eye acted up and the black thunderflame exploded. It spread over the black claw and enlarged it many times into a huge thunderflame claw.
The crackling fire filled the air with death.
It was a power and aura that struck fear to the core of the disciples and the mighty experts above, including Exalted Hei Ran and Ouyang Lingtian.
As for the ice dragon, it actually showed fear under the black thunderflame’s power. Its huge icy bulk quaked from it…

chapters.title: Chapter 1026 - 1026, The Best Best
chapters.content:
Chapter 1026, The Best Best
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
