Proofreader: Papatonks
Boom!
The dreadful black thunder claw squeezed and the ice dragon’s claws exploded to pieces. The thunderflame made sure to burn them to nothing before they got back to its body.
The ice dragon shook from fear, looking terrified.
The guy was simply standing at the side, without a care, till now and gave off no indication it wielded such godly power, incapable of even being sealed.
It flicked its tail and the scared dragon withdrew as he absorbed the cold icy sword waves from the sky and repaired the damage. Its claws were soon good as new.
Zhuo Fan was not about to let it go. Since he had to get involved, he would finish it too.,
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone and the huge thunderflame claw shot forth to clutch the ice dragon’s head, bursting it with a squeeze.
The ice was blown away, even if formed from the worldly power, ended up burned to nothing from the thunderflame.
The thunderflame claw grabbed further, at the body, and took seconds to turn the three-hundred-meter large ice dragon to pieces, pieces that had no chance of returning, sizzling and gone from this world.
The thunder claw grasped one last time and drew a person next to Zhuo Fan.
Because of the seal placed on him, Ye Lin’s mind was hazy, his body wobbling around. Yet he managed to catch some glimpses through the haze, “Thank you, elder brother. After all these years I still can’t catch up to you.”
“It’s fine, just be more careful next time.”
Releasing the claw, Zhuo Fan looked calm as before, still sitting with Chu Qingcheng leaning on his shoulder having felt nothing of what transpired. Even with all the chaos that went on, along with the ruckus and destruction, Zhuo Fan made sure to keep Chu Qingcheng shielded from even the slightest tremor.
Everyone else though was too shellshocked to react.
Ouyang Changqing was gaping even. It was beyond his ‘expert’ comprehension how the merchant he asked to come watch turned into a world expert himself.
The divine move used to crush the ice dragon was beyond sublime. With the ice dragon using sealing, only a divine sword could touch it, but even his dad would have a hard time doing it.
[Just who the hell is that freak?]
Shangguan Qingyan looked on with adoration. But seeing Zhuo Fan and Chu Qingcheng hand in hand, with the pretty face leaning on his shoulder, her joy plunged into confusion.
[Who is she to him? Why is he so caring with her? I’ve never seen him act like this with anyone…]
“Gu Yifan!”
A sudden cry entered her confused mind and saw Murong Xue frowning with a complex gaze at Zhuo Fan.
Shangguan Qingyan looked around and rushed to whisper, “Sister Xue, are you sure? How can he be that Gu Yifan?”
“He might wear a mask, but I’ll never forget the child next to him!”
Murong Xue was convinced, “I also know the black thunderflame he used as well. Black flames are a rarity across the world. It is him, beyond any doubt!”
Clenching her fists, Shangguan Qingyan lowered her head.
[How am I supposed to turn this around when sister Xue is dead set on her suspicion?]
[Curses, sister Xue is too much of a stickler for righteousness and will definitely tell others. What to do?]
Shangguan Qingyan was anxious while looking from Zhuo Fan to Murong Xue.
Murong Xue picked on her cues and whispered, “Yan’er, did you already know him?”
“Eh, no way. Only what I heard from you, ha-ha…” Shangguan Qingyan flinched and forced a straight face on.
Murong Xue’s hard stare was unnerving, “Yan’er, you don’t then? Then why were you so nervous seeing him about to get hurt? Fess up, did you know he was here?”
Shangguan Qingyan caved under Murong Xue’s hard stare, squeezing a helpless nod.
“Yet you still covered for him? Do you have any idea how dangerous he is?”
“Sister Xue, he said he came here to save his son. He’s no threat to our lands.”
“And you believed him?”
“Of course I did. He helped get our Soaring Sword back!” Shangguan Qingyan turned defiant under the assault, speaking with conviction, “And I saw how much he cared for his son. He won’t ever use his son as an excuse, especially when his life is on the line.”
Murong Xue’s eyes shook and frowned in thought.
Shangguan Qingyan was anxious, “Sister Xue, I beg of you, don’t tell on him, please. He’s not bad.”
“If he’s so nice, then there’s no good left in the world!”
Murong Xue rolled her eyes, then sighed as she looked at Zhuo Fan, “I don’t need to say anything. His attack painted a target on him. The Sea Bright Sect will place a high value on him and it’s just a matter of time before he’s found out.”
“Then let him… fake for a while longer.” Shangguan Qingyan sighed as looked at Zhuo Fan with deep concern.
Murong Xue sighed and shook her head.
One guard saw everything that had happened and whispered to Zhuo Fan, “Sir, I fear we’re now the center of attention. Our cover will be blown.”
“I know.”
Zhuo Fan glanced at the peaceful Chu Qingcheng and smiled, “But it was all worth it. Qingcheng shouldn’t have been like these for so many years and should close her eyes and get well. It’s what I owe her, what I…”
Zhuo Fan looked lost and the guard understood as he retreated.
Shui Ruohua stared into Zhuo Fan’s expressive eyes with astonishment, “Sir, why do I find you familiar? Have we met?”
Zhuo Fan remained silent.
Whoosh~
Exalted Hei Ran suddenly landed before them.
Giving a long look to Zhuo Fan, he helped Ye Lin from the ground and cupped his hands, “Thank you, sir, for your help. How may I address you?”
“Steward Qian Fan.” Zhuo Fan replied.
Exalted Hei Ran started, “Qian clan, from the northern lands…”
“Yes.”
“Oh, northern lands have such amazing talent!” Exalted Hei Ran gave him one last look then cursed inside.
He thought Ye Lin and Zhuo Fan from western lands were the peak of what was humanly possible in terms of talent. Now he found that there was one more obscene genius, from northern lands.
[Talent comes in all sizes in every generation and from anywhere.]
[The world will change.]
Exalted Hei Ran inspected Ye Lin’s weak body then said to Shui Ruohua, “Take Qingcheng, I’m taking you back to look after your wounds.”
“Hold!”
Shui Ruohua rushed to obey and take Chu Qingcheng, but Zhuo Fan intervened.
Zhuo Fan looked at Chu Qingcheng with her eyes closed and said, “Only brother here is wounded. Senior can just take him. Miss needs peace to get well, don’t disturb her. You can all mind yourself, since he is far more important to you, sir. It’s best if you don’t delay his healing.”
Ugh!
Exalted Hei Ran knew sarcasm when he heard it. A clear criticism for abandoning them over Ye Lin. He sighed and cupped his hands again before leaving with Ye Lin.
Shui Ruohua was stumped as to what to do.
Whoosh~
Ouyang Lingtian came next, on the stage and raised his hand at the uncaring son, who was now shaking in fear at his dad’s presence.
“You fool, you almost sent us all to oblivion, you know that?”
“I know, the elders told me.” He held his head with a guilty look, quickly changing topics, “But shouldn’t we be tending to the world channel and seal it first? We need to stop the power from flowing in. Uh, why is there no more sword energy in the sky?”
Ouyang
Lingtian huffed in anger, “There’s no need to seal it, not when it closed itself.”
“How peculiar, then…”
“Weren’t you saying that you were clueless and that the elders had to fill you in?” Ouyang Lingtian railed it on him, “Damn brat, listen up! The worldly power needs to be drawn into the secular world to be controlled. To simplify, your art did that. The world went berserk because you changed the target of the drawing. Like before, the ice dragon became the target, making it so the worldly power focused on him. Once the ice dragon is no more, then there’s no one drawing it. Of course the world will return to normal!”
Ouyang Changqing bobbed his head.
A weakened yet firm voice reached them, “Ouyang Changqing, let’s fight again!”
It was Ye Lin who was now carried away by Exalted Hei Ran.
“Humph, just a fight. Next time I’ll just use one art to beat you again. Let me tell you, the best in the alliance will one day be yours truly, ha-ha-ha…”
Bam!
Ouyang Lingtian had enough of his boasting and cuffed him over the head, “You’re fighting nothing! Haven’t you caused enough trouble? And I thought the best in the four lands had been settled already.”
Ouyang Lingtian’s eyes shone as he looked at Zhuo Fan.
Everyone stared as well in realization.
[Maybe not only the best disciple in the alliance…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1027: Watched
chapters.content:
Chapter 1027: Watched
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Ouyang Changqing felt conflicted as he looked at Zhuo Fan. He could tell the other was strong, but did not mean he was ready to admit it, “Unless a proper match is taking place, no one can say who’s stronger!”
“What’s the point? That exchange was enough to show the difference between you.”
Ouyang Lingtian gave him a sharp glare then spoke heavily, “That ice dragon is something you and the western lands disciple have made with your power. It can be said he fought both of you then and easily beat it. He is far above you in this aspect and…”
Ouyang Lingtian grew silent at the end and Ouyang Changqing got curious, “And?”
“The ice dragon used your strongest Heaven Sealing Sword Art yet he easily broke it. This shows he is above you. He is in another class than you who are fighting for the best disciple in the four lands. You just can’t win against him.”
Murong Xue was the one to finish Ouyang Lingtian’s words.
He was staring at his father with eyes filled with questions and Ouyang Lingtian nodded, “Xue’er is right. I’ve been fighting for so many years, but not once have I seen any divine sword’s power being restrained. Not even Invincible Sword’s Sundering Sword Art has such power. But he… just who is he?”
Ouyang Lingtian stared at Zhuo Fan filled with doubt. The others were also curious, trying to guess his background. At the very least, they could rule out being a tiny steward to some merchant clan.
Murong Xue kept her promise to Shangguan Qingyan and did not say a word. Not like they needed her help, since Zhuo Fan gave himself away in broad daylight. He was in the limelight and there was no escaping it.
Sea Bright Sect was not about to overlook such a mysterious and dangerous element slipping into their home either.
They were all looking tense, trying to pick his every tell. Zhuo Fan acted oblivious, just sitting there with a girl on his shoulder not wanting to disturb her.
“I am Ouyang Lingtian of Sea Bright Sect. Who might sir be and where do you come from? What brings you to the Sea Bright Sect?” Seeing how the strange mood had no effect on Zhuo Fan, Ouyang Lingtian came over before this seemingly Radiant Stage cultivator, he dared not disrespect in the least.
The rest looked intently at the exchange. Ouyang Changqing still refused to believe what was happening. His father, the best in northern lands, was paying respects to some junior. It only went to prove how much the best in northern lands evaluated Zhuo Fan, no less than at his level.
Since he got rid of the Heaven Sealing Sword Art in one move, it meant that such power was the nemesis of the Heaven Sealing Sword. As its wielder, he was definitely concerned.
While the cultivation was far below, the skill used put him on edge.
Zhuo Fan gave him a look and knew he could no longer play innocent, having got to his usual mysterious and calculative self. He regarded the extremely respectful northern lands senior and spoke casually, “Senior Ouyang, I am only a steward of the Qian clan coming to deliver goods. Let’s leave it at that.”
“Qian steward? Ha-ha-ha, does sir take me for a child? We know everything about the Qian clan and there’s no one like you among it.”
Ouyang Lingtian shook his head, “I don’t want to force sir to be honest, but the situation is critical now. Your sudden presence here terrifies us all. I have no choice but to offend sir to avoid any problems. I can only ask for your forgiveness.”
Ouyang Lingtian’s face was cold, giving the elders a look.
The dozens of Genesis Stage elders had the merchant group surrounded.
The guards tensed, awaiting for Zhuo Fan’s orders.
Shangguan Qingyan started, clenching her fists with a frown and a pained heart.
Murong Xue shook her head, while the western lands disciples and Sea Bright Sect disciples watched the events unfold.
Shui Ruohua and the other girl were just confused, looking at Zhuo Fan in wonderment.
[How did he turn dangerous? Who is he, to need to arrest him?]
Zhuo Fan didn’t move still, looking gracefully at the peaceful girl leaning on him.
He then glanced at Ouyang Lingtian, “Senior Ouyang, could you give me a moment to sit better?”
“Sit better? What for?” Ouyang Lingtian had no idea what trick Zhuo Fan was trying to pull.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Senior Ouyang, I just want to sit and nothing else. After all the destruction the ice dragon caused, it will make for a nice sunset to enjoy with the ice covering everything.”
[Enjoy the sunset?]
Ouyang Lingtian’s brow twitched, looking around the icy and snow-covered ruins, then at Zhuo Fan with a dump look.
[What’s up with this guy? There’s no shock, panic, fear, nor anger, just the intention to watch the scenery? Is he alright?]
Ouyang Lingtian was floored by the deep eyes behind the eagle mask.
Zhuo Fan’s request had him stumped. The others let Ouyang Lingtian take the lead and would not stop now.
So all were looking dumb at Zhuo Fan, who just wanted to enjoy twilight.
They had seen their fair share of people in their long lives as cultivators, against sly weasels or rash fools, but Zhuo Fan took the cake.
Chu Qingcheng opened her eyes, much clearer than before, but still vacant. She then left Zhuo Fan’s side.
“Qingcheng is awake.”
Shui Ruohua lit up and spoke in gratitude, “After all these years, this is the first time she had such a peaceful rest. Even with all the chaos around, it’s a miracle she could sleep for so long…”
Shui Ruohua teared up. Zhuo Fan nodded at Chu Qingcheng and said, “Senior Ouyang, let’s go. Miss Shui, I’ll leave Miss Chu in your care.”
“Did you stay like that so you won’t disturb her?”
Ouyang Lingtian saw Zhuo Fan showing no change but then it hit him, “I get it now. Sir, after you.”
Ouyang Lingtian gestured and a couple elders approached Zhuo Fan to detain him. Zhuo Fan didn’t fight, walking away with a deep gaze as Shui Ruohua held Chu Qingcheng.
[Qingcheng, after I save young Sanzi, I will come get you and will never leave your side again…]
Pa!
He barely made a step as Chu Qingcheng reached out and gripped Zhuo Fan’s hand.
Zhuo Fan started and looked on with hope.
[Is Qingcheng awake…]
What he saw was the same empty eyes, even as her soft hand held on to him, like something precious, unwilling to let go.
Shui Ruohua tried to pull her, but the grip wouldn’t give.
Shui Ruohua was awkward, looking puzzled.
[What’s got into Chu Qingcheng?]
Zhuo Fan knew that she reached for him out of instinct.
No matter when or where, even with her faded mind, her memories gone, her feelings would never change. Chu Qingcheng was holding on to Zhuo Fan all because of those feelings.
Zhuo Fan’s heart was in pain again, speaking firmly to Ouyang Lingtian, “Senior Ouyang, could you also bring Miss wherever you’re taking me?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1028: Snow Peak Four Elders
chapters.content:
Chapter 1028: Snow Peak Four Elders
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Sure, as long as the people from western lands agree.”
He gave Chu Qingcheng a long look and understood the situation, that it would not help Zhuo Fan’s case either way. By looking at their hands so tightly held, Ouyang Lingtian had a guess as to what they might be. There was no reason not to indulge him this small request and nodded.
He couldn’t just as well turn antagonistic, not before having an idea of who Zhuo Fan was, where he came from and the side he took.
Zhuo Fan gave a smile and a nod, then turned to Shui Ruohua.
She got the idea, seeing how Chu Qingcheng and him were so close, it might actually work in Chu Qingcheng’s favor and help her recover faster. She gave her approval and let go of Chu Qingcheng’s hands.
Chu Qingcheng showed a faint smile, finally at Zhuo Fan’s side and sticking to his arm like glue.
Sea Bright Sect’s elder escorted Zhuo Fan and the guards under careful watch, just like prisoners.
Shangguan Qingyan witnessed from the side with worry for Zhuo Fan on one hand, and confusion on the other. Zhuo Fan had never been thoughtful to any woman around her, to the point he’d even do all he could not to disturb her sleep.
[But who is she?]
“Junior sister Shui, what is going on? Who is he and why did you let junior sister Qingcheng go with him?”
“I don’t know either, but they seem to be very close. Qingcheng felt at peace around him. I believe that letting her stay with him will help her recover.”
Wu Qingqiu rushed to Shui Ruohua for an answer, but she didn’t know much else either.
Yan Mo grumbled, “How can you be so careless? He’s too much of an enigma and has the Sea Bright Sect watching him. By letting Chu Qingcheng go with him might end up with using her as a shield in the end. How are we going to save her then, in Sea Bright Sect’s home no less? They wouldn’t just cave under his conditions just because you’re a western lands disciple.”
“What else was I supposed to do? You saw it too, her hands were glued to him and wouldn’t let go.”
“Her mind is lost, so of course she’s being hard on us. Don’t you get that simple truth?”
“Why you…”
Yan Mo and Shui Ruohua bickered, with Wu Qingqiu frowning in thought. He then rushed over and cupped his hands at Ouyang Lingtian, “Senior Ouyang, my junior sister with a frail mind has now gone with that unknown man. I only ask senior to look after her if anything happens…”
“I understand, you don’t have to say it. But there’s no need to worry, since he has no ill-will towards your junior sister.” Ouyang Lingtian cut him off with a dismissive wave.
Wu Qingqiu looked lost, “Senior, how are you so sure…”
“His feelings for your junior sister are plain to see and she leans on him too. This can’t be faked.” Ouyang Lingtian spoke, “I’ve been around for many years and can read a situation. Your junior sister will be in complete safety at his side, ha-ha-ha…”
Ouyang Lingtian laughed and patted his shoulder then left them there confused.
Ouyang Lingtian walked to his son and raised his hand, making Ouyang Changqing tuck his head and kneel with a sullen look.
Ouyang Lingtian watched his reckless and wild son with gnashed teeth, lowering his hand in the end, resorting to chiding, “Damn it boy, have you any idea what storm you stirred today? You not only caused so much harm to your fellow disciple sealed as they are, needing to be taken to Heaven Sealing Pavilion to recover, you also forced me to take the Heaven Sealing Sword from its place, weakening the barrier. What if Invincible Sword used this chance to strike? If the sect fell, it would all be on you!”
“I need to get the sword back at once and report to Sect Leader about Steward Qian. Once everything is settled I’ll come deal with you!”
Ouyang Lingtian flicked his sleeve and flew away, leaving Ouyang Changqing with a pained gaze and disgruntled face.
[Then I wish for it to never settle! As long as dad’s busy, he won’t deal with me.]
“This Ouyang Changqing…”
Murong Xue could read him like a book, shaking her head and saying, “Yan’er, don’t you think he hasn’t matured one bit-, uh, Yan’er…”
Shangguan Qingyan wasn’t there though.
Wu Qingqiu had got Ouyang Lingtian’s answer and consoled his group before leaving as well.
As he went, Wu Qingqiu’s mind was deep in thought.
Shui Ruohua suddenly found her path blocked by someone unnexpected, “Miss, are you…”
“Shangguan Qingyan from eastern lands.” She made a bow.
Shui Ruohua looked puzzled, “Miss Shangguan, why have you suddenly appeared like this?”
“I want to know everything about that lady, down to the smallest detail. Can you tell me?” Shangguan Qingyan looked straight in Shui Ruohua’s eyes.
Shui Ruohua started in confusion.
[Why is she interested in Qingcheng?]
Shui Ruohua gauged her restless eyes and nodded in the end…
An hour later, the moon now replaced the sun in the sky as the night fell.
A flash of light appeared on Beyond Heaven Island, on the highest pavilion, connecting it to the sky, making it a true abode of immortals.
Ouyang Lingtian appeared here, walking towards the copper pillar, two meters tall by half meter wide, covered in signs that glowed faintly.
He took a deep breath, and presented the Heaven Sealing Sword with utmost respect, “I have borrowed the divine sword and now come to return it. I ask the four venerables to activate the barrier and put the divine sword in its rightful place!”
“Ha-ha-ha, that was quick.”
An aged voice echoed in the pavilion, followed by the appearance of four elders with white beards on each side of the copper pillar, “Lingtian, we have lent the sword on account of the sect being in mortal danger. Now that you have come to return it, we would like some answers.”
Ouyang Lingtian shook his head, “The misfortune of the sect came upon by my wretched son, almost unleashing a calamity…”
Ouyang Lingtian sighed and gave a full account of the events. The elders turned grave.
“Changqing is a good seed with his amazing talent, but it got to his head and affects his mind. The stronger he is the bigger the fall. Lingtian, he’s your son and you need to set him straight. Regardless of his great future, it will only bring glory to the sect as long as he walks on the righteous path. But if he turns evil, the world will suffer. He cannot be indulged!”
“I shall take Venerable’s advice to heart.” Ouyang Lingtian felt ashamed.
The four made signs and the barrier on the pillar opened. One elder gestured and the Heaven Sealing Sword in Ouyang Lingtian’s hands flew above the copper pillar, hovering quietly.
The elders changed their signs and the barrier was restored.
The Heaven Sealing Sword shone brightly in an icy blue glow, but withe barrier in place, it did not travel far, sucked in by the copper pillar.
The entire sect’s barrier shook then and took on an icy blue glow, mystical and enchanting.
The four elders nodded, “Now the sect barrier is strong and peace is restored. Not even Invincible Sword can get in, ha-ha-ha…”
“Yes, Venerables, I shall now take my leave as I have matters to discuss with Sect Leader.” Patriarch bowed.
The four waved him off and he withdrew.
Their eyes, however, failed to notice a delicate shadow watching on like a viper.
“That’s why there’s not a guard around Heaven Sealing Pavilion, the strongest four sword guardians, Snow Peak Four Elders, watch it.”
The pillar’s shadow wiggled and Bali Yuyu appeared in the darkness, looking at the four elders with a frown, “The four combined have the power of a Sword King, just as strong as Ouyang Lingtian. Getting the sword will be difficult, not to mention a long battle that will draw in more trouble. What to do?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1029: Desperate Measures
chapters.content:
Chapter 1029: Desperate Measures
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Bali Yuyu stared hard at the four elders from the shadows, hesitation plaguing her heart. Zhuo Fan had her take the sword tonight, but it was obvious that wouldn’t go as smoothly in the best sect of northern lands, even for a Sword King like herself.
[God damn it, what now? I’m not good when it comes to thinking!]
Bali Yuyu couldn’t see any way out of this.
[What would that punk do?]
Seeing him always coming up with a plan for everything, then this situation oughtn’t be any different.
[Why can’t I think of anything then?]
She was scrounging up all the brain power she could muster for a way out, though she still came up empty.,
The Heaven Sealing Sword was behind a barrier and was also powering it. That meant she no longer had any way of taking it by force. To say nothing of the four strong elders guarding it.
It was a flawless defense that she had no way of breaching.
[Should I just go back and ask him?]
Thinking about it, Bali Yuyu’s mind wandered, but then shook the thought away.
[No, I agreed to take the sword tonight. Getting stuck and going to him for help will only make him laugh at me. I am the great Frigid Rain Sword King for crying out loud!]
[Though it’s clear that force won’t give me any result. What do I do then?]
[What’s more, I can’t see any way of passing the unbreakable defense, so what could he do?]
[Yeah, he can’t do anything either. Besides, he had me come here to scout, while taking the sword over an afternoon is too hasty. His plan’s the one with issues here, having nothing to do with me. Even if I dump this problem on him, he can’t solve it either.]
[Yep, definitely no solution. So there’s no indignity in going back with an unsolvable problem.]
Bali Yuyu found the perfect excuse and simply gave up. She blended with the darkness and slipped away.
She was going to Zhuo Fan to complain about this impossible task.
Although Zhuo Fan had other matters to attend to at the moment, with the Sea Bright Sect setting its eyes on him…
In the Sea Bright Sect’s hall, Ouyang Lingtian stepped lightly and was stunned by what he saw.
Besides Sect Leader Ling Yuntian, there was also Exalted Hei Ran and Sun Sea Sect’s Bu Xingyun.
Ouyang Lingtian soon came to a realization and bowed, “Sect Leader, I assume you know.”
“Of course.”
Ling Yuntian pointed at the two, “Exalted Hei Ran and Sect Leader Bu had explained everything. I knew there was something special about Steward Qian, but even I didn’t think he’d be so extraordinary. I’m stunned to hear that he destroyed a spirit formed by the worldly power in one blow. You know as well as I that only with the help of a divine sword can we hope to fight back when the power of the world converges.”
Bu Xingyun rolled his eyes, “Sect Leader Ling, why are you still praising him? He’s a spy, central area’s. My sect has already found him out. This only proves it!”
“That’s too soon to tell.”
Exalted Hei Ran waved, “His skills are baffling and equally strong, but there’s little evidence to support he came to Sea Bright Sect for nefarious reasons. Wild speculation will only harm the innocent.”
“Harm an innocent? What kind of good can a man of unknown background bring in coming to Sea Bright Sect? If not a central area spy, what, here to wish long life at Sect Leader Ling’s birthday? So what if he is innocent? In these times of crisis, desperate measures are a must, like culling all unknown elements.”
“Absolutely not, it will only bring more problems if we just kill without finding out who he is.” Exalted Hei Ran refuted that proposal, frowning at the dreaded outcome.
Bu Xingyun mocked, “Are you talking about the buzzing news about Devil Mountain’s calamity? Humph, Exalted Hei Ran must now be paranoid. First of all, no one has ever seen Devil Mountain and it can just as well be fake. Secondly, even if it’s real, you think its disciples are all over the place? You think you’re just going to bump into one at every step?”
“The chances this time are high.”
Exalted Hei Ran winced, “His strength is beyond comprehension. How many youths in the lands can match him? Who else but Devil Mountain could bring about such a disciple? If he does come from there, all the more reason we cannot mess with him.”
“Devil Mountain must’ve sapped all your nerves. If Devil Mountain’s disciple is against northern lands, are we just going to watch with a smile?”
“Devil Mountain never involves itself with secular matters. As long as we don’t touch them, they won’t bother us either.”
“What if they touch us?”
“No, this has never happened before…”
“Alright!”
Ling Yuntian stepped in their quarrel, shouting, “This is the Sea Bright Sect. We decide how we handle suspects here. It’s not your problem to consider.”
The two huffed in anger.
Ling Yuntian sighed and said, “Lingtian, how did you deal with him?”
“I dared not do anything without Sect Leader’s approval. From what I’ve learned of his actions, he is not just anyone and would not make things harder. For now, the elders have sealed their Yuan Qi and placed it behind a barrier, awaiting Sect Leader’s orders!”
“And what about the matter of the sealed Soaring Sword?” Ling Yuntian asked.
Ouyang Lingtian shook his head, “The sealing and breaking ways from the Heaven Sealing Sword we know of should be supreme, but it seems this seal on Soaring Sword is so strange that neither method, or any other, work. It makes us wonder who the culprit could be to know of such incredible sealing. We will need time to research it before we can break it.”
“Shangguan Feixiong is one stubborn fool, insisting on releasing the seal all by himself, even after half a year of fruitless results. If it hadn’t been for us two old men stumbling upon this three days ago, we might have never known, ha-ha-ha…” Exalted Hei Ran sighed.
Ouyang Lingtian nodded, “Hei Ran, you have the cheek to say that? You’d never tell us either. It’d still be in the dark if it weren’t for Murong Lie calling me to help.”
“The old coot had us keep our lips sealed so he wouldn’t look bad.”
“You two geezers have no sense of priorities to actually agree with him.” Ouyang Lingtian rolled his eyes.
Ling Yuntian turned grave, “The unsealing of the Soaring Sword takes the highest priority as of now. Once the seal is lifted and all leaders of every land gathered, we can then investigate Steward Qian and discuss how to address the issue.”
They all agreed, with only Bu Xingyun grumbling, “Just kill him and be done with it!”
“Also!”
Ling Yuntian glared at him, “Sect Leader Bu, you’re in Sea Bright Sect. Could you please respect our rules? Keep your eyes to yourself.”
Ugh!
Bu Xingyun winced, “Sect Leader Ling, what’s that supposed to mean?”
“Ha-ha-ha, Sect Leader Bu is sure to know. In the Sea Bright Sect, I know everything that’s happening. You had your disciple monitor Qian Fan’s group. How else would you have known so fast and be the first to report to me on this matter?”
“I-I’m only doing it for the safety of Sea Bright Sect. Sect Leader Ling, please don’t misunderstand.” Bu Xingyun gave a forced smile.
Pa!
Ling Yuntian patted his shoulder with a smile, “If Sect Leader Bu wants me not to misunderstand, then please take actions that aren’t subjected to suspicion. Try not to overstep again.”
Bu Xingyun gave him a long look and shook as he nodded.
[This guy ain’t as kind on the inside as on the outside…]
In a rather spacious cell, Zhuo Fan’s team sat calmly with their cultivation sealed. The walls were unbreakable and even many spatial barriers in place to prevent any from getting out.
Qiao’er was the only one overlooked, the Sea Bright Sect elders buying into her actually genuine childish act. How tough could a child be?
Zhuo Fan looked calm, ignoring the dark mood in the cell, holding on to the pretty girl’s hand.
“Sir, what do we do now? It’s completely opposite from our plan.” One guard asked.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “If the plan can’t keep up with reality, it can only adapt to include the changes. At worst, we’ll be waiting a few days in here before we get to work.”
“They’re not letting us out of their sights. Is sir that sure?”
“Why else would I be so calm? Now stop talking.” Zhuo Fan glared at him and sighed as he turned to the numb Chu Qingcheng, “I’m happy that this at least lets us be together. With how dangerous the trip to the North Sea is, even one moment more is enough…”
Clap~
Clapping resounded in the empty place, followed by laughter, “Ha-ha-ha, I was right. Brother Zhuo, it’s really you. You’re still alive and finally came back…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1030: Constant Visitation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1030: Constant Visitation
Proofreader
: Papatonks
With a shaky brow behind the eagle mask, Zhuo Fan looked beyond the bars on reflex. The jail door opened with a creak and the unchanged figure of Wu Qingqiu stepped in before him.
With a pleased smile, he looked in excitement as he got closer and closer to Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan shook his head with a chuckle, “What gave it away?”
“Of everyone on this heaven’s green earth, only brother Zhuo would ever feel so much love for junior sister Qingcheng. This goes both ways as well, with junior sister Qingcheng only ever trusting brother Zhuo from the bottom of her heart.”
Wu Qingqiu’s eyes shone and sighed, “I had a hard time believing that a good friend who has been gone for so many years would appear before me. It was thanks to senior Ouyang’s words that had me jump to such a wild conclusion. He said you would never harm junior sister out of love and he was right. That leaves only you who has such undying love for her. Thus the only solution, however impossible and no matter how unlikely the person, is the most probable. For which I have come to see if you’re real.”
Zhuo Fan shook his head. He traced the eagle mask and slowly lowered it, “Brother Wu is wise beyond his years. You found me out. Without me or Ye Lin back then, western lands would’ve had you as its best disciple. Brother Wu is without equal.”
“I knew it. Y-you’re really here…”
Ignoring his words, Wu Qingqiu took in his calm smile and sharp eyes as emotions overwhelmed him. He needed a good minute to get his heart to calm down, “It was truly a shot in the darkest of abysses, yet it ended up being real. Where have you been all these years, even leaving your wife behind?”
Zhuo Fan looked back and said nothing.
Wu Qingqiu glanced at the ever soothed yet vacant Chu Qingcheng on his arm with a crestfallen look, “A man always wants to leave his mark. Whatever business you had that needed finishing, no one could’ve stopped you. Junior sister Qingcheng is very reasonable and would’ve let you go. The least you could’ve done was to come back safely and not do this to junior sister. Her hair not only turned white but she also closed her mind to everyone. As for you, I see you’ve recovered from your pain, by the looks of your fine black hair, doing quite well for yourself. I barely recognized you.”
Wu Qingqiu’s tone held some blame and anger at how Zhuo Fan treated Chu Qingcheng, who he saw as a good sister.
Zhuo Fan had no retort, taking in all of his rebuke.
“You have been someone we admire the most, especially by Yan Mo and of course by little junior brother.”
Wu Qingqiu glared at him, “You’ve excelled in mind and in strength, earning our full respect. When we heard that you had been killed, many of us wanted revenge. We had taken upon ourselves to take care of the widow you left behind. Even that rampant Yan Mo is thoughtful towards junior sister Qingcheng, all because everyone in our generation sees you as the true best in western lands. And what did you do? Faked your death and vanished for four-five years. You have let down junior sister Qingcheng who has always been hoping for your return, and you have let down your brothers who looked up to you.”
Wu Qingqiu’s tone only grew angrier.
Zhuo Fan took a deep breath, feeling shame, “Be it four or five years, it’s still a long time. I believed that I could take on everything myself. Qingcheng would’ve been in pain but then followed by relief as in a decade or two, her wound would begin to heal and in fifty years she would’ve moved on. A century later, she wouldn’t even remember me. The deepest love would be buried in the sands of time, right? But…”
Zhuo Fan felt his heart bleed every time he looked into those dull eyes of his wife.
“Junior sister Qingcheng didn’t even wait. The moment you were proclaimed dead, her heart died with you.” Wu Qingqiu was grave, “I just want to know, why didn’t you come back if you were safe? No matter how much you changed, she still could tell it was you even back at the stage. Maybe if you stay with her, you could open her heart again. In the matters of the heart, only the cause can heal it. No pill in this world can heal her, for you are her cure.”
Zhuo Fan shook his head in desolation, “I cannot see her, because I hope she will learn to forget me…”
“Why?”
“It’s for her own good. I don’t want to hurt her.” Zhuo Fan squeezed her hand, “If I die tomorrow, am I supposed to let her die with me?”
Wu Qingqiu started, “What’s that supposed to mean?”
“My life isn’t my own and can be reaped at a whim. I just don’t want to burden her.” Zhuo Fan gave a long sigh.
Wu Qingqiu was stunned, “I may not know what trouble you’re in, but I can see your point. Are you saying that all you’ve done was for her to live?”
Zhuo Fan nodded, his eyes glazing from being weary.
“Sorry, I forgot myself there. I should’ve known you’d never be so cruel to junior sister Qingcheng.” Wu Qingqiu relented and bowed after some thought.
Zhuo Fan waved his hand, “It’s fine, telling me off actually made me feel a bit better. I am rather very grateful to you and all who took the time to look after Qingcheng these years.”
Wu Qingqiu shook his head, “It’s what a fellow brother does, all natural.”
“What natural, you don’t understand women at all!”
A nagging voice came out from behind, “If I may say so, and the eldest senior brother of Double Dragon Manor, you should be tearing into this cruel man for dumping his wife!”
The two looked back to see with a start that it was Shangguan Qingyan with red eyes from crying and looking at them with indignation.
Zhuo Fan was puzzled, “What are you doing here? What do you think the jail of Sea Bright Sect is? This isn’t a playground.”
“Yeah, I told seniors outside not to let anyone disturb us. Why can you…” Wu Qingqiu looked baffled at her.
Bang~
Shangguan Qingyan stomped on her way over, cursing in the meantime, “I know you’re Double Dragon Manor’s eldest senior brother Wu Qingqiu and that those seniors let you in because of your importance in Double Dragon Manor, but you’re just a disciple. I, however, am the young miss of the Shangguan clan, the apple of my father’s eye. So who do you think those oldies will favor more?”
Ugh!
Wu Qingqiu was lost for words.
[True, Double Dragon Manor is leading western lands, but I’m just a disciple within its grounds. No matter how much favor I have, it’ll last for a few decades tops. When the next batch of new guys come, I’ll soon be forgotten.]
While the Shangguan clan of eastern lands would always hold their young miss in the highest regard regardless. Their statuses were just worlds apart.
Those oldies would of course not step on eastern lands’ young miss’ toes the most.
Wu Qingqiu rolled his eyes and grumbled.
[Sea Bright Sect’s elders sure are tough.]
He failed to notice that they wouldn’t let a western lands disciple see their greatest suspect unless they were tough. It was all due to not wanting to piss off Double Dragon Manor that was behind him that they let him through.
As pissing off Double Dragon Manor meant pissing off all of western lands. They couldn’t take the blame.
The same went for Shangguan Qingyan.
So this young missy stormed into the jail and right in Zhuo Fan’s face as she glared.
“Uh, young miss Shangguan, did I do something to anger you?”
Zhuo Fan looked confused.
Shangguan Qingyan’s lip trembled and nodded, “Yeah, you did, because you have no clue what women think!”
[Uh, come again?]
Zhuo Fan paused, turning to Wu Qingqiu for answers but he was just as clueless, offering an unhelpful shrug.
“Zhuo Fan, I know all about you and your wife, every single detail!”
Shangguan Qingyan’s eyes flared with anger, “You’ve gone through so much together, so why are you such a blockhead? Don’t you see what she wants?”
Zhuo Fan winced, turning grave…

chapters.title: Chapter 1031 - 1031, Breakout
chapters.content:
Chapter 1031, Breakout
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Staring at Zhuo Fan’s clueless face, Shangguan Qingyan sighed and her features softened, “You said in the central area that you abandoned your wife because she would die with you, right? But what if that was what she wanted?”
“Well I didn’t!”
Zhuo Fan spoke heavily, “I just couldn’t have her enter hell because of me. It’s like pushing her into the abyss. I’m no saint, but this is something I could never do.”
“Yet your wife was more than happy to join you in hell!”
“No, unacceptable!” Zhuo Fan shook his head, “She wants to be with me so of course I want to as well. But being selfish for a brief period would get her killed, something I don’t want to see. That’s why it’s better if she forgets me.”
Zhuo Fan caressed Chu Qingcheng’s white hair, hurt just by seeing her so unresponsive. “But not like this. I only hoped she would forget me alone…”
“She forgot everyone, even herself, all but you, right?” Shangguan Qingyan glanced at the dull gaze of Chu Qingcheng and teared up again.
Zhuo Fan shook and closed his eyes. Recalling how Chu Qingcheng shunned any at the fight earlier, while only showing fondness to him, a stranger in an eagle mask, he hurt even more.
Shangguan Qingyan lowered her head and sighed, “I don’t want eternity, only a moment. Zhuo Fan, these were Chu Qingcheng’s last words. Do you know what they mean?”
“What?”
“I’ve pressed senior sister Ruohua for every detail and she said Miss Chu had always been muttering this right before she lost herself.”
Shangguan Qingyan sighed, “Sir Zhuo is a man of lofty ambitions and achievements. Be it as Zhuo Fan or Gu Yifan, any place that he’s found in is bound to be overturned and danger to follow. Miss Chu was ready. Since she chose you, she was willing to accept everything. She didn’t mind not spending eternity together, as long as she was there next to you. This was her deepest wish.
“But you had been so selfish and decided by yourself to cut it off. You said it’s all for her, so she could be safe and away from you, but did you ever stop to think what she wanted? You gave her all you could, but robbed her of all she wanted. She is living well, but she might as well be dead. Sir Zhuo, is this your love for her? such selfishness…”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shook, his body trembled, filled with regret as he looked at Chu Qingcheng’s dull features.
[I was truly wrong…]
[True demonic cultivators can break away from the hypocrisies and deceits, but they can’t fight love, ha-ha-ha…]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes were filled with sorrow.
[A demon should never have felt attachment. Attachment cuts off the demonic path and traps you.]
[I could scheme over anything in the world, but always become powerless in the face of love. I wanted what’s best for my wife, but ended up hurting her the most.]
If this was a backlash, then Zhuo Fan admitted he failed in this aspect.
Not only was his wife hurt, but he was crushed in this battle as well…
Zhuo Fan stood with a blank stare, with Shangguan Qingyan and Wu Qingqiu feeling his pain.
The greatest pain in the world was having the opposite outcome of what you intended. What he thought would get him the best of both worlds ended up with him losing everything.
Pa!
A sudden hand gently landed on Zhuo Fan’s confused face.
Zhuo Fan looked startled at Chu Qingcheng, running her hand through his hair in an effort to console him.
Alas, those same empty eyes stared back into his soul.
Wu Qingqiu lit up, “Brother Zhuo, don’t lose heart. Ever since you came, junior sister Qingcheng has shown great improvement. I believe that as long as brother Zhuo stays, junior sister Qingcheng is sure to get better!”
“Yes, now that I’m here, I will help her get well and never leave again.”
Touching the gentle hand on his hair, Zhuo Fan stood and looked in Chu Qingcheng’s eyes as he spoke, “Even in death, I will always hold your hand. I won’t let you walk the earth alone ever again…”
Shangguan Qingyan and Wu Qingqiu nodded with a smile. Though the former felt her own heartache.
She was happy that Zhuo Fan reunited with his dear wife, but it was also the cause of her pain.
In the end, she rooted for the pair, to have a happy reunion and be together. As for herself, she felt great even only being young Sanzi’s aunt.
Shangguan Qingyan smiled, brighter than ever before. Wu Qingqiu looked dumbstruck as he smiled back.
Chu Qingcheng began to show signs of a smile too, a flicker of life coming and going in her empty eyes.
Bam!
The jail door was slammed open, making them jump. A bloody corpse missing an arm and leg flew in.
The feisty woman showing up waltzed inside and shouted at Zhuo Fan, “Brat, you alright? I came to get you out.”
“Who are you? There are thirty Genesis Stage experts outside. How did you get in here?” Wu Qingqiu gasped.
The woman smirked, “What can thirty puny Genesis old farts do anyway? They should be proud they could hold me for even a second. But what’s with this jail’s design, putting two Soul Harmony Stage brats as guards at the end? I say, they’re more and more rotten, ha-ha-ha…”
She flashed before the two with bloodthirst, ready to end them.
Wu Qingqiu’s eyes widened in panic. With how strong she looked, she of course had no trouble dealing with the Genesis elders outside, and silently too.
[She is deadly!]
She could kill them as easily as squashing ants and they couldn’t even make a peep while at it.
Wu Qingqiu grew grave and pale, sighing. Just what was wrong with today, always putting them in imminent danger?
“Stop, Yuyu!”
It was then a shout came.
The bloodthirst-fueled finger halted and she looked from them to Zhuo Fan, “What’s the point in letting them live?”
Bali Yuyu failed to get the sword from the Heaven Sealing Pavilion and came back to discuss it with Zhuo Fan. There she found their team locked up.
So while her head didn’t always work straight, her fist was more than enough to compensate. She made the bright decision to break Zhuo Fan out and ask his big brain for a plan.
Having him stuck behind bars left her with no clue what to do next.
“They’re friends coming for a visit, not guards. Don’t hurt them.” Zhuo Fan waved.
Whether accustomed or not, she actually listened with a shrug and patted the two, “Oh, on the same side, ha-ha-ha. Sorry about that, don’t mind it.”
“Uh, it’s fine, just don’t mind it at all, ha-ha-ha…” Wu Qingqiu looked tense, giving Zhuo Fan a puzzled look.
[What the hell has he been up to these years? Where did she find this powerhouse? Is she from Devil Mountain too?]
[Oh, Devil Mountain!]
With all the memories being refreshed, he forgot to ask if Devil Mountain was real or just a thorough lie.
But then glancing at Bali Yuyu, Wu Qingqiu flinched and kept his doubts to himself.
[Better leave it for later.]
Shangguan Qingyan was so terrified, she couldn’t even make a peep.
Bali Yuyu ignored the harmless brats and mocked, “Hey, Steward Qian, what’s going on? I’ve been out with work for a bit and you got yourself imprisoned? You even had me come break you out. Steward Qian, has your shrewd mind finally come up empty for once? He-he-he…”
“How stuck-up you are.”
Zhuo Fan turned to the others with a smile, “See this face, allow me to teach you a life lesson. The next time you see someone like this, you’re to step on it and beat it without remorse. For the moment one gets cocky over nothing, you’ll come to regret having not hit it when you could.”
Bali Yuyu giggled, but then her face sank…

chapters.title: Chapter 1032 - 1032, You Can Go
chapters.content:
Chapter 1032, You Can Go
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Bali Yuyu gnashed her teeth and spat, “Rotten punk, you let your mouth run off and ended up in jail. Now I come to save you out of the kindness of my heart but instead of thanks you’re mocking me? What would you have done if I hadn’t come along?”
“Who asked you anyway?”
Zhuo Fan scoffed with a raised eyebrow, holding onto Chu Qingcheng’s hand, “I was even hoping to stay here for a couple of days. Miss Yuyu is free to leave. I’m stuck here behind the barriers and can’t go. Bye!”
[Hey!]
Bali Yuyu’s face twitched, annoyed with him to the extreme. She came to the rescue but the more she looked, she noticed they were unlike any prisoners she saw, they were more like guests.
[Is this your home? Are you free to come and go as you please? I even had to go through the guards!]
Burning with anger, Bali Yuyu stopped her cursing when she noticed Zhuo Fan holding hands with Chu Qingcheng. Her anger evaporated, replaced by confusion.
“Qian Fan, who is she?”
“My wife.”
“Your wife?” Bali Yuyu flinched, feeling her heart skip a beat but also souring. But as a Sword King, and particularly a warmonger, she wasn’t about to let softness show on her features. She took a deep breath to calm herself, “Why haven’t I heard about this, or seen her?”
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes, “Who are you to me for me to tell you everything? Humph, it’s my fortune to be reunited with my wife. I shall treasure these days, imprisoned alongside her.”
“Be sure to look after junior sister Qingcheng, Zhuo Fan. You owe her too much after so many years.”
Wu Qingqiu said with a smile, forgetting there was a witch not up to two feet away. An expert that removed dozens of Genesis Stage experts without a sound.
Bali Yuyu looked confused and stared at Zhuo Fan, “Then I’ll break you out of here. We’ll talk once we’re safe…”
“No, my wife’s mind had suffered a shock and fighting will affect her. Staying here is much better.”
“Just knock her out and we’ll be off.”
“What did you say?”
Zhuo Fan glared, “Bali Yuyu, listen here. She is my wife, touch her and you’ll be sorry!”
Bali Yuyu was taken aback having never seen Zhuo Fan be so determined. She knew the girl was very important to him and sighed with a lowered head.
One guard mediated, “Sir, miss Yuyu is only thinking of your own good. There’s no need to turn cruel over a simple refusal, ha-ha-ha…”
“This isn’t about keeping calm. I won’t let anyone touch her.” Zhuo Fan held Chu Qingcheng as he spoke with resolve.
Bali Yuyu’s face fell and gnashed her teeth. Shangguan Qingyan shook her head, feeling sad.
[Zhuo Fan is more careful with Chu Qingcheng than with any other girl. Senior sister Ruohua was right, Zhuo Fan and Chu Qingcheng were protective of each other, with no one able to separate them.]
Wu Qingqiu’s face twitched and asked his most pressing question, “Uh, Zhuo Fan, you just called this miss Bali Yuyu? What a coincidence for her to have the same name as the central area’s Frigid Rain Sword King, ha-ha-ha…”
“That’s me, it’s not a coincidence!”
Zhuo Fan stayed silent, but Wu Qingqiu and Shangguan Qingyan were frozen stiff.
[Frigid Rain Sword King is in Sea Bright Sect and listening to this devious guy, but for what?]
Bali Yuyu ignored their shock and the fact she was found out, “Since you don’t want to leave, what are you planning? Didn’t you aim for the North Sea? How are you going to reach it if you’re stuck here?”
“I’ll leave when the moment is right. Thanks for caring. But for now, I want to be with my wife. You can go now.”
“Go? If I go, who’ll save you?” Bali Yuyu roared, “You think just anyone can burst into Sea Bright Sect’s jail? If I go, you’ll either die or be stuck here till you die.”
“It’s none of your concern. No one can stop me from leaving when I want, nor take me away if I don’t want to.” Zhuo Fan glared at her, his voice irreproachable, “Frigid Rain Sword King, we’re all behind bars so you don’t have to stay as well and can go back to report to Invincible Sword. This is all I amount to, getting trapped by the Sea Bright Sect. Devil Mountain disciple is nothing much, not when Devil Mountain doesn’t exist. You can go and tell him that. Your mission is over.”
Bali Yuyu bit her lip, not wanting to go, her eyes glaring back, “You really don’t need my help?”
“No, now go!”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “With my wife by my side, I don’t need another woman causing misunderstandings. As someone under me, tonight is your last task. The plan is a success and we can go our separate ways. As you are with Baili Yutian, you can wait for my end then report it back to him. There’s no need for you to be here anymore.”
Bali Yuyu shook, with her and Shangguan Qingyan feeling stabbed in the heart. Having him say there was no place for any girl around him other than his wife cut them deep.
Bali Yuyu didn’t go anywhere, speaking coldly, “You think I want to stay around you? I’ve had enough ages ago, but with the Sea Bright Sect’s barrier so strong, I can’t pass it.”
“You didn’t get the Heaven Sealing Sword?”
“You think it’s that easy?”
Bali Yuyu rolled her eyes, “The Heaven Sealing Sword is behind an unbreakable barrier in the Heaven Sealing Pavilion. There are also the Four Snow Peak Elders, the strongest defenders in northern lands, watching over it. Their combined attacks would be hard to face even for Ouyang Lingtian. How then am I supposed to do it? Could you steal it then?”
“No.”
“Obviously.”
“But you can!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone.
Bali Yuyu paused, “Are you deaf? I can’t beat those four and can’t even break the barrier.”
“I can’t because I don’t have the strength to face Sword King level experts. But you have it and can do it for me!” Zhuo Fan said, “Ever heard of diversion tactics?”
Bali Yuyu pondered and exclaimed, “You want to draw them out? But they’ve been alive for thousands of years. You think such a simple trick will work? And I still can’t deal with the barrier.”
“Going after them is bound to fail, which is why we’ll use a complex plan!”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, “Because they’re wise old men, they have many things and thus many leverages. Ever heard of rumors becoming real?”
Frigid Rain Sword King looked stumped.
He gestured to her to get closer and Zhuo Fan whispered dark secrets to her through the bars.
Bali Yuyu gave him a look of confusion at the end, “Will it actually work?”
“With the old coots so obsessed with their stuff, they’re easy to dupe, even the wisest elders.” Zhuo Fan’s eyes sparkled.
Bali Yuyu nodded and left, “I’ll give it a shot. But if it doesn’t work, I’ll take it out on you!”
“Don’t go failing on purpose just to find me. This trick only works once. Don’t waste my effort and brain cells.”
“If it works, I wouldn’t be caught dead coming back here.” Bali Yuyu huffed and her footsteps sounded distant now.
With the witch leaving, Wu Qingqiu gasped, “Zhuo Fan, are you siding with the central area’s Sword Star Empire?”
“Yeah, I thought you said you’re not here to make trouble for northern lands.” Shangguan Qingyan said hurriedly.
Zhuo Fan said, “I’m not here for northern lands’ affairs nor am I on the central area’s side. I’m doing it for myself. You can now go report, but don’t mess with the plan. You heard it, right? I want to go to the North Sea and the Sea Bright Sect would never lower the barrier for me. I can only borrow Bali Yuyu to weaken the barrier and make it easier for me to leave. This way it saves me a Dragon Breath Pill, which is great, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan had a wide smile plastered on his face, making the two confused.
Outside the jail, Bali Yuyu looked furious around the corpses. She took a deep breath, about to throw away a token, but something held her back.
It was the same token Zhuo Fan had the Qian clan prepare for her.
Qian Fan’s wife, Qian Yu, escorting goods…
She heard voices nearby and Bali Yuyu gripped the token. She sniffed as her eyes teared over.
She put the token away and flew for the Heaven Sealing Pavilion…

chapters.title: Chapter 1033 - 1033, Robbery
chapters.content:
Chapter 1033, Robbery
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
The stars shone bright on this quiet night. The four elders in the Heaven Sealing Pavilion sat on each side of the copper pillar with closed eyes.
Heaven Sealing Sword was still shining blue, radiating power taken by the barrier.
Boom!
A sudden explosion tore the tranquility, with a huge fire breaking out five kilometers from Beyond Heaven Island. The flames reach high in the sky, with the clouds reflecting a deep red.
The four elders flinched awake, looking at the fire in the distance and heard the resulting ruckus. The sect members were running around to deal with it.
“What’s going on? What could have made that noise inside the sect?” One elder stroked his beard.
Another elder shook his head and closed his eyes, “Doesn’t matter. At worst, Sect Leader and Lingtian will deal with it. We just need to do our job and guard this place. Nothing else matters than doing our part.”
The others regained calm after a pause, just sitting there in silence.
“Report!”
Yet fifteen minutes later, a panicked shout reached the pavilion.
A Sea Bright Sect disciple flew before the four and started lamenting, “Venerables, this is bad! I-Invincible Sword and five Sword Kings have broken in. Sea Bright Sect Ling has fallen and senior uncle Ouyang Lingtian is barely holding on. You have to help him, venerables!”
[What?!]
The calm elders snapped their eyes open and stared at him in disbelief, “Are you sure? How, when our barrier is unbreakable! Invincible Sword would have no reason to be here either way. Why would they make such a sudden attack, for what purpose?”
The guy didn’t say anything, just looking frightened, being scared out of his mind and unable to calm down.
“Hey, which elder’s disciple are you? Why aren’t you answering?”
One venerable squinted and shouted in suspicion, “Did you see Invincible Sword and his team? Did you see the Sect Leader die?”
The guy barely squeezed a word through the terror, “Y-yes…”
The four elders grumbled.
[What’s with him acting so weird?]
His earlier report was clear so why was he now stuttering so much…
“Venerables, get the Heaven Sealing Sword, quickly!”
Another shout came to the pavilion before they could make some sense of it all. A second disciple rushed in, looking miserable.
He slumped at their feet and urged, “Senior uncle Lingtian is hurt badly. Double Dragon Manor and Shangguan clan have suffered severe casualties and can’t hold on. Senior uncle requests that venerables go and help with the divine sword!”
He then spurted blood and fell unconscious from his heavy wounds.
The four were alarmed.
[Is the battle outside that fierce? They’ve taken out the main resistance. Is the enemy that strong?]
The four looked shocked, but recalling Invincible Sword, they were instantly sure.
[With that old monster leading the charge and with the help of a divine sword, it’ll be hard to stop him.]
Three elders turned to the oldest, “Eldest brother…”
The elder frowned, his heart in chaos. He figured the best thing to do now was to understand what was happening.
But it all happened so fast that there was no time, with the situation out of control and unable to make sense of it all.
[What am I supposed to do?]
“Venerable, save us!”
A wail came from outside.
The four elders’ hearts thumped with worry.
This time it was a female disciple bursting in, covered in wounds and her eyes filled with blood. She wept, “Venerables, senior uncle Ouyang…”
The four elders shook, hurriedly asking, “What happened to Lingtian…”
“Senior uncle was k-killed by Invincible Sword…”
The girl twitched one more time and cried as she fell unconscious as well.
The four elders no longer looked at her, each shocked to the core.
Ouyang Lingtian, the strongest in northern lands and the only one to use the Heaven Sealing Sword to its full power, had just died at Invincible Sword’s hands.
The future of Sea Bright Sect was now ruined, all those thousands of years of glorious history brought to an abrupt end.
The four panicked and their hearts sank.
The noise outside only grew louder. One elder jolted back to his senses and said, “Eldest brother, we need to help the sect! We can’t sit around while our disciples are being wiped out. There is no sect without them!”
“Yes, but there’s rules regarding the sword…”
The High Venerable no longer sat around thinking, turning to the Heaven Sealing Sword with hesitation, “The sword can never leave the pavilion, only in special circumstances. If we take the sword then…”
The other three elders cried out, “Eldest brother, we don’t have time to mind the rules! Without the Heaven Sealing Sword, we can’t stop Invincible Sword’s Sundering Sword. Are you trying to let him kill more of us? This is an emergency and we don’t have time to worry about that now. Are you afraid of losing the Heaven Sealing Sword?”
High Venerable looked at them and then he nodded.
[Yes, it’s an emergency. Stopping the old monster comes first. This entire situation feels strange, but we need to act fast.]
With the four of them working together and wielding the Heaven Sealing Sword, nothing could stop them.
High Venerable’s eyes shone with conviction, “Release the barrier and take the sword!”
The other three nodded and made signs.
Ripples began to spread from the barrier around the sword.
The barrier then opened and allowed for the cold aura of the Heaven Sealing Sword to spread outside. It then began to hum, shaking and hovering above the copper pillar.
High Venerable reached out for it.
Whoosh~
The sword turned into a cold glow and flew towards him.
Whoosh~
Silver sword energy waves came from nowhere just then, shooting for the elders. The dreaded aura they carried made them shiver and feel death breathing down their necks
The four jumped away to dodge.
Bam!
While they got out of the way, the Heaven Sealing Sword could not. With a clang, the sacred weapon got sent hurtling through the air. It was no longer able to tell where High Venerable was and just spun in place.
It was then a woman flashed before the four and grabbed Heaven Sealing Sword. She landed a hundred meters from them and spared them a cold gaze. She was none other than the female disciple coming to report.
Only she now released a deadly aura that made even the four elders shiver.
“W-who are you? Give Heaven Sealing Sword back!” The four elders shouted at once, clenching their fists.
She, however, made the wise choice to ignore them, looking at the divine sword with a flat look, devoid of any joy she might have hoped…

chapters.title: Chapter 1034 - 1034, He Must Die
chapters.content:
Chapter 1034, He Must Die
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Those geezers have been around for thousands of years and a simple diversion won’t work. Even if they do fall for it, you won’t be getting the Heaven Sealing Sword from behind the barrier. The best tactic is to use a lure so they would take it out themselves.
“As for what could possibly drive them to shirk their duty and rely on the sword? Easy, when the sect is in grave peril. The geezers would die for the sect, it is everything to them, while also their only achievement and weakness. You just have to bait them and all will fall into place. As for how to do it, the three-person-confirmation method.”
“I know these weasels are shrewd and hard to dupe, but as more people say the same thing, they have to believe it. No matter how suspicious, human nature is the same. We don’t even need to believe it fully either, just enough to consider the loud ruckus as grave danger. Just to be safe, they would then take the sword out. With how no lie is perfect, you will have to act fast. In the heat of the moment, those geezers are two distraught to pay attention to everything. Adding to that the unhealthy confidence experts tend to have, ha-ha-ha, once you take the sword, take care of yourself, Frigid Rain Sword King…”
As she stared at the silent Heaven Sealing Sword in her hand, she replayed Zhuo Fan’s words in her mind. Bali Yuyu’s lip quivered, then glared at the four with fury, “What the hell is wrong with you old coots? Are you that stupid to fall for his dumb trick? Have your brains turned to mush?”
Ugh!
The four elders looked at each other with dumb looks.
[Uh, what’s she on about? She took out the divine sword and now blames us for being duped? It sounds more like she didn’t want to do it but was forced. What kinda skewed logic is that?]
[Are there people in this world that are forced to rob themselves? Or is this broad just mocking us?]
[Curses, this is mortifying. It’s not enough you stole our sword, now you had to insult our intelligence too?]
“Girl, who are you? How dare you steal our divine sword? Give it back now and we’ll spare you!”
The elders roared.
Bali Yuyu mocked their kind offer, “Decrepit old fools, save your flimsy speech for your Sea Bright Sect disciples. You have no chance of scaring the likes of Bali Yuyu!”
“The Frigid Rain Sword King Bali Yuyu?”
The four elders gasped, “What are you doing here? How did you get into our sect?”
Bali Yuyu grinned, “Like getting in here was difficult. I just had to stroll right in, humph. Now I can leave and none of you can stop me. Take care.”
Bali Yuyu was about to leave but the Heaven Sealing Sword in her hand had different plans, shaking and trying to fly away from her.
It was the divine sword’s defiance, shunning any who didn’t train in its arts.
Bali Yuyu was a Sword King and a cultivator of the Sundering Sword Art. With the five great divine swords sharing common aspects, she poured her thunder sword energy into it to calm it down.
Having humans for its wielders was also an important aspect, since it held no malice towards them. If it were a sacred beast instead, the divine sword would go berserk in trying to tear the beast to pieces.
Once the divine sword settled, Bali Yuyu made a sign and placed it in her ring.
“Bali Yuyu, give it back or you’re going to die here!”
Heaven Sealing Sword was now in the enemy’s bag, making the Four Snow Peak Elders shout at her and attack. Cold sword waves came at Bali Yuyu from all around her.
She gave a smirk of disdain and flared her aura. Her hands flickered and thunder cracked the air, deflecting the sword waves.
Boom~
A chain of devastating explosions resounded as the Heaven Sealing Pavilion blew up, with the horizon taking on a glowing silvery hue.
When dust settled and all noise died, the Four Snow Peak Elders found no sign of Frigid Rain Sword King.
She was gone before they knew it.
The four elders were a match for even Ouyang Lingtian, making it impossible for her to beat them. The same, however, applied for them.
With both sides holding equal power, getting the sword from them was impossible, as impossible as it was for the four to stop her.
So while they were flinging threats, they knew the minute the Bali Yuyu got to the Heaven Sealing Sword, they had no chance of getting it back. That attack they did was only out of duty.
The four watched the empty night sky filled with regret.
In another area, people had the burning place surrounded, with Ouyang Lingtian, Ling Yuntian and Exalted Double Dragon among them. Sea Bright Sect’s disciples and elders watched from the side, making sure nothing escaped their notice, despite finding nothing.
“Sect Leader Ling, what is this place?” Murong Lie frowned, looking at the blazing fire, “They had to be very strong to have ruined this place so quickly, at the level of the best in the land. But what’s so important here that would make them cause such destruction?”
The others turned to Ling Yuntian.
Ling Yuntian sighed, “This is the Alchemy House of the Sea Bright Sect, where many pills are refined. Are they aiming to cripple our pill supply?”
“That has to be it. Central area’s spies must’ve slipped in and started causing havoc.” Bu Xingyun nodded and cupped his hands, “Sect Leader Ling, please double the search parties and find them as soon as possible. There seems to be more of them besides that Qian caravan. We need to hold Qian Fan for questioning!”
The other mulled a bit and agreed. Ling Yuntian fell silent, still in thought.
Ouyang Lingtian smiled, “Sect Leader, it’s like you don’t see it as a spy attack.”
“Just like you said, only a real expert could’ve done this, someone of your level. That means it could only be a Sword King.”
Ling Yuntian’s eyes shone, “But don’t you think taking out just the Alchemy House is too little for the Nine Sword Kings hiding among us? If word got out they were out pilfering would only bring them shame.”
The others nodded, “Yes, why would experts like the Nine Sword Kings lower themselves to something like this?”
“Maybe it’s not a Sword King, but another expert…” Murong Xue thought of something.
All eyes turned to her.
[Someone else besides the Nine Sword Kings? The other lands’ experts?]
Aside from the traitors of western lands and eastern lands, that only left Murong Lie of southern lands and Ouyang Lingtian of northern lands capable of this.
[Are you suspecting your own brother? Or are you saying Ouyang Lingtian would do this to his own home?]
Murong Lie was the only one who understood, having fought with Bali Yuyu yet having not known who she was, “Xue’er, you mean that woman…”
Murong Xue nodded, but her eyes shone with cold bloodthirst.
Rumble~
Thunder claps echoed from the Heaven Sealing Pavilion, shaking the skies.
“The Heaven Sealing Sword!”
Ouyang Lingtian cried out and rushed towards it. The others soon followed in realization. Murong Xie grabbed her brother and said, “Brother, you go on ahead, there’s something I must do.”
“What?”
Murong Lie was confused, “What could be more important than an attack on the Sea Bright Sect?”
“You don’t have to worry. I’ll just check something and return.”
“Just be careful. There’s a strong expert hiding in the Sea Bright Sect and it’s no longer safe.” Murong Lie saw her unshrinking will and relented, going on alone.
Murong Xue gnashed her teeth and muttered, “Damn you, bastard. The merchant caravan was missing a girl. It has to be her. That guy can’t sit still even in jail, causing such a disaster without any shred of remorse. This time he must die. Before Sea Bright Sect suffers any more destruction and he kills more innocents…”
Boom!
A third loud boom rang that night. The sky began to quicker and broke away, letting the stars shine brighter upon the world, without any impediment.
The men going for Heaven Sealing Pavilion flinched and stopped to look in shock.
The strongest barrier in the lands was now broken….

chapters.title: Chapter 1035 - 1035, I Cannot Die
chapters.content:
Chapter 1035, I Cannot Die
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Brother Wu, what do you think of my skill?”
Chu Qingcheng sat in the gloomy jail, with Zhuo Fan standing behind her, softly running the comb through her long silky locks, full of care and gentleness.
“It has only been one day since Qingcheng and I got married and I had been forced to go to Double Dragon Manor, never getting the chance to comb her hair. It might be silly, but it was a wish of mine. You two can tell me if I’m doing it wrong.”
Wu Qingqiu’s face twitched, “Zhuo Fan, you’re way too casual. Frigid Rain Sword King listened to you and went to steal Heaven Sealing Sword. She might fail and be chased here, you’d be involved in the central area’s matters, from which you can’t come out alive. And if she succeeds, the Sea Bright Sect would have no way of dealing with her and will take their hatred on you, leading to death once more. I just can’t figure out how you can be so indifferent about it. It’s like it isn’t your problem.”
“Yeah, that Frigid Rain Sword King wanted to break you out of here. You could’ve accepted and all would be over. Why would you stay here to die?” Shangguan Qingyan grew downcast.
Zhuo Fan only had attention for combing his wife’s hair, smiling, “It’s a bit messy. I know I’m not used to this, I just need practice. Qingcheng, sorry…”
“Hey, Zhuo Fan, did you hear any word I said?”
“All of it.”
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes, “First off, I told you I’m not with the central area’s group, having my own interests.”
“But the Sea Bright Sect won’t believe you…”
“No matter.”
Zhuo Fan smirked, “Them believing or not is all the same to my life. I cannot die either way, ha-ha-ha…”
Wu Qingqiu was baffled, “What do you mean it’s all the same? They’re never going to allow a central area spy to live, on top of having killed so many experts of theirs. Those Genesis Stage experts outside weren’t killed by you, but since Bali Yuyu did it to save you, you’ll still be implicated. In their anger, they’ll even take your life. It will only be harder on Qingcheng, after finally coming back. Now you…”
Zhuo Fan gave him a gesture to be quiet as he showed a vague smile, “Brother Wu, you’re a righteous cultivator to the core, even your thinking is upright. Be it killing or spying, none have anything to do with me. If killing meant death, then there would be no murders. It’s nothing more than a scare tactic. The strong have always preyed on the weak. With enough strength, no one can take your life no matter who you kill.”
Zhuo Fan paced around, tending to Chu Qingcheng’s fine locks, his gentle care in complete dissonance with his cruel tone.
Wu Qingqiu sighed, “I know that, but you’re now the weak one and about to be sacrificed. Aren’t you scared?”
“Why should I be?”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed, showing a devious smile, “If they can strike me, you think I can’t strike back? Unless they’re backward enough to think like a dumb teenager and die together, they would never touch me. You really think that I was so open about letting them seal my cultivation and put me behind bars without any precautions?”
Wu Qingqiu’s heart sank, being more confused than ever.
Zhuo Fan’s smirk turned serious when he looked at Chu Qingcheng, “I couldn’t die because I wanted to reunite with my wife one day. Now I cannot die even more, because she needs me. I am not about to let anyone take my life!”
“Then I’ll take it, demon!”
Bam!
While a boom, the jail door burst open and a girl’s voice echoed inside.
Murong Xue appeared with a furious scowl, stomping down the steps while staring at Zhuo Fan who didn’t even pause from combing.
Shangguan Qingyan rushed to block her good sister, seeing her so furious, doing anything to soothe her, “Sister Murong, what’s wrong? Why are you so furious…”
“You dare ask me that? Did you not see the many corpses of Sea Bright Sect elders outside?” Glaring at her, for the first time, Murong Xue yelled at her sweet little sister, scaring her away.
Ignoring her infatuated sister with Zhuo Fan, Murong Xue glared, “Gu Yifan, give me an answer. Did you kill those people?”
“Word caught my ear that southern lands Immortal Healer Murong Xue is smart and sharp, but why is it that today you’re so slow?” Tending to Chu Qingcheng’s temples, Zhuo Fan drawled, “My Yuan Qi is sealed and am stuck in this barrier. You tell me how I am supposed to kill anyone. You stupid or what?”
Murong Xue gasped in hatred, “You might not have done it, but that woman around you did the killing, didn’t she?”
“Yep!” Zhuo Fan was blunt.
Murong Xue gnashed her teeth, “Why has she been killing? Did you put her up to this?”
“She did it to break me out.”
“I asked you if you told her to kill so she could get you out!”
“That’s why I’m saying you’re dumb. If I told her that, what would I still be doing here? I’d be miles away by now.” Zhuo Fan cocked an annoying eyebrow, mocking the irate girl further, “There’s no point in having her save me, so I had her leave. So why are you here, a trip to the sect dungeon?”
Shangguan Qingyan couldn’t contain her giggle. Murong Xue glared at her and made her flinch in fright.
But then she cautiously held her sister’s trembling hand from rage, pleading, “Sister Xue, it’s true. The woman came to save him when we were here. But he didn’t want to go, coming to terms with his crimes and turning a new leaf. Could you ask brother Murong Lie to speak for him with Sect Leader Ling and let him go…”
“A new leaf? Humph, his character is unchanging.”
Flinging her hand away, Murong Xue glared with hatred at Zhuo Fan, “Let me ask you, did you put that woman to make those two explosions in the sect? Don’t try to deny it, I’ve seen the destruction and it couldn’t be made by anyone other than a Sword King level expert. Except for the central area, only that woman around you has such power. Now that she’s missing, it’s obviously…”
“There’s three explosions.”
Zhuo Fan cut her off with an evil smile, “First was at a place far from Heaven Sealing Pavilion, the second at the Heaven Sealing Pavilion, as for the third…”
Zhuo Fan’s grin widened.
She gnashed her teeth in frustration and anger, “The sect barrier. I knew it was you behind it all!”
“Yep, I had her do it, what about it?”
“I’ll kill you!”
Zhuo Fan’s callous admittance proved to have been the last push to Murong Xue’s fury. She raised her palm and struck for Zhuo Fan’s head. Even with his cultivation sealed, he still showed no fear before impending doom.
Bam!
Zhuo Fan just stood there with a smile, but Murong Xue had to withdraw two steps with a trembling hand. Her eyes were burning with even more rage.
Plop~
Zhuo Fan smirked as he knocked the air three times, “Miss Murong, better not call yourself smart again. You’re more of a bonehead. I’m a prisoner here missie, with a strong barrier left by Genesis Stage experts. While I can’t get out, neither can you get in. Miss Murong you’re better off asking Sect Leader Ling to open them if you still plan on killing me. Judging by that savage strike just now, your hand must be crushed, yet it still couldn’t touch a hair on my head. Ha-ha-ha, I’m sorry, really I am. Here I am, at my weakest, yet you can’t even reach me.”
“Gu Yifan, you’re one vile demon. Just you wait! We’ll just see how long your cocky attitude lasts!”
Murong Xue glared at Zhuo Fan’s taunting gaze and scrunched her teeth harder. She then flicked her hand and left, “I’ll report everything to Sect Leader Ling, he’ll deal with you. First you slaughtered people in the Sea Bright Sect, then you broke their barrier!”
Zhuo Fan didn’t even flinch, looking at her in ridicule. Shangguan Qingyan started and begged, “Sister Xue, don’t! He really hasn’t done anything in jail. He’s good!”
“Good my ass! Even if he doesn’t move a muscle, disaster will still befall everyone, just like it did central area’s Serene Shores Trading. He is a devil, rotten to the core. His mere existence is vile.”
Murong Xue clenched her fists and left in a huff, disregarding her sister’s plea and even cursing, “Yan’er, have you got taken in by him? With everything that’s happened here, with so many people dead, you still take his side? I will no longer help you hide it and report everything.”
“Ah! No, sister Xue…”
Shangguan Qingyan cried after her and Wu Qingqiu sighed, “This is a huge mess, brother Zhuo. What are you going to do?”
“Nothing, just wait and see.”
“Aren’t you scared the Sea Bright Sect will execute you?”
“They won’t even try, moreover…”
Zhuo Fan quirked a smile, “This only cements my safety. For now I have two blades and soon the third, ha-ha-ha…”
Wu Qingqiu was baffled, feeling like Zhuo Fan had cast a net that spread over everyone, putting them on edge…

chapters.title: Chapter 1036 - 1036, Mastermind
chapters.content:
Chapter 1036, Mastermind
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Sister Xue, don’t do it! Give him another chance…”
“Shut up! I’ve given him plenty of chances, which is why so many innocents are now dead. That foul demon has to be put down now, before he brings about an even greater disaster!
“Sister Xue, it’s really not him, but the one under him…”
“Who acted in his stead!”
Murong Xue and Shangguan Qingyan were fighting while walking for Sea Bright Sect’s Main Hall. Shangguan Qingyan pleaded while Murong Xue would always throw her reasons aside, flaring in anger, “He is a plague. His end will settle everything. You’ve been infatuated with him and can’t see him for who he is. You even had me go along with this charade. But there’s no point talking about this. I shall do the world this favor, for the greater good!”
She shrugged Shangguan Qingyan’s hand off and stormed into the Main Hall. Shangguan Qingyan was looking erratic as she followed after her.
They, however, were left speechless as they came in, no longer saying a word.
The mood was tense and heavy. The thick air was so oppressive it made it hard to breathe.
There was not a single sound, not even from a random animal…
Sect Leader Ling Yuntian had a dark look on his face, his usual smile no longer seen. Ouyang Lingtian, Murong Lie and Exalted Double Dragon and many others were tense too.
