Before them were four elders, stricken with guilt and lowered heads in shame. On the ground were the two disciples that worked with Bali Yuyu in passing the report.
They were brought in under suspicion of being spies.
Murong Lie looked confused at the heavy mood, no longer thinking of reporting Zhuo Fan and instead whispering to Murong Lie, “Uh, brother, what happened? Why…”
“A true disaster.”
Murong Lie sighed, actually looking mournful, “Xue’er, you sensed it too, the third explosion came from the sect barrier…”
“Yeah, I did. Did someone get in?”
“On the contrary, someone got out. They took the northern lands’ Heaven Sealing Sword as well…” Murong Lie shuddered and his sigh was longer.
Murong Xue’s eyes widened and cried out, “The Heaven Sealing Divine Sword’s gone? How?”
“Yes, it’s gone, that’s the only reason why the strongest barrier in the lands could break.” Murong Lie felt utterly powerless then. His hand flashed and revealed a golden longsword traced by golden flames, “That means we only have the Decimating Sword as the only weapon against Invincible Sword. We now have no hope at all.”
Everyone lowered their heads, feeling the heavy loss.
Shangguan Feixiong glanced at the heavy toothpick Soaring Sword had become with gnashed teeth. Exalted Double Dragons looked at each other in guilt.
They might’ve had a chance against Invincible Sword now, if they hadn’t let Danqing Shen run off with the Vaulting Sword. They could only blame themselves for being soft on their disciple.
Though no one knew that the disciple did not have it. This issue led to Exalted Double Dragons and Danqing Shen coming to a huge misunderstanding, courtesy of Zhuo Fan.
“Sect Leader, it’s our fault we let Frigid Rain Sword King take the sword. Sect Leader, we will accept any punishment you’d inflict upon us without remorse.”
Looking at their dark faces the Four Snow Peak Elders’ guilt only grew, to the point they even gave a deep bow with tears on their faces, “For any damage that our neglect has caused the sect, we deserve nothing less than execution!”
Ling Yuntian returned the bow and helped them up, not blaming them in the least, “Venerables, you’ve always held yourself with responsibility and diligence. Everyone in the sect knows this. It’s all the thief’s fault for using such a loud distraction to hide the truth while bringing false reports. Anyone would’ve fallen for it in such desperate moments. The more one is loyal to the sect, the easier it is for them to believe such treachery. Venerables, there’s no need to blame yourselves.”
“I have looked into these two disciples and they’re not traitors, ending up controlled with a bewitching demonic art.”
Exalted Hei Ran’s brow shook, “The bewitching art isn’t some incredible skill, for strong experts would not usually fall for such guile. And even if it worked, the target would end up dull-minded and easy to spot. To pull off such a trick on four peak Genesis experts shows how daring the user was, and skilled.”
Exalted Bai Mei sighed, “It’s not just daring, but calculative. The skill is minor, easily seen through, yet highly effective in the created circumstance. Repeated confirmation makes it believable. Once they took it as real, they were tricked. Then it was just a matter of pouncing with utmost speed at the right moment to get the elders on the wrong foot and steal the sword.”
The others nodded and sighed.
“I’ve heard that the Nine Sword Kings are beyond strong, and that includes Frigid Rain Sword King. I just can’t believe one woman can be so vile and of such twisted cunningness. She’s a true master in strength and mind!”
Ling Yuntian eased a long breath, “Invincible Sword has yet to come and one woman Sword King had us running around in panic. Then when we face Invincible Sword, how will we fight back?”
“Right, what will we do…”
“Who says there’s anything we can do…”
Everyone was wrought with worry, looking bleak and downcast at the doomed and imminent future.
Only Shangguan Feixiong spoke, “Sect Leader Ling, do not be distressed. The thief might be Bali Yuyu, but it might not be her who devised this strategy. From how I see it, the only one among our lands that can come up with such a cunning tactic to control the enemy can only be Sword Star Empire’s Baili Jingwei. He must’ve planned this before. We have faced him in the central area and he almost destroyed us with his strategies. It was a very close call. He is truly dangerous.”
“Even if it is Baili Jingwei’s plan, can’t we do anything about it? Shangguan Clan Head, how do you intend to soothe my worries?”
“Ha-ha-ha, I meant to say that she’s too far away from the central area and not with Baili Yutian. Once fighting starts, anything can happen and he’s too far to give advice. So for now, our opponent is still just Invincible Sword.”
“Oh, Shangguan Clan Head is right.” Ling Yuntian nodded and sighed, “Although Invincible Sword is an immense threat to us all, he finds any sort of strategy beneath him and would give us a breather.”
Ling Yuntian saw the others nod and relax as well, feeling relieved from their talk.
Murong Xue stepped in just then, cupping her hands, “Sect Leader Ling, I have a report!”
Shangguan Qingyan didn’t stop her, shaking her head in anxiety.
“Miss Murong, why the sudden courtesy?”
Ling Yuntian had regained his kind smile.
Murong Xue spoke heavily, “Sect Leader Ling, the mastermind behind the theft isn’t from the central area, but the imprisoned Qian merchant, Qian Fan!”
Ling Yuntian looked dumbfounded, “What did you say?”
“Xue’er, what’s going on? Just tell us!” Murong Lie urged her.
Murong Xue began, “The leader of the Qian caravan is Steward Qian Fan, but I have met him before in the central area. He’s the same one who caused the calamity in the central area, the demon Gu Yifan!”
“Gu Yifan?!” Shangguan Feixiong reacted instantly, his eyes looking hopeful, “Gu Yifan is here, now?”
Murong Xue nodded, “Wherever the foul Gu Yifan goes, disaster is soon to follow. I met him in the northern lands as I was coming here and he also had a strong female guard that matched my brother. He may be in jail, but I have just confirmed that he’s behind the devious plan to steal the sword. You can ask sister Yan’er if you don’t believe me. She was there. And she knew he was here long before I did.”
“Yan’er, is what Xue’er said true?” Shangguan Feixiong stared at his daughter.
Shangguan Qingyan’s face shook and relented a nod.
“Foolish girl, why haven’t you said anything? You know I’ve been trying to find him all this time.” Shangguan Feixiong ignored everything and even forgot to salute the rest as he stormed outside, roaring, “Gu Yifan, you bastard! What did you do to my sword? Fix it this instant! Uhm, where is the Sea Bright Sect’s jail again…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1037 - 1037, You Can’t Touch Me
chapters.content:
Chapter 1037, You Can’t Touch Me
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Bam!
In the gloomy prison, Shangguan Feixiong was holding a scarlet sword, bursting right in and looking around with bloodshot eyes like someone who was possessed. Those hungry eyes took moments to find his quarry, setting his eyes on Zhuo Fan.
“What did I say? The first to show up will be Shangguan Clan Head. You lost, brother Wu.” Smirking, Zhuo Fan hardly cared being the target of such an intense gaze and spoke to Wu Qingqiu, “Per our bet, you now owe me a favor.”
Wu Qingqiu shrugged, “As long as it doesn’t go against my morals, I’ll do it, brother Zhuo.”
Bam!
Shangguan Feixiong arrived before the two in one mighty leap, the stone floor cracking under him, “Curse you, Gu Yifan! You might have the time of your life, but you almost got me killed!”
“Shangguan Clan Head, why do you say that?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow.
Shangguan Feixiong’s face twitched, showing his scarlet sword and accusing Zhuo Fan, “Damn punk, stop playing around! You dare ask me that? It’s I who should be asking what the hell is this!”
“What is what? Isn’t that your clan’s Soaring Sword? It’s looking mighty polished.”
“Can it!”
Shangguan Feixiong was outraged, spitting as he raged, but the drops jumped back when met with the barrier, landing on his own face. It even got into his eyes.
Zhuo Fan waved his hand, “Shangguan Clan Head, why so excited? We even worked together.”
“Screw your cooperation! I…”
He was about to rave again, but stopped before he sprayed himself again, and swallowed.
Wu Qingqiu sighed at the side, admiring Zhuo Fan.
[Who said that the mighty have fallen? Brother Zhuo has his cultivation sealed, in prison, yet still talks with eastern lands best clan’s Clan Head like he has the advantage.]
[It actually looks like this big boss from eastern lands has his hands tied by a junior, ha-ha-ha…]
Crossing his hands, Wu Qingqiu enjoyed the show. Zhuo Fan was equally calm, considerate as he pointed, “Shangguan Clan Head, I am now a prisoner of Sea Bright Sect. My safety is guaranteed with the jail barrier in place. No matter what you try to do, it won’t work. If you really want to punch me, then just like I said to miss Murong, you’ll have to go ask Sect Leader Ling. Or maybe you could break it yourself. With your strength, that should be doable. Though that would be mighty rude of you before getting approval. That’s not how the Clan Head of the best clan in eastern lands acts.”
“Ugh, Gu Yifan, are you a prisoner or a guest? The barrier is clearly keeping you here, so why are you talking like it’s protecting you instead, like you’re the lord here? What gives you the confidence?”
Sensing the mockery in Zhuo Fan’s smile, Shangguan Feixiong’s face twitched hard.
Zhuo Fan grasped at the air and his eyes shone, “No matter where I am, with all under my control, I am the lord. Just like now. You see me as a prisoner here, in my cell, but the way I see it, it is Shangguan Clan Head that is the one imprisoned. I can do whatever I want here, even tend to my wife. But Shangguan Clan Head can’t beat me, nor take it out on me, all because of this flimsy barrier. Ha-ha-ha, I only have a few of words for you: you can’t touch me.”
“Who do you think among us is the real prisoner?” Zhuo Fan cocked an eyebrow, then walked to Qiao’er looking after Chu Qingcheng, “Qiao’er, comb her hair. You’re much better at it than me. It’s the first time doing it for both of us so why are you so good at it?”
“Because we’re girls.”
“That’s talent?”
“Sort of.”
…
Shangguan Feixiong’s mouth twitched as Zhuo Fan did whatever. Then his words sunk in.
[The kid is right, I’m more tied down on the outside.]
[Who is the one locked anyway? A prisoner outside, one that can’t even beat a kid, while the one inside so carefree and infuriating to no end. Just what is up with this world?]
Shangguan Feixiong felt stunned, now realizing that after meeting this brat, he was never in control, but the one being controlled. He didn’t even have a way to vent his anger.
He had to take his anger on himself, kicking himself while at it.
Giving it some thought, Shangguan Feixiong chose to calm down as much as he could, since anger didn’t help him get his divine sword back. He took a deep breath and said, “Gu Yifan, don’t play dumb with me. You know exactly why I was angry. Soaring Sword is the treasure of eastern lands. We made a deal that we would help you if you returned the sword…”
“Yes, and I did give it to you. Isn’t it right there in your hand?”
“What you brought was a piece of scrap!”
Shangguan Feixiong shouted, “Why did you seal the sword spirit? I was planning to use it to fight Invincible Sword. Now I’ll end up dead without even putting up a fight. How isn’t this your fault?”
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow and sneered, “You’d be doomed even with the help of the Soaring Sword. Since there’s no use of you going, I just saved your life. You should thank me.”
“Screw thanking you! You ruined Soaring Sword. How is that fair?”
Gnashing his teeth, Shangguan Feixiong flicked the sword and demanded, “You have to unseal it or else…”
Bam!
This time it felt like a mob was barging in here as all kinds of experts rushed inside the jail.
Zhuo Fan regarded everyone, then turned to Shangguan Feixiong with a chuckle, “Shangguan Clan Head, to be honest, I did seal the sword spirit to take the Soaring Sword from Shangguan Feiyun. I was in such a hurry when I left that I forgot to unseal it. It’s my oversight, so after all this time trying and failing to unseal it yourself, it’s only right that I should do it, to complete our agreement back then.”
“That’s right. I didn’t mean anything else by it either. I can understand that you were rash and needed to save your son, but as long as you unseal it now, I will forget everything. We are an upright clan that keeps their word.”
Shangguan Feixiong grinned in delight. He was only after unsealing the divine sword. So there was no reason to explode in anger if he got his wish. Zhuo Fan’s words helped sooth his rage.
But then Zhuo Fan shifted the subject with a sinister smile, “Things have changed now. If you had come by yesterday to unseal it, I would’ve done it without hesitation. Now, I’m afraid it’ll have to wait.”
“What does that mean? Why wait?” Shangguan Feixiong cried out.
Zhuo Fan curled his lips, sweeping his eyes over the people walking down, “Because I’m a weak lamb with three blades on me. Since you’re my first blade, I can’t just give you up so soon, now can I?”
Shangguan Feixiong gave him a hard look then turned to the others with a nod.
Shangguan Feixiong sighed knowing his hopes were dashed.
Ling Yuntian’s group now approached Zhuo Fan, with Exalted Double Dragons looking shocked to the core.
It was beyond comprehension how the best disciple in western lands that had perished five years ago would end up here, and as their enemy.
They grimaced, even as Zhuo Fan remained calm and had no issue facing them.
“Qian Fan, Steward Qian Fan, Gu Yifan, Grandmaster Gu, and best disciple in western lands, Zhuo Fan, right?”
Looking at Zhuo Fan’s calm visage, Ling Yuntian smiled, “Sir is known by all of these. Which would be more appropriate to address you?”
Zhuo Fan shrugged, “Feel free to call me anything, Sect Leader Ling. Though I’ve grown attached to Zhuo Fan.”
“Alright, Sir Zhuo.”
Ling Yuntian nodded, “Could Sir Zhuo tell us in detail why in your capacity as western lands disciple you haven’t returned to western lands having recovered and instead come to northern lands?”
Zhuo Fan turned serious, his eyes flashing, “I came to these lands, and to your sect, for one thing, the North Sea demon!”
“What?”
Ling Yuntian and Ouyang Lingtian gasped in shock, “What do you want with that monster?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1038 - 1038, Three Blades
chapters.content:
Chapter 1038, Three Blades
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Zhuo Fan revealed a vague smile as he refused to answer, “It doesn’t concern you so you shouldn’t ask.”
“Yes, we don’t care about your personal matters and we can’t get involved with sea demon either…”
Ling Yuntian sighed, then his eyes flashed and glared, “Then what has sir to say about Heaven Sealing Sword getting stolen and our barrier destroyed? Did you do this?”
“Yes!”
“Why?” Ling Yuntian stared at him hard and shouted, “Heaven Sealing Sword is the treasure of my sect and losing it will lead to countless losses. Sir is from western lands and all four lands suffer the same problem. Also, we each mind our own problems, so why would you then do something so grave and lead to a hopeless fate?”
“Because he is the herald of calamity, cold and cruel to anyone else’s pain or life.”
Murong Xue shouted in anger, “The central area’s case is the strongest evidence. So many lives were lost at his hand yet he holds no remorse. Sect Leader Ling, he cannot be allowed to live. For the good of the world, he has to be removed. Or disaster will only keep appearing.”
The others looked at each other but their eyes were thoughtful, each with their own idea.
Bu Xingyun, who has seen Zhuo Fan for who he is, jumped right in, “Miss Murong can’t be more right. He has to die. Sect Leader Ling, he admits to stealing the sword and should be put down as an example.”
“Sect Leader Bu, I have told you many times already. You are not in the Sun Sea Sect. This isn’t your place to make decisions.”
Ling Yuntian huffed and turned to Zhuo Fan, “Sir, you have yet to answer.”
Zhuo Fan said, “Sect Leader Ling is a sharp man. Is there a need to ask? I said I wanted to go to the North Sea but the Sea Bright Sect cut off the path to it. The only way to get there is by breaking the barrier.”
“Just for that you had the Heaven Sealing Sword stolen?”
“Just?”
Eying Ouyang Lingtian, Zhuo Fan chuckled, “It might look like a flimsy reason, but it’s crucial to me. To go to the North Sea, I stole Heaven Sealing Sword, I ruined your barrier, and I would have certainly destroyed your sect or the five lands if I had to. Anyway, those that stop me will be crushed.”
“You’re a certifiable lunatic! Just for that you put all of the northern lands at risk?” Ouyang Lingtian roared, “You could’ve said you wanted to go to the North Sea and we’d have let you. It’s easy to have it done. Why did you insist on taking the sword and inflicting such damage?”
Zhuo Fan glanced at him with mockery, “Senior Ouyang, would you have really let me if I asked? Humph, you’re too simple. If it would have been that easy, why would the Sea Bright Sect be established on the shores of the North Sea, monopolizing its resources?”
Ouyang Lingtian shook at the response.
“Also, you might call yourself upright and righteous, but none here is any nobler.”
Zhuo Fan jeered, “Now that’s such a big issue, you’re saying opening access to the sea is nothing, that a simple request would’ve been enough. But if the sword had never been taken, would you have indulged a mere merchant’s plea? The answer is obvious. How else would you have dominated the sea’s exploitation? With that reason, the result is just as flat. Because you had the North Sea locked, I had no choice but to blow this simple matter as going to sea out of proportions. Because you stopped me, I had to move you out of the way first to continue my path. If you want to blame someone, don’t blame my extreme methods, but your greed in stopping everyone else.”
Ling Yuntian’s lips shook and relented a nod, “Yes, with Sir Zhuo being a merchant, your approval would have likely been rejected. If I were in Sir Zhuo’s place, I would’ve stolen the sword as well.”
“Sect Leader Ling, how can you say that? Just for going to sea the entire northern lands’ population is at risk. How can they compare?”
Murong Xue’s glare never subsided, “Just for himself, he spits in the face of virtue and good. His heart is twisted but also strong. He has to be put down!”
The others nodded this time, but then shook their heads soon after.
Zhuo Fan grinned, uncaring for his safety, even taking time to mock her, “Miss Murong truly is a warrior of justice. A shame the world isn’t filled with people like miss, dead set on purging evil. Some don’t wish for my death. I fear your wish will have to go unanswered.”
“Humph, be smug all you like. I’m sure Sect Leader Ling will uphold his principles and knows not to show any mercy against fiends like you!” Murong Xue glared in hatred then cupped her hands in hope, “Sect Leader Ling…”
“That’s enough, miss Murong. You don’t have to say it. I have made up my mind.”
Murong Xue perked up, taking it as a sign that Ling Yuntian took her side and was about to bring Zhuo Fan to justice. “Sir Zhuo, will your guard return?”
Zhuo Fan nodded with a smile, “Of course, you saw it yourself, she came to break me out, but I needed to tend to my wife so I didn’t leave. She’ll be back though, in a few days to go to sea.”
“Good, then we’ll wait till then. When she comes, I will personally escort you all out to sea.” Ling Yuntian hesitated as he cupped his hands then left.
Ouyang Lingtian and the people of the Sea Bright Sect understood and left as well.
Murong Xue was left dumbfounded, still as a statue.
[W-what is this? Why is he freed? He killed so many of your Genesis Stage experts and stole your sword, but you’re just going to move past it and even escort him to sea? What is going on here?]
Murong Xue was utterly confused, while the rest knew why this happened. Shangguan Feixiong had just gone through a verbal clash with Zhuo Fan and Zhuo Fan was in no rush to unseal eastern lands’ sword. But that didn’t stop him from feeling so down. He asked, pointing at the Soaring Sword, “Kid, say when. I’ll wait.”
“Wait for me before the sea.”
“Alright, but you better not forget this again. Who knows how many years it will take for us to meet again.” Shangguan Feixiong sighed and left.
Exalted Double Dragons hesitated before saying, “Zhuo Fan, we’re happy you’re alive. We wanted to look into what happened to you…”
“I understand Exalted’s difficulty and master had settled everything in my stead. I am instead very grateful to you for looking after Chu Qingcheng all these years. I have yet to step into Double Dragon Manor for even one day, but I can be considered one of you still. You can put your mind at ease, Exalted, I will always be thankful to Double Dragon Manor and western lands.” Zhuo Fan spoke over them.
Exalted Double Dragons nodded in relief. They feared Zhuo Fan would’ve hated them for not dealing with the sects back then and letting Chu Qingcheng turn like this.
With a devious otherworldly genius around and a monster watching them from shadows, the two never felt safe.
Now though, hearing Zhuo Fan’s gratitude, they finally found zen.
After a couple more words, they too left.
Now there was only Wu Qingqiu, Shangguan Qingyan, Murong Xue and Murong Lie.
Murong Xue was overcome by confusion, “Brother, what is this? Why has Sect Leader Ling shown such leniency to this demon after all the hurt he’s caused?”
“Xue’er, Sect Leader Ling is in charge of the sect and needs to think of everyone.” Murong Lie took a deep breath.
Murong Xue said, still baffled, “If Sect Leader Ling is acting in everyone’s interests, then he should know how much of a disaster he is. He can’t be left alive. Now that he’s set free, many more people will get hurt!”
“Yes, this demon ought to be snuffed. If I live, more would die.”
Zhuo Fan patronized, “Miss Murong is so focused she saw me for what I am, a true demon that spreads pain and suffering. While miss Murong wants to see me dead, I have too many demon progeny around. I could stand before you and present my neck yet you still wouldn’t be able to touch a hair on it, ha-ha-ha…”
“What are you saying?”
“For the technobabble-impaired, I am a demon reaping countless souls, but Ling Yuntian, Ouyang Lingtian and even Exalted Double Dragons are my children. They may deny it, but they know in their heart that they have to keep this true demon alive.”
Murong Xue winced.
Zhuo Fan continued regardless of her feelings, “You think you’re the only bright enough to see me for the danger I am? They all know. The minute I walk out will be sure to cause more suffering somewhere. Alas, their hands are tied. For I have on me three whimsical blades, flying away the minute my soul leaves my body. They’ll never see them again. That’s why they can’t touch me.”
“Three blades?”
“First is the Shangguan clan’s Soaring Sword. If I die, Soaring Sword remains sealed. It translates into the fall of the Shangguan clan, and with northern lands and eastern lands trapped, the other lands would fall as well. For the second blade, Heaven Sealing Sword, is the same with Soaring Sword. The third blade, Devil Mountain. Double Dragon Manor had been scared witless five years ago when Devil Mountain took the stage and would never do anything to a Devil Mountain disciple, lest Devil Mountain would burn whole of western lands in anger.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed, “They don’t care about the casualties, only about getting the Heaven Sealing Sword and unsealing the Soaring Sword. This affects their future. The constant cries of the masses fall on their deafened ears as all of their focus is set on the lands’ unification. They only care about losing their status and sects, not for the countless poor souls in pain and dying.
“That’s why I said reporting me will only make it worse for you. Because you said too much, they won’t touch me. I am now a prisoner, but I control their fates. It is not I who is locked away here now, but you, righteous warrior, obsessed with killing me!”
Bam!
The Four Snow Peak Elders suddenly appeared with grave faces, “Sect Leader Ling has ordered us to watch over Zhuo Fan and the others…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1039 - 1039, Sword Star’s Oppression
chapters.content:
Chapter 1039, Sword Star’s Oppression
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Murong Xue shuddered as she watched the four old men with shaken looks, “Sect Leader Ling sent the Venerables to protect a divine sword thief? How does that make sense? Are they afraid that his henchwoman will be back to break them out?”
“Ha-ha-ha, miss Murong, you know already. I’d have walked ages ago if I wanted to. Why would I need to stay here and even have these coots watching over me?”
Zhuo Fan sneered, “Moreover, Ling Yuntian knows I want to go out to sea and won’t leave even if I can of my own free will. Setting up such a strong guard for someone like that hardly makes any sense. Or are you still scared I’d escape despite wanting to be here?”
Murong Xue’s eyes shook and she gritted her teeth.
Murong Lie sighed and pulled her hand, “Xue’er, let’s go. Sect Leader Ling said it’s for the greater good.”
“How is that so?”
Murong Xue stared at the four elders, “Seniors, I just wish to know, what is Sect Leader Ling’s real reason for sending you to watch over a prisoner that doesn’t want to escape?”
The Four Snow Peak Elders muttered to themselves, before High Venerable replied, “Miss Murong is sharp, Sect Leader did send us to watch him. He might not want to leave now, but what about later? With that woman’s incredible strength, only the four of us could stop her from breaking in again. As for the other reason…”
High Venerable hesitated.
“What other reason?” Murong Xue knew it but still insisted on hearing it.
The Four Snow Peak Elders lowered their heads, giving Zhuo Fan the opportunity to condescend, “Miss Murong, you’re being hard on seniors. Do you really want to tear the last shred of cordiality? Ha-ha-ha, I bet you know already. The seniors are here to guard me, as in protect me, lest a certain someone gets the bright idea in the heat of the moment and kills someone of my immense value, making the two divine swords to be lost and damning the four lands. Especially when that certain someone has such an incredible brother. One’ll need extra protection, no?”
Murong Xue glared at him as her lip shook, then she turned to the four silent venerables. Their silence said it all. With a huff, she stormed out in indignation and fury.
Murong Lie looked at them once and shook his head as he followed her.
Only the four elders, Zhuo Fan’s team, Shangguan Qingyan and Wu Qingqiu remained.
“I’ve never seen sister Xue so overcome with anger.”
Shangguan Qingyan sighed, feeling sad.
Wu Qingqiu nodded, “She believed she was ridding the world of evil, for the common good, but the people on the same path as hers turned their backs, actually being cautious around her. It might not be just as simple as anger for miss Murong, but disillusioned.”
“She got here on the firm belief that good triumphs over evil, only to find that she is the only one willing to face a demon like me. Getting disappointed with reality is a given, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan laughed in mockery.
Shangguan Qingyan rolled her eyes and blamed him, “It was all going fine so far so why did you have to antagonize sister Xue further?”
“I didn’t do anything, she chose to walk this lone path herself.”
Zhuo Fan spoke, “Humanity is filled with endless desires. And where there’s desire, there’s evil. Few in this world have a true righteous and benevolent heart, while the great majority who walk this path could never come to free themselves of their demons. She wants to go further on the path of purging demons and she must bear the solitude and betrayal. Only by persevering through this can she reach the height of righteousness. But by being too rigid, one breaks easily. In this world, righteous cultivators have it hard to achieve their path.
“Either follow the crowd and ruin their paths, neither demonic nor righteous, always a stranger wherever they went, or die at the hands of others in this messed-up world. But righteousness has a natural shortcut over the demonic path, having grown above the mortal coil and the worldly affairs. Shunning self-indulgence and feeling for the world’s energy is the easiest way to achieve it. That’s why demonic cultivators enter the world and understand it, while righteous cultivators enter the world and overcome it. Rise from the mire unstained, cleanse oneself in clear water without being tainted. Thus brother Wu, you’re also a righteous cultivator, very much invested in it. Which is why, as a friend, I advise you to see the world in all its colors, then return to cultivate in seclusion. The secular world is too chaotic for a true righteous man to walk the path.”
Wu Qingqiu pondered and cupped his hands, “Thank you, brother Zhuo for your guidance.”
“We’ve also been guided.”
The Four Snow Peak Elders nodded and bowed before Zhuo Fan in admiration and sincerity, “Sir is a demonic cultivator yet your wisdom transcends it. We are grateful for your words. As the sect is now in danger, we are too preoccupied to mule them. We shall delve into these words once this problem passes and, like sir said, not let the world impede us.”
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes, “I’m talking to my brother here, not you. Tell that to someone who cares, humph!”
The four sat before the cell with a smile, like experts that have surpassed the world.
Wu Qingqiu and Shangguan Qingyan chuckled, looking at Zhuo Fan with respect. Zhuo Fan hadn’t said it to them particularly, but the words of wisdom were immensely valuable, which is why the elders would lower their pride and bow to him.
Zhuo Fan was a true friend, to say those words to him.
While the people in the dungeon were struck with inspiration, the outside people still indulged in their worries and affairs.
“Sect Leader Ling, do you really believe he’ll return the sword?”
Bu Xingyun was panicking, whining in Ling Yuntian’s ear, “Even if he does give it back, you’re just going to ignore all the deaths that have happened in the sect? Even if you don’t kill him, you need to make an example out of him. We need to do right by those dead elders. Sea Bright Sect needs to mind its name!”
Giving him a frustrated look, Ling Yuntian sighed, “Sect Leader Bu, now I know why Sun Sea Sect would incite Frigid Rain Sword King to destroy it. The problem doesn’t stop with your people.”
“Sect Leader Ling, what are you implying?”
Bu Xingyun looked lost, “That sneaky punk is clearly behind the disaster of Sun Sea Sect. What do I have to do…”
Ling Yuntian cut him off with a wave, “As sect ruler, we need to have perspective. Zhuo Fan is very cunning and an expert in passing the blame. You saw it too. We went to him and he didn’t deny anything, always finding an explanation, always having an answer. But the thing we wanted most, we didn’t get. The Soaring Sword remains sealed, the Heaven Sealing Sword is still gone and he still has leverage on us.”
“What do you suggest, torture him for them? He made his move, so what’s there to force? To settle the score for the dead? Ha-ha, he has two cards of ours and we have reached an agreement now. They will soon be back in our hands. Doing this petty thing to ruin any chance of getting the divine swords, the central area would mow us down. Who will take the blame then, Sect Leader Bu?”
Ugh!
Bu Xingyun choked.
Ling Yuntian shook his head and sighed, “Zhuo Fan’s speech balanced demand and compromise, giving us no chance to gain advantage, and letting him control the negotiation. He had taken everything into account before it even began. He had his guard flee with the Heaven Sealing Sword before we could take it back. All the power we have can’t help change this fact. He may be in jail, but looking at it in perspective, we’re the ones having our strings pulled in his hands.
“Moreover…”
Ling Yuntian turned to Shangguan clan and Exalted Double Dragons with a sharp glint, “He is very close to these two lands’ people, implicating many and affecting their interests. They’ll never agree to us laying a finger on him. Not that we intended to either, and ruin our chances of getting Heaven Sealing Sword back. Thus, of the four lands, three have reached a silent agreement. Only southern lands is against it. That Murong Xue has such a stubborn temper, but alas, all alone. From the very start, even with his cultivation sealed, we, the strong majority, couldn’t touch a hair on him despite having him surrounded. He is confident in his position.”
Bu Xingyun’s heart sank and a chill went through him, “That’s terrifying! He gives nothing away while having every one of us tied.”
“Yeah, western lands has gone and got themselves a man like no other. But now he isn’t part of western lands any more.” Looking at Exalted Double Dragons, Ling Yuntian frowned and sighed.
Murong Xue stormed out of the dungeon and stomped away in anger.
Ling Yuntian watched her go.
Murong Lie followed after her, but Sect Leader Ling went to stop him. He did not mind a girl’s temper, but Murong Lie’s dissatisfaction had to be resolved, for the good of the alliance.
Ling Yuntian bowed and looked apologetic, “Murong Clan Head, forgive me. Heaven Sealing Sword is too important to us and have lost decorum…”
“I know, Sect Leader Ling. I understand my sister’s temper the most. Sect Leader Ling did what you had to.” Murong Lie nodded calmly.
Ling Yuntian eased a smile, “Murong Clan Head, I’m relieved to know you are a man of principle. I’ll wait for miss Murong to calm down then apologize to her and make it right…”
“Report!”
A disciple rushed over in panic, scrambling to give a jade slip to Ling Yuntian, “Sect Leader, there’s an urgent report from the frontlines. The army of the Sword Star Empire led by Dragon Cleaving Sword King Danqing Shen is advanced on northern lands!”
[What?!]
Everyone was stunned at this grave news.
Sword Star Empire’s oppression had begun at last…

chapters.title: Chapter 1040 - 1040, Bloodthirst
chapters.content:
Chapter 1040, Bloodthirst
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“So little, Frigid Rain?”
In a pitch-black forest, beneath the black clouds, Invincible Sword was sitting cross-legged on a rock with his eyes closed.
Before him was the most familiar person, on their knees and presenting an icy sword with utmost respect. Bali Yuyu had returned to the empire’s camp the minute she stole the sword, to give Heaven Sealing Sword to her Patriarch.
Baili Yutian gave her a sharp look, grinning and gesturing for the divine sword to shoot in his hand, “Ha-ha-ha, yes, Yuyu, you’ve done great this time, you brought back Heaven Sealing Sword. Sea Bright Sect’s barrier will be nothing but paper now. I can blow at them and they’d be crushed. Yuyu, your feat is remarkable, ha-ha-ha…”
“Thank you, Patriarch, for your care. I am grateful.”
Bali Yuyu cupped her hands, then hesitated, “Patriarch can see that my success is due to Zhuo Fan’s cunning plan. He deserves credit for my feat, but he is now imprisoned and cannot bask in Patriarch’s blessing. Would it be possible to save him, Patriarch?”
Waving the sword around to get a feel of it, Baili Yutian paused and his mood fell, “Zhuo Fan, is it that Qian Fan pretender? A Devil Mountain disciple that threatened me and five Sword Kings with our lives got himself caught by some nobodies in the Sea Bright Sect? Humph, he’s just a joke after all.”
“Patriarch, please, I saw that even in the few times he moved, he’s at a Soul Harmony Stage cultivator at least. It’s not amazing, but he has guile, though he loves prancing.”
Bali Yuyu bowed again, pleading, “With Sea Bright Sect having caught him and I stealing the divine sword, they are sure to take it out on him. I don’t know how long he’ll last. I just hope Patriarch will lend a hand in teaching Sea Bright Sect a harsh lesson. Show Patriarch’s might and generosity by nurturing him. By saving his life it will be two birds with one stone. He would be in immense gratitude and would swear his life to Patriarch.”
Baili Yutian raised an eyebrow and glared at her, “Are you telling me what to do?”
“Never!” Bali Yuyu shuddered and crawled on the ground.
Baili Yutian mocked, “I had you go with him to see through his skills and the limits of Devil Mountain. Now Devil Mountain no longer seems as insurmountable as before. The kid is so weak, of no importance.”
“But Patriarch…”
“Silence!”
Baili Yutian roared at her interjection. His eyes were sharp, “Baili Yuyu, you’re only breaking more rules with your actions. Has it been fun these last few days? You dare argue with me? The only reason I have ignored your repeated disregard is because you brought Heaven Sealing Sword. Now leave!”
Baili Yuyu hesitated, but still pushed on, “Patriarch, he may be weak, but just as shrewd as the prime minister. He would be a great help to you, Patriarch. The gain of this sword is all due to him. I only ask that Patriarch save his life and inspire him with your favor…”
Bam!
A huge force struck Bali Yuyu and sent her flying through dozens of trees. She landed hard and coughed blood from the impact.
But her eyes no longer had anger in them, but stubbornness.
“Bali Yuyu, I told you to be quiet, but you just won’t listen. This is what you get for defying me!”
Baili Yutian showed his power, his icy bloodthirst.
Bali Yuyu shuddered, her heart tensed.
Whoosh~
Thunder Sword King flashed between them just then.
Noticing the situation and Bali Yuyu, the rough man could glean on what happened.
He bowed to Baili Yutian and presented a jade slip, “Patriarch, Prime Minister sent word. We can start in ten days. With oppression from all sides, the four lands would crumble soon!”
“I know.
Baili Yutian took the jade slip and placed it in his ring after reading it. He then left, though his icy voice still echoed, “Ten thousand lashes! Make her remember her place!”
Bali Yulei bowed and walked to Baili Yuyu and helped her up, “Just what happened? Patriarch should be thrilled you brought him Heaven Sealing Sword, so why…”
“I asked Patriarch to save the kid, but Patriarch refused…”
Wiping her bloody lips, Baili Yuyu sighed, “I thought Patriarch would agree seeing the Heaven Sealing Sword in my hand, but…”
Baili Yulei complained, “Yuyu, why even bother? Patriarch only wanted to know his limits, and had no other intentions for him. Patriarch had said these days the kid is sly and should be removed if there’s a chance. He was waiting on your return before making a decision. With the kid caught, then Patriarch has no fear of Devil Mountain. It’s good enough he doesn’t kill the kid himself. Why then would you beg him to go?”
“Patriarch wants to kill him? Why?”
Bali Yuyu jerked with a start, “He’s no Sword King or cultivator in the Genesis Stage but he has amazing talent and bravery. His future is limitless, so why is Patriarch…”
Baili Yulei sighed, “Yuyu, Patriarch is the strongest man. While he laments how lonely it is at the top, does he really want to be defeated? Humph, you’d best not take his fondness of outsiders, like Danqing Shen and Shangguan Feiyun, seriously. Patriarch only saw that they posed no threat to him.
“While the kid, while you were away, had shaken him up with mere words. The attitude and aura almost had Patriarch soil himself. Even we fell for it. That’s why Patriarch was respectful to him, but also on guard. Now, he learned it was nothing more than a ruse, only giving him more reasons to kill the kid. His bluffing now, but his potential is undoubtedly real and could become a threat.
“Patriarch isn’t about to overlook him. And you say he’s skilled in mind games and arts, which makes him that much terrifying. Patriarch looks down on Sword Kings because they can never reach him, not even together. Baili JIngwei is also ignored, with his sharp mind, because smarts hold no power over true strength. He can kill him whenever. But by being skilled in both aspects, one could rule the world. It would ruin Patriarch’s aspirations. The more you begged for the kid, the more his fate was sealed.”
“Patriarch must kill him? Then what do we do?”
Bali Yuyu shook, her eyes trembling and her fists clenched.
Baili Yulei frowned, “Yuyu, there’s something wrong about you ever since you returned. Why do you care so much about his fate? You’ve always kept to yourself so far and have killed scores of experts these centuries without ever flinching. Why then just a few months with that kid had you go against Patriarch for him? Yuyu…”
“Brother Yulei, I-I don’t want to be lonely…”
Bali Yuyu’s lower lip quivered, pleading, “Brother Yulei, I can’t thank you enough for all you’ve done for me. Now that Patriarch wants to kill him, could you do something to save him? He’s sure to be immensely grateful.”
Bali Yuyu even kneeled.
Pa!
Baili Yulei clutched her arm and took a deep breath, “Yuyu, you’re asking the impossible. Nothing can stop Patriarch from killing someone.”
“Brother Yulei, I beg you!”
Bali Yuyu teared up, her face most earnest in her pleas.
Baili Yulei sighed, “Get up for now and let me exact your punishment. Just give me time to think about it.”
“Brother Yulei, thank you so much for your help!” Bali Yuyu brightened and smiled regardless of her wounds.
Baili Yulei had a wry smile, “Yuyu, you’ve really changed. It’s good you learned to smile…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1041 - 1041, Surrounded
chapters.content:
Chapter 1041, Surrounded
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Three days later, the Sea Bright Sect was officially at war. All disciples were armed, ready and pumped to fight. They had pills, spiritual weapons, spiritual beasts, everything.
With the repeated flashing of the teleportation array, motes of light floated down like stars, illuminating the faces of the other three lands’ reinforcements.
Western lands’ disciples had come to realize on that day at that stage that it was Zhuo Fan who had struck last. They hoped to visit him, but with the war upon them, the situation was too dire and they were refused.
The best disciple in western lands had returned and they wished to bask in his glorious presence, even as a prisoner.
Especially some of his old pals, wishing to talk about the past, but the martial law in the sect prevented all that.
As for the elders, they had never left the Main Hall. They had been looming over the map of the five lands with increasing worry and constantly debating on the right tactic.
The enemy was taking them by the storm, with Invincible Sword having already slipped deep into their lands and in hiding. He felt like a hanging axe over their necks. Many experts were left behind so the main base wouldn’t fall so quickly. But with the frontline having Danqing Shen, the casualties would mount fast.
This war was hard, especially being pushed from two sides…
“Baili Jingwei is a true tactician, having Invincible Sword’s team slip into our lands to control our reactions. While they can bide their time, we need to think twice on every action. We can only watch as our frontlines get pushed back, watch as death looms ever closer.”
Ling Yuntian was bleak, looking at the other experts, “Do any of you have any ideas? Please share it!”
Murong Lie shook his head, “We’re mostly fighting men. Fighting alone is more our style and we are unaccustomed to such large-scale battles. And there’s also Baili Jingwei manipulating the board from behind. This only makes things worse.”
“Western lands has a few deep thinkers and men of military expertise. They protect western lands’ borders but we didn’t bring them. They would surely have a solution.”
Exalted Hei Ran spoke with a frown.
Ouyang Lingtian nodded, “These years the Luo Alliance has experienced immense growth with the military clan leading them. The western lands should be under their control.
“Yes, ever since they came in, western lands’ safety has only solidified, ha-ha-ha…” Exalted Bai Mei laughed with pride.
“A shame they’re left as western lands defenders. Just one of them coming to northern lands would’ve been of immense help in making sense on how to counter this grave problem.”
Bu Xingyun had a wry smile, “Exalted Bai Mei sure is confident in western lands’ defense. Then when the central area attacks western lands, there’ll be no need for our help, yes? You should be able to last for a long time, humph.”
Exalted Bai Mei glared at him.
“Report!”
A disciple burst in and presented a jade slip, not to Sect Leader Ling, but to Exalted Double Dragons, “Exalted, there’s an urgent report! Western lands is in danger!”
[What?!]
Exalted Hei Ran snatched the jade slip and gasped, “Zither Sword King is marching with his army on western lands!”
Everyone gasped.
“How can it be? Does Baili Jingwei plan on taking two lands in this war? Is central area that strong?”
“People, western lands is in peril, can you…” Exalted Hei Ran cupped his hand with a heavy look. Bu Xingyun scoffed, enjoying his pain, “Exalted Hei Ran, you needn’t be hasty. We all know western lands has the most capable Luo Alliance tending to its borders. They won’t fail. It’s best we address northern lands’ issues first before tending to western lands.”
“You…” Exalted Hei Ran gnashed his teeth and flicked his hand, “Inform all of western lands’ people! We’re returning!”
“Exalted, please, we need to stay united. We’re not abandoning western lands. Don’t listen to Sect Leader Bu!” Ling Yuntian bowed in apology.
Exalted Hei Ran bowed back, looking guilty, “Sect Leader Ling, I am not so petty. We just can’t ignore our home’s plight. We can’t help northern lands in this, I’m sorry. Once western lands is safe again, we’ll be rushing to help northern lands.”
“The four lands are of one body, helping each other in need.”
Ling Yuntian was very courteous, “Western lands is in danger and you should by all right go protect them. Once northern lands is stable, we will provide help.”
The Exalted Double Dragons bowed once more in gratitude.
The people of western lands soon gathered outside the hall, ready to head back. The other three lands’ men saw them off.
But then, another disciple rushed to the elders with a jade slip, bowing to Murong Lie, “Clan Head, Wine Sword Immortal is leading an army for southern lands. Please return and fight him off!”
“Southern lands as well…”
Murong Lie shook in shock, just as another disciple shot for Shangguan Feixiong with a jade slip, “Clan Head, eastern lands reports that Shangguan Feiyun is marching with three million strong on our borders. Please make a decision, Clan Head!”
“Now eastern lands?”
Shangguan Feixiong’s mouth twitched and paled. Everyone else was looking agape.
Northern lands was at war and now the other three lands were engaged in battle as well. What was worse, each front had a Sword King leading them.
[What’s Baili Jingwei thinking? Is he planning to take all the lands by going all out?]
Ling Yuntian slumped from the shock, “They say Baili Jingwei is a mastermind of complex plans, subtle and sharp. Why then would he risk so much by attacking with everything and leaving himself open?”
“Central area is now open. Doesn’t he fear an attack? Even with Sword Star Empire leading an entire land, it still needs all the manpower it has to war against the other four. Any unrest in their empire might prove fatal. So why…”
Everyone was overwhelmed by such a seemingly rash tactic.
Shangguan Feixiong sighed, “We can talk all we want about his risk, but if we don’t do something, it’ll be our homes that fall.”
“Sorry, Sect Leader Ling, we need to defend our homes. Goodbye!”
“We want to help northern lands, but we need to protect our lands, forgive us…”
“Sect Leader Ling, we’re friends, but we need to look after ourselves first. Forgive us…”
…
Everyone rushed to say their apologies to Sect Leader Ling and got ready to leave. They had to return home and not dally in another’s.
Ling Yuntian sighed in defeat, “We’ll be broken, all of us, if we scatter. Ask yourselves, which land can stand up to central area by itself? Northern lands are under the greatest danger of destruction, with Invincible Sword and five Sword Kings lurking in shadows. We will be the first to fall, followed by everyone else, one by one. We need to stand together and not let him pick us apart. Otherwise it’ll only be a matter of who dies last.”
“Sect Leader Ling, we understand, but who do we sacrifice?”
Exalted Hei Ran looked long at Ling Yuntian, “We all know victory comes from unity, while death follows apart, but we have no choice. I’m from western lands so of course I think for their safety. Shangguan Clan Head is from eastern lands and wants their best too and would not agree. Isn’t that the same for northern lands and southern lands? Baili Jingwei has given us a very tough problem that no one can address, left to handing a blank paper with no answer.”
The others could do nothing but cup their hands, “Baili Jingwei is a true mastermind. He can see how weak we are and even though we gathered to help, it’s just a joke now. He is a demon toying with us. Who the hell would sacrifice three lands over one’s safety?”
The others shook their heads, neither wanting to give up their homes and domains. It was like waiting for central area to trap them and snuff them out.
They sighed powerlessly and in despair, “In the end, our fates are in heaven’s hands. We can only last as long as we can manage…”
“Maybe one person can solve this!” Someone barged into their despairing speech.
Everyone turned to Shangguan Feixiong in shock, “Who?”
“Gu Yifan!”
Shangguan Feixiong’s eyes flashed, “Uh, I mean western lands’ best disciple, Zhuo Fan. He once helped us steal our sword back from central area, even clashing with Baili Jingwei and winning. The only one who can stand up to Baili Jingwei’s sharp mind is him!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1042 - 1042, Beseech the Devil
chapters.content:
Chapter 1042, Beseech the Devil
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
All eyes shot in his direction then agreed after a moment of reflection.
They all had first-hand experience of Zhuo Fan’s twisted and insidious mind. The Exalted Double Dragons could be said to take the cake, if there was a prize involved, “Zhuo Fan’s skill is unquestionable. He was well known in western lands back then, even laying the foundation of today’s Luo Alliance. It’s a good thing we can consult him on the four lands’ plight, and we might even make a comeback.”
“Uh, then we should forget our status and seek his counsel…”
“You can’t!”
Ling Yuntian agreed after a pause, with Murong Xue glaring at them in cloying righteous anger, “He’s an abomination, a herald of calamity. By no means can we hand over command of countless lives to him so he can do what he pleases. It will lead to unspeakable horrors!”
Ling Yuntian frowned and spoke solemnly, “Does miss Murong have a better idea for our current crisis?”
“I…”
Murong Xue could find no words.
Ling Yuntian sighed, “Miss Murong, forgive an old man’s crude words, but what man would care if the water is good or not when thirst has him in a tight grip? As the urgent matters stand, we need someone that can help us overcome this situation. We’re at a point when any idea, even rotten, would be better than nothing, regardless of consequences.
“Miss Murong, we’re open to any ideas you might have. But if you have none, I hope miss won’t be so adamant to refuse, thank you.”
Ling Yuntian bowed with a cold face then addressed the rest, “Let’s go see what solution can the western lands’ best disciple provide.”
He led the way to the sect dungeon, his eyes gleaming with hope. Murong Xue was the only one left behind in defiance still.
“Xue’er, the bigger picture takes precedence. Stop only thinking of your biased principles!” Murong Lie patted her shoulder with a sigh.
Murong Xue was indignant, “I’m not biased. The guy’s mind is warped. Any plan will be twisted, uncaring for the dangers it might bright, or the damage. Just why does Sect Leader Ling insist on beseeching a devil?”
“In despair, man will take anything, be it from god or a devil.” Murong Lie sighed, patted her head and followed after them.
Their last hope was Zhuo Fan who beat Baili Jingwei at his own game. They gave little thought to the indignity and cruelty such a plan might involve…
Inside his cell, Zhuo Fan was enjoying his rare moment of bliss.
He was meticulous in combing the white hair of his wife, flowing before him like a silver waterfall.
Zhuo Fan smiled, filled with tenderness for the woman. He prompted Qiao’er for an answer, “What do you think of your dad’s combing this time?”
“Better.” Qiao’er giggled with a thumbs up.
Zhuo Fan nodded and said, “Of course, after three days of combing, I’ve got the hang of it, though even combing forever feels short. I just hope to give your mom the best combing I can before leaving. I wouldn’t want to leave in regret.”
“Dad, we’ll be getting back from the North Sea safely, don’t worry.” Qiao’er noticed his worry and soothed him.
Zhuo Fan said, “Who can tell for certain? It’s best to plan ahead. It’s because of doing things without a plan last time that I hurt your mom leaving like that. I will think it through now and go without regret. So that if I don’t return, I’ll leave your mom cared for.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes moistened as he looked at Chu Qingcheng. Qiao’er shook her head, falling silent.
“You’re a true man, sir. I have seen many demonic cultivators, men that have gone far on the demonic path, betrayers and savages, but none like sir, so intoxicated with love, outdoing many great righteous cultivators too.”
The Four Snow Peak Elders were touched by his display of affection and sighed, “You look nothing like a demonic cultivator. When we heard of your past exploits then see you now, it’s like you’re a different person. Has sir relinquished the demonic path or have you reached a stage beyond our scope? We are simply bemused.”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Who can say? Emotion is the bane of the demonic path, but in the words of my masters, a checkpoint in the demonic path. So I plunge in head-on, deeper and deeper. Even I have yet to realize just how far gone I am. I may just be walking a new demonic path. Though I’ve only passed the start of it, with no end in sight. Or maybe I’ve strayed from the path without even knowing it.”
“Sir is of incredible bravery to walk an untraveled road and its dangers. We are in awe.” The elders bowed, “But taking a new path to its end is bound to bring monumental achievement. We would wish for nothing more than to witness your glory!”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “The road ahead is obscured. I can’t even get my bearings, let alone think of glory. But this path I chose I will brace myself until the very end. To stay by her side and defeat my enemy, I need to keep going.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone with conviction and the four elders paid their respects again.
Bam!
The jail door opened and Ling Yuntian’s group entered with long faces.
The four elders glanced over with a frown, even annoyance, at the interference.
These three days, these exceptional experts had been watching Zhuo Fan and his deep insight in the demonic path. They had casual words exchanged, yet each were entwined with profound truths.
The elders had come to forget about their guard duty, resolved to expound on Dao and glean many truths and realizations for their souls.
Ling Yuntian’s arrival was most unwelcomed, carrying with him and his group the rot of the mortal world. The four were, understandably, most against it.
Like how a child was having the sweetest dream getting shaken awake and smelled reality.
The four elders were the same. The righteous path overcomes the mortal world, and with the debates they held with Zhuo Fan, they felt they were above mundane and mortal desires. But to be plunged back down in the mortal mire gave a shock to their systems.
As Sea Bright Sect’s venerables, they knew their Sect Leader had to have come with real reasons and welcomed him with respect instead of anger.
Ling Yuntian was too rushed to notice their change, bowing before Zhuo Fan, “Sir Zhuo, I have come today seeking counsel.”
“I know.”
“You do?”
“It’s just about that time.” Zhuo Fan smiled, pausing his combing and regarding the agitated old men, “Central area’s Sword Sword Star Empire must’ve attacked.”
Ling Yuntian shook, “Sir, how do you know?”
“Isn’t it obvious? Sect Leader Ling’s hasty arrival could only mean real business. If not Heaven Sealing Sword, then it’s central area related. Not to mention you weren’t that distressed even when you lost Heaven Sealing Sword.”
Zhuo Fan smirked as he walked closer and sat on a chair a guard freed for him, “And lastly, the central area had to have taken such action that even Sect Leader Ling couldn’t cope with, ha-ha-ha…”
Everyone’s hearts sank, yet their eyes gleamed brighter.
[Zhuo Fan lives up to his name, of incredible mind and foresight. That means he should have a counter for Baili Jingwei’s plan.]
They all looked eagerly at Zhuo Fan, like their savior. Shangguan Feixiong was even more excited, “Sect Leader Ling, didn’t I tell you he’s a deep thinker? Coming to him for help in this was the best idea. Don’t stand around, ask young master Zhuo for the solution.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1043 - 1043, Four Lands’ Grand Marshal
chapters.content:
Chapter 1043, Four Lands’ Grand Marshal
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Uh, right, young master Zhuo, central area’s army…” Ling Yuntian rushed to bow as he spoke.
Zhuo Fan dismissed him with a wave, “There’s no need of that, I already know. Central area’s army is not only attacking northern lands, but the other three lands, a war on all fronts and with no hope in sight.”
They all shook and stood there in stunned silence as they stared at Zhuo Fan.
“Sir has such a cunning mind!”
Ling Yuntian’s eye twitched, shaken awake, then bowed again, “We’ve only got word of these attacks, yet sir knows without even looking. Yes, it’s as sir said, Dragon Cleaving Sword King is leading the attack on northern lands, while the other lands each have a Sword King taking charge of those large armies as well. We can’t do anything and can’t think of what to do, just come ask for sir’s advice.”
Zhuo Fan smirked, “It’s quite simple, really, nothing to it.”
[Simple?]
Everyone twitched, their eyes glazed over in confusion.
[With this grave danger from being attacked on four fronts, Sir Zhuo thinks it’s nothing?]
[Is that just boasting, or does he have some godlike strategy to help us out of this?]
Everyone was looking incredulous and stunned.
[He can’t be playing with us, can he?]
Exalted Hei Ran got caught off-guard as well by his boasting, “Zhuo Fan, you’re the pride of western lands. We all know of your skills, but you can’t look at this with such disregard. You need to be serious. Baili Jingwei himself came up with this plan, the best mind in the central area. There is no room for errors. You need to think things through and come up with a complete response. How to deploy troops, how to repel the enemy, to provide support, to bait the enemy, to charge, all of these need thorough thinking. You are dealing with the most famous mind and any mistake…”
“Exalted Hei Ran, you’re just enumerating military tactics, but I’m not too familiar with these. If you’re after victory, you’re welcome to see Luo Yunhai. He’s much better than me.”
Zhuo Fan cut him off with a smirk, “You know him as Luo Clan Head, having grown in the military and of deeper knowledge of wars than myself.”
Ugh!
Exalted Hei Ran was stumped, “I mean, Zhuo Fan, don’t joke around. Luo Yunhai is a fine man, yes, but if he could fight the shrewd Baili Jingwei then the latter wouldn’t have put us in such a predicament by going to war on four fronts.
“So when not even an unbeatable general can handle him, this shows that military tactics have no place here.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Exalted Hei Ran, you’re already off the minute you thought about scoring victory. This isn’t a matter of fighting.”
They all flinched in bewilderment, with Ling Yuntian cupping his hands, “Sir Zhuo, if this is not war, what then?”
“Who is Baili Jingwei?”
“Central area’s Sword Star Empire Prime Minister!”
“There you have it.” Zhuo Fan cocked an eyebrow, “He’s no commander or general, but a Prime Minister. Is he even thinking about fighting you? He’s a politician, doing his very best with leveraging.”
Murong Lie’s brow shook and muttered, “How is a politician any different from a commander, now that he directs the central area armies?”
“He’s far greedier.”
Zhuo Fan replied, “There’s no guile without trade, but there’s none more cunning than a politician. A commander is always focused on gaining ground, on winning one battle at a time. While a politician is only thinking of fattening his pockets with every action while ignoring the details. He wages war with four lands, but does he really want to fight them all? His true purpose is to scatter you. No matter which land you choose to defend, the other three will be sour, making it easier for them to get the lands. It’s a far more effective plan than fighting for every inch of land. In other words, it’s a mind game, of no consequence, how the four wars end, while your changing mindset is.”
They all bobbed their heads, seeing reason.
Ling Yuntian bowed again in respect, “We’ve thought of this as well, but with sir’s analysis, we came to see how insidious it is. But understanding is one thing, while dealing with it is another. We ask for sir’s advice.”
“Couldn’t be easier. If Baili Jingwei was a nice guy, I’d be stumped as well. However, a guy enacting such a sneaky ploy has no place among the righteous. I can read him like an open book. When he had Baili Yutian go to northern lands with five Sword Kings, I had it all figured out. Neither of us are nice guys. Only a man of our devious minds can understand the other, he-he-he…”
Zhuo Fan had a cryptic smile and the other smiled in joy, eager to know what his counter was.
Zhuo Fan chose silence, unnerving them at the worst moment and making these old guys’ faces go red and beaming at him with endless hope.
[Bro, where’s the rest?]
Zhuo Fan spoke with pride, “By the way, we’ve yet to establish terms. Let’s begin, shall we?”
They all flinched and almost fell. Their faces twitched and faces fell.
[Oh right, nothing’s free in the world. He’s certainly not above asking to be paid for his rescue plan.]
Zhuo Fan sure knew how to sell himself, showcasing his talent before talking terms. Mentioning them any sooner and the other party would never believe in his skills.
Zhuo Fan led the talks, making it so he was their only hope of survival. They were stuck with him.
And as desperate men clinging for any lifeline, they would take his terms without question.
“Sir Zhuo, we will agree with any terms you might have, just help us against the central area’s invasions.” Ling Yuntian turned serious as he spoke in earnest.
That was all Zhuo Fan needed to hear, his face beaming, “First off, this five fronts war shall be under my command with none permitted to interfere.”
“Of course, since only you can handle Baili Jingwei, we will follow your lead.” Everyone gave hasty nods.
“Second, I want you to vow on your path to look after Qingcheng’s safety. No matter what happens, you are to protect her and look after her.”
“Uh, well…” They looked baffled, with Zhuo Fan continuing, “Anything can happen on the battlefield. At my sudden demise, you can’t even look after my family? I can’t leave this world knowing my wife isn’t taken care of. Vow and I’ll be at ease.”
[Oh, I see, sure.]
They all saw reason, making their vows based on their own path in cultivation. Once a cultivator made such a vow, it was for life. He had to fulfill it or his entire beliefs would crumble along with feeling the wrath of heaven.
None would take such a promise lightly, though it was just over some widow. What was the worst that could happen?
Only Exalted Bai Mei and Exalted Hei Ran felt their faces heat up. Zhuo Fan was clearly hinting at them saving Ye Lin while leaving Chu Qingcheng to die mere days before, at the stage.
Such was their bad luck, as Zhuo Fan was not around the past years to see how thoughtful they were of Chu Qingcheng all this time. Doing this had made it seem that this five-year-long favor was for nothing.
[Opportunity is much more praised than prevention.]
Exalted Hei Ran sighed.
Zhuo Fan was at ease now that this condition was accepted. He no longer needed to worry about Qingcheng’s safety when he’d be out at sea.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed and said, “Next isn’t much of a condition. It’s not exactly right for a convict to command the elders’ forces of every land…”
“Oh right, we are fully committed to supporting Grand Marshal Zhuo of the four lands in defending our homes from invaders. All lands’ sects and clans are at your disposal!”
Ling Yuntian bowed.
The rest followed suit, “May sir be appointed as Grand Marshal of the four lands to fight back the enemy!”
“In that case, what are you waiting for? Get this Grand Marshal free and out there fighting Baili Jingwei. Do you expect me to fight him behind bars?”
Zhuo Fan cocked an eyebrow and smirked. Qiao’er giggled at the side.
The merchant guards bowed with smiles of respect.
[Sir Zhuo is wise beyond his years. He had no worry of being exposed since he already had everything in control. He’s like a god…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1044 - 1044, Gotten too Far
chapters.content:
Chapter 1044, Gotten too Far
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Sister Xue’er, you can relax knowing my dad, brother Murong and everyone else are men with experience in the cultivation world. They’ve seen it all and aren’t about to let some fresh punk delude them.”
Before the Main Hall, Murong Xue was still looking distressed and in anger. Ouyang Changqing tried appeasing her.
But the girl of his dreams was most definitely not interested.
Western lands’ people had long since gathered, waiting on Double Dragon Manor’s orders to return and defend home. Northern lands’ best disciple words earned their cold glares. Ye Lin sneered as he mocked him, “You sure got a mouth on you. You’re not grown up yourself yet you call another a punk?”
“Ye Lin, I have beaten you once, best disciple in western lands, and I can do it again. Care to try?”
“What’s to fear fighting a dumb brat? But get one thing straight, I was the best disciple before, but with my elder brother back, I’m now second. Though I’m more than enough for the likes of you.”
“Then I’ll just start the thrashing with you before settling with your convicted elder brother. The best disciple in the land is a crucial part of my future. I’m not about to give it up, humph!”
Crack~
Ouyang Changqing’s knuckles crackled as he made his fist, giving Ye Lin a cruel smile. Ye Lin cocked his head, unafraid, smirking as he stepped closer.
The two were ready to draw blood.
The audience shook their heads, with Murong Xue totally ignoring them.
Wu Qingqiu waved his hands, stepping between them with a smile, “Little junior brother, we’re still guests here and can’t start a fight with our hosts. Young master Ouyang, you’re the image of your sect and shouldn’t fight with your guests. Both our elders will have to punish you if you go through with this. We’re about to part anyway, so can we please not do it with a fight? Let’s all go our way on good terms.”
The two huffed and looked away.
Wu Qingqiu shook his head. The others nodded at him.
[Ye Lin may be the strongest in western lands, but the leadership will fall to Wu Qingqiu with his elegance. He knows how to look at things in perspective.]
Only his broad mind could keep the peace between the sects. No other disciple was better than him…
“Humph, it might be late for a fight, but we still need to clear some things out.”
Unable to flex before the girl of his dreams just because of Wu Qingqiu’s smooth words, Ouyang Changqing grumbled, “I’m a reasonable man. I know you think the world of Zhuo Fan, but isn’t it because he’s stronger than you? Ha-ha-ha, I saw it myself, so I know it’s true. That is his talent, while his few decades on this earth can’t possibly compare to the experience my father and the elders have accumulated. You think he can handle something my dad can’t? I only put myself in their stead and called him a punk, what’s wrong with that?”
Wu Qingqiu shook his head, “Young master Ouyang is right, but you fail to understand brother Zhuo. Only by experiencing his tactics will you realize just how much better he is than many seniors. Why else would Sect Leader Ling and the others lower themselves to ask for a convict’s help?”
“Anyone would try anything when the time is dire.” Ouyang Changqing rolled his eyes.
Ye Lin smirked, “Why haven’t they come to you then?”
“You…” Ouyang Changqing glared at him in anger.
The elders then walked over, having returned from the dungeon.
Only this time, they looked much brighter and worry free from the time they left.
Among their starry eyes of hope was Zhuo Fan holding Chu Qingcheng’s soft hand and Qiao’er in the other.
The elders were even acting like servants, bowing and scraping before Zhuo Fan like he was their ancestor.
The disciples were mindblown.
[What just happened? Why is a convict being hailed a hero? The elders are cloyingly nice with him, like they had no dignity to speak of…]
Ouyang Changqing gaped there for a while, giving time for Zhuo Fan’s procession to step inside the Main Hall.
Ouyang Changqing then woke up and rushed to Ouyang Lingtian, “Dad, wait, what’s going on? Why are you so nice to some punk? Does he have such a brilliant plan to turn things around?”
“Uh, not yet, but soon.”
Ouyang Lingtian patted his head and rushed inside the Main Hall.
Ouyang Changqing’s face twitched and looked back at the rest of the stunned disciples, “The damn punk sure has talent, to swindle that many old men. I just can’t figure what grand plan he might have to even get my dad, a seasoned cultivator, to follow him around. Just what did he do?”
Everyone shook their heads.
“Ha-ha-ha, I did tell you. There are times when brother Zhuo is shrewder than any elder!” Wu Qingqiu proudly said.
Ouyang Changqing was most confused, still in disbelief.
[A damn brat just hoodwinked a bunch of seasoned old men?]
They were all grinning from ear to ear, like they just found their lord and savior. How could a brat pull it off?
[Godlike!]
[Why hasn’t dad ever looked at me like that?]
Ouyang Changqing was stumped, while Murong Xue totally blown away.
The most she believed was if these elders accepted Zhuo Fan’s foul plan, the world would be in chaos from his despicable and cruel methods.
But now it was way worse. These leaders of their own land had not just accepted his plan, but even worshiped him. Now the damage he’d do would only multiply.
Murong Xue caught Murong Lie, who was last to go in, with unease, and held his hand, “Brother, what’s happening? Weren’t you all going to ask him for a solution? Why is he out and about? I’d get it if it was his condition, but why are you all acting…”
“Xue’er, you weren’t there so you don’t know. We’ve sorely underestimated him.” Murong Lie took a deep breath.
Murong Xue said, “Brother, what does that mean?”
“His mind is sharp and astute, his plans sublime, inhumane even. I am of firm belief he may be the only one in the lands that can stand up to Baili Jingwei.’
Murong Lie looked ecstatic, “We had yet to explain Baili Jingwei’s actions to him yet he already foresaw it. We ourselves just became aware of this but he already knew. Isn’t that divine? That’s why we discussed having this danger on the lands averted, making him the four lands’ Grand Marshal, in control of everything. Everyone will heed his orders, including us.”
[What?!]
Everyone around gasped and began whispering, “Grand Marshal of the four lands, equal to becoming the ruler of them all! And he can deploy anyone?”
“Yeah, it’s that simple, but in times of war, we need him to resolve this crisis.”
Looking at them so shocked, Murong Lie waved his hand, “This is the situation. Now I need to go in and discuss further matters. For once, Shangguan Clan Head’s choice truly lives up to the hype, ha-ha-ha…”
Murong Lie slipped inside the Main Hall, leaving all these people behind to process such explosive news with dumb looks.
Wu Qingqiu was the first to come to, looking at his fellow disciples, Ye Lin and at Ouyang Changqing, “See? This is the power of the best disciple in western lands. While we are squabbling over who is the best disciple in the alliance, he already took control of the four lands, becoming their Grand Marshal. The elders are even following his orders. This is the gap between us. We are his peers yet left in the dust, so far behind we can’t even see him.”
Everyone bobbed their heads, then shook it in helplessness. The more behind they were in regards to that monster, the more despair they felt.
The most prideful man ever, Ouyang Changqing, felt the sting
much deeper than the rest…

chapters.title: Chapter 1045 - 1045, Only a Game
chapters.content:
Chapter 1045, Only a Game
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“No, any rotten plan coming from that demon would bring about only suffering and pain. He can’t be left in charge of the war! There’ll be no one left alive to pick up the pieces.”
Murong Xue was outraged and stormed into Main Hall, fanatic in her conviction. The others were still trying to come to terms with what they saw to stop her.
For the first time, Ouyang Changqing’s ego was so crippled, he could not attend to the girl of his dreams. He sighed to Wu Qingqiu, “I’ve never seen those old guys bow to anyone in my life. That best disciple of yours is a freak of nature. Since you’re around him all the time, isn’t his style influencing your cultivation and mind?”
“We’re still safe, since he didn’t get to reach Double Dragon Manor when he presumably died. Our minds had yet to be corrupted, ha-ha-ha…”
Wu Qingqiu’s group flinched and let out a dry laugh. Ouyang Changqing nodded, “What a stroke of luck, for if it were me, just being constantly compared with such a freak would give me a stroke from all the anger. Just how did he get to lead the four lands…”
Ouyang Changqing sat down with a dull gaze. Murong Xue just drove right into the Main Hall. She saw Ling Yuntian and other Genesis Stage experts pushing their Yuan Qi in Zhuo Fan’s acupoint and soon his cultivation was released.
Zhuo Fan stretched a bit and nodded with a grin.
Murong Xue glared at him, but bowed before Ling Yuntian with a request, “Sect Leader Ling, you said you were only going to hear his plan. Against my principles, I choose to respect that decision. But his mind is warped, so how can you let him take control of the four lands’ armies? There are too many lives at stake. The slightest mistake will lead to a genocide!”
“Miss Murong, that’s exactly why we have all come to this decision to let Sir Zhuo be in charge. Only he can fight a genius like Baili Jingwei. Miss Murong, would it be possible to address your bias to Sir Zhuo?” Ling Yuntian regarded her with a cold eye, fed up with this zealous girl.
Murong Lie no longer took her side after Zhuo Fan made him a believer out of his skills, “Xue’er, this is for everyone’s good, so don’t let emotions or your moral obligation, cloud your judgment. None of us could suffer the consequence of losing this war.”
“Then I request for Zhuo Fan to be under constant supervision, to stop him from abusing his authority. Every order needs unanimous approval before it is to be carried out. It’s the least measure of safety we can have to prevent his poison from seeping into the masses.”
Murong Xue stared burning daggers of hatred at Zhuo Fan. With not even her own brother taking her side, she knew Zhuo Fan had them wrapped around his finger and she could do nothing to change that. She could only compromise, no longer demanding his swift execution and instead try to curb his authority.
The others looked hesitantly towards Zhuo Fan. It would be a good idea to have a safety net in this chaos, stopping everything from devolving any mistake into a catastrophe.
So they turned to him to see his take on it.
Zhuo Fan spoke uncaring, “Have you all forgotten my first condition back in the dungeon? Complete control. And now you want to restrict me? Humph, fine, I’ll just quit…”
“Uh, wait, Sir Zhuo, that’s not it at all. Just…”
Ling Yuntian was panicking, glancing at Murong Xue, “It’s only miss Murong’s idea for an extra precaution. In the case when sir overlooks something, we can easily address the issue before it devolves.”
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow in mockery, “Overlook? Ha-ha-ha, true, no one is perfect and infallible. I will be sure to make mistakes…”
“Then does sir…”
“Not happening!”
Just as Ling Yuntian saw hope, Zhuo Fan snuffed it out, flying into a rage, “Sect Leader Ling and miss Murong, what do you take war for?”
The two had no reply ready. They were mere cultivators and knew little about war and all its aspects.
[Isn’t it mere fighting the other over resources and land? What else can it be?]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone coldly, “War is a game!”
“A game?”
Murong Xue flared, “You’re treating the horror and suffering the people endure on the battlefield as a game? This is absurd! How do you intend to win this war if you can’t even take it seriously? Sect Leader Ling, I still believe he isn’t right for…”
“Miss Murong, you’re the one underestimating war!”
Zhuo Fan shouted over her, “War is only a game. All the people, assets and locations are the pawns of the player. To win the war, one must use the least of his pawns to grasp most pawns of the enemy. Life and people have no place in it. A commander having a heavy conscience over these trifles can never win. And when he loses, the casualties mount in piles.”
Murong Xue’s lip shook, unable to retort.
Zhuo Fan’s gaze was ice, staring her down, “What war out there doesn’t have casualties, using your own people’s lives in exchange of the enemy’s? This is war in it’s purest form, a concept no one can deny. Miss Murong goes on and on about suffering and pain, then do you believe with that you can win on kindness alone? Taking command yourself will be the worst choice, making you an aid is handicapping the commander. For victory, yes, I may trade a large number of lives, but your kindness will stop my orders and result in a larger bloodshed. You want to save the people, or win the war? Which is it?”
“Uh, I think that winning the war means saving the people, ha-ha-ha…”
Murong Xue’s eyes flashed with determination, but it was Ling Yuntian who stepped in to speak what everyone else believed.
But all here knew winning the war and saving the people hardly were connected. Central area’s army was marching on northern lands but the people might survive.
All this talk was to give oneself a just cause, if nothing else.
They just wanted to win the war and not save the people. Murong Xue’s stance was thus in conflict with everyone else’s from the start.
“As we gave our word to let Sir Zhuo decide everything and he doesn’t agree, we will have to veto your request…”
“Wait.”
Zhuo Fan held up his hand, looking from Murong Xue to Ling Yuntian, “Sect Leader Ling, I’m not doing this to hold all power, but because the circumstances demand it. All here know that Baili Jingwei is leading the other camp, with nothing holding him back.
