I need to do the same, and not out of arrogance in my infallibility, but that even if there are things overlooked, you might not notice them but will distract me from doing my job with your actions.”
Ugh!
All tensed and gave a dry smile, “Sir Zhuo, what are you…”
“Ha-ha-ha, sorry, it may be hard to accept, but it’s the truth. We are all clear on the fact that the war is a game between me and Baili Jingwei. No matter what move we make, only we grasp the full implication it entails. Anyone watching would be blind to its intricacies, so it’s best to not interfere. Just do what I say and don’t ask questions.”
“Are you calling us fools?” Bu Xingyun’s face twitched and fell, “We can’t even join the fight between you two?”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “We each know ourselves best, which is why this is the second reason I don’t need assistance, ha-ha-ha…”
“Ha-ha! That’s a mockery if I ever heard one! You just got out of jail and started acting smug. See how I throw you back in…” Bu Xingyun grew enraged as he let anger get the best of him, even attacking.
Ling Yuntian jumped before him, “Sect Leader Bu, you’re in the Sea Bright Sect, can you please have some of the courtesy of a guest? Sir Zhuo could’ve just as well been a simple guest and you’d have still had no right to treat him like this!”
Bu Xingyun’s mouth twitched, gnashing his teeth as he glared at Zhuo Fan.
“Sir Zhuo, forgive me, Sect Leader Bu is a bit rash. Don’t mind it.”
He let out a deep breath sighed and bowed to Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan smirked at Bu Xingyun, “No worries, I’ve seen my fair share of mangy curs. I don’t have time to pay attention to all the barking, ha-ha-ha…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1046 - 1046, Weird Order
chapters.content:
Chapter 1046, Weird Order
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Why you…”
Bu Xingyun’s eyes were bloodshot but Ling Yuntian’s glare made him flinch back. The latter turned to Zhuo Fan with a bow, “Sir Zhuo, please. Allow me to introduce you to the current affairs before you pass your instructions. Ha-ha-ha, the frontlines are strong, with east and west…”
“That won’t be necessary.””
Zhuo Fan held up his hand, his eyes flashing, “Sect Leader Ling, I already said that Baili Jingwei is a politician, his attention is not on the frontlines so we don’t need to give them any either.”
[Ignore the frontlines?]
Murong Xue winced, never hearing this kind of reason before, and defied his logic, “As the Grand Marshal, you refuse other’s advice, you ignore the battlefield, so how then do you intend to fight, how do you intend to command? I may not be versed in the art of war, I have seen my fair share of leaders and their armies, but never one to give blind orders like you. Who do you think you are, divinity?”
“Behold and witness my… divinity, ha-ha-ha!”
Zhuo Fan shrugged, leaning into the tutor chair as he ordered, “Have all lands, beside northern lands, withdraw all troops. Give up the borders and fall back to the center. Like Double Dragon Manor for western lands, the other lands must have their own main base. They have three days to gather in their respective bases!”
[What?!]
Everyone went wide eyed, Ling Yuntian’s hand still gesturing at the map shaking from fright.
“S-Sir Zhuo, come again? All lands are to fall back to their bases? That will leave the enemy free rein to march into our homes and we’ll have a harder time fighting back. That’s like giving the lands to the enemy. Sir Zhuo, please…”
“You don’t trust me?”
Zhuo Fan scanned their eyes, mocking, “Fight it yourself then, and leave me out of it.”
“Uh, no no no, Sir Zhuo, we only find this order a bit ridiculous. We just don’t know what sir is aiming for by doing this…”
Ling Yuntian saw the others looking bleak as well.
Zhuo Fan smirked, “Didn’t I tell you? When I make a move, you won’t see its truths. Isn’t this obstruction of duty? You are to relay my order at once. Any delay from your part will lead to defeat and disaster, which is on you.”
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes and exasperatedly placed one leg over the other, taking his time to relish the song he was humming.
The war and anything were of no concern to him.
But that did not apply to the rest of the frantic leaders here, who were a distressed and nervous wreck.
Zhuo Fan’s foresight and insight were unquestionable. Stealing Heaven Sealing Sword from them, helping Shangguan clan retrieve Soaring Sword and fighting Baili Jingwei spoke for themselves.
Then there was now, Zhuo Fan throwing out a random order with no rhyme nor reason, no different from suicide, and expecting them to just accept it.
By following this over, they thought, would lead to the fall of the three lands in under a month. And by denying it, the lands might hold their ground for a year or so, at best.
[Just what secrets does his order hold?]
The oldies looked at each other, stumped, filled with hesitation.
“Sect Leader Ling, brother, I told you this guy’s head is filled with rotten plans. Don’t be fooled. He’s making every land commit suicide!” Murong Xue’s decisive tone cut the awkward mood, using this chance to get back at Zhuo Fan and expose his foul deeds.
The others frowned, eyeing the casual Zhuo Fan undecided still. Zhuo Fan smirked, “The only reason you bowed and scraped for my help was to get you out of this crisis, no? Since you’re going to die anyway, you’re afraid of going a couple days earlier? Humph, bunch of ninnies!”
“Guard!”
Ling Yuntian had enough of worrying and ordered, “Notify all lands to fall back! Abandon the frontlines and return to their bases. They have three days!”
“Yes, sir!”
The man flew away to pass his words.
The others panicked, “Sect Leader Ling…”
“Anything is better than nothing. Do any of you have a better idea?” Ling Yuntian sighed and said, “Sir Zhuo, we’ve followed your wishes. What do we do next?”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Wait. The next step comes after three days.”
“In three days we’ll see the effect?” Ling Yuntian startled him and everyone else.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Yep, haste makes waste. Lighten up, the lands won’t perish in three days. Also, since you trust me, I will cooperate on my side as well.”
Zhuo Fan turned serious and gestured for a merchant guard to lend him his ear, “You can go back and report to Wu Randong at once and restore the company in the central area, no, in every other land than northern lands that is at war.”
“So soon? But with the lands at war…”
“It’s only war that offers us unique opportunities. While the factions fight, we may still be walking in shadows, but we will expand greatly from it as well. Once dust settles, the chance will be missed as well!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed, “Pay particular attention to the central area and move fast and hard. I want Baili Jingwei’s worst nightmare to come alive before his eyes. He won’t be able to stop it then, ha-ha-ha…”
The man nodded and bowed, “I obey, sir!”
He took the other caravan guards and left. Watching them go with such haste, Ling Yuntian was bemused, “Sir Zhuo, they…”
“I had our own men work in tandem with your movements. Devil Mountain may be a hidden sect and doesn’t involve itself in mortal affairs, but it still holds sway among mortals. I had them make contact and help you stir some trouble for our dear friend Baili Jingwei.”
“Truly?”
Ling Yuntian lit up with joy and bowed, “I am most honored to have the great Devil Mountain offer assistance. Thank you sir for everything.”
The others were also happy, happy they made the right choice in putting Zhuo Fan in the lead of the alliance’s army. He even got his sect involved, which was a cause for celebration.
Zhuo Fan was modest, “It’s nothing, just a few mortal forces. Though my sect is hidden and away from mortal affairs, ha-ha-ha…”
[It’s not to help you by any means, just expanding my power while I’m at it. I’m not a soup kitchen so I don’t work for free, ha-ha!]
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes, while Murong Xue stared intently at him, like looking at a criminal.
[Your game won’t work, not while I’m watching your every move!]
In western lands, Alliance Leader Luo Yunhai with Zhuge Changfeng, Leng Wuchang and You Ming were in the commanding tent discussing plans with a sigh.
“People, it’s been three long days of analysis and scouting. Do you have any idea how to fight the enemy?” Luo Yunhai looked haggard as he turned to his aides.
The three shook their heads in helplessness.
You Ming was the most versed in military and pointed at the enemy camp on the map, “The enemy is Zither Sword King, of no military background and knows nothing about leading soldiers. Their ranks aren’t tight either. Anyone else would’ve had an easy time fighting them, but they have the advantage in power. Their twenty million men are most experts, with Zither Sword King the strongest of them all, able to fight thousands. No matter what tactic, what maneuver, what trap we use, their power will mow us down with a frontal assault each time.”
You Ming glanced at Leng Wuchang.
“Don’t look at me. Since you can’t figure it out, you think I can? My opponent ain’t any weaker than yours.”
Leng Wuchang sighed and shook his head, “All strategy is based on overt and covert tactics. Overt regards formations, while covert hide intentions to a sinister outcome. However, while Zither Sword King leads the army, a practitioner, the strategist is none other than the best official in the central area, Baili Jingwei. He is skilled in overt and covert alike. It’s impossible to grasp any weakness to exploit. I have taken a look at the situation and Baili Jingwei has made his deployment unbreakable. The only chance I can gather is from the rear.”
“Rear?”
“Yes, he is attacking the four lands with an army each so the lands would have no time for anything else, a master stroke. The four lands can no longer take care of each other in this case. But it’s also because of this that he leaves his back open. We need to make a commotion in his rear and will force him to withdraw in panic.”
Leng Wuchang spoke solemnly, pointing at the map, “However, all paths out of the four lands are blocked. Who will reach his rear? That’s why the only weakness can’t be leveraged. Baili Jingwei’s armies march with all their might upon us, trapping us and leaving us no room to win.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1047 - 1047, Heaven’s Secrets
chapters.content:
Chapter 1047, Heaven’s Secrets
Luo Yunhai overlooked the tactical map in deep worry, “Yes, with the four lands under attack, making use of the front to gain any semblance of success is an impossibility. Sir Leng, is there any chance whatsoever that we can attack the central area’s heart? Rumors, divide and conquer, or any tactic to raise doubts and crumble their military offensive.”
“Uh, well…”
Leng Wuchang shook his head, turning to Zhuge Changfeng, passing the baton, “Clan Head, Zhuge Changfeng has once been an empire’s Prime Minister. He is much better suited for this, ha-ha-ha…”
Luo Yunhai looked on to Zhuge Changfeng with hope, the Luo clan’s great steward.
Zhuge Changfeng rolled his eyes and sighed, “Sir Leng, you’re so sly, knowing there’s no solution yet dragging me into this. Are you mocking me?”
Leng Wuchang lowered his head with a grin.
“Steward Zhuge, there’s no weakness we can exploit inside their hearts either?” Luo Yunhai’s eyes shook and his heart fell.
Zhuge Changfeng pondered before sighing, “Clan Head, forgive my incompetence. The Sword Star Empire has been a baffling nation since inception. Normal tactics don’t work on it. In normal empires, the emperor would be in constant dissent with his officials, one side striving to better the other. And while a direct military offensive would show little result, inciting the enemy court would pit them against each other.”
Luo Yunhai knew this all too well. His godfather was a victim of it. He hated these suspicions between the lord and its subjects, but also knew their value.
In any empire, no matter how strong, suspicions between the lord and the officials would lead to mistakes that brought about collapse. One could have a godly commander and flawless officials, as long as the emperor mistrusted them, he would do all he could to relieve them of their lives.
What came next was the enemy nation having their trouble while the crisis was averted
In this situation, Luo Yunhai, a modest man, found this underhanded tactic the most plausible. In any case, all is fair in love and war. Winning was all that mattered, with no tactic being avoided, be it overt or covert.
Though judging by Zhuge Changfeng’s look, such a tactic wouldn’t work.
“Clan Head, The emperor Baili Jingshi is no less able as Baili Jingwei, thus making such a tactic fruitless. But the crux is the Sword Star Empire’s structure, unlike your average empire, and sowing dissent won’t work on it. The emperor and the Prime Minister are appointed by Baili Yutian. This leads to no conflict between the two and thus no suspicions.”
Zhuge Changfeng sighed, “The emperor doesn’t fear his minister, and the same goes for the latter. The two work together, like a double-headed dragon in ruling the empire. And even if, by absurd, dissent works, Baili Jingwei’s military command won’t be affected by the emperor. The only appropriate target for dissent is Invincible Sword. Alas, he’s a madman, thinking himself on top of the world and finding even the Sword Star Empire beneath him. Telling him that Baili Jingwei is against him; he won’t believe it, or even care for that matter. He is certain that nothing in this world can make him fall and thus nothing matters.
“Yeah, Invincible Sword is beyond arrogant, which makes him a worse target for dissent because he doesn’t care in the first place, no matter how things play out.”
Leng Wuchang hesitated, “Fear is the easiest emotion one can leverage. Without it, he won’t argue with vile people.”
Zhuge Changfeng eyed him, “Sir Leng, who are you calling vile?”
“Steward Zhuge, you understand that some debatable methods are unavoidable in diplomacy. I’m not cursing you.” Leng Wuchang chuckled.
Zhuge Changfeng smirked, “We’re all wallowing in trickery, with neither one of us any better. But isn’t it all for the swift rise of the clan?”
“True, we had to pull strings and make sure our new allies would see dangers outside the protective embrace of our Luo Alliance. Hasn’t Steward Zhuo put us here for this reason? Had we been any upright, Steward Zhuo would’ve never chosen us as Clan Head’s aides.”
You Ming sighed.
They all had to nod at that, with Leng Wuchang resuming, “Clan Head is just too morally bound, leaving the dirty work to us. Only now we three have the same enemy yet can’t help Clan Head overcome this problem. I wonder how Steward Zhuo would approach this?”
The four looked lonely, with Luo Yunhai still feeling the loss of his friend.
[Brother Zhuo, I thank you for all you did in the battle with Quanrong and preventing the people of Tianyu from suffering. Now all of western lands are in peril. Just where are you? What should I do?]
“Yunhai!”
A soft voice suddenly broke the silence as two figures burst into the tent.
Luo Yunhai gasped, “Sister, Yue’er, what is it?”
“Since Yue’er has finished her current supply orders for the Luo Alliance, we came to see you!”
Luo Yunchang smiled at her brother, looking fondly, “Yunhai, you’ve been looking a bit thin lately. You need to take care of yourself.”
Luo Yunhai chuckled, “It’s fine.”
The other three bowed to the girls, “Greetings young miss, madam!”
“There’s no need for courtesy. You have been helping Yunhai all this time and I am grateful to you for relieving some of his worries.” Luo Yunchang replied in kind, with the three bowing again, “Young miss is too kind.”
“Husband, we heard sister Lei say the enemy camp is showing movement. They’re going to attack soon. Do you have any plans?”
Yue’er went to Luo Yunhai’s side and looked concerned.
He and the other three men all shook their heads.
Yue’er fell silent before smiling, “Husband, don’t worry too much, sister Shuang’er had gone to her ancestral home to pray for a solution to her ancestors’ spirits. She said heaven might help us turn things around.”
“Holy Maiden has seen the disaster coming and has divined that overcoming it is beyond impossible. It’s no less difficult from Tianyu’s last war. All we can do now is do our best and follow heaven’s will. It is up to it if we are to perish.” Luo Yunhai shook his head with a bitter look.
Yue’er rushed to console him, “Husband, sister Shuang’er said the ancestor’s divination is far more precise than hers and may work in our favor. Don’t be discouraged. Hasn’t the last crisis of Tianyu been solved as well?”
“That was with brother Zhuo’s help. Holy Maiden said he operates outside heaven’s will and can change it. How then could we, mere mortals, fight the heavens?”
The others’ hearts sank. Zhuge Changfeng and the others refused to believe this, that they would rather fight the heavens above. But as matters stood, it was out of their hands, they had no hope but to trust in fate.
“No matter what, let’s wait for Shuang’er’s reading. If heaven can’t be swayed, we just do our best to fight it.” Luo Yunchang spoke with determination
The others nodded.
Whoosh~
Yun Shuang rushed into the tent and gasped for breath, “A sliver of hope just appeared!
“What?”
“The fates are shifting!”
Yun Shuang panted, yet her eyes glimmered with hope, “I’ve read the heavens with the ancestor spirit’s help when going to my home and saw total demise, but then the fates changed. A power unlike any other is shaping fate, presenting us with a sliver of hope. We may fight this war yet!”
Luo Yunhai gave a shaky question, “Holy Maiden, what do you mean?”
“It’s just like the last great war of Tianyu. Someone outside fate is fighting it. The central area’s certainty of winning against the four lands might crumble!”
Luo Yunhai gasped, “Another man like brother Zhuo is involved in this war? But Holy Maiden, didn’t you say there are no other people outside fate? How come another one appeared so soon?”
“I am unclear. Could it be a flood of unchained people?” Frowning, Yun Shuang looked confused, “But with how big the world is, there’s a chance a second one had to appear.”
Luo Yunhai squinted, incredulous, “People are born between heaven and earth. Just how coincidental this is, for a person outside fate to appear right when the need is dire? People, I have a strong feeling this person is known to us, as if…”
Luo Yunhai trailed off, even he felt his guess was outrageous. Their disappointment would be too great if it proved to be false. Yet his eyes were filled with excited tears, his heart drumming in his chest.
[Brother Zhuo, have you come back?]

chapters.title: Chapter 1048 - 1048, Back
chapters.content:
Chapter 1048, Back
“Marshal Luo, orders are here!”
An elder came into the commanding tent as he boomed. The hopeful, curious and tense gazes had him pause, “Uh, what’s wrong?”
Luo Yunhai smiled and said, “Commander Touba, what urgent order has you running here?”
“Righ, Tuoba Tieshan, you were quite cocky when you were invited into the Luo Alliance and even gave us many conditions. It’s only due to our kind Clan Head, and his respect for seniors, that he agreed without delay. If it were me, humph.”
Leng Wuchang mocked, “So what is it this time, that you have to relay the order in person? Back then you insisted on being on equal grounds with Clan Head. Not even the seven houses joining the Luo Alliance first were treated as such. Yet a defeated Quanrong commander…”
“Sir Leng!”
Luo Yunhai cut him off with a look, cupping his hands to Tuoba Tieshan, “Forgive me, Steward Leng has been rude to commander. Please accept my apologies in his stead.”
“Uh, no no no, Marshal Luo, it’s I who is sorry.”
Tuoba Tieshan sighed, “Sir Leng is right. I was very rude when I joined Luo Alliance, proud of my seniority. But that was because of being a defeated commander, thinking that I would receive a cold reception. I never thought I’d see Marshal Luo to be so courteous and magnanimous. I feel ashamed. I’ve come to know many of the Quanrong imperial family’s secrets and when I should’ve been silenced, the Luo Alliance took me in and protected me. I thank you so much, Marshal Luo, for saving my life!”
Tuoba Tieshan gave a deep bow and Luo Yunhai went to help him up, “Commander Touba, you’re an undefeated god of war like my godfather. It is Luo Alliance’s honor to have you. I could never watch as a hero commander ends up framed. Commander, you needn’t trouble yourself over such small things.”
Tuoba Tieshan was touched by Luo Yunhai’s respect and grabbed his hand.
“Luo clan’s righteousness is without equal!”
“Commander, you’re exaggerating.”
Luo Yunhai smiled then grabbed his hand hard. Luo Yunchang and Yue’er were watching contentedly.
Only Leng Wuchang remained unfazed, speaking with Zhuge Changfeng, “Old man, you’d think the old commander would be as excited if he knew you had a hand in making the Quanrong emperor wish him dead?”
Zhuge Changfeng shot him a sharp glare, “Don’t let Clan Head hear you. Let only us know of these dark things we do. The old coot was conceited when Clan Head invited him in, but now look at him. If not for Clan Head having a soft spot for him and with us needing to expand our military, you’d think I’d waste time over this? Anyway, it’s our duty to help Clan Head in his plans, the same thing Steward Zhuo had done back in the day. The only reason my trick worked was because the Quanrong emperor already had a bad impression of the old man. In the end it’s the conflict between lord and official that led to this. I only revealed the issue to him and helped him out. Or once the situation devolved any more, they would be at each other’s throats and there was no saving we could’ve done. Even if Clan Head finds out at some point, I did it for the greater good.”
Leng Wuchang nodded, “Who hasn’t? Ha-ha-ha…”
“Commander, you were in quite the hurry. What has you coming here in person?” Luo Yunhai asked.
Tuoba Tieshan started and then recalled his mission, presenting a jade slip in anger, “Marshal Luo, this is preposterous. I don’t know what those leaders are thinking about sending such an absurd order. They want all the lands beside northern lands to fall back to their bases. Isn’t it clearly making it worse? The defenses and arrays on the borders are our greatest asset. Leaving them behind will give the enemy free rein to cull us down at every turn. Just what are those guys doing?”
“Is this true?”
Luo Yunhai gasped, reading the jade slip at once and his face sinking, “Letting the enemy take our greatest defense is simply suicidal!”
Tuoba Tieshan nodded in anger, “Precisely, those morons haven’t ever stepped foot on a battlefield and now they start giving orders to us seasoned generals. Our defeat is certain now. Though even defending wouldn’t assure a win, we’ll at least last for a lot longer. Marshal Luo, you’re the Exalted Double Dragons appointed chief of western lands’s defenses before their departure. All of us will listen to you. What should we do?”
“When the general’s away, the lord’s orders can’t reach him!”
Luo Yunhai threw the jade slip as he spoke harshly, “No one with the slightest military common sense would ever follow such an idiotic order. They’re treating war as a game!”
“Yes! Those leaders must’ve lost their minds to send such an order. One land’s leaders might propose it, but the other three actually accepted it? Are they all idiots?”
Tuoba Tieshan ranted, his anger burning brightly, “I just can’t believe our leaders would be so useless! Just how on earth did the four lands even survive for so long against the central area’s attacks?”
The others nodded and Leng Wuchang spoke, “Clan Head, no matter who issued this infantile order, it comes from straight above. Refusing, even if winning, will incur punishment. Maybe it will mark the end of our place in western lands. We have nothing to gain from it so why still fight?”
“There are some things a man must do. A soldier must do his duty. I fight to stop the central area’s oppression and trample of the western lands so that the people can be safe and not for the appreciation of the higher ups.”
Luo Yunhai huffed and shouted, “As long as there’s even a man alive from Luo clan, we will defend western lands. I am a Marshal of western lands for a reason and I intend to uphold my duty. Let those leaders go to hell, I still have a conscience!”
The others’ hearts thumped, looking at him in admiration. Luo Yunchang and Yue’er nodded in appreciation.
“Husband is more and more like master!”
“He’s been under Zhuo Fan’s influence from the start. Some things were bound to rub off on him with how close they were.” Luo Yunchang smiled.
Tuoba Tieshan gave a thumbs up, “Marshal Luo is a true man. Since Marshal Luo lives for western lands, then I shall join you in this endeavor, ha-ha-ha…”
“Since Clan Head has made his decision, we shall abide by it.”
Leng Wuchang and the other two bowed, “Clan Head is upright and frank, but we cannot let you fall here. What Steward Zhuo left us to do is to assure this, by doing things the Clan Head can’t. Leave the mediating with the leaders to us. But before that, we need to understand what they’re thinking. Commander Touba, which leader proposed it, who was against it and who delivered it? We need a clear picture to break Clan Head from the stain of defying orders.”
Tuoba Tieshan frowned, “I’m not sure either. I had someone investigate when the order came. It’s been a day now. I want to know whose brain is rotten to send such idiotic orders. What right does he have to command us?”
“Report!”
A shout announced the coming of a guard.
Tuoba Tieshan smirked, “Here he comes, he-he, come in.”
Whoosh~
The soldier knelt before them and spoke, “Marshal Luo, Commander Touba, the leaders have given us a reply to the order’s source. It’s from the newly appointed Grand Marshal of the alliance, the first disciple in western lands, Zhuo Fan!”
“What?”
Everyone stared agape, “Z-Zhuo Fan? He’s not renamed, is he?”
“No, he said he’s the best disciple in western lands!”
Yue’er started then got excited, “It’s master. He’s alive! Only he is the real best in western lands, the only one to defeat Ye Lin.”
Luo Yunhai shook all over from shock, but then got so excited he teared up, “I just knew brother Zhuo, the man outside fate, has come back.”
“Yeah, only he is outside heaven’s influence.” Shuang’er beamed, “I’ll have to trouble you once more, Steward Zhuo, to save the people!”
[PR: Lol so we gonna take back all that defamatory language? Haha]

chapters.title: Chapter 1049 - 1049, Opponent
chapters.content:
Chapter 1049, Opponent
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Wu~
Luo Yunchang could no longer contain her emotions. She had shed so many bitter tears these years and now could not help but cry again. Yue’er consoled her, “Sister Yunchang, master being alive is a good thing. Why…”
“That rotten bastard, he hadn’t sent a single word of how he’s doing, letting us think he was gone, with even his corpse destroyed…”
Wiping the tears, Luo Yunchang whined but her eyes were dancing with joy, with a little hint of resentment hidden within, “I’ll find that dead guy and have him return what interest he owes me from these years plus more!”
The others smiled, with Yun Shuang looking happy as she said, “Sister Yunchang, you’re not the only girl who brother Zhuo owes. Have you prepared yourself?”
Luo Yunchang blushed and glared at her, “Fine, you can come.”
“Of course, grandfather had me stay by his side and help him, so coming along is only natural.” Shuang’er giggled.
Tuoba Tieshan waved the soldier away then said, “Miss Luo, I hope you don’t mind, but take Lian’er with you as well. Ever since Zhuo Fan left us five years ago, Lian’er could no longer smile…”
“Five years ago?”
Luo Yunchang gave him an odd look, “Commander Touba, have you got it wrong, perhaps? After Tianyu’s war, Zhuo Fan had gone to the Demon Scheming Sect, then made his name in the Double Dragon Manor before he had been trapped and lost his life. When did he have the time to see your daughter?”
Tuoba Tieshan shrugged, “It was when news of his death went around everywhere, he appeared in Quanrong, ruining Beast Taming Sect and vanishing again. Lian’er misses him with a passion…”
“Steward Zhuo destroyed the Beast Taming Sect?”
Leng Wuchang said, “Why hasn’t Double Dragon Manor’s investigation in Quanrong Empire brought any results?”
Tuoba Tieshan shook his head with a sigh, “It involved the Quanrong imperial family’s shame. His Majesty ordered everything covered up. Zhuo Fan only destroyed the Beast Taming Sect while His Majesty ordered me to kill those royal sons and the casualties that followed. We kept our lips sealed when Double Dragon Manor came around, letting not a single word about this or Zhuo Fan, afraid the secret might leak. Finally, His Majesty wanted to kill me to silence me as well, but it’s all thanks to the Luo Alliance that I’m alive with my family…”
“Yeah yeah, we got it from here.”
Leng Wuchang cut him off, “I just want to ask one thing. Commander has been one of us ever since you joined the Luo Alliance. You knew of Steward Zhuo’s survival and saw the young miss in pain so why didn’t you say anything?”
“Yeah, why didn’t you?”
Luo Yunchang stared daggers at him, “I’ve always been respectful to you, senior, yet you’re so cruel. Why haven’t you spoken of it to any of us?”
They all surrounded him with savage glares. Luo clan’s usual righteousness and upright stance forgave everything, except this one time. They deserved to be petty for once.
[You knew how much we care for Steward Zhuo yet you said nothing, not even if he was alive. You’re evil!]
Tuoba Tieshan sighed, “I had my reasons for not revealing it. I’ve been a commander in Quanrong and a loyal official to His Majesty, even if he discarded me. Saying anything would lead to the Quanrong imperial family’s scandal coming out. I am loyal to my country and could not afford such a thing to rock my home.
“Also, I noticed Zhuo Fan wanted obscurity. Saving me and my family, the least I could do was abide by his wishes.”
The others nodded. The old commander was loyal to a fault, so they could understand.
“Humph, the least you could’ve done is tell me!”
Luo Yunchang would not have it, glaring at Tuoba Tieshan in anger, “Commander Touba, do you have any idea how many tears I’ve spilled for that heartless man?”
Tuoba Tieshan bowed, “I am terribly sorry, young miss, ha-ha-ha…”
“It’s all in the past now. Brother Zhuo is back so let’s leave it be.”
Luo Yunhai understood the commander’s loyalty and shielded him from his sister’s wrath, “Where were we again? Oh, the order, it’s really…”
“Ingenious!”
Tuoba Tieshan spoke firmly, his eyes twinkling.
Leng Wuchang’s face twitched, “Commander Touba, did we not just hear you call the leader an infantile moron?”
“That was when I didn’t know who gave it.”
Tuoba Tieshan raised an eyebrow, “Anyone else would have rotten brains for giving such an order. But Zhuo Fan is someone I once fought with, who loves to be mysterious. He has guile, he has awareness, striking out of nowhere with his baffling plans. Who can understand them? That’s why I am sure this order is no different!”
Zhuge Changfeng waved him off with a smile, “Commander, did you notice something to call it ingenious?”
“It’s because I can’t find it ingenious. If any random guy can figure it out, wouldn’t the enemy do the same? What’d be the point of it then? That’s why I’m saying Zhuo Fan has some weird yet masterful plans, despite not being in the military. This is what makes them so dangerous.”
Tuoba Tieshan watched them in sympathy, “Luo Alliance’s sages, did any of you notice anything?”
The trio shook their heads, “Steward Zhuo’s style has no guidelines. We wouldn’t have suffered at his hand if we could read him back then, ha-ha-ha…”
“Then the order…”
Tuoba Tieshan turned to Luo Yunhai and grinned. Luo Yunhai’s eyes flashed and shouted, “Notify all western lands forces, they are to make swift departure for Double Dragon Manor!”
“Yes, sir!”
The guards outside shouted and ran to their duties…
At the border of the central area and northern lands, in the central area army’s commanding tent, Prime Minister Baili Jingwei sat in the main chair with the Dragon Cleaving Sword King at his side.
Glancing at him, Baili Jingwei smiled, “Dragon Cleaving Sword King, it must be what you wanted, leading the army to attack northern lands.”
“What do you mean?” Danqing Shen kept a smile on.
Baili Jingwei leaned over, “Sword King is from western lands and knows it the most, making an attack on it most suitable. But I know Sword King cares too much for western lands still and am afraid that you’d be overcome by emotion and would let your old friends go. Unlike Sword King Feiyun, jumping to attack eastern lands the moment he heard. He hates the Shangguan clan to the core and wants to end them at his own hand and return to glory, ha-ha-ha…”
“Ha-ha-ha, Prime Minister Baili’s consideration has us terrified.” Danqing Shen smirked, “Prime Minister, we’ve been waiting for so long in northern lands so we must be waiting for the right moment to attack, yes?”
Baili Jingwei nodded, “Correct, Patriarch has long since ventured deeper in northern lands. I am just waiting to coordinate with him and take it all in one strike, ha-ha-ha…”
“Report!”
A shout came from outside the tent.
“See, the time is night!” Baili Jingwei grinned with pride, “Enter!”
A soldier burst in and bowed with a jade slip in his hands, “A message from within containing valuable information!”
“We’re all friends here, speak!”
Baili Jingwei picked up a wine cup from the table without a care, “Is Sea Bright Sect’s barrier broken? Ha-ha-ha, it’ll make Patriarch’s attack that much easier.”
The guard bowed, “Prime Minister, Sea Bright Sect’s barrier is broken and the Heaven Sealing Sword was stolen, but from what the jade slip contains, it’s not him who did it, but a third party.”
“Someone is after Heaven Sealing Sword as well?”
The cup shook in Baili Jingwei’s hand, then chuckled, “No matter, as long as the barrier is down, they can no longer hide. It matters not who did it. In any case, once Patriarch steps in, the Heaven Sealing Sword is as good as his, ha-ha-ha…”
The man’s brow shook, “His jade slip isn’t to inform, but to warn the Prime Minister to be cautious. The one who stole the sword is very sharp. Three days ago was in jail, but he talked his way into earning the respect and worship of all leaders of the alliance, making him the Grand Marshal of their forces. He said this person is highly likely to be the greatest opponent Prime Minister ever had. He hopes that the Prime Minister will exercise extreme caution.”
“My greatest opponent?”
Baili Jingwei mocked, “I’ve been going unchallenged among the lands for years and hardly are there people that I pay attention to. Since when do I need a spy to tell me to be careful of anyone? Ha-ha-ha, absurd! Now who is he speaking of?”
The man took a deep breath and spoke, “He said he was western lands’ best disciple, Zhuo Fan. He had also fought with sir in the central area, under the alias Gu Yifan.”
“What? Zhuo Fan… Gu Yifan?”
Baili Jingwei’s hand flashed and took out a jade slip. But then he showed a crazed smile, “I had men investigate western lands to look into Gu Yifan, only to find an otherworldly genius, Zhuo Fan. I knew they were one and the same, ha-ha-ha. Good, he is indeed a good adversary. We meet again, only this time, we will see just who will have full grasp of the lands, old enemy!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1050 - 1050, The Next Step
chapters.content:
Chapter 1050, The Next Step
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
The aged hands trembled, but as the initial surprise faded, Danqing Shen curled up his lips, “The enemy commander is Gu Yifan?”
“Yes, or better yet, Zhuo Fan, ha-ha-ha…” Leaning on his chair, Baili Jingwei sighed, his eyes flashing in excitement.
Danqing Shen sighed, “It’s hard to believe he’s still alive and now becoming our enemy. By the looks of it, Prime Minister, you seem quite happy to find out the same guy you were so insistent on killing last time is now very much alive and in charge of the alliance’s military.”
“Yeah, I wanted him gone then due to the danger he represented. But after seeing the war truly gone, I felt a sense of loss and regret. Such a good adversary was only met once yet I couldn’t even have a true and honest match with him. It was a true shame. Then I found out he survived, and while resentful, the prominent emotion was joy. Now look how soon we are back to fighting each other, and this time we’ll have a real match. With the Sword Star Empire against the four lands, besides the experts, are around equal in military might. It comes down to us and our tactics, ha-ha-ha…”
“Though it’s clear by Prime Minister’s deployment that you have the upper hand. To the point in only a couple steps you will be ready to strike. While he has many steps to compensate for to catch up to sir’s deployment. The war looks settled since it started. He’ll have a hard time turning it around with so little time at his disposal.” Danqing Shen smiled.
Baili Jingwei smiled, “The world isn’t fair. I may hold the advantage now, but we both have around the same assets, his almost equal to mine. It’s all down to his skill to overcome the danger. Ha-ha-ha, Dragon Cleaving Sword King, who do you think will win this time?”
“Prime Minister, why even ask? Am I not leading the army against northern lands? Do I not want to win?” Danqing Shen’s brow shook.
Baili Jingwei gave him a long look then burst out laughing, his eyes shining, “Dragon Cleaving Sword King, I just want to hear your take on it. Last time, the guy had made a truly devious escape from right before our eyes. It’s a loss I will never soon forget. I just had him on the ropes, hanging by a thread, so how could I have let him escape?”
Baili Jingwei smiled at Danqing Shen, the latter feeling the cold within.
Baili Jingwei wasn’t blaming anyone, but doubt sprouted as to Danqing Shen’s role in Zhuo Fan’s survival.
Danqing Shen’s squinted, his mind processing, while Baili Jingwei was staring back with a cryptic smile.
“Report!”
A sudden shout broke the awkward mood as a soldier rushed in and on his knee. He held three jade slips, “Prime Minister, Sword King, the three lands’ battlefields have sent jade slips. The eastern, western and southern armies are all withdrawing. They await Prime Minister’s orders!”
Baili Jingwei never left his gaze off Danqing Shen as he chuckled, “The three lands move as one. Then that guy has made his move. Dragon Cleaving Sword King, what do you think of it?”
“Abandoning their borders means they’ve thrown away their defensive positions. Now we can go straight in and take the lands in one fell swoop!”
Pouring himself a drink, Danqing Shen spoke, “Only such a suicidal action defies logic. The lands’ borders falling means the sects and clans are on their own, with nothing standing behind them to help hold their ground. Not even your average man would give such an idiotic decision, let alone that twisted punk. What I think is that a trick is at play here.”
Baili Jingwei smiled a nod, “Yes, Dragon Cleaving Sword King is right. With his cunning, he’d never make such a rash decision. He must have a plan, or…”
Baili Jingwei’s eyes shone with another possibility, “Give off the image that he has one?”
“What does that mean?”
“Blending reality with illusion is part of warfare.”
Baili Jingwei explained, “The three lands’ forces have no chance against ours, falling in a year at the latest. But he had given a radical order to disturb our morale, to raise our suspicion where there isn’t any and force us to retreat out of caution. This would give them more time to prepare. This might be an empty city tactic.”
Danqing Shen nodded, “By going straight in, even if it is the empty city tactic, we’ll find out soon anyway. Leaving behind such a defensive position would only lead to a crushing defeat. He’s risking too much with such a daring move. And if it’s not the empty city tactic, hiding something else, we’ll be in danger if we follow and might even suffer heavy losses.”
“That’s why we’ll wait for his next step!”
“The next step?”
“Yes!”
Baili Jingwei smiled in confidence, “He wants to play games with me, but he must entice me first. A mere empty city tactic that might not even play as he wishes is bound to have a follow up. Watching his next move will let me know his intentions. If there’s an ambush to it, he will try anything to make me take the bait…”
“Report!”
Another shout echoed and a guard barged in looking anxious, “Prime Minister, His Majesty sent word of an uprising in every domain in the central area. The city lords and the soldiers are having a hard time fighting back. He asks for swift reinforcements!”
“Central area is revolting?”
Danqing Shen cried out in shock, “How? We made sure every area in the central area was secured before marching. None would dare act out so why would they do it now? How is it so serious that not even the city lord’s forces can cope?”
Baili Jingwei mulled it over and grinned, “I see it now, a parlor trick. Dragon Cleaving Sword King can’t you see it?”
“See what?”
“His linked plans.”
Baili Jingwei gave a knowing smile of confidence, “I now know why he used the empty city tactic. He first had them fall back to affect my mental state and hesitate on what to do. Then he had the alliance’s spies hidden in the central area cause a disturbance so that I’ll be forced to quell it. It would lead to a lower casualty rate on the lands and also strike back at us in this timely manner while we aren’t ready. Through this chance, he can even have us surrounded, storming the central area. It will turn our hard plan of attacking them all useless by attacking us in the rear. With the morale in shambles, he will have an easy time turning it around!”
Danqing Shen nodded, “It does seem like it. Prime Minister’s wisdom has no bounds. Then His Majesty’s request…”
“Report to His Majesty to hold on. In a month I will take the three lands then quell the chaos.” Baili Jingwei spoke with a grin.
The soldier bowed and rushed to convey the message.
Danqing Shen spoke, “Addressing it after the three lands won’t…”
“Dragon Cleaving Sword King, just how much trouble could some random spies cause anyway? To even think about toppling the core of our Sword Star Empire, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Jingwei didn’t care at all, “It’s all Zhuo Fan’s tactic to split our forces, but I’m too smart to fall for it. Also, I’ll be sure to make him suffer for using the empty city tactic on me. Tell the three Sword Kings to march into the three lands head on. I want them to take their bases within a month!”
“Yes, sir!”
A soldier outside replied and left. Baili Jingwei’s eyes flashed with victory at Danqing Shen’s pensive expression…
In the Main Hall of Sea Bright Sect, Zhuo Fan lounged in the main seat with unspeakable boredom. Around him were the same oldies frantic and distraught.
“Report!”
A disciple rushed to them and bowed. The others immediately asked, “What is it?”
“There’s a report from the front. The central area’s Sword Star Empire is under revolt, with the emperor asking Baili Jingwei for reinforcements!”
“What?”
They all stared agape then turned a bright face to Zhuo Fan, “Great, Sir Zhuo! Devil Mountain is incredible to even raise chaos in the central area’s heart. Baili Jingwei will now have no choice but go back, ha-ha-ha…”
“But…”
The disciple continued with a pained look, “Scouts say Baili Jingwei isn’t heeding the emperor’s order, actually telling the other three Sword Kings to press on into the lands. Now the borders have fallen and the armies are advancing towards the lands’ bases with nothing standing in their way.”
[What?!]
Everyone shuddered, plunged into despair from their high…

chapters.title: Chapter 1051 - 1051, Cooperation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1051, Cooperation
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Murong Xue frowned and sighed, “Baili Jingwei isn’t so easy to fool, seeing through the empty city tactic.”
“What now? Once he figures out the ruse, it’ll be disastrous.”
Ling Yuntian turned to Zhuo Fan for help, “Sir Zhuo, what do we do next? Please tell us!”
Murong Xue smirked and got before Ling Yuntian and showing no courtesy this time as she reproached, “Sect Leader Ling, how can you still put your trust in him? It’s because of his dumb idea that we lost three lands. Asking any more of his help would lead to the loss of northern lands as well!”
“Even if you don’t listen, you’ll still lose. What’s that got to do with me? Tch.” Zhuo Fan scoffed.
Murong Xue glared at him.
Ling Yuntian ignored Murong Xue as all the elders awaited Zhuo Fan’s saving grace.
Zhuo Fan smirked, being awfully obtuse, “I’ve expected this to happen, so rest assured that everything is going according to plan.”
“Humph, more bragging. The enemy saw through your empty city tactic and yet you still say that?” Murong Xue mocked him at every chance.
Zhuo Fan smirked, “Miss Xue, restrain your wild speculation. I have never said I was using the empty city tactic, now have I? It’s only your biased assumption. I had planned for them to invade the lands from the start, to lure them in. Shouldn’t we be glad the enemy is playing alone?”
“Luring?” Everyone gasped.
Murong Xue grew more outraged, “Lure? You take us all for military ignoramus? Luring means drawing the enemy into a trap or a favorable position to attack. But from your order, the three lands’ armies have set no ambush, all going back to their bases. What’s the point in luring them into your home, to kill you?”
“What do women know of war, it’s all about applying tactics and wisdom.”
Zhuo Fan smirked in disdain, “Three days have passed. Have the three lands fallen back to their bases?”
“Uh, eastern lands and southern lands had sent word they did.”
Ling Yuntian nodded, “Only western lands had used a day to question the order, wasting precious time instead of following orders, but they should be on their way still.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Western lands, with my Clan Head in charge of the army, ha-ha-ha. He’s just like his godfather, so hiccups are bound to happen, acting as if not hearing the lord’s orders. But with his just command, while others need three days to retreat, two should be enough for him. I believe his ranks are the tightest and can reach…”
“Report!”
A disciple barged in and bowed with a jade slip in hands, “Western lands sent word their armies have reached their base, waiting for Steward Zhuo’s commands!”
Zhuo Fan grinned, “It’s been so long since anyone called me that. They’ll soon come knocking, I’m sure. There’s no avoiding it, ha-ha-ha…”
“Guard!”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed, “Each land base has a teleportation array to the northern lands. Tell all of them to come to me. Our battle will be in the northern lands!”
“Yes, sir!”
The disciple rushed to comply, while the oldies were dumbfounded. Exalted Hei Ran was even panicking, “Z-Zhuo Fan, what are you doing? Are you calling everyone here to protect northern lands? What about our homes, just let them take it?”
“If you just wanted to combine the alliance’s forces to protect one area, we would’ve long come to an agreement instead of asking for your help. It’s because we want to protect our homes as well that we found ourselves unable to come to a decision. So why…”
Shangguan Feixiong hesitated, “Zhuo Fan, as a western lander, you should’ve sided with western lands, so why are you focusing on the desolate northern lands? Also, what did Ling Yuntian give you to play favorites?”
Ling Yuntian was frantic to deny, speaking in a solemn tone, but his smile couldn’t be hidden, “Shangguan Clan Head, I believe in Sir Zhuo to be fighting for everyone’s best interests.”
“Cut the crap! Of course you’re on his side since he’s fighting for your home. But what about our homes? Are they just going to be abandoned?”
Shangguan Feixiong roared, unable to hold it in, feeling like he was led by the nose all along.
Zhuo Fan gave him a cold look, his tone low and rough, “You’re welcome to fight if you don’t want your lands back. But if you do, stop and listen to my orders!”
The others went quiet, looking at Zhuo Fan with hope.
“Like Shangguan Clan Head said, what would be the point of taking the lead if it’s just about focusing on defending one land?”
Zhuo Fan mocked, “But would you have been able to focus without me? All of you know survival comes from standing together, but each of you have their own turf. Without me to mediate, you’d all rather die than choose any land to defend. You know deep down that I’m right.”
Shangguan Feixiong sighed, “Yes, none would agree to choose a land to protect. I am from eastern lands and would never abandon my home for northern lands. Why couldn’t the rest of you protect mine instead? Everyone must think the same thing. But even so, we’d rather die home than then become another’s sacrificial pawns. But you…”
“Gave us no choice but to abandon our homes and protect a stranger’s!” Murong Lie shouted as Shangguan Feixiong trailed off in indignation, “You played us into abandoning our homes!”
Everyone gave a firm nod of approval.
Ling Yuntian was the only one beaming though, finding himself a winner, “Don’t be so difficult people, although Sir Zhuo hasn’t been fair, he made a hard decision for us, to unite. I promise to treat everyone with utmost respect once they come to northern lands. You’re free to feel right at home.”
Bah!
[Way to rub it in, humph.]
Staring daggers at him, everyone grew annoyed.
“This is what the average man would do. If I had stopped here, then there’d be no point in making me the Grand Marshal of the alliance!”
While they were all morose, Zhuo Fan smiled.
That caught their attention.
Zhuo Fan continued, “When you thought of joining forces, you only thought of defending. But I have no concept of defense. I want them all brought here to attack. You need to risk things to gain something, to let your wife go, uh, that part I’d rather not. Ha-ha-ha, in any case, the abandoned lands are now juicy meat for the starved wolves. But soon, very soon, I’ll make Baili Jingwei regret even catching a whiff of that meat, forcing him to spit them back out. Worry not, every land will be back in your hands in time. That, I promise!”
They all were filled with hope.
[Truly?]
While doubts existed, they had no choice but to play along since they were in the same boat. With the lands lost, they could only follow through Zhuo Fan’s plan to the end to get them back.
Only Murong Xue, as usual, refused to believe any word that came out of that devil’s mouth. She only felt he was deluding them for something or somewhat.
[Rotten punk, I’m not letting you out of my sight. I’ll figure out your game!]
[With the lands lost, that leaves northern lands the only defense. I won’t let you cause destruction here as well!]
In the Double Dragon Manor, Luo Yunhai pointed at the tactical map with a frown, “Zither Sword King is marching unhinged, right on our tail. There’s nothing stopping them. And without the defenses at the border, we thought we’d last barely a month, but now I see even a week is an exaggeration. The land is doomed!”
“Steward Zhuo’s empty city tactic was seen through!” Zhuge Changfeng sighed in worry.
Even the three great minds thought Zhuo Fan used deception in his order. Now they sighed in sorrow at the loss of western lands for the tactic failing.
The tent flap was pushed back and Tuoba Tieshan came in in distress, “There’s another order. All forces of the three lands are to use the teleportation array to go to northern lands. The final battle will be waged there!”
Everyone gasped, “Going to northern lands not to flee but to fight? Was this Steward Zhuo’s plan all along? It isn’t a deviation? To get everyone to the northern lands?”
They all were perplexed at the order.
[What is Steward Zhuo even after?]
Tuoba Tieshan sighed, “Zhuo Fan is unreadable. I just can’t see through him…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1052 - 1052, Checkmate
chapters.content:
Chapter 1052, Checkmate
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Sir Zhuo, eastern lands’ forces arrived and await your instruction!”
“Southern lands’ forces are here, awaiting instructions!”
“Western lands’ men have gathered at the northern lands border, awaiting instructions!”
Reports came into the Main Hall one after the other, with the others now waiting to see what he would do next.
Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan held his teacup and sipped from it before putting it down with utter nonchalance. Then his eyes shone as he directed in a demanding tone, “The first order was to have the three forces return to their bases in three days. The second order, to teleport to northern lands in three days as well. That makes it six days, right?”
“Yes, to transfer so many people also took a lot of sacred stones.” Shangguan Feixiong sighed.
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes, “War is always costly, yet you mind such trifles?”
“I’m not, I only want to know if it’s worth it.”
“I’ll make you feel it is.”
Zhuo Fan rolled his sleeve, and smirked, “With the two orders completed, here is my final and most crucial command. The outcome of the four lands’ war against the central area will all rest on this.”
They all shuddered, tense and paying close attention.
[Everything hanging on a single order? What kind of divine trick will he use?]
Even the antagonistic Murong Xue had to sharpen her ears, very much curious to know.
“My third order…”
Zhuo Fan watched them gulp in anticipation and he emphasized every word, “All forces are to surround Invincible Sword and strangle him!”
[What?!]
Sss~
They all shook and gasped, looking at Zhuo Fan with dumb looks. It was beyond anything they expected from him.
[Using all the people of the four lands in exchange for the strongest, Baili Yutian?]
[This is insanity!]
Shangguan Feixiong was in disbelief, “Z-Zhuo Fan, aren’t you mistaken? You want us to kill Baili Yutian together? He’s strong enough to mow us down by the hundreds of thousands. We’ll be wiped out in minutes!”
“For that reason I needed all other lands to join in killing him!”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, “He is very strong, but only a man with Yuan Qi. With so many of us, by coming at him one at a time, each casualty we suffer will surely drain him that much more until his head will roll. The instant it does, the battle is ours!”
Everyone’s faces twitched, Zhuo Fan’s plan horrifying them to the core.
Using millions of lives to wear down Invincible Sword was not something that ever crossed their minds. Zhuo Fan’s sudden order had them hesitating, even afraid.
They could already see the mountains of corpses and the rivers of blood, the foul scent of iron in the air and the muddy ground with limbs sticking out.
Murong Xue was outraged at the genocide and rebelled, “You fiend, how can you think of something so vile? Throwing innocents against that blade will end in countless casualties. You’re a stone-cold demon!”
“This is war. Have you ever seen one without casualties?”
“But the adversary should at least be at their level. Invincible Sword and all those cultivators are way too far apart. You’re asking them to die, to become cannon fodder. This doesn’t make sense!”
“As long as they manage to wear down even a smidgen of Invincible Sword’s Yuan Qi, it makes perfect sense. Even the toughest animal collapses under the assault of too many ants. The four lands’ forces will wear him down to his grave!”
“What would be the point of it all then? To kill just Invincible Sword, so many of us will fall but there are Baili Jingwei and the Sword Star Empire around still. How will we fight them?”
“Yeah, killing just Invincible Sword will lead to the loss of nearly two lands in terms of life. How are we going to hold our own against Baili Jingwei?”
Ling Yuntian nodded as well with a frown, “Has Sir Zhuo done this only to take that monster’s head?”
Zhuo Fan had an evil smile on his face, “Yes, all of it is for this. And yes, it all comes down to the Invincible Sword’s fate. By taking down him, victory is guaranteed. Whether it’s Sword Star Empire or Baili Jingwei, they’re both finished. It’s just that simple.”
Everyone looked in suspicion as he explained.
“Sword Star Empire is unlike the average empire, with the emperor and ministers in close relation and making it strong. They have no flaw, all brought about by Invincible Sword Baili Yutian.”
Zhuo Fan sipped from his cup once more, “It’s also why the Sword Star Empire’s foundation is resting solely on the Invincible Sword. It’s strong because he is. The Nine Sword Kings have utmost respect for the man, while Baili Jingwei garnered respect, even from the Sword Kings, all because Invincible Sword appreciates his skills. But this invincible balance is taken for granted by Baili Jingwei, and will end up crushing the empire.”
Everyone was still shaken up, “Why do you say that?”
“He’s too greedy and impatient, driven to have the five lands united in his time and thus expanded the empire too quickly.”
Zhuo Fan continued, “To attack the four lands at the same time, Baili Jingwei had recruited foreign Sword Kings in addition to the five his clan had, Shangguan Feiyun and Danqing Shen being among them. This bolstered the empire’s strength, making not even the four land alliance able to face them. But he’s too hasty to get the four lands, emptying the empire of everything and putting it into the invasions. The empire now lays void of any military and ripe for revolution. That’s why he had the Serene Shores Trading killed. They not only had ties with every land, but also dealt with their leaders and other mighty figures that would make use of the empty empire to affect its stability.
“So before going to war, the company had to be purged. He couldn’t allow such a big faction to stay behind and resort to tricks that ruined everything. Thus, Miss Murong, what you’ve been droning on about, that I killed so many central area’s innocents, is in fact unrelated to me. Baili Jingwei used it as an excuse to snuff them before setting out, just that it came a bit earlier. In fact, if it all went as he wished, the damage would’ve been far greater. I only triggered it and not carried it out myself.”
Murong Xue huffed, “I saw your nature. If you’re unrelated, then what about the next one, or the next people?”
“Fine, I know our views are in opposition, but let’s first focus on the war.”
Zhuo Fan knew appealing to reason wouldn’t work on her obstinate kind, so he looked at the oldies, “Now that we know the cause of his strength and weakness, we should realize defeating them in a straight up battle is impossible. But the enemy had given us a golden opportunity. Baili Jingwei is too conceited and eagerly threw their Patriarch into our home. The Invincible Sword is just as conceited too, thinking nothing can stop him, that nothing could hold him and so he came. This is where our chance lies.”
“Although the Invincible Sword is extremely dangerous, scaring our people the minute he arrives in northern lands, venturing deep in enemy territory is equally dangerous, for he doesn’t know if we would all jump on him regardless. Ha-ha-ha, as for worrying about being too few of us around afterward to fight, I can assure you that Baili Jingwei is far more worried. Think about it, the Invincible Sword entered deep into our land, but why did he only bring his clan’s Sword Kings?”
They all frowned, with Ouyang Lingtian speaking out, “Is it mistrust?”
“Exactly, senior Ouyang. Look beyond the overblown confidence Baili Yutian and Baili Jingwei constantly project and you’ll find their cautious natures. The people around the Patriarch cannot be allowed to have conflicting interests. A man of a different clan would be looked on with suspicion since they might have different motives. Thus Baili Yutian would not trust any foreign Sword King to fight alongside Baili Yutian. He fears betrayal, striking at Baili Yutian when he fights the four lands.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, like all was laid out before him, “Baili Yutian thus only has Baili Sword Kings around him while the attacks of our lands are all foreign Sword Kings. Thus making it very easy what Baili Jingwei truly cares about. He isn’t afraid of Sword Kings revolting, nor the empire’s dire straits, but Patriarch’s death. Yet even so, he had Baili Yutian take the lead. A truly conceited and cautious man.
“Such is the current situation. Those central area’s armies attacking us don’t matter, it won’t affect the Sword Star Empire. But what about the death of the Invincible Sword? With this deterrence gone, the Nine Sword Kings will grow cocky and not listen to Baili Jingwei. Especially the four foreign ones, finding themselves free to do whatever. There won’t even be a need for us to attack the central area, it will destroy itself for us. Such a grand empire is going to fall, making the loss of two lands worth of lives all the more worth it. Now, isn’t killing central area’s Invincible Sword to our advantage?”
Everyone stared with open jaws, yet their hearts stirred.
[Yeah, it won’t matter how heavy the losses, everything is worth the peace and future of our next generations.]
Only Murong Xue, per usual, nagged, “Using millions of lives over one victory? Devil, what do you take life for? There won’t be as many deaths if they fought the central area’s army, but you…”
“I’m the commander and all I see are assets and their place on the board.”
Zhuo Fan gave her a cold stare, “I only know that this will checkmate Baili Jingwei…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1053 - 1053, Drive
chapters.content:
Chapter 1053, Drive
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Orders!”
On the border between northern lands and the central area, the forces of the other three lands had transferred, with each taking a region and awaiting orders. Western lands’ experts under Luo Alliance’s leadership were the same, anxiously awaiting at the border for the next radical order.
The northern wind carried with it a sudden shout. The soldiers landed from up above before each faction, speaking at the top of their lungs.
Whoosh~
Luo Yunhai and many other generals from western lands were growing impatient in the commanding tent. “Another order’s here! I wonder what’s brother Zhuo’s plan in the face of such a desperate crisis?”
“We already lost three lands and there’s no place to retreat now. With all having been going according to Steward Zhuo’s plan, then the third order must be fighting back.”
Zhuge Changfeng rubbed his beard, his face solemn, his eyes shining with hope, “The question is, how outrageous and weird is it this time? Ha-ha-ha, I’m eager to see Steward Zhuo in action one more time.”
The others nodded, their brow quivering with excitement.
Whoosh!
One soldier landed in the Luo clan’s camp, bowing, “Grand Marshal of the alliance, Sir Zhuo, orders half of Luo Alliance’s strong to defend northern lands’ borders!”
The man presented a jade slip, one that could only come from Sea Bright Sect.
“That’s it?”
Luo Yunhai was puzzled, “Brother Zhuo had us come here to protect northern lands?”
“If it’s just that, the previous preparations mean nothing. We had been better off waiting for death, and happy with it behind our strong defenses. This is unlike Steward Zhuo’s style.” Leng Wuchang held his chin in doubt.
The soldier cupped his hands with a smile, “Luo Clan Head, this order has only been given to you, while the other forces have different tasks.”
“The rest have other orders? What is it?” They all cried out.
Turning heavy, the soldier scanned their faces and spoke, “Grand Marshal ordered for southern lands and eastern lands, along with western lands’ remaining half troops to march towards Sea Bright Sect. You are to kill Invincible Sword Baili Yutian at all costs!”
[What?!]
Sss~
The jaws of Luo leaders hit the ground the same way it did to the oldies back in the sect.
The order had been relayed at the other camps just then, and shouts of shock came without stop.
The Grand Marshal’s third order was pure insanity. He wanted to focus all their efforts into taking down the strongest monster of the five lands, Invincible Sword.
Zhuge Changfeng, Leng Wuchang and You Ming stood dumbstruck then laughed in realization, “I get it now! Steward Zhuo is a genius! Ha-ha-ha…”
Only they laughed, while the rest were still looking like statues, giving them odd looks.
[What’s going on? Why…]
They looked at them so wild with joy, letting their laughter free, but also sensing sorrow as tears glistened in their eyes.
“Steward Zhuge…” Luo Yunhai began in worry.
Zhuge Changfeng shook his hand and the trio gradually calmed down, turning bleak even.
“So many years have gone yet Steward Zhuo is still the same. We just can’t surpass him.”
“Yeah…”
“What’s with you three?” Luo Yunhai was bemused.
Zhuge Changfeng bowed to him and sighed, “Clan Head, you know of us having lost to Steward Zhuo back in the day. We’ve been working these years in assisting Clan Head also to compete with him. What he did back then, we could do it too, but now, we have lost in such a way we finally accept the truth. We will never measure up to Steward Zhuo’s one aspect for as long as we live.”
“What?”
“Drive!”
The trio spoke in unison.
Zhuge Changfeng continued with a heavy heart, “Clan Head, what do you think about a beggar being harassed on the street?”
Luo Yunhai gave him a confused look, but seeing their cryptic smiles, he said, “A beggar is being harassed due to his status. If he rises above his station, he will be free of any harassment.”
“Ha-ha-ha, yes, riches can lessen your attackers.” Zhuge Changfeng continued, “Then, Clan Head, what if a merchant was held down by a politician?”
Luo Yunhai was more confused than ever. But he looked at the other’s smile and spoke firmly, “Money can buy anything. Since some politician is pushing against him, the he just has to find a bigger supporter to fight back!”
“Yes, using one’s assets in exchange for even bigger assets and gaining much more, one step at a time. This is what we three have been doing these years.”
Zhuge Changfeng sighed, his eyes filled with sadness, “From harassed beggars, we became merchants. From oppressed merchants we entered service. But our every progress was met with more suppression, never able to escape it our entire lives. This is who we are. But Steward Zhuo is different from us in this tiny yet crucial aspect. The Luo clan had defeated in ten years all the other houses and wielded all the power in Tianyu. This is something we could never achieve.”
Luo Yunhai’s heart shook, “How is it different?”
“Clan Head, how can a beggar never be harassed in his life?” Zhuge Changfeng smiled as he asked instead of replying.
Luo Yunhai frowned in confusion.
Zhuge Changfeng saw him unresponsive and shouted, “Clan Head, to never be harassed again, one must stand above everyone else. The beggar must become emperor to feel truly safe!”
“How is that possible?” Luo Yunhai was baffled.
Zhuge Changfeng sighed, “Yes, it’s quite the fairytale, isn’t it? But isn’t our Luo Alliance today also a fairytale to the old Luo clan?”
Luo Yunhai pondered and then turned solemn.
“This is where we are different from Steward Zhuo. His drive is unlike any other!”
Leng Wuchang patted Luo Yunhai’s shoulder, “We never actually accepted when he defeated us back then, since we are no less shrewd than he is. The three sages of Tianyu aren’t just for show. Only now do we understand, that our vision isn’t as broad as his. Our horizon is narrow, and our drive weaker.
“The Invincible Sword is the core of the Sword Star Empire. We knew this, but he’s too strong, deterring us from even considering him. The price to pay is just too great, with little chance to succeed. Steward Zhuo had set his eyes on him from the start, burning bridges and abandoning the lands so that he could face the core issue. He has such drive none of us is capable of. Having now been made aware of his plan, we realize the truth. A land has around thirty million men, with half meaning fifteen. Against such a force, Baili Jingwei had no chance of providing timely assistance no matter how desperate.
“While the two lands and a half of soldiers will make close to a hundred million. Invincible Sword is tough, so much so he can handle a land by himself. But what can even he do against the likes of such a combined attack? Using all those countless lives against just one? Who would have the nerve to do this? Not even we considered this course before hearing the order. This is also why the Sword Star Empire will eventually collapse. Steward Zhuo’s order is a master stroke of the ages. I bet that not even Baili Jingwei would dream that Steward Zhuo would take this action!”
Luo Yunhai’s brow shook, then he looked at the starry sky with a smile, “Yes, you stewards are right. I can still remember the day the clan was made of four people, staying in the Veiled Dragon Pavilion, and brother Zhuo coming out to proclaim that the Luo clan will stand at the top. None of us believed him, but now, ha-ha-ha, brother Zhuo is a man who only saw the very peak. There’s nothing he wouldn’t dare or do. That is my brother Zhuo. Luo clan’s first steward is our patron saint!”
The trio nodded in agreement.
“Brother Zhuo had us stop to…”
“Protect us.” Leng Wuchang bowed, “It’s way easier to fight Baili Jingwei and Dragon Cleaving Sword King’s army than going to war with a madman like the Invincible Sword…”
“Yes, you guys sure got the easiest job this time.” the soldier spoke with reverie, “It’s good to have someone left behind in court. Others, I bet, must be sinking in despair from being stuck with hunting Invincible Sword!”
Right on cue, howls of grief tore at the sky and endless tears soaked the earth..

chapters.title: Chapter 1054 - 1054, Outrage
chapters.content:
Chapter 1054, Outrage
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“What’s going on? Why the sudden commotion in the enemy camp?”
The three land forces’ wailed and grieved like their own funeral hearing they were sent to die fighting that monster Invincible Sword. The thick air of despair and anguish leaked all the way to the central area’s army camp.
Baili Jingwei was still smug in his belief that he broke Zhuo Fan’s empty city tactic and took the three lands without losses.
[That guy must be wallowing in his defeat right about now, being rebuked by all the other leaders.]
But then the sudden widespread grief had him flinch.
A scout burst into the tent, “Prime Minister, for some reason there is a sharp increase in forces on the northern lands’ side. Their howls alone travel for thousands of miles. From what I’ve seen, they have now tripled their numbers!”
“Tripled? How? Where did northern lands get so many people?”
Baili Jingwei was confused, but then he exclaimed with a mocking smile, “Oh, since the empty city tactic fizzled out, the lands had no choice but to converge here. Humph, they’re nothing but deserters with lower morale. Of course they’ll cry. Tell the army to raise defenses for when the cornered dog makes an assault.”
“Yes, sir!”
The man left.
Baili Jingwei looked mighty pleased, humming a tune. He even started dancing.
Whoosh~
Danqing Shen entered the tent and paused, taken aback, “Prime Minister, what got you so excited about?”
“Ha-ha-ha, Dragon Cleaving Sword King, you’re just in time to hear the good news. The war against the four lands will be done in three months. I’ll be sure to put on a good word to the Patriarch when merit is given back in court. Dragon Cleaving Sword King has always wanted to rule over your paradise? After the unification, that area will be set aside for you to oversee.”
“Oh, I am most thankful, Prime Minister, ha-ha-ha…”
Danqing Shen nodded, but his heart sank. He made sure to hide his worries, though, behind his smile, “Prime Minister, weren’t you saying it’s going to take a year? Why so soon all of a sudden?”
Baili Jingwei leaned back with immense pride, “We have to thank my old opponent for that, Zhuo Fan’s empty city tactic, ha-ha-ha. His tactic got exposed and ended up delivering the three lands to us. Now northern lands’ borders have increased activity, mostly from the other lands’ forces teleporting in. In other words, the other lands are ripe for the taking. We will crush their teleportation arrays in a week and the lands are as good as ours.
“Then, in half a month, the three armies will be called here and defeat northern lands together. That will give him no room to escape.”
“But with four lands united, the northern lands’ border will be even stronger. It won’t be easy taking it down!” Danqing Shen sat at the table and sipped from his teacup, not looking pleased at all.
Knowing his thoughts, Baili Jingwei smirked, “Dragon Cleaving Sword King, have you forgotten how Patriarch’s team is out there and are waiting for the right time to strike? With both of us working together, northern lands will be weakened and wide open for attack. Now must be the ninth day. Patriarch will act on the tenth. With attacks coming from within and outside, we’ll just see how long they’ll last, humph…”
Danqing Shen’s brow shook at Baili Jingwei’s celebrating tone. He lowered his head and just sipped tea, in his own thoughts.
Baili Jingwei glanced over with a scoff, “The worst sinner in the lands, hated by millions, Zhuo Fan, Gu Yifan. I will be sure to raise his monument in every land to be remembered by, he-he-he. Though I’ve yet to settle on the right name…”
“Report!”
The sudden shout broke his bliss as the soldier rushed to bow and stammer, “A jade slip arrived from the enemy’s side. Please take a look, Prime Minister!”
Baili Jingwei gave it a look and chuckled, “He doesn’t even care if he’s found out, sending jade slips all the time. But with the situation crystal clear, it won’t matter even if they’re discovered.”
“Uh, Prime Minister…”
The soldier grimaced, “The jade slip is a secret message and under a seal. We can’t open it.”
Baili Jingwei shook and froze in a frown, “He sent a secret message to me? Is it that crucial? The situation is obvious, the Sea Bright Sect’s barrier is broken, so what could be so important? Does that guy have a way to reverse things even in this clear-cut scenario?”
“Give it to me!”
Baili Jingwei gestured for the guard and he presented it.
Danqing Shen sighed, “Is it the spy in northern lands again?”
“Yes, Patriarch would have a hard time breaking the Sea Bright Sect so I took precautions. While he hasn’t gotten the Heaven Sealing Sword, he proved his use by sending intel on Gu Yifan being the Grand Marshal of the four lands.”
Baili Jingwei knew Danqing Shen would’ve figured it out in the end so he didn’t deny it. He made a sign and the jade slip was unsealed for him to read.
He was better off not knowing anything, for the information shocked him to the core. His hand relaxed and the jade slip broke as it hit the floor.
Danqing Shen paused, seeing the great Prime Minister Baili lose his cool, “Prime Minister, are you alright?”
“Zhuo Fan, you’re brutal!”
Baili Jingwei took a good while to come to, but now his face was twisted, his nails digging into his palms till he bled.
Baili Jingwei looked savage, “I knew he shouldn’t be left alive. He’s terrifying in the command of the four lands. He actually found out my greatest worry and still dares to use it. Ruthless, cruel, shrewd…”
Baili Jingwei couldn’t even finish from sheer outrage. He then barked, “Guard!”
Thump~
A soldier rushed inside and on his knee, “Prime Minister, orders?”
“Attack! Right now!” Baili Jingwei shrieked, “Tell all men to attack the northern lands’ border and punch through them!”
“Ah?”
“Don’t give me that!”
“Uh, Prime Minister, but didn’t you just order us to raise defenses? The men are doing it as we speak…”
Pa!
Baili Jingwei slapped him hard and cussed, “When the hell did I give you such an order? I want you to charge, now! Send every last man to the northern lands’ border and get me an opening!”
“Uh, yes, yes…” The soldier shook in fear then left in haste.
Baili Jingwei paced around the tent in great distress, like he was a different person from before. He has lost his calm and shook all over like a scared mouse, “Today’s the ninth day and that means Patriarch will attack tomorrow. His appearance will paint a hundred million targets on him. If something happens to the Patriarch… Zhuo Fan, you son of a she-dog, damn you to hell…”
“Tell the other three armies to get to northern lands right now!” Baili Jingwei roared at the first soldier.
The man bobbed his head and went right to it, away from the Prime Minister’s wrath.
Baili Jingwei was still uneasy, unable to sit on his chair as he was sweating bullets, “The armies have invaded the lands for three days and they’ll need that much time to return to the borders. Then they’ll need three more days to use the teleportation arrays. Six damn days! Will Patriarch be able to last the endless flood of men chipping at him for so long? Zhuo Fan, god damn you for making me do this!”
Baili Jingwei roared like a madman.
Danqing Shen was startled, then he smirked, “Prime Minister, did something happen?”
“Uh, nothing.” Baili Jingwei shook then gave him a look. He gnashed his teeth as he tried swallowing the fury.
[The foreign Sword Kings must never know Zhuo Fan is after the Patriarch, or they’ll only make things worse.]
[Zhuo Fan is a true mastermind with his devious plans. He now has me trapped without a single hope to fight back. At least I left a spy there to inform me, or else…]
Baili Jingwei squinted, feeling a chill crawl up his spine.
[He’s an abomination…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1055 - 1055, Besieged
chapters.content:
Chapter 1055, Besieged
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Report!”
Baili Jingwei flinched at this ominous word and his heart almost stopped. A soldier rushed inside to present a jade slip.
“What now?”
Baili Jingwei’s face twitched and felt like crying. He was scared things could actually get worse than they already were.
The soldier sweated, unaware of his Prime Minister’s worry, “Prime Minister, the imperial capital is in urgent need of rescue. His Majesty makes an earnest request of military aid. Of the 3,820 cities, 565 have fallen. To make matters worse, the revolution is only gaining more ground. The city lords can’t stop the flood!”
“It’s that desperate?”
Baili Jingwei was shaken up, “Does that mean the disturbance wasn’t on a small scale but a full blown riot? But who has such power in the central area? Wait, is it Serene Shores Trading?”
Baili Jingwei’s face twitched and turned savage with fury, “Damn those merchants! After purging their base, the sudden vanishing of all their branches led me to believe they scattered like flies, when they were waiting for me to show my back. Humph, soldier, tell Wine Sword Immortal to lead his men back to quell the riots!”
“Prime Minister, Wine Sword Immortal is deep in northern lands and requires three days at the least to return. Also…” Danqing Shen picked up on the clues and said, “You just ordered them to teleport to northern lands but the imperial capital doesn’t have a moment to spare. Let’s split our forces and settle the fires. Guard, stop the charge! We’re going back to save the empire…”
Danqing Shen had yet to finish before Baili Jingwei cut him off, “Wait! W-we can’t leave, just charge! You must charge!”
“Prime Minister, a rebellion is upon us. We must provide aid and quell it before it endangers the empire!”
Danqing Shen tested, “Even if we split our forces, with our defenses, we’re sure to last a few weeks. It’ll be enough for us to quell the revolution and make it back. Not to mention the other three armies are coming soon, in just six days. We will hold out!”
