[You might hold out, but the Patriarch can’t keep a hold of his head! We’re in a race for time where every second counts, where every moment might mean the death of the Patriarch and the collapse of the empire.]
[All that matters is for Patriarch to survive to keep hope alive. Everything can be regained even if lost in this moment. The empire may go in flames for all I care, but the Patriarch must still stand!]
[Zhuo Fan, you rotten son of a b-]
Baili Jingwei crunched his teeth, shaking all over, “Was all of it part of his plan? All of it is to stall me? That was no empty city tactic, but bait to lure the three armies away from the teleportation arrays and not provide timely rescue, earning him six days of peace. Then there’s the empire’s insurrection, besieging me on all fronts.
“In six days I can pacify the empire but not save Patriarch, which would still lead to its fall. And if I choose to save Patriarch, I won’t break their lines in a mere six days, all while the fires rage in the imperial capital. Or maybe the revolution will cut off our reinforcements, hindering us further to delay the rescue. Either way, the game is lost before it starts. He crushed me!”
Baili Jingwei went limp, falling in his chair with dead eyes.
“Prime Minister, what’s wrong?” Danqing Shen held him.
Baili Jingwei looked bleak and in despair, “He played me from the very beginning. The board is out of my control. I never dreamed my greatest advantage had become my downfall at that guy’s devious planning. Zhuo Fan…”
Baili Jingwei wailed, filled with denial and regret…
Achoo~!
Zhuo Fan sniffed in Sea Bright Sect’s Main Hall and then shivered. Ling Yuntian smiled, “Sir Zhuo, did you catch a cold perhaps?”
“Since when does a cultivator catch a cold?”
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes, “My ears are burning. That Baili Jingwei punk must be cursing me, humph!”
The others chuckled, with Murong Lie praising, “Only Sir Zhuo could call a genius like Baili Jingwei a punk. Sir Zhuo’s plan is ingenious and praiseworthy. Reports are coming from the frontline saying Baili Jingwei flipped out, ordering to storm our defenses. He must have known about Sir Zhuo’s plan and gone insane, ha-ha-ha…”
“He’s reacting already?”
Zhuo Fan paused, then nodded with a smile, “I see…”
“What?”
“I see there’s a spy among you!” Zhuo Fan gave them a deep look.
They all cried out, “How can sir say that?”
“Baili Jingwei fell for my first two tricks and still followed my expectation until my third one. But how did he find out about it so fast? And I also made sure to light the empire on fire. He should split his men to save it. Even if he guessed my intentions, still having doubts, he’d never ignore the empire in peril.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed as he looked over the oldies, “The answer couldn’t be simpler. He didn’t guess my plan but was certain of it. How? Only if someone told him. That’s why he flipped out and started a mad charge.”
The men gasped, “We have a traitor? Who?”
Everyone looked at each other in suspicion.
Zhuo Fan smiled and waved without worry, “Not that it matters. Covert operations are about mind games, about laying traps and running the minute it’s exposed, unlike an overt plan. It won’t affect the plan if others realize it. I had his three armies stalled in the three lands, losing precious time to come back. He is also stuck even with charging the northern lands, not having the manpower to break through the lines anytime soon. It is this time that will earn us victory.”
“Uh, Sir Zhuo, did you foresee a traitor among us?” Ling Yuntian asked Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Sea Bright Sect’s barrier is strong, something I’m sure Baili Jingwei knew beforehand since he planned to attack it at some point. Spies are a must in wars, which is why I foresaw a spy among us. That’s why I didn’t tell you, nor explain my orders in detail. Now it won’t make a difference, because the enemy is stuck in my trap, ha-ha-ha…”
“Sir Zhuo is godlike!” Everyone looked in awe at Zhuo Fan, in awe of his skills. Only Murong Xue looked askance with a cold face.
Though she might abhor Zhuo Fan, she had to give the man credit for his methods.
[He is the vilest devil, a Demon Archon with unlimited appetite for destruction and blood.]
[Once the war is over, he must be removed for good. What man would throw away a hundred million lives for victory?]
Zhuo Fan noticed it was getting dark and grinned, “Friends, the time limit to deal with Invincible Sword is six days. Any later and Baili Jingwei would have all the army assembled and anything can happen. We have to kill Invincible Sword within this period!”
The men grew solemn and nodded. Shangguan Feixiong smiled, holding out his dear sword, “Zhuo Fan, you haven’t unsealed it last time since you were in jail and used it as leverage. Now you are our Grand Marshal, one of us. I still want to fight Invincible Sword and can’t do it without Soaring Sword…”
“Of course!”
Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed in two golden halos at the scarlet sword, “Divine Eye of the Void’s 2nd stage, Void Annihilation!”
Bam!
The sword shuddered then shone a bright red as it flew around having regained its freedom.
The people stared agape.
[That’s it? The Soaring Sword is unsealed just like that?]
[Doesn’t that make us all fools for toiling over it for a year?]
They all looked at Zhuo Fan with shock and awe.
[Zhuo Fan is a miracle worker, and not just a mastermind.]
Shangguan Feixiong beamed as he looked at the divine sword. He made a sign and the sword fell in his grip, “Thank you so much for this immense help…”
“It’s fine, ha-ha-ha….” Zhuo Fan had no shame in his casual attitude. But then Shangguan Feixiong turned heavy, “The hell would I do thanking you? That was your duty to begin with! This was part of our first deal!”
Zhuo Fan grinned.
Ling Yuntian smiled, stepping between the two and saying, “Shangguan Clan Head, you’re wrong there. He only said about giving you the sword and not in what condition. Now Sir Zhuo unsealed it so how can you say that?”
“Yeah, you…”
“Fine, now your Soaring Sword is back to you, so go on.”
Ling Yuntian urged him to the side before beaming at Zhuo Fan, “Sir Zhuo, the Soaring Sword is settled, now it’s about Ha-ha-ha. Ha-ha-ha, when will your guard be returning with it?”
“Oh, her, you’ll meet her when you see Baili Yutian.”
“What…” They gasped.
Zhuo Fan had an evil grin, “Hasn’t she already told you who she is? Since she’s Frigid Rain Sword King, then she’ll take Heaven Sealing Sword to Baili Yutian. Since you’ll be meeting that old man soon, you can ask him for it.”
“What?”
Their hearts sank at Zhuo Fan’s devastating news.
[Is Sir Zhuo working with Baili Yutian?]

chapters.title: Chapter 1056 - 1056, Sending Off
chapters.content:
Chapter 1056, Sending Off
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Everyone looked at Zhuo Fan as if he grew a second head. Murong Xue was the one most affected, but then she lashed out, “See that? I knew he’s not dependable, yet you all insisted on trusting him. He used the Heaven Sealing Sword to bait you all this time, only to tell us now that the divine sword is with Invincible Sword. He was playing us all along!”
Zhuo Fan smirked.
The men frowned and hesitated, with Ling Yuntian gathering the courage only to be supplicant, “Sir Zhuo, you promised us that you’ll return the Heaven Sealing Sword, so why…”
“Yes I did and I am. Go see Invincible Sword and ask him to give it back.”
Ling Yuntian was on the verge of tears, “Isn’t that twisting words, Sir Zhuo? The old monster came from it specifically and now that he has it, you think he’ll be a fool to just give it back?”
“Heh, you’re not that far off the mark there, he-he-he…”
Zhuo Fan cocked an eyebrow, complementing his evil smile.
The others were bemused.
Zhuo Fan gestured for Ling Yuntian to come on over to lend his ear, “Didn’t you just say he came for Heaven Sealing Sword? When you see him, tell him that it was not him who took it…”
Zhuo Fan acted like he shared his deepest secrets, showing a confident smile. Ling Yuntian frowned in doubt, “That’s… it?”
“You don’t believe me? Has my plan ever failed?”
Zhuo Fan gave an insidious smile, acting like he was counting his greatest hits, “When Baili Yuyu couldn’t steal your sword and pass the barrier, it was my idea that had her succeed. When Baili Jingwei attacked all lands, you were all being hysterical in despair, yet it was I who broke the invasions. Now, the hunt for Baili Yutian, the same thing that is now driving Baili Jingwei insane, is my idea too, no? Has any of them failed? You still doubt me after all this?”
Ling Yuntian pondered and relented a nod, “Yes, Sir Zhuo has shown great success in every aspect, a man of integrity and infallible genius. I’m fortunate you’re on our side, or else our end would’ve come far quicker. Then, when we’ll look for Invincible Sword tomorrow, we’ll just do as Sir Zhuo said. I just hope it’ll prove as effective as all plans.”
“Of course it will work, now go. With the Heaven Sealing Sword back, your three swords will make light work of him.” Zhuo Fan shooed him away, shouting at the rest,
“The plan can’t be clearer now, so just go grasp victory. If anything happens, I’ll be sure to amend the plan from the back!”
The others nodded and bowed before leaving, “Then we shall take our leave. We are grateful for sir’s overseeing the battlefield.”
Zhuo Fan found himself in the spacious hall with his dear Chu Qingcheng, Qiao’er and… Murong Xue?
“What are you still doing here?” Zhuo Fan Zhuo Fan gave her an odd look, “For now all is quiet. With them going away, shouldn’t you do the same?”
“I’m watching you!”
“Watching?”
“Yes!” Murong Xue stared with an icy gaze, “You’re one sick man, backstabbing and traitorous. One moment you’re with Invincible Sword, the next you’re giving advice to us. Nothing about you is trustworthy. I am never going to leave you out of my sight, stopping you from doing something that will plunge the world into hell.”
Murong Xue sat in a chair, unmoving. But her eyes bore into Zhuo Fan every second, making her presence most off-putting.
[Don’t you try anything, I got my eye on you!]
[Man, she’s a pain.]
Zhuo Fan smirked and walked to Chu Qingcheng’s side, “Miss Murong is welcome to stay, I won’t tell you to go. But me and my wife have been so long apart that, with these days detained over some trifles, that only makes me anticipate our time together. So us two might be doing something inappropriate for public display. Miss Murong is, of course, welcome to stay and gain much knowledge on the subject. I sure don’t mind. Maybe miss will also like some hands-on teaching, ha-ha-ha…”
“Why you…”
Murong Xue blushed hard and grew irate. Her purdy eyes stared daggers at him, unable to come up with any retort. She ended up flicking her hand and leaving, “Humph, all men are rotten to the core!”
“Be careful not to include your brother as well. But seriously now, you don’t want to gain early practice? It’s all gonna pay up later.”
“Drop dead!”
Zhuo Fan knew no shame, his voice traveling outside the hall and making her yell even harder.
Zhuo Fan chuckled, then he turned to the dull-eyed Chu Qingcheng with grief, “Qiao’er, call Wu Qingqiu, Shui Ruohua and the others. Don’t let anyone know.”
“Yes, father!”
Qiao’er replied seriously and left. Just a stone’s throw away from the Main Hall, Murong Xue still hadn’t given up on watching him. She then noticed Qiao’er leaving and her heart sank, actually believing Zhuo Fan’s words, “Pervert, your wife is like that and you want… Humph, shameless bastard!”
Murong Xue huffed and left as well.
Inside the Main Hall, Zhuo Fan and Chu Qingcheng were now alone.
Looking at her gentle face and her white hair, heartbroken like he was with Ning’er, Zhuo Fan’s eyes grew hazy, taking out a comb and started running it through her long silky locks.
“Qingcheng, we may be married, but I’ve never been completely honest with you.”
Zhuo Fan teared up, “I am not from here. In fact, I shouldn’t even be before you. I am a Demonic Emperor, bearing heavy sins, bringing chaos and destruction wherever I go. Maybe the heavens wished for this. Ning’er suffered and now you. I knew pain would be coming and wanted to distance myself from you, but why did you still have to take the same path I treaded? Ha-ha, no, you have far deeper feelings for me than I had for Ning’er back then. I at least did not lose my mind.
“I just can’t fathom what these bloody executioner hands did to deserve your love?”
The comb trembled in his hand, his voice heavy, “I have lived two lives, yet never had anyone wishing to stay with me with all their heart. First was Ning’er, but she no longer remembers me. I felt my heart torn in two, but I was glad for her that she would no longer suffer any longer. The second is you. You forgot me as well, but I feel such a deep pain in my heart. Qingcheng I do wish for you to forget me, but I hope you’d always recall me as well. Qingcheng, tomorrow I’m going to the North Sea and might die. I hope that you’ll remember me before I go. I know that this might cause you pain once more, but I’m selfish and really hope that I am not just a passing phase in your heart. I do…”
The comb stopped and he kneeled before her, resting his head on her knees, choking with emotion and shaking all over.
Whoosh!
A breeze ran through the white hair as Chu Qingcheng’s eyes teared up as well. Her fair hands trembled and lowered her head, looking at the shaking figure she hadn’t seen for five years with a gentle gaze.
One hand reached and touched Zhuo Fan’s head…
“Brother Zhuo!”
Chu Qingcheng shuddered at the sudden interruption and her hand returned to its position, the light in her eyes fading once more.
Zhuo Fan got up and strained himself to appear casual as Wu Qingqiu, Ye Lin, Shui Ruohua and everyone arrived in the Main Hall. Behind them was Qiao’er.
Wu Qingqiu cupped his hands, “Brother Zhuo is now the Grand Marshal of our lands. We wanted to see you for days but couldn’t. What could have had the Grand Marshal summon us?”
“Ha-ha-ha, brother Wu, what’s this about Grand Marshal? We’re all friends here. I only have a small request. Brother Wu, don’t forget you lost our bet in the dungeon. You owe me a favor.”
“Ha-ha-ha, so that’s what it is. Brother Zhuo wants to cash in so soon?” Wu Qingqiu laughed, “Sure, brother Zhuo, I’ll be sure to do all I can to fulfill a brother’s request.”
The others nodded as well with shining eyes.
Helping Chu Qingcheng stand, he went to Shui Ruohua and Zhuo Fan said earnestly, “Northern lands is fraught with danger. Help me take Qingcheng back to western lands. The three attacking armies should now be in full retreat so you can use the teleportation array to return to Double Dragon Manor. It’s the safest choice.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1057 - 1057, Tenth Day
chapters.content:
Chapter 1057, Tenth Day
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“We shall follow brother Zhuo’s order to the letter!” Wu Qingqiu replied on the spot, “The question now is when?”
“Immediately. Even if we’re in the Sea Bright Sect, war will be coming soon and it will no longer be safe. I hope to get Qingcheng out as soon as possible.”
“Sure, we will go right now.” Wu Qingqiu and the others bowed, “Brother Zhuo, take care.”
“Take care.”
Zhuo Fan cupped his hand as they took Chu Qingcheng away. But she shot her hand to clutch Zhuo Fan’s, her grip strong.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shook with hope, “Qingcheng, you’re awake… ugh…”
But those empty eyes reflected his downcast face.
“Zhuo Fan, it’s just Qingcheng’s instinct. She’ll need more time for her mind to recover.” Shui Ruohua sighed and spoke morosely. She then took Chu Qingcheng’s hand to leave, but the grip on Zhuo Fan’s hand only tightened, her fingers digging into his skin and drawing blood.
Zhuo Fan didn’t even register the pain, his gaze always on Chu Qingcheng as he spoke in a heavy tone, “Qingcheng, I’m doing this to keep you safe. I will come back to you, I promise!”
Chu Qingcheng shook, but it was clear Zhuo Fan’s promise eased her heart as her grip eased. Shui Ruohua quickly took her hand back.
The others finally relaxed and bowed to Zhuo Fan once more before leaving with Chu Qingcheng.
Ye Lin had vowed again and again that he would definitely make sure sister-in-law would be safe and sound.
Zhuo Fan smiled, feeling relieved to leave her in their care, having complete trust in them for already looking after Chu Qingcheng for the past five years.
Zhuo Fan gazed at the sky, and noticed dawn was just around the corner.
Zhuo Fan said, “Everything’s ready, Qiao’er. Let’s go as well.”
“Where?”
“North Sea!” Zhuo Fan’s gaze was set.
Qiao’er asked, “Father, aren’t you leading the four land alliance? What are they going to do in case of an incident?”
“Let those clowns deal with it.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone and smirked, “When two fight, the third party wins in this stalemate. Central area and the four lands are of similar strength. They would kill until they dye the skies red and cover the earth in corpses, with neither side coming on top. When we return from the North Sea, we will find the world has changed overnight. Our power will also expand in these circumstances, patching up our way to the top once more, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan flew towards the North Sea shore, with Qiao’er smiling behind him.
In the glorious light of a new day’s dawn, the father and daughter began their journey. What of the Sea Bright Sect’s barrier one might ask? Nothing of it since Zhuo Fan’s apocalyptic thunderflame could poke a hole in it. Especially since the Heaven Sealing Sword was conveniently removed, making the barrier so much weaker. It was simply a joke for a man of his caliber.
While they were out hiking, the same joke, it would seem, applied to one other person, far better than to Zhuo Fan.
Rumble~
Thunder cracked the sky as purple lightning exploded in thousand branches. The barrier of Sea Bright Sect cracked like eggshells, bringing fresh sea air into the sect, or maybe doom.
The purple lightning formed thousands of swords waved up above, looming dangerously over the sect. Even Genesis Stage experts felt numb under this sea of purple. Their breaths faltered and their immense Yuan Qi slowed down to a trickle.
Mere pressure was enough to bring the sect to its knees, such was the power of the purple curtain.
The leaders of the four lands came out to see what was all the ruckus to gasp in fear and despair, “I-Invincible Sword is here!”
“Invincible Sword now?”
Murong Xue glanced at the purple attack hanging above him and gasped, “Is this the effect of Invincible Sword’s attacks? It’s so much more terrifying than my brother’s! How is he still human?”
Murong Lie gripped the golden burning longsword but his brow was soaked, “Invincible Sword is no human, or he wouldn’t be anything great, humph!”
The others gave a weak nod, with some even faltering back.
Such was the might of Invincible Sword, dreading his coming before even meeting him. Not even the highest power in other lands could fight the fear.
Boom~
Explosions rang everywhere, followed by savage winds and wails of demise throughout the Sea Bright Sect. Blood sprayed so high it reached the heavens, mixing with the purple lightning and turning the world of mortals into a hellscape. It sapped any bit of courage one might have. The winds then made sure to bring the stench of blood to every corner of the sect, completing the carnage.
“Sect Leader, Invincible Sword has come with five Sword Kings and ten disciples! He broke the barrier and is slaughtering us!”
Whoosh~
A bloody elder arrived in a panic, howling with grief, “We’ve already lost tens of thousands of experts! Please save us, Sect Leader!”
Ling Yuntian was distressed as well, turning to the others, “Lingtian, Murong Clan Head, Exalted Double Dragons and everyone else, we set ourselves on killing the old monster with numbers and now he came to us himself. We’ll do as Sir Zhuo planned. We’ll go meet him and stall for two and a half lands’ worth of men to come from the frontlines so we can finish this!”
“Yes!”
The other cupped their hands, though hesitation dominated still.
Talking was one thing, while putting it into action was another.
Ling Yuntian didn’t look too confident in this joint slaughter, turning to Murong Xue, “Miss Murong…”
“Sect Leader Ling, I’ll do everything in my power, whatever it may be!”
“Then go look for Sir Zhuo and ask him what to do now that the Invincible Sword is here.”
“Go ask him?” Murong Xue’s face fell.
Murong Lie glared at her and snapped, “Xue’er, there’s no time to argue! We need Sir Zhuo’s cunning tactics. We’d go ourselves but we need to go join the fight. Stop being a child and do this for the sake of everyone else!”
Murong Xue huffed and grumbled but she knew her priorities and flew for the Main Hall.
As for the leaders, they shot in frantic haste at the devastation with a grave expression.
Whoosh~
Murong Lie, Ouyang Lingtian and the rest soon met with sixteen people walking without a care.
In front were the five Sword Kings, looking icy as they dolled out death, uncaring and unfeeling.
Be it a building, barrier, or some venerable coming to stop them, they all replied the same way, flicking their hand and sending thunderous explosions that tore everything to pieces.
All while their casual trek through the enemy base went undisturbed, like they were a bulldozer.
Behind them was a tall elderly, imposing and confident, looking down on the world with none wanting to get near him. He acted like he was on top of the world. The only option was join him or perish.
Even the mighty Sword Kings were giving him ample respect and did his bidding.
It was none other than the best of the best, the Invincible Sword.
Behind him further were ten juniors, who came out on a sightseeing trip to see the world, keeping their heads low behind the old man and doing nothing else.
Not like they needed to, since the path was being cleared with terrifying efficiency

chapters.title: Chapter 1058 - 1058, One Sword Versus Three
chapters.content:
Chapter 1058, One Sword Versus Three
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Gulp.
Murong Lie swallowed hard as he and the rest felt their spine tingle, “Everyone, there’s only sixteen of them, with ten being kids. But why then do I feel like the whole central area is bearing down on me, like an endless army coming for my life?”
“Isn’t the Invincible Sword a one man army? We wanted to keep this moment for later but he came knocking on our door. No matter how feeble we feel, we have to do this regardless!”
Ling Yuntian glanced at Ouyang Lingtian, straining to speak, “Go, Lingtian, do as Sir Zhuo said and get the Heaven Sealing Sword back.”
[Why don’t you go die instead?]
Ouyang Lingtian’s mouth twitched, his heart sinking, but still shot for the Invincible Sword. Murong Lie, like a good friend, held the Decimating Sword as he followed, “Brother Ouyang, I’ll join you!”
The others followed in silence.
Whoosh!
The highest powers of the four lands gathered before the Invincible Sword, blocking his path.
The Sword Kings halted their destructive stroll as well, yet gave these oldies supercilious looks.
[You have some nerve trying to fight Patriarch, insignificant bugs!]
Murong Lie knew too well how strong the Invincible Sword was. What came as a true shock, however, was finding out what Invincible Sword was holding, their fear mounting because of it.
He was not holding the Sundering Sword.
He was so strong without even the help of a divine sword, so how much of a monster would he be then if he wielded one?
“It’s been ages since I saw this old coot, and I see he’s gotten stronger still. Is there no end to his growth?”
Murong Lie and the others felt like crying, “They say he has the power of a land, but now I fear he’s almost as strong as two. Would it still be possible to gang up on him with two and a half lands of soldiers? Will it kill him?…”
The hopes of everyone reached rock bottom.
Invincible Sword looked smug as always, at the top of the world, “I’ve been in northern lands for many days now and should’ve at least pay your sect a visit. Alas, that child, Jingwei, had me wait for a bit longer and prepare you a nice surprise. That’s why I waited even though you all lost your Heaven Sealing Sword, only showing up now. I haven’t scared you, have I? Ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Yutian laughed, shaking the skies. The Sword Kings looked smug at their dreaded looks.
The leaders clenched their fists and just sweated.
“Thank you, Invincible Sword.”
Ling Yuntian bowed with a forced smile, “Your name shocks the world. There’s no living being who hasn’t heard of your might. My sect is filled with boundless honor with your visit. If it were just to say hello, there was no need to fight your way in. We would’ve gladly welcomed you. Why must you steal our divine sword and barge in, lowering yourself to such petty actions? I’m afraid it will make others mock the mighty Invincible Sword, staining your name, ha-ha-ha…”
Invincible Sword’s eyes flashed with anger.
Bali Yuyu stepped forward with a glare, “Ling Yuntian, you dare insult my Patriarch? I’ll put you in your place here and now!”
Bali Yuyu exploded with power and was ready to strike. Ouyang Lingtian rushed to protect Ling Yuntian.
But Ling Yuntian didn’t care, “Miss must be Frigid Rain Sword King of the Nine Sword Kings, right? Ha-ha-ha, nice to meet you. Wasn’t your act of stealing our sword ten days ago under the Invincible Sword’s orders? While I have nothing to say if Miss denies it, you are still under the Invincible Sword. Anyone could guess that your actions were sanctioned by the Invincible Sword into playing thief…”
“You…” Bali Yuyu flared but the Invincible Sword cut her off, “Yuyu, get back!”
Bali Yuyu gnashed her teeth, her stare boring into Ling Yuntian. Alas, she had to give and fall back.
Ling Yuntian turned to the Invincible Sword with a bow, “Sir runs quite the tight ship. I take my hat off to you, having them cater to your every whim, ha-ha-ha…”
“Sect Leader Ling, and what’s that supposed to mean, that I’m a thief?” Baili Yutian squinted.
Ling Yuntian spoke, “You’re not? Then isn’t the Heaven Sealing Sword on you right now?”
“While it is, a divine sword always finds its way in the hands of the able while slipping from those unworthy. If you can’t keep it, you lose it, just like your precious sect,” the Invincible Sword chided.
Ling Yuntian nodded, “True, the weak can’t hold a divine sword, bound to lose it at some point and it’s only their fault. Although, this and that are different. We’re all practitioners here, and my sect is willing to accept the loss of the divine sword in open combat with sir. Yet you used tricks to get it from our sect. Ha-ha-ha, it can either be that your cunning mind is sublime, or that we’re just too naive to fall for it. Be that as it may, sir’s name will take a plunge either way. The ignorant might even say you feared us holding the Heaven Sealing Sword, resorting to trickery then open combat. Is that all the mighty Invincible Sword amounts to? Guess you’re only as strong as our sect to resort to stealing. Ha-ha-ha…”
The Invincible Sword narrowed his eyes into slits, his face darkening by the second.
“You’re saying I can’t take your divine sword in open combat? Humph…”
The Invincible Sword huffed, “Every time I come for a fight you do nothing but cower behind your shell, or the divine sword would’ve long been in my hands. What would’ve been the use of tricks then?”
“Yeah, though we refused your challenge since we enjoy peace and quiet and not chaos. Nonetheless, stealing our sword is quite a heavy stigma…”
“Alright!”
Invincible Sword cut the air with his hand and then his palm flashed to reveal an icy-blue longsword. Everyone gasped.
Invincible Sword then threw it. Ouyang Lingtian moved fast and reached out to have the divine sword fall in his grip once more.
“You now have the Heaven Sealing Sword, but only temporarily. With your broken barrier, you can no longer hide. You can’t do anything even with the divine sword but keep it warm for when I take it. Then any complaints you have will be moot!”
Ling Yuntian bobbed his head, “Of course, the Invincible Sword is indeed direct and frank, the best in the world, ha-ha-ha…”
Ling Yuntian laughed then turned his head, “Sir Zhuo’s appeal to ego plan is a success. This coot got the Heaven Sealing Sword yet gave it back. Now we have three divine swords, bolstering our chance of success against this obnoxious monster!”
The men nodded, the three divine swords pointing at the sky. Gold, red and blue flashed from them and shot into the heavens.
Boom!
The predominating purple lightning was now cut in half, replaced with golden flames, scarlet glows and blue traces from Murong Lie’s Decimating Sword, Shangguan Feixiong’s Soaring Sword and Ouyang Lingtian’s Heaven Sealing Sword. They used their power to wrest control of the heavens from the enemy.
The Sword Kings frowned, glaring at them.
[These rotten bastards actually used mind games to fool Patriarch. How revolting!]
The Invincible Sword didn’t care, glancing at the half lost skies with a grin, “Three swords against one should be impressive. I’m thrilled that yours truly can enjoy fighting three divine swords, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Yutian flicked his sleeve and a crackling long sword appeared in his hand, pointing it at the sky.
The sky exploded as even more purple lightning boomed everywhere, overtaking the previous losses, swallowed by the flood of lightning. The golden flames, red glows and blue streaks couldn’t hold on at all, torn to pieces.
The skies were dyed purple once more.
Murong Lie, Shangguan Feixiong and Ouyang Lingtian shook and coughed blood. Shangguan Feixiong had it worse, not being on a Sword King’s level gave him the worst wound.
The other two stared at Invincible Sword with blood dripping from their mouths in dread. Only the Invincible Sword could wrest back dominance from three swords…
[This monster is too damn strong…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1059 - 1059, Rescue
chapters.content:
Chapter 1059, Rescue
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Father, are you certain the sea demon they all talk about is Sea Ao?”
“Yes, the way it’s been told, there’s no way it’s just a simple spiritual beast. It must be a sacred beast!”
“But the North Sea is so big. Where do we even start?”
In the open waters, one man and one child flew about, looking all over the place for something other than water and more water. Qiao’er had to express her doubts about this ineffective solution.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, “Someone once told me that the world has three forbidden areas where any mortal will die, Lightning Canyon, Fire Pit and Ice Mountain. They appear on and off across the world, with no fixed location.
These areas are prisons for the sacred beasts. Lightning Canyon holds Qilin, Fire Pit holds dragon ancestor so that leaves Ice Mountain being another prison where a Sacred beast is. But because the prisoners wore down at the barriers of the prisons for ages now, the dragon ancestor managed to relocate to Ultimate Clarity Sect, so the Sea Ao must’ve done the same in the North Sea. Just from hearing Ice Mountain, it’s easy to tell the entrance has to be extremely cold. With my sharp senses, we’re going to find it for sure!”
Qiao’er nodded as she flew by his side while looking for anything out of place. Zhuo Fan honed in on his senses, probing for anything truly cold, far colder than the icy waters of the sea below him.
Rumble~
A loud thunder clap exploded behind him.
Zhuo Fan paused and looked back with a gasp. The sky behind them was now a sea of purple, tearing at the sky and bringing doom to those below.
It was the Sea Bright Sect, the same place they were at just a while ago.
“Purple lightning, how come the Invincible Sword came out so soon…” Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, then he flew back at once.
Qiao’er was startled, “Where are you going, father?”
“I need to see if your mother left safely. If she’s stuck there…” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone coldly, “We’ll have no choice but to face the Invincible Sword ourselves!”
Zhuo Fan sped up, his figure gone from here.
“Father, wait for me!”
Qiao’er cried and rushed to catch up. But then she felt a chill all over and looked around bemused, “Why is it getting so cold all of a sudden?”
Rubbing her shoulder to fend off the biting chill, Qiao’er glanced about but at the calm waters. There was no wind and the sun was still up.
She just shook her head with a chuckle, “I must be feeling things. But this North Sea sure is cold.”
Qiao’er rushed after Zhuo Fan, leaving as well.
Mere moments later, the calm sea shifted, Thick mist blew in, just like after a heavy rain, and covered everything in a blink of an eye.
A cold like no other swept the surface of the sea, freezing it on the spot. The thousands of lifeforms in its waters were unable to even budge, frozen stiff among the ice.
Two huge light sources suddenly came from deep in the mist, one looking bright, while the other dimmed.
“What’s that noise? Are humans fighting?”
Far from the thick mist were constant booms echoing about, making the rumbling voice inside cackle, “That vile race only knows how to look for more reasons to kill itself off. Their own fellow people slaughter until everything turns red. One moment they asked me for permission to go out to sea and the next they’re killing each other. Ha-ha, great, perfect! Since neither side can stand the other, let me give you a hand and swallow you both, hi-hi-hi…”
A creepy laughter echoed out from the fog as it drifted swiftly, going towards the Sea Bright Sect. The waters turned ice wherever it passed in an instant.
With it came the shuddering and haunting voice of a demon, “I open my doors to you, welcoming you to become dessert, hi-hi-hi…”
The sea overlord was coming to shore!
In the Sea Bright Sect, the Invincible Sword was showcasing his unstoppable power against the other swordwielders, taking control of the skies and striking terror in the hearts of men.
He looked at everyone with nothing but disdain, while the other Baili experts held their heads high and mocking the enemy.
[See that? That’s the Patriarch’s power right there. What are you yokels going to do about it?]
Ling Yuntian’s face fell, his team sighing heavily with worry as they watched in sorrow.
The ten juniors aside, Baili Yutian was sufficiently monstrous alone that they together couldn’t handle him, let alone the other five Sword Kings by his side.
Ling Yuntian’s heart sank as he looked around.
[We need Sir Zhuo’s mind now more than ever. What’s taking Miss Murong so long to deliver one simple message?]
“Children!”
Baili Yutian’s eyes shone and shouted, “Scatter and have fun, but don’t interfere with my enjoyment!”
“Yes!”
The others cupped their hands and flew off, into the sect.
Now there was only the Invincible Sword against the other lands’ strongest.
Murong Lie’s eyes twitched. Decimating Sword shook in his hand as he spat, “Like a true Invincible Sword, you even had the Sword Kings leave your side. You want to fight all of us all by yourself?”
“Don’t I have what it takes?” Baili Yutian mocked.
“More than enough. The Invincible Sword’s power is too much for us to disregard.” Ling Yuntian chuckled, “But aren’t you scared something might happen and you’d have no one to aid you if you send the Sword Kings away?”
The Invincible Sword’s face twitched and he looked harder at him before laughing in his face, “Sect Leader Ling, you’re still up for jokes? Accident? You think of yourself capable of giving me that?”
“Invincible Sword, don’t get smart with us. All of us here are as strong as your Nine Sword Kings and we have three divine swords on top. A sudden incident might do you in!”
Murong Lie roared and pointed at him. The others were equally resentful, flaring their auras at him.
The Invincible Sword couldn’t care less, merely tracing Sundering Sword’s edge, as if in his own world. “All bark and no bite. Show me what you’re made of and not prattle me to death! As for Nine Sword Kings, humph, they’re nothing but children making a scene. You think you can scare me with that? Ha-ha-ha, that’s rich.”
“People, he was our target to begin with. Now that there’s no one helping him, it’s the best chance we can get. Charge!” With how nothing could ever earn the old man’s respect, Ling Yuntian sent to the others, “Use his conceit to your advantage and make him pay with his life before he gets cautious and makes it harder for us!”
The others nodded and shouted as they stormed Baili Yutian with their best skills.
“Decimating Sword, Decimating Inferno!”
Whoosh~
Murong Lie slashed and the golden sword exploded with flames at Baili Yutian. The fire formed a sword wave that shot with such heat that it warped the air and even left black cracks.
“Soaring Sword Art, Soaring Skies!”
Whoosh!
Shangguan Feixiong shouted and hacked with the Soaring Sword. The scarlet sword wave shot with incredible speed for its quarry.
“Heaven Sealing Sword Art, World Seal!”
Ouyang Lingtian was not one to be left behind. He waved his sword, devoid of the savage nature like the rest, but hiding an incredible force behind its subtle nature. The attack reached Baili Yutian’s side and was about to engulf him.
The Invincible Sword found himself under attack from all sides, ultimate skill coming from the three divine swords…

chapters.title: Chapter 1060 - 1060, Oppressed
chapters.content:
Chapter 1060, Oppressed
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
The three divine sword wielders each used their own swordsmanship. They had immense power, enough to even crush a Sword King, yet proved to be sorely lacking when up against the undefeated Invincible Sword.
The Exalted Double Dragons took this time to strike as well. With a dragon roar, a sword dragon fell from the heavens above and shot for the Invincible Sword.
Eastern lands’ three venerables, northern lands’ Four Snow Peak Elders and southern lands’ sword guardian venerables made their move too.
The incredible and flashy display was not only amazing but also deadly and apocalyptic. All these powers converged on one old man standing there all by himself.
As the string of explosions echoed out, it felt like the world would be torn asunder.
Alongside their joint attack, there were many other great experts who sent out such force that not even the Nine Sword Kings together would survive.
A land’s army was bound to find itself crippled and blown to pieces too.
But as the ruckus died down, thunder flared and retook dominance as it spread in every direction, blowing away the dust.
The Invincible Sword was still standing straight, holding the Sundering Sword as he touched the ground, majestic and undaunted. There was not a speck of dust on him. His eyes were cold and sharp, his grin disparaging.
Everyone gasped in disbelief, “No way! All our attacks did nothing?”
“The old monster is just outrageously strong!”
Ling Yuntian’s face twitched, his heart shuddering, “Three divine swords and every top expert of the four lands couldn’t even scratch him? How are we even supposed to kill him? Can more than two lands’ worth of soldiers do nothing to him?”
Ling Yuntian turned to the others. Baili Yutian had gone beyond what was humanly possible, not even the world’s strongest joined together could hurt him.
Their hearts sank in despair and remorse.
[Fighting the Invincible Sword was the greatest mistake. This freak of nature is too damn tough and strong…]
Clang!
A sharp noise pierced their miserable thoughts.
They flinched as they saw the purple lightning streaked divine sword getting off the ground as he moved.
[The monster is about to attack!]
They all froze, with sweat trickling down their brow.
The Invincible Sword wore a sneer, his eyes shining as he raised the purple sword high, “You attacked first and didn’t feel a thing, what an utter disappointment. Letting you have the three divine swords is such a waste. Now then, it’s my turn. Once I remove your heads from your necks, the divine swords will belong to me and no one will question my methods!”
Their blood ran cold and flinched back with fear.
Whoosh~
Baili Yutian used no skill, just slashed like usual.
Though anything average turned extraordinary when it came to the likes of Baili Yutian, carrying with it an unstoppable force of nature.
Rumble~
The immense power came for the four lands’ experts while the purple lightning above started striking down, following the sword wave and disintegrating anything in its path.
Everyone panicked, with Ouyang Lingtian rushing to use the Heaven Sealing Sword, “Heaven Sealing Domain, Sky Sword! Unbreakable world, unbreakable sword!”
Hum~
The Heaven Sealing Sword shook and unleashed a dim blue glow that surrounded everyone to keep them safe from the incoming attack.
“Humph, the Heaven Sealing Sword?”
Baili Yutian mocked, “The Heaven Sealing Sword Art seals everything. But you, Ouyang Lingtian, are too weak and can’t stop the pinnacle of the Sundering Sword Art that I’ve reached!”
Boom!
The thin blue barrier had no chance against the onslaught, gone upon contact with the thunder sword wave. Ouyang Lingtian coughed blood on the spot and was sent flying.
Murong Lie and Shangguan Feixiong rushed to use their own swords, fairing no better than Ouyang Lingtian even if working together. They coughed blood and were flung away all the same.
The three swordwielders didn’t stand a chance, which meant the others were far worse off.
The deadly sword wave carried berserk lightning as it boomed swiftly towards them, through them, and into the horizon. It pulverized anything in its path, laying waste to half of the Sea Bright Sect in that attack alone.
As for the lands’ experts, they didn’t get to let a wail out, gone from here and sent thousands of miles away, buried under the rubble, either dead or near it.
The Invincible Sword’s sword was just too terrifying.
Hu~
Biting winds swept the dust away, though the Invincible Sword resumed leaning on his sword, standing there among the desolation and destruction. He eased a long breath, frowning as he began to walk.
“If I knew how it would turn out, I wouldn’t have sent the brats flying. With all of them all over the place, it’s going to be annoying finding the divine swords. What a pain.”
Bang!
The Invincible Sword flew up and searched along the ruins…
The five Sword Kings and the princes heard the loud commotion and jumped.
Crown Prince Baili Jingtian looked back at the huge dust kicked up by the attack and gasped, “Patriarch is amazing. That slash alone must’ve finished them all off. Brothers, the Patriarch is done with his fight, but he still wants to have one person dead. We will help him by bringing back that guy’s head!”
“Right!”
The others roared in agreement and sped deeper into the Sea Bright Sect.
The Sword Kings got busy as well, with only Bali Yuyu frowning, “Brother Lei, they’re going right for him. We…”
“Find him first and hide him, then we’ll talk.”
Baili Yulei’s eyes flashed, “If the Patriarch or anyone else finds him, he’s dead!”
Bali Yuyu’s eyes shone with resolve as she shot deeper in the Sea Bright Sect.
On the easternmost side of Sea Bright Sect, Wu Qingqiu’s group were frantic in their rush with the dulled Chu Qingcheng. Sometimes looking back at the devastation with a chill down their spines.
“Brother Zhuo has to be either a god, or a bad omen. He had us take Qingcheng out of here since it won’t be safe, and it’s already gotten dangerous. Even the Invincible Sword came. It won’t matter if we die, but we’ll fail to fulfill brother Zhuo’s request!”
“Senior brother Wu, the teleportation array is farther away but they seem to be closing in fast!” Shui Ruohua held on to Chu Qingcheng as she heard the shouts coming from behind.
Yan Mo spoke, “Those are from the elders of the Sea Bright Sect coming out to stop the enemy, who shouldn’t be too outrageous like the Sword Kings and Invincible Sword.”
“Of course it’s not them. From that huge explosion and rumbling in the distance, that must be where the Invincible Sword must be fighting. He won’t show up here. we will be safe for now.”
Wu Qingqiu smiled and eased their worries, “We’ll arrive in fifteen minutes and we’ll be safe for good, ha-ha-ha…”
The others nodded and smiled, even as they sped up. Protecting Qingcheng took priority!
A shout then reached them, “Wu Qingqiu, where are you guys going?”
The group stopped, startled.
[Did they catch up so soon? But the shouts are still far away. How does he know of senior brother Wu’s name then? Did he lay in ambush?]
Wu Qingqiu looked puzzled as well.
[Why does he know my name?]
It might be an ambush, but for a simple disciple of the four lands? Even if it was set up to kill potential dangers, he wasn’t exactly at the top either.
At the very least, he had two ahead of him in western lands, Zhuo Fan and Ye Lin. Shouldn’t he kill them instead?
[Why does he even know my name?]
Wu Qingqiu’s group was stumped as to what was going on…

chapters.title: Chapter 1061 - 1061, Strongest in the Lands
chapters.content:
Chapter 1061, Strongest in the Lands
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Whoosh!
A sudden figure landed before them, speaking in a harsh tone, “Where do you think you’re going?”
“Uh, looking for the toilet…” Wu Qingqiu stiffened as he made an excuse on the spot. Then he noticed who it was and rolled his eyes, “Ouyang Changqing, you almost gave me a heartattack! We thought the enemy caught up to us!”
Ouyang Changqing roared, “It would’ve been far better if they did. Aren’t you here to help northern lands? Now that we’re under attack, suffering heavy losses, what do you do? You’re running away! Humph, turns out western lands’ people are nothing but spineless cowards.”
“Who says we’re running?”
Wu Qingqiu pointed at Chu Qingcheng, “We were entrusted with the Grand Marshal order to escort Qingcheng back to western lands. Also, none of us can do anything against the Invincible Sword!”
Ouyang Changqing gave Chu Qingcheng’s dull gaze a long look, “I can relate with sending your beloved somewhere safe. Take her, there’s a teleportation array up ahead. But could you tell me something first? Where is the Grand Marshal, Sir Zhuo?”
“As a Grand Marshal, he must be in the Main Hall, overseeing the alliance!”
“The hell he is! I’m just coming from there and there’s no sign of him!” Ouyang Changqing mocked, “That guy is a coward as well, running the moment the Invincible Sword came killing. Sister Xue and I have been searching all over, but have found no trace of him!”
The others were shocked, “No way! We just met him before dawn in the Main Hall, how can he be gone?”
“Who knows, maybe he used the teleportation array first.” Ouyang Changqing mocked, “So this is the wimpy style of the best disciple in western lands. Ye Lin is way better by comparison.”
“Now listen here, elder brother isn’t like that. Say one more word and I’ll beat you to a pulp!”
“Heh, reality has spoken yet you still cover for him? Besides, since the best disciple in western lands is gone, won’t you inherit the title? What’s not to like?”
“When I earn something, I do it with my own two hands. I will give my all regardless of victory or defeat. I shall be the best in my own way and even if only second, I will never use such petty tricks to take the crown. Listening to you talk, oh young master Ouyang, your best disciple in northern lands title doesn’t seem to carry much weight.”
“What’s that supposed to mean? I have earned it in the most righteous…”
Ouyang Changqing and Ye Lin kept fighting and devolved into grabbing each other. Wu Qingqiu had to rush in to break them up.
But what good would that do against the best seeds of their respective lands?
The more the two talked back, the more heated became, on the brink of fighting it out for real.
Whoosh~
Murong Xue suddenly flashed over, looking stumped, “What are you all doing? You’re squabbling when there’s destruction and war going around you?”
“Uh, sister Xue.”
Ouyang Changqing eased up at once, afraid of giving the girl of his dreams the wrong impression, “Sister Xue, you must believe me. I am a civilized man who always avoids brawls. They’re just too crude and savage to understand reason…”
Murong Xue’s face twitched and rolled her eyes.
Like she didn’t know this pompous fool for who he was.
[Civil, you? More like a grandmaster in picking fights, who’s only lived for so long thanks to his daddy.]
She promptly ignored him, choosing to talk to Wu Qingqiu, “Where’s Zhuo Fan? Do you know where he went?”
They all shrugged, unable to provide any help.
“Damn that demon, running away at the worst possible moment!” Murong Xue gnashed her teeth and frowned.
Ouyang Changqing played it cool, “Sister Xue, he’s just a rotten coward. I bet he ran off the minute he saw the enemy starting killing their way in. He’s unreliable and I refuse to believe we can’t fight without his rotten help! Haven’t you always said he’s filled with foul schemes and better stay away for everyone’s good? He-he-he…”
Ye Lin flared, but Wu Qingqiu held him back from starting anything.
“It does ring true. He ran off after causing a scene just like with the central area’s Serene Shores Trading, letting others take the fall.” Murong Xue pondered, then nodded, “He’s better off gone. I refuse to believe that my brother and everyone can’t stand up to the Invincible Sword’s group without his vile methods!”
“Miss Murong, you’re just unbearably naive. Your brother and everyone can attack together all they want, but they’ll never get to touch a hair on the Patriarch’s body!”
A condescending tone reached them, followed by ten youths standing proud and confident before them.
The leader was a man of sharp features and elegance, wearing a most disparaging smile he could muster, complementing the disdainful gaze.
The hearts of everyone shook and even stung from the immense pressure.
[Expert!]
It was the unanimous conclusion they arrived at, no longer looking casual in the face of such danger. Ouyang Changqing as well grew grave, asking Murong Xue, “Sister Xue, you know him? Who is he?”
“Central area’s strongest junior, Sword Star Empire’s Crown Prince, Baili Jingtian!”
Murong Xue’s eyes shook, finding it hard to speak, “He might as well be the best junior in the lands. Behind him are nine princes, each stronger than the last.”
Baili Jingtian chuckled, with the other princes joining in.
Wu Qingqiu’s face fell, his fists clenched and his heart heavy.
[We’re just about to get Qingcheng to safety so how did such a deadly enemy appear?]
The usually playful and cynical Ouyang Changqing suddenly got excited, his fists trembling with eagerness.
[The best youth in the lands!]
Ouyang Changqing’s eyes burned hot.
Murong Xue, oblivious to his quirk, totally focused on Baili Jingtian, said, “Crown Prince, what a strange coincidence to find you all the way out here…”
“Best in the lands!”
Ouyang Changqing roared over her and shot straight for Baili Jingtian, shouting at the top of his lungs, “Once I beat you, I shall be the best of the best, ha-ha-ha…”
“Ouyang Changqing, don’t be hasty! You’re not his…”
“Sister Xue, watch closely. I will prove to you how worthy I am of you!”
Murong Xue started, not expecting him to be so impulsive. Ouyang Changqing was deaf to reason, finding his life-long dream right before his eyes and had all the intention to grasp it. He charged right for Baili Jingtian and unleashed a cold sword wave at the chest.
[Heaven Sealing Sword Art, Blood Seal!]
Baili Jingtian hardly cared, smiling, “The best in northern lands’ son? You’re as bold as your father I see, worthy of senior Ouyang’s teachings. A shame you’re not the only inheritor of a great expert and not fit to touch me!”
Bam!
The loud bang rattled the air, fluttering the clothes of the princes.
Baili Jingtian was still standing in the same spot, just like usual.
Ouyang Changqing gasped, staring hard at the finger in front of him facing him that was flashing with purple lightning, another prince that stood by Crown Prince’s side.
[This is impossible! The best disciple in the central area didn’t have to step in but another prince took my all-out attack like nothing?]
Ouyang Changqing was in complete denial of what happened.
Only then Murong Xue’s words sank in. The central area had ten princes, with each as strong as the best disciple of any other land.
[Are you serious?]
Ouyang Changqing’s eyes shook hard as he gnashed his teeth in indignation.
Murong Xue and Wu Qingqiu’s hearts sank.
[The strongest clan in the lands is just too terrifying. Even the young have the power to shake the lands.]
[It seems like Baili now got the best youth in the lands title as well. But where does Zhuo Fan fit in all this, I wonder?]
They were all hoping yet watching gravely as Ouyang Changqing, whose power they knew, was stopped before even reaching Baili Jingtian.
Whoosh~
Just then, another figure appeared wrapped in golden flames smashed for Baili Jingtian’s head…

chapters.title: Chapter 1062 - 1062, Vying
chapters.content:
Chapter 1062, Vying
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Following the draconic cry, golden flames exploded as a fierce power pushed down on Baili Jingtian. The searing heat was so strong it twisted and singed his hair.
The Crown Prince’s brow shook, looking dead serious at the incoming golden flames.
[There’s actually an expert among these bugs?]
He was just mildly surprised, still standing there without budging.
Bam!
The golden figure then found itself halted by a strong hand just an inch from reaching his target. The flames scattered on impact and revealed Ye Lin in his normal form.
The one to block him was a buffed man, looking serious despite having blocked the attack. Not just anyone could stop the might of a half sacred beast with just their body. It was truly incredible that the buffed man even trained his body to this extent.
“How does the Baili clan have someone like him, able to withstand little junior brother’s strike with his body alone?” Wu Qingqiu gasped.
The other western lands’ disciples were just as astounded.
Only Murong Xue frowned, “He is the second prince, Baili Jinggang, forging his body since he was young in the Thunder Pavilion’s lightning. He’s so tough and strong that he only comes second to Baili Jingtian. But no disciple in the world is better than him when it comes to raw power.”
The others turned to Ye Lin filled with worry for his sake.
Ye Lin walked the same path, of a strong body, but now had met his match.
They weren’t the only one surprised, and Baili Jinggang found Ye Lin a true freak.
He was supremely confident in his lightning-forged body, having never failed him so far. Yet taking on Ye Lin’s, he felt like a hammer blow got smashed into him, feeling it in his bones.
A piercing pain like no other came screaming from his body. He only kept a straight face by gnashing his teeth, or he’d be tearing up right about now.
He certainly did not think the five lands would have another freak in body cultivation.
Baili Jinggang looked up at Ye Lin’s savage eyes in wariness. Their nature was antagonistic…
He was about to fall back, letting his elder brother deal with it, but Murong Xue happened to announce his mighty body for all to hear.
[Now this is a problem. Leaving like this will make me look bad.]
Seeing the caution in their eyes, Baili Jinggang lamented. He had to suffer through those bitter tears, all for the sake of upholding the world’s image of his tough body.
So he withstood Ye Lin’s sweeping leg, feeling the heat on contact and gnashing his teeth. He even managed to force Ye Lin back.
The others were more shocked than ever, believing in Murong Xue’s information, “Baili Jinggang is really strong enough to push back little junior brother with strength alone.”
[Bite me! The true strong one is that freak coming out of nowhere. Where did he get all that power? My arm’s about to snap.]
Baili Jinggang’s face twitched, crying on the inside. He finally managed to keep a straight face, through the pain and anger, then he flung Ye Lin back.
Ouyang Changqing’s adversary struck as well, sending him off.
Ouyang Changqing and Ye Lin looked grave at these ten men. While the two princes walked back unconcerned and with disdain and hands behind their back.
Ye Lin and the rest failed to notice Baili Jinggang’s arm shivering all over, while the other prince’s fingers spasmed as ice formed on them.
It looked like the princes scored a victory each, but looking closer, they got the short end of the stick. But they had to put a show of calm to preserve their dignity.
Baili Jingtian saw the truth and gasped inside.
[These bugs actually have some good seeds. Not all of the four lands’ juniors are worthless.]
“Second brother, third brother, stand down. They came for me. Who asked you to interfere?” Baili Jingtian looked after their reputation and had them fall back on purpose.
The two bowed, going behind him.
These two were true geniuses that only the Crown Prince could face.
Baili Jingtian looked around and stepped before the two adversaries with a smile, “I know of Ouyang Lingtian’s son, but the other…”
“Western lands’ best disciple, Ye Lin!” Ouyang Changqing was the one to reply.
Baili Jingtian eyed him and nodded, “Oh, I was wondering how this young master could show such skill. So you’re the best of your generation in western lands.”
“Wrong, I’m just the second. First is my elder brother!” Ye Lin scoffed, finding it totally beneath him in taking something that wasn’t his to begin with.
Baili Jingtian jerked, “For western lands to have such a mighty figure as a runner-up, then the first must be godlike, right?”
“Wrong again, he’s only a coward, running off at the first sign of your coming.”
“Shut your mouth! Elder brother’s valor is beyond your understanding. He’ll never run! Try saying that again!”
“Zhuo Fan is a coward, fleeing with tails between his legs, ugh…”
Ouyang Changqing was disdainful and mocked but then Ye Lin flared in anger. He grabbed the other’s neck, while Ouyang Changqing did the same, not to be any lesser.
The two were back to arguing once more.
Murong Xue and the other’s faces fell.
[War is in front of us and these two only know how to squabble.]
Baili Jingtian frowned, smiling after a pause, “Zhuo Fan, are you talking about that Qian Fan merchant, Steward Qian?”
“Right, he’s been using that name to get into the Sea Bright Sect.” Ouyang Changqing replied while focusing on fighting with Ye Lin.
Baili Jingtian snickered, “Then may I ask, where is this Sir Zhuo?”
“How should I know? Ask them!”
[If there’s anything worse than a tough enemy is a dumb ally.]
Ouyang Changqing was so caught in wrestling Ye Lin he let his mouth run off, grumbling and pointing at Wu Qingqiu and making it even worse, “They’re defending Zhuo’s wife and escorting her home. They must know about him!”
[Oh, Zhuo Fan’s wife, is it?]
Baili Jingtian gave the others a look.
Their hearts sank and stepped before Chu Qingcheng, which only worked to point her out to Baili Jingtian.
Baili Jingtian smiled and his eyes flashed, “Grab her and we’ll get that guy’s location, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Jingtian flicked and the princes charged at Wu Qingqiu’s group.
Everyone flunched, with Ye Lin panicking. He stopped fighting with Ouyang Changqing and went to help.
Ouyang Changqing finally reacted, finally knowing who the enemy was and went to help.
But then someone jumped up to stop them, Baili Jingtian.
He wore a mocking grin, speaking with disdain, “Weren’t you coming at me before? Well here I am, attack me together!”
“Beat it! Don’t touch my sister-in-law!”
Ye Lin roared as golden flames turned into scales and charged like a tornado for Baili Jingtian, “Dragon Scale Flash!”
“If you want Zhuo Fan, go find someone else, not his woman. I hate nothing more than bastards who go after women and children!”
Ouyang Changqing roared, releasing his aura and flicking his fingers, sending icy waves at Baili Jingtian, “Heaven Sealing Sword Art, Endless Ice Seal!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1063 - 1063, A Toss-up
chapters.content:
Chapter 1063, A Toss-up
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Whoosh~
The cold sword wave stilled anything it passed through, as if stopped in time.
Whoosh!
Golden scales rained down like meteors at Baili Jingtian, blocking any chance of evading.
Ye Lin and Ouyang Changqing worked together for the first time, bringing out the best in each other.
Baili Jingtian hardly noticed the danger, still wearing that disparaging smile, “Did you know that the Patriarch’s demands are the harshest? Every time we fight, if even one time we fail to take on a hundred experts of our level by ourselves, we fail his expectation. In regard to those fights, you two coming at me is hardly enough to make me sweat, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Jingtian’s eyes flashed, feeling the dangerous attacks coming near, and merely waved.
Rumble~
With a rumble, lightning snaked from above, thousands of them forming into a sharp sword energy, smashing down on the ground to destroy it.
Ye Lin and Ouyang Changqing’s attacks were torn to pieces, the overbearing shockwave coming right for them and sending them flying, trailing blood behind them.
They paled instantly, finding that Baili Jingtian’s had the same smile once dust settled. He hadn’t moved an inch.
Their attacks had no effect whatsoever, but instead, they were the ones to suffer.
[This is terrifying!]
They were mighty youths so how could they be routed so easily? Was this the power of the best disciple in the lands?
The two were overwhelmed at the disparity. Ye Lin was having a difficult time believing that he, a sacred beast inheritor, would lose to another peer again. The remorse in his heart was too much to bear.
He ought to know that while he was the dragon ancestor’s inheritor, the enemy was the Sword Sovereign’s successor, a mere toss-up between them. As for strength, the master led while the disciple grew on his own abilities.
Dragon ancestor was a sacred beast, making it hard to clearly convey his skills to a human. As for a sacred weapon successor, like Ouyang Changqing and Baili Jingtian, they had understood Sword Sovereign’s essence through the sacred weapons. They were practically direct disciples of another human, making the passing of the techniques flawless.
Ye Lin’s defeat this time meant not the loss of dragon ancestor to Sword Sovereign. It only stated that humans and sacred beasts were different. A sacred beast taking a human disciple would not be able to impart all their skills.
Moreover, these two’s cultivation was also a gulf.
Wiping the blood from his mouth, Ouyang Changqing was not about to admit defeat anytime soon, turning to Ye Lin, “Brother Ye Lin, I almost forgot to tell you. That punk is in the Genesis Stage. We are without a doubt mighty geniuses, but with only Soul Harmony Stage cultivation we’ll only suffer against him. We can’t compare with him in the usage of the world’s power.”
“Makes sense, but could you please stop with the narcissistic praises? You should’ve stopped at calling me a genius. Don’t include yourself as well!” Ye Lin glared at him.
Ouyang Changqing rolled his eyes, “Fine, but now what do we do? I do have a plan, but I need brother Ye Lin to work with me.”
“Say it.”
“Remember our fight, when the world’s energy went berserk? I want to do it again!” Seeing Ye Lin agreeing, Ouyang Changqing turned serious, “I’ll open a channel, guiding the world’s energy into you, and you must bear with it. Even if you go berserk, all that matters is that you gnaw him to the bone!”
Ye Lin rolled his eyes, “What am I, a dog? Even gnaw? Then again, your idea has some merit. I’ll be sure to do my best in controlling that power and unleash it upon him.”
“That settles it!”
Ouyang Changqing made a sign, “Evoking Heaven Art!”
A great power suddenly gathered high above, turning into countless cold sword energies.
Baili Jingtian laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, you’re only borrowing power that’s not even yours. It might work against an equal opponent, but nothing that can stop a true Genesis Stage expert’s world’s power!”
“You’ll just have to wait and see!” Ouyang Changqing shouted, “Brother Ye!”
“I got it. Transformation, Fire Dragon King!”
Ye Lin roared and the golden flame exploded around him, warping and surging five hundred meters in height.
Ouyang Changqing changed signs, “Heaven Sealing Art, World Channel!”
Whoosh!
The power far above flew into Ye Lin, only this time, it no longer froze him but fueled his fire, with the golden flames roaring higher and brighter.
The huge dragon’s expression was heavy from pain as well, but he bore through it even as the strain increased along with the power.
Ouyang Changqing didn’t seal Ye Lin’s strength, but drew the world’s power into him to bolster his. But with this constant flow of power, the odds were it would go berserk once more and take over his mind. The risk in doing it was very high as well.
“Brother Ye, how does it feel? Can you take it?”
“No problem!” The dragon’s eye shone with resolve as he gnashed his fangs.
“Then strike, do it now!” Ouyang Changqing pointed at Baili Jingtian.
Ye Lin roared in anger and threw himself at the enemy with his claws and fangs ready to tear him apart.
For the first time, Ouyang Changqing applauded Ye Lin, “Good, brother Ye, attack! Ha-ha-ha, Baili Jingtian, you’re finished. Brother Ye has my Heaven Sealing Art in him, no matter what you do, all your power will be drawn into him and only make him stronger. Not just your Yuan Qi but the world’s power as well. He’s unstoppable now and you will die!”
Ye Lin roared as he finished, the flames on his body rising higher and brighter.
“Oh, so that’s how it is.”
Baili Jingtian smirked, drawing two fingers out and releasing sword intent from their tips.
Ouyang Changqing mocked, “Baili Jingtian, are you deaf? I already told you, no matter what you…”
Boom!
Baili Jingtian flicked his hand and a purple sword energy shot for the fire dragon.
A bang echoed out at impact that forced the flames to explode and Ye Lin to cough blood as he himself flew out of the fire dragon. He was now looking deathly pale and blood flew from his pierced chest.
The world’s channel died naturally with the destruction of the fire dragon.
Baili Jingtian was still standing there with his smile.
Ouyang Changqing gapped.
“T-that’s impossible!”
Ouyang Changqing shook his head in disbelief, “Dad clearly told me that once the world’s energy goes berserk, only the Heaven Sealing Sword can seal it, so how…”
Baili Jingtian mocked, “Your dad only told you that the Heaven Sealing Sword can do it? It seems he hasn’t told you that the Heaven Sealing Sword Art means sealing, while the Sundering Sword Art means destruction. The two sword arts are in conflict, leaving victory in the hands of the wielder and their strength. By using the Heaven Sealing Sword Art, no other power can break it, except a divine sword or the Sundering Sword Art. In other words, you’re suicidal if you think you can come at me with it when your mastery is weaker than my mastery of the Sundering Sword Art, ha-ha-ha…”
Ouyang Changqing stood dumbstruck.
[The Sundering Sword is the Heaven Sealing Sword’s bane? No way!]
Whoosh!
In the middle of his daze, a sword wave ran through his chest.
Ouyang Changqing spat blood and fell to the ground.
He, the greatest disciple in the northern lands, couldn’t even take a hit.
[Baili Jingtian is terrifying, a young Invincible Sword!]

chapters.title: Chapter 1064 - 1064, Rush
chapters.content:
Chapter 1064, Rush
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Yin Yang Ghost Claw!”
Yan Mo released his aura, fighting with a prince just off from the main fight. Yin and yang flames formed into an eerie claw that raked the air.
The prince gazed coldly, waving his finger and shooting a sword wave to crush the claw like it was nothing.
The sword wave wasn’t finished, slashing Yan Mo’s chest and making him cough blood as he flew through the air.
“Yan Mo!”
Wu Qingqiu cried out in worry just as Baili Jinggang arrived before him and smashed his punch into his clarity domain, “You have the time to mind others when fighting me?”
Bam!
Second only to Ye Lin, the strongest body in the western lands was Wu Qingqiu.
However, Baili Jingtian’s unstoppable punch connected to Wu Qingqiu’s chest, snapping his ribs. Wu Qingqiu was flung through the air and landed hard, with blood splattering everywhere.
They weren’t the only ones, with everyone else suffering the same fate against the nine princes. All these renowned disciples ended up crushed in less than a second.
None could get up, too damaged and too paralyzed to move.
The ten princes of Baili were unstoppable in power and potential.
Plop!
Murong Xue bled from the mouth with a frown, her knee hitting dirt. Looking around, she found that the ten princes were dominating the fights, leaving their opponents on the ground. Even Ye Lin and Ouyang Changqing, the opposing lands’ strongest, were no different–looking on with despair and dismay.
[We’re finished!]
Murong Xue’s heart sank in defeat and she shook her head. She should’ve known that the ten princes were beyond any of them could hope to match. Baili Jingtian alone was like a second Invincible Sword, crushing them all the same even without the other nine princes.
Compared to them, her side were weevils.
First came defeat and then came robbing their future and their lives.
Murong Xue sighed and closed her eyes. Regardless of that foul man’s shrewd planning, it was Baili Yutian who had taken initiative and now held the advantage.
[Now we have lost and the four lands lost as well.]
[The people are going to suffer once more…]
“Brother, these guys were nothing. How do we handle her though?” Baili Jinggang’s cold eye surveyed the area and as he brought a shivering Chu Qingcheng over to Baili Jingtian.
Baili Jingtian gave her a long look, “Miss, there’s no need to fear us. We won’t hurt you. We only want to find your husband. Where could Sir Zhuo be at this moment?”
Chu Qingcheng shivered and lowered her head.
Baili Jingtian looked at his brothers with puzzlement.
[Don’t tell me she’s been scared out of her mind.]
He’d seen his fair share of cowards, but never one who turned like this and was a cultivator as well.
They were only a bit rough on them, that was all, not yet having resorted to killing.
[So what’s got her so terrified?]
“Brother, this must be her nature.”
Baili Jinggang said, “When we struck, the girl had just stood there and shivered. She didn’t even fight us when we brought her, like a cripple. Why would Zhuo Fan, a deceitful and arrogant bastard who even fooled the Patriarch marry a dull wife like her?”
Baili Jingtian was stumped.
[She’s dull?]
Cough~
Ye Lin spat blood and forced his weak body to sit, “Don’t touch my sister-in-law! She lost her mind and knows nothing. Just take me if you want!”
“What good will that do? Who are you to Zhuo Fan anyway, that you could draw him out?”
Baili Jingtian mocked and turned to the shivering Chu Qingcheng, “She may be a dumb wife, but Zhuo Fan did have them escort her. That proves he’ll come for her. She’ll make a good bait. Brothers, take her back.”
“Yes, sir!”
Baili Jinggang bowed with the others and grabbed her hands to leave, but then paused, “Brother, what about them?”
“They may be insignificant bugs now, but who’s to say what the future holds? Especially those two, having the potential of a Sword King. Get rid of them.”
Baili Jingyu’s face was cold as jumped in the air. He drew two fingers and unleashed booms as his power shot from them.
The people on the ground closed their eyes.
The pride of western lands was going to fall here of all places, away from home. Ouyang Changqing gnashed his teeth, roaring, “I can’t accept it! I’ve yet to marry sister Xue! I’ve yet to be the best in the lands. I can’t die, I won’t!”
“You? Become the best? Humph!”
Baili Jingtian scoffed, “At best you’re nothing but your old man’s successor, the best in the northern lands. The best in the lands shall forever be with our clan, so just wake up already. Oh, sorry, it looks like you won’t even be dreaming soon. Take this little pity you got from me and use what precious seconds you have left to dream then, ha-ha-ha…”
Ouyang Changqing’s lips shook.
“Changqing, I’m here to save you. I knew sensing the Evoking Heaven Art here that it was you who did it. Ha-ha-ha, I’m so glad there’s still time!” A sudden voice shouted.
“Elder Lu!”
Ouyang Changqing looked at the old man leading two dozen others and showing their mighty Genesis expert aura.
Ouyang Changqing was overjoyed, “We’re saved! Twenty elders are here and in Genesis Stage. They…”
Boom~
Thunder rattled the air with every explosion of lighting and the elders were broken apart under the thunder sword waves. They couldn’t even scream as they turned to ashes.
Baili Jingtian put down his fingers and mocked, “Young master Ouyang, did you not hear me? I’ve trained against crowds from a young age, against a hundred. Aren’t you a bit naive thinking twenty Genesis Stage bags of bones could save you?”
Ouyang Changqing felt like crying, roaring, “You freak, have you no respect for your elders? Killing kind old men without provocation, is this how you’ve been raised? What has the Baili clan even taught you?”
“The Patriarch said to cut the tongues of the chatty ones.” Baili Jingtian darkened as he glared at him.
Ouyang Changqing closed his mouth, shivering in silence. Murong Xue shook her head with a bitter smile.
[The pompous fool is wild even in death.]
Baili Jingtian drew his fingers again and built power in them as he put on an evil smirk, “There’s no need to harbor false hope as the Sea Bright Sect has hardly any people left alive. No one will be coming to save you. So just accept my judgment and go to hell, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Jingtian flicked and the sword energy came crashing down. It held so much power the stones were eaten away, robbing the breaths of the wounded on the ground.
They were all doomed.
They knew it but none could do anything to stop it.
“Elder brother, farewell. Forgive me for not protecting my sister-in-law.” Ye Lin closed his eyes in remorse.
“Zhuo Fan, I am ashamed to be your brother.” Wu Qingqiu and Yan Mo lowered their heads.
“There are too many monsters in the world. I am unable to be the best in the lands…” Ouyang Changqing felt his heart twist in defiance.
“Central area’s might can’t be repelled. The people are going to suffer…” Murong Xue sighed.
In the moment of their deaths, all that went through their minds were their regrets. But then, “Divine Eye of the Void’s 5th stage, Thunderflame Wall!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1065 - 1065, Who’re You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1065, Who’re You?
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Elder brother!”
Ye Lin cried out and opened his eyes. The others were also excited as they looked on with hope, “Zhuo Fan!”
Hum~
Power shot in front of the sword wave and black thunderflames sprung to life in the form of walls.
Baili Jingtian got startled by the sudden development.
But the deadly Sundering Sword Art attack smashed into the flaming walls next.
There was no sound, the sword energy was swallowed up as it made contact with the flaming wall, losing most of its power.
Baili Jingtian gasped in disbelief.
[What is going on? How did my sword energy suddenly get so much weaker?]
The first wall was soon exhausted and the sword energy now met with the second.
This was where it got stalled for longer, not passing through as fast, getting its power cut off even more.
Once the second wall was gone, the sword energy lost most of its power. As it arrived at the third and final wall, it faded away along with it in an explosion.
Fierce winds blew around, showing a man with long black hair.
The Baili princes gasped then grew excited.
[The Patriarch wants his head. We just have to take it and make a name for ourselves!]
The princes were eager to get rewarded, including the crown prince.
“Elder brother!”
Ye Lin cried out, looking grave, “Forgive me, I failed you and didn’t protect sister-in-law.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shook and glanced at him before turning to Chu Qingcheng who Baili Jinggang was still holding.
His eyes grew icy as he stepped forward, ignoring everyone else.
Murong Xue shouted, “Devil, what are you doing here? You’re only dying with us. You can’t fight them! Their leader is the best disciple in the lands, Baili Jingtian. He’s the next Invincible Sword!”
Zhuo Fan never paid her any mind, still walking forward.
“Fine, since you want to die, go ahead. The sooner a devil like you dies, the better off the world will be.” Murong Xue huffed after being ignored.
Ouyang Changqing said, “Sister Xue, Baili Jingtian is beyond strong like Invincible Sword, but Zhuo Fan did stop the berserk Ye Lin and he’s the best disciple in western lands. He should have a chance, right?”
“None whatsoever.”
Murong Xue shook her head and huffed, “Senior Ouyang explained clearly that he stopped it because his power clashed with the world’s power. I had also once fought him and he isn’t anything strong. He needs to restrain the Sundering Sword Art or he’s only going to die against an expert like Baili Jingtian!”
“Really?”
Ouyang Changqing’s hope hit rock bottom, speaking with misery, “And here I thought there’s hope for us now that he showed up, but he’s only showing off to die. What did I ever do to deserve this? Is there no real savior coming to rescue us?”
Ouyang Changqing sighed and lamented his untimely demise. But then a weak laugh came, “Ha-ha-ha, young master Ouyang, no need to fret. Our savior is right here. Who are you beseeching?”
Ouyang Changqing turned to Wu Qingqiu and Yan Mo, seeing their conviction and confidence.
“You guys believe he can save us? But sister Xue…”
“Miss Murong!”
Wu Qingqiu ignored him and said to the girl, “You said you fought him once, but do you know his real strength? Acting sloppy and being serious are two things entirely.”
“Serious?”
Murong Xue paused to think, “It’s I who was serious though. You believe all my strength wasn’t enough for him to get serious?”
Wu Qingqiu shook his head, “In the Double Dragon Manor’s gathering, Demon Scheming Sect’s disciples talked about how brother Zhuo had always been laid back. He’ll never lift a finger to do anything dull. Let me put it another way, did brother Zhuo use his eye when he fought you?”
“His eye?”
“Precisely!”
Ye Lin butted in with immense confidence in Zhuo Fan, “Elder brother’s half, uh, seventy percent of power is in his eyes. Since he hasn’t used them on you, he was only playing. He’s only serious when he uses them. When I fought with elder brother, his eyes never stopped flashing. In other words, he was only using a third against you and you still look down on him.”
Murong Xue gasped as she frowned at Zhuo Fan.
[Are his eyes that amazing? He’s such a great genius yet a third of his power is only in his body?]
Ouyang Changqing turned to Zhuo Fan in haste, wishing to see the battle for the best disciple in the lands about to unfold…
Hovering above and gazing down on the approaching Zhuo Fan, Baili Jingtian smirked, “Qian Fan, Zhuo Fan, ha-ha-ha. How should I call you, I wonder?”
“Whatever.”
“Then, Sir Zhuo.”
Baili Jingtian smirked, “I remember the first time I saw Sir Zhuo and it left a deep impression. Even the Patriarch got fooled by you. Sir’s skills are sublime, with none seeing through your bluff. Frigid Rain Sword King then came back and we knew the truth, that you’re just at the Soul Harmony Stage in strength yet you act like a Sword King. We truly admire your calm and level-headed attitude as you put on your act.
