“The princes were all so tough, especially Baili Jingtian. Brother Ye Lin and I had to work together, yet we still couldn’t make him take us seriously. He wiped the floor with us easily. The others were also felled by the nine princes too, in one strike while we couldn’t even touch them. Dad, just how did those Baili freaks train? It’s like they were leagues above us from the four lands!”
Ouyang Changqing asked his seniors, but they froze up like statues, with Ouyang Lingtian droning on, “The royalty of the Sword Star Empire is unstoppable. Baili Yutian crushed us in one strike, even our strongest juniors were unable to match the princes. Father and son ended up as punching bags, the four lands’ strongest wiped, regardless of age. We may go above and beyond with our sacrifices to win this war, but then what, what about our children? The Invincible Sword might die, but a new Invincible Sword will appear in the central area…”
Ouyang Lingtian sank in despair, unable to see a way out of this horrible nightmare.
The other two sighed.
[Sword Star Empire is strong in every generation, destroying four lands’ every last hope.]
[What then is the point of even fighting? Even if we somehow get to stop this generation’s Invincible Sword, what will our kids do when the next one appears?]
The three sighed again.
“Ha-ha-ha, Ouyang Lingtian, Murong Lie, ignorant fools, you’ve got yourself cooped up in seclusion to fight Patriarch to the point you turned blind to the ever changing world outside!”
Baili Yuyun laughed with immense pride, his patronizing cutting deep, “Our empire has potential and strength beyond what your lands can offer. Not only Patriarch and the five Sword Kings can crush you, but even our juniors can wipe the floor with your top disciples, for we are the strongest clan in the world. We are above you in every single way. Your obsession to resist will only delay your end and prolong your pain. Ouyang Lingtian, how your son ended is proof of that. You can fight our empire for a decade, century, thousands of years, yet still have not the slightest chance at winning!”
The trio shook, their faces sinking harder and the divine swords slipping out of their grip.
The confidence of these true experts was destroyed.
The Sword Kings jeered harder.
“Bullshit!”
Ouyang Changqing had never seen his father so down, snapping in anger. He stomped over to Zhuo Fan, baffling him, and shouting at the Sword Kings above, “What strongest clan? That’s nothing but utter horse crap! I had yet to finish talking. We have indeed lost at the hand of your princes, but all your ten princes were just as easily destroyed by brother Zhuo here as well!”
The Sword Kings flinched, turning to Zhuo Fan and looking grave. Ouyang Lingtian watched curiously now.
Ouyang Changqing held his head high, like he did it, “Brother Zhuo, uh, big brother Zhuo, is a genius to shake the gods and shock the world. What could your princes possibly do? Big brother Zhuo wiped out nine of them in a flash, you got that? They didn’t even have time to fight back. Even Baili Jingtian, the last one, lost his arm and fled like a coward, and only with the help of two Sword Kings!”
“Humph…”
Ouyang Changqing went one, “We ended up defeated by your ten princes, yet that’s enough to declare the central area above us? Then, since big brother Zhuo destroyed your princes in a flash, leaving one crippled, still make you superior? Calling yourself the best clan in the world, then who do you take Zhuo Fan for? Humph, well let me tell you, get off your high horse for one day the Zhuo clan will take over! Big brother Zhuo is the second Invincible Sword, no, that guy’s nothing. Big brother Zhuo will be even stronger!”
Ouyang Changqing flared his nostrils at the Sword Kings, barking on and on like the greatest man there ever was, cocky and obnoxious. He spoke of everything like it was some grand achievement.
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Brother Ouyang, since you’re so keen on placing hatred on someone, take it yourself and not drag me into this. I have no intention to compete with Baili clan.”
“Brother Zhuo, I would’ve taken it all if I could fight, just look what that got me?” Ouyang Changqing turned his sparkling eyes to him, “You saw it yourself, how cocky those wretched fools are. Their words almost crushed dad on the inside. I could not just watch and had to support my father and the other lands’ heroes, to show them the light. And I only spoke the truth. With brother Zhuo’s power, it’s only a matter of time before you replace the arrogant Baili clan in lording over the world. I have faith in you. I call you big brother now, coming into your clan, so now you have to take a stand. Do this and I shall follow your every word to the letter, what do you say?”
Zhuo Fan eyed him long and hard.
The war took place in northern lands, where both sides focused their forces. While his faction would use the other four empty lands to develop, now that he had the chance. But once everything settled, northern lands would be hard to influence. So with Ouyang Changqing as the big boss around these parts would be a nice back door to spread his grip.
Zhuo Fan gave a reluctant nod, [Might as well set myself a foothold here.]
Ouyang Changqing grinned, finally able to be as cocky as he wanted on another’s reputation.
All of this wasn’t on impulse either, birthed from the incredible worship he had in Zhuo Fan.
Ever since he witnessed Zhuo Fan crushing the ten princes like nothing, he knew then and there why Ye Lin held Zhuo Fan in such high regard.
Be it in wisdom or boldness, Zhuo Fan had it all to fight even those old fogies.
His action was more like an investment. He accepted Zhuo Fan as one to shake the world with his actions, and Ouyang Changqing definitely wanted to be right there to relish in it.
He might be pompous, but his goals were lofty since young, to be the best of the best. Though by the looks of it, with so many freaks around, it proved difficult. So he chose to stick to the freakiest around, to lord over the rest of the masses.
[Now that’s a great bet!]
Ouyang Lingtian turned to Zhuo Fan, gasping but also feeling hope stirring in his crushed heart.
The Baili clan was not almighty. Someone would come to dethrone them.
[And that someone is Zhuo Fan!]
The Sword Kings above did not deny Ouyang Changqing’s ravings, slowly nodding their heads, “Yes, well said, boy. If the central area is a cut above the other lands, then Devil Mountain disciple’s power is beyond the profane world, shaking even us. That’s why we won’t let him grow!”
“Kill him!”
Baili Yuyun shouted and the trio shot for Zhuo Fan.
Ouyang Lingtian and the others too used their last strength to roar and stop them, “Sir Zhuo, run! We’ll stop them!”
“Humph, damaged as you are?” The Sword Kings mocked.
A flash of thunder followed by rumbling came out of nowhere, “Who dares touch father shall die!”
Zhuo Fan smirked, “You’re late, Qiao’er…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1077 - 1077, Here’s Your Strongest Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 1077, Here’s Your Strongest Clan
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Boom!
Purple lightning flashed at the horizon, unleashing three attacks on the Sword Kings before they reached Zhuo Fan.
They had to flick their hands to stop the lightning strikes from hitting them, and they frowned as the attack forced them back.
[Who is it that can unleash the same type of lightning as the Sundering Sword?]
Whoosh~
Qiao’er flashed in front of Zhuo Fan, giggling, “Father, I’m just in time!”
“No, you’re late!” Zhuo Fan grinned and shrugged teasingly, “Any later and you’d have to scrape your poor old man from the ground.”
Qiao’er gave a sly grin, “No, I wouldn’t. Dad has so many aces those three wouldn’t be able to touch you.”
“Who can say? Maybe I’m so stingy I’ll never use any. We still need to reach North Sea as well and should be use in case of certain doom only, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan shook his head, at which Qiao’er smiled and wrinkled her cute nose.
“Dad, that’s petty!”
While they were having a moment there between father and daughter, the rest were just shellshocked. Ouyang Changqing jerked awake, “Hey, big brother Zhuo, y-your miss…”
“What?”
“Uh, that miss of yours that interfered…” Ouyang Changqing gesticulated as he found it hard to speak the right words, stammering, “J-just how old is she…”
The rest gasped at the young miss in disbelief.
She looked around six but she just struck thrice with the power of around peak Soul Harmony Stage.
A junior with that power would be a mighty talent indeed. But then what would that make her, still a twerp yet wielding so much power!
[Just what is wrong with this world?]
Ouyang Lingtian’s team was just as stunned as the rest of them.
Thinking about it, they had seen Zhuo Fan with his daughter, but was written off as extra in their minds, of no import. Only now they saw her as a real threat.
Were all those around Zhuo Fan freaks of nature?
Shangguan Feixiong had it the worst. He could still remember the young boy Zhuo Fan had with him back in the central area, the same boy who punched Shangguan Feiyun so hard he spurted blood. Now he showed up with a girl.
[Is the Zhuo clan a den of monsters?]
Everyone gave Zhuo Fan astonishing looks.
Zhuo Fan gave a light wave, though finding no need to answer Ouyang Changqing, “Qiao’er, now I can rest easy with you here. I’ll leave the Sword Kings to you. Make sure they don’t follow and do be careful. Their nature is in opposition with yours, so don’t meet their Sundering Sword Art.”
“Don’t worry, dad, I know, he-he.” Qiao’er flicked her twin ponytails as she turned around to stare at her targets with insufferable smugness, “Dad says you three can’t pass me, unless you want to die. I feel heaven’s generosity for life so I’ll make it easy for you. If you don’t budge, then you get to live longer!”
Dong!
The minds of all boomed like drums at the young missie’s blustering, unable to wrap their heads around how a wee girl could be so arrogant.
Then they realized.
[Right, like father like daughter, insufferably arrogant both of them.]
While the next reaction was…
[Is the girl crazy? She may be in the Soul Harmony Stage at her incredibly young age, practically a miracle, but no matter how outrageous, she’s no match for Sword Kings. It’d be a loss upon this world for such a gem to be nipped in the cradle.]
Looking at the cute girl standing tall-ish, with that mighty look on her face, had Ouyang Lingtian and the rest feel it was such a pity, giving blaming looks to Zhuo Fan.
[We can understand the child being rash, obnoxious and wild, since it’s her nature, but you, as her father, are supposed to act your age and not send your own daughter to her death!]
[Why the hell would you?]
Zhuo Fan flicked his hand, walking away, “In fifteen minutes you’ll all be safe through the teleportation array as I escort you. I also want to see for myself that Qingcheng has left.”
“Uh, big brother Zhuo, you’re going to leave and leave my niece here all by herself…” Ouyang Changqing was quite forward, first calling him big brother and now treating Qiao’er as his niece, all stuck to him like glue.
Zhuo Fan eyed him then chuckled.
[The kid sure has no sense of shame, just like me.]
In the poor days of the Luo clan, he was anxious to get some backing for it, so he used the same tactic on Long Jiu from Veiled Dragon Pavilion. While he might not have found anyone from the mortal domain worth his attention, back then he was too broke and too powerless not to become sworn brothers with his best options to speed up his development plan. It was his lack of propriety that got the same clan turned into the enormous faction that was today.
Looking at Ouyang Changqing, Zhuo Fan was looking at himself and smiled, “Brother Ouyang, weren’t you calling my clan the strongest? Then just watch, the Zhuo clan’s might. I find it beneath me addressing some Sword Kings, leaving it to the kids, ha-ha-ha…”
Everyone gasped, their eyes big.
[Dude, that’s quite a mouth you have. You can show off, yes, but that’s going overboard. Sending a six-year-old girl to deal with Sword Kings? Is your clan made up of gods now?]
Besides Zhuo Fan, taking his sweet time walking off, the others were rooted to their spots, all staring at the cute Qiao’er with skepticism.
They were just too damn curious how the child could fight three Sword Kings in the Soul Harmony Stage.
They wanted to test her limits and Zhuo Fan’s wild boasting. Ouyang Lingtian and the other two were gripping their divine swords, ready to strike as well.
If Qiao’er couldn’t handle it, they would protect her. It was too much of a shame to bear, having a six-year-old dying to protect these old coots. Their pride was on the line here.
The Sword Kings were just as tense, though never considering Qiao’er from the start.
Having seen her to be in the Soul Harmony Stage from the three lightning attacks, they no longer cared. They only had eyes for Zhuo Fan.
“Brother Yun, the plan was to take the kid’s head to get some credit, but then these three geezer came to give us their swords. Taking them to Patriarch as well will give us an even bigger commendation. Maybe Patriarch will even let us have them once he finished learning their arts. Then we’ll become the only ones among the Nine Sword Kings to wield divine swords. None will be our equals, he-he-he…”
One Sword King spoke to Baili Yuyun, who nodded and shouted, “What are we waiting for? Kill them and take the swords!”
The Sword Kings laughed and went for Ouyang Lingtian and Zhuo Fan, full of excitement at the prospects of a glorious future. Qiao’er never even registered as their target.
Ouyang Lingtian turned grave, flicking his sword and pointing it at the incoming Sword Kings, “Come on! You’ll have to pry our sword from our cold, dead hands!”
“Isn’t that obvious? We came to do just that, ha-ha-ha…” Baili Yuyun cackled, focusing his sword energy, drifting and floating. He waved and lightning cracked, striking fear in all as the sword energy split into three and shot for them.
The three’s brows shook, sweat building on their brows. They used their divine swords to block, gnashing their teeth and getting ready for impact.
A bang resounded from the impact, but not with their swords. It was a streak of golden energy that shot for the three sword energies.
Baili Yuyun gasped, “What is that?”
Boom!
He had no time to make sense of it as the raging golden flames surged and punched a huge hole in the sky.
The golden light and the three sword energies clashed in a terrible explosion, dyeing the skies golden with the searing flames.
The shockwave spread everywhere for thousands of miles, burning anything to a crisp.
Ouyang Lingtian and the other two had their divine swords to shield them but the power was so great they coughed blood still. The blood never got to touch the ground, burned in the air before it reached it.
Only Qiao’er smiled, her twin tails swaying with the heat waves, unaffected. Zhuo Fan never looked back still, walking away with a smirk.
[Here’s your strongest clan, ha-ha-ha…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1078 - 1078, Unstoppable Ambush
chapters.content:
Chapter 1078, Unstoppable Ambush
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Plop~
The scorching golden flames filled the skies. Three men were suddenly flung to the side, broken and wrecked, with even their black hair singed as they all coughed up a lot of blood.
Finally stabilizing their condition, the Sword Kings looked pale as death.
Their early confidence and mocking smirks were wiped off their faces, looking panicky and in shock at the golden conflagration and at the sweet innocent girl behind it.
Only this six-year-old girl’s smile looked like the devil’s to them. No matter how impressed they were of her before, they still couldn’t believe she would end up so outrageously powerful. One strike had them falling back in wounds.
[T-this is impossible!]
Eyes shook, hearts quaked. The golden inferno was reflected on their terrified faces, turning their legs into jelly and robbing them of all courage.
They were pushed back, all three of them, and given injuries. A couple more of that and they’d be breathing their last, even Sword Kings as they were.
[That thing is a killing machine!]
[Blast that Bali Yuyu for not doing her job right. Her report is leagues behind reality!]
[If the missie is so tough, what about the big guy?]
The trio’s hearts sank, not wanting to go down that road…
“Ha-ha-ha, get a load of my power!”
Qiao’er wiggled her brows in pride and laughed as golden flames burned in front, “Listen up and listen good. That was just a warning. Take one more step and you’ll have me to answer to!”
The trio’s hearts jumped in their chests, taking a step back in fright.
The imperial family from the central area would’ve gone wide-eyed from shock. Three great and strong Sword Kings ended up terrified and cowering before some kid?
The reality was, the girl was just that damn dangerous that not even a Sword King could mess with her.
Ouyang Changqing’s jaw hit the floor, becoming numb from shock. He had to see it to believe it.
[The kid is so deadly that she can destroy a Sword King with every strike!]
Standing there frozen in shock, Ouyang Changqing took a long time to come back to reality. He whipped his head at Zhuo Fan and stammered, “B-big brother Zhuo, are all in your clan like that? What the hell got you so monstrous…”
“Not monstrous, but the strongest clan, no?”
Zhuo Fan smirked, “Brother Ouyang, you said my clan is the strongest, and while I dislike showing off, sometimes you have to take a stand. Won’t everyone treat your words like bragging otherwise? Ha-ha-ha, just leave this to Qiao’er. You should hurry instead and look after your father to leave this place. It’s not safe at all here.”
With a wide smile, Zhuo Fan kept on walking, showing off his straight back.
Ouyang Changqing was in awe as he muttered, “Damn, I made the right bet after all. The Zhuo clan is outrageous and now I’m set to get in, ha-ha-ha. My foresight is the best… ugh, forget my old man…”
Only now he recalled how the previous mighty blast sent the three seniors flying. The shock of Qiao’er’s super ridiculous power had him blanked out till now, waking up at last to the fact that his father needed help.
The three old men were slumped on the searing ground blinking at the golden inferno and at Qiao’er, even forgetting about their wounds.
They were in the same state as the three Sword Kings. Besides shock, they were more in awe.
[There’s actually something so ridiculously insane in this world as a six-year-old girl capable of… of…]
“Dad, this is no time to gawk, not with your wounds. Big brother Zhuo wants us to leave, so let’s go!” Ouyang Changqing rushed over and pulled on Ouyang Lingtian’s hand over his shoulder.
The others heard his yell and finally reacted, going to the other two to help them out.
Yet the three old guys were still out of it, unable to process what had just transpired, eyes staring blankly at Qiao’er.
[Someone’s always above you.]
For the first time ever, they felt this saying on their own skin. There was no such thing as the strongest in this world and there might even be more out there better than you.
[Men need to know respect and not be arrogant.]
The trio were taken away as they sighed with lowered heads.
They were the strongest in their lands, at the top of the world, with only the Invincible Sword standing above them. They were all civilized men, but being constantly affected by their status made them develop unhealthy pride in themselves while disregarding all others. They only saw the Invincible Sword as their real opponent.
Qiao’er now showed them, slapped them hard awake. There were countless young heroes out there, beyond even what these old relics could achieve.
Wu Qingqiu’s team gave Qiao’er one last look before realizing that Zhuo Fan’s daughter did have the power to block the Sword Kings.
Even as baffled and stunned as they were, they could not misplace the safety they felt.
Without hesitating any longer, they dragged the three seniors after Zhuo Fan. Ye Lin stepped livelier, catching up to him, whispering, “Elder brother, did Qiao’er use a Dragon Breath Pill?”
“Yeah.”
“How many do you have? If she uses them all, then nothing will stop them.”
“Relax, Dragon Ancestor gave her ten. I bet three are enough to rip even those Sword Kings to pieces.” Zhuo Fan smirked in confidence.
Ye Lin flinched and gasped, “So many? Master is playing favorites. He only gave me a couple last time and now he just gives away ten? On top of that, they’re even stronger? And he even said the Dragon Breath Pill drains him a lot, liar. This shows he cares more about the girl than me.”
“I don’t think so since I provoked him into giving them and our mission this time is too dangerous. Dragon Ancestor just gave us a little something to be prepared for whatever comes our way.”
“Dangerous? Elder brother, weren’t you in a rush to seal the World Wind Tunnels? Why have you come to the northern lands? Can I help?”
“Most likely not.”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, turning serious, “To be honest, I came to the North Sea to find Heaven Sealing Sea Ao. But then I heard he has a foul temper, treating humans like they’re his bitter enemies, so I came prepared. You can’t get involved. The more we are before the sacred beast, the worst it would probably be. There’s no point in wasting your life. I’ll have to play it by ear and see if I can get him to cooperate.”
Recalling his master’s strength, Ye Lin nodded in understanding, then sighed and gave up.
And so, the team left their backs in Qiao’er’s care as they moved with speed for the teleportation array.
The Sword Kings looked through the golden fire wall with anxiety and gnashed teeth. To get to them, they first had to get through Qiao’er and her cold smile, though they were feeling a bit fearful.
[The girl is outrageous!]
[But the problem is her dad, how strong is he? In the case he’s even stronger than her, then we have it worse.]
Chasing did not sound so pleasant right now.
[Curse you, Baili Yuyu, and your rotten report. We were all minding our business and would’ve kept it like this instead of offending this monster pair.]
[Now that all gloves are off, we need to finish them now or suffer later. But how the hell are we to do that?]
They had deep frowns, and filled with blame for Bali Yuyu, cursing her to the high heavens.
Whoosh~
A sudden gale blew and a tall figure loomed over them from behind. An aged and rumbling voice shook the air, “What happened, why such a huge ruckus?”
“Patriarch?”
Shuddering, the Sword Kings turned around at once and bowed, “Greetings, Patriarch!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1079 - 1079, Hard to Block
chapters.content:
Chapter 1079, Hard to Block
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Whoosh!
Invincible Sword flashed before the three with coldness in his eyes, “What happened here? Report!”
“Patriarch, we were stopping Zhuo Fan and Ouyang Lingtian’s group of three divine swords wielders.” The trio tensed and answered at once.
Baili Yutian’s beard shook, but then grinned, “That’s great then, the heads and the swords I wanted gathered in one place. Well, where are they?”
“R-ran off…”
The trio’s faces twitched, feeling apprehensive as they glanced at Baili Yutian shaking all over.
His features twisted as he roared, “Ran off? How the hell did they just run off?”
“B-because…”
“And why are you still standing here like fools and not going after them?” Baili Yutian cut through their stammering as he raged on.
The trio looked at each other with bitter gazes, when Baili Yuyun finally scrounged up his courage to point at Qiao’er, “Patriarch, we failed you, stopped by this little girl. We couldn’t do anything. Please show leniency, Patriarch!”
“A little girl?”
Baili Yutian narrowed his eyes, scanning Qiao’er, “So this is the one you say that blocked you?”
“Yes, Patriarch, she’s always been with that Zhuo Fan. Her innocent, cute and joyful manner is just a front for the real…”
Bam!
Baili Yuyun and the other two found themselves flung away by a sudden release of immense power, even as he talked. They bled once more, coughing and paling.
Baili Yutian’s eyes burned hot with his anger, “I don’t need excuses! You’re nothing but dead waste for even a little girl to stop you!”
“Yes!”
The trio took the critique with a deep bow.
Baili Yutian turned his attention to Qiao’er, showing off a cold smile, “Ha-ha-ha, Devil Mountain isn’t the empty lie I thought it to be. There’s some truth to it, I see. Missie, you sure are something to stop these three, even if they’re more or less garbage.”
“Better believe it, humph!”
Qiao’er scoffed and raised her cute face with excessive pride, “Those three don’t know reason so I only set them straight. Old coot, if you know what’s good for you, disappear from my sight. Dad said none of you can cross this line…”
“Or what?” Baili Yutian smiled.
Qiao’er smirked, her eyes flashing coldly, “What I’m going to do to old geezer like you is cremate you!”
“You got quite the mouth on you!”
Baili Yutian shook his head, giving a scornful look and smile. He just walked towards the golden fire, one step at a time, like he was out on a stroll.
“Missie, you’re the first to ever talk to me like that since I started on my path. Show me then, just what skills you have to back up that overconfidence, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Yutian laughed, letting it loose as his bulk neared Qiao’er.
Qiao’er stared at him, her face growing hard, then her hand flashed with a golden ball of fire. The violent and destructive air it gave spoke of death and horrors.
“Old coot, you asked for it. You only got yourself to blame for ending up in pieces by insisting on crossing the line.”
“There’s no line that can’t be crossed, only the strength to do so.”
Glancing at the ball in Qiao’er’s hand and sensing its power, Baili Yutian was first amazed then excited as he quickened his pace. He couldn’t wait to test Qiao’er’s strength.
“So that’s what got those three fools to eat dirt. Ha-ha-ha, not bad at all. I can feel the flood of power coming off it. Though it’s not yours, miss, but to have it proves Devil Mountain is more than it seems. I so wish I could meet a real Devil Mountain expert. It would make death worth it.”
“Oh, you’re going to see one alright, right now!”
Qiao’er’s eyes flashed and the Dragon Breath Pill whistled through the air for Baili Yutian.
Boom!
The golden light shot like a start, smashing for Baili Yutian at top speed.
It followed with a tremendous explosion, not unlike the previous one, shaking the world around for thousands of miles. The golden inferno released decimating shockwaves that engulfed half of the Sea Bright Sect and destroyed veritable monuments, having survived for thousands of years.
As for the mighty Invincible Sword himself, it got swallowed up by the raging flames.
The Sword Kings gasped in panic, “Patriarch!”
There was no answer, giving the sinking feeling the old expert’s body crumbled under the onslaught of fire.
The Sword Kings slumped in shock.
Qiao’er giggled and mocked, “That’s what you get for pushing it! And he still went on about seeing some Devil Mountain true expert. Happy now? I am none other than such an expert of Devil Mountain. So rest in pieces, he-he-he…”
“Ha-ha-ha, every true expert out there can use their own power to twist the world to their whim!”
An aged voice of disdain echoed from the flames, “Miss, you’ve got a good talent, the makings of a great expert. It’s a shame though, that you’re quite far from being one, with your childish use of another’s power. Allow me to show you what a true expert can do!”
Rumble~
Lightning crackled all of a sudden and a savage sword wave crossed the skies and split the inferno.
Invincible Sword appeared in sight, taking his time as he walked out, casual as before.
With every step, rumbling echoed out.
The golden flames crumbled with a sudden bang as purple lightning thundered high above, tearing into the golden fires until nothing remained. The inferno soon turned into a purple thunderstorm.
Baili Yutian thus became the overlord of this storm. With him here, the golden flames would never burn again.
“Patriarch!”
The Sword Kings cheered.
Qiao’er shook, looking at the old man in disbelief, “N-no way! Dragon Ancestor’s Dragon Breath Pill did nothing? W-what is he?”
“Dragon Breath Pill, ha-ha-ha. Was that what you threw?”
Baili Yutian’s eyes shone with bloodthirst, his steps measured as he got closer to Qiao’er, “This toy is good enough to deal with a Sword King. It even made me twitch. Ha-ha-ha, how many years has it been since someone managed to make me feel numb? I’m really curious now as to who made this Dragon Breath Pill. Though no matter how great, it’s still a crutch, while true experts wield endless strength from within. That’s what I want to fight, not some child throwing toys at me. So I will ask you again, missie, does Devil Mountain have any experts? Ha-ha-ha…”
Qiao’er’s brow shook, staring hard at Invincible Sword’s stature growing bigger as he neared. She flinched back in reflex, her hand holding another Dragon Breath Pill.
Baili Yutian noticed and shook his head, “Miss, so you chose to ignore me. I told you, I have no interest in such toys…”
Whoosh~
Qiao’er threw the second Dragon Breath Pill and cut him off, “Then have another taste, geezer!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1080 - 1080, Limit
chapters.content:
Chapter 1080, Limit
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Boom!
Another glorious explosion shook the skies, with the raging fires leaping high above, from Qiao’er’s second Dragon Breath Pill she threw at Baili Yutian.
The result was the same as the first time unfortunately. Following the flashes of lightning, the fire soon got pulverized into nothing. Only the lightning remained, flashing across the skies, a hymn to the coming of an overlord…
Baili Yutian had no hair out of place, taking his time to walk ever nearer to the sweet girl with a smirk on his face.
“Miss, what you got may stop others, but never myself. Can you see why? Ha-ha-ha, because I am just that much stronger. Every law, limit, rule in this world is nothing to the truly strong, one such as I!”
Qiao’er shivered, looking shocked and stumbling back. She had lost her confidence and was now sinking into terror.
[His strength is inhuman, like a sacred beast. But more of a fledgling, having yet to mature.]
Regardless, Qiao’er still found it dismal how such an aberration walked this earth, besides her dear dad, of course.
At least Zhuo Fan got a Sovereign’s legacy, while he…
Qiao’er’s eyes widened, staring hard at the incoming firm steps with a lost look.
[Or maybe this old coot grasps the Sword Sovereign’s essence?]
[It all makes sense now, why Invincible Sword is so ridiculously strong compared to the other Sword Kings. He has come to touch upon the core of Sword Sovereign’s swordsmanship, having gleaned into its fundamentals.]
Not even Zhuo Fan could top that. He was more quantity than quality, taking every legacy he got for a trial run and not delving deeper into their core values.
As for Invincible Sword, he only had Sundering Sword’s swordsmanship and even that was just a fraction from the Sundering Sword. This, however, proved enough to take him to the pinnacle of power in this domain.
Zhuo Fan and Invincible Sword, both learned Sovereign paths. But as to who would come on top, be it the broad approach or the focused approach, remained to be seen.
Though facts already tipped the balance in Zhuo Fan’s favor. He had widened his gaze while Invincible Sword focused it instead, making it one of the main reasons for going after the other divine swords.
He learned all the Sundering Sword Art had to give him, and to go further, he needed the other arts to rise above this stagnation.
Qiao’er had lost her precious calm, her palms feeling clammy.
She knew then that she wasn’t facing some average cultivator, but a future Zhuo Fan. As for Zhuo Fan’s capacity for growth, she based it off of dragon ancestor describing Zhuo Fan’s limitless future.
A Sovereign inheritance was a huge deal. Even with a shoddy perception, you’d still rise above the masses. This went double for Invincible Sword and Zhuo Fan, cultivation geniuses the world had never seen. Add to that a Sovereign’s inheritance and they would become something the sacred beasts would come to pay attention to.
Qiao’er had the minor Dragon Breath Pills dragon ancestor gave to her for protection, but they proved to be nothing but parlor tricks before the one grasping Sundering Sword’s complete Sundering Sword Art.
“I’m going to end you!”
Qiao’er shook hard, staring at the man coming ever closer, and five Dragon Breath Pills showed in her hand before throwing them all at him.
Boom!
The first unleashed sky-high flames upon contact with Invincible Sword. Before the golden inferno suffered the same fate the last two times, the second Dragon Breath Pill vame, unleashing another huge explosion.
The second wave of flames overlapped the first, swallowing Baili Yutian completely.
Then came the last three, throwing inferno after inferno at Baili Yutian.
The purple lightning flashed nonstop, to scatter the flames, but five raging fires were too much indeed. Even under the constant lightning strikes from the heavens, the fire never died out.
The three Sword Kings grew grave once more with worry. Despite it all, Baili Yutian’s footsteps never wavered, still walking on, yet a slight frown was still noticeable.
“Aah!”
A sudden cry came from him, unleashing all his power. As the five searing waves of fire were about to enclose him, booms resounded as lightning gushed from within, tearing at the fires. The dreadful lightning flashed and punched a hole in the inferno, helping the lightning coming from above to attack it from the outside until no golden flames remained.
The Sword Kings gasped, unwilling to believe what they were seeing.
“Patriarch’s power exceeds that of the world’s?” Baili Yuyun glanced at the other two, his voice shaky, “Any other Genesis Stage expert relies on the world’s power for their strength, even we, Sword Kings, are no different. Yet Patriarch…”
“Yeah.”
Another Sword King nodded, “Some say the world’s power has a limit. If one comes to overcome it, they would be able to tear the world apart. I always thought it to be a myth. How can the world have a limit? Now I know that Patriarch had already attained this realm. It’s inconceivable! We all saw how the world’s power barely put a dent in the thick flames, yet the Patriarch’s own strength cleaved them. What more proof is there?”
The other two nodded, their eyes shining with excitement.
It was pride in their clan that the Invincible Sword was indeed the strongest in the five lands. Not even the world could stop him.
They had no way of knowing that the world’s power had no limit. It was this domain’s scope that had a limit.
A limit that not even Sword Kings could touch upon, but Baili Yutian did.
It was solid proof he had outgrown the mortal domain and could no longer be classified as such.
The mortal domain was a mere dimension, array, that Heavenly Sovereign formed, thus having its limits. But like Baili Yutian said, enough strength could crush those limits.
He came before it, but only probing about, unable to understand its intricacies.
He was still in the dark that he was among the very few in the mortal domain qualified to enter the Sacred Domain…
Hu~
A biting wind swept the area, with a black dust blowing everywhere. Baili Yutian stood in the air and smiled victoriously, “Miss, five Dragon Breath Pills can overlap, but it’s unfortunate they couldn’t combine into a single strike, coming utterly short of a true expert’s might. The middle part, that of connecting them, is the biggest flaw. So no matter how many you throw at me, they can’t, ugh…”
Baili Yutian declared smugly, like instructing a child, but then found his audience wasn’t there to humor his flair of the dramatic.
[The twerp is sly!]
“Patriarch, she threw the five Dragon Breath Pills not to beat you, but to run away!” Baili Yuyun popped over and exclaimed.
Pa!
The resounding slap sent him reeling, with Baili Yutian barking, “You think I don’t know that? Humph, don’t just stand there, go and find her! I wanted Zhuo Fan and the three divine swords, but now I also want her. She thinks she can toy with me? Humph, I’ll show her the real meaning of strength!”
“Yes!”
They all bowed at once, following his orders.
Meanwhile, Zhuo Fan’s gang were speeding away when they heard a loud commotion behind that drew their attention. They gasped at the sight of the golden inferno.
[How is that wee lass so strong, and at such a young age?]
The flames barely held for a few seconds before purple lightning snuffed them out.
Ouyang Lingtian cried out, “I-Invincible Sword, that’s his might when using the world’s power. He caught up. Will the young girl be able to stop him?”
“Hey dad, don’t worry, our Zhuo clan’s the strongest there is. A child can handle three lousy Sword Kings, so there’s no way Invincible Sword stands a chance either against our clan’s young miss, he-he-he…” Ouyang Changqing gave a dismissive wave.
Ouyang Lingtian’s face twitched, “Boy, you sure switch camps fast, not waiting for me to die before relinquishing your history and ancestors.”
“What are you saying, dad? I’m still Ouyang and not turning my back on my ancestors. It’s merely showing respect to my big brother. My big brother Zhuo and I will do great things together. Ain’t that glorious?”
Ouyang Lingtian rolled his eyes, turning serious as he glanced at Zhuo Fan. Since he was of the Sea Bright Sect, his son would become the sect’s successor. Though with Zhuo Fan being so outstanding, a real go-getter, he showed incredible potential and promise.
For his son to follow him might not be such a bad idea after all. By all accounts, this was a breach of sects’ rules, though Ouyang Lingtian turned a blind eye.
Anyone would strive to grow, and only a fool would be blind to Zhuo Fan’s prospects to not follow.
Although, Murong Xue always seemed to be against him, “Humph, spineless coward, falling in with devils.”
Boom!
A huge explosion came from behind just then, with a golden glow reaching high in the sky, before it was soon covered in purple.
Zhuo Fan shook, stopping for once, “There’s no point rushing it. Qiao’er can’t hold them. Prepare to fight…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1081 - 1081, Unfit
chapters.content:
Chapter 1081, Unfit
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“What, fight?!”
Seeing Zhuo Fan stop, the rest halted as well, looking grave, “Brother Zhuo, are you absolutely sure Qiao’er can’t hold it?”
Zhuo Fan gave a curt nod, “In the last two explosions, the lightning always prevailed over the inferno, it’s proof that Qiao’er can’t handle Invincible Sword. I wager they’ll soon catch up and escaping with our speed is pointless. That’s why, fight!”
Brows shook all over as faces sank in despair, balling their fists as fear creeped into their hearts.
Besides the fact that all here were stragglers, not even at their best would they ever hoped to stand a chance against that monster.
Ouyang Lingtian was the most clear on that. He and the other two divine sword wielders’ only hope was in Qiao’er’s godlike talent. This, however, turned out to be a bust as well, with the old freak coming to finish them off.
Everyone shivered.
“Big brother Zhuo, what are our chances?” Ouyang Changqing, gazed at him with blinding hope.
Everyone turned as well with burning gazes, including the three oldies here, all eager to know the answer to that question, having lost their backbone and awaited his instructions.
Back when he was the Grand Marshal, they could still make use of that noggin on their shoulders, considering the three orders. Now though, they relinquished their cognition in favor of following Zhuo Fan’s orders.
They were at the end of the rope and the only way out was with help. Any that fell in such dire straits would stoop to any low, would take any deal. They would forgo using their own minds in overcoming to earn another’s help. The help might come from a volatile person, but no matter how wretched the character or unreliable, his words were law to them.
Not to mention Zhuo Fan’s intellect had been put to the test and prevailed. Their trust in him was blinding at this point.
None had such complete faith in Zhuo Fan until now, especially the ever belligerent Murong Xue. Even she found herself with her fate in his hands.
Despair was among the best ways to get people to listen and obey. How else would you explain the many plebeian revolts throughout history?
Zhuo Fan met their gaze with a knowing smile, “Rest easy, with me here, nothing will happen.”
“Big brother knows a way? You can overcome Invincible Sword?” Ouyang Changqing gasped, discovering another side of him.
[The boss is so tough he only used his pinkie before, when he has the power to fight the best in the lands?]
[R-really? But we’re peers, there’s a limit to how strong you can get…]
His suspicion soon waned right after, recalling Qiao’er pushing back three Sword Kings and she was even younger.
[As her father, there’s nothing big brother Zhuo can’t do!]
[The Zhuo clan is a hidden den of monsters.]
Ouyang Changqing cupped his hands in admiration, “Big brother Zhuo is unfathomable, having not shown your talent for us to see. Now I get to see big brother’s style and I bet big brother and Invincible Sword’s fight shall be the greatest and most glorious battle since the world came to be. It shall be our utmost honor to witness history being made!”
The rest looked at Zhuo Fan with astonishment.
[He can handle Invincible Sword, really?]
[That’s insane!]
Invincible Sword had trained for ages, but what about him? If he could meet the old monster head on, these observers would be ashamed for the old coot.
[You cultivated for millenia yet can’t even compare to a guy being around for just a few decades? What have you been doing all these years, lounging?]
Those from the western lands were even more incredulous since the last time they saw him was barely ten years ago, when they knew his strength. There was just no way one could jump ranks so much and so fast. Not just Invincible Sword would be depressed if he could, but even them, feeling like they wasted their years.
[We’ve been hard at work training, so why are we still so far behind?]
Everyone had tense looks, waiting for Zhuo Fan’s answer. There was hope and denial on their faces. While it was a great boon for them if Zhuo Fan had such heft, the same couldn’t be said for their pride and self-confidence.
[What the hell have you been doing these years? How did you get so far ahead? We’re not even in your shadow anymore!]
Gulping, Ouyang Lingtian and the other two were stressed out as they waited with fixed gazes on him, their thoughts and wishes in deep conflict.
If Zhuo Fan declared he could fight Invincible Sword, they were the first to be in utter denial, taking out their sash and just hanging themselves with it.
[If you’re such an abomination, what does that make us?]
Looking at them all, knowing full well the chaos in their hearts, Zhuo Fan chuckled and shook his head, “Friends, with my strength, even fighting peak Genesis experts is out of question, let alone Invincible Sword. I just happen to have some things on me, like Qiao’er, from my master when times are tough. I can at least escape with my life.”
[Oh, I see.]
They all bobbed their heads, their rearing jealousy and envy curbed on the spot.
[What did I tell you? There’s no way humans could train so fast, that’s simply insane. It turns out to be some special means instead. That explains the lass’ outrageous power, it’s all based on something else.]
[One’s cultivation can only grow through hard work after all!]
Ouyang Lingtian and the other two had this belief ingrained in their hearts, getting testy the minute someone challenged it. If Zhuo Fan and Qiao’er had truly amassed in a few years what took a thousand, their minds would snap and would just curl up and cry in a corner.
They thanked the heavens it wasn’t so. This at least brought value to their bitter struggle to the top for years on end. They got to keep their ego intact, for now.
“Changqing, slow and steady wins the race, tested and proved throughout the ages. Remember that. To be strong you need to train hard and not rely on props. When they fail, and they will, you only have yourself to rely on. Understand?” Ouyang Lingtian used this chance to teach his wisdom to the child, though doing more for himself and washing away this defeat.
It included Zhuo Fan in it as well, though they all understood it. Old timers found their limelight stolen by youth, so they could only hang their seniority over their heads to show off.
Ouyang Changqing played along by nodding, the picture of an earnest pupil, yet rotten heart of disdain. Youths were pragmatic, looking only at the end and not the means. Sure, his old man’s words held some truth in them, though here and now, they fell on deaf ears.
To make it worse, if it came from Zhuo Fan for instance, he’d have his full attention.
Whoosh!
Purple flashed and Qiao’er caught up to them. She looked panicked, rushing to Zhuo Fan, “Father, t-that old timer is too strong. Dragon Breath Pill didn’t do anything. He’s on his way right now!”
“Ha-ha-ha, yes, but not on his way, having already arrived.”
Just as she finished, four whistling sounds were heard as Invincible Sword was upon them with the three Sword Kings in tow.
Everyone flinched back from shock, even Qiao’er. For the first time, she scampered behind Zhuo Fan, peaking at Baili Yutian with fear.
[The monster is here!]
Zhuo Fan lacked the obvious fear and distress prevalent running rampant in his group, smiling as he cupped his hands, “Sir, we meet again.”
“Indeed, Sir Zhuo, your absence weighed heavy on my heart, ha-ha-ha…” Giving a smirk, Baili Yutian laughed, “Devil Mountain is such a big name, living up to its reputation. I have now come to see it for what it is. Although, I’m afraid leaving without your head and the three divine swords is out of the question. Will sir oblige?”
Zhuo Fan cocked an eyebrow, giving off a smirk of his own, “Sir sure is forgetful, of our deal to stay out of each other’s way. Isn’t it a little too soon to come for my head? Sir might want to go back on his word, but aren’t you too eager, too.. undignified?”
“An agreement is made between equal parties, something I considered you to be then. Not anymore!” He squinted and gave an evil smile, “If you wish the deal to hold, you will have to prove to me you have what it takes for me to honor it still.”
“You don’t say. Ha-ha-ha, then I guess the deal is off, here and now.”
“Giving up so soon, sir? Ha-ha-ha, with your bluff seen through, you’re sensible.”
“That’s where you’re wrong, sir.”
Zhuo Fan grinned as Baili Yutian laughed, his eyes disdainful, “I found that from how sir defined the deal that you’re the one unfit for me to keep it. You’re just too weak!”
Baili Yutian shuddered, his manic smile frozen on his face as his expression darkened.
“Humph, Sir Zhuo called me forgetful, when you’re even more so. I take it back, you’re not sensible, but conceited. It might scare everyone else, but not me. You’re only signing your death warrant!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1082 - 1082, Showdown
chapters.content:
Chapter 1082, Showdown
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Baili Yutian flicked his fingers. The sky turned purple from the lightning and a savage sword energy flew straight for Zhuo Fan.
The pressure they felt spiked from that one strike, stalling everyone’s breath and making them shiver. It even made their skin crack, scarlet blood seeping from their wounds, like they were ready to pop.
Ouyang Lingtian and the other two had bloody faces, unable to resist. Not even wielding divine swords proved enough to defend against this casual swipe from Baili Yutian.
[Invincible Sword, unstoppable and decimating!]
He held the greatest power in the world, relentless and crushing. Below this sword wave, all felt death breathing down their necks, turning icier and icier.
“Ha-ha-ha, Sir Zhuo, I just came from having tried your child’s toy. Quite impressive, I might add, but far from enough to threaten me. Sir Zhuo, a father shouldn’t be using the same method like your daughter in desperate times. You’d only disappoint me.”
Baili Yutian laughed with disdain. The three Sword Kings looked smug seeing their boss smug, cackling on the inside.
[Mess with Patriarch and this is what you get. None can stand up to the Patriarch. Devil Mountain’s Dragon Breath Pill might deal with a Sword King, but it’s only a crude toy against Patriarch, ha-ha-ha…]
Zhuo Fan squinted, facing the fierce winds and looked at the obnoxious four above with a cold smile, “Invincible Sword, don’t get too happy. You’re far from becoming unbeatable. I might not have such toys on me, though I’m partial to having pets. Since sir is gracious enough to show us how it’s done, I would very much appreciate your input on this little beastie.”
Zhuo Fan flicked his hand and the storage ring opened a portal.
A fierce gale blew and the ground shook. The sword energy was right on top of the group, about to take their heads, when a huge-sharp claw lashed out at it. The explosion rumbled out and the Invincible Sword’s energy remnants faded off into nothing.
A chilling wind passed as a wind shadowed the sun and the skies in its entirety. A single flap crushed stone and broke mountains. The endless purple lightning around got snuffed out as well under the biting gale.
The Invincible Sword’s dominance over the sky had been cut down to half its size as a three-headed humongous bird with an azure flame on its forehead presented its glorious size to the world.
It shrieked, the piercing sound deafening and reverberating in all directions. All spiritual beasts within a thousand miles cowered in fear, prostrating before their king.
“T-that’s…”
All gaped in shock and terror, including even Invincible Sword, “Could this be the legendary imperial spiritual beast of the 9th level, the Three-headed Crow?”
The Sword Kings were dumbstruck, face twitching and shaking hard, “Patriarch, that’s indeed the strongest spiritual beast, the 9th grade imperial Three-headed Crow. Hardly anyone has seen it. To think it would make its appearance today!”
“The Devil Mountain is a monster to even rear something of this caliber!”
Baili Yuyun grew grave as he stared in disbelief, “9th level spiritual beasts are the strongest, said to be an emperor anywhere it went to all creatures. There has never been any man in the five lands’ history capable of surpassing such a legend. It was in fact human empires that caved under its claw and wingspan by the dozens. I just can’t fathom how such an emperor of beasts would be willing to listen to some human. Patriarch, Devil Mountain…”
Baili Yuyun shook in anxiety, his regret mounting. This expert could not be trifled with, having the might to subdue even the mightiest of beasts, a 9th level spiritual beast.
The real issue here was that they got on this mystical hidden sect’s bad side now.
[How are we supposed to survive it? When the real experts feel like coming for retribution, not even the Patriarch might hold.]
Baili Yuyun grew panicked, looking at Baili Yutian in fear.
Baili Yutian knew what he wanted to say and hold his hand out to stop him, his smirk obvious as he stared in excitement at the huge beast, “For thousands of years I’ve been in constant search for a worthy opponent, yet was disappointed every time. Provoking Devil Mountain might not have been wise, but to see a living legend, a 9th level spiritual beast, is filling this old heart with glee, ha-ha-ha…”
“Patriarch, that’s not the problem here, it’s the person who subdued it…”
“I know that.”
Invincible Sword waved him off with impatience, “Only a true expert can make a 9th level spiritual beast bow. We’ve really stirred the hornet’s nest this time and even I might feel it’s sting. But what of it? Do you three know how the Sword Star Empire came to be? In my prime, I’ve faced countless hardships and challenges that led to what you see today. Isn’t it just another strong adversary that showed up? Just in time too, to curb this solitude I’ve endured for years and years. I can now feel young again. No matter how tough Devil Mountain is or how many experts come at me, I’ll meet them head on down to my last breath. Just like how I did back in the day and challenged the five lands. Ha-ha-ha, Devil Mountain, this is great. It’s so good that you exist. Now I’m no longer alone, ha-ha-ha…”
An uninhibited mad laughter came from Invincible Sword as he stared at the Three-headed Crow, brimming with glee.
The Sundering Sword appeared in his hand. As he felt the streaks of purple lightning flaring, his thirst for battle raged as his aura burst forth.
In a blink, the skies changed. Lightning crackled, purple fighting to wrest control of the skies from the black winds.
The Sword Kings fell back as Patriarch grew more and more excited, having never seen him so wild and violent.
Now that the 9th level spiritual beast appeared, it could handle all his power and he could finally let loose.
For a man so crazed about being at the very top, it was the greatest stimulant.
The Three-headed Crow started, hardly believing what he was seeing.
Not even it had faced such a strong human, surprised one even appeared in this mortal domain.
Invincible Sword was a man that even an imperial spiritual beast would respect.
Ouyang Lingtian and the others watched the Three-headed Crow with gaping mouths, “Uh, Sir Zhuo, t-the Devil Mountain even has something this outrageous?”
“Well, they’re good for errands and holding the door.” Zhuo Fan spoke heavily, staring at the beast and man about to duke it out. Even he began to feel some respect.
Wisdom came with age, it was what everyone was saying. And the more one went on in years the more they gained and the more they feared losing any of it. Invincible Sword was the exception, age was just a number to him, while always going around challenging his limits with no fear of what it might do to his clan.
[No wonder he’s the Invincible Sword, ha-ha.]
He was at least leagues above all the other four so-called strongest in their lands.
The three old timers gawking from the sidelines earned Zhuo Fan’s displeasure.
He was on the four lands’ side, facing off against the Invincible Sword. Yet when it came to respect, he found the enemy far more worthy of it.
It was all due to these ‘mighty’ experts cowering in the face of their enemy, while the Invincible Sword relished the challenge. [That’s what separates the strong from the weak!]
“Propping doors? Sir Zhuo, just what the hell is Devil Mountain even?” Ouyang Lingtian cried in shock.
Zhuo Fan smiled, his focus never leaving the fight that was to commence.
He noticed the Three-headed Crow was shaking, looking just as thrilled.
[The 9th level spiritual beast`wants to put the Invincible Sword’s title to a real test, ha-ha-ha…]
[How foolish.]
Zhuo Fan shook his head and continued to watch.
He shouldn’t be belittling the three, not when they were heroes of their own areas. But now, when life was on the line, in the face of this showdown, they only cared about self-preservation, although quite a logical action too.
While he had no worry since it was all going as planned, the rest were on a razor’s edge, from one situation into another. How could they handle that?
He always emphasized on their toughness and bravery, but he was asking too much from them.
Zhuo Fan emptied his mind then, finding a new world view then and there, opening his eyes.
All were just too focused to notice his changed gaze, with even Zhuo Fan unable to understand what realization he came to…

chapters.title: Chapter 1083 - 1083, Man and Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 1083, Man and Beast
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Whoosh~
Holding the sharp Sundering Sword, Baili Yutian glanced with excitement from the crow to Zhuo Fan below, “Ha-ha-ha, Sir Zhuo, I must thank you for giving me such a great adversary. I’ll be sure to show my appreciation by giving you a proper burial once I slay it and keep your head.”
“I’m humbled, which is why I’ll be sure to gather your pieces and send them back to Sword Star Empire once my spirit animal tears you apart. The least I can do is not let your corpse be ravaged by wild beasts, as a token of our brief friendship, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan looked perky as well.
The two stared at each other and burst out laughing..
The audience was left dumbstruck, none able to understand what was happening, not even the three Sword Kings.
[They both talk about the other’s demise, but what’s the deal with using such a friendly tone?]
What baffled the Sword Kings more was how their Patriarch sounded even genuine. It held no sarcasm, but true in his intent to pay back the favor.
[Who in the world is kind to their victim? Since when is giving them a burial being nice?]
Invincible Sword was just that content with saying such dreadful words, making all others numb.
Ouyang Changqing wanted clarification, “Big brother, were you cursing each other just now?”
“Of course not, we’re just having a friendly chat, finding common ground even.”
“Friendly? Common ground? I don’t see it.” Ouyang Changqing was stumped.
Zhuo Fan sighed, “You haven’t been around much and have no clue about a practitioner’ friendship. Being part of this circle of practitioners, you don’t get to choose. Each of us wants the other dead, driven by our own interests. That, however, doesn’t stop us from having mutual respect as well, showing it by looking after their corpse. This is how you treat an honorable opponent, completely natural.”
“How’s that natural? I didn’t understand any of that?” Ouyang Changqing scratched his head, clueless still.
Ouyang Lingtian took a moment to mule his words and then bowed to Zhuo Fan, “We all admire sir’s conscience!”
“Dad, you got what he said?”
“Of course!”
The three old men laughed, “Practitioners don’t get to choose, ha-ha-ha…”
(StarReader: the author is taking the idiom literally, with the implied meaning that they don’t get to choose where to die or if they get a burial.)
They turned serious then, their smiles falling, turning to the man and beast above with nothing but respect.
Self-preservation no longer dominated their actions, standing tall like a true top expert of their land.
Zhuo Fan nodded.
[No wonder they understand, being the head of their land. A practitioner must be willing to challenge, that’s what makes him a fighter, rather than stretching his time on this earth for as long as he can.]
[They sealed it off in their hearts, sealed themselves from the Dao in the secular world. This may be why their insights in the sacred weapons lack compared to the Invincible Sword. Their hearts were confined with trifles.]
[Now their hearts are open…]
Whoosh~
The Three-headed Crow flapped its huge wings, sending fierce winds around. It then shot for the Invincible Sword, talons at the ready to tear him apart, whistling through the air.
“Patriarch, look out!”
“Rip him apart!”
The Sword Kings cried out while Qiao’er cheered for their house pet. She was getting more than a little kick out of it, seeing Invincible Sword about to get it after picking on her.
Clang!
The Invincible Sword squinted, flicking the sword to block the claw, letting out a grating sound.
The power exerted was absurd, cataclysmic, with Invincible Sword forced back as he defended, his arms bulging from strain and sweat formed on his brow.
Having never seen Patriarch in such difficulty in battle, the Sword Kings were panicking.
The rest, by contrast, were wild with joy. Ouyang Changqing skipped over to Zhuo Fan to exclaim, “Big brother, if you had that precious, you should’ve taken out from the start and saved my dad and others the effort.”
“I wanted to wait for the perfect timing to catch the Invincible Sword by surprise and end him. Now I had no choice but to let them face off.”
Zhuo Fan made up some lie on the spot. He couldn’t outright say.
[I was waiting for both sides to be crippled.]
That would be most rude.
The excuse sounded clever too, with none judging his intellect. After all, he had done all the thinking for them all this time. No matter how suspicious this reason was, since Zhuo Fan said it, they had to believe it. Who here was the Grand Marshal anyway?
Only Ouyang Lingtian and the old timers understood that the war didn’t matter, only this battle.
“Aah!”
A howl echoed as the Invincible Sword tensed his legs and stood firm to stop his retreat.
The Invincible Sword then pushed harder, flinging the humongous bulk of the Three-headed Crow back, making it roll in the air a couple times.
The three pairs of eyes looked back with shock, “You’re quite strong for a human!”
“It speaks, just like that sea demon!” Ouyang Changqing shrieked, “Do all 9th level spiritual beasts speak? Is the sea demon at the same level?”
The other paused then nodded, coming to the same conclusion.
Only Zhuo Fan and Qiao’er knew the reason behind a 9th level spiritual beast could speak, the azure flame enlightened it. As for the sea demon, it was much much worse than a puny spiritual beast.
What did startle Zhuo Fan though, was that the Invincible Sword was able to fight a 9th level spiritual beast evenly. At this level, the beasts were king, not to mention this particular creature was the Kunpeng’s right-hand, a cut above the norm.
Despite it all, the Invincible Sword pushed on.
[Does this mean that the Invincible Sword is at the stage of a Spirit King? He’s not one in the truest sense only because the domain blocks him?]
Zhuo Fan’s mind was calculating and observing.
His power went beyond anything and anyone, yet his cultivation stalled. It did not match the natural order.
[If the Invincible Sword gets any stronger, will the domain press harder on his cultivation?]
If his power overcame the limit of the domain, once he broke through he’d rise above the mortal realm, and he would incur heavenly tribulation.
But with the Sword Sovereign’s inheritance, heavenly tribulation might not mean instant death.
[But then what? Will he remain in the mortal domain or…]
[Was the Invincible Sword the only true talent that reached this point in the long history of the mortal domain? There had to be generations of glorious talents and their centuries-long legends. With how the five divine swords existed since the beginning, the Sword Sovereign’s inheritors couldn’t amount to just these few. So where are they?]
[If they ascended to the Sacred Domain, why hasn’t there been word of any people coming from the mortal domain then?]
Zhuo Fan knew things didn’t add up. The Heavenly Sovereign’s domain wasn’t merely made to trap sacred beasts.
Shriek~
The sudden cry pierced the skies and the ears of everyone.
The Three-headed Crow cried out at the indignity of having a human push it back. Its huge wings sent swirling black winds straight for Baili Yutian.
Any hill or rock in their path were reduced to nothing, the wind holding the power of decay as it ate through anything it touched.
Even the lightning streaking across the skies fared no better, turning the purple hued heavens block from the winds. All felt a sudden chill as it whistled in their ears, their blood running cold.
It was all done to swallow Baili Yutian.
The Sword Kings cried out once more, worried for their Patriarch.
Everyone else was in grave disbelief a Sword King would act like that.
Though it became clear from the display that not even the best in the world might fare better against a 9th level spiritual beast.
As the darkness and the winds surrounded him, the Invincible Sword’s eyes flashed and lightning sparked across the sword…

chapters.title: Chapter 1084 - 1084, Three Sundering Sword Strikes
chapters.content:
Chapter 1084, Three Sundering Sword Strikes
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Three-Heads, be sure to give that old coot a good smacking for me!” Qiao’er cheered from behind Zhuo Fan once she saw the dreadful powers clashing in the sky.
Three-headed Crow turned grim at its master’s order, flapping his wings hard, “Black Astral Wind Annihilation!”
Rumble~
The winds flooded the sky like a stampede, encroaching on Invincible Sword, trapping him within and closing in to seal his fate. The pressure was enough to stick the robe to his body, pushing harder and harder on him. Even his bones were creaking.
“Patriarch!”
The Sword Kings cried out, sweating from worry. Against such power the likes of which they had never seen before, they themselves would’ve died on the spot if they were in the Invincible Sword’s stead right now.
And that was just from the pressure alone. Once the winds truly struck, then their Patriarch…
They grew more restless as fear fed them worst-case scenarios. Their nails dug into their palms, drawing blood without them even knowing.
Ouyang Changqing and the others witnessed such a shocking scene with glee. The Invincible Sword’s legend was about to die.
Only Zhuo Fan and the three old timers were calm.
The end of this fight between the man and beast wasn’t just a mere conclusion to the war, but also the declaration of who stood at the top, who was the strongest.
This was a practitioner’s honor and conviction, something no profane reason could stain. Zhuo Fan felt this on his own skin, thus he watched this fight for no other reason than that.
They all wanted to see the shocking showdown of the strongest, and how far they were from the top.
Cough~
As the power grew more savage in its approach, it caused his old bones to stiffen up. And with any flaring of its aura, pain speared through his whole body.
What was truly astounding was that he was sweating as well. Baili Yutian gnashed his teeth to bear through it, even as he wore an exciting smile and a lively gaze. He did not fear it, but relished it.
[He-he-he, how many years has it been since I felt such pain?]
[This is a battle. This is how I should live, ha-ha-ha…]
Laughing on the inside, Baili Yutian shouted and grip his sword tighter. His whole body shone purple while the Sundering Sword flickered with lightning.
“First of the Three Sundering Sword Strikes, All-conquering!”
Whoosh~
As the black winds were upon him, Baili Yutian’s hand tightened. His bones creaked and his body unleashed surges of lightning. With a sudden shift, a sword wave was unleashed in every direction, sweeping all in its path.
Rumble~
The sky thundered and the earth boiled as everything around quaked. From the Invincible Sword, a powerful purple lightning storm spread out and as it met the black winds, they stalled for a second before decimating the winds.
The purple lightning destroyed everything in its path, retaking back control of the skies, bringing back its purple hues. The terrible lightning slammed from up above, like performing a victory dance.
Bam!
Three-headed Crow was flung back, flipping a dozen times, his eyes wild from shock.
[H-how can a mere human…]
Pa!
It was too soon to be amazed as a sudden explosion came from its body, burning through his feathers. The stench of it filled its nose.
Three-headed Crow was overwhelmed, looking at the wound as it let out black smoke in disbelief.
[A human actually wounded me?]
This was a wound Sundering Sword made. The Invincible Sword used the chance when the black winds were countered to harm him.
The audience gaped at such an outcome. Even the Sword Kings were flabbergast.
They said none could fight a 9th level imperial beast, but now it was wounded. What made it worse was that it came in retaliation from its own attack.
[T-this is outrageous!]
They started off believing Patriarch would have a hard time even escaping the black winds’ attack, since it came from a 9th level imperial beast.
Only to witness the impossible. Patriarch crushed those winds and used the opening to strike back as well, making history.
[The Invincible Sword is worthy of his name!]
The Sword Kings went wild with joy.
[The Patriarch is our damn greatest pride!]
By contrast, Ouyang Lingtian’s group mood sank as they all gave heavy sighs.
[Not even a 9th level imperial beast can deal with the old guy? Is he too strong?]
Zhuo Fan and the old timers were amazed as well, watching on to see how it would end.
Hu~
The Invincible Sword was short of breath, wiping his sweaty brow and looking exhausted from the strain the strike put on him.
He wasn’t worried though, but thrilled, filled with thirst for battle. He got so giddy that he was willing to squeeze the other in a bear hug, if it were a human.
[Brother, what took you so long to see me? Why haven’t we met already? I’ve been so lonely, all by myself for ages, ha-ha-ha…”
Three-headed Crow’s feelings were anything but mutual, wearing a heavy expression. It was a mighty 9th level imperial beast, with the whole mortal domain as its turf. Except for those really exceptional few out there, it feared nothing!
It turned out, however, he got pushed back twice when fighting some average human. The annoyance was turning into hatred.
All spiritual beasts were above humans when it came to power. Spiritual beasts of any grade were seen as either inferior, average or superior. The first two could match a peak human expert, while the superior bests were a cut above even that, able to stand against those truly strong humans.
Three-headed Crow was a 9th level spiritual beast, beyond superior even, the best of the best. Add in Kunpeng’s teachings, it was no longer limited to the mortal domain’s power scale. Logic would say it was second only to the sacred beasts in the mortal domain, and not any human in existence.
Its pride thus could not accept how an inferior human being actually came to harm it. Where would its dignity be among fellow spiritual beasts? And worse, what would it tell Kunpeng?
Had it no pride?
Three-headed Crow was outraged, shaking its heads and glaring at the Invincible Sword with intent to kill.
Spiritual beasts lacked the admiration humans had for true experts.
[You shamed me and now I’ll kill you!]
It was just that simple for beasts.
It was so enraged its fury was just short combusting. Qiao’er, the cute thing, was so considerate she fanned the flames, “Three-heads, if you lose, I’m going to tell the chief. Doesn’t uncle hate letting go of others? He sent you to help yet you come back humiliated. Is there no one under him good at anything? We might as well not even ask for help the next time, let him retire instead.”
Three-headed Crow saw the warning in Qiao’er’s gaze and sighed.
[You are the company you keep. This girl is as twisted as that Zhuo Fan, twisting the knife where it hurts. And hurt, it does.]
Three-headed Crow feared nothing but the sacred beasts. Now Kunpeng sent him on an errand, under another’s command.
[It looks like having this lass fanning the flames will make my life hell.]
[Curse you, spoiled brat, getting so smug for having the Sundering Thunder Phoenix inheritance. Stop playing cute with me, you’re nothing but a 6th level spiritual beast!]
[You dare tell me what to do? Your mom was shivering every time she saw me. Why not me instead?]
[We’re both birds, so why can’t I catch a lucky break? It pisses me off!]
Sighing hard, Three-headed Crow’s mood sank as his thoughts took a worse turn. Though not like it could talk back to her, since things were different now, a reborn phoenix and all that nonsense.
[The lass will soon be just another boss!]
Three-headed Crow’s cold eyes turned to its only target, the Invincible Sword.
[It’s all his fault and today he’ll die…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1085 - 1085, Fatality
chapters.content:
Chapter 1085, Fatality
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Hu~
Three-headed Crow’s azure flame above its forehead flickered wildly like candlelight, its eyes, however, were cold and icy, focused solely on the Invincible Sword who stood across from it.
Picking up on its thirst for his death, Baili Yutian grinned, holding his sword in both hands fully intent to match it with his own lust for battle, “Come, fowl beast, try my second attack of the Three Sundering Sword Strikes!”
“How dare you!”
Three-headed Crow shuddered, shrieking, “A wretched human dares challenge my authority? You have a death wish!”
Three-headed Crow shook and the azure flame on its forehead expanded in size, like an explosion, before shrinking back to cover the crow.
Hu~
With a mighty cry, the crow had turned into an azure firebird. Judging from the pressure increase, it had to be ten times as strong at least.
It left the audience gasping and wide eyed.
Ouyang Changqing and the Sword Kings were equally shocked. The crow was strong enough as it was, yet here it went going even further in displaying its complete superiority over them. The Invincible Sword barely fought back against it the first time, which meant now he would fall short.
Ouyang Changqing and the rest’s faces shone with hope, while the Sword Kings sank in the pits of despair, high strung and worried.
[Patriarch…]
Baili Yutian stared at the huge bird of fire, eyes calm and gesturing, “Come, fowl beast!”
“Pretentious fool!”
Three-headed Crow squinted in anger, shouting as it flapped its wings to rush Baili Yutian, “Human, bear witness to a king’s might, Earth-crushing Claw!”
Whoosh!
As it dived to attack, two claws formed from azure flame, bearing down on Baili Yutian. The air warped as it traveled, giving the illusion that space itself was melting.
The azure claws of fire arrived in an instant, the blistering heat twisting the robe on Baili Yutian, about to burst into flames. Not even the Yuan Qi protecting the best in the world could fend off this deadly fire and its effect.
The Sword Kings were frantic, “What fire is that? Why can’t Patriarch fend off the heat? Once it explodes, then Patriarch…”
A heavy frown set in, their minds filled with disastrous scenarios.
Ouyang Changqing clenched his fists hard, beyond thrilled.
[The old monster is done in at last, ha-ha-ha…]
Zhuo Fan and the old timers remained silent.
“Second sword of the Three Sundering Sword Strikes, Obliterate!
As the fire claws neared, Baili Yutian’s eyes shone and gripped his sword with conviction.
Following his shout, the sword slashed forward with all the might his aged, yet fit, body had to offer.
Whoosh!
Unlike with the previous flashy and spectacular strike, Baili Yutian released a thin sword energy this time. Despite its dull and flat appearance, this sword energy felt to have contained even more power than the last. It was also made evident from Baili Yutian huffing for breath at the exertion.
All looked curious, how could such a plain sword energy take so much out of him.
It was made apparent soon enough.
The sword wave clashed with the flaming claws, with everyone expecting to see nothing more than a blip where the small attack hit the claws, of no effect.
What followed instead was endless explosions as violent lightning ran rampant from within the flaming claws, swallowing them from the inside.
This was just the start. All watched in stunned silence as the tiny sword energy shot in and out of the fire claws, leaving behind a streak of lightning that consumed the skies. Not even the azure flame stood a chance against the ever encroaching purple.
As the lightning grew, the huge flaming claws were swallowed in it, while the sword energy shot through them and for the Three-headed Crow.
[How is this possible?]
Three-headed Crow’s eyes widened from shock. As the purple sword wave came head on, it raised its own fire claw to grab for it.
Rumble~
On contact, the tiny sword wave exploded in a glorious fashion, unleashing a thunderstorm like no other, singeing the crow’s body as it struck and swallowed it.
The startling and frightening explosions that followed only amplified the dread felt from seeing lightning engulf the skies and the humongous crow along with them.
The others stared blankly, incredulous how so much destruction could be packed into something so tiny.
[Why did that old guy’s attack look so plain yet so devastating? Did the 9th level spiritual beast fall for it?]
Zhuo Fan mused and nodded in realization, “So that’s why it’s called Obliterate. All power is focused on one spot followed by a violent release that can submerge and destroy everything.”
(StarReader: He analyzed the individual characters that make up the word. First means bury, cover, submerge etc., while the second means exterminate, destroy, etc.)
“Yes, the Sundering Sword is essentially a tool for pure destruction. The Invincible Sword’s insights are worlds beyond ours.”
Ouyang Lingtian sighed, “Seeing that focused destructive force only proves it, needing an amazing talent to control such wild power. The Invincible Sword is worthy of his name, the peak practitioner.”
The other two nodded with utter calm, despite this meaning that the Invincible Sword won and would spell doom to them all. They had broken off from the mortal affairs, gleaning into the world’s nature.
Whoosh~
A black shadow streaked across the endless lightning above as Three-headed Crow used its powerful bulk to fly out. It had lost its majestic air from before, however, now looking worse for wear.
The only azure flame remaining burning was the feeble mote on the forehead. Even its plumage was singed, stripping away more of a 9th level imperial beast’s prestige.
All of this was caused by one man, the strongest human.
Three-headed Crow felt its entire honor had been dragged through the mud. Its eyes burned with hatred for the old guy, screeching, “Rotten human, you have slighted me for the last time. Now you die!”
Three-headed Crow shot for the Invincible Sword. Its speed belied its now worse state, filled with power and vigor.
Humans had spiritual beasts beaten when it came to smarts, but their bodies were leagues above. It had suffered an affront to his dignity with the Invincible Sword landing two strikes on it, but at the end of it all, the damage it suffered was only skin deep.
The Invincible Sword, instead, was the one who neared exhaustion from those attacks, panting.
This was a gap between spiritual beasts and humans. The spiritual beasts’ bodies were just too damn tough.
Sword Kings knew this too and cried out, “Patriarch…”
Whoosh~
Baili Yutian’s wave cut them off.
Taking deep breaths, he forced himself, although with a pale face and weakened body, to stand tall. He even smiled in excitement, “I have roamed the world undefeated with these three strikes, only ever forced to use the first. Never has the chance presented itself, or required, the use of all three. It’s because no one could take them on. This time, ha-ha-ha, I’m relishing the fact I can use them all. Truly a joy, ha-ha-ha…
“Three-headed Crow, thank you for fulfilling my life-long wish and allowing me to fight with all I have.”
Baili Yutian held his sword, his eyes sharp as he gave an effusive smile, “Third sword of the Three Sundering Sword Strikes, Fatality!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1086 - 1086, Apex Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 1086, Apex Battle
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Whoosh~
The Sundering Sword in the Invincible Sword’s hand flashed purple and lightning snaked its blade. His eyes stared at it, and he started fading in and out of sight right under everyone’s eyes. It gave off the feeling that the world was going along with this strike’s build up.
Ouyang Changqing slapped his head, “What the? What kind of skill is the old guy using? Why is his body warping like that?”
