“One with the sword and nature?” Zhuo Fan cried out, “Baili Yutian’s genius is without equal in this world. His insights in the way of the sword are so great, all he needs is the right cultivation level to ascend…”
“Brother Zhuo, he’s at the top already, what ascending? There’s hardly anyone in the five lands that can match up to him, maybe not even a 9th level spiritual beast…”
“I’m not talking about the lands, but…”
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, shaking his head and letting his voice trail off. Baili Yutian had achieved the peak in terms of swordsmanship, with cultivation being the only thing holding him back from unleashing its full power.
[If he were a Saint right now, he’d already be worthy as the next Sovereign.]
Zhuo Fan was after the same stage as well.
Though the Sovereign Stage was beyond arduous to reach. One not only needed to have adequate cultivation, but also needed insights in a path that made him one with nature.
Many peak Saints had strength while lacking true enlightenment. The Invincible Sword here, had attained the hardest requirement first. All that he needed now was time.
But with the The Ten Paths to Heaven having been taken, no one could become a Sovereign even by having the right to. The world’s nature prevented it. There could never be an influx of true experts, to maintain balance in the world.
For the Invincible Sword to become a Sovereign, he needed to take one off his perch first, the greatest problem for posterity, Zhuo Fan included.
He was after the same stage as well, working hard each day to cover all bases, mental, spiritual and physical. And not just to reach it, but to fight one as well, to steal the throne. The only unknown in his plan was how many Sovereigns were still around in the Sacred Domain and if there were any vacancies. He never heard anything about the ten emperors vanishing while in the Sacred Domain, now even more so.
All he could do was get ready. In case of any challenge that might come, he’d cross that bridge when he got there.
Zhuo Fan kept watching the Invincible Sword, his respect mounting. Anyone qualified to be a Sovereign was a rarity, making it rest heavily on fate whether such fortune might befall you of all people…
Ouyang Lingtian looked startled. The old timers, having trained in the sword, could sense more than any just how incredible the Invincible Sword’s attainment was, never leaving him out of their sights.
Hu~
Sending biting winds, Three-headed Crow charged head on with its sharp claws primed to tear Baili Yutian’s skull off his shoulders.
Baili Yutian heard the whistling of the wind and the sword finally moved. Making a completely plain swing, Baili Yutian faded in and out while lightning exploded as a purple sword wave flew at the Three-headed Crow.
It laughed in mockery, “Ha-ha-ha, have you gone senile, old fool? You saw how your sword energy can’t do anything to me. I easily crushed it last time and now you’re using it again…”
A sudden groan cut him off, followed by spraying blood dyeing the skies red as it powered down like rain.
Three-headed Crow froze, jerking its head to look down in utter shock.
[How…]
The majestic claw that whistled through the air with incredible power, and his pride, was now gone, leaving behind a perfect cut.
The sword energy had robbed it from it.
It was stupefied.
It was a 9th level imperial beast, the toughest there was, yet it just got sliced from some sword energy? It saw his sword energy’s power already too, those previous two strikes hardly did anything to him. So what made this plain sword energy so damn special?
[T-this is just too freaky…]
Three-headed Crow’s six eyes were lost in utter confusion.
Its mind had been made aware and became quite smart as well, perfectly capable of judging when to dodge or not. It never got within the range of the sacred weapon, since it would be easy for it to cause harm. While a human wielded it, any sword energy shouldn’t have… couldn’t…
This was where it was stuck.
Baili Yutian smirked at its conundrum, his body fading out once more as he unleashed another sword energy on its wing.
Whoosh~
Blood gushed once more as a huge wing fell and the Three-headed Crow stood there too shocked to even sense it.
[How…]
“Humph, this strike is called Fatality, meaning demise!”
Baili Yutian grinned, showing his pearly whites, “No matter what I face, I will cut it with Fatality. I am holding the Sundering Sword in my hand, sundering the heavens with it. What else is there that can’t be severed?”
Baili Yutian turned as he shouted, now fading in as he slashed hard at the Three-headed Crow’s head.
“Wait…”
Whoosh!
Three-headed Crow’s eyes were wide with dread, about to beg, but the Invincible Sword’s unstoppable attack had already passed.
The sword wave flitted through it, leaving behind a motionless Three-headed Crow.
Slowly, its huge bulk peeled in two, crashing down on the ground and kicking up a cloud of dust.
The terror in those six eyes was the last expression it had as the azure flame died along with its life.
The apex battle between the strongest human and peak spiritual beast had reached a most shocking conclusion that none saw it coming.
Everyone was too out of it to speak. Ouyang Changqing felt like crying, despair coming crashing down harder after having tasted hope.
[Brother Zhuo even used his last card, a 9th level spiritual beast no less, but this monster just won’t die! Doesn’t this mean it’ll be our turn to kill us?]
The Sword Kings went wild with joy.
Patriarch had crushed a 9th level imperial beast all by himself.
[Amazing! The Invincible Sword’s name will travel the far-reaches of the world, not just among humans, but even among spiritual beasts. Now nothing can stand up to Patriarch.]
[Now this is the true Invincible Sword!]
Zhuo Fan and the old timers weren’t so taken by emotion, looking at the humongous corpse with a heavy heart.
They were not relating its fate with theirs, but weighing the challenging future ahead.
Before them was the peak power across the lands, and also their goal. Even Zhuo Fan was solemnly watching the hovering Invincible Sword above.
[The Invincible Sword, the peak of mortal domain, to think anyone could attain such heights in a limited and barren world. Going further will mean being worthy of the Sovereign Stage.]
[I strive for the Sovereign Stage just as well, and to reach it, I need to get to this level before returning to Sacred Domain. Peak of Genesis Stage, the strongest in mortal domain, that’s the bare minimum if I want to challenge a Heavenly Sovereign when I return.]
Zhuo Fan stared hard at Invincible Sword, an evil grin creeping on his face.
[Invincible Sword, you’ll be my final rival in the mortal domain. The moment I surpass you will be the time I leave this world. I just hope you’ll still be around to be my stepping stone, ha-ha-ha…]
Hu~
Oblivious to Zhuo Fan painting a target on his back, Baili Yutian’s breathing was ragged, paling harder as he became weaker.
Using all three strikes took a toll on his aged body, feeling how much it really was for the first time. But he did not mind it one bit, looking refreshed despite the waned face.
He turned to Zhuo Fan, “Ha-ha-ha, Sir Zhuo, thank you for that, I’ve greatly enjoyed myself. It’s a shame, I ended up winning. So going by our agreement, I’ll be taking that head and burying you.”
Baili Yutian pointed the sword at him with a cold smile. The Sword King flew next to Baili Yutian, looking smug and arrogant.
[Well, now can you face the facts? Humph…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1087 - 1087, Chilling Breeze
chapters.content:
Chapter 1087, Chilling Breeze
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Heart sinking, everyone flinched back from fear, now that this evil was coming for them.
They still gave Zhuo Fan hopeful looks, like looking at their last lifeline to save them from this despair and terror.
[Bro, d-do you have anything else?]
Zhuo Fan muttered under his breath then raised his hands to give a light clap, not looking the least bit terrified like his peers.
Clap~
Ouyang Lingtian and the old timers stood at his side with a grave look, picking up on his intent behind such a gesture.
The Invincible Sword’s brow shook, looking confused.
“Sir, you’re too nice, and the right thing to do is thank you for such a favor.”
The crisp clapping halted and Zhuo Fan said, “Thank you for making us witness such a rare showdown, of letting me peer into the heights of humanity’s cultivation. It allowed me to have a clear goal and for that, you have my deepest gratitude.”
Zhuo Fan leaned and offered a sincere bow. Ouyang Lingtian and the other two followed along.
The Sword Kings’ faces twitched, not getting anything.
[What’s this guy up to this time?]
Ouyang Changqing’s group were dumbstruck, “Big brother Zhuo, dad, what are you all doing? That monster’s here to kill us and you’re here bowing? You should be thinking hard on how to get us out of this mess, for crying out loud…”
“You don’t get it, Changqing!”
Ouyang Lingtian broke the silence, “In our world, practitioners don’t get to choose. Remember that. All our affairs belong to this circle, but as a practitioner, a cultivator, this bow is a tribute to the strong. By not bowing now, then the secular world is holding you back and preventing you from ever reaching the top.”
“We have been around for far too long that we’ve forgotten our initial goal for Dao along the way. Now, having met Sir Zhuo, his actions and words have opened our eyes. People may be practitioners, but their hearts fall behind. We’ve been wrong for too long!”
Murong Lie sighed with wisdom, the trio giving Zhuo Fan another look of respect.
As a fellow cultivator, this young man understood this truth better than these old relics, who’d forgotten. That was why they fell short.
Ouyang Changqing gave them a blank stare, then jerked, recalling the monster hanging over their heads.
The Invincible Sword looked to be sympathizing with them, his gaze showing a rare and calm expression, actually coming to see the four as equals.
This never would’ve happened before.
The Invincible Sword was the best of the best, be it among humans or beast. Who could be his equal? This time, however, he had such a gaze. His Sword Kings were baffled.
Putting away the sword, the Invincible Sword cupped his hands, filled with respect, “I’ve been roaming the lands in solitude, but now I’ve finally met true fellow practitioners. Sir Zhuo especially, so young yet so enlightened to Dao, neither arrogant nor impulsive. You have my respect. It’s a true loss that our intentions align, but not our positions. I am thus forced, by our circle of practitioners, to take your heads. Especially, Sir Zhuo, yours is an absolute must. It has been my greatest fortune to have met you today, Sir Zhuo, but now it’s time to say goodbye…”
Baili Yutian sighed one last time in regret, but then his eyes steeled, pointing the sword at Zhuo Fan with the intent to end him.
Ouyang Changqing was on the verge of crying.
He still thought Zhuo Fan was taking the refined approach with the Invincible Sword, appealing to his heroism to instill fondness in another hero so they’d all make up in the end. The thing was, the old freak was buying it.
That was until he flipped and drew his sword.
[Brother Zhuo, he ruined your last feelings, so what do we do now? If only I knew this, I wouldn’t have complimented him and just died. Now I’m not just ashamed but also getting killed.]
How could he possibly understand these true practitioners’ feelings? At the very least, they were all clear on their grudges and affairs, public and private, and respect had no part in this at all.
By refusing to admit the opponent’s strength, you yourself would never grow either. Your potential would be crushed by your own denials.
Easier said than done, such people being rarities.
As Zhuo Fan took the lead, Ouyang Lingtian and the old timers realized this truth as well, earning them the Invincible Sword’s own respect as well, but also fueling his desire to kill Zhuo Fan.
He knew the youth would soar and one day would threaten him.
He might be searching for a good opponent, but finding one with the potential only filled him with fear. He had to snuff it out.
A human heart was wrecked with contradictions and dissonance, something not even the best could escape from.
The Invincible Sword’s sword lifted, humming softly, the eulogy of all here into hell.
Ouyang Lingtian was wounded heavily, but felt no fear, pointing his sword at the sky.
The old timers were finally doing this not for anyone else, neither to defend, but to challenge the very top, for their own path forward.
A Dao heart warded all fears, for having the world within, one understood all.
Here and now, the top of their respective land finally showed the strength they should have. The Sword Kings could even sense the trio’s change, despite how weakened they were. It was as if energy gathered around them from the world, the same with Patriarch.
[Their hearts… had grown…]
The Sword Kings’ brows tense, hearts sinking.
[They must die here and now, before they grow so strong they might even surpass Sword Kings.]
[They have to die now, to avoid a worse future.]
Ouyang Changqing was clearly blind to the change, sweating buckets.
[There’s no way three wrecked people can defeat that monster.]
[It’s over, this is the end…]
“Wait!”
The one-sided battle was on the cusp of igniting when Zhuo Fan shouted, “Sir, I recommend you don’t take it further and just fall back!”
“Afraid, is it?”
“Ha-ha-ha, not fear, but reluctance.”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “I didn’t care much about your fate so far, but seeing your battle made me realize that you’re an opponent I’ll have to take down myself. My strength is lacking now, so I’d like for you to keep living, for when I personally come to challenge you. I’d hate to end you now.”
Baili Yutian started, then cracked up, “Sir Zhuo, you sure know how to speak in riddles. Not even I understand you. If you have the power now, why wait to kill me? If you do not, why then speak of wanting my life? Why on earth would I let you go just to bring me more trouble?”
“Sir Invincible Sword, there’s nothing conflicting about it.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “I want your life, but would hate to do it any other way than with my own fist. It would rob both of us of an enjoyable battle. So I say sir should save his energy, to let us live so that we may settle our fight fair and square. The winner enters Devil Mountain and the loser will be buried in the dirt.”
The Invincible Sword’s eyes shook as he cried out, “Devil Mountain? Aren’t you part of it? Why would you want to enter it?”
“To be frank, I came from Devil Mountain, but can’t return due to lack of strength.”
Shaking his head, Zhuo Fan opened his heart to the one opponent he recognized, “Sir, the five lands are tiny. Only when entering Devil Mountain will you know the true world of the strong. There’s an endless amount of others above you. Though when it comes to talent, there are rarities. All you need now is a way in. On the day of our battle, you’ll get your ticket. If I fail, it proves I’m not worthy to return, you are doing it for me.”
Baili Yutian was plagued with indecision.
Baili Yuyun urged, “Patriarch, the punk’s words are poison. One minute he says he’s from Devil Mountain, the other that he can’t return. What kind of sect wouldn’t allow the return of their disciples? He knows he’s on death’s door and clings to anything to fool us into letting him live. You mustn’t let him get to you!”
Baili Yutian glared at Zhuo Fan, though deciding still came hard.
“Devil Mountain is filled with experts?”
“Beyond anything you can imagine.” Zhuo Fan nodded, looking nervous as he recalled those days, “There’s no end to their legends. Your strength could hardly even qualify. The Dragon Breath Pill sir calls it a toy, ha-ha-ha, well, it’s even less than one in Devil Mountain. But I have something way better, something that would scatter your ashes in the wind. Would sir like to see?”
Baili Yutian stared hard, unable to say a word.
It was then that a thick fog spread from the sea inland, carrying biting cold winds…

chapters.title: Chapter 1088 - 1088, Ice Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 1088, Ice Mountain
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Patriarch, the punk is only trying to confuse us!”
Baili Yuyun spoke at once, seeing Baili Yutian sinking in contemplation, “The Devil Mountain may be as terrible as he pictures it, but why then is he taking such careful steps with us? Why hasn’t Devil Mountain sent even one elder to guard him? It doesn’t add up. Is the sect that confident their disciple can roam the world all alone? Even as training, there should at least be some hidden guardian watching over him. Here he is, on his last leg yet we see no trace of anyone coming to shield him.”
“Are you saying there’s no Devil Mountain?”
“Exactly, or even if there is, it can’t be as ridiculous as he makes it sound like.”
Baili Yuyun nodded, staring confidently at Baili Yutian, “Patriarch, you’ve been roaming the lands for millennia and yet didn’t catch a word of something so overblown. As sir is the pinnacle of the five lands, if you don’t know its secrets, then no one does. The greatest doubt comes from this kid, being the only one who spread the so-called legend of Devil Mountain. He’s its only disciple we’ve seen for thousands of years. Isn’t that the least bit strange? How can it be just one training outside in all these years? For this reason I chose to cut in. It’s nothing more than a huge lie cooked up by this guy alone to fool all heroes and cover his back.”
The Invincible Sword’s brow trembled, his face sinking as he glared at Zhuo Fan.
“Quite right, Sir Zhuo, how is it you’re the only one from Devil Mountain in all these years? Are you lying to me?”
The Invincible Sword roared as his fury was evident in his sharp stare, along with the thirst for blood.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, sighing, presenting the Thunder Ring, “Since sir doesn’t believe it, there’s no avoiding a fight. It pains me being forced to end such a good future opponent like this, but it is what it is…”
With regret on his face, Zhuo Fan’s eyes went cold as his ring released a scorching and wild power.
The others’ hearts jumped in their chest knowing a fight would break out. Their fists clenched, their brows sweaty.
None knew just how effective the calm Zhuo Fan was in dealing with the best there was. Anything that might reveal it to be all a lie would doom them all.
The Invincible Sword mocked the energy his ring released, “Again with the Dragon Breath Pill? Doesn’t your family have any other toys? It’s nothing to me!”
“Yes, a Dragon Breath Pill indeed, although mine is leagues beyond that of Qiao’er. Sir better watch it.” Zhuo Fan had a smile plastered on his face in complete confidence.
[Again with the lying? You sure know how to act, humph.]
There was nothing on Zhuo Fan telling the Invincible Sword this was all a ruse, but he still wasn’t buying it.
He was utterly convinced Zhuo Fan was bluffing, so he might as well finish this already.
Well of course there were no tells to Zhuo Fan’s acting, since all Zhuo Fan told was the truth.
The instant he struck, there would be no trace of the old man behind.
Baili Yutian chose to listen to his suck-up adviser instead, now set on marching to his doom as he was ready to strike with the divine sword.
Zhuo Fan’s ring flashed brighter and hotter as a consequence.
To the unsuspecting old man, this fight about to begin, if one could call it that, was a foregone conclusion.
But could anyone from the mortal domain take on the full might of a Dragon Breath Pill? Not likely, even if that someone was the Invincible Sword himself.
Hu~
The wind picked up around them, stronger and stronger, the cold seeping into their bones and making all shiver, even the Invincible Sword.
[That’s cold!]
The experts gasped in confusion. As Sword King level experts, mere cold was a thing of the past, so how come a light breeze got them shivering?
The Invincible Sword was frowning hard, pausing his attack.
“Damn it, he’s here!”
Ouyang Lingtian was the only one aware of the situation, his face filled with fear and shaking like a leaf.
Everyone’s eyes were on him.
[He wasn’t scared when facing the Invincible Sword so how come he’s panicking now?]
[What out there could be more scary than the Invincible Sword?]
Ouyang Changqing glanced at his dad and asked, “Dad, who are you talking about?”
Ring~
The four divine swords present began to shake in their grasps, in excitement and battle hungry. They were moving so hard they almost flew off.
Everyone looked wide eyed at the wild divine sword swords, with Baili Yutian the most shocked of all, “What’s going on? What did you do to the Sundering Sword?”
“No one touched it, not while you’re holding it!” Ouyang Lingtian struggled to get Heaven Sealing Sword under control while rolling his eyes, “It’s him, the monster is here!”
“Who?” Everyone cried back.
“North Sea’s overlord, the sea demon!” Ouyang Lingtian turned in the sea’s direction, watching as the thick fog engulfed the Sea Bright Sect. Cracking ice was heard as the cold spread and grew stronger, covering half the sect in a thick layer, while the black fog prevented anyone from peering through it. And it was still going.
“Damn, that monster would never attack our sect, not while the barrier was in place. With it gone, he just showed up instantly?”
All turned north as well, looking startled and shocked. The Invincible Sword was the only one excited, “Ha-ha-ha, North Sea’s sea demon’s reputation precedes him. I’ve always wanted to meet him. I wonder if he’ll fare any better than the 9th level imperial Three-headed Crow.”
[By all means, go for it if you have a death wish!]
Zhuo Fan knew the truth and rolled his eyes. Even so, he gazed at the fog hard, sharing a look with Qiao’er. They both shot into the black fog.
[Heaven Sealing Sea Ao, here I come!]
“Sir Zhuo, don’t!” Ouyang Lingtian cried out, but father and daughter ignored him.
The Invincible Sword followed right after Zhuo Fan.
“Patriarch!” The Sword Kings shouted this time around, though he wasn’t one to listen on a good day, let alone now.
The black mist swallowed the Invincible Sword in seconds, leaving the worried Sword Kings behind.
“Brother Yun, what do we do?”
The other two turned to their elder.
Baili Yuyun thought hard and then flew in the Invincible Sword’s direction, “Our duty is to protect the Patriarch!”
“Yes!”
The others nodded and followed him into the encroaching blackness.
Ouyang Changqing’s team was stumped. What now? Their enemies just ran off.
Having lost their target, they just stood there lost, without meaning or purpose.
Ouyang Lingtian, the only one knowledgeable here, looked at the swiftly encroaching darkness and said, “Don’t just stand there and flee! Once the mist takes you, there’s no escape.”
“Then brother Zhuo…”
“Sir Zhuo came to the North Sea for the sea demon. The rest is up to him!” Ouyang Lingtian sighed and turned to the juniors, “Go, I’ll use the Heaven Sealing Sword to stop the black mist from taking you! The sea demon is unlike the Invincible Sword, harder than you will ever know, now run!”
Ouyang Lingtian carried his wounded body as he flew for the black mist.
“Father!” Ouyang Changqing cried out, but he was gone.
The other two old timers shared a nod and spoke as they flew, “We’ll lend brother Ouyang a hand. All of you need to leave!”
“Brother!” Murong Xue shouted after him, but darkness already took him.
The juniors looked at each other with clenched teeth, resolved to run away.
They could not let their seniors’ effort go in vain.
Zhuo Fan felt like he entered a new world, one of snow, ice and water.
“Is this Ice Mountain?” Zhuo Fan was stern as mist formed while he was speaking.

chapters.title: Chapter 1089 - 1089, Heaven Sealing Sea Ao
chapters.content:
Chapter 1089, Heaven Sealing Sea Ao
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
There were large swells turned into icy peaks as far as the Qiao’er’s eyes could see. She rubbed her freezing arms and said, “Father, is this Sea Ao’s world, Ice Mountain?”
“It’s one of the three deadly danger zones that takes most lives!”
He turned his eyes from the white skies and the constant snowfall, to clear frozen sea, like a huge mirror. It glimmered with a mesmerizing luster, hiding the horrors beneath, of the thousands upon thousands of frozen bodies, contorted and appalling.
“Dragon Ancestor was right, Sea Ao hates humanity to the bone. Any man-eating beast would just be following its nature and not toy with humans for one’s twisted amusement. His heart is so sick it makes me wonder if he’ll even let us talk.”
“Father, don’t forget about me. I’m no human. He’s bound to listen to me, he-he-he…” Qiao’er stuck out her head, putting on a cutely smug look.
A creepy cackle echoed all around them in reply, “Hi-hi-hi, all flee at the sign of my coming, yet you just came straight for me. Is it bravery, or recklessness? It turns out that you knew my nature and came to find me. You also know the old dragon, I take it. He-he-he, this should be good.”
The two jerked and perked up as they nodded.
They figured it had to be Heaven Sealing Sea Ao who spoke to have mentioned dragon ancestor like that. It showed some kind of friendship there.
[Maybe this won’t be too hard.]
Since he came with words and not to attack, negotiations were still on the table.
“Senior Sea Ao, I am Zhuo Fan. I have come at Dragon Ancestor’s recommendation to ask senior’s help in saving my son. You will have my eternal gratitude!” Zhuo Fan cupped his hands at the sky.
Sea Ao let another cackle, followed by his eerie voice, “Saving? Hi-hi-hi, why should I? If Dragon Ancestor sent you, then you know humans have cut me deeper than I could heal. Now a human has me trapped in this place, fearful of leaving lest the five swords turn me into a sieve. I and humanity are mortal enemies. No amount of killing will ever quench my hatred. And you came to me for help? What a cosmic joke, ha-ha-ha…”
“No no no, senior Sea Ao, he is no human, but my brother!” Qiao’er rushed to explain.
Sea Ao taunted, “He-he-he, thanks for reminding me, girl. Weren’t you saying just moments ago that I’m bound to listen to you? You sure are cheeky, I’ll give you that, ha-ha-ha. Do enlighten me then, where does that confidence stems from, when we don’t even knowing each other? Old dragon might’ve sent you, but that’s no guarantee if I’ll agree, humph.”
“Uh, senior Sea Ao, I’m the future Thunder Phoenix. We’re the same, you and I. Help me now and I’ll return the favor.”
Qiao’er’s cheeks went red, pondering for a moment before taking a soft approach, “In this vast world, there’s only five of us sacred beasts. We need to unite against the rampant humans.”
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao was silent.
But then it cakcled again, “Little Thunder Phoenix, you only got Thunder Phoenix’s legacy and had yet to fill her shoes. You certainly have no shame, calling yourself a sacred beast so soon. A sacred beast is the strongest beast. You, on the other hand, have a long way to go. All you have now is talent, yet you already see yourself on top? He-he-he, that’s not a sacred beast’s style. It’s more accurate to say it stinks of human cunning. You have gotten too close to them and have taken their foul demeanor. And you dare call yourself a sacred beast? Humph!”
Qiao’er’s heart shrank, turning to Zhuo Fan and shrugging.
“Little Thunder Phoenix, you came at the recommendation of the old dragon, but did he tell you to use his name when asking for my help?” Sea Ao roared.
Zhuo Fan and Qiao’er shook their heads, “Senior Dragon Ancestor knows senior Sea Ao’s deep and bitter hatred towards humans and wouldn’t wish to force senior into anything that you might be against. My only hope is that senior would appeal to our honesty and help us.”
“Shut it! Don’t use human conscience on sacred beasts. You know nothing about us!”
Zhuo Fan’s smooth words only earned Sea Ao’s lashing, “Among the five great sacred beasts, I’m the closest to old dragon, but that doesn’t mean I’ll ever agree to any of his request. Do you know why?”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, looking worried.
“Humph, for we, sacred beasts, are the peak of this world. We aren’t like humans, living in societies, but roaming the lands by ourselves. There’s nothing holding us together. The only reason old dragon sent you to me is because I can help, and not because he can persuade me to. The other four are no different. No appeal to our conscious will work, because we don’t have one. Only humans, like you, small and weak, live through working together for the betterment of the group. For any one of you alone in this vast world is doomed to die. Strength comes from solitude, with no friends or companions.”
Zhuo Fan heard Sea Ao’s fervent speech and the fury behind as he continued, “Little Thunder Phoenix, your tactic of warming up to me for your own goal is precisely how humans operate and not like us sacred beasts. You’re not fit to be a sacred beast, one tainted by humanity such as you. Thunder Phoenix’s spirit would be furious to know her legacy befell onto some human in beast clothing. I’ll even bet she’d snap your neck!”
Bloodlust spiked then, flooding this world. The biting chill made even Qiao’er shiver in fear.
Sea Ao wanted to kill her.
Qiao’er wobbled back while Zhuo Fan flashed in front to protect her.
Things were far worse than he thought.
[Sea Ao’s hatred for humanity consumed him to the point he’ll kill even sacred beasts with human air around them.]
[He can’t tolerate anything that has to do with humans, turning into a bigger problem.]
If it was just human hatred, any bloodlust would’ve been focused on Zhuo Fan, but he now included all related to humans as well.
[That includes Qiao’er and young Sanzi, the one in desperate need of his healing. This is a serious problem with no answer. Should I leave young Sanzi in his care?]
Zhuo Fan was conflicted.
Sea Ao roared once more and Zhuo Fan froze. Then the Sea Ao laughed, sounding nice for once, “Ha-ha-ha, scared you, didn’t I? Did you find my words frightening?”
Zhuo Fan had no idea what he was up to.
“Little Thunder Phoenix, I’ve only been telling you of how a sacred beast acts and hope you won’t go against it. Otherwise, it won’t matter much, since you can do whatever. That’s how impulsive sacred beasts are, ha-ha-ha…”
Laughing like a madman, Qiao’er shivered in frights. Sea Ao then changed subjects, “Who are you trying to save anyway? Mind letting me have a look at him?”
Zhuo Fan and Qiao’er shared a glance and the former touched his ring hesitantly.
Sea Ao read him like a book, smiling, “Worried about little old me? Ha-ha-ha, you should. I’m at bitter war with humanity and won’t be caught dead helping a human. But like little Thunder Phoenix said, we’re sacred beasts and there’s only five of us in the entire world. We only have each other, like family, with every loss a heavy burden. When family comes asking for help, I’m duty-bound to help. That’s what I get for being your uncle, of sorts, ha-ha-ha…”
“Father, will you entrust brother’s life to me?”
Qiao’er turned to Zhuo Fan, “He is the only one that can save brother. We have to trust him. I can tell from his words that he’s sincere.”
[You call that sincere? Did he not just use your own approach, after talking you down even?]
Zhuo Fan squinted, not following her request.
Sea Ao mocked, “Ha-ha-ha, humans and their suspicions. They came to ask for help yet still don’t trust you. So many years have gone yet they never change. Humph, you can distrust me all you like, but since old dragon sent you, I won’t make it harder on you. Go ahead and leave.”
With a humm, the space warped and a gap formed in the black mist behind the two, leading outside.
Getting in was easy, while leaving was at Heaven Sealing Sea Ao’s whim. By doing this, he also showed the two he was of no threat to them.
“Father!”
Qiao’er turned her hopeful eyes on him. This was a rare chance that might never come again.
Sea Ao’s domain roamed, unlike dragon ancestor’s, drifting about North Sea. How were they to find him again?
[He can also avoid us as well, making our search pointless.]
This was the best chance to negotiate with Sea Ao, maybe the only one…

chapters.title: Chapter 1090 - 1090, Malice
chapters.content:
Chapter 1090, Malice
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Hu~
A huge bird of hundreds of meters was perched on a cliff in Allbeast Mountain Range, black as night and eyes like ice. On its head was a mote of azure flickering about, the Chaos Flame. Such a beast was being deferential.
A tall man stood before it, taking his finger out of the azure flame, none other than Vaulting Kunpeng.
Cough~…
The huge bird coughed twice, then tested its human speech. Its eyes shone with joy, its face smiling as it bowed before the man, “Thank you, master, for imparting me your wisdom. I shall never forget such kindness.”
“I’m only doing this because I have a certain need for you.”
Kunpeng sighed, “Midnight War Owl, you’re a 9th level imperial beast like Three-heads and I’ve been considering you along with it when I chose my aide. Now you shall represent me when leading the beasts.”
Shivering, Midnight War Owl looked baffled, “M-master, brother Three-heads said he’ll be back soon. When it sees me, it…”
“Ha-ha, what a good friend you are…”
Kunpeng shook his head, “It won’t be joining us, I fear. That’s why I had you take his place…”
“Then brother…”
“The azure flame I give you is my seal. I know its condition better than anyone. That old Sea Ao spared no pretense, even taking down my aide. Then again, old dragon should feel the same thing about me, ha-ha-ha…”
Kunpeng paced around, turning to watch the clear moon hanging high in the sky. The thought of someone from the mortal domain making away with Three-heads never crossed his mind, not since it was a 9th level imperial beast he raised, pinning all the blame on Sea Ao.
“War Owl, Sea Ao used to be the simplest and closest to humans among us five sacred beasts. But with deeper ties, the cut is deep once broken. He gave his sincerity and was rewarded with betrayal. Now his heart is filled with hatred, a malice he can’t ever let go of. Zhuo Fan stands no chance in talking any sense to a vindictive lunatic. Ha-ha-ha, my own envoy got killed even. Now they only have themselves to rely on.”
Kunpeng’s eyes had a strange glimmer as he watched the moon.
War Owl sighed at the demise of his brother. it turned to the moon as well, its gaze ladened with the pain of loss and just a glimmer of hope.
[Three-heads died in this mission. I only hope it is completed so its death won’t be in vain.]
It prayed for Zhuo Fan to pull through.
The bright moon glow basked every corner of Allbeast Mountain, as well as the chaotic war near the North Sea. It sent the prayer deep into the black fog and onto a pensive man.
[Should I trust him or not?]
Zhuo Fan was thinking hard on his decision, looking from the exit of Sea Ao’s domain to Qiao’er’s hopeful eyes.
It might very well be his hardest decision yet.
Facing a totally unfamiliar and untrustworthy opponent, he had no leverage to lean on, no control. Any choice had a real chance of ruining everything.
By distrusting Sea Ao, he and Qiao’er would only avoid the problem, with a high chance of breaking it off with Sea Ao here and now, never to meet again and leaving young Sanzi helpless.
But by giving young Sanzi to him, Sea Ao might take its fury and malice on young Sanzi. Zhuo Fan had heard it loud and clear, the true feelings Sea Ao’s earlier speech contained.
Zhuo Fan was at an impasse, unable to see any viable option.
“Kid, I see you’re hesitating so I won’t force you. You can go.”
“Father!”
Sea Ao urged and Qiao’er was being impatient.
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shot open just then and young Sanzi’s unconscious form appeared in this world of ice. He wore a gentle smile, free of pain and suffering.
“Senior Sea Ao, he is Qilin’s son. I ask senior to lend aid in saving his life. I will be eternally grateful!”
“Qilin? How did his son become yours?” Sea Ao’s voice echoed from all directions in surprise.
Zhuo Fan cupped his hands, “He is my godson and we depend on each other.”
“Humph, godson?”
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao mocked, “You even took him in. I can overlook taking the girl with the Thunder Phoenix’s legacy, but now you have a true Qilin as godson? Planning on rearing them so you can one day rule the world? He-he, you sure know how to curry favor, taking them under your wing at their worst for you to use great sacred beasts when you need it most. You’re the most deceitful human I’ve ever seen.”
Zhuo Fan did not refute, nodding, “Yes, those were my thoughts as well.”
“Were? Don’t tell me they’re gone now.”
“They are my son and daughter, nothing more.”
“Lies!”
Sea Ao howled, “There’s no wretched being out there as humans. They’ll even turn on their flesh and blood, let alone others. You took them in so you can use them!”
Zhuo Fan chuckled and shook his head, “I won’t deny it. I had that idea. As a family, children ought to obey their parents, no? By not letting them come to danger and being close to one another, our bond as father and son remains close, and also virtuous. I don’t hurt them but give them my love and care, completely worth it.”
“Bullshit, you’re just using them!”
The air shimmered and rumbling of avalanches were heard. Sea Ao was mad, “Cunning human, you have nothing but excuses. Using such cheap love on sacred beasts like us is utterly vile!”
Qiao’er was about to argue when Zhuo Fan shook his head to stop her.
Zhuo Fan went on, casually, “Senior Sea Ao has been around since antiquity but still can’t see that the world is always in balance? Even when it comes to love, I gave them a family, a father. It’s only natural to give their lives in exchange. Now’s no different. Save the Qilin and I am yours to send on any task senior Sea Ao wishes without so much as a complaint.
“Sir is now stuck in this place, like a prisoner. But worry not, I have the solution. It won’t be long before the mortal domain will be broken and get you free. Seniors Kunpeng and Dragon Ancestor are behind me all the way as well. You may distrust me, but what about them?”
“Rotten human, always looking to bargain. Those old fools must be blind to put their trust in a bastard like you. I won’t make that mistake. I never trusted a human again, not since I have been imprisoned here.
Following the roar, a deep cold shot for Zhuo Fan’s head.
Qiao’er shot to defend him but something slammed into her and was flung a mile away.
Hu~
Biting and icy winds whistled past Zhuo Fan. Qiao’er flipped four times before she could stop, looking stunned at the sight.
Zhuo Fan was encased in ice, frozen and dead. There was no sign of life coming from him. He was stuck with his arm out, like all those stiff bodies trapped in the ice below them.
“Father…”
Qiao’er muttered, then wailed at the top of her lungs, “Father!”
Zhuo Fan was deaf in the block of ice, his eyes blank, his face flat.
“Hi-hi-hi…”
Sea Ao cackled from all around, “It’s no use, little Thunder Phoenix. When I seal a human, even their souls are trapped. He’s no different from a corpse, unable to see or hear. With time, his life will ebb, turning into another one of my samples, hi-hi-hi…”
“Damn it! Heaven Sealing Sea Ao, give my father back now!”
Qiao’er shook from pain, her heart torn. Rage took her then as she roared at the air, “Harm him in any way and I vow to take your life!”
“Hi-hi-hi, how spunky!”
Sea Ao patronized, “Little Thunder Phoenix, I can squash you as easy as a bug the way you are now. But even in your prime, no sacred beast can beat another anyway, ha-ha-ha…”
“Why you…”
“However…”
Sea Ao switched tunes when she began, “You have a choice. Didn’t you come to save the young Qilin? You now get to decide who lives and dies, the human or the Qilin? Hi-hi-hi…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1091 - 1091, Choice
chapters.content:
Chapter 1091, Choice
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
[What?!]
Qiao’er shuddered, looking between Zhuo Fan’s frozen figure in ice and young Sanzi on the snow, barely breathing.
“He-he-he, what’s there to think about, little Thunder Phoenix?”
Sea Ao’s bewitched, “You said it yourself, there are only five great sacred beasts, that we’re a family. The Qilin will die along with this young Qilin. While this filthy human has been using you. It’s obvious then. You only have to nod and I will make mince meat out of his corpse. Then the Qilin can be saved, ha-ha-ha…”
Qiao’er gave a stiff shake, her eyes turning red as she choked, “No, he’s my father. I don’t want him to die.”
“I take it you’ll be saving the human over the Qilin?”
Sea Ao’s snicker once again echoed, having a blast in her torment and weaving deceit, “Then take the human while I’ll have young Qilin for dinner, he-he-he…”
“How could you? You’re a sacred beast too. How can you harm brother…”
“And you aren’t? Why then do you choose a human over him?”
“I…”
Qiao’er was stuck, unable to reply as she looked between her father and brother with pain and sorrow.
Whoosh~
Four figures then flashed in her eyes, led by the best in mortal domain, the Invincible Sword.
Looking at the prevalent white and the boundless ice, Baili Yuyun was baffled, “That’s strange, we’ve been running around the mist forever. Where did we end up this time? Why is there a world in the black mist? Patriarch, do you know anything about this place?”
“It feels familiar. I seem to have heard about it once.”
Baili Yutian frowned, looking just as puzzled at the ice and snow, but then he noticed someone.
He shot straight for Qiao’er with Sword Kings in tow.
“Lass, why are you alone? Where’s Sir Zhuo?”
Qiao’er’s lip quivered, pointing with bleary eyes and a frail voice, “There.”
The four flinched as they saw Zhuo Fan encased in ice.
[What on earth? What happened to Sir Zhuo? And…]
They then looked down and noticed the sea ice below them holding scores of bodies.
Baili Yuyun turned to Qiao’er in panic, “Girl, you wanted to come here, right? Then you must know where we are!”
“D-dad called it Ice Mountain.” Qiao’er strained to speak through her pain, “It’s what everyone is calling it.”
[One of the three danger zones, Ice Mountain?]
Sss~
Baili Yuyun gasped, his heart stuck in his throat as the news scared the life out of him.
Anyone knew that no one came out of the three danger zones alive, and now they ran into one.
The three Sword Kings were now tearing up as well, lamenting their fate. That was why the brash and cocky lass turned so meek and distraught. Anyone would cry in this heaven forsaken place.
The Invincible Sword found his predicament amusing though, “Ha-ha-ha, I’ve been roaming around for thousands of years and yet never stumbled upon any danger zone, only now ran into it. Though what makes this place so bad to be called a danger zone?”
“Lass, what’s so dangerous about it?”
Baili Yuyun got the hint and turned to ask Qiao’er. In such a bad place, being in the dark as to what might attack them was the biggest danger.
Qiao’er sniffed, pointing at Zhuo Fan.
In other words, ‘that’s the danger, so watch it.’
Baili Yuyun bobbed his head and asked, “How did Sir Zhuo turn up like that?”
From the looks of it, the Ice Mountain made it very easy for one to end up sealed.
[The problem is how.]
Qiao’er was the only one to see it happen to Zhuo Fan and so the Sword Kings got over their rivalry and asked.
“Humph, it’s obviously the work of that wretched Heaven Sealing Sea Ao!”
“Heaven Sealing Sea Ao, the hell is that?”
“The North Sea demon.” Qiao’er rolled her eyes with a huff.
The three exclaimed.
[The sea demon sealed the crafty punk!]
Baili Yutian’s eyes shone, the thirst for battle reignited. he looked around and shouted, “Sea demon, I’ve long heard of you and have come for a challenge!”
“Patriarch…”
The Sword Kings looked tense at Invincible Sword, sweat trickling down their brow.
The sea demon was famed for its savagery and challenging it before knowing its strength was ill-advised.
[Patriarch, you just finished fighting a 9th level imperial beast and are exhausted. You’ll only be worse for wear if it turns out the sea demon is to be at the same level.]
[Best you rest a couple of days then challenge again for best chances…]
The strong had a powerful drive to challenge the stronger. The Invincible Sword was called such because he had been through countless deadly fights, but always prevailing.
Where was the challenge in fighting a winning battle?
The old guy had a nasty temper too, eager to throw himself into the fray against the sea demon, regardless of its power, “Sea demon, I’m the strongest in the five lands, the Invincible Sword. Show yourself now, or are you afraid? Ha-ha-ha, then you should be running back to the sea, not coming to shore!”
“Hi-hi-hi, yokels are the most ignorant.”
Sea Ao’s creepy voice crackled, “I’d have turned all you humans to pieces if it weren’t for that heaven-sealing barrier. Now someone comes to run their mouths? You have a death wish!”
Baili Yutian’s eyes shone, resolved to fight no matter what, “Anyone can talk, but hardly anyone can put their money where their mouth is and fight me. Stop hiding like a coward and yap along. That’s the way of the weak!”
“You call yourself strong? Hi-hi-hi…”
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao laughed louder, “Foolish human, if you’re strong, the crickets and bugs ought to kill themselves in shame, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Yutian turned cold, brandishing the Sundering Sword as he shouted, “Sea demon, enough talking. Show your face if you dare, so I can kill you!”
“The Sundering Sword?”
The sea demon cried, “So that’s why, you’re the Sundering Sword’s successor.”
Baili Yutian spoke coldly, “I’ve been using the Sundering Sword’s art for thousands of years, reaching perfection. Scared?”
“Ha-ha-ha, scared? That swordsmanship can’t harm me. The scared one should be little Thunder Phoenix. The five sacred weapons might look intimidating but they hold no sway in my domain. Human, you shouldn’t have brought it along, hi-hi-hi…”
Baili Yutian was perplexed.
“He-he-he, so you don’t know. The sword is divine, but your strength is unable to unleash its potential. For the divine swords to restrain us, they need sacred stones. Now, you no longer have that chance!”
“What’s that supposed to mean?”
Baili Yutian shouted.
Rumble~
The world shook and the distant mountains of ice and snow crumbled. It was like an omen, that a demon was clawing its way out of hell.
“You’ll be staying here, along with the sword, hi-hi-hi…”
The rumbling grew more intense, like the world was about to crumble. Even Baili Yutian began to sweat, his heart seizing.
Outside the domain, Ouyang Lingtian, Murong Lie and Shangguan Feixiong used their divine swords as lanterns to ward off the black mist that prevented them from advancing, each shining in its own light.
The three had red faces and gnashed their teeth, their body stretched taut as they strained themselves.
With a sudden boom, the entire mist exploded, the shockwave flung back the trio and shook their insides till they coughed blood. The divine swords fell from their hands and into the mist.
“Our swords!”
They cried to no avail. The swords were gone and they were too weak to chase. They were helpless to even stop the shockwave from sending them into buildings until they fainted…

chapters.title: Chapter 1092 - 1092, Welsher
chapters.content:
Chapter 1092, Welsher
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Boom~
Everything shook around Baili Yutian, making him grip the divine sword harder while looking on edge as he scanned all around him for anything suspicious.
It had been thousands of years since the last time he felt like a prey, like he entered a hunter’s domain. This was exactly what he felt from the sea demon, making him both nervous and excited, but most of all, thrilled.
[This is too damn nerve-wrecking!]
While he relished in the challenge, the Sword Kings weren’t so quick to agree.
[Just how absurd this sea demon is to make such a scene? Too much and that’ll mean we’re just throwing our lives away.]
Wiping their sweaty brows, the Sword Kings felt for the first time like they were in the eyes of a hunter, making their blood run cold.
[This is too damn dangerous!]
Qiao’er had a deep frown, still overwhelmed by Sea Ao’s choice to the point she blocked off what happened around her.
Boom~
The intense rumbling only got Baili Yutian to be more tense.
With one more explosion that wrecked the skies, followed by a deluge of snow and ice on top of them.
Baili Yutian’s heart jumped and rushed to dodge one particular hunk of ice while using the Sundering Sword to fend off the snowstorm.
The Sword Kings and the Invincible Sword alike stood in absent shock to find the devastating Sundering Sword unable to break the hail of ice, only making it rebound off the blade. At best, the ice got split only when meeting the Sundering Sword’s edge.
[T-this can’t be happening!]
Baili Yutian gasped, while the Sword Kings looked on in disbelief.
The ice contained the sea demon’s sealing power, yet among them four, only the divine sword had the strength to crack it open.
They had trouble handling so little of the sea demon’s power, but what about when he came at them at full strength?
The Invincible Sword felt they not only stirred the hornet nest, but all nests.
The danger zones were known for a very good reason.
[This fight may very well be my last, ha-ha-ha…]
Baili Yutian shook his head, his eyes shining with the will to die. They were blinded by what was before them, despairing just by seeing the sea demon’s casual show of force.
Rumble!
Another rumble pierced their ears just then. The frozen sea cracked all over and crumbled, crushing the countless bodies trapped in its surface.
Something the size of an island burst from the ice, looking like a shell that let out a chilling aura. An old weathered face came out next, with two eyes the size of mountains, one shining yellow and the other looked dull, with a clear wound in it.
That scar was Sword Sovereign’s handiwork.
The absurdly huge creature towered hundreds of meters over them, howling at the skies. Heaven Sealing Sea Ao’s frightening power made even Baili Yutian shiver, making him feel tiny and worthless.
[This is the sea demon, the lord of the North Sea!]
“P-Patriarch, maybe should we ask for leniency?”
Baili Yuyun’s face twitched, looking pained. He looked at the creature outsizing him a thousand times over and said, “This thing is different from that 9th level imperial beast. We have no chance!”
Baili Yutian’s face sank.
[You think? Do I look so blind to need your input?]
Tilting his head way up until it became uncomfortable, to fully appreciate this huge Sea Ao in all its glory, he gulped as a chill crawled up his spine.
The Invincible Sword, the best in the lands, had never thought possible the day would come that just a mere aura would send fear in his bones.
Baili Yutian glanced at Zhuo Fan’s block of ice, now believing the kid’s words.
[Sir Zhuo, you’re right. The lands are just a speck compared to the great world. I’m not that strong after all. I… am weak!]
The Invincible Sword regarded the Sea Ao again and focused. He lifted the Sundering Sword and charged for the demon’s head.
“Patriarch…”
The Sword Kings cried out behind. Invincible Sword had made his mind, focused completely on fighting as he roared, “I admit that I am very weak, but my will of being strong hasn’t changed. Sea demon, show me a peak expert’s power!”
Hu~
The Invincible Sword psyched himself up yet Sea Ao’s reaction was to flare its nostrils, sending a chilling air at him.
The Invincible Sword seized on the spot, unable to move.
With a thump, a clear block of ice slammed the ground, containing the Invincible Sword with the Sundering Sword in his most heroic pose. Not even Sundering Sword could fight off the cold, slowly halting its ringing.
Dong!
The sound rang through the Sword Kings’ minds, numbing them. They looked at the Sea Ao with dull gazes and pale faces.
Their patriarch, the Invincible Sword, was done in from a mere exhale.
[W-what the hell kind of monster is this?]
Faces twitching, the trio crumbled on the ice in shock. Despair had their hearts in a tight grip, even hoping the Sea Ao saw them as nothing but extras and let them go out of the kindness of his heart.
Sea Ao, however, hated humans with a passion, and that wouldn’t change anytime soon.
“Hi-hi-hi, that’s what humans are!”
Showing a condescending smile, Sea Ao shook its large head and cackled, “Picking on weak and fearing the strong, a race without honor. Where had their earlier fire gone to? Look at them, nothing but whiny dogs looking for clemency. Disgusting!”
Sea Ao’s voice released a wave of cold.
The Sword Kings turned to flee, but the cold swept them in an instant, leaving behind three more sculptures.
Five more vivid ice sculptures had now joined the endless others and, unfortunately, might have the same sordid end as well, in pieces.
Qiao’er’s heart was wrecked with anxiety.
Sea Ao chuckled, “Little Thunder Phoenix, now do you see humanity’s ignorance? Now choose, will it be your human father, or your Qilin brother?”
Sea Ao dove back into the sea, enjoying himself as he pointed out the Zhuo Fan sculpture and unconscious Gu Santong.
Qiao’er looked left and right, unable to make a decision, “Father would’ve definitely save brother, because that’s why we came here in the first place. But my brother wouldn’t want father to be in danger. How is this a choice?”
“He-he-he, you’re overthinking it.”
Se Ao snickered, “Humans forget kindness and are adept in betrayal. This man admitted to using you two. What’s so hard about casting him out? You’re only tools to him. Why would he care for some tools? Sacrificing yourself for him is not worth it!”
Qiao’er sank in a long silence, but then she nodded, “I’ve made up my mind. I want to save brother!”
“Ha-ha-ha, good choice. Humans can’t be trusted and should be abandoned…”
“No!”
Sea Ao laughed, but Qiao’er cut him off with conviction, “Not abandoned, but chosen. I know father would choose brother, so I won’t disappoint him.”
The cackle stopped, with the Sea Ao giving her the cold eye, “You’re saying you’re choosing the human?”
Qiao’er flicked her hand, “I’ve made my choice, so save brother! This is what my father and I both agree on. Father’s spirit would be gratified. Just how father saw mother losing her mind over him, he would be torn with guilt knowing he lived while brother died, a fate worse than death!”
“Bull! Those vile and dishonorable humans can’t feel guilt!”
Sea Ao roared, with Qiao’er pointing at his nose and shouting back, “I made my choice. Are you going to do it or not? Are you a welsher? So humans are bad like you say, but aren’t you the disgrace of sacred beasts for not keeping your promise?”
Sea Ao squinted and cracked a smile, revealing a deep chill, “Using humans as reverse psychology, good one, little Thunder Phoenix. Having come to this, if I don’t agree…”
“What will change?”
Sea Ao mocked and opened its maw to bite on the ice.
Just that where he bit, young Sanzi lay.
Sea Ao ate young Sanzi in one gulp.
Qiao’er was too stunned to react…

chapters.title: Chapter 1093 - 1093, A Father’s Rage
chapters.content:
Chapter 1093, A Father’s Rage
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Qiao’er’s eyes went wide as saucers and turned red from the tears. She pointed a trembling hand at the devious and smug Sea Ao, her lip quivering, “Y-you lied! You ate my brother! Give him back now!”
“Hi-hi-hi, girl, no one can tell me what to do, ha-ha-ha…”
With a prideful laughter, Heaven Sealing Sea Ao gave the little girl a patronizing look, relishing her desolate and crushed expression.
Qiao’er’s face twitched, the pain in her heart growing.
Father and daughter braved many dangers to come save young Sanzi. But they just arrived here and her father sacrificed himself, sealed in ice, while Sea Ao toyed with her emotions, giving her an impossible choice.
When she did come to a decision at long last, she found out it was nothing more than a ruse, the bastard not planning to keep his word. She and her father were his entertainment.
Qiao’er’s eyes were bloodshot, roaring, “Sea Ao, you rotten bastard! You used me! You broke your promise! You’re not worthy of being a sacred beast!”
“Hi-hi-hi, I sure had to mess around with you. What of it? Don’t you humans use these petty tricks all the time? I’m only responding in kind, what’s wrong with that?”
“But my brother and I aren’t humans…”
“You’ve been corrupt from being around one, which makes you human all the same!”
Qiao’er raged, but Sea Ao went cold and flashed its fangs with killing intent, “I’ve said before, that no sacred beast reeking of human stink will be a sacred beast again. You, the Qilin, and that human father you all attach to are nothing but humans. As long as I’m around, no human will ever leave my presence alive, you included!”
Hu~
Sea Ao breathed out a wave of frigid mist, turning into a tornado as it shot for Qiao’er.
Qiao’er was unable to move from shock.
She had no chance as she was against the Heaven Sealing Sea Ao, since she hadn’t matured. The three of them would find their end on this very day.
Ice spread over her body, creaking as it formed.
Qiao’er stared into space, her eyes filled with tears of despair.
[Forgive me, father, I failed. I couldn’t save my brother. You and I are helpless as well, with me about to join you.]
[Father, brother, see you again below.]
Qiao’er closed her eyes, having given up all hope and sank in despair. All that remained of her defiance were those hot tears, evidence of the indignity she suffered.
Sea Ao mocked as she turned to ice, “Hi-hi-hi, I told you, little Thunder Phoenix, I never planned on helping either one of you. All I did was use you for the best entertainment. Sorry, but it seems I’ve given you false hope, ha-ha-ha. I just love to see my prey squirm, the thrill of seeing that hope broken, the horror, is to die for, hi-hi-hi!”
“Aah!”
Qiao’er cried out in powerless defiance, feeling victimized.
She hated Sea Ao and his guile. He never planned on letting them live, yet he imposed on her an impossible choice. He made her see her father and brother as they would die. And when she did finally decide, she came to realize that it didn’t matter. She felt utterly powerless.
It was better if all three of them had been sent to the hereafter from the start. At least they would go together. Now, she had went through all that torture for nothing.
Qiao’er cried out her pain, only feeding Sea Ao’s twisted hobby. The cold winds soon took her, about to encase her in ice.
Bam!
A black sword with black flames then shot from the ice and shielded her.
The frigid winds struck the sword instead of Qiao’er, letting out loud hissing of steam instead of freezing over. The tornado was now turned into steam that spread everywhere, enveloping Qiao’er as well.
Sea Ao’s mad laughter came to an abrupt stop, its eyes shaking as he gave an odd look at the sudden steam.
The mist soon cleared and Qiao’er was safe and sound, with a black longsword covered in black flames hovering in front. It gave off an aura that struck fear even in the Heaven Sealing Sea Ao.
“Where did the sword come from? Who did that?”
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao flinched, turning grave. Qiao’er looked at the familiar blade and hope rekindled in her eyes, muttering, “F-father…”
Sss~
The hissing drew their attention to a block of ice, now sporting webbing cracks with black flames seeping out of them, only to explode at the very end.
Someone walked through the ice pieces and stood next to Qiao’er. He reached out to take the sword and grin, “Qiao’er, forgive me for putting you through that. Leave the rest to me.”
“Father!”
Qiao’er cheered, “You’re alright?”
“Not possible! I sealed you. I did! How did you break out?” Heaven Sealing Sea Ao gaped in shock, its claws slamming the icy sea, sending violent winds in all directions.
Zhuo Fan had been sealed, yet now was standing like nothing happened. He grinned, but his eyes were cold as ice.
“Senior Sea Ao, I’ve been nothing but courteous ever since I came to Ice Mountain. You wanted to kill humans and iced me. You wanted Qiao’er to choose and she did. But even after a little girl did all you ask you just go back on your deal just to toy with her innocent heart? That’s where I draw the line!”
“How are you any different, with your slyness? If you’d have been sealed, you’d never know what happened after.” Sea Ao glared at Zhuo Fan and roared.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “I have the thunderflame’s protection. It’s impossible to seal me. But that’s besides the point. What matters is that you’ve been nothing but a disappointment, senior. You have made Qiao’er cry…”
“And?”
“Nothing, just…”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed with bloodthirst. He flicked the sword, pointing it at the huge head, “You stirred a father’s rage. You toyed with my daughter and took my son. I’ll have you pay for that!”
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao eyed him then cracked up in disdain, “Ha-ha-ha, you make me pay? Getting out of my seal changes nothing. I hardly need to lift a finger to squash bugs like you. You can’t do anything to me!”
“I’m not trying to, only letting you know that toying with your adversary must come while aware of the situation. Some people should never be fooled, senior Sea Ao!”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone as he shouted, charging for the Heaven Sealing Sea Ao, like the Invincible Sword did before.
This time though, it was Zhuo Fan who challenged the greatest sacred beast.
Qiao’er cried, “Father, be careful!”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes were grave.
“Humph, screw careful! You’re nothing but an arrogant bug. You can only be careful against a worthy match. You, human punk, have nothing on me!”
Hu~
Sea Ao breathed out another wave of cold towards Zhuo Fan, the winds swirling into twisters. It was more than enough to freeze him into an icicle once more.
Qiao’er watched with her heart in her throat, worried sick for Zhuo Fan.
Boom!
Zhuo Fan had no intent to even dodge, slamming into the twister with a bang and letting the cold seep in his bones.
“That’s that.”
Sea Ao smirked in disdain, then felt the need to gloat over Qiao’er as well. He didn’t get the chance as a figure dashed through the twisters enveloped in writhing black flames…

chapters.title: Chapter 1094 - 1094, You Lose
chapters.content:
Chapter 1094, You Lose
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
[How…]
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao was overwhelmed at the sudden development. His sealing never failed him ever and always struck true.
This was the might of the apocalyptic thunderflame, a power beyond the five great sacred beasts’. His seals had no effect at all.
Not to say that Sea Ao was powerless against Zhuo Fan, who had a far weaker cultivation. Zhuo Fan had quality, while Sea Ao had quantity, lots of it. Sea Ao needed to just ramp up the power output, and not get taken in by Zhuo Fan’s words, then he would seal him no problem.
Zhuo Fan knew this as well, his eyes shining as he sped up to fly faster for Sea Ao’s head.
The only chance at winning against a peak power like the Sea Ao was to capitalize on his disdain and slight. He had to strike in the smallest window to give a deadly blow to the enemy and offer some hope at victory.
As for any other situations? He was doomed, dead, finished.
Zhuo Fan squinted, touching his Thunder Ring, going even faster and crossing half the Sea Ao’s bulk.
The beast smirked half a second later, “He-he-he, amusing. That’s an interesting black flame you got there. It can even overcome my seal. I wonder, just how much of it does your puny human body contain? Will it burn all of my seal’s power, hmm?”
Hu~
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao breathed out at Zhuo Fan once more. A sea of cold air came like a flood, as if the heavens fell on top of Zhuo Fan’s head.
The attack was tens of miles thick and a hundred wide. That was no flood, but a literal mountain of ice and cold.
The thunderflame within Zhuo Fan was bound to be snuffed out under such deluge. And when it failed, so did he, sealed in this ice like other countless humans before him.
He only escaped last time due to Sea Ao’s obnoxious disdain. Now, the Sea ao would not make the same mistake again.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shook, gnashing his teeth as the immense attack was about to hit him. His left eyes’ thunderflame roiled, while the right eye shone in two golden halos.
Divine Eye of the Void 2nd stage, Thunderflame Void Annihilation!
Whoosh~
A black beam of fire pierced the incoming cold mountain, punching a hole through it big enough for his size. Zhuo Fan followed right behind the flames. Even so, the cold came closing in around him, eating away at his black flames on his body and turning into mist.
It turned out the flood of cold was just too thick in the end. The thunderflame gave signs of dying now and then, but Zhuo Fan used his eye to get it burning again. He did it despite the strain it put on him, making his eye bleed. For the second the thunderflame halted was the moment it was all over for him.
There was no room for error on the edge of the knife.
Qiao’er was anxious, unable to provide any bit of help to her father.
Sea Ao rose an eyebrow, looking piqued, “Why is his skill so familiar? Where have I seen it?
Bam!
The beam of black flames punched through the thick deluge of cold. Zhuo Fan flew right out, covered in sweat and huffing. His left eye was bleeding hard, erased as it met the black flames.
Zhuo Fan still charged ahead recklessly, without regard for his safety.
He was at chest level of Sea Ao and next would be his target, the head. That would be when he had the advantage to grasp victory.
Zhuo Fan stepped forward while ignoring his exhaustion.
Qiao’er eased a heavy breath, now knowing her father had come through.
“Right, Heavenly Sovereign! It’s Heavenly Sovereign’s Divine Eye of the Void!”
A howl of fury wrecked the world as Sea Ao’s bloodlust spiked, “Y-you’re with the Heavenly Sovereign! I’m going to crush you to a pulp!”
Sea Ao slammed with its huge claw, making it look comical compared to the bug-sized Zhuo Fan. With rage burning in his bloodshot eyes, it roared, “Heavenly Sovereign trapped me in here all my life. I’ll never forget this debt for as long as I live. For being Heavenly Sovereign’s inheritor, you shall die all the same! I’ll ground your bones to dust and throw it all away!”
Hu~
The huge claw whistled through the air, its pressure stealing Zhuo Fan’s breath away. He then felt his sternum snap and had to spurt blood from the damage.
Shocked, Zhuo Fan turned grave.
[Just his pressure made me suffer already. That means the moment the attack lands, there’ll be nothing left of me.]
Sweating buckets, Zhuo Fan was at an impasse. Qiao’er paced in worry, powerless to help. She could only watch and pray for him.
Zhuo Fan was now near the neck, just a thousand meters to go.
Zhuo Fan’s right eye shone with one golden halo.
Whoosh~
Sea Ao’s claw slammed down, hitting nothing. Zhuo Fan had jumped on top of Sea Ao’s head with an evil grin.
“Divine Eye of the Void’s 1st stage, Shift?”
Sea Ao cried out. It had let anger get to him and Zhuo Fan’s action slipped unnoticed. But then his intact eye squinted and yellow shone from it, “Humph, rotten punk, don’t think for a second that popping around the place will stop me. Your skill is crude at best compared to Heavenly Sovereign’s. Void Seal!”
Hum~
Ripples flew in all directions, giving Zhuo Fan the impression there were walls all around him. Now there was no way of escaping through Shift.
Not that he cared, having reached his target. He smirked in glee, his hand touching the Thunder Ring.
Sea Ao was clueless to his intent, merely laughing at the fact the rat was trapped, laughter laced with sorrow, “Ha-ha-ha, lets see you run now. There’s nothing you can do! You can’t harm a hair on me. Conceited little shit, just because you got a taste of Heavenly Sovereign’s inheritance you think you can blow your horn in my face? The only reason you survived so far is because I never saw you worthy of my attention. Now that you’re with Heavenly Sovereign, you’ll feel all my wrath!”
“Heavenly Sovereign, you son of a she-dog, I can’t take it out on you so I’ll crush your successor to soothe my hatred!” Sea Ao cursed and shouted, snapping his head around and opening his maw to bite at the space-locked Zhuo Fan, “Rotten punk, I’ll make mincemeat out of you and there’s nothing your master, Heavenly Sovereign, can do about it, ha-ha-ha…”
“Sea Ao, hold on! My father has nothing to do with Heavenly Sovereign. You’re wrong about him!”
Qiao’er cried out but Sea Ao was past listening, his eyes red with sweet retribution. He wanted the kid eaten to quell the hatred festering within. So what if he got it all wrong? The target was human, wasn’t he? All humans deserved death in his book.
“Father!”
Qiao’er’s worry for Zhuo Fan only mounted seeing he wasn’t listening.
Zhuo Fan ignored everything, only focused on the ring shining on his hand. As the abyss that was Sea Ao’s maw closed in, his grin only grew eviler.
“Heaven Sealing Sea Ao, your loss today is all because of your conceit.”
“What?”
Sea Ao reacted out of reflex, still going in for a bite.
Zhuo Fan had a strange spark in his eyes, his snicker growing to his ears, “I’m saying thank you for giving me this chance. You lose!”
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan flicked his hand and a miniature sun appeared, scorching and terrifying…

chapters.title: Chapter 1095 - 1095, World of the Strong
chapters.content:
Chapter 1095, World of the Strong
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
[T-that’s…]
The huge eye squinted and Heaven Sealing Sea Ao gasped as he shouted, “Old dragon’s full-powered Dragon Breath Pill? W-why would he give it to you, Heavenly Sovereign’s successor?”
“Ha-ha-ha, he’d never trust me if I really was Heavenly Sovereign’s successor. But there’s a difference between being a successor and learning his ultimate skill. I agreed to help him and he shields me. Like you said, they’re all after something and not noble like you. As for now…”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone cruelly, ready to throw the Dragon Breath Pill.
Sea Ao was shaken up, scrambling to flee. He rushed to close his mouth and stammered, “Now hold on, let’s talk about this. Don’t…”
“Talking only works among equals. But you, sir, are too strong!” Zhuo Fan didn’t fall for his stalling so he could escape.
So Zhuo Fan threw the fireball without qualms, shouting coldly, “Here’s my gift, senior Sea Ao, for looking after my children. Also, senior Dragon Ancestor sent his regards. May you eat well and stay healthy, ha-ha-ha…”
The Dragon Breath Pill crushed any barrier in place as it swirled straight into Sea Ao’s gaping abyss.
Boom!
Everything was dyed orange as the flames unleashed a sea of flames.
Dragon ancestor’s full-powered Dragon Breath Pill went off in Sea Ao’s mouth and the raging torrents of heat and fire shot in every direction. The terrible flames melted all ice in an instant, turning the sea into steam before it as well was erased in the scorching heat.
Sea Ao’s fangs broke off then and there, ruined. The fire made its way deeper and into his body, every nook and cranny, engulfing his organs in boiling lava.
Only when all his being was saturated with fire did it leak out, sending plumes of blood high in the sky in a mist of red.
His body was now in dire straits as tons of blood spewed out of his mouth. His proud visage now paled greatly, his scales black, singed or burned.
With one strike, Zhuo Fan was close to taking his life.
As Sea Ao was on the same level as dragon ancestor, taking such a blow had serious consequences. Only this time, it was even worse. The only way dragon ancestor could reduce Sea Ao to such a state was by risking his own life in battle.
It all came down to how cautious they were of each other. When fighting, they always kept their senses sharp.
While Zhuo Fan was fairly easy to look down on, being a puny human and all, working in his favor. He used his own weakness to his advantage, making the other show the perfect target to strike by opening his piehole.
This was something no being in the world, and in their right mind, would make such a monumental mistake. The inners would always be weaker than a thick skin. If left with no choice, taking dragon ancestor’s full-blown attack on his body was much better, at least it would leave a bruise or a cut. As for taking it out with his mushy insides, that was positively life-threatening.
Then again, who could blame Sea Ao if in his shoes? Zhuo Fan was just too weak to even tickle his stomach if he detonated inside. Who’d ever saw it coming that he’d deliver dragon ancestor’s attack instead of himself into the maw of the beast? It was no different than dragon ancestor breathing fire down his gullet.
In a duel of peers, why would one expose their weakness? To die?
Zhuo Fan hit him more than good this time, practically destroying him, since that was the plan all along.
Using Dragon Breath Pill from the start would hardly make Sea Ao even twitch, only making him angry instead.
The best course was to be a patient hunter for the right moment to strike, as he did.
His plan involved using two Dragon Breath Pill, one on the face to pry the jaws open and the second down the hatch. It was like a boon from heaven itself how the guy simply offered himself from the start.
That was why Zhuo Fan even drove the nail in by saying he lost, since he exposed his weakness.
He-he, and now Sea Ao was paying the full price for it.
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao roared in pain, tearing up even. He swore on his life that such disgraceful defeat had never happened to him in his long, long life. He never suffer so much ever. Yet the day finally came that a bug from the mortal domain did him good. He, the overlord of the sea, a sacred beast.
He was enraged, he lost all his honor, and howled with bloodlust, “You little shitty bastard! You’re not getting out of here alive!”
“Ha-ha-ha, senior Sea Ao, do you think you’re in any position to make threats?” Zhuo Fan mocked as he watched the black scales fall off, the maimed body, and smelled the burn coming out from that blood spurting from him.
With another spray of blood in tons, the sea took darker shade of red. Heaven Sealing Sea Ao, glared at Zhuo Fan, “Don’t get cocky, bastard, I haven’t keeled over just yet! Wounded as I am, it’s still more than enough to deal with the likes of you. Die!”
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao reached with his claw to slap Zhuo Fan out of existence.
Bam!
All Sea Ao did in the end was break an iceberg into ice cubes.
Zhuo Fan flashed on the singed and wounded claw, sporting a smug and evil grin, “Ha-ha-ha, senior Sea Ao, I see you don’t feel like talking. The feeling is quite mutual, I asure you. I have no intent of settling this peacefully, our debt is far from over!”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone and waved his longsword. The black flames on it roiled as he then shoved the pointy end into the claw.
Pa!
The deadly black flames and the sharp edge of the sacred weapon went through the tough scale without a hitch, letting out booms after booms.
“This is for young Sanzi!”
Even more wounded, Sea Ao wailed. He slammed with the other claw, but Zhuo Fan was long gone, now appearing on a shoulder. He slashed this time and the black thunderflame licked the scales and blew many away. That earned another howl from the sacred beast.
“This is for Qiao’er!”
Pitiless, Zhuo Fan lashed out all over the huge body and leaving gapping bloody wounds in his wake.
Zhuo Fan was not about to let this bastard toy with his own daughter and had her suffer in vain.
“Senior Sea Ao, you’re hanging by a thread at this point and can hardly muster the strength to seal me at tis point. Your huge body now became a burden. Now I ask you what you asked me, what can you do to me? Ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan cackled, buzzing around the huge Sea Ao like an annoying flea, slashing and poking at every chance. Sea Ao was powerless to swat him, reduced to roaring and crying in pain.
He was a proud sacred beast, among the best in the Sacred Domain. Even the Sovereigns were weary of him. His stride must’ve come to an end since now even he ended up toyed by a nobody. It was a disgrace!
No matter how humiliating it felt, he could do nothing for he was on the verge of dying. And that was due to Zhuo Fan’s grace too, or he could’ve just throw another Dragon Breath Pill and be done with Heaven Sealing Sea Ao. He would be the first in the mortal domain to kill a sacred beast.
His name would go down in history!
“Ha-ha-ha…”
“Ahhh!”
Zhuo Fan laughed like mad while Sea Ao cried out in pain. Thanks to the early searing heat wave and the endless rumbling, the four sealed experts were thawed.
The Invincible Sword gripped the Sundering Sword and suddenly coughed blood with ice and fire.
The Sword Kings had it worse, spurting a couple more times. They turned worried towards him, “Patriarch, are you alright?”
“I’m fine, just a serious wound.”
The Invincible Sword took a deep breath and spewed blood with flame and ice again, “What happened anyway?”
The trio shrugged in confusion, right as the sympony of wails and laugher reached their unfiltered ears.
Curiosity got the best of them and now they were witnessing a most bizarre play that left them dumbstruck. Before them was a battle of the strongest…

chapters.title: Chapter 1096 - 1096, I Lost
chapters.content:
Chapter 1096, I Lost
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Ahhh!”
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao shouted in rage and pain, twisting and jerking from every attack. He flayed his tower-sized claws around in a futile attempt at ending his torment and squashing the bite-sized interloper. But the meal just wouldn’t stay put, having also learned to bite back and hard at every chance it got. The end result was mounting wounds, tons of blood loss and excruciating pain for the overlord of the sea.
Zhuo Fan cackled all the while, his eyes savage and sadistic each time his blade sunk into Sea Ao’s flesh.
“A-ha-ha-ha….”
The Invincible Sword and the Sword Kings blinked constantly, trying to get some sense of this absurd development. Baili Yuyun’s face twitched as he strained to ask, “W-what’s he doing? Is it me or is he torturing the monster?”
“It’s all real. I never once took the kid to pull something like this!”
The Invincible Sword was just as dumbstruck, looking dazed, “What happened to me?”
“Patriarch, the monster blew its nose and encased you in ice.”
“And then, what happened after?”
“We got frozen too and don’t know.” Baili Yufeng looked on stiffly as he gave automatic and flat replies. He forgot all about decorum while Baili Yutian lost his customary pride, reduced to giving an unconscious nod and forgetting about chiding the junior’s lack of respect.
That’s what this so-called fight did to all of them. Sea Ao’s humongous body that was riddled with wounds entered his vision, he felt he was still in a dream.
[I couldn’t even touch this monster and now someone is toying with him?]
[How did the kid do it?]
Baili Yutian’s brow shook and sighed along with his Sword Kings.
[Regardless of how, the strength must be absurd. The kid was being honest when he said he could wipe out the five Sword Kings back then.]
In the case of him having the same powerful tool, he wouldn’t admit it either. This was a true trump card. If it could cripple the likes of Sea Ao, then who in this world could withstand it?
I was a dreaded existence, yet humiliated to such a degree.
[Thank heavens we have yet to reach a point of no return with him…]
The Sword Kings sweated buckets and the Invincible Sword squinted as his jaw set in defiance.
Boom!
