The powerful shockwave spread everywhere and picked the four off their feet, flinging them all over the place.
They slammed into the ice hard a thousand meters away, heavily bleeding and looking much worse for wear.
Looking back at the main event, they found the source. Sea Ao wanted to squash Zhuo Fan and this had resulted in them suffering for it.
Zhuo Fan made a quick escape out of the attack’s reach, popping on the beast’s head and using the flaming sword, “Ha-ha-ha, senior Sea Ao, with this strike, I give you my blessings!”
Bam!
“Ah!”
The black thunderflame flashed across the head and made blood spurt out of it. Heaven Sealing Sea Ao howled once more, in anger and pain, but mostly futility. A sacred beast like him couldn’t do anything against some lousy brat?
He waved his claws again, trying everything to slap Zhuo Fan out of the air, but all he got was laughter for his efforts as the bug used these chances to dodge and slash twice more.
Sea Ao unleashed twisters with every wave, shaking the world around him, but what gave the greatest horror was the constant cackle of Zhuo Fan from within the winds. Like a devil from hell, he clawed his way out to toy with his prey while flaying it alive.
The Sword Kings gulped hard, their hearts running wild as they made sure to dodge an errant ice block blown their way while keeping their eyes on Zhuo Fan. What was most prevalent was the terror in their eyes.
[Why didn’t anyone tell us this kid is a freak of nature? The monster is like a child compared to his sadistic streaks. Is he the devil?]
“Patriarch, we’d better run before we get caught up in that kid and sea demon’s battle.” Looking behind, he saw the thick black fog filled with holes from the searing heat wave. Baili Yuyun perked up and urged Baili Yutian.
Baili Yutian cursed, “Humph, are you in that much of a rush to flee for your life, you weakling? In all my long years roaming the world, I’ve not once feared another’s fight!”
“You’re right, Patriarch. No man in the five lands can stop Patriarch, but these two are anything but humans. Better to be safe than sorry, sir…”
Baili Yuyun was hopeful as he shook all over while pleading. He knew Patriarch was not one to listen, but this was not the time to throw a hissy fit. They were all sporting deep wounds and they might very well meet their end from Sea Ao’s stray attack.
[Patriarch, let’s just go, please!]
Baili Yuyun was sweating all over.
Baili Yutian turned from him to the battle between man and beast and sighed, “We’re leaving!”
“Great, Patriarch!”
The trio cheered.
Ding!
Baili Yutian paused, looking at his hand to find the purple Sundering Sword shaking while pointing at the Sea Ao with hunger.
Invincible Sword’s had a pained gaze, “Sundering Sword, you want to fight, don’t you?”
Ding!
Sundering Sword gave a jerk in response.
“I’m afraid we can’t. That fight isn’t one we can meddle in. That is the world of the strong, a world I have yet to even enter.”
Baili Yutian sighed, sapped of strength while tightening his grip on the sword, “The moment I held you in my hand, I vowed to the heavens to take you to the summit. You made the right choice accepting me. Over the following millennia, I never stepped back against any that faced me. I’m sorry, but now I understand that I’ve yet to take you to the peak. I am truly weak. But rest assured, my promise hasn’t changed. The day will come when I will take you into such a peak fight. For now, we must withdraw as we don’t qualify to join it.”
Ding!
The sword was restless still, though it soon quietened.
It had now forgotten its mission of killing the sacred beasts. Even with one before it, wounded as it was, the Sundering Sword still gave up.
It had long since become one with this human expert. The Invincible Sword’s wish was the sword’s. It wanted to challenge a sacred beast while being held and not go take one down by itself.
The Invincible Sword smiled, “Thank you.”
He flew out of the mist, with the Sword Kings behind him. But not before he gave Zhuo Fan one last look, shouting, “Zhuo Fan don’t you die on me! I will one day rise to the top and for that I need that ticket in Devil Mountain!”
Baili Yutian then vanished in the fog.
Zhuo Fan shook and smirked. He Shifted out of another claw and popped next to Qiao’er, “Stop, I lost!”
Sea Ao, in the middle of his craze, jerked to a stop. He turned a confused eye on Zhuo Fan.
[What’s with him? Why give up? I might be strong and look tough but he has dominated the fight all this time. Why then..]

chapters.title: Chapter 1097 - 1097, Gentle
chapters.content:
Chapter 1097, Gentle
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
The humongous creature plunged into the sea, sending a tsunami in every direction. Heaven Sealing Sea Ao gave Zhuo Fan a dark look of confusion, “W-what’s that supposed to mean?”
“Nothing besides losing. I now await my sentence!”
Ding!
He let Vaulting Sword slip and stick into the ground while he sat down. Qiao’er cried, “Father!”
Sea Ao was perplexed.
[What’s the damn kid’s angle this time?]
Zhuo Fan had a genial smile on his face. Gone was the mad and sadistic expression, now looking like a real gentleman that wouldn’t hurt a fly, preaching love and peace.
A disturbing silence ensued. Heaven Sealing Sea Ao was still tense and on guard at the sudden change. His fury now cooled down to a confusing calmness. All that he could think of were questions upon questions. He even forgot what he was supposed to do.
His brain stopped working the minute Zhuo Fan gave up out of the blue.
“Why, you don’t want to punish me? I take it we can talk then?”
Zhuo Fan watched Sea Ao just staring there with a dumb look and smiled, “Senior Sea Ao, please spit out my son.”
Sea Ao flinched and then exclaimed in anger, “Are you making fun of me now, brat?”
“No games and no insults, I only have a simple request for senior to calm down and negotiate better.”
Zhuo Fan smiled like a sage of boundless wisdom. His back was straight, his gaze deep, “As I’ve said, talks are negotiations are conducted between equals. Please forgive my earlier transgression. With senior’s rage, it made it hard for my words to reach you. That is why I resorted to such tactics. I hope senior can settle down now.”
“Settle?”
Eyelid twitching, Sea Ao snapped, “You wish! Merely looking at your face get my blood boiling. There’s no settling! And why would I ever talk to you? I want nothing more than to grind your bones and flay you alive!”
“Wrong!”
Zhuo Fan’s gaze met his, unphased at the outburst, “Not us, but me. You want to flay only me, right?”
Sea Ao shuddered.
Giving a long and heavy sigh, Zhuo Fan glanced at Qiao’er behind him then at Sea Ao, “In our fight, senior Sea Ao could do nothing to me. Senior Sea Ao could at any time swallow Qiao’er and threaten me to stay put. Why didn’t you?”
“Humph, sacred beasts have their pride, unlike humans who stoop to any low, even taking hostages.” Sea Ao spat..
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “”Senior, you’re contradicting yourself. When you toyed with Qiao’er, senior had used all manner of dirty tricks humans employ. From the way I see it, besides Kunpeng, senior is the closest towards human nature among the five great sacred beasts. With danger hanging overhead, mentioning a sacred beast’s pride sounds like a tasteless joke, senior.”
“Uh, I!”
Sea Ao’s words got stuck in his throat, put on the spot, but then he grew stubborn, “That was merely out of anger that I forgot about the girl. I don’t need you to remind me!”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, the smile never leaving his face, “You should’ve said it at the start and I might’ve believed you. However, aren’t you contradicting yourself with what you said before? Ha-ha-ha, senior, you never considered Qiao’er a hostage or intended on killing her, did you?”
Sea Ao winced.
“The five great sacred beasts are unique in this world.”
Zhuo Fan took a deep breath as he gazed above, “As sole beings, no matter how much bad blood is between you, would you still be so quick to cut each other down? The very top is a place of endless solitude, even more when everyone around you dies out.”
Sea Ao was grave.
Zhuo Fan continued, “Senior does indeed hate humans to the bone, willing to even take it out on the sacred beasts that humanity corrupted. That bloodlust directed at Qiao’er did not lie. That’s why I believe senior truly wanted Qiao’er and young Sanzi dead. But humanized sacred beasts are nothing more than misled children. Regardless how furious, how outraged senior was, were you still willing to end them?
“As such, I’ve always been watching you from the start, senior, to see if the madness was real or not and whether you’d be willing to kill young sacred beasts. I’m glad to say senior has not crossed that line. That can only mean young Sanzi is safe. So I ask senior to heal him.”
Zhuo Fan gave a full bow of respect.
“Damn you, human, are you tricking me, is that it?”
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao set his jaw, his huge eyes turning bloodshot as he raved, “Over many years, I’ve seen more people than I could count and know the darkness that lies in a human’s nature, but you are the most sinister and cunning of all. I knew it the moment you used old dragon’s attack. Now you’re breaking my principles, twisting my beliefs so you can get your young Qilin back as good as new. No, I will not listen to you! Come fight me if you dare, but I will never do what a human asks even if it kills me!”
Qiao’er’s face fell, looking worried at Zhuo Fan. He shook his head, “Don’t say that, senior. I said it’s my loss already.”
“You call that a loss? Look what you did to me, and you’re holding all the cards. You can leave when you want or even kill me. Why is it I can’t see you lose out on anything?”
“I lost from the very beginning.”
Zhuo Fan sighed, saluting, “Young Sanzi’s Qilin Shield is damaged and senior is the only one that can restore it. I brought him to request your help. This put me at a loss, from which I could never recover. The only thing left for me to do was not to suffer a total defeat, losing even that with which I came. Nothing I could do will ever change senior’s refusal to help. That is why I ask senior to lend a hand for the sake of the five sacred beasts.”
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao gave him a long look then snickered, “Hi-hi-hi, after all that yapping we’ve finally reached the real issue. Let me tell you…”
“Senior…”
Zhuo Fan’s shout cut him off, his gaze steeled in determination, “Senior won’t heal Qilin all because of me. Let me bear all of senior’s loathing towards humanity. As long as senior agrees to save him, senior can take a life for a life.”
“Father!” Qiao’er cried.
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao shook, his eyes having a strange glint.
“Senior might deny all you want, but know that you can’t do anything to me unless I let you. Qilin and Qiao’er are both your juniors and can’t do anything to stop you. I am the one who earned your ire, your bitter enemy. If you want to take it out on someone, would you feel better killing me or them?”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Senior’s malice needs to be let go and I’m willing to be the means to do it. On the condition that senior lends a hand.”
Qiao’er quivered, her tearing eyes never leaving Zhuo Fan as she bit her lip, drawing blood.
She knew no one could change Zhuo Fan’s mind once he was made up. This was also his only option.
Sea Ao was stunned, suspicion flashing in his eyes. Then he cackled, “Hi-hi-hi, you’re just too shrewd. Are you up to your mind games again? He-he-he, you think I’ll sympathize and won’t kill you? Wrong! I will definitely crush your bones and scatter your pieces everywhere!”
Sea Ao slammed his palm on Zhuo Fan’s head. The violent winds were sharp enough to rend the ice around.
Qiao’er’s tears flowed down her cheeks.
“Wait!” A shout came just as the palm reached Zhuo Fan.
The heavy palm grounded to a halt. Sea Ao parted the claws to peek at Zhuo Fan with a mocking smile, “Hi-hi-hi, I just knew you were working an angle. You played the noble sacrifice thinking you could earn my sympathy. Once I save the Qilin, you can just use it for your mind games, making these two pups want to die for you. Sneaky human, I’ve seen this old trick already and it won’t work on me, ha-ha-ha….”
“Senior, that’s not it. Since senior mentioned trickery, senior ain’t exactly trustworthy either.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, taking off his ring and throwing it to Qiao’er, “My sacrifice can’t be in vain. Once I die, senior Sea Ao must save young Sanzi. But if senior breaks his word, there’s another Dragon Breath Pill in there you can throw immediately in his face. He’ll be sure to join me and young Sanzi in hell once he takes another one. Just remember not to waste words or listen to him. The instant he stalls, throw it!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1098 - 1098, Backlash
chapters.content:
Chapter 1098, Backlash
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Are you threatening me?”
“No, a mere precaution.”
Zhuo Fan had an evil grin, “I believe without a doubt that senior wants me dead while eager to help young Sanzi. The human heart, a complex concept, appears similar in some aspects to senior’s actions. As such, I am unable to confirm whether senior would keep his word or not, contradicting himself once more. While I’m most sure that people won’t readily give up their lives out of stubbornness. We all know that the true winner is the one living. You kill me then die yourself from a tantrum? What’s the point? Ha-ha-ha…”
Sea Ao stared hard, his eyes flashing with bloodthirst, “Fine, now can I get on with it? Are you that willing to give your life for the young Qilin?”
“He’s my son. There’s nothing I wouldn’t do!” Zhuo Fan showed a bright smile.
Sea Ao’s brow shook and the claw resumed its savage descent, “Great, now die, human!”
Whoosh~
The thick bloodlust bore heavy on Zhuo Fan’s shoulder.
“Father!” Qiao’er cried out, holding the Thunder Ring tight. Her body was shaking all over and her heart was ready to break.
Her father was about to die for young Sanzi’s sake.
Hu~
Zhuo Fan sat with his back straight at the coming winds, his eyes crystal clear.
The palm halted at the very end for some reason. Sea Ao shifted it back and looked coldly at the unfazed Zhuo Fan.
“Kid, there’s no chance of winning this fight. You won.”
Bam!
Sea Ao slammed the claw into the water, sending a huge wave all around.
Zhuo Fan smirked, “Thanks.”
“Father…”
Qiao’er was stunned. Sure, she was thrilled Zhuo Fan hadn’t been splattered all over the place, but a large part of her was plagued by confusion and doubts.
Sea Ao lowered his eyes and said, “Little Thunder Phoenix, I knew from the beginning this human was sly but you two children meant the world to him. Under my taunts, any other cunning man would fake sincerity and gain my sympathy. He acted like he was after something to provoke me into being savage and cast all my hatred on him while leaving you and the young Qilin out of it.”
“You’re wrong there. I really was after something. That never changed.” Zhuo Fan threw his two cents.
Sea Ao shook his head, “It takes a lot of nerve to admit it to my face. The fact that you were willing to take all my hatred for the children made you grow in my eyes.”
Zhuo Fan nodded.
“I never imagined you’d then come out of my seal and reduce me to such a state. I knew it was all to enrage me so you could give your life for Qilin’s, but you really went all out. You are one shrewd prick. You almost had me fooled as well.”
Sea Ao continued, “It then occurred to me, wasn’t I making a mistake, perhaps? Weren’t you afraid I’d kill you then forget about saving Qilin? As you sacrificed yourself, I then realized all of it was nothing but a grand scheme to you. You angered me just so I’d give value to your death in exchange for Qilin.”
“Uh, with one minor detail.”
Zhuo Fan scratched his nose, “I did aim to garner senior’s rage, but when I rained havoc on senior, there was hardly any planning involved, doing it for Qiao’er’s sake. It felt great too, ha-ha-ha…”
Sea Ao stumbled and then glared at him, “It only proves your genuine feelings. Why get so angry if you never saw the children as your own? The victim in all of this is my weary old body, now wrecked. But with all of these, I still couldn’t believe you. What had me stop my desire to end you were your eyes.”
“My eyes?”
“Yes.”
Sea Ao sighed, “I once caught a youth who had the same look as you, calm, peaceful and steady. He only moved with the purpose of understanding the world, the Dao. He did it in the end, becoming a Sovereign, becoming a dear friend of mine. Then why would he betray this bond? I never fully understood and have been in constant search of this gaze. One after another, people came, soon turning into millions upon millions, but not one proved of help.
“On the verge of death, everyone has anxious looks to some extent. Those self-righteous zealots are no different. So how then could such a gaze exist in the first place? Human, why didn’t you have any hesitation beneath my palm? Did you truly believe I wouldn’t kill you? You may be an expert in mind games and seeing my intent, but is your heart that steady even in death?”
Zhuo Fan mused for a moment and shook his head, “An unsteady heart is borne out of regret. Regret gives rise to fear, anger and many more raw emotions. I had none as I sacrificed myself for my son. I had no true regrets, just some qualms. My promise to my wife and the promise to battle with another would not be fulfilled…”
“So that’s why.”
Sea Ao sighed, “The Dao can be split in two, obsession and detachment. The obsessed can’t achieve it unless they let go. You have detached yourself from life and death, but cling to your vows. It’s rare to find such a combination of characters. Kid, you have what it takes to become a Sovereign. I’m sure of it. Now it all comes down to you if you can grab one of The Ten Paths to Heaven.”
Zhuo Fan nodded.
Sea Ao raised its head and, with a rumble, something flew out of his mouth. A blue and clear ice landed on the ground.
In the one by two meters, young Sanzi rested.
“Brother!” Qiao’er cried in joy, with Zhuo Fan looked on with hope.
Sea Ao wiped his mouth, “He only survived by luck, I put him inside a pocket in my body or he’d have died from the dragon fire.”
“Senior…”
“My stomach makes the Heaven-sealing Coffin!”
Sea Ao said, “His Qilin Shield is damaged and to heal it I needed my gastric juices to permeate his body. The child will stay in the ice coffin for 49 days. The moment it thaws will be the day he is healed.”
Zhuo Fan bowed and cupped his hands in gratitude, “Thank you, senior. I shall never forget this!”
Qiao’er bowed as well, all smiles.
“You were right. As a sacred beast myself, we’re unique, and it would bring me solitude in a world less of one. But us, old ones, are stuck in our prisons and can’t look after them and need someone reliable.”
“Uncle Sea Ao, weren’t you hating humans? Now you’re entrusting us to one?” Qiao’er started then giggled.
Sea Ao shook his head, “This is hardly a solution, forced into taking the lesser evil. Humans are hateful, but having been so close to them at some point, I could feel their deep love and sense of duty. For my hatred to be so strong, my love had to be just as strong. In any case, it’s better to give you over to someone I can trust than to some twisted people. Zhuo Fan, these two shall be in your care. In this whole wide world, there’s only five of us sacred beasts left.”
“Senior, be at ease knowing I only have them as children!” Zhuo Fan nodded.
Sea Ao nodded and smiled back.
[This human is similar to the first, both pursuing Dao. I hope he’ll never change.]
Pa!
A sudden sharp sound echoed and Zhuo Fan’s eyes bled out.
“What’s wrong, kid?”
“I don’t know…” Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, his face hard.
Pa!
The second time, Zhuo Fan felt his eyes burning in their sockets and held them. Again and again, cracking sounds echoed, with the black thunderflame leaking from between his fingers and going berserk. It spread like a tide of destruction as it covered Zhuo Fan, just how when he fought Sea Ao.
Only this time, the thunderflame was out of control, the pain growing so bad he had to wail.
“Aah!”
Apocalyptic thunderflame, something that should never be in this world ran amok…

chapters.title: Chapter 1099 - 1099, Hearts Connected
chapters.content:
Chapter 1099, Hearts Connected
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Hu~
Cold winds blasted and a thick black fog dyed everything in shades of gray, looking akin to purgatory.
Bali Yuyu watched with worry as the black mist stopped its invasion. Behind her was Shui Ruohua helping Chu Qingcheng. She looked behind her, at the open teleportation array and worried as well.
[What’s taking them so long? Did something happen?]
Rustle~
The grass moved and Wu Qingqiu with Ouyang Changqing and the rest dragged their feet over to their salvation. But seeing the girls, they started, “You should’ve been long gone by now. Why are you still here?”
“The guy’s slow wife refused to go so we decided to wait for you. I would simply force her through if worst comes to worst.”
Bali Yuyu rolled her eyes and pointed at Chu Qingcheng behind her, “And where is he, anyway? Is he alright?”
Ouyang Changqing knew who she mentioned and sighed in exhaustion, “He went after the sea demon. It’s going to take a while before he arrives. We’d better leave first.”
“The sea demon?”
“Haven’t you noticed the creeping black fog?” Ouyang Changqing nodded and asked, “Big sister, you should’ve seen how good big brother Zhuo is. He beat up three Sword Kings and after challenging Invincible Sword, dashed straight in to face the sea demon. Invincible Sword must’ve followed after big brother for a fight as well without delay, all plunging straight into the black fog…”
“You’re telling me Patriarch is after Zhuo Fan?” Bali Yuyu gasped in fright.
[Is he going to survive with Patriarch on his heels?]
Ouyang Changqing smirked, “Big sister, take it easy. Dad said the sea demon is worse by a mile than Invincible Sword. Since big brother went for the sea demon, then what’s there to fear some Invincible Sword? I’m sure that with a savage beast before him, Invincible Sword would be sure to turn into a sniveling coward. The only danger to big brother can only come from the sea demon. It would make Invincible Sword look like an amateur by comparison, he-he-he…”
“A-he-hem, look who you’re speaking to!”
Wu Qingqiu glared and cleared his throat before speaking heavily, “Frigid Rain Sword King, Ouyang Changqing is crude in his meaning. Brother Zhuo is level-headed and would not come all the way to face the sea demon without precaution. If he can handle the sea demon, that means Invincible Sword is of no consequence.”
“Yeah, so lighten up. You’re better off worrying about our situation. Dad said once the sea demon’s black fog spreads, everyone is done for. They’re now trying to stop it. We better take the chance and run, so as not to drag them down.”
“Then leave, coward!”
Bali Yuyu bore her sharp stare into him, “I don’t know how dangerous the sea demon is, but I am clear on Patriarch’s strength. No, once Patriarch is after him, no begging from my part will spare him…”
Bali Yuyu shot for the black fog, shouting behind her, “Leave! I’ve escorted you here so I’ve fulfilled his request!”
“Now even big sis left. With all of us injured, we’ll be dead for sure if anything happens.”
Ouyang Changqing chuckled and shrugged, staring hard at the opened teleportation array, “So we’re going, right? Right?”
Wu Qingqiu sighed with a twitching face, “Do you have to ask? Staying won’t do any of us any good.”
And made the first move towards leaving, with others close behind.
“Wait, senior brother Wu. Qingcheng won’t leave!”
Shui Ruohua cried after him, “We’ve been here for a while but Qingcheng refuses to budge. It feels like she won’t leave until Zhuo Fan returns.”
Wu Qingqiu sighed in understanding, “Junior sister Chu won’t be pleased, but staying here will only burden brother Zhuo. We’re leaving, even if we must force junior sister Chu to come along.”
Wu Qingqiu and Ye Lin shared a look and flanked Chu Qingcheng. Ouyang Changqing was most eager, joining them with a bright smile, “Sister-in-law, pardon me. It’s for your own good. Big brother Zhuo doesn’t want you hurting. I know you can’t understand me, so… sorry.”
The guys grabbed her shoulders…
“Aah!”
Akin to divine intervention, Chu Qingcheng heard a most familiar wail.
She shuddered and the guys were blown away. Ouyang Changqing even staggered before smacking his rear on the pavement. The sharp pain made him wince and tear up.
“S-sister-in-law, please, we’re only trying to help. Why shield yourself with Yuan Qi and hurt us? Don’t you know how injured we are? We can’t take your…”
While he was whining, the western lands group looked at Chu Qingcheng in shock.
In all these years Chu Qingcheng had lost her mind, she hardly showed any reaction, let alone using Yuan Qi for anything. Did this mean she was back?
They all lit up, with Shui Ruohua grabbing her shoulder in excitement, “Qingcheng, y-you’re awake…”
“Z-Zhuo Fan…” After all these years silent, she stammered a familiar name, her eyes flashing now and then.
Everyone was overjoyed.
[It’s a miracle! Or maybe triumphant love? In only a few days brother Zhuo did what we couldn’t in years of trying.]
[A heart can heal only with the right medicine!]
Shui Ruohua was ecstatic, tears of joy brimming in her eyes. Chu Qingcheng’s lips trembled, while her eyes took on a look of horror, “Z-Zhuo Fan is in danger. H-he’s in danger…”
She then shot in the air, straight into the black mist.
“Qingcheng, wait!”
Shui Ruohua panicked and rushed right after her, but the minute she tried using her energy, she coughed blood, falling back. None of the ethers could do anything, too weak to follow.
They came out wounded from the fight with the ten princes and merely walking was a miracle. Flying was out of the question.
Watching Chu Qingcheng vanish, Ouyang Changqing sighed, “Where’s big sister when you need her? Sister-in-law hasn’t been hurt like us, making it impossible to catch her. Did she snap?”
“She’s not crazy, just her mind dulled. Since she woke up just now, why take off like that?” Wu Qingqiu frowned as he pondered, “She mentioned Zhuo Fan being in danger. Did you hear her too?”
Ouyang Changqing shrugged, “Maybe she’s hearing things or restless? Big brother Zhuo is definitely in danger in the black mist, but how could we ever know? We’re not only miles away but even standing before the mist, there’s no way to notice whatever’s going on in there. How is sister-in-law so sure then? She totally snapped!”
“Then I fear…”
Wu Qingqiu looked in the distance then sighed, “Their hearts are connected. That means brother Zhuo is in serious peril…”
The rest tensed, looking grave and worried.
Bali Yuyu was rushing through the dark fog when she stumbled upon four people flying out.
She gasped in recognition.
[Ugh, can I just pretend I didn’t see them?]
Bali Yuyu shook, conflicted between Zhuo Fan in the mist and the four people.
She wanted to make sure Zhuo Fan was safe, which was impossible if the four caught up to her.
So she spotted some ruins around and wanted to avoid them like a plague. But that blasted Baili Yuyun just had to spot her just then, shouting, “Is that Yuyu? Come quick, Patriarch’s hurt…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1100 - 1100, Wait
chapters.content:
Chapter 1100, Wait
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
[Damn you and those blasted eyes of yours. I was this close to dodging you. Just you wait. The moment I get the chance, I’ll be sure to gouge those shifty eyes out of your skull!]
Bali Yuyu’s heart raged while flying over to the four in annoyance disguised as shock, “Patriarch is hurt? How? Is this how you three protect him?”
Baili Yuyun sighed, “Not even our best was enough. The sea demon is absurd. He couldn’t even touch him.”
“The s-sea demon is that strong, for even Patriarch to…”
Bali Yuyu’s heart sank, knowing Zhuo Fan was in there alone with that beast. How could Zhuo Fan stand a chance where Invincible Sword failed?
Filled with worry, Baili Yuyu turned to the black fog with tense fists.
Baili Yutian failed to notice Baili Yuyu’s shift. Maybe the deep wounds scrambled his senses. He coughed iced and burning blood and sighed, “I’ve never seen strength like the sea demon’s. I have suffered a complete defeat. But this is only the beginning. One day, I will come to challenge ag-, ugh…”
Invincible Sword coughed fire and ice again, his face white as paper.
“Patriarch, don’t speak. We better look for a quiet place to heal. We can’t ignore your wounds!” Baili Yuyun urged.
Invincible Sword waved him off, sighing and looking at the black fog behind with determination, “No, I’m staying. I have lost, but I want to see with my own eyes the result of such a powerful showdown and its victor.”
“Powerful showdown?”
Baili Yuyu lit up, “Patriarch, is someone still in there fighting the sea demon?”
Baili Yutian took a deep breath and nodded. Baili Yuyun sighed with a grumble, “Yuyu, speaking of, I have something to say to you. How in heaven’s name did you even do your investigation? Because of you we were this close to making a mess of this and getting wiped out.”
“W-what did I do?” Baili Yuyu was baffled.
Baili Yuyun spat, “You have the nerve to ask? Did you not say that Zhuo kid is in Soul Harmony Stage at best, a trifle?”
“Uh, yeah, why…”
“Why?! Did it ever occur to you that the missie next to him might have a powerful bauble to give us, Sword Kings, heavy wounds? That child almost had all three of us killed!”
Baili Yuyun shot a reproaching glare, with the two nodding along, feeling victimized.
It was utterly mortifying for a wee girl to make them scramble away in fright. If word got out in the central area, they’d have no self-respect left to even walk outside.
Baili Yuyu gave a confuzed shake of her head, “You mean Qiao’er? But she’s adorable. How can she be… tough?”
“Adorable? That’s news to me!”
Baili Yuyun’s face twitched, fuming along with his two brothers, “Like father like daughter, like master like disciple. With the small one godlike, the parent couldn’t be any lesser! Did you not know she has a trinket to handle Sword Kings? What’s worse, her dad had something that could end Patriarch! Heaven almighty, he just took out a 9th level imperial beast for crying out loud; his spirit animal no less. That’s a damn 9th level imperial beast! I’m willing to bet not all Nine Sword Kings combined could put a dent in its plumage before getting annihilated!”
Sss~
Baili Yuyu gasped, “A 9th level imperial beast? Wasn’t that just a myth? It exists? And he has one?”
“You didn’t know?”
“Not a hint!”
“That’s why I’m asking, how did you make your investigation?” Baili Yuyun huffed and puffed, turning at the end to Baili Yutian, “We were fortunate Patriarch’s skill is divine to kill the 9h level imperial beast, the true best in the lands.”
Ignoring the blatant suck-up, Baili Yutian felt he was at the lowest point in his life to mind anything else.
Baili Yuyu’s heart jumped in shock, “Patriarch killed the beast? When it was his turn, did Patriarch finish him off?”
Ugh!
Baili Yuyun shook from a sudden chill, his face sinking. He peeked at Invincible Sword then barked, “Don’t stick your nose where it doesn’t belong. He can never again be mentioned anywhere near Patriarch!”
“But aren’t I talking with you, brother Yun?”
“I’m saying your info is faulty and almost got us killed. Don’t mention it again…”
“Alright!”
Baili Yutian raised his voice, sighing at the black fog, “I was about to fight with him when the sea demon arrived. He was after the sea demon and I wanted to meet it too, all of us entered its domain. I arrived there just to see him frozen by the sea demon and challenged the beast. It ended with me frozen as well before I could even get close.
“By the time I woke up, I’d found myself gravely wounded along with the three of them. But I witnessed a most shocking scene, one that I would never forget for as long as I live.”
“What?” Baili Yuyu was nervous, eager to know.
Baili Yutian sighed, “Zhuo Fan and the sea demon fought. He was clearly not to its level, but thanks to an ingenious skill, he was slowly gaining advantage. The sea demon was forced to just take his attacks. That happened after sea demon was gravely wounded, near death. I don’t know how he did it, but I’m certain he was behind it. It was thanks to his showdown with the sea demon that a heat wave blasted over us and thawed the ice while also leaving us with deep wounds.
“With how the sea demon suffered at such a blow, it’s clear that once the two of us fought, I’d have been reduced to ashes. What Invincible Sword, ha-ha-ha! I’ve been blind all my life, unable to see the vastness of the world!”
The Sword Kings lowered their heads. Baili Yuyun shot a glare at Baili Yuyu, “See? This is what your report did, downplaying the tiger into a cat. He almost ripped us to shreds. It’s giving me the chills just thinking about it!’
Baili Yuyu was stumped, blinking her big dull eyes of their fog.
[The guy is that great? He sure didn’t look like it…]
“Patriarch, you’re waiting for the fight to end but how will you find out the winner? It’d be better if you tended your wounds!” Baili Yuyun bowed.
Baili Yutian said, “It’s simple. We can’t see their fight but the end will be obvious. If Zhuo Fan wins, he’ll be coming out. If the sea beast won, the black fog would retreat leaving nothing behind it.”
“Retreat? Why would he?”
“Ha-ha-ha, the sea demon would’ve won a pyrrhic victory. Is he supposed to wait here for other humans to kill it instead of licking his wounds?”
Baili Yutian’s eyes shone with conviction, “So I’ll be waiting right here for the conclusion and confirm my next great rival.”
The Sword Kings started and nodded, staying with him.
Bali Yuyu was nervous as she remained here, waiting not for the end, but with hope in her heart that he would come out of the black mist.
Whoosh~
Someone shot past just then and plunged into the fog. Baili Yuyu cried out, “Didn’t she transfer away? What’s she doing here? Can’t those louses do anything?”
“Oh, someone found it tedious and came to die.”
Baili Yuyun noticed and mocked, “That right there is a fight that could end even us, watching from the sidelines. For a mere girl in the 5th layer of Ethereal Stage to go in is plain suicidal. Ha-ha-ha…”
“Or maybe the kid won and she’ll be safe.”
“Or the kid lost and the sea demon wouldn’t spare a single human.”
“It’s all up to fate, ha-ha-ha…”
The three Sword Kings jeered, with Bali Yuyu nervous as to what to do. Should she go in? But she squashed the thought as soon as it popped.
[I was to save her for that rotten punk, but now he’s in a fight to the death so why bother with her fate?]
[Whatever, let her go. It’s all the same to me however she ends up.]
Bali Yuyu’s eyes shone coldly, her heart taking a crueler stance.
[It’s better if she’s gone. Then the punk would have no one to worry about, ha-ha-ha…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1101 - 1101, Four Sacred Beasts
chapters.content:
Chapter 1101, Four Sacred Beasts
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Aah!”
In a world of snow and ice, Zhuo Fan howled with black flames writhing all over him. Qiao’er panicked, turning to Sea Ao, “Uncle, w-what’s happening?”
“The Divine Eye of the Void he inherited is too weak while the black thunderflame is savage power beyond any level, now out of his control. Going to extremes, it’s very easy for the black flame to run amok, eating him instead.”
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao was grave, “He has been using the eye skill through the fight and the Divine Eye of the Void reached its limit for controlling the thunderflame’s nature, thus lashing out. But where did he get the thunderflame from? Why is it so violent? Why doesn’t my seal work on it?”
Qiao’er grew anxious, “Uncle Sea Ao, dad’s apocalyptic thunderflame is made of four sacred beast’s powers of terrible strength. How can it be controlled?”
“The power of four sacred beasts? How?”
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao started and paused, “Did Nine Serenities’ research succeed? Kid, whose successor are you?”
“My master… is Nine Serenities Sovereign… agh!”
“I see, then the old guy did it!”
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao nodded and sighed, “That’s why the thunderflame is so wild, made up of four sacred beasts’ powers, while above our level so my sealing doesn’t work.”
“Uncle Sea Ao, help him! There has to be something we can do!”
Qiao’er could not take it anymore. Zhuo Fan’s wails and seeing him cooked under the flame brought her to tears as she urged Heaven Sealing Sea Ao. The beas sighed, “The kid gave his all and some in taking all my malice for humanity so he could save young Qilin. I admire his spirit and I could’ve helped at the start, but weak as I am from the old dragon’s fire, it is impossible to suppress the thunderflame. Water and fire are opposite and I’m also powerless right now. Or else I would’ve sealed him as he jumped around.”
“What can we do?”
“Nothing. I’m hanging by a thread as is.” Heaven Sealing Sea Ao shook his head.
Qiao’er was crying now, filled with pain and worry for Zhuo Fan.
Whoosh~
Three flashes came out of the thick black fog and straight for Heaven Sealing Sea Ao.
The three divine swords that slipped out of their owners’ grasp sensed Sea Ao’s energy and shot for it to kill this sacred beast.
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao winced, about to submerge under the sea, but Heaven Sealing Sword flew around the beast and sent a sword wave freezing his body in place.
The other two divine swords stabbed deep into his shoulders, drawing blood.
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao roared in pain, “Curses, despicable, striking someone who is down. Have you no shame ganging up on me? Is this how your master taught you?”
To mock him, the divine swords gathered then split again, each striking from a different direction and punching holes in Sea Ao’s bulk.
“Uncle Sea Ao, what’s wrong? Three swords can’t be that tough. Why…” Qiao’er cried out.
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao felt like crying, “I know these sacred weapons better than you. They can’t do much without absorbing sacred stones, but as I am now I can’t even seal them. They’re taking advantage of my state and with the fire and water in conflict within my body stopping me from sealing them. Not to mention they’re sharp as hell. I can’t hold on much longer, agh!”
Sea Ao howled in pain, with Qiao’er by herself in worry, “What do I do? I’ll take on a sacred weapon for you!”
“Don’t! They may be weak now, but you’re no match still. You’ll only die!” Sea Ao shook his large head to stop her. He waved his large palm around and slapped the Heaven Sealing Sword away.
The two swords, however, used the opening to shoot through his chest, drawing another howl out of him. Even with the flesh wounds the swords were giving him, with enough time death would come in the end. Not to mention his bane was among them, the Heaven Sealing Sword.
Sea Ao grew restless by the second.
[What rotten luck today has brought. I should’ve just stayed home instead.]
Thinking humans were at war, he planned on causing extra damage to them, only to be the one to get damaged and near death.
[Blast it all to hell! Couldn’t I have checked the stars before coming here?]
Whoosh~
The divine swords ran circles around him, making Sea Ao cry out every time. Qiao’er was unable to sit still from anxiety. Sea Ao was the only one that could help Zhuo Fan. Without him, Zhuo Fan was doomed.
She was powerless to help anyone.
“Divine Eye of the Void’s 7th stage, Void Seal!”
Beneath the corrosive thunderflame, seven golden rings shone followed by a shout like that of a beast from hell.
Hum~
The three divine swords jerked, but they reacted too slow to get away and the spatial ripple caught them. The swords clanged on the ice, their sword spirits gone.
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao sighed.
Crack~
“Agh!”
The black thunderflame grew more berserk, eating away Zhuo Fan’s entire left eye. Without it to curb it, the thunderflame feasted itself on Zhuo Fan, giving him searing pain.
“Father!”
Qiao’er cried out in tears, with Sea Ao hesitating, “Kid, thank you for that. I’m amazed you’d help me despite the cruel predicament you’re in.”
“Ha-ha-ha, it’s… nothing.”
Zhuo Fan strained to swallow the agonizing cries as he smiled, “I was not helping you. I never owe anyone anything. You save my son then consider the debt paid.”
“That won’t do, not when saving a fellow sacred beast is a must.” Heaven Sealing Sea Ao spoke.
Zhuo Fan said, “You’re saving young Sanzi as a sacred beast, but he’s my son. Such a favor I have to pay back. Also, this is also my wish. I knew the thunderflame would take me one day. It just so happened to be today. My life was doomed from the start. But young Sanzi and Qiao’er have yet to grow and protect themselves. Few are those worthy of absolute trust in this world as well.”
“Sorry, but now it’s my turn to entrust you. These children need someone. Senior Sea Ao is their elder, worthy of trust. I saved you so that you may become their rock. I hope seniors will look after them. Qiao’er, I’m going. Use the recoil array to free seniors from their torment. This is your future and your only hope. They’ll look after you and be safe. I’ll also give you the tools to achieve it. Find Wu Randong in the Serene Shores Trading. I had everything laid out.”
“Father!”
Qiao’er kneeled at his feet in tears.
Zhuo Fan smiled, wishing to hold her one last time but drew back his hand after seeing the violent black flames.
His road was at an end. But unlike his last life, he had a legacy, making it worth it…
Zhuo Fan took a deep breath and closed his eyes, focusing on reining in the pain he felt yet his heart was at peace.
[This life has been brief, but fulfilling…]
Sea Ao shouted at last, “Kid, it’s too soon to give up. I can’t stop the black flames, but I can give you the means to do it yourself! Take it!”
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao gouged out his eye.
Blood spurted like a fountain, dyeing the sea red.
Sea Ao offered his palm and in it rested a blue and dazzling eye…

chapters.title: Chapter 1102 - 1102, Blue Glow
chapters.content:
Chapter 1102: Blue Glow
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Uncle Sea Ao…” Qiao’er shuddered, looking stunned at the huge bloody eye.
Sea Ao smirked, gazing upon the eye and the scar it had, “That brat, Sword Sovereign, gave it a scratch but it still has my sealing power. It should work in sealing the black fire from exploding.”
“Really?” Qiao’er lit up.
Sea Ao nodded, smiling despite the blood seeping from the empty socket.
Zhuo Fan grimaced as he strove to speak, “Senior Sea Ao, thank you for your assistance. I am very sorry to have made you to sacrifice senior’s eye…”
“Ha-ha, it’s just a useless eyeball. Nothing to it!”
Sea Ao said, “You helped me deal with the sacred weapons. Being incapable of letting go of some eye would only make me look no different from those despicable humans. I would then have no ground and right to hate them. Now get ready to take my seal. I don’t like owing anyone, just like you.”
Sea Ao threw his eye and used his palms to pressure the huge eye and send power into it, soon shining blue. It then shrank down to the size of a human eyeball, drifting toward Zhuo Fan encased in black flames.
The violent fire sensed a deep chill coming from it and cooled somewhat.
Relaxing from the unspeakable pain, Zhuo Fan sighed, nodding at Sea Ao. He waited for the blue glow to enter his body and get the flames under control.
Whoosh!
The eye was about to enter its new place when fire flashed by and sent the eye flying.
Sea Ao cried out, crying out in shock, “What was that?”
“T-Thunderflame Void Annihilation!”
Zhuo Fan looked stumped, “Why? I didn’t even use it, agh!”
He clutched his head as the black flames came back with a vengeance.
Thunderflames cracked the air as it shot all over. Zhuo Fan raised his heavy head, sending lightning like a machine gun.
The dangerous thunderflame struck down in endless numbers, leaving everywhere black flames. Qiao’er jumped away, trying not to get that terrible fire from touching her. Heaven Sealing Sea Ao had trouble with his large bulk, taking on dozens of thunderflames. He once again howled in pain as blood seeped out from the new wounds.
“Aah!”
Zhuo Fan gripped his head in agony. His right eye’s seven golden halos flickered, with traces of black thunderflame on their edges and eating their way through the gold.
Qiao’er cried out, dodging while shouting, “Uncle Sea Ao, what do we do? You have to help him!”
“Agh! Blast it, his black flames made the Divine Eye of the Void lash out as well!”
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao howled as he jerked from every hit, “Divine Eye of the Void is Heavenly Sovereign’s top skill, focused on the void in particular. In layman terms, its a vessel sealing large amounts of power for his use. But even he could only ever hold the Berserk Purple Lightning. Now the kid holds the far more ruthless apocalyptic thunderflame. His skill is far below Heavenly Sovereign as well and makes it impossible to contain such insane power.
“As he can’t seal the thunderflame, it runs amok. Before was just a bit of violent outburst, while now it crushed its vessel. Divine Eye of the Void has been infected and got out of control as well. The kid is in dire straights now. Once Divine Eye of the Void is ruined, he loses any means of holding the power and it would burn him to ashes.”
Qiao’er cried out, “What do we do? What of your eye? Can it help dad?”
“Not anymore.”
Sea Ao shook his head with a deep frown, “He had the Divine Eye of the Void to help settled the savage flames with my eye. Now the Divine Eye of the Void is out of control and has no vessel. Nothing can contain this power, not even me.”
“Can’t your eye act as vessel?”
“Are you kidding? I am Heaven Sealing Sea Ao with the innate power of sealing. My eye has the same power, it’s already full of it to accept anything else.”
Sea Ao rolled his eyes, “And what spatial power is stronger anyway than Heavenly Sovereign’s Divine Eye of the Void? His occular skill rises in power with the user. It’s not like a sacred beast’s innate ability. Not to mention the thunderflame is above our powers. We have no hope of containing it. It can only be the Divine Eye of the Void. My eye has the power to settle it so he could get it under control.”
“There’s nothing we can do to save father?”
“It’s unclear.”
Sea Ao shook his head, “He just lost control of Divine Eye of the Void for now and is yet to be ruined as well. We just have to purge the thunderflame from his body and I’ll seal his eyes. With nothing to generate the flames, it will settle. The problem is how to do it? As he is now he’s a chariot run amok. We have to seal the eye generating the thunderflame then the Divine Eye of the Void to mend it.”
Whoosh~
Black thunderflame shot by his face in streaks and exploded high in hte sky, punching a huge hole. In it was a bizarre view, a fantastical paradise of rivers mountains and nature.
Sss~
Sea Ao gasped, dumbstruck. Qiao’er shouted, “T-this is father’s power? His Thunderflame Void Annihilation is amazing but not like this. He wouldn’t have needed Three-headed Crow otherwise to intimidate the Sword Kings and Invincible Sword.”
“This isn’t his, it’s the thunderflame exerting far more than he can handle.”
Blanking a few seconds, Sea Ao turned to Zhuo Fan and shook his head, “The thunderflame is out of his complete control and it only grows stronger until it consumes him. If we want to save him, we need to seal it fast!”
Qiao’er panicked, crying from feebleness. the thunderflame was beyond deadly. And now that the Divine Eye of the Void went crazy too, everything was truly apocalyptic. Who could stop something like this?
[Father is the source so how in heaven’s name do we remove all thunderflames from him?]
Qiao’er had tears streaming down her cheeks as she watched Zhuo howling in the flames. Sea Ao dodged the painful strikes while looking at the eye in his hand with a sigh.
[It’s too late now…]
Whoosh~
A flash of white streaked passed them, ignoring the savage flames and hugging Zhuo Fan’s contorted figure from pain. Soft lips then took his.
Hu~
A twister enveloped the two, with the woman in white unleashing a pure glow that soon covered the two of them. They had formed around them an exquisite array that shook the world, with the spiritual energy from everywhere surging over. Zhuo Fan’s black thunderflame surged like a tide at the woman.
“Mother…”
Qiao’er muttered. Heaven Sealing Sea Ao started, looking at the spiritual energy flow around them and lit up, “There’s always a way! The brat must’ve saved the world in his last life to have such godlike luck! Heaven Sealing Sea Ao, We can seal it!”
Sea Ao gripped the eye and his lone eye shone with determination…

chapters.title: Chapter 1103 - 1103, Cosmic Soul Nurturing Array
chapters.content:
Chapter 1103: Cosmic Soul Nurturing Array
Proofreader
: Papatonks
In a black space, the black flames spread to every corner, burning the five-hundred-meter-long prismatic dragon. It howled from pain, its pristine scales and sharp claws eaten away.
In moments, the dragon’s size was reduced to a third.
The dragon squinted and sighed.
He gave up hope.
[With the death of my soul, I’ll be erased from this world.]
The dragon closed its eyes, at peace.
He had given up on everything, but then Sea Ao gave his eye to save him, sparking hope. Now not even Sea Ao could do anything to get him out of this disaster.
All these changes led to an uneasy heart from peace. He was better off not even trying.
[Alive or dead, Zhuo Fan, haven’t you made peace with it?]
The dragon smiled, free of pain and ignoring the burning flames.
Hu~
A wind blue out of nowhere, brushing the flames and the dragon. The huge dragon froze.
[Where’s the pain?]
He opened his eyes to gaze in shock.
[Where’s the thunderflame?]
The cooling breeze passed once more through the space. Pure light followed, shining down like fireflies, bringing a touch of color to this dark place and hope into the huge dragon’s eyes.
[Why is this light so familiar…]
The dragon stared, feeling soothed under the glow as the light slowly seeped into his body and healed his battered soul. The huge dragon stood proud and majestic once more.
[What’s going on? I was about to die so why am I alive? Where did the light come from? Did senior Sea Ao manage to save me? Can I go back to Qingcheng and fight the Invincible Sword?]
The dragon roared in laughter, focusing his senses on his real body.
Sss~
The thunderflame was still around, but Zhuo Fan’s pain subsided, opening his eyes.
What he saw left him in utter shock, “Qingcheng…”
Chu Qingcheng was hugging and kissing him, though her eyes were still lost. She had done this out of nothing but instinct…
“Qingcheng, hurry and let go!”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shook, noticing the ravaging thunderflame around him and Chu Qingcheng. He shouted with panic.
He wanted to get his lover away and not drag her down. Only to find out he had no strength to even twitch a finger, leaving him confused.
Sea Ao smiled, “Awake, are we? He-he-he, kid, I don’t know what miracles you did in your past life to have someone exchange their life to save yours in such a doomed situation. You truly are fortunate!”
“Exchange with mine?”
Zhuo Fan reacted at last, the thunderflame now moved from him to Chu Qingcheng and burned her instead.
Zhuo Fan gasped, finding himself powerless to help. “Qingcheng, leave! I don’t want you to save me, just go…”
Chu Qingcheng didn’t hear him, her sightless eyes staring back at him with her body using her Yuan Qi to take his flames into herself.
Zhuo Fan’s heart was in constant pain, the right eye and the now empty and black left socket shedding bitter tears of sorrow, “Qingcheng, leave! I don’t need saving…”
“Kid, you just don’t know how to count your blessings. Who could save you as you are?”
Sea Ao glanced at him, “That thunderflame is devastating and needs the right vessel to contain all its power. But this girl has the Empty Spirit Body. Do you know what that means? Since ancient times, hardly anyone understood its real implications. Allow me to enlighten you. Heavenly Sovereign has the Empty Spirit Body. It’s why he got to create the Divine Eye of the Void and grasp sovereignty through the spatial path!
“Now you get it? She has the same body as Heavenly Sovereign, she can take on your Divine Eye of the Void’s role into containing the violent thunderflames. Her soul is a domain soul practicing arrays. With the power of one person, an array can be formed. This array is baffling, able to draw upon the cosmic cycle’s power, but not to fight. It is to help. Your soul was about to fade but the girl saved you in time. Even with the flames off you, you’d end up a wreck with that ruined soul of yours. Now though, your very core is intact and safe, able to reach sovereignty without a worry. And all thanks to this lass, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan shuddered, looking around lost. Thanks to his extensive experience in arrays, he could glean into its functions despite not having a base, “Cosmic Soul Nurturing Array… h-how can someone know it? How is it you know it?”
Zhuo Fan shed tears as she looked at Chu Qingcheng, his heart in agony, “I clearly ruined it…”
“Yes, even as a sacred beast I can tell this array focuses on soul recovery, a life for a life. Every soul is unique, making using the array lead to soul clashes. That’s why only the Empty Spirit Body can use it.”
Sea Ao sighed, “Kid, no one would ever turn their soul into panacea for another. Unless she did it for one person, to save him when he needed it most. Kid, you are fortunate to have someone who cares for you so much, to give their life for you.”
The tears flowed out of his control. Zhuo Fan stared into Chu Qingcheng’s empty eyes, filled with sorrow and anguish.
[Her only thoughts were for me, but she still doesn’t recognize me…]
Zhuo Fan shouted, “Qiao’er, get her back!”
Qiao’er shook and took a step forward.
“It’s too late now!”
Sea Ao spoke, “They’re both affected by the thunderflame. Taking the girl will only lead to both of them dying. Let this continue and the brat can be saved. it’s either both of you die, or just one. The choice should be obvious for a smart guy like you.”
“Then I’ll die with her.”
“Throw her off yourself then. Don’t involve the little Thunder Phoenix!”
Sea Ao snapped back, “Little Thunder Phoenix sees you as a father and her as mother. She’ll be killing the both of you. As a father, you should not let your own child carry such guilt.
“Senior Sea Ao, you do it!”
“Don’t feel like it. I gouged my eye out for you and everything. Letting you die would mean I maimed myself for nothing.” Sea Ao glared at him and turned to the pitiful Qiao’er, “This is love, something every Sovereign experienced. He needs this pain.”
“But father…” Qingcheng hesitated watching Zhuo Fan struggle to get Chu Qingcheng away.
Sea Ao smiled, “He’s now weak due to the thunderflame exhausting his Yuan Qi. As drained as he is, he can do nothing but go with our wishes.”
Sea Ao glanced at the two. The black flames were mostly on Chu Qingcheng now, leaving only a little left within Zhuo Fan’s body. Chu Qingcheng could take in no more. And the more there was of the thunderflame, the faster she burned. At this rate the flames would consume her before she finished.
Sea Ao mulled over the situation, his eyes drifting to the three divine swords.
“The lass alone can’t take all the flames. We need to amplify the array!”
Sea Ao flicked and the three divine swords floated over as he mumbled, “The array uses the heaven cycle’s power and needs the five elements at its core to showcase its might. But we don’t have them. I am only able to replace earth, fire, water and wind.”
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao held out a scarlet sword and stuck it at a spot around Chu Qingcheng, “Soaring Sword, representing the boundless earth!”
Ding!
Soaring Sword was on Chu Qingcheng’s left, shining scarlet.
“Heaven Sealing Sword, representing the surging water!”
Ding!
Heaven Sealing Sword stuck three meters from Chu Qingcheng.
“Decimating Sword, representing the scorching fire!”
Ding!
Decimating Sword stabbed where Sea Ao gestured.
The problem was, what came next?
Sea Ao frowned but heard a whistle as a black sword floated before him, its blade quivering…

chapters.title: Chapter 1104 -1104, Sovereign Path
chapters.content:
Chapter 1104: Sovereign Path
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Vaulting Sword?”
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao just stared at it for a while, flinching awake, “What’s with that look? I didn’t even recognize you!”
Then his eyes lit up, “The sword spirit changed, right?”
Ding!
Vaulting Sword hummed in agreement.
“Why else wouldn’t you gang up on me with the others? It all makes sense, you changed your master, ha-ha-ha…”
Sea Ao laughed, then grew grave, “The kid sure is something to change even a sacred sword’s spirit for his own use. As a Heavenly Sovereign inheritor it’s only natural though. That means you want to save your master as well. Go! Vaulting Sword, representing the billowing wind!”
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao pointed and the Vaulting Sword struck the exact spot, three meters from Chu Qingcheng.
With the four divine swords included, the array surged and the earth shook. The black thunderflame on Chu Qingcheng spread among the divine swords, tainting them black with lightning.
Chu Qingcheng shook as well, taking in more of Zhuo Fan’s black flames into herself through the array.
Her power increased and took it all in with greater speed, leaving the excess her body could not contain to the four divine swords.
For the next half hour, Zhuo Fan watched as the thunderflame left from him to Chu Qingcheng with tears in his eyes and pain in his heart. Chu Qingcheng was committed, despite the fire eroding her into nothingness.
Two hours later, the last trace of thunderflame left Zhuo Fan. Sea Ao went fast into action, before any more were generated in his body. He shot the blue eye into Zhuo Fan’s face, burrowing into the left socket and releasing icy energy.
Hum~
Divine Eye of the Void was still out of control and felt hostility towards this intruder, shining in seven golden halos, unleashing a terrible power.
Luck had it the Divine Eye of the Void was far from trained to perfection, just at the 7th stage. While Sea Ao’s eye belonged to a sacred beast, albeit damaged. It still proved enough. Using it while the apocalyptic thunderflame had still been around though, and the Divine Eye of the Void would’ve had the upper hand.
With the main problem gone, the Divine Eye of the Void alone posed no danger. Even Heavenly Sovereign showed its strongest power when both eyes worked together. One eye was easy to seal.
Before Divine Eye of the Void got any more ideas, Heaven Sealing Sea Ao held out his palm and unleashed a cold twister upon Zhuo Fan. The heaven-sealing eye joined in to cover both eyes.
Sss~
Zhuo Fan’s eyes had a layer of ice over them, with a cryptic seal forming on his forehead.
With it, Zhuo Fan’s vision went black, losing sight of everything, including that of his wife burning away from the black fire…
Hu~
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao eased a long breath, nodding, “Kid, the Apocalyptic Thunderflame Eye ran amok, damaging Divine Eye of the Void as well. You will have a hard time controlling the two skills for the next while. I have used a heaven seal on your eyes to save them. When the Divine Eye of the Void recovers, you will grasp the seal on Apocalyptic Thunderflame Eye and can open it. Abusing the thunderflame will only get you killed. It’s for your own good so you better take care!”
“Qingcheng…”
Zhuo Fan only focused on his grip on Chu Qingcheng’s hand, his ears flooded with the hissing of the black flames. He didn’t need eyes to know, the sorrow eating him up inside as he bit his lip.
“Qingcheng, answer me, even if it’s with few words. Why do you want to save me…”
Chu Qingcheng stared back, devoid of any emotion even as the black thunderflame ate her flesh. Then she closed her eyes as her life got drained away.
“Aah!”
Zhuo Fan howled, his emotions all over the place. He couldn’t even cry from the seal.
Sea Ao sighed, “There’s no fault in a man’s tears. Crying helps in times of great sorrow. Though it doesn’t look like you can, nothing coming out from the seal…
“This girl can’t be saved either. May she rest in peace.” Sea Ao’s eyes held nothing but respect for her, “Humans are the most fascinating creatures, capable of so much evil but there are also those worthy of respect.”
“Aah!”
Zhuo Fan cried himself hoarse, shouting at the sky with a red face, his heart unable to bear this crushing sorrow.
Qiao’er watched her father’s weak struggle and mother’s demise in tears. She forced the sobs away, though, not wishing to cause more pain to her father.
Sea Ao sighed.
[The young Thunder Phoenix is more human by the second. But I don’t hate it, ha-ha-ha…]
Sorrow took Sea Ao as well as he watched Chu Qingcheng almost gone under the thudnerflame’s attack.
“The body is almost finished and now comes the soul. Once it is gone, she may rest. You have given me one last frail hope in humanity…”
“Qingcheng!”
Hum~
With Zhuo Fan’s last cry of immense grief, one tear shining in seven colors came from beyond the icy seal and fell down his face.
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao gasped, “How? Not even the black flames can escape my seal so how can a tear?”
The tear was just that grand, defying his common sense as it swaggered down.
It was like smacking him senseless.
[Is there a leak in my seal, or what? Even so, there’s no way a mere tear can slip out.]
Zhuo Fan was in too much pain to register his cry of shock, using his all just to shout his pain. His mind blacked out and he fell limp.
But the prismatic tear fell from his face and onto the still burning Chu Qingcheng.
Hum~
A multicolored light exploded, erasing the black flames. A mote of white floated out of the body under the cover of the prismatic light, coming before Sea Ao.
“The Undying Sovereign path?”
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao gapped, looking at Zhuo Fan in stupefaction, “How can it be? How can the kid have a Sovereign path’s protection? Only the ten Sovereigns can…”
Sea Ao’s eyes grew grave.
[Just who on earth is he?]
Qiao’er started, pointing at the prismatic glow, “Uncle Sea Ao, w-what’s that?”
“Any that delved deep into Dao becomes a forefather of that path, a Sovereign, as he forms his Sovereign path he grasped from the heavens. He would be as undying as the world itself.”
Graver than ever, Sea Ao glanced at the prismatic light, “This glow can only come from those understanding The Ten Paths to Heaven, something only a Sovereign can wield, the Sovereign path. It is the core of their beliefs. They would never fall so long as it stays strong. The girl was on the brink of having her soul erased, but the Sovereign path saved her last trace.”
Qiao’er was overjoyed, “Does that mean mother is saved?”
“Of course, and not just saved, but protected under the Sovereign path. There’s only a handful of beings that can touch her in the world.”
Sea Ao’s eye shook as he watched Zhuo Fan unconscious from the heartache, his eye gleaming, “Young Thunder Phoenix, just who is your godfather? Why does he know one of the The Ten Paths to Heaven?”
Qiao’er started then shook her head.
Looking between the two, Sea Ao turned to the huge hole the thunderflame punched in the sky slowly mending. He snatched the resplendent glow in his hand and threw it into the black hole.
The hole then closed right after it swallowed it.
[Regardless of how this path came to be, with the kid so special, I must get his favor.]
Sea Ao’s eyes shone and smirked at the closing hole, “Girl, see you in the Sacred Domain, ha-ha-ha…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1105 - 1105, Shuddering Heavens
chapters.content:
Chapter 1105, Shuddering Heavens
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Rumble~
The sky was blue, the sun was bright, but a gloom descended with the thundering noise coming out of nowhere and shaking everything in creation. A prismatic glow flooded everywhere, wreaking havoc as it crossed the heavens. It caused the ground to sake as well, incomprehensible as it sounded, surging like waves.
As for the people riding the waves, they were barely standing, with the real experts under a heavy pressure from the light, sealing their power and reduced to weak and frail mortals. Even flying was impossible.
Inside a grand and lavish palace among the trees on Seven Sacred Mountain in the Sacred Domain, a group of white coats with white long beards stooped in an attempt to keep themselves steady.
A broad man with a Van Dyke beard stumbled in through the doors, panic on his face, “Lord Saints, just what is going on? What is this?”
“We know not, but the world is in turmoil, taking it out on everything. This isn’t normal. We’ve been living for a million years but never seen anything like it. Something must’ve happened. Check the archive’s records for anything. The world is about to go through a change!”
“Yes!” The man staggered out at once.
The Ruby Cloud Sect in the Sacred Domain held a group of Daoist women scrambling as they strained to stand upright. One among them, aged, stuck to the wall while looking above at the prismatic phenomenon. Her heart was frantic, her face a mask of fear while her eyes filled with confusion.
[Just what is going on? Has Sacred Domain ever seen such a shocking change?]
Whoosh!
In moments, the prismatic glow faded in the distance. The woman hesitated then rushed unsteadily in the distance, leaving her disciples behind still trying to fight the shaking…
In one corner of the Sacred Domain, devoid of the shock and franticness the rest of the domain felt, in a quiet and isolated manor, a creek snaked about a book pavilion where a hand held a chess piece in hand. It shook once before stilling.
The Sacred Domain began rumbling then, with only him and this place unaffected.
“A Sovereign path appeared?”
Next to him, a man in black and hidden face gasped, “Has he returned so soon? We didn’t even feel it!”
Pa!
The hand finally placed the piece on the board, “The path is present but not the user. It’s quite unexpected for him to separate himself from it.”
“The Sovereign path keeps him alive at all times. With it gone it means his end is nigh!”
The man in black nodded as he said, “Should I investigate who he gave the path to?”
In the dusky room the man laughed in the end, “Don’t bother. The Sovereign path is born of the world and only a Sovereign can find it. We have no chance so why try to. Besides, the person protected by the Sovereign path has to be important. He will stand out with ease and soon will be found. Also, I’m not content with just his path, but his people!”
Pa!
Another chess piece fell, with two glimmer shining peculiar in the gloom. The right shone in twelve golden rings while the right flickering purple.
“Your path returned, but when will your man return? Ha-ha-ha…”
The dark laughter spread through the world, making even the prismatic glow high above shudder…
Rumble~
The Sacred Domain was rumbling still, with every corner jolted around. It took two hours for the prismatic glow to fade and the commotion to die down.
Though all denizens of Sacred Domain were now shaken to the core and confused.
Only some really old and powerful relics knew the truth, as well as the cause of it all, Heaven Sealing Sea Ao, who was grinning after the mortal domain got shaken up as well.
“It’s been too long since the ten Sovereigns formed their paths. That’s the last time I’ve seen such a phenomenon.”
“Uncle Sea Ao, what was that? Why did I feel so weak?” Finally able to stand still without the ground moving beneath her, Qiao’er asked curiously.
Sea Ao sighed, “The coming of a Sovereign path causes stirrings throughout the world. When the ten Sovereigns formed theirs, the same happened. Once the path enters the body, they would be one and the phenomenon ceases.”
“Enters the body, then…” Qiao’er exclaimed.
Sea Ao nodded with a smile, looking at the unconscious Zhuo Fan, “Once the kid wakes up, tell him his destiny with the girl has yet to run its course, ugh!”
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao frowned.
“What’s wrong?” Qiao’er asked.
Sea Ao barked, “Curses, why are humans focusing all their power here? They’re clearly after me. As I am now…”
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao gave his battered body a once over and rolled his eyes in annoyance.
“Humph, the enemy comes in waves and I’m in this sorry state. I don’t plan on playing anymore, I’m leaving now!”
Heaven Sealing Sea Ao slapped the ice and launched a ripple.
Rumble~
Deep sounds echoed out as the ice and the sea was on the move. The black fog withdrew as well, along with his departure. Zhuo Fan and Qiao’er were on the ice too, thus following him to the North Sea as well.
“Hey, what’s happening? What are you doing?”
“Little Thunder Phoenix, you can’t feel it but a flood of strong cultivators are just ahead.”
Sea Ao’s face twitched, “I’m not afraid of a bunch of bugs, not by any means. But I’m wounded and can’t handle them. Don’t humans like to say, know when to quit and make a tactical retreat? I don’t feel like fighting them so I’m going.”
Rumble~
Sea Ao’s claws moved and the ice he was on sped up.
Qiao’er went to Zhuo Fan’s side and left with him.
Baili Yutian’s group outside got their bearings after all the shaking. They looked at the receding black fog and the endless corpses it left behind.
The Invincible Sword and the others flinched, sighing, “The sea demon is still alive after all. Zhuo Fan did not survive.”
“With that large shaking, even outside its domain we felt utterly weak. That sea demon must’ve been behind it!”
Baili Yuyun’s eyes flickered with fear as he sighed, “To think the sea demon is so strong. Despite the deep wounds he still had so much power in him. It turns out the sea demon had the final say. That Zhuo Fan is dead.”
Baili Yutian felt regret. The rival he approved of was so short lived it left him empty.
Bali Yuyu’s heart was in pain, clenching her fists from sorrow.
[That rascal died just like that…]
Whoosh~
As all were taken in by different emotions at the demise of Zhuo Fan, they heard something coming from up above.
Cultivators in the millions blotted the sky as they charged in to draw blood. Some were wiping their tears and howling in sorrow of not living past today.
They all were charging to their deaths and all knew it. What chance were there really, to take down Sword Kings and the Invincible Sword?
Thus, the millions of people were crestfallen having handed their wills to their lord, now charging in with the rest.
Zhuo Fan’s order to get two lands worth of soldiers here to kill Invincible Sword was now in motion.
Baili Yutian’s team was clueless of this. They watched the flood of bloodthirst coming from these people while none thought for a second it was all for them. In fact, they took them as their own reinforcements.
Baili Yuyun laughed, “Patriarch, Prime Minister Baili’s army came through for us and now that they’re here the northern lands are ours!”
“This way we got something for our efforts!”
Baili Yutian looked at the approaching mob and then jerked, “Hold on. Why don’t they look anything like the people from the central area? Why do I feel their bloodthirst is directed at us?”
Shuddering, the Sword Kings paused and then looked peculiar at the bloodshot gazes of the mob.
[Yeah, why would they be coming at us?]

chapters.title: Chapter 1106 - 1106, Ganging Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 1106, Ganging Up
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Invincible Sword, screw you! Fight me if you have the guts!”
“Invincible Sword, son of rat bastard, I will haunt you from beyond if I die today!”
“Invincible Sword, it’s either you or me! I’ve come to take your skull as my personal chamber pot!”
…
Knowing they were doomed to die, what could running their mouths do, kill them again?
[Weren’t you so tough, oh Invincible Sword? The best in the world? None would slight you in the least, but since I’m going to die anyway, I can cuss your entire lineage!]
The black cloud came down like heavy rain, roaring and shouting curses without stopping, like true heroes.
The obscene and quite colorful language grated the Invincible Sword and the Sword Kings’ ears, making these lofty figure stare dumbly.
[Who are these guys? They have guts to come cursing us. Even the four lands’ leaders show us respect. These bugs must have a death wish coming around and running their mouths without rhyme or reason.]
While not suicidal, but dead men walking all the same. No amount of threats would work on people that knew death was a certainty.
Bam!
Baili Yuyun bowed to Baili Yutian, “Patriarch, allow me to set them straight and make them rue this day!”
“No!”
Baili Yutian’s gaze was cold, shaking his head, “They’re cursing me, which means only I have the right to take their lives. Humph, nothing but a bunch of ignorant fools to dare mock even me. I’ll have them face the consequences of their actions!”
The Sundering Sword in his hand flickered with lightning and the heavens took a purple hue as lightning flashed above.
He raised his sword at the stampede and made a casual swipe, shouting, “Humph, you think yourselves the likes of sea demon or that Zhuo? You just don’t know your own worth!”
Rumble~
A purple sword wave flared as it traveled straight through the army. The flooded sky of lightning struck down along the path of the wave, unleashing a veritable thunderstorm. What followed were the obvious wails and howls of demise as the army was reduced to ashes in the wind.
Left behind the attack was a scorched earth, now black from the ashes.
One strike was all it took to cull tens of thousands of lives. The best in the lands might look weak before Heaven Sealing Sea Ao, but he was still a god in the mortal domain.
“Patriarch’s might is supreme, the best in the world, ha-ha-ha…” Baili Yuyun cupped his hands and gave a round of praise.
His flattery might’ve worked before, when the Invincible Sword truly thought himself standing at the top. Now it fell flat, if not ironic. Witnessing Zhuo Fan and Sea Ao fighting, Baili Yuyun’s suck-up was nothing but a shame to the Invincible Sword.
[Is that sarcasm?]
Pa!
Baili Yuyun found himself flying, slamming hard into the ground a hundred meters away from the casual slap, coughing blood and gore. Getting back up on shaky legs, he bore a look of utter confusion to his lord and Patriarch.
Cough~
Baili Yutian had a coughing fit, spilling burning and frozen blood into his hand and showing it in anger, “Is this the supreme might the best in the world has? Were you blind to not see the sea demon’s power? How am I the best?”
“Uh, Patriarch, the sea demon is a monster, while among humans you…”
“Bull! The best in the world are split between humans and monsters? Then why could Zhuo Fan hurt the demon while I couldn’t?” Invincible Sword flicked his hand, boring his glare into the man, “I need able bodies, not some disgusting bootlicker, got that?”
“Yes, Patriarch!”
They all bowed at once. Baili Yuyun lowered his head, his complaints never voiced.
Cough~
Invincible Sword coughed again, being severely injured in the Ice Mountain from Sea Ao’s ice and Zhuo Fan’s Dragon Breath Pill. He was at less than half power. Every attack he made would only worsen his situation.
It mattered little though, since bugs were not worthy of his full power. How much harm could flexing his power cause anyway?
He was about to find out how wrong he was.
That group was a mere appetizer for what was to come. While he could cull a wave, how long could he keep up?
Whoosh~
The skies once again littered with a cacophony of vulgar calls, “Invincible Sword, fight us, coward! We’re waiting for you, so come on!”
“Invincible Sword, you have some cheek to be so arrogant, calling yourself above everyone!”
“Invincible Sword, you’re not invincible, just delusional. Feel like living? Then get on your knees and walk between my legs, ha-ha-ha…”
…
Invincible Sword’s face twitched, his stooping figure shaking from rage. He turned stiffly at the sudden catcalls to find another bunch of bugs looking for a quick death. The insults became harder and harder to bear.
“Another bunch of maggots came to die, cough…”
Invincible Sword tightened his jaw and the Sundering Sword hummed with desire to strike. He caved before he ever got to swing it and spurted blood.
The Sword Kings rushed to help, “Patriarch…”
Baili Yuyun volunteered on the spot, “Patriarch, these ants don’t deserve sir’s attention. Leave them to me! I will handle them!”
“Beat it! They came for me. Not facing them will only give credence to their insults!” He shoved Baili Yuyun away and swung Sundering Sword with bloodshot eyes, sending another sword wave with resounding booms that resulted in thousands upon thousands more deaths.
While his body coughed blood again, damaged further from his stubborn stance. The others were watching in worry and supported him.
“Patriarch…”
“Next team, attack!”
Outside the Sea Bright Sect, Leng Wuchang noticed the purple lightning flaring in the distance and ordered the tens of thousands of men, “Bear in mind that you may never return, but you have to taunt that old monster as much as you can. He is a man of excessive pride that disdains your very existence. Taunt him and he will strike with all he has. It is a path of no return, I know, but you are fighting for the chance of the next teams to live. The more that monster wastes energy on you the higher the next teams’ odds at taking him down. Within you lies the power to have your fellow brothers survive this. Know your sacrifice is not in vain!”
The men howled in high spirits as they marched to their doom.
One elder sighed from the side, “Exalted Double Dragons have said many times the Luo clan is filled with talents. Sir Leng is wise to have the clans and sects of two lands arranged so their friends and family lay in the back for the greatest chance at surviving. It’ll be hard not to do their best, ha-ha-ha…”
“Merely a trick is all.”
Leng Wuchang smiled, “As we’re using the human waves tactic against the Invincible Sword, cooperation and formation among strangers hold little value. This arrangement is the most effective.”
“Sir Leng is most right. Then I shall go call for the next team.”
“Take care, Executive Lu!”
Leng Wuchang gave a slight bow then his kind smile fell the moment that back left his eyes. He smirked, “Humph, they have not an ounce of remorse in using others’ lives to strengthen their position. These four lands leaders truly are…”
“Sir Leng disdains such base people?” A cheerful voice reached him.
Leng Wuchang shook and turned to see a familiar figure, bowing, “If it isn’t miss Shuang’er. With your deep grief for loss of life, why are you on this cruel and bitter battlefield?”
“Not all wars are cruel.”
Shuang’er sighed, “I have to thank Sir Leng for this strategy, to lessen the disasters. Brother Zhuo ordered for two lands to surround the Invincible Sword but did not go into details. Sir Leng’s effective organization has raised the tactic’s chances of success. Telling every team to go slander the Invincible Sword will cause a man of his temperament to fly into a rage. He will tire more like this and spare us from further casualties before his death.”
Leng Wuchang nodded, but his smile was bitter, “Clan Head sent me to organize the attack with this idea in mind, but it may be against Steward Zhuo’s intention.”
“Why do you say that?”
“Do you believe for certain Steward Zhuo had no concrete way of dealing with the Invincible Sword?” Leng Wuchang’s eyes shone with conviction, “Steward Zhuo’s plan is to see both sides crippled.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1107 - 1107, Go, Go, Go!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1107, Go, Go, Go!
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
