Proofreader: Papatonks
Shuddering, Shuang’er gave him an incredulous look, “T-that can’t be! Brother Zhuo is the Grand Marshal of our lands! Why would he…”
“Speaking of his position, isn’t it merely interim? Calling it exploit isn’t much of a stretch, regardless of how bad it sounds.”
Leng Wuchang’s eyes shone, “When the dust settles, fingers will be pointing. The lands are now at war and the leaders of the four lands have no choice but to show courtesy when inviting Steward Zhuo to take charge. Once fighting stops, the Grand Marshal loses its meaning. The four lands would remain, but what about Steward Zhuo? He is a far too shrewd a man to not pick up on the obvious danger coming with his new status.
“Furthermore, Steward Zhuo’s plan destroys the main headache, collapsing the central area, while also making the four lands break under the severe casualties. When two fight, a third always wins. Steward Zhuo took the reins, but who is he working for in the end? This is the main issue.”
Leng Wuchang smoothed his goatee, showing a crafty smile as he sighed, “I wonder, will Steward Zhuo take it out on me for reducing his plan of grinding the two sides’ assets? I guess I’ll just dump it all on Clan Head, who just had to be so righteous and sorry for humanity. Wouldn’t you say? Ha-ha-ha…”
Watching him go, Shuang’er frowned deep in thought.
[This means the man hasn’t changed at all after all these years. It’s like he hasn’t once thought about humanity’s wellbeing…]
Boom~
The Invincible Sword faced the endless waves of soldiers with wave after wave, sending them all to hell.
These men were suicidal lunatics, coming one after the other, again and again. Invincible Sword’s slash weakened, but not enough for the attack to be blocked.
The four Sword Kings looked lost. Anyone knew that making an example out of a few of them ought to scare these cowardly rabble away, but they had all gone insane, coming with the sole purpose of dying. They were lining up for execution.
[What is wrong with the people of northern lands? Have they lost their marbles?]
Their marbles were very much accounted for. It was Zhuo Fan’s attrition tactic that convinced them all that the only way to win the war was over a mountain of corpses. They were simply climbing on the stairs to victory.
Sometimes, it wasn’t death that scared people, but dying without meaning or purpose.
The Sword Kings were just too strong, making all of their efforts feel empty when they couldn’t even hurt their enemies. Here was where Zhuo Fan came with a solution- through the power of a hundred million people, they would wear them out.
By changing perspective, the crowd’s morale shifted. Their deaths now had worth, leading to the ultimate death of the Invincible Sword and the Sword Kings. Adding to it Leng Wuchang’s tactic of splitting kin and friends, their value only soared in their hearts.
[The more you drain these monsters, the safer your kin will be. And who’s to say they won’t earn glory?]
With victory in their hearts and souls, they all stepped forth to their doom without any fear.
Boom!
With another wave down, the Invincible Sword paled from exhaustion, gasping hard and coughing blood twice more. His wounds only deepened.
“Patriarch, please rest and leave it all to me!”
Bali Yuyu chose the perfect moment to block him. Weak as he became, he no longer insisted and fell back, going to rest with the other three Sword Kings.
As for the next wave of soon-to-be dead people, Bali Yuyu would handle them. The soldiers still cursed and taunted but the old man had no more energy for them, no longer stubborn and turned a deaf ear to heal.
Leng Wuchang saw Baili Yutian withdrawing and a Sword King taking stage, he decided to make slight adjustment to the tactic, by sending five teams at once instead of just one to drain them harder. And every last one of the attacks came pouring down right for the Invincible Sword.
It was no wonder Bali Yuyu was frantic in keeping Patriarch safe while also exhausting herself.
The other Sword Kings had to replace her. Though weren’t they wounded themselves? Ten waves were nothing, but having pushed on to a hundred and the earlier damage began to show their effects, making their situation that much harder.
Luckily Baili Yulei rushed here with the crown prince at the best moment to hold the fort.
Which was not to say that a heavily damaged one, two normal and three wounded Sword Kings could outlast the constant attacks from the hundred million soldiers two lands were throwing at them. No, they certainly had it bad.
While the suicidal madmen couldn’t touch them, their Yuan Qi took a heavy blow. Only three days into the fight, they found themselves dazed and their Yuan Qi reserve next to bone dry.
As for the enemy, they still had two thirds of their force intact.
In the dark at the actual numbers, the Sword Kings were in a dangerous spot, only amplified with every passing wave.
Their strength wasn’t the only one leaving, with their minds taking their toll as well.
“Baili Jingwei, didn’t you say you’re going to break into northern lands with ease, you bastard? Weren’t you going to support us? This feels like the whole of northern lands’ forces are now focused on us. Where the hell are you?”
Bali Yuyu couldn’t take it anymore and lashed out. The other Sword Kings were aggravated as well, with bloodshot eyes and growling.
They believed in Baili Jingwei’s plan, but for some reason, everything took a turn for the worse.
[What kind of problems could his plan to attack all lands meet?]
Despite their frustration and confusion, they were very much in the dark about Baili Jingwei having it far worse than them.
“Go, go, go! Charge for crying out loud! Breach northern lands at all costs!”
At the northern lands’ border, Baili Jingwei was frantic and anxious as he pointed at the smoking battlefield and howled like he was possessed. His white teeth crunched so hard they might break any second.
[Zhuo Fan, you rotten piece of… I’m not through with you! I’m going to get you for using this despicable tactic on me!]
[Just how are Patriarch and the others holding up? It’s been six days under harassment from a hundred million people. Then there’s the three divine swords. Patriarch has to be safe!]
Baili Jingwei’s eyes were red all over, howling, “Charge, no matter what! Get in there you god-damned rejects!”
Answering him was a draconic roar. Danqing Shen pointed at the sky and hacked down. A resounding boom followed, making the sky echo with the wails and cries of hundreds of Genesis experts as they lost their lives. The enemy lines were shaking to the core as well, under the onslaught.
Ding~
A most sublime zither added some color to the battlefield, but this turned out to be a dirge. The sounds split into seven sword energy attacks, mowing people down and unleashing a shower of limbs, viscera and blood upon all around.
The music turned soothing once more, with the man in white gently touching the strings with a peaceful smile.
“It’s the Zither Sword King! Look out for his Seven Notes Obscure Sword!” A venerable from northern lands recognized him and shouted, moments before he popped like an overripe tomato.
Shangguan Feiyun hovered high above, lowering his fingers, “You think Zither Sword King is the only one to watch out for? There are four Sword Kings on this battlefield. Are you calling the others weaklings?”
“Yeah, Zither Sword King always shows off, playing a zither on the field of battle!”
Wine Sword Immortal whined, approaching Shangguan Feiyun, “Should we try being refined for a change? At this rate, all credit will go to that string plucker. Next thing you know, Prime Minister Baili is shouting at us for not trying too hard. I’d rather not have him grating on my ears with his yapping, ha-ha-ha…”
Wine Sword Immortal laughed and spurted wine then pointed. the wine turned into a golden inferno that took sword shape and fell down like rain to kill a thousand experts.
Shangguan Feiyun’s heart sank, “Wine Sword Immortal, is this the Decimating Sword Art from southern lands? Fire really is the most effective way of killing.”
“Let’s not dwell in the past.”
Wine Sword Immortal shook his head with a sigh, “I’ve had a drink over with Murong Lie back then, considering him a friend. He was also kind enough to let me observe Decimating Sword for a year, leading to today’s results. But times have changed, I’m afraid, and I don’t know if he’ll gift me more wine.”
“Humph, once you take southern lands, all the wine will be yours.”
“What taste can stolen wine have over one offered by a dear friend?” Wine Sword Immortal looked worried, sadness flashing deep in his gaze.
Seeing how two Sword Kings were chatting merrily, Baili Jingwei had to do something about that. His anger burned to new heights as he shrieked, “Shangguan Feiyun, Wine Sword Immortal, did I call you here for a drink? Charge, god dammit!”
“Tch, the brat is picking our faults again.” Wine Sword Immortal shrugged and sighed as he shot for the northern lands’ frontline.
Shangguan Feiyun was right behind him.
Huffing and puffing, Baili Jingwei shook all over.
[Damn these foreign Sword Kings, they can’t do anything right! What do I do? It’s been so many days and Patriarch…]
“Prime Minister sir, report!”
A messenger bowed before him.
Baili Jingwei snatched the jade slip and read it with heart in his throat.
[What’s so important in these crucial moments?]
He jolted and in the next moment his eyes shone.
[The punk is missing and not leading the alliance? Perfect…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1108 - 1108, Promoting
chapters.content:
Chapter 1108, Promoting
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Boom~
Sun Sea Sect Leader Bu Xingyun appeared among some broken ruins. He watched the lightning flaring in the distance and noticed it had ebbed since yesterday, its weariness becoming more pronounced as time passed.
His eyes shook and he took a deep breath, turning from the incredible display to looking around.
Crack!
The splitting of a rock entered his ear and Bu Xingyun’s eye lit up. His attention snapped to the source, reaching it in moments. He sent a palm attack, blowing away the rubble and revealing the frail Sect Leader of Sea Bright Sect, Ling Yuntian.
With his ruined clothes, messy hair, pale face and blood on his mouth, he didn’t look as dignified.
“Sect Leader Ling, how are you? Here, take this healing pill. I’ll take you somewhere safe to recover.” Bu Xingyun helped him and a blue pill entered his mouth.
Bu Xingyun then placed him on his back moving swiftly through the air.
[Now they’re all accounted for, ha-ha-ha…]
Whoosh~
Bu Xingyun arrived minutes later ten miles outside Sea Bright Sect, at a tent. The patrols were all Sea Bright Sect disciples that had survived, they moved with purpose at their arrival and helped him take Ling Yuntian into the tent.
There were many others inside lying down and wounded, Exalted Double Dragons and the three Shangguan clan venerables among them.
At the time the Invincible Sword’s powerful sword struck, they all survived by the grace of the three divine swords. Although they were now hanging by a thread.
Seeing the new addition, they all cheered, “Sect Leader Ling…”
Ling Yuntian was placed on a stretcher like the rest and as he heard the frail voices, he cracked an eyelid to wheeze out, “W-where am I? What happened?”
“Ha-ha-ha, Sect Leader Ling, did the monster’s blow hit you in the head? We’ve all been defeated and damn nearly killed. It’s thanks to Sect Leader Bu that we’re still alive, coming to our rescue before breathing our last among rubble.”
Exalted Hei Ran explained with gratitude for Bu Xingyun, “Sect Leader Bu is our savior. We can’t thank him enough.”
Bu Xingyun gave a modest wave, even blaming himself, “You’re too kind, sirs, I am ashamed to not have been there alongside you to fight. This little help is nothing.”
“If you had come with us, you’d have been buried under the ruins like us then no one could’ve helped some old men. Sect Leader Bu, you were right not to join the battle. I ask your forgiveness for the many disagreements we had before.”
“It’s fine, Exalted Hei Ran. We’re all in this together. They were mere trifles, ha-ha-ha…” Bu Xingyun gave a bright laugh.
Ling Yuntian knew by now that all the men here got saved by Bu Xingyun. He forced himself to prop his body and thank Bu Xingyun.
Whoosh~
The tent opened just then and a man in a black robe entered laughing, “I am very pleased to know that all of you are still in this world. Sect Leader Ling, Exalted Double Dragons, as well as the representatives of the eastern lands and southern lands, I wonder if your precarious condition had made you more tolerant for my advice?”
“Who are you? State your name!” Ling Yuntian shouted.
The man in black removed his cowl, revealing a savage smile, “I guess some of you here have yet to meet me. Then allow me to introduce myself. I am central area Sword Star Empire’s Prime Minister, Baili Jingwei!”
“You’re Baili Jingwei?” Everyone gasped and stared with big eyes, “What are you doing so deep in the northern lands? How did you pass Sea Bright Sect’s defenses? Guards, seize him!”
Someone raised his hand to grab Baili Yutian, shouting, “Ha-ha-ha, instead of enjoying yourself from your position, you dared venture here. Now we’re not only taking your empire’s cornerstone, Baili Yutian, but even the wisest Baili Jingwei. The destruction of the Sword Star Empire is nigh!”
A group of Sea Bright Sect disciple entered to cut off the intruder’s escape.
“Wait!”
Baili Jingwei shouted before Bu Xingyun got to grab him. Bu Xingyun smirked, “Prime Minister Baili, what trick are you playing now? Humph, you may be clever, renowned throughout the lands, but you are a frail scholar.”
“Why so nervous then?”
With a sneaky smile, Baili Jingwei shrugged and spoke to the wounded elders, “Sect Leader Ling, I have come alone and weak before you just so we can talk. You’re free to take me prisoner once I’m done, taking down the head. Or are you perhaps afraid of a little old scholar standing in your domain among the greatest experts in the lands? You wouldn’t even give me the chance to speak?”
Bu Xingyun paused and turned to Ling Yuntian for directions.
Ling Yuntian coughed for a bit and gave a weak wave, sending the disciples away.
Bu Xingyun snapped his head back on Baili Jingwie, cursing, “Your tricks won’t work here, humph!”
Baili Jingwei nodded with calmness.
“Prime Minister Baili, with both sides trapped in a bitter war, what purpose does your visit hold?” Ling Yuntian demanded.
The others focused on Baili Jingwei and awaited his reply.
[What’s this sneaky Prime Minister playing at? Coming in here without so much as a Sword King for escort? Does he have a death wish?]
Baili Jingwei shook his head, his voce firm, “To be honest, I’ve come to save everyone.”
“Save us?” They all looked stumped, then Exalted Hei Ran mocked him, “Prime Minister Baili, are you alright? We hold all the cards and morale has never been higher. A disciple came in just now saying your Patriarch is barely holding on while we still have millions of soldiers ready to fight still and finish him. And you have the nerve to come into our domain and proclaim you’re here to save us? What a sick joke.
“They say Prime Minister Baili is beyond wise, but to think you came to preach such idiotic nonsense. The rumors must be inflated, ha-ha-ha…” They all laughed at his expense.
Baili Jingwei shook his head, not falling for his jab, waiting for them to laugh before continuing, “You’re all right and you have victory in your grasp. I am aware and accept my loss. Everyone is very close to ruining my empire with your ingenious plan. But while that is a bitter reality, so too will your demise following our nation’s defeat.”
Ugh!
The smiles froze on their faces and looked grave. Ling Yuntian glared, “Baili Jingwei, what’s that supposed to mean?”
“Ha-ha-ha, haven’t you considered what might come next after you employ such a plan?”
Baili Jingwei’s eyes shone with wisdom, “I admit you win this round, but you’ll be losing as well. You will crush the undefeated Sword Star Empire, but at a cost of your own demise. Be it Sea Bright Sect or Double Dragon Manor, Shangguan clan and Murong clan, they all will fall in time, experiencing the same defeat as my nation, erased from this world.”
“What a load of bull! Your Sword Star Empire is the one to fall here. It has nothing to do with us! Why would we be joining you in death?”
“Nothing? Then do you all know how gaining victory against a mighty foe ruins my nation?”
“Absolutely!”
Ling Yuntian smirked, “As long as we take the Invincible Sword down, your empire loses their foundation!”
“Then I still have at my disposal millions of soldiers and four Sword Kings. While you are drained and weary from the fight with Patriarch, I can still destroy the four lands.”
“Really? Those kings you’re so proud of will turn on you in the end!” Ling Yuntian disdained, “Without the Invincible Sword to coerce them, the Sword Kings won’t ever listen to you.”
They all let out smug smiles, filled with confidence.
Baili Jingwei’s eyes shone with mockery as he smiled, “What makes you so sure the first thing they’ll do when learning of Patriarch’s passing, they’ll be turning on me?”
“Er…”
The wounded elders all froze, unable to reply…

chapters.title: Chapter 1109 - 1109, No Victor
chapters.content:
Chapter 1109, No Victor
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Frowning, the bed-ridden old men looked at each other before staring back into Baili Jingwei’s deep eyes, “W-what do you mean?”
“Ha-ha-ha, nothing, just given the impression we’re all part of someone’s master plan. When two fight, the third wins. None of us are victors.”
With anger in his eyes, Baili Jingwei sighed.
The wounded looked on with nothing but doubt in their eyes.
Baili Jingwei shook his head and let out a long and heavy breath, then he composed himself as he spoke, “I bet that wise ass of yours only told you what you wanted to hear of how this will end. Then allow me to share with you the rest.
“First of all, this plan is devious beyond measure. It takes a lot of mettle to send everything at Patriarch. I never dreamed you’d have it in you. Technically it’s not bravery, just up against the wall, ending up used. I have to give him credit, this move hit me where it hurt the most. I aimed for instant gains when attacking the four lands. I went for bolstering our Sword Kings numbers, increasing the empire’s power, but they are volatile. Once Patriarch is gone to stop them, the four will lash out. They’re the biggest threat to topple the empire.”
[Didn’t Sir Zhuo say the same thing?]
The patients grinned to themselves.
[That’s Sir Zhuo’s plan, alright. The only reason the wisest in the world even bothered risking his life to come here for a ceasefire is because Sir Zhuo cut him deep.]
“But that’s only half of it.”
Baili Jingwei could read them like a book, continuing, “Next comes death, though unsure if it’ll be yours or mine. Did you think that with Patriarch’s death, the four Sword Kings will turn on us? What a joke, they all come to my central area for fame and fortune. Do you really think they’ll just give it all up?”
The men gasped, “Y-you mean…”
“Humph, I can’t say what they’ll do for certain, but if it were me seeing both sides at death’s door, I’d definitely revolt. I’d gather a personal army and use retribution for Patriarch as an excuse to keep fighting, dyeing the four lands in blood. And only when the four lands have nothing left to fight with will they turn against the central area.”
Giving a devilish smile, Baili Jingwei’s eyes shone with guile, enticing them with his words, “That’s why I say the fall of my nation marks the destruction of the four lands. the five lands would then belong to the four Sword Kings. That’s not a pretty picture, is it?”
The leaders of the four lands in question were sweating buckets.
Baili Jingwei smirked, keeping his voice even yet still piercing, “Toiling so hard, losing so many men to claim to kill the invincible Patriarch, yet all for another’s sake. Sea Bright Sect will be finished, Double Dragon Manor as well, Shangguan clan… Ha-ha-ha, with Shangguan Feiyun’s hatred for his clan, even if it still exists, what good will come of it? At the very end, the world would belong to the four, oh, and let’s not forget Sir Zhuo. It must come at a surprise to know that the central area is facing a rebellion. A hidden power is on a swift rise. I believe that once the major powers of the five lands are out of the picture, a new world order will come. Since Sir Zhuo has the greatest credit in conducting this play, it’s only fair to get a slice of the pie, wouldn’t you say? Ha-ha-ha…”
Their wounded faces twitched, looking nervous.
If all went like Baili Jingwei said, what were they fighting and dying for?
[Was it all a scheme from Sir Zhuo against the central area and the four lands as well?]
They all grew grave and felt fear as Zhuo Fan’s wide smile entered their minds.
[He’s terrifying!]
They had no way of seeing through this devious plot and they were perfectly fine doing the work for him. If it really was the case of ending their clans and sects, how would they face their ancestors in the beyond?
They all hung their heads, distressed.
“Damn Zhuo Fan, I just knew that sneaky punk was up to no good. He almost used us! Do you all still remember how he wanted to cause chaos in the central area? It turns out it’s all to vie for power!” Bu Xingyun roared, cursing, “Sect Leader Ling, what do we do now?”
Ling Yuntian’s brow shook with endless worry. He also happened to turn his eyes on Baili Jingwei as he thought, “Prime Minister Baili, you’re not here just to flex your smarts over us, are you? Get to the point!”
Just what he wanted to hear.
Baili Jingwei showed a genial smile, “Sect Leader Ling, I’ve come to settle this matter. Since both of us are doing the work for that shameless punk, I hope that Sect Leader Ling and every leader shall cease and desist their assault on Patriarch!”
“Stop?! You want us to leave a monster like Invincible Sword alone?”
Ling Yuntian hesitated and for good reason, his fists clenching in rejection, “We’ve finally have him on the ropes for the first time. When will we ever get such a chance again?”
“Ha-ha-ha, I’d find such a chance equally hard to give up if I were in your shoes, Sect Leader Ling, but everyone should know that Zhuo Fan’s scheme rests solely on Patriarch’s fate. To unravel it, you must let go of Patriarch. Sirs are all men of your word. Are you willing to lay waste to your foundation for the sake of another? I have to say, I’m touched.”
The patients jolted, gnashing their teeth and nodding.
Having gotten his point across, Ling Yuntian turned to Baili Jingwei and spoke heavily, “Fine, we agree. But after Invincible Sword leaves…”
“Rest assured that our empire is in chaos and suffered heavy losses. We have no time to waste.” Baili Jingwei’s eyes shone and nodded, “Once Patriarch is with us, the war will cease, with neither side a winner. I vow on my Dao Heart, on behalf of the Sword Star Empire, that we’ll not step one foot on the four lands for the next century.”
The elders found it much easier now to agree.
They would now have a hundred years of peace…
Ling Yuntian nodded as well, then called, “Guard, tell…”
…
Boom~
As silver waves passed, tens of thousands of experts met their end. Baili Yuyu and Baili Yulei shook under the exertion, looking wane and frail. They slumped on the ground, with no more strength to give.
“We can’t hold on anymore either!” Gasping for breath, Baili Yuyu looked at the others, equally spent, and shook her head.
The others felt the bitterness of despair.
These days Patriarch and the Sword Kings took turns in fending off the enemy, but this led to aggravating wounds and spent Yuan Qi.
Whoosh~
Here came another wave, men coming to die for their cause, shouting and cursing.
[What’s this? Why are they all on the ground? Does this mean…]
Their dead eyes, resigned to their fate, glimmered with hope and jubilation, “B-brothers, they’re spent! Attack and take their heads!”
“They’re exhausted? Does that mean we don’t get to die?”
“Not just live, but take Invincible Sword and five Sword Kings’ lives. We’ll live forever in history!”
Roar~!
The howls rang through the sky and the suicidal team got pumped, charging the enemy with fervent joy.
A world of fame and wealth was waiting for them, stepping on the bodies of the brothers before them and now plucking it like nothing.
Grinning to their ears, the men went crazy as they lunged like ravenous wolves at the chance to go down in history. Their true and vile natures were laid bare to the world.
Baili Yutian’s lips shook, looking furious as he held the divine sword in defiance, “I, the great Invincible Sword, am not about to meet my end in a glorious battle against an expert, but at the nibbling of cockroaches! What a disgrace!”
The Sword Kings were just as unwilling.
Dying from Murong Lie or Ouyang Lingtian, and even that freak, Zhuo Fan, would’ve been so much better. Now they were shamed having their honor smeared with these bugs.
“Hold! Sect Leader Ling sent orders for everyone to stop attacking Invincible Sword. Any violation means death!”
A shout echoed into the crazed maniacs’ ears, making them freeze in stupefaction…

chapters.title: Chapter 1110 - 1110, Widespread Grievance
chapters.content:
Chapter 1110, Widespread Grievance
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
[What the hell?]
Rooted to the spot, the men had glazed looks of confusion at the unbelievable things they were hearing.
They were so close to breaking this impossibly tough bone, and they just want them to stop?
Even Invincible Sword’s group was left speechless.
[What in heaven’s name is going on? What are the four lands planning this time?]
Whoosh~
A man in white landed, the venerable in charge of the wave, and walked towards Invincible Sword with a bow, “Sir Baili and Sword Kings, please follow me. Your people are here to take you.”
[Our people?]
Flinching, the six looked at each other baffled. But since they were like lambs to the slaughter, what more could they do to them?
They ignored the strangeness of the invitation and the possible trap, with Baili Yutian coughing blood a couple more times and some Sword Kings lending their arm, they all stumbled forward.
“Why? Just why let them go?”
A howl of indignation and fury broke the sky and a figure in gray shot for Baili Yutian with a savage punch, “My brothers died at their hands. We suffered so many losses, got them ready to reap, so why the hell won’t you let us take their lives? I’ll have my revenge for my brothers! Die, Invincible Sword!”
Bang!
He hardly made any progress towards Invincible Sword as an energy wave flashed past and left him in bloody pieces.
The elder in white flicked his Yuan Qi charged fingers, smirking in disdain at the rest, “Have I not made myself clear? The leaders of the four lands have decreed to let Invincible Sword leave. Any violation means execution!”
The men shuddered and lowered their heads in anger and hatred.
They knew not what got those higher-up to lose their heads and come here right when they were about to succeed only to stop them. Had the tens of millions before died for nothing?
Ignoring these bugs who were unable to control their fate, Baili Yutian walked away with the old man.
They soon reached a thicket.
Ling Yuntian’s group was waiting, along with a friendly face, Baili Jingwei.
“Jingwei, what’s going on here? Can you explain it to me?” Baili Yutian was gravely wounded but still had the demeanor of a king.
Baili Jingwei cupped his hands as he bowed, “Patriarch, we made peace!”
“Oh, I see.”
Baili Yutian sighed, looking at the hovering image behind him, “Is that a teleportation array? It’s quite subtle and compact. I wager it can only take a couple people at once. Is it your handiwork?”
“Yes, Patriarch, to be on the safe side, I built it after coming to northern lands.”
“Good, let’s go.”
Baili Yutian walked straight for the portal, uncaring about the situation. the others followed. Ling Yuntian smiled and stepped forward, “Sir, both sides have suffered in this war and are heavily wounded. I hope there won’t be any conflicts in the future…”
Baili Yutian never once spared him a glance, going through the portal at his own pace.
Ling Yuntian’s face twitched, put on the spot.
“Humph, you’re not even fit to talk to Patriarch, not when you cower away from the fight, geezer!” Bali Yuyu huffed and followed through.
The Sword Kings echoed her disdain, going through the portal, including crown prince Baili Jingtian.
Baili Jingwei smiled, bowing with respect at Ling Yuntian, yet his smile felt flat, “Sect Leader Ling, this is just how Patriarch and Sword Kings are. I offer my apology on their behalf…”
“It’s fine. I just hope Prime Minister…”
“Of course, for the next century, we’ll be at peace, ha-ha-ha. Farewell!” Baili Jingwei smirked as he passed through as well.
His mask of kindness fell right as he vanished, revealing the naked scorn beneath.
Hum~
With all gone, Ling Yuntian’s group remained. He was looking tense and heavy.
Feeling his pain, Bu Xingyun laughed, sucking up, “Invincible Sword’s arrogance is common knowledge. It must be hard for Sect Leader Ling to suffer such humiliation yet save the four lands’ foundation.”
“Search everything!”
Ling Yuntian roared, “Why could Baili Jingwei teleport to the heart of northern lands from the frontlines? And what is this secret teleportation array doing here? Why could he enter our Sea Bright Sect like there was no one to stop him? Zhuo Fan was right. Northern lands has a traitor, and of great status as well. This is the only possible answer for a central area to have such a hidden door!”
Bu Xingyun nodded, “Yes, we must investigate! Sect Leader Ling, leave this to me. I will definitely get to the bottom of this!”
Ling Yuntian nodded and sighed.
[Just who is this traitor?]
In Baili Yutian’s camp, Baili Yutian and his group appeared through the portal, with Baili Jingwei in the rear.
Invincible Sword and the five Sword Kings felt ages since they saw the familiar faces and mood.
They were finally back in their own domain, to safety. Sword Kings were anxious to go to the security of their hope, especially after suffering through millions of men coming at them relentlessly.
“Prime Minister Jingwei, thank you.”
Crown Prince Baili Jingtian spoke earnestly, “We’re alive all thanks to your timely intervention. But how did Prime Minister convince them to accept a ceasefire so willingly?”
“It’s simple, because they had us by the short hairs.”
Baili Jingwei shook his head and revealed a jade slip, “The imperial capital reports that the Sword Star Empire now has over a thousand cities that have fallen. Once news of Patriarch’s wounds spread, the four Sword Star Empire won’t sit still. We are beset by conflict from every side and have lost the strength to fight this war. Of course we’d be happy to go home in peace.”
“How did it come to this? For even the empire’s core…” Everyone cried out.
Baili Jingwei nodded, “Yes, Zhuo Fan has made us suffer the worst. We’ll likely need decades to settle.”
“That guy again? How did he manage to get our empire…” Baili Jingtian and the Sword Kings gasped.
Baili Jingwei had a bitter smile, “It is all my fault, Patriarch. The guy had beaten me completely in strategy. It might come as a shock to know that he was appointed as the commander of the four lands, the Grand Marshal…”
Baili Jingwei began telling everything that had happened. The audience was just too out of it to react. They knew Zhuo Fan to be some mystery sect’s disciple, but to think he also held control over the boar, with the five lands dancing to his tune.
He bested Patriarch and outclassed Prime Minister. Just who was this godlike talent?
[In short, I only managed to get those geezers to relent because that punk is missing. I fear that not even my presence would’ve swayed them otherwise and I’d have only suffered by going there. That guy is the greatest opponent in my entire life.”
Fear lingering in his eyes, Baili Yuyun was grave. The others sighed, with Baili Yuyun saying, “Prime Minister, you can relax now. He’s no longer a threat to you.”
“Wha-” Baili Jingwei began.
“His corpse got eaten by the sea demon. Who cares how great he was in life? Ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Yuyun narrated their side of the events this time. Baili Jingwei listened with a dumb look.
His eyes then landed on Baili Jingtian’s missing hand and cried, “Curses, is this guy our bane? All of Baili, from young to old, from refined to martial, got smacked around. But in the end he got done over by some mystery sea demon? How are we then to exact revenge?”
“The one opponent we acknowledge is gone like that. Who are we to fight now? Go take it out on Ling Yuntian and those fools? Are they worth the bother?”
Baili Yutian frowned hard, his features twisted in anger, his eyes bloodshot.
Blood spurted high and his eyes went black, knocked out. Yet he still had the mind to mutter, “Zhuo Fan, your life… is mine…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1111 - 1111, Care
chapters.content:
Chapter 1111, Care
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Boom~
“By Prime Minister’s orders, retreat…”
Shouts louder than the the howls of death spread across the battlefield, with both sides fighting a bitter war and the four Sword Kings unleashing their killer moves.
These men roamed the battlefield and sent the latest orders of Baili Jingwei.
About to unleash another strike, Shangguan Feiyun jerked to a halt, “We’re about to win this and now we’re pulling back? What’s Baili Jingwei thinking?”
“We must’ve lost the the battle.” The soothing melody came to a halt as well as Zither Sword King spoke.
Shangguan Feiyun roared in defiance, “Where have we lost exactly? Everything’s going our way and are about to march into northern lands. How is this a loss? Baili Jingwei also promised me help in attacking eastern lands. Now we’re pulling back just when the enemy’s about to fall? I can’t accept it!”
“So? This is the central area’s war with the four lands. Since Prime Minister Baili ordered a cease and desist, no one will fight on. You’re welcome to face the four lands by yourself if you want to, ha-ha-ha…” Danqing Shen returned as well.
Wine Sword Immortal smirked, quite perky as he caught up, “He-he-he, a cease is great. I won’t get to kill anymore and get on those old friends’ bad side.”
Zither Sword King glanced over and left after putting away the zither. Shangguan Feiyun was the only one pissed by this development, but still withdrew, though he flicked his sleeve in annoyance.
Prime Minister’s order spread all over and the fighting stopped, with the Sword Star Empire pulling back.
The battlefield soon became silent as the grave, having lost all the clamor of weapons and shouting…
On northern lands’ side, two hundred defensive arrays got crushed and had lost more than half their men. Their last barrier was about to fail as well and then they would’ve all got mowed down.
Marshal Luo Yunhai was tense, soaked in sweat and equally incredulous at a Sword King’s might. They managed to last the first six days all due to their defenses. But once the four Sword Kings stepped in, it felt like the world came crashing down on them.
He gnashed his teeth and shouted, “Hold fast! One more day! Every last one of you, hold! We need to buy our men time. We can’t let them get past us and ruin the Grand Marshal’s plan!”
Boom~
The sudden explosion drowned his voice. All the men were shaking as they face the relentless enemy, his words falling on deaf ears.
Letting out a deep breath, he shook his head. All tactics and strategies fell through at this point, only able to defend. At the end of the day, strength was what mattered the most. His pep talk wouldn’t change reality, who lost or who died.
Whoosh~
The explosions came to a halt out of the blue, catching Luo Yunhai off-guard. Tuoba Tieshan ran over with a happy look, “Marshal Luo, great news! They’re falling back. The Sword Star army is retreating. We survived the onslaught, ha-ha-ha…”
“They’re leaving?” Luo Yunhai was dazed, then he turned to his Head Steward, “Steward Zhuge, what are they up to? Why fall back out of nowhere?”
Zhuge Changfeng was deep in thought at the sudden development.
A soldier rushed over and bowed, carrying a jade slip, “Clan Head, Sir Leng sent word!”
Snatching and reading it, Luo Yunhai smashed it on the ground, exploding in anger, “What the hell! Those geezers…”
“What is it, Clan Head? What happened?” Zhuge Changfeng asked with a start.
Luo Yunhai took a deep breath, his face twisted in rage as he spat, “Sir Leng said those old coots ordered retreat just as Invincible Sword was about to die.”
“What?!”
Zhuge Changfeng pursued, “What of Steward Zhuo? What did he say?”
Luo Yunhai sighed, “Brother Zhuo got caught by the sea demon when he went after it and is now missing. This decision is all on those old guys!”
“So that’s why.”
Zhuge Changfeng nodded, turning to the silent hellscape where both armies bled and died. His eyes shone as he said, “It seems the parties reached a hidden agreement. The war is over.”
“How can there be peace?”
Luo Yunhai roared, aggrieved, his eyes bloodshot, “We lost over half our men! There’s only forty million of us left. And Sir Leng said sacrificed close to sixty millions to wear down Invincible Sword. We lost a hundred million people, equivalent to three lands. With the old coots giving up now, then how are we supposed to defend the next time they attack?
“The death toll is tremendous and we payed a heavy price as well. Who is going to take responsibility? Did they just die for nothing?”
Tuoba Tieshan didn’t take the news too well either. Only Zhuge Changfeng sighed and noddded as he explained, “Clan Head, allow me to be blunt. I’ve been a dynasty’s Prime Minister and know exactly what these men in power care about, having served an emperor myself. Using the chance of Steward Zhuo’s disappearance, their moral compass, Baili Jingwei strike them where it hurt the most, having leverage over them and making them cease the war regardless. As for what they are so much about, ha-ha-ha; clinging to power. As for the forces of the four lands and the damage, they have little concern. Haven’t the lands reared so many experts just to keep them safe?
“Clan Head, I’ll be honest with you. These four lands’ leaders may be of righteous sects and lofty as immortals, but they wallow in lust for power, incapable to rise above the mundane world. Wanting them abandon everything and give their everything for Dao is fundamentally impossible. They might be willing to sacrifice their lives, but there are some things they find far more valuable than life. More valuable than our lives! Steward Zhuo used to say desires held you back. For so many years the four lands feared the frail scholar, Baili Jingwei, for this exact reason.”
“Baili Jingwei is a master manipulator of other’s desires. The only one who can fight him on this is brother Zhuo.”
Luo Yunhai nodded in understanding then teared up, “Speaking of, I miss brother Zhuo, Steward Zhuge. He may be missing, but I want to find him with sister. And when I do find him, I’ll never let him go.”
Zhuge Changfeng smiled, “I know Clan Head is aggrieved, but it’s best not to see Steward Zhuo like your past whiny self, ha-ha-ha…”
“Stop teasing!”
Luo Yunhai glared at him.
Deep in the North Sea, in Heaven Sealing Sea Ao’s domain, Zhuo Fan was still out, laying on the icy sea, looking haggard and weak.
Qiao’er watched over him with worry. Sea Ao was concerned as well, ignoring his wounds. They both failed to notice that no pain was greater than a withered heart.
Zhuo Fan had sunk into an abyss. It was all up to him to wake or not…
A drop plopped in the water, sending ripples. In a black space, a man stood beside a pond with a crushed expression.
There was nothing around him, just emptyness. Zhuo Fan’s eyes were, by all account, dead.
An aged hand appeared just then, landing on his shoulder.
Zhuo Fan never so much as blinked.
A faint smile came into view as a stooped man walked to his side to sit, “Ha-ha-ha, you’re back. Didn’t I tell you not to come to this dark place? You’ll never get out.”
“Who… are you?”
Zhuo Fan stiffly turned around to see only the outline in the darkness. Then he recalled, “You’re… that…”
The old man nodded and a row of white teeth were revealed in the darkness, “Yes, I told you last time that I’ll come every time you appear here to stop you from passing on. Last time was due to nearing death but this time is far more dangerous. Your heart, your will is dead.”
“Sorry, I made you see me again.”
“Aren’t you even going to ask me who I am?”
“No point. I don’t need to know anyway.” Zhuo Fan spoke, his lonely eyes made him look like a corpse.
The old man shook his head, “It’ll be a shame to yearn for death so soon. I helped you in protecting the girl’s life. If you want to see her again, live and meet her in the Sacred Domain!”
“What?!” Zhuo Fan shook all over, astonished.
With only his teeth showing, the old man looked faded, yet a prismatic glow hovered over him, “Remember how I told you to accept everything about the one you care? I am the same. I can’t have you sink into oblivion, ever. But I’m afraid this will be the last time. I can no longer protect you from here on. Take more care of yourself!”
The old man turned into the prismatic glow and faded away…

chapters.title: Chapter 1112 - 1112, Four Swords As One
chapters.content:
Chapter 1112, Four Swords As One
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Senior!”
Zhuo Fan shot to his feet, awake. Qiao’er jumped in joy, “Dad, you’re back!”
“Kid, you’re up at last. You only have a scratch here and there and collapsed from exhaustion. Even so, you were out for a whole week. For a moment there I thought you lost your will, never to rise again, ha-ha-ha…” Sea Ao laughed in glee, “The next thing you know, you wake up like nothing!”
Zhuo Fan saw black before his eyes and touched their seal. What bothered him most was the lack of any trace of his wife’s energy. He rushed, “Qingcheng! What about Qingcheng, Senior Sea Ao?”
“You mean the girl? You saved her so take it easy.”
“Me?!”
“Yeah.”
Sea Ao explained after seeing the confused expression he had on, “To save you, she took the thunderflame into her body. Just as her soul was about to fade away, a Sovereign path came out of you, shielding the last vestige of her soul from annihilation. It was the only thing that stood in the way of her rejoining the mere spiritual energy of the world around us.”
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook hard, looking pale and dismayed, “Sovereign path? Isn’t that what legends talk of only as the ultimate skill of the Sovereign Stage, one form that gives eternal life? How come I have it?”
“You don’t know?”
“Of course not. I’d have used it from the start if I did, not to waste time running all over the place.”
“In that case, I know even less.” Sea Ao shrugged and grinned, “It’s said only a Sovereign can wield a Sovereign path, as in the Ten Sovereigns. Hardly a feat possible by a Dao amateur like you. Does that mean a Sovereign resided within you to protect your little old life? He-he-he, that’s quite the backing, kid. Now, who on earth are you, exactly?”
Plagued with confusion, Zhuo Fan was lost. But then he snapped back as he recalled the hazy elder.
[Has he always been protecting me?]
[But who was he? Why would he appear only as my life is about to be extinguished?]
His mind was drowned in question with no answer, questions he could only put aside for now. He instead asked Sea Ao in worry, “What about Qingcheng’s soul? Where is she?”
“I threw it in the Sacred Domain.”
“Sacred Domain?”
“Yes.” Sea Ao grinned, “Boy, you and the lass’ luck is out of this world. Did you know the North Sea had a connection with the Sacred Domain?”
Zhuo Fan mulled over, “From Dragon Ancestor’s map, close to the North Sea is indeed a World Wind Tunnel, but I didn’t know where exactly.”
“He-he, then let me tell you about Heavenly Rebirth Lake!”
“The lake in legends saying it can have someone reborn?” Zhuo Fan’s heart jumped in shock, “It’s only a myth in the Sacred Domain, a mere hearsay, and mostly taken as a mere story. But after looking through the Nine Serenities Secret Records, I knew it to be Rebirth Sovereign’s seat of enlightenment. It twisted time and space, and as long as just a sliver of your soul remains, rebirth is possible, into an easy life. Only its hard barrier makes it impossible for all but the fated to enter. The other nine Sovereigns were no different. Such a miracle of creation was actually here in all places. Go figure.”
Sea Ao nodded, “Every Sovereign has their own unique ability, seat of enlightenment. None may enter but themselves. Maybe because of your thunderflame in relation with the Divine Eye of the Void, you tore a gap in the barrier. Don’t you find it connected how it was the Heavenly Rebirth Lake here of all places? It offered the lass the chance to be reborn. The other option would be ending up as a cripple if not outright dying from having but a sliver of soul remaining.”
Zhuo Fan pondered and finally nodded with a smile.
[That’s why that senior told me to live to see her in the Sacred Domain. Qingcheng is already there. Then I will survive until we see each other once more.]
[But who was he? How did a Sovereign end up within me? Why would he give everything to help me? Why would he choose nothingness just to help me save Qingcheng?]
[Regardless of it all, this is one immense favor I have to return. The only question is if I’ll ever get the chance…]
Zhuo Fan finally showed a wide and bright smile, his heart at peace.
[She has yet to pass on, waiting for me out there for the moment we’re together again.]
Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan’s deathly outlook now turned vibrant with hope and vitality. He aimed for Sacred Domain to fight, but now he had another reason, love.
Hum~
Zhuo Fan’s mindset shifted just as faint sounds reached their ears.
Zhuo Fan started as he sensed the source to be the Vaulting Demonic Sword. On its blade there was also the blazing black thunderflame.
“He-he-he, it must hurt, right? While you, kid, were taking a week-long nap, the sword was being burnt all this time.”
Sea Ao smirked looking at the shaking blade, teasing, “Kid, I don’t know how you got such an idiotic sword spirit. The 6th grade sacred weapon was made by Sword Sovereign with the rarest of ores from the five danger zones. Not even your thunderflame can so much as scratch its blade. Yet the swords taking on your thunderflame very soon got snuffed. Just look at the other three swords, becoming dead in just an hour. Only this sword spirit fueled the fire with its spiritual energy and let the thunderflame burn it for seven days. Talk about the pinnacle of stupidity, enduring so much pain and anguish.”
Hum~
The sword gave an indignant shake while also showing its impatience as the flames crackled with much force.
Zhuo Fan was connected to the sword spirit and sensed it, smirking, “I get it. You sure are ambitious. Let’s give it a try!”
“What are you talking about?” Sea Ao looked out of it as he stared at Zhuo Fan.
He took the ring from Qiao’er and his hands shone with glittering sacred stones, taking flight and burrowing into the ice and snow.
Se Ao watched from the side. In six hours, the array was done and Sea Ao gnashed his fangs, “Refining array? What for?”
“Can’t you tell, senior? What else but refining?”
Zhuo Fan chuckled, signaling, and the demonic sword skipped into the array, with the other three divine swords flying inside.
Zhuo Fan was then focused, making signs as he shouted, “Heaven, earth, mystical and nature; earth, water, wind and fire; with the thunderflame as medium four swords unite, with my sword spirit controlling the shift!”
Boom!
Zhuo Fan then ended with pointing at the array, unleashing a reverberating explosion that shook the whole of the domain. The thunderflame on the demonic sword slipped into the array, surging with strength from the power of the array. It grew so high, one might think it would puncture heaven itself.
The four sacred swords enveloped in the black blaze began to melt.
“Boy, do you have it in you to refine sacred weapons?” Sea Ao looked stunned, “We’re talking about the 6th grade sacred weapons that the Sword Sovereign made, and you think you can refine them?”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “My skills are mere parlor tricks compared to Sword Sovereign, but I’m not trying to refine his sacred weapons, now am I? I only want to combine them, to fulfill my sword spirit’s wish.”
“That’s impossible. The Sword Sovereign needed the five sacred beast powers to refine them. I even helped him get them. That is the reason these five sacred weapons are our bane. He also had the same idea, of combining the five powers while refining them, to make a Sovereign weapon. But with the powers in conflict, everything came to waste. You expect to succeed where he failed?”
“He failed because he lacked something, something I happen to have.” Zhuo Fan was gravely releasing black energy in waves at the array as he pushed out his palms, “Demon Transformation Art!”
Whoosh~
An inky black like the darkest night descended, swallowing the four divine swords, now warped under the constant torment of the thunderflame.
The demonic sword exploded in a scarlet and bloody light, using it to envelop the three swords. As the thunderflame and the black energy ate away at the three blades, the amalgamation within the bloody bubble twisted and melted into one entity, in the form of a black sword.
Sea Ao stood agape, remembering to shout after a long time, “I totally forgot you combined the five sacred beast powers. How hard could melting sacred weapons be? Sacred weapons are tough, with no mortal flame able to scratch them while the thunderflame is the supreme power of the world. Using it to melt the bodies and the demonic method to merge the sword styles, the thing Sword Sovereign failed becomes achievable in your hands. Kid, you sure are something.”
A humming was heard and a black blade with blue, red, green and golden stripes flew out of the inferno. Zhuo Fan gripped it in his hands.
“It’s not me, but the Nine Serenities Sovereign and the Sword Sovereign. I am merely standing on the shoulders of giants.” Zhuo Fan beamed, “Senior Sea Ao, I shall never forget what you did for me today. Farewell. I need to get back to Sacred Domain…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1113 - 1113, Impartial
chapters.content:
Chapter 1113, Impartial
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Zhuo Fan! Where are you, Zhuo Fan?”
On the shore of North Sea, devastated from the brutal and bloody battle, the surviving Sea Bright Sect disciples were busying themselves restoring the heavy damage. Only a few people traveled along the shore of the expansive sea, shouting and pleading with tears in their eyes. Luo Yunchang with Shuang’er and their people were searching with a bleak outlook for one missing man.
Luo Yunhai was walking aside, gazing at the vast waters with a heavy sigh, “Brother Zhuo, we finally came to know you’re alive, but where could you have gone to now?”
“A dead man like him always pops out of nowhere and vanishes in the same fashion moments later. He won’t even drop by for a visit. We get that you’re busy but the least you could do is send us words now and then and not keep us heartbroken and always worrying about you.” Wiping her tears, Luo Yunchang chided.
Her sisters consoled her, giving her a handkerchief. Luo Yunhai shook his head, “Sister, don’t feel bad, brother Zhuo has great fortune and I’m sure this time is no different.”
“That’s for the good guys. No evil wicked man ever got blessed with good luck.” Someone shouted in reply.
They all turned in anger at an elegant and lofty girl, her eyes always looking far over the wide sea. She looked cold and sorrowful, but her biting words clearly struck someone when they were down.
Luo Yunchang stared daggers at her and snapped, “What did Zhuo Fan ever do to you? Why are you cursing him when we don’t even know if he’s alive?”
“His fate is no mystery, not when he’s dead.”
The girl sighed, “Everyone knows how strong the sea demon is, and the information we have says that when the sea demon withdrew, only the Invincible Sword’s group got out. That fiend is without a doubt laying crushed under the sea demon’s paw. His sins are heavy, but out of respect for the departed, I will stop here. I only want for no one to follow his example on the evil and bloody path he trailed.”
“Hey, what’s the big idea?”
“Sister Xue, brother Zhuo is gone now so could you at least try to show some consideration?” Luo Yunchang raged, waving her hands around in defiance. Another girl rushed over to placate them, “Did you forget why we’re here? Brother Murong and my father are still missing!”
A man strutted over to the girls, shouting, “Sister Xue, Yan’er, I had no luck finding father and the others. What about on your side?”
The three were also here, searching the rubble.
Murong Xue ignored them and went to look, “Good and evil have always been on separate sides. The devil is gone, but the whole world knows of his sins. You may refuse to hear the truth, but do you think you can stop all people from talking?”
“Wait!”
Luo Yunhai held out her hand to block them. Her eyes glimmered and Luo Yunhai walked to her and looked into the other girl’s flat gaze, “Miss, don’t judge before you understand. Zhuo Fan is my big brother and my Luo clan’s steward. As his brother and Clan Head, I am unable to ignore your blatant slander. You call big brother a fiend with grave sins. Why?”
“You’re his little brother? Well so am I!”
“Take a powder!”
Ouyang Changqing snickered, worming his way in their graces, but Murong Xue glared at him before turning to Luo Yunhai, “I am not talking behind someone else’s back, nor am I insulting the departed. Evil is evil. Since you wish to know his vile deeds, I shall lay them all out for you.”
Murong Xue began with her trip to the central area. When she finished, Luo Yunhai sneered, “Central area is our enemy. Brother Zhuo was besieged on all sides by enemies. Whether in self-defense or attacking, it was all within his right. You call that a crime? In that case, who among the four land leaders, including your Murong clan, is innocent?”
“He involved countless innocents from a merchant group…”
“Those clinging to the powerful should be ready to fall alongside them.”
“But all those lives, gone before their time…”
“Where you see life, I see fairness.” Luo Yunhai retorted, “You call them innocent, the same type of innocent fostered on wealth and power. Could those innocent hands be clean then, never stained with blood and grime? Since they aren’t, then they’re not innocent. You might even say they received just rewards. What’s there to sympathize with?”
Murong Xue frowned, unrelenting, “Sinners as they might have been, not all deserve death, yet so many have died…”
“You don’t get to judge who dies or lives or how much of a sinner one is. What gave you the idea they deserved to live? Brother Zhuo said once, corruption begets corruption. They might’ve just stolen a single needle, but what goes around, comes around. To say nothing of a merchant group, wallowing in profits, their hands couldn’t be dirtier. Brother Zhuo did the world a favor, acting in heaven’s stead.”
“He’s not heaven. Who is he to pass judgment in its stead and harm so many people?”
“Neither are you. Why do you insist on labeling brother Zhuo as evil while calling yourself righteous?” Luo Yunhai matched her at every turn, leaving Murong Xue tongue tied.
Zhuge Changfeng chuckled to himself.
[Clan Head’s statecraft is progressing well.]
He stepped over, encouraging, “Miss, I was once an imperial Prime Minister, and can say with confidence that among officials and merchants, countless people lay dead at their feet. The Murong clan is a righteous clan, with miss only looking at the thousands of casualties and not at the details leading to the disaster. To be honest, in my capacity as his formal opponent and now colleague, I can assure you that Steward Zhuo is fair!”
“Fair?”
Murong Xue mocked, pointing at the thousands of corpses, howling in exasperation, “You call it fair, his vile plan of having so many lives accompany him in death?”
Luo Yunhai cast a cold eye on the bodies, shouting back, “Commander Touba!”
“Present!” Tuoba Tieshan snapped to attention on Luo Yunhai’s side.
“Commander Touba, tell this miss, what was our relationship a dozen years ago?”
“Enemies!”
“And Zhuo Fan?”
“Enemies!”
“Have you met in battle? How did it conclude?”
“In Tianyu’s great war, I suffered a crushing defeat. My soldiers laid to waste, my officers broken, the death toll uncountable. I marked the end of my career.”
“Do you hate him?”
“What hate is there for a soldier to fight on the battlefield that uses his own strength?” Tuoba Tieshan chuckled, then snapped loudly, “Hate is a sign of cowardice. Hate cannot prevail over an enemy. I lost to Zhuo Fan and all he has is my utmost respect. I only think of fighting him again, nothing more, nothing less.”
Luo Yunhai dismissed him, turning a sharp gaze on Murong Xue, “Now you see? On the field of battle, where the fighting is most fierce, it is measured in defeat or victory, and not in casualties. Best be prepared to die the moment you step into the fray, for there is no good and evil, only weak and strong. In this war, the four lands had prevailed over the central area. Regardless of the casualties, we won. This was brother Zhuo’s justice. None shall ever call him vile or evil!
“If you think war is evil, then let me tell you the difference!”
Luo Yunhai flicked his hand and a map appeared before her eyes, “Due to brother Zhuo’s plan, the battle resumed to only northern lands, allowing the other three lands to be safe. Even with the enemy armies entering deep into the three lands, due to brother Zhuo’s tactic, they had always been on the move, not stopping for anything, thus their influence minimal to the people. You’re a leader of southern lands. Now you may return home and see if even a grass was touched.
“Also, even with the war waged on northern lands’ soil, we held the frontline, stopping them from taking any step deeper while our people behind assaulted the Invincible Sword. In between, no civilian had been affected. When the war was over, they were still living their normal lives. Brother Zhuo had come up with the plan, but no innocents have been implicated. This is being impartial!”
Murong Xue’s brow shook hard, muttering, her voice weak, “But his plan caused many people to die. If not for him, even if we lost, there wouldn’t be so many casualties.”
“Miss Murong, weren’t you listening? Brother Zhuo, only let those involved die and not the innocent.”
Luo Yunhai’s sharp stare never left her, roaring, “To be blunt, the war between the four lands and central area is nothing but a battle of interests between us who use these lands’ resources. All the deaths are warranted, for we fought for ourselves. The true cruelty and evil would’ve been dragging the populace into it. They suffer when we flourish, they suffer when we decline. What do they ever get in peacetime? Why should we involve them in wars?”
“It’s the same as driving a spiritual beast-pulled carriage and you find six children playing in the road. If you decide to veer off, you’d be hitting the one child hiding behind a tree. What would you choose? Would you be trampling the children or the other one?”
“I…” Murong Xue was stuck.
“Allow me to help you.”
Luo Yunhai shouted over her, “You only see lives as numbers and would’ve chosen the lone child without fault to protect the six playing in the road. Since they were more, you believe you did the right thing. Here’s where brother Zhuo differs. He would’ve gone over the six children, for they were in the wrong and had to suffer the consequences, instead of having an innocent life take the fall for them. That’s being impartial!
“The same applies to us now. To involve even one innocent life into our war would’ve been the greatest sin. No matter how many of us died from battle, all are within our rights. For we refuse to give what we have. When every man is for himself, what’s there to complain about?”
Rooted on the spot, Murong Xue looked dumbly at Luo Yunhai, words failing her in even mounting a retort.
Luo Yunhai gave her a hard stare, “I know brother Zhuo isn’t a saint by any means, but he is one demon I respect. He never lays his hands on good people, with demons always fighting other demons. To my eyes, he is heaven’s judge in punishing evil. I ask that you keep your insults you have for him to yourself. Your immature understanding of kindness and justice have no use in this world.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1114 - 1114, Hiding
chapters.content:
Chapter 1114, Hiding
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Luo Yunhai flicked around and left, leaving the three in complete stupefaction. Zhuge Changfeng quickened his step to catch up to the Clan Head.
Luo Yunhai paused moments later.
“Clan Head…”
Noticing his dark look and clenched fists, Zhuge Changfeng asked.
Luo Yunhai gulped, his voice low, “Steward Zhuge, we are too passive. Even in times when the Luo clan had nothing to their name, I still didn’t feel as passive as now. We had him, we were so close to winning after the bitter and heavy sacrifices, yet we gave it all up just because the ones above said so?”
“Clan Head, I understand your feelings.”
Zhuge Changfeng smiled, his eyes sharp, “Clan Head wants to seize power, recalling our unstoppable rise.”
Luo Yunhai nodded, “We’ve had a swift growth in the western lands, but far too benign. We have never held the right to decide in any real situation. Just how we were sent to risk our lives then gave it all up the next moment. We never had a say in it. We’re only reactive.”
“I want to lead the world and not have some codgers toy with me!” Luo Yunhai’s eyes shone as he revealed his wish.
Zhuge Changfeng nodded, “I understand everything, Clan Head. With the world now recovering after the chaos, it is ripe with opportunities. We will help Clan Head take it all. You can be sure of that!”
Luo Yunhai glanced at him, signaled, and left with his people. But for the first time, his eyes held a deep desire for power.
When in Tianyu, it was Zhuo Fan who helped him with every plan. The Luo clan was weak, but not defenseless, taking its due share every time and working its way up to change its fate.
After Zhuo Fan left, he gave Lou Yunhai three great minds to help with everything while laying the groundwork for the development of the Luo Alliance. He groomed the righteous clan to never lose its core values, or its honest style, earning the admiration of people everywhere.
Now, even with how great the Luo Alliance was, it was nothing but a pawn from the western lands on the world chessboard. Pushed around, told what to do, striving and suffering, yet not once able to fight for the right of those that perished. Even in their civil war, they just ignored the imperial order. Here though, in the war of the lands, they were to stop when told to, regardless of if the higher ups lacked the decency to explain why.
Regardless of the deal those old men reached, one thing was certain, they, the little men, had nothing to do with it. They were there to be used.
Luo Yunhai had never before been treated with such callous disregard, like a convenient tool. His heart burned with the desire to change the futility and weakness he felt.
[In this cruel world, morals and duty are garbage without the power to back them.]
You might care for the men under you, but would your superior sympathize? You might worry about the people, but would those above?
Duty and honor were built on supreme power. Everything else was moot.
[It’s why brother Zhuo took the Luo clan to the top of Tianyu before leaving. For even being another’s right-hand man, you’d still be his pawn.]
[I’ve grown lazy these years, to not understand brother Zhuo’s pain.]
Luo Yunhai closed his eyes, tearing up a bit, but then he snapped them open with resolve.
[No more. Brother Zhuo, you’ve left us three great minds to assist our assault, not defenses. The Luo clan will climb its way higher, starting now. Never again shall we be stuck in a rut like today. We write our own fate, not letting others use us ever again!]
Luo Yunhai walked on with purpose and determination.
Murong Xue never spoke a word.
“Hey, who does the punk think he is? You think you’re so tough yelling at my girl?” Ouyang Changqing finally reacted and lashed out.
Shangguan Qingyan glanced at him and smirked, “You complain now, when they’re gone? What was that back there then?”
“Uh, it’s just he made damn good sense and I had no comeback. Besides, he’s big brother’s brother and I have to show restraint. Or big brother might come after me…”
“Tch, all bark and no bite.” Shangguan Qingyan rolled her eyes and disdained. Murong Xue’s eyes shook and said to Ouyang Changqing, “You believe him? That what that fiend did was impartial?”
“Well…”
Ouyang Changqing glanced at her, not wanting his answer to anger her. ” Xue’er, Changqing, Yan’er, you’re here!”
“Elder brother!”
“Dad!”
“Father!”
The three were caught by surprise at the familiar shout, then turned with joy to find their family they had been searching for all along.
The three were looking grave, even with their warm gaze upon their children and siblings.
Murong Xue sensed the change and frowned, “Brother, what is it?”
The three sighed, with Murong Lie beginning, “Xue’er, this will be our last meeting for a long time, if not final.”
“What?” The three juniors shouted.
Murong Lie gestured to them to calm down, “We have discussed retiring and understanding Dao in peace. Henceforth, Xue’er, you shall be the acting Murong Clan Head!”
“Changqing, you’ll only have yourself to look after you in the sect from now on.”
“Yan’er, tell my decision to our venerables and elders. Take care.”
Ouyang Lingtian and Shangguan Feixiong gave their own encouragements, their eyes firm.
The juniors were left dumbstruck, “But why?”
“In our fight with the Invincible Sword, we came to understand that we’ve let the mundane matters take over our lives for too long, keeping us from seeing the path. We bug our minds with the secular affairs, unlike Sir Zhuo and Baili Yutian, who despite being in the secular world, their hearts only focus on Dao. We need to return to seclusion.”
Murong Lie was the only one who spoke, “As for the second reason, you should know by now. How did the war end?”
The juniors looked confused.
Murong Lie sighed, “I guess you’re too young still to see it, so I’ll tell you. Ever since we woke up among the ruble, we saw the war ending and were stunned. We went to Sect Leader Ling and then came to know of the deal with Baili Jingwei; a hundred year peace. But who is to stop the Invincible Sword after that?
“All I got from him was silence. Or better yet, they never once thought about it or cared. For with the fall of the Invincible Sword, it meant the four Sword Kings would run amok in their lands. While with the Invincible Sword alive, the world war might have its second act in the future. The death toll would be even higher, with the people suffering for it. Xue’er, you know that our clan is a clan of valor, Shangguan clan is righteous, but even our venerables gave in to the proposal, all so they could keep the clan alive for a century more.”
Murong Xue lowered her head and bit her lip.
“Take me but save the world. It’s the foundation of the Murong clan, but never imagined the day would come when they would push the pain a hundred years later on their children.”
Murong Lie shook his head, “Xue’er, we’ve let the profane infect us and twist our views. The Murong clan isn’t what it used to be. Shangguan clan is the same. Thus we decided to step back from worldly affairs. Sending righteousness into the mundane world only invites temptation and decay. Perhaps it only helps demonic cultivators to understand their path better.”
Murong Xue shuddered and Zhuo Fan’s warning rang in her mind, “For the righteous to reach the end, rising above is a must. Surrounded by the profane and your Dao Heart will be tainted. Drowned in your demons, you might never find righteousness again.”
[The fiend is so clear on both paths. Does that mean I’m the one unable to tell the difference between the two?]
“Juniors, this is goodbye.”
Murong Lie cupped his hands and laughed. The other two did the same and left just like that.
The juniors’ shouts were too slow to reach them.
Murong Xue was left there, with closed eyes and a sigh as she recalled Zhuo Fan’s ridiculing smile.
Facts spoke louder than words. Her own brother was disappointed in their clan. Their clan had long since lost their righteous reputation, selling out the people of the four lands. It was all them, and not those vile and cunning demons.
“It seems I need to do the same as my brother, go into hiding and learn the way.”
With a bitter smile, Murong Xue sighed, “I hope that once I understand everything, I’ll see you in a different light, fiend…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1115 - 1115, Worldwide Changes
chapters.content:
Chapter 1115, Worldwide Changes
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
The war of the lands started after more than a year of ample preparations from both sides, yet lasted under two weeks. These few days were more than enough to cause a widespread change to the world.
The losses in the war were the highest on the four lands’ side, having been the one at disadvantage to begin with. They had lost close to three quarters of all their manpower to hold back the invading army. It was nothing more than a pyrrhic victory, of blood and carnage.
Nonetheless, a win was what they had achieved against a formidable foe. They had forced the central area into retreating. Yet it felt more of a defeat because when the chance presented itself to finish off the undefeated empire, they chose to let it slip away for some odd reason.
All the soldiers who risked their lives and the very few lucky ones to have outlived this war felt toyed with at the news. For what had they bled so much?
While the powers that be talked among each other, the lower rung was easily swayed and gullible. Saying something like it was for their own good, as more losses would be disastrous, or any such sanctimonious excuses, was enough.
This took their mind off the reality that the Invincible Sword was going to come back with a vengeance, possibly go berserk in his assault. While a fraction of officers were sharp enough to figure it out, the main bulk of the army was made up of lost sheep going where the wind blew. All the pain, bloodshed and suffering felt soothed with tangible gains in their hands.
After such a genocidal war, many crucial positions in the four lands became open. In the western lands’ case, the nine sects were in short supply of disciples and elders, and they started mass recruiting. In the eastern lands and southern lands’ cases, the head clans ruling them were short handed as well and needed to fill in countless spots, mostly low positions.
With brilliant prospects ripe for the taking, many scrambled to climb the social ladder. For who had the time to mind insipid stuff like the illogical decision of the leaders to negotiate a ceasefire?
The Luo Alliance had heavy losses as well and also took in crowds of people into their fold. Every time he saw the boundless greed in all their eyes, Luo Yunhai sighed, “The pigs…”
Leng Wuchang and Zhuge Changfeng were happy though, as supreme power was being dumped on their’ heads. Without these fools, who would carry out all those power plays and upstaging battles?
Such was reality. As the Luo Alliance wasn’t a selective sect that took one disciple at a time, it could gobble up whole clans by the dozens. It recruited like a ravenous whale feasting on krill. In mere months, it was halfway back to its old self. It left all the sects in the dust and in utter shock.
The Luo Alliance experienced the swiftest growth after the war. While the quality left much to be desired, it made up in quantity. It jumped right into being at a top middle-three sect level and even showed signs of catching up to a superior-three sect.
Double Dragon Manor was just as stunned. Before, the Luo Alliance was only at the top lower-three sect level. The growth was just insane.
It soon became apparent why. This was the Luo Alliance’s spoils from the war. Being an alliance, it had swift growth as its main feature. This was noted even before the war, though not at this rate since other veteran sects stood above. Now that the veteran powers were weakened, the Luo Alliance showed just how fast it could bolster their ranks.
Exalted Double Dragons sighed.
[Zhuo Fan has set up the Luo Alliance well. Luo Alliance will soon become the head of the nine sects, if not on the Double Dragon Manor’s level.]
None of them were aware that this war had stirred Luo Yunhai to reach for the top. Double Dragon Manor would have no chance to stop it by then.
Some clans cheered, others bemoaned. While the western lands were buzzing with activity and recuperation after the war, the southern lands, northern lands and eastern lands were in the pits of despair, wretched and devastated.
Their main factions were recovering, sure, but the main issue here was the lack of a most crucial figure. The three divine swords got lost when their wielders entered the Sea Demon’s black mist in a grave state, and now those three clans washed their hands of their lands’ problems, opting for seclusion.
The three lands were left dumbstruck. Without the leaders, it’d be a miracle if they could withstand the Nine Sword Kings, to say nothing of the Invincible Sword.
To get these three leaders to come back to them, the northern lands’ group kicked Ouyang Changqing’s door, the eastern lands’ blue bloods waited at Shangguan Qingyan’s house for news, while the coots in the southern lands had the Murong compound on lockdown to not let Murong Lie go, staying there until death if they had to.
They were met with a vile and most unscrupulous Ouyang Changqing. He knew they needed him so he had no qualms in asking for a bribe then and there. To make it worse, he flaunted in their face every day, acting like the king of the northern lands and getting on their nerves because he knew they couldn’t touch him. As for when his old man would come around, he made sure to be as vague as possible.
In Shangguan Qingyan’s case, there was a lady too refined and poised to fall so low. So she bolted her door to any and all solicitors. The troublemakers were easily dispatched with the help of the clan’s three venerables. They were far from helpless. After some thorough examples were made, the crowd knew when to take a hint.
The biggest shock came in the Murong clan. Murong Lie vanished and, as it turned out, so did his sister. With the two gone, the clan had no one to turn to.
Having lost their divine swords and their leaders, the three lands were at their weakest in history. With little choice, they returned to restoring their strength. They learned from the western lands to just take in people en masse for the common ranks. This ought to patch up the most glaring vulnerability. The more the better, no?
The four lands being in such a horrid mess presented the perfect chance to the central area to take them all down. With their Nine Sword Kings, a division was more than enough to mow them down.
Baili Jingwei’s peace accord made it impossible, having pledged on his own Dao Heart from invading those lands for the century to come.
Though a man as wise as Baili Jingwei, was not so foolish to set himself up to a hundred years of stagnation. The peace came to be because he had no choice. He truly needed a century of peace.
The Sword Star Empire was the mightiest, employing the greatest army, but it had lost its cohesion, a thing of the past, replaced by bits and pieces.
With the central area’s vast swaths of lands and riches, in just a couple of weeks, a million insurrections ignited. A third of the towns fell, making it the worst civil war in the history of the central area.
Zhuo Fan made a killer move telling the Serene Shores Trading to rise up in time of war. Even within the relatively short time frame, the Serene Shores Trading had no qualms and flipped the mighty nation upside down, especially how void it was of any real military to stop them.
The entire insurrection was a chain reaction. With one taking the lead, the other local thugs followed right after. It led to the mighty nation that knew only peace for a millennia burning down to pieces faster than tinder.
Baili Jingwei, himself, was stunned to find the peace he maintained had so many dangers lurking under the surface. They hardly were worth notice, if they had been put out when they started. Now though, he had to rein it in and look after his Patriarch while pacifying the four Sword Kings.
He knew though, that the Sword Star Empire was now changed forever. The insurrection was on a massive scale. He might force it to simmer, but the embers would still be there, losing the cohesion it enjoyed for so many years. To cull all the foreign elements from such a large territory required time and patience, a hundred years at least.
Baili Jingwei made the vow for good reason. He did not want the four lands to mess up his nation any more than it already was. Funny how the four lands’ leaders still thought they had forced Baili Jingwei into a corner to make such a proposal, enjoying their victory. They were just oblivious to the fact that Baili Jingwei played them all this time.
Time, it was something every side needed right now, Prime Minister Baili the most.
“Grandmaster, how is the Patriarch’s condition?”
In a dim hall, a wizen old man came from behind a thick drape. Baili Jingtian rushed him for answers. The emperor and the crown prince were right behind him.
The man bowed, “Your Majesty, Prime Minister, Your Highness, I have given Patriarch a 12th grade pill to stabilize. However…”
“What?” All asked in one voice, laced with concern.
The elder frowned, “The Patriarch’s wounds are beyond deep, his Yuan Qi spent, his core damaged. The Patriarch still had the strength to live for close to a thousand years more, but as he is now, he shall find his rest in a hundred years, beyond any hope…”
“You’re saying Patriarch has only a hundred years…” Baili Jingwei’s heart jumped in his throat, “Grandmaster, the nation can’t do without the Patriarch. There has to be…”
The old man sighed, “Humans have their limits, and so do I. Unless…”
“What?”
“The Patriarch advances before the end, extending his life. I’ve lived for so many years already and with the Patriarch at the very peak, there still has not been any case of there being another realm above it. Thus…”
Bam!
Baili Jingwei crushed his skull with his palm, his eyes cold.
Baili Jingshi gasped, “H-he was an imperial 12th grade alchemist…”
“Not a word can escape the Patriarch’s condition.”
Baili Jingwei’s eyes flashed, glancing at the bleeding body, “Your Majesty, he would’ve died even if he was a miracle worker. What do you think the four Sword Kings will do the minute they know of the Patriarch’s condition?”
Baili Jingshi nodded after a thought, “How did you handle them? Are they truly in the dark about everything?”
“I made sure no word escaped carrying the Patriarch back to the imperial capital, I even had the five Sword Kings stay silent. The five of them were wounded and I had them sent to recover.
