“Well… it is doable.”
Danqing Shen mulled it over, “Killing one man then coming right back isn’t an issue. Sure, I agree.”
Yuwen Yong bowed once more, filled with joy, his eyes showing obvious scorn…
An hour later, Baili Jingwei stood in a dark room. Yuwen Yong bowed next to him, “Prime Minister, everything’s set. Danqing Shen is going!”
“Good, I didn’t hide your matter for a century for nothing. Don’t worry, I’ll let you take revenge yourself. Also, make sure to notify all the lands about Danqing Shen’s actions.”
“Yes, and thank you, Prime Minister!”
Baili Jingwei nodded, a grin forming on his face.
“Rest assured, Patriarch, I’ll make sure to remove every danger to the empire’s safety. Soon, the Sword Star Empire will shine like the sun, ha-ha-ha…”
The mad laughter bounced off the dark wall of the hall…

chapters.title: Chapter 1126 - 1126, You’re Looking for Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1126, You’re Looking for Me?
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Are you certain that the Devil Palace Lord is in there?”
Three months flew by. The Zither Sword King was in a lavish hall, framed by a soothing light and in elegant clothes.
A man kneeled before him, old and bald.
“Sword King, I’ve been scouting the Devil Palace for decades, while the Palace Lord’s whereabouts are always unknown.”
But thanks to my broad experience these many many years, I drew some conclusions at long last based on his known locations. I went there to try my luck and actually came to find one of the five Dharma Kings, Sparrow King. She and Beast King are the most common of the five that go with the Palace Lord. Her presence is solid proof the the Palace Lord is there, in Swordfall!”
The Zither Sword King nodded and waved him off.
Bald Demon bowed and took his leave.
“Well, well, I didn’t know that the Zither Sword King wanted to see me so much, ha-ha-ha…” A laughter sounded around, “Then you ought to have a rough idea what my palace is about. Why go through all this trouble tracking me down for decades?”
The Zither Sword King and Bald Demon flinched, their hearts jumping in their chest. They whipped their head about and finally noticed the extra youth with covered eyes sitting in his Sword King throne, a playful yet insidious smile on his face.
He had a girl and a youth on either side, staring them down like hawks. The tokens on their waist glittered in the light in a dazzling fashion.
Bald Demon’s eyes went wide, almost soiling himself as he stammered, “B-Beast King and Sparrow King! Y-you’re the Palace Lord?”
“The Dark Demon Lord of the Devil Palace?”
Zither Sword King’s brow quivered, caught by surprise at the sudden appearance. Then he turned grave.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “It would be a darn shame for all that effort tracking me down all those decades not to show up, don’t you think? So I figured why not come to you and put you at ease, ha-ha-ha…”
Gulp.
Bald Demon’s knees were jelly, sweat pouring down like rain. He turned a pleading look to the Zither Sword King, waiting on his decision.
[Boss, you put me up to this. This is your turf, you gotta help me!]
The Zither Sword King had no time to mind his existential crisis, staring hard at Zhou Fan before taking out a millenium zither. He flicked his hands and a soothing melody sounded, releasing seven sword energies straight at Zhuo Fan.
“They say they the Dark Demon Lord is beyond strong, at the peak of the world’s strength. I would like to test my meager skill against your lordship’s, if sire deems me worthy.”
“Seven Notes Obscure Sword?” Bald Demon lit up.
“How dare you!”
Qiao’er raged but Zhuo Fan waved her back.
Hum~
Zhuo Fan snickered from the grand throne, he didn’t need to even move as a shield formed around him.
The seven strikes backed by the power of a Sword King fizzled out on contact. They couldn’t even get the shield to shake. Even a three-year-old was stronger.
Zither Sword King’s eyes shook from shock, his spine taken with a chill.
[The Dark Demon Lord is beyond monstrous. My Seven Notes Obscure Sword couldn’t so much as touch him, canceled out like nothing.]
[T-this can’t be happening!]
Bald Demon was gaping wide, his eyes bugging out. His innards, however, writhed in regret for going after such a ludicrous expert like the Palace Lord. Not even a Sword King’s attack could make him flinch.
Since it was out that he was the Zither Sword King’s spy, then his life was forfeit, especially since his boss couldn’t save him.
He felt like crying then and there. The thrill of doing all he wanted in the lands for being under the Zither Sword King got to his head.
He thus disregarded the Devil Palace Lord and his kings, taking them for overinflated rumors compared with the might of a true Sword King from the central area. Why else would they stick to the shadows and be so sneaky about it?
Reality though proved otherwise.
[Shit! They’re insanely strong! You call yourself a Sword King when you can’t even get him to twitch a finger?]
Bald Demon bowed at once to Zhuo Fan, “Spare me, Palace Lord, I had no choice. The Zither Sword King made me. Please…”
“Sword King, did that suffice your curiosity? I now have a little curiosity of my own and was wondering if you could tell me why would you insist on going through such lengths to find me out? Of the Ten Sword Kings, the Zither Sword King is the most casual and relaxed of them, not going out of your way. My people had an easy time working in your area as well, making me not even see the Zither Sword King as an enemy.”
Ignoring the background noise, Liu Mubai had Zhuo Fan’s full attention and smile.
The Zither Sword King chuckled with joy, before all mirth vanished like it never existed, “I am grateful for the Palace Lord’s indulgence, but before I answer, would it be presumptuous of me to ask the Palace Lord something? With the Devil Palace spread throughout the five lands, do you have any intentions to take down the Sword Star Empire?”
“Yes.” Zhuo Fan was quick to reply.
“Why?”
“It’s in my way and has to be removed.” Zhuo Fan was as earnest as he was serious.
Zhuo Fan needed to set up the recoil array that ran through all the lands. Sword Star Empire held power in the central area and was sure to interfere with his project if left be.
[It’s not like I can waltz in saying ‘Hey, let me set this up real quick and I’ll be on my way.’]
Why?
Be it territory or assets, all were based on power. Why would anyone talk with you when you had nothing to your name? And in the case you had the power, why waste time with empty chatter when taking was so much easier?
For himself and his goal, Zhuo Fan had to take the empire down. All that was left was for the right moment to avail itself.
Zither Sword King stared hard at him and noticed the truth. He smirked, his eyes shining with hope, “Then I can be frank with the Palace Lord as well. Let’s work together!”
Qiao’er and young Sanzi shared a curious look, while the bawling Bald Demon choked on his tears and snot as he shot a wide look at him.
[Boss, are you high? You didn’t send me after him to take him out but to cooperate? What the hell?]
“Why?”
Zhuo Fan saw it coming, judging by the flat look, “Give me one good reason why I should trust you?”
“We have the same goal, you and I, the demise of the Sword Star Empire!”
The Zither Sword King sighed, “Before the Sword Star Empire came to rule the central area, it was the Liu clan that wielded Sundering Sword, my clan. The Invincible Sword challenged everyone left and right, rising above us all. He is indeed a genius, becoming unstoppable even before he got to understand Sundering Sword’s art, able to take it by force from my clan. Then the Sword Star Empire grew and swallowed all of the central area. Any dissidents were culled and my clan was left to decay.
“But the hope that one day we might recover the Sundering Sword and destroy the empire was passed down through generations, all the way to me. My little insight into the Sundering Sword Art was all thanks to my ancestors, allowing me to rise to the rank of a Sword King and into the heart of power. It may be ancient history or perhaps the Invincible Sword had defeated too many experts for him to remember me as well. In any case, he has no suspicion of me. I have stayed all this time as the central area’s Sword King for the right timing to get back at them.”
“So you came for me?”
“Yes, I noticed the Devil Palace decades ago, quicker than anyone else and knew therein lay my chance. I just didn’t know how far it would go or grow enough to threaten the empire. For this I planted a spy to observe.”
The Zither Sword King was excited, “I’m glad to know the wait was not in vain. The Palace Lord is a heavenly genius. In a century, you set up a faction that can fight with the empire’s Ten Sword Kings. While lordship, yourself, are even unmatched. I am now certain that with both of us working together, the empire will fall!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1127 - 1127, Aged Birthday
chapters.content:
Chapter 1127, Aged Birthday
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Qiao’er and Gu Santong shared a look. Bald Demon was looking stumped as well.
[Why… so all that spying was so he could join hands with the Palace Lord?]
[But aren’t I from the Devil Palace already? What joining?]
He always felt that he had been a double agent, only to find out he was just a simple one since both sides wanted to work together.
[What was the point of even doing all that then? So the two could mediate?]
Zhuo Fan paused for a long time, before shaking his head, “I appreciate the Zither Sword King’s thoughts, but the time isn’t ripe. Seeing sir so anxious, it will make our cooperation stifled. Fighting alone would be preferred.”
“Why the hesitation, Palace Lord?”
“Many reasons, starting with the empire still holding strong and would only prolong a war. Or in the case of a win, my palace will come into the light and draw the eyes of the other lands, putting us in danger. As for the most crucial reason, the odds are slim at best…”
“Why do you say that?” Zither Sword King shook.
Zhuo Fan said, “The Invincible Sword.”
“Him?”
Zither Sword King scoffed, “Palace Lord, the old guy hasn’t been around for a century. If not dead, then on his deathbed, frail and weak…”
“Have you seen him?”
“Uh…” Zither Sword King paused at the question, hesitating, “Baili Jingwei and the emperor are the only ones who know his condition.”
The Zither Sword King nodded, “True, he’s not about to let it spread, especially when there’s so much danger lurking about. Zither Sword King, they say you’re quite casual, but now you’re acting against this info. Is it on purpose or made so? Filled with nothing but hatred, you’ll be prone to anxiety and rash decisions. We shall not be cooperating, goodbye.”
Zhuo Fan stood and walked out with Qiao’er and Gu Santong at his sides.
The Zither Sword King rushed, “Hold on, Palace Lord! That’s not an issue. I’ve waited for so long and can still wait for a few more years.”
“Sword King, you might say that, but that is your nature. To be frank, I don’t want dead weights. A man that has no control over himself and only seeks revenge, can never achieve anything.”
“Then how can we cooperate?” Zither Sword King’s eyes shook.
Zhuo Fan paused, “Sword King, you’re a smart man and should know that cooperation isn’t limited to joining hands. Being on the same page will suffice. While our aims differ, our target is the same. Knowing this, you can tell how we can work together, ha-ha-ha…”
Zither Sword King was silent.
“About that rhyme of yours, make another when you have the time.” Zhuo Fan waved and left with his children.
Zither Sword King winced and sighed, “Dark Demon Lord is so peculiar. Baili Jingwei has met his match again.”
“Sword King, so you…”
Bald Demon stuck to his side. But then his body turned into a bloody mist, drifting away.
The Zither Sword King relaxed his hand, no shift in features at all.
“You know too much…”
“Father, how should we deal with that traitor, Bald Demon?”
The trio walked among a busy street, with Gu Santong feeling annoyed as he looked back.
Zhuo Fan dismissed his worry, “That’s no traitor, but a spy, one that hid for decades in my palace. Liu Mubai owns him and he isn’t about to worsen our relationship over one small trifle. Liu Mubai is bound to clean up. Let others take care of their dogs and not undermine their authority.”
“Wha…”
“He knows too much. Would you have left him around to leak the private meeting with the Devil Palace Lord if you were in his shoes? Ha-ha-ha, Liu Mubai planned on removing him the minute he was open about his intentions.” Zhuo Fan grinned.
Young Sanzi nodded.
Qiao’er asked, “Father, were you just talking about the rhyme that spread across the lands? It sounds like we’re trying to ruin the empire. Did Liu Mubai spread it?”
“Should be.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “I picked up from his speech that he is fixated on seeing the Sword Star Empire burn and the rhyme came to me as a borrowed knife tactic. He knows we have the strength to oppose it so he let the rhyme spread and inflame the hatred on both sides. We could’ve had no intentions for the empire for all he cared, because now we’re enemies for sure. He’s only working with us to make sure the Sword Star Empire is done for.
“Sometimes, rumors are worse, especially one like this that gets on the nerves of a ruler. The two of us are now fire and water, on a collision course. I don’t mind him doing this, but I hate being used. That’s why I mentioned the rhyme at the end to gauge his reaction, whether he was behind it or not. But also to warn him that I know and not to get smart with me. I have the final say and I’m not about to play his game.”
Young Sanzi and Qiao’er nodded.
“Hey, did you hear? Dragon Cleaving Sword King is going after the Luo Alliance Leader in western lands. Do you think he has any chance?”
“A Sword King targeting the Luo Alliance Leader? Isn’t that so low of him? He has his status to think about.”
“How is that low? They say the Dragon Cleaving Sword King’s decision has nothing to do with the two lands. It’s to fulfill a thousand year-old promise. Someone brought him the lost painting and asked for revenge for the imperial family a century ago. This is their world. The four lands could know about it as well, but I don’t think they’ll intervene since it’s not about the two lands.”
“But he’s the pillar of western lands. With him gone…”
“And? He’s part of their world too and no one can run from resentments.”
“With the Sword King stepping in, even with millions of soldiers, the Luo Alliance Leader will die. It’ll be child’s play for a Sword King to get their head, go for him and not waste time on the soldiers…”
“Right?”
A particular gossip pierced Zhuo Fan’s thoughts.
Zhuo Fan shuddered and his brow tense, “Danqing Shen is going after Yunhai?”
“Father, should I go stop him?” Young Sanzi offered.
Zhuo Fan raised his hand, “Something’s not right. Why does the whole world know of Danqing Shen’s plan to kill him?”
“Father, what do you mean?”
“Suspicion comes from trickery. Danqing Shen has always been quiet, while the one asking the favor wouldn’t have let it leak to warn them. Celebrate after the job is done. Or is he so sure Danqing Shen can do it?”
Zhuo Fan mulled it over and then said, “Qiao’er, young Sanzi, find out the five lands’ reaction to this. I’ll stop old Dan myself. I fear this was a trick all along.”
The two bowed, “Yes, father.”
In Blackwind Mountain, the base of the Luo Alliance, the main hall was decorated for a special occasion, Alliance Leader Luo Yunhai’s grand birthday, oblivious to the imminent danger.
Experts and renowned guests came from all over, with every figure in the western lands present here. Even the nine sects were here to offer respects.
“Luo Alliance Leader, may you live long and happy!”
“Sect Leader Li, come, sit!”
“Luo Alliance Leader, you give me much favor welcoming me yourself.”
“Clan Head Zhang, it’s only proper. Sir coming to my birthday is the real honor, ha-ha-ha…”
Luo Yunhai and Yue’er were in front of the hall, greeting the many guests with a stiff smile.
He sometimes glanced at Yue’er, giving a bitter smile, “Yue’er, is 150 years old worthy of an grand birthday? I said not to hold it but you insisted and now look how much a pain it is.”
“Whose fault is it if not yours?”
Yue’er rolled her eyes, giving him a sharp look, “You wanted to wrest for power since a century ago. For that purpose, we need to make connections, and a grand birthday is the best occasion. Steward Zhuge said it himself, a small celebration every five years with a large one every decade. Making sure to invite all with renown in the western lands, increasing from one event to another while using the upright conduct of the Luo Alliance to sway the people. Sure, a grand birthday is a hassle, but you can’t deny its effects.
“These decades, not only has the Luo Alliance been growing swiftly, but dear’s voice has gained more and more weight in the western lands. Better than the Double Dragon Manor who stays closed up for years on end. I believe that the nine sects trust dear far more than the Double Dragon Manor. Steward Zhuge’s plan worked like a charm.”
Luo Yunhai’s smile fell and nodded, “Yeah, their work has excellent results. Luo Alliance has gained more and more friends. I’m just sad that you have to go through the toil with me.”
“Dear, it’s my job.” Yue’er blushed with a sweet smile.
Luo Yunhai looked around oddly, “Now where did that girl run off to now?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1128 - 1128, Malcontent
chapters.content:
Chapter 1128, Malcontent
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Yue’er looked around curiously, “Yeah, where is she? I don’t see her gophers either.”
“Who are you calling a gopher, Yue’er?”
A tall middle-aged man walked over with a smile, “Ha-ha-ha, that brat has been taken by your charming daughter for years now, always after her like a lost puppy. You just can’t drive him off either, just like a shadow. Why not just seal the deal already?”
Yue’er’s face twitched and huffed.
[You wish! How’s your son fit for my daughter?]
Luo Yunhai laughed, “Brother Xingyun, Sifan and Jianshan are still young. Let’s give them a couple more years.”
“How are they young?” Long Xingyun chuckled, looking hopeful, “Brother Yunhai, our friendship began since Tianyu. We built the Luo Alliance together. The two grew up together, childhood sweethearts that only have eyes for each other. Why not make it official? Ha-ha-ha…”
[What eyeing each other? My daughter barely even looks at him.]
Yue’er gave him a dark look while Luo Yunhai chuckled.
“Long Xingyun, after all this time, I see you’re as rotten as ever. The whole alliance knows of your son’s incompetence. How can he be a match for the Luo clan’s pride and joy?” Someone shouted in the distance.
“Who said that? Who insulted my son?” Long Xingyun snapped back, only to snort at the speaker, “Well, well, what’s it to you? You’re not part of the Luo Alliance anyway, so don’t butt in!”
Thump~
A cold-faced middle-aged man stepped closer, with a split mustache and flickering eyes. His stare pierced hearts. He was the Head Venerable of Sword God Sect, one of the seven founding elders of Luo Alliance, Xie Xiaofeng’s eldest son, Xie Tianshang.
He began with a gesture of respect to Luo Yunhai, offered his gifts, then turned to Long Xingyun, “I may not be, but my dad is. My son grew up in the alliance as well. You can say anything else, but when it comes to the junior’s marriage, I have to speak my mind.”
“What the hell does that have to do with you?”
“Everything. My son thinks the world of the Luo clan’s daughter.” Xie Tianshang cupped his hands again, “Brother Yunhai, I’ve always been fascinated by swords and failed to guide him. Thank you for always looking after him. Now that he’s all grown up, I wish to fulfill my duty as a father. Seeing his honest intentions for your daughter, I would like to make the humble request for her hand.”
Luo Yunhai and Yue’er lowered their heads in awkward silence.
[And another showed up for marriage.]
“Then I won’t impose and make it hard on the Luo Alliance Leader.” Long Xingyun sneered, saluting Luo Yunhai again, “Brother Yunhai, that settles it then. Let’s discuss the details later…”
“Curses, how is that settled? Get lost!” Xie Tianshang shoved Long Xingyun aside and took his place to offer his sincerity to the two.
Long Xingyun replied with a kick, “You left Tianyu, yet you meddle into Tianyu’s matters still?”
The two old friends started bickering like biddies. Though never resorting to violence, the scene they made wasn’t any smaller.
Luo Yunhai shook his head, helpless.
“Sword God Sect’s Sect Leader has arrived!”
The herald shouted and Wen Tao smiled as he saluted, taken back at the display, “Uh, Venerable Xie, why…”
“Senior brother!”
Xie Tianshang’s face twitched, stopping the quarrel. Wen Tao looked at the two and cracked up, “Ha-ha-ha, how lively. Venerable Xie, you’re so relaxed now that you’re home, unlike your stern attitude in the sect.”
Xie Tianshang rolled his eyes, yet he had a smile on his face.
“Sect Leader Wen, it’s been ages!” Luo Yunhai cupped his hands.
Wen Tao waved off the excessive courtesy, “Please, we’re all brothers here. There’s no need for that. I remember like yesterday how the Luo clan kept me safe on the frontlines of the five lands’ war.”
“It’s only natural. The Luo clan has joined the nine sects before all due to Sect Leader Wen’s support…”
“We had all done it for brother Zhuo, while you saved my life. They can’t compare. Anyway, we became family from that moment on. Brother Luo, congratulations!” Wen Tao cupped his hands again.
Luo Yunhai returned the gesture with the same joy and sincerity.
“Hellion Flame Sect Leader Yan Mo and Ultimate Clarity Sect Leader Wu Qingqiu have arrived!”
The two stepped lightly to the bustle, with Wu Qingqiu laughing, “Brothers, you’re all here. I see that we’re late. I’ll drink to make up for it. Yunhai, congratulations. I would’ve held my own grand birthday, but we’re all Sects Leaders, and no longer part of the secular world. At the very least, ic get to meet with my sworn brothers, ha-ha-ha…”
Yan Mo smiled and nodded, offering his respects alongside Wu Qingqiu.
“Sect Leader Wu, don’t joke. How can the mundane world’s customs be of notice to the secluded sects?” Luo Yunhai joked.
Wen Tao asked, “What of Ye Lin? You still haven’t found him after all these years? With Zhuo Fan gone, he’s at the top of western lands.”
Wen Tao gave a thumb’s up.
“Don’t remind me. Ever since the war, little junior brother vanished mere days after returning and I haven’t heard from him since.”
Wen Tao sighed, “Many seniors have been missing since the war as well. It’s as if they all went into seclusion after, no longer concerning themselves with fame and riches.”
The men shared a look and sank into silence. The four lands had lost most of their forces and only grew further apart from the central area’s level.
“Please, sit. As it’s my grand birthday, let’s not talk about sad matters. Why not join me in drinking our fill?” Knowing their worries, Luo Yunhai smiled and proposed to pull them out of their sorrow.
The men laughed, “Let’s!”
The guests kept pouring in well into dusk. Zhuge Changfeng and Leng Wuchang looked over the gift list and shared a frown.
“Stewards, what’s wrong?”
The two bowed, “Young miss!”
Luo Yunchang took the list and smiled, “9th grade pills, 10th grade spiritual weapons, 11th grade ingredients. The gifts have only been increasing over the decades. Yunhai is starting to get their attention, ha-ha-ha…”
“Yes, but it’s too soon to tell if it’s for good or worse.” Zhuge Changfeng sighed.
Luo Yunchang was puzzled.
Zhuge Changfeng bowed, “Young miss, we’ve anticipated this outcome ever since Clan Head decided on moving up the ladder at all costs.”
“What outcome?”
“Double Dragon Manor is malcontent by the year.”
Zhuge Changfeng sighed, “The Luo Alliance has enjoyed a swift growth over the century, winning many hearts. With the western lands having a bleak future, Double Dragon Manor couldn’t be happy. The first half of the century, Clan Head’s birthday parties all had an envoy from the Double Dragon Manor, offering encouraging gifts. Later on, as our alliance gained clout and the western lands followed us more and more, Double Dragon Manor gave us the cold shoulder over the next two decades and lessened their gifts.
“The last thirty years there hasn’t been any, the period marking the peak of our influence. It came so that when discussions of defenses were held, the Double Dragon Manor was bypassed and the nine sects discussed it only with us. It is no different from going over an emperor’s authority in his court and getting killed in the process.”
Luo Yunchang’s brow shook, “You mean Double Dragon Manor wants Yunhai…”
“No no no, it has yet to come to that.”
Zhuge Changfeng refuted, “The Luo Alliance is vital to western lands. Be it from reasons, or excuses, Double Dragon Manor would never move against us, unless they want to lose their status in western lands. The world of practitioners has its own rules. Without a good reason for war, they would earn everyone’s disgust and hatred. Double Dragon Manor wants to rule western lands and won’t violate this. Alas…
“They have their eyes on us to find our weakness. The minute we do anything out of line, they’ll capitalize on it. So the fiercer things get, the more collected we must be and avoid any trouble.”
Luo Yunchang nodded and sighed, “This is Yunhai’s choice and has to bear its burden along with its dangers. Zhuo Fan had told him so before he left and must be ready for it.”
“Clan Head is indeed ready to reach the top. It’s very similar to Steward Zhuo.”
“True, his guide has been Zhuo Fan all along!” Luo Yunchang looked at the sky with a radiant smile…

chapters.title: Chapter 1129 - 1129, Party Crashing
chapters.content:
Chapter 1129, Party Crashing
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
In the bustling hall, with everyone taking seats, Luo Yunhai arrived at his seat with his lady. He saluted everyone with a smile, “Sect Leaders, Venerables, Clan Heads, Elders, it is an honor to have all of you at my humble birthday. The Luo Alliance thanks you, as does everyone here!”
The two bowed.
“Luo Alliance Leader, you’re too kind, ha-ha-ha…” The festivities began with the guests returning the gesture.
Luo Yunhai said, “As only a few days ago the nine Sect Leaders and I have discussed the border defense, the celebration has been rushed. I only hope that you may overlook any slightness.”
The two bowed again.
“Please, Luo Alliance Leader, it’s no trouble…” Everyone was modest.
Luo Yunhai was very nice, but all the veteran cultivators picked up on his meaning.
His talks with the nine Sect Leaders for the border defense showed the Luo clan’s status, that of the Marshal over all of western lands, while calling the nine sects fellow brothers. showing their close ties. The position was special and also firm, making so any that was discontent would be shooting himself in the foot, and his future in western lands.
Such forceful declaration coming from Luo Yunhai was seen more as courtesy and benevolent.
[We’re strong but not oppressive, respectful and thoughtful of all opinions.]
Or the two bows to every guest would not have happened.
It made everyone want to be friendly and to respect the Luo clan. By exercising their power, it would only shun the guests away.
Luo Alliance Leader showed that while strong, he was mild and put their minds at ease.
Luo Yunhai watched the prevalent smiles in every direction with a pleased look.
[Luo Alliance has gained even more friends.]
An obnoxious laughter then broke the jovial mood, “Ha-ha-ha, it’s Luo Alliance Leader’s big birthday, but I wasn’t invited?”
“Sir, you can’t go in. Sir…”
“Beat it!”
A three-meter tall elder with white hair strutted into the hall following the clamor outside. Next to him were five youths, fierce and, judging by the unrestrained aura, in the Genesis Stage.
The guards tried stopping them but were just shoved aside.
Some guests were startled and whispered, “Qin Society Head, Qin Hao? What’s he doing here? Isn’t he on bad terms with the Luo Alliance?”
“He must’ve come to ruin the party. This is going to be good!” The guests went silent and resumed observing the two.
“Alliance Leader, they insisted even as we tried to stop them…”
“It’s fine, you may go.”
The guard rushed to report, but Luo Yunhai dismissed him. He then turned to the old man with cupped hands, “Society Head Qin, to what do I owe this most unexpected visit?”
“Yea, we didn’t invite you, sir. So what warranted this forced arrival?” Luo Yunchang stood up with cold eyes.
Qin Hao chuckled in derision, “Young miss, I know of your willful nature, but to think you’d not even show respect on your brother’s birthday. In any case our clans, we are the largest two groups in the western lands. Shouldn’t the Luo Alliance Leader have invited me as well for his birthday? I was doubtful if maybe brother had misplaced the invitation since you have been so busy with the border and neglected many things. No matter, for here I am, to wish you a long life, ha-ha-ha…”
“Humph, we don’t need copycats like you around!” Luo Yunchang mocked, “It seems Society Head Qin expected the feeling to be mutual. Sorry to disappoint.”
Many of the guests weren’t so discreet in hiding their laughter. Qin Hao’s face fell.
All of western lands knew that the Luo clan was the first to start a clan alliance, having built it to be the strongest. All the others that came later were imitations, shaky and hardly effective. Except for Qin Society, trying its damness to stick close to Luo Alliance’s model.
In the eyes of all, however, the first was a hero, while the second a ne’er-do-well. With the Luo Alliance around, the Qin Society was overshadowed, doomed to be second for all eternity. The only reason it lasted for so long was because Double Dragon Manor had its back.
Luo Yunchang’s copycat remark struck him to the quick, and hard. His face darkened by the second.
“Alliance Leader Luo, so you really had no intention of inviting me. But since I’m here now, you wouldn’t throw a poor old man out, would you? It’ll go against all your alliance stands for.”
“Take a seat, Society Head Qin. Bringing another plate is of no import.” Luo Yunhai chuckled and gestured.
Qin Hao gave a look of scorn, not following along, “It’s not that I don’t appreciate it, but seeing how Alliance Leader Luo does not wish to see me, I shall leave. But having seen Alliance Leader Luo after a long time and on your birthday no less, I couldn’t leave without giving a gift. Men, present the gift!”
“Yes!”
A rugged man bowed and offered a three meter long redwood box after taking it out of his ring.
Luo Yunhai looked hard at him, trying to find his angle.
Qin Hao’s eyes held a savage glint, waving and opening the box to let a flood of scarlet blind the audience.
After adjusting to the gaudy show, the people gasped, “A top 12th grade spiritual sword?”
“This is my gift to Alliance Leader Luo, a treasure fit for a hero. Please accept it, Alliance Leader!” Qin Hao sneered, giving a mock bow and challenging him with his eyes.
The hall exploded in whispers.
“A 12th grade spiritual weapon is a rarity. Where did he get his hands on such a treasure?”
“Such a high quality spiritual weapon is a marvel for every land. Even Double Dragon Manor might not have…”
“Them? I bet even the central area can’t have more than a couple. As for the other lands, it’s hard to say if they even have one, let alone a top one…”
…
All guests turned their eyes to the dazzling scarlet light show in awe. Luo Yunhai was also taken aback.
“Clan Head, Qin Hao has come to crash the party, that is certain. Double Dragon Manor must’ve put him up to this, to curb our growth. It’s Clan Head’s birthday and if you can’t take the limelight, the Qin Society will only grow more outrageous as more social climbers would suck up to him.” Leng Wuchang whispered in Luo Yunhai’s ear.
Luo Yunhai nodded and took in the awe on the guests’ faces.
[He came here to show off so he could poach my allies. I need to stop him or the Luo Alliance will lose to him.]
[The 12th grade spiritual weapon, even top quality, isn’t the point here, but grasping the hearts of the people.]
But what could he do to fight him on this?
Luo Yunhai turned to Qiu Yanhai, whispering, “Elder Qiu, you’re the best at refining in the alliance. Do you have any masterpieces?”
“Clan Head, I am a refiner, but only in the 10th grade and can make an 11th grade at best. I have nothing that can compete with a top 12th grade spiritual weapon like that.” Qiu Yanhai was put in difficulty.
Luo Yunhai sighed, glaring at Qin Hao yet having no solution.
Wu Qingqiu shook his head, whispering to Wen Tao, “I heard Double Dragon Manor isn’t as welcoming with the Luo Alliance, so they turned to Qin Society to keep them in check. The rumors are true, I see. It’s the only explanation for the Qin Society’s recent rise. Even if Double Dragon Manor hadn’t given such a treasure to the Qin Society, just based on their value, they would never show it, let alone gift it. It’s like giving up a part of themselves.”
“People only look at gains and losses. Taking out a 12th grade spiritual weapon to strike at Luo Alliance shows that Double Dragon Manor is on the move.” Wen Tao sighed, “But is Double Dragon Manor what it used to be?”
“Tch, no one was there to threaten Double Dragon Manor. Now that there is, of course it changed. Luo Alliance isn’t dangerous in its growth, but in its commercial dealings with all the lands, using sacred stones as currency. Luo Alliance has outgrown Double Dragon Manor, making the latter pointless. Double Dragon Manor has no choice but to switch tactics to gain western lands under their control. Ha-ha-ha, I now see why brother Zhuo warned me to step away from the corruption of the mundane to reach Dao…”
Wen Tao nodded and sighed, looking disappointed…

chapters.title: Chapter 1130 - 1130, Shock and Awe
chapters.content:
Chapter 1130, Shock and Awe
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Qin Hao looked at everyone’s shocked faces with a vile smirk, cupping his hands to drive in his disdain, “Everyone, I’ve picked out Pyrocloud with nothing but care to give the Alliance Leader. I couldn’t just bring something random, not at such an important event as a grand birthday.”
[Curses, there’s hardly any 12th grade spiritual weapons in the world and you say you’re careful? Like you own piles of them, damn show-off!]
The people grumbled inside, but the glittering spiritual sword pulled their heartstrings harder.
Qin Hao was acting like he just came into new money, though it did come with perks. Upstarts were blinded by money and would guarantee to get all his buddies stuff too. No one was a saint, so in times when one needed help, they would be more than happy to squander money, which went double for upstarts.
“Alliance Leader Luo and I have our differences, but I know to look past them. I give nothing but respect by offering this 12th grade spiritual weapon.”
Qin Hao knew those looks and grinned, gesturing to offer the scarlet weapon to Luo Yunhai with his eerie gaze.
Luo Yunhai’s eye twitched, hesitating as he watched that insufferable and gloating smirk.
Taking it means losing this bout. Qin Hao was no guest here and barged in just to give him a gift. All signs told to refuse it, since accepting meant greed.
[The Luo Alliance yearns for Qin Society’s stuff and this will strike at their reputation once word spreads to every corner.]
While refusing, let Qin Hao win. The guy had qualms about throwing such a beauty away, with how rare they were. But since it was all an act and made the Luo Alliance look bad, the sword had lost its value with all his goals checked out.
Accepting it meant a stain on the Luo Alliance’s name. Not taking it was playing into his hand, having robbed the limelight while also keeping his precious.
The Luo Alliance was going to lose some, without a doubt.
Luo Yunhai’s face twitched, sighing as he spoke, “Society Head, I appreciate your generosity, but it’s too precious of a gift to accept.”
“It is? Then I’ll be sure to bring a cheaper one next time, ha-ha-ha…” Qin Hao went for the kill, putting away the sword without a qualm while sending scornful looks at the people behind Luo Yunhai. Luo Yunhai glared at him hard.
Qin Hao cupped his hands to the other guests and laughed, “I have one more great news to bring on Alliance Leader’s auspicious day. On the 10th of May next year I shall hold my 260th birthday. Everyone is invited. You’d give me much honor with your presence there. And Alliance Leader Luo, I know you did not give me an invite to yours, but I am most willing to give one to you. Please accept it once Qin Society presents it with utmost respect. I’m getting excited just thinking what your gift might be, especially how much bigger the Luo Alliance is compared to Qin Society, ha-ha-ha…”
“Let’s go!”
Qin Hao strutted out of the hall, like a winner. He finally one-upped the Luo Alliance and crushed their name.
Luo Yunhai’s group had dark looks, fists clenched, jaws set. The guests blinked between the sides.
[No one likes being dissed by an underdog.]
Whoosh~
Three youths blocked Qin Hao, shouting, “Hold up, old man!”
“Who dares to block the path of the Qin Society Head?”
The rugged man’s first reaction was to shout and attack, but Qin Hao raised his hand to hold him back. He looked closer and sneered, “Look who it is, if it isn’t the Luo Alliance’s young miss and the two noble sons. What can I do for you?”
Luo Sifan, Long Jianshan and Xie Nianyang had been rushing for three months to make it to the Alliance Leader’s celebration on time.
But seeing this old guy crashing the party, they were furious.
Luo Sifan beamed, “Uncle Qin, did you come to congratulate father? Why are you leaving with your gift then? Is it normal to bring it then take it away?”
“Ha-ha-ha, dear child, it’s your dad who thought little of it so I can only take it back. I wish not to darken the Luo Alliance Leader’s day so I chose to leave sooner, ha-ha-ha…”
“Really, dad didn’t like it? Can I take a look?”
“Go right ahead, child, but I’m sure it’s nothing to fuss over. Since you’re the Luo Alliance young miss, you must’ve seen many greater things than this. It won’t look nice, being so overwhelmed over something so little, ha-ha-ha…”
Qin Hao’s eyes held nothing but contempt, then opened the box with utter glee once more, eager to see Luo Alliance young miss’ dumb look of shock.
Pyrocloud’s glory was once more shed into the world, making everyone’s heart race. The kids stared hard as well.
Pa!
The lid closed shut and the world dimmed just a little. Qin Hao snickered at Luo Sifan, “Young miss Luo, have you seen something like this?”
“You call that great? No wonder dad rejected that junk.”
Luo Sifan slanted her head and smirked, “Your poker is so-so, but it’s natural for dad to shun it. But looking at you and how you’re really getting on in your years, but yet to be met with such cordiality at your thoughtful gift, I’ll take it instead. Just leave it and go.”
“Sifan!”
Luo Yunhai snapped at her. He could not take the gift no matter what, or the world would think the worst of them. Luo Yunchang and Yue’er were giving her obvious looks to back off.
The girl ignored him, staring into Qin Hao’s eyes with a glimmer in hers.
Qin Hao laughed and nodded, “Oh my, my treasure is nothing to the Luo Alliance Leader but quite important to the young miss I see. I just can’t tell who’s the blind one here. Luo Alliance Leader, do you really want the gift?”
Qin Hao turned to Luo Yunhai, taunting, but he got no response, only a dark look.
Pa!
Luo Sifan yanked the box and placed it on a table with glee, “Enough yapping about and give it already. I told you I’ll take your little bauble.”
“Sifan, what do you think you’re doing?” Luo Yunhai roared, to which Qin Hao mocked, “So Luo Alliance Leader does care about little old me’s gift. Then what was the point of that noble act just now? Ha-ha-ha…”
Luo Yunhai’s mouth shook, about to spit blood. Qin Hao’s laugh turned into a cackle.
“Old man, why would dad care about some toothpick? I just can’t bear to see you come all this way just to be shot down. That’ll be so unfair to you.”
Luo Sifan snarked, “We have more than enough junk like that around for the Luo Alliance to care. Even my gift ends up better than yours.”
Luo Sifan’s hand shone and a blue sword dazzled the eyes with its azure aura. They all gasped, even the nine sect leaders.
[T-that sword…]
“12th grade top…” Yan Mo muttered.
Wen Tao wiped his brow, his heart stirring, “Not just top, but perfect! I’ve never seen a spiritual weapon having such an aura. It’s one with the world. That’s why the girl looked down on Pyrocloud. It’s scrap by comparison…”
Everyone bobbed their heads.
Qin Hao’s winning look got crushed and his body shook all over in disbelief.
[H-how on earth? The Luo Alliance actually has a divine weapon like the unique ones of every land?]
Luo Sifan bowed, her turn to look smug, moving to present the sword to Luo Yunhai, “This is Everblue, 1.88 meters, 4.9 kg, symbolizing the auspicious number nine, the best of its kind. You represent benevolence, enact justice, steer the world, and lead the people. My friends and I looked long and hard before choosing the most fitting sword for father. May you live forever and ever, father. Happy birthday!”
Having it pointed out, the people woke up and noticed the perfect 12th grade spiritual weapon was a best fit for Luo Yunhai’s style, unlike the raw Pyrocloud of before.
[Now this is a thoughtful pick!]
[Does that mean the Luo Alliance has so many of them that they could spare time on these details? Are they filthy rich?]
[Is there no bottom to their wealth?]
All eyes widened in shock, even Qin Hao, looking agape with his heart in pieces.
[Curses, now the Luo Alliance is better than the Double Dragon Manor? Why the hell are we still messing with them…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1131 - 1131, Clan Conduct
chapters.content:
Chapter 1131, Clan Conduct
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Everblue’s glorious aura shone in the amazed eyes of all guests.
Luo Yunhai reached for it and then pointed at the box to open and let Pyrocloud’s red glow shine out.
It soon found that the blue sword shone brighter, overwhelming it and stealing the red aura for itself.
Pyrocloud then shook and darkened.
The people cried out, “How can this be? Pyrocloud degraded to the 11th grade?”
Qin Hao’s face shook hard, a vein snapping on his forehead as his heart raced like a dying horse.
[What the hell? Why would a 12th grade spiritual sword up and get degraded? Is Everblue capable of taking the power of other spiritual swords? That’s insane!]
Everyone lit up as they gazed upon Everblue. Qin Hao’s heart was bleeding.
His prized sword just got bumped down to 11th grade.
[That’s too fast a devaluation! Damn Luo Alliance, where the hell did they find such a ridiculous sword. I’ve never heard of such things!]
This was the product of Zhuo Fan’s insights into Vaulting Sword’s art mixed with the Demon Transformation Art. It not only had a mild aura, but all spiritual swords around it would be worn out from having their spiritual energy sucked out.
Zhuo Fan had many Sovereign legacies, with swordsmanship being among his latest. His products were bound to be glorious as well.
But all people could see was the perfect 12th grade spiritual sword, so strong and so baffling.
Luo Yunhai felt familiarity with it in his grip, laughing, “Great sword!”
The kids perked up, excited as well that their efforts were all worth it.
Pa!
Qin Hao sighed, about to slip away. He came to make a scene and only made a fool of himself instead. His “precious gift” even got degraded on top, the knife that cut the deepest. He gambled and lost everything.
“Wait!”
Luo Yunhai called out, “Society Head, since you offered me a gift, I shall accept it.”
Qin Hao sighed, shaking his head and showing maudlin self-pity, “Alliance Leader Luo, there’s no need for jokes. With your deep resources, I cannot compare my paltry trinket with your divine sword. Your daughter is most correct. My sword is nothing to Alliance Leader, especially now, degraded as it is. I shall take my leave and disturb you no further.”
Qin Hao slumped as he slinked away.
“Not so fast.”
Luo Yunhai smiled, “Society Head is too kind, please stay. It’s my fault for being so busy to forget about your invitation. With Society Head disregarding our differences in coming to offer me a gift, I was thoughtless in receiving you. Please forgive me.”
Luo Yunhai bowed in sincerity.
Looking from him to the dazzling blue sword, Qin Hao’s face twitched and sighed, “Alliance Leader Luo is so compassionate, with such a sort the perfect fit of a true hero. I now know why the Luo Alliance earned the respect of everyone in western lands. It is I who offended you first. Please forgive me.”
Qin Hao bowed, returning the gesture.
Luo Sifan was stunned, “Auntie, aren’t they here to make a scene? Why is dad…”
“Give respect and you shall receive our undying gratitude. Take a finger, and we’ll take a hand. The Luo clan faces trouble but is not cruel either. This is the righteous and benevolent conduct of the Luo clan.” Luo Yunchang patted her head.
Zhuge Changfeng approached, “Young miss, the best way to destroy an enemy is by making friends with him. Clan Head is most suited for this, different from Steward Zhuo’s style. Though he used gains as lures to move others. We may have defeated Qin Hao after coming to crash the party, but we cannot kick someone when they’re down and leave his dignity. Going out of line will turn him into our enemy. Clan Head did so to bring him on our side, but that’s his choice. Though he doesn’t look the fool, and maybe Clan Head’s intention would get to him. This will only work to further grow our Luo Alliance!”
Luo Sifan nodded but then asked, “Who’s Steward Zhuo? Why haven’t we heard about him?”
“He is dearly missed and grieved.”
Luo Yunchang sighed, sorrow taking over her, “Maybe few are those that can still remember him, but some elders always hold him in respect, admiration, fear and a bit of pity when talking about him.”
“Pity?”
“How can they not pity a glorious hero dying before his time?” Luo Yunchang wiped her tears, shaking her head, “I told you mentioning him will make us sad.”
Zhuge Changfeng nodded, “We don’t mention Steward Zhuo because it would bring the ladies sorrow, only discussing it privately. Young miss can’t understand.”
“Making auntie sad? Then is he auntie’s lover?” Luo Sifan asked.
Luo Yunchang gave an ever bitter smile, “I see him as such, but his heart might hold another. That devil, I don’t even know where his body is, yet I’ve yet to find if he held me dear…”
Luo Yunchang was forlorn.
Luo Sifan’s eyes shone. She had no clue who this Steward Zhuo was to make her aunt, a famous iron lady, so sad even after his passing.
[Just what was he? Was there such a man alive in this world?]
Luo Sifan turned to Long Jianshan and Xie Nianyang, her gophers, and shook her head.
[Nah, I sure haven’t found any, ha-ha…]
Luo Yunhai invited Qin Hao in for a drink. Qin Hao came to crash the party and Luo Yunhai didn’t like it, of course, but now that he had been pulled in, all the grudge faded into cordiality.
The wine poured non-stop, the mood turning lively again. But eyes kept drifting on the blue blade.
Qin Hao was no exception, cupping his hands, “Alliance Leader Luo, where did you get such a divine sword?”
Luo Yunhai was dubious as well, “Sifan, where did you find this precious spiritual sword?”
All sound ceased, with eyes peeling and ears focused on their location.
“Father, we’ve gone through much to get this gift for you.”
The trio chuckled pridefully, “We have gone through so much toil to meet with a master swordsmith in Swordfall…”
“Swordfall?”
Qin Hao cried, “You can’t mean this sword came from the blind swordsmith, can you?”
Luo Sifan lit up and nodded, “You know him? Yes, we’ve been looking to meet him for so long before he finally gave us a sword, even picked one best for father’s gift.”
“I was wondering how you chose something that matched my nature to perfection. So you had help, ha-ha-ha…” Luo Yunhai nodded, “Society Head Qin, is there something wrong about this swordsmith?”
Qin Hao frowned hard, “Juniors, you must’ve had heaven’s favor to get that eccentric to give you a spiritual sword. Word first reached me about this strange man twenty years ago. I’ve also sent people to get a sword, but none succeeded. In anger, I tried forcing him, only to lose all that tried, Genesis Stage experts no less. When the casualties reached a hundred, I realized this was hopeless. The blind swordsmith is not normal by any means.
“Later on, I heard someone even sent four hundred Genesis Stage experts for him yet none returned. I’m just glad I didn’t go myself into the devil’s den. From then on, no one tried anything. Even if there were divine swords there, none would try ever again. One thing was certain though, that no sword ever left his hands. I just can’t believe your daughter managed to pull it off. Heaven must’ve favored you greatly. The sword is just like the rumors say, exquisite.”
Everyone gasped in shock, even the kids.
[Talk about having the devil’s luck. Three brats did what hundreds of Genesis Stage experts couldn’t.]
The kids were just as clueless as before.
[Was it supposed to be that hard? The blind uncle was quite nice though. How can he be cruel when he bickered with juniors?]
But then recalling Qiao’er scaring away Bald Demon with two words, the trio tensed.
[Did we just go to hell and back…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1132 - 1132, Intercepted
chapters.content:
Chapter 1132, Intercepted
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Father, I would like to know if the Luo Alliance ever had a blind member…”
“Alliance Leader, we have a grave situation…”
Luo Yunhai thought of something and asked, but the sudden panicked shout drew everyone’s attention to outside the hall. A scout in black rushed in and kneeled, “We have news from the central area that Dragon Cleaving Sword King is on his way to kill Alliance Leader. You must get to safety and survive!”
[What?!]
Everyone at the celebration panicked, the hall drowned in frantic voices.
Dragon Cleaving Sword King, the once best in western lands, was coming after Luo Yunhai’s head?
[This is a disaster. There’s nothing in western lands that can stop him.]
The Luo Alliance was in huge trouble.
Many guests had dark looks, waiting for their response.
Zhuge Changfeng rushed to the scout, snapping at him, “How solid is the info? He is a Sword King, not someone to stoop down to dirty assassinations. Did the empire send him? Are they only after the Luo Alliance?”
“Steward Zhuge, the report says the central area has no hand in it, that Danqing Shen is doing it on his own…”
“What did we ever do to him?”
“Clan Head, stewards, not to him but someone else. For he brought Lads of Our Nation to him and asked for Clan Head’s death. It has spread everywhere by now. Everyone calls it hate begets hate, a part of the cultivation world. Now they’re waiting for the drama to unfold between the Luo Alliance and Danqing Shen.”
Zhuge Changfeng’s face shook hard at the impossible problem.
[This is grave!]
[Since this was treated as a cultivator’s grudge, and only after one person, no expert of the four lands will lend a hand, especially since the central area isn’t marching on us.]
[Luo Yunhai’s death would mean nothing to the four lands, the impact limited to the Luo Alliance, not a loss of strength, but a restructuring of power.]
[While the four states keep their strength, the Luo Alliance’s will crumble under the redistribution of power.]
[Double Dragon Manor’s dear wish, no doubt. Asking them to help now…]
Zhuge Changfeng shook his head and sighed. Leng Wuchang knew the situation was dire, his mind working hard for a solution. He found none.
“Brother Yunhai, we nine Sect Leaders will plead your case before Double Dragon Manor. Only the Exalted can stop their former disciple now.” Wen Tao spoke.
The others weren’t against it, but Qin Hao had little hope this would work.
As an old adversary of the Luo Alliance for years and years, he knew best of Double Dragon Manor’s stance. In this trying time where a supreme expert was joining in, they all supported Luo Alliance in getting Double Dragon Manor to help, but whether the help would come, remained to be seen.
“The Exalted can at best match Danqing Shen, even if they do agree. This is an assassination. Danqing Shen can sidestep them with ease.”
Qin Hao, having Luo Yunhai nursing his ego all this time, decided to give subtle advice.
[Don’t go as they won’t help since they’re too eager to see you die.]
The others fell silent, with Wu Qingqiu making another proposal, “I was once somewhat close to the Shangguan clan. Maybe I could send them a request to help.”
“Somewhat? Brother Wu, you’ve been making constant trips to eastern lands even now, ha-ha-ha…” Wen Tao snickered at his expense.
Wu Qingqiu smiled as he looked at Luo Yunhai, “Well?”
“Thank you Sect Leader Wu, but going to Double Dragon Manor is still better, since this involves western lands. It would be best not to go over them.”
Zhuge Changfeng nodded, looking grave, “Clan Head, Sect Leaders request will also take days and that means delaying the old man is a must. I propose we double the guard and raise the alert of the border patrols while also sending people to intercept in between to buy enough time.”
A tall man popped before them, his sideburns swaying in the breeze. He cupped his hands, “Clan Head, I volunteer to go and meet Dragon Cleaving Sword King.”
“Elder Li…”
“Clan Head, we also volunteer.”
Qiu Yanhai, Xue Qingjian, along with Earth and Heaven elders cupped their hands as well.
Luo Yunhai hesitated, “You are Luo clan’s guardian venerables, without equal in the Luo Alliance. But Dragon Cleaving Sword King is just as monstrous. Going means…”
“As fellow peak Genesis experts, we would like to see what sets a Sword King apart from us, ha-ha-ha…” Li Jingtian made a fierce salute, his eyes eager for battle, “Clan Head, allow us to go against true experts. Death matters little to us!”
“Please allow us, Clan Head!” The other fow bowed.
Luo Yunhai sighed and nodded. Everyone else watched the five with respect.
[The loyalty and courage Luo clan’s venerables have is awe-inspiring, rushing by their own initiative against such an enemy.]
“Before you go, take Everblue with you to help.”
“And Pyrocloud. While not up to Alliance Leader’s Everblue, it will help.”
Luo Yunhai offered his new spiritual sword and Qin Hao presented the degraded Pyrocloud. This was respect among heroes. There was a stifling mode prevalent in the hall.
The five took them and cupped their hands before leaving. All felt this might be the last time they would see them.
“As the wind howls and rain batters, our brave depart never to return.”
Qin Hao cupped his hand in complete respect, “Alliance Leader Luo, you have nothing but admiration at the strength your alliance garnered, having such loyal warriors as well.”
Luo Yunhai shook his head with sorrow, “It was Steward Zhuo who brought them. Watching them go to their doom makes me a failure as a Clan Head, disgracing his spirit.”
[Steward Zhuo again?]
Luo Sifan was getting more and more curious.
[Who on earth is he? Why is he mentioned with nothing but reverence, like a saint?]
Her feelings were ignored in this dire time when survival was doubtful. People rushed about, laying defenses, forming patrols, anything to stop Danqing Shen. The celebration came to a halt as the guest knew this was the last drink.
“Long Jianshan, Xie Nianyang, we never did see the five elders fight as one. It must be amazing. Let’s go watch!” While all were busy, she sneaked to her gophers to get them on board.
Long Jianshan hesitated, “The strongest venerables have never moved before. The enemy must be dangerous. Won’t we get hurt by going?”
“Scared?”
“I-I’m not scared. How are we going to catch up anyway?”
“Simple, with Grandpa Li’s dotting so much, I slipped a Thousand Leagues Scent on him in case the old man would try to avoid playing with me. We’ll find them for sure with the Lovesick Larva.”
“Sifan, you trickster.” Long Jianshan’s face twitched and sighed, “I got nothing left to argue…”
“Stop with the prattle. You’re in or out?”
“In!”
The brats sneaked out.
“We’re did those kids go this time?” Yue’er looked around and frowned…
A month later, at the western lands border, a thin old man stood in the desert, facing five men.
Danqing Shen was out on a stroll, living a little, while also taking Luo Yunhai in passing.
“I haven’t been home in years, yet I just passed the border and you’re here to meet me. How may I help you?”
“Are you Dragon Cleaving Sword King, Danqing Shen?”
“Precisely!”
“We’re the Luo clan’s five venerables.”
“That explains it.” Danqing Shen nodded, smiling, “You came to die for your lord. I do appreciate your devotion.”
Ding!
Li Jingtian held out an azure sword while Qiu Yanhai wielded Pyrocloud, pointing it at him, “We came on behalf of the Clan Head, but also to see the legend of the best in western lands for ourselves. As peak Genesis experts, why are you so much stronger?”
“I see, martial fanatics, just like me, ha-ha-ha…” Danqing Shen chuckled freely. Then he stiffened, setting his piercing gaze upon the azure sword.
“Where did you get that?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1133 - 1133, Toward the Sword Shack
chapters.content:
Chapter 1133, Toward the Sword Shack
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Pick up the pace, you two. I don’t want to get there when the fighting is over!”
A girl ran ahead of two guys, dashing through the woods and holding a wiggling worm, adjusting course based on its direction.
Long Jianshan and Xie Nianyang shared a worried look for the willful and obstinate young miss.
“Sister Sifan, let’s just stop. We’ll only burden the venerables in a Genesis Stage expert showdown.”
“Say if you don’t want to go, don’t make excuses, you chicken!” Luo Sifan huffed, speeding up, “I’ll just go by myself then. I’ve yet to see a Sword King fight. Are they as amazing as they say that not even the five of them together can handle?”
The gophers hung their heads in defeat at their headstrong boss lady.
“We’re here!”
Luo Sifan glanced at the worm raising its head and lit up. She crossed a bush and a sea of yellow entered her view, with the sun’s dazzling rays shining on her delicate features, her enchanting eyes.
She froze on the spot. Her excitement for the fight had now drained from her face, her blood running cold.
Whoosh~
The gophers arrived as well, “Sister Sifan, wait for us, we…”
The duo stiffened at the shocking scene.
[H-how is this possible?]
As the sand blew, they witnessed blood soaking everywhere. Five familiar figures were laying in it, unmoving.
Before them was an old man in blue, holding an azure sword and tracing its blade with a frown, “Strange, how can there be the Vaulting Sword Art? Why does this sword contain Vaulting Sword’s mysteries? The Exalted aren’t good at refining either, while their swordsmanship isn’t impressive either. Does this mean that the western lands has another Vaulting Sword inheritor? But why the Luo clan? I’ve never heard of anyone from Luo clan getting into Double Dragon Manor.”
“Grandpa Li!”
Luo Sifan cried out in tears, rushing to him before the other two could stop her, “Sifan…”
The old man paused and observed the distressed girl looking after Li Jingtian, “You’re from Luo clan?”
“Y-you’re Dragon Cleaving Sword King, Danqing Shen?” Luo Sifan’s eyes quivered, but steeled herself to meet his gaze.
Danqing Shen nodded, “I am.”
The kids shivered, their hearts tensing.
“Did you do this to them?” Luo Sifan was most definitely scared, but fought through it to ask.
Danqing Shen offered a snicker, “Yes, this is my handiwork. Missie, you’re quite brave, knowing I hurt them yet rushing over still. Aren’t you scared I’ll take your lives?”
The trio flinched and shook like leaves. Luo Sifan tightened her fists, “My clan has no cowards. Grandpa Li and the others are our venerables. I am not about to turn a blind eye to them!”
“My, what spunk!”
Danqing Shen nodded, “I can see the valor in Luo clan like they say. Even the kids are steadfast. I’d hate to go against you just on this alone, but I made a vow. Girl, you recognize this sword?”
Luo Sifan glanced at Everblue and nodded.
“Great, let’s talk. I’ve come to western lands for only one man and I’ll kill any that stand in my way. But seeing your venerables so steadfast and righteous garnered my sympathy and I left them breathing. Now tell me where you got this sword and I’ll leave you be as well.”
Luo Sifan was silent.
[Why’s he so interested in it? Are Sword Kings after 12th grade spiritual weapons as well? Or is it maybe the blind uncle? I can’t tell on him or he’ll get hurt.]
Danqing Shen snickered, “Don’t feel like talking? Then none of you are leaving here alive, including your elders.”
Danqing Shen flexed his aura to mount the pressure. The kids were rooted on the spot, their breaths stolen and their faces red.
Luo Sifan gnashed her teeth.
“Ha-ha-ha, just like Luo clan, tight-lipped.” Danqing Shen’s eyes shone, ramping up the pressure, “I asked the old guys as well, but they just attacked and look how they end up. But why are you kids doing the same? They could at least fight while you are all powerless before me. Do you really want to die like this?”
“Luo clan… never turns its back on anyone…” Luo Sifan squeezed through the pain and discomfort.
Danqing Shen was touched.
He was about to go easy on them when a shout came, “It’s the blind swordsmith! He gave it to us…”
Whoosh~
Danqing Shen snapped his eyes on Long Jianshan.
“Who is that?”
“He lives three miles out of Swordfall. The villagers know about him.” Long Jianshan recoiled under the piercing stare.
Danqing Shen nodded and chuckled, “Girl, you’re not bad, while he, ha-ha-ha…”
Danqing Shen vanished. Luo Sifan glared at him, “Long Jianshan, how can you sell out the blind uncle? What if he wanted to harm uncle?”
“But we were about to get killed! What was I supposed to do?” Long Jianshan looked crushed, muttering, “I was doing it for us. It’s he who will die, instead of us five, six, seven, eight.”
“All the more reason we can’t betray his goodwill after giving the sword. Are we that ungrateful that we sent trouble his way? Haven’t you ever heard of death before dishonor?”
Luo Sifan glared as she lashed at him.
“Who is to say eight lives outweigh one life?”
Rumble~
A loud rumble aproached as a 3rd level spiritual beast drawn carriage arrived, caring a languid voice.
“Are you from the Luo clan? Get in. I want to save the blind swordsmith.”
“Y-you’re…”
“I’ve met your Alliance Leader once and told me who deserves to die and who doesn’t. Regardless of what Danqing Shen has against the Luo clan, the blind swordsmith is innocent. I will try to mediate.”
The soft voice spoke again, “Have the wounded placed in a safe spot. I’ll save them.”
Luo Sifan nodded in joy and signaled Xie Nianyang for help with the elders. Long Jianshan hesitated, shaken up hard from the encounter with the Dragon Cleaving Sword King.
But scarier by far was Luo Sifan’s fury, and so Long Jianshan lent a hand as well.
After taking care of them, the three got in and were shocked to witness such beauty.
Rumble~
The carriage rushed through and arrived before the cabin with the sign Sword Shack written on it.
Its door was blown out and Danqing Shen sat before it. His eyes shone at the dangling spiritual swords.
Hearing the carriage stop, he looked behind to see a fair lady cupping her hands, “Dragon Cleaving Sword King, greeting.”
“Murong clan’s young miss?” Danqing Shen chuckled, “I don’t recall having met with brother Murong. It ought to be Wine Sword Immortal the closest with you. Miss Murong, why would you look for me?”
The kids got out as well and shrank in fear, while also amazed at Murong Xue.
[The lady must be important for even Danqing Shen to show respect.]
They had yet to grasp how vast the world was, that their Luo Alliance had only been around for just shy over a century. As for the Murong clan, it held power in the five lands for millennia, making even the central area think twice.
This was the deterrence a Sword King level expert brought, unlike all those countless factions.

chapters.title: Chapter 1134 - 1134, The First Steward
chapters.content:
Chapter 1134, The First Steward
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Taking in the Sword Shack’s condition, and the lack of battle signs, Murong Xue relaxed and asked, “What of the blind swordsmith? Sword King couldn’t have erased him already, right?”
“I was met with a 9th grade array just as I arrived and only broke it.”
Danqing Shen smiled, “Inside there’re only swords. But every last one of them contains deep insights in the sword path. I didn’t know such a person lived. He may very well be the best refiner, ha-ha-ha…”
Luo Sifan eased a breath.
[Thank heavens blind uncle isn’t here.]
Murong Xue wasn’t one to be settled with just that, “Dragon Cleaving Sword King, why might you be looking for the blind swordsmith? What are your intentions?”
“To ask some questions.”
“That’s it?”
“Though if the answers are to disappoint, I’ll be taking his life instead.” Danqing Shen squinted, his face cold.
Murong Xue’s heart sank. She let out a breath, knowing she could not stop a Sword King, despite being a peak Genesis expert herself.
Luo Sifan was startled as well, praying.
[Don’t come, blind uncle, someone wants to kill you, a top expert in the world. You have to stay away. I couldn’t forgive myself if you died.]
Which, obviously, went unanswered…
“My, what a crowd we have today. It’s been ages since I got so many guests at my shack.”
Flinching, all snapped in the voice’s direction and saw a youth in white and covered eyes, his smile sinister, “And a few old signatures among you as well. Welcome, old friends, ha-ha-ha…”
Luo Sifan gasped, “Run, uncle, he wants to kill you!”
“Kill me, who? Aren’t we all old pals? I never irked anyone here.” Zhuo Fan had no qualms at all.
[Old pals?]
Luo Sifan looked at Danqing Shen and Murong Xue, their faces so shocked they’d seen a ghost.
Danqing Shen pointed at Zhuo Fan, stammering, “Y-you’re not dead?”
“Of course not, or were you expecting a ghost in broad daylight.”
“It never crossed my mind that you’re the blind swordsmith.”
Murong Xue’s eyes shook, taking a deep breath and turning to Luo Sifan, “Don’t worry, this blind uncle is none other than the greatest devil that has walked the earth. Him getting hurt? It’ll be a miracle if he doesn’t cause genocide instead.”
“Yeah, who could ever kill me? Ha-ha-ha, girl, know how to make tea? Put a kettle on. Me and my old friends are having a chat.”
Zhuo Fan waved without a care…
An hour later, Murong Xue gave the five wounded pills before laying them in the shack. Zhuo Fan entertained the guests in a small gazebo outside. The hostility was now gone, replaced with utter calm.
The kids were staring oblivious to the inner workings, slowly making their way inside the shack. Long Jianshan pulled her to the side and looked outside, “Sister Sifan, who is that blind guy? Why is Dragon Cleaving Sword King suddenly listening to his words and sitting down to enjoy old times? Who the hell is he to stand equal to a Sword King?”
“How should I know?”
Luo Sifan was equally baffled by what was happening, “In any case, the blind uncle must be something else. How else can you explain these big names acting all friendly around him…”
Zhuo Fan felt three pairs of intrigued eyes on his back and smiled. “After a century I still get to see some old friends. Miss Murong, still a busybody like usual?”
“I’m working for the greater good in helping the needy. Not like you know anything about that, now would you?”
Murong Xue rolled her eyes and huffed, “Yet all these years that went by still can’t make me forget the war, your actions, whether good or bad, whether right or wrong. That’s why I have been traveling to see the world and find a definite answer. It has eluded me even now.”
Zhuo Fan smirked, “I’ve experienced life’s trials as well, with something to show for, unlike you. If willing, come with me to see the culmination of evil and righteous in humanity. Maybe it will bring you peace.”
Murong Xue nodded in the end, no longer as antagonistic.
“Zhuo Fan, did you make this?”
Danqing Shen placed Everblue on the table, staring hard at his face.
Zhuo Fan nodded.
“How? Why can I feel the Vaulting Sword Art from it? When did you learn it?”
“Over the last century.”
Zhuo Fan eased a breath, “Old Dan, I’ve been keeping something from you for a long time. That fight in Double Dragon Manor…”
Zhuo Fan revealed Vaulting Sword’s situation in detail, “Sorry for fooling all of you. Vaulting Sword was with me, while the Exalted and you thought it was with the other. This burden had been held for a hundred years.”
“What?”
Danqing Shen shook, unable to comprehend how a brat pulled the wool over him, the best in western lands, and yet he was still the fall guy.
[Outrageous!]
Murong Xue gave him a long look and smiled, “You’re really something, toying with western lands’ best when you were nothing. I don’t think there was anyone in the world would be more insane as you.”
“True, that was one huge gamble that had me nervous to the core.”
“Nervous? Yet you still took it? Where is it now?”
“I won’t return it.”
Danqing Shen held out his hand but Zhuo Fan shook his head, “It’s been with me for so many years, I see no reason to give it away. I’m only explaining to you and giving you understanding, while giving me peace. I mean, you did save me once and it wouldn’t do to keep this from you.”
“I’ve saved you years ago and you’re only telling me now?”
“I was scared you’d kill me.”
“What about now?”
“No.” Zhuo Fan was frank like never before in his life. Danqing Shen’s beard shook wildly in anger.
[Curses, he grew up and now I can’t do anything!]
The instant Danqing Shen sensed the Vaulting Sword in Everblue, he knew. The swordsmith had the same understanding as him, and after seeing it to be Zhuo Fan, all became clear.
Zhuo Fan was a freak of nature to begin with. Taking a century had to have made him an abomination. He believed he’d suffer for fighting, if it came to that.
After grumbling for a while, Danqing Shen hit the table and rose to leave.
Zhuo Fan stopped him, “Wait, old Dan, we haven’t finished talking about old times after so many years. Where are you going?”
“Screw your reminiscing! I have nothing to say to you. I need to kill someone, a bloodlust like no other has taken over me. You had me fuming mad!”
Zhuo Fan didn’t let him go still, “Old Dan, you can kill anyone but Alliance Leader Luo. Do a favor for the little old me and let him go, alright?”
“Favor? My word is my bond. Someone brought me the painting and asked for his head. How can I refuse?”
“Old Dan, don’t you find it the least bit strange? The whole world knows about it. You’re being played.”
“So what? I don’t care!”
Danqing Shen snapped, “I have my principles. Even if we haven’t fallen out, we’re men of our word. You have your values and I have mine. My oath has to be fulfilled to the best of my ability!”
Zhuo Fan nodded in understanding, “Your best… then if it exceeds it?”
“What’re you on about?”
“Getting killed on your way to Luo Yunhai should be called excessive, right?”
Danqing Shen’s face twitched, “And who would?”
“Me.”
Zhuo Fan spoke.
Danqing Shen clenched his fists, squinting, “Why would you?”
“Because I am the first steward of the Luo clan, Zhuo Fan!”
Boom!
A flood of bloodthirst rushed out of Zhuo Fan, filling the earth and the heavens with a crippling coldness…

chapters.title: Chapter 1135 - 1135, Still Have the Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 1135, Still Have the Skill
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Hu~
An eerie wind blew through the world, sending fear into the hearts of every living being. Murong Xue even flinched back at her level.
As for the kids, the paled instantly, shaking all over from terror. The blind uncle who looked to be in the Profound Heaven Stage was actually on Danqing Shen’s level.
[Is he another Sword King level expert?]
But no matter how hard they wracked their brains about it, no such blind expert came to mind. The newest addition was that Lone Arm Sword King.
Luo Sifan gasped at Zhuo Fan’s cruel figure.
[Blind uncle is full of surprises…]
Danqing Shen knew Zhuo Fan was at his level and couldn’t be pushed around. He felt tense against such equal opponent.
Though it was far from making him fear it.
“You did in just a hundred years what it took me a thousand. Zhuo Fan, you’re one of a kind genius. You may be at my level, but we’ll only end our fight in a draw. I know that most of your power is within those eyes. I may not understand why, but it’s obvious you can’t use them now. You have no chance of stopping me as you are.”
Danqing Shen jumped and pointed two fingers at the sky. Following a deep rumble, the heavens caved and roars echoed out, with dragons converging on his fingertips.
A power like no other fell from the sky, the destructive force covering the entire area.
Murong Xue was sweating. The kids were panicking.
[Is this a Sword King? We’ve never felt this before, not even from tens of Genesis experts joining hands.]
[All Sword Kings are out of this world. But can blind uncle stop it…]
The trio turned to Zhuo Fan with hope, only to see him calm as always.
They thought the worse.
[Even he is scared stiff in front of Danqing Shen’s power?]
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan was gone the next moment, popping just a meter from Danqing Shen.
[Why is he so fast?]
The calm Danqing Shen turned frantic. His attack gathering in his fingers was sent slashing at Zhuo Fan with a flick of his wrist.
Zhuo Fan couldn’t dodge at this distance, taking the brunt of the attack. Any other Sword King would never take something like this head on, since it would cripple them.
And yet…
Whoosh!
Zhuo Fan’s right hand shone scarlet and grabbed.
Bam!
With the roars of thousands of dragons, the attack carried the might of heavens and dragons as they went for Zhuo Fan. But Zhuo Fan merely caught it with his Qilin arm.
The rumbling grew in intensity, the clash sending blinding lights everywhere, along with violent shockwaves. They crumbled the earth, shook the skies and crushed mountains. The onlookers were overwhelmed.
[Is this a clash between Sword Kings? This is insane! What’s with all this shaking? Is the world coming to an end?]
Danqing Shen was just as incredulous, “How can you take on my sword with… one arm…”
A golden fire exploded from the arm, cutting off his words. The flames covered the sword wave, eliciting wails of dragons, while the Qilin arm squeezed. The powerful sword wave was devoured with a boom by the golden flames.
While the mass of dragon power in the world around them faded out.
“The Decimating Sword Art?” Danqing Shen cried out.
Then a scarlet glow flicked across the air and a heavy power hacked at him. Zhuo Fan merely chopped, yet the scarlet wave felt like death to Danqing Shen.
Boom!
The attack shot into the sky, erasing everything for a thousand miles in its path. The mountain scenery surrounding Swordfall turned into a desert in an instant.
The kids watched agape as the dust roiled in the sky. The landscape changed all around them, the shock almost stopping their hearts.
Murong Xue was unable to believe such power existed and gulped.
The cunning devil from a hundred years ago became a Demon Archon. Who could stand up to him?
Danqing Shen’s white hair fluttered in the winds. Zhuo Fan took back his hand from the side of his face and said, “Old Dan, I may not have my eyes, but my skill remains. Now can you turn back?”
“Soaring Sword Art?”
Danqing Shen stared back with empty eyes. His smile turning bitter, “Yes, I can. I have no way of killing Luo Yunhai. There’s no chance for me when I’m stopped by someone who learned three divine sword arts to perfection. None… whatsoever…”
Danqing Shen looked devastated and forlorn, leaving with hunched shoulders.
“Zhuo Fan, you deserve to have Vaulting Sword.”
And he left, back to central area.
Zhuo Fan was just too strong for him to defeat. The first strike stopped him, but the next would end him.
[The brat became the second Invincible Sword, ha-ha-ha…]
Zhuo Fan landed as he watched Danqing Shen go. Murong Xue no longer looked calm, shaking like a leaf.
“The four missing divine swords ended up with you a hundred years ago?”
“Yes, and no. You’ll know in time.”
Zhuo Fan walked back to the shack. The kids were silent from fear, even shivering.
Zhuo Fan patted the girl’s head, “It’s fine now. Go back to your dad. Danqing Shen was beaten back so tell him to relax.”
“Uh, right…” Luo Sifan nodded.
Zhuo Fan smiled and patted her some more before going to Li Jingtian’s side. He inspected their wounds and nodded, “Miss Murong isn’t stingy with her medicine, using 10th grade pills. In a week, they should wake up and recover in a month.”
“I’m never stingy with my patients. But it’s also because Danqing Shen didn’t go hard on them and crushed their spirit, or it wouldn’t be as easy.”
“Old Dan is an upright man, but in our world, sometimes you’re forced to do things against your principles, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan laughed, “Maybe he’d wanted this defeat.”
“Really? I didn’t notice him throwing the fight.”
“You can’t keep yourself from following your heart’s desire. This is old Dan’s way.” Zhuo Fan smiled.
Murong Xue mulled it over.
Luo Sifan plucked up her courage to say, “Blind uncle, do you and the Luo Alliance have history?”
“Ha-ha, there may be some there.”
Zhuo Fan smirked, then a jade slip shot into his hand. After a careful read, his face was hard, “Girl, speak to no one about today. Act like you never saw me. When the geezers wake up, take them and leave, understand?”
Everyone flinched.
[What’s going on? Why the sudden change…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1136 - 1136, Twisted Humanity
chapters.content:
Chapter 1136, Twisted Humanity
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Luo Sifan grew annoyed, “Blind uncle, you’re being mean to us. How are we going to explain to them when they wake up? That Dragon Cleaving Sword King up and left? We have no excuse…”
“Isn’t simple?”
Zhuo Fan cocked an eyebrow, “Just say you pleaded with all your being and he was touched by your upright characters so he left. Then add a little flair to the story, make it harrowing and desperate. That ought to sell nicely.”
[That’s it?]
The trio’s faces twitched.
[It’s too damn obvious for anyone to believe!]
Zhuo Fan said, “We’re the only ones who know about what happened. If you don’t talk and I stay silent, none will be the wiser. You can spin it however to others, but what grounds do they have to doubt you? Besides, Danqing Shen has long since left.”
“But…”
“No buts, you’re not to say the truth, or else…” Zhuo Fan turned cold, adding a bit of bloodthirst in his gaze, “Danqing Shen can’t go to the Luo Alliance, but I can. Take it as you will.”
The kids shook in recollection of Zhuo Fan’s godlike might and bobbed their heads.
Zhuo Fan grinned, “Great. I’m letting you take the credit here, and not silencing you. And haven’t I told you last time not to speak about me? How come you brought Danqing Shen to my door?”
The trio froze, with two of them looking at Long Jianshan’s horrified face.
“Oh, the chubby guy again.”
