Zhuo Fan pulled on that tearing face, snickering, “Selling me out, have you? You were also complaining last time, snubbing me. Let’s settle everything here and now, he-he-he…”
Long Jianshan slumped to the ground in a trembling mess, “Senior, I’m sorry. I didn’t know you’re so great. I am nothing to you. Please have the generosity to spare me. I’ll never speak of you ever again.”
“Blind uncle, please let him go.” Luo Sifan pleaded, afraid Zhuo Fan was going to pinch his brains out. Who could say with these geezers’ tempers?
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Your old man must’ve spoiled you rotten, judging by that horrified look; conceited all the time yet a coward when it matters. Get up. Now’s your time to make up for it and play the hero. Tell on me again and I’ll go into your home and make mincemeat out of you. Got that?”
“Yes, great senior, totally. I believe you can do anything.” Long Jianshan sobbed and trembled.
Zhuo Fan nodded, content, with the other two kids lowering their heads.
Zhuo Fan finally eased a breath and walked off.
“Blind uncle, you…”
“Girl, I’m leaving. Today was but an interlude to what is to come. Take care.”
Zhuo Fan turned to Murong Xue, “Miss Murong, are you still interested in figuring some things out? I’ll show you what is good and what is evil.”
Zhuo Fan left. Murong Xue muttered, before following after him. The kids were the only ones remaining, looking lost. Long Jianshan was still shaking, his face twitching.
[Mommy, he’s gone at last…]
In the Double Dragon Manor, Wen Tao, Yan Mo and other Sect Leaders had been at the Heaven Reaching Pavilion for a long time, pacing about while waiting for a reply.
A grizzled man came out and bowed, “Sect Leaders, what might have brought you here?”
“Elder, we would like to ask the Exalted whether…”
“I’m terribly sorry, but the Exalted have been gone for a while now. We don’t know where they went.” The old man cut off Wen Tao, his expression heavy.
Yan Mo asked, “When will the Exalted be back?”
“We’re unsure. They’ve always been unpredictable. You’ve all been cultivating in Double Dragon Manor and should know this better than anyone.”
“We do, sorry to disturb you…”
Wen Tao shook his head and sighed. They all bowed and left.
Once gone, one black and one white old man came out.
Exalted Hei Ran shook his head, “They’re all part of western lands yet we’re still ignoring them in this?”
“We’d be holding our duty if it were anyone else. But Luo Yunhai’s ambition has no limit. He’s been growing over these years so much that it’s clear he aims for the top, going against us. His people skills are truly formidable. All these people just now were once our disciples, yet they’ve taken the Luo clan’s side. He must’ve learned Zhuo Fan’s core values. Even when Zhuo Fan faked death, they still recommended the Luo clan.”
Exalted Hei Ran nodded, “I know. I just got word the Qin Society that’s been at odds with the Luo Alliance all this time got pulled into the birthday celebration. Luo Yunhai’s compassion has no limit…”
“With such a high achiever in western lands, it brings unrest, a vicarious settlement is best…” Exalted Bai Mei left while Exalted Hei Ran sighed behind him…
At the entrance to the Shangguan clan in eastern lands, Shangguan Qingyan walked Wu Qingqiu out, “I’m sorry, senior brother Wu, our venerables are set on this…”
“It’s fine. The seniors must have their own thoughts about it. Goodbye.” Wu Qingqiu bowed.
Shangguan Qingyan returned the gesture, feeling helpless.
Shangguan Qingyan went back in and bowed before the elders, “Venerables, senior brother Wu was here and I couldn’t be blunt, but now I have to know. The Luo clan is a benevolent group in western lands, working well with ours. Why wouldn’t we help them in this time of need and bring us closer together?”
“Yan’er, all these years you’ve handled the clan, you’ve never done anything of import, only trivialities, and don’t have perspective. Why do you think Double Dragon Manor doesn’t interfere despite Danqing Shen coming to western lands to cause trouble? Why was it Wu Qingqiu who came asking for our help?”
“Maybe Double Dragon Manor was in difficulty?”
“What difficulty when it’s just Danqing Shen and not against the central area? Even if something grave was happening, it should be Double Dragon Manor who would ask of our help and not Ultimate Clarity Sect.”
“That’s…” Shangguan Qingyan hesitated.
The venerable sighed, his voice resolute, “Yan’er, humanity is twisted at heart. We’re not suspicious of other, but should at least be cautious. Double Dragon Manor is the head of western lands. By going over their heads in interfering, we’re underminding their authority, damaging the relation between the lands. And when Wu Qingqiu arrived, signs have already shown this might be the case. The western lands waters run deep and it’s best we don’t get involved.”
“Venerable, Double Dragon Manor wants…” Shangguan Qingyan’s face fell.
A month later, the envoys gone to plead assistance had returned, looking bitter and disappointed.
Yan Mo cupped his hand in apology, “Brother Luo, the Exalted are away…”
“Their minds maybe. They were clearly avoiding us.”
Wen Tao sighed, “I’d never have known people could be like this if it weren’t for this incident. For even the Exalted to do this…”
Luo Yunhai and Zhuge Changfeng foresaw this and nodded.
“Shangguan clan’s three venerables declined on grounds of stumbling in their cultivation.” Wu Qingqiu reported.
This reason was so casual it left others speechless.
[Stumble? They’ve been around millennia and a thousand years at peak Genesis Stage with no sign of advancing. What stumbling?]
Neither side was willing to help. Who then in the Luo Alliance could put a stop to Danqing Shen’s power?
All had deep frowns at such a serious problem.
But this trouble ended up repelled without their knowledge. The man who did it was now watching them from the shadows with a warm smile…

chapters.title: Chapter 1137 - 1137, Central Area Ambassador
chapters.content:
Chapter 1137, Central Area Ambassador
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Dad!”
In a moment of great turmoil, Luo Sifan’s group came in with the wounded elders.
Luo Yunhai gasped, “Sifan? Where have you brats run off to the last few days? Your mother has been searching for you everywhere!”
“Dad, we’re not children. We’ve gone to do important stuff.”
“Important?”
Luo Yunhai glanced behind them, at Li Jingtian and others.
He only got utter confusion from the elders, and a shrug.
Luo Yunhai turned to the kids, with Luo Sifan looking prideful, “Dad, you don’t have to worry about that Danqing Shen guy anymore. We scared him off. He must be back in the central area by now.”
“What?”
Everyone gasped, looking at the kids in disbelief. These wee kids made Dragon Cleaving Sword King leave? As if!
Luo Yunhai asked, still out of it, “Elder Li, you went to stop Danqing Shen. What on earth happened? Are you alright?”
“Thank you, Clan Head, for your concern. Actually…”
Li Jingtian bowed, then their faces twitched, “We’re not sure.”
“Not even you? Why?”
“Clan Head, we’ve been unconscious from our heavy wounds. And when we woke up, we saw the kids had taken us to a bamboo shack. They say they’ve made Danqing Shen fall back and the only thing we could do was come back since there was no sign of him around. No checkpoint we passed had seen him either…”
Li Jingtian’s story began shaky and ended in confusion.
[Did he leave or not?]
Luo Yunhai looked hard at Luo Sifan, “How did you get him to leave?”
“We…”
Luo Sifan giggled, putting on Zhuo Fan’s style as she wove a touching tall tale. Long Jianshan and Xie Nianyang joined in as well, ramping up the danger, the tragedy and, inadvertently, the comedy. They were sure to include any trial imaginable to any human being, no short of going to hell and back.
“And that’s how Dragon Cleaving Sword King felt sorry for us pathetic three and left.” Long Jianshan ended with a few sniffs, though the pride obvious in his eyes, “Alliance Leader, you can’t imagine the danger sister Sifan was in, but I stepped in…”
“As if! I stepped in…”
“Shut it! It was me!”
“No, me!”
…
Long Jianshan wanted to paint himself as saving the damsel, but Xie Nianyang wouldn’t have it. The next thing you knew, Alliance Leader Luo would think of him when giving his daughter’s hand.
The two agreed that anything else was fine, except this.
The innocent Luo Sifan looked dumbstruck.
[Why fight over who lied?]
They weren’t fighting for just some breadcrumbs, but for their future father-in-law’s favor.
Luo Yunhai was clearly not buying it, snapping at them, “Alright, already. Who told you brats that you can go into such danger? Guard, cane them fifty times, without Yuan Qi protection, and then ground them in their room for a month!”
“Ah?”
“Don’t give me that! I’ll make sure you won’t soon forget this.”
Luo Yunhai had the guard take them away, at the dismay of the heroes.
[Didn’t we do good? Why are we punished?]
Zhuo Fan laughed at their expense, patted Murong Xue’s shoulder and left.
Wu Qingqiu and Luo Yunhai were in the dark as to what actually happened, but their nerves relaxed with Danqing Shen giving up…
Whoosh!
Zhuo Fan took Murong Xue through the forest outside the Luo Alliance, laughing, “The brats did it this time. They thought they could take credit? I’d have slapped them in Yunhai’s stead. How could they go through such dangers, when their parents are worried sick? Ha-ha-ha…”
“You sure know your way around, having been the first steward of the Luo Alliance. No one picked up on anything.” Murong Xue looked behind the barrier.
“Please, I set these up before leaving. Even if it is improved, it is done with my own work as the base. I don’t need to know much about this place, ha-ha-ha…”
“The good and evil you speak of…”
“This!”
Zhuo Fan shrugged, “Double Dragon Manor represents what’s good and fair in western lands, earning people’s trust. Shangguan clan also preaches righteousness. Miss Murong must think that with the Luo clan holding the same values and asking them for help, they ought to jump at the occasion to do good. Why then the cold shoulder?”
Murong Xue sank in thought.
Zhuo Fan smirked, “It didn’t get them anything by helping. The Luo clan is large and Double Dragon Manor began to have different opinions about it. Since such a prime chance came to cull it, why waste it? Shangguan clan is an upright clan, but having not gotten western lands’ boss’ green light, what would be the point of saving the Luo clan? It was ill-advised getting on Double Dragon Manor’s bad side as a result. So I ask you, miss Murong, is this good or evil?”
“Behind a greedy heart, demons lurk.” Murong Xue sighed.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Hardly. Double Dragon Manor has its own issues. It has deep roots into western lands, tied to it. Once that changed, western lands changed. Moreover, one’s nature is forever unknown. What kind of boss out there would allow an underdog to rise above it? Even beasts would do everything to drive out intruders, most of all humans. Why? Fear. Double Dragon Manor wants to do things for itself. Failing sometimes means losing one’s life.
“Shangguan clan looked after itself just as well. By offending Double Dragon Manor they lose a strong ally. What’s so bad about getting your family strong before doing good? What point is good if it can’t keep you in power? So, are they good, or evil?”
Murong Xue was mystified.
Zhuo Fan laughed, “Keep watching. The five lands are going to clash again. I’ll then show you what a real disaster and calamity is all about!”
Murong Xue followed him still…
In a gloomy hall, Yuwen Yong hastily came forward to bow, “Prime Minister, Dragon Cleaving Sword King was thwarted. Someone stopped him, holding strength beyond his, from taking down Luo Yunhai.”
“Oh, did those two geezers intervene?” Baili Jingwei smiled.
Yuwen Yong was grave, “No.”
“Who then?”
“I don’t know. The Sword King didn’t say, only that he was powerless.”
“I see. Dragon Cleaving Sword King’s word is his body. For him to say that then it exceeded his ability.” Baili Jingwei nodded, “No matter, what about the other lands’ reactions?”
“Ignored.” Yuwen Yong replied, “They all say they reap what they sow and none stepped in, not even Double Dragon Manor. Ultimate Clarity Sect’s Wu Qingqiu even asked Shangguan clan’s help for the Luo clan, only to be refused.”
Baili Jingwei’s smile grew, “Good, there’s at least some result. Sir Yuwen, ever thought of returning to Tianyu?”
“What?”
“Pass my order. Prince of Harvest, Baili Yunming, in his position as central area ambassador, along with Deputy Minister of War Yuwen Yong are to go to western lands and discuss the removal of Devil Palace with every land. The other three lands will have a renowned member from the Ministry of Rites, Ministry of Revenue and Ministry of Works as ambassadors informing the leaders of the lands of this action.”
“Prime Minister, you…” Yuwen Yong was stunned.
Baili Jingwei waved him off, snickering, “Sir Yuwen, you have one other mission. Listen…”
Baili Jingwei explained in the dark Yuwen Yong’s true purpose.
Baili Jingwei dismissed him and said coldly, “Understand? I’m letting you do this not to get Tianyu back, but to become lord over western lands, under the Sword Star Empire!”
“Thank you so much, Prime Minister. I won’t let you down!” Yuwen Yong cupped his hands and went away with glee…

chapters.title: Chapter 1138 - 1138, Glorious Return
chapters.content:
Chapter 1138, Glorious Return
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
By Baili Jingwei’s decree, the officials drafted the documents quickly, sending them to the four lands’ leaders through ambassadors. As the Sword Star Empire was focused on recovery the past century, it maintained stable relations with the other lands. The lands were very much wary of this large enemy, but the appearances were kept, with some seldom cooperation taking place.
Baili Jingwei sent the ambassadors as goodwill. The four lands were welcome to refuse, but that would raise tension with the empire and lead to further problems that they would rather do without.
What was the harm of one small errand boy paying a visit anyway? As for Devil Palace, they were at peace with them now, but who knew what the future held?
The day might come when all the lands had to unite and remove this organization. Taking precautions for that was only natural.
After careful consideration, the four lands agreed to the empire’s ambassador.
Yuwen Yong and Prince of Harvest, Baili Yunming, took their flashy honor guard to western lands. Unlike the other lands’ envoys, they had to make a stop by the Tianyu Empire before going to Double Dragon Manor.
“The empire’s ambassador is passing by and wants us to receive him?”
Three months later, in the Imperial Palace’s study, the middle-aged emperor, Yuwen Cong, lost his youthful chubbiness, thinning somewhat. He even had a mustache. He gasped as he stared at Luo Yunhai sitting across from him, “Alliance Leader Luo, are you sure? Tianyu isn’t in the direct path between western lands’ border and Double Dragon Manor. Are you sure that’s right?”
Luo Yunhai sighed, “Of course I am, since it came directly from Double Dragon Manor. Saying there’s someone from Tianyu among the delegation making a glorious return and asking explicitly for the Luo Alliance to receive them.”
“From Tianyu? Who?”
Yuwen Cong paced about in thought, “Some glory, when it’s just some guised detour. Humph, I am the Emperor of Tianyu. Any that have been from Tianyu are my people. But to come back as Sword Star Empire’s delegate, he’s demanding my respect? That’s humiliating.”
Luo Yunhai chuckled, “Your Majesty, what humiliation? This is in constant flux. Weren’t you respectful when meeting me before you even became emperor?”
“Oh, I see.”
Yuwen Cong chuckled, “Speaking of, Alliance Leader Luo, you were very kind back then. When Zhuo Fan seized everything, I thought I’d be reduced to a puppet my entire life. But after the Luo Alliance expanded, you returned ruling back to me. I’ll always be grateful for that.”
Luo Yunhai said, “Your Majesty, the Luo clan is also thankful for all your care back then.”
“We both know it was an investment. Like Zhuo Fan said, having motives. But you lacked any with me, offering back the power to rule in sincerity. They just don’t compare.”
“Regardless, the kindness still remains. The Luo clan will never lord over their supporters.”
Yuwen Cong chuckled, “Alliance Leader Luo, no, brother Yunhai, I shall return your respect manifold. Whoever comes back to strut, I’ll be sure to shower him in glory, so as not to nitpick with you.”
“Nitpick?”
“Brother Luo, I may be the ruler of some small kingdom, but things happening in western lands do reach my ear. I know Double Dragon Manor is watching you like a hawk, ready to use anything as an excuse, right? I have vied for the throne and know how to handle problems.”
Luo Yunhai’s face twitched, then beamed…
After three more days, the imperial capital was adorned with colorful decorations. Emperor Yuwen Cong and Empress Long Kui stood at the entrance. It was the highest honor given by the Tianyu Empire to any guest, that of the emperor welcoming the delegation himself.
Though soon found it to be given, since it came from the Sword Star Empire.
Next to them stood the Luo Alliance high officials, with Luo Yunhai in the lead. All stood there, waiting until noon, when the sun was at its highest, to reveal a rumbling carriage forward guarded by an escort of a hundred thousand men and pulled by dozens of spiritual beasts.
“That’s western lands’ ambassador? Baili Jingwei must’ve sniffed a weakness in western lands and wants to take a bite.” Zhuo Fan looked at the large army from the shadows of the walls.
Snickering, Murong Xue said, “How do you know Baili Jingwei is after western lands?”
“If it feels off and looks off, then it must be something off. The other lands’ ambassadors aren’t as armed. Care to know why?”
Murong Xue nodded.
“Because all other ambassadors are second-rates while only ours has a prince included. Something is bound to happen in western lands.”
Zhuo Fan grinned, “They say the prince is also, ha-ha-ha. Just watch…”
Murong Xue watched curiously as the procession came to a stop at the gates.
Luo Yunhai’s group stepped forward and bowed, “I am Alliance Leader Luo Yunhai and welcome the central area’s ambassador.”
“I am the Emperor of Tianyu, Yuwen Cong, welcome!” Yuwen Cong smiled while holding his empress’ hand.
There was no reply from the carriage though.
A sinister laughter cracked up, “Ha-ha-ha, third brother, it’s been ages. I almost forgot you were the emperor.”
Yuwen Cong shook all over as he glared at the carriage, still in disbelief of what he was hearing.
“That voice…”
“Ha-ha-ha, have you forgotten your own brother’s voice?”
The door of the carriage opened and a man with sharp eyes stepped out.
Yuwen Cong paled, his finger shaky, “S-second brother?”
Everyone gasped.
[The emperor’s second brother, it’s that second prince Yuwen Yong that went missing? What’s he doing back? He was being hunted for treason, and now…]
“Third brother, you lost weight!”
Yuwen Yong had a vile smile as he approached Yuwen Cong, patting his cheek twice, “When I told you to get thin, you said you couldn’t, gaining even from drinking water. How come you’re so thin? Oh, I got it, it was an act. When seizing the throne, you played the innocent chubby to avoid suspicion. You fooled me and our elder brother. Now that you got to be emperor, there’s no need for any pretense, is there? Ha-ha-ha…”
Clap~
Yuwen Yong made sure to slap hard enough to swell, laughing at his expense, driven by hatred, “Old third, aren’t you tired of acting? You became emperor, but now what? Aren’t you just a lapdog licking my boots?”
“How dare you address His Majesty without proper respect?” Long Kui shouted. Luo Yunhai scoffed, “Ambassador, you represent the central area. Please watch yourself with Tianyu’s emperor. Don’t take it too far!”
“Too far? The lord of some third-rate empire can compare to the glorious Sword Star Empire’s Deputy Minister of War?”
Yuwen Yong’s snickered, “Alliance Leader Luo, you’re western lands’s Marshal, half of it is yours and you have my respect. As for His Ex-Lardness? What do you think the Exalted Double Dragons would ever do to me?”
Yuwen Yong gathered Yuan Qi in his palm. Luo Yunhai panicked and grabbed it, “What are you doing?”
“Just stretching. Alliance Leader Luo, lighten up. I’m not about to cause trouble as the central area’s ambassador, humph…”
Yuwen Yong rolled his shoulder like he really was stretching. His hand slipped from Luo Yunhai’s hold and sent a taunting and sinister look.
Luo Yunhai gnashed his teeth, his face dark. Yuwen Cong took a deep breath, bowing while straining to hold it in, “After you, ambassador!”
“Sure, Your Majesty!”
Yuwen Yong showed a malicious smile, signaling the troops, “Enter the city but be careful. Prince of Harvest is sleeping and we don’t want to disturb him or heads will roll!”
“Yes, sir!”
The army rumbled onwards with dozens of carriages. Yuwen Cong’s group was filled with fury and revulsion.
The Sword Star Empire’s ambassador was western lands’ guest and they could do nothing against him.
The same happened in the past in this nation, but regardless of the discontent, never had it been the emperor suffering for it.
Though this time, it was the ambassador of the largest empire in the central area hitting the emperor of a third-rate nation…

chapters.title: Chapter 1139 - 1139, Trail
chapters.content:
Chapter 1139, Trail
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
The Sword Star Empire’s delegation entered the imperial capital, leaving Yuwen Cong’s group behind like dirt.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “To think it’s Yuwen Yong of all people. The former brash and reckless fool has smoothened out into a calculating man. Ha-ha-ha, time does change everything.”
“The most Double Dragon Manor can do when irate is to drive them out. For humiliating the delegation meant war with the Sword Star Empire, which none of the four lands had the nerve to risk. The Luo Alliance has no choice but to swallow this up.”
“If it’s only some rudeness, they could just pull through. However…” Zhuo Fan left, “Miss Murong, we’re keeping an eye on the garrison. There’s no way Yuwen Yong came to Tianyu just to take it out on the emperor.”
Murong Xue rushed after him. She got so used to following Zhuo Fan, she did it out of reflex, so she could take in humanity in all its shades of gray…
Six hours later, the sun came down so the moon could take its rightful place. The imperial capital was decorated and dazzling, a different fervor setting in from daytime.
At the garrison, a fat man paced around, bored as hell.
Creak~
Yuwen Yong stepped in, bowing, “Deputy Minister Yuwen Yong greets Prince of Harvest!”
“Sir Yuwen, you’re finally here. I’m sick of staying all day in the carriage!”
Yuwen Yong sat at the table, with the fatty coming over like an eager child, “I did what you said and didn’t accept anyone’s invitation. Tonight you have to entertain me. The Prime Minister had me listen to you, but you can’t just turn me into a prisoner.”
Yuwen Yong smirked, his eyes shining with malice, “No worries, Your Highness, I understand your plight. You’re going to love it tonight.”
“Really? He-he, thanks, Sir Yuwen.” Prince of Harvest had a knowing smile, twisting his fat fingers.
Yuwen Yong grinned, taking out civilian clothes, “Your Highness, you’re very precious and would draw attention. Change into these, then we can have fun. I’ll have two men cover for you so no one finds out and shames us.”
“I got it. The Prime Minister cares about this and I won’t let him down.”
The prince changed, and was a bundle of excitement as he walked outside, “Sir Yuwen, you’re nice. Once we get back, I’ll be sure to put in a good word with the Prime Minister, he-he-he…”
The Prince of Harvest left, with two guards watching him.
Yuwen Yong’s grin widened, “Put a good word? Ha-ha, how pointless…”
“Sir Yuwen, Emperor Yuwen invites you and Prince of Harvest to a feast.” A guard knocked on the door.
Yuwen Yong said, “I know. His Highness doesn’t feel well so I’ll be going alone.”
“Understood!” The man left.
Yuwen Yong straightened his clothes and set off.
Zhuo Fan slipped out of the shadows.
Murong Xue asked, “Going to the Imperial Palace?”
“No, after the idiot prince. He’s pivotal.” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone and Murong Xue followed after him.
An hour later, there was one particular building, lavishly decorated and filled with cheerful noises. It had a plaque ten meters high and very conspicuous.
“Fragrant Manor!”
Prince of Harvest muttered, showing a degenerate smile as he approached, “He-he-he, I feel right at home. Paradise, fairies and ladies, here I come.”
Prince of Harvest was like a beast in heat, going straight in. His guards grinned behind him.
Prince of Harvest was soon surrounded by cherry lips as he entered a room. He waved the two and they offered a bottle.
Prince of Harvest drank it and his eyes went bloodshot as he roared, “Tonight, I’ll be taking on a hundred people. Who shall face me, ha-ha-ha…”
Bam!
The doors shut and moans, clamor and shrieks came out from behind it. The two guards stood outside, sharing a knowing smile.
[Our good prince likes nothing else but to engage in such activities, he-he-he…]
“W-we’re going in?” Murong Xue glanced at the shut doors from the shadows and it was obvious what was going on behind them, reddening.
Zhuo Fan smirked, “All the more reason we need to enter. What’s the point of tailing only to give up at the climax?”
“How obscene!” Murong Xue glared at him with red ears and a hot face.
“How is that? I can’t see what’s happening in there, now can I? I can only guess based on those constant creaking and moans. How’s it any different from looking from outside?”
“Why enter then?”
“To be on the safe side. My eyes aren’t what they used to be and I can’t leave anything unturned, he-he.” Zhuo Fan turned to mist and flew inside.
The door opened and closed so fast and so little, that the guards were oblivious.
Murong Xue blushed red-hot, tensing as she forced herself to go as well. The door clicked close and the guards felt something going in. But seeing nothing, they ignored it.
She hid with Zhuo Fan in a corner, the degenerate sounds grating her ears. Zhuo Fan didn’t even twitch.
Even after two hours, the noises kept going strong, with the Prince of Harvest turning into an animal and howling like a savage. The girls all groaned and cried under his brutality.
Murong Xue bit her lip, glaring at Zhuo Fan and whisper-shouting, “Haven’t you found anything after all this time?”
“I did.”
“What?”
“He must’ve taken something to have boundless stamina.” Zhuo Fan nodded like a sage.
Murong Xue’s face twitched, “I’m talking about Baili Jingwei’s scheme here!”
“I’m looking for that as well, but I haven’t found anything. What a bummer I can only hear…” Zhuo Fan sighed, devastated.
Murong Xue was fuming mad, “Pervert, watch then, for I’m going.”
But then, a person got thrown in through the window, looking either dead or unconscious.
“There it is!”
Zhuo Fan grinned, “Any man seeking relief, even if under a stimulant, would not turn into a mindless animal. What was the point? Prince of Harvest is about to go raving mad, his drink spiked to numb his mind. I think it’s Baili Jingwei’s doing. What do you think, miss Murong?”
“I…” Murong Xue was puzzled.
“What are you thinking about?”
Zhuo Fan asked, but then nodded, “Ew, that’s just nasty. I may be a demon, but I have my principles and never dual cultivated. Yet you actually… I never imagined…”
“You…” Murong Xue lowered her head in shame.
[Rotten bastard! He’s toying with me!]
Then the newcomer stirred and groaned. Murong Xue started at the sounds, “Is it that child?”
“Sifan.” Zhuo Fan sighed.
The crazed Prince of Harvest picked up on the girl’s voice and turned with bloodshot eyes. He howled and threw himself at her.
[Here comes another, ha-ha-ha…]
A finger flick hit the deranged man and he froze on the spot.
Zhuo Fan lowered his hand. Murong Xue was about to go, “I’ll take the girl. She shouldn’t be here, ruining her good name.”
Pa!
Zhuo Fan gripped her shoulder, earning an odd look from her.
Luo Sifan stirred awake and Zhuo Fan pointed at Prince of Harvest so he could move again. The pretty girl aroused all his senses, howling as he jumped her…

chapters.title: Chapter 1140 - 1140, Stirring Trouble
chapters.content:
Chapter 1140, Stirring Trouble
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Ah, who are you?”
Luo Sifan came to with a start at the beastly and naked man throwing himself at her. She snapped her hands forward out of reflex, pushing him back, into the floor, and making him cough blood.
The drug had long since taken over the Prince of Harvest’s mind, numbing his senses and taking away his reasoning. Regardless of the pain, he only saw the girl as a tasty morsel, coming at her with lust in his eyes.
Luo Sifan was scared silly, but her instincts as a peak Radiant Stage cultivator kicked in once more, flinging the deranged man away and bleeding.
The man was so far gone he cared not for his life, going for her again and again, only to be repelled every time.
By the thirty-ish time Prince of Harvest’s fat body got bounced back, he looked battered all over, but his eyes never lost their ravenous hunger as they sought out Luo Sifan.
Luo Sifan was horrified, even though she won. Murong Xue looked inquisitively at Zhuo Fan, “Why?”
“Why what?”
“You had him restrained, so why let him go so the girl would deal with him?”
Zhuo Fan said, “I feel like finding out what Baili Jingwei is up to, and for that, I let him win.”
“You let him win?”
“Sure. I’ve had my eyes on the central area for years now and I’m planning on destroying it soon, for my plan to return. I can’t wait a moment longer. As for why I held back, one is because Baili Yutian’s a mystery, and two, central area’s recovery in these recent years has been going far too easily. You’ve seen for yourself, how strong central area was in the war, stronger than all four lands’ forces.”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Unless it makes a move, no one can shake that rock. Now that he finally showed his hand, I’m not about to stop him.”
Murong Xue’s brow shook, “Then why did you stop his savage act for a moment there? You could’ve not interfered at all.
“Miss Murong, know this, I let him move, but I also have my limits. No harm will ever come to a Luo clansman.”
Zhuo Fan eased a long breath, “In all fairness, my plan would’ve been in motion all the same if Danqing Shen had killed Yunhai. But I stepped in because he cannot die. The same went for stopping the crazed prince, so Sifan wouldn’t get hurt. By letting him act, I allowed Baili Jingwei’s plan to continue as I moved under this distraction. Nothing would’ve happened since Sifan is at peak Radiant Stage while the prince is just a fresh Radiant Stage cultivator. It’ll only make Yunhai feel bad, is all.”
Murong Xue gasped, looking away, “I don’t get what you’re saying at all, schemer!”
“Ha-ha-ha, miss Murong, you’re catching on. The you before would’ve butted in on the spot to help the needy, for the common good, for righteousness and purging of evil. Now, you have learned patience.”
“No, I haven’t. It’s because I’m still of two minds on what is right or wrong, and I don’t want to make the wrong judgment. I’ve seen the people go through countless changes this hundred years, which only plunged me into deeper confusion. Now I’m going with you so I can see your choices.” Murong Xue squinted.
Zhuo Fan smirked, “Miss Murong, I’ll share with you a story, one that will clear all doubts about right and wrong, good and evil. I listened to it in my travels through the five lands. It was illuminating, so much that my heart grew incredibly while my cultivation dropped five layers.”
“Dropped?”
“Sure did. True Self Art focuses on the heart and heart alone, bringing one back to one’s true nature. Getting stronger is pointless, with only a growing heart and mentality would prove fruitful. Once reaching one’s origin, I will finally see for myself what the world Dao really is.”
“Now I’m interested to hear it!” Murong Xue showed a rare smile, a sight for sore eyes, yet lost on Zhuo Fan.
Bam!
That marked the fiftieth time Prince of Harvest went on the offensive and was repelled. The pain and hurt his body endured had no way of breaking through his drug-addled mind still, getting his feet under him with a loony smile and greedy eyes. Completing the picture was the constant blood coming from his mouth, mixed with bits and pieces from his innards.
Luo Sifan’s brow shook hard, unable to look at the ghastly figure.
[Who is this freak? He’s like the living dead. Doesn’t he feel any pain?]
“He-he-he…”
Prince of Harvest twisted his body, taking another step for Luo Sifan. Blood poured out of him still, driven by only one instinct, to mate. The innocent girl felt sick to her stomach, opting to dodge this time.
The doors burst open just then and the two guards flew in followed by two new people, “Sister Sifan!”
Long Jianshan and Xie Nianyang had arrived.
Watching Prince of Harvest’s bizarre shape going for Luo Sifan had them in shock just then, “Who the hell are you? Don’t touch her!”
The two coordinated perfectly, one with a palm, the other with a kick, striking the vitals of the beaten prince.
Long Jianshan was ruthless enough to even go for Prince of Harvest’s heart, punching a hole in the fat man’s chest. Xie Nianyang did an overhead kick, right at the face, removing the head from that gross body.
Blood gushed everywhere, while the headless Prince of Harvest twitched once before splattering in his own blood.
“That was my claw, I saved Sifan!”
“That was my kick, I saved sister Sifan!”
Ignoring the corpse, the two stared daggers at each other, then rushed at Luo Sifan’s side, “Sister Sifan, are you alright?”
With a blank face, Luo Sifan finally snapped awake, pointing at the corpse, “W-who is he?”
“Prince!”
A cry came before they could reply. The two guards turned their gaping expressions from the blood, to the three as they spewed fire, “You have some nerve to kill Sword Star Empire’s Prince of Harvest! You killed the Sword Star Empire’s envoy and have declared war on us.
[Sword Star Empire’s envoy?!]
The trio shook all over then went slack from shock.
[We’re done for!]
Zhuo Fan chuckled from the shadows, “Oh, the brats are in for it now, ha-ha-ha…”
“Is this Baili Jingwei’s plan? Dragging western lands into a war?”
“If it were that easy, he wouldn’t be Baili Jingwei. War? He can’t suffer from it, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan waved her off, walking away, “Baili Jingwei has started, and so shall I. I’ve waited a hundred years for this. Wu Randong, your bitter wait is at an end!”
In the brightly lit imperial palace, with three rows of guards inside and another three outside, making it foolproof, Yuwen Yong attended the banquet held for the Sword Star Empire delegates, ridiculing, “Third brother, it’s been ages since my last feast in the imperial palace. It feels awfully foreign. Since when did a third-rate empire have Soul Harmony guards? And dozens of them too. Third brother, you’ve sure gotten the empire far, ha-ha-ha…”
“Imperial brother, there’s no need for hazing. The Luo Alliance sent the guards for your protection. I am but the lord of a meager empire and have no right to have even one Soul Harmony expert in my employ. To be frank, master is only at the 5th layer of Ethereal Stage.” Yuwen Cong spoke coldly. Luo Yunhai’s group stared hard at him.
Yuwen Yong sneered, “Fang Qiubai? Isn’t he Tianyu’s Divine Dragon? Why is he such a disappointment? Only 5th layer Ethereal Stage? That’s my level!”
“Ha-ha-ha, brother is Sword Star Empire’s Deputy Minister of War, enjoying lush resources, unlike our barren lands. It’s normal for brother to outdo master.”
Yuwen Yong nodded, “Right you are, brother. Central area’s environment is way better than here. Take the lowest official in the central area and you still won’t find any weaker than the emperor here.”
In face of such an empty taunt, Yuwen Cong smiled, “To each his own ambition. Some like to be the head of something, however small, while others prefer to bask in the glorious stool of others, to smell their stench. There’s no forcing one’s nature. Sometimes, not just any can be a leader, no matter how much they try.”
The bite Yuwen Yong placed in his mouth shook, his face darkening from fury…
[You have guts, Yuwen Cong!]
Luo Yunhai was stern, while the guards drew around the emperor.
Yuwen Yong’s fury abated, snickering at everyone’s tense looks, “Brother, why do I feel these guards aren’t here to keep me safe, but you instead?”
“Brother, by no means do I deserve such honor.”
Ignoring the empty formality, Yuwen Yong’s eyes shone, “Sometimes, the guards’ level matters not, not when they protect the wrong asset.”
Luo Yunhai’s face fell, staring hard with a frown.
[What’s that supposed to mean?]

chapters.title: Chapter 1141 - 1141, Ruse
chapters.content:
Chapter 1141, Ruse
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“There’s huge trouble!”
Panicked cries echoed out into the hall from outside, making everyone frown.
Yuwen Yong was the only one still sneering.
The one howling staggered inside and Yuwen Cong shouted at him, “What’s all this fuss? Speak clearly about what happened!”
“Yes, Your Majesty!”
The man wiped his heavy brow and bowed, still shaken up, “Your Majesty, Sword Star Empire’s envoy, Prince of Harvest Bali Yunming w-was…”
“Was what?” Everyone’s hearts sank as Yuwen Cong howled.
The man cried as he bowed, “Killed…”
“What?!”
Yuwen Yong smacked the table as he raged, “What did you say? What happened to the Prince of Harvest?”
The man shook all over, “The envoy, Prince of Harvest, was killed…”
“Absurd! How could this have happened?”
Yuwen Yong raved and looked around, “Do any of you have any idea who Prince of Harvest is? He is the fifteenth grandson of his imperial majesty, bestowed the title of prince at the age of eighteen, out of deep love. He was sent to the western lands to entrust you with his safety and learn of the world. But you had an assassin at every corner I see. Sword Star Empire will not stand for this! Everything that comes is on you!”
Everyone’s heart was in their throats. The central area envoy, a prince no less, was killed here. They had to answer for it, unable to escape such dire consequences.
Yuwen Cong pondered, “Brother, it’s too early to assume. You said that the prince was unwell and can’t attend the feast. Then he must be in his quarters. How could he be assassinated?”
“Yeah, the guards there are thorough. Not only Deputy’s men, but also Luo Alliance’s. How could there be a hit?” Luo Yunhai spoke with conviction.
Yuwen Yong mocked, “How should I know?”
“Where was Prince of Harvest attacked?” Yuwen Yong looked with disdain at the man.
“Sir, Prince of Harvest was murdered… at Fragrant Manor.”
“Fragrant Manor… a brothel?” Yuwen Cong let it slip and earned the ire of his empress, Long Kui, who whispered, “What’s with that quick reaction in calling it a brothel? Do you know it?”
“Uh, no, not at all. I just… heard about it, yeah, from Xiao Lizi, ha-ha-ha…”
“Him? Won’t an eunuch feel crushed going there?” Long Kui had a cruel smile.
Yuwen Cong gulped and switched topics, “Empress, this isn’t the time for trifles. The envoy is dead, with heavy implications. We must ascertain the truth!
“Brother, why did the Prince of Harvest, safe in his quarters, appear in a brothel? Is there something we should know?” Yuwen Cong spoke earnestly, “This is no longer a matter of protection. We can’t protect him if your envoy goes wherever without telling us. We need to be aware of his every move, be it the brothel, or the bathroom.”
Luo Yunhai gave the emperor a thumb’s up.
[The emperor ain’t just for show, so quick to shirk the blame.]
The empress did not complain further, knowing this was matters of national security.
Yuwen Yong rubbed his beard, his eyes flashing, “Guard, execute all who were on duty! What’s the point of them if they can’t even notice the prince sneaking out?”
“Yes!”
A man next to him bowed and ran off.
Yuwen Yong glanced at Yuwen Cong, “Satisfied with my unbiased decision, brother? Who’s at fault will get the blame. I know how to be fair.”
“I have no comment.” Yuwen Cong refused to reply.
Yuwen Yong looked at the man he sent, “Though the guards are punished for neglecting their duty, they’re not to blame for the murder. Now, who was it that killed the prince? Have you caught the outrageous criminal?”
“Yes, but…” The man hesitated, glancing at Luo Yunhai.
Luo Yunhai’s heart sank with unease.
Yuwen Yong demanded, “Stop blabbering and bring them here! Let us see who had the nerve to commit such a treasonous act!”
“Yes!” The man nodded and sighed as he went to pass the order. Five people came in, escorted by many guards.
Luo Yunhai cried out, “Sifan!”
“Dad!” Luo Sifan teared up, looking victimized along with Long Jianshan and Xie Nianyang, “Alliance Leader!”
“What’s the meaning of this? What did they do this time?”
“You’re supposed to bring the criminal, not a girl.” Yuwen Yong said the obvious.
Prince of Harvest’s guards bowed and pointed at them, “Deputy sir, these three killed the prince. The body is outside, scattered.”
“What?!”
Luo Yunhai gasped, “I-it can’t be!”
The three lowered their heads, admitting with their silence.
Luo Yunhai held his head, with Yuwen Cong growing restless.
[What’s with this girl getting involved in this huge problem? A ruse must be at play here.]
Yuwen Yong snickered, his hand gushing with Yuan Qi, “Since we have the culprits and it’s due to our neglect, I shall do away with the criminals and not trouble you, ha-ha-ha…”
Yuwen Yong’s hand came down on Luo Sifan’s head.
Luo Sifan cried out in fright, the attack stopping inches from her hair. She cracked a frightened eyelid to see her father gripping the deadly attack with fury.
“Peak Soul Harmony Alliance Leader, a man among men deserving his name, humph.”
Yuwen Yong’s face shook, pain stabbing his hand as he released his attack, yet challenging Luo Yunhai, “Alliance Leader, what’s this? You ought to know this matter involves the envoy and shouldn’t be biased. I killed the guilty guards and killing the culprits should be the best resolution for you…”
Luo Yunhai took a deep breath, not releasing his grip, showing the deep worry plaguing his heart. Yuwen Yong laughed, “Alliance Leader, are you impeding me in exacting judgment on the culprits? The Sword Star Empire won’t stand for it. Central area and western lands will be at war because of you. Are you ready to take on such a burden?”
“Brother Yunhai!”
Yuwen Cong cried out, figuring something out, “What has niece been doing in a brothel? What exactly happened?”
Luo Yunhai came to, finding a lifeline, and asked, “Yes, what were you doing there?”
“Dad, I don’t know how, but as we walked around the city, someone knocked me out. The next thing I knew, some naked man jumped me and I smacked him back. I fended him off dozens of times but didn’t kill him.” Luo Sifan pleaded her innocence.
Long Jianshan and Xie Nianyang bobbed their heads, “Yes, Alliance Leader, we chased the black figure, unable to catch him as he toyed with us. Then we reached a building where we heard sister Sifan’s screams and ran there. But the two guards at the door wouldn’t let us in and we had to fight our way in. What we saw inside was a weird thing jumping Sifan. I acted without realizing, running my hand through his chest…”
“I sent his head flying with a kick.” Xie Nianyang admitted, “We had no way of knowing he was the prince.”
Everyone knew then and there.
[It’s a ruse, clear as day.]
Luo Yunhai glared at Yuwen Yong, gnashing his teeth, “Sir Yuwen, you come at me, do not drag children into this! You didn’t like how Danqing Shen couldn’t take my head, did you?”
“Alliance Leader, what are you saying? Everyone knows it’s between you and Danqing Shen. I represent an empire as a peaceful envoy. Why would I ever want the great Marshal of the western lands dead?”
Yuwen Yong’s words dripped with cruelty, “You need to stop being so biased! Brats, you said someone did this to you. Well, where is he?”
The three lowered their heads in defeat…

chapters.title: Chapter 1142 - 1142, Pretext
chapters.content:
Chapter 1142, Pretext
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Yuwen Yong laughed, his eyes sharp, “With no one around, you have no proof. For all I know, you could be making it up to save your hide. While your heavy crime of killing the prince is undoubtedly clear. We all heard you admit it.”
“You’re guilty and deserve to die!” Yuwen Yong snickered as he turned to Luo Yunhai, “Alliance Leader, is there something you wish to say?”
Luo Yunhai had a dark look on his face, “I just want to know what Prince of Harvest was doing in the brothel.”
“Yeah, how? With such a tight guard around…” Yuwen Yong had an answer ready, turning to the two guards.
Catching on, they cupped his hands, “Deputy sir, the prince’s character is known to all our people. Having come here as an envoy and unable to bring company, the prince had been feeling down these long days of travel. Now that we got to a big city, he disguised himself with normal clothes and slipped out. None here knew of the lord’s true identity, with only us following him. He was quite free, but then…”
“I see, you didn’t let the prince out today, just so he could go bed someone tonight.” Luo Yunhai fumed at Yuwen Yong.
He knew then that with such a big welcome they held, the prince had just to show his face and everyone would know him for who he was. Their scouts would tail him from the shadows and make sure to keep him safe…
Yuwen Yong grinned cruelly, mocking, “Alliance Leader, you shouldn’t accuse someone without proof. I won’t hear it. Everyone here knows our prince had been bottling up his needs for so long and just wanted to let loose. But at the brothel, these brats killed him without reason. It was my duty to dole out punishment to the lax guards. The prince had no restraint over his lower head and got himself killed. What’s left is to punish the killers.
“Then, Alliance Leader, I’ll be taking the brats, if you wouldn’t mind.” Yuwen Yong flicked his hand and guards went for the kids.
Luo Yunhai shouted while defending them, “Let’s see you try!”
Whoosh!
In moments, many experts had Yuwen Yong and his men surrounded instead, this being Luo Alliance’s turf.
Yuwen Yong cared not, for his aim was achieved.
“Alliance Leader, and what is this?”
Yuwen Yong waved, “I’m a central area envoy, a guest to western lands that came here brokering peace. Our prince might’ve died without reason in your home, but we still have to be fair and not let this harm our talks. We only wish to give the Prince of Harvest justice. The same for anyone, regardless of status, a life for a life. Everyone in the world agrees to this logic, and yet the Luo clan, hailed as righteous and loyal, can’t? Or maybe you’d like the central area to drill it into you.”
Luo Yunhai’s face twitched in anger, a vein popping from strain, “No matter what, no one will lay a finger on them, or they’ll have to deal with me!”
“My, Alliance Leader, that’s some fire in you. In broad daylight, uh, clearly shielding criminals and ruining the peace between our lands.”
Looking at him, then at the sky, Yuwen Yong chuckled, “I thought Double Dragon Manor answered for western lands, but now I see the times have changed, with the Luo Alliance taking over.”
Hearts sank in panic, knowing he was throwing blame around just so the two would be at each other’s throat.
Yuwen Cong waved, “Brother, please don’t say nonsense. The Luo Alliance handling this area and western lands’ defenses were agreed upon by everyone. Double Dragon Manor entrusted them with this duty. With such a serious situation, it’s only proper for the Alliance Leader to make a thorough investigation. It’s all within his right.”
“Right? Humph…”
Yuwen Yong mocked, “What right would that be, when the three culprits are related to him yet he gets to investigate? Not to mention, the truth is clear as day. Investigate what then? Alliance Leader’s reaction is clearly that of harboring them.”
Yuwen Yong’s accusation only grew wilder and wilder. Luo Yunhai was silent, stewing in rage.
“Fine, this is Luo Alliance’s turf and we’re just a group of delegates, unable to take the criminals from Luo Alliance. Let’s go!”
Being at odds for a while, Yuwen Yong smiled in the end, calling his men back, “I’ll be sure to report this to the empire and the Double Dragon Manor. Let’s see what they have to say. I only wanted to handle this quietly, on account of Tianyu being my homeland, but you just keep fighting me on this. Now you’ll suffer for it, humph.”
Yuwen Yong glared at Luo Yunhai one last time, laughing as he walked out.
Yuwen Cong panicked at the thought of making this matter bigger, rushing after Yuwen Yong, “Brother, wait, please don’t…”
Yuwen Yong got what he wanted and saw no reason to waste words on the other. He rushed back, eager to send his report.
[Prime Minister, the first step is complete, humph…]
…
Two jade slips streaked the sky with their green light, reaching Baili Jingwei and Double Dragon Manor in three days.
That was the moment all the lands’ leaders came to know of Alliance Leader Luo’s daughter’s crimes, to which Baili Jingwei had his response ready from the start.
Zither Sword King led five million soldiers of the empire to ramp up the pressure on the border between the two lands; readying for war.
“Bastard, this is just a pretext of Baili Jingwei to take it out on western lands!”
Bam!
In the Double Dragon Manor, Exalted Hei Ran slapped the table, holding two jade slips in the other, one reporting the events, the other being Yuwen Yong’s accusations, “It just happened yet they already have men at the border? It was premeditated without question!”
Exalted Bai Mei sighed with a frown, “Yes, I did say there was something off about the four lands envoys. It was all a ruse. But why must it be us? The other lands are doing well, as if to state we’re the ones at fault. We shouldn’t have agreed to letting the envoy in in the first place.”
“What’s the point of saying that now? Send the other three lands messages that we need to work together!” Exalted Hei Ran rolled his eyes.
Exalted Bai Mei nodded, “That’s all we can do. At least five million isn’t a lot. It doesn’t look like Baili Jingwei is ready for war…”
Double Dragon Manor’s plea for help reached the other lands, alas, relations weren’t as good as before.
Did they think Baili Jingwei sent some pushovers to the other three lands? No renowned official he sent was weak in his book, that was for sure.
A month passed, finding Zhuo Fan on his throne in a gloomy hall. Murong Xue was by his side, overlooking him laying out his meticulous plan. Below was the second young master of Serene Shores Trading, the envoy of Devil Palace, Wu Randong.
“This is what I want you to do? You got all that? You’ll have to endure for a bit.” Zhuo Fan spoke.
Wu Randong’s brow moved as he bowed, looking excited, “Palace Lord, I’ve been waiting for this day for too long. Sir could even cast me aside and I’d still be at peace with it!”
“It’s not casting you out, but the winning move!”
Zhuo Fan grinned, “What about the Luo clan, how are they faring? They should be ready to give.”
Wu Randong bowed, “Palace Lord is correct. The Luo clan is stuck, assaulted from all sides. Double Dragon Manor asked for help from the other lands but were quickly rejected.”
“Why would the four lands, united against the central area, sit back in western lands’ time of need?” Murong Xue frowned, “Even interdependent, they shouldn’t just let western lands go to war!”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, saying to Wu Randong, “Share the details with her.”
“Yes, Palace Lord.”
Wu Randong bowed, speaking gravely, “Miss Murong, the three lands are in opposition in this matter and not a whole. All because the central area holds the moral high ground.”
Murong Xue asked, “Moral?”
“To an empire, the envoy represents a nation’s ruler. To sects, he represents a Sect Leader’s authority. To the lands’ powers, he is a proxy to the highest power. By killing him, it’s like killing the ruler he represents. No one could accept this, unless you’re out for war. Killing an enemy’s envoy is like killing their leader.”
Wu Randong continued, “That’s why this matter is taken as being the Luo clan’s fault by any and all in the three lands while the central area is in the right. Adding to this, the central area’s envoys are in their lands, all the reason why the three lands are finding it hard to step in.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1143 - 1143, I’ll Bear It!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1143, I’ll Bear It!
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Zhuo Fan nodded, “This is morality, and the apparent righteousness all people have. It’s universal law for one to repay with life or money for a crime. It stands at the core of every human, the basis of any human society. Without it, humans would be scattered, let alone having the common interest the four lands once had. That’s why no one can oppose such a principle, for it’s like denying yourself. As the Luo clan had no hard proof for their innocence, none would be taking their side.”
“Palace Lord’s talk of principle is the deepening discrepancy between the three lands. That is, whether or not it’s worth helping the Luo clan. By siding with them in the open, it’s like throwing away the sense of justice all people have. By turning a deaf ear, they fear the central area would use this chance to remove one of their allies. Adding to that, the central area’s envoys are in their homes, so they can hardly show any support, while also talking it out with the envoys in hope of diffusing this problem.”
“That’s precisely why war must have a good pretext. One must have the moral high ground, or else the one at threat would be himself.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Though every land fears the empire’s war, when there’s no need to. Baili Jingwei is so cautious and subtle, meaning the Sword Star Empire’s frail stability would crack the minute any large deployment is made. For that reason he only sent five million soldiers at the border, to intimidate and bluster.”
Wu Randong nodded, “Palace Lord is correct. Baili Jingwei is now aware of Devil Palace and can no longer wage war on a grand scale like before. Though his scare tactic is no less believable to the lands, ha-ha-ha…”
“The four lands are a shadow of themselves a century ago, suffering heavy losses.”
Zhuo Fan’s face hardened, “That can only mean, to broker peace with Baili Jingwei, they need a scapegoat. Miss Murong, we’ll be going to the Luo clan again. If Yunhai recalls my actions, Baili Jingwei’s scheme will fall apart. But he isn’t me…”
Zhuo Fan stood and walked, with Murong Xue on his heels. Wu Randong bowed, “Safe travels, Palace Lord…”
In the heart of Luo Alliance, everyone was looking pensive, waiting for Double Dragon Manor’s message and trying to come up with a solution on their own.
They kept coming back to the killing of Prince of Harvest. It was the only reason why the central area could show their might and send troops to intimidate despite the lands being against it.
With the kids killing Prince of Harvest out in the open, the empire coming for justice was only proper. They could say it was a trap all along, but the schemer was also sure to tie up any loose ends.
That guy in black who took Luo Sifan was gone. With so many guards among the delegation, anyone could have put on a disguise and led the kids away.
“It’s impossible!”
Zhuge Changfeng shook his head, worried as much as the other two, “Baili Jingwei must’ve set it up, but why? Is it just to target us? Even if we admit it, what then? It’ll only take out some scapegoats. One prince for the life of three kids? Why would he do that?”
Leng Wuchang was solemn, “It’s obvious he’s not after the brats with such a twisted trick. He knows Clan Head would never give them up.”
Leng Wuchang glanced at the pensive Luo Yunhai.
Luo Sifan was in her mother’s embrace, looking at her father with tears in her eyes.
Whoosh!
Wen Tao and Wu Qingqiu rushed in.
“How is it?” Luo Yunhai jumped to his feet and welcomed them, “What did the Exalted say?”
The two found it hard to speak, with Wu Qingqiu starting, “Brother Yunhai, we’re the ones at fault while Baili Jingwei had kept talking with the three lands to stay out of it. They take it as being against the four lands’ common interest and nothing more than a personal grudge while hoping of diffusing this problem to avoid war. The Exalted… each man for themselves, to sacrifice them for the western lands’ peace. If the matter isn’t settled, they would keep pushing us and the other three lands leaving us aside.”
“I knew it…” Zhuge Changfeng leaned back in his chair with a sigh.
Luo Sifan cried in her mother’s embrace, “Mom…”
“Sifan, it’s alright. I won’t let anything happen to you.” Rubbing her back, Yue’er’s heart was torn as well.
Luo Yunhai gnashed his teeth, “In other words, the Exalted want my daughter to take the blame to make the central area retreat?”
The two hung their heads.
“Don’t they know she’s been set up?” Luo Yunhai howled.
Wu Qingqiu sighed, “Anyone can see what is going on, but without proof, the central area had the pretext to wage war while the other lands have no reason to intervene. How could they help? Helping Luo Alliance harbor criminals? No leader of the three lands would ever accept this. The war must be right, even if on the surface.”
“It’s not about the lands standing united, it’s about reason.”
Wen Tao patted Luo Yunhai’s shoulder, “Brother Yunhai, sorry, we’re unable to give much help…”
Luo Yunhai’s brow shook, looking at his crying daughter. His eyes shone and stormed out.
No one chased him.
[Maybe Alliance Leader needs time to calm down.]
Five million soldiers wasn’t many, but they had a Sword King leading them. When the war started, the death toll would be huge, something none from western lands wanted to happen…
Three days later, Yuwen Yong walked in the dead of night through a gloomy forest when someone popped in front of him.
Yuwen Yong smiled and cupped his hands, “Alliance Leader Luo, was it you that asked me to see me here? What would Alliance Leader ask of me on this perfect night for murder?”
“Let the children go!” Luo Yunhai glared at him.
Yuwen Yong cackled, “What’s this, Alliance Leader? It’s a heavy crime for her to kill the empire’s precious prince. With the entire affair so huge, you just want me to let your daughter go? You’re barking at the wrong tree. I’m just an envoy, a messenger. I don’t have the authority to pardon a national criminal.”
“Spare me the theatrics. We’re the only ones here. Why are you doing this?” Luo Yunhai shouted.
Yuwen Yong looked around, showing his sneaky grin, “Nothing, really. Our intent was plain from the start, to exact justice for Prince of Harvest. Take the culprits and punish them.”
Yuwen Yong emphasized his words, reading Luo Yunhai’s face.
“The kids didn’t do crap. There’s no point in taking them.” Luo Yunhai caught his drift, squinting, “I’ll go with you. Baili Jingwei is after me, isn’t he? Then I’ll go with you to the central area.”
Yuwen Yong chuckled, “To the central area? The great Alliance Leader Luo, with half of western lands behind you, there’s absolutely no reason to kidnap the mighty Marshal. This would make your friends attack and we’ll start another world war all over again. Although I haven’t been in western lands for many years, I also know very well that the Luo Alliance puts benevolence first and has many allies. Touching you is like poking the hornet’s nest!”
“Shove it! Don’t you need a pretext?”
Luo Yunhai sneered, “I made the brats kill Prince of Harvest, they’re just like assassins that listened to my orders. I’ll bear this blame. Take me, the main culprit while leaving those nobodies aside.”
Yuwen Yong stared in those firm eyes and chuckled, “Is this true?”
“My word is my bond!”
“Great, since the Alliance Leader said it, I’ll oblige, but no take backsies, he-he-he…” Yuwen Yong snickered, his eyes shining, “Alliance Leader, after you. Though you should know, the five million strong army at the border won’t leave until you enter our empire’s lands.”
“You don’t have to tell me.”
Luo Yunhai was calm, walking forward. Yuwen Yong followed with a winning smile.
In the morning of the next day, the delegation sent word to all western lands a most shocking news. The Alliance Leader Luo, Marshal Luo Yunhai, instigated the death of Prince of Harvest and Deputy Yuwen Yong was taking him back to execute him…

chapters.title: Chapter 1144 - 1144, Trend
chapters.content:
Chapter 1144, Trend
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Whoosh~
As Yuwen Yong’s delegation was set to leave, thousands upon thousands of men had the tiny Tianyu imperial capital surrounded, ready for war.
Yuwen Yong snorted and glanced at unconcerned Luo Yunhai, “Alliance Leader, I told you that you have many friends. We haven’t even started and they came, humph…”
“Friends, step aside please!”
Luo Yunhai caught on and stepped forward with a bow and cupped hands, “Thank you all for your intentions towards me and the Luo Alliance, but the central area and western lands are on the path to war because of me. Giving my life for western lands is my duty. I ask that everyone accepts.”
Luo Yunhai bowed once more.
The huge crowd replied in kind, “We respect Alliance Leader Luo’s righteousness!”
“Dad!”
Luo Sifan rushed out of the ranks, going for her father, “Dad, it’s all my fault. I should take the blame. It isn’t yours to carry…”
Luo Yunhai smiled, “Sifan, it had nothing to do with you. They were after me. Why else were they so quick to accept me taking the blame? Now go back, don’t let this hold you back. It’ll all be fine…”
“Dad…”
Luo Sifan sobbed. Long Jianshan and Xie Nianyang approached, looking forlorn with their hung heads.
Luo Yunchang, Yue’er and Zhuge Changfeng, wanted to get their Clan Head home, but they knew his mind was set and did not say anything.
Only Yue’er came next to Luo Yunhai, holding his hand, “I’m going with you.”
“Yue’er!”
“Ever since we held hands for the first time, we never separated.” Yun’er smiled as she turned to Luo Yunchang, “Sister, I’ll leave Sifan in your care.”
Luo Yunchang’s eyes shook, looking long at the couple, and gave a painful nod.
“Mom, you too…” Luo Sifan cried harder, crushed from sorrow.
Yue’er rubbed her cheek with a smile, “Once together, only death will do us part. Sifan, I won’t ever leave your father. I’m sorry for not looking after you.”
“Dad, mom…” Luo Sifan cried harder. Luo Yunchang and Yue’er exchanged looks and the latter knocked her out to let Luo Yunchang take her.
To their relief, Luo Yunchang took the girl and returned to the crowd. But Luo Yunchang was also struggling, closing her eyes shut as tears fell down her cheeks, her heart breaking with every step.
“I’ll leave the Luo clan to you, stewards!”
Luo Yunhai saluted Zhuge Changfeng and the others, leaving with Yuwen Yong’s escort. In their travels, any with even a bit of honor would see them go.
They all knew the Luo clan was framed. That was why Luo Yunhai took the blame from his daughter to settle the tense situation. He had earned everyone’s respect and admiration with his selfless act.
Yuwen Cong and every Sect Leader, including the former enemy Qin Hao from Qin Society came.
All known figures came to see Luo Yunhai off, the greatest meeting in western lands. It caused a great shock in even Yuwen Yong.
[Luo Alliance has far greater clout in western lands than I thought. The only one missing is Double Dragon Manor…]
From a dark corner, Zhuo Fan watched with a shaking head, “Oh, those old coots, they won’t even put up a token of effort? Humph, he is giving his life for western lands, and by not showing even the slightest intention, they’ll only earn the people’s ire.”
“You won’t step in to save him? Luo Yunhai didn’t die to Danqing Shen, but will now be executed in the Sword Star Empire capital.” Murong Xue teased.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “You think Baili Jingwei fanned the flames so hard and even brought an army just for the measly Luo Alliance Leader? Ha-ha, a pawn is only a pawn in your hand. Once crushed, it’s worthless. Yunhai won’t die in the empire, for he has plenty of worth. How could Baili Jingwei do away with him before squeezing him for all his worth?”
“You mean Baili Jingwei is on the move?”
“Yep, with Yunhai in his control, he ought to have enough pieces to act. Only when he moves, I can move too.”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “A hundred years passed, yet the four lands’ leaders have not made an ounce of progress, Baili Jingwei playing them like a fiddle.”
Murong Xue chuckled, “Oh, is there another way of handling this matter? I find Luo Yunhai’s sacrifice for the good of others is honorable. How would you handle it?”
“Humph, giving your life for peace is honorable, sure, but it’s not to settle things, it’s because he had no choice. Baili Jingwei forced him into a corner.”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Miss Murong, what you and Yunhai along with many value honor, it is in fact a great flaw. In the end, people harm themselves.”
“Why do you say that?”
“Oh, I did say I was going to tell you a story. This is the perfect setting. Care to listen?”
Zhuo Fan didn’t wait for her answer, getting right to it, “Once upon a time, there were two warring kingdoms. They both had prisoners of war and sometimes exchanged them, while most of the time employed them as slaves. One kingdom decreed that any who brought back their fellow people would be rewarded. And so, many merchants traveled to the enemy kingdom and had no trouble buying some prisoners of war to bring back, receiving glory and wealth. But one man among them refused, more than happy to hand the wealth over to the officials. What do you think of him?”
Murong Xue frowned, “Honorable and kind, not minding little remuneration, and a man of virtue.”
“This is the righteousness you know, right?”
“Yes!” Murong Xue nodded.
Zhuo Fan laughed, “The story has yet to end. When this same man you consider virtuous and honorable returned to his master, and gave his report filled with pride, how do you think the master reacted?”
“If the master was just as upright, he would praise him!”
“He was upright, true, garnering respect, but he did not shower the disciple in praise, instead giving him two slaps, ha-ha-ha…”
“Why?” It totally baffled Murong Xue.
Zhuo Fan snickered, “That’s the same reaction the disciple had. He helped people, for neither profit nor fame, so where did he do wrong? His master replied that after the law was placed, people could earn a fortune for redeeming prisoners of war and fame along with respect of others. But what about those that refused the reward?
“It takes money to redeem prisoners of war, but when you ask for a reward, it may seem like your honor and decency is being questioned. Saving people from misery has nothing to do with honor or decency. And by not being rewarded for the hard work, who will still do it? Just like the man who redeemed without reward, thinking he was doing good. When in fact, when people see him as an example, who would go back to redeem prisoners? Losing money and the chance of fame is a lose-lose deal. This leads to no prisoners being bought back, living the rest of their lives in misery and torment. So then, is such an act righteous or evil?”
Stunned speechless, Murong Xue was lost for words.
“The righteousness you hold dear may not be in the people’s benefit. The evil you believe may also not be in detriment to life.”
Whoosh~
His hand shone and revealed white paper between the two. Zhuo Fan grinned, “Like this paper, I see my side as righteous and you see yours as righteous, but who is to say which is right, which is clearer?”
Ugh!
Murong Xue’s heart sank.
Zhuo Fan laughed, dangling the paper, “In the end, what we choose isn’t right or wrong, but what we want to see or face. Once you see what others want to do, we just show it to them. Just like in the story, the goal is to redeem prisoners and save them from suffering. It’s not to show off your moral values and pointless theatrics that are more of a hindrance then help, ha-ha-ha…”
“But, how are we to see what we want?”
“By following the trend.”
Zhuo Fan grinned, “Human nature is selfish, you can’t deny it. The heart has demons, something else you can’t deny. This, however, does not mean such a person isn’t capable of virtue. Just like that law, sending everyone to redeem prisoners, making them do good while also fulfilling their desire for fame and fortune. This is the trend, what everyone yearns for. It’s totally natural for a good man to be selfish. The righteous one holds isn’t to purge one’s demons, but embracing them instead, for righteous and demonic may not be in such contradictions to begin with.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1145 - 1145, Answer
chapters.content:
Chapter 1145, Answer
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Murong Xue gave him a long look and a nod, “In other words, anything is allowed, be it good or evil, as long as it follows a good trend?”
“Going by the upright and honorable miss Murong, that is your wish.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Just like another tale. A thief entered a rich house to steal, only to find the owner deathly wounded and called for help, leading to his capture. But at the trial, he was released. The verdict read ‘I would rather have thieves saving lives, then our world turned into a living hell, with none lending a hand.’
“This is also a trend. Reason dictates that releasing a thief was against the law, but it gives birth to a trend, making life precious, far more precious than anything in the world. Like so, it would lead to the belief that even if one steals, he would do not harm. Those who harmed would be punished severely while those who didn’t will have lighter sentences. It’s clearly his own evil machination, yet the trend made it honorable by saving lives as result. Thus, evil is evil, stealing is stealing, fighting is fighting, yet there would no longer be harmed people. Not for others, but for oneself.”
Murong Xue nodded numbly, her heart changing as she discovered a new way of looking at things.
Zhuo Fan chuckled, turning to the tide of people, “Returning to Yunhai, he took the blame to secure western lands’ safety, an act both honorable and admirable. But after that, Baili Jingwei’s plan bears fruit.”
“His plan?”
“Making a crack in western lands.”
Zhuo Fan spoke, “Yunhai’s development was too fast this past century, gaining too much attention from the Double Dragon Manor, still holding the last word in the western lands. This is similar to the Luo clan’s beginning. I went for quick growth then because I believed to lord over the rest in quick succession. But the Luo Alliance is going even faster while lacking the ability to overcome others. As it is, it only lacks some heavyweights and it would replace Double Dragon Manor. In short, it only needs time.
“Seizing the boss’ seat has to be done fast, to minimize the danger. When I brought up the Luo clan, I played hard and fast, keeping it in the shadows, out of prying eyes. While the Luo Alliance’s intent had not just been found out, but decades in advance. While other factors played a role, Double Dragon Manor aren’t open with their hostility, but it is there and growing. When Danqing Shen came and in the prince matter, Double Dragon Manor wanted to cut the Luo Alliance down to size, to crack it. A gap Baili Jingwei is sure to use to slip right in.”
Murong Xue squinted, “You mean Baili Jingwei isn’t starting a war with western lands, but wants to drive a wedge?”
“In war, the four lands unite and there’s also Devil Palace hiding in the central area. He’ll never do it.”
Zhuo Fan continued, “So he can only play in skirmishes, making a gap in western lands; the hostility between the Luo Alliance and Double Dragon Manor. This had yet to be nuanced until now, but today it has been cemented and would lead to a huge crack in western lands’ defenses. It’s plain to see what influence the Luo Alliance has in western lands. Yunhai’s fate is bound to raise discontent in the hearts of not just the Luo Alliance, but many other factions in western lands.
“Double Dragon Manor is the big leader of western lands. He can lash out at the little guy all he wants, so long as they are in their house. While outside, he has to protect him; it’s his job. It’s public knowledge the Luo Alliance suffered for nothing and now Yunhai would suffer a fate he could not escape by taking all the blame. In this time of peril, Double Dragon Manor gave not a token of help, throwing the little guy to the wolves. What will the other little guys think? They’ll be disappointed. The Luo Alliance was threatening Double Dragon Manor, but at least play your role, easing the other little guys’ hearts. That’s why I wonder just how these old coots got to lead western lands.”
Murong Xue’s face twitched, “The Exalted had towered over western lands for thousands of years as men of virtue and honor, unlike the devious and twisted guy you are.”
“Even if honorable, they have their own demons and desires, lust for fame and fortune. How could they just forget their duty just because they find Luo Alliance an eyesore?”
“True, the older the senior, the unsteadier the heart.” Murong Xue sighed.
Zhuo Fan nodded then shook his head, “Though this isn’t half bad either. At the very least they talked it out with the other lands and didn’t stone the Luo clan where it stood. This showed they knew good from bad and greed had yet to cloud their judgment, just a mere omission. That’s already kindness from a leader. If it were me…”
“What?”
“The Luo clan would’ve long since been ashes.” Zhuo Fan said.
Murong Xue sighed, “The Luo clan must be thankful that they have you as a steward and not an enemy. By the way, didn’t you say you have a solution? What is it?”
“Oh, mine is a little blunt, something miss Murong is sure to not like.”
“Just say it. It’s just a thought and not truly enacted either. I’m also much more tolerable now…”
“Oh, then my answer is…”
Zhuo Fan showed his evil smile, “Stirring the entire alliance to duke it out regardless of bloodshed. Who do they think I am? I’ve gone through thick and thin and they think they can chop me off like that? Bring it!”
Dong!
Murong Xue blanked out, floored by Zhuo Fan’s thuggish solution, “That’s your answer? It’s like sending everyone to die for you.”
“Ha-ha-ha, I told you that you wouldn’t like it and you said you could take it.”
Zhuo Fan said calmly, “Miss Murong, that was a joke. But my solution can handle it in one move, fighting all the way. Have you ever heard of ‘the bold fear the resolute, and the resolute fear the reckless?’ Sometimes, the scariest people around are the crazies.”
“Nothing beats your crazy. Can the Luo Alliance’s strength do it?”
“There’s no need to. They only have to look like it to scare the other. In fact, it’s no different from Baili Jingwei’s tactic.”
Zhuo Fan grinned, “Miss Murong, do you still remember our talk at the beginning?”
“Trend?”
“Yes, that.”
Zhuo Fan said, “The Luo Alliance isn’t even close to a tenth of the central area’s power, but a spark can trigger a great change. The Luo Alliance with a few allies can hold at least a third of western lands’ power. How would Double Dragon Manor handle such force? Maybe ignore it and let the central area crush it, but then what will be left of western lands? Without the Luo Alliance, even with western lands being Double Dragon Manor’s, they would earn nothing but ire.
“Could the other three lands stand still while western lands goes through a bitter war? The loss of one land means the death of all. The others are sure to disregard any honor or fame then. This is a siege they have to hold out. So my solution is to hold western lands hostage, thus all four lands, and by extension, everyone, to wage bitter war with me for my own benefit.”
“But won’t this lead to a world war like before, with heavy losses?” Murong Xue’s eyes shook, “You’re a lunatic, ignoring the consequences. Luo Yunhai is far more reasonable!”
Zhuo Fan said, “He is indeed reliable, not wanting to let his family suffer. Ha-ha-ha, miss Murong, you must’ve forgotten, that central area is in no position to fight the four lands again. That’s why Baili Jingwei could only glare at my tactic without retaliation. There’s your trend. The five lands would then have useless peace talks and the prince died for nothing.”
“You’re twisted!” Murong Xue huffed, though a smile played on her lips.
[Zhuo Fan’s plan may look insane, but the results go in the right direction. This must be where righteousness and demonic intersect.]
“If you figured it out, can’t the Luo clan as well?”
“It may not be that simple. Leng Wuchang and Zhuge Changfeng aren’t just for show, but they wouldn’t mention it…”
“Why not?”
“They’d never propose something unless absolutely certain!”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “A large deployment needs plenty of pawns. The Luo clan has too few. They don’t know how big Devil Palace is and if they would work together, nor do they know Baili Jingwei’s limit, and if they themselves can sustain such a plan. With so many unknowns, the most important is in the end their apprehension, drawing Double Dragon Manor and other lands’ leader’s fury that would burn the Luo clan to the ground at some point. This strategy would never come for those playing it safe and without resolve. The three are all excellent masterminds, but not rulers, lacking in drive.”
Murong Xue nodded, “Yeah, who else in this world would bet on victory using the entire population as a bargaining chip but a demon like you?”
“In any case, it’s good to be careful. They also lack the foundation to take such risks.” Zhuo Fan took one last look at Luo Yunhai in the distance and then vanished.
Murong Xue followed him…

chapters.title: Chapter 1146 - 1146, Last Hope
chapters.content:
Chapter 1146, Last Hope
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Luo Yunhai left with the crime of killing a central area prince on his shoulders followed by the retreat of the five million army. The four lands breathed easier, rejoicing at having avoided another bitter war. Whatever Baili Jingwei was thinking, they never wanted to wage war with him.
Be it in strength, numbers and peak experts, they lost to the central area by a clear margin. In a high level battle, last time they had Zhuo Fan leading them, so who was to match Baili Jingwei’s brains now?
The leaders’ joy and celebration was Luo clan’s sorrow.
Everyone, with Luo Yunchang and the numb Luo Sifan, sat in their chairs with worry. The three minds sighed, the venerables lowered their heads, losing their boldness.
Bam!
Li Jingtian slammed the table and jumped to his feet, “We’re going to get Clan Head back, hide for a while and the news will just blow over!”
“Bull! Did you forget who holds him? Sword Star Empire! Have you forgotten the miserable defeat to Danqing Shen? Save him? Watch out not to leave your life first, humph!”
Leng Wuchang glared back with a louder voice.
Everyone started, for Sir Leng was always respectful to the venerables. It was clear that even he took the loss hard.
Li Jingtian slammed the table again, “What then? Are we going to let Clan Head go with them and have the empire execute him? I’ve been with Clan Head in wars for a hundred years now and never so furious!”
“Elder Li, wait.”
