Zhuo Fan didn’t look affected. Hovering with pride among the darkness with a sinister grin. The demonic sword in his hand oozing darkness had its strip of blue shining a deep and cold glow.
Whoosh~
Making a radiant arc through the sky, the heavens shook as an unnatural power came from the darkness. The thunder blades still assaulted it, only this time they stalled, before sinking like rocks. The relentless attack slowed down to a trickle and then to a halt, letting the darkness swallow them.
“What’s going on?”
Baili Jingwei watched as the lightning sky was invaded by the darkness and didn’t understand, “The Patriarch’s strike was like a meteor shower, leaving his opponent worse for wear. None could defend even against a tenth of the strikes. Why then did the blades stop?”
Many others were just as puzzled. Only the wounded Ouyang Lingtian propped himself and looked with a chuckle, “Zhuo Fan is a true genius, my understanding of the Heaven Sealing Sword over the last thousand years pales compared to his short century of study.”
“Heaven Sealing Sword?”
Baili Yutian squinted at Zhuo Fan, finding it true, then mocked, “Great, I wanted to learn each of the five divine sword arts, but I’ve never seen anyone in the world mastering the other four and fight me with it. Now you used the Heaven Sealing Sword Art, blocking my Star Severing Swords. You opened my eyes. A shame you lost more than half of your control and have fallen in disadvantage in terms of world energy. Would you be able to seal my next attack? Ha-ha-ha…”
The Invincible Sword hacked with his divine sword, sending a deadly aura of power. At the same time, the thunder in the sky focused on the Sundering Sword, shining as bright as the sun.
The Invincible Sword roared and struck, “Zhuo Fan, this strike can cleave heaven. Will you be able to seal such an indomitable slash?”
Whoosh~
Following the crack of lightning, a purple sword wave flew at Zhuo Fan. Except for some darkness and the stopped thunder blades, everything broke apart to nothing. The disintegrating power marched at Zhuo Fan, wanting to erase him from this world.
“Heaven Sealing Sword Art only knows to seal. The stronger the skill the easier it is to overwhelm it. Baili Yutian has now used a strike to sever the heavens, using absolute power to break the seal. It’ll need a power many times stronger for the gentle Heaven Sealing Sword Art to seal something like that!”
Danqing Shen gasped, “And Zhuo Fan is nowhere above the old man’s. With the sky mostly lost as well, he’s at a disadvantage. He has no way of retaliating against the old monster’s Sundering Sword Art!”
Baili Jingwei snickered at the words.
[Now the punk will die.]
Zhuo Fan showed no fear against the incoming deadly blow, swinging the demonic sword in the air, the blue line on it shining softly.
Whoosh~
The dark sky moved, focusing on the sword, surging with power. The thick black energy brought thousands of sealed thunder blades onto the demonic sword, bolstering its power.
Danqing Shen’s eyes shook in amazement, “I totally forgot! He doesn’t just use Heaven Sealing Sword Art but Vaulting Sword Art as well. He might have little world energy he could use but the old monster’s sword he sealed is now at his disposal. Vaulting Sword Art harmonizes yin and yang, a mixed art. Using other’s power, Zhuo Fan can match the old monster. But Vaulting Sword Art is also a gentle skill and might not be enough to defeat the brutal Sundering Sword Art…”
“Soaring into the heavens with the sword!”
Shangguan Feixiong propped his body and looked up while smiling, “Brother Ouyang, did you ever think the four strongest swords arts would come together in one man? Ha-ha-ha, I for one didn’t even after meeting the little freak. For a man of such perception to be in the world that could comprehend four of the strongest sword arts. Especially Soaring Sword Art, looking as if it was made for him. Never in my wildest dreams would I ever conceive that the Soaring Sword Art could unleash such power in the hands of a man.”
Ouyang Lingtian nodded, looking in Shangguan Feixiong’s blazing gaze, and chuckled with hope as he returned his attention to the fight.
[The Soaring Sword Art was made for the kid. There might not be another man that can use it to such an extent…]
Rumble~
The Invincible Sword’s purple sword wave destroyed all in its path, unstoppable.
Zhuo Fan gave it a cold look, grinning and then his Qilin shone scarlet. What was even more strange was how the demonic sword’s red line was also glowing, matching Zhuo Fan’s right arm.
[Soaring Sword, Breaking Heaven!]
The purple sword wave was upon him, burning most of his black domain, but Zhuo Fan never lost his cool. His grip tightened and he slashed the sword glowing a blinding red.
Whoosh~
A red wave shot, clashing with the purple one.
Boom!
Seconds after the deadlock, the purple lightning sword wave crumbled.
Dong!
Everyone else was gobsmacked.
[The Patriarch’s strongest strike got defeated just like that? How?]
The Invincible Sword was also shaken up, confident his Sundering Sword Art had reached its peak, that the other’s Soaring Sword Art would never…
Before he could make sense of everything, the red wave passed through the thunder clouds and took all his vision.
It startled him that Zhuo Fan’s sword didn’t just break his, but struck back as well.
[No, this can’t be! He can’t break my blow and attack as well…]
Baili Yutian was unable to take it in, but reality came crashing regardless. The deadly wave made Baili Yutian gnash his teeth and slash.
[Defending comes first.]
Bam!
But even defending went beyond his predictions.
The red wave pushed back the Sundering Sword even while he used all he had. It, along with the sword, pressed into his chest armor and kept pushing him back.
Beyond shocked, he squeezed everything from his body into his arms and made the red wave slip beside the Sundering Sword and into the sky.
Boom!
The thunderstorm above sported an extra-large hole, with purple lightning flickering at the edges, unable to mend it. It was like it had some kind of power that broke Baili Yutian’s connection with the world.
Everyone was rooted in shock, even Baili Yutian.
Glancing at the far Zhuo Fan and the red glowing arm coupled with the demonic sword and for the first time, the best in the lands felt fear towards a human. His grip on his sword tightened in reflex…

chapters.title: Chapter 1168 - 1168, Defeat
chapters.content:
Chapter 1168, Defeat
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“This can’t be real!”
Baili Jingwei’s face twitched as he staggered, “The Patriarch got pushed back?! No way!”
The rest were overwhelmed as well. The Invincible Sword showed signs of losing. This had never happened before, ever.
Emperor Baili Jingshi felt drained, slumping to the ground in shock.
[If the Patriarch falls, the empire that lasted thousands of years will come crashing down!]
Danqing Shen believed Zhuo Fan could do it, but to see it actualized was another thing. His power was beyond anything they knew, and the old monster only got out alive thanks to the Sundering Sword taking the brunt.
The little monster’s understanding of the Soaring Sword Art was simply insane. The Shangguan clan had held onto the same sword for centuries, yet none could display what he could in a hundred years.
Shangguan Feiyun felt his throat dry.
[The Soaring Sword Art can do that? Why didn’t I realize?]
Only young Sanzi stood straighter, looking at Zhuo Fan’s right hand and wiping his mouth of blood.
Zhuo Fan’s understanding of the Soaring Sword Art came from his observations and insights into the Soaring Qilin’s power With Zhuo Fan using a Qilin arm to unleash the Soaring Sword Art, the power multiplied.
It went as far as beyond what the old monster could take even with his peak Sundering Sword Art.
Everyone looked tense at the fight. The Invincible Sword turned grave for once, facing his strongest adversary yet with a cold glint in his eyes.
Crack~
The snapping sounds reached his ears and Baili Yutian’s heart shook. He saw the armor on his chest sporting cracks from the Soaring Sword strike.
[Providence…]
Baili Yutian sighed.
[I hoped to finish this challenge with my past self from a hundred years ago and reach the top with dignity. But he is too powerful. I have to give everything for any chance at seeing the new world.]
Baili Yutian smirked, looking at Zhuo Fan with fire in his eyes, “Zhuo Fan, come, let’s finish this peak showdown!”
“Gladly!”
Flicking the demonic sword, Zhuo Fan shouted back. They both shone red once more, using his power to slash and unleash another deadly Soaring Sword wave at Baili Yutian.
The Invincible Sword would no longer defend, but dodge instead, using the Sundering Sword as cover.
Soaring Sword wave flitted past, grazing the Sundering Sword, yet the great power was enough to push on the cracked chest plate and spread the damage.
[The Soaring Sword Art is truly frightening, holding so much power just within its aura alone. But it’s almost time…]
The Invincible Sword turned to Zhuo Fan again after dodging, only to find him coming straight for his life right behind the sword wave, “Ha-ha-ha, the Soaring Sword Art is the strongest, but it is hardly enough to take you down. I’ll have to do it up close and personal!”
Bam!
Zhuo Fan flared scarlet and hacked. The Invincible Sword rushed to block with his sword, resulting in a loud clang as the swords collided. But under Zhuo Fan’s power, the Invincible Sword faltered, with the demonic sword pressing on the Sundering Sword and into his chest.
Crack~
The Invincible Sword’s armor got more cracks, faster and faster, covered all over in black veins and ready to crumble.
The Invincible Sword gnashed his teeth and stared at the youth just a foot from him without fear. His red face strained as he pushed, roaring and shoving Zhuo Fan back.
“Kid, you dare come close to me with such gall? Absurd! Thunderstorm!”
The Invincible Sword shouted and waved the Sundering Sword, making the sky rain down thousands of thunder swords at Zhuo Fan from all directions.
Zhuo Fan was in enemy territory, with the world’s energy here in the other’s control. He could no longer use the Heaven Sealing Sword Art to seal the strikes. In a Genesis Stage fight, each had their own domain and charging into another’s territory was the same as throwing away his advantage, the world energy he controlled. It was beyond dangerous. None would do it without utmost certainty of victory.
Zhuo Fan took such incomprehensible risk to fight Baili Yutian up close, only to find out the strike did not end his opponent, suffering retaliation instead.
Zhuo Fan was the one in dire straits now.
Baili Jingwei’s side cheered with renewed hope.
Zhuo Fan was ever calm, the demonic sword’s golden line shining bright and unleashing a scorching heat.
“Decimating Sword Art, Decimating Heaven!”
Whoosh~
He waved at the sky, sending searing waves in all directions. In moments, golden flames formed in the sky as thick firewalls put a barrier between him and the sky. The purple lightning waves landed on the flamewalls, hissing to nothing.
The Decimating Sword Art was similar to the Sundering Sword Art, both preferring raw power, but the difference was with the Decimating Sword Art being partial to some flexibility. Hard, but not brutal. By using this trait, gentleness overcame strength and burned the incoming waves of attacks to nothing.
Baili Yutian’s wide sword wave attack used with word power was stopped for moments, ample time.
Whoosh~
With the Invincible Sword isolated from the sky, Zhuo Fan had removed both of their ties to the world power and now flashed in Baili Yutian’s face once more, his arm flaring scarlet and using Soaring Sword Art to slash at his opponent’s head.
Hum~
A scarlet glow came out of the blade’s edge, forcing Baili Yutian to gnash his teeth and block with his sword for the second time. Now though, with such a close distance, the sword wave proved even more powerful. Baili Yutian had no way of deflecting it, letting the divine sword push into his chest and closer to his heart. No amount of strength helped.
The Invincible Sword’s cracked armor crumbled to pieces and the Soaring Sword’s power entered his heart, making him cough three crimson mouthfuls of blood. He shot back like a meteor, slamming hard into the ground, forcing up a cloud of dust and entrails as his force pulverized hundreds of thousands of the empire’s soldiers.
Baili Jingwei’s group was quick, ducking out of the shockwave, with Danqing Shen’s group doing their best to protect the convicts.
Once dust settled, Zhuo Fan hovered above, but the purple tinged sky was no more. It was a testament to the Invincible Sword losing control, or better yet, the man himself was…
Baili Jingwei’s eyes shook, looking at the dozens of miles big crater with dead eyes, “How could the Patriarch just… lose?”
“Baili Yutian is dead, we won!”
Seeing no thunder in the sky, Zither Sword King took a deep breath and roared in excitement.
Zhuo Fan’s Soaring Sword Art was too damn strong.
[Not even the Invincible Sword could take it on, for if he had even a bit of strength left, the purple lightning in the sky would’ve stayed.]
Devil Palace and the four lands’ convicts cheered as well.
[To think that the great Invincible Sword had got to see this day.]
Only the Bali Sword Kings and the empire’s soldiers slumped on the ground in disbelief.
[The Patriarch couldn’t have lost!]
Regardless of their wants and needs, the purple was gone and the empire had fallen. The invincible nation knocked down from its pedestal on high along with its invincible god.
While some rejoiced, others mourned. Along with the frantic glee there were equally opposite sorrow and lament. Zhuo Fan kept staring at the crater even now.
[The sword was strong, but only enough to damage the old man, not kill him…]
Sss~
Thunder crackled then as purple lightning spread across the sky once more.
An even greater power pressed down, taking the breath away from all onlookers.
An aged voice came from the crater, “I never thought it’d come to this. But now, Zhuo Fan…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1169 - 1169, Spirit King
chapters.content:
Chapter 1169, Spirit King
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
All shuddered at the fear they felt from the familiar voice. They turned their stiff heads at the crater, with some showing despair while others exhilaration.
[The empire lives on!]
Rumble!
Purple lightning reemerged, with the entire sky turning purple, without a single trace of darkness. Even the air itself became electrified, as purple lightning snaked everywhere.
Zhuo Fan was surrounded by purple glows in seconds, coming from everywhere.
“What’s going on here?”
Danqing Shen’s heart jumped in his throat, looking at the flickering lightning just a foot from his soaked head, “This isn’t world power, so why is the entire world coming under the old monster’s control?”
Pa!
A purple lighting strike flared next to him and flung him two dozen meters away. His face red as he coughed blood.
The rest found the hard way how the lightning could strike at any time and fear gripped their hearts.
[What the hell is going on? We clearly aren’t in the old monster’s domain, but why would it appear around us? A Genesis Stage expert should not be able to exert control to this extent. It feels like the world is at his whims and we’re its prisoners to kill at the slightest discontent.]
[This is terrifying!]
Zither Sword King and Ling Yuntian glanced at the purple lightning around with sweat all over. Baili Jingwei laughed and cupped his hands, “Patriarch is unstoppable. With the Patriarch around, the empire shall never fall, ha-ha-ha…”
“The Patriarch is unstoppable!”
“The Patriarch is unstoppable!”
…
The soldiers shouted like fanatics, throwing fists in the air. The rest were looking bleak, like they entered hell.
They knew Baili Yutian was strong, but now strength did not cut it as apt description of that monster. It went beyond the realm of human comprehension.
As the lightning danced around them, ready to send them to an early grave at any given moment. Their previous joy at victory became a crushing despair.
They were mice trapped in the old man’s cage, for him to toy with as he wished. He had stopped being a man, turning into a living god.
Who could possibly take on a god?
They turned to Zhuo Fan in the sky, holding a shred of forlorn hope. Only a demon could fight a god, its antithesis.
[Only Zhuo Fan, a demon, has the strength to do it?]
Hope flickered in the depths of their gazes as they turned to the man in the sky…
With a crumbling sound and the lightning flaring, Invincible Sword’s tough body floated out of the crater. Lightning covered him, like a thunder god. His armor was gone, there was blood on his mouth, but his eyes were sharp and his aura explosive.
Baili Jingwei’s side laughed, “The Patriarch is unstoppable…”
“Zhuo Fan, these mortals are clueless, but not you.”
Ignoring the fanatic joy below, Baili Yutian stared at Zhuo Fan with a grin.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Above Genesis is the Spirit King Stage, wielding the power of the air around us. A Genesis Stage expert only controls the power above to give him a boost in battle. A Spirit King is like a border official, able to control the entire space. Every corner is suffused with your power, for you to do anything you want with it. That’s a Spirit King!”
“Yes, I knew you’re not like these mortals and know far more than we do.”
Baili Yutian laughed, “Zhuo Fan, the day you told me there’s something above Genesis Stage, I was skeptical. Even as I saw you fight the sea demon, doubt remained. Only when I advanced and felt all the power you spoke I realized you never lied to me. Mortality through spirituality, imperial, saintly and sovereignty, it’s all real. Devil Mountain is real! That’s why I can’t wait to see everything for myself. Mere days after I broke through, I felt my body light, like there’s something pulling at me to leave.”
[What’s keeping you then?]
Ling Yuntian and the rest sighed, quipping in their minds. Zhuo Fan paused in thought.
[Going above Genesis you can no longer stay in the mortal domain. That’s why there’s no one above mortal stages in the mortal domain, they all left. But left where, exactly? Why haven’t I heard of any of them before?]
Zhuo Fan pondered and Baili Yutian grinned, “As it stands, I should just let go and see the new world. But I remembered our promised fight. I didn’t know of your fate, but I still waited. Also, Jingwei told me the empire is about to change. I had a refiner make me an 11th grade spiritual armor to restrain my cultivation before I’d be forced to leave.
“But to think providence brought you to me. I could fight to my heart’s content and finish it once and for all with you, ha-ha-ha…”
“Why didn’t you go all out just now?”
Zhuo Fan taunted, “Did you think Genesis Stage was enough to deal with me, perhaps?”
Baili Yutian nodded, “Zhuo Fan, you know about the Spirit King Stage and thus must know about its power. Fighting as I am would be like taking it out on you while taking out all the fun from the fight. But I never imagined you’d go beyond this level after a hundred years. That sword would’ve crippled the past me. A shame the 11th grade spiritual armor broke and my power is let loose. In two hours I’ll be forced to leave…”
Baili Yutian glanced at the wide sky.
Outside of the ever present lightning, there was a shimmering light growing as it fell, like a tunnel for him to ascend and leave this world behind.
“I wanted to have a blast fighting you some more. What a shame I’m running out of time and you out of power. As a fellow warrior, I shall send you off myself, out of respect!”
Baili Yutian eased a breath and raised a hand. The air grew heavy and the lightning around Zhuo Fan focused on him, “I’ll be honored to fulfill your final wish.”
Boom!
Zhuo Fan slashed his demonic sword, sending golden flames around to obliterate the lightning, “You’re too kind, Invincible Sword, but that should be my line. I’ll be sure to take your head before the call pulls you away. Allow me to fulfill any of your last wishes.”
“Ha-ha-ha, Zhuo Fan, you’re really something. Do you really think you have a chance?” Baili Yutian mocked, “Your sword is strong, but can no longer hurt me for everything around us is under my control. There’s no hope for you. That’s why I didn’t want to fight you as a Spirit King Stage cultivator, it’s boring.”
Whoosh!
A scarlet sword wave flew at Baili Yutian’s neck in reply, unleashed by Zhuo Fan with all his power.
The Invincible Sword wasn’t as hard-pressed, merely extending two fingers to cross them.
Under the frightened eyes of many, the air warped and Zhuo Fan’s attack got deviated by a meter from Baili Yutian, letting it explode somewhere behind.
Baili Yutian stood there with a tranquil expression, “This is my world and you can no longer touch me.”
Danqing Shen’s side lamented, hanging their heads and feeling disgruntled.
[Why? Why is it that a man appeared that can take the Invincible Sword down, but the monster had to advance as well?]
[Now everyone will die, all plans wasted.]
All their efforts had been in vain.
[The Invincible Sword really is invincible.]
Baili Jingwei’s side had a victorious smile and stuck out their chests. None noticed that Zhuo Fan wore a sinister smile as well.
He sometimes touched his covered eyes with a calm expression.
[I should go all-out as well, ha-ha-ha…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1170 - 1170, Unsealed
chapters.content:
Chapter 1170, Unsealed
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Thunder Cage!”
Baili Yutian raised his hand in Zhuo Fan’s direction and grabbed at air, “A shame I’ll be the one going to Devil Mountain. Zhuo Fan, farewell forever.”
Rumble!
Thunder rumbled, like the space was cracking as the lightning around Zhuo Fan boxed him in like a claw from all directions. Purple lightning was prevalent everywhere he looked, blocking any means of escape.
Zhuo Fan was fated to be blasted into thousands of pieces.
Watching their only hope about to shatter, the rest sighed. Luo Yunchang teared up as she cried, “Zhuo Fan!”
“Master!”
“Big brother Zhuo!”
“Steward Zhuo!”
All of the Luo clan was worried, yet powerless to do anything more than shout.
Qiao’er and Gu Santong were his children, and the only ones calm. They just watched, like it was all just a show.
Ouyang Lingtian gave them an odd look, “Aren’t you the least bit worried your father’s about to die?”
“Why should we be? You call that dying when dad didn’t even go all out?” Gu Santong scoffed, “Wait until dad’s out of tricks and can’t do anything. That’s where the real danger is. Until then, this is nothing, he-he-he…”
Ouyang Lingtian gave him a long and dull look, “Your dad didn’t go all out yet? He used all of the four sword arts and even that wasn’t enough to deal with Baili Yutian, now a stage above him, a Spirit King. How can he still have a way of pulling off a win in this desperate situation? “
“Ice King, you just don’t know our dad!”
Qiao’er teased, “Dad only focused on the sword for the last hundred years, but it’s not like he didn’t beat others before that. You know most of dad’s power is in his eyes. Anything short of that means going easy.”
[Eyes?]
Ouyang Lingtian’s side blinked, turning to the white figure in the sky and found him to be unphased from all the deadly lightning crackling around. He gave a casual pull at the eye cover and showed eyes encased in ice, along with a strange mark on his forehead.
[I understand the Heaven Sealing Sword Art fully and know how to use sealing. The eyes shouldn’t lash out again, ha-ha-ha…]
Zhuo Fan made a sign and brought two fingers to his forehead.
Hum~
The mark on Zhuo Fan’s forehead glowed an intense blue as it faded slowly from his skin.
As its power disappeared, the frost on his eyes melted. Zhuo Fan became excited, eagerly anticipating the result.
Rumble~
The lightning was right next to him now. Baili Yutian flicked his hand and the area crackled hard. Zhuo Fan was surrounded by a flood of lightning, the purple color so blinding and the power terrifying. As it spread, everything in its path died.
“Zhuo Fan!” Luo Yunchang wailed, with the rest sighing. Bali Yuyu hung her head forlorn.
[I should’ve stopped you from meeting the Patriarch, but now…]
Ouyang Lingtian made a weird face, turning to Gu Santong.
[Where’s your dad? Dead?]
The two still looked undisturbed, puzzling the other Dharma Kings.
Baili Yutian sighed at the white glow becoming stronger and bigger, “A poor ending, but at least I got my pass for Devil Mountain. Now I can go without qualms, ha-ha-ha…”
“Aren’t you afraid I’ll be laying waste to your empire if you go?” A wild laughter came.
Baili Yutian’s heart jumped, turning to where the lightning was most focused.
Rumble~
A crackle far louder and terrible than the purple lightning’s covered the sky as black thunderflames exploded into existence. The purple lightning put up no resistance in its path, revealing a most familiar figure, unaffected by the encroaching black flames.
But now his eyes were opened, the right eye glowed golden with four rings while the left eye glowed faintly blue with sparks around the sucking abyss of flames.
Baili Yutian gasped, “Why are you not dead?”
“I told you, I should be the one to fulfill your will. How could I die before that?” Zhuo Fan smirked.
Baili Yutian stared at him hard, then chuckled, “Humph, it won’t change anything regardless. You are in the Genesis Stage and can’t do anything to me. I’m truly invincible now. I don’t know how you lived through that, but you can’t harm me. You can survive every time you want, but you’ll never win!”
Zhuo Fan gave a deep smile in reply.
[True, against a Spirit King, the Genesis Stage is worlds below.]
Baili Jingwei snickered, filled with disdain.
[You got out alive, but the Patriarch’s the ultimate existence of this world, what could you possibly do? Humph…]
Baili Yutian’s eyes shone and sent a palm attack, “A Sword King’s Lashing! Let’s see you deal with this!”
Whoosh~
The whole sky crackled and was littered with purple sword waves as they rained down on Zhuo Fan. Unlike the last time, not only the range was way bigger, but the power had multiplied as well, as did their numbers. The thick hail of energy blades came down on Zhuo Fan, to skewer him and bury him. Invincible Sword watched for anything he might pull this time.
It was quite baffling how Zhuo Fan just stood there, not budging an inch…
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan flickered out of sight, the wide attack hitting nothing.
“Where’d he go?” Baili Yutian started.
Whoosh!
A fierce gale blew out just then from his side.
Baili Yutian flinched and slashed with Sundering Sword in reflex.
Bam!
With a scarlet glow and the familiar ruthless power coming into his heart, Baili Yutian’s hands went soft as he got flung into the air. His blood was boiling as he stopped in the air, finding Zhuo Fan in his previous position, with his right eye shining in one golden halo.
“The space is under my control, how did you get next to me? That’s impossible!”
“Thunderflame Void Annihilation!”
Zhuo Fan’s reply was a quirky smile, his right eye shining in two golden rings while his left flashed with the black thunderflame.
Whoosh~
A broken beam of black flames shot from Zhuo Fan’s eyes and at Baili Yutian. Thanks to Zhuo Fan’s boost in power, his eyes grew stronger as well, to a terrifying degree.
Even Baili Yutian, a fresh Spirit King was slow to react against the thunderflame empowered Void Annihilation as it came for his life.
Baili Yutian could only use the ability of a Spirit King, extending his fingers to warp space in front of the attack and deflect it.
It didn’t help.
Bam!
The attack hadn’t deviated even an inch, the black beam of flames shooting for the Invincible Sword still. As Void Annihilation was the bane of any spatial skills, no spatial attack could affect it. The move wouldn’t be so named otherwise.
The thunderflame was also capable of burning anything in existence.
The Invincible Sword ended up a powerless Spirit King before this kind of attack, forced back despite his overwhelming power.
The Divine Eye of the Void was a Sovereign’s ultimate skill as well. There was hardly any skill more qualified in the spatial field in the whole Sacred Domain…

chapters.title: Chapter 1171 - 1171, Unleashed Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 1171, Unleashed Power
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Baili Yutian’s eyes twitched at the incoming beam of black flames, his heart shaking. It went beyond his comprehension how he was in a stage beyond any mortal’s grasp yet a punk like Zhuo Fan defeated him.
So he stopped trying to make sense of it all, calming himself down and raised the Sundering Sword out of instinct.
Bam!
The Invincible Sword’s hands trembled, and he got sent flying from the mighty attack, only coming to a stop a mile away. The black flames spread over the blade, and onto his shaking hands as well.
Staring hard at the snickering figure, Baili Yutian turned grave. He had just used his advantage as Spirit King yet it still proved useless against such an attack. It showed the possibility of losing this fight, against some Genesis Stage brat that could break his stage advantage.
The audience was speechless, with Baili Jingwei’s group dumbstruck. They couldn’t wrap their heads around how their Patriarch, the peak existence of this world that had just gone a step higher, was pushed back.
[What the hell is Zhuo Fan?]
“Darkness comes and Sword Star wanes~”
Someone from the Devil Palace began and it turned into an endless flood as all disciples cheered, singing the song that had spread throughout the lands.
More and more sang, stronger and stronger, the fervor igniting their spirits.
He was the Dark Demon Lord, their Devil Palace Lord, and he was going to crush the undefeated nation!
The fanatic shouting raged in the others’ ears. Baili Jingwei heard it too, his face bleak as he gnashed his teeth. The soldiers hesitated, not knowing what to do.
[It can’t be true. The Patriarch losing, the empire falling?]
Hum~
As doubt spread through the battlefield, a barrier was placed around Baili Jingshi, Baili Jingwei, and their Sword Kings.
The Invincible Sword looked at his divine sword wrapped in black flames and felt fear. It soon turned into raging battle lust, flicking those flames off.
He exploded with power, reaching every corner of the world and making it tremble. The deadly aura descended like the end of day was upon them.
“Divine Eye of the Void’s 5th stage, Void Wall!”
Knowing what was happening, Zhuo Fan’s right eye displayed five halos. The Dharma Kings and the Sword Kings on the scaffold, were covered in seven invisible barriers.
Zhuo Fan raised his hand and traced along the demonic sword, making every inch he passed release black thunderflames, bolstering the demonic sword’s power.
Whoosh~
He flicked it at the man in front with an evil smile, though his eyes were craving battle still, his power at its peak.
Ugh!
[What are they doing this time?]
All the soldiers felt the space tremble with each barrier set in place, then looked at Baili Jingwei’s group and at the scaffold with tears in their eyes.
[Dude, you’re both setting up for some absurd move, I get it, and you protected your main guys. B-but, what about us?]
[We’re just small fries, so we can just die, is that it? This is discrimination, I tell you, discrimination!]
[The Dark Demon Lord not included us nobodies, since we’re enemies, but the Patriarch, you too? What’s worse, you’re the one who started this damn showdown…]
All were downcast and despairing at how easily they were cast aside. With no choice, they fled every which way.
[Run!]
Rumble!
They only raised a leg when suddenly the sky, earth, air, everything, exploded with lightning. It disintegrated everything, the soldiers, the rocks, the remaining ten million soldiers, all were gone just like that.
The Invincible Sword shouted as he slashed at Zhuo Fan, the world becoming sword waves as they came at Zhuo Fan. Such a move was enough to do in a Sword King from the pressure and errant power alone.
All the lucky survivors witnessed such godly power from the safety of their barrier.
[Is this the fully unleashed power of a Spirit King? It’s dreadful! It’s like fighting the world itself. He controls the air and everything in it. Who could ever hope to overcome all that power?]
[That’s why they set up barriers. It’s the only reason we can witness such might without turning to ashes as well.]
Having front row seats at the untold destruction, everyone felt a chill down their backs. They gasped at their fortune of being important enough to not get kicked to the curb.
Some looked worried at Zhuo Fan. How was he going to face off against the world that had now turned on him?
It was beyond merely sending waves of soldiers like they did with the Invincible Sword back in the last war.
But against such incredible danger, Zhuo Fan smiled.
[Even with the world under Baili Yutian’s control, he won’t ever get to control my surroundings!]
Zhuo Fan huffed, his right eye displayed four golden rings and his left flickered with thunder and fire.
“Divine Eye of the Void’s 4th stage, Thunderflame Space Crusher!”
Boom!
The space around him hummed as black thunderflames darkened it, turning it into Zhuo Fan’s dark world.
He was no Spirit King, unable to control the air and space around him, but this small area answered to him and him alone.
Crack~
The violent purple thunder blades shot for Zhuo Fan, but all were erased upon entering the black domain.
Baili Yutian narrowed his eyes, finding the mass attack useless, so he switched tactics. He gathered his power and slashed hard, opting for a focused strike to break the enemy’s defense.
Whoosh~
A purple wave once again streaked the sky, turning three hundred meters big as it got charged with the lightning it crossed along its path, looking to destroy the unstoppable domain Zhuo Fan erected.
Zhuo Fan’s Soaring Sword Art wasn’t any weaker though.
His right hand flared and slashed hard with the power of a Qilin.
Whoosh~
A black wave shot, inspiring dread and death as it met the Invincible Sword’s attack.
Rumble!
The two waves exploded with noise and power. The pressure filled the world with purple lightning and black flames, sent everywhere like a meteor shower, destroying the already ruined place even more.
Those behind the barrier watched this incredible showdown between mammoths. Glancing at the destruction around, they all felt their blood run cold.
[Curses, their clash only gets more unbelievable and world-ending!]
The shock had yet to subside, with Zhuo Fan wielding the demonic sword rushing at Baili Yutian. His eyes maintained the Thunderflame Space Crusher, but instead of making it focus on himself, he made it turn into a mile-long black dragon. He stood on its head, charging with all his fury.
With the space under Baili Yutian’s control, lightning struck him constantly from all over, to no avail.
Against the mighty black dragon, all the thunder blades fizzled out as he charged to take down the head.
Baili Yutian’s heart shook, turning grave at Zhuo Fan’s bravery.
He now noticed that even with all his power, while he controlled the fate of everyone in his area, only Zhuo Fan was immune, a monster among monsters, running amok.
Baili Yutian steeled his heart and relinquished control of space around, focusing all the power of the world…

chapters.title: Chapter 1172 - 1172, Reaching the Summit
chapters.content:
Chapter 1172, Reaching the Summit
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Sss~
The power rose sharply as it was focused. Baili Yutian pointed his sword, with all the purple lightning focused on its edge. In practically an instant, endless amounts of purple lightning focused on him, bringing about a frightening display of raw power.
With a sharp cry, the amassed purple lightning turned into a three hundred meter huge bird carrying Baili Yutian and the divine sword. Thanks to all that unimaginable power crammed in there, the huge bird was blinding in its glow, like the sun.
Bam!
Zhuo Fan and Baili Yutian’s blades once again met, only this clash did not resume at their own power as they had further amplified their strength through different means to new heights.
Zhuo Fan’s Divine Eye of the Void and apocalyptic thunderflame tripled his power. While Baili Yutian used everything at his disposal, his control of the world included, to focus the lightning into a bird, a ten fold increase.
Zhuo Fan could handle a third of the Invincible Sword’s strength with it being spread out. But now, with all that wild power concentrated, Zhuo Fan had no chance against it.
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan got flung two miles along with his black dragon of thunderflame. The Invincible Sword shuddered and fell back half a mile.
As they came to a halt, they charged again with their blades.
The skies thrummed with their booming attacks as a black dragon and purple lightning bird kept colliding all over the place. In but moments, their blades screeched a hundred times, shuddering the world around them.
The audience, that was still alive, kept getting more shocked.
The two of them had the literal power at their fingertips to kill millions of soldiers. They were weapons of mass destruction in and of themselves.
[No human should hold so much power! No wonder the world can’t have both of them!]
The two spared no effort in securing victory.
At last, the sounds of their clashes, strong enough to raise the dead, ceased with the smash of one of them into the ground, leaving a crater dozens of miles wide.
Danqing Shen’s group panicked while Baili Jingwei’s group lit up. It was Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan rose from the deep rubble he was buried under and spat blood. He was gasping and weary.
Shriek~
The purple lightning bird hovered above his head. The Invincible Sword sat on the bird’s head, gazing at his strongest opponent of his life, weary as well, but his eyes were smiling, “Zhuo Fan, you lost! No matter how strong your Soaring Sword Art is, you’re stuck at the Genesis Stage, limited by Yuan Qi and unable to match a Spirit King like me. Going all out against me so many times was your mistake!”
“Humph, aren’t you the same?”
Zhuo Fan huffed, “Spirit King Stage can control the power of space and air, but doesn’t enjoy such a great increase of his own strength. Old man, focusing your control into a limited space only drew faster on your Yuan Qi reserves, faster than even me. Not to mention, how long can your aged body last taking on so much power? I bet you can hardly move.”
Baili Yutian grinned, his body swaying, with a popping sound coming from his bones, but his eyes were still focused on the fight, “Why the hell would you care? I’m standing while you’ve fallen!”
The Invincible Sword glanced at the curtain of light coming from the heavens above, his mouth forming a smile.
“Once I’m through with you, I’ll have no qualms going there, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Yutian laughed, heaving the now heavy divine sword, he was ready to end his strongest opponent.
Everyone watched tense and riveted.
Zhuo Fan showed a weird grin, “It’s too soon for you to go, ha-ha-ha…”
“Thunderflame Dragon Nest!”
Zhuo Fan plunged the demonic sword down.
A surge of black energy exploded like a tide, turning the earth black as night.
Roars upon roars came from it as it roiled like the sea. Black dragons flew into the sky, powered by the thunderflame, all aiming for Baili Yutian and his lightning bird, drowning him in blackness. Everything now took a much bleeker and darker hue.
Zhuo Fan snickered, “Invincible Sword, you shouldn’t have focused all that control of the space on yourself. Just so you know, I have a domain soul, and by relinquishing control, I can use it for myself. Now you’re in my dragon nest. Let’s see you come out now, ha-ha-ha…”
Roar~!
Thousands upon thousands of black dragons breathed fire on the lightning bird and chipped away at it, bit by bit.
Baili Yutian held a cold smile, “What can a mere domain do to me?”
Baili Yutian shook hard and the lightning bird cried out. Purple lightning flared and the dragon nest suffered an explosion as it collapsed. The bright sun once again blessed this wretched battlefield and his aged face.
Sss~
But the Invincible Sword had no time to react as a figure flashed in his face.
Ugh!
The Invincible Sword was frozen, looking down to find that his lightning bird had a thin and long hole running through it, all the way to him and through him…
The Invincible Sword looked with a stiff face at the black flames on his abdomen, while his legs were engulfed in it already, slowly eating at him.
“Invincible Sword!”
A cold voice came to his ears, “I told you my sword arts are for devouring. The dragon nest wasn’t so it could whittle you down, but to engulf your senses. With a Spirit King able to control space, I had to be on high alert all the time. Not even my domain would have escaped your range. A shame you focused it all on you and lost your advantage. So I used this chance to blindside you with an attack.”
Baili Yutian’s brow shook, looking back to find Zhuo Fan’s calm face as he wielded the black sword flickering with flames.
The Invincible Sword gripped his sword, looking at the light above, feeling unreconciled. But then he gnashed his teeth and threw the Sundering Sword, roaring, “Zhuo Fan, you win. You get to go to Devil Mountain. Take the Sundering Sword and reach the summit. Do not disgrace that sword!”
Baili Yutian sighed and closed his eyes, the flames burning him to ashes.
Feeling the purple blade trembling in his grip, mourning for its master, Zhuo Fan sighed.
[The Invincible Sword, a worthy opponent.]
Pa!
In the Sacred Domain, in a little shack, a youth sat before a chessboard, about to put a piece. His hand shook and the piece rolled among the others.
“It’s gone!”
He took a deep breath, “The Spirit King in the mortal domain is gone. What a pity. He was about to arrive at the world they always yearn for.”
The shadow at his side stood, “The Spirit King this time was off. He should’ve long since come but suppressed himself to stay for something. Might it not be the same again?”
“No, this time he’s gone for good while last time his signature was merely weakened. Someone killed him before he could come.”
“The mortal domain had two Spirit Kings?”
“No, someone jumped stages to do it!”
The man gapped, “Jumped stages? Any Spirit King birthed in such a wasted place, like the mortal domain, is a priceless talent! Yet one was killed by someone jumping stages? This hasn’t happened ever!”
“That was because for so many years he never thought of returning. Now that he wants to, none could stop him, ha-ha-ha…”
Pa!
A piece slammed on the board and the youth let out a mad laughter, chilling to the bone…

chapters.title: Chapter 1173 - 1173, I’m Back
chapters.content:
Chapter 1173, I’m Back
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“P-Patriarch…”
Baili Jingwei slumped to the ground, his feet giving in, with a look of utter despair.
The rest of the Sword Star Empire’s people were numb, while the emperor fainted.
The heart of the empire, their god, the Patriarch, the Invincible Sword – had died.
[T-this can’t be happening!]
Everyone shook their heads in disbelief, coming out of the illusion they built around the man. The Invincible Sword’s ashes scattered in the wind, while the divine sword, having been his lifelong partner for thousands of yours, now rested in Zhuo Fan’s hand.
This reality could not be denied.
Baili Jingwei closed his eyes, tears trailing down his face. The Sword Kings kneeled and slammed to the ground. Only Shangguan Feiyun, just stood there, frozen.
[Shit, I made the wrong bet!]
He believed that the Invincible Sword would help him in his goal, only to find this always undefeated man finally meet his match.
Shangguan Feiyun’s heart sank into hatred.
While some wallowed in despair, others rejoiced at a new lease of life. Baili Yutian fell, marking the decline of the Bailis. As for the convicts, they were celebrating.
[The monster Baili Yutian is gone, ha-ha-ha…]
Zither Sword King watched the sky, at the new dawn rising, welcoming it with a smile, “Darkness swallows the stars, bringing about a new dawn. I never dreamed it would come true, ha-ha-ha…”
Liu Mubai was moved to tears.
The weight of the past, the hatred of his clan, had been carried for years and years with no hope of being relieved of such burden. Now it was over, making all his toil as Sword King for a thousand years all the more worth it.
Everyone was engrossed in their own raw emotions, some of joy, some of sorrows. Zhuo Fan held the Sundering Sword and placed it in his ring.
Hum~
The demonic sword shook in request. Zhuo Fan smiled, “I know, but later. You won’t be sorry. Let’s return first.”
Ding!
The demonic sword rang as he slipped into Zhuo Fan’s body.
Zhuo Fan smiled and descended, taking away the barriers and releasing the convicts’ bonds. In an hour, they were all free.
“Palace Lord!” Wu Randong was the first to bow, filled with endless gratitude and reverence. The other Devil Palace disciples followed suit, looking at Zhuo Fan like he was the shiniest jewel. But fear remained still, of disturbing this great man, never daring to meet his gaze.
Ignoring their excitement, Zhuo Fan spoke to Wu Randong, “All obstacles are removed now. Finish the imperial capital project within the month!”
“Yes, sir!” Wu Randong bowed.
Ling Yuntian brought the four lands’ captives, with a bow, “Thank you, Sir Zhuo, for your timely rescue. We’d have perished for sure.”
“It’s fine, since I didn’t come for you. It was meant for the empire and I to fight. He stood in my way and I brushed him aside, nothing more, nothing less. It was nothing personal.” Zhuo Fan shook his head.
Ling Yuntian nodded, “Yes, Sir Zhuo has always been walking alone, above the disputes of the lands. You never had anything against the empire. It’s only that our goals aligned, that we faced the same enemy. But, Sir Zhuo, you should’ve told us of your plans against the empire and we would’ve worked together to make it easier. Why did you insist on having us suffer like this?”
“You have the nerve to ask me that? You had Baili Yutian on the ropes a hundred years ago, so why did you stop?”
“Uh…” Ling Yuntian was lost for words.
Zhuo Fan said, “Sect Leader Ling, it’s not that I don’t trust you. What I don’t trust is human nature. Central area had pushed you into a corner, making me your Grand Marshal. After the lands’ war, what use would my word have? The same applies now. If not for the empire waging war with the lands, you’d have never even thought of listening to my orders. Baili Jingwei’s spy aside, people only ever group up to repel outsiders, right?”
Ugh!
Ling Yuntian gave a nervous chuckle, then he rushed to change topics, “Uh, Sir Zhuo, speaking of the spies… Curse you, Bu Xingyun, I’ll have your body scattered in the wind…”
Ling Yuntian rushed to the spies, shouting and cursing, looking smug like he had just earned a hard victory.
Bu Xingyun’s side panicked and fled, but Ling Yuntian’s group caught them and started laying it on them hard and fast.
Zhuo Fan sneered.
[Those geezers…]
“Big brother Zhuo!”
“Master!”
Luo Yunhai and his wife came with the Luo clan, all excited. Zhuo Fan smiled and cupped his hands, “I ask that you forgive me for the trouble I…”
“Shove it where the sun doesn’t shine!”
A raging voice echoed as a charming figure stormed over and jabbed a finger in his chest, “You rotten bastard, where have you been all these years, not so much as sending a hello for a hundred years? You were better off staying dead. You could’ve at least let us know you were safe. Everyone was worried sick…”
Zhuo Fan staggered under the assault, able to face Invincible Sword’s mighty aura, yet couldn’t take the pokes from a pretty lady. All he could do was shrug, “Young miss, I did want to let you know, but I’ve always been busy and didn’t want to involve you. I feared…”
“So that makes it fine to blow us off? Didn’t we get dragged into it anyway? Whatever comes, it’ll come, regardless where you are. What doesn’t, won’t, but you still aren’t there either. What’s there to fear…”
Luo Yunchang kept yelling and taking it up on him for all those years, only to finish in tears and catch him in a strong hug, leaning her head on his chest. Her eyes were red as she sniffed, “Answer me and don’t go. I told you, no matter what it is, we’ll do it together. Please don’t leave, alright?”
Zhuo Fan froze, looking down at her fair face and shook his head as he didn’t know what to do with his hands.
“Uh, young miss…”
“Hand down!”
Luo Yunchang had his hand placed on her waist, then lay happily on his chest, smiling and crying.
Zhuo Fan scratched his nose, looking at the others who were happy staying out of it, looking for an excuse to get away.
“Uh, Palace Lord, I’ll gather the men and start working!”
“What’s the hurry? I just rescued them. Can’t they relax for a few days? Hey…”
Zhuo Fan saw Wu Randong run off. Zhuo Fan looked down at the young miss glued to him and sighed, “Young miss, I need to look for my wife.”
Luo Yunchang shook, but held on still. She spoke after a pause, “It’s fine if you go after miss Qingcheng, I won’t stop you. But you can’t stop my feelings for you either!”
“Young miss…”
“You don’t have to say it.”
Luo Yunchang stood straight and looked him in the eye with a smile, “I told you, I won’t stop you and neither can you stop me. We’re a family. Let’s go back, Steward Zhuo. Your seat has always been saved for you. No matter what you do, we’d do it together, even finding miss Qingcheng. We’ll always be by your side, so long as you don’t throw us away.”
The Luo clan nodded, showing their sincerity.
Zhuo Fan felt warm at their intention and sighed a nod, “If you so wish. The Luo clan’s head steward has returned!”
They all cheered and jumped in joy. But seeing them like this, Zhuo Fan might be smiling, but his eyes showed sadness.
[Meeting only to part. Our days together will be short. The path of ascension is almost done.]
“Stop, don’t touch him! If you have something with him, take it up with me!”
A shout drew Zhuo Fan’s attention. He frowned and looked over with a start. Nodding, he walked over…

chapters.title: Chapter 1174 - 1174, To the Winner the Spoils
chapters.content:
Chapter 1174, To the Winner the Spoils
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Bam!
A convict kicked a brawny man to the ground, mocking, “Ha-ha-ha, so this is what the mighty Sword King has come to, ha-ha-ha…”
“Stop! We surrendered. What are you trying to do?” Bali Yuyu glared at them, gnashing her teeth.
The youth sneered, giving her a most unbecoming leer, “What, you ask? Weren’t the Sword Kings always acting so high and mighty? With the Invincible Sword dead, any kind of lashing out won’t do you any good. Surrendering is your only hope at living, so play along, or else…”
“Or else what?”
A steel grip had twisted his wrist. The man whipped his head with a scowl, only to pale hard, “Marshal Zhuo, we’ve got all the prisoners sorted out for you to handle.”
Bali Yuyu shook, observing the man she had been daydreaming about day and night for the past century, and her heart raced.
Zhuo Fan sneered, “You actually know they’re my prisoners? Others who didn’t might think it was you who got them. You must be so amazing taking down the central area’s Sword Kings.”
“I’d never, Marshal Zhuo, you’re our Grand Marshal of the four lands just as it was a hundred years ago. We’re doing it all for you!”
“Humph, what a pretentious excuse. You never did anything for me a hundred years ago, and now that I got the central area, you wanted to step in?”
Zhuo Fan flung the man into the air, vanishing in the distance, “I’m fine without it.”
The rest acted oblivious, lowering their heads and clearing the area.
Ignoring the profiteers, Zhuo Fan turned to Bali Yuyu who never took her eyes off him. He snapped his fingers and her bounds came undone, “I saw how you never got a wound on you when you fought Qiao’er. How did those ants even catch you?”
“I sealed my own cultivation.”
“You did?”
“Yes, you’ve won and we lost. Those bastards used brother Lei to threaten me, so what could I do? Or did you expect me to be as fearless as the Patriarch and have you cut me down?” Bali Yuyu glared.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “My fight with him has been in the works for a century, an honorable duel bearing no grudge from either party. Along the way I took the empire for my own purposes, still nothing personal. Now that the empire is mine, I want nothing else. You’re free to go.”
“Free?”
Bali Yuyu started, “You’re letting us go free? What if we’ll take revenge?”
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Can you really, with just that much strength? Don’t make me laugh.”
“Not now, but who’s to say later…”
“Neither later.”
Zhuo Fan cut her off, “Since I overcame all of you, I hold no fear for the future. If, by some miracle, you do succeed, that proves I’ve been idle and deserve to die. A real man isn’t afraid of any challenge. Moreover, I’m a challenger myself, challenging myself for my own goals is all the more reason I can’t let others catch up to me. Or I wouldn’t have needed him to step in and would’ve died at your hands instead.”
Bali Yuyu’s eyes grew hazy, “You’re just like Patriarch, no, stronger. Patriarch always yearned for the top, but feared being overtaken. You don’t have such fear, and that’s why you won.”
“You flatter me. What I fear is something you can never reach.”
Zhuo Fan waved, walking away, “Take them and go. We’ve had a nice run once, and this is my thanks for it.”
Bali Yuyu gave him a long look then pointed at the others to remove their binds. A sudden roar then shook the heavens as someone shot for Zhuo Fan, “Zhuo Fan!”
“What now?”
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan clutched the neck of the attacker, Baili Jingtian.
“Revenge for the Invincible Sword, is that it? I told you that none of you have it in you. But since you challenged me, I’ll answer with the same coin.”
Zhuo Fan gripped harder, cutting his breath, “I’m a man of principles and can overlook the boiling hatred you all nurture, but the moment you try anything, you have to own up to your actions!”
“Wait!”
Baili Yulei shouted and rushed over, pleading, “Sir Zhuo, please let the Crown Prince go. If you must kill him, take me instead!”
Zhuo Fan squinted, “Baili Yulei, we were on better terms hundred years ago. Though it was to help another and thus you helped me, I still consider it a favor. But what is your deal with the Crown Prince, to go so far?”
“It’s about that time a hundred years ago as well. He knows I had let you go yet never revealed it. Holding his word for a hundred years, he earned my friendship.”
“Didn’t you stop to think that maybe he had his reasons?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, “Your Highness, you’re no saint, I see, knowing to use gratitude to your own means.”
Baili Jingtian said, “As the Crown Prince, I’ve learned how to rule. Gratitude has nothing to do with it, just business. But yes, when you had your black flames on me, Thunder Sword King did save my life. He did right by cutting my arm off. I had the same thought but couldn’t do it because that would mean everything would be over, my throne would no longer be mine. Have you ever heard of a cripple sitting on the throne in humanity’s long history? So Thunder Sword King had solved my crisis and my life.
“But later, I helped them hide their connection with you, not really thinking over the implications. But without an arm, I was fated to be alone, so why then insist on making an enemy out of a Sword King? It’s all to protect myself due to what happened, and I had to keep it to myself.”
“See? He had it all figured out and didn’t do it for you. I bet you looked after him these years so you should be square.” Zhuo Fan snickered.
Baili Yulei’s brow shook, yet his voice was firm, “Regardless, I still feel friendship for him keeping it a secret for so long and ask that you stay your hand.”
“Sure, since you felt friendship for him, I felt the same for you. But only this once. At least wait until you have the strength before coming at me.”
Zhuo Fan smirked and let go, walking off, “A month later, I’ll be leaving this world, to where your Patriarch yearned to go. Anyone is welcome to come since I lack manpower, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Jingtian squinted, “What’s his angle? Trying to get us on his side after killing the Patriarch? As if!”
“It’s hard to tell.”
With her heart already made up, Bali Yuyu muttered, “The Patriarch and Zhuo Fan fought an honorable battle with their lives on the line. When the Patriarch died, he held no hatred. Among cultivators, what grudges could there be among challengers? Your Highness, you’ll never grow strong without at least this much aspiration. Look at yourself. After a hundred years, you couldn’t even defeat the likes of Ye Lin and Ouyang Changqing, the same ones you once beat. A missing arm shouldn’t have affected your strength as much. Think back at what you’ve been doing this past century.”
The only thing that came to Baili Jingtian’s mind was hate.
He hated Zhuo Fan for taking his arm, losing his status, and everyone for mocking his deficiency. The hatred had taken over his mind to such extent he almost let the Sundering Sword Art waste away…
Baili Jingtian sighed long and hard, closing his eyes.
The first step to become stronger and defeat the man he hated all his life was to let go of the hate and set his eyes on the top.
Bali Yuyu glanced over and showed a sneaky smile.
[Let us all go then, to the world of the strong that the Patriarch wanted to see. At the very least, we’ll ease his spirit, right? Ha-ha-ha…]
[You just want to be at the kid’s side!]
Baili Yulei snapped his eyes on her, shaking his head…
In another part, following the ruckus, Baili Jingshi and Baili Jingwei were shoved and sworn at. Bu Xingyun and the other spies were beaten black and blue.
Luo Yunhai’s brow shook, “They are still the Prime Minister and emperor. Even as captives, why must they be scorned so?”
“The winner gets the spoils, and they lost.”
Zhuo Fan walked by, “But aren’t I supposed to be the winner here? These people from the four lands were mere captives and now they think of themselves as the bosses?”
Luo Yunhai pleaded, “Big brother Zhuo, Baili Jingwei is vile, but never trounced our dignity. I hope you will let us handle him.”
“Yeah, I always pay back with the same coin. I may kill him, but never shame him.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “You’re the Clan Head, so do what you will!”
Luo Yunhai perked up and rushed into the fray. Zhuo Fan shook his head, “See, this was my last lesson to you on good and evil, righteous and demonic. Now who here is right and who is wrong? Miss Murong…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1175 - 1175, Gathering of Royalties
chapters.content:
Chapter 1175, Gathering of Royalties
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Humph, so this is the loftiest emperor and greatest Prime Minister in the whole wide world. You got cocky, you showed off, now look where that got you, beneath my boot!”
“Hi-hi-hi, you finally got yours. Now it’s our turn to toy with all these bigshots, ha-ha-ha…”
…
Bang~
Baili Jingwei’s group gnashed their teeth without a word, taking all the abuse they threw at them, be it physical or emotional. The abusers grew wilder, stopping only when Luo Yunhai came over to break them up, but even so, they left with a wide and scornful smile, like some prized underdog.
Murong Xue shook her head, disappointed, “These dignified people cast away their people, shirking all duty in face of disaster, yet they now prance around high and mighty as they take it out on the defeated enemy. Even Baili Jingwei, the greatest mastermind and our enemy wouldn’t fall so low.”
Zhuo Fan smiled as he left with a dark glint in his eye.
[Good and evil begin from thoughts. In this world, who could rein in his wild nature? Ha-ha-ha…]
The imperial capital fell. Aside from Shangguan Feiyun and the spies, taken away by the other lands’ leaders, the rest of the captives were handed to the Luo clan to be dealt with.
The news spread like wildfire throughout the empire, crushing the morale of all the forces still trying to fend off the invading three lands’ armies. The empire fell and the central area fell as well. This became the new reality.
The eastern lands’ rebellion soon won as well, with the Shangguan clan reinstated as its ruler.
The five lands regained peace, the Dharma Kings returning to their old jobs, handling their lands. Zhuo Fan put everything aside, going with the Luo clan to rest with the others.
Luo Sifan and the other two kids were torn from worry. They welcomed her parents back with utter joy, while the oldies from the Luo Alliance noticed the first great steward returned as well, everyone gave him a deep bow of respect.
The kids became aware that Steward Zhuo was a monumental existence to the alliance. Also, he wasn’t blind.
It left them baffled.
Zhuo Fan caught up with his old friends, offering a different kind of comfort.
Three days passed and Zhuge Changfeng was with Zhuo Fan in the Luo clan’s backyard, enjoying idle talk and playing chess. Luo Sifan was engrossed seeing the pieces fly across the board, glancing at Zhuge Changfeng and seeing him frown hard. She raised her hand to propose, “Grandpa Zhuge, here.”
“Ha-ha-ha, young miss, if I place it there, then I’ll burn my own foot, with Steward Zhuo not even needing to land the killing blow.”
Zhuge Changfeng rubbed his beard, chuckling and cupping his hand, “Steward Zhuo’s chess skills have grown sharper. I admit complete defeat.”
Luo Sifan pouted, “Grandpa Zhuge, you lost ten rounds already, but weren’t said to be the best at chess in the western lands? Why…”
“That’s when Steward Zhuo wasn’t around, since I lost to Steward Zhuo once a hundred years ago, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuge Changfeng laughed.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Prime Minister Zhuge, you’re still holding onto that grudge? Ha-ha-ha…”
“Big brother Zhuo!”
“Master!”
Luo Yunhai and his wife came over, bowing to him. Zhuge Changfeng and Luo Sifan rose up and greeted them.
“Clan Head, madam!”
“Mom, dad!”
“Yunhai, you’re the Clan Head, I should be the one to visit you. What are you doing here so early in the morning?” Zhuo Fan gathered the pieces on the board while talking casually.
Luo Yunhai chuckled, “Big brother Zhuo, you jest. I’d never try getting you to visit me. I heard you are back and many of our old friends from the western lands are here to see you, even the Exalted…”
“Exalted Double Dragons?”
Luo Sifan jumped, “The Exalted have hardly gone around the land and even I never met them. To think they’d show up at our door.
“That’s a given.”
Zhuge Changfeng smiled, “Steward Zhuo defeated the Invincible Sword, the best in the world. He is now in the Luo clan and it bolsters the Luo Alliance’s fame and value. They say the Luo clan has replaced the Baili as the best clan in the world. The Exalted have to show respect and can no longer stay haughty like before.”
Luo Sifan oohed, looking at Zhuo Fan like a prized pony.
[Uncle Zhuo is so grand…]
Zhuo Fan stood and walked, “Since we’re friendly, let’s meet them. I won’t get the chance again…”
“Wait!”
Zhuo Fan turned back at the sharp shout, “Shuang’er, it’s been a while. I’ve been in the Luo clan for days yet never saw you around. Where have you been? Ha-ha-ha…”
“Holy Maiden!”
Zhuo Fan chuckled in good-humor. He was still feeling odd, since Shuang’er should’ve known he was with the Luo clan yet never came to see him.
Luo Yunhai’s group smiled.
Yun Shuang smiled back and took Zhuo Fan’s arm, “Come with me.”
“Why?”
“My Patriarch wants to see you.”
“Your Patriarch?” Zhuo Fan asked curiously.
Shuang’er’s eyes glimmered, “Yes, my Yun clan Patriarch, Sovereign Yun, one of the ten ancient Sovereigns wants to see the Demonic Emperor Zhuo Yifan!”
Zhuo Fan’s heart tensed, looking grave.
[The missing Sovereign Yun was in the mortal domain?]
…
Ten days later, in a thick forest, a man and a woman dashed through the woods to land among some ruins. Every rock was covered in vines or hidden by the wildlife.
“This is the Yun clan’s ancestral home?” Zhuo Fan asked.
Yun Shuang nodded, “The Yun clan left this place ages ago, and it came into ruin, making it look bleak. If not for the last five lands’ war growing to such a scale, I might have never come back here to seek my Patriarch’s blessing. I then stayed here, under his guidance, to cultivate.”
Yun Shuang made a sign and the random rocks scattered about rippled, and the air shimmered in front.
“Let’s go.”
Giving Zhuo Fan a smile, she pulled his hand as she took the lead to enter the shimmering air. The two ended up in a dark cave and found themselves unable to control their bodies, floating in space.
The only presence there were the endless stars casting a mystical glow.
Boom!
The image of a three hundred-meter tall old man whooshed in their sight, releasing a white aura and shedding light in this dark space.
“Welcome to my Star Space, Demonic Emperor Zhuo Yifan!”
“Y-you’re Sovereign Yun?” Zhuo Fan’s heart shook, finding meeting a Sovereign still shocking. He bowed and offered his respect, “Greetings, senior.”
Yun Shuang bowed as well, “Greetings, Patriarch!”
“There’s no need for that. I am but a trace.”
Sovereign Yun looked stern, “Demonic Emperor Zhuo Yifan, do you know why I asked for you?”
Zhuo Fan never looked up, bowing still, “I do not. Please enlighten me, senior!”
“Because you lost something. Without it, you will die!”
Sovereign Yun was grave as he shouted, “Boy, your death isn’t important, but it will involve the fate of every living thing, bringing misery to us all. You have to get it back, understand?”
Zhuo Fan pondered and said, “Senior, what am I looking for?”
“You know fully well what.”
Sovereign Yun shouted, “You were operating outside of fate and I could not see your destiny, but I could still see your past. But all these years, I had been blind to you. Do you know why? It’s because you had something on you that helped you in all your cunning endeavors. Do you know what that is?”
Zhuo Fan guessed, “Is it that… what senior is referring to?”
“Only you know what you’re to find. I’m only giving you a reminder.”
Sovereign Yun was being cryptic as his hand shone white and revealed a black sphere, throwing it to Zhuo Fan.
“This is a 6th grade sacred weapon I made with all my power, Worldbridge. No place is out of its reach. As long as you think of somewhere, it will take you there, helping you find what, or who, you want. It will also guide you towards what you’re looking for.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1176 - 1176, Opened Ascension Path
chapters.content:
Chapter 1176, Opened Ascension Path
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Taking a closer look at the black sphere, he noticed energy swirling within, like the primordial energy that made the world, followed by endless stars surrounding it.
His mind felt like he was in a vast and endless world, aware of his insignificance in the face of such a universe, an ant squashed by forces unseen.
He was jolted to his senses the next moment, sweat trickling down his brow. His heart was filled with fear and unease. His pride and arrogance as a human was squashed then and there.
Yun Shuang said, “Big brother Zhuo, are you alright?”
“I’m fine.”
Easing a breath, Zhuo Fan stared at the black ball, “Senior Sovereign Yun, how do I use your treasure?”
The Sovereign smirked, “Figure out yourself. No matter who or what you’re looking for, this Worldbridge will help you.”
“That’s all I had to say, boy. You can go!”
Sovereign Yun flicked his hand and an astral wind sent Zhuo Fan flying.
Yun Shuang started, “Big brother Zhuo…”
“Shuang’er!”
Sovereign Yun shouted, as did Yun Shuang. She turned back and said, “Patriarch…”
“I’m about to fade away.”
Sovereign Yun turned transparent, yet he smiled, “Since ancient times, this trace remained because of Worldbridge’s help. All I’ve been doing was waiting for a man to appear to give it to him. Now that time has come and I shall vanish. The rest is up to him. Don’t let it all go to waste…”
The voice faded as well, in this dark place.
With a boom, everything collapsed, turning into fading glimmers. The sun shone within, revealing just an ordinary cave…
[Patriarch!]
Shuang’er lamented, bowing at the deep cave before leaving.
With a start, Zhuo Fan plopped on the ground, thrown among rocks and kicking up dust. Finally straightening himself, he said, “I was clearly in the mountain and now I’m at its foot. The senior sure doesn’t see his guests out. Talk about rude!”
“Big brother Zhuo!”
Shuang’er came over and saw him covered in dust, “Are you alright? Patriarch’s dismissal can be a bit harsh.”
Zhuo Fan patted the dust off his clothes, “It’s fine. But are all Sovereigns like that? Do all of them have weird hobbies?”
Shuang’er giggled, “Big brother Zhuo is going back to Sacred Domain? Can you take me along?”
“Why?”
“You need help and I can lend a hand.”
“Oh, that…”
Zhuo Fan hesitated, put on the spot, “Peak Genesis Stage isn’t bad, but I know you’re bad at fighting. Sacred Domain is too…”
Shuang’er was firm in this, “Don’t underestimate me!”
Shuang’er’s eyes shone an eerie blue and an astonishing power came out. With rumbling combing from everywhere, the entire mountain range crumbled on the spot. But it wasn’t due to the shaking, it was because it was flattened.
Zhuo Fan felt heavy as well and sank into the earth. Everything in a hundred miles sank three hundred meters.
Shuang’er stopped and looked in pride, “Well, big brother Zhuo? That’s a third of what I can do. I refrained from flattening a thousand miles around since there are people living here. And that’s not even my special skill.”
“You’re practically a different person after receiving Sovereign Yun’s guidance.”
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched, “But why didn’t your Patriarch train disciples to protect your clan?”
Shuang’er shrugged, “Patriarch cared for the world. He only waited here for you to give you something. He doesn’t care what befell the clan, or how it fares. He only taught me because he sensed your aura a hundred years ago and wanted me to help you.”
“I see. But why would he help me? Is it because of the Sovereign path?”
Zhuo Fan frowned, looking at the black ball in his hand and then patted Shuang’er’s shoulder, “We’ll meet in Sword Star Empire’s capital in twenty days. Don’t be late and… don’t tell the Luo clan.”
“You’re not taking them?”
“What’s the point of being in so much danger?”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “They are kings in the mortal domain and have a stable position. They should enjoy retirement. By going to Sacred Domain instead, they will have to start over, facing danger upon danger. In short, there are many horrible men there, and even more hidden experts unaccounted for. I even feel scared. Taking them along will make it hard to protect them.”
Shuang’er nodded and sighed.
The two returned to the Luo clan and stayed for a few days, meeting old friends from western lands before leaving for the empire’s capital.
At that time, a dozen days passed already, with most of the people Zhuo Fan gathered already there.
Gu Santong and Qiao’er were obvious, with Ye Lin and other Dharma Kings, Bali Yuyu, Baili Yulei and Baili Jingtian present as well. Even Murong Xue was going.
“Miss Murong, you’re coming along?” Zhuo Fan asked.
Murong Xue nodded, “My sight has broadened and I wish to see the upper world, if you don’t mind.”
“I don’t, not since you’re your brother’s problem now. If he doesn’t mind, why should I? Ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan came before the Thunder Pavilion.
There was not a trance of lightning as before, turned into an average place. That was because a month back, Zhuo Fan threw a casual seal over it when he was here.
Glancing at the bowing Wu Randong nearby, Zhuo Fan said, “After we leave, you are to watch over the mortal domain. At my signal, activate the second array, got it?”
“Crysta clearl. Palace Lord, the empire is gone and my hatred has quelled. I only wish to fulfill the Palace Lord’s orders!” Wu Randong bowed sternly.
Zhuo Fan nodded and made a sign. The space around them rippled, “World’s arts combine, seas of spiritual clarity, aid me in activating the array. Open the path to heaven and guide me on my journey!”
Boom!
Every land began shaking, the sky filled with the cries of the frightened. The tunnels dug throughout the lands and packed with sacred stones intertwined as they activated and linked the five lands into one gargantuan array.
Whoosh~
A white pillar shot into the sky from the former Beast Taming Sect. Violent and volatile power gushed from it, racing through and into the array dug underground, all the way to the imperial capital.
Rustle~
More pillars of light shot out, from Ultimate Clarity Sect, North Sea, the former Flying Cloud Manor and more. It was like they connected heaven with the earth, unleashing tremendous power. The people near these locations blanked out on the spot, even Genesis experts could barely breathe from the pressure. They could barely crawl on the ground, horrified at the development.
Seven pillars in all, scattered throughout the five lands rose into the air. The thick spiritual energy from the Sacred Domain came pouring in from the World Wind Tunnels, fueling the huge array and coming to the imperial capital.
Dragon ancestor roared in joy, “Ha-ha-ha, at long last, the time of our freedom has come, ha-ha-ha…”
“Finally completed. The kid is about to return, ha-ha-ha. Safe travels, old friend!”
In the Allbeast Mountain Range, Vaulting Kunpeng felt the spiritual energy around changing and saw the seven pillars of light with a wide smile.
[It all went according to plan, a plan in the making for eons, ha-ha-ha…]
Whoosh~
All that power focused in one area. Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone and made another sign as he pointed, “All paths converge, ascension path, open!”
Boom!
With one last strong worldwide shake, the Thunder Pavilion let out its own white pillar into the sky. BOOM! The heavens above then manifested a dazzling light, the same one that was calling the Spirit King Baili Yutian.
The path to the Sacred Domain was finally open…

chapters.title: Chapter 1177 - 1177, Forward Together
chapters.content:
Chapter 1177, Forward Together
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Drip~
The earth shook and water dripped inside a dark prison. A weary middle-aged man sat on a filthy bed, bleak and forlorn.
Crack!
Noise came from just outside, with a man bowing, “Greetings, Your Majesty!”
“Open the cell!”
“Yes!”
A man in royal garb stepped in, looking at the prisoner in ruined clothes, “Imperial brother, did you hear? That’s the sound of old friends leaving. But even as the ruler of a nation, I still had no suitable parting gift.”
“Who is leaving?”
The prisoner looked up, staring at Tianyu’s emperor, Yuwen Cong.
Yuwen Cong sighed, “My sworn brothers, of course, Zhuo Fan and the Luo clan. They’re going to a bigger world and reaching new heights we could never even dream of. I can only stay here and wish them safe travels.”
“Ha-ha-ha, for Your Majesty to come see a traitor in person, is it just to show off?”
Yuwen Yong mocked, “I sided with the Sword Star Empire, the greatest power, only for Zhuo Fan to later destroy it. Now you have caught me and must be mighty pleased. Now there’s no chance of me fighting back. I am at your whim, to kill, to maim!”
Yuwen Cong looked saddened, “Second brother, to be honest, I’d have truly removed you if this happened a hundred years ago. But now, everything changed. I’ve felt my power waining with the Luo Alliance hanging overhead. I’ve been depressed and forlorn. But then, Luo Yunhai, returned to me my full authority. I thought I’d be happy, but all I found within me was an endless void.”
“Void?”
“Yes.”
Yuwen Cong sighed, “What’s so great about imperial power, when all is so futile? For this power I killed my elder brother, harmed my father, and then became a puppet just so that someone would throw me back out like trash. The moment the power returned to me, I cried. What the hell is this? Kings and officials, fathers and sons, tear at each other and for what, so that one man can stand alone, in the cold harsh emptiness?”
Yuwen Cong teared up, leaving Yuwen Yong in shock, “Yes, just what is authority, to make me, the foolish and chubby third brother, so ruthless to kill our father and first brother, then hunt you down as well?”
Second brother, I am confessing here, but you shouldn’t pin everything on me either. It was in fact the Crown Prince who killed our father then. I only joined later and killed the Crown Prince, on the charge of patricide.”
“The Crown Prince killed our imperial father? Don’t spout nonsense! Why did I hear then that you killed them, teaming up with the Luo clan to take power?”
“That’s the truth. You’re my prisoner, so why would I bother making everything up?
Yuwen Cong sighed, “Imperial father drew outsiders to fight the Luo clan and set the stage for the Crown Prince’s death, all so he could leave the lands to me. In the end, the Crown Prince struck first, the Luo clan had shockingly won, and with them in the shadows, I became their puppet emperor. If it weren’t for the Luo clan, it still would’ve been me who inherited it. For imperial father never planned on giving power to the Crown Prince.”
Yuwen Yong’s face shook, “How can that be? I thought you killed them and I’ve always sought revenge…”
“When the imperial members vie for power, who doesn’t seek revenge?”
Yuwen Cong sighed, “Everyone went insane, trying to cull everyone outside of their control. Be it our imperial father or the Crown Prince who won, neither would’ve let you, the imprisoned second brother, free. I as well was a threat to the throne and removed.”
Yuwen Yong squinted in a daze, then he slumped powerlessly, “What have I been doing this last century then? Helping those trying to kill me for revenge? Ha-ha-ha…”
“Guard, release Yuwen Yong.”
Yuwen Cong shouted and a soldier obeyed. Yuwen Cong gave him a long look, then smiled, “I had a drink with Zhuo Fan a few days ago and realized a problem. He never cared for power, but winning against the world. We fought hard and bitterly, but won the rights to a life of solitude.
“Second brother, the other lands condemn their traitors, with Shangguan Feiyun, Bu Xingyun and the others having a sordid end, you are still my second brother, my only remaining brother. Zhuo Fan had been a true friend to give you to me and none other cared much either. Now, Yuwen clan has another member left alive.”
Yuwen Yong could finally move and doubted, “Aren’t you afraid I’ll come back to fight you?”
“Fight me? I’m but the lord of a third-rate empire while you climbed to be a valued minister in the Sword Star Empire? Why would you come after me?”
Yuwen Cong mocked, turning to leave, “Zhuo Fan left, Luo clan left, all old friends left. I have no brothers and I’m going to live a life of solitude. And with your crimes, even if I secede the throne to you, would the Double Dragon Manor agree? If you can take down the Double Dragon Manor, why come for my throne then? Funny, isn’t it? Ha-ha-ha…”
Yuwen Yong’s eye twitched as he watched the emperor leave.
[Nothing mattered in the end. It’s all nothing but pure bias. Why even fight anymore? Ha-ha.]
Yuwen Yong walked out with a hunched back, feeling like centuries caught up with him…
Meanwhile, Zhuo Fan finished the signs and regarded the light pillar. He turned to the others, “This is the path to the upper world, follow me. Once we arrive, you have to listen to all I say, lest you get on someone’s bad side and never see the light of day again.”
“Yes!” Everyone shouted.
