Ye Lin took the first step to Zhuo Fan, “Big brother, isn’t it a recoil array to break open the mortal domain? Why did it change into a path of ascension? What about master and others…”
“They’ll wait for a bit.”
Zhuo Fan squinted, “Ye Lin, do you have that much trust in those old bones’ words?”
“Er…”
“All we got from what happened is from their mouths. Who can prove it’s real?”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, emphasizing every word, “You saw every aspect of humanity in the five lands war and can tell. Central area defeating the four lands did not mean their destruction. Four lands defeating the empire didn’t mean central area’s fortune. Each power fights for itself. There’s no morality involved, no good, no evil. By letting those old monsters go, can you guarantee it won’t blow up in our faces?”
Ugh!
Ye Lin frowned in hesitation.
Pa!
Zhuo Fan had a grave look, putting a hand on his shoulder, “We’ll go first to see the situation in the Sacred Domain. If it’s like those guys said, I’ll give Wu Randong the signal and he’ll activate the recoiling array to free them. But if it’s a lie, painting themselves as victims, for their sake and that of world peace, they’ll be locked up for the rest of their lives!”
“Uhm…”
“Don’t give me that and get a move on!”
Zhuo Fan pushed and threw Ye Lin into the pillar, gone before he could scream.
Zhuo Fan turned to the rest, beaming, “Who’s next?”
“Me!”
A roar of anger came as a girl flashed in his view.
Zhuo Fan started, “Y-young miss, what…”
“You foul cretin, you’re taking off again and leaving us behind?”
“N-no, it’s just that there isn’t suited for you…”
“Big brother Zhuo, no matter what you say, we agreed to stay together. You have no right to slip away.” Luo Yunhai smiled, “Look, I’ve brought the whole clan to fight alongside you!”
Li Jingtian’s venerables appeared, Li Jingtian and the power couple, as well as thousands of Genesis Stage veteran soldiers. Even Luo Sifan and the brats came.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Aren’t you afraid of leaving the Luo Alliance’s core empty?”
“No, out with the old and in with the new!”
Luo Yunhai waved, “We built the Luo Alliance here then we can do it again there. Big brother Zhuo, I’m still young and have ambition. I fear nothing. Let us do this together!”
“Yeah, Steward Zhuo, let us follow you!”
The others shouted their agreements.
Zhuo Fan sighed, yet he felt gratified inside. Just as he was about to speak, someone pushed him into the pillar.
“No more talking. Let’s all go!”
Someone held Zhuo Fan and dragged him inside the pillar with a sweet smile…

chapters.title: Chapter 1178 - 1178, Lightning Tribulation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1178, Lightning Tribulation
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Hum~
Everyone vanished one after the other. Wu Randong made a sign when he was alone, and the gaudy pillar of light faded away.
The other seven pillars in the five lands followed suit.
Wu Randong smirked, looking at the sky, “Take care, Palace Lord.”
“Until next time, brother Zhuo.”
Wu Qingqiu and the others watched them go from a distance with cupped hands, “I really want to go as well and see the wider world outside, but…”
“But you had sect matters to attend to. I also have my clan to consider as well.”
Shangguan Qingyan shrugged, “What’s more, we have to watch over the grand array he took a century to set up and receive him at any time. He gave us harsh warnings about this. It may very well be related to his survival.”
Wu Qingqiu nodded and smiled, “Yes, he has a lot of trust in us, with his life even, to give us such a task, to cooperate with Devil Palace in guarding the grand array. We are not about to let him down! Ha-ha-ha…”
The others smiled broadly…
While they watched Zhuo Fan go, filled with respect and trust, in Ultimate Clarity Sect, the dragon ancestor blinked at the sudden disappearance of the light pillars.
[What the hell? The mortal domain isn’t open yet so why did it stop?]
Then it hit him and he raged, “Rotten cretin, you have the nerve to throw us away? Just you wait! You’re going to pay for this! We’ll wreck you so hard you’ll come back crying, begging us for help. Curses!”
“He left for good this time.”
In the North Sea, Heaven Sealing Sea Ao peeked his head out of the water, sensing the world settling, shaking his head in boredom, “Boy, take care. Who knows when you’ll be back.”
The huge head dipped back under the water.
Being around Zhuo Fan for a hundred years made him recall those ancient times he interacted with humans, filled with warmth and joy. Now, he was back to being alone…
…
Whoosh~
The mortal domain’s people each had their thoughts regarding Zhuo Fan’s leaving. But in the Sacred Domain, in a scorched area, a beam of light appeared and people walked out of it.
The thick spiritual energy slammed into their face, flooding their every fiber and making their Yuan Qi run wild without even focusing on cultivating.
They all were left speechless.
[Is this the world the Patriarch wanted to see? It’s incredible. The degree of spiritual energy here is scary, no different from a sacred stone mine, no, ten times denser.]
With the sacred stone mines sealed off, the amount mined was very little for everyone to enjoy.
But here and now, this was a cultivator’s paradise!
Everyone was overjoyed, with Bali Yuyu giggling, “Zhuo Fan, is this Devil Moun-, uh…”
Her joy was short-lived as she turned to him.
“Young miss, we’ve arrived. Can you let go?”
Zhuo Fan sighed, laying on the scorched earth with Luo Yunchang clutching to him for her dear life.
Luo Yunchang smirked, happy to hold him with closed eyes, “No, or you’ll just be running off again. This place is foreign to me. I couldn’t find you in the five lands and this will go double here. So you better stay put, for I’m not letting you go…”
“Get off already!”
A dainty hand grabbed her collar and yanked her off Zhuo Fan.
Baili Yuyu looked mighty jealous, “Have you no shame, woman? Throwing yourself at a man in broad daylight?”
“He’s my steward, why do you care who I throw myself to? If you hate it so much, will engaging in such activity at night be to your liking?”
“Damn you…”
“That’s enough!”
Bali Yuyu was fuming mad, but Zhuo Fan interfered. He brushed off the dust and stood up with a stern look, “We have arrived and I have to give you fair warning not to wander about and draw trouble. We can’t take any of it, understand?”
All were just as grave as him.
Zhuo Fan continued, “First off, this place is called the Sacred Domain. Compared to mortal domain, everything is a few stages higher, with treasures at every step, making this place teeming with experts. I’m sure you’ve already felt the outrageous spiritual energy density, making it easy to cultivate. While in the mortal domain, a supreme genius of twelve achieving Bone Tempering Stage can be praiseworthy, and reaching the Profound Heaven Stage would be monstrous.
“Here, however, Radiant Stage kids are running all over the place, with more talented being in the Ethereal Stage, and the true monsters at the Genesis Stage. Especially you three brats, listen up. Your parents might’ve let you come to set up shop in this great place, but this is no paradise. It is hell. Walking about as you are, any other sixteen-year-old will wipe the floor with you. So be careful, for those days of lording over with status and power are over.”
Sss~
Everyone gasped in shock.
“Yes, that’s exactly what I mean. In the mortal domain we were at the peak, but here we’re at the bottom, no different than common people.”
Zhuo Fan spoke coldly, “So in the Sacred Domain, if you want to hold any kind of power, you need to be a Spirit King at the very least. Anything in the mortal stages are ants. That’s why none of us have the right to show off and must keep our noses down.”
Everyone grew heavy, feeling apprehension.
They were among the top in the mortal domain and now they ended up scraping the barrel.
Zhuo Fan smirked, “But there’s no need to be discouraged. You’re at the bottom because the mortal domain’s conditions were too poor. Based on talent alone, you’re Sacred Domain monsters as well. Especially the Sword Kings. Reaching Spirit Kings Stage should be easy, taking only time. So all we need to do is endure for a while and then we can leave our mark on Sacred Domain.”
[Truly?]
Everyone’s eyes glimmered. They were all men who enjoyed status. Even though they sank to rock bottom, they now had faith they could make a comeback.
“What of Devil Mountain? Is it the same as Sacred Domain?” Bali Yuyu asked, getting the attention of everyone.
[Right, he always says he came from Devil Mountain so why are we in Sacred Domain?]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, giving a sinister smirk, “Of course it isn’t. Devil Mountain is but a part of Sacred Domain. Don’t be quick to think Devil Mountain is friendly either. From now on, Devil Mountain is in fact our greatest opponent!”
Everyone shuddered.
[It’s not his sect? Why…]
Rumble~
Thunderclaps sounded from the heavens as lightning snaked about the black clouds.
Flinching, the people panicked. But then their power started boiling, like…
“Breaking through!” They all cried out.
Zhuo Fan exclaimed, “Yes, mortal domain was not just barren of spiritual energy but also being suppressed. Coming to Sacred Domain is like overcoming all adversity and thus our cultivation will soar. Especially a Sword King’s, who had been kept at the peak for too long, he’ll be rushing to advance, without a moment to lose. Damn it!”
“Why is it so bad? Isn’t advancing a good thing?”
“What do any of you know?”
Zhuo Fan frowned hard, looking at the roiling thunderclouds, “Other stage increases aside, reaching Spirit King Stage means you’re shedding the mortal coil, being remade. That means a lightning tribulation will fall on you to rebuild your meridians and purify Yuan Qi. One breaking through is fine, but the issue here is that there are so many at peak Genesis Stage. With all calling forth lightning, the power will multiply. The issue isn’t you withstanding it, but Yunhai and the rest suffering as a result.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1179 - 1179, Scarlet Lightning Valley
chapters.content:
Chapter 1179, Scarlet Lightning Valley
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Everyone got restless at his words, with Murong Lie saying, “All Genesis Stage cultivators with me. We’ll draw away the lightning tribulation!”
“Too late.”
Glancing at the thundering clouds above, lightning struck nearby, leaving behind a black crater fifty miles wide.
Zhuo Fan squinted and shook. Black energy came out of him, covering Luo Yunhai and thousands of others below Genesis Stage, “I’ll protect them with my domain while you get some distance and take on your tribulation.”
Murong Lie and the rest shot away. But another boom sounded as lightning slammed overhead and cut off their flight.
But recalling the many innocent lives behind, they kept forcing themselves to fly.
Boom~
Lightning snaked and struck down on them. Zhuo Fan held the fort, ignoring the lightning striking him as well. He worked his energy to keep the others safe. At the same time, black energy was released around, absorbing the lightning’s power to increase his own cultivation. His meridians and Yuan Qi were being refined with every strike.
He was only in the 7th layer of Genesis Stage, but ever since he arrived here and felt the thick spiritual energy, his cultivation grew as well.
While he was defending the Luo clan and the rest, he was also taking in the heaven’s power, strengthening himself several times.
With a muffled sound, he reached the 8th layer.
Zhuo Fan grinned…
Boom!
Another lightning came down on his head and he shook all over. His Demon Transformation Art was revved up to the max, working to remove the lightning’s power, but still a fraction got loose within him, roaming through his veins and making his body spasm. Blood spilled from his mouth.
He chose to contain it and endure. He could, in fact, use more of his focus to absorb the violent lightning, but then who’d defend the little guys? He could only bear it in silence.
Boom~
The deadly lightning struck again and again, thick as a bucket, or thin as a plate, crashing down like a mountain, eighty one times.
Zhuo Fan bore through it, and while his body smoked now, he was still fine. His meridians at least had strengthened and his cultivation reached the 9th layer.
“Ha-ha-ha, looks like I’m close to Spirit King as well!”
Zhuo Fan looked at the scattering black clouds and sighed, “Never mind, taking eighty one lightning strikes almost burned through all my body. Taking another round right now to advance to the Spirit King level will most likely kill me. Next time…”
Zhuo Fan felt his aching body, but his power surged with vigor through his limbs.
Only a monster like Zhuo Fan, able to fight a Spirit King, could take something like that. Other Genesis cultivators would’ve breathed their last around the thirtieth strike.
Just as Zhuo Fan was about to let the others out, booming sounded again and looked up. The deadly lightning echoed in his ears once more.
His brow jumped, his face twitching, “You don’t mean it’s still coming, do you?”
Boom!
Another explosion was his answer to that challenge as an even thicker lightning slammed into him.
The dreadful power made him tremble all over as he spurted blood.
[What is this? That’s no lightning tribulation. No such lightning has that kind of power.]
Zhuo Fan peered at the sky in shock, finding the thunderclouds weren’t just black, but laced with crimson.
[Soul-sucking blood lightning?]
[This is Scarlet Lightning Valley!]
Looking at the burnt soil below, Zhuo Fan finally knew where he was in Sacred Domain. Lightning constantly struck it and on a different level than outside this area.
Each lightning was devastating in might, turning a brighter red the stronger it was. Once a red lightning fell, even a Saint would have to be wary, yet a white lightning could press hard a Spirit King.
That was what made this place so desolate. No one wanted to come in here just to die the next second.
[What’s with our rotten luck? We just came to Sacred Domain and landed in this place.]
Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth. This place wasn’t up to Lightning Canyon, but it wasn’t far behind either.
[Right, Thunder Pavilion!]
Zhuo Fan exclaimed in realization.
The eight World Wind Tunnels in the mortal domain corresponded with Sacred Domain’s eight extreme locations. Thunder Pavilion was linked to this Scarlet Lightning Valley. Since they came through the Thunder Pavilion’s location, they ended up in this god-forsaken place. All the constant lightning around the Thunder Pavilion was due to this place as well.
Zhuo Fan held his head.
[This is fricking fate, I tell you. The recoiling array needed to draw spiritual energy from all around. The crucial thing is balance. Its best location was the heart of the five lands, which was Thunder Pavilion.]
[Which made coming from mortal domain to the Sacred Domain always going to be here. The Scarlet Lightning Valley couldn’t be avoided. Now we just have to get the hell out of here under a shower of lightning before a scarlet one drops on us…]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone and a demonic sword appeared in his palm, shining scarlet.
[Soaring Sword Art, Soaring Heaven!]
Zhuo Fan slashed and a scarlet sword wave shot at the thunderclouds.
Rumble!
White flashed just then, striking the wave. Scarlet and red collided and dissipated, but Zhuo Fan’s art remained, its power piercing the clouds and punching a hole through them.
Zhuo Fan grinned.
[This works. Now I just have to break down the clouds and the scarlet lightning can’t form.]
But he then watched as the clouds flickered with lightning and sealed back the hole like it never happened.
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched, his hand waving the sword around as he sent attacks at the clouds.
[I’ll just have to be faster than its recovery.]
Booms sounded constantly, the sword waves clashing with the lightning yet the art’s power reached the clouds many times and punched holes in it.
But then the lightning grew in strength and Zhuo Fan’s Soaring Sword Art lost its advantage, until it could no longer even block it. The following lightning struck Zhuo Fan and numbed his whole body while the holes in the sky were patched up as a trace of scarlet flashed.
Zhuo Fan started.
[Once they start turning red, I’ll have no chance!]
Zhuo Fan’s hands were sweaty…
Ding!
A ringing reached his ears and Zhuo Fan flinched. His Thunder Ring flashed purple and the Sundering Sword appeared in his other hand.
“Oh, Sundering Sword, what are you up to?” Zhuo Fan asked.
Whoosh!
The purple sword released a powerful lightning wave, then took Zhuo Fan to face the heavens.
Zhuo Fan blinked, but still chose to follow the spirited sword into facing this challenge.
Boom!
Lightning thundered and a huge strike came down at Zhuo Fan. It even contained a trace of red.
[Damn it, the lightning changed!]
Zhuo Fan panicked, wanting to block with the demonic sword, but the Sundering Sword moved first, slapping it out of the way and releasing a strong purple wave. It carried Zhuo Fan’s arm and struck hard.
Boom!
With a deafening explosion, the purple lightning wave blasted the incoming attack into harmless motes of light. The purple sword then shot into the thunderclouds and blew a huge hole in them, greatly weakening the charged lightning clouds. To the point the snaking lightning glowing red turned white.
[This is destruction, the power of the Sundering Sword Art!]
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shook, “I see, the Soaring Sword Art might be tough enough to break heaven, but clouds are formless, merely pushed back and not dissipated, letting them recover fast. But with the Sundering Sword Art, containing the power of destruction, the thunderclouds were greatly weakened.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1180 - 1180, Sundering Sword’s Inheritance
chapters.content:
Chapter 1180, Sundering Sword’s Inheritance
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Ding!
The Sundering Sword hummed softly, as if to confirm his words.
Zhuo Fan snickered, “Then, Sundering Sword, rise with me and break that lightning, tear a hole in the sky so that I can use apocalyptic thunderflame to make sure it never recovers, ha-ha-ha…”
Bam!
The Sundering Sword put a stop to his mad cackle, smacking his head with the wide part of the blade, making his nose swell.
“What was that for?!”
Rubbing his poor nose, Zhuo Fan snapped back, irate, “I wield you now, you’re my sword. I’m your master. Is that how you treat me? See how I pulverize your sword spirit!”
The Sundering Sword paused then struck again, only this time it did on the demonic sword.
Ding!
[Wanna fight? Don’t mess with me!]
The demonic sword was no pushover, reacting by floating in front of the Sundering Sword and taunting it.
The Sundering Sword just stood still.
Zhuo Fan said, “You’re saying to put all my skill aside and use just you to face the thunderclouds?”
Ding!
The Sundering Sword shook again.
[Hey, don’t just ignore me! I’m made of sterner stuff, four swords in fact. Yet a newbie like you tries to take my place? Why should master use just you? Trying to replace me, is that it? Ha, keep dreaming, hunk of rust, in a few days you’ll be a part of me, hi-hi-hi…]
The demonic sword had enough of the Sundering Sword’s arrogance and brandished its edge, trying to pick a fight.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Alright, I’ll give you this chance. Demonic sword, return.”
The demonic sword stalled, looking stumped at his master’s decision, even depressed.
[Master, you already got a new flame and forgot your trusted sidekick? I’m made of four blades here!]
Demonic sword didn’t make a fuss, noticing Zhuo Fan’s determination, turning into a black light and slipping in his body.
Zhuo Fan gripped the Sundering Sword and it took him towards the sky to fight the heavens.
Lightning struck constantly, yet all Zhuo Fan did was swing the Sundering Sword around, destroying the attacks as purple glows flared on every contact.
The utter destruction of the lightning had the thunderclouds growing weaker.
When Zhuo Fan used the Soaring Sword Art, he only scattered the lightning power in the clouds, only delaying its growth and not stopping the source.
Now though, he had the means to destroy them!
Boom!
Zhuo Fan charged into the thunderclouds with the Sundering Sword, with lightning coming from all around now.
“If I used Thunderflame Void Annihilation now, the clouds…”
Bam!
Zhuo Fan indulged in a flight of fancy, but the sudden knock to the head brought him back to reality. Zhuo Fan sighed and shook his head, “Fine, I get it, no other skills but you, happy? But how is a lone sword supposed to remove all the thunderclouds in a thousand mile area? Time waits for no one, and once red starts appearing…”
The Sundering Sword was silent, for a lack of a better word.
Then it started moving and took Zhuo Fan’s hand with it. Its blade shone a deep purple glow.
Zhuo Fan shook all over, as a figure suddenly appeared in his mind as he wielded the Sundering Sword.
“Sundering, one day I will take you to the top, become the focus of everyone, ha-ha-ha…”
Baili Yutian cackled among the flaring lightning clouds as he hacked at the incoming attacks with pride and arrogance, “Only I am worthy of such a divine sword, not those common folk. But…”
Baili Yutian paused, showing fear, “There will always be someone better out there. If one day someone can take you from me, it proves I’m not worthy of you, and you should have a much stronger master. He will be just like me, taking you to the top and not disgrace your sundering name, of splitting the heavens. By then, I shall be dead, but you must pass on all my knowledge and insight in the way of the sword to him. If I can’t take you to the top, then my path will!”
Hum~
The Sundering Sword shook to console him.
“Ha-ha-ha, I’m only assuming here. Who in the world could ever defeat me. Don’t worry about it, ha-ha-ha…” Baili Yutian wielded the divine sword with burning battle spirit.
Zhuo Fan finally understood the Sundering Sword. It passed on Baili Yutian’s legacy. There was none out there better than Baili Yutian when it came to understanding the Sundering Sword Art, not even the Sword Sovereign.
While he had made the five divine swords by combining their arts with the five sacred beasts’ powers, he was not the least bit aware of what changes that brought. Baili Yutian, however, was a man immersed in the Sundering Sword Art all his life, having understood the core of the Sundering Sword Art.
Why else would the Sundering Sword’s inheritance have Baili Yutian’s image and not someone else’s? There had to be countless people wielding it through eons, including the Sword Sovereign.
[But only one man truly understood it.]
Zhuo Fan’s gaze steeled, slashing around based on Baili Yutian’s example.
Wind picked up and purple lightning flared as the sword fell. The thunderclouds around shone and then faded away. From just the sword’s intent, lightning exploded in all directions and the world crumbled.
Zhuo Fan forgot himself in this state, his form following Baili Yutian’s actions to perfection as he unleashed devastating and brutal sword strikes.
By the time he finished the entire set of strikes, the sky was clear of thunderclouds and the sun shone brightly on the scorched earth for the first time ever.
Zhuo Fan felt a tear come loose at the display.
Not due to him, but induced by the Sundering Sword spirit, having their minds linked.
The sword spirit might not speak, but it could send Zhuo Fan its deep emotions.
Purple flickered from the Sundering Sword, blending with the world’s spiritual energy. Zhuo Fan saw as the sword spirit scattered its own energy to return to the earth once it passed on the Sundering Sword Art.
[A true sacrifice for a true friend.]
With the death of the Invincible Sword, it wanted to follow him as well. But his wish to pass on his legacy kept it here. Now, it could pass on as well without remorse.
The Sundering Sword now became just an empty shell.
“Zhuo Fan, reach the top!”
As the last purple energy faded, Zhuo Fan saw the Invincible Sword shout in his mind and knew it to be the sword spirit blessing him instead of its former master.
Zhuo Fan smirked and nodded, “Like master, like sword. Like sword, like master. The Sundering Sword spirit was as carefree and heroic as the Invincible Sword.”
Tracing the purple divine sword’s blade, Zhuo Fan smiled and placed it in his ring, his eyes firm.
[I will reach the top, along with your sword art…]
Whoosh~
Murong Lie and the others popped up next to Zhuo Fan, “Sir Zhuo, are you alright?”
“Yes, what about you?” Zhuo Fan flicked his hand and the domain faded, revealing strong auras. Luo Yunhai’s group had broken their restraints and entered Genesis Stage, while the three kids were now in Ethereal Stage.
Zhuo Fan nodded, turning to the Sword Kings with a glint in his eye.
Murong Lie’s group had been kept for so long behind that now they were at peak Spirit King Stage. Even Li Jingtian and the elders reached mid Spirit King Stage.
They were all thrilled at the boundless Yuan Qi they felt.
“Steward Zhuo, your cultivation fell again, to the 5th layer of Bone Tempering Stage!” Li Jingtian gasped.
Zhuo Fan now focused on his own cultivation and cried out in astonishment, “Mid Spirit King?”
Having met with lightning tribulation, the peak Genesis Stage Zhuo Fan, due to Sundering Sword’s inheritance, his heart grew as well as making the True Self Art bring his cultivation down to the Bone Tempering Stage, while his true cultivation lay at mid Spirit King Stage.
Though reaching Spirit King brought lightning tribulation, Zhuo Fan had been waving Sundering Sword around without restraint, thus he unknowingly cut his own tribulation down before he could feel it.
He felt down at the realization.
[I missed the chance to toughen my body.]
But since he got a taste of the others’ tribulations, his regret faded.
[What’s the point of going through all that again when I already got a Spirit King’s body the first time around? Ha-ha!]
“Everyone!”
With all safe and sound and Zhuo Fan gaining the Sundering Sword’s insight, a bargain to be honest, his eyes flashed, “With our Spirit Kings cultivation levels, we now can form a group. Sword Kings, having gotten a divine sword’s insights, will be more than mere Spirit Kings. I dare say that we can now jump ahead and carve our own slice of the Sacred Domain!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1181 - 1181, Hunter, Hunted
chapters.content:
Chapter 1181, Hunter, Hunted
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Come right up! Top spirit ores, black crystals, and other top goods…”
“12th grade pills…”
…
The peddlers were shouting their wears in the market of a small town, having put them on a dazzling display for all interested parties, making this place buzz with activity.
In front of the town there was a towering guard post, with the word on it spelling Joy Town.
A girl led her twelve imposing Genesis Stage guards up to the entrance. She also had one thin youth right next her.
The bustling little town fell utterly silent. Everyone turned their heads at the unfamiliar faces, each pair of eyes glimmering with hidden intentions. It lasted merely moments, as they all resumed the chatter and activity like the previous unnerving pause never occurred.
Luo Yunchang found it strange, giving Zhuo Fan a look, but the latter smiled as he signaled them all to enter the town.
The market was just as busy as before, yet it now had a strange vibe to it. The eyes of all the people found themselves resting on the newcomers at one point or another.
Luo Yunchang was unnerved, her face grave as she clutched Zhuo Fan’s hand.
“Zhuo Fan, this town is creepy.”
“We wouldn’t be here otherwise, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan snickered, his eyes taking in every last face around, showing the same hunting gaze as the townfolks.
Zhuo Fan took Luo Yunchang and the others to a tavern and bowed, “Young miss, it’s getting late. Could we rest here?”
Luo Yunchang nodded, following his intention of going inside after him.
“Whence you came and where you’re hailing, travelers? Will you be stopping by or resting?” A dolled up middle-aged woman smiled the minute they entered, asking and scanning them like a hawk.
Zhuo Fan said, “Have five of your best rooms ready. Young miss will take one and the rest are for us, thirteen.”
“Oh, five rooms…” The host looked troubled, “Forgive me, but my meager establishment does not have so many empty rooms.”
“How many are there then?”
“One.”
“One isn’t enough!” Zhuo Fan shook his head, “We can’t have young miss take it and have no one watch over her. Young miss, let’s just find another tavern.”
Luo Yunchang gave him a look and nodded, “We’ll do as Steward Zhuo says.”
“This is the only tavern in Joy Town. Going out to find more and you’ll be left sleeping with the stars overhead.” A shout came.
They all jumped, looking to find a middle-aged man covered in fine attire and glittering decorations. The hostess lit up and bowed, “Steward Fang!”
“Owner, this doesn’t concern you. I’ll take care of our new friends.”
Steward Fang smiled and sent the hostess away before he cupped his hands towards the group, “I am Fang Ding, the steward of Liao clan. How may I address you?”
Zhuo Fan gave a curt nod, smiling back with cupped hands, “I am Zhuo Fan, Luo clan’s steward. Here is my young miss Luo Yunchang and her guards. Trading brought us through this area and we thought of resting after noticing the darkened sky.”
“Oh, you’re a steward?”
Fang Ding’s eyes shone with suspicion, “Brother Zhuo, if I may be so bold, your cultivation is a little…”
Zhuo Fan caught his meaning and looked crestfallen as he sighed, not willing to talk about it.
Luo Yunchang intervened, “To be honest, Steward Zhuo was born with incomplete meridians, unable to compare with other fellow cultivators. But his intellect is beyond reproach. My father especially had him take over our affairs. A steward isn’t a fighting role, so what’s the point of a high cultivation, wouldn’t you say? Ha-ha-ha…”
Luo Yunchang held Zhuo Fan’s hand, giving him a compassionate pat on the hand.
[Well I’ll be, the pretty boy is mooching off her!]
Fang Ding reached an instant conclusion.
[A twenty-something year old guy in the Bone Tempering Stage is worse than a toddler! Might as well spare him from a crippled life. No matter how sharp he is up there, there’s no way to become a steward. While a steward is no fighter, he is, after all, the face of a clan!]
[He clearly curried favor to reach his position. ]
[Humph, the kid is garbage.]
Fang Ding was smart enough not to speak his mind though.
“Brother Zhuo, there’s a master in every walk of life. Now you’re a steward and tomorrow a leader.” Fang Ding patted his shoulder as he laughed, “Since I find you so close and you all have nowhere to stay, why not spend the night at the Liao manor?”
Luo Yunchang perked up, but was looking immensely gratified as she bowed, “What a great idea, but we wouldn’t want to impose on your Clan Head.”
“Young miss Luo, my master is a most hospitable person. Everyone in a hundred miles knows him for his generosity. My master would help any in times of need when they knock on his door, be it stranger or fellow townsmen.”
Fang Ding smiled, “Why else would this town be called Joy Town? I’m sure you’ve noticed our people’s cheerful nature. This place is under my master’s supervision. He is sure to go wild with joy having you staying over at his place.”
The hostess then giggled, coming over and complaining, “Master Liao is a man of honor and integrity. He stole so many of my guests, I’m scraping a living here, ha-ha-ha.”
Fang Ding smiled.
Luo Yunchang and Zhuo Fan shared a look then said with respect, “Then thank you so much, Steward Fang. Excuse us for imposing.”
“Young miss Luo is too kind.” Fang Ding returned their gesture. Fang Ding lead them out of the tavern. The hostess’ face went dark just then, showing a cruel smile as bloodlust boiled in her eyes…
Fang Ding brought Zhuo Fan’s group minutes later to a large manor. He greeted the guards and walked in. The guards beamed and bowed, unlike any guards from the usual lording clans.
Luo Yunchang felt her hair stand on end noticing the disdain hidden behind the facade, gripping Zhuo Fan’s hand tighter.
“Young miss Luo, please wait a moment while I fetch master.”
In the large hall, Fang Ding bowed as he made his escape.
Zhuo Fan smiled back, looking around the place.
Taking a deep breath, Luo Yunchang whispered, “Zhuo Fan, something definitely not right about this place.”
“Of course there isn’t. Who in their right mind set up a town at the edge of Scarlet Lightning Valley without a good reason? From what I know, there’s been a large war here once, turning it into a wasteland, with no people or resources. Who would ever want to stay here?”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, looking at the manor with a smirk, “The ones coming here can only be those with checkered past no one wants. They only know how to live by harming others, through means no one would speak of in the open. Not even demonic cultivators dare to step in here. For all they know, that bright and cheerful smile could be hiding a bloodthirsty monster.”
Luo Yunchang shuddered, “What the hell are we doing here then? Let’s run before…”
“Run? We came here to scout and check their limits so as to choose the best way to make our move.”
Zhuo Fan mocked, “In a lawless corner like this, just how bad could it get? He wants to be the hunter, but time will tell who the real prey is, humph.”
Luo Yunchang nodded, “Zhuo Fan, are we really going to steal another’s turf?”
“Of course!”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “The Sacred Domain has long since been split up and the borders are not about to change overnight. For outsiders like us who want to keep low, we can only do that by assuming another’s place. There’s nothing remotely honorable about Joy Town, but someone still knows it. That gives us the certified identity we desperately need.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1182 - 1182, Liao Clan Head
chapters.content:
Chapter 1182, Liao Clan Head
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
In a dark room, a used rocking chair creaked as it swayed at the motions of an elderly man with white hair and a dim expression.
Fang Ding bowed, “Clan Head, I’ve looked into them on the way and they’re merchants. The highest level cultivator is their Clan Head, a Spirit King, holding a bit of sway in a small town, they have nothing else to their name. We can begin!”
“How are the goods?” The elderly man spoke in a jittery tone.
Fang Ding was solemn, “Clan Head, be assured they’re exquisite. The young miss and the twelve guards are in Genesis Stage. Only that pretty boy steward is a waste at Bone Tempering Stage and can be ignored.”
“Let’s take a look.”
The elderly man coughed and walked out with Fang Ding behind him.
With a light coughing, the elderly man entered the main hall. Luo Yunchang’s group stood up and greeted him.
The elderly man’s black and blue face, like a freak’s, had the women frightened, and they let out an, “Ah!”
Zhuo Fan squinted, sizing him up.
“Is my face that scary, young miss?” The old man coughed twice and smiled before taking the main seat with Fang Ding at his side.
The women strained to keep a straight face as they bowed, “Clan Head Liao, forgive our loss of composure.”
“It’s fine, I know better than anyone just how ghastly I look. Everyone jumps the first time, ha-ha-ha…” The old man waved off their concern, then sized them up with a glimmer in his eyes.
Luo Yunchang felt a chill come over her, like she was being put on display for others to judge her worth.
The old man restrained his piercing gaze and showed a wide smile, “Steward Fang has been telling me young miss Luo’s father is a lord over a city. Which was it again?”
“Magical City!” Luo Yunchang smiled.
The old man pondered.
[Magical City is nothing special, occupying around a hundred miles, far smaller than my town. Any Spirit King can take the lead there. The Luo clan shouldn’t be a tough nut to crack then…]
The elderly man continued, “Magical City, under whose administration?”
“Liao Clan Head, please, everyone knows the Eight Emperors of the Sacred Domain. Half of Sacred Domain belongs to the Eight Emperors while the other half to the Seven Sacred Mountains. The bits and pieces stuck in between are at the discretion of the tougher Spirit Kings to fight over. They’re places no one cares about and, unfortunately, housing people they care even less.”
Luo Yunchang sighed, “Father offered a gift at the start of the year to the lord of Tempest City and hoped to get his recommendation to gain the Sword Emperor’s help. But even the last of the Sword Emperor’s seventy two city lords did not deign to see us. He even threw our gift out the door, forcing father to come back in disappointment. It’s not easy to get on anyone’s good graces.”
The old man sighed, “Yes, in these times great danger awaits any who do not have a strong backer. You have managed to get a city lord position today, but tomorrow someone else will take it from you.”
“Yes, these are harsh times, eh?”
Luo Yunchang gave him an odd look, “Liao Clan Head, I-I beg your pardon? What do you mean by that last part?”
The old man had an eerie grin, “That I’m so relieved your father has no one to turn to. It’ll give me that much sweeter sleep once I take you, ha-ha-ha…”
Luo Yunchang started in shock and jumped to her feet. The twelve guards and Zhuo Fan moved to defend her.
“Don’t waste your energy, insects.”
The old man sneered and with a flick of his hand, the group felt a gale coming at them and flung them into the air. They then vanished the next second and reappeared in a place where there were piles and piles of bones.
Luo Yunchang shrieked then looked for Zhuo Fan, “Ah, Zhuo Fan, save me…”
“Barrier!”
Zhuo Fan squinted at his surroundings and said, “To think the town had such a place. On the surface it looked flourishing, but beneath it hid a mountain of bones.”
Luo Yunchang clutched to him for dear life as she looked around in worry, “How do we escape?”
“There is no escape! Your meager strength won’t ever get out of my 1st grade sacred array!”
A laughter came from everywhere in this morbid place and the old man reemerged in front of them with a snicker.
Fang Ding and all the town folks were here as well, laughing at the Luo clan’s flustered and panicked looks.
Bang~
Luo Yunchang’s anger-fueled fist let out muffled sounds as it landed on the invisible barrier that surrounding them, roaring, “Geezer, let us out right now or you’ll be sorry!”
“Let you go? Why, on account of your third-rate city’s lord of a father? Ha-ha-ha…”
The old man cackled, “Please, not only do I not fear him, but would you believe me when I tell you that he won’t even suspect me, woman?”
Luo Yunchang’s face fell, her eyes staring hard. Zhuo Fan smiled, “True enough, with Scarlet Lightning Valley being so close, any disappearance would immediately think it is the main reason. Who’d ever think such a joyful little town would hide a den of bloodthirsty monsters?”
“I must say, you’re more than you look, kid. You got good eyes on you.”
The old man cocked an eyebrow as he gave Zhuo Fan another careful look, “I can see it’s not just your pretty looks that got you the steward job. So you do have skill after all. Yes, I picked this place because of Scarlet Lightning Valley offering a perfect excuse for any and all kills that I make. No one would ever think it was me!”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Right, you’re quite cautious, looking into all travelers that reach your town. You’re letting those with backing go while striking at the nameless ones. It mattered little if those little groups the victims belonged to had the power or not, especially since you have Scarlet Lightning Valley as cover. Let’s say your cover is blown, but even then, as peak Spirit King you’d make light work of them. You’ve made a killer living in this place, and it’s safe too.”
“You know me so well, kid, despite being a cripple. I’m starting to like you.” The old man nodded, offering, “Why not join me and I’ll spare you.”
Zhuo Fan smirked.
Luo Yunchang was furious, hammering away at the impervious barrier while screaming like a banshee, “You could be the lord of your own area with your strength, so why did you choose to do such things instead? Even working under the Eight Emperors should be easier than attacking in the shadows.”
The old man gnashed his teeth, then eased with powerlessness.
“Because he has no other choice. No matter how much the Eight Emperors love talent, they’ll never take in someone who uses the Soul Devouring Array. They’d rather avoid repeating the age-old scenario of being hunted down by all of Sacred Domain.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone as he shouted.
The old man shuddered from shock, glaring hard at Zhuo Fan, “W-who the hell are you? How do you know…”
As for the town folk, they were equally overwhelmed.
“Soul Devouring Array? What’s that?” Luo Yunchang frowned hard.
With an evil smile, Zhuo Fan stared at the other party, opening the sordid past hidden for so many years, “Soul Eater is a demonic cultivation art that took everything from another cultivator to further their own power. Only what it’s absorbed also contains regret and hatred, taking its toll on the user’s mind while rotting the body from the inside. Therefore, restraint is an absolute must with this method, to purge all the hatred first and strengthen one’s core before using it again. That is if one doesn’t want to end up becoming a walking corpse.”
Zhuo Fan pointed at the old man’s ghastly face and laughed.
The old man’s face twitched, boiling mad.

chapters.title: Chapter 1183 - 1183, Messing with the Wrong Guy
chapters.content:
Chapter 1183, Messing with the Wrong Guy
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“T-that’s because of the art?” Luo Yunchang gasped.
Zhuo Fan grinned, “Yep, this is where those absorbing constantly without moderation get. Young miss, have another look at the piles of bones. He sucked them dry, so much so that the hatred and death festered beneath his skin so much that his body couldn’t take it. He’s a Spirit King, but with a withered look, he’s getting very close to keeling over. The only thing prolonging his miserable existence is doing it over and over again, which also further amplifies the problem.
“To survive, he has to absorb many more people, leading to more dangerous absorption. This vicious cycle would invoke the wrath of all cultivators. There’s no Emperor out there who would take such an unnecessary risk. It’s like committing social suicide, which is why he would be hated like that patriarch, Liao Tianding in the past.”
“How do you know so much…” The old man looked at Zhuo Fan like he was a monster.
Luo Yunchang’s brow shook, “Liao Tianding?”
“An even more suicidal fool.”
Zhuo Fan smirked, his face grave, “That guy wasn’t as subtle as his grandson here in avoiding genocide. He had no qualms about killing scores of people. He was a demon among demons, the first ever to be called a Demon King. City after city turned into ghost towns with their only residents being piles of bones. His frozen cultivation also jumped from Spirit King all the way to Saint, just short of becoming a Sovereign. All he missed was a Sovereign path, otherwise he would have lived forever.
“Too bad he first became a public enemy, inciting the wrath of the entire Sacred Domain’s dark and white factions. For the first time ever, they joined hands in destroying him. It ended with his death somewhere around Scarlet Lightning Valley, here in fact. His clansmen then vanished into thin air, never to be found. Not that it mattered since this art was something only he knew and it died with him. But by the looks of things, he had passed it on. That’s why you’re all so sneaky in setting up a town here.”
The old man’s face twitched hard, overwhelmed at having his secrets spilled. He pointed a shaky finger at him, stammering, “W-who the hell are you? How do you know a ten thousand-year long secret?”
“Ten thousand years?”
Zhuo Fan mused, “That bastard got me killed around five thousand years after the great battle. I see, so that means that my rebirth through the Nine Serenities Secret Records took me five thousand years.”
The old man roared at having received no answer, “W-what are you? Why do you know…”
“Because I was there as well!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone with malice.
The old man gave him a baffling look, “No, impossible, just how old are you? How could a mere Bone Tempering cultivator have been in that battle?”
“Geezer, I have to say, your patriarch was insufferably arrogant and died. While you have learned from his lesson and kept your head down. It’s a real shame how much you’ve fallen. You are now in the presence of the head of the Eight Emperors in…”
“You’re Sword Emperor Ao Changtian?” The old man cried out.
Zhuo Fan’s face sank, “Since when did that old coot take the throne? I am Demonic Emperor…”
“Demonic Emperor Zhao Chen?” The old man didn’t know restraint, crying over and over and cutting him off.
Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth, “Geriatric fool, are you even listening? In the battle to hunt Liao Tianding down, that rotten punk hadn’t even been born yet. I’m the head of the Eight Emperors of that time!”
“Uh, has there ever been a Demonic Emperor as the head of the Eight Emperors?” The old man blinked, looking utterly lost.
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched and sighed, “Old man, how old are you?”
“Over three thousand years.”
“I see, pipsqueak, you truly deserve getting killed.” Zhuo Fan laughed, “You’ve only come two thousand years later and you’ve already forgotten my name? That’s a death sentence right there. Then again, you ought to die regardless. Being so obscure, so withdrawn from society, with no friends or relatives in the world, no one would even notice your passing. You’re practically made to die. That first reason only made it more obvious.”
Everyone sank in confusion.
Zhuo Fan snickered, “I’m saying that I’m copying your style and killing all the insignificant targets to replace them. From now on, Joy Town will be the Luo clan’s and you will sink into obscurity.”
“What?”
They all stared blankly, then cracked up.
“Ha-ha-ha, take our town? Who do you think you are shouting such idiotic dreams as a Bone Tempering cultivator?”
“Just because you know some old events, you think you can play the senior to intimidate us? Can’t you even tell your stage? A Bone Tempering cultivator gets two centuries at best. Who are you trying to fool by saying you were there, ten thousand years ago?”
“He-he-he, brat, you almost had me with your big talk, but you’re now in my trap and I will suck you dry. Yet you still have the nerve to say you’d take Joy Town from us? What a joke!”
…
Everyone laughed, looking at Zhuo Fan with nothing but scorn.
[No matter how much of a smooth talker you are, you should never say such idiotic things. Even calling yourself some long lost third cousin of an Emperor’s second sister would’ve been smarter if you wanted to live.]
[At least that would intimidate us enough to get you released.]
[But that brash talk? No one’s going to buy that obvious lie…]
Bam!
A sudden explosion rang in their ears even as they laughed, cutting it short soon after.
The Soul Devouring Array had just gone from pristine to total destruction in just a moment. In its place were black flames licking at the edges.
Ugh!
Their smiles got frozen on their faces and their laughter got stuck in their throats. Their eyes were the only things betraying the fear and shock they felt inside.
Zhuo Fan’s left eye flared with the black thunderflame, his smile insufferable, “Sorry, but I’m no comedian. I only know how to follow through with what I say. You’re doomed!”
Zhuo Fan flicked his hand and a black wave shot into the sky, followed by a loud explosion and a shower of black flames.
Hu~
Terrible energies drew near the town folk, enclosing them and the sinister town beneath the joyful facade.
“A-a Spirit King!”
The old man gasped, his mouth trembling, “One… three… twenty! How in the hell did so many of them come here? Who have we messed with?”
Sensing all those raging energy signatures, and none of them on his side, the old man was in despair, with the other struck with dread.
Just what Emperor had they irked to send so many Spirit Kings to their little town?
[Mommy, who the hell are they? Is this an entrapment?]
The old man was a wreck inside, howling, “Everyone run! We can’t take them, just run…”
A boom cut him off and the sky above roiled with black flames. Fang Ding and all other town folk got reduced to ashes.
The old man shook all over, turning a stiff head at Zhuo Fan, to see him smirking, “Flooding the space with your power and controlling it… You’re a Spirit King as well?”
“You got that right!”
Zhuo Fan grinned, raising his hand and shouting, “Die!”
The old man gnashed his teeth, roaring, “I’m a peak Spirit King! You won’t kill me by being in the same stage as me, Thousand Soul Possession!”
Wraiths howled and the air grew cold as they flouted into existence. Despite having the space under his control, the wraiths still appeared.
They didn’t get to survive for long, as the black flames burned them down to nothing a second later.
The old man was dumbstruck.
[What the hell is this? I’m at peak Sword King Stage so why on earth are my actions so damn useless?]
“Geezer, you may be higher in cultivation than me, but I trump you in quality, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan grasped and black flames howled on the old man’s side, slamming into him and covering him completely.
“Agh~!”
His mournful cries filled with pain and horror rent the sky as he twisted in futile attempt at survival. His eyes, however, contained nothing but confusion as he roared in defiance, “J-just who the hell are you?”
“The head of the Eight Emperors five thousand years ago, Demonic Emperor Zhuo Yifan!”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, “Now the Luo clan’s steward, Zhuo Fan. You should be honored for dying at my hand.”
“Aah!”
With one last cry, whether in regret and defiance, or maybe even fear, the old man breathed his last, and his existence burned from this world…

chapters.title: Chapter 1184 - 1184, Another Change
chapters.content:
Chapter 1184, Another Change
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Roar~!
Draconic roars littered the sky as Danqing Shen brought the few Luo clan Spirit Kings from the north side of town, killing their way in. The dragon and sword energies flared unrestrained and took down all people that tried fleeing this disaster.
From the south side, Bali Yuyu turned into a demon, spreading death and destruction with her rain of swords.
Murong Lie was in the east, standing guard and unleashing hell with his flames.
Ouyang Lingtian came in from the west like an ice wall, freezing anyone that tried getting out and turning them into crystallized works of art.
As howls and cries of agony resounded, the town’s population was purged with the closing of the net.
By the time the mortal domain residents entered the town proper, there was nothing but blood and body parts all over. Murong Xue felt it unbearable and searched for Zhuo Fan, “Are these people as bad as you thought, are their crimes so heinous?”
“Ask her.”
Zhuo Fan shrugged and walked to the others, shouting, “Clean up the place, it will be our home for a while!”
The men cheered and started working.
Murong Xue turned to Luo Yunchang, having more pressing concerns, like morality.
Luo Yunchang gave her a smile as she explained what happened. Only then did the woman’s worries ease.
[The town cesspool of pointless killing.]
Like the saying went, evil beget evil. Though imps had no chance of fighting against the likes of a Demonic Emperor.
Murong Xue turned to watch Zhuo Fan giving orders with a smile.
[This demon was right, he’s only going after those that deserve it…]
The housing was distributed according to each individual’s strength, placing the Luo clan’s leadership and the Spirit Kings in the manor.
They just had to touch it up a bit first, like putting up the Luo clan signboard, marking as official the switch from the Liao clan’s town to the Luo clan’s.
Zhuo Fan found a few hidden arrays and other secret tunnels, quite convenient in fact, such that he didn’t need to make any new ones. So after he handled the basic organization, he went into seclusion.
It was not to cultivate, but to fulfill the dear wish of his trusty guardian.
Ding!
The demonic sword made its appearance in a shower of black light as Zhuo Fan worked on setting up a refining array. It hovered about, shaking with excitement and entering the center before Zhuo Fan’s even said anything.
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Blood spirit, you were supposed to be my vital Blood Infant, and I only let you inside the Vaulting Sword to keep its nature. I’m also curious to see if I can do the impossible and combine the five divine swords said to never be melded as one. Even if not a Sovereign weapon, the union of the five sword arts are best suited for me. I should be the one getting excited here, so why are you so eager then? You didn’t look to have gotten much out of the combination of the first four.”
Ding~
The sword rang, its patience nonexistent as it urged him.
“Fine, fine, let’s see what tricks you can do. But let me warn you, you better hang tight as the apocalyptic thunderflame burns you again. It won’t be pretty though.” Zhuo Fan smiled.
The demonic sword swayed in excitement.
Smirking, Zhuo Fan made the signs to start the array, “Sword spirit renewal, five become one as a sacred weapon ascends to give birth to a Sovereign weapon!”
Hu~
Zhuo Fan’s left eye released black flames, melding with the array. The air around the array warped as the black thunderflames covered it completely. The demonic sword was being cooked under the ravaging flames, shaking now and then.
It was good that it couldn’t speak or the room would’ve been echoing with its screams of torment.
Zhuo Fan held out the Sundering Sword, now without a sword spirit, and threw it in.
Crackling sounded as the demonic sword and the Sundering Sword melted and slowly fused.
“Demon Transformation Art!”
Zhuo Fan shouted and released a flood of black energy into the array.
The black smoke engulfed the crackling flames and as the last wave of black smoke came, it enveloped the two swords in darkness. The array turned into a black cocoon, with black energy swirling around its outer layer as explosions of thunder and flames echoed from within.
Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan observed every little change in the array, his heart tense. He had never heard of a Sovereign weapon even existing or anyone attempting to refine one. Although he was piggybacking on Sword Sovereign’s five Sacred weapons, he lacked an ounce of confidence.
[I just can’t tell what will become of the fusion of the five Sacred weapons. Will it be as before, just adding another sword, or will it go through a change?]
[Uniting five sword arts has to be at the level of Sword Sovereign’s sword path, right?]
[I’m really looking forward to it…]
Zhuo Fan stared hard at the writhing ball of darkness, pacing around and sweating out of anxiety.
Time slipped away and flashes kept coming from within. Only about eight hours later did they show signs of growing weaker. The flames were strong still though, while the sword was nowhere in sight.
The only reason he knew it was still there was because Zhuo Fan’s life was connected to the Blood Infant.
After much hesitation, Zhuo Fan reached out, hoping to peer inside.
[But what if the fusing is at a critical point and my interference would ruin it?]
So Zhuo Fan halted, pushing down his curiosity and waited.
It took three whole days before Zhuo Fan ran out of patience, with the ball showing no obvious sign of stopping in the meantime.
Just as he was about to stop the array, the black ball gave a mighty shudder and caused the ground to do the same. Zhuo Fan almost fell.
Boom~
Even the sky started rumbling and warped, with some strange cloud forming, as if in a frown.
Plop~
In the Seven Sacred Mountains, an old man with white beard was perusing a script in a refined pavilion.
The world then shook around him, the peak itself as well and the sky showed multicolored clouds.
Everyone cried out, “Why is this happening again? Didn’t this end with the one a hundred years ago? We didn’t even get to understand that and now another is coming?”
“This is different from the last.”
The old man floated and turned to the others, “Look, a century ago, we couldn’t even use our cultivation, unlike now.”
[Oh, that’s right…]
The other elders floated at once and could finally stand upright, but the sky’s changes had them confused.
[It’s unlike last time, but still quite similar…]
Pa!
In a small bamboo house, a chess piece landed on the board as he turned to look at the sky outside, “After so many years, someone challenging the Sovereign Stage appeared!”
“Who?” Another man spoke in a rough voice.
“Do you remember the one who has the highest chance of dragging down a Sovereign?”
“Patriarch Blood Demon?”
“Him, he had a shot but not his own path and was unable to advance. No matter how strong, he was still no match for a Sovereign. Only…”
Pa!
Another piece fell on the board and the man said,”It can’t be said the same about his Blood Infant.”
“A spirit?”
“Yes, spirits are born in this world, within the scope of the Ten Paths, with none having its own true path, yet having the chance of forming a Sovereign path. Once one has this, one can gamble with a Sovereign. If the Blood Infant stood independent…”
“That’s not possible. Who would just let their vital Blood Infant fly free?” The other man denied it.
The first man lay another piece and sneered, “Yes, one can’t gain without giving up first. This was the reason why that old man could never match a Sovereign. But that’s in the past. There’s no Sovereign path appearing yet the change is still here, showing that someone out there has the potential. I wonder who? Is it one of his friends he brought along, perhaps? Ha-ha-ha, how amusing. The mortal domain is filled with talent. The more barren a place is, the more miracles it enjoys.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1185 - 1185, Apocalyptic Sword Child
chapters.content:
Chapter 1185, Apocalyptic Sword Child
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Boom~
The shaking kept up for six hours.
From his room, Zhuo Fan had no way to see the changing skies, looking startled as he stared at the black ball, afraid of doing anything and ruining it all.
The black ball began hissing and shrunk down to just half a meter in size, revealing a strange shape that made Zhuo Fan tense.
As the ball shrank even more, the shape became clearer. Zhuo Fan’s eyes jumped wider as the black ball vanished.
What was revealed was a thin seven-year-old child with a darker skin tone dressed in pitch-black robes. The ball shrank only because he was absorbing it!
Zhuo Fan was struck dumb.
“Master!”
The child was so sharp that he kneeled and cupped his hands.
Zhuo Fan’s eyebrow jumped, staring hard at him, “Master? Then you’re my vital Blood Infant?”
“Yes, thank you so much master for giving me such a strong body and offering me a vessel.” The kid grinned and said in gratitude, “After the five Sacred weapons combined, I became a Sovereign weapon and Sovereign weapons can take human form. This is the reason behind my appearance. I shall never forget your grace and favor for as long as I live.”
The child kowtowed three times.
Still out of it, Zhuo Fan mumbled to himself before snapping out of it, “A Sovereign weapon taking human form, which means that you, as its sword spirit, are now this body’s soul. I see, so that’s why you were so eager to combine with the last sword. It was a way for you to become human!”
The child scratched his head, laughing at being found out.
“To be honest master, humans are the ultimate beings of the world. All spirits aspire to take human form, to live as they do–to dance, laugh, speak, and create. However, becoming human is fraught with dangers and perils, doubly so for spirits who are less sentient than even common spiritual beasts. I was fortunate enough that master gathered the five sacred weapons and merged them thereby creating a Sovereign weapon, and giving me the means to become human. I have you to thank for all of this, master.”
The child kowtowed again, filled with gratitude.
Zhuo Fan pondered and then sighed, “My vital Blood Infant you were once, but now we’ve grown apart, like our ties have been cut. No wonder you no longer need me to survive, as you now have a Sovereign weapon for a vessel.”
“Master, you have built me this body, making you my parent. How could I ever abandon you?”
Reading between the lines, the child puffed up his chest as he declared, “Henceforth, I am your sword, guarding you and never leaving you, just like old times. The only difference is that I can now exchange actual words with master.”
The child shone and turned into a pitch-black sword, floating towards Zhuo Fan as it glittered. Unlike its previous form, when it had a trace from every sword, all signs of the other swords were removed by adding the fifth one.
Zhuo Fan paused before growing solemn, “You have your own body and your fate is yours to decide. You have finally gained freedom after following me for so many years. Are you content with never wandering the great world outside? Just tell me the truth. We’ve been so close for so long so I won’t make it hard for you.”
“Master, your cold treatment is because you don’t believe me, or that you don’t believe yourself?”
Whoosh~
The demonic sword turned back into a child, his gaze firm. Zhuo Fan paused and found it to be the same look he had.
“I am master’s vital Blood Infant and never had a sense of self, my survival depending on master. Only with time have I gained a personality within you, master. That means all my habits and quirks have come from you, even your heart. I am another master, while you are yourself. If master owes no favor, does that mean I do? Master is giving his all to help the Luo clan and I will give my all to be at your side every step of the way, nothing more nothing less.”
Zhuo Fan jerked, giving him a long look.
[Everything this child knows comes from me. He’s like another me. I am never one to be an ingrate and neither is he.]
[He is a replica of my own personality, so what’s there to doubt? He ceased to be my Blood Infant, but became my strongest companion, a loyal guardian sword.]
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Then you will be my Sword Child, guarding my side.”
“Yes, master!” Sword Child nodded with a bright smile.
Zhuo Fan nodded then paused, giving him an odd look, “Sword Child, would you still be loyal to me even with all the heinous and treacherous acts I’ll be doing?”
“Oh, that, like I said, I learned everything from you and I am just like you. You betray, then I betray. Or maybe, even if you might not let me go, I’ll just off you and go my way. Then I’ll do the same as you, resort to heinous acts to get what I want. It’s that simple.”
Sss~
Zhuo Fan gasped, his heart shuddering, then he patted his chest.
[Alright, at least I’m a man of principle and won’t stoop so low and wallow in filth. Or I wouldn’t just be losing a divine sword, but gaining a powerful enemy.]
Zhuo Fan walked out, his thoughts racing, trying to recall if he had ever betrayed himself.
[The kid better not have copied that as well and treat me the same. Talk about getting what I deserve.]
Sword Child beamed behind him, though he was a little restless.
“Sword Child, how is your strength?”
“Before refining, I’ve been growing alongside you. If you got stronger, so did I, therefore I am a mid-stage Spirit King like you.”
“Oh, then do you know any special skills? Don’t tell me you know all of mine as well.”
“No, I can’t use Divine Eye of the Void nor the apocalyptic thunderflame. Though I took all of the five arts you comprehended and combined them into a sixth.”
“Sixth?”
“The Apocalyptic Sword Art…”
…
Zhuo Fan talked while walking.
[I need to be cautious, not only against enemies, but also taking precautions with myself. It’s a must.]
The two left their room and met with the Luo clan’s higher ups waiting at the door.
Seeing Zhuo Fan come out with someone half his size left them stunned.
“Hasn’t he been in there for three days? Why is there a child by his side? Did he make him himself?”
“That’s no laughing matter. Like three days are enough to bring a child into the world. It takes ten months at the least!”
“Knock it off! You think that’s the problem, how a man birthed a child that grew up so fast? Maybe there’s a hidden tunnel in his room through which the kid sneaked in?”
“Not possible. I’ve been on guard every minute on the hour ever since Steward Zhuo entered seclusion. There’s not a fly going past me without my knowing, let alone a child.”
…
Everyone started a heated debate over this very crucial topic. Zhuo Fan snickered, “What are you all doing here? Did something happen?”
“Uh, Steward Zhuo, the world started shaking and the sky changed colors. We came to see if you were fine.” Li Jingtian bowed.
Zhuo Fan waved his concern away, “I’m fine, so you can return. Our cultivation has been soaring recently and needs time to stabilize. After that, we have big things ahead of us.”
“We know!”
They all nodded, with no plan on leaving. Their curious eyes glued to Sword Child.
Catching on to their obvious curiosity, he made the introduction, “He’s my personal guard, the Apocalyptic Sword Child!”
“Personal guard?”
They all started, “Steward Zhuo, you need a guard at your level? That means he can’t be too far behind your strength. A pipsqueak…”
“Yeah, dad, if you really wanted one, pick me instead.” Gu Santong gave Zhuo Fan an odd look.
Bang!
Zhuo Fan knocked on his head, chiding, “You dare say that about others? Which six-year-old, I wonder, lorded about in Tianyu like he owned it?”
“How is that the same, I’m a Qilin!” Gu Santong puffed up his chest in pride.
Pa!
A dark and thin palm landed on his shoulder, “Young master San, a spar will make everything clearer. Ha-ha-ha…”
Gu Santong shook, meeting a pair of black eyes and an evil smirk.
[Mommy, he has the same look as dad. Is he some long lost son out of wedlock?]
Gu Santong jumped in fright…

chapters.title: Chapter 1186 - 1186, Qilin vs. Sovereign Weapon
chapters.content:
Chapter 1186, Qilin vs. Sovereign Weapon
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Place your bets! No take backs!”
The Joy Town that had been bathed in blood was once again filled with noise, only this time, it happened a hundred miles outside of it, in a valley.
Qiu Yanhai even had a stall set up as he shouted, “We’re all friends here people, so don’t be shy and place your bets to make this place livelier. Our young master San has a one to three odds, and on the other side we have Steward Zhuo’s secret guard, the Apocalyptic Sword Child, one to five odds. All bets are now open!”
People already gathered around and started taking out all their valuables. The stall was packed with pills, spiritual weapons and all kinds of super rare ingredients.
With a bang, a large scarlet wine jar creaked the stall’s boards.
Everyone knew then and there who was the weirdo behind such an exotic bet.
Qiu Yanhai’s face twitched, turning to the Wine Sword Immortal’s red nose, “Senior, while I did say there’s no limit, to make it livelier, but you can’t just take out some jar of wine? That’s like ten spirit stones, tops!”
“You call this ten spirit stones? What you see right here is an aged and fine wine of the Murong clan. I made the trip to their home just to get it before coming with you all. It’s always on high demand. The only reason I’m willing to part with such a great wine is seeing you all so fired up.” Wine Sword Immortal patronized.
Qiu Yanhai shook his head, “Fine, I’ll write down ten sacred stones, on account of your seniority. Now who will you be betting on?”
“Isn’t it obvious? Steward Zhuo’s young master San!”
The Wine Sword Immortal chuckled, “With all the action going on so far, everyone knows of Gu Santong’s strength, no less than ours. And since we’ve gotten to the Sacred Domain, everyone reached the Spirit King Stage while his power had to have improved as well. As for that Sword Child, he doesn’t look like much, so I’d rather be on the safe side and stick with young master San.”
Everyone nodded in approval. Rather than taking a risk on an unknown fighter, they’d play it safe by betting on Gu Santong.
A zither then slammed on the stall, followed by a casual voice, “I’m betting on Sword Child.”
“Liu Mubai?”
The Wine Sword Immortal gave him an odd look, “You know his strength to bet on him?”
Liu Mubai snickered as he shook his head, “Nope, but for Zhuo Fan to make him a personal guard, that should be proof enough, right? In fact, I find young master San awfully rash for taking on his challenge just like that. Knowing the enemy is what gets you victory. While he is an open book, the opponent is sealed shut. That’s why the Sword Child has a higher chance at winning.”
“Makes sense, exactly what I’d expect from the Zither Sword King who bid his time to exact revenge for his clan, calculative and observant.” The others lit up and switched their bets from Gu Santong to the Sword Child.
The Wine Sword Immortal licked his dried lips as he moved his wine jar as well, “Uh, Liu Mubai, I’ll trust you on this, but you better pay me back if I lose.”
“Sure, and my zither is also among those bets, ha-ha-ha…” Liu Mubai didn’t mind it, looking at the fighters on their peaks with a smile.
Ever since the empire fell, he had felt so relieved having his wish granted and also brighter in his demeanor.
On the side where there was constant cheering, Zhuo Fan, Luo Yunhai and the rest were standing on a hill and watching the two filled with battle lust.
Luo Yunhai said, “Big brother Zhuo, who is the Sword Child? Can he take on young Sanzi?”
“He should.”
Zhuo Fan said, “Young Sanzi became an early-stage Spirit King after coming to the Sacred Domain, but the Sword Child is my demonic sword transformed, with half my skills. In fact, he should have all my skills besides my eyes. He shouldn’t lose out against young Sanzi.”
[What?!]
They all shouted, “He’s that divine sword?”
“Sure is, and precisely because he’s not human, but a spirit in a sword, we can’t see his cultivation.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “In his words, he’s the same as me, a mid-stage Spirit King. As for his strength, we’ll just have to wait and see. Letting young Sanzi fight is the perfect chance.”
The others nodded, with Qiao’er sadly staring at Gu Santong.
[Brother, do be careful, the kid is father’s sword and not human. In a fight between a divine sword and sacred beast, victory might not be so easy…]
Gu Santong was totally in the dark about his opponent’s nature, judging him by his young appearance, that he was still too young.
[If he’s a sacred beast, his form means he’s not matured yet. If he’s a human, then that makes him weak as a lamb.]
So he boasted, “Kid, we’re on the same side, so I’ll give you the chance to walk away. I won’t judge you for it, nor make it hard on you, for father.”
“Young Sanzi, you’re as cocky as ever.”
The Sword Child smirked, “Even as a sacred beast, you’re now in Sacred Domain and only an adolescent. There’re plenty of people that can kill you. I’ll just help father by giving you a fair warning, so the next time you go out, you’ll be a bit cautious and not lose your life.
[Eh?]
Gu Santong shook, giving him an odd look.
[Is he really dad’s son? His tone, his style, his arrogance, they’re practically the same!]
All the others gave Zhuo Fan strange looks.
[Steward Zhuo, that’s a miniature version of you, in child form.]
Zhuo Fan smiled.
[The Sword Child had taken everything from me, resembling me more than a son.]
Gu Santong saw no reaction from Zhuo Fan and made up his mind.
[It doesn’t look like the kid is close to dad, and I can set him straight.]
He put on a mean face and smirked, “I could accept it coming from dad, but from a pipsqueak? It sounds more like a taunt. We’ll see who beats who soon enough!”
Gu Santong shot forth and his fist glowed scarlet as he struck at Sword Child. Though it was obvious there was some restraint, leaving a third of his strength behind. Though Gu Santong still thought it excessive and brought it down to just half his strength.
“Young master San, just let loose and come at me with everything. I can easily take it.”
The Sword Child smirked, his eyes set as a red glow shot from his finger and at Gu Santong’s fist.
Whoosh~
A sword wave soared.
It clashed with Gu Santong’s first, letting out a deafening boom. Gu Santong shuddered all over and got pushed back a hundred meters. His gaze now horrified as he turned to Sword Child, “Soaring Sword Art, and at peak strength? How do you have such power? Only dad can unleash it to this level…”
“He inherited Steward Zhuo’s sword skills fully, worthy of being his sword.” Shangguan Feixiong’s eyes shook in admiration.
Zhuo Fan grinned, “He was connected with me, body and mind till now. It’s normal to know the five sword arts. And from what he told me, he also learned a sixth one. Now that’s something I’d like to see.”
“Sixth?”
Shangguan Feixiong and the others nodded, “Right, with Steward Zhuo learning the sword arts to the peak, his divine sword’s spirit has to be even sharper, able to combine the five arts. Now I’m also looking forward to seeing it, ha-ha-ha…”
They all laughed, looking eager as the battle unfolded.
At the betting stall, all those who were about to bet on Gu Santong shifted to the other guy. Qiu Yanhai cursed, “What do you think you’re doing? Have you no ethics? Saying you’d take it and leave it but now that young master San is lacking, you switch tunes? Fat chance!”
“Damnit, I only lost that exchange and now they’ve all lost their faith in me? How mortifying, I got to up my game!”
Gu Santong’s face twitched hearing Elder Qiu’s shouts, anger getting to him as he shot for Sword Child, “Lousy brat, I was going easy on you, but no more. Get ready, ha-ha-ha…”
Gu Santong’s hands shook and struck at the air.
Boom!
It felt like the world was collapsing as the air warped from all the shaking. It got so strong, black scars appeared in space, spreading fast towards the Sword Child. The cracking sounds jarring to the ears.
The audience gasped.
[The space fractured! Doesn’t that mean letting a scar touch you would tear you to pieces?]
[This is too much!]
Gu Santong’s past attempt with this move only warped the air. Now though, he was at the Spirit King level and could warp space. Space was the place where everything existed. By rupturing it, then the space being occupied would be torn to shreds.
[Steward Zhuo, it’s turning deadly!]
Everyone turned to Zhuo Fan.
He was still just looking with a smile, “The kid ain’t human, making no difference even if the sky got torn apart.”
The others exclaimed.
[But of course, he’s a divine sword! The space rupturing won’t affect him…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1187 - 1187, Fatality
chapters.content:
Chapter 1187, Fatality
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Condense!”
The spatial crack struck at the Sword Child like a viper, the blackness therein promising to swallow him whole.
Sword Child couldn’t care less, evident by his smirk, as he shouted and flicked his hand.
A cold wind blew and the encroaching scars slowly lost their speed until they froze in place, with a trace of ice even revealed on them.
Gu Santong gasped, “Heaven Sealing Sword Art?”
“Ha-ha-ha, yes, I am master’s sword any sword art he knows, I know. That’s why, young master San, feel free to come at me with everything.”
The Sword Child smiled, finally going for Gu Santong. He waved a finger and flames exploded into an inferno. The black gaps in space merged with the flames and slowly healed. With the path cleared between the two, the Sword Child had an easy time shooting for Gu Santong’s face to poke him with a crackling finger.
Gu Santong’s face twitched and stepped back while using his fist to defend, “Decimating Sword Art and Sundering Sword Art, how is it you know all my dad’s five sword arts to perfection? No son could ever do so much. Who are you?”
“I told you, I’m master’s sword.”
Bam!
Gu Santong unleashed his full power at long last, his fist sending a scarlet wave that struck at the purple thunder sword wave. The intense clash had crushed forty mountains around the area to dust. Gu Santong shuddered, forced to step back from the aftermath.
The Sword Child laughed as the shock wave came, pointing at Gu Santong, “I am a divine sword in body, not of flesh and blood. I don’t fear my insides getting jolted, not when I haven’t got any. That’s where a sacred beast differs from me, Vaulting Sword, Dragon Soar!”
With a draconic cry, the Sword Child pressed his advantage, sending another sword wave with his finger. This time, Gu Santong barely got himself steady to brace for impact.
All he could do, in the end, was punch back.
Bam!
Gu Santong’s hasty punch lacked his full power and was once again pushed back.
The Sword Child smiled, standing still, “Most cultivators would try to settle the rattling inside them before the damage mounts instead of unleashing strikes so fast. I don’t have such a problem. I could hound you and kill you in just ten moves, all while you couldn’t even defend. The outcome is clear and there’s no point of fighting, ha-ha-ha…”
“What a deadly sword!”
The audience gasped in shock, “Steward Zhuo, a humanoid divine sword is so dangerous, bereft of weaknesses. His body is even stronger than a sacred beast, unheard of!”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Yeah, even I didn’t think young Sanzi would lose so fast. That’s why the Sword Child was so thankful for me refining him such a body. As a divine sword, it’s truly godlike. I wonder if there’s anything out there that can hold him back.”
Zhuo Fan mused.
[He has everything I have, except for the eyes…]
Everyone was grave.
[The Sword Child is simply monstrous. But what if he turns on us?]
He called himself Zhuo Fan’s sword, but that was a weapon in the end, one that had no will but to follow its master’s intent.
[But with the kid as he is…]
“Steward Zhuo, he’s got your smugness to a tee.” Leng Wuchang pointed out, “Though he looks rather young, and youngsters tend to have overblown egos…”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Yes, he’s just like me. Only that in my early years I was restrained, more ruthless than brash. He has no constraints, and while he is a second me, we will most likely walk different paths, and he needs someone to watch over him.”
“Brilliant, Steward Zhuo!” Leng Wuchang nodded. Zhuo Fan’s eyes turned frosty as he observed the fight.
Gu Santong was a powder keg ready to pop from being pushed around so much. He roared then and, in a flash of red, the image of a three hundred meter Qilin appeared overhead. Its roar shaking the world.
The Spirit Kings felt their hearts seize from shock.
“Young master San wants to go all out, making everything shake. Can the Sword Child take it? I’ll just bet this wine jar on young master San!”
Wine Sword Immortal got shocked as well and switched his bet again, with many others following him.
Only Liu Mubai and a few others were relaxed, “Wine Sword Immortal, you’re gonna be sorry. Check out the Sword Child’s look.”
Wine Sword Immortal turned and only now noticed that despite Gu Santong raging and roaring, the Sword Child held nothing but disdain in his eyes.
“Young master San, since you don’t know a helping hand when you see one, you leave me no choice.”
The Sword Child’s eyes shone and raised a finger. A black power gathered, “You went all out, so you should have a look at my sixth sword art, Apocalyptic Sword’s strength!”
