The prideful Gu Santong’s eyes shook, unable to take the other’s naked taunt. He roared and his power surged before he punched with both fists, “Lousy brat, have a taste of this, Upheaval, a Soaring Qilin’s might!”
The piercing howl rang in everyone’s ears as the Qilin image opened its maw. It then shot for the Sword Child with fury burning in its eyes, ready to burn the world if it had to.
“Come on!”
The Sword Child snickered, the black sword wave ready as he struck.
Hu~
It was anticlimactic how plain it was launched, with no fuss, like a breeze tracing the air.
The sword wave, however, erased everything in its path, even the dust, from existence.
The sword wave looked flimsy by all accounts, yet it struck fear in the hearts of all who watched.
It was not total destruction and explosiveness that was scary, but the silent yet decimating moves that could take lives without leaving a sign.
Zhuo Fan was out for two seconds before he came to and understood the gap between the fighters, “Sword Child, stop this right now!”
Too little, too late. The black sword wave reached young Sanzi’s Qilin image, but there was no bang, not even a fizzle. The black wave passed through the image, making it pause before fading away, purged from this world.
Young Sanzi coughed blood at the backlash, looking pale, but the black wave was coming with death behind it.
Young Sanzi panicked, everyone panicked.
[This is fatality!]
“Sword Child, didn’t you hear me? I told you to stop!” Zhuo Fan shouted in anger.
Sword Child’s brow shook and gave a cruel smile at the panicked face, with no intention of stopping.
Hum~
The space started warping then, with the Sword Child at its center.
He looked back at Zhuo Fan with a frown, only to see his cold gaze and the seven golden halos in his right eye.
“Master, don’t…”
“Divine Eye of the Void 7th stage, Void Seal!” Zhuo Fan muttered.
Whoosh~
The space contracted, and the Sword Child shook as his eyes went blank and collapsed. He turned back into the pitch-black sword, with a dim glow.
It showed no signs of being alive.
The black sword wave coming at Gu Santong faded away just in time as well, making him breathe easier for having escaped with his life.
[That strike is deadly, no less than dad’s apocalyptic thunderflame…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1188 - 1188, Advancing Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 1188, Advancing Again
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Thump~
Zhuo Fan walked over to the Apocalyptic Sword and picked it up with a sigh, “You really are me, but only the young me, twisted, conceited and obnoxious. Ha-ha-ha, foolish boy, you thought by having a Sovereign weapon body, I couldn’t take you on? The five divine swords were affected by the Divine Eye of the Void and this form isn’t any different. Think long and hard about this.”
Zhuo Fan made a seal and the demonic sword entered his body.
“And you, young Sanzi, there’s always someone better then you out there. This will be your lesson.” Zhuo Fan walked to Gu Santong and warned.
Gu Santong hung his head, giving a heavy nod, “I know, dad. I won’t be as arrogant again.”
“You’ve said that a hundred times already. Why would I believe you this time? Ha-ha-ha, you’ll learn the more you suffer.” Zhuo Fan shook his head.
The others came over and bowed, “Steward Zhuo, how will you handle the Sword Child? He’s a loose cannon.”
“I’ll handle it, don’t worry.”
Zhuo Fan soothed their fears, “With these few days of peace, we’ve found a temporary residence in the Sacred Domain. To grow bigger however, we must first take down one of the Eight Emperors. That being said, I’ll be setting out to get a feel of the Sacred Domain’s current situation to remove all unknowns. Wait for my message and be ready to move!”
“Won’t it be too dangerous to go alone?”
“Yeah, I’ll come with you!”
Luo Yunchang spoke up, with Bali Yuyu stepping forth.
Zhuo Fan calmed them down, “It’s fine. The Sacred Domain is my world. I know it better than any of you. I have enough strength to survive even an encounter with an Emperor. Rest assured that I’ll be alright.”
“Shuang’er, come over for a minute!”
Zhuo Fan called Yun Shuang to remain after the others were now at ease, and whispered, “Did you finish what I asked you to do? Did you divine her location?”
Yun Shuang’s brow shook, “For some reason, I am blind to sister Qingcheng’s fate, just like yours. Patriarch said that you lost something. Did you give it to her? Can it hide one’s fate?”
“The Sovereign path?”
Zhuo Fan squinted and asked ardently, “How else am I supposed to find her? Where do I start searching the big Sacred Domain without so much as a clue?”
Shuang’er bit her lip, “Forgive me for being unable to help, but…”
“But what?”
“You alone can find her!”
“Me?”
“Yeah.”
“I know nothing of reading the stars…”
“Didn’t Patriarch give you something? It will guide you towards what or who you want to find.” Slightly explained, “Patriarch also mentioned that what you’re looking for is yours. The two of you would be drawn to each other. By using the item, you’ll find it and sister Qingcheng.”
Zhuo Fan thought for a bit and nodded, “I see, Sovereign Yun gave me the black sphere for this purpose. But how do I use it?”
“Figure it out yourself. I surely don’t know.” Yun Shuang shrugged.
Zhuo Fan sighed and nodded, his eyes blazing with determination, “I’ll try it as I go. Now I need to get away so the fear of the Sword Child caused will fade. I must also teach that boy some manners.”
Zhuo Fan cupped his hands to her and the rest, leaving.
The others gave him a respectful goodbye as well, while only a red-nosed old man just wouldn’t let go of a jar of wine, crying like his parents were dead, like an old woman.
“My precious wine, I could never leave you. How could my foolproof mind ever conceive the risk of betting on Gu Santong?”
“Senior, betting is business. You made the wrong wager so I can’t help you. Now let go!”
The Wine Sword Immortal wailed like a child while Qiu Yanhai fought to try and pry the drunkard’s fingers from the jar. With their gap in cultivation, no amount of effort helped in the end.
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched and gave the two geezers a long look.
[What was I thinking bringing these fools?]
Zhuo Fan left as the rest sent him off. After a good distance, he looked around and found a deserted cave, setting up an array to hide himself as he took out Sovereign Yun’s black orb.
Looking into the Sacred Domain’s situation was more of a whim, while finding Chu Qingcheng was his real goal.
He couldn’t have said that to the guys, since they came with him to a new world to settle down, not help him find his woman. How could their de-facto leader ever do such a petty and irresponsible thing? When they found out he was up to no good, going on a hike, they might just as well go out and meet their fortune elsewhere.
A remarkable leader had to, at all times, inspire fairness and grandeur.
[As for looking after my family and other private stuff, that goes behind doors, he-he.]
Taking out the black orb, Zhuo Fan stared hard, “Qingcheng, where are you? And how do you start this thing anyway? Sovereign Yun, what a guy, giving me the tools but not the manual. Where do I even start?”
Zhuo Fan whined.
As he stared deep into the orb, his gaze grew hazy and the darkness inside the orb swirled, pulling him in.
Hu~
Zhuo Fan shuddered and his eyes went black. He plopped on the ground with eyes wide open, coming to his senses the next moment, only to find himself surrounded by stars in a black space. Stars flew by him so close, he could reach them with his hands.
“W-where am I? What am I doing here?”
Zhuo Fan jerked around and then recalled, “Sovereign Yun’s place was the same. My mind must’ve entered the orb. Is this how you use the treasure? But how am I supposed to find her now?”
Zhuo Fan frowned, looking up at the glittering stars in doubt while he paced around in thought.
“Yun clan’s Holy Maiden can read the heavens through the stars. Sovereign Yun reads mortals’ fate through the stars as well. Maybe to find Qingcheng I have to understand the stars’ motions? Should I go to Shuang’er for tips? But it looks more like a trait than an art. Yun clan’s leader is the only one able to do it. What to do?”
Zhuo Fan stared at the sky, in a dilemma.
His face began slacking as he took in the stars’ glows, noticing something peculiar.
“Kid, humans are the ultimate beings of the world, the basic of all other things. Humans hold 360 small cosmoses within that work in tune with the universe. Each person has a protector star. When you observe the skies, you are in fact looking at their fate. Your eyes do not see the starry night sky, but the universe’s cycle of reincarnation. To find what you seek, use your heart and you will grasp it!”
An aged voice whispered in his ears, making his heart jump and focus harder on the stars.
Zhuo Fan stared blankly, ignoring everything, time itself, as he gazed upon the starts and their movements. His Yuan Qi began moving along with the stars, in strange and baffling patterns.
At one point, he realized the stars melded with him. Looking at the stars was like looking at his body’s innards. The flow of blood, breathing, all made his organs shake, understanding it all.
[I want to find Qingcheng!]
As he grasped everything, his heart throbbed and the stars followed his wish. His senses perceived as the brightest nine stars formed a line, shooting eastward.
Nine stars in a row, deceiving the heavens and changing fate, hidden from a Sovereign’s power.
[She’s in the east!]
Zhuo Fan lit up and shook awake. He got up and found the black orb at his side.
Putting it away, Zhuo Fan was in high spirits as he shot out of the cave. He noticed it was dark then, with the stars in the sky being the same ones he saw in the orb, and the brightest nine forming a line.
Was it the black orb affecting the stars, or did they reflect what was in the black orb? Or maybe Zhuo Fan was controlling them?
Confused, Zhuo Fan felt stunned.
[Hot damn, I advanced again, I’m now a late-stage Spirit King!]
What’s more important was that his surface cultivation level had dropped to the 1st layer of Bone Tempering Stage.
[My heart grew once more…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1189 - 1189, The Ruby Cloud Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 1189, The Ruby Cloud Sect
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Whoosh~
Beneath the sunny and clear sky, Zhuo Fan darted across the land, his eyes holding a strange light as he used the stars to be his guide.
Glancing at the sky, he squinted and smiled. He was getting close to the last of nine stars’ position, close to the one he wished to see.
Zhuo Fan got excited. Ever since he saw the stars inside the black orb, he felt odd, like there was something connecting him with every little thing in the world. He could even see the stars in broad daylight.
“Senior sister, master had us take the Purple Gold Glazed Cup and meet up with senior aunt’s group in Mist City for a treasure competition, to make sure we get our hands on the map to the Nether Sea. But I just don’t feel right leaving junior sister behind all by herself.”
“And why not? That dumb girl is as plain of talent as she is of strength. Not just I, but even all of you are stronger than her. What’s the point in bringing a dead weight?”
“She’s just relying on master’s favor to come along and get a share no matter how much in the wrong she is…”
“But master said so…”
“Quiet! That sickening girl must’ve strung master along with her sweet words. All she’s good at is sucking up. There’s no way I’m about to share credit, for such an important mission, with her! We’ll just say she was too slow and couldn’t keep up.”
Their nagging echoed through the thick forest, reaching Zhuo Fan’s sharp ears.
Nether Sea?
[Isn’t that the Nether Sovereign’s place? Although I’ve caught a glimpse of it in the mortal domain’s World Wind Tunnels, I had no idea how to enter it. But could such a map be real?]
Zhuo Fan paused and rushed over to the forest. He got his clothes in order and casually walked through the vegetation.
Rustle~
“Who’s there?” A sharp cry came as six sharp swords glinted as they shot for the bush.
Zhuo Fan felt their bloodthirst before he saw their faces.
Zhuo Fan snickered, but still faked panic, “Wait, wait! I lost my way and don’t mean any harm!”
Zhuo Fan rushed out of the bush, shaking in fear. Before him were six pretty girls, all perfect beauties in their own right, yet their cold eyes ruined the image.
They sized him up and noticed him in the Bone Tempering Stage. They sighed with ease and the leader, their senior sister, mocked, “You’re so old yet only in the Bone Tempering Stage? Never knew someone like you existed in Sacred Domain. Humph, so weak and yet you’re wandering around a forest? A spiritual beast might pounce on you at any time and leave only your bones behind.”
“Very true, I also know this is dangerous, but I have to earn a living. There’s nothing else I can do besides picking herbs, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan gave a silly laugh, his face foolish as his sharp eye inspected their cultivation.
[Oh, three Spirit Kings, one mid-stage, two early-stage, with the rest being at peak Genesis Stage. Quite a strong team.]
Zhuo Fan snickered and bowed again pretending to be confused, “Misses, may I ask you what is up ahead? I’ve been in this forest for three months, unable to come out.”
“A mere Bone Tempering cultivator got what he deserves being stuck out here when you can’t even fly.”
The senior sister relished in his predicament, with the other girls shooting him mocking smiles. She said again, feeling proud for some reason, “Boy, you’re better off turning back before you meet your end in this forest. And don’t go any further, lest you want a painful death.”
“Why?”
“Ahead is the Ruby Cloud Sect!” The senior sister sneered.
Zhuo Fan exclaimed, his face sinking.
[I was wondering why this place felt familiar, it turns out to be close to the Ruby Cloud Sect. Humph, I’ve been following the nine stars for so many months, ignoring the places I pass, all so I can find my wife.]
Oblivious to his reaction, or better yet, never even registering anything about Zhuo Fan’s person, the senior sister arched her slim eyebrow and kept on patronizing him, “You must’ve heard as well of my sect’s rules. Any man that dare come uninvited is to have a fate worse than death. Dying in a spiritual beast’s mouth is heaven compared to that. So be smart and get lost, humph.”
[Ha-ha, you think I don’t know that? Who doesn’t know of those old biddies and their menopause.]
Zhuo Fan snickered inside, showing a weird smile on the outside, “Does that mean you’re all Ruby Cloud Sect disciples?”
“Yes, scared now?”
The six girls thrusted their chest out in pride, their eyes holding nothing but loathing, “We’re on a mission right now and even though we’re on a tight schedule, you should be honored for us to look after a nobody like you. If you had met our master, he-he…”
Clang!
Zhuo Fan’s smirk grew wider, clenching his fists, “If I really had met your master, it would’ve been really bad indeed. As for you…”
Zhuo Fan’s Qilin arm gave a cold aura.
“Senior sister, please wait up…”
A gentle voice sounded and a girl of around twenty, dressed in white, huffed as she entered their sights.
[Just another corpse.]
Zhuo Fan huffed inside.
The others were annoyed, “How did this girl even follow us? She’s worse than a ghost!”
“Senior sister!”
The girl giggled as she landed on the leader’s side, “Why didn’t you wait for me and went ahead? I could hardly keep up.”
The senior sister rolled her eyes in disdain, “Junior sister, the road is dangerous and we didn’t want you to tire and meet with danger. You should go back. Master cares for you so much and won’t punish you for returning. Just say that I told you so.”
“Senior sister, don’t say that. We’re close sisters, and I can help you when you’re in trouble. It’s also my very first mission outside the sect. I can’t just fail it.”
The girl was quite lively, totally oblivious to her senior sisters’ disdain. She was like a sheep raised in the pen that had never braved the dangers of the wild outdoors.
Zhuo Fan snickered, giving her a long look, “Your senior sisters only think of you when they say you should stay in the sect. The world is fraught with dangers, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan clenched a fist behind him, his eyes gleaming coldly.
“Hey, who are you? You can also tell they’re nice to me?” With a pure smile, the girl turned to Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan held the same odd smile as he nodded.
[Yes, they’re so nice to send you to hell, but now I see you came for death yourself…]
Ugh!
Zhuo Fan shuddered just then, looking deep in the girl’s eyes and felt his heart racing.
[She’s really plain, no amazing beauty, but delicate and innocent.]
Those eyes gave him a familiar feeling.
The girl looked into his eyes at the same time, lost for a moment, “Have we met before?”
“What is your name?” Zhuo Fan’s heart jumped.
“Qingcheng!” The girl spoke without hesitation, considering Zhuo Fan as one of her friends on the spot, “Chu Qingcheng!”
Zhuo Fan froze as he took her in fully and muttered like in a dream, “Chu Qingcheng, still the same name…”
His numb mind looked in the distance then turned to the girl’s lost eyes, the fist behind relaxing as he smiled.
[Qingcheng, I found you at last…]
The rough hands held Chu Qingcheng’s soft cheeks, his eyes looking only at her and appreciating her for who she was with a soft gaze.
Chu Qingcheng showed no revulsion to this stranger. She felt an odd sensation inside, like she knew this man but could not recognize him…

chapters.title: Chapter 1190 - 1190, You Have to Be Mine
chapters.content:
Chapter 1190, You Have to Be Mine
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Bam!
Zhuo Fan drew closer as he held that cute face, but then a palm sent him flying and into the ground. Chu Qingcheng jumped and blushed hard as she recalled what happened.
“Damn punk, you got some nerve going after a Ruby Cloud Sect disciple! You must have a death wish!” The senior sister started cursing at Zhuo Fan on the ground, about to stomp on his legs for good measure.
Chu Qingcheng saw it and managed to stop her.
[Heavens damn it, nosy crow!]
Zhuo Fan’s brow twitched as his anger boiled.
The couple finally got together after so many years, but they couldn’t even enjoy the reunion as the retarded biddy had to ruin it. Zhuo Fan wanted nothing more than to flatten them to a gooey mush.
The only thing holding him back was knowing Chu Qingcheng was from Ruby Cloud Sect. So he took a deep breath to bottle the rage. It just wouldn’t do for the husband to waste his wife’s besties in a fit of fury.
[Why did Chu Qingcheng end up appearing in Ruby Cloud Sect of all places?]
Checking the nine stars’ direction and recalling the familiar feeling he got from this girl, Zhuo Fan was certain beyond any shadow of a doubt that she was Qingcheng, and not just in name either.
Making a monumental effort to restrain himself, Zhuo Fan put on a pained look as he crawled to his feet. He saw the angry shrews and raised his hands in a rush to explain, “Sisters, please, the striking similarity young miss has with my late younger sister made me lose myself in emotions. It won’t happen again next time.”
“Next time? You think you can just touch a lady’s face?” The senior sister was outraged, about to smash him into the ground again, but Chu Qingcheng jumped in, “Senior sister, please, he must’ve loved his sister dearly and didn’t know that he was doing something improper. It wasn’t with intention, so please don’t blame him.”
“Humph, blame him? For what, it wasn’t me who he was hitting on anyway. Since you don’t care, why should I?”
The senior sister flicked her sleeve with a snarl, flying away with her other sisters, “Let’s just go and not waste time with that fool. She deserves being taken advantage of for falling for a rotten man’s lies.”
“Senior sister…”
Chu Qingcheng cried after her, but the women were gone, and she hung her head sadly. She then blinked her big bright eyes at Zhuo Fan, “Did you do that because I looked like your little sister, or was it… on purpose?”
Under her hopeful and intense gaze, Zhuo Fan knew she was looking for comfort, to justify her act of kindness. It would’ve been so much easier to just nod and play along.
While he didn’t mind with others, towards Qingcheng, he could lie. Now that the extras were gone from butting in, he could come clean.
“No, I really couldn’t help myself, but not because of my little sister, since I don’t have one. It’s because of my lover.”
“Wha…”
Chu Qingcheng went red on the spot, then she glared before turning to leave, “I was wrong about you, thinking you were nice, but it turns out you’re just like senior sister said. You did it to take advantage of me and end up making them call me a fool.”
Chu Qingcheng looked hurt, following after the women when Zhuo Fan shouted, “Wait!”
“What now? If you try anything, you’ll be sorry!” Chu Qingcheng paused, then looked back at him hesitantly and threatened.
Her tone only made Zhuo Fan chuckle.
[She’s in Genesis Stage and I’m in Bone Tempering Stage, by all appearances, yet she is using that shy tone? How is that normal?]
Zhuo Fan shook his head, giving her a long and deep stare, “Miss, I was not toying with you, nor did I try to take advantage of you. It’s truly because I see you as my lover. My wife died and seeing you resemble her, emotions overwhelmed me.”
Chu Qingcheng started, looking in Zhuo Fan’s honest gaze and blushed as she gave a weak nod.
“You must really love your wife. Then I won’t hold you to what happened.” The naive young miss turned around, wanting to leave with the matter settled.
“Wait!”
“What is it this time?”
Chu Qingcheng paused and looked back curiously.
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Miss Chu, I can tell you’re a good person. Could you do me a little favor? I got lost in this forest and could you give me a lift?”
“Take you… with me?”
“You can’t?”
“Uhm, I guess I can.”
She looked conflicted, but against Zhuo Fan’s request, she just couldn’t find it in her to refuse. She shyly got to Zhuo Fan’s side and looked to see if the coast was clear before she reached out around his waist, “Uh, I’ll fly you out, j-just don’t move…”
Chu Qingcheng jumped and they were in the air.
Pa!
Zhuo Fan took this moment to reach around her waist.
Chu Qingcheng panicked and blushed harder, “What are you doing? Hands off!”
“Miss, I’m a Bone Tempering cultivator and I’m scared for my first time flying.” With a wide grin, Zhuo Fan took all the advantage he could.
Chu Qingcheng was left succumbing to his sly hand and focused on making the trip as short as possible.
Pa!
At one point, Zhuo Fan’s head up and leaned on the girl’s shoulder.
Chu Qingcheng jerked and cried again, “What are you leaning on me for?”
“First time flying is scary.” Zhuo Fan smiled wider, to which Chu Qingcheng gaped. She was simply powerless against Zhuo Fan’s slick tactics and reasoning. Despite it all, she still couldn’t find a reason to hate him, taking a deep breath to warn instead, “Hey, have some manners. Try anything again and I-I-I’ll drop you!”
This time Zhuo Fan went for the kill, moving from simply leaning on her shoulder to hugging outright.
Chu Qingcheng’s heart was in chaos, her cheeks steaming from how red they were.
“What are you doing? Let me go!”
“No, I’m scared of falling!” Closing his eyes, Zhuo Fan was at peace holding the one person he hadn’t seen in a hundred years. He was too content to let go.
Chu Qingcheng was frantic and landed on the ground before someone saw them.
She could never let her senior sisters see her like this. It was too damn mortifying!
Whoosh~
The two touched down, with Zhuo Fan holding onto her like an octopus. Chu Qingcheng’s face twitched and snapped, “Hey, we’re on the ground, now get off!”
“No, you’re lying! We’re definitely in the air and I won’t fall for it, he-he-he…”
The young miss had met the biggest rogue of them all, with the thickest skin ever as he used every trick to stay glued to her.
Chu Qingcheng squinted and huffed before she used force, throwing Zhuo Fan off, hard. He landed on the ground with a bang.
Chu Qingcheng glared, “You definitely took advantage this time and you dare lie to me?”
“Young miss Chu!”
Zhuo Fan dusted his clothes before he smiled, “Before I answer, would you answer me two questions first?”
“Is there anyone you fancy?” Zhuo Fan went right ahead before she could reply.
Chu Qingcheng shook her head.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Are you engaged?”
Chu Qingcheng started then shook her head.
[Why is he asking me this?]
“Great!”
Zhuo Fan got the answers he wanted and laughed, coming before Chu Qingcheng and reached out to hug her close as he looked longingly at her, “Now I’ll answer yours. I did it on purpose, because I like you. You have to be mine!”
Dong!
Chu Qingcheng’s mind blanked out, her eyes hazy.
[What on earth is going on? How am I yours just like that…]
She finally reacted after a few long moments and shoved him, “You’re crazy! We only met a couple hours ago and I have no idea who you are…”
“I am Zhuo Fan, there, now we’re no strangers, Qingcheng. Come with me!”
“As if! I am a Ruby Cloud Sect disciple. When it comes to marriage, I have to tell my master…”
“An old crow meddling in my affairs? Qingcheng, come with me. No one can stop us!” Zhuo Fan shouted, his voice filled with power…

chapters.title: Chapter 1191 - 1191, Annihilating
chapters.content:
Chapter 1191, Annihilating
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Chu Qingcheng gave him a long look, her eyes twitching. She then shook her head and put on a cold face as she walked away, “Do you have any idea who my master is, you lunatic? Braggart!”
“I know, one of the Eight Emperors, the one called Enchanting Empress, but ever since demonic energy had affected her hard in the battle at Nine Serenities’ tomb, she aged. That’s why we call her the Crone Empress.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, “Qingcheng, come with me and I promise the biddy won’t ever get to you.”
Chu Qingcheng covered her ears and shook her head, “Be silent! Don’t sully my master’s name! Just who do you think you are? Those senior sisters of mine are enough to flick the life out of you, let alone master. If you care for your life, stop talking. Not even I can save you then!”
“Save me?”
Zhuo Fan was touched, beaming, “Qingcheng, you’d take my side before that biddy? That means you do care about me. So why not come with me?”
Chu Qingcheng hesitated.
[Me and my big mouth!]
Just what was with her? Why did she blurt that out? She barely even knew the guy, only finding out his name just now.
Her heart was conflicted, while her face icy, glaring back, “There’d be no point in the end, not when you’re using me to replace your wife. This isn’t love. There’s no such thing as love at first sight. Now go, I’ve taken you out of the forest so you’re safe.”
“Qingcheng, you have to believe me. You are my wife, not a substitute. You and her are one and the same!” Zhuo Fan spoke with determination.
Chu Qingcheng rolled her eyes, laughing, “Sure, then chase me. We’ll talk again when you catch me!”
Chu Qingcheng pulled a smug look, like she outsmarted him, then flew away. Zhuo Fan smirked.
“Dear me, if you don’t take me flying, I’ll just have to do it myself! Everyone says, flying as a couple is so much better, while flying alone is so boring, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan had no trouble going after her, treating it like a game…
An hour later, Chu Qingcheng was rushing in her senior sister’s direction, but having caught no sight of them for so long began to weigh on her mind.
“Ugh, I’m not strong enough to keep up and with that delay I’ll never catch up. Why can’t they just wait for me?”
“Fang Min, as the head senior sister of Ruby Cloud Sect, you should be showing at least some remorse seeing your fellow sisters in peril instead of ignoring their fate. Hand over Purple Gold Glazed Cup, or else…”
A coarse laugh echoed across the sky, startling Chu Qingcheng. Looking over, she noticed in the distance her fellow sisters surrounded by two dozen men in black. Five of them were even late-stage Spirit Kings. As for her sisters, all were injured, with five taken prisoners and only her head senior sister barely hanging on.
Chu Qingcheng shot straight for them, striking with a cold palm at the man’s chest, “How dare you harm my senior sister!”
Bam!
The man snickered and pointed two fingers at her. The power between the fingers shot through her cold aura and into her body.
Chu Qingcheng coughed blood, collapsing on the spot.
“Ha-ha-ha, the broads of Ruby Cloud Sect are so mighty, for even a 7th layer Genesis cultivator to strike me, a peak Genesis cultivator. What a moron!”
The guy mocked and his team laughed.
Fang Min shook her head, glaring at Chu Qingcheng, “You fool, you saw us surrounded, but instead of going to the sect for help, you charged right in? You thought your meager skill was going to save the day?”
“Senior sister, I…” Chu Qingcheng hung her head low, the words wounding her.
Fang Min scoffed and shouted at the men in black, “Arrogant bastards, you knew we’re from Ruby Cloud Sect yet you still came for us? You’ve just signed your death warrant!”
“He-he-he, why do you think we’re masked?”
The leading late-stage Spirit King stepped forward and shouted, “We’d much rather avoid having the Crone Empress hounding us till the end of days. If you want to live past today, hand it over and we’ll let you go. When we get violent, at the end there’s just us, men, and you, girls, ha-ha-ha…”
The others laughed, showing greedy smiles.
Fang Min, grounded her teeth, with the other girls putting a tough front when they were all afraid of those creepy smiles.
[These filthy mongrels don’t care…]
Hesitating, Fang Min was put on the spot. By handing it over, the blame of failure would fall entirely on her. But if she didn’t they would never be able to live with themselves after today.
Fang Min was on the fence, weighing her position in the sect or her future.
Her eyes wandered back to the depressed Chu Qingcheng and lit up. She shot before her and threw a prismatic cup to her.
“Junior sister, take this and run. I’ll hold them off. You can’t let me down!”
“Senior sister?”
“Run!” Fang Min shouted again, looking ready to die for the cause.
Chu Qingcheng sniffed and nodded. She took the treasure and ran. She would give her life to protect it, to repay all her senior sisters’ trust in her.
The men in black saw her run off and shouted, “Girl, give it here if you don’t want a really good time!”
Whoosh~
The men ignored the other girls and shot after Chu Qingcheng. Fang Min gave a token of resistance, looking at the frail figure almost overrun with men with a creepy grin.
“Girl, get back here!”
Boom!
A powerful palm struck at Chu Qingcheng from behind.
She tensed up and noticed him to be the peak Genesis expert she went after before. Her heart sank.
Despite the peril and certain doom, she was set to carry on her sisters’ mission.
Chu Qingcheng gnashed her teeth and held the cup tight with one hand, while using the other to launch an attack in reply.
The man in black snickered, “Ha-ha-ha, missie, you’re still acting tough after that defeat? Die!”
Bam!
All they knew was that the guy’s power had the clear advantage, yet as the two of them clashed, the man in black up and got pulverized into a bloody mist, his very trace gone from this world.
Ugh!
The other chasers halted on the spot, looking dumbstruck.
[No way! How can a 7th layer Genesis cultivator be that much stronger than a peak one to kill him in one shot? Why the hell was she hurt in the first place then? Was it to bait us?]
The Ruby Cloud Sect disciples blinked in disbelief.
They knew all too well about their little junior sister’s strength, and it was clearly nowhere near that level.
[That guy was a peak Genesis expert, only beneath a Spirit King.]
They all had suffered at his blows, yet now…
Everyone was dumbstruck, even Chu Qingcheng, staring from her palm to the bloody mist in shock.
[Was my palm that strong? This never happened before.]
None noticed a shadow lurking in a bush just off from the conflict, watching. An eye was particularly eye-catching, shining in eight golden rings.
[Divine Eye of the Void 8th stage, Blink!]
Zhuo Fan muttered as he put away the fingers, his smile cold, “Sending a move through space, right in front of the opponent before they react is in the realm of a Spirit King’s spatial control skill, catching anyone off-guard, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan glanced at the stunned Fang Min, his face hard, “This woman knew Qingcheng couldn’t handle them yet still handed over the treasure and faked holding them; what a twisted heart. She did it to save her skin and shirk responsibility for failure, letting Qingcheng take the fall. For messing with my wife, her fate is death. Qingcheng might look innocent as a lily now, but her man ain’t just going to turn the other cheek.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1192 - 1192, Killing a Spirit King
chapters.content:
Chapter 1192, Killing a Spirit King
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Girl, you’ve been holding out on me!”
Once the reality of the situation sank in, an aged man in black shot forth as he released his deadly aura, “Never would I imagine that I’d have to step in against some lousy girls. Now it’s time for you to join my brother!”
The man raised his hand and the air around Chu Qingcheng warped.
Chu Qingcheng cried out, “A Spirit King!”
“I may be at the early stage, but I’m a Spirit King nonetheless. Against a 7th layer Genesis cultivator like you, it’s more than enough. You can hide as much power as you want, but it still won’t touch upon a Spirit King’s might, ha-ha-ha…”
The man’s eyes shone with pride. Chu Qingcheng’s face grew hard, her heart sinking as she took out a 12th grade spiritual sword as she stood on high alert to all movement around her. However, the trembling gave her unsettled mind away.
Deep down she knew an attack could come from anywhere, especially since she was up against a Spirit King, who could control the space around her.
What was she to do?
She was wound tighter than a violin, tense and anxious. The men in black snickered at her being so jumpy.
The Spirit king laughed and grabbed, “Say good night, girl!”
Whoosh~
The space shifted just then and a rain of arrows launched for Chu Qingcheng.
She panicked, her face paling. A Spirit King could attack out of the blue, giving her no time to react.
She clutched the spiritual sword harder, feeling like she was about to fall.
“Qingcheng!” Her fellow sisters shouted in worry. Wounded as they all were, they had no hope of providing any help, only staring helplessly as their little junior sister was about to meet her end.
Whoosh~
The downcast Chu Qingcheng up and vanished from everyone’s sight, leaving the arrows to miss their target.
The Spirit King shouted, “Where is she?”
“Above!”
From behind his cozy little bush, Zhuo Fan grinned to himself as his right eye shone in one golden halo, “Divine Eye of the Void 1st stage, Shift!”
Hum~
Chu Qingcheng popped back into their sights just half a meter above the Spirit King’s head, looking as dull as ever.
[Uh, what just happened?]
The man in black panicked, his eyes filled with confusion.
[What was that? I had control of the entire space, so why did this chick appear next to me without me sensing her? Just who am I dealing with here?]
The guy and Chu Qingcheng shared an equally dumb look of stupefaction, forgetting who they were. The rest just stared at them like statues.
Chu Qingcheng’s sisters were overwhelmed.
[What supreme skill was that? How did she do that? The Spirit King clearly didn’t notice her either.]
One senior sister cried out, “Qingcheng, now’s your chance, attack!”
Chu Qingcheng woke up from her daydreaming at long last.
[Right!]
She couldn’t get a better shot than this, and slashed down. The Spirit King had no way of taking on a 12th grade spiritual weapon with his body and surviving.
Chu Qingcheng perked up and went for his head.
The man reacted fast, flicking his sleeve and revealing sharp fingers as they aimed to grip Chu Qingcheng’s wrist.
With his power, it wouldn’t stop as a mere seizure of the hand, but breaking it completely.
The girls sighed inside.
[Even with Qingcheng so strong, a Spirit King still has the upper hand even at such close distance. Their gap in experience shows.]
Chu Qingcheng knew this as well and her heart sank.
For some very peculiar reason though, the man’s claw and the entire arm up and got flung in the air as it sprayed blood everywhere.
The guy was frozen stiff with an utter dumbfounded look in his eyes.
[What the name of all that’s holy going on here? Can anyone explain it to me?]
He would never get to know the truth, not like anyone here knew anyway. As he lost his golden chance to stop Chu Qingcheng, her sword came down with ease.
The Sword King got split in two, his innards and spilling out like molasses, soaking the dirt in his blood and guts. His separated eyes were still as confused as before, unable to unravel the profound mystery of his death.
The shock outcome was so great everyone was in denial of what they saw.
Chu Qingcheng handling a peak Genesis expert was unexpected but understandable, somewhat, but doing it to someone a stage above?
That guy had shed the mortal coil and became a Spirit King! And yet he got done in with a sword, something not even a peak Sword King could do.
Everyone’s eyes twitched as they looked at Chu Qingcheng in fear and confusion. Her senior sisters as well were slack jawed with popping eyes.
Thump~
The late Spirit King and leader of the men landed before Chu Qingcheng. While his features were covered, the cloth couldn’t hide the naked bloodthirst in his eyes.
“Appearance is an illusion. A chick like you looks harmless as a puppy, yet a true expert hides underneath all that facade.”
He cupped his hands to her, shouting, “Please oblige me a few moves, young miss!”
He unleashed his power and the space all around started fracturing.
The men in black cried out and cheered.
Chu Qingcheng was shocked to the core, forcing herself to breathe under that stifling power. Even as it pushed against her, she managed to stand still.
The man grew grave, “Young miss, you’re not going to show your true strength? You showed great power by dispatching my people with frightening ease, yet you can’t even handle my pressure?”
He ramped up the aura by a third. Chu Qingcheng coughed and sank to one knee, feeling like something was crushing her.
The others were mocking her.
[These broads are something, but not enough for our boss. He’s the strongest, ha-ha-ha…]
The leader never left Chu Qingcheng out of his sight, on high alert. The two deaths before were just too bizarre.
“Curses, you dare mess with my woman?”
Zhuo Fan wore a cold smile, “Since you insist on wanting me to step in, then you better be ready for it!”
Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed in eight golden rings.
[Divine Eye of the Void 8th stage, Blink!]
Hu~
Chu Qingcheng felt uplifted out of the blue, the pressure gone as she stood back with ease.
She was perplexed.
[Did he stop?]
Looking around though, told a different story. The air around her was still shimmering, the grass beneath her was flattened and the rocks pulverized, yet ten meters around her was right as rain.
Chu Qingcheng was stumped.
[What’s he playing at this time?]
The guy cracked up and looked ready to fight, “So you’re finally giving your all? Let’s do this then, young miss!”
“See that? She’s standing under the boss’ pressure. Only Spirit Kings can do that!”
“Yeah, that’s why she killed two of our strong men, because she’s on another level. We were too careless, taken in by her average appearance, when she was nothing but a Spirit King expert. She must’ve been baiting us for the right moment to take the treasure back.”
The other men in black bobbed their heads, commenting on Chu Qingcheng’s performance, “She must be the real head senior sister of Ruby Cloud Sect to guard the treasure!”
Fang Min’s face twitched and ground her teeth.
[This lousy brat! This is absurd! I’m the real head senior sister here…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1193 - 1193, Shadow
chapters.content:
Chapter 1193, Shadow
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Ignoring the comments, Chu Qingcheng was tense enough as it was due to the opponent’s challenge. But she still raised her sword to point it at him and look tough, “Come! I’ll never hand over the Purple Gold Glazed Cup!”
“Neither do I want you to, for it will be the winner’s spoils.” The leader’s hand released a gray energy, his eyes sharp as they made the young miss cower.
Whoosh!
Before the leader even got to strike, however, Chu Qingcheng’s sword acted first.
A sharp sword energy went by the leader’s head, striking another Spirit King somewhere behind.
Blood spurted everywhere as the victim was removed from this world.
Ugh!
The leader stiffened, frozen on the spot as if he regarded Chu Qingcheng like a monster or a creature beyond any comprehension.
He had no time to even flinch as the attack flew dangerously close to his own head before taking down a brother of his. Just an inch to the side and it’d have been him instead…
Gulp.
The leader was sweating buckets just as he saw the young miss looking perplexed at what transpired.
Her sword moved by itself!
Whoosh!
Chu Qingcheng’s sword acted up again, sending another sword wave, whizzing past the leader’s scalp to pop another Spirit King into a cloud of bloody mist.
Everyone shuddered as they jumped back, looking at Chu Qingcheng like she was a devil. A twitch of the sword nailed one down. Such simplistic and efficient killing was that of an expert killer. What was even worse, she was mocking their leader, the one she was actually facing while culling them instead!
[Just how outrageous is this chick’s power to even slight a late-stage Spirit King? Is she an Emperor?]
As blood leaked out of a slight cut on the leader’s cheek, he now saw Chu Qingcheng with nothing but fear.
He never saw a faster sword in his life. The girl wasn’t innocent by a long shot. The strikes were shot with brutality, meant to execute with impunity.
“M-miss, who on earth are you?”
Unable to get even his voice under control, the leader shuddered in front of Chu Qingcheng’s guileless gaze.
Chu Qingcheng mused then replied according to the custom, with cupped hands, “I am Ruby Cloud Sect 362nd generation disciple, Chu Qingcheng. May I know who you are?”
“362nd… the youngest? How do you have such power and skill?”
Incapable of getting an answer, the leader frowned in thought. He regarded Chu Qingcheng again with utter shock now, “T-that’s…”
A shadow grew behind Chu Qingcheng, dark and shifty, and he only realized it now thanks to his Spirit-King-level cultivation.
The force he felt from it left him weak in the knees and he staggered back.
He hastily cupped his hands, “I am in awe of miss’ incredible feat of strength. We’ll meet again if fate wills it.”
“Let’s go!”
The leader waved and was the first to flee for his life, his back soaked.
The rest of his men were right behind him.
[The missie must be really something for the boss to choose retreat over attacking.]
Chu Qingcheng was absolutely perplexed, just saluting back on reflex, “Uh, yeah, later…”
“Humph, what frickin’ later? You came for a fight so don’t think of getting out alive!”
Chu Qingcheng didn’t care about them, while Zhuo Fan snickered from his cozy little bush.
Chu Qingcheng’s shadow shot out and her sword acted up again.
Whoosh!
A sword energy flew at the men in black, running through the chests of three people.
Plop~
They all turned to a bloody mist, all Genesis Stage experts.
The leader snapped at Chu Qingcheng, “Miss, we never touched any of your people. We’re even leaving yet you would be so cruel as to kill us, fleeing men?”
“No, that… it’s the sword…”
Chu Qingcheng looked hurt at the accusation, lamenting as she turned to her sword. Her words got cut off, literally, as her sword had a mind of its own.
Sword energy flew galore, each robbing a wail of agony from a man in black, along with his life, sending them to the great beyond.
The leader looked at the heavy casualties and roared, “Curses, this chick is an oddity and bloodthirsty like a banshee. Run, we’ll pay her back later!”
“Well aren’t you a ray of sunshine, so optimistic. Humph, there won’t be any loose ends!”
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan flicked from his bush with an insidious smile. Chu Qingcheng’s shadow moved her hand and sent more sword energy flying, making it so it was all her doing.
The sky was filled under the gaudy lights of the sword waves, soon covering the ground in fresh and bloody corpses for the new grass to grow. The Ruby Cloud Sect disciples looked startled.
[Since when was junior sister Qingcheng so cruel?]
Chu Qingcheng watched as lives were mowed down like grass on the verge of tears, shouting, “Stop, please stop…”
“No can do, Qingcheng. I’m ending this here and now for your sake.” Zhuo Fan muttered from the bush.
Chu Qingcheng held the sword with both hands, trying her best to get it under control. She cried, “Stop this instant or I will cripple my meridians. Without my Yuan Qi you can’t do anything!”
Zhuo Fan listened at last, with a shake of his head.
[Fine, since you said so and if it’ll make you happy…]
Chu Qingcheng’s shadow settled and the flood of sword energy slowed down to a halt. Though only three men in black remained, including the leader.
Glancing back at the she-demon, the wretched thieves ran for their lives while the girl was downcast.
They came here thinking it was an easy gig, but luck had it they got almost all of their men killed.
[We need backup to deal with this hellspawn!]
The Ruby Cloud Sect disciples glanced at Chu Qingcheng, slumped on the ground, with dull eyes. They couldn’t recognize her, only feeling fear.
“Senior sister, are you alright? I kept the Purple Gold Glazed Cup safe!”
Chu Qingcheng jumped back to her feet like nothing happened, beaming at the girls, “You’re all hurt. Want me to heal you?”
Pa!
Fang Min yanked the cup from Chu Qingcheng’s hand and mocked as a form of thanks, “Little junior sister, you sure kept to yourself all this time. But now you showed us. Without your help today, junior sister, our lives would’ve been forfeited. All of us are so useless, needing junior sister’s protection.”
“Senior sister, don’t say that. It’s my duty.” Chu Qingcheng was worried as she spoke obliviously to the sarcasm, “Senior sister, why aren’t you pleased that we have overcome this disaster?”
Fang Min chuckled with scorn, “Oh, I’m pleased as punch, of junior sister’s glorious future. You alone had finished off two dozen people and many Spirit Kings among them, making us fall short. But junior sister, when did you become so cruel to kill people on a whim? We all saw them leaving so why did you go after them still? If I didn’t know any better, you’d have to be from Devil Mountain than Ruby Cloud Sect.”
“Senior sister, I really didn’t want to kill them. It was my sword…”
“It just moved? That’s rich!”
Fang Min snickered, her tone biting and mean, “Sisters, let’s keep going. We don’t need to worry about little junior sister anymore. She has an almighty independent divine sword and can do away without our help.”
Fang Min was the first to fly off, with the others taking healing pills before giving Chu Qingcheng looks of fear and then following. Chu Qingcheng was left alone and in guilt, looking at her baffling spiritual sword with conflicted emotions.
She liked the sword for coming to her and her senior sisters’ rescue, but hated it for going out of control and isolating her from her senior sisters.
It was never the sword however, but a man, the one wearing a creepy smile just off to the side in a bush…
Silavin: Merry Christmas everyone!

chapters.title: Chapter 1194 - 1194, An Emperor Joins
chapters.content:
Chapter 1194, An Emperor Joins
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Chu Qingcheng lowered her head, depressed, looking at her sword with a sigh, “Senior sisters are wrong about me. I’m no killer…”
“Ah! They have the treasure and might meet other mean people!”
Chu Qingcheng started and spoke to her spiritual sword, “Cerulean, we have to protect senior sisters, but you have to behave and not kill whenever. You have to listen, or…”
Chu Qingcheng’s voice drifted, not knowing how to threaten her rampant spiritual sword, “Or I’ll just get another one!”
Ding!
The sword slightly shook in ridicule.
[You call that a threat? Besides, that wasn’t me, so why are you threatening me? Humph…]
The oblivious Chu Qingcheng was deaf to her spiritual sword, of course, looking relieved as she chased after her senior sisters.
“Ah, save me! Someone save me!” A sudden cry reached her ears.
Shriek~
She also heard the sharp shriek of a bird.
Chu Qingcheng looked back in panic.
A hundred meter big bird, covered in blue flames was holding a man in its beak.
“8th level spiritual beast, Firestorm Eagle?”
Chu Qingcheng shouted, “How did this guy end up caught by a spiritual beast like this? Cerulean, let’s go save him!”
Chu Qingcheng shot for the 8th level spiritual beast and slashed.
Bam!
A white sword wave hacked into the blue flames, freezing the air and making the fire fizzle out.
Shriek~
The spiritual beast cried out and Zhuo Fan used this chance to get out of its beak. The spiritual beast didn’t fight the girl, choosing to flee instead.
Chu Qingcheng beamed, then recalled Zhuo Fan and went to him, only to find his legs sticking out of the ground.
Chu Qingcheng grabbed one at random and pulled, “Sorry, I was so focused on the fight with the beast I forgot about you. Are you alright?”
“Ha-ha-ha, I’m perfect! I am in the Bone Tempering Stage after all and won’t die from something as simple as falling.” Zhuo Fan grinned and wiped his face of dirt and dust, “Qingcheng, thanks for saving me again. It must be in the stars to meet. We have to be fated to be together!”
Chu Qingcheng’s face fell and threw him, “Humph, a scoundrel only knows how to spew lies. I wasted my time saving you for nothing, you’re just trying to make your move on me. I should’ve just let that bird eat you.”
“You’d never, since you can’t go on without me!” Zhuo Fan was sickeningly corny.
Though he was also right as his words made Chu Qingcheng blush, her heart racing.
She shook her head of those random emotions and gave a smirk, “You’re nothing to me, braggart, so why would I ever stick around with you? Humph, now off you go, shoo. I still need to find my senior sisters. Bye!”
Chu Qingcheng left.
“Ah!”
Zhuo Fan howled and his forehead was covered in sweat, straining to speak, “Qingcheng, don’t worry about me, just do what you have to do. Leave me here in the wild outdoors for another strong spiritual beast to come around and take a bite out of me, again. I won’t blame you, since you don’t care about me. Just go do you!”
Chu Qingcheng looked back to see Zhuo Fan grimacing and looking pale while his leg bled.
Chu Qingcheng rushed over and took out a gauze to bandage him, “Weren’t you a Bone Tempering cultivator? Why did you get a broken leg from falling?”
“It’s that spiritual beast who snapped it in its beak.”
Zhuo Fan gasped, “Bone Tempering Stage isn’t enough to withstand those sharp fangs.”
“Here, a healing pill from my sect.”
She fished out a vial in a rush and fed Zhuo Fan a pill. Chu Qingcheng’s heart felt forlorn for some reason, “But as we’re all Genesis experts, we only got pills for internal wounds. It will take a week to heal your leg as is.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, looking distressed, “Not moving for a week, I’ll be a sitting duck for spiritual beasts to gobble me up.”
“Stop saying that. You’ll be fine with me around.” Chu Qingcheng glared at him but then she looked in the direction her fellow sisters went.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Qingcheng, aren’t you going after your senior sisters? Just go and forget about me.”
“How can I just leave you with your leg like this?”
Puffing her underwhelming chest, Chu Qingcheng spoke with honor and righteousness, but then she hoisted Zhuo Fan’s arm and helped him up on her back, smiling, “Isn’t this better? I’ll carry you to find my senior sisters and let you down in a safe place.”
“That’s mighty clever of you!” Zhuo Fan lit up and nodded.
Chu Qingcheng smiled in pride, “Of course, now let’s go!”
The two were gone like the wind, but the pure girl failed to notice the big eagle looking at them from a distance…
[Thank heavens that prick is gone…]
“Brother, what’s with that cut on your back?” Another eagle shrieked in teasing, many times bigger, “Did a human play with you? Want bro here to set them straight?”
The first eagle flayed its wings and squawked, looking panicky, “No, definitely no! Please don’t. I never want to see that guy again!”
“Is he that tough? From the wound, he doesn’t look much to me. The slash barely dented your feathers.”
“You know nothing! It’s not the sword wielder, the tough one, but the guy forcing me to hold him in my beak!” Its eyes were filled with fear as he recalled Zhuo Fan’s black orbs. Its feathers even trembled from terror.
The bigger eagle looked stumped.
[Who on earth did this guy meet to make him shake like a leaf…]
The escaping men in black arrived at a barren mountain, where a refined elder was enjoying his tea in his chair.
The three men in black slumped weakly at the old man’s side, bowing, “Clan Head!”
“Well, where is it?”
“Clan Head, we failed to take it and suffered heavy casualties!” The leader hung his head.
Crack!
The cup broke in the old man’s hand, his voice laced with fury, “Failed? More than twenty experts and a late-stage Spirit King failed? Weren’t they just seven girls? You couldn’t even deal with them? Are you morons or simply garbage?”
“Clan Head!”
The others shivered, with the leader speaking, “Clan Head, let me explain. Six of them were nothing, but the last girl was simply horrible. She killed without blinking and had an uncanny power about her. None of us could handle her. Even ww would’ve ended up dead if we were any slower!”
The old man eyed them and rose from his chair, his eyes sharp, “For you, a late-stage Spirit King, to fail against her, then she must be something else. That leaves only me to step in!”
“Clan Head, you’re going to go after them yourself?”
“The Demonic Emperor entrusted us with this task and I’m not about to botch it!”
The old man snapped back, “If just one of you had shown even a bit of promise I wouldn’t have deigned to steal from some nobodies!”
The old man covered his face with black cloth, “The Demonic Emperor said not to harm anyone if possible as to not stir up the old hag. All that matters is that we ruin their deal in Mist City. Let’s go!”
“Yes!”
They all got excited.
[With the Clan Head stepping in, that girl is finished. He is a mighty expert in the Sacred Domain, a true Emperor…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1195 - 1195, Imperial Descent
chapters.content:
Chapter 1195, Imperial Descent
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Whoosh~
Under a clear sunny sky, the six disciples of Ruby Cloud Sect were the only ones flying. The leader had a nice face but the grimace ruined her image. The head senior sister looked angry all the time these past three days.
One looked worried, “Senior sister, aren’t we going too fast? There’s been no sight of junior sister all this time. Maybe she’s lost?”
“Humph, a Spirit King is beneath her but she can’t catch up? She must’ve been playing around since it’s her first time outside the sect. Why do you care?” Fang Min spat with venom.
The disciple’s heart shrank but still tried, “Yeah, it’s her first time this far from the sect and might not know the way. Should we leave her some signs to follow…”
“You talk too much!”
Fang Min barked, “That girl’s so tough now so why would she need your care? Are you leaving signs so the enemy can find us instead, is that it?”
The girl shrank under head senior sister’s harsh stare.
Fang Min glared at her then looked back ahead, brooding and furious as they went on…
Boom!
A sudden pressure came out of nowhere over them and their flight was cut off, falling to the ground.
An aged voice laughed from everywhere, “Ha-ha-ha, you think I need some signs to find you?”
Whoosh~
Fifty men in black landed before them, with twenty Spirit Kings among them. Their leader wore black, his scary eyes making the girls tremble.
“Imperial descent, he’s an Emperor!”
Fang Min gasped, full with dread as she looked at the older man. Her heart was beating so hard it might jump out of her chest.
The other girls could barely breathe.
The old man mocked, “Juniors of the Ruby Cloud Sect, I’d rather avoid having any real altercation with that biddy so hand over the Purple Gold Glazed Cup I’ll be letting you all go without harming one hair on you. What do you say?”
“As a mighty Emperor, senior must be of great renown in Sacred Domain. Why would you lower yourself to some petty theft, agh!”
Fang Min tried the diplomatic way, her tone shaky, but an even stronger pressure descended and forced her to shriek and cough blood.
The old man snickered, “We all have our sordid past, or do you not already see our covered faces? Girl, give it here and we’ll be out of your hair, no fuss no mess. But if it gets to it, I’ll just have to pry it from your cold, dead hands.”
The girls tensed, all looking towards Fang Min and awaiting her decision.
[Head senior sister, what do we do?]
“Senior!”
Fang Min’s eyes darted around, smiling, “Sorry, but you’re getting ahead of yourself.”
“You really want me to kill you all?”
“Ha-ha-ha, kill us?”
Fang Min laughed in his face, “Senior, you got me all wrong. I’m not so stupid to fight the impossible. The treasure just isn’t with us. You can just kill us and see for yourself.”
The old man’s face twitched as he gave her a hard look, “Not on you? Do you think I’ll buy that?”
“Search ahead then!”
Fang Min grinned as she forced her feet under her, taking out her storage ring, “I’ll go first. All I have is in there. Take a look. Why, still don’t believe me? Ha-ha, you can just search me as well…”
Fang Min started undressing under the fixed gaze of the old man.
As her dress grew lighter, her curves grew more obvious. The other guys behind were enchanted.
Many gulped and drooled, having forgotten about some lame treasure, engrossed in having her take off everything. That took priority by far.
[Senior sister…]
Her fellow disciples were tense and jittery.
[When senior sister finishes, it won’t be us next, will it? We’ll now lose both the treasure and our purity!]
[What is senior sister thinking going so far?]
“Alright!”
Fang Min was left in a most enticing and revealing inner garment when the old man stopped her.
His men hung their heads at having lost a good show, whining inside.
[Clan Head, can’t you mind the timing? Only just a bit more. I know you’re withered, but you could at least think of everyone else.]
The old man already believed this lass somewhat for going so far, not even bothering with the thrown ring as he shouted, “I’ll believe you, for now, but if you don’t have it, who does?”
“My junior sister?”
“Your junior sister?”
“Junior sister is the strongest so the treasure can only be in her care. We’re nothing but bait. Even if you kill us, you won’t get anything out of it!” Fang Ming held out her head.
The old man looked back at the previous leader and he attested, “Clan Head, the strongest girl is indeed not here. They must’ve split up and had her deliver the treasure.”
“Where is she?”
The old man fixed his gaze back on Fang Min, “Speak and you may go. Otherwise…”
Fang Min paused, “Three days ago, after the attack, junior sister took a different route, just to be safe. I have no idea where she could be by now. You could just trail back and maybe still find some clues.”
“Find some trackers and get me her direction!”
The old man’s piercing gaze never left Fang Min, “Girl, lie to me and I’ll be back at any time to send you all to hell! Let’s go!”
He shot into the sky, gone like the wind. The rest gulped and gave the six pretty girls one last look before leaving as well.
Even with all the danger gone, the girls still looked to be in despair.
Getting dressed again and picking up her ring, Fang Min had a smile of utter scorn on her face, “Humph, here’s what you want, you old fart. Come and get it!”
“Senior sister, are they gone? Will they come back?” One girl was still shaken up from the deadly pressure even now.
Fang Min grew grave, “Yeah, once he finds junior sister doesn’t have the Purple Gold Glazed Cup, he’ll be sure to storm back. Sisters, we’re detouring to Mist City. Leave not a trace of your energy on your way so they can’t find us!”
“Yes, head senior sister!”
They all cupped their hands, but then one girl shyly said, “What about little junior sister. When they do find her…”
“That’s her problem. It was either sending them after her or us dying instead. What would you prefer, her or us?”
Fang Min snapped a cold glare on her, shutting her up.
She had a cruel smile as she then took the lead, all the rancor eating her up these past days gone.
[Girl, you won’t be missed, humph…]
Five days went by, with a girl carrying on her back a thin man and taking a totally different path from Fang Min’s group. In flying she spoke her worries, “Zhuo Fan, is Mist City this way? Why haven’t we met with the others yet?”
“Not to worry, my sense of direction is perfect.”
Zhuo Fan grinned, feeling warm and gooey inside as he gazed upon her adorable and worried face.
[Perfect direction?]
[Ha! Well of course, I’ve been roaming the Sacred Domain for ages that I know it like the back of my hand. While omitting the fact I’m taking the wrong way is a different story.]
[Rather than catch up to those third wheels, a world just for the two of us is so much better, ha-ha…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1196 - 1196, Hellish
chapters.content:
Chapter 1196, Hellish
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Huff~
It had been a week already yet no sign of the girls as Chu Qingcheng carried Zhuo Fan with ragged breath. Worry plagued her innocent heart, making her not stop for even a second all this time. Even for a Genesis Stage expert, the long travel took its toll.
Zhuo Fan was feeling a bit guilty, wiping her sweaty brow, “Qingcheng, my leg is healed now. Let’s take a rest.”
“No, I’ve yet to catch up to my senior sisters. We can’t stop now. It will only make us lag further behind.” Chu Qingcheng was stubborn.
[You won’t ever catch them, not by taking the wrong way at least.]
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Qingcheng, what difference does it make if we can’t reach them? They’re faster than you anyway so there’s no way you can catch up. Aren’t you going to just meet up in Mist City? You’ll just see them there, so just take it easy.”
“But this is my first time outside the sect. How should I know where Mist City is?”
“Don’t you have me for something this simple? I’ll show you the way.”
“You?” Chu Qingcheng started, looking back, “Weren’t you out looking for herbs? Won’t I give you more trouble for guiding me all the way to Mist City?”
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “What does it matter? I’m just a drifter. We’ll just go to Mist City then you can drop me off on your way back.”
“Oh, then, thanks…” Qingcheng’s cheeks went pink thinking she would carry him back as well. Though her heart did not seem to mind it.
Zhuo Fan snickered, his breath tickling her ear, “You don’t want to carry me?”
Chu Qingcheng blushed harder, shaking her head.
“Would you carry me then?”
The guy was taking all the advantage he could from her back, making her flustered.
“Then hold me all my life, alright?”
Zhuo Fan spoke in an emotional and heavy tone. Chu Qingcheng shuddered, her mind blanking out as she stared deep in those black and tender eyes of his.
She just did not know where Zhuo Fan’s confession even came from to say something like that.
Zhuo Fan looked at her with nothing but love, leaned over and pecked her lips.
Dong!
Chu Qingcheng froze solid, her mind blown away. Feeling the strange yet familiar male scent, her heart raced. With one shudder they both fell to the ground.
Each left a two meter wide hole.
Chu Qingcheng crawled out of hers, panicky and blushing, looking over as Zhuo Fan held on the edge of his hole, “Y-you’re just toying with me again!”
“Yeah, sorry, I just can’t help it, he-he-he…”
Zhuo Fan scratched his head, yet showed no remorse as he smiled, “Since I took unfair advantage, why don’t you do the same? I’ll even let you kiss me for ten whole minutes. I won’t mind it one bit either, ha-ha.”
“Y-you’re so crude!”
Chu Qingcheng glared at him and walked out on him, “I’m ignoring you!”
“Qingcheng, don’t go. You don’t know the way so let me guide you.”
“I don’t need you. I can just ask someone, humph.”
Zhuo Fan snickered as he gestured for the way ahead. Chu Qingcheng had lost faith in this rascal, huffing and flying into the air in anger.
Zhuo Fan scratched his head, “Too soon? Was I pushing things too hard? Ha-ha-ha, guess it’s not easy chasing girls. I just can’t understand how Qingcheng stood so loyal for ten years and endured so much bitterness. Guess I get what I deserve now, with me doing the chasing this time.”
Zhuo Fan sighed.
“Hmm, let’s see what I should use this time for our next meeting. Last time I was getting chewed by an eagle, so that’s out. I’m in the Bone Tempering Stage, so I can’t just go after her…”
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan was going through his bag of tricks to hook girls when black streaks flew overhead and darkened the sky.
Thanks to his meager cultivation, he was ignored by these powerhouses.
Zhuo Fan, however, grew grave from their direction of flight, “How did they catch up so fast? Qingcheng is all alone so they should be looking after those broads instead, take their stuff and just leave. So why are they here again?”
“Casting blame?”
Zhuo Fan vanished the next second, “Damn it, they even have an Emperor with them. I won’t be able to hide this time…”
Chu Qingcheng kept flying and cursing in anger, “Rotten, evil Zhuo Fan, you only know how to toy with me. Senior sister was right, there’s no trusting any man. They’re all evil!”
Boom!
A resounding boom echoed, followed by an unearthly pressure slamming into her and sending her crashing into the ground.
Rumble!
An even bigger explosion echoed as a crater half a mile wide sprouted, kicking up dust. Chu Qingcheng coughed blood and looked pale.
Men in black landed in her sights, the leader being an old man, “Her? She doesn’t look like anything yet she killed two dozen people?”
“Clan Head, don’t let her cultivation fool you, she is a freak.” The ex-leader whispered in his ear.
Chu Qingcheng strained her waned face, only to cough blood again, “Y-you again…”
“Girl, hand over the Purple Gold Glazed Cup, or I’ll give you a fate worse than death!”
“Purple Gold Glazed Cup?”
Chu Qingcheng looked confused, “I don’t have it, but I wouldn’t give Ruby Cloud Sect’s treasure even if I did…”
The old man scoffed, “Very well.”
Bam!
Chu Qingcheng was sent flying from a kick to the gut. She jerked and coughed more blood, mixed with her innards.
“How weak, just at Genesis Stage?”
The old man frowned, looking back in doubt, “Is she the same expert that had you scared out of your minds? I don’t see it.”
The man’s face twitched, hanging his head, “Clan Head, maybe she’s not herself today, up on bricks…”
Pa!
The old man smacked him hard.
“You think it’s funny?”
The old man snorted. The other man lowered his head, cursing Chu Qingcheng to high heaven.
[Damn girl, where has all that fire gone? Give me something, even a tenth, so that I can prove to Clan Head my mission failed for a very good reason. As it is now, I’m only being rebutted.]
[There’s no way we can prove our failure now…]
“I’ll deal with you later.”
“Yes.”
The old man glared at him before turning to Chu Qingcheng. The ex-leader looked like a kicked puppy, on the verge of crying.
The old man reached the girl and raised his foot, “Lass, you killed my men, so I can’t let you go like the rest. Since you’re so obstinate, I’ll crack open that skull of yours before looking for the treasure on your body.”
The old man stomped.
A mighty pressure fell on her face, heralding certain doom.
Chu Qingcheng felt her weakened body growing heavy and her heart sinking.
[Am I going to die? There’s so many things I want to do. I don’t even know my purpose in life so how can I just…]
Boom!
Her eyes closed just as the old man stomped a huge crater in front of her a mile wide.
When the dust settled, the old man shook, his head whipping in another direction and shouting, “State who you are!”
“You don’t need to know it for where you’re going.”
A pitch-black figure appeared in the roaming dust, its voice eerie and chilling. Even these criminals used to getting their hands dirty felt their hearts seizing from the hellish feeling…

chapters.title: Chapter 1197 - 1197, Imperial Mark
chapters.content:
Chapter 1197, Imperial Mark
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
All heads turned to where the wind blew, on edge. Even the old man was cautious, taking back his foot.
When all dust cleared, they saw a thin man holding a barely alive Chu Qingcheng.
The men in black gasped.
[He saved her from under Clan Head’s nose without any of us noticing anything…]
“He’s a true expert!”
The old man’s eyes shone, his voice low, “At least it makes my trip worthwhile knowing there’s someone that can take me on.”
Zhuo Fan traced Chu Qingcheng’s unconscious face, looking dark as he turned to the rest, “Geezer, you must be rushing to die going after her.”
“Humph, pretentious fool, at least you have skill to save someone from my attack. Though having an unconscious girl weighing you down won’t be of much help…”
Whoosh~
The old man looked smug with his smile, but then he heard whistling sword waves, instantly ripping apart ten Spirit Kings.
[So fast!]
Everyone gasped in fright. The old man froze as well, unable to believe what he saw.
[How is his sword energy so fast that I couldn’t even see it? It’s beyond even Sword Emperor Ao Changtian’s Imperial Sword Winds!]
“W-what the hell are you?”
The old man finally revealed fear in his voice for the first time.
Zhuo Fan grinned, with the ex-leader in black exclaiming, “Now I get it! Clan Head, he had to be the one who struck us before, not the girl. He’s the monster!”
Bam!
His head got split in two like a melon.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Who sent you and why?”
They all gulped, the only sound in the deathly silence. The other men were horrified, glancing at the Clan Head for any signs of what to do.
The old man was sweating now, thinking of a way out. Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Since you can’t even answer, I have no further use for you.”
“Heaven Sealing Sword Art, Space Seal!”
Zhuo Fan flicked his hand and the space took on a cold glint, with all of the others stuck in place.
[W-what is this? A Spirit King?]
Their hearts jumped in their chests. The elder looked grave, barely budging even as an Emperor. With his movement slowed down so much, he began to feel the danger.
[He’s no average Spirit King to be able to freeze fellow Spirit Kings and even an Emperor.]
[Just what is he? Why haven’t I heard of anyone like him in all my years in Sacred Domain?]
Zhuo Fan grinned, “Well, feel like talking now? You can opt for silence, but there’ll be nothing left of any of you to even bury you. Who was it that said she’s weighing me down? I don’t even need to go all out against the likes of you, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan drew out two fingers, the air warping from the violent forces gathering at the tips.
“Wait!”
The old man shouted in a panic, “I’ll talk! I don’t think sir is from Ruby Cloud Sect, nor do I know why you got involved in this, but I don’t think you’ll tell me either way. But still, no one wants to butt in the issues of the Eight Emperors, I reckon.”
Zhuo Fan nodded.
The old man looked relieved at his attitude, “We are under the Demonic Emperor, tasked to go after the Ruby Cloud Sect disciples and get the Purple Gold Glazed Cup. The treasure auction in Mist City has a map of the Nether Sea that everyone wants, it points the way to the Nether Sovereign’s home, with the promise of becoming a Sovereign, or at least a Saint. By taking the Ruby Cloud Sect’s treasure, it could no longer participate in the bidding, giving us one less opponent to worry about.”
“Oh, pretty much what I figured as well.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, flicking his hand, letting the violent energy expand everywhere. The frozen people evaporated on contact. Fifty experts died just like that.
The old man cried in anger, “W-what are you doing? I told you everything so why…”
“You did, but I don’t recall ever saying I’ll let you go.”
With a sinister smile, Zhuo Fan said, “You hurt Qingcheng and expect to live? Ha!”
The old man ground his teeth, his eyes bloodshot, “This is absurd! I didn’t want to get involved with you for fear of suffering pointless casualties. Did you really think that an Emperor like me would be scared of a mere Spirit King?”
Boom!
The old man shook and flew out of the frozen space. He started making signs and golden lights spilled out of him, “Imperial Mark, Ghost Skeleton!”
Whoosh~
The golden lights exploded in intensity and a skeleton hundreds of meters big appeared around him. The golden lights focused then and took the form of a four-sided seal high in the sky, encompassing the old man and the skeleton.
Zhuo Fan watched it all with a cold eye and a smirk.
This was a skill particular to Emperors, using one’s soul and control of space to form the Imperial Mark, unstoppable and disregarding all spacial laws. Once the seal fell, the land would break along with any Spirit King that tried fighting it. The soul’s character would also be shown its full potential inside the Imperial Mark as well.
The old man’s soul was a ghost skeleton, of yin in nature, making the attack have an even harsher effect on souls.
The moment the golden seal appeared, spilling light everywhere, Zhuo Fan shook as he heard howls of wraiths within his mind. It dazed him for a moment, with his body wobbling.
“Humph, nothing but a Spirit King. You can control space, but can you take on the Imperial Heavenly Brilliance?”
The old man was out for blood, shouting as the golden seal came down on top of Zhuo Fan, “Rotten cretin, I’ll make mincemeat out of you, now while your mind is hazy!”
Apocalyptic thunderflame!
Zhuo Fan’s left eye flared with black flames, while deep in his soul, thunderflames sparked to life.
The golden glow met with a sudden blackness, erasing it and making Zhuo Fan’s eyes shine.
Looking up at the incoming golden seal, Zhuo Fan grinned. His right eye shone in two golden halos, “Humph, the Imperial Mark might be unstoppable, but even it will suffer before my thunderflame.”
“Divine Eye of the Void 2nd stage, Thunderflame Void Annihilation!”
Whoosh!
A dreadful black beam of flame shot at the golden seal.
The old man cried out, “What is that?”
Boom!
The black flames smashed into the seal and availed itself of the Void Annihilation’s power to enter the newly formed half a meter wide and hundreds of meters long hole.
The old man spurted blood and paled, proving that the Imperial Mark and he were connected, making him suffer when it was damaged.
What was worse, the black thunderflames didn’t rest with only punching a hole in the seal, eating away at the remains as well.
“Aah!”
With an unearthly howl, the man screamed from having his very soul eaten away. The pain had to be excruciating, enough to make one go insane.
He was constantly pleading for mercy, yet Zhuo Fan just stood to the side and watched as the seal was burned to nothing. The old man wailed in pain down to his last breath, his face twisted and horrible.
It was a testament to a most gruesome death no one would wish upon anyone.
“I didn’t use the Decimating Sword Art on you as well because I needed your body intact.”
Zhuo Fan walked over to the twisted body, chuckling. He hooked his finger and a head landed in his palm…

chapters.title: Chapter 1198 - 1198, Gambling Town
chapters.content:
Chapter 1198, Gambling Town
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Drip~
The downpour had soaked the land, washing away the blood and filth, leaving no trace behind of the atrocity that happened, while giving the air an earthy scent.
In a damp cave, with water dripping from the stalagmites, the girl laying on a stone bed muttered as she woke up, “W-where am I…”
“Oh, Qingcheng, awake yet?”
Zhuo Fan lit up, chuckling, “I can’t believe how I ended up saving you in the end. Shouldn’t you pledge endless devotion now? Ha-ha-ha…”
[You saved me?]
Chu Qingcheng was confused, trying to recall the fuzzy details. Then it all came to her in a flash, looking at Zhuo Fan with suspicion, “How did you save me? They had an Emperor and many Spirit Kings!”
“Emperor, Spirit Kings?”
Zhuo Fan shrugged, putting on a clueless look, “I didn’t see any. Didn’t you just leave me behind? As I tried catching up with you on the ground, I saw you lying unconscious. So I carried you here to nurse you. I never got to see anything.”
Chu Qingcheng’s eyes grew hazy, “Strange, they were so ruthless, clearly wanting to kill me. I still remember that foot about to crush my head before I lost consciousness. Did they just let me go after finding I don’t have it?”
Chu Qingcheng turned to Zhuo Fan, as if in question.
Zhuo Fan shrugged, smiling cluelessly.
Chu Qingcheng thought long and hard but still couldn’t find an explanation. So she resigned to being fortunate to have come out alive. Now she just had to catch up to her senior sisters.
“Ah!”
She just got up to her feet when she felt her waist in pain before slumping back down.
Zhuo Fan jumped to help her, “What is it? Take it slow, Qingcheng.”
“I have some bad wounds and can’t move very well.”
Chu Qingcheng winced and took a red pill from her ring. She ate it and sighed, “Now It’ll be a miracle if I get to Mist City on time, let alone catching up with the others.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, his mind calculative, “Did you forget about me already? Last time you carried me so now I’ll carry you!”
“You?”
“Yep. With you unable to fly, my running has to be way better than being stuck here, right?”
Chu Qingcheng yelped as he up and put her on his back, taking a long whiff of her scent while plastering a smile on his face, “Oh, my wife’s smell is so unlike everyone else’s. I’ll be sure to engrave it in my memory, to hold it close to the end of days.”
Bam!
Chu Qingcheng smacked his head, blushing hard and chiding, “Cut that out! I-I’m not your wife…”
“Yes you are.”
“Miscreant!”
“Maybe not now, but you soon will be. You can never escape from me, he-he-he…” Zhuo Fan held onto Chu Qingcheng’s supple legs and lifted, eliciting another pleasant yelp from her before he started walking.
Chu Qingcheng glared at this rotten man, but for some reason, her heart just wouldn’t match her thoughts. His wide back called to her to just rest on it.
As a strong girl, she, of course, pushed through the thought with sheer determination, despite her heart’s constant hammering in her chest.
Zhuo Fan carried his darling, asking about her life till now.
“Qingcheng, who gave you that name anyway? It sounds so nice, like those kingdom toppling beauties. Is father-in-law a Chu?”
“Stop that nonsense!”
Chu Qingcheng blushed again, but she replied still, “Master named me when she picked me up. I heard that the ground collapsed just as master passed by, revealing these characters, thus taking me and naming me after them.”
“Oh, I see.”
Zhuo Fan nodded.
[That old man from my soul was very thoughtful for me. To make sure I found Qingcheng, he left clues of her birth, but…]
“And your parents? Didn’t your master find your parents?”
