Chu Qingcheng lowered her head, sighing, “Master said I don’t have any, that she only found me alone. I always wanted to go out and find where I came from when I left the sect.”
“Any idea where to begin?”
“None.”
Chu Qingcheng shook her head. Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, his mind making the right adjustments to the plan, “Then leave it to me. I will make it clear as day!”
“You?”
“You don’t believe I can do it?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, smiling, “I’ve been roaming the world for so many years, and where I lack in strength, I made up with knowledge in spades. They don’t call me an information broker for nothing. There’s not an obscure rumor or far-fetched myth I didn’t hear. The Demonic Emperor’s high treachery or the Enchanting Empress’s twisted love life throughout the ages, I know everything…”
Pa!
His head snapped to the side from the blow as Chu Qingcheng yelled at him, “Don’t you dare vilify my master!”
“Why would I even want to? While the crone is hardly amazing now, back in the day…”
“You’re still saying that?”
“Fine, fine, I’ll stop. It’s not like we all haven’t been rash and reckless in our youth.” Zhuo Fan smirked, feeling gloomy inside.
[What’s so great about that biddy anyway? Something’s definitely off here, just taking Qingcheng to the sect and raising her. I’d better get those guys to look into what went on a century ago…]
Zhuo Fan walked on, his mind on different matters. Chu Qingcheng saw him silent and asked, “Are you angry?”
“Oh, not at all. I could never be angry at you.” Zhuo Fan beamed.
Chu Qingcheng brightened and her heart swooned. In her joy, her head leaned on his back, at peace and happy.
Zhuo Fan caught her look and was just as content.
Zhuo Fan walked with Chu Qingcheng on his back for seven days before she finally got better. She could pretty much walk on her own and be off on her merry way, but these short days had worked to get the destined couple to grow much closer, as well as Zhuo Fan’s persistent demand to guide her.
Chu Qingcheng thus let him do what he wanted, with some reluctance.
She ended up carrying him as they flew, reaching the gates of Mist City three months later.
The two entered the bustling city hand in hand. Everything drew Chu Qingcheng’s eyes, amazed at any sparkling or cute thing, being her first time outside the sect. Zhuo Fan acted natural, except for that eerie light in his eyes.
“Qingcheng, Mist City is known as gambling town in Sacred Domain, with a gambling game at every corner of every street. In the city center, the Treasure Hoarding Palace took the best spot of all gambling dens. The treasure deal you are all here for has to be held there.”
“This is a gambling town? Isn’t it Seven Treasures Sect’s domain, where deals are made?”
“It is, but the Sect Leader is a renowned gambler, dubbed the Gambling Emperor, making the deals made here resemble gambling. When conducting business with him, you either lose, or he loses. There’s no such thing as mutual satisfaction.”
“What?”
Chu Qingcheng gasped, “No fairness? Who on earth would bet with him for anything then? As one of the Eight Emperors, who’d win against him?”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “A true gambler knows when to accept a loss. Or there would never be anyone willing to risk gambling against such a man if there’s not a chance of winning. A gambler would be down without a buddy to gamble with. That’s why the Gambling Emperor is only letting luck decide. Regardless of the loss, he’ll never go back on it. This is the rule of all gambling. The moment he breaks it, no one will ever come to his town ever again.”
Chu Qingcheng nodded and then her eyes shone, “Zhuo Fan, have you ever bet against him? Ha-ha-ha, nah, it can’t be. Why would he bet against someone like you? And you don’t look to be having anything worth his time either.”
“Oh, I did bet.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed, “I offered a heaven grade cultivation method for his heaven grade martial art and won in the end. He ended up crying three whole days before he finally gave me the martial art.”
Chu Qingcheng gave him a long look.
[A Bone Tempering cultivator with a heaven grade cultivation method betting for a heaven grade martial art? If you’re going to boast, make it believable…]
Reading her like a book, Zhuo Fan held her gaze before finally chuckling, “Qingcheng, can’t believe you fell for it. Without me around, I fear someone’s going to cheat you out of your spirit stones, ha-ha-ha…”
“Y-you tricked me!”
Chu Qingcheng gaped, then started chasing Zhuo Fan around. He played along, enjoying the rare moment.
“Qingcheng, what are you doing?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1199 - 1199, Gambling Town’s Upstart
chapters.content:
Chapter 1199, Gambling Town’s Upstart
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“S-Senior aunt Mei…”
Chu Qingcheng jumped in fright, looking back in anxiety where the voice came from and stiffened like a child being caught.
A woman in her fifties came over, a mid-stage Empress, with sharp eyes and an ashen face wearing plain clothes. She glared at the two, approaching with authority.
Her fierce attitude only worked on girls, not on seasoned demons like Zhuo Fan.
[Mei Sangu hasn’t kicked the bucket yet? What a drag!]
Zhuo Fan cursed her inside.
Mei Sangu reached them and her eyes never left Chu Qingcheng. Behind her were Fang Min and the other girls, along with one young man. She pointed at Zhuo Fan’s face while cussing, “Qingcheng, who’s this? You’re a Ruby Cloud Sect disciple yet are gallivanting with a man in broad daylight? The scandal!”
“Senior aunt, h-he…” Chu Qingcheng was embarrassed, stuck unable to even introduce him.
Fang Min butted in, ever unhelpful with making things worse, “Senior aunt, he’s the thug we found in the forest looking for herbs a few months ago. He’s nothing, but he must be one smooth talker to actually get in junior sister’s graces to follow her here. Junior sister, if you were looking for a man, you sure have poor tastes. Just what are you up to hanging out with a nobody like him, ha-ha-ha…”
The other girls giggled at her expense.
“Senior sister, you misunderstand, h-he’s…” Chu Qingcheng rushed to explain but got stuck again.
Mei Sangu rushed, “Qingcheng, just what is going on here? Explain yourself. You know very well of your master’s high expectations. Don’t throw it all away on a whim.”
“Senior aunt, I-I…”
“Just tell them already!”
Chu Qingcheng kept stammering so Zhuo Fan intervened, grabbing her hand and declaring, “Forgive me, but she is with me now. You all better be nice to her, or else…”
Everyone froze, their hearts shuddering from shock. Mei Sangu could hardly believe her ears, “Qingcheng, y-you’ve already…”
“N-no, we didn’t do anything!”
Chu Qingcheng blushed hard as she explained and cursed Zhuo Fan, “What are you saying? I’m not yours at all! Could you please stop lying to everyone? What did I ever do to you to shame me so?”
Zhuo Fan shrugged, “I’m not shaming you. You were mine to begin with. Be it now and forever, no one can take you away from me.”
Chu Qingcheng gave him a long look, still distressed and red, but his bold declaration touched her.
“Ha-ha-ha, a Bone Tempering punk goes after a Ruby Cloud Sect disciple? Not even the last dead girl will be a fit for you! Humph, she’s way out of your league!”
Fang Min laughed, throwing him a despising look, then turned to the handsome youth, “Ah’Sheng, are the Sword Cloud Palace disciples allowed to have affairs with bugs?”
The youth smiled condescendingly, “We aren’t fools to resort to such absurd means. Or does junior sister think she is only fit for this guy?”
“Well said, junior sister must surely know her worth, ha-ha-ha…” Fang Min loved to mock the two.
Chu Qingcheng hung her head with guilt, tears flowing.
Mei Sangu sighed and pulled her shoulder, “Come with me, girl, you shamed us enough as it is. You’re to reflect long and hard when we return.”
Chu Qingcheng followed out of instinct.
“Qingcheng, it’s fine. Just come find me if you need anything. I’ll never let them touch a hair on you.” Zhuo Fan shouted after the two.
Fang Min mocked, “Boy, you’re so yellow on the inside that you’re now running your mouth? You call that skill? If you’re a man, just go take junior sister from senior aunt Mei’s hand. Oh, look who I’m talking to. Of course if you’d do that you’d end up flattened with senior aunt’s temper, ha-ha-ha…”
“Brother, may I know your name?” Zhuo Fan only addressed the youth next to her.
The guy was surprised, then sneered, “I am Xu Zhensheng. What may I do for you?”
“Nothing much, just meaning to give you a word of advice.”
Zhuo Fan snickered, “Catching a woman’s heart is like looking for a needle in the haystack. You have to grasp what she values. Your approach won’t get you anywhere, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan left him to digest that tidbit, while Fang Min and the girls stood there stunned.
Fang Min asked, “What did he mean by that?”
“Uh, probably nothing.”
Xu Zhensheng was out of sorts, making a random excuse, while his heart was in awe.
[He doesn’t look like it, but this guy’s like a love doctor or something. Go after what she values. It makes perfect sense!]
He butted in just now so the junior sister would be at odds with both parties, having no choice but to go with him.
What kind of person would ever want to live their lives under constant nagging? This was a clear tactic of taking advantage of the situation to get the girl to his side. They could just elope later on.
[Absolutely brilliant!]
[But what’s the point of getting the girl to follow him when he hasn’t got the skill to fight back the Ruby Cloud Sect’s hunters?]
[If he can’t handle them, why resort to dissent? he doesn’t look like the reckless and impulsive type either.]
Xu Zhensheng couldn’t figure him out. Fang Min and the girls gave him odd looks.
[What’s with Ah’Sheng? He’s been out of it just from a couple words from that guy. How peculiar…]
Mei Sangu brought Chu Qingcheng to a tavern in Mist City, where she interrogated her over what she went through.
“You’re saying that you’ve been hurt badly and he guided you here? You were just using him to show you the way, and that’s all there is to it?”
“Senior aunt, that is it for now.”
“What’s that supposed to mean? Don’t tell me later you…”
“Uh, not at all!” Chu Qingcheng shook her head and Mei Sangu finally sighed, “I hope so, Qingcheng. You are the favorite disciple of my senior sister. Don’t do anything that will bring the sect shame. Since it was just a misunderstanding, we can let it go. But next time, you are to stay clear of men, understand?”
“Yes!” Chu Qingcheng squeaked.
Mei Sangu gestured for her to leave, “Go and get some rest for two days. In three days, the exchange gathering will commence. We have to get the Nether Sea map!”
“Yes!” Chu Qingcheng was downcast as she left, with Mei Sangu sighing from behind, “Girls yearn for love. We better find them a betrothal instead of having some egotistical cheat toy with them…”
Zhuo Fan held a green jade slip, following the map inside to the center of town, to a large courtyard guarded by two Genesis Stage experts.
“This is the place.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, the two guards blocked him as he tried going inside, “Halt! Only honored guests of Mist City stay here. Laborers have no place here!”
“Step aside, I’m one of them.”
“You?” Sizing him up, the two mocked, “Have you ever seen some Bone Tempering bug treated as a guest?”
“I’m from the Luo clan, now move.”
“Luo clan?” The two started but their disdain of Zhuo Fan never diminished, “Kid, now you’re trying to scare us? The Luo clan became an honored guest only a month ago. They squandered billions of sacred stones and earned our city lord’s personal invitation here. They have many experts, of which over twenty Spirit Kings. Yet you’re saying there’s also you somewhere in there?”
Zhuo Fan’s face sank, “Then just call someone from the Luo clan and it will all be made clear?”
“Why? Is a bug worthy of the audience of such an important guest?”
“Steward Zhuo!”
A cry came just then as Li Jingtian rushed over upon noticing Zhuo, “Steward Zhuo, you’re finally here! You almost made my heart stop with your year-long disappearance!”
Ugh!
The guards blinked in stupefaction, a silly smile on their faces, “S-sir Li, y-you know him?”
“He is the Luo clan’s head steward. Be nice to him or any slight done to Steward Zhuo is a slight to the entire Luo clan. We’ll be sure to settle this debt!”
Li Jingtian gave them a tongue lashing and grabbed Zhuo Fan’s arm with a smile, “Steward Zhuo, we did as you said in the jade slip and spent a ton of money without a care. We almost bought the whole town, ha-ha-ha…”
“Good, in three days, at the treasure gathering, we must succeed!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone as he left with Li Jingtian.
The two guards were still staring with goony looks, their faces twitching.
[What’s a powerful clan doing with a Bone Tempering nobody for a head steward? From the looks of Sir Li, they value him greatly too…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1200 - 1200, Treasure Gathering
chapters.content:
Chapter 1200, Treasure Gathering
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Three days later, at the Treasure Hoarding Palace, placed in the center of Mist City, an endless crowd had gathered. Some were officials, others were average people, but they were all there for the great treasure exchange.
Though that was just a fancy word for gambling. As most treasures were never seen in public.
Some would end up spending a fortune, only to get nothing in return. Others, had the fortune of using just ten spirit stones and becoming set for life.
This was the thrill of gambling, fraught with dangers, but the potential to win a reward so valuable that it could put you in power overnight.
Everyone here walked in line, for on this day there was no status separating anyone as they entered the hall and got to their seats. The place housed hundreds of thousands, gathered around a stage where the city lord of Mist City awaited.
Today he was not just the city lord, but the host for the occasion.
With this exchange holding some very incredible items, he had to come out and handle this big event involving powerful people.
Taking a deep breath, the man of the hour overlooked the stands, tensing as he lingered a moment longer on the nine covered private booths.
Therein were the other representatives of the Eight Emperors. All were a headache to deal with and could trash this place without fear of consequences. It unnerved him, but he tried to focus and calm his mind.
“We’ve been here for a month yet still haven’t seen the city lord such a nervous wreck.”
In one of the booths, Li Jingtian glanced at the fretful man and turned to the other booths, “Steward Zhuo, today we’re up against the Eight Emperors, in the open no less, but isn’t it a bit too early with barely a year of preparations? Even Mist City Lord isn’t ready to face the others, and he has the Gambling Emperor behind him. We…”
Zhuo Fan sat in a cozy chair, “Yes, the risk is great, but we have to grasp the opportunity. It’s the best chance we have of involving ourselves in the Eight Emperors’ conflict. Who’s to say there’ll be a next one? Also, didn’t I say I will be taking the lead in this? Young miss, miss Murong, what are you two even doing here?”
Zhuo Fan looked back at the two girls.
“As the young miss of the Luo clan, I have to be present at such a huge event.” Luo Yunchang shrugged from her own fancy chair.
Murong Xue gave him a look, “I’m not about to miss out on the chance of seeing the Sacred Domain’s bigshots. So far, it doesn’t look any different from the mortal domain.”
“If it’s all the same, why come?”
Bali Yuyu rolled her eyes, “We’re here to show these big names in Sacred Domain what we’re made of, not strut about. You’re both here for nothing.”
“Hey, don’t talk like that! Who’s in charge of the clan here anyway?”
“Settle down now.”
As they were about to bicker again, Zhuo Fan intervened, “Since we’re all here, might as well enjoy it. Young miss Luo, is correct though. At such an important event, a steward isn’t enough to represent the clan head’s intentions. It’s only normal for the young miss to be here.”
Luo Yunchang rose an eyebrow, shooting Bali Yuyu a smug look. The cold lady huffed and flicked her head away.
The others chuckled at their antics.
Bang~
A deafening ringing echoed as a bell was struck. The stands went quiet, with the city lord walking forward with a smile.
“Guests, the 1784th Treasure Exchange Gathering begins! Be it the poor or the rich, this very hall offers the same opportunity to all: An opportunity to change their destiny. Life is hard and cruel, so don’t wait for it to get better. Take out everything you have and go after those treasures!”
The crowd went wild.
“We’ll start off with our first item of the day.”
At city lord’s shout, guards pushed in a trolley. It had a black cover, blocking any prying eyes as the host gave his speech, “This is a fascinating spiritual weapon for the ladies, and an obsession for the men. It is a treasure that drives shock into all. You can’t possibly imagine the world could ever have something so incredible. What is it, you ask?”
The eyes below the stage glittered, trying their best to guess what this amazing bauble could be behind that thin veil.
With a cryptic smile, the city lord resumed, “I don’t know it and neither do any of you. Per custom, it can be something grand and unique, or as common as dirt. Let the blind bidding commence and may the highest bidder win. Opportunity rarely knocks in one’s lifetime, people. Don’t miss your chance at glory!”
“One Hundred thousand spirit stones!”
A shout echoed the instant he finished riling up the crowd, followed by a flood of others, “One million! I must have it. It has to be amazing to make women fascinated and men obsessed.”
“Five million!”
The people whispered, then checked their pockets to see if they could afford it. Some had the means but not the will to step in, for fear of going bust.
Zhuo Fan sneered at the bivalent crowd, “That’s the Gambling Emperor’s ploy alright, plant to hike up the bidding. That means the item must be junk to raise it so high.”
“Why?”
“People would feel sorry spending a fortune over something cheap, but it garners attention. While buying something valued with a lower price would cause excitement and greed. All these years, the Gambling Emperor has been using this trick to cheat people out of their money. It’s an old tactic, but there’s plenty of people out there who would fall for it all the same, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan shook his head in disdain. Li Jingtian nodded, “Yeah, but what kind of fools would fall for it?”
“Do you need to ask? Us, of course!”
“Eh?” Li Jingtian flinched, “Steward Zhuo, you know it’s a trick yet still go for it?”
“What else do you expect from an upstart? You’re saying all those sacred stones you wasted the past month are to be for nothing?”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “The grand Eight Emperors are high up on their throne and hardly anyone could get close. The best way is to find some dumb and gullible moneybags. Who wouldn’t want a friend, uh, pawn like that? That’s how you gain value by joining their circle, taking back what you lost plus interest.”
Li Jingtian grinned, “Steward Zhuo, you always look ahead.”
“Then let’s bid, but what’s the price at right now?”
“Eight million.”
“Then will add one more…”
“Ten million!”
A shout came first before Zhuo Fan got the chance, filled with power.
Zhuo Fan’s eye twitched looking over.
[One of the Eight Emperors?]
“Ah’Sheng, we’re not here to have some bet with the Gambling Emperor, nor do we have so many spirit stones. The map is all that matters!”
In the booth where the last bid came from, an elder with white eyebrows eyed Xu Zhensheng with a grave look.
Xu Zhensheng smiled, “Senior uncle, I’m buying with my own money for a girl. As long as she likes it, the price won’t matter. It won’t affect the sect’s coffers by a single stone.”
He then gave Fang Min a dazzling smile.
She felt her insides tingle, then she preened at her junior sisters.
[See that, my man knows how to please his girl. Envious much? Ha-ha-ha…]
The girls nodded like good children, with only Chu Qingcheng depressed, her mind always on Zhuo Fan.
“Sir Liu, Ah’Sheng looks smitten with Ah’Min. It won’t be long before they tie the knot, ha-ha-ha…” Third aunt Mei giggled, showing her white teeth, a stark difference from how she acted around Zhuo Fan and Qingcheng.
Her mind was another matter, however.
[Ah’Min is good at this, having the kid wrapped around her finger. Humph, let him waste his money on the junk, and then they won’t have anything left to bid for the Nether Sea map!]
[Damn broad, going as far as using a honey trap!]
The elder frowned, reading her like a book.
[He says he’s using his own money, but isn’t your pocket money taken from the sect? We’re in Gambling Town and he should know its standards. What if you’re wasting just that little bit of money we might need to place a winning bid at the very end? How is that going to help the sect?]
The elder glared hard at Xu Zhensheng.
He caught his meaning but showed no reaction.
[Chasing girls is pricey. That guy used the elder’s nagging to make the lass fall for him then elope. I’ll just use money to buy a girl’s heart. Isn’t that the same?]
[And regarding eloping, bringing the Ruby Cloud Sect’s head senior sister over to the Sword Emperor’s sect will earn me bragging rights. Some glittering rocks can’t ever compare to that.]
“Twenty million!”
Zhuo Fan shouted an even higher bid…

chapters.title: Chapter 1201 - 1201, A Moneybags’ Style
chapters.content:
Chapter 1201, A Moneybags’ Style
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Xu Zhensheng’s face twitched and fell, glaring at the other booth, “Senior uncle, who is that?”
“Oh, that must be the Luo clan.”
The old man squinted and said, “They’re not with them, just a group that got fame from throwing their money around in Gambling Town recently, nothing but moneybags.”
[Nothing?]
[They go after Eight Emperors’ people without any backing? I can’t lose now, what about Sword Emperor’s sect’s reputation!]
Xu Zhensheng shouted, “Thirty million…”
“Zhensheng!”
The elder snapped, a little too late. Youths could never handle a challenge right, irking for a fight at the slightest provocation.
Thirty million was his yearly allowance for training, yet it was all thrown over some unknown useless bauble.
The old man cursed him for being a sore loser, while Fang Min rejoiced under the second hand attention.
Zhuo Fan casually replied, “Sacred stones!”
The entire stands were stirring, with all eyes fixed on his booth in shock.
Twenty million sacred stones over some random crap? That was no longer betting, but throwing cash around.
[What kinda moneybags are behind that curtain?]
Xu Zhensheng choked, grimacing, unable to face Fang Min’s hopeful eyes and choosing to direct all his hatred at the enemy.
[Bastard, who the hell are these Luos? Throwing away twenty million sacred stones like garbage? Did they run out of spirit stones? This is absurd! They got more money than a Sword Emperor disciple!]
The senior uncle was stunned, but sighed in relief.
[I’m glad this wastrel got his desires curbed, ha-ha-ha…]
“Uh, honored Luo clan, are you sure you want to bet twenty million sacred stones on this?” The city lord was taken aback as well.
All eyes awaited for the booth’s reply.
“City Lord, we only have sacred stones and we’ll only be using them from now on.”
Boom!
The hall exploded with clamor, never leaving the booth out of their sight. They all heard of the Luo clan’s deep pockets, but to think they were bottomless.
They used sacred stones right off the bat and they would keep doing it! What were the rest supposed to bet then?
Many clutched their heads, grimacing out of futility to deal with this upstart.
Looking at the crowd, the city lord stuck to his role, “The Luo clan bid twenty million sacred stones on this item. Is there anyone else who bids more?”
Silent as the grave.
“No one at all?” The city lord tried.
Seeing no reaction, he declared, “Then the fascination of women and obsession of men shall go to the Luo clan!”
The city lord threw his arm and uncovered the trolley to reveal a dazzling prismatic hairpin, decorated with 18 crystalline pearls of incredible clarity that mesmerized the crowd.
The girls in particular, looked spellbound, holding them under its mystical spell.
“Prismatic Virtuous Hairpin, created from refined metal 180 times and adorned with pearls, each priceless. As a woman, wearing such a pearl hairpin would magnify their beauty, emphasize their elegance, and perfect their image.
The city lord went on, “Alas, it can’t be considered anything more than a hairpin. Any man that would buy it is bound to have their hearts bleed in regret going home with this trinket, ha-ha-ha…”
The audience burst out in laughter, most of which were men, of course. As for the women, they were just enamored with the pearl hairpin.
The Ruby Cloud Sect women, even Mei Sangu, weren’t any different, their eyes sparkling like that of a young girl.
Fang Min bit her lip, giving Xu Zhensheng a reproachful look, “You’re useless. You couldn’t even buy a hairpin.”
“Sister Min, it’s good that he didn’t. It’s nothing but a pointless decoration worth less than a hundred spirit stones.”
“As if! It has its uses and I wanted it!” Fang Min whined like a spoiled brat. Chu Qingcheng nodded at the side, envious, “Sure it’s not valuable, but it’ll be nice to be able to wear it just once.”
“You? Ha!”
Fang Min scoffed, “No amount of hairpins will work on someone as hopeless as you!”
Chu Qingcheng pouted with a lowered head.
The city lord turned to the Luo clan to say, “Of course, a sword is worthy of a hero, as makeup is sublime on a lady. We’ve been mocking its value only from a man’s standpoint. For a woman, however, especially a breathtaking beauty as young miss Luo, it is another matter entirely. With your wealth, it is not just about money when bidding on the hairpin, but a must have accessory. Take the hairpin to young miss Luo!”
“Yes.”
An attendant took the trolley with the item.
All the eyes that glittered as the item passed belong solely to women, filled with envy.
“Hold!” A voice from the booth came.
“Wha…”
“Give this hairpin to Ruby Cloud Sect’s young miss Chu Qingcheng.”
Everyone got rowdy again. All whispering as they turned in Ruby Cloud Sect’s direction.
[Luo clan just threw away twenty million sacred stones just so it can gift it to Ruby Cloud Sect? Are they their backers?]
The Ruby Cloud Sect group was baffled as well. Fang Min turned eager to Mei Sangu, “Senior aunt, is the Luo clan with us?”
The elder stared at her hard, tense.
[With Ruby Cloud Sect having such a wealthy branch, it will make the last bidding dangerous.]
“I don’t know. Sect Leader didn’t tell me anything. Were they sent to help?” Mei Sangu was floundering.
An attendant brought the item over, bowing, “Senior, who might miss Qingcheng be?”
Whoosh~
All eyes focused on Chu Qingcheng, who looked out of sorts as she raised a hand.
The attendant smiled and bowed again as he presented the hairpin, “As miss heard, the Luo clan’s master gifts you this. Please take it miss.”
“Uh, oh.”
Chu Qingcheng operated on reflex at this point, too overwhelmed to speak. Before she did reach it, however, another hand flicked the cover and moved to grab it right in her face.
With a cold eye, the attendant dodged the insidious hand, staring at the owner, “Miss, you’re not Chu Qingcheng and I can’t give it to you.”
“I’m the head senior sister of Ruby Cloud Sect, Fang Min. If Luo clan told you to give Ruby Cloud Sect the time, then why can’t I have it?” Fang Min’s eyes burned with jealousy as she grinded her teeth.
The man spat, “Master Luo bought the hairpin, and it’s our duty to give it to the rightful owner. Gambling Town abides by this rule. Since sir wished for young miss Qingcheng of Ruby Cloud Sect to have it, it’s clear that it doesn’t belong to the sect itself.”
“Damn you…”
“Min’er, stop making a scene. You’re only making a fool of yourself.”
Fang Min was about to flip out, but Mei Sangu shouted. She then smiled, “Qingcheng, it’s his gift, so take it.”
Chu Qingcheng nodded with a smile, taking the item offered by the attendant and adorning the hairpin in her hair.
The clothes made the man, or the woman in this case, as the hairpin blended flawlessly with the perfect girl, turning her otherworldly…

chapters.title: Chapter 1202 - 1202, Gambling Stage
chapters.content:
Chapter 1202, Gambling Stage
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Qingcheng? Did you find her?”
Luo Yunchang heard Zhuo Fan shouting and flinched, “Did I hear right? Is she from Ruby Cloud Sect?”
Zhuo Fan nodded and eased a long breath, “Yes, it’s truly unfortunate that she is so close to Ruby Cloud Sect. It’s sure to make things worse at one point.”
“T-then congratulations…”
Li Jingtian muttered, looking strained. Zhuo Fan cared not, saying, “Elder Li, there’s something strange about the secrecy around Qingcheng in Ruby Cloud Sect. Look into it, as well as what events happened a hundred years ago. I have a feeling that hag is setting her up for something.”
“Sure, Steward Zhuo, I’ll go check it out later.”
“Thanks.”
Zhuo Fan frowned, his mind elsewhere.
The city lord once again announced, “Ladies and gentlemen, as well as seniors, the first item found an owner but you needn’t fret, for our second item is far more precious. Bring it in…”
“Thirty million!”
The city lord flinched, looking again at the Luo clan booth with a twitchy eye, “S-sir, I’ve yet to call out the starting price…”
“Who cares, I just gotta have it!”
Boom!
The stands were taken by storm once more. The first item’s only clue to its value was the city lord’s base price, but now that was shot out the window, placing a sky-high bid off the bat regardless if it was junk or diamonds. Though it would be such a shame for those thirty million sacred stones if it ended up being a bust.
Thinking about it from a different angle.
[What shame would there be if they’re filthy rich? The real question is, just how loaded are they to burn so much money?]
The focus of the gathering has changed from betting, to figuring out the mystery behind the Luo clan.
[Where did they come from?]
The city lord sighed, but stuck to his role, calling it thrice, “Anyone else? Anyone at all? Someone?”
Everyone was silent. Knowing nothing about that thing on the stage, and already having a thirty million bid on it, no one would be insane to take such unwarranted risk.
“The item goes to the Luo clan!”
The city lord slammed his gavel, “What is it, you might ask? Let us see…”
“Give it to young miss Qingcheng from Ruby Cloud Sect, thanks!”
Zhuo Fan cut him off, making the city lord stumble. He gave a powerless and strained sigh as he said, “Sir, you don’t even wish to know what you bought?”
“No, since everything will be delivered to young miss Qingcheng!” Zhuo Fan’s tone was irreproachable.
The city lord gave a casual wave, sending the attendant with the item. Everyone watched as the unknown item moved away.
This never happened once in the history of Mist City.
Ruby Cloud Sect’s group was dumbfounded.
[Who’s Luo clan? Why are they just giving us stuff? They want to work their way into our good graces?]
[Yeah, that’s gotta be it. But why then are they sending it to just one person, the youngest disciple?]
That was what had these girls stumped.
So began an endless trail of unknown items sent to Chu Qingcheng with every outrageous bid from Zhuo Fan before the city lord ever got to rile up the crowd.
Chu Qingcheng had to do nothing and found herself swimming in treasures with a blank look.
As for the people coming here for the thrill of betting, they were left powerless against such moneybags, turning into props to make him look good.
Since he won all the items with an impossible price, the others had nothing on him. It was a sad day for any gambler. A dreamer, or a plain addict, it mattered not the heavy loss or the crushing defeat, but being unable to bet!
The city lord felt the worst of it by far.
With every dreaded call from Zhuo Fan, an item was bought without even being able to get a word in. The only dignity as host remaining was to call the next item.
It was a sad sad day for him.
Now that all the items were gone, it was city lord’s time to shine once more, “With the commodities over, we would first like to thank our honored Luo clan for being our greatest investor. The next item shall be the greatest the city has ever seen. The Eight Emperors of the Sacred Domain shall now compete over our last item, Nether Sea map. Others are welcome to join, so long as you can stomach it and have the strength to back it, ha-ha-ha.”
[Eight Emperors?]
The tired or bored gamblers thought the last item might be their time to shine. They were happy chasing the thrill even if it meant losing the shirt off their backs.
Hearing Eight Emperors being mentioned, however, woke them up on the spot.
[You kidding me? Bet with the Eight Emperors? I’m too young to die!]
Not a sound was made in the entire hall, with the audience feeling a chill down their backs. The city lord gave them a cold smile, then smirked at the Luo clan’s booth.
[You can have the world’s wealth in your pocket, but not even you have the gall to challenge these powerhouses.]
“Eight Emperors representatives, this is a request from the Gambling Emperor. Please present your bids on the table so that the winner can be declared without any hard feelings. Bring chairs and a table!”
Someone brought a large table and seven seats. The city lord smiled, being the first to face it and take out a gray map to display it on the table.
The people in the booths huffed and made their way out, including Mei Sangu’s group, each looking impressive.
The audience had their first glimpse of real power.
“What does the Gambling Emperor intend with this? Give his town a show?”
“Yeah, as each of us are people of repute, why should we bother giving these people any consideration by showing our competition? Does the Gambling Emperor want to inflate his image? Are you planning on leading all of the other Emperor representatives by the nose?”
Curses and sneers sounded at the table as each representative took their seats, with their people standing behind.
The city lord smiled, “People, since you came to Gambling Town, you must gather around the betting table. The Nether Sea map can’t just be given, since the Gambling Emperor has been wanting the Nether Sovereign’s seat of enlightenment as well.”
“Why invite us here for…”
“Betting!”
The city lord’s eyes shone, showing a sinister smile, “We can’t sell it to you, but we can lose it as long as you have the means to win it.”
Mei Sangu squinted and huffed, “Fine, and how do we play?”
“I’m sure the common games of chance are beneath such fine people, so we’ll be using riddles. Guessing right makes you the winner. In case of a draw, the house wins.”
The city lord smirked.
[Riddle?]
The seven people nodded, “Fine!”
“Then let the games begin!”
“Wait!”
To the shock of everyone in there, a shout came from the Luo clan booth.
“Add another seat. The Luo clan is joining!”
[What?!]
The crowd stirred.
[The Luo clan is competing with the Eight Emperors? Is it suicidal? Or do they have backing?]
The representatives themselves were taken aback, each trying to guess their history. With such nerves of steel, they had to be something else to join such a bet.
Did they represent Sacred Mountain?
The city lord smiled, “Bring another seat. There’s plenty of room around the betting table!”
One empty chair appeared on the side of the large table, with everyone fixed on it with strange gazes.
The Luo clan walked out of their booth and made their way down.
Chu Qingcheng and Ruby Cloud Sect’s girls gasped, “You? What are you doing here?”
“As part of the Luo clan, it’s only natural that I follow young miss. Something wrong?” Zhuo Fan beamed, walking in front. His mysterious manner gave others no means of reading him…

chapters.title: Chapter 1203 - 1203, Treasure Competition
chapters.content:
Chapter 1203, Treasure Competition
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Startled, Chu Qingcheng stared at Zhuo Fan, getting more confused by the second. The other girls couldn’t wrap their heads how a magnate like the Luo clan would take in Bone Tempering garbage.
Zhuo Fan couldn’t care less about what they thought, smiling at one particular girl, “Qingcheng, did you like what I gave you?”
“Ah, you gave them to me…”
“Yes, did you like them?” Zhuo Fan sighed, “Sorry for giving you random things. We were only together for a short time and couldn’t tell what you’d like so I just gave you everything to pick the right one for you. If you don’t like anything, just throw them away. But tell me what you like so I’ll be sure to pick the best for you next time.”
“Uh, it’s fine, they’re all nice.” Chu Qingcheng blushed red-hot, lowering her head as her heart blossomed in her chest.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Nice? What were they then, since I couldn’t see? Tell me all about them so I can give you more in the future.”
“You don’t have to waste your money…”
“Humph, he didn’t waste anything, especially since he didn’t even want that stuff. So he just showered you with them while he was at it. You really think he’ll do it again?”
Fang Min was stewing in her jealousy as she scoffed, “Master Luo must’ve bought all that to show off, regardless what stuff it was. Who knows what the punk must’ve said to his master to gain the right to handle such garbage. He’s nowhere near capable of getting millions of sacred stones from his master just to burn them for you.”
“Yeah, he’s just a lucky bastard to have such a nice master to take him in. What a shame to have picked dirt from the ground. Of course he has no say over his master’s money, not to give it to you at least.”
Xu Zhensheng was also irked, “Junior sister, you better stay away from him. He’s nothing but a lapdog. Do you wish to rely on someone’s charity?”
Chu Qingcheng looked hurt, giving Zhuo Fan a long look before saying, “Senior sister, but he’s really nice. Even if he didn’t buy all of that, just his thoughtful…”
“Come again? Dumping the stuff his master didn’t want on you is thoughtful? Dumb girl, are you so cheap?”
Fang Min glared hard then turned to Mei Sangu, “Senior aunt, shouldn’t you handle this? Junior sister Qingcheng is being misled.”
Mei Sangu gave Zhuo Fan a cold look, speaking to the seated Luo Yunchang, “Girl, leash your servant from his obnoxious flirting.”
“Hey, old bat, it’s you who should tighten the chain on those she-dogs, their incessant barking is driving us nuts.” Luo Yunchang bit back.
The audience gaped.
The Luo clan just taunted an Emperor’s representative?
[How cool is that! Just who are they?]
Mei Sangu was nearing her tenth millennium yet just got insulted by a wee girl. Of course she’d explode, slapping the table and flaring her aura at Luo Yunchang, “You have some nerve, dumb girl!”
Whoosh~
A figure flashed in front of Luo Yunchang, spreading his cold aura to counter Mei Sangu’s temper, meeting in an explosive clash.
Mei Sangu shook, her heart in shock. Bali Yuyu fell back, glaring at Mei Sangu in challenge.
[Old bat, not bad at all!]
[How did this miss…]
Mei Sangu sized Bali Yuyu up, shocked by the second. The rest were baffled while also raising the Luo clan’s importance in their minds.
Mei Sangu was a tested and true Emperor Stage expert, but Bali Yuyu was a mere Spirit King. Despite the gap, they were matched.
[No wonder the Luo clan joined the Eight Emperors’ fray.]
The representatives’ hearts sank, no longer dismissing them. The audience was restless.
Bali Yuyu took a deep breath, turning to Zhuo Fan who only had eyes for Chu Qingcheng, “Steward Zhuo, you caused this mess yet you’re flirting to the side?”
“Yeah, Steward Zhuo, you said you wanted to bet so we came along. Why should you stay behind and relax while I’m taking it over for you?” Luo Yunchang gave him a smile, her tone bitter.
[Steward?]
Chu Qingcheng started, “Y-you’re Luo clan’s steward?”
The rest were astonished.
[How did a Bone Tempering cultivator end up being a magnate’s steward? Don’t they care about power when headhunting?]
“Uh, I’ll explain later.”
With a wide smile, Zhuo Fan rushed back, leaving Chu Qingcheng in confusion.
Zhuo Fan reached Luo Yunchang and she casually ceded her seat. Li Jingtian tidied it up before gesturing to Zhuo Fan to take it with utmost respect.
The audience was staring dumbstruck as the Luo clan steward took the seat of honor.
[But why…]
The city lord gave him a long look of confusion, but knew he was valued so he also treated the steward with the respect he deserved, regardless of cultivation.
“Sir Zhuo, so young and so promising.”
“Thank you, City Lord. We may now begin the bet.”
“Gladly!”
The city lord nodded and addressed the eight people at the table, “With all participants in order, I shall now speak of the rules. First of all, money dictates the chips you hold, the more you have the easier to advance and become the house. The poorest needs to win bouts with the house to stay in the game. The instant he loses, it’s game over.”
Mei Sangu squinted, “Which means?”
“You take turns playing.”
The city lord snickered, “Let’s say, for example sake, that we both take our treasures. If mine proves to be worth more, then I’m the house and you have to bet against me. Win, and you get everything to bet with the next contender. Beat all the others and you’ll be crowned victorious.”
The people gasped, “So before we get to challenge you, we first have to fight among each other? That means all the treasures might end with you while we get nothing!”
“Yes, such a possibility exists, but it so happens that I’m the holder of the priceless Nether Sea map. All the treasures here can’t hope to come close to it. That makes me, as a matter of course, the final house. Before that, however, give your all. One more thing, the first better has an advantage. He might have two treasures and can be a house, ha-ha-ha…”
Their faces sank and gnashed their teeth. The Gambling Emperor was evil, getting all of them to duke it out and still having a high chance of losing everything at the very end.
The map was his and so would be their treasures.
[We’d get nothing!]
Folding, however, was not an option either.
Stealing, on the other hand, would leave dire consequences to everyone here. It was a different item from that Nine Serenities Secret Records. It had instant use, while this was merely a guiding tool.
It was not worth waging war over something so vague.
The contenders finally made their decision, nodding.
[Let’s do this!]
Whoosh~
Mei Sangu revealed her prismatic cup, “This is Ruby Cloud Sect’s core treasure, Purple Gold Glazed Cup, a 4th grade sacred weapon.”
“The Demonic Emperor allowed me to bring the Demonic Gauntlet, a 3rd grade sacred weapon.” An old man with black hair sighed as he threw in a claw with dark energy oozing out.
He knew it was less than the Purple Gold Glazed Cup.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shook.
It was his finest work back in the day, given to his treacherous disciple.
[To think I’d see it here.]
The other representatives took out their own as well, some 4th other 3rd grade. The highest, however, belonged to the Sword Emperor, Howling Sword, 5th grade.
The others gasped.
[This guy can become the second house.]
[He doesn’t seem to mind using something so valuable in a bet.]
The city lord went by the book as he turned to Zhuo Fan, “Luo clan, the item of your choosing…”
“Magnates like them only have money. They have no legacy, only building their wealth over time, humph.” Fang Min found the right moment to mock them.
Zhuo Fan smiled and in a shower of light, a draconic roar echoed. The gaudy glow had them gawking…

chapters.title: Chapter 1204 - 1204, Brutal
chapters.content:
Chapter 1204, Brutal
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Clink!
The light trailed over their heads and landed on the table, revealing the glorious and ostentatious three-meter-long sword, with even a dragon scale on it no less.
The city lord’s face twitched, “Peak 5th grade sacred weapon? It’s close to 6th grade even, a true rarity in the Sacred Domain.”
“That’s far from all. City Lord, would you care to take a closer look upon the way it was made? This is by no means amateur work, nor your average 5th grade sacred weapon.” Luo Yunchang raise an eyebrow in pride.
The city lord bobbed his head, “Indeed, young miss Luo is right. The maker has instilled his peak sword arts into it, making it even have a spirit! Incredible! I fear not even a 6th grade sacred weapon might compare!”
“It’s a certainty, not just a possibility!”
Zhuo Fan grinned as he pointed out, “City Lord, look here, could anyone get their hands on such ingredients?”
The city lord took a closer look and gasped in shock, “Y-you mean to say it’s made with a scale from a Dragon King from the Dragon Lands?”
The audience widened their eyes and cried out. Even the representatives were shaken up as they stared in disbelief.
[They have the nerve to have a sacred weapon made of a Dragon King scale? Do they have a death wish?]
“Y-young miss Luo, don’t you know if the dragons from the Dragon Lands find out…” Th city lord’s face twitched hard, barely finding the words to speak.
Zhuo Fan waved off his concern, “City Lord, relax, we don’t fear them, which is why we’ve taken it out. A Dragon King is a peak 10th level spiritual beast, stronger than the average Emperor. We took one’s scales to make a weapon out of it, yet we’d be scared to let them find out? Ha-ha-ha…”
“Uh… I see…”
Th city lord gave a bright smile, his heart racing as his image of Luo clan grew in his mind.
Dragons were kings among spiritual beasts, with many powerful beings among them. Not even the Seven Sacred Mountains would mess with them, but the Luo clan did.
[Just who has their backs?]
Everyone’s disdain of them was cut short then and there.
The city lord gave them a long look then declared, “People, I believe you all know the value of a 5th grade sacred weapon. All of your treasures combined can’t even match Luo clan and Sword Emperor’s items, each. With Luo clan’s being slightly better. Besides me, Luo clan is the final house, followed by the Sword Emperor representative, then all of you according to your treasures. Objections?”
“It’s plain to see this is fair, so of course there aren’t any.”
A grimacing old man took the Demonic Gauntlet as he turned to savage-looking young master, “Wraith Scholar, your Shadow Veil is 4th grade. As the Demonic Emperor’s representative, bet with me, with you being the house.”
The scholar had a creepy smile as he fanned himself with a ghastly fan, nodding, “Sure, I shall be happy to face Thousand Faced Devil. You ask first.”
“No, it’s your right as the house.”
“With pleasure!”
Pa!
Snapping the fan closed, the scholar said, “Answer me this, was it the Demonic Emperor the one who destroyed the 36 gates of Demon Light Castle three years ago?”
Thousand Faced Devil’s face shook, stammering, “Wraith Scholar, why do you say that? Didn’t you investigate and found it to be the Falcon Emperor?”
“Yes, we thought so as well, but after fighting among each other and suffering losses, it was the Demonic Emperor who took advantage of the gap to step in. How do you explain that?”
“What’s so strange about them relying on the Demonic Emperor for protection to avoid casualties?”
“None, actually, but in our war, neither side won, with the prideful Demonic Emperor expanding his domain for thousands of miles. It baffled both of us.”
Wraith Scholar snickered as he stared Thousand Faced Devil down, “You’re his right-hand man, so I would like to hear it from you. Spare us both the trouble of lying, it won’t work. Everyone here knows, I’m sure, just that there is no proof. The Gambling Emperor is known to be fair at the gambling table. If his people judge it to be a lie, you shall become the loser.”
Taking a deep breath Thousand Faced Devil eyed the cold city lord. He already had a decision in mind and knew the truth.
“Fine, I admit it to be the Demonic Emperor’s doing. But that’s because…”
“I only needed that cleared up. You win.”
Wraith Scholar snickered as he pushed his treasure over, “The Wraith Emperor will be sure to join the Falcon Emperor to settle this debt with the Demonic Emperor. Tell him to be ready for a reckoning!”
Thousand Faced Devil’s face twitched as he took it, “I will tell him.”
“Farewell.”
Wraith Scholar stood up and cupped his hands, “Thank the Gambling Emperor for his fairness. I shall now take my leave.”
The others looked puzzled as he went.
[Isn’t this supposed to be a riddle? How come it became truth or dare?]
Bam!
Thousand Faced Devil slapped the table in anger, “City Lord, is this the Gambling Emperor’s intention?”
“The Gambling Emperor only proposed betting, not involving himself in your issues. Now sir has two items and can be the house.” The city lord smiled.
Thousand Faced Devil was outraged, but he held it in.
Gambling Emperor knew all along what happened then. He kept it hidden for so long not to gain hatred. With the two having no proof of hanging it over the Demonic Emperor’s head, they could do nothing.
Today, however, he had no choice but to admit it, thus giving them an excuse.
It wasn’t his fault though, since the Demonic Emperor gave him strict orders to get that map. If he denied it, he would have gotten back only to die. The Demonic Emperor’s cruelty was well-known.
Taking a deep breath, Thousand Faced Devil could only keep going. The Demonic Emperor was already tough enough not to fear the other two. All that mattered was the map.
So he turned to the FalconEmperor’s representative to shout, “I’m the house now, please…”
The grizzled old man met his challenge.
Thousand Faced Devil did have some skill though, using his cunning and favoritism to pave his way forward and win many treasures. He was now facing Ruby Cloud Sect, “How many stars are in the sky?”
“With so many shining, who can say? Can you?” Mei Sangu retorted.
Thousand Faced Devil snickered and shook his head, “I don’t either, making this a draw. But I’m the house so that makes it my win. Hand it over.”
Thousand Faced Devil threw the Purple Gold Glazed Cup in his bag. Ruby Cloud Sect’s group was stumped. Mei Sangu stammered, “Wait, I’ve yet to ask my question!”
“You did, or does that not count?” City lord smiled and shrugged, “Gambling Town is fair. Your question was the same as his and with neither knowing the answer, the house won.”
The women grimaced. Zhuo Fan chuckled.
The devil now turned to the old man with the white eyebrows, taking out his treasures as he spoke with hatred, “Brother Liu, listen closely to my question!”
“Wait!”
The old man smiled and said, “I’m the house, so I go first.”
“Go ahead.”
“Guess how many toes I had on my 5000th birthday.”
“Uhm…”
Thousand Faced Devil looked down at his shoes, making a wild guess, “Ten. I’ve never heard of you suffering heavy wounds and shouldn’t have anything cut off.”
The old man grinned, taking out a shoe to reveal all his five toes. Then his eyes shone and pointed. A bloody toe splattered on the floor.
The old man sweated as he laughed, “Today’s my 5000th birthday and only have nine toes. You lose, Thousand Faced Devil!”
[That’s brutal!]
Thousand Faced Devil gave him a long look, wanting to refute, but he pushed the treasure over, “Fine, old man, I lost.”
Now Liu was the house. Even in a draw with Sword Emperor, Thousand Faced Devil would still lose.
“Kid, it’s our turn.”
The old man wiped his brow, dragging his bleeding foot to Zhuo Fan with a forced smile. What welcomed him was a smirk…

chapters.title: Chapter 1205 - 1205, Headache
chapters.content:
Chapter 1205, Headache
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Looking down at the blood, the ghastly scene made even Ruby Cloud Sect’s girls cover their eyes. It shocked them to the core to find someone so resolute to even harm themselves.
Zhuo Fan looked back up, giving the old man a snicker, “Senior, you’re playing hardball!”
“Kid, youths have little experience. There’re plenty of savager people in the world than me. You’ll meet them later. Letting this little frighten you proves you have no place on this stage.”
“Ha-ha-ha, sir’s lesson is right. I hope sir will go easy on me.”
“You’re making it hard for these old bones. The Sword Emperor must have that map. I urge you to withdraw. Kid, you don’t understand the world of adults.” The old man patronized.
Chu Qingcheng was worried for Zhuo Fan. He looked wise and bold, making her feel like a kid would be no match for him.
[I just hope he won’t push it and get hurt in the process.]
Zhuo Fan’s eye held an eerie glow as he offered, “Please!”
“Kid, the young fear nothing, but will only end up broken, ha-ha-ha…” The old man stared at him, extending his wounded leg, “Kid, the same question, how many toes did I have on my 5000th birthday?”
Zhuo Fan snickered, “With senior having nine, then it must be nine.”
“Ha-ha-ha, kid, you think I wouldn’t cut another off?”
The old man drew his fingers and shot for the leg and another bloody toe fell. The old man bore through the pain, looking smug, “Wrong, it’s eight!”
The people sighed.
Against such a question, no one could guess as long as he keeps cutting off his toes.
[The kid met his match in an aged scoundrel.]
Whoosh~
A black light flashed, and the old man Liu shook. Below him, blood spilled like a flood, followed by a searing pain.
“Aah!”
The old man howled as he fell to the ground, leaving two intact feet in the pooling blood. Zhuo Fan stood across, holding a black longsword glowing eerily.
“I was wrong after all. I mustn’t know anything, I guess. But it looks like senior was wrong as well. You didn’t have eight toes on your 5000th birthday, but none, ha-ha-ha…”
Everyone shivered as their eyes bugged out.
The old guy was the Sword Emperor’s representative, that nobody dared to offend. Now a Bone Tempering nobody did…
[Wait, how did he get the strength to cut an Emperor’s feet off?]
Chu Qingcheng was frightened. She never saw Zhuo Fan cut someone down, but the familiar scene had her hesitating.
[Is he the same brat I’ve been cursing all this time?]
“Senior uncle, are you alright?”
Xu Zhensheng rushed to his side, then glared at Zhuo Fan, “Y-you dare…”
Zhuo Fan cut him off, “What, since senior can change the outcome, why can’t I? City Lord, how do we settle this round?”
“Tie.” The city lord’s face twitched, giving him an odd look. He didn’t think this kid with low cultivation had it in him to be so cruel.
Zhuo Fan grinned, “I knew City Lord was fair. But that was his question and now comes mine. Although, senior doesn’t look to be in shape to continue. Switch, maybe?”
“Humph, rotten punk, I’ll take his place to bet with you!”
Xu Zhensheng gnashed his teeth and stepped forward. He then felt his senior uncle pulling his sleeve as he lay in his own blood, looking worried.
“Senior uncle…”
“Ah’Sheng, you’re not his match.”
The old man was trembling as he looked at Zhuo Fan’s vile smile, “I was wrong. He’s no youth, but a conniving old monster. Boy, you won’t win.”
Xu Zhensheng couldn’t believe his ears. He was a great peak-stage Spirit King yet he couldn’t win against a Bone Tempering punk?
The other youths on stage looked baffled.
Only a few veterans caught his meaning. Mei Sangu as well could see that Zhuo Fan’s eyes were beyond shifty, her opinion of him changing into fright.
The slash was too clean and without hesitation, coming at an Emperor no less. Such nerves and savagery didn’t come from just anywhere.
It was an edge forged in endless bloodshed and over a mountain of corpses.
How could a Bone Tempering cultivator wield such experience?
The old man gripped Xu Zhensheng hard, gasping for breath as he gnashed his teeth, “City Lord, we give up. You bet with him. Boy, this isn’t over. I will get you for taking my two feet!”
“Anytime!”
Zhuo Fan turned towards city lord, “Care to ask, City Lord?”
The city lord looked grave, “Steward Zhuo, now I know why you wield a clan’s power, having the skills to handle the job.”
“Thanks.”
“Here’s my question.”
The city lord paused, “This is the Nether Sea map. I want to know that if you got the map, how sure are you of finding it?”
Everyone flinched at the question, focused on the two with rapt attention as they waited for the answer.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “I didn’t even see the map so how sure I can be? Like with any treasure map, I’ll be doing my best. Is that enough?”
“A perfect answer, since this answer comes from your heart. Take it.”
The city lord handed the map to Zhuo Fan.
Looking over the aged paper, Zhuo Fan said, “Just like that? I’ve yet to ask my question. You’re the house and have the highest chance of winning?”
“Steward Zhuo’s methods opened my eyes. I’m sure I can’t answer it anyway. I lose, ha-ha-ha…” The city lord said.
Zhuo Fan paused then showed a vague smile as he stashed the map in his ring, “Thanks.”
Zhuo Fan waved and left with his group, under the hard stares of everyone there.
One looked forlorn, stuck between women as she sighed.
[He won’t even look at me once?]
On the road, Bali Yuyu looked back to see no one, smirking, “Here I thought the map was something special, but we got it easy.”
“Easy?”
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Easy meant those people in there wouldn’t have bled for it. Didn’t you notice how pained the representatives were when taking out the treasures?”
“Since it’s so important, why isn’t there anyone tailing us?”
“Because it’s just a map and not something you can use either. It’s common practice of those relics to see the prize before jumping in. After we find the Nether Sea, those bastards are sure to charge, all of them!”
Zhuo Fan sneered, “The map is no treasure, but a headache. They’re all waiting for us to find the real deal before robbing us blind. Even the Gambling Emperor is no exception. Why do you think he never tried looking for it then? He had the map. I bet he couldn’t figure the map out, so he went to find another that can while he lurks from behind.”
“Why then would the other seven go through such trouble?”
“The other Emperors haven’t looked over the map and while they knew it was hard to understand it, they still want to try; such is greed. If he did unravel it by any chance, wouldn’t he get everything? Just like…”
Zhuo Fan trailed off.
Back then, in Nine Serenities’s tomb, he unraveled its mystery.
Bali Yuyu nodded and said, “Since it’s a headache, why did we fight for it? Couldn’t we be another lurking shadow instead?”
“Oh, Yuyu, the shadows are all seasoned and famed geezers. Our Luo clan has yet to make a name for itself in Sacred Domain. Why hide? We’re only using the map to knock on the Eight Emperors’ doors and enter the fray. Without it, there’s no way for us to enter the eight great lands of the Sacred Domain.”
“Oh, so that’s why. Who do we go to first?”
“The Demonic Emperor, Zhao Chen!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, his smile evil…

chapters.title: Chapter 1206 - 1206, Honey Trap
chapters.content:
Chapter 1206, Honey Trap
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Zhuo Fan stood in the center of a pitch-black room. He took out a black sword as his right eye shone in two golden halos.
“Divine Eye of the Void’s 2nd stage, Void Annihilation!”
Bam!
A ripple struck the sword, making it shiver. It then whooshed as it turned into a tanned child. Sword Child had regained its freedom.
“Master, you’re letting me out at long last. I was wrong and it won’t happen again!” Sword Child bowed on the spot.
Zhuo Fan stared at it with a critical eye, “Then where were you wrong?”
“I disrespected my betters and was hard on young master San. He is master’s godson and I’m just a sword. It was a clear breach in status and deco-“
“Please, how is that your mistake?”
Zhuo Fan barked, “You see no difference between friend or foe, having no control. You’re jealous and reckless. As my sword, you are closest to me. But with young Sanzi as my godson, you wanted to replace him. That’s why you taunted him so much, backing him into a corner until you had no other choice than to go for the kill. Tell me I’m wrong!”
Sword Child was silent.
Zhuo Fan continued, “You know that everyone around me is a person I cherish, a comrade and a friend, treating the Sword Kings and Elder Li’s group the same way. I don’t want them to feel left out and harbor ill will, leading to conflict. In any society or group, its end is sure to come by wasting all its energy on infighting. The Sword Star Empire fell because of Baili Jingwei’s rampant expansion, leading to two groups of Sword Kings forming and clashing. Young Sanzi is one of us. I don’t want my sword and my people to be at their throats, are we clear?”
“Yes, master!”
“Don’t call me master, but dad!”
“Dad?” Sword Child started.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “I told you, I don’t want infighting, treating everyone as friends. You are born from my path, resembling me the most, and that makes you my son. Since you feel sour about young Sanzi, then I’ll take you in as well, treating you both the same. He’s your eldest brother, of equal status and there’s no reason to feel jealous.”
“Yes, father!” Sword Child beamed.
Zhuo Fan warned, “One last thing, as my spitting image, you know my standards. Demonic cultivators need not only be demonic, but have principles as well. None of us may ever be allowed to be heavy handed on our own regardless of reason. It’s no different than smearing your heritage and your ancestors, taking it out on your own people. Remember Demon Scheming Sect’s Xie Wuyue? If it were then that I’ve learned you had the same character as him, I wouldn’t have been so light as your grandmaster was!”
“Yes, father. I’ll focus on my mentality and achieve Dao like you. I won’t let demons take hold of me.” Sword Child stood straight as he vowed.
Nodding, Zhuo Fan patted his head and sighed.
[I can only hope.]
Creak~
Bali Yuyu slipped in, “Steward Zhuo, someone’s here for you.”
“Who?”
“Who else but a distressed damsel!”
“Qingcheng?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, then nodded, “I’ll go right now.”
Zhuo Fan was practically running, with Bali Yuyu rolling her eyes, “Steward Zhuo, when do you plan on stealing that busybody from Ruby Cloud Sect?”
“Not now, we’re not ready to take on the Eight Emperors in the open. Also…”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “The Ruby Cloud Sect is where she grew up. Her heart is still there and using force is no different than killing her parents. She would hate me forever. Taking it one step at a time is better, starting with winning her heart. Once I ruin their ties, everything else will fall in place.”
Bali Yuyu rolled her eyes, “How long will that take? I hear she’s spoiled in the sect. All the elders favor her, even her master, that Crone Empress.”
“That’s what worries me. Those hags are conniving banshees. Qingcheng has shown nothing extraordinary about her so how could she have caught their eyes to such a degree?”
Zhuo Fan asked in a frown, “Speaking of, I had Elder Li look into Qingcheng’s past. Any news?”
“None so far. He said he’ll start once we’re safe out of Gambling Town.”
“Tell him to do it now. The Gambling Emperor’s group is watching over the town. No one will try anything under their watch.”
Zhuo Fan said, “Also, with my other son here, safety won’t be an issue. Tell him to get on it right away!”
Zhuo Fan patted Bali Yuyu’s shoulder and left. She raised an eyebrow, looking oddly at Sword Child, “Son? You became a son as well?”
“I can’t? You might say that I’ve been with my father day in and day out, every minute of the hour.”
Sword Child showed her a toothy grin, “Why, wanna be my mommy?”
Bali Yuyu flushed and looked away, feeling defeated.
[Why does he only ever care about her…]
Zhuo Fan reached the dazzling lounge, meeting with a hesitant Chu Qingcheng pacing around.
“Qingcheng, how did you get here?”
“Zhuo Fan!”
His voice pulled her away from her worries and then she hung her head, her shoulder slumped.
Zhuo Fan knew why, “Is something wrong?”
“Zhuo Fan…”
“Just speak your mind, after all, there’s no secret between husband and wife, right?”
“How irritating, calling me your wife!”
Chu Qingcheng glared at him with red cheeks, but her sadness returned once more, “Zhuo Fan, I just don’t know where to begin. Senior aunt Mei wants you to give us the map.”
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, giving her a long look, “Qingcheng, you’re putting me in a difficult position. You’re my wife, yes, but the map belongs to my lord. I’m but a steward. Clan Head saw greatness in me and took me in as steward. I could never betray his trust by taking what is his.”
“I feel the same. Despite being a steward, you rely on others. Senior aunt is asking for too much.”
Chu Qingcheng paused then gnashed her teeth, “Forget it, you don’t have to feel bad, Zhuo Fan. I’ll just tell them I failed. It’s only going to get me a nagging at most.”
Chu Qingcheng walked away but Zhuo Fan caught her shoulder, “Wait, you’re saying they’re going to fault you for this?”
“Yeah, senior aunt won’t be hard on me, but my senior sisters will mock and deride me.” Chu Qingcheng muttered.
He took the forlorn Chu Qingcheng into his arms and said, “My poor Qingcheng, my dear wife, what did you do to suffer so? Why don’t you leave Ruby Cloud Sect and live with me?”
“How could I? Master and senior aunts are so nice to me. I can take a bit of scolding. I could never betray them!”
Zhuo Fan knew this was coming and faked difficulty, “While I can’t give them the map, as long as they’ll give you to me, I’ll have them take a look at it. I’ll have you know I’m an established painter.”
“Give me to you?”
“Yeah, just mention it to them. It’s their problem if they agree or not. It won’t have anything to do with you and they won’t scold you.”
Zhuo Fan snickered, holding her close and cooing, “Dear wife, I’m not saying that to demean you, only thinking of being together again. I would give anything for us to live together.”
Chu Qingcheng smiled, swooning. But then she scrutinized him, “Alright, but how did you cut Elder Liu’s legs on the betting stage? You’re not an Emperor but a…”
“Bone Tempering cultivator, I know. You must all be disgusted with me.”
“No, ever since then, senior aunt Mei changed her opinion of you. How did you do it?”
“Simple, really.”
Zhuo Fan snickered, “Speed, ferocity and accuracy. He was just ahead of me and complacent in his victory. I just needed something sharp enough and the result was clear to all. Not even a Saint could escape from that.”
“That can’t be it. Senior aunt said that a sword so fast could only be polished through mountains of corpses. How can you, at the Bone Tempering Stage…”
“I’ll be honest with you. I used to be… a butcher.”
Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Millions of pigs must’ve crossed these hands, isn’t that a mountain of corpses? Your senior aunt has good eyes, ha-ha-ha…”
Chu Qingcheng nodded and exclaimed, “I see, only there’s a big difference between a murderer and a butcher…”
“About the same, just look at people as pigs to the slaughter. You’ve been gone for quite a while now, should you head back? Tell them what I said and maybe we’ll seal the knot. I’ll become the mighty son-in-law of Ruby Cloud Sect, ha-ha-ha…”
“Annoying!”
Zhuo Fan urged Chu Qingcheng to leave, flirting while at it. Chu Qingcheng didn’t mind it, just replying in good humor.
Seeing her go, Zhuo Fan’s face fell, gripping his fists, “Rotten Ruby Cloud Sect, trying to honey trap me with Qingcheng? What do you take my wife for? Bastards!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1207 - 1207, Star Chart
chapters.content:
Chapter 1207, Star Chart
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“In the Nether Sea’s depth, the endless hellhold,
Where lost souls roam, their fate foretold.
Who dares to tread upon our shore,
Shall be condemned to suffer more.
With mortal eyes forever blind,
In the abyss, their souls confined!”
Shuang’er held a black paper covered in squiggles in an elegant room, reading the first line at the top. Murong Xue and Luo Yunchang frowned.
Murong Xue ventured, “These lines are supposed to unravel the Nether Sea map’s secrets?”
“It should, but what do they mean?” Luo Yunchang held her forehead, feeling tired, “The map is covered in black dots that make no sense. The only clue is this verse. It’s been three days already and we still couldn’t find anything.”
Murong Xue shrugged, “If it were that easy, the Gambling Emperor wouldn’t have wagered it. Zhuo Fan was right, if he couldn’t read it, give it to someone else and reap the rewards while they fight. Regardless of who can read it, he would win in the end. It seems insidious experts aren’t local to only mortal domain, the ones in Sacred Domain are each more twisted than the last.”
The other girls nodded.
If there was one difference between Sacred Domain and mortal domain, that was power. The cruel and manipulative mentality was still thriving here as well.
Creak~
The door opened and someone came in, “Shuang’er, did you find anything? It’s fine either way, we about to set off for Devil Mountain.”
“Sorry, big brother Zhuo, we can’t do anything…”
“Don’t let it bother you so much. You had the map for three days while the Gambling Emperor must’ve gotten it decades ago and still couldn’t figure it out. It’d be stranger if you managed to do what an Emperor couldn’t.”
Zhuo Fan didn’t mind it, taking the map and giving it a long look, “Whatever, I never planned on using it anyway. It’s only a means to an end, to find that kid, humph.”
Zhuo Fan folded the map.
Shuang’er jumped just then, “Wait!”
Zhuo Fan froze, “What?”
“I think I got something!”
Shuang’er yanked the map from his stiff hand and stared hard at a black circle in a corner, “Yes, why didn’t I see it sooner? The black spots are just so many that this small area doesn’t stand out at all. This part is actually the Phoenix Constellation!”
Zhuo Fan asked, “What’s that?”
“The Phoenix Constellation is a group of stars in the southeast corner of the night sky, focused on conflicts. A change there is chaos and fighting in the world. But with the star group being so large, how come it’s so small on this map? If you hadn’t folded it making it stand out, I wouldn’t have seen it!”
“You’re saying this map covered in black dots is a star chart?” Zhuo Fan opened the map again and gave it a careful look. He noticed some familiar star groups as well, just that it was hard to single them out with all the dark spots.
“Yes, the map is a depiction of stars but heavily concealed. That’s why none of the other experts could read it. We now know it’s a star chart, but how do we find the Nether Sea’s location?”
Shuang’er mulled it over then jumped, “Big brother Zhuo, didn’t Patriarch give you that treasure? Didn’t he say to use it whenever you’re looking for something or someone?”
“Right, I totally forgot about it! Since it’s a star chart, Sovereign Yun, who is adept in reading stars, his treasure has to help!”
Zhuo Fan took out a black orb.
How was he to use the two of them together though?”
The black orb came with an answer. The map showed a reaction as the orb appeared, giving off gray energy before vanishing.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes bugged out, “Where’d it go?”
Hum~
The black orb flared black and trembled. Suddenly, all of their eyes went black and they fell flat on the floor.
Waking up, they found themselves in a black area filled with stars.
“W-where are we? What are we doing here?” Luo Yunchang cried out.
Zhuo Fan was calm, since he had been here before, “No need to panic, our spirits have gone into the orb. It won’t harm us.”
“Look, the map!”
Shuang’er drew their attention and pointed at the map expanding to the point of covering the entire area.
The small black circles on the map now had stars shooting between them, turning it into an actual map.
Zhuo Fan cheered, “It’s the Sacred Domain’s map, but where’s the Nether Sea?”
“Over there, I think!”
Shuang’er pointed at a bright cluster, “The poem mentioned lost souls. There is were the death star is, always dark and shining only when death is about to take you. Since it’s bright, then that must be the Nether Sea’s location, a place where lost souls are buried.”
Zhuo Fan was thrilled, “Yes, that must be it. To think we’d figure it out in the end where the Nether Sovereign is. It was worth taking the map, ha-ha-ha…”
The girls were beaming as well, with Shuang’er looking worried, “Big brother Zhuo, do you plan to go there?”
“Of course. A Sovereign’s place is a special area anyone in Sacred Domain would drool over.”
“Nether Sea is going to be very dangerous.”
Shuang’er sighed, raising a finger, “Big brother Zhuo, look closer. What do you think this map is?”
Zhuo Fan raised his head and shook as his face grew hard.
With the stars on the map joined together, they drew the map of the Sacred Domain. But on the edge of it, they showed only one character.
[Death.]
“Zhuo Fan, the Nether Sovereign is warning us not to seek out the Nether Sea, or…” Luo Yunchang looked worried as well.
Zhuo Fan paused in thought then smiled, “Well of course a Sovereign’s seat of enlightenment would have some difficulties. Am I just going to miss out on this grand chance at witnessing the Nether Sovereign’s seat of enlightenment?”
“Zhuo Fan!”
“Alright now, let’s go back.”
Luo Yunchang wanted to say more, but Zhuo Fan stopped her. He had them brought back to their bodies and the black orb hummed, releasing the map.
They got up and looked at the map with conflicted emotions. Zhuo Fan picked it up casually and placed it in his ring, but then doubt clouded his mind.
[Why did Sovereign Yun’s treasure react with the Nether Sea map? He also warned me that his treasure can find anyplace and anyone.]
[Qingcheng is the one I wanted to find. As for the place, maybe it’s…]
Zhuo Fan felt like someone was using him.
Knock~
“Ahem, Steward Zhuo, young miss Chu came.”
“I got it, Elder Li.”
Zhuo Fan put away the orb and left. The girls watched him while recalling the Nether Sovereign’s warning and worried again. They even forgot about their jealousy.
Zhuo Fan reached the lounge and saw Chu Qingcheng and put on a smile, “Ha-ha-ha, wifey, it looks like we’re made for each other. Are you ready for a long night with your husband?”
“Miscreant!”
Chu Qingcheng blushed and huffed.
Zhuo Fan said, “Wait, they didn’t agree?”
“Regardless of what, I’m not some thing! Ugh!”
Chu Qingcheng pouted and so they were alone and whispered, “Zhuo Fan, senior aunt Mei said to give the map first, even a copy. As for us, she needs to return to the sect and tell master before…”
Chu Qingcheng looked embarrassed acting all shyly.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes went cold.
[That biddy plans on welching out of the deal. But I’m not one to lose my head in front of a girl and fall for that.]
Zhuo Fan didn’t let his thoughts show, “Alright, I’ll bring it right away.”
Zhuo Fan was gone for moments, bringing a delicate box, “Give it to Mei Sangu. What she wants is in there.”
“Truly?”
“Of course, our happiness is there as well.” Zhuo Fan smiled.
Chu Qingcheng beamed and nodded as she left. But after a step, she paused and pecked his cheek, running away with a flushed face.
Zhuo Fan felt his cheek with a goony smile…

chapters.title: Chapter 1208 - 1208, The Draw Map
chapters.content:
Chapter 1208, The Draw Map
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Senior aunt, I brought it!”
Chu Qingcheng bounced happily in a courtyard, calling in joy.
The hopeful women had waited a long time to hear this. They welcomed her with Mei Sangu in the lead, looking pleased and greedy. Fang Min and the others behind her were boiling in envy.
“Qingcheng, you’ve done well. Where is it?”
“Here!”
Chu Qingcheng beamed and Mei Sangu took the box with haste, her entire body shaking.
Fang Min’s tone dripped with vitriol, “The day finally came junior sister’s first honey trap mission. Though she lacks passion, only ending up with a copy instead of the real thing. I would’ve done it hands down!”
“Senior sister, I didn’t use any traps. We truly…”
Chu Qingcheng lowered her head bashfully, “Besides, the map is definitely with the Clan Head. If it went missing, he’ll have to answer for it. He’s already taking enough risk giving us a copy. We can’t just…”
Mei Sangu was upright and honorable as she nodded, “Yes, the boy shows his deep affection by doing this. We shouldn’t be hard on him, since he couldn’t do it anyway. It’s good we at least got a copy, ha-ha-ha…”
Mei Sangu grinned from ear to ear as she was eagerly opening the box.
“Senior aunt, what do you think then of his request…”
“I’ll tell senior sister once we get back. No rush.”
“We’ll do as senior aunt says.”
Chu Qingcheng gave a sweet smile, lowering her head and fiddling with her clothes. She was like a chipper child that couldn’t show her enthusiasm.
Fang Min seethed at the side, “What’s so great about being with some ignorant and lousy punk? That’s no reason to be content!”
“Eh?”
A weird shout drew Fang Min’s attention, looking over with joy, “What is it, senior aunt, is the map bad?”
“No way! Zhuo Fan wouldn’t lie to me!” Chu Qingcheng started and rushed to see.
She didn’t worry about the map though, but that this would get her senior aunt to flip out.
Mei Sangu had a deep frown, holding a shriveled paper with yellow lines on it. It looked like a map, sure, but a map of what? All those random lines made it hard to decipher.
“I knew the Nether Sea was cryptic, but to think that not even I can make sense of any of it.”
“Senior aunt, you actually believe it to be real?” Fang Min looked it over, “Maybe the punk just drew something random. Few have seen the Nether Sea map, with neither one among us. It’d be strange not to fool us.”
Chu Qingcheng jumped in his defense, “Senior aunt, Zhuo Fan was thoughtful the entire time, and even promised me to do his best in copying it to make sure it’s identical. Senior sister is just making things up!”
“I’m making it up? You tell me then what kind of map is that? We can’t make anything of it…”
“Min’er!”
Mei Sangu glared, taking the map with joy, “The fact you can’t makes it real. The Nether Sea would’ve been a famous attraction by now if everyone could read it. I can also feel the kid’s sincerity through this copy.”
“Uh, what do you mean, senior aunt?”
“Look, there’s not a mark of a brush being used when drawing it. It’s not uneven like others.”
Mei Sangu held her head high as she claimed, “If he was faking it, then he would’ve left clear signs of drawing. With the Nether Sea being so special, there’s no way the map was drawn with a brush. The more mystical the lines, the more genuine it is and proves his sincerity. These yellow stains as well, that must be where the Nether Sea is. All that’s left is reading it!”
Mei Sangu paraded the map before the girls, leaving them speechless. Staring at the random and fading lines had them baffled. Chu Qingcheng looked pleased as punch though.
Ugh!
Fang Min reeled, feeling like throwing up her lunch. She pointed at the map, “What the hell did the punk use? That paper reeks of pee!”
“Really?”
Mei Sangu gave it a sniff then flinched with a wince, “Yeah, just what did he use? It doesn’t look like ink at all.”
Chu Qingcheng panicked, but she couldn’t allow this hiccup to make her senior aunt loathe Zhuo Fan, so she changed the subject, “Senior aunt, Zhuo Fan said using ink was out of the question when making the Nether Sea map copy. Think about it, ink is black and wouldn’t be able to outline such vague and mystical drawing. So he went through toil and pain to find a famous and perfect color to match it. Senior aunt, he’s very sincere!”
“Really?”
Mei Sangu raised an eyebrow, giving the map another look and nodded, “Yes, it’s hard to show the same result with ink and brush. The kid must’ve gone above and beyond to make this map.
