We’ll set off tomorrow for the sect to hand over the map to Sect Leader. I believe she will be thrilled and will reward you greatly, especially you, Qingcheng, ha-ha-ha…”
Fang Min sneered in envy.
Qingcheng beamed and eased a breath.
[With this achievement, master shouldn’t care about Zhuo Fan’s background…]
On the second day, bright and early, the Ruby Cloud Sect set off with their copy.
Through sheer and utter coincidence, however, the Luo clan happened to be at the city gates as well.
“Get ready for battle!”
Zhuo Fan was grave as he whispered to Bali Yuyu at his side, “Don’t leave the hag out of your sight. Don’t go easy, but don’t go killing either.”
Bali Yuyu nodded, eager to fight.
Mei Sangu beamed upon noticing them, showing an even greater respect for Zhuo Fan, going as far as greeting them all, “Luo friends, are you leaving as well? What a coincidence, we’re going too. Do we have the same direction as well?”
“Uh, probably not.”
Zhuo Fan started, looking out of sorts.
[Did they not look over the copy I gave them? Why are they so cordial and even greeting me?]
Bali Yuyu looked stumped at him.
[Weren’t we up for a brawl? They see us more like friends than anything, without a shred of ill-will.]
The Luo clan looked clueless as Mei Sangu showed a bright smile and cupped her hands at Zhuo Fan, practically rejuvenated on the spot, “Steward Zhuo, you’re so young and able. I believe we will have many chances to work together in the future. Farewell!”
Mei Sangu left in a grand manner with her disciples. Chu Qingcheng came before Zhuo Fan, winking and leaving in elation.
A faint whisper happened to reach his sharp ears, “Don’t worry, senior aunt is pleased with you. We’ll definitely succeed!”
[Pleased? She’s actually happy with my map?]
Zhuo Fan was floored, not registering as the girls left.
The others were even more so.
“Zhuo Fan, didn’t you say the hag would be hounding us through the city to kill us after seeing the map? We even had to get up so early for it. Why then was she pleased as punch?”
Bali Yuyu patted his shoulder, “Maybe she’d be a real catch, if she shed off a couple, or more, thousand years.”
Zhuo Fan took a deep breath, “Something’s off here. The hag saw my handiwork and didn’t get angry?”
“What handiwork? Just how did you draw it anyway?”
“How? Didn’t all of us learn how to draw since we were kids?” Zhuo Fan looked awkwardly, mimicking some motions before giving up.
Bali Yuyu was still clueless, “When did we ever draw? I never raised a brush in my life, so how can I draw?”
“Hey, Sword Child, what did your dad mean?” Sword Child happened to pass over and she asked him.
Sword Child showed a rather obtuse smile, “To be my true mother, you must then understand how dad draws!”
“Hey, what’s that supposed to mean?”
“That I saw dad take some random paper and whizzed on it. He waved it a couple of times to dry, then put it in the box.”
Sword Child snickered with a shrug, “I’m but a sword spirit so I’ve never drawn in my life. You, humans, don’t you pee since you were kids? You don’t even know this?”
Dong!
Bali Yuyu froze in place, looking at Zhuo Fan now understanding as to why he thought that the hag would want him dead.
[Anyone in their right mind would explode being toyed like that, especially a senior. But is that hag slow in the head not to clobber it? I can barely hold back!]

chapters.title: Chapter 1209 - 1209, Trouble Ahead
chapters.content:
Chapter 1209, Trouble Ahead
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Steward Zhuo, I feel a lot of eyes on us after leaving the city.”
An hour on the rough road, and old man whispered in Zhuo Fan’s ear.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “With the map with us, they won’t stop spying on us until it’s gone. Some think ahead while others will go for it on our way. We might have picked a long tail, but few of them will ever attack us. It doesn’t matter.”
“Yes.”
The old man left to walk with the others.
Two hours later, they arrived at a lofty mountain range. As the wind whistled, it signaled the arrival of men in black, in the hundreds. The leader had a familiar face, none other than the Demonic Emperor’s representative, Thousand Faced Devil.
Zhuo Fan welcomed him with a smile and a shake of the head, “Like master like servants. I said Zhao Chen is fickle and impulsive, and his men are no different.”
“Steward Zhuo, Luo clan!”
Thousand Faced Devil ignored his complaints as he greeted with cupped hands, “We have no bad blood between us. I know you are a grand clan and wish to be cordial still. In that regard, I hope you will offer up the Nether Sea map. I won’t forget such a favor!”
Zhuo Fan smiled walking forward and returning the gesture, “Senior, we’d gladly offer anything else if it means befriending you, but as it happens, the Nether Sea map isn’t anything, but something won through our blood and sweat on the gambling stage. There’s no reason at all to give it to you senior, sorry.”
“Steward Zhuo, spare me the empty pleasantries. I won’t buy it.”
Thousand Faced Devil eyed the rest, turning cruel, “I don’t know how tough the Luo clan is, or how many experts it has, but from what I see, the only one able to fight me is the miss who met Mei Sangu. As for the rest, twenty Spirit Kings won’t matter against my hundred. You will all die. Steward Zhuo must’ve earned your position with your guile, so you should know this as well.”
Zhuo Fan was unmoved, “Senior, you mean that no matter what will incur from it, you still have to rob us?”
“Yes, I don’t know your limits, but it can’t be worse than suffering the Demonic Emperor’s wrath. He will be sure to take my life if I don’t return with the map. Since death is certain, in either case, I at least have some chance going against you, right?”
“Yes, the unknown is scary, but it’s also uncertain and, by extension, survivable. You’re gambling we have no backing at the level of the Eight Emperors, so attacking us won’t be an issue.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, “Congratulations, you win! We really aren’t at the Eight Emperors’ level. Your plan to pick on the weak is a success, but too bad you’re the weaker one in this situation and made the wrong call. You don’t have enough men to take us on.”
Thousand Faced Devil sized them all up, laughing, “Steward Zhuo, bluffing now, are you? Yes, the peak-stage Spirit King young miss is comparable to an Emperor without a doubt, but don’t go telling me you have more of such monsters. At the same cultivation, the strengths of everyone is almost the same, which makes it a matter of numbers. That is where you lose!”
“Quality, not quantity is what the Luo clan favors, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan snickered and patted Sword Child’s head, “Son, bring me his head, intact.”
“Yes father!”
Sword Child bowed and took two steps forward, his eyes glimmering.
Thousand Faced Devil gasped, “You’re sending a child to take my head? What a joke!”
Whoosh~
Black flashed in front of him. With a faint breeze, the sharp sword wave flared across his forehead.
Thousand Faced Devil was startled, ducking just inches from the attack, taking some hair and leaving him soaked in sweat. The strands drifting in the wind.
But then came the second strike.
Fearful as he was now, a whirlwind kick came from below, aiming to relieve him of his head.
Thousand Faced Devil felt death nearing and leaned sideways to dodge and jump a thousand meters back, away from the danger.
Looking ahead, the sight shocked him stiff.
The one who almost took his life was none other than the scrawny child. His kick did not touch him, but the force behind it unleashed a sword wave that reaped ten lives.
The bodies turned to mist, cutting Thousand Faced Devil’s hundred Spirit Kings to ninety.
Sss~
Gasping, everyone went pale. Thousand Faced Devil was shaken to the core, his bravery gone as he looked at Sword Child in utter dread.
It was beyond him how a seven-year-old wielded such deadly power.
[Is he even human?]
Thousand Faced Devil felt his world view come crashing down on him.
Sword Child was, of course, a Sovereign weapon, sharp and deadly. Not even a sacred beast could match his toughness, let alone humans.
“Boy, you’re quite springy for an old man.”
Sword Child huffed, snickering at Thousand Faced Devil. The latter felt his skin crawl, then noticed the casual Luo clan.
Bali Yuyu, the pseudo Emperor, didn’t lift a finger, with only the little freak causing so much damage. This made it so the Luo clan had two Emperor level experts and would be deadly if the others joined as well.
His advantage in this highway robbery had now flown out the window.
Thousand Faced Devil sighed, thinking of backing off, but a look at the glaring Bali Yuyu and Sword Child told him he had to pay for starting this.
At least an Emperor had an Emperor’s advantage, one a Spirit King couldn’t cover.
Thousand Faced Devil’s eyes flashed and he made a sign. As his hands moved, ghastly faces appeared in the air.
“Imperial Mark, Thousand Faces Slaughter!”
Thousand Faced Devil flew in the air and then vanished. The wind stirred and a thousand golden, hundred-meter tall ghastly faces appeared from above.
“He-he-he, now you know why they call me Thousand Faced Devil!”
Thousand Faced Devil was hidden among those faces, cackling, “My Imperial Mark is made of a Spirit King level soul attack for every face, not a full attack but eighty percent strong at the very least. Now I have a thousand men army. Boy, your monsters might be tough and can live through this, but what about the rest? Especially you, Steward Zhuo, and your young miss. You’re too weak and an easy target. Know when to give up. Hand over the map!”
Bam!
Sword Child waved and smashed a face in disdain, “Nothing but parlor tricks, crumbling at a touch.”
“Hi-hi-hi, I told you, it’s not for you two. With your strength, you can beat one, but what about a thousand? Also, my faces can reform after beaten. How long will you last, I wonder?”
Following his creepy laughter, another face formed, completing the set of thousand.
Sword Child waved, making the air warp from the heat, “Then let’s see which will last longer, your faces or my searing strikes. Humph, Decimating Sword Art, Rampant Inferno!”
Hu~
Fires sparked to life out of nowhere throughout the sky, making the faces tremble and crumble to dust.
The thousand faces were burned to nothing in an instant, with incessant cackling still coming from above, only this time, it was one of agony.
Sword Child showed his evil side as he sneered, “Now you know what I’m made of…”
“Don’t move!”
A shout caught their attention as a boiling hand grabbed Zhuo Fan’s neck…

chapters.title: Chapter 1210 - 1210, Two Heads
chapters.content:
Chapter 1210, Two Heads
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Huff~
Thousand Faced Devil panted hard with a wane and sweaty face, a clear sign of weakness.
Sword Child and Bali Yuyu flinched, only to relax the next moment upon seeing he picked Zhuo Fan of all the targets.
Not registering the casualness the others had, Thousand Faced Devil roared, “Give me the Nether Sea map or it’s off with his head!”
He gripped Zhuo Fan’s neck tighter.
The Luo clan didn’t seem to care much.
“Did you not hear me? Even in the Bone Tempering Stage, isn’t he still your steward? Don’t you care if he lives or dies?”
“Splitting Art, so you’re a former assassin, senior.”
Thousand Faced Devil grew tense at the unexpected reactions, or lack thereof. The one to finally give him any attention at all was the same one who he held hostage, “Splitting your spirit into many to confuse the enemy then snatching victory amidst the chaos. It must be quite the skill indeed for not even I to pick up on it. It also gives the enemy the chance to break them down one at a time. Knowing the spirit is exposed, even at the Spirit King level, it’s still very fragile. Showing such weakness can be fatal in an Emperor Stage battle.”
The devil met Zhuo Fan’s taunting eyes and snapped, “What do you know of such a high level battle? Shut your trap or I’ll snap your neck!”
“Ha-ha-ha, you should’ve done that from the start, when you had the chance. A shame an assassin should be focusing on speed and killing, not on taking hostages. You doomed your assassin profession the instant you left killing aside.”
Thousand Faced Devil gave him a long look, clueless about where he was getting at.
[I’m an Emperor and I’m supposed to kill a bug like him from the start? I control his life and can take it whenever I want. Why…]
Crack!
The snapping sound made Thousand Faced Devil shiver, feeling his hand going numb and him being unable to move it. His eyes grew wide as he saw Zhuo Fan’s right hand glowing red and gripping the same arm tight like clamps.
“H-how can…”
Thousand Faced Devil’s face twitched, wanting to squeeze his fingers and crush Zhuo Fan’s neck. A shame his hand was frozen, unable to budge. It was, in fact, pulled away by an incredible force, out of his control.
“Y-you…”
Thousand Faced Devil gawked at the hand gripping his, then at Zhuo Fan’s creepy smile. Fear took its hold on his mind, roaring, “How can you have such power? A Bone Tempering cultivator…”
“Ha-ha-ha, I told you, your assassin career is at an end.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes grew cold and he snapped his Qilin arm to the side. Thousand Faced Devil’s weakened body snapped from the shoulder as he flew away without his arm, leaving a bloody trail.
Whoosh!
Before he got to taste the agony of having his arm yanked out of his socket, something black flashed in front of his horrified eyes, a sword slash.
Whoosh~
A head rolled in the air, falling in a small hand. Thousand Faced Devil’s headless body spurted blood for a few moments, then plopped.
His men saw their boss offed like nothing and lost all courage, flying away in panic.
Zhuo Fan’s group let them go, holding them in disdain.
[Of all the people here, taking Steward Zhuo hostage is like signing your own death warrant!]
“Dad, here’s his head.”
Sword Child presented the shocked and terrified head to Zhuo Fan. He nodded and put it in his ring before signaling the others to resume their journey.
Minutes after they left, many men in black appeared at this bloodbath, before vanishing once more.
In a manor in Mist City, the city lord heard the scout’s report and turned pensive, “You’re telling me the Luo clan had an easy time dealing with Thousand Faced Devil’s team? They definitely aren’t a normal group to not care about the Demonic Emperor’s opinion. Have you found anything about them?”
“City Lord, we’ve long since sent people to Joy Town, and there is such a clan there. But with the location being so remote, it’ll be hard to find anything from their past. From the passing traders, we did find that the town has been around for thousands of years, far from the secular world and from the power struggles of the Sacred Domain.”
“Why would this monster rise up now of all times, after thousands of years? And so flashy too…”
The city lord paused, “I’ll need to report this to the Gambling Emperor. Something isn’t right about this group, messing with the Eight Emperors’ people and even stealing their things.”
Two months later, in a dark hall, only a pair of eerie eyes were seen coming from the seat of honor, with the city lord kneeling below, reporting Gambling Town’s events.
A bright smile appeared below the eyes, “Ha-ha-ha, how amusing! Of all the famed Eight Emperors, none won my gamble. The victor turned out to be some unknown clan from nowhere.”
“Gambling Emperor, the Luo clan has many people of great talent. Their steward, Zhuo Fan, has low cultivation yet holds such a position. His conduct is calm and calculative, while the guards are firm and resolute. They’re more than meets the eye!”
“Of course, while life is a constant fight and luck plays a large role, by lacking strength as well, luck can only get you so far. I could never look down on such a clan. Ha-ha-ha…”
The Gambling Emperor smiled, “So they killed the Demonic Emperor’s men, inciting the butcher. What will his reply be? If they hold an Emperor’s power, they have no reason to fear. Otherwise, their choice is to seek their backer or find shelter with the other seven. This will make the next owner of the map known. Where will they go then?”
The city lord bowed, “Gambling Emperor, the scouts following them say they’re going toward Devil Mountain!”
“What?”
Gambling Emperor finally showed a reaction, the eyes stunned for a moment, “Having killed his men, the Demonic Emperor is bound to hunt them down till the end of days and yet they’re knocking at his door. What’s the Luo clan up to? They believe that they have the power to fight with the Demonic Emperor and settle it?”
The Gambling Emperor frowned, with the city lord unable to provide an answer…
Meanwhile, a lavish and jaded jar crumbled as it met the hard floor. An imposing youth wore a scowl in anger as he jumped to his feet and stared down at the shivering men in black below.
“Not only did you not get the Nether Sea map from Gambling Town, but of those I sent, one is missing and the other got killed by some nameless and unknown little group, no less?”
“D-Demonic Emperor sir, the Luo clan is a mystery that we can’t deal with…” One man ventured, shaking like a leaf.
Unlike Zhuo Fan’s calculative and deceitful nature, Zhao Chen was more of a petty and impulsive prick. Once in power, he never stopped lusting for more, expanding his domain. His handling was cruel as well, worse than Zhuo Fan.
His reckless reputation sent fear in his enemies but also his men.
Zhao Chen gave them a sinister smile, “Can’t deal with it? Thousand Faced Devil took a hundred Spirit Kings yet couldn’t handle one lousy clan? What use do I have of you then?”
“Garbage!”
Zhao Chen roared and the one who reported got split into bloody chunks with a splat. The others trembled in terror, “Sir, please calm down!”
“Humph, everyday I hear the same thing. You only had to show a bit of courage and do what I told you to and I wouldn’t have to take my rage on you.”
Zhao Chen flicked his sleeve, “What of the Luo clan? Where are they?”
“Uh, we… don’t know…”
“You don’t?”
“Demonic Emperor sir, they killed Thousand Faced Devil and we didn’t try…”
“Garbage!”
Zhao Chen threw his hand and more than ten people went splat, covering the floor in blood and gore. The rest cowered back.
A voice came from outside, “Demonic Emperor, someone’s here to seek an audience bearing gifts.”
“Gifts?”
Zhao Chen was curious, “Bring it here!”
Two boys walked in with two exquisite boxes and placed them on the ground. Zhao Chen flicked a finger and two bloody heads were revealed…

chapters.title: Chapter 1211 - 1211, Protection
chapters.content:
Chapter 1211, Protection
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Zhao Chen stared at the familiar faces, his shocked voice breaking the brief silence, “Thousand Faced Devil, Huangfu Song? What are their heads doing here?”
“Guard, who brought them here?”
“Demonic Emperor sir, they call themselves the Luo clan of Joy Town and are outside the mountain waiting to see you.” A guard rushed in, looking fretful in the face of Zhao Chen’s rage.
Zhao Chen’s face twitched in disbelief, “Luo clan, as in the same one? They dare bring my men’s heads? They’ve gone too far! Seize them and drag them in here! I want to see what the hell they are up to!”
“Yes.”
His men went to follow his orders and brought a man and a woman surrounded by black guards into the hall.
Looking at his old place, it took Zhuo Fan back to the good old days. The only thing spoiling his reminiscing was seeing Zhao Chen unchanged after thousands of years. He showed a savage grin, yet bearing no hatred.
Zhao Chen shivered as their eyes met, feeling an uncanny familiarity. His heart began to race with fear and even staggered back.
Pa!
One man in black bowed, “Demonic Emperor sir, they are the Luo clan’s people that brought the heads. We await your orders!”
“Uh, leave.”
Zhao Chen never took his eyes off Zhuo Fan, losing all his anger as he gave a numb wave, “All of you leave!”
“Uh, right.”
The men shared puzzled looks, finding Demonic Emperor’s demeanor off, like he wasn’t himself. It was their first time hearing his kind voice, so they left on the double.
Zhuo Fan, Bali Yuyu and Zhao Chen were the only ones left, as well as the bloody floor with the corpses.
Zhuo Fan smiled at the stiff face, cupping his hands, “Demonic Emperor, your reputation precedes you. I am steward Zhuo of the Luo clan. Here is my guard, Bali Yuyu. It’s an honor to finally meet the great Demonic Emperor.”
“Your name feels familiar…”
Zhao Chen squinted, lost for a moment before saying, “Not just the name, but also the character… No, it’s not the same. He was never one to be casual, and never lowered himself to become some steward. No, it’s definitely impossible for a dead guy, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Demonic Emperor, what are you saying?”
“Uh, nothing.”
Zhao Chen snapped back to reality, his face going cold as he stared at the heads, “Steward Zhuo was it? What is the meaning of this? Your show of force, or challenge?”
“No no no, Demonic Emperor sir, this is the Clan Head’s gift, he wishes for you to gladly accept it.”
“Gift? You kill my men and bring me their heads and you call it a fricking gift?”
Bam!
Zhao Chen slammed the table in anger, “No one does that! Explain yourself or not only will you meet your end here but the entire Luo clan will be wiped out. I’ll take all your heads to trample them on the way to hell!”
Hu~
Zhao Chen’s explosive aura swept the hall, making Bali Yuyu shiver back.
[The Eight Emperors are way stronger than common Emperors.]
Zhuo Fan faced the pressure, shouting as well, “Demonic Emperor sir, please hear us out. After that, you’re free to take our heads without any complaint.”
“Speak.”
Zhao Chen eyed them.
Stretching his collar, Zhuo Fan smiled, “Demonic Emperor sir, did you perhaps send someone to attack the Ruby Cloud Sect’s disciples and steal their Purple Gold Glazed Cup?”
“No!”
Zhao Chen said casually after a moment.
Zhuo Fan beamed, “I thought so as well. The Demonic Emperor would never stoop as low as do something like this to the Ruby Cloud Sect Leader, one of the Eight Emperors. It would not only stain your name but would make another strong enemy without any reason. Why ever go through all that grueling trouble?
“But he announced himself as one of Demonic Emperor’s aides, dropping sir’s name while saying it was your idea all along. I did not want him to yammer on and make sir’s life worse so I was swift in removing this bandit, to preserve sir’s name. Was I wrong?” Zhuo Fan pointed at the first head, smiling.
Zhao Chen was noncommittal, “And Thousand Faced Devil?”
“Demonic Emperor sir, was it not you who instigated the Demon Light Castle issue three years back, making Wraith Emperor and Falcon Emperor wage war, gaining the most in the process?”
“Nonsense! That was their own problem born from their animosity. What does that have to do with me?” Zhao Chen’s heart sank, denying everything.
Zhuo Fan gave a natural nod, “But of course, Demonic Emperor sir could’ve never have done such a thing. Thousand Faced Devil must’ve run his mouth in Gambling Town, making you the scapegoat. Now Wraith Emperor and Falcon Emperor joined hands to deal with you. I could not stand letting such a man live any longer!”
“What?”
Zhao Chen darkened, then flicked his hand, “Fine, fine, let those geezers come. I’m not scared of them.”
Zhuo Fan made a deep gesture of respect, “Demonic Emperor sir is so heroic, with those two beneath you. But what about three, or four Emperors? Ha-ha-ha, fear not an able opponent but an incompetent ally. With a foul aide like Thousand Faced Devil and the other poisoning the well outside and earning sir enemies, sir is bound to become public enemy number one. No one can face entire crowds by himself, even someone as heroic as sir.”
Zhao Chen’s face twitched, his fists clenched, his teeth grinding.
“As such, we took it upon ourselves and did sir a favor by removing these scumbags. Didn’t we do sir a great favor?” Zhuo Fan beamed.
Zhao Chen stared into his eyes, still looking uneasy, “These dogs might be in the wrong, but only I get to punish them, and not an outsider. With them dead, my forces weakened. How am I to handle it then?”
“Demonic Emperor sir, out with the old, in with the new. It’s no trouble at all if they’re gone, not when you have the Luo clan to fill in the gap, Ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan gave a weird smile, bowing, “Our Clan Head admires the Demonic Emperor’s heroism, wishing to stand among the Eight Emperors since young. So we came to join you. I ask that Demonic Emperor gives us a spot. Of course we’re not going to be like those two boneheads, for we are far superior than them in every way, be it in strength or handling matters. This way, they didn’t die to outsiders, but removing the filth in sir’s stead!”
Zhao Chen shook hard, gasping, “You want my protection?”
“Of course, there’s no reward without effort. Which is why we went out of our way to showcase our results and receive sir’s protection.”
Zhuo Fan’s hand shone and took out an aged paper.
He offered it with two hands, making Zhao Chen jump in joy, “The Nether Sea map?”
“Yes, we know sir wants it and went through hell and high water to bring it to sir.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, glancing at the ghastly heads with derision, “Also, this is our chance to prove our use to sir. The two lost their lives and couldn’t get it while we did. I am confident sir would be pleased to have us!”
Zhuo Fan nodded as he smiled wildly, but then he hesitated, “Why is it you chose me of all the Eight Emperors? And don’t tell me it’s out of admiration or some flowery speech. I want the truth!”
“Demonic Emperor sir is a man of many values. I knew we made the right choice!”
The two shared a nod before Zhuo Fan turned to Zhao Chen, “I’ll be perfectly honest. The Luo clan has been hiding in Joy Town for millenium. To come out of that hole, we needed an Emperor on our side. We had to make a choice from among them. Sir can also see that with our strength it’d be easy to have any Emperor’s favor. The first that took our notice was, of course, the head of the Eight Emperors, the Sword Emperor!
“Alas, Sword Emperor has the highest demands and the greatest power. Like they say, it’s better to be a leader among men than a grunt among giants. We feared that we had no room to grow under the Sword Emperor, giving up. As for the rest, they’re all geriatric and washed up, pedantic and outdated, hardly able to help us rise among their people. Only Demonic Emperor sir, with your youthful valor, is the perfect choice to work for, your right hand!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1212 - 1212, Give and Take
chapters.content:
Chapter 1212, Give and Take
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Zhao Chen approved as he nodded, elated at the praise, “Good eye. I see your Clan Head is an educated man. I’m not one to brag, but among the Eight Emperors, only I have such strength and right to be the head among all Emperors. It’s only a matter of time before the decrepit Sword Emperor will be replaced!”
“That’s what our Clan Head’s been saying as well, although…”
“Yes?”
“We killed two of sir’s men and going to another Emperor would keep us safe, if only for a while before we’ll suffer your retribution. Being the target of the Demonic Emperor’s wrath is like having a viper stalking you. We’ll never get a wink of sleep. Only under sir’s protection could we be friends instead and resolve this animosity.”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Regardless of everything, our best choice had and always will be Demonic Emperor!”
Zhao Chen gave him a long look, “Good thinking and impeccable analysis. Yes, you’ve made the perfect choice in coming here with these fools’ heads. Who was it, though, that came up with this brilliant tactic?”
Zhao Chen’s eyes shone, somewhat eager.
“Demonic Emperor sir, Steward Zhuo is our Clan Head’s trusted man. With him helping Clan Head every step, it is only his duty to help Clan Head make a decision.”
That was Bali Yuyu’s cue and she came forward with a cupped hand.
Zhuo Fan shook his head in modesty, “Please, I only offered simple advice. Clan Head had the final say.”
“Steward Zhuo, take credit where it’s due. As a Bone Tempering cultivator, to stand next to Clan Head is only possible by showcasing your impressive talent.” Bali Yuyu mocked, “Demonic Emperor sir, please overlook Steward Zhuo’s paltry cultivation, for in the Luo clan, he even has Clan Head’s ear. Otherwise, Clan Head’s inclination would be towards the Sword Emperor with so many of our clan’s guards practicing the sword.”
“Eh?”
Zhao Chen stared hard at Zhuo Fan, only then noticing he was dealing with a bug.
Belying his low cultivation, the guy was very well placed, in fact. This further proved his talents lay elsewhere.
[From what the woman says, the guy must be quite the deep thinker.]
[Blasted, that’s exactly the talent I’m missing!]
Zhao Chen walked forward taking Zhuo Fan’s hand with a smile, “Ha-ha-ha, it’s so rare to find a true strategist these days, Steward Zhuo. I truly need someone like you for Devil Mountain. Leaving it up to those fools will run all its millennium long legacy into the ground.”
“Demonic Emperor sir, you’re too kind. Then the Luo clan…”
“Say nothing more. Of the 20 Demon Guards, 36 cities and 64 clans, as you replaced Thousand Faced Devil, you shall be above everyone of them.”
Zhao Chen slapped his chest, vowing, “I shall declare the Luo clan as my loyal subjects, with Steward Zhuo my right-hand man. Any that touches you will earn my wrath!”
“Uh, Demonic Emperor sir, shouldn’t it be Clan Head who has my position?”
“What’s the difference? You help Luo Clan Head and he helps me. Isn’t it all the same? Why be so complicated about it?”
“Uh, that goes beyond my authority. Shouldn’t sir address Clan Head first?”
“What’s the point? What I say goes! Guard, prepare a feast to welcome Steward Zhuo…”
Devil Mountain was all a cheer for the next three days, with Zhao Chen giving Zhuo Fan a proper welcome. He also declared to all Sacred Domain that the Luo clan fell in with Devil Mountain.
The Luo clan became the leader of the twenty Demon Guards and Zhuo Fan became Zhao Chen’s personal adviser.
Another ten days passed and Zhao Chen gave twenty towns under the Luo clan’s supervision. Zhuo Fan and Baili Yuyu thus took their leave from Demonic Emperor, to help the Luo clan handle the transition.
Leaving the mountain, Zhuo Fan looked back at the lush peak and sighed, “I used to be all alone, with but a few arrays guarding the mountain. I never thought I’d see the day it would be crowded, no longer the paradise of old. That kid hasn’t changed, in contrast, still fighting for power like everyone else. Humph, to think that in my time, even without any territory of my own, I was still the head of the Eight Emperors. Imbecile, what are you doing going after so many things? You’ve brought nothing but shame to this famous mountain.”
“What are you doing coming under his wing then?”
Bali Yuyu replied, “Shouldn’t we be using others to finish him off? Now that we work for him, we’re under his men’s watch and won’t be able to lift a finger against him.”
Zhuo Fan smirked, “In war you have to give first and then take. Any person or faction crumbles from within in the end, with the outside influence holding little effect on its fate. We are now like maggots inside his home, nibbling everything he has. Don’t the twenty cities prove it? Ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan walked with confidence. Bali Yuyu followed after him with a soft gaze.
In Gambling Town, the shocking news of the Luo clan joining Demonic Emperor reached everyone’s ears.
In Mist City Lord’s manor, the Gambling Emperor held a jade slip behind a curtain, “Luo clan actually became the Demonic Emperor’s first Demon Guard? This is too baffling, almost unbelievable.”
“Gambling Emperor, they must’ve offered the map to quell Demonic Emperor’s anger.”
“No!”
Gambling Emperor waved, watching city lord from beyond the curtain, “I know his temper well, reckless, pigheaded, and quick to anger. The most the Luo clan could get out of that deal is survive, not become his guard, going as far as making him the head of his twenty Demon Guards. It makes no sense at all for a rash and hotheaded man to swing from rage to elation at the drop of the hat. Especially that Demonic Emperor…”
“Does that mean the Luo clan got a high status in Devil Mountain through other means?”
“Definitely, for even giving the map without the animosity, they’d still wouldn’t get placed so high. The deal stinks to high heaven!”
The Gambling Emperor squinted, “Did the Demonic Emperor also mention in his declaration that he made the Luo clan’s steward his right-hand man?”
“Yes, that’s him, but it’s so strange. The Luo clan is now the first Demon Guard and its representative should be their Clan Head not the steward.”
“Then everything must’ve had something to do with that steward.”
The Gambling Emperor smiled, “How amusing, the steward is fascinating. Men, never leave him out of your sight. I want to know the full extent of his skills and what miracles he brings, ha-ha-ha…”
“Yes.”
The space warped…
In a dark room, two shadows sat across from each other.
“Did you hear? That arrogant Luo clan that was in Gambling Town got the Demonic Emperor’s protection.”
“And, aren’t we going to act?”
“Of course we are, but everything about the Luo clan is strange. Anything could happen.”
“What’s so great about some no-name clan showing up? Demonic Emperor made us lose half our lands. We have to take it back, on our titles as Emperors. I heard that the Seven Sacred Mountains intends to move on to the Eight Emperors. One of the weaker ones might even get replaced.”
“Then…”
The man hesitated, “Fine, then if we have to strike, we’ll go after the Demonic Emperor. The Luo clan wants to have a protector to spread its wings but they’ve made the wrong choice!”
In the Ruby Cloud Sect, a woman in her forties sat in the main seat holding a yellow paper with a grimace, “Junior sister, are you certain this is a copy of Nether Sea map?”
“Definitely, just look at the vague lines and the faded landscape. No brush could ever leave such artistry behind!” Mei Sangu looked proud as she explained.
Her disciples bobbed their heads, even Chu Qingcheng.
Mei Sangu was happy to give Chu Qingcheng the credit, “Senior sister, it’s all thanks to Qingcheng using a honey trap to get that boy to forget all dangers in making this copy.”
“Senior aunt, that was not a honey trap. Didn’t we clear that out?” Chu Qingcheng smiled as she implored her, “Master, Zhuo Fan said he wanted me to leave the sect and have a normal life…”
“Nonsense! You’re the pillar of the sect! You can’t just go with any man that talks to you!” Mei Sangu glared at her.
Chu Qingcheng got anxious, “But senior aunt, you clearly promised…”
“What? I only said we’ll return to report to senior sister. If she doesn’t agree, that’s that!”
“You…”
“That’s enough.”
Looking at them all red, the woman raised a hand, “Regardless of honey trap or Qingcheng promising the boy, it no longer matters. This map is fake.”
“Fake? That can’t be! Look at the lines…”
“Not made by a human, right?”
The woman sneered, “To be so smug when the other fooled you so badly. No man made the map, true, but also untrue, since no brush was used.”
“Eh?”
Mei Sangu blinked in confusion…

chapters.title: Chapter 1213 - 1213, War
chapters.content:
Chapter 1213, War
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
The woman shook her head and chuckled, “You all, high up on your perch made you forget the basic human nature.”
“Basic nature?”
“Don’t common people eat, drink and relieve themselves?”
She threw the yellow paper in Mei Sangu’s hand smiling, “Remember when raising Qingcheng that she drew the same map up to four times a day? And that smell, it just never gets old, ha-ha-ha…”
[What?!]
Mei Sangu gave the copy another sniff, finally coming to an explosive revelation, “Senior sister, you’re saying that fricking punk relieved himself on this paper?”
“What do you think?”
“This is absolutely outrageous!”
Mei Sangu flipped out, flicking her hands with lightning speed, tearing it in drifting pieces on the ground. The thought of having treated that foul thing as treasure for so many months, tracing its every ‘mystical’ line and making her hands reek, she keeled over and emptied her stomach on the spot.
Fang Min and the disciples sniffed their own hands and couldn’t wait a second more to wash their hands.
They were elegant ladies, yet had to touch such filthy and repugnant things?
Chu Qingcheng shook her head in disbelief, “No, that can’t be. He wouldn’t lie to me. Why would he use such a thing to toy with me?”
“Humph, dumb girl, he was only messing around and never truly cared about you one bit. You still went on playing the honey trap, when the other played you instead. You even dared to involve ourselves, how worthless!” Fang Min spat.
Chu Qingcheng lowered her head, her heart crushed with heartache.
On her first time leaving the sect, the first man she ever felt something for was Zhuo Fan. They were such a good match together, wanting to remain like this, but it turned out that Zhuo Fan had been toying with her.
[He could’ve just said the map couldn’t be copied. Why did he have to lie to me?]
[Are senior sisters right, that he’s only using me and never really cared? How could I be so foolish to not see it. In Gambling Town, he had so many pretty women around, so why would he care about some plain girl instead?]
As her bleak outlook turned forlorn, Chu Qingcheng’s heart sank.
The woman on the main seat coughed, “Qingcheng, men are fickle, so don’t let them get to you. You have your destiny with you and are much better off without those fools. Focus on cultivation.”
Chu Qingcheng deflated and gave a weak nod as tears brimmed her eyes.
“Senior sister, I can’t do anything right, letting some brat get the best of me at my age and even bringing such filth back to the sect. I deserve to be punished!” Mei Sangu looked ashamed.
The woman waved her worries away, “We have thousands of years of experience, making our childhood memories vague. The disciples are also sensible to not encounter such an event. It only came to mind because I’ve been looking after Qingcheng all these years. She is my dear precious disciple, making these memories deeper, ha-ha-ha…”
“Master!”
Chu Qingcheng was touched. Unable to overcome the sadness within, she started bawling. Fang Min huffed in envy.
[Damn this girl, throwing tantrums. She didn’t help the sect one bit yet master still treats her so nicely. Where’s the fairness gone to?]
Mei Sangu only grew angrier and roared, “Rotten cretin! Senior sister, I’m going after him and putting him in his place or he’ll think Ruby Cloud Sect is a pushover!”
The woman caressed Chu Qingcheng’s hair, her eyes flashing.
“Sect Leader, Devil Mountain made a declaration to the entire Sacred Domain!”
A sharp voice came from outside and a girl floated in to present a jade slip.
The woman took the jade slip and shouted, “Sangu, you don’t have to go. He’s untouchable.”
“Wha…”
“Take a look at yourself. He and the Luo clan are now cherished men of Demonic Emperor. Going after him means waging war.”
“What?” Mei Sangu snatched the jade slip and gave it a quick read, her face fuming, “Damn it! They must’ve given the real Nether Sea map for his status so the dog would have a master. We can’t do anything to him now!”
Fang Min and the rest were shocked.
[The Luo clan sure works fast, getting the Demonic Emperor’s protection in such a short time.]
The leading woman shook her head, “Don’t worry, they won’t be safe for long. When their protector falls, we’ll get them and make them pay for Qingcheng!”
[What?]
The others blinked in doubt…
Three months later, Zhuo Fan handled the transition of the twenty cities Zhao Chen gave to the Luo clan who happened to be under the two he killed.
There would always be some trouble when such a change occurred, from some ignorant fools trying to take over or other such overambitious people. Three months to settle all that was not nearly enough.
The Luo clan, however, moved with power and speed. Adding to them Murong Lie, Liu Mubai and the other Sword Kings, all the trouble became trifles. The twenty cities fell into their hands, finally making it officially Luo clan’s second turf in Sacred Domain, thousands of times bigger than Joy Town.
It wasn’t meant to last, as barely after the Luo clan set up their operations, they met a huge issue.
The Three Emperors war!
“Steward Zhuo, Featherwind City has noticed suspicious activity outside its walls!” A guard bowed before Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan frowned, “Featherwind City is next to Wraith Emperor’s lands. Do Wraith Emperor and Falcon Emperor prepare to move?”
“Big brother Zhuo, do we act?” Luo Yunhai came over to ask. Luo Sifan spoke with pride, “Let them try. We have nothing to fear with the Demonic Emperor watching over us! The Luo clan isn’t the only one fighting in this. We have reinforcements!”
“Not happening!”
Zhuo Fan glared at the two, “You think of yourselves shielded and want to fight them? Even with covered backs, it’ll be our Luo clansmen who will die out there. Why should we take such losses?”
Luo Yunhai nodded, “I can understand that, but we are at the border of the Demonic Emperor’s lands. Are we to retreat if not attacking?”
“Retreating will ruin this rare chance of getting in the Eight Emperors’ conflict.”
“Then…”
“Get the best of two worlds by watching them slaughter each other. This grudge is between the three of them and we can stay clear. How is the question.”
Zhuo Fan mused with a flickering gaze.
Another person burst in with a new jade slip, “Steward Zhuo, Demonic Emperor Zhao Chen requests your presence!”
“I was about to go see him as well.”
Zhuo Fan grinned, taking the jade slip and leaving for Devil Mountain with Bali Yuyu, taking three days to arrive.
The Demon Guard knew them and let them in.
In the hall, they bowed before Zhao Chen, “Greetings, Demonic Emperor!”
“Steward Zhuo, please sit!”
Zhao Chen impatiently gestured at the chairs, “Steward Zhuo, I believe you know by now why I called for you, having taken over the twenty cities I gave you.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “The Wraith Emperor’s forces show increased activity. They have ill thoughts!”
“Not just that, but they want to settle the score from years ago.”
Zhao Chen huffed and flicked his hand, “The Falcon Emperor’s men are acting up on the other side as well. The two must’ve planned it to pincer me. Do they really think they can beat me with this? Ha! Steward Zhuo, I called for you to ask how the Luo clan is handling the twenty cities. Are you ready to block Wraith Emperor’s forces?”
Zhuo Fan paused, “Demonic Emperor sir, the Luo clan is still new here, struggling to get all the local thugs in check. Now that the enemy is coming from outside, getting complete control in just three months is a little…”
“Alright, I know where you’re going with this, but escaping this war is impossible. Now how many men do you need? I’ll give them to you. I want to let them know that even with both against me, I’ll still crush them. They want to settle things over? Humph, they’re far from worthy!”
Zhao Chen’s eyes shone with cruelty.
Zhuo Fan muttered, “Demonic Emperor sir, the way I see it, avoiding a war is the best option…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1214 - 1214, Overwhelming Tactics
chapters.content:
Chapter 1214, Overwhelming Tactics
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Why do you say that, Steward Zhuo?” Zhao Chen frowned.
Zhuo Fan smiled as he stood, taking a couple of steps, “When two fight, the third reaps the reward. Demonic Emperor sir is heroic, but against two others the odds aren’t looking favorable. You may even win, but the losses will be devastating and turn into a loss in the end. While the other Emperors will use this chance to seize sir’s lands. In short, war will only bring downsides. Like in the war between the Falcon Emperor and the Wraith Emperor, what did sir do?”
“You think I don’t know that?”
Zhao Chen sighed, “It’s not I who started this fight, but the other two geezers coming at me. Not defending will be the same as handing over the land, losing not only territory but my name too. With the world seeing me weak, no one would turn to me for protection.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Yes, by not fighting the losses will be greater, making the war a must. However, it shouldn’t be sir who fights.”
“Who else then? They came especially to fight me!”
“Let those lurking from the sidelines fight. That’s the best tactic!”
Zhuo Fan wore a sneaky smile, “Any that joins it has to suffer. Why doesn’t sir just have those spectators hop into the fray while you take their place instead, as the third party?”
Zhao Chen started, “You want me to look for allies? But who would aid me at such a time? There’s two Emperors coming as well. Any allies I find, if I do find any, would at most give a lofty speech only to be a no show when the war starts.”
“Demonic Emperor sir, it’s not seeking allies, but adversaries. You fight alongside allies, unlike with adversaries. They do the work while we watch without lifting a finger.”
“Uh, Steward Zhuo, are you in your right mind?”
Zhao Chen stared hard then cracked up, “Ha-ha-ha, Steward Zhuo, where are we supposed to find such nimrods? I don’t know of any among the Eight Emperors who’d be that stupid to waste his strength.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Of course there aren’t any foolish enough to do it, and recruiting adversaries comes with a price, even the Eight Emperors.”
“What price would that be?” Zhao Chen asked.
Zhuo Fan’s grin widened, stressing every word, “Demonic Emperor sir, have you managed to decipher the Nether Sea map by any chance?”
“You want to give the map? Not happening!”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, denying such an idea, “The Nether Sea map is the only clue to the Nether Sovereign’s seat of enlightenment. It’s invaluable. Why should I just hand it over? What if they decipher it?”
“The map is too abstruse for common eyes to unravel. The Gambling Emperor wouldn’t have bet it otherwise. We’re not going to use the real map either, but a copy. The real thing will stay with sir.”
“No, what if they can still crack it?”
“We can just tamper with it, making it impossible.”
“Tampering it and they still won’t notice?”
“Demonic Emperor sir, please take out the map and allow me a look.” Zhuo Fan bowed.
Squinting, Zhao Chen finally relented and took out the map after a long pause. Zhuo Fan approached casually and pointed, “Sir, the map has countless black circles. All we have to do is just add more here while taking there, when we make a copy. No one will figure it out, not even the Gambling Emperor. The right and left corners are similar as well so we can just switch them with none the wiser. Even put side by side with the original, who would notice? You could stare at it till you go blind and still won’t figure it out.”
Zhao Chen nodded and exclaimed, “Steward Zhuo’s tactic is ingenious. With a few subtle changes on the already abstruse map, no one will notice. Now we have a bargaining chip, getting something for nothing, ha-ha-ha. Only, who should we make a deal with?”
“With who yearns for the map the most.”
Zhuo Fan pace, “In Gambling Town, the Gambling Emperor threw the map into a bet so he won’t value it, or maybe he already owns a copy. The other representatives might want the map, only two yearn for it. The Ruby Cloud Sect tried using a honey trap on me to give them a copy. The Sword Emperor’s representative even cut off his own toes in the betting. Talking with them would be far more successful.”
Zhao Chen gave an approving nod, “Sir is truly sharp. I’m fortunate to have you. I’ll contact the two right away.”
“One moment!”
Zhuo Fan intervened, “Demonic Emperor sir, no need to be hasty. All know our circumstances, and are sure to make heavy demands if we just go to them with the map. Heed my advice, sir, and they would be more than willing to work for us.”
Zhao Chen’s face twitched, staring long at Zhuo Fan, “Having sir with me is like gaining a gem. Then I’ll leave the overwhelming alliance to sir!”
“Just doing my duty, sir.”
Zhuo Fan bowed, exchanged a couple more words and left with Bali Yuyu. His first goal was the Ruby Cloud Sect, where Chu Qingcheng was. The failed deal in the Gambling Town would be finished this time.
Whoosh~
Arriving before the Ruby Cloud Sect’s territory, a dozen girls blocked their way, with Fang zmin in the lead.
Zhuo Fan snickered, shouting, “Girlie, go tell them that I represent the Demonic Emperor and have come to see the Enchanting Empress on important business!”
“Humph, rotten punk, like we haven’t had enough of your tricks last time. Now you have the nerve to come to the Ruby Cloud Sect? You’re looking to die!” Fang Min huffed, preparing to attack Zhuo Fan, “Sisters, rip this arrogant bastard to shreds!”
“Yes!”
The girls went on the offensive, aiming for Zhuo Fan. The heavy pressure befell Zhuo Fan, a Bone Tempering cultivator, bound to flatten him.
Whoosh~
Bali Yuyu flashed in front, sending a casual ice sword wave at them.
Bam!
The dozen girls coughed blood and were flung away like flies.
They should thank their lucky stars that Bali Yuyu went easy, or there would’ve been nothing left of them.
Bali Yuyu sneered and Zhuo Fan stepped forward, “I represent the Demonic Emperor. Attacking me is attacking sir. Does Ruby Cloud Sect want a war with Devil Mountain?”
“Humph, the Demonic Emperor is cornered, can he spare energy against another enemy?”
A mocking tone came, followed by a familiar figure, Zhuo Fan perked up, “If it isn’t senior aunt Mei, how’ve you been.”
“You dare call me that?”
“Just like Qingcheng does.” Zhuo Fan beamed without a trace of shame.
Mei Sangu recalled Zhuo Fan giving her that foul handiwork and cursed, “Damn cretin, I have a score to settle with you for last time!”
“Tch, so you found out, eh? Here I thought the biddy would take ages.” Bali Yuyu mocked.
Mei Sangu’s ears twitched, clenching her fists. She knew the girl was more than she looked and winning would not be easy. She couldn’t put her in her place.
Zhuo Fan laughed, “I’ll give you all the explanations you want for last time. The real issue is now. I represent the Demonic Emperor but you’re just keeping me at the door?”
“Huh, and what of it? Devil Mountain’s newest servant only knows how to abuse his status.”
“Ha-ha-ha, Mei Sangu, how is it any different from you?”
Zhuo Fan was grave, “Being the Demonic Emperor’s representative isn’t anything great, but that’s not for you to say, since you’re not worthy. I’m the Demonic Emperor’s representative, here to see the Ruby Cloud Sect Leader for a deal. Only your Sect Leader can send me away, for she is the Ruby Cloud Sect. Senior aunt Mei, are you perhaps that representative? Isn’t this a power play? Did the Enchanting Empress die?”
[Why you…]
Mei Sangu’s face twitched in anger, ready to explode. She wanted nothing more than to flatten him under her heel, but the only option she had was to bottle up her fury.
Not only was Bali Yuyu an unknown guard that she had no confidence winning against, Zhuo Fan was, unfortunately, right. He was the Demonic Emperor’s representative and this involved the relations between Devil Mountain and the Ruby Cloud Sect. She had no right to take charge here.
What a darn shame, a Bone Tempering bug had such power, but not her.
Mei Sangu’s anger flared once more. Dealing with Zhuo Fan was like losing five thousand years of her lifespan…

chapters.title: Chapter 1215 - 1215, Pressing Urge
chapters.content:
Chapter 1215, Pressing Urge
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Senior aunt Mei, kill him already!”
“Shut up! Are you an idiot to not see I can’t?”
Fang Min rushed her, but Mei Sangu took out her anger on her instead.
[Dumb girl, you think I don’t want to?]
Zhuo Fan watched the play with an even smugger grin of disdain.
Whoosh~
A new figure came before them and Zhuo Fan cried in joy, “Qingcheng?”
“Senior aunt Mei, master invited them into the hall.” Chu Qingcheng was icy, only bowing to Master and leaving right after.
Zhuo Fan figured out why and shook his head.
[Using that stained paper must’ve angered her.]
Bali Yuyu shoved his shoulder to express, “Aren’t you going to explain?”
“Don’t have to, since anything said at this point won’t reach her.” Zhuo Fan smiled broadly as he walked under the girls’ guidance into the sect.
They reached a quaint hall with a mature woman sitting on a high chair. Zhuo Fan knew her to be the Enchanting Empress of the Eight Emperors.
[It’s been a while, old crone.]
The Enchanting Empress sized him up as he entered, smiling, “Steward Zhuo? Please sit.”
“Senior Enchanting Empress.” Zhuo Fan cupped his hands, sitting in a bamboo chair, with Bali Yuyu sitting next to him.
Mei Sangu and the disciples stood on the Enchanting Empress’s side, never leaving the two out of their sights.
“Steward Zhuo is from Joy Town? Your name is bringing me unpleasant memories.”
Sipping her tea, Enchanting Empress pointed out, “He was authoritarian like you. Looking at Steward Zhuo is like seeing him. I wonder if there’s a connection.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “The Demonic Emperor said the same thing when he saw me, but I was born and raised in the Luo clan. I’m sorry to disappoint you, but the name was bestowed by Clan Head himself.”
“Oh, it’s fine. Just recalling an old friend of days long passed.”
“Old friend? Of yours and the Demonic Emperor?”
Zhuo Fan said, “I’m quite curious if he’s so alike me. Why would both seniors have the same reaction? Maybe your old friend must be quite amazing. I would like to hear more, ha-ha-ha…”
The Enchanting Empress stared hard and shook her head, “The same yet different, only the first impression is similar. Our friend never joked, was brooding and dark like ice, like a viper. Steward Zhuo is calm by comparison, amiable.”
“Really? The Demonic Emperor said the same, ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan sipped his own tea, his eyes flashing.
[Similar yet not, but actually also the same because I was reborn!]
Zhuo Fan came from the Demonic Emperor Zhuo Yifan but that man had long ago died.
[The one before you is just Zhuo Fan, who experienced so much in the mortal domain.]
[The Enchanting Empress, you will never see my past image no matter how much you scrutinize me.]
Zhuo Fan smirked and placed down the cup, “Good tea, hibiscus and fresh water, soothing the heart and calming hte mind. It’s just like Ruby Cloud Sect, fragrant and filled with a woman’s energy.”
“Steward Zhuo knows his tea. Ruby Cloud Sect’s mountain tea is gathered by our maidens with the tip of their tongue in early spring, when they’re still pure. No other place has such quality.”
“Tip of the tongue, you say?”
Zhuo Fan rose an eyebrow, looking on the tea tray, “Which is Qingcheng’s? I’ll have ten kilos of it, thanks.”
The girls turned from him to Chu Qingcheng, giggling. The Enchanting Empress smiled as well.
Chu Qingcheng blushed, glaring at him and warning him not to be frivolous. Zhuo Fan was still looking through the teacups, ignoring her fiery stare.
“Steward Zhuo is so funny. You’re nothing like him, ha-ha-ha…”
The Enchanting Empress turned serious, having enough pleasantries, “We’ve talked for so long yet I’ve yet to know what the Demonic Emperor’s representative is doing here.”
Unsuccessful in his noble pursuit, Zhuo Fan place the tea at the side and smiled, “Nothing much, just a bargain to discuss with the Enchanting Empress.”
“Bargain?”
“Exactly!”
Zhuo Fan grew serious, “Enchanting Empress must’ve heard by now that sir is about to fight with the Falcon Emperor and the Wraith Emperor. They’re testing the waters now, with ill intent. The Demonic Emperor thus wishes to ask the Enchanting Empress to step in and mediate. Upon success, a great reward awaits you.”
The Enchanting Empress’s brow shook, “So that’s why you’re here. The Wraith Emperor and Falcon Emperor aren’t easy to deal with either. With their ill tempers, they would hardly give me any attention.”
“The only reason the two started this war is because they have sir outnumbered. But Enchanting Empress, by coming forth and standing with sir, it will be a tie. They would never try anything at that point and everyone would just fall back. The people would be fortunate to be spared from such a calamity.”
“I see, the Demonic Emperor wants my support to intimidate them.”
The Enchanting Empress squinted then refused, “Steward Zhuo can return to the Demonic Emperor, for the Ruby Cloud Sect is not about to join such an ill event.”
“Enchanting Empress, we’ve yet to speak our terms. Maybe they’ll be to your liking?”
“There’s no need. Stepping in can force the two to withdraw, but what about later? Their hatred would be directed at me. I’m not that narrow minded to take such little gain and earn two Emperors’ disfavor.”
The Enchanting Empress waved him off, “Steward Zhuo, you can leave. Send them on their way, girls!”
Disciples came over at once and offered, “After you.”
Looking at her and then at the hesitant Chu Qingcheng, Zhuo Fan sneered. He nodded and stood, “I worked hard to convince the Demonic Emperor to win the Enchanting Empress over, but alas, ma’am is cold. I’ll just have to take it up with the Sword Emperor and let him have the Nether Sea map.”
“Wait!”
Enchanting Empress shouted at his words, “What did you say, the Nether Sea map? That’s your term, the Nether Sea map?”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “It is, but not the original, just a copy.”
“Copy? You have the nerve to say that?”
Mei Sangu flipped at the mere mention of the word, “I still haven’t payed you back for the last copy you gave me and now you bring your dirty rags here again?”
The Enchanting Empress was grave, staring at him.
Zhuo Fan snickered, “I was about to mention that. When I raised the proposal, I said I would risk my life to copy the map if you give me Qingcheng. But what do you do? Return to the sect and leave me hanging. I’m not as gullible as Qingcheng to believe your lies. But she insisted on having it or she would be scolded. I thus promised her and gave her a map.”
Zhuo Fan bent backward, sticking out his waist very suggestively, his tone a mockery, “Ain’t this a map as well? While not Nether Sea map, by any means, but I would rather have you spit fire at me instead of Qingcheng.”
“Zhuo Fan…”
Chu Qingcheng was touched and looked her heart melted.
The Enchanting Empress was grave, “And now? Is the map real this time?”
“Of course, the Demonic Emperor personally offered the deal so it can’t be anything less than genuine.”
Zhuo Fan shouted, “The Demonic Emperor planned to go for the head of the Eight Emperors first, the Sword Emperor. He just had to show up and the other two would easily fall back. But I miss Qingcheng and hope to give the Ruby Cloud Sect some help, thus I persuade the Demonic Emperor to find another worthy ally, recommending the Enchanting Empress. I did all this so that Qingcheng and I could be together. I’m doing this out of personal interest, since the Sword Emperor is enough to force the two back. So why even bother making another map?”
Enchanting Empress nodded, “How can we be sure the map is real?”
“When we give you the copy, we’ll bring the real map as well so that you can see for yourself. You may also ask the Gambling Emperor to inspect it for any flaws.”
“In that case, we agree to the Demonic Emperor’s proposal.”
The Enchanting Empress shouted with resolve.
Since this involved the Sword Emperor, the Falcon Emperor and Wraith Emperor would not direct their anger towards her. The Sword Emperor was there to take the lead and she’d be safe.

chapters.title: Chapter 1216 - 1216, Meeting The Sword Emperor Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 1216, Meeting The Sword Emperor Again
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
With the agreement coming to a close, Zhuo Fan and Bali Yuyu said their goodbyes. The Enchanting Empress had someone walk them out, urging them to talk about the details later.
The Enchanting Empress gazed into the distance once they were gone, sighing, “I can see why a Bone Tempering cultivator got such a high position, he has a knack for it. The rash Demonic Emperor can be said to be soaring to new heights now.”
“Senior sister, you believe he…”
“From his proposal, not only could I not find any reason to refuse, but I also lost the right to haggle. Humph, the brat poses as Demonic Emperor’s representative, but he’s smooth enough to make it look like we’re the one’s winning in this deal.”
The Enchanting Empress’s eyes shone, “Qingcheng had no chance against his guile, thoroughly charmed. Sangu, watch Qingcheng closely. Don’t let him take her.”
Mei Sangu nodded, “Senior sister, I know exactly Qingcheng’s value. I won’t let that nameless brat touch one hair on her!”
The Enchanting Empress nodded and smiled…
In front of the Ruby Cloud Sect, a sudden shout stopped the two from leaving.
“Wait!”
Knowing full well why, Zhuo Fan put on a smile as he turned to his intended, “Qingcheng, you don’t have to send us off. I still need to pay the Sword Emperor a visit. I would much rather be with you and go through a wedding, even raising a cute baby. Sigh, busy, busy, busy.”
“Cut that out! Who’d ever…”
Chu Qingcheng blushed and glared at him. Then she whispered, “Zhuo Fan, forgive me for getting the wrong idea about before. I thought you only wanted…”
“My feelings for you are genuine. You don’t have to say anything. You’ll come to see it in time.”
Zhuo Fan held her soft hand and pecked her cute cheek, “One day I will take you away from the Ruby Cloud Sect.”
Feeling her cheeks burning, Chu Qingcheng showed no anger, just lowering her head. She gave a faint nod and a smile filled with joy.
Zhuo Fan said his goodbye, leaving with Bali Yuyu’s piercing stare on him.
Chu Qingcheng watched them go, her deep gaze filled with emotion…
Three months later, on a lofty mountain range, two people walked by.
Looking up at the few clouds surrounding a glorious palace, Zhuo Fan smiled and cupped his hands, “I represent the Demonic Emperor and request a meeting with the Sword Emperor!”
Whoosh~
Thirty people surrounded them the next instant, holding swords or blades that glinted in the sun.
Zhuo Fan cared not, while Bali Yuyu showed disdain.
[You call that a sword?]
“Zhuo Fan, you have some nerve coming here when we still have a score to settle from Mist City.”
A familiar voice echoed as a man stepped out of the encirclement.
Zhuo Fan smirked, cupping his hands, “If it isn’t young master Xu Zhensheng. It’s been a while.”
“Don’t you give me that!”
Xu Zhensheng sneered, “You’re just looking to get killed, aren’t you? In Gambling Town, the Gambling Emperor’s turf, we couldn’t touch you, but now here you are, in our own lands. You’re practically begging for it. Brothers, sword formation! Kill the bastard and take revenge for Elder Liu!”
“Yes!”
The men pointed their swords at him and a net shot for the two to cut them down.
Bali Yuyu flashed in front of Zhuo Fan, releasing her power. Thunder echoed as icy lightning sword aura spread everywhere.
Boom!
Upon contact, a deafening explosion tore the skies. The thirty swords were reduced to splinters, littering the ground. Their users, however, recoiled from the outburst of power and coughed blood. They slammed on the ground, too wounded to get up.
Xu Zhensheng squinted in shock, his voice shaking, “Y-you dare raise your hand in the Sword Emperor’s land? You’ll get yours, mark my words! Once I get my senior uncles, you’re dead!”
“And? Do they represent Sword Emperor Ao Changtian?”
Zhuo Fan sneered, “Brother Zhensheng, you have to understand, I’m here on behalf of the Demonic Emperor to discuss with the Sword Emperor. As the Sword Emperor’s disciple, instead of walking us in, you attacked us. It’s not just disrespectful to the Demonic Emperor, but you have disgraced your Sword Emperor. Are his disciples so cocky to find him beneath them? Now you won’t even allow his guests to see him? Is he held prisoner in there?”
“Y-you…”
Xu Zhensheng choked, unable to speak as he sweated buckets.
[Right, this is undermining authority. It mustn’t reach master’s ears or I’m dead.]
Whoosh!
Another old face showed up then, dressed in white and having an elegant demeanor. Though he had no legs and floated.
The elder gave them a dark look, shouting, “The Sword Emperor will see you!”
“Thank you!”
Zhuo Fan leaned and walked ahead. Bali Yuyu gave the old guy a look and followed.
“Elder Liu…”
Xu Zhensheng began, but the man held up a hand, “The Sword Emperor will handle everything.”
The old man led the way with Xu Zhensheng at his side. The four reached a magnificent hall, with eighteen lofty pillars looking like divine swords, majestic and kingly.
In the center seat stood an old man with a white beard, a face covered in scars, and a sharp gaze.
[What strong sword energy.]
Bali Yuyu grew grave, clenching her fists. The old man made her feel threatened, in serious danger of dying.
Zhuo Fan grinned.
[Sword Emperor Ao Changtian, we meet after so long. What comes around goes around. With me gone, the second best for ten thousand years finally got the throne, ha-ha-ha.]
Whoosh~
A cold wave flashed and Bali Yuyu caught a cold blade between her fingers. It was seven feet long, covered in intricate dragon patterns. The tip was aiming straight for Zhuo Fan’s forehead, merely an inch from killing him.
[That was too close!]
Bali Yuyu gasped, knowing it was for Zhuo Fan. She looked back at Sword Emperor on his chair.
He stared at her as well, then laughed, “Girl, good skills. Who taught you?”
“Family legacy.”
Bali Yuyu stared at him with anger in her eyes, “What does senior Sword Emperor mean by this?”
Elder Liu floated on a seat next to Sword Emperor, looking coldly at the two. Xu Zhensheng stood at his side.
Sword Emperor began, “The boy took my junior brother’s legs and thinks that being the Demonic Emperor’s representative would absolve him of it. But you’re only going to leave this place without your legs!”
“What?”
Bali Yuyu glared at him, “You want Steward Zhuo’s legs? I don’t think so!”
“Ha-ha-ha, you’ve lost any right the minute you entered my domain. I want his legs and nothing more out of respect for that Demonic Emperor brat, or did you think I’d stop there otherwise?”
The Sword Emperor’s power exploded, flashing in the two’s faces. His pressure slammed like a mountain, making them gasp as even their Yuan Qi slowed down.
Bali Yuyu panicked inside as sweat trickled down.
They were far from able to take on the Eight Emperors’ power…

chapters.title: Chapter 1217 - 1217, Three-way Talk
chapters.content:
Chapter 1217, Three-way Talk
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
A deadly bloodthirst enveloped them, like a sea of needles aimed at their heart. Bali Yuyu was frozen in place by now, while Zhuo Fan took a casual step forward, “We came to give you the Nether Sea map.”
The Sword Emperor immediately stopped his relentless pursuit for vengeance, staring hard at Zhuo Fan, “W-what was that?”
“Sword Emperor, we came to give you the Nether Sea map. Kill me and you’ll never get the chance again.”
“Humph, you think it’ll save you? Think again!”
The Sword Emperor flicked his hand, but then he went back to his throne, barking, “What the hell are you up to? Talk already before I lose the little patience I have left!”
Zhuo Fan cupped his hands, “Sword Emperor, it’s like this. You must’ve heard by now how the Falcon Emperor and Wraith Emperor are moving. The Demonic Emperor doesn’t fear them and only wants to spare the people the needless destruction and pain. Thus he is asking the Sword Emperor to mediate…”
“You can’t beat them so you came crawling to me. Don’t you think offering a copy instead of the original is a little… insincere?”
“My hands are tied. This is as far as the Demonic Emperor will bargain.”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Seeing as the Sword Emperor rejected the proposal, we shall leave.”
The two bowed.
“Wait!”
The Sword Emperor shouted. Zhuo Fan looked back, “Anything else I can do for you, Sword Emperor?”
“Use it to cut off your legs and you may leave with your life.” The Sword Emperor pointed at the sword Bali Yuyu threw on the ground.
Bali Yuyu grimaced, awaiting Zhuo Fan’s signal.
Zhuo Fan smiled and sighed. He stared at the sword, “Sword Emperor, can’t I make amends instead? I would rather not go without my legs for the rest of my days.”
“This is what you get for cutting my junior brother’s legs. I’m not as gracious as you might think.”
“Sword Emperor, I told you that I can make amends. Just tell me what I have to do, short of cutting my legs.”
“What do you have that’s worth my junior brother’s legs?”
“At Gambling Town, senior Liu cut his two toes for the Nether Sea map. I figured using the same map in exchange for his legs should be worth it. I’m sure senior Liu would’ve gladly given up his legs then just to earn the map.”
The old man eyed the Sword Emperor with a grave look, nodding. The Sword Emperor said, “Then hand it over, but can you take it from the Demonic Emperor?”
“Not the original, only a copy, if you don’t mind…”
“Copy?”
Sword Emperor glanced at elder Liu to see him frowning then nodding.
[Anything’s better than nothing.]
“It shouldn’t be fake either, right?”
“Of course not. I have a way to prove it to sir and you can even take it up with the Gambling Emperor to validate it.”
“That’s settled then. The girl will stay here as insurance.” Sword Emperor clapped, his decision final.
Zhuo Fan snickered, bowing, “Sword Emperor, you don’t need a hostage. All sir has to do is mediate the war and the Demonic Emperor will gladly offer the copy.”
“What?”
Sword Emperor glared at him, “You’re toying with me!”
“Sword Emperor, I would never.”
“Outrageous! I deigned letting you make amends by exchanging the Nether Sea map copy for your legs, but in the end, you’re still dragging the Demonic Emperor into this. How is that making amends?”
“Sword Emperor, please, I’m really doing what I said.”
Zhuo Fan bowed in panic, “To be honest, the Demonic Emperor already found an ally, the Ruby Cloud Sect’s Enchanting Empress. Two against two would be enough to force the enemy Emperors to withdraw. The matter with Elder Liu that day weighed heavy on my mind that I insisted on making another copy and having the Sword Emperor for an ally. The Sword Emperor is the head of the Eight Emperors, lofty and respected. Your mere presence will smooth things over.
“However, the Demonic Emperor was disinclined towards this proposal. More copies meant… ha-ha, you understand. So I worked three days and three nights to get the Demonic Emperor to accept the Sword Emperor as an ally. It’s just a matter of mediating and sir will get the copy. It’s hardly any different from doing nothing, isn’t it? Isn’t this ample proof of my sincere actions?”
[Uh…]
The Sword Emperor paused, looking at Zhuo Fan’s smile and said, “I can see now how you got a name for yourself in Gambling Town, thanks to that insidiousness and guile. With you by the Demonic Emperor’s side, it’s like having a hundred more Spirit Kings!”
“Sword Emperor, you flatter me.”
“That’s no compliment, but reality!”
The Sword Emperor waved, “Fine, you can go. I’ll agree with the Demonic Emperor’s request. We’ll now wait to meet and settle the rest. By the way, bring the Gambling Emperor as well to inspect the map.”
Zhuo Fan bowed, “Thank you so much Sword Emperor. Farewell!”
Zhuo Fan and Bali Yuyu left.
The Sword Emperor’s face fell, “Rotten brat, so cunning that it makes me want to flay him alive but I can’t do nothing to him. Humph, just a Bone Tempering cultivator yet…”
Bam!
The Sword Emperor slammed the table beside him to pieces.
Xu Zhensheng started, “Master, we’re just going to let him go? Elder Liu’s legs…”
“Didn’t he say it himself? He made up for it with the Nether Sea copy…” Elder Liu looked downcast.
“But isn’t that just a simple trade?”
“It is, but in his view, it’s making amends so that’s what it is. He also brought up the Ruby Cloud Sect to corner us. We could forgo the deal, but all we need to do is mediate and we’ll get a copy of the Nether Sea map. We can’t let this easy win pass us by.”
“But we could’ve still cut his legs. He made no amends, just speaking on behalf of the Demonic Emperor. A deal is one thing while retribution is another!” Xu Zhensheng’s eyes flashed with cruelty.
The Sword Emperor and elder Liu shook their heads.
“Ah’Sheng, when you meet him again, strike him then and there. Don’t ever give him the chance to speak.”
“Why?”
“The moment he does, you’d have lost all reasons to do so.”
The Sword Emperor sighed, “I could’ve done it at first, but lost my chance as he skirted around the Nether Sea map, the reason for the deal. With it in play, I lost all reason to deal with him. He represents the Demonic Emperor. Killing him means no deal, when we truly want it to go through. The kid is bad news, able to save his skin and accomplish the Demonic Emperor’s task…”
Xu Zhensheng started and elder Liu sighed.
The debt for his legs would remain on hold for a long time…
A month later, Zhuo Fan returned to Devil Mountain. Zhao Chen could hardly wait, questioning the minute he stepped in the hall, “Well, how did it go? Those two geezers have been growing restless these past months. They’ve taken three towns already. I haven’t joined the fight since I’ve been waiting for you to give me a reply.”
“Demonic Emperor sir can rest easy knowing everything went as planned.”
Zhuo Fan smirked, “The Enchanting Empress and Sword Emperor will be stepping in, all for just one copy of the map and nothing more. Now it’s up to sir, to use them against each other. The Wraith Emperor and Falcon Emperor will come out heavily wounded at the least.”
Zhao Chen laughed, “Steward Zhuo, you’re amazing to get two helpers so quickly. Luck’s on my side, ha-ha-ha. I’ll send letters to them right away to have a talk and settle those geezers.”
“Brilliant, sir!”
Zhuo Fan bowed, his smirk obvious.
Three days later, Devil Mountain sent two jade slips. After two more months, the Sword Emperor and Enchanting Empress arrived with their forces, along with a fat man in fancy clothes…

chapters.title: Chapter 1218 - 1218, Inconsistent
chapters.content:
Chapter 1218, Inconsistent
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Wearing a decorated black robe, Zhao Chen took his twenty Demon Guards to welcome them, with Zhuo Fan in their lead, of course, “Sword Emperor, Enchanting Empress, it’s been a long time. I’m thrilled to have both of your support in this matter, ha-ha-ha…”
“Demonic Emperor, please, we came to do our part and receive our just reward, ha-ha-ha…” The two replied back with respect. Sword Emperor went right to it, “Isn’t it time to show us what you promised? We’ve gone to great lengths to bring experts to appraise it.”
The Sword Emperor made way as he pointed at a fatty behind.
Zhao Chen cried, “Gambling Emperor, you’re here too?”
“Sure I am. In such a crucial situation, Sword Emperor insisted that I validate the items. I was also free at the moment, so I tagged along to enjoy the bustle. I’m curious if there’s been any clues to unraveling the Nether Sea map after taking it from me.” The Gambling Emperor smirked.
Zhao Chen shook his head, “Gambling Emperor, you jest. Known for your sharp mind, if you, who had it for decades and couldn’t crack it, how could I do so in only a few days? Then there’s the recent trouble that came up, taking more of my time. You’re overthinking things.”
“You don’t have to remind me. The answer to the riddle is like gambling, up to luck, coincidence and a whole lot of wisdom. I’m just a bit brighter, but not wiser, for true wisdom is unassuming and simple. Maybe your little friend managed to do it in a couple of days?”
“Hey, hey, are you two done? This is not the time to show off when we haven’t even seen the map.”
The Sword Emperor cut the two’s idle chatter, “Since this is a discussion among three parties, it will only be carried out on the premise of the map’s validity.”
The Demonic Emperor and Gambling Emperor laughed, the former bringing them into the main hall.
A three meter long table lay in the center. Zhao Chen took out three boxes and placed them on it, opening each one to reveal three scrolls.
The middle one had everyone’s focus, confirming it to be the real Nether Sea map. The other two looked newer, obviously the copies.
Unfolding them, they all looked the same, covered in black dots and circles. The lines at the top were also copied to the tiniest detail.
“This is the real Nether Sea map. Unlike that…”
Mei Sangu had come as well and her eyes shone as she sighed. Then she glared at Zhuo Fan recalling the indignity he put her through with his sick joke.
Zhuo Fan bowed towards Gambling Emperor, “Senior, please inspect the copies and see if there are any discrepancies so we may correct.”
“There’s nothing to inspect about the original. It just can’t be faked.”
The Gambling Emperor nodded, “The genuine map is made of ancient Nether paper, filled with yin energy, making it impervious and eternal, the craftsmanship lost with time. Everything’s about the drawing, whether it’s done accurately. It’s only a matter of matching the copies to the original.”
The Gambling Emperor leaned over to look closer.
After many hours, he still said nothing. A day in and he still found them to be identical to the real map.
The others didn’t disturb him in the process, since it involved the other three’s basis for cooperation.
Only after the second day did the Gambling Emperor put them down and sighed, “Yes, the copies are the same.”
The rest nodded, smiling.
“Now we shall help the Demonic Emperor in talking those two old guys into withdrawing so peace can be restored.” The Sword Emperor turned lively knowing that the map was within reach.
The Enchanting Empress nodded as well, in full agreement. The sooner they were done, the sooner she got what she wanted.
Zhao Chen shouted, “Hold on, I changed my mind.”
“You don’t want to trade?” The Sword Emperor reacted.
Zhao Chen shook his head, “Hardly, I just wish to add another condition. Don’t you think it’s too easy to get a copy by only talking?”
“What do you propose?” The two frowned, having a bad feeling.
Zhao Chen snickered, cupping his hands, “I ask that you promise me something. We all know the value of the Nether Sea map and I wish to ask a favor of you two in exchange for a copy.”
“What is it?”
“That all three of us act, help me to take all of the lands owned by the Wraith Emperor and Falcon Emperor.”
“What?”
The two flinched, with the Enchanting Empress shouting, “Steward Zhuo clearly said it’s only mediating. There was no mention of attacking. How can you just…”
“Yeah!”
Zhuo Fan also intervened, “Demonic Emperor sir, when I asked sirs for cooperation, fighting wasn’t part of it. Going back on it isn’t… right.”
“What’s so bad about it? And you have no right to talk here! Back off!” Zhao Chen glared at him.
Zhuo Fan sighed and stepped down.
Zhao Chen turned to the other two, “When I sent Steward Zhuo to ask for your help, the war hadn’t started. With you acting as mediators, it wouldn’t matter then since no harm’s been done. Now, those bastards took ten of my cities. I’m not about to take this lying down! You may still be after brokering peace, but I’ve grown out of it, humph!”
The two darkened, looking at the copies now and then. Getting them to attack over the copy was…
“Demonic Emperor, I’m sorry to say this, but you’re asking for too much!”
Zhuo Fan was grave, stepping in with a bow, “The Nether Sea map is valuable, but it is merely a faint hope. Deciphering it is still uncertain. Asking the Sword Emperor and Enchanting Empress to get involved in the war will bring them losses, and they have to receive adequate compensation.
