I propose that after their lands are taken over, the Demonic Emperor would split them with the two sirs, making it a common ground to act together. Adding the two copies as well, and it sounds worthwhile.”
“Outrageous!”
Zhao Chen snapped, “You want to split my gains? Isn’t that asking for much? Zhuo Fan, on which side are you on?”
“Sir, I’m always on your side, but in business, both sides need to be satisfied. How else are they to help you?”
“No, the most I can offer is twenty cities, since I’m still throwing in the two maps…”
“Demonic Emperor!”
“I believe Steward Zhuo’s proposal to be reasonable. We will divide everything evenly among us three. That’s the only way for us to involve our own forces.”
“Enchanting Empress, don’t haggle with me! I’m even giving you the map!” Zhao Chen roared.
The Enchanting Empress said with a cold smile, “Right now, you’re surrounded on all sides. What good will a piece of paper do when you’re burning to the ground? In any case, if you want us to fight, we can, but we’re not about to suffer for nothing. Sword Emperor, are you up for some charity?”
“Ha-ha-ha, I’m no fool to accept such dumb demands!”
“Y-you all…”
Demonic Emperor gnashed his teeth, flinging his hand in the air, “Fine, have it your way! We’ll split it three ways, that’s our agreement. As for the maps…”
“We’ll have them, of course.”
“Why the hell would you?”
“Because those two came for you. It wouldn’t bother us at all if we just stayed back, while you needed us.” Sword Emperor sneered, “The map is the reward for our cooperation.”
The Demonic Emperor was huffing and puffing in anger, but finally turned away, “Fine, do what you want, making me lose so much!”
“And you… you talk too much!”
Zhao Chen pointed at Zhuo Fan, barking before going to his chambers.
Zhuo Fan sighed, while the two Emperors were smug. The Gambling Emperor gave Zhuo Fan a long look, sporting a crafty grin.
[The kid sure is something else…]
“Steward Zhuo, we would like to make a copy ourselves. Could we?”
Zhao Chen was gone now and the Enchanting Empress asked Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan frowned, giving her a dark look, “We had the copies prepared already. Why would you bother for more? Do you doubt…”
“No no no, we just wish to feel for ourselves the fascination of the Nether Sea map.”
Zhuo Fan smiled after some difficulty, “As you wish, but please give your copy to the Gambling Emperor for keeping. The Gambling Emperor is fair, always neutral. Once the deal is done, each of you can take your copy from him.”
“We understand.”
The Enchanting Empress and Sword Emperor took out paper and started copying the Nether Sea map.
Zhuo Fan sneered inside.
[These geezers are the same, cautious to the extreme, ha-ha-ha…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1219 - 1219, Eight Emperor War
chapters.content:
Chapter 1219, Eight Emperor War
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
The Sword Emperor and Enchanting Empress were obsessed with the map at this point, taking their good time copying it and then comparing it for good measure. This whole process took a week, before handing the paper to the Gambling Emperor.
Zhuo Fan sent the three great people on their way, as the representative of Devil Mountain, to get ready for war. Zhao Chen looked to not have gotten over his loss in this deal and never showed up in the meantime.
The Emperors felt even more gratified by his demeanor, like they won big. So they saluted Zhuo Fan as they left.
The Gambling Emperor gave him a long look, “Demonic Emperor has earned heaven’s favor to have Steward Zhuo by his side.”
He left flying, under Zhuo Fan’s watch and grin.
“How was it? Did it work?”
The Demonic Emperor strolled out and smiled in joy.
Zhuo Fan bowed, “Sir, everything went perfectly. To get their copy as soon as possible from the Gambling Emperor, they’re sure to help us crush the other two quickly.”
“Ha-ha-ha, Steward Zhuo is incredible, getting those two to fall for your scheme with a few words and coming to my rescue. They wouldn’t have taken such a risk otherwise.”
“Demonic Emperor sir, all I did was play a little mind trick.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, “Asking them to fight for us by using the map as bait wouldn’t have worked. So we had them act as mediators first, fooling them into coming to the talks before changing your mind. They were promised the map, but now that the Gambling Emperor has validated it and seeing it so close, they couldn’t bear the thought of missing out.”
“Then we played our little act, one with the other against them.”
Zhao Chen laughed, “I gave them crumbs while Steward Zhuo argued over honorable reward. Of course they’d side with Steward Zhuo but forgot to consider if they should join the war in the first place. It was truly smooth how they got dragged into fighting our war for us with none the wiser. Steward Zhuo’s skills are ingenious, way better than any adviser I ever had, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan bowed, “Demonic Emperor is too kind. I’m just ashamed of making sir play the bad guy.”
“It’s fine, since it’s only natural for me to play such a role. You’d come off as fake if you’d done it and the plan would fall through. What mattered was for this deal to work. And they wanted the Nether Sea copy, humph.”
Zhao Chen sneered.
Zhuo Fan nodded with his own cruel smile. He took out the real map and splashed water over to clean it.
“They wanted to copy the original, never imagining we’d tampered with it, adding more black circles. They still have a fake in the end!”
“It’s all due to Steward Zhuo’s clever thinking, anticipating such a situation. You have my complete admiration!”
Zhao Chen’s eyes flashed and both cracked up.
Zhao Chen said, “Should we now gather the men and join them in raiding those old fools’ lands?”
“No, Demonic Emperor, we cannot join this war.”
“Why not?”
Zhao Chen stated, “Those two came for me and I have to be a part of this war. Steward Zhuo, do you have another devious plot?”
Zhuo Fan gave a vague smile, “Demonic Emperor, think about it. With three Emperors, those two will fall, no doubt about it. But when push comes to shove, what of our allies? Knowing the enemy is going to be defeated, they would give their all to fight in anger and hatred against such indignity. Our losses would be huge while our allies would just wait at the side. They would have some losses as well, while us and the enemy would be crippled, making them the real winners.”
“Yes, none of those Eight Emperors are good. They’ll be sure to do this!” Zhao Chen gnashed his teeth.
Zhuo Fan grinned, “Then, when they fight, we just do nothing. The enemy would give their all against our allies, making them suffer while we watch them burn from a safe distance. When the outcome is obvious, we join in as allies and win everything. Isn’t that better?”
“Yeah, we won’t lose one man and would get a third of those two’s lands.” Zhao Chen’s eyes shone with joy, “Steward Zhuo, amazing as ever!”
“I did say Demonic Emperor, to look for adversaries and not allies, and found I have.” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone.
Zhao Chen was over the moon. Thrilled and oblivious at this careful net being laid out, meant to drag him down to hell as well…
A month later, the Wraith Emperor and Falcon Emperor had no trouble at all taking twenty more of Demonic Emperor’s cities.
The rest of the world found it odd. Even with two Emperors against him, Demonic Emperor wouldn’t just sit still, right? Letting his lands be taken away without even a fight?
The attackers themselves found it queer.
Out of the blue, the neutral Sword Emperor and Enchanting Empress joined the fight against them.
They looked to have been gotten ready just for this too.
The war was thus in full swing, with each side having two Emperors. As for Demonic Emperor, he showed no sign of joining. The enemy had no intention to duke it out with those strong crazies so they withdrew from the Demonic Emperor’s lands.
The Demonic Emperor still hadn’t sent one soldier on the front or recovered his lands.
Uncertain, the two enemies set their soldiers at the borders, waiting for a week, only falling back for real when the Demonic Emperor still showed no signs. They now moved their soldiers to deal with the Sword Emperor and Enchanting Empress’ invasions on their lands.
Their weakened borders led to the new participants having an easy time taking ten cities.
The enemy was furious, sending their armies to help while shouting curses all the time.
[We had no beef with you so why the hell are you ganging up on us? This is absurd!]
The two rushed to counter, making the strong forces of the Sword Emperor and Enchanting Empress suffer losses.
Another month passed and the newcomers took five more cities with their relentless assaults, though losses mounted to forty percent.
The Sword Emperor and Enchanting Empress felt it and swore on and off because of it. Not the enemy Emperors, since they were just defending their lands.
Their only gripe was, of course, with the Demonic Emperor. It was his mess to begin with yet after more than a month, he still sat on his laurels, leaving them four to enjoy a nice day on a bloody battlefield.
The Demonic Emperor had to strike the enemy’s heart and then the war would’ve been over and done with ages ago.
He didn’t do that of course, letting the four Emperors clash and entwine, making a resolution improbable in the short term. The Demonic Emperor would definitely hang the copy over their heads because of this too, making all the effort till now wasted.
So the war went on, with no one to direct it or stop it; just what Zhuo Fan wanted.
[Eight Emperors? Ha! Letting you rulers kill each other is the fastest way to fall. So go ahead, tear each other apart to your heart’s content, ha-ha-ha…]
Shriek~
Over the bloody battlefield, with limbs and corpses rotting in the blazing sun, a two-mile-long bald eagle cast a dark shadow with its huge wings. On its back was a spindly man with sharp eyes.
“Senior sister, the Falcon Emperor has joined the battle!” In a large tent, Mei Sangu rushed to report.
Eight Emperors frowned, “The old man is here? Damn it, a fight among Eight Emperors can’t be avoided now. The war has to end now if we are to endure. Sangu, take the Ruby Cloud Sect forces fifty miles back so that they do not get affected.”
“Yes!”
Mei Sangu carried her orders. The Enchanting Empress’ eyes flared and she flew out to face the Falcon Emperor above the hellscape.
“Old man, you’re finally stepping in yourself. I thought you’d wait till the last man to show up.”
“Enchanting Empress, what did I ever do to you to invade my lands?”
“We all work for our greed. You didn’t do anything, but I’m entrusted with another’s business.” Enchanting Empress’ eyes shone.
The Falcon Emperor squinted, “A deal with the Demonic Emperor perhaps? I was wondering why would you and the Sword Emperor turn on us? Tell me, what did he promise you anyway? I’ll just double it!”
“Ha-ha-ha, Falcon Emperor, you think any random trinket could impress us? You don’t have what he does!”
“Really? Then that leaves war as the only option.”
The Falcon Emperor flicked his sleeve and the eagle beneath him shot for the Enchanting Empress with bloodthirst…

chapters.title: Chapter 1220 - 1220, The One from Sacred Mountains
chapters.content:
Chapter 1220, The One from Sacred Mountains
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
[Lofty Falcon!]
The Falcon Emperor waved and a golden falcon flew out from his body, high above, growing larger and larger as it enveloped the sky. It flapped its wings and shot golden feathers down like meteors.
Everything in a thousand miles was covered in craters. The ground quaked, the air warped, everything ended up reduced to nothing from the overbearing power.
Both sides were wise enough to pull out their men, avoiding the pointless loss of millions of lives. Not even a Spirit King could avoid that.
They watched agape and in fear at the wanton destruction, thanking their lucky stars to be alive.
They were also amazed at the Eight Emperors’ strength, way beyond any normal Emperor.
[Senior sister…]
Mei Sangu watched with worry. An eerie laughter jarred their ears, “Ha-ha-ha, Falcon Emperor, using the Imperial Mark off the bat? You’re going all out, I see!”
Whoosh~
A swirling wind came out of nowhere, removing all the dust.
A stem hundreds of meters long, adorned with golden lights and petals emitting faint ethereal fragrance winded its way upward, blossoming in this wretched battlefield. The Enchanting Empress sat upon it, showing mesmerizing charm and a coy smile playing on her lips.
“Imperial Mark, Heavenly Jasper?”
The Falcon Emperor smiled, “My Ascending Divine Falcon soul rules the skies while your Heavenly Jasper soul roots in the endless earth. It’s like a battle between heaven and earth.”
The Enchanting Empress said, “The heavens and earth coexist, as do yin and yang. Despite being opposite, they can’t overcome each other, unlike us. For someone always falls!”
“Humph, since time immemorial, the heavens are lofty and the earth is base. You’re the one who shall fall!”
“Let’s see it then, shall we?”
The Enchanting Empress raised an eyebrow, shouting, “High earth ranked martial art, Flower Bloom, Heaven Piercing Forest!”
Boom~
The earth cracked as golden vines snaked out of the ground, untold numbers shooting for the skies.
They whistled as they rented the air, feeling like they were about to tear the heavens asunder. Falcon Emperor was grave atop his eagle as he avoided the incoming vines.
The Enchanting Empress sneered, “Does a heavenly lord not deign to land?”
“Enchanting Empress, you’re getting ahead of yourself. Uprooting these things is nothing to me!” Falcon Emperor made a sign, “High earth ranked martial art, Divine Elusive Falcon, Airborne Hunt!”
The golden eagle above exploded in a brilliant flash, sending golden motes of light in all direction. They shook turned into miniature golden eagles, in the millions.
There was not a place that hadn’t one.
The Enchanting Empress turned grave, making the vines cover her.
Bang~
Explosions echoed all around her. Her tough vines were unable to withstand the finger-sized golden eagles, splintering and breaking with every impact.
The Falcon Emperor sneered.
The vines all crumbled, but the Enchanting Empress was nowhere to be seen. Her Imperial Mark, Heavenly Jasper was gone as well.
Then he noticed the ground had a dark hole, one meter wide.
The Falcon Emperor muttered, “Flowers live on the ground. Does that mean she hid beneath the earth…”
Bam!
Dust flew everywhere as a root shot from under the earth, straight for him. The deadly bloodlust made him flinch, jumping off the eagle on instinct.
With a muffled sound, the giant eagle cried as it got skewered.
The Falcon Emperor looked back and gasped. His huge eagle had half of its body gone, releasing a rain of blood in its suffering plunge to the ground.
In its place was a towering stem with a gorgeous flower at the end. Though this flower not only had thorns, but teeth and a bloody maw as it tore through the eagle’s body. The blood pulsed through its veins down the stem, giving it a ghastly look.
The Enchanting Empress was still atop her flower, giving him a wicked smile of contempt.
“To think the Heavenly Jasper is a carnivore!”
The Falcon Emperor clenched his fists and threw his hand out, making golden lights gather behind him to form a three hundred meter long golden eagle, “Enchanting Empress, you killed my mount so I’m going to gut you like a trout and offer up your soul to my divine falcon.”
The Enchanting Empress said, “Any slower and the 10th level spiritual beast wouldn’t have been the only casualty. You lost back there and are still blustering about?”
“Shut it, Enchanting Empress! Today you’re plucked, one petal at a time!”
“What did you say?” The Enchanting Empress was outraged.
“I said you’re plucked!”
“Die!” The Enchanting Empress made a furious sign and her man-eating chair shot for the skies.
The earth shook with its movements as thousands upon thousands of vines shot out as well, aiming for the Falcon Emperor.
The Falcon Emperor was no pushover either, trembling and releasing a lofty eagle cry as he dived along with his golden eagle. The blazing sun above, sent its rays to help, turning into firebirds in the millions.
The sky warped and the earth caved as the two relentless cultivators unleashed their heavy attacks. Even as they had yet to clash, the thick and calamitous power they unleashed reeked of death.
All spectators shuddered with the fight reaching do-or-die.
“Stop!”
A shout rent the skies, making the two halt their attacks.
Whoosh!
Understanding their situation, the man never thought of the possibility the two could pull back their attacks.
[And since you can’t stop, I will handle them myself.]
Two booms echoed that startled everyone. At the peak of the skies, two white sword waves shot down, hundred meters in length, straight for the two.
The rising vines got pruned down to their molecules, while the diving golden eagle got bisected, before turning into harmless lights.
A three hundred meter large image of a man carrying eighteen swords on his back used his large hands to clasp on Enchanting Empress’ carnivorous flower and Falcon Emperor’s golden eagle.
“This…”
The two cried, “Spirit body soul…. a Saint!”
“I am the 6th Sacred Mountain’s Saint, He Xiaofeng!”
The huge image held in the center of his head an eminent youth staring down at them, “I heard of the Eight Emperors going to war, bringing chaos and destruction among the people so I came to put a stop to it. Give up. My attacks would’ve cut your souls and yourselves if they were aimed at your Imperial Marks.”
The two gasped and bowed, “Thank you, Saint, for your mercy. We’re forever grateful!”
“Cut the crap! We came out because of orders to discuss with the Eight Emperors. But it turns out you guys are nothing but idiots to fight over fortunes!”
He Xiaofeng decreed, “You are to go to the Sword Emperor’s place within the month. We’ll talk there.”
He Xiaofeng released his hold on them and vanished. The two Emperors stood stock still, seeing the fear in the other’s eyes.
[This Saint had always been in seclusion. What’s he doing out? The last time that he came out was due to Nine Serenities Secret Records. Is this time because…]
The Enchanting Empress’ heart sank.
[Curses, here comes another struggle for treasure. The Sacred Mountains are no saints after all, humph!]
The Sword Emperor and Wraith Emperor were at their throats with their deadly attacks when an old man popped in to put a halt to their senseless destruction, telling them the Eight Emperors were to gather.
Thus, the curtain fell on the war of five Emperors, with neither party coming out pleased. As the big bad boss above came down, the little guys could no longer act tough and do what they pleased…

chapters.title: Chapter 1221 - 1221, Summons
chapters.content:
Chapter 1221, Summons
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Someone from the Sacred Mountains came?”
In Devil Mountain’s main hall, the Demonic Emperor shouted out after the Sword Emperor’s messenger left. Then his fury exploded and he smashed a good table to splinters.
“Damn them all! They just couldn’t pick a better timing than right when things were getting heated up. I was just about to charge in and sweep everything but they just had to butt in and ruin everything! So many losses yet fricking nothing to show for it! Curse them!”
[Hello~, you lost nothing, you dunce. Why the tantrum? It should be the Sword Emperor, Enchanting Empress, and me in particular, who should be raging.]
[It was bad enough it took so much effort to enact such a bloody war, getting everyone to jump in, now everything went out the window. I’m the one who lost everything here!]
[Seven Sacred Mountains only ever acts out of need, which means…]
Zhuo Fan rubbed his chin in thought, “Demonic Emperor sir, news of Nether Sea map must’ve reached them. We’ll have to hand the map over!”
“Why the hell would I?” Zhao Chen threw his hand.
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Yeah, after so much blood and sweat in keeping the original, only to give it all up makes me worthless to sir. However, no matter the value of the map, one’s life is far more precious.”
Zhao Chen shuddered, recalling the lesson of his master dying at a Saint’s hand because of the Nine Serenities Secret Records and sighed.
[Master was the boldest of the Eight Emperors and even under the other seven’s attacks, still stood undefeated. Only when a Saint…]
[Curse those Seven Sacred Mountains!]
Zhao Chen raged inside, evident by his ragged breath, his face turning red.
Zhuo Fan said, “Demonic Emperor sir, have you cracked the map by chance? It would make giving it up all the more easier.”
“Crack it? You think you can up and resolve something so abstruse over lunch?” Zhao Chen sighed, “I wouldn’t care about giving it up either if I had.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, “An idea struck me that might help!”
“Oh, Steward Zhuo, you saw through it?”
“I can’t say for sure, just that I might know where to start.”
“That’s better than nothing. At least we could try it on a copy we make.” Zhao Chen laughed, taking out the map, “Steward Zhuo, what’s your idea? Tell me!”
Zhuo Fan leaned and pointed out a corner, “I was struck by an idea that this map might be just a star chart.”
“Steward Zhuo, can you read the stars?”
“Somewhat, with my low cultivation, I could only invest my time in other areas, lest I was content to remain pariah.”
Zhuo Fan continued, “Sir, look here, these corners seem to resemble star clusters and this looks just like the night sky. It’s just so hard to make it up with all of them so tight together.”
Zhao Chen frowned hard and exclaimed, “These extra black dots do interfere, Steward Zhuo. Just tell me about the sky area you can see while ignoring the one that eludes you.”
“Demonic Emperor sir, that’s brilliant! I was thinking the same thing!” Zhuo Fan smiled and took out a paper to put over the other, “Look sir, this is the rough star chart.”
Zhao Chen nodded, then his eyes lit up as he looked, “Isn’t this a map of Sacred Domain?”
“Good going, sir! The image formed does look like the Sacred Domain’s map!”
“Ha-ha-ha, then follow the stars and draw out the Sacred Domain outline. Nether Sea must be somewhere on it. But where?”
Zhuo Fan smirked as he played along, “I can’t make out this part. The star positions, the shape, like nine rings. Maybe underworld star cluster…”
“Wait, underworld?”
“Right, diviners look at the sky to determine one’s fate. If there’s a bright star in the underworld star cluster, that means they’re going to die!” Zhuo Fan pointed out.
Zhao Chen considered it then smiled, “Nether Sea must be where the underworld river is. The death star’s location must be the door to Nether Sea!”
“We did it! Nether Sea map’s mystery is resolved, ha-ha-ha…” Zhao Chen laughed wildly.
Zhuo Fan bowed, “Amazing sir, congratulations!”
“Come, Steward Zhuo, you’re going overboard. Something tells me you cracked it already and only came here to tell me.”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Sir, I’m but a fool.”
“You don’t have to push the credit on me, to stroke my ego. I could never have the heart to cast out such a talented genius like you, Steward Zhuo. So don’t play the fool with me and suck up to me.”
Zhao Chen beamed as he put the map in his ring, patting Zhuo Fan’s shoulder, “Once I get Nether Sovereign’s cultivation method and become a Saint, no, a Sovereign, you’ll still be at my side, above everyone else. I won’t ever forget your dedication, ha-ha-ha…”
“Thank you, Sovereign!”
Zhuo Fan bowed, snickering inside.
[Since you want Nether Sovereign’s legacy, by all means, take it. Just be sure to take the rest with you, alright, ha-ha-ha…]
A month later, the Eight Emperors took their closest people to the Sword Emperor’s place. Despite being the owner in his home, he didn’t feel like one.
In his seat sat a youth, He Xiaofeng, and an old man next to him stood with a ruthless glimmer in his eyes.
“Greetings, Saints!”
Everyone below bowed. The elder said nothing, with He Xiaofeng speaking, “Rise.”
“Thank you, Saint!”
The people sat and He Xiaofeng swept them with his cold eyes, “Where is Demonic Emperor Zhao Chen?”
“What may I do for you, Saint?” Zhao Chen bowed at once, meek.
He Xiaofeng demanded, “I heard you have the Nether Sea map. Is this true?”
“It is, Saint!”
“Have you resolved its mystery?”
“I’m but an oaf, Saint!”
“None of you are worthy of being able to unravel such a treasure anyway.” He Xiaofeng sneered, not bothering masking his condescending tone. His voice was soft, yet strict as well, “Give it here!”
Zhao Chen took out the map and presented it, “Saint, here it is, as requested.”
He Xiaofeng nodded and took it for a closer look with a chuckle. Then he gave it to the old man.
“You’re not mad about giving it up?”
The elder spared it a glance then asked Zhao Chen.
Zhao Chen showed an ingratiating smile, “It has been my only wish to offer the map to Saint. How could I ever be mad? I would’ve long come to you and offered it but I feared disturbing sir’s cultivation.”
[Leech!]
The others wore bright smiles but thought the same thing in their minds, cursing his despicable behavior.
They were clueless that Zhao Chen had already seen through the map.
“Good, I’ll remember you.”
The elder looked skeptical as he stared Zhao Chen down, “Have you made any copies? I can give it to you to make one, as a memento.”
Zhao Chen shook his head, “Saint sir, you wound me. Since I offer you the map with all sincerity, I could never do such a thing. My only wish has been to serve Sacred Mountains. All our Eight Emperors’ duties are to maintain the world for Sacred Mountain, to let sirs reach higher enlightenment. How could we ever yearn for something like a Sovereign’s seat of enlightenment? I, of course, made no copies, ha-ha-ha.”
“You’re really not bad!”
The old man nodded and showed a weird smile, “Much better than your master, Zhuo Yifan, at least. That guy didn’t know his limit, trying and failing to rely on the Demon Sovereign’s legacy to rise above the Seven Sacred Mountains. But you, you never even thought about it, settling down instead.”
“Saint is most gracious.”
Zhao Chen bowed with a beaming smile.
[Humph, I never got the chance. Who the hell would want you hanging over them? Who among the Eight Emperors doesn’t want to stomp you under their heels?]
[It’s only a matter of time before I will, he-he-he…]
Zhuo Fan next to him had a dark look, recalling how a Saint came after his life and clenched his fists.
[Those bastards from the Seven Sacred Mountains rely on the world’s resources to seek Dao, but did they rise above its affairs? No! The Eight Emperors rule half of Sacred Domain, but they would never escape their control.]
[A bunch of fools who stand outside the secular world, but always think of it, are stuck unable to reach the Sovereign Stage, only wasting the Sacred Domain’s resources. Serves you right!]
[Any random mutt would’ve been flying if you’ve done it by now.]
[Speaking of those truly touching the cusp of Sovereign Stage, then all those seniors I brought from the mortal domain with their world of experience and focused solely on Dao have a better chance than you.]
[Fakers and posers got no chance!]

chapters.title: Chapter 1222 - 1222, Off on a Treasure Hunt
chapters.content:
Chapter 1222, Off on a Treasure Hunt
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
The old man placed the map in his ring, pointing out as he looked at the Emperors, “You all should take the Demonic Emperor’s example and be sincere. Understand what you can and can’t have, to not overstep your bounds in your schemes.”
“Yeah, yeah, sir is absolutely right, ha-ha-ha…”
Beaming and bobbing their heads, the Enchanting Empress and Sword Emperor felt their hearts sink, reporting, “Sir, we happened to get a copy from the Demonic Emperor, now resting in the Gambling Emperor’s care. We leave it at sir’s discretion.”
The old man grinned knowingly.
The Gambling Emperor’s heart froze and presented the copies with nothing but respect as absolute power demanded, “Here are their copies, sir.”
“Right.”
The old man huffed and took them, giving the papers but a glance, as he snickered, “You’ve been the first holder of the Nether Sea map, is there anything else you would like to add?”
The Gambling Emperor offered another white paper, “I had made another copy, sir.”
“Gambling Emperor, you’re the sharpest of the Eight Emperors. The Nether Sea map had been with you for so many years yet not one word went around that you had it…”
“I’m flattered, sir, but I meant not to hide it. It was to research it and find Nether Sea’s location, to offer it…”
The Gambling Emperor shivered under the old man’s stare as he explained himself, but the former cut him off, “That’s enough. I’m well aware what it’s on all of your minds. A word of advice, don’t be too smart for your own good. Your little games are known to Sacred Mountains. I’d rather avoid having you end up like the Demonic Emperor of old.”
The Eight Emperors lowered their heads in respect and fear. None could defy the Saints.
Zhuo Fan squinted and hatred burned inside.
“The matter is settled, you may go. I and He Xiaofeng have matters to discuss. Do keep in mind that there might be some changes among the Eight Emperors recently and you should have an idea about it.”
The old man’s remark had everyone looking grave at the implications.
[Changes in the Eight Emperors, does he mean someone will replace us?]
The people bowed and withdrew. He Xiaofeng recalled something and shouted, “Enchanting Empress, stay!”
The Enchanting Empress looked at the rest as she was the only one left with the two Saints, bowing, “How may I assist you, sir?”
“Enchanting Empress, you’re one of the Eight Emperors my father groomed.” He Xiaofeng hooked his finger, “Father trusts you the most. What of the matter you reported to father a hundred years ago?”
Enchanting Empress smiled and nodded, “Sir, Qingcheng is good.”
“Shouldn’t you arrange a meeting then?”
He Xiaofeng’s eyes shone, “You raised the girl for so long, so don’t you think it’s time for her to come with me to Sacred Mountains?”
“It’s too sudden!”
“Perhaps, the ancient records do say her refusal will complicate things.”
He Xiaofeng sighed, “My unique position and fear of arousing suspicion prevented me from bringing her into Sacred Mountains from the beginning. It would’ve been so much easier if we had just grown up together.”
Enchanting Empress nodded, with the old man smiling, “Xiaofeng, don’t worry, as the young lord of the 6th Sacred Mountain, capturing a girl’s attention can’t be easier. Am I right, Enchanting Empress?”
“Uh, yeah, ha-ha-ha…”
Enchanting Empress bobbed her head, feeling conflicted.
[That was before. Now the girl is only getting closer to another man. Maybe… no, it should work. That kid is nothing before the lofty young lord of Sacred Mountains!]
The seven Emperors left the hall and gathered around to brainstorm the reason behind keeping the Enchanting Empress. Sure, they all clashed on an average basis, with even having a war not a month ago, but before Sacred Mountains, they found a common ground to unite them and discuss their situation.
“What’s the Enchanting Empress’ connection with the two Saints? Why do they keep her back every time?”
“Who knows? The broad has a large circle of friends. When dealing with Zhuo Yifan, we were the only ones who knew about him. Even with our swift speed, somehow the Saints got wind of it a bit too fast. Something tells me that she was the one who leaked it.”
“Her? No way? With the coming of a Saint, none of us would get anything from the Nine Serenities Secret Records. Why would she do something that got her nothing instead?”
“What’s the point in bringing up the past? Now it’s what matters. Sacred Mountains said they want to reorganize the Eight Emperors. We need to consider our course…”
…
They went silent as they sighed. Zhuo Fan eavesdropped from the side, glancing at the closed hall’s doors.
[Those rotten broads are with the Sacred Mountains?]
“Regardless of Sacred Mountains intent for us, we have no power. Rather than shake in our boots over what might come, we should go home, meditate, and clean house.”
Zhao Chen spoke first, cupping his hands, “Goodbye!”
Zhuo Fan left with him. The others got curious. They knew the Demonic Emperor to be a powder keg ready to blow most of the time, so why was he so fine with how things turned out?
[Peculiar.]
The Gambling Emperor watched them go with a glimmer in his eyes, “Something must be up. Maybe they don’t care about Sacred Mountains’ decision? That just can’t be…”
A week later, Zhao Chen was back in his hall on Devil Mountain, alone with Zhuo Fan.
“Ha-ha-ha, Sacred Mountains? Once I find the Nether Sovereign’s seat of enlightenment and gain his legacy, they’ll be nothing! The age of a Sacred Domain dominated by Sacred Mountains is over. The time for my rule has come!
Zhao Chen said with excitement, “Steward Zhuo, gather the men at once, but only the most loyal, to go with me in search of Nether Sea!”
Zhuo Fan bowed and shook his head, “Sir, there’s no rush. The Saints have yet to leave. They might just be coming for us once we move.”
“Right, right, Steward Zhuo. With those bastards here, they’ll be sure to mess things up. I don’t want to end up like my master.”
Zhao Chen said, “Steward Zhuo, when should we act then?”
“We can take our time since no one can resolve Nether Sea’s riddle overnight. Waiting won’t change anything. Once the annoyances are gone, we can start then. In the meantime, sir is to be on your best behavior in looking after your lands to raise no suspicion.”
“Right, we’ll do as you say. Guard…”
Zhao Chen followed Zhuo Fan’s proposal and gave another thirty cities in the Luo clan’s care, besides the hundreds of rich lands and spiritual thick mountains.
The Luo clan became Devil Mountain’s number one figure. Everyone under the Demonic Emperor knew that the first Demon Guard by his side held half of Devil Mountain’s power. Zhuo Fan, the steward, was even more powerful, despite the lousy cultivation.
The Luo clan was outstanding as well, handling these new places with precision and honor. In only three months, the Demonic Emperor’s cities were transformed and lively, with all the efforts focused on their rightful administration.
To the point that the Saints looked impressed, leaving for Sacred Mountains with ease.
The moment they were gone, Zhao Chen’s ambition knew no rest, “Steward Zhuo, we can begin!”
“Let’s wait three more months, just in case.”
Zhuo Fan remarked, making the rash Zhao Chen fretful and anxious.
Zhuo Fan not just had the Demonic Emperor’s ear now, but even got him to listen. This was the devious and twisted methods of the great Zhuo Fan. Zhao Chen had a great adviser by his side and not listening now would only leave himself to blame when he lost everything.
Zhao Chen knew this as well, which was why he did not flatten him on the spot in a fit of rage like he did with all the other fools he had under him.
[Who’s the Demonic Emperor here, you or me?]
The three months passed quietly and Sacred Mountains showed no sign of moving. Zhao Chen’s limited patience was running out, “Steward Zhuo, now should be good!”
“Sir, let’s be off in search of Nether Sea!” Zhuo Fan nodded.
Zhao Chen was bouncing in joy, laughing like he already got the Nether Sovereign’s precious cultivation method.
Zhuo Fan smiled at his childish act, looking at the sky, “So peaceful, like the calm before the storm, ha-ha-ha…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1223 - 1223, Snatched
chapters.content:
Chapter 1223, Snatched
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Whoosh~
Figures landed in a thick forest, with Demonic Emperor Zhao Chen in the lead. Behind him was Bali Yuyu who brought Zhuo Fan, as well as a young lady that glanced about.
“Steward Zhuo, are you certain the entrance is around here?”
Zhao Chen asked Zhuo Fan, who glanced back at Shuang’er, “This is the place, right? We can’t make any mistake, it is Demonic Emperor’s great undertaking.”
“Big brother Zhuo, I recognize this place from the stars. It’s the right place.”
Shuang’er nodded with confidence, then she turned grave and squinted at the sun, “The death star changes based on the world revolutions and humanity. I need to be certain of its position today before I can say anymore. This shows the path to Nether Sea changes as well.”
Zhuo Fan nodded and said, “Demonic Emperor sir, leave it to Shuang’er. She will find the entrance!”
“The Luo clan is filled with talents. A young lady actually can read the stars, a true gem.” Zhao Chen sighed, “It’s my fortune to have the Luo clan come to serve under me.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Demonic Emperor sir is too kind. We have nothing but some strange skills from all walks of life. We still need sir’s guidance. I only hope that when sir soars, you would remember our efforts today and look after us. It’s my only wish.”
“Rest assured that I won’t ever forget you devotion, ha-ha-ha…”Zhao Chen laughed then stared at Shuang’er as she took two steps east, three steps west.
[This girl looks to know her stuff, but the wait is killing me.]
After a long and slow period, Shuang’er kept her constant pacing around the forest. As the sun set, she still wore a deep frown.
Zhao Chen was tense, thumping with her every step.
[Can she really do it?]
With no diviner in his ranks, he could only rely on her.
Shuang’er lit up and stood firm, “Found it. At the 128th degree of the ecliptic, the death star’s deviation, shifts the central palace and changes the world below. This is the place!”
Shuang’er stomped with confidence.
Zhuo Fan lit up and came to look.
“This is the Nether Sea entrance? But how do we get in?” Zhao Chen stared down at the grass and asked.
Zhuo Fan smiled, taking out hundreds of sacred stones and setting up an array, “Every secret path has to be connected to pocket space. This is the ancient Piercing Cloud Array and by finding the aright door, we can link the worlds and open the barrier to travel.”
“Ancient array?”
Zhao Chen eyed Zhuo Fan, “You know them? All are kept by Sacred Mountains, how…”
Zhuo Fan smirked, “Clan legacy, but only a couple and not stockpiled like Sacred Mountains, he-he-he…”
“Sir, let’s hurry and open the door, the Nether Sea is right ahead!”
Zhuo Fan rushed Zhao Chen, egging him on. With Nether Sea, Zhao Chen forwent Zhuo Fan’s suspicion, overtaken by excitement.
Zhuo Fan made signs:
“The gates of the Abyss open wide,
Spirits and souls stay on the other side.
For the path of the Nether Sovereign I stride,
Follow me, my comrades, with courage as our guide!”
Hum~
The array flared to life with blinding lights before a beam of light shot into the sky, connecting with a bright star high above.
Shuang’er cried, “It’s the death start! This is the way! The Nether Sovereign used the death star to seal it. To open it you must pass through the death star as well, then enter the Nether Sea. It’s just like the map said!”
“Then I’ll go to Nether Sea for Nether Sovereign’s cultivation method.”
Zhao Chen shouted in excitement, “It’s providence! Heaven wants me Sovereign, ha-ha-ha…”
A creepy laugher came just as his reached the peak, “Ha-ha-ha, Demonic Emperor, you really did crack the Nether Sea map. You didn’t let me down, waiting for half a year.”
“Who said that?”
Zhao Chen shouted and grimaced as he looked back at the familiar fat man, “Brother Demonic Emperor, what I couldn’t do in decades, you did it in just a year. You have my respect.”
“Gambling Emperor!”
Zhao Chen ground his teeth, “What are you doing here? Did someone leak it?”
“There was no need, for I planned on watching anyone who had the map from the moment I threw it away.”
“But I gave it up. Why are you still stalking us?”
“True, you did give it up, but your acting was too obvious something was up.”
The Gambling Emperor snickered, “All of Sacred Domain knows of your boiling rage and temper. You just got the map then forced to hand it over soon after yet you were more than happy to? Something’s just isn’t right here. Then when we left the hall, you ran away on the spot, becoming even more suspicious. Sure, the possibility of cracking the map was highly improbable, but I still tailed you this half a year every minute on the hour. Lo and behold, you haven’t let me down, finding the entrance. Demonic Emperor, thank you for that, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhao Chen balled his fists, his eyes spitting fire.
He toiled to find this place only to let others take it?
Zhuo Fan watched in silence, snickering in his mind. He long noticed the Gambling Emperor’s gaze and merely omitted mentioning it.
That was why he leaked the truth of the map to Zhao Chen when news of Saints appearing came. Zhao Chen would then hand over the map and draw attention with his weird behavior, all to fan the flames of conflict.
[The five Emperor war ended up a bust, but now you’ll be sure to fight to the death. There’s but one Nether Sovereign legacy and you must keep it a secret as well.]
[Now fight and kill for your survival and future!]
Zhuo Fan sneered inside.
The two were about to do just that when a proudfull voice came, “Oh, Demonic Emperor, Gambling Emperor, you guys found the entrance and plan on having it all to yourself? We did have a deal, no, so shouldn’t you share it with the Ruby Cloud Sect as well?”
“Enchanting Empress?”
The two whipped their heads back.
Whoosh~
The Enchanting Empress brought a dozen disciples with her as she floated down with a smirk.
The two huffed, with Demonic Emperor demanding, “Gambling Emperor, this broad has a loose tongue. Let’s just deal with her first then settle the Nether Sea afterward?”
“It’s always best to lower the shares. Agreed!”
The Gambling Emperor gave a cold smile, ready to kill. The Demonic Emperor took a step forward, his eyes cold.
The Enchanting Empress mocked them, “You two are so cruel, and we even worked together too. Gambling Emperor, weren’t you always fair? Now you two are ganging up on a poor frail soul?”
“There’s no ganging, but you’re just too meddlesome!”
Zhao Chen leaked black energy, “I gave you the copy that you ended up handing over. All cooperation between us is gone!”
“Since this isn’t the gambling table, there’s no room for honor.” Gambling Emperor sneered.
The Enchanting Empress smirked, “I knew you weren’t going to be fair, so I brought someone who would. You won’t get rid of me that easily.”
The two grimaced, their hearts sank.
[The hag brought help? Who? The Sword Emperor is…]
“Hey, punk, are you still having that idiotic dream of taking my junior sister? Well time to smell the roses, for she already has a man!”
Fang Min came up to mock Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan frowned.
Two familiar figures appeared just then. One was Chu Qingcheng and the other was the young Saint, He Xiaofeng.
His hand was snaked around Chu Qingcheng’s waist as he floated down with a grin.
[Curses, my wife’s been snatched after half a year of not seeing each other?]
Zhuo Fan shuddered, balling his fists.
Zhao Chen and the Gambling Emperor panicked, “Y-you didn’t return, Saint?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1224 - 1224, Death’s Entrance
chapters.content:
Chapter 1224, Death’s Entrance
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Like a match made in heaven, they deigned the world with their presence as He Xiaofeng sneered. Chu Qingcheng looked away, unable to meet Zhuo Fan’s eyes. He Xiaofeng had her soft hands gripped in a vice, preventing her from moving away.
[Rotten lowlife!]
Zhuo Fan grimaced, feeling like decking the bastard. But he recalled the bigger picture and reined in his anger.
He’d get his chance sooner or later.
[This isn’t over.]
“You don’t look too pleased to see me, ha-ha-ha…”
The two landed and He Xiaofeng mocked them as he said, “I’ve been staying over at the Ruby Cloud Sect for a few days. Finding Miss Qingcheng so charming, I had my senior uncle return. Are you perhaps against my coming?”
The two bowed at once, “Never!”
“Then let’s return to the matter at hand, shall we?”
He Xiaofeng looked at the light pillar, “Demonic Emperor, Gambling Emperor, who can explain what exactly you are doing here? What is this?”
[Pompous bastard!]
They had no choice but to bow, with the Demonic Emperor beginning, “Saint, I found that offering the map to Sacred Mountains was not enough to show my devotion, therefore I spent the last six months pondering hard before I found the Nether Sea entrance. I was only thinking of taking the lead in removing any dangers that might appear, paving the way for you.”
“Oh, you cracked it without the map? Demonic Emperor, I tip my hat towards you.” He Xiaofeng’s tone dripped with sarcasm.
Zhao Chen continued, “It’s because of my deep devotion to Sacred Mountains, my endless pursuit to work for them that gave me the courage and blessing to help you. My meager mind could have never come up with the solution otherwise, ha-ha-ha…”
“Good boy, toadie.”
He Xiaofeng sneered, “You’re the last disciple of your master, no? I never got to see him, but I heard that the Demonic Emperor of old was arrogant even against Saints, always so self-important. How did he even get a disciple like you?”
Zhao Chen winced then shook his head, “That’s why he died. I want to live, so I would never betray the Saints’ kindness.”
The Enchanting Empress sank in thought as well.
Unlike the staunch Demonic Emperor old, this one had no backbone, becoming someone’s dog. But were they any different?
They turned into dogs much sooner, perhaps, with only Zhuo Yifan remaining firm in his stance.
The Enchanting Empress and Gambling Emperor lowered their heads. Zhuo Fan squinted and sighed.
Coming back to Sacred Domain, the only thing he feared was theHeavenly Sovereign finding him out. His main purpose was to find Qingcheng, but it wasn’t his true reason for coming back.
Providence worked in mysterious ways. Maybe he had returned only to finish what Zhuo Yifan had started.
“Looking at you so meek, I guess I’ll believe you for now.”
He Xiaofeng sneered at his dog, turning to the light pillar, “This is the Nether Sea entrance? How do we go in?”
The Demonic Emperor bowed, “We don’t know. We’ve been trying to figure out when sir came.”
“So then do you have any idea?”
The two shook their heads. Gambling Emperor proposed, “The entrance might be a teleportation array, taking us to Nether Sea.”
“Oh, care to test that theory, Gambling Emperor?”
“Me?”
“Yes, you.”
“No, Saint, better leave it to our men, just in case…”
“I told you to go and you refuse?” He Xiaofeng barked, “The Eight Emperors are the next strongest here, beside me. If you’re alright, then I’ll be fine. If you’re in trouble, I’ll be cautious.”
[Curse you, using me as your guinea pig!]
The Gambling Emperor’s face sank as he resigned himself. He walked to the light. It might be fine, but it could also kill him.
He still had to go either way.
The Gambling Emperor walked in, with hesitation and anxiety.
Light enveloped him and he found everything to be fine. He looked around to find himself in the same place.
[Eh, what’s going on here?]
He Xiaofeng shouted, “Gambling Emperor, did you find anything? Can you see the way in?”
“No, there’s no difference from outside, only a bit stiffer.”
The Gambling Emperor shook his head with a frown. Moving his limbs, cracks echoed, like something snapped.
A fading glow then fell from the star above and then hit his body.
The Gambling Emperor’s fine hair turned white just then, his fat body shriveled as wrinkles appeared on his face.
The Gambling Emperor panicked and rushed to leave, but just as he raised a leg, he crumbled to dust. Even his clothes were disintegrated.
Sss~
Everyone gasped, even He Xiaofeng.
He aged and died in mere moments, under their very eyes.
Gulp.
Everyone felt their skin crawl. He Xiaofeng shook as he glared at Zhao Chen, “Demonic Emperor, what the hell is this? Are you positive this is the Nether Sea entrance?”
“Saint, I am. Passing through must be done through a test, I fear.”
Zhao Chen looked at Zhuo Fan, “Steward Zhuo, what is this? Why did he turn to dust just by stepping in?”
Zhuo Fan pondered with a grave look.
Shuang’er lit up and pointed at the star above, “It’s the death star. It would unleash its death energy on any that want to enter the Nether Sea, taking their lives. Because there was so much of it, seeping into his bones, he died as if he aged thousands of years, even rotting his bones.”
“Even the entrance has a test?”
He Xiaofeng nodded and said coldly, “The Nether Sovereign’s seat of enlightenment must be amazing indeed. Not just anyone can enter.”
He Xiaofeng took out the original map and recited:
“In Nether Sea’s depth, the endless hell,
Where lost souls roam, their fate foretold.
Who dares to tread upon our shore,
Shall be condemned to suffer more,
With mortal eyes forever blind,
In the abyss, their souls confined!
This is clearly a warning. No man can step into the Nether Sovereign’s seat of enlightenment, lest they die. Even finding the Nether Sea entrance was pointless, since one just dies in the end. Since we can’t go in, forget it.”
He Xiaofeng sighed and looked at the light beam with desire.
The rest shook their heads.
The Nether Sovereign’s legacy was taunting them, but life was more important. Without it, the legacy was moot.
“Wait!”
Zhuo Fan shouted, his eyes shining, “Maybe there is a way!”
“You know how?” He Xiaofeng sneered, “The Nether Sea killed an Emperor and even I don’t dare step in, but a puny Bone Tempering cultivator has what it takes? Die then, humph!”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “The Nether Sovereign is an ancient Sovereign, so not anyone could just enter into his seat of enlightenment. One needs his guidance to pry into the mysteries of the world and enter.”
“His guidance? What is that?” He Xiaofeng started.
Zhuo Fan pointed at the map, “Didn’t you just read it?”
“This is a warning for no one to enter!”
“A true warrior does not balk in the face of absolute death. You see it as a warning, while I see it as an invitation.”
Zhuo Fan grinned, “Nether Sovereign showed us the way inside.”
[What?!]
They all stared at Zhuo Fan in disbelief.
[Where does it say that? There’s no mention of it at all…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1225 - 1225, Roaming Lost Soul
chapters.content:
Chapter 1225, Roaming Lost Soul
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Zhuo Fan said, “The Nether Sovereign said in his guiding poem that lost souls may roam in the Nether Sea, lest they will be destroyed on sight. That’s why the Gambling Emperor had such a grizzly death.”
Everyone nodded.
“You mean to say only the dead can enter?”
He Xiaofeng rose an eyebrow, “Once you’re dead, what’s the point?”
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “The Nether Sovereign says that a living body can’t enter, or they die, not that entering means death. The roaming lost soul part means renouncing the flesh so you may drift towards the Nether Sea.”
“Renounce the body? What do you mean?”
“It points at the soul, leaving the body behind so you may enter.” Zhuo Fan spoke firmly.
Everyone hesitated. That was just too dangerous. A mistake from Zhuo Fan’s part meant they would all die!
He Xiaofeng was grave as he pointed at Zhuo Fan, “Is that your idea? Then go test it.”
“Test it yourself!” Bali Yuyu growled from behind in anger, Zhuo Fan tried to stop her.
Zhuo Fan had a cruel smile, “Sorry, but one needs to be at Ethereal Stage at the least to wander as a soul. I’m in the Bone Tempering Stage and can’t do it, ha-ha-ha…”
“Then you go!”
Humph snapped at Bali Yuyu, “Since you talk too much, you’ll go instead!”
Bali Yuyu was ready to blow. The only thing keeping her from snapping his neck was that he had power beyond her imagination.
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Fine, I’ll go myself. Yuyu, stand back.”
“Isn’t it impossible for you?”
“I just realized our clan’s secret art and can soul drift even at Bone Tempering Stage.” Zhuo Fan showed an evil grin, “It’s all thanks to the Saint’s reminder, or I would’ve completely forgotten about it.”
He Xiaofeng sneered, “Then go already. Use actions to prove your undying gratitude for yours truly.”
“I shall pave sir’s way!” Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth and showed a dark smile.
He then sat down to pop out his soul.
Bali Yuyu started, “Wait, I’ll go instead!”
“No, it’s fine. You and Shuang’er can wait outside and look after my body.” Zhuo Fan spoke and turned to the light pillar withp uncertainty.
It was just a guess he had about the poem, nothing more. He either nailed it, or his soul would get nailed.
He could only gamble.
Any other nobody could’ve done this job, but the Saint was clearly singling him out to get rid of him. Refusing would just give an excuse to kill him.
Since he gambled, let providence decide.
[Let’s hope luck’s with me and I don’t end up like the Gambling Emperor.]
Zhuo Fan grew stern and he closed his eyes. A faint image floated out of his head, drifting for the light pillar.
The others forgot to breathe while watching him test his theory. If a Bone Tempering soul had no trouble passing, then it had to be safe.
If the soul popped, then they would just think of another way.
Everyone was tense and on edge, some over the outcome, others for Zhuo Fan’s safety.
Chu Qingcheng was worried for Zhuo Fan’s soul as it ventured near danger. But with He Xiaofeng holding her back, she could do nothing.
“Hurry up and enter…” He Xiaofeng was impatient from excitement, even easing Chu Qingcheng’s hand.
Chu Qingcheng yanked it out of his grip and sat down. Another faint image appeared over her head and she shot for the pillar, “Zhuo Fan, wait, I’ll try!”
Zhuo Fan blinked as an image shot by him into the light.
Only then did he realize, “Qingcheng, don’t…”
He also went in.
Whoosh~
Both of them ended up entering at the same time, causing the Enchanting Empress to shout, “Qingcheng!”
They were beyond saving now. No one went in after them either, only staring at the light pillar.
Hum~
A wave of power shot out as the pillar joined with the heavens. The death star shone above and the two souls inside floated higher towards it, gone in an instant.
“The souls survived and teleported!”
Zhao Chen cheered, “Steward Zhuo’s theory is right. You need to let go of your body to enter the Nether Sea. Ha-ha-ha, Steward Zhuo is a genius indeed to solve this riddle. Now we can venture safely inside the Nether Sea.”
Bali Yuyu nodded, relieved.
She cared not about the Nether Sea, but for Zhuo Fan.
The Enchanting Empress and the girls were excited, “Saint, there’s no problem and we can go in.”
“Right.”
He Xiaofeng was thrilled, then he regarded the Demonic Emperor’s group, “Demonic Emperor, walk with me. Enchanting Empress, you stay behind and look after my body.”
Ugh!
The Enchanting Empress panicked, “But, young master He, why let them join you? I also want to go to the Nether Sea…”
“Enchanting Empress!”
He Xiaofeng shouted, sending her, “You belong to my father and I trust you the most. The Demonic Emperor is too devious. I’m taking him along to watch out for his tricks. You stay behind and look after his people and stop them from doing anything. This is the safest solution. Don’t betray my father’s trust in you!”
The Enchanting Empress nodded, “Young master thinks of everything.”
“And that Zhuo Fan…”
He Xiaofeng’s eyes flashed with murder, “You’re right, Qingcheng cares for him, running into danger for him. If he survives, it would only hold Qingcheng back. Even if a mere Bone Tempering cultivator…”
“Sir wants to…”
“I’ll take his life inside the Nether Sea.”
“No, no!”
The Enchanting Empress advised, “Killing the person Qingcheng cares about and you may never get her heart. Qingcheng needs to be devoted to you for your plan…”
“I know her heart is more important than her man. I’m not that impulsive.”
He Xiaofeng gave an annoyed wave, “Humph, but with the Nether Sea so deadly, he might come upon a little accident. All that remains is for Qingcheng to never find out about it.”
The Enchanting Empress nodded, “I’ll leave it to young master He. Just be sure to hide it.”
“You think I don’t know that?”
He Xiaofeng huffed, then his soul came out before everyone, “Demonic Emperor, hurry up and join me!”
Zhao Chen figured out his intent and gave Bali Yuyu a look to get ready for anything, before letting out his soul and following He Xiaofeng.
The two entered the light pillar and vanished.
The two groups looked after the bodies…
Two light pillars shone down and faded to reveal two people, a man and a woman. Looking at herself and finding she was solid, Chu Qingcheng started, “We can enter with our bodies? I thought only souls could enter. Did you know my soul is a white lotus? I thought you wouldn’t recognize me.”
“We’re in yin bodies, probably because we’re in the Nether Sovereign’s seat of enlightenment.”
Zhuo Fan came before her and sighed, “Silly girl, why did you risk yourself for me? If my theory was wrong, you’d have died.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1226 - 1226, Crossing the Sea
chapters.content:
Chapter 1226, Crossing the Sea
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Chu Qingcheng lowered her head, flustered, “I wasn’t thinking, driven to take on any danger in your stead. As for the consequences, it didn’t matter even if I died.”
“Ha-ha-ha, you haven’t changed at all.”
Hugging her, Zhuo Fan rubbed her back with a smile.
Chu Qingcheng leaned on his shoulder, her heart content to just lay there in his arms. She then cried with a start, “Don’t misunderstand…”
“Misunderstand what?” Zhuo Fan gave her an odd look.
Chu Qingcheng turned bashful, “T-that He Xiaofeng. I don’t know why a Saint, having just come to the Ruby Cloud Sect, up and started coming on to me. I did tell him that I h-have…”
“Have someone?”
Chu Qingcheng stammered, her cheeks growing hotter, and Zhuo Fan teased.
Chu Qingcheng just gave a meek nod, but then she turned sad, “That guy just keeps coming on strong, ignoring my feelings, even pestering me every day. Like just now, he just wouldn’t let me go once he grabbed me and I just happened to meet you here. So I’m saying not to misunderstand. There’s nothing between us.”
“I know.”
Caressing her hair, Zhuo Fan smiled, “Like I said, you’re mine, but not in the sense of possession. I always believe you felt the same way about me. That’s why I never doubted for a moment, nor misunderstood. You have nothing to explain.”
Not expecting him to say that, Chu Qingcheng was filled with warmth, then she hugged him tighter with a gratified smile, “Zhuo Fan, thank you.”
“It’s only natural.”
Zhuo Fan patted her back, feeling bloodthirst creeping in from inside.
[That Saint definitely has something planned to be so obsessed with Qingcheng. Is he after that thing?]
With his Saintly power, killing him on the outside was impossible without leaving a trail. While in the Nether Sea, who would know?
He squinted, his eyes shining with coldness.
He Xiaofeng would never think the same bug he wanted to squash in the dangerous Nether Sea was having the same plan for him.
He was sure to crack up if he knew.
[A Bone Tempering cultivator kill a Saint? Ha! I can just sit there and take it yet still he couldn’t scratch me.]
This bug he was after though, had a bite like no other…
“I didn’t know that the Nether Sea became a love nest.”
An aged voice sighed, his words coming in waves.
The two jumped, watching as an old man was walking on the beach with a bamboo basket on his back.
Despite his low voice, the two still heard him loud and clear.
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, “That’s strange. I didn’t know anyone lived here.”
“The Nether Sea is roamed by lost souls. There are no people here, but souls!” The old man’s ears twitched and looked at him with an amiable smile, “Or are you two people?”
Chu Qingcheng stuck her chin out, “Of course.”
“People have bodies to house their souls, making it impossible to come here. Here are only lost souls, be it of spiritual beasts or humans; not souls exactly, but ghosts.”
The old man smirked, “You just don’t realize you’re dead yet. The souls of the dead from gruesome battles or from detonations are fragmented, slowly pieced together in the Nether Sea. With that state comes loss of memories as well. In time, they will come back though, no rush, ha-ha-ha.”
Zhuo Fan mulled his words.
[So even detonation doesn’t erase you, recovering your soul in the Nether Sea?]
He asked, “Senior, do all who had their soul scattered can reform here?”
“Not always. The Nether Sea isn’t infinite and can only hold so many roaming souls. It’s all up to fate.” The old man shook his head and smiled, “The fortunate fragmented souls coming here have but a glimmer of hope at survival and reincarnation. The Nether Sea is under the Nether Sovereign’s control. He can save some, but never all. The nature of all living beings is to perish, while reincarnation is earned. The dead should not feel resentment, for that’s how it is.”
The two nodded.
[Yes, living brings many trials that borne resentment. Does the Nether Sovereign’s seat of enlightenment wash away this resentment?]
[Rumor has it that the Nether Sovereign controls life and death, becoming feared like the King of Hell. Maybe, he is actually a man capable of great compassion or love instead.]
“How did you two kids die? If you want to cross the sea, I can give you a ride.” The old man smiled.
“Cross the Nether Sea?” Zhuo Fan started.
The old man nodded, “Cross the Nether Sea to shed all mortal concerns. You have to let go of everything from the living realm and pass the Nether Sea to have a chance at reincarnation.”
“Let go?
“Memories, feelings, love, friendship, hate, anger, revenge, greed, everything.”
“Are there any unwilling to cross?”
“There are plenty of those, staying here, in the Nether Sea. Many couples just like you were around that ended up food for the sea beasts to absorb their souls’ energy.”
“Does that mean crossing get us reborn?”
“Crossing takes a whole month, time in which you shed everything from the past into its waters, for the chance at being reborn. Once you reached the other shore, any vestige of the past that you clung to as you crossed would result in your soul vanishing from the Nether Sea. Scarce are those truly worthy of being reborn.”
The Nether Sea was a just a transit hub, where one shed their past life. By letting go of everything one would begin anew, a clean slate. This was why no one remembered their past life.
Zhuo Fan thought something.
[True Self Art?]
[Maybe True Self Art’s core is to let go?]
Zhuo Fan felt his heart thumping.
The old man shouted, “Hey, do you cross or not? Staying here would let the thick yin of the Nether Sea eat your souls and wasting such a rare chance you got.”
“Senior, we’re not ghosts, but looking for Nether Sovereign’s seat of enlightenment.”
“You came here with your souls?”
“Precisely!”
“Sigh, you just had to come to this hellish place.” The old man pointed at the endless sea, “It’s been ages since I’ve last seen living souls. Now there are greedy people practically dying to come here. To get to the Nether Sovereign’s seat of enlightenment, you must pass this area. Not only do countless sea beast ghosts await you there but also three trials before you reach it. Many brave men died on this path. I can’t believe such a sweet couple would harbor such greed as well. To what end? Aren’t you together now?”
“There’s been many others here before us?”
“You thought you’re the only one clever enough to solve the puzzle since ancient times?” The old man nodded, “One needs to have the brains and the bravery to solve the Nether Sovereign’s riddle as well. Despite all that, there hasn’t been one person who returned. Why then, ha-ha-ha, must you go as well?”
Ugh!
Chu Qingcheng’s heart tense, looking at the old man with a warm smile, “Hey, senior, we changed our minds. We won’t go to the Nether Sovereign’s seat of enlightenment, but want to return. How do we do that?”
“Humph, now you want to go back? A little late for that.”
The old man pointed at the shore, “It’s hard coming in and harder coming out. You need to cross Nether Sovereign’s seat of enlightenment to return, or forever stay here until death!”
“You mean cross the Nether Sea and its three trials?”
“Yes, you asked for this, didn’t you? So don’t blame me.” The old man patronized.
Zhuo Fan smiled, turning to a bitter Chu Qingcheng, “It’s fine. As long as we’re together, nothing else matters. We’ve been through this before, haven’t we?”
“Right.”
Chu Qingcheng nodded, greatly motivated, and said to the elder, “Can you help us cross the sea, to Nether Sovereign’s seat of… where’d he go?”
The old man was gone.
His voice came of faintly, “I only cross ghosts, never bothering with those fated to come here. If heaven wills it, we’ll meet again, ha-ha-ha…”
His sharp laughter echoed everywhere, but he was nowhere to be found…

chapters.title: Chapter 1227 - 1227, First Trial
chapters.content:
Chapter 1227, First Trial
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Senior, are you ignoring us?”
Chu Qingcheng cried at nothing, with silence her only reply. Zhuo Fan shrugged, “He crosses the dead, not the living. He’ll just take us when we breathe our last, ha-ha-ha…”
“What else can I expect from a creep. I don’t need his help anyway.”
“Why, you’d have a chance to be reborn.”
“That means living another life and forgetting everyone. Master, senior aunts, senior sisters, and…” Chu Qingcheng paused, peeking at Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan smiled, “Then we better make sure we live through it.”
“Right.”
Chu Qingcheng nodded with conviction. Zhuo Fan took her flying towards the raging sea, vanishing in the distance.
As this was Nether Sovereign’s seat of enlightenment, testing them was a given, but it didn’t seem to limit their strength either. Except for their earthly vessels, they maintained all their power.
Chu Qingcheng didn’t know this little tidbit, looking oddly at him flying, “You can actually fly here?”
“Uh, maybe the Nether Sea has something to do with it, making me feel so light. There’s no way I could fly outside, that would make me a ghost, ha-ha-ha…” Chu Qingcheng flew along, no longer minding it.
A roar boomed with relentless force as a flood dragon shot from the sea and sent water everywhere as it went to swallow the two of them in its maw.
All they noticed was how everything went black the next second, already in its belly.
It then went beneath the surface once more and swam without a care. The other sea beasts knew to stay clear.
As it cruised, the flood dragon halted all of a sudden and writhed in pain.
Bam!
The sea exploded as the flood dragon’s black got ripped off from inside and black flames shot out from the wound after turning its insides to charcoal.
Zhuo Fan took Chu Qingcheng outside, his eyes flaring in a dark black flame.
Chu Qingcheng cried, “Zhuo Fan, you’re amazing! That was a 10th level spiritual beast yet you just came out of it like nothing. How did you do that? And what was that black fire?”
“Maybe turning into a soul made me stronger.” Zhuo Fan gave a sheepish smile, “I certainly have no clue.”
Chu Qingcheng gave him a long look, but let it go in the end. Just that this Bone Tempering cultivator got stronger and could even fly after coming to the Nether Sea.
[Turning into a ghost makes you stronger? Why not me as well?]
Roar~!
Roars came after noticing the commotion here and the Nether Sea boiled. A flood of spiritual beasts scrambled over, each a thousand meters long, all surrounding the two tiny human souls.
Chu Qingcheng watched the beasts she only witnessed in the sect’s paintings and paled with fright, “Z-Zhuo Fan, they’re all 12th level spiritual beasts, peak of the Sacred Domain. W-we’re doomed!”
“Come now, even with these high level beasts, they’re nothing but ghosts now. They lack the power they had when they were alive.”
Zhuo Fan calculated, confident that the apocalyptic thunderflame and his sacred beast powers could take them.
Zhuo Fan’s left eye flared blue and the black thunderflame emerged. Before it even reached them, the beasts howled in agony, lowering their heads before Zhuo Fan.
“Lord Sea Ao’s envoy, we didn’t think to meet you here. I hope sir can overlook the flood dragon’s transgression.”
“Please forgive us!”
The rest lowered their heads as well.
Chu Qingcheng started dumbstruck.
[Sea Ao? What’s that?]
Zhuo Fan felt his left eye, coming up with an idea why. The thunderflame could deal with them but not command them into submission. They were only bowing their heads towards Sea Ao’s eye.
[Why didn’t it ever occur to me that Heaven Sealing Sea Ao was a lord of the seas? It’s obvious now the sea beasts would listen to him, but…]
“You’re all dead and have come to Nether Sea, yet still listen to Lord Sea Ao?”
“We are sea beasts. Lord Sea Ao is our primogenitor. Where might Lord Sea Ao be right now? Is he alive…”
The beast did not finish, fearing for their lord’s fate.
Zhuo Fan coughed, “Lord Sea Ao is alive and well. It happened that when I trained in a deadly fire and got out of control, Lord Sea Ao offered his wounded eye to save my life. Lord Sea Ao is my savior.”
“Oh, that means his malice towards humans has subsided, good. We’ve been by ourselves in worry lord would be forever taken in by hatred. For lord to give his eye to save sir’s life proves lord’s approval of sir. A pity you are in the Nether Sea now and must have met with disaster. Could we be of any help?”
“We seek the Nether Sovereign’s seat of enlightenment. Could you take us to it?” Zhuo Fan asked.
The beasts were put on the spot, “You need to pass the trials to reach it first. We’ve been charged with blocking you but since lord cares so much of sir, we will no longer stop you. As for reaching the Nether Sovereign’s place so easily, it’s impossible. We can’t pass the three gates.”
“Then guide us there and I’ll do the rest.”
“Sir, forgive our presumptuous words but the guardians are incredibly strong. Going there is dangerous…”
“I’m a soul now, so how much worse can it get? I either go or die.”
The beasts shared a look and nodded, “Then please jump on my back, sir, I’ll take you.”
“Much obliged!”
Zhuo Fan smirked and took Chu Qingcheng on the back of the 12th level sea beast. It waded forth like an emperor, with the other beasts acting as its imperial guards. The average beasts had no idea what caused such a group to go out with such ferocity. They made the wise decision to turn tail and scram for their lives.
Chu Qingcheng and Zhuo Fan stood on the back of the beast, side by side. It was astonishing to see all the beasts around them showing nothing but respect to those two humans. She was so startled that she gave Zhuo Fan a long look.
Outside, he looked like a Bone Tempering cultivator with some status that offered some incredible assistance. Now, however, he looked like the king of the world.
[Which is the real him?]
[Is he more suited as a ghost than a human? An all-powerful King of Hell maybe?]
Chu Qingcheng was in constant confusion.
The clamoring procession of beasts went on. Behind them, an aged figure floated, “Heh, everyone has a hard time coming out of the first trial bruised and weary from those sea beasts’ harassment, but this kid had them show the way. Humph, might it be… him?”
An hour later, the couple arrived before a large gate, the two pillars a deep red and hundreds of meters tall. They towered inside the sea, yet they still shone in a terrifying glow.
The huge sea beast slowed down, turning to them, “Sir, we’ve arrived at the first pass, Tyrant Gate.”
“Oh?”
Zhuo Fan casually jumped off with Chu Qingcheng, looking at the huge gate, “Does the test expect us to push it?”
The sea beast nodded, “Yes, Tyrant Gate requires boundless strength to open. Only by opening can you meet the guardian and it’s the minimum requirement to face him. Many others got stuck before this gate, even Saints.”
Sss~
Chu Qingcheng gasped in worry.
“Don’t worry, those Saints had to deal with the sea beasts while opening the gate so of course they couldn’t manage. We’re safe now and can go all out.”
Zhuo Fan consoled her and walked up to the gate to give it a push.
It creaked but didn’t budge.
Zhuo Fan nodded.
[It sure is heavy. I’ll need to use everything I have or I can’t even push it a crack.]
Zhuo Fan closed his eyes and reached out his hands, with his right shining red.
To open the gate, using Qilin power was a must.
Despite a soul, his connection to his body was still there and he could borrow Qilin’s strength, just as he borrowed the Apocalyptic Thunderflame Eye’s fire…

chapters.title: Chapter 1228 - 1228, Guardian
chapters.content:
Chapter 1228, Guardian
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Hum~
Outside of the Nether Sea, Zhuo Fan sat cross-legged near a pillar of light. His right hand began to shone a bright red, making the air shimmer around him.
The Enchanting Empress looked on curiously. Bali Yuyu and Shuang’er turned grave.
“It’s strange how he keeps swaying and shaking. Did something bad happen inside?” Bali Yuyu whispered to Shuang’er, “I’m going in to help. Watch over him.”
Giving the Enchanting Empress a cautious look, Shuang’er nodded.
Bali Yuyu sat down and a shadow came out of her body, shooting into the pillar and up toward the Nether Sea in a blink…
On the seabed of Nether Sea, before the Tyrant Gate, Zhuo Fan’s right hand shone a bright red as he slammed his palm on the heavy door with extreme focus.
The water churned under the power for a thousand miles. Waves reached higher and higher, with fierce winds blowing over the sea’s surface. Many of the caverns deep below the surface up and crumbled under such magnitude.
The low sea beasts scattered in fright, running for their lives.
The huge gate, however, didn’t even budge.
Zhuo Fan gave the huge slabs of stone a look and his eyes hardened. Setting into a stance, his right shone even stronger as he gave his all. Even on the bottom of the icy Nether Sea, he was actually sweating.
Despite his efforts, the gate would not open, not even a crack.
Chu Qingcheng was restless, wanting to lend a hand. But her frail body, even in Genesis Stage, was like a feather against such a mountain of rock.
Hu~
Zhuo Fan was spent, huffing hard as he gave up opening it. Wiping his brow, he said, “Never mind, with the gate so thick, strength just isn’t enough to move it.”
“What do we do now?”
Chu Qingcheng asked Zhuo Fan, “Since we can’t even pass the first trial, do we go back?”
Zhuo Fan grinned, “The Nether Sovereign set up this trial, but since opening won’t work, avoiding the problem altogether should do the trick.”
“Trick?”
“Yeah!”
Zhuo Fan smirked, staring at the huge gate, his right eye shone with black flames, “Apocalyptic Thunderflame Eye!”
Boom!
With a huge explosion, black flames shot at the huge gate and burned a two meter tall hole in it. Like a mouse making its own way in another’s home.
The sea beasts started and looked at Zhuo Fan with amazement.
[Lord Sea Ao chose an outstanding human. This gate has never been opened, until now. But what will the guardian think of this method?]
A 12th level sea beast sighed, speaking earnestly, “Sir, inside is the guardian. You are the first person to see him, best of luck.”
“Thank you!”
Zhuo Fan cupped his hands at the spiritual beasts, taking the stumped Chu Qingcheng’s hand and going inside.
The spiritual beasts got rowdy as they left, “Shouldn’t the first gate be pushed open to pass it? Will this method work?”
“Regardless of fairness, it’s up to the guardian to decide.”
The leading spiritual beast sighed, “I just can’t believe someone can actually make a hole in it. Is it that ridiculously easy to break? When I reached it, I slammed into it until I was battered yet still couldn’t even crack it. Now, ha-ha, Lord Sea Ao’s envoy is truly amazing…”
The other spiritual beasts bobbed their heads.
Their admiration was short, for a howl came from the burned hole, “You have some nerve making a hole in my gate! You broke the rules and now you shall pay!”
Ugh!
The spiritual beasts looked worried.
[Guess it wasn’t fair after all. Sir will have an even harder time passing through here now…]
In an empty and large hall, the only decoration was a rotten chair. A scowling and built man sat on it, looking to be in his forties, having a beard and mustache. His deep eyes were filled with wrath as he snapped at the two people in front.
Chu Qingcheng jumped in fright, with Zhuo Fan cupping his hands, “Senior, we’ve come to pass the trial, but not for the Nether Sovereign’s treasures or legacy, only to live. You have your problem and I have my solution. By passing that gate and reaching you means being halfway to solving it. Why do the means matter?”
“I don’t want to care either. If you had done it in a more honorable way, then passing me would’ve been easier.”
Then the large man showed a vague smile, “Only you did it through a trick, making passing me as well that much harder. Sometimes, using tricks to solve your problems is the worst choice, especially in serious matters. Do you understand?”
Zhuo Fan shook, hearing him but not being able to understand. So he cupped his hands again, “Senior, how then are we to pass you?”
“Beat me.”
“What?”
The big man snickered at the two, “If you had pushed the gate open, beating me would’ve been easy, while now, ha-ha-ha…”
“What about now?”
Zhuo Fan shouted, “Enlighten me, senior!”
Zhuo Fan shot for him, on the offensive, with his Qilin arm shining brightly.
Only to find himself flung back, repelled by some force, flipping through the air many times. The big man still sat on his chair with a taunting gaze, two fingers outstretched.
[How is this possible?]
Zhuo Fan was shocked and his heart sank.
His attack was a mere test, which was why he used the Qilin arm and not the other killing moves or sneak attacks.
This test had him floored.
He knew the might of his arm very well, with even a Saint wanting to avoid such raw power. This man, however, merely flicked him. What made it worse was he felt nothing else than strength.
Zhuo Fan grew grave, calculating how to overcome this difficult opponent.
Whoosh!
Chu Qingcheng flashed before the big man, slapping at his chest with her cold attack.
“Qingcheng, don’t…” Zhuo Fan shouted.
[You’re no match! Don’t irritate him!]
It was too late.
The big man mocked, sparing her but a glance, “Girl, stay out of this!”
His voice turned into a storm as it flung Chu Qingcheng out of sight in an instant.
Zhuo Fan cried out, “Qingcheng! W-where did you throw her?”
“To your destination, the Nether Sovereign’s seat of enlightenment.”
The big man laughed, “Aren’t I nice? Since you like tricks so much, here’s your chance to use them again, by sending you straight to the destination without having to pass the trials. Though it’s hard to say how the missie will be treated when she reaches it, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan’s heart sank, clenching his fists and letting his right eye shine in one golden halo.
[Divine Eye of the Void’s 1st stage, Shift!]
Whoosh~
He popped up in front of the man’s face, with his right eye now glowing with two rings, while his left burned with the black thunderflame, “Divine Eye of the Void 2nd stage, Thunderflame Void Annihilation!”
Hu~
The deadly flames shot for the man like vipers, the short distance making dodging impossible…

chapters.title: Chapter 1229: You Won
chapters.content:
Chapter 1229: You Won
Boom!
The black flames ran rampant.
Zhuo Fan drifted to the floor, staring at the raging blackness. He refused to believe this expert would offer himself up to be blindsided like this.
The fact that his face showed no fear, no shock, no reaction to the black flames’ sudden attack, left Zhuo Fan increasingly uneasy.
Bam!
Like he expected, the black flames scattered, revealing the untouched man still sitting in his chair.
Reality still proved to come as a shock, despite having considered this outcome.
