The black flames never failed him, destroying anything they touched, yet they couldn’t harm one hair on this big man?
The man laughed at his stumped face, “Divine Eye of the Void, Qilin strength and then there’s this black fire. All are amazing things, but none mastered, unable to showcase their true talents. Kid, craftiness does not equal enlightenment. Go back!”
“Back?”
Zhuo Fan was grave, “You have set Qingcheng off ahead, and you want me to return just to die? Not happening! I don’t want to become a ghost here, wandering the Nether Sea for all time.”
Zhuo Fan flew once more, his eyes flickering with a black glow as he stretched out two fingers. A devastating sword energy gathered.
“Apocalyptic Sword, Heaven Butcherer!”
Whoosh!
Zhuo Fan learned to combine the five sword arts into the Apocalyptic Sword from Sword Child. The black wave of death looked to come to reap all lives in existence.
The big man’s brow shook for once, laughing, “So you weren’t just a mixed bag, ha-ha-ha, going quite far in understanding the Sword Sovereign’s swordsmanship and actually surpassing it. However, it won’t change anything! Tyrant’s Fist!”
Bam!
Instead of two fingers, the man used a punch, striking the black wave to pieces. Zhuo Fan took the brunt of the backlash and got sent flying out of sight.
The man pulled back his fist and looked down with a chuckle, “To think I’d be up to tricks as well, using Emperor Stage strength when up against a Spirit King. The boy should’ve passed me, but I didn’t achieve my goal, ha-ha-ha…”
As he lowered his hand, a white mark was on it…
“Aah!”
Zhuo Fan shouted from being sent flying under that huge power, through the hole he burned and into something soft.
Only kept on his feet thanks to a large hand holding him.
Huge heads appeared around, looking at him with worry, “Sir? Are you alright?”
“Sir, did he hurt you?”
“Sir, what about the girl? Where is she?”
…
The spiritual beasts chatted, but he had no mind to focus on the kind sea beasts. He stood up, checking his wounds, only to find none.
[He didn’t hurt me? That backlash should’ve at least left me bleeding inside, if not outright dead.]
Zhuo Fan was puzzled, asking the beasts, “Who is he and how is he so strong? He knows so much about Heavenly Sovereign, Sword Sovereign and Qilin.”
“Uh, well…”
The beasts looked away. All the chatter died out on the spot.
Zhuo Fan stared hard at them, figuring out that they knew the answer. He threatened, “Didn’t you respect Sea Ao in life and death? I am asking here as his envoy and you don’t respond?”
“Lord Sea Ao knows we can’t say anything.”
One spiritual beast answered, with the others bobbing their huge heads.
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched.
[These guys were told to keep their mouths shut. Knowing the enemy and oneself is the path to victory.]
Against such a powerful opponent, he had to know everything he could, since overpowering was out. That left outsmarting him, only possible if he knew more.
Zhuo Fan asked again, “The big man inside is so strong, maybe a Saint? Then I’ll never be able to beat him as a mere Spirit King.”
“Ha-ha-ha, sir, this may be pushing it, but I still have to say that sir has no scheme. He is without a doubt not being hard on sir.”
“Oh, how come?”
“He-he, he is always fair, including regarding the stone gate when it comes to the challengers. As sir is a Spirit King, then pushing the gate will need Spirit King strength and you’ll thus have the chance to pass his trial. For he’ll also use the same level of strength, that of Spirit King, to fight you.”
“How can that be?”
Zhuo Fan was skeptical, “Just a show sent someone flying for thousands of miles. How is that a Spirit King level? It’s more within a Saint’s limit!”
The beasts smiled, “Even the same level can have huge gaps, depending on someone’s grasp of their strength. But you’re right about one thing. When he was a Spirit King, he did go challenge a Saint. He failed, yes, but it was shocking to find he came out of the fight in one piece. When he became a Saint, he fought and overpowered a hundred 12th level spiritual beasts, subduing the spiritual beast world for a while. Later on came Lord Qilin, and only then was his strength matched…”
“What?”
Zhuo Fan cried out, “To not lose against a Qilin? Then he’s…”
Ugh!
The spiritual beast covered his mouth having let it out of the back, rushing to wave off his words, “Sir, those are your guesses. I didn’t tell you anything…”
Zhuo Fan was too deep in thought to care about his words, looking at the huge gate with understanding.
Zhuo Fan took a deep breath, jumping out of the soft palm and arriving before the gate. He looked at the hole he burned through with a jeer.
He then put his palms on the gate, his right arm flaring red once more.
The spiritual beasts were curious, “Uh, sir, what are you doing? Didn’t you pass the gate already? Shouldn’t you be challenging the guardian instead?”
“I have passed it, but not my heart!”
Zhuo Fan smirked, “Senior was right, tricks aren’t everything in life. The gate tests the heart, not strength, leaving no room for being crafty.”
Zhuo Fan closed his eyes, using all his strength to push while emptying his mind, focusing only on this one task.
The big man’s ear twitched and grinned, “It’s him alright. Abstaining from pride and arrogance curbed. He has remarkable insight.”
Hours trickled by with the gate not budged even a hair. He kept at it for eight hours so far, not relaxing a moment, his eyes closed and with a body soaked in sweat.
The spiritual beast audience looked dumbly, looking at the gate and the man like they were one with how neither showed any movement.
[There’s no budging it so why even insist? Besides, the longer you’re at it, the weaker you become, especially without resting.]
They wanted to advise him against it, but Zhuo Fan’s eyes never opened.
So the spiritual beasts gave up.
Bam!
Then, the sudden noise had the spiritual beasts jump in fright. They gawked as the huge gate rumbled, with dust falling from it.
The beasts turned to Zhuo Fan to find the red glow on his arm weakened, yet his eyes closed. Despite his relaxed hands, rumbling echoed out as the large gate got pushed open.
Zhuo Fan smirked as he opened his eyes, strutting inside before the big man. Zhuo Fan said nothing, merely gave a light punch.
A force shot at the man’s face and he was forced, for once, to punch back. Upon impact, everything within a thousand miles crumbled, even the ground, from the raw power. Even the Nether Sea outside the gate roiled and sent sea beasts into a frenzy.
Crack!
The big man’s chair split apart.
The man nodded at Zhuo Fan, “You won. You passed this trial…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1230 - 1230, Second Trial
chapters.content:
Chapter 1230, Second Trial
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Thank you, senior, for your guidance!”
Zhuo Fan bowed to the big man, no longer trying to assess the other’s identity.
The big man walked closer, “Extreme power leads to violence, extreme violence leads to tyranny. Being tyrannical can break anything, even the world, but such a rampage will always come to an end, reaching exhaustion. The exhaustion of power marks the end of the road. Thus, the source of all tyranny is tranquility. Calm as water and relentless like a storm when in action. Once the unrest passes, peace is restored. Do you understand what I’m saying?”
“Bursts of brutality in a sea of tranquility. The storm always passes, while the breeze is eternal. The true path of tyranny isn’t destruction, but world peace.” Zhuo Fan nodded.
The big man laughed, “Indeed, one’s insight is always better than the ramblings of an old man. This is the proof you passed the trial. Go!”
The big man touched Zhuo Fan’s forehead with two fingers, a prismatic glow flashing for a blink.
Zhuo Fan shuddered, his mind empty as all the insights made his heart grow once more.
“Senior, which way is the second trial?” Zhuo Fan stilled himself and asked.
The big man smirked, grabbed his shoulder and threw him, “Allow me, ha-ha-ha…”
Whoosh!
“Ahhhh!”
As Zhuo Fan’s wailing faded in the distance, the big man nodded, just as an old man appeared behind.
He was the same old guy Zhuo Fan met on the Nether Sea shore.
“The Demon Transformation Art didn’t reject it. He has only begun stepping on the path of tyranny, but he did receive it.” The big man sighed.
The old man nodded, “This way, our plan is finally showing hope…”
Boom!
A huge explosion happened above the Nether Sea, causing it to roil.
The two exchanged a glance and turned grave, “A Heavenly Sovereign!”
In the gloom of the seabed, something smashed into a two-meter-tall wooden gate, turning it into splinters.
“Where am I?”
Zhuo Fan stood up, dusting himself off and looked at his surroundings.
Hu~
A black smoke rose, shooting before him, “After all these eons, I finally get to see someone reaching the second trial, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan jumped in fright, putting a hundred meters between them. Looking back, he only saw black mist.
“Senior, are you the second guardian?”
Thinking he was renowned as well, Zhuo Fan gave a deep bow, sizing the hidden figure and the ruined gate, “That’s the second trial’s gate? Did I just cross it?”
The black mist cackled, “Hi-hi-hi, of course. What else would you call smashing straight through the gate?”
“Uh, what next, senior? How do I pass the trial?”
“Beat me.”
“Just like the first trial?” Zhuo Fan shouted.
The black energy mocked, “He-he-he, I’m not so honest and kind like that yokel to give you a warm up. I’m more blunt. In this trial, your life’s at stake. You either pass or be buried here.”
Zhuo Fan shuddered in shock.
Having passed the first trial, he knew the guardians were great men. The big man had no intention of killing him, instead guiding him on a new path.
This man, however, went straight to a deathmatch.
[I know nothing about him. How do I win?]
“Uh, senior, are there any rules? Will you stay as Spirit King when fighting?”
“Ha-ha-ha, you’re overthinking things. I’m not as chatty as that yokel, going all out. Ha-ha-ha, take this!”
Whoosh!
The black mist turned into an arrow and shot for Zhuo Fan.
It caught him by surprise and pierced through him. Black mist began seeping out of him, with a black figure leaning on his back.
Zhuo Fan was utterly confused, but just to be safe, he jumped away from that man. What he saw from afar made him gasp.
“Y-you…”
“He-he-he, yes, I’m you.”
The shadow turned around as well, showing Zhuo Fan a familiar face, his.
The shadow turned into another him, copying not just the features, but mannerism as well. Zhuo Fan felt he was looking in the mirror.
Zhuo Fan smirked, “Senior, w-what is this?”
“This is the second trial, know thyself.”
The shadow snickered, “I won’t go hard on you, using only your strength to fight you. One would argue that you know yourself best, but with me being you, I also know you. Who do you think will win? Ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan calculated, his mind calming.
It was baffling fighting himself, but at least they should be evenly matched. A little strategy should bring him success.
Against the strange old man, however, if he went all out, he had no chance of winning.
This made this trial way easier than the first.
Zhuo Fan raised a hand, “After you.”
“Quite calm, I see.”
The opponent smiled, “You must think the fight’s in the bag. Ha-ha-ha, well I say that everyone ends up losing to themselves. Throughout life, no matter the strength one has, their true opponent is no one but themselves!”
The man’s eyes shone and waved a finger at Zhuo Fan, “Apocalyptic Sword!”
Whoosh!
A black sword wave shot straight for Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan panicked.
[He copied my skills too? The Apocalyptic Sword Art only came to be from the insights in the other five sword arts.]
He only just grasped it. Even if the other was at Sword Sovereign’s level, even he would need time to learn it.
This was impossible.
[One’s sword is built on their insights, how can…]
He had no time to answer all these questions, for the deadly wave was upon him. He extended two fingers and retaliated with the Apocalyptic Sword Art as well.
Bam!
The deadly attacks rumbled the world around them on contact, making the sea boil.
Zhuo Fan staggered back twice, while the other stood still.
“How is that possible?!”
Zhuo Fan gasped, “Isn’t his strength the same as mine? Why did he win that exchange?”
The man snickered, “They say you know yourself best, but you’re the most oblivious of yourself as well. Zhuo Fan, do you still think you can win?”
Zhuo Fan grew grave, his eyes cautious.
His arts were copied, his strength too, but what was worse, he knew him better than himself.
[Winning won’t be easy.]
Zhuo Fan found his greatest opponent.
Whoosh~
The copycat vanished, appearing behind him.
Zhuo Fan was nervous, for the copycat had a golden halo in his right eye.
[Even the Divine Eye of the Void…]
The glow turned into two rings while the left eye flared with the black thunderflame.
[Curses, it’s my Thunderflame Void Annihilation!]
Zhuo Fan was soaked in sweat, his heart racing. He never thought he’d see the day that his invincible skill would be set on him.
The copycat snickered, showing the same cruel gaze he himself used on his enemies…

chapters.title: Chapter 1231 - 1231, Shadow
chapters.content:
Chapter 1231, Shadow
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Against imminent death, Zhuo Fan responded with the same deadly attack, his eyes flashing gold and black respectively, as he unleashed a Thunderflame Void Annihilation of his own.
Bam!
The resounding explosion sent black flames swirling everywhere, actually burning the water to nothing.
Zhuo Fan got flung a thousand meters, his eyes burning as blood trickled down.
While the copycat…
[Blast it, he’s still in the same spot and mocking me.]
Zhuo Fan’s heart sank.
[He’s godlike, knowing both my skills and ending up way stronger than me on top.]
The longer he fought, the worse it would be. Zhuo Fan was at an impasse.
The copycat laughed at his conundrum, “Where did all that bluster go? Didn’t you think it was going to be easy than the first trial?”
“Senior, why must you go so far? What do you get out of this?”
“Oh, you still think I won’t kill you, ha-ha-ha…”
The copycat smiled, “Do you know how long I have been in this place? Without a body, I am stuck in this Nether Sea for all eternity.”
“Doesn’t Nether Sea have reincarnation? Why haven’t you tried yet?”
“Reincarnation?”
The copycat’s eyes turned vicious, his smile mocking, “Reincarnation means relinquishing everything. It’s impossible for me who has so many things I’m clinging on to. I have my own way, reborn without reincarnating. I’ll just destroy a human’s spirit and possess his body. Alas, no such specimen has darkened my door. Now that you’re here, I’ll kill your spirit and take your body and be reborn, hi-hi-hi…”
The copycat cackled while dashing for Zhuo Fan while unleashing Sundering Sword, Heaven-sealing Sword, Soaring Sword, Vaulting Sword and Decimating Sword strikes to obliterate him.
Zhuo Fan jumped back again and again, dodging out of the whirlwind of death. The close calls and the thick bloodlust he sensed from the slashes had him shudder.
Plop~
Zhuo Fan got struck by three sword waves. One through each hand and one through the shoulder. The pain was agonizing, a pain felt in the soul.
Zhuo Fan was used to it by now, though, the problem was how to deal with the relentless copycat.
Zhuo Fan brightened just then, finding hope in one aspect.
[The copycat has taken all my skills, but does that include my recent insight as well?]
Zhuo Fan halted his movements under the rain of sword energy, stilling his mind.
At extreme power, tyranny obliterated in an instant!
Qilin fist!
Zhuo Fan punched, with the tip exploding in a brilliant red.
Boom!
The space warped around him as the Nether Sea roiled. The horrible power crushed all in its path as it went for the copycat. Not even the sword energies could withstand it.
The tyrannical path he gleaned in at the first trial matched the Qilin’s power to a degree that it could take on a Saint.
The copycat merely smiled, shocking Zhuo Fan by punching as well, using the exact same motions Zhuo Fan did.
[He can copy even this…]
“Ha-ha-ha, I told you, I’m you. I have what you have!” The copycat smashed forward, “But far stronger!”
Bam!
The punches met and the water boiled. The black cracks around them spread in every direction, but the strongest shockwave came straight for Zhuo Fan.
The copycat had crushed his attack again!
Zhuo Fan couldn’t believe this was happening.
[Am I helpless against some pretender?]
Bam!
The aftermath flung him half a mile, making his entire body feel pain and weakening him. As he slumped to the ground, he was too weak to even get up.
[The only saving grace is I’m a soul without innards, or I’d be turned to paste by now.]
Whoosh!
The copycat flashed before him with a savage grin, “Ha-ha-ha, you lost and couldn’t pass the trial. I will now use your spirit to be reborn, ha-ha-ha…”
Huff~
Zhuo Fan panted, struggling to get up, only to sprawl back down in weakness. He closed his eyes, giving up.
The copycat laughed harder as he placed a hand on Zhuo Fan’s head.
[It’s over, Zhuo Fan!]
“Divine Eye of the Void 8th stage, Blink!”
Zhuo Fan flashed his eyes open and his right eye shone in eight golden rings.
The copycat’s chest sported a hole in it as he froze in place. Zhuo Fan glared at him and his shaking hand, “Didn’t you have all my skills and strength? Don’t you know the Divine Eye of the Void 8th stage can transfer any of my attacks to you through space?”
“Ugh…”
The copycat frowned then sneered, “Of course I did, I just didn’t care.”
Zhuo Fan stared hard.
The copycat mocked, “Take a look down.”
Zhuo Fan stared and found his chest having an extra breathing hole as well, in the same spot as the copycat.
Looking up at the copycat, the chest was healing.
Zhuo Fan was perplexed.
“Ha-ha-ha, who do you think I am?”
The copycat cackled, “I told you that I’m you. Harming me is harming yourself. Kill me and you kill yourself. All harm you do to me you do to yourself. You can do nothing to me!”
Zhuo Fan shuddered, “No way! Why then are you fine with all the wounds you caused me?”
The copycat gave an insufferable grin.
Zhuo Fan was so confused, he didn’t know what to do.
[I can’t harm the copycat no matter what I do. He’s even stronger than me.]
[How am I even supposed to win?]
Since this was a trial, there had to be a way to pass it.
Zhuo Fan frowned hard in thought.
The copy sneered, floating a hundred meters above and pointed at Zhuo Fan, “Main, farewell. From now I’m Zhuo Fan, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan was still puzzled even as the killing move came for him.
[Why does he have my Divine Eye of the Void and apocalyptic thunderflame? He even has my recent insight on the tyrannical fist.]
[It’s like seeing another me. No one else can have my insights to such flawless degree. Not even a Sovereign can do it…]
Zhuo Fan looked up at the same face marred by the savage grin and spread his arms as he gambled.
The copycat’s sword strike ran through Zhuo Fan’s chest and the two bodies clashed, with the heads facing each other. The copycat didn’t look happy at his win, while Zhuo Fan was calm.
“When did you notice?” The copycat spoke.
Zhuo Yifan said, “Just now. I can’t kill you since I get wounded instead. This means we’re one. You’ve also been going on that you are me as well, Zhuo Yifan.”
“You won, Zhuo Fan. It looks like I won’t be able to be reborn like last time by taking over your body, ha-ha-ha…” The copycat turned into a black mist and entered Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes were vague. When he snapped out of it, he found himself sitting down and unharmed before a broken wooden gate. There was not a trace of battle around.
His shadow floated away, forming a man in black three meters away as he congratulated, “Zhuo Fan, you passed…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1232 - 1232, Third Trial
chapters.content:
Chapter 1232, Third Trial
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Thank you, senior.”
Zhuo Fan stood up and bowed before the shadow, “Senior, was everything that happened an illusion?”
“Yes and no.”
“What does it mean?”
“An illusion is fake, but the contents can be real and fake.” The shadow replied, “Those were the doubts your heart had.”
Zhuo Fan asked, “If I had died in there, would I have died now?”
“Yes and no.”
“And what does that mean?”
“Zhuo Fan would’ve died, while the one who lived…”
“Zhuo Yifan!” Zhuo Yifan finished, “My current self would’ve died, while the old me would be reborn?”
The shadow nodded, “You can see it like that, but dying would be an exaggeration, since you’re both one. The one remaining would control the heart. Are Demonic Emperor Zhuo Yifan and the current Zhuo Fan’s hearts the same?”
Zhuo Yifan shook his head, “Zhuo Fan came from the mortal domain while Zhuo Yifan was a genius of the Sacred Domain. Their hearts diverged long ago.”
“Why then do you still accept him?”
The shadow smiled, “As hearts differ, so do their paths. With both of you sharing the same space it will lead to conflicts, that leads to inner demons. You don’t remove him but accept him instead?”
Zhuo Fan smiled and shook his head, “Hearts change, but be it for good or bad, I can never deny who I was. The path I tread today was built on his remnant. Denying it means destroying my future. Just like how my strike hurt me instead of him, for we are one.”
“Marvelous.”
The shadow gave a bright smile, “Many Saints that have gained power turn their back on their past, if not erasing it completely, focused only on seeking the Sovereign Stage. They are blind to the truth, that this action destroys their very selves. Each person’s path leaves its mark from the very first step one takes. Erasing this mark will crush any chance at finishing their journey. This is the reason behind there being so many Saints yet hardly any reaching the Sovereign Stage.”
“Thank you senior for your guidance.” Zhuo Fan bowed.
The shadow floated before Zhuo Fan and reached with a finger on his forehead, shining prismatically, “If it had been Zhuo Yifan before me instead, I would’ve sent you back. I’m glad it’s Zhuo Fan and now you have passed the trial, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan felt his heart becoming clearer, understanding deeper insights. He found with a start that he had grown in heart and mentality, “Senior, may I go to the third trial?”
“Of course, let me send you off!”
With a wave, Zhuo Fan found a black gate before him. He gave it a long look but then someone pushed him inside.
The shadow waved again and the gate vanished.
Whoosh~
The sea crossing old man and the big man appeared next to him, nodding as Zhuo Fan vanished.
“He passed again. I feared he would choose the old stubborn path.”
“Yeah, since Zhuo Fan of now is also the Zhuo Yifan of before.”
The shadow sighed and rejoiced, “I was worried as well that he’d become Zhuo Yifan, ruining all our hard work. Zhuo Yifan is the epitome of a demonic cultivator, obstinate and narrow-minded. He’s unable to grasp the core of the Demon Transformation Art, or accept our paths. If Zhuo Fan had been hostile and denied his former self, he would’ve become that narrow as well and his heart would have closed up. What fortune it never came to be…”
The two nodded, “Many people believe what they do is right while shunning others that do the same thing. They don’t realize that everyone else is their reflection. It’s funny how the world is filled with fools, fighting with themselves. Our efforts have borne fruit, for Zhuo Fan accepted his past and steps closer to the Dao.”
“It’s too soon to tell. There’s one last trial to go before the Nether Sovereign’s test. Any deviation means everything we worked for is lost and the final victor will be the Heavenly Sovereign.”
The big man was grave, while the other sighed.
Rumble~
The three looked up at the sky and tensed.
“Our four Sovereign paths have been holding the Nether Sea for so many years against the Heavenly Sovereign, but with two of us having been passed on, there’s no telling how long before the Nether Sea falls under his assaults. I just hope it’ll be enough for all the inheritances to be passed on.”
Boom!
Another rumble came from above, making the entire sea roil and the sea beasts rushing into hiding, all of them…
“Aah!”
Zhuo Fan slammed into the ground once more with a familiar cry. This place was way weirder than the last ones.
There were pinwheels, wooden horses, swings, rocking chairs and many, many more… toys.
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched.
[The first trial had a huge stone gate, almost impossible to open, but there I gained the tyrannical path. The second trial was facing my former self, to temper my mind.]
[The seniors were quirky and had their own styles as mighty seniors, so what then is up with the third trial? A playground?]
[I wouldn’t have bought this stuff for young Sanzi a hundred years ago!]
Zhuo Fan was on high alert regardless, shouting after seeing no one, “Is this the third trial? Senior, could you come out?”
Silence…
Zhuo Fan searched around but there wasn’t any sign of any man around.
Whoosh~
A shadow flashed behind that startled Zhuo Fan. Looking back, there was no one there.
Pa!
Another person appeared behind him again and Zhuo Fan swished around, but still no one, “Senior, please, enough with the games. You have enough power to toy with me to death.”
“Ha-ha-ha, I am close to dying of boredom, all alone for so many eons. Don’t worry, I won’t get tired of you anytime soon.”
A child’s voice echoed, making Zhuo Fan flinch. Looking back, he still found no one there, “Senior, does passing the third trial imply beating you as well?”
“Why beat me?”
The child giggled, “Since you want to pass, the goal is hide and seek. You find me and you pass.”
Hide and seek?
Zhuo Fan frowned, “Isn’t that just random?”
“Is that what you think?”
The child started, “Then let’s play with the wooden dolls. Win to pass!”
[Curses, now the topic changed at random? There’s no logic behind it. Unlike the other two seniors, this guy’s all over the place.]
[Is this the third trial’s guardian?]
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched and shook his head, “Senior, can you please not joke around? I really want to pass, but isn’t this a little… beneath you?”
“Beneath me? A big guy like you wants my respect?”
A figure flashed before Zhuo Fan, an eight-year-old child. He might look like that, but the eyes hid wisdom, while the face showed pride as he looked down, of sorts, on Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan had a weird feeling, it was like meeting young Sanzi again.
He should’ve called young Sanzi a senior back then as well, but it was just too hard to say that to someone so young in body and mind.
“Oh, senior is a dead sacred beast as well?”
“Hey, I’m human all the way!”
The child huffed and stuck out his tongue, “Buddy, ever heard of the best talent in antiquity?”
[Best talent?]
Zhuo Fan mulled, “Isn’t that the Heavenly Sovereign? He’s the first among the ten Sovereigns.”
“Bah, his cultivation is the greatest but he’s not the best talent.”
The child turned smug, “Talent is excelling in youth, achieving in their prime, and continues to dominate in their seniority. Look at me, my looks, my everlasting youth, aren’t I an excelling youth? The Heavenly Sovereign has nothing on me! He can only stay in his twenties at best. In other words, he got his success at twenty, reaching a cultivation enough to not grow old only then. But me, I got it all at eight. Who’s the genius now?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1233 - 1233, Child Sovereign
chapters.content:
Chapter 1233, Child Sovereign
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Zhuo Fan sized him up and shouted, “I heard that among the ten Sovereigns, the last one is the Child Sovereign, having found his path in youth. Can it be that sir…”
“Hey, leave that last part out!”
The Child Sovereign’s face twitched and sneered, “We’re all Sovereigns yet talk behind another’s back? Especially those three, having no shame calling themselves the top of Sovereigns. And when it’s my turn, they label me as the runt. Couldn’t you have come up with the Ultimate Talent instead? Are you looking down on me because of my looks?”
Zhuo Fan chuckled, bowing with respect, “Forgive me, Sovereign. But even so, sir is still a Sovereign, a realm all want to achieve and never could, even if they get a poor title.”
“I’d rather not hear you saying that about me. I’m not much worse than the other nine either.”
The Child Sovereign flared his nostrils, looking at Zhuo Fan with a cold gaze, “Buddy, did you come to pass the trial?”
“Uh, yes!”
“Just go home, you won’t make it.”
“Why? I didn’t even try…”
“You’re still asking why? Because you mentioned that title, that’s why. Humph!” The Child Sovereign stuck out his tongue, “You called me last so I’ll keep you in the Nether Sea until you rot!”
Zhuo Fan sighed.
[The Child Sovereign looks like a kid, but he’s been a Sovereign for countless eons, unlike Gu Santong. So how can he still act like one?]
[Just how did he become a Sovereign anyway? What’s his path?]
[Regardless, he’s being hard on me on purpose. At least I’ve been through this before with young Sanzi. Maybe I’ll just coax the young Sovereign. Just what made them stay the same after years and years?]
“Uh, Sovereign, that was but a slip of the tongue. In truth, everyone respects and admires sir the most among all the others.”
Zhuo Fan beamed, putting on an amiable look as he sucked up to him, “There has never been one with more talent than sir in all of history! There hasn’t been any youth achieving their paths for so long. Even my godson, Gu Santong, it was because he was a young sacred beast that he had so much power, but he also grew up in the end. Only sir, forever young, can outclass all the other Sovereigns. They must be jealous of your talent to call you last. But sir isn’t last, to me, you are the first!”
Child Sovereign gave a wide smile, “Truly?”
“More real than you and I. Just with your youthful looks, none of the others can match. They must be dying with envy, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan smirked, running his mouth. It was an amazing feat attaining one’s path at such an age, making him unique, but no one wanted to be stuck as a sniveling brat.
The Child Sovereign’s talent was incredible, but he was stuck in this form and could only console himself. Why would any other Sovereigns ever be jealous of a shorty?
Even Zhuo Fan wouldn’t want to be like him.
The Child Sovereign nodded, being as simple as his name implied, making a little flattery work on him. “Right, you have good eyes, pal. So you want to pass? I’ll give you a hand. Since you adore me so much, I can let you go through, no trouble. But before that, I am guarding this trial on behalf of the Nether Sovereign. I have to play my part or he’ll nag me later.”
“Please do, senior.”
Zhuo Fan rejoiced. The other trials were dangerous, but both got him something great. The last trial had to be up to par as well and he was looking forward to it.
Child Sovereign beamed, “So, I’ll go easy on ya, by playing catch. Grab me and you pass.”
“Uh…”
Zhuo Fan’s face twitched, shaking his head, “Sovereign, isn’t this too easy? Does sir have a deeper meaning behind the children’s game?”
“What else can help you pass?”
“Oh, only passing…” Zhuo Fan felt letdown for overthinking it. He feared it might be something impossible and would’ve failed, but now it was way too easy and he’d get nothing.
[I’m so picky.]
The Child Sovereign saw through him, “Why, you like pain? Can do. The same game, but this time I’ll make sure you’ll be stuck here till you rot!”
Zhuo Fan’s heart sank.
Having gone through two trials, he knew the Sovereigns had a reason for being mysterious and acting so strange.
[Maybe the game’s the same?]
Zhuo Fan nodded gravely.
“Please guide me, senior.”
Zhuo Fan shot to grab the Child Sovereign.
Whoosh~
The Child Sovereign vanished then and there, popping behind him, on a wooden horsie, “Still think it’s easy not even able to reach me?”
Whoosh!
Zhuo Fan flashed as well and reached out for Child Sovereign’s shoulder.
“I knew that even a restrained Sovereign is impossible for me to overcome so easily.” Zhuo Fan sounded from behind Child Sovereign, his right eye shining in a golden halo as his hand was inches from the child.
Zhuo Fan felt some uneasiness as he continued, “Of course, if Sovereign used some mystical art, I would never ever be able to do it in a million years.”
“Reverse psychology, is it?”
The Child Sovereign’s eyes shone and snickered, “Relax, I’m quite conscientious when playing and won’t break the rules. Though it’s not like it’ll make a difference, you sneaky rascal, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan watched him on top of the strangely swaying wooden horse, just as his hand grabbed at the child’s shoulder, without touching him.
[I couldn’t catch him even at such a distance?]
Zhuo Fan was startled. The Child Sovereign was on the same swaying horse, giggling, “I didn’t move this time, but you still couldn’t catch me? Ha-ha-ha…”
The Child Sovereign scurried over to a nearby bed, laughing.
Zhuo Fan was grave.
[The Child Sovereign has some weird movements. It looked like he used the swaying wooden horse to avoid me. Such precision and subtlety is just what a Sovereign can do. He’s weaker now, but he has experience and mentality to help him take on anyone.]
Zhuo Fan’s brow shook, his right eye shining golden, “Freeze!”
Hum~
The Child Sovereign’s space turned solid and Zhuo Fan reappeared to try and touch him, only for Child Sovereign to vanish once again.
[Illusion?]
Zhuo Fan’s heart raced.
“I didn’t use any skill, having slipped away before you reached out.”
The Child Sovereign sounded from behind. Zhuo Fan saw him on a swing, moving his feet around with a smile.
[So fast!]
Zhuo Fan gasped.
[He’s restrained yet can move faster than my Divine Eye of the Void. A Sovereign is on a whole other level. He doesn’t have just strength, but many insights and skills to widen the gulf from the rest.]
Zhuo Fan was eager to fight, shooting for the Child Sovereign with the Divine Eye of the Void shining brightly. He flashed on and off, his hands moving and forming a net to trap the Child Sovereign.
The kid’s image warped like a mist, small or big, as it slipped through the net with his annoying snicker.
The playground found itself scoured by two figures, running all over the place as one chased and the other dodged.
Zhuo Fan gasped, huffing after four hours of no results. The Child Sovereign was giggling still from the swing, “Brat, tired already? Look at me, I’m not even out of breath.”
[You’re a Sovereign, how’s that a comparison?]
“It’s just catch, yet you’ve been up to your old tricks and guile all this time. Of course you’ll wear out.” The Child Sovereign sighed, “Pal, do you know the best animal to catch a mouse in his den?”
Zhuo Fan said, “A cat?”
“Fool, the mouse itself!”
The Child Sovereign mocked, “You only want to catch me, not play along. Since you can’t go along with the flow, how can you catch me? Do you even know how or where I’m dodging?”
Zhuo Fan shuddered, his mind abuzz…

chapters.title: Chapter 1234 - 1234, Return to Your Roots
chapters.content:
Chapter 1234, Return to Your Roots
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Zhuo Fan took a deep breath and closed his eyes. When he opened them, they lost their edge.
The Child Sovereign nodded, “Again!”
“Sure!”
Zhuo Fan shouted as he smiled and went after the Child Sovereign. He still couldn’t touch him.
However, he no longer looked so stressed out, but casual as he went after Child Sovereign again and again.
He got so into it, Zhuo Fan forgot how many times he’d been doing it and instead enjoyed the game just for the fun of it.
Zhuo Fan ran all over the place, finally feeling that the Child Sovereign was almost within grasp.
Pa!
Zhuo Fan’s hand missed the Child Sovereign but then he grabbed out of reflex to his side, actually feeling flesh.
Zhuo Fan looked back at the Child Sovereign’s smile.
“I got you?”
“Congrats, you passed!” The congratulations no longer sounded childish, his face turning mature as he nodded.
Zhuo Fan said, “Passed… what?”
Then it hit him that he had been playing the Child Sovereign’s game to pass the third trial. He was just so engrossed that he forgot about anything else as he chased the Sovereign around.
“You’ve accepted the new change of pace, good.”
The Child Sovereign sighed, “Now wasn’t that fun playing a game? Wasn’t it great to forget all your worries?”
Zhuo Fan nodded.
The Child Sovereign sighed at the sky, “Kid, I’m the best talent in the world, having found my path since very young. Everyone thought I was the strongest human, their representative and hope. But I’ve become a Sovereign a hundred thousand years later than the other nine, the so-called last. Do you know why?”
“Please enlighten me, senior.” Zhuo Fan bowed.
The Child Sovereign continued, “Achieving success in youth means becoming the center of everyone’s hopes and responsibilities yet having scarce experience. No knowledge and no guidance had paused my cultivation at peak Saint for ages. In the end, all the other nine advanced, with only me left behind. I was confused, disillusioned, whining, dragging my feet and then shouted at the sky what more did it want. I’ve seen many famous masters, asking without shame for guidance. I’ve gone through trials and hardship, only to realize that what I lacked was living.”
“Living?”
“Yes, living.”
The Child Sovereign spoke, “At birth, we come into this world wanting nothing, no fame, no power, free and light. Only as we grow do we yearn for wealth and fame, pursuing lofty dreams while burdening ourselves with much more and more weights. Myself the most, being humanity’s top, I had heavy burdens on me, glory and duty. The joy and pain robbed me of plain living. So I’ve spent those hundred thousand years doing just that, living. I even acted as a child and played with other kids to mend the hole inside me and become a Sovereign. My path is that of average, returning to my roots.”
The Child Sovereign faced Zhuo Fan and patted his shoulder, “Brat, no human starts off burdened. All the worries you have are things you pick as you pursue your goal. By picking them up, you need to learn to also let go of them. Haven’t you done just that since now? Return to your roots, that of an innocent child. Observe the world and you will catch me.”
“I can’t thank you enough, senior.” Zhuo Fan bowed.
Child Sovereign smiled and pointed two fingers on Zhuo Fan’s forehead, flashing prismatic, “This is your proof to reach the Nether Sovereign’s seat of enlightenment. A harsher test awaits you!”
Zhuo Fan shuddered and felt a cool feeling taking over his heart, bringing him peace.
“Uh, Sovereign, where might the Nether Sovereign’s seat of enlightenment be?” Zhuo Fan bowed.
Child Sovereign smirked and pointed at a wooden horse, “Giddy up, it will take you there.”
“Uh, that…”
Zhuo Fan winced, “Sovereign, don’t you have anything normal instead of a toy? It’s too…”
“Not flashy enough? I got a wooden lion with a royal air if that’s more of your style.”
“T-that won’t be necessary.”
Zhuo Fan sighed, “It’s not gaudiness, just that going on a wooden toy to see the Nether Sovereign is a little lame.”
“What’s so lame about it? I always go over there like that.”
The Child Sovereign glared at him, “Didn’t I tell you to let go? You expect to reach your path clinging onto all those biases from the secular world? Fine, since you won’t go, go home!”
“No, no, no, I’ll take it!”
Zhuo Fan rushed to stop him, putting on a grimace as he got on the wooden horse. He struck a funny image, a grown man riding a children’s horse.
He still looked stylish though.
The Child Sovereign burst out laughing.
Zhuo Fan sighed, “Sovereign, you must be bored to death, using games to toy with me. But I can take it, for I respect my seniors.”
“Better keep that to yourself and have your last shred of decency, ha-ha-ha. Go!”
Pa!
Slapping the horse’s butt, the wooden horse shot forth like a shooting star. Zhuo Fan was gone before he knew it.
The Child Sovereign smiled, “This leaves the Nether Sovereign’s side. Old friend, it’s up to you now…”
Boom~
Cataclysmic explosions rumbled as the sky cracked and the Nether Sea boiled. Child Sovereign sighed.
“Heavenly Sovereign, you’re here.”
The Child Sovereign vanished.
He reappeared high in the sky along with three other figures.
They said with urgency, “How was it? Did he pass?”
“Isn’t it obvious since I’m here?”
The Child Sovereign looked at the sky and at the spreading cracks with clenched fists, “How long will it last?”
The trio shook their heads, “Heavenly Sovereign’s Divine Eye of the Void’s 2nd stage, Void Annihilation is designed to break barriers. With only one Sovereign path remaining, with the Nether Sovereign linking with the Nether Sea, I believe it would last at most one hour…”
“In other words, the Nether Sovereign must pass on his life and death path in this short time before all is for naught!” The Child Sovereign ended.
Dark clouds loomed in the horizon, with a minute light trailing among the gloomy weather…
“How’s this wooden horse so fast?”
The biting winds made Zhuo Fan’s ride unpleasant, shocked at the toy’s speed. In moments, he was on a bleak mountain, with a stone platform made up of three square meters black blocks. A wooden cross stood tall on the platform, with a familiar figure tied to it struggling to break free off those bonds.
“Qingcheng!”
Chu Qingcheng started and cheered, “Zhuo Fan… uh…”
The image of Zhuo Fan on the wooden horse left her speechless.
[Uh, just where did you find that weird ride?]
She then snapped out of it, “Zhuo Fan, help me!”
“I’m coming!”
Zhuo Fan shot off the horse before it landed, only to freeze on the spot the minute he touched the ground. He watched as gray mist floated from below and grabbed his legs.
Apocalyptic Thunderflame Eye!
Zhuo Fan let out the black thunderflame burning the gray mist and making it wail.
“You dare? Who is running amok in my seat of enlightenment?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1235 - 1235, Lost Souls
chapters.content:
Chapter 1235, Lost Souls
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Whoosh~
As the eerie wind blew, gray mist fell from the skies above, turning into a dark and aged face staring down the two with bloodthirst.
“My seat of enlightenment?”
Chu Qingcheng was baffled, “Does that mean he’s…”
Zhuo Fan rushed a bow, “Greetings, Nether Sovereign!”
“It’s really the Nether Sovereign? Didn’t he die?” Chu Qingcheng was stumped, “Why then is everyone fighting over his seat of enlightenment then? They’re only getting themselves killed trying to steal from the owner!”
She didn’t know what to think of all those greedy fools.
It was said that the ten ancient Sovereigns fell and finding their seat of enlightenment would mean inheriting their legacy to become a Sovereign.
[Since the guy was still alive and you’re trying to steal his stuff, you must be itching to die!]
The Nether Sovereign glanced over and sneered, “I am Nether Sovereign, ruling over life and death. Death won’t stop me. Since my Nether Sea can hold lost souls, why can’t it hold myself? Ha!”
Chu Qingcheng bobbed her head.
[Yeah, the Nether Sovereign is the Patriarch of all lost souls. With the Nether Sea holding them, it can have him as well.]
[Those out there must be unbearably naive to go after the Nether Sovereign’s stuff of all people. But we were not here to take anything, we just got involved by accident. What a cruel fate.]
“Senior Nether Sovereign, we have come here by accident and only wish to return to our world and not take anything. I hope sir will pardon us.”
Zhuo Fan bowed, “As per your demands, I passed the three trials. Please let us go.”
Chu Qingcheng bobbed her head.
The Nether Sovereign sneered, “Trials? Right, I did set those up so one could see me by passing them, but that does not guarantee you’ll get to leave with your life. A chance isn’t the same as certainty. It’s all up to my mood.”
“Uh, senior Nether Sovereign, are you perhaps happy now?”
“Anything but!”
“Why?” Zhuo Fan and Chu Qingcheng asked.
Nether Sovereign scorned, “You expect me to smile when some brats barge in, messing up my concentration?”
Rumble~
A boom came from up above and the Nether Sovereign turned grave.
“However, I won’t go hard on you and shall give you a choice. One of you shall stay and one can return. You choose.”
“I’m staying!”
Both shouted at the same time.
The Nether Sovereign cackled, “Ha-ha-ha, that was quick. Was I being too easy, perhaps? Then here’s another.”
“Senior, you’re a renowned Sovereign. How could you not keep your word?” Chu Qingcheng tensed and looked at Zhuo Fan, “Since you’re letting someone go, let him. I will become a lost soul.”
Zhuo Fan remained silent because he knew the problem was simple and complicated. Neither of them wanted the other to become a lost soul.
The Nether Sovereign had brought up this question because he already had a solution in mind.
The Nether Sovereign smiled, “I told you that you have a chance to walk away alive. Since you couldn’t choose it, let me help you.”
The Nether Sovereign’s eyes shot two gray rays that created a huge hole in the air. Howling and booming came from beyond.
The two of them saw familiar people running, chased around by a tide of shadows. He Xiaofeng and Zhao Chen were being hounded by the Nether Sea’s souls. Bali Yuyu was there as well.
[What’s she doing here?]
Zhuo Fan was worried. The Nether Sovereign turned to them, “Your enemy and your friend are there. Now, since only one can live, who will you choose?”
Zhuo Fan fell silent.
Between him and Chu Qingcheng, he would pick Qingcheng without delay. His life was his own, and didn’t matter what happened as long as he passed on with clear conscience.
But Bali Yuyu’s sudden entrance made it harder. Dying because of him would make him feel guilty. Zhuo Fan never owed anyone anything, and this made the choice that much harder.
“Go!”
The Nether Sovereign laughed, blowing over them and sending them among the sea of lost souls.
Bam!
He Xiaofeng met an old man’s palm with his own, sending him reeling and his blood boiling, despite being a soul.
“Curses, there are Saint souls here! The Nether Sea is too difficult… Oh, Qingcheng, you’re here!”
“You found them?”
Zhao Chen beat a soul and looked in joy, “Steward Zhuo, where did you go? We couldn’t find you no matter how much we looked. Are you alright?”
Zhuo Fan frowned.
They did not cross the three trials, or maybe…
[Were they for me? Doesn’t everyone have the chance to receive a Sovereign’s guidance?]
Whoosh~
A shadow appeared and struck for Zhuo Fan’s back, but then a kick sent it flying as Bali Yuyu flashed on Zhuo Fan’s side, rejoicing, “Zhuo Fan, you’re alright!”
“Yuyu, did someone tell you about three trials?”
“What trials? The minute we entered, lost souls started chasing us down, not bothering to even speak. I just thought they can’t speak to begin with, why?”
“Oh, nothing.”
Zhuo Fan was grave, further proving that the tests were held for him in particular. Further, the only way to find the Nether Sea was through Sovereign Yun’s globe. Then there were the Sovereigns’ three tests.
[Was this all on purpose?]
[But why? I was a mere Demonic Emperor before. Is it because I found Nine Serenities Secret Records?]
Zhuo Fan was confused.
“Aah!”
Zhuo Fan startled awake, “Qingcheng!”
Chu Qingcheng was still stuck to the cross, unable to move, as the souls shrieked and approached.
“Qingcheng!”
He Xiaofeng shouted as well, yet was happy inside.
[Great, a damsel in distress in need of a hero. I don’t know how she got up there or how she appeared here, but I just have to save her and her heart will be mine, as well as it…]
He Xiaofeng shot for Chu Qingcheng, shining silver. A huge figure with eight swords on its back appeared, almost a thousand meters tall.
A Saint’s unique ability, sacred body!
“Damned souls, leave Qingcheng alone!”
The huge image reached for two swords and slashed.
Boom!
Tornadoes flew from the speed and power and erased everything in their path. He Xiaofeng’s image towered above like a mighty king.
He sneered at everyone with pride and conceit.
[Well, Qingcheng, aren’t I cool?]
Bam!
He didn’t get to wallow in his narcissistic tendencies as the following boom was from an even bigger fist hurtling his image through the air. He hit the ground hard and shattered his sacred body. He Xiaofeng felt his entire body aching and turned pale.
[Who did that? Curses, that really hurt!]
He Xiaofeng panted as he strained to look up, “P-peak Saint? There’s a peak Saint in the Nether Sea? He actually died?”
Before him was another colossal image, wearing a dark face of disdain, “Ignorant pipsqueak, in the great ancient war, even Sovereigns fell, let alone some lousy peak Saints. You dare prance before me, foolish 2nd layer Saint?”
He Xiaofeng’s heart sank.
[The Nether Sea is the Nether Sovereign’s domain, so of course there’d be monstrous souls…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1236 - 1236, Life and Death
chapters.content:
Chapter 1236, Life and Death
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Saint, what do we do?”
Zhao Chen panicked in the face of such an unstoppable enemy and rushed to He Xiaofeng.
[Since you’re a Saint, you should handle it, right?]
[Besides, he’s dead while you’re alive.]
He Xiaofeng’s face twitched, his heart shaking as he found himself stuck unable to do anything. He was the Sacred Mountain’s young master, with lofty cultivation enough to toy with any other fools outside as none could do the same to him.
Here though, he couldn’t raise his head, for his fist was weaker.
Bam!
Another boom echoed as the Saint’s fist came for another blow. Lightning flashed, with the space cracking in places and warmth coming from one hole.
[That’s yang energy!]
He Xiaofeng shouted, “That’s the exit. Use it to leave!”
“Humph, you’re right about that, for no matter how hellish the Nether Sea is, a glimmer of hope will always exist.”
The dark man’s hand took out a cup with bamboo sticks, throwing it to the ground, “These are Life and Death Omens, with only ten of a thousand bearing life. Win and get lost. Lose and you’ll stay, forever.”
The group looked grave.
With this peak Saint taking charge, there was no forcing one’s way out. The only choice was to follow his rules, test their luck on those sticks and hope to get that one slim chance at life.
None felt the odds any bit promising.
“I’ll go first!”
Zhuo Fan stepped out. Others found this situation a life-or-death case, while he tried to look beyond it and understand its purpose.
[Since the Sovereigns set this up, I should be safe.]
Without a care, Zhuo Fan reached out for a stick. The others were tense and grateful.
Even Zhao Chen felt admiration for the man.
[Steward Zhuo is a cut above the rest. It’s a shame his cultivation is so low, for he excels in everything else. Not everyone can take the pressure of facing imminent death.]
They were oblivious to the fact that the game was rigged and he knew it.
The stick he chose had the word life written in red.
“Good sign.”
Zhao Chen laughed, “With just one percent chance, he picked life. Steward Zhuo’s fortune is beyond life, ha-ha-ha…”
“What fortune, that is a total disaster.”
He Xiaofeng spat, “Picking life means our odds just dropped, imbecile!”
Zhao Chen choked.
No one else was eager to try their luck. In the end, Bali Yuyu finally went for it.
The thin stick had a black word on it, death.
Bali Yuyu sighed towards Zhuo Fan. The others tensing.
[Life is fortune while death is normal. But will such a blessing fall on me as well?]
“What are the rest of you waiting?”
The peak Saint huffed, “I take it that you give up and choose to stay in the Nether Sea forever!”
He Xiaofeng glared hard at Zhao Chen, barking, “Go pick!”
Since the order wouldn’t change anything, Zhao Chen reached out with a shaky hand, picking up a life stick.
Zhao Chen was elated and laughed. He Xiaofeng’s face twitched.
[Curses, I should’ve gone instead! Now the odds are lower.]
He Xiaofeng reached out with a trembling hand, sweat trickling down. But then he thought better and pointed at Chu Qingcheng, “Wait, what about her? How can she pick one when she’s tied up?”
“Her? She caused trouble and was tied up. She’ll have to let another pick for her. Her fate is either to live or to have her soul destroyed here and now, never even able to wander the Nether Sea.”
[What?!]
Everyone gasped.
[What did she do to deserve such cruel punishment?]
Zhuo Fan understood everything and said nothing.
He Xiaofeng’s eyes shone and picked… death.
He Xiaofeng’s horrified face was pale as paper. The peak Saint cackled, “Rotten cretin, how many souls did you kill in the Nether Sea so far? You should’ve been tied up as well and die at my hand. Now that you chose death, you’re dead anyway.”
His palm flashed with unseen speed.
“Wait!” He Xiaofeng shouted.
The savage palm halted, “Any last words?”
“The stick wasn’t for me, but for her!” He Xiaofeng pointed at Chu Qingcheng.
Chu Qingcheng shook her head, “No, I didn’t ask him to pick for me. That stick is his!”
“Yeah, why would you get to pick for her?”
“B-because she’s my fiancée. I decide everything about her.”
“As if! I’m not your fiancée!” Chu Qingcheng denied as she turned to Zhuo Fan.
He Xiaofeng shouted with pride, “My Sacred Mountain supports your master and she obeys us. You were always meant for me. You have always been my child bride. Everything you have is because of me. You can just ask your master when you go back.”
“No, that just cannot be!”
Chu Qingcheng shook her head in anger, “You’re just afraid of dying and are spouting crap!”
“No, he is right.”
The peak Saint boomed, “You entered with your souls in the Nether Sea and manifested yin bodies. In other words, your souls’ energy is under the Nether Sea’s watchful eye. Any lie you say will be reflected on your yin bodies. As there is no reaction from him, this proves it is true.”
Chu Qingcheng shuddered, hanging her head in disbelief, “How could master…”
Zhuo Fan pondered.
[They know of the Sovereign path on her and they now want it.]
“Well, can I choose for her now?”
“Yes.”
Ignoring Chu Qingcheng’s crushed face, He Xiaofeng asked for clarification. Then grinned, having extended his life for a couple more minutes.
He now had another chance to actually survive this.
So he picked a stick again, far more carefully.
Pa!
He Xiaofeng chose from the middle and held out the stick with the red word as he cackled, “It’s life! I picked life. I can return, ha-ha-ha…”
“You three can return while the women will stay.”
The peak Saint spoke, “You also have the option to give your stick to another, if you so choose to.”
“Tch, who’d ever pick death over life? That added part is pointless.” Zhao Chen sneered.
As he looked around, he saw He Xiaofeng’s savage grin.
“W-what are you doing?”
“Nothing, just wish you’d give life to Qingcheng.” He Xiaofeng’s spoke evilly, “As my fiancée, I have to save her.”
[Screw you! Now you care? What about just now when you used her?]
Zhao Chen’s face twitched, cursing inside. Then he turned to Zhuo Fan, “Saint, why are you going after me when he also has one?”
“Yeah!”
He Xiaofeng’s eyes shone with savagery, setting his sinister smirk on Zhuo Fan.
The peak Saint stepped in, “Once chosen, only the two doing the exchange may decide. In other words, the one who chooses life must want to, but the one who chooses death must want just as well for the deal to work.”
“Tch, it’s obvious for a life chooser, but what’s up with a death chooser refusing?”
Zhao Chen sneered, “How do you know they wouldn’t want to?”
The man mocked, “Vulgar fools like you can never understand life and death. Have you forgotten that the Nether Sea is watching your souls? Your true intentions will be laid bare regardless of lies.”
[That’s why the Nether Sea insists for souls to enter. It’s like baring yourself and exposing every aspect of you.]
He Xiaofeng sighed and spat, “Zhuo Fan, weren’t you always fond of Qingcheng? You should sacrifice yourself for her.”
“No, I changed my mind.”
Zhuo Fan chuckled, turning to Bali Yuyu, “I want to give my life to Yuyu.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1237 - 1237, Cleanse
chapters.content:
Chapter 1237, Cleanse
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
[What?!]
Everyone was baffled, even Bali Yuyu, by Zhuo Fan’s choice.
[Didn’t he always love Chu Qingcheng? Why…]
Zhuo Fan walked before Bali Yuyu and sighed as he gave her the life stick, “There’s no need for you to stay in hell because of me. Go back.”
“You’re giving me life because you owe me?” Her big eyes watched him.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “No, that intention might have been before, but now I truly want you to live. Just because the heart chooses to.”
Bali Yuyu looked at the peak Saint with questioning eyes.
“He is sincere.” The Saint judged.
Bali Yuyu bit her lip and looked at Chu Qingcheng as she held her own death stick, “I understand what you’re thinking. Even though you want to die, I will respect your decision.”
“Both hearts agree. The deal is concluded.” The Saint spoke.
Zhuo Fan smiled and patted Bali Yuyu’s shoulder, taking her death stick and walking to Chu Qingcheng.
Bali Yuyu’s eyes teared up.
He Xiaofeng was baffled, “What’s up with them? Why did he yearn for the death stick more than his life?”
“Insatiable fools like you could never understand life and death.”
The peak Saint sneered at them, then he flashed next to Chu Qingcheng and Zhuo Fan. His huge palm hovering overhead, “Having chosen death, this palm shall destroy you.”
Zhuo Fan hugged Chu Qingcheng with a peaceful expression, “Will you regret us dying?”
“It matters not, not when neither life nor death can part us.” Chu Qingcheng smiled back, then sighed, “I just feel a bit of loss since I don’t know where I came from…”
“I had someone look into it. We’ll know it soon, if we survive.”
“Since death doesn’t matter, neither does anything else as I’m with you.” Chu Qingcheng muttered.
Boom!
The huge palm slammed down, the two vanishing in a flash of bright light, dead.
Everyone watched them vanish, then Zhao Chen shrugged, “I came to the Nether Sea yet got nothing for my troubles, losing instead my genius aide.”
Crack!
He Xiaofeng’s clenched his fists.
[I have it much worse than you. Do you have any idea how much Chu Qingcheng was worth? The ancient and fragmented records of the Sacred Mountains say that she could become a Sovereign.]
[It’s an utter loss letting her die here in the Nether Sea. I shouldn’t have brought her. I thought she might be of help searching for a Sovereign’s domain, but…]
He Xiaofeng flicked his sleeve and left.
Bali Yuyu watched the two vanish with a bitter smile. The peak Saint called out before she went as well, “Wait.”
“What is it?” Bali Yuyu frowned.
“Dao is descending and the end of days is nigh. The only hope lies with Zhuo Fan. Seeing your sincerity towards him, I can trust you. The Nether Sovereign wishes to ask you if you will help him.”
“H-he’s still alive?” Bali Yuyu cheered…
Zhuo Fan and Chu Qingcheng appeared back on the stone platform, with the Nether Sovereign watching the couple with a nod, “Living fear death, but that is mere regret of the things they have to give up by dying, the things they couldn’t do. Letting go of everything makes life and death meaningless. Zhuo Fan, you passed the last test.”
“Thank you Sovereign, for your wisdom.”
Zhuo Fan bowed, “Only, aren’t you worried that I was certain you wouldn’t kill me?”
The Nether Sovereign raised an eyebrow, “Kill you? Did you really think I never thought of it? Except for the three guardians, the other testers were Zhuo Yifan from your heart and that peak Saint. None of them have ever gone easy on you. By failing to grasp the tyrannical path, you wouldn’t have passed the first trial. You took on his fist intent and, while you can’t feel it, your body is in shambles. Any more strikes and your body would have crumbled and left you in the Nether Sea forever.”
Zhuo Fan shuddered from shock.
“On the second trial, if Zhuo Yifan had won, you wouldn’t be you anymore. Your heart would’ve regressed to the time of being the Demonic Emperor in Sacred Domain, with the hundred years of experience in the mortal domain erased.”
The Nether Sovereign continued, “In the third trial, was it really just a game with the Child Sovereign? With your Spirit King soul power, didn’t you find it odd how you still stood after four hours of relentless running? The trial strained your mind. Your spirit would’ve been spent to death if you hadn’t understood the path.”
Gulp.
Zhuo Fan’s heart froze. He always thought they used different ways of teaching him, not realizing the deadly danger lurking beneath.
The Nether Sovereign mocked, “The three trials and the five testers, all passed onto you their path while also ready to kill you in the process. Nothing is free in this world. The bigger the risk, the bigger the reward, with the reward always in correlation with the price. They were earnest in passing their path to you, that meant holding nothing back, even if it meant ruining everything by killing you. It is the only way to truly invest oneself in teaching, by giving their all so that you can understand them.
“Just like that last palm, it struck not you, but your heart. Had you not let go of all your worries, even believing to have a lucky break, the palm would’ve shattered your soul. It had nothing to do with Miss Chu at all. It was all you, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan felt a chill down his spine, realizing with a start just how close he was skirting death.
[The Sovereigns were too playful, hiding death behind their smiles and making me confused.]
The Nether Sovereign smiled.
Rumble~
The skies shook hard, the sound slamming into their ears. The Nether Sovereign grew worried and rushed things, “Zhuo Fan, once you return, focus on understanding my life and death path, as well as the other three paths. It’s all up to you to stop the end of days.”
“End of days?”
Zhuo Fan started, but then a prismatic glow entered him from the Nether Sovereign.
The gloomy sky shattered and golden rays shone down from the high heavens.
Nether Sovereign shouted, “Go!”
The two were blown away and vanished from sight.
The Nether Sovereign turned to the golden glow above and whistled. The other testers arrived, looking grave, “Heavenly Sovereign, after all these years, you still managed to force your way in.”
“Ha-ha-ha, you asked for this, didn’t you?”
The sky let out golden ripples and a humongous eye appeared with twelve golden rings in its center.
“It would’ve been impossible to barge in here with your four Sovereign paths holding me back. But you had to be suicidal and pass them all on.”
“Suicidal?”
The first guardian mocked, “We’ve died eons ago. Everyone here is a mere damned soul clinging to their path. How is that suicidal?”
The huge eye focused on him, “Tyrant Sovereign, Shadow Sovereign, Child Sovereign, Nether Sovereign, and Rebirth Sovereign. You know yourselves to be damned souls so why do you keep fighting me? I’m not doing this out of my wish, but for the world’s Dao!”
“But your path is frightening.”
The old fisherman said, “The world is of yin and yang, condoning good and evil within its boundaries, without any extremes. All the creatures had the right to live!”
Hum~
Heavenly Sovereign mocked, “Dao is the foundation of everything in existence, discarded like a rag the minute the demonic path arrived. The world is tainted, no longer caring about Dao. What’s terrifying is the demons in humanity. As the Heavenly Sovereign I shall stand in heaven’s stead to enact the Dao by purging all demons. As such, since you’re all born of the demonic path, you all must be removed for being opposite of my path.”
“We aren’t demonic cultivators, but people, in coherence with Dao.” Nether Sovereign spoke, “We seek the good in people, while you can’t see right from wrong. Of course we walk different paths!”
“Humph, we really are different men on different paths. You want to use the demonic path to fuse the ten paths, to fight my heavenly path. But all your hopes will be in vain, with your plan in shambles. I will be the one to fuse the paths and not the one you rest your hopes on!”
Heavenly Sovereign mocked, “Farewell for good, old friends… Cleanse!”
Hum~
The huge eye shone in eleven golden rings, unleashing a ripple of light. The Nether Sea vanished then and there, despite the Nether Sovereign’s calm face.
“Heavenly Sovereign, you will fail. Our paths shall bear witness…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1238 - 1238, Emperor Stage
chapters.content:
Chapter 1238, Emperor Stage
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
Whoosh!
A shadow flitted beneath the blazing sun, before slamming into Zhuo Fan’s body.
He shook and coughed blood, “Senior Nether Sovereign was right. I couldn’t feel it, but my body is a wreck from senior Tyrant Emperor’s punches.”
Feeling sharp pain from everywhere, Zhuo Fan sighed.
[Those seniors went all out when it came to passing their path, going as far as killing me if they had to.]
“Big brother Zhuo!”
A cry came, “Great, your soul is back! That He Xiaofeng and Zhao Chen came back before and said you and sister Qingcheng died in Nether Sea. You gave me such a fright. Thank heavens sister Yuyu came after and said that you’d wake up.”
Zhuo Fan looked at Shuang’er and her smile. Then he looked around, but all he found was Luo clansmen.
“Where are the others and Qingcheng?”
“Ruby Cloud Sect group heard of sister Qingcheng’s passing and took her body. Demonic Emperor and that He Xiaofeng didn’t even look at you as they left.”
Shuang’er smiled.
Zhuo Fan nodded.
[Those two only care about themselves and no one else.]
[Since my soul returned, Qingcheng’s must be back as well. That He punk might try forcing himself on her after finding out she’s alive.]
[What a shame I couldn’t get rid of him in the Nether Sea.]
Zhuo Fan sighed and looked around, “Where’s Yuyu? I don’t see her.”
“You finally think about her.”
Shuang’er squinted at him, “Sister Yuyu said she has something to do and won’t be back to the clan for a while.”
[Something?]
[What can she do when she isn’t even familiar with Sacred Domain?]
Zhuo Fan frowned, but gave up trying to figure it out. He knew her character and she should be fine.
“Then let’s go back. She must have her own plans.”
“Should we tell Demonic Emperor?”
“Why bother?”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone coldly, “I’ve earned much from the Nether Sea and will use them to advance. I don’t have time for anything else. When I come out, I’ll settle the score with those geezers, humph.”
The others nodded and looked ready to fight.
[After these calm years, Steward Zhuo is ready to strike the Eight Emperors…]
Three months later, Zhuo Fan was in a private room in the Luo clan’s manor, having entered it the minute he arrived.
Luo Yunchang and the others were left hanging, their cordial mood gone.
Danqing Shen and the oldies nodded, “He must’ve gotten something from the Nether Sea. I should’ve went as well, ha-ha-ha…”
“Yeah, it must be something great by the looks of his hurry.”
They were envious, “My, that’s a supreme expert’s domain for you, filled with riches. The kid is so biased, taking just two girls with him to hide his strength. We really missed out…”
The others nodded.
Zhuo Fan ignored all the chatter coming from outside and set up a defensive array before sitting cross legged on the bed with eyes closed to ponder all that happened in the Nether Sea.
The Tyrant Emperor’s fist, Zhuo Yifan’s fight, the Child Sovereign’s movements, that peak Saint’s attack, and the Nether Sovereign’s final warning.
Each even flowed through his mind as his energy surged higher and higher. Yuan Qi flooded his meridians with astonishing speed, covering every nook and cranny.
Hum~
Buzzing came from Zhuo Fan’s body as he released prismatic glows. The array had no way of stopping the lights, passing through them and coloring the heavens.
“What’s that?”
The chatty group outside gasped, watching the sky shining in rainbow colors. Their cries soon died out as the light fell on them and provided warmth and comfort.
Danqing Shen’s heart thumped, his voice shaky, “Please watch over me, I’m advancing!”
He rushed into his room and sat down at once to use the prismatic glow to reach the Emperor Stage.
“Curses, that’s my line!”
Murong Lie was also frantic as he went to his room, “I’m advancing too. I leave the guarding to you, brothers!”
“You think we’re any different? Let’s leave guarding to whomever feels like it, cause I won’t.” Ouyang Lingtian went as well.
“How sly, advancing by yourselves. What about us?”
“Yeah, we’re in the same boat. This is a truly rare chance we cannot miss.”
“Yeah, let’s just all advance then, and no one guards.”
…
All of the Luo clan in the city felt something from the prismatic glow above, their strength soaring.
None had time for anything else, whether patrolling or guarding as they vanished into their rooms to close their eyes.
The entire city of hundreds of thousands became quiet as a ghost town, with not even a breeze passing.
[What’s going on?]
Baili Jingtian, looked at the astonishing scene with a smirk, “Thunder Sword King, this is our chance. They’re all gone and Zhuo Fan has no one protecting him. Let’s go in and kill him for our empire!”
Silence was his only answer.
Baili Jingtian looked around to find Baili Yulei gone like the rest.
“You’re also…”
Baili Jingtian raged, “As a Sword Star Empire’s Sword Kings, haven’t we been tagging with Zhuo Fan for the chance to kill him? Humph, useless! I’ll just have to do it myself!”
Baili Jingtian stomped ahead.
He only got to make two steps as his eyes glazed over under the prismatic light show. His rage faded and calm was restored.
“The grudge is fading, but why? Ah, I feel like cultivating, knowing that I’ll advance if I do. I can’t miss this chance…”
Baili Jingtian plopped down then and there to meditate.
The prismatic lights danced above over everyone’s heads, enlightening them. None of the citizens missed this chance to cultivate.
Boom!
With a large explosion, a draconic cry sounded. Danqing Shen’s dragon soul soared out and shone golden alongside a three hundred meter long sword. He actually formed his Imperial Mark so soon!
His power surged wildly, growing exponentially.
He entered Emperor Stage under the prismatic light yet didn’t stop.
Boom~
Following Danqing Shen were tens of other auras booming all over the town and unleashing their golden aura into the skies. Murong Lie and the others advanced as well.
Luo Yunhai and the Luo clan’s young guards reached the Spirit King Stage. Luo Sifan and the juniors jumped two whole stages, to the Genesis Stage.
Everyone was overjoyed and amazed. Even with the incredible spiritual energy of the Sacred Domain, wasn’t this still too fast?
The only explanation was the mystical prismatic light coming from Zhuo Fan’s room. They knew it had to be incredible.
Cultivating under such a light was paradise.
So they kept going despite having advanced, for the multicolored lights called to them and whispered deep secrets of the world that made their Yuan Qi soar…

chapters.title: Chapter 1239 - 1239, Dragons Come Knocking
chapters.content:
Chapter 1239, Dragons Come Knocking
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Elder, up ahead is the Luo clan’s base.”
Whoosh~
A dozen people streaked the clear sky and landed, with a muscled man in his thirties leading them as he pointed in the direction of the prismatic glow, “We receive word from Gambling Town that the clan is refining a sword from a dragon scale is over there.”
The old man next to him gasped, “That’s…”
“What is that?”
Another elder with red hair frowned, “In all my thirty two millennia, I’ve never seen such an event anywhere in Sacred Domain. The whole world knows that any who refines a weapon with my race shall feel our wrath. But this clan just pranced around with their dragon sword without fear. Does someone have their back?”
“Yeah.” Another elder with black hair stepped forward, his eyes flashing, “Something doesn’t feel right. The Luo clan doesn’t look like much but does unusual things. Their location is also under some baffling phenomenon. Stay cautious.”
The others nodded.
The muscled man sneered, then came over with a bow, “Elders Bai Long, Chi Long, Hei Long, you’re overreacting. Isn’t that just a rainbow? I heard they have Demonic Emperor Zhao Chen’s protection. How is that a strong backing? Moreover, the most they could ever get to side with them are the Seven Sacred Mountains. But would those old guys dare mess in our affairs?”
“We don’t fear even three of those mountains working together. As for all seven…”
Bai Long pondered, “It never hurts to play it safe. Humans are treacherous and cunning. What if it’s the Seven Sacred Mountains’ attempt to taunt us into waging war? Never forget their constant taunts half a million years ago over the Fountain of Youth, making our race suffer heavy casualties as we relinquished that precious area. We were lucky that our diehard resolution scared them off, thinking we’d take them down with us, and didn’t suffer further needless losses.
“For the same reason we need to be extremely careful against the sudden clan taunting us out of nowhere. Remember the past.”
The others nodded, with the muscled man saying, “Should we test them? We’ll have to reconsider if an expert is among them. Otherwise, I alone am more than enough to waste them. I don’t fear even the Eight Emperors, let alone this puny clan. A dragon’s pride can’t be tarnished. Those humans are looking down on us.”
The three elders nodded.
The muscled man perked up and bowed before shooting forward. Before he even got close, the sudden boom scared him.
A draconic cry announced the rise of a prismatic dragon as it unleashed a golden aura. The dragon split into five, each with its own color. They circled in the sky and released black energy in the form of a hole. As the golden auras converged, the dragons intertwined their heads and tails to form the frame of a black mirror.
This was Zhuo Fan’s Imperial Mark, the Heaven Devouring Wraith Mirror.
The black mirror fell in Zhuo Fan’s room and vanished, followed by the disappearance of the prismatic lights.
Everyone else shot their eyes open, looking at the clear sky and sighing with disappointment.
[Where did the lights go? Couldn’t it last a bit longer? We haven’t had enough.]
After they checked their cultivation, their joy shot higher than the sorrow. All had grown by a large margin.
Danqing Shen, Murong Lie and the other oldies were now peak Emperors. Even Eight Emperors were nothing to them now.
As inheritors of the Sword Sovereign, and having gone through Zhuo Fan’s four Sovereign paths’ baptism, the Eight Emperors were like children now. Even those chosen from the Sacred Mountains couldn’t compare in foundation with them.
“For heaven’s sake! I told you it was a rainbow!”
The muscled man calmed himself as he said, “That was a human forming his Imperial Mark. Why did he have a dragon soul? Curses, the punk stole our dragon power to form his soul! How did he do it under our watch?”
The muscled man was puzzled, but then he shot at the city in rage.
[A mere human not only stole our dragon power but even used us for a weapon. They must all die!]
His berserk roar caused the cheerful Danqing Shen and others to flinch. They focused on the muscled man charging into their city, “Puny Luo clan, you have some nerve! I will obliterate you all!”
Peak Emperor power was unleashed, flooding the city with his bloodthirst.
The Luo clan would’ve been hard pressed against such a mighty foe for sure, two days ago that is. But now, the Luo clan’s Spirit Kings were peak Emperors.
An Emperor making a scene here? Nothing but a trifle.
“Where did this guy come from? He’s got spunk.”
Danqing Shen whispered to the others. Murong Lie beamed, filled with battle spirit, “With such a perfect test subject showing up, why not use him to hone our newfound Emperor strength?”
“Agreed!”
Everyone nodded with devious grins, even Baili Yulei got excited, “But first, form a line. We can’t have anyone hog him!”
“Like usual then!”
Murong Lie grinned at Li Jingtian, “Luo clan’s original Venerables go first then us, ha-ha-ha…”
“Don’t mind if we do, ha-ha-ha…”
Li Jingtian cupped his hands, filled with battlelust as he shot for the city limit, “I’m your opponent!”
The muscled guy nodded, “Peak Emperor, good. I didn’t think a tiny clan would have one. A shame you’re a human. Us dragons are tens of times stronger than you, humph.”
“You’re a dragon?”
Li Jingtian gasped then grew thrilled at the challenge, “Awesome! I can go all out then!”
“Come again?”
“They say dragons have the strongest bodies. I’m also a body cultivator so let’s dance!” Li Jingtian laughed and shot for the muscled guy with a punch covered in black energy.
Bam!
A savage shockwave spread outward, causing the space to warp. Li Jingtian’s punch landed in the guy’s outstretched hand, unleashing a violent wind. His body shuddered under the mighty force.
The muscled guy gasped, “I didn’t know humans could train their bodies to such a degree. A real shame though, that you’re just a human. No amount of training could ever help to win against dragons!”
Boom!
The muscled man shook his hand and shot Li Jingtian back for a dozen steps. His eyes were filled with shock and thrill.
[Dragons are so powerful!]
“Old Li, use your Imperial Mark! You’re no beast so don’t try meeting one with just your body! We humans use martial arts to our advantage!”
A shout roused Li Jingtian from his frenzy, Qiu Yanhai. The others nodded.
The muscled man mocked, “Your friend’s right. A mere human could never best dragons in raw power. That’s why you humans are so prideful in the Imperial Mark. Dying before taking it out, I would send you off in tears, ha-ha-ha. Those below are counting on you to protect them with the Imperial Mark!”
[What the hell do you know? They’re urging me so I’d finish fast and they’ll get a shot. Especially those Sword Kings. Once they get here, you won’t stand a chance, even as a dragon. Those are the real monsters here. You’re nothing but a freak of nature.]
Li Jingtian took a deep breath and made a sign, using the Imperial Mark he just formed.
He came to test himself. But this guy was actually waiting for him to show his best?
[Don’t you know where you are? This is the Luo clan, home of monsters and devils. Those below can’t wait to chew you up and spit you back out…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1240 - 1240, Are They Human?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1240, Are They Human?
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Imperial Mark, Heaven Crushing Black Dragon!”
Squinting, Li Jingtian finished making signs and shouted. With a flash of golden, a huge black dragon coiled around an equally large seal high in the sky.
Li Jingtian pointed and with a draconic roar, the sea smashed towards the muscled guy. The space around it shook and warped from its power.
The muscled guy widened at its incredible power and raised a growing arm.
Bam!
The arm of a peak Emperor dragon slammed into the martial fanatic Li Jingtian, sending shockwaves on impact, yet none faltered back. The space was the one taking the brunt of their relentless power, with constant ripples flashing out.
The muscled guy’s eye twitched in shock.
It amazed him how Li Jingtian had the strength to match his. It was said a human’s Imperial Mark was unstoppable, just like a spiritual beast’s tough body.
He, however, was a dragon and ending a fight with a human in a draw would only bring him disgrace.
The muscled guy’s face turned red.
Crack!
His body shook and his eyes grew bigger as sweat dripped down. He strained as he pushed harder and sent the mark back.
