Li Jingtian shuddered and coughed blood, “You win this round, but the next one is mine!”
“Humph, you’re not bad yourself. It’s the first time a human of equal level broke my arm.”
He looked at his shaking right arm and said, “Too bad there’s no second round. I can still fight even with a broken arm, but you’ve suffered a heavier wound weakening your Imperial Mark and dooming your fate. With you gone, the Luo clan will have no expert defending it, ha-ha-ha.”
Li Jingtian gave him a dumb look and flew down.
[I’m not the Luo clan’s true defender. I just dropped by for a spar and not to die. Besides, there’re plenty of others that can clobber you. There’s just the matter of making sure those freaks don’t kill you so I can have my fill sparring with you.]
Li Jingtian turned to Qiu Yanhai, “Your turn.”
“Old Li, what’s up with going all out in a spar? It’s not about your wounds, but breaking his arm. Won’t my spar be one-sided, without going all out even?”
“Stop with the bragging. One hand is enough for him to take you on. Now go!” Li Jingtian sighed.
The muscled guy was baffled.
[There’s another one stronger around? The Luo clan must be something else to have two of peak Emperors.]
The muscled guy couldn’t believe his ears, only accepting it when Qiu Yanhai flew before him.
Qiu Yanhai smiled and bowed, “After you.”
“Humph, you must be dreaming thinking you can beat me with two peak Emperors. Your only chance is to come at me together, instead of dying by challenging me alone.”
The muscled guy charged. It was clear the possibility of having both peak Emperors ganging up on him had him on edge. He wanted to end this fast.
It really was a quick spar.
Three minutes later, Qiu Yanhai huffed with a pale face and was bleeding from the mouth. He saluted, “Dragons are indeed strong. I lost.”
The muscled guy’s face twitched, downcast as he stared at his singed palm.
[Screw your loss! He’s as strong as the first guy. Now my other arm is ruined. What the hell is up with the Luo clan? How did they get two experts at the level of Eight Emperors?]
[At least there isn’t a third one showing up…]
“Hey, who’s next?”
Qiu Yanhai’s question had his heart shivering.
Whoosh~
A figure in white flashed over, Xue Qingjian. She glanced at his ruined hands and snapped at Qiu Yanhai, “Wasn’t this a spar? Why go all out like Old Li? How am I to train against a handicapped adversary? I can’t gauge my Imperial Mark like this.”
“Sorry, honey, it was in the heat of the moment, he-he-he…” Qiu Yanhai gave a goony smile.
[Train? You’re using me for a punching bag?]
The muscled guy noticed Xue Qingjian at peak Emperor Stage and cried out, “Just how many Emperors do you have?”
“All of them here.”
Xue Qingjian pointed at the group below and they all flew up, with dozens at peak power among the hundreds.
The dreadful maelstrom of auras had the muscled guy’s face twitching.
[Curses! Damn fakers, what are you doing siding with the Eight Emperors at your level? You could just thrash them and take everything!]
[That’s why you challenged us, you have the power. But we’ve come prepared and won’t fail.]
The muscled guy roared.
The people started and saw his smug smile, “Humph, no matter how many you are, you’ll all die. I didn’t come alone. There’s two dozen peak experts beside the three elders. Each of them is as strong as me. None of you will survive this!”
“What?” The group shouted.
The muscled man smirked, “Scared?”
“Awesome! More sparring partners, ha-ha-ha…”
The group cheered in excitement and thrill of battle.
The muscled guy was dumbstruck, “Hey, have you lost it? Our elders are Saints! We also have two dozen peak Emperors! What’s there to laugh about?”
“We’re so excited since you came right as we became Emperors to test ourselves, ha-ha-ha…”
Murong Lie sighed, “We thought of taking you with us to spar since you’re a peak Emperor Stage dragon, since dragons are far stronger than humans and should meet our standards. Alas, look how you ended up after just two bouts; you’re no training material at all. To test ourselves, we need Saints. Of course we’d be excited with your elders coming over.”
“But how do we split them? There’s just three of them.” Wine Sword Immortal posed a very good question.
Danqing Shen said, “Dragon Saints can’t be normal. We’ll have to go three or four against one, so there’s no need to take turns.”
The Sword Kings nodded.
“Leave the strongest to me for a while.”
The group turned to find Sword Child there as well, “I’m dad’s sword and reached peak Emperor Stage thanks to his inspiration. A couple of dragon Saints aren’t a problem to me. Just leave them to me when you find it too tough to go on.”
Their eyes twitched and gave him a nasty look, “We won’t give you the chance. Young master can just watch from the sidelines.”
“Stubborn fools.” Sword Child turned his head away.
The muscled guy had a dumb stare.
[Are these guys human? We came to destroy them yet they take us for training partners? Are they that strong?]
The muscled guy’s beliefs crumbled then and there.
[What’s wrong with today’s generation? Since when did humans become stronger than dragons?]
Whoosh~
Dozens of figures appeared, with the three dragon elders in the lead.
Elder Bai Long said, “What happened? Did you meet an expert and call for help?”
The muscle guy’s lip shook, raising his ruined arms and pointed at the hundreds of people in front.
The elders gasped.
[Why are there so many Emperors? It’s like an Eight Emperors’ faction.]
[No, not even they have so many peak Emperors.]
Sss~
The elders shuddered, their spine tingling under the gaze of ten people locking onto them like prey.
[What did we get ourselves into?]
[Wait.]
[Since when did humans look at dragons like that? We’re dragon Saints too…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1241 - 1241, Dragon Form
chapters.content:
Chapter 1241, Dragon Form
Translator: StarReader
Editor: CutieBinkie
Proofreader: Papatonks
“Pick your targets. Charge!”
Having long been ready, Murong Lie and the rest shouted with zeal, each after one dragon expert. The rest followed after them.
The elders gasped, “You didn’t explain to them who we are?”
“I did!”
The muscled guy shook his head, “It’s because of it they don’t fear us, wanting to fight us instead.”
“For crying out loud, what is wrong with them? These humans don’t even respect us. We’ll have to cull a hundred and make an example of them!”
Elder Bai Ling roared, letting his hand drop at the incoming Luo tide, with him taking the lead to charge, “Attack! These humans must’ve forgotten our might after so many years. Let them suffer for it!”
Draconic roars littered the sky as the two dozen dragon experts followed him into battle.
Boom!
The savage shockwave shook the space as it spread from the impact. The two dozen dragons were up against hundreds of Luo clansmen, with even the elders facing three or four Sword Kings.
This showed a clear contrast between the two races, with dragons tens of times stronger.
The shock, however, came for those prideful dragons.
[Divine Dragon Sweep!]
Elder Bai Long unleashed a mighty palm, an image of a hundreds of meters long draconic tail lashing out appeared behind, leaving spatial distortions in its wake.
Under such power, the landscape would change for thousands of miles, with the Luo clan’s town flattened.
Decimating Lash!
Vaulting Dragon Cleave!
Sundering Lightning!
Murong Lie, Danqing Shen and Baili Yulei intervened with their Imperial Mark made of their sword arts. The dragon tail broke down into nothing.
Elder Bai Long shuddered back five steps and looked back in shock.
[It can’t be! Three peak human Emperors blocked my attack. They’re not your normal Emperors for sure!]
Elder Bai Long was grave, now understanding why these folk were so antagonistic. They were freaks!
The other side faltered five steps as well, looking at the elder with thrill and astonishment.
[That’s a dragon Saint for you.]
They could only fight him together. It didn’t matter though, for in a spar, one had to go all out to make the most of it.
This was the expert that could test their limits and unearth their potential for more.
The trio’s eyes burned with battlelust.
Hei Long and Chi Long met their own match, looking just as dark. As for the other twenty plus dragon Emperors, they had to contend with ‘normal’ Luo clan Emperors, tens of them each.
As the ardent fight went on, the proud dragons realized these humans weren’t normal. They doubted they could even beat them at this point.
The muscled guy who started it all sighed.
[What have we gotten ourselves into? This isn’t just some normal human gathering. Their power is beyond human, close to that of spiritual beasts.]
The three elders were beyond mere dragon Emperors, yet three to four humans could hold them back while other dragons couldn’t…
“Ancient experts!”
Elder Bai Long fought with Danqing Shen’s group a few more times and turned grave.
Hei Long and Chi Long nodded. The rest were dumbstruck, keeping away from their battles for now.
The muscled guy with ruined arms flashed to the elder’s side and asked, “Elder Bai Long, what is this about ancient experts?”
“In ancient times there were humans that could fight sacred beasts and dragons. Among them were the ten ancient Sovereigns, who could surpass even the five sacred beasts.”
Bai Long spoke, “All the cultivators under the ten Sovereigns had the power to fight us dragons. But after the bloody war, many perished. The strength of spiritual beasts and dragons is innate, we hadn’t changed, while humans lost their roots. That’s why humans today are weaker than spiritual beasts. Even if you take the strongest and loftiest of the Seven Sacred Mountains, they still can’t…”
Hei Long said, “They remind us of the fights with the ancient humans. It’ll be hard to beat them if we keep holding back. Dragons, assume your true form! We’re going all out!”
[Dragon form?]
The dragons gasped.
That was their true nature, meaning their power would be on another level.
They were strong to begin with in human form, handling other equal stage human cultivators with relative ease. They only went full dragon when they had no choice, uncaring of the shame of having their bodies harmed. They were just too prideful to admit that the weak humans were worthy of seeing their true form.
Since antiquity, around half a million years ago, the last time this happened was when the Seven Sacred Mountains came charging in. Now it was going to happen again today, when they weren’t even pushed back?
[Isn’t this overestimating them a little?]
“Elder Hei Long…”
“I don’t want to hear it. Since they have ancient expert strength, we’ll fight them for real!”
Hei Long’s eyes were firm, turning to the other elders, “They say ancient dragons fought with humans using their true bodies. What do you think?”
The others nodded, “Agreed!”
The elders jumped out of the fight and into the skies. With a roar, their bodies glowed white and soon revealed themselves as three huge red, white, and black dragons with unspeakable aura. Their tail swish sent cutting winds.
Under the fierce winds, the Luo clan town threatened to crumble.
“They’re now tens of times stronger!”
Danqing Shen gasped in shock, “Fellas, this looks bad. It’s no longer a spar now. Three of us aren’t enough to take even one.”
Murong Lie’s face twitched, sweat trickling down his brow, “Yeah, dragon Saints are no pushovers. We have to stop them somehow before they ruin the town. We just got a foothold on Sacred Domain but now it’s about to be destroyed.”
They all gave grave nods.
“You should be proud of forcing us into our true form, Luo clan, but now it’s over!”
The wounded muscled guy had a sinister grin of disdain, “We once faced a thousand Saints with a hundred true dragon Saints, destroying a mountain. While only the elders remain, with the two dozen dragon Emperors, you’re finished. A true dragon Emperor is enough to face your Saints, ha-ha-ha…”
The muscled guy roared and turned into a hundred meter long earth dragon. His two claws were wounded, but was still more than enough to handle the normal Luo Emperors.
Following his action, the rest of the dragons changed as well.
The sky was now filled with huge dragons, ready to unleash destruction upon the world.
Looking at the incoming apocalypse, the people’s hearts shank, their brows locked, and their breathing heavy.
“Leave the dragon Saints to me. Former Sword Kings like you should have no trouble dealing with the dragon Emperors, or there’d be no point in you being here.”
A lazy voice sounded as slow steps approached…

chapters.title: Chapter 1242: Injuring Three Dragons
chapters.content:
Chapter 1242: Injuring Three Dragons
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Hu~
The black figure floated into the coming storm.
Bai Longs eyes shone and he swished his white tail at the heads of the humans below, like a scythe to reap their lives.
Whoosh~
The huge tail unleashed a terrible power, crushing the citys walls to dust.
Danqing Shens group was grave yet didnt dodge.
Whoosh!
A black light shot out of nowhere and met the tail.
[What?!]
Bai Long felt his huge and all powerful tail come to a halt from something beyond his control. He even felt pain from it.
[What is going]
Bai Long was shocked, watching as white scales fell down and blood spurted everywhere. Not just the sensitive dragons, but even the humans were overwhelmed by the scent of blood.
The dragons gasped at Elder Bais red tail, How did it get hurt?
Who did that? Get out here, now!
Bai Long roared with bloodshot eyes.
One strike had him bleeding. It was but a flesh wound, but that was a power neither of the ones below had.
He couldnt believe the Luo clan had an even greater expert than these. And by the looks of his wound, he could kill dragon Saints.
Bai Long was grave, with the other two growing tense.
[Just what is the Luo clan? How many experts do they have?]
A light footstep sounded in the stillness, revealing a wicked grin and on the face of an eight-year old.
Ha-ha-ha, Im dads sword. Cause trouble here and youll be leaving in pieces. Dragon Saints sure are amazing, only getting your scales peeled when it shouldve killed you. Thats one tough body.
A child?
Bai Long gaped.
[Did he shoot that sword attack? A damn child harmed me?]
[Is the Luo clan filled with one freakier monster than the next?]
Was it you who harmed me?
Dragon Saints are strong and renowned in the Sacred Domain. I guess with dad away, Im the only one in the Luo clan that can harm you guys. Got a problem with that?
Sword Child gave a taunting smirk, Or do you believe that anyone here can hurt you now? What a bummer. Since anyone can kill you, are you worms or dragons? Ha-ha-ha
How dare you!
Hei Long roared in fury, flicking his tail at Sword Child, Have a taste of this then! Feel free to dodge, but your town will be no more. Be buried with the rest of them!
Hu~
A huge shadow came crashing down, overshadowing the sun.
Sword Child smiled and charged at Hei Long with his right hand shining black, Then why dont you try my power? Dragons and sacred beasts arent the toughest in the world. I have the strongest body, ha-ha-ha
Apocalyptic Sword!
Bam!
The oversized black tail clashed with the tiny Sword Child in a glorious explosion. The shockwaves spread everywhere and warped the skies, with the dragons forced back under the pressure.
[What monster is he? How can a child take on Elder Hei Longs tail?]
[Did he just say hes dads sword? Does that make his dad a god? Youre saying the Luo clans true expert hasnt come out yet?]
The dragons were shocked to the core.
[Have we rushed things by coming here now? How were we supposed to know there was such a mighty faction hiding here?]
Their shock didnt stop there, watching with bugged eyes as a black figure punched through the huge tail, bearing a wicked grin.
Hei Long howled in pain and anger.
[Holy hell! He hurt another dragon Saint, and this ones much worse!]
[How is the kid so strong? Its harrowing!]
Danqing Shens side grinned. Sword Child was something the Sacred Domain had never seen, a Sovereign weapon. The limited cultivation was lacking against a dragon Saint, obvious from the shallow wound his sword strike left.
When it came to sharpness and hardness, he was unmatched even by sacred beasts, let alone some wiggling reptiles. Using his body as a blade, the bloody outcome was more than obvious.
No matter how hard one trained their hands, they couldnt break a nail.
Danqing Shens group sneered at the two wounded dragons.
[Dragons pride themselves on their toughest bodies, but look where that got them, ha-ha-ha]
Pa!
Sword Child looked smug at his handiwork, but then a shadow loomed over him and he found himself unable to move.
A red dragon stared down at him and clawed.
Elder Chi Long took advantage of his lapse in judgment to grab him.
Elder Chi Long smirked, Ha-ha-ha, brat, youre too cocky. Humans are tricky with their many and strong martial arts, but your bodies are frail. I dont know what art you pulled to hurt them, but I got you now. I need to just squeeze and youre paste!
Whats holding you? Sword Child taunted with a raised eyebrow, Few things can kill me in the world, but squeezing aint one of them, he-he-he.
The huge dragon eye twitched and Chi Long raged, You got spunk, so allow me to share with you the feeling of having all your bones crushed.
Chi Long squeezed hard.
His claw hardly moved even as he strained to make a fist. Something was stopping him from doing it.
What the hell?
Chi Long used two claws this time, to no avail.
Sword Child rubbed his chin in a most condescending way, Old timer, any harder and youll be breaking your knuckles. My bones are the toughest there is!
Damn brat, dont get cocky. No matter how tough humans are, they can never reach a dragons level! Chi Long couldnt accept it, squeezing with more strength.
The rest just stared. Sword Child yawned, feeling no pain at all. He found it more amusing to give the straining dragon a taunting look.
After having enough of trying, Chi Long huffed and relaxed his grip, knowing how futile it all was.
Sword Childs eyes shone with bloodlust.
Chi Long!
Bai Long cried out.
A black sword wave shot through the red claw and showered the skies in blood.
Four large rough talons rumbled as they landed on the ground.
Chi Long wailed like a banshee. Sword Child flew up and laughed, I told you so, old timer. Now you broke your fingers.

chapters.title: Chapter 1243: The Real Monster
chapters.content:
Chapter 1243: The Real Monster
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Everyone gasped at this unbelievable sight, their hearts jumping from shock. The dragons felt fear as Sword Childs cold eyes snapped on them.
[What abomination is he? Elder Chi Longs hardened claw ended up without four talons under his attack. Its nothing short of a fairy tale!]
[Youre saying the brat is tougher than a dragon Saint? He cant be squished?]
[Is he not human?]
He was not, so there was no point for you to even try!
Danqing Shens group knew this best. Sword Childs display still sent them reeling in shock.
[Hes a chip off the old block for sure, using the same tactics and toying with the enemy.]
The dragon Saints fell for the enemys scheme and played to his rhythm instead of their own. Sword Child was an Emperor but had the body of a divine sword.
The dragon Saints couldve just used their powers to wipe out his soul and be done with it without a hassle. This was where excessive pride in their draconic bodies got them, thinking it infallible and suffering for it.
Chi Long kept howling in pain and fury, looking at Sword Child with savagery.
The other two elders were just as hateful, looking at him for a sign of weakness.
Dragons, attack together! Destroy the Luo clan! Give the city no quarter! Chi Long roared, giving a bloody order.
The rest howled and charged. Endless dragon breaths were spewed as they came down upon the humans, with no end in sight.
Danqing Shens group jumped to stop it, Clan guardians, destroy the enemy before they call for help!
The Luo clan and the dragons were at war. The testing and training was over. There was no honor here, no mercy, only revenge, for the ruined claw, for the heavy wounds.
The dragons could take on ten easily, while the Luo clan outnumbered them ten to one. Danqing Shen and the other true experts could also take one dragon alone, boosting the Luo clans morale.
In this war, both sides were equally matched, with neither giving an inch.
The three dragon Saints grew grave from above. They came here ready for this but even they did not expect to meet such strong opposition outside of facing the Sacred Mountains.
The outcome of this war rested solely on their strongest from each side, the elders and the freaky child.
[Once we beat him, we can just mow down the rest of them. The same applies to the kid, killing our dragons like nothing.]
The fate of both sides rested on just four people.
Bai Long and the elders flicked their tails and shot for Sword Child together.
A spectator would think dragons have lost all their honor to gang up on a child..
[Arent you three the elders on top of the dragon clan? Youre ganging up on a frail boy?]
They couldnt care less, for this boy gave them a bloody lesson. Rather than wait for the him to take them down one at a time, they would finish him then and there.
Bam!
Hei Long took the lead and hissed as he whipped his tail at Sword Child, sending him hurtling.
Bai Long waited behind to claw him and sent him reeling in another direction. The intense shock of the blow got his body shaking, though he didnt care, since it wouldnt hurt. Physical attacks were useless.
The dragons still didnt get it after all this time. Chi Long shot ahead of him and struck with savage fury many times stronger than before, sending him flying again.
Sword Child was treated like a ball, passed around between the three dragons thousands of times.
A human wouldve been reduced to nothing ages ago, while Sword Child didnt even feel an itch, sneering at them.
After bouncing him around tens of thousands of times, the dragons grew tired and stopped.
For crying out loud, what is this kid? Weve been attacking him for so long but cant even hurt him. Is he even human?
Chi Long panted hard, while the other two nodded.
Sword Child snickered, drawing two fingers and cutting the air with them, letting out a whistling and metallic sound.
Had enough, old timers? Now its my turn!
Sword Child shot for Chi Long, I took four talons last time and now Ill have the entire claw, ha-ha-ha
Chi Long suffered once and leaned out of the way and dodged with his tail. Sword Childs finger slashed a black sword wave and took some of his scales along with blood.
Not bad. Didnt think youd be so nimble with such a huge body.
Sword Child taunted, slashing where Chi Long dodged, A shame my sword isnt so easy to avoid.
Whoosh~
A sword wave shot from his finger, right for the huge dragon.
Chi Long shook in horror. While it wasnt Sword Childs direct attack, he still couldnt take it on. He might end up cut in half.
In this critical juncture, he couldnt dodge and blocking was ill-advised.
He took a deep breath and blew, releasing a scarlet glow, Draconic Wave!
Bam!
The two attacks met and with a resounding boom, they shook everything around. Chi Long shuddered and looked grave, while Sword Child got pushed ten feet back, looking a little flushed.
Bai Long lit up and cried, Look, the kid got pushed back and seems to be in some pain.
How come? We pounded him thousands of times already and it didnt even scratch him Hei Long frowned.
Bai lOng said, I got it! His reaction is due to using our powers. Its not his body that reacted, but his soul. He has a tough body, beyond ours, but his soul is only that of an Emperor, not so monstrous. Use soul attacks and hell die!
Right! Weve gotten so used to dealing with humans with our bodies that we forgot about attacking his soul. Now that we found such an abominably tough opponent, well have to learn from them and use soul attacks, ha-ha-ha Hei Long mocked. Chi Long lit up as well and grinned.
Sword Child frowned, his heart sinking as he inched away.
[Crud, the fools found me out. Not even a hundred dragons could break my body, but my soul]
Sword Child looked around, searching for Danqing Shen or the others to join up and defend his soul.
The three dragons found his weakness and instantly unleashed three red, black and white glows at him.
Draconic Wave!
Sword Childs eye twitched and he dodged once and twice, only to find himself in front of the last, blocking his retreat and forcing him to face it.
He swung his fingers before the scarlet glow, blocking it, but that action shuddered his soul and messed with his tempo.
The three glows combined just then and appeared once more.
Sss~
Sword Child gasped inside, with no chance to dodge. Blocking the combined attacks would leave him gravely wounded as well.
He was stuck.
Something the three huge dragons relished.
[The freak is done for, he-he-he]
Hum~
Five colored dragons joined together formed a black mirror right in front of Sword Child.
Dad!
Sword Child cheered while the dragons hearts sank.
Dad!
[Does that mean the real monster is here?]

chapters.title: Chapter 1244: Heaven Devouring Wraith Mirror
chapters.content:
Chapter 1244: Heaven Devouring Wraith Mirror
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Boom!
The combined attack of the dragons landed on the mirror, making it shake a bit. Black energy then formed vortexes on its surface, sucking up the power into those abysses.
[This cant be!]
The three pairs of huge draconic eyes shuddered in disbelief at the weird mirror. Domain soul Imperial Mark, it can devour anything!
Even so, we unleashed our Draconic Waves, not something a mere Imperial Mark could absorb. Just how was that domain soul formed to be so tough and take it on?
Hei Long cried out, staring at the black mirror with fear.
[The kids father is a monster as well, defying all logic.]
Whoosh~
Rumbling came from the mirror as black dragon claws emerged from the vortexes, shooting straight for the dragons in the sky.
Crack~
The dragons were still out of it, only waking up when there were five black claws on them. Those claws were hard as diamonds, making the dragon Emperors unable to break out of them.
What the hell are these things? Agh
The black dragon claws pulled one dragon into the mirror. He howled just before his end came, followed by many other dragons.
The sky was filled with draconic howls one second, then eerie still the next, with the sun shining on the remaining three dragon Saints.
The dragons and Danqing Shens group gasped.
[What kind of Imperial Mark did Zhuo Fan make? How is it that insane? We barely get to hold our own against one, yet he finishes all of them like nothing.]
[This is the power of the pillar of the Luo clan!
Clap~
The dumbstruck humans and dragons snapped out at the sudden sound.
They found out the dragons had black claws on them as well, unable to break free.
They got to experience for themselves the terror of their fellow dragons. The claws were strong, stronger than them.
But they still couldnt get why a human would have such a deadly Imperial Mark.
They didnt have the time to make sense of any of it, stuck in a dire situation. Despite being Saints, these humans could actually kill them, especially now that the true monster was here.
The three dragons exchanged a glance and used all their power to fly around.
Clap~
The black dragon claws that foiled dragon Emperors stood no chance against the Saints, breaking down.
Despite that, they chose to flee with a flick of their tail instead of pursuing the fight.
[Curses, we screwed up badly! Just you wait until were back with a real army, then well flatten you and rescue our people!]
Leaving so soon? Ill go stop them! Sword Child sneered.
Sword Child, stop. Ill do it. A shout reached him.
Whoosh!
Zhuo Fan flashed in the sky and the Heaven Devouring Wraith Mirror entered his body.
Looking at the parting dragons, he had a nasty smirk. He vanished from his spot and appeared before the trio.
So fast!
The dragons stammered from shock, What skill was that to catch up to a dragon Saints speed?
[Is he that monstrous? He wont be easy to deal with!]
[But were not about to just keel over just because you stopped us! Humph, even the human Saints have trouble against us!]
The three demons shared a look and flicked their tails as they charged.
Fighting against an unknown like Zhuo Fan could lead to annihilation, but a sudden charge was not something a human could stop either.
The sudden display of power caused the sky to sport black cracks from the three waves of light, while the world around was devastated by a fierce storm.
Alas, they happened to meet not just anyone, but Zhuo Fan who inherited four Sovereign paths
Raising his Qilin arm, Zhuo Fan stood calmly, giving off an eerie vibe as the unleashed storm had no effect on him.
Qilin Tyrant Fist!
He faced the mighty attacks with but a fist. It flashed scarlet for a moment, then it exploded like a volcano.
Boom!
The world around them shook under the deafening explosion, with the sky now replaced by a gigantic black hole. The dragons felt their heads overcome by a searing pain as blood flowed down their faces.
The huge bodies spun a dozen times before they could straighten and look at Zhuo Fans grin with fear.
[How is this possible?]
[Hes just a peak Emperor and blocked us with a punch. Just how]
They recalled Sword Child.
[This guy is the freaks father. Then he must be even worse. His sons body is an abomination and so must the father!]
The dragons grew tense, their blood running cold.
[This is bad. We might not get out of this alive]
The audience was bug-eyed. Just a punch stopped the three dragons.
[Steward Zhuo is even more of a monster now.]
Damn it, why are we even further behind him? Baili Jingtian gnashed his teeth.
Baili Yulei chuckled and shook his head.
Bali Yuyu entrusted him to look after Baili Jingtian. Now there was no point. Each time they broke through, Zhuo Fan would always stand the highest. It got so bad that it became a gulf between them.
[Now we cant even touch him.]
[Yuyu, you can rest easy now, ha-ha-ha]
Zhuo Fan did not finish the dragons, cupping his hands, Dragon friends, its been ages.
You knew wed come?
Word travels fastest in Gambling Town. News of wielding a dragon scale sacred weapon would one day reach the dragons and that would mean youd come here.
You mean this was all a trap?
Bai Long gasped, What are you? What do you want? What are you humans up to? Do you want the Sacred Mountains to wage war with us again?
Zhuo Fan had a vague smile, Seniors, were unrelated to the Sacred Mountains. I only wish to invite you over for a few days and talk.
Anything you wish to say, you can do it back in our Dragon Lands! Bai Long shouted with unease.
Zhuo Fan sighed, I see you dont believe me. Sorry in advance for making it hard on you, elders. Shadow Bind!
Zhuo Fan flashed next to them and three shadows shot from Zhuo Fan and wrapped around them, preventing them from moving

chapters.title: Chapter 1245: Talks
chapters.content:
Chapter 1245: Talks
Proofreader
: Papatonks
The black mirror reemerged and Zhuo Fan waved the three dragons into it before vanishing.
Danqing Shen sighed, Boy, I knew it the moment I saw you that you were a dragon among men. Youve come a long way, so far that youre making all of us old men amazed at your progress. Even the Invincible Sword didnt make us feel so far behind.
The others nodded with envy.
Old Dan, youre too kind. I was only lucky to receive seniors guidance.
Zhuo Fan smiled, pacifying their downcast moods, Elder Li, did you find anything about what I asked?
Li Jingtian bowed, Steward Zhuo, forgive me. This turned out to be hard. The area was erased of any clues.
Erased?
Yes, they say the sky fell a hundred years ago, that not one survivor remained from the sudden destruction. Li Jingtian reported with doubt, The strange thing is, any disaster should have at least have some survivors. Even if they did die in the end, some clues had to be left behind, or traces of what happened. Yet there was absolutely nothing. The only evidence people once lived there were the merchants that used to pass through fleeing for their lives upon the sudden change in the sky.
Zhuo Fan frowned, It was done quite thoroughly.
Steward Zhuo, should I continue?
No, I dont think theres anything else to find.
Zhuo Fan sighed, What cities are Ye Lin, young Sanzi and Qiaoer guarding? Call them over and send someone else instead.
Yes!
Li Jingtian bowed and left. Zhuo Fan waved for the others to disperse while he returned to his room.
He was an Emperor now, but he still needed to ponder the four Sovereign paths. The strong dragons forced him out ahead of time.
A month later, Li Jingtian shouted from beyond his door, Steward Zhuo, Ye Lin, young master San and young miss Qiaoer are waiting in the hall.
Ill be right there.
Zhuo Fans eyes shone as he opened them.
He walked into the hall and the three people there greeted.
Father!
Elder brother!
Theres no need for courtesy, just sit! Zhuo Fan smiled, How was it? Was it nice and easy ruling over a city?
The trio sneered, with Ye Lin beginning, Elder brother, theres nothing more boring for us than playing as city lords. We might as well be lords over in the mortal domain instead of coming to the Sacred Domain with you. While youve been working behind our backs lately.
Whats wrong? Zhuo Fan asked.
Young Sanzi mocked, Father, weve been away for so long that only after returning did we find out that those old codgers advanced. We heard youre the cause behind it. Cant you let us enjoy it too? Theyre all Emperors now, having the same strength as we have. Now we fell behind. Who are we to blame for that?
Yeah, its not fair leaving us out of such a grand occasion! Ye Lin huffed in anger.
Zhuo Fan sighed, Take it easy. That was an accident. I got four Sovereign legacies and had to enter seclusion. How was I supposed to know the Sovereign paths would light the sky and help not just me but the whole Luo clan in advancing? You cant expect me to know that. Young Sanzi, youre also sacred beasts, making the insight ineffective. Your bloodline is the most important, so why nag me over this?
We just think its unfair for Ye Lin! young Sanzi rolled his eyes and Qiaoer sulked.
Ye Lin nodded, Elder brother, you have to make it up for me. Let me enjoy the grand Dao lights as well!
Its not up to me. The paths arent mine. I cant control it.
Zhuo Fan shrugged, but chuckled at Ye Lins downcast gaze, But I can make it up to you in another way to catch up to those guys in no time, a cultivation shortcut.
What is it?
The three perked up.
Zhuo Fan grinned and as a black energy streaked around, it left behind two dozen figures slumped on the ground.
The trio looked oddly at them.
Zhuo Fan smiled, Dragon friends, let us talk. How may I call you?
[Dragons?]
The trio stared in amazement.
Having just got back, they didnt know of the battle a month ago, that the dragons came knocking and that Zhuo Fan snatched them up. Looking at the slumped dragons, they felt curious and amiable.
[Theyre Dragon Ancestors offspring essentially]
Who are you? What do you want from us? Bai Long glared at Zhuo Fan, I warn you, do anything to us and our people will get you for it. Not even you can fight off the Dragon Lands endless experts!
Zhuo Fan put on a genial smile, bowing, Senior, we have no bad intention towards dragons. Quite the opposite, were both on the same side?
Same side? They all flinched in doubt.
[Were dragons and youre humans. Hows that the same side? Stop playing with us!]
Zhuo Fan pointed, Ye Lin, tell them about your master.
Dragon seniors, my master is one of the ancient five great sacred beasts, Decimating Dragon Ancestor. Ye Lin bowed with nothing but respect.
The dragons gasped, How can that be? Our ancestor fell in ancient times
Ye Lin, show them. Zhuo Fan waved.
Ye Lin lifted a finger and a golden fire burst out of it.
The elders felt the familiar energy and cried out, Yes, its Dragon Ancestors Decimating Golden Flame! Its the same fire from our Dragon Lands. How can you
Elder, did they steal it as well? The wounded muscled guy added.
The elders hesitated.
Ye Lin spoke with pride, Master told me sacred beast powers can destroy the world. They can only be imparted, lest one dares be destroyed instead. Stealing? I know that Dragon Lands hold the Decimating Golden Flame as well, but did any of you train in it?
Uh, well
Bai Long sighed, Yes, Elder Yun has managed to train in ancestors golden fire, but two years later the flames consumed him. Theres no surviving it unless the ancestor himself bestows it, even to dragons.
Then hes truly Dragon Ancestors successor? They were all baffled by this development.
Zhuo Fan pointed at young Sanzi and Qiaoer, They are Qiaoer and Thunder Phoenixs successors as well, true sacred beasts and not humans. Dragon Ancestor even trained them.
Zhuo Fan gave them a look and the two released their auras.
A savage red aura covered the city while purple lightning crackled in the sky.
This left them in an even bigger shock. They could feel a power like no other forcing them into submission from the two. Such pressure made their limbs soft and blocked their resistance.
Sacred beasts!
The elders were beyond thrilled, bowing with the rest of the dragons, They say the five great sacred beasts fought with the ten Sovereigns. I cant believe there would be successors. The day for our sacred beasts rise is nigh, ha-ha-ha.
The others cheered.
The Seven Sacred Mountains had pushed the dragons around for too long. Once the two sacred beasts matured, they would level them.
Zhuo Fans face twitched, Uh, dragon seniors, its too soon to rejoice.
Whats the problem? We now have sacred beasts and the time of spiritual beasts is just around the corner
Yes, you have sacred beasts, but humans have Sovereigns!
Sovereigns?
Bai Long said, Didnt they all die?
Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes and sneered, Who told you that? Couldnt they just hide? Anyway, I already met five of them. Four in Sacred Domain and one in mortal domain. Also, besides these two young sacred beasts, the other three are still trapped. Attacking humanity doesnt make sense. Youll only let the Sovereigns see you and ruin your efforts.

chapters.title: Chapter 1246: Teaming Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 1246: Teaming Up
Proofreader
: Papatonks
The dragons froze in place, with Bai Long shaking, Say what? The Sovereigns are still alive? That means humans arent finished yet!
I cant claim all ten are around, but theres still enough of them. Zhuo Fan snickered.
Their faces twitched with Bai Long sighing, Just who was it that spread the word the ten Sovereigns and the sacred beasts fell? Arent they still alive, here and now? You also mention that the other three sacred beasts are trapped? Our ancestor
Yes, hes trapped in a place called the mortal domain.
Zhuo Fan spoke gravely, You can tell that we have dragon souls. To form it, dragon power is needed. Theres no way for humans to steal it when youre guarding it with vehemence. With Dragon Ancestor in the mortal domain, only by gathering earth dragon souls to draw out the dragon power will it work. Since hes your primogenitor, drawing dragon power shouldnt be hard.
The others nodded, I see. So you all came from the mortal domain? Is Dragon Ancestor alright? How do we save him?
People, he is very much safe.
Zhuo Fan appeased, He cant go out just yet and sent us ahead to Sacred Domain.
Yet?
Yes, he cant break the mortal domains barrier, but its quite easy to break his cell. He wont do it, because of one man
Who?
The creator of mortal domain, the Heavenly Sovereign! Zhuo Fans eyes shone.
Bai Long cried out, The top Sovereign? He made the mortal domain?
It was meant as a prison, to confine the sacred beasts. The Heavenly Sovereign hasnt done anything to them all these years, making his situation unknown. Thats why Dragon Ancestor had us go ahead and scout the place for his trail. If the Heavenly Sovereign is weakened, itll be the best chance to strike. Also, weve made preparations in the Sacred Domain, to help all of them escape the mortal domain.
Then youre Dragon Ancestors envoy, here to help them! Bai Long was excited,
Zhuo Fan nodded without shame, Yes, this is sirs intent. To wait or strike true. Thats why Im saying were on the same side. Dragon Ancestor relies on us in the mortal domain and relies on you in the Sacred Domain. Will you help us?
Of course! Anything for Dragon Ancestor! Bai Long roared, the others joining him in standing tall.
It was his lifes greatest honor to lay his life for Dragon Ancestor.
Ye Lin sighed.
[They might look like humans, but theyre as simple as spiritual beasts where it counts. Dragon Ancestor has no trouble getting out and coming to Sacred Domain, but this bro of mine has mislead them.]
[He stands for the humans in the end anyhow, not wanting for the sacred beasts to reign once more.]
If it turned out that the Heavenly Sovereign was their common enemy, they would return. It all came down to Dragon Ancestors words, if they could be trusted.
Zhuo Fan offered a hand with a smile, Do we team up?
Were all doing this for Dragon Ancestor. That makes us family!
Pa!
Bai Long shook Zhuo Fans hand hard, We will do our all to go with your plan to save Dragon Ancestor. How may I call you?
Luo clans steward, Zhuo Fan!
Dragon clans elder, Bai Long! Bai Long grinned and patted his chest, You have an impressive body for a human. How did you train?
At Dragon Ancestors favor, he offered me a scale and reforged my body in the golden flames.
No wonder, ha-ha-ha Bai Long believed him more. With Dragon Ancestor coming, it was a reason to celebrate.
After pleasantries, Zhuo Fan pointed at his people, Our investigation is to thwart the Heavenly Sovereign, but first well need more strength. I ask Elder Bai to take these three to the Dragon Lands and teach them. They will act as representatives of our cooperation, and to also gather more men. They are two sacred beasts and Dragon Ancestors disciple. They have great authority among the sacred beasts.
Of course, Qilin is the head of beasts, Thunder Phoenix and Kunpeng oversee the north and south birds. Sea Ao rules the seas and Dragon Ancestor created his race. Most of all the spiritual beasts came from them, and they were once a force to be reckoned with in the Sacred Domain.
Bai Long sighed, Ever since the five sacred beasts fell, us dragons were the only one still putting up a fight against humans, with the birds and beasts scattering. This time is different. With the two of them calling them, attacking the Seven Sacred Mountains will be nothing, ha-ha-ha
Zhuo Fan nodded with a smile, Great, but lets be subtle about it and not let them catch wind of this. The Dragon Lands are vital in the Sacred Domain, with many eyes on them. Thats why we didnt come knocking the moment we got here, attracting the enemys attention. We thus thought of drawing you out to talk. The sacred weapon from a dragon scale comes from senior Kunpeng. He mustve forged it from a deceased dragon. I ask for your forgiveness.
Its fine. Were not petty to mind trifles. Its all for Dragon Ancestor! The dragons didnt mind it.
Its unknown when Qilin and Thunder Phoenix will mature, but a war is knocking and we need all the sacred beasts. Is there a way for them to grow faster among spiritual beasts?
Well
Bai Long hesitated, We are the only spiritual beasts able to take human form, and that is because of our precious land, Dragonizing Pool! In the ancient past, when humans and spiritual beasts were at peace, Dragon Ancestor and the Shadow Sovereign made it. It contains the essence of Dragon Ancestor and the core of Shadow Sovereigns path. We are able to find human reflections in its waters, using its power to turn human. Our own strength is greatly improved as well.
Sacred beasts can turn human by themselves, but if they can go through the Dragonizing Pool, taking in Dragon Ancestors power, it will deepen their form. The Shadow Sovereigns path is truly intricate, not only dividing people into flesh and soul, but shadows as well. By bringing out the power of their shadow, they can maximize their potential. Dragonizing Pool is a true masterpiece of cooperation between a Sovereign and sacred beast!
Zhuo Fan nodded and rejoiced inside, Great! Ye Lin, you guys got your wish, receiving a dragons favor to make up for your weakness.
The trio nodded with eagerness.
Elder Bai, what of the Fountain of Youth? One dragon spoke.
Zhuo Fan turned to him, Fountain of Youth?
Yes.
Bai Long wore a heavy frown, The Fountain of Youth had been passed down in ancient times by its creator, the Child Sovereign. Those that bathed in its waters will remain young and strong for all their lives, even in seniority. The Fountain of Youth helps ones heart as well, shedding away all worries and attaining inner peace. When humans cultivate in the fountain, their hearts will not be plagued by any negative emotions, heightening their insight towards a Sovereign path to incredible degree. I believe that by taking the young sacred beasts there, they would reach their peak even faster.
Zhuo Fan laughed, Not just them, but us as well. But will the dragons share it with us? Ha-ha-ha
Steward Zhuo, you jest. The Fountain of Youth has long since left our hands. Whats there to share?
Wha
Five hundred thousand years ago, the Seven Sacred Mountains stole it from us.
Bai Long sighed, It is now locked in the Seven Sacred Mountains, with only their most important people going in. Each Sacred Mountain takes up duty to protect it every year. Theres no way for us to enter. But now we have the two young masters and we can amass troops to raid the Seven Sacred Mountains, taking back the Fountain of Youth!
Nodding, Zhuo Fans eyes burned with battlelust, No matter where the Heavenly Sovereign is right now, we shall take the Seven Sacred Mountains first. Please return and be ready. I will work from my end.
My thoughts exactly, Steward Zhuo, Ha-ha-ha The elders laughed and cupped their hands.
They would finally get revenge on the Seven Sacred Mountains after all these years of torment.
They couldnt beat all seven mountains, but with the sacred beasts calling the other spiritual beasts, the mountains wouldnt stand a chance.
Zhuo Fan talked some more before sending them away. Ye Lins group going as well. Only Chi Longs wounds were a bit problematic, but Zhuo Fan had understanding of the Shadow Sovereigns path and using reflection and shadows, he left all of them speechless as he performed miracles.
[He really is Dragon Ancestors envoy!]
Zhuo Fan eased up with them gone, having found backing in the Sacred Domain at long last. He could go up against the Eight Emperors without worry of other powers blocking him.
[Not even the Seven Sacred Mountains]

chapters.title: Chapter 1247: Takeover
chapters.content:
Chapter 1247: Takeover
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Demonic Emperor sir, Steward Zhuo is seeking an audience!
W-what did you say?
In Devil Mountains large and glorious hall, a man in black kneeled before the stunned Zhao Chen. After hearing it a third time he reacted, Thats not possible. Didnt he die in the Nether Sea? How show him in already!
Yes!
Zhuo Fan walked it with a wide smile, bowing, Demonic Emperor sir, have you been well?
S-Steward Zhuo, youre still alive!
Zhao Chen laughed and patted his shoulder, Great, my aide has come back to me. You have no idea how pained I was seeing you crushed. Nights have been hard, the memory is still fresh.
Zhuo Fan sneered inside, but only showed a smile, You honor me, sir.
Go on, tell me, how did you get out? Zhao Chens eyes grew suspicious.
Zhuo Fan made an excuse, The Nether Sovereign has been an almighty being since ancient times, but he doesnt waste time on nobodies. Everything was but a test. As long as we didnt fear death, hed let us go.
A blessing in disguise!
Zhao Chen sighed, then stuttered, W-why is your cultivation at the 3rd layer of Qi Condensation, Steward Zhuo? It was bad enough with only a Bone Tempering cultivation, yet now you regressed?
Zhuo Fans regression was a joyous occasion, all thanks to understanding the Sovereign paths and his broadened mentality.
Zhuo Fan sighed, I had the fortune of passing the Nether Sovereigns trials through a fluke, but as I was so weak, the nether energy corroded my cultivation.
It mustve been so hard on you, Steward Zhuo.
Zhao Chen sighed, But since the Nether Sovereign let you go, he mustve admired your talent. Is there no way of recovering from this?
Zhuo Fan caught his meaning, fishing for anything that Zhuo Fan mightve gotten from the Nether Sea and wanting to get a bite himself.
He finally got to what Zhuo Fan wanted, egging him on, Sir is insightful to find out that the Nether Sovereign did give me a cultivation method right at the end.
What is it?
Zhuo Fan revealed a jade slip, The Nether Script provided critical aid when my cultivation regressed. It says it can speed up cultivation and should recover my original level in three months. Cultivating further, it would be even faster. In ten years, Im sure to make some waves.
So magical?
Zhao Chen snatched the jade slip by reflex, uncaring that this was anothers lifeline. He was no different from a thief.
This was the attraction of a Sovereigns items, with the whole world lusting after them.
Zhuo Fan knew this all too well, using it as bait.
[Make anothers cultivation efforts your own. Absorb it within you]
Zhao Chen gasped, The Sovereigns cultivation method is incredible. It can even do this?
Yes, how else would you get instant results, ha-ha-ha!
Zhuo Fan said, Its a pity my cultivation is too low and I cant take on much. I could only absorb one Qi Condensation cultivator a day. I cant have anyone else know as well, lest I earn public anger. Sir has to be careful.
Zhao Chen was too thrilled to care, Yeah, very careful, ha-ha-ha
Why would you show me such a dangerous thing? Arent you afraid I would steal it and silence you? Steward Zhuo, you could never make such a basic mistake.
Zhuo Fan stared hard at him. He was obsessed with the new cultivation method, but not enough to rob him of his mind.
Zhuo Fan nodded, Sir is right. The cultivation art isnt a danger to just everyone, but to yourself as well. Thats why I wish to share it. I dont need many resources now, but with time the demand will rise as soon as I grow in strength. I could never reveal my new strength so I need sirs help.
Makes sense.
Zhao Chen squinted at the jade slip.
He knew exactly what resources Zhuo Fan needed and that this cultivation method would incite hatred from everyone.
At the same time, the lure of power was too much for some to bear. A swift rise was impossible by common means, only through this art.
No one wants to part with anything that comes from a Sovereigns domain.
Tracing the jade slip, Zhao Chen muttered, staring hard at Zhuo Fan, Steward Zhuo is right about one thing. Training in this art while avoiding suspicion will only work if you have me covering for you. But now that I have it, why should I help you? The less who know about this, the better.
Zhao Chen exploded with power, filled with bloodthirst, and ready to silence Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan said casually, Demonic Emperor sir, I wouldnt do that if I were you.
And why not?
Sir, you need far more resources than me. How many would you procure by yourself? Youll still need someone to help you out. That means letting someone know about this. Can you guarantee they wont sell you out?
Zhao Chen furrowed his brow, his bloodlust deflated.
Zhuo Fan smiled, If sir is willing to trust me, I will help sir in this aspect, training with sir and becoming your accomplice. Exposing it will harm me as well, so we need to work together. Why then would sir kill such a loyal helper and risk taking another that might betray you at any time?
Steward Zhuo!
Zhao Chens eyes shook and sighed, Youve thought of everything. I have no reason to strike you. Guard!
Sir!
A man in black rushed inside and bowed, Demonic Emperor sir, what are your orders?
Everything, my domain and Devil Mountain, are for Steward Zhuo to manage. His word is mine. Let everyone know!
Uhm
The guy flinched.
[Isnt that the same as making him the Demonic Emperor? All he is missing is a title. What if he goes for a takeover?]
[If Zhuo Fans word is Demonic Emperors, what are you going to do, sir?]
Zhao Chen barked, Im entering seclusion, got that? Let Steward Zhuo handle everything in my stead in the meantime!
[Oh, I see.]
Yes!
The man rushed to carry his orders.
Zhao Chen turned a snicker to Zhuo Fan, Steward Zhuo, all my resources are yours. Everything in my domain is at your fingertips. We are truly in the same boat. Itll be bad for both of us to let this leak out. Be careful and dont at least dont be found out too soon.
Sir, I also train with it. I wont let anyone call me a waste thirty years later, ha-ha-ha.. Zhuo Fan cackled.
Zhao Chen had a vile grin, Steward Zhuo, no one says that. Youre already frightening with your courage and guile, but youll be a force to be reckoned with once you have power. Maybe then Ill even be afraid of you.
Youre too kind, sir.Zhuo Fan bowed.
Zhao Chen gave him a look then laughed as he left.
[Zhuo Fan is sharp to snatch peoples weaknesses. Even so, once I get stronger, I wont have to fear any Saint and can remove the punk and the danger.]
[But I still need his skills for now]

chapters.title: Chapter 1248: Expansion
chapters.content:
Chapter 1248: Expansion
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Excited to cultivate, Zhao Chen called for a few people on Devil Mountain to enter his chambers, only for them to scream in horrible agony as they died.
Zhuo Fan sneered from the outside, leaving for his own matters. Once he got out of the hall, the whole of Devil Mountain kneeled with utter respect, Greetings, Steward Zhuo, endless fortunes and everlasting life!
In just a few minutes, Devil Mountain knew Zhuo Fan had become the Demonic Emperors representative, promoted from the head of the twelve demon guards into the crown prince.
Everyone conformed with this change, showering with flatteries.
Zhuo Fan beamed.
[One moment was all it took to lose everything, but I spent a century to gain it all back, ha-ha-ha]
Zhuo Fan shook his head, flicking his hand, Every town and city within the Demonic Emperors domain is to be ready for battle. In three months, we will go to war!
Yes, sir!
The huge crowd roared.
After Zhuo Fan took power, all the cities under the Demonic Emperor had a change in management. The Luo clans high officials were sent to rule them. With their many experts, the Luo clan gained swift control of every inch of Zhao Chens lands, with the latter none the wiser.
The Demonic Emperor had many city lords in the early to late Emperor Stage, but the Luo clan had scores of them, with a dozen even possessing obscene strength for their level.
A bit of flexing and smashing was all they needed to establish their rule.
Three months, that was how long Zhuo Fan took to usurp all power in the Demonic Emperors domain. Zhao Chen would have a hard time getting everything back.
Zhuo Fans plan to take over Zhao Chens forces from the inside was achieved.
Zhao Chen would surely shed tears if he knew. Alas, ignorance is bliss, oblivious to the Luo clans true power.
Otherwise he would never have given so much power to Zhuo Fan.
Steward Zhuo, weve taken everything from Zhao Chen and can remove him. No one will raise a fuss!
Li Jingtian bowed to Zhuo Fan in a hall, reporting the last three months activities. Zhuo Fans eyes shone, smiling, Not yet, he still has uses. Did you send him cultivation resources?
I have, but he demands more and more from you!
So eager for quick gains, to drain them, humph!
Zhuo Fan muttered, Its almost time. March on the Wraith Emperor and the Falcon Emperors unmanned lands. We will challenge them this time and destroy them!
Everyone bowed, Yes, sir!
News of war spread like lightning throughout the Sacred Domain. Under Zhuo Fans command, the Demonic Emperors army stormed the two Emperors lands.
They stood no chance, with ten cities falling in three days, butchering all people in their path.
The Demonic Emperors army was ruthless and terrifying.
Damn you, Zhao Chen!
Bam!
The Falcon Emperor slammed a table, Its only been a couple days of peace and now another war starts? The punk was vicious last time as well, pushing us to fight the Enchanting Empress and Sword Emperor to wear each other out. We had no time to recover and hes coming for us again!
The Wraith Emperor frowned hard, We can deal with his treachery, but I fear theres someone even more cunning making things harder.
Who?
The Falcon Emperor gave him a look and exclaimed, You mean his new right-hand, Zhuo Fan?
The Wraith Emperor sighed, Falcon Emperor, have you noticed how despite Zhao Chens cunning, he was crude and easy to anger? Now though, looking at the previous war and the current one, each step is taken with precise calculations from someone. Its like were merely puppets dancing to his tune.
Why do you say that?
Think for a second. Why would the Demonic Emperor attack us both? Isnt it because he saved his strength last time? And how else did he do it if not by inviting the Enchanting Empress and Sword Emperor to fight for him? The Eight Emperors have always been smart not to get involved in pointless affairs, but why did they join regardless? Who brought them?
Zhuo Fan?!
The Falcon Emperor nodded, He didnt look like much when I saw him as we greeted the Saints, but Zhao Chen has always kept him around. He has to be good at something!
The Wraith Emperor continued, Yeah, he made a mess of things in the Demonic Emperors stead, forcing both of our sides to lose. This time hes sending troops I heard that the Demonic Emperor is in seclusion and gave all power to Zhuo Fan. It means
The war was Zhuo Fans idea, and not his master?
The Falcon Emperors beard shook as he slammed the table, He got some nerve, waging an Eight Emperors war whenever he wants!
The Wraith Emperor sighed, He really is reckless, for not even the Demonic Emperor would do this. Theres no way an aide would do this. Its like hes the real Demonic Emperor!
The Falcon Emperor gave him a long look and nodded.
Yes, the only thing the punk is missing to step on the big stage is strength. Should we just remove him?
The Wraith Emperor nodded with a nasty smirk.
In a world of strength, being weak meant you were nobody, for anyone could just squash you.
[Even if youre great at everything else, ha-ha-ha]
Before a room on Devil Mountain, Zhuo Fan bowed, Demonic Emperor, Ive brought what you requested!
Rumble~
The stone door cracked open after a series of heavy sounds, then Zhuo Fan stepped in. He grinned at the familiar room as the door closed behind him.
A man wrapped in thick black energy sat in center, with a fervent gaze, that of a demented person.
After three months of cultivating, his aura took a darker and foul air, giving him a sinister vibe, like that of an abomination on the prowl for man flesh.
[He should be close to going mad at this rate.]
Zhuo Fan bowed, Demonic Emperor sir!
Zip it and give me the ingredients. Where are they? Zhao Chen barked, exposing an excited grin, like that of a beast.
In a flash of azure, hundreds of people appeared, unconscious.
Zhao Chen said, So little? Thats only 532, where are the rest? Did you use them?
You jest, sir, I can only take one a day at most.
Why then
Sir, so many people missing is bound to raise suspicions, especially when sir requires high quality materials. Zhuo Fan smiled, Now that were at war with the Falcon Emperor and Wraith Emperor, it will work as a good cover for any missing people. Im slaughtering every city I come across, sending everyone there for sirs cultivation.
Zhao Chen nodded, Good, very good Eh, were at war?
Why yes, so that we get even more ingredients. War is the best way to fool everyone. Please dont blame me for going ahead with this. Zhuo Fan snickered.
Zhao Chen squinted, nodding after a pause, Its fine. Nothing matters so long as you supply me with ingredients.
Zhao Chen activated his cultivation method and a dreadful black energy spilled over the people. It wrapped around them before returning over to him, leaving the people to crumble to dust.
Zhuo Fan smiled as he left.
[Idiot, didnt you always want Nine Serenities Secret Records? Now youre training in its core teaching, Demon Transformation Art. Though I did leave one part out.]
[Renounce your old art before training this one.]
[The previous cultivation method would conflict with Demon Transformation Art and youll be unable to grasp its essence, that all paths have the same destination. Youre too rash in cultivating, taking so many lives and others cultivation without even considering if theres a limit.]
[Its only a matter of time before you suffer for your greed. Thats why I didnt impart it to you back then. Now though, ha-ha, have your fill]

chapters.title: Chapter 1249: Worming Facts
chapters.content:
Chapter 1249: Worming Facts
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Zhao Chen was enveloped in black energy, his mind intoxicated and hazy. He could not see any issues with it because the power was just too strong, giving him a false feeling of control over the entire world as it grew thicker and thicker, promising him Sainthood.
Zhuo Fan sensed his scattered and wild aura. The increase was only in quantity and not quality, blocking any chance of becoming a Saint.
Zhuo Fan shook his head as he looked at the closed stone door.
Steward Zhuo, the Saint wants to meet you again! Li Jingtian had been waiting outside to give him a jade slip.
Zhuo Fan read it, Meeting? Saints sure are free, asking to see me right as Im at war. Ugh, that damn He Xiaofeng again, staying in Ruby Cloud Sect still.
Bam!
Zhuo Fan crushed the jade slip to dust in anger.
[Bastard, hes after Qingcheng again!]
Steward Zhuo, will you go?
Of course. The least I can do is show a Saint proper respect.
Show respect? Steward Zhuo dealt with dragon Saints like nothing. Crushing an entitled Saint brat should be as easy as snapping your fingers, ha-ha-ha Li Jingtian raised an eyebrow.
Zhuo Fan smirked, Right you are, I have nothing to fear from the likes of He Xiaofeng, but I need to consider the bigger picture and lay low for now.
Why do you say that?
He Xiaofeng is an early Saint, nobody important, but he has the 6th Sacred Mountain behind him. Weve yet to hear any word from the dragons. Even with them joining us, itll take time to gather all the spiritual beasts. We need to bide our time.
Zhuo Fans eyes shone, The Eight Emperors arent united. Being hostile to the Sacred Mountains now will surround us with enemies.
[Eight Emperors?]
Li Jingtian jerked, What of it? Every Luo clan elder leading a team could mow them down.
Wont that reveal us to the Saints as well?
Tapping his head, Zhuo Fan smiled, It will also scare them, turning from being pedantic to stooping to any low and retaliating against us. To resist the enemy, we need to secure our lands. Dont ever forget the lesson of the Sword Star Empire and Baili Jingwei. By waging war with the Sacred Mountains, the Eight Emperors would be sure to strike back. We have to make our lands strong as iron to avoid any problems.
Li Jingtian nodded, Steward Zhuo is thorough in the end. Then well take the Eight Emperors lands before anything.
Yeah, were to take their lands without them noticing our intentions and plan for it, ha-ha-ha Zhuo Fan snickered at the door behind him and left with Li Jingtian.
[Disciple, you betrayed your master and now youll become bait, drawing everyone in.]
Whoosh~
A month later, three people darted beneath the sun as they landed in a forest. Zhuo Fan, Li Jingtian and Qiu Yanhai looked at the Ruby Cloud Sects dazzling entrance.
Zhuo Fan said, Ill go pay my respects and keep the Saint and the hag busy while you stick to the plan. The rest are nothing.
Understood! The two bowed.
Zhuo Fan walked in, soon blocked by a few familiar figures.
Head senior sister, its been a while. Howve you been?
You dont get to call me that! Humph!
Fang Min glared at him, Eh? Wheres your guard?
Zhuo Fan shrugged, Look at what youre saying. Do you think theres no one guarding me with my current status? Theyre only hiding in the shadows. Should I call them out? They may not be hundreds, but 180 there should be, each tough in their own right. I have no fear against some early Spirit Kings.
Tch, youre quite the show off, for a useless Demonic Emperor dog.
Youre wrong about that. Even dogs differ among each other. I act in Demonic Emperors stead, can you say the same? While Im a purebred prized poodle, youre just a flea-ridden mongrel, ha-ha-ha
You
Fang Min grimaced in anger, wanting to kill him then and there. Zhuo Fan taunted further, I came to your sect at the Saints invitation. Touch me in any way and not even your master can protect you.
Fang Min shuddered and panted, straining to quell her rage, After you!
Thats better. Youre only shaming the Enchanting Empress by failing to receive guests, he-he-he. Zhuo Fan snickered at their furious glares, Wheres Qingcheng anyway? Why dont I see her?
Fang Min got her chance to strike back, Youll never get to see her again.
Why do you say that? Zhuo Fans heart tensed.
Fang Min mocked, Junior sister has been promised to the Saint, but the obstinate girl doesnt know whats good for her and refused. She even tried leaving but master locked her up on the Snow Peak for the time when the Saint takes her away. So you wont see junior sister ever again once she goes to the Sacred Mountains, ha-ha-ha
Zhuo Fan nodded, having taken this scenario into account and looked back.
Li Jingtian and Qiu Yanhai gave him a signal.
Zhuo Fan relaxed.
Zhuo Fan taunted Fang Min so she would let Chu Qingchengs situation slip. The chick was harsh but not too bright though, making it extra easy for him to deal with her.
A few slick words got her to spill all of the sects secrets.
[The Enchanting Empress has good tastes in disciples.]
Zhuo Fan smirked, approving of Fang Min, who gave him an odd look.
[Whats with him? I taunted him with Qingcheng yet he doesnt care?]
Head senior sister!
Zhuo Fan said, Why are you so happy that Qingcheng is being taken to the Sacred Mountains? That place is a cultivators dreamland. As I understand, you should be jealous and stewing in envy from not being picked instead of that dumb girl. What does she have that I dont? Looking at looks, figure, cultivation, and you know, youd probably on par, no? Ha-ha-ha, no wonder there are no men around.
Pff~
The other disciples giggled with red faces. Fang Min glared and gnashed her teeth, cutting their joy short.
Youre right!
Fang Min sighed, Chu Qingcheng has never been stronger than me, ever, but master always spoiled her, giving her everything. The Saint also picked her, not even giving me a second glance. Am I so bad? Is she that much better?
I dont think so.
You agree too? Then why do you all go after her?
Objectively speaking, youre better in every way, but one.
Which one?
Birth! Zhuo Fans eyes shone.
Because she was and still is Qingcheng, her birth made him protect her without fail. It was also her birth, having a Sovereign path that made the Enchanting Empress and Saint value her immensely.
[You could never catch up to her with such a circumstance!]
Fang Min didnt get it, Birth? Isnt she just an orphan? Whats so special about her? Master just took her in, is all.
Very special indeed.
Zhuo Fan was grave, Let me be frank with you. You can never match her background, not even your master. Do you believe me when I tell you that she can make He Xiaofeng destroy Ruby Cloud Sect? Even the Eight Emperors, the guy would definitely fulfill her every wish to win her smile.
[How is this possible?]
Fang Min was dumbstruck, Stop fooling around! A Saint would never spoil his girl that much. The Eight Emperors in the Sacred Domain are like the Sacred Mountains to them. Their death will bring chaos.
This isnt spoiling, its about worth. What does it matter if the world burns, so long as Qingcheng smiles? Zhuo Fan gave an eerie grin, This is her background, the one that can topple cities. Why else would she be Chu Qingcheng? Ha-ha-ha
(StarReader: Qingcheng means city-toppling beauty.)
They arrived before the sects Main Hall. Zhuo Fan entered with a smile, leaving the girls stumped behind.
[Is Qingcheng that important? Just who is she]

chapters.title: Chapter 1250: Rescue
chapters.content:
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Hu~
The violent winds carried with them icy snow, pelting the entrance of a mountain cave. Chu Qingcheng had a lost gaze as she stared at the dancing snow. She finally sighed with a lowered head.
A woman that had aged with grace sat on a flat stone outside the cave with closed eyes. She was like a statue, even as the snow landed on her body.
Chu Qingcheng stood up and walked outside. She made a sign and struck.
Bam!
The entire peak trembled, with snow falling from it in every direction. Chu Qingcheng recoiled, falling on the ground with a red face.
The entrance of the cave now sported a shimmering wall, vanishing right after.
The woman shook and all the snow on her fell.
Mei Sangu shook her head at the stubborn Chu Qingcheng, “I’m sorry that I let you go out the first time. I hoped you’d learn of the world, not have some wicked brat make you lose your way to the point you disobey your seniors.”
“Senior aunt Mei, please let me go. I don’t want to go to Sacred Mountain!”
“Why? Sacred Mountain has anything a cultivator could want. They lead the Sacred Domain. All of your sisters are dying to go. You are blessed with incredible fortune and yet cast it aside. Can’t you tell right from wrong?”
“Then let them go instead. Why do I have to go?”
Chu Qingcheng was forlorn, “I don’t care about cultivation or growing stronger, because I don’t want to go!”
Mei Sangu could read her heart, “Are you still thinking about that brat? Qingcheng, did he enchant you or give you something for you to fall so badly after just seeing him a couple of times?”
“I don’t know either.”
Chu Qingcheng watched the dancing snow with a happy smile, “Ever since I saw him, I felt drawn to him by familiarity, wanting to be with him forever. I don’t care where I’ll be and what it’ll happen, so long as we’re together. Just let me go, senior aunt Mei!”
Pa!
Mei Sangu sighed, facepalming, “Qingcheng, you’re hopeless. It’s senior sister who placed the barrier, so even I can’t break it, but I wouldn’t do it even if I could. It’s not just for you, but the boy as well. Think for a moment, a Saint has his eyes on you. Do you think he’ll get away alive?”
“I don’t know how the Saint will treat you, but it’s certain that he will kill him and the Luo clan. He managed to gain status under the Demonic Emperor, but can he still withstand the Sacred Mountains’ pressure? By going with him, you’re sentencing the Luo clan to death. If you truly love him, think about his well being instead of ruining everything for a brief moment of joy.”
Chu Qingcheng lowered her head, but she was still vehement, “Why does it have to be me? There are so many stronger senior sisters in the sect. Why did that blind Saint insist on me?”
“He might really be blind, uh, no, ahem. Forget I said that. I mean that the Saint has special tastes. This is your chance.”
Chu Qingcheng clenched her fists, but slumped in the end as she sighed.
Mei Sangu chuckled.
[She finally gave up, ha-ha-ha…]
Whoosh!
Mei Sangu jerked, still slow to react as a figure grabbed her by the neck and prevented her from using her strength.
Another figure flashed behind her and struck the back of her neck.
Mei Sangu slumped, unconscious.
Chu Qingcheng cried out, “Senior aunt!
“Miss Chu, Steward Zhuo told us not to harm anyone in Ruby Cloud Sect. You can relax.” The two figures were utterly respectful towards her.
Chu Qingcheng stammered, “You mean… Zhuo Fan sent you?”
“Yes, I am Li Jingtian, a Luo clan Venerable, tasked by Steward Zhuo to rescue you.”
“I am Qiu Yanhai, also a Venerable.”
The two cupped their hands and smiled.
Chu Qingcheng gave a nod, “I know you. You were with Zhuo Fan in Gambling Town. Did Zhuo Fan really send you to save me?”
“Yes.”
The two echoed.
Chu Qingcheng cheered up, “How did he know I was kept here? Did my sisters tell him?”
“Miss Chu, your sisters aren’t that kind. Steward Zhuo’s uncanny foresight let us know of the Sacred Mountains’ deal with your master after your rebirth. It’s the only explanation for their treatment of you.” Li Jingtian sneered.
Chu Qingcheng’s heart sank. She looked up to her master as her own mother.
[But master made a deal to give me over to the Sacred Mountains?]
Her heart was torn with grief, making her joy plunge in sadness.
Li Jingtian saw she was silent and said, “Miss Chu, please stand back. We’ll break the barrier and don’t want to harm you. Steward Zhuo will never forgive us.”
“Oh, thank you.”
Chu Qingcheng woke up from her thoughts and took a couple steps back, “Seniors, master placed the barrier. Please be careful not to get hurt.”
[Hurt?]
As peak Emperors, these guys only feared Danqing Shen and his group with their monstrous power.
The two just chuckled.
Qiu Yanhai’s hand flashed with a searing flame, shouting, “Old Li, the hags used an ice seal, weak to my attribute. I’m more than enough. Stand back!”
Qiu Yanhai struck with his palm, making it explode in a blistering red.
Hum~
The invisible barrier vanished on the spot. The heat stormed the cave drying Chu Qingcheng’s soft skin and even making her hair curl.
Qiu Yanhai panicked and bowed, “Forgive me, miss. I used too much strength. You aren’t hurt, are you?”
“No.”
Chu Qingcheng shook her head, amazed at his skill, “Senior, you’re incredible. Not even senior aunt could remove master’s barrier but you did it like nothing. Are you stronger than master?”
Qiu Yanhai grinned in pride, “Miss is too kind. I’m not that great, not when there are others in the Luo clan far stronger than me. As for your master and seniors, I can handle them, ha-ha-ha. I actually overestimated your master just now, and used half my strength. A third would have sufficed.”
“You’re that much stronger than master? How can this be? Master is one of the Eight Emperors!”
Chu Qingcheng was shocked at Qiu Yanhai’s confidence and bragging. He even said that the Luo clan had many more better than him.
[Why are they relying on the Demonic Emperor if the Luo clan can handle the Eight Emperors? Was there a clan in this world ever able to surpass the Eight Emperors besides the Sacred Mountains?]
Chu Qingcheng was utterly confused.
Qiu Yanhai grinned, but Li Jingtian cut his showboating short, “Steward Zhuo gave us a job. Let’s save her and go!”
“Oh, right. Miss, come with us. It’s now or never!” Qiu Yanhai rushed to Chu Qingcheng.
She then recalled something and stepped away from Qiu Yanhai.
The two were puzzled, “Miss, what’s wrong?”
“You go, I’m staying. Tell Zhuo Fan that fate keeps us apart…”
“Why?”
“If you take me, you’ll become enemies with Ruby Cloud Sect and even get the Sacred Mountains to attack you. I could never forgive myself for getting all your clan killed.”
Chu Qingcheng’s shoulder slumped, “Zhuo Fan earned his master’s recognition in becoming steward, but I won’t harm the Luo clan and him because of me. Go and tell him to not look for me again and not use his status carelessly…”
Li Jingtian smiled. They snatched her either way and fled.
Chu Qingcheng cried out and Li Jingtian shouted, “Miss Chu, Steward Zhuo has all that taken care of. We don’t care about some puny Sacred Mountains anyway, ha-ha-ha…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1251: Sacred Mountains’ Decision
chapters.content:
Proofreader
: Papatonks
The two rushed away with Chu Qingcheng in tow, yet not out of Ruby Cloud Sect, instead slipping near the Main Hall.
A patrol of disciples passed by and the two knocked them out without a sound.
“What are you doing?” Chu Qingcheng whispered.
Li Jingtian waved off her concern, “Miss Chu, they’re fine. Make sure to stay quiet and follow me.”
The two venerables led her to a hidden spot. Chu Qingcheng was baffled, but trusted them since they harmed no one.
They reached a hidden part of the wall of the building and looked in through the window, “Steward Zhuo, you’ve drunk a dozen cups already? Can we start already?”
[Master?]
Chu Qingcheng gave the two an odd look, seeing them grave.
She could only refocus on the scene inside the hall, where He Xiaofeng, her master and Zhuo Fan were.
Zhuo Fan placed his teacup down.
[This should be enough. I’ve stalled for an hour now. Should I keep going?]
“Enchanting Empress, your maiden tea is delightful. I can’t get enough of it…”
“Steward Zhuo, Lord Saint called you here to discuss, not chat over tea!” The Enchanting Empress’s face was dark, glaring at Zhuo Fan.
It all started as courtesy, showing him hospitality, but this guy kept fussing over the tea being too cold or too hot. Then he stuffed himself with snacks, only to ask for a potty break. He was wasting time, no doubt about it, not wanting to get to it.
[We’re all civilized people here, men of status that know courtesy. So being polite was only natural. But this?]
Zhuo Fan had been milking their courtesy for an hour now.
The two didn’t know what he was playing, but their patience was running thin, unable to keep their calm.
Bam!
Zhuo Fan slammed the teacup down, raging, “Humph, Enchanting Empress, is this how you treat guests? Can’t a guy enjoy a nice warm tea around here? Is this Ruby Cloud Sect’s hospitality?”
“You’ve had eighteen of them!”
He Xiaofeng’s face twitched, snapping, “This is the sixth time you used that pretext. Can’t you at least change your script? You might like this agitation, but we don’t. What are you trying to pull?”
Zhuo Fan beamed bashfully, “That many? Ha-ha-ha, sorry, I didn’t keep count. Though could I get a refill?”
“Enough!”
He Xiaofeng slammed the table, “Zhuo Fan, I’ve never seen a more revolting person in my life. I know what your game is, but no matter how much you stall it won’t work. It’s time you give me an explanation! Why is the Demonic Emperor attacking two Emperors without reason?”
Zhuo Fan shrugged, “The whole of the Sacred Domain knows it, even the Enchanting Empress. The two Emperors were at odds with the Demonic Emperor and waged war. If not for Lord Saint interfering, it would’ve been over by now. Later, Saint took the Nether Sea map then went back. Sir doesn’t have to mix in our squabbles.”
“It’s the Sacred Mountains’ decision, not requiring discussion with anybody, especially with you.” He Xiaofeng unleashed his strong aura filled with bloodthirst.
Zhuo Fan sneered inside.
[He can flip out all he wants now, humph…]
The Enchanting Empress intervened, “Sir Saint, think of everything. If Qingcheng finds out about his death, it will make things worse. It’ll be bad if she takes her life.”
He Xiaofeng quelled his seething anger.
The Enchanting Empress said, “Steward Zhuo, I know you wield all of the Demonic Emperor’s forces, with Zhao Chen in seclusion. It’s brave of you to go against two Emperors in the Demonic Emperor’s name, but once he comes out, he will make you answer for it.”
“Nothing Enchanting Empress needs to concern herself with. All I do is for the Demonic Emperor. I started the war with sir’s approval. There’s no point in you interfering, ha-ha-ha…”
“Steward Zhuo, you’re burning bridges.”
The Enchanting Empress mocked, “The Demonic Emperor has the power to fight those two because I and the Sword Emperor wore them out. While you two stood by and watched, we took heavy losses. I can overlook this, but now you want us to stand back? That’s not very honest.”
“But it is, since our deal is done. You got your Nether Sea map so what are you lacking?”
“I don’t care about your squabbles. You are forbidden from fighting!”
