“Uh, well…” The girls blinked and shook their heads in silence.
Chu Qingcheng found it even more peculiar, “Why then is he only coming at me? I know that all of you are prettier than me, and like Zhuo Fan more as well, so why…”
“Sister Qingcheng don’t think too hard about it. He likes you and that’s a fact. We also wish him happiness and bless…”
“Is he just using me?”
Chu Qingcheng turned nervous.
Luo Yunchang guffawed, “H-how can you think that?”
“I saw the Eight Emperors’ tokens in his room. Just when my master died, he burned her token. So I figured, did he plan on striking the Eight Emperors from the start?”
Chu Qingcheng looked crushed, “Did he get close to me for another reason entirely? Staying in the Luo clan for so long, I can tell that he has a special status, controlling everything. Even your Clan Head listens to his words. He has nothing to worry about being punished by the Clan Head. He lied to me from the start.”
Luo Yunchang sighed and held her shoulder, “Sister Qingcheng, you have to believe me, Zhuo Fan can betray the world, but he would never betray you.”
“Why? We only met a couple of times, so why… I’m sure he approached me on purpose too. Besides getting at my master, there must be another reason…”
“Sister Qingcheng, big brother Zhuo’s reason for approaching you is honest. He truly likes you.” Shuang’er smiled as she explained.
This explanation had no real reason and only got Chu Qingcheng more worried, “How is it that you all know the reason while I’m the only one in the dark? You all say he’s sincere and I also feel it, but I just can’t understand why he would ignore all the beauties around him and go for me? I’m not that charming.”
“Silly sister, it’s enough to know he’s sincere. Why nitpick about it?”
Luo Yunchang sighed, “You two are alike in that, following your own paths. You’re the one trying to unravel everything while he’s determined to hide it.”
“Why?”
“I don’t know.”
Luo Yunchang shrugged, “Maybe he doesn’t want to burden you or make you sad. Since you have a new life, he wants to bury the past.”
Chu Qingcheng looked confused, but the knowing girls just gave her a reassuring nod.
[Just what is going on?]
She held her head, more confused than ever.
Luo Yunchang comforted, “Silly sister, isn’t it enough to know he cares? Why bother thinking so much? Ha-ha-ha…”
Chu Qingcheng gave a reluctant nod…
“Luo clan, come out this instance!”
The sudden shout made the sky tremble. The Luo clan shuddered, with roof tiles falling down.
The girls turned to Luo Yunchang.
She was grave, “Zhuo Fan had all our strongest people sent to kill the lunatics. Now, with no one capable of defending our home, someone comes knocking…”
“Sister Yunchang, let’s check the situation first.” Yun Shuang proposed.
Luo Yunchang nodded and the girls went to the entrance of the Luo clan manor. Luo Yunhai already brought the few Emperors he had outside, staring at the four in the sky.
A middle-aged man led them, the 6th Mountain Lord.
“Senior, how may I address you? I am the Clan Head Luo Yunhai. What have we done to offend you, senior?”
Luo Yunhai cupped his hands.
He Haodong sneered. Xu Tianchuan was the one to speak with pride, “Where’s Zhuo Fan? Tell him to come out now!”
“Oh, Steward Zhuo, he’s been awfully busy in the Emperor lands. He’s taken people to settle matters. You’ll have to wait a few months for his return.”
“There’s someone stirring things in Emperor lands? Why don’t I know of this?”
Xu Tianchuan roared, “Zhuo Fan has some nerve, moving as he wants, not even informing us three of the Emperor lands’ situation. He plans on taking them from us. Curses, I had high hopes for him giving him such a crucial position, but he took advantage of my goodwill. God damn it!”
Xu Tianchuan raved and Luo Yunhai cupped his hands, “Sir…”
“We are the true rulers of the Emperor lands, the Sacred Mountains’ three representatives within the Eight Emperors!”
Xu Tianchuan’s nostrils flared, then pointed at He Haodong with respect, “He is the 6th Sacred Mountain’s Lord. Your clan dared to deceive us and now shall receive the capital punishment.”
Luo Yunhai gasped.
[The 6th Sacred Mountain? Here so soon? But we have yet to hear from the dragons…]
He Haodong huffed, “Stop wasting time and just kill them, to preserve the Sacred Mountains’ dignity. Once Zhuo Fan returns, deal with him as well. Let all of the Eight Emperors’ lands know today that they’re under your control while the Luo clan seized power and were executed.”
“Yes!”
The trio snickered and turned to the Luo clan with savage glints in their eyes…

chapters.title: Chapter 1274: Taken
chapters.content:
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Luo Yunhai’s face twitched, his heart sank as he looked behind at his people.
They were average Emperors and couldn’t handle the three peak Emperors from the Sacred Mountains. It would’ve been great if that was all, but there was also the Mountain Lord.
The Mountain Lord was a peak Saint. With Steward Zhuo and all the other true experts gone, they stood no chance at even escaping.
Luo Yunhai lamented at their fate. Xu Tianchuan’s trio grinned with malice. Their bloodlust spiked and their auras surged, ready to crush the Luo clan into the dust.
“Wait!”
A gentle voice came as a figure rushed before them and stalled the trio’s bloodthirst.
Xu Tianchuan sneered, “What is it, young miss, do you want to be our first victim?”
“Humph, kill me and you’re through!”
“Oh, quite the temper on you. We are the Sacred Mountains disciples, yet you think your backer can fight us?”
“Of course!”
“Who’s the suicidal moron?”
“Right under your nose.” The girl pointed straight at He Haodong.
The trio started.
He Haodong was curious, “Young miss, do you know me?”
“Nope.”
“Why would I bother to protect you?”
“Because you want me.” The girl shouted.
He Haodong gave her a long look, more confused. Xu Tianchuan mocked, “Lass, don’t flatter yourself. You think you’re the most beautiful lady in the Sacred Domain?”
“Humph, who am I?”
The girl glared at He Xiaofeng, “Mountain Lord He, if you really are the 6th Mountain Lord, then you’d know I’m Chu Qingcheng, just like your son and my master.”
“You were actually here?”
He Haodong’s brow shot up, muttering, “So the Luo clan took you from the Ruby Cloud Sect when they found you missing?”
“I left and wasn’t taken.”
“I don’t care, this just means they have something to do with my son’s death.”
He Haodong’s fury grew, his terrible aura spreading over everyone and making Xu Tianchuan shiver back.
[Mountain Lord He is angry!]
“Talk! How did my son die? You were all ignored for so long thinking you were weaklings, but this proves I need to conduct a thorough investigation!”
“Mountain Lord He, what are you saying? We had nothing to do with your son.”
Luo Yunhai played dumb. He knew the moment that the fact Zhuo Fan killed He Xiaofeng got out, the Luo clan would turn into a grave. They just had to bear through it for a bit and their lives would still hang on.
He had to, so Zhuo Fan and the others could arrive on time to save them.
He Haodong ignored their excuse, thirsty for vengeance, “Humph, I don’t need you to admit it either. You can’t escape involvement either. Xu Tianchuan, show no mercy.”
“Yes!”
The trio laughed and shot down. Luo Yunhai panicked and got ready to fight.
Chu Qingcheng held a spiritual sword and brought it to her neck, shouting, “Just try it! If even one man dies today, I will join them in the afterlife. Your century of planning will all go to waste.”
“Wait!”
He Haodong raised his hand, stopping the confused trio.
He Haodong glared at her, “What’s your relation to them? Why protect them?”
“You don’t need to know, since they had nothing to do with your son. Let them go and I’ll come with you. Or the only thing you’ll be getting are corpses and an unsolved riddle.”
Chu Qingcheng smiled.
He Haodong nodded, “Fine, the Enchanting Empress raised quite the stubborn disciple. Now put down the sword. I promise you. But you must also promise to listen to me and I’ll let them go.”
Chu Qingcheng looked back at the Luo clan with worry then gave a firm nod.
“Alright, now come with me.”
He Haodong was grave as he left, his voice echoing, “And the Clan Head, he’ll be coming with me to the Sacred Mountains. I need to clarify some things. As for the rest, I don’t care.”
Luo Yunhai gave the others a nod and flew up with Chu Qingcheng after him.
The three young masters remained behind with the Luo clan.
With the Clan Head gone and no experts, there was no telling when Steward Zhuo would be back to handle matters.
Bang~
Then suddenly, explosions resounded around the Luo clan and people were crashing into the ground as they coughed blood.
Luo Yunchang cried out at the vile trio.
“What are you doing? The Mountain Lord promised to let us go…”
“The Mountain Lord promised not to kill you, but that didn’t mean we can’t beat you. We promised nothing!”
The trio grinned with malice, “Zhuo Fan had the nerve to toy with us, making us receive punishment from the Sacred Mountains, so we’ll make him pay. Once he returns, I’ll show him what happens to bugs in the Eight Emperors’ lands who try to rise above their station!”
Luo Yunchang’s face sank…
A month later, Zhuo Fan smiled at the city coming up in front, “Almost home. I wonder if Qingcheng missed me.”
“She won’t be the only one.” Sword Child snickered.
Zhuo Fan shook his head.
Rustle~
Dozens of figures flew next to the two, Danqing Shen and the others.
They noticed Zhuo Fan was now at the 7th layer of Foundation Establishment Stage and they lit up, “Steward Zhuo, you advanced!”
“Yeah, dad is now a Saint!” Sword Child spoke with glee.
The others gasped, “So soon?”
“Ha-ha-ha, it was just luck.”
Zhuo Fan was casual, “I found it such a waste letting all the demonic energy Sword Emperor refined just vanish. So I took it and happened to break through. Since the source of his demonic energy is the same as mine, it was very easy to take it.”
Danqing Shen nodded and mentioned, “Steward Zhuo’s advancement is a reason to celebrate, but be careful not to stray like them. We witnessed just what happens when you lose your way. Their strength only increased while their path crumbled, just like a powerful wild animal. I’d rather be stuck than turn into such a Saint.”
“Yeah, but don’t worry. I know what I’m doing.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Did you handle the other three Eight Emperors?”
They all laughed, with Li Jingtian declaring, “Steward Zhuo, those madmen were nothing. It might’ve been a little tough with just one, but we were five against them, making it very easy.”
“Good, this is a big matter and we’ll make a statement when we return home, that the Sacred Mountains’ Saints are causing havoc and we’re waging war with them to stop them.”
“Yes!”
Everyone nodded.
“Eh?”
Sword Child gasped as he pointed, “Father, why are the flags crooked on the broken walls? Did someone come here?”
“Can’t be.”
Zhuo Fan frowned, “The Eight Emperors’ lands are ours and with the Sacred Mountains in the dark, none can challenge us. Unless..”
Zhuo Fan flew faster…

chapters.title: Chapter 1275: Can’t Take It
chapters.content:
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Crack~
The sharp sound of whips echoed in the Luo clan’s wide gardens, where a dozen poles were placed with Luo Yunchang and the other high officials tied up to them.
They all looked pale and bleeding, but their eyes were firm.
Pa!
Xu Tianchuan cracked the whip once more, then threw it away like a child, “Elder brother, I’ve whipped them hundreds of times. I’m tired!”
“Tired? That’s nowhere near enough. All elders of the Sacred Mountains laugh at us. The great Sacred Mountains disciples ended up running in circles in the Eight Emperors’ lands. We are too ashamed to go back as we are.”
Xu Tianchuan turned a savage grin to his victims, “This is all because of them. The Eight Emperors’ lands think they’re governed by the Luo clan, not Sacred Mountains. The Luo clan usurped power and must suffer!”
“But Mountain Lord He said not to kill them.”
“That’s why we’re only venting on them.”
Xu Tianchuan held out his hand in anger, “Just give me the whip. I’ll do it this time!”
Qu Xiangfeng sighed and handed it over. Xu Tianchuan used his two hands to test the whip around then turned his vicious gaze on the helpless people.
He approached a girl and nodded, “You.”
Xu Tianchuan swung back and let it fall. Luo Yunchang panicked, “Stop! She’s just a child! She can’t take your hits. I’ll take her place!”
“It’s because she can’t it’ll be her torture.”
Xu Tianchuan cackled, “Whipping Spirit Kings’ tough bodies won’t make you feel a thing. Only this young girl with low cultivation will have a full taste of pain, ha-ha-ha…”
Whoosh!
The whip flicked in action.
Luo Yunchang panicked, “Sifan!”
The girl had long since lost consciousness and couldn’t hear her.
A muffled sound came just then and the whip halted in the air.
Xu Tianchuan flinched and found Zhuo Fan holding it.
He had a hard face, while Danqing Shen and the rest looked ready for war.
They’d been gone for a couple of months yet someone made a mess of their clan? Intolerable!
“Zhuo Fan!”
Luo Yunchang and Xu Tianchuan cried out at the same time. The first was of joy while the second was of anger and shock for not noticing when a bug took his whip.
Zhuo Fan glared and muttered, “None in the Eight Emperors’s lands would mess with the Luo clan. The Sacred Mountains can’t reach us either, unless they’re the entitled puppeteered pricks got wilder and came here for a fight. The odds of that happening are next to zero, rather than enjoying their happy lives. So why… humph, to think it’s actually you.”
“Zhuo Fan, you have some nerve. You dared to use us for puppets!”
Xu Tianchuan roared, “I’m going to kill you for your treachery, even if Mountain Lord He promised not to kill the Luo clan. You must die!”
Xu Tianchuan shot for Zhuo Fan with bloodlust, a palm to the face.
Zhuo Fan merely grabbed Xu Tianchuan’s hand, startling Qian Qiu and Wu Qianqiu. It was beyond their comprehension how a peak Emperor like Xu Tianchuan could be grabbed like that.
Xu Tianchuan was stunned then baffled. He then noticed the iron grip holding him and how powerless he was.
Zhuo Fan ignored their shock, “Mountain Lord He? 6th Mountain Lord, He Xiaofeng’s dad?”
“That’s right, now let go before you’re dead.” Xu Tianchuan replied while attempting to yank his hand free.
Zhuo Fan’s hand shook and Xu Tianchuan lunged forward. A bang followed as Zhuo Fan slapped him to pieces, Xu Tianchuan’s body exploding in a shower of blood and flesh.
Sss~
The other two gasped and shivered, “Y-you killed a Sacred Mountains disciple! Are you suicidal?”
“Our fate is not up to you to decide.”
Zhuo Fan showed a vicious smile, “Since you won’t be there to see it.”
Zhuo Fan gave Danqing Shen a look and the Sword Kings unleashed their deadly sword arts on the two.
An Emperor stage Sacred Mountains disciple had the advantage with the superior skills and cultivation method, but that was gone when facing Sword Kings who inherited the a Sovereign’s legacy.
In a blink, the two breathed their last and were reduced to pieces.
Zhuo Fan signaled the men to release the people on the pillars, while he went to untie Luo Yunchang and the girls. His heart bled at their wounds, “What happened? Where’s Yunhai and Qingcheng?”
The girls looked away and Zhuo Fan understood, “Did Mountain Lord He seal your cultivation? There’s no way those three could’ve captured you…”
“It’s because sister Yunchang worried about your plans.”
Shuang’er glared at him, “I was about to fight when the trio began attacking, but sister Yunchang blocked us, not wanting to expose us and ruin your plan. Since they only wanted to hurt us and not kill us, it wouldn’t matter.”
Zhuo Fan was lost, looking at Luo Yunchang’s happy face, “I was just too worried about your plans. Since we knew nothing, we couldn’t do anything to ruin them. Now Qingcheng and Yunhai are now on the 6th Sacred Mountain. If we had attacked those pricks, then the Sacred Mountains would notice and ruin everything.”
“So we held in this little torment, for the bigger picture. We’d discuss what to do when you came back, rather than have all our work fail.”
“Young miss, you’re still the same, looking at the future, the bellwether of the Luo clan. Even without Yunhai around, you can lead the Luo clan with no problem.” Zhuo Fan praised.
Luo Yunchang’s eyes shone, looking at the pieces on the ground, “By the looks of it, has Steward Zhuo’s machination come to fruition?”
“Not quite, but now I can’t take it anymore.”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes burned with rage, “Since the Mountain Lord came for us, we have no choice but to fight. Li Jingtian, Qiu Yanhai…”
“Sir!”
“Rush to the Dragon Lands and confirm the situation. No matter the preparations, they are to march to the Sacred Mountains. The Eight Emperors’ lands are now safe, leaving only flanking the Sacred Mountains. Isn’t this what they’ve always been waiting for? Any longer and the Sacred Mountains will take the Eight Emperors’ lands and will make things worse for the Dragon Lands. Make them come to a quick decision, even if it means only a couple hundred experts of assistance.”
“Understood!” The two flew away.
“Xue Qingjian, Heaven and Earth Sages!”
“Sir!”
“Send all the men of the Luo clan to announce that the Sacred Mountains’ wretched act of stealing the Eight Emperors’ lands’ resources and cutting the future of common cultivators. That they’re sending people to mess with the Eight Emperors’ lands and treat us all like slaves. They are practicing vile arts and raising us to become their materials. They are behind all the missing people from the start and the mad Eight Emperors recently. Pin everything on the Sacred Mountains. With those three pricks setting an example, the people have had enough of the Sacred Mountains. They’ll believe anything at this point.”
Zhuo Fan gave an evil grin, “I want the Sacred Mountains’ name dragged through the mud and then some!”
“Understood!” The three got to work.
Luo Yunchang frowned, “The Sacred Mountains are too strong. Even with the Eight Emperors’ lands believing us, the people would never voice their anger.”
“I know, but I don’t need them in the war, just to side with us ideologically. They also need a leader.”
Zhuo Fan smirked, “Young miss, declare that the Mountain Lord He abducted Yunhai and say that we’ll have justice. Declare war!”
[War?]
Luo Yunchang was worried, “Then we’ll soon be fighting for real. Isn’t it too early to start when the dragons have yet to send word?”
“Don’t worry, declaring war won’t mean an immediate war.”
Zhuo Fan smirked, clenching his fists, “I’ll have all of the Sacred Domain and the Sacred Mountains regard us with caution at the declaration of war…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1276: Interrogation
chapters.content:
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Everything bad that happened over the past three months in the Sacred Domain had all been blamed on the Seven Sacred Mountains by the Luo clan.
The news was explosive, with the people hardly believing their ears.
They were skeptical at first, or rather not wanting to believe it out of fear. For these events meant that they were mortal enemies with the Sacred Mountains.
The Eight Emperors had killed countless people for their own selfish need to cultivate, while the pricks backed by the Sacred Mountains declared deadly laws that killed even more, and these two were in fact related.
The people wanted revenge for all those tragic deaths. But the enemy was too strong, what was a mantis to do when facing a chariot?
As such, the people labeled it as a misunderstanding, that the Sacred Mountains weren’t evil.
Now though, the Luo clan ripped the facade wide open, declaring war on the Sacred Mountains.
It was like saying…
[Since none of you gave the guts to fight, we are willing to become their lambs instead.]
The people were conflicted.
The Sacred Mountains were too strong. They didn’t have the strength to fight them. It was suicide…
Then a righteous leader came, just in time to guide the lost flock and bring them justice.
The bright announcement was pasted in every corner of the Eight Emperors’ lands, alarming the folks once more.
“By the authority vested in us, in a world where the heavens and the earth show no mercy, treating all living beings as mere livestock, and where Saints act unrighteously, extracting the blood and flesh of the common people, we, the united forces of the house of Luo, now decree to carry out the will of heaven. We shall unite with heroes from all corners of the world, together, to confront the Sacred Mountains, to punish its wrongdoing, to quell the grievances of the common people, and enact heaven’s will…”
All the people read the red words with shock.
“T-the Luo clan wants to punish the Sacred Mountains!”
Cries sprouted all around, “How can this be? Who in the Sacred Domain can ever contest with the Sacred Mountains? The Luo clan is honorable, but would they defy the true powers that be?”
“What a pity. With the Eight Emperors finally gone and the Luo clan ruling the lands, we could finally live in peace. Now they’re going to their deaths. But to what end?”
“The Luo clan is suicidal and the lands will be in conflict again.”
All the people talked about the recent announcements, all shaking their heads and lamenting about the Luo clan’s shortsightedness, as well as the harsh times awaiting them.
[Who will unite the lands with the Luo clan gone?]
Only a few got fired up, deciding to go to the Luo clan and join them in the war. Even if death was a certainty, they would go down swinging.
While some hid and grinned in the shadows. They waited for the Luo clan to die so they could take over the lands.
All the opinions were either of support, of denial, or lamentation, but none around truly believed in it. The situation was clear, even the evil Sacred Mountains were still almighty. The Luo clan was still just a bug. The outcome was obvious.
Then, a shocking event had taken the world by storm, changing their opinions on the spot…
On the 6th Sacred Mountain, in a dark chamber, Luo Yunhai was tied to a cross and bleeding, forming a large bloodstain at his feet. The flickering torches shone on his pale face now and then, revealing his weak state.
The Mountain Lord stood before him, glaring and unfeeling.
He reached out to wipe some blood on the swollen face, mocking, “Still won’t talk? I’m giving you one more chance to tell me the truth. How did my son die? Who did it?”
“I… don’t know…”
Pa!
Luo Yunhai’s voice was rough and quiet, followed by a sudden strike that flung his head to the side. He chose to bear through the pain rather than cry out.
His chest had a metal rod through it. It was now being yanked around and made blood gush out.
“Still won’t talk? You won’t die, but sometimes life can be worse than death.”
He Haodong gnashed his teeth and roared, “Tell me who killed my son?”
“I don’t know.” Luo Yunhai closed his eyes and howled.
He Haodong was outraged, “Humph, have it your way. If you don’t know then what’s Chu Qingcheng doing in your clan?”
“I told you. She came here by herself. That’s all I know.”
“Bullshit, she doesn’t have the strength to get out of the Ruby Cloud Sect. There were Emperors watching her every movement as well. The Enchanting Empress had told me already so don’t try to lie to me!” He Haodong’s tone went higher as he finished.
With blood dripping constantly, Luo Yunhai still stuck to his same words, “I don’t know! She just came to the Luo clan and said she left the Ruby Cloud Sect, that she could only rely on us. How should I know how she escaped? Go ask her instead!”
“You think I don’t want that instead of wasting time on you?”
He Haodong grew mad, “Are you oblivious or just faking not knowing how important she is to me? Using force on her will ruin everything I worked for over the past century!”
Huff~
Luo Yunhai panted, his eyes mocking, “So this is the Sacred Mountain Lord, nothing but a common street thug. Since you can’t deal with her, you’re taking out on me. Humph, well I know nothing!”
Bam!
Luo Yunhai’s head flung to the side from the punch, coughing blood and teeth.
“Ignorant fool, stop being pretentious!”
He Haodong left with a flick of his sleeves, “The fools of Eight Emperors’s lands are getting outrageous to look down on the divine Sacred Mountains. It’s time we teach them what real terror is.”
He Haodong closed the iron gate behind him.
Luo Yunhai smiled as he sighed.
[It’s like big brother Zhuo said, he won’t touch sister Qingcheng. I’m relieved…]
Luo Yunhai closed his eyes, slipping into unconsciousness…
He Haodong walked out of the room and two people appeared in a bow.
He Haodong glared, “How’s the girl? Is she making trouble?”
“Mountain Lord, all she’s done is insist on wanting to see that kid.”
“Good, just remember to treat her well if we want to get anything.”
“Yes, Mountain Lord, just like the ancient texts say. She can only give what she holds of her own will, never forced. We won’t let the young miss feel any regret.”
“Good.”
He Haodong nodded and held a bloody piece of clothing with a warm smile. He then went with the two towards a refined room. He knocked, “Qingcheng, may I come in?”
“Enter.”
He Haodong smiled at her cold tone and regarded the charming Chu Qingcheng inside as he entered.
Chu Qingcheng was urgent in her demands, “Where’s Yunhai? Where are you holding him?”
“Don’t worry, Qingcheng, young master Luo is my friend that I treat with respect and care. He’s my guest, ha-ha-ha…”
“I want to see him!” Chu Qingcheng said.
He Haodong shook his head, looking kind, way different from the vicious side he showed moments before, “It’s not possible. Men and women need to keep their distance. You and Feng’er haven’t married, but I see you as my daughter-in-law. I could never let some random boy get close to you. It’ll be a scandal throughout the Sacred Mountains.”
“Don’t call me that. Your son is dead and I have nothing to do with the Sacred Mountains!” Chu Qingcheng snapped.
He Haodong sighed, “My son had to have been fated with you. He was so excited when he came back from outside. You were all he talked about. I could tell that he was in love.”
[Just keep acting. You think I haven’t heard your son’s talk with my master? That’s not love, but selfishness over something I have.]
Chu Qingcheng rolled her eyes, though she didn’t reveal it for if He Haodong knew his deceit was out, he wouldn’t be as accommodating.
To save Luo Yunhai, to keep the Luo clan safe, she had to play along…

chapters.title: Chapter 1277: Foul Wretched Bugs
chapters.content:
Proofreader
: Papatonks
[Having been around the Luo clan and Zhuo Fan for so long, I’ve become shifty myself.]
[Uh, I mean clever, yes clever!]
Chu Qingcheng showed a bright smile and bowed, “Mountain Lord He, I’m gratified but I don’t feel the same way for young master. I ask that you let us go.”
“A girl’s heart can’t be forced. This means Feng’er isn’t the lucky one. It’s not your fault, miss Chu.”
He Haodong looked out the window, looking pained, “At the devastating news of my son’s demise, I could only shed tears and nothing else. Miss Chu, I ask that you please tell me anything you might know about his death.”
He Haodong gave Chu Qingcheng a deep bow.
Chu Qingcheng helped him up, “Senior, you’re being too courteous to someone like me.”
“It’s only proper. If I can clear my son’s injustice, then I will even kowtow.” He put on a sincere expression, with tears brimming in his eyes.
Chu Qingcheng realized she’d have fallen for his trick if not for knowing the truth.
Even so, her young heart was still moved.
[He must love his son.]
Regardless of sympathy, she would still not rat Zhuo Fan out.
Ugh!
He Haodong held his chest and fell to the ground, looking pale. Chu Qingcheng panicked and rushed to help, “Senior, w-what’s wrong…”
“M-miss Chu, I can’t bear it. Could you promise me something?” He Haodong had a ragged breathing.
Chu Qingcheng was quick to agree, “Tell me.”
“This… is for you.”
He Haodong showed her a jade bracelet in five colors, “It’s made of ancient jade harvested from the Sea Abyss Forest. It only forms once a million years. It helps clear the mind and strengthen the soul. Even those with poor talent can become Saints.”
Chu Qingcheng was shocked, “Sea Abyss Forest has sea beasts and flying spiritual beasts around at the 12th and 11th level. Even Saints don’t go there. This must be invaluable.”
“Yes, it is.”
He strained to explain, “Those spiritual beasts always watch over it with scrutiny. Since it can open their minds, then they would never let anyone take it. The Seven Sacred Mountains had suffered great losses to take just this piece. And now it’s yours.”
“No, I can’t accept something so rare.”
“It’s because it’s valuable that I’m giving you in Feng’er’s stead.”
Cough~…
He Haodong coughed blood looking weaker, “I planned on gifting it to Feng’er’s future wife, but with him gone and as he loved you, I’ll give it to you in his stead.”
He Haodong forced it in Chu Qingcheng’s hand, but she still shook her head, “I can’t accept…”
“Qingcheng, did you forget your promise to me? If you refuse, I’ll just destroy the Luo clan.”
Chu Qingcheng shuddered and was silent.
He Haodong smiled and coughed a few more times. Chu Qingcheng didn’t know what to do.
Two people rushed in just then and cried out at He Haodong’s state.
“Mountain Lord, are you alright?”
“I’m fine. I… can’t bear it…”
He Haodong smiled at Chu Qingcheng, “Qingcheng, you can go now.”
“Go?”
“Yes, I got my wish so you can go.”
He Haodong smiled through his tears, “Ever since Feng’er passed, I had two wishes. To find the cause of his death, for revenge, and give this bracelet to you for my son. The second is the most important, for this fulfills Feng’er’s longing. Now I am at peace.”
He Haodong sighed with a smile, closing his eyes like he was no longer for this world.
The two people cried out in panic, “Mountain Lord, you can’t go…”
“Senior, wake up…”
Chu Qingcheng shook all over, “Isn’t senior a peak Saint? How did he become so weak?”
The two attendants sighed, “Miss, ever since young lord passed, Mountain Lord has been sick with worry and in despair. His cultivation went wrong and his heart was plagued by demons. He took medicine but it didn’t help. He had no reason to live, even if he is a peak Saint.”
Chu Qingcheng was filled with worry.
He was ruthless, but he loved his son dearly.
“What will become of the 6th Sacred Mountain with the Mountain Lord’s passing? Civil war, chaos, murder? We’d take Mountain Lord’s place if we could.”
The two teared up and said, “Miss, the Mountain Lord said you can go. I will take care of everything, so that you and young master Luo can leave. We will handle the funeral and won’t be seeing any more guests.”
Chu Qingcheng hesitated, “Let’s not get too hasty. I’ll stay to send senior off.”
“Doesn’t miss hate the Mountain Lord for taking you?”
“Why would I hate him? He has always been kind to me and I’d feel pain to see him go like this.”
“You don’t want the Mountain Lord to die?”
“Of course not!”
Chu Qingcheng sighed, “He is so kind, hurting so much for his son, so pitiful. I really wish I could save him.”
The two nodded and said, “Miss, why not try it. Maybe your kindness and thoughts could help him? The Mountain Lord has always seen you as a daughter-in-law. Without his son, you’re the only one he cares about in the world. That’s why he would give you the most precious item on the 6th Sacred Mountains.”
Looking at the bracelet, Chu Qingcheng nodded and held He Haodong’s hand, using her Yuan Qi.
“Senior, hold on, don’t die.”
He Haodong was still unconscious.
The attendants were panicking, “Miss Chu, you can do it. Heal his heart and the Mountain Lord will surely wake up!”
Chu Qingcheng nodded and used her Yuan Qi until she was almost spent, even sweating from exertion.
“Miss Chu, forgive us for not being of any help. The Mountain Lord cared so much about you, only your Yuan Qi can wake him. We fear our Yuan Qi will only make it worse. The Mountain Lord’s heart is broken and not his body.”
“I know!”
Chu Qingcheng gnashed her teeth and worked harder, with no results.
The two urged her harder, “Miss Chu, you have to save him with all your heart. Your sincerity is sure to save the Mountain Lord.”
Chu Qingcheng closed her eyes and gave all she had.
Chu Qingcheng slumped from tiredness, leaving the attendants sighing, “Mountain Lord, she did her best but nothing came out.”
“This means she must be committed with all her being for it to work.”
He Haodong’s pale face returned to normal and looked at  Chu Qingcheng with gnashed teeth, “I had Feng’er get her to be smitten with him so that his death would be the best case to make this work. Now even if this chick wants to save me, it’s not at her own sacrifice, so it is of no use!”
The two were silent.
He Haodong stood, “Let her rest. We’ll think of something. Also, go to the Luo clan and see if Zhuo Fan is back. I heard the two are in love and maybe we can use that prick to get the thing out of her.”
“Mountain Lord, won’t we fail letting him get it out of miss Chu?”
“Fool, ever heard of sleight of hand? I’ll just grab it before it goes to him.” He Haodong glared.
A mocking laughter reach their ears just then, “Ha-ha-ha, you want Sovereignty? Foul wretched bugs like you aren’t worth it!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1278: Mystery Expert
chapters.content:
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Who said that?” He Haodong barked.
Boom!
A violent sword wave came crashing down from the heavens above, laying the fine room to ruins and disintegrating everything in its path. The mighty sword energy surged and He Haodong with his attendants were sent flying in the explosion.
Once the dust settled, everything was leveled, with no one in sight.
He Haodong shuddered, looking stiffly at the sky.
[A t-true expert has come!]
Whoosh~
The Sacred Mountains experts rushed at the commotion, only to see He Haodong, “Mountain Lord, what happened? Are you alright?”
“I-I’m fine.”
He Haodong found it hard to speak, still out of it. Then he panicked and rummaged through the rubble, “Where’s Chu Qingcheng?”
The two attendants bowed, “Mountain Lord, wasn’t she killed?”
“No, the attack was to blind us and not to kill us. We wouldn’t have survived otherwise.” He Haodong was solemn.
The others bowed, “Mountain Lord, what happened?”
“Someone came to save Chu Qingcheng!”  He Haodong gnashed his teeth, his voice shaking from rage and fear.
The others gasped, roaring, “No way! We’ve guarded the 6th Sacred Mountain all these years. Not even other mountain’s Saints can slip in. How could he just come in and slip out unnoticed after attacking the Mountain Lord?”
“He must be terrifying!”
He Haodong wiped his brow, “He can come and go as he pleases and toyed with our lives. His strength must be monstrous. Did he kill my son? Was he after the thing in the girl?”
The others were stunned, “Mountain Lord, does that mean getting revenge for young lord…”
“What revenge?”
He Haodong shook his head, “The problem is, can we take the thing back when such a mystery expert holds it? When did the Sacred Domain have such a monstrous figure? It’s horrible!”
He Haodong sighed, while the others were deep in thought about their future.
They had been after Chu Qingcheng for a hundred years now, only for another to take her from them. All their effort was in vain…
In the secret room, Luo Yunhai was hanging by a thread on the cross.
Bam!
The thick steel door was kicked open. Luo Yunhai cheered, “Big brother Zhuo, you came!”
“Hush, we came to save you.”
Zhuo Fan and Sword Child got close and took out the rods before giving him a healing ill, “Where’s Qingcheng?”
Luo Yunhai shook his head, “I don’t know. I’ve been locked up since we arrived. But I don’t think they’ll try anything with her.”
“I know they have plans for Qingcheng and won’t touch her.” Zhuo Fan patted his shoulder, his eyes fierce, “You’ve been through a lot, brother, but now I’m taking revenge, ten times over!”
Luo Yunhai nodded.
Zhuo Fan was talking big. This was the Sacred Mountains, filled with experts and he wanted to run amok? What about finding you out and making it worse?
Luo Yunhai had unflinching belief in his big brother. When he said something, he’d do it.
Putting the wounded Luo Yunhai on his back, Zhuo Fan had Sword Child scout ahead, “Be quiet and don’t alert them. We’ll get at these fools after we find Qingcheng and she’s safe.”
“I know, dad. I know your style. I won’t let them get any upper hands on us.” Sword Child nodded.
Luo Yunhai was curious, “Big brother Zhuo, didn’t you make a scene two hours ago? Aren’t they alerted already? I think they are.”
“Two hours ago?”
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, “We only just arrived. We were still far away two hours ago to have done anything.”
“It wasn’t you who made such a loud noise.”
“Of course not, I’m not that reckless. Going in head first will get them to hang you two over my head.” Zhuo Fan gasped, “Oh, right, who else made a scene on the Sacred Mountains besides us? Is it inner conflict?”
Zhuo Fan turned to Sword Child.
He shook his head, “Inner conflict with no guards around? Expecting no defensive array from the great Sacred Mountains is far fetched. They think no one would attack this place? So it was because someone struck already. He-he-he, dad, our luck is great. Someone took the brunt while we saw no patrols.”
“But who did it?”
Zhuo Fan was doubtful, “There are hardly any with the strength and nerve to strike at the Sacred Mountains.”
“Who the hell cares? With the Sacred Mountains in panic, we have an easy time moving.”
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Right. Let’s get Qingcheng and then we’ll be free to act. The 6th Sacred Mountain is going to disappear from the Sacred Domain!”
Zhuo Fan smirked and left with Luo Yunhai on his back and Sword Child guarding them.
Two steps out the door and someone shouted, “Who are you? Where are you taking the prisoner?”
“It’s an Emperor.”
“And at peak.”
Zhuo Fan and Sword Child shared a look and a devious grin. Sword Child flashed and ran through the man, exploding him to pieces.
Sword Child dusted his hands in disdain, “Emperors are now beneath me and he dared block us? Idiot.”
“How dare you!”
Another shout came and hundreds of auras appeared in front.
Zhuo Fan was grave, “Curses, they’re all Saints. The Sacred Mountains are filled with experts.”
“What now, dad? Get past them or kill them?” Sword Child whispered.
Zhuo Fan paused, “I came here to kill them and earn a name. But they have Qingcheng and we can’t attack. Should we just get through first?”
“Then use your Sacred Body and my strength. They can’t stop you.”
Zhuo Fan nodded and black energy spilled out of him, forming his Sacred Body.
Fighting Saints would be taxing, especially if he were killing every one of them. But carving a bloody path wasn’t hard.
One man stood out shouting, sealing the fate of the 6th Sacred Mountain, “Who are you? Were you the ones who took Chu Qingcheng? Talk!”
“Qingcheng isn’t here?”
Zhuo Fan caught his meaning.
[Someone has come ahead and rescued her. I don’t know who or why, but one thing is certain— Qingcheng isn’t here.]
He could let loose.
Zhuo Fan snickered, “Hey you, was that the truth?”
“I am the 6th Mountain Lord, He Haodong!”
He Haodong barked, “A sword wave fell on Chu Qingcheng’s room and leveled it. Since then, she’s been missing, did you take her? Do you know what that was? Speak!”
Zhuo Fan smiled in realization, “Sorry, but we don’t know who that was. We only came for our Clan Head.”
“Clan Head?”
He Haodong then noticed Luo Yunhai on his back, “I see now. You’re from the Luo clan. Humph, you have some nerve, Eight Emperors’ lands’ bugs showing up here on the Sacred Mountains trying to take someone. Your entire clan is dead?”
“Dead? Humph…”
Zhuo Fan laughed, “You should worry about your 6th Sacred Mountain first…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1279: Saint Battle
chapters.content:
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Everyone looked at Zhuo Fan’s grin with gaping mouths. Many of them started laughing and mocking his outrageous claim.
Zhuo Fan was the first in ages to challenge the Sacred Mountains.
He Haodong enjoyed deriding him, “Whose fool are you? Are you so slow in the head to spout such nonsense?”
“I am the Luo clan’s steward, Zhuo Fan.”
“You’re that Zhuo Fan?”
He Haodong was silent, then shouted, “You’re the guy close to Qingcheng? Did you have something to do with her rescue?”
“Humph, it doesn’t matter, since it has nothing to do with you.”
Zhuo Fan smirked, flying with Luo Yunhai on his back, “You don’t need to know where you’re going.”
They turned to Zhuo Fan with lost gazes.
[He’s not even in the Profound Heaven Stage yet he can fly?]
“He’s full of tricks!”
One elder roared and flew after him. He shone golden and a giant with twelve shields appeared around him. He was a mid Saint.
“You’re boasting and looking for trouble on the 6th Sacred Mountain, for that you will die here! You won’t escape. We’ll see soon enough who among us will die!”
“Humph, as you wish.”
Zhuo Fan quipped, letting black energy flood the heavens and taking the form of a black giant, violent and powerful.
They all gasped.
[He’s a Saint? How? How could anyone from the Eight Emperors’ lands have the arts to reach the Saint Stage?]
Reaching a higher stage needed more than just talent and perception. A cultivation method was paramount, needing a heaven ranked method to become a Saint.
But all such cultivation methods were long since monopolized by the Sacred Mountains.
For a Saint to appear outside of the Sacred Mountains was a slim chance, only through incredible talent or perception in creating their own heaven ranked cultivation method.
The Seven Sacred Mountains would pursue anyone that was such a man to join them, while the ones that refused just wandered about.
With few rogue Saints about, they were no threat and they weren’t stupid enough to attack the Seven Sacred Mountains, maintaining balance of the Sacred Domain.
It was unthinkable how someone had the nerve to use three of the Sacred Mountains’ disciples for pawns and then come take someone from their mountain. What was more, it was done by Zhuo Fan, whom they all knew to be weak.
Everyone was filled with bloodlust.
Instead of just minding his own business he kept thwarting the Sacred Mountains’ plans. He had to die.
He Haodong roared, “Elder Lu, kill him!”
“Yes, Mountain Lord!” Elder Lu grinned in confidence.
It was obvious to anyone that one was mid and the other was an early Saint. He would win for sure…
[Soaring Demonic Dragon!]
Zhuo Fan sneered and the huge dragon on the giant’s chest shot out of of it.
Boom!
A dreadful explosion echoed that shook the skies. Elder Lu had his guard down, taking Zhuo Fan for easy pickings, and the black dragon made a half a mile large hole in the elder’s giant.
The twelve shields crumbled to dust.
Elder Lu coughed blood as his Sacred Body collapsed, falling to the ground.
“Elder Lu!” The others cried out, while their minds abuzz from what they saw.
[Elder Lu is stronger and trained in a high cultivation method on the Sacred Mountains. How did he lose so fast?]
[Even if the punk has the aptitude to make a cultivation method to reach the Saint Stage, it can’t match with ours, polished over millions of years.]
A draconic roar echoed and the black dragon turned on Elder Lu, swallowing him whole.
The dragon returned to Zhuo Fan’s Sacred Body’s chest. The head looked violent as its maw spilled black energy.
The others felt a chill down their spines.
[What a savage Sacred Body!]
He Haodong frowned and flew up. Lightning crackled and a vajra body with twelve greatswords on its back appeared around him.
Whoosh!
He Haodong took two of the thunderblades and hacked at Zhuo Fan.
“Oh, Mountain Lord is going ahead. Is it to save face?”
Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, “Well, sorry to disappoint. Soaring Demonic Dragon!”
The dragon roared once more and came out of the giant’s chest, going for He Haodong.
Bam!
He Haodong was ready, blocking with a thunderblade and using the other to strike.
The black dragon got split in two, vanishing like black mist. Zhuo Fan shook and staggered back at the backlash.
But then, his giant sported another black dragon head, while Zhuo Fan turned serious for once, “Humph, you’re peak Saint after all and have some skill.”
“Cut the crap and die!”
He Haodong went on the offensive, his two thunderblades sending thousands of sword waves at Zhuo Fan.
Zhuo Fan had his Sacred Body dance through the strikes, suddenly pausing when the attacks stopped. Dozens of lashes appeared on his Sacred Body, his scales broke, turning to dust.
Zhuo Fan shook and blood leaked from his mouth.
Luo Yunhai cried, “Big brother Zhuo, are you alright?”
“Mountain Lord is formidable!” The crowd cheered seeing Zhuo Fan being pushed back.
[There’s nothing amazing about getting a couple dozen hits in from thousands. This guy is good.]
He Haodong saw the truth and his expression grew grave.
He was a peak Saint while the other was a fresh one. It should be an easy job killing him. But the way he avoided most of his attacks showed he lost in that exchange.
If they were of equal cultivation, then he himself would die in one hit.
[This kid isn’t normal, that’s why Elder Lu suffered.]
He Haodong’s thunderblades flashed through the air as he went for Zhuo Fan, blocking any chance at dodging.
Luo Yunhai cried, “Big brother Zhuo…”
“Mountain Lord, kill him!” Those below cheered.
Zhuo Fan squinted and shouted, “Come, my sword!”
“Yes, father!”
Whoosh!
The ignored Sword Child flew in the sky, turning into a black blade and entering Zhuo Fan’s hand.
He Haodong’s violent sword hacked at Zhuo Fan.
Boom!
With a sudden thunderclap, a black glow shone and the sword vanished.
Everyone looked agape, with He Haodong staggering back two steps as the two thunderblades in his hands crumbled.
He Haodong coughed blood and shuddered. He watched as Zhuo Fan’s giant held a black longsword, the same one his real body was holding.
Both of them had black flames licking its blade, eerie and sinister…

chapters.title: Chapter 1280: Crushing a Sacred Mountain
chapters.content:
Proofreader
: Papatonks
He Haodong’s face shook, his eyes grew wide. He then turned grave as he got his arm behind him.
All that mattered now was winning, regardless of what the enemy came up with.
He Haodong charged again, unleashing another sword image, to which Zhuo Fan merely waved his black sword.
Crack~
The two new thunderblades crumbled to nothing.
Everyone gasped, gawking at Zhuo Fan in disbelief.
[What sword is that to be so deadly?]
The twelve thunderblades on Mountain Lord He’s back were a part of his Sacred Body, made of lightning. Like the 12th heaven purple lightning, tough beyond belief and at the 6th grade sacred weapon level.
[How could they just break?]
He Haodong was just as baffled.
Regardless of these issues, he chose to still go through with it. He had come out alone and now he had to finish off Zhuo Fan to preserve his dignity as the big boss on the mountain.
Zhuo Fan killed Elder Lu and he came out to win back the loss and get revenge.
Falling back now would only bring him shame.
He Haodong took a deep breath and roared, “Heaven-breaking Swords!”
Ding~
The remaining eight thunderblades flew from his back and soared into the sky, appearing like flashes of lightning. Black holes cracked in the sky from their incredible power, forming a net and threatening to break the fabric of space.
The eight thunderblades multiplied into a thunderstorm, ready to rain havoc on the world below.
The sheer amount struck fear in all beings.
The audience cheered.
[Mountain Lord He’s supreme martial art is out! It drove terror into the hearts of many 11th level dragon Saints in the past great war.]
Now it was used on some poor lonely bastard.
[Who would ever have the same honor of facing Mountain Lord He’s ultimate skill alone?]
Mountain Lord He hasn’t used it in ages, and now the crowd was excited to see it again.
All smirked at Zhuo Fan’s plight, writing him off.
[Humph, it’s all over for you. Even with your hard blade, there’s nothing you can do against a flood of sword waves. Your Sacred Body will be crushed and death will surely follow, ha-ha-ha… There will be nothing left of you to bury.]
[You should be honored to die at the same move that defeated many dragons, humph.]
All the Saints took it as Zhuo Fan’s doom, while Luo Yunhai looked on with worry.
Zhuo Fan just smiled and grinned, “Sword Child, wanna give it a try?”
“Dad, it’s merely a concept and I haven’t understood it. It’s too risky against so many enemies.” Sword Child sighed.
Zhuo Fan didn’t care, “It’s because they’re so many that makes it a good practice run. Where else am I supposed to test it? I let the fight drag out just so I could train.”
“Alright, try it then, Divine Eye of the Void and the Apocalyptic Sword together.” The sword shook and black energy seeped out.
“Kill!”
He Haodong signaled and the thunderblades fell like a torrent of heavy rain, right on Zhuo Fan’s head. The immense pressure had the black energy on Zhuo Fan’s giant tremble.
All looked on with sneers.
Zhuo Fan was confident as he raised the demonic sword.
Hum~
Zhuo Fan and the giant’s right eye shone in nine golden halos.
“Divine Eye of the Void 9th stage, Void Eater!”
“Apocalyptic Sword Art, Obliterate!”
Zhuo Fan and Sword Child shouted at the same time and the giant spun, cutting with the greatsword all around.
The space warped around it under the eerie power, spreading out farther and farther away.
The incoming deadly thunderblades warped as well, with the space around them vanishing into nothing.
Not a single thunderblade could ever get within ten meters of Zhuo Fan, vanishing into thin air.
He Haodong guffawed, “What the hell?”
The others were stumped as well.
[Where are the lightning swords? Where did they go?]
“Ah!”
A sudden cry broke the stifling silence.
They looked up to see He Haodong’s vajra Sacred Body twisting like the thunderblades.
He couldn’t even get away, the Sacred Body twisted beyond recognition before vanishing under the eyes of all the Saints.
He Haodong gasped and shouted, “What kind of martial art is this?”
“Mountain Lord He, shouldn’t you be asking about your son’s death instead?”
“What?!” He Haodong shuddered.
Zhuo Fan nodded, “Yes, I killed him.”
“You!”
He Haodong raged, clenching his fists and then popping out of existence just like that.
“Uh…”
The others were overwhelmed with shock.
[Where’s Mountain Lord He? Did he die?]
[The guy used one creepy art. What on earth did it do?]
Even Luo Yunhai on Zhuo Fan’s back was baffled, “Big brother Zhuo…”
“Ha-ha-ha, it’s the first trial run, so of course you don’t know.”
Zhuo Fan explained, “After becoming a Saint, my Divine Eye of the Void reached the 9th stage, Void Eater, allowing it to devour all space in my domain. Sword Child used his strongest Apocalyptic Sword Art in correlation with my attack to form an Apocalyptic Void and annihilate all in my domain before they even notice. As the devouring spreads out, any caught within it will vanish before they know it.”
Luo Yunhai gasped, “Then you can kill anyone, even those caught off-guard, before they even know it.”
“Not quite. This skill uses Apocalyptic Sword Art and if the other has higher swordsmanship then I can’t touch him.”
“There’s someone who can block your sword when a peak Saint couldn’t?” Luo Yunhai started.
Zhuo Fan was grave, “Of course, since s peak Saint is nothing. I’ve always been afraid of the one equal to me, no, the one above me.”
Zhuo Fan felt a heavy weight on his shoulder thinking how the enemy was three stages above in the Divine Eye of the Void.
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan shuddered and the black giant vanished.
Luo Yunhai asked, “Big brother Zhuo…”
“He’s spent. Let’s get him and force him to give Mountain Lord He back. He must’ve used some trick to grab Mountain Lord He!”
The Saints roared and hundreds charged with their power on display.
Zhuo Fan wiped his brow and said to Luo Yunhai, “I’m not used to the 9th stage and it takes a lot out of me. Killing a peak Saint, and working in combination with Sword Child to unleash that attack left me empty.”
“What do we do?” Luo Yunhai glanced at the savage Saints coming to kill them.
Zhuo Fan smirked, “Like I said, crush them.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1281: Overwhelming Shock
chapters.content:
Proofreader
: Papatonks
“Crush them? How, when they’re so many?” Luo Yunhai didn’t understand.
Zhuo Fan smirked, “With this.”
Zhuo Fan took out a huge golden fireball. Its dreaded power surged around, forcing the many Sacred Bodies to halt in fear.
“W-what is that? Why does it feel so scary?”
“A Dragon Breath Pill!”
Zhuo Fan smiled at the familiar ball, “Decimating Dragon Ancestor gave me three of these in mortal domain, each unleashing his full power. I wasted one for revenge, another against Heaven Sealing Sea Ao and this is the last. I planned to save it when things got dire, especially against
him
, but I have no choice. Since these guys want to die so much, I’ll oblige them, ha-ha-ha.”
Zhuo Fan flicked the huge fireball on top of their heads, laughing, “Here’s a present for you! I, Zhuo Fan, am a man of my word. I said I’ll crush you and that’s what I’ll do, ha-ha-ha…”
“We have to block it!”
The others felt the tremendous power of the Dragon Breath Pill and shouted. Everyone used their best skills against it along with their Sacred Bodies.
Despite the hundreds of Saints using enough power to destroy the world, it was still not enough to even shake the fireball. It hardly even shrank.
Under the fearful eyes of all, the golden fireball struck them…
Boom!
A huge explosion was unleashed, followed by a sudden heat wave. The Decimating Golden Flame swallowed the 6th Sacred Mountain whole.
The mighty Saint army had no time to scream their last before they burned to ashes.
Their tough bodies were eroded and vanished, even faster than when Zhuo Fan handled He Haodong.
In seconds, the 6th Sacred Mountain was a raging sea of golden flames. The beautiful sceneries, the fancy pavilions, all were reduced to dust.
In just one strike, a great Sacred Mountain now disappeared from reality.
Only the golden sea of flames was the sole proof of it ever existing, and of the horror that was unleashed to erase it.
Luo Yunhai’s face twitched as he gasped. He never got to see such an astonishing spectacle in his life.
“Big brother Zhuo, that’s why you weren’t scared. You had such a trick up your sleeve.”
“A shame it was the last one…” Zhuo Fan clicked his tongue, “Next time I meet tough opposition, better keep my nose down. Then again, there probably aren’t that many out there at my level, ha-ha-ha…”
Luo Yunhai nodded, “You killed the 6th Sacred Mountain Lord, that means you can dominate anyone in the Sacred Domain in a duel. You’re also the only one in the clan capable of fighting the Sacred Mountains. What do we do when the other mountains come knocking?”
“It’s for that reason that I used the precious Dragon Breath Pill to crush the 6th Sacred Mountain.”
Zhuo Fan eased a breath, “The worst thing about humans is their cowardly natures, the Sacred Mountains included. The stronger you are, the more afraid they’ll be. If I had left it after saving you and Qingcheng, then all of the Sacred Mountains would’ve come for revenge. Since I killed those entitled pricks, the Sacred Mountains, who value reputation and dignity above all else, will definitely have come in force.”
Luo Yunhai was grave, “Yes, the Sacred Domain is just like the mortal domain. The higher-ups or emperors are nothing but hypocrites. For their name, they’ll never see reason, nor honor.”
“That’s why I crushed the 6th Sacred Mountain, to give them a fright. They don’t know my limit and won’t rush to get me out of fear of suffering the same fate. We can drag it out for a year and a bit, wait on the dragons’ report so that we may really have a fighting chance against the Sacred Mountains. Before that, bluffing is the way to go.”
Luo Yunhai smiled, “Just like when the Luo clan got set up and Veiled Dragon Pavilion thought we were something big when we had nothing.”
“Yeah, the Sacred Mountains may believe that we still have Dragon Breath Pills when in reality we’ve already run out.”
Zhuo Fan smirked and the two laughed.
Luo Yunhai frowned, “Mountain Lord He said someone took Qingcheng, but who and to where?”
Zhuo Fan’s eyes shone, “If he came to the Sacred Mountains, he could’ve easily killed some girl. But now I don’t know where to look for her. The expert had to be a top power in the Sacred Domain.  Out of the Seven Sacred Mountains, that leaves Dragon Lands. But it doesn’t look like they would move…”
“Maybe there’s some hidden power like us?”
“Could be, but that would be even worse.”
Zhuo Fan sighed, leaving after giving the flames one last look, “Let’s go, I’ll think about Qingcheng later. We now need to spread this news throughout the Eight Emperors’ lands. We’ll grasp the people’s support and become their leader. Once the dragons respond, we can crush the rest of the Sacred Mountains and usher in a brave new world.”
Zhuo Fan left the sea of flames.
A shadow watched him go from a distance, “Decimating Dragon Ancestor’s fire. He’s with the sacred beasts.”
“Ugh…”
The man shook and looked back to see Chu Qingcheng groaning.
The man shook his head, “The kid has different tastes now, giving a Sovereign path to this girl, ha-ha-ha…”
The man left as well…
A month later, news of the 6th Sacred Mountain’s destruction rocked the Sacred Domain.
[The top power in the Sacred Domain for eons up and got crushed just cause you said so? Not even the dragons would do it if they could.]
[They can crush a mountain as well, but they could never destroy all of them.]
For even dragons could be surrounded and defeated as more and more mountains joined the attack.
That was why the dragons had no chance against the Sacred Mountains.
Now, though, the 6th Sacred Mountain was no more. It left people in disbelief, for this meant one thing only.
That the other party was so strong it could finish a mountain like nothing and that it was so large that it trumped the 6th Sacred Mountain’s defenses, stopping them from even calling for help.
When did the Sacred Domain have such a powerful group?
People shook their heads.
[Damn blasted rumor. How come something like this happens? What fool would believe this crap? Ha-ha-ha, what morons.]
Then came the Luo clan’s announcement, stirring the people once more. The rumor they wrote off as exaggeration ended up confirmed.
That meant they could believe it, leaving the people in shock that a Sacred Mountain was no more.
What was even more astonishing was that the new Luo clan from the Eight Emperors’  lands was the one that did it.
[Is the Luo clan that strong? Can they go to war and crush the Sacred Mountains just cause they say it? That’s the everlasting Sacred Mountains for eons and eons we’re talking about here! Some upstart clan up and wasted the 6th Mountain and its people?]
Everyone in the Sacred Domain felt numb, their world view crumbling.
[Huh, so Sacred Mountains aren’t that tough like they claim. Their day has come and a new overlord will replace them…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1282: Mirror Moon Cottage
chapters.content:
Proofreader
: Papatonks
In the large hall on the 7th Sacred Mountain, six elders sat in their chairs, overlooking the three youths below.
The three youths kneeled in respect.
The elder with the long beard nodded, “You have been carefully selected among all the talents to go out and replace Xu Tianchuan and the other two in taking over the Eight Emperors’ lands. I hope you won’t disappoint us like they did.”
“Mountain Lord, we won’t fail you!” They cupped their hands and declared.
The elders nodded with smiles.
Xu Tianchuan’s group had been an utter disappointment, but if there was one thing the Sacred Mountains had, it was disciples. They had done a harsher selection this time around and chosen the best of the best to replace those fools.
[This should settle it, ha-ha-ha!]
The elder with the long beard waved them away, “You’re to leave in three days!”
“Yes, Mountain Lord!” They bowed again as they withdrew.
The elder with the long beard turned to the others, “I have high hopes for these three. They aren’t arrogant and reckless. They are more than enough to take over the Eight Emperors’ lands.”
“Yeah…”
The others nodded and an elder with white brows added, “Old He has been gone for a long time to just be setting those three brats straight. What’s taking him so long? We haven’t heard from the brats either.  Strange.”
The others squinted.
The elder with the long beard waved it off, “Ha-ha-ha, those brats must’ve been so berated by Old He that they feel too ashamed to come back. They must be working hard to make up for their mistakes in the Eight Emperors’ lands. It may take time to uproot the devious and heinous Luo clan from this world and restore the Sacred Mountains’ dignity. Old He must be keeping watch. Everything should be fine, ha-ha-ha…”
Everyone nodded and smiled.
“Mountain Lord, this is bad!”
A shocked voice came from outside. The elder with the long beard frowned and shouted back, “What happened that has you so panicked? Report!”
“Mountain Lord, this is really bad!”
A young man entered the hall incoherent and distraught. He fell to his knees and stammered, “It’s crazy, utter madness…”
“What is? Speak clearly!”
“The Eight Emperors’ lands have risen up!”
The youth yelled, “Xu Tianchuan and the two senior brothers were killed by the Luo clan, and their heads are hanging on the Luo clan’s gate. They also declared to all the lands that they’ll eliminate the Seven Sacred Mountains…”
“What?”
The six elders were shocked, with the elder with the long beard slapping his armrest in rage, “Outrageous! The Luo clan must’ve gone mad to kill someone from the Sacred Mountains! And they even dare say something like that? Humph, they should’ve been removed from the start. Tell some elders to annihilate the Luo clan. Let all of the Eight Emperors’ lands know what braggarts get for running their mouth!”
The disciple cried there, still not going out.
The elder with the long beard roared, “What are you standing there for? I gave you an order!”
“Mountain Lord, I don’t believe a few elders are enough. This involves the 6th Sacred Mountain. Allow me to finish…”
“What? A few Sacred Mountains elders aren’t enough for a nobody clan? I even thought it was too much!”
The elder with the long beard shook and glared, “Who is your master? You dare question my orders?”
The disciple reported, “Mountain Lord, I’d never. There’s just another matter I need to report. Mountain Lord can decide after sir hears it.”
“Speak.”
“The 6th Sacred Mountain is no more…”
Ugh!
The six old men went wide eyed from disbelief, the elder with the long beard blinked at a loss, “C-come again?”
The youth repeated himself and the head elder finally clutched his sparse hair in shock.
“This can’t be!”
The elder with the long beard howled at last, “Old He’s 6th Sacred Mountain has many experts with hardly anyone daring to attack it, with no one capable of crushing it. Where did you get that information? Don’t go spouting things!”
The youth’s lips quivered, “Mountain Lord, I’d wish for it to be fake, but I was sent to look into the 6th Sacred Mountain and saw it destroyed. The entire mountain is gone, now replaced by a strange golden sea of flames. It burns for thousands upon thousands of miles. Mountain Lords can go inspect it for themselves.”
Plop!
The elder with the long beard slumped in his chair, lost.
For the disciple to say that, it meant this was real.
[How could… a mighty Sacred Mountain…]
The elders were dark, their hearts sinking in fear. If the 6th Sacred Mountain was gone, then what about the rest…
They all shuddered. The grand and godlike Mountain Lords for thousands of years might be gone overnight. Dread gripped their hearts.
“Who did it? Did you find out?”
“As long as the culprit doesn’t say it, it will be hard to find out.” The elder with white brows spoke in shock.
The others nodded, their faced hard.
The disciple bowed, “Mountain Lords, there’s no need to investigate, for the culprit declared it himself.”
“Who?” They all shouted at the same time.
The youth muttered, “The Luo clan from the Eight Emperor’s lands…”
“What?”
“Mountain Lords, the information first came from the Luo clan’s announcements. It declares that Mountain Lord He had gone to the Luo clan and took their Clan Head. So the Head Steward Zhuo Fan went to the 6th Sacred Mountain in rage. He not only rescued his Clan Head but also flattened the mountain.”
The youth retold the same words on the declaration, “No one took it seriously when they declared war, but with the 6th Sacred Mountain gone, the Eight Emperors’ lands are boiling. The people go to the Luo clan and help them defeat us. All of Emperor lands see us with enmity.”
“Mountain Lords, this is why I did not convey your order. With the Emperor lands as our enemy, sending someone will have all eyes on them, but with the Luo clan having the power to destroy a mountain, there’s even more reason to be prudent. Sending the elders will only get them killed. I ask Mountain Lord to reconsider.”
The elder with the long beard’s face twitched and clenched his fists, “A puny Eight Emperors’ land clan dared to destroy a Sacred Mountain? Something just isn’t right here…’
“Yeah, this much power is a rarity. Unless…”
“What?” The head elder turned to the elder with white brows.
The latter continued, “Do you all remember the ancient legend?”
“You mean…”
“The ten Sovereigns fell, the five beasts vanquished, Shu Jing is gone, and the Sacred Mountains live on.” The elder with white brows said, “After the supreme experts vanished in ancient times the Sacred Mountains took over the Sacred Domain, but there’s one place that still strikes fear in us…”
“Mirror Moon Cottage!” They all shouted.
The elder with white brows continued, “Yes, the lord of Mirror Moon Cottage, Sir Shui Jing, is rumored to be exceptional. Some of our people offended him in ignorance and made thousands of Saints on Seven Sacred Mountains die. No one knew what happened or who triggered it. Since then, the Seven Sacred Mountains made a rule to never mess with Sir Shui Jing and his people.”
“After all these years, with the Sacred Mountains growing with every generation, Sir Shui Jing was never seen again and was forgotten. Now that the 6th Sacred Mountain is destroyed, it made me remember about an old senior’s warning. Maybe…”
“The Luo clan is theirs?”
Sss~
Everyone gasped, their hearts shuddering.
If it were true, then they had brought doom to themselves…

chapters.title: Chapter 1283: Illusion
chapters.content:
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Between the walls of an empty valley stood a bamboo pavilion. The waterfall next to it rumbled as it fell in a clear pool, completing the mesmerizing scenery.
A youth in white of around twenty sat in the pavilion, playing the zither. His finger gracefully traced the strings, sending a soothing melody throughout the valley.
Birds and butterflies gathered around, drawn to his music.
“Ugh…”
A groan came from a bed hidden by a curtain.
The young master never stopped his performance, “Awake?”
“Where am I?”
Chu Qingcheng parted the veil and looked about.
She was pale, squinting at the scenery with alertness, “Who are you?”
The youth smiled, “Miss, you’re safe here. I mean you no harm. You have exhausted yourself in the 6th Sacred Mountain, affecting your soul. You’re still weakened and need rest.”
“You didn’t answer my question.” Chu Qingcheng was on guard.
The youth paused, “Miss is so cautious. I can’t understand how you could let that He Haodong fool you so easily into wasting your Yuan Qi. Ha-ha-ha, it’s good that you didn’t care too much about him, or you’d have lost more than just your Yuan Qi, the thing someone granted you. But this proves how kind you are. I can understand why he’d give it to you.”
“What are you talking about?”
“Nothing, I’m just recalling some old matters.”
The youth continued playing, “Allow me to introduce myself. Everyone calls me Sir Shui Jing and Miss can call me the same. This is my home, Mirror Moon Cottage. Miss, you can stay here safely and no one will disturb you.”
Chu Qingcheng gave him a long look, “You’re keeping me here?”
“No, I’m only inviting Miss to be my guest.”
“You won’t stop me from leaving?”
“Of course not. I’m a man of my word.” Shui Jing focused on playing the zither.
Chu Qingcheng nodded and smiled, “You’re a dog if you break it.
“Not just a dog, but a she-dog.”
“I want to find Zhuo Fan. Don’t stop me.” Chu Qingcheng flew out of the pavilion and into the sky.
Shui Jing kept playing the zither.
Chu Qingcheng raised an eyebrow, “I don’t care who you are but you can’t keep me here. I am looking for Zhuo Fan to see what he has to say about you. If you’re nice, I’ll come back and thank you. But you’re too strange to be nice.”
Chu Qingcheng flew further away.
An hour later, Chu Qingcheng crossed ten mountains and saw no one on her way, not even a trace of civilization.
She was perplexed.
[Where am I? There’s no one here.]
She wanted to find someone and ask for directions to the Luo clan.
Six hours later, Chu Qingcheng was still feeling weak. She was getting tired from flying and the blazing sun overhead.
She then noticed a creek in a valley and landed.
But then she heard a zither being played and perked up.
[Where there’s a zither, there’s people!]
Chu Qingcheng skipped over to the source, brushing the veil away to enter the pavilion.
“Excuse me, is…” Chu Qingcheng froze in her tracks.
It was Shui Jing who kept playing.
Shui Jing smiled, “Miss Chu, you’re back? You need to rest in your condition.”
“W-why is it you?”
Chu Qingcheng looked around dumbstruck, “Why am I back here. I clearly left…”
Shui Jing shook his head, smiling.
Chu Qingcheng cupped her hands in anger, “Goodbye!”
Chu Qingcheng rushed out again, with Shui Jing still playing.
Another twelve hours passed and Chu Qingcheng looked determined but tired. She paused in the air in shock.
The familiar zither was heard once more.
[Maybe… no, he can’t still be here…]
Chu Qingcheng shook her head and landed in the familiar valley, seeing Shui Jing with his zither.
Shui Jing smiled, “Miss Chu, you need to rest after being gone for so long or you’re only going to get worse.”
“W-what did you do?”
Chu Qingcheng clenched her hands in anger, “You said you won’t keep me but you’re not honest!”
The zither stopped and Shui Jing smiled, “Miss Chu, have I done something to you?”
“You must’ve put up an illusory array to keep me returning here every time. You’re holding me prisoner.”
Shui Jing shook his head, “Miss Chu, I vow on my Dao Heart that there’s no array around.”
“Why can’t I go out?”
“This is Mirror Moon Cottage, where everything is an illusion. Fame and fortune, love and hate, these are what trap mortals from seeing the way out. What keeps you here is no array, but your own heart.”
Shui Jing smiled and vanished, his voice sounding through the valley, “Miss Chu, just rest here. I will come back every few days. Take care!”
“Wait! Let me go!”
Chu Qingcheng shouted at the air.
She took a deep breath and shot out with determination in another direction. But she still ended up here.
Panting from exhaustion, Chu Qingcheng tried again and again, with the same result. All she had done was waste time and energy.
After trying for eight times, Chu Qingcheng was too spent and blacked out in the air. She fell but the stones below warped and turned into the bed in the pavilion.
The next morning, Chu Qingcheng woke up to find herself back in the bed and saw the same waterfall outside and birds chirping.
Her heart was in a panic, unable to escape.
Shui Jing looked down from a tall peak with a sneer, “Everything is an illusion here, with riches and fame ephemeral. The ignorant can’t escape their own hearts. Chu Qingcheng is a rare good person, yet not even she can, let alone others. The world is hopeless, isn’t it Sword Heart?”
“No matter whether they appear hopeless, fate is not for ants to decide. It’s the will of the heavens!”
A middle-aged man next to him had a sharp gaze. His empty left sleeve floated in the wind.
Shui Jing held a confident smile, like he was in control, leaving. Sword Heart watched him go with a hard gaze.
The last act of heaven’s will was about to start…

chapters.title: Chapter 1284: Confrontation
chapters.content:
Proofreader
: Papatonks
Tap, tap!
A finger struck the table, betraying Zhuo Fan’s pensive mind.
Li Jingtian rushed into the room and Zhuo Fan quickly asked, “What’s the news?”
“Steward Zhuo, there’s no clue about Miss Chu. I couldn’t find…” Li Jingtian sighed with a hung head.
Zhuo Fan looked down as well, pacing in thought, “There aren’t many that can breach the Sacred Mountains and take someone away, and even fewer are those capable of doing it without leaving a trail. I just can’t figure out who could be behind this? Did anyone in the Sacred Domain have such a power?”
Li Jingtian was worried.
He was new to the Sacred Domain but even he had heard many rumors about most powers in these lands. To him, the Sacred Mountains were the peak of the Sacred Domain. Who then could steal someone from under their nose?
[They can’t be a nobody, that’s for sure.]
“Steward Zhuo, does the Sacred Domain have any hidden experts?” Li Jingtian mentioned.
Zhuo Fan shook his head, “For them to be hidden means not many are aware of them. I do know of a few rogue Saints but they aren’t as strong as the Sacred Mountains, let alone taking someone from them. Unless…”
“What?”
“Elder Li, who are above Saints?”
Li Jingtian lit up, “Sovereign?”
Zhuo Fan was grave. He’d seen his fair share of Sovereigns, and feared the one that never showed himself.
He had been consoling himself thinking they were all gone, or that they were too weak to show up.
But after meeting them, he woke up to reality.
[It’s not that they can’t be found, but they don’t want to be found. While them finding you can’t be easier.]
[Was taking Chu Qingcheng a clear strike on me though?]
Was the culprit the one he feared the most?
Zhuo Fan was sunk in thought. He didn’t fear death, but involving innocents. He was no longer alone…
“Is the Luo clan’s steward, Zhuo Fan, here? I am 7th Seven Sacred Mountain Lord, He Yunshan, here to request a meeting.”
(StarReader: not related to 6th Mountain Lord. Different surname.)
The sound of thunder struck from the sky and shook the Luo clan. Zhuo Fan heard and winced, “The 7th Mountain Lord? Here so soon?”
“Steward Zhuo, the dragons are still silent. What do we do?” Li Jingtian was tense.
Zhuo Fan thought for a moment, “Relax, for them to seek us and not fight us proves they are afraid. The Dragon Breath Pill might have gotten to them. We just have to be cool about it and they won’t do anything.”
“Let’s go meet them.”
“Yes, Steward Zhuo!”
Zhuo Fan led the way with Li Jingtian behind. The two flew for the city gates.
The Luo clan’s gates were surrounded by hundreds of people surging with incredible strength that struck fear in all. Saints!
In the lead were six people, the Mountain Lords. The elder with a long beard squinted and analyzed everyone. His eyes flickered with doubt. The others were just as baffled.
[That’s strange. All of the Luo clan is filled with nobodies. There are some at the Emperor Stage with impressive strength, but nothing Sacred Mountains can’t handle.]
Would the Sacred Mountains bother with a clan lacking even a Saint? Absolutely not.
So how come this nobody clan ended up flattening a Sacred Mountain?
The six elders whispered among each other.
“What do you think?”
“Completely average and not anything like Sir Shui Jing. A great master should have great disciples. It makes no sense for Shui Jing to not have Saints.”
“The problem lay with Steward Zhuo Fan. They say he alone went to level Old He’s peak. Is it only him under Shui Jing? We’ll test it out and if they’re related to Sir Shui Jing, we’ll just gloss over it. At worst, he’ll lead the Eight Emperors’ lands. It was Old He who messed with the Luo clan. It has nothing to do with us.”
The elders nodded, looking like obscene sycophants with those bobbing heads and flattering looks.
“But…”
The elder with a white long beard looked hard, “But if Sir Shui Jing has nothing to do with Zhuo Fan or the Luo clan, that they’re only acting, then we can’t have this clan breathe a second more, regardless of who leveled the 6th Sacred Mountain. Our dignity shall not be stepped on by some bugs. No one will fear us otherwise!”
They all agreed.
Yep, hard on the weak and cowards against the strong; classic thugs.
Whoosh~
Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian arrived and the elders looked startled.
Zhuo Fan was in the Foundation Establishment Stage, worse than a cripple. But since he could fly in, that meant he was far stronger.
The elders looked grave.
[Caution is advised against him.]
The elder with a long beard began with a cough, “I am 7th Sacred Mountain Lord, He Yunshan. Are you perhaps, the Grand Steward, by the name of Zhuo Fan?”
“It is I.”
Zhuo Fan smiled, “To what do we owe the visit?”
“Why? Steward Zhuo doesn’t know?”
He Yunshan raised an eyebrow in anger, his eyes cold, “Didn’t you hear how everyone says that Steward Zhuo leveled the 6th Sacred Mountain.”
Zhuo Fan nodded with a smile, “There’s no need to hear, for I did do it.”
[Fast talker!]
He Yunshan cursed at Zhuo Fan’s blunt reply while he was looking calm on the outside, even praising him with a thumbs up.
The others were dark.
Zhuo Fan’s carefree reply let them know he wasn’t scared of the hundreds of Saints around. He never gave a hoot about the Sacred Mountains for he had a stronger backer.
[Should we step down then?]
[Old He’s peak got wasted. It’s not our problem anyway. We’re not even close. There’s no need to fight with some mystery expert.]
The elders withdrew on the spot.
He Yunshan paused and shouted, “Since Steward Zhuo admits, then I’ll be frank as well. What has the 6th Sacred Mountain done to earn Steward Zhuo’s ire? As he was of the Seven Sacred Mountains like us, we would like to know the reason.”
[Shit, did we not come to find their limit to see if they can bleed or not? Why nitpick?]
If he was under Shui Jing, then the latter might just come out to ruin them.
[You can kill your mountain for all we care, just don’t drag us into this!]
Everyone sighed, with the elder with long beard pulling He Yunshan’s sleeve, hinting to back off before it was too late.
He Yunshan pulled away in anger with a righteous look.
“Humph, an explanation?”
Zhuo Fan barked, “The Luo clan helped the Sacred Mountains’ disciples handle the Eight Emperors’ lands and bring peace, only to have Mountain Lord He come take our Clan Head to torture and imprison our people. You think I could take that lying down?”
He Haodong faked surprise, “He Haodong did that?”
Ugh!
Even the Saints were stumped.
[Come on, what is that supposed to mean? Don’t act like you don’t know him. Aren’t we on the same side? What’s with the exaggerated shock?]
“Steward Zhuo, please accept my humble apologies.” He Haodong gave a curt bow, “We just didn’t know and ask for your forgiveness. I’d have cut ties with him if I knew he was so despicable and ungrateful. Farewell, Steward Zhuo!”
He Yunshan turned around and left, looking holy.
Zhuo Fan gave him a long look, returning a stiff gesture.
[This guy has no damn shame…]

chapters.title: Chapter 1285: Dragon Emperor
chapters.content:
Proofreader
: Papatonks
The crowd watched the old fool running his mouth with all kinds of tricks then just walked off like it was nothing.
[Oh, right, since they are fleeing from Zhuo Fan, doesn’t that mean that the Sacred Mountains are afraid? What about our dignity? What about ruling the Sacred Domain?]
Since He Haodong was dead and he started lashing out at him, that was just to keep appearances for the people that the Sacred Mountains were still honorable.
